paite: Adam, Seth, Enosh;
english: Adam, Seth, Enosh,

paite: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared;
english: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,

paite: Enok, Methuselah, Lamekh;
english: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

paite: Noah, Shem, Ham leh Japheth.
english: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

paite: Japheth tapate: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek leh Tiras ahi uh.
english: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

paite: Gomer tapate: Ashkenaz, Riphath, leh Togarmah ahi uh.
english: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.

paite: Javan tapate: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, leh Rodanim ahi uh.
english: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

paite: Ham tapate: Kush, Mizraim, leh Put, Kanaan ahi uh.
english: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

paite: Kus tapate: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah leh Sabtekhah ahi uh. Raamah tapate: Seba, leh Dedan ahi uh.
english: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

paite: Kush in Nimrod asuang a; amah lei ah mihat ahong hi pan hi.
english: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one on the earth.

paite: Mizraim in Ludte, Anamte, Lahabte, Naphtuhte,
english: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

paite: Pathruste, Kasluhte, Philistiate hong kipatna leh Kaphtorte asuang hi.
english: Pathrusim, Casluhim (where the Philistines came from), and Caphtorim.

paite: Kanaan in Zidon ata masapen leh Heth asuang a;
english: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, Heth,

paite: Jebus mi, Amor mi, Girgas mi;
english: the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,

paite: Hiv mi, Arki mi, Sin mi.
english: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,

paite: Arvad mi, Zemar mi leh Hamath mi leng asuang hi.
english: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

paite: Shem tapate: Elam, Asshur, Arpakshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, leh Meshek.
english: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.

paite: Arpakshad in Shelah asuang a, huan Shelah in Eber asuang hi.
english: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.

paite: Eber lak ah tapa nih apiang ua: khat pen min Peleg ahi (adam lai in lah lei akikhen ngal a), a-unaupa min Joktan ahi.
english: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.

paite: Joktan in Almodad, Seleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah;
english: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

paite: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah;
english: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

paite: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba;
english: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,

paite: Ophir, Havilah, leh Jobab asuang hi. Hiaite tengteng Joktan tapate ahi uh.
english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

paite: Shem, Arpakshad, Shelah;
english: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,

paite: Eber, Peleg, Reu;
english: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

paite: Serug, Nahor, Terah;
english: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

paite: Abram, huai mah Abraham ahi.
english: Abram (also called Abraham).

paite: Abraham tapate: Isak leh Ishmael ahi.
english: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

paite: Hiaite akhang kizopdan uh ahi: Ishmael ta masapen Nebajoth ahi. Huan Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
english: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

paite: Mishma, Dumah, Massa; Hadad, Tema,
english: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,

paite: Jetur, Naphish, leh Kedemah. Hiaite Ishmael tapate ahi uh.
english: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

paite: Keturah, Abraham mei tapate: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, leh Shuah ahi. Jokshan tapate: Sheba leh Dedan ahi uh.
english: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

paite: Midian tapate: Ephah, Epher, Honok, Abida, leh Eldaah ahi uh. Hiaite tengteng Keturah suante ahi uh.
english: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.

paite: Abraham in Isak asuang hi. Isak tapate: Esau leh Israel ahi uh.
english: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

paite: Esau tapate: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jaalam, leh Korah ahi uh.
english: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

paite: Eliphaz tapate: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, leh Amalek ahi uh.
english: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.

paite: Reuel tapate: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, leh Mizzah ahi uh.
english: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

paite: Seir tapate: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezar leh Dishan ahi uh.
english: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

paite: Lotan tapate: Hori leh Homam; leh Lotan sanggamnu Timna ahi uh.
english: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.

paite: Shobal tapate: Alian, Manahath leh Ebal, Shephi leh Onam ahi uh. Huan Zibeon tapate: Aiah leh Anah ahi uh.
english: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

paite: Anah tapa Dishon ahi. Dishon tapate: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran leh Keran ahi uh.
english: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

paite: Ezer tapate: Bilhan, Zaavan leh Jaakan ahi uh. Dishan tapate: Uz leh Aran ahi uh.
english: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

paite: Huchi in hiaite Israel suante tung a vaihawm kumpipate himhim a-om ma ua, Edom gam a vaihawm kumpipate ahi uhi. Beor tapa Bela, akhopi min Dinhabah ahi.
english: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

paite: Bela asi a, huchi in Bozrah a Zerah tapa Jobab in asik in vai ahawm hi.
english: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.

paite: Jobab asi a, Teman mite gam a Husham in asik in vai ahawm hi.
english: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

paite: Husham asi a, Bedad, Moab gam a Midian mi thattu, Bedad tapa Hadad in asik in vai ahawm a; akhopi min Avith ahi.
english: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.

paite: Hadad asi a, huchi in Masrekah mi Samlah in asik in vai ahawm hi.
english: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

paite: Samlah asi a, huchi in lui kiang a Rehoboth a Shaul in asik in vai ahawm hi.
english: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.

paite: Shaul asi a, huchi in Akbor tapa Baal-hanan in asik in vai ahawm hi.
english: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

paite: Baal-hanan asi a, asik in Hadad in vai ahawm a, akhopi min Pai ahi; huan azi min Mehetabel, Matred tanu, Mezahab tanu ahi.
english: Baal Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

paite: Hadad leng asi hi. Edom hausa makaite: hausa makai Timnah, hausa makai Aliah, hausa makai Jetheth,
english: Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,

paite: hausa makai Aholibamah, hausa makai Elah, hausa makai Pinon,
english: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

paite: hausa makai Kenaz, hausa makai Teman, hausa makai Mibzar,
english: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

paite: hausa makai Magdiel, leh hausa makai Iram; hiaite Edom hausa makaite ahi uhi.
english: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.

paite: Philistia mite'n Israel adou ua; huchi in Israel mite Philistia mite ma ah ataikek ua, Gilboa tang ah thah in a-om uhi.
english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

paite: Philistia mite'n Saul leh atapate adelh vengveng ua; Philistia mite'n Jonathan, Abinadab leh Malki-shua, Saul tapate athat uhi.
english: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

paite: Huchi in kidouna Saul a ding in ahaksa mahmahta a, thalkap mite'n amah aphata uh; huan thalkap mite ziak in alungkham mahmah hi.
english: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.

paite: Huchih lai in Saul in agalvan popa kiang ah, "Na namsau dokkhia inla, huai in hon dawt pailet in; huchi lou in zaw hiai zeksumlouhte hong pai in bawl louhlouh in ahon bawl kha ding uh," achi a. Himahleh agalvan popa a-ut kei; alau mahmah ngal a. Huaiziak in Saul in anamsau ala a kisiatna in aneita hi.
english: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.

paite: Agalvan popa'n Saul asita chih atheih in, huai bangmah in ama'n leng anamsau kisiatna in azang a asita hi.
english: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.

paite: Huchi in Saul asita a, atapa thumte; huan a-inkote tengteng leng asikhawm vek uhi.
english: So Saul died with his three sons; and all his house died together.

paite: Guam a om Israel mite tengteng in sepaihte taikek leh Saul leh atapate asi uh chih amuh un akhopite uh anusia ua, ataikekta uhi. Philistia mite ahong ua huaite ah atengta uhi.
english: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

paite: Azingsang in hichi ahi a, thahsate puante suah ding a Philistia mite ahong pai lai un, Gilboa tang ah Saul leh atapate apuk uh chih amu uhi.
english: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

paite: Huan amah vante asuah ua, alutang ala ua, agalvan leng, amilimte uh kiang leh mite kiang ah tanchin puak ding in Philistia mite gamsung ah akhak kimvel vek uhi.
english: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, then sent into the land of the Philistines all around to carry the news to their idols and to the people.

paite: Huchi in agalvan apathiante uh inn ah akoih ua, Dagon tempul ah alutang atak uhi.
english: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.

paite: Jabesh-gilead tengteng in Saul tung a Philistia mite thilhih tengteng azak un,
english: When all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

paite: mihangsante tengteng athou ua, Saul luang leh atapate luang ava lamang ua, Jabesh ah ahon pua ua, Jabesh a tosaw sing nuai ah aguhte uh avui ua, ni sagih an angawl uhi.
english: all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA tung a tatlekna hih a, TOUPA thu azuih louh a, dawi zawl aisan siam thu adot ziak in Saul asita hi.
english: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against Yahweh, because of Yahweh’s word, which he didn’t keep, and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit, to inquire,

paite: Huai a thu kan a, TOUPA a kipan thu akan louh ziak in: huaiziak in amah athat a, lalgam Jesse tapa David kiang ah apeta hi.
english: and didn’t inquire of Yahweh. Therefore he killed him, and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.

paite: Huchi in Israel tengteng Hebron ah David kiang ah ahong kikhawm ua, "Ngai in, na guh leh na sa ka hi uh.
english: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

paite: Tuma lam in, Saul mahmah kumpipa ahih lai in, Israel pikhia a pilut nang na hi a; TOUPA na Pathian in na kiang ah, Israel ka mite na vak ding a, ka mite Israel tung ah lal na hi ding hi, hon chi,” achi uhi.
english: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. Yahweh your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’”

paite: Huchi in Israel Upa tengteng Hebron ah kumpipa kiang ah ahong pai ua; huan David in Hebron ah TOUPA ma ah amau toh thukhun abawlpih a; Samuel khut a TOUPA thu bang in, Israel tung a kumpipa ding in David thau anilh uhi.
english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Yahweh. They anointed David king over Israel, according to Yahweh’s word by Samuel.

paite: David leh Israel tengteng Jerusalem, huai tuh Jebus ahi a, huai ah ahoh ua; huchi in Jebus mite, huai gam a tengte huai ah a-om uhi.
english: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.

paite: Huchi in Jebus a tengte'n David kiang ah, "Hiai lam a na hong louh ding ahi," achi ua. Himahleh David in Zion kulh muanhuai ala a; huai mah David khopi ahi.
english: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here!” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.

paite: David in, "Kuapeuh Jebus mite that masa penpen alianpen leh heutu ahi ding," achi a. Huan Zeruiah tapa Joab akuantou masapen a, huchi in amah alianpen a bawl in a-omta hi.
english: David had said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.

paite: David bel kulh muanhuai ah ateng a; huaiziak in David khopi achi uhi.
english: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it David’s city.

paite: Huchi in khopi abawlsuak vek a, Millo kimvel a kipan nangawn in: huchi in Joab in khopi dangte abawlhoih vek hi.
english: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

paite: Akiang a sepaihte' TOUPA a-om ziak in, David ahong thupi semsem hi.
english: David grew greater and greater, for Yahweh of Armies was with him.

paite: Hiaite David neih mihatte lak a amakaipente ahi uh, Israel tungtang a TOUPA thu bang zel a, amah kumpipa dia bawl ding a, Israel tengteng toh, agamsung a amah lak a ahatna uh taklangte.
english: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to Yahweh’s word concerning Israel.

paite: Hiai David in aneih mihatte zah ahi: Jashobeam, Hakmon mi tapa, sawmthumte lak a makai lianpen; zathumte dou ding in ateipi alek a khatvei thu in amaute athat hi.
english: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.

paite: Amah nung in Dodo tapa Eleazar, Ahoh mi, mihat thumte lak a khat ahi hi.
english: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.

paite: Pasdammim ah David kiang ah a-om a, huai ah kidou tum in Philistia mite akikhawm ua, barli buh a dimna mun ah; Philistia mite ma a kipan in mite ataikekta uhi.
english: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

paite: Huchi in huai mun laitak ah adingh ua, ahum ua, Philistia mite athat uhi; TOUPA'N zohna thupitak in amaute ahondamta hi.
english: They stood in the middle of the plot, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and Yahweh saved them by a great victory.

paite: Heutu lian sawmthumte lak a thum suangpi a David kiang ah, Adullam kokhuk ah ahohsuk uhi; Philistia mite tampite'n Rephaim Phaizang ah puanin akai uhi.
english: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

paite: Huai lai in David bel kohawm sung ah a-om a, Philistia mite kulhpi bel Bethlehem ah a-om hi.
english: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time.

paite: Huchi in David in tui alunggulh a, "Aw kongpi kiang a om, Bethlehem tuileh tui dawn ding a hong pia mi khat omleh chi na ing e!" achi hi.
english: David longed, and said, “Oh, that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”

paite: Huai thumte'n Philistia mite tampi lak aphu paisuak ua, kongpi kiang a om, Bethlehem tuileh a kipan tui ava tawi ua, ahon la ua, David kiang ahon tun uhi: himahleh David in adawn nuam kei a, TOUPA a ding in abungkhe zaw hi.
english: The three broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, took it, and brought it to David; but David would not drink any of it, but poured it out to Yahweh,

paite: Hiai ka hih, ka Pathian in hon phal kei hen: ahinna uh lauhuaina a koih hiai mite sisan ka dawn ding hia? Amaute'n lah ahinna uh lauthawnna toh hon tawi uh ahi ngal ua,” achi hi. Huaiziak in adawn nuamta kei hi. Hiai thilte huai mihat thumte'n ahih uh ahi.
english: and said, “My God forbid me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy?” For they risked their lives to bring it. Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.

paite: Abishai, Joab unaupa, huai thumte lak a khat ahi: ama'n zathumte dou ding in ateipi alik a amaute athat a, mi thumte lak ah min aneita hi.
english: Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.

paite: Thumte lak ah, nihte sang in, amah azahtakhuai zaw hi, huchi in aheutupa ding ua bawl in a-om hi: hita mahleh thum masate zaw apha kei.
english: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain; however he wasn’t included in the three.

paite: Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, Kabzeel a mihangsan, thilhih thupite hihpa tapa, Moab a Ariel tapate nihte athat a: apaisuk lai a, vuk kiak lai in kokhuk lak ah humpinelkai athat hi.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.

paite: Aigupta mi athat a, milian mahmah, tong nga a sang; huan Aigupta mi khut a ateipi siamganmi chiam bang ahi; huchi in akiang ah chiangkhun toh ahohsuk a, Aigupta mi khut a kipan teipi ala a, amah mah teipi in ahihlumta hi.
english: He killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high. In the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.

paite: Hiai thilte Jehoiada tapa Benaiah in ahih a, huchi in huai mihat thumte lak ah min anei hi.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things and had a name among the three mighty men.

paite: Ngai in, sawmthumte sang in zahtakhuaizaw in a-om a, himahleh thum masate zaw apha kei, huchi in David in agalvil heutu in amah akoih hi.
english: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three; and David set him over his guard.

paite: Sepaih pawlte a mihatte: Joab unaupa Asahel, Bethlehem a Dodo tapa Elhanan;
english: The mighty men of the armies also include Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

paite: Haror mi Shammoth, Pelon mi Helez;
english: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

paite: Tekoa mi Ikkesh tapa Ira, Antoth mi Abiezer.
english: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,

paite: Husat mi Sibbekai, Ahoh mi Ilai;
english: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

paite: Netophah mi Maharai, Netophah mi Baanah tapa Heled;
english: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

paite: Benjamin tate Gibeah a Ribai tapa Ithai, Pirathon mi Benaiah;
english: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

paite: Gaash luitate a Hurai, Arbath mi Abiel.
english: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

paite: Baharum mi Azmaveth, Saalbon mi Eliahba;
english: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

paite: Gizon mi Hasem tapate, Harar mi Shage tapa Jonathan;
english: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,

paite: Harar mi Sakar tapa Ahiam, Ur tapa Eliphal;
english: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

paite: Mekerath mi Hepher, Pelon mi Ahijah;
english: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

paite: Karmel mi Hezro, Ezbai tapa Naarai;
english: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

paite: Nahtan unaupa Joel, Hageri tapa Mibhar.
english: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,

paite: Ammon mi Zelek, Beroth mi Naharai, Joab galvan pomi Zeruiah tapa;
english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite (the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah),

paite: Ithri mi Ira, Ithri mi Gareb;
english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

paite: Hit mi Uriah, Ahlai tapa Zabad;
english: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

paite: Reuben mi Shiza tapa Adina, Reuben mite lak a makai lianpen leh akiang a sawmthumte.
english: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite (a chief of the Reubenites), and thirty with him,

paite: Maakah tapa Hanan, Mithni mi Josaphat;
english: Hanan the son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,

paite: Asterath mi Uzzia, Aroer mi Hotham tapate Shama leh Jehiel,
english: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,

paite: Shimri tapa Jediael, Tiz mi a-unaupa Joha;
english: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

paite: Mahavi mi Eliel leh Jeribai, leh Elnaam tapate Joshaviah, Moab mi Ithmah;
english: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

paite: Eliel, Obed leh Mezoba mi Jaasiel ahi uh.
english: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

paite: Huchi in hiaite Kish tapa Saul ziak a akihepmang lai a Ziklag a David kiang a hong paite ahi uh: huchi in kidouna a amah panpih mite mihatte lak ah a-om uhi.
english: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish. They were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.

paite: Thalte in akigalthuam ua, suangkap leh thalpeu a thalkap ah khut taklam leh veilam azang thei ua; amaute Saul unau, Benjamin a kipan ahi uhi.
english: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow. They were of Saul’s relatives of the tribe of Benjamin.

paite: Amakaipen Ahiezer ahi, huan Joash, Gibeah mi Shemaah tapate: Azmaveth tapate Jeziel leh Pelet; Berkah, Antoth mi Jehu;
english: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;

paite: Gibeon mi Ishmaiah, sawmthumte lak a mihat, sawmthumte tung ah; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan leh Geerath mi Jozabad;
english: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty and a leader of the thirty; Jeremiah; Jahaziel; Johanan; Jozabad the Gederathite;

paite: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah leh Haruph mi Shephatiah;
english: Eluzai; Jerimoth; Bealiah; Shemariah; Shephatiah the Haruphite;

paite: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer leh Korahith mi Jashobeam;
english: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;

paite: Gedor mi Jeroham tapate Joelah leh Zebadiah ahi uh.
english: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

paite: Gad mite ahihleh gamdai a kulh ah David lam ah akituamseh ua, mihangsan, kidouna a dia chilsa, lum leh teipi khoih theite; amaitang uh humpinelkaite maitang bang, mual a sazate bang a kin;
english: Some Gadites joined David in the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for war, who could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains:

paite: Ezer apipen, azom in Obadiah, Eliab athumna;
english: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

paite: Mishmannah alina, Jeremiah angana;
english: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

paite: Attai agukna, Eliel asagihna;
english: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

paite: Johanan agiatna, Elzabad akuana;
english: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

paite: Jeremiah asawmna, Makbannai asawm-le-khatna.
english: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai the eleventh.

paite: Hiai Gad tapate lak ate sepaihte heutute ahi uh: aneupen zakhat toh akikim a, alianpen pen sangkhat toh.
english: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the army. He who was least was equal to one hundred, and the greatest to one thousand.

paite: Hiaite Jordan lui piaute tui in atup lai a, akha khatna a kan a paite ahi ua; huchi in phaizang a om tengteng, suahlam leh tumlam tuaktuak, delhzakte ahi uh.
english: These are those who went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all who lived in the valleys, both toward the east and toward the west.

paite: Benjamin leh Judah tate lak a mi, kulh ah David kiang ah ahong uhi.
english: Some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.

paite: Huchi in amaute tuak ding in David apaikhia a, amaute kiang ah, "Hon panpih dia lemna deih a ka kiang a hong na hih ualeh, nou a ding in ka lungtang phankhawm ahi ding; himahleh ka khut ah bangmah hiamgamna a-om kei chih thei a, ka galte a dia kei hon man ding a hong pai na hih uleh, ka pipute uh Pathian in huai en henla, sal hen," achi hi.
english: David went out to meet them, and answered them, “If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it.”

paite: Huai lai in sawmthumte lak a amakai lianpenpa, Amasai tung ah kha ahong tung a, "Nang David, Jesse tapa, nang a, nang lam a pang ka hi uh: na kiang ah muanna om henla, nang hon panpih mite kiang ah muanna: na Pathian in lah nang ahon panpih ngal a,” achi hi. Huai lai in David in amaute ana kipahpih a, pawl heutute ding in abawlta hi.
english: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse. Peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you.” Then David received them and made them captains of the band.

paite: Manasseh a kipan in leng khenkhatte, hong taikhia in kidouna a Saul dou ding a Philistia mite toh hong pai in David lam ah ahong belh ua; himahleh amaute'n amaute apanpih kei uh. Philistia mite toupate'n thu hilh in amah asawlmang ngal ua, i lupente uh lauthawnghuaina ding in, "Saul, heutupa lam ah apukmang ding," chi in.
english: Some of Manasseh also joined David when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle, but they didn’t help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.”

paite: Ziklag a David ahoh in, Manasseh a kipan amah lam ah hong puklut a-om ua, Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Mikael, Jozabad, Elihu, Zilthai, Manasseh a kipan sangkhatte heutute ahi uhi.
english: As he went to Ziklag, some from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.

paite: Huan galguk bawlte dou ding in David apanpih uh; amau lah mihat hangsante leh sepaih lak a heutute ahi ngal ua.
english: They helped David against the band of raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and were captains in the army.

paite: Sepaih pawl thupi, Pathian sepaih pawl bang a hong hih masiah uh niteng in David kiang ah amah panpih ding in ahong paikhawm uhi.
english: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like God’s army.

paite: Hiaite TOUPA thu bang a Saul gam amah a dia bawl dia kidou ding kigalthuamte huaite lupente Hebron a David kiang a hong paite ahi uhi.
english: These are the numbers of the heads of those who were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to Yahweh’s word.

paite: Judah tate lum leh teipi tawi theite sangguk-le-zagiat, kidou ding a kigalthuam.
english: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, armed for war.

paite: Simeon tate ah kidouna ding a, mihat hangsante, sangsagih-le-zakhat.
english: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valor for the war: seven thousand one hundred.

paite: Levi tate ah sangli-le-zaguk.
english: Of the children of Levi: four thousand six hundred.

paite: ehoiada bel Aaron inkote pipa ahi a, amah toh sangthum-le-zasagih a-om uhi;
english: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron; and with him were three thousand seven hundred,

paite: Tangval hat hangsan, Zadok leh apa inkote heutu sawmnih-le-nih.
english: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father’s house twenty-two captains.

paite: Benjamin tate, Saul unaute, sangthum: amaute lak a thupi penpente Saul inkote lam ah aginom lailai uhi.
english: Of the children of Benjamin, Saul’s relatives: three thousand, for until then, the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to Saul’s house.

paite: Ephraim tate ah singnih-le-zagiat, mihat hangsan, apipute uh inkote a miminthangte.
english: Of the children of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers’ houses.

paite: Manasseh nam kimkhatte singkhat-le-sanggiat, hong a, David kumpipa a bawl dia, min genkhiakte.
english: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.

paite: Issakar tate, hunte theihsiamna nei mite, Israel in bang ahih dia chih thei ding; amaute lupente zanih ahi uh; huan a-unaute tengteng uh amau thupiak in a-om uhi.
english: Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were two hundred; and all their brothers were at their command.

paite: Zebulun a kipan, sepaih pawl kuankhe theite bang, kidouna van chi chih toh kigalthuamsa singnga; kidou ding a kigalthuamsa, lungsim thuah nih nei lou mite.
english: Of Zebulun, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array with all kinds of instruments of war: fifty thousand who could command and were not of double heart.

paite: Naphtali a kipan heutu sangkhat, amaute kiang ah lum leh teipi tawi singthum-le-sangsagih.
english: Of Naphtali: one thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty-seven thousand.

paite: Dan mite kidou ding a kigal thuamsa, singnih sanggiat-le-zaguk.
english: Of the Danites who could set the battle in array: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.

paite: Asher a kipan, sepaih pawl akuankhe thei, kidou ding a kigalthuamsa singli.
english: Of Asher, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array: forty thousand.

paite: Jordan lehlam gal ah, Reuben mite leh Gad mite leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte a kipan, kidouna a ding a kidouna vanzat chi chih toh nuaikhat-le-singnih.
english: On the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle: one hundred twenty thousand.

paite: Hiaite tengteng, kidoumi ngen hi in, kidou ding a kigalthuamsa, lungtang bukim toh Hebron ah David, Israel tengteng tung a kumpipa dia bawl ding in ahong pai ua: David kumpipa a bawl ding in Israel dang tengteng in lungkhat apu chiat uhi.
english: All these were men of war who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.

paite: Huchi in huai ah David kiang a, ne leh dawn in, ni thum a-om uh; a-unaute un lah amau a ding in kisakna abawl ngal ua.
english: They were there with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brothers had supplied provisions for them.

paite: Huai ban ah Issakar, Zebulun leh Naphtali tanpha a teng amau kiangnai a omte'n, sabiltungte leh sangawngsaute leh sakol neute leh bawngtalte in tanghou ahon pua ua, an nek ding, theipi gah beute, grep minbomte, uain leh sathau, atam a tam bawngtalte leh belamte: Israel nopsakna thupi ahi.
english: Moreover those who were near to them, as far as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali, brought bread on donkeys, on camels, on mules, and on oxen: supplies of flour, cakes of figs, clusters of raisins, wine, oil, cattle, and sheep in abundance; for there was joy in Israel.

paite: Huchi in David in heutu leh makai chiteng, sangte leh zate heutute toh thu akikum uhi.
english: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.

paite: David in Israel kikhawmte tengteng kiang ah, "Hoih na sak ua, TOUPA i Pathian ua kipan ahihleh, mun chiteng a Israel gam tengteng nutsiat a om i unaute kiang ah thu i khak ding ua, loupa munte nei akhopite ua akiang ua siampute leh Levi mite om, huchi a i kiang a ahong kikhopkhawm theihna ding un.
english: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of Yahweh our God, let’s send word everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have pasture lands, that they may gather themselves to us.

paite: Huchi in i Pathian uh bawm i lakik nawn ding uhi; Saul hun lai in i na zong kei uhi," achi hi.
english: Also, let’s bring the ark of our God back to us again, for we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”

paite: Kikhawmpi tengteng in huchibang in i hih ding uh achi ua: mi tengteng mit ah huai thil dik ahi ngal a.
english: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

paite: Huchi in David in Israel tengteng Aigupta gam luita Shihor a kipan Hamath lutna chiang pha in, Kiriath- jearim a kipan a Pathian bawm va la ding in amite akaikhawm hi.
english: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.

paite: Huchi in David, Israel tengteng toh, Baalah huai bel, Kiriath-jearim ah ahi, huai tuh Judah gam ahi a, huai a kipan a Pathian, TOUPA Cherubte tung a tupa, aminlohna om va la ding in akuantou hi.
english: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God Yahweh’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.

paite: Pathian bawm kangtalai thak in apua ua, Abinadab inn a kipan alakhia ua: huchi in Uzza leh Ahio in ahawl uhi.
english: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

paite: Huchi in David leh Israel tengteng Pathian ma ah ahatna tengteng un late, kaihgingte, pekging gui sawm neite, khuangtate, dakkhutbette leh pengkulte toh lopna bawl in a-om uhi.
english: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets.

paite: Huan Chidon buhchilna phual ahong tun un, bawngtalte akisuih man un, Uzza in bawm len ding in akhut in asawk hi.
english: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.

paite: Uzza tung ah TOUPA hehna asouta a, bawm a akhut akhoih ziak in, amah ahihlumta hi: huchi in Pathian ma ah asita hi.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.

paite: TOUPA Uzza tung a apuahkhap ziak in, David alungkim kei hi: huchi in huai lai tuni tan in, Perez-uzzah achita hi.
english: David was displeased, because Yahweh had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.

paite: Huai ni in David in Pathian akihta a, bangchi in Pathian bawm inn ka kitun thei dia? chi in.
english: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”

paite: Huchi in ama'n akiang a, David khopi sung ah bawm apolut kei a, Git mi Obed-edom insung ah apolut zawta hi.
english: So David didn’t move the ark with him into David’s city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.

paite: Pathian bawm bel kha thum Obed-edom inkote kiang ah insung ah a-om a: huchi in TOUPA'N Obed-edom leh aneih tengteng avualzawlta hi.
english: God’s ark remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months; and Yahweh blessed Obed-Edom’s house and all that he had.

paite: Huchi in Tura kumpipa Hiram in David kiang ah sawltak mite asawl a, sidar singte, suangsek mite, khutsiam mite, inn lamsak ding in.
english: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.

paite: David in Israel tung ah TOUPA'N amah kumpipa in akoihkipta chih athei a, agam lah, ami Israelte, sangpi a tawisang in a-omta hi.
english: David perceived that Yahweh had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, for his people Israel’s sake.

paite: David in Jerusalem ah zite tamsem api a: huchi in David in tapate leh tanute tamsem asuangta hi.
english: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.

paite: Hiaite Jerusalem a aneih tate minte ahi; Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon;
english: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

paite: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpalet;
english: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,

paite: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia;
english: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

paite: Elishama, Beeliada, Eliphalet.
english: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.

paite: Philistia mite'n Israel tengteng tung ah kumpipa a David thaunilh ahi chih azak un, David zong ding in Philistia mite tengteng akuantou ua: David in huai azak in, amaute dou ding in akuankheta hi.
english: When the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went out against them.

paite: Philistia mite ahong ua, Rephaim Phaizang atuam uhi.
english: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.

paite: Huchi in David in Pathian adong a, "Philistia mite dou ding in ka kuantou diam? Amau ka khut ah na hon pe diam?" chi in. TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Kuantou in; na khut a amaute hon pe ding ka hi," achi hi.
english: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” Yahweh said to him, “Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.”

paite: Huchi in Baal-perazim ah ahong tou ua, David in amau athat a; huchi in David in, "Pathian in tui khah bang in ka khut in ka melmate ahihsia," achi a. Huaiziak in huai mun min ding in Baal-perazim asa hi.
english: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like waters breaking out. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

paite: Huai ah apathiante uh anusia ua; David in thupiak apia a, mei in ahal uhi.
english: They left their gods there; and David gave a command, and they were burned with fire.

paite: Huchih nung in Philistiate'n phaizang atuam nawn lai uhi.
english: The Philistines made another raid in the valley.

paite: David in Pathian thu adong nawn a; Pathian in akiang ah, "Amau delh ding in na kuantou kei ding: amau kihei mangsan inla, singtheimi singte zawntak ah amau sual in,” achi hi.
english: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them opposite the mulberry trees.

paite: "Singthei mi singte dawn a taiging na zak chiang in; huai chiang in kidou ding in na kuankhe ding hi: Philistia mihonte that ding in na ma ah Pathian akuankheta chihna ahi ding hi," achi hi.
english: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”

paite: Huchi in Pathian in amah thu apiak bang in David in ahih a: Gibeon a kipan Gezer pha in Philistia mihonpi athatta uhi.
english: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.

paite: Huan gam tengteng ah David min athangkheta a; huchi in TOUPA'N nam tengteng tung ah amah launa atungsakta hi.
english: The fame of David went out into all lands; and Yahweh brought the fear of him on all nations.

paite: Huchi in David khopi sung ah David in innte akibawl a; Pathian bawm a ding in mun abawl a, puanin akaihsakta hi.
english: David made himself houses in David’s city; and he prepared a place for God’s ark, and pitched a tent for it.

paite: Huai lai in David in, "Levi mite chih louh kuamah in Pathian bawm apo ding ahi kei: TOUPA'N lah amau Pathian bawm po ding leh tangtawn a amah nna sepsak ding in amaute ana telta ngal a," achi hi.
english: Then David said, “No one ought to carry God’s ark but the Levites. For Yahweh has chosen them to carry God’s ark, and to minister to him forever.”

paite: Amun abawlsaksa a TOUPA bawm hon latou ding in, David in Jerusalem ah Israel tengteng akaikhawmta hi.
english: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up Yahweh’s ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.

paite: Huchi in David in Aaron tapate leh Levi mite akhawm a;
english: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:

paite: Kohath tapate lak ah: amakai lianpen Uriel leh a-unaute za-le-sawmnih;
english: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brothers one hundred twenty;

paite: Merrari tapate lak ah: amakai lianpen Asaiah leh a-unaute zanih-le-sawmnih;
english: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred twenty;

paite: Gershom tapate lak ah: amakai lianpen Joel leh a-unaute za-le-sawmthum;
english: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brothers one hundred thirty;

paite: Elizaphan tapate lak ah: amakai lianpen Shemaiah leh a-unaute zanih;
english: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred;

paite: Hebron tapate lak ah: amakai lianpen Eliel leh a-unaute sawmgiat;
english: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brothers eighty;

paite: Uzziel tapate lak ah: amakai lianpen Amminadab leh a-unaute za-le-sawm-le-nih.
english: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brothers one hundred twelve.

paite: David in Zadok leh Abiathar siampute, Levi mite, Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel leh Amminadab asamsak a,
english: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites: for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,

paite: akiang uah, "Noute Levi mite pipute inkuan a lupente na hi ua: kihihsiang unla, nou leh na unaute uh, mun ka bawlsaksa a Israel' Pathian, TOUPA bawm na laktheihna ding un.
english: and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, both you and your brothers, that you may bring the ark of Yahweh, the God of Israel, up to the place that I have prepared for it.

paite: Atung a pan hih ding achih bang a amah i zon louh ziak un, i tung uah TOUPA i Pathian apuakzak hi," achi hi.
english: For because you didn’t carry it at first, Yahweh our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him according to the ordinance.”

paite: Huchi in siampute leh Levi mite, Israel' Pathian, TOUPA bawm latou ding in akisiangsak uhi.
english: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA thu bangbang a Mosi in thu apiak bang in Levi tate'n aliangzang uah huai a chiangtawnte in Pathian bawm azawngta uhi.
english: The children of the Levites bore God’s ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to Yahweh’s word.

paite: David in Levi mi makaipente kiang ah a-unaute uh lasa mite tumging theihte toh, pekging gui sawm neite leh kaihgingte leh dakkhutbette, ngaihtak a ging leh nuamsa a aw suah ding sep ding in ahilh hi.
english: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up their voices with joy.

paite: Huchi in Levi mite'n Joel tapa Heman asep ua; a-unaute lak ah, Asaph Berekiah tapa; huan Merari tapate a-unaute uh lak ah, Kusaiah tapa Ethan;
english: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

paite: amau toh a-unaute uh pawl nihnate, Zekariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, kongkhak ngak mite.
english: and with them their brothers of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.

paite: Huchi in lasami, Heman, Asaph, Ethente seh in a-omta ua, ngaihtak a tum ding, dal dakkhutbette toh;
english: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud;

paite: Zekariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, Benaiah, pekging gui sawm neite Alamoth toh kituak a bawl toh;
english: and Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with stringed instruments set to Alamoth;

paite: Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mineiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, Azaziah, kaihgingte Sheminith toh bawl, makai ding in.
english: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead.

paite: Huan Kenaniah, Levi mite lak a amakai lianpen, lapu in apang a: asiam ziak in, la hilh in apang hi.
english: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the singing. He taught the singers, because he was skillful.

paite: Berekiah leh Elkanah bawm a dia kongkhak ngak mite in a-om uhi.
english: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.

paite: Shebaniah, Josaphat, Nethaneel, Amasai, Zekariah, Benaiah, Eliezer, siampute'n, Pathian bawm ma ah pengkulte amut ua: Obed-edom leh Jehiah tuh bawm a dia kongkhak ngakte ahi uhi.
english: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before God’s ark; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

paite: Huan David leh Israel Upa, sangte tung a heutute, Obed-edom inn a kipan TOUPA'N thukhun bawm latou ding in nuamsatak in akuanta uhi.
english: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring the ark of Yahweh’s covenant up out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian in TOUPA bawm zawng Levi mite apanpih ziak in, amau bawngtal sagih leh belamtal sagih in akithoih uhi.
english: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

paite: David, puanmalngat hoih puanaktual in akizem a, bawm zawng Levi mi tengteng leh lasa mite leh la heutupa Kenaniah lasa mite toh, huchi in David in puanmalngat siampu lian puanak asilh hi.
english: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the choir master with the singers; and David had an ephod of linen on him.

paite: Huchibang in Israel tengteng in TOUPA thukhun bawm kikou kawm leh pengkul ging binei toh, pengkulte toh, dakkhutbette toh pekging gui sawm neite leh kaihgingte ngaihtak a ging toh, ahon latouta uhi.
english: Thus all Israel brought the ark of Yahweh’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA thukhun bawm David khopi ahong tun in, Saul tanu Mikal tohlet ah adakkhia a, David lam leh mawl amuta a; alungtang in amusit hi.
english: As the ark of Yahweh’s covenant came to David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.

paite: Huchi in Pathian bawm ahon lalut ua, David in abawlsak, puanin laizang ah akoihta ua, Pathian ma ah halmang thillatte leh lemna thillatte alan uhi.
english: They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.

paite: David in halmang thillat leh lemna thillatte alat khit in TOUPA min in mite avualzawl hi.
english: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in Yahweh’s name.

paite: Israel michih kiang ah, pasal leh numei michih kiang ah tanghou beu khat, sa bak khat leh grep min gaw beu khat ahawm hi.
english: He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA bawm mai a nasem ding leh TOUPA, Israel' Pathian kipahpih ding, kipahthu gen ding leh phat ding in Levi mite lak a kuate hiam asepta hi:
english: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before Yahweh’s ark, and to commemorate, to thank, and to praise Yahweh, the God of Israel:

paite: Amakai lianpen Asaph, amah zom in Zekariah, Shemiramoth, Jeiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, pekging gui sawm neite leh kaihgingte toh; Asaph dakkhutbette, ngaihtak a ging toh;
english: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;

paite: Benaiah leh Jahaziel siampute Pathian thukhun bawm ma a, om nilouhte toh.
english: with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.

paite: Huchi in huai ni in David in, Asaph leh a-unaute khut ah, TOUPA kiang a kipahthute gen ding ahihkip masa penpen hi.
english: Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to Yahweh by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.

paite: Aw TOUPA kiang ah kipahthute gen unla, amin lou un; mite lak ah athilhihte theisak un.
english: Oh give thanks to Yahweh. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.

paite: Amah mai ah la sa unla, phatna late sa un; anasep lamdangte tengteng thu in houlim un.
english: Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works.

paite: Amin siangthou suang unla: TOUPA zongte lungtang kipak hen.
english: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.

paite: TOUPA leh ahatna zong unla; amel zong nilouh un.
english: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

paite: Ahih khitsa athillamdangte theigige unla; alamdannate leh, akam a vaihawmte;
english: Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

paite: Aw nou asikha Israel chi, nou amitel, Jakob tate.
english: you offspring of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

paite: Amah TOUPA i Pathian ahi: ama'n leitung pumpi vai ahawm hi.
english: He is Yahweh our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

paite: Tangtawn in athukhun theigige unla, suan sangkhatte kiang a apiak athu;
english: Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

paite: Thukhun Abraham toh abawl, Isak kiang a athuchiam;
english: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac.

paite: Huai mah dan thuseh ding in Jakob kiang ah ahihkip a, Israel kiang ah tangtawn thukhun ding in;
english: He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

paite: "Na kiang ah Kanaan gam, na goutan tuan, ka hon pe ding," chi in;
english: saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance,”

paite: Mi tawmchik phet na hih lai un; ahi, tawmchik mahmah, asung a mikhual in;
english: when you were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

paite: Nam dangdang kiang ah abanhoh ua, gam dangdang a kipan in mi tuamtuamte kiang ah.
english: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

paite: Kuamah nuaisiah aphal kei a; ahi, amaute ziak in kumpipate leng asal hi;
english: He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

paite: "Ka thaunilhte khoih kei unla, ka zawlneite leng hihna kei un," chi in.
english: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

paite: Leitung luahte tengteng aw, TOUPA pahtawi in la sa unla, niteng in ahotdamna thu theisak un.
english: Sing to Yahweh, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.

paite: Namte lak ah athupidan gen unla, michihte lak ah athilhih lamdangte genzak un.
english: Declare his glory among the nations, and his marvelous works among all the peoples.

paite: TOUPA lah athupi a, nakpi mahmah a phat ding ahih ziak in pathian tengteng sang a kihtak ding ahi.
english: For great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.

paite: Michih pathiante milim ahi ua; TOUPA'N bel vante abawl hi.
english: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but Yahweh made the heavens.

paite: Pahtawina leh thupina ama ah a-om a; hatna leh kilawmna ama mun ah a-om hi.
english: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.

paite: Michih a chichihte aw, TOUPA kiang ah pia unla, TOUPA thupina leh hatna pia un.
english: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of the peoples, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength!

paite: TOUPA amin thupina pia unla, thillat ding tawi unla, ama ah hong pai un; siangthou kilawmna in TOUPA bia un.
english: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship Yahweh in holy array.

paite: Leitung tengteng aw, ama ah ling un; khovel leng alin theihlouhna ding in hihkip in a-om hi.
english: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.

paite: Vante kipaktak in om uhenla, leitung leng nuamsatak in om hen; namte lak ah "TOUPA'N vai ahawm," chi uhen.
english: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns!”

paite: Tuipi leh asung a thil om tengteng ging honhon henla; gam leh asung a om tengteng kipaktak in om hen;
english: Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field exult, and all that is in it!

paite: Huai hun chiang in gamnuai a sing tengteng in TOUPA ma ah nuamsa in la asa ding ua, leitung vaihawm ding in ahong pai sin ngal a.
english: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth.

paite: Aw TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu gen un, amah lah ahoih ngal a; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

paite: "Aw, ka hotdamna uh Pathian, hon hondam inla, na min siangthou phat ding leh na phatna suang ding in, namte lak a kipan hon pikhawm inla, hon humbit in," chi un.
english: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise.”

paite: Israel' Pathian TOUPA phat in om hen, tangtawn a kipan tangtawn dong in. Mipi tengteng in, Amen, chi in TOUPA aphatta uhi.
english: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting. All the people said, “Amen,” and praised Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in huai a TOUPA thukhun bawm ma a niteng a akuldan bang zel a nasem ding in Asaph leh a- unaute akoihta a;
english: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;

paite: Obed-edom leh a-unau uh sawmguk-le-giatte toh; Jeduthun tapa Obed-edom leh Hosah bel kongkhak ngakmi ahi uhi;
english: and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight relatives; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;

paite: Huan Zadok siampu leh a-unaute siampute, Gibeon a om mun sang a TOUPA biakbuk ma a,
english: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before Yahweh’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,

paite: zingsang leh nitak a halmang thillat maitam tung a TOUPA a dia halmang thillatte lan gige ding in, Israel kiang ah thupiak a piak TOUPA, dan sung a kigelh dungzui in;
english: to offer burnt offerings to Yahweh on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in Yahweh’s law, which he commanded to Israel;

paite: Azahngaihna tangtawn a a-om ziak in TOUPA kiang a kipahthu gen ding Heman leh Jeduthun leh midang min loh a telkhiakte toh;
english: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to Yahweh, because his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Heman leh Jeduthun in Pathian lasakna dia vanzatte, pengkulte leh dakkhutbette, ngaihtak a ginsak dingte anei ua; kongkhak ngakmi ding Jeduthun tapate toh.
english: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.

paite: Huchi in mipi tengteng amau inn lam chiat ah apaita ua; huan David leng a-inkote vualzawl ding in apai sam hi.
english: All the people departed, each man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, David a-inn a a-om lai in zawlnei Nathan kiang ah David in, "Ngai in, kei sidar sing inn ah ka om a, himahleh TOUPA thukhun bawm puanzak nuai maimah ah a-om a," achi hi.
english: When David was living in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, “Behold, I live in a cedar house, but the ark of Yahweh’s covenant is in a tent.”

paite: Nathan in David kiang ah, "Na lungsim a na vei bangtak in hih in; Pathian na kiang ah lah a-om ngal a," achi hi.
english: Nathan said to David, “Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you.”

paite: Huai zan mah in hichi ahong hi a, Nathan kiang ah Pathian thu ahong tung hi,
english: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

paite: "Ka sikha David va hilh in, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Ka omna ding in nang inn na hon lamsak ding ahi kei;
english: “Go and tell David my servant, ‘Yahweh says, “You shall not build me a house to dwell in;

paite: Israel suante Aigupta gam a kipan ka pikhiak a kipan tutan in inn lam ah ka om kei a; puanin leh biakbuk ah ka om zel hi.
english: for I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tent to another.

paite: Israel tengteng toh ka paina himhim uah leng ka mite vak ding a thu ka piak Israelte vaihawmte kiang ah, bangziak a sidar sing inn hon lamsak lou, ka chi ngei a hia?'
english: In all places in which I have walked with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’

paite: "Huaiziak in ka sikha David kiang ah huchi in gen in, Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi, belam tatna mun a kipan na belamching lai ka mi Israelte tung a kumpipa ding in ka hon la a;
english: “Now therefore, you shall tell my servant David, ‘Yahweh of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel.

paite: na paina peuhmah ah na kiang ah ka om zel a, na melmate ka hon hihmansak zel hi; lei a mithupi mahmahte bang in min thupitak ka hon bawlsak sin hi.
english: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.

paite: Ka mi Israelte a ding in mun ka sepsak ding a, kisuan nawn lou a amau tuam mun a a-om gige theihna ding un amaute ka phutkip ding a, tuma lam a bang in, migiloute'n amaute ahihgenthei nawn kei ding uh;
english: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not waste them any more, as at the first,

paite: ka mi Israelte tung a vaihawmte ka seh hun a kipan. Huan na melma tengteng leng ka zahlaksak lai ding hi. Huai lou leng TOUPA'N inn khat ahon lamsak lai ding chih ka hon hilh ahi.
english: and from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover I tell you that Yahweh will build you a house.

paite: Huchi in na ni abei a, na pi-le-pute kiang a na pai hun chiang in, hichi ahi ding a, na nung a na suan na tapate lak a mi ka tungding ding a; agam ka hihkip ding hi.
english: It will happen, when your days are fulfilled that you must go to be with your fathers, that I will set up your offspring after you, who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

paite: Ama'n inn ahon lamsak ding a; alaltutphah tangtawn in ka hihkip ding.
english: He will build me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.

paite: Huchi in apa ka hi ding a, amah ka tapa ahi ding; ka zahngaihna na ma a ompa a kipan a ka lakmang bang in, amah zaw ka lamang kei ding hi;
english: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from him who was before you;

paite: Ka inn ah leh ka gam ah amah tangtawn in ka dingkipsak ding a, alaltutphah tangtawn a hihkip ahi ding," chi in.
english: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne will be established forever.”’”

paite: Huai thute tengteng leh huai kilakna bang geih in Nathan in David kiang ah agen hi.
english: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa David alut a, TOUPA ma ah atu a, "Aw TOUPA Pathian, kua ahia ka hih a, ka inkote leng kua ahia ahih ua, hichi tantan na hon pi?
english: Then David the king went in and sat before Yahweh; and he said, “Who am I, Yahweh God, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?

paite: Aw Pathian, huaite leng nang mitmuh in thil neuchik phet zaw ahi a; himahleh aw TOUPA Pathian, na sikha inkuan hong omdan ding thu kum tampi sung a ding na na genta a, milian bang in na hon sep lai a, aw TOUPA Pathian.
english: This was a small thing in your eyes, O God, but you have spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have respected me according to the standard of a man of high degree, Yahweh God.

paite: Na sikha pahtawi a a-om tungtang thu ah David in na kiang ah bang agen tuan nawn dia? Na sikha lah na theitel mahmah hi.
english: What can David say yet more to you concerning the honor which is done to your servant? For you know your servant.

paite: Aw TOUPA na sikha ziak in nangmah lungsim a pawt bang zel in hiai thil thupi mahmah theisak ding in thil thupi mahmahte na hihta hi.
english: Yahweh, for your servant’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.

paite: Aw TOUPA ka theih un nang bang mahmah a-om kei ua, nang lou ngal Pathian himhim leng a-om sam kei hi.
english: Yahweh, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan na tatkhiak a na mite ma a namdangte zahlaksak a, thil thupitak leh lauhuaitak hih a min thupitak bawlsak ding a Pathian in amah mite a dia ahon tatkhiak na mi Israelte bang mahmah leitung ah namdang kua a-om ua?
english: What one nation on the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people whom you redeemed out of Egypt?

paite: Na mi Israelte tangtawn a na mite ding in lah na bawlta ngal a; nang TOUPA amaute Pathian na hita hi.
english: For you made your people Israel your own people forever; and you, Yahweh, became their God.

paite: "Huchi in aw TOUPA, na sikha tungtang thu leh a-inkote tungtang thu na gen tangtawn a ding in hihkip inla, na gensa bang in hih in.
english: Now, Yahweh, let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, be established forever, and do as you have spoken.

paite: Tangtawn in na min hihkip leh hihlet in om hen, 'Sepaihte' TOUPA Israel' Pathian, Israelte a dia Pathian mahmah ahi,' na sikha David inkote na ma ah hihkip in om uhen," chi in.
english: Let your name be established and magnified forever, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel. The house of David your servant is established before you.’

paite: "Aw nang ka Pathian, na sikha kiang ah inkuan na dingsak ding chih na na puangta ngal a; huaiziak in na sikha in na kiang ah ka thum ngam lai ahi.
english: For you, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build him a house. Therefore your servant has found courage to pray before you.

paite: Aw TOUPA, nang zaw Pathian na hi a, hiai thil hoih na sikha na chiamta hi.
english: Now, Yahweh, you are God, and have promised this good thing to your servant.

paite: Na sikha inkote na ma a tangtawn a a-om gige theihna ding un na vualzawl a; aw TOUPA, na vualzawl zaw tangtawn a vualzawlna ahi,” achi hi.
english: Now it has pleased you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Yahweh, have blessed, and it is blessed forever.”

paite: Huai nung in hichi ahong hi a, David in Philistia mite asual a, azou a, Gath khua leh akhotate Philistia mite asuhsak hi.
english: After this, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

paite: Moabte asual nawn a, Moab mite David sikhate ahong hita ua, siah ape zel uhi.
english: He defeated Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David and brought tribute.

paite: Euphrates Luipi a agam kipsak ding a David apai kawm in Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer leng Hamath chin ah asual nawn hi.
english: David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, toward Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

paite: Huchi in David in kangtalai sangkhat leh sakol tungtuangmi sangsagih leh sepaih singnih amatsak a; David in kangtalai kaimi sakol tengteng thagui asattansak a, kangtalai zakhat kai ding bel ahawi hi.
english: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them enough for one hundred chariots.

paite: Huan Damaskas a Siria mite Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer huh ding in ahong kuan ua, David in Siria mi singnih-le-sangnih athat hi.
english: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians.

paite: Huchi in David in Damaskas a Siria mite lak ah asepaihte akoih a; huchi in Siria mite David sikhate ahong hita ua, siah ape zel uhi.
english: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David and brought tribute. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.

paite: David in Hadadezer pawlte dangka-eng lumte alaksak a, Jerusalem ah apaipih hi.
english: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

paite: Hadadezer khua Tibhath leh Chun a kipan David in dal tampi apua a, huaite in Solomon in dal lohte, atunnate, dal tui-um belsuante abawl hi.
english: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.

paite: Huchi in Hamath kumpipa Tou in Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer sepaih tengteng David in azou chih azak in,
english: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,

paite: Hadadezer asim a, athah ziak a chibai buk ding leh kipahpih ding in David kiang ah atapa Hadoram asawl a; Hadadezer leh Toute lah kidou sek ahi ngal ua; dangka-eng leh dangkasik leh dal tui-um belsuan chi chih leng atawisak lai hi.
english: he sent Hadoram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him (for Hadadezer had wars with Tou); and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.

paite: Hiaite leng David in namdang azoh tengteng Edom, Moab, Ammon suante, Philistiate, leh Amalekte lak a pan dangkasik leh dangka-eng alakte toh TOUPA kiang ah alan hi.
english: King David also dedicated these to Yahweh, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations: from Edom, from Moab, from the children of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

paite: Huai lou leng, Zeruiah tapa Abishai in Edomte singkhat-le-sanggiat Chi Phaizang ah athat hi.
english: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

paite: Edom gam ah sepaihte akoih a; huchi in Edom mi tengteng David sikhate ahong hita uh. TOUPA'N David apaina peuh ah azousak zel hi.
english: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.

paite: Huchi in David in Israel mi tengteng tung ah vai ahawm a; ami tengteng tung ah diktattak in vai ahawm hi.
english: David reigned over all Israel; and he executed justice and righteousness for all his people.

paite: Zeruiah tapa Joab bel sepaih heutupen ahi a; Ahilud tapa Jehoshaphat bel tanchin gelhpa ahi.
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

paite: Ahitub tapa Zadok leh Abiathar tapa Abimelek bel siampu ahi ua, huan Shavsha bel laigelhmi ahi a;
english: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was scribe;

paite: Jehoiada tapa Benaiah bel Kereth mi leh Pelet mite heutu ahi a, David tapate bel kumpipa kim a heutu lian ahi uhi.
english: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief officials serving the king.

paite: Huan huai nung in hichi ahong hi a, Ammon suante kumpipa Nahash asi a, asik in atapa in vai ahawm hi.
english: After this, Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.

paite: David in, "Apa'n hon na hehpih zel ziak in ke'n leng Nahash tapa Hanun ka hehpih sam ding," achi a. Huchi in David in apa tungtang thu a lungmuan ding in mite asawl hi. Huan David mite Ammon suante gam ah Hanun kiang ah amah lungmuan ding in ava tung uhi.
english: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun to comfort him.

paite: Himahleh Ammon suan heutute'n Hanun kiang ah, "David in na pa azahtak ziak a lungmuan ding mi na kiang a hon sawl hi in na gingta a hia? Amite gam hihse ding a enchian leh enkhe ding a na kiang a hong pai ahi khamoh ding uam maw?" achi uhi.
english: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Haven’t his servants come to you to search, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?”

paite: Huchi in Hanun in David mite aman a, akhamul uh ametmaisak a, huan apuansilhte uh alaitak ah atobou uh khuhpha minmen in atansak a, apaisakta hi.
english: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks, and sent them away.

paite: Huchi in kuate hiam in amite ana hihdan David ava hilh ua. Huan adawn ding in mi asawl a; amau lah azum mahmah ngal uhi. Kumpipa'n, "Na khamul uh asau nawn ma Jeriko ah om unla, huai zoh chiang in hong kik un," achi hi.
english: Then some people went and told David how the men were treated. He sent to meet them; for the men were greatly humiliated. The king said, “Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”

paite: Huchi in Ammon suante'n David zakdah lam ana hihta uh chih akitheih un, Hanun leh Ammon suante'n Mesopotamia gam a mite, Siria-maakah a mite, Zobah a mite, kangtalai leh sakol tungtuang mite goihna ding in dangkasik talent sangkhat akhak uhi.
english: When the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.

paite: Huchi in kangtalai singthum-le- sangnih, Maakah kumpipa leh amite toh api ua, Medeba kiang ah panmun abawlta uhi. Ammon suante akhua ua kipan apawtkhia ua, akikaikhawm ua, kidou ding in akuanta uhi.
english: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah with his people, who came and encamped near Medeba. The children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

paite: David in huai azak in, Joab leh sepaih hangsante tengteng asawlkhia hi.
english: When David heard of it, he sent Joab with all the army of the mighty men.

paite: Ammon suante ahong kuan ua, khopi kongpi chin ah akiphalh ua, kumpipa amau thu a hong kuante atuam in loubuk ah a-om uhi.
english: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.

paite: Huchi in amalam leh nunglam ah ahon sual dek uh chih Joab in atheih in Israel mite lak a mi teltuamte atelkhia a, Siria mite sual ding in akizalh uhi.
english: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose some of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.

paite: Midang tengteng bel a-unaupa Abishai khut ah akoih vek a, Ammon suante sual ding in amau leng akizalh uhi.
english: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

paite: Huchi in ama'n, "Siria mite ka zoh kei dekleh, hon panpih in; Ammon suante na zoh kei dekleh ka hon panpih ding.
english: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you are to help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.

paite: Hangsantak in om unla, i mite leh i Pathian khuate hum in i kipasalsak ding uh; TOUPA'N hoih asak bang zel in hih hen," achi hi.
english: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. May Yahweh do that which seems good to him.”

paite: Huchi in Joab leh akiang a mite'n kidouna mun a Siria mite ava naih ua; huchi in ama ah ataikekta uhi.
english: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.

paite: Ammon suante'n Siria mite ataikek uh chih atheih un amau leng a-unaupa Abishai ma ah ataikekta ua, khua ah alut uhi. Huchi in Joab Jerusalem ah apaita hi.
english: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

paite: Siria mite'n Israelte ma ah apang thei kei uh chih ana theih un, mi asawl ua, Lui khen lam a Siria pawlte asamkhia ua, Hadadezer sepaih heutu Shophak bel aheutupen uh ahi.
english: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them.

paite: Huai thu David ahilh ua; ama'n Israel mi tengteng asamkhawm a, Jordan lui akan ua, ava mu ua, sual ding in akiphalh uhi. Huchi in Siriate kidoupih dia David akisak khit in amah akidoupihta uhi.
english: David was told that, so he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, came to them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

paite: Siria mite bel Israelte ma ah ataikek ua; David in Siria mi, kangtalai sangsagih tung a tuang leh sepaih singli athat a, sepaih heutu Shophak leng athat hi.
english: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed of the Syrian men seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand footmen, and also killed Shophach the captain of the army.

paite: Huchi in Hadadezer mite'n Israelte ma ah apang theita kei uh chih atheih un, David toh kilemna abawl ua, asikhate ding in a-omta uh; Siria mite'n leng Ammon suante apanpih nuamta kei uhi.
english: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and served him. The Syrians would not help the children of Ammon any more.

paite: Hiaite Israel tapate ahi uh: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issakar, Zebulun;
english: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,

paite: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad leh Asher.
english: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

paite: Judah tapate: Er, Onan leh Shelah; huaite Shuah tanu Kanaan nu a kipan amah lak a piang thumte ahi uh. Huan TOUPA mitmuh in Judah ta masapen Er agi kei a; amah athat hi.
english: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah, which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh’s sight; and he killed him.

paite: Huchi in Tamar atapa zi in Perez leh Zerah asuansak hi. Judah tapate tengteng nga ahi uh.
english: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

paite: Perez tapate: Hezron leh Hamul ahi uh.
english: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

paite: Huan Zerah tapate: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Kalkol leh Dara: avek un nga ahi uh.
english: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five of them in all.

paite: Huan Karmi tapate: Akar, thil siangthou a talekpa, Israel hihbuaipa.
english: The son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.

paite: Huan Ethan tapa Azariah ahi.
english: The son of Ethan: Azariah.

paite: Hezron, amah lak a piangte leng; Jerahmeel, Ram leh Kelubai.
english: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.

paite: Huan Ram in Amminadab asuang a; Amminadab in Nahson, Judah suante lal asuang hi.
english: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

paite: Nahson in Salma asuang a, Salma in Boaz asuang;
english: and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,

paite: Boaz in Obed asuang a, Obed in Jesse asuang hi.
english: and Boaz became the father of Obed, and Obed became the father of Jesse;

paite: Jesse in ata masapen Eliab, anihna Abinadab leh athumna Shimea asuang;
english: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,

paite: alina Nethaneel, angana Raddai;
english: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

paite: agukna Ozem, asagihna David.
english: Ozem the sixth, and David the seventh;
