paite: Huan asanggamnute uh Zeruiah leh Abigail ahi uh. Huchi in Zeruiah tapate: Abishai, Joab leh Asahel, thum ahi uh.
english: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.

paite: Abigail in Amasa asuang a, huan Amasa pa Ishmael mi Jether ahi.
english: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.

paite: Huan Jezron tapa Kaleb in Azubah azi leh Jerioth lak ah tate asuang a; hiaite atapate ahi: Jesher leh Shobab leh Ardon.
english: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

paite: Azubah asi a, Kaleb in amah a ding in Ephrath api a, huai in Hur aneihsak hi.
english: Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.

paite: Hur in Uri asuang a, Uri in Bezaleel asuang hi.
english: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.

paite: Huai nung in Gilead pa Makir tanu kiang ah Hezron alut a; huai zi dia api lai in kum sawmguk a upa ahi; ama'n Segub asuansak hi.
english: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.

paite: Segub in, Gilead gam a khopi sawmnih-le-thum nei Jair, asuansak hi.
english: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

paite: Ama'n amau a kipan Kenath leh huai a khoneite, khopi sawmguk toh Geshur, Aramin leh Jair khuate ala hi. Hiaite tengteng Gilead pa Makir tapate a ahi uh.
english: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

paite: Huai nung in Kaleb-ephrathah ah Hezron asi a, huchi in Hezron zi Abia in Tekoa pa Ashur asuansak hi.
english: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron’s wife, bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

paite: Huan Hezron ta masapen Jerahmeel tapate: ata masapen Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem leh Ahijah ahi uh.
english: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.

paite: Jerahmeel in zi dang anei a, amin Atarah ahi; amah Onam nu ahi.
english: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.

paite: Jerahmeel ta masapen Ram tapate Maaz, Jamin leh Eker ahi uh.
english: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

paite: Onam tapate: Shammai leh Jada ahi uh. Shammai tapate: Nadab leh Abishur ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

paite: Abishur zi min Abihail ahi; ama'n Ahban leh Molid asuansak hi.
english: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban and Molid.

paite: Nadab tapate: Seled leh Appaim ahi ua, Seled bel tate nei lou in asi hi.
english: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled died without children.

paite: Appaim tapa Ishi ahi. Ishi tapa Sheshan ahi. Sheshan tapa Ahlai ahi.
english: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.

paite: Huan Shammai unaupa Jada tapate: Jether leh Jonathan ahi ua; Jether ta nei lou in asi hi.
english: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.

paite: Huan Jonathan tapate: Peleth, Zaza ahi uh. Hiaite Jerahmeel tapate ahi uh.
english: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

paite: Huchi in Sheshan in, tanute chih louh, tapate anei kei hi. Huan Sheshan in Aigupta mi khat sikha anei a, amin Jarha ahi.
english: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

paite: Huan Sheshan in asikha Jarha kiang ah zi ding in atanu apia a; huchi in Attai aneihsak hi.
english: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.

paite: Huan Attai in Nathan asuang a, Nathan in Zabad asuang;
english: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,

paite: Zabad in Ephlal asuang; Ephlal in Obed asuang;
english: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,

paite: Obed in Jehu asuang a, Jehu in Azariah asuang;
english: and Obed became the father of Jehu, and Jehu became the father of Azariah,

paite: Azariah in Helez asuang a, Helez in Eleasah asuang hi;
english: and Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah,

paite: Eleasah in Sisamai asuang a, Sisamai in Shallum asuang;
english: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai became the father of Shallum,

paite: Shallum in Jekamiah asuang a, Jekamiah in Elishama asuang hi.
english: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.

paite: Huchi in Jerahmeel unaupa Kaleb tapate: Ata masapen Mesha ahi a; amah Ziph pa ahi, huan Mareshah ahi a, amah Hebron pa ahi.
english: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

paite: Huan Hebron tapate: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, Shema ahi uh.
english: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

paite: Shema in Raham, Jorkoam pa asuang; Rekem in Shammai asuang hi.
english: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.

paite: Huan Shammai tapa Maon ahi; Beth-zur pa Maon ahi.
english: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.

paite: Ephah, Kaleb mei in, Haran, Moza leh Gazez asuang a: Haran in Gazez asuang hi.
english: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.

paite: Jahdai tapate: Regem, Jotham, Gesan, Pelet, Ephah leh Shaaph ahi uh.
english: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

paite: Maakah, Kaleb mei in, Sheber leh Tirhanah anei a.
english: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.

paite: Madmannah pa Shaaph, Makbenah pa leh Gibea pa Sheva anei a; Kaleb tanu Aksah ahi.
english: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

paite: Hiaite Kaleb tapate ahi uh: Ephrathah ta masapen Hur tapa, Kiriath-jearim pa Shobal;
english: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,

paite: Bethlehem pa Salma, Bethgader pa Hareph.
english: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.

paite: Kiriath-jearim pa Shobal in tapate anei a; Haroeh leh Menaheth kimkhatte ahi ua,
english: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.

paite: Kiriath-jearim inkote; Ithrit mite, Puthit mite, Shumathit mite, Misrai mite; Zareathit mite leh Eshtaol mite hong kipatna ahi.
english: The families of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.

paite: Salma tapate: Bethlehem, Netophah mite, Joab inkuante Atroth-beth, Zorit mite, Manahathit mite kimkhatte ahi uh.
english: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.

paite: Huan Jabez a teng laigelhmite inkote: Tirathit mite, Shimeathit mite, leh Sukathit mite. Hiaite Ken mi Rekab inkote pa, Hemath a kipan hong paite ahi uhi.
english: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kum ahong bei a kumpipate kidou ding a akuankhiak lai un, Joab in asepaih hatte apikhia hi. Ammon suante gam asuhsak a, Rabbah khua a-um uh. David bel Jerusalem ah a-om hi. Huan Joab in Rabbah khua asual a, alata hi.
english: At the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, Joab led out the army and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. Joab struck Rabbah, and overthrew it.

paite: Huchi in David in akumpipa uh lallukhu khuk lai alaksak a, agikdan dangka-eng talent khat ahi, suangmantamte leng atel a; David akhusak ua; khopi a om gallak sum tampi ala hi.
english: David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it. It was set on David’s head, and he brought very much plunder out of the city.

paite: Huchi in huai lai a mipite bel apikhia a, sing-atnate, leilehna sikzumte, heipite in nna asemsak hi. Huchibang in Ammon tate khopi tengteng David in ahih hi. David leh mi tengteng Jerusalem ah apai nawnta uhi.
english: He brought out the people who were in it, and had them cut with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. David did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai nung in, Philistia mite toh Gezer ah kidouna a-om a; huchi in Husat mi Sibbekai in milian suante lak a mi Sippai athat a; huchi in avuallelta uhi.
english: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.

paite: Philistia mite toh kidouna a-om nawn a; Jair tapa Elhan in Git mi Goliath unaupa Lahmi athat a, ateikung chiampek bang ahi.
english: Again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

paite: Gath ah kidouna a-om nawn a, huai ah misang mahmah, akhut lang tuak a khutzung guk, akhe lang tuak a khezung guk, avek a sawmnih-le-li nei a-om a; amah leng miliante lak a khat ahi.
english: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand and six on each foot; and he also was born to the giant.

paite: Ama'n Israel mite asimmoh a, David unau Shimea tapa Jonathan in amah athat hi.
english: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.

paite: Huaite Gath a milian lak a piang ahi uh; huaite David leh amite khut ah asi uhi.
english: These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

paite: Huan Setan in Israelte asual a, David bel Israelte phakzah sim utna aneisak hi.
english: Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to take a census of Israel.

paite: Huan David in Joab leh amiliante uh kiang ah, "Kuan unla, Beer-sheba a kipan Dan tan in Israel mite sim unla, aphakzah uh ka theihtheihna ding in hong hilh nawn un," achi hi.
english: David said to Joab and to the princes of the people, “Go, count Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring me word, that I may know how many there are.”

paite: Joab in kumpipa kiang ah, "TOUPA'N amite amun za in hihpung taleh zong, kumpipa ka toupa, ka toupa mite mah hilou uh ahi maw? Bangziak a ka toupa'n huai theih kilawp ahia? Bangziak a Israelte siam louh tanlohna hi ding ahia oi?" achi hi.
english: Joab said, “May Yahweh make his people a hundred times as many as they are. But, my lord the king, aren’t they all my lord’s servants? Why does my lord require this thing? Why will he be a cause of guilt to Israel?”

paite: Huchi in Joab apawtkhia a, Israel gam tengteng ah apai a, Jerusalem ah apai nawn hi.
english: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, then came to Jerusalem.

paite: Joab in mihing om zah David ahilh hi. Israel gam a namsau tawimi tengteng maktaduaikhat-le-nuaikhat ahi uh; huan Judah gam a namsau tawimi bel nuaili-le-singsagih ahi uh.
english: Joab gave the sum of the census of the people to David. All those of Israel were one million one hundred thousand men who drew a sword; and in Judah were four hundred seventy thousand men who drew a sword.

paite: Levite leh Benjaminte bel asimtel kei; Joab in kumpipa thupiak zakdah lamtak ahi ngal a.
english: But he didn’t count Levi and Benjamin among them, for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.

paite: Huai thil ah Pathian akipak kei a; huchi in Israelte agawtta hi.
english: God was displeased with this thing; therefore he struck Israel.

paite: Huchi in David in Pathian kiang ah, "Hiai thil ka na hihna ah nakpitak in ka na hihkhialta ahi; himahleh na sikha thulimlouhna hehpih in ngaidam in, haihuaitak in ka na hihta hi,” achi hi.
english: David said to God, “I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing. But now put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant, for I have done very foolishly.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N zawlnei Gad kiang ah,
english: Yahweh spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,

paite: "Kuan inla, David kiang ah TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Thil thum ka hon tah: na tung a ka hih ding in alak ua khat tel in achi,' " va chi in.
english: “Go and speak to David, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”

paite: Huchi in David kiang ah Gad ava hoh a, akiang ah, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: So Gad came to David and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Take your choice:

paite: Akoi ahia na deih tel in; kum thum kialpi tun hia, na melmate namsau a delhphak a om a kha thum na melmate vuallelhsak hia, ni thum hipi len ding, TOUPA namsau a TOUPA angel in Israel gam tengteng a mi ahihmanthat zel?' chi in. Huchi in kei hon sawlpa bang ka chi dawn dia, kingaihtuah inla, hon hilh in," achi hi.
english: either three years of famine; or three months to be consumed before your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtakes you; or else three days of the sword of Yahweh, even pestilence in the land, and Yahweh’s angel destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.’”

paite: David in Gad kiang ah, "Ka lungzing mahmah, TOUPA khut ah puklut peuhmah mai leng; azahngaihna lah athupi mahmah ngal a; mihing khut ah zaw hon puklutsak mahmah ke'n," achi hi.
english: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let me fall, I pray, into Yahweh’s hand, for his mercies are very great. Don’t let me fall into man’s hand.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Israelte lak ah hipi alengsakta.
english: So Yahweh sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.

paite: Huan Jerusalem khua hihse ding in Pathian in angel asawl a; ahihsiat dek laitak in, TOUPA'N a-en a, thil hoih lou hih atup akhiam a, mite hihmangthang angel kiang ah, "Ahunta; na khut lik nawn ke'n," achi hi. Huchi in TOUPA angel Jebus mi Ornan phual chin ah adingh hi.
english: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was about to destroy, Yahweh saw, and he relented of the disaster, and said to the destroying angel, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” Yahweh’s angel was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

paite: David adaktou a, TOUPA angel, namsau phawisa a Jerusalem lam ngim a, lei leh van kikal a dingh amu hi. Huchi in David leh a-upate'n sai-ip puan silh in lei ah abokkhup uhi.
english: David lifted up his eyes, and saw Yahweh’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.

paite: David in Pathian kiang ah, "Keimah ka hi kei a hia mipite sim ding chih thu pepa? Keimah ka hi ginat huai loutak a thil na hihkhial, hiai belamte'n bang thil ahia ahih tei uh? Aw TOUPA ka Pathian, keimah leh ka inkote tung ah na khutkha inla, na mite'n hipi thuak nawn kei uhen," achi hi.
english: David said to God, “Isn’t it I who commanded the people to be counted? It is even I who have sinned and done very wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand, O Yahweh my God, be against me and against my father’s house; but not against your people, that they should be plagued.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA angel in David kiang a Gad va hohtou a, Jebus mi Ornan phual a TOUPA dia maitam doh ding a David hilh ding in thu apia hi.
english: Then Yahweh’s angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to Yahweh on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

paite: Gad in TOUPA min a athugen ziak in David ahohtouta hi.
english: David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in Yahweh’s name.

paite: Ornan akilehhei a, angel amu a; atapa li akiang a omte abuta uhi. Ornan in buh ana chil ahi.
english: Ornan turned back and saw the angel; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

paite: David, Ornan kiang atun in, Ornan akihei a, David amuta a, huan phual a kipan apawtkhia a, amai a lei si in David ma ah abokkhup hi.
english: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.

paite: Huchi in David in Ornan kiang ah, "Hiai phual TOUPA a dia maitam ka bawlna ding in hon pe dih ve; aman kim geih la in hon pia in, mipite lak a hii akikhin theihna ding in," achi hi.
english: Then David said to Ornan, “Sell me the place of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to Yahweh on it. You shall sell it to me for the full price, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”

paite: Ornan in David kiang ah, "Tang in, TOUPA ka kumpipa'n pha asak bang in hih hen; halmang a lat ding in bawngtalte, sing ding in phual vanzatte, tangbuang thillat ding in buhte ka hon pia hi; ka hon sutuah vek ding," achi hi.
english: Ornan said to David, “Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes. Behold, I give the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal offering. I give it all.”

paite: Huan kumpipa David in Ornan kiang ah, "Hilou e; aman kim geih in ka lei zaw ding, man bei in TOUPA a ding in nang a ka la kei ding, halmang thillat leng ka lan kei ding,” achi a.
english: King David said to Ornan, “No, but I will most certainly buy it for the full price. For I will not take that which is yours for Yahweh, nor offer a burnt offering that costs me nothing.”

paite: Huchi in David in huai mun leina in Ornan dangka-eng shekel zaguk apia hi.
english: So David gave to Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.

paite: David in huai ah TOUPA a ding in maitam abawl a, halmang thillatte leh lemna thillatte alan a, TOUPA asam a; TOUPA'N maitam tung ah mei in van a kipan in adawngta hi.
english: David built an altar to Yahweh there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called on Yahweh; and he answered him from the sky by fire on the altar of burnt offering.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N angel thu apia a, anamsau apai ah athun nawnta hi.
english: Then Yahweh commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.

paite: Huchi in David in Jebus mi Ornan phual ah TOUPA'N ahon dawng chih atheih in huai ah akithoihta hi.
english: At that time, when David saw that Yahweh had answered him in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

paite: Huai lai in Mosi in gamdai a TOUPA biakbuk leh halmang thillatna maitam abawl Gibeon khua mun sang ah a-om ahi.
english: For Yahweh’s tabernacle, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.

paite: Himahleh David bel TOUPA angel namsau akihtak ziak in Pathian dong ding in huai ah ahoh thei kei hi.
english: But David couldn’t go before it to inquire of God, for he was afraid because of the sword of Yahweh’s angel.

paite: Huchi in David in, "Hiai zaw TOUPA Pathian inn ahi hi; hiai zaw Israelte halmang thillatna maitam ahi hi," achi hi.
english: Then David said, “This is the house of Yahweh God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”

paite: Huchi in David in Israel gam a namdang omte sapkhawm thu apia a; huan, Pathian inn lamna ding in suangsek mite suang aseksak hi.
english: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God’s house.

paite: David in intual kongkhak leh abulhna ding kilhna ding sik tampi abawlkhol a; dal tamtak buk seng louh toh; sidar sing sim seng louh toh;
english: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the couplings, and bronze in abundance without weight,

paite: Zidon mi leh Tura mite'n David kiang ah sidar sing tampi ahon la uhi.
english: and cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.

paite: David in, "Ka tapa Solomon lah anaupang lai in, bangmah athei nai kei a, TOUPA' inn lam ding thupitak, amin leh athupina gam chih a thangkhe ding ahi a; huaiziak in ka kisakhol hi," achi hi. Huchi in David asih ma in akisakhol nasa mahmah hi.
english: David said, “Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for Yahweh must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries. I will therefore make preparation for it.” So David prepared abundantly before his death.

paite: Huchi in atapa Solomon asam a, TOUPA Israel' Pathian inn lam ding in thu apia hi.
english: Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: Huan David in atapa Solomon kiang ah, "TOUPA ka Pathian min ding in inn lam lungsim in ka nei gige hi.
english: David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of Yahweh my God.

paite: Himahleh, ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a, nang zaw sisan na naksuah tel a, kidoute na uang tel a; leitung ah ka mitmuh a sisan na naksuah ziak in, ka min a ding in inn na lam kei ding.
english: But Yahweh’s word came to me, saying, ‘You have shed blood abundantly and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.

paite: Ngai in, tapa chingkam na hon nei ding a, amah kei lungtuak mi ahi ding a, akim gam a amelma tengteng lak ah galmuanna ka pe ding; amin Solomon ahi ding a, amah ziak in Israelte galmuang leh lungmuangtak in ka omsak ding.
english: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.

paite: Ama'n ka min a ding in inn alam ding a, amah ka tapa ahi ding a, kei apa ka hi ding; huan, Israelte tung a agam laltutphah tangtawn a ding in ka hihkip ding.
english: He shall build a house for my name; and he will be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’

paite: "Huchi in ka tapa, TOUPA na kiang ah om henla, lamzang zel inla, na tungtang thu agenkholhsa bang in, TOUPA na Pathian inn lam in.
english: Now, my son, may Yahweh be with you and prosper you, and build the house of Yahweh your God, as he has spoken concerning you.

paite: TOUPA'N pilna leh theihnate hon neisak peuhmah phot henla, Israelte tung ah thuneihna hon pia hen, huchi in TOUPA na Pathian dan na zui thei ding hi.
english: May Yahweh give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the law of Yahweh your God.

paite: Huchi in Israelte tungtang thu a dan thusehte leh vaihawmnate TOUPA'N Mosi apiak na zuihleh, na lamzang zel ding; hattak in om inla, hangsantak in om in; lau ke'nla, lunglel sam ke'n.
english: Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which Yahweh gave Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.

paite: Ngai in, ka lungzin lai in TOUPA' inn a ding in dangka-eng talent nuaikhat leh dangkasik talent maktaduaikhat ka na kisakhol khin a; dal leh sikte leng buk seng louh, tampi ahi; sing leh suang leng ka kisakhol khin ahi, huaite na sunzom theita ding.
english: Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for Yahweh’s house one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million talents of silver, and bronze and iron without weight; for it is in abundance. I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to them.

paite: Nasemmi, sing-atmi leh suangsekmi leh khutsiamna chiteng sem thei leng na hau hi.
english: There are also workmen with you in abundance—cutters and workers of stone and timber, and all kinds of men who are skillful in every kind of work;

paite: Sim seng vual louh dangka-engte, dangkate, dalte, sikte leng; thou inla, nasep pan in, TOUPA na kiang ah om hen," achi hi.
english: of the gold, the silver, the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may Yahweh be with you.”

paite: David in Israelte makai tengteng atapa Solomon panpih ding in thu apia hi.
english: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,

paite: "TOUPA na Pathian uh na kiang uah a-om kei a hia? Mun chih mual chih ah galmuanna ahon pe kei a hia? Hiai gam a mite ka khut ah ahon peta a, TOUPA ma leh amite ma ah gam lak ahita.
english: “Isn’t Yahweh your God with you? Hasn’t he given you rest on every side? For he has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before Yahweh and before his people.

paite: Tu in na lungtang uleh na lungsim uh TOUPA na Pathian uh zong ding in koihkip un; huaiziak in thou unla, TOUPA min a inn lam ding suang, TOUPA thukhun bawm leh Pathian tui-um belsuan siangthoute laklutna ding in, mun siangthou lam un," achi hi.
english: Now set your heart and your soul to follow Yahweh your God. Arise therefore, and build the sanctuary of Yahweh God, to bring the ark of Yahweh’s covenant and the holy vessels of God into the house that is to be built for Yahweh’s name.”

paite: David adamsawt in a-upa mahmah a; huchi in Israelte kumpipa in atapa Solomon abawlta hi.
english: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

paite: Huan Israelte makai tengteng siampute leh Levite toh asamkhawm hi.
english: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

paite: Levite kum sawmthum a kipan atunglam sim ahi ua; atamlam uh piching singthum-le-sanggiat ahi.
english: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.

paite: Huaite lak a, "Singnih-le-sangli TOUPA' inn lam heutute heutu ding ahi ua; sanggukte heutute leh vaihawmmi dingte ahi uh;
english: David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of Yahweh’s house, six thousand were officers and judges,

paite: Sanglite kongkhak ngak mite ding ahi ua, huan sanglite, phatna ding a thil tumging chi ka bawl," David in achihte zang a TOUPA phat ding mite ahi uhi.
english: four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised Yahweh with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”

paite: Levi tapate Gershon, Kahath, Merari zah in David in pawl abawl a,
english: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

paite: Gershon mite Laadan leh Shimei ahi uh.
english: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

paite: Laadan tapate makaipente Jehiel, Zetham, Joel, thum ahi uh.
english: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel, three.

paite: Shimei tapate Shelomith, Haziel, Haran, thum ahi uh. Hiaite Laadan suan inkuan makaipente ahi uh.
english: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.

paite: Shimei tapate bel Jahath, Zina, Jeush, Beriah ahi uh. Hiai lite Shimei tapate ahi uh.
english: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

paite: Jahath a-upapen ahi a, Zizah anihna ahi; Jeush leh Beriahte'n bel ta ahau kei ua; huaiziak in inkuan khat bang a sim ahi uh.
english: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.

paite: Kohath tapate Amram, Izhar, Hebron, Uzziel, li ahi uh.
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

paite: Amram tapate Aaron leh Mosi ahi uh; Aaron bel amah leh asuante tangtawn a ding a thil siangthoutakte hihsiangthou a, tangtawn a TOUPA ma a gimlim hal a, a-nna sem a, amin a vualzawlpa ding a hihtuam ahi uh.
english: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before Yahweh, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.

paite: Pathian mipa Mosi bel, atapate Levi nam lak a sim ahi uh.
english: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.

paite: Mosi tapate Gershom leh Eliezer ahi uh,
english: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

paite: Gershom tapate lak a upapen Shebuel ahi.
english: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.

paite: Eliezer tapate lak a upapen Rehabiah ahi. Eliezer in tapa dang anei kei; Rehabiah in bel tapa tampi anei.
english: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

paite: Izhar tapate: Shelmoth amakai lianpen.
english: The son of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.

paite: Hebron tapate lak a makai lianpen Jeriah ahi a, anihna Amariah, athumna Jahaziel, alina Jekameam ahi.
english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

paite: Uzziel tapate lak a upazaw Mikah ahi a, anihna Isshiah ahi.
english: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.

paite: Merari tapate: Merari tapate bel Mahli leh Mushi ahi uh, Mahli tapate Eleazar leh Kish ahi uh.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

paite: Eleazar tapate nei lou in asi a, tanute kia anei a; Kish tapa a-unaute un zi in anei uh.
english: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only; and their relatives, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.

paite: Mushi tapate Mahli, Eder, Jeremoth, thum ahi uh.
english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

paite: Huaite Levi suan a-inkuan uh bang zel a min gelh a asim uh inkuan makaipen, TOUPA' inn lam a kuan, kuni sawmnih a kipan tunglam asimte uh ahi.
english: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of Yahweh’s house, from twenty years old and upward.

paite: David in, "TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in amite galmuangtak in a-omsakta a, Jerusalem ah a-om nilouh hi.
english: For David said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people; and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.

paite: Levite'n leng biakbuk leh anasepna ding tui-um belsuan tengteng azon uh akiphamohta kei hi," achi hi.
english: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”

paite: David thupiak nanung ziak in Levite kum sawmnih a kipan atunglam tan in sim ngal ahi uhi.
english: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were counted, from twenty years old and upward.

paite: Anasep uh Pathian inn a nasep a Aaron tapate panpih a intual sung leh dantan sung a thil siangthoute hihsiangthou a, TOUPA' inn a nasep ahi;
english: For their duty was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of Yahweh’s house—in the courts, in the rooms, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of God’s house;

paite: tanghou koih dingte, tangbuang thillat ding a tangbuang nel mahmah, silngou hel louh tanghou pek hiam, bel a uk hiam, kan hiam, ateh leh aletdan bang teng ding bawlte toh;
english: for the show bread also, and for the fine flour for a meal offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all measurements of quantity and size;

paite: Zingsang teng a TOUPA kiang a kipahthu gen leh amah phatte toh, nitak a leng huchi mah;
english: and to stand every morning to thank and praise Yahweh, and likewise in the evening;

paite: Sabbathte, kha thakte a ankuanglui neihte ahih ding seh bang zel a TOUPA kiang a halmang thillat tengteng TOUPA ma a lat gigete toh;
english: and to offer all burnt offerings to Yahweh on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually before Yahweh;

paite: kihoupihna biakbuk kepte, mun siangthou kepte, TOUPA' inn a nasem a a-unau Aaron tapate'n hih ding aseh peuhmah uh hihte toh.
english: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of Aaron their brothers for the service of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Aaron tapate pawl khendan hichibang ahi, Aaron tapate Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar ahi uh.
english: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

paite: Nadab leh Abihu bel apa uh sang in asi masa ua; ta anei kei uh; huaiziak in Eleazar leh Ithamarte'n siampu nna asem uhi.
english: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.

paite: David in Eleazar tapa Zadok leh Ithamar tapa Ahimelekte toh anasepdan ding uh ahawmsak hi.
english: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.

paite: Ithamar suante sang in Eleazar suan makaipen a pang atamzaw uh; hichibang in akhen ua; Eleazar suan ah, inkuan makaipen sawm-le-guk a hi uh; Ithamar suan ah, inkuan makaipen giat ahi uhi.
english: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and they were divided like this: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.

paite: Eleazar suan a mi leh Ithamar suan a mite lak ah, mun siangthou a miliante leh Pathian miliante a om tuaktuak uh ahih ziak in aisan in, amaute akhen uhi.
english: Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

paite: Huan Levi mi, laigelhmi Nethaneel tapa Shemaiah in kumpipa, milian, siampu Zadok, Abiathar tapa Ahimelek, siampute leh Levite inko makaipente mitmuh in agelh a; inkuan pipa khat tan Eleazar tung ah apuk a, khat bel Ithamar tung ah apuk hi.
english: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

paite: Huchi in aisan akhatveina bel Jehoarib tung ah atu a, anihveina Jedaiah tung ah;
english: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

paite: athumveina Harim tung ah, aliveina Seorim tung ah;
english: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

paite: angaveina Makijah tung ah, agukveina Mijamin tung ah;
english: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

paite: asagihveina Hakoz tung ah, agiatveina Abijah tung ah;
english: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

paite: akuaveina Jeshua tung ah, asawmveina Shekaniah tung ah;
english: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

paite: asawm-le-khatveina Eliashib tung ah, asawm-le-nihveina Jakim tung ah;
english: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

paite: asawm-le-thumveina Huppah tung ah, asawm-le-liveina Jeshebeab tung ah;
english: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

paite: asawm-le-ngaveina Bilgah tung ah, asawm-le-gukveina Immer tung ah;
english: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

paite: asawm-le-sagihveina Hezir tung ah, asawm-le-giatveina Happizzez tung ah;
english: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,

paite: asawm-le-kuaveina Pethahiah tung ah, asawmnihveina Jehezekel tung ah;
english: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,

paite: asawmnih-le-khatveina Jakin tung ah, asawmnih-le-nihveina Gamul tung ah;
english: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,

paite: asawmnih-le-thumveina Delaiah tung ah, asawmnih-le-liveina Maaziah tung ah atu hi.
english: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.

paite: Huai bel TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in apu uh Aaron thu ana piak, TOUPA insung a nna asepdan ding ana sehdan ahi hi.
english: This was their ordering in their service, to come into Yahweh’s house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father, as Yahweh, the God of Israel, had commanded him.

paite: Levi suan dangte lak ah; Amram tapate lak ah Shubael ahi; Shubael tapate lak ah Jehdeiah.
english: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

paite: Rehabiah lam ah; Rehabaihte lak ah amakaipen Isshiah ahi.
english: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.

paite: Izharte lak ah Shelomoth; Shelomoth tapate lak ah Jahath,
english: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.

paite: Hebron tapate, a-upapen Jeriah ahi a, anihna Amariah, athumna Jahaziel, alina Jokameam ahi.
english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

paite: Uzziel tapate lak a mi Mikah; Mikah tapate lak a mi Shamir ahi.
english: The sons of Uzziel: Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.

paite: Mikah unaupa Isshiah ahi a; Isshiah tapate lak a mi Zekariah ahi.
english: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.

paite: Merari tapate bel Mahli leh Mushi ahi ua; Jaaziah tapate lak a mi Beno ahi.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.

paite: Merari suante, Jaaziah lak ah Beno, Shoham, Zakkur leh Ibrite ahi uh.
english: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.

paite: Mahli lak ah, Eleazar ahi a, ama'n tapa anei kei.
english: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

paite: Kish lak ah, Kish tapa Jerahmeel ahi.
english: Of Kish, the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.

paite: Mushi suante bel, Mahli, Eder leh Jerimothte ahi uh. Hiaite bel Levite suante lak a a-inkuan ua makai lianpente ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.

paite: Hiai inkuan chih a lianpen leh naupangpente'n leng Aaron ta a-unaute uh bang in, agam tan ding uh, kumpipa David, Zadok, Ahimelek, siampu leh Levite inko makaipente mitmuh in ai asan sam uhi.
english: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites, the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.

paite: Huan Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun tapa khenkhat kaihgingte, pekgingte, dakkhutbette toh ala vek a nasemmi ding in David leh sepaih heutute'n ahihtuam ua; nasep ding omdan bang zel in nasem mite tamdan ding asep uhi.
english: Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who were to prophesy with harps, with stringed instruments, and with cymbals. The number of those who did the work according to their service was:

paite: Asaph tapate lak a mi Zakkur, Joseph, Nethaniah leh Asarelah ahi ua, amau bel Asaph tapate, kumpipa thupiak bang a zawlnei thugen a gen, Asaph thuthu a omte ahi uh.
english: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. The sons of Asaph were under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied at the order of the king.

paite: Jeduthun lak ah: Jeduthun tapate Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah leh Matithiahte, guk ahi uh; kaihging toh TOUPA kiang a kipahthu gen a la vek a apa uh Jeduthun thuthu a omte ahi uh.
english: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising Yahweh with the harp.

paite: Heman lak ah: Heman tapate Bukkiah, Mataniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanni, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Malothi, Hothir leh Mahaziothte ahi uhi;
english: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.

paite: Huaite tengteng Pathian lam thu a kumpipa zawlnei Heman tapate pengkulkawi mut dingte ahi uh. Pathian in Heman tapa sawm-le-li leh tanu thum apia hi.
english: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

paite: Huaite tengteng TOUPA' inn a dakkhutbet toh, kaihging toh, pekging toh, Pathian inn a nasepna ding a la toh lem mite, apa uh thuthu a omte ahi uh; Asaph, Jeduthun leh Hemante bel kumpipa thupiak iak a omte ahi leuleu uhi.
english: All these were under the hands of their father for song in Yahweh’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God’s house: Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.

paite: Atamlam uh, a-unau, TOUPA ding a lasak kisin siam khinsa tengtengte toh zanih sawmgiat-le-giat ahi uh.
english: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to Yahweh, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.

paite: Huan aneu leh alian, sinsakmi leh sinmi in atan ding uh kibang vek in ai asan uhi.
english: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.

paite: Huchi in aisan akhatveina Asaph tapa Joseph tung ah atu a; anihveina Gedaliah tung ah; amah leh a-unaute leh atapate sawm-le-nih ahi uhi.
english: Now the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, he and his brothers and sons were twelve;

paite: Athumveina bel Zakkur tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih ahi uh.
english: the third to Zaccur, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Aliveina Izri tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih ahi uhi.
english: the fourth to Izri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Angaveina Nethaniah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Agukveina Bukkiah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asagihveina Jesharelah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: the seventh to Jesharelah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Agiatveina bel Jeshaiah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Akuaveina bel Mataniah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawmveina Shimei tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawm-le-khatveina Azarel tung ah, atapa leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawm-le-nihveina Hashabiah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawm-le-thumveina Shubael tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawm-le-liveina Matithiah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawm-le-ngaveina Jeremoth tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawm-le-gukveina Hananiah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawm-le-sagihveina Joshbekashah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawm-le-giatveina Hananiah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawm-le-kuaveina Malothi tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawmnihveina Eliathah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawmnih-le-khatveina Hothir tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawmnih-le-nihveina Giddalti tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawmnih-le-thumveina Mahazioth tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawmnih-le-liveina Romamti-ezer tung ah atu a, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih ahi uhi.
english: for the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.

paite: Kongkhak ngak pawl khendan: Kore mi bel Asaph tapate lak a Kore tapa Meshelemiah ahi.
english: For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

paite: Huan Meshelemiah in tapate anei a: ata masa Zekariah ahi a, azom Jediael, athumna Zebadiah, alina Jathniel;
english: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

paite: angana Elam, agukna Jehohanan, asagihna Elioenai ahi.
english: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.

paite: Obed-edom in tapate anei a; ata masa Shemaiah ahi a, azom Jehozabad, athumna Joah, alina Sakar, angana Nethaneel,
english: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

paite: agukna Amiel, asagihna Issakar, agiatna Peulethai ahi, amah bel Pathian in avualzawl hi.
english: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.

paite: Atapa Shemaiah a kipan tapa, a-inkote uh vaihawmte leng apiang ua; amaute mihat hangsan ahi chiat uhi.
english: Sons were also born to Shemaiah his son, who ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.

paite: Shemaiah tapate Othni, Rephael, Obed leh Elzabadte ahi ua, a-unau uh Elihu leh Semakiah bel mihat mahmah ahi uh.
english: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose relatives were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

paite: Huaite tengteng Obed-edom suante ahi ua: amau leh atapate uh leh a-unaute uh nasepna lamsang ah mi piching ahi uh; Obed-edom a kipan mite sawmguk-le-nih ahi uhi.
english: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom with their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.

paite: Meshelemiah in tapa leh unau mihat mahmah sawm-le-giat anei hi.
english: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.

paite: Merari suante lak a Hosah in leng tapate anei a; Shimri bel amakai lianpen ahi a, ta masa ahi kei na a, apa'n makaipen in abawl hi.
english: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),

paite: Azom in Hilkiah ahi a, athumna Tebaliah, alina Zekariah ahi. Hosah tapate leh a-unaute avek un sawm-le-thum ahi uh.
english: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.

paite: Huai amakaipente lak a mi a-unaute uh bang a TOUPA' inn a nasem thilbawl a tantuan nei a kongkhak ngakmi pawl a akhente uh ahi.
english: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Aneu alian in, a-inkuan dungzui zel un kongpi chih a om ding zonna ding in ai asan uhi.
english: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.

paite: Huchi in suahlam a dia aisan pen Shelemiah tung ah atu hi. Lemgel siam piltak, atapa Zekariah a ding in ai asan ua, mallam pen amah a tuam in atu hi.
english: The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

paite: Simlam bel Obed-edom tuam in; atapate tuam in Asuppim.
english: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.

paite: Tumlam a toupaina lampi a Shaleketh kongkhak venna toh, Shuppim leh Hosah tuam in.
english: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.

paite: Suahlam ah Levite guk a-om ua, niteng in mallam ah li, simlam ah li, thil koihkhawmna inn ah nih tuaktuak.
english: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.

paite: Tumlam inn um sung a ding in alutna ah li; inn um sung ah nih.
english: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

paite: Huaite ahi uh, Korah tapate leh Merari mi tapate kongkhak ngakmi pawl akhente uh.
english: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.

paite: Huan a-unaute uh Levite lak ah Ahijah, Pathian sum koihkhawmna inn leh thil latsate koihkhawmna inn heutu ahi.
english: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God’s house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

paite: Laadan tapate: Gershon mite tapate Laadante a te, pipute inkote amakai lianpen Gershon mi Laadan a te; Jehieli.
english: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.

paite: Jehieli tapate: Zetham, Joel a-unaupa, TOUPA' inn a sum koihkhawmna heutu ahi uh.
english: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Amram mite a kipan, Izhar mite a kipan, Hebron mite a kipan, Uzziel mite a kipan:
english: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:

paite: Mosi tapa, Gershom tapa Shebuel sum koihkhawmna heutu ahi.
english: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries.

paite: A-unaute bel Eliezer tapa Rahabiah, Jeshaiah, Joram, Zikri leh Shelomithte ahi.
english: His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.

paite: Shelomith leh a-unaute bel kumpipa David leh a-inkote uh makaipen sepaih sangkhat heutute leh zakhat heutute leh sepaih pawl heutute'n ahihsiangthousa uh, thil siangthou koihkhawmna inn tengteng kemte ahi uhi.
english: This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’ households, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.

paite: Kidouna gallak thilte TOUPA' inn bawlphatna ding in akoih uhi.
english: They dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair Yahweh’s house.

paite: Zawlnei Samuel, Kish tapa Saul, Ner tapa Abner leh Zeruiah tapa Joabte'n ahihsiangthou tengteng uh, kuapeuh in thil ahihsiangthousa peuhmah uh Shelomith leh a-unaute kep vek ahi.
english: All that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated, whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth and of his brothers.

paite: Izhar mi Kenaniah leh atapate Israel gam polam tungtang thu a heutute leh vaihawmmi ahi uh.
english: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

paite: Hebron mi Hashabiah leh a-unau mihangsan sangkhat-le-zasagih Jordan gal tumlam a Israelte ukpate ahi uhi; TOUPA nna tengteng leh kumpipa nasepna lam nna ah.
english: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of Yahweh and for the service of the king.

paite: Hebron mi Jerijah bel asuan uh tungtang thu a inko makai lam ah Hebronte, amakaipente ahi uhi. David kum sawmli avaihawm kum a azon un Gilead gam a Jazer ah mihat hangsan amukhia uhi.
english: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.

paite: A-unau mihangsante sangnih-le-zasagih ahi uhi. Huaite inko makaipen, kumpipa David in Pathian lam thil chiteng leh kumpipa na lam thu a Reuben, Gad leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte heutu dia abawlte ahi uh.
english: His relatives, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.

paite: Israelte atamdan uh inkuan makaipente, sepaih sangkhat heutute, zakhat heutute leh kumpipa nasem mite tengteng kum khat sung a kha teng a kikheng zelzel, pawl chih a mi singnih-le-sangli ahi uhi.
english: Now the children of Israel after their number, the heads of fathers’ households and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year—of every division were twenty-four thousand.

paite: Pawl khatna akha khatna a heutu Zabdiel tapa Jashobeam ahi a, pawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
english: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

paite: Amah Perez suan a mi, akha khatna a sepaih heutu tengteng makaipen ahi.
english: He was of the children of Perez, the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.

paite: Akha nihna pawl a heutu Ahoh mi Dodai ahi a, apawl a mi Mikloth leng ahi a, apawl uah singnih-le-sangli a-om uhi.
english: Over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite and his division, and Mikloth the ruler; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

paite: Akha thumna a sepaihte heutupen siampu Jehoiada tapa Benaiah ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
english: The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the chief priest. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

paite: Hiai Benaiah ahi a, sawmthum lak a mihangsan, sawmthum tung a mi pen; apawl ah atapa Ammizabad atel hi.
english: This is that Benaiah who was the mighty man of the thirty and over the thirty. Of his division was Ammizabad his son.

paite: Akha lina a sepaih heutu Joab unaupa Asahel ahi a, atapa Zebadiah asik a pang ahi, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
english: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

paite: Akha ngana a sepaih heutu Izrah mi Shamhuth ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
english: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

paite: Akha gukna a sepaih heutu Tekoa mi, Ikkesh tapa Ira ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
english: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

paite: Akha sagihna a sepaih heutu Ephraim suan Pelon mi Helez ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
english: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

paite: Akha giatna a sepaih heutu Zerah suan Husat mi Sibbekai ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
english: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

paite: Akha kuana a sepaih heutu Benjamin suan Anathoth mi Abiezer ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
english: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

paite: Akha sawmna a sepaih heutu Zerah suan Netophah mi Maharai ahi a, apawl ah singnih sangli a-om uh.
english: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

paite: Akha sawm-le-khatna a sepaih heutu Ephraim suan Pirathon mi Benaiah ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
english: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

paite: Akha sawm-le-nihna a sepaih heutu Othniel suan Netophah mi Heldai ahi a, apawl ah singnih-le-sangli a-om uh.
english: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

paite: Huai lou leng, Israel namte tung a: Reubente lak a Zikri tapa Eliezer vaihawmpa ahi a, Simeonte lak ah Maakah tapa Shephatiah ahi;
english: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: of the Reubenites, Eliezer the son of Zichri was the ruler; of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah;

paite: Levite lak ah Kumuel tapa, Hashabiah; Aaronte lak ah Zadok;
english: of Levi, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; of Aaron, Zadok;

paite: Judate lak ah David unaute lak ah Elihu, Issakarte lak ah Mikael tapa Omri;
english: of Judah, Elihu, one of the brothers of David; of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael;

paite: Zebulunte lak ah Obadiah tapa Ishmaiah; Naphtalite lak ah Azriel tapa Jeremoth;
english: of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah; of Naphtali, Jeremoth the son of Azriel;

paite: Ephraim suante lak ah Azaziah tapa Hoshea; Manasseh nam kimkhatte lak ah Pedaiah tapa Joel.
english: of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;

paite: Gilead gam a Manasseh nam kimkhatte lak ah, Zekariah tapa Ido; Benjaminte lak ah, Abner tapa Jaasiel;
english: of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah; of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner;

paite: Dante lak ah Jeroham tapa Azariel. Huaite Israel nam heutute ahi uh.
english: of Dan, Azarel the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.

paite: David in kum sawmnih a kipan anuailam asim kei hi, Israelte bel van a aksi zah in apungsak ding chih TOUPA'N ana gen khit tak ziak in.
english: But David didn’t take the number of them from twenty years old and under, because Yahweh had said he would increase Israel like the stars of the sky.

paite: Zeruiah tapa Joab in asim pan a, himahleh asimzou kei a, Israelte tung ah leng hehna ahong tungta a; kumpipa David vaihawm lai khangthubute ah azah gelh leng ahi sam kei hi.
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to take a census, but didn’t finish; and wrath came on Israel for this. The number wasn’t put into the account in the chronicles of King David.

paite: Kumpipa sumkempa Adiel tapa Azmaveth ahi a; huan lou lam ah, khopite ah, khopel khawng ah, insangte a sumkempa bel Uzziah tapa Jehonathan ahi.
english: Over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel. Over the treasures in the fields, in the cities, in the villages, and in the towers was Jonathan the son of Uzziah;

paite: Lou a leileh nasep sem kempa Kelub tapa Ezri ahi a;
english: Over those who did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub.

paite: Grephuan kempa Ramath mi, Shimei ahi a, grephuan a uain suksa koihkhawm kempa Shiph mite mi Zabdi ahi.
english: Over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite. Over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite.

paite: Phaiguam olive sing leh theipi kungte kempa Geder mi Baal-hanan ahi a, sathau koihkhawmna kempa Joash ahi.
english: Over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the lowland was Baal Hanan the Gederite. Over the cellars of oil was Joash.

paite: Sharon a ta ganhon kempa Sharon mi Shitrai ahi a, Phaizang a ganhon kempa Adlai tapa Shaphat ahi.
english: Over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite. Over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai.

paite: Sangawngsau kempa Ishmael mi Obil ahi a, sabiltung kempa Meronoth mi Jehdeiah ahi a;
english: Over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite. Over the donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite. Over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite.

paite: belamhon kempa Hagar mi Jaziz ahi. Huaite tengteng kumpipa David sumkem mite ahi uh.
english: All these were the rulers of the property which was King David’s.

paite: Huan David paneu, Jonathan tuh mipil, laisiam mahmah thu theipen ahi a, huan amah leh Hakmoni tapa Jehiel in kumpipa tapate asinsak uhi.
english: Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe. Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons.

paite: Kumpipa lemgelpihpa Ahithophel ahi a; Arki mi Hushai kumpipa lawm ahi a.
english: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.

paite: Ahithophel zom in Benaiah tapa Jehoiada leh Abiathar ahi ua, kumpipa sepaih heutu bel Joab ahi.
english: After Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar. Joab was the captain of the king’s army.

paite: Huan David in Israel heutu tengteng nam makaipente, kumpipa nasem a kikheng zelzel pawl heutute, sepaih sangkhat heutute, zakhat heutute, kumpipa leh atapate sum leh thil neih tengteng tung a heutute, milian mihat, mihat hangsan tengtengte toh Jerusalem ah asamkhawm hi.
english: David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, the captains of the companies who served the king by division, the captains of thousands, the captains of hundreds, and the rulers over all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the officers and the mighty men, even all the mighty men of valor, to Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa David adingh a, "Ka unaute leh ka mite aw, ka thu na ngaikhia dih ua, ke'n TOUPA thukhun bawm koihna leh i Pathian khe ngakna ding inn lam lungsim in ka nei gige a; alamna ding leng ka ngah khin sipsip hi.
english: Then David the king stood up on his feet and said, “Hear me, my brothers and my people! As for me, it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, and for the footstool of our God; and I had prepared for the building.

paite: Himahleh, Pathian in ka kiang ah, 'Nang zaw kidoumi sisan suahmi na hih ziak in ka min a ding in inn na lam kei ding,' achi hi.
english: But God said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for my name, because you are a man of war and have shed blood.’

paite: Himahleh TOUPA Israel' Pathian in, ka pa inkote tengteng lak a kipan Israelte kumpipa dia tangtawn a om ding in ahon na telta a; Judah makai pipen ding in ana telta a; Judah namte lak ah ka pa inkote; ka pa tapate lak a kipan Israel tengteng kumpipa ding in ahon na telkhe tuamta hi.
english: However Yahweh, the God of Israel, chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever. For he has chosen Judah to be prince; and in the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel.

paite: TOUPA'N tapa tampi ahon pia a, ka tapa tengteng lak ah, Israelte kumpipa ding in TOUPA gam laltutphah a tu ding in ka tapa Solomon ana telta hi.
english: Of all my sons (for Yahweh has given me many sons), he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of Yahweh’s kingdom over Israel.

paite: "Huchi in ka kiang ah, 'Na tapa Solomon in ka inn leh ka intualte adingsak ding; ka tapa ding in ka telta a, huchi in apa ka hi ding.
english: He said to me, ‘Solomon, your son, shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

paite: Ka thupiakte leh ka vaihawmte apom gigeleh tua na hih gige bang un agam tangtawn a ding in ka kipsak ding hi.'
english: I will establish his kingdom forever if he continues to do my commandments and my ordinances, as it is today.’

paite: Huchi in TOUPA mipi, Israelte tengteng mitmuh in leh i Pathian zak in TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiak tengteng pom ding leh limsak ding in ka hon hanthawn ahi; huchi in hiai gam hoih mahmah na luah ding ua, na nung uah na suante uh tangtawn a ding in na luahtou sawnsak zel ding uhi.
english: Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, Yahweh’s assembly, and in the audience of our God, observe and seek out all the commandments of Yahweh your God, that you may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children after you forever.

paite: "Huan nang, ka tapa Solomon, na pa Pathian thei inla, lungtang hoih bukim leh lungsim kilawptak in anasep sem in; TOUPA'N lah lungtang a-en sek a, lungsim a lunggel tengteng athei vek hi; amah na zonleh na mu ding a, na lehngatsanleh bel tangtawn in ahon khahkhe ding hi.
english: You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for Yahweh searches all hearts, and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever.

paite: Pilvang in; mun siangthou a dia inn lam ding in TOUPA'N nang ahon septa; hattak in om inla, pang in," achi hi.
english: Take heed now, for Yahweh has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong, and do it.”

paite: Huchi in David in atapa Solomon kiang ah atempul intual, asum koihkhawmna, adantan tungnung, asung dantan, azahngaihna tutphah,
english: Then David gave to Solomon his son the plans for the porch of the temple, for its houses, for its treasuries, for its upper rooms, for its inner rooms, for the place of the mercy seat;

paite: Alungsim a alunggel bang tengteng, TOUPA' inn um sung intual, akim dantan tengteng, Pathian in asum koihkhawmna inn, thil tan koihkhawmna inn lamdan ding guhgel apia hi.
english: and the plans of all that he had by the Spirit, for the courts of Yahweh’s house, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of God’s house, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;

paite: Siampute leh Levite apawlpawl a a-omna ding uh lim, TOUPA' inn a nasepna lam ding tengteng lim, TOUPA' inn a nasepna ding tui-um belsuan tengteng lim leng.
english: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, for all the work of the service of Yahweh’s house, and for all the vessels of service in Yahweh’s house—

paite: Nasepna lam a dia tui-um belsuan chi chih, dangka-eng tui-um belsuan ding, dangka-eng zat zel zah ding,
english: of gold by weight for the gold for all vessels of every kind of service, for all the vessels of silver by weight, for all vessels of every kind of service;

paite: Dangka-eng khawnvak koihna leh akhawnvak ding dangka-eng zat zel zah ding, khawnvak koihna leh akhawnvak tui ding a zat zel zah ding, khawnvak koihna a mun kiphamoh chiat bang zel a dangkasik khawnvak koihna ding a dia zat zel zah ding toh;
english: by weight also for the lamp stands of gold, and for its lamps, of gold, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps; and for the lamp stands of silver, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps, according to the use of every lamp stand;

paite: tanghou at koihna ding dangka-eng dohkan leh dangkasik dohkan bawlna ding a, dangka-eng zat zah ding leh dangkasik zat zel zah ding atehna in apia hi.
english: and the gold by weight for the tables of show bread, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver;

paite: Maiphiatna kuang, noute toh; dangka-eng belhbu ding, belhbu khat zel a dia zat zel zah ding.
english: and the forks, the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;

paite: Cherubte akha uh zak a; TOUPA thukhun bawm tuam tuanna lim bang bawlna ding dangka-engte toh.
english: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and gold for the plans for the chariot, and the cherubim that spread out and cover the ark of Yahweh’s covenant.

paite: David in, "Hiaite tengteng TOUPA'N amah mah khut a hon gelh, hiai a lim tengteng hon theisak hi in ka thei," achi hi.
english: “All this”, David said, “I have been made to understand in writing from Yahweh’s hand, even all the works of this pattern.”

paite: Huchi in David in atapa Solomon kiang ah, "Hattak leh hangsantak in om inla, pang in; lau ke'nla, lunglel sam ke'n; TOUPA Pathian, ka Pathian na kiang ah a-om hi; TOUPA' inn lam nasep tengteng zoh ahih vek mateng hon paisan in, ahon limsak lou kei ding hi.
english: David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed, for Yahweh God, even my God, is with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you, until all the work for the service of Yahweh’s house is finished.

paite: Huan ngai dih, Pathian in na chih teng semmi pawl siampute leh Levite a-om ua, bang nna peuh a, bang lam peuh a nasep siam, hattak chiat a nang hon panpih ding na kiang ah a-om zel ding uhi; heutute leh mipi teng in leng na thupiak peuhmah azui ding uhi," achi hi.
english: Behold, there are the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of God’s house. Every willing man who has skill for any kind of service shall be with you in all kinds of work. Also the captains and all the people will be entirely at your command.”

paite: Huan kumpipa David in mipi tengteng kiang ah, "Pathian telkhiak ka tapa Solomon anaupang lai in bangmah athei nai kei a, asep ding lah athupi ngal a, tempul mihing a ding ahi kei a, TOUPA Pathian a ding ahi zaw hi.
english: David the king said to all the assembly, “Solomon my son, whom alone God has chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for Yahweh God.

paite: Huchi in ka Pathian inn a ding in adangka-eng lam thil a ding in dangka-engte, dangkasik lam thil a ding in, dangkasik, dal lam thil a ding in dal, sik lam thil a ding in sik, sing lam thil a ding in sing theih tawk in ka na kisa khinta a, azepna ding onik suang, suang kilawm, asilh ding suang kilawm chi tuamtuam leh suangmantam chi chih leh suangpak suang tampite ka pe khinta hi.
english: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for the things of gold, the silver for the things of silver, the bronze for the things of bronze, iron for the things of iron, and wood for the things of wood, also onyx stones, stones to be set, stones for inlaid work of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

paite: Huai kia lou leng ka Pathian inn ka deihsak mahmah a, keimah sum dangka-eng leh dangkate leng, inn siangthou a dia ka na kisaksa tengteng chih louh, ka Pathian inn a ding in ka pia hi, huai tuh baang zutna ding in ophir dangka-eng,
english: In addition, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, since I have a treasure of my own of gold and silver, I give it to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house:

paite: dangka-eng talent sangthum leh dangkasik siangthou talent sangsagih, azatna lam tuamtuam a misiamte zat ding in, dangka-eng zatna ding a dangka-engte.
english: even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, with which to overlay the walls of the houses;

paite: Dangkasik zatna ding a dangkasikte ahi. Tuni in TOUPA a ding a kipaktak a pe phal kuakua na om ua?" achi hi.
english: of gold for the things of gold, and of silver for the things of silver, and for all kinds of work to be made by the hands of artisans. Who then offers willingly to consecrate himself today to Yahweh?”

paite: Huchi in inkuan makaipente, Israel nam heutute, sangkhat heutute leh zakhat heutute, kumpipa nasemte heutute toh kipaktak in apia uhi.
english: Then the princes of the fathers’ households, and the princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers over the king’s work, offered willingly;

paite: Pathian inn lamna ding dangka-eng talent sangnga leh darik singkhat, dangkasik talent singkhat leh dal talent singkhat-le-sanggiat, sik talent nuaikhat apia uhi.
english: and they gave for the service of God’s house of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand darics, of silver ten thousand talents, of bronze eighteen thousand talents, and of iron one hundred thousand talents.

paite: Suangmantam neite'n TOUPA sum koihkhawmna a Gershon mi Jehiel kep ding in akoih uhi.
english: People with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of Yahweh’s house, under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

paite: Huchi in mipite akipak mahmah ua, lungsim mun khat pu a kipaktak a TOUPA apiak ziak un, kumpipa David in leng nop sak petmah in nuam asa hi.
english: Then the people rejoiced, because they offered willingly, because with a perfect heart they offered willingly to Yahweh; and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

paite: Huchi in David in mipi tengteng ma ah TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu agen hi,
english: Therefore David blessed Yahweh before all the assembly; and David said, “You are blessed, Yahweh, the God of Israel our father, forever and ever.

paite: "Aw TOUPA, ka pu uh Israel' Pathian, tangtawn in phat in om hen. Aw TOUPA, thupina, thilhihtheihna, pahtawina, zohna, lalna nang a ahi a, lei leh van a om tengteng nang a ahi. Aw TOUPA, gam nang a ahi a, mi tengteng atungnungpen na hi.
english: Yours, Yahweh, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and on the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, Yahweh, and you are exalted as head above all.

paite: Hauhsakna leh pahtawina na kiang a kipan ahi, bangkim tung ah thu na nei a, na khut ah thilhihtheihna a-om a, mi tengteng hih thupina leh hatna piaktheihna na khut ah a-om hi.
english: Both riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all! In your hand is power and might! It is in your hand to make great, and to give strength to all!

paite: 'Huchi in ka Pathian uh kipahthu ka hon hilh ua, na min thupi ka phat uhi.'
english: Now therefore, our God, we thank you and praise your glorious name.

paite: "Himahleh kua ahia ka hih a, ka mite leng kua ahia ahih ua, hiaite kipaktak a ka hon lat theih mahmah uh? Thil tengteng na kiang a kipan a pawt ahi ua, nang a hon pe nawn lel ka hi uhi.
english: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from you, and we have given you of your own.

paite: Ka pi-le-pute uh bang in kou zaw na ma ah mikhual, mite kiang a om sam bang ka hi ua; leitung adamsung nite zaw limliap bang lel ahi a, lamet ding himhim a-om kei hi.
english: For we are strangers before you and foreigners, as all our fathers were. Our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no remaining.

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian uh, na min siangthou ding a inn ka hon lamsak ding a hiai thil ka na kisakna tengteng uh nangmah khutsuak ahi a, nang a vek ahi.
english: Yahweh our God, all this store that we have prepared to build you a house for your holy name comes from your hand, and is all your own.

paite: Ka Pathian, nang lungtangte na enchian sek a, diktatnate na kipahpih nak chih leng ka thei hi. Ke'n zaw lungsim taktak in hiai thil tengteng kipak mahmah in ka hon lan ahi, hiai lai a kipak mahmah a na kiang a hon lan mite ka muh in ka kipak mahmah hi.
english: I know also, my God, that you try the heart and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things. Now I have seen with joy your people, who are present here, offer willingly to you.

paite: AW TOUPA, ka pu uh Abraham, Isak, Israel' Pathian, na mite'n hichibang lungsim aput gige theihna ding un alungsimte uh nang a ding in hihkip inla;
english: Yahweh, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this desire forever in the thoughts of the heart of your people, and prepare their heart for you;

paite: huan ka tapa Solomon na thupiakte, na thu theihsakte, na dante zui a, huaite tengteng hih ding leh ka kisakkholhna inn lam ding in lungsim hoihkim pusak in," David in achi hi.
english: and give to Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision.”

paite: David in mipi tengteng kiang ah, "Khai le, TOUPA na Pathian uh phat un," achi a, huchi in mipi tengteng in TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian aphat ua, akun ua, TOUPA leh kumpipa abia uhi.
english: Then David said to all the assembly, “Now bless Yahweh your God!” All the assembly blessed Yahweh, the God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads and prostrated themselves before Yahweh and the king.

paite: Azing in TOUPA kiang ah kithoihna ding leh TOUPA kiang a halmang thillat ding in bawngtal sangkhat leh belam sangkhat leh belamnou sangkhat, adawn ding uh thillat toh Israelte tengteng a ding in kithoihna tampi alan uhi.
english: They sacrificed sacrifices to Yahweh and offered burnt offerings to Yahweh on the next day after that day, even one thousand bulls, one thousand rams, and one thousand lambs, with their drink offerings and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel,

paite: Huchi in huai ni in TOUPA ma ah nuamsatak in ane ua, a-om chiat uhi. David tapa Solomon bel kumpipa ding in abawl tuan nawn ua, TOUPA milian ding in sathau anilh ua, huan, Zadok bel siampu ding in.
english: and ate and drank before Yahweh on that day with great gladness. They made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him before Yahweh to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.

paite: Huchi in Solomon TOUPA laltutphah ah apa David sik in kumpipa in atuta a, lamzangtak in a-om a; huan Israelte tengteng in athu azui uhi.
english: Then Solomon sat on the throne of Yahweh as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.

paite: Huan heutute tengteng leh mihat hangsante leh kumpipa David tapa dang tengtengte kumpipa Solomon lak ah akipia uh.
english: All the princes, the mighty men, and also all of the sons of King David submitted themselves to Solomon the king.

paite: TOUPA'N Israelte tengteng mitmuh in nakpitak in Solomon ahih thupi a, Israel gam a ama a kumpipate lak ah kuamah in atan ngei louh uh, kumpipa hihna thupi mahmah atangta hi.
english: Yahweh magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and gave to him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

paite: Jesse tapa David in Israelte tengteng tung ah vai ahawm hi.
english: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

paite: Israelte tung a avaihawm sung kum sawmli ahi; Hebron ah kum sagih vai ahawm a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum-le-thum vai ahawm hi.
english: The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

paite: Upa tekkun a dam in, hausatak leh pahtawinate tang in asi a; asik in atapa Solomon in vai ahawm hi.
english: He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.
