paite: Ngai in, kumpipa David tanchin atung a kipan atawp tan in, zawlnei Samuel laibu, zawlnei Nathan laibu leh zawlnei Gad laibute ah atuang hi.
english: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Samuel the seer, and in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the history of Gad the seer,

paite: Avaihawm thute, athilhihtheihdan tengtengte, amah leh Israelte tung leh gam tengteng tung a thil hong omdante toh.
english: with all his reign and his might, and the events that involved him, Israel, and all the kingdoms of the lands.

paite: Hiaite Hebron a piang David tapate ahi uh: Ata masa, Jezreel numei Ahinoam a pan Amnon; anihna, Karmel numei Abigail a pan Daniel;
english: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;

paite: athumna, Geshur kumpipa Talmai tanu Maakah tapa a pan Absalom; alina, Haggith tapa Adonijah;
english: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;

paite: angana, Abital a pan Shephatiah; agukna, azi Eglah a pan Ithream.
english: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:

paite: Hebron ah atapa gukte apiang ua; huai ah kum sagih leh kha guk vai ahawm hi. Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum leh kum thum vai ahawm hi.
english: six were born to him in Hebron; and he reigned there seven years and six months. He reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem;

paite: Hiaite Ammiel tanu Bath-shua lak a Jerusalem a piang lite ahi uh: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, leh Solomon.
english: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;

paite: Adang kuate Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet;
english: and Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,

paite: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia;
english: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

paite: Elishama, Eliada, leh Eliphelet ahi uh.
english: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

paite: Hiaite tengteng, ameite tapate chih louh, David tapate ahi uh; huan asanggamnu uh Tamar ahi.
english: All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.

paite: Huan Solomon tapa Rehoboam ahi. Atapa Abia, atapa Asa, atapa Jehoshaphat,
english: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

paite: atapa Joram, atapa Ahaziah, atapa Joash;
english: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

paite: atapa Amaziah, atapa Azariah, atapa Jotham;
english: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

paite: atapa Ahaz, atapa Hezekiah, atapa Manasseh;
english: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

paite: atapa Ammon, atapa Josiah.
english: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.

paite: Josiah tapate: ata masa Johanan, anihna Jehoiakim, athumna Zedekiah, alina Shallum.
english: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.

paite: Jehoiakim tapate: Jekoniah atapa leh Zedekiah atapa ahi uh.
english: The sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah his son.

paite: Huan salmatpa Jekoniah suante: Atapa Salathiel,
english: The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,

paite: Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, leh Nedabiah.
english: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

paite: Pedaiah tapate: Zerubbabel leh Shimei ahi. Zerubbabel tapate: Meshullam leh Hananiah ahi; asanggamnu uh Shelomith ahi:
english: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;

paite: Hashubah, Ohel, Berekiah, Hasadiah, leh Jusa-hesed, nga ahi uh.
english: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed, five.

paite: Huan Hananiah tapate: Pelatiah leh Jeshaiah ahi; Rephaiah tapate, Arnan tapate, Obadiah tapate, Shekaniah tapate.
english: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.

paite: Shekaniah tapa Shemaiah ahi. Huan Shemaiah tapate: Hattush, Igeal, Bariah, Neariah, leh Shaphat, guk ahi uh.
english: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

paite: Neariah tapate: Elioenai, Hizkiah, leh Azrikam, thum ahi uh.
english: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.

paite: Elioenai tapate: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Dalaiah, leh Anani, sagih ahi uh.
english: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.

paite: Judah tapate: Perez, Hezron, Karmi, Hur leh Shobal ahi uh.
english: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

paite: Shobal tapa Reaiah in Jahath asuang; Jahath in Ahumai leh Lahad asuang hi. Hiaite Zorathit inkote ahi uh.
english: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

paite: Huan hiaite Etam pa tapate ahi uh: Jezreel, Ishma, leh Idbash: huan asanggamnu uh Hazelelponi ahi.
english: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.

paite: Gedor pa Penuel ahi a, Hushah pa Ezer ahi. Hiaite Ephrathah ta masa, Bethlehem pa, Hur tapate ahi uh.
english: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.

paite: Tekoa pa Ashur in zi nih, Helah leh Naarah anei hi.
english: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

paite: Naarah in Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, leh Haahashtari aneihsak hi. Hiaite Naarah tapate ahi uh.
english: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

paite: Helah tapate Zereth, Izhar, leh Ethnan ahi uh.
english: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.

paite: Koz in Anub leh Zobebah, Harum tapa Aharhel inkote asuang hi.
english: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

paite: Huan Jabez bel a-unaute sang in azahtakhuaizaw a: anu'n amin Jabez asa a, "Lungkhamna toh amah ka neih ziak in," chi in.
english: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”

paite: Jabez in Israel' Pathian asam a, "Aw hon vualzawl mahmah in, ka gam liansak in, na khut ka kiang ah om in, hoih lou a kipan in kei hon kem in, hon lungkham saklouhna ding in," chi in. Huchi in Pathian in anget aphalta hi.
english: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!” God granted him that which he requested.

paite: Huan Shuhah sanggampa Kelub in Eshton pa Mehir asuang hi.
english: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

paite: Eshton in Beth-rapha, Paseah, Irnahash pa Tehinnah asuang hi. Hiaite Rekah mite ahi uh.
english: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.

paite: Huan Kenaz tapate: Othniel, Seraiah; huan Othniel tapate: Hathat.
english: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.

paite: Meonothai in Ophrah asuang; Seraiah in Geharasim pa Joab asuang; khutsiam mite chih in a-om uhi.
english: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim, for they were craftsmen.

paite: Huan Jephunneh tapa Kaleb tapate: Iru, Elah leh Naam ahi uh. Elah tapa Kenaz ahi.
english: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.

paite: Jahaleleel tapate: Ziph leh Ziphah, Tiria leh Asarel ahi uh.
english: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

paite: Ezra tapate: Jether, Mered, Epher leh Jalon ahi uh; huan Miriam, Shammai, leh Eshtemoa pa Ishbah anei hi.
english: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

paite: Azi Jehudijah in Jered Gedor pa, Heber Sokoh pa, leh Jekuthiel Zanoah pa asuang hi. Huchi in hiaite Mered in api, Pharaoh tanu Bithiah tapate ahi uh.
english: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.

paite: Huan Naham sanggamnu, Hodiah zi tapate: Keilah pa Garmi, leh Maakah mi Eshtemoa pa ahi uh.
english: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

paite: Simon tapate: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, leh Tilon ahi uh. Ishi tapate: Zoheth, leh Ben-zoheth ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.

paite: Huan Judah tapa Shelah tapate: Lekah pa Er, Mareshah pa Laadah, leh puanmalngat hoih bawlte inkuante, Ashbea inkote;
english: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;

paite: Jokim, Kozeba mite, Joash, Saraph, Moab a vaihawmna nei, Jashubi-lehem. Huchi in chiamtehna laite alui mahmah hi.
english: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.

paite: Hiaite belvel mite leh Netaim leh Gederah a tengte ahi uh. Huai ah anasepna ziak in kumpipa kiang ah ateng uhi.
english: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king for his work.

paite: Simeon tapate: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul,
english: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;

paite: atapa Shallum, atapa Mibsam, atapa Mishma.
english: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.

paite: Mishma tapate: atapa Hammuel, atapa, Zakkur, atapa Shimei.
english: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.

paite: Shimei in tapa sawm-le-guk leh tanu guk anei a, himahleh a-unaute'n tate tampi anei kei ua, Judah tate bang in, a-inkote tengteng uh leng apung kei uhi.
english: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn’t have many children, and all their family didn’t multiply like the children of Judah.

paite: Amaute Beer-sheba, Moladah leh Hazar-shual ah ateng ua;
english: They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,

paite: Bilhah ah, Ezem ah, Tolad ah;
english: at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,

paite: Bethuel ah, Hormah ah, Ziklag ah;
english: at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,

paite: Beth-markaboth ah, Hazar-susim ah leh Beth-birei ah, Shaaraim ah leng. Hiaite David vaihawm tanpha in akhopite uh ahi.
english: at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.

paite: Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Token, Ashan, akhotate uh ahi, khopi nga ahi.
english: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;

paite: Huai kim a khotate tengteng Baal pha in ahi. Hiaite atenna uh ahi a, khangthu suina anei uhi.
english: and all their villages that were around the same cities, as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept their genealogy.

paite: Meshobab, Jamlek leh Amaziah tapa Joshah;
english: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,

paite: Joel, Joshibiah tapa Jehu, Seraiah tapa, Asiel tapa;
english: Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

paite: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel leh Benaiah;
english: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,

paite: Shiphi tapa Ziza, Allon tapa, Jedaiah tapa, Shimri tapa, Shemaiah tapa;
english: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—

paite: Hiai minlohte a-inko sung ua vaihawmte ahi uh: huan apipute uh inkote akhang mahmah uhi.
english: these mentioned by name were princes in their families. Their fathers’ houses increased greatly.

paite: Aganhon uh a dia loupa nek ding zong ding in, phaizang suahlam pang tanpha in, Gedor lutna chiang pha in apai uhi.
english: They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

paite: Loupa nek hoihna leh tamna amu ua, gam za leh dai, ban ah galmuang; tuma a huai a omte lah Ham a kipante ahi uhi.
english: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful, for those who lived there before were descended from Ham.

paite: Hiai min gelhte Judah kumpipa Hezekiah dam lai in ahong pai ua, apuaninte uh leh huai a om Meun mite asual ua, amaute ahihse vek ua, tuni tan in amun uah ateng uh; huai lai a agante uh a dia louhing a-om ziak in.
english: These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents and the Meunim who were found there; and they destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.

paite: Alak ua khenkhatte, Simeon tapate, mi zanga, aheutute uh Ishi tapate Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah leh Uzziel makaih in Seir tang ah ahoh uhi.
english: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

paite: Asuakta Amalek mite lak a khosuaksunte asual ua, tuni tan in huai ah ateng uhi.
english: They struck the remnant of the Amalekites who escaped, and have lived there to this day.

paite: Huan Israel ta masapen Reuben tapate (amah piang masapen ahi a; himahleh apa lupna ahihbuah ziak in, piandan a u-pa hihna Israel tapa, Joseph tapate kiang a piak ahi; huchi in upatna dungzui in khangthu akisim kei hi.
english: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (for he was the firstborn, but because he defiled his father’s couch, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; and the genealogy is not to be listed according to the birthright.

paite: A-unaute tung ah Judah avualzou a, amah a kipan in vaihawmtu ahong om a; himahleh upatna Joseph a ahi).
english: For Judah prevailed above his brothers, and from him came the prince; but the birthright was Joseph’s)—

paite: Israel ta masapen Reuben tapate: Hanok, Pallu, Hezron, leh Karmi.
english: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

paite: Joel tapate: atapa Shemaiah, atapa Gog, atapa Shimei,
english: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

paite: atapa Mikah, atapa Reaiah, atapa Baal;
english: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

paite: atapa Beerah, atapa Assuria, kumpipa Tilgath-pilneser in apimang; amah Reuben mite vaihawmtu ahi.
english: and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive. He was prince of the Reubenites.

paite: Huan akhangthute uh khangthu sutna akisim lai a a-inkuankuan ua a-unaute; hausa makaipa, Jeiel leh Zekariah,
english: His brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was listed: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

paite: Azaz tapa Bela, Joel tapa Shema, Aroer a teng, Nebo leh Baal-meon pha a teng.
english: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon;

paite: Suahlam ah luipi Euphrates a kipan gamdai lutna pha in atengta hi; Gilead gam a agante uh apun ziak in.
english: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

paite: Huan Saul dam lai in Hagri mite toh akidou ua, huaite azou a: Gilead suahlam gam tengteng ah apuaninte uah ateng uhi.
english: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.

paite: Huan Gad tapate amau zawntak ah, Salkah tan in Bashan gam ah ateng uh:
english: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah:

paite: Hausa makai Joel leh azom Shapham, Janai leh Bashan ah Shaphat:
english: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

paite: Apipute uh inkote a-unaute uh: Mikael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jakan, Zia leh Eber, sagih ahi uh.
english: Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.

paite: Hiaite Huri tapa Abihail tapate ahi uh, Jaroah tapa, Gilead tapa, Mikael tapa. Jeshishai tapa. Jahdo tapa, Buz tapa;
english: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

paite: Abdiel tapa Ahi, Guni tapa, apipute uh inkote hausapa.
english: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.

paite: Bashan a Gilead ah, akhopite, Sharon huapkhakte tengteng, agamgi tanpha ah ateng uhi.
english: They lived in Gilead in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon as far as their borders.

paite: Hiaite tengteng Judah Kumpipa Jotham dam lai leh Israel kumpipa Jeroboam dam lai in akhangthute in sim in a-om vek uhi.
english: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

paite: Reuben tapate leh Gad mite leh Manasseh nam kimkhat mihangsante, namsau leh lum thuah thei mite leh thalpeu a kap ding, kidou siam, galkap dia kuan thei, singli sangli zasagih-le-sawmguk ahi uh.
english: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, able to shoot with bow, and skillful in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty that were able to go out to war.

paite: Hagarit mite, Jetur toh, Naphish toh, Nodab toh akidou uhi.
english: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.

paite: Amaute dou ding in panpih in a-om ua, huchi in Hagarit mite akhut ua piak in a-om ua, akiang ua om tengteng toh; amau lah Pathian kiang ah kidouna ah akap ngal ua, Pathian in angetna uh aza a; amah a amuanna uh akoih ziak un.
english: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all who were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he answered them because they put their trust in him.

paite: Huchi in agante uh alamang ua; asangawngsau uh singnga, belam nuainih-le-singnga, sabiltung sangnih, mite nuaikhat.
english: They took away their livestock: of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand, and of donkeys two thousand, and of men one hundred thousand.

paite: Kidouna Pathian a ahih ziak in, mi tampi petmah apuk uhi. Huchi in saltanna tanpha in amun uah atengta uhi.
english: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity.

paite: Huan Manasseh nam kimkhatte tate gamsung ah ateng ua: Bashan a kipan Baal-hermon leh Senir leh Hermon tang tan in apung uhi.
english: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.

paite: Hiaite Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, Jahdiel, mihat hangsante, miminthangte, apipute uh inkuan a lupente ahi uhi.
english: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.

paite: Huchi in apipute uh Pathian dou in atalek ua, ama ua Pathian in ahihsiat, gam a mite pathiante lak ah ang akawm uhi.
english: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them.

paite: Israel' Pathian in Assuria kumpipa Pul kha leh Assuria kumpipa Tiglath-pileser kha atokthou a, huchi in amaute apimang a, Reuben mite leh Gad mite leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte mahmah, Halah, Habor, Hara leh Gozan lui pha in api a, tuni tanpha a-om uh.
english: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried away the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.

paite: Levi Tapate: Gershom, Kohath, Merari ahi uh.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

paite: Huan Kohath tapate: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, Uzziel ahi uh.
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

paite: Amram tate: Aaron, Mosi, Miriam ahi uh. Aaron tapate: Nadab leh Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar ahi uh.
english: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

paite: Eleazar in Phinehas asuang a, Phinehas in Abishua asuang;
english: Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, Phinehas became the father of Abishua,

paite: Abishua in Bukki asuang a, Bukki in Uzzi asuang;
english: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.

paite: Uzzi in Zerahiah asuang a, Zerahiah in Meraioth asuang;
english: Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth.

paite: Meraioth in Amariah asuang a, Amariah in Ahitub asuang;
english: Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

paite: Ahitub in Zadok asuang a, Zadok in Ahimaaz asuang;
english: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz.

paite: Ahimaaz in Azariah asuang a, Azariah in Johanan asuang;
english: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.

paite: Johanan in Azariah asuang a, amah Jerusalem a Solomon inn lam lai siampu nasep sempa ahi:
english: Johanan became the father of Azariah, who executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.

paite: Huan Azariah in Amariah asuang a, Amariah in Ahitub asuang;
english: Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

paite: Ahitub in Zadok asuang a, Zadok in Shallum asuang;
english: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Shallum.

paite: Shallum in Hilkiah asuang a, Hilkiah in Azariah asuang;
english: Shallum became the father of Hilkiah. Hilkiah became the father of Azariah.

paite: Azariah in Seraiah asuang a, Seraiah in Jahozadak asuang;
english: Azariah became the father of Seraiah. Seraiah became the father of Jehozadak.

paite: TOUPA'N Nebukadnezzar khut a Judah leh Jerusalem apimang lai in saltanna lam ah Jahozadak apitel hi.
english: Jehozadak went into captivity when Yahweh carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

paite: Levi tapate: Gershom, Kahath leh Merari Jahozadak ahi uh.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

paite: Hiaite Gershom tapate minte ahi uh: Libni leh Shimei.
english: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

paite: Kohath tapate: Amram, Ezhar, Hebron leh Uzziel ahi uh.
english: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

paite: Merari tapate: Mahli leh Mushi ahi uh. Hiaite apipute uh inkote dungzui in Levite inkuante ahi uh.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.

paite: Gershom a kipan: Atapa Libni, atapa Jahath, atapa Zimmah;
english: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

paite: atapa Joah, atapa Iddo, atapa Zerah, atapa Jeatherai.
english: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.

paite: Kohath tapate: Atapa Amminadab, atapa Korah, atapa Assir;
english: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

paite: atapa Elkanah, atapa Ebiasaph, atapa Assir;
english: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,

paite: atapa Tahath, atapa Uriel, atapa Uzziah, atapa Shaul.
english: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

paite: Elkanah tapate: Amasai leh Ahimoth ahi a,
english: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.

paite: atapa Elkanah, atapa Zophai, atapa Nahath,
english: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, Nahath his son,

paite: atapa Eliab, atapa Jeroham, atapa Elkanah.
english: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.

paite: Samuel tapate: Ata masapen Joel, azom Abiah ahi.
english: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.

paite: Merari tapate: Mahli, atapa Libni, atapa Shimei, atapa Uzzah;
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,

paite: atapa Shimea, atapa Haggiah, leh atapa Asaiah.
english: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

paite: Huan hiaite David in thukhun bawm akhawl nung a, TOUPA insung a la a nasepna tung a heutu a akoihte ahi uh.
english: These are they whom David set over the service of song in Yahweh’s house after the ark came to rest there.

paite: Jerusalem a Solomon in TOUPA' inn alam khit masiah, kihoupihna biakbuk ma ah la sa in nna asem uhi. Athupiak bang zel un anasepna uh ahih uhi.
english: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting until Solomon had built Yahweh’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.

paite: Hiaite atapate toh nasemte ahi uhi. Kohath mite tapate ahihleh: Lasami Heman, Joel tapa, Samuel tapa;
english: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

paite: Elkanah tapa, Jeroham tapa, Eliel tapa, Toah tapa;
english: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

paite: Zuph tapa, Elkanah tapa, Mahath tapa, Amasai tapa;
english: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

paite: Elkanah tapa, Joel tapa, Azariah tapa, Zephaniah tapa;
english: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

paite: Tahath tapa, Assir tapa, Ebiasaph tapa, Korah tapa;
english: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

paite: Ezhar tapa, Kohath tapa, Levi tapa, Israel tapa.
english: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

paite: A-unaupa Asaph, ataklam pang a dinghpa, Asaph Berekiah tapa mahmah, Shimea tapa;
english: His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,

paite: Mikael tapa, Baaseiah tapa, Malkijah tapa;
english: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,

paite: Ethni tapa, Zerah tapa, Adaiah tapa;
english: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

paite: Ethan tapa, Zimmah tapa, Shimei tapa,
english: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

paite: Jahath tapa, Gershom tapa, Levi tapa,
english: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

paite: akhut veilam ah a-unaute uh Merari tapate: Kishi tapa Etham, Malluk tapa Abdi;
english: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

paite: Hashabiah tapa, Amaziah tapa, Hilkiah tapa;
english: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

paite: Amzi tapa, Bani tapa, Shamer tapa;
english: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,

paite: Mahli tapa, Mushi tapa, Merari tapa, Levi tapa.
english: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

paite: A-unaute uh Levi mite Pathian inn biakbuk a nasepna tengteng a ding a aseh ahi uhi.
english: Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God’s house.

paite: Himahleh Aaron leh atapate'n halmang maitam tung ah, gimlim maitam tung ah, Mun Siangthoupen a nasepna tengteng a ding in alan uh; Pathian sikha Mosi thupiak tengteng bang a, Israel a ding a tatna bawl ding in.
english: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

paite: Huan hiaite Aaron tapate ahi uh: atapa Eleazar, tapa Phinehas, atapa, Abishua;
english: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

paite: atapa Bukki, atapa Uzzi, atapa Zerahiah;
english: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

paite: atapa Meraioth, atapa Amariah, atapa Ahitub;
english: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

paite: atapa Zadok, atapa Ahimaaz ahi.
english: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.

paite: Huchi in hiaite agamgite ua apuanin kaihnate uh dungzui a atenna uh ahi: Aaron tapate kiang ah, Kohath mite inkote a, amau mun ding a ai san a piak masakpen ahi.
english: Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),

paite: Amau kiang ah Judah gam ah Hebron leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh apia uhi;
english: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands around it;

paite: Himahleh huai a khopi munte leh khotate, Jephunneh tapa Kaleb kiang ah apia uhi.
english: but the fields of the city and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

paite: Aaron tapate kiang ah kihumbitna khopite apia uh, Hebron; Libna leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Jattir, Eshtemoa leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
english: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron, Libnah also with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,

paite: Hilen leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Debir leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
english: Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,

paite: Ashan leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Beth-shemesh leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh.
english: Ashan with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands;

paite: Huan Benjamin nam a kipan; Geba leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Allemeth leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Anathoth leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh. A-inkuante tengteng a akhopite tengteng uh khopi sawm-le-thum ahi hi.
english: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its pasture lands, Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

paite: Kohath tapa omlaite kiang ah, huai nam inkuan a kipan, nam kimkhat, Manasseh nam kimkhat a kipan khopi sawm aisan a piak ahi uhi.
english: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.

paite: Huan Gershom tapate ahihleh, a-inkuante uh dungzui in, Issakar nam a kipan, Asher nam a kipan, Naphtali nam a kipan, Bashan a Manasseh nam a kipan, khopi sawm-le-thum ahi.
english: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

paite: Merari tapate kiang ah aisan a piak ahi, a-inkote uh dungzui in, Reuben nam a kipan, Gad nam a kipan, Zebulun nam a kipan, khopi sawm-le-nihte.
english: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

paite: Israel suante'n Levi mite kiang ah khopite leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh apia uhi.
english: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.

paite: Judah tate nam a kipan, Simeon tapa nam a kipan, Benjamin tate nam a kipan, hiai khopi minlohte, aisan in apia uhi.
english: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.

paite: Kohath tapa inkote lak a khenkhatte'n Ephraim nam a kipan amau gamgi khopite anei uhi.
english: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.

paite: Amaute kiang ah bitna khopite apia uh, Ephraim singtang gam a Shekem leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; Gezer leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
english: They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands and Gezer with its pasture lands,

paite: Jokmeam leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Beth-horon leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
english: Jokmeam with its pasture lands, Beth Horon with its pasture lands,

paite: Aijalon leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Gath-rimmon leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
english: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands;

paite: Manasseh nam kimkhat a kipan Aner leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; Bileam leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Kohath tapate inko lak a omlaite a ding in.
english: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its pasture lands, and Bileam with its pasture lands, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.

paite: Gershom tapa kiang ah, Manasseh nam kimkhat inkuan a kipan a piak ahi; Bashan a Golan leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Astaroth leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
english: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, and Ashtaroth with its pasture lands;

paite: Issakar nam a kipan in: Kedesh leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Daberath leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
english: and out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,

paite: Ramoth leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Anem leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
english: Ramoth with its pasture lands, and Anem with its pasture lands;

paite: Asher nam a kipan in: Mashal leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Abdon leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
english: and out of the tribe of Asher, Mashal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,

paite: Hukok leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Rehob leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
english: Hukok with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands;

paite: Naphtali nam a kipan in: Galili a Kedesh leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Hammon leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Kiriathaim leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh.
english: and out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, Hammon with its pasture lands, and Kiriathaim with its pasture lands.

paite: Levi mite omlaite kiang ah, Merari tapate, Zebulun nam a kipan a piak ahi, Rimmon leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Tabor leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
english: To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its pasture lands, and Tabor with its pasture lands;

paite: Jeriko a Jordan khen, suahlam pang, Reuben nam a kipan, amaute piak ahi, gamdai a Bezer leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Jahzah leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
english: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasture lands, Jahzah with its pasture lands,

paite: Kedemoth leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Mephaath leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
english: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands;

paite: Gad nam a kipan in: Gilead a Ramoth leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Mahanaim leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
english: and out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, Mahanaim with its pasture lands,

paite: Heshbon leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Jazer leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh.
english: Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands.

paite: Issakar tapate: Tola, Puah, Jashub, Shimron, li ahi uh.
english: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

paite: Tola tapate: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, Shemuel, apipute uh inkuan a lupente, huai bel, Tola a kipante; akhangte ua mihat hangsante: David dam lai in singnih sangnih-le-zaguk ahi uh.
english: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.

paite: Huan Uzzi tapa Izrahiah ahi, huan Izrahiah tapate: Mikael, Obadiah, Joel, Isshiah, nga ahi ua, avek un hausa makaipente ahi uh.
english: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.

paite: Amaute toh, apipute uh inkote dan in, akhangte un, kidouna ding a sepaih pawlte ahi ua, singthum-le-sangguk; zi leh tapa tampi anei uhi.
english: With them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the army for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.

paite: Huan Issakar inkote tengteng lak a, mihat hangsante, a-unaute uh avek ua khangthu sutna a sut in, singgiat-le-sangsagih ahi.
english: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, listed in all by genealogy, were eighty-seven thousand.

paite: Benjamin tapate: Bela, Beker, Jediael, thum ahi uh.
english: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.

paite: Bela tapate: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, Iri, nga ahi ua; pipute inkuan a lupente, mihat hangsante; huan khangthu sutna a sim in singnih sangnih sawmthum-le-li ahi uh.
english: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were listed by genealogy twenty-two thousand thirty-four.

paite: Beker, tapate: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, Alameth ahi uh. Hiaite tengteng Beker tapate ahi uh.
english: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.

paite: Huchi in khangthu sutna a sim ahi ua, akhangte uh dungzui in, apipute uh inkuan a lupente, mihat hangsante, singnih-le-zanih ahi uh.
english: They were listed by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand two hundred.

paite: Huan Jediael tapa Bilhan ahi; Bilhan tapate: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Kenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, Ahisahar.
english: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

paite: Hiaite tengteng Jediael tapate ahi uh, apipute uh inkuan a lupente dungzui in, mihat hangsan, kidouna a dia sepaih pawl a kuankhe thei dingte, singkhat sangsagih-le-zanih ahi uh.
english: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.

paite: Ir tapate Shuppim leh Huppim ahi ua, Aher tapa Hushim ahi.
english: So were Shuppim, Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, and the sons of Aher.

paite: Naphtali tapate: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer leh Shallum, Bilhah tapate ahi uh.
english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.

paite: Manasseh tapate: Asriel, azi in asuan: amei Aram numei in Gilead pa Makir asuang hi;
english: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore. She bore Machir the father of Gilead.

paite: Makir in Huppim leh Shuppim sanggamnu amin Maakah zi in api a; anihna min Zelophehad ahi: Zelophehad in tanute anei hi.
english: Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah. The name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.

paite: Makir zi Maakah in tapa anei a, amin Peresh asa a; a-unaupa min Sheresh ahi; atapate Ulam leh Rakem ahi uh.
english: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh. The name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

paite: Ulam tapa Bedan ahi. Hiaite Gilead tapate ahi uh Makir tapa, Manasseh tapa.
english: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

paite: Asanggamnu Hammoleketh in Ishod, Abiezer, Mahlah anei hi.
english: His sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.

paite: Shemida tapate Ahian, Shekem, Likhi, Aniam ahi uh.
english: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.

paite: Huan Ephraim tapate: Shuthelah, leh atapa Bered, leh atapa Tahath, leh atapa Eleadah, leh atapa Tahath,
english: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,

paite: leh atapa Zabad, leh atapa Shuthelah, huan Ezer leh Elead, agante uh lamang ding a ahong paisuk ua gamsung a om Gath mite'n athahte uh.
english: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take away their livestock.

paite: Apa uh Ephraim in ni tampi asuun a, huchi in amah lungmuan ding in a-unaute ahong uhi.
english: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.

paite: Huchi in azi kiang ah ahoh a, nau apai a, tapa anei a, a-insung tuahsiat ziak in amin ding in Beriah asa hi.
english: He went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because there was trouble with his house.

paite: Atanu Sheerah ahi a, Beth-horon nuainung leh tungnung leh Uzzen- sheerah lamnu ahi.
english: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.

paite: Rephah atapa ahi, Reseph leng; Reseph tapa Telah, Tahan atapa;
english: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,

paite: Laadan atapa, Ammihud atapa, Elishama atapa;
english: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

paite: Nun atapa, Joshua atapa ahi.
english: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.

paite: Aneihte uleh atennate uh Bethel leh akhotate ahi, suahlam ah Naaran, tumlam ah Gezer, huai khopite toh, huai Ayyah leh khopite tan in.
english: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;

paite: Manasseh tate gamgi chin ah, Beth-shean leh akhopite, Taanak leh akhopite, Meggiddo leh akhopite, Dor leh akhopite, hiaite ah Israel tapa Joseph tapate ateng uhi.
english: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.

paite: Asher tapate: Imnah, Ishuah, Ishuai, Beriah, Sheerah asanggamnu uh.
english: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Serah was their sister.

paite: Beriah tapate: Heber, Malkiel, Birzaith pa.
english: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

paite: Heber in Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, Shua asanggamnu asuang hi.
english: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.

paite: Japhlet tapate: Pasak, Bimhal, Asvath. Hiaite Japhlet tapate ahi uh.
english: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

paite: Shamer tapate: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah leh Aram.
english: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

paite: A-unaupa Helem tapate: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, Amal.
english: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.

paite: Zophah tapate: Suah, Hernephar, Shual, Beri, Imrah;
english: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,

paite: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, Beera.
english: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.

paite: Jether tapate: Jephunneh, Pispah, Ara.
english: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.

paite: Ulla tapate: Arah, Hanniel, Rezia.
english: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.

paite: Hiaite tengteng Asher tate ahi uh; pipute inkuan a lupente, mihat, mitel, hangsan, kumpi tapate lak a vaihawmte. Kidouna nasepna ding a khangthu sutna a sim in amau zah singnih-le-sangguk ahi uhi.
english: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.

paite: Huchi in Benjamin in ata masa Bela, azom Ashbel, athumna Aharah asuang;
english: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,

paite: alina Nohah, angana Rapha ahi.
english: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

paite: Bela in tapate anei a, Addar, Gera leh Abihud;
english: Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,

paite: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah;
english: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,

paite: Gera, Shephuphan, Huram.
english: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.

paite: Hiaite Ehud tapate ahi uh: hiaite Geba a tengte pipute inkuan a lupente ahi uh, huchi in amaute Manahath ah sal in api uhi.
english: These are the sons of Ehud. These are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried captive to Manahath:

paite: Naaman, Ahiah, Gera, amaute sal in api a; Uzza leh Ahihud asuang hi.
english: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

paite: Shaharaim in amaute asawlmang nung in, Moab mun ah tapate asuang; azite Hushim leh Baar ahi uh.
english: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.

paite: Azi Hodesh a pan, Jobab, Zibia, Messa leh Malkam asuang hi;
english: By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,

paite: Jeuz, Sakia, Mirma. Hiaite pipute inkuan a lupente, atapate ahi uhi.
english: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.

paite: Hushim lak ah Abitub leh Elpaal asuang hi.
english: By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.

paite: Elpaal tapate: Eber, Misham, Shamed, Ono lamkhetu leh Lod, huai khopite toh lampa.
english: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;

paite: Beriah, Shema, Aijalon, Gath a tengteng delhzakte tengtengte pipute inkuan a lupente ahi uh;
english: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;

paite: Ahio, Shakshak, Jeremoth;
english: and Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,

paite: Zebadiah, Arad, Edar,
english: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,

paite: Beriah tapate Mikael, Ishpah, Joha.
english: Michael, Ishpah, Joha, the sons of Beriah,

paite: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hezeki, Heber;
english: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,

paite: Ishmerai, Jezliah, Jobab, Elpaal tapate,
english: Ishmerai, Izliah, Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,

paite: Jakim, Zikri, Zabdi;
english: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,

paite: Elienai, Zilthai, Eliel;
english: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,

paite: Adaiah, Beraiah, Shimrath, Shimei tapate:
english: Adaiah, Beraiah, Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,

paite: Ishpan, Heber, Eliel;
english: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,

paite: Abdon, Zikri, Hanan;
english: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,

paite: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah;
english: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,

paite: Ipdeiah, Penuel, Shashak tapate;
english: Iphdeiah, Penuel, the sons of Shashak,

paite: Samserai, Shehariah, Athaliah;
english: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,

paite: Jaaresiah, Eliah, Zikri, Jeroham tapate.
english: Jaareshiah, Elijah, Zichri, and the sons of Jeroham.

paite: Hiaite akhangte ua pipute inkuan a lupente ahi uh, ahausa makaipente: hiaite Jerusalem ah ateng uhi.
english: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.

paite: Gibeon ah Gibeon pa ateng a, azi min Maakah ahi:
english: The father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon

paite: Atapa masapen Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab;
english: with his firstborn son Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,

paite: Gedor, Ahio, Zaker.
english: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,

paite: Mikloth in Shimea asuang hi. Anaute uh toh Jerusalem ah a-unaute uh zom ah ateng lai uhi.
english: and Mikloth, who became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their families in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

paite: Ner in Kish asuang; Kish in Saul asuang; Saul in Jonathan, Malki-shua, Abinadab leh Eshbaal asuang hi.
english: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

paite: Jonathan tapa Merib-baal ahi a; Merib-baal in Mikah asuang hi.
english: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

paite: Mikah tapate: Pithon, Melek, Tarea leh Ahaz ahi uh.
english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

paite: Ahaz in Jehoaddah asuang; Jehoaddah in Alemeth, Azmaveth leh Zimri asuang; Zimri in Moza asuang;
english: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

paite: Moza in Binea asuang; Rapha atapa, Eleasah atapa, Azel atapa:
english: Moza became the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

paite: Azel in tapa guk anei a, amin uh hiaite ahi: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah leh Hanan. Hiaite tengteng Azel tapate ahi.
english: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

paite: Unaupa Eshek tapate: Ulam ata masa, Jehush a zom, Eliphelet athumna ahi.
english: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

paite: Ulam tapate mihat hangsan, thalkap mite ahi uh, tapate' tapate, tupate tampi, zakhat-le-sawmnga ahi uh. Hiaite tengteng Benjamin tapate ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and grandsons, one hundred fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.

paite: Huchi in Israel tengteng khangthu a sim in a-om ua; huan, ngai in, Israel leh Judah Kumpipate Laibu ah gelh in a-om uhi: atatlekna ziak un Babulon lam ah sal a pimang in a-om uh.
english: So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.

paite: Amau tante akhopite ua teng masapente bel, Israel, siampute, Levi mite leh Nethinim mite ahi uhi.
english: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.

paite: Jerusalem ah Judah tate, Benjamin tate, Ephraim leh Manasseh tate ateng uhi.
english: In Jerusalem, there lived of the children of Judah, of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:

paite: Ammihud tapa Uthai, Omri tapa, Imri tapa, Bani tapa, Perez tapate ah Judah tapa.
english: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.

paite: Shilon mite; Asaiah piang masapen leh atapate.
english: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

paite: Zerah tapate ah; Jeuel, a-unaute, zaguk-le-sawmkua ahi uh.
english: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.

paite: Benjamin tapate ah; Meshullam tapa Sallu, Hodaviah tapa, Hassenuah tapa;
english: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;

paite: Huan Jeroham tapa Ibneiah, Uzzi tapa Elah, Mikri tapa, Shephatiah tapa Meshallum, Reuel tapa, Ibnijah tapa.
english: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

paite: A-unaute uh, akhangte uh dungzui in, zakua sawmnga-le-guk ahi uh. Hiai mite tengteng apipute uh inkote dungzui a alupente ahi uhi.
english: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers’ households by their fathers’ houses.

paite: Huan siampute ah: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib; Jachin;
english: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,

paite: Hilkiah tapa Azariah, Meshullam tapa, Ahitub tapa, Pathian inn a vaihawmpa;
english: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house;

paite: Jeroham tapa Adaiah, Pashur tapa, Malkijah tapa, Maasai Adiel tapa, Jahzerah tapa, Meshullam tapa, Meshillemit tapa, Immer tapa;
english: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

paite: A-unaute uh, apipute uh lupente, sangkhat zasagih-le-sawmguk; Pathian inn a nasepna thilhihna ding a mihithei mahmahte ahi uh.
english: and their brothers, heads of their fathers’ houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty; they were very able men for the work of the service of God’s house.

paite: Huan Levi mite ah: Hashub tapa Shemaiah, Azrikam tapa, Hashabiah tapa, Merari tapate ah;
english: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

paite: Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, Mika tapa Mattaniah, Zikri tapa, Asaph tapa;
english: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,

paite: Shemaiah tapa Obadiah, Galal tapa, Jeduthun tapa, Asa tapa Berekiah, Elkanah tapa, Netophah mite khuate a tengte.
english: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

paite: Huan kongkhak ngak mite; Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, a-unaute uh, Shallum bel amakaipen ahi.
english: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),

paite: Kumpipa kongpi suahlam pang ngak sek: Levi tate puanin a dia kongkhak ngak mite ahi uhi.
english: who previously served in the king’s gate eastward. They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.

paite: Kore tapa Shallum, Ebiasaph tapa, Korah tapa, a-unaute, apa inkote a, Korah mite, nasepna thilhihna a heutu ahi ua, biakbuk kongpite ngak mite: apipute uh TOUPA puanin tung a heutu, biakbuk lutna ngak mite ahi uhi.
english: Shallum was the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over Yahweh’s camp, keepers of the entry.

paite: Eleazar tapa Phinehas hun paisa ah amaute tung a vaihawmpa ahi a, akiang ah TOUPA a-om hi.
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and Yahweh was with him.

paite: Meshelemiah tapa Zekariah kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ngakpa ahi.
english: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Hiaite tengteng kongpite kongkhak ngak mite hi ding a telte zanih sawm-le-nih ahi uh. Hiaite akhuate ua khangthu a simte ahi ua, asep ding uh bawlsa a David leh zawlnei Samuel in ahihkipsate ahi uhi.
english: All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve. These were listed by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.

paite: Huchi in amau leh atapate un TOUPA' inn kongpite, adandan in, biakbuk inn nangawn in akem uhi.
english: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of Yahweh’s house, even the house of the tent, as guards.

paite: Apang lite ah, suahlam, tumlam, mallam, simlam ah kongkhak ngak mite a-om uhi.
english: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.

paite: A-unaute uh, akallak lak in ni sagih nite teng in amau kiang a om ding in ahong pai zel ding uh ahi:
english: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them,

paite: Kongkhak ngakpipen lite lah, Levi mite, sep ding sehsa a om ahi ua, Pathian insung a dantante leh sumkoihnate tung ah heutu ahi uhi.
english: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.

paite: Huai lai a thupiak amau tung a a-om ziak in, Pathian inn kimvel ah agiak ua, zingsang teng in huai hon ding amau nasep ahi.
english: They stayed around God’s house, because that was their duty; and it was their duty to open it morning by morning.

paite: Huan alak ua kuate hiam in nasepna tui-um belsuante akem ua; alaklut uleh alakkhiak teng un aphazah asim gige uhi.
english: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service, for these were brought in by count, and these were taken out by count.

paite: Alak ua khenkhatte vante, mun siangthoupen tui-um belsuan tangbuang nelte, uainte, sathaute begaw leh gimnamtuite kem ding a seh ahi uhi.
english: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.

paite: Siampute tapate lak a akhente gimnamtuite toh hel in abawl uh.
english: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the spices.

paite: Mattithiah, Levi mite, Korah mi Shallum ta masapen lak a khat in belliangneite kan thilte tung a nasepna sehsa anei hi.
english: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.

paite: A-unaute uh lak a akhen, Sabbathte a bawl ding in, Kohath mite tapate'n tanghou akem uhi.
english: Some of their brothers, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath.

paite: Hiaite lasa mite ahi ua, Levi mite inkote pipute inkuan a lupente, dantante sung ah ateng ua, sun leh zan in anasepna ua zat in a-om ua, nasepna dangte a kipan a-awl uhi.
english: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service, for they were employed in their work day and night.

paite: Akhang pumpite uah, hiaite Levi mite pipute inkuan makaipente ahi uh, amakaipente: hiaite Jerusalem ah ateng uhi.
english: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men. They lived at Jerusalem.

paite: Huan Gibeon ah Gibeon pa ateng a, Jehiel, azi min Maakah:
english: Jeiel the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon.

paite: Atapa masapen Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab;
english: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

paite: Gedor, Ahio, Zekariah, Mikloth.
english: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.

paite: Huan Mikloth in Shimeam asuang a, huchi in amau leng a-unaute uh toh Jerusalem ah, a-unaute uh zawn ah ateng uhi.
english: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

paite: Ner in Kish asuang a; Kish in Saul asuang; Saul in Jonathan, Malki- shua, Abinadab leh Eshbaal asuang hi.
english: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

paite: Jonathan tapa bel Merib-baal ahi; Merib-baal in Mikah asuang hi.
english: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

paite: Huan Mikah tapate: Pithon, Melek, Tahrea leh Ahaz.
english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.

paite: Ahaz in Jarah asuang; Jara in Alameth, Azmaveth leh Zimri asuang hi; Zimri in Moza asuang hi.
english: Ahaz became the father of Jarah. Jarah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

paite: Moza in Binea asuang; Rephaiah atapa, Eleasah atapa, Azel atapa;
english: Moza became the father of Binea, Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

paite: Azel in tapa guk anei a, amin uh hiaite ahi: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah leh Hanan: hiaite Azel tapate ahi uh.
english: Azel had six sons, whose names are Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.

paite: Paul, Pathian deihlam a Jesu Khrist sawltak hi ding a sap leh i unaupa Sostheni in,
english: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,

paite: Korinth a Pathian saptuam omte, Khrist Jesu a sehtuam siangthoute, misiangthou hi ding a sapte leh gam chih a i Toupa, amau leh eite Toupa, Jesu Khrist min lou tengteng kiang ah;
english: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:

paite: Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Khrist Jesu a Pathian hehpihna noute kiang a hong kipiak ziak in na tungthu uah Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen gige a;
english: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus,

paite: bangkim ah thugen peuhmah ah leh theihna chiteng ah, amah ahihhauh in na om uhi.
english: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge—

paite: Huchi in Khrist thu ka theihsak pen noumau ah hihkip in a-om hi.
english: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you—

paite: Huan i Toupa Jesu Khrist kilakna ngak kawm in, khalam thilpiak himhim na tasam kei uhi.
english: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,

paite: Ama'n i Toupa Jesu Khrist ni chiang a gensiatbei a na omna ding un, atawp pha in hon hihkip behlap ding hi.
english: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: A Tapa Jesu Khrist i Toupa toh kithuahna nei ding a nou hon samlutpa, Pathian amuanhuai hi.
english: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

paite: Huan unaute aw, na vek un thu kibang na gen ua, na lak ua kikhenna himhim a-omlouhna ding in lungsim mun khat leh ngaihtuah mun khat a diktak a na kizop tinten zawkna ding un Toupa Jesu Khrist min in ka hon ngen ahi.
english: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

paite: Ka unaute aw, na tungtang thu uh, na lak uah kiselna a-om chih Kloi inkuanpihte'n hon hilh uhi.
english: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are contentions among you.

paite: Hiai ka chihna ahi, nou sung a khat-le-khat in, "Kei Paul pawl ka hi, kei Apollos pawl ka hi, kei Kifas pawl ka hi, kei zaw Khrist pawl ka hi," na chih uh.
english: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and, “I follow Christ.”

paite: Khrist khenzak in a-om a hia? Na sik un Paul kilhden in a-om a hia? Ahihkeileh Paul min in baptis in na om ua hia?
english: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?

paite: Khrispas leh Gaias lou ngal na lak uah mi kuamah ka hon baptis louh ziak in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen ahi.
english: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,

paite: Huchi hi keileh zaw mi'n keimah min a baptis na hi uh achi kha ding uhi.
english: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.

paite: Stephenas inkuanpihte bel ka baptis ngei a, tuate lou zaw midang ka baptis hia ka thei kei.
english: (I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don’t know whether I baptized any other.)

paite: Khrist in baptis ding in hon sawl kei a, tanchinhoih gen ding in ahon sawl zaw hi; thupil a gen lou in, huchi lou in zaw Khrist kros thilhihtheihna bangmah lou asuaksak kha ding uhi.
english: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News—not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn’t be made void.

paite: Kros thu zaw mangthang lelte a ding in haina ahi ngal a; ei hotdam lelte a ding in bel Pathian thilhihtheihna ahi zaw hi.
english: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

paite: "Mipil' pilna ka hihmang ding a, lemthei' lemtheihna leng ka paikhe ding," chih gelh ahi.
english: For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.”

paite: Mipil koi ah ahia? Laigelhmi koi ah ahia? Hiai khovel a selhatmi koi ah ahia? Pathian in khovel pilna haihuai ahi chih atheisak kei a hia?
english: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

paite: Pathian pilna ah bel, khovel in apilna zang a Pathian atheihtheih louh nung in thugen haihuai zang a agingtate hotdam akipah lam ahi.
english: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.

paite: Judate'n chiamtehnate aphut ua, Grikte'n pilna'n azong uh.
english: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,

paite: Eite'n bel Khrist kilhden thu i gen ua; huai tuh Judate a ding in pukna, Zentelte a ding in haina ahi.
english: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Greeks,

paite: Himahleh Judate leng hi hen aw, Grikte leng hi heh, sapte a ding in zaw Khrist, Pathian thilhihtheihna leh Pathian pilna pen ahi.
english: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;

paite: Pathian haina mihing sang in apilzaw a, Pathian hatlouhna leng mihing sang in ahatzaw hi.
english: because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

paite: Unaute aw, ahon sapna ngaihtuah dih ua, salam a mipil tampite, mihat tampite, mihoih pipite, sap ahihlouhdan uh;
english: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;

paite: himahleh Pathian in mipilte azahlaksak theihna ding in khovel thil haite atel a; huan Pathian in khovel thil hatloute atel a, ahatte azahlaksak theihna ding in;
english: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world that he might put to shame the things that are strong.

paite: khovel thil niam leh simmohhuaite, thil omloute tan in Pathian in atel a; thil omte bangmah lou a abawltheihna ding in.
english: God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that don’t exist, that he might bring to nothing the things that exist,

paite: Huchi in Pathian ma ah mi kuamah aki-uangsak thei kei ding uh.
english: that no flesh should boast before God.

paite: Amah ziak in noute Khrist Jesu ah na om uhi; Pathian in Khrist i pilna, i diktatna, i sianthouna leh i tatna hi ding in abawlta hi,
english: Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption,

paite: hichi a gelh ahih bang in, "Asuang peuhmah in Toupa suang hen."
english: that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”

paite: Unaute aw, hiaite na theih louh uh ka deih kei, huchi a i pipute tengteng meipi nuai a a-om vek ua, avek ua tuipi leng akan ua,
english: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

paite: avek ua meipi leh tuipi a Mosi a baptis lut a a-om vek ua,
english: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

paite: avek ua khalam an kibang anek chiat ua,
english: and all ate the same spiritual food;

paite: avek ua khalam dawn ding kibang adawn chiatdan uh. Amaute zui, khalam Suangpi a pan adawn chiat ngal ua; huai Suangpi Khrist ahi.
english: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.

paite: Himahleh alak ua mi tamzaw tung ah Pathian alunghita kei a; gamdai ah apuklum uhi.
english: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

paite: Huan huai thilte ei ding a etton ding ahi, thil gilou alunggulh bang ua i lunggulh samlouhna ding in.
english: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.

paite: Alak ua khenkhat milim bemi ahih bang un milim bemi hi kei un, "Mipite ne ding leh dawn ding in atu ua, lam ding in adingh nawn chiat uh," chih gelh bang in.
english: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”

paite: Alak ua khenkhat in nungak angai ua, ni khat in singnih-le-sangthum in apuklup loh bang un, i kingai kei ding uh.
english: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

paite: Alak ua khenkhat in Toupa aze-et ua, gul a hihman a a-om bang un, Toupa zaw i ze-et kei ding uh.
english: Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.

paite: Alak ua khenkhat aphun ua, hihmangthangpa hihmanthat a a-om bang un, phun sam kei ni.
english: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.

paite: Huan huaite vaukholhna ding in atung uah ahong tung hi; eite, hun tawp hong tunnate, hon thuhilhna ding a leng gelh ahi uhi.
english: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.

paite: Huaiziak in dingh a kingaihtuah pilvang hen, huchi lou in zaw apuk kha ding hi.
english: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.

paite: Mihing thuak theih val khemna himhim na tuang uah atung ngei kei hi. Pathian zaw amuanhuai hi, ama'n na thuak theih val uh khemna na tuah uh aphal kei ding; na thuaktheihna ding un khemna peuh ah taikhiakna lampi abawl zaw ding hi.
english: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

paite: Huaiziak in ka deihtakte aw, milim biak taisan un.
english: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

paite: Mipilte kiang a gen bang in ka thugente ngaihtuah un.
english: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.

paite: Vualzawlna nou a ka hon vualzawl uh, Khrist sisan kikoppihna ahi kei a hia? Tanghou ka balkhap uh Khrist pumpi kikoppihna ahi kei a hia?
english: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?

paite: Eite mi tampi tanghou beu khat, pum khat i hi uh; i vek un tanghou beu khat ah i tang chiat uhi.
english: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.

paite: Salam a Israelte en dih ua; kithoihna sa nete'n maitam thilte akikoppih kei ua hia?
english: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?

paite: Bang ka genna ahia le? Milim lak a kithoihna leh milim leng banghiamtak ahi chih ka genna hia?
english: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?

paite: Zentelte kithoihna, Pathian lak ah hilou in dawite lak ah akithoih uh ahi chih ka gen zaw ahi; noute zaw dawite toh na kithuah uh hon deih lou ka hi.
english: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God, and I don’t desire that you would have fellowship with demons.

paite: Toupa nou leh dawi nou na dawnkhawm thei kei ding uh; Toupa dohkan leh dawi dohkan ah na nekhawm thei sam kei ding uh.
english: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.

paite: Ahihkeileh Toupa hazatna tohthoh i tum uh ahi maw? Amah sang in i hatzaw ua hia?
english: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

paite: "Thil bangkim hih asiang a," himahleh thil bangkim hih ahoih kei, "Thil bangkim hih asiang a," himahleh thil bangkim hih in mi abawlhoih kei hi.
english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up.

paite: Kuapeuh in amah hoihna ding zong lou in midang hoihna ding zong zaw hen.
english: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.

paite: Sa dawr a azuak peuhmah uh na sia-le-pha theihna ziak un bangmah dong lou in ne un.
english: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,

paite: "Lei leh asung a tengteng Toupa a ahi ngal a."
english: for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.”

paite: Gingloumi lak a kuahiam in nou hon sap a, hoh na ut ngal un, sia-le-pha theihna ziak in bangmah dong lou in, ahon lui peuh uh ne un.
english: But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.

paite: Himahleh kuahiam in, "Hiai zaw kithoihna ahi chi a ahon hilh leh sia-le-pha theihna ziak leh nou a hon hilhpa ziak in ne kei un,"
english: But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For “the earth is the Lord’s, with all its fullness.”

paite: Nangmah sia-le-pha theihna ka chi kei a, ama sia-le-pha theihna pen ahi ka chih zawk. Bang achia midang sia-le-pha theihna in ka noplenna thunun ahia?
english: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?

paite: Kipaktak a ka tanleh atung a kipahthu ka genna tung ah bang ding a gensiat a om ka hia?
english: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for something I give thanks for?

paite: Huchi in na nek uhiam na dawn uhiam, na hih peuhmah uh, Pathian thupina ding ngen in hih un.
english: Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

paite: Judate a ding hiam, Grikte a ding hiam, Pathian saptuamte a ding hiam in apukna ding uh bangmah hih kei un.
english: Give no occasion for stumbling, whether to Jews, to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;

paite: Ke'n keimah phattuamna zong lou a, hotdam ahihtheihna ding ua mi tampi phattuamna zong a, mi tengteng bangkim a ka kipahsak bang in.
english: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.

paite: Hon enzuite hi un, kei leng Khrist enzuipa ka hih mah bang in.
english: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.

paite: Huan bangkim a na hon theihgige ziak un leh thukhah ka hon hilh bang a na vom tinten ziak un ka hon phat ahi.
english: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.

paite: Himahleh pasal peuhmah lutang Khrist ahi, numei lutang pasal ahi, Khrist lutang Pathian ahi chih na theih uh ka deih hi.
english: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.

paite: Pasal alu khuh kawm a thum hiam, thu gen hiam peuhmah in, alu aselphou hi.
english: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.

paite: Himahleh numei alu khuh lou a thum hiam, thu gen hiam peuhmah in alu selphou ahi; metmai toh kibang ahi.
english: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.

paite: Numei alu khuh lou a a-om ngalleh met vanglak hen. Himahleh, numei a ding a sam met leh metmai azumhuaileh alu khuh hen.
english: For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.

paite: Pasal zaw Pathian batpih leh thupina ahih ziak in alu akhuh ding hilou himhim ahi; numei bel pasal thupina ahi.
english: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.

paite: Numei a kipan pasal pawt ahi kei a; numei bel pasal a kipan a pawt ahi zaw hi;
english: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;

paite: numei a dia pasal siam ahi kei a; numei bel pasal a dia siam ahi zaw hi.
english: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.

paite: Huaiziak in angelte ziak in numei in pasal thuneihna chiamtehna akhuk ding ahi.
english: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.

paite: Himahleh Toupa thilgeldan ah, pasal lou in numei a-om thei kei a, pasal leng numei lou in a-om thei sam kei hi.
english: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.

paite: Pasal a kipan a numei pawt ahih bang in, pasal leng numei lak a piang ahi ngal a; himahleh bangkim Pathian a kipan a pawt vek ahi.
english: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.

paite: Noumau kingaihtuah dih ua, numei in alu khuh lou a Pathian kiang a thum akilawm hiam?
english: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?

paite: Pasal in samsau aneihleh amah a ding in azumhuai ahi chih na lungtang pianpih un leng ahon theisak kei a hia?
english: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?

paite: Numei in bel samsau aneihleh amah a ding in thupina ahi zaw; kikhuhna ding a asam piak ahih ziak in.
english: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.

paite: Himahleh mi kuahiam hiai thu a agenhakleh huchibang paidan himhim i nei kei ua, Pathian saptuam pawlte'n leng anei sam kei uhi.
english: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.

paite: Himahleh nou hiai thu ka hon hilhna ah ka hon phat thei kei, na hoihsemna ding uh hilou in, na siatsemna ding ua na kikhop nak ziak un.
english: But in giving you this command I don’t praise you, because you come together not for the better but for the worse.

paite: Amasapen in saptuamte na kikhop un, na lak uah kilangkhenna a-om chih ka za a; gin leng ka gingta sim hi.
english: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.

paite: Na lak ua ataktakte alattheihna ding un, na lak ua gintuamna leng a-om sam ding him ahi.
english: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.

paite: Na hong kikhop ua na nekkhawm uh Toupa nitak an ahi kei hi;
english: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.
