paite: Michih in na nek chiang un noumau nitak an na ne masa zel ngal ua; huchi in mi khat gil akial a, adang in akham hi.
english: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.

paite: Bangchidan ahia? Nek leh dawnna ding inn na nei kei ua hia? Ahihkeileh Pathian saptuamte musit in, bangmah neiloute na selphou ua hia? Na kiang uah bang ka genta dia? K'on phat dia hia? Hiai lam thu ah ka hon phat thei kei hi.
english: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.

paite: Ka thu hon hilhsawn Toupa kiang a kipan ka muh ahi, huchi a Toupa Jesu'n matsak a a-om zan a, tanghou alak a,
english: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.

paite: kipahthu agen khit a abalkhap a, "Hiai ka pumpi nou a dia piak ahi, keimah theihgigena in hiai hih zel un,” achih.
english: When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.”

paite: Huchi mah bang a nitak an anek khit a nou leng alak a, "Hiai nou ka sisan a thukhun thak ahi, na dawn teng un keimah theihgigena in hih zel un," achih.
english: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”

paite: Huai tanghou na nek ua, nou na dawn teng un ahong pai nawn masiah, Toupa sihna na puangzak uhi.
english: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.

paite: Huaiziak in kuapeuh kilawmloutak a tanghou ne hiam, Toupa nou dawn hiam in Toupa pumpi leh sisan tung ah siam louh atang ding hi.
english: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.

paite: Huchi in michih amah ki-enchian zaw hen, huchibang in tanghou ne in nou dawn hen.
english: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.

paite: Ane leh dawn in Toupa pumpi ngenteltak a angaihtuah keileh amah tung a vaihawmna ding in ane in adawn hi.
english: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.

paite: Hiai ziak in na lak ua mi tampi na hat kei ua, na zawngkhal ua, tampi'n na sihloh uhi.
english: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.

paite: Himahleh ngenteltak in eimah kingaihtuah zel lehang, vai hawmsak a om nak lou ding i hi uhi.
english: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.

paite: Himahleh vai hawmsak a i om in leng khovel toh siam louh tang a i omlouhna ding in Toupa taihilh in i om zel ahi.
english: But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.

paite: Huaiziak in ka unaute aw, ne ding a na kikhop un kingak chiat un.
english: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

paite: Na kikhop uh vaihawmna na thuakpihlouhna ding un, kuapeuh in agil akialleh a-inn lam ah ne masa hen. Huan thudang zaw ka hong pai chiang in ka bawllem ding hi.
english: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.

paite: Tu in unaute aw, khalam thilpiak thute na theih louh uh ka ut kei hi.
english: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.

paite: Zentelte na hih lai un bangchidan peuh a hon pi lai un leng, huai milim pau theiloute lam ah pimang in na om uh chih na thei uhi.
english: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.

paite: Huaiziak in kuamah in, Pathian Kha a thu gen in, "Jesu hamsiat in om hen," achi ngei kei. Huan kuamah in, Kha Siangthou kia lou ngal in, "Jesu, Toupa ahi," achi ngei kei uh chih ka hon theisak hi.
english: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.

paite: Huan thilpiak tuamtuam a-om a, Kha bel kikhat ahi.
english: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.

paite: Nasepna tuamtuam leng a-om, himahleh Toupa khat ahi.
english: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.

paite: Nasepsakna tuamtuam leng a-om, himahleh Pathian khat ahi, mi tengteng a bangkim sempa ahi.
english: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.

paite: Himahleh Kha theihsakna michih kiphattuampih chiatna ding in piak ahi.
english: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.

paite: Mi khat kiang ah Kha in pilna thu apia hi; midang kiang ah, huai Kha mah in theihna thu apia hi.
english: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,

paite: Huan midang kiang a, huai Kha mah in, ginna apia a; midang kiang ah hihdamtheihna apia;
english: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,

paite: midang kiang ah thillamdang hihtheihna, midang kiang ah thugenkholh theihna, midang kiang ah khate theihkak theihna, midang kiang ah pau tuamtuamte, midang kiang ah pautuamte hilhchetna.
english: and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of languages, and to another the interpretation of languages.

paite: Himahleh hiaite tengteng Kha khat leh akikhat mah in, michih kiang ah adeih bang zel a hawm in asem hi.
english: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.

paite: Pumpi i chih khat ahi a, hiang anei a, pumpi hiangte tengteng, tam mah le uh, pumpi khat ahi a; Khrist leng huchibang mah ahi.
english: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.

paite: I vek un pumpi khat a om ding in Kha khat a baptis in i omta ua, Judate hiam, Grikte hiam, sikhate hiam sikha lou hiam; huan i vek un Kha khat a kipan dawnsak in i omta uhi.
english: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.

paite: Pumpi i chih hiang khat kia hilou in tampi ahi zaw hi.
english: For the body is not one member, but many.

paite: Khepek in, "Khut ka hih louh ziak in pumpi a pang ka hi kei," chileh, huai thu ziak in pumpi a pang lou ahi tuan kei hi.
english: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.

paite: Huan bil in, "Mit ka hih louh ziak in pumpi a pang ka hi kei," chileh, huai thu ziak in pumpi a pang lou ahi tuan kei hi.
english: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.

paite: Pumpi tengteng mit hi vek taleh gingzakna koi ah a-om dia? Avek in gingzakna hitaleh, gimzakna koi ah a-om dia?
english: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

paite: Himahleh Pathian in hiang khempeuh pumpi ah a-utna peuh ah a-omsak chiatta hi.
english: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

paite: Huchi in huai tengteng hiang khat kia hileh pumpi pen koi ah a-om dia?
english: If they were all one member, where would the body be?

paite: Himahleh hiang tampi ahi zaw uh, himahleh pumpi khat kia ahi.
english: But now they are many members, but one body.

paite: Huan mit in, khut kiang ah, "Bangmah in ka hon deih kei," achi thei kei; lu in leng khepekte kiang ah, "Bangmah in ka hon deih kei," achi thei sam kei hi.
english: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”

paite: Huchih nak sang in, pumpi hiang hat dia kilawm lou pente akiphamohzaw mahmah uhi.
english: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

paite: Huchi in pumpi hiang pahtawi tham louh zaw a i sehte, huaite ngei i pahtawi zaw uhi; huan i hiang kilawmloute'n kilawmna thupizaw amu zel uhi.
english: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,

paite: I hiang kilawmte'n bel huchibang a hih akiphamoh kei uhi. Pathian in, kilawmna nei lou hiang pahtawi zawk ding in, pumpi alemkhawm hi.
english: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,

paite: Huchi a pumpi a kikhenna om lou a, ahiangte'n kibangtak a akibuaipihtuah theih zawkna ding un.
english: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.

paite: Huchi in hiang khat in athuakleh hiang tengteng in athuakpih a, hiang khat pahtawi a a-omleh hiang dangte'n akipahpih zel uhi.
english: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

paite: Huchi in noute Khrist pumpi na hi ua, ahiangte na hi chiat lai uhi.
english: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.

paite: Huan Pathian in khenkhat saptuam lak ah ahon koih a, akhatna ah sawltakte, anihna ah thugenkholte, athumna ah sinsaktute akoih a; huai nung in thillamdang hihte a-om a; huai nung in hihdamtheihna thilpiakte, panpih theihna thilpiakte, vaihawm siamna thilpiakte, pau tuamtuam a thugentheihna thilpiakte a-om nawn hi.
english: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.

paite: Avek un sawltak ahi uhia? Avek un thugenkholmi ahi uhia? Avek un sinsaktu ahi uhia?
english: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?

paite: Avek un thillamdang hihmi ahi uhia? Avek un hihdamtheihna thilpiakte ahi uhia? Avek un pautuamte in thu agen uhia? Avek un thu hilhchianmi ahi uhia?
english: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?

paite: Thilpiak thupipente lunggulh mahmah zaw un. Huan lampi hoihsem ka hon ensak ding hi.
english: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.

paite: Mihing pautuamte leh angel pautuamte in thu gen mah leng, itna ka neih keileh dak ging lel hiam, dakkhutbet ging lel hiam ka hi ding hi.
english: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.

paite: Huan thugenkholh theihna nei in, thuguk tengteng leh theihna tengteng thei vek in, mual suantheihna khop hial ginna kim nei mah leng, itna ka neih keileh bangmah ka hi kei hi.
english: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.

paite: Huan migentheite vakna ding in ka sum tengteng pe vek in, ka pumpi leng kang ding hial in kipe mah leng, itna ka neih keileh kei a ding in bangmah aphatuam kei hi.
english: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.

paite: Itna in adohzou a, amigi a; itna in ahaza kei a, akisathei sam kei;
english: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

paite: itna aki-uangsak kei a, ahuham sam kei. Amah thu achi tentun kei a, ahehbaih kei, hehsa in a-omden sam kei;
english: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

paite: itna in gilou akipahpih kei a, adik akipahpih zaw hi.
english: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

paite: Itna in bangkim athuak teitei a, bangkim agingta a, bangkim alamen a, bangkim athuakkhe zel hi.
english: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

paite: Itna zaw chikchiang mah in abei kei ding; himahleh, thugenkholhnate om mahleh hihtawp ahong hi ding a, pautuamte om mahleh ahong tawp ding a, theihnate om mahleh hihtawp ahong hi ding.
english: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

paite: Akim lou in i thei ua, akim lou in thu i gen uhi.
english: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;

paite: Akim ahong tun chiang in akim lou hihtawp ahita ding.
english: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.

paite: Ka naupan lai in naupang pau in ka pau a, naupang theih in ka thei a, naupang ngaihtuah in ka ngaihtuah hi; tua ka hong pichin nung in naupang hihdan ka tawpsanta hi.
english: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

paite: Tu in zaw limlang ah i mu milmial ahi, huai hun chiang in zaw kimaituah in ahita ding hi. Tu in zaw akim lou in ka thei a, himahleh huai hun chiang in zaw theih khit a ka om bang in ka theikimta ding hi.
english: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

paite: Huchi in hiai thumte: ginna, lametna, itna, a-om gige ding ahi; himahleh hiaite a athupipen itna ahi.
english: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

paite: Itna delh zel unla, khalam thilpiakte leng lunggulh gige un, himahleh thu na gentheihna ding uh lunggulh sem un.
english: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

paite: Pautuamte a pau in mi kiang a thugen hilou in Pathian kiang a gen ahi zaw hi, kuamah in athugen athei kei a; himahleh kha ah thuguk agen ahi.
english: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God, for no one understands, but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.

paite: Thugenmi in bel mihing kiang ah bawlhoihna thute, hanthawnna thute, khamuanna thute agen zaw zel hi.
english: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.

paite: Pautuamte a pau in amah kia akibawlhoih a, thugenmi'n saptuamte abawlhoih zaw hi.
english: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.

paite: Huan na vek un pautuamte a na pau uh ka hon deihsak a, himahleh thu na gen uh ka hon deihsak sem hi; saptuamte'n kibawlhoihna amuhtheihna ding un ahilhchet nawn keileh thugenmi zaw pautuamte a pau mi sang in athupizaw hi.
english: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but even more that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.

paite: Tu in unaute aw, na lak uah kilakna hiam, theihna hiam, thugen hiam, sinsakna hiam toh hong lou a, pautuamte a thu gen in hong pai leng, nou a ding in bang ka phatuam dia?
english: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?

paite: Thil hinna nei lou, gingtheite leng, tamngai hiam, kaihging hiam, gen nei a agin keileh, bang la ahia atum ua akaih uh bangchi in atheihtheih dia?
english: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?

paite: Gen nei lou a pengkul amut un kua galkap ding in akisa dia?
english: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?

paite: Huchi mah bang in nou leng pau theih baihlam a na gen kei uleh bang thu ahia na gen uh bangchi in atheihtheih dia? Huihkhua a pau lel na hi kei ding ua hia?
english: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.

paite: Khovel ah pau chi tuamtuam tampi a-om tham a, himahleh gen nei lou himhim a-om kei hi.
english: There are, it may be, so many kinds of languages in the world, and none of them is without meaning.

paite: Apau in bang gen ahia chih ka theih keileh a genmi a ding in kei melmak ka hi ding a; a genmi leng kei a ding in melmak ahi ding.
english: If then I don’t know the meaning of the language, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.

paite: Huchi in noute'n khalam thilpiakte na lunggulh mah bang un saptuam bawlhoihna ding in theihtawp suah in zang un.
english: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.

paite: Huaiziak in pautuamte a thu gen in ahilhchet theihna ding in thum hen.
english: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.

paite: Pautuamte a ka thumleh ka kha in zaw athum ngei a, ka theihna bel aphatuam tuan kei hi.
english: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.

paite: Bangchi in ahita dia le? Kha in ka thum dia, theihna in leng ka thum ding; kha in la ka sa dia, theihna in leng la ka sa ding hi.
english: What should I do? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

paite: Hichi lou in, Kha in vualzawl mah lechin athei nailoute'n na thugen theiloupi in na kipahthugen uh bangchi in Amen, achi thei ding ua?
english: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?

paite: Nang zaw chihtak in kipahthu na gen hoih a, midang abawlhoih tuan kei hi.
english: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.

paite: Noumau tengteng sang in pautuamte a thu ka gen tam zawk ziak in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen hi;
english: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.

paite: Himahleh saptuamte kikhopna ah pautuamte a thu singkhat gen sang in midangte ka hilhtheihna ding in ka theihtheihna in thumal nga kia gen ka utzaw ahi.
english: However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.

paite: Unaute aw, ngaihtuahna ah naupang kei un; himahleh gilou ah zaw naungek unla, lungsim ah piching un.
english: Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.

paite: Dan laibu ah: "Pautuamte leh gamdang mite muk in, hiai mite kiang ah thu ka gen ding a; huchi in leng ahon ngaikhe tuan kei ding uh, Toupa'n achi," chih gelh ahi.
english: In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. They won’t even listen to me that way, says the Lord.”

paite: Huaiziak in pautuamte zaw gingtate a ding in chiamtehna ahi kei a, gingloute a ding in ahi zaw, thugen bel gingloute a ding in chiamtehna ahi kei a, gingtate a ding in ahi zaw hi.
english: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.

paite: Huaiziak in saptuam tengteng kikhawm a na vek ua pautuamte a na pau uleh thei nailoute leh gingloute hong lut leh ahai uh hon chi kei ding ua hiam?
english: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won’t they say that you are crazy?

paite: Na vek ua thu na gen uleh ging lou hiam, thei nai lou hiam hong lutleh asiamlouhdan uh na vek ua ma ah hihlat ahi ding;
english: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.

paite: huchi in alungtang thugukte uh hihlat in a-omta ding a, lei si in Pathian abe ding ua, "Pathian na lak uah a-om taktak," chih agen ding uhi.
english: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.

paite: Unaute aw, bangchi ding ahita dia le? Na hong kikhop un, phatna la hiam, thu kihilh hiam, theihsakna thu hiam, pautuamte, hilhchetna hiam na nei chiat zel ua. Bangkim bawlhoihna ding in hih hi hen.
english: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.

paite: Kuapeuh in pautuamte a thu agen uleh, nih in hiam, atampen in thum in hiam hileh, kikhel zel in leng hi hen.
english: If any man speaks in another language, let there be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.

paite: Huan mi khat in hilhchian hen; hilhchianmi a-om keileh saptuamte kikhopna ah dai in om henla, amah leh Pathian kiang ah gen hen.
english: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.

paite: Thugenmi in leng nih in hiam, thum in hiam, gen uhenla, midangte'n hoihtak in ngaihtuah uhen.
english: Let two or three of the prophets speak, and let the others discern.

paite: Himahleh akiang a tu midang kiang a theihsakna thupiak ahong tunleh amasa pen dai mai hen.
english: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.

paite: Mi tengteng in atheihtheihna ding leh mi tengteng khamuang a a-omtheihna ding un, na vek un khatkhat in thu na gen thei ngal ua.
english: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn and all may be exhorted.

paite: Thugen mite, khate thugen mite thuthu in a-om uh ahi.
english: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,

paite: Pathian zaw buaina Pathian ahi kei a, lemna Pathian ahi zaw hi. Mi Siangthou saptuam pawl tengteng a-om bang in,
english: for God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.

paite: Saptuamte kikhopna ah numeite dai dinden in om uhen; amau zaw athugen uh phal ahi kei a; Dan gen bang in thumang in om zaw uhen.
english: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says,

paite: Huan bangpeuh atheihnop uleh inn ah amau pasalte dong uhen; saptuamte kikhopna a numei thugen zaw azumhuai hi.
english: if they desire to learn anything. “Let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly.”

paite: Pathian thu noumau a pan pawt ahi maw? Ahihkeileh noumau kiang kia ahong tung ahi maw?
english: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?

paite: Kuapeuh thugenmi hiam khami hiam akisakleh na kiang ua ka gelh Toupa thupiak ahi chih atheih ding ahi.
english: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.

paite: Himahleh kuapeuh in atheih keileh amah leng theih ahi kei hi.
english: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.

paite: Huaiziak in unaute aw, thugen lunggulh unla, pautuamte a thugen leng kham kei un;
english: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.

paite: Himahleh bangkim kilawm leh diktak a hih hi hen.
english: Let all things be done decently and in order.

paite: Huai ban ah unaute aw, tanchinhoih ka hon hilh zaw ka hon theisak nawn ding a; huai tanchinhoih na kipahpih ua, huai mah ah na dingh ua;
english: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,

paite: k'on thuhilh pen na mawk gintak uh hilou a, pomkip na hih uleh, huai mah ah hotdam in na om uhi.
english: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.

paite: Amasapen in ke'n ka muh sam nou ka hon hilhsawn a; huchi a, Laisiangthou bangbang a i khelhnate ziak a Khrist asih a,
english: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

paite: vui a a-om a, laisiangthou bangbang a ani thum ni a kaihthoh a a-omdan,
english: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

paite: huchi a Kifas kiang a akilak a, huai khit a sawm-le-nihte kiang a akilak thute,
english: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

paite: huai khit in unau zanga sang a tamzawte kiang ah khatvei thu in akilak nawn a, huaite lak a mi, atamzaw tutan in adam lai ua, khenkhat bel a-ihmuta uhi.
english: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.

paite: Huai khit in Jakob leh sawltak tengteng kiang ah akilak nawn hi.
english: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

paite: Huan atawp pen ah, ahun lou bang a piang, keimah kiang ah leng akilak hi.
english: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

paite: Kei zaw sawltak lak a neupen, Pathian saptuamte ka sawi ziak a sawltak chih tuak louh ka hi.
english: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.

paite: Himahleh Pathian hehpihna ziak in ka hihhih ka hita; huan ahehpihna hon piak athawn in a-om kei a, huchih nak sang in amau tengteng sang in ka semgimzaw hi; himahleh keimah kia in ka sem kei a, Pathian hehpihna ka kiang a om in asem zaw hi.
english: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

paite: Himahleh, ke'n leng, amau leng huchi in ka gen zel ua, huchi in nou leng na gingta uhi.
english: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

paite: Huan Khrist misi lak a kipan kaihthoh in a-om chih ahon hilh ngal uleh, bangchidan ahia na lak ua khenkhat in, misi thohnawnna himhim a-om kei na chih uh?
english: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

paite: Misi thohnawnna himhim om lou ahihleh, Khrist leng kaihthoh in a-om kei ding hi.
english: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

paite: Huan Khrist kaihthoh a a-om keileh, i thugen uh bangmah lou ahi ding a, na gin uh leng bangmah lou ahi ding hi.
english: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.

paite: Ahi, Khrist akaithou chih Pathian i theihpih ziak in, Pathian lam thu ah theihpih zuauthei i hong hi ding hi, misite kaihthoh a a-om kei uleh, amah leng akaithou kei ding hi.
english: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.

paite: Misite kaihthoh a a-om kei un zaw, Khrist leng kaihthoh in a-omta kei ding.
english: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.

paite: Huan Khrist kaihthoh a a-om keileh, na gin uh bangmah lou ahi ding a, na khelhna uah na om nilouh uh ahi ding.
english: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.

paite: Huchi hileh, Khrist a ihmusate mangthangta uh ahi ding hi.
english: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

paite: Tu damsung kia a Khrist tung a lametna i neih in zaw mi tengteng lak a mi hehpihhuaipen i hi ding hi.
english: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.

paite: Himahleh Khrist misi lak a kipan kaihthoh in a-om taktak ahi, ihmute lak a kipan gah masa ana hita hi.
english: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.

paite: Mi khat ziak a sihna ahong om ziak in mi khat ziak mah in misi thohnawnna leng ahong omta ahi.
english: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.

paite: Adam ah mi tengteng asi mah bang un, Khrist ah mi tengteng hihhin in leng a-om ding uhi.
english: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

paite: Himahleh amau hun chiat ah; Khrist gah masapente ahi a; huai khit chiang in ahong pai nawn na ah Khrist ate athou ding uhi.
english: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s at his coming.

paite: Huai khit chiang in atawp ahong tung ding; huai hun chiang in, vaihawmna tengteng, thuneihna leh thilhihtheihna tengteng ahihman nung in, Pathian kiang ah, Pa kiang ngei ah gam ape ding hi.
english: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God the Father, when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.

paite: Amelmate tengteng akhenuai a akoih masiah ama'n vai hawm ding ahi ngal a.
english: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

paite: Melma nanungpen hihmang a om ding sihna ahi.
english: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.

paite: Ama'n, "Akhenuai ah bangkim akoih hi." Himahleh, "Akhenuai ah bangkim koih in a-om," achih in anuai a bangkim koihpa apang kha kei chih akimu gige ahi.
english: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.

paite: Huan anuai a bangkim koih a a-om hun chiang in, Tapa mahmah leng anuai ah koih in a-om ding; Pathian bangkim a bangkim ahihtheihna ding in.
english: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.

paite: Huchi ahih kei in, misite a ding a baptisma atansak uh bang achihna uh hi ding ahia? Misite kaihthoh a om lou ding ahih uleh bang achia amaute a dia baptisma tansak uh ahia?
english: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?

paite: Bangziak a eite dakkal chih a sih lauhuai a om i hi ua?
english: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?

paite: Unaute aw, Khrist Jesu i Toupa a ka hon suanna sial in niteng in ka si, ka chi ahi.
english: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

paite: Mihing dan in gen leng Ephesa a gamsate kilaipih ka hihleh, kei a ding in bang aphatuam dia? "Misi, kaihthoh a a-om kei ding uleh ne in dawn leng ake, zingchiang a si ding hi ve hang in."
english: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”

paite: Khem in om kei un, "Lawm giloute'n omdan hoih ahihgawp nak uhi."
english: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”

paite: Kizentak in halh unla, thil hihkhial kei un; khenkhat in Pathian theihna himhim na nei kei ua. Hiai tuh na zumna ding ua ka gen ahi.
english: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.

paite: Himahleh kuahiam khat in, "Misi bangchi in kaihthoh ahi ding uh? Pumpi bangchibang pu in ahia ahong thoh ding?" chi ahi ding e.
english: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”

paite: Nang, mihai, nang mahmah in na tuh leng, asih phot keileh hihhin in a-om sam a;
english: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.

paite: huan chi na tuh in apumpi hong om ding pen ahi kei a, atang lel na tuh zaw nak, buhtang hiam, chi dang tang hiam ahi thei hi.
english: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.

paite: Himahleh Pathian in ama deih bangbang in pumpi apia a, haichitang chih kiang ah amau pumpi chiat apia hi.
english: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.

paite: Sa tengteng sa chi khat ahi kei ua; mihing sa atuam a, gamsa sa atuam; vasa sa atuam a, ngasa sa atuam hi.
english: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.

paite: Van pumpi a-om a, leitung pumpi leng a-om, himahleh van lam pumpite thupina atuam a, lei lam pumpite thupina atuam hi.
english: There are also celestial bodies and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.

paite: Nisa thupina atuam a, khapi thupina atuam a, aksite thupina atuam; aksi leh aksi leng athupina uh atuam ziak in.
english: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.

paite: Misite thohnawnna leng tua bang ahi. Muat thei a tuh in a-om a, muat thei lou a kaihthoh in a-om hi.
english: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.

paite: Pahtawi louh a tuh in a-om a, thupitak a kaihthoh in a-om hi. Hat lou a tuh in a-om a, thilhihtheihna nei a kaihthoh in a-om hi.
english: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

paite: Pianken pumpi a tuh in a-om a, khalam pumpi a kaihthoh in a-om hi. Pianken pumpi a-omleh khalam pumpi leng a-om hi.
english: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.

paite: Huchi in mi masapen, "Adam mihing ahong hi a," chi a gelh ahi; Adam nanung pen bel hinna pepa kha ahong hita hi.
english: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

paite: Himahleh khalam a-om masa kei a, salam a-om zaw; huai zoh in khalam pen a-om hi.
english: However, that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.

paite: Mihing masa pen lei a siam, leimi ahi a; mihing nihna pen van a pan ahi.
english: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.

paite: Lei a siam mihing leimi ahih bang in, van a kipan mi tuh vanmi ahi.
english: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

paite: Huan lei a siam mihing batna i put bang in, van a kipan hong paipa batna leng i pu sam ding uhi.
english: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.

paite: Unaute aw, sa leh sisan in Pathian lalgam aluah thei kei ding a; muat thei in muat theihlouhna aluah sam kei ding chih, ka gen ahi.
english: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can’t inherit God’s Kingdom; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable.

paite: Ngai un, thuguk ka hon hilh ding hi! I vek un i ihmu khol kei ding ua, himahleh i vek un pengkul nanungpen agin chiang in, sawt lou kal in,
english: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,

paite: Mitphiat kal lou in hihlamdan in i om vekta ding; pengkul ging ding ahi ngal a, huchi in misite muat thei lou in kaihthoh in a-om ding ua, eite leng hihlamdan in i omta ding uhi.
english: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

paite: Hiai muat thei in muat theihlouhna asilh ding ahi a, hiai sithei in leng sih theihlouhna asilh sam ding ahi.
english: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.

paite: Huchi a hiai muat thei in muat theihlouhna asilh a, hiai sithei in sih theihlouhna asilh hun chiang in, huai hun ngeingei in, "Zohna in sihna avalh zouta," chih thugelh ahong tung ding hi.
english: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”

paite: "Aw sihna, na gu koi a-omta ahia? Aw han, na zohna koi a-omta ahia?"
english: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”

paite: Sihna gu khelhna ahi a; khelhna thilhihtheihna dan ahi.
english: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

paite: Himahleh i Toupa Jesu Khrist ziak a zohna hon pepa Pathian kiang ah kipahthu om hen.
english: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Huaiziak in ka unau deihtakte aw, kiptak in, hihlin vual louh in, Toupa nasep phatuamngaitak a sem gige in om un, na sepgimna uh Toupa ah athawn ngei kei chih na thei uhi.
english: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

paite: Huan misiangthoute a dia thilpiak thu zaw, Galatia gam a saptuam pawlte kiang a thu ka piak bang in nou leng na hih sam un.
english: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.

paite: Ni sagih ani masapen in michih in vualzawlna na muh bang zel un koih khawl chiat un; ka hong chiang a lakkhawm himhim a-omlouhna ding in.
english: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.

paite: Huan na hehpih thilpiak uh Jerusalem a hohpih ding in ka hong tun chiang in kuapeuh hoih na chih ua lai na piak uh ka sawl ding hi.
english: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.

paite: Huan kei va hoh kilawm ahihleh, kei toh ahoh ding uhi.
english: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

paite: Huan Masidonia gam ka totsuah khit chiang in na kiang uah ka hong ding a; Masidonia gam ka tuansuak himhim ding hi.
english: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

paite: Na kiang uah bang tan hiam, phalbi sung teng houh ka taam nilouh kha diam; ka hohna ding peuh a noute'n na hon khaksawn theihna ding un.
english: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

paite: Tua pai kawm lel a hon muh malam ka ut kei a, Toupa'n lem asakleh na kiang ua sawt sim taam ka lamen hi.
english: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

paite: Himahleh Pentikost ni tan in Ephesa ah ka taam ding hi.
english: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

paite: Kong lianpi, phatuampi sepna ding kei a ding in akihong ngal a; huan dou mite leng tampi a-om uh.
english: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

paite: Huan Timothi ahong tunleh lauthawng lou a na kiang ua a-omna ding in pilvang un; ke'n ka sep bangmah in Toupa nna asem hi.
english: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

paite: Huaiziak in kuamah in musit kei uhen; ka kiang a ahong theihna ding in khamuangtak in khakhia unla; unaute toh amah muh ka lamen hi.
english: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

paite: I unaupa Apollos thu zaw, unaute toh na kiang ua hong ding in ka deih ngial hi, himahleh tu'n zaw hong a-ut kei a; alemtan hun chiang in ahong ding hi.
english: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

paite: Kiveng unla, ginna ah dingkip un, kihihhang unla, hattak in om un.
english: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

paite: Na hih peuhmah uh itna a hih hi vek hen.
english: Let all that you do be done in love.

paite: Unaute aw, Stephenas inkuan-pihte zaw Akhaia gam a gingta masate ahi ua, misiangthoute nna sem ding in akipia uh chih na thei uhi;
english: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—

paite: huchibang mite kiang ah leh nasep a panpih leh semgim peuhte kiang a lut ding in ka hon hanthawn hi.
english: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.

paite: Huan Stephenas, Fortunate leh Akaikas ahong tun uh ka kipak hi; noute hih louh kilang lou a ka taksapna hon huh ziak un.
english: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.

paite: Amau ka lungsim leh na lungsim uh hon hihhalh ua, hichibang mite zaw kipahpih un.
english: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.

paite: Asia gam a saptuam pawlte'n chibai hon buk uhi. Akuila, Priscilla leh a-inn ua om saptuamte'n deihsaktak in Toupa ah chibai hon buk uhi.
english: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.

paite: Unau tengteng in chibai hon buk uhi. Tawp siangthou in chibai kibuk un.
english: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

paite: Kei Paul in hiai chibai bukna keimah khut mahmah a ka gelh ahi.
english: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.

paite: Kuapeuh in Toupa Jesu Khrist a-it keileh hamsethuak in om hen. I Toupa ahong pai hi.
english: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!

paite: Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na kiang uah om hen.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

paite: Khrist Jesu a ka itna na vek ua lak ah om hen. Amen.
english: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.

paite: Unaute aw, Pathian thuguk noute hon hilh ding a na kiang ua ka hong lai in thugen thupi leh pilna thupi toh ka hong pai kei hi.
english: When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.

paite: Jesu Khrist, amah mah kilhden a om thu kia lou ngal na lak uah bangmah theih ka tum kei hi.
english: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.

paite: Hat lou leh lau in, nakpitak a ling kawm in na lak uah ka om hi.
english: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.

paite: Ka paukam suak leh ka thugente thupil a khemna thu ahi kei a, Kha leh thilhihtheihna theihsakna in ahi zaw hi.
english: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,

paite: Huchi a na ginna uh mihing pilna a kinga lou a, Pathian thilhihtheihna a kinga a a-om zawk theihna ding in.
english: that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.

paite: Himahleh pichingte lak ah ahihleh thupil i hilh zel a, hinapi in hiai khovel thupil zaw ahi kei; hiai khovel vaihawmte mangthang dingte thupil leng ahi sam kei hi;
english: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing.

paite: Pathian pilna guk leh kisel, i thupina ding a Pathian in khovel om ma a asehkholhsa pen i hilh zaw nak hi.
english: But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,

paite: Hiai khovel vaihawmte himhim in athei kei uh; thei le uh zaw thupina Toupa kilhden lou ding hi ve un.
english: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.

paite: "Mit a muh ngei louh, bil a zak ngei louh, mihing lungtang a lut ngei lou, Pathian in amah itte a dia abawl," chih gelh bang in.
english: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”

paite: Pathian in Kha in huaite ei ahon theisakta a; Kha in bangkim asuikhe vek a; Pathian thugilte tan in.
english: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.

paite: Mihing ngaihtuahte mihing sung a om kha mah lou in, kua'n ahia thei ding? Huchi mah bang in Pathian ngaihtuahte Pathian Kha mah lou kuamah in athei kei uhi.
english: For who among men knows the things of a man except the spirit of the man which is in him? Even so, no one knows the things of God except God’s Spirit.

paite: Huan athawn a Pathian in thil hon piakte i theihna ding in, eite'n zaw khovel kha hilou in, Kha, Pathian a kipan ngei i mu zaw uhi.
english: But we received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.

paite: Mihing' pilna a sinsak thute a hilh lou in Kha sinsak in i hilh zaw ua, Kha neite kiang ah khalam thutakte i hilhchian uhi.
english: We also speak these things, not in words which man’s wisdom teaches but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.

paite: Khovel mi'n Pathian Kha thilpiakte asang kei nak hi, amah ngaihdan in haihuai ahi ngal a, kha a theihchet ahih ziak in atheithei kei hi.
english: Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him; and he can’t know them, because they are spiritually discerned.

paite: Khami in bel thil bangkim achian zel a, amah lah kuamahi achian kei uhi.
english: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is to be judged by no one.

paite: "Kua'n ahia Toupa lungsim thei khin a, amah thuhilh thei ding?" Eite'n bel Khrist lungsim i pu uhi.
english: “For who has known the mind of the Lord that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.

paite: Unaute aw, khamite kiang a gen bang in na kiang uah thu ka gen thei kei hi; sa mite, Khrist a naungekte kiang a gen bang in ka gen zaw hi.
english: Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.

paite: An gum na nek theih nai louh ziak un, nawitui in ka hon vak a, sami na hih lai ziak un tua an gum tu tanpha in leng na ne thei nai kei lailai uhi.
english: I fed you with milk, not with solid food, for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,

paite: Na lak ua kihazatna leh kiselna a-om nak ziak in sami hi lai in mihing bang a om lai hilou na hi uhiam?
english: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?

paite: Mi khat in, “Paul pawl ka hi," midang in, “Kei zaw Apollos pawl ka hi," na chih lai teng uh mihing lel hi lai hilou na hi uhiam?
english: For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” aren’t you fleshly?

paite: Apollos kua ahia le? Paul leng kua ahia? Nasemmi, noumau hon gingtasak mi lel ahi ve ua, huai leng Toupa'n apiak bang zel in ahi.
english: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the Lord gave to him?

paite: Ke'n ka suan a, Apollos in tui in avak a, himahleh Pathian in akhangsak hi.
english: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.

paite: Huchi in akhangsakpa Pathian kia lou ngal, asuanpa lah bangmah ahi kei a, tui a vakpa leng bangmah ahi tuan kei hi.
english: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.

paite: Huan asuanpa leh tui a vakpa pum khat ahi ua, himahleh amau sepgim bang zel in, amau kipahman amu tuaktuak ding uhi.
english: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.

paite: Koute Pathian na seppihte ka hi ua, noute Pathian louma na hi ua, Pathian inn lam leng na hi uhi.
english: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.

paite: Pathian in hehpihna hon piak bang zel in inn lam heutupen piltak bang in ke'n suangphum ka lem a, midang in atung ah inn alam uhi. Himahleh michih atung a alamdan ding uah pilvang uhen.
english: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.

paite: Suangphum lepkhitsa lou ngal suangphum dang kuamah in alem theita kei ua, huai suangphum Jesu Khrist ahi.
english: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.

paite: Hiai suangphum tung ah kuapeuh in dangka-eng in hiam, dangka in hiam, suangmantam in hiam, sing in hiam, loupa in hiam, buhpawl hiam zang in lam taleh;
english: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or straw,

paite: michih nasep ahong lang ding hi; tua Ni in hihlang ding ahi ngal a, meikuang a akilak ding ziak in; meikuang ngeingei in michih nasep bangchibang ahia chih a-enchian ding hi.
english: each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work is.

paite: Kua nasep leng atung a alam pen a-om gigeleh huai mi in kipahman amu ding.
english: If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.

paite: Kua nasep leng akatleh huai mi in atan ding hi; amah taktak zaw hotdam in a-om ding, himahleh mei apaisuak bang in.
english: If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.

paite: Pathian tempul na hih uleh Pathian Kha noumau sung ah ateng gige chih na thei kei ua hia?
english: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you?

paite: Kuapeuh in Pathian tempul ahihsiatleh Pathian in huai mi ahihse ding; Pathian tempul asiangthou ngal a, huai tempul noumau na hi uhi.
english: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.

paite: Kuamah amah-le-amah kikhem kei hen. Na lak ua kuapeuh hiai khovel a pil akisakleh, ahong piltheihna ding in mihai hong suak hen.
english: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool that he may become wise.

paite: Hiai khovel pilna Pathian ngaihdan in haina ahi. "Ama'n amaute apil lepchiahna uah aman hi," chih gelh ahi;
english: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”

paite: Toupa'n mipilte ngaihtuahna athawn ahi, chih athei chi a gelh ahi nawn lai hi.
english: And again, “The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.”

paite: Huaiziak in kuamah in mihingte suang kei hen; bangkim nou a ahi vekta ngal a;
english: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,

paite: Paul hiam, Apollos hiam, Kifas hiam, khovel hiam, hinna hiam, sihna hiam, thil omsa hiam, thil hong om ding hiam;
english: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,

paite: avek in nou a ahi vek hi; noumau leng Khrist a na hi ua; Khrist leng Pathian a ahi.
english: and you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.

paite: Koute zaw Khrist nasemte leh Pathian thuguk kemte bang in min hon thei uhen.
english: So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants and stewards of God’s mysteries.

paite: Hiai ah kempa mimuanhuai hih akiphamoh ahi.
english: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.

paite: Himahleh nou na hon ettelna uh leh mihing ngaihtuahna a na hon ettelna uh kei a ding in thil neuchik ahi.
english: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a human court. Yes, I don’t even judge my own self.

paite: Keimah leng ka ki-entel ngei tuan kei. Bangmah kimohsakna ding ka kithei kei a; himahleh huai in siam hon tangsak tuan kei hi; hon entelpa Toupa ahi zaw hi.
english: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.

paite: Huchi in ahun ma in bangmah thukhenna bawl kei un, Toupa hong pai masiah, ama'n mial a thil selgukte vak ah hon lakhe ding a; lungtang a tupte leng ahihlang lai ding hi; huai hun chiang in michih in Pathian a kipan in amau tan hun chiat in phatna aloh chiat ding uhi.
english: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.

paite: Unaute aw, na phattuampihna ding un hiai thu Apollos leh kei tung ah ka belh hi, huchi a koute a kipan a hindan na sintheihna ding uleh, akigelhsa pen sang a na lak ua kuamah mi khat midang sang a ngaina zaw a na kisaktheihpih louhna ding un.
english: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.

paite: Kua'n ahia nou a thiltuam deuh om a mu? Na muhsawn louh ngal uh bang ahia na neih uh? Huchi a amusawn lel na hih uleh na muhsawn uh athawn a piak hilou bang a bangziak a kisathei zenzen?
english: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?

paite: Tu in na vahta ua! Tu in na hong hauta ua! Kou lou in vai na hawmta uh! Ahi, vaihawm taktak le uchin, huchi a noute toh vai ka hawm sam theihna ding un.
english: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you!

paite: Pathian in kou sawltakte, si ding a sehsa bang in ananungpen in hon sepkhia hi in ka thei ahi; khovelte leh angelte leh mihingte mitmuh a etnop a bawl in ka om uhi.
english: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.

paite: Kou zaw Khrist ziak in mihai ka hi ua, nou bel Khrist ah mipil na hi zaw uhi; kou zaw ka hat kei ua, nou bel na hat uhi; nou zaw mi pahtawi in na om ua, kou zaw mi simmoh in ka om zaw uhi.
english: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.

paite: Tutan in leng ka gilkial un ka dangtak ua, puansilh ka kiching kei ua, mi khut thak nuhna ka hi ua, mun leh mual ka nei kei uh;
english: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.

paite: koumau khut a sem in ka gim mahmah ua; mi'n hon tai uleh ka vualzawl ua; ahon sawi uleh ka thuak teitei uhi.
english: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.

paite: Mi'n hon gensiat uleh ka khem ua; tutan in leng khovel ninnok thil tengteng nin kihhuai bang in ahon bawl uhi.
english: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.

paite: Na zumna ding un hiai thu ka gelh ahi kei a, ka ta deihtakte bang a hon taihilh ding in ka gelh ahi zaw hi.
english: I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.

paite: Khrist ah heutu singkhat nei mah le uchin, pa zaw tampi na nei tuan kei uhi. Ke'n Khrist Jesu ah tanchinhoih in noute ka hon neikhia hi.
english: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.

paite: Huaiziak in ka omdan zui ding in ka hon ngen ahi.
english: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.

paite: Hiai ziak in Timothi, Toupa a ka ta deihtak leh muanhuai, na kiang uah ka hon sawl hi. Ama'n Khrist a ka omdan, gam chih a saptuamte teng thu ka hilh zeldan noute ahon theisak nawn ding hi.
english: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every assembly.

paite: Huan kei na kiang ua hong nawn lou ding bang zen in khenkhat na na ki-uangsak uhi.
english: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.

paite: Himahleh Toupa'n pha asakleh sawt louchik nung in na kiang uah ka hong ding, huchi in miki-uangsakte kamhat thu hilou in, athilhihtheihna uh ka thei zawta ding hi.
english: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.

paite: Pathian lalgam zaw kamhat thu ah a-om kei a, thilhihtheihna ah a-om zaw hi.
english: For God’s Kingdom is not in word, but in power.

paite: Bang na deihzaw ua? Chiangpum toh hia, itna leh kingaihniamna lungsim toh na kiang ua ka hong ding?
english: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?

paite: Na lak uah kingaihna nin a-om chih thu athang vengvung hi. Huchibang kingaihna nin Zentelte lak a leng om ngei lou, na lak ua mi khat in amah pa zi akitenpih hi.
english: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father’s wife.

paite: Huai thilhihpa na lak ua kipan delhkhiak ding a lungngaih nak sang in na kisaktheihpih zaw uhi.
english: You are arrogant, and didn’t mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.

paite: Kei mahmah pumpi in ka pang kei na a, kha in noute lak ah ka om a, thil huchi tel hihpa tu in leng Toupa Jesu min in na lak ua pang bang a kingaihtuah in thupukna ka bawlta hi.
english: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist min a na kikhop chiang un, noute lak ah kha in ka om a, Toupa Jesu Khrist thilhihtheihna leng a-om hi.
english: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together with my spirit with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,

paite: Mi huchibang zaw Toupa ni chiang a akha hotdam a a-omtheihna ding in asa hihmang ding in Setan kiang ah pekhia un.
english: you are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

paite: Na kisaktheihna uh hoih lou ahi. Silngou tawmchik in tanghou beu apum in azelsuak chih na thei kei ua hia?
english: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?

paite: Silngou pang lou na hih mah bang un tanghou beu thak na hong hihtheihna ding un silngou lui pen paikhe siang un. I Paikan Ankuangluina ding Khrist latkhiak in a-omta hi.
english: Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.

paite: Huaiziak in ankuanglui ni, silngou lui a ankuang lui lou in, nunsia leh gitlouhna silngou a leng ankuang lui sam lou in, takna leh thutak tanghou silngou soh louh in ankuang i lui zaw ding uh.
english: Therefore let’s keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

paite: Ka laikhak ah kingaihhatte kithuahpih lou ding in na kiang uah ka gelh hi.
english: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;

paite: Hiai khovel a kingaihhatte hiam, huaiham leh lepgute hiam, milim bete hiam kithuahpih het louh ding chi ka hi kei a; huchibang hileh khovel a kipan na paikhiak uh kul ding ahi.
english: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world, or with the covetous and extortionists, or with idolaters, for then you would have to leave the world.

paite: Tu'n bel kuapeuh unau min po ngal in, kingaihhatmi hiam, mihuaiham hiam, milim bemi hiam, mihuaiham hiam, milim bemi hiam, hanhatmi hiam, zukham hatmi hiam, lepgumi hiam hileh, kithuahpih lou ding in na kiang uah ka gelh ahi; mi huchibang kiang ah nek leng ne kei un.
english: But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortionist. Don’t even eat with such a person.

paite: Polam mite tung a vaihawm ding ke'n bang ahia ka awlmoh ding om? Nou sung a mite hilou hia na ngaihtuah ding uh?
english: For what do I have to do with also judging those who are outside? Don’t you judge those who are within?

paite: Polam a mite tung a Pathian in vaihawm hilou hia? “Huai migiloupa na lak ua kipan koihkhia un."
english: But those who are outside, God judges. “Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.”

paite: Na lak uah kuapeuh in midang toh thubuai neita le uchin, misiangthoute ma a tun lou in, midiktatloute ma ah na tun ngam ding ua hia?
english: Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?

paite: Ahihleh misiangthoute'n khovel tung a vaihawm ding ahi chih na thei kei ua hia? Khovel mite tung a bawn vaihawm ding na hih uleh, thil neupente leng ngaihtuah tak lou na hi ua hia?
english: Don’t you know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

paite: Tulai damsung thute gen louh angelte nangawn i vaihawm ding uh ahi chih na thei kei ua hia?
english: Don’t you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?

paite: Huchi in tulai damsung thute ngaihtuah ding na neih un bangziak a saptuamte ngaihniam pente ngaihtuahsak na hi ua?
english: If then you have to judge things pertaining to this life, do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly?

paite: Na zumna ding un ka gen ahi. A-unaute kal a thu hihpuk thei mipil, khat bek na lak uah na mu kei ua ahi ding maw?
english: I say this to move you to shame. Isn’t there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?

paite: Unau in a-unau mah ginglou mite vaihawmna a atut zawk nak!
english: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!

paite: Hilou ahi, hiai na diklouhna khat uh ahi pah hi, thubuai na kineih tuah nak uh. Bangziak a dikloupi a hihna na thuak zaw lou? Bang achia kizangsak zaw mai lou oi?
english: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?

paite: Hilou ahi, noumau ngei in na unaute uh tung ah leng na hihdik kei ua, na zangsak uhi.
english: No, but you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that against your brothers.

paite: Ahihleh midiktatloute'n Pathian lalgam aluah kei ding uh chih na thei kei ua hia? Khem in om kei un, kingaihhatte, milim bete, angkawmte leh mihukte leh tokohukte,
english: Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor male prostitutes, nor homosexuals,

paite: gutate, mihuaihamte, zukhamhatte, salhhatte leh lepgute'n Pathian lalgam aluah kei ding uh.
english: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit God’s Kingdom.

paite: Huan noute khenkhat huchibang na hi uh; himahleh Toupa Jesu Khrist min in leh i Pathian Kha ah siansak na hita ua, hihsiangthou na hita ua, siamtang na hita uhi.
english: Some of you were such, but you were washed. You were sanctified. You were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the Spirit of our God.

paite: "Thil bangkim hih kei a ding in asiang a," himahleh thil bangkim hih ahoihkim kei, "Thil bangkim hih kei a ding in asiang a," himahleh bangmah sikha ding in ka kiphal kei hi.
english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything.

paite: "Nek dingte gilpi a ahi a, gilpi leng nek ding a ahi," himahleh Pathian in ahihmang tuaktuak ding. Huan pumpi pen kingaihna ding ahi kei a, Toupa a ding ahi; Toupa leng pumpi a ding ahi;
english: “Foods for the belly, and the belly for foods,” but God will bring to nothing both it and them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.

paite: Pathian in misi lak a kipan Toupa akaithou a, eite leng athilhihtheihna in hon kaithou sam ding hi.
english: Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.

paite: Na pumpi uh Khrist hiang ahi chih na thei kei ua hia? Khrist hiangte laksak in kizuak hiang ding peuh in ka bawl dia hia?
english: Don’t you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? May it never be!

paite: Bawl lou hial ding. Ahihleh kizuak zop amah toh pum khat ahi uh chih na thei kei ua hia? "Anih un sapum khat ahi ding uh," achi ngal a.
english: Or don’t you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? For, “The two”, he says, “will become one flesh.”

paite: Toupa zop bel amah toh kha pum khat ahi uhi.
english: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit.

paite: Kingaih taisan un. Mihing thilhihkhelh chiteng pumpi polam ah ahi; mingaih hat in bel amah pumpi tung ah thil ahihkhial hi.
english: Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.

paite: Ahihleh na pumpi uh, na sung ua om Pathian kiang a kipan a na muh uh, Kha Siangthou tempul ahi chih na thei kei ua hia? Noumau a leng na hi kei ua,
english: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,

paite: man a leisa na hih ziak un, na pumpi uh leh na kha Pathian a mah in, Pathian pahtawi un.
english: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.

paite: Tu in, na thilgelh thute uh zaw, "Pasal a ding in numei khoih louh ahoih hi."
english: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.

paite: Himahleh kingaihna a-om nak ziak in pasal chih in ama zi chiat nei henla, numei chih in leng ama pasal chiat nei hen.
english: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.

paite: Pasal in azi kiang ah atan ding hun pia hen; huchi mah bang in zi in leng apasal kiang ah atan ding hun pe sam hen.
english: Let the husband give his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife her husband.

paite: Zi in ama pumpi tung ah thu anei kei a, apasal in thu aneizaw hi; huchi mah bang in pasal in leng ama pumpi tung ah thu anei kei a, azi in thu aneizaw hi.
english: The wife doesn’t have authority over her own body, but the husband does. Likewise also the husband doesn’t have authority over his own body, but the wife does.

paite: Thum ding a na kipiak theihna ding uleh, na kikholh nawn theihna ding ua sawt lou kal a dia pha na sak tuaktuak kei ngal uleh akuamah mah kizangsak kei un, huchi lou in zaw na kidek zoh louh ziak un Setan in ahon khem kha ding hi.
english: Don’t deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that Satan doesn’t tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

paite: Himahleh hiai thu thupiak dan hilou in phal lam thu in ka gen zaw ahi.
english: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.

paite: Ke'n bel, mi tengteng keimah bang a a-om vek uh ka deih ahi. Himahleh michih in Pathian a kipan thilpiak amau muh lam anei chiat uhi; khat in lam tuam ah khat in lam dang in.
english: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However, each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.

paite: Himahleh koppih neiloute leh meithaite kiang ah huchi in ka chi ahi; keimah bangtak in om le uh amau a ding in ahoih ding hi.
english: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.

paite: Kidektheihna aneih kei ualeh kiteng uhen; huk sang in kiten ahoihzaw hi.
english: But if they don’t have self-control, let them marry. For it’s better to marry than to burn with passion.

paite: Huan kitengsate kiang ah thu ka pia, keimah bel hilou in, Toupa piak ahi zaw; zi in apasal khen kei hen;
english: But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband

paite: akhen vanglakleh pasal nei nawn lou in om vanglak hen, ahihkeileh, apasal toh mah kituak nawn uheh; huan pasal in azi ma kei hen.
english: (but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband not leave his wife.

paite: Midang kiang ah ahihleh Toupa hilou in keimah in ka gen; unau kuapeuh in zi, gingloumi kitenpih leh akiang a om gige a-utleh, ma kei hen.
english: But to the rest I—not the Lord—say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.

paite: Huan numei pasal ginglou kitenpih in, apasal in akiang a om gige a-utleh ma kei hen.
english: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.

paite: Pasal gingloumi azi ziak in hihsiangthou in a-om a, zi gingloumi leng apasal ziak in hihsiangthou in a-om sam ahi; huchi hita keileh, na tate uh asiangthou kei ding uhi; himahleh asiangthou na uhi.
english: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.

paite: Himahleh aging lou pen in akhenleh khen mai hen, huchibang ah zaw unaupa hiam, unaunu hiam, hen ahita kei ding. Pathian in lemna ah ahon sam hi.
english: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.

paite: Zi aw, na pasal na hotdam ding leh ding louh bangchi in na thei a eita? Pasal aw, na zi na hotdam ding leh ding louh bangchi in na thei a eita?
english: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?

paite: Himahleh, Toupa'n michih kiang a apiak bang chiat leh Pathian in michih asap lai a a-omdan bang chiat in om hen. Huchibang in saptuam pawl tengteng ah ka hihkip hi.
english: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.

paite: Zeksumsa a sap a-om uhia? Zeksum louh hong hi tuan kei uhen. Zeksum louh a om sap a-om uhia? Zeksum tuan dah uhen.
english: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.

paite: Pathian thupiakte zuih lel louh ngal zeksum i chih bangmah ahi kei a, zeksum louh leng bangmah ahi kei hi.
english: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but what matters is keeping God’s commandments.

paite: Michih sap a a-om lai ua atan ngeina uah om chiat uhen.
english: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.

paite: Sikha hisa a sap na hi hia? Khawk sa tuan ke'n. Na suahtak theihleh sensuk in.
english: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.

paite: Sikha hisa a om Toupa sap Toupa sikha noplen ahi a; huchi mah bang in noplen sa a sap Khrist sikha ahi.
english: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord’s free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ’s bondservant.

paite: Man a lei na hita ua mihingte sikha ah lut kei un.
english: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.

paite: Unaute aw, michih sap a a-om lai bangbang in Pathian kiang ah om gige hen.
english: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.

paite: Huan nungak siangthou lam thu ah zaw Toupa thupiak himhim ka nei kei; himahleh muanhuai a om ding in Toupa kiang a kipan zahngaihna mu ka hih ziak in ka ngaihtuahdan ka gen ding.
english: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.

paite: Tulai haksatna ziak in pasal a-omdan ngeingei bang in omleh amah a ding in hoih in ka gingta hi.
english: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, it’s good for a man to remain as he is.

paite: Zi a hen na hi hia? Kisutkhiak tum ke'n. Zi a hen louh na hi hia? Zi zong ke'n.
english: Are you bound to a wife? Don’t seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don’t seek a wife.

paite: Himahleh zi na neihleh thil na hihkhial kei hi, nungak siangthou in leng pasal aneihleh thil ahihkhial sam kei hi. Himahleh, hichibang mite'n sa ah gimna athuak ding uhi; himahleh ke'n zaw hon thuaksak louh ka ut hi.
english: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.

paite: Himahleh unaute aw, hiai ka chi ahi; hun seh atomta; zi neite nei lou bang a a-omtheihna ding un;
english: But I say this, brothers: the time is short. From now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;

paite: kapte kap lou bang a a-omtheihna ding un leh kipakte kipak lou bang a a-omtheihna ding un;
english: and those who weep, as though they didn’t weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn’t rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn’t possess;

paite: khovel zangte zang lo zen lou a a-omtheihna ding un; hiai khovel omdan lah amangthang gige ahi.
english: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.

paite: Lungzinna nei lou a na om uh ka hon deih hi. Zi nei lou pasal in Toupa lungkimsakna ding in, Toupa lam thilte alimsak hi.
english: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;

paite: Zi nei pasal in bel azi lungkimsakna ding in, khovel thilte alimsak hi.
english: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.

paite: Pasal neisa leh nungak siangthou kilamdanna a-om hi. Pasal nei lou numei in apumpi leh kha asianthoudan ding, Toupa lam thilte alimsak a; pasal nei numei in bel apasal lungkimsakdan ding, khovel lam thilte alimsak hi.
english: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.

paite: Nou phattuamna ding in hiai ka gen ahi; na tung ua khamna nga hilou in, navak a na omna ding uleh Toupa kiang a na kipiakna uh bukimna ding in ahi zaw.
english: This I say for your own benefit, not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.

paite: Kuapeuh in azikham tung a gamta diklou hi a akigintak a, alunggulhna a let ngal a akulleh, hoih asak bang in hih hen aw; kiteng uhen, khelhna ahi kei.
english: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn’t sin. Let them marry.

paite: Himahleh kuapeuh alungtang a thu khensat a, alou thei lou khop a kulna nei hilou a, amah kithuzohmi in asianthouna kepbit atup tintenleh ahihhoih ding.
english: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no urgency, but has power over his own will, and has determined in his own heart to keep his own virgin, does well.

paite: Huchi in nungak kitenpihpa'n ahihhoih a; himahleh zi nei lou dia amah kikham in ahihhoih zaw ding hi.
english: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn’t give her in marriage does better.

paite: Zi zaw apasal adam lai teng hen ahi; himahleh apasal asihleh bel adeih peuh anei thei ding a, himahleh Toupa a ommi ahih ding ahi.
english: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.

paite: Himahleh kei ngaihdan in, a-om ngei in om gigeleh nuam asa zaw ding; ke'n Pathian Kha nei sam in ka kithei hi.
english: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.

paite: Tu in milimte kiang a kithoihna tungtang zaw; i vek un theihna i nei chiat uh, chih i kithei hi. Theihna in mi akisatheisak a itna in mi abawlhoih hi.
english: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

paite: Kuapeuh in thil banghiam thei a akingaihtuahleh, atheih ding thei nai lou ahi.
english: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.

paite: Himahleh mi kuapeuh in Pathian a-itleh, huai mi mah ama theih ahi.
english: But anyone who loves God is known by him.

paite: Huchi in milimte kiang a kithoihna thil nek thu zaw, "Khovel ah milim himhim bangmah ahihlouhdan uleh, khat kia lou ngal Pathian dang himhim a-omlouhdan i thei uhi."
english: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.

paite: Van ah leh lei ah pathian min pu tampi om mah le uh, huchibang pathian tampi leh toupate tampi a-om uhi.
english: For though there are things that are called “gods”, whether in the heavens or on earth—as there are many “gods” and many “lords”—

paite: Eite a ding in bel Pathian khat kia Pa, a-om a amah kiang a kipan in bangkim apawt a, eite leng amah a dia om i hi uhi. Toupa khat kia, Jesu Khrist a-om hi, amah ziak in bangkim a-om hi, eite leng amah ziak mah a om i hi uhi.
english: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.

paite: Himahleh huai theihna mi tengteng ah a-om kei hi; khenkhatte milim biakna sa ahih ziak un, milim kiang a kithoihna ahi chih thei napi in tutan in ane uhi; huchi in asia-le-pha theihna uh ahat louh ziak in athanghuaisak uhi.
english: However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.

paite: Himahleh, sa nek in Pathian mit hon tungsak tuan kei ding a, ne kei mah lehang i se tuan kei a, ne mah lehang leng i hoih tuan sam kei hi.
english: But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don’t eat are we the worse, nor if we eat are we the better.

paite: Himahleh pilvang un, huchi lou in zaw na noplenna uh bangchi chi hiam in mihatloute a ding in pukna ahong hi kha ding hi.
english: But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.

paite: Nang theihna neimi, kuapeuh in milim biakna in a-ankuang um a ahon muh ngal un, amau mihat lou na hita le uh milim kiang a kithoihna thil ne ding in asia-le-pha theihna hong maingal lou ding hia?
