english: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?

paite: Huchi in na theihna ziak in unau hat lou, asih sik a Khrist in asihsakpa, amangthang ding hi.
english: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.

paite: Unaute tung a huchibang thil na hihkhelh ua, asia-le-pha theihna uh ahat louh nak lai a na liamsak behlap un, Khrist tung ah thil na hihkhial uhi.
english: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.

paite: Huaiziaktak in ka sa nek in ka unau ahihpuk sang in, ka unau ka hihpuklouhna ding in sa himhim ka ne ngei kei ding hi.
english: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.

paite: Noplen ka hi kei a hia? Sawltak kei a hia? I Toupa Jesu ka muta kei a hia? Noute Toupa a ka nasep gah na hi kei ua hia?
english: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren’t you my work in the Lord?

paite: Midangte a ding in sawltak hi kei mah leng, noute a ding bek in zaw ka hi; Toupa a ka sawltak hihna chiamtehna noumau na hi uhi.
english: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

paite: Hiai kei hon demte ka dawn na ahi,
english: My defense to those who examine me is this:

paite: Ne ding leh dawn ding in thu ka nei kei ua hia?
english: Have we no right to eat and to drink?

paite: Sawltak dangte leh Toupa unaute leh Kifas bang in zi gingtami pi vialvial ding in thu ka nei kei ua hia?
english: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

paite: Ahihkeileh kei leh Barnabas kia koumau kivak kawm a khut a nna sem lou ding in thu ka nei lou tuam ua hia?
english: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?

paite: Sepaih kua ahia amah kivak a galkap ngei? Kua'n ahia agah ne lou a grephuan bawl ngei? Ahihkeileh kua'n ahia ganhon nawitui ne lou a ganhon vul ngei?
english: What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn’t eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock, and doesn’t drink from the flock’s milk?

paite: Huai thute mihing bang mai in ka gen a hia? Dan thu mah in leng huai ngei agen sam kei a hia?
english: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn’t the law also say the same thing?

paite: Mosi Dan Laibu ah, "Bawngtal in buh achil lai in amuk gak ke'n," chih gelh ahi. Pathian in bawngtal a ding kia hia angaihtuahsak?
english: For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.” Is it for the oxen that God cares,

paite: Ahihkeileh ei a ding a kigen ahi hia? Hi e, ei a ding a agelh ahi; lei letpa'n lamet nei a aleh ding ahi a, buhvopa'n leng tan neih sam lamen a avuak ding ahi.
english: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.

paite: Koute'n khalam thilte na kiang ua ka tuh ngal uleh, na salam thilte uh at le ung leng thil thupi ahi dia hia?
english: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?

paite: Midang in bawn na tung ua thuneihna atan uleh kou tang sem lou ding ka hi uh maw? Himahleh huai thuneihna ka zang kei uh; Khrist tanchinhoih ka dallouhna ding un bangkim ka thuak teitei uhi.
english: If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more? Nevertheless we didn’t use this right, but we bear all things, that we may cause no hindrance to the Good News of Christ.

paite: Tempul a thil siangthou bawl vialvialte'n tempul a kipan nek amu ua, maitam a nasemte'n maitam a pan ane uh chih na thei kei ua hia?
english: Don’t you know that those who serve around sacred things eat from the things of the temple, and those who wait on the altar have their portion with the altar?

paite: Huchi mah bang in, Toupa'n tanchinhoih gente nek muhna ding in tanchinhoih mah asep hi.
english: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.

paite: Himahleh ke'n zaw tuate khat leng ka zang kei hi; ka tung a hiaite na hih ding uh ahi chi a hiai thu gelh ka hi kei hi. Kuapeuh in ka suan pen bangmah lou a abawl sang un, si mai leng kei a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
english: But I have used none of these things, and I don’t write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void.

paite: Tanchinhoih gen mah leng kisaktheihna ding ahi kei hi. Hih louh theih louh ka tung ah akinga ahi; tanchinhoih gen kei leng ka tung gik ding ahi.
english: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about, for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t preach the Good News.

paite: Huai tuh keimah ut thu a hih hi leng kipahman ka nei hi; himahleh, keimah ut thu ahihkeileh tanchinhoih kepna nna piak a om ka hi.
english: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.

paite: Ka kipahman bang ahia le? Tanchinhoih ka gen in loh nei lou a, tanchinhoih athawn a pia ka hihtheihna ahi.
english: What then is my reward? That when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.

paite: Mi teng a pan zalen himah leng, mi tamsem ka laktheihna ding in mi tengteng sikha in ka kibawlta hi.
english: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.

paite: Huchi in Judate ka laklut theihna ding in Judate kiang ah Juda mi bang in ka om zel; dan nuai a omte ka laklut theihna ding in dan nuai a omte kiang ah dan nuai a om bang in ka om zel; dan nuai a om tuan lou in.
english: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;

paite: Dan neiloute ka laklut theihna ding in dan neiloute kiang ah dan nei lou bang in ka om zel, Pathian dan a om lou tuan lou in; Khrist dan zom ngal in.
english: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.

paite: Hatloute ka laklut theihna ding in hatloute kiang ah hat lou bang in ka om zel; hihtheihna teng zang a khenkhatte ka hotdam theihna ding in mi tengteng kiang ah bangkim ka hita hi.
english: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.

paite: Tanchinhoih ziak in bangkim ka hih zel a, huai nasepna a ka tel sam theihna ding in.
english: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.

paite: Kitaitehte avek un atai ua, himahleh khat kia in kipahman amu zel chih na thei kei ua hia? Na muhtheihna ding un huchi mah bang in tai un.
english: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.

paite: Huan kidemna a kimawl mi peuhmah bangkim ah mahni kithunun in a-om nak hi. Amau zaw lallukhu se thei mu ding in ahih ua, eite'n bel Lallukhu Setheilou mu ding in.
english: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.

paite: Huaiziak in kei ka tai a, aziak bei hilou in; huihkhua leltak noh lou in ka pang hi.
english: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,

paite: Himahleh ka pumpi ka thunun a; sikha in ka bawl zaw zel hi; huchi lou in zaw midangte kiang a ka tangkoupih nung in leng bangchi hiam in kei ngeitak kipahman mu tak lou in ka om kha ding hi.
english: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.

paite: Hinna thu, atung a kipan a ana omta, koute'n ka zak uh, ka mit ua ka muh uh, ka et kilkel ua, ka khut ua ka khoih uh,
english: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life

paite: huai hinna latsak in ahong omta a, koute'n ka mu uhi, huai tangtawn hinna, Pa kiang a-omleh koute kiang ah latsak a om noute kiang ah ka hon puang uhi;
english: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);

paite: huai koute'n ka muhsa uh leh ka zaksa uh mah noute kiang a ka puankhiak uh, huchi a noute'n leng koute toh kithuahna na neihtheihna ding un; koute kithuahna bel Pa toh a Tapa Jesu Khrist toh kithuahna ahi.
english: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

paite: Noute na kipahna uh abukimna ding in hiai ka hon gelh uhi.
english: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.

paite: Huan thukhah akiang a kipan a ka zak uh na kiang ua ka hon hilhsawn uh hiai ahi; Pathian zaw vak ahi a, amah ah mial a-om kei hi.
english: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

paite: Mial a om napi in amah ka kithuahpih chi lehang zuau i gen a, thutak i zui kei uhi.
english: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.

paite: Himahleh amah vak a a-om bang a eite leng vak a i omleh i kithuah chiat ua, huan a Tapa Jesu sisan in i khelhna tengteng ahon silsiangsak zel hi.
english: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.

paite: Khelhna ka nei kei chi lehang eimah leh eimah i kikhem a, eimah ah thutak a-om kei hi.
english: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

paite: I khelhnate thupha i tawileh i khelhnate ngaidam ding leh i diktatlouhna tengteng silsiang ding in amah amuanhuai in adiktat hi.
english: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

paite: Thil ka hihkhial kei i chihleh amah zuauthei in i bawl ua, athu leng ei ah a-om kei hi.
english: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

paite: Ka naute aw, thil na hihkhelhlouhna ding un hiai thute na kiang uah ka gelh ahi. Kuapeuh in thil ahihkhelhleh Pa kiang a hon gensakpa, Jesu Khrist, midiktat i nei hi.
english: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.

paite: Amah i khelhnate thuphatawina ahi, eimah khelhna kia hilou in, khovel tengteng khelhna thuphatawina leng ahi.
english: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

paite: Huan athupiakte i zuihleh huai ah amah i thei chih i kithei hi.
english: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

paite: Athupiakte zui lou a, "Amah ka thei," chimi zaw mizuauthei ahi, amah ah thutak a-om kei hi.
english: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.

paite: Kuapeuh athu zui peuhmah amah ah Pathian itna akim petmah hi. Amah ah i om chih hiai ah i kithei ahi.
english: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:

paite: Amah ah ka om gige chimi, amah om bang in a-om sam ding ahi.
english: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.

paite: Deihtakte aw, thupiak thak na kiang uah ka gelh kei a; thupiak lui atung a kipan a na neih uh ka gelh zaw ahi. Huai thupiak lui na thu theihsa pen uh ahi.
english: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.

paite: Himahleh thupiak thak gelh hi sam na veng, huai amah ah leh noumau ah alang hi, mial aman lellel ziak in leh vak taktak tua ahong vak tak ziak in.
english: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.

paite: A-unau ho napi a, vak ah ka om chimi tutan in leng mial ah a-om gige hi.
english: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.

paite: A-unau itmi bel vak ah a-om gige a, amah ah kipalpaihna ding san a-om kei hi.
english: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.

paite: A-unau homi zaw mial ah a-om a, mial ah akhosa a, mial in amit atotsak ziak in apaina leng athei kei hi.
english: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

paite: Naute aw, ama min ziak a na khelhnate uh ngaihdam ahih tak ziak in na kiang uah ka gelh ahi.
english: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

paite: Pate aw, amah atung a kipan a om gige na theih ziak un na kiang uah ka gelh ahi. Tangvalte aw, Pathian thu noumau ah a-om gige a, giloupa na zoh tak ziak un na kiang uah ka gelh ahi. Naute aw, Pa na theih ziak un na kiang uah ka gelh ahi.
english: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.

paite: Pate aw, amah atung a kipan a om gige na theih ziak un na kiang uah ka gelh ahi. Tangvalte aw, na hat ua Pathian thu noumau ah a-om gige a, migilou na zoh tak ziak un na kiang uah ka gelh ahi.
english: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

paite: Khovel it kei unla, khovel a thil omte leng it sam kei un. Mi kuapeuh in khovel a-itleh Pa itna amah ah a-om kei hi.
english: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.

paite: Khovel a thil om tengteng, taksa utnate, mit utnate, damsung thupina limte Pa a kipan ahi kei a, khovel a kipan ahi zaw hi.
english: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.

paite: Khovel, a-utnate toh amangthang lellel ahi. Pathian deihlam hihmi bel tangtawn in a-om gige ding hi.
english: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.

paite: Naute aw, hun nanungpen hita e, Khrist doupa ahong pai ding chih na zak bang un tu in leng Khrist doumi tampitak ahong pawtta uhi; huaiziak in hun nanungpen ahita chih i thei uhi.
english: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.

paite: Amaute i lak ua kipan in apawt ua, himahleh ei sung mi tak ahi kei uh; ei sung mi tak hi le uh i kiang uah a-om sam ding uhi; himahleh avek un ei sung mi tak ahi kei uh chih alatchetna ding in ahon pawtsanta uhi.
english: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.

paite: Mi Siangthou kiang a kipan thaunilhna na tang ua, bangkim na thei uhi.
english: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

paite: Thutak na theih louh ziak ua ka gelh ahi kei a, na theih ziak uh leh thutak a zuau bangmah apawt ngei louh ziak in ka gelh ahi zaw hi.
english: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.

paite: Jesu tuh Khrist ahi chih gingtaloumi sang a zuauthei kua a-om a? Khrist doumi tuh Pa leh Tapa gingtaloumi ahi.
english: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.

paite: Kuapeuh Tapa nial in Pa anei kei a; kuapeuh Tapa gingta in bel Pa leng asang hi.
english: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.

paite: Nou zaw atung a kipan a na zak uh noumau ah omsak gige un. Huai atung a kipan a na zak uh noumau a a-om gigeleh noute ngei leng Tapa leh Pa ah na om gige ding uhi.
english: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.

paite: Hiai ahi amah ngei in ahon chiam pen: tangtawn hinna.
english: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.

paite: Noumau hon pimang tumte tungtang na kiang uah ka gelh ahi.
english: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.

paite: Nou zaw amah kiang a kipan a thaunilhna na tan uh noumau ah a-om gige a, kuamah hilh na kiphamoh kei uhi; ama thaunilhna in thil tengteng ahon sinsak bang in leh hiai thudik hi a, zuau leng ahih louh ziak in huai in nou ahon sinsak bang in amah ah om gige un.
english: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.

paite: Huchi in naute aw, amah ah om gige un; amah ahong kilak chiang in ama ah zum lou in hangsantak in i om thei ding uhi.
english: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

paite: Amah midiktat ahi chih na theih uleh mi kuapeuh diktatna hihmi amah a suak ahi chih na thei uhi.
english: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.

paite: Ngai un, Pa hon itna thupi hi na tel e! Pathian tate chih a i om; huai mah i hihna uh ahi hi. Hiai khawng ziak in khovel in ahon thei kei hi, amah atheih louh ziak in.
english: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

paite: Deihtakte aw, tu'n ah Pathian tate i hi ua, bangchi in ahia i om ding chih akithei tadih kei hi; amah ahong kilak chiang in, amah bang in i om ding chih bel i thei hi, amah a-om ngeingei bangtak a mu ding i hi ngal ua.
english: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.

paite: Amah tung a lametna nei peuhmah amah asiangthou bang in akihihsiangthou hi.
english: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.

paite: Kuapeuh thil hihkhial dan ah atalek hi; dan a tatlekna khelhna ahi ngal a.
english: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.

paite: Amah khelhnate lamang ding in ahong langta chih na thei uhi; amah ah khelhna bangmah a-om kei hi.
english: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.

paite: Kuapeuh amah a om gige in thil ahihkhial kei; kuapeuh thil hihkhial in amah amu kei a, amah leng athei kei hi.
english: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.

paite: Tate aw, kuamah khem in om kei un. Diktatna hihmi amah adiktat mah bang in adiktat hi.
english: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

paite: Thil hihkhialmi zaw diabol a pawt ahi; diabol in atung a kipan thil ahihkhial hi. Pathian Tapa hong latna pen diabol nasepte ahihmanthat theihna ding in ahi.
english: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.

paite: Kuapeuh Pathian a suak in amah a Pathian chi a-om gige ziak in thil ahihkhial kei, Pathian a suak ahih ziak in, thil ahihkhial thei kei hi.
english: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.

paite: Hiai ah Pathian tate leh diabol tate atheihtheih hi; kuapeuh diktatna hih lou Pathian a suak ahi kei a, a-unau it lou leng Pathian a suak ahi kei hi.
english: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.

paite: Atung a kipan thukhah na zak uh i ki-ittuah chiat ding uh chih ahi.
english: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—

paite: Kain, giloupa a kipan amah unau thatpa bang in om kei ni. Bangziak in ahia athah tak? Amah thilhihte agilou a, a-unau thilhihte adik ziak in ahi.
english: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

paite: Naute aw, khovel in nou ahon huatleh lamdang sa kei un.
english: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.

paite: Unaute i it ziak in sihna a kipan in i pawt ua, hinna ah i lutta chih i thei uhi. Kuapeuh itna nei lou sihna ah a-om lai hi.
english: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.

paite: Kuapeuh a-unau hua tualthat ahi; tualthatmi tangtawn hinna nei a-om kei uh chih na thei uhi.
english: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

paite: Hiai ah itna bang ahia chih i thei hi, ama'n eite a dia ahinna apiak tak ziak in; en leng unaute a ding in i hinna i piak sam ding ahi.
english: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

paite: Himahleh kuapeuh in khovel sum nei in, a-unau tasam in mu henla, amah lainat tuan kei taleh Pathian itna amah ah bangchi in a-om dia?
english: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?

paite: Naute aw, thu kia in it kei ni, lei kia in leng it sam kei ni, thilhih leh thutak in hi zaw hen.
english: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

paite: Hiai in thutak a suak i hi chih hon theisak a, amah ma ah i lungtang i muangsak thak ding hi.
english: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,

paite: I lungtang in siam louh ahon tansak dek chiang in chihna ahi; Pathian zaw i lungtangte sang in alianzaw a thil bangkim athei hi.
english: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

paite: Deihtakte aw, i lungtang in siam louh ahon tan keileh Pathian lam ah i hangsan hi;
english: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

paite: athupiakte i zuih ua, amitmuh a thil kipahhuai i hih zel ziak in i nget peuhmah amah a kipan in i mu zel uhi.
english: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

paite: Huan athupiak hiai ahi, a Tapa Jesu Khrist min gingta lehang, ama'n thu ahon piak bang in ki-ittuah chiat lai lehang.
english: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.

paite: Athupiakte zuimi amah ah a-om gige a, amah mah leng amah ah a-om gige hi. Huan Kha ahon piak ah amah eimau ah a-om gige chih i thei uhi.
english: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.

paite: Deihtakte aw, kha napeuh gingta kei un, himahleh khate Pathian a kipan ahi uhiam hilou chih chian un; khovel a zawlnei taklou tampi ana pawt tak ziak un.
english: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

paite: Hiai ah Pathian Kha na thei ding uh, bang kha peuh Jesu Khrist, sa in ahong pai chih gum tuh Pathian a kipan ahi.
english: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,

paite: Bang kha peuh Jesu gum lou Pathian a kipan ahi kei; huai tuh Khrist doumi kha, hong pai ding na zak uh ahi; tu in khovel ah a-om khinta hi.
english: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.

paite: Naute aw, Pathian a kipan na hi ua, tuate na zouta uhi; noumau a om khovel a om sang a athupi zawk ziak in.
english: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.

paite: Amau khovel a ahi ua; huaiziak in khovel a bang in apau ua, khovel in athu uh angaikhia hi.
english: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.

paite: Eite Pathian a kipan i hi ua, Pathian thei mite'n i thu angaikhe zel uhi; Pathian a kipan lou mite'n bel i thu angaikhe kei uhi. Hiai ah thutak Kha leh thutak lou kha i thei uhi.
english: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

paite: Deihtakte aw, i ki-ittuah chiat ding uh; itna zaw Pathian a suak ahi ngal a, michih itna nei peuhmah Pathian a suak ahi khin ua, Pathian athei lai uhi.
english: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

paite: Itna nei lou in Pathian athei kei; Pathian itna ahih ziak in.
english: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

paite: Hiai ah Pathian itna i tung uah ahong langta hi, amah ziak a i hintheihna ding a Pathian in a Tapa neihsun khovel a ahon sawlna ah.
english: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.

paite: Hiai ah itna a-om, eite'n Pathian i it uh ka chi ahi kei, ama'n ahon it a, i khelhnate thuphatawina ding in, a Tapa ahon sawl ka chi zaw hi.
english: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

paite: Deihtakte aw, Pathian in huchi tel a ahon itleh eite leng i ki-ittuah chiat ding uh ahi.
english: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

paite: Kuamah in chik lai mah in Pathian amu ngei kei hi. I ki-ittuah chiat uleh ei ah Pathian a-om gige dia, a-itna leng eite sung ah akim lai ding hi.
english: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

paite: Amah ah i om gige chih leh amah eite sung ah a-om gige chih Kha a hon piak tak ziak in hiai ah i thei hi.
english: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.

paite: Huan Pa in Tapa khovel Hondampa hihna nei in ahon sawl chih i muta ua, i theisak uhi.
english: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.

paite: Kuapeuh Jesu Pathian Tapa ahi chi a gum amah ah Pathian a-om gige a, amah leng Pathian ah a-om gige hi.
english: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.

paite: Pathian in eite a ding in itna anei chih i theita ua, i gingta lai uhi. Pathian itna ahi; itna a om gige mi Pathian ah a-om a, Pathian leng amah ah a-om hi.
english: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.

paite: Hiai ah i tung uah itna akimta, vaihawm ni a ding a lau lou a i omtheihna ah; amah om bang a khovel a i om ziak in.
english: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.

paite: Itna ah launa a-om kei, itna kim in lauhna adelhkhe zaw zel hi, lauhna in gawtna ahon ngaihtuahsak; alaumi peuhmah itna ah abukim nai kei hi.
english: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

paite: Ama'n ahon it masak ziak in i it uhi.
english: We love him, because he first loved us.

paite: Mi'n, "Pathian ka it," chi in a-unau ho taleh amah zuauthei ahi; a-unau amuhsa bawn a-it kei in, Pathian amuh ngei louhpi bangchi in a-it thei dia?
english: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?

paite: Amah kiang a kipan in hiai thupiak i nei uhi, kuapeuh in Pathian a-itleh a-unau leng a-it sam ding chihna ahi.
english: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.

paite: Kuapeuh Jesu, Khrist ahi chih gingta Pathian suahsak ahi; kuapeuh asuaksakpa it in asuahsak leng a-it nak hi.
english: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.

paite: Hiai ah Pathian tate i itna ah Pathian i it a, athupiakte i zui chih i thei uhi.
english: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.

paite: Pathian i itna hiai ahi, athupiakte i zuihna; athupiakte lah ahaksa ngal kei hi.
english: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.

paite: Pathian suahsak peuh in khovel azou zel hi; hiai ahi khovel tung a vualzohna, i ginna uh.
english: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.

paite: Jesu, Pathian Tapa ahi chih gingtami kia ngal lou, kua'n khovel azou zel a?
english: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

paite: Hiai ahi tui leh sisan a hong paipa, Jesu Khrist; tui kia ah hilou in, tui ah leh sisan ah ahi zaw. Theisakpa tuh Kha ahi, Kha thutak ahih ziak in.
english: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

paite: Van tung ah theihpih thum a-om, Pa, Thu leh Kha Siangthou ahi ua, amaute khat ahi uhi.
english: For there are three who testify:

paite: Leitung ah theihpih thum a-om, Kha leh tui leh sisan; huai thumte akithutuak uhi.
english: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.

paite: Mihing theihpihna bawn i sanleh Pathian theihpihna athupizaw hi. Pathian theihpihna tuh a Tapa tanchin atheipihta chih ahi.
english: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.

paite: Pathian Tapa gingtami in amah ah theihna anei a, Pathian gingtaloumi in amah zuauthei in abawl hi; Pathian in a Tapa tanchin atheihpih agintak louh ziak in.
english: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.

paite: Theihpihna hiai ahi, Pathian in tangtawn hinna ahon pia a, huai hinna a Tapa ah a-om hi.
english: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

paite: Kuapeuh Tapa nei in hinna anei; kuapeuh Pathian Tapa nei lou in hinna anei kei hi.
english: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.

paite: Tangtawn hinna na nei uh chih na theihna ding un, nou Pathian Tapa min gingtate kiang ah hiai thu ka gelh ahi.
english: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.

paite: Hiai pen amah tung a i hangsanna ahi, bangpeuh ama deihlam bang a i ngetleh ama'n ahon ngaihkhiaksak hi.
english: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

paite: Huchi in bangpeuh i nget ahon ngaihkhiaksak chih i theihleh akiang a i thilnget i muta chih i thei hi.
english: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

paite: Kuapeuh in a-unau sihna khop hilou khelhna hih in muleh angetsak ding, huchi in Pathian in an genmi kiang ah sihna tun hilou khelhna hihte a ding in hinna ape ding hi. Sihna tun khelhna a-om a; huchibang lam ah angetsak ding ka chi ahi kei hi.
english: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.

paite: Diktatlouhna tengteng khelhna ahi; sihna khop hilou khelhna leng a-om sam hi.
english: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.

paite: Kuapeuh Pathian suahsak in thil ahihkhial kei chih i thei hi; Pathian Tapa neihsun in amah akem gige a, giloupa'n khoih leng akhoih thei kei hi.
english: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.

paite: Huan eite Pathian a kipan i hi chih i thei ua, khovel pumpi bel giloupa thuthu in a-om chih i thei hi.
english: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.

paite: Huan Pathian Tapa ahong pai a, adikpa i theihna ding in theihtheihna ahon pia chih i thei behlap uhi; eite a Tapa Jesu Khrist a i om in adikpa ah i om uhi. Amah tuh Pathian diktak leh tangtawn hinna ahi.
english: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.

paite: Naute aw, milim lak ah kihemkhia un, Amen.
english: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.

paite: David hong upa in, ahong tek mahmahta hi. Huchi in puan in akhuh zel ua, himahleh lum asa thei tuan kei hi.
english: Now King David was old and advanced in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he couldn’t keep warm.

paite: Asikhate'n akiang ah, "Ka toupa kumpipa a ding in nungak zong le ungla; kumpipa kiangchin ah om gige henla, kemleh; na angsung ah hong lumleh, ka toupa kumpipa'n lum ahon sa thei ding," achi uhi.
english: Therefore his servants said to him, “Let a young virgin be sought for my lord the king. Let her stand before the king, and cherish him; and let her lie in your bosom, that my lord the king may keep warm.”

paite: Huchi in Israel gam tengteng ah nungak melhoih azong ua, Shunam mi Abishag ava mu ua, kumpipa kiang ah api uhi.
english: So they sought for a beautiful young lady throughout all the borders of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

paite: Huai nungak amel ahoih mahmah a, kumpipa akem a, anek-tak abawlsak hi. Himahleh, kumpipa'n amah akithuahpih kei hi.
english: The young lady was very beautiful; and she cherished the king, and served him; but the king didn’t know her intimately.

paite: Haggith tapa Adonijah in, "Kei kumpipa a pang ding ka hi ve," chi in akingai thupi mahmah hi. Kangtalai leh sakol tungtuangmi sawmnga ama a tai dingte toh akisasak hi.
english: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, “I will be king.” Then he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

paite: Apa'n lah chik lai in leng, "Bangziak a hichibang a hih na hia?" chi in alungkhamsak ngei kei hi. Amah melhoih mahmah a, Absalom sangpa ahi.
english: His father had not displeased him at any time in saying, “Why have you done so?” and he was also a very handsome man; and he was born after Absalom.

paite: Ama'n Zeruiah tapa Joab leh siampu Abiathar thu adong a; amau Adonijah lam ah apang ua, amah apanpih uhi.
english: He conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest; and they followed Adonijah and helped him.

paite: Siampu Zadok, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, zawlnei Nathan, Shimei, Rei leh David pawl a mihangsante bel Adonijah lam ah apang kei uhi.
english: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and the mighty men who belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.

paite: Adonijah in belamte, bawngtalte, ganta vak thaute Zoheleth' Suang ah agou a, huai tuh En-rogel kiangchin a om ahi. Kumpipa tapate, a-unau tengteng leh Judah gam a kumpipa sikha tengteng achial hi.
english: Adonijah killed sheep, cattle, and fatlings by the stone of Zoheleth, which is beside En Rogel; and he called all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah, the king’s servants;

paite: Zawlnei Nathan, Benaiah, mihangsante leh a-unaupa Solomon bel achial kei hi.
english: but he didn’t call Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother.

paite: Nathan in Solomon nu Bathsheba kiang ah, "Haggith tapa Adonijah, i toupa David theih louh in vaihawm in a-om chih za lou na hi maw?
english: Then Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, “Haven’t you heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith reigns, and David our lord doesn’t know it?

paite: Na bitna ding leh na tapa Solomon bitna ding ka hon hilh ding.
english: Now therefore come, please let me give you counsel, that you may save your own life and your son Solomon’s life.

paite: Kumpipa David kiang ah va lut inla, akiang ah, Aw toupa, ka kumpipa, na sikhanu kiang ah na tapa Solomon, ka nung in ahong lal ngeingei dia, amah ka laltutphah ah atu ding, chi in na kichiam ahi kei maw? Bang achia Adonijah in vaihawm ahia?" va chi dih achi hi.
english: Go in to King David, and tell him, ‘Didn’t you, my lord the king, swear to your servant, saying, “Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne”? Why then does Adonijah reign?’

paite: "Ngai in, kumpipa na va houpih laitak in ke'n leng ka hon zui lut sam dia, na thugen ka hon hihkippih ding," chi in agen hi.
english: Behold, while you are still talking there with the king, I will also come in after you and confirm your words.”

paite: Bathsheba kumpipa kiang ah indan ah ava lut a; kumpipa a-upa mahmahta a, Shunam mi Abishag in kumpipa nek-tak a na bawl hi.
english: Bathsheba went in to the king in his room. The king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite was serving the king.

paite: Bathsheba in kumpipa kun in zahtakna apia hi. Kumpipa'n, "Bang na deih a?" ana chi hi.
english: Bathsheba bowed and showed respect to the king. The king said, “What would you like?”

paite: Ama'n, "Ka toupa aw, TOUPA na Pathian min lou in na sikhanu kiang ah, na tapa Solomon ka nung in ahong lal ngeingei ding a, amah ka laltutphah ah ahong tu ding, chi in na kichiam khinta hi.
english: She said to him, “My lord, you swore by Yahweh your God to your servant, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne.’

paite: Ngai in, tu in Adonijah lah alal a; nang ka kumpipa toupa'n lah na thei kei hi.
english: Now, behold, Adonijah reigns; and you, my lord the king, don’t know it.

paite: Bawngtalte, ganta vak thaute leh belamte agou zengzung a, kumpipa tapa tengteng leh siampu Abiathar leh sepaih heutu Joab achial a, na sikha Solomon achial kei hi.
english: He has slain cattle and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and has called all the sons of the king, Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the army; but he hasn’t called Solomon your servant.

paite: Huchi in toupa aw, ka toupa nung a alaltutphah a kua hong tu ding ahia chih na gen ding in, Israelte tengteng mit nang ka toupa kumpipa tung ah atu hi.
english: You, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, that you should tell them who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

paite: Huchi lou in zaw hichi ahi ding a, toupa kumpipa apute kiang a a-ihmut sam hun chiang in, kei leh ka tapa Solomon thil hihkhial in ahon sep mai ding uh,” achi hi.
english: Otherwise it will happen, when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon will be considered criminals.”

paite: Ngai in, huchi a kumpipa ahoupih laitak in, zawlnei Nathan ava lut sam hi.
english: Behold, while she was still talking with the king, Nathan the prophet came in.

paite: "En dih, zawlnei Nathan ahong," chi in kumpipa ahilh uh. Kumpipa kiang ava tun in, kumpipa ma ah amai a lei si in abokkhup hi.
english: They told the king, saying, “Behold, Nathan the prophet!” When he had come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

paite: Nathan in, "Ka toupa, kumpipa aw, ka nung ah Adonijah alal dia, ka laltutphah ah atu ding na chi maw?
english: Nathan said, “My lord, King, have you said, ‘Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne’?

paite: Tuni in akuansuk a, bawngtalte, ganta vak thaute leh belamte agou zengzung a, kumpipa tapa tengteng, sepaih heutute leh siampu Abiathar achial hi. Ngai in, ane un adawnkhawm ua, Pathian in kumpipa Adonijah hondam hen, achi uh.
english: For he has gone down today, and has slain cattle, fatlings, and sheep in abundance, and has called all the king’s sons, the captains of the army, and Abiathar the priest. Behold, they are eating and drinking before him, and saying, ‘Long live King Adonijah!’

paite: Himahleh kei na sikha ngei leh siampu Zadok, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah leh na sikha Solomon ahon chial kei hi.
english: But he hasn’t called me, even me your servant, Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon.

paite: Hiai toupa ka kumpipa thu a hih ahih ngalleh toupa ka kumpipa'n anung a laltutphah a tu dingpa akua pen ahia chih na sikhate na hilh nai lou na hi ding maw?" achi hi.
english: Was this thing done by my lord the king, and you haven’t shown to your servants who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?”

paite: Kumpipa David in adawng a, "Bathsheba hon sapsak dihua," achi hi. Kumpipa kiang ah ava hoh a, kumpipa ma ah ava dingh hi.
english: Then King David answered, “Call Bathsheba in to me.” She came into the king’s presence and stood before the king.

paite: Kumpipa akichiam a, "Lungzinna tengteng a ka hinna humbitpa TOUPA ahin bang in,
english: The king vowed and said, “As Yahweh lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

paite: na kiang a TOUPA Israelte' Pathian min lou a, na tapa Solomon ka nung in ahong lal ngeingei ding. Ka sik in ka laltutphah ah ahong tu ding, chi a ka kichiam bang in, tuni in ka hih ding,” achi hi.
english: most certainly as I swore to you by Yahweh, the God of Israel, saying, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne in my place;’ I will most certainly do this today.”

paite: Bathsheba amai a lei si in abokkhup a, kumpipa zahtakna pia in, "Ka toupa, kumpipa David tangtawn in dam zel hen,” achi hi.
english: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth and showed respect to the king, and said, “Let my lord King David live forever!”

paite: Kumpipa David in, "Siampu Zadok leh zawlnei Nathan, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah hon va sapsak dih ua," achi hi. Amau kumpipa ma ah ava pai uhi.
english: King David said, “Call to me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada.” They came before the king.

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang uah, "Na toupa uh sikhate pi unla, ka tapa Solomon keimah sabiltung mahmah ah tuangsak unla, Gihon ah pisuk un.
english: The king said to them, “Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride on my own mule, and bring him down to Gihon.

paite: Siampu Zadok leh zawlnei Nathan in Israelte kumpipa ding in thau nilh uhen. Pengkul mut unla, Pathian in kumpipa Solomon hondam hen, chi un.
english: Let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel. Blow the trumpet, and say, ‘Long live King Solomon!’

paite: Huchi in amah na zuitou ding ua, ka laltutphah ah ahong tu ding hi; amah lah ka sik a lal ding ahi ngal a. Amah Israel gam leh Judah gam vaihawmtu dia ka seh ahi,” achi hi.
english: Then come up after him, and he shall come and sit on my throne; for he shall be king in my place. I have appointed him to be prince over Israel and over Judah.”

paite: Jehoiada tapa Benaiah in kumpipa adawng a, "Amen, TOUPA, ka toupa kumpipa Pathian in leng pha sa hen.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, “Amen. May Yahweh, the God of my lord the king, say so.

paite: TOUPA ka toupa kumpipa kiang a a-om bang in, Solomon kiang ah leng om sam henla, ka toupa kumpipa David laltutphah sang in alaltutphah hih thupizaw hen," achi hi.
english: As Yahweh has been with my lord the king, even so may he be with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord King David.”

paite: Huchi in siampu Zadok, zawlnei Nathan, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, Kereth mite leh Pelet mite ahohsuk ua, David sabiltung tung ah Solomon atuangsak ua, Gihon ah api uhi.
english: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on King David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.

paite: Siampu Zadok in puanin a pan thau koihna ala a, Solomon anilh hi. Pengkul amut ua, huchi in mi tengteng in, "Pathian in kumpipa Solomon hondam hen," achi uhi.
english: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the Tent, and anointed Solomon. They blew the trumpet; and all the people said, “Long live King Solomon!”

paite: Mi tengteng in amah azuitou ua, mite'n tamngaite atum ua, akipak mahmah ua, ahusa ging un lei akheng hi.
english: All the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth shook with their sound.

paite: Adonijah leh amichial, akiang a om tengteng in ankuang alui khit un aza ua, Joab in pengkul mutging azak in, "Khopi sung a husa ging zuazua bangchidan ahia le?" achi hi.
english: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they had finished eating. When Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, “Why is this noise of the city being in an uproar?”

paite: Huai achih laitak in, ngai in, siampu Abiathar tapa Jonathan ava hoh a, Adonijah in, "Hong pai dih ve, nang zaw mikizen na hi a, tanchinhoih na hon tun mahmah ding," ana chi hi.
english: While he yet spoke, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said, “Come in; for you are a worthy man, and bring good news.”

paite: Jonathan in adawng a, Adonijah kiang ah, "Tun ke'ng e, toupa aw, kumpipa David in Solomon kumpipa in abawl khinta hi.
english: Jonathan answered Adonijah, “Most certainly our lord King David has made Solomon king.

paite: Amah toh siampu Zadok, zawlnei Nathan, Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, Kereth mite leh Pelet mite kumpipa'n asawl a, kumpipa sabiltung tung ah atuangsak uhi.
english: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and they have caused him to ride on the king’s mule.

paite: Siampu Zadok leh zawlnei Nathan in Gihon ah kumpipa ding in thau anilh uh. Huai a pan nuamsatak in apaitou ua, huai in khopi sung athawn zuazua hi. Husa na zak uh huai ahi,” achi hi.
english: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon. They have come up from there rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that you have heard.

paite: Huchi in Solomon leng lalgam tutphah ah atuta hi.
english: Also, Solomon sits on the throne of the kingdom.

paite: Kumpipa sikhate i toupa kumpipa David vualzawl ding in ahong ua, "Pathian in na min sang in Solomon min hihhoih zaw henla, na laltutphah sang in ama laltutphah hih thupizaw hen,” ahong chi uh. Huchi in kumpipa lupna tung ah akun hi.
english: Moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make the name of Solomon better than your name, and make his throne greater than your throne;’ and the king bowed himself on the bed.

paite: Kumpipa'n leng, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian, tuni mahmah a ka laltutphah a tu ding hon pepa phat in om hen. Ka mit mahmah in amuta,” achi hi.
english: Also thus said the king, ‘Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, who has given one to sit on my throne today, my eyes even seeing it.’”

paite: Adonijah michial tengteng in alauta ua, athou ua, alampi chiat uah apaivekta uhi.
english: All the guests of Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and each man went his way.

paite: Adonijah in Solomon alau a, athou a, maitam kii ava len hi.
english: Adonijah was afraid because of Solomon; and he arose, and went, and hung onto the horns of the altar.

paite: "Ngai in, Adonijah in kumpipa Solomon alau a; kumpipa Solomon in asikha namsau a that lou ding in ka kiang ah kichiam phot hen," chi in maitam kii alen hi chi in Solomon ahilh uhi.
english: Solomon was told, “Behold, Adonijah fears King Solomon; for, behold, he is hanging onto the horns of the altar, saying, ‘Let King Solomon swear to me first that he will not kill his servant with the sword.’”

paite: Solomon in, "Miginomtak ahih asuklat peuhmahleh asamzang khat leng lei ah ake kei ding. Gitlouhna anei chih theihna a-omleh bel asi ding," achi hi.
english: Solomon said, “If he shows himself a worthy man, not a hair of his shall fall to the earth; but if wickedness is found in him, he shall die.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Solomon in mi asawl a, maitam a pan ava pisuk ua, amah ava hoh a, kumpipa Solomon ma ah akun hi. Solomon in akiang ah, "Na inn ah pai in," ana chi hi.
english: So King Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. He came and bowed down to King Solomon; and Solomon said to him, “Go to your house.”

paite: Huan TOUPA min a athilhih tungtang thu a Solomon minthandan Sheba kumpinu'n ana zak in thuhaksa pipi toh amah ettel tum in akiang ah ahoh hi.
english: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning Yahweh’s name, she came to test him with hard questions.

paite: Jerusalem ah nungzui mi tampi toh, gimlimte leh dangka-eng tampi leh suangmantamte pua sangawngsaute tonpih in ahoh hi. Solomon kiang atun in alungtang a thu a pai tengteng suahkhe vek in ahoupih hi.
english: She came to Jerusalem with a very great caravan, with camels that bore spices, very much gold, and precious stones; and when she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.

paite: Solomon in athudot tengteng adawng vek a; kumpipa theih louh, ahilhchet theih louh himhim a-om kei hi.
english: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from the king which he didn’t tell her.

paite: Sheba kumpinu'n Solomon pildan tengteng, a-inn lam,
english: When the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,

paite: adohkan a nek ding, asikhate tutdan, anasemte nasepdan, akivatdante uh, anou pe mite, TOUPA' inn a lat halmang thillatte amuh in lungsim chih leng nei zou lou khop in lamdang asa hi.
english: the food of his table, the sitting of his servants, the attendance of his officials, their clothing, his cup bearers, and his ascent by which he went up to Yahweh’s house, there was no more spirit in her.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa kiang ah, "Na thilhihte leh na pildante ka gam a ka zak thuthang adik mah ana hi.
english: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.

paite: Himahleh keimah mit mahmah a ka hong muh masiah agen uh ka taksang kei hi. Huchi in ngai in, akimkhat leng ahon na hilh sam ua, agen uh ka zak sang in na pildan leh na hoihdan ana thupizaw hi.
english: However, I didn’t believe the words until I came and my eyes had seen it. Behold, not even half was told me! Your wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame which I heard.

paite: Na mite, hiai na sikha, na kiang a om gige na pilna thu ngaikhe gigete ahampha uhi!
english: Happy are your men, happy are these your servants who stand continually before you, who hear your wisdom.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian, na tung a kipak mahmah, Israelte laltutphah a hon tusakpa phat in om hen. TOUPA'N Israelte tangtawn in a-it a, huaiziak in, diktattak a vaihawm ding in kumpipa in ahon bawl hi," achi hi.
english: Blessed is Yahweh your God, who delighted in you, to set you on the throne of Israel. Because Yahweh loved Israel forever, therefore he made you king, to do justice and righteousness.”

paite: Huchi in dangka-eng talent za-le-sawmnih leh gimlim atam a tam leh suangmantamte kumpipa apia a, Sheba kumpinu'n kumpipa Solomon gimlim apiak bang lawmlawm a tam alut ngei kei hi.
english: She gave the king one hundred twenty talents of gold, and a very great quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never again was there such an abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

paite: Hiram longhon, Ophir a pan dangka-eng va pote'n leng Ophir a pan almug sing tampi leh suangmantamte ahon pua uhi.
english: The fleet of Hiram that brought gold from Ophir also brought in from Ophir great quantities of almug trees and precious stones.

paite: Kumpipa'n almug singte TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn umna ding in leh lasa mite kaihging leh pekging bawlna ding in azang hi. Tuni tan in hichibang almug sing himhim alut in, muh leng muh ahi nawnta kei hi.
english: The king made of the almug trees pillars for Yahweh’s house and for the king’s house, harps also and stringed instruments for the singers; no such almug trees came or were seen to this day.

paite: Anget louh Solomon in apiakte chih louh leng kumpipa Solomon in Sheba kumpinu'n adeih tengteng, anget peuhmah apia hi. Huchi in amah leh lawite a-omna gam ah apai nawnta uhi.
english: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, in addition to that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.

paite: Solomon kiang a kum khat sung a dangka-eng lut gikdan dangka-eng talent zaguk sawmguk-le-guk ahi.
english: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

paite: Hiaite lou leng sumsin mite leh thilzuak mite, Arab kumpipate leh gamsung vaihawmte a pan siahpiakte anei lai hi.
english: in addition to that which the traders brought, and the traffic of the merchants, and of all the kings of the mixed people, and of the governors of the country.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon in dangka-eng sekpek in lum lian zanih abawl a; lum khat ah dangka-eng shekel zaguk alut hi.
english: King Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred shekels of gold went to one buckler.

paite: Dangka-eng sekpek in lum zathum abawl a; lum khat ah dangka-eng mina thum alut a; huaite kumpipa'n Lebanon gammang inn ah akoih hi.
english: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three minas of gold went to one shield; and the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

paite: Kumpipa'n saiha laltutphah thupi mahmah abawl a, huai dangka-eng hoihpen tui in aluan hi.
english: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the finest gold.

paite: Laltutphah kaltouhna ah siksan guk a-om a, laltutphah nunglam dawn abem hi. Atutna sik tuak ah douna a-om tuaktuak a; adouna zulte ah humpinelkai dingh lim nih a-om hi.
english: There were six steps to the throne, and the top of the throne was round behind; and there were armrests on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests.

paite: Siksan gukte sik tuak ah humpinelkai dingh sawm-le-nih lim a-om a; huchibang koi gam mah ah leng abawl ngei kei uhi.
english: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. Nothing like it was made in any kingdom.

paite: Kumpipa nou tengteng dangka-eng ahi vek a, Lebanon gammang inn a, atui-um belsuan tengteng leng dangka-eng ngen mah ahi vek uhi. Dangka himhim a-om kei. Solomon dam lai in huai bangpi in asim kei uh.
english: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. None were of silver, because it was considered of little value in the days of Solomon.

paite: Kumpipa'n tuipi ah Hiram longhon kithuahpih Tarshish longhon anei a; Tarshish longhon in kum thum hal zel in dangka-eng, dangka, saiha, zawng leh utong ahon po zel uhi.
english: For the king had a fleet of ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram’s fleet. Once every three years the fleet of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Solomon in leitung a kumpipa tengteng hauh lam leh pil lam in akhup vek hi.
english: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and in wisdom.

paite: Pathian in alungtang a pilna thu akoihsak ngaikhe ding in leitung a mi tengteng in Solomon ahong zuan huthut zel uhi.
english: All the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom which God had put in his heart.

paite: Michih in thilpiakte kum teng a piak zah nei in dangka tui-um belsuan dangka-eng tui-um belsuan puan, galvan, gimlim, sakol leh sabiltungnoute ahong pe zel uhi.
english: Year after year, every man brought his tribute, vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules.

paite: Solomon in kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite akaikhawm a, kangtalai sangkhat-le-zali leh sakol tungtuangmi singkhat-le-sangnih anei hi. Huaite kangtalai koihnate ah, Jerusalem a kumpipa omna ah a-omsak hi.
english: Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen. He kept them in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.

paite: Kumpipa'n Jerusalem ah atam mahmah ziak in dangka chite suang bang mai a sehkhop in a-omsak a, sidar singte phai a theipi sing bang lel a sehkhop in a-omsak hi.
english: The king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem, and cedars as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

paite: Solomon neih sakolte Aigupta gam a pan ahon tolhkhiak ahi a; kumpipa sumsin mite'n huaite ahonhon in ana khak zel ua, ahon a lei zel ahi.
english: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt. The king’s merchants received them in droves, each drove at a price.

paite: Aigupta gam a kangtalai dangka chi shekel zaguk zel in leh sakol dangka chi shekel za-le-sawmnga zel in ahon polut uhi. Huchibang mah in Hitte kumpipa tengteng leh Siria kumpipate a ding in leng apokhia uhi.
english: A chariot was imported from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for one hundred fifty shekels; and so they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Syria.

paite: Himahleh Solomon in Pharaoh tanu ban ah namdang numei tampi a-it hi. Amau Moabte, Ammonte, Edomte, Zidonte leh Hitte ahi uh.
english: Now King Solomon loved many foreign women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh: women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites,

paite: Huai namte tungtang thu TOUPA'N Israel suante kiang ah, "Amau toh na kitentuah het louh ding uh ahi. Na kitentuah uleh apathiante uh lam a na lungtang uh hon ngasak ngeingei ding uh ahi," chi a na hilh khit tak namte ahi uh. Hinapi in Solomon in amau it in alen tinten hi.
english: of the nations concerning which Yahweh said to the children of Israel, “You shall not go among them, neither shall they come among you, for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods.” Solomon joined to these in love.

paite: Huchi in zipi zasagih, kumpipa tanute anei a, mei zathum anei hi. Huai azite'n alungtang apikawisak uhi.
english: He had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines. His wives turned his heart away.

paite: Hichi ahong hi a, Solomon ahong upat nung in, azite'n pathian dangte lam ah alungtang apikawisak uhi. Huchi in apa David lungtang bang in TOUPA a Pathian lam ah alungtang ahoihkimta kei hi.
english: When Solomon was old, his wives turned away his heart after other gods; and his heart was not perfect with Yahweh his God, as the heart of David his father was.

paite: Solomon in Zidonte pathiannu Ashtaroth leh Ammonte pathian kihhuai mahmah Milkom azuita hi.
english: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

paite: Huchi in Solomon in TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahihta a, apa David bang in TOUPA azui tettet kei hi.
english: Solomon did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and didn’t go fully after Yahweh, as David his father did.

paite: Huchi in Solomon in Jerusalem chin a mual ah Moabte pathian kihhuai mahmah Khemosh a ding leh Ammon suante Pathian kihhuai mahmah Molek a ding in mun sang abawlta hi.
english: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, on the mountain that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech the abomination of the children of Ammon.

paite: Huai mah bang in namdang azi tengteng apathiante uh kiang a kithoih a gimlim hal zelte a ding leng abawlsak hi.
english: So he did for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA Israelte' Pathian, akiang a nihvei kilak khinsa alungtang in alehngatsan ziak in, Solomon tung ah TOUPA ahehta hi.
english: Yahweh was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned away from Yahweh, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice,

paite: Hiai thu, pathian dangte na zui ding ahi kei, chih thu a na pepa TOUPA thupiak lah azui kei hi.
english: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods; but he didn’t keep that which Yahweh commanded.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Solomon kiang ah, "Hichibang in na omta a, ka thukhun leh ka dan thusehte zuih dia thu ka hon piak lah na zuita kei hi. Gam ka hon sut ngeingei dia, na sikha ka pe ding.
english: Therefore Yahweh said to Solomon, “Because this is done by you, and you have not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded you, I will surely tear the kingdom from you, and will give it to your servant.

paite: Himahleh na pa David ziak in na damsung tel in zaw ka hih tadih kei ding. Himahleh na tapa khut a pan gam pen ka hon sut ding hi.
english: Nevertheless, I will not do it in your days, for David your father’s sake; but I will tear it out of your son’s hand.

paite: Gam tengteng ka hon sut vek kei dia; himahleh ka sikha David ziak leh ka tel Jerusalem ziak in nam khat na tapa ka pe ding," achi hi.
english: However, I will not tear away all the kingdom; but I will give one tribe to your son, for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.”

paite: TOUPA'N Solomon melma ding in Edom mi, Hadad adingkhesakta a; amah Edom gam kumpipa suan ahi.
english: Yahweh raised up an adversary to Solomon: Hadad the Edomite. He was one of the king’s offspring in Edom.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Edom gam a David a-om lai a, amithahte uh vui ding a asepaih heutu Joab ahohtouh a, Edom mi pasal peuhmah ava thah khit nung in,
english: For when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the army had gone up to bury the slain, and had struck every male in Edom

paite: Joab leh Israel mi tengteng kha guktak Edom gam a pasal tengteng ahihlup khit masiah om uhi.
english: (for Joab and all Israel remained there six months, until he had cut off every male in Edom),

paite: Hadad leh apa sikhate lak a Edom mi khenkhatte Aigupta gam ah atai ua; Hadad ahihleh naupang neu ahi lai hi.
english: Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt, when Hadad was still a little child.

paite: Midian gam a pan apawt ua, Paran ahong tung uh. Paran a pan mite api ua, Aigupta gam, Aigupta gam kumpipa Pharaoh kiang atungsuk ua; ama'n inn ana pia a, nek dingte ana ngaihtuahsak a, gam leng ana pia hi.
english: They arose out of Midian and came to Paran; and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave him a house, and appointed him food, and gave him land.

paite: Hadad tung ah Pharaoh mit atung mahmah a, huchi in ama zi sanggamnu, kumpinu Tahpenes sanggamnu azi ding in apia hi.
english: Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him as wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.

paite: Tahpenes sanggamnu in tapa Genubath aneihsak a, Tahpenes in Pharaoh inn ah anawinek tawpna abawlsak hi. Pharaoh inn ah Pharaoh tapate lak ah Genubath a-omta hi.
english: The sister of Tahpenes bore him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house; and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s house among the sons of Pharaoh.

paite: Hadad in Aigupta gam a pan David apute kiang ah a-ihmuta chih leh sepaih heutu Joab leng asita chih ana zak in, Hadad in Pharaoh kiang ah, "Ka gam ua ka paitheihna ding in hon pawtsak ve," achi hi.
english: When Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the army was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, “Let me depart, that I may go to my own country.”

paite: Huchi in Pharaoh in akiang ah, "Ka kiang a nå om in taksap bang na nei a? Ngai in, huchi a na gam ua pai nawn na tup maimah?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Bangmah nei lou e. Bang teng hileh hon paisak himhim in," achi hi.
english: Then Pharaoh said to him, “But what have you lacked with me, that behold, you seek to go to your own country?” He answered, “Nothing, however only let me depart.”

paite: Pathian in amelma ding in Eliadah tapa Rezon, atoupa Hadadezer, Zobah kumpipa a pan taimangsa leng adingsak nawn hi.
english: God raised up an adversary to him, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his lord, Hadadezer king of Zobah.

paite: David in Zobah a mite athah lai in ama'n akiang ah mite akaikhawm a, sepaih heutu in ana pang hi. Damaskas ah ahoh ua, huai ah ateng ua, Damaskas ah kumpipa in atuta hi.
english: He gathered men to himself, and became captain over a troop, when David killed them of Zobah. They went to Damascus and lived there, and reigned in Damascus.

paite: Hadad in buaina tut behlap in Solomon damsung teng Israelte melma ahi gige a; Israelte aho mahmah a, Siria gam tung ah vai ahawm hi.
english: He was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, in addition to the mischief of Hadad. He abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.

paite: Nebat tapa Jeroboam, Zered a Ephraim mi Solomon sikha mah, anu min Zeruah ahi a, meithai ahi, huai mi'n leng kumpipa tung ah akhut alik sam hi.
english: Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, also lifted up his hand against the king.

paite: Kumpipa tung a akhut ahon likna san hichibang ahi: Solomon in Millo abawl a, apa David khua asiatna lailai abawlhoih hi.
english: This was the reason why he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breach of his father David’s city.

paite: Jeroboam ahihleh mihat leh hangsan ahi a; huchi in Solomon in huai tangval mithanuamtak ahi chih atheih ziak in Joseph inkote nasep tengteng tung ah heutu in abawl hi.
english: The man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon saw that the young man was industrious, and he put him in charge of all the labor of the house of Joseph.

paite: Huai lai in hichi ahong hi a, Jerusalem a pan Jeroboam apawtkhiak lai in Shiloh mi zawlnei Ahijah in lampi ah ana mu a; Ahijah in puan thak asilh a; amau gel kia in gamlak ah a-om uhi.
english: At that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him on the way. Now Ahijah had clad himself with a new garment; and the two of them were alone in the field.

paite: Ahijah in apuan thak silh ala a, nen sawm-le-nih in abotkek hi.
english: Ahijah took the new garment that was on him, and tore it in twelve pieces.

paite: Jeroboam kiang ah, "Nen sawm la in," TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi, "Ngai in, Solomon khut a pan lalgam ka sut dia, nam sawm nang ka hon pe ding.
english: He said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon and will give ten tribes to you

paite: Himahleh ka sikha David ziak leh Israel nam tengteng lak a ka tel khopi, Jerusalem ziak in nam khat anei ding;
english: (but he shall have one tribe, for my servant David’s sake and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel),

paite: amau hon paisan a, Zidonte pathiannu Ashtaroth, Moabte pathian Kemosh leh Ammonte pathian Milkom abiak ziak un leh ka mitmuh a thil hoih hih ding leh ka sehte leh ka vaihawmte zui dia apa David bang a ka lampite azuih louh ziak in.
english: because they have forsaken me, and have worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon. They have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in my eyes, and to keep my statutes and my ordinances, as David his father did.

paite: "Gam pumpi in ahihleh ka sut kei dia; himahleh ka thupiakte leh ka dan thusehte zuipa, ka tel, ka sikha David ziak in adamsung in kumpipa in ka omsak lai ding.
english: “‘However, I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand, but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake whom I chose, who kept my commandments and my statutes,

paite: Himahleh atapa khut a pan in lalgam ka sutkhe dia, nang ka hon pe ding, nam sawmte tan in leng.
english: but I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand and will give it to you, even ten tribes.

paite: Ka sikha David in ka min omna ding a ka tel khopi Jerusalem a ka ma a vak aneih gige theihna ding in nam khat bel atapa ka pe ding hi.
english: I will give one tribe to his son, that David my servant may have a lamp always before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen for myself to put my name there.

paite: Nang ka hon sep ding a, na ut tengteng bang in vai na hawm dia, Israelte kumpipa na hi ding.
english: I will take you, and you shall reign according to all that your soul desires, and shall be king over Israel.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, thu ka hon piak peuhmah na pom a, ka lampite na zuih a, ka sikha David bang a ka dan thusehte leh ka thupiakte zui dia ka mitmuh a thil hoih na hihleh na kiang ah ka om dia, David a dia ka dinkipsak bang in inkuan kip ka hon dinkhiaksak dia, Israelte ka hon pe ding hi.
english: It shall be, if you will listen to all that I command you, and will walk in my ways, and do that which is right in my eyes, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did, that I will be with you, and will build you a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel to you.

paite: Huchi in David suan ka hihgim dia, himahleh tangtawn in zaw ahi kei ding," achi hi.
english: I will afflict the offspring of David for this, but not forever.’”

paite: Huaiziak in Solomon in Jeroboam thah atum a, Jeroboam a ding a, Aigupta gam ah, Aigupta gam kumpipa Shishak kiang ah atai a, Solomon sih matan Aigupta gam ah a-omta hi.
english: Therefore Solomon sought to kill Jeroboam, but Jeroboam arose and fled into Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

paite: Solomon tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng leh apilna Solomon thilhih gelhna bu ah atuang kei a hia?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, aren’t they written in the book of the acts of Solomon?

paite: Solomon in Israel tengteng tung a Jerusalem a vai ahawm sung kum sawmli ahi.
english: The time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.

paite: Huchi in Solomon apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, apa David khopi ah avui uh. Huchi in atapa Rehoboam asik in ahong lalta hi.
english: Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.

paite: Huan Rehoboam Shekem ah ahoh hi. Israel tengteng Shekem ah kumpipa a amah bawl ding in ahoh khinta uhi.
english: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam in huai thu ana zak in Kumpipa Solomon kiang a pan ataimangna Aigupta gam a om lai ahi a, Jeroboam ahihleh Aigupta gam a om ahi.
english: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was yet in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon, and Jeroboam lived in Egypt;

paite: Amah ava samsak ua, Jeroboam leh Israel kikaikhawm tengteng ahong ua, Rehoboam kiang ah,
english: and they sent and called him), Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came, and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

paite: "Na pa'n ka hakkol uh agiksak mahmah hi. Huaiziak in na pa hon zat gimna leh ahakkol giktak ka tung ua angak hon hihzangsak inla, huchi in nang nna ka sem ding uh," chi in ahong gen uhi.
english: “Your father made our yoke difficult. Now therefore make the hard service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Ni thum sung va kikhinkhe phot unla; ka kiang ah hong pai nawn un," achi hi. Huchi in mite apaikheta uh.
english: He said to them, “Depart for three days, then come back to me.” So the people departed.

paite: Kumpipa Rehoboam in apa Solomon dam lai a, akiang a om upate kiang ah, "Hiai mite bangchi in ka dawng dia hon hilh mah dih uh," chi in adong hi.
english: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me to answer these people?”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Tuni a hiai mite sikha a na om a, a-nna uh sem a, amau dawng a, akiang ua thuhoih na genleh, tangtawn in na sikha in a-om ding uh," achi uhi.
english: They replied, “If you will be a servant to this people today, and will serve them, and answer them with good words, then they will be your servants forever.”

paite: Himahleh upate hoihsak azui kei a, amah toh kivual tuailai akiang a omte adong zawta hi.
english: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.

paite: Akiang uah, "Hiai mite, ka kiang a, na pa'n ka tung ua hakkol angak hon hihzangsak in, chi a hong gen mite bangchi in ka dawng dia, hon hilh mah dih uh," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may answer these people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”

paite: Akhanvual tuailaite'n akiang ah, "Hiai mite, na pa'n ka hakkol uh agiksak thei mahmah a, nang hon hihzangsak dih ve, na kiang achi mite kiang ah, hichibang in chi inla, hichibang in akiang uah gen in.
english: The young men who had grown up with him said to him, “Tell these people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter to us’—tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.

paite: 'Ka pa kawng sang in ka khutme alianzaw. Ka pa'n hakkol giktak ahon na batsak a, ke'n na hakkol uh ka behlap lai ding hi. Ka pa'n zepna in ahon sawi a, ke'n aikam in ka hon sawi ding,' " achi hi.
english: Now my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”

paite: Huchi in Jeroboam leh mi tengteng kumpipa'n ni thum nung chiang in, "Ka kiang ah hong nawn un," chi a ahilh bang in, ani thum ni in Rehoboam kiang ah ava hoh uhi.
english: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”

paite: Kumpipa'n mite khauhtak in ana dawng a, upate hoihsak apompih kei hi.
english: The king answered the people roughly, and abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him,

paite: Tuailaite hoihsak bang in, "Ka pa'n na hakkol uh ana giksak a, ke'n na hakkol uh ka behlap lai dia, ka pa'n zepna in ahon na sawi a, ke'n ahihleh aikam in ka hon sawi ding," achi hi.
english: and spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n mite thu angaikheta kei; hiai bang a thil om TOUPA a pan lah ahi ngal a. TOUPA'N Shiloh mi Ahijah zang a Nebat tapa Jeroboam kiang a, athugen atungtun theihna ding ahi.
english: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was a thing brought about from Yahweh, that he might establish his word, which Yahweh spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

paite: Israel tengteng in kumpipa'n athugen uh apom kei chih atheih un, "David ah tantuan bang i nei ua? Jesse tapa ah gouluah ding i nei kei uh. Israelte aw, na puanin chiat uah pai un. David, na inkuan kingaihtuah in," chi in kumpipa adawng uh. Huchi in Israelte apuanin chiat uah apaita uhi.
english: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion have we in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse. To your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So Israel departed to their tents.

paite: Himahleh Judah khopite a teng Israel suante tung ah Rehoboam in vai ahawm hi.
english: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Rehoboam in phutluih nasemte heutu Adoram asawl hi. Israel tengteng in suang in ana deng ua, asita hi. Huaiziak in Jerusalem a tai ding in kumpipa Rehoboam kintak in akangtalai ah atuang hi,
english: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and all Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in tuni tan in David inkote tung ah Israelte ana hel uhi.
english: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israel tengteng in Jeroboam ahong kik nawn chih azak un, kikaihkhawmna a hoh ding in asamsak ua, Israelte tung ah kumpipa in abawl uhi. Judah nam chih louh David inkote zui kuamah a-om kei uh.
english: When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the congregation, and made him king over all Israel. There was no one who followed David’s house, except for the tribe of Judah only.

paite: Jerusalem atuntak in Rehoboam in Israel inkote dou a Solomon tapa Rehoboam lalgam la nawn ding in Judah inkuan tengteng leh Benjamin nam a pan mihangsan atelkhiak, nuaikhat-le-singgiat akaikhawm hi.
english: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.

paite: Himahleh Pathian mipa Shemaiah kiang ah Pathian thu ahong tung hi.
english: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

paite: Judah gam kumpipa Solomon tapa Rehoboam kiang ah leh Judah leh Benjamin inkuan tengteng kiang ah leh midang teng kiang ah,
