english: “Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people, saying,

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Va hohtou kei un. Israel suan na unaute va dou kei un. Na inn chiat uah pai nawn vek un. Hiai kei thilhih ahi, chi in gen in," achi hi. Huchi in TOUPA thu azui ua, TOUPA thu bang in akik nawn ua, apai nawn vekta uhi.
english: ‘Yahweh says, “You shall not go up or fight against your brothers, the children of Israel. Everyone return to his house; for this thing is from me.”’” So they listened to Yahweh’s word, and returned and went their way, according to Yahweh’s word.

paite: Huchi in Jeroboam in Ephraim tanggam ah Shekem khua asat a, huai ah ateng hi. Huai a pan apawtkhia a, Penuel khua asat hi.
english: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and lived in it; and he went out from there and built Penuel.

paite: Jeroboam in alungtang in, "Lalgam David inkote ahong hi nawn diam aw," achi hi.
english: Jeroboam said in his heart, “Now the kingdom will return to David’s house.

paite: "Hiai mite Jerusalem a TOUPA' inn a kithoihnate lan dia ahohtouh uleh alungtang un atoupa uh, Rehoboam, Judah gam kumpipa lam ah a-awn nawn mai ding. Huchi in kei ahon that ding ua, Judah gam kumpipa Rehoboam lam ah abelh nawn mai ding uh," achi hi.
english: If this people goes up to offer sacrifices in Yahweh’s house at Jerusalem, then the heart of this people will turn again to their lord, even to Rehoboam king of Judah; and they will kill me, and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.”

paite: Kumpipa'n mi adong a, dangka-eng in bawngnou lim nih abawl a; akiang uah, "Nou a ding in Jerusalem a hohtouh ahaksa lo tel hi. Aw, Israel en dih uh, Aigupta gam a pan nou hon pikhia na pathiante uh," achi hi.
english: So the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold; and he said to them, “It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Look and behold your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt!”

paite: Huchi in khat Bethel ah akoih a, khat pen Dan ah akoih hi.
english: He set the one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.

paite: Mipite lah hiai bawngnou lim khat be ding in Dan tanpha ava pai ziak un hiai khelhna ahong hita hi.
english: This thing became a sin, for the people went even as far as Dan to worship before the one there.

paite: Mun sang ah innte alam a, Levi suante hilou, miniampente lak a mi siampu in abawl hi.
english: He made houses of high places, and made priests from among all the people, who were not of the sons of Levi.

paite: Jeroboam in Judah gam a ankuanglui aneih mah bang un akha giatna, huai kha ani sawm-le-nga ni ankuanglui ni ding in asep hi. Maitam ah ahohtou a; Bethel ah abawngnou lim kiang ah akithoih hi. Mun sang abawlte ah siampute sep in Bethel ah akoih hi.
english: Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast that is in Judah, and he went up to the altar. He did so in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves that he had made, and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places that he had made.

paite: Ama'n adeih bang a, aseh kha mah, akha giatna, ani sawm-le-nga ni in Bethel a maitam abawl ah ahohtou hi. Israel suante a ding in ankuangluina asep a, maitam a gimlim hal ding in ahohtou hi.
english: He went up to the altar which he had made in Bethel on the fifteenth day in the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and he ordained a feast for the children of Israel, and went up to the altar to burn incense.

paite: Huan ngai in, TOUPA thu in Judah gam a pan Bethel ah Pathian mipa khat ahong hi. Maitam chin ah gimlim hal ding in Jeroboam ana ding hi.
english: Behold, a man of God came out of Judah by Yahweh’s word to Bethel; and Jeroboam was standing by the altar to burn incense.

paite: Ama'n TOUPA thu in maitam akikoukhum a, "Maitam aw, maitam, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Ngai in, David inkuan ah tapa, amin Josiah ahong piang dia, ama'n na tung a gimlim halna mun sang a siampute na tung ah alan dia, na tung ah mihing guhte ahal ding, " achi hi.
english: He cried against the altar by Yahweh’s word, and said, “Altar! Altar! Yahweh says: ‘Behold, a son will be born to David’s house, Josiah by name. On you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense on you, and they will burn men’s bones on you.’”

paite: Huai ni mah in chiamtehna apia hi. “Hiai TOUPA'N chiamtehna ding achih ahi. Ngai in, maitam ahong khangkham dia, atung a meivute ahong bo vek ding," achi hi.
english: He gave a sign the same day, saying, “This is the sign which Yahweh has spoken: Behold, the altar will be split apart, and the ashes that are on it will be poured out.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian mipa in Bethel a maitam akikoukhum thu kumpipa'n azak in, Jeroboam in, "Man un," chi in maitam a pan akhut in asawk hi. Mat tum a asawkna khut azawta a, akhut akaikik nawn theita kei hi.
english: When the king heard the saying of the man of God, which he cried against the altar in Bethel, Jeroboam put out his hand from the altar, saying, “Seize him!” His hand, which he put out against him, dried up, so that he could not draw it back again to himself.

paite: Pathian mipa in TOUPA thu chiamtehna dia agen bang in maitam leng akhangkham a, maitam a meivute leng abo vek uhi.
english: The altar was also split apart, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by Yahweh’s word.

paite: Kumpipa'n adawng a, Pathian mipa kiang ah, "Ka khut ahong dam nawn theihna ding in TOUPA na Pathian hehpihna ngen inla, hon thumsak in," achi hi. Pathian min TOUPA kiang ah angen a, kumpipa khut ahong dam nawn a, amalam a bangmah in ahong om nawnta hi.
english: The king answered the man of God, “Now intercede for the favor of Yahweh your God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored to me.” The man of God interceded with Yahweh, and the king’s hand was restored to him, and became as it was before.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n Pathian mipa kiang ah, "Ka inn ah kei toh i pai dia hong kihihhalh tadih inla, huchi in kipahman ka hon pe ding," achi hi.
english: The king said to the man of God, “Come home with me and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward.”

paite: Pathian mipa in kumpipa kiang ah, "Na inn kimkhat zah hon pe ding himah lechin leng na kiang ah ka hong pai tuan kei ding, hiai ah tanghou ne in tui himhim leng ka dawn sam kei ding.
english: The man of God said to the king, “Even if you gave me half of your house, I would not go in with you, neither would I eat bread nor drink water in this place;

paite: Tanghou va ne in tui himhim leng va dawn ke'nla, 'Na va hohna lampi ah leng kik nawn ke'n chi a TOUPA thu a sawl ka hi,' " achi hi.
english: for so was it commanded me by Yahweh’s word, saying, ‘You shall eat no bread, drink no water, and don’t return by the way that you came.’”

paite: Huchi in lampi dang ah apai a, Bethel a ahong kuanna lampi ah apaita kei hi.
english: So he went another way, and didn’t return by the way that he came to Bethel.

paite: Bethel ah zawlnei putek khat a-om hi. Atapate'n huai ni a Bethel a Pathian mipa thilhih tengteng ahilh vek uhi. Kumpipa kiang a athugente leng apa uh ahilh lai uhi.
english: Now an old prophet lived in Bethel, and one of his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel. They also told their father the words which he had spoken to the king.

paite: Apa un akiang uah, "Koi lampi atawn a?" achi hi. Atapate'n Judah gam a pan hong pai Pathian mipa pai nawnna lampi akawkmuh uhi.
english: Their father said to them, “Which way did he go?” Now his sons had seen which way the man of God went, who came from Judah.

paite: Huchi in atapate kiang ah, "Sabiltung hon bawlsak dih uh," achi hi. Sabiltung abawlsak ua; atung ah atuang hi.
english: He said to his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” So they saddled the donkey for him; and he rode on it.

paite: Pathian mipa adelhta a, tosaw sing nuai a tu in ava mu hi. Akiang ah, "Nang na hi maw Judah gam a pan hong pai Pathian mipa?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Hi e,” achi hi.
english: He went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak. He said to him, “Are you the man of God who came from Judah?” He said, “I am.”

paite: Huchi in ama'n akiang ah, "Ka inn ah kei toh hong pai inla; tanghou hong ne dih ve,” achi hi.
english: Then he said to him, “Come home with me and eat bread.”

paite: Ama'n, "Nang toh kik nawn thei ka hi kei, na kiang a hong thei leng ka hi sam kei. Hiai ah na kiang ah tanghou ne in tui himhim leng ka dawn sam kei ding.
english: He said, “I may not return with you, nor go in with you. I will not eat bread or drink water with you in this place.

paite: Tanghou va ne in tui himhim leng va dawn ke'nla, na va hohna lampi ah leng kik nawn ke'n, chi a TOUPA thu a hilh lah ka hi ngal a,” achi hi.
english: For it was said to me by Yahweh’s word, ‘You shall eat no bread or drink water there, and don’t turn again to go by the way that you came.’”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Kei leng nangmah bang a zawlnei ka hi. Angel in TOUPA thu in, tanghoute ne a tuite dawn ding in na inn ah pikik nawn in, chi in ahon houpih hi," achi hi. Himahleh akiang ah zuau agen hi.
english: He said to him, “I also am a prophet as you are; and an angel spoke to me by Yahweh’s word, saying, ‘Bring him back with you into your house, that he may eat bread and drink water.’” He lied to him.

paite: Huchi in akiang ah akik nawn a, a-inn ah tanghoute ne in tui adawnta hi.
english: So he went back with him, ate bread in his house, and drank water.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, dohkan a-um lai un, apikik nawnpa zawlnei kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: As they sat at the table, Yahweh’s word came to the prophet who brought him back;

paite: Huchi in Judah gam a pan hong pai Pathian mipa kiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "TOUPA thugen mang lou a, TOUPA na Pathian in thu ahon piak na zuih louh a,
english: and he cried out to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, “Yahweh says, ‘Because you have been disobedient to Yahweh’s word, and have not kept the commandment which Yahweh your God commanded you,

paite: hong kik nawn a, tanghou ne in tui leng dawn ke'n, ka chihna mun mahmah a tanghou ne a, tui na dawn ziak in na luang na pute han a koih ahi kei ding," chi in agenkheta hi.
english: but came back, and have eaten bread and drank water in the place of which he said to you, “Eat no bread, and drink no water,” your body will not come to the tomb of your fathers.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, tanghou ne a, tui adawn zoh in, zawlnei pikik nawnpa'n sabiltung abawlsak hi.
english: After he had eaten bread and after he drank, he saddled the donkey for the prophet whom he had brought back.

paite: Huchi in apaita a lamkal ah humpinelkai toh akituak ua, ana that hi. Aluang lampi ah akipai a, akiang ah sabiltung adingh a, humpinelkai leng siluang kiang ah adingh hi.
english: When he had gone, a lion met him by the way and killed him. His body was thrown on the path, and the donkey stood by it. The lion also stood by the body.

paite: Ngai in, mi ava pai ua, lampi a siluang kipai leh siluang kiang a humpinelkai dingh amu ua; zawlnei putek tenna khua ah ava gen uhi.
english: Behold, men passed by and saw the body thrown on the path, and the lion standing by the body; and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet lived.

paite: Lamkal a pan va pikik nawnpa zawlnei in huai thu ana zaktak in, "Pathian mi, TOUPA thugen mang nuamloupa ei ve. Huchi in ToUPA'N akiang a agen, athu bangbang a TOUPA'N humpinelkai kiang a pia a, na ham a, na keilum ahita ve," achi hi.
english: When the prophet who brought him back from the way heard of it, he said, “It is the man of God who was disobedient to Yahweh’s word. Therefore Yahweh has delivered him to the lion, which has mauled him and slain him, according to Yahweh’s word which he spoke to him.”

paite: Atapate kiang ah, "Sabiltung hon bawlsak dih uh," chi in agen a; abawlsak uhi.
english: He said to his sons, saying, “Saddle the donkey for me,” and they saddled it.

paite: Huchi in akuanta a, aluang lampi a kipai leh sabiltung leh humpinelkai a luang kiang a dingh ava mu hi. Humpinelkai in luang ana ne nai kei a, sabiltung leng ana ham kei hi.
english: He went and found his body thrown on the path, and the donkey and the lion standing by the body. The lion had not eaten the body nor mauled the donkey.

paite: Zawlnei in Pathian mipa luang adom a, sabiltung tung ah akoih a, akikpihta hi. Huchi in zawlnei putek tenna khua ah suun ding leh vui ding in alalut hi.
english: The prophet took up the body of the man of God, and laid it on the donkey, and brought it back. He came to the city of the old prophet to mourn, and to bury him.

paite: Aluang ama han ah asial a, "Ka unaupa khawk hi na mah e!" chi in asuun uhi.
english: He laid his body in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, “Alas, my brother!”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, avui khit nung in atapate kiang ah, "Ka sih chiang in Pathian mipa kivuina han ah hon vui sam un. Aguhte kiang ah ka guhte koih un.
english: After he had buried him, he spoke to his sons, saying, “When I am dead, bury me in the tomb in which the man of God is buried. Lay my bones beside his bones.

paite: Pathian thu a Bethel a maitam leh Samaria gam khopite a mun sangte inn tengteng akikoukhumna thu hong tung ngeingei ding ahi,” achi hi.
english: For the saying which he cried by Yahweh’s word against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, will surely happen.”

paite: Huai thil zoh in Jeroboam in a omdan diklou atawpsan tuan kei hi. Miniampente lak a mun sang siampu dia abawl siampute a-omtheihna ding un adeihdeih ahihtuam hi.
english: After this thing, Jeroboam didn’t turn from his evil way, but again made priests of the high places from among all the people. Whoever wanted to, he consecrated him, that there might be priests of the high places.

paite: Huai thil Jeroboam inkuan khelhna amau inn gamsaktu leh leitung maikaih a pan hihmangthangtu ahong hita hi.
english: This thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off and to destroy it from off the surface of the earth.

paite: Huai lai in Jeroboam tapa Abijah achina hi.
english: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam became sick.

paite: Jeroboam in azi kiang ah, "Thou inla, Jeroboam zi na hi chih ahon theihtheihlouhna ding un kihihlamdang inla, Shiloh ah va hoh dih; ngai in, huai ah zawlnei Ahijah, hiai mite tung a kumpipa dia ka hong om ding ka tungtang thu genpa a-om hi.
english: Jeroboam said to his wife, “Please get up and disguise yourself, so that you won’t be recognized as Jeroboam’s wife. Go to Shiloh. Behold, Ahijah the prophet is there, who said that I would be king over this people.

paite: Tanghou beu sawm leh tanghou pei lian lou leh khuaizu thawl khat tawi inla, akiang ah va hoh dih. Naupang omdan ding hon na hilh ding," achi hi.
english: Take with you ten loaves of bread, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will become of the child.”

paite: Jeroboam zi in huchibang in ahih a, athou a, Shiloh ah ahoh a, Ahijah inn ah ava hohta hi. Ahijah in khua amu thei nawn kei a; a-upat ziak in amit amialta hi.
english: Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose and went to Shiloh, and came to Ahijah’s house. Now Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were set by reason of his age.

paite: TOUPA'N Ahijah kiang ah, "Ngai in, Jeroboam zi atapa tungtang a thu dong ding in ahong, achi ana a, chi in hichibang in na hilh ding ahi. Huan hichi ahi ding a, ahong lut chiang in numei dang hileh kilawmtak in ahong kibawl ding,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Ahijah, “Behold, Jeroboam’s wife is coming to inquire of you concerning her son, for he is sick. Tell her such and such; for it will be, when she comes in, that she will pretend to be another woman.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Ahijah in ahong lut lai a akhesik ging ana zaktak in, "Nang Jeroboam zi hong lut dih ve. Bang achia ahia midang dan a na kibawl? Tanchin hoih loutak nang hon hilh dia sawl ka hi.
english: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet as she came in at the door, he said, “Come in, Jeroboam’s wife! Why do you pretend to be another? For I am sent to you with heavy news.

paite: Pai nawn inla, Jeroboam kiang ah, TOUPA'N, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: Mipite lak a pan ka hon tawisang a, ka mi Israelte tung ah heutu in ka hon bawl hi.
english: Go, tell Jeroboam, ‘Yahweh, the God of Israel, says: “Because I exalted you from among the people, and made you prince over my people Israel,

paite: David inkuante gam ka sut a, huai nang ka hon pia hi. Himahleh nang ka sikha David bang in na om kei. Ama'n zaw ka thupiakte azui a, ka mitmuh a thil hoih kia hih tum in alungtang tengteng in ahon zui hi.
english: and tore the kingdom away from David’s house, and gave it to you; and yet you have not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in my eyes,

paite: Himahleh nang bel na ma a mite tengteng sang in thil na hihkhial mahmah se a, na hon hehsakna ding in pathian dangte leh milim sunte na bawl a, na hon nungngatsanta hi.
english: but have done evil above all who were before you, and have gone and made for yourself other gods, molten images, to provoke me to anger, and have cast me behind your back,

paite: Huaiziak in ngai in, Jeroboam inkuan tung ah thil hoih lou ka tungsak dia, Jeroboam a pan ta pasal taphot Israel gam a mi nehden leh den louh leng ka hihmang dia, mi'n ek aphiatsiang sipsip bang in Jeroboam inkuan agam vek masiah ka phiatmang ding hi.
english: therefore, behold, I will bring evil on the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam everyone who urinates on a wall, he who is shut up and he who is left at large in Israel, and will utterly sweep away the house of Jeroboam, as a man sweeps away dung until it is all gone.

paite: Jeroboam inko lak a mi, khopi a si peuhmahte ui in ane dia; gam a si peuhmahte tung a leng vasate'n ane ding uh. Hiai TOUPA'N agen khinta hi.
english: The dogs will eat whoever belongs to Jeroboam who dies in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat whoever dies in the field, for Yahweh has spoken it.”’

paite: "Huchi in thou inla na inn ah pai nawn mai in, khopi sung na sik chiang in huai naupang asi ding hi.
english: Arise therefore, and go to your house. When your feet enter into the city, the child will die.

paite: Huchi in Israel tengteng in asuun ding ua, avui ding uh. Jeroboam inkote lak ah amah kia han akoih ahi ding hi. Jeroboam inko lak ah amah kia a TOUPA Israelte' Pathian lam a thil hoih omsun ahi.
english: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him; for he only of Jeroboam will come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward Yahweh, the God of Israel, in the house of Jeroboam.

paite: TOUPA'N amah a dia Israelte tung a kumpipa hi ding; Jeroboam inkuan hihmang ding mi khat atungkhe ding hi. Himahleh bang eita? Huai ni ding, tu mah ahi.
english: Moreover Yahweh will raise up a king for himself over Israel who will cut off the house of Jeroboam. This is the day! What? Even now.

paite: TOUPA'N lah tui a phaiphek lingling bang mai in Israelte ahon sat ling dia; huchi in TOUPA hehsak a Asherte uh abawl ziak un apute uh ana piaksa, hiai gam hoihtak a pan Israelte abotkhe siang vek dia, lui khen lam ah ahon hihzak vek ding hi.
english: For Yahweh will strike Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water; and he will root up Israel out of this good land which he gave to their fathers, and will scatter them beyond the River, because they have made their Asherah poles, provoking Yahweh to anger.

paite: Israelte thil hihkhialsak a, ahih Jeroboam khelhnate ziak in Israelte alehngatsan ding,” achi hi.
english: He will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he has sinned, and with which he has made Israel to sin.”

paite: Jeroboam zi athou a, apawtkhia a, Tirzah khua ava tung a; inn kongpi bul atuntak in huai naupang asita hi.
english: Jeroboam’s wife arose and departed, and came to Tirzah. As she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.

paite: TOUPA'N asikha zawlnei Ahijah zang a thu agen bang ngei in Israel tengteng in avui ua, asuunta uhi.
english: All Israel buried him and mourned for him, according to Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the prophet.

paite: Jeroboam tanchin dang, agaldou thute leh avaihawm thute, ngai in, Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh in a-om hi.
english: The rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he fought and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

paite: Huchi in Jeroboam vaihawm sung kum sawmnih-le-nih ahi a, apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, amah sik in atapa Nadab ahong lalta hi.
english: The days which Jeroboam reigned were twenty two years; then he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his place.

paite: Solomon tapa Rehoboam Judah gam ah alal hi. Alal tung lai in Rehoboam kum sawmli-le-khat a upa ahi. TOUPA'N amin omsakna dia Israel nam tengtengte lak a atel khopi Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-sagih alal hi. Anu min Naamah ahi a, amah Ammon mi ahi.
english: Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which Yahweh had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.

paite: Judahte'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih ua; apute uh thilhih tengteng khup in akhelhnate un ahazatna atokthou uhi.
english: Judah did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they committed, above all that their fathers had done.

paite: Mual sang teng ah leh sing hing teng nuai ah suangphuhte phut in mun sangte leh Asherte nangawn abawl ngal ua.
english: For they also built for themselves high places, sacred pillars, and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.

paite: Huai gam ah pasal kizuakte leng a-om ua; Israel suante ma a TOUPA'N adelhkhiak namte thilhih kihhuai chiteng ahih uhi.
english: There were also sodomites in the land. They did according to all the abominations of the nations which Yahweh drove out before the children of Israel.

paite: Kumpipa Rehoboam lal akum nga kum in hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta kumpipa Shishak in Jerusalem asual hi.
english: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem;

paite: TOUPA' inn a goute leh kumpipa' inn a goute ala a, avek in ala khin hi. Solomon dangka-eng lum bawl tengteng leng ala tel vek hi.
english: and he took away the treasures of Yahweh’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He even took away all of it, including all the gold shields which Solomon had made.

paite: Kumpipa Rehoboam in huaite tang in dal lumte abawl a, kumpipa' inn kongpi vengmi heutute akemsak hi.
english: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who guarded the door of the king’s house.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA' inn a kumpipa alut peuhmah chiang in veng mite'n huaite atawi ua, dantan ah akoih nawn zel uhi.
english: It was so, that as often as the king went into Yahweh’s house, the guard bore them, and brought them back into the guard room.

paite: Rehoboam tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Rehoboam leh Jeroboam adamsung teng un akidou uhi.
english: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

paite: Huchi in Rehoboam apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, David khopi ah apute lak ah avui uh. Anu min Naamah ahi a, Ammon mi ahi. Asik in atapa Abijam ahong lalta hi.
english: Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess. Abijam his son reigned in his place.

paite: Huan Nebat tapa kumpipa Jeroboam kum sawm-le-giat alal kum in Judahte tung ah Abijam alal pan hi.
english: Now in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam the son of Nebat, Abijam began to reign over Judah.

paite: Jerusalem ah kum thum alal a; anu min Maakah, Abishalom tanu ahi.
english: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.

paite: Ama a pan thil gilou ahih tengteng ama'n leng ahih sam ahi. Apu David bang in alungtang TOUPA a Pathian lam ah ahoihkim sam kei hi.
english: He walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him; and his heart was not perfect with Yahweh his God, as the heart of David his father.

paite: Himahleh David ziak in TOUPA a Pathian in anung a, atapa hong dinkhiakna ding leh Jerusalem khua dingkipsak ding in Jerusalem ah khawnvak apia hi.
english: Nevertheless for David’s sake, Yahweh his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him and to establish Jerusalem;

paite: Hit mi Uriah tungtang chih louh in David in TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih ahih ziak leh adamsung teng a hih dia thu apiak peuhmah asel ngei louh ziak in.
english: because David did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and didn’t turn away from anything that he commanded him all the days of his life, except only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

paite: Rehoboam adamsung teng Jeroboam toh akidou gige uhi.
english: Now there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

paite: Abijam tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw? Abijam leh Jeroboam akidou uhi.
english: The rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

paite: Abijam apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; David khopi ah avui uhi. Ama sik in atapa Asa alal hi.
english: Abijam slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Asa his son reigned in his place.

paite: Israel kumpipa Jeroboam kum sawmnih alal kum in Asa bel Judahte tung ah alal pan hi.
english: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa began to reign over Judah.

paite: Kum sawmli-le-khat Jerusalem ah alal a; anu min Maakah ahi a, amah Abishalom tanu ahi.
english: He reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.

paite: Asa in apu David mah bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
english: Asa did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, as David his father did.

paite: Pasal kizuakte gam a pan adelhkhia a; apute'n milim ana bawl tengteng uh alamang hi.
english: He put away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.

paite: Anu Maakah leng, milim kihhuai mahmah Asherah abawlsak ziak in, akumpinu hihna atawpsak hi. Amilim bawl ahihsia a, Kidron lui ah ahal hi.
english: He also removed Maacah his mother from being queen, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah. Asa cut down her image and burned it at the brook Kidron.

paite: Mun sangte ahihleh alamang kei a; himahleh Asa lungtang adamsung teng in TOUPA lam ah ahoih bukim hi.
english: But the high places were not taken away. Nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect with Yahweh all his days.

paite: Apa'n thil ana latsate leh amah mah in ana latsa dangka, dangka-eng leh tui-um belsuan TOUPA' inn ah alalut hi.
english: He brought into Yahweh’s house the things that his father had dedicated, and the things that he himself had dedicated: silver, gold, and utensils.

paite: Asa leh Israel kumpipa Baasha lal sung teng akidou gige uhi.
english: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

paite: Israel kumpipa Baasha in Judah ava dou a, Judah kumpipa Asa kiang a lut ding leh pawtkhe ding dalna ding in Ramah khua abawl hi.
english: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

paite: Huchi in Asa in TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn a gou om lai dangka leh dangka-eng tengteng ala a, asikhate apia hi. Huchi in kumpipa Asa in Damaskas a om Siria kumpipa Hezion tapate Tabrimon tapa Ben-hadad kiang ah,
english: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that was left in the treasures of Yahweh’s house, and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered it into the hand of his servants. Then King Asa sent them to Ben Hadad, the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,

paite: "Kei leh nang kikal ah leh ka pa leh na pa kikal ah thukhun a-om a; ngai in, thilpiak dangka leh dangka-eng ka hon khak hi. Hong pai inla, Israel kumpipa Baasha in ahon paisanna ding in amah toh na thukhun uh hihsia in," chi in akhak hi.
english: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, like that between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent to you a present of silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”

paite: Ben-hadad in kumpipa Asa thu ana pom a, Israel khuate dou ding in asepaih heutute asawl a, Ijon, Dan, Abel-beth-maakah khuate, Kinneroth bial tengteng leh Naphtali gam tengteng tan in adou hi.
english: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel, and struck Ijon, and Dan, and Abel Beth Maacah, and all Chinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Baasha in huai thu ana zaktak in Ramah abawl atawp a, Tirzah ah atengta hi.
english: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and lived in Tirzah.

paite: Kumpipa Asa in Judah gam tengteng ah thu athangsak vialvial hi. Kuamah om awl a-om kei uh. Huchi in Baasha in Ramah khua bawlna dia suang leh sing azatte anawn ua; huaite zang in kumpipa Asa in Mizpah khua leh Benjamin gam a Geba khua abawl hi.
english: Then King Asa made a proclamation to all Judah. No one was exempted. They carried away the stones of Ramah, and its timber, with which Baasha had built; and King Asa used it to build Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

paite: Asa tanchin dang tengteng, athilhihdan tengteng, athilhih tengtengte leh akho bawlte Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw? Himahleh atek lam in akhe ahong nata hi.
english: Now the rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? But in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

paite: Huchi in a-ihmuta a, apu David khopi ah apute lak ah avui ua; atapa Jehoshaphat asik in alal hi.
english: Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place.

paite: Jeroboam tapa Nadab Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum nihna ah Israel tung ah alal pan a, Israel tung ah kum nih alal hi.
english: Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah; and he reigned over Israel two years.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih loutak ahih a, apa lampi atawn a, Israelte thilhih akhialsak a, ahihkhelhna pentak ama'n leng ahih sam hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.

paite: Issakar inkuante lak a mi Ahijah tapa Baasha in amah aguksawm a, Philistiate tan, Gibbethon ah Baasha in athat hi. Nadab leh Israel tengteng in Gibbethon a-um lai uh ahi.
english: Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha struck him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel were besieging Gibbethon.

paite: Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum thumna ah ahi Baasha in athah a, asik a ahong lal.
english: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha killed him and reigned in his place.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa ahong hih in Jeroboam inko tengteng athat a; Jeroboam a ding in kuamah ahinghawi kei hi. TOUPA Shiloh a mi asikha Ahijah zang a agensa bang in.
english: As soon as he was king, he struck all the house of Jeroboam. He didn’t leave to Jeroboam any who breathed, until he had destroyed him, according to the saying of Yahweh, which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite;

paite: Huai bel Israelte thil hihkhialsak a ahih, Jeroboam khelhnate ziak leh TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian ahehsak ziak ahi.
english: for the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and with which he made Israel to sin, because of his provocation with which he provoked Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger.

paite: Nadab tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Asa leh Israel kumpipa Baasha alal sung teng un akidou gige uh.
english: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

paite: Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum thum na ah Ahijah tapa Baasha Tirzah ah Israel tengteng tung ah alal pan a, kum sawmnih-le-li alal hi.
english: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha the son of Ahijah began to reign over all Israel in Tirzah for twenty-four years.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih a, Jeroboam lampi zuih azui a, Israelte thil hihkhialsak a ahihkhelhna ahih sam hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin with which he made Israel to sin.

paite: Huchi in Baasha kalh in Hanani tapa Jehu kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: Yahweh’s word came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

paite: "Leivui a pan ka hon domsang a, ka mi Israelte tung ah heutu in ka hon bawl hi. Nang Jeroboam lampi zuih na tawn a, akhelhnate a hon hehsak ding in ka mi Israelte thil na hihkhialsak hi.
english: “Because I exalted you out of the dust and made you prince over my people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins,

paite: Ngai in, Baasha leh a-inkote ka hihmang ding hi. Huchi in Nebat tapa Jeroboam inkote bang mai in na inkote ka bawl ding.
english: behold, I will utterly sweep away Baasha and his house; and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

paite: Baasha inkote lak a mi khopi a si peuhmah ui in ane dia; a-inkote lak a mi gamlak a si peuhmah tungleng vasate'n ane ding uh," chi in.
english: The dogs will eat Baasha’s descendants who die in the city; and he who dies of his in the field, the birds of the sky will eat.”

paite: Baasha tanchin dangte, athilhihte leh athilhihtheihdante Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Baasha apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, Tirzah ah avui ua; asik in atapa Elah alal hi.
english: Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah; and Elah his son reigned in his place.

paite: Baasha leh a-inkote tungtang thu ah akhutsuak a TOUPA hehsak dia Jeroboam inkote batna nei a TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou mahmah ahih ziak leh amah athah ziak in Hanani tapa zawlnei Jehu zang a agen TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha and against his house, both because of all the evil that he did in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he struck him.

paite: Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum sawmnih-le-gukna ah Baasha tapa Elah, Tirzah ah Israelte tung ah alal pan a, kum nih alal hi,
english: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah the son of Baasha began to reign over Israel in Tirzah for two years.

paite: Asikha Zimri, akangtalai kimkhat tung a heutu in Tirzah ah amah gukthah asawm hi. Huchih lai in, Tirzah ah insung lam heutu Arza inn ah amah zukham in a-om hi.
english: His servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him. Now he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, who was over the household in Tirzah;

paite: Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum sawmnih-le-sagih in Zimri lut in ava sual a, athat a, asik in alalta hi.
english: and Zimri went in and struck him and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ahong lal pan a, alaltutphah a ahong tuttak in, Baasha inko tengteng athat vek a; atanaute leh alawmte lak a mi pasal photphot khat leng ahawi kei hi.
english: When he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, he attacked all the house of Baasha. He didn’t leave him a single one who urinates on a wall among his relatives or his friends.

paite: Huchi in zawlnei Jehu zang a Baasha kalh a agen, TOUPA thu bang in, Zimri in Baasha inko tengteng athat vek hi;
english: Thus Zimri destroyed all the house of Baasha, according to Yahweh’s word which he spoke against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,

paite: TOUPA, Israelte’ Pathian, hehsak dia aginatlouhna ua, atohthoh ua, Baasha khelhnate leh atapa Elah khelhnate a amaute akhelh ua, huai mah a Israelte akhelhsak ziak un.
english: for all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, which they sinned and with which they made Israel to sin, to provoke Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.

paite: Elah tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum sawmnih-le-sagihna ah Zimri, Tirzah ah ni sagih alal hi. Philistiate neihsa, Gibbethon a mite'n a-um uhi.
english: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.

paite: A-um mite'n, "Zimri in aguksawm a, kumpipa athat," chih agen uh ana za ua; huchi in Israel tengteng in sepaih heutu, Omri, huai ni in agiahmun uah Israelte tung a kumpipa in abawl uhi.
english: The people who were encamped heard that Zimri had conspired, and had also killed the king. Therefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp.

paite: Omri bel Israel tengteng toh Gibbethon a pan in ahohtou ua, Tirzah ava um uhi.
english: Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Zimri in khua ala uh chih atheih in, kumpipa' inn a kulh ah atailut a, kumpipa' inn ah akibuhal a, asita hi;
english: When Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the fortified part of the king’s house and burned the king’s house over him with fire, and died,

paite: TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou mahmah hih a akhelhnate ziak leh Jeroboam lampi tawn a Israelte thil hihkhialsak a, akhelh ziak in.
english: for his sins which he sinned in doing that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did to make Israel to sin.

paite: Zimri tanchin dangte leh asawmgukna thute Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he committed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Huchi in Israel mite pawl nih in akikhenta ua; mipi kimkhat in Ginath tapa Tibni kumpipa dia bawl tum in azui ua; akimkhat in Omri azui uhi.
english: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king, and half followed Omri.

paite: Himahleh Omri zuite'n Ginath tapa Tibni zuite azou ua: huchi in Tibni asi a, Omri ahong lalta hi.
english: But the people who followed Omri prevailed against the people who followed Tibni the son of Ginath; so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.

paite: Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum sawmthum-le-khatna ah Omri Israelte tung ah alal pan a, kum sawm-le-nih alal a: Tirzah ah kum guk alal hi.
english: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri began to reign over Israel for twelve years. He reigned six years in Tirzah.

paite: Shemer a Samaria mual dangka talent nih in alei a; mual tung ah khua asat a, akhosat min huai neipa Shemer min tam in Samaria asa hi.
english: He bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver; and he built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, Samaria, after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill.

paite: Omri in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih a, ama a mi tengteng sang in thil ahihkhial thupi tuamse hi.
english: Omri did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and dealt wickedly above all who were before him.

paite: Nebat tapa Jeroboam dan tengteng ala a, aginatlouhna ziak ua TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian hehsak dia Israelte thil ahihkhelhsak bang in akhial samta hi.
english: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sins with which he made Israel to sin, to provoke Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.

paite: Omri thilhih tanchin dangte leh athilhihtheihdan ahihlat thute Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he showed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Huchi in Omri apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, Samaria ah avui ua; asik in atapa Ahab ahong lal hi.
english: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria; and Ahab his son reigned in his place.

paite: Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum sawmthum-le-giatna ah Israelte tung ah Omri tapa Ahab alal pan hi. Omri tapa Ahab, Samaria ah kum sawmnih-le-nih Israelte tung ah alal hi,
english: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab the son of Omri began to reign over Israel. Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.

paite: Omri tapa Ahab in ama a mi tengteng sang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih hi.
english: Ahab the son of Omri did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight above all that were before him.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhna bang hih sam bangmah lou a ngai hileh kilawmtak in, Zidonte kumpipa Ethbaal tanu Jezebel zi in anei a, Baal nna sem in abia hi.
english: As if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, he took as wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and went and served Baal and worshiped him.

paite: Samaria a Baal inn alam ah Baal a ding in maitam adoh hi.
english: He raised up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.

paite: Ahab in Asherah abawl a; ama a Israel kumpipa tengteng sang in Ahab in TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian hehsakna thil anak hih tungtuan hi.
english: Ahab made the Asherah; and Ahab did more yet to provoke Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him.

paite: Alal lai in Bethel mi Hiel in Jeriko khua asat a; atachil Abiram tanloh in asuangphum aphum hi. TOUPA'N Nun tapa Joshua zang a ana gensa bang in, anautum Segub tanloh hial in akulh kongkhakte adingkhesak hi.
english: In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho. He laid its foundation with the loss of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates with the loss of his youngest son Segub, according to Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.

paite: Huan Gilead gam a Tishbi a mi Elijah in Ahab kiang ah, "TOUPA, ama a ka dinna Israelte' Pathian ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Keimah thu lou in kum bangzah hiam sung daitui leh vuah azu kei ding," achi hi.
english: Elijah the Tishbite, who was one of the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As Yahweh, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.”

paite: TOUPA thu akiang ah ahong tung hi,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to him, saying,

paite: "Hiai a pan pawt inla, suahlam zuan in pai inla, Jordan gei a om Kerith lui ah va kibu in.
english: “Go away from here, turn eastward, and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, that is before the Jordan.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, huai luitui na dawn dia; huai ah nang hon vak ding in va-ak thu ka pe khinta hi," achi hi.
english: You shall drink from the brook. I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”

paite: Huchi in akuan a, TOUPA thu bang in ahihta hi. Jordan gei a om Kerith lui ah atengta hi.
english: So he went and did according to Yahweh’s word, for he went and lived by the brook Cherith that is before the Jordan.

paite: Va-akte'n zingsang in tanghou leh sa ahong puak zel ua, nitaklam in tanghou leh sa ahong puak nawn zel uhi. Huai luitui adawn hi.
english: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening; and he drank from the brook.

paite: Anung deuh in hichi ahong hi a, huai gam a vuah himhim azuk louh ziak in lui ahong kangta hi.
english: After a while, the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land.

paite: TOUPA thu akiang ah ahong tung a,
english: Yahweh’s word came to him, saying,

paite: "Thou inla, Zidon gam a Zarephath ah hoh inla, huai ah om in. Nang hon vak ding in meithai khat thu ka pe khinta," achi hi.
english: “Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to sustain you.”

paite: Huchi in athou a, Zarephath ah ahohta hi. Huai khokulh kongpi atun in, ngai in, meithai khat sing tom in ana om a; amah asam a, "Bel in tui tawmchik hon la dih ve, ka na dawn ding," achi hi.
english: So he arose and went to Zarephath; and when he came to the gate of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called to her and said, “Please get me a little water in a jar, that I may drink.”

paite: La dia kuan asam a, "Tanghou neuchik bek hon tawi lechin," achi hi.
english: As she was going to get it, he called to her and said, “Please bring me a morsel of bread in your hand.”

paite: Ama'n, TOUPA na Pathian ahin bang in, ka gen hi. "Tanghou ka nei kei, bel ah tangbuang pham khat lel leh thawl ah sathau tawmchik kia ka nei hi. Ngai in, ka pai chia ka tapa a dia bawlna ding singkang nih hiam lel ka tom a, huchi in ka ne ding ua, ka si mai ding uh," achi hi.
english: She said, “As Yahweh your God lives, I don’t have anything baked, but only a handful of meal in a jar and a little oil in a jar. Behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and bake it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.”

paite: Elijah in akiang ah, "Lau ke'n, na gen bang in va hih in. Himahleh huai in tanghou neuchik petmah hon bawlsak phot inla, huai hon tawi inla, huai khit chiang in nang a ding leh na tapa a ding na bawl ding hi.
english: Elijah said to her, “Don’t be afraid. Go and do as you have said; but make me a little cake from it first, and bring it out to me, and afterward make some for you and for your son.

paite: TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: TOUPA'N leitung a vuah ahon zuksak masiah tangbuang bel avuak tuan kei dia, sathau thawl leng akang kei ding," achi hi.
english: For Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘The jar of meal will not run out, and the jar of oil will not fail, until the day that Yahweh sends rain on the earth.’”

paite: Huchi in Elijah gen bang in ahih a; amah leh a-inkote leh Elijah toh ni tamtak ane uhi.
english: She went and did according to the saying of Elijah; and she, he, and her household ate many days.

paite: Elijah zang a agen TOUPA thu bang in tangbuang bel avuak tuan kei a, sathau thawl leng akang sam kei hi.
english: The jar of meal didn’t run out and the jar of oil didn’t fail, according to Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by Elijah.

paite: Huai thilte nung in hichi ahong hi a, huai numei, inn neinu tapa china in ahong gim mahmah a, anak ahong beita hi.
english: After these things, the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became sick; and his sickness was so severe that there was no breath left in him.

paite: Ama'n Elijah kiang ah, "Nang Pathian mipa aw, ka tung a lungkimlouhna bang nei na hia? Ka khelhna hon theikhesak ding leh ka tapa hon thahsak dia hong pai na hi ve!" achi hi.
english: She said to Elijah, “What have I to do with you, you man of God? You have come to me to bring my sin to memory, and to kill my son!”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Na tapa hon pia in," achi hi. Huchi in apom lai ala a, a-omna dantan ah apom tou a, alupna ah asial hi.
english: He said to her, “Give me your son.” He took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into the room where he stayed, and laid him on his own bed.

paite: TOUPA asam a, "Aw TOUPA, ka Pathian, ka tenna meithainu tung ah leh atapa hihlupsak in thil hoih lou hon tungsakta na hi maw?" achi hi.
english: He cried to Yahweh and said, “Yahweh my God, have you also brought evil on the widow with whom I am staying, by killing her son?”

paite: Huchi in naupang tung ah thumvei bokkhup in, TOUPA asam a, "Aw TOUPA, ka Pathian, hehpih in hiai naupang hinna asung ah hon omsak nawn in," achi hi.
english: He stretched himself on the child three times, and cried to Yahweh and said, “Yahweh my God, please let this child’s soul come into him again.”

paite: TOUPA'N Elijah thu ana ngaihkhiaksak hi. Hichi in naupang hinna amah sung ah ahong om nawn a, ahong halh nawnta hi.
english: Yahweh listened to the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.

paite: Elijah in naupang api a, dantan a pan insung ah apaipihsuk a, anu apia hi. Elijah in, “En in, na tapa ahing hi," achi hi.
english: Elijah took the child and brought him down out of the room into the house, and delivered him to his mother; and Elijah said, “Behold, your son lives.”

paite: Numei in Elijah kiang ah, "Tu in Pathian mipa na hi a, na kam a TOUPA thu thutak ahi, chih ka theita," achi hi.
english: The woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God, and that Yahweh’s word in your mouth is truth.”

paite: Huan ni sawtkuamtak nung in hichi ahong hi a, akum thum kum in TOUPA thu Elijah kiang ah ahong tung hi. "Va kuan inla, Ahab kiang ah va kihil in. Huchi in leitung ah vuah ka zusak ding," achi hi.
english: After many days, Yahweh’s word came to Elijah, in the third year, saying, “Go, show yourself to Ahab; and I will send rain on the earth.”

paite: Ahab kiang a kihil ding in Elijah akuanta hi. Samaria gam ah kial ana mahmah hi.
english: Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria.

paite: Ahab in Obadiah, a-inn sunglam heutu asam hi. Obadiah bel TOUPA laudan siam mahmah mi ahi a;
english: Ahab called Obadiah, who was over the household. (Now Obadiah feared Yahweh greatly;

paite: huan, hichi ahong hi a, Jezebel in TOUPA zawlneite asatkhiak lai in Obadiah in zawlnei zakhat api a, kokhuk ah sawmnga nga in asel a, tanghou leh tui in avak hi.
english: for when Jezebel cut off Yahweh’s prophets, Obadiah took one hundred prophets, and hid them fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)

paite: Ahab in Obadiah kiang ah, "Tui nak nei tengteng leh lui phaizang tengteng omna gam va tuan vialvial dih ve. Sakol leh sabiltungte i hut hing theihna ding in loupa i muhsak thei kha hiam, huchi lou in zaw gante i tan vek kha ding,” achi hi.
english: Ahab said to Obadiah, “Go through the land, to all the springs of water, and to all the brooks. Perhaps we may find grass and save the horses and mules alive, that we not lose all the animals.”

paite: Huchi in gam totsuak ding in akihawm ua; Ahab amah kia in lampi dang ah apai a, Obadiah leng amah kia in lampi dang ah apai hi.
english: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it. Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.

paite: Huchi a Obadiah apai lai in, ngai in, Elijah in ana tuak a; ama'n athei lai a, huchi in abokkhup a, "Ka toupa Elijah na hi maw?" achi hi.
english: As Obadiah was on the way, behold, Elijah met him. He recognized him, and fell on his face, and said, “Is it you, my lord Elijah?”

paite: Ama'n adawng a, "Hi e, kuan inla, ngai in, Elijah huai ah a-om hi, chi in na toupa va hilh in,” achi hi.
english: He answered him, “It is I. Go, tell your lord, ‘Behold, Elijah is here!’”

paite: Ama'n, "Thil bang ahia ka hihkhelh a, na sikha thah dia Ahab khut a na hon piak ding?
english: He said, “How have I sinned, that you would deliver your servant into the hand of Ahab, to kill me?

paite: TOUPA na Pathian ahin bang in ka gen ahi, ka pu in nang ahon zonsaklouhna nam leh gam himhim a-om kei. Hiai ah a-om kei, achih chiang un nang ahon muhlouhna thu uah gam leh nam akichiamsak hi.
english: As Yahweh your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent to seek you. When they said, ‘He is not here,’ he took an oath of the kingdom and nation that they didn’t find you.

paite: Tu in nang, kuan inla, ngai in, Elijah hiai ah a-om, chi in na toupa va hilh in, na chi hi.
english: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here.”’

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, nang ka hon nutsiattak in TOUPA Kha in ka theihlouhna ah nang ahong lamang dia; huchi in Ahab ka va hilh a, nang ahon muh theih ngal ke'n zaw, kei hon that mai ding hi. Himahleh na sikha in ka valnou tung a pan TOUPA ka lau hi.
english: It will happen, as soon as I leave you, that Yahweh’s Spirit will carry you I don’t know where; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he can’t find you, he will kill me. But I, your servant, have feared Yahweh from my youth.

paite: Jezebel in TOUPA zawlneite athah lai a ka thilhih, TOUPA zawlneite lak a mi zakhat, sawmnga nga a kokhuk a, tanghou leh tui a ka vakdan ka toupa hon hilh lou uhia?
english: Wasn’t it told my lord what I did when Jezebel killed Yahweh’s prophets, how I hid one hundred men of Yahweh’s prophets with fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water?

paite: Tu in nang, kuan inla, ngai in, Elijah huai ah a-om hi, chi in na toupa va hilh in na chi mawk a; ama'n kei ahon that mahmah ding," achi hi.
english: Now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, “Behold, Elijah is here”.’ He will kill me.”

paite: Elijah in, "Ama ka dinna sepaihte' TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi, tuni in akiang ah ka kihil ngeingei ding," achi hi.
english: Elijah said, “As Yahweh of Armies lives, before whom I stand, I will surely show myself to him today.”

paite: Huchi in Ahab houpih ding in Obadiah akuan a, ahilhta a; huchi in Elijah mu ding in Ahab akuanta hi.
english: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Ahab in Elijah amuh in Ahab in akiang ah, "Nang na hi maw, Israelte buaisakpa?" achi hi.
english: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, “Is that you, you troubler of Israel?”

paite: Ama'n adawng a, "Israelte ka buaisak kei. Nang leh na pa inkote ahi ve abuaisak zaw; TOUPA thupiakte lehngatsan a, Baal na zuih zawkna ah.
english: He answered, “I have not troubled Israel, but you and your father’s house, in that you have forsaken Yahweh’s commandments and you have followed the Baals.

paite: Huchi in tu in Israel tengteng leh Baal zawlnei zali-le-sawmnga leh Asherah zawlnei, Jezebel dohkan a ankuang um zalite ka kiang ah Karmel tang ah va samkhawm in," achi hi.
english: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel to Mount Carmel, and four hundred fifty of the prophets of Baal, and four hundred of the prophets of the Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table.”

paite: Huchi in Ahab in Israel suan tengteng kiang ah mi asawl a, zawlneite Karmel tang ah asamkhawm hi.
english: So Ahab sent to all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together to Mount Carmel.

paite: Elijah in mipi tengteng ava naih a, "Vanglak a bang tan om ding na hi ua? TOUPA Pathian ahihleh, amah zui unla; Baal ahihleh amah zui un," achi hi. Mipite'n kam khat in leng adawng kei uh.
english: Elijah came near to all the people, and said, “How long will you waver between the two sides? If Yahweh is God, follow him; but if Baal, then follow him.” The people didn’t say a word.

paite: Huchi in Elijah in mipite kiang ah, "TOUPA zawlnei omsun kei kia ka hi a; Baal zawlneite bel mi zali-le-sawmnga ahi uh.
english: Then Elijah said to the people, “I, even I only, am left as a prophet of Yahweh; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred fifty men.

paite: Huchi in bawngtal nih hong pia uhenla; amau bawngtal khat amau a tuam ding in tel uhenla, semnen uhenla, sing tung ah koih uhenla, anuai ah mei toh kei uhen. Ke'n leng bawngtal khat ka bawl sam dia, sing tung ah ka koih dia mei ahihleh ka toh kei ding.
english: Let them therefore give us two bulls; and let them choose one bull for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under; and I will dress the other bull, and lay it on the wood, and put no fire under it.

paite: Nou na pathiante min uh sam unla, ke'n TOUPA min ka sam ding. Huchi in mei a hon dawng Pathian pen Pathian hi hen," achi hi. Huchi in mi tengteng in, "Athugen ahoih hi,” chi in adawng uhi.
english: You call on the name of your god, and I will call on Yahweh’s name. The God who answers by fire, let him be God.” All the people answered, “What you say is good.”

paite: Elijah in Baal zawlneite kiang ah, "Nou bawngtal khat nou a tuam ding in tel unla, bawl masa un; nou na tam deuh ua; na pathiante min sam unla, himahleh anuai ah mei toh kei un," achi hi.
english: Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Choose one bull for yourselves, and dress it first, for you are many; and call on the name of your god, but put no fire under it.”

paite: Bawngtal atan pen uh ala ua, abawl ua, "Baal aw, hon dawng in," chi in zingsang a pan sun tan in Baal min asam uh. Himahleh aw himhim a-om kei a, adawng leng a om sam kei a, maitam kibawl tung ah atawm uhi.
english: They took the bull which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, “Baal, hear us!” But there was no voice, and nobody answered. They leaped about the altar which was made.

paite: Sun lai in hichi ahong hi a, "Elijah in amau enghou in, kikou ngaih ve ua; pathian khat ahi ngal a. Midang houpih hiam, nungdelh nei lel hiam, khualzin ahihkeileh ihmu lel phawn teitei ngai houh hi in teh,” achi hi.
english: At noon, Elijah mocked them, and said, “Cry aloud, for he is a god. Either he is deep in thought, or he has gone somewhere, or he is on a journey, or perhaps he sleeps and must be awakened.”

paite: Huchi in angaih a ngaih in akikou ua, ahih zeldan bang un sisan pawt khop hial in temta in aki-atkeh ua, thilzum in akisun uhi.
english: They cried aloud, and cut themselves in their way with knives and lances until the blood gushed out on them.

paite: Sun nung ahong hih in hichi ahong hi a, nitaklam kithoih hun tan in thu agen uhi. Himahleh aw hiam, dawngtu hiam limsaktu leng a-om kei.
english: When midday was past, they prophesied until the time of the evening offering; but there was no voice, no answer, and nobody paid attention.

paite: Huchi in Elijah in mipi tengteng kiang ah, "Hong naih dih ua," achi hi. Huchi in mipi tengteng in ava naih uhi.
english: Elijah said to all the people, “Come near to me!”; and all the people came near to him. He repaired Yahweh’s altar that had been thrown down.

paite: TOUPA maitam kichimsa abawlhoih a; na min Israel ahi ding, chi a TOUPA thu ana mupa Jakob tapate nam zah suang sawm-le-nih Elijah in ala hi.
english: Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom Yahweh’s word came, saying, “Israel shall be your name.”

paite: Huai suangte in TOUPA min in maitam abawl a; maitam kim buhchi tehna nih takna ding atoukuak hi.
english: With the stones he built an altar in Yahweh’s name. He made a trench around the altar large enough to contain two seahs of seed.

paite: Sing akoih hoih sipsip a, bawngtal asemnen a, sing tung ah akoih hi. "Bel li tui in dimsak unla, halmang thillat leh sing buak un," achi hi.
english: He put the wood in order, and cut the bull in pieces and laid it on the wood. He said, “Fill four jars with water, and pour it on the burnt offering and on the wood.”

paite: Anihveina ding in, "Buak nawn un," achi a, abuak nawn uhi. Athumveina ding in, "Buak nawn un," achi a, abuak nawn uhi.
english: He said, “Do it a second time;” and they did it the second time. He said, “Do it a third time;” and they did it the third time.

paite: Huchi in tui maitam kim ah aluang zuazua a; tohkuak tui in adimta hi.
english: The water ran around the altar; and he also filled the trench with water.

paite: Nitaklam kithoih hun in hichi ahong hi a, zawlnei Elijah in ava naih a, "TOUPA Abraham, Isak leh Israel Pathian, nang Israel gam a Pathian na hihleh, kei na sikha ka hih, hiai tengteng nang thu a ka hih tuni in theihsak hi hen.
english: At the time of the evening offering, Elijah the prophet came near and said, “Yahweh, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known today that you are God in Israel and that I am your servant, and that I have done all these things at your word.

paite: Hon ngaikhia in, aw TOUPA hon ngaikhia in, hiai mipite'n nang TOUPA Pathian na hi a, alungtang uh na heikik nawnta chih atheihna ding un," achi hi.
english: Hear me, Yahweh, hear me, that this people may know that you, Yahweh, are God, and that you have turned their heart back again.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA mei ahong kia a, halmang thillat, asing, asuang leh aleivui akangtum a, tohkuak a tui ahipkang hi.
english: Then Yahweh’s fire fell and consumed the burnt offering, the wood, the stones, and the dust; and it licked up the water that was in the trench.

paite: Huchi in mipi tengteng in huai amuh un abokkhup ua, "TOUPA amah Pathian ahi, TOUPA amah Pathian ahi,” achi uh.
english: When all the people saw it, they fell on their faces. They said, “Yahweh, he is God! Yahweh, he is God!”

paite: Elijah in akiang uah, "Baal zawlneite man unla, khat leng suaktasak kei un," achi hi. Huchi in aman ua, Elijah in Kishon lui ah apisuk a, huai ah amaute athat hi.
english: Elijah said to them, “Seize the prophets of Baal! Don’t let one of them escape!” They seized them; and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and killed them there.

paite: Elijah in Ahab kiang ah, "Paitou inla, ne in dawnta in; vuahpi zu ding husa a-om," achi hi.
english: Elijah said to Ahab, “Get up, eat and drink; for there is the sound of abundance of rain.”

paite: Ne leh dawn ding in Ahab apaitouta hi. Elijah bel Karmel tang vum ah apaitou a; lei ah akunsuk a, akhukte kikal ah amai aphual hi.
english: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he bowed himself down on the earth, and put his face between his knees.

paite: Asikha kiang ah, "Va paitou inla, tuipi lam va en mah dih!" achi hi. Ava paitou a, tuipi lam a-en a, "Bangmah a-om kei," achi hi. Ama'n, "Sagihvei kuan nawn in,” achi hi.
english: He said to his servant, “Go up now and look toward the sea.” He went up and looked, then said, “There is nothing.” He said, “Go again” seven times.

paite: Asagihveina ah hichi ahong hi a, "Ngai in, tuipi a pan mihing khuttum chia lel meipi hong lengtou viaiviai," achi hi. Ama'n, "Va pai inla, Ahab kiang ah, na kangtalai bawl inla, paisukta in, vuah in ahon khum kha ding, chi in," achi hi.
english: On the seventh time, he said, “Behold, a small cloud, like a man’s hand, is rising out of the sea.” He said, “Go up, tell Ahab, ‘Get ready and go down, so that the rain doesn’t stop you.’”

paite: Sawt lou nung in hichi ahong hi a, huih leh meipite in van adup keihkuih a, vuahpi tam petmah ahong zuta hi. Ahab kangtalai a tuang in Jezreel ah apaita hi.
english: In a little while, the sky grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.

paite: TOUPA khut Elijah tung ah a-om a; apuan ateng a, Ahab ma ah Jezreel kholutna tan atai hi.
english: Yahweh’s hand was on Elijah; and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.

paite: Huan Ahab in Elijah thilhih tengteng, namsau a zawlnei tengteng athah thute toh Jezebel ahilh hi.
english: Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.

paite: Huchi in Jezebel in Elijah kiang ah, "Huai mite lak a mi khat hinna bang a zingchiang a hichi hun ma a na hinna ka hon bawlsak sam keileh pathiante'n alohloh uh hon loh uhenla, huai sang a sezaw in leng,” chi a hilh ding in mi asawl hi.
english: Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, “So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I don’t make your life as the life of one of them by tomorrow about this time!”

paite: Huchi in huai atheih in alau a, athou a, ahinna humbit ding in atai hi. Judah gam a Beer-sheba khua ava tung a, huai ah asikha anusia hi.
english: When he saw that, he arose and ran for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongs to Judah, and left his servant there.

paite: Amah gamdai ah ni khat lampaina tan ah ahoh a, Juniper sing nuai ah tu in sih angenta hi. "Ahunta; TOUPA aw, tu in ka hinna la in, ka pute sang in lah ka hoihzaw tuan kei," achi hi.
english: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree. Then he requested for himself that he might die, and said, “It is enough. Now, O Yahweh, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.”

paite: Juniper sing nuai ah alum a, a-ihmuta hi. Ngai in, angel in ahong khoih a, akiang ah, "Thou inla ne in," achi hi.
english: He lay down and slept under a juniper tree; and behold, an angel touched him, and said to him, “Arise and eat!”

paite: Ama'n a-en vialvial a, ngai in, alu chin ah tanghou pei, suangsa a haiminsa leh tuithawl ana om hi. Huchi in hiaite ne in adawn a, alum nawn hi.
english: He looked, and behold, there was at his head a cake baked on the coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank, and lay down again.

paite: Anihveina ding in TOUPA angel ahong pai nawn a, ahong khoih a, "Thou inla, ne in, na paina ding agamla lo lai hi,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel came again the second time, and touched him, and said, “Arise and eat, because the journey is too great for you.”

paite: Huchi in athou a, ne in adawn a, an ziak a hatna in Pathian tang Horeb tan ni sawmli leh zan sawmli apai hi.
english: He arose, and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb, God’s Mountain.

paite: Huai a kokhuk khat ava tung a, huai ah a-omta hi. Ngai in, TOUPA thu akiang ah ahong tung a, akiang ah, "Hiai a bang hih na hia, Elijah?" achi hi.
english: He came to a cave there, and camped there; and behold, Yahweh’s word came to him, and he said to him, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”

paite: Ama'n, "TOUPA, Sepaihte' Pathian a ding in phatuam ka ngai mahmah hi. Israel suante'n lah na thukhun alehngatsan ua, na maitamte achimsak ua, na zawlneite namsau in athat ua; a-om lai kei ka hi a, ka hinna lakmang ding in azong uh," achi hi.
english: He said, “I have been very jealous for Yahweh, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”

paite: Ama'n, "Pawtkhia inla, huai tang ah TOUPA ma ah va dingh in," achi hi. Ngai in, TOUPA ahong pai a, huihpi hat mahmah in tangte TOUPA ma ah amutkhang a, suangpi akitam phuakphuak hi. Himahleh huai ah TOUPA a-om kei. Huih nun khit in zin ahong ling a; himahleh huai zinling ah TOUPA a-om kei.
english: He said, “Go out and stand on the mountain before Yahweh.” Behold, Yahweh passed by, and a great and strong wind tore the mountains and broke in pieces the rocks before Yahweh; but Yahweh was not in the wind. After the wind there was an earthquake; but Yahweh was not in the earthquake.

paite: Zinlin khit in meikuang ahong pawt a; himahleh huai mei ah TOUPA a-om kei. Meikuang nung in aw ngat ngiingei ahong pawt hi.
english: After the earthquake a fire passed; but Yahweh was not in the fire. After the fire, there was a still small voice.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Elijah in huai azak in apuanin amai akhuh a, va pawtkhia in kokhuk lutna ah ava dingh hi. Ngai in, huai aw in akiang ah, "Hiai a bang hih na hia, Elijah?" achi hi.
english: When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his mantle, went out, and stood in the entrance of the cave. Behold, a voice came to him, and said, “What are you doing here, Elijah?”

paite: Ama'n, "TOUPA, Sepaihte' Pathian a ding in phatuam ka ngai mahmah hi. Israel suante'n lah na thukhun alehngatsan ua, na maitamte achimsak ua, na zawlneite namsau in athat ua. A-om lai kei ka hi a, ka hinna lakmang ding in azong uh," achi hi.
english: He said, “I have been very jealous for Yahweh, the God of Armies; for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword. I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.”

paite: TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Pai nawn inla, gamdai lam a Damaskas ah pai in. Na tun chiang in Siria kumpipa ding in Hazael thau na nilh ding hi.
english: Yahweh said to him, “Go, return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus. When you arrive, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria.

paite: Israel kumpipa ding in Nimshi tapa Jehu thau na nilh ding; na sik a zawlnei ding in Abel-meholah a mi Shaphat tapa Elisha leng thau na nilh ding ahi.
english: Anoint Jehu the son of Nimshi to be king over Israel; and anoint Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel Meholah to be prophet in your place.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, Hazael namsau pel peuhmah Jehu in athat dia; Jehu namsau pel peuhmah Elisha in athat ding.
english: He who escapes from the sword of Hazael, Jehu will kill; and he who escapes from the sword of Jehu, Elisha will kill.

paite: Himahleh Israel gam ah Baal ma a khukdin ngei lou leh amah tawp ngeiloumi sangsagih kei a ding in ka sit hi," achi hi.
english: Yet I reserved seven thousand in Israel, all the knees of which have not bowed to Baal, and every mouth that has not kissed him.”

paite: Huchi in huai a pan apawtkhia a, Shaphat tapa Elisha ava mukhia hi. Ama'n langkawn bat bawngtal tuak sawm-le-nih in lou ana kai hi. Asawm-le-nihna azang hi. Elijah in ava naih a, apuan ava silhsak hi.
english: So he departed from there and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth. Elijah went over to him and put his mantle on him.

paite: Ama'n abawngtalte paisan in Elijah anungdelh a, "Ka nu leh ka pa hon tawpsak ding in ka hon ngen, huchi in ka hon zui ding," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Pai nawn ve le, bang ka hon chih a eita?" achi hi.
english: Elisha left the oxen and ran after Elijah, and said, “Let me please kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow you.” He said to him, “Go back again; for what have I done to you?”

paite: Amah zui lai akik nawn a, bawng tuakkhat agou a, bawng vante in asa ahuan a, mite apia a, amau ane uhi. Huchi in athou a, Elijah adelh a, a-nna asepsakta hi.
english: He returned from following him, and took the yoke of oxen, killed them, and boiled their meat with the oxen’s equipment, and gave to the people; and they ate. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and served him.

paite: Huan David sih ni ding ahong naita a; atapa Solomon thu apia hi.
english: Now the days of David came near that he should die; and he commanded Solomon his son, saying,

paite: "Leitung pumpi lampi ah ka pai sam dia; nang hattak leh pasalphatak in om in.
english: “I am going the way of all the earth. You be strong therefore, and show yourself a man;

paite: Na thilhih peuhmah leh na kiheina lam peuhmah a na lamzan theihna ding in Mosi Dan a gelh ahih bang in, TOUPA na Pathian in alampite zui ding leh adan thusehte, athupiakte, avaihawmte leh athu theihsakte pom dia thu apiakte zui in.
english: and keep the instruction of Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, his commandments, his ordinances, and his testimonies, according to that which is written in the law of Moses, that you may prosper in all that you do and wherever you turn yourself.

paite: TOUPA'N ka tungtang thu a, 'Na suante'n alungtang tengteng uleh alungsimtak ua ka mitmuh a thutak a-om ding a, a-omdan ua apilvan uleh Israelte laltutphah a tu ding mi na tatlak kei ding, chi a agen ahihkip ding hi.’ ”
english: Then Yahweh may establish his word which he spoke concerning me, saying, ‘If your children are careful of their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail you,’ he said, ‘a man on the throne of Israel.’

paite: "Zeruiah tapa Joab in ahon bawldan, Israelte sepaih heutu nih Ner tapa Abner leh Jether tapa Amasa abawldan na thei hi. Amaute athah a, kilep lai a kidou sisan suah a, atai a kawnggak leh akhedap but a kidouna sisan abansakdan.
english: “Moreover you know also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, even what he did to the two captains of the armies of Israel, to Abner the son of Ner and to Amasa the son of Jether, whom he killed, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war on his sash that was around his waist and in his sandals that were on his feet.

paite: Huchi in pha na sakdan bang in hih inla, alu a kelsam pou in han ah lungmuangtak in tumsak ke'n.
english: Do therefore according to your wisdom, and don’t let his gray head go down to Sheol in peace.

paite: Gilead mi Barzillai tapate tung ah hehpihna hihlang in. Na dohkan a an ummi ding in telsak in; na unau Absalom a pan ka taimang lai in ka kiang ah ahong ngal a.
english: But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table; for so they came to me when I fled from Absalom your brother.

paite: Ngai in Bahurim mi, Benjamin suan Gera tapa Shimei na kiang ah a-om hi. Ama'n Mahanaim a ka hoh lai in hamse hoihloupi ahon lohkhum hi. Himahleh Jordan ah hong dawn ding in ahong kuan hi. Huai ah, namsau in ka hon that kei ding, chi in TOUPA min lou in akiang ah ka na kichiamta hi.
english: “Behold, there is with you Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite of Bahurim, who cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore to him by Yahweh, saying, ‘I will not put you to death with the sword.’

paite: Huchi in moh lou in zaw koih ke'n; Mipil na hi ngal a. Atung ah bangchi in na hih dia chih ahihleh na thei mai ding. Alu a kelsam pou in sisan toh han ah na tumsak ding ahi," achi hi.
english: Now therefore don’t hold him guiltless, for you are a wise man; and you will know what you ought to do to him, and you shall bring his gray head down to Sheol with blood.”

paite: David bel apute kiang ah a-ihmu samta a, David khopi ah avui uhi.
english: David slept with his fathers, and was buried in David’s city.

paite: Israelte tung a David lal sung kum sawmli ahi. Hebron ah kum sagih alal a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum-le-thum alal hi.
english: The days that David reigned over Israel were forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

paite: Apa David laltutphah ah Solomon atu a; huchi in agam nakpitak a hihkip in ahong omta hi.
english: Solomon sat on David his father’s throne; and his kingdom was firmly established.

paite: Huan Solomon nu Bathsheba kiang ah Haggith tapa Adonijah ahoh a. Ama'n, "Hoih lam thu a hong na hi maw?" ana chi hi. Ama'n, "Hoih lam thu ah hi e,” achi hi.
english: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. She said, “Do you come peaceably?” He said, “Peaceably.

paite: "Na kiang ah banghiam gen ding ka nei hi," achi nawn a, ama'n, "Gen ve," achi hi.
english: He said moreover, I have something to tell you.” She said, “Say on.”

paite: Ama’n “Lalgam kei a ahita chih leh Israelte tengteng in leng kimpipa ding in kei ahon en gige uh chih na thei. Himahleh ka unaupa a ding in lalgam hei a om a, TOUPA sehdan in ka unaupa a ahong hita hi.
english: He said, “You know that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign. However, the kingdom is turned around, and has become my brother’s; for it was his from Yahweh.

paite: Tu in thil khat nget ding ka hon nei a, hon nial ke’n,” ahi hi. Ama’n akiang ah, “Gen ve.” achi hi.
english: Now I ask one petition of you. Don’t deny me.” She said to him, “Say on.”

paite: Ama'n, "Hehpih in kumpipa Solomon hon houpihsak inla, na thu sel lou ding ahi ngal a, Shunam mi Abishag zi ding in hon neisak in," achi hi.
english: He said, “Please speak to Solomon the king (for he will not tell you ‘no’), that he give me Abishag the Shunammite as wife.”

paite: Bathsheba in, "Hileh ake, kumpipa ka hon na houpihsak ding," achi hi.
english: Bathsheba said, “All right. I will speak for you to the king.”

paite: Bathsheba in Adonijah a dia kumpipa Solomon houpih ding in akiang ah ahohta hi. Amah mu ding in kumpipa adingh a, ama ah akun a, alaltutphah ah atuta hi. Kumpipa nu a ding in laltutphah akoihsak a; ataklam ah atu hi.
english: Bathsheba therefore went to King Solomon, to speak to him for Adonijah. The king rose up to meet her and bowed himself to her, and sat down on his throne and caused a throne to be set for the king’s mother; and she sat on his right hand.

paite: "Thil neuchik khat ka hon ngen ut hi. Hon nial mahmah ke'n," achi hi. Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Nu, hon ngen ve, ka hon phalsak lou kei ding," achi hi.
english: Then she said, “I ask one small petition of you; don’t deny me.” The king said to her, “Ask on, my mother, for I will not deny you.”

paite: Ama'n, "Shunam mi Abishag na unaupa Adonijah zi ding in neisak in," achi hi.
english: She said, “Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother as wife.”

paite: Kumpipa Solomon in adawng a, anu kiang ah, "Bangchidan a Shunam mi Abishag, Adonijah a dia ngen na hia oi? Gam leng ngetsak vanglak tanla; amah ka u avo oi. Amah a ding leh siampu Abiathar leh Zeruiah tapa Joab a ding in leng ngen tanla," achi hi.
english: King Solomon answered his mother, “Why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Ask for him the kingdom also, for he is my elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.”

paite: Kumpipa Solomon in TOUPA min lou in, "Adonijah thilnget in amah tung a sihna thu gen ahih kei himhimleh Pathian in alohloh in hon loh mai hen, huai sang a thupizaw in leng.
english: Then King Solomon swore by Yahweh, saying, “God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah has not spoken this word against his own life.

paite: TOUPA, athuchiam bang a hon hihkip, ka pa David laltutphah a hon tusak, inkuan hon na phuhkhiaksakpa ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Adonijah tuni mahmah a asihsak ngeingei ding ahi," chi in akichiamta hi.
english: Now therefore as Yahweh lives, who has established me and set me on my father David’s throne, and who has made me a house as he promised, surely Adonijah shall be put to death today.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Solomon in Jehoiada tapa Benaiah asawl a, ama'n ava sual a, athatta hi.
english: King Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell on him, so that he died.

paite: Siampu Abiathar kiang ah kumpipa'n, "Anathoth a na inn-le-lou ah pai in, si tak lah na hi ngal a. Himahleh ka pa David ma a Toupa PATHIAN bawm na na zawn zel ziak in leh ka pa haksatna thuak tengteng na na thuak sam zel ziak in, tu in zaw ka hon that kei ding,” achi hi.
