english: To Abiathar the priest the king said, “Go to Anathoth, to your own fields, for you are worthy of death. But I will not at this time put you to death, because you bore the Lord Yahweh’s ark before David my father, and because you were afflicted in all in which my father was afflicted.”

paite: Huchi in Solomon in Abiathar TOUPA siampu ahihna atawpsak hi. Hiai TOUPA'N Shiloh a Eli inkuante tungtang thu agen atangtun theihna ding ahi.
english: So Solomon thrust Abiathar out from being priest to Yahweh, that he might fulfill Yahweh’s word which he spoke concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.

paite: Huai thu Joab kiang ahong tung a, Absalom lam ah Joab apang kei na a, Adonijah lam ah apang hi. Joab TOUPA puanin ah atai a, maitam kiite alen hi.
english: This news came to Joab; for Joab had followed Adonijah, although he didn’t follow Absalom. Joab fled to Yahweh’s Tent, and held onto the horns of the altar.

paite: "TOUPA puanin ah Joab atai a, ngai in, maitam bul ah a-om," chi in kumpipa Solomon ahilh uhi. Kumpipa Solomon in Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, va sual in, chi in asawl hi.
english: King Solomon was told, “Joab has fled to Yahweh’s Tent; and behold, he is by the altar.” Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, “Go, fall on him.”

paite: Benaiah TOUPA puanin ah ahohtou a, akiang ah, "Kumpipa'n hong pawtkhia heh, achi,” achi hi. Ama'n, "Hilou e. Hiai ah ka si zaw ding,” achi hi. Benaiah in, “Joab in huchi in ahon na dawng hi,” chi in kumpipa kiang ah thu atun nawn hi.
english: Benaiah came to Yahweh’s Tent, and said to him, “The king says, ‘Come out!’” He said, “No; but I will die here.” Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, “This is what Joab said, and this is how he answered me.”

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Achih bang in hih inla, va sual inla, vui in, aziak om het lou a Joab in sisan asuahna a pan kei leh ka pa inkote na hulsak theihna ding in," achi hi.
english: The king said to him, “Do as he has said, and fall on him, and bury him, that you may take away the blood, which Joab shed without cause, from me and from my father’s house.

paite: "Amah sang a kizenzaw leh hoihzaw mi nih, Ner tapa Abner, Israelte sepaih heutu leh Jether tapa Amasa, Judahte sepaih heutu ka pa David theih louh a sual a, namsau a athah ziak in TOUPA'N alutung ah asisan akiksak nawn ding hi.
english: Yahweh will return his blood on his own head, because he fell on two men more righteous and better than he, and killed them with the sword, and my father David didn’t know it: Abner the son of Ner, captain of the army of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the army of Judah.

paite: Huaiziak in asisan uh Joab lutung leh asuante lutung ah tangtawn in akik nawn dia; David leh asuante leh a-inkote leh alaltutphah tung ah TOUPA a pan lungmuanna tangtawn in a-om nilouh ding,” achi hi.
english: So their blood will return on the head of Joab and on the head of his offspring forever. But for David, for his offspring, for his house, and for his throne, there will be peace forever from Yahweh.”

paite: Huchi in Jehoiada tapa Benaiah va hohtou in ava sual a, athatta hi. Huchi in gamdai ah amah inn mah ah vui in a-om hi.
english: Then Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up and fell on him, and killed him; and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.

paite: Kumpipa'n sepaihte tung ah asik in Jehoiada tapa Benaiah apangsak hi. Kumpipa'n Abiathar sik in Siampu Zadok apangsak hi.
english: The king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his place over the army; and the king put Zadok the priest in the place of Abiathar.

paite: Kumpipa'n Shimei asamsak a, akiang ah, "Jerusalem ah inn kilam inla huai ah teng inla, huai a pan koi dang mah ah pawt ke'n.
english: The king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, “Build yourself a house in Jerusalem, and live there, and don’t go anywhere else.

paite: Na pawt ni, Kidron lui na kan ni in na si ngeingei ding chỉh thei in. Na sisan nangmah lutung mah ah a-om ding," achi hi.
english: For on the day you go out and pass over the brook Kidron, know for certain that you will surely die. Your blood will be on your own head.”

paite: Shimei in kumpipa kiang ah, "Adik hi. TOUPA ka kumpipa'n agen bang in na sikha in ahih zel ding," achi hi. Huchi in Jerusalem ah Shimei sawtkuamtak ateng hi.
english: Shimei said to the king, “What you say is good. As my lord the king has said, so will your servant do.” Shimei lived in Jerusalem many days.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kum thum nung in Shimei sikhate lak a nih, Gath kumpipa Maakah tapa Akish kiang ah ataimang uhi. "Ngai in, na sikhate Gath ah a-om uh," chi in Shimei ahilh uhi.
english: At the end of three years, two of Shimei’s slaves ran away to Achish, son of Maacah, king of Gath. They told Shimei, saying, “Behold, your slaves are in Gath.”

paite: Shimei athou a, asabiltung avan a, asikhate zong ding in Gath a Akish kiang ah ahohta hi. Shimei in Gath a pan asikhate ava pikik hi.
english: Shimei arose, saddled his donkey, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his slaves; and Shimei went and brought his slaves from Gath.

paite: Shimei Jerusalem a pan apawt a, Gath ah hoh in ahong kik nawn chi in Solomon ahilh uhi.
english: Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and had come again.

paite: Kumpipa'n Shimei asamsak a, akiang ah, "Na pawt ni, gamdang a na pawtkhiak ni in na si ngeingei ding, chi in TOUPA min lou a hon kichiamsak in, ka hon theisak ahi kei maw? Nangmah in leng ka kiang ah, na thugen ka zak ahoih hi, na chi hi.
english: The king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, “Didn’t I adjure you by Yahweh and warn you, saying, ‘Know for certain that on the day you go out and walk anywhere else, you shall surely die’? You said to me, ‘The saying that I have heard is good.’

paite: Bangziak a TOUPA kichiamna leh ka hon thupiak zui lou na hia?" achi hi.
english: Why then have you not kept the oath of Yahweh and the commandment that I have instructed you with?”

paite: Kumpipa mah in Shimei kiang ah, "Na lungtang sunggil gitlouhdan, ka pa David tung a na gamtatdante na thei vek hi. Huchi in TOUPA'N na gitlouhna nangmah lutung ngei ah akiksak nawn ding.
english: The king said moreover to Shimei, “You know in your heart all the wickedness that you did to David my father. Therefore Yahweh will return your wickedness on your own head.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon vualzawl in a-om dia, David laltutphah TOUPA ma ah tangtawn in hihkip ahi ding,” achi hi.
english: But King Solomon will be blessed, and David’s throne will be established before Yahweh forever.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n Jehoiada tapa Benaiah thu apia hi. Amah akuan a, ava sual a, athatta hi. Huchi in gam Solomon khut a hihkip in a-omta hi.
english: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he went out, and fell on him, so that he died. The kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.

paite: Huan Siria kumpipa Ben-hadad in asepaih tengteng akaikhawm vek a, kumpipa sawmthum-le-nih atel ua, sakol leh kangtalaite toh akuantou a, Samaria khua ava um a, adouta hi.
english: Ben Hadad the king of Syria gathered all his army together; and there were thirty-two kings with him, with horses and chariots. He went up and besieged Samaria, and fought against it.

paite: Israel kumpipa Ahab kiang ah khopi sung ah mi asawl a, akiang ah, Ben-hadad in hichi in achi,
english: He sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel and said to him, “Ben Hadad says,

paite: "Na dangka leh dangka-eng kei a ahi. Na zite leh na tate, na neih hoihpente tan in leng kei a ahi," achi hi.
english: ‘Your silver and your gold are mine. Your wives also and your children, even the best, are mine.’”

paite: Israel kumpipa'n ana dawng a, "Ka toupa, kumpipa aw, na gen bang in kei leh ka neih tengteng nang a ahi," achi hi.
english: The king of Israel answered, “It is according to your saying, my lord, O king. I am yours, and all that I have.”

paite: Amisawlte apai nawn ua, Ben-hadad in hichi in achi, "Ka kiang a na dangka leh dangka-eng, na zite leh na tate na hon piak ding ahi, chi in mi hon sawl ding ka hi,
english: The messengers came again and said, “Ben Hadad says, ‘I sent indeed to you, saying, “You shall deliver me your silver, your gold, your wives, and your children;

paite: 'Zingchiang hiai hun in ka sikhate na kiang ah ka hon sawl dia, na inn leh na sikhate inn ahong mai ding uh.' Huan hichi ahi ding a, na mit late ala ding ua, ahon paipih vek ding uh," achi hi.
english: but I will send my servants to you tomorrow about this time, and they will search your house and the houses of your servants. Whatever is pleasant in your eyes, they will put it in their hand, and take it away.”’”

paite: Israel kumpipa'n agam a upa tengteng asam a, thei un, “Hiai mi in thil hoih loutak hih atupdan. Ka kiang ah mi ahon sawl a, ka zite, ka tate, ka dangka leh ka dangka-eng ahong ngen a, amah ka na nial kei hi," achi hi.
english: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, “Please notice how this man seeks mischief; for he sent to me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I didn’t deny him.”

paite: Upa tengteng leh mipi tengteng in akiang ah, "Amah na limsak dah inla, angette leng pe sam ke'n," achi uhi.
english: All the elders and all the people said to him, “Don’t listen, and don’t consent.”

paite: Ben-hadad misawlte kiang ah, "Kumpipa, ka toupa kiang ah, na sikha kiang a mi sawl a na hon nget masak tengteng bang in ka hih dia; himahleh hiai zaw ka hih kei ding," achi, chỉ un. Huchi in amisawlte apai nawn ua, huai thu ava tun uhi.
english: Therefore he said to the messengers of Ben Hadad, “Tell my lord the king, ‘All that you sent for to your servant at the first I will do, but this thing I cannot do.’” The messengers departed and brought him back the message.

paite: Ben-hadad in akiang ah mi asawl nawn a, "Kei hon zui teng in akhut dim ua apham dia kiching Samaria kho leivui nutsiat ahihleh pathiante'n alohloh hon loh uhenla, huai sang a sezaw in leng," achi hi.
english: Ben Hadad sent to him, and said, “The gods do so to me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria will be enough for handfuls for all the people who follow me.”

paite: Israel kumpipa'n adawng a, "Mi kigalthuam khinsa, agalvan suah khesa bang in ki-uangsak kei hen, chi in va hilh un,” achi hi.
english: The king of Israel answered, “Tell him, ‘Don’t let him who puts on his armor brag like he who takes it off.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, amah leh kumpipate'n puanin a zu ana dawnkhawm lai un huai thu Ben-hadad in ana za a, amite kiang ah, "Kisa dih ua," achi hi. Huchi in khua dou ding in akisata uhi.
english: When Ben Hadad heard this message as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, he said to his servants, “Prepare to attack!” So they prepared to attack the city.

paite: Huchi in ngai in, zawlnei khat in Israel kumpipa Ahab ava naih a, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hiai mipi tampite na mu hia? Ngai in, tu in na khut ah ka hon pe ding. Huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi, chih na thei ding uh," achi hi.
english: Behold, a prophet came near to Ahab king of Israel, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘Have you seen all this great multitude? Behold, I will deliver it into your hand today. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.’”

paite: Ahab in, "Kua zang in eita?" achi hi. Ama'n, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Gam sehkhente a heutu tangvalte zang in," achi hi. Ama'n, “Kua'n dou dia thu pe ding eita?” achi hi. Ama'n, "Nangmah in,” chi in adawng hi.
english: Ahab said, “By whom?” He said, “Yahweh says, ‘By the young men of the princes of the provinces.’” Then he said, “Who shall begin the battle?” He answered, “You.”

paite: Huchi in ama'n gam sehkhente a heutu tangvalte akaikhawm a, zanih sawmthum-le-nih ahi uh. Huai mite nung in mi tengteng, Israel suan tengteng akaikhawm a, sangsagih ahi uh.
english: Then he mustered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty-two. After them, he mustered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.

paite: Sun laitak in ava pawt ua, Ben-hadad leh kumpipate, amah panpih kumpipa sawmthum-le-nihte huai puanin ah zu dawnkham in ana om uh.
english: They went out at noon. But Ben Hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty-two kings who helped him.

paite: Gam sehkhente a heutu tangvalte ava pawt masa ua; Ben-hadad in mi asawl a, "Amau, Samaria a pan hong pawt a-om uh," chi in ahilh uh.
english: The young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben Hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, “Men are coming out from Samaria.”

paite: Ama'n, "Kilep tum a hong ahih uleh hingmat unla, kidou tum a hong ahih uleh leng hingmat un," achi hi.
english: He said, “If they have come out for peace, take them alive; or if they have come out for war, take them alive.”

paite: Huchi in hiai gam sehkhente a heutu tangvalte leh ahon zui sepaihte khua a pan apawt uhi.
english: So these went out of the city, the young men of the princes of the provinces, and the army which followed them.

paite: Abitum chiat uh ava that ua; huchi in Siriate ataikekta ua, Israelte'n adelh uhi. Huchi in Siria kumpipa Ben-hadad sakol tung a tuang in sakol tungtuang mite toh asuakta hi.
english: They each killed his man. The Syrians fled, and Israel pursued them. Ben Hadad the king of Syria escaped on a horse with horsemen.

paite: Israel kumpipa ava pawtkhia a, sakol leh kangtalaite ava sual a, Siriate tampi athat hi.
english: The king of Israel went out and struck the horses and chariots, and killed the Syrians with a great slaughter.

paite: Zawlnei in Israel kumpipa ava naih a, akiang ah, "Kihatsak inla, na hihdan ding ngaihtuah in kum hong beileh Siria kumpipa'n hong dou nawn ding ahi," achi hi.
english: The prophet came near to the king of Israel and said to him, “Go, strengthen yourself, and plan what you must do, for at the return of the year, the king of Syria will come up against you.”

paite: Siria kumpipa sikhate'n akiang ah, "Apathiante uh mualte pathiante ahi uh. Huaiziak a ei sang a amau hatzaw ahi uh. Phaizang ah dou lehang, amau sang ini hatzaw ngeingei ding uh," achi uhi.
english: The servants of the king of Syria said to him, “Their god is a god of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we. But let’s fight against them in the plain, and surely we will be stronger than they.

paite: "Hiai thilhih in, kumpipate avek un lakhia inla, amun uah gamuk mite koih in.
english: Do this thing: take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their place.

paite: Sepaihte, sakolte leh kangtalaite, na mansuahsa zah geih sepaihte ding khethaksak nawn in. Huchi in phaizang ah i dou ding ua, amau sang in i hatzaw na ding uhi,” achi uh. Ama'n athugen uh angaikhia a, huchibang in ahihta hi.
english: Muster an army like the army that you have lost, horse for horse and chariot for chariot. We will fight against them in the plain, and surely we will be stronger than they are.” He listened to their voice and did so.

paite: Akum nawn in hichi ahong hi a, Ben-hadad in Siriate akaikhawm a, Israelte dou ding in Aphek ah ahohtou hi.
english: At the return of the year, Ben Hadad mustered the Syrians and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel.

paite: Israel suante leng akikaikhawm ua, nek ding asekkhawm masa ua, dou ding in akisata uhi. Israel suante kelnou tawm chikchik hon nih bang lel in ava kilang ua; Siriate bel gam ah apumdim uhi.
english: The children of Israel were mustered and given provisions, and went against them. The children of Israel encamped before them like two little flocks of young goats, but the Syrians filled the country.

paite: Pathian mipa'n Israel kumpipa va naih in, ahoupih a, akiang ah, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Siriate'n, TOUPA mualte Pathian ahi a, phaizang Pathian ahi kei, achi uhi. Huaiziak in hiai mipi tampite na khut ah ka hon pe ding hi, huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi, chih na thei ding uh," achi hi.
english: A man of God came near and spoke to the king of Israel, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘Because the Syrians have said, “Yahweh is a god of the hills, but he is not a god of the valleys,” therefore I will deliver all this great multitude into your hand, and you shall know that I am Yahweh.’”

paite: Ni sagih sungtak akinangtuah nilouh uh. Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani sagih ni in akidouta ua; Israel suante'n Siria mite ni khat in sepaih nuaikhat athat uhi.
english: They encamped opposite each other for seven days. Then on the seventh day the battle was joined; and the children of Israel killed one hundred thousand footmen of the Syrians in one day.

paite: Midangte bel Aphek ah, khopi sung ah atailut ua, omlaite mi singnih-le-sangsagih kulh chim in achipkhumta hi. Ben-hadad atai a, khopi sung ah dantan sunggil ah alut hi.
english: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and the wall fell on twenty-seven thousand men who were left. Ben Hadad fled and came into the city, into an inner room.

paite: Asikhate'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, Israel inkuan lak a kumpipate mihehpih thei kumpipate ahi uh chih thu ka za uh. Sai-ip puan teng in, ka lu ua khau a kikhih in Israel kumpipa kiang ah hon va hohsak in; ama'n ahon hinghawi nuam khamoh kei ding," achi uhi.
english: His servants said to him, “See now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings. Please let us put sackcloth on our bodies and ropes on our heads, and go out to the king of Israel. Maybe he will save your life.”

paite: Huchi in sai-ip puan ateng ua, alu uah khau in akikhih ua, Israel kumpipa kiang ah ava hoh ua, "Na sikha Ben-hadad in, hehpih in hon hinghawi hen, achi," achi uhi. Ama'n, "Dam lai ahi maw? Amah ka unaupa ahi," achi hi.
english: So they put sackcloth on their bodies and ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, “Your servant Ben Hadad says, ‘Please let me live.’” He said, “Is he still alive? He is my brother.”

paite: Huai mite'n lungnuamtak in, alungsim thutak gen ahi ding chih gingta in, "Na unaupa Ben-hadad himah e," achi pah uhi. Huchi in ama'n, "Va pai unla, hon pi un," achi hi. Ben-hadad ahong pawtkhia a, akiang ah ahoh a; ama'n akangtalai ah ana tuangsak hi.
english: Now the men observed diligently and hurried to take this phrase; and they said, “Your brother Ben Hadad.” Then he said, “Go, bring him.” Then Ben Hadad came out to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.

paite: Ben-hadad in akiang ah, “Ka pa'n na pa a pan khua ana lakte ka hon pekik ding. Ka pa'n Samaria a sumsinna munte a bawl bang in Damaskas ah sumsinna munte na bawl sam ding hi. Huchibang a thu kikhung in ka hon paisak ding hi," achi hi. Huchi in akiang ah thu akhung a, apaisakta hi.
english: Ben Hadad said to him, “The cities which my father took from your father I will restore. You shall make streets for yourself in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria.” “I”, said Ahab, “will let you go with this covenant.” So he made a covenant with him and let him go.

paite: Zawlnei tapate lak a mi khat in TOUPA thu in alawmpa kiang ah, "Hon khen in," achi a; huai mi in akhen ut kei hi.
english: A certain man of the sons of the prophets said to his fellow by Yahweh’s word, “Please strike me!” The man refused to strike him.

paite: Huchi in akiang ah, "TOUPA thu na man louh ziak in, ngai in, mual na hon khupsantak in, humpinelkai in ahon na kei ding," achi hi. Mual akhuptak in humpinelkai in atuak a, athat hi.
english: Then he said to him, “Because you have not obeyed Yahweh’s voice, behold, as soon as you have departed from me, a lion will kill you.” As soon as he had departed from him, a lion found him and killed him.

paite: Huchi in midang ava mu nawn a, "Hon khen in," achi a; huai mi in akhen a, aliamta hi.
english: Then he found another man, and said, “Please strike me.” The man struck him and wounded him.

paite: Huchi in zawlnei apai a, lampi ah kumpipa ana tang a, amai a vut nuh in ana kibawl lamdang hi.
english: So the prophet departed and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with his headband over his eyes.

paite: Kumpipa ahong tun in kumpipa ana sam a, "Kei na sikha kidouna lak ah ka tailut a; ngai in, mi khat ahong kilehhei a, ka kiang ah mi khat ahon pi a, hiai mi na veng in, ataimangleh ahinna sik in na hinna na tan dia, ahihkeileh dangka talent khat na piak ding ahi," achi hi.
english: As the king passed by, he cried to the king, and he said, “Your servant went out into the middle of the battle; and behold, a man came over and brought a man to me, and said, ‘Guard this man! If by any means he is missing, then your life shall be for his life, or else you shall pay a talent of silver.’

paite: "Kei na sikha ka pumbuai ziak in ana paimangta hi," achi hi. Israel kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Huchibang geih in na tung a thu khen ahi ding, nangmah in thu khen khin na hi ve," achi hi.
english: As your servant was busy here and there, he was gone.” The king of Israel said to him, “So shall your judgment be. You yourself have decided it.”

paite: Ama'n amai a pan vut alakhezok a; Israel kumpipa'n zawlneite lak a mi ahi chih atheita hi.
english: He hurried, and took the headband away from his eyes; and the king of Israel recognized that he was one of the prophets.

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Hihsiatgawp dia ka sehsa mi khat na paisak ziak in ahinna sik in nang hinna, amite sik in na mite na tan ding," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Because you have let go out of your hand the man whom I had devoted to destruction, therefore your life will take the place of his life, and your people take the place of his people.’”

paite: Israel kumpipa bel nguitak leh lungkim loutak in apai a, Samaria khua ahong tungta hi.
english: The king of Israel went to his house sullen and angry, and came to Samaria.

paite: Huan huai thilte nung in hichi ahong hi a, Jezreel mi Naboth in Jezreel ah grephuan anei a, huai Samaria kumpipa Ahab inn kiang a om hi.
english: After these things, Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard which was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

paite: Ahab in Naboth kiang ah, "Ka inn kiang a om ahih ziak in antehlouhing huan ding in na grephuan hon pia in. Asik in grephuan hoihzaw ka hon pe ding. Ahihkei a na deih zawkleh lah adangka in ama'n hun ding ka hon pe ding," chi in agen hi.
english: Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying, “Give me your vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near my house; and I will give you for it a better vineyard than it. Or, if it seems good to you, I will give you its worth in money.”

paite: Naboth in Ahab kiang ah, "TOUPA'N ka pu ka pate gou nang ka hon piak ding aphal kei," achi hi.
english: Naboth said to Ahab, “May Yahweh forbid me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers to you!”

paite: Jezreel mi Naboth in huchibang thu akiang a agen ziak in Ahab ngui leh lungkim loutak in a-inn ah alut hi; ka pu ka pate gou ka hon pe thei het kei ding, achi bikbek ngal a. Huchi in alupna ah alum a, khat lam anga a, an ane kei hi.
english: Ahab came into his house sullen and angry because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him, for he had said, “I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers.” He laid himself down on his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.

paite: Huchi in azi Jezebel ava hoh a, akiang ah, "Bangchidan ahia na lungsim huchitak a alungkham a, an na nek louh?" achi hi.
english: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said to him, “Why is your spirit so sad that you eat no bread?”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Naboth kiang ah, na grephuan hon leisak in, ahihkeileh na deih zawkleh asik in grephuan dang ka hon pe ding ka chi hi. Ama'n, ka grephuan zaw ka hon pe thei het kei ding, chi in ahon dawng a ahi," achi hi.
english: He said to her, “Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite, and said to him, ‘Give me your vineyard for money; or else, if it pleases you, I will give you another vineyard for it.’ He answered, ‘I will not give you my vineyard.’”

paite: Azi Jezebel in akiang ah, "Israel gam kumpipa na hi kei a hia? Thou inla, an ne inla, lungsim nuamtak in om in. Ke'n Jezreel mi Naboth grephuan ka hon pe ding," achi hi.
english: Jezebel his wife said to him, “Do you now govern the kingdom of Israel? Arise, and eat bread, and let your heart be merry. I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.”

paite: Huchi in Ahab min in laithonte agelh a, Ahab suainamna in suai anam a, Naboth invengte a-upate leh makaite kiang ah akhak hi.
english: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters to the elders and to the nobles who were in his city, who lived with Naboth.

paite: Laithonte ah, "An ngolh na puang unla, mipi lak ah Naboth ma kaisak un.
english: She wrote in the letters, saying, “Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

paite: Belial tate mi nih ama ah tusak unla, nang Pathian leh kumpipa na gensia hi, chi a amah hek ding mi ana bawl un. Huchi in amah pikhia unla, suang in ana denglum un," achi hi.
english: Set two men, wicked fellows, before him, and let them testify against him, saying, ‘You cursed God and the king!’ Then carry him out, and stone him to death.”

paite: Atenna khua a upate leh makaite'n Jezebel in akiang ua akhak laithon akigelh bang in ana hihta uhi.
english: The men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had instructed them in the letters which she had written and sent to them.

paite: An ngolh apuang ua, mipi lak ah Naboth a makaisak uhi.
english: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

paite: Belial tate mi nih hong pai in ama ah ava tu ua; Belial tate'n mipite ma ah, Naboth in Pathian leh kumpipa agensia, chi in amah ahek uhi. Huchi in khua a pan apokhia ua, suang in adeng ua, asita hi.
english: The two men, the wicked fellows, came in and sat before him. The wicked fellows testified against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, “Naboth cursed God and the king!” Then they carried him out of the city and stoned him to death with stones.

paite: Jezebel kiang ah, "Naboth suang in adeng ua, asita," chih hilh ding in mi asawl uhi.
english: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, “Naboth has been stoned and is dead.”

paite: Jezebel in Naboth suang in adeng ua, asita chih azak in hichi ahong hi a, Jezebel in Ahab kiang ah, "Thou inla, Jezreel mi Naboth grephuan, ahon leisak phal louh neita aw le. Naboth adam nawnta kei, asita hi," achi hi.
english: When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned and was dead, Jezebel said to Ahab, “Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money; for Naboth is not alive, but dead.”

paite: Ahab in Naboth asita chih azak in hichi ahong hi a; Jezreel mi Naboth grephuan nei dia kuansuk ding in Abab athouta hi.
english: When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.

paite: Tishbi mi Elijah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
english: Yahweh’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

paite: "Thou inla, Samaria a om Israel kumpipa houpih ding in hohsuk in. Ngai in, Naboth grephuan ah a-om a, neih tum in huai ah ahohsuk hi.
english: “Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who dwells in Samaria. Behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone down to take possession of it.

paite: Akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Na that a, na neihsak behlap lai maw? chi inla, akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, ui in Naboth sisan aliahna mun mah ah nang sisan leng aliak ding uh' na chi ding," achi hi.
english: You shall speak to him, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “Have you killed and also taken possession?”’ You shall speak to him, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth, dogs will lick your blood, even yours.”’”

paite: Ahab in Elijah kiang ah, "Na hong muta maw, ka melmapa?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Hon muta ka hi ve; TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou hih dia nang leh nang na kikhotkhiak tak ziak in.
english: Ahab said to Elijah, “Have you found me, my enemy?” He answered, “I have found you, because you have sold yourself to do that which is evil in Yahweh’s sight.

paite: Ngai in na tung ah thil hoih lou ka tungsak dia, na suante ka lamang dia, Ahab a pan a ta pasal taphot Israel gam a mi zalen hi in zalen lou hitaleh ka satkhe ding.
english: Behold, I will bring evil on you, and will utterly sweep you away and will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, and him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel.

paite: Nang na hon hehsak ziak in leh Israelte thil na hihkhelhsak ziak in Nebat tapa Jeroboam inkote leh Ahijah tapa Baasha inkote bang mai in na inkote ka bawl ding," achi hi.
english: I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation with which you have provoked me to anger, and have made Israel to sin.”

paite: Jezebel tungtang thu leng TOUPA'N agen a, "Jezebel khokulh chin ah uite'n ane ding uh.
english: Yahweh also spoke of Jezebel, saying, “The dogs will eat Jezebel by the rampart of Jezreel.

paite: Ahab inkote lak a mi khopi a si peuhmah uite'n ane ding ua; gam a si peuhmahte tung a leng vasate'n ane ding uh," achi hi.
english: The dogs will eat whoever dies of Ahab in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat whoever dies in the field.”

paite: Azi Jezebel tohthoh a TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou hih dia amah-le-amah kikhawngkhia Ahab bang mi kuamah a-om kei hi.
english: But there was no one like Ahab, who sold himself to do that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.

paite: TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a delhkhiaksa Amorte thilhih chiteng bang in milimte bia in thilkihhuaitak ahih hi.
english: He did very abominably in following idols, according to all that the Amorites did, whom Yahweh cast out before the children of Israel.

paite: Ahab in huai thu azak in hichi ahong hi a, apuan abotkek a, sai-ip puan asilh hi. An angawl a, sai-ip puan ah alum a, kidawmtak in apai hi.
english: When Ahab heard those words, he tore his clothes, put sackcloth on his body, fasted, lay in sackcloth, and went about despondently.

paite: TOUPA thu Tishbi mi Elijah kiang ah ahong tung hi.
english: Yahweh’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

paite: "Ka ma a Ahab akiniamkhiakdan na mu hia? Akiniamkhiak ziak in adamsung in hiai thil hoih lou ka tungsak kei dia, atapa damsung in bel a-inkote tung ah hiai thil hoih lou ka tungsak ding," achi hi.
english: “See how Ahab humbles himself before me? Because he humbles himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days; but I will bring the evil on his house in his son’s day.”

paite: Huan kum thum sung Siriate leh Israelte kidou lou in a-om uhi.
english: They continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.

paite: Akum thum kum in hichi ahong hi a, Israel kumpipa kiang ah Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat ahohsuk hi.
english: In the third year, Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.

paite: Israel kumpipa'n asikhate kiang ah, "Ramoth-gilead khua ei a ahi chih thei napi a, bangchidan a Siria kumpipa khut a pan sutkhe lou a mawk om i hi ua oi?" achi hi.
english: The king of Israel said to his servants, “You know that Ramoth Gilead is ours, and we do nothing, and don’t take it out of the hand of the king of Syria?”

paite: Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ramoth-gilead ah galdou ding in kei toh na hong kuan diam?" achi hi. Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "Kei leh nang, ka mite leh na mite pum khat i hi ua, ka sakol leh na sakol pum khat ahi ve ua le," achi hi.
english: He said to Jehoshaphat, “Will you go with me to battle to Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”

paite: Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "Tuni in TOUPA thu dong in, chi in ka hon ngen," achi hi.
english: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for Yahweh’s word.”

paite: Huchi in Israel kumpipa'n zawlnei mi zali asamkhawm a, akiang uah, "Ramoth-gilead khua dou ding in ka kuantou diam, kuantou lou ding?" achi hi. Amau, "Kuan in, Toupa'n kumpipa khut ah ahon pe ding,” achi uh.
english: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said to them, “Should I go against Ramoth Gilead to battle, or should I refrain?” They said, “Go up; for the Lord will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

paite: Himahleh Jehoshaphat in, "Hiai ah TOUPA zawlnei dang kuahiam bek i dot ding om lou hia?" achi hi.
english: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of Yahweh, that we may inquire of him?”

paite: Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "TOUPA hon dotsak ding mi khat Imlah tapa Mikaiah om lai veh aw. Himahleh amah ka hua hi; ka tungtang thu ahoih lou lam lou ngal agen ngei kei," achi hi. Jehoshaphat in, "Kumpipa'n hichibang in chi kei hen," achi hi.
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of Yahweh, Micaiah the son of Imlah; but I hate him, for he does not prophesy good concerning me, but evil.” Jehoshaphat said, “Don’t let the king say so.”

paite: Huchi in Israel kumpipa'n heutu khat asam a, "Kintak in Imlah tapa Mikaiah va pi mah dih," achi hi.
english: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Quickly get Micaiah the son of Imlah.”

paite: Israel kumpipa leh Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat bel Samaria kongpi lutna gei phaizang ah akumpipa uh puan a kithuam in alaltutphah tuaktuak uah atu ua, zawlnei tengteng in ama uah thu agen uhi.
english: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting each on his throne, arrayed in their robes, in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.

paite: Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in sik kiite abawlsak a, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hiaite in Siriate mangthang sipsip khop in na hihse ding chi in," achi hi.
english: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘With these you will push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’”

paite: Huchi mah bang in zawlnei tengteng in, "Ramoth-gilead ah va hohtou inla, va lohching in, TOUPA'N kumpipa khut ah ahon pe ding," chi in agen uhi.
english: All the prophets prophesied so, saying, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead and prosper; for Yahweh will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

paite: Mikaiah sam dia sawl a ompa'n akiang ah, "Ngai dih, zawlneite'n thukhat sat in ahoih lam in kumpipa kiang ah thu agen chiat uh. Agen khitsa bang un gen sam inla, ahoih lam in va gen in," chi in angen hi.
english: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “See now, the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Please let your word be like the word of one of them, and speak good.”

paite: Mikaiah in, "TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi, TOUPA'N ka kiang ah agen mah ka va gen ding," achi hi.
english: Micaiah said, “As Yahweh lives, what Yahweh says to me, that I will speak.”

paite: Kumpipa kiang atuntouh in, kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Mikaiah, Ramoth-gilead khua dou ding in ka kuantou diam, kuantou lou ding?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Kuantou inla, va lohching in; TOUPA'N kumpipa khut ah ahon pe ding," achi hi.
english: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall we forbear?” He answered him, “Go up and prosper; and Yahweh will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang ah, “Thutak kia lou ngal ka kiang a TOUPA min agen lou dia bangzah vei ahia ka hon kichiamsak ding?" achi hi.
english: The king said to him, “How many times do I have to adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in Yahweh’s name?”

paite: Ama'n, "Israel tengteng ching ding nei lou belam bang in tang a dalhzak in ka mu hi. TOUPA'N, hiaite'n heutu aneita kei ua, michih ama inn chiat ah lungmuangtak in pai hen achi," achi hi.
english: He said, “I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. Yahweh said, ‘These have no master. Let them each return to his house in peace.’”

paite: Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ka tungtang thu ahoih lou lam kia lou ngal, ahoih lam himhim agen kei ding chih ka hon hilh ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”

paite: Ama'n, "Huaiziak in TOUPA thu ngaikhe dih, TOUPA alaltutphah tung a tu, van a mipi tengteng ataklam leh veilam a dinghte toh ka mu hi.
english: Micaiah said, “Therefore hear Yahweh’s word. I saw Yahweh sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.

paite: TOUPA'N, Ramoth-gilead a hohtou a, gal a si dia kua'n Ahab kunzou ding ahia? achi hi. Khat in hichibang in, midang in huchibang in," achi uh.
english: Yahweh said, ‘Who will entice Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One said one thing, and another said another.

paite: Huchi in kha khat ahong pawt a, TOUPA ma ah adingh a, "Ke'n ka kunzou ding," achi hi.
english: A spirit came out and stood before Yahweh, and said, ‘I will entice him.’

paite: TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Bang in eita? achi hi. Ama'n ka va hoh dia, azawlnei teng muk ah kha zuauthei ka va suak ding, achi hi. Ama'n va kun mah inla, na lohching lai ding. Va kuan inla, huchibang in va hih ve leh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to him, ‘How?’ He said, ‘I will go out and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ He said, ‘You will entice him, and will also prevail. Go out and do so.’

paite: "Huaiziak in tu in ngai in, TOUPA'N hiai na zawlnei teng muk ah kha zuauthei akoih a, na tungtang thu ahoih lou lam TOUPA'N agen khinta," achi hi.
english: Now therefore, behold, Yahweh has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these your prophets; and Yahweh has spoken evil concerning you.”

paite: Huchi in Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in ahon naih a, Mikaiah biang ahong beng a, "TOUPA Kha in na kiang a thu gen ding in kei a pan koilam ah ahia apai?" achi hi.
english: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did Yahweh’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”

paite: Mikaiah in, "Ngai in, dantan sunggil a kibu dia na lut ni in na thei ding," achi hi.
english: Micaiah said, “Behold, you will see on that day when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”

paite: Israel kumpipa'n, "Mikaiah pi unla, khopi ukpipa Ammon leh kumpi tapa Joash kiang ah paipih nawn un," achi hi.
english: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king’s son.

paite: Kumpipa'n hichi in achi, "Hiai mi suangkul ah khum unla, galmuang a ka hong pai nawn masiah gimthuakna an leh gimthuakna tui na pia un," achi hi.
english: Say, ‘The king says, “Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.”’”

paite: Mikaiah in, "Galmuang a na hong pai nawnleh TOUPA'N kei zang a thu gen lou ahi ding," achi hi. Amah mah in, "Nou, mipite aw, na vek un na za un," achi hi.
english: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, Yahweh has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, all you people!”

paite: Huchi in Ramoth-gilead ah Israel kumpipa leh Jehoshaphat ahohtou uh.
english: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.

paite: Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ka kibawl lamdang dia, kidouna ah ka hohtou dia; nang bel na kumpi puan silh in," achi hi. Huchi in Israel kumpipa akibawl lamdang a, kidouna ah ahohtou hi.
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself and go into the battle, but you put on your robes.” The king of Israel disguised himself and went into the battle.

paite: Siria kumpipa'n akangtalai tung a heutu sawmthum-le-nihte kiang ah, "Israel kumpipa kia lou ngal mineu leng, milian leng akuamah sual kei un," chi in thu apia hi.
english: Now the king of Syria had commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.”

paite: Kangtalai tung a heutute'n Jehoshaphat amuh un, hichi ahong hi a, "Israel kumpipa ahi mah ve," achi uh. Huchi in sual tum in a-umta ua; Jehoshaphat akikoukhia hi.
english: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “Surely that is the king of Israel!” and they came over to fight against him. Jehoshaphat cried out.

paite: Kangtalai tung a heutute'n Israel kumpipa ana hi kei chih atheih un hichi ahong hi a, adelh lai uh anungkiksan uhi.
english: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

paite: Mi khat in tup tuam nei lou in athalpeu alai a, Israel kumpipa kithopna kikaltak ah akapkhata hi. Huchi in akangtalai hawlpa kiang ah, "Kaihei inla, sepaihte lak a pan hon pawtpih in, ka liam," achi hi.
english: A certain man drew his bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor. Therefore he said to the driver of his chariot, “Turn around, and carry me out of the battle, for I am severely wounded.”

paite: Huai ni in kidouna athupi mahmah a; kumpipa akangtalai tung a kingai in Siriate lam nga in a-opsuk a, nitaklam in asita a; aliamna a pan sisan kangtalai sung ah aluang hi.
english: The battle increased that day. The king was propped up in his chariot facing the Syrians, and died at evening. The blood ran out of the wound into the bottom of the chariot.

paite: Nitum kuan in sepaihte lak ah, "Michih amah khua ah, michih amah gam ah pai vek hen," chi in thu puankhiak ahi.
english: A cry went throughout the army about the going down of the sun, saying, “Every man to his city, and every man to his country!”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa asita a, Samaria khua alutpih ua; huchi in Samaria ah kumpipa avui uh.
english: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.

paite: Samaria khua dil khat ah kangtalai asil ua; TOUPA thugen bang in uite'n asisan aliaksiang ua, agalvan leng asilsiang uh. Huai dil bel kizuakte kisilna dil ahi.
english: They washed the chariot by the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood where the prostitutes washed themselves, according to Yahweh’s word which he spoke.

paite: Huchi in Ahab tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng, saiha inn alamte, akhosat tengteng Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he built, and all the cities that he built, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Huchi in apute kiang ah Ahab a-ihmuta a; asik in atapa Ahaziah ahong lalta hi.
english: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.

paite: Israel kumpipa Ahab lal akum lina ah, Judahte tung ah Asa tapa Jehoshaphat alal pan hi.
english: Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

paite: Jehoshaphat alal kipat in kum sawmthum-le-nga ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-nga vai ahawm hi. Anu min Azubah ahi a, amah Shilhi tanu ahi.
english: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

paite: Apa Asa lampi tot tengteng atawn a; pialsan het lou in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi. Himahleh mun sangte alamang kei a, mun sangte ah mite kithoih lai in gimlim ahal lailai uhi.
english: He walked in all the way of Asa his father. He didn’t turn away from it, doing that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes. However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.

paite: Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa toh kilemna abawl hi.
english: Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.

paite: Huchi in Jehoshaphat tanchin dangte, athilhihtheihdan ahihlat thute, agaldou thute Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he showed, and how he fought, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Apa Asa dam lai a pasal kizuak omlaite, agam a pan adelhkhe vek hi.
english: The remnant of the sodomites, that remained in the days of his father Asa, he put away out of the land.

paite: Edom gam ah kumpipa a-om kei a, thuneihna piaksawn mi khat in vai ahawm hi.
english: There was no king in Edom. A deputy ruled.

paite: Jehoshaphat in Ophir a pai a dangka-eng po ding Tarshish longte abawl hi. Himahleh Ezion-geber mun ah longte asiat khit vek ziak in ahohta kei hi.
english: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but they didn’t go, for the ships wrecked at Ezion Geber.

paite: Huchi in Ahab tapa Ahaziah in Jehoshaphat kiang ah, na sikhate toh longte ah ka sikhate kuankhawm le uh ake, achi a; himahleh Jehoshaphat in lem asa kei.
english: Then Ahaziah the son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, “Let my servants go with your servants in the ships.” But Jehoshaphat would not.

paite: Huchi in apute kiang ah Jehoshaphat a-ihmuta a, apute lak ah apu David khopi ah avui ua; asik in atapa Jehoram alalta hi.
english: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city. Jehoram his son reigned in his place.

paite: Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat lal akum sawm-le-sagih kum in Samaria ah, Israelte tung ah Ahab tapa Ahaziah alal pan a, Israelte tung ah kum nih alal hi.
english: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned two years over Israel.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a, anu leh apa lampi totte, Nebat tapa Israelte thil hihkhialsakpa Jeroboam lampi totte atawn sam hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, in which he made Israel to sin.

paite: Apa hih teng hih in Baal nna sem in abia a, TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian ahehsak hi.
english: He served Baal and worshiped him, and provoked Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger in all the ways that his father had done so.

paite: Huan Solomon in Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh toh kizolhna abawl hi. Pharaoh tanu akitenpih a, ama inn ding leh TOUPA' inn ding alam khit ma leh Jerusalem kulh a-umsuak masiah David khopi ah a omsak hi.
english: Solomon made a marriage alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt. He took Pharaoh’s daughter and brought her into David’s city until he had finished building his own house, Yahweh’s house, and the wall around Jerusalem.

paite: Mipite kia mun sangte ah akithoih ua, huai ma in TOUPA min a dia inn akilam nai takdih louh ziak in.
english: However, the people sacrificed in the high places, because there was not yet a house built for Yahweh’s name.

paite: Solomon in TOUPA a-it a, apa David dan thusehte azui a; mun sangte a kithoih in, gimlimte kia ana hal hi.
english: Solomon loved Yahweh, walking in the statutes of David his father, except that he sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

paite: Kithoih ding in Gibeon ah kumpipa ahoh hi; huai lah mun sang poimohtak ahi ngal a. Solomon in huai maitam tung ah halmang thillat sangkhat alan hi.
english: The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for that was the great high place. Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.

paite: Gibeon ah zan in Solomon kiang ah amang in TOUPA ahong kihil hi. Pathian in akiang ah, "Ngen in, bang ahia ka hon piak ding?" achi hi.
english: In Gibeon, Yahweh appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God said, “Ask for what I should give you.”

paite: Solomon in, "Na sikha, ka pa David na mitmuh a thutak leh diktatna leh lungtang diktak pu a a-om bang in, nang akiang ah hehpihna thupi mahmah na langsak hi. Nang hiai hehpihna thupi mahmah ama a ding in na guan a, nang alaltutphah a tu ding tapa na pia a, tuni a ahong om petmah bang in.
english: Solomon said, “You have shown to your servant David my father great loving kindness, because he walked before you in truth, in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with you. You have kept for him this great loving kindness, that you have given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is today.

paite: Aw TOUPA, ka Pathian, nang na sikha, ka pa David sik in kumpipa in na hon bawlta hi. Kei zaw naupang leltak ka hi a; thu tung lam leh pawt lam leng ka thei kei hi.
english: Now, Yahweh my God, you have made your servant king instead of David my father. I am just a little child. I don’t know how to go out or come in.

paite: Na sikha, na mitelte, mi tampi, atam ziak ua sim seng vual louh leh azah theihseng vuallouhte lak ah a-om hi.
english: Your servant is among your people which you have chosen, a great people, that can’t be numbered or counted for multitude.

paite: Huaiziak in na mite vai hawmsak ding in na sikha theihsiamna lungtang pia in, huchi a asia leh apha ka khenkak theihna ding in. Na mi hiai zah zouzai kua'n ahia vai hawmsak thei ding?" achi hi.
english: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this great people of yours?”

paite: Solomon in huai ngen a, athugen in TOUPA akipaksak hi.
english: This request pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.

paite: Pathian in akiang ah, "Na damsawtna ding, nang a dia hauhsaknate, na melmate sihna ding ngen lou a, vaihawm siamna dia theihsiamna na nget zawk ziak in;
english: God said to him, “Because you have asked this thing, and have not asked for yourself long life, nor have you asked for riches for yourself, nor have you asked for the life of your enemies, but have asked for yourself understanding to discern justice,

paite: ngai in, na nget bang in ka hihta hi. Ngai in, pilna leh theihsiamna lungtang ka hon pia hi. Huchi in na ma ah nang bang kuamah a-om kei ding ua, na nung in leng nang bang kuamah ahong om sam kei ding.
english: behold, I have done according to your word. Behold, I have given you a wise and understanding heart, so that there has been no one like you before you, and after you none will arise like you.

paite: Na nget louh, hauhsakna leh zahtakhuaina leng ka hon pe lai hi. Huchi in na damsung in kumpipate lak ah nang bang a-om kei ding uh.
english: I have also given you that which you have not asked, both riches and honor, so that there will not be any among the kings like you for all your days.

paite: Na pa David in azuih bang a ka dan thusehte leh ka thupiakte zui dia ka lampite a na paileh ka hon damsawtsak lai ding hi,” achi hi.
english: If you will walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as your father David walked, then I will lengthen your days.”

paite: Solomon akhanglou lou a, ngai in, mang ana hi. Huchi in Jerusalem ah ahoh a, TOUPA thukhun bawm ma ah adingh a, halmang thillat leh lemna thillatte alan a, asikhate tengteng a ding in ankuang alui hi.
english: Solomon awoke; and behold, it was a dream. Then he came to Jerusalem and stood before the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, and offered up burnt offerings, offered peace offerings, and made a feast for all his servants.

paite: Kizuak numei nih kumpipa kiang ah ahong ua, ama ah ava dingh uhi.
english: Then two women who were prostitutes came to the king, and stood before him.

paite: Numei khat in, "Aw ka toupa, hiai numei toh inn khat a tengkhawm ka hi ua; huai inn a amah toh ka om lai un nau ka nei hi.
english: The one woman said, “Oh, my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house. I delivered a child with her in the house.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ka nau neih nung ani thum ni in hiai numei in leng nau anei sam hi. Omkhawm ka hi ua; huai inn a om koute gel lou, kuamah mikhual om a-om kei hi.
english: The third day after I delivered, this woman delivered also. We were together. There was no stranger with us in the house, just us two in the house.

paite: Zan in hiai numei ta ana si a; ama'n adelhlup khak ahi.
english: This woman’s child died in the night, because she lay on it.

paite: Zan lai in athou a, na sikhanu a-ihmut kal in, ka sik a ka tapa ana la a, apom a, ama ta si pen ka ang ah ana sial hi.
english: She arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me while your servant slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.

paite: Zingsang a ka ta nawi pe dia ka thohleh, ngai in, ana si khin hi. Himahleh zingsang a ka etchetleh ngai in, ka suan ka tapa pen ana hi kei," achi hi.
english: When I rose in the morning to nurse my child, behold, he was dead; but when I had looked at him in the morning, behold, it was not my son whom I bore.”

paite: Numei dang in, "Hilou e. Ahing pen kei tapa ahi a, asi pen nang tapa ahi," achi hi. Khat in, "Hilou, asi pen na tapa ahi a, ahing pen ka tapa ahi,” achi tinten hi. Huchibang in kumpipa ma ah agen tuaktuak uhi.
english: The other woman said, “No! But the living one is my son, and the dead one is your son.” The first one said, “No! But the dead one is your son, and the living one is my son.” They argued like this before the king.

paite: Kumpipa'n, "Khat in, ahing pen ka tapa ahi a, asi pen na tapa ahi,” achi hi. Khat pen in, "Hilou, asi pen na tapa ahi, ahing pen ka tapa ahi zaw, achi zel hi," achi hi.
english: Then the king said, “One says, ‘This is my son who lives, and your son is the dead one;’ and the other says, ‘No! But your son is the dead one, and my son is the living one.’”

paite: Kumpipa'n, "Namsau hon va lak un," achi hi. Huchi in kumpipa ma ah namsau ahon tawi uhi.
english: The king said, “Get me a sword.” So they brought a sword before the king.

paite: Kumpipa'n, "Naungek hing pen tum nih suah unla, akimkhat khat pia unla, adang khat kiang ah akimkhat pia un," achi hi.
english: The king said, “Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.”

paite: Naungek hing pen nu in ata alainat mahmah ziak in kumpipa kiang ah, "Aw ka toupa, naungek hing pen amah pe mai in, that mahmah ke'n," achita hi. Khat pen in, "Kei a hi tuan dah henla, nang a leng lah hi tuan kei heh. Himahleh tumtan hi hen," achita hi.
english: Then the woman whose the living child was spoke to the king, for her heart yearned over her son, and she said, “Oh, my lord, give her the living child, and in no way kill him!” But the other said, “He shall be neither mine nor yours. Divide him.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n adawng a, "Naungek hing pen that kei unla, amah pia un. Amah anu ahi,” achi hi.
english: Then the king answered, “Give the first woman the living child, and definitely do not kill him. She is his mother.”

paite: Israel tengteng in huai thu a kumpipa thukhendan ana za ua; kumpipa alau uh. Vaihawm ding in Pathian pilna amah ah a-om chih athei uhi.
english: All Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king, for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him to do justice.

paite: Huchi in Kumpipa Solomon tuh Israel tengteng kumpipa ahong hita hi.
english: King Solomon was king over all Israel.

paite: Hiaite amiliante ahi uh: Zadok tapa Azariah siampu ahi.
english: These were the princes whom he had: Azariah the son of Zadok, the priest;

paite: Shisha tapa Elihoreph leh Ahiah laigelhmi ahi uh. Ahilud tapa Jehoshaphat tanchin gelhmi ahi.
english: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;

paite: Jehoiada tapa Benaiah sepaih heutu ahi a; Zadok leh Abiathar siampu ahi uh.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the army; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;

paite: Nathan tapa Azariah heutute tung a mi ahi a; Nathan tapa Zabud siampu leh kumpipa lawm ahi khawm hi.
english: Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers; Zabud the son of Nathan was chief minister, the king’s friend;

paite: Ahishar insung lam heutu ahi a; Abda tapa Adoniram phutluih nasemte heutu ahi.
english: Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the men subject to forced labor.

paite: Solomon in Israel tengteng tung ah heutu sawm-le-nih anei hi. Huaite'n kumpipa a ding leh a-inkote a ding in nek-le-tak angaihtuah zel uhi. Mi khat in kum khat in kha khat zel nek ding tak ding ape zel hi.
english: Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided food for the king and his household. Each man had to make provision for a month in the year.

paite: Hiaite amin uh ahi: Ephraim tanggam ah Ben-hur.
english: These are their names: Ben Hur, in the hill country of Ephraim;

paite: Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth-shemesh leh Elon-beth-hanan ah dil Ben-deker ahi.
english: Ben Deker, in Makaz, in Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh, and Elon Beth Hanan;

paite: Arubboth ah Ben-hesed ahi a, ama'n Sokoh leh Hepher gam teng leng atangkhawm hi.
english: Ben Hesed, in Arubboth (Socoh and all the land of Hepher belonged to him);

paite: Dor gam tengteng ah Ben- abinadab ahi a, ama'n Solomon tanu Taphath zi in anei hi.
english: Ben Abinadab, in all the height of Dor (he had Taphath, Solomon’s daughter, as wife);

paite: Tanak khua leh Meggiddo khote, Jezreel kho nuai, Zarethan khochin a om Beth-shean bial teng ah, Beth-shean apan Abel-meholah, Jokmeam gam bul tan in Ahilud tapa Baana ahi.
english: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth Shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;

paite: Ramoth-gilead ah Ben-geber ahi a, ama'n Manasseh tapa Jair khote, Gilead gam a omte atangkhawm hi. Bashan gam a Argob bial, kho thupi taktak sawmguk, kulh leh akalhna daltawn neite leng atangkhawm hi.
english: Ben Geber, in Ramoth Gilead (the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead, belonged to him; and the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, sixty great cities with walls and bronze bars, belonged to him);

paite: Mahanaim ah Iddo tapa Ahinadab ahi.
english: Ahinadab the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;

paite: Naphtali ah Ahimaaz ahi a, ama'n leng Solomon tanu Basemath zi in anei hi.
english: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali (he also took Basemath the daughter of Solomon as wife);

paite: Asher leh Bealoth khua ah Hushai tapa Baana ahi a;
english: Baana the son of Hushai, in Asher and Bealoth;

paite: Issakar ah Paruah tapa Jehoshaphat;
english: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar;

paite: Benjamin ah Elah tapa Shimei;
english: Shimei the son of Ela, in Benjamin;

paite: Amorte kumpipa Sihon leh Bashan kumpipa Og gam, Gilead gam ah Uri tapa Geber ahi a, Amah huai gam heutu omsun ahi.
english: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer who was in the land.

paite: Judahte leh Israelte tuipi piau a piaunel zah mahmah in atam ua, ane un adawn ua, nuamtak in a-om zel uhi.
english: Judah and Israel were numerous as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and making merry.

paite: Solomon in lui a pan Philistiate gam leh Aigupta gamgi pha in gam teng ah vai ahawm hi. Thilpiakte ahon tawi zel ua, Solomon damsung teng a-nna asem uhi.
english: Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the River to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt. They brought tribute and served Solomon all the days of his life.

paite: Solomon ni khat an nekkhiak, tangbuang nel mahmah pota sawmthum leh tangbuang pota sawmguk;
english: Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty cors of fine flour, sixty measures of meal,

paite: bawngtal thautak sawm, gam a bawngtal sawmnih leh belam zakhat ahi uh. Hiaite lou leng sakhite, sangaite, sakhital, ak vak thaute leng ahi lai uhi.
english: ten head of fat cattle, twenty head of cattle out of the pastures, and one hundred sheep, in addition to deer, gazelles, roebucks, and fattened fowl.

paite: Lui gal khen lam gam teng, Tiphsah a pan Gaza tan, lui gal khen lam a kumpipate tung ah alal hi. Akimvel a mi teng toh kilem in a-om hi.
english: For he had dominion over all on this side of the River, from Tiphsah even to Gaza, over all the kings on this side of the River; and he had peace on all sides around him.

paite: Solomon damsung in Judahte leh Israelte Dan a pan Beer-sheba tan in michih amau grep leh theipi chinna nuai ah bittak in ateng chiat uhi.
english: Judah and Israel lived safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.

paite: Solomon in kangtalai kai sakol singli leh sakol tungtuangmi singkhat-le-sangnih anei hi.
english: Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.

paite: Hiai heutute'n amau tankha kha in Solomon leh kumpipa Solomon dohkan hong um teng nek ding apia ua, piak kim louh anei ngei kei uh.
english: Those officers provided food for King Solomon, and for all who came to King Solomon’s table, every man in his month. They let nothing be lacking.

paite: Michih in ahih dia seh bang dungzui in a-omna ding mun ah sakolte leh gan taihat mahmahte a ding in barli buh leh buhpawlte ahon pua uhi.
english: They also brought barley and straw for the horses and swift steeds to the place where the officers were, each man according to his duty.

paite: Pathian in Solomon pilna leh theihsiamna thupi mahmah leh lungsim letna tuipi piau a piaunel bang mai apia hi.
english: God gave Solomon abundant wisdom, understanding, and breadth of mind like the sand that is on the seashore.

paite: Solomon pilna in suahlam ta tengteng pilna leh Aigupta mite pilna tengteng akhup vek hi.
english: Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east and all the wisdom of Egypt.

paite: Mi tengteng sang in apilzaw a, Mahol tapate, Ezrah mi Ethan, Heman, Kalkol leh Darda sang in leng. Huchi in akim a nam tengteng lak ah amin athangkheta hi.
english: For he was wiser than all men—wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol; and his fame was in all the nations all around.

paite: Paunak sangthum agen a, alate sangkhat leh nga ahi uh.
english: He spoke three thousand proverbs, and his songs numbered one thousand five.

paite: Sing tanchin, Lebanon tang a Sidar sing a pan kulhbaang a hong selkhia hissop tan in agen hi. Gamsate tanchin, vasate tanchin, bokvak a paite tanchin leh ngasate tanchin leng agen hi.
english: He spoke of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon even to the hyssop that grows out of the wall; he also spoke of animals, of birds, of creeping things, and of fish.

paite: Huchi in Solomon pilna ngaikhe ding in nam tengteng a pan apilna zasate leh lei a kumpipa teng ahong pai uhi.
english: People of all nations came to hear the wisdom of Solomon, sent by all kings of the earth who had heard of his wisdom.

paite: Huan Tura kumpipa Hiram in Solomon kiang ah asikhate asawl hi; apa mun ah kumpipa in amah thau anilh uh chih lah ana zata ngal a. Hiram in David a-it gige him ahi.
english: Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon, for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the place of his father, and Hiram had always loved David.

paite: Solomon in mi sawl in Hiram kiang ah,
english: Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,

paite: "Ka pa David in TOUPA'N akhepek nuai a akoih masiah akimvel a mun chih mual chih a kidounate ziak a TOUPA a Pathian min a dia inn alam theihlouhdan na thei hi.
english: “You know that David my father could not build a house for the name of Yahweh his God because of the wars which were around him on every side, until Yahweh put his enemies under the soles of his feet.

paite: Tu in TOUPA ka Pathian in mun chih mual chih ah muanna ahon neisakta hi. Melma leh vangsiatna leng a-om kei hi.
english: But now Yahweh my God has given me rest on every side. There is no enemy and no evil occurrence.

paite: Ngai dih, TOUPA'N ka pa David kiang ah, 'Na tapa na sik a na laltutphah ka luahsak ding in ka min a ding in inn ahon lam ding, chi a ana gensa bang in, TOUPA ka Pathian min a ding in inn lam ka tum hi.'
english: Behold, I intend to build a house for the name of Yahweh my God, as Yahweh spoke to David my father, saying, ‘Your son, whom I will set on your throne in your place shall build the house for my name.’

paite: Huaiziak in tu in Lebanon tang a sidar singte hon phuksak ding in thu pia inla, ka sikhate leng na sikhate lak ah ahong tel sam ding ua, na sikhate loh ahihleh na chih peuhmah ka hon pe ding. Zidon mite bang a sing phuksiam ka lak uah kuamah a-om kei uh, chih lah na thei ngal a," chi in agensak hi.
english: Now therefore command that cedar trees be cut for me out of Lebanon. My servants will be with your servants; and I will give you wages for your servants according to all that you say. For you know that there is nobody among us who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Hiram in Solomon thu azak in akipak mahmah hi. "Hiai mi tampi tung a vaihawm dia tapa piltak David pepa TOUPA tuni in phat in om hen," achi hi.
english: When Hiram heard the words of Solomon, he rejoiced greatly, and said, “Blessed is Yahweh today, who has given to David a wise son to rule over this great people.”

paite: Huchi in Hiram in Solomon kiang ah, "N'on thukhah ka na za hi. Sidar sing thu leh meilah sing thu na deih peuhmah ka hih ding.
english: Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, “I have heard the message which you have sent to me. I will do all your desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning cypress timber.

paite: Ka sikhate'n Lebanon tang a pan tuipi pha in ahon lasuk ding ua, n'on mun sehsak a tuipi a tolh ding in ka gaklopsak ding hi. Huai ah ka phelsak dia, nang na na la ding hi. Nang leng ka inkote nek ding tum in ka deih na hon hihsak sam ding," chi in mi asawl hi.
english: My servants will bring them down from Lebanon to the sea. I will make them into rafts to go by sea to the place that you specify to me, and will cause them to be broken up there, and you will receive them. You will accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.”

paite: Huchi in Hiram in sidar sing leh meilah sing Solomon deih teng apia hi.
english: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar timber and cypress timber according to all his desire.

paite: Solomon in Hiram inkote nek ding in buh pota singnih leh sathau suk pota sawmnih apia hi. Hiai Solomon in kum teng a Hiram apiakdan ahi.
english: Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand cors of wheat for food to his household, and twenty cors of pure oil. Solomon gave this to Hiram year by year.

paite: TOUPA'N achiam bangtak in Solomon pilna apia hi. Hiram leh Solomon kikal ah kilemna a-om a; anih un kilemna thukhun abawl uhi.
english: Yahweh gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him. There was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty together.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon in Israel tengteng lak ah phutluih nasemmi abawl a; amau mi singthum ahi uh.
english: King Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.

paite: Lebanon ah kha khat a kikheng zel in singkhat asawl zel hi. Kha khat Lebanon ah a-om ua, kha nih amau inn ah. Phutluih nasem mite heutu Adoniram ahi.
english: He sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: for a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home; and Adoniram was over the men subject to forced labor.

paite: Solomon in tangte ah thil pomi singsagih leh suangsekmi singgiat anei hi.
english: Solomon had seventy thousand who bore burdens, and eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains,

paite: Huaite sim louh in Solomon in anasep tung a heutu tuam, nasep vengmi sangthum-le-zathum anei lai hi.
english: besides Solomon’s chief officers who were over the work: three thousand three hundred who ruled over the people who labored in the work.

paite: Kumpipa thupiak in inn suangphum dia lep ding in suang lian pipi, suang mantam pipi leh suang seksa ahon pua uhi.
english: The king commanded, and they cut out large stones, costly stones, to lay the foundation of the house with worked stone.

paite: Inn lam mite, Solomon mite leh Hiram mite leh Gebal mite'n suangte asek ua, huai inn lamna ding in sing leh suangte abawl uhi.
english: Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders and the Gebalites cut them, and prepared the timber and the stones to build the house.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante apawt nung uh kum zali-le-sawmgiatna kum, Israelte tung a Solomon lal akum lina, Ziv kha, akha nihna in TOUPA' inn lam apan uhi.
english: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Ziv, which is the second month, he began to build Yahweh’s house.

paite: Solomon in TOUPA a dia a-inn lam adunglam tong sawmguk ahi a, availam tong sawmnih ahi, asanlam tong sawmthum ahi.
english: The house which King Solomon built for Yahweh had a length of sixty cubits, and its width twenty, and its height thirty cubits.

paite: Huai inn a Mun Siangthou malam a inlim availam tan tong sawmnih a sau ahi a, amalam a pen availam tong sawm ahi.
english: The porch in front of the temple of the house had a length of twenty cubits, which was along the width of the house. Ten cubits was its width in front of the house.

paite: Inn a ding in tohlet neuchik vathangkalh om in abawl hi.
english: He made windows of fixed lattice work for the house.

paite: Huai inn baang kimvel leh tempul baang kimvel in tempul mun baang kimvel leng huai inn baang si in inn chial nei alam hi.
english: Against the wall of the house, he built floors all around, against the walls of the house all around, both of the temple and of the inner sanctuary; and he made side rooms all around.

paite: Akimvel in dantan abawl a; achial nuainungpen availam tong nga ahi a, alai a pen availam tong guk ahi. Athumna availam tong sagih ahi. Kalvaite ahihleh inn baang a kigolh akiphamoh kei; inn polam ah akimvel in baang ah akingakna akibawl ziak ahi.
english: The lowest floor was five cubits wide, and the middle was six cubits wide, and the third was seven cubits wide; for on the outside he made offsets in the wall of the house all around, that the beams should not be inserted into the walls of the house.

paite: Huai inn alam lai un suang alaihna mun a seksa vek a bawl ahi. Huchi in alam sung un sek ging, heipi ging leh sik vanzat ging huai inn ah zak ahi kei hi.
english: The house, when it was under construction, was built of stone prepared at the quarry; and no hammer or ax or any tool of iron was heard in the house while it was under construction.

paite: Dantan laita pente kongpi huai inn taklam pang ah a-om a; alaita ah kahna kivial in akahtou ua, alaita a pan athumna tan ah.
english: The door for the middle side rooms was in the right side of the house. They went up by winding stairs into the middle floor, and out of the middle into the third.

paite: Huchi in huai inn ahon lam a, azou a, inn bel sidar inkam leh apek in akhuh hi.
english: So he built the house and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar.

paite: Inchial neite akisituah vek in tong nga chiat a sang in alam a; huaite sidar sing sige toh apeh hi.
english: He built the floors all along the house, each five cubits high; and they rested on the house with timbers of cedar.

paite: Solomon kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: Yahweh’s word came to Solomon, saying,

paite: "Hiai inn na lam laitak tungtang thu, ka dan thusehte na pom a, ka vaihawmte na zuih a, ka thupiak tengteng zui dia na pom peuhmahleh, na pa David kiang a ka gensa, huai ka thu na tung ah ka hihkip ding.
english: “Concerning this house which you are building, if you will walk in my statutes, and execute my ordinances, and keep all my commandments to walk in them, then I will establish my word with you, which I spoke to David your father.

paite: Israel suante lak ah ka teng dia, ka mi Israelte ka limsak lou kei ding," achi hi.
english: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.”

paite: Huchi in Solomon in huai inn alam a, azouta hi.
english: So Solomon built the house and finished it.

paite: Inn sunglam baang ding in sidar singpek azang a; apialkhang a pan atunglam baang pha in asunglam ah sing abelh vek hi. Apialkhang ding in meilah singpek aphahbeh hi.
english: He built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar; from the floor of the house to the walls of the ceiling, he covered them on the inside with wood. He covered the floor of the house with cypress boards.

paite: Inn phaitam lam tong sawmnih pen pialkhang a pan baangte tan in sidar singpek vek in abawl a; biakna mun, Mun Siangthoupen a ding in leng asunglam ah azang hi.
english: He built twenty cubits of the back part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the ceiling. He built this within, for an inner sanctuary, even for the most holy place.

paite: Huai inn, abiakna munpi adunglam tong sawmli ahi.
english: In front of the temple sanctuary was forty cubits long.

paite: Huai insung lam ah apakmum leh apakpalh limgelh kilawm sidar sing a khuak a-om a; avek in sidar sing vek ahi a; suang himhim muh ahi kei hi.
english: There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers. All was cedar. No stone was visible.

paite: TOUPA thukhun bawm koihna ding in huai insung ah biakna lam ah mun abawl hi.
english: He prepared an inner sanctuary in the middle of the house within, to set the ark of Yahweh’s covenant there.

paite: Huai, biakna mun sung adunglam tong sawmnih, availam tong sawmnih, asanlam tong sawmnih ahi a, dangka-eng hul ngen in aluan a; sidar sing a bawl maitam leng aluan hi.
english: Within the inner sanctuary was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in width, and twenty cubits in its height. He overlaid it with pure gold. He covered the altar with cedar.

paite: Huchi in Solomon in huai insung dangka-eng hul ngen in aluan a; biakna mun malam dangka-eng khainiang in adaikaih a; huai dangka-eng in aluan hi,
english: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold. He drew chains of gold across before the inner sanctuary, and he overlaid it with gold.

paite: Huai in avek a azoh pha in apumpi in dangka-eng in aluan tawmtawm hi. Biakna mun maitam pumpi leng dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: He overlaid the whole house with gold, until all the house was finished. He also overlaid the whole altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary with gold.

paite: Biakna mun ah tong sawm tuaktuak a sang, cherub nih olive sing in abawl hi.
english: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.

paite: Cherub kha khat pen tong nga ahi a, cherub kha langkhat pen tong nga mah ahi. Akha mong khat a pan akha langkhat mong kikal tong sawm ahi.
english: Five cubits was the length of one wing of the cherub, and five cubits was the length of the other wing of the cherub. From the tip of one wing to the tip of the other was ten cubits.

paite: Cherub khat pen leng tong sawm ahi a; cherubte akikim geih un, akibang geih uhi.
english: The other cherub was ten cubits. Both the cherubim were of one measure and one form.

paite: Cherub khat sanlam tong sawm ahi a, cherub khat pen leng huai toh kikim mah ahi.
english: One cherub was ten cubits high, and so was the other cherub.

paite: Cherubte insung gilzaw ah akoih a; cherubte kha akizak a, khat kha in baang langkhat lam ava khoih a, cherub khat pen kha in leng baang langkhat akhoih a; huai inn laitak ah akha uleh akha uh akisukhatuah uhi.
english: He set the cherubim within the inner house. The wings of the cherubim were stretched out, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the middle of the house.

paite: Huai cherubte dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.

paite: Inn baang tengteng akimvel in cherubte, tum sing leh pakpalh limte gelh kilawm insung lam leh polam ah abawl hi.
english: He carved all the walls of the house around with carved figures of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, inside and outside.

paite: A-inn pialkhang sunglam leh polam dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: He overlaid the floor of the house with gold, inside and outside.

paite: Biakna mun lutna ding in olive sing kongkhak abawl a; kongpi lutung leh kongpi biangte abaang seh nga suah seh khat chiat ahi.
english: For the entrance of the inner sanctuary, he made doors of olive wood. The lintel and door posts were a fifth part of the wall.

paite: Huchi in olive sing inn kongkhak nih abawl a; huai ah cherubte tum sing leh pakpalh limte gelh kilawm in abawl hi. Huai dangka-eng in aluan a; cherubte leh tum singte dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: So he made two doors of olive wood; and he carved on them carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold. He spread the gold on the cherubim and on the palm trees.

paite: Tempul lutna ding in abaang seh li suah seh khat chia in olive kongpi khuam abawl lai hi.
english: He also made the entrance of the temple door posts of olive wood, out of a fourth part of the wall,

paite: Meilah sing kongkhak nih toh; kongkhak khat a pek nihte kheptheih ahi a, kongkhak khat pen apek nih leng kheptheih ahi.
english: and two doors of cypress wood. The two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.

paite: Huaite ah cherubte tum sing leh pakpalh limte agelh a; huai gelh kilawm mamtak in dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: He carved cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold fitted on the engraved work.

paite: Tempul huangsung intual sunggilzaw pen suangsek chial thum leh sidar singpek thuah khat in abawl hi.
english: He built the inner court with three courses of cut stone and a course of cedar beams.

paite: Akum lina, Ziv kha in TOUPA inn suangphum lep khit ahi.
english: The foundation of Yahweh’s house was laid in the fourth year, in the month Ziv.

paite: Akum sawm-le-khatna, Bul kha, akha giatna in huai inn zuih ding bangbang, bangkim mansa vek ahi. Huchi in kum sagih sung alam hi.
english: In the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, the house was finished throughout all its parts and according to all its specifications. So he spent seven years building it.

paite: Huan Solomon in a-inn kum sawm-le-thum alam a, huchi in a-inn pumpi alamzou vekta hi.
english: Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

paite: Lebanon gammang inn, khuamvual li, khuam tung a sidar singpek tung ah alam a; adunglam tong zakhat ahi. Availam tong sawmnga ahi a, asanlam tong sawmthum ahi.
english: For he built the House of the Forest of Lebanon. Its length was one hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits, on four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams on the pillars.

paite: Huai khuam a kinga dantan sawmli-le-nga tunglam ah sidar singphel a khuh ahi a; vual khat ah sawm-le-nga zel ahi.
english: It was covered with cedar above over the forty-five beams that were on the pillars, fifteen in a row.

paite: Vual thum ah tohlette a-om a, vak leh vakte bel vual thum in akigalsai vek uhi.
english: There were beams in three rows, and window was facing window in three ranks.

paite: Kongkhak leh khuam tengteng singpek aning li nei a bawl ahi a, vak leh vakte vual thum in akigalsai vek uhi.
english: All the doors and posts were made square with beams; and window was facing window in three ranks.
