paite: Inn lim khuam nei abawl a; adunglam tong sawmnga ahi a, availam tong sawmthum ahi. Huaite ma ah akhuamte leh ama a lutna tung kah toh inlim abawl hi.
english: He made the hall of pillars. Its length was fifty cubits and its width thirty cubits, with a porch before them, and pillars and a threshold before them.

paite: Avaihawmna ding laltutphah inlim, vaihawmna inlim, avaihawmna ding abawl hi. Huai pialkhang langkhat a pan langkhat pha a sidar sing a khuh ahi.
english: He made the porch of the throne where he was to judge, even the porch of judgment; and it was covered with cedar from floor to floor.

paite: Ama tenna ding in, inn lim nung a, huangsung intual dang nei om pen huchi mah bang a bawl ahi. Huai inlim mah bang in Solomon in zi a Pharaoh tanu aneih, inn ding leng alamsak lai hi.
english: His house where he was to dwell, the other court within the porch, was of the same construction. He made also a house for Pharaoh’s daughter (whom Solomon had taken as wife), like this porch.

paite: Hiai tengteng suang manpha pipi, ahun geihgeih a sek zel suang, atna a at a lam ahi. Sunglam leng, polam leng asuangphum a pan alek pha in, huchi mah bang in polam ah huangsung intual lianpi tanpha in.
english: All these were of costly stones, even of stone cut according to measure, sawed with saws, inside and outside, even from the foundation to the coping, and so on the outside to the great court.

paite: Suangphum suang manpha pipi, suang lian pipi, suang tong sawm leh suang tong giatte a lep ahi.
english: The foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits and stones of eight cubits.

paite: Huai tunglam ah suang manpha pipi, suang ahun geihgeih zel a sek leh sidar sing ahi.
english: Above were costly stones, even cut stone, according to measure, and cedar wood.

paite: Akimvel in huangsung intual lianpi suangsek chial thum leh sidar singpek thuah khat a um ahi. TOUPA' inn huangsung intual sunggilzaw leh inn inlim mah bang in.
english: The great court around had three courses of cut stone with a course of cedar beams, like the inner court of Yahweh’s house and the porch of the house.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon in Tura a pan mi sawl in, Hiram asam hi.
english: King Solomon sent and brought Hiram out of Tyre.

paite: Huai mi Naphtali nam meithai tapa ahi a, apa Tura khomi, dalsekmi ahi. Amah dalsek lam himhim ah apil in atheisiam in akhutsiam petmah hi. Kumpipa Solomon kiang ah ahoh a, a-nna tengteng asepsak vek hi.
english: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in bronze; and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill to work all works in bronze. He came to King Solomon and performed all his work.

paite: Dal khuam nih, tong sawm-le-giat a sang; akimvel a teh a tong sawm-le-nih a lian tuaktuak abawl hi.
english: For he fashioned the two pillars of bronze, eighteen cubits high apiece; and a line of twelve cubits encircled either of them.

paite: Khuam lu a koih ding dal sunbawk nih abawl a; bawk khat sanlam tong nga ahi a, bawk khat pen sanlam tong nga mah ahi.
english: He made two capitals of molten bronze to set on the tops of the pillars. The height of the one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits.

paite: Khuampite dawn ah lubawkte gial im-iam leh kihek nginngian a-om a; hiai lubawk kisuangsawn bel khainiang kiphan sagih, bawk khat pen a ding in leng sagih mah a kituam ahi.
english: There were nets of checker work and wreaths of chain work for the capitals which were on the top of the pillars: seven for the one capital, and seven for the other capital.

paite: Huchi in khuamte abawl a; khuam lu a bawkte tuamna ding in gial im-iam khat tung ah akimvel vual nih a-om a; huchi mah bang in khat tung ah leng a-om lai hi.
english: So he made the pillars; and there were two rows of pomegranates around the one network, to cover the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; and he did so for the other capital.

paite: Inn lim a khuam dawn a bawk ah lili lim atuang a, huai tong li ahi.
english: The capitals that were on the top of the pillars in the porch were of lily work, four cubits.

paite: Khuam nih dawn a bawkte gei ah gial im-iam kiang ah theibuhfaite a-om a; theibuhfaite bel huai bawkte ah zanih tuaktuak a volh in a-om uhi.
english: There were capitals above also on the two pillars, close by the belly which was beside the network. There were two hundred pomegranates in rows around the other capital.

paite: Tempul inlim ah khuamte adingsak a; taklam khuam adingsak a, amin Jakin asa a; veilam khuam leng adingsak a; amin Boaz asa hi,
english: He set up the pillars at the porch of the temple. He set up the right pillar and called its name Jachin; and he set up the left pillar and called its name Boaz.

paite: Khuamte dawn ah lili lim atuang a; huchi in khuam lam nasep teng zohsiang ahita.
english: On the tops of the pillars was lily work. So the work of the pillars was finished.

paite: Dal tuibem lianpi, tong sawm, asanlam tong nga asung a; agei tong sawmthum kimvel ahi.
english: He made the molten sea ten cubits from brim to brim, round in shape. Its height was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits encircled it.

paite: Agei nuai ah pakmum lim in akimvel vek a, tong sawm ahi a, tuibem kimvel in a-om hi. Huai pakmumte vual nih in a-om ua, sunkhawm pah ahi.
english: Under its brim around there were buds which encircled it for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The buds were in two rows, cast when it was cast.

paite: Huai bawngtal sawm-le-nih tung ah akinga a, thum in mallam anga ua, thum in tumlam anga ua, thum in simlam anga ua, thum in suahlam anga uhi. Atung uah tuibem akitung a, ameilam un asunglam adoh hi.
english: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set on them above, and all their hindquarters were inward.

paite: Khutpek chia a sah ahi a; agei lili pak bang, nou gei bang a bawl ahi. Bath sangnih takna ahi.
english: It was a hand width thick. Its brim was worked like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It held two thousand baths.

paite: Dal in tunsawnna sawm abawl a; tunsawnna khat sau lam tong li ahi a, availam tong li mah ahi a, asanlam tong thum ahi.
english: He made the ten bases of bronze. The length of one base was four cubits, four cubits its width, and three cubits its height.

paite: Tunsawnna bawldan hichibang ahi. Huai in kuak anei a, huai kuakte ageite kikal ah a-om hi.
english: The work of the bases was like this: they had panels; and there were panels between the ledges;

paite: Ageite kikal a kuakte ah humpinelkaite, bawngtalte leh cherubte atuang ua; agei tungte ah tunsawnna a-om hi. Humpinelkaite leh bawngtalte nuailam ah kilawmsaknate a-om dindian hi.
english: and on the panels that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubim; and on the ledges there was a pedestal above; and beneath the lions and oxen were wreaths of hanging work.

paite: Tunsawnnate ah dal kangtalai li leh dal tung chih a-om chiat a; aning lite ah kingakna a-om chiat hi. Kisilna nuailam ah akingakna sun a-om a, asik chiat ah kilawmsakna a-om chiat hi.
english: Every base had four bronze wheels and axles of bronze; and its four feet had supports. The supports were cast beneath the basin, with wreaths at the side of each.

paite: Valh gong sung tong khat ahi; akam kimvel valh bang a bem ahi a, tong khat-le-akim ahi. Akam gei kimvel gial kilawm ahi a, akuakte ning li ahi a, abem kei uh.
english: Its opening within the capital and above was a cubit. Its opening was round like the work of a pedestal, a cubit and a half; and also on its opening were engravings, and their panels were square, not round.

paite: Akuak nuailam ah kangtalai lite a-om ua; kangtalai tungchihte tunsawnna ah a-om uhi. Kangtalai sandan tong khat-le-akim ahi,
english: The four wheels were underneath the panels; and the axles of the wheels were in the base. The height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.

paite: Huai kangtalaite bawldan sakol kangtalai khe bawldan bang ahi a; atungchihte, avalhte, asutkalhnate leh laibawkte avek a sun ahi.
english: The work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel. Their axles, their rims, their spokes, and their hubs were all of cast metal.

paite: Tunsawnna ning li chiat ah kingakna li a-om a; huai kingaknate tunsawnna toh pum khat vek ahi uh.
english: There were four supports at the four corners of each base. Its supports were of the base itself.

paite: Tunsawnna tung ah valh, tong kimkhat a sang a-om a; tunsawnna tung a atunna khete leh akuakte pum khat vek ahi.
english: In the top of the base there was a round band half a cubit high; and on the top of the base its supports and its panels were the same.

paite: Atunna khepekte leh akuakte ah azat bangbang in cherubte, humpinelkaite leh tum singte atuangsak a, akimvel in kilawmsakna a-om dindian hi.
english: On the plates of its supports and on its panels, he engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees, each in its space, with wreaths all around.

paite: Huchibang vek in tunsawnna sawm abawl a; avek in pum khat a sun ahi chiat ua, kikim chiat, bawldan kibang geih ahi chiat uh.
english: He made the ten bases in this way: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one form.

paite: Kisilna bel sawm dal in abawl a; kisilna bel khat in bath sawmli adong a; kisilna bel tong li chiat ahi uh. Tunsawnna sawm tung ah kisilna bel khat akitung chiat hi.
english: He made ten basins of bronze. One basin contained forty baths. Every basin measured four cubits. One basin was on every one of the ten bases.

paite: Tunsawnnate inn taklam pang ah nga atung a, inn veilam pang ah nga mah. Tuibem pen inn taklam pang ah suahlam ah simlam nga in atung hi.
english: He set the bases, five on the right side of the house and five on the left side of the house. He set the sea on the right side of the house eastward and toward the south.

paite: Hiram in kisilna belte, vutluahte, maiphiat kuangte abawl a, huchi in TOUPA inn a dia Solomon abawlsak teng azousiangta hi.
english: Hiram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram finished doing all the work that he worked for King Solomon in Yahweh’s house:

paite: Khuam nihte, khuam dawn a bel bang a bawk nihte, khuam dawn a bel ban a bawk nih tuamna gial im-iam nihte,
english: the two pillars; the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars;

paite: tuamna gial im-iam nih a dia theibuhfai zalite, khuam dawn a bel bang a bawk nih tuamna ding gial im-iam tuaktuak a dia theibuhfai vual nihte;
english: the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks; two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars;

paite: tunsawnna sawm leh tunsawnna tung a kisilna bel sawmte;
english: the ten bases; the ten basins on the bases;

paite: tuibem khat leh tuibem nuai a bawngtal sawm-le-nihte,
english: the one sea; the twelve oxen under the sea;

paite: belte, vutluahte leh maiphiat kuangte toh. Tui-um belsuan tengteng TOUPA' inn a dia Hiram in kumpipa Solomon abawlsak dal nawttet a bawl vek ahi.
english: the pots; the shovels; and the basins. All of these vessels, which Hiram made for King Solomon for Yahweh’s house, were of burnished bronze.

paite: Jordan Phaizang ah Sukkoth leh Zarethan kikal a bellei omna ah hiai teng kumpipa'n asung hi.
english: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan.

paite: Huai tui-um belsuan tengteng atam mahmah ziak in Solomon in buk khe lou in akoih a; dal bukzah pen theihkhiak ahi kei hi.
english: Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because there were so many of them. The weight of the bronze could not be determined.

paite: Solomon in TOUPA' inn a tui-um belsuan om tengteng abawl a; dangka-eng maitam leh tanghou koihna dohkan dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: Solomon made all the vessels that were in Yahweh’s house: the golden altar and the table that the show bread was on, of gold;

paite: Mun siangthoupen ma a khawnvak koihnate, taklam a nga leh veilam a ngate dangka-eng siang in; pakte, khawnvakte leh taitehte dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: and the lamp stands, five on the right side and five on the left, in front of the inner sanctuary, of pure gold; and the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs, of gold;

paite: Noute, khawnvak puantehnate, maiphiat kuangte, keute leh mei laknate dangka-eng siang in; insung gilzaw, Mun Siangthoupen kongkhakte leh inn, tempul, kongkhak bulhnate dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: the cups, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans, of pure gold; and the hinges, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, of the temple, of gold.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Solomon in TOUPA' inn a dia abawl tengteng azouvekta hi. Huchi in Solomon in apa David in ana latkhitsa dangka chite, dangka-eng leh tui-um belsuante alalut a, TOUPA' inn a goute lak ah akoihta hi.
english: Thus all the work that King Solomon did in Yahweh’s house was finished. Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated—the silver, the gold, and the vessels—and put them in the treasuries of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huchi in Solomon in Israel upate, anam intekpen tengteng Israel suan inkuan a lupente, Jerusalem a kumpipa Solomon kiang ah David khopi, Zion a pan TOUPA thukhun bawm zawngtou ding in akaikhawm vek hi.
english: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel with all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel, to King Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of Yahweh’s covenant out of David’s city, which is Zion.

paite: Israel mi tengteng Ethanim kha, akha sagihna ah, ankuangluina ah kumpipa Solomon kiang ah akikaikhawm vek uhi.
english: All the men of Israel assembled themselves to King Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.

paite: Israel upa tengteng ahong ua, siampute'n bawm azawng uhi.
english: All the elders of Israel came, and the priests picked up the ark.

paite: TOUPA bawm leh Kihoupihna Puanin leh puanin a tui-um belsuan siangthou tengteng tan in siampute leh Levi chite'n azawngtou uhi.
english: They brought up Yahweh’s ark, the Tent of Meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent. The priests and the Levites brought these up.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon leh Israel suan omkhawm tengteng akiang a hong kikhawmte bawm ma ah a-omkhawm uh. Belam leh bawngtal atam ziak a sim seng vual louh leh azah theihseng vual louh in akithoih uhi.
english: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, who were assembled to him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.

paite: Siampute'n TOUPA thukhun bawm omna ding, insung a biakna mun a Mun Siangthoupen ah cherubte kha nuai ah alalut uhi.
english: The priests brought in the ark of Yahweh’s covenant to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most holy place, even under the cherubim’s wings.

paite: Cherubte'n bawm omna tung zawn ah akha uh azak gige ngal ua, cherubte'n bawm leh azawnna chiangtawnte ahuap vek uhi.
english: For the cherubim spread their wings out over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.

paite: Azawnna chiangtawn asau mahmah ziak in, azawnna chiangtawn mongte biakna mun ma, mun siangthou a pan amuh theih hi. Himahleh inn polam ah zaw adawk kei, tuni tan huai ah a-om nilouh hi.
english: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the holy place before the inner sanctuary, but they were not seen outside. They are there to this day.

paite: Aigupta gam a pan apawt ua TOUPA Israel suante toh thu akhun lai a Mosi in Horeb tang a suangpek nih akoihte kia lou ngal, huai bawm sung ah bangmah dang a-om kei.
english: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when Yahweh made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, siampute Mun Siangthou a pan ahong pawt khiaktak un meipi in TOUPA' inn ahong dim meuhmouh hi.
english: It came to pass, when the priests had come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled Yahweh’s house,

paite: Meipi ziak in siampute nasem in a-om thei kei uh. TOUPA thupina in TOUPA' inn lah adimsak vek ngal a.
english: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house.

paite: Solomon in thu agen a: "TOUPA'N, mial bikbek ah ka om ding," achi hi.
english: Then Solomon said, “Yahweh has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

paite: "Na tenna ding in, tangtawn a na om gigena ding inn ka hon lamsak petmah hi,” achi hi.
english: I have surely built you a house of habitation, a place for you to dwell in forever.”

paite: Kumpipa akinunghei a, Israel kikaikhawm tengteng avualzawl a, Israel kikaikhawm tengteng adingh dipdep uhi.
english: The king turned his face around and blessed all the assembly of Israel; and all the assembly of Israel stood.

paite: Ama'n, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian, ka na David kiang a amah kam mahmah a,
english: He said, “Blessed is Yahweh, the God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David your father, and has with his hand fulfilled it, saying,

paite: Aigupta gam a pan ka mi Israelte ka pikhiak ni a pan Israel nam lak a koi lai khua leng ka min omna ding, inn lamna ding ka tel ngei kei hi. Himahleh ka mi Israelte heutu ding in David ka tel hi, chi a ana genpa, amah khut mahmah a hon pichingsakpa phat in om hen.
english: ‘Since the day that I brought my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house, that my name might be there; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.’

paite: "Ka pa David in Israelte' Pathian, TOUPA min dia inn lam alungsim in ana tum hi.
english: “Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N ka pa David kiang ah, 'Na lungsim in ka min a ding in inn lam na tum a, hichibang lungsim na put na hihhoih hi.
english: But Yahweh said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart.

paite: Himahleh nang zaw, inn na lam kei ding. Na tapa, na khal a hong pawtkhe ding in ka min a ding in inn alam zaw ding," ana chi hi.
english: Nevertheless, you shall not build the house; but your son who shall come out of your body, he shall build the house for my name.’

paite: "TOUPA'N athugen ahihkip a; TOUPA'N ana chiamsa bang ngei in ka pa David mun ka hon luah in, Israel laltutphah ah ka hong tuta a, Israelte' Pathian, TOUPA min a ding in inn ka na lamta ngei hi.
english: Yahweh has established his word that he spoke; for I have risen up in the place of David my father, and I sit on the throne of Israel, as Yahweh promised, and have built the house for the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: Huai ah bawm omna ding mun ka na sep a, huai ah Aigupta gam a pan apikhiak lai a i pute uh kiang a athukhun, TOUPA thukhun a-om,” achi hi.
english: There I have set a place for the ark, in which is Yahweh’s covenant, which he made with our fathers when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.”

paite: TOUPA maitam ma, Israel hong kikhawm tengteng muh in Solomon adingh a, van lam ah akhut azaktou hi.
english: Solomon stood before Yahweh’s altar in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven;

paite: "AW TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian, na sikha lungtang tengteng na mitmuh a omte kiang a thukhun tangtun a hehpihna hihlang zel, na sikha ka pa David kiang a thuchiam tangtunpa, tunglam ah leh nuailam lei ah nang bang Pathian dang a-om kei.
english: and he said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, there is no God like you, in heaven above, or on earth beneath; who keeps covenant and loving kindness with your servants who walk before you with all their heart;

paite: Ahi, nang na kam in thu na gen a, na khut in na hon lohchingsakta a, tuni a, hong omta ngei bang in.
english: who has kept with your servant David my father that which you promised him. Yes, you spoke with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is today.

paite: Huaiziak in aw TOUPA Israelte' Pathian, na sikha ka pa David kiang a, na suante ka mitmuh a na om bang a ka mitmuh a om sam ding a a-omdan uh apilvan peuhmah uleh ka mitmuh in Israelte laltutphah a tu ding na tatlak kei ding, chi a na chiam tangtun in.
english: Now therefore, may Yahweh, the God of Israel, keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him, saying, ‘There shall not fail from you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your children take heed to their way, to walk before me as you have walked before me.’

paite: Aw Israelte' Pathian, na sikha ka pa David kiang a thu na gensa hehpih in tungsak in."
english: “Now therefore, God of Israel, please let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David my father.

paite: "Himahleh lei ah Pathian ateng mahmah dia hia? Ngai in, van leh vante' van a leng ta lou na hi a; hiai ka inn lam ah nak tat tuak kei na tel chia!
english: But will God in very deed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less this house that I have built!

paite: Himahleh TOUPA ka Pathian, tuni a na sikha in ahon sapna thumna, athusam ngaihkhiaksak in, na sikha thumna leh ngetna hon limsak in.
english: Yet have respect for the prayer of your servant and for his supplication, Yahweh my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer which your servant prays before you today;

paite: Hiai mun lam nga a na sikha in thum a thu asam ding ngaikhia a, nang, huai ah ka min a-om ding, na chihna mun ngei a, inn lam a sun leh zan a na mit ahah gige theihna ding in.
english: that your eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which you have said, ‘My name shall be there;’ to listen to the prayer which your servant prays toward this place.

paite: Na sikha leh na mi Israelte'n hiai mun lam nga a, ahong thum chiang un angetnate uh na ngaihkhiaksak zel in. Ahi, na tenna mun, van ah na ngaikhia in; ngaikhia inla, ngaidam in." \
english: Listen to the supplication of your servant, and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. Yes, hear in heaven, your dwelling place; and when you hear, forgive.

paite: "Mi kuapeuh in a-invengte tung ah thil hihkhial in, kichiamsak hial ahong kiphatmohleh hiai inn a na maitam ma ah hong kichiam henla,
english: “If a man sins against his neighbor, and an oath is laid on him to cause him to swear, and he comes and swears before your altar in this house,

paite: nang van ah na ngaikhia inla, gamtang inla na sikhate vai hawmsak in, migilou pen mohpaih in alutung ah a-omdan nga inla, midiktat pen siamtangsak in adiktatna bangbang amah pia in.
english: then hear in heaven, and act, and judge your servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way on his own head, and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

paite: Na mi Israelte'n na tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak ua melmate lak a avuallelh ua nang lam ahong ngat nawn ua, na min aphat ua, hiai inn a thum a thil ahon nget uleh,
english: “When your people Israel are struck down before the enemy because they have sinned against you, if they turn again to you and confess your name, and pray and make supplication to you in this house,

paite: nang van ah ana ngaihkhiaksak inla, na mi Israelte khelhna ngaidam inla, apute uh gam na piak ah pikik nawn in."
english: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them again to the land which you gave to their fathers.

paite: "Na tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak ua van akikhak a, vuah ahong zuk louh hun chiang in, hiai mun lam nga a ahong thum ua, na min apuankhiak ua, amau na bawl gentheih ziak a akhelhnate uh akisik uleh,
english: “When the sky is shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against you, if they pray toward this place and confess your name, and turn from their sin when you afflict them,

paite: nang van ah ana ngaikhia inla, na sikhate leh na mi Israelte khelhna ngaidam inla, apaina ding uh lampi hoih sinsak inla, na mite goutan dia na piakna gam ah vuah zusak in."
english: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, and of your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk; and send rain on your land which you have given to your people for an inheritance.

paite: "Ka gam ua kial ahong kiak a, hipi ahong len a, keuna hiam, muatna hiam, khaukhup hiam, lung hiam ahong om a, amelmate un akongpi kim ua ahong um ua, hipi khatpeuh, chinatna bangpeuh ahong tunleh,
english: “If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence, if there is blight, mildew, locust or caterpillar; if their enemy besieges them in the land of their cities, whatever plague, whatever sickness there is,

paite: na mi Israel tengteng lak a amau lungtang a hipi om hi a thei a, hiai inn lam nga a khut zankhia a, thumna leh ngetna ahon lat uleh;
english: whatever prayer and supplication is made by any man, or by all your people Israel, who shall each know the plague of his own heart, and spread out his hands toward this house,

paite: na omna van ah ana ngaikhia inla, ngaidam inla, gamtang inla, nang alungtang uh theipa, michih a-omdan bangbang in lohchingsak in; nang, nang kia lah mihing ta tengteng lungtang theipa na hi ngal a.
english: then hear in heaven, your dwelling place, and forgive, and act, and give to every man according to all his ways, whose heart you know (for you, even you only, know the hearts of all the children of men);

paite: Ka pute uh na piak gam a aten lai teng uh nang ahon lauhtheihna ding un."
english: that they may fear you all the days that they live in the land which you gave to our fathers.

paite: "Na mi Israelte hilou namdang, na min ziak a gam gamlapi a pan hong paite tungtang thu leng;
english: “Moreover, concerning the foreigner, who is not of your people Israel, when he comes out of a far country for your name’s sake

paite: na min thupi mahmah, na khut hat mahmah, na ban na zak thu na za chiat ding ahi ngal ua, huaite'n hiai inn lam nga a, ahong thum chiang un,
english: (for they shall hear of your great name and of your mighty hand and of your outstretched arm), when he comes and prays toward this house,

paite: nang na omna van ah ana ngaikhia inla, namdang in hon nget ana hihsak in. Na mi Israelte bangmah a leitung mite'n na min atheih ua, laudan ahong siam ua, hiai ka inn lam in na min pu ahi chih ahon theihtheihna ding un."
english: hear in heaven, your dwelling place, and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for; that all the peoples of the earth may know your name, to fear you, as do your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by your name.

paite: "Na mite'n amelmate uh na sawlna lamlam ah adou ua, na khopi tel lam nga leh na min a dia ka lam inn lam nga a, TOUPA kiang a ahong thum uleh,
english: “If your people go out to battle against their enemy, by whatever way you shall send them, and they pray to Yahweh toward the city which you have chosen, and toward the house which I have built for your name,

paite: athumna uleh angetna uh nang van ah ana ngaikhia inla, athu uah gamtang in."
english: then hear in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

paite: "Na tung a thil ahihkhelh uleh, kuamah thil hihkhial lou lah a-om ngal kei a; atung ua na hehna, melma gam gamla mahmah hiam, naichik hiam a leng sal a api ua;
english: If they sin against you (for there is no man who doesn’t sin), and you are angry with them and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive to the land of the enemy, far off or near;

paite: sal a apina gam ua ahong kingaihtuahkhiak ua, akisik ua, thil i na hihkhialta, dikloutak leh gilou mahmah in i na gamta uh, chi a sal a pi mite gam a nang ahon nget uleh,
english: yet if they repent in the land where they are carried captive, and turn again, and make supplication to you in the land of those who carried them captive, saying, ‘We have sinned and have done perversely; we have dealt wickedly,’

paite: amelma amau sal a pite gam a alungtangtak uleh alungsimtak ua nang lam ahong ngat ua, apute uh na piak gam lam leh na khopi tel lam leh na min a dia ka inn lamlam nga a na kiang a ahong thum uleh;
english: if they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies who carried them captive, and pray to you toward their land which you gave to their fathers, the city which you have chosen and the house which I have built for your name,

paite: athumna uleh angetna uh nang na omna van ah ana ngaikhia inla, athu uah gamtang in.
english: then hear their prayer and their supplication in heaven, your dwelling place, and maintain their cause;

paite: Na mi na tung a thil hihkhialte leh na tung a ana tatlekna uah atatleknate tengteng uh ngaidam inla; sal a pite'n ahehpih theihna ding un hehpihna neisak in.
english: and forgive your people who have sinned against you, and all their transgressions in which they have transgressed against you; and give them compassion before those who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them

paite: Na mi na goutan, Aigupta gam a pan sik haltuina sung a pan na pikhiakte lah ahi ngal ua."
english: (for they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out of Egypt, from the middle of the iron furnace);

paite: "Ahon sap chiang ua na ngaihkhiak dia, na sikha ngetna leh na mi Israelte ngetna lam a na mit na hah gige theihna ding in.
english: that your eyes may be open to the supplication of your servant and to the supplication of your people Israel, to listen to them whenever they cry to you.

paite: Aw Toupa PATHIAN, ka pute uh Aigupta gam a pan na pikhiak lai a na sikha Mosi zang a na gen bang in na goutan ding in leitung mite lak a pan na hihtuam lah ahi ngal ua,” achi hi.
english: For you separated them from among all the peoples of the earth to be your inheritance, as you spoke by Moses your servant, when you brought our fathers out of Egypt, Lord Yahweh.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Solomon in TOUPA kiang a athumna leh ngetna tengteng agen khit in, TOUPA maitam ma a khukdin a, van lam a akhut zaktou a om lai athou hi.
english: It was so, that when Solomon had finished praying all this prayer and supplication to Yahweh, he arose from before Yahweh’s altar, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread out toward heaven.

paite: Adingtou a, aw ngaihtak in Israel kikhawm tengteng avualzawl hi.
english: He stood and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying,

paite: "Athuchiam tengteng bang zel a, ami Israelte khawlna pepa TOUPA phat in om hen. Asikha Mosi zang a athuchiam hoih tengteng thu khat leng avuaksuak kei," chi in.
english: “Blessed be Yahweh, who has given rest to his people Israel, according to all that he promised. There has not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by Moses his servant.

paite: "TOUPA i Pathian, i pute kiang a a-om bang in i kiang uah om henla; hon paisan in hon donsak lou kei hen.
english: May Yahweh our God be with us as he was with our fathers. Let him not leave us or forsake us,

paite: Huchi in alampi tengteng tawn ding leh i pipute ana piak khitsa bang a, athupiakte, adan thusehte, avaihawmte zui dia i lungtangte ama lam a angatsak theihna ding in.
english: that he may incline our hearts to him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, which he commanded our fathers.

paite: Asikha thu leh ami Israelte thu ah ani omdan bang zel a, agamtat theihna ding in hiai ka thugen, TOUPA ma a ngetna ka tutte sun leh zan in TOUPA i Pathian ma ah om gige hen.
english: Let these my words, with which I have made supplication before Yahweh, be near to Yahweh our God day and night, that he may maintain the cause of his servant and the cause of his people Israel, as every day requires;

paite: TOUPA Pathian ahi a, kuamah dang a-om kei uh chih leitung a mite'n atheihtheihna ding in.
english: that all the peoples of the earth may know that Yahweh himself is God. There is no one else.

paite: Huchi in adan thuseh bang a om ding leh athupiakte zui ding in TOUPA i Pathian lam ah na lungtangte uh hoihkim hen, tuni a bang in.”
english: “Let your heart therefore be perfect with Yahweh our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as it is today.”

paite: Israel tengteng leh Solomon in TOUPA ma ah kithoihna alan uhi.
english: The king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before Yahweh.

paite: Solomon in TOUPA a dia alat kilemna kithoihna ding in bawngtal singnih-le-sangnih leh belam nuaikhat-le-singnih ahi. Huchibang in kumpipa leh Israel suan tengteng in TOUPA' inn alan uhi.
english: Solomon offered for the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered to Yahweh, twenty two thousand head of cattle and one hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huai ni mah in kumpipa'n TOUPA inka zawn a intual huangsung laitak ahihsiangthou hi. Huai ah halmang thillatte, tangbuang thillatte, kilemna thillat thaute alan hi. Aziak bel huai halmang thillatte, tangbuang thillatte, kilemna thillat sathaute huai dal maitam atat zoh louh ziak ahi.
english: The same day the king made the middle of the court holy that was before Yahweh’s house; for there he offered the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar that was before Yahweh was too little to receive the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings.

paite: Huchi in huai hun in Solomon leh Israel tengteng, mipi kikhawm tampi, Hamath lutna a pan Aigupta gam lui pha a mite'n TOUPA i Pathian ma ah ni sagih leh ni sagih, ni sawm-le-li sung ankuang aluikhawm uhi.
english: So Solomon held the feast at that time, and all Israel with him, a great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt, before Yahweh our God, seven days and seven more days, even fourteen days.

paite: Ani giat ni in mipite akikhensak a, amau kumpipa avualzawl ua, huchi in TOUPA'N asikha David leh ami Israelte tung a ahoihna huchi lawmlawm a alatsak ziak in lungsim nuamsa leh kipak mahmah in a-inn lam uah apaita uhi.
english: On the eighth day he sent the people away; and they blessed the king, and went to their tents joyful and glad in their hearts for all the goodness that Yahweh had shown to David his servant, and to Israel his people.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Solomon in TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn lam a, lunggulhtak a, atup tengteng ahih khit vek nung in,
english: When Solomon had finished the building of Yahweh’s house, the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do,

paite: Gibeon khua a, akiang a, akilak bang in TOUPA Solomon kiang ah ahong kilak nawn hi.
english: Yahweh appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.

paite: TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Na thumna leh na ngetna ka ma a na hon tutte ka na ngaikhia hi. Na inn lam tangtawn a ka min omna ding in ka hihsiangthouta hi. Ka mit leh ka lungtang huai ah tangtawn in a-omta ding hi.
english: Yahweh said to him, “I have heard your prayer and your supplication that you have made before me. I have made this house holy, which you have built, to put my name there forever; and my eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually.

paite: Nang leng thu ka hon piak peuhmah bang a hih dia na pa David a om bang, lungtang hoihtak pu leh lungsim diktak pu a ka mitmuh a na om a, ka dan thusehte leh ka vaihawmte na zuih gigeleh,
english: As for you, if you will walk before me as David your father walked, in integrity of heart and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my ordinances,

paite: Israelte tung ah na gam laltutphah tangtawn a ding in ka hihkip ding; na pa David kiang a, Israelte laltutphah a tu ding na tatlak kei ding, chi a ka na chiamsa bang in.
english: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom over Israel forever, as I promised to David your father, saying, ‘There shall not fail from you a man on the throne of Israel.’

paite: Himahleh nang hiam na suante hiam in na hon zuih uh kiksan a, ka thupiakte leh ka dan thusehte leh ka hon theihsakte pom lou a, pathian dangte nna na sep ua, na biak uleh,
english: But if you turn away from following me, you or your children, and not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods and worship them,

paite: gam ka piak a pan Israelte ka hihmang dia; hiai inn ka min a dia ka hihsiangthousa ka mitmuh phak louh ah ka suanmang ding. Huchi in namte lak ah enghouna leh aselam gentehna in Israel zat ahong hi ding.
english: then I will cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and I will cast this house, which I have made holy for my name, out of my sight; and Israel will be a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

paite: Hiai inn sang tawkleh leng, akiang a pai peuhmah in lamdang sa in amuk uh ahum ding ua, bangziak a TOUPA'N hiai gam leh hiai inn hichi tel a hih adiam aw? achi ding uh.
english: Though this house is so high, yet everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss; and they will say, ‘Why has Yahweh done this to this land and to this house?’

paite: Mite'n TOUPA a Pathian uh, apute uh Aigupta gam a pan pikhepa apaisan ua, pathian dangte alet ua, abiak ua, a-nnate uh asep ziak uh ahi. Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hiai siatna tengteng atung uah atungsakta hi, chi in adawng ding uh," achi hi.
english: and they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned Yahweh their God, who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and embraced other gods, and worshiped them, and served them. Therefore Yahweh has brought all this evil on them.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Solomon inn nihte; TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn alam sung kum sawmnih abei nung in,
english: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the two houses, Yahweh’s house and the king’s house

paite: Tura kumpipa Hiram in Solomon sidar singte, meilah singte leh dangka-engte akul teng atupsak vek ahi, kumpipa Solomon in Galili gam a khua sawmnih Hiram apia hi.
english: (now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and cypress trees, and with gold, according to all his desire), King Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.

paite: Solomon in apiak khuate en ding in Tura a pan Hiram apawtkhia a; ava en a himahleh alungtung kei.
english: Hiram came out of Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they didn’t please him.

paite: Ama'n, unaupa aw, hiai na hon kho piakte bangchibang khua amaizen ua? achi hi. Huchi in tuni tan in ama'n huai khuate Kabul gam achi hi.
english: He said, “What cities are these which you have given me, my brother?” He called them the land of Cabul to this day.

paite: Hiram in dangka-eng talent za-le-sawmnih kumpipa akhak hi.
english: Hiram sent to the king one hundred twenty talents of gold.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon in phutluih nasem pawl abawl nangawn hiai ahi: TOUPA' inn leh amah inn lam ding leh Millo, Jerusalem kulh, Hazor khua, Meggiddo khua leh Gezer khuate bawl ding in ahi.
english: This is the reason of the forced labor which King Solomon conscripted: to build Yahweh’s house, his own house, Millo, Jerusalem’s wall, Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.

paite: Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh ahohtou a, Gezer khua ava la a, ahal a, huai khua a teng Kanaante athat a, atanu Solomon zi thilpiak in ana pe khinta ngal a.
english: Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, taken Gezer, burned it with fire, killed the Canaanites who lived in the city, and given it for a wedding gift to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.

paite: Solomon in Gezer, Beth-horon khangnungzaw,
english: Solomon built in the land Gezer, Beth Horon the lower,

paite: Baalath leh Israel gamdai a Tadmor khuate,
english: Baalath, Tamar in the wilderness,

paite: Solomon in thil koihkhawmna khua aneih tengteng, akangtalai koihna khuate, Jerusalem khua leh Lebanon a vaihawmna gamsung pumpi Solomon in lunggulhtak a bawl atup tengteng abawl hi.
english: all the storage cities that Solomon had, the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

paite: Israel suante hilou, Amorte, Hitte, Perizte leh Jebus omsun tengtengte;
english: As for all the people who were left of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of the children of Israel—

paite: asuan uh, huai gam a om lai Israel suante'n ahihman zoh vek theihlouhte lak ah Solomon in sikha, phutluih nasem pawl abawl a, tuni tan in asem lai uhi.
english: their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel were not able utterly to destroy—of them Solomon raised a levy of bondservants to this day.

paite: Israel suante bel Solomon in sikha in abawl kei. Galdou mite, a-intekpate, amiliante, asepaih heutute, akangtalai leh asakol tungtuang pawl heutute ahi zaw uh.
english: But of the children of Israel Solomon made no bondservants; but they were the men of war, his servants, his princes, his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.

paite: Hiaite Solomon nasep tung a heutu tuam, zanga-le-sawmnga, nasep veng mite ahi uh.
english: These were the five hundred fifty chief officers who were over Solomon’s work, who ruled over the people who labored in the work.

paite: Himahleh Pharaoh tanu bel David khopi a pan, Solomon in alamsak ama inn ah apaitou hi. Huchi in Solomon in Millo abawl hi.
english: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of David’s city to her house which Solomon had built for her. Then he built Millo.

paite: Solomon in TOUPA a dia abawl maitam ah kum teng in thumvei halmang thillat leh kilemna thillat alan a, TOUPA ma a maitam ah gimlimte ahal hi. Huchi in inn alamzouta hi.
english: Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar which he built to Yahweh three times per year, burning incense with them on the altar that was before Yahweh. So he finished the house.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon in Edom gam a Tuipi San gei Eloth chin a om Ezion-geber mun ah longhon abawl hi.
english: King Solomon made a fleet of ships in Ezion Geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.

paite: Hiram in asikha long mite, tuipi a kiseksa, long a Solomon sikhate kiang ah asawl hi.
english: Hiram sent in the fleet his servants, sailors who had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.

paite: Huai mite Ophir ah ava hoh ua, dangka-eng talent zali-le-sawmnih ahon pua ua, kumpipa Solomon kiang hon tun uhi.
english: They came to Ophir, and fetched from there gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to King Solomon.

paite: Peter, Jesu Khrist sawltak in, Pontus gam, Galatia gam, Kappadosia gam, Asia gam Bithinia leh gam tuamtuam a mikhual dalhzakte kiang ah;
english: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

paite: Pa Pathian theihkholh bang a Jesu Khrist thumanna leh sisan theh tang ding a Kha hihtuamna tungtawn a tel a omte kiang ah hehpihna leh khamuanna hihkhan in om hen.
english: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist leh Pa Pathian phat in om hen! Ama'n azahngaihna thupitak bang zel in, misi lak a kipan Jesu Khrist thohnawnna ziak in lametna hing mu ding in ahon piang thaksak nawn hi;
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

paite: goutan setheilou, nin baang lou, tul thei lou, van a nou a ding a sit muhna ding in;
english: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,

paite: hotdamna, hun nanung a lang ding a zohsa mu ding in, ginna ziak in Pathian thilhihtheihna a ven na hi uhi.
english: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

paite: Tu in ze-etna chiteng ziak in hun sawt lou lungkham tadih mah le uchin, huai ah nakpitak in na kipak uhi.
english: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,

paite: Na ginna uh ze-etna, dangka-eng mei a ze-et nung nangawn a mangthang zel sang a manphazaw, Jesu Khrist kilak chiang a phatna leh pahtawina leh thupina ding ahong hihtheihna ding in.
english: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

paite: Mu ngei lou napi in amah na it ua, tu in mu tadih kei mah le uchin, amah na gingta ua, kipahna gen vual louh leh thupina a dim in na kipak mahmah uhi.
english: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,

paite: Na ginna un atup pen na kha uh hotdamna na mu uhi.
english: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

paite: Huai hotdamna thu zawlneite hehpihna na kiang ua hong tung ding thugenkholte'n akankan ua, siamneltak in azongkhia uhi.
english: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,

paite: Khrist kha amau a om in Khrist thuakna ding leh thupina hon zui dingte atheihkholhsak lai in, bang hun a bangchi a hong tung ding ahia chih zonkhiak atum uhi.
english: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them.

paite: Huai thu in amau nasep kisep lou in, noumau nasep asem zaw uh chih akiang uah theihsak ahita, huai thute van a kipan a sawlkhiak Kha Siangthou panpih in tanchinhoih nou hon hilhte'n tu in ahon hilh ua, huai thilte angelte'n leng vel a-ut uhi.
english: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you, in these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.

paite: Huaiziak in na lungsim puan uh teng in pilvang unla, Jesu Khrist kilak chiang a hehpihna nou ahon puak ding lungke lou in lamen un.
english: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

paite: Ta thumangte bang in, na theih louh lai ua na nidanglai duhgawlna uh bang a om lou in;
english: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,

paite: nou hon sampa asiangthou bang in nou leng na tatdan tengteng uah hong siangthou un;
english: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior,

paite: "Noute na siangthou ding uh ahi, kei ka siangthou ngal a," chih gelh ahi.
english: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”

paite: Huan khentuam nei lou a michih nasep bang chiat a vaihawmpa Pa bang a na loh uleh, hiai lai a na taam lai teng un laudan siam in om un.
english: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,

paite: Na pipute uh piaksawn, na omdan uh bangmah hilou a kipan, thil se thei, dangka leh dangka-eng a tat na hi kei ua,
english: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,

paite: belamnou gensiatbei leh nin baang lou sisan bang a, Khrist sisan pha a tat na hi zaw uh chih na thei uhi.
english: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,

paite: Amah leilung pian ma in sehkholh in a-om ngeitak a, himahleh hun nanung ah noumau ziak in kilak in a-om hi.
english: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,

paite: Amah ziak in misi lak a kipan kaithoupa leh athupina pepa Pathian gingtate na hi uh, na ginna uh leh na lametna uh Pathian a a-omtheihna ding in.
english: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.

paite: Unaute it taktak ding a thutak zui a na kha uh na hihsiangthou tak ziak un lungtang a phatuamngaitak in ki-ittuah chiat un.
english: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently,

paite: Chi se thei lak ah hilou in, Pathian Thu hing gige leh om gige chi setheilou lak a piangthak na hi zaw uhi.
english: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.

paite: "Mi tengteng loupa bang ahi ua, athupina uh leng loupa pak bang ahi. Loupa avuai a, apak apulh hi.
english: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;

paite: Toupa bel tangtawn in a-om gige hi," chih ahi ngal a. Hiai ahi tanchinhoih nou ahon hilh pen uh.
english: but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.

paite: Huchi in gitlouhna tengteng, khemna tengteng, lepchiahna tengteng, hazatna tengteng, gensiatna tengteng tawpsan unla,
english: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,

paite: naungek suak thakte bang in khalam nawitui, bangmah hel louh lunggulh un; huai a na khantheihna ding un:
english: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,

paite: Toupa mihehpih theitak ahi chih na chep tak ngal uleh.
english: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

paite: Amah suang hing, mihingte deih louh, Pathian theih a bel tel leh manpha ahi.
english: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.

paite: Amah kiang a hong pai in, noute ngei leng suang hingte bang in Jesu Khrist ziak a Pathian kipah lam kithoihna lan ding a siampu siangthou hi ding in khalam inn ah leptouh in na om uhi.
english: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

paite: Huaiziak in Laisiangthou ah: "Ngai un, Zion ah aning a suang kiphamohpen tel a om leh manphatak ka lem hi; amah gingtate azahlak kei ding uh," chih atuang hi.
english: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”

paite: Nou agingtate a ding in huai manphapi ahi, agingtaloute a ding in bel; "Inn lamte suang deih louhpen, huai mah aning a suang phatuampen ahong hita hi."
english: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,”

paite: Huan "Pukna suang leh dalna suangpi ahi. Thu kigente azuih louh ziak un akisuipuk ua; huchibang ding a sehsa ahi him uhi."
english: and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.

paite: Himahleh mial a kipan pawt a, vak lamdangtak a lut ding a nou hon sampa hoihna na muhsak theihna ding un, nou zaw chitel, kumpi siampu, nam siangthou, Pathian mite na hi uhi;
english: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

paite: Nidanglai in nam himhim na hi kei ua; tu in zaw Pathian namte na hita uh; nidanglai in zahngaihna na mu kei ua, tu in zaw zahngaihna na muta uhi.
english: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

paite: Deihtakte aw, mikhual leh khualzin na hih ziak un kha dou nakpa taksa utnate tawpsan ding in nou ka hon ngen hi.
english: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,

paite: Zentelte lak a na tatdan uh kilawmtak hi hen, huchi in thil hihkhial a, ahon gensiat chiang un leng na thil hoih hih amuhte uh ziak in veh a a-om chiang un Pathian apahtawi thei ding uhi.
english: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation.

paite: Toupa ziak in mihing dan bawl peuhmah ah lut un; thuneihna tawi kumpipa kiang ah hiam,
english: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme,

paite: thil hihkhialte tung a thuk ding leh thil hoih hihte phat ding a kumpipa'n aseh gam ukpate thunuai ah lut un.
english: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.

paite: Hiai Pathian deihlam ahi, mihaite haina thil hoih hih in na hihdai thei ding uhi.
english: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.

paite: Noplen na hi ua, himahleh na noplenna uh khelhna khuhna ding a zang lou in Pathian sikha a omna ding in zang zaw un.
english: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

paite: Mi tengteng zahtak un. Ki-unauna it un. Pathian laudan siam un. Kumpipa pahtawi un.
english: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

paite: Sikhate aw, mihoih leh minunnemte lak kia hilou in migiloute lak ah leng laudan siam in nou hon heute thuthu in om un.
english: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.

paite: Mi'n Pathian theihna ziak in thuak louh ding thuak a lungkhamna athuak teiteileh huai pen Pathian pahtak lam ahi.
english: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.

paite: Nou na thilhihkhelh ziak ua vuak na thuak un, kuhkaltak in thuak mah le uchin phatna bang na loh ua? Himahleh na thil hoih hih ziak ua na thuak ua, kuhkaltak a na thuak teitei ualeh, hiai pen Pathian kipah lam ahi.
english: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.

paite: Khrist in leng nou ahon thuaksak ziak in, huai bang hih ding a sap na hi uhi; akhap a na zuihna ding un zuih ding ahon nutsiat ahi.
english: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,

paite: "Ama'n thil ahihkhial kei a, akam ah khemna leng a-om sam kei."
english: who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”

paite: Enghou a a-om lai in, a-enghou thuk kei a, athuak lai in avau kei hi; diktattak a ngaihtuahpa kiang ah akipe zaw hi.
english: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.

paite: Khelhna lam a si khin, adiktatna lam a i hintheihna ding in amah mah in tua sing ah asa in i khelhnate apua hi; avuakna golhte ah hihdam in na omta uhi.
english: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.

paite: Belam mang bang in na mang ua, tu'n zaw nou hon chingpa leh heutupa kiang ah na kik nawnta uhi.
english: For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

paite: Huchibang in, nou zite aw, noumau pasalte thuthu in om un, huchi in alak ua khenkhat in Pathian thu zui kei mah le uh na tatdan uh zoh in a-om ding uhi.
english: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word,

paite: Laudan siam kawm a na tatdan siangthou uh en in.
english: seeing your pure behavior in fear.

paite: Na kivatna uh polam kivatna samphek leh dangka-eng khi-oh hiam, puansilh a kivatte hilou in,
english: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,

paite: lungtang a mihing thuguk lungsim thunuailut leh nunnem puansilh setheilou a kivat Pathian mitmuh in amanpha mahmah hi.
english: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.

paite: Huchibang in tuma lam a numei siangthou Pathian gingtate'n leng amau pasalte thuthu a om in akivan uhi.
english: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.

paite: Sarah in Abraham, toupa chi a athuthu a a-om bang in; thil hoih hih a, khemlauna himhim lau lou a na om uleh Sarah tate na hi ding uhi.
english: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror.

paite: Huchi mah bang in, nou pasalte aw, numei zaw bel kitambaihzaw ahih bang un leh hehpihna hinna tanpihte ahih bang un, theihsiamna toh pahtawidan siam kawm in theihna bang zel in na zite uh kem un, na thumna uh dal a a-omlouhna ding in.
english: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.

paite: Atawp pen in, na vek un lungsim mun khat in om unla, kilainattuah unla, thunuailut in om un.
english: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

paite: Khelhna, khelhna in thuk kei unla, salhna, salhna a thuk sam lou in, vualzawl zaw un. Hiai vualzawlna tang ding a sap na hi uhi.
english: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.

paite: "Hinna it a nihoihte muh ut in khelhna lak ah alei venghoih henla, amuk leng khemna thu gen lou ding in venghoih hen.
english: For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.

paite: Gilou nungngatsan in thil hoih hih henla; kituahna zong in delh zel hen.
english: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.

paite: Midiktatte tung ah Toupa mit atu a, abil in leng athumna lam uah adoh zel hi, himahleh Toupa mel in thil hihkhialte adou nak," chih gelh ahi.
english: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”

paite: Thil hoih lam a phatuam na ngaih uleh na poikhoih ding uh kua a-om dia?
english: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?

paite: Himahleh diktatna ziak a na thuakta bang na hih uleh, na hampha ding uhi. Akihtakhuaina uh kihta kei un.
english: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”

paite: Himahleh na lungtang uah Toupa in Khrist bawl un; noumau a om, na lametpen uh hon dong peuhmah dawng ding in mansa gige in thunuailuttak leh laudan siam kawm in om un;
english: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,

paite: sia-le-pha theihna siangtak nei un, huchi in nou ahon gensiatna lam uah, Khrist a na omdan hoih uh gen thanghuaite hih zahlak in a-om ding uhi.
english: having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.

paite: Thil gilou hih ziak a thuak sang in Pathian hoihsak lam ahihleh thil hoih hih ziak a thuak ahoihzaw hi.
english: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.

paite: Pathian kiang a hon pitheihna ding in Khrist in leng khelhnate a ding in khatvei athuakta hi, midiktat in midiktatloute sik in athuak a; sa ah sihsak in a-om a, Kha ah hinsak in a-omta hi.
english: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,

paite: Huai kha in suangkul a kha omte kiang ah thu ava tangkoupih hi.
english: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,

paite: Huai mite'n nidanglai a Noah dam lai a long bawl sung teng a, Pathian thuakzohna in angak lai in thu amang kei ua; huai long ah mi tawmchik, mi giat lel tui a pan humbit in a-om uhi.
english: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.

paite: Huan huai tui in Jesu Khrist thohnawnna ziak a hotdamna baptisma lim hon ensak a, huai tuh pumpi nitna siansakna dan hilou in, sia-le-pha theihna siansakna ziak a Pathian kiang naihna ahi zaw hi.
english: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

paite: Amah van a pai in Pathian taklam ah a-om a; angelte, thuneihnate, thilhihtheihnate amah thuthu a omsak in a-omta hi.
english: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.

paite: Huchi in Khrist in taksa a athuak ziak in nou leng huchibang lungsim in kivan un; sa a thuak khinsa in gilou atawpsanta hi.
english: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,

paite: Huchi in tunung sa a om lai teng mihing duhgawlna lam bang a om lou in, Pathian deihlam in a-omta hi.
english: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.

paite: Zentelte ut lam hihna, huknate, tak taksa utnate, uain hainate, zu khamnate, milim biakna kihhuaitakte tuma lam a hihsa teng i na zang khin ngal a.
english: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.

paite: Huai a amau nuambawl luatna bang a noute'n tu a na bawl sam louh uh lamdang asa ua, nou ahon gense nak uhi.
english: They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you.

paite: Amau mihing leh misite ngaihtuah ding a mansa kiang ah atanchin uh agen ding uhi.
english: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

paite: Hiai ziak in ahi, misite kiang a leng tanchinhoih gen a hih, sa a om mihingte bang a ngaihtuah in om mah le uh, kha a bel Pathian bang a ahintheihna ding un.
english: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.

paite: Himahleh thil tengteng tawpna anaita, huaiziak in na thumtheihna ding un lungsim diktak pu in pilvang un.
english: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

paite: Bangdang teng sang in phatuamngaitak in ki-ittuah chiat unla; itna in gilou tampi akhuh zel hi.
english: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

paite: Phun lou in kizintun tuah unla;
english: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

paite: michih in thilpiak na muh bang zel un, Pathian hehpihna chiteng kemhoihte bang in huaite in nna kisepsaktuah chiat un.
english: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.

paite: Mi kuapeuh in thu agenleh Pathian thute bang in gen hen; mi kuapeuh in nna asepleh Pathian in hatna apiak bang in sem hen; huchi in Jesu Khrist ziak in thil bangkim ah Pathian pahtawi in a-om thei ding, thupina leh vaihawmna tangtawn in amah a ahi, Amen.
english: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

paite: Deihtakte aw, na lak ua ze-etna thupitak hong om, noumau ze-etna ding a na tung ua hong tung, thillamdang na tung ua tung bang in lamdang sa kei un.
english: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.

paite: Khrist thuaknate thuakpihte na hihdan bang zel un kipak zaw un; huchi in athupina a ahong kilak chiang in noumau leng nuamtak in na kipak thei ding uhi.
english: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.

paite: Khrist min ziak a tai na hih uleh, na hampha uhi; na tung uah thupina kha leh Pathian kha a-om gige hi.
english: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.

paite: Himahleh na lak uah kuamah in tualthatmi ahih ziak hiam, midangte thilhih gensakmi ahih ziak hiam in thuak kei hen.
english: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.

paite: Himahleh, Khristian ahih ziak a athuakleh zum kei hen; huai min pu ahih ziak in Pathian pahtawi zaw hen.
english: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.

paite: Pathian inkuanpihte ah vai-hawmna pat ahunta hi; huan eite ngei a apan masakleh Pathian tanchinhoih thumangloute tawpna bangchi phet ahi diam aw?
english: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?

paite: Huan, "Midiktat nangawn hotdam liailiai ahih in, Pathian limsak lou leh migiloute koi ah bang asuak ding ua?"
english: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”

paite: Huaiziak in Pathian hoihsak bang a thuakte'n thil hoih hih in akhate uh Siampa muanhuaitak kiang ah kemsak hen.
english: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.

paite: Huchi in na lak ua saptuam upate kei na upatpih uh, Khrist thuaknate theipa leh thupina hong lang ding tang sam ding in hiai bang in ka hon hanthawn hi:
english: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:

paite: Na lak ua Pathian belamhonte ching unla, enkol un, sawl teitei ziak hilou in, Pathian hon deihna bang hi zaw in, punna thanghuai deih ziak hilou in, kithalawptak zaw in,
english: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;

paite: na tante uh tung ah kiliansak tuan lou in belamhonte zuih ding a kibawl zaw in, kem un.
english: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

paite: Huchi in Belamchingpa lianpen ahong lat chiang in, Thupina Lallukhu tul thei lou na mu ding uhi.
english: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.

paite: Huchi mah bang in, nou valnoute aw, upate nuai ah lut un. Ahi, na vek ua nna kisepsaktuah chiat ding in thunuailutna in kithuam un; "Pathian in kisatheite adou a, kingaineute bel hehpihna ape nak hi."
english: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

paite: Huaiziak in ahuntak a nou ahon pahtawi theihna ding in, Pathian khut hattak nuai ah kihihniam un;
english: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

paite: ama'n ahon limsak gige ziak in na mangbatna tengteng uh amah tung ah nga vek un.
english: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

paite: Pilvang unla, limsak un; na melma uh diabol, humpinelkai humham bang in anawmvalh ding zong in avialvak hi.
english: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

paite: Na unau uh khovel a omte tung ah huchibang thuaknate atung sam chih thei in gingkiptak a om in, amah dou un.
english: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

paite: Huan hehpihna tengteng Pathian, atangtawn thupina tang ding a Khrist a nou hon sampa ngei in, sawt lou kal na thuak nung un ahoih bukim a hon bawl in, hon hihkip in, ahon hihhat ding hi.
english: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.

paite: Amah kiang ah vaihawmna tangtawn in om hen, Amen.
english: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

paite: Ka unaupa muanhuaitak Silvanas khut in, noumau hanthawn leh huai Pathian hehpihna taktak ahi chih thei in, tomchik in na kiang uah ka gelh ahi; huaite ah dingkip un.
english: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.

paite: Babulon a om noumau bang a telnu'n chibai ahon buk hi; huchibang in ka tapa Marka in leng chibai ahon buk ahi.
english: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.

paite: Itna kitawpna a tawp in chibai kibuk un, na lak ua Khrist a om peuhmahte kiang ah khamuanna om hen, Amen.
english: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

paite: Ephraim tanggam Ramathaim-zophim ah mi khat a-om a, amin Elkanah ahi a, amah Jeroham tapa, Elihu tapa, Tohu tapa, Ephraim mi Zuph tapa ahi.
english: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim, of the hill country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.

paite: Ama'n zi nih anei a, akhat min Hannah ahi, akhat min Peninnah ahi. Peninnah in tate anei a, Hannah in bel tate anei kei hi.
english: He had two wives. The name of one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.

paite: Huai mi akhua ua kipan Shiloh ah Sepaihte' TOUPA houpih ding leh kithoih ding in kum teng in ahohtou hi. Huai ah Eli tapate nih, Hophni leh Phinehas, TOUPA siampute a-om uhi.
english: This man went up out of his city from year to year to worship and to sacrifice to Yahweh of Armies in Shiloh. The two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, priests to Yahweh, were there.

paite: Elkanah kithoih ni ahong tun in, azi Peninnah leh atapate leh atanute tengteng tantuan abawlsak hi.
english: When the day came that Elkanah sacrificed, he gave portions to Peninnah his wife and to all her sons and her daughters;

paite: Hannah tan nih abawlsak a, Hannah lah a-it mahmah ngal a. Himahleh TOUPA'N asul akhaksak hi.
english: but he gave a double portion to Hannah, for he loved Hannah, but Yahweh had shut up her womb.

paite: TOUPA'N asul akhaksak ziak in alangnu'n alungkhamsak nak hi.
english: Her rival provoked her severely, to irritate her, because Yahweh had shut up her womb.

paite: Huchibang a kum teng a ahih ziak in TOUPA inn ahohtouh teng in alungkhamna atokthou nak hi. Huchi in akapkap a, an leng ane kei.
english: So year by year, when she went up to Yahweh’s house, her rival provoked her. Therefore she wept, and didn’t eat.

paite: Apasal Elkanah in akiang ah, "Hannah, bang achia ahia na kah? Bang achia an ne lou na hia? Bang achia lungkham na hia? Tapa sawm sang in nang a ding in ka hoihzaw kei a hia?" achi hi.
english: Elkanah her husband said to her, “Hannah, why do you weep? Why don’t you eat? Why is your heart grieved? Am I not better to you than ten sons?”

paite: Huchi in Shiloh a anek ua adawn khit un Hannah adingh a, siampu Eli TOUPA tempul kong khuambul a atutna ah atu hi,
english: So Hannah rose up after they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh. Now Eli the priest was sitting on his seat by the doorpost of Yahweh’s temple.

paite: Hannah lungsim haksa mahmah in a-om a, TOUPA kiang ah athum a, khase mahmah in akap hi.
english: She was in bitterness of soul, and prayed to Yahweh, weeping bitterly.

paite: Thu achiam a, "Sepaihte' TOUPA aw, na sikhanu gimna en a, na hon theihgige a, na sikhanu na hon mangngilh louh a, na sikhanu tapa na piakleh adamsung teng TOUPA ka pe dia, alu ah mulmetna zat ahi kei ding,” achi hi.
english: She vowed a vow, and said, “Yahweh of Armies, if you will indeed look at the affliction of your servant and remember me, and not forget your servant, but will give to your servant a boy, then I will give him to Yahweh all the days of his life, and no razor shall come on his head.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA ma a athum san lai in Eli in amuk-phun ana chiamteh hi.
english: As she continued praying before Yahweh, Eli saw her mouth.

paite: Hannah in alungtang in agen a, amuk kia atangsak a, a-aw bel zak ahi kei hi. Huaiziak in Eli in zukham asa hi.
english: Now Hannah spoke in her heart. Only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard. Therefore Eli thought she was drunk.

paite: Huchi in Eli in akiang ah, "Bang tan ahia kham a na om nilouh ding? Na uain koihmang in," achi hi.
english: Eli said to her, “How long will you be drunk? Get rid of your wine!”

paite: Hannah in, "Kham kei veng e, ka toupa. Lungsim lungkham mahmah numei ka hi. Uain leng, zu chik leng ka dawn kei, TOUPA ma ah ka lungsim ka suahkhia ahi zaw.
english: Hannah answered, “No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit. I have not been drinking wine or strong drink, but I poured out my soul before Yahweh.

paite: Na sikhanu Belial tanu in hon ngoh het ke'n. Ka lungsim a dimlet lunggimna leh ka lungkhamna genkhia ka hi zaw hi,” chi in adawng hi.
english: Don’t consider your servant a wicked woman; for I have been speaking out of the abundance of my complaint and my provocation.”

paite: Eli in, "Lungmuangtak in pai in, Israelte' Pathian in na thilnget nang hon pia hen," chi in adawng hi.
english: Then Eli answered, “Go in peace; and may the God of Israel grant your petition that you have asked of him.”

paite: Ama'n, "Na sikhanu na mitmuh in deihsakna musak in," achi hi. Huchi in numei apaita a, an ane a, lungkham mel aputa kei hi.
english: She said, “Let your servant find favor in your sight.” So the woman went her way and ate; and her facial expression wasn’t sad any more.

paite: Zingsangpi in athou ua, TOUPA abia ua, apai ua, Ramah a a-inn uh atung nawnta uh. Elkanah in azi Hannah akithuahpih a, TOUPA'N amah atheigige hi.
english: They rose up in the morning early and worshiped Yahweh, then returned and came to their house to Ramah. Then Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and Yahweh remembered her.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Hannah in nau apai a, ahun ahong tun in tapa anei hi. "TOUPA ka nget ziak in," chi in amin Samuel asa hi.
english: When the time had come, Hannah conceived, and bore a son; and she named him Samuel, saying, “Because I have asked him of Yahweh.”

paite: Huchi in Elkanah leh a-inkote tengteng TOUPA ma a kum teng a akithoihna uh lan ding leh athuchiam uh tangtun ding in ahong paitou uhi.
english: The man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer to Yahweh the yearly sacrifice and his vow.

paite: Hannah bel ahohtou kei hi. Apasal kiang ah, "Kei zaw naupang in nawinek atawp masiah ka hohtou kei ding. Huai hun chiang in TOUPA ma a akilat theihna ding in ka pi ding. Huai ah a-om nilouhta ding," achi hi.
english: But Hannah didn’t go up, for she said to her husband, “Not until the child is weaned; then I will bring him, that he may appear before Yahweh, and stay there forever.”

paite: Apasal Elkanah in akiang ah, "Hoih ding na chih bang zel in hih in. Anawinek na tawpsak tan in om in. Himahleh TOUPA'N athu hihkip lel hen," achi hi. Huchi in nawinek atawp masiah huai ah numei a-om a, atapa nawinek atawp masiah nawi anesak hi.
english: Elkanah her husband said to her, “Do what seems good to you. Wait until you have weaned him; only may Yahweh establish his word.” So the woman waited and nursed her son until she weaned him.

paite: Nawinek atawptak in, tangbuang ephah khat leh uain thawl khat tawi in bawngtal kum thum a upa toh Shiloh a TOUPA inn ah ata naupang chik paipih in, apitou hi.
english: When she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bulls, and one ephah of meal, and a container of wine, and brought him to Yahweh’s house in Shiloh. The child was young.

paite: Bawngtal khat gou in, naupang Eli kiang ah api uhi.
english: They killed the bull, and brought the child to Eli.

paite: Ama'n, "Toupa, na hin bang in ka gen ahi, kei zaw, aw toupa, hiai lai a na kiang a dingh a TOUPA kiang a thum numei ka hi.
english: She said, “Oh, my lord, as your soul lives, my lord, I am the woman who stood by you here, praying to Yahweh.

paite: Hiai naupang ngen in ka thum a, TOUPA'N ka nget ahon peta.
english: I prayed for this child, and Yahweh has given me my petition which I asked of him.

paite: Huaiziak in ke'n leng TOUPA kiang ah ka lan hi. Adamsung teng TOUPA a dia lat ahi," achi hi. Huai ah ama'n TOUPA abia hi.
english: Therefore I have also given him to Yahweh. As long as he lives he is given to Yahweh.” He worshiped Yahweh there.

paite: Huai khit in Samuel in sathau bawm lakhia in alu ah asung a, atawp a, "TOUPA'N agoutante tung a heutu ding a sathau hon nilh ahi kei maw?
english: Then Samuel took the vial of oil and poured it on his head, then kissed him and said, “Hasn’t Yahweh anointed you to be prince over his inheritance?

paite: Tuni a na hon nutsiat chiang in Zelzah ah Benjamin gamgi a Rakil han kiang ah mi nih na mu dia; amau na kiang ah, 'Na sabiltung zonte amuta uh. Ngai in, na pa'n sabiltungte lungkhampih nawn lou in, nang hon lungkhampihta hi. Ka tapa a ding in bang ka hih dia, chichi ahi, achi ding uh'.
english: When you have departed from me today, then you will find two men by Rachel’s tomb, on the border of Benjamin at Zelzah.
