They will tell you, ‘The donkeys which you went to look for have been found; and behold, your father has stopped caring about the donkeys and is anxious for you, saying, “What shall I do for my son?”’

paite: Huai a pan pai zel inla, Tabor tosaw na va tung ding a, huai ah mi thum Bethel a Pathian kiang a hohtou dingte'n hon na kituahpih ding uh. Khat in kelnou apom dia, khat in tanghou pek khal thum atawi dia, khat in uain thawl atawi ding hi.
english: “Then you will go on forward from there, and you will come to the oak of Tabor. Three men will meet you there going up to God to Bethel: one carrying three young goats, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a container of wine.

paite: "Chibai ahon buk ding ua, tanghou pek khal nih ahon pe ding ua; huai na la ding ahi.
english: They will greet you and give you two loaves of bread, which you shall receive from their hand.

paite: Huai khit in Philistia sepaihte omna Pathian mual na va tung ding ahi. Huan hichi ahi ding a, huai khua na va tun chiang in zawlnei pawl khat ama ua pekgingte, khuangtate, tamngaite leh kaihgingte tawimi pawl toh mun sang a pan hong paikhesuk na tuak dia, amaute'n thu agen ding uhi.
english: “After that you will come to the hill of God, where the garrison of the Philistines is; and it will happen, when you have come there to the city, that you will meet a band of prophets coming down from the high place with a lute, a tambourine, a pipe, and a harp before them; and they will be prophesying.

paite: Na tung ah TOUPA Kha nakpitak in ahong tung ding a, nang leng amau toh thu na gen dia, huchi in mituam na suak ding hi.
english: Then Yahweh’s Spirit will come mightily on you, then you will prophesy with them and will be turned into another man.

paite: " 'Hiai chiamtehnate na tung a ahong tun chiang in, thil hong om in azil dungzui in na hih ding ahi. Pathian lah na kiang ah a-om ngal a.
english: Let it be, when these signs have come to you, that you do what is appropriate for the occasion; for God is with you.

paite: Kei ma in Gilgal ah hohsuk in. Ngai in, kei leng halmang thillatte leh lemna kithoihnate lan ding in na kiang ah ka hong suk ding.' Na kiang a ka hong a, na hih ding ka hon hilh ma ni sagih na taam ding," achi hi.
english: “Go down ahead of me to Gilgal; and behold, I will come down to you to offer burnt offerings and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings. Wait seven days, until I come to you and show you what you are to do.”

paite: Huchibang ahong hi ngei a, Samuel paisan dia anungngattak in Pathian in lungtang dang apeta hi. Huai chiamtehna tengteng huai ni in ahong tung vek hi.
english: It was so, that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart; and all those signs happened that day.

paite: Huchi in mual ahong tun uleh, ngai in, zawlneite'n ana kituahpih uhi. Atung ah TOUPA Kha nakpitak in ahong tung a, athugenna uah amah leng atel samta hi.
english: When they came there to the hill, behold, a band of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came mightily on him, and he prophesied among them.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, tuma lam a amah ana theisate'n zawlneite thugenna ah atel sam chih atheih un, akihou ua, "Kish tapa tung a thil hong om bangchidan ahita a? Saul leng zawlneite lak a tel samta ahi maw?" akichi uhi.
english: When all who knew him before saw that, behold, he prophesied with the prophets, then the people said to one another, “What is this that has come to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?”

paite: A-omna khua ua mi khat in adawng a, "Apa uh kua ahi tuan a ahia?" achi hi. Huchi in Saul leng zawlnei ahi samta maw? chih paunak ahong hita hi.
english: One from the same place answered, “Who is their father?” Therefore it became a proverb, “Is Saul also among the prophets?”

paite: Athugen khit in mun sang atungta hi.
english: When he had finished prophesying, he came to the high place.

paite: Saul paneu in akiang ah leh asikha kiang ah, "Koi a hoh na hi ua?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Sabiltung zong ka hi uh. Ka muh zoh louh ziak un Samuel kiang ah ka va hoh uhi," achi hi.
english: Saul’s uncle said to him and to his servant, “Where did you go?” He said, “To seek the donkeys. When we saw that they were not found, we came to Samuel.”

paite: Saul paneu in, "Samuel in na kiang ua bang ahia agen hon hilh dih," achi hi.
english: Saul’s uncle said, “Please tell me what Samuel said to you.”

paite: Saul in apaneu kiang ah, "Sabengtungte amuta uh chih ahon hilh hi,” achi hi. Himahleh lalgam thu Samuel in agen pen ahilh kei hi.
english: Saul said to his uncle, “He told us plainly that the donkeys were found.” But concerning the matter of the kingdom, of which Samuel spoke, he didn’t tell him.

paite: Huchi in Samuel in mipite Mizpah ah TOUPA mai ah asamkhawm hi.
english: Samuel called the people together to Yahweh to Mizpah;

paite: Huai ah Israel suante kiang ah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: Israelte Aigupta a pan ka pikhia a, Aigupta mite khut a pan leh nou hon nuaisiah gam tengteng a pan ka hon hunkhia hi.
english: and he said to the children of Israel, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says ‘I brought Israel up out of Egypt and I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all the kingdoms that oppressed you.’

paite: Himahleh tuni in na mangbatna tengteng uleh na gimthuakna tengteng ua kipan nou hon humbitpa na Pathian uh na deih kei uh. Akiang ah, 'Ahi kei, kumpipa hon bawlsak in,' na chi uh. Huaiziak in tu in anam a nam leh achi a chỉ in TOUPA ma ah hong kilang un" achi hi.
english: But you have today rejected your God, who himself saves you out of all your calamities and your distresses; and you have said to him, ‘No! Set a king over us!’ Now therefore present yourselves before Yahweh by your tribes and by your thousands.”

paite: Huchi a Samuel in Israel chi tengteng ahong kilat naisaktak in Benjamin chitel ahong hita.
english: So Samuel brought all the tribes of Israel near, and the tribe of Benjamin was chosen.

paite: Benjamin chite bel a-inkuankuan in ahong kilak ua, Matri mite inkuan tel ahong hi a, Kish tapa Saul tel ahong hita hi. Amah azon uleh amuzou kei uh.
english: He brought the tribe of Benjamin near by their families and the family of the Matrites was chosen. Then Saul the son of Kish was chosen; but when they looked for him, he could not be found.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA adong tuan nawn ua, "Hiai mi hong pai nai lou hiam," achi uh. TOUPA'N adawng a, "Ngai un, van lak ah akibu hi," achi hi.
english: Therefore they asked of Yahweh further, “Is there yet a man to come here?” Yahweh answered, “Behold, he has hidden himself among the baggage.”

paite: Huchi in atai ua, ava pikhia ua, mipi lak a adinleh mi lak ah asangpen a, kuamah aliangzang khengzou a-om kei uhi.
english: They ran and got him there. When he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.

paite: Samuel in mi tengteng kiang ah, "TOUPA miseh na mu uhia? Mi tengteng lak ah amah bang mahmah a-om kei," achi hi. Mite akikou ua, "Pathian in kumpipa hondam hen," achi uhi.
english: Samuel said to all the people, “Do you see him whom Yahweh has chosen, that there is no one like him among all the people?” All the people shouted and said, “Long live the king!”

paite: Huchi in Samuel in mipite lalgam omdan ding ahilh hi. Laibu ah agelh a, TOUPA ma ah akoih hi. Samuel in mite amau inn chiat ah apaisakta hi.
english: Then Samuel told the people the regulations of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book and laid it up before Yahweh. Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.

paite: Saul leng Gibeah a a-inn ah apai sam hi. Pathian in alungtang uh akhoih mihangsante leng amah toh apaikhawm uhi.
english: Saul also went to his house in Gibeah; and the army went with him, whose hearts God had touched.

paite: Himahleh Belial tapate'n, "Hiai mi'n bangchi in ahon hondam thei mahmah dia?" chi in amah angaineu ua, thilpiak ahong pe kei uh. Himahleh amah bel adai dide hi.
english: But certain worthless fellows said, “How could this man save us?” They despised him, and brought him no tribute. But he held his peace.

paite: Huchi in Ammon mi Nahash ahong kisa a, Jabesh-gilead sual tum in ava giahkhum hi. Jabesh mi tengteng in Nahash kiang ah, "Kou toh thukhun bawl in, huchi in nang nna ka sem ding uh," achi uh.
english: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up and encamped against Jabesh Gilead; and all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, “Make a covenant with us, and we will serve you.”

paite: Ammon mi Nahash in akiang uah, "Hichibang in ahi nou toh thu ka khun ding. Na mit taklam tengteng uh khelkhiak vek ahi dia; huai Israel mi tengteng minsiatna dia koih ahi ding," achi hi.
english: Nahash the Ammonite said to them, “On this condition I will make it with you, that all your right eyes be gouged out. I will make this dishonor all Israel.”

paite: Jabesh khua upate'n akiang ah, "Israel gam tengteng a thupo mite ka sawltheihna ding un ni sagih sung hon hungaih in. Hon hondam ding kuamah a-om keileh na kiang ah ka hong paikhe ding uh," achi uhi.
english: The elders of Jabesh said to him, “Give us seven days, that we may send messengers to all the borders of Israel; and then, if there is no one to save us, we will come out to you.”

paite: Huchi in huai thupo mite Saul omna khua Gibeah ahong tung uhi. Mite bil azak in huai thute agen ua; mite aw suah in akap uhi,
english: Then the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul, and spoke these words in the ears of the people, then all the people lifted up their voice and wept.

paite: Ngai in, lou a pan bawng hawl in Saul ahong pai hi. Saul in, "Bang achi ua ahia mite akah uh?" achi hi. Jabesh a mite thugen ahilh uhi.
english: Behold, Saul came following the oxen out of the field; and Saul said, “What ails the people that they weep?” They told him the words of the men of Jabesh.

paite: Huai thu azaktak in Saul tung ah Pathian Kha ahong tung a nakpitak in ahehta hi.
english: God’s Spirit came mightily on Saul when he heard those words, and his anger burned hot.

paite: Huchi in bawngtal nih ala a, asemnen vek hi. Israel gam tengteng ah thupo mite ahawmsak a, "Kuapeuh Saul leh Samuel zui nuam lou peuhmah hiai bawngtal bang a hih ahi ding," achi hi. Huchi in mipite'n TOUPA alau ua, thukhat sat in ahong kuankheta uh.
english: He took a yoke of oxen and cut them in pieces, then sent them throughout all the borders of Israel by the hand of messengers, saying, “Whoever doesn’t come out after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done to his oxen.” The dread of Yahweh fell on the people, and they came out as one man.

paite: Bezek ah amaute asim a, Israel mite nuaithum ahi uh. Judah mite singthum ahi uh.
english: He counted them in Bezek; and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.

paite: Ahong pai thupo mite kiang ah, "Jabesh-gilead mite kiang ah, zingchiang in nisat san laitak mah in hotkhiak na hi ding uh va chi un," achi hi. Thupo mite ava hoh ua, Jabesh mite ahilh ua, huchi in akipak mahmah uhi.
english: They said to the messengers who came, “Tell the men of Jabesh Gilead, ‘Tomorrow, by the time the sun is hot, you will be rescued.’” The messengers came and told the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.

paite: Huchi in Jabesh mite'n, "Zingchiang in na kiang uah ka hong pawtkhe ding ua, ka tung uah na ut-ut un hih mai un," achi uhi.
english: Therefore the men of Jabesh said, “Tomorrow we will come out to you, and you shall do with us all that seems good to you.”

paite: Hichi ahong hi a, azing in Saul in mipite pawl thum in akoih a, zing ven hun laitak in agiahmun uah alut uhi. Ammon mite sun nisat san lai tan in athat uhi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, athahvalte adalhzak vek ua, nih a omkhawm himhim leng a-om kei uhi.
english: On the next day, Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the middle of the camp in the morning watch, and struck the Ammonites until the heat of the day. Those who remained were scattered, so that no two of them were left together.

paite: Mipite'n Samuel kiang ah, "Kuate ahia, Saul in i tung uah vai ahawm tel ding maw chi? Huai mite hon pi in ka that ding uh," achi uhi.
english: The people said to Samuel, “Who is he who said, ‘Shall Saul reign over us?’ Bring those men, that we may put them to death!”

paite: Saul in, "Tuni chitchiat in zaw kuamah that kei un. Tuni in TOUPA'N Israelte lak ah hotdamna abawlta ngal a," achi hi.
english: Saul said, “No man shall be put to death today; for today Yahweh has rescued Israel.”

paite: Huchi in Samuel in mipite kiang ah, "Kisa dih uh, Gilgal ah i hoh ding ua, huai ah lalgam i thaksak nawn ding uh," achi hi.
english: Then Samuel said to the people, “Come! Let’s go to Gilgal, and renew the kingdom there.”

paite: Huchi in mite tengteng Gilgal ah ahohta uhi. Saul Gilgal ah TOUPA ma ah kumpipa in abawlta uhi. Huai ah TOUPA ma ah lemna kithoihnate alan uhi. Huchi in huai ah Saul leh Israel mi tengteng akipak mahmah uhi.
english: All the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before Yahweh in Gilgal. There they offered sacrifices of peace offerings before Yahweh; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.

paite: Huan Samuel in Israel mi tengteng kiang ah, "Ngai dih ua, ka kiang a na thugen tengteng uh ngaikhia in, na tung uah kumpipa ka bawlta hi.
english: Samuel said to all Israel, “Behold, I have listened to your voice in all that you said to me, and have made a king over you.

paite: Tu in, ngai dih ua, kumpipa in na ma uh akai hi. Kei zaw tek in ka sam leng akangta hi. Ngai dih ua, na kiang uah ka tapate a-om uh. Ka naupan a pan tutan na ma uh ka hon pi hi.
english: Now, behold, the king walks before you. I am old and gray-headed. Behold, my sons are with you. I have walked before you from my youth to this day.

paite: Hiai ah ka om hi. TOUPA ma leh asathau nilhpa ma ah hon sel un. Kua bawngtal ka suh ngei a? Kua sabiltung ahia ka suh ngei? Kua ka khem ngei a? Kua ka hihgenthei ngei a? Ka mit tawsak ding in kua a pan in golhna ka la ngei a? K'on din nawn vek ding," achi hi.
english: Here I am. Witness against me before Yahweh and before his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey have I taken? Whom have I defrauded? Whom have I oppressed? Of whose hand have I taken a bribe to make me blind my eyes? I will restore it to you.”

paite: Amau, "Na hon khem ngei kei a, n'on hihgenthei ngei sam kei. Kuamah khut a pan lak tuak louh leng na la ngei kei," achi uhi.
english: They said, “You have not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither have you taken anything from anyone’s hand.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Ka khut ah bangmah kilawm lou na mu kei uh, chih tuni in TOUPA na lak uah theihpihpa ahi a; asathau nilhpa atheipihpa ahi," achi hi. Amau, "Amah hon theipihpa ahi," achi uhi.
english: He said to them, “Yahweh is witness against you, and his anointed is witness today, that you have not found anything in my hand.” They said, “He is witness.”

paite: Samuel in mite kiang ah, "Mosi leh Aaron seppa leh Aigupta a pan na pipute uh pikhepa TOUPA ahi.
english: Samuel said to the people, “It is Yahweh who appointed Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.

paite: Huchi in dingh kinken unla, TOUPA ma ah TOUPA'N na tung uh leh na pipute uh tung a thil dik ana hihte ka hon sutpih ding.
english: Now therefore stand still, that I may plead with you before Yahweh concerning all the righteous acts of Yahweh, which he did to you and to your fathers.

paite: Aigupta gam a Jakob alut nung in, na pipute un TOUPA asam ua, huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron asawl hi. Na pipute uh Aigupta gam a pan apikhia a, hiai mun ah atengsak hi.
english: “When Jacob had come into Egypt, and your fathers cried to Yahweh, then Yahweh sent Moses and Aaron, who brought your fathers out of Egypt, and made them to dwell in this place.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA a Pathian uh amangngilh uh. Ama'n Hazor sepaih heutu Sisera khut, Philistia mite khut leh Moab kumpipa khut ah akhawng a, amaute'n adou uhi.
english: But they forgot Yahweh their God; and he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the army of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab; and they fought against them.

paite: "TOUPA asam ua, 'TOUPA i lehngatsan ua, Baal leh Ashtaroth nna i sep ziak un i na khialta uh. Himahleh tu in ka melmate khut a pan hon hunkhia inla, huchi in nang nna ka sem ding uh,' achi uh.
english: They cried to Yahweh, and said, ‘We have sinned, because we have forsaken Yahweh and have served the Baals and the Ashtaroth; but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve you.’

paite: TOUPA'N Jerubbaal, Bendan, Jephthah leh Samuel asawl a, khat lam khat lam a na melmate uh khut a pan ahon hunkhia hi. Huchi in bittak in na tengta uhi.
english: Yahweh sent Jerubbaal, Bedan, Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side; and you lived in safety.

paite: Ammon suante kumpipa Nahash nou dou ding in ahong kuan chih na theihtak un, ka kiang ah, 'Ahi kei, kumpi in ka tung uah vaihawm hen' na chi uh; TOUPA Pathian lah na kumpipa uh ahi gige ngal a.
english: “When you saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you, you said to me, ‘No, but a king shall reign over us,’ when Yahweh your God was your king.

paite: "Huchi in na kumpipa tel uleh nget uh en dih uh, TOUPA'N kumpipa ahon bawlsakta hi.
english: Now therefore see the king whom you have chosen and whom you have asked for. Behold, Yahweh has set a king over you.

paite: TOUPA laudan na siam ua, a-nna na sep ua, a-aw na zuih ua, TOUPA thupiak na helsan louh ua, nou leh na tung ua vaihawm kumpipa toh TOUPA na Pathian uh zuite na hih uleh ahoih ding hi.
english: If you will fear Yahweh, and serve him, and listen to his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of Yahweh, then both you and also the king who reigns over you are followers of Yahweh your God.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA aw zui lou a, TOUPA thupiak na helsan uleh na pipute un ToUPA khut athuak mah bang un nou leng na thuak ding uhi.
english: But if you will not listen to Yahweh’s voice, but rebel against the commandment of Yahweh, then Yahweh’s hand will be against you, as it was against your fathers.

paite: Huchi in ding kinken unla, TOUPA'N na mitmuh ua thil thupitak ahih ding en un.
english: “Now therefore stand still and see this great thing, which Yahweh will do before your eyes.

paite: Tuni in huit buh ala uh ahi kei maw? Van gingsak ding leh vuah zusak ding in TOUPA ka sam ding. Huchi in kumpipa na nget thu uah TOUPA mitmuh a thil na hihkhelh uh athupidan thei in na mu ding uh," achi hi.
english: Isn’t it wheat harvest today? I will call to Yahweh, that he may send thunder and rain; and you will know and see that your wickedness is great, which you have done in Yahweh’s sight, in asking for a king.”

paite: Huchi in Samuel in TOUPA asam a, TOUPA'N huai ni in van agingsak a, vuah azusak hi. Huchi in mite'n TOUPA leh Samuel alau mahmah uhi.
english: So Samuel called to Yahweh, and Yahweh sent thunder and rain that day. Then all the people greatly feared Yahweh and Samuel.

paite: Mi tengteng in Samuel kiang ah, "Ka sihlouhna ding un, TOUPA na Pathian kiang ah na sikhate hon thumsak in. Hiai thil hoih loutak, kumpipa ka na nget uh, ka gitlouhna tengteng uh behlap ka na hita uh," achi uhi.
english: All the people said to Samuel, “Pray for your servants to Yahweh your God, that we not die; for we have added to all our sins this evil, to ask for a king.”

paite: Samuel in mite kiang ah, "Lau kei un, hiai thil giloutak na hihta uhi. Himahleh TOUPA na zuih uh pialsan kei unla, na lungtang tengteng un TOUPA nna sem zaw un.
english: Samuel said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. You have indeed done all this evil; yet don’t turn away from following Yahweh, but serve Yahweh with all your heart.

paite: "Lampial kei un. Manna bei thilte leh nou hon hunkhe theiloute zui kei un; amaute bangmah lou ahi ngal ua.
english: Don’t turn away to go after vain things which can’t profit or deliver, for they are vain.

paite: Amin thupitak ziak in TOUPA'N amite alehngatsan kei dia; amah mite hi ding a noute hon bawl TOUPA kipah lam ahi.
english: For Yahweh will not forsake his people for his great name’s sake, because it has pleased Yahweh to make you a people for himself.

paite: Huai phet leng ahi kei a, nou a dia thum tawp in TOUPA tung ah thil ka hihkhial het kei ding. Himahleh lampi hoih leh dik ka hon kawkmuh zaw ding ahi.
english: Moreover, as for me, far be it from me that I should sin against Yahweh in ceasing to pray for you; but I will instruct you in the good and the right way.

paite: TOUPA laudan siam photphot un. Na lungtang tengteng un chihtaktak in amah nna sem unla; nou a dia athilhih thupitakte ngaihtuah un.
english: Only fear Yahweh, and serve him in truth with all your heart; for consider what great things he has done for you.

paite: Himahleh giloutak a thil na hih lailai uleh nou leh na kumpipa uh na mangthang ding uh," achi hi.
english: But if you keep doing evil, you will be consumed, both you and your king.”

paite: Saul kum sawmthum ahih in vaihawm apan a; Israelte tung ah kum nih vai ahawm in,
english: Saul was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned over Israel forty-two years.

paite: Saul in Israelte lak ah mi sangthum atel hi. Huai teng lak a sangnih Mikmash ah leh Bethel tang ah Saul kiang ah a-om uh. Sangkhat Benjamin gam a Gibeah ah Jonathan kiang ah a-om uh. Adang teng apuanin uah apaisak vek hi.
english: Saul chose for himself three thousand men of Israel, of which two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in the Mount of Bethel, and one thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin. He sent the rest of the people to their own tents.

paite: Jonathan in Gibeah a om Philistia galvil sepaihte ava sual hi. Huai Philistia mite'n ana za uhi. Huchi in Saul in, "Hebru mite'n na za uhen," chi in agam tengteng ah pengkul amutsak hi.
english: Jonathan struck the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard of it. Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, “Let the Hebrews hear!”

paite: Israel tengteng in, Saul in Philistia galvil sepaihte asual chih leh Israelte'n leng Philistia mite huat in a-om uh chih thute ana zata uh. Huchi in mite Saul kiang ah Gilgal ah akikaikhawm uhi.
english: All Israel heard that Saul had struck the garrison of the Philistines, and also that Israel was considered an abomination to the Philistines. The people were gathered together after Saul to Gilgal.

paite: Philistia mite Israelte sual ding in akikaikhawm uhi. Kangtalai singthum, sakol tungtuangmi sangguk, mihing tuipi piau a piaunel zah mahmah a tam ahi uh. Huchi in akuantou ua, Beth-aven suahlam pang ah Mikmash ah panmun akhoh uhi.
english: The Philistines assembled themselves together to fight with Israel: thirty thousand chariots, six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the seashore in multitude. They came up and encamped in Michmash, eastward of Beth Aven.

paite: Israel mite'n umbit in a-om uh chih akitheih un, mite lah alunghimoh mahmahta ua, mite kokhuk ah, lounok ah, suangpi pang ah, kulh ah leikohawm ah akibu uhi.
english: When the men of Israel saw that they were in trouble (for the people were distressed), then the people hid themselves in caves, in thickets, in rocks, in tombs, and in pits.

paite: Hebru mi khenkhatte Jordan gal ah Gad leh Gilead gam ah atai uhi. Saul bel Gilgal ah a-om lailai a, mite'n ling kawmkawm in amah azui uhi.
english: Now some of the Hebrews had gone over the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead; but as for Saul, he was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.

paite: Samuel hun seh bang in ni sagih ataam hi. Himahleh Samuel lah Gilgal ah ahong pai kei hi. Huchi in mite'n ataizaksanta uh.
english: He stayed seven days, according to the time set by Samuel; but Samuel didn’t come to Gilgal, and the people were scattering from him.

paite: Saul in, "Haltum thillat ding leh lemna thillat dingte hiai ah ka kiang ah hon la un," achi hi. Huchi in halmang thillat alan hi.
english: Saul said, “Bring the burnt offering to me here, and the peace offerings.” He offered the burnt offering.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, halmang thillat alan khin lel a, ngai in, Samuel ahong tung hi. Amah mu ding in Saul akuan hi. Samuel in, "Bang na hih na hia?" achi hi.
english: It came to pass that as soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might greet him.

paite: Saul in, "Mite'n ahon paimangsan khin ua, nang lah niseh ni in na hong tungta kei hi. Philistia mite lah Mikmash ah akikaikhawm uh chih ka thei hi.
english: Samuel said, “What have you done?” Saul said, “Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that you didn’t come within the days appointed, and that the Philistines assembled themselves together at Michmash,

paite: Huaiziak in 'Philistia mite'n Gilgal ah hon sual dekdek uhi. TOUPA hehpihna lah ka ngen nai kei a,' ka chi hi. Huaiziak in halmang thillat lan lou thei ka hi kei,” achi hi.
english: therefore I said, ‘Now the Philistines will come down on me to Gilgal, and I haven’t entreated the favor of Yahweh.’ I forced myself therefore, and offered the burnt offering.”

paite: Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "Na thilhih ahaihuai mahmah hi. TOUPA na Pathian thupiak, nang thu ahon piak na zui kei hi. TOUPA'N Israelte tung ah na lalna tangtawn a hihkip tum zaw hiven maw,
english: Samuel said to Saul, “You have done foolishly. You have not kept the commandment of Yahweh your God, which he commanded you; for now Yahweh would have established your kingdom on Israel forever.

paite: Himahleh na lalna amongta ding; TOUPA'N thu ahon piak na zuih louh ziak in TOUPA'N ama lungtang bang pumi azong a, mite tung a heutu ding in TOUPA'N amah asepta hi," achi hi.
english: But now your kingdom will not continue. Yahweh has sought for himself a man after his own heart, and Yahweh has appointed him to be prince over his people, because you have not kept that which Yahweh commanded you.”

paite: Samuel athou a, Gilgal a pan Benjamin gam a Gibeah ah ahohtou hi. Saul in akiang a mi omte asim a, zaguk tak ahi uh.
english: Samuel arose, and went from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. Saul counted the people who were present with him, about six hundred men.

paite: Saul leh atapa Jonathan leh akiang ua mi omte Benjamin gam a Gibeah ah a-om uh. Himahleh Philistia mite'n Mikmash ah panmun akhoh uhi.
english: Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people who were present with them, stayed in Geba of Benjamin; but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.

paite: Lok mite Philistia mite panmun a pan pawl thum ahong kuan ua, pawl khat in Shual gam a Ophrah lam zuan lampi azui uhi.
english: The raiders came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned to the way that leads to Ophrah, to the land of Shual;

paite: Pawl khat in Beth-horon lam zuan lampi azui ua, pawl dang in gamdai zul Zeboim Phaizang lam zuan gamgi lampi azui uhi.
english: another company turned the way to Beth Horon; and another company turned the way of the border that looks down on the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.

paite: Philistia mite'n, "Hebru mite'n namsau hiam, tei hiam abawl kha zenzen ding uh," achih ziak un Israel gam pumpi ah siksekmi akimu kei hi.
english: Now there was no blacksmith found throughout all the land of Israel, for the Philistines said, “Lest the Hebrews make themselves swords or spears”;

paite: Himahleh Israel mi tengteng, michih aleilehna, asuanggal, aheipi, atupi tat-hiam ding in, Philistiate kiang ah ahohsuk zel uhi.
english: but all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, each man to sharpen his own plowshare, mattock, ax, and sickle.

paite: Himahleh tupite, suanggalte, sikkhutte leh heipite tat-hiamna ding sik-hat leh chiang mukzumte bawlna ding anei uhi.
english: The price was one payim each to sharpen mattocks, plowshares, pitchforks, axes, and goads.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, akidou ni un Saul leh Jonathan kiang a om mite'n namsau hiam, tei hiam anei kei uh. Saul leh atapa Jonathan in bel anei uhi.
english: So it came to pass in the day of battle that neither sword nor spear was found in the hand of any of the people who were with Saul and Jonathan; but Saul and Jonathan his son had them.

paite: Philistia galvil sepaihte Mikmash kuam ah apaikheta uhi.
english: The garrison of the Philistines went out to the pass of Michmash.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ni khat Saul tapa Jonathan in agalvan tawipa tangval kiang ah, "Kisa dih, gal langkhat a Philistia mi galvil sepaihte omna ah i va hoh ding," achi hi. Himahleh apa ahilh kei hi.
english: Now it happened on a day that Jonathan the son of Saul said to the young man who bore his armor, “Come! Let’s go over to the Philistines’ garrison that is on the other side.” But he didn’t tell his father.

paite: Saul bel Gibeah gam tawp lam pek a Migron a theibuhfai kung nuai ah a-om hi. Akiang a om mite zaguk ahi uh.
english: Saul stayed in the uttermost part of Gibeah under the pomegranate tree which is in Migron; and the people who were with him were about six hundred men,

paite: Shiloh a TOUPA siampu Eli tapa Phinehas tapa Ikabod unaupa Ahitub tapa Ahijah siampu puanak silh a-om hi. Jonathan ahoh chih mipite'n athei kei uhi.
english: including Ahijah the son of Ahitub, Ichabod’s brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli the priest of Yahweh in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. The people didn’t know that Jonathan was gone.

paite: Jonathan in Philistia mi galvil sepaihte omna a hoh atupna phaizang leh phaizang kikal ah alang tuaktuak ah suangpi sangtak a-om hi. Akhat min Bozez ahi a, akhat min Seneh ahi.
english: Between the passes, by which Jonathan sought to go over to the Philistines’ garrison, there was a rocky crag on the one side and a rocky crag on the other side; and the name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.

paite: Suangpi sang khat pen Mikmash zawn mallam a om ahi a, adang khat pen Gebeah zawn simlam a om ahi.
english: The one crag rose up on the north in front of Michmash, and the other on the south in front of Geba.

paite: Jonathan in agalvan tawipa tangval kiang ah, "Kisa dih, zeksum louh sepaihte omna ah i va hoh ding. TOUPA'N thil ahon hihsak kha mai hiam. TOUPA a ding in atam hiam, atawm hiam ahotdamna ding bangmah dalna a-om tuan ngal kei a," achi hi.
english: Jonathan said to the young man who bore his armor, “Come! Let’s go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised. It may be that Yahweh will work for us, for there is no restraint on Yahweh to save by many or by few.”

paite: Agalvan tawipa'n akiang ah, "Na lungsim a om bangtak in hih in. Ngai in, na lungsim bang geih ka lungsim ahi," achi hi.
english: His armor bearer said to him, “Do all that is in your heart. Go, and behold, I am with you according to your heart.”

paite: Huchi in Jonathan in, "Kisa in, akiang uah i va hoh galkah dia, i va kimusak ding.
english: Then Jonathan said, “Behold, we will pass over to the men, and we will reveal ourselves to them.

paite: I kiang a, 'Na kiang ua ka hong matan uh na om un, ahon chih uleh i mun ah i dingh kinken dia, akiang uah i hohtou kei ding.'
english: If they say this to us, ‘Wait until we come to you!’ then we will stand still in our place and will not go up to them.

paite: "Ka kiang lam uah hong tou un, achih uleh bel i hohtou dia, TOUPA'N i khut ah amaute ahon pia chih ei a ding in chiamtehna ahi ding," achi hi.
english: But if they say this, ‘Come up to us!’ then we will go up, for Yahweh has delivered them into our hand. This shall be the sign to us.”

paite: Anih un Philistia mi galvil sepaihte ava kimusak uhi. Philistiate'n, "En dih uh, Hebru mite abukna leihawm a pan ahong paikhia uh," achi uhi.
english: Both of them revealed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines; and the Philistines said, “Behold, the Hebrews are coming out of the holes where they had hidden themselves!”

paite: Galvil sepaihte omna a mite'n Jonathan leh agalvan tawipa, "Hong paitou unla, thil banghiam ka hon ensak ding uh," chi in ana sam uhi. Jonathan in agalvan tawipa kiang ah, "Hon zuitou dih. TOUPA'N amaute Israelte khut ah apeta hi," achi hi.
english: The men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armor bearer, and said, “Come up to us, and we will show you something!” Jonathan said to his armor bearer, “Come up after me, for Yahweh has delivered them into the hand of Israel.”

paite: Jonathan akhut leh khe toh pang in akaltou a, agalvan tawipa'n azui hi. Amau bel Jonathan ma ah apuk ua, ama nung in agalvan tawipa'n amaute athat hi.
english: Jonathan climbed up on his hands and on his feet, and his armor bearer after him, and they fell before Jonathan; and his armor bearer killed them after him.

paite: Jonathan leh agalvan tawipa'n athah masakpen uh mi sawmnih vel, lou chiing khat, bawngtal nih leilehna chia sung ahi.
english: That first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armor bearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were half a furrow’s length in an acre of land.

paite: Giahmun leh gamlak a mipi tengteng aling ua; galvil sepaihte leh lok mite leng aling sam uh. Huan ziin ahong ling a; huchi in nakpitak a linna a-om hi.
english: There was a trembling in the camp, in the field, and among all the people; the garrison and the raiders also trembled; and the earth quaked, so there was an exceedingly great trembling.

paite: Benjamin gam Gibeah ah Saul galvil mite'n a-en vialvial uhi. Ngai in, mipite zul in azulkhe zungzung ua, khat lam khat lam ah akiphutuah muimui uhi.
english: The watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and behold, the multitude melted away and scattered.

paite: Huchi in Saul in akiang a mipi omte kiang ah, "Tu in kisim unla, kuate ahia kim lou hong ki-en dih ua," achi hi. Ahong kisim uleh ngai in, Jonathan leh agalvan tawipa ana om kei uhi.
english: Then Saul said to the people who were with him, “Count now, and see who is missing from us.” When they had counted, behold, Jonathan and his armor bearer were not there.

paite: Saul in Ahijah kiang ah, "Pathian bawm va la dih," achi hi. Huai lai in Pathian bawm Israel suante kiang a om ahi.
english: Saul said to Ahijah, “Bring God’s ark here.” For God’s ark was with the children of Israel at that time.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Saul in siampu ahoupih laitak in Philistia mite giahmun lam a thawmging angaih semsem hi. Saul in siampu kiang ah, "Na khut kaikik in," achi hi.
english: While Saul talked to the priest, the tumult that was in the camp of the Philistines went on and increased; and Saul said to the priest, “Withdraw your hand!”

paite: Huchi in Saul leh akiang a mipi om tengteng apaikhawm ua, kidouna ah ahohta uh. Ngai in, amau leh amau namsau in ana kisattuah ua, huchi in apumbuai uhi.
english: Saul and all the people who were with him were gathered together, and came to the battle; and behold, they were all striking each other with their swords in very great confusion.

paite: Hiai ban ah tuma lam a Hebru mite huai gam kim a pan Philistiate giahmun a amau toh va paitoute leng Saul leh Jonathan kiang a om in Israel mite lam ah ahong pang nawnta uhi,
english: Now the Hebrews who were with the Philistines before and who went up with them into the camp from all around, even they also turned to be with the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.

paite: Huchi mah bang in Ephraim tanggam a Israel mi kibu tengteng in Philistia mite ataimang uh chih ana za ua, amau leng kidouna a pang sam in adelhzui uhi.
english: Likewise all the men of Israel who had hidden themselves in the hill country of Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.

paite: Huchi in huai ni in TOUPA'N Israelte ahumbitta hi. Beth-aven pha in asual uhi.
english: So Yahweh saved Israel that day; and the battle passed over by Beth Aven.

paite: Huai ni in Israel mite alungkia ua, Saul in, "Ka melmate tung a phu ka lakna dia nitaklam ahih masiah kuapeuh in an anekleh hamsia thuak hen," achih ziak in. Huchi in kuamah in an himhim achiam kei uhi.
english: The men of Israel were distressed that day; for Saul had adjured the people, saying, “Cursed is the man who eats any food until it is evening, and I am avenged of my enemies.” So none of the people tasted food.

paite: Mipi tengteng gamnuai ava tung ua, lei ah khuaizu ana om hi.
english: All the people came into the forest; and there was honey on the ground.

paite: Mipite gamnuai ava tun un, ngai in, khuaizu ana takkhia hi. Himahleh mipite'n hamsia alauh ziak un kuama'n khut a sawk in achiam ngam kei uhi.
english: When the people had come to the forest, behold, honey was dripping, but no one put his hand to his mouth, for the people feared the oath.

paite: Himahleh apa'n mipite kichiam a, vau ahih lam Jonathan in thei lou in akhut a chiangmong in khuaikhak adawt a, akam a guang in aneta a, huchi in amit hah ahong chiangta hi.
english: But Jonathan didn’t hear when his father commanded the people with the oath. Therefore he put out the end of the rod that was in his hand and dipped it in the honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes brightened.

paite: Mipi lak a mi khat in ahoupih a, "Na pa'n zaw mipite tuni a an ne peuhmah hamsethuak in om hen, chi a vau bikbek hiven. Huchi in mipite abah uhi,” achi hi.
english: Then one of the people answered, and said, “Your father directly commanded the people with an oath, saying, ‘Cursed is the man who eats food today.’” So the people were faint.

paite: Jonathan in, "Ka pa'n mite buaisak lel ahi ve. Enta unla, khuaizu tawmchik ka chep ziak lel a ka mit ahong vak takdan.
english: Then Jonathan said, “My father has troubled the land. Please look how my eyes have brightened because I tasted a little of this honey.

paite: Mipite'n gallak thil amuh peuhpeuh uh tuni in a-utut uh ne thei le uh vakzaw na tel in chia! Huaiziak in Philistiate tamsem thah louh loh i hi ve ua,” achi hi.
english: How much more, if perhaps the people had eaten freely today of the plunder of their enemies which they found? For now there has been no great slaughter among the Philistines.”

paite: Huai ni in Mikmash a pan Aijalon tan in Philistia mite adou uh. Huchi in mipite abah mahmah uhi.
english: They struck the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon. The people were very faint;

paite: Mipite'n agallak thil uh aboh in aboh uhi. Belamte, bawngtalte leh bawngnoute aman ua, leitual ah athat ua, mipite'n asisan toh ane uhi.
english: and the people pounced on the plunder, and took sheep, cattle, and calves, and killed them on the ground; and the people ate them with the blood.

paite: "Ngai in, mipite'n sisan toh ne in TOUPA tung ah akhialta uh," chi in Saul ahilh uhi. Ama'n, "Na talekta uhi; ka ma ah suang lianpi khuk un," achi hi.
english: Then they told Saul, saying, “Behold, the people are sinning against Yahweh, in that they eat meat with the blood.” He said, “You have dealt treacherously. Roll a large stone to me today!”

paite: Saul in, "Mipi lak ah vakzak vek unla, akiang uah, michih in abawng hon kai hen. Michih in abelam hon kai hen. Hiai ah hong gou in ne hen. Asisan toh ne a TOUPA tung a thil hihkhial lou in, va chi un," achi hi. Huai zan in mi tengteng in amau bawngtal chiat uh ahon kai ua, huai ah agou uhi.
english: Saul said, “Disperse yourselves among the people, and tell them, ‘Every man bring me here his ox, and every man his sheep, and kill them here, and eat; and don’t sin against Yahweh in eating meat with the blood.’” All the people brought every man his ox with him that night, and killed them there.

paite: Saul in TOUPA a ding in maitam adoh a; huai pen TOUPA a dia maitam abawl masakpen ahi.
english: Saul built an altar to Yahweh. This was the first altar that he built to Yahweh.

paite: Saul in, "Zan chiang in Philistia mite va dou unla, zing khovak tan in i sual ding uh. Kuamah i hawi kei ding uh," achi hi. Amau, "Hoih na sak peuhmah hih in," achi uh. Siampu in ahihleh, "Pathian naih ni," achi hi.
english: Saul said, “Let’s go down after the Philistines by night, and take plunder among them until the morning light. Let’s not leave a man of them.” They said, “Do whatever seems good to you.” Then the priest said, “Let’s draw near here to God.”

paite: Saul in Pathian adong a, "Philistia mite ka va sual diam? Israelte khut ah amaute na pe diam?" achi hi. Himahleh huai ni'n adawng kei.
english: Saul asked counsel of God: “Shall I go down after the Philistines? Will you deliver them into the hand of Israel?” But he didn’t answer him that day.

paite: Saul in, "Nou mipi heutu tengteng hong nai dih ua. Tuni in akoi pen ah ahia i khelh uh theihkhiak tum dih uh.
english: Saul said, “Draw near here, all you chiefs of the people, and know and see in whom this sin has been today.

paite: Israelte hondam zelpa TOUPA ahin lai teng ka tapa Jonathan hilhial in ana hihkhelhleh amah asih ngeingei ding ahi,” achi hi. Himahleh mipi lak a mi kuamah adawng himhim a-om kei uh.
english: For as Yahweh lives, who saves Israel, though it is in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die.” But there was not a man among all the people who answered him.

paite: Israel tengteng kiang ah, "Noute atuam in omkhawm unla, kei leh ka tapa Jonathan atuam in ka omkhawm ding uh," achi hi. Mipite'n Saul kiang ah, "Hoih na sak bang in hih in," achi uhi.
english: Then he said to all Israel, “You be on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side.” The people said to Saul, “Do what seems good to you.”

paite: Saul in TOUPA Israelte' Pathian kiang ah, "Adiktak hon hihlang in," achi a, aisan pen Jonathan leh Saul tung ah apuk a; mipite bel ahul uhi.
english: Therefore Saul said to Yahweh, the God of Israel, “Show the right.” Jonathan and Saul were chosen, but the people escaped.

paite: Saul in, "Kei leh ka tapa kikal ah aisan un," achi hi. Huchi in Jonathan tung ah apuk hi.
english: Saul said, “Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son.” Jonathan was selected.

paite: Saul in Jonathan kiang ah, "Bang ahia na hih hon hilh in," achi hi. Jonathan in ahilh a, "Ka chiang tawi mong in khuaizu neuchik ka na chiam hi. Ngai in, ka sih ding mah ahi," achi hi.
english: Then Saul said to Jonathan, “Tell me what you have done!” Jonathan told him, and said, “I certainly did taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in my hand; and behold, I must die.”

paite: Saul in, "Pathian in ahihhih in hih mai hen. Huai sang a thupizaw in leng. Jonathan, na si ngeingei ding ahi," achi hi.
english: Saul said, “God do so and more also; for you shall surely die, Jonathan.”

paite: Mipite'n Saul kiang ah, "Israelte lak a hiai hotdamna thupi mahmah hihpa Jonathan asi dia hia? Si lou hial ding. TOUPA ahin lai teng asamzang khat leng lei ah ake het kei ding. Tuni in Pathian toh asemkhawm uhi," achi uh. Mipite'n Jonathan ahondam ua, asi kei hi.
english: The people said to Saul, “Shall Jonathan die, who has worked this great salvation in Israel? Far from it! As Yahweh lives, there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground, for he has worked with God today!” So the people rescued Jonathan, so he didn’t die.

paite: Saul in Philistia mite adelh lai akiksanta a, Philistia mite amau om mun ah apaita uhi.
english: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines; and the Philistines went to their own place.

paite: Saul in Israelte tung ah vaihawmna ala a, aning teng ah amelmate, Moab, Ammon suante, Edom, Zobah kumpipate leh Philistia mite adou a; akiheina peuh ah avualzou zel hi.
english: Now when Saul had taken the kingdom over Israel, he fought against all his enemies on every side: against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines. Wherever he turned himself, he defeated them.

paite: Hangsantak in gal adou a, Amalekte azou a, alok mite khut a pan Israelte ahonkhia hi.
english: He did valiantly and struck the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of those who plundered them.

paite: Saul tapate bel Jonathan, Ishvi leh Malki-shua ahi ua, atanu nihte min hiaite ahi; a-upazaw min Merab ahi a, anaupangzaw min Mikal ahi.
english: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchishua; and the names of his two daughters were these: the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal.

paite: Saul zi min Ahinoam ahi a, amah Ahimaaz tanu ahi. Asepaih heutu min Abner ahi a, amah Saul paneu Ner tapa ahi.
english: The name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam the daughter of Ahimaaz. The name of the captain of his army was Abner the son of Ner, Saul’s uncle.

paite: Saul pa Kish ahi a, Abner pa Ner bel Abiel tapa ahi.
english: Kish was the father of Saul, and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.

paite: Saul damsung teng in Philistia mite toh nakpitak in akidou uhi. Saul in mihat leh hangsan amuh peuhmah anuai a sem ding in ala zel hi.
english: There was severe war against the Philistines all the days of Saul; and when Saul saw any mighty man or any valiant man, he took him into his service.

paite: Huan Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "TOUPA'N amite tung ah, Israelte tung ah kumpipa dia nang sathau hon nilh dia ahon sawl ka hi. Huaiziak in tu in TOUPA thugen ngaikhia in.
english: Samuel said to Saul, “Yahweh sent me to anoint you to be king over his people, over Israel. Now therefore listen to the voice of Yahweh’s words.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, Amalek mite'n Israelte tung a athilhih uh, Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawtkhiak lai ua lampi a ana daldan ka theigige hi.
english: Yahweh of Armies says, ‘I remember what Amalek did to Israel, how he set himself against him on the way when he came up out of Egypt.

paite: Amalekte dou ding in kuan inla, athil neih tengteng uh hawi himhim nei lou in hihmang vek in. Numei leh pasal, naungek leh nawi ne lai, bawngtal leh belam, sangawngsau leh sabiltung tan in that vek in, achi,” achi hi.
english: Now go and strike Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and don’t spare them; but kill both man and woman, infant and nursing baby, ox and sheep, camel and donkey.’”

paite: Huchi in Saul in mipite asamkhawm a, Telaim ah amaute asim a, sepaih nuainih leh Judah mi singkhat ahi uh.
english: Saul summoned the people, and counted them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen and ten thousand men of Judah.

paite: Saul Amalekte khua atungsuk a, phaizang ah ana buk hi.
english: Saul came to the city of Amalek, and set an ambush in the valley.

paite: Saul in Kente kiang ah, "Hong pawt unla, Amalekte a pan kihuikhia un. Huchi lou in zaw, ka hon that tel kha ding. Nou zaw Israel suan tengteng Aigupta a pan ahong pawtkhiak lai un na na hehpih ua," achi hi. Huchi in Kente Amalek mite lak a pan apawtkhia uhi.
english: Saul said to the Kenites, “Go, depart, go down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them; for you showed kindness to all the children of Israel when they came up out of Egypt.” So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.

paite: Saul in Amalek mite Havilah a pan Aigupta gam gei a Shur tan in adou hi.
english: Saul struck the Amalekites, from Havilah as you go to Shur, which is before Egypt.

paite: Amalek mite kumpipa Agag ahingmat a, mipi tengteng namsau in asatlum vek hi.
english: He took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

paite: Himahleh Saul leh mipite'n Agag ahawi ua, belam leh bawngtal hoihhoih, athauthau, belamnoute, ahoih tengteng athat nuam kei uh. Ahoih lou leh adeih louh peuhmah uh bel athat vek uhi.
english: But Saul and the people spared Agag and the best of the sheep, of the cattle, of the fat calves, of the lambs, and all that was good, and were not willing to utterly destroy them; but everything that was vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.

paite: TOUPA thu Samuel kiang ah ahong tung hi,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Samuel, saying,

paite: "Saul kumpipa dia ka seh ka kisik hi. Hon zui lai hon kinungngatsan in ka thupiak bang in ahih ngal kei a," achi hi. Hiai in Samuel ahehsak a, zankhua in TOUPA asam hi.
english: “It grieves me that I have set up Saul to be king, for he has turned back from following me, and has not performed my commandments.” Samuel was angry; and he cried to Yahweh all night.

paite: Saul mu ding in Samuel zingkhangpi in athou a, Karmel ah Saul ahoh hi. Ngai in, huai ah amah theihgigena suang aphut a, akik nawn a, apai zel a, Gilgal ah apaisukta, chih Samuel hilh in a-om hi.
english: Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning; and Samuel was told, saying, “Saul came to Carmel, and behold, he set up a monument for himself, turned, passed on, and went down to Gilgal.”

paite: Saul kiang Samuel ahong tung a, akiang ah, "TOUPA'N hon vualzawl hen. TOUPA thupiak bang in ka hihta," achi hi.
english: Samuel came to Saul; and Saul said to him, “You are blessed by Yahweh! I have performed the commandment of Yahweh.”

paite: Samuel in, "Tua belam ham ka bil a hong lut leh bawng ham ka zakte bangchidan ahi dia le?" achi hi.
english: Samuel said, “Then what does this bleating of the sheep in my ears and the lowing of the cattle which I hear mean?”

paite: Saul in, "Amalek mite ahon laksak uh ahi. TOUPA na Pathian kiang a kithoihna ding in mipite'n belam leh bawngtal hoihhoih ahawi uhi. Adang tengteng ahihleh ka that vek uhi," achi hi.
english: Saul said, “They have brought them from the Amalekites; for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the cattle, to sacrifice to Yahweh your God. We have utterly destroyed the rest.”

paite: Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "Dai in, TOUPA'N tuzan a ka kiang a athugen ka hon hilh ding," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Gen dih ve," achi hi.
english: Then Samuel said to Saul, “Stay, and I will tell you what Yahweh said to me last night.” He said to him, “Say on.”

paite: Samuel in, "Nang ngaih in mi neuchik himah lechin leng, Israel nam heutu dia bawl na hi kei maw? TOUPA'N Israelte kumpipa ding in sathau ahon nilh hi.
english: Samuel said, “Though you were little in your own sight, weren’t you made the head of the tribes of Israel? Yahweh anointed you king over Israel;

paite: TOUPA'N nang ahon sawlkhia a, kuan inla, mikhialte, Amalek mite that vek inla, amanthat sipsip masiah uh dou zel in, ahon chi hi.
english: and Yahweh sent you on a journey, and said, ‘Go, and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they are consumed.’

paite: Bang ding a TOUPA thu zui lou a, gallak thilte aboh a na boh a, TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou na hih mawk?" achi hi.
english: Why then didn’t you obey Yahweh’s voice, but took the plunder, and did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight?”

paite: Saul in Samuel kiang ah, "E, TOUPA thu ka zui vo oi, TOUPA'N hon sawlna ah ka hoh a, Amalek kumpipa Agag ka hon man a, Amalek mite ka that vek vo oi.
english: Saul said to Samuel, “But I have obeyed Yahweh’s voice, and have gone the way which Yahweh sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.

paite: Himahleh mipite'n gallak thil belam leh bawngtal hihman ding lak ah ahoihhoih Gilgal a TOUPA na Pathian kiang a kithoihna ding in ahon tawi uh," achi hi.
english: But the people took of the plunder, sheep and cattle, the best of the devoted things, to sacrifice to Yahweh your God in Gilgal.”

paite: Samuel in, "TOUPA'N TOUPA thu zuih makipahpih bang in halmang thillatte leh kithoihnate akipahpih a hia? Ngai in, kithoihna sang in thuman ahoihzaw a, belamtal thau sang in athu man ahoihzaw hi.
english: Samuel said, “Has Yahweh as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying Yahweh’s voice? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to listen than the fat of rams.

paite: Helna zaw aisan khelhna toh akibang a, engtatna zaw milim biakna toh akikim hi. TOUPA thu na nial ziak in ama'n leng kumpipa ding in nang ahon nialta," achi hi.
english: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as idolatry and teraphim. Because you have rejected Yahweh’s word, he has also rejected you from being king.”

paite: Saul in Samuel kiangah, "Mipite lau a, athu uh ka manna lam in TOUPA thupiak leh nang thu ka na bohse maizen a; ka na khialta hi.
english: Saul said to Samuel, “I have sinned; for I have transgressed the commandment of Yahweh and your words, because I feared the people and obeyed their voice.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in ka khelhna ngaidam inla, TOUPA ka biaktheihna ding in kei lam ah hong kihei nawn in," achi hi.
english: Now therefore, please pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship Yahweh.”

paite: Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "TOUPA thu na nialta a, nang lam ah ka hong kihei nawn kei ding. TOUPA'N Israelte kumpipa ding in ahon deih kei," achi hi.
english: Samuel said to Saul, “I will not return with you; for you have rejected Yahweh’s word, and Yahweh has rejected you from being king over Israel.”

paite: Huchi in Samuel pai dia akiheileh apuan mong ah alen a, akekta hi.
english: As Samuel turned around to go away, Saul grabbed the skirt of his robe, and it tore.

paite: Huchi in Samuel in akiang ah, "Tuni a pan ToUPA'N Israel gam ahon sutta, nang sang a hoihzaw na inveng kiang ah apeta hi.
english: Samuel said to him, “Yahweh has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today, and has given it to a neighbor of yours who is better than you.

paite: Israelte thagui azuau kei dia, akisik sam kei ding. Mihing bang a kisik nawn themthum mi ahi ngal kei hi," achi hi.
english: Also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent; for he is not a man, that he should repent.”

paite: Huchi in ama'n, “Ka na khialta hi. Himahleh ka mite upate leh Israelte ma a hon zahtak ding in ka hon ngen hi. TOUPA na Pathian ka biaktheihna ding in kei lam ah hong kihei in aw," achi hi.
english: Then he said, “I have sinned; yet please honor me now before the elders of my people and before Israel, and come back with me, that I may worship Yahweh your God.”

paite: Huchi in Samuel in Saul apaipih a, Saul in TOUPA abia hi.
english: So Samuel went back with Saul; and Saul worshiped Yahweh.

paite: Samuel in, "Amalek mite kumpipa Agag ka kiang ah hon pi un," achi hi. Samuel kiang ah ling kawm in Agag ava hoh hi. Agag in, "Sihna mulkimhuai in hon paikhengta ahi ve," achi hi.
english: Then Samuel said, “Bring Agag the king of the Amalekites here to me!” Agag came to him cheerfully. Agag said, “Surely the bitterness of death is past.”

paite: Samuel in, "Na namsau in numeite ta nei lou dia abawl bang in na nu leng numei lak a ta neiloumi ahi ding," achi hi. Huchi in Samuel in Gilgal ah TOUPA ma ah Agag asatzanta hi.
english: Samuel said, “As your sword has made women childless, so your mother will be childless among women!” Then Samuel cut Agag in pieces before Yahweh in Gilgal.

paite: Huchi in Ramah ah Samuel apai a; Saul bel a-inn ah Saul omna khua Gibeah ah apaitou hi.
english: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.

paite: Huchi in Samuel in asih ni pha in Saul amu nawnta kei hi. Samuel bel Saul ziak in alungkham hi. Israelte kumpipa dia Saul ana tel ziak in TOUPA akisik hi.
english: Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death, but Samuel mourned for Saul. Yahweh grieved that he had made Saul king over Israel.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Samuel kiang Huansraelite kummipang ka deih louhsa Saul ziak in bang tan ahia na lungkham ding? Na kii ah sathau thundim inla, kuan in. Bethlehem mi Jesse kiang ah ka hon sawl ding. Atapate lak a mi kumpipa ding in ka sep khinta hi," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Samuel, “How long will you mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him from being king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil, and go. I will send you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, for I have provided a king for myself among his sons.”

paite: Samuel in, "Bangchi in ka kuan thei dia? Saul in ana zaleh hon that ding," achi hi. TOUPA'N, "Bawngla hon pi inla, TOUPA kiang a kithoih dia hong ka hi," chi in.
english: Samuel said, “How can I go? If Saul hears it, he will kill me.” Yahweh said, “Take a heifer with you, and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to Yahweh.’

paite: "Kithoihna ah Jesse sam inla, na hih ding ka hon hilh ding. Amin ka hon hilh dingpa sathau hon nilhsak in," achi hi.
english: Call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you shall do. You shall anoint to me him whom I name to you.”

paite: Samuel in TOUPA gen bang in ahih a, Bethlehem ah ahohta hi. Khua a upate'n ling kawm in amah ana dawn ua, "Hoih lam thu a hong na hi maw?" achi uh. Ama'n, "Hoih lam thu ah hi e,” achi hi.
english: Samuel did that which Yahweh spoke, and came to Bethlehem. The elders of the city came to meet him trembling, and said, “Do you come peaceably?”

paite: "TOUPA kiang a kithoih dia hong ka hi. Kisiangsak unla kithoihna ah hong pai sam un," achi hi. Jesse leh atapate asiangsak a, kithoihna ah asam hi.
english: He said, “Peaceably; I have come to sacrifice to Yahweh. Sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice.” He sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ahong pai un Eliab ana en a, "TOUPA sathau nilhpa ama a ompa ahi mahmah ve," achi hi.
english: When they had come, he looked at Eliab, and said, “Surely Yahweh’s anointed is before him.”

paite: Himahleh ToUPA'N Samuel kiang ah, "Amel in hiam, asandan hiam in en ke'n. Ke'n amah ka deih kei hi. TOUPA'N mihing et bang in a-en kei. Mihing in polam a kilatdan a-en a, TOUPA'N bel lungtang a-en zaw hi,” achi hi.
english: But Yahweh said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the outward appearance, but Yahweh looks at the heart.”

paite: Jesse in Abinadab asam a, Samuel ma ah apaisak hi. Ama'n, "Hiai leng TOUPA tel ahi nai kei,” achi hi.
english: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. He said, “Yahweh has not chosen this one, either.”

paite: Jesse in Shammah ava paisak nawn hi. Ama'n, "Hiai leng TOUPA tel ahi nai kei lai," achi hi.
english: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. He said, “Yahweh has not chosen this one, either.”

paite: Huchi in Jesse in atapa sagihte Samuel ma ah apaisak nawn hi. Samuel in Jesse kiang ah, "TOUPA'N hiaite atel kei," achi hi.
english: Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. Samuel said to Jesse, “Yahweh has not chosen these.”

paite: Samuel in Jesse kiang ah, "Hiai ah na tapate a-om kim vek uhia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Anaupangpen a-om lai, ngai in, ama'n belam aching hi," achi hi. Samuel in Jesse kiang ah, "Va samsak dih ve; ahong tun masiah i tu kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: Samuel said to Jesse, “Are all your children here?” He said, “There remains yet the youngest. Behold, he is keeping the sheep.” Samuel said to Jesse, “Send and get him, for we will not sit down until he comes here.”

paite: Huchi in ava samsak a, amah ahon pi uhi. Amah bel san thiuhtheuh, mit hah kilawm leh melhoihtak ahi. "TOUPA'N, thou inla, sathau nilh in, hiai amah ahi,” achi hi.
english: He sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, with a handsome face and good appearance. Yahweh said, “Arise! Anoint him, for this is he.”

paite: Samuel in sathau bawm kii ala a, a-unaute lak ah amah sathau anilh hi. TOUPA Kha huai ni a pan nakpitak in David tung ah ahong tungta. Samuel athou a, Ramah ah apaita hi.
english: Then Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the middle of his brothers. Then Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up and went to Ramah.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA Kha in Saul apawtsan a, TOUPA sawl kha gilou in amah ahihbuai hi.
english: Now Yahweh’s Spirit departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from Yahweh troubled him.

paite: Saul sikhate'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, Pathian sawl kha gilou in nang hon hihbuai hi.
english: Saul’s servants said to him, “See now, an evil spirit from God troubles you.

paite: Ka toupa un na ma a om na sikhate kaihging tumsiamtak mi zon thu hon pe dih ve. Pathian sawl kha gilou in ahon mat chiang in atum dia, na hoih mai ding," achi uhi.
english: Let our lord now command your servants who are in front of you to seek out a man who is a skillful player on the harp. Then when the evil spirit from God is on you, he will play with his hand, and you will be well.”

paite: Saul in asikhate kiang ah, "Tumsiamtak mi hon zonsak unla, ka kiang ah hon pi un," achi hi.
english: Saul said to his servants, “Provide me now a man who can play well, and bring him to me.”

paite: Asikhate lak a khat in adawng a, akiang ah, "Ngai dih, Bethlehem mi Jesse tapa khat ka muta a, huai mi tumsiamtak, mihangsantak, kidoumi, thugen siam, melhoihtak ahi a, akiang ah TOUPA a om hi," achi hi.
english: Then one of the young men answered and said, “Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite who is skillful in playing, a mighty man of valor, a man of war, prudent in speech, and a handsome person; and Yahweh is with him.”

paite: Saul in Jesse kiang ah mi asawl a, "Na tapa David belamching a om ka kiang ah hon hohsak in," achi hi.
english: Therefore Saul sent messengers to Jesse, and said, “Send me David your son, who is with the sheep.”

paite: Jesse in sabiltung, tanghou leh uain thawl khat leh kelnou ala a, Saul piak ding in atapa David aposak hi.
english: Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread, a container of wine, and a young goat, and sent them by David his son to Saul.

paite: Saul kiang ah David ava tung a, ama ah ava dingh hi. Ama'n ana it mahmah a, agalvan tawipa in apangsak hi.
english: David came to Saul and stood before him. He loved him greatly; and he became his armor bearer.

paite: Saul in Jesse kiang ah, "David ka kiang ah om hen, ka mit atung mahmah hi," chi a hilh ding in mi asawl hi.
english: Saul sent to Jesse, saying, “Please let David stand before me, for he has found favor in my sight.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Saul tung a Pathian sawl dawi ahong om chiang in David in kaihging ala a, atum zel hi. Huchi in Saul ahong halh a, ahoih a; dawi in apawtsan hi.
english: When the spirit from God was on Saul, David took the harp and played with his hand; so Saul was refreshed and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.

paite: Huan Philistia mite'n kidou ding in asepaihte uh akaikhawm ua, Judah gamsung Sokoh ah akikhawm uhi. Ephes-dammim mun ah Sokoh khua leh Azekah kho kikal ah panmun akhoh uhi.
english: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle; and they were gathered together at Socoh, which belongs to Judah, and encamped between Socoh and Azekah in Ephesdammim.

paite: Saul leh Israel mite akikhawm ua, Elah Phaizang ah panmun akhoh uhi. Philistia mite na dal ding in akiphalh uhi.
english: Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and encamped in the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.

paite: Philistia mite tang pang ah a-om ua, Israel mite bel alangkhat tang pang ah a-om ua, akikal uah phaizang a-om hi.
english: The Philistines stood on the mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on the mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.

paite: Philistia mite panmun a pan amihat uh, amin Goliath, Gath khomi, tong guk leh khap khat a sang ahong pawtkhia hi.
english: A champion out of the camp of the Philistines named Goliath of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span went out.

paite: Dal lukhu akhu a, awmphaw asilh a; a-awmphaw gikdan dal shekel sangnga ahi.
english: He had a helmet of bronze on his head, and he wore a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of bronze.

paite: Angal ah dal ngalphaw abun a, anungzang ah dal teita akuah hi.
english: He had bronze shin armor on his legs and a bronze javelin between his shoulders.

paite: Atei peu siamkol bang ahi a; atei lu bel sik shekel zaguk a gik ahi. Aphaw popa ama ah apai hi.
english: The staff of his spear was like a weaver’s beam; and his spear’s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron. His shield bearer went before him.

paite: Adingh a, Israel sepaihte asam a, akiang uah, "Bangziak a kidou dia hong kiphalh na hi ua? Kei Philistia mi, nou Saul sikha na hi kei uh maw? Mi kitel unla ka kiang ah hong paisuk hen.
english: He stood and cried to the armies of Israel, and said to them, “Why have you come out to set your battle in array? Am I not a Philistine, and you servants to Saul? Choose a man for yourselves, and let him come down to me.

paite: Hon sual a ahon thahleh na sikha un ka om ding uh. Himahleh ke'n ka zoh a ka thahleh ka sikha un na om ding ua, ka nna uh na sem ding uh," achi hi.
english: If he is able to fight with me and kill me, then will we be your servants; but if I prevail against him and kill him, then you will be our servants and serve us.”

paite: Philistia mi in, "Tuni in Israel sepaihte ka chou a, mi khat hon kuansak unla ka na kisual ding uh," achi hi.
english: The Philistine said, “I defy the armies of Israel today! Give me a man, that we may fight together!”

paite: Saul leh Israel tengteng in huai Philistia mi thugente azak un, alunglel ua, lauh petmah in alau uhi.
english: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed and greatly afraid.

paite: Huchi in David tuh Judah gam a Bethlehem a Ephrath mi Jesse tapa ahi a, ama'n tapa giat anei hi. Saul hun lai in amah upa in tektak ahi khinta hi.
english: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Bethlehem Judah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons. The man was an elderly old man in the days of Saul.

paite: Jesse tapa upazaw thum in kidouna ah Saul azui uhi. Atapa thum kidouna a hohte min a-upapen Eliab, azom Abinadab, athumna Shammah ahi.
english: The three oldest sons of Jesse had gone after Saul to the battle; and the names of his three sons who went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next to him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.

paite: David anaupangpen ahi a, a-u thumte'n Saul azui uhi.
english: David was the youngest; and the three oldest followed Saul.

paite: Bethlehem ah apa belam kem in Saul kiang a pan David ava hoh hi.
english: Now David went back and forth from Saul to feed his father’s sheep at Bethlehem.

paite: Philistia mi in zingsang leh nitak teng in ava naih zel a, ni sawmli sung ava kitaklang zel hi.
english: The Philistine came near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.

paite: Jesse in atapa David kiang ah, "Vaimim kan ephah khat leh hiai tanghou beu sawm pua inla, na unaute kiang ah agiahmun uah va hohpih pah in.
english: Jesse said to David his son, “Now take for your brothers an ephah of this parched grain and these ten loaves, and carry them quickly to the camp to your brothers;

paite: Bawngnawi dat khal sawm apawl ua sangkhat heutupa a ding in puak inla; na unaute bangchi in a-om ua va en inla, atanchin uh theihna banghiam hon pua in," achi hi.
english: and bring these ten cheeses to the captain of their thousand; and see how your brothers are doing, and bring back news.”

paite: Saul leh amau leh Israel mi tengteng Philistia mite dou ding in Elah Phaizang ah a-om uhi.
english: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.

paite: Zingkhang in David athou a, belamte chingmi khat akemsak hi. Jesse in thu apiak dungzui in apua a, akuanta hi. Kidouna mun a pawtkhe lel sepaihte kidou dia akikou zuazua laitak un amah kangtalai omna mun ava tung hi.
english: David rose up early in the morning and left the sheep with a keeper, and took the provisions and went, as Jesse had commanded him. He came to the place of the wagons as the army which was going out to the fight shouted for the battle.

paite: Israelte leh Philistia mite kidou ding in ana kikhung ua, sepaih leh sepaih ana kigalsai uhi.
english: Israel and the Philistines put the battle in array, army against army.

paite: David in akemmi khut ah avan akoih a, sepaihte kiang lam ah ava tai a, asanggamte chibai ava buk hi.
english: David left his baggage in the hand of the keeper of the baggage and ran to the army, and came and greeted his brothers.

paite: Amaute ahoupih laitak in ngai in, amihat uh Gath a Philistia mi amin Goliath, Philistia mite sepaih pawl lak a pan ahong paisuk a, athugen ngei mah hong gen nawn hi. Huai thu David in azata hi.
english: As he talked with them, behold, the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, came up out of the ranks of the Philistines, and said the same words; and David heard them.

paite: Israel mi tengteng in huai mi amuh un, ataikek ua, lauh petmah in alau uhi.
english: All the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him and were terrified.

paite: Israel mite'n, "Huai mihing hong kuankhia na mu hia? Israel mite chou dia hong kuankhia ahi. Kuapeuh amah that kumpipa'n nakpitak in sum lam in ahih hausa dia, atanu ape dia, apa inkuan Israelte lak ah azalensak ding," achi uhi.
english: The men of Israel said, “Have you seen this man who has come up? He has surely come up to defy Israel. The king will give great riches to the man who kills him, and will give him his daughter, and will make his father’s house tax-free in Israel.”

paite: David in akiang a dinghte kiang ah, "Hiai Philistia mi that a, Israelte minsiatna lamangmi bangchi bawl ahi dia? Hiai zeksum louh Philistia mi kua ahia ahih, Pathian hing sepaihte achou vial mahmah,” achi hi.
english: David spoke to the men who stood by him, saying, “What shall be done to the man who kills this Philistine and takes away the reproach from Israel? For who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?”

paite: Mipite'n huchi in adawng ua, "Amah that peuhmah ka gen bang ua bawl ahi ding,” achi uhi.
english: The people answered him in this way, saying, “So shall it be done to the man who kills him.”

paite: A-u upapen Eliab in mite kiang a, athugen lai ana za hi. David tung ah Eliab aheh guih a, "Bangziak a hong suk na hia? Gamdai a belam tam lou omte kua chingsak na hia? Na kisaktheihdan leh na lungsim hoihlouhdan ka thei. Kidou en ding bang in na hong mawkmawk a," achi hi.
english: Eliab his oldest brother heard when he spoke to the men; and Eliab’s anger burned against David, and he said, “Why have you come down? With whom have you left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know your pride and the evil of your heart; for you have come down that you might see the battle.”

paite: David in, "Bang ka hih a ahia? Aziak om hilou ahi maw?" achi hi.
english: David said, “What have I now done? Is there not a cause?”

paite: Ama'n midang lam angatsan a, agen ngei mah agen hi. Mipite'n ama a mah bang in adawng nawn uhi.
english: He turned away from him toward another, and spoke like that again; and the people answered him again the same way.

paite: David thugen azak un Saul kiang ah agensawn ua; ama'n asam hi.
english: When the words were heard which David spoke, they rehearsed them before Saul; and he sent for him.

paite: David in Saul kiang ah, "Amah ziak in kuamah lungsim lunglel kei heh. Na sikha in huai Philistia mi ka va sual ding," achi hi.
english: David said to Saul, “Let no man’s heart fail because of him. Your servant will go and fight with this Philistine.”

paite: Saul in David kiang ah, "Nang zaw huai Philistia mi sual ding in na kuan thei kei ding, valnou phet na hi a, amah lah avalnou tung a pan galdou siammi ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: Saul said to David, “You are not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him; for you are but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.”

paite: David in Saul kiang ah, "Na sikha in apa belamte achin lai in, humpinelkai hiam vompi hiam ahong kuan a, belamhon lak a pan belamnou aman hi.
english: David said to Saul, “Your servant was keeping his father’s sheep; and when a lion or a bear came and took a lamb out of the flock,

paite: Ka delhzui a, ka sual a, akam a pan ka hunkhe zel hi. Amah hong sual tum in ahong dingh a, ke'n abaksam ah ka man a, ka sual a, ka that zel hi,
english: I went out after him, struck him, and rescued it out of his mouth. When he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, struck him, and killed him.

paite: Na sikha in humpinelkai leh vompi ka that tuaktuak hi. Huai zeksum louh Philistia mi amau bang in a-om sam ding hi. Pathian hing sepaihte achou vial a,” achi hi.
english: Your servant struck both the lion and the bear. This uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, since he has defied the armies of the living God.”

paite: David in, "Humpinelkai khutbom a pan leh vompi khutbom a pan kei hon hunkhepa TOUPA'N huai Philistia mi khut a pan hon hunkhe ding," achi hi. Saul in David kiang ah, "Kuan in, na kiang ah TOUPA om hen!" achi hi.
english: David said, “Yahweh, who delivered me out of the paw of the lion and out of the paw of the bear, will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine.” Saul said to David, “Go! Yahweh will be with you.”

paite: Saul in amah galthuam David asilhsak a, dal lukhu akhusak a, awmphaw asilhsak hi.
english: Saul dressed David with his clothing. He put a helmet of bronze on his head, and he clad him with a coat of mail.

paite: David in agalvan tung ah anamsau akuah a, pai ding in akisa hi. Huchibang achiamteh ngei nai kei hi. David in Saul kiang ah, "Ka paipih thei kei. Hichibang ka chiamteh ngei kei," achi hi. Huchi in David in agalthuam asuahta hi.
english: David strapped his sword on his clothing and he tried to move, for he had not tested it. David said to Saul, “I can’t go with these, for I have not tested them.” Then David took them off.

paite: Achiangkhun atawi a, luita a suang mum mam pilhpelh nga atel hi. Abelam chinna kawlzal ah akuah hi. Akhut a avaisuanglot tawi in, Philistia mi ava zuan naita hi.
english: He took his staff in his hand, and chose for himself five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in the pouch of his shepherd’s bag which he had. His sling was in his hand; and he came near to the Philistine.

paite: Philistia mi ahong pai zel a, David azuan nai hulhul a; ama ah alum tawipa apai hi.
english: The Philistine walked and came near to David; and the man who bore the shield went before him.

paite: Philistia mi'n a-en vialvial a, David amuhleh asimmoh mahmah hi. Amah lah san chiuchiau, mit hah kilawmtak, valnou lel lah ahi ngal a.
english: When the Philistine looked around and saw David, he disdained him; for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and had a good looking face.

paite: Philistia mi in David kiang ah, "Ui ka hi maw chiangte toh ka kiang a na hong pai?" achi hi. Philistia mi in apathiante lou in David ahamsiatkhumta hi.
english: The Philistine said to David, “Am I a dog, that you come to me with sticks?” The Philistine cursed David by his gods.

paite: Philistia mi in David kiang ah, "Ka kiang ah hong pai in, tung a leng vasate leh gamsate na sa ka nesak ding," achi hi.
english: The Philistine said to David, “Come to me, and I will give your flesh to the birds of the sky and to the animals of the field.”

paite: David in Philistia mi kiang ah, "Nang zaw namsau, tei leh lum tawi in na hong kuan a, himahleh kei zaw Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel Sepaihte' Pathian na kousiatpa min in ka hong kuan zaw hi.
english: Then David said to the Philistine, “You come to me with a sword, with a spear, and with a javelin; but I come to you in the name of Yahweh of Armies, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.

paite: Tuni in TOUPA'N ka khut ah nang ahon pe ding hi. Huchi in ka hon that dia, na lutang ka tan ding. Philistia sepaihte luangte tuni in tung a leng vasate leh gamsate ka nesak ding hi. Huchi in leitung a mi tengteng in Israel ah Pathian a-om chih athei ding uh.
english: Today, Yahweh will deliver you into my hand. I will strike you and take your head from off you. I will give the dead bodies of the army of the Philistines today to the birds of the sky and to the wild animals of the earth, that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel,

paite: Hiai a kikhawm tengteng in TOUPA'N namsau leh tei in ahondam kei chih athei ding uh. Kidouna lah TOUPA kidouna ahi ngal a. Ama'n ka khut uah noute ahon pe ding," achi hi.
english: and that all this assembly may know that Yahweh doesn’t save with sword and spear; for the battle is Yahweh’s, and he will give you into our hand.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Philistia mi ahong kuan a, David sual dia ahon naihleh, sepaihte lam ah Philistia mi sual ding in David atai gepgep hi.
english: When the Philistine arose, and walked and came near to meet David, David hurried and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.

paite: David in a-ip asawk a, suang khat alakhia a, avaisuanglot in alawn a, Philistia mi taltangtak ah adeng hi. Ataltang ah suang alut a, akhup in apuk helhul maimah hi.
english: David put his hand in his bag, took a stone and slung it, and struck the Philistine in his forehead. The stone sank into his forehead, and he fell on his face to the earth.

paite: Huchi in David in vaisuanglot leh suang in Philistia mi azou hi. Philistia mi adeng a, athatta hi. Himahleh David in namsau atawi kei.
english: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and struck the Philistine and killed him; but there was no sword in David’s hand.

paite: Huaiziak in David atai a, Philistia mi tung ah adingh hi. Anamsau ala a, apai a pan adokkhia a, huai in athat a, alu atanta hi. Philistia mite'n amihat uh sita ahi chih atheih un ataikekta uh.
english: Then David ran, stood over the Philistine, took his sword, drew it out of its sheath, killed him, and cut off his head with it. When the Philistines saw that their champion was dead, they fled.

paite: Israel mite leh Judah mite athou ua, akikou ua, Philistia mite Gath leh Ekron kulh kongkhak pha in adelh uh. Philistia mite lak a liamte Shaaraim lam tawn in Gath leh Ekron pha in apuk zengzung uhi.
english: The men of Israel and of Judah arose and shouted, and pursued the Philistines as far as Gai and to the gates of Ekron. The wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even to Gath and to Ekron.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante'n Philistia mite adelh uh atawpsan ua, ahong kik nawn ua, agiahmun uh alok uhi.
english: The children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they plundered their camp.

paite: David in Philistia mi lu ala a, Jerusalem ah apaipih a, agalvan bel apuanin ah akoih hi.
english: David took the head of the Philistine and brought it to Jerusalem, but he put his armor in his tent.

paite: Saul in Philistia mi sual dia David kuankhe lai amuh in sepaih heutu Abner kiang ah, "Abner, hiai valnou kua tapa ahia?" achi hi. Abner in, "Na hin bang in ka gen, toupa aw, ka thei kei," achi hi,
english: When Saul saw David go out against the Philistine, he said to Abner, the captain of the army, “Abner, whose son is this youth?” Abner said, “As your soul lives, O king, I can’t tell.”

paite: Kumpipa'n, "Hiai naupang kua tapa hiam dongkhia in," achi hi.
english: The king said, “Inquire whose son the young man is!”

paite: Philistia mi that David ahong pai in Abner in api a, Philistia mi lu tawi kawm in Saul kiang ah apaipih hi.
english: As David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.

paite: Saul in akiang ah, "Tangval, kua tapa na hia?" achi hi. David in adawng a, "Bethlehem mi na sikha Jesse tapa ka hi," achi hi.
english: Saul said to him, “Whose son are you, you young man?” David answered, “I am the son of your servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Saul kiang a thu agen khit in Jonathan hinna leh David hinna ahong kipeh geih a, huchi in Jonathan in ama hinna a-it bang in amah a-it hi.
