english: When he had finished speaking to Saul, the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

paite: Saul in huai ni in a-omsak ngal a, apa inn ah apaisak nawnta kei hi.
english: Saul took him that day, and wouldn’t let him go home to his father’s house any more.

paite: Huchi in ama hinna bang geih a amah a-it ziak in Jonathan in David toh thu akhung hi.
english: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.

paite: Jonathan in apuansilh lai asuah a, David apia a, akivatna leh anamsau leh athalpeu leh ataigakna nangawn apia hi.
english: Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was on him and gave it to David with his clothing, even including his sword, his bow, and his sash.

paite: Saul in asawlna peuh ah David ahoh zel a, kizentak in agamtang hi. Saul in sepaihte heutu in amah abawl a, hiai tuh mi tengteng ngaih in leh Saul sikhate ngaih in ahoih hi.
english: David went out wherever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely; and Saul set him over the men of war. It was good in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul’s servants.

paite: Ahong pai un hichi ahong hi a, Philistia mi that David ahong pai in Israel kho teng ah numeite lasa leh lam kawm in khuangta leh thil gingtheite toh, nuamsatak in kumpipa Saul dawn ding in ahong pawtkhia uhi.
english: As they came, when David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, the women came out of all the cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet King Saul with tambourines, with joy, and with instruments of music.

paite: Numeite'n lam kawm ala a kidawngtuah in, "Saul in asang asang athat, David in asing asing," achi uhi.
english: The women sang to one another as they played, and said, “Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.”

paite: Hiai lasak in Saul akipaksak kei a, aheh mahmah hi. David bel asing asing that in angai ua, kei ka hihleh asang asang kia that in ahon ngai uh. Kumpigam lou ngal atan ding dang bang ahia om? achi hi.
english: Saul was very angry, and this saying displeased him. He said, “They have credited David with ten thousands, and they have only credited me with thousands. What can he have more but the kingdom?”

paite: Saul in huai ni a pan David ahazat bawlta hi.
english: Saul watched David from that day and forward.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, azingsang in Saul tung ah Pathian sawl kha gilou ahong tung a, insung ah thu agen hi. David in nidang a ahih mah bang in kaihging atum hi. Saul in ateipi atawi hi.
english: On the next day, an evil spirit from God came mightily on Saul, and he prophesied in the middle of the house. David played with his hand, as he did day by day. Saul had his spear in his hand;

paite: Saul in ateipi akhoh a, "Huai baang ah David ka khohden ding," achi hi. David in nihvei akihepkhiaksan hi.
english: and Saul threw the spear, for he said, “I will pin David to the wall!” David escaped from his presence twice.

paite: Akiang a ToUPA a-om ziak leh Saul apaisan ziak in Saul in David alau hi.
english: Saul was afraid of David, because Yahweh was with him, and had departed from Saul.

paite: Huaiziak in Saul in amah a pan akisuansak a, asepaih sangkhat tung a heutu in abawl hi. Huchi in mipi lak ah David lut in apawt zel hi.
english: Therefore Saul removed him from his presence, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.

paite: David bel ahih peuhmah ah piltak in agamtang zel a; akiang ah TOUPA a-om hi.
english: David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and Yahweh was with him.

paite: Saul in piltak in agamtang chih amuh in alau hi.
english: When Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he stood in awe of him.

paite: Himahleh Israelte leh Judahte tengteng in David a-it uh; alak ua lut a pawt zel lah ahi ngal a.
english: But all Israel and Judah loved David; for he went out and came in before them.

paite: Saul in David kiang ah, "Ngai in, ka tanu upazaw Merab na zi ding in ka hon neisak ding. Hangtak in hon gum peuhmah lechin. TOUPA kidounate dou in," achi hi. Saul in, "Ke'n zaw atung a khut kha lou in Philistia mite'n atung ah khut kha zaw uhen," achi hi.
english: Saul said to David, “Behold, my elder daughter Merab. I will give her to you as wife. Only be valiant for me, and fight Yahweh’s battles.” For Saul said, “Don’t let my hand be on him, but let the hand of the Philistines be on him.”

paite: David in Saul kiang ah, "Kua ahia ka hih a, ka hinna leh Israelte lak a ka pa inkuante leng bang ahia ahih uh, kumpipa makpa ka hihna ding?" achi hi,
english: David said to Saul, “Who am I, and what is my life, or my father’s family in Israel, that I should be son-in-law to the king?”

paite: Himahleh hichi ahong hi a, David toh Saul tanu Merab kitensak ahong hun in, Meholath mi Adriel zi ding in ape mawk hi.
english: But at the time when Merab, Saul’s daughter, should have been given to David, she was given to Adriel the Meholathite as wife.

paite: Saul tanu Mikal in David a-it a; Saul ahilh ua; huai in akipaksak hi.
english: Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved David; and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.

paite: Saul in, "A-awkna ding thang ahong hihtheihna ding leh Philistia mite'n atung a khut akhaktheihna ding un amah ka pe ding," achi hi. Huaiziak in Saul in David kiang ah, "Tuni in ka makpa na hihna ding hunlem anihveina na nei," achi hi.
english: Saul said, I will give her to him, that she may be a snare to him and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Therefore Saul said to David a second time, “You shall today be my son-in-law.”

paite: Huchi in Saul in asikhate thu apia a, "Asimtham in David houpih unla, ngai in, kumpipa na tung ah akipak mahmah a, asikhate tengteng in leng nang ahon it uh. Huchi in kumpipa makpa in om in, chi un," achi hi.
english: Saul commanded his servants, “Talk with David secretly, and say, ‘Behold, the king has delight in you, and all his servants love you. Now therefore be the king’s son-in-law.’”

paite: Saul sikhate'n huai thu David bil ah agen uhi. David in, "Mizawng leh kuamah theih phak ngel louh kei a ding in kumpipa makpa hih thil namai in na sep ua hia?" achi hi.
english: Saul’s servants spoke those words in the ears of David. David said, “Does it seem to you a light thing to be the king’s son-in-law, since I am a poor man and little known?”

paite: Saul sikhate'n, "David in huchibang in achi," chi in ahilh uh.
english: The servants of Saul told him, saying, “David spoke like this.”

paite: Saul in David kiang ah hichibang in na chi ding uh, "Kumpipa'n kumpipa melma phulakna ding in Philistia mite zekvun zakhat chih louh man bangmah adeih kei achi, chi un," achi hi. Saul in David lah Philistia mite khut a sihsak lungsim in anei bikbek hi.
english: Saul said, “Tell David, ‘The king desires no dowry except one hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king’s enemies.’” Now Saul thought he would make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.

paite: Asikhate'n huai thu David ahilh uleh kumpipa makpa hih David akipak mahmah hi.
english: When his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king’s son-in-law. Before the deadline,

paite: Huchi in ni chiamte abei ma in, David leh amite athou ua, Philistia mite zanih ava that uhi. David in azekvun uh ahon pua a, kumpipa makpa ahihtheihna ding in kumpipa kimtak in apia hi. Huchi in Saul in atanu Mikal azi ding in apeta hi.
english: David arose and went, he and his men, and killed two hundred men of the Philistines. Then David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full number to the king, that he might be the king’s son-in-law. Then Saul gave him Michal his daughter as wife.

paite: Saul in David kiang ah Pathian a-om chih atheitelta hi. Saul tanu Mikal in amah a-it hi.
english: Saul saw and knew that Yahweh was with David; and Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved him.

paite: Huchi in Saul in David alau semsem a, Saul bel David melma ahi denta hi.
english: Saul was even more afraid of David; and Saul was David’s enemy continually.

paite: Philistia' miliante ava kuankhe zel uhi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, akuankhiak peuhmah chiang ua Saul sikha tengteng sang a piltak a David agamtat ziak in amin athang semsem hi.
english: Then the princes of the Philistines went out; and as often as they went out, David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul, so that his name was highly esteemed.

paite: Huan Saul in atapa Jonathan leh asikha tengteng kiang ah David thah ding thu agen hi.
english: Saul spoke to Jonathan his son and to all his servants, that they should kill David. But Jonathan, Saul’s son, greatly delighted in David.

paite: Himahleh Saul tapa Jonathan in David adeihthoh mahmah hi. Jonathan in, "Ka pa Saul in thah ding in hon zong hi, huaiziak in, zingchiang zingsang in pilvang inla mun-guk ah bu nilouh in.
english: Jonathan told David, saying, “Saul my father seeks to kill you. Now therefore, please take care of yourself in the morning, live in a secret place, and hide yourself.

paite: Ka pawtkhe dia, na omna gamlak ah ka pa kiang ah ka va dingh dia, na tungtang thu ah ka pa ka houpih ding. Huchi in ka muhdan ka hon hilh ding," achi hi.
english: I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you are, and I will talk with my father about you; and if I see anything, I will tell you.”

paite: Jonathan in apa Saul ma ah David aphat a, akiang ah, "Asikha David tung ah kumpipa khial het kei hen. Na tung ah lah akhial kei a, athilhihte lah nang a dia hoih pipi ahi zaw ngal ua.
english: Jonathan spoke good of David to Saul his father, and said to him, “Don’t let the king sin against his servant, against David; because he has not sinned against you, and because his works have been very good toward you;

paite: Sih khawk sa lou in Philistia mi asual a, TOUPA'N Israel tengteng a ding in hotdamna thupitak asepkhiaksak hi. Huai nang ngei in na mu a, na kipak mahmah hi. Huaiziak in sisan poi khoih lou tung ah bang ding in ahia na khelh ding, aziak bangmah om lou a David na thah ding?" achi hi.
english: for he put his life in his hand and struck the Philistine, and Yahweh worked a great victory for all Israel. You saw it and rejoiced. Why then will you sin against innocent blood, to kill David without a cause?”

paite: Huchi in Saul in Jonathan thugen azui hi. Saul in kichiam in, "TOUPA ahin lai teng amah thah ahi kei ding," achi hi.
english: Saul listened to the voice of Jonathan; and Saul swore, “As Yahweh lives, he shall not be put to death.”

paite: Jonathan in David asam a, huai thil tengteng ahilh hi. Jonathan in Saul kiang ah David api a, tuma lam mah bang in akiang ah a-om nawnta hi.
english: Jonathan called David, and Jonathan showed him all those things. Then Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence as before.

paite: Kidouna ahong om nawn a, David akuankhia hi. Philistia mite ava sual a, tamtak ava that a, ama ah ataikek uhi.
english: There was war again. David went out and fought with the Philistines, and killed them with a great slaughter; and they fled before him.

paite: Saul bel a-inn a teipi tawi a, atut lai in atung ah TOUPA sawl kha gilou ahong tung hi. David in kaihging atum hi.
english: An evil spirit from Yahweh was on Saul as he sat in his house with his spear in his hand; and David was playing music with his hand.

paite: Saul in ateipi in David baang toh khohden atum hi. Himahleh Saul kiang a pan akitholhkhe geih a, teipi pen baang ah akhohtal hi. Huchi in David ataikhia a, huai zan in asuakta hi.
english: Saul sought to pin David to the wall with the spear, but he slipped away out of Saul’s presence; and he stuck the spear into the wall. David fled and escaped that night.

paite: Saul in azingsang a David tang a that ding in mi asawl hi. David zi Mikal in, tuzan a na hinna na humbit keileh zingchiang in hon that ding uh, chi in ahilh hi.
english: Saul sent messengers to David’s house to watch him and to kill him in the morning. Michal, David’s wife, told him, saying, “If you don’t save your life tonight, tomorrow you will be killed.”

paite: Mikal in David tohlet ah akhaikhesuk a; huchi in ataimang a, asuakta hi.
english: So Michal let David down through the window. He went away, fled, and escaped.

paite: Mikal in milim ala a, lupna ah alumsak a, alulam ah kel mul lukham akoih a, puan in akhuh hi.
english: Michal took the teraphim and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats’ hair at its head and covered it with clothes.

paite: David pi dia Saul in mi ahon sawl kiang ah, "Achi ana," ana chi hi.
english: When Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, “He is sick.”

paite: Saul in David va en ding in mi asawl nawn a, "Alupna toh hon zawngtou le uchin ka na that ding," achi hi.
english: Saul sent the messengers to see David, saying, “Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may kill him.”

paite: Amisawlte ava lut uleh, ngai in, lupna ah milim alulam a kel mul lukham kham in ana om hi.
english: When the messengers came in, behold, the teraphim was in the bed, with the pillow of goats’ hair at its head.

paite: Saul in Mikal kiang ah, "Bangziak a hichibang a hon khem a, bitna dia ka melma pawtsak na hia?" achi hi. Mikal in Saul adawng a, "Hon paisak in, bangziak a nang hon that ding ka hia? ahon chi,” achi hi.
english: Saul said to Michal, “Why have you deceived me like this and let my enemy go, so that he has escaped?” Michal answered Saul, “He said to me, ‘Let me go! Why should I kill you?’”

paite: Huchi in David ataimang a, asuakta hi. Ramah a Samuel kiang ava tung a, Saul in atung a athilhih tengteng ava hilh hi. Amah leh Samuel akuan ua, Naioth ah a-om uhi.
english: Now David fled and escaped, and came to Samuel at Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. He and Samuel went and lived in Naioth.

paite: Ngai in, Ramah a Naioth ah David a-om, chi in Saul ahilh uh.
english: Saul was told, saying, “Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.”

paite: Huchi in David pi ding in Saul in thupotu asawl hi. Zawlnei pawlte thugenkhol a a-om lai uh leh Samuel atung ua heutu a om ava muh un Saul in amisawl thupote tung ah Pathian Kha ahong tung a, amau leng thugenkhol in a-om sam uhi.
english: Saul sent messengers to seize David; and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as head over them, God’s Spirit came on Saul’s messengers, and they also prophesied.

paite: Huai Saul ahilh uleh, thupotu dang asawl nawn a, amau leng thugenkhol in ava om zel uhi. Saul in athumveina ding in thupotu dang asawl nawn a, amau leng thugenkhol in ava om nawn zel uhi.
english: When Saul was told, he sent other messengers, and they also prophesied. Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they also prophesied.

paite: Amah leng Ramah ah ava hoh a, Seku mun a tuileh lian mahmah ava pha hi. "Samuel leh David koi a om ahi ua?" chi in adong hi. Mi kuahiam khat in, "Ngai in, Ramah a Naioth ah a-om uh," achi hi.
english: Then he also went to Ramah, and came to the great well that is in Secu: and he asked, “Where are Samuel and David?” One said, “Behold, they are at Naioth in Ramah.”

paite: Ramah a Naioth ah ahoh a; Pathian kha atung ah ahong tung samta a, apai zel hi. Ramah a Naioth atun matan thugenkhol in a-om lai hi.
english: He went there to Naioth in Ramah. Then God’s Spirit came on him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.

paite: Ama'n apuansilhte leng asuah a, Samuel ma ah thugenkhol in a-om a, huai ni nitum leh huai zankhua in vuaktang in alum hi. Huaiziak in "Saul leng zawlnei lak a tel sam ahi maw?" achi uhi.
english: He also stripped off his clothes. He also prophesied before Samuel and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Therefore they say, “Is Saul also among the prophets?”

paite: Huan Hannah athum a, hichi in achi, "Ka lungtang TOUPA tung ah akipak mahmah, TOUPA ah ka kii pahtawi in a-om. Ka melmate tung ah ka kam letsak in a-om; na hotdamna a ka kipah mahmah ziak in.
english: Hannah prayed, and said, “My heart exults in Yahweh! My horn is exalted in Yahweh. My mouth is enlarged over my enemies, because I rejoice in your salvation.

paite: TOUPA bang a siangthou a-om kei uh: Nang bang mahmah lah a-om ngal kei uh. I Pathian bang suangpi himhim leng a-om sam kei.
english: There is no one as holy as Yahweh, for there is no one besides you, nor is there any rock like our God.

paite: Huchi tel a kisathei in thu gen nawn kei unla; na kam ua pan pau uang himhim pawt kei hen. TOUPA lah pilna Pathian ahi ngal a, ama'n thilhihte hoihtak in abuk zel hi.
english: “Don’t keep talking so exceedingly proudly. Don’t let arrogance come out of your mouth, for Yahweh is a God of knowledge. By him actions are weighed.

paite: Mihat thalpeute akitansak a, akisuite taihatna a gak in a-om hi.
english: “The bows of the mighty men are broken. Those who stumbled are armed with strength.

paite: Niang leh tai a omte nek ding zong in alohtawm ua, gilkialte kial nawn lou uhi. Achiingnu'n ta sagih aneita a, ta tampi neinu abahta hi.
english: Those who were full have hired themselves out for bread. Those who were hungry are satisfied. Yes, the barren has borne seven. She who has many children languishes.

paite: TOUPA'N athat a, ahingsak hi. Han ah apaisuksak a, apikhetou hi.
english: “Yahweh kills and makes alive. He brings down to Sheol and brings up.

paite: TOUPA'N azawngsak a, ahausasak a, ahihniam a, ahihsang hi.
english: Yahweh makes poor and makes rich. He brings low, he also lifts up.

paite: Leivui a pan azawngte adingtousak a, ekvu a pan khutdohte adomtou hi. Miliante kiang a a-omsak theih a, thupina laltutphah atantheihna ding un. Lei kingaknate TOUPA a ahi a, ama'n atung uah khovel angata ngal a.
english: He raises up the poor out of the dust. He lifts up the needy from the dunghill to make them sit with princes and inherit the throne of glory. For the pillars of the earth are Yahweh’s. He has set the world on them.

paite: Amisiangthoute khe akem ding a, migiloute bel mial lak ah daihsak in a-om ding uh. Hatna a kuamah in zou lou ding ahi ngal a.
english: He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the wicked will be put to silence in darkness; for no man will prevail by strength.

paite: TOUPA melmate a i tamgawp ding ua, van a pan vanpiging bang in amaute adou ding. TOUPA'N kawlmong pha in vai ahawm ding a; akumpipa kiang ah hatna ape dia, athaunilhpa kii apahtawi ding," achi hi.
english: Those who strive with Yahweh shall be broken to pieces. He will thunder against them in the sky. “Yahweh will judge the ends of the earth. He will give strength to his king, and exalt the horn of his anointed.”

paite: Huchi in Ramah ah a-inn ah Elkanah apaita hi. Huchi in naupang in siampu Eli ma ah TOUPA nna asemta hi.
english: Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. The child served Yahweh before Eli the priest.

paite: Eli tapate Belial tapate ahi ua; TOUPA athei kei uh.
english: Now the sons of Eli were wicked men. They didn’t know Yahweh.

paite: Mite lak a siampute hihdan ngeina ahihleh mi'n kithoihna ahong lat chiang un, sa huan laitak in siampu sikha sa thukna sikkhut zum thum nei tawi in ahong pai zel hi.
english: The custom of the priests with the people was that when anyone offered a sacrifice, the priest’s servant came while the meat was boiling, with a fork of three teeth in his hand;

paite: Belgongza hiam, belgong nei hiam, bel khaina nei hiam, bel hiam sung asunsuk a, huai sa thukna zum in ahon thukkhiak tengteng siampu in ala zel hi. Huchibang in Israel mi huai a hong pai tengteng a pan Shiloh ah ana hihsak zel uhi.
english: and he stabbed it into the pan, or kettle, or cauldron, or pot. The priest took all that the fork brought up for himself. They did this to all the Israelites who came there to Shiloh.

paite: Huai ban ah, thau akhul ma un siampu sikha ahong pai a, kithoihmi kiang ah, "Siampu a ding haimin ding sa hon pia in. Na sa huanmin adeih kei, asial adeih hi," achi hi.
english: Yes, before they burned the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man who sacrificed, “Give meat to roast for the priest; for he will not accept boiled meat from you, but raw.”

paite: Mi'n akiang ah, "Athau pen khul phot uhenla, huai khit chiang in na hinna in adeih zahzah na la ding," ana chih chiang un ama'n, "Hilou e, tu mah a na hon piak pah ding ahi. N'on piak keileh thagum in ka la ding," achi hi.
english: If the man said to him, “Let the fat be burned first, and then take as much as your soul desires;” then he would say, “No, but you shall give it to me now; and if not, I will take it by force.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA mitmuh in tangvalte khelhna athupi mahmah a, mite'n lah TOUPA kiang a kithoihna lat thilkihhuai in angaita uhi.
english: The sin of the young men was very great before Yahweh; for the men despised Yahweh’s offering.

paite: Himahleh Samuel in bel naupang chik in, puanmalngat siampu puanak silh in TOUPA ma ah nna asem hi.
english: But Samuel ministered before Yahweh, being a child, clothed with a linen ephod.

paite: Huai lou leng anu'n puanaktual neu akhuisak a, kum teng kithoihna uh lan dia apasal toh ahoh chiang un kum teng in atawisak zel hi.
english: Moreover his mother made him a little robe, and brought it to him from year to year when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.

paite: Eli in Elkanah leh azi avualzawl a, "TOUPA a dia na thillat uh mun luah ding numei suan TOUPA'N hon pia hen," achi hi. Huchi in a-inn uah apaita uhi.
english: Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, “May Yahweh give you offspring from this woman for the petition which was asked of Yahweh.” Then they went to their own home.

paite: TOUPA'N Hannah aveh a, nau apai a, tapa thum leh tanu nih anei hi. TOUPA ma ah naupang Samuel ahong khanglianta hi.
english: Yahweh visited Hannah, and she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters. The child Samuel grew before Yahweh.

paite: Eli bel atek mahmahta hi. Israel mi tengteng tung a atapate thilhih tengteng leh kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak bul a nasem numeite ana kithuahpih zel thute uh aza hi.
english: Now Eli was very old; and he heard all that his sons did to all Israel, and how that they slept with the women who served at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Huchi in akiang uah, "Bangziak a hichibang thilhih na mai ua? Hiai mi tengteng a pan na thilhihdan hoihloute uh ka na za ngal a.
english: He said to them, “Why do you do such things? For I hear of your evil dealings from all these people.

paite: Hichi ding hilou ahi, ka tapate aw, na tanchin uh ka zak ahoih lou lam ngen ahi. TOUPA mite na taleksak uhi.
english: No, my sons; for it is not a good report that I hear! You make Yahweh’s people disobey.

paite: Mi khat, midang tung a akhelhleh Pathian in vai ahawmsak ding hi. Himahleh TOUPA tung a mi akhelhleh kua'n amah a ding in angetsakta dia?" achi hi. Huchi pipi in leng apa uh aw angaikhe kei ua, ToUPA'n amaute athah ding ziak in.
english: If one man sins against another, God will judge him; but if a man sins against Yahweh, who will intercede for him?” Notwithstanding, they didn’t listen to the voice of their father, because Yahweh intended to kill them.

paite: Naupang Samuel akhanglian deuhdeuh a; Pathian leh mihing deihsak in a-om hi.
english: The child Samuel grew on, and increased in favor both with Yahweh and also with men.

paite: Eli kiang ah Pathian mipa khat ahong a, akiang ah, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi, 'Aigupta gam a Pharaoh inn a na om lai un na pa inkote kiang ah ka kilak kei maw?
english: A man of God came to Eli and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Did I reveal myself to the house of your father when they were in Egypt in bondage to Pharaoh’s house?

paite: Israel nam tengteng lak a pan ka siampu hi ding, ka maitam a thil lan ding, gimlim hal ding leh siampu puanak silh dia amah ka tel ahi kei maw? Na pa inkote kiang ah Israel mite halmang thillat teng ka pia ahi kei maw?
english: Didn’t I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to go up to my altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? Didn’t I give to the house of your father all the offerings of the children of Israel made by fire?

paite: Bangziak in ahia ka tenna a na lat ding ua ka thupiak ka kiang a kithoihna leh kei a tuam dia thillat pen lei toh sikden a, kei sang a na tapate na zahtak zawk a, noumau na kisukthauna ding ua ka mi Israelte kithoihna ahoihpente na zat uh?'
english: Why do you kick at my sacrifice and at my offering, which I have commanded in my habitation, and honor your sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the best of all the offerings of Israel my people?’

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA Israelte' Pathian in, 'Ke'n zaw na inkote leh na pa inkote tangtawn in ka ma ah na om ding uh,' ka na chi ngei hi. Himahleh tu in TOUPA'N, 'Na om het kei ding uh. Hon zahtak peuhmah ka zahtak dia, hon musit peuhmah ka musit ding,' achi hi.
english: “Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I said indeed that your house and the house of your father should walk before me forever.’ But now Yahweh says, ‘Far be it from me; for those who honor me I will honor, and those who despise me will be cursed.

paite: Ngai in, 'na bante leh na pa inkote bante ka tankhiak ni ahong tung, na inn ah tekkun a dam a-om kei ding uh.
english: Behold, the days come that I will cut off your arm and the arm of your father’s house, that there will not be an old man in your house.

paite: Ka tenna inn ah, Pathian in Israel hauhsakna apiak teng ah melma na mu dia, tangtawn in na inn ah tekkun a dam a-om kei ding uh.
english: You will see the affliction of my habitation, in all the wealth which I will give Israel. There shall not be an old man in your house forever.

paite: Ka maitam a pan ka hihman louh ding na mi pen na mit hihkhamtu leh na lungsim lungkhamsaktu ahi ding. Na inn a hong piang peuhmah adawnsih zel ding uhi.
english: The man of yours whom I don’t cut off from my altar will consume your eyes and grieve your heart. All the increase of your house will die in the flower of their age.

paite: Hiai, na tapate nih Hophni leh Phinehas tung a thil tung ding nang a ding in chiamtehna ahi ding. Ni khat in anih un asi tuaktuak ding uhi.
english: This will be the sign to you that will come on your two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas: in one day they will both die.

paite: Kei a ding in siampu muanhuai ka dingkhesak dia, huai in ka lungtang leh ka lungsim toh kituak in nna asem ding. Inkuan kiptak in ka lamsak dia, tangtawn in ka thaunilhmi ma ah a-om ding.
english: I will raise up a faithful priest for myself who will do according to that which is in my heart and in my mind. I will build him a sure house. He will walk before my anointed forever.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, na inn a om lai tengteng dangka leh tanghou ngen in akiang ah akuan ding ua, tanghou tawmchik bek nek ding ka muhtheihna ding un siampu nna khat bek hon semsak ve aw, chi in ka hong thum hi, achi ding uh," achi hi.
english: It will happen that everyone who is left in your house will come and bow down to him for a piece of silver and a loaf of bread, and will say, “Please put me into one of the priests’ offices, that I may eat a morsel of bread.”’”

paite: Huan David bel Ramah a Naioth a pan atai a, Jonathan kiang ava tung hi. "Bang ka hih a ahia? Bang ahia ka tatsiatna? Na pa tung ah bang ahia ka hihkhelh, hichitak a hon thah atup maizen?" achi hi.
english: David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said to Jonathan, “What have I done? What is my iniquity? What is my sin before your father, that he seeks my life?”

paite: Ama'n, "That lou e. Na si het kei ding. Ngai in, ka pa'n kei hon theisak lou in bangmah himhim lian in neu taleh, ahih ngei kei hi. Bang ding in ahia hiai thute kei ahon iim ding? Ahon iim kei hial ding," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “Far from it; you will not die. Behold, my father does nothing either great or small, but that he discloses it to me. Why would my father hide this thing from me? It is not so.”

paite: David in, "Na mitmuh in deihsakna ka tang chih na pa'n atheichian mahmah ngal a, alungsim in, hiai zaw Jonathan in thei dah hen, huchi lou in zaw alungkham lo kha ding, chi ahi ding. Himahleh TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi, sihna toh ka kikal uh kal khat lel ahi," chi in uangtak in agen hi.
english: David swore moreover, and said, “Your father knows well that I have found favor in your eyes; and he says, ‘Don’t let Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved;’ but truly as Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, there is but a step between me and death.”

paite: Jonathan in David kiang ah, "Na hinna in adeih peuhpeuh ka hon hihsak zel ding," achi hi.
english: Then Jonathan said to David, “Whatever your soul desires, I will even do it for you.”

paite: David in Jonathan kiang ah, "Ngai in, zingchiang a kha thak ding ahi. Kumpipa kiang a ankuang um ngeingei ding ka hi. Himahleh ani thum ni nitaklam tanpha in gamlak a kibu ding in ka kuan zaw ding.
english: David said to Jonathan, “Behold, tomorrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to dine with the king; but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field to the third day at evening.

paite: Na pa'n ka om louh lam ahon theihkhiakleh, David in akhua Bethlehem a va hoh zual ding hon ngen ngutngut a; a-inkuan ua dia kum teng a akithoih hun uh ahi," na chi in.
english: If your father misses me at all, then say, ‘David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Bethlehem, his city; for it is the yearly sacrifice there for all the family.’

paite: "Ahoih vo oi, achihleh na sikha alungmuang ding. Himahleh ahehleh thil hoih lou hih atum, chih thei mai in.
english: If he says, ‘It is well,’ your servant shall have peace; but if he is angry, then know that evil is determined by him.

paite: Huaiziak in na sikha hoihtak in hih in. Na sikha lah TOUPA thukhun ah na lutpihta ngal a. Himahleh tatsiatna nei ka hihleh nangmah in hon that mai in. Bangziak a na pa kiang a hon pi chitchiat ding na hia?" achi hi.
english: Therefore deal kindly with your servant, for you have brought your servant into a covenant of Yahweh with you; but if there is iniquity in me, kill me yourself, for why should you bring me to your father?”

paite: Jonathan in, "That lou e. Ka pa'n na tung a thil hoih lou hih atum chih ka theih peuhmah leh nang hilh lou in ka om mahmah dia hia?" achi hi.
english: Jonathan said, “Far be it from you; for if I should at all know that evil were determined by my father to come on you, then wouldn’t I tell you that?”

paite: Huchi in David in Jonathan kiang ah, "Na pa'n hehngoh in hon na dawng taleh kua'n ahon hilh dia?" achi hi.
english: Then David said to Jonathan, “Who will tell me if your father answers you roughly?”

paite: Jonathan in David kiang ah, "Pai dih, gamlak ah i va hoh peuhmah ding," achi hi. Huchi in gamlak ah ava hohkhawm uhi.
english: Jonathan said to David, “Come! Let’s go out into the field.” They both went out into the field.

paite: Jonathan in David kiang ah, "TOUPA Israelte' Pathian atheihpihtu hi hen. Zingchiang hichih hun hiam, ani thum ni hiam a ka pa ka va dawp hun a, ngai in, David tungtang thu ahoih lam ahihleh na kiang a mi hon sawl in ka hong hilh kei dia hia?
english: Jonathan said to David, “By Yahweh, the God of Israel, when I have sounded out my father about this time tomorrow, or the third day, behold, if there is good toward David, won’t I then send to you and disclose it to you?

paite: Ka pa'n na tung ah thil hoih lou hih ut bang hitaleh, ka hon hilh louh a, lungmuangtak a na paitheihna dia ka hon khah keileh, TOUPA'N Jonathan abawlbawl in bawl henla, huai sang a thupi in leng. Ka pa kiang a a-om zel bang in TOUPA na kiang ah om hen.
english: Yahweh do so to Jonathan and more also, should it please my father to do you evil, if I don’t disclose it to you and send you away, that you may go in peace. May Yahweh be with you as he has been with my father.

paite: Ka sihlouhna dia ka damsung kia a TOUPA hehpihna hon musak hilou in,
english: You shall not only show me the loving kindness of Yahweh while I still live, that I not die;

paite: tangtawn in ka inkote leng na hehpih tawp ke'n. TOUPA'N David melma leitung a pan ahihman khit vek pha in leng tawp ke'n," achi hi.
english: but you shall also not cut off your kindness from my house forever, no, not when Yahweh has cut off every one of the enemies of David from the surface of the earth.”

paite: Jonathan in David inkote toh thukhun bawl in, "David melmate khut tan in leng TOUPA'N phut hen," achi uhi.
english: So Jonathan made a covenant with David’s house, saying, “Yahweh will require it at the hand of David’s enemies.”

paite: Huchi in Jonathan in David akichiamsak nawn hi; amah hinna a-it bang geih in lah a-it ngal a.
english: Jonathan caused David to swear again, for the love that he had for him; for he loved him as he loved his own soul.

paite: Huchi in Jonathan in akiang ah, "Zingchiang a kha thak ding ahi. Na tutna avuak ding ziak in na om louh akilang ngei ding hi.
english: Then Jonathan said to him, “Tomorrow is the new moon, and you will be missed, because your seat will be empty.

paite: Ni thum na om nung in paisuk pah inla, tuma a thil ahong om lai a na kibukna mun ah hoh inla, Ezel suang chin ah ana om gige in.
english: When you have stayed three days, go down quickly and come to the place where you hid yourself when this started, and remain by the stone Ezel.

paite: Muitum bang in thaltang thum asik ah ka hon kapkhe ding hi.
english: I will shoot three arrows on its side, as though I shot at a mark.

paite: Ngai in, kuan inla, thaltangte va mukhia in, chi in naupang ka sawl ding hi. Naupang kiang a, en in, thaltangte na nunglam ah a-om, la inla hong pai in, ka chihleh TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi, nang a ding in agalmuanhuai in lauh ding om lou ahi ding.
english: Behold, I will send the boy, saying, ‘Go, find the arrows!’ If I tell the boy, ‘Behold, the arrows are on this side of you. Take them;’ then come, for there is peace to you and no danger, as Yahweh lives.

paite: Himahleh naupang kiang a, en in, thaltangte na pamlam ah a-om uh, ka chihleh paimang mai in. TOUPA'N ahon paimangsak ahi ding.
english: But if I say this to the boy, ‘Behold, the arrows are beyond you,’ then go your way, for Yahweh has sent you away.

paite: Nang leh ke'n thil i gensa tungthu ah ngai in, nang toh i kikal ah TOUPA a-om tawntung hi,” achi hi.
english: Concerning the matter which you and I have spoken of, behold, Yahweh is between you and me forever.”

paite: Huchi in David gamlak ah akibu a; kha ahong thak a, kumpipa ankuang um in atu hi.
english: So David hid himself in the field. When the new moon had come, the king sat himself down to eat food.

paite: Hun dang a atutna ngei bang in atutna ah kumpipa atu hi. Jonathan adingh a, Saul kiang ah Abner atu a; David mun bel avuak hi.
english: The king sat on his seat, as at other times, even on the seat by the wall; and Jonathan stood up, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, but David’s place was empty.

paite: Himahleh Saul in huai ni in bangmah agen kei, "Atung ah thil banghiam a-om a, siang lou hiam ahi ding, siang lou ahi ngei ding," achi hi.
english: Nevertheless Saul didn’t say anything that day, for he thought, “Something has happened to him. He is not clean. Surely he is not clean.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, khadet zing ani nih ni in David mun avuak lailai hi. Huchi in Saul in atapa Jonathan kiang ah, "Bang achia Jesse tapa zan leh tuni a ankuang um dia hong pai lou ahia?" achi hi.
english: On the next day after the new moon, the second day, David’s place was empty. Saul said to Jonathan his son, “Why didn’t the son of Jesse come to eat, either yesterday, or today?”

paite: Jonathan in Saul adawng a, "David in Bethlehem a hoh ding ahon ngen ngutngut hi.
english: Jonathan answered Saul, “David earnestly asked permission of me to go to Bethlehem.

paite: Hon hohsak teitei in, ka inkote'n khua ah kithoihna nei ding in ahon thukhak tinten uh. Huchi in na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tanleh hon hohsak inla, ka unaute ka va veh ding, achi hi. Huaiziak in kumpipa dohkan ah ahong kei hi," achi hi.
english: He said, ‘Please let me go, for our family has a sacrifice in the city. My brother has commanded me to be there. Now, if I have found favor in your eyes, please let me go away and see my brothers.’ Therefore he has not come to the king’s table.”

paite: Huchi in Jonathan tung ah Saul aheh guih a, akiang ah, "Nang, numei genhak leh helhat tapa, Jesse tapa na zahlakna ding leh na nu vuaktanna zahlaksak ding in na tel chih thei lou hon sa na hi hiam?
english: Then Saul’s anger burned against Jonathan, and he said to him, “You son of a perverse rebellious woman, don’t I know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame, and to the shame of your mother’s nakedness?

paite: Jesse tapa hiai a a-om sung teng hihkip na hi kei dia, na gam leng. Huaiziak in samsak pah inla, ka kiang ah hon pisak in, asih ngeingei ding ahi," achi hi.
english: For as long as the son of Jesse lives on the earth, you will not be established, nor will your kingdom. Therefore now send and bring him to me, for he shall surely die!”

paite: Jonathan in apa Saul adawng a, akiang ah, "Bang ding in maw thah ding ahih? Bang ahih a ahia?" achi hi.
english: Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said to him, “Why should he be put to death? What has he done?”

paite: Saul in thah tum in teipi in akhoh a, huchi in Jonathan in apa'n David thah atum ngei, chih achian hi.
english: Saul cast his spear at him to strike him. By this Jonathan knew that his father was determined to put David to death.

paite: Jonathan bel dohkan a pan heh mahmah kawm in adingh a, huai kha ani nih ni in an a-um kei hi. Apa'n David azahlaksak mahmah ziak in alungkhampih hi.
english: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and ate no food the second day of the month; for he was grieved for David, because his father had treated him shamefully.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, zingsang in Jonathan in naupang khat pi in gamlak ah David toh amun sehsa uah ahoh uhi.
english: In the morning, Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little boy with him.

paite: Anaupang kiang ah, "Tai inla, ka thaltang kapkhiakte va zong in," achi hi. Naupang atai lai in, apam lam ah thaltang akap hi.
english: He said to his boy, “Run, find now the arrows which I shoot.” As the boy ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

paite: Jonathan in akapkiakna mun a naupang ava tun in Jonathan in naupang asam a, "Thaltang na pamlam ah ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: When the boy had come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the boy, and said, “Isn’t the arrow beyond you?”

paite: Jonathan in anaupang asam a, "Hong pai meng in, kin in, zekai ke'n,” achi hi. Jonathan naupang in thaltangte atawmkhawm a, apu kiang ah ahong paita hi.
english: Jonathan cried after the boy, “Go fast! Hurry! Don’t delay!” Jonathan’s boy gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.

paite: Himahleh, naupang in bangmah athei kei, Jonathan leh David kia in thil omdan athei uhi.
english: But the boy didn’t know anything. Only Jonathan and David knew the matter.

paite: Jonathan in anaupang kiang ah athal leh avante apia a, akiang ah, "Pai inla, khua ah ana paipih in," achi hi.
english: Jonathan gave his weapons to his boy, and said to him, “Go, carry them to the city.”

paite: Jonathan in apaitak in David omna mun simlam pang a pan adingh a, amai a lei si in thumvei akunsuk a, akitawptuah ua, akikahkhum ua, David anak kahzaw hi.
english: As soon as the boy was gone, David arose out of the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times. They kissed one another and wept with one another, and David wept the most.

paite: Jonathan in David kiang ah, "Lungmuangtak in pai in aw, nang toh kei kikal ah leh ka suante leh na suante kikal ah tangtawn in TOUPA om hen, chi in TOUPA min in i kichiam tuak khinta hi,” achi hi. Huchi in adingh a, apaita a, khua ah Jonathan alutta hi.
english: Jonathan said to David, “Go in peace, because we have both sworn in Yahweh’s name, saying, ‘Yahweh is between me and you, and between my offspring and your offspring, forever.’” He arose and departed; and Jonathan went into the city.

paite: Nob a siampu Ahimelek kiang ah David ahong hi. Ahimelek in ling kawm in David ana dawn a, akiang ah, "Bangchidan ahia tangtat na chia, kuamah tonpih na neih louh?" achi hi.
english: Then David came to Nob to Ahimelech the priest. Ahimelech came to meet David trembling, and said to him, “Why are you alone, and no man with you?”

paite: David in siampu Ahimelek kiang ah, "Kumpipa'n thilhih ding in thu ahon pia a, ka kiang ah, ka hon thilhihsak tup leh ka hon thupiak kuamah in thei kei heh, achi bikbek hi. Ka sikhate amun ding uh ka sehsakta," achi hi.
english: David said to Ahimelech the priest, “The king has commanded me to do something, and has said to me, ‘Let no one know anything about the business about which I send you, and what I have commanded you. I have sent the young men to a certain place.’

paite: Huaiziak in tu in, "Na khut ah bang a-om a? Tanghou beu nga ahihkeileh na neih lamlam hon pia in," achi hi.
english: Now therefore what is under your hand? Please give me five loaves of bread in my hand, or whatever is available.”

paite: Siampu in David adawng a, "Tanghou vantang ka nei kei a, himahleh tanghou siangthou bel ka nei hi, tangvalte numei a pan akihepkhiak nak uleh," achi hi.
english: The priest answered David, and said, “I have no common bread, but there is holy bread; if only the young men have kept themselves from women.”

paite: David in siampu adawng a, akiang ah, "Tu ni thum sung numei a pan ka kihemkhe vek taktak uhi. Ka hong pawtkhiak dek lai in leng tangvalte tui-um belsuan asiangthou a, tanghou leng vantang ahi a, ahi, tuni tui-um belsuan sung asiansak mah bang in," achi hi.
english: David answered the priest, and said to him, “Truly, women have been kept from us as usual these three days. When I came out, the vessels of the young men were holy, though it was only a common journey. How much more then today shall their vessels be holy?”

paite: Huchi in siampu in tanghou siang- thou apeta hi. Huai ah lah tanghou koih alak ni ua tanghou lum a khen dia TOUPA ma a pan lak pen kia lou ngal tanghou dang a-om ngal kei hi.
english: So the priest gave him holy bread; for there was no bread there but the show bread that was taken from before Yahweh, to be replaced with hot bread in the day when it was taken away.

paite: Huai ni in Saul sikhate lak a mi khat TOUPA ma a zekaisak a-om a; amin Doeg ahi. Amah Edom mi, Saul ganchingmi lak a heutupen ahi.
english: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before Yahweh; and his name was Doeg the Edomite, the best of the herdsmen who belonged to Saul.

paite: David in Ahimelek kiang ah, "Teipi hiam, namsau hiam na kem kei maw? Kumpipa hon sawlna thukin ahih ziak in ka namsau leh ka galvan bangmah ka hon tawi man kei hi,” achi hi.
english: David said to Ahimelech, “Isn’t there here under your hand spear or sword? For I haven’t brought my sword or my weapons with me, because the king’s business required haste.”

paite: Siampu in, “Philistia mi Goliath, Elah Phaizang a na thahpa namsau, ngai in, siampu puanak nung ah puan a tuam in a-om hi. Huai na laknopleh la in. Huai lou ngal adang a-om kei," achi hi. David in, "Huai val a-om ding hia, hon pe dih ve," achi hi.
english: The priest said, “Behold, the sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the valley of Elah, is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. If you would like to take that, take it, for there is no other except that here.” David said, “There is none like that. Give it to me.”

paite: Huchi in David adingh a, huai ni in Saul lau in ataimang a, Gath kumpipa Akish kiang ah apaita hi.
english: David arose and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.

paite: Akish sikhate'n akiang ah, "Hiai mi huai gam kumpipa David ahi kei maw? Saul in asang asang athat, David in asing asing, chih lou kawm in atungtang la in asa zuazua uh ahi kei maw?" achi uhi.
english: The servants of Achish said to him, “Isn’t this David the king of the land? Didn’t they sing to one another about him in dances, saying, ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands’?”

paite: David in huai thute alungsim in apai a, Gath kumpipa Akish alau mahmah hi.
english: David laid up these words in his heart, and was very afraid of Achish the king of Gath.

paite: Huchi in ama ah a-omdan ahihlamdang a, amitmuh un akihaisak hi. Akhut in kongkhakte aham ekek a, akhamul ah achil aluangsak zengzung hi.
english: He changed his behavior before them and pretended to be insane in their hands, and scribbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down on his beard.

paite: Huchi in Akish in asikhate kiang ah, "Enta unla, mihai ahih na thei ua, bangziak a ka kiang a hon pi na hi ua?
english: Then Achish said to his servants, “Look, you see the man is insane. Why then have you brought him to me?

paite: Mihai ka kitaksap ziak in hia hiai mi ahaidan hihlang dia ka ma a na hon pi uh? Hiai mi ka inn ah ahong lut tel mahmah ding maw?" achi hi.
english: Do I lack madmen, that you have brought this fellow to play the madman in my presence? Should this fellow come into my house?”

paite: Huchi in David bel huai a apawtkhia ay pan Adullam kokhuk ah a-omta hi. Asanggamte leh apate inkote tengteng in azak un huai ah akiang ah ahohsuk uh.
english: David therefore departed from there and escaped to Adullam’s cave. When his brothers and all his father’s house heard it, they went down there to him.

paite: Lungkham peuhmah, leiba nei peuhmah leh lungkim lou peuhmahte akiang ah akikaikhawm uh. Huchi in aheutu un a-omta hi. Akiang ah mi zali hiamtak a-om uhi.
english: Everyone who was in distress, everyone who was in debt, and everyone who was discontented gathered themselves to him; and he became captain over them. There were with him about four hundred men.

paite: David bel huai a pan Moab gam a Mizpah ah ahoh hi. Moab kumpipa kiang ah, "Pathian in ahon hihsak ding thil ka theih masiah ka nu leh ka pate na kiang ah na om le uh," achi hi.
english: David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab; and he said to the king of Moab, “Please let my father and my mother come out to you, until I know what God will do for me.”

paite: Moab kumpipa ma ah amaute api a; huchi in kokhuk a David a-om lai teng akiang ah a-om uhi.
english: He brought them before the king of Moab; and they lived with him all the time that David was in the stronghold.

paite: Zawlnei Gad in David kiang ah, "Kokhuk ah om nilouh ke'n. Pawt inla Judah gam ah pai in," achi hi. Huchi in David apawt a, Hareth gammang ah alutta hi.
english: The prophet Gad said to David, “Don’t stay in the stronghold. Depart, and go into the land of Judah.” Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hereth.

paite: Saul in, "David leh akiang a omte amuta uh," chih ana za hi. Saul bel Gibeah a Ramah a tamarisk sing nuai ah teipi tawi in atu hi. Akim ah asikha tengteng adingh uhi.
english: Saul heard that David was discovered, with the men who were with him. Now Saul was sitting in Gibeah, under the tamarisk tree in Ramah, with his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing around him.

paite: Saul in akim a dingh asikhate kiang ah, "Nou Benjamin mite aw, ngaikhia un; Jesse tapa in loute leh grephuante hon pia in asepaih sangkhat heutu leh asepaih zakhat heutu in ahon bawl dia hia?
english: Saul said to his servants who stood around him, “Hear now, you Benjamites! Will the son of Jesse give everyone of you fields and vineyards? Will he make you all captains of thousands and captains of hundreds?

paite: Na vek un na hon sawm ua, ka tapa in Jesse tapa kiang a thu akhun ka kiang a hihlang himhim na om kei uh. Ka tapa in ka sikha kei hon dou ding leh tuni nangawn a kei hon tang dia ahanthawn thu ka kiang a hihlang na om louh uh?" achi hi.
english: Is that why all of you have conspired against me, and there is no one who discloses to me when my son makes a treaty with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you who is sorry for me, or discloses to me that my son has stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as it is today?”

paite: Huchi in Saul sikhate kiang a ding Edom mi Doeg in adawng a, "Jesse tapa Nob a Ahitub tapa Ahimelek kiang a, ahong lam ka mu hi.
english: Then Doeg the Edomite, who stood by the servants of Saul, answered and said, “I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.

paite: Ama'n TOUPA adotsak a, nek ding apia a, Philistia mi Goliath namsau leng ape lai hi," achi hi.
english: He inquired of Yahweh for him, gave him food, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n Ahitub tapa Ahimelek leh Nod a siampu a pang apa inkote tengteng asamsak hi.
english: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father’s house, the priests who were in Nob; and they all came to the king.

paite: Saul in, "Nang, Ahitub tapa, na ngaikhia in," achi hi. Ama'n, "Ka toupa, hiai ah ka om," achi hi.
english: Saul said, “Hear now, you son of Ahitub.” He answered, “Here I am, my lord.”

paite: Saul in akiang ah, "Tanghou leh namsau na pia a, TOUPA bang dotsak a, tuni a kei hon dou ding leh hon tang dia bang ding a nang leh Jesse tapa in hon guksawm na hi ua?" achi hi.
english: Saul said to him, “Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, in that you have given him bread, and a sword, and have inquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as it is today?”

paite: Ahimelek in kumpipa adawng a, "Kumpipa makpa, na thumang, na inkuan sung ua mizahtakhuai David bang a muanhuai na sikhate tengteng lak ah kua a-om ua?
english: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, “Who among all your servants is so faithful as David, who is the king’s son-in-law, captain of your body guard, and honored in your house?

paite: Amah a dia Pathian thu ka dotsak amasapen ahi a hia? Ahi kei. Kumpipa'n asikha hiam, ka pa inkote kuapeuh hon ngoh mahmah kei hen. Na sikha in hiai thu bangmah ka thei kei hi," achi hi.
english: Have I today begun to inquire of God for him? Be it far from me! Don’t let the king impute anything to his servant, nor to all the house of my father; for your servant knew nothing of all this, less or more.”

paite: Kumpipa'n, "Ahimelek, na sih ngeingei ding ahi, nang leh na pa inkote tengteng toh," achi hi.
english: The king said, “You shall surely die, Ahimelech, you and all your father’s house.”

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang a dingh sepaihte kiang ah, "Kihei unla, TOUPA siampute that un, David lam a apan ua, taimang ahi chih thei napi a ka kiang a agen louh ziak un," achi hi. Himahleh kumpipa sikhate'n TOUPA siampute sual ding in khut azak nuam kei uhi.
english: The king said to the guard who stood about him, “Turn and kill the priests of Yahweh, because their hand also is with David, and because they knew that he fled and didn’t disclose it to me.” But the servants of the king wouldn’t put out their hand to fall on the priests of Yahweh.

paite: Kumpipa'n Doeg kiang ah, "Nang kihei inla, siampute sual in,” achi hi. Edom mi Doeg akihei a, siampute asual a, huai ni in puanmalngat siampu puanak silh, mi sawmgiat-le-nga athat hi.
english: The king said to Doeg, “Turn and attack the priests!” Doeg the Edomite turned, and he attacked the priests, and he killed on that day eighty-five people who wore a linen ephod.

paite: Nob, siampu khua namsau in asual a; numei leh pasal naupang leh nawi ne laite nangawn, bawngte, sabiltungte leh belamte toh namsau in asatlum hi.
english: He struck Nob, the city of the priests, with the edge of the sword—both men and women, children and nursing babies, and cattle, donkeys, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.

paite: Ahitub tapa Ahimelek tapate lak a khat, amin Abiathar ataikhia a, David kiang ah ataitung hi.
english: One of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped and fled after David.

paite: Abiathar in Saul in TOUPA siampute athah thu David ahilh hi.
english: Abiathar told David that Saul had slain Yahweh’s priests.

paite: David in Abiathar kiang ah, "Edom mi Doeg huai a, a-om ni mah in Saul ahilh ngeingei ding chih theisa in ka om hi. Na pa inkuan tengteng kei ziak a si ahi uh.
english: David said to Abiathar, “I knew on that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul. I am responsible for the death of all the persons of your father’s house.

paite: Nang ka kiang ah om inla, lau ke'n. Kei thah hon tumte'n nang leng thah ahon tum ding uh. Ka kiang ah om lechin na bit ding hi," achi hi.
english: Stay with me. Don’t be afraid, for he who seeks my life seeks your life. You will be safe with me.”

paite: Huan ngai in, "Philistia mite'n Keilah khua asual ua, phual a buhte alaksak vek uh," chi in David ahilh uhi.
english: David was told, “Behold, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah, and are robbing the threshing floors.”

paite: Huchi in David in, "TOUPA, huai Philistia mite ka va sual diam?" chi in adong hi. TOUPA'N David kiang ah, "Philistia mite va sual inla, Keilah khua va humbit in," achi hi.
english: Therefore David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I go and strike these Philistines?” Yahweh said to David, “Go strike the Philistines, and save Keilah.”

paite: David mite'n akiang ah, "Ngai in Judah gam a om nangawn i lau ua, Keilah a hohsuk a Philistia sepaihte va sual lauhuaizaw sem na'n chia," achi uhi.
english: David’s men said to him, “Behold, we are afraid here in Judah. How much more then if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?”

paite: David in TOUPA adong nawn hi. TOUPA'N adawng a, akiang ah, "Thou inla, Keilah ah hohsuk in, Philistia mite na khut ah ka hon pe ding," achi hi.
english: Then David inquired of Yahweh yet again. Yahweh answered him, and said, “Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into your hand.”

paite: Huchi in Keilah ah David leh amite ahoh ua, Philistia mite ava sual ua, agante uh alaksak ua, tamtak athat uh. Huchibang in David in Keilah khomite ahumbitta hi.
english: David and his men went to Keilah and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their livestock, and killed them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Keilah a David kiang a Ahimelek tapa Abiathar atai lai in siampu puanak tawi in apaisuk hi.
english: When Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, he came down with an ephod in his hand.

paite: Keilah ah David ahoh chih Saul ahilh uhi. Saul in, "Pathian in ka khut a amah hon pia ahita ve. Kulh kongpi leh akalhna nei khua ah lah lut in akikhumta ngal a," achi hi.
english: Saul was told that David had come to Keilah. Saul said, “God has delivered him into my hand, for he is shut in by entering into a town that has gates and bars.”

paite: Saul in mi tengteng kidou ding in Keilah khua va sual a David leh amite va um ding in asamkhawm hi.
english: Saul summoned all the people to war, to go down to Keilah to besiege David and his men.

paite: David in Saul in atung ah thil hoih lou asawm chih a na thei hi. Siampu Abiathar kiang ah, "Siampu puanak hon la dih ve," achi hi.
english: David knew that Saul was devising mischief against him. He said to Abiathar the priest, “Bring the ephod here.”

paite: Huchi in David in, "Aw TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian, kei ziak a khua hihse ding in Keilah ah Saul hong paisuk atum, chih kei na sikha in ka za hi.
english: Then David said, “O Yahweh, the God of Israel, your servant has surely heard that Saul seeks to come to Keilah to destroy the city for my sake.

paite: Keilah a mite'n akhut ah hon pe ding uam? Na sikha in ka zak bang in Saul ahong paisuk diam? Aw ToUPA, Israelte' Pathian, hehpih in na sikha hon hilh in," achi hi,
english: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? Will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? Yahweh, the God of Israel, I beg you, tell your servant.” Yahweh said, “He will come down.”

paite: TOUPA'N, "Ahong suk ding," achi hi. Huchi in David in, “Keilah khua mite'n kei leh ka mite Saul khut ah ahon pe ding uam?" achi hi. TOUPA'N, "Ahon pe ding uh," achi hi.
english: Then David said, “Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul?” Yahweh said, “They will deliver you up.”

paite: Huchi in David leh amite, zaguk hiamtak athou ua Keilah a pan apawt ua, alemna lamlam ah apaita uh. Keilah a pan David ataikheta, chih Saul ahilh ua; huchi in kuankhiak akikhelsakta hi.
english: Then David and his men, who were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah and went wherever they could go. Saul was told that David had escaped from Keilah; and he gave up going there.

paite: David gamdai ah, leikohawm ah a-om hi. Ziph gamdai a tanggam ah a-om nilouh hi. Saul in niteng in amah azong a, himahleh Pathian in akhut ah ape kei hi.
english: David stayed in the wilderness in the strongholds, and remained in the hill country in the wilderness of Ziph. Saul sought him every day, but God didn’t deliver him into his hand.

paite: David in amah thah tum in Saul ahong kisa chih athei a; huchi in Ziph gamdai Horesh ah David a-om hi.
english: David saw that Saul had come out to seek his life. David was in the wilderness of Ziph in the woods.

paite: Saul tapa Jonathan athou a, Horesh ah David kiang ah ahoh a, Pathian ah akhut ahatsak hi.
english: Jonathan, Saul’s son, arose and went to David into the woods, and strengthened his hand in God.

paite: Akiang ah, "Lau het ke'n, ka pa Saul khut in ahong zongkhe kei ding, Israelte tung ah kumpi na hong hi dia, kei nang hon zom pa ka hi ding. Hiai leng ka pa Saul in athei kilkel hi," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for the hand of Saul my father won’t find you; and you will be king over Israel, and I will be next to you; and Saul my father knows that also.”

paite: Anih un TOUPA ma ah thukhun abawl ua, Horesh ah David a-om nilouh a, Jonathan bel a-inn lam ah apaita hi.
english: They both made a covenant before Yahweh. Then David stayed in the woods and Jonathan went to his house.

paite: Huchi in Ziph mite Gibeah ah Saul kiang ah ahohtou ua, "I kiang ua Horesh a leikohawm, gamdai simlam pang Hakilah mual a David na kibu nilouh akei maw?
english: Then the Ziphites came up to Saul to Gibeah, saying, “Doesn’t David hide himself with us in the strongholds in the woods, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of the desert?

paite: Huaiziak in aw kumpipa, hong paisuk na lunggulh lamtak ahih bang in hong paisuk inla, kou ka hih ding uh ahihleh kumpipa khut a amah hon piak ahi ding," achi uhi.
english: Now therefore, O king, come down. According to all the desire of your soul to come down; and our part will be to deliver him up into the king’s hand.”

paite: Saul in, "TOUPA'N hon vualzawl hen. Noute'n na hon hehpih mahmah uhi.
english: Saul said, “You are blessed by Yahweh, for you have had compassion on me.

paite: Pai unla, va chian nawn sem unla, anung va zui unla, amumi leng va chian hoih nawn sese un. Lepchiah piltak in thil ahih nak chih mi'n ahon hilh uhi.
english: Please go make yet more sure, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who has seen him there; for I have been told that he is very cunning.

paite: Huaiziak in abukna mun tengteng thei sipsip unla, ka kiang ah hong nawn ngeingei unla, nou kiang ah kei leng ka hong sam ding hi. Huan hichi ahi ding a, hiai gam a a-om peuhmahleh Judah mi sang tampi lak a pan ka zongkhe ding," achi hi.
english: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hides himself; and come again to me with certainty, and I will go with you. It shall happen, if he is in the land, that I will search him out among all the thousands of Judah.”

paite: Huchi in athou ua, Saul ma in Ziph ah ahoh uh. Himahleh David leh amite gamdai simlam Arabah a Maon gamdai ah a-om uhi. Huai mun Jashimon simlam a om ahi.
english: They arose, and went to Ziph before Saul; but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the Arabah on the south of the desert.

paite: Saul leh amite amah zong ding in ahoh uh. David ahilh ua, huchi in suangpi zuan in apawtkhia hi. Maon gamdai ah David adelhta hi.
english: Saul and his men went to seek him. When David was told, he went down to the rock, and stayed in the wilderness of Maon. When Saul heard that, he pursued David in the wilderness of Maon.

paite: Saul tang langkhat lam pang ah apai a, David leh amite bel tang langkhat lam pang ah apai uhi. David Saul lau in kintak in atai a; Saul leh amite'n lah David leh amite mat tum in a-umkimvel ngal ua.
english: Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain; and David hurried to get away for fear of Saul, for Saul and his men surrounded David and his men to take them.

paite: Himahleh Saul kiang ah, "Kin meng inla, hong pai in, Philistia mite'n i gam uh ahong sual uh," chi in thangkou ahong tung hi.
english: But a messenger came to Saul, saying, “Hurry and come, for the Philistines have made a raid on the land!”

paite: Huchi in Saul in David adelh lai akiksan hi. Philistia mite sual ding in apaita hi. Huaiziak in huai mun Sela-hammahlekoth achi uhi.
english: So Saul returned from pursuing David, and went against the Philistines. Therefore they called that place Sela Hammahlekoth.

paite: David huai a kipan apaitou a, En-gedi leikohawm ah a-om hi.
english: David went up from there and lived in the strongholds of En Gedi.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Saul in Philistia mite va delh ahong paikik in ngai in, "En-gedi gamdai ah David a-om," chih hilh in a-om hi.
english: When Saul had returned from following the Philistines, he was told, “Behold, David is in the wilderness of En Gedi.”

paite: Huchi in Saul in Israel mi tengteng lak a telkhiak tuam mi sangthum api a, sathakte tenna suangpi lak lam ah David leh amite zong in ahohta uhi.
english: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men on the rocks of the wild goats.

paite: Lamkal ah belam huang kokhuk omna ava tung ua, khawl tawldam ding in Saul ava lut hi. Kokhuk sunggil lam ah David leh amite a-om uhi.
english: He came to the sheep pens by the way, where there was a cave; and Saul went in to relieve himself. Now David and his men were staying in the innermost parts of the cave.

paite: David mite'n akiang ah, "Ngai dih, TOUPA'N na kiang ah, ngai in, na khut ah na melma ka hon pe dia, atung ah hoih na saksak in na hih ding, achih ni ahita ve," achi uhi. Huchi in David athou a, simthamtak in Saul puan mong ava tan hi.
english: David’s men said to him, “Behold, the day of which Yahweh said to you, ‘Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand, and you shall do to him as it shall seem good to you.’” Then David arose and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe secretly.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, aden chiang in Saul puan mong ava tan in David lungsim asun mahmah hi.
english: Afterward, David’s heart struck him because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.

paite: Huchi in amite kiang ah, "Amah TOUPA sathau nilh ahi, chih thei napi a, atung a khut zang a TOUPA sathau nilh ka toupa tung a hiai thil ka hih louh ding hi a," achi hi.
english: He said to his men, “Yahweh forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, Yahweh’s anointed, to stretch out my hand against him, since he is Yahweh’s anointed.”

paite: David in huai thu in amite akhamdai a, Saul sual dia akuan uh aphalta kei hi. Saul bel kokhuk a pan apawt a, apai nawnta hi.
english: So David checked his men with these words, and didn’t allow them to rise against Saul. Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.

paite: Anung zek in David leng athou a, kokhuk a pan apawt a, "Kumpipa, ka toupa," chi in Saul anungsap hi. Nunglam ah Saul ahong kihei a, David in amai a lei si in akunsuk hi.
english: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave and cried after Saul, saying, “My lord the king!” When Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth, and showed respect.

paite: David in Saul kiang ah, "Ngai in, David in na siatna azong, chi a mite'n na kiang a, agen uh bangziak a gingta na hia?
english: David said to Saul, “Why do you listen to men’s words, saying, ‘Behold, David seeks to harm you’?

paite: Ngai in, tuni in TOUPA'N kokhuk ah ka khut ah nang ahon pia chih na mit mahmah in na mu hi. Mi khenkhatte'n nang that ding in ahon chi uh. Himahleh ka hon hawi hi. Ka toupa tung ah ka khut himhim ka kha kei ding, TOUPA sathau nilh ahi ngal a," ka chi hi.
english: Behold, today your eyes have seen how Yahweh had delivered you today into my hand in the cave. Some urged me to kill you, but I spared you. I said, ‘I will not stretch out my hand against my lord, for he is Yahweh’s anointed.’

paite: Huai kia leng hilou in, pa, en in, na puan mong leng ka tawi hi. Na puan mong ka tan theih a, ka hon thahlouhna ah ka khut ah thil hoih lou leh tatlekna a-om kei, chih leh ka hinna lak tum in hon zongzong lechin leng, na tung ah ka khial kei chih thei in.
english: Moreover, my father, behold, yes, see the skirt of your robe in my hand; for in that I cut off the skirt of your robe and didn’t kill you, know and see that there is neither evil nor disobedience in my hand. I have not sinned against you, though you hunt for my life to take it.

paite: TOUPA'N nang leh kei kikal ah vaihawm henla, TOUPA'N na tung ah ka phu hon laksak hen. Himahleh ke'n zaw na tung ah khut ka kha kei himhim ding.
english: May Yahweh judge between me and you, and may Yahweh avenge me of you; but my hand will not be on you.

paite: Nidanglai a paunak in, "Migilou a pan gitlouhna apawt zel," achi hi. "Himahleh ke'n bel na tung ah khut ka kha kei ding.
english: As the proverb of the ancients says, ‘Out of the wicked comes wickedness;’ but my hand will not be on you.

paite: Israel kumpipa kua zong in ahia ahong pawtkhiak? Kua ahia na delh? Ui sisa, uihik lel mo?
english: Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom do you pursue? A dead dog? A flea?

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA vaihawmpa hi henla, nang toh kei kikal ah vaihawm hen, hon mu in hon genpih henla, na khut a pan hon hunkhia hen," achi hi.
english: May Yahweh therefore be judge, and give sentence between me and you, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of your hand.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, David in Saul kiang a hiai thute agen khit in, Saul in, "Hiai ka tapa David aw hilou amaw?" achi hi. Huchi in aw suah in Saul akapta hi.
english: It came to pass, when David had finished speaking these words to Saul, that Saul said, “Is that your voice, my son David?” Saul lifted up his voice and wept.

paite: David kiang ah, "Kei sang in na diktatzaw, nang zaw ka tung ah thil hoih na hih a, ke'n bel thil hoih lou ka hih.
english: He said to David, “You are more righteous than I; for you have done good to me, whereas I have done evil to you.

paite: Tuni in ka tung a thil hoih na hihdan na hihlang a, TOUPA'N na khut a kei ahon piak a leng na hon thahlouhna ah.
english: You have declared today how you have dealt well with me, because when Yahweh had delivered me up into your hand, you didn’t kill me.

paite: Mi'n amelma mu taleh bangmah lou in akhah mawk diam? Huaiziak in tuni a ka tung a na thilhih ah TOUPA'N thil hoih in nang họn thuk hen.
english: For if a man finds his enemy, will he let him go away unharmed? Therefore may Yahweh reward you good for that which you have done to me today.

paite: Ngai in, kumpipa na hong hi ngei dia, Israel gam na khut ah hihkip in a-om ding chih ka theita hi.
english: Now, behold, I know that you will surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel will be established in your hand.

paite: Huaiziak in ka nung a ka suan hong om dingte hihmang lou ding in TOUPA min in ka kiang ah kichiam inla, ka pa inkote a pan ka min thaimang ke'n," achi hi.
english: Swear now therefore to me by Yahweh that you will not cut off my offspring after me, and that you will not destroy my name out of my father’s house.”

paite: Huchi in Saul kiang ah David akichiam hi. Huchi in inn ah Saul apai a, David leh amite leikohawm ah apaitou uhi.
english: David swore to Saul. Saul went home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.

paite: Huan Samuel asita a; Israel mi tengteng ahong paikhawm ua, amah kah in Ramah ah a-inn uah avui uhi. David athou a Paran gamdai ah ahohsuk hi.
english: Samuel died; and all Israel gathered themselves together and mourned for him, and buried him at his house at Ramah. Then David arose and went down to the wilderness of Paran.

paite: Maon ah mi khat a-om a, Karmel tang ah aneih-le-lam a-om hi. Amah mithupitak ahi a, belam sangthum leh kel sangkhat anei hi. Karmel tang ah abelam mul amet hi.
english: There was a man in Maon whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great. He had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats; and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

paite: Amin Nabal ahi a, azi min Abigail ahi. Huai numei teitak leh melhoihtak ahi. Himahleh pasal pen mi chihhaktak leh giloutak ahi a; amah Kaleb suan ahi.
english: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail. This woman was intelligent and had a beautiful face; but the man was surly and evil in his doings. He was of the house of Caleb.

paite: David in gamdai a pan Nabal in abelam mul amet chih ana za hi.
english: David heard in the wilderness that Nabal was shearing his sheep.

paite: Huchi in David in tangval sawm asawl a, tangvalte kiang ah, "David in Karmel tang ah va hohtou unla, Nabal kiang ah hoh unla ka min in chibai va buk un.
english: David sent ten young men; and David said to the young men, “Go up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name.

paite: Mineizoupa kiang ah huchi in va chi un: 'Nang tung ah, na inkuante tung ah leh na neih tengteng tung ah khamuanna om hen.
english: Tell him, ‘Long life to you! Peace be to you! Peace be to your house! Peace be to all that you have!

paite: Na belam mulmet mite a-om uh chih ka na za hi. Na belamching mite ka kiang ah a-om zel ua, apoi uh bangmah ka khoih kei ua, Karmel tang a a-om sung un bangmah amangsak kei uh.
english: Now I have heard that you have shearers. Your shepherds have now been with us, and we didn’t harm them. Nothing was missing from them all the time they were in Carmel.

paite: Na tangvalte dong lechin hon hilh mai ding uh. Huchi in hiai ka tangvalte'n na mitmuh in deihsakna tang uhen, ni hoih ni tak a hong hoh lah ka hi ngal ua. Na neih bangbang na sikhate leh na tapa David na pe dih ve, achi, chi un, " achi hi.
english: Ask your young men, and they will tell you. Therefore let the young men find favor in your eyes, for we come on a good day. Please give whatever comes to your hand to your servants and to your son David.’”

paite: David tangvalte ava tun un David min in huai thu tengteng Nabal kiang ah agen ua, huchi in adaita uh.
english: When David’s young men came, they spoke to Nabal all those words in the name of David, and waited.

paite: Nabal in David sikhate adawng a, "David kua ahia oi? Jesse tapa kua ahia oi? Tulai in sikha tampi pute taimangsan atam mai uh.
english: Nabal answered David’s servants and said, “Who is David? Who is the son of Jesse? There are many servants who break away from their masters these days.

paite: Ka tanghou, ka tui leh ka belam mulmet mite a dia ka gohsa kuate ahi ua chih ka theihlouhte ka pe peuhmah dia hia?" achi hi.
english: Shall I then take my bread, my water, and my meat that I have killed for my shearers, and give it to men who I don’t know where they come from?”

paite: Huchi in David tangvalte akihei ua, akik nawn ua; huai thu tengteng ahong hilh uh.
english: So David’s young men turned on their way and went back, and came and told him all these words.

paite: David in amite kiang ah, "Na namsau uh kuah chiat un," achi hi. Anamsau uh akuah chiat uh. David in leng anamsau akuah a, mi zali in David azuitou ua; mi zanih van veng in a-om uhi.
english: David said to his men, “Every man put on his sword!” Every man put on his sword. David also put on his sword. About four hundred men followed David, and two hundred stayed by the baggage.

paite: Tangval khat in Nabal zi Abigail kiang ah, "Ngai in, David in gamdai a pan ka pu uh chibai buk ding in mi ahon sawl a, ama'n ana sal hi.
english: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal’s wife, saying, “Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to greet our master; and he insulted them.

paite: Himahleh huaite lah ka tung uah ahoih mahmah ua, ka poi uh bangmah akhoih kei uh. Gamlak a ka om lai ua ka omkhawm sung tengteng uh bangmah ka tan kei uhi.
english: But the men were very good to us, and we were not harmed, and we didn’t miss anything as long as we went with them, when we were in the fields.

paite: Belamching a akiang ua ka om sung tengteng un sun leh zan kou a ding in baang ahi mai uhi.
english: They were a wall to us both by night and by day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.

paite: Huaiziak in bang ahia na hih ding hoihtak in ngaihtuah dih ve. Ka pu uh tung ah leh a-inkuan tengteng tung ah thil hoih lou tup in anei hi. Amah lah a Belial tapa mahmah a, kuamah houpih theih ahi kei hi," chi in agen hi.
english: Now therefore know and consider what you will do; for evil is determined against our master and against all his house, for he is such a worthless fellow that one can’t speak to him.”

paite: Abigail in kintak in tanghou beu zanih, uain thawl nih, belam nga huan dia mansa, vaimim kan buk nga, grep gah phoukeu bawk zakhat leh theipi beu zanih alakhawm a, sabiltung aposak hi.
english: Then Abigail hurried and took two hundred loaves of bread, two containers of wine, five sheep ready dressed, five seahs of parched grain, one hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on donkeys.

paite: Asikha tangvalte kiang ah, "Ka ma ah na pai zel unla, ngai un, ka hon zui ding," achi hi. Himahleh apasal Nabal ahilh kei hi.
english: She said to her young men, “Go on before me. Behold, I am coming after you.” But she didn’t tell her husband, Nabal.

paite: Huchi in hichibang ahi a, asabiltung tung a tuang a tang sang sing lak a apaisuk lai in, ngai in, David leh amite'n ahon zuan ua, huchi in amau atuakta hi.
english: As she rode on her donkey, and came down hidden by the mountain, behold, David and his men came down toward her, and she met them.

paite: David in, "Bangmah amansaklouhna dia gamdai a hiai mipa neih tengteng athawn lel in ka na vensak ana hi mahmah ve; thil hoih lah thil hoih lou in ahon dinta ngal a.
english: Now David had said, “Surely in vain I have kept all that this fellow has in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained to him. He has returned me evil for good.

paite: Zingchiang zingsang khovak pha a amah a tengteng lak a pasal naupang khat kia lel leng ka hawi peuhmahleh Pathian in David melmate thupizaw sem in bawl hen,” achi hi.
english: God do so to the enemies of David, and more also, if I leave of all that belongs to him by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall.”

paite: Abigail in David amuh in asabiltung a pan akumsuk zok a, David ma a lei si in akunsuk hi.
english: When Abigail saw David, she hurried and got off her donkey, and fell before David on her face and bowed herself to the ground.

paite: Akhebul ah abokkhup a, "Keimah in, ka toupa aw, kei mahmah in thulimlouhna ka khu ding. Na sikhanu'n na bil a zak ding in thu gen henla, na sikhanu thugen hehpih in ngaikhia in.
english: She fell at his feet and said, “On me, my lord, on me be the blame! Please let your servant speak in your ears. Hear the words of your servant.

paite: Ka toupa aw, Belial mi Nabal bangmah in sim ke'n. Amin bangbang ahi geih hi. Nabal ahi na mah a, ahai hi. Kei na sikhanu'n, ka toupa'n na hon sawl tangvalte ka na mu kha kei hi.
english: Please don’t let my lord pay attention to this worthless fellow, Nabal, for as his name is, so is he. Nabal is his name, and folly is with him; but I, your servant, didn’t see my lord’s young men whom you sent.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in, toupa aw, TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi. Ka mu mahmah kei hi, TOUPA'N sisan suah lou ding leh na khut a phu la lou ding in lah nang ahon bawl hi. Na melmate leh ka toupa hoihlouhna zong mite Nabal bang himai uhen.
english: Now therefore, my lord, as Yahweh lives and as your soul lives, since Yahweh has withheld you from blood guiltiness and from avenging yourself with your own hand, now therefore let your enemies and those who seek evil to my lord be as Nabal.

paite: Hiai ka toupa a dia na sikha in vualzawlnate ka hon tawi ka pu hon zui tangvalte piak hi hen.
english: Now this present which your servant has brought to my lord, let it be given to the young men who follow my lord.

paite: Na sikhanu tatlekna hehpih in ngaidam in. TOUPA'N ka toupa inkuan kiptak in aphut ngeingei dia, ka pu TOUPA kidounate dou ahi ngal a. Na damsung teng in nangmah gitlouh man muh ding a-om kei ding.
english: Please forgive the trespass of your servant. For Yahweh will certainly make my lord a sure house, because my lord fights Yahweh’s battles. Evil will not be found in you all your days.

paite: Nang hon delh ding leh na hinna hihmang ding in mite hong kisa mah le uh, ka toupa hinna zaw TOUPA na Pathian toh hinna a gak ahi dia; na melmate hinna bel vaisuanglot a suanglot bang in alawnmang ding hi.
english: Though men may rise up to pursue you and to seek your soul, yet the soul of my lord will be bound in the bundle of life with Yahweh your God. He will sling out the souls of your enemies as from a sling’s pocket.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N na tungtang thu a thil hoih a chiam bang teng ka toupa tung a ahih chiang a, Israelte kumpipa dia ahon bawl chiang in,
english: It will come to pass, when Yahweh has done to my lord according to all the good that he has spoken concerning you, and has appointed you prince over Israel,

paite: Aziak om lou a sisan na suah louh a, ka toupa'n phu na lak louh nang a ding in lungkhamna himhim ahi kei ding. Ka toupa a ding in leng lungkimlouhna himhim ahi sam kei ding. TOUPA'N ka toupa tung a thil hoih ahih hun chiang in na sikhanu theigige in," achi hi.
english: that this shall be no grief to you, nor offense of heart to my lord, either that you have shed blood without cause, or that my lord has avenged himself. When Yahweh has dealt well with my lord, then remember your servant.”

paite: David in Abigail kiang ah, "Tuni a kei hon na dawn dia hon sawlpa TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian phat in om hen.
english: David said to Abigail, “Blessed is Yahweh, the God of Israel, who sent you today to meet me!

paite: Na lemtheihna vualzawl in om henla, nang sisan suah mohna a pan hon humnu leh keimah khut a phu la lou dia hon bawlnu vualzawl in om hen.
english: Blessed is your discretion, and blessed are you, who have kept me today from blood guiltiness, and from avenging myself with my own hand.

paite: Kei hon dawn dia hong pawtkhe pah lou hi lechin, TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian ahin bang in ka gen ahi, zingchiang khovak pha in Nabal ka hawisak het kei ding," achi hi.
english: For indeed, as Yahweh the God of Israel lives, who has withheld me from harming you, unless you had hurried and come to meet me, surely there wouldn’t have been left to Nabal by the morning light so much as one who urinates on a wall.”

paite: Huchi in David in athiltawite ala a, akiang ah, "Lungmuangtak in na inn ah paitouta in. Na thu ka mang hi. Na nget nen ka hon sansak hi,” achi hi.
