english: So David received from her hand that which she had brought him. Then he said to her, “Go up in peace to your house. Behold, I have listened to your voice and have granted your request.”

paite: Nabal kiang ah Abigail ahohtou hi. Ngai in, a-inn ah kumpipa ankuanglui bang mai in ankuang a na lui hi. Akham mahmah ziak in Nabal amaitai ngial hi. Huaiziak in azingsang khovak masiah bangmah ahilh kei hi.
english: Abigail came to Nabal; and behold, he held a feast in his house like the feast of a king. Nabal’s heart was merry within him, for he was very drunk. Therefore she told him nothing until the morning light.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, zinglam a Nabal uain kham ahong halh in azi in huai thute ahilhta a, alung adaiduak a, suang bang in ahong om hial hi.
english: In the morning, when the wine had gone out of Nabal, his wife told him these things; and his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ni sawm nung in TOUPA'N Nabal tung ah khut akha a, asita hi.
english: About ten days later, Yahweh struck Nabal, so that he died.

paite: David in Nabal asi chih azak in, "Ka minsiatna dia Nabal thilhih a pan hon genpih a, asikha thil hoih lou hih lou dia hon khampa TOUPA phat in om hen. Nabal thil hoih lou hih TOUPA'N amah tung mah ah akesakta," achi hi. Huchi in David in Abigail azi dia va houpih ding in mi asawl hi.
english: When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, “Blessed is Yahweh, who has pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and has kept back his servant from evil. Yahweh has returned the evildoing of Nabal on his own head.” David sent and spoke concerning Abigail, to take her to himself as wife.

paite: David sikhate'n Karmel tang a Abigail kiang atuntouh un, "David in azi dia nang hong pi ding in ahon sawl," chi in amah ahoupih uhi.
english: When David’s servants had come to Abigail to Carmel, they spoke to her, saying, “David has sent us to you, to take you to him as wife.”

paite: Athou a, amai a lei si in akunsuk hi. "Ngai dih ua, na sikhanu uh ka toupa sikhate khe sil ding sikha ka hi," achi hi.
english: She arose and bowed herself with her face to the earth, and said, “Behold, your servant is a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.”

paite: Huchi in Abigail athou zok a, sabiltung tung ah atuang a, anungzui nungak ngate toh David misawlte azui ua, azi in a-omta hi.
english: Abigail hurriedly arose and rode on a donkey with her five maids who followed her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.

paite: David in Jezreel a mi Ahinoam leng ana pi khin a; huchi in azi ding in a-om tuaktuak uhi.
english: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they both became his wives.

paite: Saul in lah atanu Mikal, David zi Gallim a mi Laish tapa Palti toh ana kitengsak zouta hi.
english: Now Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, to Palti the son of Laish, who was of Gallim.

paite: Huan Ziphte Gibeah ah Saul kiang ah ahoh ua, “Gamdai chin a Hakilah mual ah David akibu kei maw?" chi in ava gen uhi.
english: The Ziphites came to Saul to Gibeah, saying, “Doesn’t David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before the desert?”

paite: Huchi in Saul athou a, Ziph gamdai ah Israel mite lak a pan telkhiak mi sangthum pi in Ziph gamdai ah David zong ding in ahohsukta uhi.
english: Then Saul arose and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.

paite: Saul in gamdai chin, lampi gei suahlam a om, Jeshimon toh kigalsai, Hakilah mual tung ah panmun akhoh a, gamdai ah David a-om lai a, Saul amah zong in gamdai ah ahong chih athei hi.
english: Saul encamped in the hill of Hachilah, which is before the desert, by the way. But David stayed in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.

paite: Huaiziak in David in enkhe mite asawl a, huchi in Saul ahong taktak chih atheitelta hi.
english: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul had certainly come.

paite: David athou a, Saul panmun khohna ah ahoh hi. David in Saul leh asepaih heutu, Ner tapa Abner lupna amu hi. Giahphual um sung ah Saul alum a, akim ah mite'n a-umkual uhi.
english: Then David arose and came to the place where Saul had encamped; and David saw the place where Saul lay, with Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his army. Saul lay within the place of the wagons, and the people were encamped around him.

paite: David in Hit mi Ahimelek leh Joab unau Zeruiah tapa Abishai kiang ah, "Saul panmun ah kua ahia ka kiang a hong ding?" chi in agen hi. Abishai in, "Kei na kiang ah ka hong suk sam ding," achi hi.
english: Then David answered and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, saying, “Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp?” Abishai said, “I will go down with you.”

paite: Huchi in David leh Abishai mipite omna ah zan in ava hoh uhi. Ngai in, Saul bel giahphual um sung ah lum in a-ihmu hi. Alulam ah ateipi lei ah asiat tal a, Abner leh mite bel akim ah lum in a-ihmu uhi.
english: So David and Abishai came to the people by night; and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the place of the wagons, with his spear stuck in the ground at his head; and Abner and the people lay around him.

paite: Abishai in David kiang ah, "Tuni in Pathian in na melma na khut a hon pia ahita ve. Huaiziak in teipi in khatvei in lei ah ka hon sunden suk ding aw? Nihvei sut tuan angai kei ding," achi hi.
english: Then Abishai said to David, “God has delivered up your enemy into your hand today. Now therefore please let me strike him with the spear to the earth at one stroke, and I will not strike him the second time.”

paite: Himahleh David in Abishai kiang ah, "Hihmangthang ke'n, TOUPA thaunilh tung a khut kha amoh lou kua a-om thei a?" achi hi.
english: David said to Abishai, “Don’t destroy him, for who can stretch out his hand against Yahweh’s anointed, and be guiltless?”

paite: David mah in, "TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi. TOUPA'N atung ah khut kha na ve. Ahihkeileh leng asih ni ahong tung na ding. Ahihkeileh leng, kidouna ah ahoh dia, amangthang mai ding.
english: David said, “As Yahweh lives, Yahweh will strike him; or his day shall come to die, or he shall go down into battle and perish.

paite: TOUPA thaunilh tung ah khut ka kha het kei ding. Alu kiangchin a teipi leh tuithawl ahihleh la inla, pai ni," achi hi.
english: Yahweh forbid that I should stretch out my hand against Yahweh’s anointed; but now please take the spear that is at his head and the jar of water, and let’s go.”

paite: Huchi in David in Saul lu kiangchin a teipi leh tuithawl ala a, apai nawnta uh. Kuamah in amu kei ua, kuamah in phawk in akhanglou kei. TOUPA'N nuamtak a a-ihmutsak ziak in avek un nakpi in a-ihmu uhi.
english: So David took the spear and the jar of water from Saul’s head, and they went away. No man saw it, or knew it, nor did any awake; for they were all asleep, because a deep sleep from Yahweh had fallen on them.

paite: Huchi in gal khat lam ah David ahoh a, gamla kuam ah mualvum ah adingh a; akikal uh gamlapi ahi.
english: Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of the mountain far away, a great space being between them;

paite: David in mipite leh Ner tapa Abner zak in akikou a, "Abner, na hon dawng kei dia hia?" chi in asam hi. Huchi in Abner in adawng a, "Kumpipa sam nang kua na hia?" achi hi.
english: and David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, “Don’t you answer, Abner?” Then Abner answered, “Who are you who calls to the king?”

paite: David in Abner kiang ah, "Mihangsan na hi kei maw? Israelte lak ah nang bang kua a-om a? Bangchidan ahia kumpipa, na toupa na ven louh? Kumpipa, na pu hihmang ding in kuahiam khat ahong pai hi.
english: David said to Abner, “Aren’t you a man? Who is like you in Israel? Why then have you not kept watch over your lord the king? For one of the people came in to destroy your lord the king.

paite: Na thilhihdan ahoih kei. TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi. TOUPA thaunilh toupa na ven hoih louh ziak in si dia kilawm na hi. Kumpipa lu chin a teipi leh tuithawl om koi a om ahita ua? En him dih," achi hi.
english: This thing isn’t good that you have done. As Yahweh lives, you are worthy to die, because you have not kept watch over your lord, Yahweh’s anointed. Now see where the king’s spear is, and the jar of water that was at his head.”

paite: Saul in David aw athei a, "Tua nang aw hia, ka tapa David?" achi hi. David in, "Hi, toupa, kumpipa aw, ka aw ahi,” achi hi.
english: Saul recognized David’s voice, and said, “Is this your voice, my son David?” David said, “It is my voice, my lord, O king.”

paite: "Bangziak in ahia ka toupa in asikha adelh? Bang thil ka hih a ahia? Akhut ah thil gilou bang ahia om?
english: He said, “Why does my lord pursue his servant? For what have I done? What evil is in my hand?

paite: Huaiziak in toupa, ka kumpipa'n asikha thu ngaikhia hen. Kei dou dia na lungtang tokthoupa TOUPA ahihleh thillat pom teitei hen. Mihing tate ahih uleh TOUPA ah hamsia thuak in om uhen. Pai inla, pathian dangte nna sem in, chi a TOUPA gou ka luah theihlouhna dia tuni a hon delhmang lah ahi ngal ua.
english: Now therefore, please let my lord the king hear the words of his servant. If it is so that Yahweh has stirred you up against me, let him accept an offering. But if it is the children of men, they are cursed before Yahweh; for they have driven me out today that I shouldn’t cling to Yahweh’s inheritance, saying, ‘Go, serve other gods!’

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA muh phak louh in lei ah ka sisan luang kei hen. Vengkeng gem dia tang a mi agamvak bang un Israel kumpipa, uihik leltak zong ding a paikhia ahi ve," achi hi.
english: Now therefore, don’t let my blood fall to the earth away from the presence of Yahweh; for the king of Israel has come out to seek a flea, as when one hunts a partridge in the mountains.”

paite: Saul in, "Ka na khialta. Ka tapa David, hong pai nawn in. Tuni a na mitmuh a ka hinna amanphat mahmah ziak in bangmah himhim ka hihta kei ding hi. Ngai in, thil haihuai mahmah ka na hihta a, ka nak khelh mahmah hi,” achi hi.
english: Then Saul said, “I have sinned. Return, my son David; for I will no more do you harm, because my life was precious in your eyes today. Behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.”

paite: David in adawng a, "Toupa aw, teipi en dih, tangval khat hong henla, hong la hen.
english: David answered, “Behold the spear, O king! Let one of the young men come over and get it.

paite: TOUPA'N michih adiktat man uleh amuanhuai man uh ape ding. Tuni in TOUPA'N ka khut ah nang ahon pe na a, TOUPA thaunilh tung ah ka khut ka lik nuam kei a ahi.
english: Yahweh will give to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness; because Yahweh delivered you into my hand today, and I wouldn’t stretch out my hand against Yahweh’s anointed.

paite: Ngai in, tuni a na hinna ka hon mantamsak mahmah bang in TOUPA'N ka hinna hon mantamsak henla, mangbatna tengteng a pan hon hunkhia hen,” achi hi.
english: Behold, as your life was respected today in my eyes, so let my life be respected in Yahweh’s eyes, and let him deliver me out of all oppression.”

paite: Huchi in Saul in David kiang ah, "Ka tapa David, vualzawl in om in. Thilhihtheitak in na om dia, na zou zel ding," achi hi. Huchi in David apai a, Saul leng amun ah apai nawnta hi.
english: Then Saul said to David, “You are blessed, my son David. You will both do mightily, and will surely prevail.” So David went his way, and Saul returned to his place.

paite: Huan David in alungsim in, Chikchiang hiam a zaw Saul khut a mangthang khongkhong ding ka hi ve. Philistia mite gam a taimang sang a hoihzaw om lou ding ahi. Huchi in Saul in Israel gam a hon zonna alungdong dia, huchi in akhut a pan ka suakta ding," achi hi.
english: David said in his heart, “I will now perish one day by the hand of Saul. There is nothing better for me than that I should escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul will despair of me, to seek me any more in all the borders of Israel. So I will escape out of his hand.”

paite: David athou a, amah leh akiang a mi zaguk omte Maok tapa Gath kumpipa Akish kiang ah apaita uhi.
english: David arose and passed over, he and the six hundred men who were with him, to Achish the son of Maoch, king of Gath.

paite: David leh amite, michih a-inkuankuan un, David zi nihte, Jezreel mi Ahinoam leh Nabal zi Karmel mi Abigailte toh Gath ah Akish kiang ah atengta uhi.
english: David lived with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal’s wife.

paite: Gath ah David atai chih Saul ahilh ua, huchi in azong nawnta kei hi.
english: Saul was told that David had fled to Gath, so he stopped looking for him.

paite: David in Akish kiang ah, "Na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tanleh, na gam a khua khat ah tenna ding mun hon pe sam inla, huai ah ka teng ding uh. Na sikha bang ding in kumpipa khopi ah na kiang ah a-om nilouh dia?" achi hi.
english: David said to Achish, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, let them give me a place in one of the cities in the country, that I may dwell there. For why should your servant dwell in the royal city with you?”

paite: Huchi in Akish in huai ni in Ziklag khua apeta hi. Huaiziak in Ziklag tuni tan in Judah gam kumpipate a ahi nilouh hi.
english: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: therefore Ziklag belongs to the kings of Judah to this day.

paite: Philistia gam a David a-om sung kum khat pumpi leh kha li ahi.
english: The number of the days that David lived in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.

paite: David leh amite ava hohtou ua, Geshur mite, Girzi mite leh Amalek mite ava dou uhi. Huai namte Telam a pan Shur gam lam pang Aigupta gam pha a om ahi uhi.
english: David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites; for those were the inhabitants of the land who were of old, on the way to Shur, even to the land of Egypt.

paite: David in gam asual a, numei leh pasal hawi himhim anei kei. Belamte, bawngte, sabiltungte, sangawngsaute leh apuansilhte uh alaksak hi. Apai nawn a, Akish kiang ah ahoh hi.
english: David struck the land, and saved no man or woman alive, and took away the sheep, the cattle, the donkeys, the camels, and the clothing. Then he returned, and came to Achish.

paite: Akish in, "Tuni in koilam na dou a?" achi hi. David in, "Judah sim gam, Jerahmeelte sim gam leh Kente sim gam," achi hi.
english: Achish said, “Against whom have you made a raid today?” David said, “Against the South of Judah, against the South of the Jerahmeelites, and against the South of the Kenites.”

paite: "Philistia gam a a-om sung mawngmawng in 'David in hichibang in ahih zel," achi kha ding ua, chi in numei pasal Gath a pi ding hawi himhim anei kei hi.
english: David saved neither man nor woman alive to bring them to Gath, saying, “Lest they should tell about us, saying, ‘David did this, and this has been his way all the time he has lived in the country of the Philistines.’”

paite: Akish in David thugen ataksang a, "Ami Israelte akimudahsak mahmah ziak in, tangtawn in ka sikha ding in a-om ding," achi hi.
english: Achish believed David, saying, “He has made his people Israel utterly to abhor him. Therefore he will be my servant forever.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai lai in Philistia mite'n asepaihte uh Israel mite sual a dou ding in akaikhawm uh. Akish in David kiang ah, "Nang leh na mite kei toh galdou dia na hong kuan ngeingei ding uh ahi, chih thei in," achi hi.
english: In those days, the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. Achish said to David, “Know assuredly that you will go out with me in the army, you and your men.”

paite: David in Akish kiang ah, "Aw le, na sikha in bang ahihthei a chih na thei ding," achi hi. Akish in David kiang ah, "Ahoih ve, kei hon vengpa ding in ka hon bawl den ding," achi hi.
english: David said to Achish, “Therefore you will know what your servant can do.” Achish said to David, “Therefore I will make you my bodyguard forever.”

paite: Samuel asita a, Israel mi tengteng in akah ua, amah khua mah Ramah ah avui uhi. Saul in dawi aisan siam zawlte leh dawisiamte agam a pan adelhkhe khin hi.
english: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had mourned for him and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. Saul had sent away those who had familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land.

paite: Philistia mite akikaikhawm ua, Shunem ah panmun akhoh uh. Saul in Israel mi tengteng akaikhawm a, Gilboa ah panmun akhoh sam hi.
english: The Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and encamped in Shunem; and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they encamped in Gilboa.

paite: Saul in Philistia sepaihte amuhtak in alau a, alungsim aling tonton maimah hi.
english: When Saul saw the army of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart trembled greatly.

paite: Saul in TOUPA adot in leng TOUPA'N mang hiam, Urim hiam, zawlnei hiam in leng adawng himhim kei hi.
english: When Saul inquired of Yahweh, Yahweh didn’t answer him by dreams, by Urim, or by prophets.

paite: Saul in asikhate kiang ah, "Dawi aisan siam zawl numei akiang a ka hoh a ka dot ding hon zonkhiaksak un," achi hi. Asikhate'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, Endor a dawi aisan siam numei om ei ve," achi uhi.
english: Then Saul said to his servants, “Seek for me a woman who has a familiar spirit, that I may go to her and inquire of her.” His servants said to him, “Behold, there is a woman who has a familiar spirit at Endor.”

paite: Saul akibawl lamdang a, puan dang asilh a, amah leh midang nih ahoh uh. Zan in numei kiang ava tung uhi. "Dawi aisanna in ai hon sansak inla, na kiang a, amin ka gen peuhmah hon sapsak in," achi hi.
english: Saul disguised himself and put on other clothing, and went, he and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night. Then he said, “Please consult for me by the familiar spirit, and bring me up whomever I shall name to you.”

paite: Numei in akiang ah, "Ngai in, Saul thilhih na thei a, agam a dawi aisan siam leh dawisiamte ahihmang khinta a, bangziak a ka sihna dia ka hinna thang kamkhum dia kisa na hia?" achi hi.
english: The woman said to him, “Behold, you know what Saul has done, how he has cut off those who have familiar spirits and the wizards out of the land. Why then do you lay a snare for my life, to cause me to die?”

paite: Saul in, "TOUPA min lou in, TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Hiai thil ziak in na tung ah gawtna atung kei ding," chi in akiang ah akichiam hi.
english: Saul swore to her by Yahweh, saying, “As Yahweh lives, no punishment will happen to you for this thing.”

paite: Numei in, "Kua ka hon sapkhiaksak dia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Samuel hon sapkhiaksak in," achi hi.
english: Then the woman said, “Whom shall I bring up to you?” He said, “Bring Samuel up for me.”

paite: Numei in Samuel amuhleh ngaihtak in akikou a, Saul kiang ah, "Bangziak a hon khem, Saul lah na hi ngal a?" achi hi.
english: When the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice; and the woman spoke to Saul, saying, “Why have you deceived me? For you are Saul!”

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Lau ke'n. Bang a na muh?" achi hi. Numei in Saul kiang ah, "Lei a pan pathiante hong pawtkhia ka mu,” achi hi.
english: The king said to her, “Don’t be afraid! What do you see?” The woman said to Saul, “I see a god coming up out of the earth.”

paite: Akiang ah, "Bangchibang ahia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Putekpi ahong pawt a, puanaktual asilh," achi hi. Saul in Samuel ahi chih athei a, amai a lei in akun hi.
english: He said to her, “What does he look like?” She said, “An old man comes up. He is covered with a robe.” Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he bowed with his face to the ground, and showed respect.

paite: Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "Bangziak a hihbuai a hon samkhia na hia?" achi hi. Saul in adawng a, "Ka lung azing mahmah a ahi. Philistia mite'n ahon dou ua, Pathian in lah ahon lehngatsan a, zawlnei hiam, mang hiam in leng lah ahon dawng himhim kei hi. Huaiziak in ka hih ding hon hilh ding in ka hon sam ahi," achi hi.
english: Samuel said to Saul, “Why have you disturbed me, to bring me up?” Saul answered, “I am very distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God has departed from me, and answers me no more, by prophets, or by dreams. Therefore I have called you, that you may make known to me what I shall do.”

paite: Samuel in, "Huchi a TOUPA hon lehngatsan in na melma ahong hita, chih theigige kawm a bangziak a thu hon dong?
english: Samuel said, “Why then do you ask me, since Yahweh has departed from you and has become your adversary?

paite: Kei hon zang a, agen bang in TOUPA'N na tung a hih ahita ve. TOUPA'N na khut a pan gam ahon sut a, na invengpa David apeta hi.
english: Yahweh has done to you as he spoke by me. Yahweh has torn the kingdom out of your hand and given it to your neighbor, even to David.

paite: TOUPA thu na man louh ziak leh Amalekte tung a aheh mahmah dungzui a na tangtun louh ziak in. Tu in na tung ah hiai thil ahihta hi.
english: Because you didn’t obey Yahweh’s voice, and didn’t execute his fierce wrath on Amalek, therefore Yahweh has done this thing to you today.

paite: Huai lou leng, TOUPA'N nang leh Israelte leng Philistia mite khut ah ahon pe dia; zingchiang in nang leh na tapate ka kiang ah na hong om ding uh. TOUPA'N Israel sepaihte leng Philistia mite khut ah ape ding," achi hi.
english: Moreover Yahweh will deliver Israel also with you into the hand of the Philistines; and tomorrow you and your sons will be with me. Yahweh will deliver the army of Israel also into the hand of the Philistines.”

paite: Huchi in Samuel thugen ziak in Saul alau mahmah a, lei ah apuk vialvual maimah hi. Tha leh zung himhim anei kei; nitum leh zankhua a an ne lou ahi ngal a.
english: Then Saul fell immediately his full length on the earth, and was terrified, because of Samuel’s words. There was no strength in him, for he had eaten no bread all day long or all night long.

paite: Saul kiang ah numeinu ahoh a, adah mahmah chih athei hi. Akiang ah, "Ngai in, na sikhanu'n na gen ka taksang a, sih-le-sih ka kiang a na thugente ka zui hi.
english: The woman came to Saul and saw that he was very troubled, and said to him, “Behold, your servant has listened to your voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have listened to your words which you spoke to me.

paite: Huaiziak in nang leng na sikhanu thu taksang sam in. An tawmchik bek ka hon lui dia, huchi in na pai chiang a hatna na neihtheihna ding in ne in," achi hi.
english: Now therefore, please listen also to the voice of your servant, and let me set a morsel of bread before you. Eat, that you may have strength when you go on your way.”

paite: Himahleh a-ut kei a, "Ka ne kei ding,” achi hi. Himahleh asikhate'n numei toh asawl teitei ua; a thu uh amangta hi. Lei a pan athou a, lupna ah atuta hi.
english: But he refused, and said, “I will not eat.” But his servants, together with the woman, constrained him; and he listened to their voice. So he arose from the earth and sat on the bed.

paite: Numei in a-inn ah bawngnou vak thau anei a, agou zok a; tangbuang ala a, amek a, silngou soh louh tanghou abawl hi.
english: The woman had a fattened calf in the house. She hurried and killed it; and she took flour and kneaded it, and baked unleavened bread of it.

paite: Saul leh asikhate ma ah alui a, aneta uh. Huchi in athou ua, huai zan in apaita uhi.
english: She brought it before Saul and before his servants, and they ate. Then they rose up and went away that night.

paite: Philistia mite'n asepaih tengteng uh Aphek ah akaikhawm vek ua, Israel mite'n Jezreel a tuikhuk kiang ah panmun akhoh uhi,
english: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek; and the Israelites encamped by the spring which is in Jezreel.

paite: Philistia makaite azaza in, asangsang in apai ua, David leh amite'n Akish toh anung uh azui uhi.
english: The lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds and by thousands; and David and his men passed on in the rear with Achish.

paite: Philistia makaite'n, "Hiai Hebrute'n bang ahia ahih uh?" achi uhi. Akish in Philistia makai kiang ah, "Hiai David Israelte kumpipa Saul sikha, hichi tan a ka kiang a om khin a, ka kiang a, ahong lut nung a lah tutan a leng adiklouhna ka muhlouhna pa ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: Then the princes of the Philistines said, “What about these Hebrews?” Achish said to the princes of the Philistines, “Isn’t this David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, who has been with me these days, or rather these years? I have found no fault in him since he fell away until today.”

paite: Himahleh Philistia kumpipate atung ah aheh uhi. Philistia kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Hiai mi na mun sehsak a pai ding in kiksak inla, kidouna ah i kiang uah hong suk kei heh. Huchi lou in zaw kidouna ah i melmate lam ah apang kha ding. Hiai mite lu ding in hiai mipa leh apu kilem nawn ve un teh aw?
english: But the princes of the Philistines were angry with him; and the princes of the Philistines said to him, “Make the man return, that he may go back to his place where you have appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he become an adversary to us. For with what should this fellow reconcile himself to his lord? Should it not be with the heads of these men?

paite: Hiai David mah ahi kei maw, Saul in asang asang athat, David in asing asing, chi a, atungtang thu la a asak uh?" achi uhi.
english: Isn’t this David, of whom people sang to one another in dances, saying, ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands’?”

paite: Huchi in Akish in David asam a, akiang ah, "TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Midik mahmah na hi a, sepaihte lak a ka kiang a na kuan leh na hong leltak ka mitmuh in ahoih mahmah hi. Ka kiang a na hong ni a pan tuni tan in na tung ah bangmah hoihlouhna himhim ka mu het kei hi. Himahleh makaite'n ahon ngai kei uhi.
english: Then Achish called David and said to him, “As Yahweh lives, you have been upright, and your going out and your coming in with me in the army is good in my sight; for I have not found evil in you since the day of your coming to me to this day. Nevertheless, the lords don’t favor you.

paite: Huaiziak in Philistia kumpipate na hihlungkim louhlouhna ding in kik inla, lungkimtak in pai in," achi hi.
english: Therefore now return, and go in peace, that you not displease the lords of the Philistines.”

paite: David in Akish kiang ah, "Ahihleh, bang thil ahia ka na hih? Na kiang a ka om sung teng tuni tan in, ka toupa kumpipa melma dou lou a ka kik nawn maimah ding, na sikha tung ah bang mu na hia oi?" achi hi.
english: David said to Achish, “But what have I done? What have you found in your servant so long as I have been before you to this day, that I may not go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?”

paite: Akish in adawng a, David kiang ah, "Ka mitmuh in Pathian angel bang in na hoih chih ka thei hi. Himahleh Philistia kumpipate'n, kidouna ah i kiang ah ahong sam kei ding, achi bikbek mawk uhi.
english: Achish answered David, “I know that you are good in my sight, as an angel of God. Notwithstanding, the princes of the Philistines have said, ‘He shall not go up with us to the battle.’

paite: Huaiziak in na kiang a om na pu sikhate toh zingkhang in thou unla, zingkhang a na thoh phet ua khua avak chiang in pai un," achi hi.
english: Therefore now rise up early in the morning with the servants of your lord who have come with you; and as soon as you are up early in the morning and have light, depart.”

paite: Huchi in David leh amite Philistia gam a kik nawn ding a zingsang a pawtkhe ding in athouta uh. Jezreel ah Philistia mite ahohtou uhi.
english: So David rose up early, he and his men, to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines; and the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

paite: Huan naupang Samuel in Eli ma ah TOUPA nna asem hi. Huai lai in TOUPA thu tung avang mahmah a; alangtang a kilaknate a-om kei hi.
english: The child Samuel ministered to Yahweh before Eli. Yahweh’s word was rare in those days. There were not many visions, then.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai lai in, Eli amun a alup lai in, amit amial panta a, khua agina muhthei nawn ngel kei hi.
english: At that time, when Eli was laid down in his place (now his eyes had begun to grow dim, so that he could not see),

paite: Pathian khawnvak amih ma in, Pathian bawm omna TOUPA tempul ah Samuel ihmu ding in alumta hi.
english: and God’s lamp hadn’t yet gone out, and Samuel had laid down in Yahweh’s temple where God’s ark was,

paite: "TOUPA'N Samuel asam a," ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh called Samuel. He said, “Here I am.”

paite: Eli kiang ah ava tai a, akiang ah, "Hiai ah ka om, na hon sam a,” achi hi. Ama'n, "K'on sam kei; va lum nawn in," achi hi. Huchi in apai a, ava lum nawn hi.
english: He ran to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” He said, “I didn’t call. Lie down again.” He went and lay down.

paite: TOUPA'N Samuel asam nawn hi. Samuel athou a, Eli kiang ah ahoh a, "Hiai ah ka om, na hon sam a,” achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "K'on sam kei, ka tapa, va lum nawn in,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh called yet again, “Samuel!” Samuel arose and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” He answered, “I didn’t call, my son. Lie down again.”

paite: Huai lai in Samuel in TOUPA athei nai kei a, TOUPA thu leng akiang a kilaksak ahi nai kei hi.
english: Now Samuel didn’t yet know Yahweh, neither was Yahweh’s word yet revealed to him.

paite: TOUPA'N Samuel asam nawn a, huai athumveina ahita. Amah athou a, Eli kiang ah ahoh a, "Hiai ah ka om, na hon sam a," achi hi. Huchi in Eli in naupang TOUPA'N sam ahi chih atheita hi.
english: Yahweh called Samuel again the third time. He arose and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” Eli perceived that Yahweh had called the child.

paite: Huaiziak in Eli in Samuel kiang ah, "Pai inla, va lum nawn inla, ahon sap nawnleh, TOUPA, thu gen in, na sikha in angaikhia, na chi ding," achi hi. Huchi in Samuel apaita a, amun ah ava lum nawn hi.
english: Therefore Eli said to Samuel, “Go, lie down. It shall be, if he calls you, that you shall say, ‘Speak, Yahweh; for your servant hears.’” So Samuel went and lay down in his place.

paite: TOUPA ahong pai a, hong dingh in, ama a asap bang in, "Samuel, Samuel," achi hi. Huchi in Samuel in, "Thu gen in, na sikha in angaikhia hi," achi hi.
english: Yahweh came, and stood, and called as at other times, “Samuel! Samuel!” Then Samuel said, “Speak; for your servant hears.”

paite: TOUPA'N Samuel kiang ah, "Ngai in, Israel gam ah aza peuhmahte bil langnih a aphuaitak in thil khat ka hih ding hi.
english: Yahweh said to Samuel, “Behold, I will do a thing in Israel at which both the ears of everyone who hears it will tingle.

paite: Huai ni in a-inkuan tungtang thu ka gen tengteng abul a pan atawp tan in Eli tung ah ka hih ding ahi.
english: In that day I will perform against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, from the beginning even to the end.

paite: Atapate'n Pathian agensiatna khelhna uh theigige napi a, akham louh ziak in a-inkuan tangtawn a ding in ka hawmsak ding hi, chih ka hilh khinta ngal a.
english: For I have told him that I will judge his house forever for the iniquity which he knew, because his sons brought a curse on themselves, and he didn’t restrain them.

paite: Huaiziak in Eli inkuan kiang ah Eli inkuan bohsiatna kithoihna in hiam, thillat in hiam, chikchiang in leng siansak theih ahi kei ding, chi in ka kichiam khinta hi," achi hi.
english: Therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli that the iniquity of Eli’s house shall not be removed with sacrifice or offering forever.”

paite: Zingsang tan in Samuel alum a, TOUPA' inn kongkhakte ahong hi. Samuel in huai kilakna Eli theihsak alau hi.
english: Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of Yahweh’s house. Samuel was afraid to show Eli the vision.

paite: Huchi in Eli in Samuel asam a, "Samuel, ka tapa," achi hi. Ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om," achi hi.
english: Then Eli called Samuel and said, “Samuel, my son!” He said, “Here I am.”

paite: Ama'n, "Bang thil ahia TOUPA'N na kiang a agen? Ka kiang ah bangmah iim ke'n aw. Na kiang a agen tengteng ka kiang a iim na neihleh na tung ah Pathian in ahihhih in hih henla, huai sang a thupizaw in leng," achi hi.
english: He said, “What is the thing that he has spoken to you? Please don’t hide it from me. God do so to you, and more also, if you hide anything from me of all the things that he spoke to you.”

paite: Samuel in thil tengteng ahilh sipsip a, akiang ah bangmah iim anei kei. Huchi in ama'n, "TOUPA thuthu ahi mah ve, hoih asak bang in hih hen aw," achi hi.
english: Samuel told him every bit, and hid nothing from him. He said, “It is Yahweh. Let him do what seems good to him.”

paite: Samuel ahong khanglian deuhdeuh a, akiang ah TOUPA a-om a, athu himhim lei lak ah akesak kei hi.
english: Samuel grew, and Yahweh was with him and let none of his words fall to the ground.

paite: Huchi in Dan a pan Beer-sheba tan in Israel mi tengteng in TOUPA zawlnei dia Samuel hihkip ahi, chih ana theita uhi.
english: All Israel from Dan even to Beersheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of Yahweh.

paite: Shiloh ah TOUPA akilak nawn a; TOUPA thu in Samuel kiang ah Shiloh a kilak lah ahi ngal a.
english: Yahweh appeared again in Shiloh; for Yahweh revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by Yahweh’s word.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani thum ni a David leh amite Ziklag atun un, Amalekte'n simlam leh Ziklag khua ana sim khin uh. Ziklag khua ana sual ua, mei in ana hal uhi.
english: When David and his men had come to Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had made a raid on the South and on Ziklag, and had struck Ziklag and burned it with fire,

paite: Numeite leh khua a om peuhmah aneu-alian sal in aman ua, kuamah that lou a pi in apaipih khinta uhi.
english: and had taken captive the women and all who were in it, both small and great. They didn’t kill any, but carried them off and went their way.

paite: David leh amite khua ava tun un, ngai in, ana kangsiang khinta hi. Azite, atapate leh atanute uh sal in ana man khinta uhi.
english: When David and his men came to the city, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, their sons, and their daughters were taken captive.

paite: David leh akiang a omte'n aw suah in kah leng kap zou nawn lou khop in akap uhi.
english: Then David and the people who were with him lifted up their voice and wept until they had no more power to weep.

paite: David zite nih: Jezreel mi Ahinoam leh Karmel mi Nabal zi Abigail leng sal a pi in a-om uhi.
english: David’s two wives were taken captive, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

paite: Michih atapate uh leh atánute uh ziak a lungkham in amah suang a den ding thu agen ziak un, David alungzing mahmah hi. Himahleh David bel. TOUPA a Pathian ah akihihhat hi.
english: David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because the souls of all the people were grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters; but David strengthened himself in Yahweh his God.

paite: David in Ahimelek tapa siampu Abiathar kiang ah, "Siampu puanak hon va laksak dih ve," achi hi. Abiathar in David siampu puanak ava laksak hi.
english: David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, “Please bring the ephod here to me.” Abiathar brought the ephod to David.

paite: David in, "Hiaite delh leng ka pha lai diam?" chi in TOUPA adong hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Delh in, na pha ngeingei ding, na la nawn vek ding," achi hi.
english: David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “If I pursue after this troop, will I overtake them?” He answered him, “Pursue, for you will surely overtake them, and will without fail recover all.”

paite: Huchi in David, amah leh akiang a mi zaguk toh akuankhia a, Besor lui ava tung ua, ami nutsiatte uh huai ah a-om uhi.
english: So David went, he and the six hundred men who were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those who were left behind stayed.

paite: David in adelh zel a, amah leh mi zalite toh, mi zanihte'n abah tak ziak un Besor lui akan zou kei uhi,
english: But David pursued, he and four hundred men; for two hundred stayed behind, who were so faint that they couldn’t go over the brook Besor.

paite: Gamlak ah Aigupta mi amu ua, David kiang ah api ua, tanghou apia ua, ama'n ane a, tui adawnsak uhi.
english: They found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he ate; and they gave him water to drink.

paite: Theipi beu them khat leh grep gah phoukeu bawm nih apia uhi. Hiaite anekleh ahong halh nawn a; ni thum leh zan thum an ne lou leh tui dawn lou lah ahita ngal a.
english: They gave him a piece of a cake of figs and two clusters of raisins. When he had eaten, his spirit came again to him; for he had eaten no bread, and drank no water for three days and three nights.

paite: David in akiang ah, "Kua na hia? Koi a kipan a hong na hia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Aigupta gam tangval, Amalek mi sikha ka hi. Ni thum ahita a, ka chi anat ziak in ka pu in hon nusia maimah hi.
english: David asked him, “To whom do you belong? Where are you from?” He said, “I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days ago I got sick.

paite: Kereth sim gam leh Judah sim gamte ka sim ua, Kaleb sim gam leng ka sim ua, huchi in Ziklag khua leng ka hal uh," achi hi.
english: We made a raid on the South of the Cherethites, and on that which belongs to Judah, and on the South of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.”

paite: David in akiang ah, "Huaite omna ah na hon pisuk thei diam?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Hon that lou ding leh ka pu khut a hon pe nawn lou ding in Pathian min lou in ka kiang ah kichiam inla, huchi in huaite omna ah ka hon pisuk ding," achi hi.
english: David said to him, “Will you bring me down to this troop?” He said, “Swear to me by God that you will not kill me and not deliver me up into the hands of my master, and I will bring you down to this troop.”

paite: Apisukleh, ngai in, Philistia gam leh Judah gam a gallak tampi alak ziak un ankuang alui ua, ane un adawn ua mun teng ah ana om dalh phengphung uhi.
english: When he had brought him down, behold, they were spread around over all the ground, eating, drinking, and dancing, because of all the great plunder that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.

paite: Huchi in David in nitum a pan zingsang nitaklam tan in amau asual hi. Tangval zali sangawngsau tung a tuang a taikekte kia lou ngal kuamah dam a suakta himhim a-om kei uh.
english: David struck them from the twilight even to the evening of the next day. Not a man of them escaped from there, except four hundred young men who rode on camels and fled.

paite: David in Amalek mite puakmang tengteng ala nawn vek a, David in azi nihte leng ahunkheta hi.
english: David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken, and David rescued his two wives.

paite: Huchi in aneu-alian in, atapate uh, atanute uh, agallak uh leh athil lak himhim bangmah tan anei kei ua, David in alaksak nawn vek hi.
english: There was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither plunder, nor anything that they had taken. David brought them all back.

paite: David in belamhon leh ganhon tengteng ala a, gan dangte ma ah ahawl ua, "Hiaite David gallak ahi," achi uhi.
english: David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drove before those other livestock, and said, “This is David’s plunder.”

paite: Mi zanih abah ziak ua David zuizou nawn lou a Besor lui a a-omsakte uh kiang ah David ava tung hi. Amau David dawn ding leh akiang a omte dawn ding in apawtkhia uh. Mite kiang atun in David in amaute chibai abuk hi.
english: David came to the two hundred men, who were so faint that they could not follow David, whom also they had made to stay at the brook Besor; and they went out to meet David, and to meet the people who were with him. When David came near to the people, he greeted them.

paite: David kiang a hohte lak a migiloute leh Belial mi teng in adawng ua, "I kiang ua ahong tel louh ziak un gallak thil i va lak nawn himhimte amau i pe kei ding uh. Api ua apaitheihna ding un azite chiat uh leh atate chiat uh ahihleh api uh i phal ding uh, achi uhi.
english: Then all the wicked men and worthless fellows of those who went with David answered and said, “Because they didn’t go with us, we will not give them anything of the plunder that we have recovered, except to every man his wife and his children, that he may lead them away and depart.”

paite: David in, "Unaute aw, TOUPA eite hon kembitpa'n ahon piakleh eite dou dia hong kuante i khut ua hon pepa thilte huchi in hih kei un.
english: Then David said, “Do not do so, my brothers, with that which Yahweh has given to us, who has preserved us, and delivered the troop that came against us into our hand.

paite: Kua'n ahia hiai thu a na thu uh zui ding? Kidouna a hohte tan bangmah van veng a na omte'n leng atan sam ding uh ahi; kibang vek a tan ding ahi," achi hi.
english: Who will listen to you in this matter? For as his share is who goes down to the battle, so shall his share be who stays with the baggage. They shall share alike.”

paite: Huai ni a pan tuni tan in Israelte a dia thupiak leh dan thuseh ding in abawlta hi.
english: It was so from that day forward that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day.

paite: David, Ziklag khua atun in, gallak khenkhat, hiai, TOUPA melmate lak a gallak, nang a dia thilpiak, chi in Judah upate, alawmte ngei kiang ah, gallak khenkhat akhak hi.
english: When David came to Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, “Behold, a present for you from the plunder of Yahweh’s enemies.”

paite: Bethel a omte kiang ah, Ramoth sim a omte kiang ah, Jattir a omte kiang ah,
english: He sent it to those who were in Bethel, to those who were in Ramoth of the South, to those who were in Jattir,

paite: Aroer a omte kiang ah, Siphmoth a omte kiang ah, Eshtemoa a omte kiang ah;
english: to those who were in Aroer, to those who were in Siphmoth, to those who were in Eshtemoa,

paite: Rakal a omte kiang ah, Jerahmeel a omte kiang ah, Kente a omte kiang ah;
english: to those who were in Racal, to those who were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, to those who were in the cities of the Kenites,

paite: Hormah a omte kiang ah, Bor-ashan a omte kiang ah, Athak a omte kiang ah;
english: to those who were in Hormah, to those who were in Borashan, to those who were in Athach,

paite: Hebron a omte kiang ah, David leh amite tatna mun tengteng kiang ah.
english: to those who were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men used to stay.

paite: Huan Philistia mite'n Israelte asual ua; Philistia mite a pan Israelte ataikek ua, Gilboa tang ah thah in a-om zelzul uhi.
english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

paite: Philistia mite'n Saul leh atapa adelhzui vengveng uh. Philistia mite'n Saul tapate: Jonathan, Abinadab leh Melkishua athat uhi.
english: The Philistines overtook Saul and his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

paite: Saul anak sual mahmah ua, thalkap mite'n akapkhata ua, thalkap mite'n nasatak in akapliam uhi.
english: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was greatly distressed by reason of the archers.

paite: Huchi in Saul in agalvan tawipa kiang ah, "Na namsau dok inla, hon sun pailet in. Huchi lou in zaw hiai zeksumlouhte ahong pai ding ua, hong sun pailet ding ua, hon bawlse kha ding uh," achi hi. Himahleh agalvan tawipa'n ahih ut kei; alau mahmah ngal a. Huaiziak in Saul in anamsau ala a, abohkhumta hi.
english: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through and abuse me!” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.

paite: Agalvan tawipa'n Saul asi chih atheih in ama'n leng anamsau abohkhum samta a, asikhawmta uh.
english: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword, and died with him.

paite: Huchi in Saul, atapa thumte, agalvan tawipa leh ami tengteng huai ni mah in asikhawm vek uhi.
english: So Saul died with his three sons, his armor bearer, and all his men that same day together.

paite: Guam gal khat lam a Israel mi omte leh Jordan gal a omte'n Israel mite ataikek uh, chih leh Saul leh atapate asi uh chih atheih un khuate apawtkhiaksan ua, ataimangta uhi. Huchi in Philistia mite'n ava luahta uhi.
english: When the men of Israel who were on the other side of the valley, and those who were beyond the Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned the cities and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, azingsang in Philistiate agalthahte uh puansilh suahsak ding a ava pai uleh Saul leh atapate thum Gilboa tang a si ava mu uhi.
english: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

paite: Alu atan ua, agalvan asuahkhiaksak ua, mite kiang leh amilimte inn a suah ding in akim ua Philistia mite gam teng ah akhak uhi.
english: They cut off his head, stripped off his armor, and sent into the land of the Philistines all around, to carry the news to the house of their idols and to the people.

paite: Ashtaroth inn ah agalvan akoih ua; Beth-shan kulhbaang ah aluang atak uhi.
english: They put his armor in the house of the Ashtaroth, and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.

paite: Jabesh-Gilead a omte'n Philistia mite'n Saul abawldan thu ana zak un,
english: When the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,

paite: mihangsan tengteng athou ua, zankhua in apai ua, Saul luang leh atapate luang Beth-shan kulhbaang a pan alakhia uh. Jabesh atung ua, huai ah ahal uhi.
english: all the valiant men arose, went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth Shan; and they came to Jabesh and burned them there.

paite: Aguhte ala ua, Jabesh a sing nuai ah avui ua, ni sagih sung an angawl uhi.
english: They took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

paite: Huan Samuel thu Israel mi tengteng lak ah athangkheta hi. Israel mite Philistia mite dou ding in akuankhia uhi. Ebenezer kiang ah panmun akhoh ua, Philistia mite'n Aphek ah panmun akhoh uhi.
english: The word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and encamped beside Ebenezer; and the Philistines encamped in Aphek.

paite: Philistia mite Israel mite na dal ding in ana kiphalh uh. Ahong kidou uleh Philistia mite ma ah Israel mite azahlakta ua, kidouna mun ah sepaih sangli vel athat uhi.
english: The Philistines put themselves in array against Israel. When they joined battle, Israel was defeated by the Philistines, who killed about four thousand men of the army in the field.

paite: Mipite agiahmun ua ava pai uleh Israel upate'n, "Bangziak in ahia tuni a TOUPA'N Philistia mite ma a hon zahlaksak mahmah? I kiang ua om a i melmate khut a pan hon hondam ding in Shiloh a pan TOUPA thukhun bawm i va la ding uh," achi uhi.
english: When the people had come into the camp, the elders of Israel said, “Why has Yahweh defeated us today before the Philistines? Let’s get the ark of Yahweh’s covenant out of Shiloh and bring it to us, that it may come among us and save us out of the hand of our enemies.”

paite: Huchi in mipite'n Shiloh ah mi asawl ua, huai a pan cherubim tung a tu sepaihte' TOUPA thukhun bawm ava la ua; huai ah Pathian thukhun bawm toh Eli tapate nih Hophni leh Phinehas a-om uhi.
english: So the people sent to Shiloh, and they brought from there the ark of the covenant of Yahweh of Armies, who sits above the cherubim; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA thukhun bawm agiahmun uh ahong tun in, Israel mi tengteng ngaihtak in akikou zuazua ua, lei nangawn athawn ging zuazua hi.
english: When the ark of Yahweh’s covenant came into the camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth resounded.

paite: Philistia mite'n akikou husa uh azak un, "Hebrute giahmun a kikou husa gingta zuazua mai bang chihna ahia le?" achi uh. Agiahmun uah TOUPA thukhun bawm ahong tung ahi, chih atheita uhi.
english: When the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, “What does the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews mean?” They understood that Yahweh’s ark had come into the camp.

paite: Philistia, "Giahmun ah Pathian ahong hi," achih ziak un mite'n alau uhi. "I tung agik hi! Tuma lam in huchibang a-om ngei ngal kei a, achi uhi.
english: The Philistines were afraid, for they said, “God has come into the camp.” They said, “Woe to us! For there has not been such a thing before.

paite: I tung agik hi! Huai Pathiante khut hattak a pan kua'n ahia hon hondam ding? Huai Pathiante ahi, Aigupta mite gamdai a hipi chiteng a that.
english: Woe to us! Who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty gods? These are the gods that struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness.

paite: Aw, nou Philistia mite aw, nou sikha ua a-om bang ua nou Hebrute sikha a na omlouhna ding un hattak in om unla, kipasalsak un. Kipasalsak unla sual un," achi uhi.
english: Be strong and behave like men, O you Philistines, that you not be servants to the Hebrews, as they have been to you. Strengthen yourselves like men, and fight!”

paite: Huchi in Philistia mite'n asual ua, Israel mite azahlaksak ua, michih apuanin lam chiat uah ataikek uh. Anak thah mahmah ua, Israelte sepaih singthum asi uhi.
english: The Philistines fought, and Israel was defeated, and each man fled to his tent. There was a very great slaughter; for thirty thousand footmen of Israel fell.

paite: Pathian bawm alaksak ua, Eli tapa nih, Hophni leh Phinehas leng athat uhi.
english: God’s ark was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.

paite: Sepaih lak a Benjamin suan mi khat atai a, apuan khawng kikek nengnung in leh alu a lei kai niaunuau in huai ni mahmah in Shiloh ava tung hi.
english: A man of Benjamin ran out of the army and came to Shiloh the same day, with his clothes torn and with dirt on his head.

paite: Ahong tun in, ngai in, Eli in lampi gei a tutna a tu kawm in ana en nilouh a, Pathian bawm ziak in alungtang aling ngal a. Mipa'n khua atun a tanchin agenleh akhomi teng akapkhia uhi.
english: When he came, behold, Eli was sitting on his seat by the road watching, for his heart trembled for God’s ark. When the man came into the city and told about it, all the city cried out.

paite: Eli in akikou husa uh azak in, "Tua thawm ging vengvung bang chihna ahia?" achi hi. Mi khat kintak in ava hoh a, Eli ava hilh hi.
english: When Eli heard the noise of the crying, he said, “What does the noise of this tumult mean?” The man hurried, and came and told Eli.

paite: Eli bel kum sawmkua-le-giat a upa ahi a, amit amialta a, khua amu thei nawn kei.
english: Now Eli was ninety-eight years old. His eyes were set, so that he could not see.

paite: Huai mipa'n Eli kiang ah, "Sepaih lak a pan hong paikhia ka hi. Tuni a sepaih lak a pan hong taikhia ka hi," achi hi. Ama'n, "Ka tapa, bangchibang in thil a-om a oi?" achi hi.
english: The man said to Eli, “I am he who came out of the army, and I fled today out of the army.” He said, “How did the matter go, my son?”

paite: Tanchin hon tunpa'n adawng a, "Israel mite Philistia mite ma ah ataikek ua, mipi lak ah kithahna thupitak a-om lai a, na tapate nih Hophni leh Phinehas leng asi ua, Pathian bawm leng alaksak uh," achi hi.
english: He who brought the news answered, “Israel has fled before the Philistines, and there has been also a great slaughter among the people. Your two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and God’s ark has been captured.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian bawm thu agentak in kongpi bul a tutphah a pan athalpuk a, amah tekta a kikhouh zou nawn lou ahih ziak in, angawng akitan a, asita hi. Israel tung ah kum sawmli sung vai ahawm hi.
english: When he made mention of God’s ark, Eli fell from off his seat backward by the side of the gate; and his neck broke, and he died, for he was an old man and heavy. He had judged Israel forty years.

paite: Amounu, Phinehas zi in nau apai a, neih ahun mahmahta hi. Ama'n Pathian bawm laksak ahih thu leh apu leh apasal si uh ahi chih azak in akunsuk a, nauvei nat in apha a, ta aneita hi.
english: His daughter-in-law, Phinehas’ wife, was with child, near to giving birth. When she heard the news that God’s ark was taken and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and gave birth; for her pains came on her.

paite: Asih dek lai in akiang a dingh numeite'n akiang ah, "Lau ke'n, tapa na neita," achi uhi. Himahleh adawng het kei a, alimsak sam kei hi.
english: About the time of her death the women who stood by her said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for you have given birth to a son.” But she didn’t answer, neither did she regard it.

paite: "Thupina in Israel apawtsanta," chi in nau min Ikabod asa hi. Pathian bawm lah alaksakta ua, apa leh apasal lah asita ngal ua.
english: She named the child Ichabod, saying, “The glory has departed from Israel!” because God’s ark was taken, and because of her father-in-law and her husband.

paite: "Thupina in Israel apawtsanta, Pathian bawm lah alaksakta ngal ua," achi hi.
english: She said, “The glory has departed from Israel; for God’s ark has been taken.”

paite: Huan Philistia mite'n Pathian bawm ala ua, Ebenezer a pan Ashdod ah apaipih uhi.
english: Now the Philistines had taken God’s ark, and they brought it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.

paite: Philistia mite'n Pathian bawm ala ua, Dagon inn ah alalut ua, Dagon kiang ah akoih uhi.
english: The Philistines took God’s ark, and brought it into the house of Dagon and set it by Dagon.

paite: Ashdod khomite zingkhangpi a athoh uleh, ngai in, TOUPA bawm ma ah Dagon amai a lei si in ana puk vialvual mawk hi. Dagon ala ua, a-omna mun ah akoih nawn uhi.
english: When the people of Ashdod arose early on the next day, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before Yahweh’s ark. They took Dagon and set him in his place again.

paite: Azing nawn zingkhangpi a athoh uleh, ngai in, TOUPA bawm ma ah Dagon amai a lei si in ana puk vialvual mawk a; Dagon lu leh akhutpek bawm langnih kitankhia kongpi bul ah ana kikham hi.
english: When they arose early on the following morning, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before Yahweh’s ark; and the head of Dagon and both the palms of his hands were cut off on the threshold. Only Dagon’s torso was intact.

paite: Huaiziak in Dagon siampu hiam, Dagon inn a hong paite'n leng Ashdod a Dagon inn bul tuni tan in asik ngam kei uhi.
english: Therefore neither the priests of Dagon nor any who come into Dagon’s house step on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod to this day.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA khut Ashdod khua mite tung ah agik a, amaute ahihsia a, Ashdod khua leh akiang vel a omte zaangtan hipi in agawtta hi.
english: But Yahweh’s hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod, and he destroyed them and struck them with tumors, even Ashdod and its borders.

paite: Huchi in Ashdod a mite'n huchibang thil tung amuh un, "Israelte' Pathian bawm i kiang uah om gige kei hen, eimah leh i pathian Dagon tung ah akhut khak ana tel mai," achi uhi.
english: When the men of Ashdod saw that it was so, they said, “The ark of the God of Israel shall not stay with us, for his hand is severe on us and on Dagon our god.”

paite: Huaiziak in Philistia hausa tengteng akiang uah asamkhawm ua, "Israelte' Pathian bawm bang i lohta dia?" achi uh. Amau, "Israelte' Pathian bawm Gath ah puak hi hen," chi in adawng uhi. Huchi in Gath ah Israelte' Pathian bawm apaipihta uhi.
english: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and said, “What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel?” They answered, “Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried over to Gath.” They carried the ark of the God of Israel there.

paite: Hichi ahong hi a, apaipih lai un TOUPA khut in huai khua ahihseta hi. Kho mite aneu leh alian agawt vek a, atung uah zaangtan hipi alengsak hi.
english: It was so, that after they had carried it there, Yahweh’s hand was against the city with a very great confusion; and he struck the men of the city, both small and great, so that tumors broke out on them.

paite: Huchi in Pathian bawm Ekron ah atun ua, Ekron khomite'n Israelte Pathian bawm eite leh i mite that ding in i kiang ahon tunta uh, chi in akikou vengvung uhi.
english: So they sent God’s ark to Ekron. As God’s ark came to Ekron, the Ekronites cried out, saying, “They have brought the ark of the God of Israel here to us, to kill us and our people.”

paite: Huchi in Philistia hausa tengteng asamkhawm ua, "Israelte' Pathian bawm paimangsak unla, koute leh ka mite ahon thahlouhna ding in a-omna mun ngei ah pai nawn hen," achi uh. Kho pumpi ah sihna khop siatna a-om a; Pathian khut lah huai khua ah agik mahmah ngal a.
english: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and they said, “Send the ark of the God of Israel away, and let it go again to its own place, that it not kill us and our people.” For there was a deadly panic throughout all the city. The hand of God was very heavy there.

paite: Asiloute'n zaangtan avei chiat ua, van ah huai kho kikou husa atungtou hi.
english: The men who didn’t die were struck with the tumors; and the cry of the city went up to heaven.

paite: Huan TOUPA bawm Philistia mite gam ah kha sagih sung a-om hi.
english: Yahweh’s ark was in the country of the Philistines seven months.

paite: Philistia mite'n, "TOUPA bawm bang i loh ding ua? A-omna ngei mah apaisak nawndan hon hilh dih ve ua," chi in asiampute leh aisan siamte asam uhi.
english: The Philistines called for the priests and the diviners, saying, “What shall we do with Yahweh’s ark? Show us how we should send it to its place.”

paite: Amau, "Israelte' Pathian bawm na paisak ding uleh leng avuak in paisak het kei un. Akiang ah tatlek kithoihna lan ngeingei un. Huchi in hihdam in na om ding uh. Huchi in bangziak a akhut nou a pan lakkhiak a om lou ahia chih na thei ding uh," achi uhi.
english: They said, “If you send away the ark of the God of Israel, don’t send it empty; but by all means return a trespass offering to him. Then you will be healed, and it will be known to you why his hand is not removed from you.”

paite: Huchi in amau, "Akiang a ka tatlekna thillat ding bang ahia?" achi uh. Amau, "Philistia hausate zah dangka-eng zaangtan lim nga leh dangka-eng sansim lim nga; na vek ua tung leh na hausate uh tung a leng hipi lah khat ahi ngal a.
english: Then they said, “What should the trespass offering be which we shall return to him?” They said, “Five golden tumors and five golden mice, for the number of the lords of the Philistines; for one plague was on you all, and on your lords.

paite: Huaiziak in na zaangtan lim uh leh na gam uh hihsetu sansim limte bawl un. Israelte' Pathian thupina pia un, huchi in akhut na tung uah, na pathiante uleh na gam uh tung ah azangsak nuam khamoh kei ding," achi uhi.
english: Therefore you shall make images of your tumors and images of your mice that mar the land; and you shall give glory to the God of Israel. Perhaps he will release his hand from you, from your gods, and from your land.

paite: Aigupta mite leh Pharaoh in lungsim akhauhsak bang un bangziak a na lungtang uh khauhsak na hi ua? Alak ua thillamdang ahih in mite paisak in apawtkhesak uh, hilou maw?
english: Why then do you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? When he had worked wonderfully among them, didn’t they let the people go, and they departed?

paite: Huaiziak in tu in kangtalai thak sutuah unla, bawngpi nih anawi suk lai, hakkol po ngei lou toh; huai bawngpite kangtalai ah khih unla, anoute uh amau a pan inn ah hon pi un.
english: “Now therefore take and prepare yourselves a new cart and two milk cows on which there has come no yoke; and tie the cows to the cart, and bring their calves home from them;

paite: TOUPA bawm la unla, kangtalai ah koih unla; tatlek thoihna dia na lat uh dangka-eng thil pen singlem ah thun in asik a koih in, paisak unla, khah un.
english: and take Yahweh’s ark and lay it on the cart. Put the jewels of gold, which you return him for a trespass offering, in a box by its side; and send it away, that it may go.

paite: Huchi in gamgi lam pang lampi tawn in Beth-shemesh ah apai hiam en un, apaileh i tung ua thil hoih loutak amah hih ana hi dia; apai keileh ei hon gawtpa amah khut ana hi kei chih i thei ding ua, i tung ua hong om himhim lel ahi ding, achi uhi.
english: Behold, if it goes up by the way of its own border to Beth Shemesh, then he has done us this great evil; but if not, then we shall know that it is not his hand that struck us. It was a chance that happened to us.”

paite: Mite'n huchibang in ahih ua; bawngpi anawi suk lai nih api ua, kangtalai ah akhih ua, anoute uh bel inn lam ah akhum uhi.
english: The men did so, and took two milk cows and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home.

paite: Sansim lim dangka-eng leh zaangtan lim koihna singlem toh kangtalai ah TOUPA bawm akoih uhi.
english: They put Yahweh’s ark on the cart, and the box with the golden mice and the images of their tumors.

paite: Bawngpite'n Beth-shemesh lam zuan in lampi azui vengveng ua; huchi in ham kawmkawm in lampi azui ua, taklam ah hiam, veilam ah hiam apial het kei uh. Philistia hausate'n Beth-shemesh gamgi pha in azui uhi.
english: The cows took the straight way by the way to Beth Shemesh. They went along the highway, lowing as they went, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left; and the lords of the Philistines went after them to the border of Beth Shemesh.

paite: Beth-shemesh khomite'n phaizang ah buh ana la ua, adaktou ua, bawm amu ua, akipahpih mahmah uhi.
english: The people of Beth Shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley; and they lifted up their eyes and saw the ark, and rejoiced to see it.

paite: Huai kangtalai Beth-shemesh a mi Joshua lou ah alut a, suangpi lian mahmah omna tak ah akhawita hi. Kangtalai sing a-ek ua, TOUPA kiang ah bawngpite halmang thillat in alan uhi.
english: The cart came into the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh, and stood there, where there was a great stone. Then they split the wood of the cart and offered up the cows for a burnt offering to Yahweh.

paite: Levi chite'n TOUPA bawm dangka-eng thil omna singlem toh alakhia ua, suangpi tung ah akoih uhi. Beth-shemesh khomite'n huai ni mah in halmang thillatte leh kithoihnate TOUPA kiang ah alan uhi.
english: The Levites took down Yahweh’s ark and the box that was with it, in which the jewels of gold were, and put them on the great stone; and the men of Beth Shemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day to Yahweh.

paite: Huai Philistia hausa ngate'n amuh nung un, huai ni mahmah in Ekron kholam ah apai nawnta uhi.
english: When the five lords of the Philistines had seen it, they returned to Ekron the same day.

paite: Philistia mite'n dangka-eng zaangtan lim TOUPA kiang a tatlek thoihna dia alat uh, Ashdod kho tuam a ding in khat, Gaza kho tuam a ding in khat, Ashkelon kho tuam a ding in khat, Gath kho tuam a ding in khat, Ekron kho tuam a ding in khat ahi.
english: These are the golden tumors which the Philistines returned for a trespass offering to Yahweh: for Ashdod one, for Gaza one, for Ashkelon one, for Gath one, for Ekron one;

paite: Dangka-eng sansim lim ahihleh kho tengteng kulh nei khua leh singtang lam khua leng sim vek a hausa ngate a Philistia mite kho zah ahi. TOUPA bawm angakna suangpi mahmah uh Beth-shemesh khomi Joshua lou ah tuni tan in a-om nilouh lai hi.
english: and the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both of fortified cities and of country villages, even to the great stone on which they set down Yahweh’s ark. That stone remains to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh.

paite: TOUPA bawm sung a-et ziak un Beth-shemesh khomite ama'n agawt a, alak ua mi sangnga-le-sawmsagih tak athat hi. TOUPA'N anak thah ziak in mite'n asuun uhi.
english: He struck of the men of Beth Shemesh, because they had looked into Yahweh’s ark, he struck fifty thousand seventy of the men. Then the people mourned, because Yahweh had struck the people with a great slaughter.

paite: Beth-shemesh khomite'n, hiai Pathian siangthou TOUPA ma ah kua adingh thei in ei a pan kua kiang ah ahia apaitouh ding? achi uh.
english: The men of Beth Shemesh said, “Who is able to stand before Yahweh, this holy God? To whom shall he go up from us?”

paite: Huchi in Kiriath-jearim khomite kiang ah, "Philistia mite'n TOUPA bawm ahong koih nawn ua, hong suk unla na kiang uah latou dih ua," chi a hilh ding in thupo mite asawlta uhi.
english: They sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath Jearim, saying, “The Philistines have brought back Yahweh’s ark. Come down and bring it up to yourselves.”

paite: Huchi in Kiriath-jearim a mite ahohsuk ua, TOUPA bawm alatou ua; mual a Abinadab inn ah alalut ua, atapa Eleazar TOUPA bawm kemtu in aseptuam uhi.
english: The men of Kiriath Jearim came and took Yahweh’s ark, and brought it into Abinadab’s house on the hill, and consecrated Eleazar his son to keep Yahweh’s ark.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Kiriath- jearim a bawm a-om sung sawtpi, kum sawmnihtak ahi. Huchi in Israel inkuan tengteng in TOUPA alungzuan nawnta uhi.
english: From the day that the ark stayed in Kiriath Jearim, the time was long—for it was twenty years; and all the house of Israel lamented after Yahweh.

paite: Samuel in Israel inkuan tengteng kiang ah, "Na lungtang tengteng uh toh TOUPA lam hong nga na hih taktak uleh, gamdang pathiante leh Ashtaroth na lak ua kipan koihmang unla, na lungtang uh TOUPA a ding in kisakholsak un. Amah kia nna sem un; huchi in Philistia mite khut a pan nou ahon tankhe ding hi," chi in agen hi.
english: Samuel spoke to all the house of Israel, saying, “If you are returning to Yahweh with all your heart, then put away the foreign gods and the Ashtaroth from among you, and direct your hearts to Yahweh, and serve him only; and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines.”

paite: Huchi in Israel mite'n Baal leh Ashtaroth akoihmang ua, TOUPA nna kia asemta uhi.
english: Then the children of Israel removed the Baals and the Ashtaroth, and served Yahweh only.

paite: Samuel in, "Israel mi tengteng Mizpah ah samkhawm vek unla, TOUPA kiang ah ka hon thumsak ding," achi hi.
english: Samuel said, “Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray to Yahweh for you.”

paite: Huchi in Mizpah ah apaikhawm ua, tui atawi ua, TOUPA ma ah asungbua uh. Huai ni in an angawl ua, huai ah TOUPA tung ah i na khialta uh, achi uhi. Samuel in Mizpah ah Israel mite vai ahawmsak hi.
english: They gathered together to Mizpah, and drew water, and poured it out before Yahweh, and fasted on that day, and said there, “We have sinned against Yahweh.” Samuel judged the children of Israel in Mizpah.

paite: Philistia mite'n Israel mite Mizpah ah a-omkhawm uh chih azak un, Israel mite sual ding in Philistia hausate akisatou ua, Israel mite'n huai ana zak un Philistia mite alauta uhi.
english: When the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together at Mizpah, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. When the children of Israel heard it, they were afraid of the Philistines.

paite: Huchi in Israel mite'n Samuel kiang ah, "Philistia mite khut a pan hon hondam dia TOUPA i Pathian na hon sapsak tawp ke'n," achi uh.
english: The children of Israel said to Samuel, “Don’t stop crying to Yahweh our God for us, that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines.”

paite: Samuel in belamnou nawi ne lai ala a, halmang thillat in TOUPA kiang ah alan hi. Israel mite a ding in Samuel in TOUPA asam a, TOUPA'N adawng hi.
english: Samuel took a suckling lamb, and offered it for a whole burnt offering to Yahweh. Samuel cried to Yahweh for Israel, and Yahweh answered him.

paite: Samuel in halmang thillat alat laitak in Philistia mite'n Israel mite sual ding in ahon naih uhi. Himahleh huai ni in TOUPA'N Philistia mite tung ah ngaihtak in van agingsak a, abuaisakgawp a, Israel mite ma ah zoh in a-om uhi,
english: As Samuel was offering up the burnt offering, the Philistines came near to battle against Israel; but Yahweh thundered with a great thunder on that day on the Philistines and confused them; and they were struck down before Israel.

paite: Mizpah a pan Israel mite apawt ua, Philistia mite adelh ua, Beth-kar nuai atun tan un athat zel uhi.
english: The men of Israel went out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, and struck them until they came under Beth Kar.

paite: Huchi in Samuel in suang ala a, Mizpah leh Shen kikal ah aphut a, "Hiai tan TOUPA'N hon panpih hi," chi in amin "Ebenezer" asa hi.
english: Then Samuel took a stone and set it between Mizpah and Shen, and called its name Ebenezer, saying, “Yahweh helped us until now.”

paite: Huchi in Philistia mite azahlakta ua, Israel gam ah ahoh nawnta kei uh. Huchi in Samuel damsung tengteng TOUPA khut in Philistia mite adou hi.
english: So the Philistines were subdued, and they stopped coming within the border of Israel. Yahweh’s hand was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.

paite: Philistia mite'n Israel mite khua alakte uh Ekron a pan Gath tan in Israel mite ape nawn vek uh. Agam Israel mite'n Philistia mite khut a pan atankheta uhi. Israel mite leh Amor mite kal ah kilemna a-om hi.
english: The cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron even to Gath; and Israel recovered its border out of the hand of the Philistines. There was peace between Israel and the Amorites.

paite: Huchi in adamsung teng Samuel in Israelte vai ahawmsak hi.
english: Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.

paite: Kum teng in Bethel leh Gilgal leh Mizpah aveh zel a; huai mun teng ah Israelte vai ahawmsak hi.
english: He went from year to year in a circuit to Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah; and he judged Israel in all those places.

paite: A-inn omna ahih ziak in Ramah ah apai nawn zelzel hi. Huai ah Israel mite vai ahawmsak hi. Huai ah TOUPA a ding in maitam khat adoh hi.
english: His return was to Ramah, for his house was there, and he judged Israel there; and he built an altar to Yahweh there.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Samuel a-upata a, Israel mite tung a vaihawmmi in atapate abawl hi.
english: When Samuel was old, he made his sons judges over Israel.

paite: Ata masapen min Joel ahi a, azom min Abijah ahi. Amaute Beer-sheba a vaihawmte ahi uh.
english: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel, and the name of his second, Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.

paite: Himahleh atapate'n ama omdan ala kei ua, sum-le-pai adelh ua, golhna ala ua, dik a vaihawmna akaikawi uhi.
english: His sons didn’t walk in his ways, but turned away after dishonest gain, took bribes, and perverted justice.

paite: Huchi in Israel mite upate tengteng akikhawm ua, Ramah ah Samuel kiang ah ahoh uhi.
english: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together and came to Samuel to Ramah.

paite: Akiang ah, "Ngai in, na upa mahmahta a, na tapate'n lah na omdan ala kei hial uh. Namdang tengteng bang a ka tung ua vaihawm ding kumpipa hon bawlsak in," achi uhi.
english: They said to him, “Behold, you are old, and your sons don’t walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.”

paite: Himahleh akiang a, "Ka tung ua vaihawm ding kumpipa hon pia in," achih un Samuel akipaksak kei hi. Huchi in TOUPA kiang ah Samuel athum hi,
english: But the thing displeased Samuel when they said, “Give us a king to judge us.” Samuel prayed to Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N Samuel kiang ah, "Mite'n na kiang a agen tengteng uh ngaikhia in. Nang hon deih lou ahi kei ua, atung ua kumpipa dia kei hon deih lou ahi zaw uhi.
english: Yahweh said to Samuel, “Listen to the voice of the people in all that they tell you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected me as the king over them.

paite: Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhiak ni a pan tutan a athilhihdan tengteng uh, hon lehngatsan a pathian dangte nna ahon sepsan zel uh mah bang in nang tung ah ahih uhi.
english: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even to this day, in that they have forsaken me and served other gods, so they also do to you.

paite: Huaiziak in athu uh ngaikhia in. Himahleh chitaktak in vauhilh inla, atung ua vaihawmmi kumpipa tatdan ding kawkmuh in," achi hi.
english: Now therefore, listen to their voice. However, you shall protest solemnly to them, and shall show them the way of the king who will reign over them.”

paite: Samuel in TOUPA thu tengteng kumpipa ngen mipite ahilh vek hi.
english: Samuel told all Yahweh’s words to the people who asked him for a king.

paite: "Na tung ua vaihawmmi ding kumpipa tatdan hichibang ahi ding. Na tapate uh ala dia, amah mah a ding, sakol kangtalai a ding leh asakol tungtuang mite ding in asep ding. Akhente asakol kangtalai ma ah atai ding uh.
english: He said, “This will be the way of the king who shall reign over you: he will take your sons and appoint them as his servants, for his chariots and to be his horsemen; and they will run before his chariots.

paite: Asepaih sangkhatte heutu ding leh sawmngate heutu ding asep dia; khenkhatte alei let ding, abuh la ding, agalvante bawl ding, akangtalai van bawl ding in azang ding hi.
english: He will appoint them to him for captains of thousands and captains of fifties; and he will assign some to plow his ground and to reap his harvest; and to make his instruments of war and the instruments of his chariots.

paite: Na tanute uh gimlim bawl ding, anhuan ding leh tanghou bawl ding in azang ding hi.
english: He will take your daughters to be perfumers, to be cooks, and to be bakers.

paite: Na lou, na grephuan, olive huan a ahoih tata ahon sut dia, asikhate ape ding hi.
english: He will take your fields, your vineyards, and your olive groves, even your best, and give them to his servants.

paite: Na haichi leh na grephuan a sawm-a-khat ahon laksak dia; asikhate leh heutute ape ding hi.
english: He will take one tenth of your seed and of your vineyards, and give it to his officers and to his servants.

paite: Na sikhapate, na sikhanute, na tangval hoihhoihte leh na bawngte ahon sut dia, anasem ding in azang ding.
english: He will take your male servants, your female servants, your best young men, and your donkeys, and assign them to his own work.

paite: Na belamhon lak a sawm-a-khat ahon laksak dia; nou asikhate na hi ding uh.
english: He will take one tenth of your flocks; and you will be his servants.

paite: Huai hun chiang in na tel ding uh kumpipa ziak in na kapkhe ding uh. Himahleh huai hun chiang in TOUPA'N ahon ngaikhe kei ding," achi hi.
english: You will cry out in that day because of your king whom you will have chosen for yourselves; and Yahweh will not answer you in that day.”

paite: Himahleh mipite'n Samuel thu azui nuam kei uh, "Ahi kei, kumpipa i neih ngeingei ding uh ahi.
english: But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel; and they said, “No, but we will have a king over us,

paite: Huchi in namdang tengteng bang i hong hi dia, i kumpipa'n vai ahon hawmsak dia, i namte pi in galte ahon doupih ding," achi uhi.
english: that we also may be like all the nations; and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.”

paite: Samuel in mipite thugen tengteng aza a, TOUPA bil ah agensawn hi.
english: Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N Samuel kiang ah, "Athu uh la inla, kumpipa bawlsak in," achi hi. Samuel in Israel mite kiang ah, "Michih noumau khua chiat ah paita un," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Samuel, “Listen to their voice, and make them a king.” Samuel said to the men of Israel, “Everyone go to your own city.”

paite: Huan Benjamin gam a Benjamin suan a mi khat mihat leh hangsan mahmah a-om a, amin Kish ahi. Amah Abiel tapa, Zeror tapa, Bekorath tapa, Aphiah tapa ahi.
english: Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name was Kish the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son of Aphiah, the son of a Benjamite, a mighty man of valor.

paite: Ama'n tapa khat anei a, amin Saul ahi. Tangval deihhuaitak ahi a, Israel mite lak ah amah sang a deihhuaizaw himhim a-om kei. Kuamah aliangzang khup leng a-om kei hi.
english: He had a son whose name was Saul, an impressive young man; and there was not among the children of Israel a more handsome person than he. From his shoulders and upward he was taller than any of the people.

paite: Saul pa Kish sabiltungte amang hi. Kish in atapa Saul kiang ah, "Thou inla, sikha khat pi inla sabiltungte va zong dih ve," achi hi.
english: The donkeys of Kish, Saul’s father, were lost. Kish said to Saul his son, “Now take one of the servants with you, and arise, go look for the donkeys.”

paite: Huchi in Ephraim tanggam ah avak a, Shalisha gam ah avak hi. Himahleh amu kei uh. Huchi in Shalim gam ah avak ua, huai ah leng amu kei uh. Benjamin mite gam ah avak nawn ua, himahleh amu tuan kei uhi.
english: He passed through the hill country of Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalishah, but they didn’t find them. Then they passed through the land of Shaalim, and they weren’t there. Then he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they didn’t find them.

paite: Zuph gam atun un Saul in akiang a om asikha kiang ah, "Kisa dih, i pai nawn mai ding, ahuchih keileh ka pa'n sabiltungte awlmoh nawn lou in ei hon ngaihtuah zaw kha ding,” achi hi.
english: When they had come to the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant who was with him, “Come! Let’s return, lest my father stop caring about the donkeys and be anxious for us.”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, hiai khua ah Pathian mipa a-om a, mizahtakhuaitak ahi. Agen peuhmah ahong tung ngeingei nak hi. Kisa in, huai ah i va hoh ding, i hohna lampi ahon hilhthei zenzen khakleh," achi hi.
english: The servant said to him, “Behold now, there is a man of God in this city, and he is a man who is held in honor. All that he says surely happens. Now let’s go there. Perhaps he can tell us which way to go.”

paite: Huchi in Saul in asikha kiang ah, "Ahi na a, ngai dih, hoh hita lehang, huai mi a ding in bang i tawi dia? I bawm ah lah tanghou a-om nawn kei. Pathian mipa kipahman tawi ding a-om het kei hi. Bang i nei a eita?" achi hi.
english: Then Saul said to his servant, “But behold, if we go, what should we bring the man? For the bread is spent in our sacks, and there is not a present to bring to the man of God. What do we have?”

paite: Sikha in Saul adawng nawn a, "Ngai in, dangka shekel mun li a khen mun khat ka tawi lai hi. Hiai i hohna ding a hon hilh man ding in Pathian mipa ka pe ding," achi hi.
