english: The servant answered Saul again and said, “Behold, I have in my hand the fourth part of a shekel of silver. I will give that to the man of God, to tell us our way.”

paite: Tuma siah Israelte lak a mi'n Pathian dot a-utleh, "Kisa dih, mutheipa kiang ah i hoh ding,” achi nak uh. Tulai a zawlnei achih uh tuma lam a mutheipa achih uh ahi.
english: (In earlier times in Israel, when a man went to inquire of God, he said, “Come! Let’s go to the seer;” for he who is now called a prophet was before called a seer.)

paite: Huchi in Saul in asikha kiang ah, "Hoih geih e, va hoh peuhmah ni," achi hi. Huchi in Pathian mipa omna khua ah ahohta uhi.
english: Then Saul said to his servant, “Well said. Come! Let’s go.” So they went to the city where the man of God was.

paite: Mual a kho zotna lampi a apaitouh lai un nungak tui tawi dia hong kuante amu ua, akiang uah, "Hiai ah mutheipa a-om hia?" achi uhi.
english: As they went up the ascent to the city, they found young maidens going out to draw water, and said to them, “Is the seer here?”

paite: Amau adawng ua, "Om mah e, ngai in, na ma uah apai, kin un, tuni in khua ah ana hoh hi. Tuni in mun sang ah mite akithoih uh.
english: They answered them and said, “He is. Behold, he is before you. Hurry now, for he has come today into the city; for the people have a sacrifice today in the high place.

paite: Khua a na luttouhtak un mun sang a an ne dia ahoh ma in na va mu ngal ding uh. Kithoihna vualzawlpa ding ahih ziak in atun mateng mipi'n an ane kei ding uh. Huai khit chiang in amisapte un an ane zel uhi. Huaiziak in hohtou meng unla, na va mu pah ding uh," achi uhi.
english: As soon as you have come into the city, you will immediately find him before he goes up to the high place to eat; for the people will not eat until he comes, because he blesses the sacrifice. Afterwards those who are invited eat. Now therefore go up; for at this time you will find him.”

paite: Huchi in khua ah ahohtou ua, khua alut uleh, ngai in, Samuel mun sang a hoh ding in amau akituahpih hi.
english: They went up to the city. As they came within the city, behold, Samuel came out toward them to go up to the high place.

paite: Saul hong ma ni khat in Samuel kiang ah TOUPA akilak a:
english: Now Yahweh had revealed to Samuel a day before Saul came, saying,

paite: "Zingchiang in hichi hun in Benjamin gam a pan na kiang ah mi khat ka hon hohsak dia, ka mi Israelte tung a heutu ding in thau na nilh ding ahi. Ama'n Philistia mite khut a pan ka mite ahondam ding. Akikou husa uh ka kiang ahong tun tak ziak in ka mite zaw ka limsak ahi," achi hi.
english: “Tomorrow about this time I will send you a man out of the land of Benjamin, and you shall anoint him to be prince over my people Israel. He will save my people out of the hand of the Philistines; for I have looked upon my people, because their cry has come to me.”

paite: Samuel in Saul amuh in TOUPA'N akiang ah, "En dih, na kiang a ka mi gen; amah mah in ka mite tung ah vai ahawm ding," achi hi.
english: When Samuel saw Saul, Yahweh said to him, “Behold, the man of whom I spoke to you! He will have authority over my people.”

paite: Huchi in kulh kongpi ah Saul in Samuel ava naih a, "Mutheipa inn koi lai a om ahia, hon hilh dih ve," achi hi.
english: Then Saul approached Samuel in the gateway, and said, “Please tell me where the seer’s house is.”

paite: Samuel in Saul adawng a, "Kei huai mutheipa ka hi. Ka ma ah mun sang lam zuan in pai inla, tuni in ka kiang ah an na ne ding hi. Zingchiang zingsang in ka hon paisak ding. Na lungtang a om tengteng leng ka hon hilh ding.
english: Samuel answered Saul and said, “I am the seer. Go up before me to the high place, for you are to eat with me today. In the morning I will let you go and will tell you all that is in your heart.

paite: Ni thum paita a mang na sabiltung thu lunghimoh ke'n. Muh ahita uh. Israelte lunggulh kua tung ah ahia a-om? Nang leh na pa inn a mi tengteng tung ah ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: As for your donkeys who were lost three days ago, don’t set your mind on them, for they have been found. For whom does all Israel desire? Is it not you and all your father’s house?”

paite: Saul in adawng a, "Israel nam lak a neupen, Benjamin nam ka hi kei maw? Ka inkuan leng Benjamin inkuan tengteng lak a neupen ahi kei maw? Bangchidan a hichidan ka kiang a gen na hia?" achi hi.
english: Saul answered, “Am I not a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? And my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? Why then do you speak to me like this?”

paite: Samuel in Saul leh asikha api a, mikhual indan ah apilut a, achialte uh, mi sawmthum lak ah mun zahtakhuai ah atusak hi.
english: Samuel took Saul and his servant and brought them into the guest room, and made them sit in the best place among those who were invited, who were about thirty persons.

paite: Samuel in anhuanmi kiang ah, "Na kiang a koihtuam ding ka chih, tantuan ka hon piak pen hon la dih," achi hi.
english: Samuel said to the cook, “Bring the portion which I gave you, of which I said to you, ‘Set it aside.’”

paite: Huchi in anhuanmi in aphei leh atung a om ahon tawi a, Saul ma ah alui hi. Samuel in, "En dih, ka na koihtuam, um inla ne in. Ahun sehsa a dia hiai mite ka chialkhawm lai a ka hon sehsak him ahi, ka na chita ngal a," achi hi. Huchi in huai ni in Saul in Samuel toh ankuang a-umkhawm uhi.
english: The cook took up the thigh, and that which was on it, and set it before Saul. Samuel said, “Behold, that which has been reserved! Set it before yourself and eat; because it has been kept for you for the appointed time, for I said, ‘I have invited the people.’” So Saul ate with Samuel that day.

paite: Mun sang a pan khua ahong paisuk un intung ah Saul in Samuel ahoupih hi.
english: When they had come down from the high place into the city, he talked with Saul on the housetop.

paite: Zingkhangpi in athou a; nisuah kuan in Samuel in intung a om Saul asam hi. "Thou in, ka hon paisakta ding," achi hi. Huchi in anih un apaikhia ua, Saul leh Samuel apawtta uh.
english: They arose early; and about daybreak, Samuel called to Saul on the housetop, saying, “Get up, that I may send you away.” Saul arose, and they both went outside, he and Samuel, together.

paite: Khonawl atunsuk un Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "Sikhapa i malam ah paisak inla, ama'n hon paipel zoh chiang in, nang bel khawl tadih in, Pathian thu ka hon hilh ding," achi hi.
english: As they were going down at the end of the city, Samuel said to Saul, “Tell the servant to go on ahead of us.” He went ahead, then Samuel said, “But stand still first, that I may cause you to hear God’s message.”

paite: Paul, Silvanas leh Timothi in, Pa Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Khrist saptuam Thessalonika a omte kiang ah, Pathian i paleh Toupa Jesu Khrist a pan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
english: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Ka thumna uah na min uh lou in, nou tengteng ziak in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen gige uhi.
english: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,

paite: I Pathian leh Pa ma ah ginna ziak a na thilhihdan uh leh itna ziak a na sepgimdante uh, Toupa Jesu Khrist lametna ziak a na kuhkalna uh mangngilh lou a, theigige in.
english: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.

paite: Unau Pathian ngaihtakte aw, nou ahon teldan ka thei uhi.
english: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,

paite: Ka tanchinhoih uh thu kia a na kiang uh hong tung lou in thilhihtheihna leh Kha Siangthou leh nakpi a theihchetna toh ahong tung zaw hi. Noumau makhua ngaihtuah in na tung uah bangchibang mi ka hita ua chih na thei uhi.
english: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.

paite: Huan thuhaksa thuak kawm in, Kha Siangthou a kipak in na pom ua, koumau leh Toupa zuite na hita uhi.
english: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,

paite: Huchi in Masidonia leh Akhaia gam a gingtu mi tengteng a ding in etton ding na hi uhi.
english: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

paite: Toupa thu noumau a kipan in Masidonia leh Akhaia gam kia hilou, mun chih ah Pathian lam a na ginna uh athangkheta hi, kou bangmah ka gen uh akiphamoh nawn kei hi.
english: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not say anything.

paite: Amau mahmah in bangchibang vualzawlna toh na kiang ua ka hong lutdan uh ahon theisak uhi. Nou milimte a kipan a Pathian lam na hong ngat takdan uleh Pathian hing leh dik nasem ding leh,
english: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,

paite: van a kipan a Tapa, misi lak a kipan a akaihthoh, thangpaihna hong tung ding lak a kipan hon suaktasakpa, huai Jesu ngei na ngak ding in.
english: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

paite: Unaute aw, na lak ua ka hong lutna uh athawn kei chih noumau mah in na thei uhi.
english: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,

paite: Athawn hih nak sang in huai malam in na theihsa bang un, Philippi a gimthuak leh zumhuaitak a bawl a ka om nung un, dalna thupitak lak ah leng Pathian tanchinhoih na kiang ua gen ding in ka Pathian uah hangsanna ka nei zaw uhi.
english: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.

paite: Ka thugen uh khemna a pawt ahi kei a, sianlouhna a suak leng ahi kei a, khemna in leng ahi sam kei hi;
english: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.

paite: tanchinhoih kepsak a om ding a Pathian hoihsakmi ka hih bang ngei un, mihing hihkipak ding hilou a, ka lungtang uh ze-etpa Pathian hihkipak zaw in thu ka gen zel uh ahi zaw hi.
english: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak—not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.

paite: Chik lai peuh in kimaitang phatna thu leh huaiham khuhmangna ding thu ka zong ngei kei uh chih na thei ua; Pathian leng ahon theihpihpa ahi.
english: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),

paite: Khrist sawltak ka hih ziak un mite buaisak thei himah le ung, mihing lak ah nou lak ah leh midangte lak ah leng pahtawina ka zong ngei sam kei uhi.
english: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.

paite: Nu naupom, ama tate deihthohtak a kemmi bang in, na lak uah nunnemtak in ka om zaw uhi.
english: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.

paite: Huchi in ittak a nou ka hon lunggulh tuntun ziak un, Pathian tanchinhoih kia hilou in, koumau hinna leng hon piak hial ka ut mahmah uhi.
english: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.

paite: Unaute aw, ka septawldan uleh ka sepgimdan uh na theigige uhi; na lak uah kuamah ka suk tuailuailouhna ding un, sun leh zan a nna sem in Pathian tanchinhoih nou ka hon hilh uhi.
english: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.

paite: Nou gingtate tung a siangthoutak, diktak leh dembei a ka omdan uh ahon theihpihte Pathian leh noute na hi uhi.
english: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.

paite: Na theih mah bang un, pa'n ama tate tung a ahih bang a hanthawn leh khamuan in nou ka hon theisak uhi.
english: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,

paite: Amah gam leh thupina a nou hon samlutpa Pathian mite hi ding a kilawm him a na hintheihna ding un.
english: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.

paite: Hiai ziak in tawp lou in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen uhi, Pathian thu koumau a kipan a na muh uh, na san lai un leng, mihing thu bang in na sang kei ua; Pathian thu ahihna bang a na san zawk ziak un; huai tuh Pathian a ahi him a, gingtami noumau sung a sem zel mah ahi.
english: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, God’s word, which also works in you who believe.

paite: Nou unaute aw, Judia gam a Pathian saptuam pawl Khrist Jesu a omte zuite na hi ua, amau Judate lak a athuak bang un, nou leng noumau gam mite lak ah na thuak sam uhi.
english: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews

paite: Huai Judate'n Toupa Jesu leh zawlneite leng athat ua, kou leng ahon delhkhia ua, Pathian ahihlungkim kei ua, mi tengteng akalh nak uhi.
english: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all men,

paite: Zentelte hotdam ahihtheihna ding ua akiang ua thugen akham ua, akhelhna uh hihdim gige ding in; himahleh atung uah thangpaihna tawpkhawk atungta hi.
english: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.

paite: Himahleh unaute aw, sawt lou kal a dia noumau toh lungtang lam a kikhen lou a, pumpi lam kia a kikhen a i om takdih ziak in, kilawptak a na mel uh mu ding in ka pang sansan uhi.
english: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,

paite: Na kiang ua hong pai ka tum tinten ngal ua; kei, Paul ngei in leng hong pai ka tumtum a, himahleh Setan in ahon dal nak hi.
english: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.

paite: Ka lametna uhiam, ka lungnopna uhiam, ka Kipahna Lallukhu uhiam bang ahia le? Ahong pai chiang in i Toupa Jesu ma ah noumau mah na hi kei ding ua hia?
english: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?

paite: Noumau mah ka thupina uleh ka lungnopna uh na hi uhi.
english: For you are our glory and our joy.

paite: Huchi in ka thuakzoh tak louh phet un Athen ah koumau kia nutsiat in om le ung hoih ka sa ua,
english: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,

paite: i unaupa uh Timothi ahihleh Khrist tanchinhoih lam a Pathian nasempa, nou hon hihkip ding leh na ginna lam ua nou hon khamuan ding in ka hon sawlta uhi.
english: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,

paite: Hiai gimthuaknate ziak a kuamah alinlouhna ding un. Hiaite bang thuak ding a seh ka hi uh chih noumau ngei in na thei uhi.
english: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.

paite: Na kiang ua ka om lai ua gimthuak ding ka hi uh chih ka hon hilhkholh bang ngei in atungta hi, huai na thei uhi.
english: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.

paite: Hiai ziak in, ka thuakzoh tak louh nung in, khempa'n nou ahon khempuk kha dia, ka sepgimna uh athawn kha ding chi in na gindan uh ka na theihna ding in mi ka hon sawl ahi.
english: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.

paite: Himahleh Timothi, noumau a kipan a tua ka kiang uh ahong tun in, hon muh ka ut mahmah bang un nou leng hon muh ut mahmah in hehpih in na hon theigige uh chih leh na ginna uh leh na itna tanchin uh kipahhuaitak mai ahon puak hi.
english: But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.

paite: Huchi ahih ziak in unaute aw, ka mangbatna uleh gimthuakna tengteng uah na ginna ziak un na tungthu uah lungmuan in ka omta uhi.
english: For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.

paite: Toupa a na dinkip phot uleh tu'n tuh ka hingta uhi.
english: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.

paite: I Pathian ma ah na tung ua ka kipahna tengteng ziak un noumau lam thu ah Pathian kiang ah bangchibang in kipahthu ka gen thei zozen ding uam aw?
english: For what thanksgiving can we give again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,

paite: Na mel uh ka muhtheihna ding uleh na ginna lam ua na taksap awng uh ka hon huksak theihna ding un sun leh zan in nakpitak in ka thum uhi.
english: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

paite: Huchi in Pathian, i Pa ngei leh Toupa Jesu'n leng, koute na kiang uah hon pitung hen.
english: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.

paite: Huan noumau lam a itna ka hauh bang un, noumau khat-le-khat na ki-ittuah chiatna uleh mi tengteng na itna uh hon khangsak zelpa Toupa'n hon hausak semsem hen;
english: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,

paite: huchi a i Toupa Jesu, amisiangthou tengteng toh ahong pai chiang a, i Pathian leh a Pa ma a na lungtangte uh sianthouna lam ah gensiatbei a om ding a nou ahon hihkip theihna ding in.
english: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

paite: Huchi in unaute aw, atawp pen in na omdan ding uleh Pathian na hih kipahdan ding uh, tua na omdan bang uh, koumau a kipan a na lak bang un na hauhsemna ding un Toupa Jesu ah ka hon ngen un ka hon hanthawn uhi.
english: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.

paite: Toupa Jesu ziak in bangthute ahia ka hon piak uh na thei uhi.
english: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

paite: Pathian deihlam a na sianthouna ding uh hiai ahi: kingaih tawpsan unla;
english: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,

paite: na pumpi chiat uh siangthou leh zahtakhuai a kepdan ding thei un,
english: that each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor,

paite: Pathian thei lou Zentelte bang a huk lamsang a ut lou in.
english: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don’t know God,

paite: Huai lam thu ah zaw kuamah takhial in a-unau tung ah thil hoih lou hih kei hen; huchibang thilhihte tengteng phulapa Toupa ahih ziak in ka hon hilhkhol un ka hon theisak khinta uhi.
english: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.

paite: Pathian in siang lou ding in ahon sam kei a, siangthou ding in ahon sam zaw hi.
english: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.

paite: Huaiziak in anial in mihing nial ahi kei a, Pathian nou a Kha Siangthou hon pepa nial ahi zaw hi.
english: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

paite: Himahleh unaute itdan lam thu gelhsak na kiphamoh kei ua, ki-ittuah chiat ding in noumau ngei Pathian hilh in na omta uhi.
english: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,

paite: Masidonia gam a unau om tengteng tung ah huai na hih ngei uhi. Himahleh unaute aw, na hauhsemna ding un ka hon hanthawn uhi;
english: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;

paite: kamsim deuh a omleh noumau nna chiat limsak leh thu ka hon piak bang ua na khut ngei ua sep na tupna ding un;
english: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you,

paite: huchi in polam mite tung ah kilawmtak in na om thei ding ua, bangmah na tasam kei ding uhi.
english: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.

paite: Himahleh unaute aw, midang lametna himhim neiloute bang a na lungkhamlouhna ding un, ihmute tungtang na theih louh uh ka deih kei uhi.
english: But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope.

paite: Jesu si a, thounawnta ahi chih i gintak mah bang in Jesu a ihmu khinsate Pathian in amah toh ahon tonpih ding hi.
english: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.

paite: Hiai Toupa thu in na kiang uah ka gen uhi; eite Toupa hong pai pha a hingdam a na omlaite'n, ihmu khinsate i makhelh kei hial ding hi, chih.
english: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.

paite: Toupa mahmah kikou aw toh, angel tungnungpen aw toh, Pathian pengkul ging toh, van a kipan a hong paisuk ding lah ahi ngal a, huan Khrist a sisate athou masa phot ding ua;
english: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first,

paite: huai khit chiang in eite hingdam a na omlaite, huihkhua ah Toupa tuak ding in amau toh meipi lak ah laktouh in i om ding uhi; huchi in tangtawn in Toupa toh i omkhawm denta ding uhi.
english: then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.

paite: Huaiziak in hiai thute in kikhamuantuah chiat un.
english: Therefore comfort one another with these words.

paite: Himahleh naute aw, ahun leh ani lam thute himhim gelhsak na kiphamoh kei uh.
english: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.

paite: Toupa ni tuh zan lai in guta bang in ahong tung ding chih noumau ngei in chiantak in na thei uhi.
english: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.

paite: Muanna leh bitna chi a agen laitak un numei nauvei bang in thakhat in manthatna atung uah atung ding a, asuakta kei hial ding uhi.
english: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman. Then they will in no way escape.

paite: Himahleh unaute aw, nou zaw huai ni in guta bang a hon bingphawn ding in mial ah na om kei uhi.
english: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.

paite: Vak tate leh sun tate na hi vek ngal ua; zan a mi i hi kei ua, mial a mi leng i hi sam kei uhi.
english: You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,

paite: Huaiziak in midangte bang in i ihmu kei ding uh, hak ni in limsak zaw ni.
english: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.

paite: Ihmute zan in ahi a-ihmut uh; zukhamte leng zan in ahi akham uh.
english: For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.

paite: Himahleh eite bel sun a mi i hih ziak in, ginna leh itna lum tawi in, hotdam lametna lukhu a zang in limsak zaw ni.
english: But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

paite: Pathian in thangpaihna thuak ding hilou in, Toupa Jesu Khrist ziak a hotdamna mu ding zaw in ahon chi hi.
english: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

paite: I hah in leng i ihmut in leng, amah toh i hinkhawm theihna ding in i sih sik in amah asita hi.
english: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

paite: Huaiziak in kihanthawntuah chiat in, na hih zel mah bang un kitungdingtuah chiat un.
english: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

paite: Huan unaute aw, na lak ua semgim leh Toupa a na heutu ua na omleh nou hon thuhilhte thei ding in ka hon ngen ahi.
english: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,

paite: Anasep ziak un it in ngai thupi mahmah un. Noumau kituak in om un.
english: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

paite: Tu in unaute aw, ka hon hanthawn uhi, dan lou a omte hilh unla, lungkete hanthawn un, hatloute panpih unla, mi tengteng lak ah thuakzoutak in om un.
english: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.

paite: Kuamah in kua gitlouh leng gilou a thuk lou ding in pilvang un; thil na kihihsaktuahna lam uah leh mi tengteng tung a na hihsakna lam uah leng ahoih lamlam zui un.
english: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.

paite: Nuam gige un;
english: Always rejoice.

paite: tawp lou in thum un;
english: Pray without ceasing.

paite: bangkim ah kipahthu gen gige un; huai tuh noumau lam a Khrist Jesu ah Pathian deihlam ahi.
english: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

paite: Kha phelh kei un;
english: Don’t quench the Spirit.

paite: thugente simmoh kei un;
english: Don’t despise prophecies.

paite: bangkim enchian zaw unla, ahoih lam peuhmah len tinten un;
english: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.

paite: gilou lam peuhmah ah kihemkhia un.
english: Abstain from every form of evil.

paite: Huchi in lemna Pathian ngei in nou hon hihsiangthou sipsip hen; na kha uh leh na lungsim uh leh na pumpi uh i Toupa Jesu Khrist hong pai chiang in gensiatbei in humbit in omsuak sipsip hen.
english: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Nou hon sampa amuanhuai a, hih leng ahih ding hi.
english: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.

paite: Unaute aw, hon thumsak un.
english: Brothers, pray for us.

paite: Unaute tengteng tawp siangthou in chibai hon na buksak un.
english: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

paite: Hiai laithon unau tengteng kiang ah sim ngeingei ding in Toupa min in ka hon ngen hi.
english: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na kiang uah om hen, Amen.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

paite: Paul, Pathian thupiak bang a i hondampa leh i lamet Toupa Jesu Khrist sawltak in;
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ our hope,

paite: ginna a ka ta taktak Timothi kiang ah, i Pa Pathian, leh i Toupa Khrist Jesu a kipan hehpihna, zahngaihna, leh khamuanna na tung ah om hen.
english: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

paite: Masidonia gam a ka hoh dek lai a ka hon nget bang in Ephesa ah om gige in, huchi a mi khenkhat gindan tuam sinsak lou ding a na hilhtheihna ding in.
english: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,

paite: Huan Pathian lam a phattuamna, ginna a om pen hilou, kiselna leh gintak thu gen omsak lel tangthu leh khangthu sui zoh louh peuh buaipih lou ding a na hilhtheihna ding in.
english: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith.

paite: Eite'n thuhilh ding i kep pen bel lungtang siangthou leh sia-le-pha theihna siang leh ginna taktak a kipan a pawt itna ahi zaw hi.
english: But the goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith,

paite: Mi khenkhatte'n hiaite pialsan in thugina lou genna lam ah avakmang uhi.
english: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking,

paite: Athugen uh leh thil ahi a agente uh leng bang ahia chih theiloupi in dan sinsak mite hih a-ut uhi.
english: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say nor about what they strongly affirm.

paite: Mi'n azat hoihleh dan ahoih chih i thei uhi.
english: But we know that the law is good if a person uses it lawfully,

paite: Ahi a, dan zaw midiktatte a ding a bawl ahi kei a, dan kalhte leh dan lou a omte a ding, Pathian limsakloute leh mikhialte, misiangthouloute leh Pathian zahloute, pate thatte, nute thatte, mihing thatte;
english: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

paite: kingaihhatte, tawkohukte, mihing gute, zuautheite, kichiam khemkhemte a ding leh thil dang thugin toh kituak lou himhimte a ding leh,
english: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine,

paite: ka kiang a kepsak a om Pathian tanchinhoih thupi hilhna dik kalhte a ding ahi.
english: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

paite: Ahon hihhatpa Khrist Jesu i Toupa kiang ah kipahthu ka gen hi, muanhuai ahon sak a, anasempa dia ahon chih tak ziak in.
english: I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service,

paite: Tuma lam in Pathian gensepa leh sawipa leh hihsepa na hita mah leng; gingtaloupi leh theiloupi a hih ka hih ziak in ahi zahngaihna ka na muh tak.
english: although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

paite: Huan i Toupa hehpihna ginna leh Khrist Jesu a itna in nakpitak in adimletta hi.
english: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

paite: Khrist Jesu khialte hondam ding in khovel ah ahong pai chih ataksanhuai in alak tuak mahmah hi. Alak ua khialpen ka hi.
english: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.

paite: Himahleh hiai ziak in ahi zahngaihna ka na muh; Jesu Khrist in adohzohna kim a khialpen keimah a alatsak theihna ding ahi, tuban siah tangtawn hinna muhna ding a amah hon gingta dingte a dia etsakna hi ding in.
english: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.

paite: Kumpipa tangtawn a om, sithei lou, muh theih louh, Pathian tak kia, tangtawn in zahtak leh thupi in om hen, Amen.
english: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

paite: Ka tapa Timothi aw, na tungtang genkholhnate toh kituak in hiai mohpuakna leh thuhilhna ka hon pia hi, huchi a huai thute hilh a, kidouna hoih na dou theihna ding in,
english: I commit this instruction to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by them you may wage the good warfare,

paite: ginna leh sia-le-pha theihna siangtak len tinten in, mi khenkhatte'n huai sia-le-pha theihna paikhia in ginna lam ah long sia bang in akekseta uhi.
english: holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,

paite: Huaite lak ah Himenaias leh Alexander apang uhi; Pathian agensiatlouhna ding un amaute Setan ka peta hi.
english: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan that they might be taught not to blaspheme.

paite: Huchi in amasapen in thilnget thumnate, thumna himhimte, thumsaknate, leh kipahthu gennate, mi tengteng a ding a bawlsak ding in ka hon hanthawn hi.
english: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men,

paite: Kumpipate leh thuneite tengteng a ding in leng; Pathian limsak leh zahtakhuaitak a kituak a khamuang a i omtheihna ding in.
english: for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.

paite: Huai tuh i Hondampa Pathian theih in ahoih in, akipahhuai hi.
english: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,

paite: Ama'n mi tengteng hotdam a om ding leh thutak thei ding in adeih hi.
english: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.

paite: "Pathian khat kia a om, Pathian leh mihing kikal ah palai khat kia a-om nawn,
english: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

paite: Amah mihing ahi, Khrist Jesu, mi tengteng tatna dia kipepa pen." Huai theihpihna ahuntak a piak ahi.
english: who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony at the proper time,

paite: Hiai hih ding a tangkoupihpa ding leh sawltak a seh ka hi, Khrist ah thutak tak ka gen, ka zuau kei; ginna leh thutak a Zentelte sinsakpa a seh ka hi.
english: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

paite: Pasalte'n mun chih a khut siangthou zak in, thangpai lou leh ginglel lou in thum le uh ka deih hi.
english: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.

paite: Huchibang mah in numeite zumthei leh omdan siam in puansilh kilawm lel in kivan le uh; samphek, dangka-eng, tuikepsuang leh puan mantam taktakte a kivan lou in;
english: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing,

paite: himahleh numei Pathian limsak kichite akihun lel in thil hihhoih in kivan le uh ka deih hi.
english: but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.

paite: Numei in thumang hiathiat in om dinden in zil hen.
english: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.

paite: Himahleh numei in thu ahilh zaw ka phal kei, pasal tung a thuneih leng ka phal sam kei, dai dinden in om zaw hen.
english: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

paite: Adam siam masak ahi a, huai nung in Evi siam ahi.
english: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

paite: Adam khem in a-om kei a, numei khem in a-om a, tatlekna ah apukta hi.
english: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;

paite: Numei in omdan siamna toh ginna leh itna leh sianthouna a a-om gigeleh nau pianna ah hotdam in a-om ding hi.
english: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.

paite: Kuapeuh saptuam heutu a pan ut in nasep hoih a-ut ahi, chih adik ahi.
english: This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work.

paite: Huchi in saptuam heutu zaw gensiatbei, zi khat nei, kidek thei, navaktak, midiktat, mipahtakdan siam, thuhilh siam,
english: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;

paite: uain khamhat lou, mivuak hat lou, minunnem ahi ding hi, selhat lou, sum deihta lou,
english: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;

paite: zahtakhuaitak a tate kemsiam, amah insung kizentak a vaihawm siammi ahi ding hi.
english: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;

paite: Mi'n ama insung vaihawm nangawn kizentak a ahihsiam keileh bangchi in ahia Pathian saptuam akep theih ding?
english: (for how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule his own house take care of God’s assembly?)

paite: Gingthakmi ahi ding ahi kei, huchi lou in zaw akisathei kha dia, diabol siam louh tansakna ah apuk kha ding hi.
english: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.

paite: Huaite lou leng polam a mite phat in a-om nalai ding ahi, huchi lou in zaw gensiat a a-om in diabol thang ah a-awk kha ding hi.
english: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.

paite: Huchibang in Saptuam Upate leng mizahtakhuai ahih ding uh ahi; kamtamte, uain haite, lepna nin a huaiham mite ahi ding ahi kei;
english: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,

paite: sia-le-pha theihna siang a ginna a thuguk kemmi ahi zaw ding uhi.
english: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

paite: Huan huaite leng chet in om masa uhen, huai nung in gensiatbei ahong hih uleh Saptuam Upa nna sem uhen.
english: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.

paite: Huchibang in azite uh leng mizahtakhuai ahi ding uhi, gensiat hat lou, kidek thei leh bangkim a muanhuai ahi ding uhi.
english: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.

paite: Saptuam Upate zi khat nei atate uleh amau insung vaihawm navaktak a hihmi hi uhen.
english: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

paite: Saptuam Upa nna hoihtak a semte'n amau a ding in phat tak hihna aloh ua, huan Khrist Jesu a om ginna a muanna leh hangsanna thupitak amu uhi.
english: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

paite: Sawt lou nung a na kiang a hong hoh lamen in hiai thu na kiang ah ka gelh ahi;
english: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly,

paite: himahleh ka hong zekai khakleh Pathian inkuanpihte lak a mi bangchibang in ahia a-om ding uh chih na theihna ding in ka gelh ahi; Pathian inkuanpihte Pathian hing saptuamte, thutak khuam leh kingakna ahi uhi.
english: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God’s house, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

paite: Pathian limsakna thuguk nial vual louh in athupi hi: "Taksa a muh theih a latsak in Pathian a-om a, Kha a siamtansak, Angelte muh, namte lak a tangkoupih, khovel a mite gintak, thupina apitouh ahi."
english: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.

paite: Himahleh tunung chiang in mi khenkhatte'n; pimangna khate leh dawite thuhilhna limsak in, ginna atawpsan ding uh chih Kha in kichiantak in agen hi; huai tuh,
english: But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,

paite: mizuautheite lepchiahna ziak in ahi; huai mizuautheite amau sia-le-pha theihna ngei a sik am a halkeu bang ahi uhi.
english: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,

paite: Kiten akham ua, nek ding ante, thutak thei a gingtate'n kipahthu gen a san ding a Pathian in asiamte, nek louh ding achi uhi.
english: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

paite: Pathian thilsiam chiteng ahoih ngal a, kipahthu gen a san ahih khit nak photleh bangmah deih louh ding ahi kei hi;
english: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.

paite: Pathian thu leh thumna a hihsiangthou ahi khinta hi.
english: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.

paite: Huaite unaute na sinsakleh Khrist Jesu nasempa hoihtak, ginna leh thuhilhna hoih tutan a na zuih thu a vaklian na hi ding hi.
english: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.

paite: Himahleh Pathian zahlouhna leh tangthu bulbal neiloute deih ke'n. Pathian limsak ding in kithuzoh in;
english: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.

paite: pumpi kisawizoina aphatuam zek a; Pathian limsakna pen tangtawn in, tua omsa hinna leh hong om nawn ding piak chiamna aneih ziak in thil tengteng ah aphatuam hi.
english: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.

paite: Hiai thu amuanhuai in alak tuak mahmah hi.
english: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.

paite: Huchi in Pathian hing i muan ziak in i semgim ua, i pang teitei uhi; amah mi tengteng Hondampa ahi a, agingtate Hondampa ahi tuanse hi.
english: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.

paite: Hiaite thupiak in pia inla, sinsak in.
english: Command and teach these things.

paite: Na naupanna kuamah musitsak ke'n; thugen ah, tatdan ah, itna ah, kha ah, ginna leh sianthouna ah, gingtute zuih ding hi zaw in.
english: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

paite: Ka hong pai masiah laisim, hanthawn leh thugin limsak in.
english: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.

paite: Nangmah a om thilpiak thugenkholhna a piak, upate khut ngak a Pathian in nang ahon neihsak limsak lou ke'n.
english: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.

paite: Mi tengteng kiang a na phattuamna alattheihna ding in huai thilte ah thanuam inla, kizang zou in.
english: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.

paite: Nangmah leh na thuhilh ah pilvang in; huai thilte hih in om gige in; huchibang hih in nangmah leh na thuzate na hondam ding hi.
english: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

paite: Upa deuhte tai ke'nla, pa bang in thuhilh in; tangval deuhte unaupa bang in;
english: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;

paite: numei upa deuhte nu bang in; nungak deuhte siangthoutak in sanggamnu bang in thuhilh in.
english: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.

paite: Meithai, meithai taktakte zahtak in.
english: Honor widows who are widows indeed.

paite: Himahleh meithai kuapeuh in tate leh tute aneih uleh huaite'n amau insung ah Pathian limsakna mohpuakna thei masa uhenla, amau nu leh pate uh kem uhen; hiai lah Pathian mitmuh in ahoih in apom tak ngal a.
english: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.

paite: Meithai taktak amah kia nutsiat a om in Pathian tung ah lametna anei a, sun leh zan a ngen in athum gige hi.
english: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.

paite: Himahleh meithai ama nopsakna sung a kipia zaw, adam lai nangawn in asi ahi.
english: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.

paite: Gensiatbei a a-omtheihna ding un huaite thupiak in pia in.
english: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.

paite: Himahleh kuapeuh in ama mite a ding angaihtuahsak louh a, ama inkuante khol houh angaihtuahsak keileh ginna azuausan a, gingloumi sang in agilouzaw hi.
english: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

paite: Meithai kum sawmguk chiang nuailam hilou, mi khat zi hisa,
english: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,

paite: thil hoih hih lam a mi phatlohta, atate vaktei khin a, mikhualte na zintun khin a, misiangthoute khe na silta a, mangbangte na dawnzang khin a, thil hoih peuhmah thanuamtak a na hih khin ahihleh meithai a gelh theih ahi.
english: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.

paite: Himahleh meithai naupang simte zaw gelh ke'n; ataksa lunggulhna un Khrist lam a akipiakna uh athuzoh chiang in pasal neih a-ut nak ua,
english: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,

paite: aginna masa uh atawpsan ziak un siam louh tang in a-om nak uhi.
english: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.

paite: Huai lou leng thadah in inn teng ah aban pawt nak ua, thadah kia leng hilou in, thu gen louh ding gen in, kamtam leh mite thilhih lai avai hawmsak nak uhi.
english: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.

paite: Huchi in meithai naupang simte zaw pasal nei in, tate nei uhenla, insung khosak ngaihtuah le uh, melmapa gensiatna ding lemtang musak kei le uh ka deih hi.
english: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.

paite: Meithai khenkhat Setan lam naih in apialkheta uhi.
english: For already some have turned away after Satan.

paite: Gingtami numei hiam pasal hiam in methaite nei taleh dawnzang hen; saptuamte hihbuai in om kei hen; meithai taktakte adawnzang theihna ding un.
english: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.

paite: Saptuam Upa vaihawm hoihte, abik in thugen leh sinsakna a semgimte aleh nih a hih thupi tuak a seh nawn sem hi uhen.
english: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.

paite: Laisiangthou in, "Bawngtal in buh achil lai in amuk gak ke'n," achi hi. "Nasemmi loh mu tak ahi," achi nawn hi.
english: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”

paite: Saptuam Upa hekna zaw theihpih nih hiam thum hiam kam a lou zaw sang ke'n.
english: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.

paite: Mikhialte mi tengteng ma ah taihilh in, midangte'n leng alautheihna ding un.
english: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.

paite: Deihsak tuam leh khentuam nei a bangmah hih lou a hiai thute zui ding in Pathian leh Khrist Jesu leh angel teltuamte mitmuh in phatuamngaitak in ka hon theisak hi.
english: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.

paite: Kuamah tung ah khut nga pah ke'nla, midang khelhna ah leng kikum pah ke'n; kihihsiangthou gige in.
english: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.

paite: Tui kia dawn ke'nla, na gilpi ziak in leh na hat louh nak ziak in uain neu khakha zang zel in.
english: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.

paite: Mi khenkhatte khelhna alang gige a, vaihawmna atun nak hi; mi khenkhat khelhnate bel akhonung in ahong kilang hi.
english: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.

paite: Huchi mah bang in mi khenkhatte thil hoih hih kilang pah a-om a, akilangloute leng sel theih ahi kei hi.
english: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.

paite: Pathian min leh athuhilhna thu gensiat a a-omlouhna ding in sikha hakkol bat peuhmahte'n amau pute bangkim ah zahtak tham in sim uhen.
english: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.

paite: Huan gingtami pu a neite'n unau ahih ziak un ngaineu kei uhen, himahleh phattuamna mute leh deihtakte ahih ziak un a-nna uh sepsak semsem uhen. Huai thute hilh inla, hanthawn in.
english: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.

paite: Mi kuapeuh in thuhilhna dang ahilh a, thutak, i Toupa Jesu Khrist thu leh Pathian limsak lam thuhilhna hoih asak keileh,
english: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,

paite: amah kisathei ahi a, bangmah thei lou ahi, theih nak sang in kisel leh thukalh lam ah ahai zawta a, huchibang a kipan in, enna, kilaina, gensiatna,
english: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,

paite: hoih lou lam a ginna, selhatna asuak nak hi; huchibang mi lungsim sia neite'n thutak nei lou in, Pathian limsak pen punna khattou asa uhi.
english: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.

paite: Himahleh lungkimna toh kithuah Pathian limsakna tuh punna thupitak ahi.
english: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

paite: Khovel ah bangmah i lutpih kei a, bangmah i pawtpih thei sam kei ding hi.
english: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.

paite: Himahleh nek ding leh silh ding nei in, huaite ah i lungkim ding uhi.
english: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

paite: Himahleh, hauhsak tumte khemna, thang, haihuai leh hihse thei duhgawlna tampi ah apuklut nak uhi, huaite'n tuh siatna leh manthatna ah mite ahihtum nak uhi.
english: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.

paite: Dangka sum deihtak zaw gilou chiteng bul ahi; khenkhatte'n a-eng ua, ginna apaimangsan ua, amau leh amau lungkhamna tampi in akisunlet tektok uhi.
english: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

paite: Himahleh nang Pathian mipa aw, huai thilte taisan inla, diktatna, Pathian limsakna, ginna, itna, thuaktheihna, kingaihniamnate delh in.
english: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.

paite: Ginna kidouna hoih dou inla, tangtawn hinna len tinten in; huai tang ding a sap na hi a; theihpih tamtakte mitmuh in gupna hoih na gumta hi.
english: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.

paite: Pathian thil bangkim hihhingpa leh Khrist Jesu, Pontias Pilat mai a gupna hoih gumpa mitmuh in thu ka hon pia hi;
english: I command you before God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,

paite: Toupa Jesu Khrist hong kilat nawn masiah huai thupiak siangthou leh gensiatbei a kem ding in.
english: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,

paite: Huai kilakna ama huntak ah phat tuak thuneipa tak kia, kumpipate' Kumpipa, toupate' Toupa'n alak ding ahi.
english: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.

paite: Amah kia in sih theihlouhna anei a, vak naih theih vual louh ah a-om a, amah kuamah in amu ngei kei ua, muh leng amu thei sam kei uhi; amah kiang ah tangtawn in thupina leh thilhihtheihna om hen, Amen.
english: He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.

paite: Hiai khovel a mihausate kisathei lou ding leh hauhna kip lou a muanna nga lou a, thil tengteng kipahna ding a tampi a hon pepa Pathian a nga zaw ding in hilh in.
english: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;

paite: Thil hoih ahih ding uh, thil hoih hih a ahauh ding uh, thilphal a asiam ding uh ahi.
english: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;

paite: Huchi a amau a ding a gou kikhol a, tunung a dia suangphum hoih phum a, tangtawn hinna taktak aletkip theihna ding un.
english: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.

paite: Timothi aw, na kiang a kepsak a om kemhoih in; Pathian zah louh thugen mawkmawk leh kikalhna dikloupi a pilna kichite nungngatsan in;
english: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,

paite: mi khenkhat in huai nei kichi in ginna ah apaikhial uhi. Hehpihna na kiang ah om hen, Amen.
english: which some profess, and thus have wandered from the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.

paite: Huan David tapa Solomon agamsung ah hatsak in a-om a; TOUPA a Pathian akiang ah a-om a, nakpi mahmah in athupisak hi.
english: Solomon the son of David was firmly established in his kingdom, and Yahweh his God was with him, and made him exceedingly great.

paite: Solomon in Israel tengteng, sepaih sangkhat heutu, zakhat heutu, vaihawmmi, Israel gam tengteng a milian, inkuan a makaipen tengteng ahoupih hi.
english: Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, to the judges, and to every prince in all Israel, the heads of the fathers’ households.

paite: Huchi in Solomon leh kikhawm tengteng Gibeon a mun sang ah ahoh ua; huai ah TOUPA sikha Mosi in gamdai a abawl Pathian biakna buk a-om hi.
english: Then Solomon, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for God’s Tent of Meeting was there, which Yahweh’s servant Moses had made in the wilderness.

paite: Pathian bawm bel David in ana bawl khitsa mun, Kiriath-jearim a kipan David in alatou khin a; Jerusalem ah akoihna ding puanin azak khitsa him ahi.
english: But David had brought God’s ark up from Kiriath Jearim to the place that David had prepared for it; for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

paite: Huan Hur tapa, Uri tapa, Bezalel bawl dal maitam TOUPA biakna buk chin ah a-om behlap a; Solomon leh mipite'n ava zuan uhi.
english: Moreover the bronze altar that Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made was there before Yahweh’s tabernacle; and Solomon and the assembly were seeking counsel there.

paite: Huan kihoupihna biakbuk chin a dal maitam omna TOUPA ma ah Solomon ahohtou a, halmang thillat sangkhat alan hi.
english: Solomon went up there to the bronze altar before Yahweh, which was at the Tent of Meeting, and offered one thousand burnt offerings on it.

paite: Huai zan in Solomon kiang ah Pathian akilak a, akiang ah, "Bang ahia ka hon piak ding hon ngen in," achi hi.
english: That night, God appeared to Solomon and said to him, “Ask for what you want me to give you.”

paite: Huchi in Solomon in Pathian kiang ah, "Ka pa David kiang ah hehpihna thupitak na langsak a, asik in kumpipa in na hon bawlta a,
english: Solomon said to God, “You have shown great loving kindness to David my father, and have made me king in his place.

paite: aw TOUPA Pathian, ka pa David kiang a na thuchiam hihtangtung in; nang lei a leivui zah mipite kumpipa in na hon bawlta hi.
english: Now, Yahweh God, let your promise to David my father be established; for you have made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.

paite: Huchi in hiai mipite ma a lut leh pawt a ka omtheihna ding in pilna leh theihna hon pia in; na mi hiai zahzah vai, kua'n ahia hawmsak thei ding?" achi hi.
english: Now give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people; for who can judge this great people of yours?”

paite: Huchi in Pathian in Solomon kiang ah, "Hichibang lungsim na put a, sum-le-paite, hauhsaknate, pahtawinate, nang hon mudahte hinnate ngen lou a, damsawtnate leng ngen lou a, atung ua kumpipa a ka hon bawl na mite vai na hawmsak theihna ding a pilna leh theihnate na hon nget zawk ziak in, pilna leh theihna piak na hita hi.
english: God said to Solomon, “Because this was in your heart, and you have not asked riches, wealth, honor, or the life of those who hate you, nor yet have you asked for long life; but have asked for wisdom and knowledge for yourself, that you may judge my people, over whom I have made you king,

paite: Huchi in na ma a kumpipate'n ana neih ngei louh uh, nang nung a leng aneih het louh ding uh sum-le-paite, hauhsaknate, pahtawinate ka hon pe lai ding," achi hi.
english: therefore wisdom and knowledge is granted to you. I will give you riches, wealth, and honor, such as none of the kings have had who have been before you, and none after you will have.”

paite: Huchi in Solomon mun sang chin a kihoupihna biakbuk omna Gibeon a zin Jerusalem ah apai a, Israel tung ah yai ahawmta hi.
english: So Solomon came from the high place that was at Gibeon, from before the Tent of Meeting, to Jerusalem; and he reigned over Israel.

paite: Huan Solomon in kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite akaikhawm a; kangtalai sangkhat-le-zali leh sakol tungtuangmi singkhat-le-sangnih anei a, huaite kangtalai koihna khuate leh Jerusalem a kumpipa omnate ah akoih hi.
english: Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen that he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n Jerusalem ah suangtum bang mai in dangka-eng leh dangkasikte akoih a, sidar singte leng phaizang a theipi sing bang a tam in akoih lai hi.
english: The king made silver and gold to be as common as stones in Jerusalem, and he made cedars to be as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

paite: Solomon neih sakolte, Aigupta gam a kipan a lakkhiak ahi a; kumpipa sumsin mite'n huaite ahonhon in akhak zel ua, ahon a lei zel ahi.
english: The horses which Solomon had were brought out of Egypt and from Kue. The king’s merchants purchased them from Kue.

paite: Aiguptate gam a kangtalaite bel dangkasik shekel zaguk zel in aleikhiaksak zel ua; sakolte dangkasik shekel za-le-sawmnga zel in; huchi mah bang in Hitte kumpipa tengteng leh Siria kumpipate kiang ah leng azuaksawn zel uhi.
english: They imported from Egypt then exported a chariot for six hundred pieces of silver and a horse for one hundred fifty. They also exported them to the Hittite kings and the Syrian kings.

paite: Rehoboam bel Shekem ah ahoh a; Israelte tengteng Shekem ah kumpipa dia bawl ding in ahoh khinta uhi.
english: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam in huai thu azak in, Aigupta gam a kipan Jeroboam ahong pai nawn hi; amah kumpipa Solomon kiang a kipan ataimangna Aigupta gam a om lai ahi ngal a.
english: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon), Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

paite: Mi asawl ua, ava sam ua; huchi in Jeroboam leh Israel tengteng ahong pai ua, Rehoboam kiang ah,
english: They sent and called him; and Jeroboam and all Israel came, and they spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

paite: "Na pa'n ka hakkol uh agiksak mahmah a; huaiziak in na pa'n hon zat gimna leh ahakkol giktak ka tung ua akoih hon sukzangsak inla, huchi in nang nna ka sem ding uh," chi in agen uhi.
english: “Your father made our yoke grievous. Now therefore make the grievous service of your father and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Ni thum khit chiang in hong pai nawn zaw un," achi a, huchi in mipite akihemkhia uhi.
english: He said to them, “Come again to me after three days.” So the people departed.

paite: Kumpipa Rehoboam in, "Hiai mipite dawnna ding thupha bang ahia na hon hilh ding uh?" chi in apa Solomon dam lai a upate kiang ah adong hi.
english: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men, who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me about how to answer these people?”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Hiai mipite na hehpih a na kipahsak a, akiang ua thuhoih tata na genleh tangtawn in na mite ahi ding uh," chi in agen uhi.
english: They spoke to him, saying, “If you are kind to these people, please them, and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants forever.”

paite: Himahleh, upate hoihsakpih apom kei a, amah khanvualpih tangvalte, akiang a om sekte adong zosop hi.
english: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.

paite: Akiang uah, "Hiai mipite ka kiang a, 'Na pa'n ka tung ua hakkol akoih hon hihzangsak in chi a gen mite ka dawndan ding hoih bang ahia na hon hilh ding uh?" " achi hi.
english: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may give an answer to these people, who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”

paite: Akhanvualpih tangvalte'n akiang ah hiai mipite na pa'n ahakkol uh ahihgik thei mahmah a, nang zaw hon hihzangsakzaw in na kiang a hong gen mite kiang ah huchi in chi inla, huchi in akiang uah gen in, "Ka pa kawng sang in ka khutzung agolzaw.
english: The young men who had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, “Thus you shall tell the people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter on us;’ thus you shall say to them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.

paite: Ka pa'n hakkol giktak ahon na posak a, ke'n ahihleh na hakkol uh behlap lai ding ka hi, ka pa'n khetna in nou ahon sawi zel a, ke'n ahihleh aikam a hon sawi ding ka hi," chi in agen uhi.
english: Now whereas my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”

paite: Huchi in Jeroboam leh mipite tengteng kumpipa'n, "Ani thum khit chiang in hong nawn un, achih bang in ni thum ni in Rehoboam kiang ah ahoh uhi.
english: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”

paite: Kumpipa'n amaute gumtak in adawng a, kumpipa Rehoboam in upate thuhilhna apom kei.
english: The king answered them roughly; and King Rehoboam abandoned the counsel of the old men,

paite: Tangvalte phatsakpih bang in, ka pa'n na hakkol uh ahihgik a, ke'n huai behlap ding ka hi; ka pa'n khetna in nou ahon na sawi a, ke'n zaw aikam a nou hon sawi ding ka hi," achi hi.
english: and spoke to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to it. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Shilon mi Ahijah zang a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam kiang a athu gensa akipsak theihna ding in kumpipa'n mite thugen Pathian ziak in apom kei hi.
english: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was brought about by God, that Yahweh might establish his word, which he spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

paite: Kumpipa'n athu uh apom kei chih Israelte tengteng in atheih un mipite'n: "David ah tantuan bang ahia i neih uh? Jesse tapa ah gouluah ding i nei sam kei uh, Israel mite aw, na puanin lam chiat uah pai un: David, na inkuan sung ngaihtuah mai in, chi in kumpipa adawng uhi." Huchi in Israel tengteng apuanin lam uah apaita uhi.
english: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion do we have in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse! Every man to your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So all Israel departed to their tents.

paite: Israel suan Judah gam khua a omte bel atung uah Rehoboam in vai ahawm hi.
english: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Rehoboam in phutluih nasem dia asawlte uh heutu Hadoram asawl a; amah huai Israelte tengteng in suang in ana deng ua, asita hi. Jerusalem a tai tum in akangtalai ah kumpipa Rehoboam atuang pah hi.
english: Then King Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and the children of Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in tutan in David inkote tung ah Israelte ahelta uhi.
english: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.

paite: Huan Jerusalem a Rehoboam atuntouh in, Israelte dou a, Rehoboam gam la nawn ding in Judah nuaikhat leh Benjamin inkote, mihangsan chiat telkhiak, nuaikhat-le-singgiattak akaikhawm hi.
english: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, one hundred eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.

paite: Himahleh Pathian mipa Shemaiah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
english: But Yahweh’s word came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

paite: Judah gam kumpipa Solomon tapa Rehoboam kiang ah leh Judah gam leh Benjamin gam a Israel mi tengteng kiang ah,
english: “Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

paite: "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: na hohtou ding uh ahi kei, na unaute uh dou sam kei un; na inn lam uah pai nawn vek un; hiai keimah hih ahi hi, chi in gen in," chi in. Huchi in TOUPA thu amang ua, Jeroboam dou ding a ahoh ding uh akik nawn uhi.
english: ‘Yahweh says, “You shall not go up, nor fight against your brothers! Every man return to his house; for this thing is of me.”’” So they listened to Yahweh’s words, and returned from going against Jeroboam.

paite: Rehoboam bel Jerusalem ah a-om a, Judah gam ah kivenna ding in khua asat hi.
english: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem, and built cities for defense in Judah.

paite: Bethlehem khuate, Etam, Tekoa asat a,
english: He built Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,

paite: Beth-zur, Shoko, Adullam,
english: Beth Zur, Soco, Adullam,

paite: Gath, Mareshah, Jip,
english: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,

paite: Adoraim, Lakish, Azekah,
english: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,

paite: Zorah, Aijalon, Hebron khua; huaite Judah leh Benjamin gam a kulh nei khopite ahi.
english: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, which are fortified cities in Judah and in Benjamin.

paite: Huchi in huai kulhte ahihkip a, heutute akoih a, nek ding, thau leh uain asekkhawm hi.
english: He fortified the strongholds and put captains in them with stores of food, oil and wine.

paite: Kho teng ah lum leh tei akoih a, khua kiptak in abawl chiat hi. Huchi in Judah leh Benjamin gam ama gam ahisak hi.
english: He put shields and spears in every city, and made them exceedingly strong. Judah and Benjamin belonged to him.

paite: Huan Israel gam tengteng a siampute leh Levite amau gam a kipan chiat in akiang ah ahong uhi.
english: The priests and the Levites who were in all Israel stood with him out of all their territory.

paite: Levite'n agam uh leh a-omnate uh apawtsan ua, Judah gam leh Jerusalem ah ahoh uh; Jeroboam leh atapate'n TOUPA a dia siampu nna sem lou ding in atawpsak uhi.
english: For the Levites left their pasture lands and their possessions, and came to Judah and Jerusalem; for Jeroboam and his sons cast them off, that they should not execute the priest’s office to Yahweh.

paite: Amun sang a ding leh keltal leh bawngnou lim abawl a ding a siampute aseh zawk ziak in.
english: He himself appointed priests for the high places, for the male goat and calf idols which he had made.

paite: Huan Israel nam, TOUPA Israel' Pathian lam a lungsim awn tengteng in azui ua, TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian kiang ah kithoih ding in Jerusalem ah ahoh uhi.
english: After them, out of all the tribes of Israel, those who set their hearts to seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

paite: Huchi in Judah gam akipsak ua, kum thum sung Solomon tapa Rehoboam in akipsak hi: kum thum sung David leh Solomon lampi azui uhi.
english: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong for three years, for they walked three years in the way of David and Solomon.

paite: Rehoboam in David tapa Jerimoth tanu Mahalath zi in anei a, huai Jesse tapa Eliab tanu ahihleh Abihail tanu ahi.
english: Rehoboam took a wife for himself, Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David and of Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse.

paite: Tapate aneihsak a: Jeush, Shemariah leh Zaham ahi uh.
english: She bore him sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.

paite: Amah nung in Absalom tanu Maakah anei a; ama'n Abijah, Atai, Ziza leh Shelomith aneihsak hi.
english: After her, he took Maacah the granddaughter of Absalom; and she bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.

paite: Rehoboam in Absalom tanu Maakah bel azite leh amite tengteng tung ah a-it tuan a; zi sawm-le-giat leh mei sawmguk anei a, tapa sawmnih-le-giat leh tanu sawmguk anei ahi.
english: Rehoboam loved Maacah the granddaughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines; for he took eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and became the father of twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.

paite: Rehoboam in Maakah tapa Abijah, a-unaute lak ah makai lianpen in abawl a; kumpipa ding a bawl alungsim ahi zomah hi.
english: Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah to be chief, the prince among his brothers, for he intended to make him king.

paite: Piltak in agamta a, atapate tengteng Judah gam leh Benjamin gam tengteng kulh nei khopite ah a-om zaksak vek a; nek ding tampi apia a, zi tampi azonsak chiat hi.
english: He dealt wisely, and dispersed some of his sons throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin, to every fortified city. He gave them food in abundance; and he sought many wives for them.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Rehoboam in gam aphutkip a, mihattak ahong hih nung in amah lam a pang Israel tengteng toh TOUPA Pan alehngatsan uhi.
english: When the kingdom of Rehoboam was established and he was strong, he abandoned Yahweh’s law, and all Israel with him.

paite: Hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa Rehoboam vaihawm akum ngana kum in, TOUPA tung a atatlek ziak un, Jerusalem sim ding in Aigupta kumpipa Shishak ahong kuantou hi,
english: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had trespassed against Yahweh,

paite: Kangtalai singkhat-le-sangnih leh sakol tungtuangmi singguk toh, Aigupta gammi hon zuite sim vual louh ahi uh; Libiate, Sukite, Ethiopiate ahi uhi.
english: with twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen. The people were without number who came with him out of Egypt: the Lubim, the Sukkiim, and the Ethiopians.

paite: Judah gam a kulh nei khopite ala a, Jerusalem ava tung hi.
english: He took the fortified cities which belonged to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.

paite: Rehoboam leh Judahte intekpen, Shishak ziak a Jerusalem a kikaikhawmte kiang ah zawlnei Shemaiah ahohtou a, akiang uah, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi, na hon lehngatsanta ua, huaiziak in ke'n leng noute Shishak khut ah ka hon koihta ahi achi," ava chi hi.
english: Now Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and to the princes of Judah, who were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said to them, “Yahweh says, ‘You have forsaken me, therefore I have also left you in the hand of Shishak.’”

paite: Huchi in Israel intekpen leh kumpipa akiniamkhiak ua, "TOUPA adiktat hi," achi uhi.
english: Then the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, “Yahweh is righteous.”

paite: TOUPA'N akiniamkhiak uh atheih in TOUPA thu Shemaiah kiang ah ahong tung a, "Akiniamkhiakta ua; ka hihmang vek kei ding a, khenkhat ka humbit ding a, Shishak zang in Jerusalem tung ah ka hehna ka sungbo kei ding.
english: When Yahweh saw that they humbled themselves, Yahweh’s word came to Shemaiah, saying, “They have humbled themselves. I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance, and my wrath won’t be poured out on Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

paite: Himahleh asikhate ahi ding ua, ka nasep leh gamdangmi nasepdan atheihna ding un," chi in.
english: Nevertheless they will be his servants, that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.”

paite: Huchi in Aigupta kumpipa Shishak Jerusalem sim in apaitou a, TOUPA' inn a goute leh kumpipa' inn a goute ala a; ala khin vek hi; Solomon bawl dangka-eng lumte leng ala hi.
english: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem and took away the treasures of Yahweh’s house and the treasures of the king’s house. He took it all away. He also took away the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

paite: Kumpipa Rehoboam in huaite tang in dal lumte abawl a, kumpipa' inn kongkhak ngakmi sepaih heutute akemsak hi.
english: King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who kept the door of the king’s house.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa TOUPA' inn a lut teng in veng mite'n ava pi ua, amah dantan ah akhakik nawn zel uhi.
english: As often as the king entered into Yahweh’s house, the guard came and bore them, then brought them back into the guard room.

paite: Akiniamkhiak ziak a hihmanthat ahihlouhna ding in atung a TOUPA thangpaihna akiheimangta a; Judah gam leng ahoih gige hi.
english: When he humbled himself, Yahweh’s wrath turned from him, so as not to destroy him altogether. Moreover, there were good things found in Judah.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Rehoboam in avaihawmna Jerusalem ah akipsakta hi: Rehoboam in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmli-le-khat a upa ahi, TOUPA'N amin omsakna ding a Israel nam tengteng lak a atel khopi Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-sagih vai ahawm a; anu min Naamah, Ammon mi ahi.
english: So King Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem and reigned; for Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which Yahweh had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.

paite: TOUPA zong dia alungsim azat louh ziak in thil hoih lou ahih hi.
english: He did that which was evil, because he didn’t set his heart to seek Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in Rehoboam tanchin abul a kipan atawp pha in zawlnei Shemaiah gelh tanchinbu ah leh zawlnei Iddo gelh tanchinbu a suante tanchin lak a gelh ahi kei maw? Rehoboam leh Jeroboam bel a kidou nilouh uhi.
english: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, aren’t they written in the histories of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer, in the genealogies? There were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

paite: Huan Rehoboam api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, David khua ah avui ua: asik in atapa Abijah in vai ahawm hi.
english: Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in David’s city; and Abijah his son reigned in his place.

paite: Jeroboam kum sawm-le-giat avaihawm kum in Judahte tung ah Abijah in vai ahawm pan hi.
english: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, Abijah began to reign over Judah.

paite: Jerusalem ah kum thum vai ahawm a, anu min Mikaiah, Gibeah mi Uriel tanu ahi. Huan Abijah leh Jeroboam bel akidou uhi.
english: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

paite: Abijah in sepaih kidoumi, mihangsan telkhiak nuaili toh ava sual a, Jeroboam mihat hangsan telkhiak nuaigiat kiphalh in ana dou uhi.
english: Abijah joined battle with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men; and Jeroboam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, who were mighty men of valor.

paite: Abijah bel Ephraim tanggam a om Zemariam tang tung ah adingh a, "Aw Jeroboam, Israelte tengteng toh na ngaikhia un;
english: Abijah stood up on Mount Zemaraim, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, and said, “Hear me, Jeroboam and all Israel:

paite: TOUPA Israel' Pathian in Israel gam David leh atate kiang a chi a thukhun in tangtawn a ding in apia chih thei dia kilawm mahmah hilou na hi uh maw?
english: Ought you not to know that Yahweh, the God of Israel, gave the kingdom over Israel to David forever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?

paite: Himahleh Nebat tapa Jeroboam, David tapa Solomon sikha apu tung ah ahong hel maimah hi.
english: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, rose up, and rebelled against his lord.

paite: Rehoboam anaupang lai a, alungsim anem lai a, amaute ana nan theih louh lai in Solomon tapa Rehoboam kalh in mithulim lou Belial tate akikaikhawm uhi.
english: Worthless men were gathered to him, wicked fellows who strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tender hearted, and could not withstand them.
