paite: "David tapa lak ah TOUPA gam dou theih na kigingta kei ua: tamkuam leng hi ua, Jeroboam in pathiante ding a nou ahon bawlsak dangka-eng bawngnou limte leng na kiang uah a-om lai hi.
english: “Now you intend to withstand the kingdom of Yahweh in the hand of the sons of David. You are a great multitude, and the golden calves which Jeroboam made you for gods are with you.

paite: TOUPA siampu, Aaron tapate leh Levite delhkhia in, gamdang mite hihdan bang in siampu na kibawl uh ahi kei maw? Huchi in bawngtuai leh belam sagih a hong kilan peuhmahte pathian hiloupite siampu ahi thei zel mawk uhi.
english: Haven’t you driven out the priests of Yahweh, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and made priests for yourselves according to the ways of the peoples of other lands? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams may be a priest of those who are no gods.

paite: "Himahleh kou zaw, ka Pathian uh TOUPA ahi a, amah ka lehngatsan kei ua: TOUPA a dia nasemmi amau nna chiat sem Aaron tapa siampute leh Levite ka nei uhi.
english: “But as for us, Yahweh is our God, and we have not forsaken him. We have priests serving Yahweh, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites in their work.

paite: Ni teng leh zan teng in TOUPA a ding in halmang thillatte, gimlimte ahal zel uh, tanghou siah leng dohkan siangthou ah akoih kichian gige uhi. Nitaklam teng a hal ding in dangka-eng khawnvak koihna akhawnvak toh; kou zaw TOUPA ka Pathian uh thupiak ka zui gige ua, nou bel amah na lehngatsan uhi.
english: They burn to Yahweh every morning and every evening burnt offerings and sweet incense. They also set the show bread in order on the pure table, and care for the gold lamp stand with its lamps, to burn every evening; for we keep the instruction of Yahweh our God, but you have forsaken him.

paite: Ngai dih ua, Pathian ka ma uh pi in ka kiang uah a-om a, asiampute leng apengkul ua nou hon noh ding a mut ding in a-om uhi. Aw, Israel suante aw TOUPA na pi-le-pute uh Pathian zaw dou mahmah kei un, na lamzang kei hial ding uh," achi hi.
english: Behold, God is with us at our head, and his priests with the trumpets of alarm to sound an alarm against you. Children of Israel, don’t fight against Yahweh, the God of your fathers; for you will not prosper.”

paite: Himahleh Jeroboam in anunglam uah aguktansak a: huchi in Judahte malam ah a-om ua, guktan mite anunglam uah a-om uh.
english: But Jeroboam caused an ambush to come about behind them; so they were before Judah, and the ambush was behind them.

paite: Judahte alehngat uleh anunglam uh leh amalam uah gal a-omta a, TOUPA asam ua, siampute'n pengkul amut uhi.
english: When Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind them; and they cried to Yahweh, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

paite: Huchi in Judahte akikou zuazua ua; huchi a Judahte akikou zuazua ualeh hichi ahong hi a, Abijah leh Judahte ma ah TOUPA'N Jeroboam leh Israelte tengteng avuallelsakta hi.
english: Then the men of Judah gave a shout. As the men of Judah shouted, God struck Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

paite: Israel suante Judahte ma ah ataikek ua, Pathian in akhut uah apeta hi.
english: The children of Israel fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hand.

paite: Huchi in Abijah leh aheute'n amau athat ua: Israel mitel ngen nuainga athat uhi.
english: Abijah and his people killed them with a great slaughter, so five hundred thousand chosen men of Israel fell down slain.

paite: Huai tung in Israel suante vuallelhdan huchibang ahi, Judah suante'n TOUPA apipute uh Pathian amuan ziak un azouta uhi.
english: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied on Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

paite: Huan Abijah in Jeroboam adelh a, akhuate alaksak a, Bethel akhotate toh, Jeshanah akhotate toh, Ephron akhotate toh.
english: Abijah pursued Jeroboam, and took cities from him: Bethel with its villages, Jeshanah with its villages, and Ephron with its villages.

paite: Abijah vaihawm lai nite in Jeroboam in dinkhiak zohna anei nawn kei; TOUPA'N agawt a, asita hi.
english: Jeroboam didn’t recover strength again in the days of Abijah. Yahweh struck him, and he died.

paite: Abijah bel ahat deuhdeuh a, zi sawm-le-li anei a, tapa sawmnih-le-nih leh tanu sawm-le-guk anei hi.
english: But Abijah grew mighty and took for himself fourteen wives, and became the father of twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.

paite: Abijah tanchin dangte leh a-omdante, athugente zawlnei Iddo hilhchetna bu ah gelh in a-om hi.
english: The rest of the acts of Abijah, his ways, and his sayings are written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo.

paite: Huchi in Abijah bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, David khopi ah avui ua, asik in atapa Asa in vai ahawmta hi. Avaihawm sung in agam uh kum sawm galmuang in a-om hi.
english: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Asa his son reigned in his place. In his days, the land was quiet ten years.

paite: Asa in TOUPA a Pathian mitmuh in thil hoih leh thil dik ahih gige hi.
english: Asa did that which was good and right in Yahweh his God’s eyes,

paite: Gamdang pathian maitamte leh mun sangte alamang a, suangphuhte ahihchim a, Asherah songte aphuk hi.
english: for he took away the foreign altars and the high places, broke down the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles,

paite: Judahte TOUPA apipute uh Pathian zong ding leh adan leh athupiak zui ding in thu apia hi.
english: and commanded Judah to seek Yahweh, the God of their fathers, and to obey his law and command.

paite: Huan Judahte khua tengteng a mun sangte leh milimte alamang vek a; amah nuai ah agam galmuang in a-om hi.
english: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the sun images; and the kingdom was quiet before him.

paite: Judah gam ah kulh nei khopite abawl a, gam galmuang in a-om a, huai kumte in kidouna anei kei; TOUPA'N galmuanna apiak ziak in.
english: He built fortified cities in Judah; for the land was quiet, and he had no war in those years, because Yahweh had given him rest.

paite: Judahte kiang ah, "Hiai khuate bawlpha nawn ni e, kulh in um lehang, insangte, kulh kongkhakte, akalhnate bawl ni: TOUPA i Pathian i zon tak ziak un gam i nuai uah ahong omta ahi: amah i zong ua, ama'n kil chih ning chih a galmuang a omna hon peta ahi,” achi hi. Huchi in abawlhoih ua, alamzang zelta uhi.
english: For he said to Judah, “Let’s build these cities and make walls around them, with towers, gates, and bars. The land is yet before us, because we have sought Yahweh our God. We have sought him, and he has given us rest on every side.” So they built and prospered.

paite: Asa in Judah mi lum leh tei tawimi sepaih nuaithum anei a: Benjamin mi phaw leh thal zangmi nuainih-le-singgiat; hiai tengteng mihat hangsan vek ahi uhi.
english: Asa had an army of three hundred thousand out of Judah who bore bucklers and spears, and two hundred eighty thousand out of Benjamin who bore shields and drew bows. All these were mighty men of valor.

paite: Huan Ethiopia mi Zerah, sepaih maktaduaikhat leh kangtalai zathum toh amau sual ding in ahong kuan a; Mareshah ahong tung hi.
english: Zerah the Ethiopian came out against them with an army of a million troops and three hundred chariots, and he came to Mareshah.

paite: Huchi in asual ding in Asa ava kuan a, Mareshah ah Zephathah Phaizang ah akiphalh uhi.
english: Then Asa went out to meet him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

paite: Asa in TOUPA a Pathian asam a, "TOUPA kia lou ngal mihattak lak a hat lou panpih a-om kei a; aw TOUPA ka Pathian uh, hon panpih ve; nang hon muang in na min in hiai mipite ka hong sual uhi. Aw TOUPA, ka Pathian uh na hi a, mihing in nang hon zou kei uhen,” achi hi.
english: Asa cried to Yahweh his God, and said, “Yahweh, there is no one besides you to help, between the mighty and him who has no strength. Help us, Yahweh our God; for we rely on you, and in your name we have come against this multitude. Yahweh, you are our God. Don’t let man prevail against you.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Asa leh Judahte ma ah Ethiopia mite asual a; Ethiopia mite ataikekta uhi.
english: So Yahweh struck the Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.

paite: Asa leh aheute'n Gerar tan in adelh ua, Ethiopia mite asih tam mahmah ziak un apang thei kei ua; TOUPA leh asepaihte ma ah vuallelhsak in a-omta ua; gallak tampi ala uhi.
english: Asa and the people who were with him pursued them to Gerar. So many of the Ethiopians fell that they could not recover themselves, for they were destroyed before Yahweh and before his army. Judah’s army carried away very much booty.

paite: Gerar kim a khua tengteng asual ua, TOUPA launa atung uah a-om a, khua tengteng alok ua, gallak atam ngial hi.
english: They struck all the cities around Gerar, for the fear of Yahweh came on them. They plundered all the cities, for there was much plunder in them.

paite: Ganpute' puaninte leng asual ua, belam leh sangawngsau tampi ahawl ua, Jerusalem ah apai nawnta uhi.
english: They also struck the tents of those who had livestock, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, then returned to Jerusalem.

paite: Oded tapa Azariah tung ah Pathian kha ahong tung hi.
english: The Spirit of God came on Azariah the son of Oded.

paite: Asa dawn ding in apaikhia a, akiang ah, "Asa leh Judah mi tengteng leh Benjamin mite aw, ka thu ngaikhe dih ua, alam a na pan sung teng un nou lam ah TOUPA apang, amah na zon uleh na mu ding ua, amah na lehngatsan uleh ama'n ahon lehngatsan ding.
english: He went out to meet Asa, and said to him, “Hear me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin! Yahweh is with you while you are with him; and if you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.

paite: Israel mite sawtpi Pathian tak nei lou leh sinsakmi leh siampu nei lou leh dan nei lou in a-om uhi.
english: Now for a long time Israel was without the true God, without a teaching priest, and without law.

paite: Himahleh, amangbat ua TOUPA Israel' Pathian lam angat ua, azontak un amu uhi.
english: But when in their distress they turned to Yahweh, the God of Israel, and sought him, he was found by them.

paite: Huai lai in apawt lam leh alut lamte a ding in galmuanna a-om kei a, gamsung a om tengteng a ding in mangbatna thupi mahmah ngen ahi zaw.
english: In those times there was no peace to him who went out, nor to him who came in; but great troubles were on all the inhabitants of the lands.

paite: Nam leh nam, khua leh khua akihihsia ua, Pathian in haksatna chiteng in ahaksasak hi.
english: They were broken in pieces, nation against nation, and city against city; for God troubled them with all adversity.

paite: Himahleh, nou zaw hattak in om unla, kithadahsak kei un, na thilhih man uh na mu ding uhi," achi hi.
english: But you be strong! Don’t let your hands be slack, for your work will be rewarded.”

paite: Huchi in Asa in huai thute leh zawlnei Oded thugente azak in akihangsak a, Judah gam leh Benjamin gam tengteng a kipan leh Ephraim tanggam a kholak a kipan athilkihhuaite apaimang vek a; TOUPA' inn lim chin a TOUPA maitam abawlhoih hi.
english: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominations out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from the hill country of Ephraim; and he renewed Yahweh’s altar that was before Yahweh’s porch.

paite: udah gam leh Benjamin gammi tengteng, akiang a om Ephraim leh Manasseh leh Simeon gam a mite toh asamkhawm vek a, TOUPA Pathian akiang ah a-om chih atheih un Israel gam a pan in ahong bel vek uhi.
english: He gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and those who lived with them out of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon; for they came to him out of Israel in abundance when they saw that Yahweh his God was with him.

paite: Huchi in Asa vaihawm akum sawm leh kum nga, akha thumna ah Jerusalem ah akikaikhawm uhi.
english: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign.

paite: Huai ni in agallak uh bawngtal zasagih leh belam sangsagih in TOUPA kiang ah akithoih uhi.
english: They sacrificed to Yahweh in that day, from the plunder which they had brought, seven hundred head of cattle and seven thousand sheep.

paite: Alungsim uh leh alungtang tengteng un TOUPA apipute uh Pathian zong ding leh;
english: They entered into the covenant to seek Yahweh, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul;

paite: kuapeuh TOUPA Israel' Pathian zong lou aneu leh alian, anumei apasal in hihlup ding thu akhung uhi.
english: and that whoever would not seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA kiang ah aw ngaihtak a ging in, akikou ua, pengkul ging toh, pengkul binei ging toh akichiam uhi.
english: They swore to Yahweh with a loud voice, with shouting, with trumpets, and with cornets.

paite: Judah mi tengteng akichiamna uah akipak ua, alungtangtak ua kichiam a, kituaktak a ahih ziak un, muh leng amu him ua; huchi in TOUPA'N mun chih ah galmuang a omna apia hi.
english: All Judah rejoiced at the oath, for they had sworn with all their heart and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found by them. Then Yahweh gave them rest all around.

paite: Kumpipa Asa nu Maakah leng milim kihhuaitak Asherah abawlsak ziak in akumpinu hihna atawpsak a; huchi in Asa in milim aphuk a, ahihzan vek a, Kidron lui ah ahal hi.
english: Also Maacah, the mother of Asa the king, he removed from being queen mother, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah; so Asa cut down her image, ground it into dust, and burned it at the brook Kidron.

paite: Himahleh, Israel gam a kipan mun sangte paihmang ahi kei a; himahleh Asa lungsim avaihawm sung in akizen gige hi.
english: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel; nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.

paite: Apa thillatte leh ama latte dangkasik, dangka-eng, tui-um belsuan Pathian inn ah alalut hi.
english: He brought the things that his father had dedicated and that he himself had dedicated, silver, gold, and vessels into God’s house.

paite: Asa vaihawm lai kum sawmthum-le-nga sung in kidou himhim a-om nawn kei hi.
english: There was no more war to the thirty-fifth year of Asa’s reign.

paite: Asa kum sawmthum-le-guk avaihawm kum in Israel kumpipa Baasha in Judahte asual a, Judah kumpipa kiang a lut ding leh pawt ding dalna ding in Ramah khua abawl hi.
english: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa’s reign, Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

paite: Huchi in Asa in TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn a gou dangkasik leh dangka-engte alakhia a, Damaskas a Siria kumpipa Ben-hadad kiang ah,
english: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of Yahweh’s house and of the king’s house, and sent to Ben Hadad king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,

paite: "Ka pa leh na pa kal a thukhun a-om bang mah in i kikal ah thukhun a-om a, ngai dih, dangkasik leh dangka-engte ka hon khak ahi; kisa dih, Israel kumpipa Baasha in ahon tawpsanna ding in akiang ah na thukhun phel nawn mai in," chi in akhak hi.
english: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, as there was between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent you silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”

paite: Huchi in Ben-hadad in kumpipa Asa thu ana pom a; Israel khuate sual ding in sepaih heutute asawl a, Ijon khua, Dan khua, Abel-maim khua, Naphtali gam a vankoihna khua tengteng asual uhi.
english: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they struck Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim, and all the storage cities of Naphtali.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Baasha in huai thu azak in Ramah khua abawl lai akhawlsan a, athilhih tup akikhelsakta hi.
english: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and let his work cease.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Asa in Judah mi tengteng api a. Baasha in Ramah khua bawlna ding a suang leh sing azatte ala vek ua, huaite in Geba leh Mizpah khua abawl hi.
english: Then Asa the king took all Judah, and they carried away the stones and timber of Ramah, with which Baasha had built; and he built Geba and Mizpah with them.

paite: Huai lai in zawlnei Hanani Judah kumpipa Asa kiang ah ahong a, akiang ah, "TOUPA na Pathian muang lou in Siria kumpipa na muang a, huaiziak in Siria kumpipa sepaihhonte na khahta ahi.
english: At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said to him, “Because you have relied on the king of Syria, and have not relied on Yahweh your God, therefore the army of the king of Syria has escaped out of your hand.

paite: Ethiopiate leh Libiate sepaihhon liantak, kangtalai leh sakol tungtuang mite tampi ahi kei uh maw? Himahleh TOUPA na muan ziak in na khut ah ahon pia hi.
english: Weren’t the Ethiopians and the Lubim a huge army, with chariots and exceedingly many horsemen? Yet, because you relied on Yahweh, he delivered them into your hand.

paite: Amah lam a lungsim diktak pu mite tung a ahatdan hihlang ding in leitung tengteng ah TOUPA mit avak dundun hi. Haihuai mahmah in thil na hihta a; tuban dou na nei gige ding," achi hi.
english: For Yahweh’s eyes run back and forth throughout the whole earth, to show himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. You have done foolishly in this; for from now on you will have wars.”

paite: Huchi in zawlnei tung ah Asa aheh a, suangkul ah akhumta a; athugen ziak in aheh mahmah mai hi. Asa in mi khenkhatte leng asimmoh behlap lai hi.
english: Then Asa was angry with the seer, and put him in the prison; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. Asa oppressed some of the people at the same time.

paite: Huan ngai dih ua, Asa tanchin abul a kipan a atawp pha in Judah leh Israel kumpipate tanchin gelhna bu ah gelh in a-om hi.
english: Behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

paite: Kum sawmthum-le-kua vai ahawm kum in Asa khe ahong na a; anatna thupitak ahi; himahleh anatna ah TOUPA zong lou in damdawi siamte azong zaw hi.
english: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign, Asa was diseased in his feet. His disease was exceedingly great; yet in his disease he didn’t seek Yahweh, but just the physicians.

paite: Huchi in api-le-pute kiang ah Asa a-ihmu a, kum sawmli-le-khat avaihawm kum in asita hi.
english: Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the forty-first year of his reign.

paite: David khopi a amah a tuam dia ahankhuk ah avui ua, gimlimtak, gimlim bawl mite'n gimlim chí tuamtuam a dim a kibawl lupna ah asial ua, amah zahtakna in meikuang thupi mahmah asem uhi.
english: They buried him in his own tomb, which he had dug out for himself in David’s city, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odors and various kinds of spices prepared by the perfumers’ art; and they made a very great fire for him.

paite: Asik in atapa Jehoshaphat alal a, Israel mite dou ding in akihihhat hi.
english: Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place, and strengthened himself against Israel.

paite: Huchi in Judah gam a kulh nei khopi tengteng ah sepaih akoih a; Judah gam leh apa Asa in ana lak Ephraim gam a khuate ah galvilmi akoih hi.
english: He placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

paite: Huan Jehoshaphat kiang ah TOUPA a-om a; Baal zong lou a, apu David in atot masaksa lampi tawn a,
english: Yahweh was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and didn’t seek the Baals,

paite: apipute uh Pathian zong a, Israel mite hih bang hih lou a, athupiakte azuih zawk ziak in.
english: but sought the God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not in the ways of Israel.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N akhut ah agam ahihkip a, huchi in Judah gammi tengteng in Jehoshaphat kipahman ahong pia ua, ahong hau in athupi hiaihiai hi.
english: Therefore Yahweh established the kingdom in his hand. All Judah brought tribute to Jehoshaphat, and he had riches and honor in abundance.

paite: TOUPA lam ah alungsim a-awn a, Judah gam a kipan mun sangte leh Asherahte aphiatmang vek hi.
english: His heart was lifted up in the ways of Yahweh. Furthermore, he took away the high places and the Asherah poles out of Judah.

paite: Kum thum avaihawm kum in amilian Benhail, Obadiah, Zekariah, Nathanael, Mikaiah, Judah gam khuate a mite sinsak ding in asawlkhia a;
english: Also in the third year of his reign he sent his princes, even Ben Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah;

paite: Levi mi, Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, Tobadonijah atel tei ua, siampu Elishama leh Jehoramte leng atel uhi.
english: and with them Levites, even Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, the Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.

paite: TOUPA Dan Bu atawi ua, Judah gam ah asinsak ua, Judah gam khua tengteng tawn in mite asinsak uhi.
english: They taught in Judah, having the book of Yahweh’s law with them. They went about throughout all the cities of Judah and taught among the people.

paite: Huchi in Judah gam leh akim gam tengteng a mite'n TOUPA laudan asiam ua, kuamah in Jehoshaphat adou ngam kei uhi.
english: The fear of Yahweh fell on all the kingdoms of the lands that were around Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.

paite: Philistia mi khenkhat in Jehoshaphat kipahman ahong pia ua, siah ding in dangkasik leng ape lai uh; Arabia mite'n ganhon, belamtal sangsagih-le-zasagih leh keltal sangsagih-le-zasagih ahon kai uhi.
english: Some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents and silver for tribute. The Arabians also brought him flocks: seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred male goats.

paite: Huchi in Jehoshaphat ahong thupi mahmah a, Judah gam ah kulhte leh thil koihkhawmna khuate abawl a, Judah gam khuate ah nasep tampi anei hi.
english: Jehoshaphat grew great exceedingly; and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah.

paite: Jerusalem ah sepaih mihat hangsante ahau behlap lai hi.
english: He had many works in the cities of Judah; and men of war, mighty men of valor, in Jerusalem.

paite: A-inkuankuan ua a-omdan uh hichibang ahi: Judah inkuan a sangkhat heutute, heutu Adnah in mihat hangsan nuaithum aheu hi.
english: This was the numbering of them according to their fathers’ houses: From Judah, the captains of thousands: Adnah the captain, and with him three hundred thousand mighty men of valor;

paite: Azom Jehohanan in nuainih-le-singgiat aheu hi.
english: and next to him Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred eighty thousand;

paite: Azom nawn Zikri tapa Amasiah bel kiphaltak a TOUPA a ding a kipia in, mihat hangsan nuainih aheu hi.
english: and next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself to Yahweh, and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valor.

paite: Benjamin inkuante mihat hangsan Eliada in thal leh lum zangmi nuainih aheu hi.
english: From Benjamin: Eliada, a mighty man of valor, and with him two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield;

paite: Azom Jehozabad in galkap ding a mansiangsa nuaikhat- le-singgiat aheu hi.
english: and next to him Jehozabad, and with him one hundred eighty thousand ready and prepared for war.

paite: Hiai tengteng Judah gam a kulh nei khopi a kumpipa'n akoihte sim louh akumpipa kiang a om gigete ahi uh.
english: These were those who waited on the king, in addition to those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.

paite: Huchi in Jehoshaphat bel hong hau in athupi mahmah a, huchi in Ahab toh kizopna abawl hi.
english: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honor in abundance; and he allied himself with Ahab.

paite: Kum bangzah hiam nung in Samaria ah Ahab kiang ah ahohsuk a, Ahab in amah leh aheute belam leh bawngtalte tampi ana goh a, Ramoth-gilead a hohtouhpih ding in achial hi.
english: After some years, he went down to Ahab to Samaria. Ahab killed sheep and cattle for him in abundance, and for the people who were with him, and moved him to go up with him to Ramoth Gilead.

paite: Israel kumpipa Ahab in Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ramoth-gilead ah i hohtoukhawm kei dia hia?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Kei leh nang, ka mite leh na mite pum khat i hi ua, gal i doukhawm ding uh," achi hi.
english: Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, “Will you go with me to Ramoth Gilead?” He answered him, “I am as you are, and my people as your people. We will be with you in the war.”

paite: Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "TOUPA thu hungaih phot lai in," achi hi.
english: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for Yahweh’s word.”

paite: Huchi in Israel kumpipa'n, zawlneite mi zali asamkhawm a, akiang uah, "Ramoth-gilead khua sual ding in ka kuan ding uam, kuan lou ding?" achi hi. Amau, "Kuan in, Pathian in kumpipa khut ah ape ding," achi uhi.
english: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, four hundred men, and said to them, “Shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?” They said, “Go up, for God will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

paite: Himahleh Jehoshaphat in, "TOUPA zawlnei kuate hiam i dot ding a-om kei ua eita aw?" achi hi.
english: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there here a prophet of Yahweh besides, that we may inquire of him?”

paite: Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "TOUPA hon dotsak ding mi khat a-om; himahleh amah bel ka muhdah lamtak ahi; ka tungtang thu ahoih lou lam kia lou ngal ahoih lam himhim agen ngei kei a; huai mi bel Imla tapa Mikaiah ahi," achi hi.
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of Yahweh; but I hate him, for he never prophesies good concerning me, but always evil. He is Micaiah the son of Imla.” Jehoshaphat said, “Don’t let the king say so.”

paite: Huchi in Israel kumpipa'n heutu khat asam a, "Imla tapa Mikaiah hon pi meng dih," achi hi.
english: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Get Micaiah the son of Imla quickly.”

paite: Israel kumpipa leh Judah kumpipa Samaria kulh kongpi lutna chin mun awng ah akumpi puan ua kizem in alaltutphah tuaktuak uah atu ua; zawlnei tengteng in ama uah thu agen uhi.
english: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah each sat on his throne, arrayed in their robes, and they were sitting in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.

paite: Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in sik kiite abawl a, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hiaite in Siriate mangthang sipsip khop in na sual ding achi," achi hi.
english: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron and said, “Yahweh says, ‘With these you shall push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’”

paite: Huchi mah bang in zawlnei dangte'n leng, "Ramoth-gilead ah hoh inla, lamzang in; TOUPA'N kumpipa khut ah ape ding hi," chi in agen uhi.
english: All the prophets prophesied so, saying, “Go up to Ramoth Gilead, and prosper; for Yahweh will deliver it into the hand of the king.”

paite: Mikaiah sam dia asawlpa un, "Ngai dih, zawlneite'n kithutuaktak in ahoih lam in kumpipa kiang ah thu agen chiat ua; huaiziak in nang leng achihsa bang un ahoih lam in va gen sam dih ve," chi in agen hi.
english: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Let your word therefore, please be like one of theirs, and speak good.”

paite: Huan Mikaiah in, "TOUPA ahin bang in ka chi hi, ka Pathian in achih bang geih in ahi ka gen ding," achi hi.
english: Micaiah said, “As Yahweh lives, I will say what my God says.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa kiang atun in kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Mikaiah, Ramoth-gilead khua sual ding in ka kuan ding uam, kuan lou ding?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Kuan unla, va lamzang un, na khut a piak ahi ding hi," achi hi.
english: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?” He said, “Go up, and prosper. They shall be delivered into your hand.”

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Thutak keleu lou ka kiang ah TOUPA min a gen lou ding in bangzah vei ahia nang ka hon kichiamsak ding?" achi hi.
english: The king said to him, “How many times shall I adjure you that you speak to me nothing but the truth in Yahweh’s name?”

paite: Ama'n, "Belamchingtu nei lou bang in Israel tengteng tang ah dalhzak in ka mu a; TOUPA'N, hiaite'n heutu anei kei ua, amau inn lam ah lungmuangtak in pai diam uhen achi," achi hi.
english: He said, “I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. Yahweh said, ‘These have no master. Let them each return to his house in peace.’”

paite: Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ka tungtang thu zaw aselam kia lou ngal ahoih lam himhim ahihleh agen sam kei ding chih ka hon hilh ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “Didn’t I tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?”

paite: Mikaiah in agen nawn a, "TOUPA thu ngaikhia un, TOUPA alaltutphah a tu, van mipite tengteng ataklam leh aveilam a dingh ka mu hi.
english: Micaiah said, “Therefore hear Yahweh’s word: I saw Yahweh sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.

paite: TOUPA'N Ramoth-gilead a Israel kumpipa Ahab kuantou a, va si ding a kua'n ahia khem ding? achih chiang in khat in, 'Huchi khachi in' achi a, midang in, 'Huchibang khachibang in' achi hi.
english: Yahweh said, ‘Who will entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One spoke saying in this way, and another saying in that way.

paite: Kha khat ahong pawt a, TOUPA ma a dingh in, 'Ke'n ka khem ding,' achi hi. TOUPA'N akiang ah, 'Bang in eita?' achi hi.
english: A spirit came out, stood before Yahweh, and said, ‘I will entice him.’ “Yahweh said to him, ‘How?’

paite: Ama'n, 'Ka va hoh ding a, zawlneite tengteng kam ah kha zuauthei in ka va suak ding,' achi hi. Huan ama'n, 'Na va khem ngei ding a, na lohching ding, kuan inla, huchibang in hih in,' " achi hi.
english: “He said, ‘I will go, and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ “He said, ‘You will entice him, and will prevail also. Go and do so.’

paite: Huchi in ngai dih, TOUPA'N, "Hiai zawlneite kam ah kha zuauthei akoih a; na tungthu TOUPA'N ahoih lou lam in agenta ahi," achi hi.
english: “Now therefore, behold, Yahweh has put a lying spirit in the mouth of these your prophets; and Yahweh has spoken evil concerning you.”

paite: Huaitak in Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in ava naih a, Mikaiah biang ah abeng a, "Na kiang a thugen ding TOUPA kha in koilam a hon pawtsan ahia?" achi hi.
english: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did Yahweh’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”

paite: Mikaiah in, "Ngai dih, dantan sunggil a bu ding a na lut ni chiang in na hon thei ding," achi hi.
english: Micaiah said, “Behold, you shall see on that day, when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”

paite: Huchi in Israel kumpipa'n, "Mikaiah pi unla, kho ukpa Ammon leh kumpipa tapa kiang ah paipih nawn un.
english: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;

paite: Kumpipa'n hichi in achi a, 'Hiai mi suangkul ah khum unla, lungmuangtak a ka hong pai nawn masiah gimthuakna an leh gimthuakna tui pia un,' achi a, na chi ding uh," achi hi.
english: and say, ‘The king says, “Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.”’”

paite: Huan Mikaiah in, "Lungmuang- tak a na hong pai nawn peuhmahleh TOUPA'N kei hon zang a thu gen lou ahi ding hi," achi a, amah mah in, "Nou mipi tengteng in leng na za un," achi hi.
english: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, Yahweh has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, you people, all of you!”

paite: Ramoth-gilead ah Israel kumpipa leh Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat ava hohtou uhi.
english: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.

paite: Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Kei ka kibawl lamdang ding a, kisualna ah ka hoh sam ding; nang zaw na kumpipa puan kisilh in," achi hi. Huchi in Israel kumpipa bel akibawl lamdang a, kidouna ah ahohtou hi.
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “I will disguise myself, and go into the battle; but you put on your robes.” So the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went into the battle.

paite: Siria kumpipa'n akangtalaite tung a heutute kiang ah, "Israel kumpipa lou ngal mineu leng milian leng na sual ding uh ahi kei," chi in thu apia hi.
english: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, "Kangtalai tung a heutute'n Jehoshaphat amuh uleh Israel kumpipa ahi ve," achi ua. Huchi in sual tum in a-umta uhi; himahleh Jehoshaphat akikou a, TOUPA'N apanpihta a, huchi in Pathian in amau amah anusesak hi.
english: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “It is the king of Israel!” Therefore they turned around to fight against him. But Jehoshaphat cried out, and Yahweh helped him; and God moved them to depart from him.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, kangtalai tung a heutute'n Israel kumpipa ahi kei chih atheih un delh nawn lou in akiksanta uhi.
english: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.

paite: Mi khat in ngim tuam nei lou in athalpeu alai a, Israel kumpipa a-awmphaw leh a-awmphaw kikal ah akha a, huchi in akangtalai hawlpa kiang ah, "Lehhawl inla, mipi lak a kipan hon paikhiakpih in, liamna natak ka tuak hi," achi hi.
english: A certain man drew his bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor. Therefore he said to the driver of the chariot, “Turn around and carry me out of the battle, for I am severely wounded.”

paite: Huai ni in kisualna athupi mahmah a; Israel kumpipa bel Siriate lam nga in akangtalai ah nitaklam tanpha in adingh a; huan nitum kuan in asita hi.
english: The battle increased that day. However, the king of Israel propped himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the evening; and at about sunset, he died.

paite: Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat bel lungmuangtak in Jerusalem a a-inn ah apai nawnta hi.
english: Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in zawlnei Hanani tapa Jehu in ana dawn a, kumpipa Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Migilou na panpih in ToUPA ho mite na it ding ahi maw? Hiai ziak in TOUPA thangpaihna, na tung ah ahong omta hi.
english: Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to King Jehoshaphat, “Should you help the wicked, and love those who hate Yahweh? Because of this, wrath is on you from before Yahweh.

paite: Himahleh hiai gam a kipan Asherah na paimang a, TOUPA na zon ziak in hoihna lam banghiam khat na nei lai hi," achi hi.
english: Nevertheless there are good things found in you, in that you have put away the Asheroth out of the land, and have set your heart to seek God.”

paite: Jehoshaphat bel Jerusalem ah a-om a; huan Beer-sheba a kipan a Ephraim tanggam pha in amite lak ah ahoh nawn a, TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian lam ah ama'n apikik nawn vek hi.
english: Jehoshaphat lived at Jerusalem; and he went out again among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim, and brought them back to Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

paite: Huchi in kho chih ah Judah gam kulh nei khopi tengteng ah vaihawmte akoih a, vaihawmte kiang ah,
english: He set judges in the land throughout all the fortified cities of Judah, city by city,

paite: "Na thilhih uh hoihtak a ngaihtuah in hih un, mihing a ding a vaihawm na hi kei ua, TOUPA a ding ahi zaw ngal a; vaihawmna ah na kiang uah atel zel ahi.
english: and said to the judges, “Consider what you do, for you don’t judge for man, but for Yahweh; and he is with you in the judgment.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA lau unla, pilvangtak in hih un; TOUPA i Pathian ah gitlouhna, khentuam neihna leh golh neknate a-om kei," achi hi.
english: Now therefore let the fear of Yahweh be on you. Take heed and do it; for there is no iniquity with Yahweh our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of bribes.”

paite: Huchi in Jehoshaphat in Jerusalem a ahong kik nawn un TOUPA vaihawm ding leh thubuaite lemmi ding in Levite, siampute, Israel inkuan makaite akoih behlap hi.
english: Moreover in Jerusalem Jehoshaphat appointed certain Levites, priests, and heads of the fathers’ households of Israel to give judgment for Yahweh and for controversies. They returned to Jerusalem.

paite: "TOUPA laudan siam kawm in muanhuaitak in, lungsim diktak pu in na hih ding uh ahi.
english: He commanded them, saying, “You shall do this in the fear of Yahweh, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.

paite: Koi lai khua a mi in leng thubuai ahong gen ua, tualthah thu, dan leh thupiak thu, dan thuseh leh vaihawm thute a hong kilan uleh, TOUPA tung a thil ahihkhelhlouhna ding un amau pilvangtak in na hilh ding ua, nou leh na unaute uh tung ah thangpaihna ahong tung zenhouh kha ding; huchibang in hih le uchin, mohsak in na om kei ding uhi.
english: Whenever any controversy comes to you from your brothers who dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and ordinances, you must warn them, that they not be guilty toward Yahweh, and so wrath come on you and on your brothers. Do this, and you will not be guilty.

paite: "Huan ngai dih ua, TOUPA lam thu tengteng ah siampu lianpen Amariah bel na heutu uh ahi a; kumpipa lam thu tengteng ah Judah inkote tung a vaihawmmi Ishmael tapa Zebadiah ahi: Levite leng na heutute uh ahi sam ding uh. Hangtak in hih unla, mihoihte kiang ah TOUPA om hen," achi hi.
english: Behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of Yahweh; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, in all the king’s matters. Also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and may Yahweh be with the good.”

paite: Huan Solomon in TOUPA min a ding inn leh kumpipa inn ding toh lam atum hi.
english: Now Solomon decided to build a house for Yahweh’s name, and a house for his kingdom.

paite: Solomon in van po ding mi singsagih leh mual a singphukmi singgiat leh amau vengmi sangthum-le-zaguk asep hi.
english: Solomon counted out seventy thousand men to bear burdens, eighty thousand men who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred to oversee them.

paite: Solomon in Tura kumpipa Huram kiang ah, "Ka pa David thil na hihsak a, a-omna inn lamna ding sidarte na khak bang in, kei leng hon kithuahpih sam in.
english: Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, “As you dealt with David my father, and sent him cedars to build him a house in which to dwell, so deal with me.

paite: Ngai dih, TOUPA ka Pathian min a-inn amah a dia lam a, ama a gimlim hal a, tanghou siah koih gige a, Sabbathte, kha thakte, TOUPA ka Pathian ankuanglui nite a zingsang leh nitak a halmang thillat latna ding inn ka lam ding ahi. Hiaite Israelte a ding in tangtawn thupiak ahi.
english: Behold, I am about to build a house for the name of Yahweh my God, to dedicate it to him, to burn before him incense of sweet spices, for the continual show bread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts of Yahweh our God. This is an ordinance forever to Israel.

paite: Huchi in ka inn lam tup athupi mahmah ding ahi; pathian tengteng sang a ka Pathian uh thupizaw ahih ziak in.
english: “The house which I am building will be great, for our God is greater than all gods.

paite: Van, vante van ah leng ta lou ahi ngal a, kua'n ahia a-inn lamsak thei ding? Kei, ama a gimlim halna ding lel chih louh ngal kei leltak in ka lamsak thei mahmah dia hia?
english: But who is able to build him a house, since heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain him? Who am I then, that I should build him a house, except just to burn incense before him?

paite: Huchi in Judah gam leh Jerusalem a mikhutsiamte ka pa David in ana zatsek, tu in ka kiang a omte lak a sem ding in mi khat, dangka-eng, dangkasik, dal, sik lam khoih thei, puan sandup, san-au, dumpuang bawl siam, gelh bangchibang peuh siam mi hon sawl in.
english: “Now therefore send me a man skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, and in purple, crimson, and blue, and who knows how to engrave engravings, to be with the skillful men who are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father provided.

paite: Lebanon a sidar sing, meilah sing, algum sing leng hon khak lechin; na mite'n Lebanon a singphuk asiam mahmah uh chih ka thei ngal a; huchi in ngai dih, ka mite nang mite lak ah tel sam le uh,
english: “Send me also cedar trees, cypress trees, and algum trees out of Lebanon, for I know that your servants know how to cut timber in Lebanon. Behold, my servants will be with your servants,

paite: sing tampi hon ngaihtuahsak ding: ka inn lam tup athupi mahmah ding ahi.
english: even to prepare timber in abundance for me; for the house which I am about to build will be great and wonderful.

paite: Ngai dih, na singphuk mite huit buh pota a singnih leh barli buh pota singnih leh uain bath singnih leh thau bath singnih ka pe ding," chi in mi asawl hi.
english: Behold, I will give to your servants, the cutters who cut timber, twenty thousand cors of beaten wheat, twenty thousand baths of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.”

paite: Huchi in Tura kumpipa Huram in, "TOUPA'N amite a-it ziak in akumpipa ding ua nang hon bawl ei ve," chi in lai khak in Solomon adawng hi.
english: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, “Because Yahweh loves his people, he has made you king over them.”

paite: Huram in, "TOUPA, Israel' Pathian, lei leh van bawlpa, TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn lam ding a pilna leh theihna nei tapa piltak kumpipa David pepa phat in om hen.
english: Huram continued, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given to David the king a wise son, endowed with discretion and understanding, who would build a house for Yahweh and a house for his kingdom.

paite: Mikhutsiam, theihtheihna nei, ka pa Huram amah mah, ka hon sawl a,
english: Now I have sent a skillful man, endowed with understanding, Huram-abi,

paite: Dan suan a mi numei khat tapa ngei, apa bel Tura a mi, dangka-eng lam, dangkasik lam, dal lam, sik lam, suang lam, sing lam, puan sandup, dumpuang, puanmalngat, sandang khoihsa, gelh bangchibang leng siam, siam chiteng siam ahi a; nang mikhutsiamte leh ka pu, na pa David khutsiamte lak ah ahong sem ding uhi.
english: the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan; and his father was a man of Tyre. He is skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, in stone, in timber, in purple, in blue, in fine linen, and in crimson, also to engrave any kind of engraving and to devise any device, that there may be a place appointed to him with your skillful men, and with the skillful men of my lord David your father.

paite: Huchi in huit buh, barli buh, thau, uain thu ka toupa'n agen asikhate hon khak hen.
english: “Now therefore, the wheat, the barley, the oil, and the wine which my lord has spoken of, let him send to his servants;

paite: Huchi in kou Lebanon a sing na deih zahzah ka na phuk ding ua, tuipi ah Jopa tan in ka hon tolhsak ding uh; huan, nang Jerusalem ah na nawntou ding hi," achi hi.
english: and we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as you need. We will bring it to you in rafts by sea to Joppa; then you shall carry it up to Jerusalem.”

paite: Huan Solomon in Israel gam a apa David in asimsa, namdangmi tengteng asim a, nuaikhat singnga sangthum-le-zaguk ahi uh.
english: Solomon counted all the foreigners who were in the land of Israel, after the census with which David his father had counted them; and they found one hundred fifty-three thousand six hundred.

paite: Huchi in van po ding mi singsagih leh tang a singphukmi singgiat leh mipite sepdan ngaihtuahsak ding mi sangthum-le-zaguk asep hi.
english: He set seventy thousand of them to bear burdens, eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred overseers to assign the people their work.

paite: Huai nung in hichi ahong hi a, Moab suante leh Ammon suante khenkhat toh Jehoshaphat sual ding in ahong kuan uhi.
english: After this, the children of Moab, the children of Ammon, and with them some of the Meunites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.

paite: Huchi in kuate hiam in Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Nang sual ding in mipi thupi mahmah, tuipi gal Siria a kipan ahong kuan uhi; ngai in, Hazazon-tamar ah a-omta ua, huai 'Engedi' leng achi uh," chi in agen uhi.
english: Then some came who told Jehoshaphat, saying, “A great multitude is coming against you from beyond the sea from Syria. Behold, they are in Hazazon Tamar” (that is, En Gedi).

paite: Jehoshaphat alau a, TOUPA zong ding in akipia a; Judah gam tengteng ah an ngawl ding thu athangsak hi.
english: Jehoshaphat was alarmed, and set himself to seek Yahweh. He proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.

paite: Huchi in Judahte bel TOUPA panpihna zong in akikaikhawm ua; Judah kho chih a kipan TOUPA zong ding in ahong pawtkhia uhi.
english: Judah gathered themselves together to seek help from Yahweh. They came out of all the cities of Judah to seek Yahweh.

paite: Jehoshaphat TOUPA' inn ah, intual thak chin ah Judah leh Jerusalem kikaikhawm lak ah adingh a;
english: Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem, in Yahweh’s house, before the new court;

paite: "Aw TOUPA ka pi-le-pute uh Pathian, van Pathian, van a Pathian na hi kei a hia? Namte' lalgam tung a vaihawmpa na hi kei a hia? Na khut ah thilhihtheihna leh hatna a-om a, kuamah zoh vual na hi kei hi.
english: and he said, “Yahweh, the God of our fathers, aren’t you God in heaven? Aren’t you ruler over all the kingdoms of the nations? Power and might are in your hand, so that no one is able to withstand you.

paite: Aw ka Pathian uh, hiai gam a tengte na mi Israelte na ma ah na delhkhiaksak a, na lawm Abraham suante tangtawn a dia na piak ahi kei maw?
english: Didn’t you, our God, drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Israel, and give it to the offspring of Abraham your friend forever?

paite: Hiai gam ah ahong omta ua, na min a ding in mun siangthou ahon lamsak uhi.
english: They lived in it, and have built you a sanctuary in it for your name, saying,

paite: Ka tung uah thil hoih lou, namsau a vaihawmnate hiam, hiite hiam, kialte hiam ahong tunleh hiai inn ma leh nangmah ma ah ka hong dingh ding ua, hiai inn ah lah na min a-om ngal a, ka mangbatna uah nang ka hon sam ding ua, nang na hon na ngaihkhiaksak in na hon hondam ding," chi in.
english: ‘If evil comes on us—the sword, judgment, pestilence, or famine—we will stand before this house, and before you (for your name is in this house), and cry to you in our affliction, and you will hear and save.’

paite: "Huchi in ngai in, Ammon suante leh Moabte leh Seir tang a mi, Israelte, Aigupta gam a kipan ahong paikhiak lai un, amau asim uh na phal kei a, amau a kipan akiheimang zaw ua, amau ahihmang kei uhi.
english: Now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir, whom you would not let Israel invade when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned away from them, and didn’t destroy them;

paite: Ka luah ding ua na hon piak gam a kipan hon delhkhe ding in ahong kuan uhi.
english: behold, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of your possession, which you have given us to inherit.

paite: Aw ka Pathian uh, atung ua vaihawm lou ding na hi maw? Mi huai zahzah hon sual ding a hong kuante lah na sualthei ding dan mahmah ka hi kei ua; alohna dan ka thei kei ua, nang lam ka hong nga zaw mai uhi,” achi hi.
english: Our God, will you not judge them? For we have no might against this great company that comes against us. We don’t know what to do, but our eyes are on you.”

paite: Judahte tengteng, anau neu chikchik uh, azite uh atate uh toh TOUPA ma ah adingh uhi.
english: All Judah stood before Yahweh, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.

paite: Huchi in mipi lak ah Jahajiel tung ah TOUPA kha ahong tung a, huai mi Zekariah tapa ahi a, huai mi Benaiah tapa ahi a, huai mi Jeiel tapa ahi a, huai mi Asaph suan Levi mi Mataniah tapa ahi.
english: Then Yahweh’s Spirit came on Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, the Levite, of the sons of Asaph, in the middle of the assembly;

paite: Ama'n, "Nou Judah gam a mi tengteng leh Jerusalem a teng tengteng leh nang Jehoshaphat, na ngaikhia un: TOUPA'N na kiang uah hichi in achi, 'Lau kei unla, huai mipi thupi mahmahte ziak in leng lunglel sam kei un; kidouna noute kidouna ahi kei a, Pathian kidouna ahi zaw ngal a.
english: and he said, “Listen, all Judah, and you inhabitants of Jerusalem, and you, King Jehoshaphat. Yahweh says to you, ‘Don’t be afraid, and don’t be dismayed because of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God’s.

paite: Zingchiang in va sual un; ngai dih ua, Ziz zottouhna ah ahong tou ua, Jeruel gamdai chin phaizang tawp lam ah na va mu ding uh.
english: Tomorrow, go down against them. Behold, they are coming up by the ascent of Ziz. You will find them at the end of the valley, before the wilderness of Jeruel.

paite: Hiai kidouna na sual uh akiphamoh kei ding: kiphalh unla, adin in dingh mai unla, nou lam a pang TOUPA hotdamna tak en gige un, Judah mite leh Jerusalem mite aw: lau kei unla, lunglel sam kei un, zingchiang in sual ding in kuan un, TOUPA lah nou lam ah apang ngal a,' " achi hi.
english: You will not need to fight this battle. Set yourselves, stand still, and see the salvation of Yahweh with you, O Judah and Jerusalem. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed. Go out against them tomorrow, for Yahweh is with you.’”

paite: Huchi in Jehoshaphat bel amai a lei si in akun a; Judah mite tengteng leh Jerusalem mite tengteng TOUPA bia in TOUPA ma ah akun uhi.
english: Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground; and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell down before Yahweh, worshiping Yahweh.

paite: Kohath suan leh Korah suan Levite aw ngaihtak a TOUPA Israel' Pathian phat ding in ahong dinghta uhi.
english: The Levites, of the children of the Kohathites and of the children of the Korahites, stood up to praise Yahweh, the God of Israel, with an exceedingly loud voice.

paite: Huchi in zingsang in zingkhang in athou ua, Tekoa gamdai ah alut ua; apai lai un Jehoshaphat adingh a, "Aw, Judah mite leh Jerusalem mite aw, ka thu ngaikhia un; TOUPA na Pathian uh ging unla, kiptak in dingh unla, azawlneite gingta un, hileh lamzangtak in na om ding uh," achi hi.
english: They rose early in the morning and went out into the wilderness of Tekoa. As they went out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, “Listen to me, Judah and you inhabitants of Jerusalem! Believe in Yahweh your God, so you will be established! Believe his prophets, so you will prosper.”

paite: Mipite ahanthawn khit in sepaihte ma a pai kawm a TOUPA pahtawina leh asiangthou kilawmdan phat ding a lasami dingte a sep hi, "Aw TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu gen un, azahngaihna lah tangtawn in a-om sin ngal a, chi un," achi hi.
english: When he had taken counsel with the people, he appointed those who were to sing to Yahweh and give praise in holy array as they go out before the army, and say, “Give thanks to Yahweh, for his loving kindness endures forever.”

paite: Huan la asak ua aphattak un Ammon suante, Moab suante, tang a mite Judate sual ding a hong kuante guktan ding mite TOUPA'N akoih a; avuallelta uhi.
english: When they began to sing and to praise, Yahweh set ambushers against the children of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, who had come against Judah; and they were struck.

paite: Ammon suante leh Moab suante'n Seir tang a omte thah chimih vek leh hihman sipsip tum in asualta uhi. Seir tang a mite ahihman khit un amau leh amau kihihman tum in akisual nilouh uhi.
english: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir to utterly kill and destroy them. When they had finished the inhabitants of Seir, everyone helped to destroy each other.

paite: Judahte'n gamdai etna mun sang ava tun uleh mipi lam a-en ua; ngai dih, misi luang lei ah apuk zengzung a, khat lel leng asuakta kei uhi.
english: When Judah came to the place overlooking the wilderness, they looked at the multitude; and behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and there were none who escaped.

paite: Huchi in Jehoshaphat leh aheute gallak la ding in ava hoh ua, alak uah sum-le-paite, puansilhte, suangmantamte ava mu ua, apuak zoh louh khop un ala ua, atam petmah a, ni thum tak gallak asek uhi.
english: When Jehoshaphat and his people came to take their plunder, they found among them in abundance both riches and dead bodies with precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away. They took plunder for three days, it was so much.

paite: Ani li ni in Berakah Phaizang ah akikhawm ua, huai ah TOUPA apahtawi ua; huaiziak in tutan in huai lai mun, Berakah Phaizang achi uhi.
english: On the fourth day, they assembled themselves in Beracah Valley, for there they blessed Yahweh. Therefore the name of that place was called “Beracah Valley” to this day.

paite: Huchi in Judah mi leh Jerusalem mi tengteng apai nawn ua Jehoshaphat in Jerusalem a nuamsatak a pai ding in ama uh akai hi; TOUPA'N amelmate uh tungthu a nuamsatak a a-omsak ziak in.
english: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, with Jehoshaphat in front of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for Yahweh had made them to rejoice over their enemies.

paite: Huchi in pekgingte, kaihgingte, pengkulte toh Jerusalem a TOUPA' inn atungtou uhi.
english: They came to Jerusalem with stringed instruments, harps, and trumpets to Yahweh’s house.

paite: TOUPA'N Israelte melma asual chih atheih un, gam chih a mite'n Pathian alauta uhi.
english: The fear of God was on all the kingdoms of the countries when they heard that Yahweh fought against the enemies of Israel.

paite: Huchi in Jehoshaphat gam galmuang in a-omta a; a Pathian in akimvel a mite lak a galmuanna apiak ziak in.
english: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet, for his God gave him rest all around.

paite: Jehoshaphat in Judah tung ah vai ahawmta a; kum sawmthum-le-nga a upa ahih in vaihawm apan a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-nga vai ahawm a; anu min Azubah, Silhi tanu ahi.
english: So Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah. He was thirty-five years old when he began to reign. He reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih hih in apa Asa lampi pialsan het lou in azui hi.
english: He walked in the way of Asa his father, and didn’t turn away from it, doing that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes.

paite: Himahleh mun sangte paihmang ahi kei a, mipite'n leng apipute uh Pathian tung ah alungtang uh anga tuan sam kei uh.
english: However the high places were not taken away, and the people had still not set their hearts on the God of their fathers.

paite: Huan ngai dih ua, Jehoshaphat thilhih tengteng abul a kipan atawp pha in Hanani tapa Jehu tanchin gelhna bu ah atuang a, Israel kumpite tanchinbu ah gelh in a-om hi.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Jehu the son of Hanani, which is included in the book of the kings of Israel.

paite: Huai nung in Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa Ahaziah, thil hoih loutak a hihsekpa akithutuahpih hi:
english: After this, Jehoshaphat king of Judah joined himself with Ahaziah king of Israel. The same did very wickedly.

paite: Tarshish lam a pai ding long abawlkhawm ua, Ezion-geber ah longte abawl uhi.
english: He joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish. They made the ships in Ezion Geber.

paite: Huchi in Mareshah mi Dodavah tapa Eliezer in Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ahaziah na kithuahpih ziak in TOUPA'N na thilhih tup ahon hihsiatsakta ahi," achi hi. Huchi in longte akise vek ua, Tarshish ah ahoh thei kei uhi.
english: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, “Because you have joined yourself with Ahaziah, Yahweh has destroyed your works.” The ships were wrecked, so that they were not able to go to Tarshish.

paite: Jehoshaphat api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, apute lak ah apu David khopi ah avui uhi. Asik in atapa Jehoram alalta hi.
english: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Jehoram his son reigned in his place.

paite: Ama'n unau, Jehoshaphat tapate anei a, Azariah, Jehiel, Zekariah, Azariahu, Mikael leh Shephatiah ahi uh. Hiai tengteng Israel kumpipa Jehoshaphat tapate vek ahi uhi.
english: He had brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat: Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, and Shephatiah. All these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.

paite: Apa un thil thupi taktak apia a, dangkasik, dangka-eng, thil mantam pipite, Judah gam a kulh nei khopite toh; himahleh gamte pen Jehoram apia a, ata upapen ahih ziak in.
english: Their father gave them great gifts of silver, of gold, and of precious things, with fortified cities in Judah; but he gave the kingdom to Jehoram, because he was the firstborn.

paite: Huchi in Jehoram in apa gam luah in ahong kihihhatta a, a-unaute tengteng namsau in Israelte lak a intek tampi toh athat vek hi.
english: Now when Jehoram had risen up over the kingdom of his father, and had strengthened himself, he killed all his brothers with the sword, and also some of the princes of Israel.

paite: Jehoram bel kum sawmthum-le-nih a upa ahih in vaihawm apan a: Jerusalem ah kum giat vai ahawm hi.
english: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

paite: Ahab inkote hih bang in Israel kumpipate lampi azui hi: Ahab tanu zi in anei hi. Huchi in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih loutak ahih hi.
english: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did Ahab’s house, for he had Ahab’s daughter as his wife. He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA'N David inkote ahihmang nuam kei; David kiang a thukhun ziak leh amah leh asuante tan a khawnvak neihsak thak ana chiam khit ziak in.
english: However Yahweh would not destroy David’s house, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a lamp to him and to his children always.

paite: Amah dam lai in Judahte lak a kipan Edomte ahel ua, kumpipa akibawltawm uh.
english: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.

paite: Huchi in Jehoram asepaih heutute leh akangtalai tengteng toh akuankhia a, zan in akuan a, amau leh kangtalai tung a heutute amau umkual Edomte asual hi.
english: Then Jehoram went there with his captains and all his chariots with him. He rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him, along with the captains of the chariots.

paite: Huchi in Edomte tuni tan in Judahte lak ah ahel lailai uh, huai lai mah in Libnah khote leng ahel uh; TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian alehngatsan ziak in.
english: So Edom has been in revolt from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time from under his hand, because he had forsaken Yahweh, the God of his fathers.

paite: Huan Judah gam tangte ah mun sang abawl a, Jerusalem mite a-angkawmsak a, Judahte apimang hi.
english: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and made the inhabitants of Jerusalem play the prostitute, and led Judah astray.

paite: Huchi in zawlnei Elijah a kipan akiang ah lai ahong tung a, "TOUPA, na pu David Pathian in hichi in achi, 'Na pa Jehoshaphat lampite na tawn kei a, Judahte kumpipa Asa lampite leng na zui kei hi.
english: A letter came to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, “Yahweh, the God of David your father, says, ‘Because you have not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat your father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,

paite: Israel kumpipate lampi na zui zaw a, Judahte leh Jerusalem a omte Ahab inkuan bang in ang na kawmsak a, na unau, na pa inkuante nang sang a hoihzaw na that lai hi.
english: but have walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and have made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to play the prostitute like Ahab’s house did, and also have slain your brothers of your father’s house, who were better than yourself,

paite: Ngai dih, TOUPA'N na mite, na tate, na zite, na gante hipi in agawt ding a;
english: behold, Yahweh will strike your people with a great plague, including your children, your wives, and all your possessions;

paite: gilpi natna thupi mahmah na nei ding a, niteng in natna ziak a na ngoi teng atolhkhiak vek tan in na chi ana ding, " chi in.
english: and you will have great sickness with a disease of your bowels, until your bowels fall out by reason of the sickness, day by day.’”

paite: Huchi in Ethiopia mite kiang a mi Philistiate leh Arabiate lungsim Jehoram sual ding in TOUPA'N atokthou hi.
english: Yahweh stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines and of the Arabians who are beside the Ethiopians;

paite: Huchi in Judate ava sual ua, agam uah alut ua, kumpipa' inn a thil tengteng ala vek ua, atapate, azite uh leng; atapa naupangpen Jehoahaz lousiah atapa dang anutsiat kei uhi.
english: and they came up against Judah, broke into it, and carried away all the possessions that were found in the king’s house, including his sons and his wives, so that there was no son left to him except Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.

paite: Huai nung in TOUPA'N hihdam thei louh gilnatna in agawt hi.
english: After all this Yahweh struck him in his bowels with an incurable disease.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akum nihna abei in anatna ziak in angoi apilhkhia a, natna mulkimhuaitak in asita hi. Amite'n apa meipi asehsak bang un asehsak kei uhi.
english: In process of time, at the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness, and he died of severe diseases. His people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.

paite: Avaihawm tung in kum sawmthum-le-nih ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum giat vai ahawm a, kuamah it louh in asi a, David khopi ah kumpipate han lou ah avui uhi.
english: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years. He departed with no one’s regret. They buried him in David’s city, but not in the tombs of the kings.

paite: Huchi in Jerusalem mite'n atapa naupangpen Ahaziah asik in kumpipa ding in abawl ua; ata upate tengteng, Arab sepaihhonte, apanmun ua hong pai mite'n athat khin vek uhi. Huchi in Judah kumpipa Jehoram tapa Ahaziah in vai ahawmta hi.
english: The inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his place, because the band of men who came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the oldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.

paite: Ahaziah in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmli-le-nih a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum khat vai ahawm a, anu min Athaliah, Omri tanu ahi.
english: Ahaziah was forty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.

paite: Ama'n leng Ahab inkote lampi tot atawn a; anu bel thil giloutak a thuhilhtu ahi.
english: He also walked in the ways of Ahab’s house, because his mother was his counselor in acting wickedly.

paite: Ahab inkote hih bang mah in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a, apa sih nung in asiatna ding a thuhilhtu ahi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as did Ahab’s house, for they were his counselors after the death of his father, to his destruction.

paite: Amah leng athuhilh un a-om a, Ramoth-gilead ah Siria kumpipa Hazael dou ding in Israel kumpipa Ahab tapa Jehoram kiang ah ahoh a, huchi in Siriate'n Jehoram asuliam uhi.
english: He also followed their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.

paite: Siria kumpipa Hazael asualna a Ramah a asukliam uh hihdam ding in Jezreel ah ahoh hi. Huchi in Judah kumpipa Jehoram tapa Azariah bel Ahab tapa Jehoram adam louh ziak in aveh ding in Jezreel ah akuan hi.
english: He returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which they had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. Azariah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.

paite: Huchi in Jehoram kiang ah Ahaziah ahoh a, amanthatna Pathian hih ahi; Nimshi tapa Jehu sual ding in Jehoram kiang a ahoh ziak in. Huai mi bel Ahab inkote hihmang ding a TOUPA seh ahi him hi.
english: Now the destruction of Ahaziah was of God, in that he went to Joram; for when he had come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom Yahweh had anointed to cut off Ahab’s house.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Ahab inkote hihse ding a asual lai in Judahte intekte leh Ahaziah nasem a-unau tapate amu a, athat vek hi.
english: When Jehu was executing judgment on Ahab’s house, he found the princes of Judah and the sons of the brothers of Ahaziah serving Ahaziah, and killed them.

paite: Ahaziah azong ua, Samaria a akibuk lai in aman ua, Jehu kiang ah ahon pi ua, athat ua; alungtang tengteng a TOUPA Zong sek Jehoshaphat tapa ahi, achi ua, avui in avuithoh uhi. Huchi in Ahaziah inkote'n agam uah thuneihna aneita kei uhi.
english: He sought Ahaziah, and they caught him (now he was hiding in Samaria), and they brought him to Jehu and killed him; and they buried him, for they said, “He is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought Yahweh with all his heart.” The house of Ahaziah had no power to hold the kingdom.

paite: Huan Ahaziah nu Athaliah in atapa si chih azak in athou a, Judah inkote kumpipa tengteng athat vek hi.
english: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring of the house of Judah.

paite: Ahaziah tapa Joash bel kumpipa tanu Jehosabeath in kumpipa tapa athahte uh lak a kipan aselmang a, naudonmi toh lupna dantan sung ah asel hi. Huchi in kumpipa Jehoram tanu Jehosabeath, siampu Jehoiada zi in, (amah Ahaziah sanggamnu ahi a) Athaliah muh louh ding in aselgu a, huchi in athah in a-om kei hi.
english: But Jehoshabeath, the king’s daughter, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stealthily rescued him from among the king’s sons who were slain, and put him and his nurse in the bedroom. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of King Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest (for she was the sister of Ahaziah), hid him from Athaliah, so that she didn’t kill him.

paite: Akiang ua teng in Pathian inn ah kum guk aguk in akibu a; huchi in Athaliah in agam uah vai ahawm hi.
english: He was with them hidden in God’s house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.

paite: Akum sagih kum in Jehoiada akihatsak a, sepaih zaheutu, Jehoram tapa Azariah, Jehohanan tapa Ishmael, Obed tapa Azariah, Adaiah tapa Maaseiah, Jikri tapa Elisaphath kiang ah thu akhung hi.
english: In the seventh year, Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds—Azariah the son of Jeroham, Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, Azariah the son of Obed, Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri—into a covenant with him.

paite: Huchi in Judah gam ah avak ua, Judah gam kho chih a Levite leh Israel inkuan intekte akaikhawm ua, Jerusalem ava tungtou uhi.
english: They went around in Judah and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the heads of fathers’ households of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.

paite: Kikaikhawmte tengteng in Pathian inn ah kumpipa kiang ah thu akhung uhi. Huan akiang uah, "Ngai dih ua, TOUPA'N David tapate tungtang thu ana gen bang in kumpipa tapa in vai ahawm ding ahi.
english: All the assembly made a covenant with the king in God’s house. Jehoiada said to them, “Behold, the king’s son must reign, as Yahweh has spoken concerning the sons of David.

paite: Na hih ding uh hichibang ahi, siampute leh Levite Sabbath ni a hong kuansekte seh thum a khen seh khat kongkhak ngak mite na hi ding ua;
english: This is the thing that you must do: a third part of you, who come in on the Sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be gatekeepers of the thresholds.

paite: seh thum a khen seh khat kumpipa' inn ah na om ding ua; huan seh thum a khen seh khat kulh kongpi ah; mipi tengteng bel TOUPA intual sung ah a-om ding uh.
english: A third part shall be at the king’s house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation. All the people will be in the courts of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Himahleh, siampute leh nasemmi Levite kia lou ngal kuamah TOUPA' inn ah lut kei un, amau bel asiangthou ziak un alut ding ua, mipi tengteng bel TOUPA hungaih in a-om ding uhi.
english: But let no one come into Yahweh’s house except the priests and those who minister of the Levites. They shall come in, for they are holy, but all the people shall follow Yahweh’s instructions.

paite: Levite'n agalvan uh tawi in kumpipa a-um ding ua; kuapeuh inn a hong lut thah ding ahi a; huan kumpipa apawt leh alut in amah kiang ah om zel un," achi hi.
english: The Levites shall surround the king, every man with his weapons in his hand. Whoever comes into the house, let him be slain. Be with the king when he comes in and when he goes out.”

paite: Huchi in Levite leh Judah tengteng in siampu Jehoiada thupiak bang in ahih ua; amaute heute chiat Sabbath ni a hong kuan dingte leh Sabbath ni a tawp dingte api ua; siampu Jehoiada in atawp ding pawl lah atawpsak nai kei hi.
english: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded. They each took his men, those who were to come in on the Sabbath, with those who were to go out on the Sabbath, for Jehoiada the priest didn’t dismiss the shift.

paite: Siampu Jehoiada in sepaih za heutute ToUPA' inn a om kumpipa David tei leh lum neu leh lum liante apia hi.
english: Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds the spears, bucklers, and shields that had been king David’s, which were in God’s house.

paite: Huan mite galvan tawi chiat in taklam sang a kipan in veilam sang tan in maitam leh inn um in kumpipa a-umsak uhi.
english: He set all the people, every man with his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, near the altar and the house, around the king.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa tapa ahon pikhia ua, lallukhu akhusak ua, theihsakna thu apia ua, kumpipa in abawl ua, Jehoiada leh atapate'n thau anilh ua, "Pathian in kumpipa hondam hen," achi uhi.
english: Then they brought out the king’s son, put the crown on him, gave him the covenant, and made him king. Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and they said, “Long live the king!”

paite: Athaliah in mipi kumpipa pahtawi a mipi kiphu motmot husa azak in TOUPA' inn ah mipi lak ah ava hoh hi.
english: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into Yahweh’s house.

paite: A-en a, ngai in, kongpi a khuambul ah kumpipa adingh a, akiang ah sepaih heutute leh pengkul mut mite toh; huai gam a mi tengteng in nuam asa mahmah ua, pengkulte amut zuazua ua; lasa mite'n athil gingtheite uh tum in phatna la asakhawm uhi. Huchi in Athaliah in apuante abotkek a, "Kiphialgukna; kiphialgukna ahi ve," achi hi.
english: Then she looked, and behold, the king stood by his pillar at the entrance, with the captains and the trumpeters by the king. All the people of the land rejoiced and blew trumpets. The singers also played musical instruments, and led the singing of praise. Then Athaliah tore her clothes, and said, “Treason! treason!”

paite: Huan siampu Jehoiada in sepaihte tung a heutu dia seh sepaih za heutute apikhia a, akiang uah, "Sepaihte kikal ah pawtsak unla, huan kuapeuh azuizui namsau a satlup hi hen," achi hi. Siampu in, "TOUPA' inn ah zaw thah ding ahi kei," achita hi.
english: Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, “Bring her out between the ranks; and whoever follows her, let him be slain with the sword.” For the priest said, “Don’t kill her in Yahweh’s house.”

paite: Huchi in lampi a-awn ua, sakol lutna kongpi ah kumpipa' inn ah ahoh a, huai ah athat uhi.
english: So they made way for her. She went to the entrance of the horse gate to the king’s house; and they killed her there.

paite: Huan Jehoiada in amah leh mipi tengteng leh kumpipa kikal ah TOUPA mite hi ding in thu akhung hi.
english: Jehoiada made a covenant between himself, all the people, and the king, that they should be Yahweh’s people.

paite: Mipi tengteng Baal inn ah ahoh ua, ahihsia ua, amaitamte, alimte ahihtam dimdem ua, Baal siampu Matan, maitam bul ah athat uhi.
english: All the people went to the house of Baal, broke it down, broke his altars and his images in pieces, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.

paite: Jehoiada in, Mosi Dan Bu a gelh bang a nuamsatak leh la sa kawm a, David in TOUPA' inn a TOUPA kiang a halmang thillat lan ding a ana seh siampu Levite nuai a sem ding in David thupiak bang in TOUPA' inn ngakmi dingte asep hi.
english: Jehoiada appointed the officers of Yahweh’s house under the hand of the Levitical priests, whom David had distributed in Yahweh’s house, to offer the burnt offerings of Yahweh, as it is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, as David had ordered.

paite: Siangthou lou peuhmah alutlouhna ding un TOUPA' inn kongkhak ngak mite asep hi.
english: He set the gatekeepers at the gates of Yahweh’s house, that no one who was unclean in anything should enter in.

paite: Huan zakhat tung a heutute, mihoihte, mipi uk mite, huai gammi tengteng api a, TOUPA' inn a kumpipa apikhia ua; kongkhak saknungzaw ah kumpipa' inn lam ah ahoh ua, kumpipa agam laltutphah ah atusakta uhi.
english: He took the captains of hundreds, the nobles, the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought the king down from Yahweh’s house. They came through the upper gate to the king’s house, and set the king on the throne of the kingdom.

paite: Huchi in namsau a Athaliah athah nung un huai gam a mi tengteng nuamsatak in a-om ua, khopi galmuang in a-omta hi.
english: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword.

paite: Joash in vaihawm apat tung in kum sagih a upa ahi; Jerusalem ah kum sawmli vai ahawm a; anu min Zibiah, Beer-sheba mi ahi.
english: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah, of Beersheba.

paite: Joash in siampu Jehoiada damsung in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
english: Joash did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes all the days of Jehoiada the priest.

paite: Jehoiada in amah zi nih aguan a, tapate leh tanute anei hi.
english: Jehoiada took for him two wives, and he became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai nung in Joash in TOUPA' inn bawlphat lungsim in anei hi.
english: After this, Joash intended to restore Yahweh’s house.

paite: Siampute leh Levite akaikhawm a, "Judate khuate ah hoh unla kum teng a na Pathian inn uh bawlphatna ding in Israel mi tengteng kiang ah sum-le-pai khonkhawm unla, zekai kei un," achi hi. Himahleh Levite akintat tuan kei uhi.
english: He gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, “Go out to the cities of Judah, and gather money to repair the house of your God from all Israel from year to year. See that you expedite this matter.” However the Levites didn’t do it right away.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n siampu lianpen Jehoiada asam a, akiang ah, "Bangziak a Levite TOUPA sikha Mosi leh Israel mipite seh theihsak a puanin a dia thoh bikhiah seh Judah mi leh Jerusalem mite thoh ding a phut lou na hia?
english: The king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said to him, “Why haven’t you required of the Levites to bring in the tax of Moses the servant of Yahweh, and of the assembly of Israel, out of Judah and out of Jerusalem, for the Tent of the Testimony?”

paite: Migilou nu Athaliah tapate'n lah Pathian inn ahihse khinta ua, huan, TOUPA' inn a thillat tengteng Baalte ape khin behlap lai uh," achi hi.
english: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up God’s house; and they also gave all the dedicated things of Yahweh’s house to the Baals.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n thu apia a, bawm abawl ua, TOUPA in kongpi polam ah akoih uhi.
english: So the king commanded, and they made a chest, and set it outside at the gate of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Gamdai a Pathian sikha Mosi in Israel mite hih ding a thoh bikhiah a seh TOUPA a ding a thoh ding in Judah gam tengteng leh Jerusalem ah thu athangsakta hi.
english: They made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in for Yahweh the tax that Moses the servant of God laid on Israel in the wilderness.

paite: Huchi in miliante leh mipite akipak ua, adangkate uh ahon la ua, akhon khit masiah uh bawm ah ahong koihkoih mai uhi.
english: All the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had filled it.

paite: Levite'n kumpipa upate kiang a bawm ahon tawi ua, dangka tampi a-om chih atheih un kumpipa laigelhmi leh siampu kumpipa seh upa in bawm a kipan abungkhia a, ala ua, amun ah akoih nawn uh. Huchibang in niteng in ahih ua, dangka tampi akholkhawmta uhi.
english: Whenever the chest was brought to the king’s officers by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king’s scribe and the chief priest’s officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to its place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.

paite: Kumpipa leh Jehoiada in TOUPA' inn nasem mite khut ah apia ua, TOUPA' inn bawlpha ding in suangsek mite, khutsiamte, TOUPA' inn bawlpha ding in sik leh dal a khutsiamte leng aguai hi.
english: The king and Jehoiada gave it to those who did the work of the service of Yahweh’s house. They hired masons and carpenters to restore Yahweh’s house, and also those who worked iron and bronze to repair Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huchi in nasem mite'n asem pan ua, asem hoih mahmah ua, Pathian inn angei bang geih in abawlhoih ua, adingkip nawnta hi.
english: So the workmen worked, and the work of repairing went forward in their hands. They set up God’s house as it was designed, and strengthened it.
