paite: Azoh un dangka om lai teng kumpipa leh Jehoiada kiang ah ahon tawi ua, huai in TOUPA' inn a nasepna ding a tui-um belsuante, latna tui-um belsuan sikkeute leh dangkasik tui-um belsuante nangawn abawl uhi. Huchi in Jehoiada damsung in TOUPA' inn ah halmang thillat alan gige uhi.
english: When they had finished, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, from which were made vessels for Yahweh’s house, even vessels with which to minister and to offer, including spoons and vessels of gold and silver. They offered burnt offerings in Yahweh’s house continually all the days of Jehoiada.

paite: Jehoiada bel upapi tekkun a dam in asita. Asih in kum za-le-sawmthum a upa ahi.
english: But Jehoiada grew old and was full of days, and he died. He was one hundred thirty years old when he died.

paite: Huchi in Israelte lak ah Pathian tung ah leh a-inn tungtang a thil ahihhoih ziak in David khopi ah kumpipate lak ah avui uhi.
english: They buried him in David’s city among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, and toward God and his house.

paite: Jehoiada sih nung in Judah miliante ahong kuan ua, kumpipa kiang ah toukaina abawl ua, kumpipa'n athu uh ana pom hi.
english: Now after the death of Jehoiada, the princes of Judah came and bowed down to the king. Then the king listened to them.

paite: Himahleh apipute uh Pathian TOUPA' inn alehngatsan ua, Asherahte leh milimte nna asemta uh. Huchi in akhelhna uh ziak in Judate leh Jerusalem tung ah thangpaihna ahong tungta hi.
english: They abandoned the house of Yahweh, the God of their fathers, and served the Asherah poles and the idols, so wrath came on Judah and Jerusalem for this their guiltiness.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA kiang a pikik ding in akiang uah zawlneite asawl a, amohdante uh atheisak ua, himahleh abil uh adoh nuam kei uhi.
english: Yet he sent prophets to them to bring them again to Yahweh, and they testified against them; but they would not listen.

paite: Siampu Jehoiada tapa Zekariah tung ah Pathian kha ahong tung a, amah mipi tunglam ah adingh a, akiang uah, "Pathian in hichi in achi: Bangziak a na lamzan theihlouhna ding ua TOUPA' thupiakte bohsia na hi ua? TOUPA na lehngatsan ziak un ama'n leng nou hon lehngatsan ahi,” achi hi.
english: The Spirit of God came on Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest; and he stood above the people, and said to them, “God says, ‘Why do you disobey Yahweh’s commandments, so that you can’t prosper? Because you have forsaken Yahweh, he has also forsaken you.’”

paite: Huchi in amah asawmta ua, kumpipa thupiak in TOUPA' inn huangsung ah suang in adenglumta uhi.
english: They conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huchibang in kumpipa Joash in apa Jehoiada hehpihna theigige lou in atapa athatta hi. Asih kuan in, "TOUPA'N ahon ngaihtuah ding a, phu ahon laksak ding," achi hi.
english: Thus Joash the king didn’t remember the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but killed his son. When he died, he said, “May Yahweh look at it, and repay it.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kum abei in Siria sepaihte'n ahong sual ua; Judah gam leh Jerusalem ah alut ua, amilian tengteng uh ahihmansak ua, Damaskas kumpipa kiang ah gallak tengteng akhak vek uhi.
english: At the end of the year, the army of the Syrians came up against him. They came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all their plunder to the king of Damascus.

paite: Siria sepaihte bel tawmchik kia ahong kuan ua; apipute uh Pathian TOUPA alehngatsan ziak un TOUPA'N sepaih tampite akhut uah apia ahi. Huchibang in Joash tung ah gawtna atungsak uhi.
english: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men; and Yahweh delivered a very great army into their hand, because they had forsaken Yahweh, the God of their fathers. So they executed judgment on Joash.

paite: Apaisan nung un, natna thupitak thuak in apaisan ua, amah mite ngei in siampu Jehoiada tapate sisan ziak in asawm ua, alupna a lum lai athat ua, asita hi. David khopi ah avui ua, himahleh kumpipate han ah aphum kei uhi.
english: When they had departed from him (for they left him seriously wounded), his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and killed him on his bed, and he died. They buried him in David’s city, but they didn’t bury him in the tombs of the kings.

paite: Hiaite amah sawm mite ahi uh: Ammon mi Simeath tapa Zabad leh Moab mi Shimrith tapa Jehozabad.
english: These are those who conspired against him: Zabad the son of Shimeath the Ammonitess and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith the Moabitess.

paite: Huchi in atapate tung ah thute, atung a puakgiktak puaksak tungtang thute; Pathian in abawlhoiht tungtang thute, ngai dih Kumpite Tanchin gelhna bu ah gelh ahi. Huan asik in atapa Amaziah in vai ahawmta hi.
english: Now concerning his sons, the greatness of the burdens laid on him, and the rebuilding of God’s house, behold, they are written in the commentary of the book of the kings. Amaziah his son reigned in his place.

paite: Amaziah in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-kua vai ahawm a; anu min Jehoaddan, Jerusalem mi ahi.
english: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan, of Jerusalem.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih a, himahleh alungsim ape bukim kei hi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, but not with a perfect heart.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, agam ahong dinkip in apa thattu, sikhate athat hi.
english: Now when the kingdom was established to him, he killed his servants who had killed his father the king.

paite: Himahleh atate uh bel athat kei a, Mosi Dan laibu a tuang, "Tate ziak in pate asi ding uh ahi kei, pate ziak in tate asi ding uh ahi sam kei, michih amau gitlouhna ziak in asi ding uh ahi,” chi a TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in ahih hi.
english: But he didn’t put their children to death, but did according to that which is written in the law in the book of Moses, as Yahweh commanded, saying, “The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.”

paite: Amaziah in Judahte akaikhawm a, Judah leh Benjamin mi tengteng a-inkuan uh dungzui zel in sangkhat heutu leh zakhat heutute nuai ah a-omsak hi. Kum sawmnih tunglam teng asim a, mi teltuam, tei leh lum tawi thei, galkap thei mi nuaithum a-om uhi.
english: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together and ordered them according to their fathers’ houses, under captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, even all Judah and Benjamin. He counted them from twenty years old and upward, and found that there were three hundred thousand chosen men, able to go out to war, who could handle spear and shield.

paite: Huan Israel gam a mi, mihat hangsan nuaikhat dangka talent zakhat in aguai lai hi.
english: He also hired one hundred thousand mighty men of valor out of Israel for one hundred talents of silver.

paite: Himahleh, akiang ah Pathian mi, mi khat ahong a, "Aw Kumpipa, Israel sepaihte na kiang ah pai kei le uh, TOUPA Israel mite, Ephraim suante huam in, na kiang ah a-om kei hi.
english: A man of God came to him, saying, “O king, don’t let the army of Israel go with you, for Yahweh is not with Israel, with all the children of Ephraim.

paite: Hoh hi lechin leng, hangtak in kidouna ah gamtang in: huchi lou in zaw Pathian in melma mai ah nang a hon vuallelsak ding: Pathian in lah panpih theihna leh vuallelhsak theihna anei ngal a," ahong chi hi.
english: But if you will go, take action, and be strong for the battle. God will overthrow you before the enemy; for God has power to help, and to overthrow.”

paite: Huchi in Amaziah in Pathian mipa kiang ah, "Ahihleh Israel sepaihte ka piaksa talent zakhat bang i chihta dia awi?" achi a. Huan Pathian mipa'n, "TOUPA'N huai sang a tampi nang ahon pe thei ahi,” achi hi.
english: Amaziah said to the man of God, “But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel?” The man of God answered, “Yahweh is able to give you much more than this.”

paite: Huchi in Amaziah in Ephraim gam a kipan a sepaih hong paite paikik ding in akhen a; huaiziak in Judate tung ah aheh mahmah ua, hehtak in apaikikta uhi.
english: Then Amaziah separated them, the army that had come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again. Therefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in fierce anger.

paite: Amaziah in lunglel lou in mite apikhia a, Chi Phaizang ah ahoh ua, Seir suante singkhat athat uhi.
english: Amaziah took courage, and led his people out and went to the Valley of Salt, and struck ten thousand of the children of Seir.

paite: Singkhat dang Judate'n ahingmat ua, suangpi vum ah api ua, suangpi vum a kipan in asawnkhe mengmeng ua, akitamzangawp uhi.
english: The children of Judah carried away ten thousand alive, and brought them to the top of the rock, and threw them down from the top of the rock, so that they all were broken in pieces.

paite: Himahleh Amaziah in akiang ah galkap ding a pai lou ding a asawlkik sepaihte'n Judah gam khuate, Samaria a kipan a Beth-horon pha in asual ua, mi sangthum athat ua, gallak tampi ala uhi.
english: But the men of the army whom Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell on the cities of Judah from Samaria even to Beth Horon, and struck of them three thousand, and took much plunder.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, Amaziah, Edomte that ahong pai in Seir suante' pathiante ahon pua a, apathian ding in apangsak a, huchi in abia ua, gimlimte ahalsak chiat hi.
english: Now after Amaziah had come from the slaughter of the Edomites, he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them and burned incense to them.

paite: Huaiziak in Amaziah tung ah TOUPA hehna akuangta a, akiang ah zawlnei asawl a, huai mi in akiang ah, "Na khut a kipan a amite hunkhe thei lou nam pathiante bang ding mahmah a zong na hia?" achi hi.
english: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against Amaziah, and he sent to him a prophet who said to him, “Why have you sought after the gods of the people, which have not delivered their own people out of your hand?”

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, akiang a thu agen lai in kumpipa'n, "Kumpipa vaihawmpa ding in nang ka hon bawl ua hia? Dai mai in: bang ding a na hinna tan ding na hia?" achi a. Huchi in zawlnei in, "Pathian in hichibang a na hih ziak leh ka thuhilhna na ngaihkhiak louh ziak in nang hihmang lungsim in anei chih ka thei hi, achi a," adaita hi.
english: As he talked with him, the king said to him, “Have we made you one of the king’s counselors? Stop! Why should you be struck down?” Then the prophet stopped, and said, “I know that God has determined to destroy you, because you have done this and have not listened to my counsel.”

paite: Huchi in Judah kumpipa Amaziah in thuhilh apom a, Israel kumpipa Jehu tapa, Jehoahaz tapa, Joash kiang ah, "Hong dih, kimatuah in i ki-en ding," chi in mi asawl hi.
english: Then Amaziah king of Judah consulted his advisers, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, “Come! Let’s look one another in the face.”

paite: Israel kumpipa Joash in Judah kumpipa Amaziah kiang ah, Lebanon tang a sidar sing kiang ah, "Ka tapa zi ding in na tanu neisak dih, chi in athukhak a; huan, Lebanon tang a gamsa ahong pai a, ling ahong chilpukgawp hi.
english: Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, “The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son as his wife. Then a wild animal that was in Lebanon passed by and trampled down the thistle.

paite: 'Nang ngai dih, Edom ka zou,' na chi a, na lungsim in na kisathei a, na inn ah om kinken mai in; nang leh Judah gam nangawn a siatna, nang dia poi ding thil bangziak a tokkhe ding na hia?" chi in mi asawl hi.
english: You say to yourself that you have struck Edom; and your heart lifts you up to boast. Now stay at home. Why should you meddle with trouble, that you should fall, even you and Judah with you?’”

paite: Himahleh, Amaziah in angaikhe nuam kei a; Edomte pathiante azon ziak a, Judah gam a amelmate uh khut a apiaktheihna ding a Pathian hih ahi.
english: But Amaziah would not listen; for it was of God, that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies, because they had sought after the gods of Edom.

paite: Huchi in Israel kumpipa Joash ahohtou a; Judah kumpipa Amaziah toh Judah gam Beth-shemesh ah kimaituah in aki-enta ngei uhi.
english: So Joash king of Israel went up, and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.

paite: Huan Israelte sang in Judate tan ahong sezaw a; michih amau inn lam chiat ah apaita uhi.
english: Judah was defeated by Israel; so every man fled to his tent.

paite: Israel kumpipa Joash in Beth-shemesh ah Judah kumpipa, Ahaziah tapa Jehoahaz tapa Amaziah aman a, Jerusalem ah api a, Jerusalem kulh Ephraim kulh kongpi a kipan akulh ning kongpi tan in tong zali tak achimsak hi.
english: Joash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth Shemesh and brought him to Jerusalem, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

paite: Huan TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn agou koihkhawmna a dangka-eng leh dangka leh tui-um belsuan om tengteng ala a, henta koltang dingte toh, huan, Samaria kholam ah apaikik nawnta hi.
english: He took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in God’s house with Obed-Edom, and the treasures of the king’s house, and the hostages, and returned to Samaria.

paite: Huchi in Judah kumpipa Joash tapa Amaziah bel Israelte kumpipa Jehoahaz tapa Joash sih nung in kum sawm-le-nga adam lai hi.
english: Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, lived for fifteen years after the death of Joash, son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel.

paite: Amaziah thilhih dangte abul a pan atawp tan in ngai dih, Judah kumpite leh Israel kumpite thugelhnabu ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, aren’t they written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?

paite: Huchi in Amaziah in TOUPA zuih atawpsantak in Jerusalem ah thah asawm ua, Lakish ah atai a; himahleh khua ah mi adelhsak ua, huai ah athat uhi.
english: Now from the time that Amaziah turned away from following Yahweh, they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem. He fled to Lachish, but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.

paite: Aluang sakol in apua ua, api-le-pute kiang Judah khopi ah avui uhi.
english: They brought him on horses and buried him with his fathers in the City of Judah.

paite: Huchi in Judah mi tengteng in kum sawm-le-guk a upa Uzziah api ua, apa Amaziah sik in kumpipa ding in abawlta uhi.
english: All the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.

paite: Ama'n kumpipa api-le-pute kiang a a-ihmut nung in Eloth khua abawlhoih a, Judah gam ah apangsak nawn hi.
english: He built Eloth and restored it to Judah. After that the king slept with his fathers.

paite: Uzziah in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawm-le-guk a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga-le-nih vai ahawm a, anu min Jekoliah, Jerusalem mi ahi.
english: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he began to reign; and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jechiliah, of Jerusalem.

paite: Apa Amaziah thilhih bangbang hih sam in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoihtak ahih zel hi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.

paite: Pathian kilakna theisiam Zekariah damsung in Pathian zong ding in akibawl tinten hi. Pathian azon sung teng in Pathian in alamzangsak hi.
english: He set himself to seek God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the vision of God; and as long as he sought Yahweh, God made him prosper.

paite: Philistiate sim ding in akuankhia a, Gath kulhte, Jabneh kulh, Ashdod kulh ahihchim a; huchi in Ashdod gam ah leh Philistiate lak ah khua abawl hi.
english: He went out and fought against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod; and he built cities in the country of Ashdod, and among the Philistines.

paite: Huchi in Pathian in Philistiate lak ah leh Gurbaal a om Arabiate leh Meuni mite lak ah apanpih hi.
english: God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians who lived in Gur Baal, and the Meunim.

paite: Ammonte'n Uzziah lak ah siah aliau sek ua; huchi in ahong hat mahmah ziak un Aigupta gam tan in aminthangta uhi.
english: The Ammonites gave tribute to Uzziah. His name spread abroad even to the entrance of Egypt, for he grew exceedingly strong.

paite: Uzziah in Jerusalem ah aning ah kongpi, Phaizang kongpi, kulh kawina lai kongpi, insangte, alam lai a, kulh in a-um hi.
english: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall, and fortified them.

paite: Gamdai ah leng insang alam a, gam tampi aneih ziak in tuilehte atoukhia a, phailam leh phaizang ah ganhon anei a; lounei mite leh uain suk mite tang lam leh gam hoihte ah akoih a, amah louma lam limsakmi tak ahi.
english: He built towers in the wilderness, and dug out many cisterns, for he had much livestock, both in the lowlands and in the plains. He had farmers and vineyard keepers in the mountains and in the fruitful fields, for he loved farming.

paite: Uzziah in sepaih kidoumi kumpipa sepaih heutu Hanani nuai a mi laigelhmi Jeiel leh heutu Maaseiahte'n aseh bang zel ua apawlpawl a galkapmi anei lai hi.
english: Moreover Uzziah had an army of fighting men who went out to war by bands, according to the number of their reckoning made by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king’s captains.

paite: Mihat hangsan chiat, a-inkuan upate tengteng sangnih-le-zaguk ahi uh.
english: The whole number of the heads of fathers’ households, even the mighty men of valor, was two thousand six hundred.

paite: Anuai uah sepaih sinsiamsa ngen nuaithum sangsagih-le-zanga melma lak a kumpipa panpihmi galsualmi taktak a-om uhi.
english: Under their hand was an army, three hundred seven thousand five hundred, who made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.

paite: Huchi in Uzziah in sepaih tengteng a ding in lum, tei, sik lukhu, sik puanak, thalpeu leh vaisuanglot a ding in suangte akisakhol hi.
english: Uzziah prepared for them, even for all the army, shields, spears, helmets, coats of mail, bows, and stones for slinging.

paite: Jerusalem ah mipilte theihkhiak khawlte abawl a, insang leh kulh ning chih ah thalkapna leh suang lian kuamkuam ana denna ding akoih a; amin gam chih mual chih ah athangta a; ahat mahmah tan in alam a lamdangtak a panpih in a-om hi.
english: In Jerusalem, he made devices, invented by skillful men, to be on the towers and on the battlements, with which to shoot arrows and great stones. His name spread far abroad, because he was marvelously helped until he was strong.

paite: Himahleh ahong hat nung in alungsim ahong sang a, hoih lou hial in thil ahih a, TOUPA a Pathian tung ah thil ahihkhial a; gimlim maitam a gimlim hal ding in TOUPA tempul ah alut hi.
english: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up, so that he did corruptly and he trespassed against Yahweh his God, for he went into Yahweh’s temple to burn incense on the altar of incense.

paite: Huchi in siampu Azariah in azui a, mihangsantak TOUPA siampu sawmgiat atel uhi.
english: Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him eighty priests of Yahweh, who were valiant men.

paite: Kumpipa Uzziah akhou ua akiang ah, "Uzziah aw, TOUPA a ding a gimlim hal nang hih ding ahi kei, gimlim hal ding a sehtuam Aaron tapa siampute hih ding ahi zaw hi; mun siangthou a kipan pawtkhia in; thil na hihkhial hi; TOUPA Pathian a pan na thupina ding ahi kei," achi uhi.
english: They resisted Uzziah the king, and said to him, “It isn’t for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to Yahweh, but for the priests the sons of Aaron, who are consecrated to burn incense. Go out of the sanctuary, for you have trespassed. It will not be for your honor from Yahweh God.”

paite: Huan Uzziah ahehta a; gimlim halna ding mei lakna atawi a, huchi a siampute tung a aheh laitak in TOUPA' inn ah, gimlim halna chin ah siampute ma ah atal ahong phakkheta hi.
english: Then Uzziah was angry. He had a censer in his hand to burn incense, and while he was angry with the priests, the leprosy broke out on his forehead before the priests in Yahweh’s house, beside the altar of incense.

paite: Huchi in siampu heutu Azariah leh siampu tengteng in a-en ua, ngai in, atal ahong phak a, huai a kipan in avikkhe pah ua, ahi, TOUPA'N agawt ziak in amah leng kintak in apawtkheta hi.
english: Azariah the chief priest and all the priests looked at him, and behold, he was leprous in his forehead; and they thrust him out quickly from there. Indeed, he himself also hurried to go out, because Yahweh had struck him.

paite: Kumpipa Uzziah bel asih ni tan in aphakta a, aphak ziak in a-inn tuam ah a-omta hi. TOUPA' inn a kipan hihkhiak in a-omta a, huchi in atapa Jotham bel agam ua mite vaihawm in kumpipa' inn a ukpa ding in a-omta hi.
english: Uzziah the king was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house, being a leper; for he was cut off from Yahweh’s house. Jotham his son was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.

paite: Uzziah thilhih dang tengteng bel abul a kipan a atawp pha in Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai in agelh hi.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, wrote.

paite: Huchi in Uzziah bel api leh apute kiang ah a-ihmu a, kumpipa kivuina mun a api leh apute lak ah avui uhi. "Amah zaw phak ahi ngal a," achi ua, huchi in asik in atapa Jotham in vai ahawmta hi.
english: So Uzziah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the field of burial which belonged to the kings, for they said, “He is a leper.” Jotham his son reigned in his place.

paite: Jotham bel avaihawmpat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-guk vai ahawm a, anu min Jerushah, Zadok tanu ahi.
english: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerushah the daughter of Zadok.

paite: Apa Uzziah thilhih bangbang hih in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih zel hi. TOUPA tempul ah bel alut kei hi. Himahleh mite'n hoih loutak in ana hih gige uhi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that his father Uzziah had done. However he didn’t enter into Yahweh’s temple. The people still acted corruptly.

paite: TOUPA' inn a kongkhak saknungzaw abawl a, huan, Ophel kulh tung ah inn tampi alam behlap lai hi.
english: He built the upper gate of Yahweh’s house, and he built much on the wall of Ophel.

paite: Huan Judah tanggam ah khuate abawl a, gamnuai ah inn thupi taktakte, insangte alam lai hi.
english: Moreover he built cities in the hill country of Judah, and in the forests he built fortresses and towers.

paite: Ammon suante'n kumpipa adou ua, azou hi. Huchi in Ammon suante'n huai kum in dangka talent zakhat leh huit buh puak singkhat leh barli buh puak singkhat apia uhi. Huchibang mah in Ammon suante'n akum nihna leh akum thumna ah leng apia uhi.
english: He also fought with the king of the children of Ammon, and prevailed against them. The children of Ammon gave him the same year one hundred talents of silver, ten thousand cors of wheat, and ten thousand cors of barley. The children of Ammon also gave that much to him in the second year, and in the third.

paite: Huchi in Jotham in TOUPA a Pathian ma a lampi hoih abawl ziak in ahong hatta hi.
english: So Jotham became mighty, because he ordered his ways before Yahweh his God.

paite: Jotham thilhih dangte agaldoute, a-omdante ngai dih, Israel leh Judah kumpite thugelhnabu ah gelh in a-om hi.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars and his ways, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

paite: Vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-guk vai ahawm hi.
english: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

paite: Jotham bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, David khopi ah avui uh; asik in atapa Ahaz in vai ahawmta hi.
english: Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.

paite: Ahaz in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-guk vai ahawm; apu David bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih kei hi.
english: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn’t do that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, like David his father,

paite: Israel kumpipate lampi azui zaw a, Baalte a ding in milim suntawmte abawl lai hi.
english: but he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and also made molten images for the Baals.

paite: Hinnom tapa phaizang ah gimlimte ahal a, TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a delhkhiaksa namte thilkihhuaitak ahih sek bang un atate uh mei ah alutsak uhi.
english: Moreover he burned incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burned his children in the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh cast out before the children of Israel.

paite: Mun sangte, mualte, sing hing nuaite ah akithoih a, gimlimte ahal zel hi.
english: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA a Pathian in Siria kumpipa khut ah apia a; asual ua, mi tampi sal in api ua, Damaskas ah apaipih uhi. Israel kumpipa khut a piak ahi lai a, ama'n tampi athat hi.
english: Therefore Yahweh his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria. They struck him, and carried away from him a great multitude of captives, and brought them to Damascus. He was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who struck him with a great slaughter.

paite: Api-le-pute uh TOUPA Pathian alehngatsan ziak un. Remaliah tapa Pekah in Judah gam ah nuaikhat-le-singnih ni khat in athat a, avek un mihangsan chiat ahi uhi.
english: For Pekah the son of Remaliah killed in Judah one hundred twenty thousand in one day, all of them valiant men, because they had forsaken Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

paite: Ephraim mihat Jikri in kumpipa tapa Maaseiah leh insung upa Azrikam leh Elkanah, kumpipa zom athat hi.
english: Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king’s son, Azrikam the ruler of the house, and Elkanah who was next to the king.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante'n a-unaute uh nuainih, numeite, atapate uh, atanute uh sal in api ua; gallak tamtak alaksak lai ua, gallak pen Samaria ah atun uhi.
english: The children of Israel carried away captive of their brothers two hundred thousand women, sons, and daughters, and also took away much plunder from them, and brought the plunder to Samaria.

paite: Huai ah TOUPA zawlnei ana om a, amin Obed ahi; Samaria a hong pai ding sepaihte ana vaidawn a, akiang uah, "Ngai dih uh, TOUPA na pi-le-pute uh Pathian Judahte tung ah aheh a, na khut ua hon pia ei ve, heh a na thahna un van asuntou hi.
english: But a prophet of Yahweh was there, whose name was Oded; and he went out to meet the army that came to Samaria, and said to them, “Behold, because Yahweh, the God of your fathers, was angry with Judah, he has delivered them into your hand, and you have slain them in a rage which has reached up to heaven.

paite: Judah leh Jerusalem mite sikhanu leh sikhapa in bawl na tum ua, himahleh noute ngei in leng TOUPA na Pathian uh tung ah na hihkhial uh ahi kei maw?
english: Now you intend to degrade the children of Judah and Jerusalem as male and female slaves for yourselves. Aren’t there even with you trespasses of your own against Yahweh your God?

paite: Huaiziak in ka thu pom unla, na unaute uh sal a na matte uh paisak nawn un; TOUPA hehna thupitak na tung uah a-om hi," achi hi.
english: Now hear me therefore, and send back the captives that you have taken captive from your brothers, for the fierce wrath of Yahweh is on you.”

paite: Huchi in Ephraimte heutu khenkhat, Johanan tapa Azariahte, Mesillemoth tapa Berekiahte, Shallum tapa Jehizkiah, Hadlai tapa Amasa kidouna a kipan a hong paite ana dal ua, akiang uah,
english: Then some of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against those who came from the war,

paite: "Salte na hon pilut ding uh ahi kei; ka khelhna uh leh ka tatlekna uh behlap in, TOUPA tung ah tatlekna na hon tungsak ding uh ahi, ka khelhna uh athupi mahmah ngal a, Israel mite tung ah hehna thupitak a-om hi," ana chi uhi.
english: and said to them, “You must not bring in the captives here, for you intend that which will bring on us a trespass against Yahweh, to add to our sins and to our guilt; for our guilt is great, and there is fierce wrath against Israel.”

paite: Huchi in sepaihte'n miliante leh mipi ma ah salte leh gallak sumte anusia uh.
english: So the armed men left the captives and the plunder before the princes and all the assembly.

paite: Huan minlohlouhte ahong thou ua, salte api ua, gallak thil in vuaktang a om teng puansilh aguan ua, avan ua, khedapte abunsak ua, nek ding leh dawn ding apia ua, sathau anilh ua, ahatloute tengteng sabiltung ah atuangsak ua, tum sing khua, Jeriko ah a-unaute uh kiang ah apaisak ua, amau Samaria ah akik nawnta uhi.
english: The men who have been mentioned by name rose up and took the captives, and with the plunder clothed all who were naked among them, dressed them, gave them sandals, gave them something to eat and to drink, anointed them, carried all the feeble of them on donkeys, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brothers. Then they returned to Samaria.

paite: Huai lai in kumpipa Ahaz in Assuria kumpipate panpihna ngen ding in mi asawl hi.
english: At that time King Ahaz sent to the kings of Assyria to help him.

paite: Edomte'n Judahte va sual a, sal dia hon mat thuk ziak un.
english: For again the Edomites had come and struck Judah, and carried away captives.

paite: Philistiate'n leng phailam khuate leh Judah simte ahong la ua, Beth-shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Sokoh leh akhotate toh, huan, Timnah leh akhotate, Gimzo leng akhotate toh ala ua, huai ah a-om uhi.
english: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the lowland and of the South of Judah, and had taken Beth Shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soco with its villages, Timnah with its villages, and also Gimzo and its villages; and they lived there.

paite: Israel kumpipa Ahaz ziak in TOUPA'N Judahte avuallelsak hi. Judahte tung ah thanghuaitak in thil ahih a, TOUPA tung ah nakpitak in akhial ahi.
english: For Yahweh brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel, because he acted without restraint in Judah and trespassed severely against Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in Siria kumpipa Tilgath-pilneser akiang ah ahong pai a, hihhat nak sang in ahihmangbang zaw hi.
english: Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria came to him and gave him trouble, but didn’t strengthen him.

paite: Ahaz in TOUPA' inn, kumpipa' inn leh miliante a pan thilte ala a, Siria kumpipa apia a; himahleh aphatuam tuan kei.
english: For Ahaz took away a portion out of Yahweh’s house, and out of the house of the king and of the princes, and gave it to the king of Assyria; but it didn’t help him.

paite: Amangbat laitak in leng hiai kumpipa Ahaz in TOUPA tung ah thil ahihkhial semsem mawk hi.
english: In the time of his distress, he trespassed yet more against Yahweh, this same King Ahaz.

paite: Amah sualmi Damaskaste pathian kiang ah akithoih hi, “Siria kumpipate' pathian in amaute apanpih ziak in kei leng ahon panpih theihna ding in akiang ah ka kithoih ding ahi," achi hi. Himahleh amah leh Israel mi tengteng siatna ahi ngal a.
english: For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus which had defeated him. He said, “Because the gods of the kings of Syria helped them, I will sacrifice to them, that they may help me.” But they were the ruin of him and of all Israel.

paite: Huchi in Ahaz in Pathian inn a tui-um belsuan akaikhawm vek a, Pathian inn a tui-um belsuan ahihkham vek a, TOUPA' inn kongkhakte akhak bikbek a; Jerusalem ning chih ah maitam abawl hi.
english: Ahaz gathered together the vessels of God’s house, cut the vessels of God’s house in pieces, and shut up the doors of Yahweh’s house; and he made himself altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

paite: Judah kho tampi ah pathian dangte dia gimlim halna mun sangte abawl a, TOUPA api-le-pute Pathian ahehsak hi.
english: In every city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and provoked Yahweh, the God of his fathers, to anger.

paite: Athilhih dangte tengteng leh a-omdan tengteng abul a kipan atawp pha in ngai dih, Judate leh Israel kumpite tanchinbu ah gelh in a-om hi.
english: Now the rest of his acts, and all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

paite: Api-le-pute kiang ah Ahaz a-ihmu a, Jerusalem khopi ah avui ua; Israel kumpipate han ah akoih kei uh. Huchi in asik in atapa Hezekiah in vai ahawmta hi.
english: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem, because they didn’t bring him into the tombs of the kings of Israel; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.

paite: Hezekiah in kum sawmnih-le-nga upa ahih in vaihawm apan a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-kua vai ahawm a; anu min Abijah, Zekariah tanu ahi.
english: Hezekiah began to reign when he was twenty-five years old, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

paite: Ama'n apu David thilhih bang hih in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih zel hi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that David his father had done.

paite: Ama'n vaihawm apat kum akha khatna ah TOUPA' inn kongkhakte ahong a, azemhoih hi.
english: In the first year of his reign, in the first month, he opened the doors of Yahweh’s house and repaired them.

paite: Siampute leh Levite apilut a, suahlam sang mun za lai ah apikhawm a, akiang uah,
english: He brought in the priests and the Levites and gathered them together into the wide place on the east,

paite: "Nou Levite aw, ka thu ngaikhia un; noute kihihsiangthou phot unla, huchi in TOUPA, na pi-le-pute uh Pathian inn hihsiangthou unla, mun siangthou a kipan ninte paikhia un.
english: and said to them, “Listen to me, you Levites! Now sanctify yourselves, and sanctify the house of Yahweh, the God of your fathers, and carry the filthiness out of the holy place.

paite: I pi-le-pute un thil ahihkhialta ua, TOUPA Pathian mitmuh in thil hoih lou ana hih ua, ana lehngatsan ua, TOUPA omna alehngatsan ua, ana nungngatta uhi.
english: For our fathers were unfaithful, and have done that which was evil in Yahweh our God’s sight, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of Yahweh, and turned their backs.

paite: Inn lim kongkhakte akhak ua, khawnvakte ahihmit ua, Israel' Pathian' mun siangthou ah gimlimte ahal kei ua, halmang thillatte leng alan kei uh.
english: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place to the God of Israel.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA hehna Judate leh Jerusalem tung ah a-om a, na mit ua na muh bang un, gam chih mual chih a sepsep ding leh lamdangsak ding leh nuihzat ding in ana bawlta ahi.
english: Therefore Yahweh’s wrath was on Judah and Jerusalem, and he has delivered them to be tossed back and forth, to be an astonishment and a hissing, as you see with your eyes.

paite: Ngai dih ua, i pi-le-pute uh namsau a vuallelhsak in a-om ua, i tanu leh i tapate uh, i zite uh, huaiziak in sal in ana om uhi.
english: For behold, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.

paite: "Ngai dih ua, ahehna mahmah athentheihna ding in TOUPA Israel' Pathian kiang ah thu khun ka tum hi.
english: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with Yahweh, the God of Israel, that his fierce anger may turn away from us.

paite: Ka naute aw don lou in om kei un, TOUPA nasem na hi ua, ama a nasem a om ding leh gimlim halmi ding in nou ahon telta ahi," achi hi.
english: My sons, don’t be negligent now; for Yahweh has chosen you to stand before him, to minister to him, and that you should be his ministers and burn incense.”

paite: Huchi in Levi mi Amasai tapa Mahathte, Kohath mi Azariah tapa Joelte; Merari tapate lak a Abdi tapa Kishte, Jehalleleel tapa Azariah, Gershon, Zimmah tapa Joah, Joah tapa Edente,
english: Then the Levites arose: Mahath, the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites; and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehallelel; and of the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah;

paite: Elizaphan tapate lak a mi Shimri leh Jeuelte: Asaph tapate lak a mi Zekariah leh Mataniahte;
english: and of the sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeuel; and of the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;

paite: Heman tapate lak a mi Jehuel leh Shimeite; Jeduthun tapate lak a mi Shemaiah leh Uzzielte akuankhia uhi.
english: and of the sons of Heman, Jehuel and Shimei; and of the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.

paite: A-unaute uh asamkhawm ua, akihihsiangthou ua, TOUPA thu a kumpipa thupiak bang a TOUPA' inn hihsiang ding in alutta uhi.
english: They gathered their brothers, sanctified themselves, and went in, according to the commandment of the king by Yahweh’s words, to cleanse Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huchi in kihihsiang ding in TOUPA insung gil lam ah siampute alut ua, TOUPA' inn a thilnin amuh tengteng uh TOUPA inkong ah alakhia uhi.
english: The priests went into the inner part of Yahweh’s house to cleanse it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in Yahweh’s temple into the court of Yahweh’s house. The Levites took it from there to carry it out to the brook Kidron.

paite: Akha khatna ani khat ni in apan ua, huai kha ani giat ni in TOUPA inlim atung ua; huchi in ani giat in TOUPA' inn ahihsiangthou ua; akha khatna ani sawm-le-guk ni in azou vek uhi.
english: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month they came to Yahweh’s porch. They sanctified Yahweh’s house in eight days, and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah kumpipa' inn ah alut ua, "TOUPA' inn a halmang thillatna maitamte, huai a tui-um belsuan tengteng, tanghou siahna dohkante, huai a vanzat tengtengte ka hihsiang vekta uh.
english: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king within the palace and said, “We have cleansed all Yahweh’s house, including the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, and the table of show bread with all its vessels.

paite: Kumpipa Ahaz in avaihawm lai a thil ahihkhelh a, apaihmang tui-um belsuan tengteng leng ka bawl zou vek ua, ka hihsiangthou lai ua; huan, ngai dih, TOUPA maitam malam ah a-om hi," achi uhi.
english: Moreover, we have prepared and sanctified all the vessels which King Ahaz threw away in his reign when he was unfaithful. Behold, they are before Yahweh’s altar.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Hezekiah bel zingkhang in athou a, khua a miliante asamkhawm a, TOUPA' inn ah ahoh uhi.
english: Then Hezekiah the king arose early, gathered the princes of the city, and went up to Yahweh’s house.

paite: Gam, mun siangthou leh Judate a ding a khelh thoihna ding bawngtal sagih, belamtal sagih, belamnou sagih leh keltal sagih akaitou ua. Aaron tapa siampute TOUPA maitam a lan ding in thu apia hi.
english: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary, and for Judah. He commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on Yahweh’s altar.

paite: Huchi in bawngtalte agou ua; siampute'n sisan ala ua, maitam atheh ua: belamtalte agou ua, asisan in maitam atheh ua; belamnoute leng agou ua, asisan in maitam atheh uhi.
english: So they killed the bulls, and the priests received the blood and sprinkled it on the altar. They killed the rams and sprinkled the blood on the altar. They also killed the lambs and sprinkled the blood on the altar.

paite: Huan keltalte khelh thoihna ding in kumpipa leh mipite kiang ah ahon kai ua, atung uah akhut uh anga uhi.
english: They brought near the male goats for the sin offering before the king and the assembly; and they laid their hands on them.

paite: Siampute'n agou ua, Israel mi tengteng a ding a lemna bawlna ding in asisan un maitam ah khelh thoihna alan ua; kumpipa thupiak bang in Israel mi tengteng a ding in alan uhi.
english: Then the priests killed them, and they made a sin offering with their blood on the altar, to make atonement for all Israel; for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.

paite: Huchi in David leh kumpipa zawlnei Gad leh zawlnei Nathan thupiak bang in TOUPA' inn ah Levite dakkhutbette, pekgingte, kaihgingte tum ding in akoih a; thupiak a zawlneite zang a TOUPA piak lah ahi ngal a.
english: He set the Levites in Yahweh’s house with cymbals, with stringed instruments, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, of Gad the king’s seer, and Nathan the prophet; for the commandment was from Yahweh by his prophets.

paite: Levite bel David bawl tumging chi toh siampute pengkul toh adingh uhi.
english: The Levites stood with David’s instruments, and the priests with the trumpets.

paite: Huan Hezekiah in maitam a halmang thillat lan ding in thu apia a. Halmang thillat ahon lat pat un TOUPA la pengkul leh Israel kumpipa David bawl tumging toh ahon sa uhi.
english: Hezekiah commanded them to offer the burnt offering on the altar. When the burnt offering began, Yahweh’s song also began, along with the trumpets and instruments of David king of Israel.

paite: Huchi in mipite'n Pathian abia ua, lasiamte'n la asa ua, pengkul mut mite'n amut ua, halmang thillat lat khit ahih masiah huchibang in ahih nilouh uhi.
english: All the assembly worshiped, the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded. All this continued until the burnt offering was finished.

paite: Thillat alat khit un kumpipa leh akiang a om tengteng in kun in Pathian abia uhi.
english: When they had finished offering, the king and all who were present with him bowed themselves and worshiped.

paite: Kumpipa Hezekiah leh miliante'n Levite bel David leh zawlnei Asaph phuah phatna la sa ding in thu apia uhi. Huchi in nuamsatak in phatna la asa ua, akun ua, Pathian abia uhi.
english: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praises to Yahweh with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. They sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshiped.

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah in, "TOUPA a ding in na kihihsiangthouta ua, hong nai unla, TOUPA' inn ah kithoihna leh kipahthu genna thillat hong lan un," achi hi. Mipite'n kithoihnate, kipahthu genna thillatte ahon lan ua, a-ut peuhmah in halmang thillat ahon lan uhi.
english: Then Hezekiah answered, “Now you have consecrated yourselves to Yahweh. Come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into Yahweh’s house.” The assembly brought in sacrifices and thank offerings, and as many as were of a willing heart brought burnt offerings.

paite: Mipite'n halmang thillat ahong lat zah uh bawngtal sawmsagih leh belamtal zakhat leh belamnou zanih ahi. Hiaite tengteng TOUPA a dia halmang thillat ding vek ahi.
english: The number of the burnt offerings which the assembly brought was seventy bulls, one hundred rams, and two hundred lambs. All these were for a burnt offering to Yahweh.

paite: Thillat tengteng bawngtal zaguk, belamtal sangthum ahi.
english: The consecrated things were six hundred head of cattle and three thousand sheep.

paite: Himahleh siampu atawm lua ua, halmang thillat pen asem seng kei ua; huaiziak in a-unaute Levite'n akimansak ma un siampute kihihsiangthou tan in ahuh uhi. Levite siampute sang in kihihsiangthou thu ah angentelzaw uhi.
english: But the priests were too few, so that they could not skin all the burnt offerings. Therefore their brothers the Levites helped them until the work was ended, and until the priests had sanctified themselves, for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.

paite: Huchi in halmang thillatte atam a, halmang thillat chih a ding a lemna thillat thaute, dawn ding thillat a dingte leng atam mahmah hi. Huchi in TOUPA' inn nasepdan hoihtak in ahih uhi.
english: Also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings and with the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of Yahweh’s house was set in order.

paite: Pathian in mite kisakholsak khin a, kintak a thil atunsak a, thil om guih ahih ziak in, Hezekia leh mi tengteng akipak mahmah uhi.
english: Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced because of that which God had prepared for the people; for the thing was done suddenly.

paite: Huchi in Solomon in Jerusalem a Moriah tang, apa David kiang a TOUPA kilakna, Jebus mi Ornan phualzang, David sehsa ah TOUPA' inn alam panta hi.
english: Then Solomon began to build Yahweh’s house at Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where Yahweh appeared to David his father, which he prepared in the place that David had appointed, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

paite: Avaihawm akum lina kum, akha nihna, ani nih ni inn lam apan hi.
english: He began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

paite: Pathian inn lamdan ding Solomon in angaihtuahdan hichibang ahi. Adunglam tong tehdan ngeina in tong sawmguk ahi a, availam tong sawmnih ahi.
english: Now these are the foundations which Solomon laid for the building of God’s house: the length by cubits after the first measure was sixty cubits, and the width twenty cubits.

paite: Amalam a inlim dunglam inn vailam tan mah tong sawmnih ahi a, asanlam za-le-sawmnih ahi a, asung dangka-eng chi kia in aluan hi.
english: The porch that was in front, its length, across the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and the height one hundred twenty; and he overlaid it within with pure gold.

paite: Dantan lianzaw pen baang ah meilah sing athuap a, huai dangka-eng chi kia in aluan a, huai ah tum sing leh khainiang lim atuangsak hi.
english: He made the larger room with a ceiling of cypress wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and ornamented it with palm trees and chains.

paite: Huchi in akilawmsak ding in bel suangmantam in azem a, dangka-eng bel Paravaim dangka-eng ahi.
english: He decorated the house with precious stones for beauty. The gold was gold from Parvaim.

paite: Inn bel, kalhkangte, baangte, apialkhangte, kongkhakte dangka-eng in aluan a; baangte ah cherub limte atuangsak hi.
english: He also overlaid the house, the beams, the thresholds, its walls, and its doors with gold, and engraved cherubim on the walls.

paite: Mun Siangthoupen abawl a, adunglam in vailam tan mah, tong sawmnih ahi a, availam tong sawmnih ahi a, dangka-eng chi ngen in aluan a, talent zaguk apha hi.
english: He made the most holy place. Its length, according to the width of the house, was twenty cubits, and its width twenty cubits; and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.

paite: Akilhna gikdan dangka-eng shekel sawmnga ahi. Dantan tungnungte dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. He overlaid the upper rooms with gold.

paite: Mun Siangthoupen ah cherub lim nih abawl a, huaite dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: In the most holy place he made two cherubim by carving, and they overlaid them with gold.

paite: Cherub khate'n tong sawmnih akhak a, cherub khat kha tong nga ahi a, baang apha a, huan, akha langkhat leng tong nga mah ahi a, cherub khat kha apha hi.
english: The wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long: the wing of the one was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

paite: Huchi in cherub dang khat kha leng tong nga ahi a, baang a pha a; huan, akha langkhat tong nga mah ahi a, cherub khat kha apha hi.
english: The wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits, joining to the wing of the other cherub.

paite: Cherubte'n tong sawmnih khak in akha uh azak ua, adingh ua, insung lam nga in adingh uhi.
english: The wings of these cherubim spread themselves out twenty cubits. They stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.

paite: Puanzak ding adumpuang, asandup, asan-au, khauzang ngatte in abawl a, huai ah cherub lim atuangsak hi.
english: He made the veil of blue, purple, crimson, and fine linen, and ornamented it with cherubim.

paite: Inn mailam ah tong sawmthum leh tong nga a sang khuam nih aphut a, huaite dawn tong nga tuaktuak ahi.
english: Also he made before the house two pillars thirty-five cubits high, and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.

paite: Huai ah khainiang abawl a, khuam dawn ah avial a; theibuhfai zakhat abawl a, khainiang ah akhai hi.
english: He made chains in the inner sanctuary, and put them on the tops of the pillars; and he made one hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.

paite: Tempul mailam ah khuam aphut a, khat taklam ah, khat veilam ah, taklam a pen Jakin achi a, veilam a pen Boaz achi hi.
english: He set up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.

paite: Huan Hezekiah in Israel gam leh Judah gam teng ah mi asawl a, Ephraim leh Manasseh gamte ah leng TOUPA Israel' Pathian a ding in Paikan Ankuang nei ding a Jerusalem a TOUPA' inn a hong pai ding in lai akhak hi.
english: Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to Yahweh’s house at Jerusalem, to keep the Passover to Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: Kumpipa leh amiliante leh Jerusalem a mipi teng in akha nihna ah, Paikan Ankuang neih asawm uhi.
english: For the king had taken counsel with his princes and all the assembly in Jerusalem to keep the Passover in the second month.

paite: Huai lai in alui thei nai kei ua, siampu kihihsiangthoute atam nai kei uh; Jerusalem a mipi akikaihkhop nai louh ziak un.
english: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves in sufficient number, and the people had not gathered themselves together to Jerusalem.

paite: Athil sawm uh kumpipa leh mipite ngaih in adik hi.
english: The thing was right in the eyes of the king and of all the assembly.

paite: Huchi in Israel gam teng, Beer-sheba a kipan Dan pha in TOUPA Israel' Pathian a ding in Paikan Ankuang nei ding a Jerusalem a hong pai ding apuang ding in thu ahihkipta hi. Adan bangtak in huchibang a tam in ahih ngei nai kei uh.
english: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beersheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the Passover to Yahweh, the God of Israel, at Jerusalem, for they had not kept it in great numbers in the way it is written.

paite: Huchi in lai taipih mite kumpipa leh amiliante uh lai tawi in, Israel leh Judah gam tengteng a pai ding in kumpipa thupiak bang in apawt ua, "Nou Israel suante aw, Siria kumpipate khut a kipan pawt a akhosuaksunte TOUPA, Abraham, Isak leh Israel' Pathian lam hong nga nawn un; huchi a nou lam ahong ngat nawn theihna ding in.
english: So the couriers went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, according to the commandment of the king, saying, “You children of Israel, turn again to Yahweh, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, that he may return to the remnant of you that have escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.

paite: Nou zaw na pi-le-pute uh leh na unaute uh, TOUPA apipute uh Pathian tung a thil hihkhial a om, segawp ding a donsak lou a na muhte uh bang in om kei un.
english: Don’t be like your fathers and like your brothers, who trespassed against Yahweh, the God of their fathers, so that he gave them up to desolation, as you see.

paite: Na pi-le-pute uh bang in genhak nawn kei unla, TOUPA kiang ah kitulut zaw unla, tangtawn a dia ahihsiangthou, amun siangthou ah hong lut unla, TOUPA na Pathian uh nna sem un, huchi in ahehna thupitak na lak ua kipan akiheimangsak ding hi.
english: Now don’t be stiff-necked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves to Yahweh, and enter into his sanctuary, which he has sanctified forever, and serve Yahweh your God, that his fierce anger may turn away from you.

paite: TOUPA lam na hong ngat nawn uleh na unaute uh leh na tate uh sal a man mite'n ahehpih ding ua, hiai gam ah ahong pai nawn ding uhi. TOUPA na Pathian uh lah chingtheitak leh zahngaitheitak ahi ngal a, amah lam na hong ngat peuhmah uleh ahon nuse kei ding,” chi in.
english: For if you turn again to Yahweh, your brothers and your children will find compassion with those who led them captive, and will come again into this land, because Yahweh your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you if you return to him.”

paite: Huchi in lai taipih mite kho chih ah Ephraim leh Manasseh gam tengteng ah Zebulun pha in apai ua, himahleh amaute nuihsan in ana simmoh uhi.
english: So the couriers passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh, even to Zebulun, but people ridiculed them and mocked them.

paite: Himahleh Asherte leh Manassehte leh Zebulunte tampi akitulut ua, Jerusalem ah ahoh uhi.
english: Nevertheless some men of Asher, Manasseh, and Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem.

paite: Judah gamte ngial houh TOUPA thu a kumpipa leh miliante thupiak zui ding in Pathian in lungsim mun khat apusak hi.
english: Also the hand of God came on Judah to give them one heart, to do the commandment of the king and of the princes by Yahweh’s word.

paite: Huchi in kha nihna ah tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina nei ding in Jerusalem ah mi tampi ahong kikhawm ua, atam mahmah uhi.
english: Many people assembled at Jerusalem to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great assembly.

paite: Huan athou ua, Jerusalem a maitamte ala ua, gimlim halna maitamte leng ala ua, Kidron lui ah apai uhi.
english: They arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and they took away all the altars for incense and threw them into the brook Kidron.

paite: Huchi in akha nihna ani sawm-le-li ni in Paikan Ankuangluina agou ua; siampute leh Levite azum ua, akihihsiangthou ua, halmang thillat toh TOUPA' inn ah alalut uhi.
english: Then they killed the Passover on the fourteenth day of the second month. The priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought burnt offerings into Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huan Pathian mipa Mosi Dan bangtak in amau mun chiat ah adingh ua; siampute'n Levite a kipan atan uh sisan atheh uhi.
english: They stood in their place after their order, according to the law of Moses the man of God. The priests sprinkled the blood which they received of the hand of the Levites.

paite: Mipi lak ah lah kihihsiangthou lou atam ua; huaiziak in TOUPA a ding a hihsiangthou ding in asiangthouloute tuam ding in Levite'n Paikan Ankuangluina ding agou uhi.
english: For there were many in the assembly who had not sanctified themselves; therefore the Levites were in charge of killing the Passovers for everyone who was not clean, to sanctify them to Yahweh.

paite: Ephraim, Manasseh, Issakar, Zebulun mite tampi akihihsiangthou kei na ua, dan lou bang in Paikan Ankuangluina ane uhi. Himahleh amaute a ding in Hezekiah athum a, "Chingthei ToUPA'N,
english: For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet they ate the Passover other than the way it is written. For Hezekiah had prayed for them, saying, “May the good Yahweh pardon everyone

paite: Michih alungtang a TOUPA, apipute Pathian, Pathian zongte, mun siangthou siansakna dan dungzui in kisiangsak kei mahleh, ngaidam hen," chi in.
english: who sets his heart to seek God, Yahweh, the God of his fathers, even if they aren’t clean according to the purification of the sanctuary.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Hezekiah thumna angaikhia a, mipite ahihdamta hi.
english: Yahweh listened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.

paite: Israel mi Jerusalem a omte'n Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina nuamsatak in ni sagih azang ua; Levite leh siampute'n kaihging ngaihtak toh TOUPA pahtawi a la sa in niteng in TOUPA aphat uhi.
english: The children of Israel who were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness. The Levites and the priests praised Yahweh day by day, singing with loud instruments to Yahweh.

paite: Huan Hezekiah in siamtak in TOUPA kilawmtak a phat Levite alungmuan hi. Huchi in TOUPA apipute uh Pathian kiang a thupha tawi in lemna thillatte lan in ni sagih ankuangluina ane tawntung uhi.
english: Hezekiah spoke encouragingly to all the Levites who had good understanding in the service of Yahweh. So they ate throughout the feast for the seven days, offering sacrifices of peace offerings and making confession to Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

paite: Huan mipi in ni sagih dang ankuang lui nawn asawm ua; huchi in ni sagih dang nuamsatak in ankuang alui nawn uhi.
english: The whole assembly took counsel to keep another seven days, and they kept another seven days with gladness.

paite: Huan Judah kumpipa Hezekiah in mipite bawngtal sangkhat leh belam sangsagih goh ding in apia a; miliante'n mipite bawngtal sangkhat leh belam singkhat apia uhi; siampu tampite akihihsiangthou uhi.
english: For Hezekiah king of Judah gave to the assembly for offerings one thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the assembly a thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep; and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.

paite: Huchi in Judah mipi tengteng siampute toh Levite toh, Israel gam a kipan a mipi hong pai tengteng leh namdang Israel gam a kipan a hong pai Judah gam a omte'n nuam asa mahmah uhi.
english: All the assembly of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the assembly who came out of Israel, and the foreigners who came out of the land of Israel and who lived in Judah, rejoiced.

paite: Huchi in nopsakna thupitak Jerusalem ah a-om a: Israel kumpipa David tapa Solomon chiang ah huchibang himhim Jerusalem ah a-om ngei nai kei hi.
english: So there was great joy in Jerusalem; for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel there was nothing like this in Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in siampu leh Levite athou ua, mipite avualzawl ua; a-aw uh ngaihkhiak in a-om a, athumna un a-omna siangthou van apha hi.
english: Then the Levitical priests arose and blessed the people. Their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy habitation, even to heaven.

paite: Huchi in huai tengteng ahih khit un huai a Israel mi om tengteng in Judah gam tengteng leh Benjamin gam leh Ephraim leh Manasseh gam suangphuhte ahihzan ua, Asherahte aphuk ua, mun sangte leh maitamte achipsak vek masiah uh Judah gam khuate ah apai zel uhi. Huchi in Israel suante tengteng agam uah amau khua chiat ah apai nawn uhi.
english: Now when all this was finished, all Israel who were present went out to the cities of Judah and broke the pillars in pieces, cut down the Asherah poles, and broke down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, also in Ephraim and Manasseh, until they had destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.

paite: Huan Hezekiah in siampute leh Levite apawldan bang zel un michih siampute leh Levite'n atuah chiat ding un, halmang thillat leh lemna thillat lanmi dingte, nasemmi dingte, kipahthu genmi ding leh TOUPA omna kongpi a ngakmi dingte pawl abawlsak chiat hi.
english: Hezekiah appointed the divisions of the priests and the Levites after their divisions, every man according to his service, both the priests and the Levites, for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of Yahweh’s camp.

paite: TOUPA dan a tuang bangbang in zingsang lam leh nitaklam halmang thillat dingte, Sabbath leh kha thak leh hunbi nei ankuang a dingte kumpipa tantuan a ding asep hi.
english: He also appointed the king’s portion of his possessions for the burnt offerings: for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the Sabbaths, for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in Yahweh’s law.

paite: Jerusalem a mipite TOUPA dan a akihihhatna ding un siampute leh Levite tantuan pe ding in thu ape lai hi.
english: Moreover he commanded the people who lived in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might give themselves to Yahweh’s law.

paite: Huai thupiak adalhzaktak in Israel suante'n abuhte, uainte, thaute, khuaizute, alou ua thilsuak masapente ahong pia ua; abangkim uh sawm-a-khat leng ahong pia uhi.
english: As soon as the commandment went out, the children of Israel gave in abundance the first fruits of grain, new wine, oil, honey, and of all the increase of the field; and they brought in the tithe of all things abundantly.

paite: srael suante leh Judah suante, Judah khuate a omte'n abawng uleh belam uh sawm-a-khatte, TOUPA a Pathian uh tantuam dia apiaksawn uh sawm-a-khatte ahon pia ua, akoihkhawm ekok phet uhi.
english: The children of Israel and Judah, who lived in the cities of Judah, also brought in the tithe of cattle and sheep, and the tithe of dedicated things which were consecrated to Yahweh their God, and laid them in heaps.

paite: Kha thumna ah akoihkhawm pan ua, akha sagihna ah akoihkhawm khin uhi.
english: In the third month, they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah leh amiliante un koihkhawm amuh un TOUPA leh ami Israelte aphat uhi.
english: When Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed Yahweh and his people Israel.

paite: Hezekiah in athil koihkhawm tungtang thu uh huai siampute leh Levite adong a.
english: Then Hezekiah questioned the priests and the Levites about the heaps.

paite: Zadok mi siampu heutu Azariah in adawng a, "Mite'n TOUPA' inn a thilpiak ahon tawi tung ua kipan in i ne zel ua, i deihkhop ua, a-om ekok lai hi. TOUPA'N mite avualzawl zel a, hiai a om ekok lai teng i kham val uh ei ve," achi hi.
english: Azariah the chief priest, of the house of Zadok, answered him and said, “Since people began to bring the offerings into Yahweh’s house, we have eaten and had enough, and have plenty left over, for Yahweh has blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.”

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah in TOUPA' inn ah dantante bawl ding in thu apia a; abawlta uhi.
english: Then Hezekiah commanded them to prepare rooms in Yahweh’s house, and they prepared them.

paite: Huan thilpiakte sawm-a-khatte, Pathian a tuamte muanhuaitak in anawn lut uhi: aheutu uh Levi mi Konaniah ahi a, a-unau Shimei bel azom ahi.
english: They brought in the offerings, the tithes, and the dedicated things faithfully. Conaniah the Levite was ruler over them, and Shimei his brother was second.

paite: Konaniah leh a-unau Shimei nuai ah kumpipa Hezekiah leh Pathian inn a heutu Azariah seh in endikmi Jehiel, Azajiah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismakiah, Mahath leh Benaiahte a-om uhi.
english: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah were overseers under the hand of Conaniah and Shimei his brother, by the appointment of Hezekiah the king and Azariah the ruler of God’s house.

paite: Levi mi Imna tapa Kore, suahlam kongkhak ngakmi Pathian kiang a lungsim ut thu a thilpiak kempa leh TOUPA a dia thilpiak leh thil siangthoupen hawmpa ahi.
english: Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the gatekeeper at the east gate, was over the free will offerings of God, to distribute Yahweh’s offerings and the most holy things.

paite: Anuai ah Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, Shekaniah, siampu khua ah nasep hunbi chiat ah a-unaute uh apawlpawl aneu leh aliante kiang a semmi a-om uhi:
english: Under him were Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their office of trust, to give to their brothers by divisions, to the great as well as to the small;

paite: Khangthu sut pasal kum thum chiang tunglam, niteng a TOUPA' inn a nasep kul nei a pawl dandan bang ua hohsekte sim louh in.
english: in addition to those who were listed by genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, even everyone who entered into Yahweh’s house, as the duty of every day required, for their service in their offices according to their divisions;

paite: A-inkuan uh pipute gelhna a siampu asehte leh Levi mi kum sawmnih chiang tunglam apawldan bang zel ua nasemmi dia sehte;
english: and those who were listed by genealogy of the priests by their fathers’ houses, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their offices by their divisions;

paite: pipute gelhna a tuang ataneute tengteng uh, azite uh, atapate uh, a-inkuan tengteng uh; asepna bik ua siangthoutak a akihihsiangthoute ahi uhi.
english: and those who were listed by genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation; for in their office of trust they sanctified themselves in holiness.

paite: Aaron suan kho chih khopua a om siampute leh Levite suante gelhna a tuang peuhmahte tantuan pe ding mi sehtuam a-om uhi.
english: Also for the sons of Aaron the priests, who were in the fields of the pasture lands of their cities, in every city, there were men who were mentioned by name to give portions to all the males among the priests and to all who were listed by genealogy among the Levites.

paite: Huchibang in Judah gam tengteng ah Hezekiah in ahih a, TOUPA a Pathian mitmuh in hoih leh dik leh muanhuai thil ahih sek hi.
english: Hezekiah did so throughout all Judah; and he did that which was good, right, and faithful before Yahweh his God.

paite: Pathian nasep lam thu ah, dan lam thu ah, thupiak lam thu ah, a Pathian zon thu ah ahih peuhmah ah alungsim tengteng in ahih a, alamzang zel hi.
english: In every work that he began in the service of God’s house, in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart and prospered.

paite: Huchibang a muanhuaitak a thil ahih nung un Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib ahong kuan a, Judah gam ah ahong lut a, kulh nei khuate ahong um a, lak ahong tum hi.
english: After these things and this faithfulness, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, entered into Judah, encamped against the fortified cities, and intended to win them for himself.

paite: Sennakerib ahong kuan a, Jerusalem hong sual atum chih Hezekiah in atheih in,
english: When Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib had come, and that he was planning to fight against Jerusalem,

paite: kho polam a tuite hihtat ding in amiliante leh amihatte athuhilh a; huchi in apanpih uhi.
english: he took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the springs which were outside of the city, and they helped him.

paite: Huchi in mi tampi akikaikhawm ua, tui tengteng leh gamsung a luangsuak luite achingtan ua, Assuria kumpipate ahong lut ua, "Tui tampi bang ding in ahong nei mahmah ding ua," achi uhi.
english: Then many people gathered together and they stopped all the springs and the brook that flowed through the middle of the land, saying, “Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find abundant water?”

paite: Huchi in akihangsak ua, kulh chipna tata abawl a, insungte leh polam kulhte leng abawlhoih hi. David khua ah Millo ahihkip a, galvante leh lumte tampi abawl hi.
english: He took courage, built up all the wall that was broken down, and raised it up to the towers, with the other wall outside, and strengthened Millo in David’s city, and made weapons and shields in abundance.

paite: Kidouna a mipi heutute abawl a, khopi kongkhak mun za lai ah asamkhawm hi.
english: He set captains of war over the people, gathered them together to him in the wide place at the gate of the city, and spoke encouragingly to them, saying,

paite: "Hattak in, hangsantak in om unla, Assuria kumpipa leh aheute mipi lau kei unla, lunglel sam kei un:
english: “Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or dismayed because of the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude who is with him; for there is a greater one with us than with him.

paite: Amah lam a pangsa sepaih ahi ua, ei hon panpih ding leh hon dousak ding a ei lam a pang bel TOUPA i Pathian uh ahi ngal a," chi in lungmuanna thu agen hi.
english: An arm of flesh is with him, but Yahweh our God is with us to help us and to fight our battles.” The people rested themselves on the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.

paite: Huai nung in Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib in; amah leh asepaihte Lakish ah a-om ua, Judah kumpipa Hezekiah leh Jerusalem a Judah mi tengteng kiang ah,
english: After this, Sennacherib king of Assyria sent his servants to Jerusalem, (now he was attacking Lachish, and all his forces were with him), to Hezekiah king of Judah, and to all Judah who were at Jerusalem, saying,

paite: "Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib in hichi in achi, Jerusalem lak bang ahia na uplouhna uh?
english: Sennacherib king of Assyria says, “In whom do you trust, that you remain under siege in Jerusalem?

paite: Hezekiah in, TOUPA i Pathian in Assuria kumpipa khut a kipan hon hunkhe ding, chi in gilkial leh dangtak a na sihna ding un ahon khem ahi kei maw?
english: Doesn’t Hezekiah persuade you to give you over to die by famine and by thirst, saying, ‘Yahweh our God will deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria’?

paite: Hezekiah mah ahi kei maw, amun sangte leh amaitamte chimsak a Judah mi leh Jerusalem a mite kiang a, maitam khat ah Pathian na be ding ua, gimlim na hal ding uh, chi a thu pepa?
english: Hasn’t the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You shall worship before one altar, and you shall burn incense on it’?

paite: Kei leh ka pute'n gamdang mite tung a ka thilhih uh na thei kei ua hia?
english: Don’t you know what I and my fathers have done to all the peoples of the lands? Were the gods of the nations of those lands in any way able to deliver their land out of my hand?

paite: "Kua namte pathian ahia ka pute'n ahihman uh ka khut a kipan a amite uh hunkhe thei om a, noute Pathian in leng ka khut a kipan a ahon hutkhiak theih tuamna ding?
english: Who was there among all the gods of those nations which my fathers utterly destroyed that could deliver his people out of my hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of my hand?

paite: Huaiziak in Hezekiah in hon khem kei henla, huchibang in hon khem kei henla, amah um kei un; bang nam pathian leh bang gam pathian himhim amite uh ka khut a kipan leh ka pute khut a kipan hunkhe thei a-om kei ua; bangchi in na Pathian un ka khut a kipan a hon hunkhe thei tuam mahmah dia?" chi in Jerusalem ah amite asawl hi.
english: Now therefore don’t let Hezekiah deceive you nor persuade you in this way. Don’t believe him, for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of my hand, and out of the hand of my fathers. How much less will your God deliver you out of my hand?”

paite: Huan amite'n huai sang a thupi in TOUPA Pathian leh asikha Hezekiah tungtang thu ahoih lou lam in agen uhi.
english: His servants spoke yet more against Yahweh God and against his servant Hezekiah.

paite: Israelte' TOUPA Pathian hehsak ding leh gense ding in lai agelh lai hi. "Gam chih, namte pathiante'n ka khut a kipan amite uh hunkhe thei lou bangmah in Hezekiah Pathian in leng ka khut a kipan amite ahunkhe kei hial ding," chi in.
english: He also wrote letters insulting Yahweh, the God of Israel, and speaking against him, saying, “As the gods of the nations of the lands, which have not delivered their people out of my hand, so shall the God of Hezekiah not deliver his people out of my hand.”

paite: Khua alaktheihna ding un amulkimsakna ding leh lungzinsakna ding in Jerusalem a kulh a omte Judah pau in ngaihtak in akikoukhum uhi.
english: They called out with a loud voice in the Jews’ language to the people of Jerusalem who were on the wall, to frighten them and to trouble them, that they might take the city.

paite: Jerusalem Pathian mihing khut a bawl leitung mite pathian bang lel phet in agen uhi.
english: They spoke of the God of Jerusalem as of the gods of the peoples of the earth, which are the work of men’s hands.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Hezekiah leh Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai huaiziak in athum ua, van a om asam uhi.
english: Hezekiah the king and Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, prayed because of this, and cried to heaven.

paite: TOUPA'N angel asawl a, huai in Assuria kumpipa giahmun a mihat hangsan tengteng leh makai heutute athat hi. Huchi in zum mahmah melpu in agam lam ah apai nawnta hi. Huan apathian inn a hoh lai ama tapate mahmah in namsau in athat uhi.
english: Yahweh sent an angel, who cut off all the mighty men of valor, the leaders, and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. When he had come into the house of his god, those who came out of his own body killed him there with the sword.

paite: Huchibang in TOUPA'N Hezekiah leh Jerusalem a mite Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib khut a kipan leh midang tengteng khut a kipan ahumbit a, akim ua mite lak ah aveng hi.
english: Thus Yahweh saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria and from the hand of all others, and guided them on every side.

paite: Huan mi tampi in Jerusalem ah TOUPA a ding in thilpiak ahon tawi ua, thil manpha pipite Judah kumpipa Hezekiah ahong pia ua; huai a kipan in nam chih mitmuh in pahtawi in a-omta hi.
english: Many brought gifts to Yahweh to Jerusalem, and precious things to Hezekiah king of Judah, so that he was exalted in the sight of all nations from then on.

paite: Huai lai in Hezekiah bel sizou ding khop in achina a, TOUPA kiang ah athum a: huan, adawng a, chiamtehna apia hi.
english: In those days Hezekiah was terminally ill, and he prayed to Yahweh; and he spoke to him, and gave him a sign.

paite: Himahleh Hezekiah in amah a ding a hoih kihih dungzui in ahih kei a, alungtang hong kisaktheih ziak in ahi; huaiziak in atung ah leh Judahte leh Jerusalem tung ah hehna ahong tung hi.
english: But Hezekiah didn’t reciprocate appropriate to the benefit done for him, because his heart was lifted up. Therefore there was wrath on him, Judah, and Jerusalem.

paite: Himahleh Hezekiah in alungtang kisaktheihna kisik in akiniamkhiak nawn a, amah leh Jerusalem a mite toh; huchi in Hezekiah damsung in TOUPA hehna atung uah ahong tung kei hi.
english: However, Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that Yahweh’s wrath didn’t come on them in the days of Hezekiah.

paite: Huan Hezekiah in sum-le-pai ahau a, athupita mahmah a; dangkasik, dangka-eng, suangmantam, gimlim, lum leh tui-um belsuan hoih pipi koihkhawmna inn alam hi.
english: Hezekiah had exceedingly great riches and honor. He provided himself with treasuries for silver, for gold, for precious stones, for spices, for shields, and for all kinds of valuable vessels;

paite: Buh, uain leh thau koihkhawmna inn leng alam lai a; gan chiteng koihna leh belam huang leng abawl hi.
english: also storehouses for the increase of grain, new wine, and oil; and stalls for all kinds of animals, and flocks in folds.

paite: Huchi in khuate leng abawl lai a, belamhon leh bawnghon ahau mahmah hi. Pathian in neizoutak in abawl hi.
english: Moreover he provided for himself cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance; for God had given him abundant possessions.

paite: Hezekiah mah in Gihon luitui saknungzaw pen ahubing a, David khua tumlam pang ah aluangkhesak hi. Huchi in Hezekiah athilhih tengteng ah alamzang zel hi.
english: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper spring of the waters of Gihon, and brought them straight down on the west side of David’s city. Hezekiah prospered in all his works.

paite: Babulon miliante'n palai asawl ua agam a thillamdang adot thu uah alungtang a om tengteng atheihtheihna ding in Pathian in anusia in aze-et hi.
english: However, concerning the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent to him to inquire of the wonder that was done in the land, God left him to test him, that he might know all that was in his heart.

paite: Hezekiah thilhih dang tengteng, athilhih hoihte, ngai dih, Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai kilakna bu, Judah kumpipa leh Israel kumpite tanchinbu ah gelh in a-om hi.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah and his good deeds, behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

paite: Api-le-pute kiang ah Hezekiah a-ihmu a, David tapate hanmun paitouhna ah avui ua; Judah tengteng leh Jerusalem a mite'n asih ni in thupitak in agal uhi. Asik in atapa Manasseh in vai ahawmta hi.
english: Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the ascent to the tombs of the sons of David. All Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem honored him at his death. Manasseh his son reigned in his place.

paite: Manasseh in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawm-le-nih ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga-le-nga vai ahawm hi.
english: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou, Israel suante ma a TOUPA'N adelhkhiak Pathian thei lou namte'n thilkihhuaitak ahih bang uh ama'n leng ahih zel hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, after the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh cast out before the children of Israel.

paite: Apa Hezekiah in ahihchip nung mun sangte abawlhoih a, Baalte a ding in maitam abawl a, Asherah limte abawl a, van a om tengteng abia a, a-nna uh asem hi.
english: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down; and he raised up altars for the Baals, made Asheroth, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served them.

paite: "Jerusalem ah tangtawn in ka min a-om ding," TOUPA'N achihna TOUPA' inn ah maitamte abawl hi.
english: He built altars in Yahweh’s house, of which Yahweh said, “My name shall be in Jerusalem forever.”

paite: TOUPA' inn huangsung intual nih ah van a om tengteng a ding in maitamte abawl hi.
english: He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of Yahweh’s house.
