paite: Phaizang ah Hinnom tapa mei ah atate alutsak a; aisante aching a, bumte aching a, dawi aisan siam zawlte leh bumsiamte aguai sek a; TOUPA thangpaisak ding in amitmuh ah thil hoih lou ahih hi.
english: He also made his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom. He practiced sorcery, divination, and witchcraft, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits and with wizards. He did much evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

paite: Pathian in David leh atapa Solomon kiang a, "Hiai inn leh Jerusalem a Israel chi tengteng lak a ka tel ah ka min tangtawn in ka omsak ding, achih khitsa Pathian inn ah amah bawl, milim bawltawm akoih hi.
english: He set the engraved image of the idol, which he had made, in God’s house, of which God said to David and to Solomon his son, “In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever.

paite: Thu ka piak tengteng leh dan tengteng, dan thuseh, thilhih ding Mosi zang a ka piakte azuih peuhmah uleh api-le-pute uh ka piaksa gam a kipan Israelte khe ka kal suankhesak nawn kei ding," achihna ah.
english: I will not any more remove the foot of Israel from off the land which I have appointed for your fathers, if only they will observe to do all that I have commanded them, even all the law, the statutes, and the ordinances given by Moses.”

paite: Manasseh in Judahte leh Jerusalem a mite thil ahihkhialsak a; TOUPA'N Israelte ma a ahihman khitsa namte sang in ahihkhialzaw hi.
english: Manasseh seduced Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that they did more evil than did the nations whom Yahweh destroyed before the children of Israel.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Manasseh leh amite kiang ah thu agen zel a; himahleh alimsak kei uhi.
english: Yahweh spoke to Manasseh and to his people, but they didn’t listen.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Assuria sepaih heutute asawl a, Manasseh khainiang in akhih ua, kol abunsak ua, Babulon ah apaipihta uhi.
english: Therefore Yahweh brought on them the captains of the army of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh in chains, bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

paite: Huchi in mangbangtak a a-om lai in TOUPA a Pathian azong a, api-le-pute Pathian ma ah nakpitak in akiniamkhiak hi.
english: When he was in distress, he begged Yahweh his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.

paite: Akiang ah athum a, hehpih angen a, angetna angaihkhiaksak a, Jerusalem ah agam ah apai nawnta hi.
english: He prayed to him; and he was entreated by him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that Yahweh was God.

paite: Huai nung in David kho polam ah Gihon tumlam pang phaizang ah ngasa kongkhak lutna pha in kulh abawl a, Ophel umsuak in sangpi in adingsak a: Judah khua kulh nei tengteng ah heutu hangsan taktak akoih hi.
english: Now after this, he built an outer wall to David’s city on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entrance at the fish gate. He encircled Ophel with it, and raised it up to a very great height; and he put valiant captains in all the fortified cities of Judah.

paite: Gamdang pathiante leh milimte, TOUPA' inn a kipan apaimang a, tang a TOUPA' inn leh Jerusalem a maitam abawl tengteng khua a kipan apaikhe vek uhi.
english: He took away the foreign gods and the idol out of Yahweh’s house, and all the altars that he had built in the mountain of Yahweh’s house and in Jerusalem, and cast them out of the city.

paite: TOUPA maitam abawl a, lemna thillat kithoihnate, kipahthu gennate alan a, Judahte bel TOUPA Israel' Pathian nasem ding in thu apia hi.
english: He built up Yahweh’s altar, and offered sacrifices of peace offerings and of thanksgiving on it, and commanded Judah to serve Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: Mipite mun sang ah akithoih lailai ua; himahleh TOUPA a Pathian uh kiang ah kithoih ahi zawta hi.
english: Nevertheless the people still sacrificed in the high places, but only to Yahweh their God.

paite: Manasseh tanchin dang tengteng, a Pathian kiang a athum thute, TOUPA Israel' Pathian min a zawlnei in akiang a thu agente uh ngai dih, Israel kumpipate tanchin lak ah atuang hi.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer to his God, and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel, behold, they are written among the acts of the kings of Israel.

paite: Athumnate, Pathian in ahehpihna leh akiniamkhiak ma in agitlouhna tengteng, mun sang abawl a, Asher leh milim bawltawm a bawlkhiakna mun tengteng leng, ngai dih, Hozai tanchin gelhna bu ah atuang vek hi.
english: His prayer also, and how God listened to his request, and all his sin and his trespass, and the places in which he built high places and set up the Asherah poles and the engraved images before he humbled himself: behold, they are written in the history of Hozai.

paite: Huchi in Manasseh bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, ama inn ah avui ua; atapa Ammon in asik in vai ahawmta hi.
english: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house; and Amon his son reigned in his place.

paite: Ammon in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nih ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum nih vai ahawm hi.
english: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.

paite: Apa Manasseh hih mah bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; apa Manasseh in abawl milim bawltawm tengteng kiang ah Ammon akithoih a, a-nna asem hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as did Manasseh his father; and Amon sacrificed to all the engraved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them.

paite: Apa Manasseh kiniamkhiak bang in TOUPA ma ah akiniamkhiak kei a, Ammon agilou semsem hi.
english: He didn’t humble himself before Yahweh, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but this same Amon trespassed more and more.

paite: Huchi in a sikhate'n asawm ua, ama inn ah athat uhi.
english: His servants conspired against him, and put him to death in his own house.

paite: Himahleh kumpipa Ammon kalh a phialguk sawm mi tengteng mipi'n athat vek nawn ua; asik a kumpipa hi ding in mipite'n atapa Josiah abawlta uhi.
english: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.

paite: Josiah in vaihawm apat tung in kum giat a upa ahi; Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum-le-khat vai ahawm hi.
english: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih zel a, apu David lampite azui a, taklam ah hiam, veilam ah hiam apialsan kei hi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and walked in the ways of David his father, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left.

paite: Kum giat avaihawm kum, naupangtak ahih lai a kipan him in apu David Pathian azong pan a; kum sawm-le-nih avaihawm kum in Judah gam leh Jerusalem a mun sangte, Asherte, milim bawltawmte, milim suntawmte ahihbei a.
english: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father; and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, the Asherah poles, the engraved images, and the molten images.

paite: Baal maitamte amitmuh in achimsak ua; huaite sang a sangzaw milimte aphuk a; Asherte, milim bawltawmte, milim suntawmte ahihkham vek a, akiang ua kithoih mite han tung ah athehzak hi.
english: They broke down the altars of the Baals in his presence; and he cut down the incense altars that were on high above them. He broke the Asherah poles, the engraved images, and the molten images in pieces, made dust of them, and scattered it on the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.

paite: Siampu guhte amaitamte uah ahal a, Judah gam leh Jerusalem ahihsiang hi.
english: He burned the bones of the priests on their altars, and purged Judah and Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi mah bang in Manasseh, Ephraim, Simeon leh Naphtali khuate tan in ahih vek hi.
english: He did this in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, even to Naphtali, around in their ruins.

paite: Maitamte achimsak a, Asherte, milim bawltawmte ahihkham a, Israel gam tengteng a milimte aphuk vek a, Jerusalem ah apai nawn hi.
english: He broke down the altars, beat the Asherah poles and the engraved images into powder, and cut down all the incense altars throughout all the land of Israel, then returned to Jerusalem.

paite: Huan avaihawm kum sawm-le-giat kum, agam leh innte ahihsiang kum in Azaliah tapa Shaphan, kho ukpa Maaseiah, Joahaz tapa laigelhmi Joah TOUPA a Pathian inn bawlhoih ding in asawl hi.
english: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder to repair the house of Yahweh his God.

paite: Siampu Hilkiah kiang ah ahoh ua, kongkhak ngak Levite'n Manasseh mite, Israel khosuaksunte, Judah mi leh Benjamin mite, Jerusalem a mite kiang a kipan ana lakkhawm uh, Pathian inn a hong koih uh dangka apia uhi.
english: They came to Hilkiah the high priest and delivered the money that was brought into God’s house, which the Levites, the keepers of the threshold, had gathered from the hands of Manasseh, Ephraim, of all the remnant of Israel, of all Judah and Benjamin, and of the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA' inn lammi nasemte apia ua; TOUPA' inn nasem mite'n inn bawl mite leh zem mite apia uhi.
english: They delivered it into the hands of the workmen who had the oversight of Yahweh’s house; and the workmen who labored in Yahweh’s house gave it to mend and repair the house.

paite: Judah kumpipate'n ahihsiat uh bawlhoihna ding in suangsekte, apehnate leh a-inkamte ding sing leina ding in khutsiamte leh inn lam mite apia uhi.
english: They gave it to the carpenters and to the builders to buy cut stone and timber for couplings, and to make beams for the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.

paite: Huchi in mite'n muanhuaitak in nna asem ua; aheutu uh, nasep ngaihtuah mite, Merari tapate lak a Levi mi Jahath leh Obadiah, Kohath mi tapate lak a mi Zekariah leh Meshullamte ahi ua; Levi mi, midang ginglawm tumsiam tengteng toh;
english: The men did the work faithfully. Their overseers were Jahath and Obadiah the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to give direction; and others of the Levites, who were all skillful with musical instruments.

paite: apuak a puakthoh mite heutu leh nna chiteng sem mite sep ding ngaihtuahmi ahi uhi. Laigelhmite, heutute, kongkhak ngak mite Levi mite lak a mi ahi uh.
english: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and directed all who did the work in every kind of service. Of the Levites, there were scribes, officials, and gatekeepers.

paite: Huan TOUPA' inn a hong koih uh sumte asuah ualeh, siampu Hilkiah in Mosi zang a apiak TOUPA Dan Bu amukhia hi.
english: When they brought out the money that was brought into Yahweh’s house, Hilkiah the priest found the book of Yahweh’s law given by Moses.

paite: Huchi in Hilkiah in laigelhmi Shaphan kiang ah, "TOUPA' inn ah Dan Bu i mukheta uh," achi a. Huan Hilkiah in laibu Shaphan apia hi.
english: Hilkiah answered Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the book of the law in Yahweh’s house.” So Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.

paite: Huan Shaphan in laibu kumpipa kiang ah apaipih a, "Na sikhate'n hih ding a seh a om tengteng ahih uh.
english: Shaphan carried the book to the king, and moreover brought back word to the king, saying, “All that was committed to your servants, they are doing.

paite: TOUPA' inn a dangka om abungkhia ua, heutute leh nasem mite apia uh," chi in thu atun hi.
english: They have emptied out the money that was found in Yahweh’s house, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers and into the hand of the workmen.”

paite: Laigelhmi Shaphan in, "Siampu Hilkiah in laibu ahon pia,” chi in kumpipa ahilh a, kumpipa ma ah asim hi.
english: Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, “Hilkiah the priest has delivered me a book.” Shaphan read from it to the king.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa'n Dan thute azak in, apuan abotkek hi.
english: When the king had heard the words of the law, he tore his clothes.

paite: Kumpipa'n Hilkiah, Shaphan tapa Ahikam, Mikah tapa Abdon, laigelhmi Shaphan leh kumpipa sikha Asaiah thu apia hi.
english: The king commanded Hilkiah, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Abdon the son of Micah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying,

paite: "Kuan unla, dan thu na muhkhiak tungtang thu uah kei leh Israel leh Judah gam a mite a ding in TOUPA hon dotsak dih ua; i pi-le-pute'n hiai Dan Bu a tuang bang a TOUPA thu azuih louh ziak un i tung uah TOUPA thangpaihna ahong om mahmah ngal a," chi in.
english: “Go inquire of Yahweh for me, and for those who are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found; for great is Yahweh’s wrath that is poured out on us, because our fathers have not kept Yahweh’s word, to do according to all that is written in this book.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n thu apiak mite leh Hilkiah puansilh kempa Hasrah tapa Tokhat tapa Shallum zi zawlnei Huldah kiang ah ava hoh ua, huai thu ah ava houpih uhi. Amah bel Jerusalem Misneh a om ahi.
english: So Hilkiah and those whom the king had commanded went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tokhath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe (now she lived in Jerusalem in the second quarter), and they spoke to her to that effect.

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi, "Ka kiang a nou hon sawlpa hilh unla, TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: She said to them, “Yahweh, the God of Israel says: ‘Tell the man who sent you to me,

paite: 'Ngai dih ua, hiai mun leh asung a omte tung ah thil hoih lou ka tungsak ding a, Judah kumpipa ma a kisimkhia, laibu a tuang hamsia tengteng leng;
english: “Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will bring evil on this place and on its inhabitants, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah.

paite: akhut thilhih ua hon hehsakna ding ua hon lehngatsan a, milim dangte ding a gimlim ahal ziak un hiai mun tung ah ka hehna sun ahi a, daihsak ahi kei ding,' chi in.
english: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands, therefore my wrath is poured out on this place, and it will not be quenched.’”’

paite: Himahleh TOUPA thu dong ding a nou hon sawlpa Judah kumpipa kiang ah, hichibang in chi un, TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi, 'Na thuzakte tungtang thu ah,
english: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of Yahweh, you shall tell him this, ‘Yahweh, the God of Israel says: “About the words which you have heard,

paite: na lungtang hihnem a a-om ziak a Pathian ma a na kiniamkhiak a, hiai mun tungtang thu leh asung a omte tungtang thu na zak a, ka ma a na kiniamkhiak a, na puan na bohkek a, ka ma a na kah ziak in ke'n leng na thu ka na ngaikhia hi.
english: because your heart was tender, and you humbled yourself before God when you heard his words against this place and against its inhabitants, and have humbled yourself before me, and have torn your clothes and wept before me, I also have heard you,” says Yahweh.

paite: Ngai dih, na pi leh na pute kiang ah ka hon hohsak ding a, na han ah lungmuangtak in na pai ding a, hiai mun leh asung a omte tung a ka hon tunsak ding thil hoih lou tengteng na mit in amu kei ding, chi in gen in,' achi hi. Huchi in kumpipa kiang ah thu atunta uhi.
english: “Behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes won’t see all the evil that I will bring on this place and on its inhabitants.”’” They brought back this message to the king.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n mi asawl a, Judah gam leh Jerusalem a upa tengteng asamkhawm hi.
english: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa leh Judah mi tengteng leh Jerusalem a mi tengteng, siampu leh Levite, mipi tengteng aneu leh alian in TOUPA' inn ah ahohtou ua; TOUPA' inn a muhkhiak thukhun bu a thu tengteng abil ua zak in asim hi.
english: The king went up to Yahweh’s house with all the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem—the priests, the Levites, and all the people, both great and small—and he read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Kumpipa bel amun ah adingh a, huai laibu a tuang thukunte hihkip ding in alungtang tengteng, akha tengteng a ToUPA zui ding leh athupiakte, athu theihsakte, adan thusehte pom ding in TOUPA ma ah thu akhung uhi.
english: The king stood in his place and made a covenant before Yahweh, to walk after Yahweh, and to keep his commandments, his testimonies, and his statutes with all his heart and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant that were written in this book.

paite: Jerusalem leh Benjamin mi tengteng huchibang a om ding in achi ua. Huan Jerusalem a mite'n Pathian, apipute uh Pathian thukhun bang in ahihta uhi.
english: He caused all who were found in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand. The inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.

paite: Huchi in Josiah hi in Israel gam in ahuap tengteng a kipan thilkihhuai tengteng apaimang a, Israel gam a om tengteng TOUPA a Pathian uh nna asemsak hi. Adamsung in TOUPA apipute uh Pathian azuih uh apialsan kei uhi.
english: Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that belonged to the children of Israel, and made all who were found in Israel to serve, even to serve Yahweh their God. All his days they didn’t depart from following Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

paite: Huan Josiah in Jerusalem ah TOUPA a ding in Paikan Ankuang abawl a; akha khatna, ani sawm-le-li ni in Paikan Ankuangluina ding agou hi.
english: Josiah kept a Passover to Yahweh in Jerusalem. They killed the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

paite: Huchi in siampute anasep uh asehsak a, TOUPA' inn a nasepna sem ding in ahanthawn hi.
english: He set the priests in their offices and encouraged them in the service of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Israel mite sinsakmi, Pathian a ding a hihtuam Levite kiang ah, "Israel kumpipa David tapa Solomon inn lam ah bawm siangthou koih un; na liangzang ua zawn akiphamohta kei ding; TOUPA na Pathian uh leh ami Israelte nna semta un.
english: He said to the Levites who taught all Israel, who were holy to Yahweh, “Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel built. It will no longer be a burden on your shoulders. Now serve Yahweh your God and his people Israel.

paite: Israel kumpipa David gelh bang leh atapa Solomon gelh bang in na inkuan vaihawm makai dungzui zel un apawlpawl in kisa un.
english: Prepare yourselves after your fathers’ houses by your divisions, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.

paite: Na unaute uh inkuan vaihawm makai dungzui zel in Levite tuam a tantuan nei in mun siangthou ah om un.
english: Stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of your brothers the children of the people, and let there be for each a portion of a fathers’ house of the Levites.

paite: Paikan Ankuangluina ding gou unla, kihihsiangthou unla, Mosi zang a TOUPA gen bang hih ding in na unaute uh ding in bawl un," achi hi.
english: Kill the Passover lamb, sanctify yourselves, and prepare for your brothers, to do according to Yahweh’s word by Moses.”

paite: Huchi in Josiah in huai a mi om tengteng Paikan Ankuang a dia lan ding in ganhon lak a belamnou leh kelnou singthum leh bawngtal sangthum apia a: huaite kumpipa sum lak a ahi.
english: Josiah gave to the children of the people, of the flock, lambs and young goats, all of them for the Passover offerings, to all who were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bulls. These were of the king’s substance.

paite: Amiliante'n mipite, siampute, Levite amau ut thu a lan ding in apia uhi. Pathian inn a heutu, Hilkiah, Zekariah leh Jehielte'n Paikan Ankuang dia lan ding in ganta nou sangnih-le-zaguk leh bawngtal zathum siampute apia uhi.
english: His princes gave a free will offering to the people, to the priests, and to the Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, the rulers of God’s house, gave to the priests for the Passover offerings two thousand six hundred small livestock, and three hundred head of cattle.

paite: Konaniah, a-unau Shemaiah leh Nethaneel, Levite heutu Hashabiah, Zeiel leh Jozabadte'n leng Paikan Ankuang dia lat ding in Levite ganta nou sangnga leh bawngtal zanga apia uhi.
english: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethanel, his brothers, and Hashabiah, Jeiel, and Jozabad, the chiefs of the Levites, gave to the Levites for the Passover offerings five thousand small livestock and five hundred head of cattle.

paite: Huchi in nasepna abawl ua, kumpipa thupiak bang in siampute amun uah adingh ua, Levite apawldan bang zel un.
english: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites by their divisions, according to the king’s commandment.

paite: Paikan Ankuangluina ding agou ua, siampute'n sisan atheh ua, Levite'n avun ahawk uhi.
english: They killed the Passover lambs, and the priests sprinkled the blood which they received from their hands, and the Levites skinned them.

paite: Huan Mosi laibu a tuang bang a inkuan khendan dungzui zel a TOUPA kiang a lat ding a piak ding in halmang thillatte alasawn ua. Bawngtalte leng huchi mah bang in ahih uhi.
english: They removed the burnt offerings, that they might give them according to the divisions of the fathers’ houses of the children of the people, to offer to Yahweh, as it is written in the book of Moses. They did the same with the cattle.

paite: Huchi in Paikan Ankuangluina ding a dan bang in a-em min ua; thillat siangthousa bel, bel khaina nei, belgongza in a-ui ua, mi tengteng kiang ah apaipih uhi.
english: They roasted the Passover with fire according to the ordinance. They boiled the holy offerings in pots, in cauldrons, and in pans, and carried them quickly to all the children of the people.

paite: Huai khit in amau leh siampute a ding abawl ua; Aaron ta siampute halmang thillat leh sathau lan in zan tanpha in abuai ngal ua; huaiziak in Levite'n amau leh Aaron ta siampute a ding abawl uhi.
english: Afterward they prepared for themselves and for the priests, because the priests the sons of Aaron were busy with offering the burnt offerings and the fat until night. Therefore the Levites prepared for themselves and for the priests the sons of Aaron.

paite: David, Asaph, Heman leh kumpipa zawlnei Jeduthunte thupiak bang in lasami Ashaph tapate amun uah adingh ua, kongkhak ngak mite bel kongkhak chih ah a-om ua; a-unau Levite'n abawlsak ziak un a-nna uh paisan akiphamoh kei hi.
english: The singers, the sons of Asaph, were in their place, according to the commandment of David, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun the king’s seer; and the gatekeepers were at every gate. They didn’t need to depart from their service, because their brothers the Levites prepared for them.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Josiah thupiak bang a Paikan Ankuang lui ding leh TOUPA maitam a halmang thillat lan ding in huai ni mah in TOUPA nasepna thil tengteng abawl uhi.
english: So all the service of Yahweh was prepared the same day, to keep the Passover, and to offer burnt offerings on Yahweh’s altar, according to the commandment of King Josiah.

paite: Huchi in huai lai a Israel suan omte'n huai ni in Paikan Ankuang abawl ua, tanghou silngou soh louh ankuang leng ni sagih abawl lai uhi.
english: The children of Israel who were present kept the Passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.

paite: Zawlnei Samuel dam lai a kipan Israel gam ah Paikan Ankuang huchibang himhim abawl ngei kei ua; Israel kumpipa kuamah in Josiah leh siampute leh Levite leh Judah tengteng leh Israelte'n aneih bang uh nei a-om sam kei uhi.
english: There was no Passover like that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet, nor did any of the kings of Israel keep such a Passover as Josiah kept—with the priests, the Levites, and all Judah and Israel who were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

paite: Kum sawm-le-giat Josiah vaihawm kum in huai Paikan Ankuangluina zat in a-om hi.
english: This Passover was kept in the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah.

paite: Huai tengteng khit a Josiah in tempul abawl khit in, Karkhemish sual ding in Euphrates Luipi ah Aigupta kumpipa Neko apaitou a; Josiah in amah ava sual hi.
english: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Neco king of Egypt went up to fight against Carchemish by the Euphrates, and Josiah went out against him.

paite: Himahleh, ama'n, "Judah kumpipa, ei gel i kisaikhakna bang om ahia? Nang sual ding in ka hong pai kei a, ka dousa dou ding a hong ka hi zaw, Pathian in kinoh ding in thu ahon pia a, ka lam a pang Pathian doudal kei in, ahon hihmang kha ding," chi in palai asawl hi.
english: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, “What have I to do with you, you king of Judah? I come not against you today, but against the house with which I have war. God has commanded me to make haste. Beware that it is God who is with me, that he not destroy you.”

paite: Himahleh Josiah in akiksan nuam kei a, adou theihna ding in akibawl lamdang a, Pathian kam a kipan a Neko thugen apom kei a, Meggiddo Phaizang ah na sual ding in akuan hi.
english: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and didn’t listen to the words of Neco from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.

paite: Huchi in thalkap mite'n Josiah akapkha ua; kumpipa'n asikhate kiang ah, "Hon paimangpih un, liamna thupi mahmah ka tuakta," achi hi.
english: The archers shot at King Josiah; and the king said to his servants, “Take me away, because I am seriously wounded!”

paite: Huchi in asikhate'n kangtalai a kipan alakhia ua, akangtalai dang ah akoih ua, Jerusalem ah apaipih ua, asi a, api-le-pute han ah avui uhi. Judah mi tengteng leh Jerusalem a mite'n Josiah asuun uhi.
english: So his servants took him out of the chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had, and brought him to Jerusalem; and he died, and was buried in the tombs of his fathers. All Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.

paite: Huan Jeremiah in Josiah akah a; lasami numei leh pasalte'n tutan in Josiah akahna la uh agen lailai uhi. Israel gam ah dan in anei ua, ngai dih, kahna la ah huai atuangta hi.
english: Jeremiah lamented for Josiah, and all the singing men and singing women spoke of Josiah in their lamentations to this day; and they made them an ordinance in Israel. Behold, they are written in the lamentations.

paite: Josiah thilhih dang tengteng, athilhih hoihte, TOUPA Dan Bu a kigelh bang zel in,
english: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah and his good deeds, according to that which is written in Yahweh’s law,

paite: amasapen leh ananungpente leng, ngai dih, Israel kumpipa leh Judah kumpipate tanchinbu ah gelh in a-om uhi.
english: and his acts, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

paite: Huai gam a mite'n Josiah tapa Jehoahaz api ua, Jerusalem ah apa sik in kumpipa in abawl uhi.
english: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father’s place in Jerusalem.

paite: Jehoahaz in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-thum ahi a, Jerusalem ah kha thum vai ahawm hi.
english: Joahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.

paite: Aigupta kumpipa'n Jerusalem a avaihawmna atawpsak a, agam uh dangkasik talent zakhat leh dangka-eng talent khat aliausak hi.
english: The king of Egypt removed him from office at Jerusalem, and fined the land one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

paite: Aigupta kumpipa'n a-unaupa Eliakim, Judah leh Jerusalem a kumpipa ding in abawl a, amin Jehoiakim chi in akhensak hi. Huchi in Neko in a-unaupa Jehoahaz Aigupta gam ah api hi.
english: The king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. Neco took Joahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.

paite: Jehoiakim in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-khat vai ahawm hi. TOUPA a Pathian mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih hi.
english: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. He did that which was evil in Yahweh his God’s sight.

paite: Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar amah sual ding in ahong kuan a, Babulon a pi ding in kol abunsak hi.
english: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against him, and bound him in fetters to carry him to Babylon.

paite: Nebukadnezzar in TOUPA' inn a tui-um belsuan leng Babulon ah apua a, Babulon a atempul ah akoih hi.
english: Nebuchadnezzar also carried some of the vessels of Yahweh’s house to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.

paite: Jehoiakim tanchin dangte, athilkihhuai hihte leh a-omdante, ngai dih, Israel kumpipa leh Judah kumpite tanchinbu ah atuang hi. Huan asik in atapa Jehoiakin in vai ahawmta hi.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah; and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.

paite: Jehoiakin in vaihawm apat tung in kum giat ahi a, Jerusalem ah kha thum leh ni sawm vai ahawm a, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih hi.
english: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem. He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight.

paite: Kum abei in kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in mi asawl a, TOUPA in atui-um belsuan hoih pipite toh Babulon ah apisak a, a-unaupa Zedekiah, Judah gam leh Jerusalem a kumpipa ding in abawl hi.
english: At the return of the year, King Nebuchadnezzar sent and brought him to Babylon, with the valuable vessels of Yahweh’s house, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.

paite: Zedekiah in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-khat ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-khat vai ahawm hi.
english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

paite: TOUPA a Pathian mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; TOUPA kam a kipan a thugenpa zawlnei Jeremiah lak ah akiniamkhiak nuam kei hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh his God’s sight. He didn’t humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from Yahweh’s mouth.

paite: Pathian min a kichiamsakpa kumpipa Nebukadnezzar tung ah ahel lai a, genhaktak in a-om a, TOUPA, Israel' Pathian lam nga lou ding in alungsim akhauhsak hi.
english: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God; but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart against turning to Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: Siampu heutu tengteng leh mipite'n leng Pathian thei lou mite mah bang in thilkihhuai pipite ahih ua, Jerusalem a hihsiangthou TOUPA' innte leng ahihbuah uhi.
english: Moreover all the chiefs of the priests and the people trespassed very greatly after all the abominations of the nations; and they polluted Yahweh’s house which he had made holy in Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N amite leh a-omna mun alainat ziak in apipute uh Pathian in akiang uah theihtawp a phatuamngai in mi asawl hi.
english: Yahweh, the God of their fathers, sent to them by his messengers, rising up early and sending, because he had compassion on his people and on his dwelling place;

paite: Himahleh Pathian misawlte amusit ua, athute angaineu ua, amite tung ah TOUPA hehna ahong thou a, hih lungdam nawnna mahmah om lou khop in azawlneite ahihgim uhi.
english: but they mocked the messengers of God, despised his words, and scoffed at his prophets, until Yahweh’s wrath arose against his people, until there was no remedy.

paite: Huaiziak in atung uah Kaldai kumpipa agamtangsak a, ama'n atangvalte uh amun siangthou uah namsau in athat a, nungak leh tangval, tek, teksia kuamah lainatna anei kei a; akhut ah ape vek hi.
english: Therefore he brought on them the king of the Chaldeans, who killed their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion on young man or virgin, old man or infirm. He gave them all into his hand.

paite: Pathian inn a tui-um belsuan tengteng, aneu leh alian, TOUPA' inn a sum koihkhawm tengteng, kumpipa sum koihkhawm leh amiliante sum koihkhawmte nangawn in Babulon ah apo vek hi.
english: All the vessels of God’s house, great and small, and the treasures of Yahweh’s house, and the treasures of the king and of his princes, all these he brought to Babylon.

paite: Pathian innte ahal a, Jerusalem kulhte achimsak a, huai lai a inn thupi tengteng ahal a, huai lai a tui-um belsuan hoih tengteng ahihse vek hi.
english: They burned God’s house, broke down the wall of Jerusalem, burned all its palaces with fire, and destroyed all of its valuable vessels.

paite: Namsau thah bang teng Babulon ah api a, Persiate ahong laltak un, sikha in amah leh atapate a-om uhi.
english: He carried those who had escaped from the sword away to Babylon, and they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia,

paite: Gam in nuamtak a a Sabbathte azattan a Jeremiah kam a TOUPA thugen atangtunna ding in, segawp a a-om sung teng, kum sawmsagih tangtunna ding in, a Sabbathte atang uhi.
english: to fulfill Yahweh’s word by Jeremiah’s mouth, until the land had enjoyed its Sabbaths. As long as it lay desolate, it kept Sabbath, to fulfill seventy years.

paite: Huchi in Persia kumpipa Kura vaihawm tung kum in Jeremiah kam a TOUPA thu atunkim theihna ding in agam tengteng a thankhiak vek ding leh agelh a gelh ding in leng TOUPA'N Persia kumpipa Kura lungtang atokthou hi.
english: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that Yahweh’s word by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

paite: Persia kumpipa Kura in hichi in achi: "Khovel gam tengteng TOUPA, van Pathian in ahon pia a; Judah gam a Jerusalem ah a-inn lamsak ding in thu ahon pia ahi. Na lak ua ama mite photphot kiang ah TOUPA a Pathian om henla, va hohtou uhen," chi in.
english: “Cyrus king of Persia says, ‘Yahweh, the God of heaven, has given all the kingdoms of the earth to me; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whoever there is among you of all his people, Yahweh his God be with him, and let him go up.’”

paite: Dal maitam, adunglam tong sawmnih, availam tong sawmnih, asandan tong sawm abawl hi.
english: Then he made an altar of bronze, twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.

paite: Dal lohbem lianpi, agei leh agei kikal a tong sawm kia, asandan tong nga abawl a; agei akimvel in tong sawmthum ahi.
english: Also he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim. It was round, five cubits high, and thirty cubits in circumference.

paite: Agei nuai bawngtal limte in avelsuak a, tong khat ah sawm zel, dal loh kimvel in a-om hi. Bawngtal limte vual nih ahi a, dal loh akimat a sun ahi.
english: Under it was the likeness of oxen, which encircled it, for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The oxen were in two rows, cast when it was cast.

paite: Huchi in bel bawngtal sawm-le-nih tung ah akinga a, thum in mallam anga ua, thum in tumlam anga ua, thum in simlam anga ua, thum in suahlam anga uh; dal loh bel huaite tung ah akoih a, anunglam anga hi.
english: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, three looking toward the west, three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set on them above, and all their hindquarters were inward.

paite: Loh pen khutpek tan in asah a, agei ahihleh nou gei bangbang, lili pak bang a bawl ahi a, bath sangthum ta ahi.
english: It was a handbreadth thick. Its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It received and held three thousand baths.

paite: Kisilna ding kuangzawn, sawm abawl lai a, taklam sang ah nga atung a, veilam sang ah nga atung a; huaite bel halmang thillat silna ding ahi; huan, dal lohbem bel siampute kisilna ding ahi.
english: He also made ten basins, and put five on the right hand and five on the left, to wash in them. The things that belonged to the burnt offering were washed in them, but the sea was for the priests to wash in.

paite: Huan bawldan ding a aseh bang in, dangka-eng khawnvak koihna sawm abawl a, tempul sung taklam ah nga, veilam ah nga akoih hi.
english: He made the ten lamp stands of gold according to the ordinance concerning them; and he set them in the temple, five on the right hand and five on the left.

paite: Dohkan sawm abawl lai a, tempul sung ah taklam ah nga, veilam ah nga akoih a, dangka-eng kuangzawn zakhat abawl hi.
english: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left. He made one hundred basins of gold.

paite: Huai lou leng siampute huang leh huang zapite a-um a, huang kongkhakte abawl a, dal in aluan hi.
english: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid their doors with bronze.

paite: Loh pen inn taklam pang ah suahlam ah simdoh in atung hi.
english: He set the sea on the right side of the house eastward, toward the south.

paite: Huram in belte, vutluahnate, kuangzawnte abawl hi. Huchi in Pathian inn a ding a kumpipa Solomon abawlsak Huram in azouta hi.
english: Huram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Huram finished doing the work that he did for King Solomon in God’s house:

paite: Khuam nihte, noubemte khuam dawn a zing nihte, khuam dawn a noubem nihte tuamna gial chitek nihte;
english: the two pillars, the bowls, the two capitals which were on the top of the pillars, the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars,

paite: huai tuamna gial chitek nih ding a theibuhfai zalite khuam dawn a noubial nih tuamna ding gial chitek tuaktuak ding a theibuhfai vual nihte.
english: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks—two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars.

paite: Kingaknate, kingakna tung a kuangzawnte leng abawl a;
english: He also made the bases, and he made the basins on the bases—

paite: Loh khat leh anuai a bawngtal sawm-le-nihte toh.
english: one sea, and the twelve oxen under it.

paite: Belte, vutluahnate, sa thuknate leh atui-um belsuan tengteng leng Huram in TOUPA' inn a dia dal nawttet akumpipa Solomon abawlsak ahi.
english: Huram-abi also made the pots, the shovels, the forks, and all its vessels for King Solomon, for Yahweh’s house, of bright bronze.

paite: Huaite Jordan Phaizang ah Sukoth leh Zered bellei mun ah kumpipa'n asung hi.
english: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.

paite: Huchibang in Solomon in tui-um belsuan tampi abawl a; dal gikzah buk seng vual ahi kei hi.
english: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance, so that the weight of the bronze could not be determined.

paite: Solomon in Pathian inn a tui-um belsuan om tengteng abawl a, dangka-eng maitamte, tanghou koihna dohkante.
english: Solomon made all the vessels that were in God’s house: the golden altar, the tables with the show bread on them,

paite: Seh bang a mun siangthou mai adet ding khawnvak koihnate, akhawnvak nangawn toh, dangka-eng ngen in abawl hi.
english: and the lamp stands with their lamps to burn according to the ordinance before the inner sanctuary, of pure gold;

paite: Dangka-eng pakte, khawnvakte leh taitehte, dangka-eng siang ngen in abawl hi.
english: and the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs of gold that was purest gold;

paite: Khawnvak puantehnate, maiphiat kuangte, keute, mei laknate dangka-eng siang ngen mah in; huan, insung lutna, insung gilzaw Mun Siangthoupen kongkhakte leh a-inn, tempul kongkhakte dangka-eng in abawl hi.
english: and the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans of pure gold. As for the entry of the house, its inner doors for the most holy place and the doors of the main hall of the temple were of gold.

paite: Huchi in Solomon in TOUPA' inn ding alamzou vekta a; Solomon in apa David in thil ana latsa tengteng alalut a, dangkasik, dangka-eng, vanzat tengteng Pathian inn a goukoihna ah akoihta hi.
english: Thus all the work that Solomon did for Yahweh’s house was finished. Solomon brought in the things that David his father had dedicated, even the silver, the gold, and all the vessels, and put them in the treasuries of God’s house.

paite: Huchi in Solomon in Israel upate, anam intekte, Israel suante inkuan makaite tengteng, David khopi Zion a kipan TOUPA thukhun bawm zawngtou ding in Jerusalem ah akaikhawm hi.
english: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel, to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of Yahweh’s covenant out of David’s city, which is Zion.

paite: Huchi in Israel mi tengteng akha sagihna a ankuangluina ah kumpipa kiang ah ahohkhawm uhi.
english: So all the men of Israel assembled themselves to the king at the feast, which was in the seventh month.

paite: Israel upate tengteng ahong ua, Levite'n bawm azawng uhi.
english: All the elders of Israel came. The Levites took up the ark.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA bawm leh kihoupihna biakbuk leh puanin a tui-um belsuan siangthou tengteng azawngtou ua; siampu Levite'n azawngtou uhi.
english: They brought up the ark, the Tent of Meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent. The Levitical priests brought these up.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon leh Israelte omkhawm tengteng akiang a hong kikhawmte bawm ma ah a-omkhawm ua, belam leh bawngtal gen seng vual louh leh sim seng vual louh in akithoih uhi.
english: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel who were assembled to him were before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.

paite: Huchi in siampute'n ToUPA thukhun bawm a-omna ding ah alalut ua, insung a biakna mun, Mun Siangthoupen ah, cherubte kha nuai ah.
english: The priests brought in the ark of Yahweh’s covenant to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubim.

paite: Cherubte'n bawm omna tung zawn ah akha uh azak gige ua, cherubte'n bawm leh azawnna chiangtawnte akhuh vek uhi.
english: For the cherubim spread out their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.

paite: Azawnna chiangtawnte asau mahmah a, azawnna chiangtawnte kongte biakna mun mai, Mun Siangthou a kipan in amuh theih a; himahleh polam ah zaw adawk kei: tutan huai ah a-om nilouh hi.
english: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the ark in front of the inner sanctuary, but they were not seen outside; and it is there to this day.

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan apawt ua, TOUPA'N Israel suante kiang a thu akhun lai Mosi in Horeb tang a suangpek nih akoih kia lou ngal huai bawm sung ah bangmah dang a-om kei hi.
english: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when Yahweh made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, siampute Mun Siangthou a kipan a ahong pawttak un, siampu omte tengteng akisiangsak ua, apawl in akibawl tuan kei ua;
english: When the priests had come out of the holy place (for all the priests who were present had sanctified themselves, and didn’t keep their divisions;

paite: Levi lasami tengteng leng avek un, Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, atapate uh leh a-unaute uh toh, puanmalngat silh a kivan in dakkhutbette, pekgingte, kaihgingte toh, maitam suahlam sang ah adingh ua, alak uah siampu za-le-sawmnih pengkul mut in a-om lai uhi.
english: also the Levites who were the singers, all of them, even Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and their brothers, arrayed in fine linen, with cymbals and stringed instruments and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them one hundred twenty priests sounding with trumpets);

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, pengkul mutte leh lasa mite'n TOUPA phatna leh kipahthu genna dia atumging uh ging khat bang mai in akiza a; pengkul leh dakkhutbet leh thil tumging toh a-aw uh asuah ua: "Amah lah ahoih ngal a; azahngaihna tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a," chi a, TOUPA aphat uleh, meipi in TOUPA' inn akhuhdim meuhmouh hi.
english: when the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking Yahweh; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of music, and praised Yahweh, saying, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever!” then the house was filled with a cloud, even Yahweh’s house,

paite: Huchi in meipi ziak in siampute'n nna asem theita kei ua; TOUPA thupina in Pathian inn adim vek hi.
english: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for Yahweh’s glory filled God’s house.

paite: Huchi in Solomon in thu agen a, "TOUPA'N, mial bikbek ah ka om ding, achi a,
english: Then Solomon said, “Yahweh has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

paite: himahleh na tenna ding, tangtawn a na omna ding inn ka hon lamsakta hi," chi in.
english: But I have built you a house and home, a place for you to dwell in forever.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa akihei a, Israel kikhawm tengteng avualzawl a; Israel kikhawmte adingkhawm uhi.
english: The king turned his face, and blessed all the assembly of Israel; and all the assembly of Israel stood.

paite: Ama'n, "TOUPA Israel' Pathian, ka pa David kiang a amah kam mahmah a,
english: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David my father, and has with his hands fulfilled it, saying,

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan ka mi Israelte ka pikhiak ni a kipan Israelte nam lak a koi khua mah ka min omna ding inn lamna ding ka tel ngei kei a; ka mi Israelte tung a heutu ding mi kuamah ka tel ngei kei hi.
english: ‘Since the day that I brought my people out of the land of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house in, that my name might be there, and I chose no man to be prince over my people Israel;

paite: Himahleh, ka min omna ding in Jerusalem ka telta a, ka mi Israelte heutu ding in David ka tel hi, chi a genpa, amah khut mahmah a hon pichingsakpa phat in om hen.
english: but now I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and I have chosen David to be over my people Israel.’

paite: "Ka pa David in Israel' Pathian, TOUPA min ding a inn lam angaihtuah hi.
english: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N ka pa, David kiang ah, ka min ding a inn lam na ngaihtuah a, hichibang lungsim na na put na hihhoih hi; himahleh nang zaw inn na lam kei ding;
english: But Yahweh said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart;

paite: na tapa, na khal a hong pawt ding in ka min ding in inn ahon lam zaw ding, ana chita hi.
english: nevertheless you shall not build the house, but your son who will come out of your body, he shall build the house for my name.’

paite: "Huchi in TOUPA'N athugen atangtungsakta a: TOUPA chiamsa bang ngei in ka pa David mun ka hon luah a, Israel laltutphah ah ka hong tu a, Israel' Pathian TOUPA min ding inn ka hon lamta ahi.
english: “Yahweh has performed his word that he spoke; for I have risen up in the place of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as Yahweh promised, and have built the house for the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: Huai ah Israel suante kiang a na khun, TOUPA thukhun bawm ka koihta ahi," achi hi.
english: There I have set the ark, in which is Yahweh’s covenant, which he made with the children of Israel.”

paite: Huan TOUPA maitam bul ah Israel kikhawm tengteng muh in adingh a, aban azak a,
english: He stood before Yahweh’s altar in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands

paite: Solomon in dal dohkan asau lam tong nga, azatlam tong nga, asanlam tong thum a bawl huang laitak a tun tung ah atuang a, Israel kikhawm tengteng ma ah akhukdin a, van lam nga in aban azak a:
english: (for Solomon had made a bronze platform, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high, and had set it in the middle of the court; and he stood on it, and knelt down on his knees before all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven).

paite: "Aw TOUPA, Israel' Pathian, lei leh van ah nangmah bang mahmah Pathian a-om kei uh, alungtang tengteng ua na lampi tawnmi asikhate tung a thukhun tangtungsak a hehpihna kem,
english: Then he said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on earth—you who keep covenant and loving kindness with your servants who walk before you with all their heart;

paite: na sikha, ka pa David kiang a, na thuchiam na tangtungsak a; ahi, tuni in na kam a na gensa na khut in na lohchingsakta a:
english: who have kept with your servant David my father that which you promised him. Yes, you spoke with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is today.

paite: Huchi in aw TOUPA, Israel' Pathian, na sikha, ka pa David kiang a, na suante na om bang a om sam ding a-omdan ua apilvan peuhmah uleh, ka mitmuh a Israelte laltutphah a tu ding na tasam kei ding, chi a na chiamsa tangtungsak in.
english: “Now therefore, Yahweh, the God of Israel, keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him, saying, ‘There shall not fail you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your children take heed to their way, to walk in my law as you have walked before me.’

paite: Huchi in TOUPA, Israel' Pathian, na sikha, David kiang a na thugen lohchingsak mahmah in.
english: Now therefore, Yahweh, the God of Israel, let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David.

paite: "Himahleh, Pathian lei ah mihing lak ah a-om petmah dia hia? Ngai in, van, vante van ah leng na ta kei a, hiai ka inn lam ah ta kei sem na tel ni chia!
english: “But will God indeed dwell with men on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less this house which I have built!

paite: Himahleh, aw TOUPA ka Pathian na sikha in nang ahon sapna leh athumna ngaihkhiaksak in, na sikha thumna leh ngetna hon limsak in.
english: Yet have respect for the prayer of your servant and to his supplication, Yahweh my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer which your servant prays before you;

paite: Hiai mun lam nga a na sikha thumna ngaikhia a, huai ah ka min a-om ding, na chihna mun mahmah, inn lam ah sun leh zan a na mitsuan gige theihna ding in.
english: that your eyes may be open toward this house day and night, even toward the place where you have said that you would put your name, to listen to the prayer which your servant will pray toward this place.

paite: Na sikha leh na mi Israelte'n hiai mun lam nga a athum chiang un angetnate uh na ngaihkhiaksak zel in, ahi, na tenna mun van ah na ngaikhia inla, na zak chiang in ngaidam in.
english: Listen to the petitions of your servant and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. Yes, hear from your dwelling place, even from heaven; and when you hear, forgive.

paite: "Mi kuapeuh in a-invengte tung ah thil hihkhial in, kichiamsak hong kiphamoh taleh, hiai inn a na maitam ma ah hong kichiam henla;
english: “If a man sins against his neighbor, and an oath is laid on him to cause him to swear, and he comes and swears before your altar in this house,

paite: nang van ah na ngaikhia inla, gamtang inla, migilou agitlouh man a moh tangsak in, midiktat adiktak man a dik tangsak in, na sikhate vai hawmsak in.
english: then hear from heaven, act, and judge your servants, bringing retribution to the wicked, to bring his way on his own head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

paite: "Na mi Israelte'n na tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak ua melmate lak a avuallelh ua, nang lam ahong ngat nawn ua, na min agup ua, hiai inn a thum a thil na kiang a ahon nget uleh;
english: “If your people Israel are struck down before the enemy because they have sinned against you, and they turn again and confess your name, and pray and make supplication before you in this house,

paite: nang van a pan na ngaihkhiaksak inla, na mi Israelte khelhna ngaidam inla, amau leh api-le-pute uh na piak gam ah pi nawn in.
english: then hear from heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them again to the land which you gave to them and to their fathers.

paite: "Na tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak ua van ahong bin a, vuah ahong zuk louh a, hiai mun lam nga a athum ua, na min agup uleh, amaute na hihgim ziak a akhelhna uh akisik uleh;
english: “When the sky is shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against you, if they pray toward this place and confess your name, and turn from their sin when you afflict them,

paite: nang van ah na ngaikhia inla, apaina ding uh lampi hoih kawkmuh in na sikhate leh na mi Israelte khelhna ngaidam in na mite agoutan ding ua na piakna gam ah vuah zusak in.
english: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk, and send rain on your land, which you have given to your people for an inheritance.

paite: Ka gam ua kial ahong kiak a, hipi ahong len a, keuna hiam, muatna hiam, khaukhup hiam, lung hiam ahong om a, amelmate un akhuate uh ahong um ua, hipi bangpeuh, natna bangpeuh ahong tunleh hii avei uhiam, alungkhamna uh theipih in.
english: “If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence, if there is blight or mildew, locust or caterpillar; if their enemies besiege them in the land of their cities; whatever plague or whatever sickness there is—

paite: Hiai inn lam nga a ban zak a mimal hiam, Israel mipihon in hiam thumna leh ngetna ahon tut uh:
english: whatever prayer and supplication is made by any man, or by all your people Israel, who will each know his own plague and his own sorrow, and shall spread out his hands toward this house,

paite: Na omna van a pan na ngaikhia inla, ngaidam inla, michih a-omdan bang chiat un lohchingsak in, alungtang uh lah na thei ngal a; nangmah kia mihing tate lungtang theipa na hi.
english: then hear from heaven your dwelling place and forgive, and give to every man according to all his ways, whose heart you know (for you, even you only, know the hearts of the children of men),

paite: Ka pi-le-pute uh na piak gam a a-om sung teng ua na lampi tawn thei ding a nang laudan ahong siamna ding un.
english: that they may fear you, to walk in your ways as long as they live in the land which you gave to our fathers.

paite: "Na mi Israelte hilou, namdangmi, na min thupitak leh na khut hattak leh na ban zak ziak a gam gamlatak a kipan a hong pai, hiai inn lam nga a ahong thum chiang un:
english: “Moreover, concerning the foreigner, who is not of your people Israel, when he comes from a far country for your great name’s sake and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm, when they come and pray toward this house,

paite: Nang na omna van ah na ngaikhia inla, nang hon sapdan uh dungzui in namdangte tung ah leng hih in, huchi in na mi Israelte bangmah in leitung a mi tengteng in na min athei ding ua, nang laudan ahong siam ding ua, hiai ka inn lam in na min apu chih athei ding uhi.
english: then hear from heaven, even from your dwelling place, and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for; that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by your name.

paite: "Na mite'n amelmate uh na sawlna lamlam a asual ua na khopi tel leh na min omna dia na lam inn lam nga a na kiang a athum uleh:
english: “If your people go out to battle against their enemies, by whatever way you send them, and they pray to you toward this city which you have chosen, and the house which I have built for your name;

paite: Nang athumna uh leh angetna uh van a pan na ngaikhia inla, athu uah pi zel in.
english: then hear from heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

paite: "Na tung a ahong khelh ua, kuamah lah khial lou a-om ngal kei a, atung ua na heh a, melma khut a na piak a, gam gamlapi ah hiam, naideuh ah hiam sal a api un leng,
english: “If they sin against you (for there is no man who doesn’t sin), and you are angry with them and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive to a land far off or near;

paite: sal a apina gam ua akingaihtuahkhiak ua, akisik ua, 'I na khialta, dikloutak leh gitlouhhuaitak in thil i na hihta,' chi a atanna gam ua ngetna ahon tut ua;
english: yet if they come to their senses in the land where they are carried captive, and turn again, and make supplication to you in the land of their captivity, saying, ‘We have sinned, we have done perversely, and have dealt wickedly;’

paite: sal a amau apina ua, atanna gam ua alungtangtak uleh alungsim taktak ua nang lam ahong ngat ua, api-le-pute uh gam lam leh na khopi tel leh na min dia ka lam inn lam nga a na kiang a athum uleh;
english: if they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, where they have been taken captive, and pray toward their land which you gave to their fathers, and the city which you have chosen, and toward the house which I have built for your name;

paite: athumna uh leh angetna uh nang na omna van ah na ngaikhia inla, athu uah pi zel inla, na tung a na khialta na mite ngaidam in.
english: then hear from heaven, even from your dwelling place, their prayer and their petitions, and maintain their cause, and forgive your people who have sinned against you.

paite: "Aw ka Pathian, hehpih in na mit hong hak inla, hiai mun athumna ah na bildoh in.
english: “Now, my God, let, I beg you, your eyes be open, and let your ears be attentive to the prayer that is made in this place.

paite: Aw TOUPA Pathian, na omna mun ah paitou in nang leh na hatna bawm toh, Aw TOUPA Pathian, na siampute na hotdamna in van inla, na misiangthoute hoihna in nuamsasak in.
english: “Now therefore arise, Yahweh God, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength. Let your priests, Yahweh God, be clothed with salvation, and let your saints rejoice in goodness.

paite: Aw TOUPA Pathian, na thaunilhpa mel lehngatsan ke'nla, na sikha David thil hoih hihte theigige in," achi hi.
english: “Yahweh God, don’t turn away the face of your anointed. Remember your loving kindnesses to David your servant.”

paite: Huchi in Solomon athum khit in van a kipan mei ahong kesuk a, halmang thillat leh kithoihnate ahong kangmangta a, huan TOUPA thupina'n inn adimta hi.
english: Now when Solomon had finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and Yahweh’s glory filled the house.

paite: TOUPA thupina in TOUPA' inn adimsak ziak in TOUPA' inn ah siampute alut thei kei uhi.
english: The priests could not enter into Yahweh’s house, because Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house.

paite: Israel suante in van a kipan a mei hong lengsuk leh inn tung a TOUPA thupina a-en nilouh ua, suanglep tung ah mai a lei si in abokkhup ua, TOUPA phat in abia uhi. "Amah lah ahoih ngal a, azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding hi," chi in chibai abuk ua, kipahthu agen uhi.
english: All the children of Israel looked on, when the fire came down, and Yahweh’s glory was on the house. They bowed themselves with their faces to the ground on the pavement, worshiped, and gave thanks to Yahweh, saying, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever!”

paite: Kumpipa leh mipite'n TOUPA ma ah kithoihnate alan uhi.
english: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before Yahweh.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon in kithoihna bawngtal singnih-le-sangnih leh belam nuaikhat-le-singnih alan uhi. Huchibang in kumpipa leh mipite'n Pathian inn alan uhi.
english: King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand head of cattle and a hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated God’s house.

paite: Huan siampute amun chiat uah adingh ua; Levite leng TOUPA kiang a kipahthu genna ding a phuah, azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding hi, chi a TOUPA phatna dia David in azat sek, thil ging thei toh TOUPA lasa in adingh ua; huchi in siampute'n pengkul amut ua, Israel mi tengteng adingh diamduam uhi.
english: The priests stood, according to their positions; the Levites also with instruments of music of Yahweh, which David the king had made to give thanks to Yahweh, when David praised by their ministry, saying “For his loving kindness endures forever.” The priests sounded trumpets before them; and all Israel stood.

paite: Solomon in TOUPA' inn mazawn a um sung kongtual ahihsiangthou behlap a; huai ah halmang thillatte, lemna thillat thaute alan a; Solomon dal maitam bawl halmang thillat, tangbuang thillat, thaute latna ding a aneu luat ziak in.
english: Moreover Solomon made the middle of the court that was before Yahweh’s house holy; for there he offered the burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat.

paite: Huchi in huai tung in Solomon leh Israel mi tengteng mipi kikaikhawm thupitak Hamath kholutna a kipan a Aigupta gam lui pha a mite toh ni sagih ankuang alui uhi.
english: So Solomon held the feast at that time for seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt.

paite: Ani giat ni in kikhopna tak anei ua; maitam kipahpihna ding in ni sagih azang ua, ankuanglui ni a ding in ni sagih azang uhi.
english: On the eighth day, they held a solemn assembly; for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.

paite: Huchi in akha sagihna ani sawmnih-le-thum ni in mipite akikhensak a, TOUPA'N David leh Solomon leh ami Israelte tung a ahoihna alatsak ziak in nuamsatak leh kipaktak in mite a-inn lam chiat uah apaita uhi.
english: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month, he sent the people away to their tents, joyful and glad of heart for the goodness that Yahweh had shown to David, to Solomon, and to Israel his people.

paite: Huchibang in, Solomon in TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn apichinta a; Solomon in alungsim a atup bang in TOUPA' inn leh ama inn lamzangtak in apichinta hi.
english: Thus Solomon finished Yahweh’s house and the king’s house; and he successfully completed all that came into Solomon’s heart to make in Yahweh’s house and in his own house.

paite: Huan zan in Solomon kiang ah TOUPA ahong kilak a, akiang ah, "Na thumna ka za a, hiai mun kei a ding in kithoihna inn ding in ka sep khin hi.
english: Then Yahweh appeared to Solomon by night, and said to him, “I have heard your prayer, and have chosen this place for myself for a house of sacrifice.

paite: Vante ka khak a, vuahte azuk louh in hiam, khaukhup ka sawl a, gamte ahihsiat hiam, ka mite lak a hipi ka lensak hiam a;
english: “If I shut up the sky so that there is no rain, or if I command the locust to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people,

paite: ka min pu ka mite kingaineu a athum ua, ahon zon ua, a-omdan giloute uh alehngatsan uleh van a kipan in ka na ngaikhe ding a, akhelhna uh ka ngaidam ding a, agam uh ka damsak ding hi.
english: if my people who are called by my name will humble themselves, pray, seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

paite: Hiai mun a thumna ka mit ka suan ding a, ka bil ka doh ding hi.
english: Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to prayer that is made in this place.

paite: Huai a ka min tangtawn a a-omtheihna ding in hiai inn ka sep a, ka hihsingthouta hi: huai ah ka mit leh ka lungtang a-om tawntungta ding hi.
english: For now I have chosen and made this house holy, that my name may be there forever; and my eyes and my heart will be there perpetually.

paite: Huan nang tungtang thu ah leng, na pa David bang a ka mitmuh a na om a, thu ka hon piak bang a na om a, ka dan thusehte leh ka vaihawmte na zuihleh:
english: “As for you, if you will walk before me as David your father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my ordinances,

paite: Israelte lak ah 'vaihawmmi na tasam kei ding,' chi a na pa David kiang a ka thukhun bang in 'na gam laltutphah ka kipsak ding hi.'
english: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom, according as I covenanted with David your father, saying, ‘There shall not fail you a man to be ruler in Israel.’

paite: Himahleh na kiheimang ua, ka dan thusehte leh ka thupiakte na lehngatsan ua, Pathian dangte nna na sep ua, na biak uleh:
english: But if you turn away and forsake my statutes and my commandments which I have set before you, and go and serve other gods and worship them,

paite: Amau ka piak gam a kipan ka hon hihmang ding a; hiai inn, ka min ding a ka hihsiangthousa, ka mitmuh phak louh ah ka suanmang ding a, nam chih lak a paunak leh aselam a gentehna ding in ka bawl ding hi.
english: then I will pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have made holy for my name, I will cast out of my sight, and I will make it a proverb and a byword among all peoples.

paite: 'Hiai inn sangpi akiang a pai peuh in lamdang asa ding ua, bangchi a hiai gam leh hiai inn TOUPA'N hichi a hih ahia? achi ding uh.'
english: This house, which is so high, everyone who passes by it will be astonished and say, ‘Why has Yahweh done this to this land and to this house?’

paite: TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian, 'Aigupta gam a kipan pikhepa alehngatsan ua, Pathian dangte zui a, abiak ua, a-nnate asep ziak un hiai siatna tengteng atung uah atung ahi, ahon chi ding uh achi hi.'
english: They shall answer, ‘Because they abandoned Yahweh, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and took other gods, worshiped them, and served them. Therefore he has brought all this evil on them.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Solomon in TOUPA' inn leh ama inn alam sung kum sawmnih abei in,
english: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built Yahweh’s house and his own house,

paite: Huram in Solomon khopi apiakte Solomon in inn abawl a, Israel suante a-omsak hi.
english: Solomon built the cities which Huram had given to Solomon, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.

paite: Solomon in Hamath-zobah asual a, azou hi,
english: Solomon went to Hamath Zobah, and prevailed against it.

paite: Gamdai ah, Tadmor abawl a, Hamath a vankoihna khuate toh.
english: He built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the storage cities, which he built in Hamath.

paite: Beth-horon saknungzaw leh khangnungzaw leng, kulhte, kongkhakte, akalhnate nei in abawlbeh hi.
english: Also he built Beth Horon the upper and Beth Horon the lower, fortified cities with walls, gates, and bars;

paite: Baalath khuate, avankoihna khua tengteng, akangtalai koihna khuate, asakol tungtuang mite omna khuate, Jerusalem leh Lebanon leh agamsung pumpi ah Solomon in adeih bangbang in abawl hi.
english: and Baalath, and all the storage cities that Solomon had, and all the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build for his pleasure in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

paite: Israel suante hilou, Hitte, Amorte, Perizte, Hivte, Jebuste suan a om lai mite tengteng;
english: As for all the people who were left of the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of Israel—

paite: Israel suante'n ahihmanlouhte uh, huai gam a amaute nung a nutsiat a om asuante uh, tutan a, Solomon in sikha nasem ding a goih teitei pawl ding in abawl hi.
english: of their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel didn’t consume—of them Solomon conscripted forced labor to this day.

paite: Israel suante Solomon in anasemmi sikha ding in abawl kei a, kidou mite, asepaih heutute makaite, akangtalai leh asakol tungtuangmi heutu ahi zaw uhi.
english: But of the children of Israel, Solomon made no servants for his work, but they were men of war, chief of his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.

paite: Huaite mipite heutu, Solomon makai lianpente ahi ua, zanih-le-sawmnga ahi uhi.
english: These were the chief officers of King Solomon, even two-hundred fifty, who ruled over the people.

paite: Solomon in David khopi a kipan atuam a inn alamsak ah Pharaoh tanu apitou a, "Ka zi Israel kumpipa David inn a om ding ahi kei, TOUPA bawm hong tunna mun siang ahi," achi hi.
english: Solomon brought up Pharaoh’s daughter out of David’s city to the house that he had built for her; for he said, “My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places where Yahweh’s ark has come are holy.”

paite: Huchi in Solomon in inlim mai a TOUPA a ding a TOUPA maitam abawl tung ah halmang thillatte alan hi.
english: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings to Yahweh on Yahweh’s altar which he had built before the porch,

paite: Mosi thupiak, niteng a dia bikhiah bangbang in Sabbath ni ah, kha thak ni, ankuanglui hun nei, kum khat a thumvei, Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluinate, Nipikal Ankuangluinate, Biakbuk Ankuangluinate,
english: even as the duty of every day required, offering according to the commandment of Moses on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, three times per year, during the feast of unleavened bread, during the feast of weeks, and during the feast of booths.

paite: Huan apa David na seh bang in siampu pawlte leh Levite atantuam chiat ua, niteng a sep kul dungzui zel a, phat dingte, siampute ma a nasem ding in asep a; kongkhak teng ah apawlpawl a veng mite asep lai a; huchibang in Pathian mipa David in ana sep hi.
english: He appointed, according to the ordinance of David his father, the divisions of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their offices, to praise and to minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required, the doorkeepers also by their divisions at every gate, for David the man of God had so commanded.

paite: Kumpipa'n siampute, Levite thu apiak bangchi mah in sumthute leng apialsan het kei uhi.
english: They didn’t depart from the commandment of the king to the priests and Levites concerning any matter or concerning the treasures.

paite: TOUPA' inn abawlkhiak tung ua kipan a azoh tan un, Solomon in asuktuahsa bang geih ahi. Huchi in TOUPA' inn pichin ahita hi.
english: Now all the work of Solomon was accomplished from the day of the foundation of Yahweh’s house until it was finished. So Yahweh’s house was completed.

paite: Huchi in Solomon bel Edom gam a luipi gei a Ezion-geber ah leh Eloth ah ahoh a,
english: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and to Eloth, on the seashore in the land of Edom.

paite: Huram in asikha tuipi a gamtangmi, longte toh akuansak a, Solomon sikhate toh Ophir ah ahoh ua, huai ah dangka-eng talent zali-le-sawmnga ahon pua ua, kumpipa Solomon kiang ah hon tun uhi.
english: Huram sent him ships and servants who had knowledge of the sea by the hands of his servants; and they came with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and brought from there four hundred fifty talents of gold, and brought them to King Solomon.

paite: Solomon minthandan Sheba kumpin’n azak in solomon thuhaksa pipi a ettel tum in nungzui mi tampi toh sangawngsaute a gimlim leh dangka-eng tampi leh suangmantamte pua in Jerusalem ah ahohtou a: Solomon kiang atuntouh in, alungsim a om tengteng suahsiang vek in ahoupih hi.
english: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to test Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great caravan, including camels that bore spices, gold in abundance, and precious stones. When she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.

paite: Huan Solomon in athudot tengteng adawng vek a: Solomon in adawn theih louh himhim a-om kei hi.
english: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from Solomon which he didn’t tell her.

paite: Huchi in Sheba kumpinu'n Solomon pilna leh a-inn lam amuh in,
english: When the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,

paite: adohkan a nek dingte, asikhate tutdante, anasemte nasepdante, akivatdante uh, anou pe mite leh akivatdante uh, TOUPA' inn a hohtouhnate, alungmang hial hi.
english: the food of his table, the seating of his servants, the attendance of his ministers, their clothing, his cup bearers and their clothing, and his ascent by which he went up to Yahweh’s house, there was no more spirit in her.

paite: Kumpipa kiang ah, "Na thilhihte leh na pildan thuthang ka gam a ka zak adik mahmah ahi.
english: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.

paite: Himahleh keimah mit mahmah a ka hong muh masiah agen kia uh ka um thei kei a, ngai in, na pilna thupidan akimkhat leng ahon na hilh kei uh: na minthanna ka zakte nakpi in na khup hi.
english: However I didn’t believe their words until I came, and my eyes had seen it; and behold half of the greatness of your wisdom wasn’t told me. You exceed the fame that I heard!

paite: Na mite nak hamphat na uh e, hiai na sikha na kiang a om gige a na pilna thu ngaikhe gigete hampha hi na tel uh e!
english: Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian, na tung a kipak, akumpipa ding a alaltutphah a hon tusakpa TOUPA na Pathian phat in om hen: na Pathian in Israelte tangtawn a hihkip ding in a-it a, huaiziak in diktattak a vaihawm ding in akumpipa ding ua nang hon bawl ahi ve," achi hi.
english: Blessed be Yahweh your God, who delighted in you and set you on his throne to be king for Yahweh your God, because your God loved Israel, to establish them forever. Therefore he made you king over them, to do justice and righteousness.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa kiang ah dangka-eng talent za-le-sawmnih leh gimlim tampi mahmah leh suangmantamte apia a, Sheba kumpinu'n kumpipa Solomon gimlim apiak bang himhim a-om ngei kei hi.
english: She gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great abundance, and precious stones. There was never before such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

paite: Huan Solomon sikhate leh Huram sikhate Ophir a kipan a dangka-eng va pote'n algum sing leh suangmantam ahon pua uhi.
english: The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum trees and precious stones.

paite: Kumpipa'n algum sing TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn umna ding leh lasa mite a ding a kaihging leh pekging ding in abawl a: huchibang Judah gam ah tuma lam in amu ngei kei uhi.
english: The king used algum tree wood to make terraces for Yahweh’s house and for the king’s house, and harps and stringed instruments for the singers. There were none like these seen before in the land of Judah.

paite: Sheba kumpinu'n athil apiak sim louh in kumpipa Solomon in adeihdeih ape sam a, huchi in agam lam ah aheute toh apai nawnta uhi.
english: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, more than that which she had brought to the king. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.

paite: Huchi in Solomon kiang a kum khat sung a dangka-eng hong lut gikdan dangka-eng talent zaguk sawmguk-le-guk buk ahi.
english: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

paite: Mi ompolhte leh sumsin mite hon tawi sim het louh in: huan, Arabia kumpipa tengteng leh gam ukpate'n Solomon kiang ah dangka-engte, dangkasikte ahon tawi sek uhi.
english: in addition to that which the traders and merchants brought. All the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon in dangka-eng sekthoh in lum lian chi zanih abawl a, lum lian khat ah dangka-eng shekel zaguk abei hi.
english: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of beaten gold. Six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one large shield.

paite: Dangka-eng sukpek in lum zathum abawl a; lum khat zel ah dangka-eng shekel zathum abei a; huaite Lebanon gammang inn ah akoih hi.
english: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold. Three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. The king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

paite: Huan kumpipa'n Saihapak laltutphah thupitak abawl behlap a, dangka siang ngen in aluan hi.
english: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.

paite: Laltutphah a akaltouhna siksan gukte, laltutphah toh azop, dangka-eng khe ngaknate, aban ngakna bul a ding humpinelkai lim nihte a-om hi.
english: There were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and armrests on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests.

paite: Siksan guk lang tuak tung ah humpinelkai sawm-le-nih adingh uhi. Huchibang koi lai gam ah leng abawl ngei kei uh.
english: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps. There was nothing like it made in any other kingdom.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon nou tengteng dangka-eng vek ahi a, Lebanon gammang inn a tui-um belsuan tengteng leng dangka-eng siang vek ahi; Solomon dam lai in dangkasik bangmah in asim kei uhi.
english: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. Silver was not considered valuable in the days of Solomon.

paite: Kumpipa'n longhon, Huram sikhate, Tarshish a hohsek kikoppih anei a, kum thum hal zel in, Tarshish longhon in dangka-eng, dangkasik, saiha, zawng leh utongte, ahon po sek hi.
english: For the king had ships that went to Tarshish with Huram’s servants. Once every three years, the ships of Tarshish came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Solomon in leitung kumpipa tengteng hauhsakna leh pilna lam ah akhup vek hi.
english: So King Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

paite: Huchi in Pathian in alungtang a akoih, apilna thu ngaikhe ding in, kumpipa tengteng in Solomon ahon zuan huthut uhi.
english: All the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

paite: Kum teng a piak bikhiah nei in dangkasik tui-um belsuan dangka-eng tui-um belsuan puante, galvante, gimlimte, sakolte, sabiltungte ape zel uhi.
