english: They each brought tribute: vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules every year.

paite: Huan Solomon in sakol leh kangtalai koihna mun sangli anei a, huan sakol tungtuangmi singkhat-le-sangnih anei a, huaite kangtalai koihna khuate ah, Jerusalem kumpipa kiangte ah a-omsak hi.
english: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen that he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in lui a kipan a Philistia gam leh Aigupta gam tan a kumpipa tengteng tung ah vai ahawm hi.
english: He ruled over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

paite: erusalem ah kumpipa'n dangkasikte suang bang mai a tam in a-omsak a, sidar singte phaizang a theipite bang lel a ngaih in a-omsak hi.
english: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedars to be as abundant as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.

paite: Solomon a ding in sakolte Aigupta a kipan leh gam chih a kipan in ahon la zel uhi.
english: They brought horses for Solomon out of Egypt and out of all lands.

paite: Solomon tanchin dangte abul a kipan atawp tanpha in, zawlnei Nathan gelh tanchinbu ah, Shilon mi Ahijah genkholhna bu ah, Nebat tapa Jeroboam tungtang thu a zawlnei Iddo mengmuh gelhna bu ah atuang kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, aren’t they written in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat?

paite: Solomon in Jerusalem ah Israel mi tengteng tung ah kum sawmli vai ahawm hi.
english: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

paite: Solomon bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, apa David khua ah avui ua, asik in atapa Rehoboam in vai ahawm hi.
english: Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in his father David’s city; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.

paite: Paul, Pathian deihlam a Khrist Jesu sawltak leh i unaupa Timothi in, Korinth a Pathian saptuam omte kiang leh Akhaia gam tengteng a misiangthou omte kiang ah:
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:

paite: Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist' Pa leh Pathian, zahngaihnate' Pa leh khamuanna tengteng Pathian phat in om hen.
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,

paite: Pathian in koumau hon khamuanna ngei in gimthuakna peuhmah a omte leng ka khamuan sam theihna ding un, ama'n ka gimthuaknate uah ahon khamuan hi.
english: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

paite: Khrist thuaknate tampitak ka tan bang un, Khrist ziak in khamuanna leng tamsem ka tang uhi.
english: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

paite: Himahleh gimthuak a ka om uleh noumau khamuanna ding leh hotdamna ding ahi a; huan khamuan a ka om uleh ka thuak bang uh na thuak chiang ua na theih ua na khamuanna ding uh ahi.
english: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

paite: Huan gimthuakna tang samte na hih bang un, khamuanna tang samte leng na hi uh chih ka theih un, noute a ka lametna uh akip ahi.
english: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.

paite: Unaute aw, Asia gam a ka tung ua gimthuakna tung na theih louh uh ka deih kei uhi, huchi a nakpitak a thuakzoh vual louh leh hin leng lamethuai lou khop hial in delhden in ka om uhi.
english: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

paite: Ahi, si dia thupukkhum in ka om ua; huai tuh koumau kimuang lou a misite kaithoupa Pathian ka muan zawkna ding uh ahi.
english: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

paite: Ama'n huchibang sih lauhuai lak ah hon hunkheta a, ahon hunkhe lellel a, hon hunkhe nawn lai ding ahi, chi in amah ka muang uhi.
english: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,

paite: Noute'n leng thumna in na hon panpih ding uh ahi, huchi in tampite thumna dawnna vualzawlna piak a ka om chiang un koute ziak in mi tampi in kipahthu agen ding uhi.
english: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.

paite: Koute suanpen hiai ahi, sapilna ah hilou in, Pathian hehpihna ah hi zaw in sianthouna leh Pathian dikna nei in khovel ah mawltak a ka gamta in, nou lam ah ka gamta hoih nawn sem uh chih ka sia-le-pha theihna un hon theisak hi.
english: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

paite: Na sim theih uleh na theihtheih ding uh lou ngal thudang himhim na kiang uah ka gelh kei uhi; atawp pha in ka thu uh na theihsiam uh ka lamen lai uhi.
english: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end—

paite: Theihsiamna tan na neih tak bang un, i Toupa Jesu ni chiang in, noute ka hon suan theih bang un nou leng koute na hon suang thei sam ding uhi.
english: as also you acknowledged us in part—that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.

paite: Huan huai gintakna nei in, na kiang uah hong masa leng ka chi a, kipahna thuah nih na neihtheihna ding un.
english: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,

paite: Noumau tawn kawm in Masidonia gam ah pai zel leng la, Masidonia gam a kipan na kiang uah hong kihei nawn in, Judia gam a ka hohna ding ah noumau hong kha le uchin ka chi ahi.
english: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.

paite: Huchibang ka ngaihtuah lai in ka lungsim kiplouhdan langsak in hia ka hih? Ahihkeileh, "Ahi, chih leh Ahi kei," chi tuaktuak ding in, thilhih ka tup nak pen sadan in hia ka tup?
english: When I therefore planned this, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”

paite: Himahleh Pathian amuanhuai bang in noumau lam a ka thu uh, Ahi, chih leh Ahi kei, chih ahi kei hi.
english: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”

paite: Akoi abang hi hen aw, Pathian Tapa Jesu Khrist thu, kei Silvanas leh Timothi in na lak ua ka gen un, "Ahi leh Ahi kei,” chih ahi sam kei a, amah ah zaw thil tengteng, "Ahi," chih ahi gige hi.
english: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”

paite: Pathian thuchiamte tengteng in amah ah, "Ahi," chih amu vek hi. Huaiziak in ahi Pathian thupina ding a amah ziak a, "Amen," ka chih uh.
english: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.

paite: Huan Khrist a noumau toh hon hihkippa leh koute hon thaunilhpa, Pathian ahi.
english: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,

paite: Amah zaw hon chiamtehpa leh i lungtang a khamna Kha hon pepa leng ahi.
english: who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.

paite: Himahleh ka kha tung a theihpih ding in Pathian ka sam ahi, noumau hon hawi ding in ahi Korinth a ka hong tak louh zawk.
english: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that to spare you, I didn’t come to Corinth.

paite: Na ginna uh hon thuneihkhum hilou in, na kipahna ding ua nou toh semkhawm ka hi zaw uhi; ginna a na dinkip ziak un.
english: We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.

paite: Huan kei Paul, na lak ua na mitmuh ua thunuailuttak a om a, na kiang ua om louh chiang a noumau lam a khauh in Khrist lungnemna leh nunnemna in ka hon ngen ahi.
english: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.

paite: Ahi, na kiang ua ka om chiang in khenkhat sa bang a om a hon septe tung a hangsantak a om ka tup ngamna bang in, ka hon khauhkhum akullouhna ding in ka hon ngen ahi.
english: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.

paite: Sa ah om mah leng sa kidou bang in i dou kei ua,
english: For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;

paite: eite kigalthopnate zaw sa leng ahi kei a, kulhpi kiptak phelna ding a Pathian ziak a thilhihtheitak galvan ahi zaw hi.
english: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,

paite: Lung a gel pansante leh thil sang chiteng Pathian theihna dal ding a sangtak a bawlte i phuk zel; ngaihtuahna chiteng Khrist thumanna sikha a pi in;
english: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,

paite: na thumandan uh hihkim a a-om chiang in, thumanlouhna tengteng phu la ding nangawn a leng mansa in ka om uhi.
english: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.

paite: Noute'n polam muh theih thilte kia en na hi uh maw? Kuapeuh in Khrist a hi a kimuang ahihleh amah kingaihtuah nawn hen, amah Khrist a ahih bang in, koute leng ka hi sem uhi.
english: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that even as he is Christ’s, so we also are Christ’s.

paite: Ka thuneihna uh nou hihsiatna ding ahi kei a, noumau bawlhoih zawkna ding a Toupa'n ahon piak suang mah leng ka zahlak kei ding uhi.
english: For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for casting you down, I will not be ashamed,

paite: Ka laikhakte a nou hon hihlau tum bang a ka latlouhna ding in huai ka chi ahi.
english: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.

paite: "Alaikhakte zaw agik in akhauh a, himahleh ataksa kilatdan mizawngkhalpi ahi a, apau leng ahawmthohhuai,” achi uhi.
english: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”

paite: Ka om louh chiang ua ka laikhakte ua ka thugelh uleh, huai lai a na kiang ua ka om chiang ua ka hih ding uh akibatlouhna a-om kei chih huchibang mite'n theisiam uhen.
english: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.

paite: Khenkhat amau kiphatte lak ah ka kisimkhawm ngam kei ua, amau toh leng ka kitehpih ngam sam kei uhi. Himahleh amau zaw amau leh amau kiteh in amau leh amau kitehpih in lungsim nei lou in a-om uhi.
english: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.

paite: Kou zaw Pathian hon tehna val in ka ki-uangsak kei ding ua, mohpuakna ahon piak bang zel in ka ki-uangsak zaw ding uhi, noumau ngei leng huai mohpuakna in hon huamkhak na hi uhi.
english: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.

paite: Ka thuneih phaklouhna ding tantan uh hong uk hilou in, Khrist tanchinhoih gen in na khua uah ka hong pai zaw uhi.
english: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,

paite: Koute ka hihna pel ua kiphat hiam, midang sepgimnate kisuanpih ka hi kei uh; na ginna uh akhandan bang zel in, na lak ua ka nasepna uh nakpitak a hihlet in omleh chih lametna ka nei zaw uhi,
english: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men’s labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,

paite: huchi in midang nasepsa suang hilou a, nou khen lam gamte tanpha a tanchinhoih ka gentheihna ding un.
english: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.

paite: Himahleh, "Asuang peuh in Toupa suang hen,"
english: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”

paite: Amah kiphat mi in phat aloh ngal kei a, Toupa'n agen hoih mi in phat aloh zaw ahi.
english: For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.

paite: Ka hai deuhna uah noute'n Pathian ah na hon thuak theih uh ka ut hi. Ahi, thuak leng na hon thuak theita uhi!
english: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.

paite: Pathian hazatna, thikthuse khop in ahi nou ka hon hazat; Khrist kiang a nungak siangthou bang a ka hon piaktheihna ding in, pasal khat ka hon hawisak hi.
english: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you in marriage to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.

paite: Himahleh gul in azuau pil a Evi akhem bang in, Khrist lam a takna leh sianthouna a kipan bangchi hiam in na lungsim uh ahihse kha ding, chih ka lauthawng hi.
english: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

paite: Khattei hong pai a Jesu dang, athu ka gen ngei louh uh, agen a, kha lamdang na muh ngei louh uh leh tanchinhoih lamdang na san ngei louh uh, na pom pah un kipe baih lua na himah kei ding ua hia!
english: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit which you didn’t receive, or a different “good news” which you didn’t accept, you put up with that well enough.

paite: Hiai Sawltaklian thuneipen na chihte uh sang in bang lam peuh ah niamzawkna nei in ka kigingta kei hi.
english: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.

paite: Thugen lam ah pau zatsiam kei mah leng theihna ah zaw huchibang ka hi kei uhi; huai noute kiang ah bang lam peuh leh thil tengteng ah ka kilangsak uhi.
english: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.

paite: Ahihkeileh, Pathian tanchinhoih athawn lel a ka hon hilh ziak a tawisan a na omtheihna ding ua ka kihihniam in thil ka hihkhial a hia?
english: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?

paite: Na nna uh ka septheihna ding in midangte a kipan huhna la in, saptuam pawl dangte ka lok ahi.
english: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.

paite: Huan na kiang ua ka om a, ka taksap lai in, kuamah ka hon hihbuai kei a; unau Masidonia gam a kipan a hong paite'n ka taksap awng ahong huksak ngal ua; bangkim ah noumau hihbuai lou in ka kibawl bang in, ka kibawl zel lai ding hi.
english: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.

paite: Khrist thutak kei mah a a-om bang in, hiai ka kisuanna zaw Akhaia gam lam ah hihdaih in a-om kei ding.
english: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

paite: Bangziak in? K'on it louh ziak hia? Pathian in ka hon it lam athei hi.
english: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.

paite: Huan anasep uh kisaktheihpih a, kou sep bangbang a sem kichite kichihna ka bulkalh theihna ding in ka sep tuh ka sem zom zel ding hi.
english: But what I do, that I will continue to do, that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity, that in which they boast, they may be recognized just like us.

paite: Mi huchibangte zaw Khrist sawltak akibawltawm a, sawltak takloute, nasemmi, mikhem hatte ahi uhi.
english: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.

paite: Huai ahihleh alamdang kei; Setan hial leng vak sawltak in akibawltawm nak ahi.
english: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.

paite: Huaiziak in anasemte leng diktatna nasemmi in kibawltawm mah le uh thillamdang ahi kei; huaite tawpna zaw athilhih bang zel un ahi ding hi.
english: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.

paite: Ka chi nawn ahi, kuamah in mihai in hon sep kei uhen; himahleh na hon seh vanglak uleh, ke'n leng neuchik bek a ka kisaktheih sam theihna ding in mihai bangtak in hon pom un.
english: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.

paite: Ka gen zaw Toupa thuneihna in ka gen kei a, ka kisaktheihna mihai bangtak in ka gen zaw ahi.
english: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.

paite: Mi tampite'n khovel thilte akisaktheihpih ziak un kei leng ka hong kisathei sam ding hi.
english: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.

paite: Nou bel mipil na hih ziak un mihaite lungkimtak in na thuakzou zel uhi.
english: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.

paite: Mi sal a hon bawlte, hon negaite, nuamtak hon sa a na tung ua kiliansak leh na mai ua hon bengte na thuak thei zel ngal ua.
english: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, or if he strikes you on the face.

paite: Kisitna dan in ka gen ahi, huchi dia zaw hat lou lua mah kei ve ua!
english: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.

paite: Amaute Hebru mi ahi uhia? Kei leng ka hi. Israel mi ahi uhia? Kei leng ka hi. Abraham suante ahi uhia? Kei leng ka hi.
english: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.

paite: Khrist nasemte ahi uhia? Mihai bang in gen taleng, ka hi sem; sepgimna ah thupi sem in, suangkul tanna ah bang thupi sem in, vuakna ah bang akan-aval in, sih lauhuaina tamveipi ka tuak hi.
english: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.

paite: Judate lak ah vuakna khatvei a sawmli ching lou ngavei ka tuak hi.
english: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.

paite: Thumvei chiang a khet in ka om a, khatvei suang a den in ka om hi, thumvei longsiatna ka tuak a, zan khat leh ni khat tuipi ah taihmang in ka om hi.
english: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.

paite: Khualzinna ah tamveipi, luite lak ah lauhuai, suamhatte lak ah lauhuai, ka chipihte lak ah lauhuai, Zentelte lak ah lauhuai, khopi ah lauhuai, gamdai ah lauhuai, tuipi ah lauhuai, unau takloute lak ah lauhuai;
english: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;

paite: septawlna leh sepgimna, ihmutmohna ah tamveipi, gilkial leh dangtakna ah, an ngawlna ah tamveipi, khosik leh vuaktang a omnate.
english: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.

paite: Huan hiaite ban a kigen lou saptuam pawl tengteng ka ngaihtuahna niteng a hon delh gige leng a-om hi.
english: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.

paite: Kua ahia zawngkhal a om a, ke'n ka zawnkhalpih louh? Kua ahia khelhna a puksia a, ke'n ka lunggimpih louh?
english: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?

paite: Suang ding ka hih vanglakleh ka hatlouhna lam thilte ahi ka suan ding.
english: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.

paite: Tangtawn a phat tak, Toupa Jesu' Pathian leh Pa in zuau ka genlouhdan athei hi.
english: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.

paite: Damaskas ah kumpipa Aretas nuai a gam-ukpa'n hon man ding in Damaskas khopi avengsak a;
english: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.

paite: himahleh kulhbaang tohlet ah bawm in hon khaikhia ua, huchi in akhut a kipan ka suakta hi.
english: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.

paite: Ka ki-uangsak lai ding hi. Ka phattuampih ding a-om kei na a, Toupa kiang a kipan mengmuhna leh kilakna thu ka genzom lai ding hi.
english: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

paite: Khrist a mi khat ka thei; huai mi tuh kum sawm-le-li ahita a, pumpi in hia a-om ka thei kei, pumpi lou in hia a-om ka thei sam kei; Pathian in athei, van thumna hial ah laktouh in a-om hi.
english: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago—whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows.

paite: Huai mi mahmah, pumpi in hia a-om, pumpi lou in hia ka thei kei; Pathian in athei hi;
english: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),

paite: paradis a laktouh a a-omdan, thu genkhiak vual louh, mihing gensiangloute aza chih ka thei hi.
english: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

paite: Mi huchibang ahihleh ka suang ding; himahleh ka hatlouhna lou zaw keimah ka kisuang kei ding hi.
english: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.

paite: Suan ut mah leng mihai ka hi kei ding, thutak tak ka gen dek ngal a; himahleh ka kidek ding, huchi lou in zaw kuapeuh in hon muh bang uleh ka lak a thu azak sang un hon ngai thupizaw kha ding uhi.
english: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me.

paite: Huan kilakna thupi mahmah ziak a ka kingaihlet luatlouhna ding in ka sa ah ling hon pia ahi, Setan sawltak, khut thak nuhna dia hon zang ding ngei; huchi lou in zaw ka kingailian kha ding hi.
english: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

paite: Huai thil tungtang thu ah hon awngsut theihna ding in Toupa thumvei ka ngen hi.
english: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

paite: Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "Ka hehpihna nang a ding in ahun hi, hatlouhna ah ahi ka thilhihtheihna hihkim a a-om,” achi hi. Huchi in Khrist thilhihtheihna ka tung a a-omtheihna ding in kipaktak in ka hatlouhnate ka suang zaw ding hi.
english: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

paite: Huaiziak in Khrist ziak a hatlouhna ah, liamna ah, taksapna ah, sawina ah, lungngaihna ah ka kipak zel hi; ka hat louh peuhpeuh chiang in ahi ka hat zawk zel.
english: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

paite: Hai ka na hita; nou hai lou thei lou in na hon bawl ua ahi; bangmah hi kei mah leng, noumau na hon pahtawi ding uh ka hi, bang lam peuh ah leng sawltaklian thuneipente ka pha lou kei hi.
english: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.

paite: Ka sawltaklian hih chiamtehnate kuhkalna chiteng toh chiamtehnate, thillamdangte, nasep thupite in na lak uah hih ahi taktak hi.
english: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.

paite: Bang lam ah ahia, saptuam pawl dangte sang a niamzaw a bawl a na omna uh? Keimah ngeingei in ka hon hihbuailouhna lam thu ah ahih kei ngalleh. Huai diklouhna ah hon ngaidam un.
english: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

paite: Ngai un, hiai na kiang ua hong hoh ding ka sawm athumveina ahi; noute ka hon hihbuai kei ding, na thilneihte uh hilou in noumau hon deih ka hi zaw hi; tate'n nu leh pate a ding in akholkhawmsak ding uh ahi kei a, nu leh pate'n tate ding in akholkhawmsak zaw ding uh ahi.
english: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

paite: Huan kei zaw na kha ua ding in kipaktak in ka kizangbei ding a, ka kizangbei vek lai ding hi. Akan-aval a nou ka hon it ziak in ke'n noute itna tawmzaw muhna in ka nei ahi maw?
english: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

paite: Himahleh kei mahmah in ka hon hihbuailouhna ah kei lepchiahpil leh khemna a noute hon man na sa ua hiam.
english: Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.

paite: Na kiang ua ka misawl kuahiamte zang in nou ka hon hamphatpih ngei a hia?
english: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?

paite: Noute kiang a hong pai ding in Titas ka ngen a, amah toh unaupa ka hon sawl hi. Titas in nou ahon hamphatpih himhim hia? Kha kibang a gamtakhawm ka hi kei ua hia? Khap kibang a pai ka hi kei ua hia?
english: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?

paite: Noumau kiang a kou leh kou kihu na hon sa ua hia? Khrist ah Pathian mitmuh in ahi thu ka gen uh. Himahleh deihtakte aw, bangkim noumau bawlhoihna ding ahi.
english: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.

paite: Ka hong pai chiang in bangchi hiam a ka lamet bang a ka hon muh keileh kei deih bang in na hon mu kei kha ding uh chih leh bangchi hiam in kitainate, kihazatnate, hehnate, kilangkhennate, kigennate, kihuaukhumnate, kingaihlet luatnate, buainate a om in ka hon mu kha ding chih ka lau hi.
english: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,

paite: Na kiang ua ka hong nawn chiang in ka Pathian in na lak uah hon hih zahlak in thil hihkhialte leh thilsiang lou hihte, kingaite, huk ching a kisik tuan lou, mi tampite ka kahkhum kha ding chih ka lau hi.
english: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.

paite: Hiai pen na kiang ua ka hong athumveina ding ahi. "Theihpih nih hiam, thum hiam kam ah thu chiteng hihkip in a-om ding hi."
english: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”

paite: Ka genkholta a, anihveina a na kiang ua ka om lai a ka gen bang in, tu'n ah na kiang ua om lou in, tuma lam a thil hihkhialte kiang ah leh midang tengteng kiang ah ka genkhol nawn dek hi, ka hong nawnleh ka hawi kei ding, chih;
english: I have warned previously, and I warn again, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again, I will not spare,

paite: Khrist keimah a thu gen zelpa pen chetna na zon ziak un, amah zaw noumau lam ah ahat lou kei a, na lak uah thilhihtheitak ahi zaw hi.
english: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.

paite: Hatlouhna a kilhlup himahleh Pathian thilhihtheihna ziak in ahing hi. Kou leng amah ah ka hat kei uhi, himahleh, noumau lam a Pathian thilhihtheihna ziak in akiang ah ka hing sam ding uhi.
english: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.

paite: Ginna ah na om na uhiam chih noumau ngeingei ki-enchian zel un. Ahihkeileh noumau ah Jesu Khrist a-om chih noumau ngeingei in na theichian kei ua hia? Deih louh na hih kei ngal uleh.
english: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.

paite: Koute deih louh in ka om kei uh chih na thei lai ding un ka gingta hi.
english: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.

paite: Huan thil himhim na hihkhelhlouhna ding un Pathian kiang ah ka ngen zel uhi; koute deihhuai a ka lattheihna ding uh ahi kei a, koute deih louh in om mah le ung noute'n akilawm peuhmah na hihtheihna ding uh ahi zaw hi.
english: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.

paite: Thutak gum ding lou in zaw, thutak dou ding in bangmah ka hihthei kei uhi.
english: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

paite: Koute ka hat louh lai un noute na hat ua, ka kipak uhi; noumau hoih lam a na kibawlphat uh thumna a ka nget uh ahi.
english: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.

paite: Huaiziak in hihse ding hilou a bawlhoih ding zaw a, Toupa'n thuneihna ahon piak bang zel in, na kiang ua ka om chiang a nakpitak a ka hon taihilhlouhna ding in, na kiang ua ka om louh lai in hiai thu ka gelh ahi.
english: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.

paite: Atawp pen in, unaute aw, kipaktak in om un, na omdan uh kitungding unla; ka hon ngetna limsak un, kikhamuantuah in om unla; lungsim mun khat pu unla, kituaktak in om un; huan na kiang uah itna leh khamuanna Pathian a-om ding hi.
english: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.

paite: Tawp siangthou in chibai kibuk un.
english: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

paite: Misiangthou tengteng in chibai ahon buk uhi.
english: All the saints greet you.

paite: Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna, Pathian itna, Kha Siangthou kithuah-pihna na vek ua tung ah om hen, Amen.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.

paite: Himahleh keimah lam thu ah zaw hiai ka na tum tintenta ahi, lungkhamna dia na kiang ua hong nawnta lou ding in.
english: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.

paite: Ke'n ka hon hihlungkhamleh ka hihlungkhampen mah lou in kua'n ahia kei hon hihkipak ding?
english: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?

paite: Huchi in huai mahmah ka gelh ahi, huchi lou in zaw ka hong in ka kipahna dingte lak ah lungkhamna ka mu zaw kha ding a; ka kipahna zaw na vek ua kipahna ahih ka hon gintaksak chiat ngal hi.
english: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.

paite: Khitui tampi ke kawm a lungtang a haksa leh lauthawng pipi a ka gelh ahi; hihlungkham a na omna ding uh ahi kei a, na tung ua itna thupizaw sem ka nei chih na theih zawkna ding uh ahi.
english: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.

paite: Himahleh kuapeuh in mite ahihlungkhamleh keimah kia hon hihlungkham ahi kei a, uanggen lua bel hilou in, na vek ua hon hihlungkham chiat ahi zaw hi.
english: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.

paite: Huchibang mi a ding in gawtna na piak tak uh akihun ahi.
english: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;

paite: Huchi in na ngaidam un na khamuan zawta ding uh ahi, huchi lou in zaw bangchi chi hiam in mi huchibang alungkham luatna in avalhzou kha ding.
english: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

paite: Huaiziak in amah na itna uh hihkip ding in ka hon ngen hi.
english: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

paite: Hiai ziak mah in leng ka gelh ahi, bang peuhmah thu na man uleh, na man louh uh theihchetna ding in.
english: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

paite: Bang lam peuh a mi na ngaihdam uh ke'n leng ka ngaidam hi; ke'n ka ngaihdam khitsa, bangpeuh ka na ngaihdam takleh noumau ziak in Khrist ah ka ngaidamta ahi.
english: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

paite: Huchi lou in zaw Setan in hunlem ala kha ding hi; atup lah i haih ngal kei ua.
english: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

paite: Huan Khrist tanchinhoih gen ding a Troas ka tun in, Toupa ah kongkhak honsak in ka om hi.
english: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

paite: Himahleh ka unaupa Titas ka muh louh ziak in ka khalam ah zaw tawldamna himhim ka nei tuan kei, huchi in amaute kampha in ka khen a, ka pawt a, Masidonia gam ah ka paita hi.
english: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

paite: Himahleh Khrist vualzohna a hon pi zelpa leh koute a mun chih a amah theihna gimnamtui theisakpa Pathian kiang ah kipahthu om hen.
english: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.

paite: Hotdam a omlelte leh mangthang lellelte ah Pathian a ding in Khrist gimnamtui ka hi uhi.
english: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are being saved and in those who perish:

paite: Pawl khatte a ding in sihna lak ah sihna ding gimnam ka hi ua, pawl khatte ding in hinna lak a hinna ding in gimnam ka hi uh. Hiai bangte a ding in kua ahia chingzou ding?
english: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?

paite: Mi tampi in Pathian thu mite khem a sumsinna a azat bang un kou zaw ka zang kei uhi. Pathian sawltak hi zaw in, chihtaktak in Pathian mitmuh in Khrist ah thu ka gen zel uhi.
english: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.

paite: Koumau kigenhoih pan nawn dek ka hi uhia? Ahihkeileh, na kiang ua piak ding hiam aw na kiang ua kipan hiam genhoihna lai, mi khenkhat a dia akiphatmoh bang in koute a ding in akiphamoh sam ding a hia?
english: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

paite: Noute ka lai uh, na lungtang ua gelh, mi tengteng theih leh sim na hi uhi.
english: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,

paite: Khrist lai, kou hon gelhsak laitui a gelh hilou, Pathian hing Kha gelh hi zaw, suangpek a gelh hilou, sa lungtang pek a gelh hi zaw na hi uh chih chiantak in na taklangta uhi.
english: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

paite: Huan Pathian lam ah huchibang muanna Khrist vang in ka nei uhi.
english: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,

paite: Bangpeuh koumau a kipan a pawt ahi chi a ngaihsun ding in koumau kia in ka chin uh ka chi kei ua; ka chintheihna uh Pathian kiang a kipan ahi zaw.
english: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,

paite: Amah mah in thukhun thak nasemte hi ding in hon chingsak a; alai thu gelh lel nasemte ding hilou in, a Kha nasemte ding in ahi zaw hi; laithu gelh lel in zaw ahihlum nak a, Kha in bel ahihhing hi.
english: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

paite: Mosi mel avak ziak in Israel suante'n amel a-en sawt thei kei ua, huai thupina amang hiaihiai a; sihna nasepna suang a laimal gelh bawn, huchi tel a thupi a atunleh,
english: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away,

paite: Kha nasepna pen bangchi phet a thupi in atung diam aw?
english: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?

paite: Siam louh tansakna nasepna bawn athupileh diktatna nasepna athupizaw mahmah ding ahi.
english: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.

paite: Hih thupi a omsa in hiai ah zaw thupina himhim aneita ngal kei a, thupina thupizaw in akhuh tak ziak in.
english: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.

paite: Mangta hiaihiai bawn thupi a atunleh om gige ding thupi atuam in a-om zaw mahmah ding ahi.
english: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.

paite: Huan huchibang lametna ka neih ziak un hangsantak in gen ngamna ka nei uhi.
english: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,

paite: Mosi hih bang in ka hih kei ua, ama'n zaw thupina mang hiaihiai tawpna Israel suante'n a-et sawt louhna ding un maikhuhna in amai akhuh a;
english: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.

paite: alungsim uh bel hihkhauh in a-om a; tuni tanpha in Thukhun Lui asim un khuhna ngeina hawk louh in a-om gige ngal a, huai khuhna Khrist ah hihmang in a-omta hi.
english: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.

paite: Himahleh tuni tanpha in Mosi Laibu asim peuh chiang un alungtang uah khuhna a-om hi.
english: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.

paite: Himahleh alungtang uh Toupa lam angat peuh chiang un khuhna lakmang ahita ding hi.
english: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

paite: Huan Toupa tuh huai Kha ahi a, Toupa Kha omna peuh ah noplenna a-om zel hi.
english: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

paite: Huchi in eite zaw i vek un mai khuh lou in limlang bang a Toupa thupina tangsawnsak zel in, amah kibatpih ngeingei a om ding in hihlamdan in i om zel uhi; hiai Toupa Kha ngei a kipan i muh ahi.
english: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.

paite: Huaiziak in Pathian zahngaihna a hiai nasepna mu in ka lungke kei uhi.
english: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.

paite: Thil zumhuai kiselte ka pampaih zawta ua, khemna thu ka zang kei ua, Pathian thu tuh mi khemna ding in ka zang kei ua, thutak theisak in Pathian mitmuh in michih sia-le-pha theihna mit ka tungsak uhi.
english: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.

paite: Himahleh ka tanchinhoih uh khuh a a-omleh, mangthang lelte ah ahi khuh a a-om.
english: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,

paite: Pathian batpih Khrist leh athupidan tanchinhoih vak in amau asalhvak theihlouhna ding in, huaite ah hiai khovel pathian in agingtaloute lungsim asukmialsakta hi.
english: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.

paite: Koumau thu ka gen kei ua, Khrist Jesu Toupa thu ka gen zaw uhi, koute leng Jesu ziak in sikha ka hih uh leng ka gen zel uhi.
english: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,

paite: Jesu Khrist mel ah Pathian thupidan theihna vak hon pe ding in, "Mial a kipan vak avakkhe ding," chipa Pathian in i lungtangte asalvakta ngal hi.
english: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

paite: Himahleh thilhihtheihna thupina koute a hilou a, Pathian a ahihtheih zawkna ding in huai gou tuh leibel ah ka kem uhi.
english: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.

paite: Alanglang ah nehden in ka om ua, himahleh ning kitel in ka om tuan kei uh; mangbang in ka om ua himahleh ka lungke tuan kei uhi.
english: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;

paite: Sawi in ka om ua, himahleh taisan in ka om kei uh; khetpuk in ka om ua, himahleh hihmang in ka om kei uh.
english: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;

paite: Ka pumpi uah chik lai peuh in leng Jesu sihna ka pu zel ua, Jesu hinna leng ka pumpi ua alattheihna ding in.
english: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

paite: Koute hingdam a omlaite Jesu ziak a si ding a matsak in ka om gige ua Jesu hinna leng ka sa sithei ua a lattheihna ding in.
english: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.

paite: Huchi in koute ah sihna in asem gige a, nou ah bel hinna in asem gige hi.
english: So then death works in us, but life in you.

paite: Himahleh, "Ka ging a, huaiziak in thu ka gen ahi," chih gelhpa ginna lungsim ngei pu in, kou leng ka ging ua, thu leng ka gen uhi.
english: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” We also believe, and therefore we also speak,

paite: Toupa Jesu kaithoupa'n koute leng Jesu ah hon kaithou sam ding a, noumau toh ama omna mun ah hon dingsak ding chih thei in.
english: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also through Jesus, and will present us with you.

paite: Bangkim noumau hoihna ding ahi ngal a, hehpihna mi tamzaw ziak a hihkhan a om a, Pathian thupina ding a kipahthu genna nakpitak a akhansak sem theihna ding in.
english: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.

paite: Huai thu ziak in ka bah kei uhi; i polam mihing zawngkhal hiaihiai mahleh, i sunglam mihing pen niteng in bawl thak zel in a-om zaw ahi.
english: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.

paite: Ka gimthuakna neukha uh tu mitphiat kal sung kia a om ding in, thupina thupitak tangtawn a ding in ahon bawlsak hulhul ahi.
english: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,

paite: Thil muhtheihte en lou in, thil muh theihlouhte ka en zaw uhi; thil muhtheihte zaw sawt lou kal a ding ahi a, thil muh theihlouhte bel tangtawn a ding ahi zaw hi.
english: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

paite: I omna lei inn, hiai puanin pen hihsiat in om mahleh van ah inn, khut a lam louh, tangtawn a om ding, Pathian a kipan inn kip i nei uh chih i thei uhi.
english: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

paite: Van a kipan i omna ding silhthuah ut mahmah in hiai puanin ah thum chihtak in i thum gige uhi.
english: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,

paite: Huchibang a silh in om leng vuaktang in i om kei ding uhi.
english: if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.

paite: Eite hiai puanin a i om sung in gik pua in thum petmah in i thum ngal ua, silh lou a om i ut ziak ahi kei a, silhthuah a om i ut ziak ahi zaw, sithei pen hinna valh a a-om theih zawkna ding in.
english: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

paite: Huan huai mahmah ding a hon sutuahpa khamna Kha hon pepa Pathian ahi.
english: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

paite: Huchi in pumpi a i om lai teng in Toupa kiang ah i om nai kei chih thei in, muangtak in i om gige uhi.
english: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;

paite: Muthei a pai lou in, ginna in i pai zaw zel uhi.
english: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

paite: Muangtak in i om, huan pumpi a om lou a Toupa kiang a om i utzaw hi.
english: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.

paite: Huaiziak in om in om keita lehang leng, amah kipahpih lam mi hih i tum tinten ahi.
english: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

paite: Michih in pumpi a thilhihte asia-apha in, i hih bangbang a i muh chiat theihna ding in, Khrist thukhenna tutphah ma ah hihlat in i om vek ding uhi.
english: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

paite: Huchi in Toupa kihtakdan thei in mihingte ka hanthawn zel uhi, koute hihna Pathian kiang ah latsak a om bang in, na sia-le-pha theihna uah leng latsak a ka om uh ka lamen uhi.
english: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.

paite: Na kiang uah ka kigenhoih nawn uh ahi kei a, lungtang hilou a, dinmun lel suangte bang ahi hiam dawnna ding na neihtheihna ding un kou lam ah suantheihna hon bawl in ka gen zaw uhi.
english: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.

paite: Ka hai uleh Pathian a ding in ahi a; ka pil uleh noumau a ding in ahi.
english: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

paite: Khrist itna in ahon sawl teitei ahi; hichi in ka ngaihtuah uhi; mi tengteng sih sik in mi khat asi a, huaiziak in mi tengteng asi uhi.
english: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.

paite: Mi tengteng sih sik a Khrist asihna pen ahingte leng amau a dia ahin nawn louh ua, asih sik ua si a thounawn a ding a ahin zawkna ding un.
english: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

paite: Huchi ahih ziak in tuban kou zaw salam ah kuamah ka thei nawnta kei ding uh; salam ah Khrist na theita mah le ung leng; tu'n zaw ka theita kei uhi.
english: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.

paite: Huchi ahih ziak in, kuapeuh Khrist a a-omleh thilsiam thak ahong hi a; thil luite amangta a, ngai un, ahong thakta hi.
english: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

paite: Himahleh bangkim Pathian kiang a kipan a pawt ahi a; ama'n Khrist ziak in amah toh kituak in hon bawl a, kituahna nasepna ahon pia hi.
english: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;

paite: Huchi in Pathian in Khrist ah khovel amah toh kituak nawn in abawl a, atatleknate uh tatlekna a sehsak lou in, kituah nawnna thu hon kemsak ahi.
english: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

paite: Huaiziak in koute Khrist palai nasemte ka hi ua, Pathian in koute tungtawn in ahon ngen ahi. Pathian toh kituakta un aw chi in Khrist sik in ka hon ngen uhi.
english: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

paite: Amah a Pathian diktatna i hong hihtheihna ding in khelhna himhim thei lou amah Pathian in eite ziak in khelhna in abawl hi.
english: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

paite: Pathian hehpihna phattuampih lou a na tanlouhna ding un, amah seppih koute'n ka hon ngen petmah uhi.
english: Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain.

paite: "Hun kipahhuai ah ka hon ngaikhia a, hotdamna ni ah ka hon panpih," achi ngal a. Ngai un, tu hun kipahuai ahi a; ngai in, tu hotdamna ni ahi!
english: For he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you. In a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.

paite: Ka nasepna uh dem a a-omlouhna ding in bang lam peuh ah kuamah pukloh ding himhim ka bawl kei uhi.
english: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,

paite: Pathian nasemte bang in bangkim ah mi mit tung in ka om zaw zel ua, nakpi a kuhkalna ah, gentheihna ah, taksapnate ah, lunggimnate ah;
english: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,

paite: vuaknate ah, hentaknate ah, mipihon buainate ah, sepgimnate ah, zan ihmutmohnate ah leh gilkialna ah;
english: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings,

paite: sianthouna in, theihna in, kuhkalna in, migitna in, Kha Siangthou in leh
english: in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,

paite: thutak thu in, Pathian thilhihtheihna in; taklam leh veilam a diktatna galvante zang in;
english: in the word of truth, in the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

paite: pahtawina ah leh pahtawilouhna ah, min gensiat leh min genhoihna ah leng;
english: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true,

paite: midiktat hi ngal in mikhemte bang a bawl in ka om ua; minthangtak hi ngal in theih tham louh bang in, si dek phial a vuak a om a, hihlup louh in, ngai dih ua, ka hing ua;
english: as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold—we live, as punished and not killed,

paite: lungkhamtak bang a om in, lah kipak gige ngal in; zawngtak bang a om in, lah bangkim a midangte hausa a bawl in, bangmah nei lou bang in, lah thil bangkim nei hi ngal in.
english: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.

paite: Korinthte aw, koute'n zalentak in ka gen ua, ka lungtang uh zatak in akihong hi.
english: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.

paite: Noute a ding in phal louh bangmah ka nei kei ua, nou bel na thil deihlam uah phal louh tan na nei uhi.
english: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.

paite: Huchi in ka hon piak bangbang hon pethuk sam ding in (tate kiang a gen bang in ka gen ahi), nou leng na lungtangte uh zasak sam un.
english: Now in return—I speak as to my children—you also open your hearts.

paite: Ginglou mite toh kituakloupi a hakkol pokhawm in om kei un; diktatlouhna leh diktatna in bang ahia kikopna aneih uh? Ahihkeileh, mial leh vak in bang ahia kithuahna aneih uh?
english: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?

paite: Belial leh Khrist in bang ahia kituahna aneih uh? Ahihkeileh, gingloumi leh gingtami'n bang ahia tankhawm aneih uh?
english: What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?

paite: Milimte leh Pathian tempul in leng bang ahia kituahna aneih uh? Eite zaw Pathian hing tempul i hi ngal ua; Pathian in, "Amaute ah ka teng dia, amau lak ah leng ka khosa ding; huan a Pathian uh ka hi dia, amau leng ka mite ahi ding uh, achih bang in.
english: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.”

paite: Huaiziak in alak ua kipan in hong pawt unla, atuam in om un, thilsiang lou himhim khoih kei un, Toupa'n achi, huchi in ka hon kipahpih dia,
english: Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.

paite: noute a ding in na Pa uh ka hi dia, noute leng kei a ding in tanute leh tapate na hi ding uh, Toupa Bangkim hihthei in achi," chi in.
english: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”

paite: Huchi in deihtakte aw, huai thuchiamte i neih ziak un, sa leh kha buahna tengteng a kipan ei leh ei i kisiangsak ding uh, Pathian laudan siam kawm a sianthouna hihbukim in.
english: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

paite: Na lungtang uah mun hon awn un; kua tung mah ah ka khial kei ua, kuamah ka hihse kei ua, kuamah ka khem sam kei uh.
english: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.

paite: Kuamah siam louh tansak sawm a hiai thu gen ka hi kei; sih leh sihkhawm a, dam leh damkhawm ding in ka lungtang uah noute ka hon vom uh chih tuma zek in ka genta hi.
english: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.

paite: Nou lam ah zaw ka pau ngamdan athupi a, ka hon suandan athupi hi; khamuanna in ka dim a, ka haksatna tengteng uah nuamsa in ka dimlet hi.
english: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.

paite: Masidonia gam ka tun un leng ka sa un muanna himhim anei tuan kei a, khat lam khat lam ah hihgim in ka om zawta ua; polam kisualnate a-om a; sunglam launate leng a-om hi.
english: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.

paite: Himahleh, lungngai a omte khamuanpa, Pathian in, Titas ahong tunna in hon khamuan a;
english: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,

paite: ahong tunna kia in ahi kei, na lungkhamdante uh, na kahdante uh, ka tung a na phattuamngaihdante uh hon hilh a, noumau a akhamuanna mah in leng ahon khamuanta ahi; huchi in ka kipak nawn sem hi.
english: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced still more.

paite: Ka laikhak in hon hihlungkham mah leng, ka kisik kei hi; atung in ahihleh ka kisik a, huai laikhak in nou ahon hihlungkham chih ka theih ziak in; himahleh sawt lou kal kia ahi.
english: For though I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you grieve, though just for a while.

paite: Tu'n zaw ka kipak ahi, hihlungkham a na om ziak uh ahi kei a, kisikna ding a na lungkham ziak un ahi zaw hi. Koumau ziak a bangmah na tanlouhna ding un Pathian deihlam bang a hihlungkham in na om uhi.
english: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.

paite: Pathian deihlam a lungkhamna in hotdamna ding in, kisikna abawl a, kisikhuai thil atun kei; khovel lungkhamna in bel sihna atun zaw hi.
english: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.

paite: En mah un, Pathian deihlam a lungkhamna in bangchibang chihtakna, bangchibang kihahsiang nopna, bangchibang ki-awilouhna, bangchibang patauh-na, bangchibang lunggulhna, bangchibang phattuamngaihna, bang-chibang gawtna ahia nou a dia ahon tut tak. Bangkim ah huai thu ah na siang uh chih na kihihlangta uhi.
english: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.

paite: Huchi in na kiang uah gelh mah leng, agilou hihpa ziak in ka gelh kei a, agilou thuakpa ziak in leng ka gelh sam kei, ka tung ua na phattuam ngaihdan uh Pathian mitmuh a na kiang ua theihsak a a-omtheihna ding in ka gelh ahi zaw hi.
english: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.

paite: Huaiziak in khamuan in ka omta him ua; koumau khamuanna kia lou ah leng, Titas kipahna ziak in ka kipak nawn sem ua, noute tengteng in alungsim na hihhalhsak tak ziak un.
english: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.

paite: Akiang ah bang lam peuh ah leng noumau hon suang mah le ung, ka zahlak ngal kei ua, zahlak nak sang in bangkim, na kiang ua thutak tak a ka gen zel bang un, Titas ma a ka hon suan uh thutak tak ahong hita ngei hi.
english: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.

paite: Huan na vek ua athu na mandante uh, lau leh ling kawm a amah na kipahpihdante uh theigige in, alainatna noumau lam ah alian nawn semta ahi.
english: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.

paite: Thil bangkim ah na tung ua ka muan ziak in ka kipak ahi.
english: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.

paite: Huan unaute aw, Masidonia gam a saptuam pawlte lak a Pathian hehpihna piak pen ka hon theisak ding uhi.
english: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,

paite: Huchi a haksa thuakna ze-etna thupi a, akipahna uh kiching zou leh nakpi a genthei hinapi, amau lam a athilphalna thupi un huaite khupzou ahihdan bang.
english: how in a severe ordeal of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.

paite: Aneih bang un, ahi, aneih sang ua thupi in leng, amau ut thu un apia uh chih theihpih ka hi;
english: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,

paite: hiai hehpihna leh misiangthoute nasepsakna thu a nakpitak a hon ngen ngutngut in.
english: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.

paite: Huan hiai leng ka lamet bang uh hilou, Toupa kiang ah akipekhe masa phot ua, huan Pathian deihna bang in koute kiang ah ahong kipekhia uhi.
english: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.

paite: Huchi in tuma a apatsa, hiai hehpihna leng noumau a hihkim lai ding in Titas ka ngen uhi.
english: So we urged Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.

paite: Huchi in bangkim ginna, thugen siamna, theihna, phattuamngaihna tengteng, na hon itna uh na hauh bang un, huai hehpihna leng na hauhtheihna ding un thanop suah un.
english: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.

paite: Thupia bang in ka gen kei a, midang phattuamngaihna in na itna uh gildan leng chian ding in ka gen ahi zaw hi.
english: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna, agentheihna ziak a na hong hauhtheihna ding un hau mahleh noumau ziak ngeingei a ahong gentheih takdan, na thei uhi.
english: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.

paite: Huchi in huai ah ka ngaihdan bang ahia ka gen hi; kum khat paita a na hih pat kia uh leng hilou, hih ding a na na lunggulh uh tu in buchingsakta le uchin nou a ding in ahoihpen ahi.
english: I give advice in this: it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.

paite: Huchi in hihpichin ding a kimanna a-om bang in, na neih bang zel ua tangtunna leng a-omtheihna ding in, tu'n ah zaw hihtangtungta un.
english: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.

paite: Kimanna pen a-om nak photleh mi aneih louhpi hilou in, aneih bang zel a apiak kipahpih tuak ahi.
english: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.

paite: Midang agim louh ua, nou na gimna ding un ka chi kei hi.
english: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,

paite: Kibatlualna ding in, na hauhna uh tulai in ataksap awnghukna ahong hih a, ahauhna uh leng na taksap awnghukna uh ahong hih sam theihna ding in ka chi ahi zaw, huchi in kibatlualna ahong om thei ding hi.
english: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack, that there may be equality.

paite: "Akhawm tam in aval in anei kei a, akhawm tawm in leng atasam tuan kei," chih gelh bang in.
english: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.”

paite: Huan ke'n nou ka hon awlmoh bang a awlmohna lungtang Titas kiang a pepa Pathian kiang ah kipahthu om hen.
english: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.

paite: Ka ngetna uh ahon sansak a; himahleh ka nget ziak kia uh hilou in, ama phatuamngaihna in, amah ut thu in na kiang ua hoh dia pawt ding in akisa hi.
english: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.

paite: Unaupa khat toh amah ka hon sawl uhi. Huai unaupa asaptuam un tanchinhoih lam a aphatna uh saptuam pawl tengteng ah athangsuak hi.
english: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.

paite: Huchi lel leng ahi kei, hiai hehpihna thawnpiak po ding a kou toh zin vialvial ding a saptuam telkhiak ahi a, Toupa thupina ding in hiai thilthawnpiak ka hawm ua, midangte huh na kithalawpna uh ensak ding in leng ka hawm uhi.
english: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.

paite: Hiai thilpiak ka hawmna lam uah kuamah in ahon demlouhna ding un ka pilvang uhi.
english: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.

paite: Toupa ngaihdan kia in hilou in, mihing ngaihdan a leng thil kilawm ka ngaihtuah khol zel uhi.
english: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

paite: Huan akiang uah ka unaupa uh ka sawl ua, amah thil tampitak ah phatuamngaitak ahi chih tamveipi ka theichianta uhi, tu khol a houh nou ahon taksan mahmah ziak in phatuam angai nawn sem hi.
english: We have sent with them our brother whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.

paite: Titas ahihleh, ka lawm leh noumau lam a ka naseppih ahi a; huan, ka unaute uh ahihleh, saptuam pawlte palai, Khrist thupina ahi uhi.
english: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.

paite: Huaiziak in na it uh chih theihna leh ka hon suanna uh theihtelna saptuam pawlte ma ah akiang uah langsak un.
english: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.

paite: Misiangthoute a dia thilpiak thu zaw na kiang uah ka gelh akiphamoh kei hi.
english: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,

paite: Na kimandan uh ka thei ngal a, huai lam thu ah zaw nikum in Akhaia gamte kimansa in a-omta uh chi in Masidonia gam a mite kiang ah ka hon na suang zel a; na phattuamngaihna un alak ua mi tampi atok halhta hi.
english: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.

paite: Himahleh huai lam thu ah zaw ka hon suanna bangmah lou ahong hihlouhna ding in unaute ka hohsak zel hi; ka gen bangtak a mansa a na na omtheihna ding un.
english: But I have sent the brothers so that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,

paite: Huchi lou in zaw Masidonia gam a mi kuate hiam in ahon zuih zenzen uleh, kiman lou in hong mu le uh, noute kia hilou in noute ka hon ginna uh lam ah kou leng ka zahlak kha ding uhi.
english: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.

paite: Huaiziak in unaute bel nou kiang a hong masa a, hoihtak a thilpiak na chiamkholhte uh na bawlkhol ding a, nget kiphamoh in ka gingta hi, laksak teitei bang hilou a phaltak a piak bang zaw a mansa a na omna ding un.
english: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.

paite: Himahleh huai lam thu ah zaw, theh tawm in a-at tawm ding a, theh tam in a-at tam ding hi.
english: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

paite: Michih in it pipi a pe lou in, piak louh theih louh a ngaihtuah a pe tuan lou in, alungtang ua atup bang zel un pe chiat uhen; Pathian in kipaktak a pe mite ahi a-it.
english: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

paite: Huan Pathian in hehpihna chiteng in na tung uah avuk thei ahi; huchi in nou bangkim ah ahun ngial nei gige in, nasep hoih chiteng a ding in na hau thei ding uhi;
english: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.

paite: "Ahawmzak a; gentheite kiang ah apia a; adiktatna tangtawn in a-om gige," chih gelh bang in.
english: As it is written, “He has scattered abroad. He has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever.”

paite: Thehpa kiang a achi pepa leh nek ding a tanghou pepa'n na theh ding uh chi ahon pe ding a, ahon hihpungsak ding a, na diktatna gahte uh leng ahon hihpungsak ding.
english: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,

paite: Thilphalna chiteng koute ziak a Pathian kiang a kipahthu genna pen nei ding a, bangkim a hihhauh a om in,
english: you being enriched in everything for all generosity, which produces thanksgiving to God through us.

paite: hiai sepsakna nna in misiangthoute taksapna awngte ahuksak kia ahi kei a, Pathian kiang a kipahthu genna tampi in leng aluanglet lai ahi.
english: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God,

paite: Hiai nasepna a etkhiak a om in Khrist tanchinhoih lam a na thugin uh na zuihdan uleh amau a ding leh mi tengteng a dia thilpiak a na thilphaldan un Pathian na hih thupi ding uh ahi.
english: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all,

paite: Amau ngei in leng na tung ua Pathian hehpihna thupi mahmah ziak in, nou a dia thumsak kawm in ahon ngai mahmah uhi.
english: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.

paite: Athilpiak gen zoh vual louh ziak in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu om hen.
english: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!

paite: Upa in, tel a om numei leh atate thutak a ka it, kei kia hilou a, thutak thei peuhmahte kiang ah;
english: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,

paite: thutak eimah a om gige, tangtawn a i kiang ua om gige ding ahih ziak in;
english: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:

paite: Pa Pathian a kipan leh Pa' Tapa, Toupa Jesu Khrist a kipan hehpihna, zahngaihna, leh khamuanna in thutak leh itna ah noute hon ompih hen.
english: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

paite: Pa kiang a kipan athupiak i muh bang in na ta kuate hiam thutak a om a ka muh ziak in ka kipak mahmah hi.
english: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.

paite: Numei hoih, na kiang a thupiak thak gelh hilou in, atung a kipan a i neih pen gelh zaw in, i ki-ittuah theihna ding in nget petmah in ka hon ngen hi.
english: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

paite: Huan hiai itna ahi, athupiak bang zel a i omna uh. Hiai ahi thupiak atung a kipat ana zak uh, huai ah na om ding uh ahi.
english: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

paite: Jesu Khrist taksa in ahong pai chih gum lou khemmi tampi khovel ah ahong pawtta uhi. Huai mite ahi, khemmi leh Khrist doumi.
english: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.

paite: I sepkhiaksate mangsak lou a, akipahman bukim a i muhtheihna ding un, nangmah kivenghoih in.
english: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.

paite: Kuapeuh huai Khrist thu sinsakna thu a om gige lou a talek in Pathian anei kei. Huai thu sinsakna thu a a-om gige in Pa leh Tapa aneikhawm hi.
english: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

paite: Kuapeuh huai thu sinsakna thu hon po lou a, na kiang ua ahong paileh na inn uah tungsak kei unla, paukam hoih in kha sam kei un,
english: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,

paite: paukam hoih a kha peuhmah athilhihkhelh ah panna anei ngal a.
english: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.

paite: Na kiang ua thu tampi gen ding ka neih ziak in lai leh laitui a gelh ka ut kei a; na kipahna uh akimtheihna ding in na kiang ua hong hoh a, kimaituah a kihou ka lamen zaw hi.
english: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.

paite: Na sanggamnu tel tate un chibai ahon buk uhi, Amen.
english: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.

paite: Huan Ahab sih nung in Israelte tung ah Moabte ahel uhi.
english: Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

paite: Samaria a dantan tungnung vathangkalh tohlet a pan Ahaziah akekhia a, akihihnata hi. Huchi in mi asawl a, akiang uah, "Kuan unla, hiai ka natna ahoihkhe nawn thei hiam Ekron kho pathian Baal-zebub va dong un," achi hi.
english: Ahaziah fell down through the lattice in his upper room that was in Samaria, and was sick. So he sent messengers, and said to them, “Go, inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I will recover from this sickness.”

paite: Himahleh TOUPA angel in Tishbi mi Elijah kiang ah, "Thou inla, Samaria kumpipa misawlte houpih ding in kuantou inla, akiang uah, Israel gam a Pathian a-om louh ziak in hia Ekron kho pathian Baal-zebub dong dia na hong kuan uh?
english: But Yahweh’s angel said to Elijah the Tishbite, “Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and tell them, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you go to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron?

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Na kahtouhna lupna a pan na hong kumsuk nawn kei dia, na si ngeingei ding, chi in va gen in," achi hi. Huchi in Elijah akuanta hi.
english: Now therefore Yahweh says, “You will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.”’” Then Elijah departed.

paite: Amisawlte akiang ah ahong kik nawn un akiang uah, "Bang achi a ahia na hong kik nawn mawk uh?" achi hi.
english: The messengers returned to him, and he said to them, “Why is it that you have returned?”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Mi khat hong houpih ding in ahong a, ka kiang uah, pai unla, nou hon sawlpa kumpipa kiang ah kik nawn unla, akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, Israel gam a Pathian a-om louh ziak in hia Ekron kho pathian Baal-zebub dong dia na sawl? Huchi in na kahtouhna lupna a pan na hong kumsuk nawn kei ding a, na si ngeingei ding, chi in va hilh un ahon chi," achi uhi.
english: They said to him, “A man came up to meet us, and said to us, ‘Go, return to the king who sent you, and tell him, “Yahweh says, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you send to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.’”’”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou hon houpih dia hong, huai thute hong hilhpa mi bangchibang ahia oi?" achi hi.
english: He said to them, “What kind of man was he who came up to meet you and told you these words?”

paite: Amau adawng ua, "Samul puan a kizem ahi a, akawng savun kawnggak in agak," achi ua; ama'n, "Tishbi mi Elijah ahi ve," achi hi.
english: They answered him, “He was a hairy man, and wearing a leather belt around his waist.” He said, “It’s Elijah the Tishbite.”

paite: Kumpipa'n sepaih sawmnga heutu, aheute sawmnga toh akiang ah asawl hi. Mualvum a tu Elijah kiang ah ahohtou a, ama'n, "Nang, Pathian mi, kumpipa'n hong paisuk in, achi ve," achi hi.
english: Then the king sent a captain of fifty with his fifty to him. He went up to him; and behold, he was sitting on the top of the hill. He said to him, “Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down!’”

paite: Elijah in adawng a, sepaih sawmnga heutu kiang ah, "Pathian mipa ka hihleh van a pan mei hong kesuk henla, nangmah leh na heute sawmnga hong kangmang vek hen," achi hi. Huchi in van a pan mei ahong kia a, amah leh aheute sawmnga akangmang vek uhi.
english: Elijah answered to the captain of fifty, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty!” Then fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.

paite: Akiang ah sepaih sawmnga heutu dang, aheute sawmnga toh asawl nawn hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Nang Pathian mi, kumpipa'n, hong paisuk meng in, achi ve," achi hỉ.
english: Again he sent to him another captain of fifty with his fifty. He answered him, “Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down quickly!’”
