paite: Elijah in adawng a, akiang ah, "Pathian mipa ka hihleh van a pan mei hong kesuk henla, nang leh na heute sawmnga hong kangmang vek hen,” achi hi. Huchi in Pathian mei van a kipan ahong kia a, amah leh aheute sawmnga akangmang vekta uhi.
english: Elijah answered them, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty!” Then God’s fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.

paite: Sepaih sawmnga dang heutu, aheute sawmnga toh asawl nawn a, huai sepaih sawmnga dang heutu akuantou a, Elijah ma ah ava khukdin a, akiang ah, "Pathian mipa aw, ka hinna leh hiai na sikha mi sawmngate hinna na mitmuh in manpha hen.
english: Again he sent the captain of a third fifty with his fifty. The third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and begged him, and said to him, “Man of God, please let my life and the life of these fifty of your servants be precious in your sight.

paite: Ngai in, van a pan mei ahong kesuk a, sepaih sawmnga heutu nihte aheute sawmnga utoh akangmangta ua; huaiziak in ka hinna na mitmuh in manpha hen," chi in angen hi.
english: Behold, fire came down from the sky and consumed the last two captains of fifty with their fifties. But now let my life be precious in your sight.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA angel in Elijah kiang ah, "Kumsuk pih in, amaute lau ke'n," achi hi. Huchi in athou a, amah toh kumpipa kiang ah akumsukkhawm uhi.
english: Yahweh’s angel said to Elijah, “Go down with him. Don’t be afraid of him.” Then he arose and went down with him to the king.

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Ekronte pathian Baal-zebub dong dia mite na sawl, Israel gam a dot ding Pathian a-om louh ziak hia? Huaiziak in na kahtouhna lupna a pan na hong kumsuk nawn kei ding a, na si ngeingei ding," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Because you have sent messengers to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, is it because there is no God in Israel to inquire of his word? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.’”

paite: Huchi in Elijah in agen TOUPA thu bang in asita hi. Tapa aneih louh ziak in Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat tapa, Jehoram kum nih alal kum in, asik in Jehoram alalta hi.
english: So he died according to Yahweh’s word which Elijah had spoken. Jehoram began to reign in his place in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, because he had no son.

paite: Ahaziah thilhih tanchin dangte Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Huan Ahab in Samaria ah tapa sawmsagih anei hi. Jehu in Samaria a, Jezreel kho heutute, upate leh Ahab tapate ana dontei mite kiang ah, laigelh in akhak hi.
english: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria, to the rulers of Jezreel, even the elders, and to those who brought up Ahab’s sons, saying,

paite: "Hiai laikhakte na muh phet chiang un, na pu tapate na kiang uah a-om ua, kangtalaite, sakolte, kulhpi nei khuate leng, galvante toh na nei uhi.
english: “Now as soon as this letter comes to you, since your master’s sons are with you, and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city also, and armor,

paite: Huchi in na pu tapate lak a mi, ahoihpen leh akizenpen zongkhia unla, apa laltutphah ah tusak unla, na pu uh inkote a ding in gal dou un," achi hi.
english: select the best and fittest of your master’s sons, set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.”

paite: Himahleh amau alau mahmah ua, "Ngai dih ua, kumpipa nihte'n azoh louhsa uh ahi a, e'n bangchi in i zou mahmah dia?" achi uhi.
english: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, “Behold, the two kings didn’t stand before him! How then shall we stand?”

paite: Kumpipa insung heutupen, khopi ukpen, upate, naupangte ana dawntei mi teng in Jehu kiang ah, "Na sikhate ka hi uh, hih dia na hon hilh tengteng ka hih ding uh. Kuamah kumpipa in ka bawl kei ding uh; nang hoih na sakdan in hih in," chi in mi asawl uhi.
english: He who was over the household, and he who was over the city, the elders also, and those who raised the children, sent to Jehu, saying, “We are your servants, and will do all that you ask us. We will not make any man king. You do that which is good in your eyes.”

paite: Akiang uah, "Kei lam a pang na hih ua, ka thu na man ding uleh na pute uh tapate lu hon la unla, zingchiang in hichih hun ma in Jezreel ah ka kiang ah hong un," chi in lai akhak nawn hi. Kumpipa tapate sawmsagih ahi ua, khopi miliante, amau dontei mite kiang ah a-om uhi.
english: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, “If you are on my side, and if you will listen to my voice, take the heads of the men who are your master’s sons, and come to me to Jezreel by tomorrow this time.” Now the king’s sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, who brought them up.

paite: Laikhak amuh un hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa tapate aman ua, sawmsagihte athat ua, alute uh bawmpi a koih in Jezreel ah akiang ah akhakta uhi.
english: When the letter came to them, they took the king’s sons and killed them, even seventy people, and put their heads in baskets, and sent them to him to Jezreel.

paite: Thangkou khat ahong tung a, "Kumpipa tapate lu ahon tawita uh," chi in ahilh uh. Ama'n, "Kulh lutna kongpi gei ah mun nih in sekhawm unla, zingchiang tan in om hen," achi hi.
english: A messenger came and told him, “They have brought the heads of the king’s sons.” He said, “Lay them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until the morning.”

paite: Azingchiang in hichi ahong hi a, ava pawt a, adingh a, mi tengteng kiang ah, "Noute diktat hi un, ngai un, ka pu ka guksawm a, ka hihlumta a; ahihleh hiai tengteng kua thah ahia le?
english: In the morning, he went out and stood, and said to all the people, “You are righteous. Behold, I conspired against my master and killed him, but who killed all these?

paite: TOUPA'N Ahab inkote tungtang agen, TOUPA thu lei ah ake het kei ding chih thei un; TOUPA'N asikha Elijah zang a agen ahon tungsakta hi," achi hi.
english: Know now that nothing will fall to the earth of Yahweh’s word, which Yahweh spoke concerning Ahab’s house. For Yahweh has done that which he spoke by his servant Elijah.”

paite: Huchi in Jehu in Jezreel a Ahab inkuan a mi omsun teng, amilian tengteng, alawm tengteng leh asiampute khat lel leng hawisak het lou in athat siang vek hi.
english: So Jehu struck all that remained of Ahab’s house in Jezreel, with all his great men, his familiar friends, and his priests, until he left him no one remaining.

paite: Huchi in athou a, apawt a, Samaria ah ahohta hi. Lampi a belampute belam mulmetna inn ava tun in,
english: He arose and departed, and went to Samaria. As he was at the shearing house of the shepherds on the way,

paite: Jehu in Judah kumpipa Ahaziah unaute amu a, "Kuate na hi ua?" achi hi. Amau, "Ahaziah unaute ka hi uh, kumpipa tapate leh kumpinu tapate chibai va buk dia paisuk ka hi uh," chi in adawng uh.
english: Jehu met with the brothers of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, “Who are you?” They answered, “We are the brothers of Ahaziah. We are going down to greet the children of the king and the children of the queen.”

paite: Ama'n, "Hingmat un," achi a; huchi in ahingmat ua, belam mulmetna inn khukchin ah athat ua, mi sawmli-le-nih ahi ua; khat lel leng ahawi kei uh.
english: He said, “Take them alive!” They took them alive, and killed them at the pit of the shearing house, even forty-two men. He didn’t leave any of them.

paite: Huai a pan apawt nung in Rekab tapa Jehonadab, amah dawn dia hong pai amu hi. Chibai abuk a, akiang ah, "Na tung a lungsim dik ka put bang in, lungsim dik na pu sam hia?” achi hi. Jehonadab in, “Pu e,” chi in adawng hi. "Ahihleh na khut hon pe dih," achi a; huchi in akhut apia a, ama'n akiang ah kangtalai sung ah akailut hi.
english: When he had departed from there, he met Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him. He greeted him, and said to him, “Is your heart right, as my heart is with your heart?” Jehonadab answered, “It is.” “If it is, give me your hand.” He gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hong sam inla, TOUPA a dia phatuam ka ngaihdan mu himhim dih,” achi hi. Huchi in akangtalai ah atuangsak hi.
english: He said, “Come with me, and see my zeal for Yahweh.” So they made him ride in his chariot.

paite: Samaria ava tun in Ahab inkote Samaria a omsunte, Elijah kiang a agen TOUPA thu bang ngei in, ahihman khit vek masiah athat zel hi.
english: When he came to Samaria, he struck all who remained to Ahab in Samaria, until he had destroyed them, according to Yahweh’s word which he spoke to Elijah.

paite: Jehu in mite tengteng asamkhawm a, akiang uah, Ahab in Baal nna sem zek phet ahi a, Jehu in bel nakpi in asem ding hi.
english: Jehu gathered all the people together, and said to them, “Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him much.

paite: "Tu in Baal zawlnei tengteng, abemi tengteng leh asiampu tengteng ka kiang ah hon samkhawm dih ua. Kuamah kim lou kei uhen; Baal kiang ah kithoihna thupitak lat ding ka nei a; kuapeuh akim lou ahing het kei ding," achi hi. Himahleh Jehu in Baal bemite hihlup tum in, gitlouh piltak a, ahih ahi.
english: Now therefore call to me all the prophets of Baal, all of his worshipers, and all of his priests. Let no one be absent, for I have a great sacrifice to Baal. Whoever is absent, he shall not live.” But Jehu did deceptively, intending to destroy the worshipers of Baal.

paite: Jehu in, "Baal min in khawmpi thupi bawl un,” achi hi. Huchi in agenzakta uhi.
english: Jehu said, “Sanctify a solemn assembly for Baal!” So they proclaimed it.

paite: Jehu in Israel gam tengteng ah akhakkhia a; huchi in Baal bemi tengteng ahong pai ua, atel lou himhim a-om kei uhi. Baal inn ah alut ua; Baal inn kongpi a pan aphaitam pha in adim dipdep uhi.
english: Jehu sent through all Israel; and all the worshipers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that didn’t come. They came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was filled from one end to another.

paite: Kivatna puan kemmi kiang ah, "Baal bemi tengteng kivatna puan hon la in," achi hi. Huchi in kivatna puante ahon la uhi.
english: He said to him who kept the wardrobe, “Bring out robes for all the worshipers of Baal!” So he brought robes out to them.

paite: Rekab tapa Jehonadab toh Baal inn ah Jehu alut ua; Baal bemite kiang ah, "Hiai ah Baal bemite lou ngal, TOUPA mite a-om kha ding uh, zong unla, en vialvial dih uh," achi hi.
english: Jehu went with Jehonadab the son of Rechab into the house of Baal. Then he said to the worshipers of Baal, “Search, and see that none of the servants of Yahweh are here with you, but only the worshipers of Baal.”

paite: Kithoihnate leh halmang thillatte lan dia alut un, Jehu in inkuan ah mi sawmgiat ana dingsak khin hi. "Na khut ua ka hon piak kuapeuh asuahtakleh, asuaktami hinna tang a amah hinna lak ding ahi,” achi hi.
english: So they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had appointed for himself eighty men outside, and said, “If any of the men whom I bring into your hands escape, he who lets him go, his life shall be for the life of him.”

paite: Haltum thillat alat khittak in hichi ahong hi a, Jehu in galvil sepaih leh aheutute uh kiang ah, "Lut unla, va that un; kuamah suaktasak kei un," achi hi. Huchi in namsau in asat ua; galvil sepaih leh aheutute uh apaikhia ua, Baal inn ah alut uhi.
english: As soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, “Go in and kill them! Let no one escape.” So they struck them with the edge of the sword. The guard and the captains threw the bodies out, and went to the inner shrine of the house of Baal.

paite: Baal inn a milimte alakhia ua, ahal uhi.
english: They brought out the pillars that were in the house of Baal and burned them.

paite: Baal lim alaichim ua, Baal inn ahihsia ua, tuni tan in dailenbuk in azang lai uhi.
english: They broke down the pillar of Baal, and broke down the house of Baal, and made it a latrine, to this day.

paite: Huchibang in Jehu in Israel gam a pan Baal ahihsia hi.
english: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.

paite: Himahleh Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhna, Israelte thil ahihkhialsak a, ahihte Jehu in atawpsan kei hi. Huai bel Bethel khua leh Dan a dangka-eng bawngnou limte biak ahi.
english: However, Jehu didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin—the golden calves that were in Bethel and that were in Dan.

paite: TOUPA'N Jehu kiang ah, "Ka mit tungtak a thil na hih ziak leh ka lungsim a deihthusam bangtak a Ahab inkote tung a na hih ziak in, na tapate suan lina tan in Israel laltutphah ah atu ding uh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Jehu, “Because you have done well in executing that which is right in my eyes, and have done to Ahab’s house according to all that was in my heart, your descendants shall sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation.”

paite: Himahleh Jehu in TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian dan alungtang tengteng in azui kei a; Jeroboam in Israelte thil hihkhialsak a, ahihkhelh atawpsan tuan kei hi.
english: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of Yahweh, the God of Israel, with all his heart. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam, with which he made Israel to sin.

paite: Huai lai in TOUPA'N Israel gam letdan aneusak panta hi. Huchi in Hazael in Israel gam tengteng ah amau anuaisiahta hi.
english: In those days Yahweh began to cut away parts of Israel; and Hazael struck them in all the borders of Israel

paite: Jordan a pan suahlam, Gilead gam tengteng, Gadte, Reubente, Manassehte, Arnon Phaizang a Aroer a pan Gilead leh Vasan gam tan in.
english: from the Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.

paite: Jehu tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng, athilhihtheihdan tengteng Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Huchi in Jehu api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, Samaria ah avui ua; asik in atapa Jehoahaz ahong lalta hi.
english: Jehu slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria. Jehoahaz his son reigned in his place.

paite: Samaria gam a Israelte tung a Jehu vaihawm sung kum sawmnih-le-giat ahi.
english: The time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.

paite: Huan Ahaziah nu Athaliah in atapa asi chih atheih in, athou a, kumpipa tapa tengteng athat vek hi.
english: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring.

paite: Ahaziah tapa Joash bel kumpipa Jehoram tanu, Ahaziah sanggamnu Jehosheba in kumpipa tapa athahte uh lak a pan pimang in, adontu toh lupna dantan ah a-omsak a; Athaliah muh theih louh ding in asel ua, huchi in thah ahita kei hi.
english: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king’s sons who were slain, even him and his nurse, and put them in the bedroom; and they hid him from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.

paite: Amah bel amah toh TOUPA' inn ah kum guk akibu ua, huchi in Athaliah in huai gam ah vai ahawmta hi.
english: He was with her hidden in Yahweh’s house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.

paite: Akum sagihna ah Jehoiada in Keroth mite leh galvil sepaihte lak a mi sepaih za heutute asamsak a, TOUPA' inn ah akiang ah apilutsak hi. Akiang uah thu akhung a, TOUPA' inn ah akichiamsak a, kumpipa tapa amusak hi.
english: In the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the captains over hundreds of the Carites and of the guard, and brought them to him into Yahweh’s house; and he made a covenant with them, and made a covenant with them in Yahweh’s house, and showed them the king’s son.

paite: Ama'n, “Na hih ding uh hichibang ahi. Na lak ua Sabbath ni a hong dingte seh thum suah seh khat in kumpipa' inn na veng ding uh.
english: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you must do: a third of you, who come in on the Sabbath, shall be keepers of the watch of the king’s house;

paite: Seh thum suah seh khat bel Sur kulh kongpi ah na om ding uh. Huchibang in na veng ding ua, asiat ding na dal ding uhi.
english: a third of you shall be at the gate Sur; and a third of you at the gate behind the guard. So you shall keep the watch of the house, and be a barrier.

paite: Na lak ua pawl nih, Sabbath ni a pai dingte'n kumpipa kiang ah TOUPA' inn na veng ding uhi.
english: The two companies of you, even all who go out on the Sabbath, shall keep the watch of Yahweh’s house around the king.

paite: Michih in galvan tawi in kumpipa na umsuak ding ua; kuapeuh huai huamsung a hong lut na thah zel ding uh ahi. Huchi in kumpipa alut leh apawt zui vialvial un," chi in thu apia hi.
english: You shall surround the king, every man with his weapons in his hand; and he who comes within the ranks, let him be slain. Be with the king when he goes out, and when he comes in.”

paite: Sepaih za heutute'n siampu Jehoiada thupiak bangbang in ahih ua; amau heutu chiat Sabbath ni a hong dingte leh Sabbath ni a pai dingte api ua, siampu Jehoiada kiang ah ahoh uhi.
english: The captains over hundreds did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded; and they each took his men, those who were to come in on the Sabbath with those who were to go out on the Sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.

paite: Siampu in sepaih za heutute TOUPA' inn a om, kumpipa David teipite leh lumte apia hi.
english: The priest delivered to the captains over hundreds the spears and shields that had been King David’s, which were in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Galvil sepaihte'n galvan tawi chiat in, Tempul sik taklam a kipan veilam tan in maitam leh inn zul ah kumpipa a ding in umkhum uhi.
english: The guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, along by the altar and the house, around the king.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa tapa ahon pikhia a, lallukhu akhusak hi. Theihsakna thu apia a; kumpipa in abawl ua, sathau anilh ua; akhut uh abeng ua, "Pathian in kumpipa hondam hen,” achi uhi.
english: Then he brought out the king’s son, and put the crown on him, and gave him the covenant; and they made him king and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, “Long live the king!”

paite: Galvilmi leh mipite husa Athaliah in ana zak in, TOUPA' inn ah mipite lak ah ava hoh hi.
english: When Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into Yahweh’s house;

paite: A-en a, ngai in, kumpipa dan dungzui in khuam zul ah ana dingh a, sepaih heutute leh pengkul mut mite bel kumpipa kiangnai ah adingh uhi. Huai gam mite'n nuam asa mahmah ua, pengkul amut uh. Huchi in Athaliah in apuante abotkek a, "Guksawmna! Guksawmna ahita ve!" chi in akikou hi.
english: and she looked, and behold, the king stood by the pillar, as the tradition was, with the captains and the trumpets by the king; and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew trumpets. Then Athaliah tore her clothes and cried, “Treason! Treason!”

paite: Siampu Jehoiada in sepaihte tung a heutute dia aseh sepaih za heutute thu apia a, akiang uah, "Sepaihte kikal ah pawtsak in. Kuapeuh amah zui namsau a satlup ding ahi," achi hi. Siampu in, "TOUPA' inn a thah ding ahi kei," ana chita ngal a.
english: Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, “Bring her out between the ranks. Kill anyone who follows her with the sword.” For the priest said, “Don’t let her be slain in Yahweh’s house.”

paite: Huchi in aman ua; kumpipa' inn a sakolte lutna lampi a pai in, huai ah athatta uh.
english: So they seized her; and she went by the way of the horses’ entry to the king’s house, and she was slain there.

paite: Jehoiada in TOUPA leh kumpipa leh mipite kikal leh kumpipa leh mipite kikal ah TOUPA mite ahihna ding un thukhun abawl hi.
english: Jehoiada made a covenant between Yahweh and the king and the people, that they should be Yahweh’s people; also between the king and the people.

paite: Huai gammi tengteng Baal inn ah ahoh ua, ahihchim ua; amaitamte leh alimte ahihnen dimdem ua, Baal siampu Mattan leng maitam bul ah athat uh. Huchi in siampu in TOUPA' inn vengmi heutute asepta hi.
english: All the people of the land went to the house of Baal, and broke it down. They broke his altars and his images in pieces thoroughly, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. The priest appointed officers over Yahweh’s house.

paite: Ama'n sepaih za heutute, veng mite, galvil sepaihte leh huai gam a mi tengteng api a, TOUPA' inn a pan kumpipa apikhia ua, galvil mite kongpi tawn in kumpipa' inn a lut in, kumpipa laltutphah ah atuta hi.
english: He took the captains over hundreds, and the Carites, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from Yahweh’s house, and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king’s house. He sat on the throne of the kings.

paite: Huchi in huai gam a mi tengteng akipak ua, khopi buai lou in a-omta hi; Athaliah namsau in kumpipa' inn ah athat uhi.
english: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword at the king’s house.

paite: Joash in vai ahawm pat lai in kum sagih a upa ahi.
english: Jehoash was seven years old when he began to reign.

paite: Jehu kum sagih alal kum in Joash alal pan hi. Jerusalem ah kum sawmli alal a; anu min Zibiah ahi a, Beer-sheba khomi ahi.
english: Jehoash began to reign in the seventh year of Jehu, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah of Beersheba.

paite: Siampu Jehoiada in Joash asinsak sung teng TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
english: Jehoash did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes all his days in which Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

paite: Himahleh mun sang teng hihsiat vek ahi tuan kei a; mun sangte ah mite kithoih lailai in gimlim ahal nilouh lai uhi.
english: However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

paite: Joash in siampute kiang ah, "TOUPA inn a laklut thilzek tatna sum teng simsate lak a pai peuhmahte ahinna uh tatna sumte, kuapeuh in TOUPA inn a laklut aphal uh sum tengtengte,
english: Jehoash said to the priests, “All the money of the holy things that is brought into Yahweh’s house, in current money, the money of the people for whom each man is evaluated, and all the money that it comes into any man’s heart to bring into Yahweh’s house,

paite: siampute'n ameltheihte ua pan la uhenla; inn sia, asiatna na bawl uhen," achi hi.
english: let the priests take it to them, each man from his donor; and they shall repair the damage to the house, wherever any damage is found.”

paite: Himahleh hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa Joash bel kum sawmnih-le-thum alal nung in leng siampute'n inn sia abawl kei lailai uhi.
english: But it was so, that in the twenty-third year of King Jehoash the priests had not repaired the damage to the house.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Joash in siampu Jehoiada leh siampu dangte asam a, akiang uah, "Bangziak a inn siatna bawl lou na hi ua? Tu'n zaw na sumkemte a pan dangka la nawn kei unla, inn sia bawlna ding in pekhe zawta un," achi hi.
english: Then King Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and for the other priests, and said to them, “Why aren’t you repairing the damage to the house? Now therefore take no more money from your treasurers, but deliver it for repair of the damage to the house.”

paite: Siampute'n mite a pan dangka lak nawn louh leh inn siatna puahphat louh pha asa uhi.
english: The priests consented that they should take no more money from the people, and not repair the damage to the house.

paite: Himahleh siampu Jehoiada in bawm ala a, asin gei avutvang a, TOUPA inn lutna taklam pang, maitam kiang ah atung hi. Huai bawm ah TOUPA inn a dangka tawilut tengteng kongkhak vengmi siampute'n ana koih zel uh.
english: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into Yahweh’s house; and the priests who kept the threshold put all the money that was brought into Yahweh’s house into it.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, bawm ah dangka atamta chih atheih un, TOUPA' inn ah kumpipa laigelhmi leh siampu lianpen ava hoh ua, sumte asim ua ipte ah athun khe zel uhi.
english: When they saw that there was much money in the chest, the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put it in bags and counted the money that was found in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Adangka sim uh nasem mite, TOUPA inn lam mite tung a heutute khut ah apekhia ua; amau TOUPA' inn lam mite leh khutsiam mite;
english: They gave the money that was weighed out into the hands of those who did the work, who had the oversight of Yahweh’s house; and they paid it out to the carpenters and the builders who worked on Yahweh’s house,

paite: suangsek mite leh suang laikhe mite kiang ah, TOUPA inn siatna bawlna ding sing leh suangte leh inn bawlna, akhawkna peuh a zat ding in apekhia uhi.
english: and to the masons and the stone cutters, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the damage to Yahweh’s house, and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA insung a dangka ahon tawi un, TOUPA' inn a ding dangkasik noute, khawnvak puantehnate, maiphiat kuangte, pengkulte, dangka-eng tui-um belsuante, dangkasik tui-um belsuante abawl kei uhi.
english: But there were not made for Yahweh’s house cups of silver, snuffers, basins, trumpets, any vessels of gold or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into Yahweh’s house;

paite: Nasem mite ape zel ua, TOUPA' inn bawlna in azang uhi.
english: for they gave that to those who did the work, and repaired Yahweh’s house with it.

paite: Nasem mite piak dia dangka akepsak mite uh leng a-etzui pih tuan kei uh. Amau ginomtak in ahih zel uhi.
english: Moreover they didn’t demand an accounting from the men into whose hand they delivered the money to give to those who did the work; for they dealt faithfully.

paite: Mohna thoihna dia thillat dangka leh khelhna thoihna dia thillat dangkate bel TOUPA' inn ah alalut kei ua; siampute tantuam ahi.
english: The money for the trespass offerings and the money for the sin offerings was not brought into Yahweh’s house. It was the priests’.

paite: Huchi in Siria kumpipa Hazael in Gath khua ava sual a, ala a; Hazael in Jerusalem a hoh atum hi.
english: Then Hazael king of Syria went up and fought against Gath, and took it; and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

paite: Judah kumpipa Joash in Judah kumpipa apu Jehoshaphat, Jehoram leh Ahaziah in ana latsa thilzek tengteng leh amah thilzekte leh TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn a gou koihkhawmna a dangka-eng om tengteng ala vek a, Siria kumpipa Hazael akhak a; huchi in Jerusalem apawtsanta hi.
english: Jehoash king of Judah took all the holy things that Jehoshaphat and Jehoram and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own holy things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of Yahweh’s house, and of the king’s house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria; and he went away from Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in Joash tanchin dangte, athilhihte tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Asikhate athou ua, aguk in asim sawm ua, Joash bel Silla zot sukna lampi Millo inn ah asual ua; athatta uhi.
english: His servants arose and made a conspiracy, and struck Joash at the house of Millo, on the way that goes down to Silla.

paite: Amah Simeath tapa Jozakar leh Shomer tapa Jehozabadte'n athat ua; huchi in api-le-pute lak ah David khopi ah avui ua; asik in atapa Amaziah ahong lalta hi.
english: For Jozacar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city; and Amaziah his son reigned in his place.

paite: Judah Kumpipa Ahaziah tapa Joash kum sawmnih-le-thum alal kum in Jehu tapa Jehoahaz Israelte tung ah Samaria ah alal pan a, kum sawm-le-sagih alal hi.
english: In the twenty-third year of Joash the son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria for seventeen years.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih a, Israelte thil hihkhialsak a, ahih Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhnate ama'n leng ahih samta a, apaisan nawn kei.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from it.

paite: Israelte tung ah TOUPA aheh mahmah a, huchi in Siria kumpipa Hazael khut leh Hazael tapa Ben-hadad khut ah adamsung teng ape vekta hi.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael, continually.

paite: Jehoahaz in TOUPA kiang ah nget chihtak in angen a, TOUPA'N athu angaihkhiaksak a; Israel simmoh a om a, Siria kumpipa'n amau asimmohdan lah amu kilkel ngal a.
english: Jehoahaz begged Yahweh, and Yahweh listened to him; for he saw the oppression of Israel, how the king of Syria oppressed them.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Israelte hondampa apia a, huchi in Siriate nuai a pan apawtkhia uh. Israel suante tuma lam bang in amau inn ah a-om kinken uhi.
english: (Yahweh gave Israel a savior, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians; and the children of Israel lived in their tents as before.

paite: Himahleh Israelte thil ana hihkhialsak a Jeroboam inkote khelhnate apaisan kei ua, ahih lailai zosop ua; Samaria ah Asherah song leng a-om lailai hi.
english: Nevertheless they didn’t depart from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, with which he made Israel to sin, but walked in them; and the Asherah also remained in Samaria.)

paite: Jehoahaz in amite lak a sakol tungtuangmi sawmnga, kangtalai sawm leh sepaih singkhat chih louh aneih aphalsak ngal kei a; Siria kumpipa'n ahihmang vek a, leivui chilzan bang in abawl hi.
english: For he didn’t leave to Jehoahaz of the people any more than fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria destroyed them and made them like the dust in threshing.

paite: Huchi in Jehoahaz tanchin dangte, athilhih tengtengte, athilhihtheihdante Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Hichi in Jehoahaz bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; Samaria ah avui ua; asik in atapa Jehoash alalta hi.
english: Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria; and Joash his son reigned in his place.

paite: Judah kumpipa Joash kum sawmthum-le-sagih alal kum in Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash Israelte tung ah Samaria ah alal pan a, kum sawm-le-guk alal hi.
english: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz began to reign over Israel in Samaria for sixteen years.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou pipi ana hih a; Israelte thil hihkhialsak a ahih Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhna tengteng apaisan kei a, aching lailai zosop hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight. He didn’t depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin; but he walked in them.

paite: Huchi in Jehoash tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng, Judah kumpipa Amaziah toh akisual lai ua athilhihtheihdante Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might with which he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Huchi in Jehoash api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; Jeroboam alaltutphah ah atu a, Jehoas bel Samaria ah Israel kumpipate lak ah avui uhi.
english: Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat on his throne. Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

paite: Elisha achi ana a, sihpih ding khop chinatna ahi. Huchi in akiang ah Israel kumpipa Jehoash ahohsuk a, akah a, "Aw, ka pa, ka pa, Israelte kangtalai leh sakol tungtuang mite," achi hi.
english: Now Elisha became sick with the illness of which he died; and Joash the king of Israel came down to him, and wept over him, and said, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!”

paite: Elisha in akiang ah, "Thalpeu leh thaltangte hon la in," achi a; ama'n thalpeu leh thaltangte ahon la hi.
english: Elisha said to him, “Take bow and arrows;” and he took bow and arrows for himself.

paite: Israelte kumpipa kiang ah, "Thalpeuh tung ah na khut nga in," achi hi. Huchi in akhut anga a; Elisha in kumpipa khut tung ah akhut anga hi.
english: He said to the king of Israel, “Put your hand on the bow;” and he put his hand on it. Elisha laid his hands on the king’s hands.

paite: Ama'n, "Suahlam tohlet hong in," achi hi. Huchi in ahong hi. Elisha in, "Kap in," achi a, akap hi. Ama'n, "TOUPA hotkhiakna thaltang leh Siria a pan hotkhiakna thaltang; Aphek ah na zoh tanpha in Siriate na sual ding hi,” achi hi.
english: He said, “Open the window eastward;” and he opened it. Then Elisha said, “Shoot!” and he shot. He said, “Yahweh’s arrow of victory, even the arrow of victory over Syria; for you will strike the Syrians in Aphek until you have consumed them.”

paite: "Thaltangte hon la in," achi a, Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "Huai in leitual sun dih," achi a; huchi in thumvei asun a, atawpta hi.
english: He said, “Take the arrows;” and he took them. He said to the king of Israel, “Strike the ground;” and he struck three times, and stopped.

paite: Huchi in Pathian mipa atung ah aheh a, "Ngavei ahihkeileh gukvei na sut ding ei ve; huchi in Siriate mangthang vek khop in na zou ding. Himahleh Siriate thumvei kia zou ding na hita ve," achi hi.
english: The man of God was angry with him, and said, “You should have struck five or six times. Then you would have struck Syria until you had consumed it, but now you will strike Syria just three times.”

paite: Huchi in Elisha asi a, avui uh. Kum hong kivei in, Moab pawlte'n agam uh ahong dou uhi.
english: Elisha died, and they buried him. Now the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.

paite: Mi khat avui laitak un hichi ahong hi a, ngai in, mi pawl khat amu uhi. Huchi in huai mi Elisha han sung ah akhe mawk ua; aluang in Elisha guhte asukkhaktak in, ahong hing nawn a, adingtouta hi.
english: As they were burying a man, behold, they saw a band of raiders; and they threw the man into Elisha’s tomb. As soon as the man touched Elisha’s bones, he revived, and stood up on his feet.

paite: Siria kumpipa Hazael in Jehoahaz damsung teng in Israelte anuaisiah hi.
english: Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a thu akhun ziak in amau ahehpih a, alainat a, azahtak a, amau ahihmang nuam kei a, akiang a pan apaikhe kei hi.
english: But Yahweh was gracious to them, and had compassion on them, and favored them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them and he didn’t cast them from his presence as yet.

paite: Siria kumpipa Hazael asi a; asik in atapa Ben-hadad alal hi.
english: Hazael king of Syria died; and Benhadad his son reigned in his place.

paite: Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash in Hazael tapa Ben-hadad in apa Jehoahaz adou a, khua alaksakte asut nawn a, Joash in thumvei azou a, Israel gam khuate alakik nawn hi.
english: Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Joash struck him three times, and recovered the cities of Israel.

paite: Israel kumpipa Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash kum nih alal kum in Judah kumpipa Joash tapa Amaziah alal pan hi.
english: In the second year of Joash, son of Joahaz, king of Israel, Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah began to reign.

paite: Alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-kua alal a; anu min Jehoadan, Jerusalem mi ahi.
english: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddin of Jerusalem.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil dik ahih a, himahleh apu David zaw apha kei; apa Joash thilhih bang ahih sam hi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, yet not like David his father. He did according to all that Joash his father had done.

paite: Mun sangte lakmang ahi tuan kei a, mun sangte ah mite akithoih lai ua gimlim ahal lai uhi.
english: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

paite: Akhut a lalgam ahong kiptak in hichi ahong hi a, apa, kumpipa thatmi ama sikhate athat hi.
english: As soon as the kingdom was established in his hand, he killed his servants who had slain the king his father,

paite: Himahleh huai tualthat mite tate athat kei hi. Mosi Dan Bu a, "Tate ziak in pate hihlup ding ahi kei a, pate ziak in leng tate hihlup ding ahi sam kei, michih amau khelhna ziak in asi ding uh," chi a TOUPA thupiak gelh ahih bang in.
english: but the children of the murderers he didn’t put to death, according to that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, as Yahweh commanded, saying, “The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.”

paite: Edomte chi phaizang ah singkhat athat a, Selah khua asual a, ala a, amin ding in Joktheel asa a, tuni tan in hiai ahi lai hi.
english: He killed ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and took Sela by war, and called its name Joktheel, to this day.

paite: Huchi in Amaziah in Israel kumpipa Jehu tapa Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash kiang ah, hong kuan in, kimaituah ni, chi in mi asawl hi.
english: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, “Come, let’s look one another in the face.”

paite: Israel kumpipa Jehoash in Judah kumpipa Amaziah kiang ah, "Lebanon tang a ling in Lebanon tang a sidar sing kiang ah, na tanu ka tapa zi ding in neisak dih ve, chi in athukhak a; Lebanon tang a gamsa ahong pai a, huai ling ahong tuanpuk hi.
english: Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, “The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son as wife.’ Then a wild animal that was in Lebanon passed by, and trampled down the thistle.

paite: Nang Edomte na zou ngei a, na lungtang ahong kisathei hi; na kisaktheihna ompih maimai in; nang leh Judah nangawn tan a siatna, nang a dia hoih lou ding thil bang ding a khoihkhe ding na hia?" chi in adawng hi.
english: You have indeed struck Edom, and your heart has lifted you up. Enjoy the glory of it, and stay at home; for why should you meddle to your harm, that you fall, even you, and Judah with you?”

paite: Himahleh Amaziah in ana ngaikhe nuam kei a; huchi in Israel kumpipa Jehoash va hohtou in ava douta hi. Judah kumpipa Amaziah toh Judah gam Beth-shemesh ah ava kimaituahta uhi.
english: But Amaziah would not listen. So Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.

paite: Judah bel Israelte ma ah azahlakta a; michih amau inn chiat ah ataikekta uh.
english: Judah was defeated by Israel; and each man fled to his tent.

paite: Israel kumpipa Jehoash in Judah kumpipa Ahaziah tapa Joash tapa Amaziah Beth-shemesh ah aman a, Jerusalem ah apaipih a, Jerusalem kulh, Ephraim kongpi a pan kulh ning kongpi pha in tong zali ahihchim hi.
english: Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh and came to Jerusalem, then broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

paite: TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn a gou koihkhawmna a dangka-eng leh dangka leh tui-um belsuan om tengteng ala a, thuchiam tangtunna dia mat a om mite toh, huchi in Samaria kholam ah apai nawnta hi.
english: He took all the gold and silver and all the vessels that were found in Yahweh’s house and in the treasures of the king’s house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.

paite: Huchi in Jehoash thilhih tanchin dangte, athilhihtheihdante, Judah kumpipa Amaziah adou thute Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Huchi in Jehoash api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, Samaria ah Israel kumpipate lak ah avui ua; asik in atapa Jeroboam alalta hi.
english: Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his place.

paite: Judah kumpipa Joash tapa Amaziah Israel kumpipa Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash sih nung in kum sawm-le- nga adam lai hi.
english: Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, fifteen years.

paite: Huchi in Amaziah tanchin dangte Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Jerusalem ah amah aguksawm ua; huchi in Lakish ah mi adelhsak ua, huai ah athatta uhi.
english: They made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.

paite: Aluang sakol in apaipih ua, api-le-pute lak ah David khopi Jerusalem ah avui uhi.
english: They brought him on horses, and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in David’s city.

paite: Judah mi tengteng in kum sawm leh kum guk a upa, Azariah api ua, apa Amaziah sik in kumpipa in abawl uhi.
english: All the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.

paite: Ama'n Elath khua abawlhoih nawn in Judah gam ah apangsak nawn a; huai nung in kumpipa api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta hi.
english: He built Elath and restored it to Judah. After that the king slept with his fathers.

paite: Judah kumpipa Joash tapa Amaziah kum sawm-le-nga alal kum in Israel kumpipa Jehoash tapa Jeroboam Samaria ah alal pan a, kum sawmli-le-khat alal hi.
english: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah, Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria for forty-one years.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; Israelte thil ahihkhialsak a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhna tengteng apaisan kei hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight. He didn’t depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

paite: TOUPA, Israelte Pathian in asikha, Gath hepher mi Amittai tapa zawlnei Jonah zang a athugen bang in, Hamath lutna a pan Arabah Tuipi pha in Israel gam ah apangsak nawn hi.
english: He restored the border of Israel from the entrance of Hamath to the sea of the Arabah, according to Yahweh, the God of Israel’s word, which he spoke by his servant Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet, who was from Gath Hepher.

paite: TOUPA'N Israelte haksatna a thupi mahmah chih lah athei ngal a; sal hi in noplen hitaleh athuakdan uh akibang a; Israelte panpih ding kuamah om sam kei hi.
english: For Yahweh saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter for all, slave and free; and there was no helper for Israel.

paite: TOUPA'N Israel min van nuai ah achimitsak zenzen ding chih ahihleh agen kei him a; Jehoash tapa Jeroboam zang in ahondam zawta hi.
english: Yahweh didn’t say that he would blot out the name of Israel from under the sky; but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.

paite: Huchi in Jeroboam tanchin dangte, athilhih tengtengte, athilhihtheihdante, agaldou thute, tuma lam in Judah gam tan hi gige Damaskas leh Hamath khua Israelte a dia ana laksak nawn thute Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he fought, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which had belonged to Judah, for Israel, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Jeroboam api leh pu, Israel kumpipate kiang ah a-ihmu samta a; huchi in atapa Zakariah asik in alalta hi.
english: Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zechariah his son reigned in his place.

paite: Israel kumpipa Jeroboam kum sawmnih-le-sagih alal kum in Judah kumpipa Amaziah alal pan hi.
english: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah began to reign.

paite: Alal pat tung in kum sawm-le-guk a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga-le-nih alal a; anu min Jekoliah, Jerusalem mi ahi.
english: He was sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.

paite: Apa Amaziah thilhih bangbang hih sam in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.

paite: Himahleh mun sangte lakmang ahi tuan kei. Mun sangte ah mite kithoih lailai in, gimlim ahal lai uhi.
english: However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

paite: TOUPA'N kumpipa agawt a, huchi in asih ni pha in aphak a, inn tuam ah atengta hi. Kumpipa tapa Jotham in agam ua mite vai hawmsak in inkuan tung a heutu in a-om hi.
english: Yahweh struck the king, so that he was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house. Jotham, the king’s son, was over the household, judging the people of the land.

paite: Huchi in Azariah tanchin dangte athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Azariah bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; api-le-pute lak ah David khopi ah avui ua; huchi in asik in atapa Jotham alalta hi.
english: Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city; and Jotham his son reigned in his place.

paite: Judah kumpipa Azariah kum sawmthum-le-giat alal kum in Jeroboam tapa Zakariah Israelte tung ah Samaria ah kha guk alal hi.
english: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah the son of Jeroboam reigned over Israel in Samaria six months.

paite: Apute hih mah bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; Israelte thil ahihkhialsak Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhnate apaisan kei hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as his fathers had done. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

paite: Jabesh tapa Shallum in aguk in thah asawm a, mipite ma ah asual a, athat a, asik in alalta hi.
english: Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and struck him before the people and killed him, and reigned in his place.

paite: Huchi in Zakariah tanchin dangte bel ngai dih, Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah atuang hi.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Zechariah, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

paite: Huai bel ToUPA'N Jehu kiang a, "Na tapate suan lina tan in Israelte laltutphah ah atu ding uh," chih thu agen hi. Huchi in huai bang geih ahong hita hi.
english: This was Yahweh’s word which he spoke to Jehu, saying, “Your sons to the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.” So it came to pass.

paite: Judah kumpipa Uzziah kum sawmthum-le-kua alal kum in Jabesh tapa Shallum alal pan a; Samaria ah kha khat sung alal hi.
english: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah, and he reigned for a month in Samaria.

paite: Tirzah a pan Gadi tapa Menahem ahohtou a, Samaria ah ahoh a, Samaria ah Jabesh tapa Shallum asual a, athat a, asik in alalta hi.
english: Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, came to Samaria, struck Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, killed him, and reigned in his place.

paite: Huchi in Shallum tanchin dangte, aguksawmna thute ngai dih, Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah atuang hi.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

paite: Huchi in Menahem in Tirzah a pan Tiphsah leh asung a om tengteng leh agamte asual a; amah a dia akihon louh ziak un asual a; huai ah naupai lai numei tengteng apikkek hi.
english: Then Menahem attacked Tiphsah and all who were in it and its border areas, from Tirzah. He attacked it because they didn’t open their gates to him, and he ripped up all their women who were with child.

paite: Judah kumpipa Azariah kum sawmthum-le-kua alal kum in Gadi tapa Menahem Israelte tung ah alal pan a, Samaria ah kum sawm alal hi.
english: In the thirty ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem the son of Gadi began to reign over Israel for ten years in Samaria.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; Israelte thil hihkhialsak Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhna in adamsung apaisan kei hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight. He didn’t depart all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

paite: Assuria kumpipa Pul in agam ahong sual a; gam aneihkippih theihna ding in Menahem in Pul dangka talent sangkhat apia hi.
english: Pul the king of Assyria came against the land, and Menahem gave Pul one thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.

paite: Menahem in Assuria kumpipa piak ding in Israel mi nei zou tengteng lak ah dangka shekel sawmnga chiat akhon a; huchi in Assuria kumpipa apai nawn a, huai gam ah ataam nilouh kei hi.
english: Menahem exacted the money from Israel, even from all the mighty men of wealth, from each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and didn’t stay there in the land.

paite: Menahem tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Huchi in Menahem api-le-pute kiang ah ihmuta a; asik in atapa Pekahiah alal hi.
english: Menahem slept with his fathers, and Pekahiah his son reigned in his place.

paite: Judah kumpipa Azariah kum sawmnga alal kum in Israelte tung ah Samaria ah Menahem tapa Pekahiah alal pan a, kum nih alal hi.
english: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria for two years.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; Israelte thil hihkhialsak, Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhnate apaisan kei hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

paite: Asepaih heutu Remaliah tapa Pekah in amah aguksawm a, Samaria a kumpipa' inn a kulh ah Argob toh, Arieh toh athatta a; akiang ah Gilead mi sawmnga toh; huchi in Pekahiah athat a, asik in alalta hi.
english: Pekah the son of Remaliah, his captain, conspired against him and attacked him in Samaria, in the fortress of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh; and with him were fifty men of the Gileadites. He killed him, and reigned in his place.

paite: Huchi in Pekahiah tanchin dangte, athilhih tengtengte, ngai dih, Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah atuang hi.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

paite: Judah kumpipa Azariah kum sawmnga-le-nih alal kum in Remaliah tapa Pekah Israelte tung ah Samaria ah alal pan a, kum sawmnih alal hi.
english: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria for twenty years.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; Israelte thil hihkhialsak, Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhnate apaisan kei.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

paite: Israel kumpipa Pekah lal lai in Assuria kumpipa Tiglath-pileser in Ijon, Abel-beth-maakah, Janoah, Kadesh, Hazor, Gilead leh Galili gamte leh Naphtali gam tengteng ala a, Assuria gam ah sal in api hi.
english: In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali; and he carried them captive to Assyria.

paite: Elah tapa Hoshea in Remaliah tapa Pekah aguksawm a, asual a, athat a, Uzziah tapa Jotham kum sawmnih alal kum in asik in alalta hi.
english: Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, attacked him, killed him, and reigned in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.

paite: Huchi in Pekah tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng, ngai dih, Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah atuang hi.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

paite: Israel kumpipa Remaliah tapa Pekah kum nih alal kum in Judah kumpipa Uzziah tapa Jotham alal pan hi.
english: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel, Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah began to reign.

paite: Alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-guk alal a; anu min Jerusha, Zadok tanu ahi.
english: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerusha the daughter of Zadok.

paite: Apa Uzziah thilhih bangbang hih sam in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes. He did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.

paite: Himahleh mun sangte hihmang ahi tuan kei; mun sangte ah mite'n kithoih in, gimlim ahal lai uhi. TOUPA' inn kongpi saknungzaw abawlhoih hi.
english: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places. He built the upper gate of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huchi in Jotham tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Huai lai in Siria kumpipa Rezin leh Remulia tapa Pekah Judate sual ding in TOUPA'N asawl pan hi.
english: In those days, Yahweh began to send Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah against Judah.

paite: Jotham api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, api-pute lak ah apu David khopi ah avui ua; asik in atapa Ahaz alalta hi.
english: Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.

paite: Remaliah tapa Pekah kum sawm-le-sagih alal kum in Judah kumpipa Jotham tapa Ahaz alal pan hi.
english: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah, Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

paite: Ahaz alal pat tung in kum sawmnih a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-guk alal hi. Apu David bang in TOUPA a Pathian mitmuh in thil hoih ahih sam kei hi.
english: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn’t do that which was right in Yahweh his God’s eyes, like David his father.

paite: Israel kumpipate tot lampi atawn sam a, ahi, TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a adelhkhiaksa namte thilkihhuaitak ahih bang un atapa mei ah alutsuaksak hi.
english: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and even made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh cast out from before the children of Israel.

paite: Mun sangte leh mualte tung ah leh sing hing chih nuai ah kithoih in gimlim ahal hi.
english: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.

paite: Huchi in Siria kumpipa Rezin leh Israel kumpipa Remaliah tapa Pekah, Jerusalem dou ding in akuantou ua; Ahaz ava um ua, himahleh azou thei kei uhi.
english: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to wage war. They besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.

paite: Huai lai in Siria kumpipa Rezin in Elath khua Siria gam ding in ala nawn a, Elath a pan Judate adelhkhia a; huchi in Siriate'n Elath khua ava luah ua, tuni tan in ateng lai uh.
english: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drove the Jews from Elath; and the Syrians came to Elath, and live there to this day.

paite: Huchi in Ahaz in Assuria kumpipa Tiglath-pileser kiang ah, "Na sikha leh na tapa ka hi kei a hia; kei hong dou dia hong kuan, Siria kumpipa khut a pan leh Israel kumpipa khut a pan hon hunkhe dih ve," chi in mi asawl hi.
english: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria and out of the hand of the king of Israel, who rise up against me.”

paite: Ahaziah in TOUPA' inn a dangka leh dangka-eng om peuhmah leh kumpipa' inn a gou koihkhawmte ala a, Assuria kumpipa kiang ah thilpiak ding in akhak hi.
english: Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in Yahweh’s house, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.

paite: Assuria kumpipa'n athugen ana pom a; huchi in Assuria kumpipa'n Damaskas khua ava dou a, ala a, Kir gam ah sal in huai a mite api a, Rezin athat hi.
english: The king of Assyria listened to him; and the king of Assyria went up against Damascus and took it, and carried its people captive to Kir, and killed Rezin.

paite: Kumpipa Ahaz bel Assuria kumpipa Tiglath-pileser houpih ding in Damaskas ah ahoh a, Damaskas ah maitam ava mu a, huchi in kumpipa Ahaz in huai maitam lim leh akibawldan bang geih etton ding in siampu Urijah kiang ah akhak hi.
english: King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, and saw the altar that was at Damascus; and King Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest a drawing of the altar and plans to build it.

paite: Siampu Urijah in maitam abawl a; kumpipa Ahaziah in Damaskas a pan akhak bang geih in siampu Urijah in Damaskas a pan a Ahaz ahong pai nawn in ana bawl khin vekta hi.
english: Urijah the priest built an altar. According to all that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus, so Urijah the priest made it for the coming of King Ahaz from Damascus.

paite: Damaskas a pan kumpipa ahong tun in maitam amu a; kumpipa'n maitam anaih a, atung ah thillatte alan hi.
english: When the king had come from Damascus, the king saw the altar; and the king came near to the altar, and offered on it.

paite: Maitam ah ahalmang thillat hal in tangbuang thillat alan a, dawn thillat asung a, alemna thillatte sisan atheh hi.
english: He burned his burnt offering and his meal offering, poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings on the altar.

paite: TOUPA ma a dal maitam ala a, maitam leh TOUPA' inn kikal a, inn mazawn a pan alasuan a, amaitam mallam pang ah akoih hi.
english: The bronze altar, which was before Yahweh, he brought from the front of the house, from between his altar and Yahweh’s house, and put it on the north side of his altar.

paite: Kumpipa Ahaz in, maitam lianpi tung ah zinglam halmang thillat, nitaklam tangbuang thillat, halmang thillat, tangbuang thillat, i gam ua mipi tengteng halmang thillat, tangbuang thillat leh dawn thillat toh hal in lan inla; atung ah halmang thillat sisan tengteng leh kithoihna sisan tengteng theh in; dal maitam bel kei thudotna ding ahi, chi in siampu Urijah thu apia hi.
english: King Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, “On the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, the evening meal offering, the king’s burnt offering and his meal offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, their meal offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle on it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice; but the bronze altar will be for me to inquire by.”

paite: Huchi in siampu Urijah in kumpipa Ahaz thupiak bangbang in ahihta hi.
english: Urijah the priest did so, according to all that King Ahaz commanded.

paite: Kumpipa Ahaz in tunna kuakte a-atkhia a, kisilna bel akoihkhia a; atunna dal bawngtal a pan lakhia in suanglep tung ah atung hi.
english: King Ahaz cut off the panels of the bases, and removed the basin from off them, and took down the sea from off the bronze oxen that were under it, and put it on a pavement of stone.

paite: Sabbath ni a dia atung nei lampi abawl uleh inn polam a kumpipa lutna TOUPA' inn a pan Siria kumpipa a ding in akheng hi.
english: He removed the covered way for the Sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s outer entrance to Yahweh’s house, because of the king of Assyria.

paite: Huchi in Ahaz thilhih tanchin dangte Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Huchi in Ahaz api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, api-le-pute lak ah David khopi ah avui ua; asik in atapa Hezekiah alalta hi.
english: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.

paite: Judah Kumpipa Ahaz akum sawm-le-nihna alal kum in Elah tapa Hoshea Israelte tung ah Samaria ah alal pan a, kum kua alal hi.
english: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea the son of Elah began to reign in Samaria over Israel for nine years.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih loutak ahih a, himahleh ama a Israel kumpipate bang zen in zaw ahih kei.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, yet not as the kings of Israel who were before him.

paite: Assuria kumpipa Salmaneser in ava dou a, huchi in Hoshea asikha ahong hi a, siah apia hi.
english: Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against him; and Hoshea became his servant, and brought him tribute.

paite: Assuria kumpipa'n, Aigupta kumpipa So kiang a mi sawl in Hoshea thuguk sawm ana theikhia a; a kumchin a, apiak zel bang in leng Assuria kumpipa kiang ah siah ape kei behlap lai a; huaiziak in Assuria kumpipa'n suangkul ah hensa in akhumta hi.
english: The king of Assyria discovered a conspiracy in Hoshea; for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and offered no tribute to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year. Therefore the king of Assyria seized him, and bound him in prison.

paite: Huchi in Assuria kumpipa'n gam tengteng atuansuak vek a, Samaria ah ahohtou a, kum thum a-umkhum hi.
english: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.

paite: Hoshea kum kua alal kum in Assuria kumpipa'n Samaria ala a, Assuria gam ah Israelte api a, Halah, Habor a Gozan lui leh Mediate khuate ah akoih hi.
english: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria and carried Israel away to Assyria, and placed them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

paite: Huchibang a, ana omna uh bel Israel suante'n Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh khut nuai a pan, Aigupta gam a pan a pikhepa TOUPA a Pathian uh tung a thil ahihkhelh ua, pathian dangte alau ziak uh ahi.
english: It was so because the children of Israel had sinned against Yahweh their God, who brought them up out of the land of Egypt from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,

paite: TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a, ana delhkhiaksa namte thuzoh leh Israel kumpipate dan thusehte azuih zawk ziak uh leng ahi.
english: and walked in the statutes of the nations whom Yahweh cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they made.

paite: Israel suante'n TOUPA a Pathian uh tung ah thil hoih loutak aguk in ahih uhi. Akho teng uah galvil mite insang a pan kulh nei khopite pha in mun sangte abawl uhi.
english: The children of Israel secretly did things that were not right against Yahweh their God; and they built high places for themselves in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city;

paite: Mual sang teng ah pathian limte leh sing hing teng nuai ah suangphuhte phut in Asherah songte abawl uhi.
english: and they set up for themselves pillars and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree;

paite: Huai mun sang tengteng ah TOUPA'N ama ua adelhmangsa namte hih bang in gimlim ahal ua; TOUPA hehsak ding in thil gilou ahih lai uhi.
english: and there they burned incense in all the high places, as the nations whom Yahweh carried away before them did; and they did wicked things to provoke Yahweh to anger;

paite: TOUPA'N akiang uah, "Hichibang hih kei un," achih milimte nna leng asem uhi.
english: and they served idols, of which Yahweh had said to them, “You shall not do this thing.”

paite: TOUPA'N, dan zuih ding na pi-le-pute uh ka piakleh ka sikha zawlneite zang a ka hon theihsak bang zel in, "Na omdan gilou uh lehngatsan unla, ka thupiakte leh ka dan thusehte zui un," chi in Israelte leh Judah zawlnei chih leh mu thei michih zang in atheisak hi.
english: Yet Yahweh testified to Israel and to Judah, by every prophet and every seer, saying, “Turn from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.”

paite: Huchi pipi in leng azui nuam kei ua, api-le-pute un TOUPA a Pathian uh gingta nuam lou a, angawng uh akhauhsak mah bang un, angawng uh akhauhsak uhi.
english: Notwithstanding, they would not listen, but hardened their neck like the neck of their fathers who didn’t believe in Yahweh their God.

paite: Adan thusehte, api-le-pute uh toh athukhun, akiang ua athu theihsakte anial ua; thil gina lou azui ua, bangmah lou phet ahong hita uh. Atungthu ua TOUPA'N, amau bang in zaw hih kei un, ana chihsa, akiang ua namte azui uhi.
english: They rejected his statutes and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified to them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and followed the nations that were around them, concerning whom Yahweh had commanded them that they should not do like them.

paite: TOUPA a Pathian uh thupiak tengteng alehngatsan ua, bawngnou lim sun nih abawl ua, Asherah song abawl ua, van a om tengteng abia ua, Baal nna asem uhi.
english: They abandoned all the commandments of Yahweh their God, and made molten images for themselves, even two calves, and made an Asherah, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served Baal.

paite: Atapate uh leh atanute uh mei tawn in alutsak ua, aisan leh bum aching ua, TOUPA hehna tokthou ding in amitmuh in thil hoih lou hih ding in akizuak uhi.
english: They caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA Israelte tung ah heh petmah in aheh a, amuh phaklouhna ding ah asuanmang a; Judah nam kia lou ngal a-omta kei uhi.
english: Therefore Yahweh was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight. There was none left but the tribe of Judah only.

paite: Judahte'n leng TOUPA a Pathian uh thupiakte azui kei ua, Israelte bawltawm dan thusehte azui zawta uhi.
english: Also Judah didn’t keep the commandments of Yahweh their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.

paite: Israel suante himhim adeihta kei a, amau ahihgim a, amuh phak louh ua asuanmang masiah lok mite khut ah apia hi.
english: Yahweh rejected all the offspring of Israel, afflicted them, and delivered them into the hands of raiders, until he had cast them out of his sight.

paite: Israelte lah David inkote ahihna uh apaihsakta ngal a; huchi in Nebat tapa Jeroboam pen kumpipa ding in abawl ua; Jeroboam in Israelte'n TOUPA azuih uh ahawlkawi a, thil gilou thupi mahmah ahihsak hi.
english: For he tore Israel from David’s house; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king; and Jeroboam drove Israel from following Yahweh, and made them sin a great sin.

paite: Israel suante'n Jeroboam thilhihkhelh bangbang ahih sam ua;
english: The children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they didn’t depart from them

paite: TOUPA'N azawlnei tengteng zang a ana gensa bang a amuh phaklouhna a, asuanmang masiah huaite apaisan ngal kei ua. Huchi in Israelte amau gam a pan Assuria gam ah api ua, tuni tan in huai gam ah a-om lai uhi.
english: until Yahweh removed Israel out of his sight, as he said by all his servants the prophets. So Israel was carried away out of their own land to Assyria to this day.

paite: Assuria kumpipa'n Babulon khomite, Kuth khomite, Ava khomite, Hamath khomite leh Sepharvaim khomite athukhak a, Samaria khote ah Israel suante mun aluahsak a; huchi in Samaria gam aluah ua, akhuate ah ateng uhi.
english: The king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, from Cuthah, from Avva, and from Hamath and Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel; and they possessed Samaria and lived in its cities.

paite: Huai lai a a-om tung un hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA laudan asiam kei ua, huchi in TOUPA'N alak uah humpinelkaite asawl a, khenkhatte akeilum uhi.
english: So it was, at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they didn’t fear Yahweh. Therefore Yahweh sent lions among them, which killed some of them.

paite: Huchi in Assuria kumpipa kiang ah, “Na lakkhiak a, Samaria gam khuate a na koih namte'n hiai gam Pathian omdan athei kei ua, huaiziak in, alak uah humpinelkaite asawl a; ngai dih, hiai gam Pathian omdan atheih louh ziak un athat uh," achi uhi.
english: Therefore they spoke to the king of Assyria, saying, “The nations which you have carried away and placed in the cities of Samaria don’t know the law of the god of the land. Therefore he has sent lions among them; and behold, they kill them, because they don’t know the law of the god of the land.”

paite: Huchi in Assuria kumpipa'n, "Huai a sal a na pite uh lak a siampu khat pi unla, hong om sam henla, ama'n huai gam Pathian biakdan sinsak hen," chi in thu apia hi.
english: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, “Carry there one of the priests whom you brought from there; and let him go and dwell there, and let him teach them the law of the god of the land.”

paite: Huchi in Samaria gam a pan apite uh lak a siampu khat Bethel ah ava teng a, TOUPA laudan ding asinsak hi.
english: So one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and lived in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear Yahweh.

paite: Himahleh nam chih in amau pathian chiat akibawl ua, Samari mite'n mun sang ana bawl innte ah nam chih in amau omna khua chiat ah huai apathiante chiat uh akoih uhi.
english: However every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities in which they lived.

paite: Babulon mite'n Sukkoth-benoth abawl ua, Kuthte'n Nergal abawl ua, Hamathte'n Ashima abawl ua;
english: The men of Babylon made Succoth Benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,

paite: Ava mite'n Nibhaz leh Tartak abawl uhi. Sepharvaim mite'n pathiante Adrammelek leh Anammelek kiang ah atate ahal uhi.
english: and the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA laudan asiam ua, alak ua mineupente mun sang siampute in abawl ua, mun sang innte ah amau a ding in thil alan uhi.
english: So they feared Yahweh, and also made from among themselves priests of the high places for themselves, who sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.

paite: TOUPA alau ua, apikhiakna gam ua namte hihdan bang in amau pathiante nna asem uh.
english: They feared Yahweh, and also served their own gods, after the ways of the nations from among whom they had been carried away.

paite: Tuma lam a, ahihdan bang un tuni tan in ahih lailai uhi. TOUPA laudan asiam kei ua, TOUPA'N Jakob suan Israel achihte kiang ah,
english: To this day they do what they did before. They don’t fear Yahweh, and they do not follow the statutes, or the ordinances, or the law, or the commandment which Yahweh commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;

paite: "pathian dangte zaw lau kei unla, amau be kei unla, akiang ah kithoih sam kei un.
english: with whom Yahweh had made a covenant and commanded them, saying, “You shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them;

paite: TOUPA, thilhihtheihna thupitak leh ban zak hial a Aigupta gam a pan nou hon pikhepa amah laudan na siam zawk ding uh ahi, amah na biak ding uh ahi a, ama kiang a na kithoih ding uh ahi.
english: but you shall fear Yahweh, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and with an outstretched arm, and you shall bow yourselves to him, and you shall sacrifice to him.

paite: Huchi in dan thusehte, vaihawmte, dante, thupiakte ahon na gelhsaksate tangtawn in na pom gige ding uh ahi; pathian dangte laudan na siam ding uh ahi kei.
english: The statutes and the ordinances, and the law and the commandment which he wrote for you, you shall observe to do forever more. You shall not fear other gods.

paite: Na kiang ua thu ka khun pen na mangngilh ding uh ahi kei; pathian dangte leng laudan na siam ding uh ahi sam kei hi.
english: You shall not forget the covenant that I have made with you. You shall not fear other gods.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan na siam ding uh ahi. Huchi in na melma tengteng khut a pan ama'n ahon hunkhe dia, chi a thu akhun a, amau a dia TOUPA thupiakte, dan thusehte, vaihawmte, dan bawlte, azui tuan kei uhi," achi hi.
english: But you shall fear Yahweh your God, and he will deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.”

paite: Bangchi mah in leng azui nuam tuan kei ua, tuma lam a ahihdan bang un ahih lailai uhi.
english: However they didn’t listen, but they did what they did before.

paite: Huchi in huai namte'n TOUPA alau ua; amilim bawltawmte uh nna leng asem lai uh. Huchi mah bang in asuante uh leh asuante uh suante tan in leng tuni tan in api-le-pute uh hih bang in ahih lailai uhi.
english: So these nations feared Yahweh, and also served their engraved images. Their children did likewise, and so did their children’s children. They do as their fathers did to this day.

paite: Huan Elah tapa Israel kumpipa Hoshea, kum thum alal kum in hichi ahong hi a, Judah kumpipa Ahaz tapa Hezekiah alal pan hi.
english: Now in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.

paite: Alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-kua alal a; anu min Abi, Zakariah tanu ahi.
english: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abi the daughter of Zechariah.

paite: Apu David thilhih tengteng hih sam in, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that David his father had done.

paite: Mun sangte ahihgawp a, suangphuhte ahihchim a, Asherahte aphuk a; Mosi dal gul bawl akitam nensak vek a; huai hun tanpha a Israel suante'n akiang a gimlim ahal ziak un, ama'n huai Nehushtan asa hi.
english: He removed the high places, broke the pillars, and cut down the Asherah. He also broke in pieces the bronze serpent that Moses had made, because in those days the children of Israel burned incense to it; and he called it Nehushtan.

paite: Ama'n TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian amuang a; huchi in anung a Judah kumpipa tengteng lak ah amah bang kuamah a-om kei ua, amalam in leng a-om sam kei uh.
english: He trusted in Yahweh, the God of Israel, so that after him was no one like him among all the kings of Judah, nor among them that were before him.

paite: TOUPA alen tinten a, ama zuih atawp nuam kei a, athupiak, TOUPA'N Mosi apiakte azui hi.
english: For he joined with Yahweh. He didn’t depart from following him, but kept his commandments, which Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA akiang ah a-om a; avakkhiakna peuh ah alamzang a; Assuria kumpipa tung ah ahel a, a-nna asemta kei hi.
english: Yahweh was with him. Wherever he went, he prospered. He rebelled against the king of Assyria, and didn’t serve him.

paite: Philistiate Gaza khua tan in agamgi chiang tengteng toh, galvilmi insang a pan kulh nei khopi tan in azou vek hi.
english: He struck the Philistines to Gaza and its borders, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city.

paite: Kumpipa Hezekiah kum li alal kum, Israel kumpipa Elah tapa Hoshea kum sagih alal kum in hichi ahong hi a, Assuria kumpipa Salmaneser in Samaria ahong dou a, a-umkimvel a,
english: In the fourth year of King Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria and besieged it.

paite: huchi in kum thum achin kum in alazou hi. Hezekiah kum guk alal kum, Israel kumpipa Hoshea kum kua alal kum in ahi Samaria khua alak zoh.
english: At the end of three years they took it. In the sixth year of Hezekiah, which was the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.

paite: Assuria kumpipa'n Assuria gam ah Israel apimang a, Halah, Habor, Gozan lui leh Mediate khuate ah akoihta hi;
english: The king of Assyria carried Israel away to Assyria, and put them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes,

paite: TOUPA a Pathian uh thu mang lou a, athukhun bohsia a, TOUPA'N asikha Mosi thu apiak tengteng azuih louh ziak un.
english: because they didn’t obey Yahweh their God’s voice, but transgressed his covenant, even all that Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded, and would not hear it or do it.

paite: Kumpipa Hezekiah kum sawm-le-li alal kum in Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib Judah gam a khokulh nei tengteng dou ding in ahohtou a, alata hi.
english: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and took them.

paite: Judah kumpipa Hezekiah in Lakish a Assuria kumpipa kiang ah, "Thil ka na hihkhial hi, kei a pan kik nawn in, ka tung a na hon got peuhmah ka po ding," chi a gen ding in mi asawl hi. Assuria kumpipa'n Judah kumpipa Hezekiah dangka talent zathum leh dangka-eng talent sawmthum abikhiahsak hi.
