english: Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria at Lachish, saying, “I have offended you. Withdraw from me. That which you put on me, I will bear.” The king of Assyria appointed to Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah in TOUPA' inn a dangka om teng leh kongkhak a dangka-eng tengteng leh kumpipa gou koihkhawmna a om tengteng apia hi.
english: Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in Yahweh’s house and in the treasures of the king’s house.

paite: Huai tung mah in Hezekiah in TOUPA tempul kongkhak a dangka-eng aluante leh Judah kumpipa Hezekiah inn khuampite a kiluante alakhe vek a, Assuria kumpipa apia hi.
english: At that time, Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of Yahweh’s temple, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.

paite: Assuria kumpipa'n Tartan, Rab-saris leh Rabshakeh sepaih tampi toh Lakish a pan Jerusalem a kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah asawl hi. Jerusalem khua atungtou ua; atuntouh un Puansawpmi Lamlian lampi a dil saknungzaw tuilakna kiang ah adingh uhi.
english: The king of Assyria sent Tartan, Rabsaris, and Rabshakeh from Lachish to King Hezekiah with a great army to Jerusalem. They went up and came to Jerusalem. When they had come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller’s field.

paite: Kumpipa asap uleh, insung heutu Hilkiah tapa Eliakim, laigelhmi Sebnah leh tanchin gelhmi Asaph tapa Joah, akiang uah ahong pawtkhia uhi.
english: When they had called to the king, Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebnah the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder came out to them.

paite: Rabshakeh in akiang uah, "Hezekiah kiang ah va gen dih ua, Kumpipa thupitak Assuria kumpipa in hichi in achi: Na gin a na muan bang ahia oi?
english: Rabshakeh said to them, “Say now to Hezekiah, ‘The great king, the king of Assyria, says, “What confidence is this in which you trust?

paite: Kidouna a ding in geldan siam leh hatna ka nei uh, na chi a; himahleh huai zaw paukam lel ahi. Kua ahia na muan a ka tung a na hel maizen?
english: You say (but they are but vain words), ‘There is counsel and strength for war.’ Now on whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me?

paite: Tu in, ngai in, hiai sialluang chiangkhun, Aigupta muang na hita a; huai a mi akingaihleh akhut asun ding hi. Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh bel amah muang tengteng tung ah huchibang ahi naknak hi.
english: Now, behold, you trust in the staff of this bruised reed, even in Egypt. If a man leans on it, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust on him.

paite: Ahihkeileh, ka kiang ah, TOUPA ka Pathian uh ahi ka muan uh, na chih uleh, amah pen Hezekiah in Judah leh Jerusalem kiang a Jerusalem a hiai maitam ma ah na biak ding uh ahi, chi a mun sangte leh amaitamte alakmangsakpa ahi kei a hia? chi in.
english: But if you tell me, ‘We trust in Yahweh our God,’ isn’t that he whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem’?

paite: Huchi in ka pu Assuria kumpipa toh thu kichiam dih ua, huchi in atung a tuangmi ding na muh theih peuhmah ding leh sakol sangnih ka hon pe ding.
english: Now therefore, please give pledges to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses if you are able on your part to set riders on them.

paite: Bangchi in ahia kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite thu in Aigupta tung a na muanna koih in, ka pu mite lak a neupen heutu khat lel leng na nankik zoh mahmah ding?
english: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

paite: Hiai gam TOUPA lou a hihse ding a hong kuantou ka hi a hia? TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, hiai gam dou inla, hihsia in, chi ahi,” chi in achi hi.
english: Have I now come up without Yahweh against this place to destroy it? Yahweh said to me, ‘Go up against this land, and destroy it.’”’”

paite: Hilkiah tapa Eliakim leh Sebnah leh Joahte'n Rabshakeh kiang ah, "Hehpih in na sikhate Siria pau in hon houpih in; huai lah ka theisiam ngal ua; kulh tung a mite zak in Judah pau in hon houpih nawn ke'n," achi uh.
english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, Shebnah, and Joah, said to Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in the Syrian language, for we understand it. Don’t speak with us in the Jews’ language, in the hearing of the people who are on the wall.”

paite: Himahleh Rabshakeh in akiang uah, "Ka pu in na pu uh kiang leh nou kiang kia ah hiai thu gen ding in ahon sawl a hia? Kulh tung a tute, noute leh a-ek uh ne dingte kiang ah leng hon sawl ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: But Rabshakeh said to them, “Has my master sent me to your master and to you, to speak these words? Hasn’t he sent me to the men who sit on the wall, to eat their own dung, and to drink their own urine with you?”

paite: Rabshakeh adingh a, Judah pau in aw ngaihtak in akikou a, "Kumpipa thupitak Assuria kumpipa thu ngaikhia un.
english: Then Rabshakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and spoke, saying, “Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria.

paite: Kumpipa'n hichi in achi, 'Hezekiah khem in om kei un; ama'n akhut a pan noute hon humbit thei lou ding ahi.
english: The king says, ‘Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will not be able to deliver you out of his hand.

paite: Hezekiah in, TOUPA'N ahon humbit dia; hiai khopi Assuria kumpipa khut ah piak ahi kei ding, chi in TOUPA ah hon muangsak kei hen.'
english: Don’t let Hezekiah make you trust in Yahweh, saying, “Yahweh will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”

paite: Hezekiah thu pom kei un. Assuria kumpipa'n hichi in achi: Hon kileppih unla, ka kiang ah hong pawtkhia un; michih in ama grepgui leh ama theipi kung ngei ate ne chiat uhenla, michih in amah tuikhuk tui dawn chiat hen.
english: Don’t listen to Hezekiah.’ For the king of Assyria says, ‘Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and everyone of you eat from his own vine, and everyone from his own fig tree, and everyone drink water from his own cistern;

paite: Noumau gam bang a buh leh uain gam, tanghou leh grephuan gam, olive leh khuaizu gam, si lou a na hintheihna ding uh gam a ka hon pi masiah, Hezekiah in, TOUPA'N hon humbit ding, chi a nou ahon khem in leng pom kei un.
english: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive trees and of honey, that you may live and not die. Don’t listen to Hezekiah when he persuades you, saying, “Yahweh will deliver us.”

paite: Namte' pathian mawngmawng lak a himhim in agam uh Assuria kumpipa a pan ahumbit ngeita uh hia?
english: Has any of the gods of the nations ever delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

paite: Hamath leh Arpad pathiante koi a omta uh ahia? Sepharvaim, Hena leh Ivah pathiante leng koi a omta ahi ua? Samaria ka khut a pan ahumbit uhia?
english: Where are the gods of Hamath and of Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah? Have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?

paite: Gam chih pathian tengteng lak a kuate ahi ua ka khut a pan agam uh humbit a, TOUPA'N Jerusalem khua kei a pan humbit mahmah ding? chi in,” achi hi.
english: Who are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of my hand, that Yahweh should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?’”

paite: Amau adai sipsip ua, kam khat in leng adawng kei uh, kumpipa dan thupiak, "Amah dawng ke'n," chih ahi ngal a.
english: But the people stayed quiet, and answered him not a word; for the king’s commandment was, “Don’t answer him.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa insung heutu Hilkiah tapa Eliakim, laigelhmi Sebnah leh tanchin gelhmi Asaph tapa Joahte'n apuansilh bohkekte uh silh in Hezekiah kiang ah ahoh ua, Rabshakeh thugente ahilh uhi.
english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, came with Shebna the scribe and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him Rabshakeh’s words.

paite: Huan kumpipa Hezekiah in huai azak in hichi ahong hi a, apuansilhte abotkek a, sai-ip puan asilh a, TOUPA' inn ah alutta hi.
english: When King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into Yahweh’s house.

paite: Inn sung heutu Eliakim, laigelhmi Sebnah leh siampu upate sai-ip puan silh in Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai kiang ah asawl hi.
english: He sent Eliakim, who was over the household, Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

paite: Amau akiang ah, Hezekiah in hichi in achi, "Tuni mangbatna leh salhna leh minsiatna ni ahi. Naute lah apian uh ahunta ngal a, piangsak ding in lah thahatna a-om nawnta ngal kei.
english: They said to him, “Hezekiah says, ‘Today is a day of trouble, of rebuke, and of rejection; for the children have come to the point of birth, and there is no strength to deliver them.

paite: Apu Assuria kumpipa'n Pathian hing gense ding a asawl Rabshakeh thugen tengteng, TOUPA na Pathian in aza dia, athugen, TOUPA na Pathian in athu azak in ana sal kha mai ding, huaiziak in, a-om lai khosuaksunte thumsak in," achi va chi un.
english: It may be Yahweh your God will hear all the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to defy the living God, and will rebuke the words which Yahweh your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.’”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Hezekiah sikhate Isai kiang ah ahoh uh.
english: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

paite: Isai in akiang uah, "Na pu kiang ah huchi in gen in, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, 'Assuria kumpipa sikhate'n kei ahon gensiatnate uh, na zak thute ziak in lau mawk ke'n.
english: Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master this: ‘Yahweh says, “Don’t be afraid of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

paite: Ngai in, asung ah kha ka omsak ding a, thuthang aza ding a, ama gam ah apai nawn ding. Huchi in ama gam mahmah ah namsau puksak in ka omsak ding, achi hi,' chi in," achi hi.
english: Behold, I will put a spirit in him, and he will hear news, and will return to his own land. I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.”’”

paite: Huchi in Rabshakeh akik nawn a, Assuria kumpipa'n Libna khua ana sual lai amu a; Lakish a pan apawt chih azaksa him ahi.
english: So Rabshakeh returned and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah; for he had heard that he had departed from Lachish.

paite: "Ngai in, nang hon dou ding in apawtta," chi a Tirhak Ethiopia gam kumpipa tungtangmi gen ana zak in Hezekiah kiang ah mite asawl hi.
english: When he heard it said of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, “Behold, he has come out to fight against you,” he sent messengers again to Hezekiah, saying,

paite: Hichi in Judah kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah na gen ding uh, "Na Pathian na muan in Jerusalem khua Assuria kumpipa khut ah piak ahi kei ding, chi in hon khem kei hen.
english: “Tell Hezekiah king of Judah this: ‘Don’t let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, Jerusalem will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.

paite: Ngai in, Assuria Kumpipate'n gam tengteng ahihse vek ua, atung a athilhih uh na za a; nang humbit na hi tuan dia hia?
english: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Will you be delivered?

paite: Namte pathiante'n ka pi-le-pute'n ahihmangte uh ahumbit ua hia? Gozan, Haran, Reseph, Eden ta Thelasar a omte.
english: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed—Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the children of Eden who were in Telassar?

paite: Hamath kumpipa, Arpad kumpipa, Sepharvaim khopi kumpipa, Hena kumpipa, Ivah kumpipate koi a om ahita ua? chi in,” achi hi.
english: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?’”

paite: Hezekiah in amisawlte khut a pan lai amu a, asim a: Hezekiah TOUPA' inn ah alut a, TOUPA ma ah huai aphalh hi.
english: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it. Then Hezekiah went up to Yahweh’s house, and spread it before Yahweh.

paite: Hezekiah TOUPA ma ah athum a, "TOUPA aw, cherubte tung a tu, Israel Pathian, nang, nang kia leitung gam tengteng Pathian na hi a; lei leh van nangmah siamsa ahi uh.
english: Hezekiah prayed before Yahweh, and said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, enthroned above the cherubim, you are the God, even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.

paite: TOUPA aw, na bil na doh inla, ngai dih ve; TOUPA aw, na mit hak inla, en dih ve; Pathian hing gense dia Sennakerib in thu ahong gen ngaikhe dih ve.
english: Incline your ear, Yahweh, and hear. Open your eyes, Yahweh, and see. Hear the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent to defy the living God.

paite: TOUPA, Assuria kumpipate'n namte leh agamte uh ahihse ngei ua, apathiante uh mei ah apai uh.
english: Truly, Yahweh, the kings of Assyria have laid waste the nations and their lands,

paite: Hiaite pathian ahi kei him ua, mihing khut a bawl sing leh suang ahi zaw uhi. Huaiziak in mei a pailut in ahihmang uhi.
english: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone. Therefore they have destroyed them.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in TOUPA, ka Pathian uh aw, nang, nang kia TOUPA Pathian na hi chih leitung a lalgam tengteng in atheihtheihna ding un akhut a pan hon humbit in," achi hi.
english: Now therefore, Yahweh our God, save us, I beg you, out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you, Yahweh, are God alone.”

paite: Huai lai in Amoz tapa Isai in Hezekiah kiang ah, TOUPA Israel Pathian in hichi in achi: Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib siatna ding a ka kiang a na thum ka za, chih gen ding in mi asawl hi.
english: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says ‘You have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria, and I have heard you.

paite: Amah tungtang TOUPA'N agen hiai ahi: "Zion tanu nungak siangthou in nang hon musit in, ahon nuihsan a; Jerusalem tanu in alu hon sinkhum hi.
english: This is the word that Yahweh has spoken concerning him: ‘The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and ridiculed you. The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.

paite: Kua na minsesak a, kua na gensia a? Kua tung ah ahia na aw na sansak a, na mit na hah sang? Israelte Mi Siangthoupa tung ah ahi.
english: Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel!

paite: Na misawlte zang in TOUPA na minsesak a, ka kangtalai tampi toh Lebanon gamgi tang sangte ka hong tungtouta hi. Huai a sidar sing sang pipite leh taksing hoih pipite ka phuk dia; alei hoihna mun gammang a tenna mun ngil pen ah ka lut ding.
english: By your messengers, you have defied the Lord, and have said, “With the multitude of my chariots, I have come up to the height of the mountains, to the innermost parts of Lebanon, and I will cut down its tall cedars and its choice cypress trees; and I will enter into his farthest lodging place, the forest of his fruitful field.

paite: Gamdang tui ka laikhia a, ka dawn zel a, ka khepek nuai ah Aigupta lui tengteng ka kangsak vek ding, na chi hi.
english: I have dug and drunk strange waters, and I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt with the sole of my feet.”

paite: "Keimah in nidanglai a pan huai ka hih ahihdan bang, ma lai a pan huai ka bawl ahihdan bang na za kei a hia? Khokulh neite in chinkhawm lel bang a hihsepa ding in nang ka hon septa hi.
english: Haven’t you heard how I have done it long ago, and formed it of ancient times? Now I have brought it to pass, that it should be yours to lay waste fortified cities into ruinous heaps.

paite: "Huaiziak in asung a omte'n hatna anei kei ua, alauthawng ua, ahong zahlakta uhi. Gamlak loupa bang leh loupa hing bang leh intung a loupa bang leh buh alet ma a haivuai bang ahi uhi.
english: Therefore their inhabitants had little power. They were dismayed and confounded. They were like the grass of the field and like the green herb, like the grass on the housetops and like grain blasted before it has grown up.

paite: "Ke'n bel na tut, na lut, na pawt leh ka tung a na hehnate ka thei hi.
english: But I know your sitting down, your going out, your coming in, and your raging against me.

paite: Ka tung a na heh ziak leh uangtak a na pau ka bil a ahong luttouh ziak in ka nakbulh na nak ah ka bulh dia, ka sikbah na muk ah; na hong kuanna lampi mahmah ah ka hon kiksak nawn ding," chi in.
english: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.’

paite: "Hiai nang a dia chiamtehna ahi ding. Tukum in buhsang na sen ding ua; kum nawn chiang in asang mah; kum thumna ah buh na tuh ding ua, at unla, grephuante bawl unla, agahte ne un.
english: “This will be the sign to you: This year, you will eat that which grows of itself, and in the second year that which springs from that; and in the third year sow and reap, and plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

paite: Huchi in Judah inkote lak a khosuaksunte'n asuklam in zung akai ding ua, atoulam in agah nawn ding uhi.
english: The remnant that has escaped of the house of Judah will again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

paite: Jerusalem a pan a omsunte Zion tang a pan akhosuaksunte apawtkhe ding uhi. TOUPA phatuamngaihna in hiai ahih ding," achi hi.
english: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and out of Mount Zion those who shall escape. Yahweh’s zeal will perform this.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Assuria kumpipa tungtang thu huchi in agen: "Hiai khopi ah ahong tung kei ding, hiai ah leng thal akap sam kei ding, lum toh akiang ah lah ahong pai kei ding a, akhozul ah lah lei ase sang kei ding hi.
english: “Therefore Yahweh says concerning the king of Assyria, ‘He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there. He will not come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.

paite: Ahong kuanna lampi ah, huai mah ah anungkik nawn dia, hiai khopi ahong tung kei ding," TOUPA'N achi.
english: He will return the same way that he came, and he will not come to this city,’ says Yahweh.

paite: "Kei ziak leh ka sikha David ziak in hiai khopi humbit ding in ka veng ding," chi in.
english: ‘For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake and for my servant David’s sake.’”

paite: Huchi in huai zan in hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA angel akuankhia a, Assuriate giahphual ah mi nuaikhat singgiat-le-sangnga athat a; zingkhang a ahong thoh uleh, ngai in, misi luang ngen ana om maimah hi.
english: That night, Yahweh’s angel went out and struck one hundred eighty-five thousand in the camp of the Assyrians. When men arose early in the morning, behold, these were all dead bodies.

paite: Huchi in Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib apawt a, akik nawn a, apai zel a, Nineveh ah a-omta hi.
english: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, went home, and lived at Nineveh.

paite: Apathian Nisrok inn a amah abiak lai in hichi ahong hi a, Adrammelek leh Sarezerte'n namsau in athat ua; huchi in Ararat gam ah atailutta uh. Huchi in asik in atapa Esarhaddon alalta hi.
english: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Elijah pingpei a van a apitouh ding in, hichi ahong hi a, Gilgal a pan Elisha toh Elijah apawt uhi.
english: When Yahweh was about to take Elijah up by a whirlwind into heaven, Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

paite: Elijah in Elisha kiang ah, "Hiai ah ana om dih; TOUPA'N Bethel a pai ding in ahon sawl," achi hi. Elisha in, “TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi. K'on nuse kei hial ding," achi hi. Huchi in Bethel ah apaisukkhawm uhi.
english: Elijah said to Elisha, “Please wait here, for Yahweh has sent me as far as Bethel.” Elisha said, “As Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So they went down to Bethel.

paite: Bethel a om zawlneite tapate Elisha kiang ah ahoh ua, akiang ah, "Tuni in TOUPA'N na heutupa ahon lakmangsak ding chih na thei hia?” achi uh. Ama'n, "Hi, thei mah ing, dai un," achi hi.
english: The sons of the prophets who were at Bethel came out to Elisha, and said to him, “Do you know that Yahweh will take away your master from over you today?” He said, “Yes, I know it. Hold your peace.”

paite: Elijah in akiang ah, "Elisha, hiai ah na om dih; TOUPA'N Jeriko a hoh ding in ahon sawl," achi hi. Ama'n, "TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi. K'on nuse kei hial ding,” achi hi. Huchi in Jeriko ah ahohkhawmta uhi.
english: Elijah said to him, “Elisha, please wait here, for Yahweh has sent me to Jericho.” He said, “As Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So they came to Jericho.

paite: Jeriko a om zawlneite tapate'n Elisha ava naih ua, akiang ah, tuni in TOUPA'N na heutupa ahon lakmangsak ding chih na thei hia? achi uh. Ama'n adawng a, "Hi, thei mah ing, dai un,” achi hi.
english: The sons of the prophets who were at Jericho came near to Elisha, and said to him, “Do you know that Yahweh will take away your master from over you today?” He answered, “Yes, I know it. Hold your peace.”

paite: Elijah in akiang ah, "Hiai ah na om dih, TOUPA'N Jordan a hoh ding in ahon sawl," achi hi. Ama'n, "TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi, k'on nuse kei hial ding," achi hi. Huchi in anih un apaikhawmta uh.
english: Elijah said to him, “Please wait here, for Yahweh has sent me to the Jordan.” He said, “As Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” Then they both went on.

paite: Zawlneite' tapate lak a mi sawmnga ava hoh ua, amaute zawn, gamla kuamtak ah ava dingh ua; amau gel bel Jordan gei ah ana dingh uhi.
english: Fifty men of the sons of the prophets went and stood opposite them at a distance; and they both stood by the Jordan.

paite: Elijah in apuan la in alomzial a, tui asat a, alang tuak ah ahong kikhenta a, huchi in anih un lei keu ah apaita uhi.
english: Elijah took his mantle, and rolled it up, and struck the waters; and they were divided here and there, so that they both went over on dry ground.

paite: Agalkah nung un hichi ahong hi a, Elijah in Elisha kiang ah, "Na kiang a pan lakmang a ka om ma in bang ahia ka hon hihsak ding hon ngen in," achi hi. Elisha in, "Na kha tan nih tang leng,” achi hi.
english: When they had gone over, Elijah said to Elisha, “Ask what I shall do for you, before I am taken from you.” Elisha said, “Please let a double portion of your spirit be on me.”

paite: Ama'n, "Thil haksapi ngen na hi ve; haksa mahleh na kiang a pan lakmang a ka om lai na muhleh na tang ding, na hon muh keileh bel na tang kei ding,” achi hi.
english: He said, “You have asked a hard thing. If you see me when I am taken from you, it will be so for you; but if not, it will not be so.”

paite: Apai kawmkawm ua, ahoulim lai un hichi ahong hi a, ngai in, mei kangtalai leh mei sakolte ahong kimu guih uhi. Akal ua kigolh in akikhensakta a; Elijah bel pingpei in van ah apaitouta hi.
english: As they continued on and talked, behold, a chariot of fire and horses of fire separated them; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

paite: Elisha in huai amu a, "Ka pa aw, ka pa aw, Israelte kangtalai leh asakol a tuangte aw!" chi in akikou hi. Huchi in Elijah amuta kei a; ama puan aman a, phel nih in abotkek hi.
english: Elisha saw it, and he cried, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!” He saw him no more. Then he took hold of his own clothes and tore them in two pieces.

paite: Elijah puan hong kia leng atawm a, apaikik nawn a, Jordan lui gei ah adingh hi.
english: He also took up Elijah’s mantle that fell from him, and went back and stood by the bank of the Jordan.

paite: Elijah puan hong kia ala a, huai in tui asat a, "TOUPA, Elijah Pathian koi ah?" achi hi. Huchi a tui asattak in alang tuak ah hong kikhen a, Elisha agalkahta hi.
english: He took Elijah’s mantle that fell from him, and struck the waters, and said, “Where is Yahweh, the God of Elijah?” When he also had struck the waters, they were divided apart, and Elisha went over.

paite: Jeriko a zawlneite tapate, amah zawn a omte'n amuh un, "Elijah kha Elisha tung ah atu mah ve," achi uhi. Amah mu ding in akuan ua, ama ah lei si in akunsuk uhi.
english: When the sons of the prophets who were at Jericho facing him saw him, they said, “The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha.” They came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.

paite: Amaute'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, na sikhate'n mi ngalhat pipi sawmnga ka ompih uh. Na heutupa zong ding in sawl ve. TOUPA Kha in latou ahi dia, koi lai tang ah hiam, koi lai phaizang ah hiam a khia khattou ahi mai ding," achi uh. Ama'n, "Kuansak ke'n," achi hi.
english: They said to him, “See now, there are with your servants fifty strong men. Please let them go and seek your master. Perhaps Yahweh’s Spirit has taken him up, and put him on some mountain or into some valley.” He said, “Don’t send them.”

paite: Zumhuai khop a anget nung un, "Kuansak ve ua,” achi khong hi. Huchi in mi sawmnga asawl ua; ni thum sung azong ua, himahleh amuzou kei uh.
english: When they urged him until he was ashamed, he said, “Send them.” Therefore they sent fifty men; and they searched for three days, but didn’t find him.

paite: Jeriko a anituan lai in akiang ah ahong nawn ua; ama'n akiang uah, na kiang uah, "Kuansak kei un, ka hon chi ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: They came back to him while he stayed at Jericho; and he said to them, “Didn’t I tell you, ‘Don’t go’?”

paite: Huai khua a mite'n Elisha kiang ah, "En in, hiai khomun anuam mahmah a, ka toupa un leng na hon muhpih hi. Himahleh tui ahoih kei a, agam mahmah gahsuah thei lou gam ahi," achi uhi.
english: The men of the city said to Elisha, “Behold, please, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord sees; but the water is bad, and the land is barren.”

paite: Ama'n, "Tuithawl thak hon la unla, chi thun un,” achi a; huchi in ahon la uhi.
english: He said, “Bring me a new jar, and put salt in it.” Then they brought it to him.

paite: Tuikhuk ah ava hoh a, chi athehlut a, “TOUPA'N hichi in achi, hiai tui ka limsakta, tuban siah sihna leh gahsuahlouhna a-om nawn kei ding," achi hi.
english: He went out to the spring of the waters, and threw salt into it, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘I have healed these waters. There shall not be from there any more death or barren wasteland.’”

paite: Huchi in Elisha gen bang in tuni tan in huai tui alimta hi.
english: So the waters were healed to this day, according to Elisha’s word which he spoke.

paite: Huai a pan Bethel ah ahohtou a; lampi a apai lai in khua a pan pasal naupang hon ahong pawtkhia ua, ahong nuihsan ua, akiang ah, "Nang lugiaupa, va hohtou in, nang lugiaupa va hohtou in," achi uhi.
english: He went up from there to Bethel. As he was going up by the way, some youths came out of the city and mocked him, and said to him, “Go up, you baldy! Go up, you baldy!”

paite: Anunglam anga a, amau amu a, TOUPA min in ahamsiatta hi. Huchi in gamnuai a pan vompinu nih ahong pawtkhia ua, alak ua naupang sawmli-le-nih abalgawp uhi.
english: He looked behind him and saw them, and cursed them in Yahweh’s name. Then two female bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of those youths.

paite: Huai a pan Karmel tang ah ahoh a, huai a pan Samaria ah apai nawnta hi.
english: He went from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Samaria.

paite: Huai lai in Hezekiah, muanmohhuai in achi ana hi. Huchi in Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai akiang ah ahong a, akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Na inkote omdan ding gel in; damkhe zou lou a si ding na hi ngal a," achi hi.
english: In those days Hezekiah was sick and dying. Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came to him, and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Set your house in order; for you will die, and not live.’”

paite: Huchi in baang lam nga in akihei a, TOUPA kiang ah,
english: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed to Yahweh, saying,

paite: "TOUPA aw, na ma a thutak leh lungtang hoihkim pu a ka omdan leh na mitmuh a thil hoih ka hihdan hehpih in theigige in," chi in athum hi. Huchi in Hezekiah kah petmah in akap hi.
english: “Remember now, Yahweh, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight.” And Hezekiah wept bitterly.

paite: Isai huangsung intual laitak atun ma in hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA thu akiang ah ahong tung hi.
english: Before Isaiah had gone out into the middle part of the city, Yahweh’s word came to him, saying,

paite: "Kik nawn inla, ka mite heutu Hezekiah kiang ah gen in, TOUPA'N, na pu David Pathian in hichi in achi, 'Na thumna ka za a, na khitui kia leng ka mu hi. Ngai in, ka hon damsak ding a; ani thum ni in TOUPA' inn ah na hohtou ding.
english: “Turn back, and tell Hezekiah the prince of my people, ‘Yahweh, the God of David your father, says, “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will heal you. On the third day, you will go up to Yahweh’s house.

paite: Na damsung kumte kum sawm-le-nga in ka behlap dia; nang leh hiai khopi Assuria kumpipa a pan ka humbit ding.' Keimah ziak leh ka sikha David ziak in hiai khopi ka hum ding, achi," chi in.
english: I will add to your days fifteen years. I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.”’”

paite: Isai in, theipi gah beu khat hon la un, achi a; huchi in ahon la ua, ameimatum ah atat a, ahong dam nawnta hi.
english: Isaiah said, “Take a cake of figs.” They took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.

paite: Hezekiah in Isai kiang ah, "TOUPA'N ahon damsak dia, TOUPA' inn ah ani thum ni in ka hohtou ding, chih chiamtehna bang ahi dia?" achi hi.
english: Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “What will be the sign that Yahweh will heal me, and that I will go up to Yahweh’s house the third day?”

paite: Isai in, TOUPA'N athil gen ahih ngei ding chih hiai nang a ding in TOUPA a pan chiamtehna ding ahi ding, "Limliap kalbi sawm tan, amailam a akintouh hia na deih, kalbi sawm tan a anunglam a akik?" achi hi.
english: Isaiah said, “This will be the sign to you from Yahweh, that Yahweh will do the thing that he has spoken: should the shadow go forward ten steps, or go back ten steps?”

paite: Hezekiah in adawng a, "Limliap kalbi sawm tan amalam a kintouh abaih tel a, huai zaw hi kei henla, limliap kalbi sawm tan in nunglam ah nungkik zaw hen," achi hi.
english: Hezekiah answered, “It is a light thing for the shadow to go forward ten steps. No, but let the shadow return backward ten steps.”

paite: Huchi in zawlnei Isai in TOUPA asam a; huchi in Ahaz dak zah theihna a limliap niamsa kalbi sawm tan in nunglam ah akiksak nawn hi.
english: Isaiah the prophet cried to Yahweh; and he brought the shadow ten steps backward, by which it had gone down on the sundial of Ahaz.

paite: Huai lai in Hezekiah chi ana chih ana zak ziak in Baladan tapa Babulon kumpipa Merodak-baladan in laikhakte leh thilpiakte Hezekiah akhak hi.
english: At that time Berodach Baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah, for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah in amau ana kipahpih a, athil manpha koihna inn a thil manpha tengteng, dangka, dangka-eng, gimlimte, sathau manpha, agalvan koihna inn teng leh agou koihkhawmna insung a om tengteng a-ensak a: a-inn leh agamsung a Hezekiah in a-etsak louh a-om kei hi.
english: Hezekiah listened to them, and showed them all the storehouse of his precious things—the silver, the gold, the spices, and the precious oil, and the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures. There was nothing in his house, or in all his dominion, that Hezekiah didn’t show them.

paite: Huai lai in zawlnei Isai kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah ahong a, akiang ah, "Huai mite'n bang ahia agen uh? Koi a pan na kiang a hong hoh ahi ua?" chi in adong hi. Hezekiah in, "Gam gamla, Babulon a kipan a hong hoh ahi uh," achi hi.
english: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah, and said to him, “What did these men say? From where did they come to you?” Hezekiah said, “They have come from a far country, even from Babylon.”

paite: Huchi in ama'n, "Na inn ah bangbang ahia amuh uh?" achi a; Hezekiah in, "Ka insung a om tengteng amu vek ua, ka gou lak ah ka etsak louh a-om kei," chi in adawng hi.
english: He said, “What have they seen in your house?” Hezekiah answered, “They have seen all that is in my house. There is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them.”

paite: Isai in Hezekiah kiang ah, "TOUPA thu ngaikhia in.
english: Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear Yahweh’s word.

paite: Ngai in, na insung a om tengteng leh tuni tan a na pi-le-pute'n ana kholkhawmte uh Babulon ah apaipih nite uh ahong tung ding; bangmah nutsiat anei kei ding uh TOUPA'N achi.
english: ‘Behold, the days come that all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have laid up in store to this day, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says Yahweh.

paite: Na gil a gah, na suan ding, na tapate ngei leng apaimangpih ding ua; Babulon kumpipa' inn ah michilgeh ahi ding uh," achi hi.
english: ‘They will take away some of your sons who will issue from you, whom you will father; and they will be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.’”

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah in Isai kiang ah, "Na gen TOUPA thu ahoih ahi,” achi hi. "Ka damsung a lemna leh thutak a-om ding nakleh hoih himai lou hia?" achi hi.
english: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “Yahweh’s word which you have spoken is good.” He said moreover, “Isn’t it so, if peace and truth will be in my days?”

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah tanchin dangte, athilhihtheihdan tengteng leh dil leh tuilakna abawl a, khopi sung a tui alaklut thute Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made the pool, and the conduit, and brought water into the city, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; atapa Manasseh asik in alal hi.
english: Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and Manasseh his son reigned in his place.

paite: Manasseh alal pat tung in kum sawm-le-nih a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga-le-nga alal a; anu min Hephzibah ahi.
english: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hephzibah.

paite: TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a adelhkhiaksa namte, thilkihhuaitak ahihte uh bang, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, after the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh cast out before the children of Israel.

paite: Apa Hezekiah in ahihsiatsa mun sangte adingsak nawn a; Israel kumpipa Ahab hih bang in Baal maitamte adingsak a, Asherahte abawl a, van a om tengteng bia in a-nna uh asem hi.
english: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he raised up altars for Baal, and made an Asherah, as Ahab king of Israel did, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served them.

paite: TOUPA'N, "Jerusalem ah ka min ka omsak ding," achihna TOUPA' inn ah maitamte abawl hi.
english: He built altars in Yahweh’s house, of which Yahweh said, “I will put my name in Jerusalem.”

paite: TOUPA' inn huangsung intual nihte ah van a om tengteng a ding in maitamte abawl hi.
english: He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Atapa mei ah apaisuaksak a, aisan leh bum ahih a, dawi zawlte leh kha napeuh adong hi. TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou thupi mahmah amah hehsak ding in ahih hi.
english: He made his son to pass through the fire, practiced sorcery, used enchantments, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits and with wizards. He did much evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

paite: TOUPA'N David leh atapa Solomon kiang a, "Hiai inn leh Jerusalem khua, Israel chi tengteng lak a ka tel ah ka min tangtawn in ka omsak ding," achihna mun ah Asherah lim khuaktawm atungkhia hi.
english: He set the engraved image of Asherah that he had made in the house of which Yahweh said to David and to Solomon his son, “In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever;

paite: "Thu ka piak tengteng leh ka sikha Mosi in dan apiak tengteng zuih peuhmah uleh api-le-pute uh ka piaksa gam a pan Israelte khete leng ka kal ka suankhesak nawn sam kei ding," achi hi.
english: I will not cause the feet of Israel to wander any more out of the land which I gave their fathers, if only they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.”

paite: Himahleh amau azui kei ua; TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a delhkhiaksa namte hih sang tham a thupizaw thil hihkhial ding in Manasseh in mite alampialsak hi.
english: But they didn’t listen, and Manasseh seduced them to do that which is evil more than the nations did whom Yahweh destroyed before the children of Israel.

paite: TOUPA'N asikha zawlneite zang in thu agen hi.
english: Yahweh spoke by his servants the prophets, saying,

paite: "Judah kumpipa Manasseh in hiai thilkihhuaitakte ahih a, Amorte sang tham in ahihkhial thupi hi. Judahte'n leng amilimte a thil ahihkhelhsak ziak in," achi hi.
english: “Because Manasseh king of Judah has done these abominations, and has done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, who were before him, and has also made Judah to sin with his idols;

paite: TOUPA, Israel Pathian in hichi in achi, "Ngai dih ua, Jerusalem leh Judah tung ah aza peuhmahte bil langnih khengzou khop in thil hoih lou ka hon tungsak ding hi.
english: therefore Yahweh the God of Israel says, ‘Behold, I will bring such evil on Jerusalem and Judah that whoever hears of it, both his ears will tingle.

paite: Jerusalem tung ah Samaria tehna khau leh Ahab inkuan' ulum khai ka khung dia; mi'n akuangnul akilumletsak bang in Jerusalem ka nul ding hi.
english: I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plumb line of Ahab’s house; and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.

paite: Ka goutan khosuaksunte ka taisan dia, amelmate uh khut ah ka pe ding.
english: I will cast off the remnant of my inheritance and deliver them into the hands of their enemies. They will become a prey and a plunder to all their enemies,

paite: Huchi in api-le-pute uh Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawt nung uh tuni pha a ka mitmuh a thil hoih lou ahih ua, hon hehsak ziak un, amelma tengteng mat ding leh gallak ding ahi ding uh," chi in achi hi.
english: because they have done that which is evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger since the day their fathers came out of Egypt, even to this day.’”

paite: TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih loutak hih a Judahte thil ahihkhelhsak, khelhna a sim lou in Manasseh in poi khoih lou sisan nakpitak in asuah lai a, Jerusalem dung leh vai adimsak hi.
english: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, until he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; in addition to his sin with which he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight.

paite: Manasseh tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng, athilhihkhelhte Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Huchi in Manasseh api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, Uzza huansung a om ama inn huan mah ah avui ua; asik in atapa Ammon alalta hi.
english: Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza; and Amon his son reigned in his place.

paite: Ammon alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nih a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum nih alal a; anu min Mesullemeth, Jotbah a Haruz tanu ahi.
english: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

paite: Apa Manasseh hih bangmah TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih loutak ahih hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as Manasseh his father did.

paite: Apa lampi tot tengteng atawn sam a, apa septe milimte nna sem in amaute abia hi.
english: He walked in all the ways that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshiped them;

paite: Huchi in TOUPA, api-le-pute Pathian apaisan a, TOUPA lampi atawn kei hi.
english: and he abandoned Yahweh, the God of his fathers, and didn’t walk in the way of Yahweh.

paite: Ammon sikhate'n amah aguksawm ua, kumpipa amah inn ah athatta uhi.
english: The servants of Amon conspired against him, and put the king to death in his own house.

paite: Himahleh huai gam a mite'n kumpipa Ammon guksawm mi tengteng athat vek uhi. Huchi in huai gam mite'n atapa Josiah asik in kumpipa in abawlta uhi.
english: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.

paite: Huchi in Ammon thilhih tanchin dangte Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Uzza huan a amah han ah avui ua; asik in atapa Josiah alalta hi.
english: He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza, and Josiah his son reigned in his place.

paite: Josiah alal pat tung in kum giat a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum-le-khat alal a; anu min Jedidah, Boskath a Adaiah tanu ahi.
english: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jedidah the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.

paite: Ama'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil dik ahih a, apu David lampi tot tengteng atawn a, taklam ah hiam veilam ah hiam apialkhe kei hi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and walked in all the ways of David his father, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left.

paite: Kumpipa Josiah alal kum sawm-le-giatna kum in hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa'n Meshullam tapa Azaliah tapa laigelhmi Shaphan kiang ah,
english: In the eighteenth year of King Josiah, the king sent Shaphan, the son of Azaliah the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to Yahweh’s house, saying,

paite: "Siampu lianpen Hilkiah kiang ah hohtou inla, kongkhak veng mite'n mite a pan ana lakkhawm uh TOUPA' inn a dangka kikoih sim uhenla;
english: “Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may count the money which is brought into Yahweh’s house, which the keepers of the threshold have gathered of the people.

paite: TOUPA' inn lam nasem mite pia uhen; amau inn se bawl TOUPA' inn a nasemte pia uhen.
english: Let them deliver it into the hand of the workers who have the oversight of Yahweh’s house; and let them give it to the workers who are in Yahweh’s house, to repair the damage to the house,

paite: Singlem bawl mite, inn lam mite, inn sia bawl mite'n inn siatna tak bawlna sing leh suangsek aleitheihna ding un, chi in va gen in, chi in TOUPA' inn ah asawl hi.
english: to the carpenters, and to the builders, and to the masons, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the house.

paite: Himahleh dangka apiakte uh etpih nawn ding in agelhsak tuan kei, muanhuaitak a hih zel ahih ziak un," achi hi.
english: However, no accounting shall be asked of them for the money delivered into their hand, for they deal faithfully.”

paite: Siampu lianpen Hilkiah in laigelhmi Shaphan kiang ah, "TOUPA' inn ah dan laibu ka mu,” achi hi. Hilkiah in huai laibu Shaphan apia a, ama'n asimta hi.
english: Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the book of the law in Yahweh’s house.” Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

paite: Kumpipa kiang ah laigelhmi Shaphan ava hoh a, kumpipa kiang ah thu ava tun nawn a, "Na mite'n inn a dangka omte apekhe vek ua, TOUPA' inn lam nasem mite ape vek uh," achi hi.
english: Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, “Your servants have emptied out the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hands of the workmen who have the oversight of Yahweh’s house.”

paite: Laigelhmi Shaphan in, "Siampu Hilkiah in laibu ahon pia,” chi in kumpipa ahilh a, huchi in Shaphan in kumpipa ma ah asim hi.
english: Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, “Hilkiah the priest has delivered a book to me.” Then Shaphan read it before the king.

paite: Kumpipa'n dan laibu a thute azak in hichi ahong hi a, apuante abotkek hi.
english: When the king had heard the words of the book of the law, he tore his clothes.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n siampu Hilkiah, Shaphan tapa Ahikam, Mikaiah tapa Akbor, laigelhmi Shaphan leh kumpipa sikha Asahiah kiang ah,
english: The king commanded Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Achbor the son of Micaiah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying,

paite: "Kei, mi tengteng leh Judah teng a ding in hiai laibu a thu tuang toh kisai in TOUPA hon dotsak un. I pi-le-pute'n hiai laibu a thute zuih ding ana ngaihkhiak louh ziak un i tung uah TOUPA thangpaihna athupi mahmah ngal a," chi in thu apia hi.
english: “Go inquire of Yahweh for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found; for great is Yahweh’s wrath that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not listened to the words of this book, to do according to all that which is written concerning us.”

paite: Huchi in siampu Hilkiah, Ahikam, Akbor, Shaphan, Asahiah, puansilh kempa Harhas tapa Tikvah tapa Shallum zi zawlnei Huldah kiang ah ahoh ua, ava houpih uhi. Amah bel Jerusalem sehkhen nihna a teng ahi.
english: So Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe (now she lived in Jerusalem in the second quarter); and they talked with her.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah TOUPA, Israelte Pathian in hichi in achi, “Ka kiang a nou hon sawlpa hilh un," TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: She said to them, “Yahweh the God of Israel says, ‘Tell the man who sent you to me,

paite: "Ngai in, hiai mun ah leh asung a tengte tung ah thil hoih lou ka hon tungsak ding, Judah kumpipa'n laibu a, athusim tengteng bang in.
english: “Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will bring evil on this place and on its inhabitants, even all the words of the book which the king of Judah has read.

paite: Kei ahon paisan ua, pathian dangte kiang ah gimlim ahal ua, akhutsuak ua ahon thangpaihsak ziak un hiai mun ah ka thangpaihna nakpitak in akuang dia, amawkmih kei ding hi.
english: Because they have forsaken me and have burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the work of their hands, therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and it will not be quenched.’”

paite: Himahleh TOUPA thu dong ding a nou hon sawlpa Judah kumpipa kiang ah huchi in na chi ding uh. TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: Na thuzakte tungtang thu ah,
english: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of Yahweh, tell him, “Yahweh the God of Israel says, ‘Concerning the words which you have heard,

paite: hiai mun leh asung a tengte hihgam leh hamsiat in a-om ding uh chih thu ka gen na zak a, na lungtang anem a, TOUPA ma a na kiniamkhiak a, na puante na bohkek a, ka ma a na kah ziak in, ke'n leng na thu ka na za, TOUPA'N achi.
english: because your heart was tender, and you humbled yourself before Yahweh when you heard what I spoke against this place and against its inhabitants, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and have torn your clothes and wept before me, I also have heard you,’ says Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in ngai in, na pi-le-pute kiang ah ka hon pi dia, na han ah lungmuangtak a pi in na om dia, hiai mun a thil hoih lou ka tunsak ding tengteng na mit in amu vek kei ding," achi hi. Huchi in huai thu kumpipa kiang ah atun nawn uhi.
english: ‘Therefore behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes will not see all the evil which I will bring on this place.’”’” So they brought this message back to the king.

paite: Huan kumpipa'n mi asawl a, akiang ah Juda leh Jerusalem khopi a upa tengteng asamkhawm uhi.
english: The king sent, and they gathered to him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Judah gam a mi tengteng leh Jerusalem a mi tengteng toh, siampute leh zawlneite toh, mipi tengteng toh, aneu leh alian in TOUPA' inn ah ahohtou ua; TOUPA' inn a kimu thukhun laibu a tuang thu tengteng abil ua zak in asim hi.
english: The king went up to Yahweh’s house, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him—with the priests, the prophets, and all the people, both small and great; and he read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Khuam zul ah kumpipa adingh a, huai laibu a tuang thukhun thu hihkip ding in lungtang tengteng leh akha tengteng a TOUPA zui ding leh athupiakte, athu theihsakte, adan thusehte zui ding in TOUPA ma ah thu akhung a; huchi in mipi tengteng in leng akhunpih uhi.
english: The king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before Yahweh to walk after Yahweh and to keep his commandments, his testimonies, and his statutes with all his heart and all his soul, to confirm the words of this covenant that were written in this book; and all the people agreed to the covenant.

paite: Kumpipa'n siampu lianpen Hilkiah leh azom a siampute, kongkhak veng mite kiang ah TOUPA tempul sung a Baal, Asherah leh van a om tengteng a dia kibawl tui-um belsuan tengteng lakhe vek ding in thu apia hi. Huchi in Jerusalem polam, Kidron mun ah huai tengteng ahal a, avute Bethel ah apaipih hi.
english: The king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the threshold, to bring out of Yahweh’s temple all the vessels that were made for Baal, for the Asherah, and for all the army of the sky; and he burned them outside of Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron, and carried their ashes to Bethel.

paite: Milim pathian bia siampute, Judah Kumpipate'n Judah gam khopi mun sangte a, Jerusalem kim a gimlim hal dia ana seh uh atawpsak a; Baal a dia, ni a dia, kha a dia, aksite a dia van a omte tengteng a dia gimlim hal mite leng.
english: He got rid of the idolatrous priests whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah and in the places around Jerusalem; those also who burned incense to Baal, to the sun, to the moon, to the planets, and to all the army of the sky.

paite: TOUPA' inn a Asherah pen Jerusalem polam Kidron lui a lakhia in ahal a, asiknengawp a, anen mi vantangte han ah atheh hi.
english: He brought out the Asherah from Yahweh’s house, outside of Jerusalem, to the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and beat it to dust, and cast its dust on the graves of the common people.

paite: Asherah a dia puan gan numeite omna, TOUPA' inn kiang a pasal kizuakte omna innte aphelkhe vek hi.
english: He broke down the houses of the male shrine prostitutes that were in Yahweh’s house, where the women wove hangings for the Asherah.

paite: Judah khopi a pan siampu tengteng apikhia a, siampute'n gimlim ahalna uh Geba a pan Beer-sheba pha in ahihbuah vek a; khopi kongpi veilam pang a om khopi ukpa Joshua kongpi ah alut a kongpite a mun sangte achimsak hi.
english: He brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba; and he broke down the high places of the gates that were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.

paite: Mun sang siampute Jerusalem a TOUPA maitam ah ahohtou kei ua, himahleh a-unaute uh lak ah tanghou silngou soh louh ane uhi.
english: Nevertheless the priests of the high places didn’t come up to Yahweh’s altar in Jerusalem, but they ate unleavened bread among their brothers.

paite: Kuamah in atapa hiam atanu hiam Molek kiang a mei a apaisuaksak nawnlouhna ding in, Hinnom suante phaizang a Tophet ahihbuah hi.
english: He defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.

paite: TOUPA' inn lutna a inn huangsung a kumpipa' inn vengmi Nathan-melek dantan chin a Judah kumpipate'n nisa a dia sakol apiakte uh alamang vek a; nisa kangtalai mei in ahal hi.
english: He took away the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun, at the entrance of Yahweh’s house, by the room of Nathan Melech the officer who was in the court; and he burned the chariots of the sun with fire.

paite: Ahaz inn chial tung a Judah kumpipate'n maitam abawlte uh leh Manasseh in TOUPA' inn huangsung intual nih a maitam abawlte kumpipa'n ahihchim a, ahihnen vek a, anente Kidron lui ah apai hi.
english: The king broke down the altars that were on the roof of the upper room of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of Yahweh’s house, and beat them down from there, and cast their dust into the brook Kidron.

paite: Jerusalem ma a tatsiatna tang taklam pang a Zidonte pathian kihhuai mahmah Astoreth a dia, Ammon suante pathian kihhuai mahmah Khemosh a dia, Ammonte Pathian kihhuai mah Molek Israel kumpipa Solomon in mun sang abawlte kumpipa'n ahihbuah hi.
english: The king defiled the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mountain of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon.

paite: Milimte akitamsak vek a, Ashera ahihpuk a, huai munte ah mihing guhte akoih hi.
english: He broke in pieces the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles, and filled their places with men’s bones.

paite: Huai lou leng Israelte thil hihkhialsakpa Nebat tapa Jeroboam in Bethel a maitam leh Israelte thil hihkhialsakpa Nebat tapa Jeroboam in abawl mun sang, huai maitam ahihchim a mun sang mei ahal in asikzan a, Ashera ahal hi.
english: Moreover the altar that was at Bethel and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, even that altar and the high place he broke down; and he burned the high place and beat it to dust, and burned the Asherah.

paite: Josiah akihei a, tang a hante amu a; huchi in han a guhte ava lasak a, huai thu Pathian mipa'n ana gen, TOUPA thu bangbang in maitam tung ah ahal a, ahihbuah hi.
english: As Josiah turned himself, he spied the tombs that were there in the mountain; and he sent, and took the bones out of the tombs, and burned them on the altar, and defiled it, according to Yahweh’s word which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these things.

paite: Huchi in ama'n, "Huai a ka muh kua suangphuh ahia?" achi a; khomite'n, “Pathian mipa, Judah gam a pan hong pai, Bethel a maitam tung a tua na hih a na genkholpa han ei ve," chi in ahilh uhi.
english: Then he said, “What monument is that which I see?” The men of the city told him, “It is the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and proclaimed these things that you have done against the altar of Bethel.”

paite: Ama'n, "Bangmah chih kei un; kuamah in aguhte lasuan kei hen," achi hi. Huchi in aguhte Samaria gam a pan zawlnei hong paipa guhte toh bangmah achih kei uhi.
english: He said, “Let him be! Let no one move his bones.” So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet who came out of Samaria.

paite: Israel Kumpipate'n TOUPA hehsak dia alam uh Samaria gam khua a mun sang inn tengteng leng Josiah in asuanmang a, Bethel a ahih vek bang geih in ahih hi.
english: All the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke Yahweh to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Bethel.

paite: Huchi in huai a mun sang siampu tengteng maitam tung ah athat a, huaite ah mihing guhte ahal a, Jerusalem ah akik nawnta hi.
english: He killed all the priests of the high places that were there, on the altars, and burned men’s bones on them; and he returned to Jerusalem.

paite: Kumpipa'n mi tengteng kiang ah, "Hiai thukhun bu a tuang bang in TOUPA, Pathian a ding in Paikan Ankuang zang un," chi in thu apia hi.
english: The king commanded all the people, saying, “Keep the Passover to Yahweh your God, as it is written in this book of the covenant.”

paite: Israelte tung a vaihawm mite'n vai ahawm ua kipan Israel kumpipa tengteng, Judah kumpipate lal sung hun teng in huchibang hial Paikan Ankuang azang ngei nai kei uhi.
english: Surely there was not kept such a Passover from the days of the judges who judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;

paite: Kumpipa Josiah lal akum sawm-le-giatna kum in Jerusalem ah TOUPA a ding in hiai bang in Paikan Ankuang anei phet uhi.
english: but in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, this Passover was kept to Yahweh in Jerusalem.

paite: Huai ban ah TOUPA' inn a siampu Hilkiah in amuh laibu a thu tuangte akipsak theihna ding in dawi aisan siam zawlte, bumsiamte, pathian limte, Judah gam leh Jerusalem a thilkihhuai amuh tengteng Josiah in ahihmang vek hi.
english: Moreover, Josiah removed those who had familiar spirits, the wizards, and the teraphim, and the idols, and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, that he might confirm the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Mosi Dan tengteng alungtang leh kha tengteng leh hatna tengteng a TOUPA pom amah bang mahmah ama a kumpipate kuamah a-om kei ua; anung in leng amah bang kuamah a-om nawn sam kei hi.
english: There was no king like him before him, who turned to Yahweh with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; and there was none like him who arose after him.

paite: Huchipi in leng TOUPA'N athangpaihna thupi mahmah, Manasseh in ana thangpaihsakna tengteng ziak in Judah tung a athangpaihna akiheisan kei hi.
english: Notwithstanding, Yahweh didn’t turn from the fierceness of his great wrath, with which his anger burned against Judah, because of all the provocation with which Manasseh had provoked him.

paite: TOUPA'N, “Israel ka suanmang bang in Judah leng ka muhphaklouhna ah ka suanmang sam dia, hiai khua ka tel Jerusalem ngei leh huai a inn ka min a-omna ding, ka chih ka paimang ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said, “I will also remove Judah out of my sight, as I have removed Israel; and I will cast off this city which I have chosen, even Jerusalem, and the house of which I said, ‘My name shall be there.’”

paite: Huchi in Josiah tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah tuang ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Amah alal lai in Assuria kumpipa dou ding in Euphrates Luipi ah Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh Neko ahohtou hi. Kumpipa Josiah in amah ana dou a; ama'n amuhtak in Meggiddo ah athat hi.
english: In his days Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates; and King Josiah went against him, but Pharaoh Necoh killed him at Megiddo when he saw him.

paite: Huchi in asikhate'n Meggiddo a pan aluang kangtalai in apaipih ua, Jerusalem ah alutpih ua, ama han ah avui uh. Huchi in huai gam a mite'n Josiah tapa Jehoahaz api ua, thau anilh ua, apa sik in kumpipa in abawlta uhi.
english: His servants carried him dead in a chariot from Megiddo, brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own tomb. The people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s place.

paite: Jehoahaz alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-thum a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kha thum sung alal a; anu min Hemutal, Libnah a Jeremiah tanu ahi.
english: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

paite: Api-le-pute hih bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.

paite: Pharaoh Neko in Jerusalem a vaihawm thei nawn lou ding in Hamath gam a Riblah ah akoltangsak a; agam uh dangka talent zakhat leh dangka-eng talent khat siah akipesak hi.
english: Pharaoh Necoh put him in bonds at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

paite: Pharaoh Neko in Josiah tapa Eliakim, apa Josiah sik in alalsak a, amin Jehoiakim chi in akheksak hi. Jehoahaz bel apimang a; Aigupta gam ah apai a, huai ah asita hi.
english: Pharaoh Necoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the place of Josiah his father, and changed his name to Jehoiakim; but he took Jehoahaz away, and he came to Egypt and died there.

paite: Jehoiakim in dangka leh dangka-eng Pharaoh ape phot a; himahleh Pharaoh thupiak bang a dangka apiakna ding in agam siah aliausak hi. Pharaoh Neko kiang a piak ding in michih liau dia aseh zah chiat bang in huai gam a mite dangka leh dangka-eng aliausak hi.
english: Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh. He exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, from everyone according to his assessment, to give it to Pharaoh Necoh.

paite: Jehoiakim alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-khat alal a; anu min Zebudah, Rumah a Pedaiah tanu ahi.
english: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zebidah the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

paite: Huchi in api-le-pute hihdan bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.

paite: Alal lai hun in Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in huai gam ahong dou a, Jehoiakim bel asikha in kum thum a-om hi. Huai nung in alehngatsan a, atung ah ahelta hi.
english: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant for three years. Then he turned and rebelled against him.

paite: TOUPA'N Kaldai pawlte, Siria pawlte, Moab pawlte, Ammon suan pawlte amah sual ding in asawlkhia a, asikha zawlneite zang a agen TOUPA thu bang in Judah gam hihsesak ding in asawl hi.
english: Yahweh sent against him bands of the Chaldeans, bands of the Syrians, bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to Yahweh’s word which he spoke by his servants the prophets.

paite: Manasseh khelhna, athilhih tengteng ziak a, amuh phaklouhna a amaute suanmang ding in, Judah tung ah TOUPA thupiak ahong tung petmah hi.
english: Surely at the commandment of Yahweh this came on Judah, to remove them out of his sight for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did,

paite: Midik sisan asuah ziak in leng; midik sisan a Jerusalem ahihdim ziak in leng TOUPA'N amah angaidam kei hi.
english: and also for the innocent blood that he shed; for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and Yahweh would not pardon.

paite: Huchi in Jehoiakim tanchin dang leh athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah tuang ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Huchi in Jehoiakim bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; asik in atapa Jehoiakin alalta hi.
english: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers, and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.

paite: Aigupta kumpipa agam a pan ahong kuankhe nawn kei; Babulon kumpipa'n Aigupta gam lui a pan Euphrates Luipi pha a kumpipa gam huap tengteng alak zoh tak ziak in.
english: The king of Egypt didn’t come out of his land any more; for the king of Babylon had taken, from the brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates, all that belonged to the king of Egypt.

paite: Jehoiakin bel alal pat tung in kum sawm-le-giat a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kha thum alal a, anu min Nehushta, Jerusalem a Elnathan tanu ahi.
english: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

paite: Apa hihdan tengteng hih in, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that his father had done.

paite: Huchih lai in Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar sikhate Jerusalem ah ahohtou ua, khua ava um uhi.
english: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up to Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

paite: Huchi a asikhate'n ava um lai un khua ah Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar ava hohtou hi,
english: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging it,

paite: Huchi in Judah kumpipa Jehoiakin, anu, asikhate, amiliante, aheutute toh Babulon kumpipa kiang ah ava pawtkhia ua; alal akum giatna kum in Babulon kumpipa'n ana man hi.
english: and Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon—he, his mother, his servants, his princes, and his officers; and the king of Babylon captured him in the eighth year of his reign.

paite: TOUPA gen bang in, a-inn a gou tengteng leh kumpipa' inn a gou tengteng ala vek a, TOUPA tempul a Israelte kumpipa Solomon in dangka-eng tui-um belsuan abawl tengteng asatgawp vek hi.
english: He carried out from there all the treasures of Yahweh’s house and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in Yahweh’s temple, as Yahweh had said.

paite: Jerusalem a mi tengteng, milian tengteng, mihat hangsan hoih tengteng, singkhat leh khutsiam leh siksekmi tengteng sal in api vek hi. Huai gam a migentheite chih louh kuamah a-omta kei uhi.
english: He carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valor, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and the smiths. No one remained except the poorest people of the land.

paite: Jehoiakin bel Babulon ah api a; kumpipa nu, kumpinute, aheutute leh huai gam a mihatte Jerusalem a pan Babulon ah sal in api hi.
english: He carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, with the king’s mother, the king’s wives, his officers, and the chief men of the land. He carried them into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

paite: Babulon kumpipa'n pasal hoih tengteng sangsagih leh khutsiam leh siksekmi sangkhat, mihat hoih teng gal dou thei mi ngen Babulon ah sal in api vek hi.
english: All the men of might, even seven thousand, and the craftsmen and the smiths one thousand, all of them strong and fit for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

paite: Apa unaupa Mattaniah, Babulon kumpipa'n asik in alalsak a, amin Zedekiah chi in akheksak hi.
english: The king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s father’s brother, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

paite: Zedekiah bel alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-khat a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-khat sung alal a; anu min Hamutal, Libnah a Jeremiah tanu ahi.
english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

paite: Jehoiakim hihdan tengteng bang in ahih a, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

paite: TOUPA hehna tawn in Jerusalem leh Judah tung ah Zedekiah, Babulon kumpipa tung a ahel a pan ama'n amuh phak louh dia apaihmang masiah hiai thilte ahong tungta hi.
english: For through the anger of Yahweh, this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Then Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

paite: Alal kum kuana kum, akha sawmna, ani sawm ni in hichi ahong hi a, asepaih tengteng toh Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar hong kuan in Jerusalem ahong dou a, om mun ava bawl a; kulh in a-umsuakta hi.
english: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it around it.

paite: Hichi in kumpipa Zedekiah lal akum sawm-le-khatna tan in khua um in a-om hi.
english: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

paite: Akha lina, ani kua ni in khua akial mahmahta a, huai gam mite a ding in tanghou a-om kei hi.
english: On the ninth day of the fourth month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

paite: Khopi kulh ahihvang ua, zan in gal dou thei mi tengteng kumpipa huan ning, kulhbaang nih kikal a kulh kongpi ah ataikhe vek ua; Kaldaite'n khua a umsuak uhi; kumpipa Arabah lampi ah apai hi.
english: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden (now the Chaldeans were against the city around it); and the king went by the way of the Arabah.

paite: Himahleh Kaldai sepaihte'n kumpipa adelh ua, Jeriko Phaizang ah apha ua; asepaih tengteng in amah taizaksan vek uhi.
english: But the Chaldean army pursued the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa aman ua, Babulon kumpipa kiang ah Riblah ah api ua; atungtang thu angaihtuah uhi.
english: Then they captured the king and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they passed judgment on him.

paite: Zedekiah tapate amitmuh ngei in athat ua, Zedekiah mitte akhelkhiaksak ua, kol abunsak ua, Babulon ah apaipih uhi.
english: They killed Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes, then put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

paite: Huchi in Babulon kumpipa, kumpipa Nebukadnezzar lal akum sawm-le-kuana, akha ngana, ani sagih ni in Jerusalem ah Babulon kumpipa vengmi pawl heutu Nebuzaradan alut hi.
english: Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

paite: TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn ahal a; Jerusalem inn tengteng, inn thupi taktakte ahal hi.
english: He burned Yahweh’s house, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem. He burned every great house with fire.

paite: Vengmi pawl heutu kiang a om Kaldai sepaih tengteng in Jerusalem kim a kulhte ahihchim vek uhi.
english: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down the walls around Jerusalem.

paite: Khopi sung a nutsiat a om mite, Babulon kumpipa kiang a kipia mite leh mipi dang teng vengmi pawl heutu Nebuzaradan in sal in api vek hi.
english: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive the rest of the people who were left in the city and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon—all the rest of the multitude.

paite: Huai gam a azawng tatate lak a mite vengmi pawl heutu in grepgui kem ding leh lou bawl ding in anusia hi.
english: But the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to work the vineyards and fields.

paite: TOUPA' inn a dalkhuamte leh atunnate leh dal limlang tuipi Kaldaite'n ahihkekgawp vek ua, adal Babulon ah apaipih uhi.
english: The Chaldeans broke up the pillars of bronze that were in Yahweh’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in Yahweh’s house, and carried the bronze pieces to Babylon.

paite: Belte, vutluahnate, khawnvak puantehnate, keute leh dal tui-um belsuan tengteng, nasepna dia azatte uh ala uhi.
english: They took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.

paite: Mei laknate, belkuangte toh, vengmi pawl heutu in dangka-eng abawlte bel adangka-eng ala a, dangkasik a bawlte adangka ala hi.
english: The captain of the guard took away the fire pans, the basins, that which was of gold, for gold, and that which was of silver, for silver.

paite: Solomon in TOUPA' inn a dia abawl khuampi nih, tuikuangpi khat leh atunnate leh hiai vanzat tengteng bawlna dal buk theih vual ahi kei hi.
english: The two pillars, the one sea, and the bases, which Solomon had made for Yahweh’s house, the bronze of all these vessels was not weighed.

paite: Khuam khat sandan tong sawm-le-giat ahi a, adawn ah dal sunbawk a-om a; huai sunbawk sandan tong thum ahi. Sunbawk kim ah agial tiktek leh theibuhfai atuang a, dal a bawl vek ahi uh. Huchi mah bang in khuampi khat leng agial tiktek hi.
english: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and a capital of bronze was on it. The height of the capital was three cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital around it, all of bronze; and the second pillar with its network was like these.

paite: Vengmi pawl heutu in siampu lianpen Seraiah leh azompa siampu Zephaniah leh kongkhak vengmi thum aman hi.
english: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold;

paite: Galdou thei mite tung a heutu khat toh, kumpipa kiang a om khopi tung a om lai ngate toh, mipite mingelhpa sepaihte heutu laigelhmi toh, khopi sung a om lai gam a mi sawmguk toh khopi sung a pan aman hi.
english: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and five men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe, the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the city.

paite: Vengmi pawl heutu Nebuzaradan in amau api a, Babulon kumpipa kiang ah Riblah ah apaipih hi.
english: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

paite: Babulon kumpipa'n Hamath gam, Riblah ah amau ana that hi. Huchi in Judah, agamsung a pan sal a pikhiak in a-omta hi.
english: The king of Babylon attacked them and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.

paite: Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in Judah gam a anutsiat teng tung ah Shaphan tapa Ahikam tapa Gedaliah ukpa ding in abawl hi.
english: As for the people who were left in the land of Judah whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, governor.

paite: Huchi in sepaih pawl heutu tengteng leh aheute'n Babulon kumpipa'n Gedaliah ukpa in abawl chih azak un Mizpah ah Gedaliah kiang ah ahoh ua, huaite bel Nathaniah tapa Ishmael, Kareah tapa Johanan, Netophah mi Tanhumeth tapa Seraiah, Mak mi tapa Jaazaniah leh aheute ahi uhi.
english: Now when all the captains of the forces, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, Johanan the son of Kareah, Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.

paite: Gedaliah huai mite leh aheute uh kiang ah akichiam a, akiang uah, "Kaldaite sikha a om lau kei un. Hiai gam ah teng unla, Babulon kumpipa na sem un, huchi in nou a ding in ahoih ding," achi hi.
english: Gedaliah swore to them and to their men, and said to them, “Don’t be afraid because of the servants of the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.”

paite: Himahleh akha sagihna ah hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa suan Elishama tapa, Nethaniah tapa Ishmael bel mi sawmkhat toh ahong kuan a, Mizpah a Juda mi leh Kaldai mi akiang a om teng leh Gedaliah ahong sual ua, athat vek uhi.
english: But in the seventh month, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal offspring came, and ten men with him, and struck Gedaliah so that he died, with the Jews and the Chaldeans that were with him at Mizpah.

paite: Huchi in mi tengteng aneu leh alian in sepaih heutute toh apawtkhia ua, Kaldaite alauh ziak un Aigupta gam ah apaita uhi.
english: All the people, both small and great, and the captains of the forces arose and came to Egypt; for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.

paite: Judah kumpipa Jehoiakin saltan akum sawmthum-le-sagihna, akha sawm-le-nihna, ani sawmnih-le-sagih ni in hichi ahong hi a, Babulon kumpipa Evil-merodak in alal pat tung kum in Judah kumpipa Jehoiakin atanna inn a pan akhahkhia hi.
english: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, released Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison,

paite: Akiang ah hoihtak in thu agen a, Babulon a kumpipa om samte laltutphah tung ah alaltutphah akoihsang tuamse hi.
english: and he spoke kindly to him and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,

paite: Atanna inn puansilhte akheng a, adamsung teng in akiang ah an ane gige samta hi.
english: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life;

paite: Huchi in aloh ding, kumpipa'n apiak tatlak lou a-om a, adamsung teng in, niteng a azat ding abawlsak gige hi.
english: and for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him from the king, every day a portion, all the days of his life.

paite: Huan Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat kum sawm-le-giat alal kum in Ahab tapa Jehoram Israelte tung ah Samaria ah alal pan a; kum sawm-le-nih alal hi.
english: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoihloupi ahih a; himahleh anu leh apa bang tel in zaw thil ahih kei. Ama'n apa Baal suangphuh apaimang hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, but not like his father and like his mother, for he put away the pillar of Baal that his father had made.

paite: Himahleh, Israelte thil hihkhialsak Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhnate amah ah abelh tinten a; huai apaisan kei hi.
english: Nevertheless he held to the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from them.
