paite: Moab kumpipa Mesha belam vul mi ahi a; ama'n Israel kumpipa kiang ah belamnou nuaikhat mul leh belampa nuaikhat mul siah aliau hi.
english: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder; and he supplied the king of Israel with one hundred thousand lambs and the wool of one hundred thousand rams.

paite: Himahleh Ahab sih nung in hichi ahong hi a, Moab kumpipa Israel kumpipa tung ah ahelta hi.
english: But when Ahab was dead, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

paite: Huchih lai in Samaria a pan kumpipa Jehoram apawt a, Israel tengteng akaikhawm vek hi.
english: King Jehoram went out of Samaria at that time, and mustered all Israel.

paite: Huchi in apawt a, Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Moab kumpipa ka tung ah ahel a, Moabte na hon doupih diam?" chi in mi asawl hi. Ama'n, "Hon doupih e, kei leh nang, ka mite leh na mite pum khat i hi ua, ka sakolte leh na sakolte leng pum khat ahi uh," achi hi.
english: He went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, “The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me against Moab to battle?” He said, “I will go up. I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”

paite: Amah mah in, "Koi lampi ah ahia i kuan touh ding?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Edom gamdai lampi ah," achi hi.
english: Then he said, “Which way shall we go up?” Jehoram answered, “The way of the wilderness of Edom.”

paite: Huchi in Israel kumpipa Judah kumpipa toh, Edom kumpipa toh, akuanta ua; ni sagih apaikual ua; asepaihte leh agan tonpihte dawn ding tui a-omta kei hi.
english: So the king of Israel went with the king of Judah and the king of Edom, and they marched for seven days along a circuitous route. There was no water for the army or for the animals that followed them.

paite: Israel kumpipa'n, "E heh he! TOUPA'N kumpipa thumte Moabte khut a piak dia hon pikhawm ahi peuhmah ve,” achi hi.
english: The king of Israel said, “Alas! For Yahweh has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”

paite: Himahleh Jehoshaphat in, "Hiai ah TOUPA hon dotsak ding TOUPA zawlnei kuahiam bek a-om kei maw?" achi hi. Israel kumpipa sikha khat in adawng a, "Elijah khut tui buaksekpa Shaphat tapa Elisha hiai a om ei ve," achi hi.
english: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there a prophet of Yahweh here, that we may inquire of Yahweh by him?” One of the king of Israel’s servants answered, “Elisha the son of Shaphat, who poured water on the hands of Elijah, is here.”

paite: Jehoshaphat in, akiang ah, "Ama'n TOUPA thu anei hi," achi hi. Huchi in Israel kumpipa leh Jehoshaphat leh Edom kumpipa akiang ah ahohsukta uh.
english: Jehoshaphat said, “Yahweh’s word is with him.” So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

paite: Elisha in Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "Nang leh ke'n kizopna bang i nei a? Na pa zawlneite leh na nu zawlneite kiang ah va hoh in," achi hi. Israel kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Pai lou e; kumpipa thumte Moabte khut a piak ding in TOUPA'N ahon pikhawm hi,” achi hi.
english: Elisha said to the king of Israel, “What have I to do with you? Go to the prophets of your father, and to the prophets of your mother.” The king of Israel said to him, “No, for Yahweh has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”

paite: Elisha in, "Akiang a ka dinna sepaihte' TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat zahtak lou hi leng nang lam leng ka nga kei dia, muh leng ka hon mu het kei ding.
english: Elisha said, “As Yahweh of Armies lives, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I respect the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward you, nor see you.

paite: Himahleh, kaihging tumsiammi hon sam un," achi hi. Kaihging tumsiam in ahon tumleh, hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA khut atung ah ahong omta hi.
english: But now bring me a musician.” When the musician played, Yahweh’s hand came on him.

paite: Ama'n, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hiai phaizang tengteng toukuak tektuk un.
english: He said, “Yahweh says, ‘Make this valley full of trenches.’

paite: TOUPA mah in hichi in achi: Huih himhim na mu kei ding ua, vuah himhim leng na mu sam kei ding uh. Himahleh hiai phaizang tui in adim vek ding hi. Huchi in nou leh na bawnghonte uh leh na gante un adawn ding uh.
english: For Yahweh says, ‘You will not see wind, neither will you see rain, yet that valley will be filled with water, and you will drink, both you and your livestock and your other animals.

paite: Hiai TOUPA ngaih in thil neuchik lel ahi a; Moabte na khut uah ahon piak behlap ding hi.
english: This is an easy thing in Yahweh’s sight. He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.

paite: Kulhpi nei khua tengteng leh khopi hoih tengteng na hihse ding ua, sing hoih tengteng na phuk ding ua, tuikhuk tengteng na hubing ding ua, mun hoih tata suang in na dengse vek ding uh," achi hi.
english: You shall strike every fortified city and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all springs of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.’”

paite: Zingsang in, thillat lat hun lai in hichi ahong hi a, ngai in, Edom gam lam a pan tui ahong luang a, tui in agam ahong dimta hi.
english: In the morning, about the time of offering the sacrifice, behold, water came by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.

paite: Moab tengteng in amau sual ding in kumpipate ahong kuantou uh chih ana zak un, galdou thei chiang tengteng ana kikaikhawm ua, gamgi ah ana pangta uhi.
english: Now when all the Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them, they gathered themselves together, all who were able to put on armor, young and old, and stood on the border.

paite: Huchi in zingkhang in athou ua, ni in tui tung a hon salvak a, Moabte'n azawn ua tui sisan bang a san in amu uhi.
english: They rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone on the water, and the Moabites saw the water opposite them as red as blood.

paite: "Sisan ei ve, kumpipate amau le amau akidou ua, amau leh amau kithat uh ahi mahmah ve. Kisa un, Moabte aw, gallak thil i va tuh ding uh,” achi uhi.
english: They said, “This is blood. The kings are surely destroyed, and they have struck each other. Now therefore, Moab, to the plunder!”

paite: Israelte giahphual ava tun uleh, Israelte ahong thou phut ua, Moabte asual ua, huchi in ama uah ataikek uh. Moabte that kawm in agam uah adelhlutta uhi.
english: When they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and struck the Moabites, so that they fled before them; and they went forward into the land attacking the Moabites.

paite: Khuate ahihsia ua; amun hoih tata teng uh michih in adeng ua, suang in adimgawpta hi. Tuikhuk tengteng ahubing ua, sing hoih tengteng aphuk ua; Kir-hareseth a om suangte kia akhoih kei uhi. Huai leng vaisuanglot tawi pawl in a-umkimvel ua, asual uhi.
english: They beat down the cities; and on every good piece of land each man cast his stone, and filled it. They also stopped all the springs of water and cut down all the good trees, until in Kir Hareseth all they left was its stones; however the men armed with slings went around it and attacked it.

paite: Moab kumpipa'n akidou uh zou ding in akitheita kei, Edom kumpipa kiang a tung dia phut paisuak tum in namsau tawimi zasagih apikhia a, himahleh alohsam uhi.
english: When the king of Moab saw that the battle was too severe for him, he took with him seven hundred men who drew a sword, to break through to the king of Edom; but they could not.

paite: Huchi in atapa upapen, asik a hong lal ding pen kulh dawn ah halmang thillat in alanta hi. Huchi in Israelte atung ah aheh mahmah ua, akisa ua, agam uah apaikik nawnta uhi.
english: Then he took his oldest son who would have reigned in his place, and offered him for a burnt offering on the wall. There was great wrath against Israel; and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.

paite: Huan zawlneite tapate' zite lak a numei khat in Elisha kiang ah, "Na sikha, ka pasal ana sita hi. Na sikha in TOUPA alau chih na thei a; aleibatna pa'n ka tate anih ua sikha dia pi ding in ahong kuan hi," chi in amangbat thu ahilh hi.
english: Now a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha, saying, “Your servant my husband is dead. You know that your servant feared Yahweh. Now the creditor has come to take for himself my two children to be slaves.”

paite: Elisha in akiang ah, "Bang ka hon hihsak dia? Hon hilh ve, inn ah bang na nei a?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Na sikhanu'n sathau um khat kia lou ngal inn ah bangmah ka nei kei," achi hi.
english: Elisha said to her, “What should I do for you? Tell me, what do you have in the house?” She said, “Your servant has nothing in the house, except a pot of oil.”

paite: Huchi in ama'n, "Va kuan inla, na invengte tengteng bel vuak va khelkhawm in; tam lou kia zaw khel ke'n.
english: Then he said, “Go, borrow empty containers from all your neighbors. Don’t borrow just a few containers.

paite: Na hong lut chiang in na tapate toh kong kikhakkhum unla, huai tuh tengteng ah sathau thun inla; adimdim in na tuamkoih ding,” achi hi.
english: Go in and shut the door on you and on your sons, and pour oil into all those containers; and set aside those which are full.”

paite: Huchi in akiang a pan apaita a, amah leh atapate toh kong akikhakkhum ua; amau belte ahon la ua, ama'n ana thun zel hi.
english: So she went from him, and shut the door on herself and on her sons. They brought the containers to her, and she poured oil.

paite: Belte adim nung in, hichi ahong hi a, atapa kiang ah, "Bel hon la nawn dih," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Bel a-om nawn kei," achi hi. Huchi in sathau akangta hi.
english: When the containers were full, she said to her son, “Bring me another container.” He said to her, “There isn’t another container.” Then the oil stopped flowing.

paite: Huai khit in Pathian mipa kiang ah ava hoh a, thil omdan ava hilh hi. Ama'n, "Va pai inla, sathau va zuak inla, na leibat va din inla, aval in na tapate toh khosa un,” achi hi.
english: Then she came and told the man of God. He said, “Go, sell the oil, and pay your debt; and you and your sons live on the rest.”

paite: Ni khat Shunem ah Elisha ava zin hi. Huai ah numei neizoutak khat a-om hi. Ama'n an ne ding in ana sawl teitei hi. Huchi in apai peuhmah chiang in huai ah an ne ding in alut hi.
english: One day Elisha went to Shunem, where there was a prominent woman; and she persuaded him to eat bread. So it was, that as often as he passed by, he turned in there to eat bread.

paite: Ama'n apasal kiang ah, “Ngai in, hiai mi hon nawk zelpa Pathian misiangthoupa ahi, chih ka thei.
english: She said to her husband, “See now, I perceive that this is a holy man of God who passes by us continually.

paite: Kisa dih, inn pindan neu i bawlsak dia, lupna, dohkan, tutphah leh khawnvak koihna i koihsak ding. Huchi a i kiang a ahong chiang in alut zel ding,” achi hi.
english: Please, let’s make a little room on the roof. Let’s set a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp stand for him there. When he comes to us, he can stay there.”

paite: Ni khat ava hoh a, huai in pindan ah ava lut a, ava lum hi.
english: One day he came there, and he went to the room and lay there.

paite: Asikha Gehazi kiang ah, "Hiai Shunem numei hon sam dih," achi hi. Ava sam a ama ah ahong dingh hi.
english: He said to Gehazi his servant, “Call this Shunammite.” When he had called her, she stood before him.

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, nang nakpitak in na hon deihthoh a, bang ka hon hihsak sam dia, kumpipa hiam, sepaih heutu hiam hon houpihsak leng na ut hia? chi in akiang ah gen in," achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Ка chipihte lak mah a teng ka hi," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “Say now to her, ‘Behold, you have cared for us with all this care. What is to be done for you? Would you like to be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the army?’” She answered, “I dwell among my own people.”

paite: Ama'n, "Amah a dia bang hih ding ahia le?" achi hi. Gehazi in adawng a, "Tapa anei kei, apasal lah a-upata a," achi hi.
english: He said, “What then is to be done for her?” Gehazi answered, “Most certainly she has no son, and her husband is old.”

paite: Ama'n, "Va sam dih," achi hi. Ava sam a, kong ah ahong dingh hi.
english: He said, “Call her.” When he had called her, she stood in the door.

paite: Ama'n, "Tu bang hun ahong tun nawn chiang in tapa na pomta ding," achi hi. Ama'n, "Maizen, toupa, nang Pathian mipa in na sikhanu kiang ah zuaugen ke'n," achi hi.
english: He said, “At this season next year, you will embrace a son.” She said, “No, my lord, you man of God, do not lie to your servant.”

paite: Huchi in numei agai a, Elisha in akiang a, agen bang a ahun ahong tun nawn in tapa aneita hi.
english: The woman conceived, and bore a son at that season when the time came around, as Elisha had said to her.

paite: Naungek ahong khanglian a, ni khat apa toh buh la mite kiang ah akuan hi.
english: When the child was grown, one day he went out to his father to the reapers.

paite: Apa kiang ah, "Ka lu, ka lu," achi hi. Apa'n sikha valnou khat kiang ah, "Pom inla, anu kiang ah paipih in," achi hi.
english: He said to his father, “My head! My head!” He said to his servant, “Carry him to his mother.”

paite: Apaipih a, anu kiang atun in aphei tung ah sun tan atu a, huchi in asita hi.
english: When he had taken him and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees until noon, and then died.

paite: Apaitou a, Pathian mipa lupna ah asial a, kong akhakkhum a, apawtta hi.
english: She went up and laid him on the man of God’s bed, and shut the door on him, and went out.

paite: Huchi in apasal asam a, "Sikha kuahiam leh sabiltung khat hon ngaihtuahsak dih ve, Pathian mipa kiang ah ka va tai dia, ka hong kik nawn ding,” achi hi.
english: She called to her husband and said, “Please send me one of the servants, and one of the donkeys, that I may run to the man of God and come again.”

paite: Ama'n, "Bangziak a tuni chitchiat a akiang a hoh tum na hia? Kha thak leng ahi kei a, Sabbath leng ahi ngal kei a," achi hi. Ama'n, “Ahoih ding," achi hi.
english: He said, “Why would you want to go to him today? It is not a new moon or a Sabbath.” She said, “It’s all right.”

paite: Huchi in sabiltung abawl a, asikha kiang ah, "Hawl inla malam ah pai in, thu ka hon piak keileh awl pai ke'n," achi hi.
english: Then she saddled a donkey, and said to her servant, “Drive, and go forward! Don’t slow down for me, unless I ask you to.”

paite: Huchi in apaita a, Pathian mipa kiang ah Karmel tang ah ava hoh hi. Pathian mipa'n gamlapi a pan ana muh in, hichi ahong hi a, asikha Gehazi kiang ah, "En in, huai ah Shunem numei a-om.
english: So she went, and came to the man of God to Mount Carmel. When the man of God saw her afar off, he said to Gehazi his servant, “Behold, there is the Shunammite.

paite: Amah dawn ding in va tai inla, akiang ah, na dam hia? Na pasal adam maw? Naupang leng adam maw? va chi in,” achi hi. Ama'n ana dawng a, "Dam e," achi hi.
english: Please run now to meet her, and ask her, ‘Is it well with you? Is it well with your husband? Is it well with your child?’” She answered, “It is well.”

paite: Mual a Pathian mipa kiang ava tun in, akhe alen tinten a, amah hong sawnhang tum in Gehazi in ava naih hi. Himahleh Pathian mipa'n, "Bangmah chih ke'n, alungsim mangbang ahi. TOUPA'N ka lak ah asel a, ahon hilh nai kei hi,” achi hi.
english: When she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught hold of his feet. Gehazi came near to thrust her away; but the man of God said, “Leave her alone, for her soul is troubled within her; and Yahweh has hidden it from me, and has not told me.”

paite: Huchi in ama'n, "Ka toupa, tapa ka hon ngen a hia? Hon khem ke'n, ka hon chi hilou maw?" achi hi.
english: Then she said, “Did I ask you for a son, my lord? Didn’t I say, ‘Do not deceive me’?”

paite: Huchi in Gehazi kiang ah, "Na puan teng inla, ka chiangkhun tawi in va hoh in. Kuapeuh mu lechin leng, chibai buk ke'n. Kuapeuh in chibai ahon buk uleh leng dawng ke'n. Naupang maitang ah ka chiangkhun va nga in," achi hi.
english: Then he said to Gehazi, “Tuck your cloak into your belt, take my staff in your hand, and go your way. If you meet any man, don’t greet him; and if anyone greets you, don’t answer him again. Then lay my staff on the child’s face.”

paite: Naupang nu'n, "TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi, ka hon khah het kei ding,” achi hi. Huchi in athou a, azuita hi.
english: The child’s mother said, “As Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So he arose, and followed her.

paite: Gehazi in amau ana makhelh a, naupang mai ah chiangkhun ana nga hi. Himahleh aw leh zak bangmah a-om kei. Huchi in houpih ding in akik nawn a, "Naupang hak het kei veh aw," chi in ahilh hi.
english: Gehazi went ahead of them, and laid the staff on the child’s face; but there was no voice and no hearing. Therefore he returned to meet him, and told him, “The child has not awakened.”

paite: Elisha insung ava lutleh ngai in, naupang asi khinta a, alupna ah ana lumsak lai uhi.
english: When Elisha had come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and lying on his bed.

paite: Huchi in ava lut a, anih un kong akhakkhum a, TOUPA kiang ah athum hi.
english: He went in therefore, and shut the door on them both, and prayed to Yahweh.

paite: Apaitou a, naupang abohkhum a, amuk leh amuk, amit leh amit, akhut leh akhut asutuah a; atung ah akizan a; huchi in naupang taksa ahong lum hiaihiai hi.
english: He went up and lay on the child, and put his mouth on his mouth, and his eyes on his eyes, and his hands on his hands. He stretched himself on him; and the child’s flesh grew warm.

paite: Huchi in akik nawn a, insung ah akivialleh a; ahohtou a, atung ah abok a; huchi in naupang sagihvei ahong hahchiai a, ahong hakta hi.
english: Then he returned, and walked in the house once back and forth, then went up and stretched himself out on him. Then the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.

paite: Huchi in Gehazi asam a, "Hiai Shunem numei hon sam dih," achi hi. Ava sam a, akiang a ava lutleh, "Na tapa pom in," ana chi hi.
english: He called Gehazi, and said, “Call this Shunammite!” So he called her. When she had come in to him, he said, “Take up your son.”

paite: Huchi in ava lut a, akhebul ah abokkhup a, amai a lei si in akun a; atapa apom a, apawtkhia hi.
english: Then she went in, fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground; then she picked up her son, and went out.

paite: Gilgal ah Elisha ahoh nawn hi. Huai gam ah kial akia hi. Zawlneite tapate ama ah atukhawm ua; ama'n asikha kiang ah, "Bel lianpi suang inla, zawlneite tapate an huansak in," achi hi.
english: Elisha came again to Gilgal. There was a famine in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him; and he said to his servant, “Get the large pot, and boil stew for the sons of the prophets.”

paite: Mi khat gam ah meh zong in ava kuan a, gam khau ava mu a, agah khenkhat alou a, apuan in atun theih zah atun a, a-atnen a, bel sung ah akha hi. Bang ahia chih athei kuamah a-om kei uh.
english: One went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered a lap full of wild gourds from it, and came and cut them up into the pot of stew; for they didn’t recognize them.

paite: Huchi in huai mite nek ding in asuakkhia ua, anhuan anek ualeh, hichi ahong hi a, "Ehe, Pathian mi, bel sung a sihna om akei maw,” achi kheukhou ua; ane theita kei uh.
english: So they poured out for the men to eat. As they were eating some of the stew, they cried out and said, “Man of God, there is death in the pot!” And they could not eat it.

paite: Ama'n, "Tangbuang hon la dih ua,” achi a; huai tuh ah akha hi, “Mite nek ding in hon suakkhe dih ua,” achi hi. Huchi in bel ah lauhuai bangmah a-omta kei hi.
english: But he said, “Then bring meal.” He threw it into the pot; and he said, “Serve it to the people, that they may eat.” And there was nothing harmful in the pot.

paite: Baal-shalisha a pan mi khat ahong a, Pathian mipa a ding in buh thak masapen abawl barli buh sangpek sawmnih leh buh thak vui a-ip in ahon tawi a; ama'n, "Hiai mite nek ding in pia in," achi hi.
english: A man from Baal Shalishah came, and brought the man of God some bread of the first fruits: twenty loaves of barley and fresh ears of grain in his sack. Elisha said, “Give to the people, that they may eat.”

paite: Asikha in, "Bang e, mi zakhattak hiai ka lui ding maw?" achi hi. Ama'n hiai mite nek ding pia in. TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Ane ding ua, akhamval lai ding uh," achi hi.
english: His servant said, “What, should I set this before a hundred men?” But he said, “Give it to the people, that they may eat; for Yahweh says, ‘They will eat, and will have some left over.’”

paite: Huchi in alui a, ane ua, TOUPA chih bang ngei in akhamval lai uhi.
english: So he set it before them and they ate and had some left over, according to Yahweh’s word.

paite: Siria kumpipa sepaih heutu Naaman, TOUPA'N Siriate humbitpa a azat ziak in, apu ngaih in thupi leh zahtakhuaitak ahi. Amah mihat ahi lai a, himahleh aphak hi.
english: Now Naaman, captain of the army of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honorable, because by him Yahweh had given victory to Syria; he was also a mighty man of valor, but he was a leper.

paite: Siriate apawlpawl in akuankhia ua, Israel gam a pan numei naupangnou khat sal in ahon pi ua; ama'n Naaman zi nna asem hi.
english: The Syrians had gone out in bands, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little girl, and she waited on Naaman’s wife.

paite: Ama'n api kiang ah, "Samaria a om zawlnei kiang ah ka toupa va hohleh chi na ing e! Ama'n aphakna na hihdamsak ding hi a,” achi hi.
english: She said to her mistress, “I wish that my lord were with the prophet who is in Samaria! Then he would heal him of his leprosy.”

paite: Mi khat ava lut a, atoupa kiang ah, "Israel gam a numei naupangnou in huchibang khachibang in agen," chi in apu ahilh hi.
english: Someone went in and told his lord, saying, “The girl who is from the land of Israel said this.”

paite: Siria kumpipa'n, "Va hoh hen aw, Israel kumpipa kiang ah lai ka khak ding,” achi hi. Huchi in apawt a, dangkasik talent sawm leh dangka-eng khal sangguk leh silh-le-ten kikhenna ding sawm akeng hi.
english: The king of Syria said, “Go now, and I will send a letter to the king of Israel.” He departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of clothing.

paite: Huai laikhak Israel kumpipa ava pia a, huai ah hiai akigelh hi, “Hiai lai na mu dia, ngai in, ka sikha Naaman aphakna na hihdamsak ding in na kiang ah ka hon sawl hi,” chih.
english: He brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, “Now when this letter has come to you, behold, I have sent Naaman my servant to you, that you may heal him of his leprosy.”

paite: Israel kumpipa'n huai lai asim a, hichi ahong hi a, apuan abotkek a, "Mite that thei a, hingsak nawn thei Pathian hia ka hih? Hiai mi in phak hihdam dia ka kiang ah ahon sawl mawkmawk. Ngaihtuah unla, ka tung ah thusia azong hi, chih thei dih ua," achi hi.
english: When the king of Israel had read the letter, he tore his clothes and said, “Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man sends to me to heal a man of his leprosy? But please consider and see how he seeks a quarrel against me.”

paite: Pathian mipa Elisha in Israel kumpipa'n apuan abotkek chih ana zak in, hichi ahong hi a, "Bangziak a na puan botkek na hia? Ka kiang ah hong paileh ake, huchi in Israel gam ah zawlnei a-om chih athei mai ding," va chi ding in kumpipa kiang ah mi asawl hi.
english: It was so, when Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had torn his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, “Why have you torn your clothes? Let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.”

paite: Huchi in asakolte leh akangtalaite toh Naaman ava hoh a, Elisha inn kongbul ah ava dingh hi.
english: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariots, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.

paite: Elisha in, "Jordan lui ah sagihvei va kisil inla, na sa in ngeina apu nawn dia, huchi in na siangta ding," chi ding in mi asawl hi.
english: Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying, “Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and your flesh shall come again to you, and you shall be clean.”

paite: Himahleh, Naaman aheh mahmah a, apaikhia a, “Ngai un, amah mah ka kiang a hong pawt dia, ahong dingh dia, TOUPA a Pathian min asam dia, ka phakna tung ah akhut akoih dia, ka phak damsak ding ei ve, chi mah hi veng in," achi hi.
english: But Naaman was angry, and went away and said, “Behold, I thought, ‘He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of Yahweh his God, and wave his hand over the place, and heal the leper.’

paite: "Israel gam lui tengteng sang in Damaskas kho luite, Abana leh Pharpar ahoihzaw kei a hia? Huaite a kisil in ka siangthou thei kei dia hia?" achi hi. Huchi in akilehhei a, heh mahmah in apai hi.
english: Aren’t Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Couldn’t I wash in them and be clean?” So he turned and went away in a rage.

paite: Asikhate'n ava naih ua, ava houpih ua, "Ka pa aw, zawlnei in thil haksatak hon hihsak dekleh leng na hihmai kei dia hia? Va kisil inla, hong siangthou in, achih pen hih zawk tuak lua hilou maw?" achi uhi.
english: His servants came near and spoke to him, and said, “My father, if the prophet had asked you do some great thing, wouldn’t you have done it? How much rather then, when he says to you, ‘Wash, and be clean’?”

paite: Huchi in ahohsuk a, Pathian mipa gen bang in Jordan lui ah sagihvei ava kidiah a; huchi in asa naungek sa bang ahong hi nawn a, ahong siangta hi.
english: Then went he down and dipped himself seven times in the Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God; and his flesh was restored like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

paite: Amah leh aheute tengteng Pathian mipa kiang ah akik nawn ua, ama ah ava dingh uhi. Ama'n, "Ngai in, Israel ah lou ngal leitung tengteng ah Pathian ana om kei, chih ka theita. Huaiziak in tu in na sikha vualzawlna la ding in ka hon ngen," achi hi.
english: He returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him; and he said, “See now, I know that there is no God in all the earth, but in Israel. Now therefore, please take a gift from your servant.”

paite: Himahleh ama'n, "Akiang a ka omna TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Bangmah ka la kei ding," achi hi. Huchi in ama'n la ding in angen a; himahleh ala ut kei bikbek hi.
english: But he said, “As Yahweh lives, before whom I stand, I will receive none.” He urged him to take it; but he refused.

paite: Naaman in, "Ahihkeileh, kei na sikha sabiltung nih puak khop leitang hon lasak in. Tuban siah kei na sikha in TOUPA kiang kia ah ngal lou halmang thillat leh kithoihna himhim pathian dangte kiang ah ka lan nawn het kei ding hi.
english: Naaman said, “If not, then, please let two mules’ load of earth be given to your servant; for your servant will from now on offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice to other gods, but to Yahweh.

paite: Hiai thil ah TOUPA'N na sikha ngaidam hen. Rimmon inn a be dia ka ban a kingai a ka toupa alut chiang a, kei leng ka kun sam angaih chiang in TOUPA'N hon ngaidam hen," achi hi.
english: In this thing may Yahweh pardon your servant: when my master goes into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leans on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon. When I bow myself in the house of Rimmon, may Yahweh pardon your servant in this thing.”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Lungmuangtak in pai in," achi hi. Huchi in akiang a pan apawt a, gamla lou apaikhe man hi.
english: He said to him, “Go in peace.” So he departed from him a little way.

paite: Himahleh Pathian mipa Elisha sikha Gehazi in, "Ngai in, ka pu in Siria mi Naaman thil hon tawite la het lou in apaisak mawk a. TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi, ka va delh dia, aneih banghiam bek ka va la ding," achi hi.
english: But Gehazi the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, “Behold, my master has spared this Naaman the Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought. As Yahweh lives, I will run after him, and take something from him.”

paite: Huchi in Gehazi in Naaman adelhta hi. Naaman in kuahiam in adelh amuh in, na houpih ding in kangtalai a pan akumkhia a, "Hoih vek na maw?" achi hi.
english: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. When Naaman saw one running after him, he came down from the chariot to meet him, and said, “Is all well?”

paite: Ama'n, "Hoih vek mah e. Ka pu in, ngai in, tu mah in Ephraim tanggam a pan in zawlneite tapate lak a tangval nih ka kiang ah ahong ahong ua, amaute dangkasik talent khat leh puansilh kikhenna ding nih pia in, chih gen ding in ahong sawl hi," achi hi.
english: He said, “All is well. My master has sent me, saying, ‘Behold, even now two young men of the sons of the prophets have come to me from the hill country of Ephraim. Please give them a talent of silver and two changes of clothing.’”

paite: Naaman in, "Khamuang inla, talent nih la ve," achi hi. Huchi in la ding in angen a, dangkasik talent nih puansilh kikhenna ding nih toh ip nih ah athun a, asikhate nih aposak a, ama ah apaipihta uhi.
english: Naaman said, “Be pleased to take two talents.” He urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of clothing, and laid them on two of his servants; and they carried them before him.

paite: Tang ava tun un alaksak a, insung ah akoih a; huchi in mite apaisakta hi.
english: When he came to the hill, he took them from their hand, and stored them in the house. Then he let the men go, and they departed.

paite: Amah alut a, apu ma ah ava dingh hi. Elisha in akiang ah, "Koi a hong kipan na hia, Gehazi?” achi hi. Ama'n, "Na sikha koimah ah ka hoh kei," achi hi.
english: But he went in, and stood before his master. Elisha said to him, “Where did you come from, Gehazi?” He said, “Your servant went nowhere.”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Nang mu dia kangtalai a pan huai mi ahong kum lai in ka lungtang na kiang ah apai kei maw? Sum, puansilhte, olive huante, grephuante, belamte, bawngtalte, sikhapate leh sikhanute lak hun ahi a hia?
english: He said to him, “Didn’t my heart go with you when the man turned from his chariot to meet you? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and olive groves and vineyards, and sheep and cattle, and male servants and female servants?

paite: Huaiziak in Naaman phak nang ah abelh dia, tangtawn in na suante ah leng abelh ding," achi hi. Huchi in a-omna a pan vuk bang a ngou in phaksa in apaikheta hi.
english: Therefore the leprosy of Naaman will cling to you and to your offspring forever.” He went out from his presence a leper, as white as snow.

paite: Huan zawlneite tapate'n Elisha kiang ah, "En in, hiai mun na kiang a ka tenna uh kou a ding in akochik lua hi.
english: The sons of the prophets said to Elisha, “See now, the place where we live and meet with you is too small for us.

paite: K'on ngen uh. Jordan lui ah ka hohsuk ding ua, huai ah sing ka va la chiat ding ua, ka tenna ding uh huai ah ka va lam ding uh aw?" achi uhi. Ama'n adawng a, "Kuan ve ua,” achi hi.
english: Please let us go to the Jordan, and each man take a beam from there, and let’s make us a place there, where we may live.” He answered, “Go!”

paite: Mi khat in, "Na sikhate kiang ah hoh sam in," achi hi. Ama'n, "Hoh sam leng akei dia," chi in adawng hi.
english: One said, “Please be pleased to go with your servants.” He answered, “I will go.”

paite: Huchi in akiang uah ahoh samta hi. Jordan lui atun un sing aphuk uhi.
english: So he went with them. When they came to the Jordan, they cut down wood.

paite: Mi khat in aphuk san lai in, aheitang tui ah akia hi. Ama'n, "Maizen! Pu, mi a kikhel ei ve," chi in akikou hi.
english: But as one was cutting down a tree, the ax head fell into the water. Then he cried out and said, “Alas, my master! For it was borrowed.”

paite: Pathian mipa in, "Koi lai ah ahia akiak?" achi hi. Ama'n akiakna mun a-ensak hi. Huchi in singhiang khat asat a, huai ah apailut a, sik ahong kilam hi.
english: The man of God asked, “Where did it fall?” He showed him the place. He cut down a stick, threw it in there, and made the iron float.

paite: Ama'n, "Tawm aw le," achi a; huchi in asawk a, atawmta hi.
english: He said, “Take it.” So he put out his hand and took it.

paite: Siria kumpipa'n Israelte ahong dou in, huai mun ah giahphual ka sat ding, chi in asikhate thu akum hi.
english: Now the king of Syria was at war against Israel; and he took counsel with his servants, saying, “My camp will be in such and such a place.”

paite: Pathian mipa'n Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "Huchibang mun a hoh lou ding in pilvang in. Huai ah Siriate ahong suk ding uh," chi in mi asawl hi.
english: The man of God sent to the king of Israel, saying, “Beware that you not pass this place, for the Syrians are coming down there.”

paite: Israel kumpipa'n Pathian mipa'n ana hilhna mun mi ava enkhesak zel hi. Huai ah khatvei nihvei phet lou in, ana kihumbit zel hi.
english: The king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of; and he saved himself there, not once or twice.

paite: Huchi in huai thu ah Siria kumpipa lungtang amangbanggawp hi. Asikhate asam a, akiang uah, "I lak ua mi akua pen ahia Israel kumpipa lam a pang? N'on hilh kei ding ua hia?" achi hi.
english: The king of Syria’s heart was very troubled about this. He called his servants, and said to them, “Won’t you show me which of us is for the king of Israel?”

paite: Asikhate lak a mi khat in, "Kuamah pang kei ve ung e, kumpipa, ka toupa aw. Israel gam a om zawlnei Elisha in na dantan sunggil a na gente Israel kumpipa ana hilh zel ahi zaw hi." achi hi.
english: One of his servants said, “No, my lord, O king; but Elisha, the prophet who is in Israel, tells the king of Israel the words that you speak in your bedroom.”

paite: Ama'n, "Koi a om ahia va simzon un, ka va mansak ding," achi hi, "Ngai in, Dothan ah a-om,” chi in ahilh uhi.
english: He said, “Go and see where he is, that I may send and get him.” He was told, “Behold, he is in Dothan.”

paite: Huchi in sakolte, kangtalaite leh sepaih tampite huai ah asawl a, zan in ava hoh ua, khua a-umkimvel uhi.
english: Therefore he sent horses, chariots, and a great army there. They came by night and surrounded the city.

paite: Pathian mipa sikha zingkhang in athou a, ava pawtkhiakleh, ngai in, sepaihte'n sakol leh kangtalaite toh khua ana umsuakta uh. Sikha in akiang ah, "Maizen! Pu aw, bang i chihta dia le?" achi hi.
english: When the servant of the man of God had risen early and gone out, behold, an army with horses and chariots was around the city. His servant said to him, “Alas, my master! What shall we do?”

paite: Ama'n, "Lau ke'n; amau lam a pangte sang in ei lam a pangte atamzaw hi,” achi hi.
english: He answered, “Don’t be afraid, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”

paite: Huchi in Elisha athum a, "TOUPA, amuhtheihna ding in amit vaksak in," achi hi. TOUPA'N huai tangval mit avaksak a; huchi in amu samta a; ngai in, Elisha kimvel a mualte mei kangtalai leh sakol in adim vekta hi.
english: Elisha prayed, and said, “Yahweh, please open his eyes, that he may see.” Yahweh opened the young man’s eyes, and he saw; and behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire around Elisha.

paite: Amah lam a ahong paisuk uleh TOUPA kiang ah Elisha athum a, "Hiai mite mit tawsak in," achi hi. Huchi in Elisha thu bang in amit uh atawsakta hi.
english: When they came down to him, Elisha prayed to Yahweh, and said, “Please strike this people with blindness.” He struck them with blindness according to Elisha’s word.

paite: Elisha in akiang uah, "Hiai lampi ahi kei, hiai leng khua ahi sam kei. Kei hon zui un, na mizonpa uh kiang ah ka hon pi ding,” achi hi. Huchi in Samaria ah apita hi.
english: Elisha said to them, “This is not the way, neither is this the city. Follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom you seek.” He led them to Samaria.

paite: Samaria khosung atun un hichi ahong hi a, Elisha in, "TOUPA, hiaite'n amuhtheihna ding un amit uh vaksak in," achi hi. Huchi in TOUPA'N amit uh avaksak a, amuta ua; ngai in, Samaria khosung ah ana omta uhi.
english: When they had come into Samaria, Elisha said, “Yahweh, open these men’s eyes, that they may see.” Yahweh opened their eyes, and they saw; and behold, they were in the middle of Samaria.

paite: Israel kumpipa'n amaute amuh in Elisha kiang ah, "Ka pa aw, ka that diam? Ka that diam?" achi hi.
english: The king of Israel said to Elisha, when he saw them, “My father, shall I strike them? Shall I strike them?”

paite: Ama'n adawng a, "That ke'n, na namsau leh na thalpeu in na salmatte na that dia hia? Tanghou leh tui ama uah lui inla, ne in dawn uhenla, apu uh kiang ah paikik nawn uhen," achi hi.
english: He answered, “You shall not strike them. Would you strike those whom you have taken captive with your sword and with your bow? Set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, then go to their master.”

paite: Huchi in nek ding thupi mahmah abawlsak a; anek ua adawn khit un apaisak vek ua, apu uh kiang lam ah apai nawn uh. Huchi in Siria pawlte Israel gam ah ahong nawnta kei uhi.
english: He prepared a great feast for them. After they ate and drank, he sent them away and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria stopped raiding the land of Israel.

paite: Huai nung in hichi ahong hi a, Siria kumpipa Ben-hadad in asepaih tengteng akaikhawm a, Samaria khua ava um hi.
english: After this, Benhadad king of Syria gathered all his army, and went up and besieged Samaria.

paite: Samaria ah kial anasa mahmah a, ngai in, sabiltung lutang dangka sawmgiat a akhot uh leh begap kab mun li a khen mun khat dangka nga a lei ahih tan hial un, khua a-um bikbek hi.
english: There was a great famine in Samaria. Behold, they besieged it until a donkey’s head was sold for eighty pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a kab of dove’s dung for five pieces of silver.

paite: Israel kumpipa kulh dawn a apai lai in numei khat in, "Aw kumpipa, ka toupa, hon huh in," chi in ana sam hi.
english: As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried to him, saying, “Help, my lord, O king!”

paite: Ama'n, "TOUPA'N ahon panpih ngal keileh ke'n koi a pan in ahia ka hon panpih ding? Buhphual ahihkeileh grep sukna khuk a pan in maw?"
english: He said, “If Yahweh doesn’t help you, where could I get help for you? From the threshing floor, or from the wine press?”

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Bang na chi a ahia awi?" achi nawn hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Hiai numei in ka kiang ah, tuni in na tapa i nek ding in hon thoh ve, zingchiang in ka tapa i ne na kei dia," achi hi.
english: Then the king asked her, “What is your problem?” She answered, “This woman said to me, ‘Give your son, that we may eat him today, and we will eat my son tomorrow.’

paite: Huchi in ka tapa ka huan ua, ka ne uh. Azing in ke'n akiang ah, "Na tapa i nek ding in hon thoh sam in, ka chi hi. Ama'n atapa aselgu maimah hi,” achi hi.
english: So we boiled my son and ate him; and I said to her on the next day, ‘Give up your son, that we may eat him;’ and she has hidden her son.”

paite: Kumpipa'n numei thugen azak in hichi ahong hi a, apuan abotkek a; kulh dawn a apai lai ahi a; mipite'n a-et uleh, ngai in, asa tung ah sai-ip puan ana silh nilouh hi.
english: When the king heard the words of the woman, he tore his clothes. Now he was passing by on the wall, and the people looked, and behold, he had sackcloth underneath on his body.

paite: Huchi in ama'n, "Tuni a Shaphat tapa Elisha in alutang apuak lai peuhmah leh Pathian in alohloh in hon loh mai hen, huai sang a leng thupizaw in," achi hi.
english: Then he said, “God do so to me, and more also, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat stays on him today.”

paite: Elisha a-inn ah atu a, upate leng akiang ah atu sam uh. Kumpipa'n akiang ah mi khat asawl a, himahleh amisawl akiang atun ma in upate kiang ah, "Hiai tualthatpa tapa in ka lu la ding in mi ahon sawl, chih na thei na uhia? Pau kei dih ua, amisawl ahong tun chiang in, kong na khak unla, kongkhak in na dal bikbek un. Anung ah apu kalsuan ging akiza kei maw?" achi hi.
english: But Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him. Then the king sent a man from before him; but before the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, “Do you see how this son of a murderer has sent to take away my head? Behold, when the messenger comes, shut the door, and hold the door shut against him. Isn’t the sound of his master’s feet behind him?”

paite: Huchi a amau ahoupih san lai in, ngai in, amisawl ahong tungsuk hi. Ngai in, kumpipa'n, "Hiai thil hoih lou TOUPA hon sawl ahi; bang ding in TOUPA ka hungaih lailai dia? chi ahi," achi hi.
english: While he was still talking with them, behold, the messenger came down to him. Then he said, “Behold, this evil is from Yahweh. Why should I wait for Yahweh any longer?”

paite: Elisha in, "TOUPA thu na za un. TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Zingchiang hiai hun ding vel in Samaria kulh kongpi bul ah tangbuang nel tehna khat shekel khat in akhawng ding ua, barli buh tehna nih shekel khat in," chi in agen hi.
english: Elisha said, “Hear Yahweh’s word. Yahweh says, ‘Tomorrow about this time a seah of fine flour will be sold for a shekel, and two seahs of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.’”

paite: Heutu khat kumpipa'n akhut angaknapa'n Pathian mipa adawng hi. "Ngai in, TOUPA'N van ah tohlette bawl leh leng hiai bang ahi thei mahmah dia hia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Ngai in, na mit in na mu dia, himahleh na ne kei ding," achi hi.
english: Then the captain on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, “Behold, if Yahweh made windows in heaven, could this thing be?” He said, “Behold, you will see it with your eyes, but will not eat of it.”

paite: Huai lai in kulh lutna kongpi bul ah phak li a-om uhi. Amau, "Bangziak a sih ngak lel a tu nilouh i hi ua?
english: Now there were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate. They said to one another, “Why do we sit here until we die?

paite: Khopi sung ah lut ni, chi leng, khopi sung kial a, huai a va si mai ding hang a; hiai ah tu nilouh lehang lah si thouthou ding hang a; huaiziak in tu in pai ni in Siria sepaihte kiang ah i va lut peuhmah ding uh. Ahon na hinghawi uh leh i hing dia; ahon na thah uleh si i himai ke," chi in akihou uhi,
english: If we say, ‘We will enter into the city,’ then the famine is in the city, and we will die there. If we sit still here, we also die. Now therefore come, and let’s surrender to the army of the Syrians. If they save us alive, we will live; and if they kill us, we will only die.”

paite: Huchi in Siriate giahphual a hoh ding in khomui in akuan uhi. Siriate giahphual tuah masak ava tun un, ngai in, kuamah ana om kei uhi.
english: They rose up in the twilight to go to the camp of the Syrians. When they had come to the outermost part of the camp of the Syrians, behold, no man was there.

paite: TOUPA'N Siria sepaihte kangtalaite husa, sakolte husa leh sepaih tampi husa ana zasak hi. Huchi in "Ngai un, Israel kumpipa'n Hit kumpipate leh Aigupta kumpipate ei hong dou dia guai ei ve,” chi in akihou uhi.
english: For the Lord had made the army of the Syrians to hear the sound of chariots and the sound of horses, even the noise of a great army; and they said to one another, “Behold, the king of Israel has hired against us the kings of the Hittites and the kings of the Egyptians to attack us.”

paite: Huchi in athou ua, khomui in ataikekta uh. Apuaninte uh, asakolte uh, asabiltungte uh leh agiahphual uh a-om ngeingei in ataisan ua, ataikekta uhi.
english: Therefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, their horses, and their donkeys, even the camp as it was, and fled for their life.

paite: Huai mi phakte giahphual tuah masak ava tun un puanin khat ah alut ua, ne in adawn uh. Dangkasik, dangka-eng leh puansilhte ala ua, asel ua; anungkik nawn ua, puanin dang ah alut nawn ua, huai leng ala ua, asel uhi.
english: When these lepers came to the outermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and ate and drank, then carried away silver, gold, and clothing and went and hid it. Then they came back, and entered into another tent and carried things from there also, and went and hid them.

paite: "Aden chiang in, i hihdik het kei. Tuni tanchin kipahhuai tun ni ahi a, ei i daih dide ua; khovak i ngak uleh gawtna i tuak ding uh. Huaiziak in kisa ni, kumpipa inkote i va hilh ding uh," chỉ in akihou uhi.
english: Then they said to one another, “We aren’t doing right. Today is a day of good news, and we keep silent. If we wait until the morning light, punishment will overtake us. Now therefore come, let’s go and tell the king’s household.”

paite: Huchi in khopi kongkhak vengmi ava sam ua, "Siriate giahphual ah ka va hoh ua, ngai in, kuamah ana om kei ua, mihing husa himhim leng a-om kei, sakolte leh sabiltungte kia ana kikhih a, puaninte leng a-om ngeingei in ana om uh," chi in ahilh uhi.
english: So they came and called to the city gatekeepers; and they told them, “We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, not even a man’s voice, but the horses tied, and the donkeys tied, and the tents as they were.”

paite: Kongkhak veng mite asam a; amau kumpipa insung a mite ava hilh uh.
english: Then the gatekeepers called out and told it to the king’s household within.

paite: Zan in kumpipa athou a, asikhate kiang ah, "Siriate hon bawldan ka hon hilh ding. I gilkialdan uh athei uh. Huaiziak in khopi a pan ahong pawt uleh ahing in i na man ding ua, khosung ah i lut ding uh, chi in gamlak a kibu dia agiahphual uh pawtkhiaksan ahi uh," achi hi.
english: The king arose in the night, and said to his servants, “I will now show you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we are hungry. Therefore they have gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, ‘When they come out of the city, we shall take them alive, and get into the city.’”

paite: Asikhate lak a khat in adawng a, "Khopi a omsun sakol nga va pisak inla, ngai in, Israel mipi adam lai tengteng Israel mipite si bang a sehte ahi himhim uhi; huchi in amaute sawl in enkhe ni," achi hi.
english: One of his servants answered, “Please let some people take five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are left in it. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are consumed. Let’s send and see.”

paite: Huchi in kangtalai kai sakol nih api ua; kumpipa'n, "Va en dih ua," chi in Siria sepaihte delh ding in asawl hi.
english: Therefore they took two chariots with horses; and the king sent them out to the Syrian army, saying, “Go and see.”

paite: Jordan lui pha in ava delh ua; ngai in, Siriate'n akin ziak ua apaih uh puansilhte leh vante, lamtawn in a-om zelzul hi. Huchi in amisawlte ahong kik nawn ua, kumpipa ahong hilh uhi.
english: They went after them to the Jordan; and behold, all the path was full of garments and equipment which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. The messengers returned and told the king.

paite: Huchi in mipi apawtkhia ua, Siriate giahphual ava lok uhi. Huchi in TOUPA thu bang ngei in tangbuang nel tehna khat shekel khat in akhong ua, barli buh tehna nih shekel khat mah in.
english: The people went out and plundered the camp of the Syrians. So a seah of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to Yahweh’s word.

paite: Kumpipa'n sepaih heutu, akhut angaknapa kulh kongpi vengmi in asep hi. Mipite'n akulh kongpi bul ah achil uhi, Pathian mipa'n akiang a kumpipa ahong paisuk lai a, ana gen bang in asita hi.
english: The king had appointed the captain on whose hand he leaned to be in charge of the gate; and the people trampled over him in the gate, and he died as the man of God had said, who spoke when the king came down to him.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian mipa'n kumpipa kiang a, Zingchiang hichih hun ding vel in Samaria kulh kongpi bul ah, "Barli buh tehna nih shekel khat in akhong ding ua, tangbuang nel tehna khat shekel khat mah in," achih a;
english: It happened as the man of God had spoken to the king, saying, “Two seahs of barley for a shekel, and a seah of fine flour for a shekel, shall be tomorrow about this time in the gate of Samaria;”

paite: sepaih heutu in Pathian mipa adawng a, "Ngai in, TOUPA'N van ah tohlette bawlleh leng, huchibang ahi thei dia hia?" achih a, ama'n, "Ngai in, na mit in na mu ngei dia, himahleh na ne kei ding," achih bang in;
english: and that captain answered the man of God, and said, “Now, behold, if Yahweh made windows in heaven, might such a thing be?” and he said, “Behold, you will see it with your eyes, but will not eat of it.”

paite: huchibang in atung ah ahong tungta hi; mipi'n kulh kongpi bul a achil ziak un asita hi.
english: It happened like that to him, for the people trampled over him in the gate, and he died.

paite: Huan Elisha in atapa ahihdamsak numei kiang ah, “Thou inla, nang leh na inkote na omtheihna munmun uah va kialtai tadih un. TOUPA'N lah kial akesak ngal a, hiai gam ah kum sagih sung kial ake ding," achi hi.
english: Now Elisha had spoken to the woman whose son he had restored to life, saying, “Arise, and go, you and your household, and stay for a while wherever you can; for Yahweh has called for a famine. It will also come on the land for seven years.”

paite: Huchi in numei athou a, Pathian mipa thugen bang in ahih a; a-inkote toh Philistiate gam ah kum sagih ava kialtai uhi.
english: The woman arose, and did according to the man of God’s word. She went with her household, and lived in the land of the Philistines for seven years.

paite: Kum sagih ahong kivei nung in hichi ahong hi a, huai numei Philistiate gam a pan akik nawn a; a-inn leh alou ngen ding in kumpipa azuan hi.
english: At the end of seven years, the woman returned from the land of the Philistines. Then she went out to beg the king for her house and for her land.

paite: Kumpipa'n Pathian mipa sikha Gehazi ahoupih a, "Elisha in thil thupi ahih tengteng hon hilh dih ve," achi hi.
english: Now the king was talking with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, “Please tell me all the great things that Elisha has done.”

paite: Asisa mi khat ahinsak nawn thu kumpipa ana hilh laitak in hichi ahong hi a, ngai in, atapa ahinsak nawn numei in a-inn leh alou kumpipa kiang ah ahong ngen hi. Gehazi in, "Ka toupa, kumpipa aw, hiai numei ahi, hiai ahi atapa, Elisha in ahinsak nawn,” achi hi.
english: As he was telling the king how he had restored to life him who was dead, behold, the woman whose son he had restored to life begged the king for her house and for her land. Gehazi said, “My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.”

paite: Kumpipa'n numei adotleh ahilh hi. Huchi in kumpipa'n heutu khat asehsak a, "Amah a tengteng, alou a thil piang tengteng tan in, hiai gam apawtkhiaksan a pan tuni tan ateng pe nawn vek un,” achi hi.
english: When the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed to her a certain officer, saying, “Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.”

paite: Damaskas ah Elisha ahoh a; Siria kumpipa Ben-hadad achi ana hi. "Pathian mipa hiai ah ahong ve," chi in ahilh uh.
english: Elisha came to Damascus; and Benhadad the king of Syria was sick. He was told, “The man of God has come here.”

paite: Kumpipa'n Hazael kiang ah, "Thilpiak tawi inla, Pathian mipa houpih ding in va hoh inla, ka chinatna a pan ka hoihkhe nawn thei diam, TOUPA hon na dotsakleh," achi hi.
english: The king said to Hazael, “Take a present in your hand, and go meet the man of God, and inquire of Yahweh by him, saying, ‘Will I recover from this sickness?’”

paite: Amah houpih ding in Hazael akuan a, thilpiak ding Damaskas a thil hoih chiteng, sangawngsau sawmli puak khop atawi a, ama ah ava dingh a, "Na tapa Ben-hadad, Siria kumpipa in, ka chinatna a pan ka hoihkhe nawn diam chi ding in na kiang ah kei ahon sawl hi,” achi hi.
english: So Hazael went to meet him and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels’ burden, and came and stood before him and said, “Your son Benhadad king of Syria has sent me to you, saying, ‘Will I recover from this sickness?’”

paite: Elisha in akiang ah, "Pai nawn inla, akiang ah, na hoihkhe nawn na mah ke, achi ve, va chi in. Himahleh ataktak in bel asi ngeingei ding chih, TOUPA'N ahon theisak hi," achi hi.
english: Elisha said to him, “Go, tell him, ‘You will surely recover;’ however Yahweh has shown me that he will surely die.”

paite: Huchi in amah a dia zumhuai khop in Elisha in a-ensal gegu a; huchi in Pathian mipa akapta hi.
english: He settled his gaze steadfastly on him, until he was ashamed. Then the man of God wept.

paite: Hazael in, "Bangziak a ka toupa kap ahia?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Israel suante tung a na thil hoih lou hih ding ka theih ziak in ahi. Akulhte uh na hal dia, atangvalte uh namsau in na that dia, atanu neu chikchikte na paizan dia, naupai lai anumeite uh na pikkek ding," achi hi.
english: Hazael said, “Why do you weep, my lord?” He answered, “Because I know the evil that you will do to the children of Israel. You will set their strongholds on fire, and you will kill their young men with the sword, and will dash their little ones in pieces, and rip up their pregnant women.”

paite: Hazael in, "Kei na sikha ui leltak in hiai thil thupi hihthei ding ka hi mahmah a hia?" achi hi. Elisha in adawng a, "Siriate tung ah na hong lal ding chih TOUPA'N ahon theisak hi " achi hi.
english: Hazael said, “But what is your servant, who is but a dog, that he could do this great thing?” Elisha answered, “Yahweh has shown me that you will be king over Syria.”

paite: Huchi in Elisha kiang a pan apawt a, apu kiang ah apaita hi. Ama'n, “Elisha in bang hon na hilh a?” achi hi. Ama'n, "Na hoihkhe nawn na tham ding, chi in ahon hilh," achi hi.
english: Then he departed from Elisha, and came to his master, who said to him, “What did Elisha say to you?” He answered, “He told me that you would surely recover.”

paite: Azing in hichi ahong hi a, puansahpi khat ala a, tui ah adiah a, amai akhuhsak a, huchi in asita a; asik in Hazael alalta hi.
english: On the next day, he took a thick cloth, dipped it in water, and spread it on the king’s face, so that he died. Then Hazael reigned in his place.

paite: Israel kumpipa Ahab tapa Joram kum nga alal kum in huai lai in Jehoshaphat bel Judah kumpipa ahi, Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat tapa Jehoram alal pan hi.
english: In the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat being king of Judah then, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.

paite: Alal pat lai in kum sawmthum-le-nih a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum giat vai ahawm hi.
english: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign. He reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

paite: Ahab inkote bang in, Israel kumpipate lampi tot atawn a; Ahab tanu zi in anei hi. Huchi in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoihloupi ahih hi.
english: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did Ahab’s house, for he married Ahab’s daughter. He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N asikha David ziak in Judah gam ahihse nuam kei a, asuante tan a khawnvak neihsak gige ana chiam tak ziak in.
english: However, Yahweh would not destroy Judah, for David his servant’s sake, as he promised him to give to him a lamp for his children always.

paite: Adam lai in Judahte tung ah Edomte ahel ua, atung ua kumpipa ding akibawltawm uhi.
english: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.

paite: Huchi in Zair ah kangtalai tengteng toh Joram ahoh hi. Zan in akisakhia a, amau um Edomte leh akangtalai tung ua heutute ava sualta hi. Huchi in mite apuaninte uah atai uhi.
english: Then Joram crossed over to Zair, and all his chariots with him; and he rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him with the captains of the chariots; and the people fled to their tents.

paite: Edomte tuni tan in Judahte tung ah ahel lailai uh. Huai hun mah in Libnah leng ana hel sam uhi.
english: So Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.

paite: Jehoram tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah akigelh kei maw?
english: The rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Huchi in Jehoram api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, api-le-pute lak ah David khopi ah avui ua; asik in atapa Ahaziah alalta hi.
english: Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.

paite: Israel kumpipa Ahab tapa Joram lal akum sawm-le-nih kum in Judah kumpipa Jehoram tapa Ahaziah alal pan hi.
english: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign.

paite: Ahaziah in vai ahawm pat in kum sawmnih-le-nih a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum khat vai ahawm hi. Anu min Athaliah ahi a, amah Israel kumpipa Omri tanu ahi.
english: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri king of Israel.

paite: Ahab inkote lampi tot atawn sam a, Ahab inkote makpapa ahih ziak in, Ahab inkote hih bang in, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih hi.
english: He walked in the way of Ahab’s house and did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as did Ahab’s house, for he was the son-in-law of Ahab’s house.

paite: Amah Ahab tapa Joram in Ramoth-gilead a Siria kumpipa Hazael ava douna ah apang sam hi. Siriate'n Joram ana hihliam uhi.
english: He went with Joram the son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead, and the Syrians wounded Joram.

paite: Siria kumpipa Hazael adouna uah Siriate'n Ramah ah kumpipa Joram ana hihliam ua, Jezreel a kidamsak ding in akik nawnta hi. Ahab tapa Joram adam louh ziak in, amah veh ding in Jezreel ah Judah kumpipa Jehoram tapa Ahaziah ahohsuk hi.
english: King Joram returned to be healed in Jezreel from the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. Ahaziah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.

paite: Huan zawlnei Elisha in zawlneite tapate lak a khat asam a, akiang ah, "Na puan teng inla, hiai sathau bawm tawi inla, Ramoth-gilead ah va hoh in.
english: Elisha the prophet called one of the sons of the prophets, and said to him, “Put your belt on your waist, take this vial of oil in your hand, and go to Ramoth Gilead.

paite: Na va tun chiang in Nimshi tapa Jehoshaphat tapa Jehu va zongkhia inla; va lut inla, a-unaute lak a pan samkhia inla, dantan sunggil ah lutpih in.
english: When you come there, find Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in and make him rise up from among his brothers, and take him to an inner room.

paite: Huchi in sathau bawm la inla, alu ah sung inla, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Israelte tung a kumpipa ding in sathau ka hon nilh hi," chi in. "Huchi in kong hong inla, taikhia in, om sawt ke'n,” achi hi.
english: Then take the vial of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, ‘Yahweh says, “I have anointed you king over Israel.”’ Then open the door, flee, and don’t wait.”

paite: Huchi in tangval, zawlnei tangvalpa Ramoth-gilead ah ahohta hi.
english: So the young man, the young prophet, went to Ramoth Gilead.

paite: Ava tunleh ngai in, sepaih heutute atukhawm ua; ama'n, "Sepaih heutu, na kiang a gen ding thukhah ka nei," achi hi. Jehu in, "Kua pen kiang ah eita?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Nang kiang ah, sepaih heutupa," achi hi,
english: When he came, behold, the captains of the army were sitting. Then he said, “I have a message for you, captain.” Jehu said, “To which one of us?” He said, “To you, O captain.”

paite: Athou a, inn ah alut a; alu ah sathau asung a, akiang ah, "ToUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: TOUPA mipite, Israelte tung a kumpipa ding in thau ka hon nilh hi.
english: He arose, and went into the house. Then he poured the oil on his head, and said to him, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I have anointed you king over the people of Yahweh, even over Israel.

paite: Ka sikha zawlneite sisan leh TOUPA sikha tengteng sisan phu Jezebel tung a ka laktheihna ding in na pu Ahab inkote na that ding hi.
english: You must strike your master Ahab’s house, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of Yahweh, at the hand of Jezebel.

paite: Ahab inko tengteng amangthang vek ding uh. Ahab a pan pasal taphot Israel gam a zalen hi in sikha hitaleh ka hihmang ding hi.
english: For the whole house of Ahab will perish. I will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, both him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel.

paite: Ahab inkote Nebat tapa Jeroboam inkote leh Ahijah tapa Baasha inkote bang in ka bawl ding hi.
english: I will make Ahab’s house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah.

paite: Uite'n Jezreel khokulh zul ah Jezebel ane ding ua, amah vui ding mi a-om kei ding, chi in," achi hi. Huchi in kong ahong a, ataikheta hi.
english: The dogs will eat Jezebel on the plot of ground of Jezreel, and there shall be no one to bury her.’” Then he opened the door and fled.

paite: Huchi in Jehu bel atoupa sikhate kiang ah ahong pawt a; khat in akiang ah, "Hoih lam thu hia? Huai mihaipa koi a pan na kiang a hong ahia?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Huai mi na thei ua; athugen leng na thei uh," achi hi.
english: When Jehu came out to the servants of his lord and one said to him, “Is all well? Why did this madman come to you?” He said to them, “You know the man and how he talks.”

paite: Amau, "Thei maizen dia, tu'n hon hilh in," achi uh. Ama'n, "Hichibang in ahon chi ahi: 'TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Israelte tung a kumpipa ding in sathau ka hon nilh hi, " achi hi.
english: They said, “That is a lie. Tell us now.” He said, “He said to me, ‘Yahweh says, I have anointed you king over Israel.’”

paite: Huchi in michih in apuan uh asuah somsom ua, kailawn tung ah aphahsak chiat ua, "Jehu kumpipa ahita," chi in pengkul amutta uhi.
english: Then they hurried, and each man took his cloak, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew the trumpet, saying, “Jehu is king.”

paite: Huchi in Nimshi tapa Jehoshaphat tapa Jehu in Joram thahna ding aguksawm hi. Siria kumpipa Hazael ziak in Joram leh Israelte tengteng in Ramoth-gilead khua aveng uhi.
english: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram was defending Ramoth Gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria;

paite: Siria kumpipa Hazael toh kumpipa Joram akidouna ua Siria mite'n asukliam uh, Jezreel a kidamsak ding in akik nawn hi. Huchi in Jehu in, "Kei lam a pang na hih uleh kuamah Jezreel a hiai thu gen ding in khua a pan paikhesak kei un," achi hi.
english: but King Joram had returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) Jehu said, “If this is your thinking, then let no one escape and go out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.”

paite: Huchi in Jehu bel kangtalai ah atuang a, Jezreel ah ahoh a, huai ah Joram alum hi. Judah kumpipa Ahaziah leng Joram veh ding in ahohsuk hi.
english: So Jehu rode in a chariot and went to Jezreel, for Joram lay there. Ahaziah king of Judah had come down to see Joram.

paite: Jezreel kulh ah galvilmi adingh a, Jehu pawlte amah toh hong pai amu a, “Mi tampi ka mu,” achi hi. Joram in, "Sakol tungtuangmi amau va dawn ding in sawl inla, hoih lam thu hia? va chi uhen,” achi hi.
english: Now the watchman was standing on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, “I see a company.” Joram said, “Take a horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, ‘Is it peace?’”

paite: Huchi in mi khat sakol tung a tuang amau dawn ding in akuan a, kumpipa'n hichi in achi, “Lemna thu toh hong pai na hi hia?” achi hi. Jehu in, "Lemna thu toh hong pai leng, nang na theih ding bang a-om a? Ka nung ah pai in," achi hi. Galvilmi'n, "I mi sawl akiang uh ava tung a, himahleh ahong kik nawn het kei mawk a," chi in ahilh hi.
english: So one went on horseback to meet him, and said, “the king says, ‘Is it peace?’” Jehu said, “What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me!” The watchman said, “The messenger came to them, but he isn’t coming back.”

paite: Huchi in mi khat sakol tung a tuang asawl nawn a, huai mi leng akiang uh ava tung a, kumpipa'n hichi in achi, "Lemna thu toh hong pai na hi hia?" achi hi. Jehu in adawng a, "Lemna thu toh hong pai leng, nang na theih ding bang a-om a? Ka nung ah pai in,” achi hi.
english: Then he sent out a second on horseback, who came to them and said, “The king says, ‘Is it peace?’” Jehu answered, “What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me!”

paite: Galvilmi leng akiang uh ava tung a, amah leng ahong kik nawn het kei mawk hi. "Huai kangtalai kihawldan leng Nimshi tapa Jehu hawldan geih ahi; mihai bang mai in ahawl hi," achi hi.
english: The watchman said, “He came to them, and isn’t coming back. The driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi, for he drives furiously.”

paite: Joram in, "Kimansak un," achi a; kangtalai akimansakta uh. Huchi in Israel kumpipa Joram leh Judah kumpipa Ahaziah amau kangtalai tuaktuak in ava pawtkhia ua, Jehu tuak ding in ataikhia ua, Jezreel mi Naboth huan ah ava mu uhi.
english: Joram said, “Get ready!” They got his chariot ready. Then Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot; and they went out to meet Jehu, and found him on Naboth the Jezreelite’s land.

paite: Joram in Jehu amuh in hichi ahong hi a, "Lemna toh hong pai na hia, Jehu?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Na nu Jezebel angkawmna leh bumna atam lai teng bangchi in lemna a-om thei dia?" achi hi.
english: When Joram saw Jehu, he said, “Is it peace, Jehu?” He answered, “What peace, so long as the prostitution of your mother Jezebel and her witchcraft abound?”

paite: Joram akihei a, atai a, Ahaziah kiang ah, "Kikhem a kilehbawlna om ei ve, Ahaziah," achi hi.
english: Joram turned his hands and fled, and said to Ahaziah, “This is treason, Ahaziah!”

paite: Jehu in athalpeu atheihtawp in alai a, Joram liang leh liang kikal ah akap a, thaltang in alungtang apailet a, akangtalai sung ah apuklut hi.
english: Jehu drew his bow with his full strength, and struck Joram between his arms; and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.

paite: Huchi in Jehu in asepaih heutu Bidkar kiang ah, "Dom inla, Jezreel mi Naboth huan ah paikhia in. Tuma lam a nang toh apa Ahab nung a i tuankhawm lai a TOUPA'N hiai puakgik atung ah anga hi.
english: Then Jehu said to Bidkar his captain, “Pick him up, and throw him in the plot of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite; for remember how, when you and I rode together after Ahab his father, Yahweh laid this burden on him:

paite: TOUPA'N zan in Naboth sisan leh atapate sisan ka muh ngei ahi," achi hi. "TOUPA'N, hiai mun ngei ah ka hon thuk ding," achi nawn hi. Huchi in "TOUPA thu bang in dom inla, hiai mun ngei ah paikhia in," achi hi.
english: ‘Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons,’ says Yahweh; ‘and I will repay you in this plot of ground,’ says Yahweh. Now therefore take and cast him onto the plot of ground, according to Yahweh’s word.”

paite: Himahleh Judah kumpipa Ahaziah in huai amuh in huan in lampi ah atai hi. Jehu in adelh a, "Amah leng huai kangtalai sung ah that un," achi hi. Huchi in Ibleam kiang, Gur zottouhna ah asatliam uhi. Meggiddo ah atailut a, huai ah asita hi.
english: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. Jehu followed after him, and said, “Strike him also in the chariot!” They struck him at the ascent of Gur, which is by Ibleam. He fled to Megiddo, and died there.

paite: Amite'n Jerusalem ah kangtalai in apaipih ua, amah han ah, api-le- pute lak ah David khopi ah avui uhi.
english: His servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his tomb with his fathers in David’s city.

paite: Ahab tapa Joram kum sawm- le-khat alal kum in Judahte tung ah Ahaziah alal pan hi.
english: In the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab, Ahaziah began to reign over Judah.

paite: Jezreel ah Jehu ava lut chih Jezebel in ana za hi. Huchi in amitte anuh a, asam azem a, tohlet ah ana dakkhia hi.
english: When Jehu had come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her eyes, and adorned her head, and looked out at the window.

paite: Jehu kulh kongpi a, ahong lut laitak in, "Na pu thatpa nang Zimri, lemna thu toh hong pai na hi hia?" ana chi hi.
english: As Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, “Do you come in peace, Zimri, you murderer of your master?”

paite: Tohlet lam nga in amah adaktou a, "Kei lam a pang kuakua na om ua? Kua?" achi hi. Michilgeh nih hiam, thum hiam amah lam nga in ahong dakkhia uhi.
english: He lifted up his face to the window, and said, “Who is on my side? Who?” Two or three eunuchs looked out at him.

paite: Ama'n, "Hon lawnkhia un," achi hi. Huchi in alawnkhia ua; asi khenkhat in baang leh sakolte atheh nengnung a; ama'n lei ah akhe in ana chil hi.
english: He said, “Throw her down!” So they threw her down; and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses. Then he trampled her under foot.

paite: Huchi in alut a, ne in adawn a, "Hamse thuaknu va dom unla, va vui un, kumpipa tanu lah ahi ngal a." achi hi.
english: When he had come in, he ate and drank. Then he said, “See now to this cursed woman, and bury her; for she is a king’s daughter.”

paite: Vui ding in akuan ua; himahleh aluguh, akhebomte leh akhutpek bomte kia lou ngal amu kei uh.
english: They went to bury her, but they found no more of her than the skull, the feet, and the palms of her hands.

paite: Huchi in ahong pai nawn in ahong hilh uh. Ama'n, "Hiai TOUPA'N asikha Tishbi mi Elijah zang a, Jezreel kulhchin ah uite'n Jezebel ane ding ua;
english: Therefore they came back, and told him. He said, “This is Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, ‘The dogs will eat the flesh of Jezebel on the plot of Jezreel,

paite: Jezebel luang Jezreel khokulh chin a huan a ekchim bang ahi dia, huchi a, hiai Jezebel ei ve, achihlouhna ding un, chi a agen ahi," achi hi.
english: and the body of Jezebel will be as dung on the surface of the field on Jezreel’s land, so that they won’t say, “This is Jezebel.”’”

paite: Simon Peter, Jesu Khrist sikha leh sawltak in, i Pathian leh Hondampa Jesu Khrist diktatna ziak a ginna manphatak i tan bang tang samte kiang ah:
english: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:

paite: Pathian leh Jesu i Toupa theihna ah hehpihna leh khamuanna noute ah hihkhan in om hen.
english: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,

paite: Ama thupina leh hoihna ziak a hon sampa, atanchin theih ziak in ama Pathianna thilhihtheihna in hinna leh Pathian limsakna lam thu ah thil tengteng ahon peta hi.
english: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,

paite: Huaite ziak in athuchiam manphatak leh thupi mahmahte ahon pia hi; huchi in utna ziak a khovel a siatna hong om taikhiaksan in; huai thuchiam manphatak leh thupi mahmahte ziak in Pathian omdan na kikoppih thei sam ding uhi.
english: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.

paite: Ahi, huaiziak tak in, thanop himhim suah in, na ginna uah hoihna hel unla, na hoihna uah theihna hel unla,
english: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;

paite: na theihna uah kidekna hel unla, na kidekna uah kuhkalna hel unla, na kuhkalna uah Pathian limsakna hel unla,
english: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;

paite: na Pathian limsakna uah unaute itna hel unla, na unaute itna ah itna hel un.
english: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.

paite: Hiai hoihnate nou a ahih a, akhan zelleh i Toupa Jesu Khrist theihna lam ah thadah lou leh gah lou lou in nou ahon bawl ding hi.
english: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Kuapeuh huai thilte nei lou mittaw, naichikte kia mu thei, anidanglai khelhnate siansakna mangngilhte ahi uhi.
english: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.

paite: Huaiziak in unaute aw, nou ahon sapna leh ahon telna hihkip ding in thanop suah semsem un; huaite na hih uleh chik lai mah in na puk kei ding uhi.
english: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.

paite: Huchi in Jesu Khrist i Toupa leh Hondampa'n tangtawn gam a lutna ahon musak lo mahmah ding hi.
english: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

paite: Huaiziak in huai thilte nei in na kiang ua om thutak a phuhkip hita mah le uchin, huai thutak mah ka hon theisak nawn ding hi.
english: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.

paite: Huan hiai pumpi a ka om lai teng noumau hon theihpih in hon tohhalh gige hoih ka sa hi.
english: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist in hon theihsak bang in ka pumpi puanin koihkhiak hun ding hong tung pah ding chih ka thei hi.
english: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.

paite: Ahi ka paikhiak nung in huai thilte na theihgigena ding un ka kisuk ding hi.
english: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist thilhihtheihna leh ahong paina thu ka hon theihsak lai un, tangthu piltak a ngaihtuahkhiak phet zui ka hi kei ua, athupina mute ka hi zaw uhi.
english: For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

paite: Ama'n Pa Pathian kiang a kipan in pahtawina leh thupina amu a, huchih lai in thupina thupitak a kipan in hichibang aw akiang ahong tung hi, "Hiai ka Tapa deihtak, ka kipahna mahmah ahi," chi in.
english: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

paite: Huan tang siangthou a akiang a ka om ziak un huai aw van a kipan a hong suak koumau ngei in ka za uhi.
english: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

paite: Huchi in genkholhna thu kip nawn sem i nei uhi. Khua ahong vak a, zingsol aksi na lungtang ua ahong suah masiah hiai thu khawnvak mun mial a vak alimsak bang ua, na limsak uleh na hihhoih ding uhi.
english: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,

paite: Laisiangthou a thugenkholh himhim eimah kihilhchet ding ahi kei chih thei masa un.
english: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.

paite: Thugenkholh himhim mihing thu a pawt ahi ngei kei a, mite'n Kha Siangthou sawl in, Pathian a kipan agen zaw uhi.
english: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

paite: Himahleh mite lak ah zawlnei takloute leng ahong pawt ua, huchi mah bang in na lak uah heutu takloute ahong om ding uhi, amaute leipa Toupa hilhial tawpsan in mi hihse thei ginna tuam, aguk in ahon lutpih ding ua, amau tung ah thakhat in manthatna atungsak ding uhi.
english: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.

paite: Mi tampi in azautatna lam thil uh ahon ching ding ua, amaute ziak in lampi dik gensiat ahi ding hi.
english: Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.

paite: Sum deihna ziak in zuauthu in sumsinna ding in nou ahon zang ding uh, himahleh nidanglai a omsa amohtanna ding uh akhawl kei a, amanthatna uh leng a-ihmu kei hi.
english: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their destruction will not slumber.

paite: Angelte'n thil ahihkhelh un Pathian in ahawi kei a, gawtmun ah apai a, vaihawm ding in phaizang khuk thuk mial ah akhum hi.
english: For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;

paite: Amah limsakloute omna khovel ah tuichim tungsak in, nidanglai khovel ahawi kei a, himahleh Noah, diktatna thugenpa midang sagih toh ahondamta hi.
english: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly,

paite: Sodom leh Gomorrah khuate amah limsak lou hong om dingte etsakna ding in azang a, vut suaksak in hihmangthang in siam louh atangsakta hi;
english: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way,

paite: huan midiktat Lot, migiloute omdan huktak ziak a lungkham mahmah pa ahondamta hi.
english: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked

paite: Huai midiktatpa alak ua a-om in, amit in amu a, abil in aza a, dan lou bang a athilhihte un alungsim diktat niteng in ahih na mahmah hi.
english: (for that righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds),

paite: Toupa'n amah limsak mite khemna a pan hotkhiakdan leh diktatloute vaihawm ni a ding a gawt kawm a hawidan athei hi.
english: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,

paite: Utna thanghuai lam a sa bang a om leh vai hawmsakna musit mite ngial houh vaihawm ni a ding a gawt kawm a hawidan atheisem hi. Haihan leh chihhak ahi ua, amithupite agensiat un leng aling kei uhi.
