english: David said to Abishai and to all his servants, “Behold, my son, who came out of my bowels, seeks my life. How much more this Benjamite, now? Leave him alone, and let him curse; for Yahweh has invited him.

paite: TOUPA'N ka haksatna ahon mu dia, TOUPA'N tuni a hon hamsiat ahoih lam in hon thuk nawn kha maithei hi,” achi hi.
english: It may be that Yahweh will look on the wrong done to me, and that Yahweh will repay me good for the cursing of me today.”

paite: Huchi in David leh amite lampi ah apai zel uh. Shimei bel agal tang pang ah apai zel a, apai kawm in ahamsiat zom zel a, suang in adeng a, leivui in atheh hi.
english: So David and his men went by the way; and Shimei went along on the hillside opposite him and cursed as he went, threw stones at him, and threw dust.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa leh akiang a mi om tengteng Aiphim atungta uh. Huchi in huai ah akhawl tawldam uhi.
english: The king and all the people who were with him arrived weary; and he refreshed himself there.

paite: Absalom leh Israel mi tengteng Jerusalem ah ahoh ua, alak uah Ahithophel leng atel hi.
english: Absalom and all the people, the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Arki mi Hushai, David lawm, Absalom kiang atun in Absalom kiang ah, "Pathian in kumpipa humbit hen, Pathian in kumpipa humbit hen," achi hi.
english: When Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, had come to Absalom, Hushai said to Absalom, “Long live the king! Long live the king!”

paite: Absalom in Hushai kiang ah, "Hichibang ahi maw na lawm na hehpihna dan? Bangziak a na lawm kiang a hoh lou?" achi hi.
english: Absalom said to Hushai, “Is this your kindness to your friend? Why didn’t you go with your friend?”

paite: Hushai in Absalom kiang ah, "Ka hoh kei ding. TOUPA leh hiai mite leh Israel mi tengteng atelpa uh thuthu in ka om dia, akiang ah ka om zaw ding.
english: Hushai said to Absalom, “No; but whomever Yahweh and this people and all the men of Israel have chosen, I will be his, and I will stay with him.

paite: Kua nna ka sem dia? Atapa ma ah nna ka sem ding ahi kei maw? Na pa ma a ka sep bang in nangmah ma ah ka sem ding,” achi hi.
english: Again, whom should I serve? Shouldn’t I serve in the presence of his son? As I have served in your father’s presence, so I will be in your presence.”

paite: Absalom in Ahithophel kiang ah, "Bangchi in i hih diam aw, na ngaihdan gen dih ve," achi hi.
english: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, “Give your counsel what we shall do.”

paite: Ahithophel in Absalom kiang ah, "Na pa mei, inn ngak a akoihte kithuahpih in. Israel mi tengteng in na pa'n nang hon mudah chih ana za ding ua; nang lam a pang tengteng khut ahat ding," achi hi.
english: Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Go in to your father’s concubines that he has left to keep the house. Then all Israel will hear that you are abhorred by your father. Then the hands of all who are with you will be strong.”

paite: Absalom a ding in inn tung ah puanin akai uh. Huchi in Israel mi tengteng mitmuh in apa meite akithuahpih hi.
english: So they spread a tent for Absalom on the top of the house, and Absalom went in to his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.

paite: Huai lai in Ahithophel lem theihnate, Pathian thu dongpa lemtheihna bang ahi a; huchi mah bang in David leh Absalom in leng Ahithophel ana ngai uhi.
english: The counsel of Ahithophel, which he gave in those days, was as if a man inquired at the inner sanctuary of God. All the counsel of Ahithophel was like this both with David and with Absalom.

paite: Huai lou leng Ahithophel in Absalom kiang ah, "Mi singkhat-le-sangnih ka telkhe dia, tuzan in David delh ding in ka kuan ding.
english: Moreover Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me now choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David tonight.

paite: Abah lai leh hat louh laitak ka va phanon dia, ka va lausak ding. Huchi in akiang a mi tengteng ataimang ding uh. Huchi in kumpipa kia ka va that mai ding.
english: I will come on him while he is weary and exhausted, and will make him afraid. All the people who are with him will flee. I will strike the king only,

paite: Na kiang ah mipite ka hon pikik nawn vek ding. Na mizonpa mi tengteng hong kik toh kibang ahi. Huchi in mi tengteng khamuang in a-om ding uh," achi hi.
english: and I will bring back all the people to you. The man whom you seek is as if all returned. All the people shall be in peace.”

paite: Huan hiai thugen in Absalom leh Israel upate akipaksak hi.
english: The saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.

paite: Huchi in Absalom in, "Arki mi Hushai sam peuhmah phot inla, amah gendan i ngaikhe peuhmah ding uh," achi hi.
english: Then Absalom said, “Now call Hushai the Archite also, and let’s hear likewise what he says.”

paite: Absalom kiang a Hushai ahong tun in Absalom in, "Ahithophel in hichibang in agen a, agen bang a hih ding i ding uam? Hih lou ding hi leng nang hon gen himhim dih," chi in ana houpih hi.
english: When Hushai had come to Absalom, Absalom spoke to him, saying, “Ahithophel has spoken like this. Shall we do what he says? If not, speak up.”

paite: Hushai in Absalom kiang ah, "Tutung a Ahithophel lemtheihna ahoih kei," achi hi.
english: Hushai said to Absalom, “The counsel that Ahithophel has given this time is not good.”

paite: Hushai in, "Na pa leh amite na thei a, sepaih hangsantak, gam a vompi anou laksak bang mai ahi uh. Na pa lah galdoumi ahi a, mipi lak ah agiak khol kei ding.
english: Hushai said moreover, “You know your father and his men, that they are mighty men, and they are fierce in their minds, like a bear robbed of her cubs in the field. Your father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.

paite: Ngai in, tu in leng koi lai leihawm hiam ah, koi lai mun ah hiam a kibu ahi ding. Huan hichi ahi ding a, akisual tung ua mi khenkhat apuk ualeh aza peuh in, Absalom zuite athat ek uh, achi mai ding uh.
english: Behold, he is now hidden in some pit, or in some other place. It will happen, when some of them have fallen at the first, that whoever hears it will say, ‘There is a slaughter among the people who follow Absalom!’

paite: Huchi in mihangsantak, humpinelkai lungsim bang pumi hial leng ahong lungke mahmah ding uh. Israel mi tengteng in lah na pa sepaih hangsantak ahihdan leh akiang a mi omte mihangsan taktak ahihdan uh athei vek ngal ua.
english: Even he who is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, will utterly melt; for all Israel knows that your father is a mighty man, and those who are with him are valiant men.

paite: Kei hoihsak sam dan, Israel mi tengteng Dan a pan Beer-sheba pha in tuipi a piaunel zah hial ding na kiang ah samkhawm vek lehang; kidouna ah nang nangawn kuan lechin.
english: But I counsel that all Israel be gathered together to you, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that you go to battle in your own person.

paite: Huchi in koi lai mun peuh ah i kituahna na ah lei a daitui kia bang mai in i boh ding ua; amah leh akiang a mi om tengteng khat lel leng i hawi kei ding uh.
english: So we will come on him in some place where he will be found, and we will light on him as the dew falls on the ground, then we will not leave so much as one of him and of all the men who are with him.

paite: Huai lou leng, khua a alutleh Israel mi tengteng, khauhual tawi in huai ah i va hoh ding ua, suang neuchik leng om lou hial khop in lui ah i kaikhe vek ding," achi hi.
english: Moreover, if he has gone into a city, then all Israel will bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there isn’t one small stone found there.”

paite: Huchi in Absalom leh Israel mi tengteng in, "Ahithophel thuhilhna sang in Arka mi Hushai thuhilhna ahoihzaw," achi uhi. TOUPA'N Absalom tung a thil hoih lou atunsak theihna ding in Ahithophel thuhilhna hoihtak nuaisiah ding in ana sep khin him hi.
english: Absalom and all the men of Israel said, “The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel.” For Yahweh had ordained to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that Yahweh might bring evil on Absalom.

paite: Huchi in Hushai in siampu Zadok leh Abiathar kiang ah, "Huchibang khachibang in Ahithophel in Absalom leh Israel upate hoih ding in angaihtuahpih a; ke'n huchibang khachibang in hoih ding in ka ngaihtuah hi.
english: Then Hushai said to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, “Ahithophel counseled Absalom and the elders of Israel that way; and I have counseled this way.

paite: Huaiziak in tuzan in gamdai lui kainate a giak nawn lou in kan ngeingei un. Huchi lou in zaw kumpipa leh akiang a om tengteng ahihmang vek kha ding uh chi in David hilhsak zok un," achi hi.
english: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, ‘Don’t lodge tonight at the fords of the wilderness, but by all means pass over, lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people who are with him.’”

paite: Khopi sung alut uh kuama'n amuhlouhna ding un, Jonathan leh Ahimaaz bel En-rogel ah a-om ua; sikhanu khat in amaute ava hilh zel hi. Amau kumpipa David ava hilhsawn zel uhi.
english: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying by En Rogel; and a female servant used to go and report to them, and they went and told King David; for they couldn’t risk being seen coming into the city.

paite: Himahleh naupang in ana mu a, Absalom ahilh hi. Himahleh anih un ataimang pah ua, Bahurim a mi khat, a-intual a tuileh nei inn ah ava hoh ua, tuileh sung ah alutsukta uhi.
english: But a boy saw them, and told Absalom. Then they both went away quickly and came to the house of a man in Bahurim, who had a well in his court; and they went down there.

paite: Numei in tuileh asitna in asin a, atung ah buh aphou a, kuama'n athei kei hi.
english: The woman took and spread the covering over the well’s mouth, and spread out crushed grain on it; and nothing was known.

paite: Absalom sikhate numei kiang ah ava hoh ua, "Ahimaaz leh Jonathan koi a om ahi ua?" achi uhi. Numei in akiang uah, "Luita tui akanta ding uh," ana chi hi. Ava zong ua, amu kei ua, Jerusalem ah akik nawn uh.
english: Absalom’s servants came to the woman to the house; and they said, “Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?” The woman said to them, “They have gone over the brook of water.” When they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, apaitum khit un tuileh a pan ahong pawtkhia ua, kumpipa David ava hilh uhi. David kiang ah, "Pawtkhia unla, tui kan pah un, huchi in Ahithophel in ahon tum hi," achi uh.
english: After they had departed, they came up out of the well and went and told King David; and they said to David, “Arise and pass quickly over the water; for thus has Ahithophel counseled against you.”

paite: Huchi in David leh akiang a mi om tengteng apawtkhia ua, Jordan lui akan uh. Khua ahong vak in Jordan lui kan lou khat lel leng a-om kei uh.
english: Then David arose, and all the people who were with him, and they passed over the Jordan. By the morning light there lacked not one of them who had not gone over the Jordan.

paite: Ahithophel in ahoihsakdan azui kei uh, chih atheih in asabiltung avan a, apawtkhia a, akhua ah apai hi. A-inkuante khosakna ding abawlsak sipsip a, huchi in a-awklumta hi. Amah asita a, apa han ah avui uhi.
english: When Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his donkey, arose, and went home to his city, set his house in order, and hanged himself; and he died, and was buried in the tomb of his father.

paite: Huchi in David, Mahanaim ava tung hi. Absalom in akiang a Israel mi tengteng toh Jordan lui akan uhi.
english: Then David came to Mahanaim. Absalom passed over the Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.

paite: Absalom in Joab sik in Amasa sepaih heutu ding in akoih hi. Amasa bel mi khat amin Ithra tapa ahi. Ithra ahihleh Israel mi, Joab nu sanggam Nahash tanu Abigail zi a neipa ahi.
english: Absalom set Amasa over the army instead of Joab. Now Amasa was the son of a man whose name was Ithra the Israelite, who went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah, Joab’s mother.

paite: Israel mite leh Absalom in Gilead gam ah panmun akhoh uhi.
english: Israel and Absalom encamped in the land of Gilead.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Mahanaim a David atun in, Ammon suan Rabbah a mi Nahash tapa Shobi, Lo-debar a mi Amiel tapa Makir leh Rogelim a Gilead mi Barzillaite'n
english: When David had come to Mahanaim, Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodebar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,

paite: lupnate, maiphiat kuangte, leibelte, huit buh, barli buh, tangbuang, be kankeu,
english: brought beds, basins, earthen vessels, wheat, barley, meal, parched grain, beans, lentils, roasted grain,

paite: khuaizu, mokhon, belamte, ganhon a pan nawikhalte, David leh akiang a om mite nek ding ahon tawi uhi, "Gamdai ah mite agilkial ua, atawl ua, adangtak uh," achih ziak un.
english: honey, butter, sheep, and cheese of the herd, for David and for the people who were with him to eat; for they said, “The people are hungry, weary, and thirsty in the wilderness.”

paite: Huan David in akiang a om mite asim a, sepaih sangkhat tung a heutute, zakhat tung a heutute abawl hi.
english: David counted the people who were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.

paite: David in mite asawlkhia a, mun thum a khen mun khat Joab in aheu a, mun thum a khen mun khat Joab unaupa Zeruiah tapa, Abishai in aheu a, mun thum a khen mun khat Git mi Ittai in aheu hi. Kumpipa'n mite kiang ah, "Keimah leng nou toh ka kuan ngeingei ding," achi hi.
english: David sent the people out, a third part under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. The king said to the people, “I will also surely go out with you myself.”

paite: Himahleh mipite'n, "Kuan lou e. Koute zaw na taimang hita le ung leng, khawk asa kei ding uh. Akimkhat hiam va si le ung leng khawk asa kei lai ding uh. Nang koute singkhat sang in na manphazaw hi. Huaiziak in khopi a pan hon panpih dia na na om ahoihzaw hi," achi uh.
english: But the people said, “You shall not go out, for if we flee away, they will not care for us, neither if half of us die, will they care for us. But you are worth ten thousand of us. Therefore now it is better that you are ready to help us out of the city.”

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang uah, "Hoih na sak bangbang un ka hih ding," achi hi. Huchi in kumpipa kulh kongpi bul ah adingh a, mipi tengteng azaza in leh asangsang in apaikhe zungzung uhi.
english: The king said to them, “I will do what seems best to you.” The king stood beside the gate, and all the people went out by hundreds and by thousands.

paite: Kumpipa'n Joab, Abishai leh Ittai kiang ah, kei ziak in tangval Absalom tung ah nemtak in hih un aw, chi in thu apia hi. Mipi tengteng in Absalom tungtang thu a kumpipa'n sepaih heutute tengteng thu apiak lai aza uhi.
english: The king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, “Deal gently for my sake with the young man Absalom.” All the people heard when the king commanded all the captains concerning Absalom.

paite: Huchi in mipite Israel mite dou ding in kidouna mun ah ahohta ua; akidouna uh Ephraim gammang ahi.
english: So the people went out into the field against Israel; and the battle was in the forest of Ephraim.

paite: Huai ah David mite ma ah Israel mite avuallel ua, huai ni in sepaih singnih athat uhi.
english: The people of Israel were struck there before David’s servants, and there was a great slaughter there that day of twenty thousand men.

paite: Akidouna un huai gam tengteng a-uap vek ngal a. Huai ni in namsau sang in leng gammang sung a mang a si atamzaw hi.
english: For the battle was there spread over the surface of all the country, and the forest devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.

paite: Absalom in David mite abingtuah guih hi. Absalom asabiltung tung a tuang ahi a, tosaw singhiang bawkphatak nuai ah sabiltung alut a, tosaw sing ah alu a-awkta hi. Lei leh van kikal ah aluai nilouh hi. Sabiltung ataisuak hi,
english: Absalom happened to meet David’s servants. Absalom was riding on his mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak; and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was hanging between the sky and earth; and the mule that was under him went on.

paite: Kuahiam in mu in, Joab ahilh a, "Ngai in, tosaw sing ah Absalom kikhai nilouh ka mu,” achi hi.
english: A certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, “Behold, I saw Absalom hanging in an oak.”

paite: Joab in ahilhpa kiang ah, "Ngai in, huai lah na mu ngal a, bangziak a hihlum a lei a kesak pah ngal lou? Huchibang a hih hi lechin dangka sawm leh kawnggak hon pe pah ding hi veng in," achi hi.
english: Joab said to the man who told him, “Behold, you saw it, and why didn’t you strike him there to the ground? I would have given you ten pieces of silver and a sash.”

paite: Huai mi'n Joab kiang ah, "Dangka sang mu ding hi leng le kumpipa tapa tung ah ka khut ka kha kei himhim ding, i bil ua i zak mahmah in kumpipa'n nang leh Abishai leh Ittai kiang ah, tangval Absalom kuamah in khoih het kei un, chi in thu ahon pe ngal a.
english: The man said to Joab, “Though I should receive a thousand pieces of silver in my hand, I still wouldn’t stretch out my hand against the king’s son; for in our hearing the king commanded you and Abishai and Ittai, saying, ‘Beware that no one touch the young man Absalom.’

paite: Ginom huai loutak in na that mawk leng, kumpipa lak ah lah bangmah sel theih ahi ngal kei a, nang lah na kihulsak nawn maimah tuak ngal a," achi hi.
english: Otherwise, if I had dealt falsely against his life (and there is no matter hidden from the king), then you yourself would have set yourself against me.”

paite: Huchi in Joab in, "Hichibang in na kiang ah ka om nilouh thei het kei," achi hi. Teipi thum atawi a, tosaw sing lak a na hing lai Absalom lungtang adawt pailet hi.
english: Then Joab said, “I’m not going to wait like this with you.” He took three darts in his hand and thrust them through Absalom’s heart while he was still alive in the middle of the oak.

paite: Joab galvan tawi tangval sawm in ahong um ua, Absalom asun ua, athatta uhi.
english: Ten young men who bore Joab’s armor surrounded and struck Absalom, and killed him.

paite: Joab in pengkul amut a, Israelte delh mipite ahong kik nawn ua; Joab in mite ana nang bikbek hi.
english: Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel; for Joab held the people back.

paite: Absalom luang ala ua, gammang ah leihawm thukpi ah apai ua, atung ah suang asekhawm venvon uhi. Huchi in Israel mi tengteng amau puanin chiat ah ataikekta uhi.
english: They took Absalom and cast him into a great pit in the forest, and raised over him a very great heap of stones. Then all Israel fled, each to his own tent.

paite: Absalom in adam lai in kumpipa phaizang ah amah theihgigena ding suang ana phut khin hi. Ka min adailouhna ding tapa lah ka nei ngal kei a, chi in ama min atamsak hi. Huchi in tuni tan in hiai Absalom theihgigena suangphuh chih in a-om hi.
english: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself the pillar which is in the king’s valley, for he said, “I have no son to keep my name in memory.” He called the pillar after his own name. It is called Absalom’s monument, to this day.

paite: Huchi in Zadok tapa Ahimaaz in, "Ka va tai dia, TOUPA'N amelma phu alaksakdan tanchin kumpipa ka va hilh ding," achi hi.
english: Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said, “Let me now run and carry the king news, how Yahweh has avenged him of his enemies.”

paite: Joab in akiang ah, "Tuni in zaw tanchin va hilh nai ke'n. Nidang chiang in tanchin va hilh zaw in, kumpipa tapa asih ziak in, tuni in zaw tanchin bangmah va hilh dah in," achi hi.
english: Joab said to him, “You must not be the bearer of news today, but you must carry news another day. But today you must carry no news, because the king’s son is dead.”

paite: Joab in Kush mi kiang ah, "Kuan inla, na thil muh kumpipa va hilh dih ve," achi hi. Huchi in Kush mi akun a, ataikhe pah hi.
english: Then Joab said to the Cushite, “Go, tell the king what you have seen!” The Cushite bowed himself to Joab, and ran.

paite: Zadok tapa Ahimaaz in Joab kiang ah, "Akoi abang hitaleh, Kush mipa ka va delh ding," achi hi. Joab in, "Ka tapa aw, tanchin hilh man lah na mu kei dia, bangziak a tai ding na hia?" achi hi.
english: Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said yet again to Joab, “But come what may, please let me also run after the Cushite.” Joab said, “Why do you want to run, my son, since you will have no reward for the news?”

paite: Himahleh ama'n, "Akoi abang hitaleh ka tai ding," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Tai mai ve leh," achi hi. Huchi in Phaizang lampi ah Ahimaaz atai a, Kush mipa amakhelh hi.
english: “But come what may,” he said, “I will run.” He said to him, “Run!” Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the Plain, and outran the Cushite.

paite: Kulh kongpi chial kikal ah David ana tu hi. Galvilpa kulh kongpi ponungzaw pen tunglam ah apaitou a, adak vialvial hi. Ngai in, mi khat amah kia in ahong tai hi.
english: Now David was sitting between the two gates; and the watchman went up to the roof of the gate to the wall, and lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, a man running alone.

paite: Galvilpa akikou a, kumpipa ahilh hi. Kumpipa'n, "Mi khat kia ahihleh tanchin hong gen ding nei ahi ding," achi a; ahong tai mengmeng a, ahong naih hiaihiai hi.
english: The watchman shouted and told the king. The king said, “If he is alone, there is news in his mouth.” He came closer and closer.

paite: Galvilpa'n midang hong tai amu nawn hi. Galvilpa'n kongkhak vilpa asam a, "Ngai in, midang amah kia in ahong tai nawn," achi hi. Kumpipa'n, "Ama'n leng tanchin hong tun sam ding nei ahi ve," achi hi.
english: The watchman saw another man running; and the watchman called to the gatekeeper and said, “Behold, a man running alone!” The king said, “He also brings news.”

paite: Galvilpa'n, "Amasapen taidan Zadok tapa Ahimaaz taidan bang mahmah in ka thei," achi hi. Huan kumpipa'n, "Amah mihoih mahmah ahi, tanchinhoih hon tun ding ahi," achi hi.
english: The watchman said, “I think the running of the first one is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok.” The king said, “He is a good man, and comes with good news.”

paite: Ahimaaz in asam a, kumpipa kiang ah, "Bangkim ahoih e," achi hi. Amai a lei si in kumpipa ma a kun in, "TOUPA, ka toupa sual a khut khak tum mite daltanpa TOUPA na Pathian phat in om hen," achi hi.
english: Ahimaaz called, and said to the king, “All is well.” He bowed himself before the king with his face to the earth, and said, “Blessed is Yahweh your God, who has delivered up the men who lifted up their hand against my lord the king!”

paite: Kumpipa'n, "Tangval Absalom adam na maw?" achi hi. Ahimaaz in adawng a, "Joab in kumpipa sikha, kei na sikha mahmah ahon sawlkhiak lai in abuai nuainuai uh ka mu a, himahleh bang ahia chih ka thei kei," achi hi.
english: The king said, “Is it well with the young man Absalom?” Ahimaaz answered, “When Joab sent the king’s servant, even me your servant, I saw a great tumult, but I don’t know what it was.”

paite: Kumpipa'n, "Ka pam ah hong dingh tadih in,” achi hi. Huchi in apam ah ana dingh hi.
english: The king said, “Come and stand here.” He came and stood still.

paite: Ngai in, Kush mi ahong tung hi. Kush mi'n, "Toupa ka kumpipa a ding in tanchin ka hon tun hi. Na tung a helte tengteng phu tuni in TOUPA'N ahon laksak hi," achi hi.
english: Behold, the Cushite came. The Cushite said, “Good news for my lord the king, for Yahweh has avenged you today of all those who rose up against you.”

paite: Kumpipa'n Kush mi kiang ah, "Tangval Absalom adam na maw?" achi hi. Kush mi in adawng a, "Toupa, ka kumpipa melmate leh na siatna zong mite tengteng huai tangval bang in om vek uheh," achi hi.
english: The king said to the Cushite, “Is it well with the young man Absalom?” The Cushite answered, “May the enemies of my lord the king, and all who rise up against you to do you harm, be as that young man is.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa alungdong mahmah a, kulh kongpi tung a dantan ah ahohtou a ava kap hi. Apaitouh kawm in, "Aw, ka tapa Absalom, ka tapa Absalom, na sih sik in si zaw mai leng maw, Aw Absalom, ka tapa, ka tapa," achi hi.
english: The king was much moved, and went up to the room over the gate and wept. As he went, he said, “My son Absalom! My son, my son Absalom! I wish I had died instead of you, Absalom, my son, my son!”

paite: Huan Joab ahilh ua, "Ngai in, kumpipa’n kap in Absalom asuun hi," achi uh.
english: Joab was told, “Behold, the king weeps and mourns for Absalom.”

paite: Huai ni a avualzohna uh mi tengteng a ding in suunna ahong hi zawta hi. "Atapa ziak in kumpipa alungkham mahmah," achih uh huai ni in mite'n lah ana zata ngal ua.
english: The victory that day was turned into mourning among all the people, for the people heard it said that day, “The king grieves for his son.”

paite: Mite kidouna a mi taimang azum ziak a aguk a paimang bang in huai ni in aguk in khopi ah alut uhi.
english: The people sneaked into the city that day, as people who are ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.

paite: Kumpipa'n amai ahum a, "Aw, ka tapa Absalom, aw Absalom, ka tapa, ka tapa!" chi in kumpipa akap huphup hi.
english: The king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, “My son Absalom, Absalom, my son, my son!”

paite: Inn ah kumpipa kiang ah Joab alut a, "Na hinna, na tapate hinna, na tanute hinna, na zite leh na meite hinna humbit mite tuni in zumtak in na bawlta hi.
english: Joab came into the house to the king, and said, “Today you have shamed the faces of all your servants who today have saved your life, and the lives of your sons and of your daughters, and the lives of your wives, and the lives of your concubines;

paite: Nang hon hote na it a, nang hon itte na hua hi. Heutute leh sepaihte nang a dia bangmah hilou bang in tuni in na hihlangta hi. Absalom dam in, kou midang tengteng tuni in si zaw vek le ung, na kipah lamtak hileh kilawm in ka thei hi.
english: in that you love those who hate you and hate those who love you. For you have declared today that princes and servants are nothing to you. For today I perceive that if Absalom had lived and we had all died today, then it would have pleased you well.

paite: Huaiziak in thou inla, pawtkhia in. Na mite lungmuansak ding lam thu gen in. Na pawtkhiak keileh TOUPA min lou in ka kichiam hi. Mi khat lel leng tuzan in na kiang ah a-om kei ding. Huai lah nang a ding in na tuailai a pan tutan a na tung a thil hoih lou hong tung teng sang in ahoih kei zaw ding," achi hi.
english: Now therefore arise, go out and speak to comfort your servants; for I swear by Yahweh, if you don’t go out, not a man will stay with you this night. That would be worse to you than all the evil that has happened to you from your youth until now.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa athou a, kulh kongpi ah ava tu hi. "Ngai un, kumpipa kulh kongpi ah atu hi,” chi in mipi tengteng ahilh uhi. Mipi tengteng kumpipa ma ah ava hoh uhi. Israelte bel amau puanin chiat ah ataikek uhi.
english: Then the king arose and sat in the gate. The people were all told, “Behold, the king is sitting in the gate.” All the people came before the king. Now Israel had fled every man to his tent.

paite: Israel nam a mi tengteng akisel vengvung ua, "Kumpipa'n i melmate khut a pan hon hunkhia a, Philistiate khut a pan hon hondamta. Tu in Absalom ziak in gam ataikhiaksan hi.
english: All the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, “The king delivered us out of the hand of our enemies, and he saved us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he has fled out of the land from Absalom.

paite: Absalom i kumpipa dia thau i nilhpa uh lah kidouna ah asita a; bang achia kumpipa pikikna ding kam khat bek na gen louh uh?" akichi uh.
english: Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why don’t you speak a word of bringing the king back?”

paite: Kumpipa'n siampu Zadok leh Abiathar kiang ah asawl a, Judah upate kiang ah, "Bangziak a kumpipa a-inn a pikik thu a, azekaipen a pang na hi ua? Israel mite'n kumpipa pikik thu agen uh lah kumpipa kiang atungta ngal a.
english: King David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, “Speak to the elders of Judah, saying, ‘Why are you the last to bring the king back to his house, since the speech of all Israel has come to the king, to return him to his house?

paite: Ка unaute na hi ua, ka guh leh ka sa lah na hi ngal ua, bang achia azekaipen a pang peuhmah na hi ua? chi in va gen un,” achi hi.
english: You are my brothers. You are my bone and my flesh. Why then are you the last to bring back the king?’

paite: Amasa kiang ah, "Ka guh leh ka sa na hi kei a hia? Joab sik a ka ma a sepaihte heutu a ka hon bawl keileh, Pathian in alohloh hon loh mai henla, huai sang a thupizaw in leng, achi," chi ding in mi asawl hi.
english: Say to Amasa, ‘Aren’t you my bone and my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if you aren’t captain of the army before me continually instead of Joab.’”

paite: Huchi in Judah mi tengteng lungtang mi khat lungtang bang mai in a-awnsakta hi. Huchi in kumpipa kiang ah, "Na mi tengteng toh hong kik nawn un," chi ding in mi asawl uhi.
english: He bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as one man, so that they sent to the king, saying, “Return, you and all your servants.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa apai nawn a, Jordan ahong tung hi. Kumpipa dawn a, Jordan a na pi galkai ding in Gilgal ah Judahte ahoh uhi.
english: So the king returned, and came to the Jordan. Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to bring the king over the Jordan.

paite: Hahurim a Benjamin mi Gera tapa Shimei leng kintak in kumpipa dawn ding in Judahte mah toh kiton in apawtkhia hi.
english: Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, who was of Bahurim, hurried and came down with the men of Judah to meet King David.

paite: Akiang ah Benjamin mi sangkhat toh, Saul inkote sikha Ziba, atapa sawm-le-nga leh asikha sawmnih toh ahi ua, kumpipa ma in Jordan agalkah uhi.
english: There were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of Saul’s house, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went through the Jordan in the presence of the king.

paite: Kumpipa inkote pi galkahna ding leh hoih asak bangbang a hih ding in long apaipih uh. Jordan lui agalkahleh kumpipa ma ah Gera tapa Shimei abokkhup hi.
english: A ferry boat went to bring over the king’s household, and to do what he thought good. Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king when he had come over the Jordan.

paite: Kumpipa kiang ah, "Ka toupa'n thulimlouhna nei in hon sep kei henla; toupa ka kumpipa'n Jerusalem apawtsan ni a na sikha in dikloutak a ana hihte leng theigige sam kei hen. Kumpipa'n alungtang ah pai kei hen.
english: He said to the king, “Don’t let my lord impute iniquity to me, or remember that which your servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.

paite: Na sikha in thil ka hihkhial chih ka kithei hi. Huaiziak in ngai in, Joseph inko tengteng lak a ka toupa kumpipa mu dia tuni a hong pawt masapen ka hi," achi hi.
english: For your servant knows that I have sinned. Therefore behold, I have come today as the first of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.”

paite: Himahleh Zeruiah tapa Abishai in adawng a, "TOUPA thaunilhpa ahamsiat ziak in Shimei pen thah ding ahi kei dia hia?" achi hi.
english: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered, “Shouldn’t Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed Yahweh’s anointed?”

paite: David in, "Nou Zeruiah tapate aw, nou na hon na theihsak ding uh bang ahia om? Tuni a kei hon doute na hi ding uh maw? Tuni a Israelte lak a mi thah ahi dia hia? Tuni in Israel mite tung a kumpipa ka hihthei lou ka hi maw?" achi hi.
english: David said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah, that you should be adversaries to me today? Shall any man be put to death today in Israel? For don’t I know that I am king over Israel today?”

paite: Huaiziak in kumpipa'n Shimei kiang ah, "Na si kei ding," achi hi. Huchi in Kumpipa akiang ah akichiamta hi.
english: The king said to Shimei, “You will not die.” The king swore to him.

paite: Kumpipa mu ding in Saul tapa Mephibosheth ahong hi. Kumpipa apawtkhiak ni a pan galmuang a ahong pai nawn ni tan in akhete azun kei a, akhamul atan kei a, apuan leng asawp sam kei.
english: Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king; and he had neither groomed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came home in peace.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa mu dia Jerusalem ahong tun in kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Mephibosheth, bangziak a ka kiang a hong sam lou?" achi hi.
english: When he had come to Jerusalem to meet the king, the king said to him, “Why didn’t you go with me, Mephibosheth?”

paite: Ama'n adawng a, "Ka toupa, kumpipa aw, ka sikha in ahon khem a; na sikha in, kumpipa kiang a hoh ding in ka tuanna ding sabiltung ka van ding, ka chi a; na sikha lah akhe abai ngal a.
english: He answered, “My lord, O king, my servant deceived me. For your servant said, ‘I will saddle a donkey for myself, that I may ride on it and go with the king,’ because your servant is lame.

paite: Kumpipa ka toupa kiang ah na sikha ahek hi. Himahleh toupa ka kumpipa Pathian angel ahi. Huaiziak in hoih na sak bangbang in hih in.
english: He has slandered your servant to my lord the king, but my lord the king is as an angel of God. Therefore do what is good in your eyes.

paite: Ka pa inkote tengteng toupa ka kumpipa ma a thah vek dia kilawm ahi uh. Himahleh na sikha na an umpihte lak ah na pangsak hi. Huaiziak in kumpipa kiang ah thil dang phut ngam lai dia kilawm ka hi maw?" achi hi.
english: For all my father’s house were but dead men before my lord the king; yet you set your servant among those who ate at your own table. What right therefore have I yet that I should appeal any more to the king?”

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Na tungtang thu bangziak a gen nawn nak na hia? Nang leh Ziba gam kihawm un ka chi hi,” achi hi.
english: The king said to him, “Why do you speak any more of your matters? I say, you and Ziba divide the land.”

paite: Mephibosheth in kumpipa kiang ah, "Eh, ama'n tang vek hen, toupa ka kumpipa lah ama inn mah ah galmuang in ahong pai nawnta ngal a,” achi hi.
english: Mephibosheth said to the king, “Yes, let him take all, because my lord the king has come in peace to his own house.”

paite: Rogelim a pan Gilead mi Barzillai ahong suk a; kumpipa Jordan a pi galkai ding in amah toh Jordan ah ahoh hi.
english: Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim; and he went over the Jordan with the king to conduct him over the Jordan.

paite: Barzillai upapi ahi a, kum sawmgiat a upa ahita. Mahanaim a kumpipa om sung in nek ding apia a, amah mineizoutak ahi.
english: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even eighty years old. He had provided the king with sustenance while he stayed at Mahanaim, for he was a very great man.

paite: Kumpipa'n Barzillai kiang ah, "Ka kiang ah hong inla, ka kiang ah Jerusalem ah ka hon vak ding," achi hi.
english: The king said to Barzillai, “Come over with me, and I will sustain you with me in Jerusalem.”

paite: Barzillai in kumpipa kiang ah, "Jerusalem a kumpipa toh hohtou ding in bang tan ka dam lai dia?
english: Barzillai said to the king, “How many are the days of the years of my life, that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?

paite: Tu in kum sawmgiat ka hita a; asia leh apha ka khen thei a hia? Na sikha in ka nek-le-dawn, a lim leh lim louh leng a theikak thei a hia? Pasal leh numeite lasak ging leng ka za thei nawn a hia? Huaiziak in na sikha bang ding a toupa ka kumpipa a dia puakgik ka hih maizen ding?
english: I am eighty years old, today. Can I discern between good and bad? Can your servant taste what I eat or what I drink? Can I hear the voice of singing men and singing women any more? Why then should your servant be a burden to my lord the king?

paite: Na sikha in kumpipa toh Jordan galkah lel ka tup ahi. Bang ding in kumpipa'n huchibang in hoih man ahon thuk chitchiat dia?
english: Your servant will just go over the Jordan with the king. Why should the king repay me with such a reward?

paite: Hehpih in na sikha hon paisak nawn mai in, ka hon ngen ahi. Ka nu leh ka pa han omna koumau kho ngei ah ka si ding. Himahleh en in, na sikha Chimham; toupa ka kumpipa toh hong galkah henla, atung ah hoih na sak bangbang in hih in,” achi hi.
english: Please let your servant turn back again, that I may die in my own city, by the grave of my father and my mother. But behold, your servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good to you.”

paite: Kumpipa'n adawng a, "Chimham ka kiang ah agalkah sam dia, hoih na sak bang zel in atung ah ka hih ding. Thil na hon nget peuhmah ka hon hihsak ding," achi hi.
english: The king answered, “Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good to you. Whatever you request of me, that I will do for you.”

paite: Huchi in mi tengteng Jordan gal akah ua, kumpipa leng agalkah hi. Kumpipa'n Barzillai atawp a, avualzawl hi. Huchi in amah amun ah apai nawnta hi.
english: All the people went over the Jordan, and the king went over. Then the king kissed Barzillai and blessed him; and he returned to his own place.

paite: Huchi in Gilgal ah kumpipa agalkah a, amah toh Chimham agalkah sam hi. Juda mi tengteng in kumpipa api galkah ua, Israel mi leng akimkhat apang uhi.
english: So the king went over to Gilgal, and Chimham went over with him. All the people of Judah brought the king over, and also half the people of Israel.

paite: Ngai in, Israel mi tengteng kumpipa kiang ah ahong ua, kumpipa kiang ah, "Bang achia ka unau uh Judah mite'n nang hon gukhia a, kumpipa leh a-inkote leh David mite teng Jordan gal a apikhawm vek mawk uh?" achi uhi.
english: Behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said to the king, “Why have our brothers the men of Judah stolen you away, and brought the king and his household, over the Jordan, and all David’s men with him?”

paite: Judah mi tengteng in Israel mite adawng ua, "Kumpipa ka kinaihpih uh ahih ziak ahi. Bangziak a hiai thu a heh mawk? Kumpipa neih muang a om ka hi mahmah uh maw? Thilpiak banghiamte leng ahon nei a hia?" achi uh.
english: All the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, “Because the king is a close relative to us. Why then are you angry about this matter? Have we eaten at all at the king’s cost? Or has he given us any gift?”

paite: Israel mite'n Judah mite adawng ua, "Kumpipa ah tan sawm ka nei ua, David ah noute sang in anglaitanna ka nei zaw uh. Bangziak a hon ngaineu maw? Kumpipa pikik nawn sawm masate ka hi kei uh maw?" achi uh. Huchi in Judah mite thu Israel mite thu sang in akhauhzaw hi.
english: The men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, “We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more claim to David than you. Why then did you despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king?” The words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai nung in David in, "Judah gam a khua khatpeuh ah ka hohtou diam?" chi in TOUPA adong hi. TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Hohtou in," achi hi. David in, "Koi ah ahia ka hohtouh ding?" achi a, Ama'n, "Hebron ah,” achi hi.
english: After this, David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah?” Yahweh said to him, “Go up.” David said, “Where shall I go up?” He said, “To Hebron.”

paite: Huchi in David, azi nihte, Jezreel mi Ahinoam leh Karmel mi Nabal zi Abigail toh huai ah ahohtou hi.
english: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

paite: David in akiang a om mi tengteng apitou a, michih a-inkuante chiat uh toh, Hebron khuate ah atengta uhi.
english: David brought up his men who were with him, every man with his household. They lived in the cities of Hebron.

paite: Judah gam a mite ahong hoh ua, huai ah Judah inkote tung a kumpipa ding in David thau anilh uhi. Huchi in "Saul vui mite Jabesh-gilead mite ahi uh," chi in David ahilh uhi.
english: The men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. They told David, “The men of Jabesh Gilead were those who buried Saul.”

paite: Jabesh-gilead mite kiang ah David in mite asawl a, akiang uah, "Na pu uh Saul na hehpihdan uh hihlang a na vui ziak un, TOUPA'N hon vualzawl hen.
english: David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh Gilead, and said to them, “Blessed are you by Yahweh, that you have shown this kindness to your lord, even to Saul, and have buried him.

paite: Tu in TOUPA'N na tung uah zahngaihna leh thutak langsak henla; hiai thil na hih ziak un ke'n leng na chit man uh ka hon thuk ding.
english: Now may Yahweh show loving kindness and truth to you. I also will reward you for this kindness, because you have done this thing.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in na khutte uh hong hat henla, hangsantak in om un. Na pu uh Saul asita hi. Judah inkote'n atung ua kumpipa ding in thau ahon nilh khinta uhi," chi in ava gensak hi.
english: Now therefore let your hands be strong, and be valiant; for Saul your lord is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.”

paite: Himahleh Ner tapa Abner, Saul sepaihte heutu in, Mahanaim ah Saul tapa Ishboshet apaipih hi.
english: Now Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul’s army, had taken Ishbosheth the son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim.

paite: Gilead, Ashur, Jezreel, Ephraim leh Israel tengteng tung a kumpipa in abawlta hi.
english: He made him king over Gilead, over the Ashurites, over Jezreel, over Ephraim, over Benjamin, and over all Israel.

paite: Saul tapa Ishboshet in Israel tung a vaihawm apat in kum sawmli a upa ahi a, kum nih sung vai ahawm hi. Himahleh Judah mite'n David azui uh.
english: Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and he reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.

paite: David in Hebron a Judah chite tung ah kum sagih leh kha guk vai ahawm hi.
english: The time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.

paite: Ner tapa Abner leh Saul tapa Ishboshet sikhate Mahanaim a pan apawtkhia ua, Gibeon ah apai uhi.
english: Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

paite: Zeruiah tapa Joab leh David sikhate apaikhia ua, Gibeon dil ah akituak uhi. Pawl khat dil gal khat lam ah atu a, pawl khat pen dil gal langkhat ah atu hi.
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah and David’s servants went out, and met them by the pool of Gibeon; and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool and the other on the other side of the pool.

paite: Abner in Joab kiang ah, "Tangvalte hong kuan uhenla, i ma uah hong kisual uhen," achi hi. Joab in, "Hong kuan le uh ake," achi hi.
english: Abner said to Joab, “Please let the young men arise and compete before us!” Joab said, “Let them arise!”

paite: Huchi in akuan ua, azah chiang sep in agalkah phei ua, Benjamin chi, Saul tapa Ishboshet lam a pang sawm-le-nih, David sikha sawm-le-nih ahi uh.
english: Then they arose and went over by number: twelve for Benjamin and for Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of David’s servants.

paite: Alangte uh lu chiat ah akimantuah ua, amau tumte chiat namsau in anak ah akidawt ua; apukkhawm vek uhi. Huaiziak in huai mun Helkath-hazzurim achi ua, huai Gibeon a om ahi.
english: They each caught his opponent by the head and thrust his sword in his fellow’s side; so they fell down together. Therefore that place in Gibeon was called Helkath Hazzurim.

paite: Huai ni a akisual uh athupi mahmah a, David sikhate ma ah Abner leh Israel mite zoh in a-om uhi,
english: The battle was very severe that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before David’s servants.

paite: Huai mun ah Zeruiah tapate thum, Joab, Abishai leh Asahel a-om uhi. Asahel zukpi bang a ngalhat ahi.
english: The three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab, Abishai, and Asahel. Asahel was as light of foot as a wild gazelle.

paite: Asahel in Abner adelh a; Abner adelh taklam hiam veilam hiam a pialsan het lou in adelh vengveng hi.
english: Asahel pursued Abner. He didn’t turn to the right hand or to the left from following Abner.

paite: Abner alehngat a, "Nang na hi maw, Asahel?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, “Ka hi,” achi hi.
english: Then Abner looked behind him and said, “Is that you, Asahel?” He answered, “It is.”

paite: Abner in akiang ah, "Na taklam hiam, na veilam hiam ah pialkhia inla, tangval khat man inla, agalvan laksak in," achi hi. Himahleh Asahel in amah adelh apialsan nuam tuan kei hi.
english: Abner said to him, “Turn away to your right hand or to your left, and grab one of the young men, and take his armor.” But Asahel would not turn away from following him.

paite: Abner in Asahel kiang ah, "Hon pialsan in. Bangziak a lei a hon satpuk ding ka hia? Na unaupa Joab mel ka mu ngam dia hia?" achi nawn hi.
english: Abner said again to Asahel, “Turn away from following me. Why should I strike you to the ground? How then could I look Joab your brother in the face?”

paite: Himahleh apial nuam tuan kei. Huaiziak in Abner in ateipi tolam in anakguh ngana nuaitak asun a, anunglam ah teipi apaisuak a, huai mun a puk in asita hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, Asahel puk a, asihna mun a hong pai teng huai mun ah akhawl zel uhi.
english: However, he refused to turn away. Therefore Abner with the back end of the spear struck him in the body, so that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there and died in the same place. As many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.

paite: Himahleh, Joab leh Abishai in Abner adelhzui ua; Gibeon gamdai lampi a Giah chin a Ammah mual atun un ni atumta hi.
english: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner. The sun went down when they had come to the hill of Ammah, that lies before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.

paite: Benjamin suante Abner kiang ah akikaikhawm ua, pawl khat in akibawl ua, mualvum ah ava dinghta uh.
english: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner and became one band, and stood on the top of a hill.

paite: Abner in Joab asam a, "Namsau in hon negai den ding hia? Atawplam in ahong kha mahmah ding, chih na thei kei maw? Bang tan ahia a-unaute uh delh tawpsan a kik nawn dia mipite hilh lou a na om ding?" achi hi.
english: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, “Shall the sword devour forever? Don’t you know that it will be bitterness in the latter end? How long will it be then, before you ask the people to return from following their brothers?”

paite: Joab in, "Pathian ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Bangmah na gen lou hi lechin zingchiang a pan mite paimang khinta ding ua, a-unaute uh delh lou ding hi ve un," achi hi.
english: Joab said, “As God lives, if you had not spoken, surely then in the morning the people would have gone away, and not each followed his brother.”

paite: Joab in pengkul amut a, mite adingh depdup uh. Israel mite adelhta kei ua, kuamah asual nawnta kei uhi.
english: So Joab blew the trumpet; and all the people stood still and pursued Israel no more, and they fought no more.

paite: Abner leh amite zankhua in phaizang tawnsuak a pai in Jordan akan ua, Bithron akantan ua, Mahanaim atung uhi.
english: Abner and his men went all that night through the Arabah; and they passed over the Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and came to Mahanaim.

paite: Joab bel Abner delh akik nawnta a, mipi tengteng akaihkhawm vek leh David sikhate sawm-le-kua leh Asahel akimta kei uhi.
english: Joab returned from following Abner; and when he had gathered all the people together, nineteen men of David’s and Asahel were missing.

paite: Himahleh David sikhate'n Benjamin mite leh Abner mite zathum-le-sawmguk athat uhi.
english: But David’s servants had struck Benjamin and Abner’s men so that three hundred sixty men died.

paite: Asahel luang ala ua, Bethlehem a apa han ah avui uh. Joab leh amite zankhua in apai ua, khovak in Hebron atung uhi.
english: They took up Asahel and buried him in the tomb of his father, which was in Bethlehem. Joab and his men went all night, and the day broke on them at Hebron.

paite: Huan Benjamin mi Bikri tapa Sheba, Belial mi khat ana om hi. Ama'n pengkul amut a, "David ah tantuan i nei kei ua, Jesse tapa ah leng gouluah ding i nei sam kei, Israel mite aw, na puanin lam chiat uah pai un," achi hi.
english: There happened to be there a wicked fellow, whose name was Sheba the son of Bichri, a Benjamite; and he blew the trumpet, and said, “We have no portion in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse. Every man to his tents, Israel!”

paite: Huchi in Israel mi tengteng in David azuih uh alehngatsan ua, Bikri tapa Sheba azuita uhi. Judah mite'n Jordan a pan Jerusalem pha in akumpipa uh alen tinten uhi.
english: So all the men of Israel went up from following David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri; but the men of Judah joined with their king, from the Jordan even to Jerusalem.

paite: Jerusalem a a-inn ah David ahong pai hi. Kumpipa'n numei sawm ameite inn ngak dia akoihte api a, inn khat ah akhum a, anek ding uh pia in avak a, himahleh amaute akithuahpih kei hi.
english: David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in custody and provided them with sustenance, but didn’t go in to them. So they were shut up to the day of their death, living in widowhood.

paite: Kumpipa'n Amasa kiang ah, "Ni thum sung in Judah mite hon sapkhawmsak inla, nang leng hong om sam in," achi hi.
english: Then the king said to Amasa, “Call me the men of Judah together within three days, and be here present.”

paite: Huchi in Amasa leng Judah mite samkhawm ding in akuan hi. Himahleh ahun sehsak sang in ava tam sawt zawta hi.
english: So Amasa went to call the men of Judah together, but he stayed longer than the set time which had been appointed to him.

paite: David in Abishai kiang ah, "Bikri tapa Sheba in Absalom sang in i poi uh akhoihzaw dia hia? Na toupa mite pi inla delh un. Huchi lou in zaw khokulh nei ah alut man dia, muh phak louh in i khahsuah kha ding," achi hi.
english: David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom did. Take your lord’s servants and pursue after him, lest he get himself fortified cities, and escape out of our sight.”

paite: Huchi in Joab mite, Kereth mite, Pelet mite leh amihat tengteng un amah azuikheta uh. Jerusalem a pan Bikri tapa Sheba delh ding in apawtkhia uhi.
english: Joab’s men went out after him with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the mighty men; and they went out of Jerusalem to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.

paite: Gibeon a suangpi omna ava tun un, Amasa in amaute ana dawn hi. Joab in kidouna van asilh a, atung ah namsau apai toh kawnggak ah akuah hi. Mailam a apai kawm in huai namsau aphawi hi.
english: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Joab was clothed in his apparel of war that he had put on, and on it was a sash with a sword fastened on his waist in its sheath; and as he went along it fell out.

paite: Joab in Amasa kiang ah, Unaupa, "Na hoih tadih na maw?" achi hi. Huai khit in Joab in Amasa tawp ding in akhut taklam in akhamul aman hi.
english: Joab said to Amasa, “Is it well with you, my brother?” Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.

paite: Himahleh Amasa in Joab in atawi namsau alimsak kei hi. Joab in agil ah adawt a, agilzangte lei ah atolhkhe zelzul a, adawt tuan nawn kei hi. Huchi in asita hi. Joab leh a-unaupa Abishai in Bikri tapa Sheba adelh uhi.
english: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand. So he struck him with it in the body and shed out his bowels to the ground, and didn’t strike him again; and he died. Joab and Abishai his brother pursued Sheba the son of Bichri.

paite: Akiang ah Joab mite lak a tangval khat adingh a, "Joab lam a pang leh David lam a pang peuhmah in Joab zui hen," achi hi.
english: One of Joab’s young men stood by him, and said, “He who favors Joab, and he who is for David, let him follow Joab!”

paite: Amasa bel lamlian laitak ah si a kidiah in ana lum hi. Huai mi'n mi tengteng dingh dide amuh in lamlian a pan Amasa luang gamlak ah asuan a, akiang a hong pai peuhmah khawl zel a amuh ziak in puan in atuam hi.
english: Amasa lay wallowing in his blood in the middle of the highway. When the man saw that all the people stood still, he carried Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a garment over him when he saw that everyone who came by him stood still.

paite: Lamlian a pan suankhiak ahih nung in Bikri tapa Sheba delh ding in mi tengteng in Joab azui uhi.
english: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.

paite: Abel leh Beth-maaka pha in Israel nam tengteng leh Ber mi tengteng atawn vek a; amau akikaikhawm ua amah azuita uhi.
english: He went through all the tribes of Israel to Abel, to Beth Maacah, and all the Berites. They were gathered together, and went also after him.

paite: Beth-maaka a Abel ah amah a-um ua; kho zulzul ah lei achiang ua, kulh zul ah adingh uhi. Joab kiang a mi om tengteng in chimsak ding in kulh akhoh ok-ok uhi.
english: They came and besieged him in Abel of Beth Maacah, and they cast up a mound against the city, and it stood against the rampart; and all the people who were with Joab battered the wall to throw it down.

paite: Huchi in khua a pan numei pil khat ahong kikou a, "Ngai un, ngai un; Joab kiang ah, hong pai nai in, na kiang ah thu ka gen ding, va chi un," achi hi.
english: Then a wise woman cried out of the city, “Hear, hear! Please say to Joab, ‘Come near here, that I may speak with you.’”

paite: Akiang ava naihtak in numei in, "Joab na hi hia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Hi e," chi in adawng hi. Huchi in akiang ah, "Na sikhanu thugen ngaikhe dih," achi a, ama'n, "Ka ngaikhia hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: He came near to her; and the woman said, “Are you Joab?” He answered, “I am.” Then she said to him, “Hear the words of your servant.” He answered, “I’m listening.”

paite: Huai numei in, "Nidanglai in Abel ah akikum ngeingei ding uh," achi zel uh. Huchibang in thu atawpsak zel uhi.
english: Then she spoke, saying, “They used to say in old times, ‘They shall surely ask counsel at Abel,’ and so they settled a matter.

paite: Kei Israel lak a kituah ut leh muanhuai mite lak a khat ka hi. Nang zaw Israel khua, akho bulpi pen hihsiat tum na hi lim ve. Bangziak a TOUPA gou nawmvalh tum na hia? achi hi.
english: I am among those who are peaceable and faithful in Israel. You seek to destroy a city and a mother in Israel. Why will you swallow up Yahweh’s inheritance?”

paite: Joab in adawng a, "Huchibang ahi zenzen kei. Nawmvalh hiam, hihsiat hiam ka tum kei himhim hi.
english: Joab answered, “Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.

paite: Huchibang thu ahi kei. Ephraim tanggam a mi Bikri tapa amin Sheba in kumpipa kalh in, David hilhial kalh in akhut alik hi. Amah hon pekhe le uchin khua ka pawtsan mai ding,” achi hi. Numei in Joab kiang ah, "Ngai in, kulh a pan alutang lotkhiak ahi ding," achi hi.
english: The matter is not so. But a man of the hill country of Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has lifted up his hand against the king, even against David. Just deliver him, and I will depart from the city.” The woman said to Joab, “Behold, his head will be thrown to you over the wall.”

paite: Huchi in numei in apilna in mi tengteng kiang ah ava pai a, Bikri tapa Sheba lutang atan ua, Joab kiang ah alawnkhia uhi. Huchi in pengkul amut a, amau puanin chiat zuan in khua a pan apaita uhi. Jerusalem ah kumpipa kiang ah Joab apaikikta hi.
english: Then the woman went to all the people in her wisdom. They cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and threw it out to Joab. He blew the trumpet, and they were dispersed from the city, every man to his tent. Then Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.

paite: Israel sepaih tengteng heutu Joab ahi a; Jehoiada tapa Benaiah ahihleh Kereth mi leh Pelet mite heutu ahi.
english: Now Joab was over all the army of Israel, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites,

paite: Adoram phutluih nasem dia goih a omte heutu ahi a, Ahilud tapa Jehoshaphat tanchin gelhmi ahi.
english: Adoram was over the men subject to forced labor, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder,

paite: Sheva, laigelhmi ahi a; Zadok leh Abiathar ahihleh siampute ahi uh.
english: Sheva was scribe, Zadok and Abiathar were priests,

paite: Jair mi Ira leng David vaihawmtu lian ahi.
english: and Ira the Jairite was chief minister to David.

paite: Huan David dam lai in kum kizom in kum thum kial akia hi. David in TOUPA adong a, TOUPA'N, "Saul leh sisan suahmi a-inkote ziak ahi. Amau Gibeon mite athat ngal ua," achi hi.
english: There was a famine in the days of David for three years, year after year; and David sought the face of Yahweh. Yahweh said, “It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he put the Gibeonites to death.”

paite: Kumpipa'n Gibeon mite asam a, akiang uah, Gibeon mite Israel suante ahi kei ua, Amor mi khosuaksunte ahi zaw uh. Israel suante amau kiang ah ana kichiam khin ua; Saul in Israel suante leh Judah suante a dia phatuam angaih ziak in thah atum nak hi.
english: The king called the Gibeonites and said to them (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites, and the children of Israel had sworn to them; and Saul sought to kill them in his zeal for the children of Israel and Judah);

paite: David in Gibeon mite kiang ah, "Bang ahia ka hon hihsak ding? TOUPA gou na vualzawl theihna ding un bangchibang in hihdik thak nawnna ka bawl dia?" achi hi.
english: and David said to the Gibeonites, “What should I do for you? And with what should I make atonement, that you may bless Yahweh’s inheritance?”

paite: Gibeon mite'n akiang ah, "Saul leh a-inkote dangka leh dangka-eng ka la kei ding uh. Kou ziak in Israel ah mi kuamah na that kei ding uh," achi uhi. Ama'n, "Na gen peuhmah uh ka hon hihsak ding,” achi hi.
english: The Gibeonites said to him, “It is no matter of silver or gold between us and Saul or his house; neither is it for us to put any man to death in Israel.” He said, “I will do for you whatever you say.”

paite: Amau kumpipa kiang ah, "Hon hihmangpa leh Israel gamsung himhim a om lou dia hihmang hon sawmpa,
english: They said to the king, “The man who consumed us and who plotted against us, that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the borders of Israel,

paite: tapa sagihte hon pia inla, TOUPA miseh Saul omna Gibeah ah TOUPA ma ah ka khailum ding uh," achi uh. Kumpipa'n, "Hon pe leng ake," achi hi.
english: let seven men of his sons be delivered to us, and we will hang them up to Yahweh in Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of Yahweh.” The king said, “I will give them.”

paite: Himahleh kumpipa'n, David leh Saul tapa Jonathan kikal a, anih ua kal a TOUPA kichiamna ziak in Saul tapa Jonathan tapa Mephibosheth ahawi hi.
english: But the king spared Mephibosheth the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of Yahweh’s oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.

paite: Kumpipa'n Aiah tanu Rizpah in Saul tapa nih aneihsak Armoni leh Mephibosheth api a, Meholath mi Barzillai tapa Adriel, Saul tanu Mikal in tapa nga aneihsakte toh
english: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bore to Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Merab the daughter of Saul, whom she bore to Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite.

paite: Gibeon mite khut ah apekhia a, mual a TOUPA ma ah akhailum uhi. Huchi in asagih un asikhawm uhi. Buh lak hun, barli buhlak pat lai in athatta uhi.
english: He delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites; and they hanged them on the mountain before Yahweh, and all seven of them fell together. They were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, at the beginning of barley harvest.

paite: Aiah tanu Rizpah in sai-ip puan ala a, amah a ding in suangpi tung ah aphah hi. Buh lak kipat tung a pan huai siluangte tung a van vuahtui in abuah tan in, sun chia siluangte tung a vasate atuk ding uh leh zan chia gamsate khoih ding aphal kei hi.
english: Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it for herself on the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water poured on them from the sky. She allowed neither the birds of the sky to rest on them by day, nor the animals of the field by night.

paite: Aiah tanu, Saul meinu Rizpah thilhih David ahilh uhi.
english: David was told what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.

paite: Huchi in David akuan a, Philistia mite'n Gilboa a Saul athah ni ua Philistia mite'n Beth-shan mun lian a akhai uh aguhte uh, Jabesh-gilead mite'n ava guklak uh, Saul guh leh atapa Jonathan guhte ala hi.
english: So David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh Gilead, who had stolen them from the street of Beth Shan, where the Philistines had hanged them in the day that the Philistines killed Saul in Gilboa;

paite: Huai a pan Saul guhte leh atapa Jonathan guhte alatou a; akhailupte uh guhte leng alakhawm hi.
english: and he brought up from there the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son. They also gathered the bones of those who were hanged.

paite: Saul guhte leh atapa Jonathan guhte Benjamin gam a Jelaha apa Kish han ah avui uh. Kumpipa thupiak dungzui in ahih uhi. Huai khit in huai gam tung ah Pathian alungkimta hi.
english: They buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the tomb of Kish his father; and they performed all that the king commanded. After that, God answered prayer for the land.

paite: Philistia mite'n Israel mite adou nawn uhi. David, amite toh ava kuansuk ua; Philistia mite ava sual ua, David abah mahmah hi.
english: The Philistines had war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines. David grew faint;

paite: Ishbi-benob, milian tapate lak a khat, ateipi gikdan dal shekel zathum, namsau thak kuah in David thah atum hi.
english: and Ishbibenob, who was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear was three hundred shekels of bronze in weight, he being armed with a new sword, thought he would kill David.

paite: Himahleh Zeruiah tapa Abishai in ahong hunkhia a, Philistia mi sual in athatta hi. David mite'n, "Israelte khawnvak na mihsaklouhna ding in kidou ding in ka kiang uah nang zaw na kuan nawn kei ding," chi in akiang ah akichiam uhi.
english: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah helped him, and struck the Philistine and killed him. Then the men of David swore to him, saying, “Don’t go out with us to battle any more, so that you don’t quench the lamp of Israel.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Gob ah Philistiate toh kidouna dang khat a-om nawn hi. Huai hun in Hushat mi Sibbekai in milian suante lak a khat Saph kichi athat hi.
english: After this, there was again war with the Philistines at Gob. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, who was of the sons of the giant.

paite: Philistia mite toh Gob ah akidou nawn uh. Bethlehem mi Jaar oregim tapa Elhanan in Git mi Goliath unaupa athat a, huai mi teipi tuh siam kolpi bang ahi.
english: There was again war with the Philistines at Gob, and Elhanan the son of Jaare-Oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite’s brother, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

paite: Gath ah kidouna a-om nawn hi. Huai ah mi khat asan a sang, akhut langkhat tuaktuak a khutzung guk, akhe langkhat tuaktuak a khezung guk, avek a sawmnih-le-li nei a-om hi. Amah leng milian suan ahi.
english: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had six fingers on every hand and six toes on every foot, twenty-four in number, and he also was born to the giant.

paite: Ama'n Israel mite ava chou a, David unau, Shimei tapa Jonathan in ana that hi.
english: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David’s brother, killed him.

paite: Huai lite Gath a milian suante ahi ua, huchi in David leh amite khut in asita uhi.
english: These four were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

paite: Huan amelma tengteng khut a pan leh Saul khut a pan TOUPA'N ahutkhiak ni in David in hiai la thu TOUPA kiang ah agen hi.
english: David spoke to Yahweh the words of this song in the day that Yahweh delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul,

paite: Ama'n, "TOUPA tuh ka suangpi leh ka kulhpi leh hon humbitpa ahi.
english: and he said: “Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer, even mine;

paite: Ka suangpi Pathian, amah ka muang ding a; ka phaw leh ka hotdamna kii, ka insang leh ka bukna ahi. Ka hondampa, hiamgamna a pan na hon hondam hi.
english: God is my rock in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge. My savior, you save me from violence.

paite: Phat tak TOUPA ka sam ding a; huchi in hon doute lak a pan hotdam in ka om ding hi.
english: I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.

paite: "Sihna tuikihot in hon umkimvel a, Pathian limsak lou mite tui lian in ahon lausak hi.
english: For the waves of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

paite: Sheol khauhualte'n hon gaksuak a; sihna thangte'n hon awksak uh.
english: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death caught me.

paite: Ka lungzin in TOUPA ka sam a, ahi, ka Pathian ka sam hi: A tempul a pan ka aw aza a, ka kikou husa abil ah alut hi.
english: In my distress, I called on Yahweh. Yes, I called to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry came into his ears.

paite: "Huaitak in lei aling a, akisat hi. Aheh ziak in van kingaknate nangawn kisat in alingta uhi.
english: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.

paite: Anak a pan meikhu azamtou a, akam a kipan katmang hat meikuang apawt hat a, huai in meihol akuangsak hi.
english: Smoke went up out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.

paite: Ama'n vante akunsak a, ahong suk ua; akhenuai ah mialna a-om hi.
english: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.

paite: "Cherub tung ah atuang a, alengta hi, huih khate tung ah amah muh in a-om hi.
english: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he was seen on the wings of the wind.

paite: Khomial in aki-umkimvel a, tui vomte, van meipi sah miuhmeuhte abawl hi.
english: He made darkness a shelter around himself, gathering of waters, and thick clouds of the skies.

paite: Ama a vakna tawn in meiholte akuang hi.
english: At the brightness before him, coals of fire were kindled.

paite: "TOUPA van a pan ahong ging a, Tungnungpen in a-aw asuaksak hi.
english: Yahweh thundered from heaven. The Most High uttered his voice.

paite: Thaltangte akapkhia a, amau adalhzaksak a; khua aphesak a, abuaizaksak hi.
english: He sent out arrows and scattered them, lightning and confused them.

paite: TOUPA salhna, anakvangte a hu in tuipi lampite ahong kilang a, lei kingaknate hihlat in a- omta hi.
english: Then the channels of the sea appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare by Yahweh’s rebuke, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

paite: "Ama'n tunglam a pan hon sawksuk a, ahon len a; tuipi a pan hon kaikheta hi.
english: He sent from on high and he took me. He drew me out of many waters.

paite: Kei hon dou hattak a pan hon humbit a, kei hon hote a pan leng; kei a ding in lah ahat lo ngal ua.
english: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me, for they were too mighty for me.

paite: Ka tuahsiat ni in ahon sual ua, himahleh TOUPA ka kingakna ahi.
english: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.

paite: Ama'n mun awngthawltak ah hon pikhia a; ka tung a akipah ziak in hon humbitta hi.
english: He also brought me out into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

paite: "TOUPA'N ka diktatna dungzui in ka tung ah ahih a; ka khutte sianthoudan dungzui in hon thuk hi.
english: Yahweh rewarded me according to my righteousness. He rewarded me according to the cleanness of my hands.

paite: TOUPA lampite ka zui a, ka Pathian a pan giloutak in ka paimang ngei ngal kei a!
english: For I have kept Yahweh’s ways, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

paite: Avaihawmna tengteng ka ma a a-om ziak in: adan thusehte ka kilehheisan ngei kei hi.
english: For all his ordinances were before me. As for his statutes, I didn’t depart from them.

paite: Ama ah leng gensiatbei ka hi lai a, ka thulimlouhna a pan ka kihuikhia hi.
english: I was also perfect toward him. I kept myself from my iniquity.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N ka diktatdan bang zel in hon na thukta a; amitmuh a ka sianthoudan bang zel in.
english: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight.

paite: "Chingtheite kiang ah chingthei in na kilang ding a, mihoihkimte kiang ah hoihkim in na kilang ding hi.
english: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man you will show yourself perfect.

paite: Misiangthoute kiang ah siangthou in na kilang ding a; migenhakte kiang ah genhak in akilang ding.
english: With the pure you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.

paite: Haksa thuak mite na hondam ding a; mikisatheite na niamsak theihna ding in atung uah na mit atu gige hi.
english: You will save the afflicted people, but your eyes are on the arrogant, that you may bring them down.

paite: "TOUPA aw, ka khawnvak na hi ngal a. TOUPA'N ka mialna avaksak ding.
english: For you are my lamp, Yahweh. Yahweh will light up my darkness.

paite: Nang panpih in sepaihhon toh ka tai a, ka Pathian panpih mah in kulh ka tawmkan hi.
english: For by you, I run against a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

paite: "Pathian lampi ahoihkim a; TOUPA thu etchetsa ahi; amah muangte tengteng a ding in amah lum ahi.
english: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tested. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

paite: TOUPA lou kua Pathian a-om a? I Pathian lou kua suangpi a-om a?
english: For who is God, besides Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God?

paite: Pathian ka hatna leh thilhihtheihna ahi a, Ama'n ka lampite hoihkim in abawl hi.
english: God is my strong fortress. He makes my way perfect.

paite: Ka khepekte zukpi khepek bang in abawl a; ka mun sangte ah hon omsak zel hi.
english: He makes his feet like hinds’ feet, and sets me on my high places.

paite: Ka khutte galdou ding in asinsak a; huchi in ka bante'n dal thalpeu atansak hi.
english: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

paite: "Nang na hotdamna lum na hon pia a; na nunnemna in na hon bawl lianta hi.
english: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your gentleness has made me great.

paite: Ka nuai a ka kalsuante na liansak a, huchi in ka khete atolh kei uhi.
english: You have enlarged my steps under me. My feet have not slipped.

paite: Hon doute ka delhpha a, ka hihmang a; hihmanthat sipsip a a-om masiah uh ka nungkik kei hi.
english: I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them. I didn’t turn again until they were consumed.

paite: Athohnawn theihlouhna ding un ka hihmang sipsip a, ka satzan ngiingei a; ahi, ka khenuai ah apukta uh.
english: I have consumed them, and struck them through, so that they can’t arise. Yes, they have fallen under my feet.

paite: Nang galdou ding in hatna in na hon gak a; hon sual mite ka nuai ah na nuaisiahta hi.
english: For you have armed me with strength for the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

paite: Hon hote ka hihmanthat theihna ding in, kei hon doute ngawng na hon pia hi.
english: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

paite: Amaute adak kimvel ua, himahleh hondam ding kuamah a-om kei uh. TOUPA a-en ua, himahleh adawng kei.
english: They looked, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.

paite: Huaitak in ke'n lei a leivui bang in ka khennel dimdem a, kholak buannawi bang mai in ka tuanzak a, ka thehzak vekta hi.
english: Then I beat them as small as the dust of the earth. I crushed them as the mire of the streets, and spread them abroad.

paite: "Nang ka mite kisualna a pan leng na hon humbit a; namte lutang hi ding in na hon kemhoih hi. Ka theih ngei louh nam in ka nna asemta ding.
english: You also have delivered me from the strivings of my people. You have kept me to be the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known will serve me.

paite: Ka kiang ah namdangte ahong kipe ding ua; ka tanchin azaktak un ka thu azui ding uh.
english: The foreigners will submit themselves to me. As soon as they hear of me, they will obey me.

paite: Namdangte atulmang ding ua, a-insang ua kipan ling kawm in ahong paisuk ding uh.
english: The foreigners will fade away, and will come trembling out of their close places.

paite: "TOUPA ahing hi. Ka suangpi phat in om henla; ka hotdamna suangpi Pathian tawisang in om hen:
english: Yahweh lives! Blessed be my rock! Exalted be God, the rock of my salvation,

paite: Phu hon laksakpa leh ka nuai a mite koihpa Pathian;
english: even the God who executes vengeance for me, who brings down peoples under me,

paite: Hon doute a pan hon domtoupa: Kei hon doute tunglam ah na hon domkang a, hiamgammi lak a pan na hon humbit hi.
english: who brings me away from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

paite: "Huaiziak in aw TOUPA, namte lak ah kipahthu ka hon hilh ding a, na min phat in la ka sa ding hi.
english: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

paite: Akumpipa a dia amah hotdamna insang ahi a, athaunilh, David leh asuante tung ah tangtawn in hehpihna alangsak,” achi hi.
english: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.”

paite: Hiaite David thu nanungpen ahi. Jesse tapa David, sangtak a dopsang a ompa, Jakob' Pathian thaunilhpa, Israelte la phuaktu in achi hi.
english: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse says, the man who was raised on high says, the anointed of the God of Jacob, the sweet psalmist of Israel:

paite: TOUPA Kha in kei hon zang in agen a, athu ka lei ah a-om hi.
english: “Yahweh’s Spirit spoke by me. His word was on my tongue.

paite: Israelte' Pathian in agen a, Israelte' Suangpi'n ka kiang ah agen hi. Mi tung a vaihawmmi adik ngeingei dia Pathian lau kawm a vai ahawm ding ahi.
english: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spoke to me, ‘One who rules over men righteously, who rules in the fear of God,

paite: Amah ni ahong suah a, meipi om het lou zingsang vak bang ahi dia, vuahzuk khit a khua hong siang a lei a loupa selnou mitmet bang ahi ding ahi.
english: shall be as the light of the morning when the sun rises, a morning without clouds, when the tender grass springs out of the earth, through clear shining after rain.’

paite: Pathian a ding in ka inkuan hiai bang hi kei mahleh, kei toh tangtawn thukhun abawl a, bangkim kizentak in ahihkip hi. Ama'n khangsak kei mahleh hiai ka hotdamna leh ka deihlam tengteng ahi.
english: Isn’t my house so with God? Yet he has made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure, for it is all my salvation and all my desire. Won’t he make it grow?

paite: Himahleh Belial tate bel avek un ling paihkhiak bang ahi ding uh, khut a lak theih louh ahih ziak un.
english: But all the ungodly will be as thorns to be thrust away, because they can’t be taken with the hand.

paite: Himahleh amau khoih ding mi sik leh teipi a, akivat ding ahi. Huchi in amun mah ah hal ahi ding uh.
english: The man who touches them must be armed with iron and the staff of a spear. They will be utterly burned with fire in their place.”

paite: Hiaite David sepaih hangsante min ahi. Tekmon mi Joseph Bashebeth sepaih heutute lak a heutupa ahi a; amah khatvei thu a mi zagiat thatpa Eznit mi Adino achih mah uh ahi.
english: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb Basshebeth, a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; he was called Adino the Eznite, who killed eight hundred at one time.

paite: Ama zom in Ahoh tapa Dodo tapa Eleazar ahi. Amah Philistia mite kidou dia akikaihkhop ua, achou ua, Israel mite a paimang vek lai ua David kiang a sepaih hangsan thumte lak a khat ahi.
english: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodai the son of an Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David when they defied the Philistines who were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel had gone away.

paite: Amah athou a, Philistia mite akhut a kham matan namsau leng khah lou khop in athat hi. Huai ni in TOUPA'N nakpitak in azouta a, mite ama nung ah gallak thil la ding lel in ahong kik nawn uhi.
english: He arose and struck the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand froze to the sword; and Yahweh worked a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to take plunder.

paite: Amah nung in Harar mi Agee tapa Shammah ahi. Behiang tampi omna lou a Philistia mite akikaihkhop lai un, Israel mite ataikek uhi.
english: After him was Shammah the son of Agee, a Hararite. The Philistines had gathered together into a troop where there was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.

paite: Himahleh amah huai mun ah adingh a, aveng a, Philistia mite athat a, TOUPA'N nakpitak in azohsak hi.
english: But he stood in the middle of the plot and defended it, and killed the Philistines; and Yahweh worked a great victory.

paite: Sepaih hangsan sawmthum lak a thumte ahohsuk ua, buhlak laitak in David kiang ah Adullam kohawm ah ahoh ua; Philistia sepaihte'n Rephaim Phaizang ah panmun akhoh uh.
english: Three of the thirty chief men went down, and came to David in the harvest time to the cave of Adullam; and the troop of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

paite: Huchih lai in David insung ah a-om a, huchih lai mah in Bethlehem ah Philistia sepaihte a-om uhi.
english: David was then in the stronghold; and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.

paite: David in tui alunggulh mahmah a, "Bethlehem a tuileh tui, kulh kongkhak kiang a dawn ding hong pia om le uh aw!" achi hi.
english: David said longingly, “Oh that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”

paite: Huchi in sepaih hangsan thumte'n Philistia sepaihte apaltan ua, kulh kongkhak kiang a Bethlehem tuileh ava tawi ua, David kiang ah apaipih uh. Himahleh ama'n ana dawn ngam kei a, TOUPA a ding in abungkhe zawta hi.
