english: The three mighty men broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate and took it and brought it to David; but he would not drink of it, but poured it out to Yahweh.

paite: "Aw TOUPA, hiai ka hih louh ding dan; sih ngap a kuante sisan ka dawn dia hia?" achi hi. Huchi in adawn nuam kei hi. Huai thilte sepaih hangsan thumte'n ahih uh ahi.
english: He said, “Be it far from me, Yahweh, that I should do this! Isn’t this the blood of the men who risked their lives to go?” Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.

paite: Zeruiah tapa Joab unau Abishai thumte lak a aheutupen uh ahi. Teipi in mi zathum sual in athat a, thumte lak ah minhoih aloh hi.
english: Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the three. He lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.

paite: Thumte lak ah pahtawi tuak pen ahi kei maw? Huaiziak in aheutu ding un abawl uhi. Himahleh tungnungpen thumte lak atung zou kei hi.
english: Wasn’t he most honorable of the three? Therefore he was made their captain. However he wasn’t included as one of the three.

paite: Kabzeel mihangsan tapa Jehoiada tapa Benaiah thil thupitak hihpa in Moab mi Ariel tapate nih athat a; huchi in ahohsuk a, vuk kiak hun lai in leikohawm ah humpinelkai leng ava that hi.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit in a time of snow.

paite: Aigupta mi, miliantak athat a; huai Aigupta mi in teipi atawi hi. Himahleh ama'n chiangkhun tawi in ava zuan a, Aigupta mi teipi tawi ava sut a, ama teipi in asunlumta hi.
english: He killed a huge Egyptian, and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.

paite: Jehoiada tapa Benaiah in huchibang thil ahih ziak in sepaih hangsan thumte lak ah minhoih aloh hi.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things, and had a name among the three mighty men.

paite: Mi sawmthumte sang in pahtawi tuak ahi. Himahleh tungnungpen thumte lak a simtel ahi zou kei hi. David in amah vengtu heutu in akoih hi.
english: He was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three. David set him over his guard.

paite: Sawmthumte lak a khat Joab unau Asahel ahi: Bethlehem a mi Dodo tapa Elhanan;
english: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty: Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

paite: Harod mi Shammah, Harod mi Elika;
english: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

paite: Pal mi Helez, Tekoa mi Ikkesh tapa Ira;
english: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

paite: Anethot mi Abiezer, Hushath mi Mebunnai;
english: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

paite: Ahoh mi Zalmon, Netophah mi Maharai
english: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

paite: Netophah mi Baanah tapa Heleb, Benjamin suan, Gebeah a mi Ribai tapa Ittai;
english: Heleb the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

paite: Pirathon mi Benaiah, Gaash luite a mi Hidai; 31 Arbath mi Abi-albon, Barhum mi Azmaveth;
english: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash.

paite: Arbath mi Abi-albon, Barhum mi Azmaveth;
english: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

paite: Shaalbon mi Eliaba, Jashen tapate lak a Jonathan;
english: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

paite: Harar mi Shammah, Arar mi Sharar tapa Ahiam;
english: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Ararite,

paite: Mankat mi Ahasbai tapa Eliphelet, Gilon mi Ahithophel tapa Eliam;
english: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maacathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

paite: Karmel mi, Hezrai, Arba mi Paarai;
english: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,

paite: Zobah mi Nathan tapa Igal, Gad mi Bani;
english: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

paite: Ammon mi Jelek, Beeroth mi Nahari, Zeruiah tapa Joab galvan tawi;
english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armor bearers to Joab the son of Zeruiah,

paite: Ith mi Ira, Ith mi Gareb;
english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

paite: Hit mi Uriah ahi uh. Avek un sawmthum-le-sagih ahi uh.
english: and Uriah the Hittite: thirty-seven in all.

paite: Huan TOUPA hehna Israelte tung ah ahong tung nawn hi. Amaute kalh a David tokthou in, "Kuan inla, Israel mite leh Judah mite sim vek in," achi hi.
english: Again Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he moved David against them, saying, “Go, count Israel and Judah.”

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang a om sepaih heutu Joab kiang ah, "Israel nam tengteng lak ah Dan a pan Beer-sheba pha in vialvak inla, mi bangzah ahi ua ka theihtheihna ding in sim vek in," achi hi.
english: The king said to Joab the captain of the army, who was with him, “Now go back and forth through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba, and count the people, that I may know the sum of the people.”

paite: Joab in kumpipa kiang ah, "TOUPA na Pathian in mite pungsak in bangzah a tam, amun za leng, toupa ka pu in muta ve, himahleh toupa ka kumpipa'n bangziak a huai thei ut se ahia?" achi hi.
english: Joab said to the king, “Now may Yahweh your God add to the people, however many they may be, one hundred times; and may the eyes of my lord the king see it. But why does my lord the king delight in this thing?”

paite: Himahleh kumpipa thu in Joab leh sepaih heutute thu azouta hi. Huchi in Joab leh sepaih heutute Israel mite sim ding in kumpipa kiang a pan apaikheta uhi.
english: Notwithstanding, the king’s word prevailed against Joab and against the captains of the army. Joab and the captains of the army went out from the presence of the king to count the people of Israel.

paite: Jordan gal ava kah ua, Gad Phaizang laitak taklam a khopi om Aroer ah Jazer pha in om mun akhoh uhi.
english: They passed over the Jordan and encamped in Aroer, on the right side of the city that is in the middle of the valley of Gad, and to Jazer;

paite: Gilead gam leh Tahtim-hodshi gam atung ua; Dan-jaan leh Zidon kimvel atung uhi.
english: then they came to Gilead and to the land of Tahtim Hodshi; and they came to Dan Jaan and around to Sidon,

paite: Tura kulh leh Hiv mite kho tengteng leh Kanaan mite kho tengteng ava tung ua; Beer-sheba a, Judah simlam ah apaikhia uhi.
english: and came to the stronghold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites and of the Canaanites; and they went out to the south of Judah, at Beersheba.

paite: Huchi in gam tengteng atotsuah khit uh, kha kua leh ni sawmnih abei in Jerusalem ahong tungkik uhi.
english: So when they had gone back and forth through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

paite: Joab in mihing phazah kumpipa apia a; Israel gam ah namsau tawi mihangsan nuaigiat a-om uhi. Judah mi bel nuainga a-om hi.
english: Joab gave up the sum of the counting of the people to the king; and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men who drew the sword, and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.

paite: Mihing asim khit un David lungtang anuam het kei. David in TOUPA kiang ah, "Ka thilhih ah nakpitak in ka na khialta hi. Himahleh tu in aw TOUPA, na sikha thulimlouhna koihmang ding in ka hon ngen hi. Haihuai mahmah in ka na hihta," achi hi.
english: David’s heart struck him after he had counted the people. David said to Yahweh, “I have sinned greatly in that which I have done. But now, Yahweh, put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant; for I have done very foolishly.”

paite: Zingsang a David athohleh David zawlnei Gad kiang ah TOUPA thu ana tung hi.
english: When David rose up in the morning, Yahweh’s word came to the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying,

paite: "Kuan inla, David kiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Thil thum ka hon tah a, na tung a ka hih ding in khat tel in, achi,' " chi in.
english: “Go and speak to David, ‘Yahweh says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”

paite: Huchi in David kiang ah Gad ahoh a, ahilh a, akiang ah, "Na gam a na tung a kum sagih sung kial akiak hia? Na melmate'n hon delh ua kha thum sung amau a pan na taimang hia? Na gam a ni thum sung hipi ahong len? Hon sawlpa bangchi in ka dawng dia? Kingaihtuah inla, hon hilh in," achi hi.
english: So Gad came to David, and told him, saying, “Shall seven years of famine come to you in your land? Or will you flee three months before your foes while they pursue you? Or shall there be three days’ pestilence in your land? Now answer, and consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.”

paite: David in Gad kiang ah, "Ka lung azing mahmah mai hi. TOUPA khut sung ah hon puklutsak in; azahngaihna lah athupi mahmah ngal a. Mihing khut sung ah zaw hon puklutsak ke'n," achi hi.
english: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let us fall now into Yahweh’s hand, for his mercies are great. Let me not fall into man’s hand.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Israel mite tung ah zingsang a pan hun seh tan hipi alengsak hi. Huchi in Dan a pan Beer-sheba tan mi singsagih asi uh.
english: So Yahweh sent a pestilence on Israel from the morning even to the appointed time; and seventy thousand men died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba.

paite: Angel in hihse dia Jerusalem lam a, akhut alikleh TOUPA'N thil hoih lou hih atup alunghei thak a, mite hihmangpa angel kiang ah, "Ahunta; na khut lik nawn ke'n," achi hi. TOUPA angel bel Jebus mi Araunah phual chin ah a-om hi.
english: When the angel stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, Yahweh relented of the disaster, and said to the angel who destroyed the people, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” Yahweh’s angel was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

paite: David in mi that angel amuh in TOUPA ahoupih a, "Ngai in, ka na khialta, dikloutak in thil ka na hihta hi. Himahleh hiai belamte'n bang ahih ua? Na khut in kei leh ka pa inkote hon khoih zaw hen," achi hi.
english: David spoke to Yahweh when he saw the angel who struck the people, and said, “Behold, I have sinned, and I have done perversely; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand be against me, and against my father’s house.”

paite: Huai ni in David kiang ah Gad ahoh a, akiang ah, "Kuantou inla, Jebus mi Araunah phual ah TOUPA a ding in maitam va doh in," achi hi.
english: Gad came that day to David and said to him, “Go up, build an altar to Yahweh on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.”

paite: Huchi in David, TOUPA thupiak bang a Gad in ahilh bang in akuantouta hi.
english: David went up according to the saying of Gad, as Yahweh commanded.

paite: Araunah in amalam a-etleh, amah lam zuan a kumpipa leh asikhate hong pai amu hi. Huchi in Araunah apawt a, amai a lei si in kumpipa ma ah abokkhup hi.
english: Araunah looked out, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him. Then Araunah went out and bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

paite: Araunah in, "Bang achia ahia toupa ka kumpipa, asikha kiang a ahong?" achi hi. David in, "Mipite lak a hipi akhawltheihna dia TOUPA a dia maitam doh ding a na phual lei ding in ahi ka hong pai," achi hi.
english: Araunah said, “Why has my lord the king come to his servant?” David said, “To buy your threshing floor, to build an altar to Yahweh, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”

paite: Araunah in David kiang ah, "Toupa ka kumpipa'n hoih asak bang in la henla, lan hen: En in, halmang a lat ding in bawngtalte a-om ua, sing ding in phual vanzatte leh bawng vante a-om uhi.
english: Araunah said to David, “Let my lord the king take and offer up what seems good to him. Behold, the cattle for the burnt offering, and the threshing sledges and the yokes of the oxen for the wood.

paite: Aw toupa, hiai tengteng Araunah in kumpipa ape vek hi," achi hi. Araunah in kumpipa kiang ah, "TOUPA na Pathian in hon dawng hen," achi hi.
english: All this, O king, does Araunah give to the king.” Araunah said to the king, “May Yahweh your God accept you.”

paite: Kumpipa'n Araunah kiang ah, "Hilou e, aman pia in ka hon lei teitei ding ahi. Kei lam a bangmah senna om lou in TOUPA ka Pathian kiang ah halmang thillatte ka lan kei ding," achi hi. Huchi in David in phual leh bawngtalte dangka shekel sawmnga in aleita hi.
english: The king said to Araunah, “No, but I will most certainly buy it from you for a price. I will not offer burnt offerings to Yahweh my God which cost me nothing.” So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

paite: David in huai ah TOUPA a ding in maitam adoh a, halmang thillatte leh lemna thillatte alan hi. Huchi in TOUPA agam tung ah alungkimta a, Israel gam a pan hipi akhawlta hi.
english: David built an altar to Yahweh there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So Yahweh was entreated for the land, and the plague was removed from Israel.

paite: Saul inkuante leh David inkuante sawtpi akidou ua; David in hatlam amanoh a, Saul inkuante'n hat louh lam amanoh uhi.
english: Now there was a long war between Saul’s house and David’s house. David grew stronger and stronger, but Saul’s house grew weaker and weaker.

paite: David in Hebron ah tapate anei a, ata masapen, Amnon, Jezreel mi Ahinoam lak a ahi.
english: Sons were born to David in Hebron. His firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;

paite: Azom Kileab, Karmel mi Nabal zi Abigail lak a ahi. Athumna Absalom, Geshur kumpipa Talmai tanu Maakah tapa ahi.
english: and his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

paite: Alina Adonijah, Haggith tapa ahi a; angana Shephatiah, Abital tapa.
english: and the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

paite: Agukna Ithream, David zi Eglah lak a ahi. Hiai teng David tapa Hebron a piangte ahi uh.
english: and the sixth, Ithream, of Eglah, David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Saul inkuante leh David inkuante akidou sung un Saul inkuante a ding in Abner akihatsak semsem hi.
english: While there was war between Saul’s house and David’s house, Abner made himself strong in Saul’s house.

paite: Saul in mei anei a, amin Rizpah ahi. Amah Aiah tanu ahi. Ishboshet in Abner kiang ah, "Bangziak a ka pa mei kithuahpih na hia?" achi hi.
english: Now Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah; and Ishbosheth said to Abner, “Why have you gone in to my father’s concubine?”

paite: Ishboshet thugen in Abner ahehsak mahmah hi. Judahte ui lutang leltak ka hi a hia? Tuni tan in na pa Saul inkuante leh a-unaute leh alawmte tung ah zahngaihna ka hihlang a, David khut ah ka hon pe kei hi. Hinapi a nang hiai numei tung a khial a na hon ngoh mawk!
english: Then Abner was very angry about Ishbosheth’s words, and said, “Am I a dog’s head that belongs to Judah? Today I show kindness to your father Saul’s house, to his brothers, and to his friends, and have not delivered you into the hand of David; and yet you charge me today with a fault concerning this woman!

paite: Pathian in Abner alohloh in loh henla, huai sang a sezaw in leng. David kiang a TOUPA akichiam bang a, huchibang ngei atung a ka hih keileh.
english: God do so to Abner, and more also, if, as Yahweh has sworn to David, I don’t do even so to him:

paite: Saul inkuante lak a pan agam laksak ding, Israel leh Judahte tung a Dan a pan a Beer-sheba tan a David laltutphah tunding ding.
english: to transfer the kingdom from Saul’s house, and to set up David’s throne over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.”

paite: Huchi in ama'n Abner alau mahmah ziak in dawn himhim leng adawng thei kei hi.
english: He could not answer Abner another word, because he was afraid of him.

paite: Abner in amah sik in David kiang ah mi asawl a, "Hiai gam kua a ahia? Ka kiang ah thu khung in. Huchi in ngai in, Israel mi tengteng na lam a pang ding in ka khut nang lam ah apang ding," chi in ava gensak hi.
english: Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, “Whose is the land?” and saying, “Make your alliance with me, and behold, my hand will be with you to bring all Israel around to you.”

paite: Ama'n, "Hi hen. Na kiang ah thu ka khung ding. Himahleh na tung ah thil khat ka hon phut hi. Huai tuh hiai ahi. Hong mu ding a na hong pai chiang in Saul tanu Mikal na hon pi phot keileh ka mel na mu thei kei ding," achi hi.
english: David said, “Good. I will make a treaty with you, but one thing I require of you. That is, you will not see my face unless you first bring Michal, Saul’s daughter, when you come to see my face.”

paite: David in Saul tapa Ishboshet kiang ah, "Philistia mite zekvun zakhat a ka leisa, ka zi Mikal hon pia in," chi ding in mi asawl hi.
english: David sent messengers to Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, saying, “Deliver me my wife Michal, whom I was given to marry for one hundred foreskins of the Philistines.”

paite: Ishboshet in mi asawl a, apasal Laish tapa Paltiel mahmah a pan apita hi.
english: Ishbosheth sent and took her from her husband, Paltiel the son of Laish.

paite: Apasal in kap kawm in Bahurim tan anung azui zel hi. Abner in akiang ah, "Pai in, kik nawn in," achi hi. Huchi in akik nawnta hi.
english: Her husband went with her, weeping as he went, and followed her to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, “Go! Return!” and he returned.

paite: Abner in Israel upate ahoupih a, "Tuma siah David na kumpipa ding un na zong uh.
english: Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, “In times past, you sought for David to be king over you.

paite: Tu in na kumpipa un bawl un. TOUPA'N David tungtang thu ah, ka sikha David khut in ka mi Israelte Philistia mite khut a pan leh amelma teng khut a pan ka hunkhe ding ana chi," achi hi.
english: Now then do it! For Yahweh has spoken of David, saying, ‘By the hand of my servant David, I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.’”

paite: Abner in Benjamin mite bil a zak in agen hi. Israel mite leh Benjamin inkuan tengteng in hoih asak bangbang un Hebron a David bil a zak dia gen ding in Abner ahoh hi.
english: Abner also spoke in the ears of Benjamin; and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel and to the whole house of Benjamin.

paite: Abner leh amite sawmnih Hebron a David kiang ah apai uhi. David in Abner leh akiang a mi sawmnihte a ding in ankuang alui hi.
english: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. David made Abner and the men who were with him a feast.

paite: Abner in David kiang ah, "Ka thou ding a, na kiang a thu akhuntheihna ding un leh na deihthusam bangtak a vai na hawmtheihna ding in Israel mi tengteng ka toupa kiang a kaikhawm ding in ka kuan ding,” achi hi. David in Abner asawlkhia a, lungmuangtak in akuanta hi.
english: Abner said to David, “I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel to my lord the king, that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may reign over all that your soul desires.” David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.

paite: Ngai in, David mite leh Joab galdou zou ahong tung ua, gallak tampi ahon pua uh. Himahleh Abner bel Hebron a David kiang ah ana om nawn kei hi. Ana paikiksak khinta a, amah leng lungmuangtak in ana paita hi.
english: Behold, David’s servants and Joab came from a raid and brought in a great plunder with them; but Abner was not with David in Hebron, for he had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.

paite: Joab leh akiang a mipi tengteng ahong tun un, Ner tapa Abner kumpipa kiang ah ahoh hi. Ama'n ana paisak nawn khin a, "Lungmuangtak in apai nawnta," chi in Joab ahilh uhi.
english: When Joab and all the army who was with him had come, they told Joab, “Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he has sent him away, and he has gone in peace.”

paite: Kumpipa kiang ah Joab ahoh a, "Na thilhih bangchidan ahia oi? Ngai in, Abner na kiang ah ahong a, bangziak a paimangsak a, apaimang vengveng mawk?
english: Then Joab came to the king and said, “What have you done? Behold, Abner came to you. Why is it that you have sent him away, and he is already gone?

paite: Ner tapa Abner na thei a, nang hong khem ding a na pawt lam leh na lut lam leh na thilhih peuhmah theih tum a hong pai ahi," achi hi.
english: You know Abner the son of Ner. He came to deceive you, and to know your going out and your coming in, and to know all that you do.”

paite: David kiang a pan Joab ahong pawtkhiak in Abner delh ding in mi asawl hi. Sirah a tuileh a pan ava pikik uh. Himahleh David in athei kei hi.
english: When Joab had come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the well of Sirah; but David didn’t know it.

paite: Hebron a Abner ahong tun in Joab in sim houpih ding in kulh kongpi ah apituam hi. A-unaupa Asahel sisan pawt thukna ding in anakguh ngana nuaitak ah adawt a, huchi in asita hi.
english: When Abner had returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into the middle of the gate to speak with him quietly, and struck him there in the body, so that he died for the blood of Asahel his brother.

paite: Anung a David in azak in, "Ner tapa Abner sisan thu ah kei mahleh ka gam TOUPA mitmuh in tangtawn in ka siang uh.
english: Afterward, when David heard it, he said, “I and my kingdom are guiltless before Yahweh forever of the blood of Abner the son of Ner.

paite: Joab lutung ah kia henla; apa inkote tengteng tung ah toh. Joab inkote lak ah meima sia vei hiam, phak natna nei hiam, chiangkhun ngai a pai hiam, namsau a si hiam, kial thuak hiam kitatlak lou in hong om hen," achi hi.
english: Let it fall on the head of Joab and on all his father’s house. Let there not fail from the house of Joab one who has a discharge, or who is a leper, or who leans on a staff, or who falls by the sword, or who lacks bread.”

paite: Huchi in a-unaupa uh Asahel Gibeon a kidouna a athah ziak in Joab leh a-unau Abishai in Abner athat uhi.
english: So Joab and Abishai his brother killed Abner, because he had killed their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.

paite: David in Joab leh akiang a mi om tengteng kiang ah, "Na puante uh botkek unla, sai-ip puan silh unla, Abner suun in ama ah pai un," achi hi. David in leng siluang azui hi.
english: David said to Joab and to all the people who were with him, “Tear your clothes, and clothe yourselves with sackcloth, and mourn in front of Abner.” King David followed the bier.

paite: Hebron ah Abner avui ua, kumpipa'n a-aw suakkhesak in Abner han ah akap a, mipi tengteng leng akap uhi.
english: They buried Abner in Hebron; and the king lifted up his voice and wept at Abner’s grave; and all the people wept.

paite: Kumpipa'n Abner akah a: "Abner, mihai sih in asi dia hia?
english: The king lamented for Abner, and said, “Should Abner die as a fool dies?

paite: Na khut hen ahi kei a, na khete leng sikkol butsak ahi sam kei. Migiloute ma a mi apuk bang a na puk maizen? achi hi." Mi tengteng in akah nawn uhi.
english: Your hands weren’t bound, and your feet weren’t put into fetters. As a man falls before the children of iniquity, so you fell.” All the people wept again over him.

paite: Huchi in sun ahih lai in mi tengteng David an nesak ding in ahong pai uh. Himahleh David in, "Nitum ma a an nek hiam, thil dang hiam leng ka nekleh Pathian in alohloh hon loh hen; huai sang a sezaw in leng," chi in akichiam hi.
english: All the people came to urge David to eat bread while it was yet day; but David swore, saying, “God do so to me, and more also, if I taste bread or anything else, until the sun goes down.”

paite: Mi tengteng in huai atheih un akipak mahmah uh. Kumpipa thilhih peuhmah in mite akipaksak hi.
english: All the people took notice of it, and it pleased them, as whatever the king did pleased all the people.

paite: Mi tengteng leh Israel mi tengteng in huai ni in Ner tapa Abner thah ahih kumpipa thu ahi kei chih athei uhi.
english: So all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to kill Abner the son of Ner.

paite: Kumpipa'n mite kiang ah, "Tuni in Israel milian, mithupitak asi, chih thei lou na hi uh maw?
english: The king said to his servants, “Don’t you know that a prince and a great man has fallen today in Israel?

paite: Kumpipa dia thaunilh himah leng, tuni in ka hat kei hi. Hiai Zeruiah tapate kei a ding in athuakhak lua uh. TOUPA'N thil hoih lou hihmi agitlouh dungzui zel in thuk hen," achi hi.
english: I am weak today, though anointed king. These men, the sons of Zeruiah are too hard for me. May Yahweh reward the evildoer according to his wickedness.”

paite: Huan Saul tapa Ishboshet in Hebron ah Abner asi chih ana zak in akhutte ahong hat kei ua, Israel mi tengteng apatau uhi.
english: When Saul’s son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands became feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.

paite: Saul tapa Ishboshet in sepaih pawl heutu nih anei hi. Khat min Baanah ahi a, adang min Rekab ahi. Amau Benjamin suan Beeroth mi Rimmon tapate ahi uh. Beeroth bel Benjamin nam a simtel a ngaih ahi.
english: Saul’s son had two men who were captains of raiding bands. The name of one was Baanah and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin (for Beeroth also is considered a part of Benjamin;

paite: Beeroth a mite Gittaim ah atai ua, tuni tan in huai ah ateng uhi.
english: and the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and have lived as foreigners there until today).

paite: Saul tapa Jonathan in tapa khebai anei hi. Jezreel a pan Saul leh Jonathan tanchin ana theih in kum nga a upa ahi. Amah donnu in apom a, ataimangpih hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, taimang dia akintatna lam in akesak a, akhe hong baita hi. Ama min Mephibosheth ahi.
english: Now Jonathan, Saul’s son, had a son who was lame in his feet. He was five years old when the news came about Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel; and his nurse picked him up and fled. As she hurried to flee, he fell and became lame. His name was Mephibosheth.

paite: Beeroth mi Rimmon tapate Rekab leh Baanah apai ua, Ishboshet inn ah sun nisat laitak a lupna a alup lai in akiang ah ahoh uhi.
english: The sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went out and came at about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth as he took his rest at noon.

paite: Huit buh la ding hileh kilawm in insung lam ah alut ua, anakguh ngana nuaitak ah adawt ua, huchi in Rekab leh a-unaupa Baanah ataimang uhi.
english: They came there into the middle of the house as though they would have fetched wheat, and they struck him in the body; and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.

paite: Inn ava lut un alupna dantan a lupna a lum lai ava dawt ua, athat ua, alu atan ua, alu ala uh. Arabah kantan in zankhua in apaimang uhi.
english: Now when they came into the house as he lay on his bed in his bedroom, they struck him, killed him, beheaded him, and took his head, and went by the way of the Arabah all night.

paite: Ishboshet lu Hebron ah David kiang ah ahon pua ua, kumpipa kiang ah, "Ngai in, nang hon thah tum, na melma Saul tapa Ishboshet lu hiai ah a-om; TOUPA'N ka toupa phu Saul leh asuante tung ah tuni in alaksakta," achi uhi.
english: They brought the head of Ishbosheth to David to Hebron, and said to the king, “Behold, the head of Ishbosheth, the son of Saul, your enemy, who sought your life! Yahweh has avenged my lord the king today of Saul and of his offspring.”

paite: David in Beeroth mi Rimmon tapa Rekab leh a-unaupa Baanah adawng a, akiang uah, "TOUPA ka mangbatna tengteng a hon tanpa ahin bang in ka gen ahi.
english: David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said to them, “As Yahweh lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

paite: Tanchinhoih hon tun akisep in, 'Ngai in, Saul asita, chi a mi khat in ahon hilh lai in, amah ka man a, Ziklag ah ka that hi'. Huai atanchinhoih hon puakman a ka na piak ahi.
english: when someone told me, ‘Behold, Saul is dead,’ thinking that he brought good news, I seized him and killed him in Ziklag, which was the reward I gave him for his news.

paite: Midiktat, ama insung a ama lupna tung ngei a lum, migilou in athah uh sisan man na tung uah ka hon phut nawn sem dia, leitung a pan alamang kei dia hia?" achi hi.
english: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house on his bed, should I not now require his blood from your hand, and rid the earth of you?”

paite: Huchi in David in atangvalte thu apia a, amaute athat uh. Akhutte uleh akhete uh atansak ua, Hebron a dil tung ah akhai uhi. Ishboshet lu bel ala ua, Hebron a Abner han ah avui uhi.
english: David commanded his young men, and they killed them, cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up beside the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth and buried it in Abner’s grave in Hebron.

paite: Huchi in Israel chi tengteng Hebron a David kiang ah ahong pai ua, "Ngai in, na guh leh na sa ka hi uh.
english: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and spoke, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

paite: Hun paisa in leng Saul ka tung ua kumpipa ahih lai a leng Israelte pikhia leh pilutpa na hi. TOUPA'N na kiang ah, ka mi Israelte na vak dia, Israelte tung ah heutu in na om ding, achi," achi uhi.
english: In times past, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led Israel out and in. Yahweh said to you, ‘You will be shepherd of my people Israel, and you will be prince over Israel.’”

paite: Israel upa tengteng Hebron ah kumpipa kiang ah ahoh uh. Kumpipa David in Hebron ah TOUPA ma ah amau toh thu akhung hi. Huchi in Israelte tung a kumpipa ding in David thau anilh uhi.
english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron, and King David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Yahweh; and they anointed David king over Israel.

paite: Vai ahawm pat tung in David kum sawmthum a upa ahi a, kum sawmli sung vai ahawm hi.
english: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.

paite: Hebron ah Judahte tung ah kum sagih leh kha guk vai ahawm a; Jerusalem ah Israelte leh Judah tengteng tung ah kum sawmthum-le-thum vai ahawm hi.
english: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.

paite: Kumpipa leh amite huai gam a teng Jebus mite sim ding in Jerusalem ah ahoh uhi. Huai mite'n David ahong lut theih louh gingta in, David kiang ah, "Hiai ah na hong lut het kei ding. Mittaw leh khebaite'n hon na dal ding uh," achi uhi.
english: The king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, who spoke to David, saying, “The blind and the lame will keep you out of here,” thinking, “David can’t come in here.”

paite: Himahleh David in Zion kulhpi alazou a, huai tuh David khopi ahi.
english: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. This is David’s city.

paite: David in huai ni in, "Jebus mi sual peuhmahte tuiluanna ah paitou uhenla, David mudah khebai leh mittawte that uheh," achi hi. Huaiziak in ahi, "Mittaw leh khebaite inn ah ahong lut kei ding uh," achih uh.
english: David said on that day, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites, let him go up to the watercourse and strike those lame and blind, who are hated by David’s soul.” Therefore they say, “The blind and the lame can’t come into the house.”

paite: Huchi in David kulh ah ateng a, David khua achi uhi. David in Millo a pan akimvel leh asunglam ah kulh abawl hi,
english: David lived in the stronghold, and called it David’s city. David built around from Millo and inward.

paite: David in TOUPA, Sepaihte' Pathian akiang a a-om ziak in thupi lam amanoh zel hi.
english: David grew greater and greater, for Yahweh, the God of Armies, was with him.

paite: Tura kumpipa Hiram in David kiang ah mi asawl a, sidar singte akhak a, khutsiamte leh suangseksiamte asawl a, David a ding in inn alamsak uhi.
english: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, with cedar trees, carpenters, and masons; and they built David a house.

paite: David in TOUPA'N amah Israel mite tung a kumpipa ding in akipsak a, ami Israelte ziak in alalgam atawisang chih athei hi.
english: David perceived that Yahweh had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel’s sake.

paite: David in Hebron apawtsan nung in Jerusalem a pan mei leh zi aneih behlap hi. Huchi in David in tapate leh tanute anei nawn lai hi.
english: David took more concubines and wives for himself out of Jerusalem, after he had come from Hebron; and more sons and daughters were born to David.

paite: Jerusalem a aneihte min hiaite ahi: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan leh Solomon,
english: These are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

paite: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg leh Japhia,
english: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,

paite: Elishama, Eliada leh Eliphalet.
english: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.

paite: Himahleh Israel mite kumpipa ding in David thau anilh uh chih Philistia mite'n azak un Philistia mi tengteng David zong ding in ahohtou uh. David in ana za a, kulh sung ah apaisuk hi.
english: When the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David, but David heard about it and went down to the stronghold.

paite: Philistia mite Rephaim Phaizang ah akiphalh uhi.
english: Now the Philistines had come and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

paite: David in, "Philistia mite sual ding in ka hohtou diam? Amaute ka khut ah na hon pe diam?" chi in TOUPA adong hi. TOUPA'N David kiang ah, "Hohtou in. Philistia mite na khut ah ka hon pe ngeingei ding," achi hi.
english: David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” Yahweh said to David, “Go up; for I will certainly deliver the Philistines into your hand.”

paite: Huchi in David Baal-perazim ah ahoh a, huai ah David in amaute asual a, "TOUPA'N ka melmate tuichin khah bang mai in ka ma ah ahon hihdalhsakta," achi hi. Huaiziak in huai mun min, "Baal-perazim," asa hi.
english: David came to Baal Perazim, and David struck them there. Then he said, “Yahweh has broken my enemies before me, like the breach of waters.” Therefore he called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

paite: Huai ah amilimte uh anusia ua, David leh amite'n ahal uhi.
english: They left their images there, and David and his men took them away.

paite: Philistia mite apaitou nawn ua, Rephaim Phaizang ah akiphalh uhi.
english: The Philistines came up yet again and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

paite: David in TOUPA adotleh Ama'n, "Hohtou ke'n. Anunglam uah khelh inla, singtheimi kung zawn ah sual in.
english: When David inquired of Yahweh, he said, “You shall not go up. Circle around behind them, and attack them in front of the mulberry trees.

paite: Hichi ahi ding, singtheimi lek a pai husa na zakleh gamtang in. Philistia sepaihte sual ding in na ma ah TOUPA akuankheta chihna ahi," achi hi.
english: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then stir yourself up; for then Yahweh has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in David in ahih a; Philistia mite Geba a pan Gazer tan in asual hi.
english: David did so, as Yahweh commanded him, and struck the Philistines all the way from Geba to Gezer.

paite: David in Israel mite lak a mi teltuam singthum akaikhawm nawn hi.
english: David again gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.

paite: Huchi in David athou a, Judah gam a Baale a pan cherubte tung a tuang sepaihte' TOUPA min aputsak uh Pathian bawm latou ding in akiang a mi om tengteng toh akuan uhi.
english: David arose and went with all the people who were with him from Baale Judah, to bring up from there God’s ark, which is called by the Name, even the name of Yahweh of Armies who sits above the cherubim.

paite: Pathian bawm kangtalai thak ah akoih ua, mual tung a om Abinadab inn a pan alakhia uh. Abinadab tapa Uzzah leh Ahio in kangtalai thak ahawl uhi.
english: They set God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house that was on the hill; and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drove the new cart.

paite: Abinadab inn a pan Pathian bawm alakhia ua; Pathian bawm ma ah Ahio apai hi.
english: They brought it out of Abinadab’s house which was in the hill, with God’s ark; and Ahio went before the ark.

paite: David leh Israel mi tengteng in TOUPA ma ah thil ging thei chi tuamtuam meilah sing a bawl leh kaihgingte, pekgingte, khuangtate, pengkul bineite, dakkhutbette atum uhi.
english: David and all the house of Israel played before Yahweh with all kinds of instruments made of cypress wood, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with castanets, and with cymbals.

paite: Nakon a buhphual atun un, bawng in ahoisak ziak in Uzzah in Pathian bawm asawk a, alen hi.
english: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached for God’s ark and took hold of it, for the cattle stumbled.

paite: Uzzah tung ah TOUPA hehna akuang a, athilhihdiklouh ziak in Pathian in huai ah athat a, Pathian bawm kiang ah asita hi.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Uzzah, and God struck him there for his error; and he died there by God’s ark.

paite: TOUPA hehna Uzzah tung a apuahzak ziak in David alungkim kei a, huai mun Perez-uzzah asa a, tuni tan in ahi lai hi.
english: David was displeased because Yahweh had broken out against Uzzah; and he called that place Perez Uzzah to this day.

paite: Huai ni in David in TOUPA alauta hi. "Bangchi in TOUPA bawm ka kiang ahong tung theita dia?" achi hi.
english: David was afraid of Yahweh that day; and he said, “How could Yahweh’s ark come to me?”

paite: David in TOUPA bawm David khua a amah kiang ah asuan nuam kei hi. Himahleh David in Git mi Obed-edom inn ah akoih zawta hi.
english: So David would not move Yahweh’s ark to be with him in David’s city; but David carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.

paite: Git mi Obed-edom inn ah kha thum TOUPA bawm a-om hi. Huchi in Obed-edom leh a-inkuan tengteng TOUPA'N avualzawl hi.
english: Yahweh’s ark remained in Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house three months; and Yahweh blessed Obed-Edom and all his house.

paite: "Pathian bawm ziak in, Obed-edom inkuan leh aneih-le-lam tengteng TOUPA'N avualzawl," chi in kumpipa David ahilh uh. Huchi in David in Obed-edom inn a pan Pathian bawm, David ah kipaktak in ava lata hi.
english: King David was told, “Yahweh has blessed the house of Obed-Edom, and all that belongs to him, because of God’s ark.” So David went and brought up God’s ark from the house of Obed-Edom into David’s city with joy.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA bawm zawng mite'n kal guk asuantak un bawngtal leh gan vak thau alan hi.
english: When those who bore Yahweh’s ark had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf.

paite: TOUPA ma ah atheihtawp in David alam a, puanmalngat puanak asilh hi.
english: David danced before Yahweh with all his might; and David was clothed in a linen ephod.

paite: Huchi in David leh Israel mi tengteng in kikou zuazua leh pengkul mut kawm in TOUPA bawm alatouta uhi.
english: So David and all the house of Israel brought up Yahweh’s ark with shouting and with the sound of the trumpet.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA bawm David khua a alut lai in, Saul tanu Mikal in tohlet a pan ana en a, TOUPA ma a David tawm leh lam amu a, alungtang in asimmohta hi.
english: As Yahweh’s ark came into David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out through the window and saw King David leaping and dancing before Yahweh; and she despised him in her heart.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA bawm alalut ua, akoihna dia David in akaih, puanin sung a amun ding ah akoihta uhi. David in ToUPA ma ah halmang thillatte leh lemna thillatte alan hi.
english: They brought in Yahweh’s ark, and set it in its place in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before Yahweh.

paite: David in halmang thillatte leh lemna thillatte alat khit in sepaihte' TOUPA min in mite avualzawl hi.
english: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Mi tengteng anumei apasal michih tanghou phel khat leh sa bak khat leh grep gah phoukeu bawm khat chiat apia hi. Huchi in michih ama inn lam chiat ah apaita uh.
english: He gave to all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, both to men and women, to everyone a portion of bread, dates, and raisins. So all the people departed, each to his own house.

paite: Hiai zoh in a-inkuante vualzawl ding in David apaikik hi. David dawn ding in Saul tanu Mikal ahong pawt a, "Tuni in Israel kumpipa thupi hi na mai e, migina lou, zumna thei lou kisuahkhete bang mai in tuni in asikha nungakte mitmuh in akisuahkhia a," ana chi hi.
english: Then David returned to bless his household. Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, “How glorious the king of Israel was today, who uncovered himself today in the eyes of his servants’ maids, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovers himself!”

paite: David in Mikal kiang ah, "Na pa leh a-inkuante tengteng sang a kei hon tel, TOUPA, Israelte tung a kumpipa dia hon seppa TOUPA ma ah ahi ka lam. Huaiziak in TOUPA ma ah nuamsa in ka om ding hi.
english: David said to Michal, “It was before Yahweh, who chose me above your father, and above all his house, to appoint me prince over the people of Yahweh, over Israel. Therefore I will celebrate before Yahweh.

paite: Hiai sang mah in leng ka zumpihhuai lai ding. Keimah mitmuh in leng ka sithuai lai ding. Himahleh huai sikha nungak na gente pahtawi in ka om ding," achi hi.
english: I will be yet more undignified than this, and will be worthless in my own sight. But the maids of whom you have spoken will honor me.”

paite: Huchi in Saul tanu Mikal in asih ni tanpha in ta anei kei hi.
english: Michal the daughter of Saul had no child to the day of her death.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa a-inn a om a, TOUPA'N akimvel a melmate tengteng a pan galmuang a a-omsak nung in;
english: When the king lived in his house, and Yahweh had given him rest from all his enemies all around,

paite: Kumpipa'n zawlnei Nathan kiang ah, "Tu in en in kei sidar sing inn ah ka teng a, himahleh Pathian bawm puanin ah a-om,” achi hi.
english: the king said to Nathan the prophet, “See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but God’s ark dwells within curtains.”

paite: Nathan in kumpipa kiang ah, "Na lungsim a om bangtak in va hih in, na kiang ah TOUPA a-om hi," achi hi.
english: Nathan said to the king, “Go, do all that is in your heart, for Yahweh is with you.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai zan mah in Nathan kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: That same night, Yahweh’s word came to Nathan, saying,

paite: "Ka sikha David va hilh in, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Ka tenna ding inn na hon lamsak ding maw?' "
english: “Go and tell my servant David, ‘Yahweh says, “Should you build me a house for me to dwell in?

paite: Israel suante Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhiak a pan tuni tan in inn ah ka teng kei a, puanin ah leh biakbuk ah ka teng zaw hi.
english: For I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought the children of Israel up out of Egypt, even to this day, but have moved around in a tent and in a tabernacle.

paite: Israel suante lak a ka paina tengteng ah leng, ka mi Israel vak dia thu ka piak vaihawmte kiang ah, "Bangziak a sidar sing a inn hon lamsak lou?" chi in ka gen ngei a hia?
english: In all places in which I have walked with all the children of Israel, did I say a word to anyone from the tribes of Israel whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people Israel, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’

paite: Huaiziak in ka sikha David kiang ah, sepaihte! TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Belam tatna mun a pan belam na ven lai in ka mi Israel mite tung a heutu ding in ka hon la hi.
english: Now therefore tell my servant David this: ‘Yahweh of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people, over Israel.

paite: Na hohna peuh ah na kiang ah ka om zel a, na ma ah na melmate ka hihmang zel hi. Lei a mithupitakte bang in min thupitak ka hon bawlsak hi.
english: I have been with you wherever you went, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a great name, like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.

paite: Hiai ban ah ka mi Israelte a ding in mun ka sep dia, amau ka suan ding a, amau mun mah ah ateng ding ua, tuma lam bang in gitlouhna tate'n ahihbuai nawn kei ding uh.
english: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not afflict them any more, as at the first,

paite: Na melmate tengteng lak a pan ka hon khawlsak hi. Huai lou him in TOUPA'N inn ka hon bawlsak ding, chi in ahon hilh hi.
english: and as from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will cause you to rest from all your enemies. Moreover Yahweh tells you that Yahweh will make you a house.

paite: Na ni abei a na pute kiang a na lup chiang in, na nung a na suan na gil a gah ding ka tungding ding a, agam ka hihkip ding.
english: When your days are fulfilled and you sleep with your fathers, I will set up your offspring after you, who will proceed out of your body, and I will establish his kingdom.

paite: Ama'n ka min a ding in inn alam dia, agam laltutphah tangtawn a ding in ka hihkip ding.
english: He will build a house for my name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.

paite: Apa ka hi ding a, amah ka tapa ahi ding. Thil ahihkhelhleh, mihing chiang leh mihing tapate khetna in ka thunun ding.
english: I will be his father, and he will be my son. If he commits iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men and with the stripes of the children of men;

paite: Himahleh, na ma a ka suanmang Saul kiang a pan ka lakmang bang in ka zahngaihna in ahon paisan kei ding hi.
english: but my loving kindness will not depart from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before you.

paite: Na inkuan leh na gam tangtawn a hihkip ngiungeu ahi dia, na laltutphah lah tangtawn in hihkip ahi ding," chi in.
english: Your house and your kingdom will be made sure forever before you. Your throne will be established forever.”’”

paite: Huai thute tengteng bang zel leh huai kilakna bang geih in Nathan in David kiang ah agen hi.
english: Nathan spoke to David all these words, and according to all this vision.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa David alut a, TOUPA ma ah atu hi, "Toupa PATHIAN aw, kua ahia ka hih a, ka inkuante bang ahia ahih uh, hiai tantan na hon pi?
english: Then David the king went in and sat before Yahweh; and he said, “Who am I, Lord Yahweh, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?

paite: Toupa PATHIAN aw, huaite leng nang mitmuh in thil bangmah tham ahi kei uh. Himahleh na sikha inkuan omdan ding thu kum tampi sung a ding in leng na gen khinta hi. Toupa PATHIAN aw, hiaite mihing hihdan ahi a hia?
english: This was yet a small thing in your eyes, Lord Yahweh, but you have spoken also of your servant’s house for a great while to come; and this among men, Lord Yahweh!

paite: David in na kiang ah bang agen nawn tuan dia? Toupa PATHIAN aw, na sikha lah na thei vek ngal a.
english: What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, Lord Yahweh.

paite: Na sikha theih ding in na thu ziak leh nangmah lungtang bang zel in hiai thil thupi tengteng na hihta hi.
english: For your word’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have worked all this greatness, to make your servant know it.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA Pathian aw, nang na thupi hi. Ka bil ua ka zak bang un nang bang kuamah a-om kei a, nangmah lou ngal Pathian a-om kei hi,
english: Therefore you are great, Yahweh God. For there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

paite: Aigupta gam a pan leh namte leh apathiante ua pan tankhia a, min bawlsak ding leh na gam a dia na mite ma a thil thupitak leh thil lauhuaitak hih ding na mi Israelte bang leitung ah namdang kua a-om a?
english: What one nation on the earth is like your people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, and to make himself a name, and to do great things for you, and awesome things for your land, before your people, whom you redeemed to yourself out of Egypt, from the nations and their gods?

paite: Huchi in Israel mite tangtawn a na mite ahong hihtheihna ding un nang a ding in na hihkipta hi. TOUPA, nang a Pathian uh na hong hita hi.
english: You established for yourself your people Israel to be your people forever; and you, Yahweh, became their God.

paite: "Huchi in TOUPA Pathian aw, na sikha tungtang thu leh a-inkuante tungtang thu na gen tangtawn a ding in hihkip inla, na gensa bang in hih in.
english: “Now, Yahweh God, the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, confirm it forever, and do as you have spoken.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA Israelte' Pathian ahi, chi in na min tangtawn in pahtawi in om hen. Huchi in na sikha David inkuante na ma ah hihkip in a-om ding uhi.
english: Let your name be magnified forever, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies is God over Israel; and the house of your servant David will be established before you.’

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA aw, Israel Pathian, na sikha kiang ah, inkuan ka hon phuhsak ding, chi in lah na puangta ngal a. Huaiziak in na sikha in hiai thumna na kiang ka hon tun ngam hi.
english: For you, Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, have revealed to your servant, saying, ‘I will build you a house.’ Therefore your servant has found in his heart to pray this prayer to you.

paite: "Tu in Toupa PATHIAN aw, nang huai Pathian na hi a, na thu dik hen, hiai thil hoih na sikha kiang ah na chiamta hi.
english: “Now, O Lord Yahweh, you are God, and your words are truth, and you have promised this good thing to your servant.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in na sikha inkuante na ma a tangtawn a a-om gige theihna ding un vualzawl in. Toupa PATHIAN aw, nang lah na genta ngal a. Na vualzawlna in na sikha inkuante tangtawn in vualzawl in om uhen," achi hi.
english: Now therefore, let it please you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Lord Yahweh, have spoken it. Let the house of your servant be blessed forever with your blessing.”

paite: Huan huai nung in hichi ahong hi a, David in Philistia mite sual in azou hi. Huchi in David in Philistia mite khut a pan Metheg-ammah alaksak hi.
english: After this, David struck the Philistines and subdued them; and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines.

paite: Moab mite asual a, lei a lumsak in khau in ateh a; vual nih athat a, vual khat bel ahinghawi hi. Huchi in Moab mite David sikhate ahong hita ua, thilpiakte ahon tawi uhi.
english: He defeated Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. The Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.

paite: David in Euphrates Luipi a, gam la nawn dia hoh in Zobah kumpipa Rehob tapa Hadadezer leng athat hi.
english: David also struck Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.

paite: Huchi in David in asakol tungtuangmi sangkhat-le-zasagih leh lei sepaih singnih amatsak hi. Huchi in kangtalai kai ding zakhat chih louh sakol tengteng athagui uh asattansak hi.
english: David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand footmen. David hamstrung the chariot horses, but reserved enough of them for one hundred chariots.

paite: Damaskas a Siria mite Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer huh dia kuante David in Siria mite lak a mi singnih-le-sangnih athat hi.
english: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty two thousand men of the Syrians.

paite: Huchi in David in Siria gam a Damaskas ah sepaih akoih hi. Siria mite David sikhate ahong hita ua, siah aliau uhi. TOUPA'N ahohna peuh ah David avualzousak zel hi.
english: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.

paite: David in Hadadezer pawlte dangka-eng lumte alaksak a, Jerusalem ah apaipih hi.
english: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

paite: Hadadezer khopite Betah leh Berothai a pan David in dal tampi ala hi.
english: From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.

paite: Hamath kumpipa Toi in Hadadezer sepaih tengteng David in azou chih azak in,
english: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer,

paite: Hadadezer asual a, azou chih azak in chibai buk ding leh vualzawl ding in Toi in David kiang ah atapa Joram asawl a; David in lah Hadadezer dou in ana that khinta hi. Huchi in Joram in dangka belte, dangka-eng belte leh dal belte ahon tawi hi.
english: then Toi sent Joram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him; for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. Joram brought with him vessels of silver, vessels of gold, and vessels of bronze.

paite: Huaite leh namdang azoh tengteng a pan alak dangka leh dangka-eng kumpipa David in TOUPA kiang ah alan hi:
english: King David also dedicated these to Yahweh, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued—

paite: Siriate, Moabte, Ammon suante, Philistiate, Amalekte leh Zobah kumpipa Rehob tapa Hadadezer a kipan agallakte.
english: of Syria, of Moab, of the children of Ammon, of the Philistines, of Amalek, and of the plunder of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

paite: David in Chi Phaizang ah Siria mi singkhat-le-sanggiat ava that a, apailam in aminthangta hi.
english: David earned a reputation when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand men of the Syrians in the Valley of Salt.

paite: Edom ah sepaih akoih a; Edom gam teng ah sepaih akoih hi. Huchi in Edom mi tengteng David sikha ahong hita uh. Huchi in TOUPA'N David apaina peuh ah avualzousak hi.
english: He put garrisons in Edom. Throughout all Edom, he put garrisons, and all the Edomites became servants to David. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.

paite: Huchi in David in Israel mi tengteng tung ah vai ahawm a; David in ami tengteng tung ah diktattak in vai ahawm hi.
english: David reigned over all Israel; and David executed justice and righteousness for all his people.

paite: Zeruiah tapa Joab sepaih heutupen ahi. Ahilud tapa Jehoshaphat bel tanchin gelhpa ahi.
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder,

paite: Ahitub tapa Zadok leh Abiathar tapa Ahimelek siampute ahi ua; Seraiah bel laigelhmi ahi.
english: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were priests, Seraiah was scribe,

paite: Jehoiada tapa Benaiah Kereth mi leh Pelet mite heutu ahi ua, David tapate bel vaihawmtu liante ahi uh.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief ministers.

paite: David in, "Jonathan ziak a hehpihna ka latsak theihna ding in Saul inkote lak a mi om lai a-om hia?" achi hi.
english: David said, “Is there yet any who is left of Saul’s house, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?”

paite: Saul inkote sikha khat amin Ziba a-om hi. David kiang a hoh ding in asam uhi. Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Ziba na hi hia?" achi a; ama'n, "Na sikha amah ka hi," achi hi.
english: There was of Saul’s house a servant whose name was Ziba, and they called him to David; and the king said to him, “Are you Ziba?” He said, “I am your servant.”

paite: Kumpipa'n, "Pathian hehpihna ka latsak theihna ding in Saul inkote lak a mi om lai om lou uhia?" achi hi. Ziba in kumpipa kiang ah, "Jonathan in tapa khat anei lai a, amah khebai ahi," achi hi.
english: The king said, “Is there not yet any of Saul’s house, that I may show the kindness of God to him?” Ziba said to the king, “Jonathan still has a son, who is lame in his feet.”

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Koi a om ahia?" achi hi. Ziba in kumpipa kiang ah, "Ngai in, Lo-debar ah Amiel tapa Makir inn ah a-om," achi hi.
english: The king said to him, “Where is he?” Ziba said to the king, “Behold, he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, in Lo Debar.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa David in mi asawl a, Lo-debar a pan Ammiel tapa Makir inn a pan mi ava pisak hi.
english: Then King David sent and brought him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, from Lo Debar.

paite: David kiang ah Saul tapa Jonathan tapa Mephibosheth ahong hi. Amai a lei si in zahtakna apia hi. David in, "Mephibosheth," achi a; ama'n, "En in, na sikha," chi in adawng hi.
english: Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, fell on his face, and showed respect. David said, “Mephibosheth?” He answered, “Behold, your servant!”

paite: David in akiang ah, “Lau ke'n. Na pa Jonathan ziak in hehpihna ka hon musak ngeingei ding. Na pu Saul gam tengteng ka hon pe nawn dia, ka dohkan ah an na ne gige ding," achi hi.
english: David said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for I will surely show you kindness for Jonathan your father’s sake, and will restore to you all the land of Saul your father. You will eat bread at my table continually.”

paite: Huchi in akun a, "Ui sisa bang lel na hon limsak, kei na sikha bang ka hi a?" achi hi.
english: He bowed down, and said, “What is your servant, that you should look at such a dead dog as I am?”

paite: Kumpipa'n Saul sikha Ziba asam a, akiang ah, "Saul thil neih tengteng leh a-inkote thil tengteng na pu tapa ka pe vek hi.
english: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said to him, “All that belonged to Saul and to all his house I have given to your master’s son.

paite: Amah a ding in lei na lehsak dia, nang leh na tapate leh na sikhate teng in na pu tapa in nek ding aneihtheihna ding in na sepkhiakte na hon la ding. Na pu tapa Mephibosheth in bel ka dohkan ah an a-um gige ding," achi hi. Ziba in tapa sawm-le-nga leh sikha sawmnih anei hi.
english: Till the land for him—you, your sons, and your servants. Bring in the harvest, that your master’s son may have bread to eat; but Mephibosheth your master’s son will always eat bread at my table.” Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

paite: Huchi in Ziba in kumpipa kiang ah, "Kumpipa ka toupa'n asikha thu apiak bang zel in na sikha in ahih ding," achi hi. Kumpipa'n, "Mephibosheth in ka dohkan ah kumpipa tapa bang in an a-um ding," achi hi.
english: Then Ziba said to the king, “According to all that my lord the king commands his servant, so your servant will do.” So Mephibosheth ate at the king’s table like one of the king’s sons.

paite: Mephibosheth in tapa naupang anei a, amin Mika ahi. Ziba inn a om tengteng Mephibosheth sikhate ahi uh.
english: Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Mica. All who lived in Ziba’s house were servants to Mephibosheth.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa dohkan a an a-um gige ziak in Jerusalem ah Mephibosheth atengta hi; amah akhe lang tuak bai ahi.
english: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, for he ate continually at the king’s table. He was lame in both his feet.

paite: Paul, Silvanas leh Timothi in, Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist a Thessalonika a om saptuamte kiang ah;
english: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

paite: Pa Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Unaute aw, na ginna uh nakpitak a khanglian in, na vek ua na ki-ittuah chiatna uh akhan semsem ziak in noumau tungthu ah Pathian kiang a kipahthu gengen ding him ka hi uh; huai ka hihtuak him uh ahi.
english: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds,

paite: Huaiziak in mi'n ahon sawina tengteng uleh gim na thuaknate ua na kuhkaldan uleh na ginna ziak un Pathian saptuam pawlte lak ah koute mahmah in ka hon suang uhi.
english: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.

paite: Huai lah Pathian' vaihawmna adiktat chih chiamtehna ahi a, tu a Pathian kumpigam mi a seh tak na hi uh chih kilatna semsem ahi; huaiziak a leng thuak na hi ngal ua.
english: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom, for which you also suffer.

paite: Pathian in nou hon hihgimte gimthuakna a thuk diktathuai in asepta hi.
english: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,

paite: Toupa Jesu van a kipan a-angel hatte toh meikuang a hong kilak chiang a, nou hihgim a omte koute toh khawlna ahon pe ding hi.
english: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,

paite: Pathian theiloumi leh i Toupa Jesu tanchinhoih taksangloute tung ah phu ala ding hi.
english: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,

paite: Amau tangtawn manthatna a gawtna leh Toupa omna leh athilhihtheihna thupina a kipan posiahna athuak ding ua,
english: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

paite: amah ahong pai chiang in misiangthoute hih thupi in a-om ding ua, gingtute tengteng lak ah lamdangsak in a-om ding uhi, ka hon thu theihsak uh na gintak ziak un nou leng amaute lak ah na tel sam ding uhi.
english: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.

paite: Huchi a hih thupi leh lamdangsak ahihtheihna ding a i Pathian in nou ahon sapna a sap tuak him ahon saktheihna ding in leh lungtaina chiteng leh ginna nasep chiteng a thilhihtheihna a ahon lohchinsak theihna ding in noute a ding in ka hon thumsak gige uhi;
english: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power,

paite: huchi a i Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna bang zel a i Toupa Jesu min noumau a hih thupi a om a, noumau leng amah a hih thupi a na omtheihna ding un.
english: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Himahleh unaute aw, i Toupa Jesu Khrist hong paina leh amah tuak ding a i kikhopna ding thu ah;
english: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you

paite: Toupa ni atung khinta chihna kha in hiam aw, thu ziak in hiam aw, kou a kipan a laikhak ziak in hiam aw, na lungsim uh alin pahlouhna ding in leh na buailouhna ding un ka hon ngen uhi.
english: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.

paite: Kuamah in bangmah in hon khem kei uhen; puksanna tak ahong tun masak phot a, khelhna mipa, mangthang tapa ngei ahong kilat keileh huai ni tung lou ding ahi.
english: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction.

paite: Ama'n Pathian kichi peuhmahte leh biak a om peuhmahte kalh in, amah leh amah kitawisang in Pathian tempul ah atu dia, Pathian in amah leh amah akibawl ding hi.
english: He opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.

paite: Na lak ua ka om lai in leng huai bang thu ka hon hilh zel chih na theigige kei ua hia?
english: Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?

paite: Amah hun tuam a ahong kilattheihna ding in bang in kham ahia chih na thei uhi.
english: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.

paite: Dan lou a omna thuguk in tu in leng asem lellel ngal a, himahleh lakmang a a-om masiah tua akhampa'n huchibang in akham ding hi.
english: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.

paite: Huai lakmang ahih chiang in dan a talekpa ahong kilangta ding a, Toupa Jesu'n akam hatna in athat dia, ahong paina leh kilakna in ahihmang ding hi.
english: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;

paite: Huai dan a talekpa ahong paina Setan sepdan bang zel in, thilhihtheihna chiteng, chiamtehna chiteng, zuau thillamdang chiteng toh,
english: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

paite: mangthang lelte ding in khemna gilou chiteng toh ahi ding; hotdam a a-omtheihna ding ua thutak itna apom louh ziak un.
english: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

paite: Huaiziak in zuauthu agintakna ding un, Pathian in diklouhna nasep akiang uah ahon sawl ding hi;
english: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,

paite: thutak gingta lou a diktatlouhna a kipakzawte'n siam louh atan vek theihna ding un.
english: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

paite: Unau Toupa ngaihtakte aw, Kha hihsiangthou leh thutak gingta a hotdam a om ding in atung a kipan Pathian in nou ahon tel ziak in na tungthu uah zaw Pathian kiang ah kipahthu gen zel ding him ka hi uhi.
english: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,

paite: Huchibang ding in ama'n i Toupa Jesu Khrist thupina tang ding in ka tanchinhoih un nou ahon sam hi.
english: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Huchi in unaute aw, dingkip unla, kam a ka thugen uleh laikhakte a nou ka hon sinsakte uh lenkip un.
english: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.

paite: Huchi in i Toupa Jesu Khrist mahmah leh Pathian i Pa, eite hon itpa leh hehpihna ziak a tangtawn a khamuanna leh lametna hoih hon pepa'n,
english: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

paite: na lungtangte uh hihkhamuang in, thil hoih hih leh thugen chiteng ah hon hihkip hen.
english: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.

paite: Atawp pen in unaute aw, Toupa thu noumau lak a a-om bang in, khang a hih thupi a a-omtheihna ding leh,
english: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,

paite: migenhakte leh migiloute lak a ka bit theihna ding un, hon thumsak un; mi tengteng in lah ginna anei vek kei uhi.
english: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.

paite: Himahleh Toupa amuanhuai a, ama'n noute hon phutkip in giloupa a pan ahon veng ding hi.
english: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.

paite: K'on thupiak peuhmah uh na hihzou ua, na hih zelzel uh leng Toupa ah ka hon gingta uhi.
english: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.

paite: Toupa'n na lungtangte uh Pathian itna ah leh Khrist kuhkalna ah pilut hen.
english: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.

paite: Huan unaute aw, koute a kipan a thuhilhna amuh bang ua om lou nasep thadah, dan lou bang a om unau tengteng a pan kihemkhe ding in i Toupa Jesu Khrist min in thu ka hon pia uhi.
english: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us.

paite: Na kiang ua ka om lai un, dan lou bang in ka gamta ngei kei uh chih leh noumau mahmah in na hon zuihdan ding uh na thei uhi.
english: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,

paite: Kuamah khut a kipan athawn in na tanghou uh leng ka ne ngei kei uh; noute ka hon tuailuai saklouhna ding un sun leh zan a gim leh tawltak a sem kawm in ka ne zaw zel uhi.
english: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you.

paite: Huai thuneihna ka neih louh ziak uh hilou in, ka omdan uh na zuih ding ua etton ding hon pia ka hi zaw hi.
english: This was not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.

paite: Na kiang ua ka om lai un; kuapeuh in nna asepnop keileh nek leng ne kei hen, chi in thu ka hon pia uhi.
english: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”

paite: Na lak ua khenkhat dan lou a omte tungtang ka za uhi, huaite'n nna himhim asem kei ua, midangte nasep ah akichinglah zaw uhi.
english: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.

paite: Huchi ahih chiang in, huai mite nasem hiathiat ding leh amau tanghou ne ding in Toupa Jesu Khrist ah thu pia in ka hanthawn uhi.
english: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.

paite: Unaute aw, nou zaw thil hoih hih chimtak kei un.
english: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.

paite: Huan kuapeuh in hiai ka laikhak ua ka thu uh azuih kei uleh, na kithuahpih hetlouhna ding un chiamteh un, azumtheihna ding in.
english: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man and have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.

paite: Ahi, melma bang in en kei unla, unau bang in hilh zaw un.
english: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

paite: Tu in muanna Toupa'n kong chiteng ah noute hon khamuan tawntung hen. Toupa na vek ua lak ah om hen.
english: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

paite: Kei, Paul in, keimah khut a hiai chibai bukna ka gelh ahi; hiai ka laikhak teng ah chiamtehna ahi; hichibang ka gelhdan ahi.
english: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na vek ua tung ah om hen. Amen.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

paite: Paul, Pathian deihdan a Khrist Jesu a om hinna thuchiam dungzui a, Khrist Jesu sawltak in,
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,

paite: ka tapa deihtak Timothi kiang ah, Pa Pathian leh Khrist Jesu i Toupa kiang a kipan hehpihna, zahngaihna, leh khamuanna om hen.
english: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

paite: Sun leh zan khawl lou a ka thumnate a nang hon theigige in, ka pipute a kipan a sia-le-pha theihna siangtak nei a ama nna ka sep gigena pa, Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen a,
english: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day

paite: kipak a ka dimtheihna ding in hon muh ka ut mahmah hi, na khitui theigige in.
english: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

paite: Ginna taktak nangmah a om ka theigige a, huai ginna atung in na pi Lois ah a-om a, huan na nu Iunis ah, tu in nangmah ah leng a om chih diktak in ka theichian hi.
english: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.

paite: Huaiziak in ka khut ngak ziak a Pathian thilthawnpiak nangmah a om pen mutkuang ding in ka hon theisak hi.
english: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

paite: Pathian in launa kha ahon pe kei a, thilhihtheihna leh itna leh kithuzohna kha ahon pe zaw hi.
english: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

paite: Huchi in i Toupa thu theihsak zumpih ke'nla, kei ahentapa leng hon zumpih sam ke'n. Tanchinhoih ziak a gimthuak Pathian thilhihtheihna dungzui in hon thuakpih zaw in.
english: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,

paite: Ama'n i thilhihte bang hilou in, ama seh leh hehpihna bang zaw in hon hondam a, sapna siangthou in ahon sam hi; huai hehpihna leilung pian ma a Khrist Jesu a hon piak ahita hi.
english: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

paite: Himahleh i Hondampa Khrist Jesu kilakna ziak in tu in hihlat in a-omta hi. Ama'n sihna hihmang in, tanchinhoih in hinna leh sih theihlouhna ahihlangta hi.
english: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.

paite: Huai tanchinhoih theisak ding a tangkoupihpa, sawltak leh sinsaktu a seh ka hi.
english: For this I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

paite: Hiai ziak in ahi, hiai thilte leng ka na thuak. Himahleh ka zum kei; ka ginpa ka thei a, akiang a ka kepsak huai ni a ding in akemhoih thei chih diktak in ka thei hi.
english: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.

paite: Khrist Jesu a om ginna leh itna nei in, ka kam a thudik na zakte zui tinten in.
english: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

paite: I sung a teng Kha Siangthou hon kepsak thutak kemhoih in.
english: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.

paite: Asia gam a om tengtengte'n ahon nungngatsan uh chih na thei a; alak uah Phigelas leh Harmogenes apang uhi.
english: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

paite: Toupa'n Onesiforas inkuanpihte kiang ah zahngaihna pia hen aw, ama'n ahon hihhalh zelzel ziak in; leh ka khainiang but leng ahon zumpih kei hi.
english: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,

paite: Rome ahong tun in hon limzon ngial a, ahong mukhia hi.
english: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me

paite: Huai ni chiang in Toupa kiang a zahngaihna mu ding in Toupa'n amah sep hen. Ephesa a anasep thupidan na thei hi.
english: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.

paite: Huchi in nang ka tapa, Khrist Jesu a hehpihna om ah thilhihtheihna nei in om in.
english: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

paite: Theihpih tampite lak a ka kam a thu na zakte, mimuanhuai, midangte hilhsawn thei dingte kiang ah kemsak in.
english: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

paite: Khrist Jesu sepaih hoih bang in gimthuak hon thuakpih in.
english: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

paite: Sepaih a om ding a atelpa kipahsak ahihtheihna ding in, sepaih kuamah kidou lai in hiai damsung khosaknate in akisubuai ngei kei hi.
english: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

paite: Huan kidemnate ah mite pang mahleh dan bang a ahihkeileh khuksak in a-om ngei kei hi.
english: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.

paite: Louneipa semgim agah tang masapa ahih ding ahi.
english: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.

paite: Ka thugentak ngaihtuah in; Toupa'n thil tengteng ah theihsiamna ahon pe ding hi.
english: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

paite: Jesu Khrist, David suan ka tanchinhoih gen bang a misi lak a kipan a thounawnpa theigige in.
english: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,

paite: Huai tanchinhoih ziak in thil hihkhialpa bang in hen hial in gimna ka thuak zel hi; himahleh Pathian thu hen in a-om kei hi.
english: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.

paite: Huaiziak in Khrist Jesu a hotdamna tangtawn a thupina toh amuh sam theihna ding un, telte ziak in bangkim ka thuak hi.
english: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

paite: Hiai thugen adik hi: "Asihna a i sih khit ngalleh, ahinna ah i hing ding hi.
english: This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.

paite: I thuak leh avaihawmna ah vai i hawm sam ding hi; amah i kitheihmohbawlleh ama'n leng hon kitheihmohbawl ding.
english: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.

paite: Eite muanhuai lou in om mah lehang, Amah zaw muanhuai in a-om gige hi; amah-le-amah akitheihmohbawl thei ngal kei a.”
english: If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”

paite: Hiai theisak inla, thute leltak tung a akisellouhna ding un Toupa muh in phatuamngaitak in theisak in; huai kiselna bangmah aphatuam kei a, angaikhete a ding in siatna ahi zaw hi.
english: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.

paite: Nasemtu, zumna ding nei lou, thutak thu diktak a zang, Pathian pomtak hi ding a nangmah kipe ding in theihtawp suah in kisin in.
