english: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

paite: Himahleh Pathian zah louh thugen mawkmawkte nungngatsan in; huchibang mite Pathian limsaklouhna lam ah apai gamla semsem ding ua,
english: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,

paite: athu un meima sia nek bang in ane zel ding; alak uah Himenaias leh Philetas apang uhi.
english: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:

paite: Huai mite'n thohnawnna a-om khinta chi in thutak lam apialsan ua, mi khenkhatte ginna ahihmangsak uhi.
english: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.

paite: Himahleh Pathian suangphum kip adingh lai a, hiai chiamtehna anei hi: "Toupa'n ama ate athei," chih leh, "Toupa min lou peuhmah in diktatlouhna paisan hen," chih.
english: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”

paite: Himahleh inn thupi ah tui-um belsuan dangka-eng leh dangka a bawlte kia a-om kei a, sing leh bellei a bawlte leng a-om hi; khenkhatte manphatak a zat a-om a, khenkhatte manpha lou deuh a zat leng a-om sam hi.
english: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.

paite: Huaiziak in mi huai thil manphaloute lak a akihepleh tui-um belsuan manphatak a zat ding, siangthou, apu a dia zat tak, nasep hoih chiteng a dia mansa ahi ding hi.
english: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.

paite: Himahleh valnou duhgawlnate taisan inla, lungtang siangthou a Toupa sam peuhmahte lak adiktatna, ginna, itna leh khamuanna delh in.
english: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

paite: Himahleh kidounate asuaksak nak chih thei in, kiselna haihuai leh pil lou ah pang nuam ke'n.
english: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.

paite: Toupa sikha in adou ding ahi kei a, mi tengteng tung ah siam tum in, thuhilh siam in, gitlouh tung a thuakzou in,
english: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,

paite: amah doute thunuailuttak in athuhilh zaw ding hỉ. Huchi in Pathian in thutak atheihna ding un akisiksak zenzen kha ding hi,
english: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,

paite: huchi in khua ahon theithei ding ua, amaute suak-le-sal a man a a-utut a bawlpa diabol thang a kipan asuakta thei ding uh.
english: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.

paite: Huan hiai thei in, ni nanung ah hun haksa pipi a hong om ding hi.
english: But know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.

paite: Mi amau ki-itte, dangka deihtate, ki-uangsakte, kisatheite, Pathian gensete, nu leh pa thu mangloute, kipahna dan theiloute, siangthouloute,
english: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

paite: itna pianpih neiloute, buaina bawlte, hekte, kidek theiloute, mihuhamte, hoih deih hetloute,
english: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,

paite: zuautatte, kingaisang, thunung khualloute, Pathian it sang a amau kipahna kia itzawte ahi ding uh;
english: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

paite: Pathian limsak batna anei ding ua, himahleh athilhihtheihna ataksang kei ding uhi. Huchibang mite nungngatsan in.
english: holding a form of godliness but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.

paite: Amaute lak a khenkhatte inn peuh a lut a gitlouh gik pua numei haideuhte sal a manmante ahi ua, huchibang numeite duhgawlna chi chih a pimang in,
english: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,

paite: zilzil napi a, thutak theipha ngeiloute ahi uhi.
english: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

paite: Jannes leh Jambres in Mosi adou bang un, huai mite'n leng thutak adou gige uhi; lungsim sesa ginna lam a Pathian deih louh mi ahi uhi.
english: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.

paite: Himahleh huai val ahih kei ding uhi, ahaidan uh Jannes leh Jambres haidan ahong kitheih mah bang in mi tengteng kiang ah hong kilang ding hi.
english: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.

paite: Himahleh nang zaw ka thugin, ka omdan, ka thiltup, ka ginna, ka thuakzohna, ka itna, ka kuhkalna na thei vek hi,
english: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,

paite: Antiok khua, Ikoniam khua, Listra a ka tung a thil tung ahon sawinate uh, huai sawina ka thuakte; huai tengteng ah Toupa'n hon hunkheta hi.
english: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.

paite: Ahi, kuapeuh Khrist Jesu Pathian limsak a om tum photphot in sawina athuak sam ding uhi.
english: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

paite: Migilou leh mikhem hatte mi khem leh khem a om in agilou semsem ding uhi.
english: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

paite: Himahleh nang zaw na zilsa leh kiptak a na gintaksa thutak ah om gige in, kua a kipan na zil hiam chih theigige in.
english: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.

paite: Huan Khrist Jesu ginna ziak a hotdamna mu ding a nang hon hilhpil thei Laisiangthoute naupangnou a kipan thei khin na hi chih theigige in.
english: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

paite: Laisiangthou peuhmah Pathian hatkhum a piak ahi a; huaiziak in thuhilhna ding, taihilhna ding, bawlhoihna ding, diktatna lam a kichilna ding in aphatuam hi.
english: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

paite: Huchi a Pathian mipa nna hoih chiteng sem ding a kimtak a kivan a akimtheihna ding in.
english: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

paite: Huaiziak in Pathian ma leh akilatna leh alalgam a misi leh mihing tung a vai hawm dingpa, Toupa Jesu Khrist ma ah mohpuakna ka hon guan hi.
english: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:

paite: Thu gen in; ahun hi in ahun lou ah leng pang zel in; thuakzoutak a thuhilh kawm in asiamlouhdan uh theisak inla, taihilh inla, hanthawn in,
english: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.

paite: thuhilhna dik angaihkhiak ngap louh hun uh ahong tung ding a; abilte uh azau ziak in amau deihlam bang in heutute akiang uah akhawm ding uh;
english: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,

paite: abilte uh thutak lam ah angongsak ding ua, tangthu lam naih in apialta ding uhi.
english: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.

paite: Nang zaw bangkim ah pilvang in, gimthuak inla, tanchinhoih genna lam nna sem in na nasepna pen hihtangtung in.
english: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.

paite: Kei zaw tu in leng luikhiak in ka om lellel a, ka pawt hun atungta hi.
english: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.

paite: Douna hoih tuh ka dou khinta a, kitaitehna ka tai khinta, ginna ka lenkip paisuakta hi.
english: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

paite: Tu'n ah zaw kei a ding in Diktatna Lallukhu koih in a-omta, Toupa vaihawmpa diktat in huai ni chiang in kei ahon pe ding, kei kiang kia hilou in akilakna it peuhmahte kiang ah ape sam ding hi.
english: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

paite: Kintak in ka kiang a hong pai pah hon tum in; Dema in tulai khovel a-it ziak in hon paisan a,
english: Be diligent to come to me soon,

paite: Thessalonika ah apaita hi; Galatia gam ah Kristens apai a, Dalmatia gam ah Titas apaita hi.
english: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.

paite: Luka kia ka kiang ah a-om hi. Marka chial inla, hon pi in, amah nasepna lam ah kei a ding in aphatuam hi.
english: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.

paite: Ephesa ah Taikika ka sawlta.
english: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

paite: Na hong pai chiang in Troas a Karpas kiang a puanaktual ka nutsiat, laibute toh hon tawi in, savun lai mahmah hon tawi in.
english: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.

paite: Alexander, dalsun siampa, ka tung ah agilou mahmah hi.
english: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

paite: Toupa'n athilhih bang zel in athuk ding; amah lak ah nang leng pilvang in, i thu adou mahmah hi.
english: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.

paite: Ka siamna thu ka gen masakpen in kuama'n ahon gum kei ua, ahon zuausan vek uhi; amoh pua in om tuan kei uhen.
english: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

paite: Tanchinhoih keimah ziak a hilhkim a a-omtheihna ding leh Zentelte'n azaktheihna ding un, Toupa'n hon gum a ahon hihhat zawta hi; humpinelkai kam a kipan in suahtaksak in ka omta hi.
english: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

paite: Toupa'n gitlouhna tengteng lak a kipan in ahon suaktasak dia, avan-gam ah bittak in ahon tun ding; ama kiang ah tangtawn in thupina om hen. Amen.
english: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

paite: Priscilla leh Akuila, Onesiphoras inkuanpihte toh, chibai hon buksak in.
english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

paite: Korinth ah Erastas a-om gige a, Trophimas bel Melita ah damlou in ka nusia hi.
english: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

paite: Phalbi ma in hong pai teitei in, Iubalas, Pudens, Linas, Klaudia leh unau tengteng in chibai ahon buk uhi.
english: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

paite: Toupa Jesu Khrist in na kha ompih hen. Na kiang ah hehpihna om hen. Amen.
english: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

paite: Upa in, deihtak Gaias thutak a ka it kiang ah;
english: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.

paite: deihtak, na kha in vualzawlna amuh bang in, bangkim a vualzawlna na muh leh na damtheihna ding in ka thum zel hi.
english: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.

paite: Unaute ahong pai un, thutak a na hindan leh na muanhuaidan ahon theihpih ziak un ka kipak mahmah hi.
english: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.

paite: Ka tate thutak ah a-om uh chih ka zak kan a kipahna thupizaw ka nei kei hi.
english: I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.

paite: Deihtak unaute mikhual himah le uh, atung ua na hih peuh ah muanhuaitak in na hih zel a;
english: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.

paite: huaite'n saptuamte ma ah na itna atheipihta uhi; amau tuh azinna ua Pathian mite hihtuak him a na khakkhiakleh na hihhoih ding hi.
english: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,

paite: Amau Khrist min a azinna uah Zentelte kiang a kipan bangmah la lou in apawt zel ngal ua.
english: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

paite: Huchi in thutak a seppihte i hihtheihna ding in huchibang mite, eite'n i kipahpih ding mah ahi.
english: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.

paite: Saptuamte kiang ah thu neukha zaw ka gelhta; himahleh Diotrephes, alak ua tungnun ut nakpa'n akipahpih kei hi.
english: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.

paite: Huaiziak in ka hong paileh athilhihte ka pholhkhe ding a, i tung ua thu dikloupi agen a akamtamdan ka theikhesak ding hi. Huan huai leng hun asa kei a, amah ngei in unaute akipahpih kei a, akipahpih nuamte leng khou in saptuamte lak a kipan adelhkhia hi.
english: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, he doesn’t receive the brothers himself, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.

paite: Deihtak, giloumi omdan zui ke'n, ahoih zui zaw in. Kuapeuh thil hoih hihmi tuh Pathian a pan ahi; thil gilou hihmi in Pathian amu ngei kei hi.
english: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.

paite: Demetrias in mi tengteng phat aloh a, thutak a phat nangawn aloh behlap hi; eite'n leng i phat ua, hiai phatna adik ahi chih na thei hi.
english: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.

paite: Na kiang ah thu tampi gelh ding ka nei, himahleh laitui leh laipuan a gelh ka ut kei hi.
english: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;

paite: Sawt lou nung chiang in hon muh ka lamen hi, huchi in kimaituah in i kihou ding.
english: but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.

paite: Theophilas aw, tuma a ka laigelh ah, Jesu thilhih leh athuhilh pat tung tengteng thu ka gelh hi.
english: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,

paite: Kha Siangthou tawn a asawltak telte kiang a thupiak tampi apiak khit a van a pitouh a a-om ni tan a thute ahi.
english: until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.

paite: Huai sawltakte kiang ah gimna athuak nung in theihna zuau lou tampi in ahing in akimusak a, ni sawmli hial akiang uah akilak a, Pathian lalgam thu agen hi.
english: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking about God’s Kingdom.

paite: Huan a-omkhawm uh akithuahpih a, "Jerusalem khua paisan kei un, Pa thilchiam ka gen na zak uh ngak un, achi tinten hi.
english: Being assembled together with them, he commanded them, “Don’t depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which you heard from me.

paite: Johan in tui in abaptis zel a, himahleh, ni sawt lou nung in Kha Siangthou a baptis in na om ding uh," achi hi.
english: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.”

paite: Huan amaute ahong kikhop un akiang ah, "Toupa, tu in hia Israelte kiang a lalgam na piak nawn ding?" chi in adong uhi.
english: Therefore, when they had come together, they asked him, “Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Pa in ahun leh ani amah thuthu a om dia aseh, nou theih ding ahi kei hi.
english: He said to them, “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.

paite: Himahleh, Kha Siangthou na tung ua ahong tun chiang in thilhihtheihna na nei ding uh; huchi in Jerusalem ah, leh Judia gamsung pumpi ah, leh Samaria leh kawlmong pha in ka theihpihte na hi ding uh," achi hi.
english: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”

paite: Huai thu agen khit in amuh laipi un, van a pitouh in a-omta a, meipi in amuh phak louh uah apitouta hi.
english: When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.

paite: Huan apaitouh lai a van lam a-et nilouh lai un, ngai in, mi nih, puanngou silh in, akiang uah ahong dingh uhi.
english: While they were looking steadfastly into the sky as he went, behold, two men stood by them in white clothing,

paite: Huai mite'n, "Galili gam a mite aw, bangziak a van lam en a dingh na hi ua? Hiai Jesu na kiang ua kipan a van apitouh a om, van a paitou na muh bang un amah mah ahong kik nawn ding," achi uhi.
english: who also said, “You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky, will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky.”

paite: Huan Olive tang achih ua kipat Jerusalem ah akik nawnta uhi. Huai tang Jerusalem kho kiang ahi a, Sabbath ni a hohna hun lel ahi.
english: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey away.

paite: Huan alut un, a-omna dantan tungnung uah apaitou ua, Peter leh Johan, Jakob leh Andru, Philip leh Thomas, Bartholomai leh Matthai, Alphai tapa Jakob, Simon Zealot Pawl a leh Jakob tapa Judas toh ahi uh.
english: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying, that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.

paite: Huai tengteng numei kuate hiam leh Jesu nu Mari toh, Jesu unaute toh, lungsim mun khat a, phatuamngaitak a thum in a-om nilouh uhi.
english: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.

paite: Huan huai ni in unaute lak ah Peter adingh a, avek un za-le-sawmnih ahi uhi.
english: In these days, Peter stood up in the middle of the disciples (and the number of names was about one hundred twenty), and said,

paite: "Unaute aw, Kha Siangthou in, David kam a, Jesu mante makai Judas thu agenkholh Laisiangthou thu ahong tung ding him ahi."
english: “Brothers, it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus.

paite: Amah zaw i lak ua simtel ahi a, hiai nasepna ah tan leng anei sam hi.
english: For he was counted with us, and received his portion in this ministry.

paite: Himahleh huai mi'n akhelhna man in mun khat alei a, akhuplam in akia a, alai ah apuakkham a, agil tengteng alawt vek hi.
english: Now this man obtained a field with the reward for his wickedness; and falling headlong, his body burst open and all his intestines gushed out.

paite: Huai thu Jerusalem a omte tengteng in ana za uhi; huchi in huai mun amau pau in, Akeldama, achi ua, huai tuh Sisan Mun, chihna ahi.
english: It became known to everyone who lived in Jerusalem that in their language that field was called ‘Akeldama,’ that is, ‘The field of blood.’

paite: "Sam Laibu ah hiai thu gelh ahi. 'A-omna mun hihgam in om hen, asung ah kuamah om kei hen,' 'huan aheutu hihna midang in tang hen,' chih ahi.
english: For it is written in the book of Psalms, ‘Let his habitation be made desolate. Let no one dwell in it;’ and, ‘Let another take his office.’

paite: "Huchi in Toupa Jesu i lak ua lut zel pawt zel a a-om sung teng a,
english: “Of the men therefore who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

paite: Johan baptisma nungsiah, i lak ua kipan van a pitouh a a-om ni tan hiai hon kithuahpihte lak a mi khat athohnawnna theihpih ding in a-om ding ahi," achi hi.
english: beginning from the baptism of John to the day that he was received up from us, of these one must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”

paite: Huan mi nih asepkhia ua, khat Joseph Barsabbas kichi ahi a, aminkhem Justas leh midang khat Mathias ahi.
english: They put forward two: Joseph called Barsabbas, who was also called Justus, and Matthias.

paite: Huan athum ua, "Toupa, Nang, mihing tengteng lungtang thei, hiai nihte akua zaw pen ahia na tel hon hilh in,
english: They prayed and said, “You, Lord, who know the hearts of all men, show which one of these two you have chosen

paite: Judas in amah omna a pai ding in hiai nasepna leh sawltakna akiaksan sik a ding in," achi uhi.
english: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.”

paite: Huan ai asan ua, a-aisan uh Matthias tung ah atu a; huchi in amah sawltak sawm-le-khatte lak a simtel ahita hi.
english: They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias; and he was counted with the eleven apostles.

paite: Kaisaria ah mi khat amin Kornelia a-om a; amah Itali pawl achih uh, huai pawl a sepaih zaheutupa ahi.
english: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,

paite: Amah Pathian limsakmi ahi a, a-inkuanpihte tengteng toh Pathian laudan asiam uhi, mite kiang ah thilthawnpiak tampi ape zel a, Pathian kiang ah leng athum gige hi.
english: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.

paite: Hiai mi'n sun dak kuana ding khawng in mengmuhna in Pathian angel khat akiang ah alut a, "Kornelia" chi a asap lai chiangtak in amu hi.
english: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him and saying to him, “Cornelius!”

paite: Huan Kornelia in lau in amah ana en kilkel a, "Toupa, bang ahia?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Na thumnate leh na thilpiakte theihgigena ding in Pathian ma ah atungtouta hi.
english: He, fastening his eyes on him and being frightened, said, “What is it, Lord?” He said to him, “Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.

paite: Tu'n ah Joppa khua ah mi sawl inla, mi khat Simon Peter achih uh va pisak in;
english: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.

paite: amah huai tuipi gei a om, savunbawlpa Simon inn a tung ahi a, ama'n na hih ding hon na hilh ding hi," achi hi.
english: He is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside.

paite: Ahoupihpa angel apaitak in, Kornelia in asikhate lak a mi nih leh anek bawl gigete lak a Pathian limsak sepaih khat asam hi.
english: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.

paite: Thu tengteng akiang ua ahilh khit in Joppa khua ah asawlta hi.
english: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.

paite: Huan azing nawn in, khopi zuan a pai, khua atun kuan un, thum ding in dak gukna vel in intung ah Peter akaltou hi.
english: Now on the next day as they were on their journey and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.

paite: Huan agil ahong kial mahmahta a, an nek a-utta hi; himahleh nek ding abawl lai un ihmu bang in zeel in ahong om hi.
english: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.

paite: Van kihong in, banghiam bawm, puan liantak bang, ning li a khih, lei a luai a khaikhiak a om in amu hi.
english: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,

paite: Huai sung ah leitung a khe li nei ganhing chi chih leh gamsa leh ganhing bokvak, tungleng vasa chichihte a-om uhi.
english: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.

paite: Huan akiang ah aw in, "Peter, thou in gou inla, ne in," achi hi.
english: A voice came to him, “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”

paite: Himahleh Peter in, "Toupa hilou e; siang lou leh nin bangmah himhim ka ne ngei kei," achi hi.
english: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”

paite: Aw in, anihveina in, “Pathian in ahihsiangthousa nang siang lou chi ke'n," achi hi.
english: A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”

paite: Huchibang ngen in thumvei ahong om a; huan van ah bawm khaitouh in a-om nawnta hi.
english: This was done three times, and immediately the thing was received up into heaven.

paite: Huan Peter in mengmu bang a amuh theisiam lou a, abuai lai in, Kornelia mi sawlte'n Simon inn ana kankhia ua,
english: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,

paite: kongkhak bul ah ana dingh ua asam ua, "Simon, Peter achih uh, huai a atun leh tun louh," ana dong uhi.
english: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.

paite: Peter in mengmu bang a amuh angaihtuah lai inla, Kha in akiang ah, "Ngai in, mi thum in ahong zong uh.
english: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men seek you.

paite: Huaiziak in thou inla, kumsuk in, bangmah ginglel lou in amaute zui in; amau ka sawl ahi uh," achi hi.
english: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”

paite: Huchi in Peter huai mite kiang ah ahohsukta a, akiang uah, "Ngai un na mizon uh ka hi; bang ahia na hong nasan uh?" achi hi.
english: Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”

paite: Amau, "Angel siangthou khat in, Kornelia, sepaih zaheutupa, midiktak, Pathian laudan siam, Juda nam tengteng lak a mihoih kiang ah, na thugen azakna ding in, a-inn ah nangmah sam ding in ahilh hi," achi uhi.
english: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”

paite: Huchi in mite asamlut a, agiaksakta hi. Huan azing in Peter athou a, akiang uah apai a, Joppa khomi unau kuate hiam leng akiang uah apai sam uhi.
english: So he called them in and provided a place to stay. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.

paite: Huan azing nawn in Kaisaria ah alutta uhi. Kornelia in, asanggamte leh alawm deihpente samkhawm in, amau ana ngak nilouh hi.
english: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.

paite: Peter ahong lut dek laitak in Kornelia in ana dawn a, akhebul a bokkhup in, abia hi.
english: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.

paite: Himahleh Peter in amah akaithou a, dingh in, "Kei leng mihing mai ka hi,” achi hi.
english: But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”

paite: Amah toh kihou kawm in alut a, mi tampi omkhawm amu hi.
english: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.

paite: Akiang uah, "Juda mi namdang toh kithuah leh pai asianlouhdan noumau mah in na thei uhi; himahleh kuamah siang lou leh nin ka chih ding ahi kei chih Pathian in ahon theisak hi.
english: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn’t call any man unholy or unclean.

paite: Huaiziak in na hong saptak in sel lou in ka hong pai hi. Huchi in ka hon dong ahi, bangziak a hon sam na hi ua le?" achi hi.
english: Therefore I also came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?”

paite: Huan Kornelia in, “Ni li ahita, tu hun bang tan in, ka inn ah, dak kuana hun thumna ah ka thum a; ngai in, ka ma ah puan vaktak silh mi khat ahong dingh a,
english: Cornelius said, “Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing

paite: 'Kornelia, na thumna zak in a-omta, mi kiang a na thilthawnpiakte leng Pathian in atheigige hi.
english: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.

paite: Huaiziak in Joppa ah Simon, Peter achih uh, sam ding in mi sawl inla, na kiang ah sam in; amah tuipi gei ah savunbawlpa Simon inn a tung ahi, amah ahong tun chiang in na kiang ah thu agen ding hi,' achi hi.
english: Send therefore to Joppa and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He is staying in the house of a tanner named Simon, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.’

paite: Huaiziak in na kiang ah mi ka hon sawl pah hi; na hong pai ahoih ahi. Huchi in Toupa'n thu ahon piak peuhmah thei ding in tu'n ah Pathian mitmuh in i vek un hiai ah i om uhi," achi hi.
english: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”

paite: Huan Peter in agen a, "Pathian in mi deihsak tuam anei kei chih, diktak in ka thei hi.
english: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;

paite: Himahleh nam chih lak ah kuapeuh amah kihtakdan siam a, diktak a gamta peuhmah, apahtak mi ahi naknak uhi.
english: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.

paite: Ama'n khamuanna tanchinhoih, Jesu Khrist tungtawn in Israel suante kiang ah agen a (amah mi tengteng Toupa ahi),
english: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—

paite: Johan in atangkou pihpih baptisma nung in, hiai tanchinhoih, Galili gam a kipan ahong thang pan a, Judia gam tengteng ah athangsuak a, noumau leng na thei uhi.
english: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

paite: Nazaret Jesu tungtang thu, huchi a Pathian in amah Kha Siangthou leh thilhihtheihna a athaunilhdan, Pathian akiang a a-om ziak in amah mi tung a thil hoih hih leh diabol gawt tengteng hihdam in avialvak vak hi.
english: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.

paite: Judate gam ah leh Jerusalem a athilhih tengteng theihpihte ka hi uh, amah sing dawn ah khai in athat uhi.
english: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.

paite: Amah Pathian in ani thum ni in akaithou nawn a, chiantak in akitheisak hi.
english: God raised him up the third day and gave him to be revealed,

paite: Himahleh mi tengteng kiang ah ahi kei, Pathian in theihpih dia asehkholhte kiang kia ah ahi koute, misi lak a kipan athohnawn nung a akiang a ne a dawnte kiang ah.
english: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

paite: Amah misi leh mihingte tung a Vaihawmpa dia Pathian seh ahi chih, mi kiang a tangkoupih leh theisak ding in Pathian in thu ahon pia hi.
english: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.

paite: Kuapeuh amah gingta amin ziak in khelhnate ngaihdam in a-om ding uh chih hiai a tanchin zawlnei tengteng in ana theihsak det uh ahi,” achi hi.
english: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”

paite: Peter in huai thu agen laitak in thuzate tengteng tung ah Kha Siangthou ahong tung hi.
english: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.

paite: Zeksumte lak a agingtate Peter hon zui peuhmah in Kha Siangthou thawnniak Zentelte tung ah leng sunbuak ahih ziak in lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
english: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.

paite: Paute a thu gen in Pathian phat in aza uhi.
english: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,

paite: Huan Peter in apuang a, "Hiai mite, eimah bang a Kha Siangthou tang sam, baptisma ding in tui zat kuama'n akham thei dia hia?" achi hi.
english: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”

paite: Huchi in Toupa min a baptisma tan ding thu apia hi. Huai khit in ni bangzah hiam taam ding in akhou uhi.
english: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.

paite: Huan Judia gam a sawltak leh unau omte'n Zentelte'n leng Pathian thu agingta uh chih azata uhi.
english: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

paite: Huchi in Peter, Jerusalem atuntouhtak in, zeksumte'n akiang ah,
english: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,

paite: "Zeksumloute inn ah lut in, akiang uah na ne," chi in akalhta uhi.
english: saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men and ate with them!”

paite: Himahleh Peter in abul a kipan in kizom zel in akiang uah ahilhchian hi.
english: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,

paite: "Joppa ah thum in ka om a, huan ihmu bang in ka om a, banghiam bawm, puan liantak bang aning li a kikhih, van a kipan khiaksuk bang in ka mu a; ka kiang ngeingei ahong tung hi.
english: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.

paite: Huai tuh ka en kilkel a, ka ngaihtuah a, 'Lei a ganhing khe li nei leh gamsate chi chih, awm a kitholh ganhingte leh tungleng vasate ka mu hi.'
english: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.

paite: Huan aw in, 'Peter, thou in; gou inla, ne in, hon chi in' ka za hi.
english: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’

paite: Himahleh ke'n, 'Toupa, hilou e, siang lou leh nin bangmah ka kam ah alut ngei kei,' ka chi hi.
english: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’

paite: Himahleh van a kipan aw in, anihveina in, 'Pathian in ahihsiangthousa nang siang lou chi ke'n,' chi in ahon dawng hi.
english: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’

paite: Huchibang ngen in thumvei ahong om a; huan bangkim van ah khaitouh in a-om nawnta hi.
english: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.

paite: Huan ngai in, mi thum Kaisaria a kipan ka kiang ah ahon sawl ua, ka omna inn kong ah ana dingh nilouh uhi.
english: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.

paite: Huan Kha in kuamah khentuam nei lou a amau zui ding in ahon sawl hi. Hiai unau guk in leng ahon zui sam ua, huai mi inn ah ka lutta uhi.
english: The Spirit told me to go with them without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house.

paite: Huan ama'n ka kiang uah, a-inn a angel kilak amuhdan leh angel in akiang a, Joppa ah mi sawl a, Simon Peter achih uh, pisak ding leh;
english: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa and get Simon, who is called Peter,

paite: 'Ama'n thu ahon hilh ding a, huai mi thu in nang leh na inkuanpihte hotdam in na om ding uh' achihdan leng ahon hilh hi.
english: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’

paite: Huan thu ka gen patleh, achil a eite tung a ahong tun bang mah in, atung uah Kha Siangthou ahong tungta hi.
english: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.

paite: Toupa thu, Johan in tui in abaptis zel; himahleh nou zaw Kha Siangthou a baptis in na om ding uh achih ka hon theikhe nawn uhi.
english: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’

paite: Huchi in Toupa Jesu Khrist i gintak ua, Pathian in thilthawnpiak ahon piak amaute kiang a apiak sam, kei Pathian sel vual ka hi a hia?" achi hi.
english: If then God gave to them the same gift as us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”

paite: Huai thu azak un adaita ua, huchi ahihleh, "Pathian in Zentelte leng hing ding a kisik phalta ahi ve maw," chi in Pathian aphat uhi.
english: When they heard these things, they held their peace and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”

paite: Huan Stephen ziak a sawina thuak dalhzakte, Phoinisia gam, Kupra tuikulh leh Antiok khua pha in apai ua, Judate kiang kia ah lou ngal kuamah kiang ah thu agen kei uhi.
english: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.

paite: Himahleh alak ua akhen tuh Kupra tuikulh leh Kurini a mite ahi ua, huai mite'n Antiok khua atun un Grikte leng ahoupih ua, Toupa Jesu tanchinhoih ahilh samta uhi.
english: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.

paite: Huan Toupa khut in amaute apanpih a; mi tampi in agingta ua, Toupa lam ahong nga chiatta uhi.
english: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.

paite: Huan atanchin thu uh Jerusalem a saptuam omte bil ah alutta a; huchi in Antiok kho pha in Barnabas asawlkhia uhi.
english: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,

paite: Amah ava tung a, Pathian hehpihdan amuh in akipak a, phatuamngaitak in Toupa len gige ding in avek un ahanthawn hi.
english: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.

paite: Barnabas mihoihtak ahi a, Kha Siangthou leh ginna a dim ahi. Huan Toupa kiang ah mi tampi a behlap in a-omta uhi.
english: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.

paite: Huan Saul zong ding in Tarsas ah Barnabas ahoh hi.
english: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.

paite: Amuh in Antiok ah ahon pi hi. Huan kum khat hilhial saptuamte kikhopna ah apang zel ua, mi tampi leng thu ahilh uhi. Antiok ah ahi nungzuite, "Khristian," achih masakpen uh.
english: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.

paite: Huai lai in zawlnei kuahiam Jerusalem a kipan in Antiok ah ahohsuk hi.
english: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

paite: Alak ua mi khat amin Agabas kichi adingh a, khovel tengteng ah kial thupitak atung dek chih Kha hilh in atheisak a; huai kial tuh Klaudias vaihawm lai in ahong tungta hi.
english: One of them named Agabus stood up and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.

paite: Huchi in nungzuite'n atheihdan chiat un Judia gam a unau omte kiang ah panpihna khak atum uhi.
english: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;

paite: Huai tuh ahihta ngei uhi, Barnabas leh Saul khut ah upate kiang ah akhak uhi.
english: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

paite: Huai lai in Kumpipa Herod in saptuamte lak a kuate hiam hihgim tum in akhut alikta hi.
english: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.

paite: Huan Jakob, Johan unau, namsau in asatlum hi.
english: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.

paite: Huai in Judate akipaksak chih atheih in, Peter leng mat atum zel hi. Huai ni tuh Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ni ahi.
english: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.

paite: Huan amat nung in suangkul ah akhum a, sepaih pawl li, li chiat zel in, akivenkhelsak hi; Paikan Ankuanglui nung in mi tengteng kiang ah pikhiak atum hi.
english: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.

paite: Huaiziak in suangkul ah Peter a-omsak tadih hi; himahleh, saptuamte'n amah a ding in phatuamngaitak in Pathian kiang ah athumsak uhi.
english: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.

paite: Herod in apikhiak ding zan in sepaih nih kikal ah khainiang nih bun in Peter a-ihmu a; avengte kongkhak bul a om in suangkul aveng uhi.
english: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.

paite: Ngai in, Toupa angel khat akiang ah ahong dingh a, suangkul sung ah vak ahong tang hi; huan Peter nak ah abenghalh a, "Thou meng in," achi hi. Huan akhut a kipan khainiangte atolhkhesuk hi.
english: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Stand up quickly!” His chains fell off his hands.

paite: Huan angel in akiang ah, "Na puan silh inla, na khetuam bun in," achi hi. Huan ama'n huchibang in ahih hi. Angel in akiang ah, "Na puan silhhoih inla, hon zui in,” achi hi.
english: The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak and follow me.”

paite: Huan Peter apawt a azuita hi, angel tatdan atak hia ahih athei kei, mengmu bang a amuh hiam akisa hi.
english: And he went out and followed him. He didn’t know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.

paite: Huan chingmi masa leh azom akhen nung un, khopi lutna sik kongpi ava tung ua, huai tuh amau a ding in akihong tawmta hi; huan apawt ua, kongzing khat akheng ua; huai a kipan angel in amah paisanta hi.
english: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.

paite: Huan Peter ahalhtak in, "Herod khut leh Juda mite lametna tengteng a kipan a hunkhe ding a Toupa'n a-angel hon sawlkhia ahi chih tu in diktak in ka theita," achi hi.
english: When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.”

paite: Huan akingaihtuah khit in, Johan, Marka achih uh, huai nu Mari inn ah ava hoh a; huai ah thum in mi tampi ana omkhawm uhi.
english: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.

paite: Kongpi kongkhak a kiuhtak in, nungak khat amin Rhoda, adawng ding in ava hoh hi.
english: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer.

paite: Peter aw azaktak in akipah ziak in kong hon lou in atailut nawn a, kongkhak bul ah Peter adingh chih ava gen hi.
english: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she didn’t open the gate for joy, but ran in and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.

paite: Himahleh amau akiang ah, "Ahai na hita ve," ana chi uhi. Ama'n bel, "Hi petmah ahi," chi in apang teitei hi. Amau, “A-angel hi in teh," achi lai uhi.
english: They said to her, “You are crazy!” But she insisted that it was so. They said, “It is his angel.”

paite: Himahleh Peter in kongkhak akiukiu a; ahon ualeh amah amu ua, lamdang asa uhi.
english: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him and were amazed.

paite: Huchi in ama'n amaute dai ding in akhutvan a, Pathian in suangkul a kipan amah apikhiakdan ahilhta hi. "Hiai thute Jakob leh unaute kiang ah va hilh un," achi hi. Huan apawt a mun dang ah ava pai hi.
english: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, “Tell these things to James and to the brothers.” Then he departed and went to another place.

paite: Ni ahong suahtak in, Peter tung a bang thil tung hiam, chi in buai chihtak in sepaihte abuai uhi.
english: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.

paite: Huan Herod in amah azong a amu kei, avengtute a-enchian a, thah ding in thu apeta hi. Huan Judia gam a kipan Kaisaria ah ahohsuk a, huai ah a-om nilouh hi.
english: When Herod had sought for him and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.

paite: Huan Tura leh Sidon a mite tung ah Herod alung hi kei mahmah hi; amau thukhat sat in Blastas, kumpipa lupna ngakpa, alawm in abawl ua, kumpipa kiang ah hong pai ua, amah a kipan nek-le-dawn ngah zel ahih ziak un akholamte uh toh kilemna angen uhi.
english: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.

paite: Huan ani chiam ni in kumpipa Herod in kumpi puan asilha, alaltutphah a tu in akiang uah thu agen hi.
english: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.

paite: Mi tengteng in, "Hiai pathian aw ahi, mihing aw ahi kei," achi ua, akikou zuazua uhi.
english: The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”

paite: Ama'n Pathian kiang a thupina apiak louh ziak in Toupa Angel in amah aman pah a, hut in ane a, asita hi.
english: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.

paite: Pathian thu bel adalh a, apung zel hi.
english: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

paite: Barnabas leh Saul in nna asep khit un, Jerusalem a kipan akik nawnta ua, Johan, amin dang Marka achih uh leng atonpih uhi.
english: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.

paite: Antiok a saptuam omte lak ah zawlnei leh thuhilhmi kuate hiam a-om ua; huaite Barnabas, Niger achih uh Simeon, Kurini khomi Lusias, kumpipa Herod toh khangkhawm Manaen leh Saul ahi uhi.
english: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

paite: Huan Toupa nna sem a an angolh lai un, Kha Siangthou in, "Barnabas leh Saul ka sapna nna sem ding in kei a ding in hon koihtuamsak un," achi hi.
english: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.”

paite: Huchi in an angawl ua, athum khit un atung uah akhut uh akoih ua, apaisakta uhi.
english: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

paite: Huchi in Kha Siangthou sawlkhiak in apai ua, Seliusia ah ahohsuk ua, huai a kipan in Kupra tuikulh ah long in apai uhi.
english: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.

paite: Salamis a a-om lai un Judate sinagog ah Pathian thu agen ua; Johan leng amaute panpih ding in atonpih uhi.
english: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They also had John as their attendant.

paite: Huan tuikulh gam Paphos kho pha in anawksuak ua, bumsiam, zawlnei tak lou, Juda mi khat amu ua, amin tuh Bar Jesu ahi.
english: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar Jesus,

paite: Huai mi gam-ukpa Serjia Paulus, mipiltak kiang a om ahi. Huai gam-ukpa'n Barnabas leh Saul asam a, Pathian thu zak atum hi.
english: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.

paite: Himahleh bumsiam Elimas, (huai tuh ama minkhiakna ahi a), amau nasep dal in ginna a kipan gam-ukpa heimang atum hi.
english: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.

paite: Huchi in Saul, Paul leng kichi; Kha Siangthou in adim a, amah a-ensal hi.
english: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him

paite: "Nang, mi khem leh huathuai chiteng a dim diabol tapa, diktatna tengteng melmapa aw, Toupa lam diktatte hihsiat na tawp kei ding maw?
english: and said, “You son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

paite: Thei in, tu in Toupa khut na tung ah atu hi, na mit ahong taw ding a, bang tan hiam khovak na mu kei ding," achi hi. Huchi in khomui leh mial in amah akhuh pah a, khut a kai ding mi zong in amai puampuam hi.
english: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

paite: Huan gam-ukpa'n huai thilhih amu a, Toupa sinsakna lamdang asa mahmah a, agingtata hi.
english: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.

paite: Paul, atonpihte toh Paphos a kipan in long in apai ua, Pamphilia gam a Perga khua atung uhi; huai ah Johan in amaute paisan in, Jerusalem ah akiksan hi.
english: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.

paite: Himahleh amau Perga a kipan apai zel ua, Pisidia gam a Antiok khua atung uhi; huan Sabbath ni in sinagog ah alut ua, atu uhi.
english: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.

paite: Dan leh zawlneite laibu asim khit un, sinagog upate'n akiang uah mi asawl ua, "Unaute aw, mite hanthawnna thu banghiam na neih uleh gen un," achi uhi.
english: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.”

paite: Huan Paul adingh a, akhut a zap in agen a, “Israel mite leh Pathian laudan siamte aw, ngai un.
english: Paul stood up, and gesturing with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.

paite: Hiai Israel chite Pathian in i pipute atel a, Aigupta gam a ataam lai un ahih thupi mahmah a, ban thahat in amaute huai a kipan in apikheta hi.
english: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.

paite: Huan kum sawmli gamdai ah athilhihte uh athuak teitei hi.
english: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.

paite: Kanaan gam a nam sagihte ahihsiat khit in, agam uh aisan a hawm in, aluah ding un apia hi.
english: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years.

paite: Huaite nung kum zali-le-sawmnga sung teng, zawlnei Samuel hun tan in vaihawmte ape zel hi.
english: After these things, he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.

paite: Huan huai nung in kumpipa angen ua; Pathian in, Saul kichi, Benjamin nam a Kish tapa, kum sawmli sung amau apia hi.
english: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.

paite: Amah asuanmang nung in akumpipa ding un David abawlta hi; Pathian in huai thu theisak in, David, Jesse tapa, ka lungtang bang pumi ka mukheta, ama'n ka deihlam ahih ding," achi hi.
english: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’

paite: Hiai mi suan a kipan in Pathian in athuchiam bang in Israelte kiang ah Hondampa, Jesu kichi ahon dinkhia hi.
english: From this man’s offspring, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,

paite: Amah ahong pai ma in Johan in kisikna baptisma thu Israel mi tengteng kiang ah ana hilh masa hi.
english: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.

paite: Huan Johan in asep ding azoh kuan in, "Noute'n kei kua na hon sa ua? Amah zaw ka hi kei hi. Himahleh ngai un, ka nung ah mi khat ahong pai dek, kei zaw akhepek a khetuam phel tak leng ka hi kei,” achi hi.
english: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’

paite: "Mite leh unaute, Abraham suante leh Pathian laudan siam Zentelte tengteng aw, noute kiang ah hiai hotdamna thu piak in a-omta hi.
english: “Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.

paite: Jerusalem a omte leh amakaite un, amah atheih louh ziak ua siam louh atansak lai un, zawlneite thute Sabbath teng a asimte uh tangtungsak ana hi uhi.
english: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.

paite: Asihna ding khop atung a bangmah amuh louh nung un leng, Pilat kiang ah hihlup ding in angen uhi.
english: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.

paite: Huan athu zawlneite'n agelhkholh tengteng uh ahihtangtun khit un, sing a kipan in alakhia ua, han ah asialta uhi.
english: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.

paite: Himahleh Pathian in misi lak a kipan akaithou nawnta hi.
english: But God raised him from the dead,

paite: Huchi in Galili gam a kipan Jerusalem a amah toh hohtoute kiang ah ni sawtpi akilak a; huai mite mah mi kiang a athu theihpihte ahi uhi.
english: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.

paite: Kou leng pipute kiang ah huai thuchiam a Tanchin kipahhuai ka hon puangzak uhi.
english: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,

paite: Huchi a Pathian in Jesu akaihthoh, ei atate kiang ah huai thuchiam tuh ahihtangtung hi. Sam nihna ah, 'Nang zaw ka tapa na hi a, tuni in ka hon neikhia hi,' chih gelh bang in.
english: that God has fulfilled this to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son. Today I have become your father.’

paite: Muatna mun a pai nawn lou ding in Pathian in amah misi lak a kipan akaihthohdan ding hiai bang in agen hi, David kiang a hehpihna ka chiamte nangmah ka hon pe ding," chi in.
english: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’

paite: "Huaiziak in Sam dang ah, 'Na Mi Siangthou muatmang na phal kei ding,' achi behlap hi.
english: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’

paite: David zaw, Pathian vai hawmsak bang in ama khang hun a nna asep khit in, a-ihmu a, apipute kiang ah asial ua, amuatmangta hi.
english: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.

paite: Himahleh Pathian kaihthoh pen in zaw muatna amu kei hi.
english: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.

paite: Huchi in unaute aw thei un; amah ziak in khelhna ngaihdamna thu na kiang ua gen ahi.
english: Be it known to you therefore, brothers, that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins;

paite: Kuapeuh agingta tuh bangkim ah amah siamtansak in a-om, huai lah Mosi Dan in siamtansak in na om thei kei uhi.
english: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.

paite: Huaiziak in pilvang un, huchi lou in zaw zawlneite a agen uh na tung uah ahong tung kha ding hi."
english: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:

paite: "Musitte aw, en un, lamdang sa unla, mangthang un; na damsung un nna khat ka sem hi, huai nna mi'n hon hilh mah le uh, na gingta kei hial ding uhi, chih," achi hi.
english: ‘Behold, you scoffers! Wonder and perish, for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe, if one declares it to you.’”

paite: Huan apawt un, Sabbath nawn chiang a huai thute gen nawn ding in angen uhi.
english: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.

paite: Huan omkhawmte akikhentak un, Judate leh phungkaite Pathian limsak lak a mi tampi in Paul leh Barnabas azui zel ua; amau ana houpih ua, Pathian hehpihna a om gige ding in ahanthawn uhi.
english: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.

paite: Huan Sabbath nawn in akhozang phial un Pathian thu ngaikhe ding in ahong kikhawm uhi.
english: The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.

paite: Himahleh Judate'n mipite amuhtak un ahaza mahmah ua; Paul thugente kalh in agensia uhi.
english: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.

paite: Huchi in Paul leh Barnabas in hangsantak in adawng ua, "Pathian thu noumau kiang ah gen masak ding him ahi; himahleh na nial ua, tangtawn a hing tak lou a na kiseh nung un, thei un, Zentelte lam ka ngata uh," achi uhi.
english: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from yourselves, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.

paite: Huchibang in Toupa'n thu ahon pia hi, "Zentelte hihvakpa ding in ka hon sep a, kawlmong pha a Hondampa dia na omtheihna ding in, chih gelh bang in,” achi hi.
english: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.’”

paite: Zentelte'n huai thu azak un, akipak ua, Toupa thu apahtawi ua, tangtawn a hing ding a sehkholh peuhmah in agingta uhi.
english: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.

paite: Toupa thu huai gam kimvel ah adalhta hi.
english: The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.

paite: Himahleh Judate'n numei zahtakhuai Pathian limsakte leh kho upate hanthawn in, Paul leh Barnabas soisasak in, agam ua kipan adelhkhia uhi.
english: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.

paite: Amau leng atung uah akhepek ua leivui asingkhia ua, Ikoniam ah apaita uhi.
english: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.

paite: Huan nungzuite kipahna leh Kha Siangthou in adim chiat uhi.
english: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.

paite: Ikoniam ah Judate sinagog ah alutkhawm ua, thu agen zel uhi, huchi in Judate leh Grik mipi tampi in leng agingtata uhi.
english: In Iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.

paite: Himahleh agingta nuam lou Judate'n Zentelte lungsim atokthou ua, unaute ahosak uhi.
english: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa ah hangtak a thu gen in huai ah sawt sim a-om uhi. Ama'n chiamtehna leh thillamdangte akhut ua hihsak in, ahehpihna thu atheisak zel hi.
english: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

paite: Himahleh khua a mipite akilangta ua, akhen in Judate agum ua, akhen in sawltakte agum uhi.
english: But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews and part with the apostles.

paite: Zentelte leh Judate aheutute uh toh pangkhawm in sawltakte simmohhuaitak a bawl a suang a den atup lai un,
english: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,

paite: amau ana thei ua, Likonia gam mah, Listra leh Darbi ah leh akim gam ah ataimang uhi.
english: they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.

paite: Huai ah tanchinhoih agen zom zel uhi.
english: There they preached the Good News.

paite: Listra ah khezaw kuahiam atu a, apian tung a pan khebai him ahi a, khe in apai ngei kei hi.
english: At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked.

paite: Huai mi'n Paul thugen angaikhia a; huan Paul in a-en gegu a, damna ding in ginna anei chih athei a, aw ngaihtak in, “Na khe in dingtang in,” achi hi.
english: He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,

paite: Huan amah atawm a, khe in apaita hi.
english: said with a loud voice, “Stand upright on your feet!” He leaped up and walked.

paite: Mipite'n Paul thilhih amuh un, Likonia pau in aw ngaihtak in, “Mihing melpu in i kiang uah pathiante ahong sukta uh e!" achi uhi.
english: When the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!”

paite: Amaute'n Barnabas pen, "Jupiter" achi ua, Paul bel thugenpi pen ahih ziak in, "Hermes" achi uhi.
english: They called Barnabas “Jupiter”, and Paul “Mercury”, because he was the chief speaker.

paite: Huan Jupiter siampu, khopi lutna a atempul om in, bawngtalte leh pakkhigui limte kongpi ah ahon tawi a, mipite toh biakna ding in lat atum uhi.
english: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes.

paite: Himahleh sawltak Barnabas leh Paul in huai azak un, apuan uh abotkek ua, mipi lak ah adianglut ua, akikou uhi.
english: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they tore their clothes and sprang into the multitude, crying out,

paite: "Pute aw, hiai thilte bangziak a hih na hi ua? Kou leng noumau hindan toh kibang pu, mihing ka hi ve ua le; hiai thil ginaloute na kiheisan ua, van, lei, tuipi leh asung ua om tengteng bawlpa Pathian hing kiang a na hong kiheina ding un tanchinhoih ka hon tun uhi.
english: “Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men of the same nature as you, and bring you good news, that you should turn from these vain things to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

paite: Pathian in nidanglai in nam chih amau lampi chiat zuih aphal hi.
english: who in the generations gone by allowed all the nations to walk in their own ways.

paite: Himahleh amah theihsakna om lou in akibawl kei, huchi in thil ahihhoih zel a, van a kipan in vuahtui ahon pia a, na lungtang uh nek ding leh kipahna a hihdim gige akei hiam," achi uhi.
english: Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.”

paite: Huchi in huai thu in mipite'n amaute biakna dia gan agoh ding uh akhamzou teitei hi.
english: Even saying these things, they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them.

paite: Himahleh Antiok leh Ikoniam ah Juda mi kuate hiam ahong ua, mipite akhempukta uhi; huchi in suang in Paul adeng ua, si hi a agintak ziak un khua a kipan akaikhia uhi.
english: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.

paite: Himahleh nungzuite akim a adin lai un, ahong thou a, khua ah alut nawnta hi. Huan azing in Barnabas toh Darbi ah apaita uhi.
english: But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.

paite: Huan huai khuate kiang ah tanchinhoih ahilh ua, nungzui tampi abawl nung un Listra, Ikoniam leh Antiok khua ah akik nawn uhi.
english: When they had preached the Good News to that city and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,

paite: Gim tampi thuak in Pathian lalgam i lut ding ahi him ahi, chi in nungzuite lungsim ahihkip ua, ginna a om gige ding in ahanthawn uhi.
english: strengthening the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into God’s Kingdom.

paite: Huan saptuam pawl teng ah upate asehsak ua, an ngawl kawm a athum khit un, agin uh Toupa kiang ah akemsak zelzel uhi.
english: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord on whom they had believed.

paite: Pisidia gam atawnsuak ua, Pamphilia gam atung uhi.
english: They passed through Pisidia and came to Pamphylia.

paite: Perga a thu agen khit un Attalia ah ahohsuk uhi.
english: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.

paite: Huai a kipan in long in apawt ua, Antiok khua ahong tung nawnta uhi. Huai mun ahi tua athilhih khitsa uh hih ding a unaute'n Pathian hehpihna a kemsak a asawlkhiakna uh.
english: From there they sailed to Antioch, from where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.

paite: Huan a tun nung un asaptuamte asamkhawm ua, Pathian in, amaute zang a athilhihte leh Zentelte a dia ginna kongkhak ahonsakdan ahilh uhi.
english: When they had arrived and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.

paite: Huan nungzuite kiang ah sawt sim a-om uhi.
english: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.

paite: Mi kuate hiam Judia gam a kipan in ahong suk ua unaute kiang ah, "Mosi Dan bang a zek na sum kei uleh hotdam na hi thei kei ding uh," chi in ahong gen uhi.
english: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t be saved.”

paite: Huchi in Paul leh Barnabas in amaute kalh in nakpitak a kisel a akilan ziak un, huai thubuai tungtang a Jerusalem a sawltakliante leh upate va mu ding in Paul leh Barnabas, leh alak ua kuate hiam asep uhi.
english: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul, Barnabas, and some others of them to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.

paite: Huchi in saptuamte'n ava kha ua, amau Zentelte hong kikhekdan thu gen zel in, Phoinisia gam leh Samaria gam atawnsuakta uh; huchi in unaute tengteng akipaksak mahmah uhi.
english: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.

paite: Jerusalem atuntouh un saptuam pawlte, sawltakte, upate'n ana kipahpih ua; Pathian in amau zang a athilhihte apuangkhe zelzel uhi.
english: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported everything that God had done with them.

paite: Himahleh Pharisai pawl a mi gingta kuate hiam akisa ua, "Zentelte zeksum ding leh Mosi Dan azuih chiat ding uh ahi," achi uhi.
english: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.”

paite: Huan sawltakliante leh upate, huai thu ngaihtuah ding in akikhawm uhi.
english: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.

paite: Nakpi a akisel nung un Peter adingtou a, akiang uah, "Mite leh unaute aw, Zentelte'n keimah kam a tanchinhoih thu za a gingta ding a, Pathian in nidanglai a na lak ua kipan ahon sehdan na thei uhi.
english: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News and believe.

paite: Lungsim theipa Pathian in eite hon piak bang mah in Kha Siangthou akiang ua pe sam in atung uah akipak chih atheisak hi.
english: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.

paite: Huan eite leh amau khentuam nei lou in ginna in alungsim uh ahihsiangthou hi.
english: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.

paite: Huchi in i pipute leh eite'n i zuih zoh louhsa hakkol, tu'n ah nungzuite tung a ngak tum a bangziak a Pathian kalh na hi ua?
english: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

paite: Amau gintak bang mah in eite'n leng Toupa Jesu hehpihna ziak a hotdam ding hi in i kigingta ngal ua,” achi hi.
english: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.”

paite: Barnabas leh Paul in, amaute zang a Pathian in Zentelte lak a chiamtehna leh thillamdang ahih thu agen lai un mipite'n ngaikhia in adai sipsip uhi.
english: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.

paite: Huchi a mipite adaih sipsip zoh un Jakob in adawng a, “Unaute aw, ka thu ngaikhia un, chi in agen sam hi.
english: After they were silent, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me.

paite: Simeon in, Pathian in amah min pu ding leh alak ua kipan mite lakhe ding in Zentelte aveh tungthu agenta hi.
english: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations to take out of them a people for his name.

paite: Huai thu leh zawlneite thu, gelh a omsa toh akituak hi.
english: This agrees with the words of the prophets. As it is written,

paite: Huai khit chiang in ka kik nawn ding a, David biakbuk chimsia ka bawl nawn ding a, asiatna lai ka puah ding a, ka tungding nawn ding.
english: ‘After these things I will return. I will again build the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will again build its ruins. I will set it up

paite: Midang akhosuaksunte leh ka min pu Zentelte ka min kikoppihte'n, Toupa azonna ding un huai thilte tengteng ahihta hi," chi in.
english: that the rest of men may seek after the Lord: all the Gentiles who are called by my name, says the Lord, who does all these things.’

paite: "Khovel siamchil a kipan hiai thu theisakpa Toupa'n achi," chih gelh ahi.
english: “All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.

paite: "Huaiziak in Zentelte lak a Pathian lam ngate hihgim kei ni chih ka thusawm ahi.
english: Therefore my judgment is that we don’t trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God,

paite: Milim biakna in abuahsak thilsiang lou, kingaihna nin, sa heklup leh sisan nek atawpsanna ding un akiang uah laigelh zaw lehang, ka chi pen hi.
english: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.

paite: Mosi Dan lah nidanglai a kipan kho teng ah athu tangkoupih ahih ban ah sinagog peuh ah Sabbath niteng in athu sim ahi,” achi hi.
english: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath.”

paite: Huan sawltakte, upate, saptuam tengteng toh, apawl ua mitel, Paul leh Barnabas kiang ah Antiok a hohsak hoih asa ua; atelte uh min Judas, Barnabas achih uh leh Silas ahi ua, huai mite unaute lak a heutu deuhte ahi uhi.
english: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers.

paite: Hichibang in agelh ua, akhut uah akhak uh: "Sawltakte leh unaute lak a upate'n Antiok khua, Siria gam leh Silisia gam a Zentel unaute chibai abuk uhi.
english: They wrote these things by their hand: “The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.

paite: Ka pawl lak ua mi kuate hiam in noute kiang a thu gen in, zeksum ding leh Mosi Dan zui ding in ahon hihbuai ua, na lungsim uh ahon mangbangsak uh chih ka za ua, amaute hiai thu gen ding in ka sawl kei uhi.
english: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, ‘You must be circumcised and keep the law,’ to whom we gave no commandment;

paite: Huaiziak in thukhat sat a ka kikhop un, ka deihtak uh Barnabas leh Paul,
english: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

paite: Toupa Jesu Khrist min ziak a sih khawk saloute toh, mitelte na kiang ua hon sawl hoih ka sa uhi.
english: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Huchi in Judas leh Silas ka hon sawl uhi, amau leng hiai thu mah kam in ahon hilh ding uhi.
english: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.

paite: Hiai thu poimohte ka gelhte uh chih louh ngal Kha Siangthou leh koute'n puakgik tuan na tung uah bangmah nga kei le ung hoih ka sa uhi.
english: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things:

paite: Milim biakna sa nek, sa sisan nek leh kingaih tawpsan le uchin ka chi uhi; hiaite na tawp uleh nou a ding in ahoih ding hi. Damtak in om un,” chi in.
english: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.”

paite: Huchi in asawl un akuan ua, Antiok khua atungsuk ua; mipi asamkhawm ua, lai apia uhi.
english: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.

paite: Huan asim khit un lungmuanna thu ziak in akipak mahmahta uhi.
english: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.

paite: Judas leh Silas in, zawlnei leng ahi ua, thu tampi in unaute akhamuan ua, ahihkip uhi.
english: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.

paite: Huan huai a sawt khop a-om nung un amau sawltakte kiang apai nawn ding in, unaute'n khamuangtak in apawtsak nawnta uhi.
english: After they had spent some time there, they were dismissed in peace from the brothers to the apostles.

paite: Paul leh Barnabas bel midang tampite toh Antiok ah Toupa thuhilh leh gen in a-om nilouh uhi.
english: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

paite: Huan ni bangzah hiam nung in Paul in Barnabas kiang ah, "Kho teng a Toupa thu i genna peuh a unau omte va veh nawn in, a-omdan uh va en lehang," achi hi.
english: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”

paite: Barnabas in Johan, Marka achih uh, akiang ua tonpih atum hi.
english: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.

paite: Himahleh Paul in bel, ama'n Pamphilia gam a amaute kiksan a, nasepna a akiang ua ahoh louh ziak in tonpih hoih asa kei hi.
english: But Paul didn’t think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn’t go with them to do the work.

paite: Huchi in nakpi in akiselta ua, huan akikhen ua Barnabas in Marka atonpih a, Kupra tuikulh lam ah long in apaita hi.
english: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,

paite: Paul in Silas atel a, unaute'n Toupa hehpihna akepsak nung un apaikheta uhi.
english: but Paul chose Silas and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.

paite: Huan saptuam pawlte hihkip zel in Siria leh Silisia gam atawnsuak uhi.
english: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.

paite: Huchi in Darbi khua leh Listra ah leng ahoh a; huai ah nungzui khat amin Timothi a-om hi. Amah gingta Juda numei tapa, apa bel Grik ahi;
english: He came to Derbe and Lystra; and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed, but his father was a Greek.

paite: Listra leh Ikoniam khua a unau omte'n amah aphat mahmah uhi.
english: The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him.
