paite: Paul in akiang a hoh sam ding in adeih a; huchi in huai a Juda omte ziak in zek asumsak a, apa Grik ahi chih lah athei vek ngal ua.
english: Paul wanted to have him go out with him, and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.

paite: Kho teng a apai kawm un Jerusalem a sawltak leh Upa omte vaihawm zui ding in unaute kiang ah thupiak zuih ding ape zel uhi.
english: As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in ginna ah saptuam pawlte akipta ua, niteng in akhang deuhdeuh uhi.
english: So the assemblies were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.

paite: Huan Kha Siangthou in Asia gam a thugen akham ziak in Phrigia leh Galatia gam a tawnsuakta uhi.
english: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.

paite: Misia gam ahong tun nung un, Bithinia gam lut atum ua; himahleh Jesu Kha in aphal kei hi.
english: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn’t allow them.

paite: Huchi in Misia gam tawn in Troas ah ahohsukta uhi.
english: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.

paite: Zan in Paul in mengmu bang in Masidonia gam a mi khat dingh a, "Masidonia gam ah hong galkai inla, hong huh in," chi a thumthum in amu hi.
english: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him and saying, “Come over into Macedonia and help us.”

paite: Huan huai mengmuhna aneih khit in akiang ua tanchinhoih gen ding in Pathian in hon sam ahi, chih kichiantak a thei in, Masidonia gam ah hoh ka tum pah uhi.
english: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.

paite: Huan Troas a kipan long in ka pawt ua, tangtak in Samothrasi ah ka pai ua, azing in Neapoli ah ka pai nawn uh;
english: Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;

paite: huai a kipan in Phillippi ah ka pai ua, huai khua tuh Masidonia gam a khua khat Rome a mipemte khua ahi a, huai uk a kho poimohpen ahi. Huai khua ah ni tamsim ka tamta uhi.
english: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.

paite: Huan Sabbath ni in kulh kongpi polam lui gei ah, thumna mun hi a ka gintakna uah ka hoh ua; huan ka tu ua, numei hong paikhawmte kiang ah thu ka gen uhi.
english: On the Sabbath day we went outside of the city by a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down and spoke to the women who had come together.

paite: Huan amin Lidia, puan sandup zuak, Thiatira khomi, Pathian bia numei khat in ka thu uh aza a; huan Paul thugen zui ding in Toupa'n alungtang ahonsak hi.
english: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us. The Lord opened her heart to listen to the things which were spoken by Paul.

paite: Amah leh a-inkuanpihte'n baptisma atan khit un, "Toupa a ginom a na hon seh uleh ka inn ah hong tung un," chi in ahon ngen a, ahon khou hi.
english: When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and stay.” So she persuaded us.

paite: Huan thumna mun a ka hoh lai un, sikha nungak kuahiam dawi aisan siam zawl in ahon kituahpih a, ama'n a-aisan ziak in apute sum tampi amuhsak zel hi.
english: As we were going to prayer, a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling.

paite: Huai mi in Paul leh kou ahon zui a, “Hiai mite, hotdamna lampi nou hon hilhte, tungnungpen Pathian sikha ahi uh," chi in akikou hi.
english: Following Paul and us, she cried out, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us a way of salvation!”

paite: Huchibang in ni tampi ahih hi. Huchi in Paul alungkimta kei a, akihei a dawi kiang ah, "Jesu Khrist min in asung a kipan pawt thu ka hon pia,” achi hi. Huchi in ahong pawtkhe pah hi.
english: She was doing this for many days. But Paul, becoming greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, “I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her!” It came out that very hour.

paite: Huan apute'n asummuhna uh amang chih atheihtak un, Paul leh Silas aman ua, heutute ma ah dawr mun ah akailut uhi.
english: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.

paite: Huchi in vaihawmte kiang ah api ua, “Hiai mite Judate ahi uh, ka khua uh ahihbuai mahmah uhi.
english: When they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, “These men, being Jews, are agitating our city

paite: Rome mite a dia kipahpih huai lou leh zuih siangloute chindan agengen uh," achi uhi.
english: and advocate customs which it is not lawful for us to accept or to observe, being Romans.”

paite: Huchi in mipite sawltakte sual ding in ahong dingkhia ua, vaihawmte'n apuan uh asahkeksak ua, chiang a sat ding in thu apia uhi.
english: The multitude rose up together against them and the magistrates tore their clothes from them, then commanded them to be beaten with rods.

paite: Huan tamveipi asat khit un suangkul ah akhum ua, avengpa kiang ah bittak a ven ding, achi bikbek uhi.
english: When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely.

paite: Huchi tel a thu apiak ziak un ama'n tanna sungnung ah akhum a, akhe uh singkol abunsak hi.
english: Having received such a command, he threw them into the inner prison and secured their feet in the stocks.

paite: Himahleh zan lai in, Pathian kiang ah Paul leh Silas athum ua, la asa ua, hentate'n angaikhia uhi.
english: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.

paite: Thakhat in zin nakpitak in ahong ling a, huchi in suangkul suangphumte tan in alingsak a, kongkhak tengteng akihong pah a, saltang chih kolbutte akiphel vekta hi.
english: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone’s bonds were loosened.

paite: Huan asuangkul vengpa ihmu ahong halh a, suangkul kongkhakte kihong in amu a, hentate taimang uh asa a, anamsau adokkhia a, kithah atum hi.
english: The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.

paite: Himahleh aw ngaihtak in Paul akikou a, "Bangmah kichih ke'n, ka vek un hiai ah ka om lai uh," achi hi.
english: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, “Don’t harm yourself, for we are all here!”

paite: Huan suangkul vengpa'n khawnvakte azong a, asung a tawmlut in, ling kawm in Paul leh Silas ma ah abokkhup hi.
english: He called for lights, sprang in, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,

paite: Amaute apikhia a, "Pute aw, hotdam a ka omna ding in bang ahia ka hih ding?" achi hi.
english: brought them out, and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”

paite: Huan amau, "Toupa Jesu ging inla, huchi in hotdam in na om ding, nang leh na inkuanpihte toh," achi uhi.
english: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”

paite: Amah leh a-inn a om teng kiang ah Toupa thu agen uhi.
english: They spoke the word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his house.

paite: Huai zan lai mah in apikhia a, asatna golhte uh asilsiangsak a; amah leh a-inkuanpihte tengteng in baptisma atang uhi.
english: He took them the same hour of the night and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.

paite: A-inn ah apitou a nek ding alui a, Pathian agintak ziak un, amah leh a-inkuanpihte, akipak mahmah uhi.
english: He brought them up into his house and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly with all his household, having believed in God.

paite: Khua ahong vak in vaihawmte'n, mimante sawl in, “Huai mite khah in," achi uhi.
english: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, “Let those men go.”

paite: Suangkul vengpa'n, Paul kiang ah athu uh ahilh a, "Vaihawmte'n nou khah ding in mi ahon sawl uh; huaiziak in tu'n hong pawt unla, khamuangtak in paita un," achi hi.
english: The jailer reported these words to Paul, saying, “The magistrates have sent to let you go; now therefore come out and go in peace.”

paite: Himahleh Paul in akiang uah, "Rome khomi ka hi ngal ua, ka siamna uleh siamlouhna uh thei lou in vantang mitmuh in na hon sat ua, suangkul ah na hon khum ua; tua aguk a hon khah maw na hon sawm uh? Hilou! Amau mahmah hong uhenla, hong pikhia uhen," achi hi.
english: But Paul said to them, “They have beaten us publicly without a trial, men who are Romans, and have cast us into prison! Do they now release us secretly? No, most certainly, but let them come themselves and bring us out!”

paite: Huchi in mimante'n huai thute vaihawmte kiang ah ahilh uhi. Rome mi ahi uh chih azak un alauta mahmah uhi.
english: The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans,

paite: Va hoh in thupha ava tawi ua, huan apikhia ua, khua pawtsan ding in angen uhi.
english: and they came and begged them. When they had brought them out, they asked them to depart from the city.

paite: Huan suangkul a kipan apawt ua, Lidia inn ah alut uhi. Unaute amuh un, akhamuan ua, apawtta uhi.
english: They went out of the prison and entered into Lydia’s house. When they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them, then departed.

paite: Amphipolis khua leh Appolonia khua tawn in, Thessalonika khua atungta ua, huai ah Judate sinagog a-om hi.
english: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.

paite: Paul, adan ngeina bang in, akiang uah alut a, Sabbath ni thumvei Laisiangthou a kipan in teltak in asutpih hi.
english: Paul, as was his custom, went in to them; and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,

paite: Khrist in gimthuak ding him ahihdan leh misi lak a kipan a thounawn ding ahihdan hilhchian in, ahihlang zel hi. "Hiai Jesu, athu ka hon hilh, amah Khrist ahi," chi in agen behlap hi.
english: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, “This Jesus, whom I proclaim to you, is the Christ.”

paite: Huchi in alak ua khenkhat in agingta ua, Pathian limsak Grik mipi tampitak leh numei makai tampi toh Paul leh Silas akithuahpihta uhi.
english: Some of them were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas: of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and not a few of the chief women.

paite: Himahleh gingta lou Judate'n ahaza ua; dawr mun a migilou thadah kuate hiam akiang uah atonpih ua, mipi samkhawm in kho pumpi atokbuai ua, Jason inn aluh ua, vantang kiang a pikhiak atum uhi.
english: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.

paite: Amau amuh louhtak un Jason leh unau dang kuate hiam kho heutute kiang ah akailut ua, akikou ua, "Khovel tokbuai a lumlette hiai ah ahong uh,
english: When they didn’t find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers before the rulers of the city, crying, “These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,

paite: Jason in ana zintun a; hiai mite'n Kaisar vaihawmna kalh in kumpipa dang khat, amin Jesu a-om," achi uhi.
english: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!”

paite: Huan mipi leh kho heutute'n huai thu azak un abuaita uhi.
english: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.

paite: Jason leh midangte tatkhiakna ding banghiam ala ua, amau tuh akhahta uhi.
english: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.

paite: Huan unaute'n azanzan in Beriah ah Paul leh Silas apaisak pah ua; huai lai ava tun un Judate sinagog ah alut uhi.
english: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.

paite: Huai mite Thessalonika khote sang in ana hoihzaw ua, huchi in lungsim kipaktak in thu apom ua, athugen uh adik leh diklouh theihna ding in niteng in Laisiangthou azong zel uhi.
english: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.

paite: Huchi in huaite mi tampi in agingtata ua; Grik numei zahtakhuai leh pasalte leng tampi mahmah in agingtata uhi.
english: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.

paite: Himahleh Thessalonika a Judate'n, Paul in Beriah ah Pathian thu agen chih azaktak un, huai ah leng ava hoh ua, mipite hanthawn in, ahihbuai nawn uhi.
english: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.

paite: Huchi in unaute'n tuipi tan a pai ding in Paul asawlkhia ua, Silas leh Timothi bel huai ah a-om tadih uhi.
english: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.

paite: Paul pitute'n Athen khua tan in api ua; Silas leh Timothi kintak a akiang a hong pai ding thupiak toh apaikikta uhi.
english: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.

paite: Huan Paul in Athen a amau ana ngak lai in, huai khua milimte a dim in amu a, alungtang in na asa mahmah hi.
english: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.

paite: Huchi in sinagog ah Judate leh Pathian limsakte ahoulimpih zel a, dawr mun ah leng huai a na om peuhmahte toh niteng in akihoulim zel uhi.
english: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who met him.

paite: Huan Epikuria mi leh Stoik mi lak a mipil kuate hiam in leng amah ahong kiselpih uhi. "Hiai mi kamtam in bang ahia gen atup?" achi ua, akhen in, "Jesu thu leh thohnawnna thu agen ziak in gamdang pathiante thugenpa ahih tuak e," achi uhi.
english: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also were conversing with him. Some said, “What does this babbler want to say?” Others said, “He seems to be advocating foreign deities,” because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.

paite: Amah alen ua, Areopagus ah api ua, akiang ah, "Hiai sinsakna thak na gengen na hon theisak thei diam?
english: They took hold of him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is, which you are speaking about?

paite: Thillamdang banghiam ka bil uah na hon tun ahi; huchi in hiai thil omdan theih ka ut uh," achi uhi.
english: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean.”

paite: Athen khomi tengteng, huai amikhualte toh, aman peuh ualeh thu thak photphot gen hiam, angaikhe ding in ahunte uh azang zel uhi.
english: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.

paite: Huchi in Areopagus laitak ah Paul adingh a, "Nou Athen a mite aw, bangkim ah sabiak limsakmi na hi uh chih ka thei hi.
english: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus and said, “You men of Athens, I perceive that you are very religious in all things.

paite: Ka vak kawm a, na biaknate uh ka et lai in, maitam khat, atung a, 'Theih louh pathian' a ding,' chi a kigelh ka mu ahi. Huchi in thei lou a na biak uh, huai thu ka hon hilh ahi zaw hi," achi hi.
english: For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I also found an altar with this inscription: ‘TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.’ What therefore you worship in ignorance, I announce to you.

paite: Pathian, khovel leh asung a thil tengteng siampa, lei leh van Toupa ahih ziak in khut a lam inn peuh ah a-om kei hi.
english: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands.

paite: Thil tasam bang in mihing khut a nna sepsak in leng a-om kei, amah mah bangkim kiang a hinna, hatna leh thil tengteng pepa ahi zaw hi.
english: He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath and all things.

paite: Huan leitung maikaih teng a om ding in bul mun khat vek in nam chih asiam a, amau a ding in hunbi asehsak a, tenna ding gamgi akhunsak hi.
english: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons and the boundaries of their dwellings,

paite: Ama'n hon gamlat kei mahleh mi tengteng in Pathian azon ua, amai amai ua, amuh teiteina ding ua alemgel ahi.
english: that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.

paite: Noumau laphuahsiam kuate hiam in leng, "Eite leng asuante i hi uh, chi a agen bang un. Amah vang in i hing in i tang in, i om uhi."
english: ‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’

paite: Huchi in "Pathian suante i hih nung, Pathian zaw dangka-eng hiam, dangka hiam, suang hiam, mihing khutsiam leh suktuah sekte bang ahi chih i gingta ding uh ahi kei.
english: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold, or silver, or stone, engraved by art and design of man.

paite: Huchi in Pathian in i theih louh hun lai khawng akitheihmohbawl a; himahleh, tu'n ah zaw gam chih a mi tengteng kisik ding thu apeta,
english: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,

paite: Pathian in amiseh zang a dikna a khovel vai ahawm ni ding achiam ziak in; amiseh tungthu amah misi lak a kipan a kaithou in, mi tengteng kiang ah atheisakta hi," achi hi.
english: because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of which he has given assurance to all men, in that he has raised him from the dead.”

paite: Huan misi thohnawnna thu azaktak un, akhen in anuihsan ua; akhen in, “Hiai thu na kiang ah ka ngaikhe nawn ding uh," achi uhi.
english: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, “We want to hear you again concerning this.”

paite: Huchi in Paul tuh alak ua kipan apawtta hi.
english: Thus Paul went out from among them.

paite: Himahleh mi kuate hiam amah lam ah apang tinten ua, agingtata ua, huaite lak a khenkhat Areopagus mi Dionisias leh numei khat amin Damaris leh akiang ua midangte toh ahi uhi.
english: But certain men joined with him and believed, including Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

paite: Huai thilte zoh in Athen a kipan Paul apawt a, Korinth ah ahohta hi.
english: After these things Paul departed from Athens and came to Corinth.

paite: Huan amin Akuila, Juda khat amu a, huai mi Pontus gam a piang ahi a, Klaudias in Judate tengteng Rome a kipan pawt thu apiak ziak a azi Priscilla toh Itali gam a kipan hong tung phet ahi uhi. Huai mite kiang ah Paul atungta hi.
english: He found a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by race, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome. He came to them,

paite: Anasep uh kibang ahih ziak in amau akikoppih in nna asemkhawm ua; anasep uh puanin bawl ahi.
english: and because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.

paite: Sabbath teng in sinagog ah chitaktak in thu agen zel a, Judate leh Grikte thuzoh atum hi.
english: He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath and persuaded Jews and Greeks.

paite: Masidonia gam a kipan Silas leh Timothi ahong tun un, Paul tuh kha phutluih in thu nasem in a-om a, tua Jesu zaw Khrist ahi chih Juda mite kiang ah atheihpih zel hi.
english: When Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.

paite: Himahleh akalh un agensia ua, Paul in apuan asing a, akiang uah, “Na sisan moh uh noumau lutung ah om hen; kei zaw ka hul ahi; tuban Zentelte kiang ah ka paita ding,” achi hi.
english: When they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook out his clothing and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am clean. From now on, I will go to the Gentiles!”

paite: Huan huai a kipan apai a, amin Titas Justas mi khat inn ah alut a, huai mi'n Pathian abe zel hi, a-inn leng sinagog toh kizom ahi.
english: He departed there and went into the house of a certain man named Justus, one who worshiped God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.

paite: Huan Krispus pa sinagog heutu in a-inkuanpihte tengteng toh Toupa agingta a, Korinth a mi tampi'n leng za in agingta ua, baptisma atang uhi.
english: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house. Many of the Corinthians, when they heard, believed and were baptized.

paite: Zan in Toupa'n Paul kiang ah mengmu bang in, "Lau ke'nla, dai lou in thu gen zel in;
english: The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, “Don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent;

paite: kei na kiang ah ka om akei hiam, sihna ding in kuamah in na tung ah khut akha kei ding uhi; hiai khua ah mi tampi ka nei ngal a," achi hi.
english: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”

paite: Huan huai ah alak uah Pathian thu hilh in kum khat leh kha guk a-omta hi.
english: He lived there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

paite: Huan Akaia gam-ukpa Gallio ahih lai in Judate'n kituak in Paul kalh in buaina abawl ua, vaihawmna tutphah ma ah api uhi.
english: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,

paite: “Huai mi'n dan lou bang in a Pathian be ding in mi athuzoh," achi uhi.
english: saying, “This man persuades men to worship God contrary to the law.”

paite: Paul in adawn dekleh Gallio in, Judate kiang ah, "Judate aw, hiai thil diklou thu hiam, thilhihkhelh thu hiam bek hileh, pel lou in ka hon awlmoh ding hi.
english: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable that I should bear with you;

paite: Himahleh thumalte leh minte, noumau dan thu lel zaw noumau kingaihtuah zaw un; ke'n zaw huchibang thu ngaihtuah ka ut kei," achi hi.
english: but if they are questions about words and names and your own law, look to it yourselves. For I don’t want to be a judge of these matters.”

paite: Huan vaihawmna tutphah a kipan in amau adelhkheta hi.
english: So he drove them from the judgment seat.

paite: Huan Grik mi tengteng in sinagog heutu Sostheni aman ua, vaihawmna tutphah ma ah avua uhi. Gallio in athilhih uh khawk asa kei hi.
english: Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.

paite: Huai zoh in Paul ni sawttak ataam nilouh a; huai zoh in unaute kampha in akha a, huai a kipan Siria gam lam ah long in apaita a, akiang ah Priscilla leh Akuila leng apai uhi. Paul in thuchiam aneih ziak in Kenkriai ah sam amet phot hi.
english: Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.

paite: Huan Ephesa atung ua, huai ah amau anusia a; himahleh amah kia sinagog ah alut a, Judate kiang ah chitaktak in thu asutpih hi.
english: He came to Ephesus, and he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.

paite: Huan sawt deuh taam ding in akhou ua, himahleh ama'n lem asa kei a,
english: When they asked him to stay with them a longer time, he declined;

paite: "Pathian in aphalleh na kiang uah ka hong nawn ding," chi in kampha in akhen a, Ephesa a kipan long in apaita hi.
english: but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return again to you if God wills.” Then he set sail from Ephesus.

paite: Huan Kaisaria ah ahong kai a, Jerusalem ah ahohtou a, saptuamte chibai buk in, Antiok ah ahohsukta hi.
english: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.

paite: Huan huai a sawt kuam a-om nung in apai nawn a, nungzuite tengteng hihhat in Galatia gam leh Phrigia gam atawnsuak vek hi.
english: Having spent some time there, he departed and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.

paite: Huan Juda mi khat, amin Apollos, Aleksandria a piang, mipiltak, Ephesa ah ahohsuk a; ama'n Laisiangthou anak theih mahmah hi.
english: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.

paite: Hiai mi'n Toupa Lampi thu zilsa ahi a, lungsim a phatuamngaitak ahih ziak in Toupa thu ahilh zel hi, Johan baptisma thu kia athei hi.
english: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.

paite: Sinagog ah hangsantak in thu agen hi. Huchi in Priscilla leh Akuila in athugen azak un, a-inn uah leh akiang ah Pathian Lampi thu kichian sem in ahilhchianta uhi.
english: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.

paite: Ama'n Akhaia gam a paikai atuptak in unaute'n ahanthawn ua, amah ana kipahpihna ding un nungzuite kiang ah lai agelhsak uhi. Huan atun in, Pathian hehpihna ziak a gingtate nakpitak in apanpih hi.
english: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him; and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;

paite: Vantang theih in Judate nakpitak in aseldong a, Laisiangthou zang in tua Jesu zaw Khrist ahi ngei chih atheisak hi.
english: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.

paite: Korinth a Apollos a-om kal in Paul in saklam gamte tawnsuak masa kawm in, Ephesa khua atung a, huai ah nungzui kuate hiam amu hi.
english: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus and found certain disciples.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Na gintak chil ua pan Kha Siangthou na tang uhia?" achi hi. Amaute'n akiang ah, "Tang lou, Kha Siangthou a-om chih zak leng ka za kei uh," achi uhi.
english: He said to them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They said to him, “No, we haven’t even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”

paite: Ama'n, "Bang baptisma ahia na tan uh?" achi hi. Amau, "Johan baptisma," achi uhi.
english: He said, “Into what then were you baptized?” They said, “Into John’s baptism.”

paite: Huan Paul in, "Johan in zaw anung a hong paipa Jesu gingta ding a mite hilh in kisikna baptisma in abaptis zel ahi," achi hi.
english: Paul said, “John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the one who would come after him, that is, in Christ Jesus.”

paite: Huan huai thu azaktak un Toupa Jesu min in baptisma atang uhi.
english: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

paite: Paul in atung uah akhut akoih a, Kha Siangthou atung uah ahong tungta hi. Huchi in pautuamte in thu agen ua; Pathian thu leng ahilhta uhi.
english: When Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them and they spoke with other languages and prophesied.

paite: Avek un piching sawm-le-nih vel ahi uhi.
english: They were about twelve men in all.

paite: Huan sinagog ah Paul alut zel a, kha thum phial hangsantak in thu agen a, Pathian lalgam thu ahihna sutpih in, mi athuzoh zel hi.
english: He entered into the synagogue and spoke boldly for a period of three months, reasoning and persuading about the things concerning God’s Kingdom.

paite: Himahleh akhen achihhak ua, agingta nuam kei uh, mipi ma a Lampi agensiattak un, ama'n amaute apaisan a, nungzuite apituam a, niteng in kisinsakna mun Tairanas ah thu hilh in asutpih zel hi.
english: But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.

paite: Huchibang ngen in kum nih phial ahih a; huchi in Asia gam a om tengteng, Judate leh Grikte'n leng Toupa thu azata uhi.
english: This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

paite: Pathian in Paul khut in thillamdang taktak ahihsak hi.
english: God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul,

paite: Huchi in ataksa sukha kinulna puan neu, puan tungsilh damloute kiang ah ahon tawi ua, anatnate uh adam zel hi, asung ua kipan dawite leng apawt uhi.
english: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out.

paite: Huan Juda mi dawi hawlkhia chi a vakvai dawithu thei kuate hiam in, "Paul in athu tangkoupih Jesu Khrist min in ka hon vau hi, chi in dawimatte tung ah Toupa Jesu min alou uhi."
english: But some of the itinerant Jews, exorcists, took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, “We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preaches.”

paite: Juda mi siampu lianpen khat Skeva in huchibang hih tapa sagih anei hi.
english: There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.

paite: Himahleh dawi in akiang uah, "Jesu ka gingta, Paul leng ka thei, nou kuate na hi ua?" chi in adawng hi.
english: The evil spirit answered, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?”

paite: Huan dawipai in aboh a, avek un azou a, anuaisiahta hi; huchi in huai mipa inn a kipan vuaktang leh liam in ataikheta uhi.
english: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

paite: Huchi in Ephesa a om tengteng, Judate leh Grikte kiang ah huai mi thu athangta hi. Huan avek un alau ua, Toupa Jesu min alianta hi.
english: This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

paite: Huan agingtate leng akhen tampi ahong ua, athilhihkhelhte uh thupha atawi ua, akipulak uhi.
english: Many also of those who had believed came, confessing and declaring their deeds.

paite: Mitkhialdawi hihmi akhen tampi in leng alaibute uh ahon tawikhawm ua, mi tengteng mitmuh in ahalta uh; huan aman asut ua dangka singnga hi in athei uhi.
english: Many of those who practiced magical arts brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all. They counted their price, and found it to be fifty thousand pieces of silver.

paite: Huchi lawmlawm a thupi in Toupa thu adalh a, azou zel hi.
english: So the word of the Lord was growing and becoming mighty.

paite: Huan huai khit in, Paul in Masidonia gam leh Akhaia gam tawtsuak takdih a, Jerusalem a hoh atum hi. "Huai a ka hoh khit chiang in Rome khua ka sik sam ding," achi hi.
english: Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, “After I have been there, I must also see Rome.”

paite: Huchi in amah nasepsakte nih Timothi leh Erastas, Masidonia gam ah apaisak phot a, amah bel Asia gam ah ataam tadih hi.
english: Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.

paite: Huai lai in Lampi ziak in mi buai petmah in abuaita uhi.
english: About that time there arose no small disturbance concerning the Way.

paite: Mi khat amin Demetrias, dangkasik sek a Diana milim bawlpa a-om a, khutsiamte a ding in kilohna tampi apia hi.
english: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought no little business to the craftsmen,

paite: Hiai mi in amaute asamkhawm a, anasep bang uh semte toh; huan akiang uah, "Pute aw, hiai nasepna i hauhna uh ahi chih na thei uhi.
english: whom he gathered together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, “Sirs, you know that by this business we have our wealth.

paite: Hiai Ephesa khua kia hilou in, Asia gam kho kim teng phial ah leng, Paul in khut a bawl pathiante, Pathian ahi kei uh chi in mi tampi thuzoh in, akiheisak khinta chih noumau ngei in na mu un na za uhi.
english: You see and hear that not at Ephesus alone, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are no gods that are made with hands.

paite: Huchi in i nekzonna un athuak ding chih alauhuai kia hilou in, pathiannu thupitak Diana tempul leng ahon ngaineu ding uh. Asia gam a mi tengteng leh khovel a mi'n abiak zel uh, athupipi toh, ahong neu ding chih alauhuai hi," achi hi.
english: Not only is there danger that this our trade come into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be counted as nothing and her majesty destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worships.”

paite: Huai thu azaktak un, aheh mahmah ua, "Ephesa a Diana thupitak ahi," chi in akikou uhi.
english: When they heard this they were filled with anger, and cried out, saying, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”

paite: Huchi in akhua in apumbuai vekta ua, Gaias leh Aristarkhas, Masidonia gam a mi, Paul nungzuite, aman ua, kituaktak in etnop inn ah ataipih kheukhou uhi.
english: The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel.

paite: Paul in mipi lak a lut atupleh nungzuite'n aphal kei uhi.
english: When Paul wanted to enter in to the people, the disciples didn’t allow him.

paite: Asia gam a heutupente lak a khenkhat kuate hiam Paul lawmte ahi ua, akiang ah mi asawl ua, etnop inn ah lut teitei lou ding in akun uhi.
english: Certain also of the Asiarchs, being his friends, sent to him and begged him not to venture into the theater.

paite: Omkhawmte abuai ua, mi tamzaw in akikhopna san uh leng athei kei uh, khenkhat thukhat in akikou ua, khenkhat thudang in akikou uhi.
english: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another, for the assembly was in confusion. Most of them didn’t know why they had come together.

paite: Mipi lak a mi khenkhat in Alexander, asiamna thu gendan ding ahilhta ua, Judate'n amah malam ah asawnphei uhi. Huan Alexander in akhut in azap a, mi tengteng kiang ah asiamna thu gen atum hi.
english: They brought Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. Alexander beckoned with his hand, and would have made a defense to the people.

paite: Himahleh amah Juda mi ahi chih atheihtak un, dakkal nih sung aw kituaktak in, "Ephesate Diana athupi hi," chi ngen in akikou uhi.
english: But when they perceived that he was a Jew, all with one voice for a time of about two hours cried out, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”

paite: Huan khosung laigelhpa'n mipi asukdaih khit in, "Ephesa a mite aw, Diana thupitak tempul kemtu leh van a kipan a milim kia, Ephesa khuate a kem na hi uh chih, kua ahia thei lou om?
english: When the town clerk had quieted the multitude, he said, “You men of Ephesus, what man is there who doesn’t know that the city of the Ephesians is temple keeper of the great goddess Artemis, and of the image which fell down from Zeus?

paite: Huchi in hiai thu sel vual ahih louh nung in, na dai dide ding uh ahi, thunung veng lou in bangmah na hih ding uh ahi kei hi.
english: Seeing then that these things can’t be denied, you ought to be quiet and to do nothing rash.

paite: Hiai mi hiai mun a na hon pite uh, tempul lokmi ahi kei ua, i pathiannu gensete leng ahi kei uh.
english: For you have brought these men here, who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of your goddess.

paite: Huchi in Demetrias leh alawm khutsiamte'n leng kua lak ah leng thubuai aneih uleh, thubuai genna innte honsa in a-om vele, gam ukpate leng a-om uhi; kihektuah uhen.
english: If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a matter against anyone, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. Let them press charges against one another.

paite: Thil dang buaina nei him na hih uleh, kikhopna ngeina ah alem ding uh.
english: But if you seek anything about other matters, it will be settled in the regular assembly.

paite: Tuni a thu vengvung ziak in salh lauhuai in i omta uh, athu om ngel lou buaina bawl a ngoh theih i hi ngal ua, hiai kikhopna san bangmah gen ding thei lou ding i kei uhiam," achi hi.
english: For indeed we are in danger of being accused concerning today’s riot, there being no cause. Concerning it, we wouldn’t be able to give an account of this commotion.”

paite: Huan huchibang thu agen khit in omkhawm heutute akikhenzak sakta hi.
english: When he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.

paite: Pentikost ni ahong tun in, avek un mun khat ah a-omkhawm uhi.
english: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.

paite: Thakhat in van a kipan huihpi nung bang in ging ahong om guih a, huchi in huai in atutna inn uh ahihdim vekta hi,
english: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

paite: leite amah-le-amah mei bang a kihawm in, alutung uah ahong tuang chiat hi.
english: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.

paite: Huchi in avek un Kha Siangthou in aluahdimta a, Kha in hihtheihna apiak a apausak bang zel in pau dangte in apauta uhi.
english: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.

paite: Huan van nuai nam chih lak a kipan Pathian limsak Juda kulmutte Jerusalem ah a-om uhi.
english: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.

paite: Huan ging husa azaktak un mipi ahong kikhawm ua, michih in apau uh amau pau chiat a azak ziak un alungsim uh ahong buai hi.
english: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.

paite: Huan avek un amangbang ua, lamdang asa mahmah uhi, "En dih uh, hiai a pau tengteng Galili gam a mi ahi kei ua hia?
english: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?

paite: Bangchi in ahia i vek ua pianpih pau chiat a i zak uh?
english: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?

paite: Eite Parthai nam, Medes nam, Elam nam; khenkhat Mesopotamia gam a om, Judia gam a om, Kappadosia gam a om, Pontas gam a om, Asia gam a om,
english: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,

paite: Phrigia gam a om, Pamphilia gam a om, Aigupta gam a om, Kurini kho kiang a Libia gam a om i hi ua; khenkhat Rome a pan mikhualte, Judate leh aphungkaite uh toh i hi ngal ua,
english: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,

paite: khenkhat Krit tuikulh leh Arab gam a mite i hi ngal ua; himahleh, Pathian thilhih thupite agen uh eimau pau chiat in i za ngal ua!" achi uhi.
english: Cretans and Arabians—we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”

paite: Huan avek un lamdang asa mahmah ua, akhiakna dan thei lou in, "Hiai bangchidan ahia?" akichi uhi.
english: They were all amazed and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”

paite: Khenkhat in, "Uain thak akham ua ahi," chi in anuihsan uhi.
english: Others, mocking, said, “They are filled with new wine.”

paite: Himahleh Peter in sawm-le-khatte toh dingkhawm in, aw ngaihtak in akiang uah agen a, nou Judia gam a mite aw, nou Jerusalem a om tengteng aw, hiai thei unla, ka thu leng ngaikhia un.
english: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice and spoke out to them, “You men of Judea and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.

paite: Hiaite na gin bang un akham kei uh, dak thumna hun ahi.
english: For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.

paite: Hiaite zawlnei Joel in agen ahi zaw:
english: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:

paite: "Pathian in, ni nanungte ah hichi ahi ding, mi tengteng tung ah ka kha ka sungbo ding a; na tapa leh na tanute'n ka thu ahilh ding uh; na tangvalte un kilaknate amu ding ua, na putekte un mang anei ding uh.
english: ‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will dream dreams.

paite: Ahi, huai ni in ka sikhapate, ka sikhanute tung ah leng ka Kha ka sungbo ding a, ka thu agen ding uhi.
english: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.

paite: Huan tunglam van ah thillamdang nuailam lei ah chiamtehna ka musak ding a; sisan, mei, meikhu hu toh,
english: I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath: blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.

paite: Nisa mial asuak ding a, kha sisan asuak ding, Toupa ni thupitak leh lauhuaitak ahong tun ma in.
english: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, Toupa min lou peuhmah hotdam in a-om ding hi.
english: It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’

paite: "Nou Israel mite aw, hiai thu za un: Nazaret Jesu, Pathian in amah zang in na lak uah thil thupite, thillamdangte, chiamtehnate ahih in ahon theichiansak hi; nou ngei in tuate na theichian uhi.
english: “Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you, even as you yourselves know,

paite: Huai mi Pathian' tupkholhsa leh theihkholh bang in na mansak ua, nou migiloute khut a kilhden in na hihlumta uhi.
english: him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men, crucified and killed;

paite: Amah, Pathian in sihna thuaknatna phelsak in, akaithouta a; ama sihna letdet vual ahih louh ziak in.
english: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.

paite: Huan David in athu agen a, 'Ka ma ah chik lai peuh in Toupa ka mu gige hi. Ka mangbatlouhna ding in ka taklam ah a-om hi.
english: For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.

paite: Huaiziak in ka lungtang anuam a, ka lei leng akipak a, ka sa lamentak in a-om behlap lai hi.
english: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover my flesh also will dwell in hope,

paite: Misikhua ah ka kha na nuse kei ding a, muatna na Mi Siangthou na musak sam kei ding hi.
english: because you will not leave my soul in Hades, neither will you allow your Holy One to see decay.

paite: Nangma'n hinna lampite na hon theisak a; nangma'n na mel in kipak in na hon hihdim ding,'" chi in.
english: You made known to me the ways of life. You will make me full of gladness with your presence.’

paite: "Unaute aw, chikhahpa David thu lau lou in na kiang uah ka gen thei hi; amah zaw asi a, vui leng avui khinta ua, ahan leng tutan in i kiang ah a-om lai hi.
english: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.

paite: Amah tuh zawlnei ahi a, Pathian in akhal a mi kuahiam sadan a achite lak a mi khat Khrist laltutphah a tu ding in akaithou ding chih kichiam in agen chih athei hi.
english: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,

paite: Huchi in huai tuh atheihkholh him ziak in Khrist thohnawn ding thu agen hi, 'Misikhua a nutsiat in a-om kei a, aluang leng amuat sam kei hi, chi in.
english: he foreseeing this, spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that his soul wasn’t left in Hades, and his flesh didn’t see decay.

paite: "Pathian in Jesu akaithouta chih theihpihte i vek un i hi uhi.
english: This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.

paite: Pathian khut taklam ah pahtawi in a-om a, Kha Siangthou chiam Pa kiang a kipan in amu a, na muh uh leh na zakte uh ahon sunbuak ahi uhi.
english: Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this which you now see and hear.

paite: David zaw van ah akahtou kei, amah ngei in, Jehovah in ka Toupa kiang ah,
english: For David didn’t ascend into the heavens, but he says himself, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit by my right hand

paite: 'Na melmate na khepek ngakna dia ka bawl masiah, Ka taklam ah tu kinken in,' " achi, ana chi hi.
english: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”’

paite: "Huchi in Jesu, na kilhden uh, Pathian in Toupa leh Khrist hikhawm in abawlta chih Israel inkuan chih in kichiantak in thei uhen," achi hi.
english: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”

paite: Huan huai thu azak un alungtang ua sut bang ahong hi ua, Peter leh sawltak dangte kiang ah, "Unaute aw, bangchi in ka hihta ding ua?" achi ua.
english: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”

paite: Peter in akiang uah, "Na khelhnate uh ngaihdamna ding in lungsim khek unla, Jesu Khrist min in baptisma tang chiat un; huchi in Kha Siangthou thawnpiak na tang ding uhi.
english: Peter said to them, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

paite: Achiam nou a ding, na tate uh a ding, gamlapi a mi tengteng a ding leh Toupa i Pathian in akiang a asap peuhmahte a ding ahi," achi hi.
english: For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.”

paite: Huan thudang tampi in ahilhchian a; hiai khang thulimloute lak ah kihumbit un, chi in ahanthawn hi.
english: With many other words he testified and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”

paite: Huan athu zui peuhmah in baptisma atang ua, huai ni in mi sangthum vel behlap in a-om uhi.
english: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.

paite: Huan sawltakte thusinsakte sin in, kithuah in, tanghou balkham in, thum in, phatuamngaitak in a-omkhawm uhi.
english: They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.

paite: Huan michih in alauta ua; sawltakte'n thillamdang leh chiam-tehna tampi ahih uhi.
english: Fear came on every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.

paite: Agingta peuhmah in bangkim akikopkhawm uhi.
english: All who believed were together, and had all things in common.

paite: Agoute uh, athil neihte uh azuak ua, adeihdong ching lel chiat in avek ua kiang ah ahawm zel uhi.
english: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.

paite: Huan niteng in, lungsim mun khat in, tempul ah phatuamngaitak in a-om zelzel ua, a-innte uah leng tanghou balkham in, nuam leh lungkim in, a-an uh ane zel uhi.
english: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,

paite: Pathian aphat ua, mi tengteng deihsak in a-om uhi. Huan ahotdam lel peuhmah Toupa'n niteng in akiang uah abehlapsak zel hi.
english: praising God and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.

paite: Buaina aven nung in, Paul in nungzuite asamsak a, ahanthawn a, kampha in akha a, Masidonia gam a pai ding in apawtta hi.
english: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.

paite: Thu tampi anungzuite hanthawn in huai gam atawnsuak a, Grikte gam atungta hi.
english: When he had gone through those parts and had encouraged them with many words, he came into Greece.

paite: Huan huai ah kha thum ataam hi. Siria gam a long a azin dek kuan in, Judate'n amah thah asawm ziak un, Masidonia gam tawn a kilehkik atum zawta hi.
english: When he had spent three months there, and a plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he determined to return through Macedonia.

paite: Asia gam tan a amah zuite, Beriah khomi Pirhas tapa Sopater, Thessalonika a pan Aristarkhas leh Sekundas, Darbe khomi, Gaias, Timothi leh Asia gam a Taikikas leh Trophimaste ahi uh.
english: These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea, Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, Gaius of Derbe, Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.

paite: Huaite'n ka ma uh akai ua, Troas ah hon na ngak uhi.
english: But these had gone ahead, and were waiting for us at Troas.

paite: Kou bel Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh ni abei in Philippi a kipan long in ka pawt ua, ni nga nung in Troas ah akiang uh ka tung uhi; huai ah ni sagih ka taam uhi.
english: We sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and came to them at Troas in five days, where we stayed seven days.

paite: Huan nipikal a ani masapen in, tanghou balkham ding a ka kikhop lai un, Paul in akiang uah thu agen hi; ama'n azingchiang a pai atup ziak in zankim tan hial thu agen hi.
english: On the first day of the week, when the disciples were gathered together to break bread, Paul talked with them, intending to depart on the next day; and continued his speech until midnight.

paite: Huan indan tungnung, ka omkhawmna uah khawnvak tampi a-om hi.
english: There were many lights in the upper room where we were gathered together.

paite: Huan amin Eutikas tangval khat tohlet ah atu a, nakpitak in ana ihmu hi. Huan Paul in thu agen sawt tak ziak in ama'n a-ihmut suak a thuakzou nawnta kei a, insawng thumna a kipan in aketa a, asisa in aphong uhi.
english: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down from the third floor and was taken up dead.

paite: Himahleh Paul akumsuk a, bohkhum in a-angpom a, "Lunglau kei un, alaitat kei lai hi," achi hi.
english: Paul went down and fell upon him, and embracing him said, “Don’t be troubled, for his life is in him.”

paite: Huan Paul akahtou nawn a, tanghou balkham in an ane a, khovak pha in akiang uah thu agen a, huai nung in apaita hi.
english: When he had gone up, had broken bread and eaten, and had talked with them a long while, even until break of day, he departed.

paite: Huan valnoupa dam in api ua, akhamuang petmah uhi.
english: They brought the boy in alive, and were greatly comforted.

paite: Huan koute Assos khua zuan in long in ka na pai masa ua, long ah Paul tuansak ka tum uhi; ama'n khe a paina lam tot atup ziak in huchibang tuh amah geldan ahi.
english: But we, going ahead to the ship, set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul aboard there; for he had so arranged, intending himself to go by land.

paite: Huan Assos a ahon tuah chiang in, long ah ka tuangsakta ua, Mitilini khua ka tung uhi.
english: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and came to Mitylene.

paite: Huan huai a kipan in long in ka pai nawn ua, azing in Khios tuikulh gal ka tung ua; huan azing nawn in Samo tuikulh ka tung ua, Troguliam ah ka giak uhi. Azing nawn in Miletas khua ka tung nawn uhi.
english: Sailing from there, we came the following day opposite Chios. The next day we touched at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium, and the day after we came to Miletus.

paite: Huan Paul in Asia gam a om sawt lou a, long a Ephesa khua khen atupsa him ahi a, ahihtheihleh Jerusalem a Pentikost ni huam tum in akinpai hi.
english: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.

paite: Huan Miletas a kipan in Ephesa ah mi asawl a, akiang ah saptuam upate asamsak hi.
english: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the assembly.

paite: Huan akiang ahong tun un, ama'n akiang uah, Asia gam ka tot chil ni a kipan na kiang ua ka om sung teng in ka omdan na thei uhi.
english: When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was with you all the time,

paite: Thunuailutpen kawm leh Judate'n hon thah asawm ziak ua khitui kai leh thil haksa ka tung a tungte thuak kawm in Toupa nna ka sem hi.
english: serving the Lord with all humility, with many tears, and with trials which happened to me by the plots of the Jews;

paite: Huchibang in aphatuam ding thu na kiang uah bangmah iim ka nei kei a, vantang lak leh inn teng ah thu ka hon hilh zel a,
english: how I didn’t shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, teaching you publicly and from house to house,

paite: Judate leh Grikte kiang ah leng Pathian lam a kisikna thu leh i Toupa Jesu Khrist lam a ginna thu ka theisak zel hi.
english: testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God and faith toward our Lord Jesus.

paite: Ngai un, tu in Kha in hon sawl teitei a ka theih ziak in, Jerusalem a hoh dia kisa ka hi, huai ah ka tung a thil hong tung ding bangmah ka thei kei;
english: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;

paite: Kha Siangthou in, henna leh haksatna in nang ahon dawn hi, chi in kho teng ah ahon hilh zel hi, tuate kia ka theih ahi.
english: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.

paite: Himahleh ka kitaitehna lam ka maban tun ding leh Pathian hehpihna tanchinhoih a dia theihpihtu a pang ding a Toupa Jesu kiang a huai nasepna ka muh pen sem khin phot leng, ka hinna leng khiaklah tham in ka sep kei hi.
english: But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.

paite: "Huan thei un, noute tengteng, Pathian lalgam thu tangkoupih a ka vakvaknate'n ka mel na mu nawnta kei ding uh chih ka thei hi.
english: “Now, behold, I know that you all, among whom I went about preaching God’s Kingdom, will see my face no more.

paite: Huaiziak in mi tengteng sisan ah ka hul ahi chih tuni in ka hon theisak hi.
english: Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,

paite: Pathian vaihawm tengteng avek in na kiang uah iim ka nei kei hi.
english: for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.

paite: Pathian saptuamte, ama sisan a aleite, vak ding in noumau leh na heute tengteng uh tung ah pilvang un, Kha Siangthou in atung uah nou heutu in ahon bawl hi.
english: Take heed, therefore, to yourselves and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the assembly of the Lord and God which he purchased with his own blood.

paite: Ka pai nung in na lak uah ngehangte ahong lut ding ua, pawlte ahawi kei ding uh chih ka thei hi.
english: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

paite: Noumau lak a mi nangawn, nungzui pawlte amau lam a kaimang ding in thu tuam gen na hong om ding uh.
english: Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.

paite: Huaiziak in limsak unla; kum thum hilhial khitui ke kawm a, sun leh zan a michih taihilh ka tawplouhdan, theigige un.
english: Therefore watch, remembering that for a period of three years I didn’t cease to admonish everyone night and day with tears.

paite: "Tu in noute Pathian leh ahehpihna ah ka hon kemsak hi, huai in noute ahon bawllian thei a, mi lungsim siangthoute kiang ah goutan ahon neisak thei lai hi.
english: Now, brothers, I entrust you to God and to the word of his grace, which is able to build up and to give you the inheritance among all those who are sanctified.

paite: Kuamah dangka, dangka-eng leh puansilh ka eng ngei kei.
english: I coveted no one’s silver, gold, or clothing.

paite: Hiai khutte'n keimah leh ka lawmte taksap asepkhiak zeldan, noumau ngei in na thei uhi.
english: You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.

paite: Bangkim ka hih peuhmah na chin ding ua ka hih ahi, huchibang a semgim leh Toupa Jesu thu theigige kawm in mihatloute na panpih ding uh ahi; amah mah in, 'Lak sang in piak in lukhawng anei zaw' achih," achi hi.
english: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’ ”

paite: Huai thu agen khit in akhukdin a, avek un athum uhi.
english: When he had spoken these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.

paite: Huan avek un akap huphup ua, Paul ngawng ah kawi in atawp uhi.
english: They all wept freely, and fell on Paul’s neck and kissed him,

paite: Amel amuh nawn tak louh ding thu agen alungkhamna pen uh ahi. Huan long pha in amah ava kha uhi.
english: sorrowing most of all because of the word which he had spoken, that they should see his face no more. Then they accompanied him to the ship.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, amaute toh ka kikhen ua, long in ka pawt ua, huai khit in tangtak in Kos tuikulh ka tung ua, azing in Rhodes tuikulh ka tung nawn ua, huai a kipan in ka pai zel ua, Patara khua ka tung uhi.
english: When we had departed from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.

paite: Phoinisia gam pai ding long khat ka mu ua, ka tuang ua, ka pai zel uhi.
english: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.

paite: Huan Kupra tuikulh ka mu ua, veilam pang ah ka kheng ua, Siria gam ah ka pai zel ua, Tair ah long van nawnkhiak ding a-om man in ka kum phot uhi.
english: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for the ship was there to unload her cargo.

paite: Nungzuite ka zongkhia ua, huai ah ni sagih ka taam uhi; huan Kha theihsak in Paul kiang ah, Jerusalem a hohtou lou ding in achi uhi.
english: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit that he should not go up to Jerusalem.

paite: Himahleh huai nite khit in ka pawt ua ka paita ua, unaute'n avek un, azi atate uh toh khopi pua dong ahong kha ua; tuipi piau ah ka khukdin ua, ka thum uhi.
english: When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.

paite: Huan mangpha ka kikhak zoh un, long ah ka tuang ua, amau bel a-inn uah apai nawnta uhi.
english: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.

paite: Tair a kipan long a ka pai khit un Ptolemais khua ka tung ua, unaute chibai ka buk uhi, akiang uah ni khat ka nituang uhi.
english: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers and stayed with them one day.

paite: Huan azing in ka pawt ua Kaisaria khua ka tung ua huai ah tanchinhoih genpa, Philip inn ah ka lut ua, amah ahihleh sagihte lak a khat ahi a, akiang ah ka taam uhi.
english: On the next day, we who were Paul’s companions departed and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.

paite: Huai mi'n, amau zawlnei bang a thu agen zel nungak siangthou ngen, tanu li anei hi.
english: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.

paite: Huai ah ni tampi ka taam ua, huai lai in Judia gam a kipan amin Agabas kichi zawlnei khat ahong suk hi.
english: As we stayed there some days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.

paite: Ka kiang uah ahong a, Paul kawnggak ala a, akhete, akhutte amah in akigak a, "Jerusalem a Judate'n hichibang in hiai kawnggak neipa agak ding ua, Zentelte khut ah ape lai ding uh, Kha Siangthou in achi,” achi hi.
english: Coming to us and taking Paul’s belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, “The Holy Spirit says: ‘So the Jews at Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt, and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’”

paite: Huan huai thu ka zaktak un, kou leh huai khua a mite'n Jerusalem a Paul hoh lou ding in ka khou chiat uhi.
english: When we heard these things, both we and the people of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.

paite: Himahleh Paul in adawng a, "Bangchi na hi ua, na kahkah ua, na hon khasiatsak uh? Toupa Jesu min ziak in Jerusalem a hen kia hilou in, sih leng ngap ka hi," achi hi.
english: Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”

paite: Huan khouhzoh vual ahih louhtak in, ka tawpta ua, "Toupa thuthu hi hen aw," ka chi uhi.
english: When he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, “The Lord’s will be done.”

paite: Huai nung in ka van uh ka bawl ua, Jerusalem ah ka hohtou uhi.
english: After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.

paite: Kaisaria a mi nungzuite kuate hiam, ka kiang uah apai ua, amau, amin Mnason inn, nungzui masa pawl Kupra tuikulh a mi khat ka tunna dingpa uh api sam uhi.
english: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.

paite: Huan Jerusalem khua ka tun un unaute'n nuamtak in hon na kipahpih uhi.
english: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.

paite: Azing in Paul toh Jakob kiang ah ka lut ua; huai ah saptuam upate tengteng leng a-om uhi.
english: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.

paite: Paul in amau chibai abuk khit in, anasepna zang a Pathian in Zentelte lak a thil ahihsak peuhmah avek in agen hi.
english: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.

paite: Unaute'n huai thu azak un Pathian apahtawi uh; huan Paul kiang ah, "Unaupa, Judate lak a gingtami tamdan na mu a; avek un dan lam ah phatuam angai lai uhi.
english: They, when they heard it, glorified God. They said to him, “You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.

paite: Nang Zentelte lak a Juda omte tengteng kiang ah atate uh zeksum louh ding leh dan bang a om louh ding chi in Mosi Dan paihkhiakna ding na thuhilh zel chih mi kam ah na thu athei vek uhi," achi uhi.
english: They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children and not to walk after the customs.

paite: "Bangchi hita ding ahia le? Na hong tung chih aza ngal ding ua.
english: What then? The assembly must certainly meet, for they will hear that you have come.

paite: Huaiziak in na kiang a ka gen bang un hih in; thuchiam nei pasal li ka kiang uah a-om uhi.
english: Therefore do what we tell you. We have four men who have taken a vow.

paite: Huai mite pi in la, akiang uah kisiangsak sam inla, asam uh amettheihna ding un amau a ding in sum seng in; huchi in mi tengteng in mi kam a na thu azak teng uh gen tham ahi kei chih athei ding ua, nangmah mah dan zui in kichiantak in na om zaw chih athei ding uhi.
english: Take them and purify yourself with them, and pay their expenses for them, that they may shave their heads. Then all will know that there is no truth in the things that they have been informed about you, but that you yourself also walk keeping the law.

paite: Zentelte lak a gingtate thu zaw, milim biakna thil nek lam ah, sa sisan nek thu ah, sa heklup nek lam ah, kingaih lam a kipan in akihulsak ding uh ahi, chi in ka gen ua, ka gelhta uhi," achi uhi.
english: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality.”

paite: Huan azing in Paul in pasalte atonpih a, amau toh akisiangsak a, tempul ah alut a, amaute a ding a kithoihna apiaksak chiat masiah kisiansakna ni anei phot ding uh chih, siampu kiang ah ahilh hi.
english: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.

paite: Kisiansuahna ni sagih achin dektak in Asia gam a Judate'n tempul ah Paul amu ua, mipi tengteng atokthou ua, amah aman ua, kikou in,
english: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,

paite: "Israel mite aw, hong huh un! Hiai mi, gam teng a mi tengteng kiang a Juda mite dante, hiai mun siangthou gensepa ahi; huai lou leng, tempul ah Grik mite alutpih a, hiai in siangthou ahihbuah khin," achi uhi.
english: crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place. Moreover, he also brought Greeks into the temple and has defiled this holy place!”

paite: Huai ma in khua ah Ephesa a mi Trophimas akiang ah amu ua, Paul in huai mi tempul ah alutpih agingta uhi.
english: For they had seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.

paite: Huan akhua in akising kheukhou ua, mite ataikhawm ua; Paul aman ua, tempul a kipan akaikhia ua; kongkhakte akhak pah ngal uhi.
english: All the city was moved and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.

paite: Amah hihlup atup laitak un Jerusalem a mi tengteng abuai uh chih sepaih pawl heutu lianpen kiang atungtou hi.
english: As they were trying to kill him, news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.

paite: Ama'n sepaihte leh sepaih za heutute api pah a, akiang uah ataisuk uhi; heutu lianpen leh sepaihte amuhtak un Paul vuak atawpta uhi.
english: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.

paite: Sepaih heutu lianpen in ahong naih a, Paul alen a, khainiang nih butsak ding thu apia a; kua ahia ahih a, bang ahia ahih adong hi.
english: Then the commanding officer came near, arrested him, commanded him to be bound with two chains, and inquired who he was and what he had done.

paite: Mipite akhen thu khat in akikou ua, akhen thudang a akikou ziak un, buaina ziak diktak athei kei a, sepaihte giahbuk a pilut thu apia hi.
english: Some shouted one thing and some another, among the crowd. When he couldn’t find out the truth because of the noise, he commanded him to be brought into the barracks.

paite: Paul kalbi atun lai in mipi ahiamgam ziak un sepaihte'n amah apumzawn uhi.
english: When he came to the stairs, he was carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the crowd;

paite: Mi tengteng in, "Hihmangthang un," chi akikou in, azui uhi.
english: for the multitude of the people followed after, crying out, “Away with him!”

paite: Sepaihte giahbuk sung a apilut dek lai un Paul in, sepaih heutu lianpen kiang ah, "Na kiang ah thu kam khat ka gen thei diam?" achi hi.
english: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he asked the commanding officer, “May I speak to you?” He said, “Do you know Greek?

paite: Huan ama'n, "Grik pau na thei maw? Tuma a mite hanthawn a, gamdai mun a mihing sangli suam a thatte heutupa Aigupta mi na hi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: Aren’t you then the Egyptian who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?”

paite: Paul in, "Silisia gam a Tarsas a om Juda mi ka hi, khopi neu liai lou khat khua-le-tui ka hi; hon hehpih inla, mi tengteng kiang ah thu hon gensak in," achi hi.
english: But Paul said, “I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no insignificant city. I beg you, allow me to speak to the people.”

paite: Huan alemsaktak in kalbi ah Paul adingh a, mi tengteng daihna ding in akhut avan a; huan adaih duamtak un Hebru pau in akiang uah thu agen hi.
english: When he had given him permission, Paul, standing on the stairs, beckoned with his hand to the people. When there was a great silence, he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, saying,

paite: "Unaute aw, pate aw, tu'n ah na kiang uah ka siamna thu ka hon hilh ding hi, ngaikhia un," achi hi.
english: “Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”

paite: Huan Hebru pau in akiang uah thu agen chih azaktak un, adai nawn sem ua; huan ama'n,
english: When they heard that he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, they were even more quiet. He said,

paite: "Juda mi ka hi a, Silisia gam a Tarsas a piang ka hi. Himahleh hiai khua ah Gamaliel khebul a zil a khanglian ka hi, i pipute Dan omdan kimtak zil zel a om ka hi a, tuni a noumau tengteng bang in Pathian a ding a phatuam na ngai sam ka hi.
english: “I am indeed a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed according to the strict tradition of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God, even as you all are today.

paite: Hiai Lampi a mite that hial khop in ka sawi zel a, numei pasal ka hen a, suangkul ah ka khumsak hi.
english: I persecuted this Way to the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women,

paite: Siampu lianpen leh upate tengteng in leng huai thu hon theihpih ua, amau a kipan in leng unaute piak ding in lai ka mu hi, huan Damaskas a omte sawi ding leh hensa a Jerusalem a pi ding in ka hoh hi.
english: as also the high priest and all the council of the elders testify, from whom also I received letters to the brothers, and traveled to Damascus to bring them also who were there to Jerusalem in bonds to be punished.

paite: "Huan hichi ahong hi a, ka pai a Damaskas kho kiang ka tun in, sun lai in, thakhat in van a kipan vak thupitak ka kim ah ahong vak hi.
english: “As I made my journey and came close to Damascus, about noon suddenly a great light shone around me from the sky.

paite: Huan lei ah ka puk a, ka kiang ah, 'Saul, Saul, nang bang achia hon sawi?' chi in aw ka zata hi.
english: I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?’

paite: Huan ke'n, 'Toupa kua na hia?' chi in ka dong a. Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, Nazaret Jesu na sawi ka hi,” achi hi.
english: I answered, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ He said to me, ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you persecute.’

paite: Ka lawmte'n vak amu ua, hon houpihpa aw aza kei uhi.
english: “Those who were with me indeed saw the light and were afraid, but they didn’t understand the voice of him who spoke to me.

paite: Ke'n, "Toupa, bang ka hih dia?" ka chi a. Toupa'n ka kiang ah, "Thou inla, Damaskas ah lut in, thil tengteng na hih ding achih peuhmah ahon hilh ding uh," achi hi.
english: I said, ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ The Lord said to me, ‘Arise, and go into Damascus. There you will be told about all things which are appointed for you to do.’

paite: Huan huai vak thupi ziak in khua ka mutheita kei a, ka lawmte'n khut in ahon kai ua, Damaskas ah ka lutta uhi.
english: When I couldn’t see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of those who were with me, I came into Damascus.

paite: "Huan mi khat, Ananias Dan lam a Pathian limsak leh huai a Judate tengteng lak a minhoih
english: “One Ananias, a devout man according to the law, well reported of by all the Jews who lived in Damascus,

paite: amah ahong a ka kiang ah ahong dingh a, 'Unau Saul, mitvakna nei in,' ahon chi hi. Huaitak in amah ka mutheita hi.
english: came to me, and standing by me said to me, ‘Brother Saul, receive your sight!’ In that very hour I looked up at him.

paite: Ama'n, 'I pipute Pathian in adeihlam thei ding in ahon deih a, Diktatpa mu a, akamsuak za ding a hon sep ahi, achi hi.
english: He said, ‘The God of our fathers has appointed you to know his will, and to see the Righteous One, and to hear a voice from his mouth.

paite: Na muh leh na zak thu ah mi tengteng kiang ah amah thu theihpihpa na hi ding.
english: For you will be a witness for him to all men of what you have seen and heard.

paite: Huan bangziak a om maimai na hia? Thou inla, Toupa min sam in, baptisma tang inla, na khelhna hihsiang tanla,' ahon chi hi.
english: Now why do you wait? Arise, be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.’

paite: "Jerusalem a ka pai nawn nung, tempul a ka thum lai in, mengmu bang in ka om hi.
english: “When I had returned to Jerusalem and while I prayed in the temple, I fell into a trance

paite: 'Kin inla, Jerusalem a kipan pawt in; ka tanchin na gen ding apom tuak kei uh,' ahon chih lai ka mu hi.
english: and saw him saying to me, ‘Hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they will not receive testimony concerning me from you.’

paite: Huan ke'n, 'Toupa sinagog teng a nang gingta peuhmah hentasak a, ka vuak zeldan athei uhi.
english: I said, ‘Lord, they themselves know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue those who believed in you.

paite: Huan na thu theihpihpa Stephen sisan asuah lai un kei leng akiang uah ka dingh a, asih ding lem ka na sa a, ahihlumte puante leng ka na kem hi,' ka chi hi.
english: When the blood of Stephen, your witness, was shed, I also was standing by, consenting to his death, and guarding the cloaks of those who killed him.’

paite: Huan ama'n, 'Pai in, hiai a kipan in gamlatak a Zentelte kiang ah ka hon sawl ding ahi,' ahon chita hi,” achi hi.
english: “He said to me, ‘Depart, for I will send you out far from here to the Gentiles.’ ”

paite: Huan huai thutan in angaikhia ua; aw ngaihtak in akikou ua, "Mi hichibang hing tak ahi kei, khovel a kipan hihmangthang un," achi uhi.
english: They listened to him until he said that; then they lifted up their voice and said, “Rid the earth of this fellow, for he isn’t fit to live!”

paite: Akikou ua apuan uh alem ua, apai ua, leivui avik uhi,
english: As they cried out, threw off their cloaks, and threw dust into the air,

paite: huchi in sepaih heutu lianpen in Paul sepaihte giahbuk sung a pilut thu apia a, atung ah huchi tel a akikouna uh atheihna ding a soisak kawm a dottel ding in, achi hi.
english: the commanding officer commanded him to be brought into the barracks, ordering him to be examined by scourging, that he might know for what crime they shouted against him like that.

paite: Savun khau a alehhensawm khit un, Paul in akiang a dingh sepaih zaheutu kiang ah, "Siam louh tansak louh Rome mi vuak ding chih nang a ding in dan toh kituak ahi hia?" achi hi.
english: When they had tied him up with straps, Paul asked the centurion who stood by, “Is it lawful for you to scourge a man who is a Roman, and not found guilty?”

paite: Sepaih zaheutu in huai azaktak in, sepaih heutu lianpen kiang ah ahoh a, "Na thilhih ding ah pilvang dih aw; hiai mi Rome mi ana hi," achi a, ahilh hi.
english: When the centurion heard it, he went to the commanding officer and told him, “Watch what you are about to do, for this man is a Roman!”

paite: Sepaih heutu lianpen ahong a, akiang ah, "Rome mi na hi maw? Hon hilh in," achi hi.
english: The commanding officer came and asked him, “Tell me, are you a Roman?” He said, “Yes.”

paite: Ama'n, "Hi e,” achi hi. Sepaih heutu lianpen in, “Ke'n hiai khomi hihna sum tampi a ka lei ei ve," chi in adawng hi. Paul in, "Kei zaw Rome mi a piang him ka hi,” achi hi.
english: The commanding officer answered, “I bought my citizenship for a great price.” Paul said, “But I was born a Roman.”

paite: Huchi in amah dottel tumte'n apaisan pah ngal ua; sepaih heutu lianpen in Rome mi ahi chih atheih in akihta a, ahen ziak in alau hi.
english: Immediately those who were about to examine him departed from him, and the commanding officer also was afraid when he realized that he was a Roman, because he had bound him.

paite: Azing in Judate'n bangziak a Paul hek ahi uhiam chih theihtel tum in, sepaih heutu lianpen in amah aphel a, siampu liante leh vaihawm tengteng kikhop ding thu apia a, Paul pisuk in, ama uah adingsak hi.
english: But on the next day, desiring to know the truth about why he was accused by the Jews, he freed him from the bonds and commanded the chief priests and all the council to come together, and brought Paul down and set him before them.

paite: Paul in vaihawmte a-en kilkel a, "Unaute aw, tuni tan in Pathian mitmuh a ahoih lam hi a ka theih peuhmah hih in ka om hi,” achi hi.
english: Paul, looking steadfastly at the council, said, “Brothers, I have lived before God in all good conscience until today.”

paite: Huan siampu lianpen Ananias in, Paul kiang a dinghte kiang ah, akam betsak ding thu apia hi.
english: The high priest, Ananias, commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.

paite: Paul in akiang ah, “Nang baang nuhngou bang lelpa, Pathian in ahon beng zaw ding, nang dan bang a vaihawm ding a tu a, dan lou bang a mi bet ding na chi vial maw?" achi hi.
english: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to judge me according to the law, and command me to be struck contrary to the law?”

paite: Huan akiang a dinghte'n, "Bangziak a Pathian siampu lianpen tai?" achi uhi.
english: Those who stood by said, “Do you malign God’s high priest?”

paite: Paul in, "Unaute aw, siampu lianpen ahi chih ka thei kei a ahi; na chipihte vaihawmte tung ah thuhoih lou gen ke'n, chih gelh ahi ngal a,” achi hi.
