english: Paul said, “I didn’t know, brothers, that he was high priest. For it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people.’”

paite: Paul in akhen Saddukaite, akhen Pharisaite ahi uh chih atheih in vaihawmte lak ah akikou a, "Unaute aw, Pharisai ka hi, Pharisai tapa leng ka hi; misi lametna leh thohnawnna thu ah vaihawmte mai a dinsak a om ka hi," achi hi.
english: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, “Men and brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees. Concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged!”

paite: Huai agentak in, Pharisaite leh Saddukaite ana kisel ua, vaihawmte akilangkhenta uhi.
english: When he had said this, an argument arose between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the crowd was divided.

paite: Saddukaite'n, misi thohnawnna a-om kei, angelte, khate leng a-om tuan kei, achi ua; Pharisaite'n huaite teng a-om vek chih agen uhi.
english: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess all of these.

paite: Huai thu in nakpitak in abuaita ua; Pharisaite lam a mi laigelhmite khenkhat adingh ua; asel ua, "Hiai mi bangmah agitlouhna i mu kei uh; kha hiam angel hiam in akiang a thu gen hileh, eite Pathian dou suak ding i hi uh,” achi uhi.
english: A great clamor arose, and some of the scribes of the Pharisees’ part stood up, and contended, saying, “We find no evil in this man. But if a spirit or angel has spoken to him, let’s not fight against God!”

paite: Huan kituahlouhna lianpi ahong omtak in, sepaih heutu lianpen in Paul abohzan khak uh alau a, sepaihte kiang ah, ava hohsuk a, alak ua kipan giahbuk a va pitouh teitei ding achi hi.
english: When a great argument arose, the commanding officer, fearing that Paul would be torn in pieces by them, commanded the soldiers to go down and take him by force from among them and bring him into the barracks.

paite: Huan azan in, Paul kiang ah Toupa adingh a, “Khamuangtak in om in, Jerusalem a ka thu na theihsak bang in Rome ah leng na theisak ding hi,” achi hi.
english: The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, “Cheer up, Paul, for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem, so you must testify also at Rome.”

paite: Huan khua ahong vaktak in Judate apanghuan ua, Paul athah masiah uh bangmah ne lou dawn lou ding in akichiamta uhi.
english: When it was day, some of the Jews banded together and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink until they had killed Paul.

paite: Huai thubawlte sawmli sang a tamzaw ahi uh.
english: There were more than forty people who had made this conspiracy.

paite: Amau siampu liante leh upate kiang ah ahoh ua, "Paul ka thah masiah uh bangmah chiam lou ding in ka kichiam uh achi uhi.
english: They came to the chief priests and the elders, and said, “We have bound ourselves under a great curse to taste nothing until we have killed Paul.

paite: Huaiziak in nou vaihawmte toh athu kichian nawn sem a ngaihtuah tum bang in, na kiang ua pekhe ding in sepaih heutu lianpen kiang ah ahem deuh in va gentou un; kou bel na kiangnai uh ahong tun ma a amah that dia mansa ka hi uh,” achi uhi.
english: Now therefore, you with the council inform the commanding officer that he should bring him down to you tomorrow, as though you were going to judge his case more exactly. We are ready to kill him before he comes near.”

paite: Himahleh Paul sanggamnu tapa in athusawm uh ana za a, giahbuk ah ava lut a, Paul ava hilhta hi.
english: But Paul’s sister’s son heard they were lying in wait, and he came and entered into the barracks and told Paul.

paite: Paul in sepaih zaheutu khat asam a, “Hiai tangval sepaih heutu lianpen kiang ah pi in, akiang ah thu banghiam gen ding nei ahih tuak,” achi hi.
english: Paul summoned one of the centurions and said, “Bring this young man to the commanding officer, for he has something to tell him.”

paite: Huchi in sepaih heutu lianpen kiang ah api a, "Paul, hentapa'n ahon sam a, hiai tangval na kiang a hon pi ding in ahon sawl a, na kiang ah thu banghiam gen ding nei ahih tuak,” achi hi.
english: So he took him and brought him to the commanding officer and said, “Paul, the prisoner, summoned me and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.”

paite: Sepaih heutu lianpen in akhut in alen a, asim in atuam paipih a, "Bang ahia hon hilh ding na neih?" chi in adong hi.
english: The commanding officer took him by the hand, and going aside, asked him privately, “What is it that you have to tell me?”

paite: Ama'n, "Paul tungtang kichian nawn sem a na ngaihtuah ding mah bang in, zingchiah vaihawmte kiang ah pisuk ding in Judate'n hon nget hoih asa chiat uh.
english: He said, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though intending to inquire somewhat more accurately concerning him.

paite: Himahleh athu uh na gingta ke'n; alak ua mi sawmli sang a tamzaw in thah asawm ua, huai mite'n amah athah masiah uh bangmah ne lou dawn lou ding in akichiam uh; tu in na thu ngak in mansa in a-om uhi,” achi hi.
english: Therefore don’t yield to them, for more than forty men lie in wait for him, who have bound themselves under a curse to neither eat nor drink until they have killed him. Now they are ready, looking for the promise from you.”

paite: Sepaih lianpen in tangval apaisak a, "Hiai thute na hon theisak chih kuamah hilh ke'n,” achi bikbek hi.
english: So the commanding officer let the young man go, charging him, “Tell no one that you have revealed these things to me.”

paite: Huan sepaih zaheutu nih asam a, "Zan ihsip hun in Kaisaria kho pha a pai ding in sepaih zanih, sakol tungtuangmi sawmsagih, tei tawimi zanih mansa in koih un, achi hi.
english: He called to himself two of the centurions, and said, “Prepare two hundred soldiers to go as far as Caesarea, with seventy horsemen and two hundred men armed with spears, at the third hour of the night.”

paite: Huan Paul tuanna ding sakol leng na ngaihtuahsak unla, gam-ukpa Felik kiang ah bittak in tun un," achi hi.
english: He asked them to provide mounts, that they might set Paul on one, and bring him safely to Felix the governor.

paite: Huan hichibang in lai agelh hi.
english: He wrote a letter like this:

paite: "Klaudias Lisias in Felik gam-ukpa hoihpa chibai abuk hi.
english: “Claudius Lysias to the most excellent governor Felix: Greetings.

paite: Hiai mi Judate'n amu ua, athah dek lai un akiang uah sepaihte pi in ka hoh a, Rome mi ahi chih ka theih in ka hunkheta hi.
english: “This man was seized by the Jews, and was about to be killed by them when I came with the soldiers and rescued him, having learned that he was a Roman.

paite: Huan ahekna uh theih ut in, vaihawmte kiang ah ka pisuk a,
english: Desiring to know the cause why they accused him, I brought him down to their council.

paite: huchi in adan uh banghiam a hek a om ahi chih ka thei a, himahleh ahekna thu uah sihna leh henna ding bangmah ka thei kei hi.
english: I found him to be accused about questions of their law, but not to be charged with anything worthy of death or of imprisonment.

paite: Huan Judate'n amah tang uh ahi chih theihsak a ka omtak in, na kiang ah amah ka hon sawl ngal a, amah hekte leng atung a thubuai aneih peuh uh na ma a gen ding in thu leng ka pia hi," achi hi.
english: When I was told that the Jews lay in wait for the man, I sent him to you immediately, charging his accusers also to bring their accusations against him before you. Farewell.”

paite: Huchi in sepaihte'n athupiak bang in Paul azanzan in api ua, Antipatris atunpih uhi.
english: So the soldiers, carrying out their orders, took Paul and brought him by night to Antipatris.

paite: Huan azing in sakol tungtuang mite akiang a pai zel ding in anusia ua, amau giahbuk ah akik nawnta uhi.
english: But on the next day they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the barracks.

paite: Huan amau Kaisaria khua atung ua, gam-ukpa kiang ah lai apia ua, Paul leng ama ah adingsak uhi.
english: When they came to Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor, they also presented Paul to him.

paite: Gam-ukpa'n asim khit in, Paul omna gam adong hi. Huan Silisia gam a pan ahi chih atheih in,
english: When the governor had read it, he asked what province he was from. When he understood that he was from Cilicia, he said,

paite: "Nang hon hekte ahong tun chiang un na thubuai ka ngaihtuah ding,” achi hi. Herod thukhenna inn a ven ding thu apia hi.
english: “I will hear you fully when your accusers also arrive.” He commanded that he be kept in Herod’s palace.

paite: Huan ni nga nung in siampu lianpen Ananias ahong tungsuk a, upa kuate hiam toh, amin Tertullas thugen siam khat toh; Paul tung a thubuai gam-ukpa kiang ah agen uhi.
english: After five days, the high priest, Ananias, came down with certain elders and an orator, one Tertullus. They informed the governor against Paul.

paite: Paul asapkhiak nung un Tertullas in amah ahek pan a, "Felik hoihpen, nangmah vang a khamuang petpet a ka om ziak un leh na hon kepna ziak a hiai namte a ding a kipuahthakna a-om zel ziak in,
english: When he was called, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, “Seeing that by you we enjoy much peace, and that prosperity is coming to this nation by your foresight,

paite: chik lai peuh in koipeuh ah leng lungkimtak in ka pom gige uhi.
english: we accept it in all ways and in all places, most excellent Felix, with all thankfulness.

paite: Akoi abang hitaleh, nang a dia chimtakhuai hih ka ut kei hi, na migitna in thu kam khat ahihleh hon ngaihkhiaksak ding in ka hon ngen hi.
english: But that I don’t delay you, I entreat you to bear with us and hear a few words.

paite: Hiai mihuathuaipi, khovel a Judate tengteng tokbuaipa leh Nazarit mite pawl a amakaipen khat uh ahih ka thei uhi.
english: For we have found this man to be a plague, an instigator of insurrections among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes.

paite: Tempul hihbuah leng atum a; huaiziak in ka man uhi.
english: He even tried to profane the temple, and we arrested him.

paite: Nangmah ngei in amah dongtel in ka hekna tengteng uh na theithei ding hi," achi hi.
english: By examining him yourself you may ascertain all these things of which we accuse him.”

paite: Huan Judate'n leng huai thu huchibang ahi, chi in apanpih uhi.
english: The Jews also joined in the attack, affirming that these things were so.

paite: Huan gam-ukpa'n thugen ding a Paul akhutvantak in, hichi in adawng a, "Ama'n nang kum tampi hiai namte vai hawmsakpa na hi chih ka theih ziak in kipaktak in ka siamna thu ka gen ding ahi.
english: When the governor had beckoned to him to speak, Paul answered, “Because I know that you have been a judge of this nation for many years, I cheerfully make my defense,

paite: Jerusalem a Pathian be ding a ka hohtouh nung ni sawm-le-nih aval nai kei ding chih na na thei ding hi.
english: seeing that you can verify that it is not more than twelve days since I went up to worship at Jerusalem.

paite: Tempul ah hiam sinagog ah hiam, khua ah leng mi kuahiam ka sel leh mipi ka hanthawn lam amau zong ahon mu kei uh.
english: In the temple they didn’t find me disputing with anyone or stirring up a crowd, either in the synagogues or in the city.

paite: Tu'n ah leng ahon hekna thu uh na theih in abul asuikhe thei kei ding uh.
english: Nor can they prove to you the things of which they now accuse me.

paite: Himahleh hiai thu na kiang ah ka genkhe ding, Dan leh zawlneite thugelh tengteng gingta in, pawl tuam achihte uh Lampi dan bang in ka pipute uh Pathian ka be zel hi.
english: But this I confess to you, that according to the Way, which they call a sect, so I serve the God of our fathers, believing all things which are according to the law, and which are written in the prophets;

paite: Pathian ah lametna nei in, hiai mite'n leng huai agintak sam uh, midiktatte leh diktatloute thohnawnna a-om ding hi.
english: having hope toward God, which these also themselves look for, that there will be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.

paite: Huchi ahih ziak in Pathian leh mihing tung a hihkhial lou ding in sia-le-pha siangtak nei ding in ka kibawl gige hi.
english: In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.

paite: "Huan kum tampi nung in ka chipihte kiang ah thilpiak ding leh thillat ding hon tawi in ka hong hi.
english: Now after some years, I came to bring gifts for the needy to my nation, and offerings;

paite: Huai thil ka piak lai in, Asia gam a kipan Juda mi khenkhatte'n mipi pang lou leh buaina om lou in, tempul ah kisiangsak in ahon mu uhi.
english: amid which certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, not with a mob, nor with turmoil.

paite: Hiai mite'n ka tung a thubuai nei hi le uh na ma ah hong pai in ahong hek khinta ding uhi.
english: They ought to have been here before you and to make accusation if they had anything against me.

paite: Ahihkeileh hiai mite ngei in vaihawmte ma a ka din lai in, ka hihkhelh bang ahia amuh uh, gen uhen.
english: Or else let these men themselves say what injustice they found in me when I stood before the council,

paite: Alak ua dingh a, 'Misi thohnawnna thu ah tuni in na ma uah salh in ka om ahi,' ka chih a hiai thu kam khat ziak houh ahih kei ngalleh, chi in adawng hi."
english: unless it is for this one thing that I cried standing among them, ‘Concerning the resurrection of the dead I am being judged before you today!’”

paite: Huan Felik hiai thilte azak a, Lampi thu atheihchet ziak in, "Sepaih heutu lianpen Lisias ahong tunsuk hun chiah na thu uh ka lem ding," chi in akoih tadih hi.
english: But Felix, having more exact knowledge concerning the Way, deferred them, saying, “When Lysias, the commanding officer, comes down, I will decide your case.”

paite: Sepaih zaheutu kiang ah, Paul zalentak leh alawmte amah hong veh leh nek-tak abawlsak utte kham lou a, vensak ding in thu apia hi.
english: He ordered the centurion that Paul should be kept in custody and should have some privileges, and not to forbid any of his friends to serve him or to visit him.

paite: Huan ni bangzah hiam nung in Felik ahong nawn a, azi Drusilla, Juda numei toh, Paul asamsak a, Khrist Jesu ginna thu angaikhia hi.
english: After some days, Felix came with Drusilla his wife, who was a Jewess, and sent for Paul and heard him concerning the faith in Christ Jesus.

paite: Paul in diktatna thu, kidek thu, thukhen vaihawmna hong tung dingte asuipih detdet lai in, Felik in lauhuai asa mahmah a, "Pai nawn phot inla, hunlem ka neih hun chiang in ka hon sam ding," achi hi.
english: As he reasoned about righteousness, self-control, and the judgment to come, Felix was terrified, and answered, “Go your way for this time, and when it is convenient for me, I will summon you.”

paite: Paul in dangka apiak peuh alamen a, huaiziak in asam mun hial a, ahoupih zihzeh hi.
english: Meanwhile, he also hoped that money would be given to him by Paul, that he might release him. Therefore also he sent for him more often and talked with him.

paite: Himahleh kum nih akivei sung in Porsias Festas in Felik mun ahon kheng a; Felik in Judate deihsakna ngah a-ut ziak in, hensa in Paul anuseta hi.
english: But when two years were fulfilled, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus, and desiring to gain favor with the Jews, Felix left Paul in bonds.

paite: Huchi in Festas in gamukna alak nung ni thum zoh in Kaisaria a kipan Jerusalem ah ahohtou hi.
english: Festus therefore, having come into the province, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.

paite: Siampu liante leh Juda makaite'n akiang ah Paul tungtang thu aselam in ana theisak uhi.
english: Then the high priest and the principal men of the Jews informed him against Paul, and they begged him,

paite: Jerusalem khua a pitouhsak ding in adeihsakna leng ana ngen ua; lampi a na lamtan a thah ding atum uhi.
english: asking a favor against him, that he would summon him to Jerusalem, plotting to kill him on the way.

paite: Himahleh Festas in, “Kaisaria a Paul kep ding leh amah leng huai lam a hoh pah ding,” achi hi.
english: However Festus answered that Paul should be kept in custody at Caesarea, and that he himself was about to depart shortly.

paite: Huaiziak in "Huai mi'n gitlouhna nei ahihleh na lak ua thunei peuhmah in hon zuisuk in hong hek uhen," chi in adawng hi.
english: “Let them therefore”, he said, “that are in power among you go down with me, and if there is anything wrong in the man, let them accuse him.”

paite: Alak ua ni sawm val ataam nung in, Kaisaria ah apaisuk a; azing in thukhenna tutphah a tu in, Paul hon pi ding in thu apia hi.
english: When he had stayed among them more than ten days, he went down to Caesarea, and on the next day he sat on the judgment seat, and commanded Paul to be brought.

paite: Paul ahong tun phet in, Jerusalem khua a kipan Juda hong sukte akim ah adingh ua, suikhiak vual louh ding thubuai tampi giktak tak agen uhi.
english: When he had come, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing against him many and grievous charges which they could not prove,

paite: Paul in asiamna thu agen a, "Judate dan hi in tempul thu hitaleh, Kaisar tung ah leng bangmah hihkhelh ka nei kei," achi hi.
english: while he said in his defense, “Neither against the law of the Jews, nor against the temple, nor against Caesar, have I sinned at all.”

paite: Himahleh Festas in Judate deihsakna ngah a-ut ziak in Paul kiang ah, "Jerusalem a hohtouh a, huai lai a ka ma a hiai thute lepsak na deih hia?" chi in adong hi.
english: But Festus, desiring to gain favor with the Jews, answered Paul and said, “Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem and be judged by me there concerning these things?”

paite: Paul in, "Kaisar thukhenna tutphah ma a, vai hawmsak a om ding in ka dingh hi. Judate tung ah thil bangmah ka hihkhial kei chih nangmah in leng na theichian mahmah hi.
english: But Paul said, “I am standing before Caesar’s judgment seat, where I ought to be tried. I have done no wrong to the Jews, as you also know very well.

paite: Migilou ka hih a, sihna khop hial khelhna ka hihleh, sih leng ka nial kei; himahleh hiaite hon hekna abul bangmah a-om keileh kuamah in akiang uah hon pekhe thei kei ding. Kaisar kiang ah ka tun ding,” achi hi.
english: For if I have done wrong and have committed anything worthy of death, I don’t refuse to die; but if none of those things is true that they accuse me of, no one can give me up to them. I appeal to Caesar!”

paite: Huan Festas in avaihawmpihte ahoulimpih kimvel nung in, "Kaisar kiang a thu tut ding na ngen maw? Kaisar kiang ah na pai mahmah ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, “You have appealed to Caesar. To Caesar you shall go.”

paite: Ni bangzah hiam nung in kumpipa Agrippa leh Barnis, Kaisaria khua ahong tung ua, Festas chibai abuk uhi.
english: Now when some days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice arrived at Caesarea and greeted Festus.

paite: Huai a ni tampi ataam ziak un Festas in Paul thubuai kumpipa kiang ah aluikhia a, "Felik in mitang kuahiam anusia hi.
english: As he stayed there many days, Festus laid Paul’s case before the king, saying, “There is a certain man left a prisoner by Felix;

paite: Jerusalem a ka om lai in siampu liante leh Juda upate'n atungtang thu ahon hilh ua, siam louh tansak ahon ngen uhi.
english: about whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me, asking for a sentence against him.

paite: Ke'n amaute kiang ah, ahekpa uleh amah hekte akimaituah ua, ahekna thu ua asiamna thu genna hunlem aneih ma in, mi kuahiam thah ding a piakkhiak Rome mite dan ahi kei, chi in ka dawng hi.
english: I answered them that it is not the custom of the Romans to give up any man to destruction before the accused has met the accusers face to face and has had opportunity to make his defense concerning the matter laid against him.

paite: Huchi in hiai lai ka hong tun un, sawt hal lou in azing in thukhenna tutphah ah ka tu a, huai mipa hon pi ding in thu ka pia hi.
english: When therefore they had come together here, I didn’t delay, but on the next day sat on the judgment seat and commanded the man to be brought.

paite: Ahekte adin lai un, ka muanmohdan ngohna atung ah gitlouhna thubuai agen kei uhi.
english: When the accusers stood up, they brought no charges against him of such things as I supposed;

paite: Asabiak thu ua, Jesu, mi khat sisa, Paul in ahing nawn ahi, chi a agup ziak in atung ah thubuai anei uh ana hi zaw hi.
english: but had certain questions against him about their own religion and about one Jesus, who was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.

paite: Ke'n huai thute ngaihtuahdan ding ka thei kei a, Jerusalem a hoh a, huai lai a huai thu lepsak a-utleh ut louh ka dong hi.
english: Being perplexed how to inquire concerning these things, I asked whether he was willing to go to Jerusalem and there be judged concerning these matters.

paite: Himahleh Paul in Kumpipa lep dia sit angen zawta hi. Huaiziak in Kaisar kiang a ka sawl theih masiah veng ding in thu ka pia hi,” achi hi.
english: But when Paul had appealed to be kept for the decision of the emperor, I commanded him to be kept until I could send him to Caesar.”

paite: Huan Agrippa in Festas kiang ah, "Hiai mi thu kei mahmah in zak ka ut gige ahi," achi hi. Ama'n, “Zingchiah athugen na ngaikhe ding," achi hi.
english: Agrippa said to Festus, “I also would like to hear the man myself.” “Tomorrow,” he said, “you shall hear him.”

paite: Huchi in azing in Agrippa leh Barnis thupitak in ahong ua, thugenna inn ah alut ua, sepaih heutu liante toh, khua a milian deuhte toh; huan Festas thu in Paul apilutsak uhi.
english: So on the next day, when Agrippa and Bernice had come with great pomp, and they had entered into the place of hearing with the commanding officers and the principal men of the city, at the command of Festus, Paul was brought in.

paite: Huan Festas in, “Kumpipa Agrippa leh hiai lai a om tengtengte aw, hiai mi na muh uh ahi, atungtang thu a Judate tengteng in, hing tak nawn lou ding chi a kikou a, Jerusalem khua leh hiai lai a ka kiang a ahek uh ahi.
english: Festus said, “King Agrippa, and all men who are here present with us, you see this man about whom all the multitude of the Jews petitioned me, both at Jerusalem and here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.

paite: Himahleh sihna ding khop bangmah ahih kei chih ka thei hi. Huan ama'n Kumpipa kiang a tut anget ziak in sawl ka tum ahi;
english: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and as he himself appealed to the emperor, I determined to send him,

paite: Himahleh ka toupa kiang ah atungthu ginatak in bangmah gelh ding ka thei kei hi. Huaiziak in na ma uah ka hon pikhia hi, Kumpipa Agrippa nangmah ma a hon pi tuanse ka hi a, etchet nung a banghiam bek gelh ding ka muhtheihna ding in.
english: of whom I have no certain thing to write to my lord. Therefore I have brought him out before you, and especially before you, King Agrippa, that, after examination I may have something to write.

paite: Hekna kiteltak omloupi a henta kuahiam Kumpipa kiang a sawl thil haihuai hi in ka thei hi,” achi hi.
english: For it seems to me unreasonable, in sending a prisoner, not to also specify the charges against him.”

paite: Huai zoh in Agrippa in Paul kiang ah, "Na siamna thu na gen thei," achi hi. Huan Paul in akhut avan a, asiamna thu agen hi.
english: Agrippa said to Paul, “You may speak for yourself.” Then Paul stretched out his hand, and made his defense.

paite: "Kumpipa Agrippa, Judate'n ahon hekna tengteng uah ka siamna thu gen ding a tuni a na ma a ka din theih hampha ka kisa hi.
english: “I think myself happy, King Agrippa, that I am to make my defense before you today concerning all the things the Jews accuse me of,

paite: Judate tawndan leh pupa ngeinate theisiam leh pil mahmah na hih ziak in ka kipak tuanse hi. Huaiziak in thuakzoutak in ka thugen hon ngaihkhiaksak ding in ka hon ngen hi.
english: especially because you are expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews. Therefore I beg you to hear me patiently.

paite: "Ka tuailai hun a kipan ka chipihte lak leh Jerusalem a ka omdan Judate tengteng in athei uhi.
english: “Indeed, all the Jews know my way of life from my youth up, which was from the beginning among my own nation and at Jerusalem;

paite: Atung a kipan a ka tanchin theite ahi ua, huchi a ka sabiakdan ua ngentelpen a khosa Pharisai ka hihdan a-ut ualeh ahon genpih thei uhi.
english: having known me from the first, if they are willing to testify, that after the strictest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.

paite: Pathian in ka pipute uh kiang a thu achiam lametna ziak in tu in hiai ah vai hawmsak in ka dingh hi.
english: Now I stand here to be judged for the hope of the promise made by God to our fathers,

paite: Huai thuchiam lametna ziak in ka nam uh sawm-le-nih in, sun leh zan in Pathian nna phatuamngaitak a sem in muh alamen uhi. Kumpipa aw, huai lametna tungthu ah Judate'n ahon hek uhi.
english: which our twelve tribes, earnestly serving night and day, hope to attain. Concerning this hope I am accused by the Jews, King Agrippa!

paite: Pathian in misite akaithou ding chih bangchidan a thil hi thei lou a ngaihtuah na hi ua?
english: Why is it judged incredible with you if God does raise the dead?

paite: "Kei mahmah in Nazaret Jesu min kalh a hihtheih teng hih thil hoih hi in ka na ngaihtuah hi.
english: “I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.

paite: Huai bang Jerusalem ah leng ka hih zel hi; siampu liante kiang a thu mu in, misiangthoute lak a mi tampi suangkul ah ka khum zel hi; ahihlup lai un lemsa lam ah leng ka na pang zel hi.
english: I also did this in Jerusalem. I both shut up many of the saints in prisons, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death I gave my vote against them.

paite: Huan sinagog teng ah ka sawi gige a, Jesu thu gensiatsak ka tum teitei hi. Huan atung uah ka gilou mahmah a, gamdang khuate tanpha in leng ka sawi zel hi.
english: Punishing them often in all the synagogues, I tried to make them blaspheme. Being exceedingly enraged against them, I persecuted them even to foreign cities.

paite: "Huchibang a hih ding in siampu liante thu mu in leh asawlna lai uh tawi in Damaskas ah ka hoh hi.
english: “Whereupon as I traveled to Damascus with the authority and commission from the chief priests,

paite: Kumpipa aw, huchi a ka pai lai in sun laitak in, nisa vak sang a vakphazaw van a kipan in keimah leh ka paipihte kim ah hong vak ka mu hi.
english: at noon, O king, I saw on the way a light from the sky, brighter than the sun, shining around me and those who traveled with me.

paite: Ka vek un lei ah ka puk ua, Hebru pau in, 'Saul, Saul, nang bang achia hon sawi? Sutna chiangzum tot nang dia na ahi,' hon chi in ka za hi.
english: When we had all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.’

paite: Ke'n, 'Toupa, kua na hia?' ka chi hi. Toupa'n, 'Na sawi, Jesu ka hi,' achi hi.
english: “I said, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ “He said, ‘I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

paite: Himahleh thou inla dingh in; hiai na thil muhte leh na kiang a ka hon lah lai dingte sem ding leh theihpih dia sikha a nang hon bawl ding in na kiang ah ka hong kilak ahi.
english: But arise, and stand on your feet, for I have appeared to you for this purpose: to appoint you a servant and a witness both of the things which you have seen and of the things which I will reveal to you;

paite: Mi tengteng leh ka hon sawlna mite, Zentelte khut a kipan ka hon humhing ding;
english: delivering you from the people and from the Gentiles, to whom I send you,

paite: amit uh hihvak ding in akiang uah ka hon sawl ahi, huchi in mial a pan vak lam anga ding ua, Setan thuneihna Pathian lam angatsan ding uhi, khelhna ngaihdamna amuhna ding uleh ahon gintak ziak ua sehtuam siangthoute lak a goutan aneihna ding un," achi hi.
english: to open their eyes, that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive remission of sins and an inheritance among those who are sanctified by faith in me.’

paite: "Huaiziak in kumpipa Agrippa aw, van a kilakna ka sel kei hi.
english: “Therefore, King Agrippa, I was not disobedient to the heavenly vision,

paite: Atung in Damaskas a mite kiang ah, huan Jerusalem ah, Judia leh gam chih a mite kiang leh Zentelte kiang ah leng athilhih uh kisik a, Pathian lam angatna ding un ka hilh zaw hi.
english: but declared first to them of Damascus, at Jerusalem, and throughout all the country of Judea, and also to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, doing works worthy of repentance.

paite: Hiaite ziak in Judate'n tempul ah ahon man ua, hon hihlup atum uhi.
english: For this reason the Jews seized me in the temple and tried to kill me.

paite: Himahleh Pathian kiang a kipan a panpihna ka muh ziak in tuni tan in mineute leh miliante kiang a thu theisak in ka om lai hi; zawlneite leh Mosi in hong tung ding achih thu kia uh lou ngal thudang gen lou in.
english: Having therefore obtained the help that is from God, I stand to this day testifying both to small and great, saying nothing but what the prophets and Moses said would happen,

paite: Huchi a, Khrist in gim athuak ding a, misi lak a kipan athohnawn ziak a mi tengteng kiang leh Zentelte kiang a vak musakpa masapen ahi ding achih thu uh," achi hi.
english: how the Christ must suffer, and how, by the resurrection of the dead, he would be first to proclaim light both to these people and to the Gentiles.”

paite: Huchibang a asiamna thu agen lai in, Festas in, aw ngaihtak in, "Paul, hai na hi; na theih tamna in nang hon haisak ahi," achi hi.
english: As he thus made his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, “Paul, you are crazy! Your great learning is driving you insane!”

paite: Himahleh Paul in, Festas hoihpen, "Hai kei veng e; thu diktak leh thu piltak ka gen zaw ahi.
english: But he said, “I am not crazy, most excellent Festus, but boldly declare words of truth and reasonableness.

paite: Hiai thute kumpipa'n athei, akiang ah leng hangsantak in ka gen ahi; hiai thil bangmah akiang ah iim ahi kei chih diktak in ka thei hi. Hiai thu inkil kawm peuh a aguk a hih ahi kei hi.
english: For the king knows of these things, to whom also I speak freely. For I am persuaded that none of these things is hidden from him, for this has not been done in a corner.

paite: Kumpipa Agrippa, zawlneite na gingta hia? Na gingta chih ka thei,” achi hi.
english: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know that you believe.”

paite: Agrippa in Paul kiang ah, "Sawt louchik sung in Khristian na hon suaksak zou dek," achi hi.
english: Agrippa said to Paul, “With a little persuasion are you trying to make me a Christian?”

paite: Paul in, "Sawt in tom taleh, nang kia ka chi kei, tuni a ka thu za tengteng leng keimah bang a om ding in Pathian kiang ah ka ngen ahi, hiai kolbutte chih louh ngal," achita hi.
english: Paul said, “I pray to God, that whether with little or with much, not only you, but also all that hear me today, might become such as I am, except for these bonds.”

paite: Huan thu agen zoh in kumpipa adingtou a, gam-ukpa, Barnis leh akiang ua tute leng adingh chiat uhi.
english: The king rose up with the governor and Bernice, and those who sat with them.

paite: Apaituam ua akihou ua, “Hiai mi'n sihna leh kolbutna khop hial thil bangmah ahih kei,” achi uhi.
english: When they had withdrawn, they spoke to one another, saying, “This man does nothing worthy of death or of bonds.”

paite: Agrippa in Festas kiang ah, "Hiai mi'n Kaisar kiang a tut ding na ngen lou hileh pawt mai ding hiven,” achi hi.
english: Agrippa said to Festus, “This man might have been set free if he had not appealed to Caesar.”

paite: Itali gam a long a pai ding thu ahihpuktak un, Paul leh henta dang kuate hiam Augusta pawl a sepaih zaheutu, amin Julias akemsak uhi.
english: When it was determined that we should sail for Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners to a centurion named Julius, of the Augustan band.

paite: Huan Adramittium kho long, Asia gam tuipi piau a kho omte tawn ding ah ka tuang ua, tuipi ah ka paita uhi. Ka kiang uah Masidonia gam a mi Aristarkhas, Thessalonika khomi a-om hi.
english: Embarking in a ship of Adramyttium, which was about to sail to places on the coast of Asia, we put to sea, Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica being with us.

paite: Azing in Sidon khua ka tawn uhi. Julias in Paul alimbawl ngial a, kihihhalh ding in alawmte kiang ah apawtsak hi.
english: The next day, we touched at Sidon. Julius treated Paul kindly and gave him permission to go to his friends and refresh himself.

paite: Huai a kipan in tuipi ah ka pai nawn ua, huih in ahi lou lam a hon mut ziak in Kupra tuikulh zul huih hatlouhna lam ah ka tai uhi.
english: Putting to sea from there, we sailed under the lee of Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.

paite: Silisia gam leh Pamphilia gamzul tuipi ka khen nung un, Lisia gam a Mira khua ka tung uhi.
english: When we had sailed across the sea which is off Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.

paite: Huai ah sepaih zaheutupa'n Aleksandria kho long Itali gam tawn ding amu a; huai ah hon tuangsak hi.
english: There the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing for Italy, and he put us on board.

paite: Ni tampi, awlawl in ka pai ua, Knidas kho zawn haksapi in ka tung teitei ua, huih in hon sawnkik ziak in Salmoni zuan in Krit tuikulh zul huih hatlouhna lam ah ka tai uhi.
english: When we had sailed slowly many days, and had come with difficulty opposite Cnidus, the wind not allowing us further, we sailed under the lee of Crete, opposite Salmone.

paite: Haksatak in tui geigei ah ka pai ua, Longkhawlna Kilawm achih mun uh ka tungta ua; huai kiang ah Lasea khua a-om hi.
english: With difficulty sailing along it we came to a certain place called Fair Havens, near the city of Lasea.

paite: Huan ni tampi abei tak ziak in leh long a pai alauhuai ziak in, An Ngawl ni akhengta ngal a, Paul in amau athuhilh a, akiang uah,
english: When much time had passed and the voyage was now dangerous because the Fast had now already gone by, Paul admonished them

paite: "Pute aw, tua long a tuangte siatna leh manthatna thupitak i tung ua tung ding ahi chih ka thei a, avante leh long tung ah kia ka chi kei a, eimah tung ah leng ka chi ahi," achi hi.
english: and said to them, “Sirs, I perceive that the voyage will be with injury and much loss, not only of the cargo and the ship, but also of our lives.”

paite: Himahleh sepaih zaheutu in Paul thugen sang in longpu leh long neipa thu agingta zaw hi.
english: But the centurion gave more heed to the master and to the owner of the ship than to those things which were spoken by Paul.

paite: Phalbi douna ding in longkhawlna aginat louh ziak in atamzaw in huai a kipan a tuipi a paikhiak a, bangchi hiam bek a Phoenik khua tun teitei a, huai lai a phalbi dou asawmpih ua; Phoenik ahihleh Krit tuikulh a longkhawlna khat ahi a, simtum leh maltum lam doh ahi.
english: Because the haven was not suitable to winter in, the majority advised going to sea from there, if by any means they could reach Phoenix and winter there, which is a port of Crete, looking southwest and northwest.

paite: Sim huih awlawl a ahong nuntak in adeihlam uh mu akisa ua, sikkip akhaikhia ua, Krit tuikulh zulzul ah apai uhi.
english: When the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, they weighed anchor and sailed along Crete, close to shore.

paite: Himahleh sawt lou nung in huih hattak, Euroklidon kichi, gam lam a kipan in ahong nung hi.
english: But before long, a stormy wind beat down from shore, which is called Euroclydon.

paite: Long ahon mutkhata a, huihlam angat theih louhtak in ka khahta ua, hon mutleng hon mutlengta hi.
english: When the ship was caught and couldn’t face the wind, we gave way to it and were driven along.

paite: Kauda tuikulh neuchik petmah pansan in huih hatlouhna lam ah ka tai ua, haksatak in long neu ka bitsak thei ham uhi.
english: Running under the lee of a small island called Clauda, we were able, with difficulty, to secure the boat.

paite: Akaihkhiak nung un panpihna khaute khawng azang ua, long nuailam ah vial kawm in akhih uhi. Puanzakna bangkim apuksak ua, huchi lou in zaw Sirtis piaunel kip lou a lenlut alau ua, huchi in huih mutdan dungzui in apai uhi.
english: After they had hoisted it up, they used cables to help reinforce the ship. Fearing that they would run aground on the Syrtis sand bars, they lowered the sea anchor, and so were driven along.

paite: Tuikihot in hon sep ek ziak in, azing in tui lak ah long a vante apaikheta uhi.
english: As we labored exceedingly with the storm, the next day they began to throw things overboard.

paite: Huan ani thum ni in, amau khut in long vante apaikhe nawnta uhi.
english: On the third day, they threw out the ship’s tackle with their own hands.

paite: Huan ni tampi nisa leh aksi leng akimu kei a, huihpi hat petmah in hon nuai a, hin himhim ka lamen nawn kei uhi.
english: When neither sun nor stars shone on us for many days, and no small storm pressed on us, all hope that we would be saved was now taken away.

paite: Huan an ne lou a sawttak a-om nung un, alak uah Paul adingh a, "Pute aw, Krit tuikulh a kiphel lou dia, ka thu ngaikhia hi le uchin hiai siatna leh manthatna tuah louh ding hi zen a.
english: When they had been long without food, Paul stood up in the middle of them and said, “Sirs, you should have listened to me, and not have set sail from Crete and have gotten this injury and loss.

paite: Himahleh tu'n ah leng khamuangtak a om ding in ka hon hanthawn lai hi. Na lak uah kuamah in hinna na mangsak kei ding uh, long zaw amangthang ding.
english: Now I exhort you to cheer up, for there will be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship.

paite: Amah Pathian a ka hih a, a-nna leng ka sep, amah angel tuzan in ka kiang ah ahong dingh a, ka kiang ah,
english: For there stood by me this night an angel, belonging to the God whose I am and whom I serve,

paite: 'Paul, lau ke'n, Kaisar ma ah na dingh ding. Ngai in, long a na kiang a zin tengteng leng Pathian in ahon pia hi,' ahon chi hi.
english: saying, ‘Don’t be afraid, Paul. You must stand before Caesar. Behold, God has granted you all those who sail with you.’

paite: Huaiziak in Pute aw, khamuangtak in om un, Pathian ka gingta hi, hon hilh bang in a-om ding hi.
english: Therefore, sirs, cheer up! For I believe God, that it will be just as it has been spoken to me.

paite: Himahleh bang tuikulh hiam ah zaw ahon lenkhe ding," achi hi.
english: But we must run aground on a certain island.”

paite: Zan sawm-le-li achin zan in Adria tuipi ah huih in alanglang ah ahon mutleng leng lai hi. Zankim lai in, long mite'n koi gam hiam tung dek in akithei uhi.
english: But when the fourteenth night had come, as we were driven back and forth in the Adriatic Sea, about midnight the sailors surmised that they were drawing near to some land.

paite: Huchi in tui thukdan ateh ua, laam sawmnih hi in athei ua, huan sawt louchik in ateh nawn ua, laam sawm-le-nga hi in athei uhi.
english: They took soundings and found twenty fathoms. After a little while, they took soundings again, and found fifteen fathoms.

paite: Huan longmei lam ah sikkip li akhia ua, huchi lou in zaw suang se mun ah hon lenkhe zenzen kha ding chih alau ua; huan khovak kal angaklahtak in a-om uhi.
english: Fearing that we would run aground on rocky ground, they let go four anchors from the stern, and wished for daylight.

paite: Huan long mite'n long malam a sikkipte khiak ding bawl a kineih in tuipi ah long neu akhia ua, long taisan atum uhi.
english: As the sailors were trying to flee out of the ship and had lowered the boat into the sea, pretending that they would lay out anchors from the bow,

paite: Hiai lai in Paul in, sepaih zaheutu leh sepaihte kiang ah, "Hiaite long a a-om gige kei uleh abit kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, “Unless these stay in the ship, you can’t be saved.”

paite: Huchi in sepaihte'n long neu khaute a-attat ua, akhahta uhi.
english: Then the soldiers cut away the ropes of the boat and let it fall off.

paite: Khovak kuan in, Paul in an ne ding in mi tengteng asawl a, "Tuni bangmah ne lou a na om ua, an na ngawlna uh ani sawm-le-li ni ahita.
english: While the day was coming on, Paul begged them all to take some food, saying, “Today is the fourteenth day that you wait and continue fasting, having taken nothing.

paite: Huaiziak in an ne ding in ka hon sawl chiat ahi; na damna ding uh; na lak uah kuamah asamzang khat leng amangthang kei ding,” achi hi.
english: Therefore I beg you to take some food, for this is for your safety; for not a hair will perish from any of your heads.”

paite: Huai thu agen khit in tanghou ala a, Pathian kiang ah kipahthu agen khit in, mi tengteng ma ah abalkham a, ane panta hi.
english: When he had said this and had taken bread, he gave thanks to God in the presence of all; then he broke it and began to eat.

paite: Amau leng khamuangtak in a-om ua, an ane samta uhi.
english: Then they all cheered up, and they also took food.

paite: Long a mite ka vek un zanih sawmsagih-le-guk ka hi uhi.
english: In all, we were two hundred seventy-six souls on the ship.

paite: An anek kham khit un, tuipi ah buh apai ua, long ahihzang deuh uhi.
english: When they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.

paite: Huan ni asuah in, koi lai gam ahia chih athei kei ua; himahleh, koi lai longkhawlna hiam piautak nei khat amu ua, huai tung ah ahihtheih uleh long taikhiaksak atum uhi.
english: When it was day, they didn’t recognize the land, but they noticed a certain bay with a beach, and they decided to try to drive the ship onto it.

paite: Huan sikkip khihnate a-attat ua, tuipi ah anusia ua; huchih lai mah in kaihheina khihnate aphel ua, huih mut ding in malam puanzak akaitou ua; piautak azuanta uhi.
english: Casting off the anchors, they left them in the sea, at the same time untying the rudder ropes. Hoisting up the foresail to the wind, they made for the beach.

paite: Himahleh tuikihot khauh nih kituahna mun ah ka lutkha zenzen ua, long in lei hetkha in, huan, long mailam atang bikbekta a, hihtat zoh louh in a-omta a, tuikihot ahat ziak in longmei lam akekgawpta hi.
english: But coming to a place where two seas met, they ran the vessel aground. The bow struck and remained immovable, but the stern began to break up by the violence of the waves.

paite: Huan hentate, tui liau galkai khattou a om kha ding ua, ataimang kha ding uh chih alauh man un sepaihte'n amaute hihlup mai asawm uhi.
english: The soldiers’ counsel was to kill the prisoners, so that none of them would swim out and escape.

paite: Himahleh sepaih zaheutu in Paul humhing a-ut a, athiltup uh akham a; tuileuh siam peuhmah tuipi a tawmkhiak a gam na kai masa ding leh,
english: But the centurion, desiring to save Paul, stopped them from their purpose, and commanded that those who could swim should throw themselves overboard first to go toward the land;

paite: midang akhen singpek tung leh akhen long van tung a kitholh galkai ding in thu apia hi. Huchi in avek un gam ah bittak in agalkai vek uhi.
english: and the rest should follow, some on planks and some on other things from the ship. So they all escaped safely to the land.

paite: Huan gam a ka suahtak un, tuikulh min tuh Malta ahi chih ka theita uhi.
english: When we had escaped, then they learned that the island was called Malta.

paite: Tuikulh gam mite'n asiam theihtawp uh suah in hon na hehpih ua; vuah ahong zuk ziak leh khovot ziak in mei atoh ua, ka vek un hon na kipahpih uhi.
english: The natives showed us uncommon kindness; for they kindled a fire and received us all, because of the present rain and because of the cold.

paite: Paul in singlom khat atom a mei ah achih a, asat ziak in gul ahong vakkhia a, akhut a tu in atangden hi.
english: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat and fastened on his hand.

paite: Tuikulh gam mite'n ganhing akhut a kikhaiden amuh un, "Hiai mi tualthat ahi ding, tuipi a kipan taikhe mahleh diktatna in ahin phalta lou ahi,” achi uhi.
english: When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he has escaped from the sea, yet Justice has not allowed to live.”

paite: Himahleh ama'n mei ah gul asingkhia a, bangmah achi kei hi.
english: However he shook off the creature into the fire, and wasn’t harmed.

paite: Amau bel abawk hiam, thakhat a puk pah a si ding in agingta uh; hun sawtpi angak nilouh ua, bangmah achi kei chih atheih un alungsim uh akheng ua, Pathian ahi achi zaw uhi.
english: But they expected that he would have swollen or fallen down dead suddenly, but when they watched for a long time and saw nothing bad happen to him, they changed their minds and said that he was a god.

paite: Huai mun kiang ah huai tuikulh a hausapa, amin Publias a-om a, huai mi in ahon na kipahpih a, ni thum siamtak in ahon tungsak hi.
english: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us and courteously entertained us for three days.

paite: Publias pa khosik leh santen vei in ana lum a; akiang ah Paul alut a, athum a, atung ah akhut koih in ahihdamta hi.
english: The father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery. Paul entered in to him, prayed, and laying his hands on him, healed him.

paite: Huai ahihdam khit in tuikulh a midang natna nei peuhmah ahong ua; adam chiatta uhi.
english: Then when this was done, the rest also who had diseases in the island came and were cured.

paite: Huai mite'n nakpitak in ahon na pahtawi ua; ka pai ding un long ah ka vante uh ahong koih uhi.
english: They also honored us with many honors; and when we sailed, they put on board the things that we needed.

paite: Huan kha thum nung in, Aleksandria kho long, phalbi a tuikulh a omsa, unau phik, Kastor leh Pollux lutang kisuanna long ah ka pai uhi.
english: After three months, we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose figurehead was “The Twin Brothers.”

paite: Sairakus khua ka tawn ua huai ah ni thum ka taam uhi.
english: Touching at Syracuse, we stayed there three days.

paite: Huai a kipan ka paikawi ua, Rejiam khua ka tung ua; ni khat nung in sim huih ahong nung a, azing nawn in Puteoli khua ka tung nawn uhi.
english: From there we circled around and arrived at Rhegium. After one day, a south wind sprang up, and on the second day we came to Puteoli,

paite: Huai ah unaute ka mu ua, akiang uah ni sagih taam ding in ahon khou ua; huchibang in Rome kholam ah ka pai zelta uhi.
english: where we found brothers, and were entreated to stay with them for seven days. So we came to Rome.

paite: Huan unaute'n ka Tanchin uh azaktak un huai a kipan in Appii dawr leh Khualbuk thumte omna chiang ah hong dawn ding in ahong kuan ua; Paul in huai mite amuh in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu agen a, alungmuang mahmahta hi.
english: From there the brothers, when they heard of us, came to meet us as far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and took courage.

paite: Rome a ka lut un Paul bel avengpa sepaih kiang a amah kia a om aphal uhi.
english: When we entered into Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard, but Paul was allowed to stay by himself with the soldier who guarded him.

paite: Ni thum nung in, Paul in Juda heutute asamkhawm a; akihoukhawm ua, akiang uah, "Unaute leh mite aw, i pipute dan tung ah bangmah ka hihkhelh louh in leng Jerusalem a kipan in Rome a mite kiang ah ahon hentasak uhi.
english: After three days Paul called together those who were the leaders of the Jews. When they had come together, he said to them, “I, brothers, though I had done nothing against the people or the customs of our fathers, still was delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans,

paite: Amau ahon etchet khit un, sihna khop hial ka tung ah bangmah amuh louh ziak un khah ahon tum uhi.
english: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me free, because there was no cause of death in me.

paite: Himahleh Judate'n huai asel ziak un Kaisar kiang tun lou thei ka hita kei a; himahleh ka chipihte hekna nei a hih bel ka hi kei hi.
english: But when the Jews spoke against it, I was constrained to appeal to Caesar, not that I had anything about which to accuse my nation.

paite: Huai lam thu a noumau hon mu a hon houpih ding in ka hon sam ahi; Israelte lamet thilte toh kisai a khainiang bun ka hi ngal a," achi hi.
english: For this cause therefore I asked to see you and to speak with you. For because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Na tanchin Judia gam a kipan lai in ka mu kei ua, unau hiai a hong omte kuamah in na tungtang thubuai bangmah apulak kei ua, gen leng agen ngei kei uhi.
english: They said to him, “We neither received letters from Judea concerning you, nor did any of the brothers come here and report or speak any evil of you.

paite: Himahleh hiai pawl zaw gam teng ah gensiat ahi ngal ua, nang bangchi in ahia na ngaih chih theih ka utzaw uhi,” achi uhi.
english: But we desire to hear from you what you think. For, as concerning this sect, it is known to us that everywhere it is spoken against.”

paite: Huan ni achiam ua, huai atunna ah akiang ah mi tampi ahong ua; zing a kipan nitaklam pha in akiang uah huai thu ahilhchian a, Pathian lalgam thu atheisak a, Mosi Dan laibu thu leh zawlneite laibu thu in Jesu lam ah amaute athuzoh zel hi.
english: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s Kingdom, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.

paite: Khenkhat in athugen agingta ua, akhen in agingta kei uh.
english: Some believed the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.

paite: Huan akituakta kei ua, Paul in thu agen khit in apaikheta uhi. Athugen tuh hiai ahi: Kha Siangthou in zawlnei Isai kam a na pipute uh kiang a athugen adik mahmah ahi chi in:
english: When they didn’t agree among themselves, they departed after Paul had spoken one message: “The Holy Spirit spoke rightly through Isaiah the prophet to our fathers,

paite: "Hiai chite kiang ah va gen in, bil in zaw na za na ding ua, angaihna ahihleh na thei kei hial ding uh; muh zaw na mu ding ua, theih ahihleh na thei kei hial ding uh.
english: saying, ‘Go to this people and say, in hearing, you will hear, but will in no way understand. In seeing, you will see, but will in no way perceive.

paite: Hiai chite lungtang atakta a, abilte uh ana ngong deuh a, amit uh leng asi ua, huchi lou in zaw amit un amu ding ua, abil un aza ding ua, alungtang un leng athei ding uh, akiheikik ding ua, ke'n ka hihdam kha ding hi," achi, achih pen ahi.
english: For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they should see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, then I would heal them.’

paite: "Huaiziak in Pathian hotdamna thu Zentelte kiang a khakkhiak ahi chih thei un, amau bel ngaih leng angaikhe ding uh," achi hi.
english: “Be it known therefore to you that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and they will listen.”

paite: Huchi a hiai thute agen khit nung in, Judate apawtkheta ua, alak uah nakpitak in kiselna apiang hi.
english: When he had said these words, the Jews departed, having a great dispute among themselves.

paite: Huchi in kum nih vengveng ama inn luahna mun ah Paul a-om a, akiang a hoh peuhmah ana kipahpih hi.
english: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house and received all who were coming to him,

paite: Pathian lalgam thu ahilh a, hangsantak in Toupa Jesu Khrist thu agen zel a, kuamah in amah akham kei uhi.
english: preaching God’s Kingdom and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.

paite: Huan Peter leh Johan, dak kuana ah thum hun lai in tempul a lut ding in ahohtou uhi.
english: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.

paite: Piching kuahiam apian tung a pan khebai ahon zawng ua, tempul a lutte kiang a khutdoh ding in, tempul Kongkhak Kilawm kichi bul ah niteng in alumsak uhi.
english: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.

paite: Peter leh Johan tempul a lut ding mu in khut adoh hi.
english: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.

paite: Peter in amah a-en gegu a, Johan in leng; huan Peter in, “Hon en in," achi hi.
english: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”

paite: Ama'n amau a pan banghiam muh akilamen a, a-en pah hi.
english: He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.

paite: Himahleh Peter in, "Dangka leh dangka-eng bangmah ka nei kei; himahleh ka neihsun ka hon pe ding, 'Nazaret Jesu Khrist min in khe in paita in,' " achi hi.
english: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”

paite: Huan akhut taklam alen a, akaithouta a; huchi in thakhat in akhete leh asiakmit guhte ahong hat pah hi.
english: He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.

paite: Amah atawmtou a, adingh a, khe in apai pah hi. Khe a paipai, diangdiang leh Pathian phat kawm in tempul ah alut hi.
english: Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.

paite: Huan khe a pai leh mi tengteng in Pathian aphat lai amuh un;
english: All the people saw him walking and praising God.

paite: Tempul Kongkhak Kilawm bul a khutdoh a tupa ahi chih athei ua; atung a thil tunglamdang asa mahmah ua, abuaipih uhi.
english: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

paite: Huan ama'n Peter leh Johan alet lai in, mi tengteng in lamdang asa mahmah ua, inlim Solomon a achih uah akiang uah ahong taikhawm uhi.
english: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.

paite: Peter in huai amuh in, mite ahoupih a, "Nou Israel mite aw, hiaite bangziak a lamdang sa? Koumau thilhihtheihna leh Pathian ka limsak ziak ua amah ka paisak bang zen ua bang achia hon en gige?
english: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, “You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?

paite: Abraham, Isak leh Jakob' Pathian, i pipute Pathian in, asikha Jesu apahtawita ahi; amah na mansak ua, Pilat in khah atup hun in leng ama ah na ut kei uhi.
english: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.

paite: Mi Siangthou leh Dik na deih kei ua, tualthatpa na kiang ua piak na ngen zawta uhi.
english: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,

paite: Hinna Siampa na that ua; himahleh Pathian in amah misi lak a pan akaithou nawn a; huai theihpihte ka hi uhi.
english: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.

paite: Ama min gintak ziak in amin in hiai mi na muh uh leh na theih un ahihhatta hi. Amah ziak a ginna ahong om in na vek ua mitmuh in ahihdam vilvelta hi.
english: By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

paite: "Himahleh unaute aw, na heutute un atheih louh ziak ua ahih bang un, na theih louh ziak un hiaite na hih uh ahi, chih ka thei uhi.
english: “Now, brothers, I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.

paite: Himahleh Pathian in zawlnei tengteng kam in, Khrist in gim athuak ding thu atheikholsak hi, huchibang in atungsak zawta hi.
english: But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.

paite: Huaiziak in na khelhnate uh thaimanna ding in kisik unla, kihei nawn un, huchi in Toupa a pan halh hun ahong tung ding hi.
english: “Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord,

paite: Khrist Jesu nou a dia aseh mah leng, ahon sawl ding hi.
english: and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before,

paite: Himahleh Pathian in thil bangkim abawlhoih hun ahong tun masiah amah van a a-om ding him ahi; huai bawlhoih ding thu Pathian in leilung pian tung a kipan azawlnei siangthoute kam a agen khit ahi.
english: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.

paite: Mosi ngei in 'Toupa Pathian in keimah ahon bawl bang in na unaute lak ah zawlnei khat ahon bawlsak ding; ama'n thu tengteng na kiang ua agen peuh na ngaihkhiaksak ding uhi.
english: For Moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.

paite: Huan mi kuapeuh huai zawlnei thu ngaihkhiaksak lou tuh, mi lak a kipan hihmangthang ahi ding,' achi hi.
english: It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.’

paite: Ahi, Samuel om a kipan zawlnei tengteng, anung ua mite toh, thugen peuhte'n, tulai tanchin agenkhol uhi.
english: Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, also told of these days.

paite: Noute zawlneite leh thukhun tate na hi ve ua; Pathian in Abraham kiang ah, 'Na suante ziak in khovel a nam chih avualzawl ding uh, chi in na pipute uh kiang ah achiam hi.
english: You are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘All the families of the earth will be blessed through your offspring.’

paite: Pathian in a Tapa Jesu, misi lak a kipan kaithou in, na khelhnate uh kiheisanna ding leh kisik mite vualzawl ding in noumau kiang ah ahon sawl masapen hi,' " achi hi.
english: God, having raised up his servant Jesus, sent him to you first to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your wickedness.”

paite: Huan Peter leh Johan in mite kiang a thu agen lai un, siampute, tempul heutute leh Saddukaite akiang uh ahong tung guih ua;
english: As they spoke to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came to them,

paite: mite asinsak uh leh Jesu ziak a misi lak a kipan thohnawnna thu ahilh ziak un alungkim kei hial uhi.
english: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

paite: Huan amaute aman ua nitaklam ahih ziak in azingsang pha in suangkul ah akhumta uhi.
english: They laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.

paite: Himahleh thu ngaikhete akhen tampite'n agingta ua; atamlam uh piching ngen leng sangnga vel aching uhi.
english: But many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.

paite: Azing in aheutute uh, upate, laigelhmite,
english: In the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.

paite: siampu lianpen Annas leh Kaiapha, Johan, Alexander, siampu lianpen tanau tengtengte leng Jerusalem ah a-omkhawm uhi.
english: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.

paite: Peter leh Johan alai ah adingsak ua, "Bang thilhihtheihna in ahia, kua min in ahia hiai na hih uh?" chi in adong uhi.
english: When they had stood Peter and John in the middle of them, they inquired, “By what power, or in what name, have you done this?”

paite: Huchi in Peter Kha Siangthou in adim a, akiang uah, "Nou mipite vaihawmte leh Israel upate aw,
english: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “You rulers of the people and elders of Israel,

paite: hiai mi damlou tung a nna hoih ka sep thu uah, hiai mi bangziak in ahia ahong dam tak chi in tu in salh leh dot a om ka hi uh maw;
english: if we are examined today concerning a good deed done to a crippled man, by what means this man has been healed,

paite: nou tengteng leh Israel mi teng in leng thei hen, kros a Nazaret Jesu Khrist na kilhden uh, Pathian in misi lak a kipan in akaithou nawn a, amah min ngei in hiai mi hiai ah na ma uah dam in adinghta ahi.
english: may it be known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, this man stands here before you whole in him.

paite: "Nou inn lam mite aw, na suangpaih uh, aning a, suang phatuampen ahong hita, huai amah ahi achi uhi."
english: He is ‘the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.’

paite: "Midang kuamah kiang ah hotdamna a-om kei, van nuai a mihing min sak lak ah, hon hondam ding min dang a-om kei,” achi hi.
english: There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”

paite: Peter leh Johan hansandan amuh un, milaisiam lou leh minautang maimai ahi uh chih atheih un lamdang asa mahmah uhi; huchi in Jesu kiang ah a-om khinta uh chih athei uhi.
english: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marveled. They recognized that they had been with Jesus.

paite: Huan mi ahihdam uh akiang ua dingh amuh un, bangmah agense thei tuan kei uhi.
english: Seeing the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

paite: Huchi in avaihawmna ua pat a apaituamsak nung un, akihou ua,
english: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

paite: "Hiai mite bangchi in i hih dia? Thillamdang chiamteh tham ahih uh Jerusalem a om tengteng in teltak in atheita uh; en leng i sel thei tuan kei hi.
english: saying, “What shall we do to these men? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly seen by all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we can’t deny it.

paite: Himahleh midang kiang a athan semsemlouhna ding in tunung siah kuamah kiang ah hiai min a thu agenlouhna ding un i vau ding uh," achi uhi.
english: But so that this spreads no further among the people, let’s threaten them, that from now on they don’t speak to anyone in this name.”

paite: Huchi in amau asam ua, Jesu min a thu gen het lou ding leh hilh het lou ding in achi tinten uhi.
english: They called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

paite: Himahleh Peter leh Johan in akiang uah, "Pathian mitmuh in Pathian thuman sang in noumau thuman adikzaw hia ngaihtuah un.
english: But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves,

paite: Kou zaw ka thil muh uh leh ka zakte uh gen lou in ka om thei kei uh," achi uhi.
english: for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”

paite: Huan amau avau semsem ua, akhahta uh, mipi ziak in gawtna lemtang amu kei uh; athilhih ziak un mi tengteng in Pathian apahtawi uhi.
english: When they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for everyone glorified God for that which was done.

paite: Hiai ahihdamna chiamtehna uh kum sawmli sang a tamzaw ahi.
english: For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.

paite: Huan Peter leh Johan apawt un amau lawmte kiang ah ava hoh ua, siampu liante leh upate'n akiang ua agen peuh uh ahilh vek uhi.
english: Being let go, they came to their own company and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.

paite: Huchi in angaikhete'n akituak in aw ngaihtak in Pathian kiang ah, "Toupa, nang tuh van leh lei, tuipi leh asung a omte tengteng bawlpa na hi;
english: When they heard it, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord and said, “O Lord, you are God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

paite: Nang Kha Siangthou in, ka pu uh na sikha David kam in, hiai thu na gen ahi: 'Zentelte bangchi in ahita aheh uh? Mite'n bangchi in ahia thil phatuam lou angaihtuah uh?
english: who by the mouth of your servant David, said, ‘Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

paite: Khovel kumpipate adingh ua, heutute leng akikhawm ua, Toupa leh ama Khrist kalh in,' chi in.
english: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers plot together, against the Lord, and against his Christ.’

paite: "Hiai khua ah na sikha siangthou, na thaunilh Jesu tung ah, Herod leh Pontias Pilat toh, Zentelte leh Israel mite toh akikhawmta uh;
english: “For truly, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed,

paite: na khut leh na lungsim a hong tung ding a na sehkholh peuh hih ding in.
english: to do whatever your hand and your counsel foreordained to happen.

paite: Huchi in tu'n ah, Toupa, ahon vaudan uh ngai in; na sikhate kiang ah na thu hangsantak a gentheihna pia in.
english: Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,

paite: Damsak ding a na khut na zak a, na sikha Jesu min a chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte hih ahih lai in,” achi uhi.
english: while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant Jesus.”

paite: Huan athum khit un a-omkhawmna mun uh ahong ling a, avek un Kha Siangthou in adim ua, hangsantak in Pathian thu ahilhta uhi.
english: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.

paite: Huan agingta mipite lungsim mun khat leh ngaihtuah mun khat in a-om ua; alak ua kuamah in athil neihte, kei a tuam ahi, achi kei ua, thil tengteng akikop uhi.
english: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.

paite: Sawltakte'n thilhihtheihna thupitak in Toupa Jesu thohnawn thu ahilhhilh ua; avek ua tung ah hehpihna thupitak a-om hi.
english: With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.

paite: Huan alak uah leng tasam kuamah a-om kei uh; gam leh inn nei peuh in azuak ua, athil khotte uh aman ahon tawi uhi.
english: For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,

paite: Huan sawltakte khebul ah akoih zel ua, amau deihdong ching hun chiat in ahawm chiat zel uhi.
english: and laid them at the apostles’ feet; and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.

paite: Huan Levi chi a mi khat, Kupra tuikulh a kipan, Joses kichi, sawltakte'n Barnabas achih uh, (huai min omdan, "Hanthawnna Tapa," chihna ahi),
english: Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,

paite: hiai mi in agam neih azuak a, aman ahon tawi a, sawltakte khebul ah akoih hi.
english: having a field, sold it and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

paite: Himahleh mi khat amin Ananias in azi Sapphira toh athil neih uh azuak hi.
english: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

paite: Huan azi theih in ama'n akhen a-iim a, akhen hon tawi in sawltakte khebul ah ahong koih hi.
english: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, then brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

paite: Himahleh Peter in, "Kha Siangthou khem ding leh gam man akhen iim ding in bangziak a Setan in na lungtang hihkhauh ahia?
english: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price of the land?

paite: A-om lai teng leng nang a ahi gige kei a hia? Na zuak nung in leng na thuthu in a-om kei a hia? Bang achia hiai thute na lungtang a ngaihtuah? Mihing khem na hi kei a, Pathian khem na hi zaw,” achi hi.
english: While you kept it, didn’t it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn’t it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven’t lied to men, but to God.”

paite: Ananias in huai thu azaktak in apuk a, asita hi; aza kha peuh in alau mahmah uhi.
english: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.

paite: Tangvalte athou ua, tuam in azawngkhia ua, avuita uhi.
english: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.

paite: Dakkal thum ding hiam nung in, thil omdan thei lou in azi ahong lut hi.
english: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.

paite: Peter in akiang ah, "Hon hilh in, hiai zah phet in maw gam na zuak uh?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Hi, hiai zah phet in ahi," achi hi.
english: Peter answered her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.” She said, “Yes, for so much.”

paite: Huan Peter in akiang ah, "Bang achia Toupa Kha ze-et ding a kithutuak na hi ua? Ngai in, kongkhak bul ah na pasal vuite khepek ahong omta, nang leng ahon zawngkhe ding uh," achi hi.
english: But Peter asked her, “How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.”

paite: Huchi in thakhat in akhebul ah apuk pah a, asi hi; tangvalte ahong lut ua, amah si in ahong mu ua, azawngkhia ua, apasal kiang ah avuita uhi.
english: She fell down immediately at his feet and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.

paite: Huan saptuamte leh huai thu za peuhmahte'n alau mahmah uhi.
english: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.

paite: Huan mi lak ah Pathian in sawltakte khut in chiamtehna leh thillamdang tampi ahih zel hi. Huan amaute avek un lungsim mun khat in Solomon inlim ah akikhawm zel uhi.
english: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.

paite: Midang bel kuamah alak uah apang ngamta kei uhi; himahleh mi'n amaute angaisang uhi.
english: None of the rest dared to join them; however, the people honored them.

paite: Huan Toupa lam ah numei leh pasal gingthak tampi behlap semsem in a-om uhi.
english: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.

paite: Huchi in mi damloute kongzing ah alumsak ua, Peter pai kawm a alim bek in alak ua khat bek aliahtheihna ding in, achi uhi.
english: They even carried out the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at least his shadow might overshadow some of them.

paite: Jerusalem kho kim a kipan mipite leng huai damloute dawi nin hihgimte hon pi in ahong paikhawm ua; huaite leng ahong dam chiat uhi.
english: The multitude also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits; and they were all healed.

paite: Huan siampu lianpen akisa a, akiang a omte tengteng toh, alawmte tuh Saddukai pawl ahi ua; amau hazatna in adim uhi.
english: But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy

paite: Sawltakte aman ua, vantang khumna ah akhumta uhi.
english: and laid hands on the apostles, then put them in public custody.

paite: Zankim in Toupa angel khat in kongkhakte hong in, apikhia hi.
english: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out and said,

paite: "Tempul ah pai unla, va dingh in mite kiang ah hiai hinna thu va gen un," achi hi.
english: “Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”

paite: Huan huai thu azak un, khua hong vak phet in tempul ah ava lut ua, thu ava gen uhi. Himahleh, siampu Lian leh alawmte ahong ua, vaihawmte leh Israel suante upate tengteng asamkhawm ua, sawltakte va pi ding in suangkul ah mi asawl uhi.
english: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak and taught. But the high priest and those who were with him came and called the council together, with all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

paite: Suangkul ah heutute va hoh mah le uh, amau ava mu kei ua; huchi in akik nawn uhi.
english: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,

paite: "Suangkul bittak a kikhak in, avengte leng kongkhak bul a dingh amu uhi, himahleh ka hong ua, asung ah kuamah ka mu kei uh," chi in agen uhi.
english: “We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!”

paite: Huan tempul upa leh siampu liante'n huai thute azak un, hiai bangchi phet in athang diam aw? chi in athu ah amangbang petpet uhi.
english: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.

paite: Huan mi khat ahong pai a akiang uah, "Ngai un, suangkul a na mikhumte un tempul a dingh in thu agen uh," chi in ahong gen hi.
english: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”

paite: Huchi in sepaih heutupa toh heutu liante ava kuan ua, vantang akihtak ziak un hiamgamna om lou in sawltakte ahon pi ua, huchi hi keileh suang a den ahi kha ding uhi.
english: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.

paite: Huan apitung un, vaihawmte ma ah adingsak uhi. Siampu lianpen in akiang uah,
english: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,

paite: "Huai min in thu hilh louh ding ka hon chita ua; thei un na thuhilh un Jerusalem ahihdim vekta hi, hiai mipa sisan hon khuksak tum na hi ve ua," chi in asal hi.
english: saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood on us.”

paite: Himahleh Peter leh sawltakte'n, "Mihing thu sang in Pathian thu i man zawk ding ahi," achi uhi.
english: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.

paite: "Nou sing ah Jesu khaikang in na that ua, i pipute Pathian in akaithou nawnta hi.
english: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.

paite: Amah mah Pathian in Kumpipa leh Hondampa a om ding in ataklam ah ahihlianta hi. Israelte khelhna a pan kiheisak ding leh ngaidam ding in.
english: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.

paite: Huai thute kou atheihpihte ka hi ua; Kha Siangthou, Pathian in athu zui peuhte kiang a apiak tak, atheipa ahi nawn lai," chi in adawng uhi.
english: We are his witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”

paite: Amau huai thu azak un asin uh athak mahmah a, hihlup atumta uhi.
english: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.

paite: Himahleh vaihawmte lak ah, amin Gamaliel, Pharisai, dan sinsakmi, mi tengteng lak a minthangpi khat adingtou a, huai mite inn polam a omsak takdih ding thu apia hi.
english: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.

paite: Huan vaihawmte kiang ah, "Nou Israel mite aw, hiai mite tung a na thilhih tup uah pilvang un.
english: He said to them, “You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.

paite: Tuma lam in Theuda kichi, mi khat ahong om a, huai mipa kiang ah mi tampi, zali phial, a-awn uhi, amah tuh hihlup in a-omta a; athu zui peuhmah avek un adalhzakta ua bangmah ahita kei uhi.
english: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves. He was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed and came to nothing.

paite: Huai mi om nung in kisimpi lai in, Galili gam ah mi khat Judas kichi ahong om nawn hi; alam ah mi khenkhat ahip nawn hi; himahleh amah leng asita a, athu zui peuhmah avek un adalhzakta uhi.
english: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in ka hon hilh ahi, hiai mite khoih kei unla, amau om-om in omsak un; hiai athiltup uh leh athilhih uh mihing a kipan ahihleh amang ding hi.
english: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.

paite: Himahleh Pathian a kipan ahihleh amau na hihmang thei kei ding uh; huchi lou in zaw Pathian dou na hi zaw kha ding uh," achi hi.
english: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”

paite: Huan agen lem asata ua; huchi in sawltakte asam ua, avua ua; avuak khit un, Jesu min a thu gen lou ding chi bikbek in akhahta uhi.
english: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

paite: Huchi in vaihawmte lak a kipan apawtkhia ua, Khrist min ziak a daina thuak tak a seh ahih ziak un akipak mahmah uhi.
english: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus’ name.

paite: Huan niteng in tempul leh amaute inn ah, Jesu Khrist ahi, chi in thuhilh leh sinsak atawp kei uhi.
english: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.
