paite: Huai lai a, nungzuite apunpun lai un, aniteng thilhawm uah Grik pau zang Juda meithaite limsak lou chi in Hebru pau zang Judate tung ah Grik Judate aphun uhi.
english: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.

paite: Huan sawm-le-nihte'n nungzui mipite asamkhawm ua, "Pathian thugen tawpsan a dohkan a nek-tak ka bawl uh ahoih kei.
english: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.

paite: Huaiziak in unaute aw, na lak uah Kha leh pilna a dim mi minhoih ngen sagih tel un, amau hiai thil gel ding in ka bawl ding ua;
english: Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

paite: kou ahihleh thum leh thu nasem in ka om gige zaw ding uh," achi uhi.
english: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”

paite: Huai thu in mi tengteng akipaksak a; huchi in ginna leh Kha Siangthou a dim ngen, Stephen, Philip, Prokoras leh Nikanor, Timon, Parmenas leh Judate phungkai Antiok a mi Nikolas atel uhi.
english: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,

paite: Sawltakte ma ah hiai mite adingsak ua; amau athum ua, atung uah akhut uh anga uhi.
english: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

paite: Huchi in Pathian thu ahong dalh zom zel a; Jerusalem ah nungzuite apungta mahmah ua; siampute lak ah leng mi tampi'n ginna lam ahong ngata uhi.
english: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples greatly multiplied in Jerusalem. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

paite: Huan Stephen, hehpihna leh thilhihtheihna in adim in, mi lak ah thillamdang leh chiamtehna thupite ahih zom zel hi.
english: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.

paite: Himahleh Kurini, Aleksandria leh Silisia gam leh Asia gam a kipan Juda pawl khat Salsuakte sinagog kichite leh mi khenkhat ahong kisa ua, Stephen hong kiselpih uhi.
english: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.

paite: Himahleh apilna leh agenpihpa Kha aselkhe thei kei uhi.
english: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.

paite: Huan mi khenkhat aguai ua; huai mite'n, "Mosi leh Pathian agensiat ka za uh," achi uhi.
english: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”

paite: Huan mite, upate leh laigelhmite atokthou ua, Stephen asual ua, aman ua, vaihawmte kiang ah api uhi.
english: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,

paite: Theihpih zuauthei bawlkhia in, amaute'n, “Hiai mi'n hiai mun siangthou leh Dan agense gige,
english: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.

paite: Nazaret Jesu'n hiai mun ahihse dia, Mosi in hon piak dante ahihlamdang ding chih, agen ka za uh," achi uhi.
english: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”

paite: Huan vaihawmte tengteng in Stephen a-ensal chiat ua, amel angel mel bang in amu uhi.
english: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.

paite: Huan siampu lianpen in, "Hiai thute adik ahi na hia?" achi hi.
english: The high priest said, “Are these things so?”

paite: Stephen in, “Unaute aw, pate aw, ngai un. I pu Abraham, Haran a a-om ma, Mesopotamia gam a a-om lai a, thupina Pathian akiang a hong kilak in akiang ah,
english: He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,

paite: 'Na kholam leh na chite lak a kipan pawt inla, gam ka hon etsak ding lam ah pai in,' " achi hi.
english: and said to him, ‘Get out of your land and away from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.’

paite: Huan amah tuh Kaldaite gam a kipan apaikhia a, Haran ah ava om a; huan apa sih nung in huai a kipan in tua na omna kholam uah Pathian in apemlutsak hi.
english: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land where you are now living.

paite: Huan hiai ah zaw mun luah ding, khe ngakna tham bangmah ape kei. Himahleh tapa aneih ma nangawn in ama gou ding leh anung a asuante gouluah ding in gam piak achiam hi.
english: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.

paite: Pathian in hichibang in agen, asuante mi kholam ah kum zali ataam ding ua mi'n sikha in abawl ding ua, asawi behlap ding uh.
english: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.

paite: Pathian in, " ‘Sikha a nei dingte nam keima'n ka ngaihtuah ding a, huai khit chiang in ahong pawt ding ua, hiai mun ah ka nna asem ding uh,' achi behlap hi.
english: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that they will come out and serve me in this place.’

paite: Pathian in akiang ah tua zeksum thu akhung a; huchi in Abraham in Isak asuang a, ani giat ni in azek asum a, huan Isak in Jakob asuang a; Jakob in suangtubul ding sawm-le-nihte ahon nei hi.
english: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.

paite: "Huai suangtubul dingte'n Joseph ahaza ua, Aigupta gam ah azuak ua; himahleh akiang ah Pathian a-om hi.
english: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him

paite: Agimthuak tengteng ah ahunkhe zel a, Aigupta gam kumpipa Pharaoh deihsakna angahsak a, mipiltak ahi chih atheisak behlap hi; huchi in ama'n Aigupta gam leh a-inn a mi tengteng tung ah gam-ukpa in abawlta hi.
english: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

paite: Aigupta leh Kanaan gam tengteng ah kial ahong tung a, gimthuakna thupitak ahong tungta hi; i pipute'n lah nek ding himhim amuta kei ua.
english: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.

paite: Himahleh Jakob in Aigupta gam ah buh a-om chih azaktak in i pipute asawlkhia a; huai tuh ahoh pat tungna pen uh ahi.
english: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.

paite: Huan anihvei hohna uah, a-unaute kiang ah Joseph kitheisakta a, huchi in Joseph chite tuh Pharaoh kiang ah akitheisakta uhi.
english: On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family was revealed to Pharaoh.

paite: Huan Joseph in apa Jakob leh a-unau tengteng mi sawmsagih leh nga asamsak hi.
english: Joseph sent and summoned Jacob his father and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.

paite: Huchi in Aigupta gam ah Jakob ahohsuk a; huai ah amah leh i pipute asita uhi.
english: Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers;

paite: Shekem ah apotung ua, Abraham in Shekem a Emmor tapate lak a dangka sum a alei han ah avuita uhi.
english: and they were brought back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.

paite: "Pathian in Abraham kiang a athuchiam ahong tun ding in Aigupta gam ah mite ahong pung ua, ahong tam deuhdeuh uhi.
english: “But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

paite: Huan Aigupta gam ah Joseph thei lou kumpi dang khat ahong lal hi.
english: until there arose a different king who didn’t know Joseph.

paite: Huai mi in i chipihte akhem a, i pipute asawi a, anaungekte uh hing lou ding in apaikhesak hi.
english: The same took advantage of our race and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to abandon their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.

paite: Huai lai in Mosi ahong piang a, Pathian muh in melhoih mahmah ahi; apa inn ah kha thum akem uhi.
english: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome to God. He was nourished three months in his father’s house.

paite: Akoihkhiak un Pharaoh tanu in ama tapa ding a la in akem hi.
english: When he was abandoned, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.

paite: Huan Aigupta gam a pilna tengteng Mosi ahilh ua, thu ah leh athilhih ah athupi mahmah hi.
english: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.

paite: "Huan amah kum sawmli achin kuan in, a-unau, Israel suante aveh hi.
english: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.

paite: Huan alak ua mi khat gimthuak lai amu a, apanpih a, ahihgimpa Aigupta mi athat a, aphu alaksakta hi.
english: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.

paite: Mosi in ama khut in Pathian in amaute ahondam chih a-unaute'n thei na uhiam asa a, himahleh athei kei uh.
english: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.

paite: Huan azing in alak ua mi nih akilai un akiang uh ava naih a, 'Pute aw, unau nei ve ua; bangziak a dikloutak a kibawl na hi ua?' chi in lep atum hi.
english: “The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’

paite: Himahleh a-invengpa tung a thugilou bawl zaw pen in Mosi tuh asawnhang a, koute tung a heutu leh vaihawm ding a kua'n hon bawl ahia?
english: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?

paite: Zan a Aigupta mi na thah bang a hon thah tum na hi maw? achi hi.
english: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’

paite: Huai thu ziak in Mosi ataimangta a, Midian gam ah ataam nilouh a, huai ah tapa nih ava nei hi.
english: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.

paite: "Huan kum sawmli nung in Sinai Tang gamdai ah; loubuk ah meikuang lak ah angel khat akiang ah ahong kilak hi.
english: “When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.

paite: Mosi in amuh in, athil muh tuh lamdang asa mahmah a; huan en ding a apai lai in, Toupa aw in:
english: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, the voice of the Lord came to him,

paite: 'Kei na pipute Pathian, Abraham’ Pathian, Isak' Pathian, Jakob' Pathian, ka hi,' ana chi hi. Huchi in Mosi aling a a-en ngamta kei hi.
english: ‘I am the God of your fathers: the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ Moses trembled and dared not look.

paite: Huan Toupa'n akiang ah, 'Na khepek a kipan na khetuam suah in; na dinna Mun Siangthou ahi,' achi hi.
english: The Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.

paite: Aigupta gam a om ka mite gimdan ka mu gige hi, athum uh leng ka za gige, amau hunkhe ding in ka hong suk hi. Hong in, Aigupta gam ah ka hon sawl ding," achi hi.
english: I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.’

paite: "Kou tung a heutu leh vaihawm ding a kua'n hon bawl ahia, chi a adeih louh uh, Mosi, loubuk a angel kilak tungtawn in, Pathian in amah mah heutu leh hunkhepa hikhawm ding in asawlta hi.
english: “This Moses whom they refused, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.

paite: Ama'n Aigupta gam ah Tuipi San leh gamdai mun ah, kum sawmli sung in thillamdang leh chiamtehnate amusak phot a, amaute apikheta ahi.
english: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.

paite: Israel suante kiang ah, 'Pathian in keimah bang in, na unaute lak a mi zawlnei khat, athu na ngaihkhiak ding uh ahon bawlsak ding chipa Mosi ahi.
english: This is that Moses who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord our God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.’

paite: Hiai mi ahi gamdai a omkhawmte lak a ompa, Sinai Tang a angel in ahoupihpa leh i pipute kiang a ompa; huai mi eite hon piaksawn ding a thuhingte lasawnpa mah ahi.
english: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,

paite: "I pipute'n amah thu amang kei ua, ahua ua, Aaron kiang ah,
english: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,

paite: 'I makai ding in pathiante hon bawlsak in; Aigupta gam a kipan a hon pikhepa Mosi lah atanchin ka thei nawnta kei uhi,' chi in alungtang uh Aigupta gam lam ah anga nawnta uhi.
english: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’

paite: Huai lai in bawngnou lim abawl ua, amai a kithoihna alan ua amau khutsuak milim tung ah akipak uhi.
english: They made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.

paite: Huchi in Pathian in alehngatsan a, van a aksi abiak theihna ding un amaute akilehngat santa hi. Zawlnei laibu a, ‘Aw nou Israel inkote aw, gamdai ah kum sawmli sung in gan sisan a kithoih in thillat toh in kei na hon bia ua eita?
english: But God turned away and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?

paite: Molok biakna maitam leh na pathian uh, Remphan aksi leh, na milim bawltawmte uh, vialpuak in biak ding in na zong ua, huaiziak in Babulon kho khen lam ah sal in ka hon pomang ding,' chih gelh bang in.
english: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the star of your god Rephan, the figures which you made to worship, so I will carry you away beyond Babylon.’

paite: "I pi-le-pute'n gamdai ah theihpihna biakbuk, Mosi kiang a theihsak a a-om bang leh alim amuhsak bang in ana bawl uhi.
english: “Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;

paite: Huai biakbuk mah i pipute suansawnte'n leng aneisawn zel ua, Pathian in i pipute ma a Zentel adelhkhiakte gam aluah lai un, Joshua makaih in biakbuk alutpih uhi. David hong om tan in huai ah a-om gige a,
english: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations whom God drove out before the face of our fathers to the days of David,

paite: amah Pathian mitmuh a deihsakna tang, Jakob' Pathian a ding in inn bawlsak angen hi.
english: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.

paite: Himahleh Solomon in huai inn alamsak zawta hi.
english: But Solomon built him a house.

paite: "Himahleh zawlnei gen bang in khut a bawl innte ah Tungnungpen a-om kei;
english: However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,

paite: "Toupa'n van ka tutphah ahi a, lei ka khepek ngakna ahi; inn bangchibang na hon lamsak ding ua? Ka khawlna mun ding koi mun ahia?
english: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or what is the place of my rest?

paite: Hiai thilte keimah khut in ka bawl kei a hia?" chi a, agen bang in.
english: Didn’t my hand make all these things?’

paite: "Migenhakte, lungtang leh bil a zeksumlouhte aw, chik lai peuh in Kha Siangthou na dal gige uh; na pipute uh hih bang in na hih nilouh uhi.
english: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.

paite: Na pipute un zawlneite lak ah kua ahia asawi louh uh? Mi Diktak hong ding thu genkholte athat ua; huai midiktak mansakte leh thatte noumau na hi uhi.
english: Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.

paite: Dan angelte piaksawn mu masa a zuiloute aw," achi hi.
english: You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”

paite: Huan huai thu azak un asin uh athakta a, Stephen tung ah aha uh agawita uhi.
english: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.

paite: Himahleh amah Kha Siangthou in adim a, van lam a-en a, Pathian thupina leh Pathian taklam a Jesu dingh amu hi.
english: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

paite: "Ngai un, van kihong ka mu a, Pathian taklam a Mihing Tapa dingh leng ka mu," achi hi.
english: and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”

paite: Huchi in amau aw ngaihtak in akikou ua, abil uh ahum ua,
english: But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears, then rushed at him with one accord.

paite: kituaktak in apang ua, khua a kipan adelhkhia ua, suang in adeng ua, atheihpihte'n tangval khat amin Saul khebul ah apuante uh akoihkhawm chiat uhi.
english: They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.

paite: Amaute'n Stephen suang in adengta ua; ama'n Pathian sam in, "Toupa Jesu, ka kha la in," achi hi.
english: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”

paite: Huan khukdin in aw ngaihtak in akikou a, "Toupa, hiai akhelhna tung uah moh posak ke'n," achi hi. Huchi in huai agen zoh in, a-ihmuta hi.
english: He kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.

paite: Saul in leng asih hoih asa hi. Huai ni in Jerusalem a saptuam omte tung ah nakpitak in sawina atung a; sawltakte kia lou ngal Judia leh Samaria bial teng ah adalhzak vekta uhi.
english: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.

paite: Huan Pathian limsak kuate hiam in Stephen avui ua, nakpitak in asuun uhi.
english: Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.

paite: Saul in bel saptuam pawlte asawi a, inn teng a lut in, numei pasal akaikhia a, suangkul ah akhum hi.
english: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.

paite: Huan adalhzakte kho teng ah apaita ua, thu agen zel uhi.
english: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.

paite: Samaria ah Philip ahohsuk a, akiang uah Khrist thu atangkoupih hi.
english: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed to them the Christ.

paite: Huan athillamdang hihte azak ua, amuh un, mipite'n lungsim mun khat in, Philip thugente alimsakta uhi.
english: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip when they heard and saw the signs which he did.

paite: Dawi nin paimi tampi amatte uh sung a kipan in aw ngaihtak a kikou a pawt leh mizaw leh khebai tampi hihdam a a-om ziak un.
english: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.

paite: Huchi in huai khopi ah nakpitak a kipahna a-om hi.
english: There was great joy in that city.

paite: Huan mi khat amin Simon a-om a; ama'n mithupi ka hi, chi in tuma lam in huai khua ah mitkhialdawi in Samaria khomite lamdang satak in abawl nilouh hi.
english: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,

paite: Mi tengteng, aneupen a pan alianpen tan in, "Hiai mi Pathian thilhihtheihna thupi achih uh ahi," chi in athu alimsak chiat uhi.
english: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, “This man is that great power of God.”

paite: Amitkhialdawi in sawtpi lamdang satak a abawl nak ziak in athu alimsak uhi.
english: They listened to him because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.

paite: Himahleh Philip in Pathian lalgam tanchinhoih leh Jesu Khrist min agen pen agintak tak un, numei leh pasalte'n baptisma atangta uhi.
english: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning God’s Kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

paite: Huan Simon nangawn in leng agingta a, baptisma atan zoh in Philip kiang ah a-om gige a, chiamtehna leh thillamdang thupite amu a, lamdang asa thei mahmah hi.
english: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.

paite: Huan sawltak Jerusalem a omte'n Samaria mite'n Pathian thu agingtata uh chih azak un, akiang uah Peter leh Johan asawl uhi.
english: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,

paite: Huai mite ava tunsuk uleh Kha Siangthou atantheihna ding un athumsak uhi.
english: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;

paite: Huai ma in alak uah kuamah tung ah atung nai kei a; Toupa Jesu min in baptisma atang phet uhi.
english: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.

paite: Huan sawltakte'n atung uah akhut uh akoih ua, Kha Siangthou atangta uhi.
english: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

paite: Huan sawltakte khut ngakna ziak a Kha Siangthou piak ahi chih Simon in amuh in; dangka piak asawm hi.
english: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,

paite: "Hichibang thuneihna hon pe sam un, kuapeuh tung a leng khut ka koihna in Kha Siangthou atan samna ding in,” achi hi.
english: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”

paite: Himahleh Peter in akiang ah, "Na dangka nang toh mangkhawm hen, Pathian thilpiak dangka sum a lei na tup ziak in.
english: But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!

paite: Hiai thu ah nang zaw na pang kei, tan leng na nei kei hi; Pathian ngaih in na lungtang adik kei hi.
english: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn’t right before God.

paite: Huaiziak in hiai na gitlouhna tawpsan inla, Toupa kiang ah thum in, huchi in na lungtang a na ngaihtuah ahon ngaidam khamoh ding hiam.
english: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.

paite: Thil khakna sinkha ah leh gitlouh gaklopna ah na om chih ka thei hi," achi hi.
english: For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.”

paite: Huan Simon in, "Na thil gen uh bangmah ka tung a hong tunlouhna ding in noumau in Toupa kiang ah hon thumsak un," chi in adawng hi.
english: Simon answered, “Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.”

paite: Huchi in amau Toupa thu atheihsak ua, agen zoh nung un, Jerusalem a kik nawn in, Samari mite tenna khua tampi ah tanchinhoih agen zel uhi.
english: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.

paite: Huan Toupa angel khat in Philip ahoupih a, "Thou inla, simlam a Jerusalem a kipan Gaza kho sunsuk lampi huai gamdai ah hoh in," achi hi.
english: Then an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.”

paite: Huchi in athou a, apaita hi; huan ngai in, Ethiopia gam a mi khat, Ethiopia kumpinu Kandas gou tengteng kempa, michilgeh thuneitak, Jerusalem ah Pathian be ding in ahohtou hi.
english: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.

paite: Apaikik lam kangtalai a tu in zawlnei Isai laibu asim hi.
english: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.

paite: Huchi in Kha in Philip kiang ah, "Huai kangtalai va naih inla, va kithuahpih in,” achi hi.
english: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go near, and join yourself to this chariot.”

paite: Michilgeh kiang ah Philip ava tai a, zawlnei Isai laibu asim aza a, "Na laibu sim na theisiam hia?" achi hi.
english: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”

paite: Ama'n, “Kuamah hon hilhchet louh in bangchi in ka theisiam dia?" chi in akiang a kaltou a tutpih ding in Philip achialta hi.
english: He said, “How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.

paite: Laisiangthou asim lai tuh hiai ahi: "Goh ding belam bang in amah api ua; belamnou amulmetpa ma a adaih dide bang in ama'n leng akam aka kei;
english: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, “He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn’t open his mouth.

paite: avuallelh lai in atung ah thugen aphal kei ua; asuante tanchin kua'n ahon gen ding ua? Khovel a kipan in ahinna alaksak ngal ua," chi in.
english: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”

paite: Michilgeh in Philip ahoupih a akiang ah, "Zawlnei in hiai thu kua thu ahia agen, amah thu hia, midang thu? Ka hon dong hi," achi hi.
english: The eunuch answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?”

paite: Huan Philip in adawng a, Laisiangthou thu abul a pan in, akiang ah Jesu thu ahilhta hi.
english: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him about Jesus.

paite: Huan lampi a apai kawm un koi mun hiam tui omna khat atung ua; huan michilgeh in, "En dih, hiai ah tui a-om, baptisma ka tan ding bang in hon dal ahia?" achi hi.
english: As they went on the way, they came to some water; and the eunuch said, “Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?”

paite: Huchi in kangtalai akhawlsak ua, anih un, Philip leh michilgeh, tui ah ahohkhawmsuk ua; huchi in ama'n abaptista hi.
english: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.

paite: Huan tui a pan apaitouh un Toupa Kha in Philip alamangta a; huan michilgeh in amah amu nawnta kei, nuamsatak in apai zel hi.
english: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.

paite: Himahleh Azotas ah Philip muh in a-om nawn hi; huan apaisuak kawm in Kaisaria atun masiah kho teng ah tanchinhoih agen zel hi.
english: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities until he came to Caesarea.

paite: Saul in Toupa nungzuite vau leh thah atup thu agen lailai man in siampu lianpen kiang ah ava hoh hi.
english: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest

paite: Damaskas a sinagog tengteng amite kiang a piak ding in lai angen a, hiai Lampi zui mi kuapeuh amuhleh, numei leh pasal leng, hen a Jerusalem a hon pitheihna ding in.
english: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.

paite: Huan apai lai in, Damaskas atun kuan in, thakhat in van a kipan vak akim ah ahong vak puap hi.
english: As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.

paite: Huan lei ah apuk a, akiang ah, "Saul, Saul, bang achia nang hon sawi na hia?" chi in aw aza hi.
english: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”

paite: Huan ama'n, "Toupa, kua na hia?" achi hi. Toupa'n akiang ah, "Na sawi Jesu ka hi; kilhna sikzum na tot nang ding in ahaksa hi," achi hi.
english: He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

paite: Huan ling leh lamdang sa kawm in, "Toupa bang sem ding a hon deih na hiam?" achi hi. Toupa'n akiang ah, "Thou inla, khopi ah lut in, huchi in na hih ding hilh in na om ding hi," achi hi.
english: But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”

paite: Atonpihte gen ding thei lou in adingh ua, aw zaw aza ua, himahleh kuamah amu kei uh.
english: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.

paite: Huan lei a kipan in Saul athou a; ahong hak a kuamah amutheita kei hi; huchi in akhut in akai ua, Damaskas ah apilut uhi.
english: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.

paite: Huan ni thum kho mu lou in a-om a, bangmah ne in adawn kei hi.
english: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.

paite: Huan Damaskas ah amin Ananias nungzui khat a-om hi. Toupa'n mengmu bang in akiang ah, "Ananias,” achi hi.
english: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”

paite: Huan ama'n, "En in, Toupa, hiai ah ka om," achi hi. Toupa'n akiang ah, "Thou inla, Kongzing Tang achih uah hoh inla, Judas inn ah, Tarsas khomi, amin Saul kichi kankhia in. Ngai in, athum laitak ahi.
english: The Lord said to him, “Arise and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,

paite: Ama'n mengmuhna in mi khat amin Ananias akiang ava lut a, amit hihvakna ding a atung akhut nga in amuta hi," achi hi.
english: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”

paite: Ananias in, "Toupa huai mi Jerusalem a na misiangthoute tung a atatsiat thu mi tampi kam ah ka za hi.
english: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.

paite: Huan hiai ah na min lou peuhmah hen ding in siampu liante a kipan thuneihna toh hong pai ahi," chi in adawng hi.
english: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”

paite: Himahleh Toupa'n akiang ah, "Hoh mai in; Zentelte, kumpipate leh Israel suante kiang a ka min polut ding a ka belseh ahi.
english: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.

paite: Ka min ziak in gimna bangchi a thupi ahia athuak ding akiang ah ka theisak ding," achi hi.
english: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”

paite: Huan Ananias ava hoh a, inn ah alut a, huan atung ah akhut anga a, "Unau Saul, na mitvakna ding leh Kha Siangthou dim a na omtheihna ding in, Toupa, na hong paina lampi a na kiang a kilak Jesu'n hon sawl ahi," achi hi.
english: Ananias departed and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”

paite: Huan thakhat in amit a kipan lip bang aketa a, amit avak nawnta a; athou a, huan baptisma atangta hi.
english: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.

paite: Huan an ane a, ahalhta hi. Huan Damaskas a nungzui omte kiang ah ni bangzah hiam ataam hi.
english: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.

paite: Huan Sinagog ah, "Jesu, Pathian Tapa" ahihdan thu atangkoupih zui ngal hi.
english: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.

paite: Huan athu zate tengteng in lamdang asa ua, “Hiai mipa Jerusalem a hiai minloute sawi zelpa ahi kei a hia? Huai mite siampu liante kiang a hensa a piak sawm a hong hohpa hilou hia?" achi uhi.
english: All who heard him were amazed, and said, “Isn’t this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!”

paite: Saul bel ahong hattuam a, huai mi Khrist ahi taktak chih ahilhchian a, Damaskas a Juda omte gen ding bei in akoih hilhial hi.
english: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.

paite: Huan ni sawttak nung in Saul that ding in Judate akihou uhi.
english: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,

paite: Himahleh ama'n athiltup uh ana thei hi. Huan amah thah tum in kulh kong teng ah sun leh zan in atang uhi.
english: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,

paite: Himahleh anungzuite'n zan in api ua, kulh tohlet ah bawm in akhaikheta uhi.
english: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.

paite: Huan Jerusalem a Saul atuntak in nungzuite kithuahpih atum a; amau bel avek un amah akihta ua, nungzui ahih sam agingta kei uhi.
english: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.

paite: Barnabas in amah api a, sawltakte kiang ah apaipih a, lampi a Toupa amuh a, ahoupihdan bang, Damaskas a Jesu min a hangtak a thu ahilhdan khawng leng akiang uah agenta hi.
english: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.

paite: Huchi in Jerusalem ah Saul tuh akiang uah lut zel pawt zel in a-omta a, Toupa min in hangsantak in thu agen zel hi.
english: He was with them entering into Jerusalem,

paite: Huan Grik pau zang Judate kiang ah thu agen a, asel a; amau bel amah hihlup atum uhi.
english: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.

paite: Huan unaute'n huai atheihtak un, Kaisaria ah apisuk ua, Tarsas ah asawlmangta uhi.
english: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.

paite: Huchi in saptuamte Judia, Galili leh Samaria gam kimvel ah akip deuhdeuh ua, muangtak in a-omta ua; huan Toupa laudan siam kawm in, Kha Siangthou khamuan in a-om ua, ahong pung deuhdeuh uhi.
english: So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.

paite: Huan Peter in kho kim atot vialvial kawm in, Lidda a Mi Siangthou omte kiang ah leng ahohsuk hi.
english: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.

paite: Huai ah mi khat amin Ainias, azawt ziak a kum giat lupna a lumden amu hi.
english: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years because he was paralyzed.

paite: Huan Peter in akiang ah, "Ainias aw, Jesu Khrist in ahon hihdam, thou inla, na awngphah zial in,” achi hi. Huchi in athou pahta hi.
english: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.

paite: Huan Lidda khua leh Sharon phai a omte tengteng in Ainias amu ua, Toupa lam anga duam uhi.
english: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.

paite: Huan Joppa ah amin Tabitha nungzui khat a-om a, Tabitha minkhiakna tuh Dorkas ahi, huai numei in thil hihhoih leh thilpiak ahau mahmah hi.
english: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.

paite: Huai lai in, achi ana a, asi hi; huchi in asilsiang ua, indan tungnung ah asial uhi.
english: In those days, she became sick and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.

paite: Huan Lidda khua tuh Joppa kho kiang ahih ziak in, nungzuite'n Peter huai ah a-om chih aza ua, "Sawt hal lou in ka kiang uah hong pai in," chi a va thum ding in akiang ah mi nih asawl uhi.
english: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.

paite: Huan Peter athou a akiang uah apaita hi. Huan atuntak in indan tungnung ah api ua; meithai tengteng dingh in, akiang ua Dorkas a-om lai a apuanak bawlte, apuan bawlte lak kawm in akap chiat uhi.
english: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

paite: Himahleh Peter in avek un apawtsak a, akhukdin a, athumta hi; huan luanglam anga a, "Tabitha, thou in," achi hi. Huchi in amit ahong hak a, Peter amuhtak in atutou hi.
english: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

paite: Huan Peter in akhut apia a, akaithou hi, misiangthoute leh meithaite asam a, hingdam in apeta hi.
english: He gave her his hand and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.

paite: Huan huai Joppa kho tengteng in athei vek ua; mi tampi in Toupa agingta uhi.
english: This became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.

paite: Huan Joppa ah savunbawlpa Simon inn ah ni tampitak Peter ataam nilouh hi.
english: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.

paite: Judah kumpipa Uzziah vaihawm lai leh Israel kumpipa Joas tapa Jeroboam vaihawm lai a zinling ma kum nih in, Tekoa mun ganhon veng mite lak a mi Amos thu Israel tungtang amuh:
english: The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.

paite: Huan ama'n, "Zion tang a kipan TOUPA ahumham ding a, Jerusalem a kipan in a-aw asuah ding; belam veng mite gantatna munte alungkham ding ua, Karmel tang vum avuai ding," achi hi.
english: He said: “Yahweh will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the pastures of the shepherds will mourn, and the top of Carmel will wither.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Damaskas kho tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; Gilead gam buhgawina sikte a agawi ziak un.
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Damascus, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron;

paite: Himahleh Hazael inn ah mei ka sawl ding a, Ben-hadad kumpipa' inn te akang khin ding hi.
english: but I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad.

paite: Huan Damaskas kho kongkhak sik ka hihtan ding a, Aven Phaizang a kipan luah mite leh Eden inn a kipan kumpipa chiang tawipa ka mangsak ding a; Siria gam mite Kir gam ah sal in a-om ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: I will break the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the valley of Aven, and him who holds the scepter from the house of Eden; and the people of Syria shall go into captivity to Kir,” says Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Gaza kho tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka hihtawp kei ding; Edom kiang a piak ding in mi tengteng sal a api ziak un.
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Gaza, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they carried away captive the whole community, to deliver them up to Edom;

paite: Himahleh Gaza kulh tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, akumpipa' inn te akang khin ding hi.
english: but I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, and it will devour its palaces.

paite: Huan Ashdod a kipan luahmi leh Ashkelon a kipan kumpipa chiang tawimi ka hihmang ding a; huan, Ekron kho tung ah ka khut ka lik ding a, Philistia mi khosuaksunte amang ding uh," Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi.
english: I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him who holds the scepter from Ashkelon; and I will turn my hand against Ekron; and the remnant of the Philistines will perish,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Tura kho tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; Edom kiang a mi tengteng apiak ua, unau tung a athukhun atheihgige louh ziak un.
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Tyre, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment; because they delivered up the whole community to Edom, and didn’t remember the brotherly covenant;

paite: Himahleh Tura khokulh tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, akumpipa' inn te akang khin ding,” achi hi.
english: but I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre, and it will devour its palaces.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Edom tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, gawtna ka daisak kei ding; a-unau namsau in adelh a, ahehpihna tengteng apaimang a, ahehna in abotkek gige a, tangtawn a ahehna avom nilouh ziak in.
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Edom, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because he pursued his brother with the sword and cast off all pity, and his anger raged continually, and he kept his wrath forever;

paite: Himahleh Teman tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, Bozrah kumpipa' inn te akang khin ding,” achi hi.
english: but I will send a fire on Teman, and it will devour the palaces of Bozrah.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ammon tate tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; agam uh azatsak theihna ding un, Gilead kho numei naupaite akuihkek ziak un.
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead, that they may enlarge their border.

paite: Himahleh Rabbah khokulh tung ah mei ka mutkuang ding a, huan, kidouna ni a kikou toh, pingpei ni a huihpi toh, akumpipa' inn te akang khin ding.
english: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it will devour its palaces, with shouting in the day of battle, with a storm in the day of the whirlwind;

paite: Akumpipa uh sal in aman ding ua, amiliante toh kiton in," TOUPA'N achi.
english: and their king will go into captivity, he and his princes together,” says Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Moab tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; Edom kumpipa guhte sunu bang zen a ahal ziak in.
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Moab, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime;

paite: Himahleh Moab tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, Kerioth kumpipa guhte akang khin ding; huan Moab buaina leh kikou leh pengkul ging in asi ding hi.
english: but I will send a fire on Moab, and it will devour the palaces of Kerioth; and Moab will die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet;

paite: Huai lak a kipan vaihawmmi ka hihmang ding a, amiliante tengteng, amah toh ka that ding," TOUPA'N achi.
english: and I will cut off the judge from among them, and will kill all its princes with him,” says Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Judah tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; TOUPA dan adeih kei ua, athupiakte azui kei uh, apate uh chih sek azuaugente un amaute apimang ziak in.
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Judah, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have rejected Yahweh’s law, and have not kept his statutes, and their lies have led them astray, after which their fathers walked;

paite: Himahleh Judah tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, Jerusalem kumpipa' inn te akang khin ding," chi in.
english: but I will send a fire on Judah, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Israel tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; dangkasik a midiktat azuak uleh khedap but khat a mitasam azuak ziak un.
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Israel, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have sold the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals;

paite: Gentheite leivui bang a sikden ut tuntun a, mizawngte vaihawmna akaikawi uhi; huan, mi khat leh apa nungak khat kiang ah ka min hihnin ding in ahoh zel uhi.
english: They trample the heads of the poor into the dust of the earth and deny justice to the oppressed. A man and his father use the same maiden, to profane my holy name.

paite: Maitam tengteng kiangchin a khamna puanphah tung ah alum zel ua, a Pathian uh inn a mi aliausakna mante un uain adawn zel uh," chi in.
english: They lay themselves down beside every altar on clothes taken in pledge. In the house of their God they drink the wine of those who have been fined.

paite: "Himahleh amau ma a Amorte, Sidar bang a sang leh tosaw bang a khauh hihmang a; tunglam a kipan agah leh nuailam a kipan azung leng hihmangpa ka hi.
english: Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.

paite: Huan Amorte gam nei ding in Aigupta gam a kipan in ka hon pikhia a, gamdai ah kum sawmli sung ka hon pi hi.
english: Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.

paite: Huan zawlnei hi ding in na tapate uh lak a mi leh Nazaritte hi ding in na tangvalte uh lak a mi ka bawl a, Aw Israel suante aw, huchibang in ahi kei a hia? TOUPA'N achi.
english: I raised up some of your sons for prophets, and some of your young men for Nazirites. Isn’t this true, you children of Israel?” says Yahweh.

paite: Himahleh Nazarit mite kiang ah uain dawn ding na pia ua, zawlneite kiang ah, thu gen kei un, chi in thu na pia uhi.
english: “But you gave the Nazirites wine to drink, and commanded the prophets, saying, ‘Don’t prophesy!’

paite: Ngai dih ua, kangtalai a buhphal sawnsip bang in, na mun uah ka hon sawn ding hi.
english: Behold, I will crush you in your place, as a cart crushes that is full of grain.

paite: Huan mitaihatte hatna amang ding a, mihat in tha asuah thei sam kei ding hi; mihat mahmah leng akihumbit thei kei ding hi.
english: Flight will perish from the swift. The strong won’t strengthen his force. The mighty won’t deliver himself.

paite: Thalpeu zangmi leng adingh thei sam kei ding; paihat thei mi leng akihumbit thei kei ding, sakol tungtuangmi leng akihumbit thei kei ding hi.
english: He who handles the bow won’t stand. He who is swift of foot won’t escape. He who rides the horse won’t deliver himself.

paite: Huai ni chiang in mi thilhihthei mahmah lak a mihangsan leng vuaktang in ataimang ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: He who is courageous among the mighty will flee away naked on that day,” says Yahweh.

paite: Aw, Israel suante aw, Aigupta gam a kipan a ka hon pikhiak inkote aw, TOUPA'N hichibang a nou ahon demna thu ngaikhia un,
english: Hear this word that Yahweh has spoken against you, children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt, saying:

paite: "Noute kia leitung a inkuan tengteng a ka theih na hi ua; huaiziak in na thulimlouhna tengteng uah ka hon gawt ding," achi hi.
english: “I have chosen only you of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”

paite: Akithukim kei un mi nih apai-khawm ding ua hia?
english: Do two walk together, unless they have agreed?

paite: Humpinelkai in gammang a sa amat lai louh ngal in, ahumham ngei a hia? Humpinelkai lun lai in bangmah amat keileh akohawm sung a kipan ahumham ngei a hia?
english: Will a lion roar in the thicket, when he has no prey? Does a young lion cry out of his den, if he has caught nothing?

paite: Amah a dia tah a-om keileh, leitung a thang ah vasa a-awk thei a hia? Thang pen bangmah awk lou in lei a kipan in akisai dia hia?
english: Can a bird fall in a trap on the earth, where no snare is set for him? Does a snare spring up from the ground, when there is nothing to catch?

paite: Khopi ah mi launa lou ah pengkul amut ding ua hia? TOUPA hih louh in khopi ah hoihlouhna ahong om dia hia?
english: Does the trumpet alarm sound in a city, without the people being afraid? Does evil happen to a city, and Yahweh hasn’t done it?

paite: Diktak in Toupa PATHIAN in anasemmi, azawlneite kiang ah athuguk hilh lou in bangmah ahih kei ding hi.
english: Surely the Lord Yahweh will do nothing, unless he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets.

paite: Humpinelkai ahumham a, kua ahia lau lou ding? Toupa PATHIAN in thu agen a, kua'n ahia gen lou thei ding?
english: The lion has roared. Who will not fear? The Lord Yahweh has spoken. Who can but prophesy?

paite: Ashdod kumpipa' inn te leh Aigupta gam kumpipa' inn te ah gen unla, "Samaria tang tungte ah kikhawm unla, huai a buaina liantak omte leh huai lak a simmohna omte en un," chi in.
english: Proclaim in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, “Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria, and see what unrest is in her, and what oppression is among them.”

paite: "Akumpipa uh innte a hiamgamna leh kisuamna koihkhawm mite'n lah hihdik dan asiam ngal kei ua," TOUPA'N achi.
english: “Indeed they don’t know to do right,” says Yahweh, “Who hoard plunder and loot in their palaces.”

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Gam kimvel in melma a-om lai ding a; na kiang a kipan na hatna alakhe ding a, na kumpipa' inn te ahihse ding uhi.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “An adversary will overrun the land; and he will pull down your strongholds, and your fortresses will be plundered.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Belampu in humpinelkai kam a kipan akhe nih hiam, bil them hiam, ahonkhia bang in, huchibang in Samaria a teng Israelte lupna ning leh lupna maimom puanphan lukham them toh hutkhiak in a-om ding uhi.
english: Yahweh says: “As the shepherd rescues out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, so shall the children of Israel be rescued who sit in Samaria on the corner of a couch, and on the silken cushions of a bed.”

paite: Ngai unla, Jakob inkote tung ah theisak un,"
english: “Listen, and testify against the house of Jacob,” says the Lord Yahweh, the God of Armies.

paite: "Israel tatleknate amah tung ah ka gawtleh, huai ni chiang in, Bethel a maitamte leng ka gawt ngal dia; maitam kiite tankhiak in a-om ding ua, lei ah ake ding uh," sepaihte Pathian, Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi.
english: “For in the day that I visit the transgressions of Israel on him, I will also visit the altars of Bethel; and the horns of the altar will be cut off, and fall to the ground.

paite: "Huan phalbi leh nipi inn ka satse ding a; saiha innte amangthang ding a, inn thupite'n tawpna anei ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: I will strike the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory will perish, and the great houses will have an end,” says Yahweh.

paite: Nou Bashan bawngpite, Samaria tang tung a om a, gentheite simmoh a, tasamte nuaisiah a, atoupate uh kiang a, "Hon la unla i dawn ding uh," chite aw, hiai thu za un;
english: Listen to this word, you cows of Bashan, who are on the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy, who tell their husbands, “Bring us drinks!”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in ama sianthouna in akichiam a, "Ngai dih ua, sikkuaika a nou ahon lakmang a, na lak ua omsun ngakuai a ahon lakmang ni ahong tung ding hi.
english: The Lord Yahweh has sworn by his holiness, “Behold, the days shall come on you that they will take you away with hooks, and the last of you with fish hooks.

paite: Huan awngvang ah na paisuak ding ua, michih tangtak in apai ding uh; Harmon ah paih in na om ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: You will go out at the breaks in the wall, everyone straight before her; and you will cast yourselves into Harmon,” says Yahweh.

paite: "Bethel ah hong unla, talek un; Gilgal ah hong unla, tatlekna pungsak un; huan, na kithoihnate uh zingsang teng in hon la unla, ni khat hal zel in na sawm ua khatte uh hon la un.
english: “Go to Bethel, and sin; to Gilgal, and sin more. Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three days,

paite: Huan silngou pang kipahthu gen kithoihna lan unla, amau deihdan a lante hilh unla, puang un; Aw Israel suante aw, hiai lah na deih ngal ua," Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi.
english: offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving of that which is leavened, and proclaim free will offerings and brag about them; for this pleases you, you children of Israel,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: "Huan ke'n leng na khopi tengteng uah hasianna leh na mun tengteng uah taksapna ka hon pia a; huchi in leng ka kiang ah na hong kik kei uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: “I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and lack of bread in every town; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.

paite: “Buh lak hun ding kha thum ahih lai in na tung ua vuah zu ding leng ka len a; khopi khat tung ah ka zusak in, khopi dang tung ah ka zusak kei hi; mun khat tung ah ka zusak sek a, azuklouhna mun akeu hi.
english: “I also have withheld the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest; and I caused it to rain on one city, and caused it not to rain on another city. One field was rained on, and the field where it didn’t rain withered.

paite: Huchi in khopi nih leh thum ah tui dawn ding zong in khopi dang ah ataikhawm ua, adeihkhop kei uh; huchi in leng ka kiang ah na hong kik kei uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: So two or three cities staggered to one city to drink water, and were not satisfied; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.

paite: "Keuna leh apna in ka hon gawt a; na huante uh, na grephuante uh, na theipi kungte uh, na olive singkungte uh singnget lung in ane khin vekta hi; huchi in leng ka kiang ah na hong kik kei uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: “I struck you with blight and mildew many times in your gardens and your vineyards, and the swarming locusts have devoured your fig trees and your olive trees; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.

paite: "Aigupta gam bang in na lak uah huihpi ka sawl a; namsau in na tangvalte uh ka that a, na sakolte uh ka pimang a; na giahphualte uh gim namsia na nak ua nam khop in ka hon omsak a; huchi in leng ka kiang ah na hong kik kei uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: “I sent plagues among you like I did Egypt. I have slain your young men with the sword, and have carried away your horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camp, yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.

paite: "Pathian in Sodom leh Gomorrah khua achipsak lai bang in, na lak uah mi khenkhat ka hihchim a, singkang lakkhiak bang na hi ua; huchi in leng ka kiang ah na hong kik kei uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: “I have overthrown some of you, as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a burning stick plucked out of the fire; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huaiziak in "Aw Israel, na tung ah hichibang in ka hih ding; na tung a hiai ka hih ding ziak in, Aw Israel, na Pathian tuak ding in mansa in om in!"
english: “Therefore I will do this to you, Israel; because I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, Israel.

paite: "Ngai in, tangte dingkhesak a, huih bawl a, mihing kiang a angaihtuahna bang ahia chih genkhesak a, zingsang mialsak, lei mun sangte chilpa amin TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian ahi!"
english: For, behold, he who forms the mountains, creates the wind, declares to man what is his thought, who makes the morning darkness, and treads on the high places of the earth: Yahweh, the God of Armies, is his name.”

paite: Aw Israel inkote aw, hiai thu noute suunna ding ka gen za un.
english: Listen to this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Israel:

paite: Nungak, Israel, apukta hi; adingh nawn kei ding; agam tung ah paihkhiak ahita; amah tungding ding kuamah a-om kei.
english: “The virgin of Israel has fallen; She shall rise no more. She is cast down on her land; there is no one to raise her up.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Israel chite kiang ah, khopi sangkhat pawtna in zakhat anuse ding a, khopi zakhat pawtna in sawmkhat anuse ding hi.”
english: For the Lord Yahweh says: “The city that went out a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went out one hundred shall have ten left to the house of Israel.”

paite: TOUPA'N Israel inkote kiang ah hichi in achi:
english: For Yahweh says to the house of Israel: “Seek me, and you will live;

paite: "Hon zong un, na hing ding uh; himahleh Bethel khua zong kei unla, Gilgal ah lut sam kei un, Beer-sheba ah galkah kei unla; pel lou in Gilgal khua sal in aman ding a, Bethel khua ahong vuaksuak ding hi."
english: but don’t seek Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and don’t pass to Beersheba; for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nothing.

paite: TOUPA zong unla, na hing ding uh; huchi lou in zaw Joseph inn ah mei bang in apawt ding a, akang khin ding a, Bethel ah mitsak ding kuamah a-om kei ding uhi.
english: Seek Yahweh, and you will live, lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and it devour, and there be no one to quench it in Bethel.

paite: Vaihawmna singkha suaksak a, diktatna lei a paikhete aw;
english: You who turn justice to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth!

paite: siguk leh zuheisuktun bawlpa leh sihna limliap lak a tangsakpa leh sun zanmial a bawlpa, tuipi tuite sam a, leitung a luangsakpa, amah tak zong le uchin; amin TOUPA ahi;
english: Seek him who made the Pleiades and Orion, and turns the shadow of death into the morning, and makes the day dark with night; who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the surface of the earth, Yahweh is his name,

paite: kulh tung a manthatna hong tung guih zou hial a, mihatte tung a manthatna tungsakpa pen.
english: who brings sudden destruction on the strong, so that destruction comes on the fortress.

paite: Kongpi ah taihilhmi amudah ua, thudiktak genmi akih uhi.
english: They hate him who reproves in the gate, and they abhor him who speaks blamelessly.

paite: Huaiziak in migentheite tuanden in buh na laksak ua; suangsek in innte na lam ua, himahleh asung ah na teng kei ding uh. Grephuan nuamte na bawl ua, himahleh uain na dawn kei ding uhi.
english: Therefore, because you trample on the poor and take taxes from him of wheat, you have built houses of cut stone, but you will not dwell in them. You have planted pleasant vineyards, but you shall not drink their wine.

paite: Na tatleknate uh tamdan leh na khelhnate uh athupidan lah ka thei ngal a; midiktatte na simmoh ua, golhna la a, kongpi a tasamte ahih ding him ua pampaihte aw.
english: For I know how many are your offenses, and how great are your sins— you who afflict the just, who take a bribe, and who turn away the needy in the courts.

paite: Huchi in hun hoih lou ahih ziak in mipil zaw huai hun chiang in adai dide ding hi.
english: Therefore a prudent person keeps silent in such a time, for it is an evil time.

paite: Na hintheihna ding un hoihlouhna zong lou in, hoihna zong unla; huan na gen bang un, TOUPA sepaihte' Pathian na kiang uah a-om ding hi.
english: Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be with you, as you say.

paite: Khelhna hua unla, hoihna it un; kongpi ah vaihawmna kiptak in tungding un; Joseph inkuan akhosuaksunte tung ah TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian in hehpihna anei kha mai ding hi.
english: Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.”

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian, Toupa'n hichi in achi: "Kongzing teng ah nakpi a kahna a-om ding a, lamliante tengteng ah, khawk hi na mah e; achi ding uh; lungkham ding in lounei mite leh nakpi a kap ding in sisuun siamte asam ding uhi.
english: Therefore Yahweh, the God of Armies, the Lord, says: “Wailing will be in all the wide ways. They will say in all the streets, ‘Alas! Alas!’ They will call the farmer to mourning, and those who are skillful in lamentation to wailing.

paite: Grephuan teng ah nakpi a kahna a-om ding a; na lak uah ka paisuak ding," TOUPA'N achi.
english: In all vineyards there will be wailing, for I will pass through the middle of you,” says Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA ni deihte aw, na tung uh agik hi! Bangziak a TOUPA ni deih na hia ua? Vak hilou in mial ahi zaw hi.
english: “Woe to you who desire the day of Yahweh! Why do you long for the day of Yahweh? It is darkness, and not light.

paite: Humpinelkai taisan a, vompi tuak mi bang leh inn a lut a, baang tung a khut nga a gul in atuk bang ahi.
english: As if a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him; or he went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, and a snake bit him.

paite: TOUPA ni vak hilou in mial ahi sin kei a hia? Mial sah leh vakna nei lou in?
english: Won’t the day of Yahweh be darkness, and not light? Even very dark, and no brightness in it?

paite: "Na ankuangluite uh ka hua in ka musit a, na kikhawmpi pisuakte uah leng ka kipak sam kei hi.
english: I hate, I despise your feasts, and I can’t stand your solemn assemblies.

paite: Ahi, na thillat uleh na buh lat uh hon lan mah le uchin, ka sang kei ding, na gan thau uh lemna thillatte leng ka limsak sam kei ding hi.
english: Yes, though you offer me your burnt offerings and meal offerings, I will not accept them; neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat animals.

paite: Na kaihging ging kilawm uh ka ngaikhe kei ding; huaiziak in kei a kipan bil aphuai na late uh lamang un.
english: Take away from me the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.

paite: Himahleh vaihawmna bel tuite bang in leh diktatna lui lian bang in luang hen," TOUPA'N achi.
english: But let justice roll on like rivers, and righteousness like a mighty stream.

paite: "Aw Israel inkote aw, kum sawmli sung in gamdai ah kithoihnate leh thillatte ka kiang ah na hon lan ngei ua hia?
english: “Did you bring to me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, house of Israel?

paite: Ahi, na milim uh Molok leh na milimte uh Kaiuan, na aksi pathian uh, noute ding in na tawisang zaw uhi.
english: You also carried the tent of your king and the shrine of your images, the star of your god, which you made for yourselves.

paite: TOUPA amin sepaihte' Pathian in, noute Damaskas kho khen ah sal in ka hon paisak ding," TOUPA'N achi.
english: Therefore I will cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus,” says Yahweh, whose name is the God of Armies.

paite: "Zion tang a nuam lua a omte leh Samaria tang a bittak a omte leh Israel nam lian lak a inkuan mithupite tung agik hi!
english: Woe to those who are at ease in Zion, and to those who are secure on the mountain of Samaria, the notable men of the chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel come!

paite: Kalneh ah hoh unla, en un; huai a kipan in Hamath kho thupi ah hoh un; Philistia gam Gath ah paisuk unla; hiai gamte sang in noute na hoihzaw uhia? Nou gam sang in agam uh azazaw a hia?
english: Go to Calneh, and see. From there go to Hamath the great. Then go down to Gath of the Philistines. Are they better than these kingdoms? Is their border greater than your border?

paite: Nou ni hoih lou gamlapi a koih leh hiamgam tunna naihsakte aw,
english: Alas for you who put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near,

paite: saiha lupna a lum a, atutphah sau tungte ua kizia a, belamhon lak a belamnoute leh bawnghonte lak a kipan bawngtuaite ne a;
english: who lie on beds of ivory, and stretch themselves on their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the middle of the stall,

paite: David bang a kaihging tumtum a, lasak ding na bawlbawl uh;
english: who strum on the strings of a harp, who invent for themselves instruments of music, like David;

paite: belhbu lian a uain dawn a, sathau hoihpen a kinuhte mah; himahleh Joseph haksatna ziak in alungkham kei uhi.
english: who drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the best oils, but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.

paite: Huchi in tua sal dia pai masate toh sal in apai ding ua, nuam sa a kiziate nopsakna lakmang in a-om ding hi."
english: Therefore they will now go captive with the first who go captive. The feasting and lounging will end.

paite: TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian, Toupa PATHIAN in amah-le-amah kilou in akichiam a, "Jakob kisaktheihna ka kih a, akumpipa' inn te ka mudah a; huaiziak in khua leh asung a om tengteng ka mansak sin ahi.”
english: “The Lord Yahweh has sworn by himself,” says Yahweh, the God of Armies: “I abhor the pride of Jacob, and detest his fortresses. Therefore I will deliver up the city with all that is in it.

paite: Hichi ahong hi ding a, inn khat a mi sawm a-omleh asi vek ding uhi.
english: It will happen that if ten men remain in one house, they will die.

paite: Huan vui ding a thaunilh, misite tanau, amaute halpa ngei in insung a kipan a aguh lakhe ding in, insung tawng pen a mi om kiang ah, "Na kiang ah kuahiam midang a-om lai uhia?" achih a, ama'n, "Om lou,” achihleh; ama'n, "Dai sipsip in! TOUPA min i lou ding uh ahi ngal kei a," achi ding hi.
english: “When a man’s relative carries him, even he who burns him, to bring bodies out of the house, and asks him who is in the innermost parts of the house, ‘Is there yet any with you?’ And he says, ‘No;’ then he will say, ‘Hush! Indeed we must not mention Yahweh’s name.’

paite: Ngai dih ua, TOUPA'N thu apeta hi; inn lian achim lemlum ding a, inn neu leng akhangkham ik-iak ding hi.
english: “For, behold, Yahweh commands, and the great house will be smashed to pieces, and the little house into bits.

paite: Sakolte suangpi tung ah atai ding ua hia? Huai ah mi'n bawng in lei alet ding ua hia? Noute'n vaihawmna lah gu na suaksak ua diktatna gah singkha na suaksak uh.
english: Do horses run on the rocky crags? Does one plow there with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison, and the fruit of righteousness into bitterness,

paite: Nou thil bangmah lou tung a kipak a, i hatna in ahi kei maw kiite i lak ua? chite aw.
english: you who rejoice in a thing of nothing, who say, ‘Haven’t we taken for ourselves horns by our own strength?’

paite: "En dih ua, Aw Israel inkote aw, nou hon dou ding in nam ka dingkhesak ding a; huan Hamath khomual a kipan in Arabah lui tan in nou ahon engbawl ding uh," TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian in achita hi.
english: For, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, house of Israel,” says Yahweh, the God of Armies; “and they will afflict you from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of the Arabah.”

paite: Huchibang in Toupa PATHIAN in ahon ensak a; ngai dih ua, haichi poi nanungzaw pen adot pat tungna ah khaukhup abawl a; ngai dih ua, kumpipa tangseu khit a pou nanungzaw ahi.
english: Thus the Lord Yahweh showed me: behold, he formed locusts in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and behold, it was the latter growth after the king’s harvest.

paite: Huan huchi ahong hi a, huai gam a loupa anek khit nung un, "Aw Toupa PATHIAN, ngaidam in, ka hon ngen ahi; bangchi in Jakob adingh thei dia? Amah lah aneu ngal a," ka chi hi.
english: When they finished eating the grass of the land, then I said, “Lord Yahweh, forgive, I beg you! How could Jacob stand? For he is small.”

paite: Hiai thu ah TOUPA'N alung hei in, "TOUPA'N, hiai hong tung nawn kei ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh relented concerning this. “It shall not be,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huchibang in, Toupa PATHIAN in ahon ensak a; huan en dih ua, Toupa PATHIAN mei a dou ding in asam a; mei in tui thuk lian akang khin a, gam leng kat a-ut lai hi.
english: Thus the Lord Yahweh showed me: behold, the Lord Yahweh called for judgment by fire; and it dried up the great deep, and would have devoured the land.

paite: Ke'n, "Aw Toupa PATHIAN, khawl in ka hon ngen ahi; bangchi in Jakob adingh thei dia? Amah lah aneu ngal a," ka chi hi.
english: Then I said, “Lord Yahweh, stop, I beg you! How could Jacob stand? For he is small.”

paite: Hiai thu ah TOUPA'N alungsim hei in, "Toupa PATHIAN in, huai leng ahong tung nawn kei ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh relented concerning this. “This also shall not be,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Hichibang in ahon ensak a; ngai dih ua, TOUPA bel ulum a bawl baang kiang ah adingh a, akhut a ulum toh.
english: Thus he showed me: behold, the Lord stood beside a wall made by a plumb line, with a plumb line in his hand.

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA'N, "Amos, bang na mu a?" achi a. Ke'n, "Ulum," ka chi hi. TOUPA'N, “Ngai in, ka mi, Israelte lak ah ulum ka koih ding a; amau ka paikheng nawnta kei ding;
english: Yahweh said to me, “Amos, what do you see?” I said, “A plumb line.” Then the Lord said, “Behold, I will set a plumb line in the middle of my people Israel. I will not again pass by them any more.

paite: Isak mun sangte ahong segawp ding a, Israel mun siangthoute hihsiat ahi ding ua; Jeroboam inkote namsau in ka dou ding," achi hi.
english: The high places of Isaac will be desolate, the sanctuaries of Israel will be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.”

paite: Huan Bethel kho siampu Amaziah in Israel kumpipa Jeroboam kiang ah, "Amos in Israel inkote lak ah nang hon kalh a; gam in athu tengteng athuak thei kei," chi in.
english: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, “Amos has conspired against you in the middle of the house of Israel. The land is not able to bear all his words.

paite: Amos in lah hichi in achi ngal a, “Jeroboam namsau in asi ding, pel lou in agam a kipan in Israel sal in apikhe ding," chi in thu akhak hi.
english: For Amos says, ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.’”

paite: Huan Amos kiang ah Amaziah in, "Aw nang zawlnei, kuan inla, Judah gam ah taimang in, huai ah an ne inla, thu hilh in.
english: Amaziah also said to Amos, “You seer, go, flee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there,

paite: Himahleh Bethel ah thu hilh nawn ke'n; kumpipa mun siangthou leh kumpipa' inn ahih ziak in," achi lai hi.
english: but don’t prophesy again any more at Bethel; for it is the king’s sanctuary, and it is a royal house!”

paite: Huan Amaziah kiang ah Amos in, "Zawlnei ka hi kei a, zawlnei tapa leng ka hi sam kei; ganhon vengpa leh theipi sing kempa ka hi zaw hi.
english: Then Amos answered Amaziah, “I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son, but I was a herdsman, and a farmer of sycamore figs;

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, 'Kuan inla, ka mi Israelte kiang ah thu gen in,' hon chi hi.
english: and Yahweh took me from following the flock, and Yahweh said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to my people Israel.’

paite: Huchi in tu in TOUPA thu za in; nang Israel kalh in thu gen ke'nla, Isak inkote kalh in thu khak ke'n, na chih.
english: Now therefore listen to Yahweh’s word: ‘You say, Don’t prophesy against Israel, and don’t preach against the house of Isaac.’

paite: Huaiziak in ToUPA'N hichi in achi, 'Khopi ah na zi kizuaknu ahi ding a, na tapate, na tanute namsau in apuk ding ua, tehna khau in na gam ahawm ding ua; nang leng siang lou mun ah na si ding a; pel lou in Israel a gam a kipan sal in apimang ding uh, achi,' " chi in adawng hi.
english: Therefore Yahweh says: ‘Your wife shall be a prostitute in the city, and your sons and your daughters shall fall by the sword, and your land shall be divided by line; and you yourself shall die in a land that is unclean, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.’”

paite: Hichibang in Toupa PATHIAN in ahon ensak a; en dih ua, nipithei bawm na hi hi.
english: Thus the Lord Yahweh showed me: behold, a basket of summer fruit.

paite: Ama'n, "Amos, bang ahia na muh?" achi a. Ke'n, "Nipithei bawm," ka chi hi. TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Ka mi Israelte tung ah tawpna ahong tungta; amaute gawtna ding ah ka lungsim ka kheng nawn kei ding hi, chi in.
english: He said, “Amos, what do you see?” I said, “A basket of summer fruit.” Then Yahweh said to me, “The end has come on my people Israel. I will not again pass by them any more.

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in, huai ni chiang in tempul a lasakte dahna la ahi ding a; mun chih ah siluang tampi a-om ding a, dai dide in apaikhe ding uh," achi hi.
english: The songs of the temple will be wailing in that day,” says the Lord Yahweh. “The dead bodies will be many. In every place they will throw them out with silence.

paite: Hiai ngaikhia in, aw tasamte ne bei nuam a; gam a migentheite hihmang nuamte aw,
english: Hear this, you who desire to swallow up the needy, and cause the poor of the land to fail,

paite: "Buh ka zuaktheihna ding un chikchiang a kha thak bei ding a, tangbuang buh ka zuaktheihna ding ua chikchiang a Sabbath ni bei ding ahia, chi in; Ephah hihneu a shekel hihlian, dikloupi a bukna khemna in na zang ua,
english: saying, ‘When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell grain? And the Sabbath, that we may market wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel large, and dealing falsely with balances of deceit;

paite: huchi a dangkasik a migentheite lei a, tasamte khedap buh khat a i lei a, buhsi i zuaktheihna ding in,” chi in.
english: that we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals, and sell the sweepings with the wheat?’”

paite: TOUPA, Jakob thupina sial in akichiam a, “Pel lou in anasep himhim ka mangngilh het kei ding," chi in.
english: Yahweh has sworn by the pride of Jacob, “Surely I will never forget any of their works.

paite: Hiai ziak in gam pumpi ling in asung a om peuhmahte alungkham kei ding ua hia? Ahi, tui lian bang in ahong khang vek ding a; Aigupta gam lui bang in ahong buai in akiam ding hi.
english: Won’t the land tremble for this, and everyone mourn who dwells in it? Yes, it will rise up wholly like the River; and it will be stirred up and sink again, like the River of Egypt.

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in, huai ni chiang in, hichi ahong hi ding a, sun lai in ni ka tumsak ding a, nisat lai in lei ka mialsak ding hi.
english: It will happen in that day,” says the Lord Yahweh, “that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day.

paite: Na ankuangluite uh lungkhamna leh na la tengteng uh kahna ka suaksak ding a; kawng tengteng sai-ip puan ka tengsak ding a, lu chih sip ah giauna ka hon tungsak ding; tapa tang neih suunna ding in lungkhamna leh atawpna khatna ni bang in ka bawl ding hi.
english: I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will make you wear sackcloth on all your bodies, and baldness on every head. I will make it like the mourning for an only son, and its end like a bitter day.

paite: “Toupa PATHIAN in, ngai dih ua, nite ahong tung lellel; huai ni chiang in gam ah kial ka sawl ding a, an kialna hilou, tui a kialna hi sam lou, TOUPA thu theihna kialna pen," achi hi.
english: Behold, the days come,” says the Lord Yahweh, “that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing Yahweh’s words.

paite: Huan tuipi a kipan tuipi ah leh mal a kipan suahlam ah leng avakvai ding ua; TOUPA thu zong ding in ning chih ah atai ding ua, amu kei ding uh.
english: They will wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east; they will run back and forth to seek Yahweh’s word, and will not find it.

paite: Huai ni chiang in nungak siangthou leh tangvalte dangtak in abah ding uhi.
english: In that day the beautiful virgins and the young men will faint for thirst.

paite: "Samaria khelhna sial a kichiam a, 'Aw Dan, na Pathian ahin bang in' leh 'Beer-sheba Lampi ahin bang in' chi, huai mite leng apuk ding ua, athounawn het kei ding uh,” achi hi.
english: Those who swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, ‘As your god, Dan, lives,’ and, ‘As the way of Beersheba lives,’ they will fall, and never rise up again.”

paite: Maitam chin a TOUPA dingh in ka mu a, ama'n, "Kongpi bulte alin theihna ding ua alu bawkte uh khen inla, avek ua lutung ah hihzan vek in; ke'n asibangte namsau in ka that ding a; khat lel leng ataimang kei ding uh, khat lel leng asuakta het kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: I saw the Lord standing beside the altar, and he said, “Strike the tops of the pillars, that the thresholds may shake. Break them in pieces on the head of all of them. I will kill the last of them with the sword. Not one of them will flee away. Not one of them will escape.

paite: Misikhua pha in paisuak mah le uh, huai a kipan ka khut in ka lakhe ding a; van ah kaltou mah le uh huai a kipan ka kaikhe ding hi.
english: Though they dig into Sheol, there my hand will take them; and though they climb up to heaven, there I will bring them down.

paite: Karmel mualvum ah bu mah le uh ka zong ding a, huai a kipan amau ka lasuk ding a, tuipi taw ah ka mitmuh louh in bu mah le uh, huai a kipan gulpi thu ka pe ding a, amau atu ding hi.
english: Though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out from there; and though they be hidden from my sight in the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent, and it will bite them.

paite: Amelmate uh ma ah sal in pai mah le uh, huai a kipan namsau thu ka pe ding a, amau asatlum ding ua; hoihna hilou in, hoihlouhna ding in atung uah ka mit ka nga ding hi.
english: Though they go into captivity before their enemies, there I will command the sword, and it will kill them. I will set my eyes on them for evil, and not for good.
