paite: Koi lai ah ahia i hohtouh ding? I unaute'n, mihing ei sang in alianzaw ua, san leng asangzaw ua; khuate alian a, van sun in kulh anei uh. Anak tapate leng i mu a, chi in hon lung kesak uh," na chi uhi.
english: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our heart melt, saying, ‘The people are greater and taller than we. The cities are great and fortified up to the sky. Moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there!’”

paite: Ke'n na kiang uah, "Amaute kihta kei unla, lauh leng lau sam kei un.
english: Then I said to you, “Don’t be terrified. Don’t be afraid of them.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian na makaipa un na mitmuh ua Aigupta gam a hon hihsak tengteng bang in ahon doupih ding.
english: Yahweh your God, who goes before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes,

paite: Gamdai ah leng mi'n ata apuak bang a TOUPA na Pathian un hiai mun na tun tan un lamtawn a hon puakdan na mu ding uhi, ka chi hi.
english: and in the wilderness where you have seen how that Yahweh your God carried you, as a man carries his son, in all the way that you went, until you came to this place.”

paite: Himahleh hiai thil ah TOUPA na Pathian uh na gingta kei uh.
english: Yet in this thing you didn’t believe Yahweh your God,

paite: Na puanin na zak ding uh hon zonsak ding leh na lampi uh hon kawkmuh dia zan a meikuang a, sun a meipi a na ma uh pipa na muang kei uhi."
english: who went before you on the way, to seek out a place for you to pitch your tents in: in fire by night, to show you by what way you should go, and in the cloud by day.

paite: TOUPA'N na thugen uh aza a, aheh a, akichiam hi.
english: Yahweh heard the voice of your words and was angry, and swore, saying,

paite: "Hiai suan giloutak lak a mi khat mahmah in leng na pi-le-pute uh pe dia ka kichiamna gam hoih petmah amu kei ding uh,
english: “Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land which I swore to give to your fathers,

paite: Jephunneh tapa Kaleb kia ngal lou in. Ama'n zaw amu dia, ava sik gam amah leh atate ka pe ding, ama'n alungtang tengteng a TOUPA azuih ziak in," achi hi.
english: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh. He shall see it. I will give the land that he has trodden on to him and to his children, because he has wholly followed Yahweh.”

paite: Noute ziak in ka tung ah TOUPA aheh a, "Nang leng huai ah na lut kei ding,
english: Also Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, saying, “You also shall not go in there.

paite: na nasempa Nun tapa Joshua bel alut ding. Amah hanthawn in, Israelte alutsak ding hi.
english: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall go in there. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

paite: "Na taneute uh, gallak in ala mai ding uh, na chihte uleh, tua asia-apha thei nai lou na tate uh alut ding ua, amau zaw ka pe dia, aluah ding uhi.
english: Moreover your little ones, whom you said would be captured or killed, your children, who today have no knowledge of good or evil, shall go in there. I will give it to them, and they shall possess it.

paite: Nou ahihleh kihei unla, Tuipi San lam ah gamdai ah pai un," achi hi.
english: But as for you, turn, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”

paite: Nou, "TOUPA tung ah i na khialta uh, i hohtou ding ua, TOUPA i Pathian in thu hon piak tengteng bang in i va dou ding uh," chi in na hon dawng ua, huchi in kidouna van in na kivan chiat ua, tang a hohtouh thil neuchik in na ngaihtuah uhi.
english: Then you answered and said to me, “We have sinned against Yahweh. We will go up and fight, according to all that Yahweh our God commanded us.” Every man of you put on his weapons of war, and presumed to go up into the hill country.

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Hohtou kei un. Va dou sam kei un, na lak uah ka om kei hi. Na melmate un hon na that kha ding uh, akiang uah chi in," ahon chi hi.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Tell them, ‘Don’t go up and don’t fight; for I am not among you, lest you be struck before your enemies.’”

paite: Huai ka hon hilh a, na ngaikhe kei ua, TOUPA thupiak na helsan zawta ua, tang ah na hohtou teitei uhi.
english: So I spoke to you, and you didn’t listen; but you rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill country.

paite: Huai tang ah Amorte'n hon na dou ua, khuai midelh bang in hon delh ua, Seir a pan Hormah tan in hon that uhi.
english: The Amorites, who lived in that hill country, came out against you and chased you as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even to Hormah.

paite: Na hong kik nawn ua, TOUPA ma ah na kap ua; himahleh TOUPA'N na aw uh angaikhe kei a, abil leng ahon doh sam kei hi.
english: You returned and wept before Yahweh, but Yahweh didn’t listen to your voice, nor turn his ear to you.

paite: Huchi in huai a na om sung uh ngaihtuah in Kadesh ah sawtpi na taam uhi.
english: So you stayed in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you remained.

paite: Huai lai in TOUPA'N ka kiang huanghang ate bang sek nawn inla, tang ah ka kiang ah hong pai inla, singkuang bawl in.
english: At that time Yahweh said to me, “Cut two stone tablets like the first, and come up to me onto the mountain, and make an ark of wood.

paite: Tuma lam a suangpek na hihkhapte a thu tuangte suangpekte ah ka gelh dia, singkuang ah na koih ding ahi," achi hi.
english: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.”

paite: Huchi in singgi sing in singkuang ka bawl a, tuma lam a bang suangpek nih ka sek a, suangpek nihte tawi in tang ah ka hohtou hi.
english: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two stone tablets like the first, and went up onto the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.

paite: Suangpekte ah ama a gelh bang, na kikhopkhawm ni ua tang a mei a pan TOUPA'N na kiang ua agen thupiak sawm agelh a, TOUPA'N ahon pia hi.
english: He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which Yahweh spoke to you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly; and Yahweh gave them to me.

paite: Tang a pan ka kiheisuk nawn a, ka singkuang bawl ah suangpek ka koih hi. TOUPA'N thu hon piak bang in huai ah a-om nilouh hi.
english: I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and there they are as Yahweh commanded me.

paite: Israel suante Bene-jaakan tuileh a pan Moserah ah apai ua; huai ah Aaron asi a, huai ah avui uhi. Atapa Eleazar in amun ah siampu nna asem hi.
english: (The children of Israel traveled from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his place.

paite: Huai a pan Gudgodah ah apai ua; Gudgodah a pan tuiluite gam Jotbathah ah apai uhi.
english: From there they traveled to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.

paite: Huai lai in tutan a TOUPA thukhun singkuang zawng a, ama a TOUPA nna sem a, amin a vualzawlsakmi hi ding in Levi chi aseptuam hi.
english: At that time Yahweh set apart the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, to stand before Yahweh to minister to him, and to bless in his name, to this day.

paite: Huaiziak in Levi in a-unaute lak ah tantuan, goutan anei kei hi. TOUPA na Pathian un akiang a agen bang in TOUPA agoutan ahi.
english: Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers; Yahweh is his inheritance, according as Yahweh your God spoke to him.)

paite: Amalam mah bang in tang ah, ni sawmli ka om a; huai lai in leng TOUPA'N ka thu angaikhia a, TOUPA'N nou hon hihmangthang kei hi.
english: I stayed on the mountain, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights; and Yahweh listened to me that time also. Yahweh would not destroy you.

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Thou inla, mipite ma kai in; amaute piak dia api-le-pute uh kiang a kichiam a ka chiam gam aluah ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Arise, take your journey before the people; and they shall go in and possess the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them.”

paite: Khai le, Israel mite aw, nou a pan TOUPA na Pathian un ahon phut bangdang ahia, na hoihna ding ua TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan siam a, alampi tengteng tawn a, amah it a, na lungtang tengteng uleh na lungsim tengteng ua TOUPA na Pathian uh nna sem a,
english: Now, Israel, what does Yahweh your God require of you, but to fear Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, and to serve Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

paite: TOUPA thupiakte, adante zuih dia tua thu ka hon piak zuih hilou maw?
english: to keep Yahweh’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for your good?

paite: Ngai un, van leh van sangpente leh lei leh asung a om tengteng TOUPA na Pathian uh a vek ahi.
english: Behold, to Yahweh your God belongs heaven, the heaven of heavens, and the earth, with all that is therein.

paite: Himahleh na pi-le-pute it bel amah kipah lam ahi a, namdang tengteng tung ah noute, amau nung a asuante uh tua na hih mah bang un hon na telta hi.
english: Only Yahweh had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their offspring after them, even you above all peoples, as it is today.

paite: Huaiziak in na lungtang vun uh sum unla, genhak nawn kei un.
english: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiff-necked.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh lah pathiante' Pathian, toupate' Toupa, Pathian thupitak, hattak, lauhuaitak, kuamah deihsak tuam nei lou a, golhna leng la ngei lou ahi ngal a.
english: For Yahweh your God, he is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the awesome, who doesn’t respect persons or take bribes.

paite: Pa neiloute leh meithaite hoihtak in vai ahawmsak hi.
english: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow and loves the foreigner in giving him food and clothing.

paite: Huaiziak in gamdang mite it sam un; nou leng Aigupta gam ah gamdangmi na hi ngeita uhi.
english: Therefore love the foreigner, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan na siam ding ua, amah nna na sem ding ua; amah na len tinten ding ua, amin lou in na kichiam ding uh ahi.
english: You shall fear Yahweh your God. You shall serve him. You shall cling to him, and you shall swear by his name.

paite: Amah na phat dingpa uh ahi, hiai na mit ua na muh khitsa uh thil thupitak leh mulkimhuaitakte hon hihsakpa na Pathian uh ahi.
english: He is your praise, and he is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things which your eyes have seen.

paite: Na pi-le-pute uh Aigupta gam ah mi sawmsagih apaisuk ua; tu in bel tamlam in van a aksi zah in TOUPA na Pathian un ahon tamsakta hi.
english: Your fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons; and now Yahweh your God has made you as the stars of the sky for multitude.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA na Pathian uh na it un adan thusehte, adante, avaihawmte leh athupiakte na zui gige ding uh ahi.
english: Therefore you shall love Yahweh your God, and keep his instructions, his statutes, his ordinances, and his commandments, always.

paite: Tu in thei un, TOUPA na Pathian sawina, athupidan, aban hatdan, aban zakdan,
english: Know this day—for I don’t speak with your children who have not known, and who have not seen the chastisement of Yahweh your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, his outstretched arm,

paite: achiamtehnate, athilhih, Aigupta gamsung a Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh tung leh agamsung pumpi a ahihte;
english: his signs, and his works, which he did in the middle of Egypt to Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and to all his land;

paite: Aigupta sepaihte leh asakol leh akangtalai tung a athilhihte; nou ahon delhzui ua, Tuipi San a atumsakdan, tutan a TOUPA'N ahihmanthatdante;
english: and what he did to the army of Egypt, to their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red Sea to overflow them as they pursued you, and how Yahweh has destroyed them to this day;

paite: hiai mun na tun masiah ua gamdai a na tung ua athilhihtheihdante;
english: and what he did to you in the wilderness until you came to this place;

paite: Reuben tapa Eliab tapa Dathan leh Abiram tung a ahihdan; lei in akam akat a, Israel mite tengteng lak a amaute leh a-inkuanpihte uh leh apuaninte uh leh aganhon tengteng uh avalh vekdante thei lou na suante uh kiang a thu gen ka hi kei hi.
english: and what he did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben—how the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households, their tents, and every living thing that followed them, in the middle of all Israel;

paite: Na mit ngei ua TOUPA'N thil thupitak, ahih tengteng mute kiang a thugen ka hi zaw hi.
english: but your eyes have seen all of Yahweh’s great work which he did.

paite: Huaiziak in na hong hat ua, luah dia na va zot gam uh na luahtheihna ding un, tuni a ka hon piak thupiak tengteng na zuih ding uh ahi.
english: Therefore you shall keep the entire commandment which I command you today, that you may be strong, and go in and possess the land that you go over to possess;

paite: Nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam, na pi-le-pute leh asuante kiang a piak dia TOUPA'N akichiamna gam a na ten sawttheihna ding un.
english: and that you may prolong your days in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers to give to them and to their offspring, a land flowing with milk and honey.

paite: Huai na va luah ding uh gam, na hong pawtna uh Aigupta gam, anteh-louhing huan a haichi na tuh ua, na khe ua tui na buah uh bang uh ahi kei hi.
english: For the land, where you go in to possess isn’t like the land of Egypt that you came out of, where you sowed your seed and watered it with your foot, as a garden of herbs;

paite: Na va luah ding uh gam zaw, mualte leh phaizangte leh van vuahtui mu gam ahi zaw hi.
english: but the land that you go over to possess is a land of hills and valleys which drinks water from the rain of the sky,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh zonkhiak gam ahi a; TOUPA na Pathian uh mit kum thak a pan kum tawp pha atuk gigena gam ahi.
english: a land which Yahweh your God cares for. Yahweh your God’s eyes are always on it, from the beginning of the year even to the end of the year.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian uh it ding leh na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng ua a-nna sem dia tu a ka hon piak thupiak tengteng phatuamngaitak a na zuih uleh,
english: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to my commandments which I command you today, to love Yahweh your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,

paite: na gam vuahtui uh ahun geihgeih in, vuahtui ke masa leh vuahtui ke nanung ka hon pe dia, huchi in na buh uh, na uain uh, na thau uh na seklut thei ding uhi.
english: that I will give the rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your grain, your new wine, and your oil.

paite: Na gante uh a ding in leng na loute uah loupa ka hon sawl dia, nou leng na ne ding ua, na tai ding uhi.
english: I will give grass in your fields for your livestock, and you shall eat and be full.

paite: Pilvang un, huchi lou in zaw na lungtang uh khem in a-om dia, na pial ding ua, pathian dangte nna sem in, na be kha ding uh.
english: Be careful, lest your heart be deceived, and you turn away to serve other gods and worship them;

paite: Na huchih uleh TOUPA na tung uah athangpai dia, van akhak dia, vuah azu kei dia, lei in agah apiangsak kei ding. Huchi in TOUPA'N ahon piak, gam hoih a pan na mangthang pah ding uhi.
english: and Yahweh’s anger be kindled against you, and he shut up the sky so that there is no rain, and the land doesn’t yield its fruit; and you perish quickly from off the good land which Yahweh gives you.

paite: Huaiziak in hiai ka thute na lungtang uleh na lungsim uah khum unla, chiamtehna ding in na ban uah na vial ding ua, na mit kikal uah talgakna ding in leng a-om ding ahi.
english: Therefore you shall lay up these words of mine in your heart and in your soul. You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

paite: Huaite na tate uh na sinsak ding ua, na inn ua na tut lai un, lampi a na pai lai un, na lup lai un, na thoh chiang un na gen ding uhi.
english: You shall teach them to your children, talking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up.

paite: Na inn kongkhak biangte uah, na kongkhakte uah na gelh ding uh ahi.
english: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates;

paite: Huchi in na pi-le-pute uh piak dia akichiamna gam ah na damsung nite uh leh na tate uh damsung nite leitung a vante nite bang in asausak ding hi.
english: that your days and your children’s days may be multiplied in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers to give them, as the days of the heavens above the earth.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh it ding leh alampi tengteng zui ding leh amah len tinten ding a phatuamngaitak a hiai thupiak nou ka hon piak tengteng na zuih peuhmah uleh;
english: For if you shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you—to do them, to love Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cling to him—

paite: TOUPA'N hiai nam tengteng ahon delhkhiaksak dia, nou sang a thupizaw leh thilhihtheizaw namte gam na luah ding uhi.
english: then Yahweh will drive out all these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourselves.

paite: Na khepek ua na sikna peuh uh nou a ahi dia, gamdai a pan leh Lebanon tang a pan lui, Euphrates Luipi a pan tumlam tuipi pha in na gam uh ahi ding hi.
english: Every place on which the sole of your foot treads shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even to the western sea shall be your border.

paite: Kuamah in hon pha kei dia; TOUPA na Pathian un na kiang ua agensa bang in na va sik ding uh gam tengteng ah noute kihtakna leh lauhna a-omsak ding.
english: No man will be able to stand before you. Yahweh your God will lay the fear of you and the dread of you on all the land that you tread on, as he has spoken to you.

paite: Ngai un, tuni in na ma uah vualzawlna leh hamsia ka koih hi:
english: Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse:

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiakte, tua ka hon piakte na zuih uleh, vualzawlna ahi ding hi.
english: the blessing, if you listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God, which I command you today;

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiakte na zuih kei uleh, na theih ngei louh uh pathian dangte be ding a tua ka hon thupiakte na pialsan uleh bel, hamsiat na hi ding uh.
english: and the curse, if you do not listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God, but turn away out of the way which I command you today, to go after other gods which you have not known.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, na va luah ding uh gam a TOUPA na Pathian un hon pilut chiang in, Gerizim tang ah vualzawlna, Ebal tang ah hamsiatna na koih ding uhi.
english: It shall happen, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land that you go to possess, that you shall set the blessing on Mount Gerizim, and the curse on Mount Ebal.

paite: Nitumna khen, Arabah a om, Kanaante gam, Gilgal zawn Moreh tosaw sik, Jordan gal ate ahi kei uh maw?
english: Aren’t they beyond the Jordan, behind the way of the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites who dwell in the Arabah near Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak gam va luah ding in Jordan na kan ding ua, na luah ding ua, huai ah na teng ding uhi.
english: For you are to pass over the Jordan to go in to possess the land which Yahweh your God gives you, and you shall possess it and dwell in it.

paite: Tua na ma ua ka koih, dan leh vaihawm tengteng zui ding in na pilvang ding uh ahi.
english: You shall observe to do all the statutes and the ordinances which I set before you today.

paite: TOUPA na pi-le-pute uh Pathian in hon piak gam na luah ua, leitung a na ten sung ua pilvangtak a na zuih ding uh dante leh vaihawmte hiaite ahi uh.
english: These are the statutes and the ordinances which you shall observe to do in the land which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess all the days that you live on the earth.

paite: Na va luah ding uh gam namte'n tang sangte leh mualte tung leh sing hing nuai a pathiante nna asepna mun tengteng uh na hihsiat vek ding uh ahi.
english: You shall surely destroy all the places in which the nations that you shall dispossess served their gods: on the high mountains, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

paite: Amaitamte uh na hihchim ding ua, a Asherahte uh mei in na hal ding uh ahi. Abawltawm uh pathian limte na phuksak ding ua, huai a minte na hihse ding uhi.
english: You shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, and burn their Asherah poles with fire. You shall cut down the engraved images of their gods. You shall destroy their name out of that place.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh tung ah bel huchibang in na hih ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not do so to Yahweh your God.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un na nam tengteng lak ua amin omna dia amun seh ding na zong zaw ding ua, huai ah na hoh ding uh ahi.
english: But to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose out of all your tribes, to put his name there, you shall seek his habitation, and you shall come there.

paite: Huai ah na halmang thillatte uh, na sawm-a-khatte uh, na vei thillat uh leh na thuchiamte uh, piak dia na chiamsate uh, na ut thu ua thillatte leh na ganhon uh leh na belamhon lak ua piang masapente na hon tawi ding uh ahi.
english: You shall bring your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, your vows, your free will offerings, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock there.

paite: Huai ah TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah na ne ding ua, na khut koihna peuh ua TOUPA na Pathian un ahon vualzawlna ah kipaktak in na om ding uh.
english: There you shall eat before Yahweh your God, and you shall rejoice in all that you put your hand to, you and your households, in which Yahweh your God has blessed you.

paite: Michih in amau hoihsak bang chiat a tuni a na hih bang ua na hih ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not do all the things that we do here today, every man whatever is right in his own eyes;

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un nou hon piak gam leh khawlna lah na tung nai tadih ngal kei ua.
english: for you haven’t yet come to the rest and to the inheritance which Yahweh your God gives you.

paite: Jordan lui na galkah ua, TOUPA na Pathian un ahon luahsak ding gam a na ten ua, bittak a na tentheihna ding ua na kim ua melma tengteng a pan hon khawlsak chiang in hichi ahi ding.
english: But when you go over the Jordan and dwell in the land which Yahweh your God causes you to inherit, and he gives you rest from all your enemies around you, so that you dwell in safety,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un amin a-omsakna dia asehna mun ah ka chih tengteng na hon tawi ding uh ahi: Na halmang thillatte uh, na kithoihnate uh, na sawm ua khatte uh, na vei thillat uh leh TOUPA kiang a na chiamsa uh na neihte ua ahoihpen teng na hon tawi ding uh ahi.
english: then it shall happen that to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose, to cause his name to dwell there, there you shall bring all that I command you: your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, the wave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which you vow to Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah kipaktak in na om ding ua, noumau leh na tapate uh, na tanute uh toh, na sikhapate uh, na sikhanute uh toh, na inn ua om, Levite toh, amau lah na lak uah tantuan leh gam anei ngal kei uhi.
english: You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God—you, and your sons, your daughters, your male servants, your female servants, and the Levite who is within your gates, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you.

paite: Mun na muh peuh ua na halmang thillatte uh lan mawkmawk lou ding in pilvang un.
english: Be careful that you don’t offer your burnt offerings in every place that you see;

paite: Na namte uh lak a TOUPA'N aseh ding mun ah na halmang thillatte uh na lan zaw ding ua, huai ah thu ka hon piak tengteng na hih ding uh ahi.
english: but in the place which Yahweh chooses in one of your tribes, there you shall offer your burnt offerings, and there you shall do all that I command you.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA na Pathian un vualzawlna hon muhsak bang zel in na hinna un alunggulhpen uh na inn chiat uah na gou ding ua, asa na ne thei ding uh. Asiangloute leh asiangte'n leng sangai leh sakhi ane thei ding uhi.
english: Yet you may kill and eat meat within all your gates, after all the desire of your soul, according to Yahweh your God’s blessing which he has given you. The unclean and the clean may eat of it, as of the gazelle and the deer.

paite: Asisan ahihleh na ne ding uh ahi kei. Tui bang in lei ah na sungbo ding uh ahi.
english: Only you shall not eat the blood. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.

paite: Na inn uah, na buh uh leh na uain thak ua sawm-a-khat na khuate uah na ne ding uh ahi kei. Ahihkeileh na ganhonte uh leh belamhonte uh leh na kelhonte uh lak a piang masapente ahihkeileh na ut thu ua na thillat uh ahihkeileh na vei thilte na khuate uah na ne ding uh ahi kei.
english: You may not eat within your gates the tithe of your grain, or of your new wine, or of your oil, or the firstborn of your herd or of your flock, nor any of your vows which you vow, nor your free will offerings, nor the wave offering of your hand;

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un amun seh ding ah, TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah na ne zaw ding uh ahi: Noute leh na tapate uh leh na tanute uh, na sikhapate uh, na sikhanute uh, na inn ua om Levite toh. TOUPA na Pathian ma uah na khut ngakna peuhmah ah kipaktak in na om ding uhi.
english: but you shall eat them before Yahweh your God in the place which Yahweh your God shall choose: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, and the Levite who is within your gates. You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God in all that you put your hand to.

paite: Na gam ua na ten sung teng un Levite limsak lou a om lou ding in pilvang un.
english: Be careful that you don’t forsake the Levite as long as you live in your land.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon chiam bang a na gam uh ahih zat a, na hinna un sa nek a-ut ziak a, sa ka ne ding, na chih hun chiang un, na hinna un alunggulh lam peuh sa na ne thei ding uhi.
english: When Yahweh your God enlarges your border, as he has promised you, and you say, “I want to eat meat,” because your soul desires to eat meat, you may eat meat, after all the desire of your soul.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un amin omna dia aseh ding mun agamlat luatleh, thu ka hon piak bang in TOUPA'N hon piak na ganhon uleh na belamhon lak ua na gou ding ua, na hinna un alunggulh lam pang na inn uah na ne ding uh ahi.
english: If the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to put his name is too far from you, then you shall kill of your herd and of your flock, which Yahweh has given you, as I have commanded you; and you may eat within your gates, after all the desire of your soul.

paite: Sangaisa leh sakhisa nek ahih bang in na ne ding ua, asiangloute leh asiangte'n leng akibang in na ne ding uhi.
english: Even as the gazelle and as the deer is eaten, so you shall eat of it. The unclean and the clean may eat of it alike.

paite: Sisan ahihleh ne lou ding in pilvang un; sisan lah hinna ahi ngal a; hinna toh sa na ne ding uh ahi kei.
english: Only be sure that you don’t eat the blood; for the blood is the life. You shall not eat the life with the meat.

paite: Na ne mahmah ding uh ahi kei; tui bang in lei ah na sungbo mai ding uh ahi.
english: You shall not eat it. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.

paite: Na ne ding uh ahi kei. Huchi in TOUPA mitmuh a thil dik na hih un noumau leh na nung ua na tate uh a ding in ahoih ding hi.
english: You shall not eat it, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, when you do that which is right in Yahweh’s eyes.

paite: Himahleh na thil siangthoute uh leh lat dia na thuchiamsate kia uh tawi unla, TOUPA'N amun seh ding ah paipih un.
english: Only your holy things which you have, and your vows, you shall take and go to the place which Yahweh shall choose.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh maitam ah na halmang thillat uh, asa leh asisan na lan ding ua; na kithoihna sisante uh TOUPA na Pathian uh maitam ah na sungkhe ding ua, asa na ne ding uh ahi.
english: You shall offer your burnt offerings, the meat and the blood, on Yahweh your God’s altar. The blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out on Yahweh your God’s altar, and you shall eat the meat.

paite: Hiai ka hon thupiak tengteng limsak unla, ngaikhia un, huchi in TOUPA na Pathian uh mitmuh a thil hoih leh thil dik na hih un noute a ding leh na nung ua na tate uh a ding in tangtawn in ahong hoih ding hi.
english: Observe and hear all these words which I command you, that it may go well with you and with your children after you forever, when you do that which is good and right in Yahweh your God’s eyes.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un na zoh ding uh namte ahon hihmanthatsak a, agam uh na luah ua, na ten hun chiang un;
english: When Yahweh your God cuts off the nations from before you where you go in to dispossess them, and you dispossess them and dwell in their land,

paite: hihmanthat a a-omna ua na awk khaklouhna ding un, pilvang un. Hiai namte'n bangchi in ahia apathiante uh nna asep uh? Achih bang un en leng i chi sam ding uh, chi in apathiante uh tungtang kan kei un.
english: be careful that you are not ensnared to follow them after they are destroyed from before you, and that you not inquire after their gods, saying, “How do these nations serve their gods? I will do likewise.”

paite: Huchibang in TOUPA na Pathian tung ah na hih ding uh ahi kei. Apathiante tung uah TOUPA theih a thilkihhuai chiteng, ahuat mahmahte ahih zel ua; atapate uh, atanute ngei uh leng apathiante uh a ding in ahal zel uhi.
english: You shall not do so to Yahweh your God; for every abomination to Yahweh, which he hates, they have done to their gods; for they even burn their sons and their daughters in the fire to their gods.

paite: Hih ding a ka hon thupiak peuhmah na hih ding uh ahi. Na behlap ding uh ahi kei a, na tawmsak ding uh leng ahi kei.
english: Whatever thing I command you, that you shall observe to do. You shall not add to it, nor take away from it.

paite: Na lak ua zawlnei hiam, mangnimi ham ahongom a, chiamtehna hiam, thillamdang hiam hon etsak a,
english: If a prophet or a dreamer of dreams arises among you, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,

paite: chiamtehna hiam, thillamdang hiam hon etsak, ahong tangtun a, na theih ngei louh uh, "pathian dangte zui ni e, a-nna uh sem ni," na kiang ua achihleh;
english: and the sign or the wonder comes to pass, of which he spoke to you, saying, “Let’s go after other gods” (which you have not known) “and let’s serve them,”

paite: huai zawlnei hiam, mangneimi hiam thute na ngaikhe ding uh ahi kei. TOUPA na Pathian uh na lungtang tengteng uh leh na hinna tengteng un na it uhia, itlou chih theihtelna ding ua TOUPA na Pathian un ahon ze-et ahi.
english: you shall not listen to the words of that prophet, or to that dreamer of dreams; for Yahweh your God is testing you, to know whether you love Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh na zui ding ua, amah laudan na siam ding ua, athupiakte na zui ding ua, athugente na zui ding ua, amah nna na sem ding ua, amah na len tinten ding uh ahi,
english: You shall walk after Yahweh your God, fear him, keep his commandments, and obey his voice. You shall serve him, and cling to him.

paite: Huai zawlnei hiam, mangneimi hiam hihlup ding ahi. Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhia a, saltanna inn a pan hon tanpa TOUPA na Pathian un zuih ding thu ahon piak lampi a pan hon pialsak dia, TOUPA na Pathian uh tung a helna thu agen ziak in, huchibang in na lak ua thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uhi.
english: That prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death, because he has spoken rebellion against Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to draw you aside out of the way which Yahweh your God commanded you to walk in. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

paite: Na unaupa, na nu tapa hiam, na tapa hiam, na tanu hiam, na zi pom lai hiam, na lawm nangmah hinna bang hial nangawn in leng, ahon zol a, kisa ni, "pathian dangte nna sem ni," ahon chihleh; nang hiam, na pipute hiam in leng na theih louh uh pathiante;
english: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own soul, entices you secretly, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods”—which you have not known, you, nor your fathers;

paite: na kimvel ua, na kiangchin ua omte hiam, na kigamlatpih deuh uhiam, kawlmong a pan kawlmong khat lam pha a mite pathiante;
english: of the gods of the peoples who are around you, near to you, or far off from you, from the one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth—

paite: pha na sakpih ding uh ahi kei, amah na ngaikhe ding uh ahi sam kei. Na hehpih ding uh ahi kei a, na hawi ding uh leng ahi sam kei, na iim ding uh leng ahi sam kei hi.
english: you shall not consent to him nor listen to him; neither shall your eye pity him, neither shall you spare, neither shall you conceal him;

paite: Na hihlup ngeingei ding uh ahi zaw. That ding in khut na kha masa ding a, huai khit chiang in mipi tengteng in akhut uh akha ding uh.
english: but you shall surely kill him. Your hand shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterwards the hands of all the people.

paite: Suang a na denlup ding uh ahi, Aigupta gam a saltanna inn a pan hon pikhepa TOUPA na Pathian ua kipan hon pialsakna ding azon ziak in.
english: You shall stone him to death with stones, because he has sought to draw you away from Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

paite: Huchi in Israel mi tengteng in aza ding ua, alau ding ua, na lak ua huchibang tatsiatna himhim achingta kei ding uhi.
english: All Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not do any more wickedness like this among you.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un na tenna ding ua ahon piak na khua khat a na lak ua kipan Belial tate khenkhat hong pawt a,
english: If you hear about one of your cities, which Yahweh your God gives you to dwell there, that

paite: huai khopi a mite na theih ngei louh uh, "pathian dangte be ding in apimang uh," chih thu kigen na zak uleh kan unla;
english: certain wicked fellows have gone out from among you and have drawn away the inhabitants of their city, saying, “Let’s go and serve other gods,” which you have not known,

paite: dingkhia unla, phatuamngaitak in dongkhia un. Ngai un, thudik ana hih a, huchibang thilkihhuai na lak ua hih ahi, chih theihtel ahihleh,
english: then you shall inquire, investigate, and ask diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination was done among you,

paite: namsau a huai khua a tengte na hihlup ngeingei ding uh ahi. Asung a om tengteng, ganhonte toh namsau in na hihmangthang vek ding uh ahi.
english: you shall surely strike the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, with all that is therein and its livestock, with the edge of the sword.

paite: Gallak thil teng kholak ah na lakhawm ding ua, khua leh gallak thil teng TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang ah halmang thillat in na hal ding ua, leivui lel ahi tawntung ding a, lam thak ahi nawn kei ding hi.
english: You shall gather all its plunder into the middle of its street, and shall burn with fire the city, with all of its plunder, to Yahweh your God. It shall be a heap forever. It shall not be built again.

paite: Gallak thil bangmah na khoih ding uh ahi kei. TOUPA'N aheh mahmahna akiheisan dia, zahngaihna ahon musak ding a, hon hehpih ding hi.
english: Nothing of the devoted thing shall cling to your hand, that Yahweh may turn from the fierceness of his anger and show you mercy, and have compassion on you and multiply you, as he has sworn to your fathers,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh mitmuh a thil hoih hih dia tua ka hon piak thupiak tengteng na zuih peuhmah uleh nou ahon pungsak ding hi; na pi-le-pute uh kiang a ana kichiam khit bang in.
english: when you listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep all his commandments which I command you today, to do that which is right in Yahweh your God’s eyes.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh tapate na hi ua; misi ziak in na ki-atkeh ding uh ahi kei. Na mitmul uh leng na metmai ding uh ahi sam kei hi.
english: You are the children of Yahweh your God. You shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian a ding in nam siangthou na hi uh. Leitung a nam tengteng tung ah amah a tuam mawng hi dia TOUPA'N hon tel na hi uhi.
english: For you are a holy people to Yahweh your God, and Yahweh has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.

paite: Thilkihhuai himhim na ne ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not eat any abominable thing.

paite: Hiai sate ahi, na nek theih ding uh: Bawngtal, belam, kel,
english: These are the animals which you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,

paite: sakhi, sangai, sakhital, sathak, gamkel, gamlawi leh gam belam.
english: the deer, the gazelle, the roebuck, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope, and the chamois.

paite: Sa chiteng, achin ka, achin ka paisuak, eknel hai chi peuhmah na ne thei ding uh.
english: Every animal that parts the hoof, and has the hoof split in two and chews the cud, among the animals, you may eat.

paite: Himahleh eknel hai lel leh achin uh leng ka ngalte, na nek ding uh ahi kei. Sangawngsau, zupi leh zusapi in eknel ahai na ua, achin uh akat louh ziak in nou a ding in siang lou ahi uh.
english: Nevertheless these you shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of those who have the hoof split: the camel, the hare, and the rabbit. Because they chew the cud but don’t part the hoof, they are unclean to you.

paite: Vok ahihleh achin aka na a, eknel ahai louh ziak in nou a ding in siang lou ahi; asa na ne ding uh ahi kei a, asiluang leng na khoih ding uh ahi kei.
english: The pig, because it has a split hoof but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses.

paite: Tui a tengte lak ah hiaite na ne thei ding uh: phe leh lip nei peuhmah na ne thei ding uhi.
english: These you may eat of all that are in the waters: you may eat whatever has fins and scales.

paite: Phe leh lip nei lou peuhmahte na ne thei kei ding uh, nou a ding in siang lou ahi uh.
english: You shall not eat whatever doesn’t have fins and scales. It is unclean to you.

paite: Vasa siang tengteng na ne thei ding uh.
english: Of all clean birds you may eat.

paite: Hiaite zaw na ne ding uh ahi kei: Muvanlai, mungawnggiau, mu-akla;
english: But these are they of which you shall not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the osprey,

paite: musane, mumeika, mu chi himhim;
english: the red kite, the falcon, the kite of any kind,

paite: va-ak chi himhim;
english: every raven of any kind,

paite: simbu, zan mu, mu chi himhim, tuipi mu;
english: the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, the hawk of any kind,

paite: simbu neu, simbu lian, simbutanglip;
english: the little owl, the great owl, the horned owl,

paite: gamdai simbu, musane, vangawngsau;
english: the pelican, the vulture, the cormorant,

paite: Tuiva kengsang, tuivapi chi himhim, huihtun leh bak.
english: the stork, the heron after its kind, the hoopoe, and the bat.

paite: Kha nei khe a pai chi himhim nou a ding in siang lou ahi uh, nek ding ahi kei.
english: All winged creeping things are unclean to you. They shall not be eaten.

paite: Vasa siang tengteng na ne thei ding uh.
english: Of all clean birds you may eat.

paite: Amah sih a si bangmah na nek ding uh ahi kei. Na ompih uh gamdang mite nek ding in na pe thei ding uh. Namdang mite kiang ah leng na zuak thei ding uh. Nou zaw TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in nam siangthou na hi uhi. Kelnou api nawitui in na huan ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not eat of anything that dies of itself. You may give it to the foreigner living among you who is within your gates, that he may eat it; or you may sell it to a foreigner; for you are a holy people to Yahweh your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.

paite: Kum chih in na lou ua an tung tengteng sawm-a-khat na piak ngeingei ding uh ahi.
english: You shall surely tithe all the increase of your seed, that which comes out of the field year by year.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan siamna dan na hon theihgige theihna ding un sawm-a-khat, na buh uh, na uain uh, na thau uh leh na ganhon uh leh na belamhon lak ua piang masapente TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah, amin omna dia aseh ding ah na ne ding uhi.
english: You shall eat before Yahweh your God, in the place which he chooses to cause his name to dwell, the tithe of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock; that you may learn to fear Yahweh your God always.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un hon vualzawl chiang in, TOUPA na Pathian un amin omna dia aseh ding mun agamlat luat ziak a nou a dia alampi asau luat a, na tawi theih kei uleh,
english: If the way is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it because the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to set his name there is too far from you, when Yahweh your God blesses you,

paite: sum na suah ding ua, sum na tawi ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian un amun sehna ah na hoh ding uh ahi.
english: then you shall turn it into money, bind up the money in your hand, and shall go to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose.

paite: Na lungsim ua na deihpen uh, bawngtal hiam, belam hiam, uain hiam, zu khauh hiam, na lungsim ua na lunggulh peuhmah uh a ding in sum na zang ding ua; huai ah TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah na ne ding ua, kipaktak in na om ding uh; noute leh na inkote uh toh.
english: You shall trade the money for whatever your soul desires: for cattle, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatever your soul asks of you. You shall eat there before Yahweh your God, and you shall rejoice, you and your household.

paite: Na tenna ua teng Levite limsak lou in om het kei un. Na lak uah amau tantuan leh goutan anei kei uhi.
english: You shall not forsake the Levite who is within your gates, for he has no portion nor inheritance with you.

paite: Kum thum achin kum in huai kum a na thil tung tengteng ua sawm-a-khat na lakhawm vek ding ua, na omna uah na koih ding uh ahi.
english: At the end of every three years you shall bring all the tithe of your increase in the same year, and shall store it within your gates.

paite: Na omna ua om Levite leng, na lak ua tantuan, goutan leng neiloute leh gamdang mite leh pa neiloute leh meithaite'n ane ding ua, ahong khosa thei sam ding uhi. Huchi in TOUPA na Pathian un na khut koihna teng uh avualzawl ding hi.
english: The Levite, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you, as well as the foreigner living among you, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that Yahweh your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.

paite: Kum sagih achin kum in ngaihdamna na bawl ding uh ahi.
english: At the end of every seven years, you shall cancel debts.

paite: Ngaihdamdan ding hichibang ahi: Leiba neimi peuhmah in a-invengte ana leitawisak angaihdam ding ahi. A-invengte leng, a-u anau leng asik teitei ding ahi kei; TOUPA khahkhiak chih ahih ziak in.
english: This is the way it shall be done: every creditor shall release that which he has lent to his neighbor. He shall not require payment from his neighbor and his brother, because Yahweh’s release has been proclaimed.

paite: Namdangmi ahihleh na sik teitei thei ding uh. Himahleh nou a bangpeuh na unaute un ana zat uh na ngaihdam ding uh ahi.
english: Of a foreigner you may require it; but whatever of yours is with your brother, your hand shall release.

paite: Mizawng himhim na om ding uh ahi kei; TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia nou ahon piak gam ah TOUPA'N lah hon vualzawl ngei ding ahi ngal a.
english: However there will be no poor with you (for Yahweh will surely bless you in the land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance to possess)

paite: Hiai thupiak tuni a ka thupiak tengteng zui dia TOUPA na Pathian uh phatuamngaitak a na zuih peuhmah uleh;
english: if only you diligently listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all this commandment which I command you today.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon chiam bang in hon vualzawl ding a, nam tampi na leitawisak ding uh. Nam tampi tung ah vai na hawm ding ua, nou tung ah bel amau vai ahawm kei ding uhi.
english: For Yahweh your God will bless you, as he promised you. You will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow. You will rule over many nations, but they will not rule over you.

paite: TOUPA'N ahon gam piak na tenna ua na unaute uh lak a mizawng a-om uleh na unau gentheite lak ah na lungsim khauhsak kei unla, sumchil sam kei un.
english: If a poor man, one of your brothers, is with you within any of your gates in your land which Yahweh your God gives you, you shall not harden your heart, nor shut your hand from your poor brother;

paite: Atung uah na thilphal ngeingei ding ua, ataksap awng hukna khop na leitawisak ding uh ahi.
english: but you shall surely open your hand to him, and shall surely lend him sufficient for his need, which he lacks.

paite: "Ngaihdam kum, akum sagihna ahong tung dekta, chi in na unau zawngte mudah a bangmah pe nuam lou in na lungtang uah dikloutak a ngaihtuahna om lou ding in pilvang un," Huchi lou in zaw, amau na tungtang thu uah TOUPA asam ding ua, nou a ding in khelhna ahi kha ding.
english: Beware that there not be a wicked thought in your heart, saying, “The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand,” and your eye be evil against your poor brother and you give him nothing; and he cry to Yahweh against you, and it be sin to you.

paite: Na piak ngeingei ding uh ahi. Na piak chiang un leng na lungtang uh anuam moh ding ahi kei. Huchibang thil ziak in ahi, TOUPA na Pathian un na thilhih tengteng uah leh na khut ngakna peuh uh ahon vualzawl ding hi.
english: You shall surely give, and your heart shall not be grieved when you give to him, because it is for this thing Yahweh your God will bless you in all your work and in all that you put your hand to.

paite: Huai gam ah lah mizawngte om louh lai om lou ding ahi ngal a. Huaiziak in na gam ua na unaute uh tung ah, tasamte tung ah, na mizawngte uh tung ah, na thilphal ngeingei ding uh ahi, chih ka hon thupiak ahi.
english: For the poor will never cease out of the land. Therefore I command you to surely open your hand to your brother, to your needy, and to your poor, in your land.

paite: Na unau uh, Hebru pa hiam, Hebru nu hiam, na kiang ua azuak ua, kum guk nangmah nna asepleh akum sagih kum in na khah ding uh ahi.
english: If your brother, a Hebrew man, or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you and serves you six years, then in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you.

paite: Na khah chiang un khutvuak in na pawtsak ding uh ahi kei.
english: When you let him go free from you, you shall not let him go empty.

paite: Na belamhon ua kipan, na phual ua kipan, na uain sukna khuk ua kipan itloutak in na pe ding uhi. TOUPA na Pathian un ahon vualzawl dan bang zel in na pe ding uhi.
english: You shall furnish him liberally out of your flock, out of your threshing floor, and out of your wine press. As Yahweh your God has blessed you, you shall give to him.

paite: Aigupta gam ah sikha na hita ua, TOUPA na Pathian un hon tan chih na theigige ding uh ahi. Huaiziak in ahi, tua hiai thu ka hon piak.
english: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and Yahweh your God redeemed you. Therefore I command you this thing today.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, noute leh na inkuan uh angaih ziak uleh, na kihoutheih ziak ua, "K'on pawtsan kei ding," achih bikbek aleh;
english: It shall be, if he tells you, “I will not go out from you,” because he loves you and your house, because he is well with you,

paite: sikzum na la ding ua, kongkhak ah abil na vut pailet ding ua, huchi in tangtawn in na sikha uh ahi ding. Na sikhanu uh leng huchi mah bang in na hih ding uh ahi.
english: then you shall take an awl, and thrust it through his ear to the door, and he shall be your servant forever. Also to your female servant you shall do likewise.

paite: Pawtsak thil haksa bang in na ngaihtuah ding uh ahi kei. Kiloh sep zahnih sem in kum guk nang nna ahon sepsak khinta ngal a. TOUPA na Pathian un na thilhih peuh uah hon vualzawl ding hi.
english: It shall not seem hard to you when you let him go free from you, for he has been double the value of a hired hand as he served you six years. Yahweh your God will bless you in all that you do.

paite: Na ganhonte uh, na belamhonte uh lak a apa, piang masapente TOUPA na Pathian uh a tuam in na pe ding uhi. Na ganhon uh apiang masapen nasem ding in na zang ding uh ahi kei. Na belamhonte uh lak a piang masapen mul na met ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall dedicate all the firstborn males that are born of your herd and of your flock to Yahweh your God. You shall do no work with the firstborn of your herd, nor shear the firstborn of your flock.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah kum teng in TOUPA'N amun seh ding ah nou leh na inkuante uh toh na ne ding uh ahi.
english: You shall eat it before Yahweh your God year by year in the place which Yahweh shall choose, you and your household.

paite: Gensiat kai, akhe bai hiam, amit taw hiam, gensiatna om peuhmah TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang a kithoihna ding in na zang ding uh ahi kei.
english: If it has any defect—is lame or blind, or has any defect whatever, you shall not sacrifice it to Yahweh your God.

paite: Na omna huangsung ah na ne ding uh ahi. Asiangloute leh asiangte'n sangai leh sakhi leng ane thei ding uh.
english: You shall eat it within your gates. The unclean and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle and as the deer.

paite: Asisan kia na ne ding uh ahi kei. Tui bang in lei ah na sungbua mai ding uh ahi.
english: Only you shall not eat its blood. You shall pour it out on the ground like water.

paite: Abib kha tang unla, TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in Paikan Ankuangluina ding in zang un. Abib kha in ahi, TOUPA na Pathian un Aigupta gam a pan zan a ahon pikhiak.
english: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the Passover to Yahweh your God; for in the month of Abib Yahweh your God brought you out of Egypt by night.

paite: TOUPA'N amin omna mun dia aseh ding ah TOUPA na Pathian kiang uah na belamhon lak ua leh na ganhon lak ua Paikan Ankuang ding in na kithoih ding uh ahi.
english: You shall sacrifice the Passover to Yahweh your God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which Yahweh shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

paite: Tanghou silngou soh toh na ne ding uh ahi kei. Na damsung teng ua Aigupta gam a pan na pawt ni uh na theihgigena ding un ni sagih tanghou silngou soh louh, haksatna tanghou toh na nek ding uh ahi, Aigupta gam a pan kintak a pawtkhia na hi uhi.
english: You shall eat no leavened bread with it. You shall eat unleavened bread with it seven days, even the bread of affliction (for you came out of the land of Egypt in haste) that you may remember the day when you came out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.

paite: Na gamsung uah ni sagih sung, na lak uah silngou muh in a-om ding ahi kei. Ani khat ni nitaklam a na kithoihna sa uh zankhua in azingsang tan in bangmah a-om ding ahi kei.
english: No yeast shall be seen with you in all your borders seven days; neither shall any of the meat, which you sacrifice the first day at evening, remain all night until the morning.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak na omna uh koi lai mah ah Paikan Ankuang kithoih in na kithoih thei kei ding uhi.
english: You may not sacrifice the Passover within any of your gates which Yahweh your God gives you;

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un amin omna mun dia aseh ding kia ah ahi ding. Huai ah Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawt hun bang un nitaklam in Paikan Ankuang kithoih in na kithoih ding uhi.
english: but at the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell in, there you shall sacrifice the Passover at evening, at the going down of the sun, at the season that you came out of Egypt.

paite: Na em ding ua, TOUPA'N amun seh ding ah na ne ding ua, zingsang in na pai nawn ding ua, na puanin uah na lut ding uhi.
english: You shall roast and eat it in the place which Yahweh your God chooses. In the morning you shall return to your tents.

paite: Ni guk sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding uh ahi. Ani sagih ni pen TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in khawmpi siangthou ahi dia, nna na sem ding uh ahi kei hi.
english: Six days you shall eat unleavened bread. On the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to Yahweh your God. You shall do no work.

paite: Nipikal sagih na sim ding ua; na buhlak tung ua kipan nipikal sagih na sim ding uhi.
english: You shall count for yourselves seven weeks. From the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain you shall begin to count seven weeks.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon vualzawl bang zel in na sepkhiak uh lak a noumau ut thu a thillat lan in TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in Nipikal Ankuanglui na nei ding uh ahi.
english: You shall keep the feast of weeks to Yahweh your God with a tribute of a free will offering of your hand, which you shall give according to how Yahweh your God blesses you.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un amin omna dia aseh ding ah na sikhanute uh, na tenna ua om Levite, na lak ua om gamdang mite, pa neiloute, meithaite toh TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah kipaktak in na om ding uhi.
english: You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God: you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite who is within your gates, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are among you, in the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

paite: Aigupta gam ah sikha na hi uh, chih na theihgige ding uh ahi. Hiai dante pilvangtak in na zui ding uh ahi.
english: You shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt. You shall observe and do these statutes.

paite: Na buhphual ua kipan leh na uain sukna khuk ua kipan na sekkhawm khit un ni sagih sung Biakbuk Ankuanglui na nei ding uhi.
english: You shall keep the feast of booths seven days, after you have gathered in from your threshing floor and from your wine press.

paite: Na ankuangluina uah nou toh, na tapa uh toh, na tanu uh toh, na sikhanu uh toh, na tenna ua om Levite, gamdang mite, pa neiloute, meithaite toh kipaktak in na om ding uhi.
english: You shall rejoice in your feast, you, your son, your daughter, your male servant, your female servant, the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates.

paite: TOUPA'N amun seh ding ah TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in ni sagih ankuang na lui ding uhi. TOUPA na Pathian un thil tung tengteng ah leh na khut ngakna tengteng uah ahon vualzawl dia, na vek un kipaktak in na om ding uh ahi.
english: You shall keep a feast to Yahweh your God seven days in the place which Yahweh chooses, because Yahweh your God will bless you in all your increase and in all the work of your hands, and you shall be altogether joyful.

paite: Kum teng in na pasal tengteng uh thumvei TOUPA ma ah mun hon sehsak ding ah akilang ding uh ahi. Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuang ah, Nipikal Ankuang ah, Biakbuk Ankuang ah akilang ding ua, TOUPA ma ah kuamah khutvuak in na kilang ding uh ahi kei.
english: Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before Yahweh your God in the place which he chooses: in the feast of unleavened bread, in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of booths. They shall not appear before Yahweh empty.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un vualzawlna ahon muhsak bang zel in michih in azoh hun bang in ape ding ahi.
english: Every man shall give as he is able, according to Yahweh your God’s blessing which he has given you.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak kulh kongpi tengteng ah na nam bang zel un vaihawmte leh heutute na kibawl chiat ding ua, mipite vai hoihtak in ahawmsak ding uh ahi.
english: You shall make judges and officers in all your gates, which Yahweh your God gives you, according to your tribes; and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.

paite: Dik loutak in vai na hawm ding uh ahi kei. Kuamah deihsak tuam na nei ding uh ahi kei. Golhgukna na la ding uh ahi kei. Golhgukna in mipilte mit atawsak a, midiktatte thu akaikawi hi.
english: You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and perverts the words of the righteous.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak gam dam a na luahtheihna ding un adik kia na zui ding uh ahi.
english: You shall follow that which is altogether just, that you may live and inherit the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh maitam na bawl chiang un apang ah sing bangchi mah in leng Asher na phutkhe ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not plant for yourselves an Asherah of any kind of tree beside Yahweh your God’s altar, which you shall make for yourselves.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un amuhdah lam suang leng na phut ding uh ahi sam kei hi.
english: Neither shall you set yourself up a sacred stone which Yahweh your God hates.

paite: Bawngtal hiam, belam hiam, himhim nei in TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang ah na kithoih ding uh ahi kei. Hiai lah TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in thilkihhuai ahi ngal a.
english: You shall not sacrifice to Yahweh your God an ox or a sheep in which is a defect or anything evil; for that is an abomination to Yahweh your God.

paite: Na lak uah TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak na tenna koipeuh uah leng pasal hiam, numei hiam leng, thukhun bohsia a pathian dang nna va sem a,
english: If there is found among you, within any of your gates which Yahweh your God gives you, a man or woman who does that which is evil in Yahweh your God’s sight in transgressing his covenant,

paite: ka thupiak louh, ni hiam, kha hiam, van ate himhim hiam, TOUPA na Pathian uh mitmuh a thil hoih lou hih a-om a;
english: and has gone and served other gods and worshiped them, or the sun, or the moon, or any of the stars of the sky, which I have not commanded,

paite: ahon hilh ua, nang na zak a, phatuamngaitak a na dot a, ngai in, adik a, thu atel mahmah a, huchibang thilkihhuai Israelte lak a hih ana hihleh;
english: and you are told, and you have heard of it, then you shall inquire diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is done in Israel,

paite: huai thil gilou hihmi, pasal hiam, numei hiam na kulh kongkhak polam uah pasal hiam numei hiam pen na pikhe ding ua, suang in na denglum ding uhi.
english: then you shall bring out that man or that woman who has done this evil thing to your gates, even that same man or woman; and you shall stone them to death with stones.

paite: Theihpih nih hiam, thum hiam kam a pan in asi ding mi hihlup ding ahi. Himahleh theihpih khat kia kam a pan in hihlup ding ahi kei.
english: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, he who is to die shall be put to death. At the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.

paite: Hihlup ding pen tung ah theihpihte'n akhut uh that ding in akha masa ding ua, huai khit chiang in mipi tengteng in, huchibang in na lak ua kipan thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uh ahi.
english: The hands of the witnesses shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

paite: Sisan kisuah thu ah, sum-le-pai thu ah, kivuak thu ah, na tenna ua kiselna thu himhim a nou a dia vaihawm haksa lua ahong omleh, TOUPA na Pathian un amun seh ding ah na hoh ding ua,
english: If there arises a matter too hard for you in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within your gates, then you shall arise, and go up to the place which Yahweh your God chooses.

paite: huai hun a siampu Levite leh vaihawmte kiang a hoh in na dong ding uhi. Amau thu hihpukdan ding hon na kawkmuh ding uhi.
english: You shall come to the priests who are Levites and to the judge who shall be in those days. You shall inquire, and they shall give you the verdict.

paite: Huchi in nou TOUPA'N mun aseh ding a pan thu hihpukdan hon na kawkmuh bang un na hih ding ua, ahon sinsak bang un pilvangtak in na hih ding uhi.
english: You shall do according to the decisions of the verdict which they shall give you from that place which Yahweh chooses. You shall observe to do according to all that they shall teach you.

paite: Thu hihpukdan hon na sinsak uleh vaihawmdan hon na hilh bang zel un na hih ding uhi. Thu hihpukdan hon na kawkmuh uh taklam ah hiam, veilam ah hiam na pialsan ding uh ahi kei.
english: According to the decisions of the law which they shall teach you, and according to the judgment which they shall tell you, you shall do. You shall not turn away from the sentence which they announce to you, to the right hand, nor to the left.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh ma a nasem a pang siampu leh vaihawmmi thu pom lou a, engtat peuhmah, huai mi hihlup ding ahi. Israel a pan huai thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uh ahi.
english: The man who does presumptuously in not listening to the priest who stands to minister there before Yahweh your God, or to the judge, even that man shall die. You shall put away the evil from Israel.

paite: Huchi in mi tengteng in aza ding ua, alau ding ua, a-engtat nawn kei ding uhi.
english: All the people shall hear and fear, and do no more presumptuously.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak ding gam na va tun ua, na va luah ua, na va ten ua, "I gam a nam tengteng bang in kumpipa i nei ding uh, na chih chiang un,"
english: When you have come to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, and possess it and dwell in it, and say, “I will set a king over me, like all the nations that are around me,”

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un atel pen kumpipa dia na neih ding uh ahi. Na unau lak ua mi khat na kumpipa ding ua na bawl ding uh ahi. Namdangmi, na unau uh hilou zaw nou hon uk dia na bawl ding uh ahi kei.
english: you shall surely set him whom Yahweh your God chooses as king over yourselves. You shall set as king over you one from among your brothers. You may not put a foreigner over you, who is not your brother.

paite: Himahleh sakol tampi akaikhawm ding ahi kei, ahihkeileh sakol zong ding in Aigupta gam a kik nawn ding in mite asawl ding ahi kei. Aziak ahihleh TOUPA'N, "Huai lam a na kik nawn louh ding uh ahi," achi khinta hi.
english: Only he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he may multiply horses; because Yahweh has said to you, “You shall not go back that way again.”

paite: Alungtang pimang a a-omlouhna ding in zi leng tampi aneih ding ahi kei. Dangka leh dangka-eng leng tampi akhawm ding ahi kei.
english: He shall not multiply wives to himself, that his heart not turn away. He shall not greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, alalgam laltutphah a atut chiang in siampu Levite a pan kila hiai dan teisawn a, amah a dia laibuzial a agelh ding ahi.
english: It shall be, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write himself a copy of this law in a book, out of that which is before the Levitical priests.

paite: Hiai dan amah kiang ah a-om gige ding a, adamsung teng a, asim zel ding ahi. Huchi in TOUPA a Pathian laudan asin thei dia, hiai dan thu tengteng leh dan thusehte pilvangtak in azui thei dia,
english: It shall be with him, and he shall read from it all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear Yahweh his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them;

paite: a-unaute tung ah alungtang akisathei kei dia, dan a pan taklam hiam, veilam hiam ah apial kei ding hi. Huai nung in alalgam Israel tung ah amah leh asuante'n sawtpi vai ahawm ding uhi.
english: that his heart not be lifted up above his brothers, and that he not turn away from the commandment to the right hand, or to the left, to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he and his children, in the middle of Israel.

paite: Siampu Levite, Levi nam tengteng in Israelte lak ah tantuan leh goutan anei ding uh ahi kei. TOUPA kiang a mei a thillat leh amau a tuam pen ane ding uhi.
english: The priests and the Levites—all the tribe of Levi—shall have no portion nor inheritance with Israel. They shall eat the offerings of Yahweh made by fire and his portion.

paite: A unaute uh lak ah goutan anei ding uh ahi kei; agoutan uh bel akiang ua agen bang in TOUPA ahi ngal a.
english: They shall have no inheritance among their brothers. Yahweh is their inheritance, as he has spoken to them.

paite: Mipite lak a pan kithoihna lanpa siampu a tuam ding hiaite ahi: Bawngtal leh belam liang leh abiangtuai langnih leh agilpi siampu apiak ding uh ahi.
english: This shall be the priests’ due from the people, from those who offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep, that they shall give to the priest: the shoulder, the two cheeks, and the inner parts.

paite: Na buh na bal, na uain, na thau tung masate uh, na belam mulmet masakpente uh leng na piak ding uh ahi.
english: You shall give him the first fruits of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un TOUPA min a nasem a om tawntung ding in nam tengteng a pan amau leh atapate uh toh atel ahi ngal ua.
english: For Yahweh your God has chosen him out of all your tribes to stand to minister in Yahweh’s name, him and his sons forever.

paite: Levi mi kuapeuh atenna Israel gam na tenna ua akoipeuh pawtsan a, alungsim a kilawptak a TOUPA'N aseh ding mun a ahong paileh;
english: If a Levite comes from any of your gates out of all Israel where he lives, and comes with all the desire of his soul to the place which Yahweh shall choose,

paite: huai a TOUPA ma a om Levite, a-unaute mah bang in TOUPA a Pathian min in nna asem ding ahi.
english: then he shall minister in the name of Yahweh his God, as all his brothers the Levites do, who stand there before Yahweh.

paite: Asiamput man uh sim louh in midang tuam nek ding atang sam himhim ding uhi.
english: They shall have like portions to eat, in addition to that which comes from the sale of his family possessions.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak ding gamsung a na lut chiang un, huai gam a namte thilhih kihhuaite zui kei un.
english: When you have come into the land which Yahweh your God gives you, you shall not learn to imitate the abominations of those nations.

paite: Na lak uah mi kuamah atapa hiam, atanu hiam mei a paisuaksak, mi kuamah aisan ching, mi kuamah mangsan ching hiam, bum hiam, mitkhialdawi tawi hiam,
english: There shall not be found with you anyone who makes his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, one who uses divination, one who tells fortunes, or an enchanter, or a sorcerer,

paite: zawl aitawi hiam, mi sisa houpih hiam, khate zawl hiam, misisate dong thei hiam na om ding uh ahi kei.
english: or a charmer, or someone who consults with a familiar spirit, or a wizard, or a necromancer.

paite: Hichibang thilhih chingte peuhmah TOUPA a ding in mikihhuai ahi ngal ua. Hiai thilkihhuaite ziak in ahi, TOUPA na Pathian un amaute ahon delhkhiaksak.
english: For whoever does these things is an abomination to Yahweh. Because of these abominations, Yahweh your God drives them out from before you.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh ma a na hoihkim ding uh ahi.
english: You shall be blameless with Yahweh your God.

paite: Huai na va luah ding uh gam a namte'n mitkhialdawi leh aisan ching mite angaikhia ua; nou zaw TOUPA na Pathian un huchibang hih ahon phal kei hi.
english: For these nations that you shall dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery and to diviners; but as for you, Yahweh your God has not allowed you so to do.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un keimah bang na unaute uh lak a mi zawlnei a hon bawlsak dia, ama thu na ngaikhe ding uh ahi.
english: Yahweh your God will raise up to you a prophet from among you, of your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him.

paite: "TOUPA i Pathian aw zaw hon zasak nawn ke'nla, hiai mei thupi hon musak nawn ke'n, ka si kha ding uh," chi a Horeb tang a kikhopkhawm ni a TOUPA na Pathian uh na deihdan bang un.
english: This is according to all that you desired of Yahweh your God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, “Let me not hear again Yahweh my God’s voice, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I not die.”

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, athugen uh agen hoih ngel uhi.
english: Yahweh said to me, “They have well said that which they have spoken.

paite: A-unaute uh lak ah nangmah bang zawlnei ka bawlsak dia, akam ah ka thute ka koih dia, akiang a ka thupiak peuhmah akiang uah agen ding.
english: I will raise them up a prophet from among their brothers, like you. I will put my words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them all that I shall command him.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, ka min a ka thu agen zui lou peuhmah ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
english: It shall happen, that whoever will not listen to my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.

paite: Ka min agen ding ka piak louh gen teitei zawlnei hiam, pathian dangte min a thugenmi zawlnei hiam, huai zawlnei hihlup ding ahi.
english: But the prophet who speaks a word presumptuously in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that same prophet shall die.”

paite: "Na lungtang ua, bangchi in ahia athu TOUPA gen ahi kei chih i theih ding? na chih uleh,
english: You may say in your heart, “How shall we know the word which Yahweh has not spoken?”

paite: zawlnei in TOUPA min a thu agen a, athil gen pen ahong tangtun kei a, alohchin keileh, huaitak ahi, TOUPA gen louh, zawlnei in ki-uangsaktak in agen mawkmawk ahi a, amah na lau ding uh ahi kei," achi hi.
english: When a prophet speaks in Yahweh’s name, if the thing doesn’t follow, nor happen, that is the thing which Yahweh has not spoken. The prophet has spoken it presumptuously. You shall not be afraid of him.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un agam uh nou ahon piak namte TOUPA'N ahihmanthat khopite na luah ua, a-innte ua na ten chiang un;
english: When Yahweh your God cuts off the nations whose land Yahweh your God gives you, and you succeed them and dwell in their cities and in their houses,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia nou ahon piakna gam ah nou a ding in khopi thum na sep ding uhi.
english: you shall set apart three cities for yourselves in the middle of your land, which Yahweh your God gives you to possess.

paite: Huai khopite zotna ding lampite sial unla, TOUPA'N hon luahsak ding gam seh thum suah un. Huchi in mi that kha kuapeuh huaite ah atailut thei ding uhi.
english: You shall prepare the way, and divide the borders of your land which Yahweh your God causes you to inherit into three parts, that every man slayer may flee there.

paite: Huai a tailutmi that kha bit thei ding hiaite ahi: Mi a-invengte tuma lam a huatna leng nei khol lou a that kha peuhmahte;
english: This is the case of the man slayer who shall flee there and live: Whoever kills his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him in time past—

paite: a-invengte toh sing phuk dia gamlak a kuan, asing phuk dia aheipi asat a, heipi tang kitol in a-invengte adenlup khakte ahi ding ua hiai khopite lak a khatpeuh ah atai thei ding uh;
english: as when a man goes into the forest with his neighbor to chop wood and his hand swings the ax to cut down the tree, and the head slips from the handle and hits his neighbor so that he dies—he shall flee to one of these cities and live.

paite: sisan phulami in ahehna apai lai a mithat mi pen delh a, lampi asau ziak a delhpha in ava satlum kha ding hi. Tuma lam a huatna na nei khol lou ahih ziak in si tak ahi kei hi.
english: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue the man slayer while hot anger is in his heart and overtake him, because the way is long, and strike him mortally, even though he was not worthy of death, because he didn’t hate him in time past.

paite: Huaiziak in Khopi thum nou a ding in na sep ding uh, chi in thu ka hon pia hi.
english: Therefore I command you to set apart three cities for yourselves.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un na pi-le-pute uh kiang a, ana kichiam bang a na pi-le-pute uh piak ana chiam gam ahon piak a;
english: If Yahweh your God enlarges your border, as he has sworn to your fathers, and gives you all the land which he promised to give to your fathers;

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh it ding leh alampi zui gige ding a, tuni a ka hon thupiak tengteng na zuih uleh hiai khopi thumte sim louh in nou a ding in khopi thum dang na behlap nawn ding uhi.
english: and if you keep all this commandment to do it, which I command you today, to love Yahweh your God, and to walk ever in his ways, then you shall add three cities more for yourselves, in addition to these three.

paite: Hiai bel TOUPA'N luah ding a ahon piak na gamsung ua poi khoih lou sisan suah a-om louh a, na tung ua sisan a-omlouhna ding ahi.
english: This is so that innocent blood will not be shed in the middle of your land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance, leaving blood guilt on you.

paite: Himahleh mi'n a-invengte ahuat a, atan a, asual a, si khop hial a avuak a, huai khopite lak a khat a ataileh;
english: But if any man hates his neighbor, lies in wait for him, rises up against him, strikes him mortally so that he dies, and he flees into one of these cities;

paite: akho upate un mi sawl uhenla, huai mipa va pi uhenla, hihlup ding in sisan phulami khut ah pekhia uhen.
english: then the elders of his city shall send and bring him there, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.

paite: Amah na hehpih ding uh ahi kei a, nou a dia hoih ding in Israel gam a pan poi khoih lou sisan suahna na hihmang ding uh ahi.
english: Your eye shall not pity him, but you shall purge the innocent blood from Israel that it may go well with you.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia ahon piak gam ah, ana phuhsa uh na invengte gamgi na suan ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not remove your neighbor’s landmark, which they of old time have set, in your inheritance which you shall inherit, in the land that Yahweh your God gives you to possess.

paite: Mi athulimlouhna hiam, akhelhna himhim hiam theihpih khat ahun kei dia; theihpih nih kam hiam, theihpih thum kam hiam a thu hihkip ding ahi.
english: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin that he sins. At the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall a matter be established.

paite: Mi khatpeuh thil hihkhial a ngoh dia tup gilou nei theihpihmi adinleh,
english: If an unrighteous witness rises up against any man to testify against him of wrongdoing,

paite: huai bang a kingohna neite gel TOUPA ma leh huai hun a siampute leh vaihawmte ma ah adingh tuak ding uhi.
english: then both the men, between whom the controversy is, shall stand before Yahweh, before the priests and the judges who shall be in those days;

paite: Vaihawmte'n ngenteltak in thu adong ding ua, ngai in, theihpihmi thu theihpih zuau ahih a, a-unau zuau a ngoh ahihleh;
english: and the judges shall make diligent inquisition; and behold, if the witness is a false witness, and has testified falsely against his brother,

paite: a-unau tung a hih atup bangbang amah tung ah na hih ding uh. Huchibang in na lak ua thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uhi.
english: then you shall do to him as he had thought to do to his brother. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

paite: Midangte'n aza ding ua, alau ding ua, huchi in tunung chiang in huchibang thil hoih lou mawngmawng na lak uah ahih nawn kei ding uhi.
english: Those who remain shall hear, and fear, and will never again commit any such evil among you.

paite: Na hehpih ding uh ahi kei. Hinna tang in hinna, mit tang in mit, ha tang in ha, khut tang in khut, khe tang in khe ahi ding ahi.
english: Your eyes shall not pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

paite: Huan i kihei ua, TOUPA'N i kiang ua agen bang in Tuipi San lam ah gamdai ah i lutta ua; Seir tang ni tampi i vel uhi.
english: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea, as Yahweh spoke to me; and we encircled Mount Seir many days.

paite: TOUPA'N ahon houpih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to me, saying,

paite: "Hiai tang na vel sawt hunta uh. Mallam zuan in kihei un.
english: “You have encircled this mountain long enough. Turn northward.

paite: Mipite, Seir tang a om, Esau suan na unaute uh gam ah na paisuak ding uhi. Amau hon na lau ding ua; huaiziak in pilvang mahmah un.
english: Command the people, saying, ‘You are to pass through the border of your brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir; and they will be afraid of you. Therefore be careful.

paite: Kisualpih kei un. Agam uh koi lai mah leng, khepek a sik khop lel leng nou ka hon pe kei ding. Seir tang zaw ama a tuam ding in Esau ka pe khinta hi.
english: Don’t contend with them; for I will not give you any of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau for a possession.

paite: Na nek ding un a-an uh sum in na lei ding ua, na dawn ding un atui uh leng sum in na lei ding uhi.
english: You shall purchase food from them for money, that you may eat. You shall also buy water from them for money, that you may drink.’”

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un na khut nasep peuhmah uah ahon vualzawl zel a, hiai gamdai zapi na totsuakdante uh leng athei hi. Hiai kum sawmli sung teng in TOUPA na kiang uah a-om a, bangmah na tasam kei uh, chi in thu pia in," achi hi.
english: For Yahweh your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years, Yahweh your God has been with you. You have lacked nothing.

paite: Huchi in Elath leh Ezion-geber a pan Arabah lam a pai in Seir tang a om Esau suan i unaute gam i tawn paisuak uhi. I kihei ua, Moab gamdai lam ah i pai uhi.
english: So we passed by from our brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir, from the way of the Arabah from Elath and from Ezion Geber. We turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Moabte hihbuai kei unla, galsual in leng sual kei un. Agam uh nou a tuam ding in ka hon pe kei ding, Lot suante a tuam ding in Ar ka pe khinta hi,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Don’t bother Moab, neither contend with them in battle; for I will not give you any of his land for a possession, because I have given Ar to the children of Lot for a possession.”

paite: Tuma lam in Emimte, huai ah ateng ua, amaute Anakte bang a milian leh tam, mi sangpite ahi uh.
english: (The Emim lived there before, a great and numerous people, and tall as the Anakim.
