paite: Huaite leng Anakte mah bang a miliante ahi ua, himahleh Maobte'n Emimte achi uhi.
english: These also are considered to be Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.

paite: Tuma lam in Seir tang ah Horte leng a-om ua; himahleh Esau suante'n aluahsak uhi. Athat ua, amun uah atengta ua; Israelte TOUPA'N amau a tuam dia apiak gam mah bang in.
english: The Horites also lived in Seir in the past, but the children of Esau succeeded them. They destroyed them from before them, and lived in their place, as Israel did to the land of his possession, which Yahweh gave to them.)

paite: Huchi in "Thou unla, Zered Phaizang kan dih ua," achi a; huchi in Zered Phaizang i kanta uhi.
english: “Now rise up and cross over the brook Zered.” We went over the brook Zered.

paite: Kadesh-barnea a pan i pawt a, Zered Phaizang i kan ua, TOUPA'N akiang ua akichiam bang a mipi lak a misuan a gal dou thei mi tengteng abei vek kikal uh kum sawmthum-le-giat ahi.
english: The days in which we came from Kadesh Barnea until we had come over the brook Zered were thirty-eight years, until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the middle of the camp, as Yahweh swore to them.

paite: Mipite lak a pan abei sipsip ma uh amaute hihmang ding in atung uah TOUPA khut atu hi.
english: Moreover Yahweh’s hand was against them, to destroy them from the middle of the camp, until they were consumed.

paite: Huchi ahi a, huchibang a mipi lak a pan galdou thei tengteng abei ua, ahong sih khit nung un,
english: So, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,

paite: TOUPA'N ahon houpih hi.
english: Yahweh spoke to me, saying,

paite: "Tuni in Moab gam, Ar na khen paisuak ding uh ahi.
english: “You are to pass over Ar, the border of Moab, today.

paite: Ammon suante kiang ava tun chiang un, hihbuai kei unla, kisualpih kei un. Ammonte gam nang a tuam ding in ka hon pe kei ding. Lot suante a tuam ding in ka pe khinta," achi hi.
english: When you come near the border of the children of Ammon, don’t bother them, nor contend with them; for I will not give you any of the land of the children of Ammon for a possession, because I have given it to the children of Lot for a possession.”

paite: Huai leng Rephaimte gam bang a sim ahi sam; huai ah tuma lam in Rephaimte ateng uhi. Himahleh Ammonte'n zaw Zamzummim achi uhi.
english: (That also is considered a land of Rephaim. Rephaim lived there in the past, but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,

paite: Anakte bang a milian leh tam leh misang pipi ahi ua; himahleh TOUPA'N ahihmang a, amau aluah leuleu ua, amun uah atengta uhi.
english: a great people, many, and tall, as the Anakim; but Yahweh destroyed them from before Israel, and they succeeded them, and lived in their place,

paite: Seir tang a om Esau suante Horte ahihmansak lai a, ahih bang in; huchi in amau aluah ua, amun uah tu dong in ateng lai uhi.
english: as he did for the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them; and they succeeded them, and lived in their place even to this day.

paite: Gaza tan a khoneu chikchik a om Avvite Kaphtor a pan a hong pawt Kaphtorte'n ahihmang ua, amun uah ateng uhi.
english: Then the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza: the Caphtorim, who came out of Caphtor, destroyed them and lived in their place.)

paite: "Thou unla, paikhia unla, Arnon Phaizang kan un; ngai dih ua, Amor mi Heshbon kumpipa Sihon leh agam ka hon pe khinta hi; luah peuhmah unla, galsual in sual un.
english: “Rise up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon. Behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.

paite: Tuni in, van nuai a mite tung ah nang hon lauhna uh leh hon kihtakna uh ka omsak pan dia, na tanchin aza ding ua, aling ding ua nang ziak in gimthuak in a-om ding uhi," achi hi.
english: Today I will begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you on the peoples who are under the whole sky, who shall hear the report of you, and shall tremble and be in anguish because of you.”

paite: Kedemoth gamdai a pan Heshbon kumpipa Sihon kiang ah lemna thu pua in mi ka sawl hi.
english: I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

paite: "Na gam ah hon paisuaksak dih ve. Lamlian zel ah ka pai ding ua, ataklam ah hiam, aveilam ah hiam leng ka pial kei ding uh.
english: “Let me pass through your land. I will go along by the highway. I will turn neither to the right hand nor to the left.

paite: Ka nek ding un an sum in na hon leisak dia, ka dawn ding un tui leng sum mah in na hon leisak ding hi.
english: You shall sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink. Just let me pass through on my feet,

paite: Jordan ka kan ua TOUPA ka Pathian un ahon piak gam ka lut masiah uh, Seir a om Esau suante leh Ar a om Moabte'n ahon paisuaksak bang un hon paisuaksak lel in," chi in.
english: as the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, and the Moabites who dwell in Ar, did to me, until I pass over the Jordan into the land which Yahweh our God gives us.”

paite: Himahleh Heshbon kumpipa Sihon in agam ah hon paisuaksak nuam kei a; TOUPA na Pathian un na khut ua ahon piaktheihna ding in alungtang akhauhsak a, na theihsa uh bang un apaupengsak hi.
english: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him, for Yahweh your God hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into your hand, as it is today.

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Ngai in, Sihon leh agam hon pe ding ka hita, agam tang ding in luah peuhmah in," ahon chi hi.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have begun to deliver up Sihon and his land before you. Begin to possess, that you may inherit his land.”

paite: Sihon leh ami tengteng Jahaz a hong sual ding in ahong kuan uh.
english: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz.

paite: TOUPA i Pathian in ahon pia a; amah leh atate leh amite tengteng i that uhi.
english: Yahweh our God delivered him up before us; and we struck him, his sons, and all his people.

paite: Huai lai in akhua tengteng i la ua, huai khuate a mihing tengteng, numei leh ataneu chikchikte uh tan in i hihmang vek ua, hawi mahmah i nei kei uhi.
english: We took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones. We left no one remaining.

paite: I lak khua a gallak a i lak thil leh gante kia ei a tuam ding in i la uhi.
english: Only the livestock we took for plunder for ourselves, with the plunder of the cities which we had taken.

paite: Arnon Phaizang a om Aroer a pan leh phaizang a kho omte a pan Gilead pha in ei a ding in khua sang lua a-om kei hi, TOUPA i Pathian in hon pe vek hi.
english: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, even to Gilead, there was not a city too high for us. Yahweh our God delivered up all before us.

paite: TOUPA'N thu hon piak bang in Ammon suante gam koimah, Jabok lui tan in mual tung a khuate kim leh kiang gam hitaleh na naih kei uhi.
english: Only to the land of the children of Ammon you didn’t come near: all the banks of the river Jabbok, and the cities of the hill country, and wherever Yahweh our God forbade us.

paite: Na melmate uh dou ding a na kuan ua, sakol, kangtalai, nou sang a mipi tamzaw na muh chiang un, na lau ding uh ahi kei. Aigupta gam a pan nou hon pikhepa TOUPA na Pathian uh na kiang uah a-om hi.
english: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and see horses, chariots, and a people more numerous than you, you shall not be afraid of them; for Yahweh your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, is with you.

paite: Kidou dia na kuan dek chiang un siampu in mipi va naih henla, houpih henla, akiang uah,
english: It shall be, when you draw near to the battle, that the priest shall approach and speak to the people,

paite: "Israelte aw, za un, tu in na melmate uh dou ding na hi ua, na lungtang uh patausak kei un. Lau kei unla, ling sam kei un, amaute lauhsak in om kei un.
english: and shall tell them, “Hear, Israel, you draw near today to battle against your enemies. Don’t let your heart faint! Don’t be afraid, nor tremble, neither be scared of them;

paite: Noute hon tonpih a na melmate uh hon dousak a, hon hondam ding TOUPA na Pathian uh ahi, chi hen."
english: for Yahweh your God is he who goes with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.”

paite: Heutute'n mipite kiang ah, "Inn thak lam a lan nai lou na om uhia? A-inn ah paikik nawn hen. Kidouna ah ava si kha dia, midang in alan kha ding,"
english: The officers shall speak to the people, saying, “What man is there who has built a new house, and has not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man dedicate it.

paite: "Grephuan bawl a, agah ne nai lou na om uhia? A-inn ah paikik nawn hen, kidouna ah ava si kha dia, midang in ane kha ding hi."
english: What man is there who has planted a vineyard, and has not used its fruit? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man use its fruit.

paite: "Zikham a kiteng nai lou na om uhia? A-inn ah paikik nawn hen. Kidouna ah ava si kha dia, midang in akitenpih kha ding," chi in gen hen.
english: What man is there who has pledged to be married to a wife, and has not taken her? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man take her.”

paite: Heutute'n mipite kiang ah, "Lau leh patau na om uhia? A-inn ah paikik nawn hen, a-unaute uh lungtang amah lungtang bang in azulsak kha ding," chi lai uhen.
english: The officers shall speak further to the people, and they shall say, “What man is there who is fearful and faint-hearted? Let him go and return to his house, lest his brother’s heart melt as his heart.”

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, heutute'n mipite kiang a thu agen khit un mipite makaih ding sepaih heutute asep ding uhi.
english: It shall be, when the officers have finished speaking to the people, that they shall appoint captains of armies at the head of the people.

paite: Dou ding kho kim na va tun chiang un lemna thu gen phot un.
english: When you draw near to a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace to it.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, ahon kileppih ua, ana kihon uleh hichi ahi ding a, huai a mi om tengteng nasem dia na goih ding uh ahi dia, na nna uh asem ding uhi.
english: It shall be, if it gives you answer of peace and opens to you, then it shall be that all the people who are found therein shall become forced laborers to you, and shall serve you.

paite: Hon kileppih ut lou a, ahon na dou ding uleh umkhum un.
english: If it will make no peace with you, but will make war against you, then you shall besiege it.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un na khut ua ahon piak hun chiang in pasal tengteng namsau in na that vek ding uh ahi.
english: When Yahweh your God delivers it into your hand, you shall strike every male of it with the edge of the sword;

paite: Numei leh ataneu chikchikte uh, gante leh khua a thil omte leh huai a gallak thil tengteng nou a tuam dia na lak ding uh ahi. TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak na melmate uh a pan gallak thil na ne ding uhi.
english: but the women, the little ones, the livestock, and all that is in the city, even all its plunder, you shall take for plunder for yourself. You may use the plunder of your enemies, which Yahweh your God has given you.

paite: Hiai namte khua hilou, na tenna ua kipan a kho gamla tengteng huchibang in na hih zel ding uhi.
english: Thus you shall do to all the cities which are very far off from you, which are not of the cities of these nations.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia ahon piak hiai namte khuate zaw TOUPA na Pathian un thu ahon piak bang in ahing peuhmah bangmah na hawi ding uh ahi kei.
english: But of the cities of these peoples that Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance, you shall save alive nothing that breathes;

paite: Hitte, Amorte, Kanaante, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste na hihmang vek ding uhi.
english: but you shall utterly destroy them: the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, as Yahweh your God has commanded you;

paite: Apathiante uh tung a ahih zel uh thilkihhuai tengteng ahon sinsaklouhna ding un hihmang vek un. Huchi lou in zaw TOUPA na Pathian tung ah thil na hihkhial kha ding uhi.
english: that they not teach you to follow all their abominations, which they have done for their gods; so would you sin against Yahweh your God.

paite: Lak tum a na dou uh khua sawtpi na um chiang un, asingte uh heipi in na phuk ding uh ahi kei; na nek ding uh ahi ngal a. Huai khopi douna a zat ding in leng na phuk ding uh ahi kei; huai gam a singte mihing hinna ahi ngal a.
english: When you shall besiege a city a long time, in making war against it to take it, you shall not destroy its trees by wielding an ax against them; for you may eat of them. You shall not cut them down, for is the tree of the field man, that it should be besieged by you?

paite: Himahleh gah nei lou singte bel phuk in na hihse thei ding ua, na doute khua na lak zoh masiah uh adouna vanzat in na zang ding uhi.
english: Only the trees that you know are not trees for food, you shall destroy and cut them down. You shall build bulwarks against the city that makes war with you, until it falls.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia ahon piak gamsung a thahsa mi ana om a, athatmi theih louh ahihleh,
english: If someone is found slain in the land which Yahweh your God gives you to possess, lying in the field, and it isn’t known who has struck him,

paite: na upate uh leh na vaihawmtute uh ahong pai ding ua, athahna kim khua a pan ateh ding ua,
english: then your elders and your judges shall come out, and they shall measure to the cities which are around him who is slain.

paite: huan hichi ahi ding a, aluang a pan kho naipen khua a upate'n bawnghon lak a bawngla, zat nai louh, hakkol po nai lou akai ding uhi.
english: It shall be that the elders of the city which is nearest to the slain man shall take a heifer of the herd, which hasn’t been worked with and which has not drawn in the yoke.

paite: Huai khua upate'n bawngla, tui luanna, lei leh louh leh bangmah chinlouhna phaizang ah akaisuk ding ua, phaizang ah angawng atan ding uh.
english: The elders of that city shall bring the heifer down to a valley with running water, which is neither plowed nor sown, and shall break the heifer’s neck there in the valley.

paite: Levi tapa siampute'n ahon zuan ding ua, amau TOUPA na Pathian un anasemmi leh TOUPA min a vualzawlmi dia asehte uh lah ahi ngal ua; thubuai leh kivuak thu agen bangbang uh ahi ding ahi.
english: The priests the sons of Levi shall come near, for them Yahweh your God has chosen to minister to him, and to bless in Yahweh’s name; and according to their word shall every controversy and every assault be decided.

paite: Luang naihpen khua upa tengteng in phaizang a bawngla ngawng atan tung uah akhut uh asil ding uhi.
english: All the elders of that city which is nearest to the slain man shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley.

paite: "Ka khut un hiai sisan asuah kei a, ka mit un leng amu sam kei.
english: They shall answer and say, “Our hands have not shed this blood, neither have our eyes seen it.

paite: TOUPA aw, na tatkhiak, na mi Israelte lak ah poi khoih lou sisan suahna moh hon khusak ke'n," chi in apang ding uhi. Huchi in sisan thu ah ngaihdam ahi ding uhi.
english: Forgive, Yahweh, your people Israel, whom you have redeemed, and don’t allow innocent blood among your people Israel.” The blood shall be forgiven them.

paite: Huchibang in TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih hih in poi khoih lou sisan suahna na lak ua kipan na koihmang ding uhi.
english: So you shall put away the innocent blood from among you, when you shall do that which is right in Yahweh’s eyes.

paite: Na melmate uh dou dia na kipatkhiak ua, TOUPA na Pathian un na khut ua ahon piak a, sal a na pi ua,
english: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and Yahweh your God delivers them into your hands and you carry them away captive,

paite: sal lak a numei melhoihtak, na mi deihlam, zi ding a na mi deihlamtak na muhleh,
english: and see among the captives a beautiful woman, and you are attracted to her, and desire to take her as your wife,

paite: na inn ah na pi dia; alu amet dia, akhutchin atan ding hi.
english: then you shall bring her home to your house. She shall shave her head and trim her nails.

paite: Asal puanak asuahkhe dia, na inn ah a-om dia, kha khat sung anu leh apa asuun dia, huai khit in, na kithuahpih dia, apasal na hi dia, amah na zi ahi ding hi.
english: She shall take off the clothing of her captivity, and shall remain in your house, and bewail her father and her mother a full month. After that you shall go in to her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.

paite: Amah a kipahna na neih keileh a-utna peuh a pai na phal ding ahi, sum-le-pai in na zuak ding ahi kei a, sumsinna in na zang ding leng ahi kei, amah na daisakta ngal a.
english: It shall be, if you have no delight in her, then you shall let her go where she desires; but you shall not sell her at all for money. You shall not deal with her as a slave, because you have humbled her.

paite: Mi'n zi nih nei henla, khat pen deih in khat pen ho taleh, adeihnu leh ahuatnu in ta suansak tuak taleh; a upapen ahuatnu tapa hitaleh;
english: If a man has two wives, the one beloved and the other hated, and they have borne him children, both the beloved and the hated, and if the firstborn son is hers who was hated,

paite: agou neih atapate akhopsak hun chiang in adeihpen tapa, atapa upa ahuat pen ta sang a deihsakna apiak tuam ding ahi kei.
english: then it shall be, in the day that he causes his sons to inherit that which he has, that he may not give the son of the beloved the rights of the firstborn before the son of the hated, who is the firstborn;

paite: Ahuat pen ta, ata upapen, aneih tengteng a pan tan nih huai a dia abawl ding ahi; ahatna bul ahi a, tachil hihna ama a tuam ahi.
english: but he shall acknowledge the firstborn, the son of the hated, by giving him a double portion of all that he has; for he is the beginning of his strength. The right of the firstborn is his.

paite: Mi'n tapa phengphitak, helhattak nei henla, anu leh apa thumang lou in, asawina uh limsakta keileh;
english: If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey the voice of his father or the voice of his mother, and though they chasten him, will not listen to them,

paite: anu leh apa'n akai ding ua, akho upate uh kiang ah akhokulh kongpi bul ah api ding uhi.
english: then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city and to the gate of his place.

paite: Akho upate uh kiang ah, hiai ka tapa uh phengphitak leh helhattak ahi a, ka thu uh leng amang nuam kei a; kizatbei hat leh kham hatmi ahi, achi ding uhi.
english: They shall tell the elders of his city, “This our son is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey our voice. He is a glutton and a drunkard.”

paite: Huchi in khua a mi tengteng in suang in adenglum ding uhi. Huchibang in na lak ua kipan thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uh ahi. Israel mi tengteng in aza ding ua, alau ding uhi.
english: All the men of his city shall stone him to death with stones. So you shall remove the evil from among you. All Israel shall hear, and fear.

paite: Mi'n sihna khop khelhna ahih a, thah a om a, sing dawn a na khai uleh;
english: If a man has committed a sin worthy of death, and he is put to death, and you hang him on a tree,

paite: aluang sing ah zankhua in a-om ding ahi kei. Huai ni mahmah in na vui ding uhi. Sing a khai peuhmah lah Pathian hamsethuak ahi ngal a. TOUPA na Pathian un luah ding a ahon piak na gam uh na hihnitlouhna ding un.
english: his body shall not remain all night on the tree, but you shall surely bury him the same day; for he who is hanged is accursed of God. Don’t defile your land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance.

paite: Na unau bawngtal hiam, abelam hiam mang na muhleh na daihsan ding ahi kei. Na unau inn ah na pi ngeingei ding ahi.
english: You shall not see your brother’s ox or his sheep go astray and hide yourself from them. You shall surely bring them again to your brother.

paite: Na unau inn kiangnai a om ahih louh a, aneimi na theih louh uh ahihleh, na inn ah na pitou dia, na kiang ah a-om nilouh dia, na unau in azon hunhun in na pe nawn ding ahi.
english: If your brother isn’t near to you, or if you don’t know him, then you shall bring it home to your house, and it shall be with you until your brother comes looking for it, and you shall restore it to him.

paite: Huchi mah bang in asabiltung leng na hih ding ahi. Huai mah bang in apuansilh leng na hih ding ahi. Huchi mah bang in na unau thil mansak na muh peuhmah na hih ding ahi, na daihsan mawkmawk ding ahi kei.
english: So you shall do with his donkey. So you shall do with his garment. So you shall do with every lost thing of your brother’s, which he has lost and you have found. You may not hide yourself.

paite: Na unau sabiltung hiam, bawngtal hiam, lampi a puk na muhleh na daihsan maimah ding ahi kei. Na photpih ngeingei ding ahi.
english: You shall not see your brother’s donkey or his ox fallen down by the way, and hide yourself from them. You shall surely help him to lift them up again.

paite: Numei in pasal van asilh ding ahi kei. Pasal in numei van asilh ding ahi kei. Kuapeuh huchibang hihmi TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in kihhuai ahi.
english: A woman shall not wear men’s clothing, neither shall a man put on women’s clothing; for whoever does these things is an abomination to Yahweh your God.

paite: Lampi a vasabu, sing ah hiam, lei ah hiam, anou hiam, atui hiam om, anou hiam atui hiam, api in a-opkhum lai na muhleh api toh anou na lakkhawm ding ahi kei.
english: If you come across a bird’s nest on the way, in any tree or on the ground, with young ones or eggs, and the hen sitting on the young, or on the eggs, you shall not take the hen with the young.

paite: Api na khah ngeingei ding ahi. Anou bel na la thei ding ahi. Huchi in nang a ding in ahoih dia, na damsung na sawtsak ding hi.
english: You shall surely let the hen go, but the young you may take for yourself, that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days.

paite: Inn thak na lam chiang in atung a pan mi kia a, asisan moh na khuklouhna ding in atung na um ding ahi.
english: When you build a new house, then you shall make a railing around your roof, so that you don’t bring blood on your house if anyone falls from there.

paite: Na grephuan ah thil chi nih na ching ding ahi kei. Huchi lou in zaw na chi tuh gah leh na grephuan a gah teng siang lou ahi ding uhi.
english: You shall not sow your vineyard with two kinds of seed, lest all the fruit be defiled, the seed which you have sown, and the increase of the vineyard.

paite: Bawngtal leh sabiltung lei na kaikhawmsak ding ahi kei.
english: You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together.

paite: Samul leh pat kigankhawm puan na silh ding ahi kei.
english: You shall not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.

paite: Na kituamna puan uh agei li ah mong khih na bawl ding uh ahi.
english: You shall make yourselves fringes on the four corners of your cloak with which you cover yourself.

paite: Pasal khatpeuh in zi aneih a, akithuahpih a, amuhdah nawn thepthup a,
english: If any man takes a wife, and goes in to her, hates her,

paite: hiai numei ka kitenpih a, ka kithuahpih a, nungak siangthou ahihna ka mu kei, chi a zahlaktak a bawl a, amin ahihsiatleh,
english: accuses her of shameful things, gives her a bad name, and says, “I took this woman, and when I came near to her, I didn’t find in her the tokens of virginity;”

paite: nungak nu leh pa'n kulh kongpi ah huai kho upate kiang ah nungak siangthou ahih kichetnate ahon tawi ding uhi.
english: then the young lady’s father and mother shall take and bring the tokens of the young lady’s virginity to the elders of the city in the gate.

paite: Nungak pa'n upate kiang ah, "Hiai mipa ka tanu ka neisak a, aho nawn thepthup hi.
english: The young lady’s father shall tell the elders, “I gave my daughter to this man as his wife, and he hates her.

paite: Ngai un, na tanu nungak siangthou ahihna ka mu kei, chi in zahlaktak in abawl a, himahleh hiaite ka tanu nungak siangthou ahihna ahi,” achi ding hi. Huchi in huai kho upate ma ah tua puan aphah ding hi.
english: Behold, he has accused her of shameful things, saying, ‘I didn’t find in your daughter the tokens of virginity;’ and yet these are the tokens of my daughter’s virginity.” They shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city.

paite: Huai kho upate'n huai mipa paipih in agawt ding ua;
english: The elders of that city shall take the man and chastise him.

paite: Israel nungak siangthou asukminsiat ziak in dangka shekel zakhat aliausak ding ua, nungak pa ape ding uhi; amah zi ahi dia, adamsung in akhen thei kei ding.
english: They shall fine him one hundred shekels of silver, and give them to the father of the young lady, because he has given a bad name to a virgin of Israel. She shall be his wife. He may not put her away all his days.

paite: Himahleh huai mipa thu ana dik a, nungak siangthou ahih kichetnate muh ahihkeileh;
english: But if this thing is true, that the tokens of virginity were not found in the young lady,

paite: nungak pen apa'n kongpi ah apikhe dia, atenna khua a mite'n amah suang in adenglum ding uh; apa inn a kizuak a Israelte lak a thil gilou haihuai mahmah ahih ziak in. Huchibang in na lak ua kipan, huai thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uhi.
english: then they shall bring out the young lady to the door of her father’s house, and the men of her city shall stone her to death with stones, because she has done folly in Israel, to play the prostitute in her father’s house. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

paite: Pasal khat in pasal nei numei akithuahpih lai muh ahihleh akithuahpih pasal leh numei anih ua asih ding uh ahi. Huchibang in Israel a pan huai thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uhi.
english: If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, then they shall both die, the man who lay with the woman and the woman. So you shall remove the evil from Israel.

paite: Nungak siangthou, mi zikham, pasal khat in khopi a amuh a, akithuahpihleh;
english: If there is a young lady who is a virgin pledged to be married to a husband, and a man finds her in the city, and lies with her,

paite: anih un khokulh kongpi ah na pikhe ding ua, suang in na denglum ding uh; numei pen khua a-om ngal a, akikou louh ziak in. Pasal pen a-invengte zi ahihminsiat ziak in. Huchibang in na lak ua kipan huai thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uh ahi.
english: then you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city, and you shall stone them to death with stones; the lady, because she didn’t cry, being in the city; and the man, because he has humbled his neighbor’s wife. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

paite: Himahleh min gamlak a midang in zi dia akhamsa nungak amuh a, apawngsualleh hiai thilhih pasal kia sihsak ding ahi.
english: But if the man finds the lady who is pledged to be married in the field, and the man forces her and lies with her, then only the man who lay with her shall die;

paite: Nungak pen bangmah loh louh ding ahi. Nungak in sihna khop khelhna bangmah hih lou ahi. Hiai bang mi ahihleh min a-invengte sual a, that toh kibang ahi.
english: but to the lady you shall do nothing. There is in the lady no sin worthy of death; for as when a man rises against his neighbor and kills him, even so is this matter;

paite: Hiai bang thu ahihleh gamlak a va tuak kha a, mi zikham nungak kikou a, panpih ding mi om lou ahih ziak ahi.
english: for he found her in the field, the pledged to be married lady cried, and there was no one to save her.

paite: Mi'n nungak siangthou kuamah kham louh amuh a, amat a, akithuahpih amuh uleh;
english: If a man finds a lady who is a virgin, who is not pledged to be married, grabs her and lies with her, and they are found,

paite: akithuahpih pasal in nungak pa dangka shekel sawmnga ape ding ahi. Zi in anei ding ahi; ahihminsiat tak ziak in. Huchi in adamsung in akhen thei kei ding hi.
english: then the man who lay with her shall give to the lady’s father fifty shekels of silver. She shall be his wife, because he has humbled her. He may not put her away all his days.

paite: Pasal in apa zi akitenpih ding ahi kei. Apa lupna abuahsak ding ahi kei.
english: A man shall not take his father’s wife, and shall not uncover his father’s skirt.

paite: Chiltang kitam ahihkeileh zahmoh atkhiak mi kuapeuh TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah atel ding ahi kei.
english: He who is emasculated by crushing or cutting shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly.

paite: TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah sawnta atel ding ahi kei. Suan sawm tan in asuante TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah atel ding ahi kei hi.
english: A person born of a forbidden union shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one of his enter into Yahweh’s assembly.

paite: Ammonte leh Moabte TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah atel ding uh ahi kei. Suan sawmna tan in alak ua mi TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak a, atel mahmah louh ding uh ahi.
english: An Ammonite or a Moabite shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one belonging to them enter into Yahweh’s assembly forever,

paite: Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawt lai ua tanghou leh tui a, ahon na dawn louh ziak un leh hon hamsiat dia Mesopotamia gam a Pethor a Beor tapa Balaam agoih ziak un.
english: because they didn’t meet you with bread and with water on the way when you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse you.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA na Pathian un Balaam thu angaikhe nuam kei; TOUPA na Pathian un nou ahon it ziak in TOUPA na Pathian un huai hamsia nou a ding in vualzawlna asuaksak zaw hi.
english: Nevertheless Yahweh your God wouldn’t listen to Balaam, but Yahweh your God turned the curse into a blessing to you, because Yahweh your God loved you.

paite: Na damsung teng un akhamuanna ding uh leh alohchinna ding uh na ngaihtuahpih ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not seek their peace nor their prosperity all your days forever.

paite: Edom mite na kih ding uh ahi kei, na unaute uh lah ahi ngal ua. Aigupta mite na kih ding uh ahi kei, agam ua mikhual na hih tak ziak un.
english: You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you lived as a foreigner in his land.

paite: Asuan uh thumna a pan TOUPA mi kikhawmte lak ah atel ding uh ahi.
english: The children of the third generation who are born to them may enter into Yahweh’s assembly.

paite: Na melmate uh dou dia giahphual na sat chiang un thilsiang lou chiteng a pan na kihuikhiak ding uh ahi.
english: When you go out and camp against your enemies, then you shall keep yourselves from every evil thing.

paite: Na lak ua kuapeuh zan chiang a amah a pan chi apawt ziak a thanghuai na om uleh, giahphual a pan apawt dia, giahphual ah alut nawn ding ahi kei.
english: If there is among you any man who is not clean by reason of that which happens to him by night, then shall he go outside of the camp. He shall not come within the camp;

paite: Himahleh ni ahong kai chiang in, akisil dia; nitum chiang in giahphual ah alut nawn ding ahi.
english: but it shall be, when evening comes, he shall bathe himself in water. When the sun is down, he shall come within the camp.

paite: Giahphual polam ah zun leh ek thakna ding mun na sep ding uh ahi.
english: You shall have a place also outside of the camp where you go relieve yourself.

paite: Na vanzat lak uah ninluahna na nei ding ua; hichi ahi ding a, na dailen chiang un, huai in lei na khuak ding ua, zun leh ek na thak uh na vuk nawn ding uhi.
english: You shall have a trowel among your weapons. It shall be, when you relieve yourself, you shall dig with it, and shall turn back and cover your excrement;

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un lah na giahphual uah nou hon humbit ding leh na melmate uh hon pe ding in ahong tel ngal a. Huaiziak in na giahphual uh asiangthou ding ahi. Huchi lou in zaw na lak ua thilsiang lou amu dia, hon paimangsan ding hi.
english: for Yahweh your God walks in the middle of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies before you. Therefore your camp shall be holy, that he may not see an unclean thing in you, and turn away from you.

paite: Na kiang ua sikha, apu hon taikhiaksan na pekik nawn ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not deliver to his master a servant who has escaped from his master to you.

paite: Na omna ua adeihpen atel peuhpeuh ah na lak uah a-om sam ding ahi. Amah na nuaisiah ding uh ahi kei.
english: He shall dwell with you, among you, in the place which he shall choose within one of your gates, where it pleases him best. You shall not oppress him.

paite: Israel tanute lak ah kizuak a-om ding ahi kei a, Israel tapate lak ah leng pasal kizuak a-om ding ahi kei.
english: There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel.

paite: Kizuakna man hiam, toko man hiam thuchiamna ding in TOUPA na Pathian inn ah na tawi ding uh ahi kei. TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in thilkihhuai ahi.
english: You shall not bring the hire of a prostitute, or the wages of a male prostitute, into the house of Yahweh your God for any vow; for both of these are an abomination to Yahweh your God.

paite: Apung delh in na unau na leitawisak ding ahi kei. Dangka lam a pung hiam, nek ding lam a pung hiam, bangpeuh apung delh a leitawisak louh ding ahi.
english: You shall not lend on interest to your brother: interest of money, interest of food, interest of anything that is lent on interest.

paite: Gamdang mite bel apung delh in na leitawisak thei ding uh. Himahleh na unaute apung delh in na leitawisak ding ahi kei. Huchi in na va luah ding uh gam a na khut ngakna tengteng uah TOUPA na Pathian un hon vualzawl ding hi.
english: You may charge a foreigner interest; but you shall not charge your brother interest, that Yahweh your God may bless you in all that you put your hand to, in the land where you go in to possess it.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang a thu na chiam un sawt hal lou in na pe pah ding uh ahi. TOUPA na Pathian un lah hon phut ngei ding ahi ngal a. Khial in na moh kha ding hi.
english: When you vow a vow to Yahweh your God, you shall not be slack to pay it, for Yahweh your God will surely require it of you; and it would be sin in you.

paite: Thuchiam lam a na kidek uleh nou a ding in khelhna ahi kei ding.
english: But if you refrain from making a vow, it shall be no sin in you.

paite: Na kam ua pawtsa na hih ding uh ahi: Ut thu a thillat na kam ua na chiam uh TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang a na chiam bang ua na lat pah ding uh ahi.
english: You shall observe and do that which has gone out of your lips. Whatever you have vowed to Yahweh your God as a free will offering, which you have promised with your mouth, you must do.

paite: Na invengte grephuan a na hoh chiang un na deih zah uh na ne ding ua, himahleh na seng ua na guan louh ding uh ahi.
english: When you come into your neighbor’s vineyard, then you may eat your fill of grapes at your own pleasure; but you shall not put any in your container.

paite: Na invengte buh ding lai mun a na hoh chiang un avui na khiak thei ding uh. Himahleh na invengte buh ding lai ah kawite na zang ding uh ahi kei hi.
english: When you come into your neighbor’s standing grain, then you may pluck the ears with your hand; but you shall not use a sickle on your neighbor’s standing grain.

paite: Pasal khat in zi aneih a, amah a siang lou banghiam khat amuh ziak a, amitmuh a lungtunna angah keileh hichi ahi ding a, kimakna lai agelhsak dia, ape dia, a-inn a pan apawtsak ding hi.
english: When a man takes a wife and marries her, then it shall be, if she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some unseemly thing in her, that he shall write her a certificate of divorce, put it in her hand, and send her out of his house.

paite: A-inn a pan apawt nung in midang ava nei thei ding hi.
english: When she has departed out of his house, she may go and be another man’s wife.

paite: Apasal nanungpen in azakdah a, kimakna lai agelhsak a, apiak a, a-inn a pan apawtsak hiam, apasal nanungzaw, zi a neipa si hiam ahihleh;
english: If the latter husband hates her, and writes her a certificate of divorce, puts it in her hand, and sends her out of his house; or if the latter husband dies, who took her to be his wife;

paite: apasal masa, amah paisakpa'n ahih nitsa ahi a, anei nawn thei kei ding. TOUPA mitmuh in hiai thilkihhuai ahi. TOUPA'N luah dia ahon piak gam ah khelhna na lutsak ding uh ahi kei.
english: her former husband, who sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife after she is defiled; for that would be an abomination to Yahweh. You shall not cause the land to sin, which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance.

paite: Pasal zi nei tung sepaih in akuan ding ahi kei a, bang nna sem dia phut ding leng ahi kei. A-inn ah kum khat zalen in a-om dia, azi lungnuamtak in a-omsak ding hi.
english: When a man takes a new wife, he shall not go out in the army, neither shall he be assigned any business. He shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer his wife whom he has taken.

paite: Buh gawizanna hiam, atunglam suang hiam kichiamna ding in kuamah a pan na lentang ding uh ahi kei; mi hinna lettangsak na hi ngal ua.
english: No man shall take the mill or the upper millstone as a pledge, for he takes a life in pledge.

paite: Kuapeuh, Israel suan a-unaute lak a mi gu a, sal a zat hiam, zuak hiam theihkhiak ahihleh huai gutapa hihlup ding ahi. Huchibang na lak ua kipan thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uh ahi.
english: If a man is found stealing any of his brothers of the children of Israel, and he deals with him as a slave, or sells him, then that thief shall die. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

paite: Phak hipi tungtang thu ah hoihtak a ettel a, siampu, Levite sinsakdan bang zel a hih ding in pilvang un. Amau thu ka piak bang in pilvangtak in na hih ding uh ahi.
english: Be careful in the plague of leprosy, that you observe diligently and do according to all that the Levitical priests teach you. As I commanded them, so you shall observe to do.

paite: Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawtna lampi a TOUPA na Pathian un Miriam tung a ahihdan theigige un.
english: Remember what Yahweh your God did to Miriam, by the way as you came out of Egypt.

paite: Bangpeuh na invengte uh na leitawi sakleh akhamna la ding in a-inn ah na lut ding ahi kei.
english: When you lend your neighbor any kind of loan, you shall not go into his house to get his pledge.

paite: Inn pua ah na dingh dia, leitawisakmi in tua khamna inpua ah ahon tawikhe ding ahi.
english: You shall stand outside, and the man to whom you lend shall bring the pledge outside to you.

paite: Mizawng ahihleh akhamna kem in na giahpih ding ahi kei.
english: If he is a poor man, you shall not sleep with his pledge.

paite: Bang teng hileh ni ahong tum chiang in akichiamna thil akiang ah pekik in. Huchi in apuantual silh in a-ihmu thei dia, nang hon phat thei ding hi. Huai khamna thil pen na Pathian ma ah nang a ding in diktatna ahi ding hi.
english: You shall surely restore to him the pledge when the sun goes down, that he may sleep in his garment and bless you. It shall be righteousness to you before Yahweh your God.

paite: Na migoih, mizawng leh tasam na unau hiam, na gam ua na tenna ua om gamdangmi hiam leng hitaleh na simmoh ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not oppress a hired servant who is poor and needy, whether he is one of your brothers or one of the foreigners who are in your land within your gates.

paite: Asep ni in aloh na pe ding uh; ni in atumkhum ding ahi kei. Mizawng ahi a, huai ah alungtang akoih hi. Huchi lou in zaw na tungtang uah TOUPA asam dia, nou a ding in khelhna ahi ding hi.
english: In his day you shall give him his wages, neither shall the sun go down on it, for he is poor and sets his heart on it, lest he cry against you to Yahweh, and it be sin to you.

paite: Tate ziak in pate hihlup ding ahi kei a, pate ziak in tapate leng hihlup ding ahi sam kei. Michih amah khelhna ziak a hihlup ding ahi.
english: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers. Every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

paite: Gamdang mite leh pa neiloute dikloutak a na gensak ding ahi kei. Meithai puan leng khamna ding in na laksak ding ahi kei.
english: You shall not deprive the foreigner or the fatherless of justice, nor take a widow’s clothing in pledge;

paite: Nou leng Aigupta gam ah sikha na hi ngeita ua, TOUPA na Pathian un huai a pan a hon tat na hi uh, chih na theihgige ding uh ahi. Huchi in TOUPA na Pathian un na khut ngakna chiteng uah hon vualzawl ding hi.
english: but you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and Yahweh your God redeemed you there. Therefore I command you to do this thing.

paite: Na lou ua buh na lak un, buhphal na khop maih uleh na lak nawn ding uh ahi kei. Gamdang mite, pa neiloute, meithaite a ding ahi. Huchi in TOUPA na Pathian un na khut koihna tengteng uh avualzawl ding hi.
english: When you reap your harvest in your field, and have forgotten a sheaf in the field, you shall not go again to get it. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow, that Yahweh your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.

paite: Na olive sing uh na sat chiang un ahiangte na sat ding uh ahi kei. Gamdang mite, pa neiloute leh meithaite a ding ahi.
english: When you beat your olive tree, you shall not go over the boughs again. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

paite: Na grephuan ua na loh chiang un asang na zong ding uh ahi kei. Gamdang mite, pa neiloute leh meithaite a ding ahi.
english: When you harvest your vineyard, you shall not glean it after yourselves. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow.

paite: Aigupta gam ah sikha na hita uh, chih na theigige ding uh ahi. Huaiziak in ahi, hiai thilhih dia thu ka hon piak.
english: You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt. Therefore I command you to do this thing.

paite: Mi akinak ua, vaihawmna mun a ahoh uleh, vaihawmte'n ana gensak ding ua, midiktat siam atangsak ding ua, migilou moh atangsak ding uhi.
english: If there is a controversy between men, and they come to judgment and the judges judge them, then they shall justify the righteous and condemn the wicked.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, migilou zep tuak mah ahihleh, vaihawmmi in alumsak dia, ama ah azep ding ahi. Agitlouh dungzui a zep ding zah bikhiah ding ahi.
english: It shall be, if the wicked man is worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down and to be beaten before his face, according to his wickedness, by number.

paite: Sawmli vei tan zep theih ahi dia, huai val zaw hilou in. Hiai sang a val azepleh na unaupa uh na zahlaksak lo kha ding uh.
english: He may sentence him to no more than forty stripes. He shall not give more, lest if he should give more and beat him more than that many stripes, then your brother will be degraded in your sight.

paite: Bawngtal in buh achil lai in amuk na gak ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not muzzle the ox when he treads out the grain.

paite: Unaute tengkhawm uhenla, tapa nei lou in alak ua khat si taleh, asipa zi in polam a midang akitenpih ding ahi kei. Apasal unaupa in aluah dia, zi in anei dia, apasal unau mohpuakna tung ah ahih ding ahi.
english: If brothers dwell together, and one of them dies and has no son, the wife of the dead shall not be married outside to a stranger. Her husband’s brother shall go in to her, and take her as his wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, atachil suansak in Israel lak a, amin amanlouhna ding in a-unau sipa min apu ding ahi.
english: It shall be that the firstborn whom she bears shall succeed in the name of his brother who is dead, that his name not be blotted out of Israel.

paite: Ama'n a-unaupa zi kitenpih a-ut keileh, kulh kongpi a upate kiang ah a-unaupa zi ahohtou dia, "Ka pasal unaupa'n Israel lak a a-unaupa min omsak zel a-ut kei a, ka pasal unaupa hih ding ka tung ah ahih nuam kei," ava chi ding hi.
english: If the man doesn’t want to take his brother’s wife, then his brother’s wife shall go up to the gate to the elders, and say, “My husband’s brother refuses to raise up to his brother a name in Israel. He will not perform the duty of a husband’s brother to me.”

paite: Huchi in akho upate un amah asam ding ua, ahoupih ding ua ama'n, "Ka kitenpih nuam kei," chi a apanleh;
english: Then the elders of his city shall call him, and speak to him. If he stands and says, “I don’t want to take her,”

paite: a-unaupa zi akiang ah upate ma ah ahong dia, upate ma ava naihtou dia, akhedap asuahsak dia, amai ah achil ase ding hi. "A-unaupa inkuan khotuah nuamloupa tung ah hichibang a hih hi ngeingei hen," achi ding hi.
english: then his brother’s wife shall come to him in the presence of the elders, and loose his sandal from off his foot, and spit in his face. She shall answer and say, “So shall it be done to the man who does not build up his brother’s house.”

paite: Huchi in inkuan khedap suahsakpa, chi in Israelte lak ah amin putsak ahi ding hi.
english: His name shall be called in Israel, “The house of him who had his sandal removed.”

paite: Mikilai uhenla, akhat penpa zi in akilaihpihpa a pan apasal honkhe ding in azahmoh kaihsak taleh;
english: When men strive against each other, and the wife of one draws near to deliver her husband out of the hand of him who strikes him, and puts out her hand, and grabs him by his private parts,

paite: akhut na tansak ding uh ahi. Na hehpih ding uh ahi kei.
english: then you shall cut off her hand. Your eye shall have no pity.

paite: Na ip sung uah bukna suang chi tuamtuam, agik leh azang na nei ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not have in your bag diverse weights, one heavy and one light.

paite: Na inn uah tehna chi tuamtuam, alian leh aneu na kem ding uh ahi kei,
english: You shall not have in your house diverse measures, one large and one small.

paite: Bukna diktak leh hoihtak na nei ding uh ahi. Tehna diktak leh hoihtak na nei ding uh ahi. Huchi in TOUPA'N ahon gam piak ah na damsawt ding uhi.
english: You shall have a perfect and just weight. You shall have a perfect and just measure, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

paite: Huchibang hihmi, diktat loutak a hih tengteng TOUPA na Pathian un akih hi.
english: For all who do such things, all who do unrighteously, are an abomination to Yahweh your God.

paite: Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawtna lampi ua Amalekte'n hon na bawldan uh:
english: Remember what Amalek did to you by the way as you came out of Egypt,

paite: Pathian leng lau lou a, na bah lai uh leh na nguai lai ua lampi a hon kituahpih a, na lak ua ananungpente, na nunglam ua hatloute, na bah lai leh na gim lai ua hon na sualdante uh theigige un.
english: how he met you by the way, and struck the rearmost of you, all who were feeble behind you, when you were faint and weary; and he didn’t fear God.

paite: Huaiziak in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia gam ahon piak chiang in, na kim ua na melma tengteng ua pan TOUPA na Pathian un galmuanna ahon piak chiang in van nuai a Amalekte theihgigena na hihmang sipsip ding uhi. Na mangngilh ding uh ahi kei.
english: Therefore it shall be, when Yahweh your God has given you rest from all your enemies all around, in the land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance to possess it, that you shall blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky. You shall not forget.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian un gouluah dia gam hon piak a na va lut ua, na va ten chiang un;
english: It shall be, when you have come in to the land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance, possess it, and dwell in it,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak na gam leigah tung masapen chiat uh na hon tawi ding ua; bawm ah na koih ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian un amin omsakna dia aseh ding ah na hoh ding uhi.
english: that you shall take some of the first of all the fruit of the ground, which you shall bring in from your land that Yahweh your God gives you. You shall put it in a basket, and shall go to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

paite: Huchi in siampu kiang ah na hoh ding ua, akiang ah, hon piak dia i pi-le-pute kiang a, achiamna gam ka hong tungta uh, chih tuni in TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang ah i hihlang uhi, na chi ding uh.
english: You shall come to the priest who shall be in those days, and tell him, “I profess today to Yahweh your God, that I have come to the land which Yahweh swore to our fathers to give us.”

paite: Siampu in na khut ua kipan bawm ala dia, TOUPA na Pathian uh maitam bul ah anga ding hi.
english: The priest shall take the basket out of your hand, and set it down before Yahweh your God’s altar.

paite: Nou TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah, "Ka pu uh Siria mi, mivakvai ahi a, Aigupta gam ah apaisuk a, ava teng a, tawmchik ahi ua; huai ah nam thupitak, thilhihtheitak, tamtak ahong hita uhi.
english: You shall answer and say before Yahweh your God, “My father was a Syrian ready to perish. He went down into Egypt, and lived there, few in number. There he became a great, mighty, and populous nation.

paite: Aigupta mite'n hon simmoh ua, hon hihgenthei ua, nasep haksa pipi hon semsak uh.
english: The Egyptians mistreated us, afflicted us, and imposed hard labor on us.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA i pi-le-pute Pathian i sam ua, TOUPA'N i aw uh ana za a, i gentheihdan, i gimdan leh nuaisiah a i omdan amu hi.
english: Then we cried to Yahweh, the God of our fathers. Yahweh heard our voice, and saw our affliction, our toil, and our oppression.

paite: TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan khut hattak, ban zak, thil lauhuaitak, chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte in ahon pikhia a;
english: Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, with great terror, with signs, and with wonders;

paite: hiai mun ah hon pilut a, hiai gam, nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam ahon pia hi.
english: and he has brought us into this place, and has given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.

paite: Ngai in, TOUPA aw, nang na hon piak leigah masapen chiatte ka hon tawi uhi,” na va chi ding uhi. TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah na vual ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian uh bia in na kun ding uhi.
english: Now, behold, I have brought the first of the fruit of the ground, which you, Yahweh, have given me.” You shall set it down before Yahweh your God, and worship before Yahweh your God.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un na inkuante, noute, Levi mite, na lak ua gamdang mite thil hoih ahon piak tengteng ah kipaktak in na om ding uhi.
english: You shall rejoice in all the good which Yahweh your God has given to you, and to your house, you, and the Levite, and the foreigner who is among you.

paite: Kum thum kum, sawm-a-khat piak kum a na thil tung tengteng uh sawm-a-khat na piak khit uleh, Levi mite, gamdang mite, pa neiloute, meithaite'n na omna uah ane ding uh, ahong khosak theih samna ding un.
english: When you have finished tithing all the tithe of your increase in the third year, which is the year of tithing, then you shall give it to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, that they may eat within your gates and be filled.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah, thu na hon piak tengteng bang in ka inn ua kipan thil siangthoute ka sepkhia ua, Levi mite, gamdang mite, pa neiloute leh meithaite ka peta uh. Na thupiak akoi mahmah ka bohse kei ua, ka mangngilh kei uhi.
english: You shall say before Yahweh your God, “I have put away the holy things out of my house, and also have given them to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all your commandment which you have commanded me. I have not transgressed any of your commandments, neither have I forgotten them.

paite: Ka dah lai un huai ka ne kei ua, ka sian louh lai un ka thehthang sam kei ua, misi tuam a ding in leng ka pe sam kei uhi. TOUPA ka Pathian uh aw ka dawp ua, na hon thupiak tengteng bang in ka hih uhi.
english: I have not eaten of it in my mourning, neither have I removed any of it while I was unclean, nor given of it for the dead. I have listened to Yahweh my God’s voice. I have done according to all that you have commanded me.

paite: Na omna siangthou van a pan hon en inla, nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam, ka pi uh leh pute piak dia na kichiamsa bang in na mi Israelte leh na gam hon piak vualzawl in, na chi ding uh.
english: Look down from your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless your people Israel, and the ground which you have given us, as you swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.”

paite: "Tuni in TOUPA na Pathian un hiai dan leh vaihawmte zui ding in thu ahon pia hi. Huaiziak in na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng ua pom in na zui ding uh ahi.
english: Today Yahweh your God commands you to do these statutes and ordinances. You shall therefore keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul.

paite: Tuni in TOUPA lampite zui a, adante, athupiakte leh avaihawmte zui a, a-aw dawp tum in na Pathian ding un na telta uh.
english: You have declared today that Yahweh is your God, and that you would walk in his ways, keep his statutes, his commandments, and his ordinances, and listen to his voice.

paite: Thu ahon chiamsa bang in leh athupiak tengteng na zuihna ding un TOUPA'N tuni in amah a tuambik hi ding in noute ahon na telta hi.
english: Yahweh has declared today that you are a people for his own possession, as he has promised you, and that you should keep all his commandments.

paite: Ana gensa bang a TOUPA na Pathian uh a dia a misiangthou na hihtheihna ding un leh nam a bawl tengteng tung a phat, minhoih leh pahtawi a na omtheihna ding un,” achi hi.
english: He will make you high above all nations that he has made, in praise, in name, and in honor, and that you may be a holy people to Yahweh your God, as he has spoken.

paite: Huan Mosi leh Israel upate'n Huniadania ka hon piak thupiak tengteng zui un.
english: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, “Keep all the commandment which I command you today.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon gam piak a lut dia Jordan na kan ni chiang un hichi ahi ding a, suang liantakte na phut ding ua, suang lou na nuh ding uh ahi.
english: It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, that you shall set yourself up great stones, and coat them with plaster.

paite: Na galkah khit chiang un atung uah hiai dan thu tengteng na gelh ding uh ahi. Huchi in TOUPA, na pi-le-pute uh Pathian in hon na chiamsa bang in nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam, TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak gam ah na pai thei ding uhi.
english: You shall write on them all the words of this law, when you have passed over, that you may go in to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised you.

paite: Jordan lui na galkah khit chiang un hichi ahi ding a, tuni a ka hon thupiak bang in Ebal tang ah suangte na phut ding ua, suang lou na nuh ding uh ahi.
english: It shall be, when you have crossed over the Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I command you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall coat them with plaster.

paite: Huai ah TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in maitam, suang maitam na bawl ding uh ahi. Vanzat ding in sik na zang ding uh ahi kei,
english: There you shall build an altar to Yahweh your God, an altar of stones. You shall not use any iron tool on them.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh maitam suang sek louh in na bawl ding uh ahi. Huai ah TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in halmang thillatte na lan ding uhi.
english: You shall build Yahweh your God’s altar of uncut stones. You shall offer burnt offerings on it to Yahweh your God.

paite: Kilepna thillatte in na kithoih ding ua, huai ah na ne ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah kipaktak in na om ding uh ahi.
english: You shall sacrifice peace offerings, and shall eat there. You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God.

paite: Suangte ah hiai dan thu tengteng teltak in na gelh ding uh ahi," chi in.
english: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly.”

paite: Mosi leh siampu Levite'n Israel mi tengteng ahoupih ua, Israel mite aw, hoihtak in ngaikhia un. Tuni in TOUPA na Pathian uh mite na hong hita uhi.
english: Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying, “Be silent and listen, Israel! Today you have become the people of Yahweh your God.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA na Pathian uh thu na zuih ding uh ahi. Tuni a ka hon thupiakte leh adante na zuih ding uh ahi, achi uhi.
english: You shall therefore obey Yahweh your God’s voice, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you today.”

paite: Huai ni mah in Mosi in mipite thu apia a,
english: Moses commanded the people the same day, saying,

paite: "Jordan lui gal na kah khit chiang un mipite vualzawl ding in Gerizim tang a hiaite adin ding uh ahi: Simeon nam, Levi nam, Judah nam, Issakar nam, Joseph nam leh Benjamin nam.
english: “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.

paite: Hamsiat ding in hiaite Ebal tang a adin ding uh ahi: Reuben nam, Gad nam, Asher nam, Zebulun nam, Dan nam leh Naphtali nam," achi hi.
english: These shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

paite: Levite'n ahon gen pan ua, Israel mi tengteng kiang ah aw ngaihtak in,
english: With a loud voice, the Levites shall say to all the men of Israel,

paite: "Khutsiamte khutsuak TOUPA a dia kihhuai milim tunkhiak tawm hiam, gukkep peuhmah hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen,” chi in ana dawng ding uhi.
english: ‘Cursed is the man who makes an engraved or molten image, an abomination to Yahweh, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ All the people shall answer and say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "Anu hiam, apa hiam zahtak lou peuhmah hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!” ana chi ding uh.
english: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "A-invengte gamgi suanmi hamsethuak in om hen,” achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uh.
english: ‘Cursed is he who removes his neighbor’s landmark.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "Lampi a pan mittaw lampi lou a paisakmi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uhi.
english: ‘Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "Gamdangmi, pa nei lou leh meithai vai dikloutak a hawmsakmi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uhi.
english: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "Apa zi kithuahpihmi ham-sethuak in om hen," apa nik lem ahih ziak in, achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uh.
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his father’s wife, because he dishonors his father’s bed.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "Bang gan peuhpeuh kithuahpihmi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uhi.
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "Asanggamnu, apa tanu hiam, anu tanu hiam, kithuahpihmi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" achi ding uhi.
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "Asungnu kithuahpihmi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uh.
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "A-invengte gukthahmi ham-sethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" achi ding uhi.
english: ‘Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "Poi khoih lou thahna ding a golhna lami hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" achi ding uhi.
english: ‘Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "Hiai dan thute zui ding a pomkip lou mi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!” achi ding uhi.
english: ‘Cursed is he who doesn’t uphold the words of this law by doing them.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian aw hoihtak a na ngaihkhiak ua, tuni a thu ka hon piak, thupiak tengteng pilvangtak a na zuih uleh, TOUPA na Pathian un leitung nam tengteng a tungnungpen in ahon bawl ding hi.
english: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today, that Yahweh your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh thu na zuih peuhmah uleh hiai vualzawlna tengteng na tung uah ahong tung dia, ahon zui ding uhi.
english: All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.

paite: Inn lam leh gam lam ah vualzawl in na om ding uh.
english: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.

paite: Na gil ua gah, na lei ua gah, na ganhon, na bawngpi leh na belamhon uh vualzawl in a-om ding.
english: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.

paite: Na bawm uh leh na tanghou mekna kuangte uh vualzawl in a-om ding.
english: Your basket and your kneading trough shall be blessed.

paite: Vakkhete vualzawl in na om ding ua, inn a hong lutte leng vualzawl in na om ding uh.
english: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.

paite: Na melma nou hon doute TOUPA'N ahon zohsak dia; nou hon dou ding in lampi khat ah ahong kuan ding ua, lampi sagih ah ataikek ding uh.
english: Yahweh will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck before you. They will come out against you one way, and will flee before you seven ways.

paite: TOUPA'N na buh inn tung uah, na khut koihna tengteng uah vualzawlna thu ape dia; TOUPA na Pathian un ahon gam piak ah ahon vualzawl ding hi.
english: Yahweh will command the blessing on you in your barns, and in all that you put your hand to. He will bless you in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

paite: Na kiang ua ana kichiam bang in TOUPA'n amah a ding in nam siangthou ding in ahon hihkip ding, TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiakte na zuih ua, alampite na zuih phot uleh.
english: Yahweh will establish you for a holy people to himself, as he has sworn to you, if you shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, and walk in his ways.

paite: Huchi in leitung a mite'n TOUPA min a sap na hi uh, chih athei ding ua, hon lau ding uhi.
english: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by Yahweh’s name, and they will be afraid of you.

paite: Nou piak dia na pi-le-pute uh TOUPA'N ana chiam gam ah na gil ua gah, na ganhon gah leh na leigah uh TOUPA'N nakpitak in apungsak ding.
english: Yahweh will grant you abundant prosperity in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers to give you.

paite: TOUPA'N ahun geihgeih in na gam uh vak ding, vuahtui hon pe ding leh na khut koihna tengteng uh hon vualzawl ding in, avan goubawm hoih akihongsak ding hi. Huchi in nam tampi na leitawisak ding ua, nou bel na leitawi kei ding uhi.
english: Yahweh will open to you his good treasure in the sky, to give the rain of your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You will lend to many nations, and you will not borrow.

paite: TOUPA'N amei hilou in, alu in hon bawl dia, anuainung hilou in, atungnung na hi ding uhi. TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiak, tuni a ka hon piak ngaikhia a, pilvangtak a na zuih uleh.
english: Yahweh will make you the head, and not the tail. You will be above only, and you will not be beneath, if you listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God which I command you today, to observe and to do,

paite: Tuni a ka hon thupiak mah bang a taklam hiam, veilam hiam a pathian dangte zui leh nasem dia na pialsan kei peuhmah uleh.
english: and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

paite: Himahleh hichi ahong hi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian uh aw hoihtak a na ngaihkhiak louh ua, tuni a ka hon piak thupiak tengteng pilvangtak a na zuih kei uleh, na tung uah hiai hamsia tengteng ahong tung dia, ahon pha nawn ding uhi.
english: But it shall come to pass, if you will not listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you today, that all these curses will come on you and overtake you.

paite: Inn lam leh gam lam ah hamsia na thuak ding uh.
english: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.

paite: Na bawm uh leh na tanghou mekna kuang uh hamsethuak in a-om ding uh.
english: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.

paite: Na gilgahte, na leigahte leh na bawngpi uh leh na belamhon gahte hamsethuak in a-om ding uh.
english: The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be cursed.

paite: Na pawtkhete uh hamsethuak in a-om ding ua, ahong lutte leng hamsethuak in a-om ding uh.
english: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.

paite: TOUPA'N na tung uah, na khut koihna tengteng uah hamsia, buaina leh salhna ahon sawl dia, na vuallel ding ua, na mangthang pah ding uh; na thilhih giloute ua kei na hon paisan ziak un.
english: Yahweh will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all that you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your doings, by which you have forsaken me.

paite: Luah dia na lutna gam ua kipan ahon hihmanthat masiah TOUPA'N na lak uah hipi alengsak gige ding hi.
english: Yahweh will make the pestilence cling to you, until he has consumed you from off the land where you go in to possess it.

paite: TOUPA'N kumzawnna, khosik, bawkna, sat huthutna, namsau, keuna leh muatna in hon gawt dia, na manthat vek masiah uh hiaite'n hon delh ding uhi.
english: Yahweh will strike you with consumption, with fever, with inflammation, with fiery heat, with the sword, with blight, and with mildew. They will pursue you until you perish.

paite: Na lutung ua van dal ahi dia, na nuai ua lei sik ahi ding.
english: Your sky that is over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you will be iron.

paite: TOUPA'N na gam vuah uh leivui leh vut asuaksak ding a; na manthat masiah uh van a pan na tung uah ahong ke ding hi.
english: Yahweh will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.

paite: TOUPA'N na melmate uh lak ah hon hihniam dia; amaute dou ding in lampi khat ah na kuankhe ding ua, lampi sagih ah na taikek ding uh. Leitung a lalgamte lak ah paihkhiak in na om ding uhi.
english: Yahweh will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways before them. You will be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.

paite: Na luang uh tungleng vasa tengteng leh gamsa tengteng nek ding an ahi dia, mi kuamah in amaute adelhmang kei ding uh.
english: Your dead bodies will be food to all birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth; and there will be no one to frighten them away.

paite: Hihdam theih louh Aigupta meimatum, chithak, bawkna leh vunthak in TOUPA'N ahon gawt ding hi.
english: Yahweh will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed.

paite: Haina, mittawtna leh lunglelhna in TOUPA'N ahon gawt ding.
english: Yahweh will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.

paite: Mittaw in khomial amaimai bang in, sun khovak nangawn ah na maimai ding ua, na khosakna uah na lamzang kei ding uh. Nuaisiah ding leh gallak ding phet na hi ding ua, hon hunkhe ding kuamah a-om kei ding uhi.
english: You will grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. You will only be oppressed and robbed always, and there will be no one to save you.

paite: Zi na kham ding ua, midang in akithuahpih ding uh. Inn na lam ding ua, na luah kei ding uh. Grephuan na bawl ding ua, agah na ne kei ding uh.
english: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit.

paite: Na mitmuh un na bawngtal uh hon gohsak ding ua, asa na ne kei ding uh. Na mitmuh un na sabiltung uh thagum a suhsak na hi ding ua, piakkik na hi kei ding uh. Na belam uh na melmate uh piak ahi ding; hon hunkhe ding kuamah na nei kei ding uh.
english: Your ox will be slain before your eyes, and you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be violently taken away from before your face, and will not be restored to you. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and you will have no one to save you.

paite: Na tanute uh leh na tapate uh namdangte piak ahi ding ua, nitum in amaute ngai in na en vungvung ding ua, na etetna lam un na mitte uh avai ding; bangmah lah hihtheih na nei kei ding uhi.
english: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people. Your eyes will look and fail with longing for them all day long. There will be no power in your hand.

paite: Na leigah, na sepkhiak teng uh na theih louh uh nam in ane khin dia, hihgentheih leh hihsiat in na om gige ding uh.
english: A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and crushed always,

paite: Huchi in hiai thil mu in na hailoh ding uhi.
english: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.

paite: TOUPA'N na khuk uah, na khe uah, hihdam theih louh meimatum ahon veisak ding, na khepek ua kipan na lusip tanpha un.
english: Yahweh will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.

paite: Nou leh na kumpipa uh nangawn in na pi-le-pute'n atheih ngei louh uh nam kiang ah TOUPA'N ahon pi dia; huai ah pathian dangte, sing leh suang pathiante nna na sem ding uh.
english: Yahweh will bring you, and your king whom you will set over yourselves, to a nation that you have not known, you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods of wood and stone.

paite: TOUPA'N hon pimangna ding nam tengteng lak ah lamdang chih leh paunak leh aselam a gentehna na hong hi ding uhi.
english: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where Yahweh will lead you away.

paite: Lou ah buhchi tampi na kuankhiakpih ding ua, tawmchik kia na la ding uh, khaupe in anegai vek ding hi.
english: You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in, for the locust will consume it.

paite: Grephuan na bawl ding ua, na kem ding ua, himahleh a-uain na dawn kei ding uh. Grep lah na lou kei ding uh, lung in anegai ding hi.
english: You will plant vineyards and dress them, but you will neither drink of the wine, nor harvest, because worms will eat them.

paite: Na gam tengteng uah olive sing na suan ding ua, himahleh athau na nilh kei ding uh, na olive gahte uh apulh khin ding hi.
english: You will have olive trees throughout all your borders, but you won’t anoint yourself with the oil, for your olives will drop off.

paite: Tanu tapa na suang ding ua, himahleh sal a kaihmang a, a-om ding ziak un na ompih kha kei ding uh.
english: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.

paite: Na theikung tengteng uh leh na leigah tengteng uh khaupe an ahi ding.
english: Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground.

paite: Gamdangmi na lak ua tengte na tung uah asang hiaihiai ding ua, nou na niam giaigiai ding uh.
english: The foreigner who is among you will mount up above you higher and higher, and you will come down lower and lower.

paite: Ahon leitawisak ding ua, nou zaw na leitawisak kei ding uh. Amau alu ahi ding ua, nou amei na hi ding uh.
english: He will lend to you, and you won’t lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.

paite: Hiai hamsia tengteng na tung uah ahong tung dia, ahon delh dia, ahon pha dia; hihmanthat a na om masiah uh; athupiak leh adan hon piak zui dia TOUPA na Pathian aw na ngaihsak louh ziak un.
english: All these curses will come on you, and will pursue you and overtake you, until you are destroyed, because you didn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you.

paite: Na tung uah leh na suante uh tung ah tangtawn a dia chiamtehna leh lamdang chih ding in a-om ding uhi.
english: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever.

paite: Thil bangkim a na hong kiningchin ua leng TOUPA na Pathian uh lungsim kipaktak leh nuamsatak a na sepsak louh ziak un.
english: Because you didn’t serve Yahweh your God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;

paite: Huaiziak in noute hon dou dia TOUPA'N ahon sawl ding na melmate uh gilkial, dangtak leh vuaktang leh thil bangkim tasam kawm in na sepsak ding uh. Ahon hihsiat masiah uh na ngawng uah sik hakkol ahon batsak ding uhi.
english: therefore you will serve your enemies whom Yahweh sends against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in lack of all things. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.

paite: Gamlapi a pan, kawlmong a pan nou hon dou ding nam, TOUPA'N muvanlai ngumkiak bang in ahon sawl ding; apau uh na theih louh uh nam;
english: Yahweh will bring a nation against you from far away, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies: a nation whose language you will not understand,

paite: nam lauhuai melpu, upa leng khawk sa lou leh tuailaite leng deihsak tuam lou.
english: a nation of fierce facial expressions, that doesn’t respect the elderly, nor show favor to the young.

paite: Na ganhon pungte leh na leigah, na manthat masiah uh ane ding ua, buh, uain, thau, na bawnghon leh na belamhonte uh ahawi kei ding uh, na tung ua manna ahon tunsak tan in.
english: They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave you grain, new wine, oil, the increase of your livestock, or the young of your flock, until they have caused you to perish.

paite: Na gam tengteng ua na muanpen uh, na kulhsangte uh achip tan in na kulh kongpi tengteng uah ahon um ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian un nou ahon piak na gam tengteng ua na kulh kongpi tengteng uh ahong um ding uhi.
english: They will besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you trusted come down throughout all your land. They will besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land which Yahweh your God has given you.

paite: Na melmate'n hon umbichilh ziak un leh ahon hihmangbatna uah na gil ua gah, TOUPA'N ahon piak na tanu, na tapate sa na ne ding uhi.
english: You will eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, whom Yahweh your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you.

paite: Na lak ua minunnem leh chingkam nangawn in leng a-unaupa, ahihkeileh azi it, a-ompih lai atate ngialtak leng a-it kei ding hi.
english: The man who is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye will be evil toward his brother, toward the wife whom he loves, and toward the remnant of his children whom he has remaining,

paite: Bangmah aneih nawn louh ziak in atate uh sa anek ding kuamah ape kei ding hi. Ahon umna uh leh ahon khelhchipna uah, na melmate'n na kulh kongpi ua ahon khelhchip ziak un.
english: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he will eat, because he has nothing left to him, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in all your gates.

paite: Na lak ua numei chinou leh chingek, achinouna leh achingekna ziak a lei leng sik nuam lou in apasal deih mahmah uh, atapate, atanute;
english: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye will be evil toward the husband that she loves, toward her son, toward her daughter,

paite: apom lai atasen leh ata piang lai dingte leng a-en moh ding uh. Bangkim ataksap khit ziak in asimnek ding; na melmate'n na kulh kongpi ua ahon lungkiaksak ziak un.
english: toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them secretly for lack of all things in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in your gates.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh min thupitak leh lauhuaitak na lauhtheihna ding ua, hiai laibu a tuang thu tengteng pilvangtak a na zuih kei uleh;
english: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, YAHWEH your God,

paite: TOUPA'N noute leh na suante uh tung ah hipi lamdangtak, hipi leng gige, damlouhna haksatak leng gige chi a lengsak ding hi.
english: then Yahweh will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful, even great plagues, and of long duration, and severe sicknesses, and of long duration.

paite: Na lauh mahmah uh Aigupta gam hiite na tung uah alengsak nawn dia, hon lenkip ding uhi.
english: He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you.

paite: Hiai dan laibu a tuanglou, damlouhna hii chiteng leng na manthat masiah uh TOUPA'N na tung uah alengsak ding hi.
english: Also every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, Yahweh will bring them on you until you are destroyed.

paite: Van a aksi zah hita noute tawmchik kia na hong hita ding uh; TOUPA na Pathian aw na man louh ziak un.
english: You will be left few in number, even though you were as the stars of the sky for multitude, because you didn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, hon hihhoih ding leh hon pungsak dia TOUPA na tung ua akipah bang in, hon hihmang ding leh bangmah lou hon suah ding in TOUPA na tung uah akipak dia, na va luah ding uh na lutna gam ua kipan suanmang na hi ding uhi.
