english: It will happen that as Yahweh rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so Yahweh will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you. You will be plucked from the land that you are going in to possess.

paite: TOUPA'N kawlmong a pan kawlmong langkhat tan in chi chih lak ah hon hihdalh dia, huai ah sing leh suang, na pi uh leh pute uh tan a na theih ngei louh uh pathian dangte nna na sem ding uhi.
english: Yahweh will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth. There you will serve other gods which you have not known, you nor your fathers, even wood and stone.

paite: Hiai namte lak ah tawldamna na mu kei ding ua, na khe uh a ding in khawlna a-om kei dia; huai ah, TOUPA'N lungtang ling, mit gim leh lungsim ngui hon pe zaw ding hi.
english: Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but Yahweh will give you there a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and pining of soul.

paite: Na hinna uh lauthawng gige in a-om dia, sun leh zan in lau gige in na om ding ua, na hinna un kitheihchetna anei kei ding hi.
english: Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life.

paite: Zingsang in, "Nitak hita maileh aw!" na chi ding ua, nitak in, "Zingsang hita maileh aw!" na chi ding uh, "Thil lauhuai na lungtang un alauh ding ziak leh na mit ua na thil muh ding uh ziak in.
english: In the morning you will say, “I wish it were evening!” and at evening you will say, “I wish it were morning!” for the fear of your heart which you will fear, and for the sights which your eyes will see.

paite: Na mu nawn kei ding uh, na kiang ua ka chih lampi ah long in Aigupta gam ah TOUPA'N ahon pi nawn ding. Huai ah na melmate uh sikhapa ding leh sikhanu dia zuak na hi ding ua, kuamah in ahon lei kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh will bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I told you that you would never see it again. There you will offer yourselves to your enemies for male and female slaves, and nobody will buy you.

paite: Horeb tang a akiang ua thu akhun sim louh, TOUPA'N Moab gam a Israel suante kiang a Mosi thu akhunsak, athukhun thu hiaite ahi.
english: These are the words of the covenant which Yahweh commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.

paite: Mosi in Israel mi tengteng asam a, akiang uah, Aigupta gam a Pharaoh, asikha tengteng leh agam tengteng tung a na mitmuh ngei ua TOUPA'N thil ahih tengteng na mu uhi.
english: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them: Your eyes have seen all that Yahweh did in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land;

paite: Khemna thupi mahmahte, chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte na mit mahmah ua na muh uh.
english: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N tuni tan in theisiam ding lungtang, mu thei ding mitte, za thei ding bilte ahon pe nai kei hi.
english: But Yahweh has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this day.

paite: Gamdai ah kum sawmli ka hon pi a; na puansilhte uh na silhtul kei ua, na khedapte uh leng na buntul kei lai uhi.
english: I have led you forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not grown old on you, and your sandals have not grown old on your feet.

paite: Kei, TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chih na theihna ding un tanghou na ne kei ua, uain hiam zu khauh hiam leng na dawn kei uhi.
english: You have not eaten bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink, that you may know that I am Yahweh your God.

paite: Hiai mun na hong tun un Heshbon kumpipa Sihon leh Bashan kumpipa Og hon dou ding in ahong kuan ua, amau i na zou uh.
english: When you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out against us to battle, and we struck them.

paite: Agam uh i la ua, Reubente, Gadte, Manasseh nam kimkhatte luah ding in i pia uhi.
english: We took their land, and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the Manassites.

paite: Na thilhih tengteng ua na lamzan zel theihna ding un hiai thukhun thute pom unla, zui un.
english: Therefore keep the words of this covenant and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.

paite: Tuni in na vek un, na nam lupente uh, na upate uh, na heutute uh leh Israel mi tengteng, TOUPA na Pathian ma ah na dingh ua;
english: All of you stand today in the presence of Yahweh your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,

paite: na taneute uh, na zite uh, na tenna ua gamdangmi na ompih uh, na singphukmi uh leh na tui tawi mite uh nangawn in;
english: your little ones, your wives, and the foreigners who are in the middle of your camps, from the one who cuts your wood to the one who draws your water,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh kichiamna leh athukhun tuni a nou toh abawl a na luttheihna ding un:
english: that you may enter into the covenant of Yahweh your God, and into his oath, which Yahweh your God makes with you today,

paite: Na pipute uh Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a ana kichiam bang leh na kiang ua ana gensa bang a amite hi ding a tuni a hon hihkip theihna ding leh na Pathian uh ahihtheihna ding in;
english: that he may establish you today as his people, and that he may be your God, as he spoke to you and as he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

paite: hiai kichiamna leh thukhun na kiang kia ua khung ka hi kei;
english: Neither do I make this covenant and this oath with you only,

paite: tuni a TOUPA i Pathian uh ma a dinghte leh tua i kiang ua omloute kiang ah leng ahi.
english: but with those who stand here with us today before Yahweh our God, and also with those who are not here with us today

paite: Aigupta ota gam a i omdan, namdangte pal paisuak a i paidan bang uh na thei ua;
english: (for you know how we lived in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the middle of the nations through which you passed;

paite: alak ua athilkihhuaite uleh amilimte uh, sing leh suang, dangka chi leh dangka-eng leng na mu uh.
english: and you have seen their abominations and their idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold, which were among them);

paite: Huchi lou in zaw na lak ua pasal hiam, numei hiam, inkuan hiam, nam hiam, huai pathiante be ding in alungtang un tu in TOUPA i Pathian uh kiheisan in, na lak uah thil kha leh gamsai selkhiakna bulte na hong om kha ding uh.
english: lest there should be among you man, woman, family, or tribe whose heart turns away today from Yahweh our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations; lest there should be among you a root that produces bitter poison;

paite: Huchi ahihleh zaw, hiai hamsia thu samte azaktak in, amah kivualzawl tawm in, "Paupeng in pai teitei leng le ka bit na ding," chi in akingaihtuah kha ding.
english: and it happen, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, “I shall have peace, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart,” to destroy the moist with the dry.

paite: TOUPA'N angaidam het kei dia, TOUPA hehna leh amullitna in huai mi akhuh dia, hiai laibu a hamse tuang tengteng atung ah atung dia, TOUPA'N van nuai a pan amin athaimang zaw ding hi.
english: Yahweh will not pardon him, but then Yahweh’s anger and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all the curse that is written in this book will fall on him, and Yahweh will blot out his name from under the sky.

paite: Hiai Dan Bu a tuang hamsia thukhun tengteng bang in Israel nam tengteng lak a pan hihtuam in thil hoih lou lam ah TOUPA'N akhenkhe ding hi.
english: Yahweh will set him apart for evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this book of the law.

paite: Khangthak hong om ding, na nung ua na tate uh hong om ding leh gam gamlapi a pan a hong pai dingte'n, huai gam a hipi leh TOUPA'N natna aveisakte amu ding uhi.
english: The generation to come—your children who will rise up after you, and the foreigner who will come from a far land—will say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses with which Yahweh has made it sick,

paite: Agam pumpi mei katsiat leh chi leh kat a dim, haichi lah kipawi lou, bangmah pou lou, sing leh lou bangmah om lou ahi ding. TOUPA heh leh thangpaihna Sodom leh Gomorrah, Admah leh Zeboim alumlet lai a siatna bangmah ahi ding.
english: that all of its land is sulfur, salt, and burning, that it is not sown, doesn’t produce, nor does any grass grow in it, like the overthrow of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, which Yahweh overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath.

paite: "Nam teng in bangziak in ahia hiai gam hichi tel a TOUPA'N abawl? Hiai thangpaihna thupi bangchidan ahia?" achi ding uh.
english: Even all the nations will say, “Why has Yahweh done this to this land? What does the heat of this great anger mean?”

paite: Mite'n, "Aigupta gam a pan apikhiak lai a TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian thukhun amau toh akhun amangngilh ziak un.
english: Then men will say, “Because they abandoned the covenant of Yahweh, the God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them out of the land of Egypt,

paite: pathian dangte, atheih ngei louh uh pathiante, ama'n asehsak louhte nna sem a, abiak ziak un.
english: and went and served other gods and worshiped them, gods that they didn’t know and that he had not given to them.

paite: Hiai laibu a tuang hamsia tengteng tungsak ding in hiai gam tung ah TOUPA aheh hi.
english: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against this land, to bring on it all the curses that are written in this book.

paite: Thangpai, heh leh thangpai mahmah in agam ua kipan abotkhe vek a, gamdang ah asawnlut hi, tua a-omdan bang uh," achi ding uhi.
english: Yahweh rooted them out of their land in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation, and thrust them into another land, as it is today.”

paite: Thil kiselte TOUPA i Pathian a ahi, thil kiphoulakte bel hiai dan thu tengteng i zuihtheihna dia eite leh i suante a ahi gige ding ahi.
english: The secret things belong to Yahweh our God; but the things that are revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may do all the words of this law.

paite: Huai khit in i kihei ua, Bashan lampi ah i paitou uhi. Bashan kumpipa Og leh ami tengteng Edrei ah ei dou ding in ahong kuan uhi.
english: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan. Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Amah lau ke'n, amah leh ami tengteng leh agam na khut ah ka hon pe khinta hi. Heshbon a om Amorte kumpipa Sihon tung a na hih bang in amah tung ah na hih ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Don’t fear him; for I have delivered him, with all his people and his land, into your hand. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”

paite: TOUPA i Pathian in Bashan kumpipa Og leng, ami tengteng toh i khut ah hon pia hi. Huchi in khat lel leng hawi lou in i that vek uhi.
english: So Yahweh our God also delivered into our hand Og, the king of Bashan, and all his people. We struck him until no one was left to him remaining.

paite: Huai lai in akhua tengteng kho sawmguk, Argob gambup a Bashan kumpipa Og gam tengteng i la vek ua, i laksak louh khua khat lel leng a-om kei hi.
english: We took all his cities at that time. There was not a city which we didn’t take from them: sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

paite: Hiai khua tengteng kulh sang pipi, kongpi leh kalhna nei chiat ahi a, kulh nei lou khua tampi sim louh in leng.
english: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, in addition to a great many villages without walls.

paite: Heshbon kumpipa Sihon tung a i hih bang in khua a pasal tengteng, numei leh ataneu chikchikte uh tan in i hihmang sipsip uhi.
english: We utterly destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones.

paite: Himahleh ganta tengteng leh khua a gallak a i lak thilte ei a tuam ding in i la uhi.
english: But all the livestock, and the plunder of the cities, we took for plunder for ourselves.

paite: Huai lai in Jordan gal a om Amorte kumpipa nihte a pan Arnon Phaizang a pan Hermon tang pha in gam i la uhi.
english: We took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon.

paite: Sidonte'n Hermon tuh Sirion achi ua, Amorte'n ahihleh Senir achi uhi.
english: (The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.)

paite: Phaigam a khua tengteng leh Gilead gam tengteng leh Bashan gam tengteng toh, Bashan gam a Og gam a khuate, Salekah leh Endrei tan in i la uhi.
english: We took all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

paite: Milian sibangte lak a khosuaksun Bashan kumpipa Og kia ahi a, ngai dih, alupna sik ahi a; Ammon suante khua Rabbah ah tutan in a-om ahi kei maw? Huai lupna mihing tong a teh in adunglam tong kua, availam tong li ahi.
english: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Nine cubits was its length, and four cubits its width, after the cubit of a man.)

paite: Huai tung in huai gam i luah ua; Arnon Phaizang kiang Aroer a pan Gilead tanggam kimkhat tan in, khua omte toh Reubente leh Gadte ka pia hi.
english: This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead with its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites;

paite: Gilead gam om lai teng leh Og gam Bashan tengteng Manasseh nam kimkhatte ka pia hi, Argob gam tengteng leh Bashan gam tengteng Rephaimte gam chih in a-om hi.
english: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh—all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.

paite: Manasseh tapa Jair in Argob gam tengteng Geshurte leh Maakathte gam tan in ala a, Bashan pen, ama min tam in Havothjair asa a, tuni tan in achi lai uh.
english: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth Jair, to this day.)

paite: Gilead kiang ah Makir ka pia hi.
english: I gave Gilead to Machir.

paite: Reubente leh Gadte bel Gilead a pan Arnon Phaizang, phaizang laitak tan in agam ding un ka pia a; Ammon suante gamgi, Jabok lui tan in.
english: To the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and its border, even to the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

paite: Atumlam gamgi Arabah a Jordan lui, Kinereth a pan Arabah Tuipi tan, Pisgah mual pang ken nuai apai ahi. Arabah Tuipi, Chi Tuipi ahi.
english: the Arabah also, and the Jordan and its border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.

paite: Huai lai in, TOUPA na Pathian un, "Hiai gam nou a tuam ding in ahon pia hi. Israelte, na unaute uh ma ah na mihangsan tengteng uh kigalthuam in va hohtou sam uhen.
english: I commanded you at that time, saying, “Yahweh your God has given you this land to possess it. All of you men of valor shall pass over armed before your brothers, the children of Israel.

paite: Himahleh, na zite uh leh na taneu chikchikte uh leh na gante uh, ganta na hau uh chih ka thei, na khua uah, ka hon piaksa ah ana om ding uhi.
english: But your wives, and your little ones, and your livestock, (I know that you have much livestock), shall live in your cities which I have given you,

paite: Nou bang a na unaute uh TOUPA'N galmuang a abawl ma leh TOUPA na Pathian un Jordan gal a gam apiak aluah sam matan uh; huchi in nou a tuam ding ua ka hon piak ah na hong pai nawn ding uh, chi in thu ka hon pia hi.
english: until Yahweh gives rest to your brothers, as to you, and they also possess the land which Yahweh your God gives them beyond the Jordan. Then you shall each return to his own possession, which I have given you.”

paite: Huai lai mah in Joshua bel, TOUPA na Pathian un huai kumpipa nihte tung athilhih tengteng na mit in amu vek a; huchi mah bang in na lutna ding gam tengteng tung ah TOUPA'N ahih ding hi.
english: I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, “Your eyes have seen all that Yahweh your God has done to these two kings. So shall Yahweh do to all the kingdoms where you go over.

paite: Amaute lau ke'n; hon doupihpa TOUPA na Pathian uh ahi ngal a," chi in thu ka pia hi.
english: You shall not fear them; for Yahweh your God himself fights for you.”

paite: "Huai lai mah in TOUPA ka ngen a,
english: I begged Yahweh at that time, saying,

paite: Toupa PATHIAN aw, na sikha kiang ah na thupidan leh na khut hattak na langsak ahi peuhmah ngei hi. Van ah hiam, lei ah hiam na thilhih bang leh na thilhih thupitak bang hihthei pathian kua a-om a?
english: “Lord Yahweh, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or in earth that can do works like yours, and mighty acts like yours?

paite: Hon galkahsak inla, Jordan gal a gam hoihtak, huai tang kilawmtak leh Lebanon hon musak in," ka chi hi.
english: Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that fine mountain, and Lebanon.”

paite: Himahleh noute ziak in ka tung ah TOUPA aheh mahmah a, ka thu angaikhe kei a; huchi in TOUPA'N, "Hunta hen, hiai thu ah hon houpih nawn ke'n," achi hi.
english: But Yahweh was angry with me because of you, and didn’t listen to me. Yahweh said to me, “That is enough! Speak no more to me of this matter.

paite: "Pisgah tang vum ah va paitou inla, tumlam, mallam, simlam leh suahlam na mit in en inla, en vialvial in. Jordan kan lou ding na hi.
english: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and see with your eyes; for you shall not go over this Jordan.

paite: Himahleh Joshua thu pia inla, hanthawn inla, hatsak in. Hiai mipite api galkai dia, na va muhtouh ding gam aluah ding uhi," ahon chi hi.
english: But commission Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.”

paite: Huchi in Beth-peor kiangchin a phaizang ah i omta uhi.
english: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, hiai thil tengteng na ma ua ka omsak, vualzawlna leh hamsiate na tung ua ahong tun a, TOUPA'N hon delhzakna nam tengteng lak a na theihkhiak nawn ua,
english: It shall happen, when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations where Yahweh your God has driven you,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian lam na ngat nawn ua, tua thu ka hon piak bang a nou leh na tate uh toh na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng ua a-aw na zuih hun chiang un.
english: and return to Yahweh your God and obey his voice according to all that I command you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un na sal hihna uh ahihmang dia, ahon hehpih dia, TOUPA na Pathian un nam chih lak a hon dalhsakna a pan hon pikhawm nawn ding hi.
english: that then Yahweh your God will release you from captivity, have compassion on you, and will return and gather you from all the peoples where Yahweh your God has scattered you.

paite: Na lak ua mi van nuai tawp pha a delhkhiak a-om uleh, TOUPA na Pathian un huai a pan hon pikhawm dia, huai a pan hon pikhe ding hi.
english: If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there Yahweh your God will gather you, and from there he will bring you back.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un na pi-le-pute un aluah gam ah hon pilut nawn dia, na luah ding uh. Ama'n hon lamzangsak dia, na pi-le-pute uh khup in hon pungsak ding hi.
english: Yahweh your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you will possess it. He will do you good, and increase your numbers more than your fathers.

paite: Na hintheihna ding ua TOUPA na Pathian uh na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng ua na it theihna ding un, TOUPA na Pathian un na lungtang uh leh na suante lungtang hon sumsak ding hi.
english: Yahweh your God will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your offspring, to love Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un hiai hamsia tengteng hon simmohte, na melmate uh leh hon hote túng ah atungsak ding hi.
english: Yahweh your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.

paite: Na hong kihei nawn ding ua, ToUPA aw na zui ding uà, tuni a thu ka hon piak, athupiak tengteng na zui ding uhi.
english: You shall return and obey Yahweh’s voice, and do all his commandments which I command you today.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un na khut ngakna tengteng uah, na gil ua gah ah, na ganhon gah uah leh na gam gah uah hoih atungsak dia, na pi-le-pute uh tung a akipah bang in na tung uah TOUPA akipak nawn ding hi.
english: Yahweh your God will make you prosperous in all the work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, for good; for Yahweh will again rejoice over you for good, as he rejoiced over your fathers,

paite: Hiai Dan Bu a tuang athupiakte, adante zui dia TOUPA aw na zuih ua, na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng ua TOUPA na Pathian uh lam na ngat phot uleh.
english: if you will obey Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, if you turn to Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

paite: Hiai thupiak, tua ka hon piak nou a ding in ahaksa lo kei a, gamlat leng hon gamlat kei hi.
english: For this commandment which I command you today is not too hard for you or too distant.

paite: I zak ua i zuihtheihna ding in, "Kua ahia van a hon kahsak a, hon laksak ding?" chih ding in van a om ahi kei hi.
english: It is not in heaven, that you should say, “Who will go up for us to heaven, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

paite: I zak ua i zuihtheihna ding in tuipi gal ah, "Kua'n ahia hon va hohsak dia, hon laksak ding?" chih ding in tuipi gal a om leng ahi sam kei.
english: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, “Who will go over the sea for us, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

paite: Na zuihtheihna ding un thu in ahon naih mahmah a, na kam uh leh na lungtang uah a-om hi.
english: But the word is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.

paite: "Tu in na ma uah hinna leh hoih, sihna leh hoih lou ka koih hi.
english: Behold, I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh it ding, alampi zui ding, athupiak, adan, avaihawm, zui dia tua ka hon thupiak na zuih uleh na hing ding ua, na hong pung ding ua, na va luah ding uh gam ah TOUPA na Pathian un hon vualzawl ding hi.
english: For I command you today to love Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, that you may live and multiply, and that Yahweh your God may bless you in the land where you go in to possess it.

paite: Himahleh na lungtang uh akiheimang a, na ngaihkhiak kei ua, pimang a na om ua, pathian dangte na biak ua, a-nna uh na sep uleh;
english: But if your heart turns away, and you will not hear, but are drawn away and worship other gods, and serve them,

paite: na mangthang ngeingei ding uh, chih tu in ka hon hilh ahi. Jordan lui kan a, luah ding a na va lutna gam uah na damsawt kei ding uhi.
english: I declare to you today that you will surely perish. You will not prolong your days in the land where you pass over the Jordan to go in to possess it.

paite: Na ma uah hinna leh sihna, vualzawlna leh hamsia ka koih chih tu a hon theihpih ding in lei leh van ka sam ahi. Huchi in hinna tel un, na hinna ding un nou leh na suante uh toh.
english: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh it in, a-aw zui in, amah len tinten un, amah na hinna uh, na damsawtna uh lah ahi ngal a. Huchi in na pu uh Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a kichiam a piak gam ah na teng ding uhi," achi hi.
english: to love Yahweh your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days, that you may dwell in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

paite: Huan Mosi in, Israel mite teng kiang ah hiai thu agen hi.
english: Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.

paite: “Tu in kum za-le-sawmnih ka hita a; ka vialvak zou nawn kei. TOUPA'N 'Hiai Jordan lui na kan kei ding,' ahon chi hi.
english: He said to them, “I am one hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. Yahweh has said to me, ‘You shall not go over this Jordan.’

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un na ma uh api dia, hiai namte ahon hihsiatsak dia, agam uh na luah ding uh. TOUPA'N ana gensa bang in Joshua in na ma uh api ding hi.
english: Yahweh your God himself will go over before you. He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua will go over before you, as Yahweh has spoken.

paite: TOUPA'N Amorte kumpipa, Sihon leh Og leh agam tung ua ahih bang in atung uah ahih dia; amaute ahihse ding hi.
english: Yahweh will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when he destroyed them.

paite: TOUPA'N amaute ahon pe dia, thu ka hon piak thupiak tengteng atung uah na hih ding uhi.
english: Yahweh will deliver them up before you, and you shall do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you.

paite: Kuhkaltak leh hangsantak in om un. Lau kei unla, kihta sam kei un. Na kiang ua hon pepa TOUPA na Pathian uh ahi ngal a. Ahon vuallelsak kei dia, pai leng hon paisan kei hial ding," achi hi.
english: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”

paite: Mosi in Joshua asam a, Israel mi tengteng mitmuh in akiang ah, "Hattak leh hangsantak in om in. Hiai mite toh akiang ua api-le-pute uh TOUPA'N kichiam a piak ana chiamsa gam ah na lut ngeingei ding ua, amaute na luahsak ding ahi.
english: Moses called to Joshua, and said to him in the sight of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you shall go with this people into the land which Yahweh has sworn to their fathers to give them; and you shall cause them to inherit it.

paite: Na ma uh pipa TOUPA ahi dia, na kiang ah a-om zel dia, ahon vuallelsak kei dia, pai leng hon paisan kei hial ding hi. Lau ke'nla, lunglel sam ke'n," achi hi.
english: Yahweh himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.”

paite: Mosi in dan agelh a, TOUPA thukhun bawm zawng Levi tapa siampute leh Israel upate tengteng apia hi.
english: Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests the sons of Levi, who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, and to all the elders of Israel.

paite: Mosi in, amau thu apia a, "Kum sagih kum, ngaihdam kum teng a Biakbuk Ankuangluina,
english: Moses commanded them, saying, “At the end of every seven years, in the set time of the year of release, in the feast of booths,

paite: mun aseh dia Israel mi tengteng TOUPA na Pathian uh ma a hong kilat chiang un, hiai dan Israel tengteng zak in na sim ding uh ahi.
english: when all Israel has come to appear before Yahweh your God in the place which he will choose, you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

paite: Mipite, numei leh pasal, na taneu chikchikte uh, na ompih uh gamdang mite, amau angaihkhiak ua, akisin ua, TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan asiam ua, hiai dan thu tengteng pilvangtak a azuihtheihna ding uh leh
english: Assemble the people, the men and the women and the little ones, and the foreigners who are within your gates, that they may hear, learn, fear Yahweh your God, and observe to do all the words of this law,

paite: atate uh athei nailoute'n leng azak ua, Jordan lui kan a na va luah ding uh gam a na ten sung teng ua TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan siam akisintheihna ding un samkhawm in," achi hi.
english: and that their children, who have not known, may hear and learn to fear Yahweh your God, as long as you live in the land where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Ngai in, na sih hun ahong naita; Joshua sam inla, kihoupihna biakbuk ah va kihil in, amau thu ka pe ding hi,” achi hi. Huchi in Mosi leh Joshua ahoh ua, kihoupihna biakbuk ah ava kihil uhi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, your days approach that you must die. Call Joshua, and present yourselves in the Tent of Meeting, that I may commission him.” Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the Tent of Meeting.

paite: TOUPA puanin ah meipi ding in akilak a; meipi ding puanın kongpl lutung ah adingh hi.
english: Yahweh appeared in the Tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood over the Tent’s door.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Ngai in, na pi-le-pute kiang ah na ihmu ding hi. Hiai mite athou ding ua, ava tenna dingte uh lak ah huai gam pathiante lak ah ang a kawm ding ua, ahon lehngatsan ding ua, ka thukhun akiang ua ka khun abohse ding uh.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, you shall sleep with your fathers. This people will rise up and play the prostitute after the strange gods of the land where they go to be among them, and will forsake me and break my covenant which I have made with them.

paite: Huchi in huai ni in atung uah ka heh dia, ka lehngatsan dia, ka kibuk mangsan dia, hihsiat in a-om ding uh. Thil hoih lou leh mangbatna tampi atung uah atung ding hi. Huchi in huai ni in, i Pathian uh i lak ua a-om louh ziak in hiai thil hoih lou i tung ua hong tung ahi kei maw? achi ding uh.
english: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall come on them; so that they will say in that day, ‘Haven’t these evils come on us because our God is not among us?’

paite: Pathian dangte lam nga a thil hoih lou ahih ding tengteng uh ziak in huai.ni in ka kibuksan ngeingei ding hi.
english: I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evil which they have done, in that they have turned to other gods.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in 'hiai la gelh inla, Israel suante sinsak inla, akam uah koih in. Hiai la Israel suante kalhna a kei a dia theihpihtu ahihtheihna ding in.
english: “Now therefore write this song for yourselves, and teach it to the children of Israel. Put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.

paite: Api-le-pute uh kiang a kichiam a ka chiam, nawitui leh khuaizu luang gam ah ka pi a, ne leh ta in a-om ua,.atai ua, ahong thau hial chiang un.pathian dangte lam anga ding ua, a-nna uh asem ding ua, kei hon hehsak ding ua, ka thukhun abohse ding uh'.
english: For when I have brought them into the land which I swore to their fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and they have eaten and filled themselves, and grown fat, then they will turn to other gods, and serve them, and despise me, and break my covenant.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, thil hoih lou leh mangbatna tampi atung ua ahong tun chiang in, hiai la akhelhna uh theihpihtu ahi ding. Asuante kam a pan mangngilh theih ahi kei ding hi. Tu in ka kichiam gam a ka pilut ma him in leng alunggel uh akawidan ka thei hi," achi hi.
english: It will happen, when many evils and troubles have come on them, that this song will testify before them as a witness; for it will not be forgotten out of the mouths of their descendants; for I know their ways and what they are doing today, before I have brought them into the land which I promised them.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in, huai la, huai ni mahmah in agelh a, Israel suante asinsak hi.
english: So Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it to the children of Israel.

paite: Nun tapa Joshua kiang ah hiai thupiak apia hi. "Hattak leh hangsantak in om in. Israel suante kiang a ka kichiam bang in huai gam ah na pilut ding hi. Na kiang ah ka om ding," achi hi.
english: He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun, and said, “Be strong and courageous; for you shall bring the children of Israel into the land which I swore to them. I will be with you.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Mosi in hiai dan thute laibu agelh khit a mansa ahih vek nung in,
english: When Moses had finished writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,

paite: TOUPA thukhun bawm zawng Levite Mosi in thu apia hi.
english: Moses commanded the Levites, who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, saying,

paite: "Hiai Dan Bu la unla, noute kalh a theihpihtu hi ding in TOUPA na Pathian uh thukhun bawm sik ah koih un.
english: “Take this book of the law, and put it by the side of the ark of Yahweh your God’s covenant, that it may be there for a witness against you.

paite: Na helhatdan uh leh na paupendan uh ka thei hi. Ngai un, tua ka hon dampih lai a bawn TOUPA tung a hel na hi ua; ka sih nung ngial in houh bangchi phet in anasazaw diam aw?
english: For I know your rebellion and your stiff neck. Behold, while I am yet alive with you today, you have been rebellious against Yahweh. How much more after my death?

paite: "Abil ua zak a hiai thu ka gen a, noute kalh a theihpihtu dia lei leh van ka saptheihna ding in na nam ua intekpen tengteng leh na heutute uh hon samkhawm un.
english: Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to witness against them.

paite: Ka sih nung in nakpitak in na kihihse ding ua, ka hon thupiak lampi a pan na pial ding uh chih ka thei kilkel hi. Atawp chiang ngial in houh thil hoih lou in hon buakkhum dia; na khut thilhih ua hihheh ding in TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou na hih ding ziak un," achi hi.
english: For I know that after my death you will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn away from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will happen to you in the latter days, because you will do that which is evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.”

paite: Mosi in, Israel kikhawmkhawm tengteng zak in hiai la thu abul a pan atawp pha in agen vek hi.
english: Moses spoke in the ears of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song, until they were finished.

paite: Bil na doh un, vante aw, ka gen ding hi. Lei aw, ka kam a thu za in.
english: Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.

paite: Vuahtui bang in ka thu azu ding a, Daitui bang in ka thugen atak ding. Loupa nou dipdip tung a vuah bang leh lounah tung a vuah phin bang in.
english: My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew, as the misty rain on the tender grass, as the showers on the herb.

paite: TOUPA min ka puan ding ziak in Thupina i Pathian pia un.
english: For I will proclaim Yahweh’s name. Ascribe greatness to our God!

paite: Amah suangpi ahi, Athilhih adik kim sipsip hi. A-omdan tengteng dan ahi. Pathian muanhuai, thulimlouhna nei lou, diktat leh hoih ahi.
english: The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.

paite: Amau leh amau akihihsia ua, atate ahi kei uh, gensiat alohna uh ahi, suan gina lou leh genhak ahi uhi.
english: They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his children, because of their defect. They are a perverse and crooked generation.

paite: Mihai leh pilloute aw, huchi in maw, TOUPA na thuk ding uh? Nou hon suang, na pa uh ahi kei maw? Ahon bawl a, ahon dingkipsak hi.
english: Is this the way you repay Yahweh, foolish and unwise people? Isn’t he your father who has bought you? He has made you and established you.

paite: Nidanglai nite theigige inla, suan tampi kumte ngaihtuah dih. Na pa dong in, ahon kawkmuh ding, na upate'n leng ahon hilh ding uhi.
english: Remember the days of old. Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders, and they will tell you.

paite: Tungnungpen in namte gam apiak lai a, mihing tate akhen lai in namte gamgi Israel suante zah in akhung hi.
english: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the children of men, he set the bounds of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel.

paite: TOUPA tantuan zaw amite ahi ua; Jakob lah agoutan ahi.
english: For Yahweh’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.

paite: Gamdai gam ah amu a, gamdai sia mau honhon ah, akim ua omkhum in akem a, Amit laivom bang in akem hi.
english: He found him in a desert land, in the waste howling wilderness. He surrounded him. He cared for him. He kept him as the apple of his eye.

paite: Muvanlai in abu a anou tokthou a, anou tung ah kha azap a, akhate azak a, atuah a, akha a apuak bang in;
english: As an eagle that stirs up her nest, that flutters over her young, he spread abroad his wings, he took them, he bore them on his feathers.

paite: Gamdang pathian hilou in TOUPA kia in api zel hi.
english: Yahweh alone led him. There was no foreign god with him.

paite: Lei mun sangte ah atuangsak a, lou a thil tung ane zel a; suangpi a pan khuaizu akikhohkhesak zel a, suang tak a pan thau toh;
english: He made him ride on the high places of the earth. He ate the increase of the field. He caused him to suck honey out of the rock, oil out of the flinty rock;

paite: Ganhon a pan nawitui khal, belamhon a pan nawitui, belamnou thau toh, Bashan uain na dawn ding.
english: butter from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the finest of the wheat. From the blood of the grape, you drank wine.

paite: Himahleh Jeshurun ahong thau a, ahong kipek a; na thau a, na sapha a, na maitai a; abawlpa Pathian alehngatsanta, hotdamna Suangpi angaineu hi.
english: But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned God who made him, and rejected the Rock of his salvation.

paite: Gamdang pathiante'n i Pathian mullitna atokthou a, thilkihhuai in ahehsak hi.
english: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods. They provoked him to anger with abominations.

paite: Pathian hilou, dawite kiang ah atheih ngei louh uh pathiante kiang ah, ahong khonung om phing pathian thakte, na pi, na pute un akihtak ngei louh uh kiang ah.
english: They sacrificed to demons, not God, to gods that they didn’t know, to new gods that came up recently, which your fathers didn’t dread.

paite: Nang hon suang Suangpi па ngaisang kei, nang hon bawlpa Pathian na mangngilh lai hi.
english: Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.

paite: Huai TOUPA'N amu a, amudah a, atanu leh tapate'n ahihheh ziak un.
english: Yahweh saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.

paite: Ka bukmang san dia, atawpna uh bang ahi dia chih ka en ding, achi hi. Suan thulim lou ginna nei lou tate ahi uhi.
english: He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.

paite: Pathian hilou thil in ka mullitna atokthou ua; athil gina lou un ahon hehsak uh; chi a genlouhte ka mullitsak dia, nam haite in ka hehsak ding hi.
english: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God. They have provoked me to anger with their vanities. I will move them to jealousy with those who are not a people. I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

paite: Ka hehna akuang a, gawtmun nuainungpen tan in akang a, lei leh athilpung akang ding, tangte kingaknate mei in akang ding hi.
english: For a fire is kindled in my anger, that burns to the lowest Sheol, devours the earth with its increase, and sets the foundations of the mountains on fire.

paite: Atung uah siatna ka chiangkhawm dia, atung uah thal ka khah ding.
english: “I will heap evils on them. I will spend my arrows on them.

paite: Gilkial in agongthak ding ua, meisa leh siatna in akangmang ding ua, atung uah gamsa hate ka sawl dia, leivui agulte gu toh.
english: They shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat and bitter destruction. I will send the teeth of animals on them, with the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.

paite: Nungak, tangval, nawi ne lai, lu a kelsam poute tanpha in polam ah namsau in asi ding ua, sunglam ah launa in.
english: Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.

paite: Ke'n, ka delhzak vek ding, mihing lak a amau theihgigena ka hihmang vek ding.
english: I said that I would scatter them afar. I would make their memory to cease from among men;

paite: Melma thangpaihna lau lou hi leng, amelmate un theikhial in, i khut uh tawisang in a-omta, huai teng TOUPA hih ahi kei, achi kha ding uhi, ka chi hi.
english: were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy, lest their adversaries should judge wrongly, lest they should say, ‘Our hand is exalted; Yahweh has not done all this.’”

paite: Pilna nei lou namte ahi ua, amau ah theihsiamna a-om kei.
english: For they are a nation void of counsel. There is no understanding in them.

paite: Aw, pil le uh hiaite atheisiam ding ua, atunung thu uh ngaihtuah ding hi ve un!
english: Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!

paite: Bangchi in khat in sang adelh dia, nih in sing ataikeksak ding ua, a Suangpi un amaute akhawng khinta hi, TOUPA'N amaute apiakkhiak kei ngalleh?
english: How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and Yahweh had delivered them up?

paite: Asuangpi uh lah i melmate mahmah theihdan in leng i Suangpi bang ahi kei hi.
english: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.

paite: Agrepgui uh Sodom grepgui ahi a, aloute uh Gomorrah loute ahi. Agrepte uh sinkha grepte ahi uh, agahbomte akha hi.
english: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison grapes. Their clusters are bitter.

paite: A-uainte uh dragon gu leh gulgial gu khatak ahi.
english: Their wine is the poison of serpents, the cruel venom of asps.

paite: Hiai ka kholkhawm, ka goubawm a bilh bikbek ahi kei maw?
english: “Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?

paite: Phulak leh thuk zaw kei hih ding ahi, asiksan uh ateu hun chiang in; asiatna ni uh ahong naita, atung ua thil hong tung dingte ahong tungpahta ding hi.
english: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, at the time when their foot slides, for the day of their calamity is at hand. Their doom rushes at them.”

paite: TOUPA'N amite avaihawm ding, asikhate leng alainat ding, athilhihtheihna uh abei chih leh kuamah sikha leh noplen a-om kei, chih amuh chiang in.
english: For Yahweh will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone, that there is no one remaining, shut up or left at large.

paite: Ama'n apathiante uh koi ah, amuan suangpi uh koi ah;
english: He will say, “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,

paite: akithoihna thau netute, adawn thillat uain dawntute? Hong thou in nou hong panpih uhenla, nou hon humbittute hi le uh ake, achi ding.
english: which ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you! Let them be your protection.

paite: Kei, kei mahmah ka hihthei unla, pathian dang a-om kei. Ka that a, ka hingsak a, ka liamsak a, ka damsak hi. Ka khut a pan noute hon hunkhe thei kuamah a-om kei uhi.
english: “See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand.

paite: Van lam ah ka khut ka zak a, keimah ka hin bang in ka kichiam hi.
english: For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare, as I live forever,

paite: Ka namsau tat-hiam a, ka khut a vaihawmna ka letleh ka melmate tung ah phu ka la dia, kei hon hote ka thuk ding hi.
english: if I sharpen my glittering sword, my hand grasps it in judgment; I will take vengeance on my adversaries, and will repay those who hate me.

paite: Ka thaltangte asisan uah ka diah dia, ka namsau in sa teng ka that bei dia; thahte leh salte sisan toh melmate tung a phulakna a kipan, achi ding hi.
english: I will make my arrows drunk with blood. My sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the head of the leaders of the enemy.”

paite: Aw, nou nam chihte aw, amite toh kipak un; asikhate sisan phuba ala ding hi. Amah doute tung ah phu ala ding, agam leh amite a ding in kilemna bukim abawl ding.
english: Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants. He will take vengeance on his adversaries, and will make atonement for his land and for his people.

paite: Huchi in mipite zak in Mosi leh Nun tapa, Joshua in hiai la thu tengteng agen uhi.
english: Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.

paite: "Mosi in huai thu tengteng Israel mi tengteng kiang a agen khit in, akiang uah;
english: Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel.

paite: Tua na kiang ua ka hon thu theihsak ah na lungtang uh koihkip unla, hiai dan tengteng pilvang mahmah a zui ding in na tate uh thu pia un.
english: He said to them, “Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you today, which you shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.

paite: Nou a ding in thil bangmah lou lel ahi kei a, na hinna uh ahi ngal a. Hiai thilhih in luah dia Jordan na va galkahna gam uah na damsawt ding uhi," achi hi.
english: For it is no vain thing for you, because it is your life, and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land, where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”

paite: Huai ni mah in TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses that same day, saying,

paite: "Moab gam a Jeriko zawn a Abarim tang dung a Nebo tang ah va hohtou inla, Israel suante luah dia ka piak Kanaan gam va gal-et in.
english: “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel for a possession.

paite: Na sanggampa Aaron Hor tang a si a, achipihte kiang a pi ahih tak mah bang in na kahtouh na tang ah na si dia, na chipihte kiang a pi na hita ding hi.
english: Die on the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor, and was gathered to his people;

paite: Zin gamdai a Meribah-kadesh tui munte a Israel suante lak a ka tung a na khelh ziak in leh Israel suante lak a na hon pahtawi louh ziak in.
english: because you trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because you didn’t uphold my holiness among the children of Israel.

paite: Tua gam na va galmuh dia; himahleh Israel suante ka piak gam ah na lut kei ding," achi hi.
english: For you shall see the land from a distance; but you shall not go there into the land which I give the children of Israel.”

paite: Hiai vualzawlna in ahi Pathian mipa Mosi in asih ma a Israel suante avualzawlna:
english: This is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.

paite: "Sinai a pan TOUPA ahong pai a, Seir a pan akiang uah athoukhia a, Paran tang a kipan hong vakkhia in, Mi Siangthou singkhat lak a pan ahong pai; akhut taklam a pan amau a ding in meikuang bang dan a-om.
english: He said, “Yahweh came from Sinai, and rose from Seir to them. He shone from Mount Paran. He came from the ten thousands of holy ones. At his right hand was a fiery law for them.

paite: Ahi, amite a-it a, Mi Siangthou tengteng na khut ah a-om uh. Na khebul ah atu ua; na thute azui chiat ding uh.
english: Yes, he loves the people. All his saints are in your hand. They sat down at your feet. Each receives your words.

paite: Mosi in eite dan ahon pia, Jakob mipite gouluah ding.
english: Moses commanded us a law, an inheritance for the assembly of Jacob.

paite: "Jeshurun ah amah kumpipa ahi, mipite intekpen leh Israel chi tengteng a-omkhawm lai un.”
english: He was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people were gathered, all the tribes of Israel together.

paite: "Reuben hing hen, si lou in, amite ahihleh tawm kei uhen."
english: “Let Reuben live, and not die; Nor let his men be few.”

paite: "Hiai Judah vualzawlna ahi. TOUPA Judah aw ngaikhia inla, amite kiang ah pilut in. Amah a ding in akhut kiching henla, nang amelmate doupihpa hi in."
english: This is for Judah. He said, “Hear, Yahweh, the voice of Judah. Bring him in to his people. With his hands he contended for himself. You shall be a help against his adversaries.”

paite: Levi tungthu ah, "Na Thummim leh na Urim, na misiangthou kiang ah omsak in, Massah ah na ze-et a, Meribah tuite ah na dou hi;
english: About Levi he said, “Your Thummim and your Urim are with your godly one, whom you proved at Massah, with whom you contended at the waters of Meribah.

paite: ka nu leh ka pa ka thei kei, chi in; a-unaute leng athei sam kei hi. Amah tate ngei leng athei tuan kei; na thu apom ua, na thukhun azui ngal ua.
english: He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’ He didn’t acknowledge his brothers, nor did he know his own children; for they have observed your word, and keep your covenant.

paite: Na vaihawmte Jakob asinsak ding ua, Israelte, na dan. Na ma ah gimlim akoih ding ua, na maitam ah halmang thillat.
english: They shall teach Jacob your ordinances, and Israel your law. They shall put incense before you, and whole burnt offering on your altar.

paite: Aneihte vualzawl in, TOUPA, akhut nasepte ana pom inla; amah doute kawng sat inla, amah hote kawng toh, adin nawnlouhna ding un."
english: Yahweh, bless his skills. Accept the work of his hands. Strike through the hips of those who rise up against him, of those who hate him, that they not rise again.”

paite: Benjamin tungthu ah zaw, "TOUPA deihtak zaw akiang ah bit in ateng ding. Nitum in amah akhuh dia, aliangte kikal ah ateng ding."
english: About Benjamin he said, “The beloved of Yahweh will dwell in safety by him. He covers him all day long. He dwells between his shoulders.”

paite: Joseph tungthu ah zaw, "Agam TOUPA vualzawl in om hen, van thil mantam daitui in, tui thuk mahmah nuailam a tui in.
english: About Joseph he said, “His land is blessed by Yahweh, for the precious things of the heavens, for the dew, for the deep that couches beneath,

paite: Nisa in apiansak gah manphate leh khapi in a-omsak thil mantamte in.
english: for the precious things of the fruits of the sun, for the precious things that the moon can yield,

paite: "Nidanglai tangte athil deihhuaipente in, tangtawn mual a thil mantamte in.
english: for the best things of the ancient mountains, for the precious things of the everlasting hills,

paite: Lei leh atung a thil mantamte in, loubuk a ompa deihsakna in. Vualzawlna Joseph lutung ah hong om hen, a-unaute a pan hihtuam a ompa lusip ah.
english: for the precious things of the earth and its fullness, the good will of him who lived in the bush. Let this come on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who was separated from his brothers.

paite: Athupina bawngtal piang masa thupina bang ahi a, akiite gam bawngtal kiite bang ahi. Huai in nam chih asi a, kawlmong tan in asi ding. Amaute Ephraim singkhatte ahi ua, Manasseh sangte ahi uhi."
english: Majesty belongs to the firstborn of his herd. His horns are the horns of the wild ox. With them he will push all the peoples to the ends of the earth. They are the ten thousands of Ephraim. They are the thousands of Manasseh.”

paite: Zebulun tungthu ah, "Kipak in, Zebulun, na vakkhiaknate ah, Issakar, na puaninte ah.
english: About Zebulun he said, “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out; and Issachar, in your tents.

paite: Tang ah chi chih asam ding ua, huai ah diktatna kithoihnate alan ding uh. Tuipi buchinna ne ding ahi ngal ua, piaunel a gou kiselte toh," achi hi.
english: They will call the peoples to the mountain. There they will offer sacrifices of righteousness, for they will draw out the abundance of the seas, the hidden treasures of the sand.”

paite: Gad tungthu ah, "Gad hihlianpa phat in om hen, humpinelkai bang in ateng a, aluzang leh aban ahamkek hi."
english: About Gad he said, “He who enlarges Gad is blessed. He dwells as a lioness, and tears the arm and the crown of the head.

paite: "Amah a ding in ahoihna pen atel a, dan pepa tantuan mun a amah atut ziak in, intekpente toh ahoh a, TOUPA vaihawmna dik leh Israelte kiang a vaihawmnate azui hi."
english: He provided the first part for himself, for the lawgiver’s portion was reserved for him. He came with the heads of the people. He executed the righteousness of Yahweh, His ordinances with Israel.”

paite: Dan tungthu ah, "Dan zaw humpinelkai nou ahi a, Bashan a pan ahong tawm ding."
english: About Dan he said, “Dan is a lion’s cub that leaps out of Bashan.”

paite: Naphtali tungthu ah, "Naphtali aw, deihsakna a lungkim, TOUPA vualzawlna a tai, sim leh tum luah in."
english: About Naphtali he said, “Naphtali, satisfied with favor, full of Yahweh’s blessing, Possess the west and the south.”

paite: Asher tungthu ah, "Asher tapate a vualzawl in om henla, a-unaute lak ah tuitum henla; thau ah akhete diah hen.
english: About Asher he said, “Asher is blessed with children. Let him be acceptable to his brothers. Let him dip his foot in oil.

paite: Na khedap sik leh dal ahi dia, na damsung ni bang in na hatna leng a-om ding."
english: Your bars will be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength will be.

paite: "Jeshurun Pathian nang hon panpih dia van a tuang, thupitak a van a tuang bang kua mahmah a-om kei uhi.
english: “There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens for your help, in his excellency on the skies.

paite: Tangtawn Pathian na kibukna ahi a, nuailam ah atangtawn ban a-om, melmate ahon satmang dia, hihmang in, achi ding hi.
english: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’

paite: "Israel bel galmuangtak in amah kia in ateng dia, Jakob tui leh buh leh uain gam ah a-om ding, avante'n leng daitui akesak ding uhi.
english: Israel dwells in safety, the fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of grain and new wine. Yes, his heavens drop down dew.

paite: Na hampha hi, aw, Israel, nangmah bang a TOUPA'N ahotdam mite kua a-om a? Nang hon panpihpa phaw, na thupina namsau ahi! Na melmate nang ah ahong kipe ding ua, nang amun sangte uh na tuanchil ding hi.”
english: You are happy, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by Yahweh, the shield of your help, the sword of your excellency? Your enemies will submit themselves to you. You will tread on their high places.”

paite: Huan Moab Phaizang a pan Jeriko zawn a Nebo tang, Pisgah tang vum ah Mosi ahohtou a; TOUPA'N Gilead gam tengteng, Dan pha in a-ensak hi.
english: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is opposite Jericho. Yahweh showed him all the land of Gilead to Dan,

paite: Naphtali leh Ephraim gam tengteng, Manasseh leh Judia gam tengteng, atumlam tuipi pha in.
english: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, to the Western Sea,

paite: Sim gam leh tum khopi Jeriko Phaizang, Zoar pha in.
english: and the south, and the Plain of the valley of Jericho the city of palm trees, to Zoar.

paite: TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Hiai gam ahi Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a, 'Na suante ka pe ding,' chi a kichiam a ka na chiam. Muh ahihleh ka hon musak peuhmah a, himahleh huai ah na pai kei ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to him, “This is the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’ I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over there.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA sikha Mosi, TOUPA thu bang in Moab gam ah asita hi.
english: So Moses the servant of Yahweh died there in the land of Moab, according to Yahweh’s word.

paite: Beth-peor zawn a Moab gam phaizang ah avui a; himahleh tuni tan in kuamah in ahan athei kei uh.
english: He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor, but no man knows where his tomb is to this day.

paite: Mosi asih in kum za-le-sawmnih a upa ahi; amit amial kei a, atha leng akiam tuan kei hi.
english: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.

paite: Israel suante'n Moab Phaizang ah ni sawmthum Mosi akah ua, huchi in Mosi suun a, akah nite uh hong beita hi.
english: The children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended.

paite: Mosi in atung a, akhut akoih ziak in Nun tapa Joshua pilna kha in adim a; Israel suante'n athu azui ua, TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in ahih uhi.
english: Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. The children of Israel listened to him, and did as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Huai nung in Israelte lak ah Mosi bang a TOUPA'N kimaituah a ahoupih zawlnei himhim a-omta kei;
english: Since then, there has not arisen a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom Yahweh knew face to face,

paite: chiamtehna leh thillamdang tengteng, Pharaoh leh asikha tengteng kiang leh Aigupta gam tengteng a-ensak a,
english: in all the signs and the wonders which Yahweh sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

paite: khut hattak leh lauhuai pipi a Israel mi teng mitmuh a Mosi in ahih bang hih a-om kei uhi.
english: and in all the mighty hand, and in all the awesome deeds, which Moses did in the sight of all Israel.

paite: Huaiziak in Israelte aw, TOUPA na pi-le-pute uh Pathian in hon piak gam, dam a na luahtheihna ding ua na zuih ding uh ka hon hilh dante leh vaihawmte ngaikhia un.
english: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them, that you may live and go in and possess the land which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, gives you.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiak ka hon piak na zuihtheihna ding un, ka hon thupiak na behlap ding uh ahi kei a, na kiamsak ding uh leng ahi sam kei.
english: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of Yahweh your God which I command you.

paite: Baal-peor a TOUPA thilhih na mit un na mu ua; Baal-peor bemi tengteng TOUPA na Pathian un na lak ua pan ahihmangta hi.
english: Your eyes have seen what Yahweh did because of Baal Peor; for Yahweh your God has destroyed all the men who followed Baal Peor from among you.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh lenkip peuhmahte bel tutan in dam in a-om lai chiat uhi.
english: But you who were faithful to Yahweh your God are all alive today.

paite: Ngai un, na va luah ding gam ua leng na zuih zel ding un TOUPA ka Pathian in thu ahon piak bang geih in dante leh vaihawmte ka hon hilh hi.
english: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as Yahweh my God commanded me, that you should do so in the middle of the land where you go in to possess it.

paite: Hiai dan leh dan thuseh tengteng za a, "Hiai nam thupi, apil leh atheisiam mite ahi taktak uh," chi ding namte kiang a hiai in na pilna uh leh na theihsiamna uh lak ding ahih ziak in pilvangtak in hiaite zui un.
english: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”

paite: I sap peuhmah chiang ua TOUPA i Pathian in ahon naih bang a amau naih zel pathian nei nam thupi kua a-om ua?
english: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to them as Yahweh our God is whenever we call on him?

paite: Hichitak a dik, dan leh vaihawmna, tua na ma ua ka khun tengteng bang dan nei nam thupi dang kua a-om a?
english: What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?

paite: Bang teng hi heh, pilvang unla, ngenteltak in kikem phot un. Huchi lou in zaw na mit un athil muhte na mangngilh ding ua, na damsung un na lungtang ua pan amang kha ding hi. Na tate uh leh na tute uh sinsak un.
english: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your children and your children’s children—

paite: Horeb tang a TOUPA na Pathian uh ma a na din ua, TOUPA'N ka kiang a, "Mite hon sapkhawmsak in, leitung a a-om sung teng ua hon kihtakdan akisintheihna ding uh leh atate uh sinsak ding in ka thute ka hon zasak ding, ahon chih ni na mangngilh kha ding uhi," achi hi.
english: the day that you stood before Yahweh your God in Horeb, when Yahweh said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.”

paite: Huchi in na hong naih ua, huai tangbul ah na hong dingh uhi. Huai lai in meikuang in van sun zen in huai tang akang a, meipi vom leh mial in akhuh lai hi.
english: You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.

paite: TOUPA'N meikuang a pan ahon houpih a; athugen na za ua, himahleh lim bangmah na mu kei ua, aw ging lel na za uhi.
english: Yahweh spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; you only heard a voice.

paite: Athukhun zui dia nou thu ahon piak, thupiak sawm na kiang uah agenkhia a, suangpek nih ah agelh hi.
english: He declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments. He wrote them on two stone tablets.

paite: Huai lai in luah dia na va galkahna gam ua na zuih ding un dante leh vaihawmte sinsak ding in TOUPA'N thu ahon pia hi.
english: Yahweh commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.

paite: Huaiziak in pilvang mahmah un. Horeb tang a meikuang a pan TOUPA'N nou hon houpih ni in lim bangmah na mu kei uhi.
english: Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that Yahweh spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,

paite: Nou leh nou kihihsia in, milim gelh kibawl in, lim kibatpih, apa lim hiam, anu lim hiam,
english: lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

paite: leitung a om gamsa kibatpih, huihkhua a leng kha nei vasa kibatpih,
english: the likeness of any animal that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the sky,

paite: lei a vak thilte kibatpih, lei nuai a tui a om ngasa mawngmawng kibatpih na kibawl kha ding uhi.
english: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;

paite: Van lam na nga un, ni, kha, aksite, van a om tengteng leng na mu un, TOUPA na Pathian un van nuai a mi tengteng ahon sehsakte un hon hip in, hiaite bia in a-nna uh na sepsak kha ding uh.
english: and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of the sky, you are drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which Yahweh your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky.

paite: TOUPA'N amite, agou hi ding in sik haltuina a pan, Aigupta gam a pan nou ahon pikhe zawta ahi; tu a na hih mah bang un.
english: But Yahweh has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as it is today.

paite: Hiai kia leng hilou in, noute ziak in ka tung ah TOUPA aheh a, Jordan lui ka galkah louh a, na luah ding ua gam hoihtak TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak a ka lutlouhna ding in leng akichiam hi.
english: Furthermore Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in to that good land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance;

paite: Kei zaw hiai gam a si ding ka hi a, Jordan lui gal kah lou ding ka hi. Nou bel na galkah ding ua, hiai gam hoihtak na luah ding uhi,
english: but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan, but you shall go over and possess that good land.

paite: Pilvang mahmah un, TOUPA na Pathian uh thukhun, na kiang ua akhun na mangngilh ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian un akibatpih himhim bawl aphal louh milimte na kibawltawm kha mahmah ding uh.
english: Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which Yahweh your God has forbidden you.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh katmang hat mei, mullit hat Pathian ahi.
english: For Yahweh your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.

paite: Tu leh tate na neih ua, huai gam a sawt kuam na ten nung ua, na kineksiat louh ua, banghiam akibatpih peuh a milim bawltawm lelte na bawlkhiak ua, hihheh dia TOUPA na Pathian uh mitmuh a thil hoih lou na hih maizen uleh;
english: When you father children and children’s children, and you have been long in the land, and then corrupt yourselves, and make a carved image in the form of anything, and do that which is evil in Yahweh your God’s sight to provoke him to anger,

paite: Jordan kan a na va luah ding uh gam a pan na mangthang pah ding uh, chih na tungtang thu ua hon theihpih ding in tu in lei leh van ka chial ahi. Sawt na teng kei ding ua, na mangthang vek mai ding uh.
english: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that you will soon utterly perish from off the land which you go over the Jordan to possess it. You will not prolong your days on it, but will utterly be destroyed.

paite: TOUPA'N mite lak ah hon dalhsak dia, TOUPA'N hon paimangsakna namte lak ah tawmchik kia na teng ding uh.
english: Yahweh will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where Yahweh will lead you away.

paite: Huai ah, sing leh suang a abawl uh pathiante, mu thei lou peuh, za thei lou peuh, ne thei lou peuh, dik thei lou peuh na be ding uh.
english: There you will serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

paite: Himahleh huai lai mah a TOUPA na Pathian uh na zon ua, na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng ua na zon uleh na mu ding uh.
english: But from there you shall seek Yahweh your God, and you will find him when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.

paite: Haksa a na om ua, na tung ua hiai thil tengteng ahong tun chiang in, TOUPA na Pathian uh lam na hong nga khongkhong ding ua, athu na zuita ding uhi.
english: When you are in oppression, and all these things have come on you, in the latter days you shall return to Yahweh your God and listen to his voice.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh lah zahngaihna a dim Pathian ahi ngal a; ahon donsak lou kei dia, ahon hihmang kei ding. Na pi-le-pute uh kiang a kichiam a athukhun amangngilh het kei ding hi.
english: For Yahweh your God is a merciful God. He will not fail you nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.

paite: Na om ma uh, nidanglaite sui le uchin leitung a Pathian in mihing asiam nungsiah van nuai ah, hichibang a thil thupi a-om ngei in, zak ahi ngei hia?
english: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from the one end of the sky to the other, whether there has been anything as great as this thing is, or has been heard like it?

paite: Na zak bang un, mei a pan Pathian aw mi'n aza ngei mawngmawng in, ahing uhia?
english: Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?

paite: Namdang lak a pan khemna, chiamtehna, thillamdang, kidouna, khut hattak, ban zak, thil mulkimhuai a TOUPA na Pathian un na mitmuh ua Aigupta gam a ahih tengteng bang a nam pikhe ngam Pathian a-om ngei hia?
english: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that Yahweh your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

paite: TOUPA amah tuh Pathian ahi, chih na theihtheihna ding ua na kiang ua hihlat ahi a; amah lou ngal adang a-om kei.
english: It was shown to you so that you might know that Yahweh is God. There is no one else besides him.

paite: Ahon sinsak theihna ding in van a pan a-aw hon zasak a, leitung ah ameikuang thupi ahon musak a, meikuang a pan athu na za uhi.
english: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you. On earth he made you to see his great fire; and you heard his words out of the middle of the fire.

paite: Na pi-le-pute uh a-it ziak in anung ua asuante uh ahon tel a, amitmuh in athilhihtheihna thupitak in Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhia hi.
english: Because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their offspring after them, and brought you out with his presence, with his great power, out of Egypt;

paite: Namdang nou sang a thupi leh thilhihtheizaw ahon delhkhiaksak a, agam uh hon luahsak a, tua na hih mah bang un hon lutsak hi.
english: to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is today.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in na lungtang un vom unla, tunglam van ah leh nuailam lei ah TOUPA zaw Pathian ahi, chih thei un. Adang himhim kuamah a-om kei hi.
english: Know therefore today, and take it to heart, that Yahweh himself is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no one else.

paite: Tangtawn a dia TOUPA na Pathian un nou ahon piak gam ah noumau leh na suante uh a dia hoih ding leh na ten sawttheihna ding un, adante leh athupiakte, tua ka hon piakte na zuih ding uh ahi.
english: You shall keep his statutes and his commandments which I command you today, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which Yahweh your God gives you for all time.

paite: Huchi in Mosi in Jordan gal, nisuahna lam pang ah khopi thum asep hi.
english: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise,

paite: Tualthatmi, a-invengte, tuma lam a leng mudah khol lou, mi that kha humbitna ding in, hiai khua khatpeuh peuh a, atailutleh humbit in a-om ding.
english: that the man slayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unintentionally and didn’t hate him in time past, and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:

paite: Huai khuate hiaite ahi uh: Reubente gam a Bezer khopi; Gadte gam Gilead a Ramoth khopi leh Manassehte gam Bashan a Golan ahi uhi.
english: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.

paite: Mosi in Israel suante apiak, dan hiai ahi.
english: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.

paite: Hiaite Mosi piak theihsaknate, dan thusehte leh dante ahi. Huai bel Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawtkhiak lai uleh,
english: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they came out of Egypt,

paite: Sihon gam, Jordan lui suahlam a Beth-peor kiang phaizang a, a-om lai ua apiak ahi. Sihon bel Amorte kumpipa, Heshbon a vaihawmpa, Mosi leh Israelte'n Aigupta a pan ahong paikhiak lai ua azohpa uh ahi.
english: beyond the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel struck when they came out of Egypt.

paite: Amau Sihon gam leh Bashan kumpipa Og gam aluah uhi. Amau nihte Jordan lui suahlam a Amor kumpipa nihte ahi uhi.
english: They took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;

paite: Hiai gam ahihleh Arnon Phaizang gei a Aroer a pan Sion tang, Hermon leng achih uh, pha a kizalh ahi. Sion tang in min dang anei a, Hermon ahi.
english: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Siyon (also called Hermon),

paite: Huai gam in Jordan lui suahlam a Arabah luipiau tengteng, Pisgah tang a tui nakte nuai a Arabah tuipi tan ahuap hi.
english: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.

paite: Huan Mosi in Israel tengteng asamkhawm a, akiang uah: Israel mite aw, na sin ua na zuih ding uh dante, vaihawmte tuni a na bil ua na zak ua ka gen ngaikhia un.
english: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears today, that you may learn them, and observe to do them.”

paite: TOUPA Pathian in Horeb ah eite toh kikal ah thu akhung hi.
english: Yahweh our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

paite: TOUPA'N hiai thu i pi-le-pute kiang ah ana khung kei a, eite, tutan a hingdam a om lai tengteng kiang ah ahi, akhun zawk.
english: Yahweh didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive today.

paite: TOUPA'N tang ah mei a pan kimaituah in hon houpih a,
english: Yahweh spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,

paite: huai lai in TOUPA thu nou hon kawkmuh ding in TOUPA toh na kikal uah ka dingh a; meikuang ziak in lah na lau ngal ua, tang ah na hohtou kei uhi.
english: (I stood between Yahweh and you at that time, to show you Yahweh’s word; for you were afraid because of the fire, and didn’t go up onto the mountain) saying,

paite: Kei TOUPA Pathian, Aigupta gam a saltanna inn a pan hon pikhepa ka hi.
english: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

paite: Ka ma ah keimah lou ngal pathian dangte na nei ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall have no other gods before me.

paite: Milim bawltawm, tunglam van a om hiam, nuailam lei a om hiam, lei nuailam a tui a om hiam, akoi batpih mahmah na kibawl ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not make a carved image for yourself—any likeness of what is in heaven above, or what is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.

paite: Huaite ma ah na kun ding uh ahi kei a, a-nna uh leng na sem ding uh ahi ahi kei. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh Pathian mullit hat, pate khelhna ziak a tate gawt zel, hon mudahte suan thumna leh suan lina tan a gawt zel leh;
english: You shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, Yahweh your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children and on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me

paite: ahon itte, ka thupiakte zuimi sang tampite tung a hehpihna langsak zel ka hi.
english: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian min na lou mawkmawk ding ahi kei. TOUPA'N amin lou mawkmawkte lah moh lou in akhah ngal kei ding hi.
english: “You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God; for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian in thu hon piak bang in Sabbath ni tang siangthou in.
english: “Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as Yahweh your God commanded you.

paite: Ni guk sung nna na sem dia, nna tengteng na sem ding ahi.
english: You shall labor six days, and do all your work;

paite: Ani sagih ni, TOUPA na Pathian a ding in Sabbath ni ahi. Huai ni in nang, na tapa, na tanu, na sikhapa, na sikhanu, na bawngtal, na sabiltung, na gante uh lak a akoi mahmah in leng, na inn a gamdang mite'n leng nna himhim asem ding uh ahi kei. Nangmah bang in na sikhapate, na sikhanute leng akhawl ding uh ahi.
english: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God, in which you shall not do any work—neither you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates; that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.

paite: Nang leng Aigupta gam ah sikha na hi khin a, TOUPA na Pathian in huai a pan khut hat leh ban zak a, hon pikhiak na hi, chih theigige in. Huaiziak in ahi, TOUPA na Pathian in Sabbath ni tang dia thu ahon piak.
english: You shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and Yahweh your God brought you out of there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm. Therefore Yahweh your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian in thu ahon piak bang in na nu leh na pa zahtak in. Huchi in TOUPA'N gam ahon piak ah lamzang in, na damsawt ding hi.
english: “Honor your father and your mother, as Yahweh your God commanded you, that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

paite: Tual na that ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not murder.

paite: Ang na kawm ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not commit adultery.

paite: Na gu ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not steal.

paite: Na invengte tung ah theihpih taklou in na pang ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

paite: "Na invengte zi na eng ding ahi kei, na invengte inn hiam, alou hiam, asikhapa hiam, asikhanu hiam, abawngtal hiam, asabiltung hiam, na invengte thil bangmah na eng ding ahi kei," achi hi.
english: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. Neither shall you desire your neighbor’s house, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor’s.”

paite: Hiai thute tang a mei, meipi leh mial sah bikbek a pan TOUPA'N aw ngaihtak in na vek ua kikhawmte kiang ah agen a, abehlap nawn tuan kei hi. Huaite suangpek nih a gelh in, kei kiang ah hon pia hi.
english: Yahweh spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice. He added no more. He wrote them on two stone tablets, and gave them to me.

paite: Tang akat lai a, mial a pan aw na zak un, hichi ahong hi a, na nam ua intekpen teng leh na upate un hon naih uhen.
