english: When you heard the voice out of the middle of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you came near to me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

paite: Nou ngai in, "TOUPA i Pathian in i kiang uah athupidan leh aletdan alangsak a, mei a pan a-aw i za uh. Pathian in mihing ahoupih a leng na sih tuanlouhdan uh tuni in na theita uhi.
english: and you said, “Behold, Yahweh our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire. We have seen today that God does speak with man, and he lives.

paite: Huaiziak in bangziak a si ding i hi ua? Hiai meikuang thupitak in hon kangmang mai ding. TOUPA i Pathian aw i zak nawnleh zaw i si mai ding uhi.
english: Now therefore, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear Yahweh our God’s voice any more, then we shall die.

paite: Meikuang a pan Pathian hing aw i zak bang a za sam a lah hing ngal mihing tengteng lak ah kua a-om a?
english: For who is there of all flesh who has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as we have, and lived?

paite: Nang va naih inla, TOUPA i Pathian in agen ding tengteng va ngaikhe dih ve. TOUPA i Pathian in na kiang a, agen tengteng kou kiang ah na gen dia; huchi in ka na ngaikhe ding ua, ka zui ding uh," na chi uhi.
english: Go near, and hear all that Yahweh our God shall say, and tell us all that Yahweh our God tells you; and we will hear it, and do it.”

paite: N'on houpih lai ua na thugen uh TOUPA'N ana za a; huchi in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Hiai mipite'n na kiang a thu agen uh ka na za a; athugen tengteng uh agen hoih uhi.
english: Yahweh heard the voice of your words when you spoke to me; and Yahweh said to me, “I have heard the voice of the words of this people which they have spoken to you. They have well said all that they have spoken.

paite: Huchibang lungsim pu gige le uh aw, laudan ahong siam ding ua, ka thupiak azui gige ding ua, amau leh atate uh tangtawn in alamzang ding uhi.
english: Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear me and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them and with their children forever!

paite: Pai inla, apuanin ua kik nawn ding in amaute hilh in.
english: “Go tell them, ‘Return to your tents.’

paite: Himahleh aluah ding ua ka piak ding gam a azuih ding ua na sinsak ding thupiak, dan thuseh leh dante tengteng ka hon piaktheihna ding in nang zaw hiai ah om tadih in,” achi hi.
english: But as for you, stand here by me, and I will tell you all the commandments, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess.”

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA na Pathian un thu ahon piak bang a hih ding in pilvang un. Taklam ah hiam, veilam ah hiam na pial ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall observe to do therefore as Yahweh your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to the left.

paite: Na va luah ding uh gam a na hin ua, na lamzanna ding uh leh na ten sawttheihna ding un, TOUPA na Pathian un thu hon piak lampi na zuih tawnsuak ding uh ahi.
english: You shall walk in all the way which Yahweh your God has commanded you, that you may live and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.

paite: Luah dia na va galkahna gam ua na zuih ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian un noute hon sinsak dia thu ahon piak, thupiak, dan thuseh leh dan hiaite ahi uh.
english: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh your God commanded to teach you, that you might do them in the land that you go over to possess;

paite: Huai bel nou leh na tapate uh leh na tupate un TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan na siam ua, na damsung teng ua adan leh athupiak ka hon piak tengteng na zuihna ding uh leh na hong ten sawttheihna ding uh ahi.
english: that you might fear Yahweh your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you—you, your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.

paite: Huaiziak in Israel mite aw, lamzang a TOUPA, na pi-le-pute uh Pathian in hon kamchiam bang a nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam a nakpitak a na hong puntheihna ding un, ngaikhia unla, zui ding in pilvang un.
english: Hear therefore, Israel, and observe to do it, that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised to you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.

paite: Israel mite aw, ngaikhia un, TOUPA na Pathian uh kia TOUPA ahi.
english: Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is one.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh na lungtang tengteng un, na lungsim tengteng un, na hatna tengteng un na it ding uh ahi.
english: You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.

paite: Hiai thu, tuni a ka hon piak na lungtang uah ataam gige ding a;
english: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;

paite: na tate uh phatuamngaitak in na sinsak ding ua, na inn ua na tut lai un, lampi a na pai lai un, na lup lai un leh na thoh chiang bang un na gen ding uh ahi.
english: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.

paite: Chiamtehna ding in na ban uah na vial ding ua, na mit kikal uah talgakna ding in a-om ding ahi.
english: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

paite: Na inn kongkhak biang leh na kongkhak uah na gelh ding uhi.
english: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian un na pu uh Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a kichiam a ahon piak gam, na bawlkhiak uh hi het lou,
english: It shall be, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you, great and goodly cities which you didn’t build,

paite: kho thupi leh kilawm taktakte, na hihdim uh hi het lou, thil hoih chiteng a dim innte, na leh uh hi het lou tuikhuk lehsate, na suan uh hi het lou grephuan leh olive singte omna a hon pilut a, na nek ua na tai chiang un, pilvang mahmah un.
english: and houses full of all good things which you didn’t fill, and cisterns dug out which you didn’t dig, vineyards and olive trees which you didn’t plant, and you shall eat and be full;

paite: Huchi lou in zaw Aigupta gam a saltanna inn a pan hon pikhia TOUPA na mangngilh kha mahmah ding uhi.
english: then beware lest you forget Yahweh, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan na siam ding ua, ama nna na sem ding ua, amin lou in na kichiam ding uh ahi.
english: You shall fear Yahweh your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.

paite: pathian dangte na zui ding uh ahi kei, na kim ua mite pathiante na be ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples who are around you,

paite: Na lak ua TOUPA na Pathian uh zaw Pathian mullit hat ahi; TOUPA na Pathian uh na tung uah aheh dia, lei a pan hon hihmang kha ding hi.
english: for Yahweh your God among you is a jealous God, lest the anger of Yahweh your God be kindled against you, and he destroy you from off the face of the earth.

paite: Massah a na ze-et bang un TOUPA na Pathian uh na ze-et ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not tempt Yahweh your God, as you tempted him in Massah.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak, athupiakte, athu theihsakte leh adante pilvangtak in na zui ding uh.
english: You shall diligently keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh a dik leh hoih na hih ding uh ahi. Huchi in nou a ding in ahoih dia, TOUPA'N na pi-le-pute uh kiang a, achiam gam hoih a lut in, na luah thei ding uhi.
english: You shall do that which is right and good in Yahweh’s sight, that it may be well with you and that you may go in and possess the good land which Yahweh swore to your fathers,

paite: TOUPA'N agensa bang in, na ma ua kipan na melma tengteng uh ahawlkhe ding hi.
english: to thrust out all your enemies from before you, as Yahweh has spoken.

paite: Na tate un, "TOUPA i Pathian un thu hon piak, athu theihsaknate, dante, dan thusehte, bangchidan ahia?" chi a tunung lam chiang a ahon dot chiang un,
english: When your son asks you in time to come, saying, “What do the testimonies, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh our God has commanded you mean?”

paite: nou na tate uh kiang ah, "Aigupta gam ah Pharaoh sikha i na hi ua, TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan khut hattak in hon pikhia hi.
english: then you shall tell your son, “We were Pharaoh’s slaves in Egypt. Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand;

paite: TOUPA'N i mitmuh un Aigupta gam tung ah, Pharaoh tung ah, a-inkuanpih tengteng tung ah, chiamtehna leh thillamdang, thupi leh huaise mahmahte amusak hi.
english: and Yahweh showed great and awesome signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;

paite: Eite bel hon pe dia i pi-le-pute kiang a piak ding chi a akichiam gam hon piaktheihna ding in huai gam a pan hon pikhia hi.
english: and he brought us out from there, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.

paite: Huchi in hiai dan tengteng zui ding leh i hoih tawntungna dia TOUPA i Pathian laudan siam ding in TOUPA'N thu hon pia a, tuni a mihing a hon hawitheihna ding in.
english: Yahweh commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Yahweh our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as we are today.

paite: Athu hon piak bang a TOUPA ma a thupiak tengteng zui dia i pilvanleh ei a ding in damna ahi ding," na chi ding uhi.
english: It shall be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all these commandments before Yahweh our God, as he has commanded us.”

paite: Na va luah ding uh gamsung a TOUPA na Pathian un ahon pilut a, na ma ua nam tampi, Hitte, Girgaste, Amorte, Kanaante, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste, nou sang a thupizaw leh hatzaw nam sagihte, adelhkhiak a;
english: When Yahweh your God brings you into the land where you go to possess it, and casts out many nations before you—the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite—seven nations greater and mightier than you;

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un amaute nou ahon piak a, na thahgam chiang un amaute na hihgam sipsip ding ua; amaute toh thukhun na bawl ding uh ahi kei.
english: and when Yahweh your God delivers them up before you, and you strike them, then you shall utterly destroy them. You shall make no covenant with them, nor show mercy to them.

paite: Zi leh ta in na nei ding uh ahi kei. Na tanute uh atapate uh na pe ding uh ahi kei. Atanute uh na tapate uh a ding na la ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to his son, nor shall you take his daughter for your son.

paite: Na tapate uh, kei hon zuilaite pathian dangte biakna ah apikawi mai ding uhi. Huchi in TOUPA na tung uah aheh dia, hon hihmang pah ding hi.
english: For that would turn away your sons from following me, that they may serve other gods. So Yahweh’s anger would be kindled against you, and he would destroy you quickly.

paite: Atung uah hichibang in na hih zaw ding uh ahi. Amaitam uh na hihchim ding ua, asuangphuhte uh na kitamzansak ding ua, a Asherahte uh na phuk ding ua, amilim bawltawmte uh na hal vek ding uhi.
english: But you shall deal with them like this: you shall break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their engraved images with fire.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in lah nam siangthou na hi ngal ua. Leitung maikaih a nam tengteng tung a amah a tuam ding a TOUPA na Pathian un hon tel na hi uhi.
english: For you are a holy people to Yahweh your God. Yahweh your God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.

paite: Namdang sang a na tam zawk ziak ua TOUPA'N na tung uah a-itna tusak a, hon tel ahi kei a, namdang tengteng a nam tawmpen na hi zomah uhi.
english: Yahweh didn’t set his love on you nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all peoples;

paite: TOUPA'N noute ahon it ziak in leh na pi-le-pute uh kiang a, ana kichiamna tangtun a-ut ziak in ahi zaw, TOUPA'N Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh khut a pan leh saltanna inn a pan khut hat mahmah a hon tatkhiak.
english: but because Yahweh loves you, and because he desires to keep the oath which he swore to your fathers, Yahweh has brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA na Pathian uh Pathian ahi chih thei un. Pathian muanhuai, amah it a athu zuimi tung a suan sangkhat tan a athukhun leh behpihna zui gige,
english: Know therefore that Yahweh your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commandments,

paite: amah hote hihmang dia amaitang mahmah ua thuk zel ahi. Amah hote ahal sawt kei dia, amaitang mahmah uah athuk ding hi.
english: and repays those who hate him to their face, to destroy them. He will not be slack to him who hates him. He will repay him to his face.

paite: Huaiziak in athupiakte, adante, dan thusehte, zui dia tuni a thu ka hon piak na zuih ding uh ahi.
english: You shall therefore keep the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances which I command you today, to do them.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, avaihawmte na ngaihkhiak ua, na zuih ua, na hih ziak un TOUPA na Pathian un na pi-le-pute uh kiang a, ana kichiamna thukhun leh hehpihna na tung uah azui ding hi.
english: It shall happen, because you listen to these ordinances and keep and do them, that Yahweh your God will keep with you the covenant and the loving kindness which he swore to your fathers.

paite: Noute ahon it dia, ahon vualzawl dia, hon hihpung ding hi. Piak ding a na pi-le-pute uh kiang a, ana kichiamna gam ah na gil ua gah leh na leigah uh leng avualzawl lai ding. Na buhte uh, na uainte uh, na thaute uh; na bawngnou uh leh na belamnoute uh leng avualzawl ding hi.
english: He will love you, bless you, and multiply you. He will also bless the fruit of your body and the fruit of your ground, your grain and your new wine and your oil, the increase of your livestock and the young of your flock, in the land which he swore to your fathers to give you.

paite: Nam tengteng tung ah vualzawl na hi ding ua; na lak uah numei hiam pasal hiam, na gante uh lak ah leng ching himhim a-om kei ding hi.
english: You will be blessed above all peoples. There won’t be male or female barren among you, or among your livestock.

paite: TOUPA'N hipi tengteng hon hihthengsak vek dia, na theihsa uh Aigupta gam hipite na tung uah atungsak kei dia, nou hon hote tengteng tung ah atungsak zaw ding hi.
english: Yahweh will take away from you all sickness; and he will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, on you, but will lay them on all those who hate you.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak ding nam tengteng na hihmang vek ding uhi. Na hehpih ding uh ahi kei a, apathiante uh nna na sem ding uh ahi kei; huaite nou a dia thang ahih ding ziak in.
english: You shall consume all the peoples whom Yahweh your God shall deliver to you. Your eye shall not pity them. You shall not serve their gods; for that would be a snare to you.

paite: Na lungsim ua, "Hiai namte lah ei sang in atamzaw ngal ua, bangchi in i hawlkhe thei dia?" chi na hih uleh,
english: If you shall say in your heart, “These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?”

paite: Amau kihta kei un. TOUPA na Pathian un Pharaoh leh Aigupta mi tengteng tung a athilhihte theigige un.
english: you shall not be afraid of them. You shall remember well what Yahweh your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:

paite: Ze-etna thupitak na mit mahmah ua na muhte uh, chiamtehnate, thillamdangte, khut hattakte leh ban zakte a TOUPA na Pathian un nou hon pikhiak; huchibang in TOUPA Pathian in na mi lauhte uh tung ah ahih ding hi.
english: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which Yahweh your God brought you out. So shall Yahweh your God do to all the peoples of whom you are afraid.

paite: Noumau a pan kibute leh akhosuaksunte amanthat vek tan un TOUPA na Pathian un alak uah tunpite asawl ding hi.
english: Moreover Yahweh your God will send the hornet among them, until those who are left, and hide themselves, perish from before you.

paite: Amau na lau ding uh ahi kei. Pathian thupitak leh lauhuaitak TOUPA na Pathian uh na lak uah a-om hi.
english: You shall not be scared of them; for Yahweh your God is among you, a great and awesome God.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un huai namte awlawl in ahon delhkhiaksak ding. Amau na hihmang pah ding uh ahi kei, huchi lou in zaw nou a ding in gamsate ahong tam lo kha ding uhi.
english: Yahweh your God will cast out those nations before you little by little. You may not consume them at once, lest the animals of the field increase on you.

paite: Ama'n masiah uh TOUPA na Pathian un ahon pe dia, buai petmah in ahihbuai ding hi.
english: But Yahweh your God will deliver them up before you, and will confuse them with a great confusion, until they are destroyed.

paite: Akumpipate uh na khut uah ahon pe dia, amin uh van nuai a pan na thaimang sipsip ding uh ahi. Na hihman sipsip tan un kuamah in hon dalzou kei ding hi.
english: He will deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall make their name perish from under the sky. No one will be able to stand before you until you have destroyed them.

paite: Apathian lim bawltawmte uh na hal ding uh ahi. Huaite dangkasik hiam, dangka-eng hiam na enlah ding uh ahi kei. Nou a dia na lak ding uh ahi kei. Huchi lou in zaw na awk kha ding uh; TOUPA na Pathian uh a dia thilkihhuai ahi ngal ua.
english: You shall burn the engraved images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it for yourself, lest you be snared in it; for it is an abomination to Yahweh your God.

paite: Na insung ua thilkihhuai lalut in huai thil bang in hamsiat thuak ding in na kibawl ding uh ahi kei. Kih petmah a kih in na mudah mahmah ding uh ahi, hamsiat thuakna thil lah ahi ngal ua.
english: You shall not bring an abomination into your house and become a devoted thing like it. You shall utterly detest it. You shall utterly abhor it; for it is a devoted thing.

paite: Chidam ludam a na om ua, na hong tam semsem ua, nou hon pe dia na pi-le-pute uh kiang a TOUPA'N akichiamna gam na va luahtheihna ding un ka hon thupiak tengteng zui ding in pilvang un.
english: You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers.

paite: Athupiakte na zui ding uhia, zui lou ding, na lungsim uh theihna dia enchian ding leh hon hihgim dia gamdai a kum sawmli sung nou ahon pina lampi tengteng theigige un.
english: You shall remember all the way which Yahweh your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to test you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments or not.

paite: Tanghou kia in mihing ahing kei. TOUPA kam a thu chih pawt in ahing zaw, chih nou ahon theihsak theihna ding in hon hihgim a, na kial uh aphal a, na theih ngei louh uh, na pi-le-pute un leng atheih ngei louh uh manna in ahon vak hi.
english: He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of Yahweh’s mouth.

paite: Hiai kum sawmli sung in na puansilhte uh na silhtul kei ua, na khete uh leng abawk kei hi.
english: Your clothing didn’t grow old on you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.

paite: Mi'n ata asawi bang in TOUPA na Pathian un nou hon sawi ahi, chih na lungsim un thei un.
english: You shall consider in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so Yahweh your God disciplines you.

paite: Alampi zui dia amah laudan siam ding in TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiakte na zui ding uh ahi.
english: You shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un phaizangte leh mualte a pan hong pawtkhia luitui, tuikhuk leh tui thukpi omna gam;
english: For Yahweh your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;

paite: buh, barli buh, grep, theipi leh theibuhfaite omna gam; thau nei olive leh khuaizu omna gam;
english: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive trees and honey;

paite: kitatlak lou a tanghou na nekna ding gam uh, bangmah na taksaplouhna ding uh, asuangte bang sik, atangte dal laihkhiak theihna gam hoih mahmah ah nou hon pilut ding ahi ngal a.
english: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig copper.

paite: Na neih ua, na tai mahmah chiang un, gam hoih mahmah ahon piak ziak in TOUPA na Pathian uh na phat ding uh ahi.
english: You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless Yahweh your God for the good land which he has given you.

paite: Athupiakte, adan thusehte leh adante, tuni a ka hon piak zui lou in TOUPA na Pathian uh na mangngilh kha mahmah ding uh, pilvang un.
english: Beware lest you forget Yahweh your God, in not keeping his commandments, his ordinances, and his statutes, which I command you today;

paite: Huchi lou in zaw na nek ua, na tai ua, inn hoih taktak na lam ua, na luah chiang un;
english: lest, when you have eaten and are full, and have built fine houses and lived in them;

paite: na ganhon uh, na belamhon uh ahong tam a, na dangka uh, na dangka-eng uh ahong tam a, na thil neih tengteng uh ahong tam hun chiang in na lungtang uh akisathei kha dia,
english: and when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold is multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied;

paite: Aigupta gam a saltanna inn a pan noute hon pikhepa TOUPA na Pathian uh na mangngilh mai kha ding uh,
english: then your heart might be lifted up, and you forget Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage;

paite: Ama'n gamdai zatak leh lauhuaitak, gul gukhahte leh aikamte omna, tui omlouhna, gamkeu ah hon pi paisuak a;
english: who led you through the great and terrible wilderness, with venomous snakes and scorpions, and thirsty ground where there was no water; who poured water for you out of the rock of flint;

paite: suangpi a pan meisah suang tui ahon pawtkhesak a, na pi-le-pute uh theih ngei louh, manna in nou ahon vak a, tunung chiang khualna a na hoihtheihna ding un nou hon hihgim a, ahon chet theihna ding in.
english: who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers didn’t know, that he might humble you, and that he might prove you, to do you good at your latter end;

paite: "Hiai i sum-le-paite eimah hatna leh i khut hatna in asepkhiak ahi," na lungtang un na chi kha ding uh, pilvang un.
english: and lest you say in your heart, “My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.”

paite: Tua na kip bang ua na pi-le-pute uh kiang a kichiam a thu akhun ahihkipna ding in TOUPA na Pathian uh theigige un, sum-le-pai muhkhiak theihna hon pepa lah amah ahi ngal a.
english: But you shall remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers, as it is today.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian uh na mangngilh ua, pathian dangte na zuih ua, a-nna uh na sep ua, na biak uleh, na mangthang ngeingei ding uh, chih tuni in ka hon theisak ahi.
english: It shall be, if you shall forget Yahweh your God, and walk after other gods, and serve them and worship them, I testify against you today that you shall surely perish.

paite: Na ma ua namdangte ahihmanthat bang in noute leng na mangthang ding uh, TOUPA na Pathian aw ngaikhe ut lou na hih ding ziak un.
english: As the nations that Yahweh makes to perish before you, so you shall perish, because you wouldn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.

paite: Israel mite aw, ngaikhia un, nou sang a thupizaw leh thilhih-theizaw namte, khopi van sun a kulh daikaih leh thupi luah ding in tuni in Jordan galkah a, na kuan ding uh ahi.
english: Hear, Israel! You are to pass over the Jordan today, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourself, cities great and fortified up to the sky,

paite: "Milian leh sang, Anakte, Anak suante ma ah kua adingh zou dia?" achih uh na theih uh leh zaksa uh ahi.
english: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know, and of whom you have heard say, “Who can stand before the sons of Anak?”

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA na Pathian uh katmang hat mei bang a na ma ua pai ahi, chih tuni in thei un. Ama'n amaute ahihmangthang dia, ahon hihniamsak ding. Huchi in TOUPA'N na kiang ua agensa bang in, amau na delhkhe ding ua, na hihmangthang pah ding uhi.
english: Know therefore today that Yahweh your God is he who goes over before you as a devouring fire. He will destroy them and he will bring them down before you. So you shall drive them out and make them perish quickly, as Yahweh has spoken to you.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon delhkhiaksak khit chiang in, "I diktat ziak a hiai luah dia TOUPA'N hon pilut ahi, na lungsim un chi kei hial un." Hiai namte agitlouh ziak un ahi zaw, TOUPA'N hon delhkhiaksak ding.
english: Don’t say in your heart, after Yahweh your God has thrust them out from before you, “For my righteousness Yahweh has brought me in to possess this land;” because Yahweh drives them out before you because of the wickedness of these nations.

paite: Na diktat ziak uh hiam, na lungsim uh dik ziak hiam in, agam uh na luah kei ding ua, hiai namte gitlouhna ziak leh TOUPA'N na pu uh Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a, akichiamna hihkip ding in TOUPA na Pathian un amau hon delhkhiaksak ahi zaw hi.
english: Not for your righteousness or for the uprightness of your heart do you go in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations Yahweh your God does drive them out from before you, and that he may establish the word which Yahweh swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

paite: Huaiziak in hiai gam hoih mahmah na diktat ziak ua luah ding in TOUPA'N hon pia ahi kei chih thei un. Nam genhakpi lah na hi ngal ua.
english: Know therefore that Yahweh your God doesn’t give you this good land to possess for your righteousness, for you are a stiff-necked people.

paite: Gamdai a TOUPA na hehsak nak dante uh theigige unla, mangngilh kei un. Aigupta gam a pan na pawt ni ua kipan hiai mun na hong tun tan un TOUPA tung a helhat na hi uhi.
english: Remember, and don’t forget, how you provoked Yahweh your God to wrath in the wilderness. From the day that you left the land of Egypt until you came to this place, you have been rebellious against Yahweh.

paite: Horeb ah leng TOUPA na hehsak ua, nou hon hihmangthang ding khop hial in TOUPA aheh hi.
english: Also in Horeb you provoked Yahweh to wrath, and Yahweh was angry with you to destroy you.

paite: Suangpek, na kiang ua TOUPA'N thu akhunna suangpek la dia tang a ka va hohtouh lai in, tang ah ni sawmli leh zan sawmli ka va om a; tanghou ka ne kei a, tui leng ka dawn sam kei hi.
english: When I had gone up onto the mountain to receive the stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant which Yahweh made with you, then I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water.

paite: TOUPA'N suangpek nih, Pathian khutzung a gelh ahon pia a; huai ah na kikhopkhawm ni ua tang tung a mei a pan TOUPA'N na kiang ua thu agen tengteng atuang hi.
english: Yahweh delivered to me the two stone tablets written with God’s finger. On them were all the words which Yahweh spoke with you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly.

paite: Ni sawmli leh zan sawmli khit in hichi ahong hi a, suangpek nih, thukhun suangpek ahon pia hi.
english: It came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights that Yahweh gave me the two stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant.

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Thou inla, hiai a pan paisuk meng in, Aigupta gam a pan na pikhiak na mite akihihse khinta uh. Zuih dia ka hon thupiak lampi a pan apialmangta ua, milim suntawm akibawl uh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Arise, get down quickly from here; for your people whom you have brought out of Egypt have corrupted themselves. They have quickly turned away from the way which I commanded them. They have made a molten image for themselves!”

paite: Huaite ban ah, "TOUPA'N, hiai mite ka etet aleh, ngai in, nam genhak ahi uh.
english: Furthermore Yahweh spoke to me, saying, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.

paite: Amau hihmangthang ding leh van nuai a pan amin uh thaimang ding in ka hih dandan in ka hih mai ding. Amau sang a nam thilhihtheizaw leh thupizaw in nang ka hon bawl ding," chi in leng hon houpih lai hi.
english: Leave me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under the sky; and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.”

paite: Huchi in tang a pan ka kihei a, ka paisuk a, tang akangta, thukhun suangpek nihte ka khut langnih in ka tawi hi.
english: So I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire. The two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.

paite: Huchi in ka en a, ngai un, TOUPA na Pathian uh tung ah na khialta uhi. Bawngnou lim suntawm na kibawl ua; TOUPA'N thu ahon piak lampi na pialsanta uhi.
english: I looked, and behold, you had sinned against Yahweh your God. You had made yourselves a molded calf. You had quickly turned away from the way which Yahweh had commanded you.

paite: Suangpek nihte ka dom a, ka khut langnih a pan ka pai a, na mitmuh un ka hihkhamta hi.
english: I took hold of the two tablets, and threw them out of my two hands, and broke them before your eyes.

paite: Tuma a ka hih bang in TOUPA ma ah ni sawmli leh zan sawmli ka bokkhup hi. Amah hihheh dia TOUPA mitmuh a na thilhihkhelhsa uh, nou khelhna tengteng ziak in tanghou ka ne kei a, tui leng ka dawn sam kei hi.
english: I fell down before Yahweh, as at the first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all your sin which you sinned, in doing that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

paite: Nou hon hihmangthang dia TOUPA hehna, athangpaihna leh alungkimlouhna mahmah lah ka lau ngal a. Himahleh huai lai in leng TOUPA'N ka thu hon ngaihkhiaksak hi.
english: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure with which Yahweh was angry against you to destroy you. But Yahweh listened to me that time also.

paite: TOUPA bel Aaron hihmangthang nuam hial khop in aheh a; himahleh Aaron mah leng ka thumsak pah ngal hi.
english: Yahweh was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him. I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.

paite: Na khelhna uh ziak a na bawl uh bawngnou lim ka la a, ka hal a, ka satzan a, leivui bang in ka gawinel dimdem a; tang a pan a lui hong luang ah anel ka pai hi.
english: I took your sin, the calf which you had made, and burned it with fire, and crushed it, grinding it very small, until it was as fine as dust. I threw its dust into the brook that descended out of the mountain.

paite: Taberah, Massah leh Kibroth-hattaavah ah leng TOUPA na hihheh uhi.
english: At Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth Hattaavah you provoked Yahweh to wrath.

paite: TOUPA'N, k'on gam piak va luah un, chi a, Kadesh-barnea a pan ahon sawl lai in, TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiak na helsan ua, amah na gingta kei ua, a-aw lah na ngaikhe sam kei uh.
english: When Yahweh sent you from Kadesh Barnea, saying, “Go up and possess the land which I have given you,” you rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh your God, and you didn’t believe him or listen to his voice.

paite: K'on theih tung a pan TOUPA tung a helhatmi na hi gige uh.
english: You have been rebellious against Yahweh from the day that I knew you.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N, ka hihmangthang ding, ahon chih ziak in TOUPA ma ah ni sawmli leh zan sawmli sung ka bokkhup hi.
english: So I fell down before Yahweh the forty days and forty nights that I fell down, because Yahweh had said he would destroy you.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah ka thum a, "Toupa PATHIAN aw, na thupina a tat, khut hattak a Aigupta gam a pan na tatkhiak, na mite leh na goutante hihmangthang ke'n.
english: I prayed to Yahweh, and said, “Lord Yahweh, don’t destroy your people and your inheritance that you have redeemed through your greatness, that you have brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

paite: Na sikha Abraham, Isak leh Jakob theigige inla, hiai mite phengphitdan, gitlouhdan leh akhelhdante uh en ke'n.
english: Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Don’t look at the stubbornness of this people, nor at their wickedness, nor at their sin,

paite: Huchi lou in zaw na hon pikhiakna gam a mite'n TOUPA'N agam chiam a apilut theih louh ziak leh amuhdah ziak in gamdai a thah ding in apikhia, achi kha ding uh.
english: lest the land you brought us out from say, ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring them into the land which he promised to them, and because he hated them, he has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.’

paite: Na thilhihtheihna thupitak leh na ban zak a na pikhiak, na mite leh na goutante lah ahi ngal ua," ka chi hi.
english: Yet they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out by your great power and by your outstretched arm.”

paite: Thugenpa, David tapa, Jerusalem kumpipa thute.
english: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem:

paite: Bangmah loute bangmah lou, bangmah loute bangmah lou, bang teng bangmah lou ahi, Thugenpa'n achi hi.
english: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”

paite: Asepgimna tengteng ni nuai a asepgim a kipan mihing in bang phattuamna anei a?
english: What does man gain from all his labor in which he labors under the sun?

paite: Khang khat apai a, khang dang ahong tung a; tangtawn in lei a-om gige.
english: One generation goes, and another generation comes; but the earth remains forever.

paite: Ni leng asuak zel a, ni atum zel; huchi in asuahna mun lam ah akik nawn pah hi.
english: The sun also rises, and the sun goes down, and hurries to its place where it rises.

paite: Simlam ah huih apai a, mallam ah akilehhei a; alampi ah akivialhei gige, huan huih alam zuih ah akik nawn zel hi.
english: The wind goes toward the south, and turns around to the north. It turns around continually as it goes, and the wind returns again to its courses.

paite: Luite tengteng tuipi ah aluanglut ua, himahleh tuipi a dim tuan kei; luite paina mun lam ah, huai lam ah apai nawn uh.
english: All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full. To the place where the rivers flow, there they flow again.

paite: Thil tengteng gimna in adim a; mihing in agen thei kei; muh in mit alungkim kei a, zak in bil leng alungkim sam kei.
english: All things are full of weariness beyond uttering. The eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.

paite: A-om khinsa ahong om ding ahi a; hih khitsa hih a om ding ahi a; huchi in ni nuai ah thil thak a-om kei hi.
english: That which has been is that which shall be, and that which has been done is that which shall be done; and there is no new thing under the sun.

paite: En dih, "Hiai athak ahi?" chi a mite'n agen uh thil a-om hia? I ma ua hunte ua a-om khinsa ahi.
english: Is there a thing of which it may be said, “Behold, this is new”? It has been long ago, in the ages which were before us.

paite: Khang masate theihgigena a-om kei a; anung a hong om dingte lak ah hong om ding khang nanung lam theihgigena leng a-om sam kei ding.
english: There is no memory of the former; neither shall there be any memory of the latter that are to come, among those that shall come after.

paite: Kei Thugenpa, Jerusalem ah Israel tung a kumpipa ka hi.
english: I, the Preacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

paite: Van nuai a hih a omte tengteng tungtang pilna a zong ding leh zongkhe ding a ka lungtang suah ka hi; huai a kisuk ding a mite tapate kiang a Pathian in apiak nakpitak a gimna ahi.
english: I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under the sky. It is a heavy burden that God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

paite: Ni nuai a hih a om nasepte tengteng ka muta a; ngai in, bang teng bangmah lou ahi a, huih nungdelh ahi.
english: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.

paite: Akawisa bawl tang theih ahi kei; huan akim lou sim theih ahi kei.
english: That which is crooked can’t be made straight; and that which is lacking can’t be counted.

paite: Keimah lungtang ka houlimpih a, "Ngai in, Jerusalem a ka ma a omte tengteng sang in pilna thupi ka hon muhsak a; ahi, ka lungtang in pilna aneita," chi in.
english: I said to myself, “Behold, I have obtained for myself great wisdom above all who were before me in Jerusalem. Yes, my heart has had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.”

paite: Huchi in pilna thei ding leh haina haitatna thei ding in ka lungtang ka suk a; hiai leng huih nungdelh ahi chih ka thei hi.
english: I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly. I perceived that this also was a chasing after wind.

paite: Pil mahmahna ah lungkham mahmahna a-om a; kuapeuh theihna khangsak in lungkhamna akhangsak hi.
english: For in much wisdom is much grief; and he who increases knowledge increases sorrow.

paite: Thou sisa in gimlim bawlpa nuhtheihna uingim asawlkhesak a; huchi mah bang in haina neuchik in pilna leh zahna abukzou nak hi.
english: Dead flies cause the oil of the perfumer to produce an evil odor; so does a little folly outweigh wisdom and honor.

paite: Mipil lungtang ama khut taklam ah a-om a; himahleh mihai lungtang akhut veilam ah.
english: A wise man’s heart is at his right hand, but a fool’s heart at his left.

paite: Ahi, huai ban ah, lampi a mihai avak lai in, atheihsiamna in azuausan a, mi chiteng kiang ah hai ahihdan agen hi.
english: Yes also when the fool walks by the way, his understanding fails him, and he says to everyone that he is a fool.

paite: Vaihawmmi lungsim nang dou ding a athohleh na mun taisan ke'n; kipiak in tatkhelhna thupite alungkimsak hi.
english: If the spirit of the ruler rises up against you, don’t leave your place; for gentleness lays great offenses to rest.

paite: Gilou ni nuai a ka muh, vaihawmmi a kipan adiklouhna hong kipankhia bang in a-om hi.
english: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, the sort of error which proceeds from the ruler.

paite: Haina nakpi a zahtakhuai in akibawl a, mun niam ah hauhsakna atu hi.
english: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in a low place.

paite: Sikhate sakol tung a tuang leh lalte leitung a sikhate bang a khe a pai ka mu hi.
english: I have seen servants on horses, and princes walking like servants on the earth.

paite: Kuapeuh kokhuk tou huai sung ah ake ding; kuapeuh dai phuvang; gulpi in akei ding.
english: He who digs a pit may fall into it; and whoever breaks through a wall may be bitten by a snake.

paite: Kuapeuh suang hemkhia huai in akihih na ding a; kuapeuh sing a belh huai ah lauhuai in akibawl hi.
english: Whoever carves out stones may be injured by them. Whoever splits wood may be endangered by it.

paite: Sik amol a, mi'n ama atat-hiam keileh, hatna tamsem akoih ding ahi; himahleh pilna thuzoh aphatuam hi.
english: If the ax is blunt, and one doesn’t sharpen the edge, then he must use more strength; but skill brings success.

paite: Khim a om ma a gulpi in akeihleh, khimmi ah phattuamna a-omta kei hi.
english: If the snake bites before it is charmed, then is there no profit for the charmer’s tongue.

paite: Mipil kam a thute hehpih thei in a-om a; himahleh mihai mukte'n amah mah anawmvalh ding.
english: The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious; but a fool is swallowed by his own lips.

paite: Akam a thute kipatna haina ahi; huan ahoulimna tawpna lungsim kimlouhna gilou ahi.
english: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness; and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.

paite: Mihai in leng thu akhangsak a; himahleh mihing in bang a-om dia chih athei kei; huan amah nung a hong om ding, amah kua'n ahilh thei dia?
english: A fool also multiplies words. Man doesn’t know what will be; and that which will be after him, who can tell him?

paite: Khopi a hohna dan atheih louh ziak in, mihaite sepgimna in amaute lak a michih agimsak hi.
english: The labor of fools wearies every one of them; for he doesn’t know how to go to the city.

paite: Aw gam, na tung agik hi, na kumpipa naupang ahih lai in na lalte'n zingsang in ane uh!
english: Woe to you, land, when your king is a child, and your princes eat in the morning!

paite: Aw gam, na kumpipa miliante tapa ahih a, na lalte'n, kham ding hilou a, hatna ding a ahuntak a anek lai un, nuam na sa hi.
english: Happy are you, land, when your king is the son of nobles, and your princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!

paite: Thadahna ziak in intung achim a; khut zawntatna ziak in inn akeh hi.
english: By slothfulness the roof sinks in; and through idleness of the hands the house leaks.

paite: Nuihna ding in ankuang a kilui a, uain in hinna akipaksak; sum thil tengteng awnghukna ahi.
english: A feast is made for laughter, and wine makes the life glad; and money is the answer for all things.

paite: Kumpipa, na ngaihtuahna in hamsiat ke'n, na lupna dantan sung ah mihausate hamsiat ke'n; huihkhua a vasate'n na aw pua a, kha neite'n athu agen ding ziak un.
english: Don’t curse the king, no, not in your thoughts; and don’t curse the rich in your bedroom, for a bird of the sky may carry your voice, and that which has wings may tell the matter.

paite: Tuite tung ah na tanghou pai in; ni tampi nung a mukhe ding na hi ngal a.
english: Cast your bread on the waters; for you shall find it after many days.

paite: Sagih kiang ah tantuan pia in, ahi, giat ngei kiang ah; leitung a bang gilou hong om ding ahia chih lah na thei ngal kei a.
english: Give a portion to seven, yes, even to eight; for you don’t know what evil will be on the earth.

paite: Meipite vuah a adimleh, leitung ah akihih awngthawl uh; huan simlam a sing apukleh, hiam mallam ah, apukna mun ah, huai ah a-om ding hi.
english: If the clouds are full of rain, they empty themselves on the earth; and if a tree falls toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falls, there shall it be.

paite: Huih ngeingaihmi in atuh kei ding a; meipi limsakmi in a-at kei ding hi.
english: He who observes the wind won’t sow; and he who regards the clouds won’t reap.

paite: Huih lampi hiam, amah nau toh omna gilsung a guhte bang hong chi khan uh ahia chih na theih louh bang in; bang teng bawlpa Pathian thilhih na thei kei hi.
english: As you don’t know what is the way of the wind, nor how the bones grow in the womb of her who is with child; even so you don’t know the work of God who does all.

paite: Zingsang in na chi tuh inla, nitak in na khut ton maimah ke'n; koi pen hong lohching ding ahia, hiai hia huai hia, ahihkeileh hong hoih tuaktuak ding uhia chih lah na thei ngal kei a.
english: In the morning sow your seed, and in the evening don’t withhold your hand; for you don’t know which will prosper, whether this or that, or whether they both will be equally good.

paite: Diktak in khovak anuam a, mitte a dia nisa muh thil nuamtak ahi.
english: Truly the light is sweet, and it is a pleasant thing for the eyes to see the sun.

paite: Ahi, mi kum tampi adamleh, huaite tengteng ah kipak hen; himahleh khomial hunte theigige hen, tampi pha ding uh lah ahi ngal a. Ahong om tengteng bangmah lou ahi.
english: Yes, if a man lives many years, let him rejoice in them all; but let him remember the days of darkness, for they shall be many. All that comes is vanity.

paite: Aw tangval, na tuailai in kipak in; na tuailai nite ah na lungtang in hon kipaksak hen, na lungtang lampite ah leh na mitte muh in om in; himahleh hiai thilte tengteng ziak in Pathian in nang vaihawmna a hon pi ding ahi chih thei in.
english: Rejoice, young man, in your youth, and let your heart cheer you in the days of your youth, and walk in the ways of your heart, and in the sight of your eyes; but know that for all these things God will bring you into judgment.

paite: Huaiziak in na lungtang a kipan lungkhamna suankhia inla, na sa a kipan gilou koihmang in; tuailaina leh khan lut lai lah bangmah lou ahi ngal a.
english: Therefore remove sorrow from your heart, and put away evil from your flesh; for youth and the dawn of life are vanity.

paite: Na tuailai nite in nang hon siampa theigige in, ni hoihloute ahong tun ua kumte ahong nai ua, Amaute ah kipahna ka nei kei, na chih hun ahong tun nai louh lai in.
english: Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw near, when you will say, “I have no pleasure in them;”

paite: Ni hiam, khovak leh kha leh aksite, hihmial a om a, meipite vuahzuk khit a akik nawn ma un;
english: Before the sun, the light, the moon, and the stars are darkened, and the clouds return after the rain;

paite: inn ngakte akivuan ua, mihatte ahong kun ua, atawm tak ziak ua ansute akhawl ua, tawlet a dakkhete hihmial a a-om ua,
english: in the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those who look out of the windows are darkened,

paite: kongzing akongkhakte khak ahih nai louh lai un; ansuk ging angaih louh a, vasa aw a mi athoh a, tumging theih tanute tengteng sukniam a a-om nai louh lai un;
english: and the doors shall be shut in the street; when the sound of the grinding is low, and one shall rise up at the voice of a bird, and all the daughters of music shall be brought low;

paite: Ahi, tungsang a om akihta ding ua, alampi ah launa a-om ding; vaisuaklu sing apaklun ding a, huan khaukhup tunggikna ahi dia, lingmin thuk azuau ding; mihing a-inn sau a pai a, suun mite kongzing kim a apai ziak un.
english: yes, they shall be afraid of heights, and terrors will be on the way; and the almond tree shall blossom, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail; because man goes to his everlasting home, and the mourners go about the streets;

paite: Dangka khau kiphel a, dangka-eng noubem suktap a a-om a, tuibel tuikhuk a hihkek a a-om a, tuibem a kangtalai khe hihtan a a-om nai louh lai in.
english: before the silver cord is severed, or the golden bowl is broken, or the pitcher is broken at the spring, or the wheel broken at the cistern,

paite: Huan a-om bang in leivui lei ah akik nawn a, kha bel apepa Pathian kiang ah akik hi.
english: and the dust returns to the earth as it was, and the spirit returns to God who gave it.

paite: Bangmah loute bangmah lou, thugenmi'n achi; bang teng bangmah lou ahi.
english: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher. “All is vanity!”

paite: Huai ban ah, Thugenpa apil ziak in, mite theihna asinsak lailai a; ahi, paunak tampi kizomzom in angaihtuah a, azongkhia a, akoih hi.
english: Further, because the Preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge. Yes, he pondered, sought out, and set in order many proverbs.

paite: Thugenpa'n thu pomtakte mukhe ding in azong a; diktak a gelhkhiak a omte, thutak thute ngei.
english: The Preacher sought to find out acceptable words, and that which was written blamelessly, words of truth.

paite: Mipil thute sutna zum bang ahi a, hoihtak a khetkip sikkilhnate bang tuh Belamchingpa khat thugen lakkhawm piakte ahi.
english: The words of the wise are like goads; and like nails well fastened are words from the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.

paite: Huan huai lou leng, ka tapa, hilh in om in; laibu tampi bawl ahihleh tawp chih ni a-om kei hi; huan zil tamna zaw taksa bahna ahi.
english: Furthermore, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.

paite: Hiai thu leh la tawpna ahi; avek in zak in a-omta; Pathian laudan siam inla, athupiakte zui in; hiai lah mihing hih ding pumpi ahi.
english: This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of man.

paite: Pathian in thilhih chiteng, thil selguk chiteng, ahoih hia ahihkeileh ahoih lou toh vaihawmna a lalut ding ahi.
english: For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it is good, or whether it is evil.

paite: Ka lungtang in, "Kisa in, vualnopna in ka hon entel dia; huaiziak in nopbawlna ah bual in," ngai in, hiai leng bangmah lou ahi, ka chi hi.
english: I said in my heart, “Come now, I will test you with mirth; therefore enjoy pleasure;” and behold, this also was vanity.

paite: Nuihzatna thu ah, "Haina ahi," Vualnopna thu ah, "Bang ahih a?" ka chi hi.
english: I said of laughter, “It is foolishness;” and of mirth, “What does it accomplish?”

paite: Adamsung ua mite tapate'n ahih ding uh bang ahia hoih ka muh theih matan, ka lungtang in pilna kei hon pi kawm in, uain a ka sa kipahsakdan leh haina let tintendan ka lungtang in ka zong hi.
english: I searched in my heart how to cheer my flesh with wine, my heart yet guiding me with wisdom, and how to lay hold of folly, until I might see what it was good for the sons of men that they should do under heaven all the days of their lives.

paite: Nasepna thupi ka bawl a; innte ka kilam hi.
english: I made myself great works. I built myself houses. I planted myself vineyards.

paite: Grephuante ka kibawl a; huante leh gamsitte ka kibawl a, huaite ah thei chi chih ka suan hi.
english: I made myself gardens and parks, and I planted trees in them of all kinds of fruit.

paite: Gammang singte khoinate hihkawt ding in, tui lite ka kibawl hi.
english: I made myself pools of water, to water the forest where trees were grown.

paite: Pasal sikhate leh numei sikhate ka lei a, ka insung ah sikhate apiang ua; belamhon leh bawnghon ka hau a, Jerusalem a ka ma a omte tengteng sang in.
english: I bought male servants and female servants, and had servants born in my house. I also had great possessions of herds and flocks, above all who were before me in Jerusalem.

paite: Dangka leh dangka-eng leng, bialte leh kumpipate a kipan kei a ding in gou ka kaikhawm a; pasal lasa mite leh numei lasa mite, mite tapate kipahna, atam a tam meite ka nei hi.
english: I also gathered silver and gold for myself, and the treasure of kings and of the provinces. I got myself male and female singers, and the delights of the sons of men: musical instruments of all sorts.

paite: Huchi in Jerusalem a ka ma a om tengteng sang in ka thupi in, ka pung zaw a; ka pilna leng ka kiang ah a-om gige hi.
english: So I was great, and increased more than all who were before me in Jerusalem. My wisdom also remained with me.

paite: Huan bangpeuh ka mit in alunggulh amau ka it kei hi; nopsakna himhim a kipan in ka lungtang ka len kei, ka sepgimnate tengteng ziak in ka lungtang lah akipak ngal a; huan hiai tuh ka sepgimna tengteng a kipan ka tantuan ahi.
english: Whatever my eyes desired, I didn’t keep from them. I didn’t withhold my heart from any joy, for my heart rejoiced because of all my labor, and this was my portion from all my labor.

paite: Huchi in ka khutte'n abawl uh nasep tengteng ka vel a, semgim a ka hih nasep gimna tengteng; huan, ngai in, bang teng bangmah lou leh huih nungdelh ahi a, ni nuai ah bangmah phattuamna a-om kei hi.
english: Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was vanity and a chasing after wind, and there was no profit under the sun.

paite: Huan pilna leh lungsim kimlouhna leh haina en ding in ka kihei a; kumpipa nung a hong pai mihing in bang hihthei ding ahia? Akihih khinsa mahmah tanpha in leng.
english: I turned myself to consider wisdom, madness, and folly; for what can the king’s successor do? Just that which has been done long ago.

paite: Huchi in khovak in khomial akhen dandan in, pilna in haina kheng ahi chih ka muta hi.
english: Then I saw that wisdom excels folly, as far as light excels darkness.

paite: Alutang ah mipil mitte a-om a, khomial ah mihai avak hi; huchi hinapi in lah thu khat mi tengteng kiang ah atung hi.
english: The wise man’s eyes are in his head, and the fool walks in darkness—and yet I perceived that one event happens to them all.

paite: Huai lai in ka lungtang in, "Mihaite kiang a ahong om bang in, huchibang in kei kiang ah leng ahong om ding; ahihleh bang ding a kei pilzaw ka hia?" ka chi hi. Huan ka lungtang in hiai mah leng bangmah lou ahi, ka chita hi.
english: Then I said in my heart, “As it happens to the fool, so will it happen even to me; and why was I then more wise?” Then I said in my heart that this also is vanity.

paite: Mipil, mihai bangmah a, theihgigena lah tangtawn in a-om ngal kei a; tunung chiang in avek ua mangngilh khit ahi ding uh chih thei in. Huan bangchi a mihai bang a mipil si ahia?
english: For of the wise man, even as of the fool, there is no memory forever, since in the days to come all will have been long forgotten. Indeed, the wise man must die just like the fool!

paite: Huchi in hinna ka hua a; ni nuai a bawl thilhih kei a ding a ahaksat ziak in; bang teng lah bangmah lou leh huih nungdelh ahi ngal a.
english: So I hated life, because the work that is worked under the sun was grievous to me; for all is vanity and a chasing after wind.

paite: Huan ni nuai a ka sepgim ka sepgimna tengteng ka hua a; ka nung a hong om ding mi kiang a ka nutsiat ngei ding ahi chih thei in.
english: I hated all my labor in which I labored under the sun, because I must leave it to the man who comes after me.

paite: Kua'n ahia mipil hia ahihkeileh mihai ahong hih ding thei? Ka sepgimna tengteng a ka sepgimna tung ah thu anei ding a, ni nuai a pilna ka etsakna ah. Hiai leng bangmah lou ahi.
english: Who knows whether he will be a wise man or a fool? Yet he will have rule over all of my labor in which I have labored, and in which I have shown myself wise under the sun. This also is vanity.

paite: Huaiziak in ni nuai a sepgimna tengteng ka na bawl tak tungtang thu a ka lungtang lungdongsak ding in ka kipumhei hi.
english: Therefore I began to cause my heart to despair concerning all the labor in which I had labored under the sun.

paite: Mi asengimna pilna leh theihna leh kivakna toh om lah a-om ngal a; himahleh huai a semgimloumi kiang ah atantuan ding a nutsiah in a-om ding hi. Hiai leng bangmah lou leh gilou lianpi ahi.
english: For there is a man whose labor is with wisdom, with knowledge, and with skillfulness; yet he shall leave it for his portion to a man who has not labored for it. This also is vanity and a great evil.

paite: Ni nuai a asepgimna tengteng a kipan leh alungtang a akisukna tengteng a kipan mihing in bang anei a le?
english: For what does a man have of all his labor and of the striving of his heart, in which he labors under the sun?

paite: Anite tengteng lungkhamna lel ahi ngal a, athuakna dahna; ahi, zan nangawn in alungtang akhawl kei hi. Hiai leng bangmah lou ahi.
english: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail is grief; yes, even in the night his heart takes no rest. This also is vanity.

paite: Mihing a ding a anek a adawn a, asepgimna a thil hoih a akha abualsak val a hoihzaw bangmah a-om kei hi. Hiai leng ka thei a, Pathian khut a kipan om ahi.
english: There is nothing better for a man than that he should eat and drink, and make his soul enjoy good in his labor. This also I saw, that it is from the hand of God.

paite: Kei sang a kua'n ahia ne thei a, ahihkeileh kua'n ahia nopsakna nei zaw?
english: For who can eat, or who can have enjoyment, more than I?

paite: Amah hihlungkim mi kiang ah Pathian in pilna leh theihna leh nopsakna ape ngal a; himahleh mikhial kiang ah, gimthuakna apia, lakhawm ding leh kholkhawm ding in, huchi a kuapeuh Pathian hihlungkim kiang a apiaktheihna ding in. Hiai leng bangmah lou leh huih nungdelh lel ahi.
english: For to the man who pleases him, God gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner he gives travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him who pleases God. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

paite: Bangchiteng a ding in hunbi a om, van nuai a thiltup chiteng a ding in hun;
english: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:

paite: Pian hun leh sih hun; suan hun leh suansa bohkhiak hun;
english: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;

paite: Thah hun leh hihdam hun; phel hun leh lam nawn hun;
english: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;

paite: Kah hun leh nuih hun; suun hun leh lam hun;
english: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

paite: Suangte paihmang hun leh suangte lakkhawm hun; kawi hun leh kawi kidek hun;
english: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;

paite: Zon hun leh mansuah hun; vom hun leh paihmang hun;
english: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

paite: Bohkek hun leh khui hun; pau louh hun leh thugen hun;
english: a time to tear, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

paite: It hun leh muhdah hun; kidou hun leh kilep hun.
english: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.

paite: Asepgimna nasempa'n bang phattuamna anei a?
english: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?

paite: Huai akisawizoina ding a Pathian in mite tapate kiang a apiak haksatna ka muta hi.
english: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

paite: Thil chiteng ahun a kilawm in abawl a; alungtang uah khovel leng akoihta a, hinapi in mihing in Pathian nasep abul a kipan a atawp pha ahihsa amukhe thei kei hi.
english: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.

paite: Adamsung teng un kipah leh hoih hih sang a amau a dia hoihzaw bangmah a-om kei chih ka thei hi.
english: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.

paite: Michih in anek a adawn a, asepgimna tengteng a hoih leh nuam asakpih Pathian thilpiak ahi.
english: Also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.

paite: Bangpeuh Pathian in ahih, tangtawn in a-om ding chih ka thei a; huai ah bangmah akikoih thei kei ding a, huai a kipan in bangmah mah akilakhe thei sam kei ding; Pathian in ahih khinta a, huchi in ama ah mite'n alau ding uhi.
english: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.

paite: A-om khinsa pen; a-om ding a om khinsa ahi; huan Pathian in apaimangsa azong hi.
english: That which is has been long ago, and that which is to be has been long ago. God seeks again that which is passed away.

paite: Huchi in ni nuai ah, vaihawmna mun ah, gitlouhna a-om chih leng ka mu hi; huan diktatna mun ah, gitlouhna huai ah a-om hi.
english: Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.

paite: Ka lungtang in, "Pathian in midiktat leh migilou angaihtuah ding; thiltup chiteng leh nasep chiteng a ding in hun a-om," ka chi hi.
english: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.”

paite: Ka lungtang in, mite tapate ziak in ahi, Pathian in amau a-ettel a, amau mahmah gamsa bang lel ahihdan uh akitheihtheihna ding un.
english: I said in my heart, “As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals.

paite: Mite tapate tung atung peuhmah lah gamsate tung ah atung ngal a; thil khat ngei atung uah atung a; khat asih bang in, huchi mah bang in adangdang asi a; ahi, hu khat aneikhawm ua; huan mihing in gamsate sang a masak zawkna anei kei; bang teng bangmah lou ahi ngal a.
english: For that which happens to the sons of men happens to animals. Even one thing happens to them. As the one dies, so the other dies. Yes, they have all one breath; and man has no advantage over the animals, for all is vanity.

paite: Bang teng mun khat ah apai ua; bang teng leivui a kipan ahi ua, bang teng leivui ah akik nawn uh.
english: All go to one place. All are from the dust, and all turn to dust again.

paite: Mihing kha tunglam a paitouleh gamsa kha nuailam a paisuk ahihdan kua ahia thei?
english: Who knows the spirit of man, whether it goes upward, and the spirit of the animal, whether it goes downward to the earth?”

paite: Huaiziak in mihing a nasepte a akipah ding sang a hoihzaw bangmah a-om kei chih ka thei hi; huai atantuan ahi ngal a; amah nung in bang ahi dia chih mu ding in amah kua'n hon pi nawn ahia le?
english: Therefore I saw that there is nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his works, for that is his portion; for who can bring him to see what will be after him?

paite: Huchi in ka kihei a ni nuai a nuaisiahna hih a om tengteng ka mu a; huan ngai in, huchibang a nuaisiah a omte, lungmuanpa neiloute; huan amau nuaisiahte lam ah thilhihtheihna a-om a, himahleh lungmuanpa anei kei uh.
english: Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold, the tears of those who were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.

paite: Huaiziak in misite asi khinsate adam lai dam a omlaite sang in ka phat zaw.
english: Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive.

paite: Ahi, a-om ngei nai lou, ni nuai a nasep gilou hih a om mu ngei nailoumi amaute sang in ka ngai thupizaw hi.
english: Yes, better than them both is him who has not yet been, who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.

paite: Huchi in sepgimna leh nasep siamna tengteng, hiai ziak a mihing invengte hazat a omna ka muta hi. Hiai leng bangmah lou leh huih nungdelh lel ahi.
english: Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.

paite: Mihai in abante khepkhawm in amah sa ane hi.
english: The fool folds his hands together and ruins himself.

paite: Khut dim nih sepgimna leh huih nungdelhna sang in, lungmuanna toh khut dim khat ahoihzaw hi.
english: Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.

paite: Huchi in ka kihei a ni nuai a bangmah lou ka mu hi.
english: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.

paite: Amah kia a om khat ka mu a, nihna anei kei a; ahi, tapa anei kei, sanggampa leng anei kei; hinapi in lah asepgim tawpna a-om kei a, hauhsakna in amitte leng alungkim tuan kei hi. "Kua a dia semgim a, ka kha hoih tansak ka hia?" achi a. Hiai leng bangmah lou ahi, ahi, nakpi a gimthuakna ahi.
english: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.

paite: Khat sang in nih ahoihzaw; asepgimna ua ding a kipahman hoih aneih ziak un.
english: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.

paite: Puk le uh, khat in alawm phong ding ahih ziak in; himahleh apuk chiang a amah kia a-om a, amah phong ding midang nei lou tung agik hi.
english: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.

paite: Huai lou in, nih alupkhawm un, lumna athei uh; himahleh khat kia bangchi in alum thei dia?
english: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?

paite: Huan mi khat in amah kia a om pen zouleh, nih in amah adou ding ua; khauzang guk a hek akitat mengmeng kei hi.
english: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

paite: Kumpipa tek leh hai, thuhilhna sang thei nawn lou sang in tuailai genthei leh pil ahoihzaw hi.
english: Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn’t know how to receive admonition any more.

paite: Suangkul a kipan a kumpipa hi ding a hong paikhia lah ahi ngal a; ahi, ama gam mahmah a gentheisa a piang ahi.
english: For out of prison he came out to be king; yes, even in his kingdom he was born poor.

paite: Ni nuai a vak ahing tengteng, tuailaite toh om uh ahihleh, anihna, amun ah adingh chih ka muta hi.
english: I saw all the living who walk under the sun, that they were with the youth, the other, who succeeded him.

paite: Mi tengteng, amaute tung a a-omna mahmah, bei chih a-om kei a; hinapi in lah tunung chiang a hong om dingte amah ah akipak kei ding uh. Chihtaktak in hiai leng bangmah lou leh huih nungdelh lel ahi.
english: There was no end of all the people, even of all them over whom he was—yet those who come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

paite: Pathian inn a na hoh chiang in na khepek kem in; ngaikhe ding a pai, mihaite kithoihna piak sang in ahoihzaw ngal a; gilou ahih uh chih akithei kei uhi.
english: Guard your steps when you go to God’s house; for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools, for they don’t know that they do evil.

paite: Kam lawp ke'nla, Pathian ma a thil himhim gen ding in na lungtang lawptawp kei hen; Pathian lah van ah a-om a, nang lah leitung ah na om ngal a; huaiziak in na thute tawmsak in.
english: Don’t be rash with your mouth, and don’t let your heart be hasty to utter anything before God; for God is in heaven, and you on earth. Therefore let your words be few.

paite: Mang lah thu leh la tampi toh ahong om a; huan mihai aw thu tampi toh.
english: For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.

paite: Pathian kiang a thuchiam na chiam chiang in, pe ding in hal ke'n; mihaite tung ah kipahna anei ngal kei a; na thuchiam pen pia in.
english: When you vow a vow to God, don’t defer to pay it; for he has no pleasure in fools. Pay that which you vow.

paite: Na chiam a na piak louh sang in, na chiam louh ahoihzaw hi.
english: It is better that you should not vow, than that you should vow and not pay.

paite: Na kam in na sa thil ahihkhelhsak phal ke'n; angel ma ah leng, adik kei chi sam ke'n; bang ding in na aw ah Pathian in aheh in, na khut nasep ahihse dia?
english: Don’t allow your mouth to lead you into sin. Don’t protest before the messenger that this was a mistake. Why should God be angry at your voice, and destroy the work of your hands?

paite: Huchibang in mangte punna leh thute tamna ah bangmah loute a-om nak; himahleh nang zaw Pathian kihta in.
english: For in the multitude of dreams there are vanities, as well as in many words; but you must fear God.

paite: Gentheite hiamgamna in bial sung ah vaihawmna leh diktatna alamang chih na muhleh, huai thu lamdang sa ke'n; thuneitu sangte'n thuneihna neite a-enkai ua; huan amau tung ah asangzaw a-om hi.
english: If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t marvel at the matter, for one official is eyed by a higher one, and there are officials over them.

paite: Huai lou in lei a punna bang teng a ding ahi; kumpipa ngei leng louma in a-nna asepsak hi.
english: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all. The king profits from the field.

paite: Kuapeuh dangka deihta dangka in alungkim kei ding; kuapeuh hauh-sakna punna deih taleng; hiai leng bangmah lou ahi.
english: He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver, nor he who loves abundance, with increase. This also is vanity.

paite: Van akibehlap chiang in, amau nete akhang uh; huan huai neimi a ding in bang phattuamna a-om a, amitte a huaite et chih ngal louh?
english: When goods increase, those who eat them are increased; and what advantage is there to its owner, except to feast on them with his eyes?

paite: Ne tawm in ne tam taleh, semgimmi ihmut alim a; himahleh mihausa vahna in amah a-ihmusak kei hi.
english: The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much; but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep.

paite: Ni nuai a gilou hoih het lou ka muh a-om a, huai tuh, hauhsakna a neipa'n amah siatna ding a akep.
english: There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.

paite: Himahleh huai hauhsaknate thuakna gilou in amangthang hi; tapa asuanleh, akhut ah bangmah a-om kei.
english: Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, there is nothing in his hand.

paite: Anu gil a kipan ahong paileh, vuaktang in apai nawn ding a hong pai bang in, asepgimna, akhut a apuakmang theih a ding in bangmah ala kei ding hi.
english: As he came out of his mother’s womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand.

paite: Huan hiai leng gilou hoih het lou ahi, ahong paidan tengteng in, hichibang in apai ding a; huih a ding a asepgimna ah bang punna anei a?
english: This also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go. And what profit does he have who labors for the wind?

paite: Adamsung teng in khomial ah an ane a, huan nakpitak a hihbuai in a-om a, chinatna leh thangpaihna anei hi.
english: All his days he also eats in darkness, he is frustrated, and has sickness and wrath.

paite: Ngai in, hoih leh kilawm hi a ka muh mi'n Pathian in amah apiak adamsung teng a anek a, adawn a, ni nuai a asepgimna tengteng a hoih asakpih a, huai ahi; hiai lah atantuan ahi ngal a.
english: Behold, that which I have seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy good in all his labor, in which he labors under the sun, all the days of his life which God has given him; for this is his portion.

paite: Mi chiteng leng amah kiang a Pathian in hauhsakna leh neih zohna apiak, huai a nektheihna apiak a, atantuan la ding leh asepgimna a kipak ding in; hiai Pathian thilpiak ahi.
english: Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labor—this is the gift of God.

paite: Adam lai nite lah atheigige kei ding a; alungtang kipahna a Pathian in amah adawn ziak in.
english: For he shall not often reflect on the days of his life, because God occupies him with the joy of his heart.

paite: Ni nuai a ka muh gilou a-om a, mite tung ah agik hi.
english: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is heavy on men:

paite: Mi Pathian in hauhsakna leh neih zohna leh zahna apiak a, huchi a adeih peuh akha a dia bangmah taksap nei het lou a, himahleh huai ne ding a Pathian in thilhihtheihna apiak louh a, mikhual in anek zawkna; hiai bangmah lou ahi a, gilou natna ahi.
english: a man to whom God gives riches, wealth, and honor, so that he lacks nothing for his soul of all that he desires, yet God gives him no power to eat of it, but an alien eats it. This is vanity, and it is an evil disease.

paite: Mihing in ta zakhat suang henla, kum tampi dam in akumte nite tampi phaleh, akha lah hoih in dim kei ngal in, kivuina nei kei ngalleh; amah a ding in ahun lou a pian ahoihzaw ka chi ahi.
english: If a man fathers a hundred children, and lives many years, so that the days of his years are many, but his soul is not filled with good, and moreover he has no burial, I say that a stillborn child is better than he;

paite: Bangmah lou lah ahong hi a, khomial ah apaimang a, khomial in amin akhuh hi.
english: for it comes in vanity, and departs in darkness, and its name is covered with darkness.

paite: Huai lou in ni amu kei a, theih leng athei kei; hiai in adang sang in akhawlna anei hi.
english: Moreover it has not seen the sun nor known it. This has rest rather than the other.

paite: Ahi, kum sangkhat gentuan dam mahleh, hoih nuam asakpih tuan kei; bang teng mun khat ah apai kei uh maw?
english: Yes, though he live a thousand years twice told, and yet fails to enjoy good, don’t all go to one place?

paite: Mihing sepgimna tengteng akam a ding ahi a, himahleh agilkialna adim tuan kei.
english: All the labor of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.

paite: Mihai sang in mipil in bang phattuamna anei a le? Ahihkeileh, mihing ma a omdan thei, migenthei in bang anei a?
english: For what advantage has the wise more than the fool? What has the poor man, that knows how to walk before the living?

paite: Lunggulhna tam vak sang in mitte muh ahoihzaw hi; hiai leng bangmah lou leh huih nungdelh lel ahi.
english: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

paite: Ana om khinsa bangpeuh, sawtpi a huai amin piaksa ahi, huan mihing ahi chih theih ahi; amah sang a hatzaw amah toh leng akisual thei kei ding hi.
english: Whatever has been, its name was given long ago; and it is known what man is; neither can he contend with him who is mightier than he.

paite: Thil tampi bangmah lou pungsak a om ding chih thei in, mihing bang ahoih tuan a?
english: For there are many words that create vanity. What does that profit man?

paite: Adamsung bangmah lou limliap bang a asukbei tengteng, adamsung in mihing a ding a hoih kua'n athei a le? Ni nuai ah amah nung in bang a-om dia chih kua'n mihing ahilh thei a ahia?
english: For who knows what is good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he spends like a shadow? For who can tell a man what will be after him under the sun?

paite: Nuh theih mantam sang in minhoih ahoihzaw; mi pian ni sang in sih ni.
english: A good name is better than fine perfume; and the day of death better than the day of one’s birth.

paite: Ankuangluina inn a hoh sang in, suunna inn a hoh ahoihzaw; huai mi tengteng tawpna ahi a; huan mihing in alungtang a angaihtuah ding ahi.
english: It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting; for that is the end of all men, and the living should take this to heart.

paite: Nuih sang in lungkham ahoihzaw; mel lungkhamna ah lungtang kipahsak in lah a-om ngala.
english: Sorrow is better than laughter; for by the sadness of the face the heart is made good.

paite: Mipil lungtang suunna inn ah a-om; himahleh mihaite lungtang vualnopna inn ah a-om hi.
english: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.

paite: Mi a ding in mihaite lasak zak sang in, mipil taina zak ahoihzaw.
english: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise than for a man to hear the song of fools.

paite: Bel nuai a lingte puak vengvung bang in, mihai nuihna huchibang in a-om ngal a; hiai leng bangmah lou ahi.
english: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool. This also is vanity.

paite: Simmohna in mipil ahaisak mahmah a; thilpiak in theihsiamna asusia hi.
english: Surely extortion makes the wise man foolish; and a bribe destroys the understanding.

paite: Akipatna sang in thil tawpna ahoihzaw; lungsim a kisaktheih sang in lungsim a doh theih ahoihzaw hi.
english: Better is the end of a thing than its beginning. The patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.

paite: Heh ding in na lungsim in kinoh ke'n; hehna lah mihaite awm ah akhawl hi.
english: Don’t be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools.

paite: Nidanglaite hiaite sang a ahoihzawkna aziak bang ahia? chi ke'n; hiai thu lah pilhuaitak in na dong kei hi.
english: Don’t say, “Why were the former days better than these?” For you do not ask wisely about this.

paite: Pilna gouluah bang in ahoih a; ahi, amau ni mute a ding in ahoihzaw tham hi.
english: Wisdom is as good as an inheritance. Yes, it is more excellent for those who see the sun.

paite: Dangka sum kihumna ahih bang in, pilna lah kihumna ahi ngal a; himahleh theihna hoihzawkna bel, pilna in aneimi hinna ahawisak hi.
english: For wisdom is a defense, even as money is a defense; but the excellency of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life of him who has it.

paite: Pathian nasep ngaihtuah in; ama'n akawisak sa, kua ahia bawl tang thei ding?
english: Consider the work of God, for who can make that straight which he has made crooked?

paite: Hauhsak ni in nuamsa inla, huan vangtah ni in ngaihtuah in; mihing in anung a thil om ding amuhkhiaklouhna ding in, Pathian in khat lah adang kiang ah kihiang helhel in abawl hi.
english: In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider; yes, God has made the one side by side with the other, to the end that man should not find out anything after him.

paite: Ka bangmah lou ni in hiai tengteng ka muta hi; midiktat adiktatna a mangthang a-om a, huan migilou agilou bawlna a ahinna hihsau a-om hi.
english: All this I have seen in my days of vanity: there is a righteous man who perishes in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man who lives long in his evildoing.

paite: Kidiktatsak lo zen ke'n; kipilsak lo zen sam ke'n; bangziak a nang kihihse ding na hia?
english: Don’t be overly righteous, neither make yourself overly wise. Why should you destroy yourself?

paite: Gilou lo zen ke'nla, hai sam ke'n; na hun tun ma a bangziak a si ding na hia?
english: Don’t be too wicked, neither be foolish. Why should you die before your time?

paite: Hiai na let tinten ahoih hi; ahi huai a kipan in leng na khut kai ke'n; kuapeuh Pathian kihta lah amute tengteng a kipan hong paikhe ding uh ahi ngal a.
english: It is good that you should take hold of this. Yes, also don’t withdraw your hand from that; for he who fears God will come out of them all.

paite: Khopi a om vaihawmmi sawmkhat sang in mipil a ding in pilna athupizaw.
english: Wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers who are in a city.

paite: Hoih hih a, khial lou, leitung ah midiktat a-om mahmah kei hi.
english: Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and doesn’t sin.

paite: Thu kigen tengteng leng limsak khol dah in; huchi lou in zaw na sikha in nang ahon hamsiat na za kha ding hi.
english: Also don’t take heed to all words that are spoken, lest you hear your servant curse you;

paite: Na lungtang in lah huchi mah bang in nang leng midangte na hamsiat mun chih athei ngal a.
