english: for often your own heart knows that you yourself have likewise cursed others.

paite: Hiai tengteng pilna in ka enchian vek a, "Ka pil ding," ka chi a; himahleh kei a kipan agamla hi.
english: All this I have proved in wisdom. I said, “I will be wise;” but it was far from me.

paite: Gamlatak a thilte leh athuk petpette; kua'n amukhe thei dia?
english: That which is, is far off and exceedingly deep. Who can find it out?

paite: Ka kipumhei a, thei ding leh zongkhe ding, pilna zong ding leh thilte ziak zong ding, gitlouhna haina ahi chih thei ding, haina lungsim kimlouhna ahi chih thei ding in ka lungtang koihkip in a-om hi.
english: I turned around, and my heart sought to know and to search out, and to seek wisdom and the scheme of things, and to know that wickedness is stupidity, and that foolishness is madness.

paite: Sihna sang a khazaw tuh numei, alungtang thangte leh lente hi a, akhut henna khau hi ahi chih ka muta hi. Kuapeuh Pathian lungkimsak huai nu a pan asuakta ding a, himahleh mikhial bel athang-awk ding hi.
english: I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God shall escape from her; but the sinner will be ensnared by her.

paite: Ngai in, hiai ka mukhia, thugentu in achi; thil omdantak mukhe ding in thil akhat akhat ka buk hi.
english: “Behold, I have found this,” says the Preacher, “to one another, to find an explanation

paite: Tu in leng ka zong lai a ka mu kei; pasal sangkhat lak a mitang khat ka mu, himahleh numei tengteng lak a mitang ka mu kei hi.
english: which my soul still seeks, but I have not found. I have found one man among a thousand, but I have not found a woman among all those.

paite: Ngai in, Pathian in mihing hoihtak in abawl chih, hiai kia ka mu a; himahleh bawltawm tampi azongkhia uhi.
english: Behold, I have only found this: that God made mankind upright; but they search for many inventions.”

paite: Mipi bang a om kua ahia? Huan thil hilhchetna kua ahia thei? Mihing pilna in amai avaksak a, amai takna akikheng hi.
english: Who is like the wise man? And who knows the interpretation of a thing? A man’s wisdom makes his face shine, and the hardness of his face is changed.

paite: K'on thuhilh, Pathian thuchiam lam thu ah, kumpipa thupiak zui in.
english: I say, “Keep the king’s command!” because of the oath to God.

paite: A-omna mun a kipan paikhe ding in kinoh ke'n; thil gilou ah engtat ke'n; ama'n lah a-utut ahih sek ngal a,
english: Don’t be hasty to go out of his presence. Don’t persist in an evil thing, for he does whatever pleases him,

paite: Kumpipa thu in thilhihtheihna aneih ziak in, "Bang ahia na hih?" Kua'n ahia akiang achi thei ding?
english: for the king’s word is supreme. Who can say to him, “What are you doing?”

paite: Thupiak zuite'n thil gilou athei kei ding uh; huan mipil lungtang in hun leh vaihawmna atheikhen zel.
english: Whoever keeps the commandment shall not come to harm, and his wise heart will know the time and procedure.

paite: Thiltup chiteng ah lah hun leh vaihawmna a-om ngal a; mihing haksatna lah atung ah athupi ngal a.
english: For there is a time and procedure for every purpose, although the misery of man is heavy on him.

paite: Ahong om ding lah athei ngal kei a; bangchi in a-om dia chih amah kua'n ahilh thei dia le?
english: For he doesn’t know that which will be; for who can tell him how it will be?

paite: Kha lentang ding in kha tung a thilhihtheihna neimi a-om kei; sihna ni tung ah leng thilhihtheihna anei sam kei. Huan huai kidouna ah panna a-om kei; piak a om gitlouhna in amah ahunkhe sam kei ding hi.
english: There is no man who has power over the spirit to contain the spirit; neither does he have power over the day of death. There is no discharge in war; neither shall wickedness deliver those who practice it.

paite: Hiai tengteng ka mu a, nasep chiteng ni nuai a hih ah ka lungtang ka pia a; asiatna ding in mi khat in midang tung a thilhihtheihna aneih louh hun a-om hi.
english: All this I have seen, and applied my mind to every work that is done under the sun. There is a time in which one man has power over another to his hurt.

paite: Huan giloute vui a om ka mu lai a, huan han ah ahong ua; huchi in hihdikte mun siangthou a kipan apaimang ua, khopi ah mangngilh in a-om uhi; hiai leng bangmah lou ahi.
english: So I saw the wicked buried. Indeed they came also from holiness. They went and were forgotten in the city where they did this. This also is vanity.

paite: Gilou nasep kintak a gawtna akibawl louh ziak in, huaiziak in mite tapate lungtang gilou hih ding in huai ah koihkip in a-om hi.
english: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.

paite: Mikhial in gilou zakhat vei hih in, anite hihsau mahleh, Pathian kihta mite amau a ding in ahoih ding chih ka thei mahmah hi, ama a laudan siamte.
english: Though a sinner commits crimes a hundred times, and lives long, yet surely I know that it will be better with those who fear God, who are reverent before him.

paite: Himahleh giloute a ding in ahoih kei ding, anite leng asausak kei ding a, huai lah limliap bang ahi; Pathian ma a laudan asiam louh ziak in.
english: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he lengthen days like a shadow, because he doesn’t fear God.

paite: Bangmah lou leitung a hih a om a-om a; midiktat omta bang hileh leng, ama tung a migilou nasep dungzui in ahong om nak hi; huai lou in migiloute omta bang hileh leng, midiktatte nasep dungzui in atung uah ahong om hi; hiai leng bangmah lou ahi.
english: There is a vanity which is done on the earth, that there are righteous men to whom it happens according to the work of the wicked. Again, there are wicked men to whom it happens according to the work of the righteous. I said that this also is vanity.

paite: Nek leh dawn a vualnuam a om kan a ni nuai a mihing in thil hoihzaw aneih louh ziak in, vualnopna ka phat hi. Pathian in amah ni nuai a apiak adamsung ni tengteng a asepgimna ah amah toh om gige ding ahi ngal a.
english: Then I commended mirth, because a man has no better thing under the sun than to eat, to drink, and to be joyful: for that will accompany him in his labor all the days of his life which God has given him under the sun.

paite: Pilna thei ding leh leitung a hih a om thu-le-la mu ding a ka lungtang ka suk lai in; sun hiam zan hiam a mit a ihmut muh louh lah a-om ngal a.
english: When I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done on the earth (even though eyes see no sleep day or night),

paite: Huchi in Pathian thilhih tengteng ka mu a, huchi in ni nuai a thilhih mihing in amukhe thei kei hi; zongkhe ding in mihing nakpitak in pang lezong, amuh louh ding ziak in; huai lou in, mipil in thei kisa mahleh, amukhe thei kei ding hi.
english: then I saw all the work of God, that man can’t find out the work that is done under the sun, because however much a man labors to seek it out, yet he won’t find it. Yes even though a wise man thinks he can comprehend it, he won’t be able to find it.

paite: Hiai tengteng ka lungtang in ka vei ngal a, hiai tengteng zongkhe ding in; midiktatte leh mipilte leh athilhihte uh Pathian khut ah a-om ahi chih; itna ahi hia muhdahna, mihing in athei kei; ama uah avek in a-om hi.
english: For all this I laid to my heart, even to explore all this: that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God; whether it is love or hatred, man doesn’t know it; all is before them.

paite: Thil tengteng kibang in avek ua kiang ah ahong om a; midiktatte leh migiloute tung ah tanchin khat a-om hi; mihoih kiang leh migilou kiang, misiang kiang leh misiang lou kiang, kithoihmi kiang leh kithoihloumi kiang ah, mihoih a-om bang in, mikhial a-om a; akichiampa, thuchiam kihtapa bang in.
english: All things come alike to all. There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good, to the clean, to the unclean, to him who sacrifices, and to him who doesn’t sacrifice. As is the good, so is the sinner; he who takes an oath, as he who fears an oath.

paite: Ni nuai ah hih a om tengteng ah hiai gilou ahi, bang teng tung a tanchin khat om; ahi nalai a, mite tapate lungtang gilou in adim a, adam lai uh alungtang uah lungsim kimlouhna a-om, huai nung in misite kiang ah apai uh.
english: This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all. Yes also, the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.

paite: Amah hing lai tengteng toh kizom a om ding in lah lametna a-om ngal a; humpinelkai sisa sang in ui hing lai lah ahoihzaw ngal a.
english: For to him who is joined with all the living there is hope; for a living dog is better than a dead lion.

paite: Mihingte'n asi ding uh chih lah athei ngal ua; himahleh misi in thil himhim athei kei, kipahman leng aneita kei uhi; amaute theihgigena lah akimangngilh hi.
english: For the living know that they will die, but the dead don’t know anything, neither do they have any more a reward; for their memory is forgotten.

paite: A-itna uh bang in, amuhdahna uleh a-enna uh tu in amangta a; ni nuai a hih a om thil himhim ah tangtawn in tantuan anei nawnta kei uhi.
english: Also their love, their hatred, and their envy has perished long ago; neither do they any longer have a portion forever in anything that is done under the sun.

paite: Pai inla, nopsakna toh na tanghou ne inla, lungtang kipak toh in na uain dawn in; Pathian in lah na thilhihte asang khinta ngal a.
english: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.

paite: Na puansilhte ngou gige in om hen; huan na lu in nilh theih tasam kei hen.
english: Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.

paite: Na bangmah lou damsung ni tengteng a na it na zi kiang ah kipaktak in om inla, huai ama'n ni nuai a ahon piak, na bangmah lou ni tengteng in; huai lah damsung in na tantuan ahi ngal a, ni nuai a na sepgimna a na sepgimna ah.
english: Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity, for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun.

paite: Na khut in hih ding bangpeuh amuh na theihtawp in sem in; na paina lam han sung ah, nasep hiam, thil ngaihtuah hiam, theihna hiam, pilna hiam a-om lou ding ahi ngal a.
english: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.

paite: Ka kihei a, kitaitehna kinte a ding ahi kei a, galdouna hatte a ding ahi tuan kei chih ka mu hi, tanghou leng apilte a ding, hauhsakna leng theisiam mite a ding, deihsakna khutsiamte a ding hi tuan lou; himahleh hun leh phat amaute tengteng tung ah ahong om zel hi.
english: I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.

paite: Mihing in ahun athei kei hi; ngasate len gilou a akimat bang leh vasate thang a a-awk uh bang in, huchibang in mite tapate, amau tung a thakhat a ahong tun guih lai in, hun gilou a mat in a-om uhi.
english: For man also doesn’t know his time. As the fish that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falls suddenly on them.

paite: Hichibang in pilna leng ni nuai ah ka mu a, ka kiang ah thupi in akilang hi.
english: I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way, and it seemed great to me.

paite: Khopi lian lou a-om a, asung ah mi tawmchik; huan kumpipa thupi in ahong sim a, ala a, adouna ding in sepaih nasep thupitak abawl hi.
english: There was a little city, and few men within it; and a great king came against it, besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it.

paite: Huchi in huai ah mipil genthei khat a-om, apilna in khopi ahunkhia a; himahleh kuamah in huai migentheipa atheigige kei uh.
english: Now a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.

paite: Huan ke'n, "Hatna sang in pilna ahoihzaw; migenthei pilna muhsit in a-om a, athute ngaihkhiaksak in a-om kei," ka chi hi.
english: Then I said, “Wisdom is better than strength.” Nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.

paite: Mihaite lak a vaihawmmi kikou sang in awl a mipil thugente akiza zaw hi.
english: The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him who rules among fools.

paite: Kidouna galvante sang in pilna ahoihzaw; himahleh mikhial khat in hoih tampi ahihsia hi.
english: Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroys much good.

paite: Paul, Pathian deihlam a Khrist Jesu sawltak in, misiangthou Ephesa a om Khrist Jesu a miginomte kiang ah:
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

paite: Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist Pa leh Pathian phat in om hen. Ama'n van munte ah khalam vualzawlna chiteng in eite Khrist ah ahon vualzawlta hi.
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,

paite: Amah mai a siangthou leh dembei a om ding a leitung pian ma a eite hon tel tak bang ngei in;
english: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,

paite: Ama'n adeih leh atup bangbang in, eite Jesu Khrist vang a atate hi ding in, itna ziak in hon sepkhol khinta hi.
english: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

paite: Huchi a it a ahon piak hehpihna thupi mahmah pahtawina i hihtheihna ding ahi.
english: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.

paite: Asisan ziak in amah ah tatkhiakna, ahehpihna hauhdan bang a i tatleknate ngaihdamna ngei i tangta ua,
english: In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace

paite: huai mah tuh ama'n eite lam ah pilna leh theihsiamna chiteng hon dimsakta a;
english: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

paite: athiltup Khrist a agelkhiak bangbang in adeihlam thuguk eite ahon theisakta hi.
english: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

paite: Huai adeihlam thilgel bel; hunbi ahong kim chiang a, thil tengteng, van a omte leh leitung a omte Khrist ah gawmkhawm a asuktuah vek ding ahi.
english: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.

paite: Ama deihlam a lunggel bang a thil bangkim semkhepa tup bang ngei in, amah mah ah sehkholh a om in i gouluah ding i muta uhi.
english: We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will,

paite: Koute, Khrist a ana lamen masate, athupina pahtawina ding a hing ding in sehkholh in ka na om khinta uhi.
english: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.

paite: Huan noute'n thutak thu, na hotdamna tanchinhoih uh ngaikhia a na gintak nung un, amah ah chiamsa Kha Siangthou a chiamteh in na omta uhi;
english: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

paite: huai tuh, Pathian thupina ding a tatna kim i tan mateng a i gouluah ding tang ngei ding i hi chih khamkholhna ahi.
english: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.

paite: Huaiziak in ke'n leng Toupa Jesu a ginna na lak ua om leh misiangthoute tengteng tung a na itna uh ka zak in,
english: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you and the love which you have toward all the saints,

paite: ka thumnate ah na min uh lou in nou ziak a kipahthu gen ka tawp kei hi;
english: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

paite: i Toupa Jesu Khrist Pathian, thupina Pa'n, amah theihna lam thu a pilna leh kilakna kha nou ahon piaktheihna ding in.
english: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him,

paite: Huchi a na lungsim mitte uh hihvak a hong om a, ama'n nou ahon sapna lametna bang leh misiangthoute agouluah hauhsaknate na theihna ding un.
english: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

paite: Huan agingta eite athilhihtheihna thupina teh vual louh, huai a hatna thilhihtheihna toh asep bang zel in.
english: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might

paite: Hiai thilhihtheihna bel misi lak a kipan a Khrist akaihthoh a, vanmun a, ataklam a atutsak hun a,
english: which he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

paite: lalnate, thuneihnate, thilhihtheihnate, vaihawmna tengteng tung leh tu khovel kia hilou a khovel hong tung ding nangawn a minsak chiteng tunglam pek ah akoih lai a azat mah ahi.
english: far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.

paite: Ama'n akhenuai ah bangkim akoih a, saptuam a bangkim tung a lutang in amah abawl a,
english: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,

paite: huai saptuam apumpi ahi a, amah bangkim a bangkim hihdimpa taangchinna ahi.
english: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.

paite: Nou leng na tatlekna uleh na khelhnate uh ziak a si na hih lai un ahon hihhing hi.
english: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,

paite: Huaite ah tuma lam in hiai khovel dan bang in, huihkhua a thuneipa, tua thumang lou tate sung a semlelpa kha deihdan in na khosa uhi.
english: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience.

paite: Huai thumang lou tate lak ah eite leng tuma lam in sa duhgawlna hih in, i tak taksa utnate bang in i om vek ua, midangte mah bang in thangpaihna ta a piang i na hi uhi.
english: We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.

paite: Himahleh zahngaihna hau Pathian in, itna thupitak a hon it ziak in,
english: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

paite: tatleknate ziak a si i hih lai in Khrist toh ahon hihhing a, hehpihna a hotdam na hita uhi.
english: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—

paite: Khrist Jesu ah amah toh ahon kaithou a, van munte ah amah kiang ah ahon tukhawmsak hi.
english: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

paite: Huchi a hun hong tung dingte a, Khrist Jesu a i tung a migitna nei a, ahehpihna hauhdan a-etsak theihna ding in.
english: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;

paite: Hehpihna ziak a ginna tawn a hotdam na hi uhi; huai leng noumau a suak ahi kei a, Pathian thilthawnpiak ahi.
english: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

paite: Thilhih ziak ahi kei, huchi hi keileh mi'n asuang kha ding hi.
english: not of works, that no one would boast.

paite: Thil hoih hih ding a Khrist Jesu a siam a om in, ama khutsuak i hi uhi; huai thil hoih hih i khosakna dan ding in Pathian in abawlkhol ahi.
english: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

paite: Huaiziak in tuma lam a nou taksa a Zentelte, taksa khut a zeksum, achihte un zeksum louh hon chihte uh na hi uhi.
english: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision” (in the flesh, made by hands),

paite: Huai lai in, Khrist lou in Israelte khua-le-tui toh kimidang in khovel ah lametna nei lou leh Pathian lou a om in, thuchiam thukhun lak ah mikhual in na om uh chih theigige un.
english: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.

paite: Tu'n bel, Khrist Jesu ah nou nidanglai a gamlapi a omte, Khrist sisan a hihnai in na hong omta uhi.
english: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

paite: Amah i kilemna ahi; ama'n ei nihte khat a siam in i kikal a kimelmakna baang lai ahihchimta hi.
english: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,

paite: Thusehte leh dan thupiakte asa a hihmang in; huchi a nihte amah a mihing thak khat a siam a kilemna abawltheihna ding in.
english: having abolished in his flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace,

paite: Huan kros ziak a nihte pumpi khat a Pathian toh hon kilemsakna ding in kimelmakna ahihbeita hi.
english: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility through it.

paite: Huan amah ahong pai in, nou gamlapi a omte kiang ah leh naichik a omte kiang ah leng lemna tanchinhoih ahilh sam hi.
english: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.

paite: Amah ziak in kha khat a Pa kiang luttheihna i nei tuaktuak uhi.
english: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.

paite: Huchi in tu'n zaw, zin-le-leng na hi nawnta kei ua, misiangthoute toh tualsung khat leh Pathian inkuanpihte na hita uhi.
english: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God,

paite: Khrist Jesu ngei aning a suang kiphamohpen hi in, sawltakte leh zawlneite suangphum tung a lam na hi ua,
english: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;

paite: amah ah suanglep tuam chiat kituaktak a suktuah, Toupa ah tempul siangthou asuak hi.
english: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;

paite: Amah ngei ah nou leng, Kha a Pathian tenna ding a lepkhawm na hi uhi.
english: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.

paite: Hiai ziak in kei Paul, nou Zentelte ziak a Khrist Jesu hentapa in,
english: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,

paite: noute a dia Pathian hehpihna nasepna piak a om ka hihdan na za thamta ding uhi.
english: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you,

paite: Huchi a kilakna tungtawn a Khrist thuguk ka kiang a theihsak a a-omdante; tuma a tomchik a ka gelh bang in.
english: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,

paite: Huai na sim un Khrist thuguk ka theihdan na thei ding uhi.
english: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,

paite: Tu hun a asawltak siangthoute leh azawlnei siangthoute kiang ah Kha theihsak a a-om bang in, tuma lam in mihing tate kiang ah theihsak in a-om ngei kei hi.
english: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,

paite: Huai thuguk hiai ahi, tanchinhoih ziak in Khrist Jesu ah, Zentelte gouluahpihte, pumpi hiangte leh thuchiam tanpihte ahi uhi.
english: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,

paite: Athilhihtheihna nasepdan bang a, Pathian hehpihna thawnpiak bang zel in huai tanchinhoih nasemtu ding a bawl ka hi.
english: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

paite: Kei, misiangthou tengteng lak a neupen sang a neuzaw kiang ah, hiai hehpihna piak ahi, Khrist hauhsakna suikhiak vual louh Zentelte kiang a gen ding in;
english: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

paite: huan Pathian thil bangkim siampa a tangtawn a sel a na om, thuguk kisel bang ahia chih mi tengteng musak ding in,
english: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ,

paite: Pathian pilna chiteng van munte a kumpi vaihawmte leh thuneihnate kiang a saptuamte zang a, tu hun a theihsak ahihna ding in.
english: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,

paite: Hiai atangtawn thiltup dungzui a Toupa Khrist Jesu a atup leh sepdan ahi.
english: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.

paite: Khrist Jesu i gin ziak in amah mah ah maingalna leh kimuanna toh luttheihna i nei hi.
english: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

paite: Huchi in noute ziak a ka gimthuak ziak in lungke lou ding in ka hon ngen hi, huaite na thupina uh ahi.
english: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.

paite: Huaiziak in i Toupa Jesu Khrist Pa ma ah ka khukdin hi,
english: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

paite: lei leh van a inkuan chiteng min phuahkhiakna pa,
english: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

paite: athupina hauhdan bang zel a, ama Kha ziak a mihing sunglam a thilhihtheihna a hihhat a ahon omsak theihna ding in.
english: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,

paite: Huan na lungtang ua Khrist ginna a atentheihna ding in, a-itna a noute zungkai leh kingakna nei a na omtheihna ding un,
english: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

paite: misiangthou tengteng toh azatdan, asaudan, asandan leh athukdan theihchet theihna leh,
english: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,

paite: Khrist itna theih phak louh, Pathian taangchinna chiteng bang a hihdim a na omtheihna ding un.
english: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

paite: Huan eimah a sem zel thilhihtheihna bang in, i nget leh i ngaihtuah tengteng sang a thupizaw tham hihtheipa kiang ngei ah,
english: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

paite: tangtawn in suan tengteng tan in, saptuamte leh Khrist Jesu ah thupina om hen, Amen.
english: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.

paite: Huaiziak in noute sap a na omna uh toh kikhawm a khosa ding in kei Toupa a hentapa in ka hon ngen hi.
english: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,

paite: Kingaihniamna leh migitna tengteng, kuhkalna toh, itna a kithuakzou chiat in,
english: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,

paite: lemna Kha a kipum khatna vom tinten ding in.
english: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

paite: Ahon sapna pen lametna mun khat a sap na hih mah bang un pumpi khat leh Kha khat kia a-om hi.
english: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,

paite: Toupa khat, ginna khat, baptisma khat,
english: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

paite: bangkim Pathian leh Pa khat kia a om a; amah bangkim tung a om a, bangkim mu suak leh bangkim sung a om ahi.
english: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.

paite: Himahleh Khrist thilpiak tehna bang zel in hehpihna i kiang chiat uah piak in a-om hi.
english: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

paite: "Huaiziak in ahi, tunglam a akahtouh lai in matte tampi api a, mihingte kiang ah leng thilpiakte apia,” achihna.
english: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to people.”

paite: Huchi in "Akahtou," chih lei mun nuainungpente bang a ahong suk masak phot keileh bangchi ahita dia le?
english: Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?

paite: Hong suk pen thil tengteng ahihdim theihna ding in, van tengteng tung pek a kahtoupa mah ahi.
english: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.

paite: Huan khenkhatte sawltak hi ding in, khenkhatte zawlnei hi ding in, khenkhatte tanchinhoih gen ding in, khenkhatte pastor hi ding in, khenkhatte sinsaktu ding in apia hi.
english: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;

paite: Hiai tuh misiangthoute thopna ding, nasepna sepna ding, Khrist pumpi lamtouhna ding in.
english: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,

paite: Huai tuh ginna leh Pathian Ta theihna lam a thukituak a, piching a, Khrist taangchinna bang a i vek ua i om masiah a ding ahi.
english: until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,

paite: Huchi a mihingte diklouhna khemna bang a lepchiahpil a khem tawmtawm a om a, thuhilhna huih chiteng a alanglang a sep leh mutleng naupang i hih nawnlouhna ding un.
english: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;

paite: Itna a thutak gen a, bangkim a amah lupen, Khrist ngei a i khanlet zawkna ding uh ahi.
english: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ,

paite: Amah a kipan pumpi tengteng kizopna chiteng sep ziak a lemtak a suktuah leh kizomkhawm a, hiang chih in sepdan ding bang asep chiang in pumpi akhang a itna ah amah-le-amah akilamtou hi.
english: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.

paite: Tu in hiai Toupa ah ka hon theisak hi, Zentelte alungsim ginatlouhna uh pu a a-om bang un, na om nawn mahmah ding uh ahi kei hi.
english: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,

paite: Amau alungtang uh khauh ziak a theihtheihna nei lou in Pathian hinna theihtheihna a pan posiah in a-om ua; atheihtheihna uh hihmial in a-om uhi.
english: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts.

paite: Akhenggawpta ua, siang lou chiteng hihna lam a huaiham in zautatna ah akipumpiak uhi.
english: They, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

paite: Himahleh nou zaw huchibang in Khrist thu na zil kei uhi!
english: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,

paite: Athu za a amah a thuhilh a om khin na hih peuhmah uleh, Jesu a thutak a om bang in,
english: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

paite: na pianken lui uh, na nidanglai hindan uh segawpsa suahkhia in,
english: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,

paite: na lungsim Kha uah athak in hong om unla,
english: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

paite: pianken thak, diktatna leh sianthouna a Pathian batpih a siam pen silh un.
english: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

paite: Huchi in zuaugen tawpsan in, noumau inveng chiat kiang ah thudik gen un; khat-le-khat kihiangtuah chiat lah na hi ngal ua.
english: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.

paite: Heh unla, khelh zaw khial kei un; na hehna uh ni in tumpih kei hen.
english: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,

paite: Diabol leng mun awn sam kei un.
english: and don’t give place to the devil.

paite: Guta in gu nawn kei hen; tasam kiang a piak ding aneihtheihna ding in, akhut a thil hoih sem in gim zaw hen.
english: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

paite: Thusia peuhmah na kam ua kipan in pawt kei hen; akhawkdan bang zel a bawlhoih ding in thuhoih peuhmah pawt zaw hen, angaikhete a ding a hehpihna ahong hihtheihna ding in.
english: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

paite: Huan Pathian Kha Siangthou hihlungkham kei un, tatna ni a ding in amah ah chiamteh na hi uhi.
english: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

paite: Khaatna bang, thangpaihna bang, hehna bang, hanna bang, gensiatnate leh gitlouh tupna chiteng toh tawpsan in om hen.
english: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.

paite: Huan kihehpihtuah chiat a lainatna nei in om unla, Pathian in Khrist a nou ahon ngaihdam bang in, noumau leng kingaidamtuah chiat un.
english: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

paite: Huchi in ata deihtakte bang in Pathian omdan zuite hi un.
english: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

paite: Huan Khrist in hon it a, namtui ding a Pathian kiang a thilpiak ding leh kithoihna ding a i sik a akipiak bang in itna ah khosa un.
english: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

paite: Misiangthou hita na hihman un kingaihna leh siang lou tengteng huaihamna toh, na lak uah lohkhak in om kei hen.
english: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

paite: Zahmohte, thugina lou gente, chiamnuih thu nangawn huaite akilawm lou ahi; huaite gen sang in kipahthu gen zaw un.
english: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.

paite: Kingaihhat leh mithanghuai leh mihuaiham in, mihuaiham zaw milim bemi ahi, Khrist leh Pathian lalgam ah gou tan ding anei kei uh chih na thei mahmah uhi.
english: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

paite: Kuamah in thugina lou peuh in hon khem kei uhen; huai thilte ziak in Pathian thangpaihna thumang lou tate tung ah atung nak hi.
english: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

paite: Huaiziak in amau kikoppih kei un.
english: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.

paite: Tuma in mial na hi ua, tu'n zaw Toupa ah vak na hong hita uhi; vak tate bang in om un;
english: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

paite: vak gah tuh hoihna, diktatna leh thutak tengteng ahi;
english: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

paite: huan Toupa ah akipah lam pomtak bang ahi hiam zong un.
english: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

paite: Huan mial thilhih gah nei ngeiloute ah leng panna nei kei unla, pan nak sang in adiklouhdan uh theisak zaw un.
english: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

paite: Aguk a athilhih nakte uh agen lel leng azumhuai hi.
english: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.

paite: Himahleh thil bangkim adiklouhdan muh theih a om tuh vak hihlat ahi nak hi; muh theih a om peuhmah vak ahi ngal a.
english: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

paite: Huaiziak in “Nang ihmu! Hak inla, misi lak a kipan thou in. Huchi in Khrist in vak hon pe ding," chih ahi.
english: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

paite: Huan mihaite bang a om lou in, mipilte bang a om zaw in, na omdan uah pilvang un;
english: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,

paite: nite ahoih louh ziak in hun na neih sung un atam theipen sem un.
english: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

paite: Huaiziak in hai nuam kei unla, Toupa deihlam bang ahia chih thei zaw un.
english: Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

paite: Uain kham in om kei un, huai ah kideklouhna a-om hi; Kha a dim in om zaw un,
english: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

paite: phatna late, Pathian late, khalam late a kihoupih chiat a Toupa kiang a na lungtang tengteng ua ging kilawm bawl leh la sa in,
english: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

paite: i Toupa Jesu Khrist min a, Pathian, Pa ngei kiang a bangkim tung a kipahthu gen gige in.
english: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;

paite: Khrist laudan siam in kiniamkhiak chiat un.
english: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.

paite: Zite aw, Toupa kiang a na kiniamkhiak bang un, noumau pasalte kiang ah kiniamkhiak un.
english: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

paite: Khrist amah ngei pumpi hondampa hi a, saptuamte lutang ahih mah bang in zi lutang tuh pasal ahi.
english: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

paite: Huchi in saptuamte Khrist kiang a akiniamkhiak bang un bangkim ah apasalte uh kiang ah zite kiniamkhiak uhen.
english: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

paite: Pasalte aw, na zite uh it un, Khrist in saptuamte a-it a, asik ua akipiak bang in,
english: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,

paite: huchi a ama'n tui a sil a, thu a ahihsiangthou theihna ding in;
english: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,

paite: huchi a saptuamte nin baang lou, vuai lou leh huchibang thil mawngmawng pu lou a, siangthou leh gensiatbei a om zaw a, saptuamte amah-le-amah thupitak a akipiak theihna ding in.
english: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.

paite: Huchibang in pasalte'n leng amau pumpi mah bang in amau zite a-it ding uh ahi. Ama zi itpa amah ki-it ahi.
english: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

paite: Kuamah in ama sa mah aho ngei kei, Khrist in saptuamte avak a adeihthoh bang in, avak in adeihthoh zaw hi;
english: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,

paite: ama sa leh guh a pan a om, apumpi hiangte i hi ngal ua.
english: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

paite: Huaiziak in pasal in anu leh apa paisan in azi alen tinten ding a, anih un sapum khat ahong hita ding uhi.
english: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.”

paite: Hiai thuguk athupi hi, himahleh ke'n zaw Khrist leh saptuamte toh kisai ahi ka gen.
english: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.

paite: Akoi abang hitaleh, nou lak a kuapeuh in amah a ki-it bang in azi it hen; zi mah in leng apasal zahtak ding in pilvang hen.
english: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.

paite: Naupangte aw, Toupa ah na nu leh pate uh thu mang un, huai tuh thil dik ahi ngal a.
english: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

paite: "Na nu leh pa zahtak in," hiai thupiak chiam nei masapen ahi.
english: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:

paite: "Huchi in nang a ding in ahoih dia, lei ah leng na damsawt ding hi."
english: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.”

paite: Huan nou pate aw, na tate uh hihthangpai kei unla, Toupa thuzohna leh hilhna ah kem zaw un.
english: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

paite: Sikhate aw, Khrist thumang bang in laudan siam leh ling kawm in lungtang khat in sadan a na pute uh thumang un;
english: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,

paite: Mihing kipaksakte maimah bang a mitmei kia veng lou in, Khrist sikha bang a lungtang a Pathian deihlam hih zaw in.
english: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,

paite: Mihing nasem phet hilou in, Toupa nasem bang zaw a chitaktak kawm a nna sem in,
english: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,

paite: michih sikha hi in noplen himahleh thil hoih ahih bang mah Toupa kiang a kipan in angei mah amu nawn ding uh chih thei in.
english: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.

paite: Nou heutute aw, huchibang in amau leh noumau heutupa van ah a-om chih leh ama'n mi deihsak tuam anei kei chih thei in vau lou in atung uah hih sam un.
english: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

paite: Atawp pen in, Toupa leh ahatna thagui ah thilhihtheihna nei in hong om un.
english: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.

paite: Diabol khemnate na dou zohtheihna ding un Pathian galvan kim in kivan un.
english: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

paite: I doute zaw sa leh sisan ahi kei ua, lalnate leh thuneihnate leh tu a om lel mial tung a khovel vaihawmte leh van munte a kha gilouhon omte ahi zaw uhi.
english: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.

paite: Huaiziak in ni hoih lou a na douzohna ding un leh na hihzoh vek nung ua leng na dintheihna ding un, Pathian galvan kim la un.
english: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

paite: Na kawng uh thutak a gak in, diktatna awmphaw zang in,
english: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

paite: lemna tanchinhoih vanzat na khe ua bun in dingh un.
english: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,

paite: Huaite ban ah ginna lum la unla, huai in migilou thal kuangthei tengteng na hihmit thei ding uhi.
english: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.

paite: Huan hotdamna lukhu leh Kha namsau, Pathian thu la unla;
english: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;

paite: thumna leh ngetna chiteng in bangchik lai peuh in Kha ah thum un. Huai lam ah misiangthou tengteng a ding in phatuamngai leh ngen bilbel in limsak un.
english: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.

paite: Tanchinhoih thuguk hangsantak a theisak ding a, ka kam ka kat a, thu gensak a ka omtheihna ding in kei a ding in leng hon ngetsak un.
english: Pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,

paite: Ka gen ding bang hangsantak a ka gentheihna ding in, huai tanchinhoih palai khainiang bun ka hi.
english: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

paite: Himahleh nou leng bangchibang in ka om hiam ka tanchin na theihtheihna ding un, Taikikas, Toupa a unau deihtak leh nasempa muanhuai in bangkim ahon theisak ding hi.
english: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.

paite: Huaiziak in amah na kiang uah ka hon sawl ahi, ka tanchin uh na theihna ding uleh ama'n na lungtang uh akhamuan theihna ding in.
english: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.

paite: Unaute kiang ah Pa Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan lemna leh ginna tel itna om hen.
english: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist tul lou a itte tengteng kiang ah hehpihna om hen, Amen.
english: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.

paite: Ahasueras dam lai in hichi ahong hi a, hiai Ahasueras bel India a kipan Ethiopia tan a, bial zakhat sawmnih-le-sagih tung a vaihawm ahi.
english: Now in the days of Ahasuerus (this is Ahasuerus who reigned from India even to Ethiopia, over one hundred twenty-seven provinces),

paite: Huai lai a, Susa Inpi a kumpipa Ahasueras a gam laltutphah tung a atut lai,
english: in those days, when the King Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom, which was in Susa the palace,

paite: avaihawm kum thum kum in, avaihawmte leh asikhate tengteng a ding in ankuangluina abawl a; Persia leh Media thuneihna, bialte a miliante leh vaihawmte ama ah a-om uhi.
english: in the third year of his reign, he made a feast for all his princes and his servants; the army of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces being before him.

paite: Agam thupi hauhsaknate leh avaihawmna sang zahtakhuaina ni tampi, ni za-le-sawmgiat a-ensak hi.
english: He displayed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honor of his excellent majesty many days, even one hundred eighty days.

paite: Huchi in hiai nite zoh in, kumpipa'n Susa Inpi a om mite tengteng, aneu leh alian a ding in kumpipa Kulhpi huangsung ah, ankuangluina ni sagih abawl hi.
english: When these days were fulfilled, the king made a seven day feast for all the people who were present in Susa the palace, both great and small, in the court of the garden of the king’s palace.

paite: Puan kang khaite, ahing, adum, puanmalngat hoih leh sandup khauzangte a dangka zungbuhte leh suangpak khuamte a henden a-om a, tutna nemte dangka-eng leh dangka a bawl, suangchian suangpak san, ngou, eng leh vom a bawl tung ah a-om uhi.
english: There were hangings of white and blue material, fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and marble pillars. The couches were of gold and silver, on a pavement of red, white, yellow, and black marble.

paite: Dangka-eng noute in dawn ding amau apia ua, noute akibang kei vek uh; kumpipa uain tampi, kumpipa khuttawi letna dungzui zel in.
english: They gave them drinks in golden vessels of various kinds, including royal wine in abundance, according to the bounty of the king.

paite: Huchi in dan bang zel in uain dawnna a-om a; kuamah phutluih a-om kei; kumpipa'n a-inn heutu tengteng kiang ah, michih in nuam asak bang zel ua ahih ding un atheisak khin hi.
english: In accordance with the law, the drinking was not compulsory; for so the king had instructed all the officials of his house, that they should do according to every man’s pleasure.

paite: Kumpinu Vasti in leng kumpipa Ahasueras inn a om numeite a ding in ankuangluina abawl sam hi.
english: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to King Ahasuerus.

paite: Ani sagih ni a, kumpipa lungtang uain a kipak a a-om lai in, Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha leh Abagtha, Zethar leh Karkaste, kumpipa Ahasueras omna a nasem michilgehte thu apia hi.
english: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcass, the seven eunuchs who served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,

paite: Kumpipa ma a kumpi lukhu toh Vasti hon tonpih a, akilawmna mite leh vaihawmte ensak ding in, amah et in ahoih hi.
english: to bring Vashti the queen before the king wearing the royal crown, to show the people and the princes her beauty; for she was beautiful.

paite: Himahleh kumpinu Vasti in michilgehte zang a kumpipa thupiak hoh lou ding in asel a, huaiziak in kumpipa aheh mahmah a, asung ah ahehna akuang hi.
english: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king’s commandment by the eunuchs. Therefore the king was very angry, and his anger burned in him.

paite: Huchih lai in hunte thei mipilte kiang ah kumpipa'n, huchibang lah kuapeuh dan leh vaihawmna theite lau a kumpipa omdan sek ahi him hi.
english: Then the king said to the wise men, who knew the times (for it was the king’s custom to consult those who knew law and judgment;

paite: Amah zom in Karsena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena leh Memukan, Persia leh Media vaihawmtu sagihte kumpipa mai mute leh gamsung a tu masate ahi uhi.
english: and next to him were Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media, who saw the king’s face, and sat first in the kingdom),

paite: "Michilgehte zang a kumpipa Ahasueras chih ahih louh ziak in, dan dungzui in kumpinu Vasti tung ah bang i hih ding ua?" achi hi.
english: “What shall we do to Queen Vashti according to law, because she has not done the bidding of the King Ahasuerus by the eunuchs?”

paite: Kumpipa leh vaihawmte ma ah Memukan in adawng a, “Kumpinu Vasti kumpipa tung ah kia thil diklou hih ahi kei a, kumpipa Ahasueras bial sung a om vaihawmte tengteng tung leh mite tengteng tung ah leng hih ahi.
english: Memucan answered before the king and the princes, “Vashti the queen has not done wrong to just the king, but also to all the princes, and to all the people who are in all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus.

paite: Kumpipa Ahasueras in ama a hong pai ding in kumpinu Vasti thu apia a, himahleh ahong pai kei, chih akigenthang chiang in, hiai kumpinu thilhih numei tengteng kiang atung ding a, amit uah apasalte uh simmohna suaksak ding ahi.
english: For this deed of the queen will become known to all women, causing them to show contempt for their husbands when it is reported, ‘King Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him, but she didn’t come.’

paite: Tuni a kumpinu thilhih na za Persia leh Media vaihawmte'n kumpipa vaihawmte tengteng kiang ah huchi mah bang in agen ding uh. Huchi in nakpi a kisimmohna leh thangpaihna ahong kipankhe ding hi.
english: Today, the princesses of Persia and Media who have heard of the queen’s deed will tell all the king’s princes. This will cause much contempt and wrath.

paite: Kumpipa deihlam ahihleh, amah a kipan kumpi thupiak pekhia henla, kumpipa Ahasueras ma ah Vasti hong pai nawn het lou ding chih, hihlamdan theih louh ding in, Persia mite leh Media mite dante lak ah gelh in om hen; huan kumpipa'n amah sang a hoihzaw midang khat amah kumpi mun leh mual peleh.
english: “If it pleases the king, let a royal commandment go from him, and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes, so that it cannot be altered, that Vashti may never again come before King Ahasuerus; and let the king give her royal estate to another who is better than she.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n thupiak abawl ding a, gamsung pumpi a akithehzak chiang in, athupi ngal a; zi tengteng in apasalte uh, aliante leh aneute kiang ah zahtakna ape ding uh," chi in.
english: When the king’s decree which he shall make is published throughout all his kingdom (for it is great), all the wives will give their husbands honor, both great and small.”

paite: Huchi in thugen in kumpipa leh lalte akipaksak a; huchi in Memukan thu dungzui in kumpipa'n ahihta hi.
english: This advice pleased the king and the princes, and the king did according to the word of Memucan:

paite: Ama'n lah huai a kigelh dungzui in, kumpipa bial tengteng, bial chiteng leh mi chiteng kiang ah apau uh dungzui in, huchi a michih in ama insung mahmah a dante apuaklut theih a, amite pau dungzui a, athehzak theihna ding in laikhakte akhakta hi.
english: for he sent letters into all the king’s provinces, into every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language, that every man should rule his own house, speaking in the language of his own people.

paite: Huan kumpipa Ahasueras in gam tung leh tuipi tuikulh gam tung ah siah abawlta hi.
english: King Ahasuerus laid a tribute on the land and on the islands of the sea.

paite: Huchi in athilhihtheihna leh ahatna thilhihte tengteng leh Mordekai, kumpipa'n amah akoihsanna, letna genna kim, Media leh Persia kumpipate chiamtehna laibu a gelh ahi kei uh maw?
english: Aren’t all the acts of his power and of his might, and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king advanced him, written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

paite: Juda mi Mordekai, kumpipa zom a Judate lak a lian ahi, a-u anau mi tampi in apom uh ahi. Ama'n mite hoihna ding zong a nasem achipihte tengteng kiang ah lemna thu agen hi.
english: For Mordecai the Jew was next to King Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews and accepted by the multitude of his brothers, seeking the good of his people and speaking peace to all his descendants.

paite: Hiai thilte zoh in, kumpipa Ahasueras thangpaihna lungkimsak a om in, Vasti bang ahia ahih, asiatna dia bang ahia thupiak chih atheigige hi.
english: After these things, when the wrath of King Ahasuerus was pacified, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and what was decreed against her.

paite: Huchi in anasepsak kumpipa sikhate'n akiang ah, "Kumpipa a ding in nungak siangthou tuailai melhoih kizong henla,
english: Then the king’s servants who served him said, “Let beautiful young virgins be sought for the king.

paite: kumpipa'n agam a bial tengteng ah heutu sep hen, huaite'n nungak siangthou tuailai tengteng Susa Inpi ah, numeite inn ah, Hegai kumpipa michilgeh numeite kempa in ahon pikhawm theihna ding un; huchi in siansakna ding a thilte uh amau kipeleh.
english: Let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom, that they may gather together all the beautiful young virgins to the citadel of Susa, to the women’s house, to the custody of Hegai the king’s eunuch, keeper of the women. Let cosmetics be given them;

paite: Huchi in nungak kumpipa lungkimsak pen Vasti sik in kumpinu hi hen," achi uhi. Huai thil in kumpipa alungkimsak a; huchibang in ahihta hi.
english: and let the maiden who pleases the king be queen instead of Vashti.” The thing pleased the king, and he did so.

paite: Susa Inpi ah Juda mi kuahiam, amin Mordekai, Jair tapa, Shimei tapa, Benjamin mi a-om a;
english: There was a certain Jew in the citadel of Susa whose name was Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite,

paite: amah bel Jerusalem a kipan a Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in Judah kumpipa Jekoniah apimang a om salte toh pimang in a-om uhi.
english: who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captives who had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away.

paite: Ama'n Hadassah, huai tuh Esther, apaneu tanu akem piching hi; ama'n nu leh pa anei kei. Huai nungak akilawm in amel ahoih hi, anu leh pa asih un Mordekai in atanu ding in ala hi.
english: He brought up Hadassah, that is, Esther, his uncle’s daughter; for she had neither father nor mother. The maiden was fair and beautiful; and when her father and mother were dead, Mordecai took her for his own daughter.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa thupiak leh athubawl akizak in, nungak tampi Susa Inpi, Hegai in akaihkhawm a-om lai un, Esther leng kumpipa' inn ah, Hegai, numeite kempa nuai ah ahon pi uhi.
english: So, when the king’s commandment and his decree was heard, and when many maidens were gathered together to the citadel of Susa, to the custody of Hegai, Esther was taken into the king’s house, to the custody of Hegai, keeper of the women.

paite: Huchi in nungak in amah alungkimsak a, ama deihsakna angahta a; ama'n siansakna ding in athilte amah ape pah a, atantuante toh, amah piak ding akilawm, kumpipa' inn a kipan nungak sagih toh; amah leh anungakte numeite inn a mun hoihpen ah asuanta hi.
english: The maiden pleased him, and she obtained kindness from him. He quickly gave her cosmetics and her portions of food, and the seven choice maidens who were to be given her out of the king’s house. He moved her and her maidens to the best place in the women’s house.

paite: Esther in ahihna agenkhe kei a, atanaute hihna leng agenkhe sam kei hi; Mordekai in lah genkhe lou ding in amah athuhilh ngal a.
english: Esther had not made known her people nor her relatives, because Mordecai had instructed her that she should not make it known.

paite: Huchi in Mordekai bel niteng in numeite inn mai ah Esther in bangchi in ahih zel a, bang ahong chi dia chih thei ding in ahoh zel hi.
english: Mordecai walked every day in front of the court of the women’s house, to find out how Esther was doing, and what would become of her.

paite: Numeite a dia dan dungzui a kha sawm-le-nih, murrah thau toh kha guk, gimnamtuite toh kha guk leh numeite siansakna ding a thilte toh, huchibang in asiansakna nite hihkim a a-om nung in, nungak chih kumpipa Ahasueras kiang a ava lut hun uh atungta hi.
english: Each young woman’s turn came to go in to King Ahasuerus after her purification for twelve months (for so were the days of their purification accomplished, six months with oil of myrrh, and six months with sweet fragrances and with preparations for beautifying women).

paite: Nungakte kumpipa kiang a alut chiang un, kumpipa' inn a hohpih ding in numeite omna a kipan adeihdeih uh piak in a-om uhi.
english: The young woman then came to the king like this: whatever she desired was given her to go with her out of the women’s house to the king’s house.

paite: Nitaklam in apai a, azing nawn in numeite inn nihna ah, kumpipa michilgeh Shasgaz, meite kempa inn ah ahong kik a, kumpipa amah ah kipak napi in, kumpipa kiang ah ahong lut kei a, amin a sap in a-om hi.
english: In the evening she went, and on the next day she returned into the second women’s house, to the custody of Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch, who kept the concubines. She came in to the king no more, unless the king delighted in her, and she was called by name.

paite: Huchi a amah atanu ding a lapa, Mordekai paneu Abihail tanu, Esther kumpipa kiang a ava lut hun ahong tun in, Hegai kumpipa michilgeh, numeite kempa a seh chih ngal louh bangmah akan kei hi. Huchi in amah ente tengteng mitmuh in Esther in deihsakna atang hi.
english: Now when the turn of Esther, the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her for his daughter, came to go in to the king, she required nothing but what Hegai the king’s eunuch, the keeper of the women, advised. Esther obtained favor in the sight of all those who looked at her.

paite: Huchi in Esther kumpipa Ahasueras kiang a kumpi inn ah akha sawmna, Tebeth kha a avaihawm kum sagihna kum in laklut in a-omta hi.
english: So Esther was taken to King Ahasuerus into his royal house in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n numei tengteng sang in Esther a-it a, nungak siangthoute sang in amitmuh in hehpihna leh deihsakna atang hi. Huchi in alutung ah lallukhu akoih a, Vasti sik in kumpinu ding in amah abawlta hi.
english: The king loved Esther more than all the women, and she obtained favor and kindness in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown on her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.

paite: Huchih lai in kumpipa'n avaihawmte tengteng leh asikhate tengteng a ding in ankuang thupi, "Esther Ankuang mahmah," aluita a; bialte kiang ah khawlna abawl a, kumpipa siamna bang zel in, thilpiakte apia hi.
english: Then the king made a great feast for all his princes and his servants, even Esther’s feast; and he proclaimed a holiday in the provinces, and gave gifts according to the king’s bounty.

paite: Huchi a nungak siangthoute nihveina dia kaihkhawm a-om lai un, Mordekai bel kumpipa kongpi ah atu hi.
english: When the virgins were gathered together the second time, Mordecai was sitting in the king’s gate.

paite: Esther in atanaute leh amite hihna agenkhe kei; amah kiang a khanletsak a om bangtak in Mordekai thupiak bang in ahih hi.
english: Esther had not yet made known her relatives nor her people, as Mordecai had commanded her; for Esther obeyed Mordecai, like she did when she was brought up by him.

paite: Huai lai a, Mordekai kumpipa kongpi a atut lai in, kumpipa michilgeh lak a nih, Bigthan leh Teresh, kongkhak ngakte aheh ua, kumpipa Ahasueras tung a khut kha ding in azongta uhi.
english: In those days, while Mordecai was sitting in the king’s gate, two of the king’s eunuchs, Bigthan and Teresh, who were doorkeepers, were angry, and sought to lay hands on the King Ahasuerus.

paite: Huai thil Mordekai in athei a, ama'n kumpinu kiang ah atheisak hi. Esther in Mordekai min in huai akumpipa ahilhta hi.
english: This thing became known to Mordecai, who informed Esther the queen; and Esther informed the king in Mordecai’s name.

paite: Huchi in athu akikanleh, huchibang ahi ngei chih akimukhia a, anih un sing dawn ah khailup in a-om uhi. Hiai thu tanchin gelhna laibu ah kumpipa ma ah akigelh hi.
english: When this matter was investigated, and it was found to be so, they were both hanged on a gallows; and it was written in the book of the chronicles in the king’s presence.

paite: Hiai thilte nung in kumpipa Ahasueras in Agag mi Hammedatha tapa Haman akaisangsak a, malam anawtsak a, akiang a om vaihawmte tengteng tunglam ah atutphah akoih hi.
english: After these things King Ahasuerus promoted Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes who were with him.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n amah tungtang thu huchibang a apiak bang in kumpipa sikha tengteng, kumpipa kongpi a omte Haman azahna pia in akun uhi. Himahleh Mordekai akun kei a, amah zahna abawl kei hi.
english: All the king’s servants who were in the king’s gate bowed down and paid homage to Haman, for the king had so commanded concerning him. But Mordecai didn’t bow down or pay him homage.

paite: Huchih lai in kumpipa sikhate kumpina kongpi a omte'n, Mordekai kiang ah, "Bangziak a kumpipa thupiak a talek na hia?" achi uhi.
english: Then the king’s servants who were in the king’s gate said to Mordecai, “Why do you disobey the king’s commandment?”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, niteng a amah ahoupih lai un, amau angaikhe kei a, Mordekai thu pai ding hia pai lou ding chih thei ding in Haman ahilh ua; amah Juda mi ahi chih amaute ahilhta hi.
english: Now it came to pass, when they spoke daily to him, and he didn’t listen to them, that they told Haman, to see whether Mordecai’s reason would stand; for he had told them that he was a Jew.

paite: Huchi a Mordekai niamchik a kun lou in, amah azahtak kei chih Haman in atheih in, aheh mahmah hi.
english: When Haman saw that Mordecai didn’t bow down nor pay him homage, Haman was full of wrath.

paite: Himahleh Mordekai tung kia a khut khak bang tham lou in angaihtuah a; Mordekai mite lah amah a-ensakta ngal ua; huchi in Haman in Ahasueras gam pumpi a om Judate tengteng, Mordekai mite, hihgawp ding in azongta hi.
english: But he scorned the thought of laying hands on Mordecai alone, for they had made known to him Mordecai’s people. Therefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews who were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, even Mordecai’s people.

paite: Kumpipa Ahasueras vaihawm akum sawm-le-nih ni, akha khatna, Nisan kha in, "Pur," asan ua, huai tuh aisan ahi, Haman ma ah, niteng in, kha teng in, akha sawm-le-nih, Adar kha tan in.
english: In the first month, which is the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of King Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that is, the lot, before Haman from day to day, and from month to month, and chose the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

paite: Huan Haman in kumpipa Ahasueras kiang ah, "Mi kuate hiam kithehzak a na gam bial sung tengteng a mite lak a dalh a-om ua; adante uh mi tengteng dan toh akibang kei a; kumpipa dante azui kei uhi. Huaiziak in amaute thuakzoh kumpipa punna ding ahi kei hi.
english: Haman said to King Ahasuerus, “There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the peoples in all the provinces of your kingdom, and their laws are different from other people’s. They don’t keep the king’s laws. Therefore it is not for the king’s profit to allow them to remain.

paite: Kumpipa deihlam ahihleh, hihsiat a a-omna ding un lai kigelhleh, kumpipa nasepna a heutute khut ah ke'n dangka talent singkhat ka pe ding, kumpipa sumbawmte a tawilut ding in," achi hi.
english: If it pleases the king, let it be written that they be destroyed; and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver into the hands of those who are in charge of the king’s business, to bring it into the king’s treasuries.”

paite: Huchi in akhut a kipan kumpipa'n azungbuh asuah a, Agag mi Hammedatha tapa Haman, Judate melmapa kiang ah apia hi.
english: The king took his ring from his hand, and gave it to Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews’ enemy.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n Haman kiang ah, "Dangka na kiang a piak ahi, mipi leng, amau tung a pha na saksak hih ding in," achi hi.
english: The king said to Haman, “The silver is given to you, the people also, to do with them as it seems good to you.”

paite: Huchih lai in akha khatna, ani sawm-le-thum ni in, kumpipa laigelhmite asamlut ua, kumpipa heutu liante leh kumpipa bial chih a omte tengteng leh mi chiteng vaihawmte Haman in thu apiak peuhmah dungzui in akigelhta hi. Bial chih kiang ah huai a kigelh dungzui in, michih kiang ah apau bang zel un; kumpipa Ahasueras min in akigelh a, kumpipa zungbuh in suai akisawn hi.
english: Then the king’s scribes were called in on the first month, on the thirteenth day of the month; and all that Haman commanded was written to the king’s local governors, and to the governors who were over every province, and to the princes of every people, to every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language. It was written in the name of King Ahasuerus, and it was sealed with the king’s ring.

paite: Huchi in Adar kha, akha sawm-le-nih, ani sawm-le-thum ni mahmah a, ni khat a, Juda mite tengteng atek-akhang naupang noute leh numeite hihsiat ding, that ding leh mangthangsak ding in, kumpipa bial sung tengteng ah dak in laikhakte akhak ua, asum uh gallak a laksak ding in.
english: Letters were sent by couriers into all the king’s provinces, to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish, all Jews, both young and old, little children and women, in one day, even on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, and to plunder their possessions.

paite: Laigelh teisawn, thupiak bial teng a piakkhiak ding leh huai ni a dia mansa a om chiat ding in, mi tengteng kiang ah asuah uhi.
english: A copy of the letter, that the decree should be given out in every province, was published to all the peoples, that they should be ready against that day.

paite: Kumpipa thupiak in dakte kinohtak in asawlkhia ua, Susa Inpi ah thupiak akipekhia hi. Huchi in dawn ding in kumpipa leh Haman atu ua; himahleh Susa khopi ahamhaihsak hi.
english: The couriers went out in haste by the king’s commandment, and the decree was given out in the citadel of Susa. The king and Haman sat down to drink; but the city of Susa was perplexed.

paite: Huchi a thil kihih tengteng Mordekai in atheih in, apuante abotkek a, vut toh sai-ip puan asilh a, khopi laizang ah apaikhia a, ngaihtak leh nakpi in akap hi.
english: Now when Mordecai found out all that was done, Mordecai tore his clothes and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out into the middle of the city, and wailed loudly and bitterly.

paite: Kumpipa kongpi mai pha in ahong pai a, sai-ip puansilh mi kuamah lah kumpipa kongpi sung ah alut thei kei hi.
english: He came even before the king’s gate, for no one is allowed inside the king’s gate clothed with sackcloth.

paite: Huchi in bial chiteng a, koi lai peuh a kumpipa thupiak leh athubawl tunna ah, Judate lak ah nakpitak a suunna, an ngawlna, kahna, mauna a-om hi. Huchi in mi tampi sai-ip puan silh in, vut lak ah alum uhi.
english: In every province, wherever the king’s commandment and his decree came, there was great mourning among the Jews, and fasting, and weeping, and wailing; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes.

paite: Esther nungakte leh aheutute ahong pai ua athu amah ahilhta uhi. Huchi in kumpinu adah mahmah a, Mordekai silh ding in puansilh akhak a, amah a kipan a asai-ip puan lakhe ding in, himahleh asang kei.
english: Esther’s maidens and her eunuchs came and told her this, and the queen was exceedingly grieved. She sent clothing to Mordecai, to replace his sackcloth, but he didn’t receive it.

paite: Huchi in Esther in Hatak, kumpipa michilgehte lak a khat asam a, amah vil ding a kumpipa'n aseh, Mordekai kiang a hoh ding in thu apia hi, hiai bang thu ahi, bangziak a hichi ahia chih thei ding in.
english: Then Esther called for Hathach, one of the king’s eunuchs, whom he had appointed to attend her, and commanded him to go to Mordecai, to find out what this was, and why it was.

paite: Huchibang in kumpipa kongpi mai a om, khopi mun za ah Mordekai kiang ah Hatak ava pawtkhia hi.
english: So Hathach went out to Mordecai, to the city square which was before the king’s gate.

paite: Mordekai in atung a tung tengteng thu amah ahilh a, Judate a dia, amaute hihsiatna ding, kumpipa sumbawmte a Haman in dangka sum piak ding a achiam zah geih ahilh hi.
english: Mordecai told him of all that had happened to him, and the exact sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king’s treasuries for the destruction of the Jews.

paite: Huai lou leng Esther kiang a lak ding leh akiang a puan ding in amaute hihsiatna ding a Susa a thubawl piakkhiak laigelh kiteisawn amah apia a; kumpipa kiang ava hoh ding a hilh ding in, akiang athumna va bawl ding leh amite a dia, ama a ngetna va bawl ding in.
english: He also gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given out in Susa to destroy them, to show it to Esther, and to declare it to her, and to urge her to go in to the king to make supplication to him, and to make request before him for her people.

paite: Huchi in Hatak ahong a Mordekai thute Esther ahilh hi.
english: Hathach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.

paite: Huchih lai in Esther in Hatak kiang ah thu agen a, Mordekai a ding thukhah apia hi.
english: Then Esther spoke to Hathach, and gave him a message to Mordecai:

paite: "Kumpipa sikhate tengteng leh kumpipa bialte a mite'n athei kilkel uhi, mi kuapeuh numei, pasal leng, sap louh a, kumpipa pisa sungnungzaw pen a ahoh uleh, amah a ding in dan khat a-om a, 'Sihsak ding,' chih leh 'Ahing ding,' chi a, kumpipa'n dangka-eng kumpi chiang aletkhumte chih louh ngal, himahleh hiai ni sawmthum sung kumpipa kiang a hong pai ding in sap in ka om nai kei hi," chi in.
english: “All the king’s servants and the people of the king’s provinces know that whoever, whether man or woman, comes to the king into the inner court without being called, there is one law for him, that he be put to death, except those to whom the king might hold out the golden scepter, that he may live. I have not been called to come in to the king these thirty days.”

paite: Huan Esther thute Mordekai ahilh uhi.
english: They told Esther’s words to Mordecai.

paite: Huchih lai in Mordekai in Esther kiang a dawnna va tun nawn ding in amau achi a, "Juda tengteng sang a, kumpipa insung a nang na suahtak tuan ding kingaihtuah het ke'n.
english: Then Mordecai asked them to return this answer to Esther: “Don’t think to yourself that you will escape in the king’s house any more than all the Jews.

paite: Nang hiai hun a bangmah gen lou a na daih dideleh, mun dang a kipan in Judate ding in panpihna leh hutkhiakna ahong om ding a, himahleh nang leh na pa inkote na mangthang ding uh: hun hichibang a dia hong lal na hih mel kua'n athei a?"
english: For if you remain silent now, then relief and deliverance will come to the Jews from another place, but you and your father’s house will perish. Who knows if you haven’t come to the kingdom for such a time as this?”

paite: Huchi in Esther in Mordekai kiang a dawnna va tun ding in amau achi hi.
english: Then Esther asked them to answer Mordecai,

paite: "Kuan inla, Susa a om Judate tengteng kaikhawm inla kei a ding in an ngawl unla, ni thum, zan hiam sun hiam: nek lah ne kei unla, dawn leng dawn kei un. Huchi mah bang in ke'n leng ka nungakte toh an ka ngawl ding uh; huai chiang in kumpipa kiang ah ka hoh ngeingei ding, dan bang zaw ahi kei a, huchi a ka manleh, mang ka himai ding," achi hi.
english: “Go, gather together all the Jews who are present in Susa, and fast for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day. I and my maidens will also fast the same way. Then I will go in to the king, which is against the law; and if I perish, I perish.”

paite: Huchi in Mordekai akuan a, Esther in amah thu apiak tengteng bang in agamta hi.
english: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani thum ni in, Esther in akumpi puansilh asilh a, kumpipa' inn zawn a, kumpipa pisa sungnungzaw pen ah ava dingh a; kumpipa bel inn lutna zawn a, kumpi inn ah alaltutphah tung ah atu hi.
english: Now on the third day, Esther put on her royal clothing and stood in the inner court of the king’s house, next to the king’s house. The king sat on his royal throne in the royal house, next to the entrance of the house.

paite: Hichibang ahi a, kumpipa'n pisa a kumpinu Esther dingh amuh in, amitmuh in deihsakna atangta: kumpipa'n akhut a om dangka-eng kumpi chiang Esther lam ah alik hi. Huchi in Esther ahong painai a, kumpi chiangdawn ahong khoih hi.
english: When the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, she obtained favor in his sight; and the king held out to Esther the golden scepter that was in his hand. So Esther came near and touched the top of the scepter.

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Bang na deih a, kumpinu Esther? Na ngetna bang ahia? Gam kimkhat tan leng piak na hi ding," achi hi.
english: Then the king asked her, “What would you like, queen Esther? What is your request? It shall be given you even to the half of the kingdom.”

paite: Huchi in Esther in, "Kumpipa'n hoih asakleh tuni in kumpipa leh Haman amah a dia ka bawl an nekna ah hong pai un," achi hi.
english: Esther said, “If it seems good to the king, let the king and Haman come today to the banquet that I have prepared for him.”

paite: Huan kumpipa'n, "Esther gen bang a hih ahihtheihna ding in Haman kinohsak un," achi hi. Huchi in Esther an nekna abawl ah kumpipa leh Haman ahong uhi.
english: Then the king said, “Bring Haman quickly, so that it may be done as Esther has said.” So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

paite: Huan uain adawn lai un kumpipa'n Esther kiang ah, "Bang ahia na thumna? Phal ahihtheihna ding in bang ahia na ngetna? Gam kimkhat tan in leng piak ahi ding,” achi hi.
english: The king said to Esther at the banquet of wine, “What is your petition? It shall be granted you. What is your request? Even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.”

paite: Esther in adawng a, "Ka thumna leh ka ngetna hiai ahi:
english: Then Esther answered and said, “My petition and my request is this.

paite: Kumpipa mitmuh a deihsakna ka tanleh, ka thumna phal ding leh ka ngetna bawl ding a kumpipa alungkimleh, kumpipa leh Haman, amau a dia ka bawl ding an nekna ah hong le uh, kumpipa'n achih bang in zingchiang in ka hih ding," achi hi.
english: If I have found favor in the sight of the king, and if it pleases the king to grant my petition and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I will prepare for them, and I will do tomorrow as the king has said.”

paite: Huchi in huai ni in nuamsa leh lung kipak in Haman apaikheta a: himahleh Mordekai kumpipa kongpi a om, Haman in ama a Mordekai dingh lou a tat leng tang lou amuh in, atung ah aheh mahmah hi.
english: Then Haman went out that day joyful and glad of heart, but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king’s gate, that he didn’t stand up nor move for him, he was filled with wrath against Mordecai.

paite: Huchi in leng Haman aki-ip teitei a, inn ah apaita; huan mi asawl a alawmte leh azi Zeresh ahon tonpih hi.
english: Nevertheless Haman restrained himself, and went home. There, he sent and called for his friends and Zeresh his wife.
