paite: Nang na huih in na muta, tuipi in amau akhuhta hi; tui hatte ah ngen bang in atumta uhi.
english: You blew with your wind. The sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.

paite: "TOUPA aw, nang bang kua a-om a? pathiante lak ah! Sianthouna a thupi, phatnate a lauhuai, thillamdang hih ah, nang bang kua a-om a?
english: Who is like you, Yahweh, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?

paite: Na khut taklam na zankhia a, lei in amaute avalhta hi.
english: You stretched out your right hand. The earth swallowed them.

paite: "Na tatsa mite nang na zahngaihna in na pikhia a; na tenna siangthou ah na hatna in amaute na pita hi.
english: “You, in your loving kindness, have led the people that you have redeemed. You have guided them in your strength to your holy habitation.

paite: Mite'n aza ua, aling uhi: Lunggimna in Philistia a tengte amanta.
english: The peoples have heard. They tremble. Pangs have taken hold of the inhabitants of Philistia.

paite: Huai chiang in Edom hausate'n lamdang asa mahmah ua: Moab a mi thilhihtheite, linna in aman a; Kanaan a tengte tengteng azulmang uhi.
english: Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed. Trembling takes hold of the mighty men of Moab. All the inhabitants of Canaan have melted away.

paite: Launa leh kihtakna atung uah ahong tung a; na ban thupina in suang bang in adai dide ua; na leisa na mite'n apaikan masiah uh, TOUPA aw, na mite'n apaikan masiah uh.
english: Terror and dread falls on them. By the greatness of your arm they are as still as a stone, until your people pass over, Yahweh, until the people you have purchased pass over.

paite: Na gouluah tang ah amau na hon tun ding a, na suan ding, TOUPA aw, tenna ding a na kibawlna mun ah, Mun Siangthou ah, TOUPA aw, na khut in alamkipsa ah.
english: You will bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance, the place, Yahweh, which you have made for yourself to dwell in: the sanctuary, Lord, which your hands have established.

paite: TOUPA'N tangtawn tangtawn in vai ahawm ding."
english: Yahweh will reign forever and ever.”

paite: Pharaoh sakol kangtalaite leh asakol tungtuang mite toh tuipi ah apilut a, TOUPA'N atung uah tuipi tuite ahon nilkhawm nawn a; himahleh Israel suante tuipi tung ah gam hul ah apai uhi.
english: For the horses of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and Yahweh brought back the waters of the sea on them; but the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea.

paite: Miriam zawlneinu, Aaron sanggamnu'n khuangta akhut in ala a; numei tengteng in khuangta toh lam kawm in anung ah azui uhi.
english: Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand; and all the women went out after her with tambourines and with dances.

paite: Miriam in amaute adawng a: "Thupitak a avualzoh ziak in, TOUPA kiang ah la sa un; tuipi ah sakol leh atungtuangmi apaikheta hi," chi in.
english: Miriam answered them, “Sing to Yahweh, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.”

paite: Huchibang in Tuipi San a pan Mosi in Israelte api a, Shur gamdai ah apai ua, gamdai ah ni thum apai ua, tui amuta kei uhi.
english: Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.

paite: Marah ahong tun un, Marah tuite akhat ziak in adawn thei kei uh; huaiziak in amin Marah asa uhi.
english: When they came to Marah, they couldn’t drink from the waters of Marah, for they were bitter. Therefore its name was called Marah.

paite: Mosi dem in mite aphun ua, "Bang dawn ding i hia!" achi uhi.
english: The people murmured against Moses, saying, “What shall we drink?”

paite: TOUPA kiang ah akap a; TOUPA'N singkung khat a-ensak a, tui lak a akhiakleh, tui ahong limta hi. Huai ah amaute a ding in dan thuseh leh dan abawl a, huai ah amaute a- enchian hi.
english: Then he cried to Yahweh. Yahweh showed him a tree, and he threw it into the waters, and the waters were made sweet. There he made a statute and an ordinance for them, and there he tested them.

paite: "Lungluttak a TOUPA na Pathian aw na ngaihkhiak a, amitmuh a dik na hih a, athupiakte a bil na doh a, adan thusehte na zuihleh, Aiguptate tung a ka tut, huai hipite lak ah abangmah na tung ah ka koih kei ding. Nang hon hihdampa TOUPA ka hi ngal a," achi hi.
english: He said, “If you will diligently listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and will pay attention to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I have put on the Egyptians; for I am Yahweh who heals you.”

paite: Elim, tuikhuk sawm-le-nih omna leh tum sing sawmsagih omna ahong tung ua; huai a tuite kiang ah agiakta uhi.
english: They came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. They encamped there by the waters.

paite: Huan Elim a pan azin zom zel ua, Israel suante Aigupta gam a pan apawtkhiak nung uh akha nihna, ani sawm-le-nga ni in Israel suante Sin gamdai atung ua, huai Elim leh Sinai kikal a om ahi.
english: They took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.

paite: Gamdai ah Israel suan omkhawmte Mosi leh Aaron dem in aphun uhi.
english: The whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron in the wilderness;

paite: Israel suante'n akiang uah, "Sa bel bulte a i tut lai un, khamtak a tanghou i nek lai un, Aigupta gam ah TOUPA khut in na si zaw mai lehang. Hiai a omkhawm tengteng kial a hon that dia, hiai gamdai a na hon pikhiak tak ziak un," achi uhi.
english: and the children of Israel said to them, “We wish that we had died by Yahweh’s hand in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the meat pots, when we ate our fill of bread, for you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Ngai in, nou a ding in van a pan tanghou ka hon zusak ding. Huchi in mite apaikhe ding ua, niteng daih ding bangzah zah hiam alakhawm ding ua, ka dan ah a-om uhiam om lou, amau ka etchet theihna ding in.
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I will rain bread from the sky for you, and the people shall go out and gather a day’s portion every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in my law or not.

paite: Ani guk ni in, hichi ahi ding a, ahon lakte uh abawl ding ua; niteng a alakkhawm uh mun nih a tam ahi ding,” achi hi.
english: It shall come to pass on the sixth day, that they shall prepare that which they bring in, and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.”

paite: Mosi leh Aaron in Israel suan tengteng kiang ah, "Nitaklam in huai hun in TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan ahon pikhia chih na thei ding uhi.
english: Moses and Aaron said to all the children of Israel, “At evening, you shall know that Yahweh has brought you out from the land of Egypt.

paite: Zingsang huai hun in TOUPA thupina na mu ding ua; TOUPA kalh a na phunnate uh lah azata ngal a. Kou bang ka hi ua, ka tung ua na phun uh?"
english: In the morning, you shall see Yahweh’s glory; because he hears your murmurings against Yahweh. Who are we, that you murmur against us?”

paite: Mosi in, "Nitaklam a nek ding sa, zingsang a kham ding tanghou TOUPA'N ahon piak chiang in hiai na mu ding uhi. Amah tung a na phunnate uh TOUPA'N azata ngal a. Kou bang ka hi ua? Kou kalh a phun na hi kei ua, TOUPA kalh a phun na hi zaw uhi," achi hi.
english: Moses said, “Now Yahweh will give you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to satisfy you, because Yahweh hears your murmurings which you murmur against him. And who are we? Your murmurings are not against us, but against Yahweh.”

paite: Mosi in Aaron kiang ah thu agen a, "Israel suan omkhawm tengteng kiang ah TOUPA ma ah hong pai nai un. Na phunnate uh lah azata ngal a, chi in,” achi hi.
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Tell all the congregation of the children of Israel, ‘Come close to Yahweh, for he has heard your murmurings.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Aaron in Israel suan omkhawmte tengteng kiang a thu agen lai in, gamdai lam a-et uleh, ngai in, meipi ah TOUPA thupina ahong dawk hi.
english: As Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the children of Israel, they looked toward the wilderness, and behold, Yahweh’s glory appeared in the cloud.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante phunna ka za; akiang uah thu gen in. Nitaklam in sa na ne ding ua, zingsang lam in tanghou na kham ding uhi. Huchi in TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chih na thei ding uh," achi hi.
english: “I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel. Speak to them, saying, ‘At evening you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am Yahweh your God.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, nitaklam in vengkeng ahong tungtou ua, giahphual ahong tuamdim ua; zingsang in giahphual kimvel ah daitui akia hi.
english: In the evening, quail came up and covered the camp; and in the morning the dew lay around the camp.

paite: Daitui kia a-om nawn louhtak in, ngai in, gamdai pumpi ah thil bem neu, lei lak ah zing daitui khal ngou chia a neu a-om hi.
english: When the dew that lay had gone, behold, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on the ground.

paite: Israel suante'n amuh un, “Hiai bang ahia?" akichituah ua, bang ahia chih lah athei ngal kei ua. Mosi in akiang uah, "Hiai TOUPA'N ahon piak na nek ding uh tanghou ahi.
english: When the children of Israel saw it, they said to one another, “What is it?” For they didn’t know what it was. Moses said to them, “It is the bread which Yahweh has given you to eat.

paite: Michih in ama khamkhop ding zah la hen. Na mite uh zah dungzui in, michih a ding in omer khat la uhen chi a, TOUPA'N thu apiak hiai ahi. Michih in apuanin a om ding zah la un," achi hi.
english: This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded: ‘Gather of it everyone according to his eating; an omer a head, according to the number of your persons, you shall take it, every man for those who are in his tent.’”

paite: Israel suante'n huchibang in ahih ua, akhen in tam deuh, akhen in tawm deuh ala uhi.
english: The children of Israel did so, and some gathered more, some less.

paite: Omer a ateh uleh atam la in bangmah anei val kei a, atawm la in bangmah atasam tuan kei hi. Michih in akham ding bang zel in ala uhi.
english: When they measured it with an omer, he who gathered much had nothing over, and he who gathered little had no lack. They each gathered according to his eating.

paite: Mosi in, "Kuamah in zingsang tan nutsiat nei kei hen," achi hi.
english: Moses said to them, “Let no one leave of it until the morning.”

paite: Hinapi in Mosi angaikhe kei ua; alak ua khenkhatte'n zingchiang tan in akoihkhol ua, athan a, a-uih hi. Huchi in atung uah Mosi ahehta hi.
english: Notwithstanding they didn’t listen to Moses, but some of them left of it until the morning, so it bred worms and became foul; and Moses was angry with them.

paite: Zingsang teng in, michih in akham ding bang zel in ala ua; ni ahong sat chiang in azul hi.
english: They gathered it morning by morning, everyone according to his eating. When the sun grew hot, it melted.

paite: Ani guk ni in hichi ahong hi a, tanghou amun nih a tam mi khat a ding in omer nih zel ala uhi. Khawmpite heutu tengteng ahong ua Mosi ahilh uhi.
english: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one; and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hiai TOUPA chihsa ahi, zingchiang TOUPA a dia Sabbath siangthou khawlna ahi. Na kan nop uleh tuni in kang unla; na huan ding uleh huan un. Avalte zingchiang tan a ding in kikoih un," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “This is that which Yahweh has spoken, ‘Tomorrow is a solemn rest, a holy Sabbath to Yahweh. Bake that which you want to bake, and boil that which you want to boil; and all that remains over lay up for yourselves to be kept until the morning.’”

paite: Mosi thupiak bang in azingchiang tan akoih ua, a-uih kei a, athan leng a-om kei hi.
english: They laid it up until the morning, as Moses ordered, and it didn’t become foul, and there were no worms in it.

paite: Mosi in, "Tuni in huai ne un; tuni lah TOUPA a dia Sabbath ni ahi ngal a. Tuni in gamlak ah tanghou na mu kei ding uh.
english: Moses said, “Eat that today, for today is a Sabbath to Yahweh. Today you shall not find it in the field.

paite: Ni guk na lakhawm ding ua; himahleh ani sagih ni Sabbath ni ahi, huai ni in bangmah a-om kei ding," achi hi.
english: Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day is the Sabbath. In it there shall be none.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani sagih ni in lakhawm ding in mi khenkhat apaikhia ua, himahleh bangmah amu kei uh.
english: On the seventh day, some of the people went out to gather, and they found none.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Bang tan ka thupiakte leh ka dante zui lou ding na hi ua?
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “How long do you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws?

paite: En in, TOUPA'N Sabbath ni ahon piak ngalleh, huaiziak a, ani guk ni a ni nih a ding tanghou hon pia ahi. Michih amun ah om henla, ani sagih ni in amun a pan kuamah paikhe kei hen,” achi hi.
english: Behold, because Yahweh has given you the Sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days. Everyone stay in his place. Let no one go out of his place on the seventh day.”

paite: Huchi in mite ani sagih ni in akhawlta uhi.
english: So the people rested on the seventh day.

paite: Israel inkote'n amin Manna asa ua; koriandar tang bang ahi a, angou a; chep in tanghou pei khuaizu soh abang hi.
english: The house of Israel called its name “Manna”, and it was like coriander seed, white; and its taste was like wafers with honey.

paite: Mosi in, "Hiai thil TOUPA thupiak ahi. Na khang na khang ua ding in omer khat thundim un. Aigupta gam a pan ka hon pikhiak lai a, gamdai a ka hon vakna tanghou amuhtheihna ding un," achi hi.
english: Moses said, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded, ‘Let an omer-full of it be kept throughout your generations, that they may see the bread with which I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.’”

paite: Mosi in Aaron kiang ah, "Bel la inla, huai ah omer khat manna dim koih in, TOUPA ma ah luikhia in, na khang na khang ua zuih ding in," achi hi.
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Take a pot, and put an omer-full of manna in it, and lay it up before Yahweh, to be kept throughout your generations.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in, Aaron in Theihpihna ma ah, koih ding in aluitouta hi.
english: As Yahweh commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

paite: Gam kiluah ahong tun masiah uh, Israel suante'n kum sawmli sung manna ane uhi. Kanaan gamgi ahong tun masiah uh, manna ane uhi.
english: The children of Israel ate the manna forty years, until they came to an inhabited land. They ate the manna until they came to the borders of the land of Canaan.

paite: Omer khat, ephah khat mun sawm ahi.
english: Now an omer is one tenth of an ephah.

paite: Huan Israel suante omkhawm Sin gamdai a pan azin ua, TOUPA thupiak bang a azin nung un Rephidim ah apuanin uh akai uhi. Huai ah mite dawn ding tui a-om kei hi.
english: All the congregation of the children of Israel traveled from the wilderness of Sin, starting according to Yahweh’s commandment, and encamped in Rephidim; but there was no water for the people to drink.

paite: Huaiziak in mite'n Mosi akinakpih ua, "Ka dawn ding uh tui hon pia in," achi uhi. Mosi in akiang uah, "Bangziak a hon kinakpih na hi ua? Bangziak a TOUPA ze-et na hi ua?" achi hi.
english: Therefore the people quarreled with Moses, and said, “Give us water to drink.” Moses said to them, “Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you test Yahweh?”

paite: Mite lah tui duh in huai ah adang uh atak a; Mosi tung ah mite aphun ua, "Dangtakna a kou leh ka tate uh leh ka gante uh hon that dia, bangziak a Aigupta gam a pan hon lakhia na hia?" achi uhi.
english: The people were thirsty for water there; so the people murmured against Moses, and said, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us, our children, and our livestock with thirst?”

paite: TOUPA kiang ah Mosi akap a, "Hiai mite bang ka loh dia? Suang a hon denglum ding in mansa in a-om uhi," achi hi.
english: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “What shall I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Mite ma ah pai inla, Israel upate tonpih inla; lui na satna chiang na khut in tawi inla, pai in.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Walk on before the people, and take the elders of Israel with you, and take the rod in your hand with which you struck the Nile, and go.

paite: Ngai in, Horeb ah suangpi tung ah na ma ah ka dingh ding a, suangpi na sat dia, huai a pan tui ahong pawtkhe ding, mite'n adawntheihna ding un," achi hi. Israel upate muh in Mosi in huchibang in ahihta hi.
english: Behold, I will stand before you there on the rock in Horeb. You shall strike the rock, and water will come out of it, that the people may drink.” Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

paite: Huai mun min Massah leh Meribah asa hi, Israel suante'n TOUPA tawng a, amah chian in, "I lak uah TOUPA a-om hia, om lou," achih ziak un.
english: He called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because the children of Israel quarreled, and because they tested Yahweh, saying, “Is Yahweh among us, or not?”

paite: Huai khit in Amalek ahong kuan a, Rephidim ah Israelte ahong dou hi.
english: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

paite: Mosi in Joshua kiang ah, “Mi hon telkhia inla, pawtkhe ni in, Amalek i dou ding. Zingchiang in ka khut a Pathian' chiangkhun tawi in mualvum ah ka kuan ding," achi hi.
english: Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out to fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with God’s rod in my hand.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in akiang a, agen bang in Joshua in ahih a, Amalek adou uhi. Mosi leh Aaron leh Hur mualvum ah ahohtouta uhi.
english: So Joshua did as Moses had told him, and fought with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Mosi in akhut aliktouh chiang in, Israelte ahat ua; akhut akhiaksuk chiang in, Amalek ahat hi.
english: When Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed. When he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

paite: Himahleh Mosi khut agik a; huchi in suang ala ua, anuai ah akoih uhi. Huai tung ah amah atu a, Aaron leh Hur in akhut adoptouhsak uhi; khat in akhat lam pang, leh adang pen in akhat lam pang ah. Huchi in nitum matan akhutte apangzou hi.
english: But Moses’ hands were heavy; so they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. His hands were steady until sunset.

paite: Huchi in Joshua in Amalek leh amite anamsau in azouta hi.
english: Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Theihgige ding in hiai laibu ah gelh inla, Joshua bil ah gen nawn in. Van nuai a pan Amalek theihgigena ka koihmang sipsip ding ziak in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: that I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky.”

paite: Mosi in huai ah maitam adoh a, amin Jehovah-nissi asa hi.
english: Moses built an altar, and called its name “Yahweh our Banner”.

paite: "Akhang akhang a TOUPA'N Amalek dou gige ding chi a akichiam ziak in,” achi hi.
english: He said, “Yah has sworn: ‘Yahweh will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.’”

paite: Jethro, Midian siampu, Mosi sungpa'n, Mosi a ding leh ami Israelte a dia Pathian in ahih tengteng leh Aigupta gam a pan TOUPA'N Israelte apikhiakdan ana za hi.
english: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses and for Israel his people, how Yahweh had brought Israel out of Egypt.

paite: Huchi in Jethro, Mosi sungpa'n, Zipporah, Mosi zi, asawlkik nung in ana kem hi;
english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, received Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her away,

paite: Zipporah tapa nihte toh. Huai nih lak a khat min Gershom ahi, "Melmak gam ah mikhual ka na hi,” achih ziak in.
english: and her two sons. The name of one son was Gershom, for Moses said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land”.

paite: Adang min Eliezer ahi, "Ka pa' Pathian hon panpihpa ahi, Pharaoh namsau a pan ahon tatkhiak ziak in," achi hi.
english: The name of the other was Eliezer, for he said, “My father’s God was my help and delivered me from Pharaoh’s sword.”

paite: Jethro, Mosi sunghpa atapate leh azi toh gamdai ah Mosi kiang ah ahong hoh ua, Pathian tang a apuanin kaihna mun ah.
english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, came with Moses’ sons and his wife to Moses into the wilderness where he was encamped, at the Mountain of God.

paite: Mosi kiang ah, "Kei na sunghpa Jethro na kiang ah ka hong, na zi leh akiang a atapa nihte toh," achi hi.
english: He said to Moses, “I, your father-in-law Jethro, have come to you with your wife, and her two sons with her.”

paite: Asunghpa dawn ding in Mosi apawtkhia a, akun a, atawp a; bang na chi uhiam chi in akidongtuah ua; puanin sung ah alut uhi.
english: Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, and bowed and kissed him. They asked each other of their welfare, and they came into the tent.

paite: Mosi in asungpa, Pharaoh tung leh Aiguptate tung a Israelte ziak a TOUPA thilhih tengteng leh lampi a haksatna atung ua hong tung tengteng leh huaite a kipan TOUPA'N atatkhiakdante ahilh hi.
english: Moses told his father-in-law all that Yahweh had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardships that had come on them on the way, and how Yahweh delivered them.

paite: Aiguptate khut a pan atatkhiak, Israelte tung a TOUPA'N ahihhoihna tengteng ziak in Jethro akipak hi.
english: Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which Yahweh had done to Israel, in that he had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.

paite: Jethro in, "Aiguptate khut a pan leh Pharaoh khut a pan hon tankhepa, Aiguptate khut a pan amite tankhepa TOUPA pahtawi in om hen.
english: Jethro said, “Blessed be Yahweh, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh; who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

paite: Tu in pathian tengteng sang in TOUPA athupizaw, chih ka thei. Kisatheitak a Israel suante tung a thilhihte tung a hiai ahih tak ziak in," achi hi.
english: Now I know that Yahweh is greater than all gods because of the way that they treated people arrogantly.”

paite: Mosi sunghpa Jethro in, halmang thillat leh thillat dangte Pathian a ding in alan hi. Pathian ma a ankuang umkhawm ding in Aaron leh Israel upa tengteng ahong pai uhi.
english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God. Aaron came with all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law before God.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, azing in mipite vai hawm ding in Mosi atu hi. Mipite zingsang a pan nitaklam tan in Mosi kiang ah adingh uhi.
english: On the next day, Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from the morning to the evening.

paite: Mosi sungpa'n Mosi in mite tung a ahih tengteng amuh in, "Mite tung a hiai thil na hih bangchidan ahia? Bangziak a nang kia tangtut na hia? Bangziak a zingsang a pan nitaklam tan na kiang mite dingh uh ahia?" achi hi.
english: When Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he did to the people, he said, “What is this thing that you do for the people? Why do you sit alone, and all the people stand around you from morning to evening?”

paite: Mosi in asunghpa kiang ah, "Pathian dong dia mite ka kiang a hong pai ahi uh.
english: Moses said to his father-in-law, “Because the people come to me to inquire of God.

paite: Haksatna aneih chiang un, ka kiang ah ahong pai ua; khat leh adang kikal ah vai ka hawm a, Pathian dan thusehte leh adante ka theisak hi," achi hi.
english: When they have a matter, they come to me, and I judge between a man and his neighbor, and I make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.”

paite: Mosi sungpa'n akiang ah, "Na thilhih ahoih kei hi.
english: Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “The thing that you do is not good.

paite: Nang leh na kiang a om hiai mite na segawp mahmah ding uhi. Nang a dia hiai thil agik luat ziak in, nang kia in na hihthei kei hi.
english: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you; for the thing is too heavy for you. You are not able to perform it yourself alone.

paite: Tu in ka aw ngaikhia in, ka hon thuhilh ding hi. Na kiang ah Pathian om hen. Pathian lam ah nang mite palai na hi dia, athubuaite uh Pathian kiang ah na tun ding hi.
english: Listen now to my voice. I will give you counsel, and God be with you. You represent the people before God, and bring the causes to God.

paite: Thusehte leh dante amau na sinsak dia, apaina ding lam uh leh anasep ding uh toh na ensak ding hi.
english: You shall teach them the statutes and the laws, and shall show them the way in which they must walk, and the work that they must do.

paite: Huai lou in mite a pan hi thei, Pathian kihtakdan siamte, thutak mite, enna hote na telkhe dia, amaute atung uah na koih ding hi. Huchibang mite sangkhatte tung a vaihawmte, zakhatte tung a vaihawmte, sawmngate tung a vaihawmte leh sawmkhatte tung a vaihawmte ahi ding uh.
english: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God: men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

paite: Hun tengteng in amau mite vai hawmsak uhen. Huan hichi ahi ding a, thu lian chiteng nang kiang ahong tun ding ua, thu neu chiteng amaute'n thu akhen ding uhi. Huchi in nang a ding in abaihlamzaw dia, na puakgik hon puakpih ding uhi.
english: Let them judge the people at all times. It shall be that every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small matter they shall judge themselves. So shall it be easier for you, and they shall share the load with you.

paite: Hiai thil na hih a, huchibang a Pathian in thu ahon piakleh, huchi in na pangzou dia, hiai mite leng lungkim in amun uah apai ding uh," achi hi.
english: If you will do this thing, and God commands you so, then you will be able to endure, and all these people also will go to their place in peace.”

paite: Mosi in asunghpa aw angaikhia a, agen tengteng ahihta hi.
english: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.

paite: Israel tengteng a pan Mosi in mihitheite atelkhia a, mite tung a lutang in abawlta hi. Sangkhatte tung a vaihawmte, zakhatte tung a vaihawmte, sawmngate tung a vaihawmte leh sawmkhatte tung a vaihawmte in abawlta hi.
english: Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

paite: Hun tengteng in mite vai ahawmsak ua; thu haksate Mosi kiang ah atun ua, thu neute bel amau akhen zel uhi.
english: They judged the people at all times. They brought the hard cases to Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.

paite: Huchi in Mosi in asunghpa apaisak a, ama gam ah apaita hi.
english: Moses let his father-in-law depart, and he went his way into his own land.

paite: Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante ahong paikhiak uh; akha thumna, huai ni mah in Sinai gamdai ahong tung uhi.
english: In the third month after the children of Israel had gone out of the land of Egypt, on that same day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.

paite: Rephidim a pan pawtkhia in, Sinai gamdai ahong tung ua, gamdai ah agiak uhi. Huai ah Israelte'n tang mazawn ah puanin akai uhi.
english: When they had departed from Rephidim, and had come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mountain.

paite: Pathian kiang ah Mosi ahohtou a, TOUPA'N tang a pan amah asam a, "Hichibang in Jakob inkote kiang ah na chi dia, Israel suante na hilh ding hi:
english: Moses went up to God, and Yahweh called to him out of the mountain, saying, “This is what you shall tell the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel:

paite: Aiguptate tung a ka hih leh muvanlai khate a ka hon tuah a, keimah kiang ngei ka hon tutdan na muta uhi.
english: ‘You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings, and brought you to myself.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in, ka aw na man taktak ua, ka thukhun na zuih taktak uleh, leitung pumpi kei a ahih ziak in mite sang in kei a ding in gou manpha na hi ding uhi.
english: Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among all peoples; for all the earth is mine;

paite: Kei a ding in siampute, lalgam leh nam siangthou na hi ding uhi. Hiai thute Israel suante kiang a na gen ding ahi,” achi hi.
english: and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words which you shall speak to the children of Israel.”

paite: Mosi ahong a mite upate asamsak a, TOUPA'N amah apiak hiai thu tengteng ama uah aluita hi.
english: Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which Yahweh commanded him.

paite: Mi tengteng in kituaktak in adawng ua, "TOUPA thugen tengteng ka hih ding uh," achi uhi. Mosi in mite thu TOUPA kiang ah atun nawn hi.
english: All the people answered together, and said, “All that Yahweh has spoken we will do.” Moses reported the words of the people to Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Ngai in, na kiang ah meipi sah in ka hong, na kiang a thu ka gen chiang a mite'n azak theih ua, chik lai peuh a nang ahon gintak theihna ding un,” achi hi. Mosi in mite thu TOUPA ahilh hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I come to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and may also believe you forever.” Moses told the words of the people to Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Mite kiang ah va hoh inla, tuni leh zingchiang a ding in amaute siangsak in, apuante uh sawpsiang uhen.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go to the people, and sanctify them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments,

paite: Ani thum ni a ding in mansa in om uhen. Ani thum ni a mi tengteng mitmuh a Sinai Tang tung a TOUPA ahong paisuk ding ziak in.
english: and be ready for the third day; for on the third day Yahweh will come down in the sight of all the people on Mount Sinai.

paite: Mite kimvel ah dai na kai ding a, tang a hohtou lou ding in pilvang un, ahihkeileh tang kim khoih lou ding in pilvang un. Kuapeuh tang khoih sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
english: You shall set bounds to the people all around, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t go up onto the mountain, or touch its border. Whoever touches the mountain shall be surely put to death.

paite: Khut in alawng ding uh ahi kei, alawng peuhmah suang a denlup ngeingei ahi ding; ahihkeileh thal a kap pailet ahi ding. Ganta hiam mihing hiam hileh leng, ahing kei ding. Pengkul sawtpi agin chiang in, tang ah ahong paitou ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot through; whether it is animal or man, he shall not live.’ When the trumpet sounds long, they shall come up to the mountain.”

paite: Tang a pan mite kiang ah Mosi apaisuk a, apuante uh asawp uhi.
english: Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.

paite: Ama'n mite kiang ah, "Ni thum ni a ding in kisakhol un; na zite uh naih kei un," achi hi.
english: He said to the people, “Be ready by the third day. Don’t have sexual relations with a woman.”

paite: Ani thum ni in zingsang in hichi ahong hi a, vanpigingte leh khophiate, tang tung a meipi sah, pengkul aw angaih a ngaih ahong ging a, giahphual sung a om mi tengteng alingta uhi.
english: On the third day, when it was morning, there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud on the mountain, and the sound of an exceedingly loud trumpet; and all the people who were in the camp trembled.

paite: Mosi in puanin a pan mite Pathian toh kimu ding in ahon pikhia a; amau tang nuailam ah adingh uhi.
english: Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the lower part of the mountain.

paite: Meikuang a tang tung a kipan TOUPA ahong kumsuk ziak in Sinai Tang apumkhut vekta hi. Haltuina meikhu bang in atungkah a, atang pumpi aling zungzung hi.
english: All of Mount Sinai smoked, because Yahweh descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked greatly.

paite: Sawtpi pengkul ging angaih semsem lai in Mosi in thu agen a, Pathian in aw in amah adawng hi.
english: When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.

paite: Sinai Tang tung a tang vum tung ah TOUPA ahong paisuk hi. Atang vum tung ah TOUPA'N Mosi asamtou a, Mosi ahohtou hi.
english: Yahweh came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. Yahweh called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Paisuk inla, mite vauhilh in. En ding in TOUPA lam hong phuvang in alak ua tampi amangthang kha ding uhi.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go down, warn the people, lest they break through to Yahweh to gaze, and many of them perish.

paite: "TOUPA kiang a hong pai siampute leng kihihsiangthou uhen, huchi lou in zaw atung uah TOUPA apuakzak kha ding," achi hi.
english: Let the priests also, who come near to Yahweh, sanctify themselves, lest Yahweh break out on them.”

paite: Mosi in TOUPA kiang ah, "Sinai Tang ah mite ahong paitou thei kei ding uh. Tang kimvel in dai kai inla, hihsiangthou in chi a na hon hilh ziak in," achi hi.
english: Moses said to Yahweh, “The people can’t come up to Mount Sinai, for you warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds around the mountain, and sanctify it.’”

paite: TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Paisuk inla, huan Aaron toh hong paitou un. Himahleh siampute leh mite'n TOUPA kiang a hong ding in hon phuvang kei uhen. Huchi lou in zaw amaute tung ah apuakzak kha ding,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to him, “Go down! You shall bring Aaron up with you, but don’t let the priests and the people break through to come up to Yahweh, lest he break out against them.”

paite: Mite kiang ah Mosi ahohsuk a, akiang uah thu agenta hi.
english: So Moses went down to the people, and told them.

paite: Huan Levi inn a pan pasal khat apaikhia a, Levi tanu zi in anei hi.
english: A man of the house of Levi went and took a daughter of Levi as his wife.

paite: Huai numei in nau apai a, tapa anei a, naupang melhoih ahi chih atheih in kha thum sung aselta hi.
english: The woman conceived and bore a son. When she saw that he was a fine child, she hid him three months.

paite: Asel zoh nawn louhtak in, phaiphek bawm abawlsak a, vahaibuan leh chim in azutbit a, asung ah nau akoih a; luipang ah loupa kawm ah akoih hi.
english: When she could no longer hide him, she took a papyrus basket for him, and coated it with tar and with pitch. She put the child in it, and laid it in the reeds by the river’s bank.

paite: Asanggamnu'n bang hong suak hiam chih thei ding in gamla kuam ah adingh hi.
english: His sister stood far off, to see what would be done to him.

paite: Pharaoh tanu lui ah kisil ding in ahong paisuk a; anungzui numeite toh lui gei ah avak uhi. Loupa lak a bawm amu a, asikha numei khat va la ding in asawl hi.
english: Pharaoh’s daughter came down to bathe at the river. Her maidens walked along by the riverside. She saw the basket among the reeds, and sent her servant to get it.

paite: Ahonleh, naupang amuta a, ngai in, naungek akapta hi. Alainat a, "Hiai Hebru tate lak a khat ahi," achi hi.
english: She opened it, and saw the child, and behold, the baby cried. She had compassion on him, and said, “This is one of the Hebrews’ children.”

paite: Asanggamnu'n Pharaoh tanu kiang ah, "Naungek hon donsak ding, Hebru numeite lak a naudonmi khat hon va sapsak leng na ut hia?" achi hi.
english: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Should I go and call a nurse for you from the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for you?”

paite: Pharaoh tanu in akiang ah, "Va kuan in,” achi hi. Nungak akuanta a, naungek nu ava samta hi.
english: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Go.” The young woman went and called the child’s mother.

paite: Pharaoh tanu in akiang ah, "Hiai naungek la inla, hon donsak in. Na loh ka hon pe na ding," achi hi. Huchi in huai numei in nau alata a, adonta hi.
english: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child away, and nurse him for me, and I will give you your wages.” The woman took the child, and nursed him.

paite: Naungek ahong khanglian a, Pharaoh tanu kiang ah ahon pi a, huchi in atapa ahong hita hi. "Tui a pan ka kaihkhiak ahih ziak in, chi in amin Mosi asa hi."
english: The child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses, and said, “Because I drew him out of the water.”

paite: Huai lai in hichi ahong hi a, Mosi ahong khanlet in chipihte kiang ah ava hoh a, apuakgikte uh ava mu hi. Asanggamte lak a khat, Hebru mi khat Aigupta mi in avuak lai ava muta hi.
english: In those days, when Moses had grown up, he went out to his brothers and saw their burdens. He saw an Egyptian striking a Hebrew, one of his brothers.

paite: Adak loplop a, kuamah a-om kei chih atheihtak in, Aigupta mi athat a, piaunel ah asel hi.
english: He looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no one, he killed the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.

paite: Huan ani nih ni a, ava hoh nawnleh, ngai in, Hebru mite lak a mi nih ana kisual ua; gilou hihpa kiang ah, "Bangziak a na lawm vua na hia?" achi hi.
english: He went out the second day, and behold, two men of the Hebrews were fighting with each other. He said to him who did the wrong, “Why do you strike your fellow?”

paite: Ama'n, "Ka tung ua lal leh vaihawm dia nang kua'n hon bawl ahia? Aigupta mi na thah bang a, hon thah tum na hi maw?" achi hi. Huchi in Mosi in alau a, “Hiai thil kitheikhe petmah ahita ve,” achi hi.
english: He said, “Who made you a prince and a judge over us? Do you plan to kill me, as you killed the Egyptian?” Moses was afraid, and said, “Surely this thing is known.”

paite: Pharaoh in hiai azak in, thah ding in Mosi azongta hi. Himahleh Pharaoh mai a pan Mosi ataimang a, Midian gam ah ava teng a; tuileh kiang ah atu hi.
english: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and lived in the land of Midian, and he sat down by a well.

paite: Midian siampu in tanu sagih anei a, amau ahong pai ua, tui ahong tawi ua, apa uh belamhonte piak ding in atuitheite adim uhi.
english: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters. They came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.

paite: Belamchingte ahong pai ua, ahawlmangsak uhi. Himahleh, Mosi adingtou a, amau apanpih a, abelamhonte uh tui apia hi.
english: The shepherds came and drove them away; but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.

paite: Apa uh Reuel kiang a ahong paitak un, "Bangziak a, tuni'n hong pai baih ve uchia?" ana chi hi.
english: When they came to Reuel, their father, he said, “How is it that you have returned so early today?”

paite: Amau, "Belamchingte khut a pan Aigupta mi khat in hon hunkhia a, tui leng ahon tawisak a, belamhonte tui apia hi,” achi uhi.
english: They said, “An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and moreover he drew water for us, and watered the flock.”

paite: Ama'n atanute kiang ah, "Ahihleh amah koi a om ahia? Bangziak a huai mi hon nusia? An ne ding in va sam ve ua," achi hi.
english: He said to his daughters, “Where is he? Why is it that you have left the man? Call him, that he may eat bread.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi bel huai mi kiang a ten alungkim a, ama'n atanu Zipporah, Mosi apeta hi.
english: Moses was content to dwell with the man. He gave Moses Zipporah, his daughter.

paite: Ama'n tapa aneihsak a, "Melmak gam ah mikhual ka hita," achih ziak in amin Gershom asa hi.
english: She bore a son, and he named him Gershom, for he said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land.”

paite: Hun hong pai zel in hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta kumpipa asita a, huchi in akoltan ziak un Israel suante athumthum ua, akap ua, koltan ziak a akahna uh Pathian kiang atungtou hi.
english: In the course of those many days, the king of Egypt died, and the children of Israel sighed because of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up to God because of the bondage.

paite: Amauna uh Pathian in aza a, huchi in Pathian in Abraham toh, Isak toh leh Jakob toh athukhun atheigige hi.
english: God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

paite: Pathian in Israel suante a-en a, Pathian in amau aphawk hi.
english: God saw the children of Israel, and God understood.

paite: Huan Pathian in huchi a chi in hiai thute tengteng agen hi.
english: God spoke all these words, saying,

paite: Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh, Aigupta gam a kipan leh saltanna inn a pan hon pikhepa ka hi;
english: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

paite: ka ma ah keimah lou ngal pathian dangte na nei ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall have no other gods before me.

paite: Milim gelhthoh himhim ahihkeileh tunglam van a om thil lim kibatpih mawngmawng hiam nuai lei a om hiam lei nuai a tui sung a om kibatpih na kibawl ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not make for yourselves an idol, nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above, or that is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:

paite: Akiang uah na kun ding ahi kei, a-nna uh leng na sem ding ahi kei. Kei lah TOUPA na Pathian, mullit hat Pathian, kei hon hote khang thumna leh khang lina tan a, pate gitlouhna tate tung a thuk ka hi ngal a,
english: you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, Yahweh your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me,

paite: kei hon it a, ka thupiakte zuite lak a sang tampite kiang a zahngaihna lak zelpa ka hi.
english: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian min na mawk gen ding ahi kei; amin mawk genmi lah TOUPA'N moh lou in akoih ngal kei a.
english: “You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God, for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.

paite: Sabbath ni siangthou a tan ding theigige in.
english: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.

paite: Ni guk sung teng nna na sem ding a, na nna tengteng nasep ding ahi.
english: You shall labor six days, and do all your work,

paite: Himahleh ani sagihna TOUPA na Pathian Sabbath ni ahi. Huai ah nna himhim; nang leng, na tapa in leng, na tanu in leng, na sikhapa hiam, na sikhanu hiam, na ganta hiam, na huangsung a om na mikhual hiam in leng asem ding ahi kei.
english: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God. You shall not do any work in it, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates;

paite: Ani guk ni in TOUPA'N lei leh van, tuipi leh asung ua om tengteng bawl in, ani sagih ni in akhawl ngal a. Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Sabbath ni vualzawl in, atang siangthou hi.
english: for in six days Yahweh made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore Yahweh blessed the Sabbath day, and made it holy.

paite: Na nu leh na pa zahtak in. TOUPA na Pathian in ahon piak gam a na nite asautheihna ding in.
english: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

paite: Tual na that ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not murder.

paite: Ang na kawm ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not commit adultery.

paite: Na gu ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not steal.

paite: Na inveng siatna ding in palai taklou na hi ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

paite: Na inveng inn na eng ding ahi kei. Na inveng zi na eng ding ahi kei, asikhapa leng, asikhanu leng, abawngtal hiam, asabiltung hiam, thil himhim na inveng a peuhpeuh.
english: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor’s.”

paite: Mi tengteng in vanpigingte, khophiate, pengkul husate leh tang kang khu amu ua; mite'n huaite amuh un, akisuan ua, gamlapi ah adingh uhi.
english: All the people perceived the thunderings, the lightnings, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. When the people saw it, they trembled, and stayed at a distance.

paite: Mosi kiang ah, "Ka kiang uah thu gen inla, ka hon ngaikhe ding uhi. Himahleh Pathian in hon houpih kei hen, ka si kha ding uh," achi uhi.
english: They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”

paite: Mosi in akiang uah, "Lau kei un. Amah launa na ma ua a-om a, na khelhlouhna ding un, noute hon enchian ding a Pathian hong pai ahih ziak in," achi hi.
english: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you won’t sin.”

paite: Mite gamlatak ah adingh ua, Pathian omna mun mial bikbek lam ah Mosi ava pai nai hi.
english: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, Israel kiang ah hichibang in na chi ding, "Van a pan nou ka hon houpih na muta uhi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

paite: Kei lou dangka pathiante na kibawl ding uh ahi kei. Dangka-eng pathiante leng na kibawl ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall most certainly not make gods of silver or gods of gold for yourselves to be alongside me.

paite: Kei a ding in lei maitam na bawl ding ua, huai ah na halmang thillatte leh na lemna thillatte, na belamte leh na bawngtalte na lan ding uh ahi. Mun tengteng a ka min ka khumna ah na kiang uah ka hong dia, ka hon vualzawl ding hi.
english: You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your cattle. In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you.

paite: Suang maitam na hon bawlsakleh, suangsek a na bawl louh ding ahi. Suang tung a na vanzat na likleh, na hihnin ahi ngal a.
english: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.

paite: Huai a na vuaktanna adawklouhna ding in, ka maitam ah kalbi in na kahtou ding ahi kei," achi hi.
english: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.’

paite: Huan hiai vaihawmnate, ama ua na ngak dingte ahi uhi.
english: “Now these are the ordinances which you shall set before them:

paite: Hebru sikha na leileh, kum guk sung nang nna asem ding a, akum sagihna ah bangmah pe lou in noplen in apawtkhe ding.
english: “If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.

paite: Ama tum a hong lut ahihleh, ama tum mah in apawtkhe ding. Zi nei ahihleh, azi in amah azuikhe ding.
english: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.

paite: Apu in zi apiak a, tapate hiam tanute hiam aneihsakleh, azi leh atate apu a ahi ding ua, amah kia in apawtkhe ding.
english: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.

paite: Sikha in teltak a, "Ka pu ka it, ka zi leh ka tate ka it; noplen in ka pawtkhe kei ding," achihleh;
english: But if the servant shall plainly say, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children. I will not go out free;’

paite: apu in vaihawmte kiang ah amah api dia; kongkhak chiang ah hiam kongkhak khuam chiang ah hiam api dia, apu'n vuhna in abil avut pailet ding. Huchi in ama'n apu nna asem tawntung ding hi.
english: then his master shall bring him to God, and shall bring him to the door or to the doorpost, and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall serve him forever.

paite: Mi'n sikhanu ding a atanu azuakleh, sikhapate bang in apaikhe kei ding.
english: “If a man sells his daughter to be a female servant, she shall not go out as the male servants do.

paite: Amah khampa, apu alung-kimsak keileh, apa atankiksak ding. Atung ah muanhuai loutak a ahihleh melmak nam kiang a zuak ding in thuneihna anei kei.
english: If she doesn’t please her master, who has married her to himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since he has dealt deceitfully with her.

paite: Atapa zi dia adeihleh, tanute bang in abawl ding hi.
english: If he marries her to his son, he shall deal with her as a daughter.

paite: Ama'n zi dang aneihthuahleh, a-an nek, apuansilh leh apiak ding a kilawm asukkiam louh ding ahi.
english: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marital rights.

paite: Atung a hiai thumte ahihkeileh, sum-le-pai pe lou in nonlen in apawtkhe ding ahi.
english: If he doesn’t do these three things for her, she may go free without paying any money.

paite: Asihna dia mi vua peuhmah, sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,

paite: Mi'n thah ding a na buk lou ahih a, Pathian in akhut a amah apiakkhiakleh, ataikhiakna ding mun ka sehsak ding hi.
english: but not if it is unintentional, but God allows it to happen; then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee.

paite: Himahleh mi khatpeuh in tupmawng in a-invengte tung ah gitlouh piltak in asihna ding in gamta taleh, ka maitam a pan amah na lakhe dia, asih ding ahi.
english: If a man schemes and comes presumptuously on his neighbor to kill him, you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.

paite: Kuapeuh apa hiam, anu hiam vomi, sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “Anyone who attacks his father or his mother shall be surely put to death.

paite: Kuapeuh mihing gu a zuakmi, ahihkeileh akhut ah muhkhiak a ommi, amah sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

paite: Kuapeuh anu leh pa hamsiatmi, sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.

paite: Mite kisual uhenla, khat in khat suang in deng hiam, akhuttum hiam in tum henla, si lou in, lupna ngak taleh;
english: “If men quarrel and one strikes the other with a stone, or with his fist, and he doesn’t die, but is confined to bed;

paite: thou nawn in, chiangkhun khun in kholak vakleh, avopa ahul dia; ahun sukbei man ape dia, amah adamsiangsak sipsip ding hi.
english: if he rises again and walks around with his staff, then he who struck him shall be cleared; only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall provide for his healing until he is thoroughly healed.

paite: Mi'n chiang in asikhapa hiam, asikhanu hiam sat henla, akhutlum in si taleh amah gawt ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “If a man strikes his servant or his maid with a rod, and he dies under his hand, the man shall surely be punished.

paite: Himahleh ni khat hiam, ni nih hiam nung a dam a, athohzohleh, gawt louh ding ahi; amah apu neihsa ahih ziak in.
english: Notwithstanding, if his servant gets up after a day or two, he shall not be punished, for the servant is his property.

paite: Mite kisual in, numei gai lai hihna in, anau tolh henla, himahleh siatdetna in zui keileh; numeinu pasal in atung a, achih bangbang a gawt ngeingei ding ahi. Vaihawmte'n abikhiah bang uh aliau ding hi.
english: “If men fight and hurt a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely, and yet no harm follows, he shall be surely fined as much as the woman’s husband demands and the judges allow.

paite: Siatna mawngmawng in zui taleh hinna tang a hinna apiak ding ahi.
english: But if any harm follows, then you must take life for life,

paite: Mit tang a mit, ha tang a ha, khut tang a khut, khe tang a khe.
english: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

paite: Mei a hal tang a mei a hal, liam tang a liam, pawn tang a pawn.
english: burning for burning, wound for wound, and bruise for bruise.

paite: Mi'n asikha mit hiam, asikhanu mit hiam suksak in, se taleh amit ziak in noplen in akhah ding ahi.
english: “If a man strikes his servant’s eye, or his maid’s eye, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.

paite: Asikhapa ha hiam, asikhanu ha hiam sukhe taleh, aha ziak in noplen in akhah ding ahi.
english: If he strikes out his male servant’s tooth, or his female servant’s tooth, he shall let the servant go free for his tooth’s sake.

paite: Bawngtal in pasal hiam, numei hiam, asik ziak in si taleh; huai bawngtal denlup ngeingei ding ahi. Asa nek louh hial ding ahi. Himahleh abawngtal nei pen gawt louh in asuakta ding hi.
english: “If a bull gores a man or a woman to death, the bull shall surely be stoned, and its meat shall not be eaten; but the owner of the bull shall not be held responsible.

paite: Himahleh huai bawngtal amalam a, akii a misik hat hi a, aneitu kiang a hilhsa leng hinapi a, ama'n ana khum tuan lou ahihleh, pasal hiam, numei hiam ana siklupleh, huai bawngtal denlup ding ahi a; aneitu leng sihsak ding ahi.
english: But if the bull had a habit of goring in the past, and this has been testified to its owner, and he has not kept it in, but it has killed a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner shall also be put to death.

paite: Atung ah dangka sum akiphutleh, akiphut bangbang ahinna tatna man ding in ape ding ahi.
english: If a ransom is imposed on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed.

paite: Tapa hiam, tanu hiam ana sikleh, hiai vaihawmna bang a, atung a hih ding ahi.
english: Whether it has gored a son or has gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.

paite: Bawngtal in sikhapa hiam sikhanu hiam asikleh, apu kiang ah dangka shekel sawmthum ape dia, bawngtal pen denlup ding ahi.
english: If the bull gores a male servant or a female servant, thirty shekels of silver shall be given to their master, and the ox shall be stoned.

paite: Pasal in kokhuk sin hong henla, ahihkeileh pasal in kokhuk tou henla, sin kei henla, asung ah bawngtal hiam sabiltung hiam ke taleh,
english: “If a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and doesn’t cover it, and a bull or a donkey falls into it,

paite: kokhuk neitu in abawlhoih a, aneipa kiang a dangka sum apiak ding ahi. Huchi in aganta si pen amah a ahi ding.
english: the owner of the pit shall make it good. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead animal shall be his.

paite: Mi khat bawngtal in midang khat bawngtal mah hih na kha henla, si taleh; abawngtal hing lai pen azuak ding ua, asum akihawm ding uhi. Abawngtal si pen leng akihawm ding uh ahi.
english: “If one man’s bull injures another’s, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live bull, and divide its price; and they shall also divide the dead animal.

paite: Ahihkeileh amalam a huai bawngtal sik hat ahi chih akitheih a, aneitu in akhum kei chih akitheihleh; bawngtal tang a bawngtal apiak ngeingei ding ahi. Huchi in aganta si pen amah a tuam ahi ding hi.
english: Or if it is known that the bull was in the habit of goring in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall surely pay bull for bull, and the dead animal shall be his own.

paite: Mi'n bawngtal hiam, belam hiam gu in gou hiam zuak taleh; bawngtal khat gun in bawngtal nga, belam khat gun in belam li a adit ding ahi.
english: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

paite: Guta inn luh kimu in, kivua in si taleh, avopa pen sisan suah chi a mohsak theih ahi kei ding.
english: If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.

paite: Himahleh atung a ni asuah nung ahihleh sisan suah chi a mohpaih theih ahi ding. Ditna kim apiak ding ahi. Piak ding bangmah aneih keileh, aguktak ziak a amah zuak ding ahi.
english: If the sun has risen on him, he is guilty of bloodshed. He shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

paite: Avan guk akhut a hing a akimuhleh, bawngtal hiam ahihkeileh sabiltung hiam, ahihkeileh belam hiam hitaleh, amun nih apiakkik ding ahi.
english: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double.

paite: Mi'n lou hiam, grephuan hiam nek a omsak in, aganta lutsak in, midang lou ah va ta taleh; ama lou hoihna pen leh ama grephuan hoihna pen a pan ditna abawl ding ahi.
english: “If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten by letting his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard.

paite: Mei hong kang in, ling lak hong kuang in, buh hiam ahihkeileh hai dingh lai hiam ahihkeileh lou kangse taleh; amei khahpa'n ditna abawl ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “If fire breaks out, and catches in thorns so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

paite: Mi'n a-invengpa kep ding in dangka sum hiam van hiam pekhia henla, huai mi inn a pan kigu taleh; guta akimuhleh azahnih pia hen.
english: “If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house, if the thief is found, he shall pay double.

paite: Guta akimuh keileh, a-invengpa van tung ah akhut akha na hiam, chih theihna ding in vaihawmte kiang ah inn neipa api ding ahi.
english: If the thief isn’t found, then the master of the house shall come near to God, to find out whether or not he has put his hand on his neighbor’s goods.

paite: Tatlekna chiteng, bawngtal thu ah hiam, sabiltung thu ah hiam, belam thu ah hiam, puansilh thu ah hiam, van mansak thu ah hiam, midang in kei a ahi, achihleh, alang tuak thu vaihawmte ma atut ding ahi. Vaihawmte mohpaihpa'n a-invengpa aleh nih apiak ding ahi.
english: For every matter of trespass, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’ the cause of both parties shall come before God. He whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor.

paite: Mi'n a-invengpa kiang ah akep ding in sabiltung hiam, bawngtal hiam, belam hiam gan himhim hiam pekhia henla; si hiam, liam hiam, hawlmang hiam a om in, kuamah in mu kei taleh;
english: “If a man delivers to his neighbor a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it dies or is injured, or driven away, no man seeing it;

paite: TOUPA kichiamna amau gel kikal ah a-om dia; a-invengpa' van tung ah akhut akha kei chihna; avan neipa'n huai apom dia, adin kei ding hi.
english: the oath of Yahweh shall be between them both, he has not put his hand on his neighbor’s goods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.

paite: Amah a pan guk a-omleh, aneipa kiang ah ditna abawl ding hi.
english: But if it is stolen from him, the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner.

paite: Gan balnen in ana om taleh, atheihpihna ding in asa hon tawi hen, balnen a om pen adin kei ding hi.
english: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make good that which was torn.

paite: Mi'n a-invengpa banghiam khel henla, anei pen om louh kal in liam in hiam si hiam in om taleh, adit ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.

paite: Himahleh aneipa akiang a om ahihleh adin kei ding. Van khelh man in adin khin lel hi.
english: If its owner is with it, he shall not make it good. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease.

paite: Khamsa hilou nungak siangthou khat pasal in zol henla, kithuahpih taleh, mou man pia in zi in anei ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.

paite: Anumei pa'n akiang a piak anial bilbelleh, nungak siangthoute man dungzui in sum ape ding hi.
english: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

paite: Dawizawl ahin na phal ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not allow a sorceress to live.

paite: Ganta kithuahpih peuhmah sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.

paite: TOUPA kiang kia lou ngal, pathian himhim kiang a kithoih peuhmah hihsiat dimdem ding ahi.
english: “He who sacrifices to any god, except to Yahweh only, shall be utterly destroyed.

paite: Mikhual na subuai hiam, na nuaisiah hiam ding ahi kei hi; Aigupta gam a mikhual na hih tak ziak un.
english: “You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

paite: Meithai hiam, pa nei lou naupang hiam na hihgenthei ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.

paite: Bangchiteng a amau na gentheihsak a, ka kiang a ahong kah peuhmah uleh, akahna uh ka ngaikhe ngeingei ding hi.
english: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;

paite: Ka thangpaihna asou dia, namsau in ka hon that ding hi. Na zite uh meithai ahi ding ua, na tate uh pa nei lou ahi ding uhi.
english: and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

paite: Na kiang ua om ka mite lak a mizawng kuapeuh kiang a sum na leitawi sakleh, leitawisakmi hih bang a sumpung na nek louh ding ahi.
english: “If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not charge him interest.

paite: Kichiamna a na inveng puansilh na lakleh, ni tum ma a ama kiang a na va piakkik ding ahi.
english: If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,

paite: Huai lah akikhuhna neihsun ahi ngal a, avun a ding a apuansilh ahi. Bang in a-ihmu dia? Hichi ahi dia, ka kiang a, ahong kah chiang in ka za ding; hehpih thei ka hih ziak in.
english: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for I am gracious.

paite: Pathian na enghou ding ahi kei a, na mite vaihawmmi leng na hamsiat ding ahi kei hi.
english: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.

paite: Na theigah min masate, na uain masate lan ding in na zekai ding ahi kei. Na tapate lak a piang masapen kei na hon piak ding ahi.
english: “You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. “You shall give the firstborn of your sons to me.

paite: Huchi mah bang in na bawngtalte lak ah leng na hih ding ahi. Na belamte lak ah leng hiai bang in na hih ding ahi. Ni sagih sung api kiang ah na omsak dia, ani giat ni a kei na hon piak ding ahi.
english: You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. It shall be with its mother seven days, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me.

paite: Kei a dia misiangthoute na hih ding uh ahi. Huaiziak in gamlak a gamsa nek bang sa himhim na nek louh ding uh ahi a; uite na pe zaw ding uhi.
english: “You shall be holy men to me, therefore you shall not eat any meat that is torn by animals in the field. You shall cast it to the dogs.

paite: Thutut zuau na genzak ding ahi kei. Theihpih diklou hi ding in migiloute toh na kizop ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.

paite: Gilou hih ding in mipi na zui ding ahi kei. Vaihawmna kaikawi ding in mi tam lamlam zui in amau na gum ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.

paite: Thubuai genna ah mizawng dou in guptuam na nei ding ahi kei.
english: You shall not favor a poor man in his cause.

paite: Na melma bawngtal hiam sabiltung hiam taimang na tuahleh, akiang a na pi nawn ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.

paite: Nang hon homi' sabiltung, avan puak lel a puk na muhleh taisan lou a, na panpih ngeingei ding ahi.
english: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him with it.

paite: Thubuai a kihekna ah mizawngte a ding in thukhenna na kaikawi ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.

paite: Thil diklou a pan gamlapi ah om in, thil hihkhial lou leh midikte that ke'n; migiloute siamtangsak lou ding ka hih ziak in.
english: “Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked.

paite: Golhgukna na la ding ahi kei. Golhgukna in mit atosak a, midiktatte thu akaikawi ngal hi.
english: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.

paite: Huai lou in mikhual na hihgenthei ding ahi kei. Mikhual lungtang na theih ziak in, Aigupta gam ah mikhual in na om ngeita uh, chih thei in.
english: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

paite: Kum guk sung na gam ah haichi na tuh dia, agahte na lakhawm ding,
english: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,

paite: himahleh akum sagihna na omsak kinken a, na khawlsak ding ahi; na mite lak a mizawngte'n anektheihna ding un. Anutsiat peuh uh gamlak sate'n ane ding uhi. Huchibang mah in na grephuan leh na olive huan tung ah na hih ding uhi.
english: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.

paite: Ni guk sung nangmah nna na sem dia, ani sagih ni in na khawl ding; na bawngtal leh na sabiltung akhawl ua, na sikhanu tapa leh mikhual ahalhtheihna ding un.
english: “Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant, and the alien may be refreshed.

paite: Na kiang a ka gen tengteng zui ding in pilvang inla; pathian dangte min lou ke'n, na kam a pan zak in leng om kei hen.
english: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.

paite: Kum khat sung in ka kiang ah ankuangluina thumvei na bawl ding ahi.
english: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.

paite: Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina bawl in ka hon thupiak bang in, Abib kha a hun sehsa in, ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding ahi, huai ni a Aigupta a pan hong paikhia na hih ziak in. Ka ma a kuamah khutvuak a ahong kilat ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.

paite: Pawltak Ankuanglui, na sepgim gahte, lou a na tuh Puaklutna Ankuangluina na bawl ding ahi. Na lou a pan na sepgimna gahte na puaklut khit chiang in kum tawp ah, Puaklut Ankuanglui na bawl ding ahi.
english: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.

paite: Kum khat sung in thumvei pasal tengteng Toupa PATHIAN ma a akilat ding uh ahi.
english: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Ka kithoihna sisan, tanghou silngou soh toh na lat ding ahi kei. Ka kithoihna thau a zingsang chiang tan in a-om ding leng ahi kei hi,
english: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian inn a na gam gah masa hoihpente lak a masapen na laklut ding ahi. Kelnou, api nawitui in na huan ding ahi kei.
english: You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of Yahweh your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.

paite: Ngai in, lampi a nang hon kem ding leh ka mun bawlsa a nang hon tun ding in na ma ah Angel khat ka sawl hi.
english: “Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.

paite: Ama ah pilvang inla, a-aw zui in hehsak ke'n; na tatleknate angaihdam louh ding ziak in, ka min lah amah ah a-om ngal a.
english: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him.

paite: Himahleh a-aw na zuih taktak a, ka gen tengteng na hihleh; na melmate tung ah melma ka hi dia, nang hon doute tung ah doumi ka hi ding hi.
english: But if you indeed listen to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries.

paite: Na ma ah ka Angel pai ding ahi, Amorte, Hitte, Perizte, Kanaante, Hivte leh Jebuste lak ah nang ahon pilut ding hi; huchi in amaute ka satkhe ding hi.
english: For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.

paite: Apathiante uh ma ah na kun ding ahi kei. A-nna uh leng na sem ding ahi sam kei. Athilhihte bang uh leng na hih ding uh ahi kei. Himahleh amaute na zou siang sipsip dia, amilimte uh na hihzan dimdem ding ahi.
english: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh nna na sem ding ua, ama'n na annek-tuidawn uh avualzawl ding hi. Huchi in na lak ua pan chinatna ka lamang ding hi.
english: You shall serve Yahweh your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you.

paite: Kuamah nausia a-om kei dia, na gamsung uah kuamah aching kei ding. Na nite zah uh ka tangtungsak ding hi.
english: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.

paite: Na ma uah kei lauhna ka sawl dia, na hong tunna mi tengteng lak ah buaizakna ka omsak ding hi. Huchi in na melma tengteng nang a pan ka taikeksak ding hi.
english: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.

paite: Na ma ah khuaizanta ka sawl dia, huai in Hivte, Kanaante leh Hitte na ma a pan ahawlkhe ding hi.
english: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.

paite: Kum khat sung in amaute na ma a pan ka hawlkhe kei ding. Agam ahong vuak dia, noute hon hihse ding in gamsa ahong pung kha ding hi.
english: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.

paite: Na hong pun ua, gam na luah mateng, na ma ua pan amaute tawm khakha in ka hawlkhe ding hi.
english: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.

paite: Tuipi San a pan Philistiate tuipi pha hial in, gamdai a pan Lui chiang pha in na gamgi ka khung ding. Na khut ua agam luah mite ka hon piakkhiak ding ziak in na ma uah amaute na hawlkhe ding uhi.
english: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.

paite: Amaute toh hiam apathiante uh toh hiam leng thukhun na bawl ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

paite: Na gamsung uah ateng ding uh ahi kei. Ka tung ah nang ahon khialsak kha ding uhi. Apathiante uh nna na sep uleh huaite nou a ding in thang ahi ding hi.
english: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”

paite: Huai nung in Pathian in Mosi kiang ah, “TOUPA kiang ah hong tou in, nang leh Aaron, Nadab leh Abihu leh Israel upate lak a sawmsagihte, gamlapi a pan in Pathian bia un.
english: He said to Moses, “Come up to Yahweh, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance.

paite: Mosi kia TOUPA kiang ah ahong pai ding, himahleh amau ahong pai nai louh ding uh ahi. Mite leng amah toh ahong hohtouh louh ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: Moses alone shall come near to Yahweh, but they shall not come near. The people shall not go up with him.”

paite: Mosi ahong pai a, TOUPA thute leh vaihawmna tengteng mite ahilhta hi. Mite'n aw kituak in adawng ua, "TOUPA'N agen thu tengteng ka hih ding uh," achi uhi.
english: Moses came and told the people all Yahweh’s words, and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, and said, “All the words which Yahweh has spoken will we do.”

paite: TOUPA thu tengteng Mosi in agelh a, zingsang in beltak in athou a, tang nuai ah maitam abawl a, Israel nam sawm-le-nih dungzui in, khuam sawm-le-nih aphut hi.
english: Moses wrote all Yahweh’s words, then rose up early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain, with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.

paite: Ama'n Israel suante lak a tangvalte asawl a, amau TOUPA kiang ah halmang thillat leh lemna thillat in bawngtalte alan uhi.
english: He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to Yahweh.

paite: Mosi in bawngtalte sisan kimkhat ala a, kuangdai sung ah akoih a; maitam tung ah asisan kimkhat atheh hi.
english: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

paite: Thukhun Laibu ala a, mite zak in asim hi. Mite'n, "TOUPA'N agen tengteng hih in athu ka mang ding uhi," achi uhi.
english: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, “We will do all that Yahweh has said, and be obedient.”

paite: Mosi in sisan ala a mite tung ah atheh a, "Thukhun sisan en un, hiai thu tengteng thu a TOUPA'N akhun," achi hi.
english: Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, “Look, this is the blood of the covenant, which Yahweh has made with you concerning all these words.”

paite: Mosi, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu leh Israel Upa sawmsagihte apaitou ua
english: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up.

paite: Israel' Pathian ava mu uhi. Akhepek nuai ah sapphir a bawl hileh kilawm leh van bang a siang a-om hi.
english: They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire stone, like the skies for clearness.

paite: Himahleh Israel suante lak a upate dou in Pathian in atung uah akhut alik kei hi. Amau leng Pathian mu napi in hingdam a om in ne in adawn uhi.
english: He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Tang ah ka kiang ah hong tou inla, huai ah om in. Suangpekte a ka gelhsa dan leh thupiakte ka hon pe ding; amaute na sinsak theihna ding in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written, that you may teach them.”

paite: Mosi leh amah huhpa Joshua adingkhia ua, Pathian tang ah ahohtou uhi.
english: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.

paite: Upate kiang ah, na kiang ua ka hong kik nawn masiah uh hiai ah hon ngak un. "Ngai un, Aaron leh Hur na ompih uhi. Mi kuapeuh in thubuai bangpeuh gen ding na neih uleh, amah akiang uah hong hoh hen," achi hi.
english: He said to the elders, “Wait here for us, until we come again to you. Behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever is involved in a dispute can go to them.”

paite: Tang ah Mosi ahohtou a, meipi in tang akhuhta hi.
english: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.

paite: Sinai Tang tung ah TOUPA thupina a-om a, meipi in ni guk sung akhuh hi. Ani sagih ni in meipi lak a kipan Mosi asamta hi.
english: Yahweh’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. The seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud.

paite: Tang vum tung a TOUPA thupina, Israel suante muh in kangmang thei meikuang bang ahi.
english: The appearance of Yahweh’s glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.

paite: Meipi lak ah Mosi alutta a, tang ah ava hohtou hi. Mosi tang ah ni sawmli leh zan sawmli ava omta hi.
english: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Thillat ahon tawitheihna ding un, Israel suante kiang ah thu gen in. Michih lungtang a uttak a pete a pan thilpiak na la ding hi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering.

paite: Amau a pan thilpiak na lak ding hiai bang ahi. Dangka-eng leh dangka leh dal.
english: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,

paite: Puanmalngat dum, khau sandup leh khau san-au leh khau hoih leh kel mul.
english: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,

paite: Belampa vun sansaksa leh ngalvang vun leh singgi sing.
english: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,

paite: Vak ding in sathau, thaunuh ding gimlim, gimnamtui a ding toh.
english: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

paite: Onik suangte, siampu puan leh awmtuamna a siat ding suangte.
english: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.

paite: Alak ua ka tentheihna ding in mun siangthou hon bawlsak uhen.
english: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.
