paite: Nang ka hon etsak bangbang in, biakbuk lim bang in leh avanzat tengteng lim bang in na bawl ding ahi.
english: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it.

paite: "Singgi sing in thukhun bawm na bawl ding ahi. Adunglam tong nih-le-akim ahi dia, availam tong khat-le-akim ahi dia, asanlam tong khat-le-akim ahi ding hi.
english: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits, its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.

paite: Dangka-engtak in na luan dia, asunglam leh apolam na luan dia, akimvel ah dangka-eng lallukhu bawl in atung ah na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.

paite: Dangka-eng in asikkual li na sung dia, aning lite ah na bulh ding hi. Sikkual nih apang khat ah a-om ding ua, sikkual dang nihte apang khat ah a-om ding uh.
english: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.

paite: Singgi sing chiang na bawl dia, dangka-eng in na luan ding ahi.
english: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

paite: Thukhun bawm sik a sikkualte sung ah chiangte na thunlut dia, huaite thukhun bawm zawn ahihtheihna ding in.
english: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.

paite: Chiangte thukhun bawm sikkual sung ah a-om ding uhi.
english: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.

paite: Thukhun bawm sung ah ka hon piak theihsakna dudes na koih ding ahi.
english: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.

paite: "Dangka-engtak in zahngaihna tutphah na bawl dia; adunglam tong nih-le-akim ahi dia, availam tong khat-le-akim ahi ding hi.
english: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.

paite: Zahngaihna tutphah mong nihte ah, dangka-eng in cherubte na bawl dia, huaite sekthoh e in na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.

paite: Among khat ah cherub khat na bawl dia, among langkhat ah cherub dang. Among nihte ah zahngaihna tutphah ah cherubte na bawl ding ahi.
english: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.

paite: Cherubte'n tungsang lam ah akhate uh azakkhe ding ua, akhate ua zahngaihna tutphah tuam in, amai un aki-entuah ding ua; zahngaihna tutphah lam ah cherubte mai a-om ding ahi.
english: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.

paite: Thukhun bawm tung ah zahngaihna tutphah na koih dia; thukhun bawm sung ah ka hon piak ding theihsakna na koih ding ahi.
english: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you.

paite: Huai ah ka hon kimuhpih dia, zahngaihna tutphah tung a pan, theihsakna thukhun bawm tung a om cherub nihte kikal a pan Israel suante kiang a thupiak ka hon piak ding thil tengteng thu ah ka hon houpih ding hi.
english: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the covenant, all that I command you for the children of Israel.

paite: "Singgi in dohkan na bawl dia; adunglam tong nih ahi dia; availam tong khat, asanlam tong khat-le-akim ahi ding hi.
english: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Its length shall be two cubits, and its width a cubit, and its height one and a half cubits.

paite: Dangka-engtak in na luan dia, akımvel in dangka-eng lallukhu na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.

paite: Akimvel in khut chia in agei na bawl dia; akimvel in agei ah dangka-eng lallukhu na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.

paite: Asikkual ding in dangka-eng in li na bawl dia; sikkualte aning lite akhe li tung a omte ah na koih ding.
english: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.

paite: Dohkan puakna ding chiangte a-omna ding in ageichin ah sikkualte a-om ding uh ahi.
english: The rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.

paite: Singgi in chiangte na bawl dia, dangka-eng in na luan dia, huaite dohkan akipuaktheihna ding ahi.
english: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.

paite: Akuangte, akeute, asinte, anoute, asitna ding in na bawl ding hi. Huaite dangka-engtak in na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls with which to pour out offerings. You shall make them of pure gold.

paite: Ka ma a dohkan tung ah tanghou sawm-le-nih na koih gige ding ahi.
english: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.

paite: "Dangka-engtak in khawnvak koihna na bawl ding ahi. Khawnvak koihna sekthoh in na bawl ding ahi. Akungpi leh ahiangte, apakmum leh apakte, kibang mah in na bawl ding ahi.
english: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.

paite: Apangte a pan hiang guk akakhe dia; khawnvak koihna pang khat a pan hiang thum, khawnvak koihna pang dang a pan hiang thum.
english: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;

paite: Belkuang thumte makha bang a bawlte, hiang khat a pakmum leh pak; hiang dang a belkuang thumte makha bang a bawlte, pakmum leh pak; huchibang in khawnvak koihna a pan a hong suak hiang gukte.
english: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;

paite: Khawnvak koihna ah belkuang li makha bang a bawl a-om ding ahi, apakmumte leh pakte uh toh.
english: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

paite: Huai mah ahiang nihte nuai ah pakmum khat a-om dia, huai mah ahiang nihte nuai ah apakmum khawnvak koihna a pan a hong suakkhia hiang gukte dungzui in.
english: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

paite: Apakmumte leh ahiangte akibang ding ua, avek in dangka-engtak a sekthoh ahi ding hi.
english: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.

paite: Huai ah khawnvak sagih na bawl dia; khawnvakte ade ding ua, apang a vakna apiaktheihna ding un.
english: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.

paite: Ataitehte leh ameivu kuangte, dangka-engtak ahi ding ua;
english: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold.

paite: belsuan tengteng toh dangka-engtak talent khat a bawl ding ahi.
english: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these accessories.

paite: Tang a ka hon etsak lim dungzui a bawl ding in pilvang in," achi hi.
english: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.

paite: Huai lou in biakbuk puan-maingat hoih koptah puanzak sawmkhat toh adum leh asandup leh asan-au in na bawl dia; siamtak a bawl cherubte toh na bawl ding ahi.
english: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim. You shall make them with the work of a skillful workman.

paite: Puanzak khat saudan tong sawmnih-le-giat ahi dia, puanzak khat zatdan tong li; puanzak chih in tehna khat anei ding ahi.
english: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains shall have one measure.

paite: Puanzak ngate akithuapkhawm chiat ding uh ahi. Puanzak nga dangte akithuapkhawm chiat ding uh ahi.
english: Five curtains shall be coupled together to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.

paite: Akithuapna a akipehna a pan puanzak khat gei ah adum in avang na bawl dia; huchibang zel in, puanzak dang mongchin mahmah ah, anihna kithuapna ah na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling, and you shall do likewise on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling.

paite: Puanzak khat ah vang sawmnga na bawl dia, anihna kithuapna a om, puanzak mong ah vang sawmnga na bawl ding; huchi a baangte akimat chiat theihna ding un.
english: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling. The loops shall be opposite one another.

paite: Dangka-eng in kilhna sawmnga na bawl dia, kilhnate'n puanzakte nihnih in akilhkhawm ding; huchi in biakbuk khat ahi ding hi.
english: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains to one another with the clasps. The tabernacle shall be a unit.

paite: Biakbuk tungkhuhna ding in kel mul puanzakte na bawl dia; puanzak sawm- le-khat na bawl ding ahi.
english: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.

paite: Puanzak khat dunglam tong sawmthum ahi dia, puanzak khat vailam tong li; puanzak sawm-le-khat tehna khat ahi vek ding hi.
english: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: the eleven curtains shall have one measure.

paite: Puanzak ngate amau mah in na thuapkhawm dia, puanzak gukte amau mah in, biakbuk mai ah puanzak gukna na khep ding ahi.
english: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.

paite: Akithuapna apuanzak ponung penpen mong ah vang sawmnga na bawl dia, anihna kithuapna puanzak mong ah vang sawmnga na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the coupling, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second coupling.

paite: Dal in kilhna sawmnga na bawl dia, kilhnate vang ah na guang dia, puanin khat ahihtheihna ding in, na thuapkhawm ding ahi.
english: You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.

paite: Puanin puanzak val om lai tum khat pen biakbuk phaitam a khai ding ahi,
english: The overhanging part that remains of the curtains of the tent—the half curtain that remains—shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.

paite: Puanin puanzakte dunglam a-omlaite, apang khat lam ah tong khat, akhuhna ding in hiai lam pang leh huai lam pang a biakbuk pangte a khai ding ahi.
english: The cubit on the one side and the cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

paite: Puanin khuhna ding belampa vun sansaksa leh atungsawn khuhna ding in ngalvang vunte na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

paite: Biakbuk a ding in singgi singpek tunna dingtang in na bawl ding ahi,
english: “You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.

paite: Singpek khat dunglam tong sawm ahi dia, singpek khat vailam tong khat-le-akim ahi ding hi.
english: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.

paite: Singpek khat ah atunna ding nih a-om dia, kimuamtuah ding in lem in. Huchibang in biakbuk singpek tengteng a ding in na bawl ding ahi.
english: There shall be two tenons in each board, joined to one another: thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

paite: Biakbuk a ding in singpek na bawl dia, simlam pang ah pek sawmnih ahi ding.
english: You shall make twenty boards for the tabernacle, for the south side southward.

paite: Singpek sawmnih nuai ah dangka in kingakna khuakkuak sawmli na bawl ding. Akimuamtuah nihte a ding in singpek khat nuai ah kingakna khuakkuak nih, akimuamna nihte a ding in singpek dang khat nuai ah kingakna khuakkuak nih na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

paite: Biakbuk pang nihna a ding in mallam pang ah singpek sawmnih a-om ding hi.
english: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,

paite: Adangka kingakna khuakkuak sawmlite singpek khat nuai ah kingakna khuakkuak nih, singpek dang khat nuai ah kingakna khuakkuak nih.
english: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

paite: Biakbuk pang tumlam ate ding in singpek guk bawl in.
english: For the far side of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.

paite: Pang nih ah biakbuk ningte a ding in singpek nih na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far side.

paite: Anuailam ah akithuapkhawm ding ua, sikkual khat ah atunglam ah akithuapkhawm ding uhi. Huchibang in amau tuak a ding in ahi ding hi. Ning nihte a ding in ahi ding uhi.
english: They shall be double beneath, and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

paite: Singpek giat a-om dia, - dangka kingakna khuakkuak sawm-le-gukte; singpek khat nuai ah kuak nih leh singpek dang khat nuai ah kuak nih zel a-om ding ahi.
english: There shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

paite: Biakbuk pang khat a singpekte a ding in, singgi sing chiangtawn na bawl dia;
english: “You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

paite: huan biakbuk pang dang khat a singpekte a ding in chiangtawn nga, biakbuk pang a singpekte, tumlam sik nihte a ding in chiangtawn nga.
english: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far side westward.

paite: Singpekte laitak a chiangtawn laita in mong khat a pan mong khat tan aphak ding ahi.
english: The middle bar in the middle of the boards shall pass through from end to end.

paite: Singpekte dangka-eng in na luan dia, chiangtawnte a ding in dangka-eng sikkualte a munte a ding in na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars. You shall overlay the bars with gold.

paite: Tang a ka hon etsak dungzui in biakbuk na dinsak ding ahi.
english: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.

paite: Puanzak adum, asandup, asan-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah siamtak a hih na bawl dia, cherubte toh bawl ding ahi.
english: “You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. It shall be the work of a skillful workman.

paite: Dangka-eng a luan singgi sing khuam lite tung ah na zak ding a; abannate dangka-eng ahi ding a, dangka kingakna khuakkuak lite tung ah khai in.
english: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, on four sockets of silver.

paite: Huai a theihpihna bawm na hon laklut theihna ding in puanzak kilhnate nuai ah na khai dia, huan huai puanzak in nang a ding in Mun Siangthou leh Mun Siangthoupen kikal akhen ding hi.
english: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil. The veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you.

paite: Mun Siangthoupen ah theihpihna bawm tung ah zahngaihna tutphah na koih ding ahi.
english: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.

paite: Puanzak polam ah dohkan na tung ding a; simlam ah biakbuk sik ah dohkan ngai in khawnvak koihna na koih ding ahi. Mallam sik ah dohkan na tung ding hi.
english: You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lamp stand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south. You shall put the table on the north side.

paite: Puanin kongkhak a ding in puankhai na bawl ding a, puanmalngat hoih koptah, phim a khui, adum, asandup leh asan-au.
english: “You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer.

paite: Akhaina ding in singgi sing khuam nga na bawl dia, dangka-eng a luan, akibatnate dangka-eng ahi ding uhi. Huaite a ding in dal kingakna khuakkuak nga na sung ding ahi.
english: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold. You shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.

paite: Singgi sing in maitam na bawl ding a, tong nga a sau, tong nga a za; maitam detdou ahi ding. Asanlam tong thum ahi ding ahi.
english: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height shall be three cubits.

paite: Aning lite tung ah akiite na bawl dia; akiite akibang ding ua; dal in na luan ding ahi.
english: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.

paite: Ameivu dohna ding belte na bawl ding a, aluahna suahdul, kuangdal, keupi leh asikkhut leh amei beldai. Abelsuan tengteng dal a na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.

paite: Huai a ding in dal in sing khul ding koihna len bang in na bawl dia; atung a ning li ah dal sikkual li na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.

paite: Anuailam maitam huapna nuai ah na koih dia; huchi a maitam laizang a, lente akikim theihna ding in.
english: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.

paite: Maitam a ding in chiangte na bawl dia, singgi sing chiangte dal in na luan ding ahi.
english: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.

paite: Chiangte sikkual sung a thunlut ding ahi a; chiangte maitam sik nihte tung ah a-om ding hi, apuakna ding in.
english: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.

paite: Tang a ka hon etsak bang in, singpekte ah ahawm na bawl dia, huchibang in na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall make it hollow with planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.

paite: Biakbuk huang na bawl ding ahi. Simlam pang a ding in simlam manoh in puankhai, huang umna ding in puanmalngat hoih sik khat a ding in tong za a sau a-om ding ahi.
english: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side.

paite: Akhuam sawmnihte leh akingakna khuakkuak sawmnihte dal ahi ding ua; khuamte khainate leh puanduangte dangka ahi ding uhi.
english: Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

paite: Huchi mah bang in mallam pang ah asau lam tong za a sau puankhai a-om ding, dal khuam sawmnihte leh akingakna khuakkuak sawmnihte dangka chi khuam, akhaina leh puanduangte ahi ding hi.
english: Likewise for the length of the north side, there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

paite: Tumlam pang a huang vailam a ding in puankhai tong sawmnga a-om ding. Akhuamte uh sawm leh akingakna khuakkuak sawm ahi ding.
english: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

paite: Suahlam a suahlam pang a huangsung umna vailam tong sawmnga ahi ding.
english: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

paite: Kongpi sik khat lam a puankhaite tong sawm-le-nga ahi dia; akhuamte thum, akingakna khuakkuak thum ahi ding.
english: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

paite: Langkhat lam pang ah puankhai tong sawm-le-ngate a-om dia; akhuamte thum leh akingakna khuakkuak thum ahi ding.
english: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

paite: Huangsung kongpi a ding in puankhai tong sawmnih a-om dia, adum, asandup, asan-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah, phim a khui ahi dia, akhuam uh li ahi dia, akingakna khuakkuak li ahi ding hi.
english: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.

paite: Huangsung kimvel a khuam tengteng dangka puanduang a gak ahi dia, abannate dangka ahi dia, akingakna khuakkuak dal ahi ding hi.
english: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.

paite: Huangsung dunglam tong zakhat ahi dia, availam tong sawmnga koipeuh ah, asanlam tong nga puanmalngat hoih koptah a bawl, akingakna khuakkuak dal ahi ding.
english: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of bronze.

paite: Biakbuk a vanzat tengteng, anasepna chiteng, akilhbelhna sikzumte leh huangsung a kilhbelhna sikzum tengteng dal ahi ding ahi.
english: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of bronze.

paite: Israel suante meivak ding in olive thautak a bawl hon tawi ding in thu na pe ding, khawnvak kuangsak gige ding in.
english: “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

paite: Puanzak, theihpihna ma a om, polam a kihoupihna puanin ah, Aaron leh atapate'n TOUPA ma ah nitaklam a pan zingsang lam tan in thu ape ding uhi. Israel suante ziak in akhang-akhang un tangtawn a ding in dan thuseh ahi ding hi.
english: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before Yahweh: it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.

paite: Israel suante lak a pan na sanggampa Aaron leh atapate siampu hi a ka nna aseptheihna ding un la in. Aaron leh atapate: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar na la ding ahi.
english: “Bring Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, near to you from among the children of Israel, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office: Aaron, with Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.

paite: Athupina ding leh akilawmna ding in na sanggampa Aaron a ding in puan siangthou bawl in.
english: You shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.

paite: Pilna kha a ka dimsak khutsiam tengteng kiang ah thu gen in, amau Aaron puan, amah hihsianna ding abawltheihna ding un. Huchi a ama'n siampu nasepna mun a ka nna aseptheihna ding in.
english: You shall speak to all who are wise-hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron’s garments to sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

paite: Apuan bawl ding uh hiaite ahi: Awmtuam, siampu puan, puanaktual, puanakzem, lukhu leh kawnggak. Na sanggampa Aaron a ding leh tapate a ding in puan siangthou abawl ding uh ahi, huchi a ama'n siampu nasepna mun a ka nna aseptheihna ding in.
english: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

paite: Amau dangka-eng, adum, asandup, asan-au leh puanmalngat hoih ala ding ua.
english: They shall use the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.

paite: Dangka-eng, adum, asandup, asan-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah in hoihtak a bawl in, siampu puan abawl ding uhi.
english: “They shall make the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skillful workman.

paite: Aliang nihte gei nihte akimat ding ua; akimatkhawm ding uhi.
english: It shall have two shoulder straps joined to the two ends of it, that it may be joined together.

paite: Siampu puanakzem gakna, puanduang kawnggak dangka-eng khau toh khau dum, khau sandup leh khau san-au siamtak a gat puanmalngat in abawl ding uh ahi.
english: The skillfully woven band, which is on it, shall be like its work and of the same piece; of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

paite: Onik suang nih na la dia, huaite tung ah Israel suante min na gelh ding ahi.
english: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel.

paite: Suang khat tung ah aminte uh lak a guk, suang dang tung ah, a-omlaite min guk dangte, apiandan bang zel un na gelh ding ahi.
english: Six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the six that remain on the other stone, in the order of their birth.

paite: Suainamna zungbuh khuakthoh a kigelh bang in, suangmantam khuakthoh agelhsiamte gelh, huai suangmantam nihte ah Israel tapate min na gelh ding a, huai suangmantamte dangka-eng khuak sung ah na phum ding ahi.
english: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, you shall engrave the two stones, according to the names of the children of Israel. You shall make them to be enclosed in settings of gold.

paite: Huai suang nihte Israel suante a ding a theihgigena suang hi ding in siampu puan liangzang ah na koih ding. Huchi in theihgigena ding in Aaron in aliangzang nihte tung ah TOUPA ma ah aminte uh apo ding hi.
english: You shall put the two stones on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel. Aaron shall bear their names before Yahweh on his two shoulders for a memorial.

paite: Dangka-eng bulhna na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall make settings of gold,

paite: Amongte a dangka-engtak khainiang nihte; pakkhi bang in na bawl dia, akibulhnate ah pakkhi bang khainiangte na khih ding ahi.
english: and two chains of pure gold; you shall make them like cords of braided work. You shall put the braided chains on the settings.

paite: Vaihawmna omtuamna siamtak in na bawl dia; siampu puan bawl bang in na bawl ding, dangka-eng in, adum in, asandup in leh asan-au in leh puanmalngat hoih koptah in, na bawl ding ahi.
english: “You shall make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skillful workman; like the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, you shall make it.

paite: Khep nih in akikhep dia, akhep adung-avai kikim, khap khat a sau leh khap khat a za ahi ding ahi.
english: It shall be square and folded double; a span shall be its length, and a span its width.

paite: Huaite tung ah suang vual li in suangmantamte na bulh dia: avual khatna sardi suang, topaz suang leh karbankul suang ahi ding. Hiai avual khatna ahi ding hi.
english: You shall set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of ruby, topaz, and beryl shall be the first row;

paite: Avual nihna emerald suang, sapphir suang leh diamond suang ahi ding ahi.
english: and the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;

paite: Avual thumna liguri suang, agate suang leh amethis suang ahi ding.
english: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

paite: Avual lina beril suang, onik suang leh jasper suang ahi ding hi. Abulhna ua dangka- eng bulh ding ahi.
english: and the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They shall be enclosed in gold in their settings.

paite: Suangte Israel suante min toh akithuah dia, amin uh dungzui in sawm-le-nih, chiamtehna gelhte bang in, michih amin toh nam sawm-le-nihte dungzui in ahi ding uhi.
english: The stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.

paite: Awmtuam tung ah pakkhi bang a bawl amongte ah dangka-eng siang khainiang na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall make on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

paite: Awmtuam tung ah dangka-eng sikkual nih na bawl dia, huai sikkual nihte awmtuam mong nihte tung ah na koih ding hi.
english: You shall make on the breastplate two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

paite: Awmtuam mongte tung a om sikkual nihte ah dangka-eng pakkhi bang nihte na koih ding ahi.
english: You shall put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

paite: Pakkhi bang khainiang nihte mong nih dangte bulhna nihte ah na khih dia, ama a siampu puan liangzangte ah na koih ding hi.
english: The other two ends of the two braided chains you shall put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod in its forepart.

paite: Dangka-eng in sikkual nih na bawl dia, huai gei a siampu puan mong nihte tung ah na koih ding; asunglam a siampu puan gei a om pen ah.
english: You shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.

paite: Dangka-eng in sikkual dang nihte na bawl dia, siampu puan gei nihte nuailam a atung ah na koih ding, amalam sang a akikhepna zawntak ah, siampu puan konggak lamdang tungtak ah.
english: You shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its forepart, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

paite: Asikkual in awmtuam siampu puan sikkual ah puanduang dum toh na hen dia, huchi a siampu puan kawnggak lamdang tung a a-omtheihna ding in leh siampu puan a pan awmtuam akiphellouhna ding in.
english: They shall bind the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate may not swing out from the ephod.

paite: Aaron in, TOUPA ma a theihgigena hiden ding a, mun siangthou a alut chiang in, alungtang zawntak ah vaihawmna awmtuam tung ah Israel suante minte apo ding hi.
english: Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart, when he goes in to the holy place, for a memorial before Yahweh continually.

paite: Vaihawmna awmtuam ah Urim leh Thummim na koih ding. TOUPA ma a ava lut chiang in, Aaron lungtang zawn ah a-om ding hi. Huchi in Aaron in TOUPA ma ah alungtang zawntak ah Israel suante vaihawmna apo gige ding hi.
english: You shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before Yahweh. Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before Yahweh continually.

paite: Siampu puan puanaktual adum in na bawl ding ahi.
english: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

paite: Akhung ah a-awng a-om dia; alaitak a, a-awng kimvel ah gatthoh khihna a-om dia, siklen puanak ban nei lou hileh kilawm ahi ding, akeklouhna ding in.
english: It shall have a hole for the head in the middle of it. It shall have a binding of woven work around its hole, as it were the hole of a coat of mail, that it not be torn.

paite: Huai puanaktual mong ah adum in, asandup in leh asan-au in na bawl dia, agei kimvel in. Dangka-eng dakte akimvel in akikal zel uah na bawl ding ahi.
english: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold between and around them:

paite: Dangka-eng dak leh theibuhfai puanaktual gei tung ah akivel in a-om ding ahi.
english: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.

paite: Aaron in nna asep chiang in huai asilh ding hi. Huchi in TOUPA ma a Mun Siangthou a alut chiang leh ahong pawt chiang in aging akiza dia, asi kei chih theihna ding in.
english: It shall be on Aaron to minister: and its sound shall be heard when he goes in to the holy place before Yahweh, and when he comes out, that he not die.

paite: Dangka-engtak in kuang na bawl dia, atung ah na gelh ding, suainamna zungbuh bang a khuak in, TOUPA A DIA SIANTHOUNA chih na gelh ding ahi.
english: “You shall make a plate of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engravings of a signet, ‘HOLY TO YAHWEH.’

paite: Huai laigelhna sikpek siampu dialkhip a, amailam ah khau dum in na khihbelh ding ahi.
english: You shall put it on a lace of blue, and it shall be on the sash. It shall be on the front of the sash.

paite: Huai Aaron taltang ah a-om dia, ama'n Israelte thillat siangthou toh kisai a, Israel suante khelhna apo ding ahi. Huai Aaron taltang ah a-om gige dia, thillat siangthoute TOUPA mai ah san ahi ding hi.
english: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall make holy in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always on his forehead, that they may be accepted before Yahweh.

paite: Puanmalngat hoih puanak na gan dia, puanmalngat in lukhu na bawl dia, agatthoh in kawnggak na bawl ding hi.
english: You shall weave the tunic with fine linen. You shall make a turban of fine linen. You shall make a sash, the work of the embroiderer.

paite: Aaron tapate a ding in puanakte na bawl dia, kawnggakte na bawlsak ding. Athupina ding leh akilawmna ding in lukhute amau a ding in na bawl ding ahi.
english: “You shall make tunics for Aaron’s sons. You shall make sashes for them. You shall make headbands for them, for glory and for beauty.

paite: Huaite na sanggampa Aaron tung ah leh akiang a atapate tung ah na koih dia; amaute thau na nilh dia, na septuam dia, na siansak ding ahi; siampu nasepna mun a ka nna aseptheihna ding un.
english: You shall put them on Aaron your brother, and on his sons with him, and shall anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.

paite: Avuaktanna uh khuh ding in puan pheituam zumte na bawlsak dia; atai a pan aphei chiang atun ding uh ahi.
english: You shall make them linen pants to cover their naked flesh. They shall reach from the waist even to the thighs.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin a alut chiang un hiam ahihkeileh Mun Siangthou a nasem dia dohkan kiang a, ahong pai chiang un, khelhna khatpeuh neih ziak a asihlouhna ding un huaite asa tung uah a-om gige ding ahi. Huchi in huai amah a ding leh anung a asuante a ding in tangtawn a dan thuseh ahi ding hi.
english: They shall be on Aaron and on his sons, when they go in to the Tent of Meeting, or when they come near to the altar to minister in the holy place, that they don’t bear iniquity, and die. This shall be a statute forever to him and to his offspring after him.

paite: Huan siampu a pang a, ka na sem ding a na siansakna dia hiai ahi atung ua na hih ding, bawngtalnou khat leh belampa nih gensiatbei na la ding ahi.
english: “This is the thing that you shall do to them to make them holy, to minister to me in the priest’s office: take one young bull and two rams without defect,

paite: Huai ban ah tanghou silngou soh louh, tanghou beu silngou soh louh thau a zut leh tanghou pek silngou soh louh thau a zut, huit buh tangbuang in na bawl ding ahi.
english: unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. You shall make them of fine wheat flour.

paite: Huaite loh sung ah na koih dia, bawngtal leh belampa nihte toh, loh in na hon tawi ding hi.
english: You shall put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bull and the two rams.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin kongkhak ah Aaron leh atapate na hon pi dia, tui in amau na sil ding ahi.
english: You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.

paite: Huai khit in siampu puansilhte na la dia, puanak tung leh siampu puanaktual leh siampu puan leh awmtuam Aaron na silhsak dia, siamtak a kigan puanduang kawnggak in amah na gak ding ahi.
english: You shall take the garments, and put on Aaron the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod, and the breastplate, and clothe him with the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

paite: Alutung ah lukhu na koih dia, lukhu tung ah lallukhu siangthou na koih ding ahi.
english: You shall set the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.

paite: Thau nilhchi na la dia, alutung ah na buak dia amah na nuh ding ahi.
english: Then you shall take the anointing oil, and pour it on his head, and anoint him.

paite: Atapate na hon pi dia puanak tungte na silhsak ding ahi.
english: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.

paite: Kawnggak in amau na gak dia, Aaron leh atapate, lukhu bem na khusak ding hi. Omden ding dan thuseh a ding in siampu nasep amaute a ahi ding. Hichibang in Aaron leh atapate na hihsiangthou ding ahi.
english: You shall clothe them with belts, Aaron and his sons, and bind headbands on them. They shall have the priesthood by a perpetual statute. You shall consecrate Aaron and his sons.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin ma ah bawngtal na kaisak dia; Aaron leh atapate'n bawngtal lutung ah akhutte uh anga ding uhi.
english: “You shall bring the bull before the Tent of Meeting; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin kongkhak kiang ah, TOUPA ma ah bawngtal na gou ding ahi.
english: You shall kill the bull before Yahweh at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Bawngtal sisan na la dia, na khutzung in maitam kiite na nuh dia, sisan tengteng maitam bul sik ah na sungkhe ding ahi.
english: You shall take of the blood of the bull, and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; and you shall pour out all the blood at the base of the altar.

paite: Asunglam tuamtu athau tengteng na la dia, asin tung a alam omleh, akailing nihte leh atung ua athau maitam tung ah na hal ding hi.
english: You shall take all the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, and burn them on the altar.

paite: Bawngtal sa leh avun leh a-ek, giahphual polam ah mei in na hal ding hi. Hiai khelhna thillat ahi.
english: But the meat of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside of the camp. It is a sin offering.

paite: Belampa khat na la dia, belampa lutung ah Aaron leh atapate'n akhut uh anga ding uhi.
english: “You shall also take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

paite: Belampa na that ding a, asisan na la dia, maitam kimvel in na theh ding hi.
english: You shall kill the ram, and you shall take its blood, and sprinkle it around on the altar.

paite: Belampa na semnen dia, asunglam na sawpsiang dia, akhete leh asate leh alu na koihkhawm ding hi.
english: You shall cut the ram into its pieces, and wash its innards, and its legs, and put them with its pieces, and with its head.

paite: Belampa avek in maitam tung ah na halmang ding ahi. Hiai TOUPA a dia mei a thillat gimnamtui ahi.
english: You shall burn the whole ram on the altar: it is a burnt offering to Yahweh; it is a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Belampa dang na la dia; belampa lutung ah Aaron leh atapate'n akhut uh akoih ding uhi.
english: “You shall take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

paite: Huan huai belampa na gou dia, Aaron bil taklam dawn leh atapate bil taklam dawn ah leh akhut taklam khutpi uah, akhe taklam khepi uah, asisan na la dia, na nuh ding a, maitam kimvel ah huai sisan na theh ding ahi.
english: Then you shall kill the ram, and take some of its blood, and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the big toe of their right foot; and sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

paite: Maitam tung a om sisan na la ding a, nuh theih thau toh, Aaron tung ah leh apuan tung ah leh atapate tung ah leh akiang a atapate puan tung ah na theh ding hi. Huchi in amah leh apuante leh tapate leh atapate' puante hihsiangthou ahi ding hi.
english: You shall take of the blood that is on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be made holy, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

paite: Huai Belampa thaute, amei thau, asung thau, asin leh akailing nihte leh athaute, ataklam phei toh na la ding ahi; hiai bel siangthou a sehtuamna belampa ahih ziak ahi.
english: Also you shall take some of the ram’s fat, the fat tail, the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, the fat that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of consecration),

paite: TOUPA mai a lohbeu a om silngou soh louh tanghou kikoihte lak a tanghou beu khat, sathau a kikang tanghou pei khat leh tanghou kan pek khat na la dia,
english: and one loaf of bread, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before Yahweh.

paite: Aaron khut leh atapate khut ah na koih dia; huaite TOUPA ma ah vei thillat in na vei ding hi.
english: You shall put all of this in Aaron’s hands, and in his sons’ hands, and shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

paite: Amau khut a pan huaite na sang dia, halmang thillat ding in maitam tung ah na hal ding ahi, TOUPA ma a gimlim hi ding in. Hiai TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ahi.
english: You shall take them from their hands, and burn them on the altar on the burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma before Yahweh: it is an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Aaron hihsianthouna belampa awm na la dia, TOUPA ma ah vei thillat in na vei ding hi. Hiai nang tan ding ahi.
english: “You shall take the breast of Aaron’s ram of consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It shall be your portion.

paite: Huai siangthou a sehtuamna belampa a pan vei thillat a veisa a-awm leh vei thillat a veisa aphei, Aaron tan leh atapate tante na hihsiangthou ding ahi.
english: You shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the wave offering, which is waved, and which is raised up, of the ram of consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons.

paite: Hiai Israel suante a pan a dan thuseh bang a Aaron leh atapate tan ngeina ahih gige ding ahi. Huai bel Israel suante'n alemna thillatte ua pan TOUPA a dia apiak ding uh ahi.
english: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel; for it is a wave offering. It shall be a wave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, even their wave offering to Yahweh.

paite: Aaron puansilh siangthoute amah nung in atapate a ahi ding uh; amaute a hihsiangthou ding leh sehkip ding in.
english: “The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.

paite: Ama mun a siampu hong hi atapa in Mun Siangthou a nasem dia kihoupihna biakbuk sung a alut chiang in, ni sagih sung huai puansilhte asilh ding ahi.
english: Seven days shall the son who is priest in his place put them on, when he comes into the Tent of Meeting to minister in the holy place.

paite: Kihihsianthouna belampa na la dia, mun siangthou ah asa na tuihuan ding ahi.
english: “You shall take the ram of consecration and boil its meat in a holy place.

paite: Aaron leh atapate'n belampa sa leh loh sung a om kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak kiang ah tanghou ane ding uhi.
english: Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Amau sehkipna ding leh hihsianthouna dia akhelhna thoihna thilte anek ding uh ahi. Thilzek leh siangthou ahih ziak in midang kuamah in anek louh ding uh ahi.
english: They shall eat those things with which atonement was made, to consecrate and sanctify them; but a stranger shall not eat of it, because they are holy.

paite: Kihihsianthouna sa hiam tanghou hiam zingsang tan a-omleh mei in na hal ding ahi. Asianthou ziak in na ne ding ahi kei.
english: If anything of the meat of the consecration, or of the bread, remains to the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire. It shall not be eaten, because it is holy.

paite: Huchibang a thu ka hon piak bangbang in Aaron kiang ah leh atapate kiang ah na hih dia, ni sagih sung amau na hihsiangthou ding ahi.
english: “You shall do so to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. You shall consecrate them seven days.

paite: Lemna thillat ding in niteng in bawngtal khat khelhna thillat ding in na lan ding ahi. Hiai a dia lemna na bawlzoh chiang in, maitam na hihsiang dia, thau na nilh dia, na siangthousak ding ahi,
english: Every day you shall offer the bull of sin offering for atonement. You shall cleanse the altar when you make atonement for it. You shall anoint it, to sanctify it.

paite: Ni sagih sung maitam a ding in lemna na bawl dia; na hihsiangthou dia; maitam siangthoupen ahi ding. Huai maitam khoih peuhmah a sianthou ngeingei ding ahi.
english: Seven days you shall make atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and the altar shall be most holy. Whatever touches the altar shall be holy.

paite: Niteng a maitam tung ah kum khat a upa belamnou nih na lat gige ding ahi.
english: “Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.

paite: Belamnou khat zingsang in na lan dia; belamnou dang khat nitaklam in na lan ding ahi.
english: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning; and the other lamb you shall offer at evening;

paite: Belamnou khat na lat chiang in tangbuang seh sawm suah seh khat, athau toh hin khat a seh lina toh dawn thillat ding in uain hin khat a seh lina na lan ding ahi.
english: and with the one lamb a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil, and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering.

paite: Belamnou khat dang pen nitaklam in na lan dia, tangbuang thillat dungzui in leh dawn thillat dungzui in gimlim ding in, na hih dia, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat gimnamtui ahi.
english: The other lamb you shall offer at evening, and shall do to it according to the meal offering of the morning and according to its drink offering, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Na khang na khang un hiai TOUPA ma a kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a halmang thillat ahi nilouh ding ahi. Huai ah na kiang ua thu gen ding in ka hon kituahpih ding hi.
english: It shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the Tent of Meeting before Yahweh, where I will meet with you, to speak there to you.

paite: Huai ah Israel suante ka kituahpih dia, ka thupina in biakbuk ahihsiangthou ding hi.
english: There I will meet with the children of Israel; and the place shall be sanctified by my glory.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin leh maitam ka hihsiangthou dia; siampu a pang a kei a dia nasem ding in Aaron leh atapate leng ka hihsiangthou tuaktuak ding hi.
english: I will sanctify the Tent of Meeting and the altar. I will also sanctify Aaron and his sons to minister to me in the priest’s office.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante lak ah ka teng dia, a Pathian uh ka hi ding.
english: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.

paite: TOUPA a Pathian uh, alak ua ka tentheihna dia amaute Aigupta gam a pan pikhepa ka hi, chih athei ding uh. TOUPA a Pathian uh ka hi.
english: They shall know that I am Yahweh their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, that I might dwell among them: I am Yahweh their God.

paite: Mosi in asungpa, Midian siampu, Jethro belamhonte aching hi. Gamdai nunglam a belamhonte pi in, Pathian tang, Horeb pha in, ahong pai hi.
english: Now Moses was keeping the flock of Jethro, his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the back of the wilderness, and came to God’s mountain, to Horeb.

paite: Pawn lak a pan meikuang in akiang ah TOUPA Angel ahong kilak hí. A-en a, ngai in, mei in loubukh akuang a, himahleh loubukh akang kei hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the middle of a bush. He looked, and behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

paite: Mosi in, “Ka kihei dia, hiai thil muh thupi, bangziak a loubukh kang lou ahia, ka va en ding,” achi hi.
english: Moses said, “I will go now, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burned.”

paite: Huchi a-en dia kihei lai TOUPA'N amuh in loubuk a pan amah asam a, "Mosi, Mosi," achi hi. Ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om," achi hi.
english: When Yahweh saw that he came over to see, God called to him out of the middle of the bush, and said, “Moses! Moses!” He said, “Here I am.”

paite: Ama'n, "Hiai mun hon naih ke'n. Na khepek a pan na khedapte suah in. Na dinna mun lei siangthou ahi,” achi hi.
english: He said, “Don’t come close. Take off your sandals, for the place you are standing on is holy ground.”

paite: Hiai achi lai a, "Na pa' Pathian, Abraham' Pathian, Isak' Pathian leh Jakob' Pathian ka hi," Mosi in Pathian a-et ngam louh ziak in amai asel hi.
english: Moreover he said, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.” Moses hid his face because he was afraid to look at God.

paite: TOUPA'N, "Aigupta gam a ka mite thuakgimna ka mu a, atung ua nasem heutute ziak a akah uh ka zata a, adahnate uh ka thei hi,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said, “I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of their taskmasters, for I know their sorrows.

paite: "Aiguptate khut a pan amaute pikhe ding leh huai gam a pan gam hoih leh za, bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luang gam, Kanaante, Hitte, Amorte, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste gam tun dia hong paisuk ka hi.
english: I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land to a good and large land, to a land flowing with milk and honey; to the place of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in, ngai in, Israel suante kah thawm ka kiang ahong tungta. Aiguptate'n amau anuaisiahdan uh leng ka mu hi.
english: Now, behold, the cry of the children of Israel has come to me. Moreover I have seen the oppression with which the Egyptians oppress them.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in kisa in, Pharaoh kiang ah ka hon sawl ding, Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante, ka mite na hon pikhiak theihna ding in," achi hi.
english: Come now therefore, and I will send you to Pharaoh, that you may bring my people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt.”

paite: Mosi in Pathian kiang ah, "Pharoah kiang a hoh a, Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante pikhe ding, kei kua ka hia?" achi hi.
english: Moses said to God, “Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh, and that I should bring the children of Israel out of Egypt?”

paite: Ama'n, "Na kiang ah ka om ngeingei ding, ka hon sawl chih, hiai nang a ding in akitheihna ahi ding. Aigupta gam a pan mite na pikhiak khit chiang in, hiai tang tung ah Pathian nna na sem ding uh," achi hi.
english: He said, “Certainly I will be with you. This will be the token to you, that I have sent you: when you have brought the people out of Egypt, you shall serve God on this mountain.”

paite: Mosi in Pathian kiang ah, "Ngai in, Israel suante kiang a ka hong pai a, akiang ua, hichibang a ka va gen chiang in, 'Na pipute uh Pathian in na kiang ua ahon sawl ka hi,' huan amau ka kiang ah, 'Amin bang ahia?' chi in ahon dong ding ua, ke'n akiang uah bang ka genta dia?" achi hi.
english: Moses said to God, “Behold, when I come to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you,’ and they ask me, ‘What is his name?’ what should I tell them?”

paite: Pathian in Mosi kiang ah, "KA HIH KA HI,” achi hi. Huchibang in Israel suante kiang ah na va gen ding ahi, “KA HIH IN na kiang uah ahon sawl hi," chi in.
english: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM,” and he said, “You shall tell the children of Israel this: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”

paite: Pathian in Mosi kiang ah agen behlap lai a, “Israel suante kiang ah hiai gen in: Israel suante Pathian, Abraham' Pathian, Isak' Pathian leh Jakob' Pathian in na kiang uah ahon sawl hi: "Hiai ka min ahi gige a, suan tengteng tan a kei theihgigena min ahi.
english: God said moreover to Moses, “You shall tell the children of Israel this, ‘Yahweh, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has sent me to you.’ This is my name forever, and this is my memorial to all generations.

paite: Kuan inla, Israel upate kaikhawm inla, akiang uah hichi in va gen in. Ka kiang ah, 'Na pipute uh TOUPA Pathian, Abraham' Pathian, Isak' Pathian leh Jakob' Pathian ahong kilak a, hichi in achi, "Ka hong veh petmah a, Aigupta gam a na tung ua hih a omte ka muta hi."
english: Go and gather the elders of Israel together, and tell them, ‘Yahweh, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has appeared to me, saying, “I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt.

paite: Huan hichi in ka chita, Aigupta gimna a pan Kanaante, Hitte, Amorte, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste gam, bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luang gam ah ka hon pilut ding."
english: I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, to a land flowing with milk and honey.”’

paite: "Na aw angaikhe ding uhi. Huchi in na kuan ding a, nang leh Israel upate, Aigupta kumpipa kiang ah na va hoh ding ua, akiang ah hichibang in na va gen ding uhi. Hebrute' TOUPA Pathian in ahon kimuhpih a, tu in, ka hon ngen uhi, hon paisak in, gamdai a ni thum lam a TOUPA ka Pathian uh kiang a ka kithoihtheihna ding un.
english: They will listen to your voice. You shall come, you and the elders of Israel, to the king of Egypt, and you shall tell him, ‘Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Now please let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to Yahweh, our God.’

paite: Ahi a, Aigupta kumpipa'n bantha hatna toh lou in ahon paisak kei ding chih ka theitel hi.
english: I know that the king of Egypt won’t give you permission to go, no, not by a mighty hand.

paite: Ka ban ka zak ding a, alak ua ka hih ding ka thillamdang tengteng in Aigupta gam ka gawt ding. Huai nung in ahon paisak pan ding hi.
english: I will reach out my hand and strike Egypt with all my wonders which I will do among them, and after that he will let you go.

paite: "Aiguptate mitmuh in hiai mite deihsakna ka pe ding. Huan hichi ahi ding a, na pai chiang un khutvuak in na pai kei ding uh.
english: I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and it will happen that when you go, you shall not go empty-handed.

paite: Numei teng in invengte leh a-inn a khualtamte a pan dangka suangmantamte, dangka-eng suangmantamte leh puansilhte aleitawi ding. Huchi in huaite na tapate uh na silhsak ding ua, na tanute uh na silhsak ding uh. Huchibang in Aiguptate na lok ding uhi," achi hi.
english: But every woman shall ask of her neighbor, and of her who visits her house, jewels of silver, jewels of gold, and clothing. You shall put them on your sons, and on your daughters. You shall plunder the Egyptians.”

paite: Gimlim halna ding maitam na bawl ding ahi. Singgi sing in na bawl ding ahi.
english: “You shall make an altar to burn incense on. You shall make it of acacia wood.

paite: Asau lam tong khat ahi dia; azatlam tong khat mah. Asau lam leh azatlam akikim dia, asanlam tong nih ahi ding ahi. Akiite leng akibang in sa khat ahi ding uhi
english: Its length shall be a cubit, and its width a cubit. It shall be square, and its height shall be two cubits. Its horns shall be of one piece with it.

paite: Dangka-engtak in na luan dia; atung, asikte leh akiite ah akimvel in dangka-eng in agei vel na bawl ding hi.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top, its sides around it, and its horns; and you shall make a gold molding around it.

paite: Dangka-eng sikkual nih apang nih a ding na bawl dia, maitam pang nihte ah na bulh dia, azawnna zawlte khumna ding ahi ding uhi.
english: You shall make two golden rings for it under its molding; on its two ribs, on its two sides you shall make them; and they shall be for places for poles with which to bear it.

paite: Singgi sing in azawnna ding chiangte na bawl dia, dangka-eng in huaite na luan ding ahi.
english: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

paite: K'on kituahpihna ding mun, theihsakna tung a om zahngaihna tutphah ma, theihpihna bawm kiang a om puanzak ma ah na koih ding ahi.
english: You shall put it before the veil that is by the ark of the covenant, before the mercy seat that is over the covenant, where I will meet with you.

paite: Zingsang teng in huai tung ahbAaron in gimlim ahal dia; khawnvakte adet chiang in, atung ah gimlim ahal ding ahi.
english: Aaron shall burn incense of sweet spices on it every morning. When he tends the lamps, he shall burn it.

paite: Nitaklam a Aaron in khawnvakte adet chiang in, atung ah gimlim ahal ding hi. Na khang na khang un TOUPA ma a gimlim ahi tawntung ding hi.
english: When Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before Yahweh throughout your generations.

paite: Huai ah theih louh gimlim hiam halmang thillat hiam, tangbuang thillat hiam, na lan ding uh ahi kei. Huai lou in huai ah dawn thillat leng na sung ding uh ahi kei hi.
english: You shall offer no strange incense on it, nor burnt offering, nor meal offering; and you shall pour no drink offering on it.

paite: Kum khat in khatvei Aaron in khelhna thillat sisan akiite ah atat dia, lemna abawl ding ahi. Na khang na khang un kum khat in khatvei atung ah lemna abawl ding ahi. Hiai TOUPA a dia siangthoupen ahi.
english: Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once in the year; with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once in the year he shall make atonement for it throughout your generations. It is most holy to Yahweh.”

paite: Huai khit in TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Azah uh theihna dia kisimpina na bawl chiang in, pasal chih in ahinna tatna sum TOUPA kiang a apiak ding ahi. Hiai ahihleh amaute na sim chiang a alak ua hipi alenlouhna ding ahi.
english: “When you take a census of the children of Israel, according to those who are counted among them, then each man shall give a ransom for his soul to Yahweh when you count them, that there be no plague among them when you count them.

paite: Simtel a om michih in tatna sum apiak ding ahi. Mun siangthou sum shekel kimkhat ahi ding ahi. Shekel khat gerah sawmnih a gik ahi.
english: They shall give this, everyone who passes over to those who are counted, half a shekel according to the shekel of the sanctuary (the shekel is twenty gerahs); half a shekel for an offering to Yahweh.

paite: Simtel a omte lak a paisuak peuhmah kum sawmnih a upa leh atunglam in TOUPA kiang a thillat alat ding uh ahi.
english: Everyone who passes over to those who are counted, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering to Yahweh.

paite: Na kha ua ding a lemna bawlna dia, TOUPA kiang a thillat apiak chiang un, ahaute leh azawngte'n shekel kimkhat sang a tamzaw leh tawmzaw apiak louh ding uh ahi.
english: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel, when they give the offering of Yahweh, to make atonement for your souls.

paite: Hiai bang in Israel suante lemna sum na la dia, kihoupihna biakbuk a nasepna ding in na sep ding ahi; na kha uh tatna ding a, TOUPA ma a Israel suante a dia theihgigena ahihtheihna ding in," achi hi.
english: You shall take the atonement money from the children of Israel, and shall appoint it for the service of the Tent of Meeting; that it may be a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh, to make atonement for your souls.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen hi:
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Kisilna ding in tuikuang dal in na bawl dia, atunna khete leng dal in na bawl ding ahi. Kihoupihna puanin leh maitam kikal ah na koih dia, huai ah tui na koih ding ahi.
english: “You shall also make a basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, in which to wash. You shall put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it.

paite: Aaron leh atapate'n akhutte uh leh akhete uh tui in asil ding uh ahi.
english: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet in it.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin sung a alut ding chiang uhiam, nasem dia TOUPA mai a, mei a thillat lan dia maitam anaih ding chiang ua, akisil ding uh ahi. Akisil kei uleh asi ding uhi.
english: When they go into the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water, that they don’t die; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Huai bang a, asihlouhna ding ua akhutte uh leh akhete uh asil ding uh ahi. Hiai tangtawn in amau a ding in dan thuseh ahi dia; akhang-akhang un amah a ding leh asuante a ding nangawn in ahi ding ahi,” achi hi.
english: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they not die. This shall be a statute forever to them, even to him and to his descendants throughout their generations.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen lai hi:
english: Moreover Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Gimlim leng kilak inla, murrah tui shekel zanga leh singguithak gimlim huai zah kimkhat, shekel zanih-le-sawmnga sialluang khum shekel zanih-le-sawmnga,
english: “Also take fine spices: of liquid myrrh, five hundred shekels; and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, even two hundred and fifty; and of fragrant cane, two hundred and fifty;

paite: Singguithak shekel zanga, mun siangthou shekel dungzui in, olive thau hin khat.
english: and of cassia five hundred, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; and a hin of olive oil.

paite: Nilh theih siangthou in thau na bawl dia, nilh theih damdawi misiamna bang a gawm; nilh theih thau siangthou ahi ding.
english: You shall make it into a holy anointing oil, a perfume compounded after the art of the perfumer: it shall be a holy anointing oil.

paite: Huai in kihoupihna biakbuk na nuh ding, theihpihna bawm toh,
english: You shall use it to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant,

paite: adohkan leh abelsuan tengteng leh khawnvak koihna leh abelsuan chiteng leh gimlim maitam toh.
english: the table and all its articles, the lamp stand and its accessories, the altar of incense,

paite: Haltum thillat maitam leh abelsuan tengteng leh tuikuang leh akhe.
english: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its base.

paite: Huaite asiangthoupen hi ding in na hihsiangthou ding ahi. Bangpeuh huaite khoih asianthou ngeingei ding uh ahi.
english: You shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.

paite: Aaron leh atapate thau na nilh dia, amau na siangsak ding, siampu nasepna mun a kei a dia nna aseptheihna ding un.
english: You shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.

paite: Israel suante kiang ah thu na gen dia, na khang na khang un kei a ding in hiai thaunilh siangthou ahi ding hi.
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.

paite: Mihing sa tung ah na buak ding uh ahi kei. Akihelkhawm bang in akibatpih dang himhim leng na bawl ding uh ahi kei. Hiai nilh siangthou ahi a, nou a ding in asiangthou ding ahi.
english: It shall not be poured on man’s flesh, and do not make any like it, according to its composition. It is holy. It shall be holy to you.

paite: Hiai bangbang a hel a, akibatpih sathau bawl hiam, siampu hilou midang tung a zang hiam kuapeuh amite lak a pan ka satkhe ding, achi," chi in.
english: Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts any of it on a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.’”

paite: Huai ban ah TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Gimlimte, singnai, onicha, galbanum leh begaw akikim chiat la in.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take to yourself sweet spices, gum resin, onycha, and galbanum: sweet spices with pure frankincense. There shall be an equal weight of each.

paite: Hiaite a pan gimnamtui na bawl ding ahi. Gimnamtui bawlsiamte hel bang na hel ding ahi. Chisoh, asiang leh azek a siangthou ahi ding hi.
english: You shall make incense of it, a perfume after the art of the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.

paite: Khenkhat na gawizan mahmah dia, kihoupihna biakbuk sung a theihpihna ma ah na koih dia, huai ah ka hon kimuhpih ding hi. Hiai nang a ding in siangthoupen ahi ding hi.
english: You shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be to you most holy.

paite: Na bawl ding gimnamtui toh kisai in, ahelkhawmdan a abatpih nou aituam ding in na kibawl ding ahi kei. Nou a ding in TOUPA mai ah siangthou ahi ding ahi.
english: You shall not make this incense, according to its composition, for yourselves: it shall be to you holy for Yahweh.

paite: Agim namtui nap dia abatpih bawl peuhmah amite a pan ka satkhe ding," achi hi.
english: Whoever shall make any like that, to smell of it, he shall be cut off from his people.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen hi:
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "En in, Judah nam a Hur tapa, Uri tapa Bezaleel amin in ka samta hi.
english: “Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

paite: Pathian Kha leh pilna leh theihsiamna leh theihna leh khutsiamna lam chiteng in amah ka dimsakta hi.
english: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship,

paite: Ama'n khutsiamna in thil lim leh mel nei in agel dia, dangka-eng leh dangka leh dal in thil abawl ding hi.
english: to devise skillful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in bronze,

paite: Huai ban ah suangmantamte a-at dia, singte lim leh mel nei in khutsiamtak in abawl ding hi.
english: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship.

paite: Aseppih ding in akiang ah Dan nam a mi Ahisamak tapa, Aholiab ka peta hi. Khutsiamna nei tengteng leng pilna lungtang ka peta a, amau nang ka hon thupiak bang in thil tengteng abawl ding uhi.
english: Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you:

paite: Kihoupihna puanin, theihpihna bawm, huai tung a om zahngaihna tutphah leh puanin vanzat tengteng;
english: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant, the mercy seat that is on it, all the furniture of the Tent,

paite: Dohkan leh avante leh khawnvak koihna a van tengteng toh, gimlim maitam;
english: the table and its vessels, the pure lamp stand with all its vessels, the altar of incense,

paite: halmang thillat maitam, avan tengteng toh, tuikuang leh akhe;
english: the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, the basin and its base,

paite: nasepna puante leh siampu Aaron puan siangthoute leh atapate puansilhte, siampu nasepna mun a nasem ding in;
english: the finely worked garments—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, the garments of his sons to minister in the priest’s office—

paite: huan nilh theih thau leh Mun Siangthou a ding gimlim abawl ding ua, nang ka hon thupiak tengteng bang in ahih ding uhi," achi hi.
english: the anointing oil, and the incense of sweet spices for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you they shall do.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen hi:
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: Israel suante kiang ah thu gen in, "Chihtaktak a ka Sabbath na tan ngeingei ding uh ahi. Na khang ua kei leh nou kal a chiamtehna ahih ziak in. Nou hon hihsiangthou, TOUPA ka hi, chih na theihna ding un.
english: “Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths; for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies you.

paite: Huaiziak in Sabbath na tang ding ua; nou a dia siangthou ahih ziak in. Kuapeuh hiai hihbuah sihsak ngeingei ding ahi. Kuapeuh hiai ni a nasem, amite lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
english: You shall keep the Sabbath therefore, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

paite: Ni guk sung nna septheih ahi dia; himahleh ani sagihna Sabbath, TOUPA a dia siangthou ahi. Sabbath ni a kuapeuh in nna khatpeuh asepleh, sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
english: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to Yahweh. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall surely be put to death.

paite: Huaiziak in Israel suante'n Sabbath ni atang ding ua, thukhun tawntung hi ding in, akhang-akhang un Sabbath ni atang ding uhi.
english: Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.

paite: Hiai tangtawn in kei leh Israel suante kikal a chiamtehna ahi. Ni guk a TOUPA'N lei leh van abawl a, ani sagih ni akhawl a, atawldam ziak in," achi hi.
english: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel forever; for in six days Yahweh made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.’”

paite: Sinai Tang tung a Pathian in Mosi houpih a, thu agen khit in theihsakna pek nih, suangpekte, Pathian khutzung a gelh, Mosi apia hi.
english: When he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, he gave Moses the two tablets of the covenant, stone tablets, written with God’s finger.

paite: Tang a pan Mosi ahong paisuk pah louh mite'n atheih un, mite Aaron kiang ah ahong kikhawm ua, akiang ah, "Kisa in, ka ma ua pai ding, pathiante hon bawlsak in. Hiai Mosi, Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhepa lah, bang chita ahia, ka thei ngal kei ua," achi uhi.
english: When the people saw that Moses delayed coming down from the mountain, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron, and said to him, “Come, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.”

paite: Aaron in akiang uah, "Na zite uh bil a om, na tapate uh bil a om, na tanute uh bil a om, dangka-eng bilbahte tolkhia unla, ka kiang ah hon tawi un,” achi hi.
english: Aaron said to them, “Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me.”

paite: Mi tengteng in abil ua dangka-eng bilbahte atolkhia ua, Aaron kiang ah ahon tawi uhi.
english: All the people took off the golden rings which were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.

paite: Ama'n akhut ua pan huaite ala a, sunthoh bawngnou lim abawl a, huai bang in dangka-eng bawngnou lim in asung hi. Huai khit in amau, "Israel aw, Aigupta gam a pan nang hon pikhia na pathian hiai ahi,” akichi uhi.
english: He received what they handed him, fashioned it with an engraving tool, and made it a molded calf. Then they said, “These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.”

paite: Aaron in huai amuhtak in, ama uah maitam abawl a, Aaron in thupuan anei a, "Zingchiang TOUPA a dia ankuangluina ahi," achi hi.
english: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made a proclamation, and said, “Tomorrow shall be a feast to Yahweh.”

paite: Azing in beltak in athou ua, halmang thillat alan ua, lemna thillat atawi uhi. Mite ne ding leh dawn ding in atu ua, kimawl ding in adingh uhi.
english: They rose up early on the next day, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Kumsuk in, na mi Aigupta gam a pan na pikhiakte, akihihsiat ziak un.
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Go, get down; for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves!

paite: Amau ka lampi hilh a pan apial pah man hial uhi. Bawngnou lim sun akibawl ua, huai abia ua, amai ah thillatte alan ua, 'Israel aw, hiai na pathian, Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhetu ahi,' achi uh," achi hi.
english: They have turned away quickly out of the way which I commanded them. They have made themselves a molded calf, and have worshiped it, and have sacrificed to it, and said, ‘These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Hiai mite ka muta a, ngai in, migenhakte ahi uhi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in atung uah ka thangpaihna akuangzak a, amaute ka kattum theihna ding in hon subuai kei in. Huchi in nam thupi in ka hon bawl ding," achi hi.
english: Now therefore leave me alone, that my wrath may burn hot against them, and that I may consume them; and I will make of you a great nation.”

paite: Mosi in TOUPA a Pathian angen a, "TOUPA, thilhihtheihna thupi leh ban thahat a Aigupta gam a pan na pikhiaksa, na mite tung ah bangziak a na thangpaihna kuangzak ding ahia?
english: Moses begged Yahweh his God, and said, “Yahweh, why does your wrath burn hot against your people, that you have brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?

paite: Bang ding in ahia Aiguptate'n thu gen a, 'Hihse dia amau pikhia ahita ve, tangte a amaute that ding leh leitung maikaih a pan amaute kangtum ding in?' Na thangpaihna thupi lakik inla, na mite tung a hiai thil hoih lou na ngaihtuah kikhelsak in.
english: Why should the Egyptians talk, saying, ‘He brought them out for evil, to kill them in the mountains, and to consume them from the surface of the earth’? Turn from your fierce wrath, and turn away from this evil against your people.

paite: Akiang ua, 'Van a aksite bang in na suante ka pungsak dia, na suante kiang a thu ka gensa, hiai gam tengteng ka hon pe ding, huchi in tangtawn in na luah ding uh,' chi a, nangmah ngei a na kichiamna, na sikhate, Abraham, Isak leh Jakob theigige in," achi hi.
english: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and all this land that I have spoken of I will give to your offspring, and they shall inherit it forever.’”

paite: Huchi in amite tung a thil hoih lou hih dia angaihtuah TOUPA'N akikhelsakta hi.
english: So Yahweh turned away from the evil which he said he would do to his people.

paite: Mosi akihei a, tang a kipan apaisuk hi. Akhut ah theihpihna suangpek nihte a-om a, suangpekte alangnih tuak a gelh ahi a, khat lam leh langkhat lam a gelh ahi uhi.
english: Moses turned, and went down from the mountain, with the two tablets of the covenant in his hand; tablets that were written on both their sides. They were written on one side and on the other.

paite: Suangpekte Pathian thilhih ahi a, agelhte leng Pathian gelh ahi, suangpekte tung a kigelhte.
english: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.

paite: Joshua in mite kikou husa azak in Mosi kiang ah, "Giahphual ah kidouna husa a-om," achi hi.
english: When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, “There is the noise of war in the camp.”

paite: Ama'n, "Tungnun kituh a kikoute aw ahi kei a, nuaisiah a om ziak a kapte aw leng ahi kei. Lasate husa ahi zaw ka zak," achi hi.
english: He said, “It isn’t the voice of those who shout for victory. It is not the voice of those who cry for being overcome; but the noise of those who sing that I hear.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, giahphual kiang ahong tuntak in, bawngnou leh lam amuta hi. Huchi in Mosi hehna asou a, akhut a pan suangpekte apai a, tang nuai ah akeksakta hi.
english: As soon as he came near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dancing. Then Moses’ anger grew hot, and he threw the tablets out of his hands, and broke them beneath the mountain.

paite: Abawngnou bawl uh ala a, mei ah akhul a, agawinen a, tui tung ah atheh a, Israel suante adawnsak hi.
english: He took the calf which they had made, and burned it with fire, ground it to powder, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel drink it.

paite: Mosi in Aaron kiang ah, "Hiai mite'n bang ahia na kiang a ahih uh, atung ua hichi tel a khelhna thupi na tunsak?" achi hi.
english: Moses said to Aaron, “What did these people do to you, that you have brought a great sin on them?”

paite: Aaron in, "Mite'n thil sia azondan uh na thei hi, ka toupa' hehna kuang kei hen.
english: Aaron said, “Don’t let the anger of my lord grow hot. You know the people, that they are set on evil.

paite: Ka ma ua pai ding, pathiante hon bawlsak in. Hiai Mosi, Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhetoupa lah, bang suakta ahia ka thei ngal kei ua, ka kiang a achih ziak un.
english: For they said to me, ‘Make us gods, which shall go before us. As for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’

paite: Ke'n akiang uah, dangka-eng nei peuh in hon tolkhia un ka chi hi. Huchi in amau kei ahon pia ua; ke'n mei sung ah ka khia a, hiai bawngnou lim ahong pawtkhia," achi hi.
english: I said to them, ‘Whoever has any gold, let them take it off.’ So they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf.”

paite: Aaron in a-utut ua om dia mite ataizak uh phal in, melmate ma ah zahlak in a-omsak, chih Mosi in amu hi.
english: When Moses saw that the people were out of control, (for Aaron had let them lose control, causing derision among their enemies),

paite: Giahphual kongpi ah Mosi adingh a, "TOUPA lam a pang kuakua ahia? Ka kiang ah hong pai hen," achi hi. Akiang ah Levi ta tengteng akikhawmkhawmta uhi.
