english: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, “Whoever is on Yahweh’s side, come to me!” All the sons of Levi gathered themselves together to him.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Israel TOUPA Pathian in hichi in achi: Michih in apang ah anamsau kuah henla, giahphual tuansuak in kongpi khat a pan kongpi dang ah lut in pawt henla, michih in asanggampa, michih in alawmpa, michih in a-invengte that hen," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Every man put his sword on his thigh, and go back and forth from gate to gate throughout the camp, and every man kill his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.’”

paite: Levi tapate'n Mosi thu dungzui in ahihta ua; huchi in huai ni in mite lak ah mi sangthum asi uhi.
english: The sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses. About three thousand men fell of the people that day.

paite: Mosi in, "Michih in atapa, michih in a-unaupa douta na hih ziak un, ahon vualzawl theihna ding in tuni in TOUPA a ding in kihihsiangthou un," achi hi.
english: Moses said, “Consecrate yourselves today to Yahweh, for every man was against his son and against his brother, that he may give you a blessing today.”

paite: Azing in hichi ahong hi a, Mosi in mite kiang ah, "Khelhna khawktak in na khialta uhi. Tu in TOUPA kiang ah ka hohtou dia; na khelhna uh a ding in lemna ka bawl thei maithei hi," achi hi.
english: On the next day, Moses said to the people, “You have sinned a great sin. Now I will go up to Yahweh. Perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin.”

paite: TOUPA kiang ah Mosi akik nawn a, "Aw, hiai mite'n khelhna thupitak ahih ua, dangka-eng pathiante akibawl uhi.
english: Moses returned to Yahweh, and said, “Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves gods of gold.

paite: Ahi a lah, tu in, akhelhna uh ngaidam in; Na ngaihdam kei dingleh, na gelhsa na laibu a pan kei hon thaimang in, ka hon ngen ahi," achi hi.
english: Yet now, if you will, forgive their sin—and if not, please blot me out of your book which you have written.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Kuapeuh ka tung a khial, ka laibu a pan ka thaimang ding.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against me, I will blot him out of my book.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in kuan inla, na kiang a ka genna mun ah mite pi in. Ngai in, na ma ah ka Angel apai ding. Akoi abang hitaleh gawt dia ka veh ni in akhelhna uh ziak in amaute ka gawt ding," achi hi.
english: Now go, lead the people to the place of which I have spoken to you. Behold, my angel shall go before you. Nevertheless, in the day when I punish, I will punish them for their sin.”

paite: Huchi in Aaron in abawl bawngnou mai a thil alat ziak in TOUPA'N mite hipi in agawtta hi.
english: Yahweh struck the people, because of what they did with the calf, which Aaron made.

paite: Huai khit in, TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, “Kuan inla, hiai a kipan paitou in, nang leh Aigupta gam a pan na pikhiak mite, na suante kiang ah ka hon pe ding, chi a, Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a ka kichiamna gam ah.
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Depart, go up from here, you and the people that you have brought up out of the land of Egypt, to the land of which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’

paite: Na ma ah ka angel ka sawl ding a; huchi in Kanaante, Amorte, Hitte, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste ka hawlkhe ding.
english: I will send an angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

paite: Bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luang gam ah hohtou un. Migenhakte na hih ziak un, kei na lak ua hohtou lou ding ka hi. Huchi lou in zaw lampi ah ka hon kangtum kha ding," achi hi.
english: Go to a land flowing with milk and honey; but I will not go up among you, for you are a stiff-necked people, lest I consume you on the way.”

paite: Mite'n hiai thuhoih lou azak un, alungkham uhi. Huchi in mi kuamah kizepna a kizem a-om kei uh.
english: When the people heard this evil news, they mourned; and no one put on his jewelry.

paite: TOUPA'N lah Mosi kiang ah, "Israel suante kiang ah, migenhakte na hi uhi. Mitphiat kal lou a na lak ua hong tou a, hong kangtum thei ka hi. Huaiziak in na tung ua bang hih ding ka hia, chih ka theihna ding in na kizepnate uh suahkhia un," chi in ana gen khinta hi.
english: Yahweh had said to Moses, “Tell the children of Israel, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go up among you for one moment, I would consume you. Therefore now take off your jewelry from you, that I may know what to do to you.’”

paite: Huchi in Israel suante'n Horeb tang ah akizepnate uh asuahkhe vek uhi.
english: The children of Israel stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward.

paite: Mosi in puanin asut a, giahphual polam, giahphual a pan gamlapi ah akai a, Kihoupihna Biakbuk, achi hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, michih TOUPA zongte kihoupihna biakbuk, giahphual polam a om ah ahoh uhi.
english: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, far away from the camp, and he called it “The Tent of Meeting.” Everyone who sought Yahweh went out to the Tent of Meeting, which was outside the camp.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, puanin lam a Mosi apaikhiak teng in, mite avek un adingh ua, michih apuanin kongkhak bul ah adingh ua; puanin a alut mateng Mosi a-enzui uhi.
english: When Moses went out to the Tent, all the people rose up, and stood, everyone at their tent door, and watched Moses, until he had gone into the Tent.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, puanin a Mosi alutleh, meipi khuam ahong kumsuk a, puanin kongkhak bul ah adingh a, huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupihta hi.
english: When Moses entered into the Tent, the pillar of cloud descended, stood at the door of the Tent, and Yahweh spoke with Moses.

paite: Mi tengteng in puanin kongkhak bul a dingh, meipi khuam amu uhi. Mi tengteng adingh ua abia uhi; michih in apuanin kongkhak chiat ah.
english: All the people saw the pillar of cloud stand at the door of the Tent, and all the people rose up and worshiped, everyone at their tent door.

paite: Mi'n alawm ahoupih bang in, TOUPA'N kimaituah in Mosi ahoupih hi. Huchi in giahphual ah akik nawn a, himahleh asikha Joshua, Nun tapa, tangval nou ahihleh puanin a pan apaikhe kei hi.
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. He turned again into the camp, but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, didn’t depart from the Tent.

paite: Mosi in TOUPA kiang ah, "En in, hiai mite hon pitou in na hon chi a, himahleh ka kiang a kua hon sawl ding na hia chih na hon theisak kei hi. Hinapi in lah, na min in ka hon thei a, ka mitmuh in hehpihna leng na mu hi, na chi hi.
english: Moses said to Yahweh, “Behold, you tell me, ‘Bring up this people;’ and you haven’t let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.’

paite: Huaiziak in tu in, ka hon ngen ahi. Na mitmuh a hehpihna ka muhleh, nang ka hon theihna ding leh na mitmuh a hehpihna ka muhtheihna ding in, tu in na lampi hon ensak in. Hiai nam na mite ahi, chih ngaihtuah in," achi hi.
english: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me your way, now, that I may know you, so that I may find favor in your sight; and consider that this nation is your people.”

paite: Ama'n, "Ka ompihna nang toh aton dia, khawlna ka hon pe ding," achi hi.
english: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Na ompihna kei toh aton kei dingleh, hiai a pan hon pitou ke'n.
english: Moses said to him, “If your presence doesn’t go with me, don’t carry us up from here.

paite: N'on tonpih keileh, bangchi in na mite leh ke'n na mitmuh in deihsakna ka mu uh chih kithei ding ahia? Leitung pumpi a teng mi tengteng a pan kei leh na mite atuam ka hi uh, chih bang in akichiansak dia?" achi hi.
english: For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Isn’t it that you go with us, so that we are separated, I and your people, from all the people who are on the surface of the earth?”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Ka mitmuh in deihsakna na mu a, na min in ka hon theita a, hiai na nget pen leng ka hon hihsak ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name.”

paite: Ama'n, "Ka hon ngen hi, na thupina hon ensak in," achi hi.
english: Moses said, “Please show me your glory.”

paite: Ama'n, "Na ma ah ka hoihna tengteng ka paisak dia, na ma ah TOUPA min ka tangkoupih ding. 'Ka hehpih nopmi, ka hehpih dia, zahngaihna ka lah nopmi kiang ah zahngaihna ka lak ding,' achi hi.
english: He said, “I will make all my goodness pass before you, and will proclaim Yahweh’s name before you. I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy on whom I will show mercy.”

paite: Himahleh ka mai na mu thei kei ding; mi, kei hon mu, ahing kuamah a-om louh ziak in.
english: He said, “You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live.”

paite: TOUPA'N, 'En in, hiai ah ka kiang ah mun khat a-om a; suangpi tung ah na dingh in.
english: Yahweh also said, “Behold, there is a place by me, and you shall stand on the rock.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahi ding a, ka thupina in hon khen sung in suangpi heng ah ka hon koih dia, ka hon khen sung in ka khut in ka hon khuh ding hi.
english: It will happen, while my glory passes by, that I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and will cover you with my hand until I have passed by;

paite: Huai khit chiang in ka khut ka lakhe dia, huchi in ka nunglam na mu dia; himahleh ka mai bel akimu kei ding, " achi hi.
english: then I will take away my hand, and you will see my back; but my face shall not be seen.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Amasa bang in suangpek nih bawl inla; hiai suangpekte tung ah, na hihsiat suangpek masapente a om thute ka gelh ding.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Chisel two stone tablets like the first. I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.

paite: Zingsang in mansa in om inla, zingsang in Sinai Tang ah hong paitou inla, tang vum ah ka kiang ah hong kihil in.
english: Be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to me on the top of the mountain.

paite: Na kiang a kuamah ahong paitouh louh ding uh ahi. Tang kimvel a leng kuamah himhim muh a a-om louh ding uh ahi. Tang mazawn lam a bawnghon leh belamhon leng agamtat louh ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: No one shall come up with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain. Do not let the flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain.”

paite: Huchi in amasapen bang in suangpek nih abawl hi. Zingkhang in Mosi athou a, TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in, Sinai Tang ah ahohtou a, akhut in suangpek nihte atawi hi.
english: He chiseled two tablets of stone like the first; then Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up to Mount Sinai, as Yahweh had commanded him, and took in his hand two stone tablets.

paite: Meipi ah TOUPA ahong kumsuk a, akiang ah ahong dingh a, TOUPA min agenkheta hi.
english: Yahweh descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed Yahweh’s name.

paite: Huchi in ama ah TOUPA apaisuak a, "TOUPA, TOUPA Pathian, hehpih thei leh it thei, dohthei leh, hoihna leh thutak hau.
english: Yahweh passed by before him, and proclaimed, “Yahweh! Yahweh, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth,

paite: Sangte a dia zahngaihna nei, gitlouhna, tatlekna leh khelhna ngaidam, mohna bangchi mah a siangsak lou ding, pate gitlouhna tate tung leh atusuante tung, akhang thumna leh akhang lina tan a thukpa," chi in apuangkhia hi.
english: keeping loving kindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin; and who will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the children’s children, on the third and on the fourth generation.”

paite: Kintak in lei si in Mosi akunsuk a, abeta hi.
english: Moses hurried and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped.

paite: Ama'n, "Tu a na mitmuh a hehpihna ka muhleh, TOUPA aw, ka hon ngen hi, ka lak uah ka TOUPA pai hen; migenhak ahih ziak un. Ka gitlouhna uleh ka khelhna uh ngaidam inla, na gouluah ding in hon la in," achi hi.
english: He said, “If now I have found favor in your sight, Lord, please let the Lord go among us, even though this is a stiff-necked people; pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance.”

paite: Ama'n: Ngai in, nou toh thukhun ka bawl hi. Leitung pumpi a hih a om ngei lou, koi nam a leng hih a om ngei lou, thillamdangte na mi tengteng ma ah ka hih ding hi. Alak ua na tenna mi tengteng in TOUPA'N nou a dia thil lauhuai ka hih dingte amu ding uh.
english: He said, “Behold, I make a covenant: before all your people I will do marvels, such as have not been worked in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among whom you are shall see the work of Yahweh; for it is an awesome thing that I do with you.

paite: Nang tuni a ka hon thupiak zui in. Ngai in na ma uah Amorte, leh Kanaante, leh Hitte, leh Perizte, leh Hivte, leh Jebuste ka hawlkhe ding hi.
english: Observe that which I command you today. Behold, I will drive out before you the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

paite: Pilvang in, na paina gam a tengte toh thukhun na bawl kha ding uh. Huchi lou in zaw na lak ua thang ahi ding uhi.
english: Be careful, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where you are going, lest it be for a snare among you;

paite: Amaitamte uh hihsia un, amilimte uh hihgawpsak un, a Asherah songte uh na phuksak ding uh ahi.
english: but you shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and you shall cut down their Asherah poles;

paite: Pathian dang na be ding uh ahi kei: TOUPA, amin Mullit hat ahi a, mullit hat Pathian ahi.
english: for you shall worship no other god; for Yahweh, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.

paite: Huai gam a teng mite toh kikal ah thukhun na bawl kha ding uh. Apathiante uh kiang a kithoihna alat chiang in khattei in ahon chial dia, akithoihna sa uh na ne kha ding uh.
english: “Don’t make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, lest they play the prostitute after their gods, and sacrifice to their gods, and one call you and you eat of his sacrifice;

paite: Na tapate a ding in atanute uh na pisak kha ding ua, atanute uh apathiante uh kiang a akizuak chiang un, na tapate uh leng amaute hih bang a, amilimte uh be ding in akhempuk kha ding uhi.
english: and you take of their daughters to your sons, and their daughters play the prostitute after their gods, and make your sons play the prostitute after their gods.

paite: Sunthoh pathiante na kibawl ding uh ahi kei.
english: “You shall make no cast idols for yourselves.

paite: Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina na nei gige ding uh ahi. Thu ka hon piak tak bang in, Abib kha in, ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding uh; Abib kha a Aigupta a pan a na hong paikhiak ziak un.
english: “You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib; for in the month Abib you came out of Egypt.

paite: Sul hong ta masa tengteng, na ganhon lak ua piang masapen teng, bawngtal hi in belam hileh, apa peuhpeuh kei a ahi.
english: “All that opens the womb is mine; and all your livestock that is male, the firstborn of cow and sheep.

paite: Himahleh sabiltungnou masapen belamnou in na tatkhiak ding uh ahi. Na tatkhiak kei uleh, angawng na hektan ding uh ahi. Na tapate tengteng lak a piang masapen na tatkhiak ding ahi. Ka ma ah kuamah khutvuak in ahong kilang ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb. If you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. You shall redeem all the firstborn of your sons. No one shall appear before me empty.

paite: Ni guk sung nna na sem ding ahi. Himahleh ani sagih ni in na khawl ding ahi. Haichi pawi hun leh pawltak hun in na khawl ding ahi.
english: “Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest: in plowing time and in harvest you shall rest.

paite: Nipi kalte a ankuangluina, huit buh pawltak gah masa ankuangluina, kum tawp a koihkhawmna ankuang- luinate na tan ding ahi.
english: “You shall observe the feast of weeks with the first fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of harvest at the year’s end.

paite: Kum khat in thumvei pasal teng- teng Toupa PATHIAN, Israel' Pathian ma a akilat ding uh ahi.
english: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: Na mai ua namte ka delhkhe ding a, na gamgi uh ka keklian ding. Kum khat a thumvei TOUPA na Pathian ma a na kilat chiang un, kuamah in na gam uh ahon deihgoh kei ding hi.
english: For I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your borders; neither shall any man desire your land when you go up to appear before Yahweh, your God, three times in the year.

paite: "Ka mai a kithoihna thillat; silngou toh sisan na lan ding uh ahi kei. Paikan Ankuanglui kithoihna leng azingchiang tan in nutsiat in a-om ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The sacrifice of the feast of the Passover shall not be left to the morning.

paite: Na gam a gah masa hoihpente a masapen TOUPA na Pathian inn ah na hon tawi ding ahi. Kelnou anu' nawitui in na huan ding ahi kei," achi hi.
english: “You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground to the house of Yahweh your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Hiai thute gelh in. Hiai thute omdan zui a nang leh Israel toh thukhun ka bawl tak ziak in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Write these words; for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”

paite: TOUPA kiang ah ni sawmli leh zan sawmli a-om a; an ane kei a, tui leng adawn kei hi. Suangpek tung ah thukhun thute, huai Thupiak Sawmte agelh hi.
english: He was there with Yahweh forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread, nor drank water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

paite: Sinai Tang a kipan akhut a theihpihna suangpek nihte tawi a, tang a kipan Mosi ahong paisuk lai in, amah ahoupih sung in amaitang tang ahi chih Mosi in athei kei hi.
english: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the covenant in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mountain, Moses didn’t know that the skin of his face shone by reason of his speaking with him.

paite: Aaron leh Israel suan tengteng in Mosi amuhtak un, ngai in, amaitang atang a; amah naih a hong pai alauta uhi.
english: When Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come near him.

paite: Himahleh Mosi in amaute asam a; Aaron leh mipi kikhawmte heutu tengteng akiang ah ahong kik nawn ua; Mosi in amaute ahoupih hi.
english: Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned to him; and Moses spoke to them.

paite: Huai nung in Israel suan tengteng ahong pai nai ua; Sinai Tang a TOUPA'N akiang a agen tengteng thupiak in amaute apeta hi.
english: Afterward all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them all the commandments that Yahweh had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.

paite: Mosi in amaute ahoupih khit in, amaitang khuhna in akhuh hi.
english: When Moses was done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA houpih dia amai alut teng in, ahong pawtkhiak nawn mateng, thupiak a omte Israel suante kiang a agen chiang in, amai khuhna ahawkkhia hi.
english: But when Moses went in before Yahweh to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spoke to the children of Israel that which he was commanded.

paite: Israel suante'n Mosi maitang amu ua, Mosi maivun atang hi. Mosi in amah houpih dia alut nawn matan in amaitang akhuh zel hi.
english: The children of Israel saw Moses’ face, that the skin of Moses’ face shone; so Moses put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with him.

paite: Huan Mosi in Israel suan tengteng akhawmkhawm a, akiang uah: "Hiaitę na hih ding ua TOUPA thupiakte ahi.
english: Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said to them, “These are the words which Yahweh has commanded, that you should do them.

paite: Ni guk sung in nna sep zoh ahi dia, himahleh ani sagih ni noute a dia inn om ni ahi ding hi. TOUPA a dia Sabbath khawlna ahi. Sabbath ni a noute a dia inn om ni: Hiai ni nna sem peuhmah thah ding ahi.
english: ‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of solemn rest to Yahweh: whoever does any work in it shall be put to death.

paite: Sabbath ni in na tenna peuh uah mei na chih ding uh ahi kei," achi hi.
english: You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations on the Sabbath day.’”

paite: Israel suan kikhawmkhawm tengteng kiang ah Mosi in thu agen a, "TOUPA'N noute ahon thupiak hiaite ahi uh.
english: Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded, saying,

paite: TOUPA a ding in na lak uah thilpiakte lakhawm un. Lungtang a utna nei kuapeuh in TOUPA a ding in thilpiakte: dangka-eng, dangka leh dal;
english: ‘Take from among you an offering to Yahweh. Whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it as Yahweh’s offering: gold, silver, bronze,

paite: khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au, puanmalngat hoih, kel mul;
english: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,

paite: belampa mul diahsan, ngalvang vun, singgi sing;
english: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,

paite: khawnvak a ding thau, thaunilh ding in gimlim; hal namtui ding;
english: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

paite: onik suangte, siampu puanak leh awmtuam a siat ding suangmantamte hon tawikhawm uhen," achi hi.
english: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.

paite: "Na lak ua khutsiam tengteng na hong pai ding ua, TOUPA'N bawl ding chi a thu ahon piak tengteng abawl ding uhi.
english: “‘Let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that Yahweh has commanded:

paite: Biakbuk, apuanin, akhuhna, asikkawi, asingpekte, asiktawnte, akhuamte leh akingakna khuakkuakte;
english: the tabernacle, its outer covering, its roof, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;

paite: abawm leh achiangte, zahngaihna tutphah leh akhuhna puanzak;
english: the ark, and its poles, the mercy seat, the veil of the screen;

paite: dohkan leh achiangte, atui-um belsuan leh tanghou koihna;
english: the table with its poles and all its vessels, and the show bread;

paite: khawnvak a ding in khawnvak koihna leng, avante, akhawnvakte, avakna thau;
english: the lamp stand also for the light, with its vessels, its lamps, and the oil for the light;

paite: gimlim maitam leh achiangte, nilh theih thau, gimlim leh biakbuk lutna kongkhak a dia puankhai,
english: and the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;

paite: halmang thillatna maitam, adal vutluah, azawlte leh atui-um belsuan tengteng, tuikuang leh akhe;
english: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of bronze, its poles, and all its vessels, the basin and its base;

paite: ahuangsung puankhaite, akhuamte, akingakna khuakkuakte, huangsung kongkhak a dia puankhai;
english: the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;

paite: biakbuk kilhna zumte, huangsung kilhna zumte leh akhaute;
english: the pins of the tabernacle, the pins of the court, and their cords;

paite: nasepna puante, mun siangthou a nasepna dia siampu Aaron puan siangthoute, atapate puante bawl uhen," achi hi.
english: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons—to minister in the priest’s office.’”

paite: Huchi in Israel suan kikhawm teng Mosi omna a pan apaita uhi.
english: All the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

paite: Michih alungtang tohthoh a om peuhmah leh michih utna nei peuhmahte ahong pai ua, kihoupihna biakbuk lamna ding leh asung a nasepna ding leh puansilh siangthoute bawlna ding TOUPA ma ah thilpiak ahon tawi uhi.
english: They came, everyone whose heart stirred him up, and everyone whom his spirit made willing, and brought Yahweh’s offering for the work of the Tent of Meeting, and for all of its service, and for the holy garments.

paite: Lungtang a utna nei pasalte leh numeite ahong pai ua, dangka-eng a kibawl thil tuamtuam: bilbah, nakbah, zungbuh, ohthoh leh butthoh kizepnate ahon tawi ua, TOUPA mai ah alan uhi.
english: They came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, and brought brooches, earrings, signet rings, and armlets, all jewels of gold; even every man who offered an offering of gold to Yahweh.

paite: Khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au, puanmalngat hoih, kel mul, belampa vun, ngalvang vun neite'n huaite ahon tawi uhi.
english: Everyone with whom was found blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair, rams’ skins dyed red, and sea cow hides, brought them.

paite: Thilpiak dia dangka leh dal neite'n TOUPA mai a thillat ding in ahon tawi uhi. Singgi sing nei teng in leng ahon tawi uhi.
english: Everyone who offered an offering of silver and bronze brought Yahweh’s offering; and everyone with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought it.

paite: Numei khutsiam teng in khut in khau akhek ua, akheksa uh ahon tawi ua, khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih ahon tawi uhi.
english: All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their hands, and brought that which they had spun: the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.

paite: Lungtang tohthoh numei tengteng in kel mul akhek uhi.
english: All the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats’ hair.

paite: Vaihawm mite'n onik suangte, suangte, siampu puan leh awmtuam a siat dingte ahon tawi uhi;
english: The rulers brought the onyx stones and the stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate;

paite: gimnamtui hal ding singgah namtui leh det ding meivak leh nilh ding sathau a zat ding leh gimnamtui a hel ding sathau ahon tawi uhi.
english: with the spice and the oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi zang a thu apiak a, van bawl ding achih tengteng bawlna ding in Israel suante, numei leh pasalte'n amau ut thu in thilpiakte TOUPA mai ah ahon tawi uhi.
english: The children of Israel brought a free will offering to Yahweh; every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which Yahweh had commanded to be made by Moses.

paite: Mosi in Israel suante kiang ah, "En un, TOUPA'N Bezaleel, Uri tapa, Hur tapa, Judah nam a mi amin in asam a;
english: Moses said to the children of Israel, “Behold, Yahweh has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

paite: Pathian Kha leh pilna leh theihsiamna leh theihna leh khutsiamna chiteng in amah adimsak hi.
english: He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship;

paite: Huai bel khutsiamtak a bawl dingte gelsiamna, dangka-eng leh dangka leh dal thilbawlsiamna ahi a, bulh ding suangmantamte atsiamna, sing lam siamna ahi.
english: and to make skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze,

paite: bulh ding suangmantamte atsiamna, sing lam siamna leh khutsiam thilbawl chiteng asiamna ahi.
english: in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship.

paite: Huan amah leh Dan nam a Ahisamak tapa Aholiab leng midangte sinsak siamna apia hi.
english: He has put in his heart that he may teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

paite: Amaute teng khuakthoh a thilbawl siamna chikim leh khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au, puanmalngat hoih gat zep siamna, gat siamna, ze tuamtuam gelh siamna nei ding in pilna apia hi," achi hi.
english: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to work all kinds of workmanship, of the engraver, of the skillful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of those who do any workmanship, and of those who make skillful works.

paite: "Hiai bang in Bezaleel, Aholiab leh mun siangthou vanzatte bawldan ding thei ding a TOUPA'N pilna leh theihsiamna a piak khutsiamte'n TOUPA thupiak bang in vanzatte abawl ding uh ahi,” achi hi.
english: “Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom Yahweh has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that Yahweh has commanded.”

paite: Huai khit in Mosi in Bezaleel, Aholiab leh michih khutsiamna nei, alungtang ua TOUPA'N pilna akoih leh michih alungtang ua nasem a kuan dia tohthoh a omte Mosi in asamta hi.
english: Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart Yahweh had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it.

paite: Amaute'n mun siangthou bawlna dia Israel suante'n ahon tawi uh thilpiak tengteng Mosi a pan alata uhi. Huchi in zingsang teng in ut thu apiak thillatte akiang ah hon tawi uhi.
english: They received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning.

paite: Mun siangthou a nna tengteng sem, khutsiam teng a nasep chiat a pan ahong pai ua,
english: All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which he did.

paite: Mosi kiang ah, "TOUPA'N bawl dia ahon thupiak bang a nasepna dia poimoh zah sang a tamzaw mite'n ahon tawi uh," achi uhi.
english: They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which Yahweh commanded to make.”

paite: Mosi in thu apia a, giahphual teng ah atangkoupih ua, "Pasal hileh numei hileh mun siangthou bawlna dia thilpiak kuamah in pe nawn kei un," achi hi. Huchi in thilpiak hon tawi nawn lou dia kham in a-omta uhi.
english: Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing.

paite: Mun siangthou bawlna a nna tengteng sepna ding in avan neihsa uh kiching in, atam lota hi.
english: For the stuff they had was sufficient to do all the work, and too much.

paite: Nasemte lak a khutsiamte'n biakbuk khuhna ding siamtak a khui cherubte lim tuanna puanzak sawm, khau dum, khau sandup leh khau san-au khuk in abawl uhi.
english: All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet. They made them with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.

paite: Puanzak khat dunglam tong sawmnih-le-giat ahi a; availam tong li; puanzak tengteng letdan akikim chiat hi.
english: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.

paite: Puanzak ngate kithuah in akhep uhi. Puanzak dang ngate leng akhep hi.
english: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.

paite: Akithuahna mong khepna a pan puanzak khat gei ah khau dum in abilte abawl a, huchi mah in anihna khepna ah, puanzak dang gei chin ah abilte abawl hi.
english: He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling.

paite: Puanzak khat ah abil sawmnga abawl a, anihna kikhepna a puanzak gei ah abil sawmnga abawl hi. Abilte kizawn geihgeih in a-om uhi.
english: He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite to one another.

paite: Dangka-eng in kilhna sawmnga abawl a, kilhnate in puanzakte agawmkhawm hi. Huchi in biakbuk khat ahong hita hi.
english: He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.

paite: Puanin biakbuk tung a ding in kel mul in puanzak abawl a; sawm-le-khat abawl hi.
english: He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.

paite: Puanzak khat dunglam tong sawmthum ahi a, puanzak khat vailam tong li ahi. Puanzak sawm-le-khatte alehlam akibang vek hi.
english: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain. The eleven curtains had one measure.

paite: Puanzak ngate amau in akikheptuam a, puanzak gukte amau in akikheptuam hi.
english: He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

paite: Akikhepna puanzak mongchin ah abil sawmnga abawl a, puanzak anihna thuahna pen mong ah abil sawmnga abawl hi.
english: He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling.

paite: Khat ahihtheihna dia puanin kaihkhawmna ding in dal in kilhna sawmnga abawl hi.
english: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.

paite: Puanin khuhna ding in belampa vun diahsan in abawl a, huai tung ah ngalvang vun in khuhna abawl hi.
english: He made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

paite: Singgi sing in biakbuk singpek ding atunthoh in abawl hi.
english: He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.

paite: Singpek sau lam tong sawm ahi a, singpek zatlam tong khat-le-akim ahi.
english: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.

paite: Singpek khat in atgek nih anei a, akigamlatdan uh kikim in huchibang in biakbuk singpek tengteng a ding in abawl hi.
english: Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.

paite: Biakbuk a ding in singpek abawl a, simlam pang a ding in singpek sawmnih abawl hi.
english: He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.

paite: Singpek sawmnih nuai ah dangka-eng in kingakna khuakkuak sawmli abawl a; a-atgek nihte a ding in singpek khat dang ah kingakna khuakkuak nih, a-atgek nih a ding in singpek dang ah kingakna khuakkuak nih abawl hi.
english: He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

paite: Biakbuk pang khat lam a ding in, amallam ning a om a ding in singpek sawmnih,
english: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards

paite: adangka-eng kingakna khuakkuak sawmlite toh; singpek khat dang ah kingakna khuakkuak nih, singpek dang khat ah kingakna khuakkuak nih abawl hi.
english: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

paite: Tumlam biakbuk pangte a ding in singpek nih abawl hi.
english: For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

paite: Apang nihte ah biakbuk ningte a ding in singpek nih abawl hi.
english: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.

paite: Anuai ah akithuah ua, atung ah sikkual khat ah akikaikhawm a; huchibang in aning tuak ah ahih tuaktuak hi.
english: They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners.

paite: Singpek giat a-om a; akingakna khuakkuak uh, dangka a bawl kingakna khuakkuak sawm-le-guk ahi ua, singpek chih dang ah kingakna khuakkuak nih abawl hi.
english: There were eight boards and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets—under every board two sockets.

paite: Singgi sing chiangtawn abawl a, biakbuk pang khat a singpekte a ding in nga abawl hi.
english: He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

paite: Biakbuk pang dang a singpekte a ding in chiangtawn nga abawl a, tumlam pang a biakbuk singpekte a ding in chiangtawn nga abawl hi.
english: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.

paite: Chiangtawn laita pen singpekte khat a pan adang kap paisuak in abawl hi.
english: He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other.

paite: Singpekte dangka-eng in aluan a, adangka-eng sikkualte chiangtawn omna ding in abawl a, chiangtawnte dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

paite: Khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat koptah hoih in puankhai abawl a; khutsiamtak in cherubte abawl hi.
english: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.

paite: Singgi sing in khuam li abawl a; dangka-eng in aluan a, abannate dangka-eng abawl hi. Huaite a ding in dangka in kingakna khuakkuak li asung hi.
english: He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them.

paite: Biakbuk kongkhak a ding in khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah, phim a khui in puankhai abawl hi.
english: He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer;

paite: Akhuam ngate abanna uh toh; azingte uleh apuanduangte dangka-eng in aluan a, himahleh akingakna khuakkuak ngate dal a bawl ahi.
english: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.

paite: Huan Bazaleel in singgi sing in bawm abawl a, adunglam tong nih-le-akim ahi a, availam tong khat-le-akim, huan asanlam tong khat-le-akim ahi.
english: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood. Its length was two and a half cubits, and its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.

paite: Dangka-engtak in asunglam leh apolam aluan a, dangka-eng lallukhu akimvel in abawl hi.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it.

paite: Aning lite a bulh ding in dangka-eng sikkual li asung hi. Apang khat asikkual nih, apang khat lam ah sikkual nih.
english: He cast four rings of gold for it in its four feet—two rings on its one side, and two rings on its other side.

paite: Singgi sing in zawl abawl a, dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

paite: Huan bawm pang a sikkual sung ah, bawm zawnna ding in hiai zawlte athunlut hi.
english: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

paite: Dangka-engtak in zahngaihna tutphah abawl a; tong nih-le-akim adunglam ahi a, tong khat-le-akim availam ahi.
english: He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its width.

paite: Dangka-eng sekkhiak in zahngaihna tutphah mong nihte tuak ah cherubte abawl hi.
english: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat:

paite: Hiai lam pang mong ah cherub khat, huai lam pang mong ah cherub dang khat, zahngaihna tutphah a pan among langnihte ah cherubte abawl hi.
english: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.

paite: Cherubte'n tunglam ah akha uh azak ua, zahngaihna tutphah tunglam ah, amai uh kingattuah in, akha un akhuh ua; zahngaihna tutphah lam ah cherubte mai a-om hi.
english: The cherubim spread out their wings above, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.

paite: Singgi sing in dohkan abawl a; adunglam tong nih ahi a, availam tong khat, huan asanlam tong khat-le-akim ahi.
english: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its width was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half.

paite: Dangka-engtak in aluan a, akimvel in dangka-eng lallukhu abawl hi.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.

paite: Huai lou in huai ah akimvel in khutpek chia in agei abawl a; akimvel in agei ding in dangka-eng lallukhu abawl hi.
english: He made a border of a hand’s width around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it.

paite: Dangka-eng sikkual li asung a, akhe lite a om aning lite tung ah sikkualte abulh hi.
english: He cast four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet.

paite: Ageichin ah, dohkan puakna ding chiangte a ding in mun, sikkualte a-om uhi.
english: The rings were close by the border, the places for the poles to carry the table.

paite: Singgi sing in chiangte abawl a, dohkan puakna ding in, dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.

paite: Dohkan tung a om tui-um belsuan abawl a, akuangte leh asikkeute leh anoubemte leh akhuhna ding singte, dangka-engtak in abawl hi.
english: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.

paite: Khawnvak koihna dangka-engtak in abawl a; sekthoh in khawnvak koihna abawl hi. Akungpi, ahiang, anoubemte leh amumte leh apakte kibang chiat uhi.
english: He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers were of one piece with it.

paite: Apangte a pan hiang guk akakhia a; khawnvak koihna hiang thum apang khat a pan, apang dang a pan khawnvak koihna hiang thum.
english: There were six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side:

paite: Noubem thum makha gah bang a bawl hiang khat ah, amum leh apak; noubem thum makha gah bang a bawl hiang dang ah, amum leh apak, huchibang in hiang guk teng ah khawnvak koihna a pan in.
english: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower, and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower; so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

paite: Khawnvak koihna makha gah bang a bawl noubem li a-om; amumte leh apakte toh.
english: In the lamp stand were four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

paite: Akibang in hiang nihte dang ah mum khat, akibang in hiang nihte dang ah mum khat, akibang in hiang nihte dang ah mum khat, hiang gukte bang zel in akakhia uhi.
english: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.

paite: Amumte uh leh ahiangte uh kibang ahi ua: avek un dangka-engtak sekthoh ahi.
english: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold.

paite: Khawnvak sagihte, meihalnate leh meivu kuangte dangka-engtak in abawl hi.
english: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.

paite: Dangka-engtak talent khat in tui-um belsuan teng abawl hi.
english: He made it of a talent of pure gold, with all its vessels.

paite: Gimlim maitam singgi sing in abawl a; adunglam tong khat ahi, availam tong khat; kiptak a bawl ahi a; asanlam tong nih ahi. Akibang vek uhi.
english: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. It was square: its length was a cubit, and its width a cubit. Its height was two cubits. Its horns were of one piece with it.

paite: Dangka-engtak in atung leh akimvel in apangte leh akite aluan hi. Huai lou leng akimvel in dangka-eng lallukhu abawl hi.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.

paite: Alallukhu nuai ah dangka-eng in sikkual nih abawl a, aning nihte kiang ah, asik nihte tung ah, apuakna ding chiangte omna ding in.
english: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown, on its two ribs, on its two sides, for places for poles with which to carry it.

paite: Huan singgi sing in zawlte abawl a, dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.

paite: Nilh theih thau siangthou, gim-namtui siangthou, gimlim bawlmi hih bang in abawl hi.
english: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.

paite: Singgi sing in halmang thillat maitam abawl a; adunglam tong nga ahi a, availam tong nga ahi a, huan asanlam tong thum ahi. Kiptak a bawl ahi.
english: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, its width was five cubits, and its height was three cubits.

paite: Aning lite ah akii abawl a; akiite akibang vek ua; dal in aluan hi.
english: He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.

paite: Atui-um belsuan tengteng, maitam, belte, vutluahte, salu kuangte, sa thuknate leh meibel tengteng dal in abawl hi.
english: He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.

paite: Huan alaizangtak nuai ah among dang ah dal hakvang maitam a ding in abawl hi.
english: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.

paite: Chiangte omna ding in, dal hakvang mong lite a ding in sikkual li asung hi.
english: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles.

paite: Singgi sing in zawl abawl a, dal in aluan hi.
english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.

paite: Azawnna ding in, maitam pang a sikkualte sung ah zawlte athunlut a; maitam singpek in asung ahawmsak hi.
english: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks.

paite: Dal in tuikuang leh akhe abawl a, numei nasem, kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a kikhawmte' limlangte abawl hi.
english: He made the basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Huangsung abawl a; simlam pang simlam ah huangsung puankhai, puanmalngat hoih koptah, tong zakhat a-om hi.
english: He made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, one hundred cubits;

paite: Akhuamte sawmnih ahi ua, adal kingakna khuakkuakte sawmnih; khuam bannate leh adangka puanduangte a-om uhi.
english: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

paite: Amallam pang a ding in puankhaite tong zakhat ahi ua, akhuamte uh sawmnih leh adal kingakna khuakkuakte sawmnih; akhuamte abannate leh dangka gaknate.
english: For the north side one hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

paite: Atumlam pang a ding in tong sawmnga a sau puankhaite a-om ua, akhuamte sawm leh akingakna khuakkuak sawm; akhuamte abannate leh adangka gaknate a-om uhi.
english: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

paite: Asuahlam pang suahlam a ding in tong sawmnga.
english: For the east side eastward fifty cubits,

paite: Kongpi sik khat a puankhaite tong sawm-le-nga ahi ua; akhuamte thum, akingakna khuakkuakte thum mah.
english: the hangings for the one side were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three;

paite: Hiai lam leh huai lam, huangsung kongpi sik khat lam pang a ding in puankhai tong sawm-le-nga ahi ua; akhuamte thum, akingakna khuakkuakte thum mah ahi.
english: and so for the other side: on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

paite: Huangsung akimvel a puankhai tengteng puanmalngat koptah hoih ahi.
english: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen.

paite: Khuam kingakna khuakkuakte dal ahi ua; khuam bannate leh adangka gaknate dangka azingte uh luanna; huangsung khuam tengteng dangka in agaknate akibawl hi.
english: The sockets for the pillars were of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. Their capitals were overlaid with silver. All the pillars of the court had silver bands.

paite: Huangsung kongpi a puankhai phim a khui, khau dum, khau sandup, asan-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah ahi. Adunglam tong sawmnih ahi a, apek sanlam tong nga ahi, huangsung puankhaite toh akituak hi.
english: The screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. Twenty cubits was the length, and the height along the width was five cubits, like the hangings of the court.

paite: Akhuamte li ahi a, akingakna khuakkuakte li, dal a bawl ahi. Abannate dangka a bawl, dangka a bawl azingte leh adung luante.
english: Their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of bronze; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.

paite: Biakbuk kilhna zum teng leh huangsung kimvel kilhna tengteng dal ahi uh.
english: All the pins of the tabernacle, and around the court, were of bronze.

paite: Hiai biakbuk vankim, sim a om bang in, theihpihna biakbuk ate ngei, Levite nasepna dia, Mosi thupiak bang zel a siampu Aaron tapa, Ithamar khut a bawl ahi uhi.
english: These are the amounts of materials used for the tabernacle, even the Tabernacle of the Testimony, as they were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

paite: Huchi in Bezaleel, Uri tapa, Hur tapa, Judah nam a mi in TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak tengteng abawlta hi.
english: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Amah toh sem, gelh nasep siam, khau dum leh khau sandup leh khau san-au leh puanmalngat a zebawl siam, Aholiab, Ahisamak tapa, Dan nam a mi ahi.
english: With him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skillful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen.

paite: Dangka-eng tengteng mun siangthou a nasepna teng a sepna dia zat, thillat dangka-eng nangawn, talent sawmnih-le-kua leh shekel, mun siangthou a shekel dungzui in, zasagih-le-sawmthum ahi.
english: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred thirty shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

paite: Dangka, khawmpi a simte mun siangthou a shekel dungzui in talent zakhat leh shekel sangkhat zasagih sawmsagih-le-nga ahi.
english: The silver of those who were counted of the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary:

paite: Michih a ding in beka khat, huai bel, shekel kimkhat ahi, mun siangthou a shekel dungzui in, michih sim a omte a ding in, kum sawmnih a upa leh atunglam, pasal nuaiguk sangthum zanga-le-sawmnga.
english: a beka a head, that is, half a shekel, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for everyone who passed over to those who were counted, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty men.

paite: Dangka talent zakhat mun siangthou a kingakna khuakkuak a ding in asung ua, puanzak a kingakna khuakkuakte toh; talent zakhat a dia kingakna khuakkuak zakhat, kingakna khuakkuak khat a dia talent khat zel.
english: The one hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary and the sockets of the veil: one hundred sockets for the one hundred talents, one talent per socket.

paite: Shekel sangkhat zasagih sawmsagih-le-nga in khuam bannate abawl a, azingte luan in akimatsak hi.
english: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.

paite: Thillat dal talent sawmsagih leh shekel sangnih-le-zali ahi.
english: The bronze of the offering was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.

paite: Huaite in kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak kingakna khuakkuak abawl a, dal maitam leh dal hakvang a bawl, maitam tui-um belsuan tengteng toh.
english: With this he made the sockets to the door of the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating for it, all the vessels of the altar,

paite: Huangsung kimvel a kingakna khuakkuak, huangsung kongpi kingakna khuakkuak, biakbuk kilhna zum tengteng leh huangsung kimvel a kilhna zum tengteng azou hi.
english: the sockets around the court, the sockets of the gate of the court, all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins around the court.

paite: Khau dum leh khau sandup leh khau san-au kigan in Mun Siangthou a nasepna ding siampu puante abawl ua, Aaron puansilh siangthoute abawl uhi. TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang a bawl ahi.
english: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet, they made finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah dangka-eng in siampu puan abawl uhi.
english: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

paite: Dangka-eng khau leh khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih a kigan in siampu puanakzem abawl uhi.
english: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman.

paite: Anunglam leh malam kaihkhawmna ding, aliangzang ah kaihna abawl ua, atunglam gei tuak akhihkhawm hi.
english: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.

paite: Atung a om, asiampu puanak siamneltak a gat leng akibang mah in anasep dungzui in; dangka-eng, khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih a TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak dungzui in gat in abawl uhi.
english: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Onik suang abawl ua, chiamtehna gelhna a gelh, dangka- eng bulhna a bulh in, Israel suante min dungzui zel in abawl uhi.
english: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.

paite: Huaite siampu puanak liangzang ah akoih ua, Israel suante a dia theihgigena suangte hi ding in: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in abawl hi.
english: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Khutsiamtak in awmtuam abawl a, siampu puan bawl bang in, dangka-eng, khau dum leh khau san leh khau sandup leh khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah in abawl hi.
english: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

paite: Adung-avai akikim a; awmtuamna thuah nih in abawl uhi. Asau lam khap khat ahi a, availam khap khat, thuah nih ahi.
english: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its width a span, being double.

paite: Huai ah vual li in suang asiat ua; avual khatna sardi suang, topaz suang leh karbankul suang; hiai avual khatna ahi.
english: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;

paite: Avual nihna, emerald suang, sapphir suang leh diamond ahi.
english: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;

paite: Avual thumna, liguri suang, agate suang leh amethis suang ahi.
english: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

paite: Avual lina, beril suang, onik suang leh jasper suang ahi a; aphuhna uah dangka-eng bulhna asiatlut uhi.
english: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.

paite: Suangte Israel suante min dungzui zel leh ahihna zah uh dungzui zel in, sawm-le-nih, chiamtehna gelhnate bang in, michih amin toh nam sawm-le-nihte gelh ahi.
english: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.

paite: Amongte ah awmtuam tung ah khainiang, dangka-engtak pakkhi abawl uhi.
english: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

paite: Huchi in dangka-eng bulhna nih abawl ua, dangka-eng sikkual nih toh, awmtuamna mong nihte ah sikkual nihte akoih uhi.
english: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

paite: Awmtuamna mongte a sikkual nihte sung ah dangka-eng khainiang nihte pak bang a bawl in athun uhi.
english: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

paite: Pak khainiang nihte mong nihte suangmantam bulhna nihte ah akoih ua, ama ah siampu puan liangzang thuahna ah akoih uhi.
english: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front.

paite: Dangka-eng in sikkual nih abawl ua, awmtuamna mong nihte tung ah akoih ua, agei ah sunglam pang ah siampu puanak a-om hi.
english: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.

paite: Dangka-eng sikkual nih dang abawl ua, nuailam ah siampu puanak mong nihte ah akoih uhi, amalam sang ah, akikhepna zawntak ah, siampu puanak kawnggak kigatthoh tung ah akoih uhi.
english: They made two more rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

paite: Gakna khau dum in siampu puanak sikkualte in awmtuam agakden ua, siampu puanak a pan a awmtuam akiphel theihlouhna ding in; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in abawl uhi.
english: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Siampu puanak puanaktual gatthoh, avek a adum a bawl ahi.
english: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

paite: Puanak tual laitak ah avang a-om a, sik puanak banbei vang bang in, akeklouhna ding a, avang kimvel in kaihna khau a-om hi.
english: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.

paite: Puanak tual mongte ah khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih in theibuhfai gahte abawl uhi.
english: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.

paite: Dangka-engtak in dak abawl ua, dakte puanaktual mong a theibuhfai gahte kikal ah, theibuhfai gahte kikal zel ah akhaisuak uhi. 26 Dak leh theibuhfai akhaisuak uhi.
english: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;

paite: Dak leh theibuhfai gahte nasepna ding a puanaktual mong kimvel ah TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in abawl uhi.
english: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Aaron leh atapate a ding in puanmalngat puanak tung gatthoh abawl uhi.
english: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons,

paite: Puanmalngat hoih in lukhu leh puanmalngat hoih in lutuam leh puanmalngat hoih koptah in puan pheituam gek abawl uhi.
english: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,

paite: Kawnggak puanmalngat hoih koptah, khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au, TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in khuithoh in abawl uhi.
english: the sash of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Dangka-engtak in lallukhu siangthou abawl ua, atung ah laigelh, chiamtehna gelhnate bang in, SIANTHOUNA TOUPA A AHI chih agelh uhi.
english: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO YAHWEH”.

paite: Huai ah khauhual dum akhih ua, lukhu tunglam gaktou pek ding in; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in abawl uhi.
english: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Hichibang in khawmpite' kihoupihna biakbuk nasep tengteng zoh ahita hi. TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a thupiak bang in Israel suante'n ahihta uhi.
english: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses; so they did.

paite: Biakbuk leh puanin van tengteng, akibatnate, asingpekte, azawlte, akhuamte leh kingakna khuakkuakte Mosi kiang ah hon tawi uhi.
english: They brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

paite: Akhuhna belampa vun diahsan leh akhuhna ngalvang vun leh akhuhna puanzak;
english: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen,

paite: theihpihna bawm leh azawlte leh zahngaihna tutphah;
english: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,

paite: dohkan leh atui-um belsuan tengteng leh Pathian Ompihna tanghou sawm-le-nihte;
english: the table, all its vessels, the show bread,

paite: khawnvak koihna, khawnvakte leh atui-um belsuan tengteng leh khawnvak a dia sathau;
english: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,

paite: dangka-eng maitam leh nilh theih sathau leh gimlim leh puanin kong a ding a puankhai;
english: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,

paite: dal maitam, adal hakvang, azawlte leh atui-um belsuan tengteng tuikuang leh akhe;
english: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,

paite: huangsung puankhaite, akhuamte leh akingakna khuakkuakte leh huangsung kongpi puankhai, akhaute, akilhna zumte leh biakbuk nasepna tui-um belsuan tengteng, kihoupihna biakbuk a ding:
english: the hangings of the court, its pillars, its sockets, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, its pins, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting,

paite: Mun siangthou a nasepna ding nasepna puan, hoihtak a bawlte, siampu Aaron a ding puan siangthoute leh atapate puante, siampu nasepna mun a nasepna ding,
english: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in, huchibang in Israel suante'n nna tengteng asem uhi.
english: According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.

paite: Mosi in nasep tengteng a-en a, ngai in TOUPA thupiak bangtak in asemkheta uhi. Huchi in Mosi in huaite avualzawl hi.
english: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as Yahweh had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.

paite: Huan Mosi in adawng a, "Ahi na a, ngai in, ahon gingta kei ding ua, ka aw leng ana ngaikhe sam kei ding uh, 'Na kiang ah TOUPA akilak keí, achih ding ziak un,” achi hi.
english: Moses answered, “But, behold, they will not believe me, nor listen to my voice; for they will say, ‘Yahweh has not appeared to you.’”

paite: TOUPA'N akiang ah, “Na khut a bang ahia?" achi a; ama'n, “Chiangkhun," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to him, “What is that in your hand?” He said, “A rod.”

paite: Ama'n, "Leitual ah khia in," achi a; leitual ah akhia a, gul ahong suak a; huai a pan Mosi ataikheta hi.
english: He said, “Throw it on the ground.” He threw it on the ground, and it became a snake; and Moses ran away from it.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, “Na khut zankhia inla, amei ah man in,” achi hi. Akhut azankhia a, amei ah amanta a, akhut ah chiangkhun ahong suak nawn hi;
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand, and take it by the tail.” He stretched out his hand, and took hold of it, and it became a rod in his hand.

paite: "huchi a apipute uh TOUPA Pathian, Abraham' Pathian, Isak' Pathian leh Jakob' Pathian, na kiang ah akilak chih agintakna ding un,” achi hi.
english: “This is so that they may believe that Yahweh, the God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has appeared to you.”

paite: TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Tu in na ang ah na khut koih in," achi nawn hi. A-ang a akhut koih a, azankhiaktak in, ngai in, vuk bang in akhut aphakta hi.
english: Yahweh said furthermore to him, “Now put your hand inside your cloak.” He put his hand inside his cloak, and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous, as white as snow.

paite: "Ama'n na ang ah na khut koih nawn in," achi hi. A-ang ah akhut a akoih nawn a, huan alakkhiakleh, ngai in, akhut khat lam bang ahong suak nawn hi.
english: He said, “Put your hand inside your cloak again.” He put his hand inside his cloak again, and when he took it out of his cloak, behold, it had turned again as his other flesh.

paite: "Huan hichi ahi ding a, ahon gintak louh ua, chiamtehna khatna leng angaihkhiak kei uleh, chiamtehna nanung agintak ding uh ahi ding hi.
english: “It will happen, if they will not believe you or listen to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.

paite: Hichi ahong hi ding a, hiai chiamtehna nihte agintak louh lai ua, na aw leng angaihkhiak kei uleh, lui a pan tui na la dia, gamkeu ah na sung ding. Lui a pan na tui lakkhiak gamkeu ah sisan ahong suak ding hi,” achi hi.
english: It will happen, if they will not believe even these two signs or listen to your voice, that you shall take of the water of the river, and pour it on the dry land. The water which you take out of the river will become blood on the dry land.”

paite: Mosi in TOUPA kiang ah, "Aw Toupa, midangnal ka hi kei a, chik lai mah in, na sikha kiang a thu na gen nungsang in leng midang-awk leh pau zekai ka hi zaw hi,” achi hi.
english: Moses said to Yahweh, “O Lord, I am not eloquent, neither before now, nor since you have spoken to your servant; for I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.”

paite: TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Mihing kam bawl kua ahia? Ahihkeileh pau theiloute, nangongte, muhnate leh mittawte kua bawl ahia? Kei TOUPA'N ka bawl ahi kei maw?
english: Yahweh said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, Yahweh?

paite: Huaiziak in tu in kuan inla, na kam ka ompih dia, na gen ding ka hon hilh ding," achi hi.
english: Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what you shall speak.”

paite: Ama'n, "Aw TOUPA, hehpih in midang sawl in, na sawl dingpa khut in, ka hon ngen hi," achi hi.
english: Moses said, “Oh, Lord, please send someone else.”

paite: Mosi tung ah TOUPA hehna asouta a, "Aaron, na unaupa a-om kei maw? Ama'n hoihtak in thu agen thei, chih ka thei. Huan ngai in, nang kimuhpih ding in ahong paikhia a, ahon muh chiang in alungtang akipak ding hi.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Moses, and he said, “What about Aaron, your brother, the Levite? I know that he can speak well. Also, behold, he is coming out to meet you. When he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.

paite: Akiang ah thu na gen dia, akam ah thute na guang ding. Na kam ka ompih dia, na hih ding ka hon hilh ding hi.
english: You shall speak to him, and put the words in his mouth. I will be with your mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what you shall do.

paite: Amah mite kiang ah na thugenpa ahi dia; amah nang a ding in na kam' tang ahi dia, huan nang amah a ding in Pathian' tang na hi ding hi.
english: He will be your spokesman to the people. It will happen that he will be to you a mouth, and you will be to him as God.

paite: Chiamtehnate na hihna ding in, na khut in hiai chiangkhun na tawi ding ahi," achi hi.
english: You shall take this rod in your hand, with which you shall do the signs.”

paite: Mosi akisa a, asunghpa Jethro kiang ah akik a, akiang ah, "K'on ngen ahi, hon paisak inla, Aigupta gam a om ka unaute kiang ah ka kik dia, adam lai uhiam chih ka va kan ding," achi hi. Jethro in Mosi kiang ah, "Damtak in va hoh in," achi hi.
english: Moses went and returned to Jethro his father-in-law, and said to him, “Please let me go and return to my brothers who are in Egypt, and see whether they are still alive.” Jethro said to Moses, “Go in peace.”

paite: TOUPA'N Midian gam a Mosi kiang ah, "Pai inla, Aigupta gam ah kik nawn in. Thah hon tum mi teng lah asita ngal ua,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses in Midian, “Go, return into Egypt; for all the men who sought your life are dead.”

paite: Mosi in azi leh atapate api a, sabiltung tung ah atuangsak a, Aigupta gam ah akik nawnta hi. Mosi in akhut in Pathian' chiangkhun atawi hi.
english: Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them on a donkey, and he returned to the land of Egypt. Moses took God’s rod in his hand.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aigupta gam a kik nawn dia na kuan chiang in, na khut a ka koih huai thillamdangte tengteng Pharaoh ma ah hih ngeingei in. Himahleh alungtang ka khauhsak dia, huchi in mite apaisak kei ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “When you go back into Egypt, see that you do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have put in your hand, but I will harden his heart and he will not let the people go.

paite: Pharaoh kiang ah, "TOUPA'N Israel ka tapa ahi, ka ta masapen," achi hi.
english: You shall tell Pharaoh, ‘Yahweh says, Israel is my son, my firstborn,

paite: "K'on chi ahi, nna ahon sepsak theihna ding in, ka tapa paisak in. Paisak na nialleh, ngai in, na tapa ka that ding, na ta masapen ngei, na chi ding hi."
english: and I have said to you, “Let my son go, that he may serve me;” and you have refused to let him go. Behold, I will kill your firstborn son.’”

paite: Lampi a khualbuk ah hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA'N amah ana tuak a, thah ding in azongta hi.
english: On the way at a lodging place, Yahweh met Moses and wanted to kill him.

paite: Huchih lai in Zipporah in suang hiamtak khat ala a, atapa zekmuk vun a-atkhia a, akhebul ah akhia a, "Kei a ding in sikai pasal na hi taktak hi," achi hi.
english: Then Zipporah took a flint, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet; and she said, “Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me.”

paite: Huchi in amah apaisak hi. Zekvun ziak in, "Sisan kai pasal na hi," achi hi.
english: So he let him alone. Then she said, “You are a bridegroom of blood,” because of the circumcision.

paite: TOUPA'N Aaron kiang ah, "Mosi tuak ding in gamdai ah hoh in," achi hi. Ava hoh a, Pathian tang ah amah atuak a, atawp hi.
english: Yahweh said to Aaron, “Go into the wilderness to meet Moses.” He went, and met him on God’s mountain, and kissed him.

paite: Mosi in amah sawl TOUPA thu tengteng leh amah apiak chiamtehna tengteng toh Aaron ahilh hi.
english: Moses told Aaron all Yahweh’s words with which he had sent him, and all the signs with which he had instructed him.

paite: Mosi leh Aaron apaita ua; Israel suan upate tengteng akaikhawm vek uhi.
english: Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel.

paite: Mosi kiang a TOUPA'N thu agen tengteng leh mite mitmuh a chiamtehna ahih tengteng Aaron in agenta hi.
english: Aaron spoke all the words which Yahweh had spoken to Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.

paite: Huchi in mite'n agingta ua; TOUPA'N Israel suante ahong veh a, agimna uh amuta, chih azaktak un, alu uh kunsak in abeta uhi.
english: The people believed, and when they heard that Yahweh had visited the children of Israel, and that he had seen their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshiped.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a:
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Kha masapen ani masapen in kihoupihna biakbuk na dingsakta ding ahi.
english: “On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Huai sung ah theihpihna bawm na koih dia, bawm puanzak in na khuh ding ahi.
english: You shall put the ark of the covenant in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.

paite: Dohkan na lalut dia, atung ah thil kizom akoih dingte kizom in na koih ding a; khawnvak koihna na lalut dia, akhawnvakte na det ding ahi.
english: You shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are on it. You shall bring in the lamp stand, and light its lamps.

paite: Theihpihna bawm ma ah gimlim a dia dangka-eng maitam na koih dia, kongkhak puankhai biakbuk ah na koih ding ahi.
english: You shall set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the covenant, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin biakbuk kongkhak ma ah halmang thillat maitam na koih ding ahi.
english: “You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin leh maitam kikal ah tuikuang na koih dia, huai ah tui na koih ding ahi.
english: You shall set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and shall put water therein.

paite: Akimvel in huangsung na bawl dia, huangsung kongpi ah puankhai na khaitou ding ahi.
english: You shall set up the court around it, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.

paite: "Thaunilhna sathau na la dia, biakbuk na nilh ding a; huai sung a om tengteng toh, na hihsiangthou dia, atui-um belsuan tengteng asiangthou ding hi.
english: “You shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and shall make it holy, and all its furniture, and it will be holy.

paite: Haltum thillat maitam na nilh ding a; atui-um belsuan tengteng toh, maitam na siangthousak ding. Huchi in maitam asiangthou penpen ding hi.
english: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and sanctify the altar, and the altar will be most holy.

paite: Tuikuang leh akhe na nilh dia, na siangsak ding ahi.
english: You shall anoint the basin and its base, and sanctify it.

paite: "Kihoupihna puanin kongkhak ah Aaron leh atapate na hon pi dia, tui in na sil ding ahi.
english: “You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.

paite: Puan siangthoute Aaron na silhsak dia, na nilh dia, na siangthousak ding ahi; siampu nasepna mun a ka nna aseptheihna ding in.
english: You shall put on Aaron the holy garments; and you shall anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

paite: Atapate na hon tonpih dia, puanak tung na silhsak ding ahi.
english: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.

paite: Apa uh sathau na nilh bang in amau siampu nasepna mun a, ka nna aseptheihna ding un thau na nilh ding ahi. Athaunilhna uh akhang-akhang ua siampu hihna ahih taktak ding ziak in," achi hi.
english: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office. Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.”

paite: Hiai bang in Mosi in ahihta a; TOUPA'N amah thu apiak bang zel in ahi, ahih.
english: Moses did so. According to all that Yahweh commanded him, so he did.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akum nihna, akha masapen, huai kha a ani masapen ni in, biakbuk dinsak in a-omta hi.
english: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up.

paite: Mosi in biakbuk adingsakta a, akingakna khuakkuakte ahen a, asingpekte atung a, azawlte athunlut a, akhuamte adingsak hi.
english: Moses raised up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.

paite: Biakbuk tung ah puanin azalhta a; atunglam ah puanin khuhna akoih a; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in ahihta hi.
english: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Theihpihna ala a bawm sung ah akoih a, bawm tung ah azawlte akoih a; bawm tunglam ah zahngaihna tutphah akoih hi.
english: He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.

paite: Bawm biakbuk sung ah atawilut a, khuhna puanzak azak a, theihpihna bawm akhuh hi. TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in ahihta.
english: He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the covenant, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin sung ah biakbuk pang mallam, puanzak polam ah dohkan akoih hi.
english: He put the table in the Tent of Meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside of the veil.

paite: TOUPA ma ah dohkan tung ah tanghoute kizom in akoih a; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in akoih hi.
english: He set the bread in order on it before Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin sung ah dohkan zawn ah, biakbuk sik simlam pang ah khawnvak koihna akoih hi.
english: He put the lamp stand in the Tent of Meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in TOUPA ma ah khawnvakte det ahi.
english: He lit the lamps before Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Huan puanzak ma ah kihoupihna biakbuk sung ah dangka-eng maitam akoih hi:
english: He put the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting before the veil;

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in, huai tung ah gimlim ahal hi.
english: and he burned incense of sweet spices on it, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Biakbuk kongkhak ah puankhai akhai hi.
english: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin biakbuk kongkhak kiang ah TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in halmang thillat leh tangbuang thillat alan hi.
english: He set the altar of burnt offering at the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin leh maitam kikal ah kisawpna ding in tuikuang akoih a, huai ah tui akoih hi.
