english: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash.

paite: Mosi leh Aaron leh atapate'n akhutte uh leh akhepekte uh huai ah asil uhi.
english: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin sung ah ahoh ua, maitam kiang ah ahong pai nai ua TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in akisil uhi.
english: When they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Biakbuk leh maitam kimvel in huangsung abawl a, huangsung kongpi puankhaite akhaita hi. Huchi in Mosi in nasep azouta hi.
english: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.

paite: Huai khit in meipi in kihoupihna biakbuk atuam a, TOUPA thupina in biakbuk adimsak hi.
english: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and Yahweh’s glory filled the tabernacle.

paite: Huchi in kihoupihna biakbuk sung ah Mosi alut theita kei; atung a meipi akai ziak in leh TOUPA thupina in biakbuk adimsak ziak in.
english: Moses wasn’t able to enter into the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud stayed on it, and Yahweh’s glory filled the tabernacle.

paite: Biakbuk tung a pan meipi laktouh a a-om chiang in, Israel suante akhualzinna uah malam ah apai zel uhi.
english: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys;

paite: Himahleh meipi laktouh a a-om louh chiang in, akilaktouh louh ni in azin kei uhi.
english: but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up.

paite: Akhualzin sung teng uh Israel inkote mitmuh in sun in biakbuk tung ah meipi in TOUPA a-om a, zan in biakbuk tung ah meikuang in a-om hi.
english: For the cloud of Yahweh was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

paite: Huan huai nung in Pharaoh kiang ah Mosi leh Aaron alut ua, "Hichibang in Israelte' TOUPA Pathian in achi. Gamdai a kei a dia ankuangluina abawltheihna ding un, ka mite paisak in," chi in ahilh uhi.
english: Afterward Moses and Aaron came, and said to Pharaoh, “This is what Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Let my people go, that they may hold a feast to me in the wilderness.’”

paite: Pharaoh in, "Israelte paisak ding a a-aw ka man ding, huai TOUPA kua ahia? Hiai TOUPA ka thei kei, Israelte leng ka paisak kei ding," achi hi.
english: Pharaoh said, “Who is Yahweh, that I should listen to his voice to let Israel go? I don’t know Yahweh, and moreover I will not let Israel go.”

paite: Huchi in amau, "Hebrute' Pathian in ahon kimuhpih a; gamdai ah ni thum lam ah, hon paisak in, ka hon ngen uhi. TOUPA ka Pathian kiang ah hon kithoihsak in. Hipi hiam, namsau hiam in ahon gawt kha ding hi,” achi uhi.
english: They said, “The God of the Hebrews has met with us. Please let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to Yahweh, our God, lest he fall on us with pestilence, or with the sword.”

paite: Aigupta kumpipa'n akiang uah, - "Mosi leh Aaron, bangziak a noute'n mite nasep khawlsak na hi ua? Na puakgikte uh pua un," achi hi.
english: The king of Egypt said to them, “Why do you, Moses and Aaron, take the people from their work? Get back to your burdens!”

paite: Pharaoh in, "Ngai un, gam a mite tu in atam ua, apuakgik ua pan na khawlsak uhi,” achi hi.
english: Pharaoh said, “Behold, the people of the land are now many, and you make them rest from their burdens.”

paite: Pharaoh in huai ni mah in mite' nasem heutute leh upate thu apia hi.
english: The same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their officers, saying,

paite: "Tuma siah a bang in teklei bawlna ding in mite buhpawl na pe nawn kei iding uhi. Kuan uhenla, buhpawl va - kilak uhen.
english: “You shall no longer give the people straw to make brick, as before. Let them go and gather straw for themselves.

paite: Tuma siah ateklei bawlsa tengteng uh, atung uah na koih ding a; huai a pan in bangmah na kiamsak kei iding uhi. Atha uh adah kha dia; huchi in kap in, ka Pathian kiang uah hon paisak inla, hon va kithoihsak in, achi kha ding uh.
english: You shall require from them the number of the bricks which they made before. You shall not diminish anything of it, for they are idle. Therefore they cry, saying, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to our God.’

paite: Nna tamsem atung uah guan unla, asepgim theihna ding un; thugina lou limsak kei uhen,” achi hi.
english: Let heavier work be laid on the men, that they may labor in it. Don’t let them pay any attention to lying words.”

paite: Mite nasem heutute apaikhia ua, a-upate uh toh, mite kiang ah thu agen ua, "Pharoah in buhpawl ahon pe kei ding.
english: The taskmasters of the people went out with their officers, and they spoke to the people, saying, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I will not give you straw.

paite: "Nouskuan unla, na muh theihtheihna uah buhpawl kilak un. Himahleh na nasep uh bangmah kiamsak ahi kei ding," achi uhi.
english: Go yourselves, get straw where you can find it, for nothing of your work shall be diminished.’”

paite: Mite buhpawl sik a buhbul lakhawm ding in Aigupta gam teng ah avak zakta uhi.
english: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.

paite: Nasem heutute'n amau anoh ua, na nasep uh zou un, na niteng sep dingte uh, buhpawl a-om lai in, achi uhi.
english: The taskmasters were urgent saying, “Fulfill your work quota daily, as when there was straw!”

paite: Israel suan upate, Pharaoh nasem heutute atung ua akoihte un, avua ua, bangziak a tuma lam a bang a zan leh tuni a na teklei bawl uh zou lou na hi ua? chi in aphutluih uhi.
english: The officers of the children of Israel, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and were asked, “Why haven’t you fulfilled your quota both yesterday and today, in making brick as before?”

paite: Huaitak in Israel suan upate ahong ua, Pharaoh kiang ah akap ua, "Bangziak a na sikhate hichi bawl tel na hia?
english: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried to Pharaoh, saying, “Why do you deal this way with your servants?

paite: Na sikhate buhpawl piak ka hi kei ua, amau lah ka kiang uah, 'Teklei bawl un!' ahon chi uh. Ngai in, na sikhate vuak in ka om ua, amoh na mite ahi uh," achi uhi.
english: No straw is given to your servants, and they tell us, ‘Make brick!’ and behold, your servants are beaten; but the fault is in your own people.”

paite: Himahleh ama'n, “Thadah na hi uh, thadah na hi uh. Huaiziak in nou, 'Pai ni in, TOUPA kiang ah va kithoih ni,' na chi uhi.
english: But Pharaoh said, “You are idle! You are idle! Therefore you say, ‘Let’s go and sacrifice to Yahweh.’

paite: Huaiziak in kuan unla; nna va sem un. Pawl ahon kipe kei dia, himahleh teklei bikhiah zah na piakkhiak ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: Go therefore now, and work; for no straw shall be given to you; yet you shall deliver the same number of bricks!”

paite: Na niteng nasep ua na tekleite ua pan bangmah na kiamsak ding uh ahi kei, akichih nung Israel suan upate'n thusia om ahihdan atheita uhi.
english: The officers of the children of Israel saw that they were in trouble when it was said, “You shall not diminish anything from your daily quota of bricks!”

paite: Pharaoh a pan ahong paikhiak un lampi a dingh Mosi leh Aaron akituahpih uhi.
english: They met Moses and Aaron, who stood along the way, as they came out from Pharaoh.

paite: Akiang uah, "TOUPA'N nou hon en in vai hawm hen. Pharaoh mit leh asikhate mit in ka gimnam uh kihhuai in na bawl ua, koute hon that dia akhut ua namsau na koih tak ziak un," achi uhi.
english: They said to them, “May Yahweh look at you and judge, because you have made us a stench to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to kill us!”

paite: TOUPA kiang ah Mosi akik nawn a, "Toupa, bangziak a hiai mite hichibang a gilou suaksak na hia? Bangziak a kei hon sawl na hia?
english: Moses returned to Yahweh, and said, “Lord, why have you brought trouble on this people? Why is it that you have sent me?

paite: Na min a thu gen dia Pharaoh kiang a ka va hoh nungsiah lah, ama'n hiai mite tung ah gilou abawl ngal a. Na mite lah na pikhe ngal kei a," achi hi.
english: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has brought trouble on this people. You have not rescued your people at all!”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Tu in Pharaoh kiang a bang ahia ka hih ding na mu ding. Khut thahat in amau apaisak dia, khut thahat in amau agam a kipan hawlkhe ding ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Now you shall see what I will do to Pharaoh, for by a strong hand he shall let them go, and by a strong hand he shall drive them out of his land.”

paite: Pathian in Mosi kiang ah thu agen a, akiang ah, "Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: God spoke to Moses, and said to him, “I am Yahweh.

paite: Bangkim hihthei Pathian min in Abraham kiang, Isak kiang leh Jakob kiang ah ka kilakta a, himahleh ka min JEHOVAH in alak uah ka kitheisak kei.
english: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, as God Almighty; but by my name Yahweh I was not known to them.

paite: Amau Kanaan gam, mikhual a a-omna gam uh, akhualzinna gam uh, pe ding in amaute toh ka thukhun leng ka hihkipta hi.
english: I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their travels, in which they lived as aliens.

paite: Aiguptate'n koltanna a, atansak un, Israel suante maunate leng ka zata a, ka thukhun ka theigige hi.
english: Moreover I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage, and I have remembered my covenant.

paite: Huaiziak in Israel suante kiang ah, kei TOUPA ka hi, chih gen inla, Aiguptate puakgik nuai a pan ka hon pikhe dia, na koltanna ua pan ka hon suaktasak ding, ban zak in leh vaihawmna thupite toh ka hon tan ding hi.
english: Therefore tell the children of Israel, ‘I am Yahweh, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm, and with great judgments.

paite: Mipite a ding in ka hong kilak ding a, noute a ding in Pathian ka hi ding. Huchi in Aiguptate puakgikte nuai a pan hon lakhepa TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chih na thei ding uh.
english: I will take you to myself for a people. I will be your God; and you shall know that I am Yahweh your God, who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

paite: Gam tungtang thu Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a pe dia ka chiamsa, huai gamsung ah ka hon tun ding. Huchi in gouluah ding in ka hon pe ding, Kei TOUPA ka hi," achi hi.
english: I will bring you into the land which I swore to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for a heritage: I am Yahweh.’”

paite: Mosi in Israel suante kiang ah huchibang in thu agensawn hi. Himahleh lungsim dahna ziak leh koltanna haksatna ziak in Mosi angaikheta kei uh.
english: Moses spoke so to the children of Israel, but they didn’t listen to Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Lut in, agam a pan Israel suante apaikhiaksakna ding in Pharaoh kiang ah thu gen in,” achi hi.
english: “Go in, speak to Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.”

paite: Mosi in TOUPA ma ah thu agen a, "Ngai in, Israel suante'n hon ngaihkhiak kei ualeh kei muk sum louh, bangchi in Pharaoh in hon ngaikhe dia?" achi hi.
english: Moses spoke before Yahweh, saying, “Behold, the children of Israel haven’t listened to me. How then shall Pharaoh listen to me, when I have uncircumcised lips?”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi kiang leh Aaron kiang ah thu agen a, Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante pikhe ding in Israel suante lam leh Aigupta kumpipa lam ah amaute thu apeta hi.
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, and gave them a command to the children of Israel, and to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

paite: Hiaite asuangtute inkuan a kipan alupente ahi uhi: Israel ta masa Reuben tate; Hanok leh Pallu, Hezron leh Karmi, hiaite Reuben inkote ahi uh.
english: These are the heads of their fathers’ houses. The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; these are the families of Reuben.

paite: Simeon tapate: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar leh Kanaan numei tapa Shaul. Hiaite Simeon inkote ahi uh.
english: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman; these are the families of Simeon.

paite: Akhang uh dungzui in hiaite Levi tapate min ahi: Gershon, Kohath leh Merari. Levi damsung kumte kum zakhat sawmthum-le-sagih ahi.
english: These are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari; and the years of the life of Levi were one hundred thirty-seven years.

paite: Gershon tapate, a-inkuan dungzui un, Libni leh Shimei.
english: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, according to their families.

paite: Kohath tapate: Amram, Izhar, Hebron leh Uzziel. Kohath damsung kumte kum zakhat sawmthum-le-thum ahi.
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel; and the years of the life of Kohath were one hundred thirty-three years.

paite: Merari tapate: Mahli leh Mushi. Akhang uh dungzui in hiaite Levi inkote ahi uh.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their generations.

paite: Amram in apa sanggamnu Jokebed zi in anei hi. Ama'n Aaron leh Mosi aneihsak hi. Amram damsung kumte kum zakhat sawmthum-le-sagih ahi.
english: Amram took Jochebed his father’s sister to himself as wife; and she bore him Aaron and Moses. The years of the life of Amram were one hundred thirty-seven years.

paite: Izhar tapate: Korah, Nepheg leh Zikri.
english: The sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.

paite: Uzziel tapate: Mishael, Elzaphan leh Zithri.
english: The sons of Uzziel: Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.

paite: Aaron in Amminadab tanu, Nahson sanggamnu, Elisheba zi in anei a, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar aneihsak hi.
english: Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, as his wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

paite: Korah tapate: Assir, Elkanah leh Abiasaph. Hiaite Korah inkote ahi uh.
english: The sons of Korah: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.

paite: Aaron tapa Eleazar in Putiel tanute lak a khat zi in anei a, Phinehas aneihsak hi. Hiaite Levi inkuan suangtute inn a kipan a lupente ahi uhi.
english: Eleazar Aaron’s son took one of the daughters of Putiel as his wife; and she bore him Phinehas. These are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites according to their families.

paite: Hiaite TOUPA'N Aaron leh Mosi kiang a anam uh dungzui a Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante hon pikhia un, achihte ahi.
english: These are that Aaron and Moses to whom Yahweh said, “Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.”

paite: Hiaite Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh kiang a Aigupta a pan Israel suante pikhe dia thugentute ahi ua, hiaite Mosi leh Aaron mah ahi uhi.
english: These are those who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt. These are that Moses and Aaron.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta gam a Mosi kiang a TOUPA'N thu agen ni in akiang ah,
english: On the day when Yahweh spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt,

paite: "Kei TOUPA ka hi. Na kiang a ka gen tengteng Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh kiang ah gen in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “I am Yahweh. Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I tell you.”

paite: Himahleh Mosi in TOUPA ma ah, “Ngai in, muk sum louh ka hi a, bangchi in Pharaoh in hon ngaikhe dia?" achi hi.
english: Moses said before Yahweh, “Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh listen to me?”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "En in, Pharaoh a ding in Pathian in ka hon bawlta. Huchi in na sanggampa Aaron na zawlnei ahi ding,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I have made you as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.

paite: Thu ka hon piak tengteng na gen ding hi. Huchi in Aaron na sanggampa'n agam a pan a Israel suante sawlkhe ding in Pharaoh kiang ah agen ding.
english: You shall speak all that I command you; and Aaron your brother shall speak to Pharaoh, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.

paite: "Huan Pharaoh lungtang ka khauhsak dia, Aigupta gam ah ka chiamtehnate leh ka thillamdangte ka pungsak ding hi.
english: I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.

paite: Himahleh, Aigupta tung a ka khut ka ngaktheihna ding leh ka sepaihte leh ka mi Israel suante, vaihawmna thupite a Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhiak theihna ding in, Pharaoh in nang ahon ngaikhe kei ding hi.
english: But Pharaoh will not listen to you, so I will lay my hand on Egypt, and bring out my armies, my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.

paite: Aigupta tung a ka khut ka lik a, alak ua pan Israel suante ka pikhiak hun chiang in, Aiguptate'n kei, TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh," achi hi.
english: The Egyptians shall know that I am Yahweh when I stretch out my hand on Egypt, and bring the children of Israel out from among them.”

paite: Mosi leh Aaron in ToUPA'N thu apiak bang in ahihta uhi.
english: Moses and Aaron did so. As Yahweh commanded them, so they did.

paite: Pharaoh kiang a thu agen lai un, Mosi kum sawmgiat a upa ahita a, Aaron kum sawmgiat-le-thum a upa ahita hi.
english: Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron kiang ah thu agen a, akiang uah,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: "Pharoah in na kiang ua, 'Nou a ding in thillamdang suah un,' achih chiang in Aaron kiang ah, 'Na chiangkhun la inla, Pharaoh ma ah khia in, gul hong suak hen,' na chi ding,” achi hi.
english: “When Pharaoh speaks to you, saying, ‘Perform a miracle!’ then you shall tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and cast it down before Pharaoh, and it will become a serpent.’”

paite: Huchi in Pharaoh kiang ah Mosi leh Aaron alut ua, TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in ahihta uhi. Pharaoh leh asikhate ma ah Aaron in achiangkhun akhia a, gul ahong suak hi.
english: Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh, and they did so, as Yahweh had commanded. Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh and before his servants, and it became a serpent.

paite: Pharaoh in leng mipilte leh bumsiamte asam a; Aigupta mitkhialdawi tawite'n amitkhialdawi un huchibang mah in ahih sam uhi.
english: Then Pharaoh also called for the wise men and the sorcerers. They also, the magicians of Egypt, did the same thing with their enchantments.

paite: Michih in leng amau chiangkhun chiat akhia ua, gul ahong suak uhi. Himahleh Aaron chiangkhun in amau chiangkhunte avalhta hi.
english: For they each cast down their rods, and they became serpents; but Aaron’s rod swallowed up their rods.

paite: Hinapi in TOUPA'N achih bang in Pharaoh in alungtang akhauhsak a, amau thu angaikhe nuam kei.
english: Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Pharoah lungtang akhauhta a, mite paisak anial hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn. He refuses to let the people go.

paite: Zingsang in Pharaoh kiang ah va hoh in, ngai in, amah lui a hoh ding ahi a, ahong pai ngak in lui gei ah na dingh in. Na khut in huai chiangkhun, gul hong suak pen na tawi ding ahi.
english: Go to Pharaoh in the morning. Behold, he is going out to the water. You shall stand by the river’s bank to meet him. You shall take the rod which was turned to a serpent in your hand.

paite: Akiang ah, 'Hebrute' TOUPA Pathian in na kiang ah ahon sawl a, gamdai a ka nna aseptheihna ding un, ka mite paisak in.' Ngai in, tuma lam in na ngeingaih kei, achi," chi in.
english: You shall tell him, ‘Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to you, saying, “Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness. Behold, until now you haven’t listened.”

paite: Hichibang in TOUPA'N achi, "Hiai ah TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding. Ngai in, ka khut a chiangkhun in lui a om tuite ka sat dia, sisan ahong suak ding uhi.
english: Yahweh says, “In this you shall know that I am Yahweh. Behold: I will strike with the rod that is in my hand on the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.

paite: Lui a om ngasate asi ding ua, lui a-uih dia; Aiguptate'n luitui adawn thei kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: The fish that are in the river will die and the river will become foul. The Egyptians will loathe to drink water from the river.”’”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a, "Na chiangkhun la inla, Aigupta tuite tung ah, atui nak neite tung ah, aluite uh tung ah, atuichinte uh tung ah leh atuilite uh tung ah, sisan ahon suahtheihna ding un, Aigupta gam pumpi a singhawmte leh suanghawmte a sisan a-omtheihna ding in na khut likkhia in, Aaron kiang ah chi in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt, over their rivers, over their streams, and over their pools, and over all their ponds of water, that they may become blood. There will be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood and in vessels of stone.’”

paite: TOUPA thupiak bang in, Mosi leh Aaron in ahih uhi. Achiangkhun aliktou a, Pharaoh leh asikhate mitmuh in, lui a om tuite asatta a, lui a om tuite sisan ahong suak vek uhi.
english: Moses and Aaron did so, as Yahweh commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and struck the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.

paite: Lui a om ngasate asi ua; lui a-uih a, Aiguptate'n luitui adawn theita kei uhi. Aigupta gam pumpi ah sisan a-omta hi.
english: The fish that were in the river died. The river became foul. The Egyptians couldn’t drink water from the river. The blood was throughout all the land of Egypt.

paite: Aigupta mitkhialdawi tawite'n leng amitkhialdawi tawi un huchi mah bang in ahih uhi. Pharaoh lungtang akhauh a, TOUPA'N achih bang in amau angaikhe kei hi.
english: The magicians of Egypt did the same thing with their enchantments. So Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.

paite: Pharaoh akihei a, a-inn ah apaita a, huai thil in alungtang akhoih kei hi.
english: Pharaoh turned and went into his house, and he didn’t even take this to heart.

paite: Aigupta tengteng in luitui adawn theih louh ziak un, dawn ding zong in lui kim teng akhuat uhi.
english: All the Egyptians dug around the river for water to drink; for they couldn’t drink the river water.

paite: TOUPA'N lui asat nung ni sagih ahong chingta hi.
english: Seven days were fulfilled, after Yahweh had struck the river.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a, "Pharoah kiang ah hoh inla, akiang ah hichi in chi in ‘Toupa’n hichi in achi, ka nna ahon sepsak theihna ding un, ka mite paisak in.'
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what Yahweh says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

paite: Amau paisak na nialleh, ngai in, ukengte in na gam tengteng ka gawt ding hi.
english: If you refuse to let them go, behold, I will plague all your borders with frogs.

paite: Lui in ukeng atam a tam hon suahkhe ding ua, huaite ahong paitou ding ua, na inn ah ahong lut ding ua, na lupna dantan sung ah, na lupna tung ah, na sikhate inn ah, na mite tung ah, na thuk ah leh na tangbuang bawlna ah ahong om ding uh.
english: The river will swarm with frogs, which will go up and come into your house, and into your bedroom, and on your bed, and into the house of your servants, and on your people, and into your ovens, and into your kneading troughs.

paite: Ukengte nang tung ah leh na mite tung ah leh na sikhate tung ah ahong kaltou ding uhi," chi in.
english: The frogs shall come up both on you, and on your people, and on all your servants.”’”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aaron kiang ah, luinak neite tung leh luite tung leh tuichinte tung ah na chiangkhun toh na khut lik inla, Aigupta gam tung ah ukengte hon paitousak in, chi in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your hand with your rod over the rivers, over the streams, and over the pools, and cause frogs to come up on the land of Egypt.’”

paite: Aaron in Aigupta luite tung ah akhut alik a; ukengte ahong paitou ua, Aigupta gamsung atuamta uhi.
english: Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.

paite: Huchi mah bang in mitkhialdawi tawite'n amitkhialdawi un ahih ua, Aigupta gam tung ah ukengte ahon latou uhi.
english: The magicians did the same thing with their enchantments, and brought up frogs on the land of Egypt.

paite: Huaitak in Pharaoh in Mosi leh Aaron asamsak a, "Kei leh ka mite a pan ukengte alakmang theihna ding in, TOUPA ngen un. TOUPA kiang a kithoihna abawltheihna ding un, mite ka paisak ding," achi hi.
english: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, “Entreat Yahweh, that he take away the frogs from me and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may sacrifice to Yahweh.”

paite: Mosi in Pharaoh kiang ah, "Ka tung ah ki-uangsak in; nang a ding leh na sikhate a ding leh na mite a ding leh nang leh na innte a pan, tui a a-omtheihna ding ua ukengte lakmangna dia chikchiang a hon ngetsak ding ka hia?" achi hi.
english: Moses said to Pharaoh, “I give you the honor of setting the time that I should pray for you, and for your servants, and for your people, that the frogs be destroyed from you and your houses, and remain in the river only.”

paite: Ama'n, "Zingchiang in," achi hi. Ama'n, "Na thu bang hi hen. TOUPA ka Pathian bang kuamah a-om kei, chih na theihna ding in.
english: Pharaoh said, “Tomorrow.” Moses said, “Let it be according to your word, that you may know that there is no one like Yahweh our God.

paite: Nang leh na innte uh leh na sikhate leh na mite a pan ukengte apawtkhe ding ua; lui kia ah a-omta ding uh," achi hi.
english: The frogs shall depart from you, and from your houses, and from your servants, and from your people. They shall remain in the river only.”

paite: Huchi in Pharaoh a pan Mosi leh Aaron apaikhia ua; Pharaoh gawtna ding a ukengte akoih tungtang ah TOUPA kiang ah Mosi athum hi.
english: Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh, and Moses cried to Yahweh concerning the frogs which he had brought on Pharaoh.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi thu bang in ahihta a; innte leh khuate a pan leh loute a pan ukengte asita uhi.
english: Yahweh did according to the word of Moses, and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the courts, and out of the fields.

paite: Huchi in akaikhawm ua, avum ua, gam a-uihta hi.
english: They gathered them together in heaps, and the land stank.

paite: Himahleh Pharaoh in atung azangta chih atheih in, alungtang akhauhsak a; amaute angaikhe kei; TOUPA gen bang in.
english: But when Pharaoh saw that there was a respite, he hardened his heart, and didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aaron kiang ah, na chiangkhun lik inla, gam a leivui sat in, Aigupta gam pumpi a hik ahong omtheihna ding un, chi in,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your rod, and strike the dust of the earth, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.’”

paite: Huchibang in ahih ua; Aaron in achiangkhun toh akhut alik a, lei a leivui asat a, mi tung leh sa tung ah hik ahong omta a; gam a leivui teng Aigupta gam pumpi ah hik ahong suak vekta hi.
english: They did so; and Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and struck the dust of the earth, and there were lice on man, and on animal; all the dust of the earth became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

paite: Mitkhialdawi tawite'n leng amitkhialdawi un hikte omsak ding in huchibang in ahih ua, himahleh ahihthei kei uh. Huchi in mi tung leh sa tung ah hik a-omta hi.
english: The magicians tried with their enchantments to produce lice, but they couldn’t. There were lice on man, and on animal.

paite: Huaitak in mitkhialdawi tawite'n Pharaoh kiang ah, "Hiai Pathian khutzung ahi," achi uhi. Himahleh Pharaoh lungtang akhauhsak a, TOUPA'N achih bang in amau angaikhe kei hi.
english: Then the magicians said to Pharaoh, “This is God’s finger;” but Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Zingkhang in thou inla, Pharaoh ma ah va dingh in. Ngai in, tuilam zuan a, ahong paikhiak in akiang ah, 'Hichibang in TOUPA'n achi, ka nna aseptheihna ding un, ka mite paisak in.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; behold, he comes out to the water; and tell him, ‘This is what Yahweh says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

paite: Huchi lou a, ka mite na paisak keileh, ngai in, na tung ah leh na sikhate tung ah leh na mite tung ah leh na insung ah thouhonpi ka sawl ding. Huchi in Aiguptate innte thouhonpi in adim ding, a-omna lei uh toh.
english: Else, if you will not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies on you, and on your servants, and on your people, and into your houses. The houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground they are on.

paite: Huai ni in ka mite tenna, Goshen gam ka satkhen ding, huai a thouhonpi a-omlouhna ding in; huchi a gamsung ah kei TOUPA ka hi chih na theihna ding in.
english: I will set apart in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there, to the end you may know that I am Yahweh on the earth.

paite: Ka mite leh na mite kikal ah kikhenna ka koih ding. Zingchiang in hiai chiamtehna a-om ding hi,' " achi hi.
english: I will put a division between my people and your people. This sign shall happen by tomorrow.”’”

paite: Huchibang in TOUPA'N ahih a; Pharaoh insung leh asikhate insung leh Aigupta gam tengteng ah, thouhonpi thupitak ahong omta a; thouhonpi ziak in gam asegawp hi.
english: Yahweh did so; and there came grievous swarms of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants’ houses. In all the land of Egypt the land was corrupted by reason of the swarms of flies.

paite: Pharaoh in Mosi leh Aaron asamsak a, "Pai unla, gamsung ah na Pathian kiang uah kithoihun." achi hi.
english: Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, “Go, sacrifice to your God in the land!”

paite: Himahleh Mosi in, "Huchibang a hih adik kei ding. TOUPA ka Pathian uh kiang ah Aiguptate zakdah kithoihna lan ding ka hih ziak un. Ngai in, amuh ua Aiguptate zakdah kithoihna lan ding ka hi uh maw, suang in ahon deng kei ding ua hia?
english: Moses said, “It isn’t appropriate to do so; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to Yahweh our God. Behold, if we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, won’t they stone us?

paite: Gamdai ah ni thum lam ah ka pai ding uh; ahon thupiak ding bang a TOUPA ka Pathian uh kiang a kithoihna bawl ding in," achi hi.
english: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to Yahweh our God, as he shall command us.”

paite: Huan Pharaoh in, "Gamdai a TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang a na kithoihtheihna ding un ka hon paisak ding. Gamlapi ah pai kei peuh le uchin. Kei a ding in hon ngetsak in," achi hi.
english: Pharaoh said, “I will let you go, that you may sacrifice to Yahweh your God in the wilderness, only you shall not go very far away. Pray for me.”

paite: Huan Mosi in, “Ngai in, nang a pan ka paikhe dia, Pharaoh a pan, na sikhate a pan, na mite a pan zingchiang a thouhonpi apaimang theihna ding in TOUPA ka ngen ding. Himahleh TOUPA kiang a kithoih dia amite paisak ding in lepchiahtak in Pharaoh gamta nawn kei hen," achi hi.
english: Moses said, “Behold, I am going out from you. I will pray to Yahweh that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, tomorrow; only don’t let Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to Yahweh.”

paite: Huchi in Pharaoh a pan Mosi apawtkhia a, TOUPA angenta hi.
english: Moses went out from Pharaoh, and prayed to Yahweh.

paite: Huan Mosi thu bang in TOUPA'N ahihta a; Pharaoh a pan leh asikhate a pan thouhonpi alamangta a; khat lel leng a-om nawnta kei hi.
english: Yahweh did according to the word of Moses, and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people. There remained not one.

paite: Himahleh hiai hun in leng Pharaoh in alungtang akhauhsak a, mite apaisak nuam tuan kei hi.
english: Pharaoh hardened his heart this time also, and he didn’t let the people go.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Pharoah kiang ah va lut inla, TOUPA Hebrute' Pathian in ka nna aseptheihna ding un ka mite paisak in.
english: Then Yahweh said to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

paite: Amaute paisak na nial a, amau na letdet laileh,
english: For if you refuse to let them go, and hold them still,

paite: ngai in, TOUPA khut, lou a om na bawnghonte tung ah, sakolte tung ah, sabiltungte tung ah, sangawngsaute tung ah, bawngtalte tung ah leh belamte tung ah atu ding. Hipi nase mahmah a-om ding hi.
english: behold, Yahweh’s hand is on your livestock which are in the field, on the horses, on the donkeys, on the camels, on the herds, and on the flocks with a very grievous pestilence.

paite: TOUPA'N Israelte bawnghon leh Aiguptate bawnghon asatkhen ding. Israel suante a lam bangmah si a-om kei ding.
english: Yahweh will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and the livestock of Egypt; and nothing shall die of all that belongs to the children of Israel.”’”

paite: TOUPA'N hun biseh asepta, zingchiang in TOUPA'N gamsung ah hiai ahih ding,” chi in va gen in.
english: Yahweh appointed a set time, saying, “Tomorrow Yahweh shall do this thing in the land.”

paite: Huan azing in TOUPA'N hiai thil ahih a, Aigupta bawnghon tengteng asita uhi. Himahleh Israel suante bawnghonte khat lel leng asi kei hi.
english: Yahweh did that thing on the next day; and all the livestock of Egypt died, but of the livestock of the children of Israel, not one died.

paite: Pharaoh in mi asawl a, ngai in, Israel bawnghonte lak ah khat lel leng asi kei ngut hi. Himahleh Pharaoh lungtang akhauh a, mite apaisak kei lai hi.
english: Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not so much as one of the livestock of the Israelites dead. But the heart of Pharaoh was stubborn, and he didn’t let the people go.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron kiang ah, "Meiphualpi vut na khut dim un la unla, Pharaoh muh in Mosi in van lam ah theh hen.
english: Yahweh said to Moses and to Aaron, “Take handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the sky in the sight of Pharaoh.

paite: Aigupta gam ah leivui nen ahong suak dia, Aigupta gamsung teng ah, mi tung leh sa tung ah meimatum nasetak ahong hi ding," achi hi.
english: It shall become small dust over all the land of Egypt, and shall be boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal, throughout all the land of Egypt.”

paite: Meiphualpi a vut ala ua, Pharaoh mai ah adinghta uhi. Mosi in van lam ah athehtou a; mi tung leh sa tung ah, meimatum ahong suakta hi.
english: They took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward the sky; and it became boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal.

paite: Huchi in meimatumte ziak in Mosi ma ah mitkhialdawi tawite adingh theita kei ua; mitkhialdawi tawite tung leh Aiguptate tung ah lah meimatum a-om ngal a.
english: The magicians couldn’t stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boils were on the magicians and on all the Egyptians.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N Pharaoh lungtang akhauhsak a, Mosi kiang a TOUPA'N agen bang in amau thu angaikhe kei hi.
english: Yahweh hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken to Moses.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Zingkhang in thou inla, Pharaoh ma ah va dingh inla, akiang ah, TOUPA Hebrute' Pathian in hichi in achi, 'Ka nna aseptheihna ding un ka mite paisak in.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, says: “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

paite: Hiai hun in na lungtang tung leh na sikhate tung leh na mite tung a ka gawtna tengteng hon tun ding ka hi ngal a. Lei pumpi ah kei bang kuamah a-om kei, chih na theihna ding in.
english: For this time I will send all my plagues against your heart, against your officials, and against your people; that you may know that there is no one like me in all the earth.

paite: Tu in ka khut zankhia in nang leh na mite hipi in hon gawt leng lei a pan satkhiak in na om ding hi.
english: For now I would have stretched out my hand, and struck you and your people with pestilence, and you would have been cut off from the earth;

paite: Himahleh hiai ziak in ahi, nang ka hon tunding, nangmah a ka thilhihtheihna ka latsak theihna ding leh huchi a leitung tengteng a ka min akipuankhiak theihna ding in.
english: but indeed for this cause I have made you stand: to show you my power, and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth,

paite: Amaute paisaklou ding in, ka mite kalh in nang leh nang na kiliansak nalai maw?
english: because you still exalt yourself against my people, that you won’t let them go.

paite: Ngai in, zingchiang tu hun in apian tung a kipan tutan a om ngei nai lou, Aigupta gam ah gialpi tam petmah ka zusak ding hi.
english: Behold, tomorrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as has not been in Egypt since the day it was founded even until now.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in mi sawl inla, lou a na neih tengteng leh na gantate kaikhawm in. Michih tung leh lou a kimu sa tung ah, inn lam a hong kihawlloute tung ah, gial ahong kesuk ding a, asi ding uh,' achi," chi in.
english: Now therefore command that all of your livestock and all that you have in the field be brought into shelter. The hail will come down on every man and animal that is found in the field, and isn’t brought home, and they will die.”’”

paite: Kuapeuh Pharaoh sikhate lak a TOUPA thu laute'n asikhate leh agantate uh insung ah ahawllut uhi.
english: Those who feared Yahweh’s word among the servants of Pharaoh made their servants and their livestock flee into the houses.

paite: TOUPA thu khawksaloute'n lou ah asikhate uh leh agantate uh anusia uhi.
english: Whoever didn’t respect Yahweh’s word left his servants and his livestock in the field.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aigupta gam tengteng a, mi leh sa tung leh Aigupta gam tengteng alou a haichi tung teng a gial a-omtheihna ding in, van lam ah na khut zankhia in,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand toward the sky, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, on man, and on animal, and on every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.”

paite: Mosi in van lam ah achiangkhun azankhia hi. TOUPA'N van-ging leh gial ahon sawl a, leitung zui in meikuang ataita a; TOUPA'N Aigupta gam tung ah gial azusakta hi.
english: Moses stretched out his rod toward the heavens, and Yahweh sent thunder and hail; and lightning flashed down to the earth. Yahweh rained hail on the land of Egypt.

paite: Huchi in gial a-om a, gial toh kihel meikuang huaise mahmah, nam ahih nungsiah Aigupta gam ah huchibang om ngei kei hi.
english: So there was very severe hail, and lightning mixed with the hail, such as had not been in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.

paite: Gial in Aigupta gamsungte a lou omte teng adengta hi. Gial in mi leh sa; lou a haichi chih adeng a, gam a sing chih akitansakta hi.
english: The hail struck throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and animal; and the hail struck every herb of the field, and broke every tree of the field.

paite: Israel suante tenna, Goshen gam kia ah gial ake kei hi.
english: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, there was no hail.

paite: Pharaoh in mi asawl a, Mosi leh Aaron asamsak a, akiang uah, "Tutung in ka khialta. TOUPA adiktat a, kei leh ka mite ka gilou uh.
english: Pharaoh sent and called for Moses and Aaron, and said to them, “I have sinned this time. Yahweh is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.

paite: TOUPA ngen in, ahunta, vanpiging leh gial thupi a-om nawnlouhna ding in. K'on paisakta dia, na om nawn kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: Pray to Yahweh; for there has been enough of mighty thunderings and hail. I will let you go, and you shall stay no longer.”

paite: Huan Mosi in akiang ah, "Khopi a pan ka pawtkhiak chiang in TOUPA lam ah ka khutte ka zak ding a; vanpiging adai dia, gial leng a-om nawn kei ding; huchi a leitung TOUPA a ahihdan na theihtheihna ding in.
english: Moses said to him, “As soon as I have gone out of the city, I will spread out my hands to Yahweh. The thunders shall cease, and there will not be any more hail; that you may know that the earth is Yahweh’s.

paite: Himahleh nang leh na sikhate'n ahihleh, TOUPA Pathian na lau nai kei ding uh chih ka thei," achi hi.
english: But as for you and your servants, I know that you don’t yet fear Yahweh God.”

paite: Pat leh barli buh densiat in a-om a, barli buh atuipumta a, pat gah akuhmumta hi.
english: The flax and the barley were struck, for the barley had ripened and the flax was blooming.

paite: Himahleh huit buh leh buhman zaw densiat in a-om kei; anou lai ziak un.
english: But the wheat and the spelt were not struck, for they had not grown up.

paite: Pharaoh a pan Mosi in khopi apawtkhiaksan in, TOUPA lam ah akhutte azak a; vanpiging leh gial adai a, leitung ah vuah buak in a-omta kei hi.
english: Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread out his hands to Yahweh; and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured on the earth.

paite: Pharaoh in vuah leh gial leh vanpiging atawpta chih atheih in, akhial tamsem a, amah leh asikhate'n alungtang uh akhauhsak uhi.
english: When Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders had ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.

paite: Huchi in Pharaoh lungtang khauhsak in a-om a, Mosi kam a TOUPA'N agen bang in Israel suante apaisak nuam kei hi.
english: The heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he didn’t let the children of Israel go, just as Yahweh had spoken through Moses.

paite: Saltan akum sawmthumna, akha lina, huai kha ani ngana ah Kebar lui a saltangte lak a ka om lai in hichi ahong hi a, van hong kihong a, Pathian kilakna ka mu hi.
english: Now in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

paite: Huai kha ani ngana ah, huai tuh kumpipa Jehoiakin saltan akum ngana ahi,
english: In the fifth of the month, which was the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity,

paite: Kaldai gam a Kebar lui a Buzi tapa siampu Ezekiel kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a: huai ah TOUPA khut atung ah a-om hi.
english: Yahweh’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and Yahweh’s hand was there on him.

paite: Huan ka en a, ngai in, mallam a kipan huihpi thupi mahmah ahong kuan a, meipi asah a sah, kuang zoizoi, akim tengteng tanvak puappuap asung mei laitak ah sik am bang a am a-om hi.
english: I looked, and behold, a stormy wind came out of the north: a great cloud, with flashing lightning, and a brightness around it, and out of the middle of it as it were glowing metal, out of the middle of the fire.

paite: Huchi in huai lai a kipan in thil hing li kibatpih ahong pawtkhia ua, akimuhdan uh hichibang ahi a: Mihing batna anei ua,
english: Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: They had the likeness of a man.

paite: mai li anei chiat ua, kha li anei chiat uhi.
english: Everyone had four faces, and each one of them had four wings.

paite: Akhete uh atang a; akhepek nuailam uh bawngnou khepek bang ahi a; huan dalte mahmah bang in avakkhe zualzual uhi.
english: Their feet were straight feet. The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze.

paite: Apang lite ua akha nuai uah mihing khut bang anei ua; huchi in ali un amel uleh akhate uh hichibang in apu uhi:
english: They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides. The four of them had their faces and their wings like this:

paite: Akhate uh akizom a; apai un leng akihei ngei kei ua, amazawn uah apai chiat uhi.
english: Their wings were joined to one another. They didn’t turn when they went. Each one went straight forward.

paite: Amel un akibatpihte mihing mel bang ahi a, ali un ataklam pang uah humpinelkai mel apu ua, ali un aveilam pang uah bawngtal mel apu ua, ali un muvanlai mel apu nawn ua, amel uh huchibang ahi.
english: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man. The four of them had the face of a lion on the right side. The four of them had the face of an ox on the left side. The four of them also had the face of an eagle.

paite: Huan akhate uh azakkhia ua, akha nihte un akizak zom chiat ua, nih in apumpi uh akhuh uh.
english: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above. Two wings of each one touched another, and two covered their bodies.

paite: Malam ah apai chiat ua, kha paina lam ding ah apai ua, apai un leng akihei ngei kei uhi.
english: Each one went straight forward. Where the spirit was to go, they went. They didn’t turn when they went.

paite: Thil hingte lak ah suangkuangthei ampha bang, meisel bang mai asuk leh tou in apai a; meibel a-ampha mahmah a, mei a kipan khophia ahong suakkhe zualzual hi.
english: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. The fire went up and down among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and lightning went out of the fire.

paite: Thil hingte khophe zualzual bang in avialtai uhi.
english: The living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.

paite: Huan thil hingte ka et lai in, ngai in, thil hingte zul ah amel lite uh a ding in lei ah kangtalai liim khat zel ka mu hi.
english: Now as I saw the living creatures, behold, there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces of it.

paite: Kangtalai khe leh atatdan beril suang zia bang mai in alang a, ali un latdan khat anei ua, alatdan uh leh atatdan uh kangtalai liim khat sung a kangtalai liim dang om bang ahi hi.
english: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl. The four of them had one likeness. Their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.

paite: Apai chiang un sik li in apai thei ua, apai un leng akihei ngei kei uh.
english: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn when they went.

paite: Akangtalai liim kual sangtak leh mulkimhuaitak ahi a; ali un akual teng mit in adim uhi.
english: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.

paite: Huchi in thil hingte apai chiang un azul uah kangtalai peite apai sam uhi; thil hingte lei a kipan dopkang a a-om uleh kangtalai liimte leng dopkang in a-om sam uhi.
english: When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them. When the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

paite: Kha apai utna lam peuhmah ah apai ua; huai lam a kha apai zel ziak in; huchi in kangtalai liimte azul uah dopkang in a-om ua, thil hing kha kangtalai liimte ah a-om hi.
english: Wherever the spirit was to go, they went. The spirit was to go there. The wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

paite: Huaite apai chiang un hiaite apai uhi; huaite adin chiang un hiaite adingh ua; huaite lei a kipan a dopkang a a-om chiang un kangtalai liimte amau zul ah dopkang in a-om ua, kangtalai liimte ah thil hingte kha a-om hi.
english: When those went, these went. When those stood, these stood. When those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

paite: Thil hingte lutung ah van kibatpih a-om a, kristal vak bang a te mulkimhuaitak alutung uah akiphalh zeizoi hi.
english: Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.

paite: Van dum nuai ah akha uh akop khat thil hing dangte sun in azak ua, akha uh kop khat in apumpi uh akhuh uhi.
english: Under the expanse, their wings were straight, one toward the other. Each one had two which covered on this side, and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side.

paite: Huan alen chiang un akha ging uh tui tampi mahmah ging bang, bangkim hihtheipa aw bang mai, mipi ging vengvung husa, sepaihhon husa bang mai in ka za a; adin uleh akha uh akaisak uhi.
english: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of an army. When they stood, they let down their wings.

paite: Alutung ua vansin tung ah aw ahong om a, adin uleh akha uh akaisak uhi.
english: There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they let down their wings.

paite: Huan alutung ua vansin tung ah laltutphah bang, sapphir suang bang mai a kimu a-om a; huai laltutphah batpih tung ah mihing bang a kilang a-om hi.
english: Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.

paite: Akawng chiang tunglam sik hal-ap bang mai in ka mu a, akawng hileh kilawm chiang nuailam mei bang mai hi in ka mu a, avak kimvel lelaw hi.
english: I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.

paite: Vuahzuk ni a meipi tung a sakhituihup latdan bang in akim vak alang hi. Hiai TOUPA thupina latdan bang ahi. Huan ka muh in akhup in ka puk a, thugenpa aw ka za hi.
english: As the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of Yahweh’s glory. When I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of one that spoke.

paite: Huchi in ka en a, ngai in, cherubte lutung a vansin om ah sapphir suang hileh kilawmtak, laltutphah bangtak a kimu ahong lang hi.
english: Then I looked, and see, in the expanse that was over the head of the cherubim there appeared above them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.

paite: Ama'n puanmalngat silhpa kiang ah, "Cherub nuai a kangtalai peite kikal ah va lut inla, cherubte kikal a meivu na khut langnih dim in va luak inla, khopi tung ah thehzak in," achi hi.
english: He spoke to the man clothed in linen, and said, “Go in between the whirling wheels, even under the cherub, and fill both your hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.” He went in as I watched.

paite: Ka mitmuh lai mahmah in akuanta hi. Huan mi ahoh lai in tempul taklam pang ah cherubte adingh ua; huang sungnungpen meipi in adimta hi.
english: Now the cherubim stood on the right side of the house when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.

paite: TOUPA thupina cherubte a kipan apaitou a, inn kongpi tung ah ava dinghta a, huai inn meipi in adim a, TOUPA thupina vak in huangsung adimta hi.
english: Yahweh’s glory mounted up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of Yahweh’s glory.

paite: Cherubte khazap gingte huangsung ponungzaw leng Pathian Bangkim hihthei in ahon houpih lai a a-om bang mai in akiza hi.
english: The sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, puanmalngat silhpa kiang ah, "Cherubte kikal a kangtalai pei kikal a kipan mei va la in," chi a thu apiakleh, amah ava lut a, kangtalai liimte bul ah ava dinghta hi.
english: It came to pass, when he commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, “Take fire from between the whirling wheels, from between the cherubim,” that he went in and stood beside a wheel.

paite: Huan cherubim, cherubte kikal a kipan in, cherubte kikal a mei om sawk in, ala a, puanmalngat silhpa khut ah apia a, ama'n ana la a, apawtkheta hi.
english: The cherub stretched out his hand from between the cherubim to the fire that was between the cherubim, and took some of it, and put it into the hands of him who was clothed in linen, who took it and went out.

paite: Huchi in cherubte bel akha nuai uah mihing khut bangtak ahong lang a.
english: The form of a man’s hand appeared here in the cherubim under their wings.

paite: Huan ka en a, ngai in, cherubte sik ah kangtalai liim li, cherub khat kiang ah, kangtalai liim khat, cherub dang kiang ah kangtalai liim dang ka mu a; kangtalai liim latdan bel beril suang zia bang ahi.
english: I looked, and behold, there were four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and another wheel beside another cherub. The appearance of the wheels was like a beryl stone.

paite: Alatdan un ali un kibatna khat anei ua, kangtalai liim khat sung a kangtalai liim dang om bang mai ahi hi.
english: As for their appearance, the four of them had one likeness, like a wheel within a wheel.

paite: Apai chiang un sik li in apai thei ua, apai un leng akihei ngei kei uh; himahleh amasa ngatna lam azui zel ua, apai un akihei tuan kei uh.
english: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn as they went, but to the place where the head looked they followed it. They didn’t turn as they went.

paite: Huan apumpi uh apum in anungte uh, akhutte uh, akhate uleh kangtalai liimte leng akim in mit in adim a, ali ua kangtalai liimte leng.
english: Their whole body, including their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes all around, even the wheels that the four of them had.

paite: Akangtalai liimte bil a ka zak mahmah in, "Kangtalai liimte kipei," chih ahi.
english: As for the wheels, they were called in my hearing, “the whirling wheels”.

paite: Michih in mel li chiat anei ua, mel khat cherub mel ahi a, anihna mihing mel ahi a, athumna humpinelkai mel, alina muvanlai mel ahi.
english: Every one of them had four faces. The first face was the face of the cherub. The second face was the face of a man. The third face was the face of a lion. The fourth was the face of an eagle.

paite: Huchi in cherubte apaitou ua; hiai bel Kebar lui gei a thil hing ka muh ahi.
english: The cherubim mounted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river Chebar.

paite: Huan cherubte apai uleh kangtalai liimte leng agei uah apai tei a, cherubte'n lei a kipan paitou ding a akhate uh azak uleh kangtalai liimte'n alehngatsan ngei kei uh.
english: When the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the wheels also didn’t turn from beside them.

paite: Adin uleh hiaite adingh tei ua, apaitouh uleh hiaite leng apai tei zel ua, thil hingte kha amau ah a-om hi.
english: When they stood, these stood. When they mounted up, these mounted up with them; for the spirit of the living creature was in them.

paite: TOUPA thupina inpi kongpi tung a kipan apawtkhia a, cherubte tung ah adinghta hi.
english: Yahweh’s glory went out from over the threshold of the house and stood over the cherubim.

paite: Huan cherubte'n akha uh azak ua, apawt un ka mitmuh mahmah in lei a kipan apaitou ua; kangtalai liimte akiang uah a-om zel a; huan TOUPA Inn lutna suahlam kongkhak chin ah adinghta a; Israel' Pathian thupina atung uah a-om hi.
english: The cherubim lifted up their wings and mounted up from the earth in my sight when they went out, with the wheels beside them. Then they stood at the door of the east gate of Yahweh’s house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

paite: Hiai bel Kebar lui a Israel' Pathian nuai a ka thil hing muh mah ahi; cherubte ahi uh chih ka thei hi.
english: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.

paite: Avek un maitang li leh kha li anei chiat ua, akha nuai uah mihing khut bang mai a-om hi.
english: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings. The likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.

paite: Huan amel lam uh ahihleh Kebar lui a ka muh melte mah bang, alatdan uleh amau mahmah leng ahi uh; huan amazawn zel uah apai chiat uhi.
english: As for the likeness of their faces, they were the faces which I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances and themselves. They each went straight forward.

paite: Huan kha in ahon domkang a, TOUPA' inn suahlam lutna, suahlam muhna ahon tun a; ngai in, lutna kongkhak chin ah mi sawmnih-le-nga ana om ua; alak uah Azzur tapa Jaazaniah leh Benaiah tapa Pelatiah, mipi heutute ka mu hi.
english: Moreover the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of Yahweh’s house, which looks eastward. Behold, twenty-five men were at the door of the gate; and I saw among them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, hiaite gitlouhna sawmkhete ahi ua, hiai khopi a gitlouh sawmkhe mite ahi uh.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who devise iniquity, and who give wicked counsel in this city;

paite: Inn lam hun ahi nai kei; hiai khopi sa uina bel ahi a, eite asa i hi uh," chite.
english: who say, ‘The time is not near to build houses. This is the cauldron, and we are the meat.’

paite: "Huaiziak in thu gen inla, aw mihing tapa, atung uah thu gen in," achi hi.
english: Therefore prophesy against them. Prophesy, son of man.”

paite: Huan ka tung ah TOUPA kha ahong tung a, ama'n ka kiang ah, "Gen in, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Hichibang in na hihsek ua, aw Israel inkote aw, na lungsim ua thil hong tungte ka theisiang vek hi.
english: Yahweh’s Spirit fell on me, and he said to me, “Speak, ‘Yahweh says: “Thus you have said, house of Israel; for I know the things that come into your mind.

paite: Hiai khopi ah na mithahte uh na pungsak huthut ua, akongzingte na mithah un na dimsakta uhi."
english: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled its streets with the slain.”

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Na mithah uh alai a na koihte uh asa ahi ua; hiai khopi ahihleh sa uina bel ahi, himahleh alai a kipan suankhiak in na om ding uhi.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Your slain whom you have laid in the middle of it, they are the meat, and this is the cauldron; but you will be brought out of the middle of it.

paite: Namsau na kihta ua, na tung uah namsau ka hon tun ding, Toupa PATHIAN in achi.
english: You have feared the sword; and I will bring the sword on you,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: "Alai a kipan ka hon pawtkhesak ding a, namdangte khut ah ka hon mansak ding a, na tungthu uh angaihtuah ding uh.
english: “I will bring you out of the middle of it, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

paite: Namsau in na si ding ua, Israel gamgi lam ah na tungthu uh ka ngaihtuah ding; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
english: You will fall by the sword. I will judge you in the border of Israel. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

paite: Hiai khopi na sa uina bel uh ahi kei ding a, nou asung a sa na hi sam kei ding ua, Israel gamgi lam ah na tungthu uh ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
english: This will not be your cauldron, neither will you be the meat in the middle of it. I will judge you in the border of Israel.

paite: Huan TOUPA ka hi chih na theita ding uh, ka dan bawl na zui kei ua, ka thupawt leng na zui sam kei ua; na kim ua namte hihdan na zui zawta uh, achi," chi in.
english: You will know that I am Yahweh, for you have not walked in my statutes. You have not executed my ordinances, but have done after the ordinances of the nations that are around you.”’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, thu ka genleh Benaiah tapa Pelatiah ana sita mai a, huchi in ka khuppuk a, aw ngaihtak a kikou in, "Ah, Toupa PATHIAN, Israel khosuaksunte chimihna na bawl ding a hia?" ka chi hi.
english: When I prophesied, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell down on my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel?”

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a: ka kiang ah,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, na unaute, na chi-le-kuangte ngei leh Israel inkote tengteng, avek un, Jerusalem luah mite'n TOUPA a kipan paimang un, hiai gam kou a dia piak ahita hi," achihnate uh ahi uhi.
english: “Son of man, your brothers, even your brothers, the men of your relatives, and all the house of Israel, all of them, are the ones to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, ‘Go far away from Yahweh. This land has been given to us for a possession.’

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Gamlapi ah namte lak ah ka suanmang a, gam tampi ah ka hihdalh na a, sawt lou kal in ava tunna gam uah amaute a ding in Mun Siangthou ka hi ding," achi hi.
english: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Whereas I have removed them far off among the nations, and whereas I have scattered them among the countries, yet I will be to them a sanctuary for a little while in the countries where they have come.”’

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Namdangte a kipan in ka hon pikhawm nawn ding a, na dalhna gam ua kipan ka hon kaikhawm nawn ding a, Israel gam ka hon pe ding hi.
english: “Therefore say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I will gather you from the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.”

paite: Huchi in huai ah ahong pai ding ua, thil huathuai tengteng leh thilkihhuaite a kipan alamang ding uhi.
english: “‘They will come there, and they will take away all its detestable things and all its abominations from there.

paite: Lungtang khat ka pe ding a, na sung uah lungsim thak ka koih ding. Huan asa ua kipan lungtangsak ka lamang ding a, akiang uah lungtang nem ka pe ding hi.
english: I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within them. I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh,

paite: Ka dan thusehte azuih ua, ka thupiakte avom ua, ahihtheihna ding un, huchi in ka mite ahi ding ua, kei leng a Pathian uh ka hi ding.
english: that they may walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

paite: Ahuathuaina uleh akihhuaina laigil lungtang zuite bel akhelhna uh avek in amau ka khusak ding, Toupa PATHIAN in achi.
english: But as for them whose heart walks after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their way on their own heads,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

paite: Huchi in cherubte'n akhate uh azak ua, akiang uah kangtalai liimte a-om a, atung uah Israel' Pathian thupina a-om hi.
english: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings, and the wheels were beside them. The glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

paite: Khopi lai a kipan in TOUPA thupina apaitou a, khopi suahlam pang a tang sang ah ava dinghta hi.
english: Yahweh’s glory went up from the middle of the city, and stood on the mountain which is on the east side of the city.

paite: Huan kha in ahon domkang a, kilakna ah Pathian kha in Kaldai gam a saltangte kiang ah ahon tun hi. Huchi in ka kilakna muh in ahon paitouhsanta hi.
english: The Spirit lifted me up, and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to the captives. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.

paite: Huchi in saltangte kiang ah TOUPA'N thil ahon etsak tengteng ka genta hi.
english: Then I spoke to the captives all the things that Yahweh had shown me.

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
english: Yahweh’s word also came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, helhat inkuan, muhna ding mit nei a mu lou, zakna ding bil nei a zaloute lak a om na hi; helhat inkuan ahih himhim ziak un.
english: “Son of man, you dwell in the middle of the rebellious house, who have eyes to see, and don’t see, who have ears to hear, and don’t hear; for they are a rebellious house.

paite: "Huaiziak in nang mihing tapa, saltanna a pai ding bang in na vante lomgak dimdiam inla, sun khovak ah amitmuh mahmah un paikhia in; amuh mahmah na mun ua kipan mun dang ah na paikhe ding ahi; helhat inkuan ahi ua, akingaihtuah loh kha mai ding uh.
english: “Therefore, you son of man, prepare your baggage for moving, and move by day in their sight. You shall move from your place to another place in their sight. It may be they will consider, though they are a rebellious house.

paite: Huan na van sun khovak in amitmuh mahmah uah, saltang pai ding van lakkhiak in na lakhe ding a, nang mahmah leng amitmuh uah gamdang a khakmang ding pai in na pai ding ahi.
english: You shall bring out your baggage by day in their sight, as baggage for moving. You shall go out yourself at evening in their sight, as when men go out into exile.

paite: Amitmuh mahmah uah kulhbaang vangsak inla, huai ah lakhia in.
english: Dig through the wall in their sight, and carry your baggage out that way.

paite: Amitmuh mahmah uah na po ding a, mial ah na paikhe ding a, lei na muhlouhna ding in na mai na khuh ding ahi; Israel inkote a ding in etsak kholhna ding in nang ka hon bawl ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: In their sight you shall bear it on your shoulder, and carry it out in the dark. You shall cover your face, so that you don’t see the land, for I have set you for a sign to the house of Israel.”

paite: Huchi in ahon thupiak bang in ka hihta a, ka van saltang ding van bang in sun khovak in ka lakhia a, ka khut in baang ka sunvang a, khomial lai in ka lakhia a, amitmuh mahmah uah ka pua hi.
english: I did so as I was commanded. I brought out my baggage by day, as baggage for moving, and in the evening I dug through the wall with my hand. I brought it out in the dark, and bore it on my shoulder in their sight.

paite: Huan zingsang in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: In the morning, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: Mihing tapa, Israel inkuan, helhat inkuante'n na kiang ah, "Bang hih na hia?" ahon chi uh ahi kei maw?
english: “Son of man, hasn’t the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, ‘What are you doing?’

paite: Akiang uah, "Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Hiai thuphuan Jerusalem heutute leh Israel inkote pumpi, a-omna uh mite tungthu ding ahi.
english: “Say to them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel among whom they are.”’

paite: Nou a ding in etsak kholhna ka hi a, ka chih bang geih a atung ua hih ahi ding; khakmang in, saltang ding in apaimang ding uh," chi in.
english: “Say, ‘I am your sign. As I have done, so will it be done to them. They will go into exile, into captivity.

paite: "Huan alak ua heutu omsun in mial nuai ah aliang in apo ding a, apaikhe ding; alakkhiakna ding un baang avangsak ua, amit in gam amuh nawn louh ziak in amai akhuh ding ahi.
english: “‘The prince who is among them will bear his baggage on his shoulder in the dark, and will go out. They will dig through the wall to carry things out that way. He will cover his face, because he will not see the land with his eyes.

paite: Amah ka len in ka khuh ding a, ka thang a awk ahi ding; Kaldai gam a Babulon ah ka hon pi ding a, muh zaw amu kei ding; huai ah asi ding hi.
english: I will also spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet he will not see it, though he will die there.

paite: Amah panpih dia akiang a omte leh asepaihte tengteng gam chih ah ka hihzak ding a, namsau dokkhia in ka delh ding hi.
english: I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his bands. I will draw out the sword after them.

paite: "Huan namte lak a ka delhzak a, gam chih a ka hihdalh hun chiang in TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
english: “‘They will know that I am Yahweh when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

paite: Himahleh namsau, kial, hipi a kipan mi tawmchik ka hawi ding; huaite'n ahong paina gam ua namte kiang ah akihhuaina tengteng aphuanna ding un; kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh," achi hi.
english: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence, that they may declare all their abominations among the nations where they come. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn hi.
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, na an ling vonvon kawm in ne inla, na tui lungzing a ling kawm in dawn in.
english: “Son of man, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and with fearfulness.

paite: Huan gam a mite kiang ah Toupa PATHIAN in Jerusalem a tengte tungtang ah leh Israel gam tungtang ah hichi in achi: Lau kawm in a-ante uh ane ding ua, lungzingtak in atui uh adawn ding ua, agamsung a tengte hiamgamna ziak in asung a thil om tengteng a kipan hihgawp in a-om ding hi.
english: Tell the people of the land, ‘The Lord Yahweh says concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem and the land of Israel: “They will eat their bread with fearfulness and drink their water in dismay, that her land may be desolate, and all that is therein, because of the violence of all those who dwell therein.

paite: Huchi in mite tenna khopite loihsan in a-om ding a, agam hihsiat in a-om ding; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh," achi hi.
english: The cities that are inhabited will be laid waste, and the land will be a desolation. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”’”

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi:
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israel gam a hiai paunak na neih uh bang chihna ahia? Anite asawt chiang in kilakna peuhmah avuaksuak nawn zel," na chih uh.
english: “Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel, saying, ‘The days are prolonged, and every vision fails’?

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Hiai paunak ka hihbei ding a, Israel gam ah azang nawn ngei kei ding uh; kilakna tundik ni ding anaita, chi in akiang uah gen zaw in.
english: Tell them therefore, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I will make this proverb to cease, and they will no more use it as a proverb in Israel;”’ but tell them, ‘“The days are at hand, and the fulfillment of every vision.

paite: "Israel inkuante lak ah kilakna hong vuaksuak leh aisan hoih lam a maitang phatna a-omta kei ding.
english: For there will be no more any false vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.

paite: TOUPA ka hi a, ka gen ding a, ka gen tangtun ahi ding a, sit ahi kei ding; Aw helhat inkuante aw, na dam lai mahmah un thu ka gen ding hi, ka tangtungsak pah ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," achi hi.
english: For I am Yahweh. I will speak, and the word that I speak will be performed. It will be no more deferred; for in your days, rebellious house, I will speak the word and will perform it,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
english: Again Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, ngai in, 'Israel inkote a min kilakna amuhte bel ni tampi a ding ahi a, agenkholhte leng gamlapi a ding ahi,' " achi uhi.
english: “Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, ‘The vision that he sees is for many days to come, and he prophesies of times that are far off.’

paite: Huaiziak in akiang uah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Ka thu bangmah sit ahi kei ding a, ka thugen peuhmah hihtangtun in a-om zaw ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in hilh in,” achi hi.
english: “Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “None of my words will be deferred any more, but the word which I speak will be performed,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn a,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israel zawlnei, amah lungtang kia a kipan a gen chingte tung ah thu gen inla, 'TOUPA thu ngai un.' "
english: “Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy, and say to those who prophesy out of their own heart, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word:

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, "Zawlnei hai, amau ngaihdan zui a, bangmah muloute tung agik hi!
english: The Lord Yahweh says, “Woe to the foolish prophets, who follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!

paite: Aw Israel, na zawlneite khopi sesa a sehal om bang lel ahita uh.
english: Israel, your prophets have been like foxes in the waste places.

paite: TOUPA ni a kidouna a dingzou ding a kulhbaang dingkipsak ding leh Israel inkote hum ding a kulhbaang lam ding in na paitou kei uhi."
english: You have not gone up into the gaps or built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in Yahweh’s day.

paite: "TOUPA thupawt ahi," chi mite'n bangmah lou lel leh genkholhna lim lel atang ua, TOUPA sawl ahi kei uh; athu uh hi ngei ding bang in mite agingtasak ua.
english: They have seen falsehood and lying divination, who say, ‘Yahweh says;’ but Yahweh has not sent them. They have made men to hope that the word would be confirmed.

paite: Kilakna hong vuaksuak lel na mu un, thugenkholh diklou na gen uh ahi kei maw? "TOUPA thupawt ahi," na chi nawn ngal ua, ke'n ka gen a hia?
english: Haven’t you seen a false vision, and haven’t you spoken a lying divination, in that you say, ‘Yahweh says;’ but I have not spoken?”

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Bangmah lou phet na gen ua zuau lel na muh ziak un, ngai un, ka hon nang ahi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Because you have spoken falsehood and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Huan ka khut in bangmah lou mute leh zuau genkhol mite anang ding a, ka mite kidotkhawmna ah atel kei ding ua, Israel inkuante min gelhna ah gelh in a-om sam kei ding uh; huchi in Toupa PATHIAN ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
english: “My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and who utter lying divinations. They will not be in the council of my people, neither will they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither will they enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.”

paite: Galmuanna omloupi ma, "Muanna," chi a mite apimang ziak un leh mi baang bawl a, sunu nuh mite'n,
english: “‘Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, “Peace;” and there is no peace. When one builds up a wall, behold, they plaster it with whitewash.

paite: "Ake nawn mai ding, vuahpi ahong zu ding a, nou gial lianpite aw, na hong ke ding ua, huih thupi in ahihse ding," chi in.
english: Tell those who plaster it with whitewash that it will fall. There will be an overflowing shower; and you, great hailstones, will fall. A stormy wind will tear it.

paite: Ngai un, baang achip khit chiang in, "Na sunu nuh uh koi ah, ahon chi kei ding ua hia?"
english: Behold, when the wall has fallen, won’t it be said to you, “Where is the plaster with which you have plastered it?”

paite: "Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ka heh in huihpi thupi in ka hihse vek ding, ka heh in vuahpi ahong zu ding a, ka heh in gial thupitak hihmang ding in ahong ke ding.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “I will even tear it with a stormy wind in my wrath. There will be an overflowing shower in my anger, and great hailstones in wrath to consume it.

paite: Huchi in sunu na nuhngou bang uh ka chimsak ding a, lei pha in achim dia, huchi in asuangphumte adawk hial ding hi; huan achim ding a, baang kichim ah hihmang in na om ding uh; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
english: So I will break down the wall that you have plastered with whitewash, and bring it down to the ground, so that its foundation will be uncovered. It will fall, and you will be consumed in the middle of it. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

paite: "Hichibang in baang tung ah leh sunu nuh mite tung ah ka hehna ka damsak ding; huan, baang a-om nawn kei a, abaang zutte leng a-om nawnta kei uh, ka hon chi ding hi.
english: Thus I will accomplish my wrath on the wall, and on those who have plastered it with whitewash. I will tell you, ‘The wall is no more, nor those who plastered it—

paite: Huai bel Israel zawlnei Jerusalem tungthu gen a, galmuanna omloupi a galmuanna musak mite ngei, a-om nawn kei uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: to wit, the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and who see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace,’” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

paite: "Nang mihing tapa, na mite tanute, alungtang lel ua gen mite masuan inla, amaute kalh in thu gen in, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi:
english: You, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy against them,

paite: Numei, mite ban a sik bunsak leh mi hinnate mat belhna ding a miliante lukhuhna khui mite atung uh agik hi! Nou hinna ding in ka mite hinna na man ding uh maw?
english: and say, “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Woe to the women who sew magic bands on all elbows and make veils for the head of persons of every stature to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of my people and save souls alive for yourselves?

paite: Buhman tawmchik leh tanghou them mu ding a si lou ding sisak ding leh hing lou ding hingsak ding in na zuaugen uh ka mite'n a-up ziak un ka mite lak ah ka min athanghuai ahi.
english: You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill the souls who should not die and to save the souls alive who should not live, by your lying to my people who listen to lies.’

paite: "Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai un, mi hinna, vasa bang a man ding a na thil butsakte uh ka mudah ahi; na bante uh ka bot ding a, na mimat dingte uh vasa bang a na mat dingte uh hinna ka pawtsak vek ding hi.
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I am against your magic bands, with which you hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms. I will let the souls fly free, even the souls whom you ensnare like birds.
