paite: Na lukhuhnate uh leng ka botkek ding a, ka mite na khut ua kipan ka suaktasak ding, na mat theih ding un na khut uah a-omta kei ding uh; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
english: I will also tear your veils and deliver my people out of your hand; and they will no longer be in your hand to be ensnared. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

paite: "Kei lungkhamsak hilou a, midiktatte lungtang zuau a na hihnat ziak un leh migilou hingdam a a-omna ding a akhelhna lampi a kipan akilehheilouhna ding in migilou khutte na hihhat uh ahi.
english: Because with lies you have grieved the heart of the righteous, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, and be saved alive.

paite: Huaiziak in bangmah lou lel, thugenkholh diklou hiam zaw na mu nawn kei ding uh; huan na khut ua kipan ka mite ka hunkhe ding a, TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh, achi, chi in gen in," achi high in," achi hi.
english: Therefore you shall no more see false visions nor practice divination. I will deliver my people out of your hand. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.’”

paite: Huchi in Israel upa khenkhatte ka kiang ah ahong pai ua, ka ma ah atu ua.
english: Then some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.

paite: Ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tungta, ka kiang ah;
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, hiai mite'n amilimte uh alungtang uah alalut ua, ama uah athulimlouhna pukna uh akoih uhi; kei ahon dong peuhmah ding ua hia?"
english: “Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before their face. Should I be inquired of at all by them?

paite: Huaiziak in amau houpih inla, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Israel inkuan a michih alungtang ua milim lalut a, ama ua athulimlouhna pukna koih a, zawlnei kiang a hong pai peuhmah, kei TOUPA'N amilim uh tamdan bang zel in ka dawng ding.
english: Therefore speak to them and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Every man of the house of Israel who takes his idols into his heart and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face then comes to the prophet, I Yahweh will answer him there according to the multitude of his idols,

paite: Israel inkote amilim uh ziak a hon na omtuamsan ziak ua alungtang ua ka mattheihna ding in."
english: that I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.”’

paite: Huaiziak in Israel inkote kiang ah Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Hong kik unla, na milimte ua kipan in hong kik un, na kihhuaina tengteng uh lehngatsan un.
english: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Return, and turn yourselves from your idols! Turn away your faces from all your abominations.

paite: "Israel inkote lak a mi kuapeuh hiam, mikhual Israel gam a teng hiam, kei a kipan a kihihtuam, alungtang ua milim lalut a, ama ua thulimlouhna pukna koih kawm a, atungtang ua hon dong ding a zawlnei kiang a hoh kei leh TOUPA ngei in ka dawng ding hi.
english: “‘“For everyone of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live in Israel, who separates himself from me and takes his idols into his heart, and puts the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet to inquire for himself of me, I Yahweh will answer him by myself.

paite: Huai mi ka masuan ding a, mi'n lamdang asak ding in tangtawn tangtawn a gen ding in ka mite lak a kipan ka hihmang ding; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uhi.
english: I will set my face against that man and will make him an astonishment, for a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from among my people. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

paite: "Huan zawlnei khem a om in thu gen henla, kei TOUPA'N zawlnei ka thuzoh ahi a, atung ah ka khut ka lik ding a, ka mi Israelte lak a kipan ka hihmang ding.
english: “‘“If the prophet is deceived and speaks a word, I, Yahweh, have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand on him, and will destroy him from among my people Israel.

paite: Athulimlouhna uh apo ding ua; zawlnei thulimlouhna amah dong mite thulimlouhna bang mai ahi ding hi.
english: They will bear their iniquity. The iniquity of the prophet will be even as the iniquity of him who seeks him,

paite: Israel inkote kei a kipan aman nawn louh ua, atatleknate tengteng ua akihihnit nawn samlouhna ding un, ka mite ahih zawk ua a Pathian uh ka hihtheihna ding in, Toupa PATHIAN in achi, chi in gen in," achi hi.
english: that the house of Israel may no more go astray from me, neither defile themselves any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a:
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, gam mite'n tatlekna thilhih a, ka tung a thil hihkhial a, ke'n ka khut ka lik a, a-an uh, hinna bul ka hihsiat a, atung ua kial ka tunsak a, mi leh sate ka hon hihmanleh hiai mi thum,
english: “Son of man, when a land sins against me by committing a trespass, and I stretch out my hand on it, and break the staff of its bread and send famine on it, and cut off from it man and animal—

paite: Noah, Daniel leh Job hial leng hong om bang hileh, adiktatna un amau hinna kia a humbit ding ahi," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Gam sahangte a gam uh ka tuansuaksak a, gam ahihsiat ua, ahong kigawp a, gamsa ziak a kuamah paisuak ding a-om kei uleh,
english: “If I cause evil animals to pass through the land, and they ravage it and it is made desolate, so that no man may pass through because of the animals—

paite: hiai mi thumte om le uh, kei ka hin bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, atanute uh, atapate uh ahumbit tuan kei ding uh; amau kia hotdam in a-om ding ua, gam asegawp ding hi.
english: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters. They only would be delivered, but the land would be desolate.

paite: Ahihkeileh huai gam ah namsau ka lik dia, "Namsau aw, gamsung teng tawnsuak in," mi leh gamsa ka gawimang ding hi.
english: “Or if I bring a sword on that land, and say, ‘Sword, go through the land, so that I cut off from it man and animal’—

paite: Hiai mi thumte om le uh leng, kei ka hin bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, atanute uh, atapate uh ahumbit tuan kei ding ua, amau hinna kia humbit in a-om ding uh.
english: though these three men were in it, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “they would deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only would be delivered themselves.

paite: Ahihkeileh, huai gam ah, hipi ka hon lensak a, mi leh sa hihmang ding a sisan suah a ka hehna huai gam tung a ka hon sunleh;
english: “Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my wrath on it in blood, to cut off from it man and animal—

paite: Noah, Daniel leh Job hial leng na om le uh, kei ka hin bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, atanu uhiam, atapa uhiam ahumbit kei ding ua, adiktatna un amau hinna ngei ahumbit lel ding uhi.
english: though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “they would deliver neither son nor daughter; they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi ngal a, "Jerusalem tung a ka vaihawmna na mahmah lite, namsaute, kialte, gam sahangte, hipite, mi leh sa gawimang vek ding a ka hon tut hun chiang in bangzah a thupi ahi diam aw?
english: For the Lord Yahweh says: “How much more when I send my four severe judgments on Jerusalem—the sword, the famine, the evil animals, and the pestilence—to cut off from it man and animal!

paite: Himahleh ngai in, huai lai a akhosuaksun pikhiak dingte nutsiat in a-om ding ua, tanute leh tapate leng; ngai un, akiang uah ahong pawtkhe ding ua, a-omdan uh athilhihte na mu ding uh, Jerusalem tung a thil hoih lou ka hon tut thu ah lungmuan in na om ding ua, atung a ka hon tut tengteng thu ah leng.
english: Yet, behold, there will be left a remnant in it that will be carried out, both sons and daughters. Behold, they will come out to you, and you will see their way and their doings. Then you will be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought on it.

paite: A-omdan uleh athilhihte uh na muh hun chiang un ahon lungmuan ding uh; atung a ka thilhih tengteng hihsan nei lou in ka hih kei chih na thei ding uh chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," chi in.
english: They will comfort you, when you see their way and their doings; then you will know that I have not done all that I have done in it without cause,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a:
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, sing dang sang in gammang nuai a sing lak a grepgui bang ahi tuam a le?
english: “Son of man, what is the vine tree more than any tree, the vine branch which is among the trees of the forest?

paite: Thil bawlna dia asing zat ahi hia? Tui-um belsuan khaina ding in kua'n azang ngei a le?
english: Will wood be taken of it to make anything? Will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel on it?

paite: Ngai in, mei a paihlut ahi a, toh ding in mei in akangmang, among langnih, akang khin a alai ah phattuamna anei a hia?
english: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire has devoured both its ends, and the middle of it is burned. Is it profitable for any work?

paite: Ngai in, abit lai nangawn in aphatuam kei; akatmang khit nung in, phatuam sin kei na tel e!"
english: Behold, when it was whole, it was suitable for no work. How much less, when the fire has devoured it, and it has been burned, will it yet be suitable for any work?”

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Gamnuai sing lak a grep guite, toh ding in mei ah ka khul maimah bang in, Jerusalem luah mite ka bawl ding.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “As the vine wood among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

paite: Amau ka masuan ding a, pawt mah le uh, mei a kipan, akangbei ding, mei in, TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh; amaute ka masuan hun chiang in.
english: I will set my face against them. They will go out from the fire, but the fire will still devour them. Then you will know that I am Yahweh, when I set my face against them.

paite: Agam uh ka hihgawp ngei ding ahi, thulimlouhna ahih ziak un chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," chi in.
english: I will make the land desolate, because they have acted unfaithfully,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
english: Again Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Jerusalem akihhuainate theikhesak inla, akiang ah,
english: “Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations;

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in Jerusalem kiang ah hichi in achi: Na pawtna gam leh na pianna gam Kanaan mite gam ahi a, na pa Amor mi ahi a, na nu Hit mi ahi.
english: and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says to Jerusalem: “Your origin and your birth is of the land of the Canaanite. An Amorite was your father, and your mother was a Hittite.

paite: Huan na pianna thu bel na pian ni in na laigui at ahi kei a, nang hihsiang ding a tui a sil na hi sam kei, chi nuh na tuak kei a, tuamlum na hi kei.
english: As for your birth, in the day you were born your navel was not cut. You weren’t washed in water to cleanse you. You weren’t salted at all, nor wrapped in blankets at all.

paite: Lainat ding a na tung a hiaite hih ding in kuamah mit in nang ahon hehpih kei ua; gamlak a paihkhiak na hita, na pian ni a kipan kih a om na hi hi."
english: No eye pitied you, to do any of these things to you, to have compassion on you; but you were cast out in the open field, because you were abhorred in the day that you were born.

paite: Huan na kiang a ka hong pai in sisan lak a kital in ka hon mu a, na kiang ah, "Sisan ah om lechin leng 'hing in!' ka hon chi a," ahi, ka hon chi ahi, "Sisan ah om mah lechin 'hing in!'
english: “‘“When I passed by you, and saw you wallowing in your blood, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’ Yes, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’

paite: Gam thil pakmum bang in ka hon khangsak a, khanglian a piching in, na hong melhoih mahmah hi. Na nawite ahong kisa ua, na sam ahong hoih a; himahleh savuak leh vuaktang lel na hi lailai hi."
english: I caused you to multiply as that which grows in the field, and you increased and grew great, and you attained to excellent beauty. Your breasts were formed, and your hair grew; yet you were naked and bare.

paite: Huan na kiang a ka hong pai a ka hon et in, deihhuai tham na hong hita a, ka puan ka hon zawn a, na vuaktanna ka hon khuhta hi; ahi, na kiang ah ka kichiam a, thukhun ah ka hon lutpih a, kei a na hita hi, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: “‘“Now when I passed by you, and looked at you, behold, your time was the time of love; and I spread my garment over you and covered your nakedness. Yes, I pledged myself to you and entered into a covenant with you,” says the Lord Yahweh, “and you became mine.

paite: Huchi in tui in ka hon sil a, ahi, na sisan ka hon hihsiang sipsip a, sathau ka hon nuh hi.
english: “‘“Then I washed you with water. Yes, I thoroughly washed away your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.

paite: Puanzem in ka hon van a, saham vun khedap ka hon bunsak a, puanmalngat hoih in ka hon van a, silk puan ka hon khusak hi.
english: I clothed you also with embroidered work and put leather sandals on you. I dressed you with fine linen and covered you with silk.

paite: Kizepna hoih in ka hon zem a, na khut ah taute, na ngawng ah dangka-eng khainiangte.
english: I decked you with ornaments, put bracelets on your hands, and put a chain on your neck.

paite: Na nak ah nakbulhte, na bil ah bilbahte, na lu ah lallukhu hoihtak in ka hon zem hi.
english: I put a ring on your nose, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.

paite: Huchi in dangka-eng leh dangkasik a zephoih na hita a, na puansilhte puanmalngat hoihtak leh silk puan leh puankhui kilawm ahi ua; na nek tangbuang nel leh khuaizu leh sathau ahi, na kilawm mahmah a, kumpi chi leng na ching hi.
english: Thus you were decked with gold and silver. Your clothing was of fine linen, silk, and embroidered work. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and you prospered to royal estate.

paite: Na kilawmna ziak in namte lak ah athangkhia a, ka thupina a kivan in na buchingta, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: Your renown went out among the nations for your beauty; for it was perfect, through my majesty which I had put on you,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Himahleh na kilawmna na muang lua a, na minthanna na hukloh a, mi vialvak peuh leh na muh peuh na kithuahpih hi.
english: “‘“But you trusted in your beauty, and played the prostitute because of your renown, and poured out your prostitution on everyone who passed by. It was his.

paite: Na puansilhte suah in mun sangte na zuan a, huai ah kizuak in na pang a, hichibang in na om ngei nawn kei ding hi.
english: You took some of your garments, and made for yourselves high places decked with various colors, and played the prostitute on them. This shouldn’t happen, neither shall it be.

paite: Ka dangka-eng leh ka dangkasik tui-um belsuan hoih taktak ka hon piakte na la a, pasal limbawlna ding in na zang, na hukpihta hi.
english: You also took your beautiful jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself images of men, and played the prostitute with them.

paite: Puansilh khui kilawmte na la a, amau na tuam a, ka sathaute leh ka gimlimte ama uah na tung hi.
english: You took your embroidered garments, covered them, and set my oil and my incense before them.

paite: Ka hon tanghou piak leng ka tangbuang hoih leh sathau leh khuaizu ka hon vaknate gimlim ding in ama uah na lui a; hichi ahong hita, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: My bread also which I gave you, fine flour, oil, and honey, with which I fed you, you even set it before them for a pleasant aroma; and so it was,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Huai lou leng na tanu, na tapa, na hon suansakte akiang uah kithoihna ding in zatbei ding in na pia a; na hukna thil namai ahi a hia?
english: “‘“Moreover you have taken your sons and your daughters, whom you have borne to me, and you have sacrificed these to them to be devoured. Was your prostitution a small matter,

paite: Ka tate na thah a, meipi a pailut a akiang ua na latte?
english: that you have slain my children and delivered them up, in causing them to pass through the fire to them?

paite: Na kihhuaina leh na hukna tengteng ah na naupan lai avuaktang a na omleh na sisan a na tal maimah hunlaite na thei nawnta kei hi.
english: In all your abominations and your prostitution you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, and were wallowing in your blood.

paite: Huan hiai na thulimlouhna tengteng khit in leng, hichi ahong hi a, na tung agik hi! Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi.
english: “‘“It has happened after all your wickedness—woe, woe to you!” says the Lord Yahweh—

paite: Mun kiphoute na kibawlna, kongzing chiteng ah mun sangte na lam hi.
english: “that you have built for yourselves a vaulted place, and have made yourselves a lofty place in every street.

paite: Lampi kipatna teng ah mun sang na lam a, na kilawmna kihhuai in na bawl a vialvak peuhmahte kiang ah na kilemdawk a, na hukna a-uang semsem hi.
english: You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your prostitution.

paite: Aigupta mi, na inveng, sami mahmah toh kingaihna khelhna leng na hihta; hon hehsak ding in na hukna na uangsakta ahi.
english: You have also committed sexual immorality with the Egyptians, your neighbors, great of flesh; and have multiplied your prostitution, to provoke me to anger.

paite: Huaiziak in ngai in, na tung ah ka khut ka lik a, na an nek ka kiamsak a, nang hon mudah Philistia tanute, na hukdan zumpih mahmah nute kiang ah ut-ut a ahon bawl ding un ka hon peta hi.
english: See therefore, I have stretched out my hand over you, and have diminished your portion, and delivered you to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who are ashamed of your lewd way.

paite: Assuria mite kiang ah leng na kizuak a, huntawk chih lah nei tel lou; ahi, akiang uah kizuak in na pang a, na kham tuan sam kei hi.
english: You have played the prostitute also with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; yes, you have played the prostitute with them, and yet you weren’t satisfied.

paite: Kanaan gam ah, Kaldai mite kiang ah na hukna na uangsak lailai a, na kham tuan kei hi.
english: You have moreover multiplied your prostitution to the land of merchants, to Chaldea; and yet you weren’t satisfied with this.

paite: Nang lungtang sia hina mai e, na tatdan numei genhak gilou mahmah mai thil na hih a, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: “‘“How weak is your heart,” says the Lord Yahweh, “since you do all these things, the work of an impudent prostitute;

paite: Lamka thuam teng a milim biakna inn na bawl a, kongzing chih a mun sang na bawlte loh na delh louh ziak in kizuak leng na bang kei hi.
english: in that you build your vaulted place at the head of every way, and make your lofty place in every street, and have not been as a prostitute, in that you scorn pay.

paite: Zi angkawm, pasalte sang a mi tuam deihzaw nu!
english: “‘“Adulterous wife, who takes strangers instead of her husband!

paite: Kizuakte kiang ah thil apesek ua, nang bel na lehpiak a hon deihmi ang ah, gam chih a kipan ahong pai ua, ahon kithuahpih theihna ding un na nou zaw nak ahi.
english: People give gifts to all prostitutes; but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and bribe them, that they may come to you on every side for your prostitution.

paite: Huan na huk thu a kuamah in ahon zot louh midang toh na kibatlouhna uh ahi; nang aman na pe zosop a; kuamah in man ahon piak louh uh na lamdanna ahi.
english: You are different from other women in your prostitution, in that no one follows you to play the prostitute; and whereas you give hire, and no hire is given to you, therefore you are different.”’

paite: Huaiziak in aw mihuknu, TOUPA thu ngai in;
english: “Therefore, prostitute, hear Yahweh’s word:

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Na kihhuaina buakkhiak ahih a, na mingaihte toh na kithuahna lam ua na vuaktanna suklat ahih ziak leh na kihhuaina milim tengteng ziak leh akiang ua na piak na tate sisan ziak in;
english: ‘The Lord Yahweh says, “Because your filthiness was poured out, and your nakedness uncovered through your prostitution with your lovers; and because of all the idols of your abominations, and for the blood of your children, that you gave to them;

paite: ngai in, nang hon ngaimi na nuamtatpihte tengteng leh na na ngaih khitsa tengteng leh na muhdahte tengteng ka samkhawm ding a, ahi, na kim ah ka pikhawm ding a, na vuaktanna tengteng amuhtheihna ding un akiang uah na vuaktanna ka hihlang ding hi.
english: therefore see, I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have taken pleasure, and all those whom you have loved, with all those whom you have hated. I will even gather them against you on every side, and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.

paite: Huan numei pasal khen a, amah ta sisan suah tungthu a bang in ka hon vaihawmkhum ding; hehna leh mullitna sisan na tung ah ka tungsak ding.
english: I will judge you as women who break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring on you the blood of wrath and jealousy.

paite: Akhut uah ka hon pe dia, na mun kidohte ahihpuk ding ua, na mun sangte achimsak ding ua; na puansilhte asuah ding ua, na suangmantamte ahon sut ding ua, savuak leh vuaktang in ahon nuse ding uh.
english: I will also give you into their hand, and they will throw down your vaulted place, and break down your lofty places. They will strip you of your clothes and take your beautiful jewels. They will leave you naked and bare.

paite: Na tung ah mipi akaikhawm ding ua, suang in ahon deng ding ua, namsau in ahon kui pailet ding uhi.
english: They will also bring up a company against you, and they will stone you with stones, and thrust you through with their swords.

paite: Na innte mei in ahal ding ua, numei tampi mitmuh in na tung ah vaihawmna atangtungsak ding ua; na hukna ka tawpsak ding a, loh leng na peta kei ding hi.
english: They will burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women. I will cause you to cease from playing the prostitute, and you will also give no hire any more.

paite: Huchi in ka hehna na tung ah ka lungdamsak ding a, ka hon mullitna adaita ding, ka dai dide dia, ka heh ngei nawn kei ding hi.
english: So I will cause my wrath toward you to rest, and my jealousy will depart from you. I will be quiet, and will not be angry any more.

paite: Na tuailai nite na theihgige louh a, hiai thilte a na hon vuisak zawk ziak in, ngai in, na tatdan dan, na tung ah ka tun ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi. Huan na kihhuaina tengteng behlap in hiai hukna na hih nawn kei ding hi.
english: “‘“Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have raged against me in all these things; therefore, behold, I also will bring your way on your head,” says the Lord Yahweh: “and you shall not commit this lewdness with all your abominations.

paite: "Ngai in, paunak zang peuhmah in hiai paunak azang ding uh, 'Atanu in anu asuun,' chih.
english: “‘“Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb against you, saying, ‘As is the mother, so is her daughter.’

paite: Na nu, amah pasal leh tate mudahnu tanu na hi a, kitanauna lam ah bel, ama pasal leh tate mudahnu tanau na hi; na nu Hit mi ahi a, na pa Amor mi ahi.
english: You are the daughter of your mother, who loathes her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

paite: "Huan na tanau, na u Samaria, na veilam a teng amah leh atanute toh ahi uh; na tanau, na nau, na taklam a teng Sodom leh atanute ahi uhi.
english: Your elder sister is Samaria, who dwells at your left hand, she and her daughters; and your younger sister, who dwells at your right hand, is Sodom with her daughters.

paite: Himahleh amau omdan na zui kei a, akihhuaina bang uh na hih kei na a, na omdan tengteng a na thulim louh zawkdan ngaihtuah in huaite bangmah tham ahi kei hi.
english: Yet you have not walked in their ways, nor done their abominations; but soon you were more corrupt than they in all your ways.

paite: "Kei ka hin bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, nang leh na tate'n ahih bang uh na tanau Sodom leh atanute'n leng ahih het kei uh.
english: As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.

paite: Na tanau Sodom thulimlouhna hiaite ahi: kisaktheihna, nekvah luatnate, amah leh atanute nuamtat mawkmawkte, migentheite leh tasamte apanpih tuan sam kei uh.
english: “‘“Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters. She also didn’t strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

paite: Huan mi uang ahi ua, ka ma a thilkihhuai hihsa ahi uh; huchi in hoih ka sak bang in ka hihmangta ahi.
english: They were arrogant and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it.

paite: "Samaria in na khelhna kimkhat leng ahih sam kei; amau sang a na kihhuainate na nak hih zawk ziak in na hihsa na kihhuaina tengteng in na sanggamnute siam na tangsak hi.
english: Samaria hasn’t committed half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters by all your abominations which you have done.

paite: Na sanggamnute dikzaw a na suklat ziak in nangmah in na zahlakna na puak ding ahi; amau sang in thilkihhuai uangzawte na hih a, na khelhnate ziak in amau nang sang in adiktatzaw uhi; ahi, na sanggamnute siam na tansakna ah nang anen-aham in zahlakna na tang ding ahi.
english: You also bear your own shame yourself, in that you have given judgment for your sisters; through your sins that you have committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous than you. Yes, be also confounded, and bear your shame, in that you have justified your sisters.

paite: "Huan a-omdan uh, Sodom leh atanu omdante, Samaria leh atanu omdante, amaute toh ton in nang omdan mahmah ka hei ding.
english: “‘“I will reverse their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, and the captivity of your captives among them;

paite: Amau a dia lungmuanna na na hih sekna a na thilhihsa tengteng ziak a na zumtheihna ding in.
english: that you may bear your own shame, and may be ashamed because of all that you have done, in that you are a comfort to them.

paite: Huan na sanggamnute, Sodom leh atanute, Samaria leh atanute a-omdan uh masa bang in a-om nawn ding ua; nang leh na tanu leng na omdan uh masa bang in na om nawn ding uh.
english: Your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former estate; and you and your daughters will return to your former estate.

paite: Na thulimlouhna muhkhiak a hih ma a na kihih thupi nite in na sanggamnu Sodom na kamse khuahna ahi sek kei maw?
english: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride,

paite: Tu'n zaw Siria tanu leh akim a mi tengteng, Philistia tanute na kim a hon simmoh mite'n ahon genseta uhi.
english: before your wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all who are around her, the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you all around.

paite: Na hukna leh na kihhuaina na po zel ahi," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Thukhun bohsia in thuchiam na khawksak louhdan bang zel in na tung ah ka hih tei sin ahi.
english: “‘For the Lord Yahweh says: “I will also deal with you as you have done, who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.

paite: Himahleh na naupan lai a na kiang a ka thukhun ka theigige ding a, na kiang ah tangtawn thukhun ka bawl ding hi.
english: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.

paite: Huchi in na sanggamnute ka pom hun chiang in na omdante na hon theikhe ding a, na kizumpih ding; amau lah na tanu ding in ka hon pia hi, na thukhun ziak bel hilou in.
english: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, your elder sisters and your younger; and I will give them to you for daughters, but not by your covenant.

paite: Na kiang a ka thukhun ka hihkip ding a, TOUPA ka hi chih na theita ding uh.
english: I will establish my covenant with you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh;

paite: Na thilhih tengteng ka hon ngaihdam vek hun chiang in na theihgigena na zum ziak a na kam kat nawnlouhna ding in," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: that you may remember, and be confounded, and never open your mouth any more because of your shame, when I have forgiven you all that you have done,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah:
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israel inkote kiang ah thuhaksa bawlkhia inla, gentehna in gen in,
english: “Son of man, tell a riddle, and speak a parable to the house of Israel;

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, chi in; Muvanlai lianpi, kha zapi, khaveng saupi gial em-um, mul bittak Lebanon tang ah aleng a, sidar sing zik atuah hi.
english: and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “A great eagle with great wings and long feathers, full of feathers which had various colors, came to Lebanon and took the top of the cedar.

paite: Ahiang ziknou pen akitan a, mi vialvakna gam ah alenpih a, sumsinna khopi ah aphut hi.
english: He cropped off the topmost of its young twigs, and carried it to a land of traffic. He planted it in a city of merchants.

paite: Huai gam haichi leng atuah a, lei hoih ah apawipou a, tui tampi gei ah aphut a, muisum sing bang in aphut hi.
english: “‘“He also took some of the seed of the land and planted it in fruitful soil. He placed it beside many waters. He set it as a willow tree.

paite: Huan akhang a, grepgui niam bilbial ahong hi a, selnoute ahon suah a, ahiangte ahong dawn hi.
english: It grew and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and its roots were under him. So it became a vine, produced branches, and shot out sprigs.

paite: "Muvanlai lianpi dang a-om nawn a, kha zapi leh mul bittak anei a, ngai in, hiai grep kung amah lam ah azung azam a; asuanna mun a kipan in amah lam ah hiangte apoukhia a, amah tui a avaktheihna ding in.
english: “‘“There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers. Behold, this vine bent its roots toward him, and shot out its branches toward him, from the ground where it was planted, that he might water it.

paite: Hiangte asuah a, grep hoihtak ahihtheihna ding in tui tampi gei a lei hoih aphuh ahi."
english: It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might produce branches and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a good vine.”’

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Apiching den dia hia? Avuai maimah theihna ding in anahte satkhia in, azung toh abotkhe kei dia hia? Anah sel thak tengteng in leng avuailoh ding; azung toh botkhe ding in thilhihtheihna thupitak hiam, muvanlai tampi akiphamoh tuan kei dia hia?
english: “Say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Will it prosper? Won’t he pull up its roots and cut off its fruit, that it may wither, that all its fresh springing leaves may wither? It can’t be raised from its roots by a strong arm or many people.

paite: "Ahi, ngai in, phuh hileh leng apiching den dia hia? Suahlam huih in ahon nuai hun chiang in avuai khin maimah kei dia hia? Apouna mun mah ah avuai maimah ding chi in," achi a.
english: Yes, behold, being planted, will it prosper? Won’t it utterly wither when the east wind touches it? It will wither in the ground where it grew.”’”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah:
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Helhat inkote kiang ah gen in, hiai thil omdan athei kei ua hia? Hilh in, ngai un, Babulon kumpipa Jerusalem ah ahong pai a,
english: “Say now to the rebellious house, ‘Don’t you know what these things mean?’ Tell them, ‘Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, and took its king, and its princes, and brought them to him to Babylon.

paite: akumpipa uleh aheutu uh aman a, amah kiang ah Babulon ah api a, akumpipa uh suan khat aman a, thukhun abawlpih a, thu achiam teitei a, gam a miliante apimang vek a,
english: He took one of the royal offspring, and made a covenant with him. He also brought him under an oath, and took away the mighty of the land,

paite: alalna gam akeniam a, amah a adinkhiak theih nawnlouhna ding in athukhun len kawm kia a adintheihna ding in.
english: that the kingdom might be brought low, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.

paite: Himahleh sakolte leh mi tampi hon sawl ding a ngen ding in Aigupta gam a palai sawl in atung ah ahelta hi. Alohching ding hia? Hichibang hihmi asuakta ding hia? Thukhun hihse ngal in apawtkhe thou ding hia?"
english: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will he who does such things escape? Will he break the covenant, and still escape?

paite: Kei ka hin bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi; kumpipa, kumpipa dia bawlpa tenna ngei ah akichiamnate musit leh athukhunte bohsia a, amah kiang mahmah ah Babulon ah asi ding hi.
english: “‘As I live,’ says the Lord Yahweh, ‘surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, even with him in the middle of Babylon he will die.

paite: Mi tampi hihlup ding a mual pawngte leh kulhte abawl hun chiang un leng Pharaoh sepaihhon leh pawl thupi mahmah leng bangmah ahihsak thei kei ding uh.
english: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company won’t help him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts to cut off many persons.

paite: Thukhun bohsia in kichiamna amusitta ngal ua; thu akichiam nung in hiai thil tengteng ahih nawn a, asuakta peuhmah kei ding hi.
english: For he has despised the oath by breaking the covenant; and behold, he had given his hand, and yet has done all these things. He won’t escape.

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: ka kichiamna amusit a, ka thukhun abohsia a, kei ka hin bang in, ama tung ah ka bung ngeingei ding hi.
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘As I live, I will surely bring on his own head my oath that he has despised and my covenant that he has broken.

paite: Len in ka khuh ding a, ka thang ah a-awk ding a, Babulon ah ka hon pi ding a, huchi in abohsiatna, ka tung ngei a abohsiatnate ziak in amah ka sual ding.
english: I will spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon, and will enter into judgment with him there for his trespass that he has trespassed against me.

paite: Huan apawl tengteng a taikekte tengteng namsau in asi ding ua, a-omlaite kawlmong chih ah adalh ding uh; huan kei TOUPA'N ka genta chih atheikhe ding uh.
english: All his fugitives in all his bands will fall by the sword, and those who remain will be scattered toward every wind. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken it.’

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Sidar sang mahmah dawn ke'n ka la ding a, ka phut ding; azikpi pen aziknou ka khiak ding a, tang sang kidoh ah ka phut ding.
english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘I will also take some of the lofty top of the cedar, and will plant it. I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.

paite: Israel sanna tang ah ka phut ding a, hiangte ahong sel ding ua, ahong gah ding, sidar thupitak ahi ding; anuai ah tungleng vasa chi chih ateng ding ua, ahiang liimte ah a-om ding uh.
english: I will plant it in the mountain of the height of Israel; and it will produce boughs, and bear fruit, and be a good cedar. Birds of every kind will dwell in the shade of its branches.

paite: Huan gam sing tengteng in kei TOUPA'N sing sangte ka niamsak a, sing niamte ka sangsak a, sing hingte ka keusak a, sing keute ka hingphasak a, ka chi nalai hi,” achi hi. Kei TOUPA'N ka genta a, ka gen bang in ka hih ding hi.
english: All the trees of the field will know that I, Yahweh, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree flourish. “‘I, Yahweh, have spoken and have done it.’”

paite: Ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn hi.
english: Yahweh’s word came to me again, saying,

paite: "Israel gam tungtang a hiai paunak azat uh bang chihna ahia, 'Pate'n grep thuk ane ua, atate uh ha azau hi, chih?'
english: “What do you mean, that you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge’?

paite: "Kei ka hin bang in, Israel ah hiai paunak zat nawn chih na nei kei ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: “As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “you shall not use this proverb any more in Israel.

paite: Ngai un, hinna tengteng kei a vek ahi, pa hinna kei a ahih bangmah in tapa hinna leng kei a ahi; kha khial peuhmah asi ding.
english: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine. The soul who sins, he shall die.

paite: "Himahleh mi adiktat a, siang leh dik ahih a,
english: “But if a man is just, and does that which is lawful and right,

paite: mun sangte a ne lou a, Israel inkote milim lam nga sam lou a, numei kizen lou leng naih lou a, kuamah tung a thil hihkhial lou a,
english: and has not eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hasn’t defiled his neighbor’s wife, hasn’t come near a woman in her impurity,

paite: leibami thil khamna koih pe kik zaw a, kuamah hiamgam a lok lou a, gilkial kiang a nek ding pia a, vuaktang puan silhsak a;
english: and has not wronged any, but has restored to the debtor his pledge, has taken nothing by robbery, has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;

paite: apung delh ding a leitawisak lou a, asumpung leng la sam lou a, thil gilou hih dia akhut kidek a, mi leh mi kikal a diktak a vai hawmsak a;
english: he who hasn’t lent to them with interest, hasn’t taken any increase from them, who has withdrawn his hand from iniquity, has executed true justice between man and man,

paite: ka dan bawlte zui a, diktak a hih a, ka vaihawmnate azuihleh, amah midiktat ahi a, ahing ngei ding chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: has walked in my statutes, and has kept my ordinances, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: "Himahleh ama'n tapa guktak ching asuan a, sisan suahmi ahih a, hiai bang ahih a,
english: “If he fathers a son who is a robber who sheds blood, and who does any one of these things,

paite: ahih ding zaw pen ahih louh a, mun sangte a anek zawk a, invengte zi ahihbuah a,
english: or who does not do any of those things but has eaten at the mountain shrines and defiled his neighbor’s wife,

paite: genthei leh tasamte asimmoh a, aloh a, akhamna koih apiak louh a, milimte lam nga, thilkihhuai ahih hi.
english: has wronged the poor and needy, has taken by robbery, has not restored the pledge, and has lifted up his eyes to the idols, has committed abomination,

paite: Apung delh a apiak a, apung alakleh, ahing ding hia? Ahing het kei ding; hiai thilkihhuai tengteng ahihta a, asi ngeingei ding, amah sisan moh ama tung ah atu ding ahi.
english: has lent with interest, and has taken increase from the poor, shall he then live? He shall not live. He has done all these abominations. He shall surely die. His blood will be on him.

paite: "Huan ngai in, tapa na nei tei taleh, apa thil gilou hihsa tengteng amuh a, lau a,
english: “Now, behold, if he fathers a son who sees all his father’s sins which he has done, and fears, and doesn’t do likewise,

paite: huchibang ahih teitei louh a, mun sang a anek louh a, Israel inkote milim lamte angat louh a, invengte zi ahihnit louh a,
english: who hasn’t eaten on the mountains, hasn’t lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hasn’t defiled his neighbor’s wife,

paite: kuamah tung a thil ahihkhelh louh a, khamna koih bangmah la lou a, kuamah lok lou a, gilkialte nek ding pe zaw a, savuakte asilhsak a;
english: hasn’t wronged any, hasn’t taken anything to pledge, hasn’t taken by robbery, but has given his bread to the hungry, and has covered the naked with a garment;

paite: genthei lak a akhut akideksak a, anou leh apung la lou a, ka thupiakte zang a ka dan bawlte zuimi ahihleh, apa thulimlouhna ziak in asi kei ding a, ahing zaw ngei ding hi.
english: who has withdrawn his hand from the poor, who hasn’t received interest or increase, has executed my ordinances, has walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father. He shall surely live.

paite: Apa bel kheltak a mi nuaisiah a, a-unaupa hiamgamtak a sual a, amite lak a thil hoih lou ahih ziak in, ngai in, athulimlouhna ziak in asi ding ahi.
english: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, robbed his brother, and did that which is not good among his people, behold, he will die in his iniquity.

paite: "Himahleh, bangziak a tapa in apa thulimlouhna thuak lou ding, na chi nak uh? Tapa in dan azuih a thil kizen ahih a, ka dan bawl tengteng azuih a, ahih laileh, ahing ngeingei ding hi.
english: “Yet you say, ‘Why doesn’t the son bear the iniquity of the father?’ When the son has done that which is lawful and right, and has kept all my statutes, and has done them, he will surely live.

paite: Kha khial asi ding; tapa in apa thulimlouhna athuak kei ding a, pa in leng tapa thulimlouhna athuak sam kei ding; midiktat diktatna amah mah tung ah a-om ding, migilou gitlouhna amah mah tung ah a-om ding hi.
english: The soul who sins, he shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be on him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be on him.

paite: "Himahleh, migilou in akhelhna hih tengteng alehngatsan a, ka dan bawlte azuih a, dan zui a thil diktat ahihleh ahing ngei ding a, asi kei ding.
english: “But if the wicked turns from all his sins that he has committed, and keeps all my statutes, and does that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live. He shall not die.

paite: Tatlekna a na hihsa theihsak ahita kei ding; ana hihsa adiktatna ah ahing ding,
english: None of his transgressions that he has committed will be remembered against him. In his righteousness that he has done, he shall live.

paite: Migilou sihna ah kipahna ka nei a hia? Alampite alehngatsan a, ahong hin ding chih louh ngal? chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked?” says the Lord Yahweh, “and not rather that he should return from his way, and live?

paite: "Himahleh midiktat in adiktatna lampi alehngatsan a, thulimlouhna ahih a, migiloute hih bang zel a thilkihhuaite ahih in ahing dia hia? Athil diktat hihsa bangpeuh leng theihgige ahi nawnta kei ding a, atatlekna hih ah leh akhelhna hih ah, huai mahmah ah asi ding hi.
english: “But when the righteous turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does, should he live? None of his righteous deeds that he has done will be remembered. In his trespass that he has trespassed, and in his sin that he has sinned, in them he shall die.

paite: "Hinapi in, TOUPA hihdan akibang gige kei hi, na chi sek uh. Israel inkote aw, ngai un; ka hihdan akibang gige kei maw? Na hihdan uh akibang kei gige zaw ahi kei maw?
english: “Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not equal.’ Hear now, house of Israel: Is my way not equal? Aren’t your ways unequal?

paite: Midiktat in adiktatnate alehngatsan a, thulimlouhnate ahihleh huai ah asi ding a, thulimlouhna ahih ah asi ding.
english: When the righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and dies in it, then he dies in his iniquity that he has done.

paite: Huai lou leng, migilou in akhelhna ahihsate lehngatsan a, dan azuih a, thil diktat ahihleh ahinna ahumbit ding.
english: Again, when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and does that which is lawful and right, he will save his soul alive.

paite: Akingaihtuah a, atatlekna a hihsa tengteng alehngatsan ziak in ahing ngei ding, asi kei ding hi.
english: Because he considers, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live. He shall not die.

paite: Hinapi in Israel inkote'n, TOUPA hihdan akibang gige kei, achi uhi. Aw Israel inkote aw, ka hihdante kibang gige ahi zaw kei maw?
english: Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’ House of Israel, aren’t my ways fair? Aren’t your ways unfair?

paite: "Huaiziak in aw Israel inkote aw, michih, noumau hihdan bang zel in vai ka hon hawmsak ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi. Kihei unla, na tatlekna tengtengte uh lehngatsan un; huchi in thulimlouhna na puksiatna uh ahi kei ding hi.
english: “Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Return, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions, so iniquity will not be your ruin.

paite: Na tatlekna tengteng uh, na tatleksate uh paimang vek unla, lungtang thak leh lungsim thak kibawl un! Israel inkote aw, bangziak a si ding na hi ua?
english: Cast away from you all your transgressions in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new spirit. For why will you die, house of Israel?

paite: Mi sihna ah kipahna mahmah ka nei kei, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi; huaiziak in kihei unla, hing un."
english: For I have no pleasure in the death of him who dies,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Therefore turn yourselves, and live!

paite: Huai lou in leng Israel heutute tungtang ah suunna la phuah ahi;
english: “Moreover, take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,

paite: Na nu bang ahia ahih? Humpinelkaipi ahi! Humpinelkaite lak ah akual a, humpinelkai lunlaite lak ah anoute avaklian hi.
english: and say, ‘What was your mother? A lioness. She couched among lions, in the middle of the young lions she nourished her cubs.

paite: Huan anoute lak ah khat avaktei a; humpinelkai lun lai ahong hi; samat asiam a, mite anegai hi.
english: She brought up one of her cubs. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.

paite: Namte'n leng atanchin aza ua; akokhuk uah mat in a-om; huan Aigupta gam ah sikkawi in amah api uh.
english: The nations also heard of him. He was taken in their pit; and they brought him with hooks to the land of Egypt.

paite: Huchi in angak a, alametna avuaksuak chih atheih in, anoute lak ah khat ala a, humpinelkai lun lai in abawl hi.
english: “‘Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her cubs, and made him a young lion.

paite: Humpinelkai lak ah apaisuk paitou a, humpinelkai lun lai ahong hi a; samat asiam a, mite anegai hi.
english: He went up and down among the lions. He became a young lion. He learned to catch the prey. He devoured men.

paite: Ama'n a-inpi kisesate uh athei a, akhopite uh ahihgawp a, gam asegawp a, ahumham husa ziak in, huai a tengteng.
english: He knew their palaces, and laid waste their cities. The land was desolate with its fullness, because of the noise of his roaring.

paite: Huchi in bialte a kipan in ning chih a namte'n amah adou ua; atung ah alen uh azak ua; akokhuk uah mat in a-omta hi.
english: Then the nations attacked him on every side from the provinces. They spread their net over him. He was taken in their pit.

paite: Sikkawite in bawm sung ah akoih ua; Babulon kumpipa kiang ah api ua; kulh muanhuaite sung ah apilut uh; huchi a Israel tang sangte tung a aw akizak nawnlouhna ding in.
english: They put him in a cage with hooks, and brought him to the king of Babylon. They brought him into strongholds, so that his voice should no more be heard on the mountains of Israel.

paite: Na nu na sisan a grepgui bang ahi, tuite kiang a suan; tui tampite ziak in gahpha leh hiangte in adim.
english: “‘Your mother was like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters. It was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.

paite: Huan vaihawmna pote lalchiang sikchiang khauh a nei in, nah bawkpha lak ah asandan uh hihsang in a-om hi, huchi in ahiang tampite uh toh sangpi amuh in a-om uhi.
english: It had strong branches for the scepters of those who ruled. Their stature was exalted among the thick boughs. They were seen in their height with the multitude of their branches.

paite: Himahleh thangpaihna a bohkhiak in a-om a, lei ah paihkhiak in a-om a, suahlam huih in agah amutkeu a; akung khauhte kitan in akeu a; mei in amaute akang beita.
english: But it was plucked up in fury. It was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up its fruit. Its strong branches were broken off and withered. The fire consumed them.

paite: Huan tu in gamdai ah, gamkeu leh tui om lou ah phuh in a-om.
english: Now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.

paite: Huchi in ahiang a sikchiang a pan mei apaikhia, agah ahulbei a, huchi in amah ah vaihawm ding in lalchiang ding sikchiang khauh a-om kei hi. Hiai kahla ahi, kahla a dia sak ahi ding hi.
english: Fire has gone out of its branches. It has devoured its fruit, so that there is in it no strong branch to be a scepter to rule.’ This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.”

paite: Huan ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, na khe in dingh in, na kiang ah thu ka gen ding hi," achi hi.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak with you.”

paite: Ka kiang a thu agen lai in kei ah kha ahong lut a, ka khe in ahon dingsak a, huchi in kei hon houpihpa ka ngaikhia hi.
english: The Spirit entered into me when he spoke to me, and set me on my feet; and I heard him who spoke to me.

paite: Ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, Israel suante kiang ah, helhat nam, ka tung a helnakte kiang ah ka hon sawl hi; amau leh apipute leng hiai ni pha nangawn in ka tung ah atalek uhi."
english: He said to me, “Son of man, I send you to the children of Israel, to a nation of rebels who have rebelled against me. They and their fathers have transgressed against me even to this very day.

paite: Suan lungkhauh leh genhakte ahi ua, akiang uah nang ka hon sawl hi; akiang uah, "Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi," na chi ding ahi.
english: The children are impudent and stiff-hearted. I am sending you to them, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says.’

paite: Huchi in amau angaikhia uhiam, angaikhe kei uhiam, (amaute lah helhat inkuan ahi ngal ua), alak uah zawlnei a-om chih atheigige ding uhi.
english: They, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse—for they are a rebellious house—yet they will know that there has been a prophet among them.

paite: "Nang, mihing tapa, amaute kihta ke'nla, athu uah leng lunglel sam ke'n, na kiang ah khaulingnei leh louling neite om in, aikam lak a teng himah lechin; helhatmi himah le uh, athu uh kihta ke'nla, alatdan uah leng lunglel sam ke'n.
english: You, son of man, don’t be afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with you, and you dwell among scorpions. Don’t be afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.

paite: Angaikhia uhiam, angaikhe kei uhiam, akiang uah ka thu na gen ding ahi; amaute lah helhat inkuan ahi ngal ua.
english: You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.

paite: "Himahleh nang mihing tapa, na kiang a ka gen ngaikhia in; mihelhat inkuan bang in helhat ke'nla; na kam ka inla, ka hon piak ne in," achi hi.
english: But you, son of man, hear what I tell you. Don’t be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth, and eat that which I give you.”

paite: Huan ka en a ngai in, khut in ahon sawk a, ngai in huai ah laibuzial a-om hi.
english: When I looked, behold, a hand was stretched out to me; and behold, a scroll of a book was in it.

paite: Ka ma ah aphalh a, asunglam leh apolam gelh ahi a; huai ah kahna, lusuunna leh unggikna gelhna a-om hi.
english: He spread it before me. It was written within and without; and lamentations, mourning, and woe were written in it.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akum sagihna, akha ngana, huai kha ani sawm ni in Israel Upa kuate hiam TOUPA thu dong ding in ahong pai ua, ka ma ah atu uhi.
english: In the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of Yahweh, and sat before me.

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a: ka kiang ah,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israel upate houpih inla, akiang uah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Kei thudong dia hong pai na hi uh hia? Kei ka hin bang in, noute thudot in ka om kei ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," chi in.
english: “Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Is it to inquire of me that you have come? As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I will not be inquired of by you.”’

paite: Amaute vai na hawmsak ding hia, mihing tapa, amaute vai na hawmsak ding hia? Apate uh kihhuainate thei uh hen.
english: “Will you judge them, son of man? Will you judge them? Cause them to know the abominations of their fathers.

paite: Huan akiang uah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Israelte ka tel ni a Jakob inkote telte kiang ah ban zak hial a Aigupta gam a akiang ua ka kitheihsak a, akiang ua ka khut ka zak a, Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, ka chih.
english: Tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In the day when I chose Israel, and swore to the offspring of the house of Jacob, and made myself known to them in the land of Egypt, when I swore to them, saying, ‘I am Yahweh your God;’

paite: Huai ni a Aigupta gam a kipan pikhia a, amah a dia gam kham, nawitui leh khuaizu a luang gam, gam tengteng a kilawmpen a pilut ding a ka khut ka zak ni in akiang uah:
english: in that day I swore to them to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands.

paite: Michih in na mit ua muh thilkihhuai paimang unla, Aigupta gam a milimte in kihihnin kei un, kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chi in ka gen hi.
english: I said to them, ‘Each of you throw away the abominations of his eyes. Don’t defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.’

paite: Himahleh, ka tung ah ahel ua, hon limsak kei ua, michih in amit ua muh thilkihhuaite leng apaimang kei ua, Aigupta milimte leng alehngatsan sam kei uh. Huai ah atung ua ka hehna lungdamsak ding in Aigupta gamsung ngei ah atung uah ka hehna ka leihbo kei na diam, ka chi hi.
english: “‘“But they rebelled against me and wouldn’t listen to me. They didn’t all throw away the abominations of their eyes. They also didn’t forsake the idols of Egypt. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them, to accomplish my anger against them in the middle of the land of Egypt.

paite: Himahleh, keimah min ziak in ka gamtang zawta a, a-omna namte uh mitmuh in Aigupta gam a kipan pikhia in akiang uah ka kitheisakta; huai namte mitmuh a ka min gensiat a a-omlouhna ding in.
english: But I worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations among which they were, in whose sight I made myself known to them in bringing them out of the land of Egypt.

paite: Huchi in Aigupta gam pawtsan ding in ka chita a, gamdai ah ka hon pilut hi.
english: So I caused them to go out of the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.

paite: Ka dan bawlte amaute ka pia a, ka dan thukhunte ka ensak a, huai tuh mi'n azuih ua ahinna ding un.
english: I gave them my statutes and showed them my ordinances, which if a man does, he will live in them.

paite: Huai lou leng kei leh amaute kikal achiamtehna ding in ka Sabbathte amau ka pia a, kei TOUPA, amaute koihtuampa ka hi chih atheihtheihna ding un.
english: Moreover also I gave them my Sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.

paite: Himahleh Israel inkote gamdai ah ka tung ah ahel ua, ka dan bawlte azui kei ua, ka thugelte, mi'n ahih a ahinna ding tak uh apaikhia ua, nakpitak in ka Sabbath abohsia ua; huchi in gamdai ah amaute hihmang ding in atung uah ka hehna ka leih kei na diam aw, ka chi hi.
english: “‘“But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. They didn’t walk in my statutes and they rejected my ordinances, which if a man keeps, he shall live in them. They greatly profaned my Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them in the wilderness, to consume them.

paite: Ka pikhiak lai in athei mite nam mahmah mitmuh a hihsiat a a-omlouhna ding un ka min ziak in ka gamtang zawta hi.
english: But I worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.

paite: Huai lou in huai gamdai ah ka gam piak, nawitui leh khuaizu a luang gam, gam tengteng a kilawmpen ah ka pilut kei ding, ban zak hial in ka chi hi.
english: Moreover also I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands,

paite: Ka thugelhte apaikhia ua, ka dan bawlte azui kei ua, ka Sabbathte abohsiat ziak un; alungtang un amilimte uh azui uhi.
english: because they rejected my ordinances, and didn’t walk in my statutes, and profaned my Sabbaths; for their heart went after their idols.

paite: Himahleh hihmang lou ding in ka mit in amuh maihta a, gam ah leng ka hihmang vekta kei hi.
english: Nevertheless my eye spared them, and I didn’t destroy them. I didn’t make a full end of them in the wilderness.

paite: Huan gamdai ah atate uh kiang ah: Na pipute uh dan bawl zui kei unla, athugelte uh zui kei unla, amilimte un kihihnin sam kei un;
english: I said to their children in the wilderness, ‘Don’t walk in the statutes of your fathers. Don’t observe their ordinances or defile yourselves with their idols.

paite: Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, ka dan bawlte zui unla, ka thugelte vom unla, zui un.
english: I am Yahweh your God. Walk in my statutes, keep my ordinances, and do them.

paite: Ka Sabbath tang unla, kei leh noute kikal a chiamtehna ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi chih na theihna ding un, ka chi hi.
english: Make my Sabbaths holy. They shall be a sign between me and you, that you may know that I am Yahweh your God.’

paite: Himahleh atate uh ka tung ah ahel ua, ka dan thukhunte azui kei ua, ka thugelte, mi'n ahih a ahinna ding tak, zui ding in avom sam kei uh. Sabbath ni abohseta ua; gamdai ah ka hehna lungdamsak ding in atung uah ka hehna ka leih kei na hiam, ka chi hi.
english: “‘“But the children rebelled against me. They didn’t walk in my statutes, and didn’t keep my ordinances to do them, which if a man does, he shall live in them. They profaned my Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.

paite: Himahleh ka khut ka kideksak a, ka pikhiak lai athei mite nam ngei mitmuh a hihsiat a a-omlouhna ding un ka min ziak in ka gamtang zawta ahi.
english: Nevertheless I withdrew my hand and worked for my name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I brought them out.

paite: Huai lou leng, namte lak ah amau ka dalhsak ding a, gam chih ah ka thelthangsak ding, gamdai ah ban zak hial in ka na chi hi.
english: Moreover I swore to them in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them through the countries,

paite: Ka thugelte zui lou a, ka dan bawlte paikhia a, ka Sabbath ni bohsia a, apipute uh milim lam angat ziak un.
english: because they had not executed my ordinances, but had rejected my statutes, and had profaned my Sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers’ idols.

paite: Huai lou leng, dan bawlhoih lou ka pia a, ahinlouhna ding ua thugelte toh;
english: Moreover also I gave them statutes that were not good, and ordinances in which they couldn’t live.

paite: athiltan uh, sul hong tengtengte'n mei a apaihna uah amaute ka hihnin a, ka lungzuangsak a, atawp a TOUPA ka hi chih atheihna ding un.
english: I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused all that opens the womb to pass through the fire, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am Yahweh.”’

paite: Huaiziak in mihing tapa, akiang uah thu gen inla, akiang uah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: “Na pate un hiaite ah ahon gense lailai uhi, ka tung a tatlekna thil ahihte uah.
english: “Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Moreover, in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.

paite: Ban zak hial a amaute ka chiam gam ah ka hon pilut in, mual sang leh singbuk lian amuh peuhmah uah akithoihnate uh alan ua, athillat uh hehhuai mahmahte apia uh. Agimlimte uh abawl ua, adawn ding thillatte uh abungkhia uh," chi in.
english: For when I had brought them into the land which I swore to give to them, then they saw every high hill and every thick tree, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering. There they also made their pleasant aroma, and there they poured out their drink offerings.

paite: Huchi in ke'n akiang uah, mun sang a na hoh nak uh bang na chihna uh ahia? ka chi a; huchi in amin a ding in tuni tan in, Bamah, chih ahita hi.
english: Then I said to them, ‘What does the high place where you go mean?’ So its name is called Bamah to this day.”’

paite: Huchi in Israel inkote kiang ah gen inla, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Na pipute uh bang zel in noumau na kihihnin un akihhuaina bang un hupmang na hi ding uh maw?
english: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Do you pollute yourselves in the way of your fathers? Do you play the prostitute after their abominations?

paite: Na thil tan uh na lan un, na tate uh mei ah na pai ua, tuni tan in na milimte tengteng un na kihihnin uh ahi kei maw? Noute thudot ding ka hi a hia, aw Israel inkote aw? Kei ka hin bang in noute thudot in ka om kei ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: When you offer your gifts, when you make your sons pass through the fire, do you pollute yourselves with all your idols to this day? Should I be inquired of by you, house of Israel? As I live, says the Lord Yahweh, I will not be inquired of by you!

paite: I kim ua namdang pau tuam mite bang a singbul suangbul be ding i hi uh, na lungsim ua na chih uh, atangtung himhim kei ding.
english: “‘“That which comes into your mind will not be at all, in that you say, ‘We will be as the nations, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.’

paite: Kei ka hin bang in, khut thagui hattak in, ban zak kawm leh heh suah in na tung uah vai ka hawm ngeingei ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “surely with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out, I will be king over you.

paite: Namte lak a kipan ka hon pikhe ding a, dalhsak a na omna gam ua kipan khut hattak leh ban zak leh heh suah in ka hon pikhawm ding.
english: I will bring you out from the peoples, and will gather you out of the countries in which you are scattered with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out.

paite: Pau tuam mite gamdai gam ah ka hon pilut ding a, kimaituah in i kisual ding uh.
english: I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there I will enter into judgment with you face to face.

paite: Aigupta gam gamdai a na pipute uh ka sual bangtak in nou leng ka hon sual ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Chiang nuai ah ka hon lutsak ding a, thukhun delhkhumna nuai ah ka hon pilut ding hi;
english: “I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.

paite: Huan na lak ua kipan mihelte leh ka tung a talek mite ka khuahsiang ding a, a-omna gam ua kipan in ka pikhe ding a, himahleh Israel gam ah alut het kei ding uh; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
english: I will purge out from among you the rebels and those who disobey me. I will bring them out of the land where they live, but they shall not enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”

paite: Noute ahihleh, Aw Israel inkote aw, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ka thu na ngaihkhiak kei uleh tunung chiang in na milim nna uh sem chiat maita unla; himahleh ka min siangthou bel na thilpiakte uleh na milimte un na hihninta kei ding uhi.
english: “‘As for you, house of Israel, the Lord Yahweh says: “Go, everyone serve his idols, and hereafter also, if you will not listen to me; but you shall no more profane my holy name with your gifts and with your idols.

paite: Ka tang siangthou, Israel sanna tang ah, huai ah Israel inkote tengteng in avek un, huai gam ah ka nna asem ding uh; huai ah amaute ka paktata dia, huai ah na thillatte uh na thilpiak hoih tatate uh, na thil tan tengteng uh ka deihta ding.
english: For in my holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel,” says the Lord Yahweh, “there all the house of Israel, all of them, shall serve me in the land. There I will accept them, and there I will require your offerings and the first fruits of your offerings, with all your holy things.

paite: Namte lak a kipan ka hon lakkhiak hun chiang in leh gam chih a na dalhna ua kipan ka hon pikhawm hun chiang in, gimlim ding in noute ka hon sangta ding a, namte mitmuh in noute ah ka sianthoudan alangta ding, Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi.
english: I will accept you as a pleasant aroma when I bring you out from the peoples and gather you out of the countries in which you have been scattered. I will be sanctified in you in the sight of the nations.

paite: Huan Israel gam, ban zak hial a na pipute uh piak ka chiam gam a noute ka hon pilut hun chiang in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
english: You will know that I am Yahweh when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the country which I swore to give to your fathers.

paite: Huan huai ah na omdante uleh na thilhih uh, na kihihnitna tengteng uh na theita ding uh; huchi in na thil hoih lou hih tengtengte uh ziak in noute mitmuh ngei in na kihta ding uhi.
english: There you will remember your ways, and all your deeds in which you have polluted yourselves. Then you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that you have committed.

paite: Na omdan hoihloute uh bang hilou a, na thilhih uh thulimloute bang leng hi sam lou a, ka min ziak a noute ka hon pichinsak hun chiang in, aw Israel inkote aw, TOUPA ka hi chih na theita ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in.
english: You will know that I am Yahweh, when I have dealt with you for my name’s sake, not according to your evil ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, you house of Israel,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, simlam masuan inla, simlam nga in na thu khah inla, simlam gammangpi lam ah thu gen inla,
english: “Son of man, set your face toward the south, and preach toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the field in the south.

paite: simlam gammangpi kiang ah, TOUPA thu ngai in, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai in, nang ah mei ka toh ding a, nang ah sing hing tengteng akangbei ding a, sing keu peuhmah leng; meikuang luahluah adai kei ding, sim a kipan mal tanpha in, matuah teng akangvom ding hi.
english: Tell the forest of the south, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word: The Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I will kindle a fire in you, and it will devour every green tree in you, and every dry tree. The burning flame will not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north will be burned by it.

paite: Huan mi tengteng in kei TOUPA meikhahpa ka hi chih amu ding ua, amit kei ding, chi in," achi hi.
english: All flesh will see that I, Yahweh, have kindled it. It will not be quenched.”’”

paite: Huchi in ke'n, "Ah! Toupa PATHIAN, gentehna thugenmi lel ahi kei maw? ahon chi ding uh," ka chi hi.
english: Then I said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! They say of me, ‘Isn’t he a speaker of parables?’”

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a: ka kianh ah,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Jerusalem maituah inla, amun siangthou lam nga in na thu gen inla, Israel gam tung ah thu gen in;
english: “Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, and preach toward the sanctuaries, and prophesy against the land of Israel.

paite: Israel gam kiang ah, huchi in TOUPA'N achi hi: Ngai in, ka hon dou ahi, ka namsau apai a kipan ka phawi ding a, na lak ua midiktat leh diktat lou kibang sap in ka phuk ding.
english: Tell the land of Israel, ‘Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, and will draw my sword out of its sheath, and will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.

paite: Huchi in na lak ua midiktat leh diktat lou ka phuk ding ziak in ka namsau apai a kipan apawt ding a, simlam a kipan mallam pha in mihing tengteng aphuk ding hi.
english: Seeing then that I will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked, therefore my sword will go out of its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north.

paite: Huchi in mi tengteng in, kei TOUPA'N ka namsau apai a kipan ka phawi ahi chih athei ding uh, akikhum ngei nawnta kei ding hi."
english: All flesh will know that I, Yahweh, have drawn my sword out of its sheath. It will not return any more.”’

paite: Huaiziak in nang mihing tapa, thum huthut inla khasetak in amitmuh un thum in.
english: “Therefore sigh, you son of man. You shall sigh before their eyes with a broken heart and with bitterness.

paite: Huan "Bangziak a thum na hia?" ahon chih uleh, "Thuthang ziak in ahi, ahong tung sin ngal a, huai hun in lungtang chiteng azul ding a, khut tengteng azaw ding a, lungsim teng abah ding a, khuk tengteng tui bang in azaw ding a; ngai in, ahong tung hi, atangtun ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in," achi hi.
english: It shall be, when they ask you, ‘Why do you sigh?’ that you shall say, ‘Because of the news, for it comes! Every heart will melt, all hands will be feeble, every spirit will faint, and all knees will be weak as water. Behold, it comes, and it shall be done, says the Lord Yahweh.’”

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a: ka kiang ah,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: Mihing tapa, thu gen inla, huchi in TOUPA'N achi hi:
english: “Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘Yahweh says: “A sword! A sword! It is sharpened, and also polished.

paite: "Namsau, namsau tat-hiam ahita, tetsak ahita, mi satna ding a tat-hiam ahita, tetsak ahi, khophia bang in! I nuamsa lailai ding maw? ka tapa, chiang na simmoh, sing a bawl peuhmah toh,
english: It is sharpened that it may make a slaughter. It is polished that it may be as lightning. Should we then make mirth? The rod of my son condemns every tree.

paite: tetsak ahi, khut a let ding in ahi namsau tat-hiam tetsak ahi, thatmi khut a tuang ding in.
english: It is given to be polished, that it may be handled. The sword is sharpened. Yes, it is polished to give it into the hand of the killer.”’

paite: Mihing tapa, kikou inla; sehal ham in, ka mite tung ahi ngal a; Israel miliante teng tung mahmah; piak ahi ua, ka mite toh, namsau nuai ah; huaiziak in kikou inla, na pheipi beng in.
english: Cry and wail, son of man; for it is on my people. It is on all the princes of Israel. They are delivered over to the sword with my people. Therefore beat your thigh.

paite: Hiai namsau midang tung a chiamtehsa ahi ngal a, na ngaihsak kei hitaleh bang suak ding chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi hi."
english: “For there is a trial. What if even the rod that condemns will be no more?” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: "Huaiziak in nang, mihing tapa, khut beng hial in thu gen in; thah a om dingte a ding namsau nihvei liksuk in om hen, ahi, thumvei; tampi thahna ding namsau ahi.
english: “You therefore, son of man, prophesy, and strike your hands together. Let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the fatally wounded. It is the sword of the great one who is fatally wounded, which enters into their rooms.

paite: Lungtang zul, apukna uh apunna ding in, namsaute kongbiang teng ah ka giaksak hi; Ah! Khophia bang in ate zolzol, sihna namsau.
english: I have set the threatening sword against all their gates, that their heart may melt, and their stumblings be multiplied. Ah! It is made as lightning. It is pointed for slaughter.

paite: Nakpi'n gamtang in, taklam ah, gamtang in veilam ah leng van zel inla, na mazawn peuhmah ah leng.
english: Gather yourselves together. Go to the right. Set yourselves in array. Go to the left, wherever your face is set.

paite: Ke'n leng khut ka beng ding a, ka tangtun ngei ding, ka hehna, kei TOUPA'N hiai ka genta hi, chi in,” achi hi.
english: I will also strike my hands together, and I will cause my wrath to rest. I, Yahweh, have spoken it.”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me again, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Babulon kumpipa namsau hong tuntheihna ding in lampi nih na bawl in; huai lampi nihte gam khat a kipan in ahong pawtkhe ding uh ahi; lampi kawkmuhna bawl inla, kho pilut na khomual ah bawl in.
english: “Also, you son of man, appoint two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come. They both will come out of one land, and mark out a place. Mark it out at the head of the way to the city.

paite: Ammon mite khua Rabbah a namsau ahong tuntheihna ding in lampi sep inla, Judah gam lai Jerusalem kulh ah leng.
english: You shall appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the fortified.

paite: Ai san ding in Babulon kumpipa lampi ka ah adingh a, lampi nih kigawmna tak ah; thalte asing loklok a terephim adong a, sa sin a-en hi.
english: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination. He shook the arrows back and forth. He consulted the teraphim. He looked in the liver.

paite: A-aisanna ah akhut taklam ah Jerusalem ana tuang a, kulh suksiatnate galsual awng zuazuate, kongpi zawn a kulh suksiatnate, mual pawngsunte, kulh bawlte toh.
english: In his right hand was the lot for Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to cast up mounds, and to build forts.

paite: Aisan vuaksuak lel bang ahi a, himahleh mat a a-omna ding ua athulimlouhna uh theihkhiakna lel ding ahi."
english: It will be to them as a false divination in their sight, who have sworn oaths to them; but he brings iniquity to memory, that they may be taken.

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Theihgigena ding a na thulimlouhna uh na bawl ziak un na tatleknate uh ahong kilang, na thilhih tengteng uah na khelhnate uh akimu kilkel a, theihkhiak na hong hih tak ziak un khut a mat na hong hi ding uhi.
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you have caused your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are uncovered, so that in all your doings your sins appear; because you have come to memory, you will be taken with the hand.

paite: Huan nang, Israel heutu, migilou si ding a liampa, na gitlouhna gawtna tawp ni ahong tung e;
english: “‘You, deadly wounded wicked one, the prince of Israel, whose day has come, in the time of the iniquity of the end,

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Heutu lukhu paihsak unla, lallukhu suhsak un, hiai angei in a-om kei ding; mivuallelte tawisang unla, miliante vuallelsak un.
english: the Lord Yahweh says: “Remove the turban, and take off the crown. This will not be as it was. Exalt that which is low, and humble that which is high.

paite: Ka lumlet ding, ka lumlet ding, ka lumlet ding; hiai leng angei in a-om kei ding, aneimi diktak ahong pai mateng amah ka pe ding hi."
english: I will overturn, overturn, overturn it. This also will be no more, until he comes whose right it is; and I will give it.”’

paite: Huan nang mihing tapa, thu gen inla, hichi in chi in; Toupa PATHIAN in Ammon tate tungtang ah leh agensiatna thu uah hichi in achi: "Namsau, namsau phawi ahita, mithahna ding leh hihmanna ding khophia bang a tetsak ahita.
english: “You, son of man, prophesy and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says this concerning the children of Ammon, and concerning their reproach: “A sword! A sword is drawn! It is polished for the slaughter, to cause it to devour, that it may be as lightning;

paite: "Kilakna taklou nang ahon musak ua, zuau in ai ahon sansak ua, namsau bel migilou si ding a liam, agitlouhna ni uh tawp hong tung dingte ngawng ah na golh ding, ahon chih un azuau uh ahi.
english: while they see for you false visions, while they divine lies to you, to lay you on the necks of the wicked who are deadly wounded, whose day has come in the time of the iniquity of the end.

paite: Apai ah thun in. Na pianna siam a na omna gam ngei ah na thu ka ngaihtuah ding.
english: Cause it to return into its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your birth, I will judge you.

paite: Na tung ah ka hehna ka sung dia, ka thangpaihna mei na tung ah ka toh ding, minunsetak, hihman siamtak khut ah ka hon mansak ding.
english: I will pour out my indignation on you. I will blow on you with the fire of my wrath. I will deliver you into the hand of brutish men, skillful to destroy.

paite: Mei a khul ding na hi ding a, gam lai ah na sisan abo ding a, theih mahmah na hita kei ding, kei TOUPA'N ka genta ngal a, chi in," achi hi.
english: You will be for fuel to the fire. Your blood will be in the middle of the land. You will be remembered no more; for I, Yahweh, have spoken it.”’”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah,
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Nang mihing tapa, sisan suah hat khopi na vaihawmkhum ding hia? Na vaihawmkhum ding hia? Akihhuaina tengteng theisak dih ve.
english: “You, son of man, will you judge? Will you judge the bloody city? Then cause her to know all her abominations.
