paite: Huan akiang uah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Khopi, ahun hong tunna ding a amah sung a sisan suah leh amah kihihnin ding a milim bawl!
english: You shall say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “A city that sheds blood within herself, that her time may come, and that makes idols against herself to defile her!

paite: Na sisan suahna ah mohna na pua a, na milim bawl ah na kihihnin ahi; na hunte na naisak a, na kumte na tung phialphial a; huaiziak in namte kiang ah gensiat ding leh gam tengteng engbawl ding in ka hon bawl ahi.
english: You have become guilty in your blood that you have shed, and are defiled in your idols which you have made! You have caused your days to draw near, and have come to the end of your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations, and a mocking to all the countries.

paite: Nang naih a om mite leh gamla a om mite'n ahon simmoh ding ua, nang, minsiat pua leh buaina a dimmi;
english: Those who are near and those who are far from you will mock you, you infamous one, full of tumult.

paite: Ngai in, Israel heutute michih in athilhihtheihna bang zel ua sisan suah mai ding in nangmah ah a-om uhi.
english: “‘“Behold, the princes of Israel, everyone according to his power, have been in you to shed blood.

paite: Nang ah mi'n nu leh pate amusit ua, nang ah mikhualte anuaisiah ua, nang ah tagahte leh meithaite amawkbawl uh.
english: In you have they treated father and mother with contempt. Among you they have oppressed the foreigner. In you they have wronged the fatherless and the widow.

paite: Ka thiltante na musit a, ka Sabbathte na bohsia hi.
english: You have despised my holy things, and have profaned my Sabbaths.

paite: Nang ah sisan suah ding in mi hekhatte a-om ua, nang ah tang sang a nete a-om ua, nang ah hukna aching uh.
english: Slanderous men have been in you to shed blood. In you they have eaten on the mountains. They have committed lewdness among you.

paite: Nang ah apate uh vuaktanna lemsak a-om ua, nang ah numei kizen louh lai kithuahpih a-om uh.
english: In you have they uncovered their fathers’ nakedness. In you have they humbled her who was unclean in her impurity.

paite: Huan mi'n a-inveng' zi tung ah thilkihhuai ahih a, midang in huktak in amou ahihnin a, midang in nang ah asanggamnu, apa tanu ngei azahlaksak hi.
english: One has committed abomination with his neighbor’s wife, and another has lewdly defiled his daughter-in-law. Another in you has humbled his sister, his father’s daughter.

paite: Nang ah sisan suah ding in golhna ala ua, anou leh apung na la a; na inveng nuaisiah in huaihamtak in na lepguksak hi; kei mahmah leng na hon mangngilh a," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: In you have they taken bribes to shed blood. You have taken interest and increase, and you have greedily gained of your neighbors by oppression, and have forgotten me,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: "Huaiziak in ngai in, na lepgukna thu ah, nang a sisan pawt thu ah khut ka hon betkhum ding.
english: “‘“Behold, therefore I have struck my hand at your dishonest gain which you have made, and at the blood which has been shed within you.

paite: Nang ka hon sual ni chiang in na lungtang in athuakzou in na khut ahat thei diam maw? Kei ToUPA ngei in ka genta a, ka hih lai ding.
english: Can your heart endure, or can your hands be strong, in the days that I will deal with you? I, Yahweh, have spoken it, and will do it.

paite: Huan namte lak ah ka hon hihdalh ding a, gam chih ah ka hon thehzak ding; nang a kipan in na nitnate ka hihmang vek ding.
english: I will scatter you among the nations, and disperse you through the countries. I will purge your filthiness out of you.

paite: Namte mitmuh in nangmah kihihnin na hi ding, huan, TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding, chi in," achi hi.
english: You will be profaned in yourself in the sight of the nations. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”’”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israel inkote ei a ding in eksia lel ahong hita ua; avek un haltuina mei lai ah dalte, langvate, sikte, suante ahi ua, dangkasik eksia lel ahita uh.
english: “Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to me. All of them are bronze, tin, iron, and lead in the middle of the furnace. They are the dross of silver.

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Eksia lel na hong hih ziak un, ngai un, Jerusalem lai ah ka hon khawm ahi.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you have all become dross, therefore, behold, I will gather you into the middle of Jerusalem.

paite: Dangkasikte, dalte, sikte, suante, langvate haltuina mei a akoihkhawm ua, tuisak ding a atung a mei atoh bang un ka hehna leh ka thangpaihna ah nou ka hon khawm ding, huai ah ka hon koih ding a, ka hon tuisak ding.
english: As they gather silver, bronze, iron, lead, and tin into the middle of the furnace, to blow the fire on it, to melt it, so I will gather you in my anger and in my wrath, and I will lay you there and melt you.

paite: Ahi, ka hon khawm ding a, na tung uah ka hehna mei ka toh ding a, alai ah na tui khin ding uhi.
english: Yes, I will gather you, and blow on you with the fire of my wrath, and you will be melted in the middle of it.

paite: Haltuina mei lai a dangkasik atui bang in nou leng, huai lai ah na tui khin ding uh, kei TOUPA'N na tung uah ka hehna ka sung ahi chih na theita ding uh,” achi hi.
english: As silver is melted in the middle of the furnace, so you will be melted in the middle of it; and you will know that I, Yahweh, have poured out my wrath on you.’”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, akiang ah gen inla,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: gam khuahsiang louh hehna ni chia vuahtui tang lou na hi.
english: “Son of man, tell her, ‘You are a land that is not cleansed nor rained on in the day of indignation.’

paite: Humpinelkai in humham a samat azon bang mai in nang ah zawlnei sawmnate a-om ahi; mi hinnate ane khin ua, goute leh thil manphate alaksak ua, alai ah meithai tampi abawl uh.
english: There is a conspiracy of her prophets within it, like a roaring lion ravening the prey. They have devoured souls. They take treasure and precious things. They have made many widows within it.

paite: Asiampute leng nakpitak in ka dan ah atalek ua, ka thil siangthoute ahihnin uh ahi, thiltante leh thil namai akhen kei ua, mite'n lah siangthou leh siangthou lou akhen tuan kei uh; ka Sabbathte akitheihmohbawl ua, alak uah hihminsiat in ka om hi.
english: Her priests have done violence to my law and have profaned my holy things. They have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they caused men to discern between the unclean and the clean, and have hidden their eyes from my Sabbaths. So I am profaned among them.

paite: Alai a heutute lah nge duhgawl nek ding zong bang lel ahi ua, sisan suah a mi hinnate hihmang in ginom loutak a aleptheihna ding un.
english: Her princes within it are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood and to destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain.

paite: Huan azawlneite un sunu in baang anuh ua, kilakna bangmah lou lel amu ua, zuau in ai asan ua, TOUPA'N bangmah a gen louh in leng, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi," achi uh.
english: Her prophets have plastered for them with whitewash, seeing false visions, and divining lies to them, saying, ‘The Lord Yahweh says,’ when Yahweh has not spoken.

paite: "Gam a mipite'n nuaisiah aching ua, loh ahat ua, ahi, migenthei leh tasamte amawkbawl ua, dikloutak in mikhualte anuaisiah uhi.
english: The people of the land have used oppression and exercised robbery. Yes, they have troubled the poor and needy, and have oppressed the foreigner wrongfully.

paite: Gam ka hihsiatlouhna ding in alak ua dai kai ding leh gam hum a ka ma a pang ding mi ka zong a, ka mu kei hi.
english: “I sought for a man among them who would build up the wall and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I would not destroy it; but I found no one.

paite: Huaiziak in atung uah ka hehna ka sungbota a, ka thangpaihna mei in ka halmangta ahi; a-omdan ngei uh atung uah ka tungsak ahi, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in,” achi hi.
english: Therefore I have poured out my indignation on them. I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath. I have brought their own way on their heads,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah,
english: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, numei nih, nu khat ta a-om uhi.
english: “Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother.

paite: Aigupta gam ah ahukmang ua, atuailai neu ua huk ahi ua, huai ah a-angnem uh azawtsak ua, atuailai nawi uh ameksak ek uhi.
english: They played the prostitute in Egypt. They played the prostitute in their youth. Their breasts were fondled there, and their youthful nipples were caressed there.

paite: Khat, a-upapen min Oholah ahi a, asanggamnu bel Oholibah ahi; huan kei a ahong hita ua, tapate tanute asuang ua. Amin uh, Oholah pen Samaria ahi a; Oholibah bel Jerusalem ahi.
english: Their names were Oholah the elder, and Oholibah her sister. They became mine, and they bore sons and daughters. As for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem Oholibah.

paite: Huan Oholah kei a ahih nung in ahukmang nawn a, adeihtak, a-invengte, Assuria anou a;
english: “Oholah played the prostitute when she was mine. She doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbors,

paite: ukpipate, vaihawm mite, tangval iplahhuai mahmah ngen, sakol tungtuangmi, puan sandup a kizemte.
english: who were clothed with blue—governors and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding on horses.

paite: Hiai Assuria tangval hoihte tengteng lak ah akiphal vek ua, a-etlahte milim tengteng in akihihnin nawn behlap hi.
english: She gave herself as a prostitute to them, all of them the choicest men of Assyria. She defiled herself with the idols of whomever she lusted after.

paite: Atuailai neu a kipan anawite ameksak uh leh akithuahpih ziak un Aigupta a kipan in ahukna atawp tuan kei a, amau leng ahukna uh atung uah ahih pichin uhi.
english: She hasn’t left her prostitution since leaving Egypt; for in her youth they lay with her. They caressed her youthful nipples and they poured out their prostitution on her.

paite: Adeihtakte, Assuria, anouhnouhte khut ngei ah ka mansak ahi.
english: “Therefore I delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians on whom she doted.

paite: Hiaite'n avuaktanna alemdawk ua, atanu leh atapate alaksak ua, amah leng namsau in athat ua, numeite lak ah akikhemlauna pen uh ahong hita a, ama tung a gel bang amualsuahta hi.
english: These uncovered her nakedness. They took her sons and her daughters, and they killed her with the sword. She became a byword among women; for they executed judgments on her.

paite: "Huan asanggamnu Oholibah in hiai amu a, himahleh a-unu sang in adeihtak nouhnouhna ah a-uangzaw in, ahukna a-uang semsem lai hi.
english: “Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet she was more corrupt in her lusting than she, and in her prostitution which was more depraved than the prostitution of her sister.

paite: Assuria mi, invengte gam ukpipa leh vaihawmpa tangval etlahhuaitak ngen, sakol tungtuangmi, kilawmtak a kivante anounou hi.
english: She lusted after the Assyrians, governors and rulers—her neighbors, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding on horses, all of them desirable young men.

paite: Hihnit in a-om chih ka mu a, anih un lam kibang atawn uhi.
english: I saw that she was defiled. They both went the same way.

paite: "Huchi in ahuknate a-uangsak sem a, baang a pasal lim tuang, Kaldai mite lim, san-au tak a kizem, em,
english: “She increased her prostitution; for she saw men portrayed on the wall, the images of the Chaldeans portrayed with red,

paite: akawng ah kawnggak agak a, dial kilawmtak khim in, avek ua milian bang in, Kaldai gam, apianna gam ua Babulon mite bangtakte amuh ziak in.
english: dressed with belts on their waists, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them looking like princes, after the likeness of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their birth.

paite: Amau amuhtak in anounou a, akiang uah Kaldai pha in mi asawl hi.
english: As soon as she saw them, she lusted after them and sent messengers to them into Chaldea.

paite: Huchi in Babulon mite akiang ah, kingaihna lupna ah ahong pai ua, ahukna un ahihnin ua, akihihbuah khinta ua, amau amah anel mahmah uhi.
english: The Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their prostitution. She was polluted with them, and her soul was alienated from them.

paite: Huchi in ahukna ahihlang a, avuaktanna alemsak a, asanggamnu a pan ka kiheisan bang in amah ka kiheisanta hi.
english: So she uncovered her prostitution and uncovered her nakedness. Then my soul was alienated from her, just like my soul was alienated from her sister.

paite: Himahleh atuailai a Aigupta gam a ahuk lai atheihgige ziak in ahuk semsem hi.
english: Yet she multiplied her prostitution, remembering the days of her youth, in which she had played the prostitute in the land of Egypt.

paite: A-angkawmpihte van, sabiltung a bang mai ahi a, athilpawtte leng, sakolte a thilpawt bang mai ahi.
english: She lusted after their lovers, whose flesh is as the flesh of donkeys, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.

paite: Huchibang in na tuailai hukna Aigupta min na tuailai nawite ahon khoihsak lai na theikhe nawnta ahi."
english: Thus you called to memory the lewdness of your youth, in the caressing of your nipples by the Egyptians because of your youthful breasts.

paite: Huaiziak in aw Oholibah, hichibang in Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi: "Ngai in, nang hon it, na lungsim in anelsate ka tamsak ding a, kil chih a kipan ka pikhawm ding.
english: “Therefore, Oholibah, the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will raise up your lovers against you, from whom your soul is alienated, and I will bring them against you on every side:

paite: Babulon mite leh Kaldai mi tengteng, Pekodte, Shoate, Koate leh akiang ua Assuria mite tengteng toh; tangval etlahhuai taktakte, ukpipate, vaihawm mite, avek un miliante leh minthangte, avek un sakol tung a tuang in ahong pai ding uhi.
english: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, Shoa, Koa, and all the Assyrians with them; all of them desirable young men, governors and rulers, princes and men of renown, all of them riding on horses.

paite: Galvante, kidouna kangtalaite, kangtalaite leh mipi omkhawm in ahong sual ding ua; lum lian leh lum neu, dal lukhute toh na kim ah ahon um ding ua; akiang uah vaihawmna ka kemsak ding a, athugel bang zel un na tung ah ahihtangtung ding uhi.
english: They will come against you with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with a company of peoples. They will set themselves against you with buckler, shield, and helmet all around. I will commit the judgment to them, and they will judge you according to their judgments.

paite: Huan na tung ah ka lung hihlouhna ka tungsak ding a, heh mahmah in nang ahon sual ding ua, na nakte leh na bilte asatkhe ding ua, akhosuaksunte namsau in asi ding uh, na tanu leh na tapate ahon laksak ding ua, akhosuaksunte mei in akanglum ding uh.
english: I will set my jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will take away your nose and your ears. Your remnant will fall by the sword. They will take your sons and your daughters; and the rest of you will be devoured by the fire.

paite: Na puansilhte ahon hawksak lai ding ua, na kizepna kilawm taktakte alamang ding uh.
english: They will also strip you of your clothes and take away your beautiful jewels.

paite: Na hukna leh Aigupta gam a kipan a na kizuakna ahon tawpsak ding ua, huchi in amau lam ah na mit na lengsak nawn kei dia, Aigupta gam na theigige nawn kei ding hi.”
english: Thus I will make your lewdness to cease from you, and remove your prostitution from the land of Egypt, so that you will not lift up your eyes to them, nor remember Egypt any more.’

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi ngal a: "Ngai in, na huat mahmah, nang hon chimtakte khut mahmah ah ka hon mansak ding.
english: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will deliver you into the hand of them whom you hate, into the hand of them from whom your soul is alienated.

paite: Huat petmah in ahon ho ding ua, na sepgim gah tengteng ahon laksak ding ua, vuaktang in kihawmkhai in ahon taisan ding uh; na kizuakna vuaktanna, na hukna leh na kizuakna ngei hihlat in a-om ding hi.
english: They will deal with you in hatred, and will take away all your labor, and will leave you naked and bare. The nakedness of your prostitution will be uncovered, both your lewdness and your prostitution.

paite: Hiai thilte na tung ah ahong tung ding, namdangte delh in na hukmang ding a, amilimte ua na kihihnit ziak in.
english: These things will be done to you because you have played the prostitute after the nations, and because you are polluted with their idols.

paite: Na sanggamnu lampi na tawn sam a, huaiziak in amah nou na khut ah ka hon pe ding."
english: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore I will give her cup into your hand.’

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Na sanggamnu nou thuk leh lian na dawn ding a, nuihsan leh simmoh in na om ding;
english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘You will drink of your sister’s cup, which is deep and large. You will be ridiculed and held in derision. It contains much.

paite: Khamna leh lungkhamna in na dim dia, lamdangsakna leh siatna nou, na sanggamnu Samaria nou toh na dawn gai keuhkeuh ding hi.
english: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of your sister Samaria.

paite: Na dawn ding a, anou leng na tawpsiang vek ding; na sam na botkhe dia, na nawite na hamkek ding. Kei, Toupa PATHIAN in ka chita hi."
english: You will even drink it and drain it out. You will gnaw the broken pieces of it, and will tear your breasts; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "N'on mangngilh a na hon na dal ziak in na hukna leh na kizuakna moh na po mai ding hi."
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you have forgotten me and cast me behind your back, therefore you also bear your lewdness and your prostitution.’”

paite: Huai lou leng TOUPA'N ka kiang ah agen nawn a, "Mihing tapa, Oholah leh Oholibah na langsin ahia? Akihhuaina uh akiang uah puang in.
english: Yahweh said moreover to me: “Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.

paite: Ang akawmta ua, akhut uah sisan abang a, amilim kiang ah ang akawmta uhi; atapate uh kei a dia asuan uh akiang ua kangmang ding in mei ah apai uhi.
english: For they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands. They have committed adultery with their idols. They have also caused their sons, whom they bore to me, to pass through the fire to them to be devoured.

paite: Huai lou in leng, ka kiang ah hiai achi uhi; amau mah in ka Mun Siangthou ahihnin ua, ka Sabbathte leng abohsia uhi.
english: Moreover this they have done to me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my Sabbaths.

paite: Amilimte uh a dia atate uh athah nung un, amau mah in ka mun siangthou hihnin ding in alut ua; ngai in, hichibang in ka insung mahmah ah ahih uhi.
english: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and behold, they have done this in the middle of my house.

paite: "Huai lou leng, gamlapi a pan mi hong pai ding in na thukhak ua, mi na sawl ua, ngai in, ahong ua, amau hel in na kisilsiang a, na mit na nuh a, kizephoihna dangte na silh a, lupna thupitak ah na tu hi.
english: “Furthermore you sisters have sent for men who come from far away, to whom a messenger was sent, and behold, they came; for whom you washed yourself, painted your eyes, decorated yourself with ornaments,

paite: Ama ah dohkan na bawl a, ka gimlim leh ka sathaute huai ah na lui hi.
english: and sat on a stately bed, with a table prepared before it, whereupon you set my incense and my oil.

paite: Huai ah mipi noptal husa zak ahi a, mi namai kia lou leng gamdai a kipan in zukhamte ahon pi ua, anih un taute abun ua, lukhu kilawmte akhu uhi."
english: “The voice of a multitude being at ease was with her. With men of the common sort were brought drunkards from the wilderness; and they put bracelets on their hands, and beautiful crowns on their heads.

paite: Huan ke'n, "Angkawmnu tek nung a kithuahpih nuam un, ama'n leng angap peuhmah diam maw?" ka chi hi.
english: Then I said of her who was old in adulteries, ‘Now they will play the prostitute with her, and she with them.’

paite: "Huchi in kizuak kiang a ahoh bang un akiang ah alutta thou ua; huchi in numei huk Oholah leh Oholibah kiang ah alutta uhi.
english: They went in to her, as they go in to a prostitute. So they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the lewd women.

paite: Himahleh midiktatte'n angkawmnute leh sisan suah hat numeite vai ahawm bang un ahawmsak ding ua, angkawmnute ahih ua, akhut ua sisan aban ziak in."
english: Righteous men will judge them with the judgment of adulteresses and with the judgment of women who shed blood, because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Na tung uah mipi ka kaikhawm ding a, ka hon loksak ding a, ka hon bawlsak ding hi.
english: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘I will bring up a mob against them, and will give them to be tossed back and forth and robbed.

paite: Mihonte'n suang in adeng ding ua, anamsau un asatlum ding ua, atanute uh, atapate uh athat ding ua, a-innte uh ahalsak ding uh.
english: The company will stone them with stones and dispatch them with their swords. They will kill their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.

paite: Hichibang in hukna gam a kipan ka hihmang ding a, numei tengteng in na hukna uh chin louh hial ding ahi chih na theihna ding un.
english: “‘Thus I will cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to be lewd like you.

paite: Huchi in na tung uah na hukna uh ahon thuk ding ua, na milim khelhnate uh na thuak ding uh, kei Toupa PATHIAN ka hi chih na thei ding uh," achi hi.
english: They will recompense your lewdness on you, and you will bear the sins of your idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.’”

paite: Akum kuana, akha sawmna, huai kha, ani sawm ni in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn a,
english: Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, tuni ngei, hiai ni min ngei gelhkhia in. Hiai ni ngei in Babulon kumpipa'n Jerusalem ahong sual pan hi.
english: “Son of man, write the name of the day, this same day. The king of Babylon drew close to Jerusalem this same day.

paite: Huan helhat Inkote kiang ah gentehna thu gen inla, akiang uah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi:
english: Utter a parable to the rebellious house, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says, “Put the cauldron on the fire. Put it on, and also pour water into it.

paite: "Sa uina bel suang inla, suang nilouh inla, asung ah tui sung in; sabakte kha inla, asa hoih tengteng, apheite, aliangte, aguhbawk hoih tata in hihdim in.
english: Gather its pieces into it, even every good piece: the thigh and the shoulder. Fill it with the choice bones.

paite: Ganhonte lak a ahoih tata la inla, anuai ah singkhuah khul ek inla, sou bolhbolh hen; ahi, aguhbomte ki-ui hen."
english: Take the choice of the flock, and also a pile of wood for the bones under the cauldron. Make it boil well. Yes, let its bones be boiled within it.”

paite: Huchi in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Sisan suah hat khopi, sa uina bel, asung kanggem, agem dai ngei nai lou tung agik hi! Tel tuan lou in, asa bak khatkhat in thuk in.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Woe to the bloody city, to the cauldron whose rust is in it, and whose rust hasn’t gone out of it! Take out of it piece after piece without casting lots for it.

paite: Asisan suah amah tung ah a-om a, leivui vuhtheihna dia lei a sunbuak gen tak louh, suangpi keu tung ah asungbo zawta hi.
english: “‘“For the blood she shed is in the middle of her. She set it on the bare rock. She didn’t pour it on the ground, to cover it with dust.

paite: Phu la ding a hehna ahong kisaktheihna ding in vuh louh in asisan suah suangpi keu tung ah ka sung ahi."
english: That it may cause wrath to come up to take vengeance, I have set her blood on the bare rock, that it should not be covered.”

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Sisan suah hat khopi tung agik hi! Kei mahmah in ka vum venvon ding.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Woe to the bloody city! I also will make the pile great.

paite: Singtum sevum venvon unla, mei chihsa unla, sate ui min unla, satui chiktak in, aguhte leng kangmang hen.
english: Heap on the wood. Make the fire hot. Boil the meat well. Make the broth thick, and let the bones be burned.

paite: Huchi in bel avuak in meivu tung ah suan hi nilouh henla, ahong sa ding a, adal ahong am ding a, anitna ahong zulmang ding, akangkhem akatmang theihna ding in.
english: Then set it empty on its coals, that it may be hot, and its bronze may burn, and that its filthiness may be molten in it, that its rust may be consumed.

paite: Chimtak khop a sual in leng akangkhem asiang tuan kei a, mei in leng akangsiang sam kei hi.
english: She is weary with toil; yet her great rust, rust by fire, doesn’t leave her.

paite: Na nitna hukna ahi a, ka hon khuah a, na sian tuan louh ziak in na tung ah ka hehna ka lungdamsak mateng chik mah chiang in na nitna a kipan khuahsiang na hi nawnta kei ding hi.
english: “‘“In your filthiness is lewdness. Because I have cleansed you and you weren’t cleansed, you won’t be cleansed from your filthiness any more, until I have caused my wrath toward you to rest.

paite: Kei TOUPA'N ka chita ahi, ahong tung mahmah ding, ke'n ka hih ding, ka nungkin kei ding a, ka hawi sam kei ding a, ka lunghei sam kei ding; na omdante leh na thilhih bang zel in vai ahon hawmsak ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in,” achi hi.
english: “‘“I, Yahweh, have spoken it. It will happen, and I will do it. I won’t go back. I won’t spare. I won’t repent. According to your ways and according to your doings, they will judge you,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah,
english: Also Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, ngai in, thakhat in na mittaina pen ka hon laksak ding a, na suun ding ahi kei dia, na kah ding leng ahi sam kei, na khitui leng akiak ding ahi kei hi.
english: “Son of man, behold, I will take away from you the desire of your eyes with one stroke; yet you shall neither mourn nor weep, neither shall your tears run down.

paite: Asim in thum inla, misi suunna nei ke'n, na dial khim inla, na khedap bun inla, na muk hum ke'nla, mite an leng ne ke'n," achi hi.
english: Sigh, but not aloud. Make no mourning for the dead. Bind your headdress on you, and put your sandals on your feet. Don’t cover your lips, and don’t eat mourner’s bread.”

paite: Huchi in zingsang lam in mipite kiang ah thu ka gen a, nitaklam in ka zi asi maimah a; zingsang lam in ahon thupiak bang in ka hih hi.
english: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and at evening my wife died. So I did in the morning as I was commanded.

paite: Mite'n ka kiang ah, hichibang na thilhihte kou ding in bang ahia ahih na hon hilh kei dia hia? achi uhi.
english: The people asked me, “Won’t you tell us what these things mean to us, that you act like this?”

paite: Huchi in ke'n akiang uah, ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a.
english: Then I said to them, “Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: Israel inkote kiang ah gen inla, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai un, ka mun siangthou, na hatna suan pen uh, na mittaina pen uh, na deihlam pen uh ka hihnin ding hi; na tanute uh; na tapate uh, nunglam a na nutsiatte uh namsau in apuk ding uh.
english: ‘Speak to the house of Israel, “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pities; and your sons and your daughters whom you have left behind will fall by the sword.

paite: Ka hih bang geih in na hih tei ding uhi; na muk uh na hum kei ding ua, mite an leng na ne sam kei ding uh.
english: You will do as I have done. You won’t cover your lips or eat mourner’s bread.

paite: Na dialte uh leng na khim ding ua, na khedap uh na bun ding ua; na suun kei ding ua, na kap sam kei ding ua, na thulimlouhnate uah na mangthang ding ua, na kikahtuah ding uhi.
english: Your turbans will be on your heads, and your sandals on your feet. You won’t mourn or weep; but you will pine away in your iniquities, and moan one toward another.

paite: Hichibang in Ezekiel, nou a ding in etsakna ahi ding a, ahihdan bang zel in na hih ding uh ahi; hiai ahong tun hun chiang in Toupa PATHIAN ka hi chih na thei ding uh, chi ahi, ka chi hi.
english: Thus Ezekiel will be a sign to you; according to all that he has done, you will do. When this comes, then you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.’”’”

paite: "Huan nang mihing tapa, amau a kipan ahatnate uh, athupi kipahnate uh, amit tainapente uh, alunglutna pente uh, atanu uleh atapate uh ka lakmang ni chiang in,
english: “You, son of man, shouldn’t it be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their heart—their sons and their daughters—

paite: huai ni mahmah chiang in na kiang ah taikhemi hong pai in, ahong theisak kei ding ua hia?
english: that in that day he who escapes will come to you, to cause you to hear it with your ears?

paite: Huai ni chiang in taikhemi kiang ah na kam na ka ding a, akiang ah thu na gen ding a, na dai maimah kei ding; huchi in amaute a ding in etsakna na hi ding a; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh," achi hi.
english: In that day your mouth will be opened to him who has escaped, and you will speak and be no more mute. So you will be a sign to them. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah;
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Ammon tate masuan inla, atungtang thu uh gen in.
english: “Son of man, set your face toward the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them.

paite: Ammon tate kiang ah, Toupa PATHIAN thu ngaikhia unla, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: ka mun siangthou hihnit a om a, Israel gam hihgawp a a-om a, Judah Inkote sal a pi a a-om lai ua, 'Awi ing e!' na chih ziak in,
english: Tell the children of Ammon, ‘Hear the word of the Lord Yahweh! The Lord Yahweh says, “Because you said, ‘Aha!’ against my sanctuary when it was profaned, and against the land of Israel when it was made desolate, and against the house of Judah when they went into captivity,

paite: ngai in, suahlam mite kiang ah ahon tan ding un ka hon pe ding ahi; nang ah buk akoih ding ua, nang ah tenna abawl ding uh; na theigahte ane ding ua, na nawitui adawn ding uh.
english: therefore, behold, I will deliver you to the children of the east for a possession. They will set their encampments in you and make their dwellings in you. They will eat your fruit and they will drink your milk.

paite: Rabbah khua sangawngsau inn ding in ka bawl dia, Ammon tate mun ganhon kualna mun ding in ka bawl ding; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh."
english: I will make Rabbah a stable for camels and the children of Ammon a resting place for flocks. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Israel gam tung a na khut na bet a, na khe na pek a, lungsim tengteng a asiatna tung a na kipah ziak in,
english: For the Lord Yahweh says: “Because you have clapped your hands, stamped with the feet, and rejoiced with all the contempt of your soul against the land of Israel,

paite: ngai in, na tung ah ka khut ka lik ding a, namte kiang ah gallak ding in ka hon mansak ding a; mite a kipan ka hon phuk ding a, huai gam a kipan in ka hon hihmang vengveng ding, ka hon hihse ding a, huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding," chi in.
english: therefore, behold, I have stretched out my hand on you, and will deliver you for a plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples, and I will cause you to perish out of the countries. I will destroy you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Moab leh Seir in, ngai in, Judah inkote namdang bang ahi uh, achih ziak un.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because Moab and Seir say, ‘Behold, the house of Judah is like all the nations,’

paite: Moab pang khat, khopite lam pang, gamgi zul a khopi, agam thupina pente, Beth-zeshimot, Baal-meon leh Kiriathaim lam pang ka hong ding a,
english: therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on its frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim,

paite: suahlam tate tan ding in Ammon tate toh ka pe ding a, namte lak a Ammon tate theihgige ahih nawnlouhna ding un.
english: to the children of the east, to go against the children of Ammon; and I will give them for a possession, that the children of Ammon may not be remembered among the nations.

paite: Moab gam tung ah thu gel ka tangtungsak ding a, huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh," chi in.
english: I will execute judgments on Moab. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Edom in Judah inkote tung a phuba la in nakpitak in thil ahihkhial hi, amah thu kia a atung ua phu alak ziak in.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because Edom has dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended, and taken revenge on them,”

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Edom tung ah ka khut ka lik ding a, alak ua kipan mi leh sate ka phukmang vek ding; Teman a kipan in ka hihgawp ding a; Dedan pha in namsau in asi ding uh.
english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “I will stretch out my hand on Edom, and will cut off man and animal from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman. They will fall by the sword even to Dedan.

paite: Huchi in ka mi Israelte khut in ka phulakna ka tungsak ding a, Edom tung ah ka hehna bang zel leh ka thangpaihna bang zel in ahih ding ua, ka phulakna ana thei ding uh," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: I will lay my vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel. They will do in Edom according to my anger and according to my wrath. Then they will know my vengeance,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Philistia mite'n phu la a, tangtawn kimelmakna a, mi hihman utna lungsim sia pu a phu alak ziak un.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because the Philistines have taken revenge, and have taken vengeance with contempt of soul to destroy with perpetual hostility,”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, ngai in, Philistia mite tung ah ka khut ka lik ding a, Kareth khomite ka phuk vek ding a, tui gei a mi omsunte ka hihmang vek ding.
english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I will stretch out my hand on the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.

paite: Huan heh mahmah in sal in atung uah phu ka la ding a, huchi a atung ua ka phulakna ka tunsak hun chiang in TOUPA ka hi chih atheita ding uh," achi hi.
english: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes. Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I lay my vengeance on them.”’”

paite: Akum sawm-le-khatna huai kha ani masapen in hichi ahong hi a, ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
english: In the eleventh year, in the first of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Tura in Jerusalem tungthu a, 'Nuam e! Namte kongkhak aseta, kei lam ah akihong, hihsiatgawp a a-om vek ziak in, ka tan hoih ding ahita,' "
english: “Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, ‘Aha! She is broken! She who was the gateway of the peoples has been returned to me. I will be replenished, now that she is laid waste;’

paite: huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, "Ngai in, aw Tura, ka hon dou ahi, tuipi in tuihualte avoktouh bang mai in na tung a hong pai ding in nam tampi ka hon sawl ding.
english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I am against you, Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against you, as the sea causes its waves to come up.

paite: Huchi in Tura kulhte ahihse ding ua, a-insangte achimsak ding ua, amah a kipan aleivui tengteng ka kheuhsiang ding a, suangpi keu lel in ka bawl ding hi.
english: They will destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers. I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her a bare rock.

paite: Tui lai a len phoukeuna mun ahi mai ding, ke'n ka chita ngal a," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi. Huchi in namte a ding in gallak ahi mai ding.
english: She will be a place for the spreading of nets in the middle of the sea; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord Yahweh. ‘She will become plunder for the nations.

paite: Huan atanu gam a omte namsau a hihlup ahih chiang un TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
english: Her daughters who are in the field will be slain with the sword. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’

paite: "Ngai in, Tura tung ah Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar, Kumpipate' kumpipa mallam a kipan in, sakolte toh sakol tungtuang mite, apawl leh mipi tampi mahmah ka hon pi dek ahi.
english: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, from the north, with horses, with chariots, with horsemen, and an army with many people.

paite: Gam ah namsau in na tanute athat ding; kulh abawl ding a, nang nanna ding in, nang douna ding in abawl ding, mual pawngte, nang douna kidalna abawlkhe ding hi.
english: He will kill your daughters in the field with the sword. He will make forts against you, cast up a mound against you, and raise up the buckler against you.

paite: Kulhbaang suksiatna bawl in, na kulh phelna ding, heipi in na insangte achimsak ding hi.
english: He will set his battering engines against your walls, and with his axes he will break down your towers.

paite: Asakol tam luat ding ziak in aleivuite un nang ahon tuam ding a, khopi akiphutvang nung a mite alut sek bang a, na kongpi a ahong lut hun chiang un, na kulhpi aling ding; sakol tungtuangte husa leh kidou kangtalai husa in.
english: By reason of the abundance of his horses, their dust will cover you. Your walls will shake at the noise of the horsemen, of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he enters into your gates, as men enter into a city which is broken open.

paite: Sakol khechin in achilse ding, na kongzingte; na mite athat khin ding, namsau in; na hatna bangbang lei ah achim ding hi.
english: He will tread down all your streets with the hoofs of his horses. He will kill your people with the sword. The pillars of your strength will go down to the ground.

paite: Na gou thil gallak in ala ding ua; na van tengteng agubei ding uh; lei ah na kulhbaang achimsak ding ua, na inpi nuam ahihse vek ding uh, na suangte, na singte, na leivuite tui lai ah apai ding uh.
english: They will make a plunder of your riches and make a prey of your merchandise. They will break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses. They will lay your stones, your timber, and your dust in the middle of the waters.

paite: Ka khawlsak khin ding a, na lasak husate, na kaihging leng adai den ding hi.
english: I will cause the noise of your songs to cease. The sound of your harps won’t be heard any more.

paite: Suangpi keu lel in ka hon bawl ding a, len phoukeuna ding na hong hi ding hi, dinsak nawn na hi kei ding, kei TOUPA'N ka chita ngal a," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi hi.
english: I will make you a bare rock. You will be a place for the spreading of nets. You will be built no more; for I Yahweh have spoken it,’ says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in Tura khua kiang ah hichi in achi, na sung a kithahnate a-om hun a, miliamte athum hun chiang in na puk ging in tuipi gei gamte aling kei ding ua hia?
english: “The Lord Yahweh says to Tyre: ‘Won’t the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when the slaughter is made within you?

paite: Tuipi tung a heutute tengteng atutphah ua kipan apaisuk ding ua, apuan thupite uh akoih ding ua, apuansilh zephoihte uh asuahkhe ding ua; linna in akivan zawta ding ua, lei ah atu ding ua, alingling ding ua, lamdang ahon sa ding uh.
english: Then all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones, and lay aside their robes, and strip off their embroidered garments. They will clothe themselves with trembling. They will sit on the ground, and will tremble every moment, and be astonished at you.

paite: Huchi in nang suunna la aphuak ding ua, na kiang ah, Khopi minthang, tuipi tung a hat, tuisiammi tengteng tenna sek, amah leh asung a tengte tengteng, mivialvakte'n ahon lauhlauh uh toh, na siatna thupi hi na tel e;
english: They will take up a lamentation over you, and tell you, “How you are destroyed, who were inhabited by seafaring men, the renowned city, who was strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, who caused their terror to be on all who lived there!”

paite: Na pukna ni in aling uh, tuikulh gamte; tuipi tuikulh alunglel ua, na man ni in, achi ding uh chi in.
english: Now the islands will tremble in the day of your fall. Yes, the islands that are in the sea will be dismayed at your departure.’

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, khopi gam, kuamah luah louh khopi bang a ka hon bawl hun chiang in, tui thukpi ah ka hon tumsak ding a, tui thupi mahmah in ahon tum ding hi.
english: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘When I make you a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited, when I bring up the deep on you, and the great waters cover you,

paite: Lei nuailam ah, nidang a segawpsa, khuk thuk a paisate kiang ah ka hon tengsak ding a, kuamah in ahon luahlouhna ding un leh mihingte lak a thupina na muh nawn hetlouhna ding in.
english: then I will bring you down with those who descend into the pit, to the people of old time, and will make you dwell in the lower parts of the earth, in the places that are desolate of old, with those who go down to the pit, that you be not inhabited; and I will set glory in the land of the living.

paite: Ka hon hihmang vengveng ding a, na om nawnta kei ding, mi'n hon zong mah le uh leng, ahon mu nawnta kei ding uh chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: I will make you a terror, and you will no more have any being. Though you are sought for, yet you will never be found again,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

paite: Ka kiang ah TOUPA thu hong tung a, ka kiang ah,
english: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,

paite: "Nang, mihing tapa, Tura kho suunna la phuak inla,
english: “You, son of man, take up a lamentation over Tyre;

paite: Tura khua kiang ah, Aw nang tuipi gei a teng sek, tuipi gei gam tampite kiang a sumsin, Toupa PATHIAN in huchi in ahon chi: Aw nang Tura, ka kilawm bukim na chi maw;
english: and tell Tyre, ‘You who dwell at the entry of the sea, who are the merchant of the peoples to many islands, the Lord Yahweh says: “You, Tyre, have said, ‘I am perfect in beauty.’

paite: "Na gam in tuipi lai asun hi, nang hon bawlte'n hon kilawm tungtuansak mah ve ua;
english: Your borders are in the heart of the seas. Your builders have perfected your beauty.

paite: Na singzat Senir meilah in abawl ua; na longpeu ding in, Lebanon a sidar in abawl uhi;
english: They have made all your planks of cypress trees from Senir. They have taken a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.

paite: Bashan tosaw na longzapna ding in abawl ua; saiha suangphum na long pialkhang ding in, taksing tuipi gam Kupra a kipan in.
english: They have made your oars of the oaks of Bashan. They have made your benches of ivory inlaid in cypress wood from the islands of Kittim.

paite: Na long puanzak Aigupta puanmalngat gial, nang chiamtehna ding in ana tung hi, nang a dia limzak dumpuang, sandup, Elishah tui gei a kipan;
english: Your sail was of fine linen with embroidered work from Egypt, that it might be to you for a banner. Blue and purple from the islands of Elishah was your awning.

paite: Na longkalmi Sidon, Arvad mi ahi; na long hawl mite leng Zemir misiamte ahi ua;
english: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers. Your wise men, Tyre, were in you. They were your pilots.

paite: Gebal upa leh mikhutsiam, na long bulhtuah mite ahi ua, tuipi long teng leh amite'n, nang hong dawr ding in ahong zuan uhi.
english: The old men of Gebal and its wise men were your repairers of ship seams in you. All the ships of the sea with their mariners were in you to deal in your merchandise.

paite: "Na galdoumi, na sepaihhon, Persia, Lud, Put mite ahi ua, alum uh leh adal lukhu uh na baang ah akhai ua, nang kilawmsakte ahi uhi.
english: “‘“Persia, Lud, and Put were in your army, your men of war. They hung the shield and helmet in you. They showed your beauty.

paite: Na sepaihhon leh Arvad mite'n na kulhpi kimvel in aveng ua, Gammadim mite'n na insang aveng ua, alum uh na kulhpi kimvel in akhai ua, nang kilawmsakte ahi uhi.
english: The men of Arvad with your army were on your walls all around, and valiant men were in your towers. They hung their shields on your walls all around. They have perfected your beauty.

paite: Na hauh ziak in, sum-le-pai gou thil chiteng, Tarshish nang hon dawr mi ahong hi a, na van lei in ahon lam hi, dangkasik, sik, langva leh asuante leng.
english: “‘“Tarshish was your merchant by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches. They traded for your wares with silver, iron, tin, and lead.

paite: Zavan, Tubal, Meshek, nang hon dawrte'n sal leh dal tui-um belsuan in ahon dawr ua, na van neihna ding in.
english: “‘“Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your traders. They traded the persons of men and vessels of bronze for your merchandise.

paite: Togarmah a mite'n sakol, kidouna sakol leh sabiltung in na van alei uhi.
english: “‘“They of the house of Togarmah traded for your wares with horses, war horses, and mules.

paite: Dedan mite nang hon dawr mite ahi ua, tui gei mun chih na sumsinna mun ahong hi a, saiha leh eboni ahon puak uhi.
english: “‘“The men of Dedan traded with you. Many islands were the market of your hand. They brought you horns of ivory and ebony in exchange.

paite: Van na hauh ziak in, Edom nang hon dawr ahong hi a, emerald suang, puan sandup, puanzep, puanmalngat, khibah, agate suangte in nang ahon dawr uh.
english: “‘“Syria was your merchant by reason of the multitude of your handiworks. They traded for your wares with emeralds, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies.

paite: Judah leh Israel teng nang hon dawrte ahi ua, Minnith buh leh Pannag, khuaizu, sathau leh singnai in ahon dawr uh.
english: “‘“Judah and the land of Israel were your traders. They traded wheat of Minnith, confections, honey, oil, and balm for your merchandise.

paite: Na hauh ziak in, sum-le-pai gou thil chiteng, Damaskas nang hon dawr ahong hi a, Helbon uain leh belam mulkaang in ahon dawr hi.
english: “‘“Damascus was your merchant for the multitude of your handiworks by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches, with the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

paite: Uzal uain hon tawi in alei ua, na vante, sikseksa, singguithak leh kawltute na sumsinna.
english: “‘“Vedan and Javan traded with yarn for your wares; wrought iron, cassia, and calamus were among your merchandise.

paite: Dedan in sakol tungphah puante in nang ahon dawr hi.
english: “‘“Dedan was your merchant in precious saddle blankets for riding.

paite: Arabia leh Kedar kumpipate nang hon dawrte ahi vek uh, belamnoute, belamtalte, keltalte in ahon dawr uh.
english: “‘“Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your favorite dealers in lambs, rams, and goats. In these, they were your merchants.

paite: Sheba leh Raamah sumsin mite nang hon dawrte ahong hi ua, gimlim hoihpente, suangmantam chi chih leh dangka-engte in, nang ahon dawr uh.
english: “‘“The traders of Sheba and Raamah were your traders. They traded for your wares with the best of all spices, all precious stones, and gold.

paite: Haran, Kanneh leh Eden, Sheba, Assuria leh Kilmad sumsin mite nang hon dawrte ahi uh.
english: “‘“Haran, Canneh, Eden, the traders of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad, were your traders.

paite: Huaite ahi uh, nang hon dawr, puansilh hoih chi, puandum buang, puanzep, pialkhang phah ze kilawm toh, khauhual chiptak a hek in, hiaite in nang ahon dawr uh.
english: These were your traders in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and embroidered work, and in cedar chests of rich clothing bound with cords, among your merchandise.

paite: "Tarshish longhon leh long lian vanpote ahi ua, na hong inbul in tuipi tung ah na hong thupita hi.
english: “‘“The ships of Tarshish were your caravans for your merchandise. You were replenished and made very glorious in the heart of the seas.

paite: Na long hawlpa'n tuipi kihot ah ahon hawllut a, suahlam huih in nang ahon nuaimang, tuipi lai ah.
english: Your rowers have brought you into great waters. The east wind has broken you in the heart of the seas.

paite: Na hauhsakna, na van, na sumsinna thil, na long mite, long hawlmi, bulhtuak mite, sumsin van kheng mite, na galbawl mite tengteng, nang a om, na sung a om teng- teng toh, na siat ni in tuipi lai ah na tummang ding uh.
english: Your riches, your wares, your merchandise, your mariners, your pilots, your repairers of ship seams, the dealers in your merchandise, and all your men of war who are in you, with all your company which is among you, will fall into the heart of the seas in the day of your ruin.

paite: Na long hawl mite kikou husa in na kim a mite aling uhi.
english: At the sound of the cry of your pilots, the pasture lands will shake.

paite: Longkalhna peu len mite tengteng, long mite leh, tuipi a hawl mite tengteng paisuk in, luipiau ah adingh uh.
english: All who handle the oars, the mariners and all the pilots of the sea, will come down from their ships. They will stand on the land,

paite: Na tungthu ah a-aw uh zak tham in asuah ding ua, khasetak in akap ding ua; alu ua leivuite buak in, vut lak ah akitholh ding uh.
english: and will cause their voice to be heard over you, and will cry bitterly. They will cast up dust on their heads. They will wallow in the ashes.

paite: Nang ziak in kimetgiau in, sai-ip puan ateng ding ua; khase lua in nakpitak a kap in nang ahon suun ding uh.
english: They will make themselves bald for you, and clothe themselves with sackcloth. They will weep for you in bitterness of soul, with bitter mourning.

paite: Nang hon suun in kahla asam ding ua, nang suun in Tura bang khopi kua a-om a, amah tuipi lai ah, adai sipsip hi.
english: In their wailing they will take up a lamentation for you, and lament over you, saying, ‘Who is there like Tyre, like her who is brought to silence in the middle of the sea?’

paite: Na vante'n tuipi a pan pawt in mi tampi avak kham sek; na dangka leh na van in lei kumpipate na hausak hi.
english: When your wares came from the seas, you filled many peoples. You enriched the kings of the earth with the multitude of your riches and of your merchandise.

paite: Tuipi thuk a na siat ni in, na sumsinna thil, na mite, nang toh athelthang uhi.
english: In the time that you were broken by the seas, in the depths of the waters, your merchandise and all your company fell within you.

paite: "Tui gei a teng mi tengteng in mulkimhuai ahon sa ua; akumpipate uh lau in asibup ua, amel uh alamdang hial hi.
english: All the inhabitants of the islands are astonished at you, and their kings are horribly afraid. They are troubled in their face.

paite: Mite lak a sumsin mite'n nang ahon khoisatkhum ua, mite a ding in launa na hong suakta a, na kilang ngei nawn kei ding, chi in ahon kahkhum uhi."
english: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you. You have come to a terrible end, and you will be no more.”’”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN thu ka kiang ah ahong tung nawn a,
english: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Tura heutupa kiang ah gen inla, Toupa PATHIAN in, hichi in achi: Na lungsim akisathei a, Pathian ka hi a, tuipi lai a Pathian tutmun ah ka tu, na chi a; himahleh mihing lel na hi a, pathian na hi kei a, pathian lungsim bang in kingaihtuah mah lechin;
english: “Son of man, tell the prince of Tyre, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because your heart is lifted up, and you have said, ‘I am a god, I sit in the seat of God, in the middle of the seas;’ yet you are man, and no god, though you set your heart as the heart of a god—

paite: Daniel sang in na pilzaw a, na lak ah thuguk a-om thei kei a;
english: behold, you are wiser than Daniel. There is no secret that is hidden from you.

paite: na pilna leh na lemtheihna in na na kihihhau a; na goubawm ah dangka leh dangka-eng na khum hi.
english: By your wisdom and by your understanding you have gotten yourself riches, and have gotten gold and silver into your treasuries.

paite: Na pilna thupi mahmah leh na sumsaina in sum na hihpung a; na hauhsak ziak in na lungsim ana kisatheita hi."
english: By your great wisdom and by your trading you have increased your riches, and your heart is lifted up because of your riches—”

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Pathian lungsim bang pu a na kingaihtuah ziak in,
english: “‘therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Because you have set your heart as the heart of God,

paite: ngai in, na kiang ah gamdangmi, nam lauhuaitak ka hon pilut sin ahi; huan, na pilna gah kilawm tung ah anamsau uh alek ding ua, na thupina ahihse ding uh.
english: therefore, behold, I will bring strangers on you, the terrible of the nations. They will draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom. They will defile your brightness.

paite: Khuk thuk ah ahon sawllut ding ua, tuipi lai a athahte uh sih in na si ding.
english: They will bring you down to the pit. You will die the death of those who are slain in the heart of the seas.

paite: Nang hon thatmi ma ah, Pathian ka hi, na chi lailai dia hia? Nang hon liamsakmi khut ah pathian na hi kei a, mihing lel na hi zaw.
english: Will you yet say before him who kills you, ‘I am God’? But you are man, and not God, in the hand of him who wounds you.

paite: Pau tuam mite khut ah, zeksum louh sih in na si ding; ka pauta ngal a," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: You will die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers; for I have spoken it,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

paite: Huai lou leng ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Tura kumpipa suunna la phuak inla, akiang ah, Hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi: Hoih buchingtak, pilna a dim, kilawmna chiteng;
english: “Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and tell him, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “You were the seal of full measure, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.

paite: Pathian huan, Eden ah na teng a; suangmantam chiteng in na kituam a, sardi, topaz leh diamond, beril, onik, jasper, sapphir, emerald, karbankul, aphumkipna leh agelh kilawmna dangka-eng a bawlte, nang siam ni a kisiamte.
english: You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz, emerald, chrysolite, onyx, jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and beryl. Gold work of tambourines and of pipes was in you. They were prepared in the day that you were created.

paite: Nang chingmi cherub sathau nilh na hi; Pathian tang siangthou ah ka hon omsak a, meisuangte lak ah na vak hi.
english: You were the anointed cherub who covers. Then I set you up on the holy mountain of God. You have walked up and down in the middle of the stones of fire.

paite: Na hoih buching; siam a na om ni a kipan, nang a diktatlouhna a-om mateng in.
english: You were perfect in your ways from the day that you were created, until unrighteousness was found in you.

paite: Na sumsinna apun hulhul ziak in hiamgamna in na dim a, khelhna ah na pukta hi. Pathian tang a kipan in bangmah lou in ka hon paita a; chingmi cherub in meisuangte lak a kipan ahon delhkhia hi.
english: By the abundance of your commerce, your insides were filled with violence, and you have sinned. Therefore I have cast you as profane out of God’s mountain. I have destroyed you, covering cherub, from the middle of the stones of fire.

paite: Na kilawmna ziak a hong kisathei in, na thupina a na pilna hihsia in, lei ah ka hon pai a, etnop ding in kumpipate ma ah mual ah ka hon phou hi.
english: Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty. You have corrupted your wisdom by reason of your splendor. I have cast you to the ground. I have laid you before kings, that they may see you.

paite: Na sumsin diktatlouhnate ah, na siatna ziak in, na mun siangthoute na hihbuah a, huaiziak in mei ka khah a; na sung a kipan ahong kangbei a, ahon musekte tengteng muh in lei ah leivui ka hon suaksakta.
english: By the multitude of your iniquities, in the unrighteousness of your commerce, you have profaned your sanctuaries. Therefore I have brought out a fire from the middle of you. It has devoured you. I have turned you to ashes on the earth in the sight of all those who see you.

paite: Mite lak a ahon thei peuhmah lamdangsak, launa na hong suakta; na om ngei nawn kei ding," chi in.
english: All those who know you among the peoples will be astonished at you. You have become a terror, and you will exist no more.”’”

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Sidon masuan inla, atungthu gen in.
english: “Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, and prophesy against it,

paite: Hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi: Ka hon nang ahi, aw Sidon, ka hihlang ding, ka thupina; nang ah TOUPA ka hihdan athei ding ua, amah ah vai ka hawm hun chiang in, ka sianthouna ka ensak mahmah ding.
english: and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Sidon. I will be glorified among you. Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I have executed judgments in her, and am sanctified in her.

paite: Akongzing ah sisan leh hipi ka tungsak ding, asung ah miliam apuk ding; mun kil chih a kipan namsau in. Huan TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
english: For I will send pestilence into her, and blood into her streets. The wounded will fall within her, with the sword on her on every side. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.

paite: "Huchi in Israel inkote sun ding loulingnei a-om kei ding a, akim a amau musit mite lak ah hihna ding ling a-omta kei ding; kei Toupa PATHIAN ka hi chih athei ding uh."
english: “‘“There will no longer be a pricking brier to the house of Israel, nor a hurting thorn of any that are around them that scorned them. Then they will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.”

paite: Hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi: "Israel inkote adalhna gam mite lak a kipan ka pikhawm nawn hun chiang in Jakob kiang a ka piak, agam mahmah uah atengta ding uh,
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “When I have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and am shown as holy among them in the sight of the nations, then they will dwell in their own land which I gave to my servant Jacob.

paite: Huchi in bittak in a-omta ding ua; ahi, innte alam ding ua; grephuante abawl ding uh. Bittak in a-om ding ua; akim ua musit mite tengteng tung a vai ka hawm chiang in kei TOUPA a Pathian uh ka hi chih athei ding uh," chi in.
english: They will dwell in it securely. Yes, they will build houses, plant vineyards, and will dwell securely when I have executed judgments on all those around them who have treated them with contempt. Then they will know that I am Yahweh their God.”’”

paite: Akum sawmna, akha sawmna, huai kha ani sawmnihna ah ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
english: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh masuan inla, atung ah leh Aigupta mi tengteng tung ah thu gen in.
english: “Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.

paite: Gen inla, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai in, Aigupta kumpipa, Pharaoh luipite lai ah Olepi thupitak, 'Ka luipi kei a ahi, keimah ngei a dia ka bawl,' chipa ka hon dou ahi.
english: Speak and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great monster that lies in the middle of his rivers, that has said, ‘My river is my own, and I have made it for myself.’

paite: Na haizekte ah ngakuai in ka hon man ding a; luipi a ngasate na lip ding in ka belhsak ding a; luipi lai a kipan na lip ah ngasate tengteng toh ka hon botkhe ding.
english: I will put hooks in your jaws, and I will make the fish of your rivers stick to your scales. I will bring you up out of the middle of your rivers, with all the fish of your rivers which stick to your scales.

paite: Huan gamdai ah ka hon pai ding a, nang leh na luipi a ngasa tengteng leng; gamlak ah na puk ding a; na luang kaihkhop ahi kei ding a, vui na hi sam kei ding; gam sahangte leh tungleng vasate kiang ah an ding in ka hon pia hi.
english: I’ll cast you out into the wilderness, you and all the fish of your rivers. You’ll fall on the open field. You won’t be brought together or gathered. I have given you for food to the animals of the earth and to the birds of the sky.

paite: Israel inkote a dia sialluang chiangkhun lel na hong hih ziak in Aigupta gam a teng tengteng in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
english: “‘“All the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am Yahweh, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.

paite: Khut a ahon let ua, aliangzang uh na tansak a, na satkhia; hon ngai ua, akongte uh kitan a tang lou in na omsak hi.
english: When they took hold of you by your hand, you broke and tore all their shoulders. When they leaned on you, you broke and paralyzed all of their thighs.”

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai in, na tung ah namsau ka hon tun ding a, na lak a kipan mi leh sa ka phukmang ding.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will bring a sword on you, and will cut off man and animal from you.

paite: Huan Aigupta gam, gam segawp leh kho sia ahi mai ding a, kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh. 'Luipi kei a ahi a, ka bawl ahi,' na chih ziak in."
english: The land of Egypt will be a desolation and a waste. Then they will know that I am Yahweh. “‘“Because he has said, ‘The river is mine, and I have made it,’

paite: Huaiziak in ka hon dou ahi, na luipi leng; Seveneh kulh a kipan in Ethiopia gamgi pha in Aigupta gam bel gam segawp leh kho sia in ka bawl ding.
english: therefore, behold, I am against you and against your rivers. I will make the land of Egypt an utter waste and desolation, from the tower of Seveneh even to the border of Ethiopia.

paite: Mihing khe in asik ngei kei ding a, sate leng apai ngei kei ding ua; kum sawmli sung luah in a-om kei ding hi.
english: No foot of man will pass through it, nor will any animal foot pass through it. It won’t be inhabited for forty years.

paite: Aigupta gam segawpte lak a khat in ka bawl ding a, akhopite ka khopi siate lak ah kum sawmli akigawp ding; Aigupta mite namte lak ah ka dalhsak ding a, gam chih ah ka dalhsak ding hi.
english: I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the middle of the countries that are desolate. Her cities among the cities that are laid waste will be a desolation forty years. I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Kum sawmli nung in adalhna munte ua kipan Aigupta mite ka lakhawm nawn ding a;
english: “‘For the Lord Yahweh says: “At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the peoples where they were scattered.

paite: Aigupta mite omdan ka hei ding a, apianna gam uh, Pathros gam ah ka kiksak ding; huchi in huai ah vualleltak in alal ding uh.
english: I will reverse the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their birth. There they will be a lowly kingdom.

paite: Lalna gam a vuallel pen ahi ding, namte lak ah leng akilalsak nawn sam kei ding hi. Namdangte tung a thu aneih nawnlouhna ding un amau ka neusak ding hi.
english: It will be the lowest of the kingdoms. It won’t lift itself up above the nations any more. I will diminish them so that they will no longer rule over the nations.

paite: Amau lam nga peuhmah in athulimlouhna uh atheihkhiakpih ziak in Israelte muanpi ahi nawnta kei ding uh; huan Toupa PATHIAN ka hi chih athei ding uh, achi," chi in.
english: It will no longer be the confidence of the house of Israel, bringing iniquity to memory, when they turn to look after them. Then they will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.”’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akum sawmnih-le-sagihna, akha khatna, huai kha ani khat ni in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi:
english: It came to pass in the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in Tura tung ah na thupitak sem ding in asepaihhon asawl a, michih lu agiauloh a, michih liangzang in adulhloh lai a; himahleh amah leh asepaihhonte'n anasepna uah Tura a kipan punna bangmah amu tuan kei uh.
english: “Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre. Every head was made bald, and every shoulder was worn; yet he had no wages, nor did his army, from Tyre, for the service that he had served against it.

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai in, Aigupta gam Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar kiang ah ka pe ding a, athil hauh ziazuate alamang ding a, alok ding a, agallaksak ding; huai asepaihhonte loh ahi mai ding.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. He will carry off her multitude, take her plunder, and take her prey. That will be the wages for his army.

paite: Ka nna asep ziak un aloh ding un Aigupta gam ka pia hi," Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi.
english: I have given him the land of Egypt as his payment for which he served, because they worked for me,’ says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Huai ni chiang in Israel inkote a ding in kii ka poukhesak ding a; alak uah na kam ka kasak ding hi; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh, chi in.
english: “In that day I will cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel, and I will open your mouth among them. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”

paite: Ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, na muh ne in; laibuzial ne inla, Israel inkote kiang ah thu va gen in," achi hi.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, eat what you find. Eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel.”

paite: Huchi in ka kam ka ka a, laibuzial ahon nesakta hi.
english: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat the scroll.

paite: Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, ka hon piak hiai laibuzial in na gil ah vahsak inla, hiai in na gilsung hihdim in," achi hi. Huchi in ka neta a, akhumdan ka kam ah khuaizu bang ahi hi.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, eat this scroll that I give you and fill your belly and your bowels with it.” Then I ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth.

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa kuan inla, Israel inkote kiang ah ka thute zang in va gen in.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, go to the house of Israel, and speak my words to them.

paite: Pau tuam leh pau haksate kiang a sawl na hi kei a, Israel inkote kiang a sawl na hi zaw a;
english: For you are not sent to a people of a strange speech and of a hard language, but to the house of Israel—

paite: nam pau tuam leh pau haksa athu uh na theihtheihlouhte kiang a sawl na hi kei hi. Akiang ua nang ka hon sawl in pel lou in na thu angaikhe mahmah ding uh.
english: not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words you can’t understand. Surely, if I sent you to them, they would listen to you.

paite: Himahleh Israel inkote'n ahon ngaikhe kei ding ua, kei ahon ngaikhe kei ding uh, Israel inkote tengteng taltangtak leh lungtang genhak mahmah ahi uhi.
english: But the house of Israel will not listen to you, for they will not listen to me; for all the house of Israel are obstinate and hard-hearted.

paite: Huan ngai in, na mai amau mai lak ah khauhsak in, na taltang leng amau taltang sang a takzaw in ka bawl hi.
english: Behold, I have made your face hard against their faces, and your forehead hard against their foreheads.

paite: Suang tak mahmah, meisuang sang a takzaw in na tal ka bawl a, lau ke'nla, amit hah uah lunglel sam ke'n, helhat inkuan himah le uh," achi hi.
english: I have made your forehead as a diamond, harder than flint. Don’t be afraid of them, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house.”

paite: Huai lou leng ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, na kiang a ka thugen ding tengteng na bil in ngaikhia inla, na lungtang ah khum in.
english: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, receive in your heart and hear with your ears all my words that I speak to you.

paite: Kuan inla, na chipih saltangte kiang va tung inla; angaikhia uhiam, angaikhe kei uhiam, 'Hichibang Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi,' chi in gen inla, hilh in," achi hi.
english: Go to them of the captivity, to the children of your people, and speak to them, and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says,’ whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse.”

paite: Huchi in kha in ahon domkangta a, amun a kipan TOUPA thupina adinkhiak lai in, ka nunglam ah zinling thawm ka za hi.
english: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing, saying, “Blessed be Yahweh’s glory from his place.”

paite: Huai tuh thil hingte kha kisukha leh akiang ua kangtalai peite, zinling thawm bang nei ahi uhi.
english: I heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, even the noise of a great rushing.

paite: Huchi in kha in hon domkang a, ahon lamangta a, heh mahmah leh ut lou pipi in ka kuanta hi; TOUPA khut lah ka tung ah ahat ngal a.
english: So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and Yahweh’s hand was strong on me.

paite: Huchi in Telabib a saltangte, Kebar lui a tengte kiang ka va tung a, atutna uah ka tu a; lamdang satak in huai ah ni sagih ka tuta hi.
english: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel Aviv who lived by the river Chebar, and to where they lived; and I sat there overwhelmed among them seven days.

paite: Huchi in ni sagih abei in hichi ahong hi a, ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
english: At the end of seven days, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israel inkote vilpa in nang ka hon sep hi; huchi in ka kam a thu na za ding a, kei sik in amaute vauna na pe ding hi."
english: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them from me.

paite: Migilou kiang a ka thu, "Na si mahmah ding," ka chih a, huai migilou ahinna hum ding a agitlouhna lampi paisan ding a vauna na neih louh a, vauna thu leng na hilh sam louh a, huai migilou agitlouhna a asihleh asisan moh nang lak ah ka hon sik ngeingei ding hi.
english: When I tell the wicked, ‘You will surely die;’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life, that wicked man will die in his iniquity; but I will require his blood at your hand.

paite: Himahleh huai migilou na vau a, agitlouhna apaisan louh a, agitlouhna lampi alehngatsan sam keileh, agitlouhna ah asi ding a, nang bel na hinna na humbit ahi zaw ding hi.
english: Yet if you warn the wicked, and he doesn’t turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.”

paite: "Huan midiktat in adiktatna lehngatsan a gitlouhna ahih a, ama a pukna ka koihleh, asi ding; vauna na neih louh ziak in akhelhna ah asi ding a; athil diktat ahihsate theihgige ahi kei ding; asisan moh ahihleh na lak ah ka hon sik ding hi.
english: “Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I lay a stumbling block before him, he will die. Because you have not given him warning, he will die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he has done will not be remembered; but I will require his blood at your hand.

paite: Himahleh midiktat khial lou ding a na vauhilh a, akhelh keileh vauna akhawksak ziak in ahing ding; nang leng na hinna na humbit ding hi," achi hi.
english: Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man, that the righteous not sin, and he does not sin, he will surely live, because he took warning; and you have delivered your soul.”

paite: Huan huai ah TOUPA khut ka tung ah a-om a, ka kiang ah, "Thou inla, phaizang ah pai inla, huai ah ka hon houpih ding," achi a. Huchi in ka thou a, phaizang ah ka paita hi.
english: Yahweh’s hand was there on me; and he said to me, “Arise, go out into the plain, and I will talk with you there.”

paite: Ngai in, huai ah TOUPA thupina, Kebar lui a ka muh thupina bang ahong dingh a, kei ka khuppukta hi.
english: Then I arose, and went out into the plain, and behold, Yahweh’s glory stood there, like the glory which I saw by the river Chebar. Then I fell on my face.

paite: Huchi in kei ah kha ahong lut a, ka khe in ahon dingsak a, ahon houpih a, "Pai inla, na inn ah kikhakkhum in.
english: Then the Spirit entered into me and set me on my feet. He spoke with me, and said to me, “Go, shut yourself inside your house.

paite: Nang zaw, mihing tapa, khauhual in ahon khih ding ua, ahon gak ding ua, alak uah na pawtkhe nawn kei ding.
english: But you, son of man, behold, they will put ropes on you, and will bind you with them, and you will not go out among them.

paite: Na dangtawng ah na lei ka belhsak ding a, na pau nawn kei ding a, amaute salpa na hi nawn kei ding; helhat inkuan ahi ngal ua."
english: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be mute and will not be able to correct them, for they are a rebellious house.

paite: Himahleh na kiang a thu ka gen hun chiang in na kam ka hon ka sak ding a, akiang uah, "Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: 'Angaikhia in ngaikhia henla, angaikhe lou in ngaikhe kei hen, helhat inkuan ahi ngal ua, achi, " chi in na gen ding hi.
english: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall tell them, ‘This is what the Lord Yahweh says.’ He who hears, let him hear; and he who refuses, let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
english: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, thu gen inla, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi.
english: “Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Wail, ‘Alas for the day!’

paite: "Kikou un, maizen! Maizen, tua ni tel; ni anai hi, TOUPA ni anai hi, mei kai ni, pau tuam mite siatna ding.
english: For the day is near, even Yahweh’s day is near. It will be a day of clouds, a time of the nations.

paite: Ahong tung ding, namsau, Aigupta tung ah; sinlai natna, Ethiopia tung ah, Aigupta ah mithah apuk un; athil hauh ziazuate alamang ding ua, asuangphumte achimse ding."
english: A sword will come on Egypt, and anguish will be in Ethiopia, when the slain fall in Egypt. They take away her multitude, and her foundations are broken down.

paite: "Ethiopia, Pud leh Lud, nam chih omkhawm, Kush leh gam tate tel teite tengteng, namsau in apuk ding uh.”
english: “‘“Ethiopia, Put, Lud, all the mixed people, Cub, and the children of the land that is allied with them, will fall with them by the sword.”

paite: "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Aigupta tungding mite leng apuk ding ua, ahatna suanpen uh leng avuallel ding; Migdol a kipan Suene pha in namsau in apuk ding uh, Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi.
english: “‘Yahweh says: “They also who uphold Egypt will fall. The pride of her power will come down. They will fall by the sword in it from the tower of Seveneh,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Gam hihgawpsate lak a khat ahi ding a, akhopite leng khopi gawpsate lak a ahi mai ding uh.
english: “They will be desolate in the middle of the countries that are desolate. Her cities will be among the cities that are wasted.

paite: Aigupta gam ah mei ka khah ding a, amau panpih mite tengteng ka hihsiat hun chiang in TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.”
english: They will know that I am Yahweh when I have set a fire in Egypt, and all her helpers are destroyed.

paite: Huai ni chiang in Ethiopia mi kigingloute lunglelsak ding in ka kiang a kipan mi sawl long in apai ding ua; Aigupta ni mah bang in lungtang mangbatna mahmah atung uah atung sam ding hi; ngai in, ahong tung lellel hi.
english: “‘“In that day messengers will go out from before me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid. There will be anguish on them, as in the day of Egypt; for, behold, it comes.”

paite: "Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar khut in Aigupta thil hauh ziazuate ka hihmang ding.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease, by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.

paite: Gam hihse ding in amah leh alawite, namte lak a kihtakte tunsak ahi ding uh; Aigupta tung ah anamsau uh alik ding ua, misi luang in gam adimsak ding uh.
english: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, will be brought in to destroy the land. They will draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.

paite: Huan luipite ka kangsak ding a, migiloute kiang ah gam ka khawng ding; agam leh asung a om tengteng pau tuam mite khut in ka hihgawp ding; kei TOUPA'N ka chita ahi.
english: I will make the rivers dry, and will sell the land into the hand of evil men. I will make the land desolate, and all that is therein, by the hand of foreigners. I, Yahweh, have spoken it.”

paite: "Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Milimte ka hihse ding a, Memphis a kipan milimte ka hihmang ding, Aigupta ah heutu a-omta kei ding uh; huchi in Aigupta gam ah launa ka omsak ding.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause the images to cease from Memphis. There will be no more a prince from the land of Egypt. I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.

paite: "Pathros ka hihgawp ding a, Zoan ah mei ka khah dia; Thebes ah ka tangtungsak ding.
english: I will make Pathros desolate, and will set a fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments on No.

paite: Huan Aigupta kulh Sin tung ah ka hehna ka lungdamsak ding a, Thebes a mipite ka phukmang ding.
english: I will pour my wrath on Sin, the stronghold of Egypt. I will cut off the multitude of No.

paite: Huan Aigupta ah mei ka khah ding a, buaitak in Sin a-om ding a, Thebes leng achim vek ding; Memphis in sun chiang in melma anei nilouh ding hi.
english: I will set a fire in Egypt Sin will be in great anguish. No will be broken up. Memphis will have adversaries in the daytime.

paite: Aven leh Pibeseth kho tangvalte namsau in apuk ding ua, huai khuate sal a pi in a-om ding uh.
english: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth will fall by the sword. They will go into captivity.

paite: Aigupta hakkol ka hihtan a, ahatna akisaktheihpih ka hihbei hun Tehphanhes ah ni amial ding; amah zaw meipi in aliah ding a, atanute sal a pi in a-om ding uh.
