english: At Tehaphnehes also the day will withdraw itself, when I break the yokes of Egypt there. The pride of her power will cease in her. As for her, a cloud will cover her, and her daughters will go into captivity.

paite: Hichibang in Aigupta gam ah thu ka tangtungsak ding; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh," chi in.
english: Thus I will execute judgments on Egypt. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akum sawm-le-khatna, akha khatna, huai kha ani sagih ni in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
english: In the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh ban ka kitansak a, ngai in, namsau tawi ding ahat nawnna ding in damdawi nuh leh tuam aloh kei hi.
english: “Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. Behold, it has not been bound up, to apply medicines, to put a bandage to bind it, that it may become strong to hold the sword.

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai in Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh ka dou ahi, aban hoih lam leh akitansa nunglam leng ka kitansak ding a; huchi in akhut a kipan namsau ka kitansak ding hi.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong arm, and that which was broken. I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.

paite: Aigupta mite namte lak ah ka dalhsak ding a, gam chih ah ka thelthangsak ding.
english: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

paite: Babulon kumpipa bante ka hatsak ding a, akhut ah namsau ka tawisak ding a; Pharaoh bante ka kitansak ding a, ama ah sihpih khop liam mau in amau ding hi.
english: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand; but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before the king of Babylon with the groaning of a mortally wounded man.

paite: Huchi in Babulon kumpipa bante ka hatsak ding a, Pharaoh bante bel aluaikhe ding; Babulon kumpipa khut ah ka namsau ka tawisak a, Aigupta kumpipa tung a alik hun chiang in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
english: I will hold up the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh will fall down. Then they will know that I am Yahweh when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he stretches it out on the land of Egypt.

paite: Aigupta mite namte lak ah ka dalhsak ding a, gam chih ah ka thelthangsak vek ding; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh," chi in.
english: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the countries. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akum sawm-le-khatna, akha thumna, huai kha ani khat ni in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
english: In the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh leh akhua leh amite kiang ah gen inla: Na thupina ah kua toh na kibang a ahia?
english: “Son of man, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt and his multitude: ‘Whom are you like in your greatness?

paite: "Ngai in, Assuria tuh Lebanon a sidar ahi a, hiang kilawm leh bawkpha, lim sah, sang kilawm, mei lak ah adawn a-om hi.
english: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with beautiful branches, and with a forest-like shade, of high stature; and its top was among the thick boughs.

paite: Tui in ahon vak a, tui thuk in akhangsak hulhul, aphuhna luite'n aluan kual ua, gam sing chih vakna ding in aluangsak hi.
english: The waters nourished it. The deep made it to grow. Its rivers ran all around its plantation. It sent out its channels to all the trees of the field.

paite: Huchi in gam sing teng zou in asang tuan a; tuite akidaih zoh ziak in akungpite khanglian in, ahiangte asau ua amengkhesak hi.
english: Therefore its stature was exalted above all the trees of the field; and its boughs were multiplied. Its branches became long by reason of many waters, when it spread them out.

paite: Ahiang ah tungleng vasate'n bu abawl ua; ahiang nuai ah sa chiteng in nou anei ua; alimnuai ah nam thupi teng ateng uhi.
english: All the birds of the sky made their nests in its boughs. Under its branches, all the animals of the field gave birth to their young. All great nations lived under its shadow.

paite: Huchi in athupina ah akilawm a, ahiangte sauna bang zel in; azungte lah tui tampite kiang ah a-om ngal a,
english: Thus it was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its branches; for its root was by many waters.

paite: Pathian huan a sidar singte'n aphazou kei ua; abawk, meilah sing in adem zou kei a; ahiang sesing in aphazou sam kei; akilawmna ah Pathian huan a sing abang zou kei hi.
english: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide it. The cypress trees were not like its branches. The pine trees were not like its branches; nor was any tree in the garden of God like it in its beauty.

paite: Ahiang tamsak in ka bawlhoih a, Pathian huan a Eden sing teng in ahaza uhi," chi in.
english: I made it beautiful by the multitude of its branches, so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied it.’

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Ahong san mahmah a, meipi lak a adawn alen a, alungtang a asandan akisaktheihpih ziak in,
english: “Therefore thus said the Lord Yahweh: ‘Because he is exalted in stature, and he has set his top among the thick branches, and his heart is lifted up in his height,

paite: namte lak ah mihattak khut ah ka mansak ding a; athulimlouhdan bang in agawt ding a, ka delhkhe ding.
english: I will deliver him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations. He will surely deal with him. I have driven him out for his wickedness.

paite: Huchi in gamdangmi, namte lak a kihtakhuai mahmahte'n aphuk ding ua, anuse ding uh; tangte, phaizangte ah ahiangte ake lemlum ding a, huai gam tuiluanna phaizang tengteng ah ahiangte akitan lemlum ding; leitung a mi tengteng alimnuai a kipan apawtkhe ding ua, amah apaisan ding uh.
english: Foreigners, the tyrants of the nations, have cut him off and have left him. His branches have fallen on the mountains and in all the valleys, and his boughs are broken by all the watercourses of the land. All the peoples of the earth have gone down from his shadow and have left him.

paite: Asiatna ah tungleng vasa tengteng ateng ding ua, abawk tung ah gamsate a-om ding uh.
english: All the birds of the sky will dwell on his ruin, and all the animals of the field will be on his branches,

paite: Hiai bel tui a vak sing tengteng akisansak louh ua, adawn uh meipi kal a lengsak lou a, tui a vak sing in asandan uh asuan samlouhna ding uh ahi; lei mun nuainungpen a kokhuk a paisukta, mihing tate lak ah pai ding in, sihna a matsak ahi vekta ngal ua."
english: to the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves in their stature, and don’t set their top among the thick boughs. Their mighty ones don’t stand up on their height, even all who drink water; for they are all delivered to death, to the lower parts of the earth, among the children of men, with those who go down to the pit.’

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Sheol a apaisuk ni in amah ka sunsak a, luitui thuktakte ka khawlsak a; huai ah tui tampi let dingte ka daltan a; Lebanon amah ka sunsak lai a; gam sing tengteng amah ziak in agim khin uhi.
english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘In the day when he went down to Sheol, I caused a mourning. I covered the deep for him, and I restrained its rivers. The great waters were stopped. I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.

paite: Namte leng apuk ging ah ka lingsak a, kokhuk a paisuksate kiang a Sheol a ka paihkhiak ni in; Eden sing tengteng, Lebanon sing hoih tata, tui a vak tengteng lei nuainungpen ah lungmuang in a-omta uhi.
english: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to Sheol with those who descend into the pit. All the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, were comforted in the lower parts of the earth.

paite: Namsau a thahte kiang ah Sheol ah apaisuk ua; ahi, namte lak a, alimnuai a tengte leh namte lak a akizoppihte toh hankhuk atungsuk uhi."
english: They also went down into Sheol with him to those who are slain by the sword; yes, those who were his arm, who lived under his shadow in the middle of the nations.

paite: "Thupina leh letna ah Eden singte lak a kua ahia nang bang om? Himahleh Eden singte toh lei mun nuainungpen ah paihkhiak na hi ding; namsau a thah, zeksumlouhte lak ah na lum ding hi. Hiai bel Pharaoh leh akhua-le-tuite ahi uh," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: “‘To whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? Yet you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the lower parts of the earth. You will lie in the middle of the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword. “‘This is Pharaoh and all his multitude,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

paite: Huan hiai ahi, akum sawm-le-nihna, akha sawm-le-nihna, huai kha ani khat ni in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi:
english: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: Mihing tapa, Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh suunna la phuak inla, akiang ah, "Namte humpinelkai lun lai kibatpih; tuipi a olepi na bang zaw hi; na nak a tuite phuansak in, na khe in na toknin a, aluite uh na ninsak vekta.
english: “Son of man, take up a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and tell him, ‘You were likened to a young lion of the nations; yet you are as a monster in the seas. You broke out with your rivers, and troubled the waters with your feet, and fouled their rivers.’”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: ka len in ka hon khuh ding a, mi tampi toh, ka len in nang ahon man ngeingei ding uh.
english: The Lord Yahweh says: “I will spread out my net on you with a company of many peoples. They will bring you up in my net.

paite: Gamlak ah ka hon nuse ding a, gamlak ah ka hon pai ding; tung a leng tengteng ka samkhawm ding a, na tung ah; nang in leitung pumpi gamsa ka taisak ding hi.
english: I will leave you on the land. I will cast you out on the open field, and will cause all the birds of the sky to settle on you. I will satisfy the animals of the whole earth with you.

paite: Tang chih ah na sa ka lui ding a; na luang in phaizangte ka dimsak ding.
english: I will lay your flesh on the mountains, and fill the valleys with your height.

paite: Na tenna gam tang tan in, na sisan in ka sil ding a, phaizang chih leng nangmah in adim ding hi.
english: I will also water the land in which you swim with your blood, even to the mountains. The watercourses will be full of you.

paite: Ka hon chimihsak hun chiang in, van ka khuh in aksi ka mialsak ding a; meipi in nisa ka liahmang ding; huan kha in avakna asuah kei ding hi.
english: When I extinguish you, I will cover the heavens and make its stars dark. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon won’t give its light.

paite: Na tung ah van a vak tengteng ka mialsak ding a; na gam ah khomial ka lengsak ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi,” chi in.
english: I will make all the bright lights of the sky dark over you, and set darkness on your land,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Na theih louh gam a namte lak a na siatna ka tunsak hun chiang in mi tampite lungtang ka lungzingsak ding.
english: “I will also trouble the hearts of many peoples, when I bring your destruction among the nations, into the countries which you have not known.

paite: Ahi, mi tampi nangmah ah lamdang sa in ka bawl ding a, ama ua ka namsau ka leh hun chiang in nang ziak in akumpipate uh leng mulkimhuai asa un alau mahmah ding uh; na puk ni in michih in ahinna uh tan lau in alingling ding uhi.
english: Yes, I will make many peoples amazed at you, and their kings will be horribly afraid for you, when I brandish my sword before them. They will tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of your fall.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi ngal a; Babulon kumpipa namsau na tung ah ahong tung dek hi.
english: For the Lord Yahweh says: “The sword of the king of Babylon will come on you.

paite: Na mite ka puksak ding, galhat mite namsau in, namte lak a kihtakhuai pente ahi ua, ahihse ding uh. Aigupta mite thupina, amipite tengteng ahihmang ding uh.
english: I will cause your multitude to fall by the swords of the mighty. They are all the ruthless of the nations. They will bring the pride of Egypt to nothing, and all its multitude will be destroyed.

paite: Tui tampi gei gamsa teng ka hihmang ding a; mi khete'n angap ninta kei ding; gamsa khete'n leng angap nin sam kei ding hi.
english: I will destroy also all its animals from beside many waters. The foot of man won’t trouble them any more, nor will the hoofs of animals trouble them.

paite: Huchi in tui ka chimsak ding a, ka luangsak ding, luite, sathau bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: Then I will make their waters clear, and cause their rivers to run like oil,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Aigupta gam ka hihsegawp ding a, ahauhna tengteng ah vuaktang in, asung a tengte ka phukmang hun in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ngei ding uh.
english: “When I make the land of Egypt desolate and waste, a land destitute of that of which it was full, when I strike all those who dwell therein, then they will know that I am Yahweh.

paite: Hiai akahla ding uh ahi; namte tanute'n hiai kah in Aigupta leh ami tengteng asuun ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: “‘“This is the lamentation with which they will lament. The daughters of the nations will lament with this. They will lament with it over Egypt, and over all her multitude,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akum sawm-le-nihna, huai kha ani sawm-le-nga ni in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
english: Also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Aigupta mipite kah ekek inla, amah leh nam minthangtak tanu kokhuk a paisuk khinte toh lei nuainung lam ah paikhia in.
english: “Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her and the daughters of the famous nations, to the lower parts of the earth, with those who go down into the pit.

paite: “Kilawmna ah kua akhup a? Paisuk inla zeksumlouhte lak ah lum in.
english: Whom do you pass in beauty? Go down, and be laid with the uncircumcised.

paite: "Namsau a thahsate lak ah apuk ding ua, namsau kiang a piak ahi khin ua, amah leh amite tengteng kaimang un.
english: They will fall among those who are slain by the sword. She is delivered to the sword. Draw her away with all her multitudes.

paite: Sheol a om galhatmi mahmahte'n amah leh apanpih mite ahoupih ding ua; apaisuk ua, alum nilouh uh, namsau a thah, zeksumlouhte.
english: The strong among the mighty will speak to him out of the middle of Sheol with those who help him. They have gone down. The uncircumcised lie still, slain by the sword.

paite: "Huai ah Assuria leh aheute tengteng a-om ua; ahante uh amah kim ah a-om a; avek un thah, namsau a puk vek ahi uh.
english: “Asshur is there with all her company. Her graves are all around her. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword,

paite: Ahante uh kokhuk thukpen ah a-om a, ahan kim ah aheute a-om uh; avek ua thah, namsau a puk vek, mihing gam galmuangsak lou mite ahi uh.
english: whose graves are set in the uttermost parts of the pit, and her company is around her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who caused terror in the land of the living.

paite: "Huai ah Elam leh ahan kim ah aheute a-om ua; avek ua, namsau a puk, lei nuainung a zeksum louh apaisuk ua, mihing gam galmuangsak lou mite, azahlakna uh kokhuk a paipih sukte ahi uhi.
english: “There is Elam and all her multitude around her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who have gone down uncircumcised into the lower parts of the earth, who caused their terror in the land of the living, and have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit.

paite: Mithahte lak ah amah leh aheute lupna abawlsak ua, ahante amah kim ah a-om a; avek un zeksum louh, namsau a thah ahi ua; akihtakhuaina uh mihing gam gallauna ahi nak a; kokhuk a paisuktate toh azahlakna uh apua ua, mithahte lak ah a-omsak uhi.
english: They have made Elam a bed among the slain with all her multitude. Her graves are around her, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for their terror was caused in the land of the living, and they have borne their shame with those who go down to the pit. He is put among those who are slain.

paite: "Huai ah Meshek leh Tubal, aheute uh toh a-om ua; ahante uh amau kim ah a-om a; avek un zeksum louh, namsau a thah ahi uh; akihtakhuaina un mihing gam ahihmang zel hi.
english: “There is Meshech, Tubal, and all their multitude. Their graves are around them, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for they caused their terror in the land of the living.

paite: Zeksum louh, mihat pukte, kidouna galvan toh Sheol a paisuktate, anamsau uh lukham a nei, aguhte uh tung a alum uh omte kiang ah alum kei uh; amau lah mihing gam a mihatte launa ahi.
english: They will not lie with the mighty who are fallen of the uncircumcised, who have gone down to Sheol with their weapons of war and have laid their swords under their heads. Their iniquities are on their bones; for they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.

paite: "Nang zaw zeksumlouhte lak ah kitan lemlum in na om ding a, namsau a site kiang ah na lum ding hi.
english: “But you will be broken among the uncircumcised, and will lie with those who are slain by the sword.

paite: "Huai ah Edom, akumpipate leh aheutute tengteng a-om ua; ahatna ua; namsau a thahte lak ah asial uh hi; zeksum louh, kokhuk a paisuksate kiang alum uhi.
english: “There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, who in their might are laid with those who are slain by the sword. They will lie with the uncircumcised, and with those who go down to the pit.

paite: "Huai ah mallam heutute, avek un, Sidon mi tengteng, thahte lak a paisuksate a-om ua, ahatna un mi agallausak nak a, azum ua, zeksum louh in namsau a thahte lak ah alum ua; kokhuk a paisuk khinte toh azahlak khawmta uhi.
english: “There are the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who have gone down with the slain. They are put to shame in the terror which they caused by their might. They lie uncircumcised with those who are slain by the sword, and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.

paite: "Pharaoh in amaute amu ding a, amite tengteng a lungmuan loh ding, Pharaoh leh asepaihhon tengteng, namsau a thahte ngei leng, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: “Pharaoh will see them and will be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: "Mihing gam ah gallauna alengsak a, zeksum louh, namsau a thahte lak ah alum ding uhi, Pharaoh leh ami tengteng ngei, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi,” achi hi.
english: “For I have put his terror in the land of the living. He will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, na nam tate kiang ah thu gen inla, akiang uah, gam tung a namsau ka hon tutleh gam mite'n alak ua pat mi khat atelkhiak ua, galvilmi dia akoih uleh,
english: “Son of man, speak to the children of your people, and tell them, ‘When I bring the sword on a land, and the people of the land take a man from among them, and set him for their watchman,

paite: ama'n gam tung a namsau hong tung amuhleh pengkul amut ding a, mipite akigalgingsak ding hi.
english: if, when he sees the sword come on the land, he blows the trumpet and warns the people,

paite: Huchi in pengkul ging za a poisaloumi kuapeuh, namsau hong tung in manloh tamahleh, asisan moh amah mah in apo ding ahi.
english: then whoever hears the sound of the trumpet and doesn’t heed the warning, if the sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.

paite: Pengkul ging azak a apoisak louh ziak in asisan moh akipuak mai ding ahi; ana poisakleh bel ahinna ahumbit ding ahi.
english: He heard the sound of the trumpet and didn’t take warning. His blood will be on him; whereas if he had heeded the warning, he would have delivered his soul.

paite: Himahleh galvilmi in namsau hong tung amuh a, apengkul amut louh a, mipite akigalgin louh ua, namsau ahong tun a, alak ua mi kuahiam in amanlohleh athulimlouhna in amangthang ding a, galvilmi khut ah asisan phu ka ngiat ding," chi in.
english: But if the watchman sees the sword come and doesn’t blow the trumpet, and the people aren’t warned, and the sword comes and takes any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity, but his blood I will require at the watchman’s hand.’

paite: Huchibang in nang, mihing tapa, Israel inkote a dia galvilmi dia ka hon bawl na hi; huaiziak in ka kam a thupawt ngaikhia inla, ka kiang a kipan kigalginna ding thu akiang uah hilh in.
english: “So you, son of man, I have set you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and give them warnings from me.

paite: Migilou kiang ah, "Aw migilou, si mahmah ding na hi," ka chih a, migilou a-omdan paisan ding a na hilh keileh migilou agitlouhna ah asi ding a, asisan phu bel nang a kipan ka la ding.
english: When I tell the wicked, ‘O wicked man, you will surely die,’ and you don’t speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man will die in his iniquity, but I will require his blood at your hand.

paite: Himahleh migilou a-omdan paisan ding a na hilh a, a-omdan apaisan kei laileh, agitlouhna ah asi ding a, nang bel na hinna na humbit ding hi.
english: Nevertheless, if you warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he doesn’t turn from his way; he will die in his iniquity, but you have delivered your soul.

paite: Huan mihing tapa, nang Israel inkote kiang ah thu gen inla, hichibang in na chi ua, "Ka tatleknate uh leh ka khelhnate un ahon delhkhum a, huaiziak in ka thanggawp uh ahi, bangchi in ka hing nilouh thei ding ua?" na chi uhi.
english: “You, son of man, tell the house of Israel: ‘You say this, “Our transgressions and our sins are on us, and we pine away in them. How then can we live?”’

paite: Kei ka hin bang in, migilou sihna ah kipahna ka nei kei a, migilou in a-omdan apaisan a ahin ka kipah lam ahi zaw. Na omdan hoih lou ua kipan kik un, kik un, Aw Israel inkote, bangziak a si ding na hi ua? chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in gen in.
english: Tell them, ‘“As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live. Turn, turn from your evil ways! For why will you die, house of Israel?”’

paite: "Nang, mihing tapa, na nam tate kiang ah gen inla, midiktat diktanna in atatlekna ni in amah ahumbit kei ding a, migilou gitlouhna in leng athulimlouhna alehngatsan ni in apuksak kei ding a, midiktat lah akhelhna ni in adiktatna in ahing thei tuan sam kei ding.
english: “You, son of man, tell the children of your people, ‘The righteousness of the righteous will not deliver him in the day of his disobedience. And as for the wickedness of the wicked, he will not fall by it in the day that he turns from his wickedness; neither will he who is righteous be able to live by it in the day that he sins.

paite: Midiktat kiang ah, na hing ngeingei ding, chih ka gen in, adiktatna muang a thil ahihkhelhleh athil dik hih khat leng theihgige ahi kei ding; athilhihkhelhsa ah asi zaw ding.
english: When I tell the righteous that he will surely live, if he trusts in his righteousness and commits iniquity, none of his righteous deeds will be remembered; but he will die in his iniquity that he has committed.

paite: Huan migilou kiang ah, 'Na si ngeingei ding,' ka chih nawn leuleu in, agitlouhnate alehngatsan a asiang leh adik ana hih a,
english: Again, when I say to the wicked, “You will surely die,” if he turns from his sin and does that which is lawful and right,

paite: migilou in mi koih khamnate pekik a, athilgukte apiak nawn a, hinna dante azuih a, thulimlouhna bangmah ahihkeileh ahing ngeingei ding a, asi kei ding hi.
english: if the wicked restore the pledge, give again that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no iniquity, he will surely live. He will not die.

paite: Khelhna ana hihsa bangmah theihgige ahita kei ding a, asiang leh adik ana hihta a, ahing ngeingei ding hi.
english: None of his sins that he has committed will be remembered against him. He has done that which is lawful and right. He will surely live.

paite: "Himahleh na nam tate'n, 'TOUPA thilhihdan akikim kei,' achih un amau hihdan adiktat kei zaw hi.
english: “‘Yet the children of your people say, “The way of the Lord is not fair;” but as for them, their way is not fair.

paite: Midiktat in adiktatna alehngatsan a, thil gilou ana hihleh huaiziak in asi mai ding.
english: When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he will even die therein.

paite: Huan migilou in agitlouhna alehngatsan a, asiang leh adik ahihleh huaiziak in ahing ding.
english: When the wicked turns from his wickedness and does that which is lawful and right, he will live by it.

paite: Himahleh, 'TOUPA hihdan akikim kei,' na chi ua, aw Israel inkote michih noumau hihdan bang in vai ka hon hawmsak ding hi," achi hi.
english: Yet you say, “The way of the Lord is not fair.” House of Israel, I will judge every one of you after his ways.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, i saltan akum sawm-le-nihna, akha sawmna, huai kha ani nga ni in Jerusalem a kipan taikhia mi khat ka kiang ah ahong pai a, "Khopi zoh ahita," ahong chi hi.
english: In the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, one who had escaped out of Jerusalem came to me, saying, “The city has been defeated!”

paite: Huai mi taikhia ahong tun ma nitaklam in TOUPA'N ka tung ah akhut anga a; zinglam a ka kiang a hong pai in ka kam ahon kasak a, huchi in ka kam ka ka a, pau thei lou in ka om nawnta kei hi.
english: Now Yahweh’s hand had been on me in the evening, before he who had escaped came; and he had opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no longer mute.

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israel gam a mun segawpsa nung a omte'n, 'Abraham khat ahi a, gam aluah a; eite bel tampi i hi ua, gam gouluah ding a piak hita ve hang,' chi in agen uhi.
english: “Son of man, those who inhabit the waste places in the land of Israel speak, saying, ‘Abraham was one, and he inherited the land; but we are many. The land is given us for inheritance.’

paite: Huaiziak in akiang uah Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: 'Sa sisan na ne ua, na milimte uh lam ah na mitte uh na lengtousak ua; sisan na suah ua, noute'n gam na tang ding uh maw?
english: Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “You eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood. So should you possess the land?

paite: Na namsau uh na muang ua; thilkihhuai na hih ua; michih in invengpa zi na hihbuah ua; noute'n gam na tang ding uh maw?'
english: You stand on your sword, you work abomination, and every one of you defiles his neighbor’s wife. So should you possess the land?”’

paite: Hichibang a akiang ua na gen ding ahi, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: 'Kei ka hin bang in, mun segawpsa nung a omte namsau in apuk ngeingei ding ua, gamlak a omte sahang kiang ah nek khit dia pe ding ka hi; kulh kip leh khuk a omte hipi in asi ding uh.
english: “You shall tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “As I live, surely those who are in the waste places will fall by the sword. I will give whoever is in the open field to the animals to be devoured, and those who are in the strongholds and in the caves will die of the pestilence.

paite: Gam leng ka hihsia in, mulkimhuaitak in ka bawl ding a; athilhihtheihna, akisaktheihpih abeita ding; Israel tangte asegawp ding a, kuamah avialvak nawnta kei ding uh.
english: I will make the land a desolation and an astonishment. The pride of her power will cease. The mountains of Israel will be desolate, so that no one will pass through.

paite: Thilkihhuai ahih ziak ua gam ka hihgawp a, mulkimhuaitak a ka bawl hun chiang in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.' ”
english: Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment because of all their abominations which they have committed.”’

paite: Huan nang, mihing tapa, baang bul ah kongpite ah na nam tate'n ahon ngen susup ding ua, michih in a-unaute kiang ah, "Kisa dih ua, TOUPA kiang a kipan thupawt i ngaikhe ding uh, akichi ding uh.
english: “As for you, son of man, the children of your people talk about you by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak to one another, everyone to his brother, saying, ‘Please come and hear what the word is that comes out from Yahweh.’

paite: Huchi in ahonhon in na kiang ah ahong pai ding ua, ka mite bang mai in na ma ah ahong tu ding ua, na thu ahong ngaikhe ding ua, himahleh azui tuan kei ding uh; akam un itna thupitak ahihlang ding ua, alungtang un bel punna lam azuan ding.
english: They come to you as the people come, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear your words, but don’t do them; for with their mouth they show much love, but their heart goes after their gain.

paite: Ngai in, nang bel amau a ding in itna la, kilawmtak a sak leh tum bang na hi ding; na thute angaikhia ua, himahleh azui tuan kei ding uh.
english: Behold, you are to them as a very lovely song of one who has a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument; for they hear your words, but they don’t do them.

paite: Hiai ahong tun hun chiang in ngai in, ahong tung lellel ahi, alak uah zawlnei a-om chih athei ding uhi, chi in," achi hi.
english: “When this comes to pass—behold, it comes—then they will know that a prophet has been among them.”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a:
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israelte belamchingte tung ah thu gen in, thu gen inla, akiang uah, belamchingte kiang mahmah ah, huchi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi: Israelte belam-ching, amau kivak maimahte tung agik hi; belamchingte'n belamte vak lou ding ahi uhia?
english: “Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy, and tell them, even the shepherds, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Woe to the shepherds of Israel who feed themselves! Shouldn’t the shepherds feed the sheep?

paite: Athaute na ne ua, amul in na kizem ua; athauthau na gou ua, belamte na vak kei uhi.
english: You eat the fat. You clothe yourself with the wool. You kill the fatlings, but you don’t feed the sheep.

paite: Natna veite, avakmangte na hon pi kei ua; amangte na zong kei ua; khauhtak leh na mahmah in na thunun zaw uh.
english: You haven’t strengthened the diseased. You haven’t healed that which was sick. You haven’t bound up that which was broken. You haven’t brought back that which was driven away. You haven’t sought that which was lost, but you have ruled over them with force and with rigor.

paite: Belampute a-om louh ziak un dalhsak in ana omta ua; ana dalh ua, gam sahangte an lel ahong hita uhi.
english: They were scattered, because there was no shepherd. They became food to all the animals of the field, and were scattered.

paite: Ka belamte tang chih leh mual chih ah avakmang ua; ahi, ka belamte leitung tengteng ah ana dalh khin uh; limsakmi leh zongmi a-om kei uh, chi in gen in," achi hi.
english: My sheep wandered through all the mountains and on every high hill. Yes, my sheep were scattered on all the surface of the earth. There was no one who searched or sought.”

paite: Huaiziak in belamchingte aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia un;
english: “‘Therefore, you shepherds, hear Yahweh’s word:

paite: Kei ka hin bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, belamching a-om louh ua, belamchingte'n ka belamte azon louh ua, belamchingte'n ka belamte avak louh ua, amau akivak zawksop ziak un ka belamte gam sahangte an lel ahong hi ua; ka belamte samat lel ahong hi petmah uh.
english: “As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “surely because my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became food to all the animals of the field, because there was no shepherd, and my shepherds didn’t search for my sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves, and didn’t feed my sheep,

paite: Huaiziak in nou belamchingte aw, TOUPA thu za un.
english: therefore, you shepherds, hear Yahweh’s word!”

paite: Hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi: Ngai un, belamchingte ka dou ahi; akhut ua kipan ka belamte ka sut ding a, ka belamte akepna uh ka tawpsak ding a, belamchingte leng amau akivakta kei ding uh; a-angsung ua kipan ka belamte ka lakhe ding a, amau dia nek ding ahih nawnlouhna ding un, chi in.
english: The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against the shepherds. I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep. The shepherds won’t feed themselves any more. I will deliver my sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.”

paite: Hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi ngal a: Ngai un, kei, kei mahmah in ka zong ding a, ka zongkhe ding hi.
english: “‘For the Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I myself, even I, will search for my sheep, and will seek them out.

paite: Belamching in abelam dalhte lak a abelamhonte azon lai bang in ka belamte ka zongkhe ding; khonim ni leh mial nuai a adalhna tengteng ua kipan ka zongkhe ding,
english: As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so I will seek out my sheep. I will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

paite: Huan mite lak a kipan ka lakhe ding a; gam chih a kipan ka kaikhawm ding a; amau gam ngei ah ka pilut ding; Israel tangte ah, lui geite ah, mi tenna mun tengtengte ah ka tasak ding.
english: I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the watercourses, and in all the inhabited places of the country.

paite: Loupa hoihna munte ah ka tasak ding a; ahuangsung uh Israel tang sangte ah a-om ding; huang hoihtak sung ah leng a-om ding ua, Israel tang tung a loupa dawng munte ah ata ding uh.
english: I will feed them with good pasture, and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will lie down in a good fold. They will feed on rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.

paite: Kei mahmah in ka belamte ka vak ding a; ka kualsak kinken ding a, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Amang ka zong ding a, delhmangte ka pikik nawn ding a, akhe kitante uh ka tuam ding a, ka hatsak ding; athau leh ahatte leng ka ching ding a; diktak in ka vak ding hi.
english: “I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick; but I will destroy the fat and the strong. I will feed them in justice.”’

paite: Huan nou tungthu ahihleh, aw ka belamhonte, hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi: Ngai un, ka belamte kal thu ka gensak ding a, belamtalte, keltalte leng.
english: “As for you, O my flock, the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the male goats.

paite: Gantatna mun hoihtak tung a tat nou ding in thil bang tham lou bang alang in, na tatna neihsun na chilse zosop uh ahi maw?
english: Does it seem a small thing to you to have fed on the good pasture, but you must tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture? And to have drunk of the clear waters, but must you foul the residue with your feet?

paite: Huan tuichim mahmahte na dawn khit un na ngap nin mawkmawk uh ahi maw? Ka belamte'n na siksa uh ane un, na ngahsa uh adawn ding uh maw?
english: As for my sheep, they eat that which you have trodden with your feet, and they drink that which you have fouled with your feet.’

paite: Huaiziak in hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in akiang uah achi: Ngai un, kei, kei mahmah in gan gawngte leh gan thaute kal thu ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says to them: ‘Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.

paite: Ahatloute na liang un leh na sikte un na phu ua, na khete un na pik ua, na dalhsak uhi.
english: Because you thrust with side and with shoulder, and push all the diseased with your horns, until you have scattered them abroad,

paite: Huaiziak in ka belamte ka humbit ding; samat lel ahi nawn kei ding ua, belamte kal thu ka gensak ding hi.
english: therefore I will save my flock, and they will no more be a prey. I will judge between sheep and sheep.

paite: Huan atung uah belamchingpa khat, ka sikhapa David ngei ka koih ding a; ama'n amaute avak ding a; amah amau chingpa ahi ding a, amaute avak ding hi.
english: I will set up one shepherd over them, and he will feed them, even my servant David. He will feed them, and he will be their shepherd.

paite: Huchi in kei a Toupa PATHIAN uh ka hi ding a, ka nasempa David atung ua heutu ahi ding; kei TOUPA ngei in ka chita hi.
english: I, Yahweh, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them. I, Yahweh, have spoken it.

paite: Amau toh lemna thukhun ka bawl ding a, sahangte gam a kipan ka hihmang ding; gamdai ah leng bittak in ateng ding ua, gammang nuaite ah a-ihmu hithit ding uhi.
english: “‘I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil animals to cease out of the land. They will dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.

paite: Amau leh ka mual kim munte ka vualzawl ding a; ahun geihgeih in vuah ka zusak ding a, vualzawl vuahte azu ding hi.
english: I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing. I will cause the shower to come down in its season. There will be showers of blessing.

paite: Huan gam a sing in gah asuah ding a, lei in apunna asuah ding a; agam uah bittak in a-om ding uh; ahakkolte uh ka kitansak a, sikha a bawl mite khut a kipan ka hutkhiak hun chiang in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
english: The tree of the field will yield its fruit, and the earth will yield its increase, and they will be secure in their land. Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I have broken the bars of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hand of those who made slaves of them.

paite: Namdangte samat lel ahi nawnta kei ding ua, gam sahangte nekmang mai ahi nawn kei ding uh; bittak in a-om zawta ding ua, kuamah in alausak ngei nawn kei ding uh.
english: They will no more be a prey to the nations, neither will the animals of the earth devour them; but they will dwell securely, and no one will make them afraid.

paite: Thilsuan minthang mahmah ka bawlsak ding a; huai gam ah kial in ahihmang nawn kei ding a, namdangte muhsitna leng athuak nawn kei ding uh.
english: I will raise up to them a plantation for renown, and they will no more be consumed with famine in the land, and not bear the shame of the nations any more.

paite: Huan kei TOUPA a Pathian uh akiang uah ka om chih athei un, amau Israel inkote leng ka mite ahi uh chih athei ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: They will know that I, Yahweh, their God am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Huan nou ka belamte, ka gantatna mun a belamte na hi ua; kei na Pathian uh ka hi, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in.
english: You my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I am your God,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Seir tang masuan inla, atung ah thu gen in. Akiang ah,
english: “Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai in, Aw Seir tang, ka hon dou hi, na tung ah ka khut ka lik ding a, ka hon hihgawp in mulkimhuaitak in ka hon bawl ding.
english: and tell it, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you. I will make you a desolation and an astonishment.

paite: Na khopite ka hihse ding a, na kigawp ding; huan TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding."
english: I will lay your cities waste, and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

paite: Na nitna uh gawtna nanungpen a asiat ni ua Israel inkote namsau thilhihtheihna a na lat a, na kinakpih gige ziak in,
english: “‘“Because you have had a perpetual hostility, and have given over the children of Israel to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end,

paite: kei ka hin bang in, sisan a ding in ka hon bawl ding a, sisan in ahon delh ding; sisan na huat louh ziak in sisan in ahon delh ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I will prepare you for blood, and blood will pursue you. Since you have not hated blood, therefore blood will pursue you.

paite: Hichi in Seir tang bel mulkimhuaitak a bawl in ka sugawp ding; atung a mi vialvakte ka tawpsak vek ding hi.
english: Thus I will make Mount Seir an astonishment and a desolation. I will cut off from it him who passes through and him who returns.

paite: Atangte amah mithahte in ka dimsak ding; na tangte ah, na phaizang leh na lui phaizang kuakte ah namsau a thahte apuk phengphung ding uh.
english: I will fill its mountains with its slain. The slain with the sword will fall in your hills and in your valleys and in all your watercourses.

paite: Ka hon sugawp den ding a, na khopite luah in a-om kei ding; huan kei TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding hi.
english: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA zaw a-om gige na a, "Hiai nam nihte leh gam nihte kei a ahi ding a, ka tang mai ding uh," na chih ziak in.
english: “‘“Because you have said, ‘These two nations and these two countries will be mine, and we will possess it,’ although Yahweh was there,

paite: Kei ka hin bang in chih, Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, na hehna bang zel leh na huatna ziak a hazatna na suklatdan bang zel in ka hih ding ahi; na tungthu ka ngaihtuah hun chiang in alak uah ka hihlang ding hi.
english: therefore, as I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I will do according to your anger, and according to your envy which you have shown out of your hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.

paite: "Hihgawp in a-omta ua, ka kiang ah piak in a-omta uh," chi a Israel tangte na gensiatna tengteng kei TOUPA'N ka za vek chih na thei ding hi.
english: You will know that I, Yahweh, have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, ‘They have been laid desolate. They have been given to us to devour.’

paite: Ka tung ah na kam in na kiliansak in ka tung ah thu na tamsak a, ka za vek hi.
english: You have magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against me. I have heard it.”

paite: Hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi: Lei pumpi kipahna ding in ka hon sugawp ding hi.
english: The Lord Yahweh says: “When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.

paite: Israelte gouluah asiat ziak a na kipah mah bang in na tung ah ka hih ding; Aw Seir tang leh Edom tengteng, avek in akisegawp ding; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
english: As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was desolate, so I will do to you. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

paite: Huan nang mihing tapa, Israel tangte kiang ah thu gen inla, "Nou Israel tangte aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia un. Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi:
english: You, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, “You mountains of Israel, hear Yahweh’s word.

paite: Na tung ah na melmate'n, 'Aha! Nidang mun sang tengtengte kei a ahita, achih ziak un,' " thu gen in.
english: The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because the enemy has said against you, “Aha!” and, “The ancient high places are ours in possession!”’

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Nam omsunte a ding a kil chih a nang ahon nek ua, hon sukgawp ziak un leh mikamtamte houlimna leh gensiat a ahon omsak ziak un;
english: therefore prophesy, and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because, even because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that you might be a possession to the residue of the nations, and you are taken up in the lips of talkers, and the evil report of the people;”

paite: Nou Israel tangte aw, Toupa PATHIAN thu ngaikhia un, Toupa PATHIAN in tangte, mualte, luiguamte, phaizangte leh mun sesate, khopi kigawpsa, akim a nam omsunte samat lel ding leh nuihsan dingte kiang ah hichi in achi.
english: therefore, you mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Yahweh: The Lord Yahweh says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which have become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are all around;

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Nam omsun leh Edom tengteng lungsim kipaktak a ka gam na na kiseh tawm ua; na hon musit mahmah ua, gallak a bawl mite tung ah ka mullitna thangpaih mahmahna in thu ka gen ngei ahi.
english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Surely in the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed my land to themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart, with despite of soul, to cast it out for a prey.”’

paite: Huaiziak in Israel gam tungthu ah thu gen inla, tangte, mualte, luiguamte leh phaizangte kiang ah Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai un, namdangte simmohna na thuak ziak un mullit mahmah leh thangpaitak in thu ka gen ahi.
english: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and tell the mountains, the hills, the watercourses and the valleys, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my wrath, because you have borne the shame of the nations.”

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Na kim a namte'n amau zahlakna apo ngei ding uh chi in ka khut ka zak hi.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “I have sworn, ‘Surely the nations that are around you will bear their shame.’

paite: Nou bel, Aw Israel tangte aw, hiang na suah ding ua, ka mi Israelte a ding in gah na suah ding uh; ahong pai dek uhi.
english: “‘“But you, mountains of Israel, you shall shoot out your branches and yield your fruit to my people Israel; for they are at hand to come.

paite: Ngai un, nou lam a pang ka hi ngal a, nou lam ka nga ding a, kalhnen in na om ding ua, chi tuh in na om lai ding uh.
english: For, behold, I am for you, and I will come to you, and you will be tilled and sown.

paite: Na tung uah mihing ka pungsak ding a, Israel inkote tengteng, avek un; mun sesate bawlphat in a-om ding a, khopite luah in a-om ding.
english: I will multiply men on you, all the house of Israel, even all of it. The cities will be inhabited and the waste places will be built.

paite: Na tung uah mi leh sa ka pungsak ding a, apung un alamzang ding uh; na omdan masa bang in luah in ka hon omsak ding a, atung a na omdan sang ua hoihzaw in ka hon bawl ding hi; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
english: I will multiply man and animal on you. They will increase and be fruitful. I will cause you to be inhabited as you were before, and you will do better than at your beginnings. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

paite: Ahi, na tung uah mi ka vaksak ding a, ka mi Israelte ngei; ahon luah ding ua, agoutan uh na hi ding a, tuban siah atate uh na tansak ngei nawn kei ding hi.
english: Yes, I will cause men to walk on you, even my people Israel. They will possess you, and you will be their inheritance, and you will never again bereave them of their children.”

paite: Hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi: "Nang mihingte nemang, na mite tansek na hi, ahon chih ziak un,
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because they say to you, ‘You are a devourer of men, and have been a bereaver of your nation;’

paite: mihingte na ne bei nawnta kei ding a, na mite leng na tan ngei na hon sam kei ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: therefore you shall devour men no more, and not bereave your nation any more,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Pau tuam mite muhsitna ka hon thuaksak nawn kei ding a, mite gensiat na thuak ngei nawn kei ding; na mite na tan ngei nawn kei ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in,” achi hi.
english: “I won’t let you hear the shame of the nations any more. You won’t bear the reproach of the peoples any more, and you won’t cause your nation to stumble any more,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israel inkote amau gam a aten lai un a-omdan uleh athilhihte un akihihnin ua; ka ma a a-omdan uh numei kizen louh lai a asianthoulouhna bang mai ahi.
english: “Son of man, when the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their ways and by their deeds. Their way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.

paite: Huaiziak in gam tung ah sisan asuah ua, amilimte ua akihihnit ziak un atung uah ka hehna ka lungdamsak hi.
english: Therefore I poured out my wrath on them for the blood which they had poured out on the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols.

paite: Namte lak ah ka dalhsak a, gam chih ah athehthangta ua; a-omdan uleh athilhihte uh bang zel in atungthu uh ka gensak hi.
english: I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries. I judged them according to their way and according to their deeds.

paite: Ava hohna namte kiang atun un ka min siangthou ahihbuah ua; mite'n, 'Hiaite TOUPA mite ahi ua, gam a kipan hong pawtkhete ahi uh," "ana chih nakna uah.
english: When they came to the nations where they went, they profaned my holy name, in that men said of them, ‘These are Yahweh’s people, and have left his land.’

paite: Himahleh Israel inkote'n ava hohna namte lak a ahihbuah uh, ka min siangthou ka lainat ahi.
english: But I had respect for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went.

paite: Huaiziak in Israel inkote kiang ah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Aw, Israel inkote, noute ka hon lainat ziak hilou in, na va hohna namte lak a na hihbuah uh, ka min siangthou ka lainat ziak zaw in hiai ka hih ahi.
english: “Therefore tell the house of Israel, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “I don’t do this for your sake, house of Israel, but for my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you went.

paite: Ka min thupitak, namte lak a buah, alak ua noumau ngei in na hihbuah uh ka siangthousak ding ahi; huchi in amitmuh ua noute a hihsiangthou a ka om hun chiang in TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: I will sanctify my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, which you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am Yahweh,” says the Lord Yahweh, “when I am proven holy in you before their eyes.

paite: Namte lak a kipan ka hon pikhe ding a, gam tengteng a kipan ka hon kaikhawm ding a, na gam mahmah uah ka hon pilut ding hi.
english: “‘“For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land.

paite: Huan na tung uah tui siang ka theh ding a, na hong siangthou ding ua, na nitna tengteng uleh na milimte lak ua kipan ka hon khuahsiang ding.
english: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from all your idols.

paite: Lungtang thak ka hon pe ding a, na sung uah kha thak ka koih ding; na taksa ua kipan suang bang a sak lungtang ka lamang ding a, taksa bang a nip lungtang ka hon pe zaw ding hi.
english: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.

paite: Na sung uah ka kha ka koih ding a, ka dan bawl ah ka hon vaksak ding a, ka thupiakte na kem ding ua, na zui ding uh.
english: I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes. You will keep my ordinances and do them.

paite: Na pipute uh kiang a ka piak gam ah na teng ding uh; nou ka mite na hi ding ua, kei na Pathian uh ka hi ding.
english: You will dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers. You will be my people, and I will be your God.

paite: Na nitna tengteng ua kipan ka hon hunkhe ding a, buh-le-bal ka sam ding a ka hon pungsak ding, na tung uah kial ake nawn kei ding hi.
english: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and will multiply it, and lay no famine on you.

paite: Singgahte ka pungsak ding a, louma ka pungsak ding a, kial ziak in namte lak ah zahlakna na thuak kei ding uh.
english: I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the increase of the field, that you may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations.

paite: Huchi in na omdan giloute uh, na thil hihhoihloute uh na theigige ding ua, na kihhuaina uleh na thulimlouhna uh ziak in noumau mitmuh mahmah in na kihta ding uhi.
english: “‘“Then you will remember your evil ways, and your deeds that were not good; and you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.

paite: Noute ziak a hiai hih ka hi kei chih na thei mai un, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi. Aw, Israel inkote aw, na omdan ziak un zum unla, lamdang sa un.
english: I don’t do this for your sake,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Let it be known to you. Be ashamed and confounded for your ways, house of Israel.”

paite: Na thulimlouhna tengteng ua kipan ka hon khuahsiang ni chiang in, khopite ka hon luahsak nawn ding a, mun sesa ka bawl nawn ding.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited and the waste places will be built.

paite: Huchi in gam sesa, tuma lam a mi vialvakte mitmuh a sesa nung himahleh lei leh in a-om ding hi.
english: The land that was desolate will be tilled instead of being a desolation in the sight of all who passed by.

paite: Hiai gam sesa nung Eden huan bang mai ahong hi nawnta, achi ding uh; khopi sia a, na kigawpsate luah leh um in a-om nawn ding hi.
english: They will say, ‘This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden. The waste, desolate, and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.’

paite: Huan na kim ua nam omlaite'n kei TOUPA'N mun siate ka bawl nawn a, gam na se khinsa ka hihhoih nawnta chih athei ding uh; kei TOUPA ka pauta a, ka hih ngei ding hi.
english: Then the nations that are left around you will know that I, Yahweh, have built the ruined places and planted that which was desolate. I, Yahweh, have spoken it, and I will do it.”

paite: Huan Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Huai lou in hiai Israel inkote ka hon dingsak ding a; ganhon bang mai a amite uh hihpung ding in.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “For this, moreover, I will be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will increase them with men like a flock.

paite: Kithoihna ding ganhon, a-ankuanglui sehsa a Jerusalem ganhonte bang mai in; huchibang in khopi sesa nung mipi tampi in ahong dim ding ua; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh," achi hi.
english: As the flock for sacrifice, as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed feasts, so the waste cities will be filled with flocks of men. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

paite: TOUPA khut ka tung ah a-om a, TOUPA kha in ahon pikhia a, phaizang laitak ah hon koih a; guh ngen in huai phaizang adim hi.
english: Yahweh’s hand was on me, and he brought me out in Yahweh’s Spirit, and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones.

paite: Huan alak uah ahon pi vialvial a; phaizang ah guh tampi ana om lemlom a; ngai dih, akeu ngen ahi.
english: He caused me to pass by them all around; and behold, there were very many in the open valley, and behold, they were very dry.

paite: Ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, hiai guhte ahing thei diam?" achi hi. Ke'n, "Aw, Toupa PATHIAN, nang na theizaw hi," ka chi hi.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” I answered, “Lord Yahweh, you know.”

paite: Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "Thu gen inla, akiang uah, 'Aw, nou guh keute aw, TOUPA thu ngai un.
english: Again he said to me, “Prophesy over these bones, and tell them, ‘You dry bones, hear Yahweh’s word.

paite: Hiai guhte kiang ah Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai un, noute ah nakna ka lutsak ding a, na hing ding uh.
english: The Lord Yahweh says to these bones: “Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you will live.

paite: Noute ah thagui ka koih ding a, sa in ka hon tuam ding a, vun in ka hon khuh ding; huan na sung uah nakna ka omsak ding a, na hing ding ua, kei TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh,' chi in," achi hi.
english: I will lay sinews on you, and will bring up flesh on you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you will live. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”’”

paite: Huchi in ahon thupiak bang in ka genta a; ka gen leh husa ahong om a, ngai in, aging luilui a, guhte amau kizoppih chiat ah akisutuah khawmta uh.
english: So I prophesied as I was commanded. As I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold, there was an earthquake. Then the bones came together, bone to its bone.

paite: Ka etleh ngai in, amau ah thagui ahong om a, sa in atuam a, vun in akhuhta a; nakna bel amau ah a-om nai kei hi.
english: I saw, and, behold, there were sinews on them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.

paite: Huchi in ama'n ka kiang ah, "Huih kiang ah thu gen inla, mihing tapa, gen mahmah in, huih kiang ah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Aw, nakna, kawlmong li a kipan in hong pai inla, hiai mithahte tung ah nak in, ahintheihna ding un, chi in," achi hi.
english: Then he said to me, “Prophesy to the wind, prophesy, son of man, and tell the wind, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Come from the four winds, breath, and breathe on these slain, that they may live.”’”

paite: Huchi in ahon thupiak bang in ka gen a, amau ah nakna ahong lut a, ahingta ua, amau khe chiat in ahong dingh ua, sepaihhon thupitak ahong hita hi.
english: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up on their feet, an exceedingly great army.

paite: Huchi in ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, hiai guhte Israel inkote pumpi ahi ua; ngai dih, amau, 'Ka guhte uh akeu khin in, ka lamet uh abei khinta, phukmang in ka omta uh,' achi uhi.
english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost. We are completely cut off.’

paite: Huaiziak in thu gen inla, akiang uah Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai un, ahante uh ka hong ding a, aw, ka mite aw, na han ua kipan ka hon khah ding a; huchi in Israel gam ah ka hon pilut ding hi.
english: Therefore prophesy, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, my people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.

paite: Na hante uh ka hon a, na han ua kipan ka hon pawtsak hun chiang in, aw, ka mite aw, TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
english: You will know that I am Yahweh, when I have opened your graves and caused you to come up out of your graves, my people.

paite: Huan noumau ah ka Kha ka koih ding a, na hing ding uh, na gam ngei uah ka hon koih ding; kei TOUPA'N ka chita a, ka hih lai ding ahi chih na thei ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi," achi hi.
english: I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live. Then I will place you in your own land; and you will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken it and performed it,” says Yahweh.’”

paite: Ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn hi.
english: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,

paite: Nang, mihing tapa, chiang khat la inla, atung ah, "Judah leh akithuahpih Israel suante," chih gelh in; chiang dang leng la inla, atung ah, "Joseph leh Ephraim chiang leh akithuahpih Israel inkote tengteng," chih gelh in.
english: “You, son of man, take one stick and write on it, ‘For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions.’ Then take another stick, and write on it, ‘For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions.’

paite: Huan chiangte peh inla, na khut a khat ahihtheihna ding in.
english: Then join them for yourself to one another into one stick, that they may become one in your hand.

paite: "Hiaite bang chihna ahi ua, na hon kawkmuh kei dia hia?" Na nam tate un na kiang ahon chih uleh, akiang uah,
english: “When the children of your people speak to you, saying, ‘Won’t you show us what you mean by these?’

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai un, Ephraim leh akithuahpih Israel chite khut a om Joseph chiang ka la ding a, huaite Judah chiang toh ka peh ding a, khat in ka bawl ding a, ka khut ah khat ahong hi ding, na chi ding hi.
english: tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his companions; and I will put them with it, with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they will be one in my hand.

paite: Chiang, atung a na gelhnate mahmah amitmuh ngei uah na khut ah a-om ding hi.
english: The sticks on which you write will be in your hand before their eyes.”’

paite: Huan akiang uah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai un, ava tunna gam ua namte lak a kipan Israel tate ka pikhe ding a, ning chih a kipan ka kaikhawm ding a, agam uah ka pikik ding hi.
english: Say to them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the nations where they have gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land.

paite: Huan huai gam, Israel tangte ah nam khat in ka bawl ding a, kumpipa khat avek ua kumpipa ahi dia; huan, nam nih ahi nawnta kei ding ua, vaihawmna gam nih in leng akikhen nawn sam kei ding hi.
english: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. One king will be king to them all. They will no longer be two nations. They won’t be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.

paite: Amilimte uh, athilkihhuaite uh, atatleknate un leng akihihnin ngei nawnta kei ding ua; apuk ua akhelhna nak tengteng ua kipan ka hunkhe ding a, ka khuahsiang ding; huchi in ka mite ahi ding ua, kei a Pathian uh ka hi ding hi.
english: They won’t defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions; but I will save them out of all their dwelling places in which they have sinned, and will cleanse them. So they will be my people, and I will be their God.

paite: Ka nasempa David atung ua kumpipa ahi ding a, avek ua tung ah belamchingtu khat a-om ding; ka thupiakte amang ding ua, ka dan bawlte azui ding ua, azang ding uh.
english: “‘“My servant David will be king over them. They all will have one shepherd. They will also walk in my ordinances and observe my statutes, and do them.

paite: Ka nasempa Jakob kiang a ka gam piak, na pipute uh na tenna sek ah ateng ding ua; huai ah tangtawn in ateng ding ua, amau leh atate uh, atate uh tate leng; ka nasempa David tangtawn in aheutu uh ahi ding hi.
english: They will dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob my servant, in which your fathers lived. They will dwell therein, they, and their children, and their children’s children, forever. David my servant will be their prince forever.

paite: Huai lou leng amau kiang ah lemna thukhun ka bawl ding a, amau a ding in tangtawn thukhun ahi ding a, akiang uah ka pe ding a, amau ka pungsak ding a, alak uah tangtawn in ka biakbuk ka dingsak ding hi.
english: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them. It will be an everlasting covenant with them. I will place them, multiply them, and will set my sanctuary among them forever more.

paite: Ka biakbuk leng akiang uah a-om ding a, a Pathian uh ka hi ding a, amau ka mite ahi ding uh.
english: My tent also will be with them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

paite: Huan alak ua tangtawn a ding a ka biakbuk adin hun chiang in kei TOUPA, Israel hihsiangthoupa ka hi chih namte'n athei ding uh, achi, chi in.
english: The nations will know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies Israel, when my sanctuary is among them forever more.”’”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a:
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Magog gam a mi, Rosh leh Meshek leh Tubal heutupen Gog masuan inla, atung ah thu gen in.
english: “Son of man, set your face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against him,

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai in, aw Gog, Rosh, Meshek leh Tubal heutupen, ka hon dou ahi.
english: and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.

paite: Ka hon lehngatsak ding a, na haizek ah ngakuai in ka hon kuai ding a, ka hon khaikhe ding; na sepaihhon tengteng, sakol leh atungtuang mite, galvan buching a kithuam tengteng, pawl thupitak, lum lian leh lum neu zang a namsau tawi chiatte toh in.
english: I will turn you around, and put hooks into your jaws, and I will bring you out, with all your army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed in full armor, a great company with buckler and shield, all of them handling swords;

paite: Persia, Kush, Put toh, avek ua lum leh sik lukhu neite;
english: Persia, Cush, and Put with them, all of them with shield and helmet;

paite: Gomer leh asepaihhon tengteng; Togarmah inkote, mal tawp a mi leh asepaihhon tengteng; na kiang a mi tampite toh leng.
english: Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes—even many peoples with you.

paite: Kigalgin inla, ahi, na man in, nang leh na kiang a omkhawm, na kithuahpih tengteng toh; huan amau vengpa na hi in.
english: “‘“Be prepared, yes, prepare yourself, you, and all your companies who are assembled to you, and be a guard to them.

paite: Ni tampi nung in sap na hi ding a, kum nanungte ah namsau a kipan hotkhiak, nam tampite lak a kipan lakkhawmte omna gam, Israel tanggam kise gigete na hon sual ding a; himahleh namte lak a kipan huai mite pikhiak ahi ua, tu in avek un lungmuangtak in akhosa ding uhi.
english: After many days you will be visited. In the latter years you will come into the land that is brought back from the sword, that is gathered out of many peoples, on the mountains of Israel, which have been a continual waste; but it is brought out of the peoples and they will dwell securely, all of them.

paite: Na kuantou ding a, huihpi bang mai in na hong tung ding a, meipi in gam atuam moimoi bang mai na hi ding, nang leh na kiang a sepaihhon tengteng leh na kiang a mi tampite."
english: You will ascend. You will come like a storm. You will be like a cloud to cover the land, you and all your hordes, and many peoples with you.”

paite: Huan hichi in Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi: “Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, na lungsim ah thil a hong lut ding a, thil hoih lou na suangtuah ding.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “It will happen in that day that things will come into your mind, and you will devise an evil plan.

paite: Huchi in kulh nei lou khuate gam ka sim ding a, mi bittak a om hiathiat, avek ua kulh lou a teng, kulh kongkhak leh akalhna sik neiloute ka sual ding, na chi sim ding hi.
english: You will say, ‘I will go up to the land of unwalled villages. I will go to those who are at rest, who dwell securely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,

paite: Gallak sum leh vante la ding leh mun sesa nung luah nawn mite leh namte lak a kipan pikhawmsa, ganhon leh vante hau a, lei laizang a tengte tung ah na khut lik na tum ding hi.
english: to take the plunder and to take prey; to turn your hand against the waste places that are inhabited, and against the people who are gathered out of the nations, who have gotten livestock and goods, who dwell in the middle of the earth.’

paite: Sheba leh Dedan leh Tarshish sumsin mite leh ahumpinelkai lun lai tengtengte'n na kiang ah, gallak la ding in na hong pai maw? Hon lok ding a na pawlte hon khawm na hi maw? Dangkasik, dangka-eng, ganhon leh van, thupitak suhsak a lamang ding na hi maw? ahon chi ding uh," chi in.
english: Sheba, Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all its young lions, will ask you, ‘Have you come to take the plunder? Have you assembled your company to take the prey, to carry away silver and gold, to take away livestock and goods, to take great plunder?’”’

paite: Huaiziak in mihing tapa, thu gen inla, Gog kiang ah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Huai ni, ka mi Israelte bittak a a-om hun ding uh na thei kei maw?
english: “Therefore, son of man, prophesy, and tell Gog, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In that day when my people Israel dwells securely, will you not know it?

paite: Mallam gam tawp pek, na mun a kipan in na hong pai ding a, nang leh na kiang a mi tampi sakol tungtuang chiat, pawl thupi mahmah, sepaihhon thupitak mai.
english: You will come from your place out of the uttermost parts of the north, you, and many peoples with you, all of them riding on horses, a great company and a mighty army.

paite: Meipi in gam atuam lunglung bang in ka mi Israelte tung ah na hong pai ding a; huan hichi ahi ding a, ni nanungte ah ka gam dou ding in ka hon pi ding a, namte'n ahon thei ding ua, Aw, Gog, amitmuh ua nang a hihsiangthou a ka om hun chiang in.
english: You will come up against my people Israel as a cloud to cover the land. It will happen in the latter days that I will bring you against my land, that the nations may know me when I am sanctified in you, Gog, before their eyes.”

paite: Huan Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Tuma lam a ka nasempa Israel zawlnei, huai lai kum tampi sung a thu na gente'n amaute sual ding a ka hon pi ding thu agen sekpa uh na hi hia? chi in," achi hi.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Are you he of whom I spoke in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days for years that I would bring you against them?

paite: Huan huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, Israel gam sual ding a Gog ahong kuan hun in ka mel ah ka thangpaihna akilang ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: It will happen in that day, when Gog comes against the land of Israel,” says the Lord Yahweh, “that my wrath will come up into my nostrils.

paite: Ka mullit a ka thangpaih laitak in, huai ni in Israel gam ah zin nakpi in aling ngeingei ding hi.
english: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath I have spoken. Surely in that day there will be a great shaking in the land of Israel,

paite: Huchi in tuipi ngate, tungleng vasate, gamsate, leitung a vak ganhing tengteng, leitung a mihing tengteng ka ma ah aling ding ua, tangte niamsak in a-om ding a, kawlte achim ding a, kulhbaang teng lei ah apuk ding, chi in ka gen hi.
english: so that the fish of the sea, the birds of the sky, the animals of the field, all creeping things who creep on the earth, and all the men who are on the surface of the earth will shake at my presence. Then the mountains will be thrown down, the steep places will fall, and every wall will fall to the ground.

paite: Ka tang tengteng ah amah sualna ding in namsau ka sam ding a; michih in namsau in a-unaupa adou ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: I will call for a sword against him to all my mountains,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Every man’s sword will be against his brother.

paite: Huan sisan pawt leh hipi in amah ka sual ding a; amah leh asepaihhonte leh akiang a mi tampite tung ah vuahpi leh gial thupi leh mei katte ka zusak ding.
english: I will enter into judgment with him with pestilence and with blood. I will rain on him, on his hordes, and on the many peoples who are with him, torrential rains with great hailstones, fire, and sulfur.

paite: Huan ka thupidan leh ka sianthoudan ka hihlang ding a, nam tampite mitmuh in ka kihihlang ding, huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
english: I will magnify myself and sanctify myself, and I will make myself known in the eyes of many nations. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”’

paite: Huan nang, mihing tapa, Gog tung ah thu gen inla, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Ngai in, Aw Gog, Rosh, Meshek leh Tubal heutupen, ka hon dou ahi.
english: “You, son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.

paite: Ka hon lehngatsak ding a, ka hon pi zel ding a, mal tawp pek a kipan ka hon pikhe ding a, Israel tangte ah ka hon tun ding hi.
english: I will turn you around, will lead you on, and will cause you to come up from the uttermost parts of the north; and I will bring you onto the mountains of Israel.

paite: Na khut veilam a kipan na thalpeu ka kitansak ding a, na khut taklam a kipan na thalte ka kesak ding hi.
english: I will strike your bow out of your left hand, and will cause your arrows to fall out of your right hand.

paite: Israel tangte ah na puk ding a, nang leh na sepaihhon tengteng leh na kiang a mipi omte toh, sasial ne vasa chitengte kiang leh gam sahangte kiang ah nekgaih ding in ka hon pe ding hi.
english: You will fall on the mountains of Israel, you, and all your hordes, and the peoples who are with you. I will give you to the ravenous birds of every sort and to the animals of the field to be devoured.

paite: Gamlak ah na puk ding a; ke'n ka chita a, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," chi in.
english: You will fall on the open field, for I have spoken it,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Magog leh tui gei gam a bittak a tengte tung ah mei ka khah ding; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
english: “I will send a fire on Magog and on those who dwell securely in the islands. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.

paite: Huan ka mi Israelte lak ah ka min siangthou ka hihlang ding a, ka min siangthou hihbuah ka phal nawnta kei ding a; huchi in namte'n kei, TOUPA Israel Mi Siangthoupa ka hi chih athei ding uh.
english: “‘“I will make my holy name known among my people Israel. I won’t allow my holy name to be profaned any more. Then the nations will know that I am Yahweh, the Holy One in Israel.

paite: Ngai un, ahong tung hi; hihtangtun in a-om ngei ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi; hiai ni ahi ka na gen.
english: Behold, it comes, and it will be done,” says the Lord Yahweh. “This is the day about which I have spoken.

paite: Huan Israel khopi a tengte apawtkhe ding ua, meikuang ah galvante akhul ding ua, akangmang ding; lum lian leh lum neute, thal leh apeute, teipi leh chiangzumte kum sagih sung meikuang ah akhul ding uhi.
english: “‘“Those who dwell in the cities of Israel will go out and will make fires of the weapons and burn them, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the war clubs and the spears, and they will make fires with them for seven years;

paite: Huchi in gam sing apo kei ding ua, gammang singte aphuk kei ding uh, galvante sing khul ding a zang ding uh ahi ngal a; gallak la mite gallak in ala tei ding ua, lok mite alokthuk ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: so that they will take no wood out of the field, and not cut down any out of the forests; for they will make fires with the weapons. They will plunder those who plundered them, and rob those who robbed them,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Huan huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, Gog a ding in Israel gam ah vuina mun ka pe ding a, tuipi suahlam, Abarim Phaizang ngei; huai in khualzinte adal ding a, Gog leh alawite avui ding ua; huchi in huai phaizang Hamongog Phaizang asa ding uhi.
english: “‘“It will happen in that day, that I will give to Gog a place for burial in Israel, the valley of those who pass through on the east of the sea; and it will stop those who pass through. They will bury Gog and all his multitude there, and they will call it ‘The valley of Hamon Gog’.

paite: Huan Israel inkote'n agam uh khuahsiang in kha sagih sung avui ding uh.
english: “‘“The house of Israel will be burying them for seven months, that they may cleanse the land.

paite: Ahi, agam ua mi tengteng in avui ding ua; pahtawi a ka om ni in ka minthanna ahi ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: Yes, all the people of the land will bury them; and they will become famous in the day that I will be glorified,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Agam uh khuahsianna ding in, luang vuilouhte teng zongkhia avui ding in nasep a nei ding mi aseptuam ding uh, kha sagih bei nung in azong pan ding uhi.
english: “‘“They will set apart men of continual employment who will pass through the land. Those who pass through will go with those who bury those who remain on the surface of the land, to cleanse it. After the end of seven months they will search.

paite: Gam vel mite'n avel un, mihing guhte amuh uleh chiamtehna abawl ding ua, Hamongog Phaizang a vui mite'n avui ma uh.
english: Those who search through the land will pass through; and when anyone sees a man’s bone, then he will set up a sign by it, until the undertakers have buried it in the valley of Hamon Gog.

paite: Huan Hamonah khopi min ahi ding. Huchibang in gam akhuahsiang ding uhi.
english: Hamonah will also be the name of a city. Thus they will cleanse the land.”’

paite: Nang, mihing tapa, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Vasa chichihte leh sa chichihte kiang ah thu gen inla, pungkhawm unla, hong pai un, sa na nek ua sisan na dawntheihna ding un Israel tang a kithoihna thupitak, nou a dia ka bawl kim ah hong kikhawm un.
english: “You, son of man, the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Speak to the birds of every sort, and to every animal of the field, “Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel, that you may eat meat and drink blood.

paite: Mithupi sate na ne ding ua, lei a heutute sisan na dawn ding ua; belamtalte, belamnoute, kelte, Bashan gam a bawngtal vak thau tengteng sisan toh.
english: You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bulls, all of them fatlings of Bashan.

paite: Nou a dia kithoihna ankuang ka lui thau, vah kikeih in na ne ding ua; asisan kham khop in na dawn ding uh.
english: You shall eat fat until you are full, and drink blood until you are drunk, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.

paite: Huchi in sakolte, kangtalai kai mite, mithupite leh galdoumi tengteng in ka ankuang ah na tai ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: You shall be filled at my table with horses and charioteers, with mighty men, and with all men of war,” says the Lord Yahweh.’

paite: Huchi in namte lak ah ka thupina ka koih ding a, nam tengteng in athugel hihpuksate leh atung ua ka khut khakdante amu ding uh.
english: “I will set my glory among the nations. Then all the nations will see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid on them.
