paite: Huai ni a kipan Israel inkote'n kei TOUPA a Pathian uh ka hi chih atheita ding uh.
english: So the house of Israel will know that I am Yahweh their God, from that day and forward.

paite: Namte'n Israel inkote athulimlouhna ziak un sal in atang uh chih athei ding ua; ka tung a aginom louh mahmah ziak un amau tung ah ka mel ka sel a, huchi in amelmate uh khut ah ka pia a, namsau in apuk vek uhi.
english: The nations will know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity, because they trespassed against me, and I hid my face from them; so I gave them into the hand of their adversaries, and they all fell by the sword.

paite: Asianthoulouhna bang zel uleh atatlekna bang zel un atung uah ka hih tei a; amau a kipan ka mel ka sel ahi.
english: I did to them according to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions. I hid my face from them.

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Tu'n zaw Jakobte omdan ka hei ding a, Israel inkuan pumpi tung ah zah ka ngai ding, ka min siangthou gum in ka thikthu ase ding hi.
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Now I will reverse the captivity of Jacob and have mercy on the whole house of Israel. I will be jealous for my holy name.

paite: Kuamah lausakmi om lou a, agam ua bittak a aten hun un leng atatlekna tengteng uh, ka tung a atatlekna uh leh azahlakna uh apo ding uhi.
english: They will forget their shame and all their trespasses by which they have trespassed against me, when they dwell securely in their land. No one will make them afraid

paite: Mite lak a kipan ka pikhiak nawn a, amelmate uh gam a kipan ka kaihkhawm a, amau nam tampi mitmuh a hihsiangthou a ka om hun chiang in.
english: when I have brought them back from the peoples, gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and am shown holy among them in the sight of many nations.

paite: Huan namte lak a sal a ka tansak nawn a, agam ngei ua ka pikhawm nawndan ah kei TOUPA a Pathian uh ka hi chih athei ding uh; huai ah alak ua khat lel leng ka nuse kei ding hi.
english: They will know that I am Yahweh their God, in that I caused them to go into captivity among the nations, and have gathered them to their own land. Then I will leave none of them captive any more.

paite: Amau a kipan ka mel ka sel nawnta kei ding; Israel inkote tung ah ka kha ka sungta ngal a, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," chi in.
english: I won’t hide my face from them any more, for I have poured out my Spirit on the house of Israel,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

paite: "Nang mihing tapa, teklei pek la inla, na ma ah koih in, huai tung ah khopi Jerusalem khopi lim bawl in.
english: “You also, son of man, take a tile, and lay it before yourself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.

paite: Akim a um in kulh khohkhum inla, mual pawng bawlkhum in sepaih giahbukte bawlkhum inla, kulh suksiatnate akim in bawlkhum in.
english: Lay siege against it, build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it. Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around.

paite: Sikpek la inla, nangmah leh khopi kikal ah sik baang ding in tung in; huai lam masuan inla, um in a-om ding a, nangmah in na um ding ahi. Hiai Israel inkote a dia etsak kholhna ahi ding.
english: Take for yourself an iron pan and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city. Then set your face toward it. It will be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

paite: "Huan nang bel na veilam pang delh in lum inla, atung ah Israel inkote gitlouhna nga in; atung a na lup sung ani zah bang zel a agitlouhna uh na puak ding ahi.
english: “Moreover lie on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it. According to the number of the days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.

paite: Agitlouhna kumte uh nang a ding a nite hi ding in lah ka septa ngal a, ni zathum-leh-sawmkua; huchibang in Israel inkote gitlouhna na po ding ahi.
english: For I have appointed the years of their iniquity to be to you a number of days, even three hundred ninety days. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

paite: Hiaite na khit hun chiang in na taklam pang delh in na lum leuleu ding a, Judah inkote gitlouhna na po ding, ni sawmli nang ding in ka sep hi; ni khat kum khat zel hi ding in.
english: “Again, when you have accomplished these, you shall lie on your right side, and shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah. I have appointed forty days, each day for a year, to you.

paite: "Na ban khuh lou a zak in Jerusalem kiluhna lam nga inla, atungthu genkhia in.
english: You shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm uncovered; and you shall prophesy against it.

paite: Ngai in, khauhual in ka hon hentom a, khopi kiluh sung nite abei masiah koilam ah leng na kihei ding ahi kei hi.
english: Behold, I put ropes on you, and you shall not turn yourself from one side to the other, until you have accomplished the days of your siege.

paite: "Buh, buhman, be, behiang, vai buhman la inla, bel khat ah koih in, huan tanghou in bawl in; na pang khat lam delh a na lup sung teng, ni zathum-le-sawmkua sung, huai na ne ding ahi.
english: “Take for yourself also wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel. Make bread of it. According to the number of the days that you will lie on your side, even three hundred ninety days, you shall eat of it.

paite: Na an nek ding teh vek ding ahi, ni khat in shekel sawmnih ahi ding ahi; hunbi neitak in na ne ding ahi.
english: Your food which you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day. From time to time you shall eat it.

paite: Tuite leng teh vek in na dawn ding ahi, hin khat seh guk suah seh khat ahi ding ahi, hunbi neitak in na dawn ding ahi.
english: You shall drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin. From time to time you shall drink.

paite: Amitmuh un mihing ekgaw sing dia zang in na kang ding a, buhman tanghou nek in na ne ding," achi hi.
english: You shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it in their sight with dung that comes out of man.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N, "Hichibang an thanghuai Israel suante'n ka delhmangna ding namte lak ah ane ding uh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said, “Even thus will the children of Israel eat their bread unclean, among the nations where I will drive them.”

paite: Huan ke'n, "Eh! Toupa PATHIAN, Ngai dih, ka hinna hihnit ahi ngei kei a, ka tuailai a kipan tutan in leng, amah sih a si hiam, gamsa keih hiam ka ne ngei nai kei a, sa kihhuai ka kam ah alut ngei nai kei hi," ka chi hi.
english: Then I said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Behold, my soul has not been polluted; for from my youth up even until now I have not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn of animals. No abominable meat has come into my mouth!”

paite: Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "En in, mihing ek sik in bawng ek ka hon pia, huaite zang in nek dingte na bawl ding hi," achi hi.
english: Then he said to me, “Behold, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare your bread on it.”

paite: Huai lou leng ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, ngai dih, Jerusalem ah, an hinna bul ka hihse ding a, a-an uh teh vek in lauthawngtak in ane ding uh; tui leng teh vek in, lungkhamtak in adawn ding uhi.
english: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem. They will eat bread by weight, and with fearfulness. They will drink water by measure, and in dismay;

paite: An leh tui tasam a, lungkhamtak a ki-entuah a, agitlouhna ua athammang khitna ding un."
english: that they may lack bread and water, be dismayed one with another, and pine away in their iniquity.

paite: I saltan akum sawmnih-le-ngana, huai kum bul, huai kha ani sawmna, khopi siat nung akum sawm-le-lina, huai ni mahmah in TOUPA khut ka tung ah ahong om a, huai ah ahon pi hi.
english: In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was struck, in the same day, Yahweh’s hand was on me, and he brought me there.

paite: Pathian mengmuhna ah Israel gam ah ahon pi a, tang sangtak ah ahon koih a, huai simlam ah khopi dinsaksa bangtak a-om hi.
english: In the visions of God he brought me into the land of Israel, and set me down on a very high mountain, on which was something like the frame of a city to the south.

paite: Huai ah ahon pi a, ngai dih, mi khat ana om a, amel latdan dal bang mai ahi a; khauzang leh tehna chiang atawi a, kongpi ah adingh hi.
english: He brought me there; and, behold, there was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a line of flax in his hand and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.

paite: Huan huai mi in ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, na mit in en inla, na bil in za in; ka hon etsak ding lam ah na lungsim nga tinten in; huai ka hon etsak ding ziak a hiai a ka hon pi na hi ngal a; na muh tengteng Israel inkote kiang ah puang in," achi hi.
english: The man said to me, “Son of man, see with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I will show you; for you have been brought here so that I may show them to you. Declare all that you see to the house of Israel.”

paite: Huan ngai dih, tempul kimvel ah kulhbaang ana om a, huai mi'n tehna chiang, tong guk a sau atawi a, atong khat bel tong khat leh khutpek bok chia ahi a; kulhbaang sahlam ateh a, chiang khep khat ahi a, asanlam leng chiang khep khat mah ahi.
english: Behold, there was a wall on the outside of the house all around, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed six cubits long, of a cubit and a hand width each. So he measured the thickness of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.

paite: Huchi in suahlam chial kongpi ahong tung a, akalbi ah apaitou a; kongpi lutna dantan ateh a, chiang khep khat a za ahi.
english: Then he came to the gate which looks toward the east, and went up its steps. He measured the threshold of the gate, one reed wide; and the other threshold, one reed wide.

paite: Huan vilna dantante adunglam chiang khep khat, availam chiang khep khat chiat ahi; vilna dantan kikal tong nga chiat ahi a; huan Inpi lam kongpi sumtawng kongpi lutna dantan chiang khep khat ahi.
english: Every lodge was one reed long and one reed wide. Between the lodges was five cubits. The threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate toward the house was one reed.

paite: Inpi lam sumtawng leng ateh a, tong giat ahi.
english: He measured also the porch of the gate toward the house, one reed.

paite: Abaangkate tong nih chiat ahi a, kongpi sumtawng inpi lam ah ahi.
english: Then he measured the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and its posts, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was toward the house.

paite: Huan suahlam kongpi vilna dantante alang tuak ah thum tuaktuak ahi a, athum un akikim vek uhi; huan, baangkate leng alang tuak ah akikim ahi.
english: The side rooms of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side. The three of them were of one measure. The posts had one measure on this side and on that side.

paite: Kongpi lutna vailam ateh a, tong sawm ahi a; kongpi paisuakna vailam tong sawmthum ahi.
english: He measured the width of the opening of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits;

paite: Huan vilna dantan ma ah deidanna langkhat ah tong khat a sah tuaktuak a-om a; huchi in vilna dantante lang tuak tong guk tuak ahi hi.
english: and a border before the lodges, one cubit on this side, and a border, one cubit on that side; and the side rooms, six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.

paite: Huan kongpi ateh a, vilna dantan khat tung a kipan alangkhat tung pha in tong sawmnih-le-nga a za ahi; kongkhak leh kongkhak kizom chiat in.
english: He measured the gate from the roof of the one side room to the roof of the other, a width of twenty-five cubits, door against door.

paite: Sumtawng leng ateh a, tong sawmnih ahi a; kongpi sumtawng pua bel huangsung ahi kei hi.
english: He also made posts, sixty cubits; and the court reached to the posts, around the gate.

paite: Huan kongpi ponungpen a kipan kongpi sumtawng sunggilpen chiang tong sawmnga ahi.
english: From the forefront of the gate at the entrance to the forefront of the inner porch of the gate were fifty cubits.

paite: Huan kongpi sunglam ah akimvel in dantante ah tohlet hon theih louh a-om a, akikal a khuamte ah leng; asumtawngte ah leng, huchibang mah in asunglam ah leng akimvel in tohlet a-om a, akhuamte ah tum sing lim a-om chiat nawn hi.
english: There were closed windows to the side rooms, and to their posts within the gate all around, and likewise to the arches. Windows were around inward. Palm trees were on each post.

paite: Huan huangsung ponungzaw ah ahon pi a; ngai dih, dantante a-om a, huangsung kimvel suanglep ahi a; huan, suanglep ah dantan sawmthum a-om hi.
english: Then he brought me into the outer court. Behold, there were rooms and a pavement made for the court all around. Thirty rooms were on the pavement.

paite: Huan suanglep bel kongpi a kipan a lep ahi a, kongpi tan ding mah a lep ahi, huai tuh suanglep nuainungzaw ahi.
english: The pavement was by the side of the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates, even the lower pavement.

paite: Huchi in kongpi nuaizaw pen zawn a kipan in huang sungnungzaw pen polam pha in ateh a, azatdan suahlam leh mallam tong zakhat ahi.
english: Then he measured the width from the forefront of the lower gate to the forefront of the inner court outside, one hundred cubits, both on the east and on the north.

paite: Huan huangsung ponungzaw pen kongpi mallam pang a adung leh avai leng ateh hi.
english: He measured the length and width of the gate of the outer court which faces toward the north.

paite: Huan vilna dantante alang tuak ah thum tuaktuak a-om a, abaangkate leh akongpi sumtawngte leng amasa bang vek ahi; adung tong sawmnga ahi a, avai tong sawmnih-le-nga.
english: The lodges of it were three on this side and three on that side. Its posts and its arches were the same as the measure of the first gate: its length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.

paite: Atohlette, asumtawngte, atum sing limte suahlam kongpi toh kikim vek ahi; kalbi sagih a-omtou a; asunglam ah asumtawng a-om hi.
english: Its windows, its arches, and its palm trees were the same as the measure of the gate which faces toward the east. They went up to it by seven steps. Its arches were before them.

paite: Huang sungnungzaw pen lutna ding kongpi bel kongpi dang zawn ah a-om zel a, mallam leh suahlam ah leng; kongpi leh kongpi kikal ateh a, tong zakhat ahi.
english: There was a gate to the inner court facing the other gate, on the north and on the east. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate.

paite: Huan simlam ah ahon pi nawn a, ngai in, simlam kongpi ana om a; atehdan ngei in abaangkate leh asumtawng ateh hi.
english: He led me toward the south; and behold, there was a gate toward the south. He measured its posts and its arches according to these measurements.

paite: Huai ah adangte bangmah in akimvel in tohlette a-om a, asumtawng ah leng; adung tong sawmnga ahi a, availam tong sawmnih-le-nga ahi.
english: There were windows in it and in its arches all around, like the other windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.

paite: Huan kalbi sagih a-omtou a, asunglam ah sumtawng a-om a; alang tuak abaangkate ah tum sing lim a-om zel hi.
english: There were seven steps to go up to it, and its arches were before them. It had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, on its posts.

paite: Simlam ah huang sungnung lutna ding kongpi a-om a, simlam kongpite kikal ateh a, tong zakhat ahi.
english: There was a gate to the inner court toward the south. He measured one hundred cubits from gate to gate toward the south.

paite: Huan simlam kongpi ah huang sungnungzaw pen ah ahon pi a, tehna ngei in simlam kongpi ateh a;
english: Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate. He measured the south gate according to these measurements;

paite: vilna dantante, abaangkate sumtawngte tehna mah in huai ah tohlette a-om a, sumtawng leng akimvel in; adunglam tong sawmnga, availam tong sawmnih-le-nga ahi.
english: with its lodges, its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements. There were windows in it and in its arches all around. It was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.

paite: Huan akimvel ah sumtawngte a-om a, adunglam tong sawmnih-le-nga, availam tong nga ahi.
english: There were arches all around, twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide.

paite: Asumtawngte'n huangsung ponungzaw lam anga a; abaangkate ah tum sing lim a-om a; akahtouhna in kalbi giat anei hi.
english: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts. The ascent to it had eight steps.

paite: Huan suahlam ah huang sungnungzaw pen ah ahon pi a, atehna ngei in kongpi ateh hi.
english: He brought me into the inner court toward the east. He measured the gate according to these measurements;

paite: Avilna dantante, abaangkate, asumtawngte tehna mah in; huai ah tohlette a-om a, sumtawng leng akimvel in; adunglam bel tong sawmnga, availam tong sawmnih-le-nga ahi.
english: with its lodges, its posts, and its arches, according to these measurements. There were windows in it and in its arches all around. It was fifty cubits long, and twenty-five cubits wide.

paite: Asumtawngte'n huangsung ponungzaw pen lam anga a, abaangkate ah lang tuak ah tum sing lim a-om a; akahtouhna in kalbi giat anei hi.
english: Its arches were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side. The ascent to it had eight steps.

paite: Huan mallam kongpi ah ahon pi nawn a; atehna ngei in ateh a; avilna dantante, abaangkate, asumtawngte;
english: He brought me to the north gate, and he measured it according to these measurements—

paite: huai ah akimvel in tohlette a-om a; adunglam tong sawmnga ahi a, availam tong sawmnih-le-nga.
english: its lodges, its posts, and its arches. There were windows in it all around. The length was fifty cubits and the width twenty-five cubits.

paite: Abaangkate huangsung ponungzaw pen lam ah a-om a; abaangkate ah alang tuak ah tum sing lim a-om hi; akahtouhna in kalbi giat anei hi.
english: Its posts were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side. The ascent to it had eight steps.

paite: Kongpi sumtawng a kipan a lut theih in dantan a-om a, huai ah halmang kithoihna ding asil zel uhi.
english: A room with its door was by the posts at the gates. They washed the burnt offering there.

paite: Kongpi sumtawng lang tuak ah; halmang kithoihnate, khelh ziak a kithoihnate, moh ziak a thillatte gohna ding dohkan nih tuak a-om hi.
english: In the porch of the gate were two tables on this side and two tables on that side, on which to kill the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering.

paite: Mallam kongpi lutna kahtouhna polam sik khat ah dohkan nih a-om a; kongpi sumtawng langkhat ah leng dohkan nih a-om nawn hi.
english: On the one side outside, as one goes up to the entry of the gate toward the north, were two tables; and on the other side, which belonged to the porch of the gate, were two tables.

paite: Huchi in kongpi sik langkhat ah dohkan li a-om a, alangkhat ah dohkan li a-om nawn a; kithoihna gan gohna dohkan giat ahi.
english: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate: eight tables, on which they killed the sacrifices.

paite: Huan halmang kithoihna dia dohkan li, suangsek a bawl, adunglam tong khat-le-akim, availam tong khat-le-akim, asanlam tong khat a-om a; huai ah halmang kithoihna leh thillat gohna ding vanzatte akoih zel uhi.
english: There were four cut stone tables for the burnt offering, a cubit and a half long, a cubit and a half wide, and one cubit high. They laid the instruments with which they killed the burnt offering and the sacrifice on them.

paite: Huan asunglam ah akimvel in kuaika, khutpek khuh a sau abulh ua; dohkan tungte ah thil latsate a-om hi.
english: The hooks, a hand width long, were fastened within all around. The meat of the offering was on the tables.

paite: Huan huang sungnungzaw pen ah ahon pilut a, ngai dih, huang sungnungzaw pen ah dantan nih ana om a; khat pen mallam kongpi chin ah, simlam nga in a-om a, khat pen simlam kongpi chin ah mallam nga in a-om hi.
english: Outside of the inner gate were rooms for the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate. They faced toward the south. One at the side of the east gate faced toward the north.

paite: Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai dantan simlam nga, tempul kemtu siampute omna ahi a;
english: He said to me, “This room, which faces toward the south, is for the priests who perform the duty of the house.

paite: dantan mallam nga maitam kem siampute omna ahi; hiaite Zadok tate, Levi tate lak a ama nna sem ding a TOUPA hong naih sekte ahi uh," achi hi.
english: The room which faces toward the north is for the priests who perform the duty of the altar. These are the sons of Zadok, who from among the sons of Levi come near to Yahweh to minister to him.”

paite: Huan huangsung ateh a, adunglam tong zakhat, availam tong zakhat, kimvel ahi; maitam bel tempul maitak a om ahi.
english: He measured the court, one hundred cubits long and one hundred cubits wide, square. The altar was before the house.

paite: Tempul inlim ah ahon pi a, sumtawng baangkate ateh chiat a, alang tuak ah tong nga a sah tuaktuak a-om a, alutna tong sawm leh tong li a za ahi; asik tuak a kongpi baangkate tong thum tuaktuak ahi.
english: Then he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side. The width of the gate was three cubits on this side and three cubits on that side.

paite: Asumtawng adunglam tong sawmnih, availam tong sawm-le-nih ahi a; luttouhna ah kalbi sawm a-om a, baangka chin ah alang tuak ah khuam lian a-om hi.
english: The length of the porch was twenty cubits and the width eleven cubits, even by the steps by which they went up to it. There were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.

paite: Huan tempul ah ahon pilut a, abaangkate ateh a, asik tuak ah tong guk a sah tuaktuak a-om a, huai tuh biakbuk vailam chia ahi.
english: He brought me to the nave and measured the posts, six cubits wide on the one side and six cubits wide on the other side, which was the width of the tent.

paite: Huan alutna tong sawm a za ahi a; asik tuak ah baangkate tong nga tuaktuak ahi; huan asunglam ateh a, adunglam tong sawmli leh availam tong sawmnih ahi.
english: The width of the entrance was ten cubits, and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side. He measured its length, forty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits.

paite: Dantan sungnung ah alut a, alutna baangkate tong nih a sah tuaktuak ahi a; alutna tong guk a za ahi a; alutna baangkate tong sagih tuaktuak ahi.
english: Then he went inward and measured each post of the entrance, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits; and the width of the entrance, seven cubits.

paite: Dantan sungnung ateh a, asungpi ban ah adunglam tong sawmnih ahi a; tempul kantan availam leng tong sawmnih ahi. Huan ka kiang ah, "Hiai Mun Siangthoupen ahi," ahon chi hi.
english: He measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, before the nave. He said to me, “This is the most holy place.”

paite: Huan atempul baang ateh a, tong guk a sah ahi; huan tempul sik chih ah dantan tong li a za chiat a-om hi.
english: Then he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the width of every side room, four cubits, all around the house on every side.

paite: Huan chial thumte ah pang dantante a-om ua, huchi a huai lai a letkipna aneih theihlouhna ding un, tempul baang a letkipna nei lou in.
english: The side rooms were in three stories, one over another, and thirty in each story. They entered into the wall which belonged to the house for the side rooms all around, that they might be supported and not penetrate the wall of the house.

paite: Huchi in apang dantante hong san hiaihiai in aza semsem a; tempul azuih touh ziak in, akimvel in asungpi anaih hulhul hi. Huchi in dantan nuainungpen a kipan atungnungpen pha a pai ding in alai a kantan ding ahi.
english: The side rooms were wider on the higher levels, because the walls were narrower at the higher levels. Therefore the width of the house increased upward; and so one went up from the lowest level to the highest through the middle level.

paite: Huan tempul kim ah suanglep vum om in ka mu a; pang dantan suangphum tehna chiang, tong guk hial a sau tan a sang ahi.
english: I saw also that the house had a raised base all around. The foundations of the side rooms were a full reed of six great cubits.

paite: Pang dantan polam bang tong nga a sah ahi; tempul pang dantan polam baang ban ah tong nga a-awl lai hi.
english: The thickness of the outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits. That which was left was the place of the side rooms that belonged to the house.

paite: Inpi suanglep vum leh tempul huangsung dantante kikal akimvel in tong sawmnih a za ahi.
english: Between the rooms was a width of twenty cubits around the house on every side.

paite: Pang dantan kongkhakte mun awng lam a hon ahi a, khat in mallam, adang khat in simlam anga a; akim a mun awng tong nga a za ahi.
english: The doors of the side rooms were toward an open area that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south. The width of the open area was five cubits all around.

paite: Huan tumlam a phaitam khekhiakna lam nga inn tong sawmsagih a za ahi; huai inn baang akim in tong nga a sah vek ahi a, adung tong sawmkua ahi.
english: The building that was before the separate place at the side toward the west was seventy cubits wide; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length ninety cubits.

paite: Huan tempul ateh a tong za a sau ahi; inn phaitam mun awng leh huai tempul baang sahdan simtel in tong za ahi nawn hi.
english: So he measured the temple, one hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with its walls, one hundred cubits long;

paite: Tempul kongtual mun awng tong za a sau ahi.
english: also the width of the face of the temple, and of the separate place toward the east, one hundred cubits.

paite: Huan aphaitam mun awng khen inn dunglam ateh a, apang tuak abaangte huap in tong zakhat ahi.
english: He measured the length of the building before the separate place which was at its back, and its galleries on the one side and on the other side, one hundred cubits from the inner temple, and the porches of the court,

paite: Huan asungpite, tohlet khuam neute, polam sumtawngte singpek in athuap ua; athum un akimvel in hon theih louh tohlet leh inchial anei a; inpi lutna kongpi tan in apialkhang a kipan tohlet pha a apum a singpek a thuap ahi, tohlet leng thuap ahi lai hi.
english: the thresholds, and the closed windows, and the galleries around on their three stories, opposite the threshold, with wood ceilings all around, and from the ground up to the windows, (now the windows were covered),

paite: Kongpi lutungte, dantan sungnung tanpha leh apolam toh, baang tengteng asunglam leh apolam tan in.
english: to the space above the door, even to the inner house, and outside, and by all the wall all around inside and outside, by measure.

paite: Huaite cherub limte leh tum sing limte a zep ahi a, cherub leh cherub kikal ah tum sing a-om zel a; cherubte'n mai nih anei chiat uhi.
english: It was made with cherubim and palm trees. A palm tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces,

paite: Mihing mel bang in alangkhat in tum sing lam anga a, humpinelkai tuailai mel bang in alangkhat in tum sing lam anga nawn hi. Hiaite tempul kimvel vek in agelh uhi.
english: so that there was the face of a man toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side. It was made like this through all the house all around.

paite: Apialkhang a kipan in kongpi tung pha in cherub leh tum sing lim a zep vek ahi; tempul baang bel huchi vek ahi.
english: Cherubim and palm trees were made from the ground to above the door. The wall of the temple was like this.

paite: Tempul kongpi biang khuamte tuh asah azat kibang ahi. Mun Siangthou ma ah sing a bawl maitam bangtak a-om hi.
english: The door posts of the nave were squared. As for the face of the nave, its appearance was as the appearance of the temple.

paite: Tong thum a sang, tong nih a za, aningte, atawte leh apangte sing a bawl vek ahi. Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai TOUPA ma a dohkan ahi,” achi hi.
english: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits. Its corners, its base, and its walls were of wood. He said to me, “This is the table that is before Yahweh.”

paite: Tempul leh Mun Siangthou in kongkhak nih tuaktuak anei hi.
english: The temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

paite: Kongkhak in phel nih anei tuaktuak a; aphel khat bel kheptheih chiat ahi; kongkhak khat ah phel nih, adang ah phel nih anei hi.
english: The doors had two leaves each, two turning leaves: two for the one door, and two leaves for the other.

paite: Baang a agelh mah bang un tempul kongkhakte ah cherub leh tum sing lim agelh chiat lai ua; sumtawng pua ah singpek sah mahmah aphalh uhi.
english: There were made on them, on the doors of the nave, cherubim and palm trees, like those made on the walls. There was a threshold of wood on the face of the porch outside.

paite: Huan sumtawng baang lang tuakte leh singpek phalhte ah tohlet hon theih louh leh tum sing lim a-om lai a; atempul pang dantan leh singpek phalh leng huchibang mah ahi.
english: There were closed windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch. This is how the side rooms of the temple and the thresholds were arranged.

paite: Huan huang sungnungzaw malam pang ah ahon pikhia a; mun awng zawn mallam kulh khuam doh dantan ah hon pilut hi.
english: Then he brought me out into the outer court, the way toward the north. Then he brought me into the room that was opposite the separate place, and which was opposite the building toward the north.

paite: Mallam pang a dantante tong za a sau tong sawmnga a za ahi.
english: Facing the length of one hundred cubits was the north door, and the width was fifty cubits.

paite: Huang sungnungzaw pen mun awng tong sawmnih lam nga leh huang ponungzaw suanglep lam doh inchial thum a-om tuaktuak hi.
english: Opposite the twenty cubits which belonged to the inner court, and opposite the pavement which belonged to the outer court, was gallery against gallery in the three stories.

paite: Dantante kikal ah tong sawm a za, tong za a sau paisuakna a-om a, akongkhakte'n mallam anga hi.
english: Before the rooms was a walk of ten cubits’ width inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors were toward the north.

paite: Dantan tungnungte akochikzaw a; inchial nuainungzaw leh alaitate sang in a-inchialte'n mun lian aluah zaw uhi.
english: Now the upper rooms were shorter; for the galleries took away from these more than from the lower and the middle in the building.

paite: Chial thum a lam ahi a, huangsung khuamte bang in khuam anei kei a; huchi in alaita sang in atungnungpen akochikzaw a, alaita leng anuainungpen sang in akochikzaw lai hi.
english: For they were in three stories, and they didn’t have pillars as the pillars of the courts. Therefore the uppermost was set back more than the lowest and the middle from the ground.

paite: Huan dantan pang polam ah huangsung ponungzaw pen lam doh baang tong sawmnga a sau a-om hi.
english: The wall that was outside by the side of the rooms, toward the outer court before the rooms, was fifty cubits long.

paite: Huangsung ponungzaw a dantante tong sawmnga a sau ahi ua; tempul zul a pen tong za a sau ahi.
english: For the length of the rooms that were in the outer court was fifty cubits. Behold, those facing the temple were one hundred cubits.

paite: Huan huai dantante nuai ah suahlam pang ah huangsung ponungzaw a kipan polam ah alutna a-om hi.
english: From under these rooms was the entry on the east side, as one goes into them from the outer court.

paite: Simlam ah leng mun awng zawn a kulhbaang doh in dantante a-om nawn hi.
english: In the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, before the separate place, and before the building, there were rooms.

paite: Ama a paina leng mallam dantante paina mah bang ahi a; adung leh avai leng, apawtkhiaknate, alepkhawmdante, akongkhakte'n simlam anga chih kia lou ngal akibang vek ahi.
english: The way before them was like the appearance of the rooms which were toward the north. Their length and width were the same. All their exits had the same arrangement and doors.

paite: Huai dantante lutna ding paisuakna tawp suahlam baangchin ah kongkhak a-om hi.
english: Like the doors of the rooms that were toward the south was a door at the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one enters into them.

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Simlam leh mallam dantan, mun awl hon dohte dantan siangthoute ahi ua; thil siangthoute akoihkhawm ua; nek ding latnate, khelh ziak a kithoihnate, moh ziak a kithoihnate alatna ding uh ahi; amun lah asiangthou ngal a.
english: Then he said to me, “The north rooms and the south rooms, which are opposite the separate place, are the holy rooms, where the priests who are near to Yahweh shall eat the most holy things. There they shall lay the most holy things, with the meal offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.

paite: Huai lai a siampute alut phot uleh, mun siangthou a kipan in huangsung ponungzaw ah apawtkhe ding uh ahi kei; huai ah anasepna puansilhte uh akoih zaw ding ua, puansilh siangthou ahi ngal ua; puansilh dang silh kia in vantang lak ah agamtang thei ding uh," achi hi.
english: When the priests enter in, then they shall not go out of the holy place into the outer court until they lay their garments in which they minister there; for they are holy. Then they shall put on other garments, and shall approach that which is for the people.”

paite: Tempul sungnungzaw pen ateh khit in suahlam nga kongpi ah ahon pikhia a, tempul kimvel in ateh hi.
english: Now when he had finished measuring the inner house, he brought me out by the way of the gate which faces toward the east, and measured it all around.

paite: Tehna chiang in suahlam pang ateh a, atehna chiang a teh in tong zanga ahi.
english: He measured on the east side with the measuring reed five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed all around.

paite: Mallam pang ahon teh nawn leuleu a, atehna chiang a teh in tong zanga ahi.
english: He measured on the north side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed all around.

paite: Simlam pang ateh nawn a, tehna chiang a teh in tong zanga mah ahi.
english: He measured on the south side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

paite: Huan tumlam ahon teh nawn a, atehna chiang a teh in tong zanga mah ahi.
english: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

paite: Apang li in atehta a; adunglam tong zanga, availam tong zanga ahi; akim in kulhbaang nei ahi; huai mun siang leh siang lou deidanna ding a bawl ahi.
english: He measured it on the four sides. It had a wall around it, the length five hundred cubits, and the width five hundred cubits, to make a separation between that which was holy and that which was common.

paite: Huchi in kongpi ah, suahlam kongpi ah ahon pi hi.
english: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looks toward the east.

paite: Ngai dih, Israel' Pathian thupina suahlam a kipan in ahong tung a; ahusa tui tampi ging bang ahi a, athupina in leitung atanvak hi.
english: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east. His voice was like the sound of many waters; and the earth was illuminated with his glory.

paite: Kilakna ka muh a alatdan, khopi hihse ding a hong pai leh Kebar lui gei a kilakna ka muh bangmah ahi a; huchi in bokkhup in ka pukta hi.
english: It was like the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city; and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell on my face.

paite: Suahlam nga kongpi ah tempul sung ah TOUPA thupina alut hi.
english: Yahweh’s glory came into the house by the way of the gate which faces toward the east.

paite: Kha in ahon domkang a, huang sungnungzaw ah ahon pilut a; huan, ngai in, TOUPA thupina in tempul aluahdim hi.
english: The Spirit took me up and brought me into the inner court; and behold, Yahweh’s glory filled the house.

paite: Huan mi khat ka kiang a adin lai in mi kuahiam tempul polam a kipan hon houpih in ka za a, ka kiang ah,
english: I heard one speaking to me out of the house, and a man stood by me.

paite: "Mihing tapa, hiai ka laltutphah omna mun, ka khepek ngakna, Israel suante lak a tangtawn a ka tenna ding mun ahi; ka min siangthou Israel inkote'n amau inn hiam, akumpipate uh hiam, ahukna uleh akumpipate uh luangvuina a zang in ahihthanghuai nawnta kei ding uh.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell among the children of Israel forever. The house of Israel will no more defile my holy name, neither they nor their kings, by their prostitution and by the dead bodies of their kings in their high places;

paite: Akongpi uh ka kongpi chin mahmah a bawl in, akongpi biang uh ka kongpi biang zul a koih in amau leh keimah kikal ah baang kia omsak in athilhih kihhuaite un ka min siangthou ahihthanghuai uhi; huaiziak in ka hehna in amau ka hihmangta hi.
english: in their setting of their threshold by my threshold and their door post beside my door post. There was a wall between me and them; and they have defiled my holy name by their abominations which they have committed. Therefore I have consumed them in my anger.

paite: Tu a kipan in kizuaknate, akumpipa uh luangte kei a kipan gamlapi ah koihmang le uh; huchi in alak uah tangtawn in ka teng ding hi.
english: Now let them put away their prostitution, and the dead bodies of their kings far from me. Then I will dwell among them forever.

paite: "Nang mihing tapa, Israel inkote kiang ah tempul lim ensak in; athilhihkhelh uh azumpih theihna ding un, abawldan ding leng na teh uhen.
english: “You, son of man, show the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities; and let them measure the pattern.

paite: Huan athilhih tengteng uh azumpih ua atempul omdante, apawtkhiaknate, alutnate, ageldante, azatdante, akepdante ensak inla, amitmuh mahmah uah gelh in; adan pumpi leh azatdan tengteng avom ua, azuihtheihna ding un.
english: If they are ashamed of all that they have done, make known to them the form of the house, its fashion, its exits, its entrances, its structure, all its ordinances, all its forms, and all its laws; and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form of it, and all its ordinances, and do them.

paite: Hiai tempul a dia dan ding ahi; tang vum tau kim tengteng mun siangthoupen ding ahi; ngai dih, hiai tempul a dia dan ding ahi.
english: “This is the law of the house. On the top of the mountain the whole limit around it shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.

paite: "Huan tong a teh in hiai maitam let lam ahi, tong khat chih tong khat leh khutpek tuam ahi a, akingakna tong khat a sang, tong khat a za, agei akim a khap khat a pawng zel ahi.
english: “These are the measurements of the altar by cubits (the cubit is a cubit and a hand width): the bottom shall be a cubit, and the width a cubit, and its border around its edge a span; and this shall be the base of the altar.

paite: Huan maitam sanlam hichibang ahi; lei a akingakna a kipan dohdan nuainungzaw pen tong nih ahi a, azatlam tong khat; adohdan neuzaw pen a kipan dohdan lianzaw pen tong li ahi a, tong khat a za ahi.
english: From the bottom on the ground to the lower ledge shall be two cubits, and the width one cubit; and from the lesser ledge to the greater ledge shall be four cubits, and the width a cubit.

paite: Amaitam tau tong li a sang ahi nawn a, maitam tau a kipan leh atunglam kii li ding ahi.
english: The upper altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar hearth and upward there shall be four horns.

paite: Maitam tau adung leh avai tong sawm-le-nih tuaktuak ahi; adung-avai kikim ahi.
english: The altar hearth shall be twelve cubits long by twelve wide, square in its four sides.

paite: Dohdan dung leh vai tong sawm-le-li tuaktuak ahi; adung-avai kikim ahi; agei tong kimkhat ahi; akingakna akim in tong khat ahi; akalbi in suahlam angat ding ahi," achi hi.
english: The ledge shall be fourteen cubits long by fourteen wide in its four sides; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and its bottom shall be a cubit around; and its steps shall look toward the east.”

paite: Huan ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, TOUPA Pathian in hichi in achi: Abawl khit chiang ua maitam zatdan ding hichibang ahi; halmang kithoihna dingte, sisan thehna dingte ahi.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, the Lord Yahweh says: ‘These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they make it, to offer burnt offerings on it, and to sprinkle blood on it.

paite: Levi chi siampu Zadok suan a mi, nna hon sepsak ding a hon naih sekpa kiang ah khelh ziak a kithoihna ding in ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai na piak ding ahi, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: You shall give to the Levitical priests who are of the offspring of Zadok, who are near to me, to minister to me,’ says the Lord Yahweh, ‘a young bull for a sin offering.

paite: Asisan na la ding a, maitam kii lite leh adohdan ning lite, agei kimvel in na luan ding a; huchibang in maitam na hihsiang in na siangsak ding hi.
english: You shall take of its blood and put it on its four horns, and on the four corners of the ledge, and on the border all around. You shall cleanse it and make atonement for it that way.

paite: Khelh ziak a kithoihna bawngtaltuai na la ding a, huai ding a tempul aseh uh, mun siangthou polam ah hal ahih ding ahi.
english: You shall also take the bull of the sin offering, and it shall be burned in the appointed place of the house, outside of the sanctuary.

paite: Huan ani nihna in keltal dembei, khelh ziak a kithoihna ding a lat ding ahi; huchi in maitam bel bawngtaltuai a ahihsiang mah bang un na siangsak ding hi.
english: “On the second day you shall offer a male goat without defect for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they cleansed it with the bull.

paite: Maitam hihsiang pen na hih khit chiang un ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai gensiatbei leh belamtal, gensiatbei, ahon lak a na lan ding hi.
english: When you have finished cleansing it, you shall offer a young bull without defect and a ram out of the flock without defect.

paite: TOUPA ma ah na lan ding a, siampu in chi asoh ding a, TOUPA kiang ah halmang a ding in alan ding.
english: You shall bring them near to Yahweh, and the priests shall cast salt on them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering to Yahweh.

paite: Ni sagih sung niteng khelh ziak a kithoihna ding in keltal na zang ding ahi; ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai leh belamtal, ahon lak a, gensiatbei leng azat ding uh ahi.
english: “Seven days you shall prepare every day a goat for a sin offering. They shall also prepare a young bull and a ram out of the flock, without defect.

paite: Maitam hihsiang leh siansakna in ni sagih ala ding a; huchi in maitam siangthou ahita ding hi.
english: Seven days shall they make atonement for the altar and purify it. So shall they consecrate it.

paite: Huan huai nite ahihtangtun khit chiang un, ani giat ni a kipan in siampute'n na halmang kithoihnate uh leh lemna kithoihnate amaitam uah alan ding ua, huan ka hon na sang ding chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi," achi hi.
english: When they have accomplished the days, it shall be that on the eighth day and onward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings on the altar and your peace offerings. Then I will accept you,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”

paite: Huan mun siangthou kongpi ponungzaw, suahlam nga ah hon pikik nawn a, kong khaksa ana hi.
english: Then he brought me back by the way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which looks toward the east; and it was shut.

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Hiai kongpi akikhak gige ding a, akihong ngei kei ding a, kuamah alut sam kei ding uh; TOUPA, Israel' Pathian ahong lut khit ziak in; akikhak gige ding ahi.
english: Yahweh said to me, “This gate shall be shut. It shall not be opened, no man shall enter in by it; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, has entered in by it. Therefore it shall be shut.

paite: Kumpi bel TOUPA ma a an ne ding in huai ah atu phet ding; sumtawng kongkhak ah alut ding a, huai mah ah apawt nawn ding," achi hi.
english: As for the prince, he shall sit in it as prince to eat bread before Yahweh. He shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate, and shall go out the same way.”

paite: Huan mallam nga kongpi ah tempul intual ah ahon pi a; ka en a ngai dih, TOUPA thupina in TOUPA tempul aluahdim vek a; huchi in bokkhup in ka pukta hi.
english: Then he brought me by the way of the north gate before the house; and I looked, and behold, Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house; so I fell on my face.

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, TOUPA tempul zatdan leh adan tengteng na kiang a ka gen tungtang ah na bildoh inla, na mitsuan inla, na lungsim ah chiamteh hoih dih; atempul a lutdante, amun siangthou a kipan pawtdante, na lungsim ah hoihtak in chiamteh in.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Son of man, mark well, and see with your eyes, and hear with your ears all that I tell you concerning all the ordinances of Yahweh’s house and all its laws; and mark well the entrance of the house, with every exit of the sanctuary.

paite: "Huan helhat, Israel inkote ngei kiang ah huchi in na gen ding ahi; Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Aw, nou Israel inkote aw, na thilhih kihhuai tengteng uh ahunta,
english: You shall tell the rebellious, even the house of Israel, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “You house of Israel, let that be enough of all your abominations,

paite: lungtang leh sa zeksum louh, ka tanghoute, thaute na lat lai ua ka mun siangthou, ka tempul mahmah hihbuah ding a na pilut ua, ka thukhun a na tatlek uh, na kihhuaina tengtengte uh na tawpta hen.
english: in that you have brought in foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to profane it, even my house, when you offer my bread, the fat and the blood; and they have broken my covenant, to add to all your abominations.

paite: Ka thil siangthoute nou na kem kei ua, hiai pau tuam mite ka mun siangthou ah nou sik a kemmi in na sep zaw uhi."
english: You have not performed the duty of my holy things; but you have set performers of my duty in my sanctuary for yourselves.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Gamdangmi kuamah, lungtang leh sa zeksum louh, Israel suante lak a gamdangmi kuamah ka mun siangthou ah alut ding uh ahi kei hi.”
english: The Lord Yahweh says, “No foreigner, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any foreigners who are among the children of Israel.

paite: Levi chi, Israelte milim delh a avakmang lai ua kei a kipan a gamlapi a paisate'n bel athulimlouhna uh apo ding uh.
english: “‘“But the Levites who went far from me when Israel went astray, who went astray from me after their idols, they will bear their iniquity.

paite: Ka mun siangthou ah nasemmi in apang ding ua; tempul kongkhakte angak ding ua; tempul sung ah nna asem ding uh; halmang kithoihnate, mipi a dia kithoihnate agou ding ua; mipi nna sepsak ding in ama uah adingh ding uhi.
english: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the house, and ministering in the house. They shall kill the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister to them.

paite: Amilimte uh ma ah a-nna uh asepsak ding ua; Israelte inkote a ding in thulimlouhna a pukna ahih nak ziak un atung uah ka khut ka lik ding a; athulimlouhna uh apo ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: Because they ministered to them before their idols, and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel, therefore I have lifted up my hand against them,” says the Lord Yahweh, “and they will bear their iniquity.

paite: Huchi in ka kiang ah siampu nna sem ding in ahon naih ngei kei ding ua; ka thil siangthoute, thil siangthoupente ahon naih ngei sam kei ding uh; azahlakna uleh athilkihhuai hihsate uh apo zaw ding uh.
english: They shall not come near to me, to execute the office of priest to me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, to the things that are most holy; but they will bear their shame and their abominations which they have committed.

paite: Tempul kem mite ding in ka bawl ding a, nasepna tengteng leh hih ding om peuhmahte hih ding in.
english: Yet I will make them performers of the duty of the house, for all its service and for all that will be done therein.

paite: Siampu Levi chi, Zadok ta, kei a kipan a Israel suante avakmang lai ua ka mun siangthou kem mite'n bel ka nna sem ding in ahong naih ding uh; thau leh sisan lan ding in ka ma ah adingh ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: “‘“But the Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok, who performed the duty of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, shall come near to me to minister to me. They shall stand before me to offer to me the fat and the blood,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Ka mun siangthou ah alut ding ua, nna hon sepsak ding in ka dohkan ahong naih ding ua, kei hon kemmi in apang ding uh.
english: “They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister to me, and they shall keep my instruction.

paite: Huan huang sungnungzaw kongpite a alut un puanaktual malngat in akithuam ding ua, huang sungnungzaw leh insung lam a nna asep sung un samul puan asilh ding uh ahi kei hi.
english: “‘“It will be that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments. No wool shall come on them while they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.

paite: Dial malngat akhim ding ua, puanmalngat pheitom abun ding ua, kho-ulsak thei asilh ding uh ahi kei hi.
english: They shall have linen turbans on their heads, and shall have linen trousers on their waists. They shall not clothe themselves with anything that makes them sweat.

paite: Huan huangsung ponungzaw, vantang kiang a ahong pawtkhiak uleh anasepna puansilhte uh asuah ding ua, dantan siangthou ah akoih ding uh, puansilh dang asilh ding uh; mipite apuansilh ua misiangthou a abawl teilouhna ding un.
english: When they go out into the outer court, even into the outer court to the people, they shall put off their garments in which they minister and lay them in the holy rooms. They shall put on other garments, that they not sanctify the people with their garments.

paite: Alute uh ametgiau ding uh ahi kei a; asam uh leng ahawisau ding uh ahi sam kei; amet lel ding uh ahi.
english: “‘“They shall not shave their heads, or allow their locks to grow long. They shall only cut off the hair of their heads.

paite: Siampu kuapeuh huang sungnungzaw pen alut chiang un uain adawn ding uh ahi kei hi.
english: None of the priests shall drink wine when they enter into the inner court.

paite: Meithai hiam maksa nung hiam zi in anei ding uh ahi sam kei hi; Israel inkote, nungak siangthou hiam siampu sihsan meithai akitenpih zawk ding uh ahi.
english: They shall not take for their wives a widow, or her who is put away; but they shall take virgins of the offspring of the house of Israel, or a widow who is the widow of a priest.

paite: Ka mite thil siangthou leh thil nin kibatlouhdan ahilh ding ua; siang leh siang lou akhentuamsak ding uhi.
english: They shall teach my people the difference between the holy and the common, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.

paite: Thubuaite leng angaihtuah ding uh ahi; ka ngaihtuah bang zel in angaihtuah ding uh; ka ankuanglui sehsa tengteng ah ka dante leh ka dan thuseh bawlsate azuih ding uh ahi; ka Sabbathte leng atan ding uh ahi.
english: “‘“In a controversy they shall stand to judge. They shall judge it according to my ordinances. They shall keep my laws and my statutes in all my appointed feasts. They shall make my Sabbaths holy.

paite: Amau kihihbuah ding in misi luang anaih ding uh ahi kei; himahleh nu hiam, pa hiam, tanu hiam, tapa hiam unaupa hiam sanggamnu pasal nei lou hiam a ding in bel akihihbuah thei ding uh.
english: “‘“They shall go in to no dead person to defile themselves; but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister who has had no husband, they may defile themselves.

paite: Huan akisiansak nung in amah a ding in ni sagih simsak nawn ding ahi.
english: After he is cleansed, they shall reckon to him seven days.

paite: Huang sungnungzaw mun siangthou a nasem ding a alut ni in khelh ziak a kithoihna amah a ding in alan ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: In the day that he goes into the sanctuary, into the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Goutan bangmah anei kei ding ua; agoutan uh kei ka hi ding. Israel ah tan bangmah na pe ding uh ahi kei, atan uh keimah ka hi.
english: “‘They shall have an inheritance: I am their inheritance; and you shall give them no possession in Israel. I am their possession.

paite: Nek ding latte, khelh ziak a thillatte, moh ziak a thillatte ane ding ua; Israel lak a thil latsa peuhmah amau a ding ahi.
english: They shall eat the meal offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every devoted thing in Israel shall be theirs.

paite: Gah masate lak a ahoihpente, na thillat chiteng ua ahoihpen, na thillat tengteng ua siampute a ding ahi; na inn ua vualzawlna atamdet theihna ding in tangbuang meklom hoihpen siampu kiang ah na pe ding uh ahi.
english: The first of all the first fruits of every thing, and every offering of everything, of all your offerings, shall be for the priest. You shall also give to the priests the first of your dough, to cause a blessing to rest on your house.

paite: Siampute'n sapul anek louh ding uh ahi. Vasa hiam gamsa bohzan hiam, amah sih a si hiam anek ding uh ahi kei hi.
english: The priests shall not eat of anything that dies of itself or is torn, whether it is bird or animal.

paite: Huai lou in leng goutan ding a gam na hawm hun chiang un gamseh siangthou, TOUPA kiang ah thilpiak na bawl ding uhi. Adunglam tong singnih-le-sangnga, availam tong singnih, apum in gam siangthou ahi ding hi.
english: “‘“Moreover, when you divide by lot the land for inheritance, you shall offer an offering to Yahweh, a holy portion of the land. The length shall be the length of twenty-five thousand reeds, and the width shall be ten thousand. It shall be holy in all its border all around.

paite: Hiai ah mun siangthou a ding in adung leh avai tong zanga tuaktuak, kimvel ahi ding a, akimvel in tong zanga a za mun awng a-om ding ahi.
english: Of this there shall be a five hundred by five hundred square for the holy place, and fifty cubits for its pasture lands all around.

paite: Huan hiai tehsa a kipan in adung tong singnih-le-sangnga leh avai tong singkhat na tehkhe ding a, huai ah Mun Siangthoupen a-om ding ahi.
english: Of this measure you shall measure a length of twenty-five thousand, and a width of ten thousand. In it shall be the sanctuary, which is most holy.

paite: Gamseh siangthou bel, mun siangthou a nasemmi, a-nna sem ding a TOUPA hong naih siampute a ding ahi ding a, a-inn mun ding un leh mun siangthou ding in gam siangthou ahi ding hi.
english: It is a holy portion of the land; it shall be for the priests, the ministers of the sanctuary, who come near to minister to Yahweh. It shall be a place for their houses and a holy place for the sanctuary.

paite: Mun dang adung tong singnih-le-sangnga, avai tong singkhat, Levi chi tempul a nasem mite tuam ding in, atenna khopi ding in a-om ding ahi.
english: Twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width shall be for the Levites, the ministers of the house, as a possession for themselves, for twenty rooms.

paite: Gamseh siangthou latsa zul ah khopi tan avai tong zanga leh adung tong singnih-le-sangnga na sep ding uhi, Israel inkote pumpi a ding ahi ding.
english: “‘“You shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand cubits wide and twenty-five thousand long, side by side with the offering of the holy portion. It shall be for the whole house of Israel.

paite: Huan kumpi tapa tan bel gam siangthou latsa leh khopi tan malam ah tumlam a tumlam nga in, suahlam a suahlam nga in a-om ding ahi. Adung bel tumlam gamgi a kipan a suahlam gamgi pha in, gamseh dang tan mah ahi.
english: “‘“What is for the prince shall be on the one side and on the other side of the holy allotment and of the possession of the city, in front of the holy allotment and in front of the possession of the city, on the west side westward, and on the east side eastward, and in length corresponding to one of the portions, from the west border to the east border.

paite: Huai bel Israel gam a amah tantuam ahi ding ahi; ka vaihawmte'n ka mite anuaisiah nawn kei ding ua, Israel inkote anam tuamdan bang zel un gam ape zaw ding uhi.
english: In the land it shall be to him for a possession in Israel. My princes shall no more oppress my people, but they shall give the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Aw, Israel vaihawmte aw, hunta hen, hiamgamna leh kigapna tawpsanta unla; diktattak a vaihawm leh diktak a hih chingta unla, ka mite delhkhiak nak pen tawpsanta un, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Enough, you princes of Israel! Remove violence and plunder, and execute justice and righteousness! Stop dispossessing my people!” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Bukna dik, ephah dik leh bath dik na zat ding uh ahi.
english: “You shall have just balances, a just ephah, and a just bath.

paite: Ephah leh bath akikim ding uh ahi, bath homer seh sawm a khen seh khat ahi ding a, ephah leng homer seh sawm a khen seh khat ahi sam ding; homer a kipan a tehkhiak ding ahi ding.
english: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain one tenth of a homer, and the ephah one tenth of a homer. Its measure shall be the same as the homer.

paite: Huan shekel bel gerah sawmnih ahi ding a; shekel sawmnih toh shekel sawmnih-le-nga toh shekel sawm-le-nga gawmkhawm na mina uh khat toh kikim ahi ding hi.
english: The shekel shall be twenty gerahs. Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels shall be your mina.

paite: Huan hiai thillat na lat ding uh ahi ding; buh homer khat zel ah ephah seh guk a khen seh khat leh buh man homer khat zel ah ephah seh guk a khen seh khat na pe ding uhi.
english: “‘“This is the offering that you shall offer: the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of wheat, and you shall give the sixth part of an ephah from a homer of barley,

paite: Huan sathau latdan ding kor khat zel ah bath seh sawm a khen seh khat; kor bel bath sawm ahi.
english: and the set portion of oil, of the bath of oil, one tenth of a bath out of the cor, which is ten baths, even a homer (for ten baths are a homer),

paite: Israel gantatna mun hoih a kipan belamhon lak a zanih zel ah anou khat, nek ding lat ding in, halmang kithoihna ding in lemna thillat ding in amaute hihsianna bawlna ding in alat ding uh ahi, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: and one lamb of the flock out of two hundred, from the well-watered pastures of Israel—for a meal offering, for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make atonement for them,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Gam a mi tengteng in Israel vaihawmpa kiang ah hiai thillat ape ding uh.
english: “All the people of the land shall give to this offering for the prince in Israel.

paite: Ankuang luina ah, kha thak ah, Sabbath ni ah, Israel ankuanglui ni sehsa tengteng ah halmang kithoihna, nek ding lat, dawn ding latte lan in angaihtuah ding a; khelh ziak a kithoihna, nek ding lat, halmang kithoihna, lemna thillat Israel inkote kisiansakna ding in ama'n atumsak ding ahi.
english: It shall be the prince’s part to give the burnt offerings, the meal offerings, and the drink offerings, in the feasts, and on the new moons, and on the Sabbaths, in all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel. He shall prepare the sin offering, the meal offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make atonement for the house of Israel.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: “Kha khatna, huai kha ani khat ni in ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai gensiatbei na la ding a, mun siangthou na siangsak ding ahi.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In the first month, on the first day of the month, you shall take a young bull without defect, and you shall cleanse the sanctuary.

paite: Huan siampu in khelh ziak a kithoihna sisan ala ding a, tempul kongpi biang leh maitam dohdan ning lite leh huang sungnungzaw pen kongpi baangka ah atat ding hi.
english: The priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the door posts of the house, and on the four corners of the ledge of the altar, and on the posts of the gate of the inner court.

paite: Huai kha ani sagih ni in hihkhak hiam theih louh ziak hiam a thil hihkhialmite a ding in leng huchi mah bang in na hih ding a, huchibang in tempul hihsianna na bawl ding hi.
english: So you shall do on the seventh day of the month for everyone who errs, and for him who is simple. So you shall make atonement for the house.

paite: "Akha khatna, huai kha ani sawm-le-li ni in Paikan Ankuang na lui ding ua; huan, ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding uh.
english: “‘“In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, you shall have the Passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.

paite: Huai ni in vaihawmpa'n amah leh agam a mi tengteng a ding in, khelh ziak a kithoihna ding bawngtaltuai atum ding ahi.
english: On that day the prince shall prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bull for a sin offering.

paite: Ankuanglui hun ni sagih sung teng in bawngtaltuai gensiatbei sagih leh belamtal sagih zel TOUPA a ding in halmang kithoihna ding in atum ding; huan khelh ziak a kithoihna ding in niteng in keltal khat toh.
english: The seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to Yahweh, seven bulls and seven rams without defect daily the seven days; and a male goat daily for a sin offering.

paite: Huan tanghou lat ding in bawngtal khat zel ah ephah khat, belamtal khat zel ah ephah khat leh ephah khat zel ah sathau hin khat atum ding hi.
english: He shall prepare a meal offering, an ephah for a bull, an ephah for a ram, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

paite: "Akha sagihna, huai kha ani sawm leh ni nga ni a ankuangluina ah ni sagih sung huchibang mah in ahih ding a, khelh ziak a kithoihnate, halmang kithoihnate, tanghou latte leh sathau latte atum ding ahi," achi hi.
english: “‘“In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the month, during the feast, he shall do like that for seven days. He shall make the same provision for sin offering, the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the oil.”

paite: Huchi in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Huang sungnungzaw pen kongpi suahlam nga pen nasep ni, ni guk sung a kikhak ding a, Sabbath leh kha thak ni in akihong ding ahi.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “The gate of the inner court that looks toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the Sabbath day it shall be opened, and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened.

paite: Huan vaihawmpa bel kongpi sumtawng ah alut ding a, kongpi baangka chin ah adingh ding a, siampute'n ahalmang kithoih leh lemna thillatte abawlsak ding ua, lutna kongpi dantan ah Pathian abe ding; huchi in apawtkhe ding a, nitaklam tan kong khak louh ahih ding ahi.
english: The prince shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate outside, and shall stand by the post of the gate; and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate. Then he shall go out, but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.

paite: Huan vantang in bel Sabbath leh kha thakte ah kongpi lutna chinte ah TOUPA ma ah Pathian abe ding uhi.
english: The people of the land shall worship at the door of that gate before Yahweh on the Sabbaths and on the new moons.

paite: Sabbath ni in vaihawmpa'n TOUPA kiang a halmang kithoihna a lat ding bel belamnou gensiatbei guk leh belamtal gensiatbei khat ahi ding.
english: The burnt offering that the prince shall offer to Yahweh shall be on the Sabbath day, six lambs without defect and a ram without defect;

paite: Belamtal khat zel ah tanghou lat ephah khat, belamnou pen ah bel apiak theih bangbang leh ephah khat ah sathau hin khat zel ahi ding hi.
english: and the meal offering shall be an ephah for the ram, and the meal offering for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

paite: Kha thak ni in ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai gensiatbei khat, belamnou guk leh belamtal khat ahi ding a, gensiatbei ahih vek ding uh ahi.
english: On the day of the new moon it shall be a young bull without defect, six lambs, and a ram. They shall be without defect.

paite: Huan tanghou lat abawl ding a, bawngtaltuai ah ephah khat, belamtal ah ephah khat, belamnou pen ah atheih bangbang leh ephah khat zel ah sathau hin khat ahi ding hi.
english: He shall prepare a meal offering: an ephah for the bull, and an ephah for the ram, and for the lambs according as he is able, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

paite: Vaihawmpa alut chiang in kongpi sumtawng ah alut ding a, huai mah ah apawtkhe nawn ding hi.
english: When the prince enters, he shall go in by the way of the porch of the gate, and he shall go out by its way.

paite: Vantangte bel ankuanglui ni sehsa a TOUPA ma a ahong pai uleh Pathian be ding a mallam kongpi a hong lut simlam kongpi ah apawtkhe ding ua; simlam kongpi a hong lut mallam kongpi ah apawtkhe leuleu ding uh; alutna kongpi uah akik ding uh ahi kei a, amalam uah apai zaw ding uh ahi.
english: “‘“But when the people of the land come before Yahweh in the appointed feasts, he who enters by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he who enters by the way of the south gate shall go out by the way of the north gate. He shall not return by the way of the gate by which he came in, but shall go out straight before him.

paite: Huan alut chiang un alak uah vaihawmpa alut ding a, apawt chiang un apawtkhe nawn ding hi.
english: The prince shall go in with them when they go in. When they go out, he shall go out.

paite: Nopbawlna leh sehsa ankuanglui nite, tanghou lat bawngtaltuai khat ah ephah khat, belamtal khat ah ephah khat, belamnou pen ah apiak theih bangbang, ephah khat ah sathau hin khat zel ahi ding hi.
english: “‘“In the feasts and in the appointed holidays, the meal offering shall be an ephah for a bull, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

paite: Huan vaihawmpa'n ut thu a thillat alat dekleh halmang kithoihna hiam lemna thillat hiam TOUPA kiang a ut thu a athillat bang a alat dekleh suahlam nga kong ahonsak ding a, Sabbath ni a hih bangmah in, halmang kithoihnate leh lemna thillatte abawl ding; huchi in apawtkhe ding a, apawtkhiak nung in kong akhak ding uhi.
english: When the prince prepares a free will offering, a burnt offering or peace offerings as a free will offering to Yahweh, one shall open for him the gate that looks toward the east; and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he does on the Sabbath day. Then he shall go out; and after his going out one shall shut the gate.

paite: "Niteng a TOUPA kiang a halmang kithoihna ding in belamnou kum khat a upa, gensiatbei na zang ding a, zingsang in na zat ding ahi.
english: “‘“You shall prepare a lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering to Yahweh daily. Morning by morning you shall prepare it.

paite: Zingsang teng in tanghou lat na bawl ding a, ephah seh guk a khen seh khat leh sathau hin khat seh thum a khen seh khat tangbuang nel mahmah anomsakna ding; huai tuh tangtawn a TOUPA kiang a tanghou latdan ding ahi.
english: You shall prepare a meal offering with it morning by morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of a hin of oil to moisten the fine flour; a meal offering to Yahweh continually by a perpetual ordinance.

paite: Hichibang in halmang thillat gige ding in belamnou, tanghou latte, sathaute zingsang teng in na bawl ding ahi," chi in.
english: Thus they shall prepare the lamb, the meal offering, and the oil, morning by morning, for a continual burnt offering.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Vaihawmpa'n atapate, kua kiang ah leng, goutan bangpeuh apiakleh atapate a ahi ding a, agou uh luah ahi mai hi.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “If the prince gives a gift to any of his sons, it is his inheritance. It shall belong to his sons. It is their possession by inheritance.

paite: Himahleh agoutan a pen anasemmi kuahiam kiang a apiakleh sal pawtna kum tan in anei ding a, huai ah vaihawmpa kiang ah apekik nawn ding hi. Amah gou ngeingei bel atapate a ding ahi ding.
english: But if he gives of his inheritance a gift to one of his servants, it shall be his to the year of liberty; then it shall return to the prince; but as for his inheritance, it shall be for his sons.

paite: Huai lou in vaihawmpa in mite goutan asuhsak ding ahi kei a, aneih-le-lam ua kipan adelhkhe ding ahi sam kei; amah a pen mah atapate kiang ah goutan in ape ding a; amau neih-le-lam a kipan mite avakzaklouhna ding un," achi hi.
english: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people’s inheritance, to thrust them out of their possession. He shall give inheritance to his sons out of his own possession, that my people not each be scattered from his possession.”’”

paite: Huan kongpi pang a siampute a dia dantan siangthou mallam nga ah ahon pilut a; ngai dih, aphaitam tumlam pang ah mun ana om hi.
english: Then he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy rooms for the priests, which looked toward the north. Behold, there was a place on the back part westward.

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai siampute'n moh ziak a thillat leh khelh ziak a thillat ahuanna mun uh, tanghou lat omna mun ahi; huangsung ponungzaw a atawikhiak ua mite hihsianna dia abawllouhna ding un," achi hi.
english: He said to me, “This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, and where they shall bake the meal offering, that they not bring them out into the outer court, to sanctify the people.”

paite: Huang ponungzaw ah ahon pikhia a, huangsung ningzul ah ahon paisak a; ngai dih, ahuangsung ning chiat ah huang ana om nawn hi.
english: Then he brought me out into the outer court and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.

paite: Huangsung ning li ah huang, bang nei, adung tong sawmli, avai tong sawmthum ana om a; huai aning ate ali un akikim vek uhi.
english: In the four corners of the court there were courts enclosed, forty cubits long and thirty wide. These four in the corners were the same size.

paite: Huai mun li sunglam ah akimvel in suang vual in alem ua, huai vual nuai ah akim in huanna ding thuk a-om hi.
english: There was a wall around in them, around the four, and boiling places were made under the walls all around.

paite: Huchi in ka kiang ah, "Hiai an huanna innte ahi, tempul nasem mite'n mite kithoihna sa ahuanna dingte uh," achi hi.
english: Then he said to me, “These are the boiling houses, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.”

paite: Huchi in tempul kongkhak ah ahon pikik a; ngai dih, tempul kongpi chin nuai a kipan, suahlam nga in tui ahong luangkhia a; tempul suahlam nga ahi a, huan tui maitam simlam tempul pang taklam nuai a kipan in ahong luangkhia hi.
english: He brought me back to the door of the temple; and behold, waters flowed out from under the threshold of the temple eastward, for the front of the temple faced toward the east. The waters came down from underneath, from the right side of the temple, on the south of the altar.

paite: Huan mallam nga kongpi tawn in ahon pikhia a, inpua ah suahlam nga pawtkhiakna lampi ponungzaw tawn in ahon pi a; ngai dih, taklam pang ah tui ahong luangkhia hi.
english: Then he brought me out by the way of the gate northward, and led me around by the way outside to the outer gate, by the way of the gate that looks toward the east. Behold, waters ran out on the right side.

paite: Huan huai mi'n tehna khau tawi kawm a suahlam nga a pai in tong sangkhat ateh a; tui ahon ngap galkahsak a, siakmit tan ahi.
english: When the man went out eastward with the line in his hand, he measured one thousand cubits, and he caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the ankles.

paite: Huchi in tong sangkhat ateh nawn a; tui ahon ngap galkahsak nawn a, khuk tan ahi. Huan tong sangkhat ateh nawn a; hon ngap galkahsak nawn a, tui kawng tan ahi.
english: Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the knees. Again he measured one thousand, and caused me to pass through waters that were to the waist.

paite: Huan tong sangkhat ateh nawn a; ngah galkah vual louh luipi ahong hita a; tui ahong sang zel a, angah a ngah galkah vual louh, aleuh a leuh tham luipi ahong hita hi.
english: Afterward he measured one thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass through, for the waters had risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be walked through.

paite: Ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, hiai na mu hia?" achi hi. Huan lui gei a kik nawn ding in ahon pikikta hi.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, have you seen this?” Then he brought me and caused me to return to the bank of the river.

paite: Huchi in ka kik a, ngai dih, lui gei tawn in, lui gei lang tuak in sing tampi ana om hi.
english: Now when I had returned, behold, on the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai suahlam gam lam a tui luang Arabah gam a luanglut ding ahi; tuipi ah aluanglut ding a, tuipi tui al tui siangthou asuaksak ding.
english: Then he said to me, “These waters flow out toward the eastern region and will go down into the Arabah. Then they will go toward the sea and flow into the sea which will be made to flow out; and the waters will be healed.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a; luite aluanna peuh uah ganhing chiteng in ahinloh ding ua, ngasate a-om huthut ding uh; tuipi tui asianthouna ding leh aluanna peuh a ganhingte'n ahinlohna ding ua hiai lui hong luang ahi.
english: It will happen that every living creature which swarms, in every place where the rivers come, will live. Then there will be a very great multitude of fish; for these waters have come there, and the waters of the sea will be healed, and everything will live wherever the river comes.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a; agei ah ngaman mite adingh ding ua; Engedi a kipan Eneglaim pha in lenpaihna mun ahi ding; angasa pen achi bang zel un, tuipi lian ngasa bang mai in atam mahmah ding uh.
english: It will happen that fishermen will stand by it. From En Gedi even to En Eglaim will be a place for the spreading of nets. Their fish will be after their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceedingly many.

paite: Buannawi leh chiklakte bel asiangthou kei ding ua, chikhuk ding a nutsiat ahi ding hi.
english: But its swamps and marshes will not be healed. They will be given up to salt.

paite: Alui gei ah agei langnih in theikung chi chih apou ding a, huaite anah avuai ngei kei in agah lou ngei sam kei ding, mun siangthou a kipan a lui hong luangkhia a vak ahih ziak in kha teng in agah ding; agah nek ding ahi ding a, anah bel hihdamna ding ahi ding," achi hi.
english: By the river banks, on both sides, will grow every tree for food, whose leaf won’t wither, neither will its fruit fail. It will produce new fruit every month, because its waters issue out of the sanctuary. Its fruit will be for food, and its leaf for healing.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Hiai Israel nam sawm-le-nih lak a gam kihawmdan ding ahi hi; Joseph in tan nih atang ding.
english: The Lord Yahweh says: “This shall be the border by which you shall divide the land for inheritance according to the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph shall have two portions.

paite: Kibang chiat in na tang ding uh ahi; na pipute uh kiang a piak ding a ka kichiamsa ahi; hiai gam na gam tan un apuk ding ahi.
english: You shall inherit it, one as well as another; for I swore to give it to your fathers. This land will fall to you for inheritance.

paite: Hiai a gam pumpi gi ding ahi; mallam ah Tuipi Lian a kipan Hethlon a paisuak in Hamath lutna phaizang ah Zedad atung a;
english: “This shall be the border of the land: “On the north side, from the great sea, by the way of Hethlon, to the entrance of Zedad;

paite: Berothah, Damaskas leh Hamath kigitna lai a om Sibraim, Hauran gamgi zul a om Hazor-hattikon pha in.
english: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim (which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath), to Hazer Hatticon, which is by the border of Hauran.

paite: Huchi in gamgi bel Tuipi Lian a kipan in Damaskas gamgi zul a Hazar-enan pha in ahi ding a; mallam ah Hamath gamgi ahi ding hi. Hiai mallam gamgi ahi.
english: The border from the sea shall be Hazar Enon at the border of Damascus; and on the north northward is the border of Hamath. This is the north side.

paite: Huan suahlam ah Hauran leh Damaskas kikal ah Gilead leh Israel gam kikal a Jordan luidung azui ding; mallam gamgi a kipan in suahlam tuipi ah Tamar apha ding. Hiai suahlam gamgi ahi ding hi.
english: “The east side, between Hauran, Damascus, Gilead, and the land of Israel, shall be the Jordan; from the north border to the east sea you shall measure. This is the east side.

paite: Simlam ah Tamar a kipan in Meibothkadesh tuite pha in Aigupta lui zui in Tuipi Lian atung ding. Hiai simlam gamgi ding ahi.
english: “The south side southward shall be from Tamar as far as the waters of Meriboth Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea. This is the south side southward.

paite: Tumlam ah Tuipi Lian in agi ding a, simlam gamgi a kipan in Hamath lutna phaizang zawn pha in. Hiai tumlam gamgi ahi ding hi.
english: “The west side shall be the great sea, from the south border as far as opposite the entrance of Hamath. This is the west side.

paite: Huchi in hiai gam Israel nam dungzui in na lak uah na hawm ding uh.
english: “So you shall divide this land to yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, na gam tan ding uleh na lak ua namdang teng, zi leh ta neisate gam tan ding bel na hop ding uh ahi. Amau lah Israel ta ding a piang mawng ahi ding uh ahi; Israel namte lak ah noute bang in tan aneih ding uh ahi.
