english: You shall divide it by lot for an inheritance to you and to the aliens who live among you, who will father children among you. Then they shall be to you as the native-born among the children of Israel. They shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a; kua nam lak ah leng namdang ana teng taleh, huai lai a agam tan ding na sehsak ding uh ahi, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: In whatever tribe the stranger lives, there you shall give him his inheritance,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Hiaite anam minte uh ahi: Mallam gamgi Tuipi Lian a kipan a Hethlon paisuak in Hamath lutna phaizang ah Damaskas gamgi a Hamath kiang mallam pang Hazar-enan pha in, suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Dante tan ahi.
english: “Now these are the names of the tribes: From the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar Enan at the border of Damascus, northward beside Hamath (and they shall have their sides east and west), Dan, one portion.

paite: Dante tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Asherte tan ahi.
english: “By the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side, Asher, one portion.

paite: Asherte tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Naphtalite tan ahi.
english: “By the border of Asher, from the east side even to the west side, Naphtali, one portion.

paite: Naphtalite tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Manassehte tan ahi.
english: “By the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west side, Manasseh, one portion.

paite: Manassehte tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Ephraimte tan ahi.
english: “By the border of Manasseh, from the east side to the west side, Ephraim, one portion.

paite: Ephraimte tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Reubente tan ahi.
english: “By the border of Ephraim, from the east side even to the west side, Reuben, one portion.

paite: Reubente tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Judahte tan ahi.
english: “By the border of Reuben, from the east side to the west side, Judah, one portion.

paite: Judahte tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah, thilpiak na lat ding uh avai tong singnih-le-sangnga ahi ding a; adung suahlam leh tumlam sang ah tan dang bangmah in ahi a, alai a mun siangthou om in.
english: “By the border of Judah, from the east side to the west side, shall be the offering which you shall offer, twenty-five thousand reeds in width, and in length as one of the portions, from the east side to the west side; and the sanctuary shall be in the middle of it.

paite: Thilpiak TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh adung tong singnih-le-sangnga, avai tong singnih ahi ding ahi.
english: “The offering that you shall offer to Yahweh shall be twenty-five thousand reeds in length, and ten thousand in width.

paite: Huan hiai ah siampute a ding in gam siangthou thilpiak ding ahi ding a; mallam ah adung tong singnih-le-sangnga leh tumlam ah avai tong singkhat leh suahlam ah avai tong singkhat, simlam ah adung tong singnih-le-sangnga ahi ding ahi. Alaizang ah TOUPA mun siangthou a-om ding hi.
english: For these, even for the priests, shall be the holy offering: toward the north twenty-five thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in width, and toward the east ten thousand in width, and toward the south twenty-five thousand in length; and the sanctuary of Yahweh shall be in the middle of it.

paite: Siampu siansaksa, Zadok tapate ka thu kem mite a ding ahi ding, amaute Israel suante avakmang lai ua Levi chite avakmang bang ua vakmangloute ahi uhi.
english: It shall be for the priests who are sanctified of the sons of Zadok, who have kept my instruction, who didn’t go astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.

paite: Huan gam thilpiak pumpi a kipan amau a dia piak tuam, mun siangthoupen ahi ding; Levi chi tan toh akigi in.
english: It shall be to them an offering from the offering of the land, a most holy thing, by the border of the Levites.

paite: Siampu tan zulzul ah Levi chite'n tan anei ding ua, adung tong singnih-le-sangnga, avai tong singkhat ahi ding hi.
english: “Alongside the border of the priests, the Levites shall have twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width. All the length shall be twenty-five thousand, and the width ten thousand.

paite: Huan azuak ding uh ahi kei a, akhen ding uh leng ahi sam kei; agam hoihna tata leng midang kiang a piak ding ahi kei hi; TOUPA a dia siangthou ahi ngal a.
english: They shall sell none of it, nor exchange it, nor shall the first fruits of the land be alienated, for it is holy to Yahweh.

paite: Huan avai tong singnih-le-sangnga ban ah tong sangnga vantang tan, khopi dinna ding, tenna inn dingte leh khopuate a ding ahi ding; khopi bel alaizang a a-om ding ahi.
english: “The five thousand cubits that are left in the width, in front of the twenty-five thousand, shall be for common use, for the city, for dwelling and for pasture lands; and the city shall be in the middle of it.

paite: Huchi in ateh vialdan hichibang in ahi ding: Amallam pang tong sangli-le-zanga, asimlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga; asuahlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga, atumlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga.
english: These shall be its measurements: the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.

paite: Akhopi in khopua anei ding a; mallam pang in tong zanih-le-sawmnga; simlam pang tong zanih-le-sawmnga, suahlam pang tong zanih-le-sawmnga, tumlam pang tong zanih-le-sawmnga ahi.
english: The city shall have pasture lands: toward the north two hundred fifty, and toward the south two hundred fifty, and toward the east two hundred fifty, and toward the west two hundred fifty.

paite: Adunglam val lai, thilpiak siangthou zul a pen suahlam ah tong singkhat, tumlam ah tong singkhat ahi ding; thilpiak siangthousa zulzul ahi ding hi; huai a thilpawtte khopi a nasem mite nek ding ahi ding.
english: The remainder of the length, alongside the holy offering, shall be ten thousand eastward and ten thousand westward; and it shall be alongside the holy offering. Its increase shall be for food to those who labor in the city.

paite: Huchi in khopi a nasemmi Israel nam tengteng a mite'n alei alet ding uhi.
english: Those who labor in the city, out of all the tribes of Israel, shall cultivate it.

paite: Thilpiak pumpi adung tong singnih-le-sangnga, avai tong singnih-le-sangnga ahi ding; thilpiak siangthousa, dung leh vai kikim khopi tan toh na lat ding uh ahi.
english: All the offering shall be a square of twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand. You shall offer it as a holy offering, with the possession of the city.

paite: Aval thilpiaksa siangthou leh khopi tan pang lang tuaktuak vaihawmpa tan ahi ding a, suahlam sang ah thilpiak tong singnih-le-sangnga ban, gamseh dangte zulzul vaihawmpa tan ahi ding; huchi in thilpiak siangthousa leh tempul mun siangthou bel alaizang ah a-om ding.
english: “The remainder shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy offering and of the possession of the city; in front of the twenty-five thousand of the offering toward the east border, and westward in front of the twenty-five thousand toward the west border, alongside the portions, it shall be for the prince. The holy offering and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the middle of it.

paite: Huan Levi chi tan leh khopi tan vaihawmpa tante kikal ah a-om ding a; vaihawmpa tan Judah tan leh Benjamin tan toh akigi ding.
english: Moreover, from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the middle of that which is the prince’s, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.

paite: Huan nam omlaite tungthu ah, suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Benjaminte tan ahi ding.
english: “As for the rest of the tribes: from the east side to the west side, Benjamin, one portion.

paite: Benjaminte tan toh kigi in suah leh tumlam ah tan khat Simeonte tan ahi.
english: “By the border of Benjamin, from the east side to the west side, Simeon, one portion.

paite: Simeonte tan toh kigi in suah leh tumlam Issakarte tan ahi.
english: “By the border of Simeon, from the east side to the west side, Issachar, one portion.

paite: Issakarte tan toh kigi in suah leh tumlam tan khat Zebulunte tan ahi.
english: “By the border of Issachar, from the east side to the west side, Zebulun, one portion.

paite: Zebulunte tan toh kigi in suah leh tumlam tan khat Gadte tan ahi.
english: “By the border of Zebulun, from the east side to the west side, Gad, one portion.

paite: Gadte tan simlam pang gamgi Tarmar a kipan in Meribah-kadesh tuite tan in Aigupta lui zui in Tuipi Lian atung ding hi.
english: “By the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar to the waters of Meribath Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea.

paite: Hiai Israel namte goutan ding a gam kihawmdan ding leh agam sehtuamte ahi uh chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: “This is the land which you shall divide by lot to the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their several portions, says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Huan hiaite khopi a kipan pawtnate ahi uh; mallam pang tong sangli-le-zanga ah kongpi thum;
english: “These are the exits of the city: On the north side four thousand five hundred reeds by measure;

paite: khopi kongpite Israel nam min bang zel a sak ding ahi a; mallam kongpi thumte, Reuben kongpi khat, Judah kongpi khat, Levi kongpi khat;
english: and the gates of the city shall be named after the tribes of Israel, three gates northward: the gate of Reuben, one; the gate of Judah, one; the gate of Levi, one.

paite: suahlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga ah kongpi thum; Joseph kongpi khat, Benjamin kongpi khat, Dan kongpi khat ahi ding hi.
english: “At the east side four thousand five hundred reeds, and three gates: even the gate of Joseph, one; the gate of Benjamin, one; the gate of Dan, one.

paite: Simlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga ah kongpi thum; Simeon kongpi khat, Issakar kongpi khat, Zebulun kongpi khat ahi ding.
english: “At the south side four thousand five hundred reeds by measure, and three gates: the gate of Simeon, one; the gate of Issachar, one; the gate of Zebulun, one.

paite: Tumlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga ah kongpi thum; Gad kongpi khat, Asher kongpi khat, Naphtali kongpi khat ahi ding hi.
english: “At the west side four thousand five hundred reeds, with their three gates: the gate of Gad, one; the gate of Asher, one; the gate of Naphtali, one.

paite: Akimvel in tong singkhat-le-sanggiat ahi ding a; huai ni a kipan in khopi min bel, "TOUPA omna mun" chih ahi ding hi.
english: “It shall be eighteen thousand reeds in circumference; and the name of the city from that day shall be, ‘Yahweh is there.’

paite: "Huan nang mihing tapa, namsau hiam mahmah la inla, na lu leh na khamul metna ding in sammetmi tem zang in; huan bukna la inla, sam khen in.
english: “You, son of man, take a sharp sword. You shall take it as a barber’s razor to yourself, and shall cause it to pass over your head and over your beard. Then take balances to weigh and divide the hair.

paite: Seh thum a khen seh khat sim a a-om sung nite abei hun chiang in khopi lai a mei ah na hal ding ahi; seh thum a khen seh khat nawn na la dia, akim ah namsau in na satnen ding ahi; huan, seh thum a khen seh khat nawn huih mutleng ding in na thehzak ding a, ke'n namsau in ka delhzui ding hi.
english: A third part you shall burn in the fire in the middle of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled. You shall take a third part, and strike with the sword around it. A third part you shall scatter to the wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.

paite: Huan tawmchik na la ding a, na puanaktual mong ah na tun ding hi.
english: You shall take a small number of these and bind them in the folds of your robe.

paite: Hiaite lak a tam lou na la ding a, mei ah na thehlut ding a, na hal ding ahi; huai a kipan in Israel inkote tengteng ah mei ahong pawt ding," achi hi.
english: Of these again you shall take, and cast them into the middle of the fire, and burn them in the fire. From it a fire will come out into all the house of Israel.

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Hiai Jerusalem khua ahi, namte' laizang ah ka koih a, akim ah gamte a-om hi.
english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘This is Jerusalem. I have set her in the middle of the nations, and countries are around her.

paite: Namte sang a nakpi a gitlouhna hih zaw in ka thugel tung ah ahel a, akim a gamte sang a thupizaw in ka dan bawl tung ah ahel uhi. Ka thugelte apaikhia ua, ka dan bawlte bang in a-om kei uhi."
english: She has rebelled against my ordinances in doing wickedness more than the nations, and against my statutes more than the countries that are around her; for they have rejected my ordinances, and as for my statutes, they have not walked in them.’

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Na kim a namte sang a buai hatzaw in na om a, ka dan thusehte bawl bang in na om kei a, ka thukhennate leng na zui kei ua, namte a dia ka thukhendan a na hih louh ziak un, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi:
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you are more turbulent than the nations that are around you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my ordinances, neither have followed the ordinances of the nations that are around you;

paite: Ngai un, kei, kei nangawn in leng ka hon nang ahi, namte mitmuh ngei in na lak uah vaihawmna ka tangtungsak ding hi.
english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I, even I, am against you; and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.

paite: Na kihhuaina tengteng uh ziak in thil ka hih ngei nai louh, hih leng ka hih ngei nawn louh ding na tung uah ka hih ding hi.
english: I will do in you that which I have not done, and which I will not do anything like it any more, because of all your abominations.

paite: Huchi in pate'n na sung ah atate uh ane ding ua, tate'n leng apate uh ane ding uh; nang a mikhosuaksun tengteng ka dalhsak vek ding."
english: Therefore the fathers will eat the sons within you, and the sons will eat their fathers. I will execute judgments on you; and I will scatter the whole remnant of you to all the winds.

paite: Huchi in hiai Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi: "Na nitna leh na kihhuainate a ka mun siangthou na hihnit ziak in, kei ka hin bang in, ka hon kiamsak ding a, ka mit in ahon maih het kei ding a, ka hon hehpih sam kei ding hi.
english: Therefore as I live,’ says the Lord Yahweh, ‘surely, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your detestable things, and with all your abominations, therefore I will also diminish you. My eye won’t spare, and I will have no pity.

paite: Seh thum a khen seh khat hipi in hiam, kial in hiam na lak uah asi ding uh; seh thum a khen seh khat nawn ka hihdalh ding a, namsau in ka delhzui ding hi."
english: A third part of you will die with the pestilence, and they will be consumed with famine within you. A third part will fall by the sword around you. A third part I will scatter to all the winds, and will draw out a sword after them.

paite: Hichibang in ka hehna ka tangtungsak ding a, atung uah ka hehna ka lungdamsak ding a, ka om anuamta ding hi; kei TOUPA'N atung ua ka hehna ka lungdamsak hun chiang in phatuamngaitak in ka genta chih atheikhe ding uh.
english: “‘Thus my anger will be accomplished, and I will cause my wrath toward them to rest, and I will be comforted. They will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken in my zeal, when I have accomplished my wrath on them.

paite: Huai lou in, na kim a namte lak ah leh vialvak tengtengte mitmuh in kho segawp leh simmohhuai in ka hon bawl ding hi.
english: “‘Moreover I will make you a desolation and a reproach among the nations that are around you, in the sight of all that pass by.

paite: Huchi in thangpai leh heh mahmah a, nakpi a taihilh a, na tung a thugelte ka tunsak hun in na kim a namte mitmuh in nuihsan leh kouna leh hilhna leh mulkimhuai na hi ding; kei TOUPA'N ka chita hi.
english: So it will be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment, to the nations that are around you, when I execute judgments on you in anger and in wrath, and in wrathful rebukes—I, Yahweh, have spoken it—

paite: Atung uah kialna thaltang hoih loutak manna ding, noumau manna ding ka hon kesak ding; na tung uah kialna ka uangsak ding a, na an uh, hinna bul ka hihse ding hi.
english: when I send on them the evil arrows of famine that are for destruction, which I will send to destroy you. I will increase the famine on you and will break your staff of bread.

paite: Huchi in na tung uah kialna leh gamsa hangte ka hon sawl ding a, ta leh nau tan in ahon laksak ding uh; hipi leh sisan suahna na lak uah aleng ding a; na tung uah namsau ka hon sawl ding, kei TOUPA'N ka chita hi, chi in.
english: I will send on you famine and evil animals, and they will bereave you. Pestilence and blood will pass through you. I will bring the sword on you. I, Yahweh, have spoken it.’”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a:
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israel tang lam nga inla, akiang uah thu gen inla,
english: “Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy to them,

paite: Israel tangte aw, Toupa PATHIAN thu ngaikhia un; Toupa PATHIAN in tangte leh mualte kiang ah, leh phaizangte leh kuamte kiang ah hichi in achi: Ngai un, kei, kei mahmah in na tung uah namsau ka hon lik ding a, na mun sangte uh ka hihse vek ding.
english: and say, ‘You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Yahweh! The Lord Yahweh says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys: “Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword on you, and I will destroy your high places.

paite: Na maitamte uh loihsan in a-om ding a, na ni pathian limte uh akitamzan ding; na mithah luangte uh na milimte uh ma ah ka pai ding hi.
english: Your altars will become desolate, and your incense altars will be broken. I will cast down your slain men before your idols.

paite: Amilimte uh ma ah Israel suante luang ka koihkhawm ding a, na guhte uh na maitam kim uah ka thehzak ding hi.
english: I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols. I will scatter your bones around your altars.

paite: Na tenna mun tengteng uah khopi ase ding a, mun sangte akisegawp ding; na maitamte uh hihsiat leh loihsan ahihtheihna ding un leh na milimte uh akitapnen a, aman theihna ding in leh na ni pathian limte uh phukpaih a a-omtheihna ding un, na nasepte uh aman theihna ding in.
english: In all your dwelling places, the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be desolate, so that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your incense altars may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.

paite: Huan na lak uah mithahte apuk ding ua, huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
english: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am Yahweh.

paite: "Himahleh gam chih a na dalhzak hun chiang un namte lak ah namsau a suakta a-om ding ziak un akhen ka hon hawi ding.
english: “‘“Yet I will leave a remnant, in that you will have some that escape the sword among the nations, when you are scattered through the countries.

paite: Huan na lak ua kipan a pawtte'n sal a apina namte uh lak ah kei ahon theigige ding ua, a-angkawmna lungtang uh ka lakmang sakleh amit uh, amilim lam ua angkawmte ka hihsiat sakdante athei ding uh; thil gilou a na hih ziak uleh akihhuai ziak un amau mitmuh ngei in leng kihhuai akisa ding uh.
english: Those of you that escape will remember me among the nations where they are carried captive, how I have been broken with their lewd heart, which has departed from me, and with their eyes, which play the prostitute after their idols. Then they will loathe themselves in their own sight for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding ua, hiai thil hoih lou akiang uah ka hih ding a, amawk in ka chi kei chih athei ding uh, chi in," achi hi.
english: They will know that I am Yahweh. I have not said in vain that I would do this evil to them.”’

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Na khut beng in na khe pek inla, Maizen! Israel inkote kihhuaina gitlouh ziak maw! Namsau in, kial in, hipi in apuk ding uhi.
english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Strike with your hand, and stamp with your foot, and say, “Alas!”, because of all the evil abominations of the house of Israel; for they will fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.

paite: Gamlapi a om hipi in asi ding ua, anai a om namsau in apuk ding ua, aval, um a omte kial in asi ding uh; hichibang in ka hehna mahmah atung uah ka bukimsak ding hi.
english: He who is far off will die of the pestilence. He who is near will fall by the sword. He who remains and is besieged will die by the famine. Thus I will accomplish my wrath on them.

paite: Mual sang teng ah, tang vumte ah leh sing hing peuhmah nuai ah leh tosaw bawkpha chih nuai a amilimte uh kiang a gimlim alatna mun ua amaitam kim ua amilimte uh lak a amisi luangte uh a-om hun chiang in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
english: You will know that I am Yahweh when their slain men are among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, under every green tree, and under every thick oak—the places where they offered pleasant aroma to all their idols.

paite: Atung uah ka khut ka lik ding a, gamdai a kipan Diblah lam a atenna mun tengteng uh gamsia suaksak in ka loihsan vek ding; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh," chi in.
english: I will stretch out my hand on them and make the land desolate and waste, from the wilderness toward Diblah, throughout all their habitations. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Nang mihing tapa, Toupa PATHIAN in Israel gam kiang ah hichi in achi: Tawpna, tawpna gam ning li ah ahong tung hi.
english: “You, son of man, the Lord Yahweh says to the land of Israel, ‘An end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.

paite: "Tu nang a ding in tawpna ahi, na tung ah ka hehna ka hon tungsak ding a, na omdan bang zel in vai ka hon hawmsak ding a, na kihhuaina tengteng na tung ah ka hon tun ding hi.
english: Now the end is on you, and I will send my anger on you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.

paite: Ka mit in ahon maih kei dia, ka hon hehpih sam kei ding hi; na omdan bang in na tung ah ka hon tun zaw ding a, huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh."
english: My eye will not spare you, neither will I have pity; but I will bring your ways on you, and your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.’

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Siatna, siatgawpna mah, ngai dih, ahong tung hi.
english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘A disaster! A unique disaster! Behold, it comes.

paite: Tawpna ahong tung hi, tawpna ahong tung hi, na tung ah ahong thouta, ngai in, ahong tung hi.
english: An end has come. The end has come! It awakes against you. Behold, it comes.

paite: Aw gam luahpa, na siatna ding na tung ah ahong tung hi, hun ahong tung hi, ni anaita hi; buaina, kipak a tang tung a kikouna ni hilou.
english: Your doom has come to you, inhabitant of the land! The time has come! The day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting, on the mountains.

paite: "Tu in ka hehna na tung ah ka hon buakzok ding hi, na tung ah ka hehna ka lungdamsak ding a; na omdan bang zel in ka hon vai hawmsak ding hi; na kihhuaina tengteng na tung ah ka hon tun ding hi.
english: Now I will shortly pour out my wrath on you, and accomplish my anger against you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.

paite: Huan ka mit in ahon maih kei dia, ka hon hehpih sam kei ding; na omdan bang zel in na tung ah ka hon tun ding a, na kihhuaina leng na lak uah a-om ding; huchi in kei TOUPA gawt theipa ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
english: My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. I will punish you according to your ways. Your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, strike.

paite: "Ngai in, ani, ngai in, ahong tung hi, na siatna ding apawtta, satna chiang apakta, kisaktheihna apakmumta hi.
english: “‘Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has gone out. The rod has blossomed. Pride has budded.

paite: Hiamgamna gitlouhna chiang asuakta ahi; kua mahmah a-omta kei ding a, ahusa uhiam, ahauhsakna uhiam leng; kuamah in a-it sam kei ding uh.
english: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness. None of them will remain, nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth. There will be nothing of value among them.

paite: "Hun ahong tungta, ani ahong naita; aleimi kipak kei henla, akhawngmi leng dah kei hen; thangpaihna avek ua tung ah a-omta hi.
english: The time has come! The day draws near. Don’t let the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath is on all its multitude.

paite: Azuakmi in, dam lai mahleh, athil zuak amu nawn kei ding; muhkholhna zaw avek ua tungthu ahi a, kuamah akik kei ding uh, kuamah ahinna thulimlouhna uah akhosa suak sam kei ding uh.
english: For the seller won’t return to that which is sold, although they are still alive; for the vision concerns the whole multitude of it. None will return. None will strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.

paite: Pengkul amut ua, bangkim akimanta; himahleh kidouna ah kuamah ahoh kei uh; avek ua tung a ka hehna a-om ziak in.
english: They have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but no one goes to the battle, for my wrath is on all its multitude.

paite: "Inpua ah namsau, asung ah hipi leh kial; gam a om namsau in asi ding ua, khopi a om kial leh hipi in ane khin ding hi.
english: “‘The sword is outside, and the pestilence and the famine within. He who is in the field will die by the sword. He who is in the city will be devoured by famine and pestilence.

paite: Himahleh ataikhete, apawt ding ua, tangte ah phaizang gam vakhu bang in; avek un, lungzuangtak in amau thulimlouhna chiat ah a-om ding uh.
english: But of those who escape, they will escape and will be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, everyone in his iniquity.

paite: Khut tengteng azaw ding a, khuk tengteng tui bang in anem ding.
english: All hands will be feeble, and all knees will be weak as water.

paite: Sai-ip puan ateng ding ua, mulkimna in amau atuam ding a, mel chiteng ah zumna alang ding a, alutang tengteng uh agiau khin ding hi.
english: They will also clothe themselves with sackcloth, and horror will cover them. Shame will be on all faces, and baldness on all their heads.

paite: Adangkasik uh leh adangka-engte un TOUPA heh ni chiang in ahunkhe thei kei ding a, ahinna uh ataisak kei ding a, agil uh avahsak sam kei ding; athulimlouhna uh pukna ahih khit tak ziak in.
english: They will cast their silver in the streets, and their gold will be as an unclean thing. Their silver and their gold won’t be able to deliver them in the day of Yahweh’s wrath. They won’t satisfy their souls or fill their bellies; because it has been the stumbling block of their iniquity.

paite: Akizepna kilawmna uh akisaktheihpih ua, akihhuaina milim un leh anitna thil un asuaksak zaw lel uhi; huaiziak in amau a ding in thilkihhuai ding in ka na bawlta hi.
english: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty; but they made the images of their abominations and their detestable things therein. Therefore I have made it to them as an unclean thing.

paite: "Huan gallak ding in namdang khut ah ka pe dia, lei a migiloute kiang ah gallak ding in ka pe ding a, amau ana hihnin ding uh.
english: I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a plunder; and they will profane it.

paite: Amaute ka nungngatsan ding a, ka mun siang ahihnin ding uh; huan guta ahong lut dia, ahihnin ding uh.
english: I will also turn my face from them, and they will profane my secret place. Robbers will enter into it, and profane it.

paite: "Gamsung lah sisan suah hat vaihawmna a dim a, hiamgamna a khopi adim ziak in khainiang bawl un.
english: “‘Make chains, for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.

paite: Huchi in namdang giloupente ka hon pilut ding a a-innte uh aneihsak ding ua; ahatna otpih uh ka hihtawp ding a, amun siangte uh hihnit in a-om ding hi.
english: Therefore I will bring the worst of the nations, and they will possess their houses. I will also make the pride of the strong to cease. Their holy places will be profaned.

paite: Lungzinna ahong tung a, muanna azong ua, a-om het kei hi.
english: Destruction comes! They will seek peace, and there will be none.

paite: Siatna tung ah siatsemna, thuthang tung ah thuthang ahong om ding a, zawlnei lak ah kilakna azong ding ua, himahleh dante siampu lak ah amang ding a, upate lak ah thudot a-om kei ding hi.
english: Mischief will come on mischief, and rumor will be on rumor. They will seek a vision of the prophet; but the law will perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.

paite: Kumpipa adah ding a, kumpi tapa lungdonna puansilh in akivan ding a, vantang khut leng aling ding. Akiang uah a-omdan bang un ka hih ding a, athilhih bang zel un vai ka hawmsak ding; huan TOUPA ka hi chih atheita ding uh," achi hi.
english: The king will mourn, and the prince will be clothed with desolation. The hands of the people of the land will be troubled. I will do to them after their way, and according to their own judgments I will judge them. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

paite: Akum gukna, akha gukna, huai kha ani nga ni in hichi ahong hi a, ka inn a ka tut a, Judah upate ka ma a atut lai un Toupa PATHIAN khut ka tung ah ahong om hi.
english: In the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, the Lord Yahweh’s hand fell on me there.

paite: Huchi in ka en a, ngai in, mi meikuang bang a kimu ahong om a; akawng chiang nuailam hi dia kilawm meikuang bang ahi a; akawng chiang tunglam bel sik hal-ap bang a vaktak ahi.
english: Then I saw, and behold, a likeness as the appearance of fire—from the appearance of his waist and downward, fire, and from his waist and upward, as the appearance of brightness, as it were glowing metal.

paite: Huchi in khut melput ahon sawkkhia a, ka talsam a hon man in, kha in lei leh van kikal ah ahon domkang a, Pathian kilakna in Jerusalem ah ahon pi hi, Jerusalem mallam huang sungnung kongpi khakna kiang ahon tun a, huai ah mullitna lim tutna mun a-om a, huai in amullitsak hi.
english: He stretched out the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and the sky, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the gate of the inner court that looks toward the north, where there was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.

paite: Huan ngai in, phaizang a ka muh bang mah in huai ah Israel' Pathian thupina a-om hi.
english: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the appearance that I saw in the plain.

paite: Huchi in ama'n ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, mallam nga in na mitsuan dih ve leh," achi hi. Huchi in mallam nga in ka mit ka suan a, ngai in, maitam kongpi mallam lutna ah hiai mullitna lim ana om hi.
english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, lift up your eyes now the way toward the north.” So I lifted up my eyes the way toward the north, and saw, northward of the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, athilhih uh na mu hia? Israel inkote'n thilkihhuai mahmah, hiai a ahih ngei uh, ka inn siangthou a kipan a gamla a ka paimangna ding a ahih uh? Himahleh thil dang kihhuaizaw na mu nawn lai ding," achi hi.
english: He said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they do? Even the great abominations that the house of Israel commit here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? But you will again see yet other great abominations.”

paite: Huan huangsung lutna ah ahon pi a; ka en a, baang ah vang ana om hi.
english: He brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold, a hole in the wall.

paite: Huchi in ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, huai baang hon khuak dih," achi hi. Ka khuakleh kongkhak ana om hi.
english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, dig now in the wall.” When I had dug in the wall, I saw a door.

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Lut inla, hiai a khelhna kihhuaitak ahih uh en dih," achi hi.
english: He said to me, “Go in, and see the wicked abominations that they do here.”

paite: Huchi in ka lut a, ka mu a, ngai in, thil hing chi chih limte, gamsa kihhuai limte, Israel inkote milim tengteng baang ah akimvel in ana tuang hi.
english: So I went in and looked, and saw every form of creeping things, abominable animals, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed around on the wall.

paite: Huan ama uah Israel inkuan, upate lak a mi sawmsagihte adingh ua, alaitak uah Sephan tapa Jaazaniah adingh a, michih in belhbu atawi chiat ua; huan gimlim khu gim azamtou ngoingoi hi.
english: Seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel stood before them. In the middle of them Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan stood, every man with his censer in his hand; and the smell of the cloud of incense went up.

paite: Huchi in ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, Israel inkuan upate mial nuai a thilhih na mu hia? Michih in milim dantan a ahih uh? TOUPA'N ahon mu kei a, TOUPA'N gam apaisanta aka," achi uhi.
english: Then he said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his rooms of imagery? For they say, ‘Yahweh doesn’t see us. Yahweh has forsaken the land.’”

paite: Ka kiang ah, "Athilhih uh kihhuai sem dang leng na mu nawn lai ding," achi lai hi.
english: He said also to me, “You will again see more of the great abominations which they do.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA' inn mallam panglutna kongkhak ah ahon pi a, ngai dih, huai ah numeite Tammuz ngai in kap in atu uhi.
english: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of Yahweh’s house which was toward the north; and I saw the women sit there weeping for Tammuz.

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Aw mihing tapa, hiai na mu hia? Hiai sang a kihhuaizaw sem na mu nawn lai ding," achi hi.
english: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? You will again see yet greater abominations than these.”

paite: Huan TOUPA' inn um sungnungzaw ah ahon pilut a, ngai in, TOUPA tempul lutna ah inliim leh maitam kikal ah mi sawmnih-le-nga, TOUPA tempul lam anungngat a, amaite uh suahlam nga in ana om ua, suahlam ah ni ana bia uhi.
english: He brought me into the inner court of Yahweh’s house; and I saw at the door of Yahweh’s temple, between the porch and the altar, there were about twenty-five men with their backs toward Yahweh’s temple and their faces toward the east. They were worshiping the sun toward the east.

paite: Huchi in ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai na mu hia, aw mihing tapa, athilkihhuai hih uh, hiai ahih uh Judah inkote a ding in thil neutham ahi hia? Gam hiamgamna in ahihdim ua, hon hehsak nawn sem ua, anak uah singhiang abat uhi.
english: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? For they have filled the land with violence, and have turned again to provoke me to anger. Behold, they put the branch to their nose.

paite: Huaiziak in ke'n leng hehtak in ka hih ding a; ka mit in amaih kei dia, ka hehpih sam kei ding: aw ngaihtak in ka bil ah hong kikou mah le uh ka ngaikhe kei ding," achi hi.
english: Therefore I will also deal in wrath. My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. Though they cry in my ears with a loud voice, yet I will not hear them.”

paite: Huchi in bil a ka zak in, "Khopi kem mite michih hihmanna van tawi in hong nai uhen," chi in ngaihtak in akikou hi.
english: Then he cried in my ears with a loud voice, saying, “Cause those who are in charge of the city to draw near, each man with his destroying weapon in his hand.”

paite: Huan ngai in, mallam kongpi tungnung paina a kipan in mi guk ahong pai ua, michih in hihlupna van atawi chiat ua; alai ua mi khat puanmalngat silh in laituibuk akuah hi. Alut ua, dal maitam kiang ah adingh uhi.
english: Behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate, which lies toward the north, every man with his slaughter weapon in his hand. One man in the middle of them was clothed in linen, with a writer’s inkhorn by his side. They went in, and stood beside the bronze altar.

paite: Huan Israel' Pathian thupina a omna cherub a kipan in huai inn kongpi kiang ah apaitou a; puanmalngat silh, laituibuk kuahpa asam hi.
english: The glory of the God of Israel went up from the cherub, whereupon it was, to the threshold of the house; and he called to the man clothed in linen, who had the writer’s inkhorn by his side.

paite: TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Khopi sung tawnsuak inla, Jerusalem tawnsuak in; asung a thilkihhuai hihsate ziak atunggik a kapte atal uah chiamteh in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to him, “Go through the middle of the city, through the middle of Jerusalem, and set a mark on the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry over all the abominations that are done within it.”

paite: Huan midangte kiang ah ka zak mahmah in, "Anung ah khopi tawnsuak unla, khut kha un, na mit un mumaih kei henla, hehpih sam kei un.
english: To the others he said in my hearing, “Go through the city after him, and strike. Don’t let your eye spare, neither have pity.

paite: Putekte, tangvalte, nungakte, naupangte leh nute that siang vek un. Chiamtehna neite bel hon naih kei un; ka Mun Siangthou ah pan un," achi hi. Huchi in inn kong a upate ah apan uhi.
english: Kill utterly the old man, the young man, the virgin, little children and women; but don’t come near any man on whom is the mark. Begin at my sanctuary.” Then they began at the old men who were before the house.

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Inn hihbuah unla, ahuangsungte mi luang in dimsak unla, pawt un," achi hi. Huan apawtta ua, khopi ah agamtangta uhi.
english: He said to them, “Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain. Go out!” They went out, and struck in the city.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, khopi ah agamtat lai un kei bel nutsiat in ka na om a, akhup in ka puk hi. "Ah! Toupa PATHIAN, Jerusalem tung a na hehna na sunbuak ah Israel khosuaksunte leng hihman vek sawm na hi hiam?" chi in ka kikou hi.
english: While they were killing, and I was left, I fell on my face, and cried, and said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Will you destroy all the residue of Israel in your pouring out of your wrath on Jerusalem?”

paite: Huchi in ama'n ka kiang ah, "Israel leh Judah inkote thulimlouhna athupi tel a ahi. 'Sisan in gamsung adim a; khopi vaihawmna kaihkawi in a-om a, TOUPA'N gam apaisanta a, TOUPA'N bangmah amu kei!' achi hi.
english: Then he said to me, “The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perversion; for they say, ‘Yahweh has forsaken the land, and Yahweh doesn’t see.’

paite: Kei toh kisai in leng, ka mit in amau ka mumaih kei ding a, ka hehpih sam kei ding hi; agitlouhna uh avekpi in amau ka khusak ding," achi hi.
english: As for me also, my eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity, but I will bring their way on their head.”

paite: Huchi in ngai in, puanmalngat silh a laituibuk kuahpa'n thu atun a, "N'on thupiak bang in ka hih khinta," achi hi.
english: Behold, the man clothed in linen, who had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, “I have done as you have commanded me.”

paite: Persia kumpipa Kura kum khatna ah, Jeremiah kam a TOUPA thu hihtangtun ahihtheihna ding in, TOUPA'N Persia kumpipa Kura kha atokthou a, huchi in agamsung teng ah thupuan abawl a, agelhthoh in leng akoih hi.
english: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that Yahweh’s word by Jeremiah’s mouth might be accomplished, Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

paite: Hichibang in Persia kumpipa Kura in achi, “TOUPA, van Pathian in, Lei gam tengteng kei ahon peta hi; Judah a om Jerusalem a amah inn lamsak ding in kei thu ahon pia hi.
english: “Cyrus king of Persia says, ‘Yahweh, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

paite: Amite tengteng na lak ua om peuhmah, akiang ah Pathian om henla, Judah a om Jerusalem ah hohtou henla, TOUPA Israel' Pathian, amah Pathian ahi, Jerusalem a om inn lam hen.
english: Whoever there is among you of all his people, may his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of Yahweh, the God of Israel (he is God), which is in Jerusalem.

paite: Kuapeuh akhualtamna koi mun peuh a nutsiat a omna mun a mite'n, amah dangka leh dangka-eng, vante leh gantate in panpih uhenla, Jerusalem a om Pathian inn a ding a ut thu a thillat chih louh," chi in.
english: Whoever is left, in any place where he lives, let the men of his place help him with silver, with gold, with goods, and with animals, in addition to the free will offering for God’s house which is in Jerusalem.’”

paite: Huchi in Judah leh Benjamin intekpate inkuan a lupente, siampute leh Levite, Pathian in Jerusalem a om TOUPA' inn lam dia hohtou dia akha uh atohthohte tengteng, athouta uhi.
english: Then the heads of fathers’ households of Judah and Benjamin, the priests and the Levites, all whose spirit God had stirred to go up, rose up to build Yahweh’s house which is in Jerusalem.

paite: Huan akimvel ua omte tengteng in akhut uh dangka tui-um belsuan dangka-engte, vante, gantate leh thil manphate in ahihhat ua, uttak a piakte tengteng sim louh in.
english: All those who were around them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, with animals, and with precious things, in addition to all that was willingly offered.

paite: Kumpipa Kura in leng TOUPA' inn a tui-um belsuan Nebukadnezzar in Jerusalem a kipan alakkhiak, pathiante inn a akoihte alakhe vek hi;
english: Also Cyrus the king brought out the vessels of Yahweh’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought out of Jerusalem, and had put in the house of his gods;

paite: Huaite Persia kumpipa Kura in sumkempa Mithredath khut in alakhe vek a, Judah vaihawm, Sesbazzar pia in asimsak hi.
english: even those, Cyrus king of Persia brought out by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.

paite: Huchi in hiai amuh zah uh ahi: dangka-eng kuang sawmthum, dangka kuang sangkhat, gimlim halna kuang sawmnih-le-kua;
english: This is the number of them: thirty platters of gold, one thousand platters of silver, twenty-nine knives,

paite: Dangka-eng noubem sawmthum, dangka noubem ahoih lou deuhte zali-le-sawmkhat leh tui-um belsuan dangte sangkhat.
english: thirty bowls of gold, four hundred ten silver bowls of a second kind, and one thousand other vessels.

paite: Dangka-eng leh dangka tui-um belsuan tengteng sangnga-le-zali ahi uh. Saltangte lak ate Babulon a kipan Jerusalem a pitouh a a-om lai un, hiai tengteng Sesbazzar in atawitou vek hi.
english: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand four hundred. Sheshbazzar brought all these up when the captives were brought up from Babylon to Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi a Ezra kap a Pathian inn mai a lei kidenna a nei in, athum a, thupha atawi lai in, Israel a kipan pasal leh numei leh naupang tampi kikhawmte akiang ah hong kikaikhawm ua: mite lah anak kah mahmah ngal ua.
english: Now while Ezra prayed and made confession, weeping and casting himself down before God’s house, there was gathered together to him out of Israel a very great assembly of men and women and children; for the people wept very bitterly.

paite: Elam tapate lak a khat, Jehiel tapa Shekaniah in adawng a Ezra kiang ah, "I Pathian tung ah i talekta ua, gammi numei namdangte i kitenpihta uh: Himahleh hiai thil thu ah Israel a ding in lametna a-om lai hi.
english: Shecaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered Ezra, “We have trespassed against our God, and have married foreign women of the peoples of the land. Yet now there is hope for Israel concerning this thing.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in zite tengteng leh amau a kipan a huchibang a piangte, ka toupa thuhilh dungzui in leh i Pathian uh thupiak a lau a lingte thuhilh dungzui in, koihmang ding in i Pathian toh thu i khung ding uh; huan dan dungzui a hih hi hen.
english: Now therefore let’s make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives and those who are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God. Let it be done according to the law.

paite: Thou in, athu lah nang a ahi ngal a, kou leng na kiang ah ka om ding uh; hangsantak in om inla, hih in,” achi hi.
english: Arise, for the matter belongs to you and we are with you. Be courageous, and do it.”

paite: Huchi in Ezra athou a, hiai thu dungzui a ahih ding un, siampute leh Levi mite lak a amakai lianpente leh Israel tengteng akichiamsak hi. Huchi in akichiamta uhi.
english: Then Ezra arose, and made the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and all Israel to swear that they would do according to this word. So they swore.

paite: Pathian inn mai a kipan Ezra athoukhia a, Eliashib tapa Jehohanan dantan sung ah alut a: huai lai a ahong pai lai in, tanghou ane kei a, tui lah adawn kei hi; saltanna a tatlekna ziak in asuun hi.
english: Then Ezra rose up from before God’s house, and went into the room of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib. When he came there, he didn’t eat bread or drink water, for he mourned because of the trespass of the exiles.

paite: Judah leh Jerusalem teng a saltanna tate tengteng kiang ah Jerusalem a kikaikhawm vek ding in thu apuangkhia ua;
english: They made a proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together to Jerusalem;

paite: kuapeuh ni thum sung a hong pai lou, vaihawmte leh upate thu bang zel in, avan tengteng laksak ahi ding a, amah mah saltanna omkhawmte a kipan a tuamkoih ahi ding hi.
english: and that whoever didn’t come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his possessions should be forfeited, and he himself separated from the assembly of the captivity.

paite: Huchih lai in Judah leh Benjamin mi tengteng Jerusalem ah ni thum sung in akikaikhawm ua; hiai akha kuana, akha ni sawmnih ni ahi. Huchi in mi tengteng Pathian inn kongtual a mun awng ah atu ua, hiai thu leh vuahpi ziak in aling uhi.
english: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together to Jerusalem within the three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the wide place in front of God’s house, trembling because of this matter, and because of the great rain.

paite: Huchi in siampu Ezra adingh a, akiang uah, "Na talek ua, Israel mohna khangsak ding in, numei nam dangte na kitenpih uhi.
english: Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have trespassed, and have married foreign women, increasing the guilt of Israel.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in na pipute uh Pathian, TOUPA kiang ah thupha tawi unla, akipah lam hih un; gam a mite a kipan, numei namdangte a kipan kituamseh un," achi hi.
english: Now therefore make confession to Yahweh, the God of your fathers and do his pleasure. Separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign women.”

paite: Huchi in kikhawmte tengteng in adawng ua, aw ngaihtak in, "Ka tungtang uh na gen bang in, huchibang in ka hih ding uh," achi uhi.
english: Then all the assembly answered with a loud voice, “We must do as you have said concerning us.

paite: Himahleh mite tampi ahi ua, vuah tampi zuk lai ahi a, huchi in inkuan ah ka dingh thei kei ua, hiai lah ni khat hiam nasep ahi kei; hiai thu ah lah nakpitak in i talekta ngal ua.
english: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand outside. This is not a work of one day or two, for we have greatly transgressed in this matter.

paite: Tu in omkhawmte a ding in i vaihawmte ding seh in om henla, i Pathian uh thangpaihna ei a kipan a akihei a, hiai thu hihbei ahih masiah, numei lamdangte kitenpihte i khopite a omte hun sehsate ah, khopi chiteng a upate amau toh, huai lai a vaihawmte toh, hong pai uhen.
english: Now let our princes be appointed for all the assembly, and let all those who are in our cities who have married foreign women come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city and its judges, until the fierce wrath of our God is turned from us, until this matter is resolved.”

paite: Asahel tapa Jonathan leh Tikvah tapa Jahaziah kia in hiai thu asel uh: huan Meshullam leh Levi mi Shabbethai in amaute apanpih uhi.
english: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah stood up against this; and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

paite: Huchibang in saltanna a kipan kik nawnte'n ahihta uhi. Siampu Ezra, apipute uh inkote dungzui a, pipute inkuan lak a vaihawm makai kuate hiam toh leh aminte ua amaute tengteng, tuam sehkhiak in a-om ua; huchi in athu entel ding in akha sawmna ani khat ni in atuta uhi.
english: The children of the captivity did so. Ezra the priest, with certain heads of fathers’ households, after their fathers’ houses, and all of them by their names, were set apart; and they sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

paite: Huchi in akha khatna ani khat ni in numei namdang kitenpih mite ahih khin uhi.
english: They finished with all the men who had married foreign women by the first day of the first month.

paite: Huchi in siampute tapate lak ah numei namdang kitenpih muh in a-om a: huaite, Jeshua tapate, Jozadak tapa leh a-unaute, Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib leh Gedaliahte.
english: Among the sons of the priests there were found who had married foreign women: of the sons of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.

paite: Huchi in azite uh koihmang ding in pha asa ua; amoh ziak un, amohna a ding in belamhon lak a belamtal alan uhi.
english: They gave their hand that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their guilt.

paite: Immer tapate lak ah: Hanani leh Zebadiah.
english: Of the sons of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.

paite: Harim tapate lak ah: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel leh Uzziah.
english: Of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.

paite: Pashur tapate lak ah: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad leh Elasah.
english: Of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

paite: Levi mite lak ah: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah, huai mah Kelita ahi, Pethahiah, Judah leh Eliezer.
english: Of the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (also called Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

paite: Lasa mite lak ah: Eliashib: huan kongkhak ngak mite lak ah; Shallum, Telem leh Uri.
english: Of the singers: Eliashib. Of the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.

paite: Israel lak ah: Parosh tapate lak ah; Ramiah, Jeziah, Malkijah Mijamin, Eleazar leh Malkijah leh Benaiah.
english: Of Israel: Of the sons of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah.

paite: Elam tapate lak ah: Mattaniah, Zekariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth leh Eliah.
english: Of the sons of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.

paite: Zattu tapate lak ah: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad leh Aziza.
english: Of the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.

paite: Bebai tapate lak ah; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, Athlai.
english: Of the sons of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.

paite: Bani tapate lak ah: Meshullam, Malluk, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal leh Ramoth.
english: Of the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth.

paite: Huan Pahath-moab tapate lak ah: Adna, Kelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui leh Manasseh.
english: Of the sons of Pahathmoab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.

paite: Harim tapate lak ah: Eliezer, Isshiah, Malkijah, Shemaiah, Simeon,
english: Of the sons of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

paite: Benjamin, Malluk leh Semariah.
english: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.

paite: Hashum tapate lak ah: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, Shimei.
english: Of the sons of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.

paite: Bani tapate lak ah: Maadai, Amram leh Uel;
english: Of the sons of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel,

paite: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Kelluh,
english: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,

paite: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib;
english: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

paite: Mattaniah, Mattenai leh Jaasau;
english: Mattaniah, Mattenai, Jaasu,

paite: Bani, Binnui, Shimei;
english: Bani, Binnui, Shimei,

paite: Shelemiah leh Nathan leh Adaiah,
english: Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,

paite: Maknadebai, Shasai, Sharai;
english: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

paite: Azarel leh Shelemiah, Shemariah;
english: Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,

paite: Shallum, Amariah, Joseph.
english: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.

paite: Nebo tapate lak ah: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel leh Benaiah.
english: Of the sons of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Iddo, Joel, and Benaiah.

paite: Hiai tengtengte'n namdang zite api ua: huchi in alak ua khenkhatte'n hiai zite a kipan tate anei uhi.
english: All these had taken foreign wives. Some of them had wives by whom they had children.

paite: Hiaite pimang a om koltanna a kipan a paitou, bial a tate, Babulon lam a akumpipa Nebukad-nezzar in apimang, Jerusalem leh Judah a, michih ama khua chiat a hong kik nawnte ahi uh.
english: Now these are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away to Babylon, and who returned to Jerusalem and Judah, everyone to his city;

paite: Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordekai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah toh hong tonte, Israel mite lak a pasal phazah:
english: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, and Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

paite: Parosh suante sangnih zakhat sawmsagih-le-nih.
english: The children of Parosh, two thousand one hundred seventy-two.

paite: Shephatiah suante, zathum sawmsagih-le-nih.
english: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy-two.

paite: Arah suante, zasagih sawmsagih-le-nga.
english: The children of Arah, seven hundred seventy-five.

paite: Pahath-moab suante, Jeshua leh Joab tate, sangnih zagiat leh sawm-le-nih.
english: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred twelve.

paite: Elam suante, sangkhat zanih sawmnga-le-li.
english: The children of Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

paite: Zattu suante, zakua sawmli-le-nga.
english: The children of Zattu, nine hundred forty-five.

paite: Zakkai suante, zasagih-le-sawmguk.
english: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred sixty.

paite: Bani suante, zaguk sawmli-le-nih.
english: The children of Bani, six hundred forty-two.

paite: Bebai suante, zaguk sawmnih-le-thum.
english: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty-three.

paite: Azgad suante, sangkhat zanih sawmnih-le-nih.
english: The children of Azgad, one thousand two hundred twenty-two.

paite: Adonikam suante, zaguk sawmguk-le-guk.
english: The children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty-six.

paite: Bigvai suante, sangnih sawmnga-le-guk.
english: The children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty-six.

paite: Adin suante, zali sawmnga-le-li.
english: The children of Adin, four hundred fifty-four.

paite: Ater suante, Hezekiah tate, sawmkua-le-giat.
english: The children of Ater, of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.

paite: Bezai suante, zathum sawmnih-le-thum.
english: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty-three.

paite: Jorah suante, zakhat leh sawm-le-nih.
english: The children of Jorah, one hundred twelve.

paite: Hashum suante, zanih sawmnih-le-thum.
english: The children of Hashum, two hundred twenty-three.

paite: Gibbar suante, sawmkua-le-nga.
english: The children of Gibbar, ninety-five.

paite: Bethlehem suante, zakhat sawmnih-le-thum.
english: The children of Bethlehem, one hundred twenty-three.

paite: Netophah mite, sawmnga-le-guk.
english: The men of Netophah, fifty-six.

paite: Anathoth mite, zakhat sawmnih-le-giat.
english: The men of Anathoth, one hundred twenty-eight.

paite: Azmaveth suante, sawmli-le-nih.
english: The children of Azmaveth, forty-two.

paite: Kiriath-arim, Kephirah leh Beeroth suante, zasagih sawmli-le-thum.
english: The children of Kiriath Arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty-three.

paite: Ramah leh Geba tate, zaguk sawmnih-le-khat.
english: The children of Ramah and Geba, six hundred twenty-one.

paite: Mikmas mite, zakhat sawmnih-le-nih.
english: The men of Michmas, one hundred twenty-two.

paite: Bethel leh Ai mite, zanih sawmnih-le-thum.
english: The men of Bethel and Ai, two hundred twenty-three.

paite: Nebo suante, sawmnga-le-guk.
english: The children of Nebo, fifty-two.

paite: Magbish suante, zakhat sawmnga-le-guk.
english: The children of Magbish, one hundred fifty-six.

paite: Elam dang suante, sangkhat zanih sawmnga-le-li.
english: The children of the other Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

paite: Harim suante, zathum-le-sawmnih.
english: The children of Harim, three hundred twenty.

paite: Lod, Hadid leh Ono tate, zasagih sawmnih-le-nga.
english: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty-five.

paite: Jeriko suante, zathum sawmli-le-nga.
english: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty-five.

paite: Senaah suante, sangthum leh zaguk-le-sawmthum.
english: The children of Senaah, three thousand six hundred thirty.

paite: Siampute: Jedaiah suante, Jeshua inkote, zakua sawmsagih-le-thum.
english: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy-three.

paite: Immer suante, sangkhat sawmnga-le-nih.
english: The children of Immer, one thousand fifty-two.

paite: Pashur suante, sangkhat zanih sawmli-le-sagih.
english: The children of Pashhur, one thousand two hundred forty-seven.

paite: Harim suante, sangkhat leh sawm-le-sagih.
english: The children of Harim, one thousand seventeen.

paite: Levi mite: Jeshua leh Kadmiel suante, Hodaviah suante, sawmsagih-le-li.
english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy-four.

paite: Lasa mite: Asaph suante, zakhat sawmnih-le-giat.
english: The singers: the children of Asaph, one hundred twenty-eight.

paite: Kongkhak ngak mite: Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita leh Shobai suante, avek un zakhat sawmthum-le-kua.
english: The children of the gatekeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, in all one hundred thirty-nine.

paite: Nethinim mite: Ziha, Hasupha leh Tabbaoth suante;
english: The temple servants: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

paite: Keros, Siaha leh Padon suante;
english: the children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,

paite: Lebanah, Hagabah leh Akkub suante;
english: the children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,

paite: Hagab, Shalmai leh Hanan suante;
english: the children of Hagab, the children of Shamlai, the children of Hanan,

paite: Giddel, Gahar leh Reaiah suante;
english: the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,

paite: Rezin, Nekoda leh Gazzam suante;
english: the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,

paite: Uzza, Paseah leh Besai suante;
english: the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,

paite: Ashna, Meunim leh Nephusim suante;
english: the children of Asnah, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephisim,

paite: Bakbuk, Hakupha leh Harhur suante;
english: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

paite: Bazluth, Mehida leh Harsha suante;
english: the children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

paite: Barkos, Sisera leh Thamah suante;
english: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,

paite: Neziah leh Hatipha suante,
english: the children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

paite: Solomon sikhate tate: Sotai, Hassopheret leh Peruda suante;
english: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Hassophereth, the children of Peruda,

paite: Jaalah, Darkon leh Giddel suante;
english: the children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

paite: Shephatiah, Hattil, Zebaim mi Pokereth leh Ami suante.
english: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, the children of Ami.

paite: Nethinim mite teng, Solomon sikhate tate, zathum sawmkua-le-nih.
english: All the temple servants, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety-two.

paite: Huchi in hiaite Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addan leh Immer a kipan a paitoute ahi uh: himahleh apipute inkote, asuan uh, Israel a kipan ahi uhia chih ataklang thei kei uh:
english: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addan, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses and their offspring, whether they were of Israel:

paite: Delaiah, Tobiah leh Nekoda suante, zaguk sawmnga-le-nih.
english: the children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty-two.

paite: Huan siampute suante: Habaiah, Hakkoz leh Barzillai Gilead mi Barzillai tanute a kipan azi kitenpihpa suante, amau min zui a sak in a-om hi.
english: Of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Hakkoz, and the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.

paite: Hiai khangthu sutna a sim mite lak a min gelhna azong ua, himahleh amu kei uh. Huaiziak in buah a sim in a-om ua siamputna a kipan dangkoih in a-om uhi.
english: These sought their place among those who were registered by genealogy, but they were not found; therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.

paite: Huan Tirshatha in, siampu Urim leh Thummim toh ahong dinkhiak mateng, thil siangthoupente ne lou ding in amau ahilh hi.
english: The governor told them that they should not eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to serve with Urim and with Thummim.

paite: Omkhawm tengteng avek un singli sangnih zathum-le- sawmguk ahi.
english: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,

paite: Apasal sikhate uleh anumei sikhate uh, sangsagih zathum sawmthum-le-sagihte sim louh in pasal lasami leh numei lasami sangnih anei uhi.
english: in addition to their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven; and they had two hundred singing men and singing women.

paite: Asakolte uh zasagih sawmthum- le-guk ahi ua; sakol neute, zanih sawmli-le-nga;
english: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five;

paite: Sangawngsaute, zali sawmthum- le-nga; sabiltung uh, sangguk zasagih-le-sawmnih.
english: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.

paite: Huan Jerusalem a TOUPA' inn ahong tun un, apipute uh inkuan lak a alupente akhen in, TOUPA' inn alamna ding in ut thu a thillat alan uhi.
english: Some of the heads of fathers’ households, when they came to Yahweh’s house which is in Jerusalem, offered willingly for God’s house to set it up in its place.

paite: Nasepna sumbawm ah ahihtheihdan un dangka-eng darik singguk-le-sangkhat, dangka paun sangnga leh siampute puansilh zakhat.
english: They gave according to their ability into the treasury of the work sixty-one thousand darics of gold, five thousand minas of silver, and one hundred priests’ garments.

paite: Huchi in siampute, Levi mite, mite lak a akhenkhat leh lasa mite, kongkhak ngak mite leh Nethinim mite, akhopite uah ateng ua, Israel mite akhopite uah ateng uhi.
english: So the priests and the Levites, with some of the people, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants, lived in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.

paite: Huchi akha sagihna ahong tun a, khopite a Israel suante a-om lai un, mite Jerusalem ah mi khat bang in akikhawmkhawm uhi.
english: When the seventh month had come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in Jozadak tapa Jeshua leh a-unaute siampute leh Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel leh a-unaute adingh ua, Pathian mipa Mosi Dan a akigelh bang a, atung a halmang thillatte lan ding in, Israel' Pathian maitam abawl uhi.
english: Then Jeshua the son of Jozadak stood up with his brothers the priests and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel and his relatives, and built the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings on it, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.

paite: Maitam kingakna tung ah atung ua; gamte a mite ziak in atung uah launa a-om hi: huchi in atung ah TOUPA a ding in halmang thillatte zing leh nitak a halmang thillatte ngei alan uhi.
english: In spite of their fear because of the peoples of the surrounding lands, they set the altar on its base; and they offered burnt offerings on it to Yahweh, even burnt offerings morning and evening.

paite: Huan akigelh bang in, biakbukte ankuangluina abawl ua, ahih ding zah in niteng halmang thillatte, dan dungzui in, niteng a sep ding kiphamoh bang in alan uhi.
english: They kept the feast of booths, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the ordinance, as the duty of every day required;

paite: Huai nung in halmang thillat ngeinate, kha thakte thillatte leh hihsiangthou a om TOUPA ankuanglui sehkhiakte tengteng leh michih a kipan TOUPA a dia uttak a ut thu a thillatte alan uhi.
english: and afterward the continual burnt offering, the offerings of the new moons, of all the set feasts of Yahweh that were consecrated, and of everyone who willingly offered a free will offering to Yahweh.

paite: Akha sagihna ani khat ni a kipan in TOUPA a ding in halmang thillatte alan pan ua; himahleh TOUPA tempul suangphum akiphum nai kei hi.
english: From the first day of the seventh month, they began to offer burnt offerings to Yahweh; but the foundation of Yahweh’s temple was not yet laid.

paite: Sumte suangsek mite kiang leh khutsiam mite kiang ah apia ua; Kura Persia kumpipa a kipan aphalna amuh bang ua tuipi a, Joppa tan a Lebanon tang a kipan sidar singte hon la ding in, Zidonte kiang leh Turate kiang ah, sa, dawn ding leh sathau apia uhi.
english: They also gave money to the masons and to the carpenters. They also gave food, drink, and oil to the people of Sidon and Tyre to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea, to Joppa, according to the grant that they had from Cyrus King of Persia.

paite: Huchi in akha nihna, Jerusalem a Pathian inn ahong tun uh akum nihna in, Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel leh Jozadak tapa Jeshua leh a-unaute siampute leh Levi mite leh koltanna a kipan a Jerusalem a hong paite akipan ua; Levi mite kum sawmnih a upa leh atunglam TOUPA' inn nasepna a heutute hi ding in asep uhi.
english: Now in the second year of their coming to God’s house at Jerusalem, in the second month, Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the rest of their brothers the priests and the Levites, and all those who had come out of the captivity to Jerusalem, began the work and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to have the oversight of the work of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huchi in Pathian inn a nasem mite heutu ding in, Jeshua atapate leh a-unaute, Kadmiel leh atapate, Judah tapate, Henadad tapate, atapate uh leh a-unaute uh Levi mite toh adingkhawmta uhi.
english: Then Jeshua stood with his sons and his brothers, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together to have the oversight of the workmen in God’s house: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brothers the Levites.

paite: Inn lam mite'n TOUPA tempul suangphum akoih lai un, Israel kumpipa David thupiak bang in, TOUPA phat ding in, siampute pengkulte toh apuan uh asilhsak ua, Levi mite Asaph tapate dakkhutbette aguan uhi.
english: When the builders laid the foundation of Yahweh’s temple, they set the priests in their vestments with trumpets, with the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise Yahweh, according to the directions of David king of Israel.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA phatna leh kipahna piakna in la asakhawm chiat ua, "Amah lah ahoih ngal a, azahngaihna tangtawn in Israel lam ah a-om gige ngal a," chi in. Huchi in TOUPA' inn suangphum akoih ziak un mite tengteng aw ngaihtak a kikou in TOUPA aphat uhi.
english: They sang to one another in praising and giving thanks to Yahweh, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever toward Israel.” All the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised Yahweh, because the foundation of Yahweh’s house had been laid.

paite: Himahleh siampute leh Levi mite leh pipute inkote lak a mi tampi, amit mahmah ua hiai inn suangphum akikoih lai a, tua inn masa mute putekte, ngaihtak in akapkhia ua; mi tampi nuamsa in ngaihtak in akikou uhi.
english: But many of the priests and Levites and heads of fathers’ households, the old men who had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice. Many also shouted aloud for joy,

paite: Huchi in mite'n nuamsa a kikouna husa, mite kahna husa toh atheikak thei kei ua: mite ngaihtak in akikou ua, ahusa uh gamlapi ah akiza hi.
english: so that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people; for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard far away.

paite: Huchi a Judah leh Benjamin melmate'n saltangte tate'n TOUPA, Israel' Pathian a ding in tempul alam uh chih azak un;
english: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity were building a temple to Yahweh, the God of Israel,

paite: Zerubbabel leh pipute inko lupente kiang ah ahong pai nai ua, akiang uah, "Hon lampih le ung ake: noute bang in, na Pathian uh lah ka zong ngal ua; Assuria kumpipa Esarhaddon in hiai mun ahon pipa dam lai nite a kipan amah kiang ah ka kithoih uhi," achi uhi.
english: they came near to Zerubbabel, and to the heads of fathers’ households, and said to them, “Let us build with you, for we seek your God as you do; and we have been sacrificing to him since the days of Esar Haddon king of Assyria, who brought us up here.”

paite: Himahleh Zerubbabel leh Jeshua leh Israel pipu inko lupente'n akiang uah, "Ka Pathian uh a dia inn na hon lampihna ding ziak bangmah na nei kei uh; himahleh Persia kumpipa Kura in kou thu ahon piak bang in, Israel' Pathian, TOUPA a ding in koute'n ka lam ding uhi," achi uhi.
english: But Zerubbabel, Jeshua, and the rest of the heads of fathers’ households of Israel said to them, “You have nothing to do with us in building a house to our God; but we ourselves together will build to Yahweh, the God of Israel, as King Cyrus the king of Persia has commanded us.”

paite: Huchi in gam a mite'n Judah a mite khut ahatsakta kei ua, inn lamna ah amau asubuaita uhi.
english: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building.

paite: Persia kumpipa Kura dam lai tengteng, Persia kumpipa Darias lal lai tanpha in, athiltup uh kalhse ding, amaute siatna ding in thuhilh mite aguai uhi.
english: They hired counselors against them to frustrate their purpose all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.

paite: Ahasueras vaihawm pat tung lai in, Judah leh Jerusalem a tengte hekna lai agelh uhi.
english: In the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, they wrote an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.

paite: Huan Artaksarses dam lai in Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel leh akithuahpihte'n Persia kumpipa Artaksarses kiang ah lai agelh ua; laikhak gelhdan Siria laimal a gelh a, Siria pau a bawlkhiak ahi.
english: In the days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of his companions wrote to Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in Syrian and delivered in the Syrian language.

paite: Sepaih heutu lian Rehum leh laigelhmi Shimshai in Jerusalem siatna ding in kumpipa Artaksarses kiang ah hichibang in laikhak agelh uhi.
english: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king as follows.

paite: Sepaih heutu lian Rehum leh laigelhmi Shimshai leh akithuahpihte un huchi in agelhta ua; Dinai mite, Apharsatki mite, Tarpe mite, Aphar mite, Arki mite, Babulon mite, Susan mite, Deha mite, Elam mite leh,
english: Then Rehum the chancellor, Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions, the Dinaites, and the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Shushanchites, the Dehaites, the Elamites,

paite: Osnappar lian leh thupi in apikhiak, Samaria khopi leh luipi khen a gamdang leh adangdang a kikoih namte tan in.
english: and the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Osnappar brought over and settled in the city of Samaria, and in the rest of the country beyond the River, and so forth, wrote.

paite: Kumpipa Artaksarses kiang a alaikhak uh teisawn hiai ahi: "Luipi khen lam leh adangdang a na sikhate.
english: This is the copy of the letter that they sent: To King Artaxerxes, from your servants, the people beyond the River.

paite: Na kiang a kipan a hong tou Judate Jerusalem ah kou kiang ah ahong uh chih kumpipa kiang ah theih in om hen: Khopi helhat leh hoih lou alam lellel ua, akulhbaangte azouta ua, asuangphumte apuah khinta uh.
english: Be it known to the king that the Jews who came up from you have come to us to Jerusalem. They are building the rebellious and bad city, and have finished the walls and repaired the foundations.

paite: Kumpipa'n thei hen, hiai khopi lam a a-om a, akulhbaangte zoh in omleh zaw, leimante, siahte sumsinna leimante hiam lamlian leimante ape kei ding ua, atawptawp in kumpipa siatna ahi ding.
english: Be it known now to the king that if this city is built and the walls finished, they will not pay tribute, custom, or toll, and in the end it will be hurtful to the kings.

paite: Tu in koute kumpi inn a pan huhna ngahte ka hih ziak un, kumpipa zahlakna muh koute ding in akilawm kei a, huaiziak in kumpipa thudik ka hon khak uhi.
english: Now because we eat the salt of the palace and it is not appropriate for us to see the king’s dishonor, therefore we have sent and informed the king,

paite: Na pipute chiamtehna laibu sung ah kizong hen: huchi in chiamtehna laibu sung ah na mu ding a, hiai khopi helhat, kumpipate leh bialte a dia poikhoih hat chih leh nidanglai mah in leng huai sung mah a helna ana bawlta uh chih na thei mai ding; huaiziak a hiai khopi kihihsegawp lah ahi ngal a.
english: that search may be made in the book of the records of your fathers. You will see in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful to kings and provinces, and that they have started rebellions within it in the past. That is why this city was destroyed.

paite: Hiai khopi akilam a, akulhbaangte hichibang a akihih khitleh zaw, luipi khen lam ah tan na nei kei ding chih kumpipa ka hon theitelsak uhi," chi in.
english: We inform the king that if this city is built and the walls finished, then you will have no possession beyond the River.

paite: Huchi in dansiam Rehum leh laigelhmi Shimshai leh Samaria leh luipi khen a gam a teng akithuahpih tengteng kiang ah kumpipa'n dawnna akhak hi: Chibai,
english: Then the king sent an answer to Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions who live in Samaria, and in the rest of the country beyond the River: Peace.

paite: "Laikhak ka kiang a na hon khak uh ka ma ah teltak a sim ahita.
english: The letter which you sent to us has been plainly read before me.

paite: Huchi in thu ka pia a, akizong khin a, nidanglai in hiai khopi in kumpipate tung ah helna abawl a, huai ah helpina leh helna a na kibawlta chih muhkhiak in a-om hi.
english: I decreed, and search has been made, and it was found that this city has made insurrection against kings in the past, and that rebellion and revolts have been made in it.

paite: Huai lou in kumpipa thilhihthei taktak, luipi khen gam tengteng tung a vaihawm, Jerusalem tung a vaihawmte ana om ua; van leimante, sumsinna leimante leh lamlian leimante amau kiang a piak ahi hi.
english: There have also been mighty kings over Jerusalem who have ruled over all the country beyond the River; and tribute, custom, and toll was paid to them.

paite: Huchi in keimah in thupiak ka bawl masiah, huai mite khawl ding leh hiai khopi lam lou ding in, thupiak bawl un.
english: Make a decree now to cause these men to cease, and that this city not be built until a decree is made by me.

paite: Hiai thu a ze-ol lou ding in pilvang un: Bang ding in kumpipate siatna ding in hoihlouhna akhang dia?" chi in.
english: Be careful that you not be slack doing so. Why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?

paite: Huchi a kumpipa Artaksarses laikhak teisawn Rehum leh laigelhmi Shimshai leh akithuahpihte ma a asim khit un, kintak in Jerusalem a Judate kiang ah ahoh ua, kihatsakna leh thilhihtheihna zang in amau akhawlsakta uhi.
english: Then when the copy of King Artaxerxes’ letter was read before Rehum, Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went in haste to Jerusalem to the Jews, and made them to cease by force of arms.

paite: Huchi in Jerusalem a Pathian inn nasep akhawl a: Persia kumpipa Darias vaihawm akum nihna tan in akhawl hi.
english: Then work stopped on God’s house which is at Jerusalem. It stopped until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

paite: Huan zawlneite, zawlnei Haggai leh Zekariah Iddo tapa in Judah leh Jerusalem a om Judate kiang ah athu agenkhol ua; akiang uah Israel' Pathian min in thu agenkhol uhi.
english: Now the prophets, Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied to the Jews who were in Judah and Jerusalem. They prophesied to them in the name of the God of Israel.

paite: Huchi in Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel leh Jozadak tapa Jeshua athou ua, Jerusalem a om Pathian inn alam panta ua; amaute panpih in akiang uah Pathian zawlneite a-om uhi.
