english: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak rose up and began to build God’s house which is at Jerusalem; and with them were the prophets of God, helping them.

paite: Huchih lai mah in akiang uah Tattenai, luipi khen a ukpipa leh Shethar-boznai leh akithuahpihte uh ahong ua, akiang uah hichibang in, hiai inn lam ding leh hiai kulhbaang zou ding in kua'n thu ahon pia a? achi uhi.
english: At the same time Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, came to them, with Shetharbozenai and their companions, and asked them, “Who gave you a decree to build this house and to finish this wall?”

paite: Huai ban ah ka kiang uah, "Hiai inn lam mite min bang ahia?" chi in ahong dong uhi.
english: They also asked for the names of the men who were making this building.

paite: Himahleh Juda upate tung ah a Pathian uh mit atu a, athu Darias kiang a ahong tun a, huai tungtang laikhak a dawnna ahong kik nawn masiah, amaute akhawlsak kei uhi.
english: But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, and they didn’t make them cease until the matter should come to Darius, and an answer should be returned by letter concerning it.

paite: Laikhak teisawn Tattenai, luipi khen a ukpipa leh Shethar-boznai leh akithuahpih Abharsa mite, luipi khen a omte'n kumpipa Darias akhak uhi.
english: The copy of the letter that Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, and Shetharbozenai, and his companions the Apharsachites who were beyond the River, sent to Darius the king follows.

paite: Akiang ah laikhak akhak uh hichibang a gelh ahi. "Darias kumpipa kiang ah khamuanna kim om hen.
english: They sent a letter to him, in which was written: To Darius the king, all peace.

paite: Kumpipa'n thei hen, Judia bial ah ka pai ua, suang thupite a lam, Pathian thupi inn ah, kulhbaangte singte akikoih a, hiai nasep thanopna toh apai zel a, akhut uah ma asawn zel hi.
english: Be it known to the king that we went into the province of Judah, to the house of the great God, which is being built with great stones and timber is laid in the walls. This work goes on with diligence and prospers in their hands.

paite: Huai upate thu ka dong ua, hichibang in akiang uah, 'Hiai inn lam ding leh hiai kulhbaang zou ding in nou kuan thu ahon pia a?' ka chi uhi.
english: Then we asked those elders, and said to them thus, “Who gave you a decree to build this house, and to finish this wall?”

paite: Nang kiang a tel mahmah gen thei ding in, aminte uh leng ka dong ua, huchi a amau makaipen a om mite min ka gelhkhiak theihna ding un.
english: We asked them their names also, to inform you that we might write the names of the men who were at their head.

paite: Huchi in hichibang in kou ahon dawng uhi, 'Van leh lei Pathian sikhate ka hi ua, hiai inn kum tampi a na kilamsa, Israel kumpipa thupi in alam leh azohsa inn ka lam uhi.
english: Thus they returned us answer, saying, “We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth and are building the house that was built these many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and finished.

paite: Himahleh ka pipute un van Pathian a na suk heh nung un, amaute Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar, Kaldai mi khut ah apia a, ama'n hiai inn ahihsia a, mite Babulon lam ah apimang hi.
english: But after our fathers had provoked the God of heaven to wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house and carried the people away into Babylon.

paite: Himahleh Babulon kumpipa Kura akum khatna kum in, kumpipa Kura in hiai Pathian inn lam ding in thupiak abawl hi.
english: But in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, Cyrus the king made a decree to build this house of God.

paite: Dangka-eng leh dangka tui-um belsuan Pathian inn ate leng, Nebukadnezzar in Jerusalem a om Pathian inn a kipan a alakkhiak a, Babulon tempul a laklutte, huaite kumpipa Kura in Babulon tempul a kipan alakhia a, mi khat Sesbazzar, ukpipa dia abawl kiang ah huaite apekhia hi.'
english: The gold and silver vessels of God’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem and brought into the temple of Babylon, those Cyrus the king also took out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered to one whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor.

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, 'Hiai tui-um belsuan la inla, pai in, Jerusalem a om tempul ah koih in, amun ah Pathian inn lam hi hen,' achi hi.
english: He said to him, ‘Take these vessels, go, put them in the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let God’s house be built in its place.’

paite: Huai lai in Sesbazzar ahong a, Jerusalem a om Pathian inn suangphumte aphum a: huai hun a kipan tutan in lam in a-om a, hinapi in lah zoh ahi kei hi.
english: Then the same Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundations of God’s house which is in Jerusalem. Since that time even until now it has been being built, and yet it is not completed.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in kumpipa'n hoih asakleh, Babulon a om, kumpipa laigelhte koihchingna insung kizong henla, Jerusalem a hiai Pathian inn lam ding kumpipa Kura in thupiak bawlna hiam abawlleh, hiai thu ah kumpipa'n akipahna kou hon khak hen," chi in.
english: Now therefore, if it seems good to the king, let a search be made in the king’s treasure house, which is there at Babylon, whether it is so that a decree was made by Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem; and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.”

paite: Huchih lai in kumpipa Darias in thupiak abawla, Babulon a goute koihkhawmna, laibute insung azong uhi.
english: Then Darius the king made a decree, and the house of the archives, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon, was searched.

paite: Huchi in Akmetha ah, Media bial a om inpi ah laizial akimukhia a, huai ah chiamtehna ding in hichibang a gelh ahi.
english: A scroll was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of Media, and in it this was written for a record:

paite: "Kumpipa Kura akum khatna kum in, Kura kumpipa'n thupiak abawl hi: Jerusalem a Pathian inn tungtang, a-inn lam hi henla, kithoihnate a latna mun uh leh huai a suangphumte kiptak a koih hi hen; asanlam tong sawmguk, azatlam tong sawmguk;
english: In the first year of Cyrus the king, Cyrus the king made a decree: Concerning God’s house at Jerusalem, let the house be built, the place where they offer sacrifices, and let its foundations be strongly laid, with its height sixty cubits and its width sixty cubits;

paite: Suang thupi taktak vual thum leh sing thak vual khat toh, huan sum sennate kumpipa' inn a kipan piakkhiak hi hen:
english: with three courses of great stones and a course of new timber. Let the expenses be given out of the king’s house.

paite: Nebukadnezzar in Jerusalem tempul a kipan a alakkhiak, Babulon lam a alak, Pathian inn a dangka-eng leh dangka tui-um belsuan piak nawn vek hi henla, Jerusalem a om Pathian insung ah amau mun chiat ah koih nawn vek hi hen."
english: Also let the gold and silver vessels of God’s house, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple which is at Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, be restored and brought again to the temple which is at Jerusalem, everything to its place. You shall put them in God’s house.

paite: "Tattenai, luipi khen a ukpipa, Shethar-boznai leh na kithuahpihte uh Apharsa mite, luipi khen a omte: huai inn lamna a kipan gamla ah om un:
english: Now therefore, Tattenai, governor beyond the River, Shetharbozenai, and your companions the Apharsachites, who are beyond the River, you must stay far from there.

paite: Hiai Pathian inn nasepna subuai kei un; Judate ukpipa leh Juda upate'n amun ah hiai Pathian inn lam uhen.
english: Leave the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in its place.

paite: Huai lou in hiai Pathian inn lamna ding a hiai Juda upate kiang ah na hih ding uh thu ka bawl hi: kumpipa vante a kipan, luipi khen a siah a kipan mahmah in, hiai mite kiang a sumzatnate thanopna chiteng toh apiak ding ahi, huchi a dala a-omlouhna ding un.
english: Moreover I make a decree regarding what you shall do for these elders of the Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king’s goods, even of the tribute beyond the River, expenses must be given with all diligence to these men, that they not be hindered.

paite: Huan ataksapnate uh, bawngtalnoute, belamtalte, belamnoute, van Pathian kiang a halmang thillat ding huit buh, chi, uain leh thaute, Jerusalem a om siampute thu bang zel in, tatlak lou in niteng in amau piak ding ahi:
english: That which they have need of, including young bulls, rams, and lambs, for burnt offerings to the God of heaven; also wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the word of the priests who are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail,

paite: Huchi a van Pathian kiang a gimlim kithoihnate alat theih ua, kumpipa hinna leh atapate hinna a dia athumtheihna ding un.
english: that they may offer sacrifices of pleasant aroma to the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king and of his sons.

paite: Thupiak ka bawl lai a, kuapeuh in hiai thu a suklamdan leh a-inn a kipan inkam dohkhiak hi henla, huai ah amah dopkang touh leh henden in om hen; hiai ziak in a-inn ekvum a bawl hi hen.
english: I have also made a decree that whoever alters this message, let a beam be pulled out from his house, and let him be lifted up and fastened on it; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.

paite: Huai mah hihlamdang ding, Jerusalem a om hiai Pathian inn hihse ding a akhut uh kuansak ding kumpipate tengteng leh mite tengteng Pathian huai lai a teng ding a amin omsakpa'n paithal vek hen. Kei, Darias in, thupiak ka bawlta; thanopna tengteng toh sepkhiak in om hen," chi in.
english: May the God who has caused his name to dwell there overthrow all kings and peoples who stretch out their hand to alter this, to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree. Let it be done with all diligence.

paite: Huchi in Tattenai, luipi khen a ukpipa, Shethar-boznai leh akithuahpihte un, kumpipa Darias in asawl ziak in, thanopna tengteng toh huchibang in asemkheta uhi.
english: Then Tattenai, the governor beyond the River, Shetharbozenai, and their companions did accordingly with all diligence, because Darius the king had sent a decree.

paite: Juda upate'n zawlnei Haggai leh Iddo tapa Zekariah genkholhna pansan in inn alam ua ma asawn zel uhi. Israel' Pathian thupiak dungzui leh Kura, Darias leh Persia kumpipa Artaksarses thupiak dungzui in inn alam ua azouta uhi.
english: The elders of the Jews built and prospered, through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. They built and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the decree of Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.

paite: Kumpipa Darias vaihawm akum gukna kum a om, Adar kha ani thum ni in hiai inn zoh ahita hi.
english: This house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante, siampute leh Levi mite leh saltanna ta dangte'n, hiai Pathian inn latna nuamtak in aneita uhi.
english: The children of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy.

paite: Hiai Pathian inn latna ah bawngtal zakhat, belamtal zanih, belamnou zali alan ua; Israel tengteng a dia khelhna thillat ding in, keltal sawm-le-nih, Israel namte zah dungzui in.
english: They offered at the dedication of this house of God one hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve male goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.

paite: Huchi in Jerusalem a om, Pathian nasepna a ding in, Mosi laibu a kigelh bang in, siampute atan hawmna uah, Levi mite amun tan uah akoih uhi.
english: They set the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God which is at Jerusalem, as it is written in the book of Moses.

paite: Huan saltanna tate'n akha khatna ani sawm-le-li ni in Paikan Ankuang alui uhi.
english: The children of the captivity kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

paite: Siampute leh Levi mite lah akisiangsakkhawm vek ngal ua; avek un asiang uhi: huchi in saltanna tate a ding leh a-unaute uh siampute a ding leh amau mah a ding in, Paikan belamnou agou uhi.
english: Because the priests and the Levites had purified themselves together, all of them were pure. They killed the Passover for all the children of the captivity, for their brothers the priests, and for themselves.

paite: Saltanna a kipan a hong paikhe nawn, Israel suante leh TOUPA, Israel' Pathian zong ding a, gam a khovel mite buahna a kipan amau leh amau kihuikhetuam tengteng in, ane uhi.
english: The children of Israel who had returned out of the captivity, and all who had separated themselves to them from the filthiness of the nations of the land to seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, ate,

paite: Nuamtak in ni sagih sung Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina abawl uhi: TOUPA'N amaute nuam asasak in, Israel' Pathian, Pathian inn a nasepna khutte uh hatsak ding in amau lam ah Assuria kumpipa lungtang akiheisak hi.
english: and kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy; because Yahweh had made them joyful, and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria to them, to strengthen their hands in the work of God, the God of Israel’s house.

paite: Hiai thilte nung in, Persia kumpipa Artaksarses vaihawm lai in, Seraiah tapa Ezra, Azariah tapa, Hilkiah tapa,
english: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

paite: Shallum tapa, Zadok tapa, Ahitub tapa,
english: the son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,

paite: Amariah tapa, Azariah tapa, Meraioth tapa,
english: the son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

paite: Zerahiah tapa, Uzzi tapa, Bukki tapa,
english: the son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

paite: Abishua tapa, Phinehas tapa, Eleazar tapa, Aaron siampu lian tapa:
english: the son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest—

paite: Babulon a kipan in hiai Ezra apaitou a; amah Mosi Dan, TOUPA Israel' Pathian in apiak, dan theisa ahi a: atung a TOUPA a Pathian khut a-om dungzui in, angetna tengteng kumpipa'n aphalsak hi.
english: this Ezra went up from Babylon. He was a skilled scribe in the law of Moses, which Yahweh, the God of Israel, had given; and the king granted him all his request, according to Yahweh his God’s hand on him.

paite: Huan kumpipa Artaksarses kum sagih kum in, Jerusalem ah Israel suante lak a akhen, siampute lak a akhen, Levi mite, lasa mite, kongkhak ngak mite leh Nethinim mite, ahohtou ua.
english: Some of the children of Israel, including some of the priests, the Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants went up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa akum sagih kum akha ngana in Jerusalem ah Ezra ahong pai hi.
english: He came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.

paite: Babulon a kipan akha khatna ani khat ni in akuantou pan a, akha ngana ani khat ni in a Pathian khut hoih atung a a-om bang zel in, Jerusalem ah ahong pai hi.
english: For on the first day of the first month he began to go up from Babylon; and on the first day of the fifth month he came to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God on him.

paite: Ezra in bel TOUPA Dan zong ding, zui ding leh Israel tua dan thusehte leh vaihawmnate sinsak ding in alungtang akoihkip hi.
english: For Ezra had set his heart to seek Yahweh’s law, and to do it, and to teach statutes and ordinances in Israel.

paite: Tu in kumpipa Artaksarses in siampu, laigelhmi, TOUPA thupiakte thu gelhmi leh Israel kiang a adan thusehte gelhmi Ezra kiang a apiak laikhak teisawn hiai ahi.
english: Now this is the copy of the letter that King Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the priest, the scribe, even the scribe of the words of Yahweh’s commandments, and of his statutes to Israel:

paite: Artaksarses, kumpipate' kumpipa'n, siampu, van Pathian Dan gelhmi, buching leh huchibang zel in, Ezra kiang ah,
english: Artaxerxes, king of kings, To Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the perfect God of heaven. Now

paite: Thupiak ka bawl hi, huchi a Israel a mite lak a amaute tengteng, ka gamsung a, asiampute uh leh Levi mite, amau ut thu petmah a Jerusalem a pai ding a theihsakte, nang kiang ah pai uhen.
english: I make a decree that all those of the people of Israel and their priests and the Levites in my realm, who intend of their own free will to go to Jerusalem, go with you.

paite: "Kumpipa leh athudot mi sagihte'n, na khut a om na Pathian Dan dungzui a, Judah leh Jerusalem tungtang thu kan ding a, nang ahon sawl bang un;
english: Because you are sent by the king and his seven counselors to inquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of your God which is in your hand,

paite: atenna Jerusalem a om, Israel' Pathian kiang a man nei lou a kumpipa leh athudot mite'n apiaksate uh dangka leh dangka-eng po ding in,
english: and to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose habitation is in Jerusalem,

paite: Babulon bial tengteng a dangka leh dangka-eng na muh tengteng, mite leh siampute'n amau ut thu a thillat, Jerusalem a om a Pathian uh inn a dia uttak a alat tengteng uh toh.
english: and all the silver and gold that you will find in all the province of Babylon, with the free will offering of the people and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem.

paite: "Huaiziak in thanopna toh hiai sum in bawngtalte, belamtalte, belamnoute na lei ding a, a-anpiak thillatte uleh adawn ding thillatte uh toh, huchi in Jerusalem a om na Pathian uh inn maitam tung ah huaite na lan ding hi.
english: Therefore you shall with all diligence buy with this money bulls, rams, and lambs with their meal offerings and their drink offerings, and shall offer them on the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.

paite: Dangka leh dangka-eng om lai hihdan ding nang leh na unaute'n hoih na sak dandan uh, na Pathian uh deihlam bang in hih un.
english: Whatever seems good to you and to your brothers to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, do that according to the will of your God.

paite: Na Pathian inn a nasepna ding a tui-um belsuan ka hon piak uh, Jerusalem Pathian ma ah pia in.
english: The vessels that are given to you for the service of the house of your God, deliver before the God of Jerusalem.

paite: Na Pathian inn ding a kiphamoh dangdangte, piakna ding na neih dingte, kumpipa gou koihkhawmna a kipan in pekhia in.
english: Whatever more will be needed for the house of your God, which you may have occasion to give, give it out of the king’s treasure house.

paite: "Kei, kumpipa kei Artaksarses mahmah in luipi khen a om sumkem mite tengteng kiang ah thupiak ka bawl hi, huchi a Ezra siampu, van Pathian Dan, laigelhmi in nou ahon nget, thanuamtak a hih zel ahihtheihna ding in.
english: I, even I, Artaxerxes the king, make a decree to all the treasurers who are beyond the River, that whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, requires of you, it shall be done with all diligence,

paite: Dangka talent zakhat, huit buh tehna zakhat, uain bath zakhat, sathau bath zakhat leh aphazah gen lou in chi nangawn.
english: up to one hundred talents of silver, and to one hundred cors of wheat, and to one hundred baths of wine, and to one hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.

paite: Bangpeuh van Pathian in thu apiak, van Pathian inn a ding in hih in om zel hen; aziak bel bang ding in kumpipa leh atapate gamsiatna ding in thangpaihna a-om dia?
english: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be done exactly for the house of the God of heaven; for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?

paite: Huai lou in leng ka hon chitaktak uh hi, siampute leh Levite, lasa mite, kongkhak ngak mite, Nethinim mite hiam hiai Pathian inn sikhate lak a akuakua tungtang ah, van leimante, sumsinna leimante hiam lamlian leimante amau liausak dan ahi kei ding hi.
english: Also we inform you that it shall not be lawful to impose tribute, custom, or toll on any of the priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, temple servants, or laborers of this house of God.

paite: Huan nang, Ezra, na khut a om na Pathian pilna zui in, thukhenmi leh vaihawmmi, tuipi khen a omte mite tengteng vaihawm ding in sep in; na Pathian dante tengteng, huaite theiloute nou sinsak un.
english: You, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God that is in your hand, appoint magistrates and judges who may judge all the people who are beyond the River, who all know the laws of your God; and teach him who doesn’t know them.

paite: Kuapeuh na Pathian dan leh kumpipa dan zui lou, sihna chiang hizong leh thanuamtak in atung ah vaihawmna bawl in om hen, ahihkeileh, khakmangna hiam, vankhakna hiam, suangkul lutna tan in," chi in.
english: Whoever will not do the law of your God and the law of the king, let judgment be executed on him with all diligence, whether it is to death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.

paite: Jerusalem a om TOUPA' inn kilawmsak ding a, kumpipa lungtang a hichibang a thil koih, i pipute Pathian, TOUPA nuamsa in om hen;
english: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of our fathers, who has put such a thing as this in the king’s heart, to beautify Yahweh’s house which is in Jerusalem;

paite: Kumpipa leh athudot mite leh kumpipa vaihawmpih thilhihthei tengteng ma a ka tung a zahngaihna hon pepa amah ahi. Huchi in ka tung a TOUPA ka Pathian khut dungzui in hihhat in ka omta a, ka kiang a hoh ding in Israel a kipan mikizen tungtuan ka kaikhawmta hi.
english: and has extended loving kindness to me before the king and his counselors, and before all the king’s mighty princes. I was strengthened according to Yahweh my God’s hand on me, and I gathered together chief men out of Israel to go up with me.

paite: Huan hiaite apipute uh inkote lak a alupente ahi ua, kumpipa Artaksarses vaihawm lai a kei hon zuite khangthu suina ahi.
english: Now these are the heads of their fathers’ households, and this is the genealogy of those who went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king:

paite: Phinehas tapate lak ah, Gershom: Ithamar tapate lak ah Daniel: David tapate lak ah, Hattush,
english: Of the sons of Phinehas, Gershom. Of the sons of Ithamar, Daniel. Of the sons of David, Hattush.

paite: Shekaniah tapate lak ah; Parosh tapate lak ah, Zekariah: amah toh pasalte khangthu suina a suikhawmte zakhat-le-sawmnga ahi.
english: Of the sons of Shecaniah, of the sons of Parosh, Zechariah; and with him were listed by genealogy of the males one hundred fifty.

paite: Pahath-moab tapate lak ah, Elihoenai Zerahiah tapa; huan amah toh pasal zanihte.
english: Of the sons of Pahathmoab, Eliehoenai the son of Zerahiah; and with him two hundred males.

paite: Shekaniah tapate lak ah, Jahaziel tapa; amah toh pasal zathumte.
english: Of the sons of Shecaniah, the son of Jahaziel; and with him three hundred males.

paite: Adin tapate lak ah, Jonathan tapa Ebed; amah toh pasal sawmngate.
english: Of the sons of Adin, Ebed the son of Jonathan; and with him fifty males.

paite: Elam tapate lak ah, Athaliah tapa Jeshaiah; amah toh pasal sawmsagihte.
english: Of the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah; and with him seventy males.

paite: Shephatiah tapate, Mikael tapa Zebadiah; amah toh pasal sawmgiatte.
english: Of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah the son of Michael; and with him eighty males.

paite: Joab tapate lak ah, Jehiel tapa Obadiah; amah toh pasal zanih sawm-le-giatte.
english: Of the sons of Joab, Obadiah the son of Jehiel; and with him two hundred eighteen males.

paite: Shelomith tapate lak ah, Josiphiah tapa; amah toh pasal zakhat-le-sawmgukte.
english: Of the sons of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah; and with him one hundred sixty males.

paite: Bebai tapate lak ah, Bebai tapa Zekariah; amah toh pasal sawmnih-le-giatte.
english: Of the sons of Bebai, Zechariah the son of Bebai; and with him twenty-eight males.

paite: Azgad tapate lak ah, Hakkatan tapa Johanan; amah toh pasal za-le-sawmte.
english: Of the sons of Azgad, Johanan the son of Hakkatan; and with him one hundred ten males.

paite: Adonikam tapate lak ah, ananungpente; hiaite amin uh ahi, Eliphelet, Jeiel, Shemaiah leh amau toh pasal sawmgukte.
english: Of the sons of Adonikam, who were the last, their names are: Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah; and with them sixty males.

paite: Bigvai tapate, Uthai leh Zabbud; amau toh pasal sawmsagihte.
english: Of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud; and with them seventy males.

paite: Huchi in Ahava pha a luang luipi tan in amaute ka kaikhawm a; huai ah ni thum ka giak uhi. Mite leh siampute ka en vialvial a, huai ah Levi tapate kuamah ka mu kei.
english: I gathered them together to the river that runs to Ahava; and there we encamped three days. Then I looked around at the people and the priests, and found there were none of the sons of Levi.

paite: Huan Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zekariah leh Meshullam, mikizen tungtuante, sinsak mite Joiarib leh Elnathan leng ka thukhak hi.
english: Then I sent for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, for Elnathan, for Jarib, for Elnathan, for Nathan, for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib and for Elnathan, who were teachers.

paite: Kasiphia mun a Iddo hausapa kiang ah amau ka sawlkhia a; Iddo kiang ah leh Kasiphia mun a a-unaute Nethinimte kiang a agen ding uh ka hilh a, i Pathian inn ua ding a nasemmi ei a dia hon tonpih ding in.
english: I sent them out to Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia; and I told them what they should tell Iddo and his brothers the temple servants at the place Casiphia, that they should bring to us ministers for the house of our God.

paite: Huchi in i tung ua i Pathian khut hoih a om dungzui in pasal khat lunggelsiam, Mahli tapate lak a, Levi tapa, Israel tapa ei ding in Sherebiah atapate leh a-unaute, sawm-le-giat toh ahon pi uhi.
english: According to the good hand of our God on us they brought us a man of discretion, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel, namely Sherebiah, with his sons and his brothers, eighteen;

paite: Hashabiah, amah toh Merari tapate lak a Jeshaiah toh, a-unaute leh atapate uh, sawmnih toh;
english: and Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty;

paite: Nethinimte, David leh avaihawmpihte'n Levi mite nasepna ding a apiakte uh, zanih-le-sawmnih Nethinimte: avek un minkhumna ah akhum uhi.
english: and of the temple servants, whom David and the princes had given for the service of the Levites, two hundred twenty temple servants. All of them were mentioned by name.

paite: Huchi in huai ah, Ahava lui ah, an ngawl ka puang a, huchi a ei a ding leh i nau neute a ding leh i neih i lamte tengteng a dia lampi tang amah lak a zong ding a i Pathian uh ma a ei leh ei i kiniamkhiak theihna ding in.
english: Then I proclaimed a fast there at the river Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God, to seek from him a straight way for us, for our little ones, and for all our possessions.

paite: Lampi a melma dou ding a ei hon panpih ding a kumpipa kiang a sepaih pawl leh sakol tungtuangmi nget lah ka zum ngal a: hoihna ding a, amah zongte tung ah i Pathian khut a-om a; himahleh amah mangngilh tengteng siatna ding in athilhihtheihna leh athangpaihna a-om hi, chi a, kumpipa kiang a thu i gen tak ziak in.
english: For I was ashamed to ask of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy on the way, because we had spoken to the king, saying, “The hand of our God is on all those who seek him, for good; but his power and his wrath is against all those who forsake him.”

paite: An i ngawl ua hiai ding in i Pathian i ngen ngutngut ua: huchi in ama'n i thumna uh hon dawng hi.
english: So we fasted and begged our God for this, and he granted our request.

paite: Huai lai in siampute lak a amakai lianpente lak a sawm-le-nih, Sherebiah, Hashabiah leh akiang ua om a-unaute uh lak a sawmkhat ka sehkhen a,
english: Then I set apart twelve of the chiefs of the priests, even Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them,

paite: amau a ding in dangka leh dangka-eng leh tui-um belsuante, kumpipa leh athuhilh mite leh avaihawmpihte'n TOUPA' inn a alatte uh huai lai a om Israel tengteng puak ding in ka buksak hi.
english: and weighed to them the silver, the gold, and the vessels, even the offering for the house of our God, which the king, his counselors, his princes, and all Israel there present, had offered.

paite: Akhut sung mahmah uah dangka talent zaguk-le-sawmnga leh dangka tui-um belsuan talent za ka buksak a; dangka-eng lak ah talent za;
english: I weighed into their hand six hundred fifty talents of silver, one hundred talents of silver vessels, one hundred talents of gold,

paite: dangka-eng noubem sawmnih, darik sangkhat lak ah; dal hoih nawttet, dangka-eng bang a manpha bel nih.
english: twenty bowls of gold weighing one thousand darics, and two vessels of fine bright bronze, precious as gold.

paite: Huan akiang uah, "TOUPA a ding in na siangthou ua, tui-um belsuante asiangthou uh; dangka leh dangka-eng TOUPA, na pipute uh Pathian a dia ut thu a thillat ahi uh.
english: I said to them, “You are holy to Yahweh, and the vessels are holy. The silver and the gold are a free will offering to Yahweh, the God of your fathers.

paite: TOUPA' inn dantante, Jerusalem a siampute lak a lupente leh Levi mite leh Israel pipute inko vaihawmte ma a huaite na buk masiah uh, pilvan suah in, amaute kem un," ka chi hi.
english: Watch and keep them until you weigh them before the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and the princes of the fathers’ households of Israel at Jerusalem, in the rooms of Yahweh’s house.”

paite: Huchi in siampute leh Levi mite'n i Pathian inn ua Jerusalem a apuak ding un dangka leh dangka-eng leh tui-um belsuan bukkhiakte ala uhi.
english: So the priests and the Levites received the weight of the silver, the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem to the house of our God.

paite: Huai lai in Jerusalem lam a pai ding in, akha khatna ani sawm-le-nih ni in Ahava lui a kipan i pawtkhia ua: huan i Pathian khut i tung uah a-om a, melma khut leh lampi a buk mi a kipan ama'n hon tankheta hi.
english: Then we departed from the river Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem. The hand of our God was on us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy and the bandits by the way.

paite: Huchi in Jerusalem i tung ua huai ah ni thum i om uhi.
english: We came to Jerusalem, and stayed there three days.

paite: Ani li ni in dangka leh dangka-eng leh tui-um belsuan i Pathian inn uah Uriah siampu tapa Meremoth khut ah buk in a-om a; akiang ah Phinehas tapa Eleazar a om; akiang uah Jeshua tapa Jozabad leh Binnui tapa Noadiah, Levi mite a-om uhi;
english: On the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God into the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them were Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, the Levites.

paite: aphazah leh agikdan tengteng sim ahi a, huai hun in laibu a chiamteh ahi.
english: Everything was counted and weighed; and all the weight was written at that time.

paite: Pimangna a kipan a hong pai, saltanna tate'n Israel' Pathian kiang ah halmang thillatte, bawngtal sawm-le-nih Israel tengteng a ding in, belamtal sawmkua-le-guk, belamnou sawmsagih-le-sagih, keltal khelhna thillat ding in sawm-le-nih alan uhi: hiaite tengteng TOUPA a ding a halmang thillat ahi.
english: The children of the captivity, who had come out of exile, offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel: twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, and twelve male goats for a sin offering. All this was a burnt offering to Yahweh.

paite: Kumpipa thukhen mite kiang leh tuipi khen a ukpipate kiang ah kumpipa thupiakte apekhia ua: huchi in mite leh Pathian inn apanpih uhi.
english: They delivered the king’s commissions to the king’s local governors and to the governors beyond the River. So they supported the people and God’s house.

paite: Huchi a hiai thilte hih khit ahih lai in, ka kiang ah vaihawmtute ahong pai nai ua, "Israel mite leh siampute leh Levi mite, gamte a mite a kipan amau leh amau akikoihtuam kei ua, amaute kihhuainate, Kanaan mi, Hit mi, Periz mi, Jebus mi, Ammon mi, Moab mi, Aigupta mi leh Amor mite, dungzui in a-om uhi.
english: Now when these things were done, the princes came near to me, saying, “The people of Israel, the priests, and the Levites have not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands, following their abominations, even those of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.

paite: Amau a ding leh atapate uh a ding in atanute uh ala ua; huchi in chi siangthou gamte mite toh amau leh amau akihelkhawmta hi: ahi, hiai tatlekna ah vaihawmtute khut leh vaihawmte amakai lianpente ahi uhi," achi hi.
english: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves and for their sons, so that the holy offspring have mixed themselves with the peoples of the lands. Yes, the hand of the princes and rulers has been chief in this trespass.”

paite: Huchi a hiai thil ka zak in, ka puansilh leh ka puanak ka botkek a, ka lu a sam leh ka khamul ka botkhia a, lamdang sa in ka tusuk hi.
english: When I heard this thing, I tore my garment and my robe, and pulled the hair out of my head and of my beard, and sat down confounded.

paite: Huai lai in saltanna a amaute tatlekna ziak a, Israel' Pathian thute ziak a lau a ling michih ka kiang ah ahong kikhawm ua; nitaklam kithoih hun masiah lamdang sa in ka tu hi.
english: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel were assembled to me because of the trespass of the exiles; and I sat confounded until the evening offering.

paite: Nitaklam kithoih hun lai in ka tunggikna a pan ka thou a, ka puansilh leh ka puanak bohkeksa toh; ka khukdin a, TOUPA ka Pathian lam ah ka khutte ka zakkhia a;
english: At the evening offering I rose up from my humiliation, even with my garment and my robe torn; and I fell on my knees, and spread out my hands to Yahweh my God;

paite: "Aw ka Pathian, na kiang a daktou ding in ka zum in ka zakta hi, ka Pathian: ka thulimlouhnate uh ka lutunglam uah apung deuhdeuh a, ka mohna un vante asunta hi.
english: and I said, “My God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to you, my God, for our iniquities have increased over our head, and our guiltiness has grown up to the heavens.

paite: Ka pipute uh dam lai hun a kipan tuni pha in nakpi in ka mohta ua; huchi in ka thulimlouhnate uh ziak in kou, ka kumpipate uh leh ka siampute uh, gamte kumpipate khut ah, namsau ah, saltanna ah, lohna ah leh zahlakna ah, hiai ni bang in piakkhiak in ka omta uhi.
english: Since the days of our fathers we have been exceedingly guilty to this day; and for our iniquities we, our kings, and our priests have been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, to plunder, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.

paite: Huan tu in sawt lou sung a ding in TOUPA ka Pathian ua kipan in hehpihna hong lang a, suakta ding a om lai dia nutsiat ding in leh amun siangthou a omkipna hon pe ding in, huchi a ka Pathian un ka mitte uh ahon sukvaksak a, ka tanna ua halhna neukha ahon piaktheihna ding in.
english: Now for a little moment grace has been shown from Yahweh our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a stake in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and revive us a little in our bondage.

paite: Sikha lah ka hi ngal ua; huchipi in leng sikha ka hihna uah ka Pathian un ahon mangngilh kei a, himahleh Persia kumpipate mitmuh in zahngaihna ahon pia a, halhna hon pe ding, ka Pathian uh inn dingsak ding leh huai a siatna bawlpha ding leh Judah leh Jerusalem a kulhbaang hon pe ding in.
english: For we are bondservants; yet our God has not forsaken us in our bondage, but has extended loving kindness to us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to revive us, to set up the house of our God, and to repair its ruins, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.

paite: "Tu in, Aw ka Pathian uh, hiai zoh in bang ka chita ding ua? Na thupiakte lah ka lehngatsanta ngal ua,
english: “Now, our God, what shall we say after this? For we have forsaken your commandments,

paite: Na sikha zawlneite zang in thu na hon pia a: 'Luah ding a na paina uh, huai gam, gamte a mite nitna ziak a gam nin ahi. Akihhuainate un gam tawp khat lam a kipan khat lam tawp tan ahihdimna ziak in.
english: which you have commanded by your servants the prophets, saying, ‘The land to which you go to possess is an unclean land through the uncleanness of the peoples of the lands, through their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their filthiness.

paite: Huaiziak in na tanute uh atapate uh kiang ah pe kei unla, atanute uh leng na tapate uh a ding in la sam kei un, amuanna uhiam ahauhsakna uhiam leng tangtawn in zong sam kei un: huchi a na hat ua, gam a ahoih na nek ua, tangtawn a na tate uh a ding a gouluah dia na nutsiat theihna ding un.'
english: Now therefore don’t give your daughters to their sons. Don’t take their daughters to your sons, nor seek their peace or their prosperity forever, that you may be strong and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children forever.’

paite: Huchi a ka gamtat giloute uh ziak leh ka mohna thupi mahmah ziak ua, ka tung ua hong tung tengteng zoh in, nang ka Pathian un ka thulimlouhnate uh gunzah sang a hon gawt tawmzaw a, akhosuaksun om lai na hon piak mu in.
english: “After all that has come on us for our evil deeds and for our great guilt, since you, our God, have punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and have given us such a remnant,

paite: Na thupiakte bohse nawn in, kihhuaite hih mite toh kituak in ka om ding uam? Akhosuak ding hiam, suakta ding himhim leng om lou khop a na bawlgawp matan ka tung uah na heh nilouh dia hia?
english: shall we again break your commandments, and join ourselves with the peoples that do these abominations? Wouldn’t you be angry with us until you had consumed us, so that there would be no remnant, nor any to escape?

paite: Aw TOUPA Israel' Pathian, nang na diktat a; hiai ni bang a akhosuak omlaite na hon nutsiat ziak in. Ngai in, ka mohna un na ma ah ka om uhi;' hiai ziak in lah kuamah na ma ah adingh thei kei ding uhi."
english: Yahweh, the God of Israel, you are righteous; for we are left a remnant that has escaped, as it is today. Behold, we are before you in our guiltiness; for no one can stand before you because of this.”

paite: Paul, Jesu Khrist leh misi lak a kipan a kaithoupa, Pa Pathian ziak a sawltak, mihing sawlkhiak hilou, mihing vang a leng hi sam lou,
english: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—

paite: leh ka kiang a unau om tengtengte'n, Galatia gam a saptuamte kiang ah:
english: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

paite: Pa Pathian leh i Toupa Jesu Khrist a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
english: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

paite: Ama'n i Pathian leh Pa deihdan in, tulai khovel giloutak lak a ahon suahtaksak theihna ding in i khelhnate a ding in amah mah ahong kipeta hi.
english: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—

paite: Pathian kiang ah thupina tangtawn in om hen, Amen.
english: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

paite: Khrist hehpihna ziak a nou hon sampa huchi guih a tanchinhoih tuam lam a na kisuansan uh lamdang ka sa hi.
english: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,

paite: Tanchinhoih dang om ahi kei a; noumau hon hihbuai in Khrist tanchinhoih hihlamdan ut kuate hiam a-om uh ahi zaw hi.
english: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

paite: Himahleh koumau hiam, van a kipan hong suk angel nangawn in leng, tanchinhoih na kiang ua ka gensa pen lou ngal uh tanchinhoih dang himhim hon na hilhta a-om uleh hamsiat in om uhen.
english: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

paite: Tuma a ka gen bang un, tua gen nawn ding ka hi. Tanchinhoih na muh pen lou ngal uh, tanchinhoih dang kuapeuh in nou ahon hilhleh hamsiat in om uhen.
english: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

paite: Ahihleh tu in mihing maipha hia ka zon, Pathian a? Ahihkeileh mihing ahi maw lungtaisak ka tup? Mihing ana lungtaisak lel hi taleng, Khrist sikha ka hi kei ding hi.
english: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.

paite: Huchi in unaute aw, ka tanchinhoih gen pen mihing a pan ahi kei chih ka hon theisak hi.
english: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

paite: Mihing kiang a kipan a ka muh leng ahi kei, mi hon hilh leng ka hi sam kei, Jesu Khrist kilakna ziak amu ka hi zaw hi.
english: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

paite: Judate sabiakdan a nidanglai ka omdan na thei khinta ngal ua, huchi a Pathian saptuamte nakpitak a sawi in sukchimih ka na sawm gige hi.
english: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.

paite: Huan ka pipute thugousiah tung a phatuam ka ngaih tuankhol ziak in Judate sabiakdan lam ah ka chipihte lak a ka khanvual tampite ka na khengta hi.
english: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

paite: Ka nu gilsung a kipan a hon hihtuampa leh ahehpihna ziak a hon sampa Pathian in,
english: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,

paite: Zentelte lak a ka hilhtheihna ding a, ama Tapa lungkimtak a keimah a akilaksak lai in, sa leh sisan toh kidong lou in,
english: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,

paite: sawltak ka hih ma a sawltak ana hisate kiang a Jerusalem a hohtou tuan lou in, Arabia gam ah ka paimang pah a; huan Damaskas ah ka kik nawnta hi.
english: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

paite: Kum thum abei nung in Kifas veh ding in Jerusalem ah ka va hohtou a, akiang ah ni sawm-le-nga ka taam hi.
english: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

paite: Sawltak dangte, Toupa unau Jakob kia lou ngal kuamah ka mu kei hi.
english: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.

paite: Na kiang ua ka thugelhte ngai dih ua, Pathian mitmuh ah ka zuau kei hi.
english: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.

paite: Huai nung in Siria leh Silisia gamte ah ka pai hi.
english: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

paite: Judia gam a saptuam, Khrist a omte meltheih ka hi nai kei lai hi,
english: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

paite: "Tuma lam a khatvei ginna thu sukchimih tum a hon sawipa'n tu in huai thu agen zawta," chih mi gen kia aza uhi.
english: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”

paite: Huan keimah ziak in Pathian apahtawita uhi.
english: So they glorified God in me.

paite: Kum sawm-le-li abei nung in Titas mah leng pi in, Barnabas toh Jerusalem ah ka va hohtou nawn hi.
english: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.

paite: Kilakna ziak a va hohtou ka hi a, Zentelte kiang a tanchinhoih ka tangkoupih amau ka va hilh a; himahleh milian deuhte atuam in ka hilh a; huchi lou in zaw athawn a tai kha hiam ahihkeileh taithawnta ka hi kha ding hi.
english: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.

paite: Himahleh ka kiang a om Titas hial leng Grik mi himahleh zeksumsak teitei in a-om kei hi.
english: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

paite: Huai unau tak lou, aguk a pilut a omte, sal a ahon laktheihna ding ua Khrist Jesu a noplenna i neih uh enkhe ding a hong lutte ziak in ahi.
english: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage,

paite: Himahleh noute a dia huai tanchinhoih thutak a bittak a kep ahihtheihna ding in amau kiang ah mitphiat kal lel leng ka kipe himhim kei uhi.
english: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.

paite: Hihna deuh min nei mahmahte bangchibang hihna nei mah le uh kei a ding in alamdanna a-om kei hi. Pathian in kuamah akhentuam kei a; huai min nei mahmahte thugen in bangmah hon behlap kei hi.
english: But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,

paite: Huchih nak sang in zeksumte kiang a tanchinhoih Peter kiang a kepsak a a-om bang in zeksumlouhte kiang a tanchinhoih kei kiang ah kepsak in a-om chih athei zaw uhi.
english: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised—

paite: Zeksumte sawltak hi ding a Peter a sempa mah in Zentelte sawltak hi ding in kei ah asem hi.
english: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles—

paite: Huan kei kiang a piak a om hehpihna amuh un, Jakob, Kifas, Johan, khuam muanhuai leh min neite'n amau bel zeksumte kiang a hoh ding leh kou Zentelte kiang a hoh ding in kei leh Barnabas kithuahna khut taklam hon pe zawta uhi.
english: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who were reputed to be pillars, gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.

paite: Gentheite ka theihgige lel uh adeih ua, huai mah hih ka tum tinten hi.
english: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.

paite: Huan Antiok a Peter ahong pai lai a demhuai mahmah a a-om ziak in amaitang ngei ah ka kalh hi.
english: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.

paite: Jakob kiang a kipan mi kuate hiam ahong pai ma un ama'n Zentelte kiang ah an ane zel a; himahleh ahong tuntak un zeksumte akihtak ziak in pang nawn lou in akikoihtuamta hi.
english: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

paite: Juda dangte leng alepchiah chiat sam ua, huchi in Barnabas hilhial leng alepchiahna uah pimang in a-om zou hial hi.
english: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.

paite: Tanchinhoih thutak bang in a-om kei uh chih ka theih in avek ua ma ah Peter kiang ah, "Nang Juda mi na hi ngal a, Judate om bang a om lou in Zentelte om bang a na om zawkleh bangchidan ahia Judate om bang a Zentelte na omsak teitei nak?" ka chi hi.
english: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?

paite: Ei zaw Zentel mikhialte hilou in, Juda mi him a piang i hi uhi.
english: “We, being Jews by nature and not Gentile sinners,

paite: Himahleh dan thilhihte ziak in mi siamtang in a-om kei, Jesu Khrist ginna ziak in siamtang in a-om zaw uh chih i thei uhi; e'n leng dan thilhih ziak hilou in, Khrist ginna ziak a siamtang a i omtheihna ding in, Khrist Jesu i gingta hi; dan thilhihte ziak in mihing himhim siamtang a om lou ding uh ahi.
english: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.

paite: Ahihleh Khrist a siamtang a om tum kawmpi a eite mikhialte i na hih nakleh Khrist khelhna omsakpa hita ve maw le! Hilou hial!
english: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!

paite: Ka thilhihsiatte ka lam nawn zel in zaw, talekpa ka hi chih ka kitheisak phet ahi ding hi.
english: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.

paite: Pathian lam a dia ka hong hintheihna ding in, kei zaw dan ziak in dan lam ah ka si khinta hi.
english: For I through the law died to the law, that I might live to God.

paite: Khrist toh kilhden in ka omta; himahleh ka hing ahi; keimah pen ka hita kei a, keimah ah Khrist ahing ahi zaw; tua sa a ka hin bel ginna a hing ka hi; Pathian Tapa, hon it a ka sik a kipepa pen ginna ah.
english: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.

paite: Pathian hehpihna bangmah lou in ka bawl kei, dan ziak a diktatna a om in zaw Khrist athawn a si ahi kha ding hi.
english: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”

paite: Nou Galatia mihaite aw, kua'n hon bumhai amaizen a? Na mitmuh ngei ua Jesu Khrist kilhden a kichiantak a lahsak zaw hiven maw.
english: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?

paite: Hiai leltak ka hon dong ding; dan thilhihte ziak in hia Kha na muh uh, na ngaihkhiak ua na gintak ziak un?
english: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

paite: Hichi tel in na hai uh maw? Kha a pan khin ngal in, sa in na zou ding ua hia?
english: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?

paite: Thil huchi zahzah athawn a thuak na hi uh maw? Athawn taktak na hitaleh.
english: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?

paite: Na kiang ua Kha hon pepa leh na lak ua thillamdang hihpa'n dan thilhihte ziak in hia ahih, na ngaihkhiak ua na gintak ziak un?
english: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

paite: "Abraham in Pathian agingta a, huai ginna diktatna a simsak ahih tak mah bang in,"
english: Even so, Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”

paite: Huchi in thei un, ginna a omte Abram tate ahi uhi.
english: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.

paite: Huan Laisiangthou in, "Pathian in ginna ziak in Zentelte siamtangsak ding in akisa chih theikhol in, nangmah ah namte vualzawlsak in a-om ding uh," chi in Abraham kiang ah tanchinhoih ana genkholta hi.
english: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.”

paite: Huchi in ginna a omte ginna mipa Abraham toh vualzawlsak in a-om sam nak uhi.
english: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

paite: Dan thilhih a kinga peuhmahte hamse nuai ah a-om uhi, "Dan laibu a thugelh tengteng bang a hih gige lou peuhmah hamsiat in om hen," chi a gelh ahi.
english: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”

paite: Tu in Pathian mitmuh in kuamah dan a siamtang a-om kei, "Midiktat tuh ginna in ahing ding,” chih ahih ziak in chih alang kilkel hi.
english: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”

paite: Himahleh dan zaw ginna a kinga ahi kei; huchibang a hihpa huaite in ahing ding chih ahi zaw hi.
english: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”

paite: Eite sik in Khrist hamsiat in ahong om a, dan hamsia a kipan in ahon tankheta hi, "Sing a khailup peuhmah hamsiat hi hen," chih gelh ahih bang in.
english: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”

paite: Huchi a Abraham tung a vualzawlnate Khrist Jesu ziak a Zentelte tung ahong tun theih a, ginna ziak a chiam a om Kha pen i muhtheihna ding in.
english: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

paite: Unaute aw, mihing hihdan in gen leng; mihing thukhun leltak leng, hihkipsa nung aphel kei ua, behlap leng abehlap ngei kei uhi.
english: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it.

paite: Abraham kiang ah leh achisuante kiang ah thuchiamte piak ana hi. Mi tampi tungthu gen bang in, "Chisuante kiang ah," achi kei a; mi khat tungthu gen bang in, "Nang chisuan kiang ah," achi zaw a, huai tuh Khrist ahi.
english: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, which is Christ.

paite: Huchi in hiai ka chi ahi; huai thuchiam bangmah lou suaksak a hihmang ding in, thukhun Pathian in ana hihkipsa, anung kum zali-le-sawmthum khit a hong om, dan in ahihmang thei kei hi.
english: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.

paite: Gouluah ding thu dan ziak ahihleh thuchiam ziak ahita kei ding a; himahleh Pathian in Abraham kiang ah thuchiam ziak in ahi ana piak.
english: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.

paite: Ahihkeileh bangchi thu a dan om ahia le? Chisuan thuchiamna ahong om masiah tatleknate ziak in behlap in a-om a, angelte zang a palai khut a hihkip ahi.
english: Then why is there the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.

paite: Huan palai himhim mi khat lak ah palai ahi ngei kei hi; Pathian bel khat ahi.
english: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.

paite: Ahihkeileh dan in Pathian thuchiamte akalh hia? Kalh lou hial! Hihhing thei himhim dan piak a om na hitaleh, dan ziak in diktatna a-om ngei ding hi.
english: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.

paite: Himahleh Jesu Khrist gin ziak a thilchiam a gingtate kiang a piak ahihtheihna ding in Laisiangthou in khelhna nuai ah bangkim akhakkhum vekta hi.
english: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

paite: Himahleh ginna ahong tun ma in ginna hong kilang ding ah khakkhum in dan nuai a ven i na hi uhi.
english: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

paite: Huchi in ginna ziak a siam i tantheihna ding in huai dan tuh Khrist hon chilpa ahi.
english: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

paite: Himahleh ginna ahong tun in, hon chilpa nuai ah i omta kei uhi.
english: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.

paite: Khrist Jesu gin ziak in Pathian tate na hi vek uhi.
english: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

paite: Noute Khrist a baptis lut a omsate Khrist in na kithuamta uhi.
english: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

paite: Huai ah Juda mi a-om kei a, Grik mi leng a-om kei; huai ah sikha a-om kei a, noplen leng a-om kei; huai ah pasal leh numei leng a-om kei hi. Khrist Jesu ah na vek un pum khat na hi uhi.
english: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

paite: Huan Khrist a na hih uleh Abraham suan thuchiam bang a gouluah dingte na hi uhi.
english: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.

paite: Himahleh huchi in ka chi ahi, Gouluah dingpa bangkim tung ah toupa himahleh naupang ahih lai teng sikha toh bangmah in akilamdang kei;
english: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all,

paite: apa hun seh ahong tun masiah achilpa leh akempa nuai ah a-om hi.
english: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.

paite: Huchibang in ei leng naupang i hih lai in, khovel thubulte nuai ah sikha in i om uhi.
english: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.

paite: Himahleh ahunbi ahong kim in, Pathian in a Tapa, numei suan in, dan nuai a hong suak in ahon sawlkhia hi;
english: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

paite: ta hihna i muhtheihna ding leh dan nuai a omte tankhe ding in.
english: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.

paite: Huan tate na hih ziak un Pathian in a Tapa Kha, "Abba, Pa,” chi a kikou in, i lungtang uah ahon sawl hi.
english: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”

paite: Huchi in sikha na hita kei ua, ta na hi zawta uhi; huan ta na hihleh Pathian vang a gouluah ding na hi uhi.
english: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

paite: Hinapi, tuma Pathian na theih louh lai un, apiandan mawng ua pathian hilou hialte sikha na hi uhi.
english: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.

paite: Himahleh tu a Pathian na hon theih nung un bel, ahihkeileh Pathian theihmi na hong hih nung un chih ding ahi zaw; thubul zawngkhal leh namanloute nuai a bangchidan a bawi a tan ut nawn na hi ua?
english: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?

paite: Nite, khate, hunte, kumte na tang zel ua.
english: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.

paite: Na tung uah tha ka sengthawn kha ding chih ka lau hi.
english: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.

paite: Unaute aw, ka hon ngen ahi, keimah bang in om un, kei leng noumau bang in ka om a, ka bangmah na hihse kei uhi.
english: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,

paite: Tanchinhoih na kiang ua ka gen masakna pen ka sa hat louh ziak ahi chih na thei uhi.
english: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.

paite: Huan ka sa a nou a dia khemna om tuh na simmoh kei ua, na kih sam kei uh; Pathian angel bang leh Khrist Jesu bang hial in na hon pakta zaw uhi.
english: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

paite: Vangpha na kisakna uh koi a omta ahia le? Hihtheih liai hileh na mit uh khelkhia in na hon pe khin ding uh chih ka hon theihpih ahi.
english: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.

paite: Thutak ka hon hilh ziak in na melma uh ka hong hita a hia?
english: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?

paite: Amau noute phatuamngaitak in, ahoih lam deih hilou napi in ahon zol ua; ahi, amau a dia phattuam na ngaih theihna ding ua koute a kipan posiah a hon omsak a-ut uhi.
english: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.

paite: Atup ahoih nakleh ahoih lam ah chik lai peuh in phatuamngaih gige ahoih hi, na kiang ua ka om lai kia hilou in.
english: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.

paite: Ka unaute aw, Khrist noumau a siam piching a a-om masiah nauvei in ka hon vei hi.
english: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—

paite: Ahi, tulai in na kiang ua om a, ka awsuah hihlamdan ka ut theihdan; na tungthu uah ka mang abang ahi.
english: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.

paite: Dan nuai a om utte aw, hon hilh un, dan in agen na thei kei ua hia?
english: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?

paite: Hichibang a gelh ahi: Abraham in tapa nih anei a, khat sikhanu toh khat noplennu toh ahi.
english: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.

paite: Himahleh sikhanu lak a pen sadan in apiang a, noplennu lak a pen bel thuchiam ziak a piang ahi.
english: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.

paite: Huai thilte etsakna ahi, huai numeite thukhun nih ahi uh; khat Sinai Tang a sikha hi ding a ta neinu, Hagar ahi.
english: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.

paite: Huan Hagar bel Arabia gam a Sinai Tang ahi a, tulai a om Jerusalem toh kibang ahi, atate toh sikha in a-om uhi.
english: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.

paite: Tunglam Jerusalem bel noplen ahi; huai ngeingei eite nu ahi.
english: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

paite: "Nang chiing, ta nei ngei lou, nuam in, nang, nauvei ngei lou, kikoukhia in; pasal neinu sang in lungzuangnu tate tamzaw ding ahi ngal a," chih gelh ahi.
english: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break out and shout, you who don’t travail. For the desolate women have more children than her who has a husband.”

paite: Huchi in unaute aw, eite Isak bang in thuchiam tate i hi uhi.
english: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.

paite: Himahleh huai lai bang in tu in leng ahi; sadan a piang in Khadan a piang asawi ahi.
english: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.

paite: Himahleh Laisiangthou in bangchi in agen a? "Bawinu atapa toh hawlkhia un; bawinu tapa in noplennu tapa gou aluahpih louh ding ziak in," achi hi.
english: However, what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the servant and her son, for the son of the servant will not inherit with the son of the free woman.”

paite: Huchi in unaute aw, bawinu tate i hi kei ua, noplennu tate i hi zaw uhi.
english: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.

paite: Noplending in khrist in ahon suaktasakta, huaiziak in dingkip unla, bawi hakkol ah zaw lut nawn kei un.
english: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

paite: Ngai un kei Paul in na kiang ua ka gen, zek na sum uleh Khrist nou a ding in bangmah phattuamna hilou ding ahi.
english: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

paite: Ahi a, dan thu tengteng zui ding a bate ana hi uh chih zeksumte tengteng kiang ah ka theisak nawn ahi.
english: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

paite: Nou dan a siamtan tumte aw, Khrist toh kikhenta na hi ua, hehpihna na puksanta uhi.
english: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

paite: Kou bel Kha ziak in ginna in diktatna lametna ka ngak uhi.
english: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

paite: Khrist Jesu ah zeksum bangmah aphatuam kei a, zeksum louh leng bangmah aphatuam sam kei; itna a sem ginna bel aphatuam hi.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.

paite: Hoihtak in na tai uhi. Kua'n thutak zui lou ding a hon dal ahia?
english: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

paite: Hiai khemna zaw nou hon sampa kiang a kipan ahi kei hi.
english: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

paite: Silngou tawmchik in tanghou beupi azelsuak hi.
english: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

paite: Kei ngaihtuahna bang lou in na ngaihtuah lamdang tuan kei ding uh chih Toupa ah ka hon muang hi; himahleh nou hon hihbuaite, akua akua hita le uh vaihawmna atung ua kia pen athuak ding uh ahi.
english: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

paite: Unaute aw, ke'n zeksum thu gen lailai ka hihleh, bangziak a sawi a om lailai ka hia? Huchibang ahih ngalleh kros kisuihna tuh hihmang ahita ding hi.
english: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

paite: Nou hon hihbuaite satkhiak in om vanglak le uh ka deih ahi.
english: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

paite: Nou unaute aw, noplen ding a sap na hi ua; himahleh na noplenna uh sa a ding a lemtanna in zang kei unla, itna in akua akua a ding a kisepsakte hi zaw un.
english: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

paite: Nangmah na ki-it bang in na vengte na it ding ahi, chih thu kam khat ah dan thu tengteng kimsak in a-om hi.
english: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

paite: Himahleh na kikeih ua, na kinektuah uleh na kinekgaihlouhna ding un pilvang un.
english: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

paite: Huchi in hiai ka chi ahi, Kha ah om un, huchi in taksa utna na hihtangtung kei ding uhi.
english: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

paite: Sa in Kha adou nak a, Kha in leng sa adou hi; thilhih na tupte uh na hihtheihlouhna ding un huaite akikalh uh ahi.
english: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

paite: Himahleh Kha pi a na om uleh dan nuai ah na om kei uhi.
english: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

paite: Huan sa thilhihte akilangchian hi, huaite hiaite ahi uh: angkawmna, kingaihna, thanghuaina, hukna,
english: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

paite: milim biakna, bumna, huatna, kinakna, hazatna, hehna, kilanna, omtuamna, gintuamna,
english: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

paite: deihgohna, tualthahna, zukhamna, zumun uangtatna, huchibang thilhih chingte'n Pathian lalgam atang kei ding uh chi a tuma a ka hon hilhkholh mah bang in, ka hon hilhkhol ahi.
english: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.

paite: Kha gah ahihleh, itna, kipahna, lemna, thuaktheihna, migitna, hoihna, muanhuaina,
english: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

paite: nunnemna, kidektheihnate ahi zaw uhi; huchibang kalh lam in dan himhim a-om kei hi.
english: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

paite: Khrist Jesu a hitate'n sa, alunggulhna leh aduhgawlna toh akilhdenta uhi.
english: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

paite: Kha a hing i hihleh kha mah ah i om ding uhi.
english: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

paite: Kitawngtuah a, kihaza chiat in, i kikoihlian kei ding uhi.
english: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

paite: Unaute aw, mi takhial bangpeuh ahih lai phawk a na omleh nou khamite aw, khemna ka tuak sam kha ding e, chi a kivenghoih kawm in, huai bang mi nunnemna lungsim toh tungding thak nawn un.
english: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

paite: Na puakgikte uh kidawn chiat un, huchi in Khrist dan na zui uh ahi ding.
english: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

paite: Mi bangmah hiloupi in mi liankuam a akibawlleh amah kikhem tawm lel ahi.
english: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

paite: Michih in amah thilhih ki-enchian hen; huchi a midang toh kiteh a, ki-uangsak lou a, amah mah a suanhuai thil ahihtheihna ding in.
english: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.

paite: Michih in ama puak mah po ding ahi ngal a.
english: For each man will bear his own burden.

paite: Thuhilh a ommi in thil hoih tengteng ahilhpa kiang ah pe sam hen.
english: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

paite: Zekhem in om kei un; Pathian zaw khem a mawkbawl vual ahi kei; mi'n atuh peuh uh huai mah at nawn ngei ding ahih ziak un.
english: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

paite: Amah salam a tuh in sa a om siatna a-at ding a, khalam a tuh in bel kha a kipan tangtawn hinna a-at ding hi.
english: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

paite: Huchi in thil hoih hih chimtak kei ni; i lungkiak keileh ahuntak ah i at ngei ding uhi.
english: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.

paite: Huchi in lemtang hun i neihdan bang zel in mi tengteng tung ah thil hoih hih ni, ginna inkuanpihte lak a omte tung ah hi kholdiak hen.
english: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

paite: Keimah khut mahmah a na kiang ua laimal gol pipi a ka gelh en un.
english: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

paite: Sa a mel kilawmsak utte peuhmah in zeksum a om ding in nou ahon sawl teitei nak uhi; bangmah dang ziak ahi kei, Khrist kros ziak a sawina athuaklouhna ding lel uh ahi.
english: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

paite: Zeksumte nangawn in leng dan azui tuan sam kei ua, na sa uah, suan ding aneihtheihna ding un na zek uh kisumleh chih a-ut lel uh ahi.
english: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.

paite: Ke'n zaw i Toupa Jesu Khrist kros lou ngal ka suan louh ding dan, huai kros ziak in khovel kei a ding in kilhden in a-om a, kei leng khovel a ding in kilhden in ka om hi.
english: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

paite: Siam thak nawnna lou zaw zeksum bangmah ahi kei a, zeksum louh leng bangmah ahi sam kei hi.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

paite: Huai dan bang a om peuhmahte tung ah lemna leh zahngaihna, Israel' Pathian tung ngei ah om hen.
english: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.

paite: Tuban siah kuamah in hon hihbuai nawn kei hen; ka pumpi ah Jesu chiamtehnate ka pu ngal a.
english: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

paite: Unaute aw, Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na kha uah om hen. Amen.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.

paite: Atung in Pathian in lei leh vante asiam hi.
english: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

paite: Lei tuh lim leh mel nei lou in, avuak kia ahi a, tui thukpi tung mial in amial hi. Pathian Kha in tuite tung a-opkhum hi.
english: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.

paite: Pathian in, "Vak om hen," achi a, huchi in vak ahong omta hi.
english: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

paite: Pathian in vak a-en a, hoih asa hi. Huchi in Pathian in mial a pan vak akhenkheta hi.
english: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.

paite: Pathian in vak, "Sun" achi a, mial, "Zan" achi hi. Huchi in ani khatna ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
english: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.

paite: Pathian in, "Tuite kikal ah vansin om henla, huai in tuite a pan tuite khenkhia hen," achi hi.
english: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”

paite: Pathian in vansin abawl a, vansin tung a tui omte a pan vansin nuai a tui omte akhenkhia a; huan huchibang ahong hita hi.
english: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.

paite: Pathian in vansin, "Van" achi hi. Huchi in ani nihna ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
english: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.

paite: Pathian in, "Van nuai a tuite mun khat ah omkhawm uh henla, gamkeu hong dawk hen," achi a; huchibang ahong hita hi.
english: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.

paite: Pathian in gamkeu, "Lei" achi a; tui omkhawmte Tuipite achi hi. Pathian in huai a-en a, hoih asa hi.
english: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.

paite: Pathian in, "Lei in loupate, anteh chi neite, thei sing lei a amau chi omdan ding bang zel a gah, agah sung a chi omte omsak hen," achi a, huchibang ahong hita hi.
english: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.

paite: Huchi in lei in loupate, anteh amau chi omdan ding bang a chi neite, sing amau chi omdan ding bang a gah, agah sung a chi omte a-omsak hi. Pathian in huai a-en a, hoih asa hi.
english: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.

paite: Huchi in ani thumna ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.

paite: Pathian in, "Sun leh zan khenna ding in vansin ah tanvakte om uhenla, huaite chiamtehnate, hunbite, nite leh kumte theihna hi uhen.
english: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;

paite: Lei tanvak ding in van a vansin ah vakte om uhen," achi a, huchibang ahong hita hi.
english: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.

paite: Pathian in tanvak thupi nih abawl a; tanvak thupizaw pen sun a vaihawm ding in, tanvak thupi louzaw pen zan a vaihawm ding in abawl hi. Aksite leng abawl hi.
english: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.

paite: Pathian in huaite lei tanvak ding in van a vansin ah akoih a;
english: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,

paite: sun tung leh zan tung a vaihawm ding leh vak leh mial khen ding in. Huchi in Pathian in huai a-en a, hoih asa hi.
english: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.

paite: Huchi in ani lina ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

paite: Pathian in, "Tuite'n thilsiam tang thei hinna neite tampi pawtsak uhenla, vasate leng leitung a vansin hawm heuhou ah leng uhen," achi hi.
english: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”

paite: Pathian in ngapi liante asiam a, ganhing tang thei chiteng tui in apawtsak a, amaute chi omdan ding bang leh kha nei vasa chiteng amaute chi omdan ding bang in asiam hi. Pathian in huai a-en a, hoih asa hi.
english: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.
