english: For Yahweh had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N agensa bang in Sarah ava veh a, achiamsa bang in Sarah tung ah TOUPA'N ahihta hi.
english: Yahweh visited Sarah as he had said, and Yahweh did to Sarah as he had spoken.

paite: Sarah agai a, Pathian in akiang a agen hun seh bang in, atek nung in Abraham tapa aneihsakta hi.
english: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

paite: Abraham in Sarah in aneihsak atapa min Isak asa hi.
english: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.

paite: Abraham in Pathian in akiang a thu apiak bang in atapa Isak ni giat achin in azek asumsak hi.
english: Abraham circumcised his son, Isaac, when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.

paite: Atapa Isak apian lai in Abraham kum zakhat a upa ahita.
english: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.

paite: Sarah in, "Pathian in hon nuisakta; aza kha peuhmah in hon nuihpih ding uh," achi hi.
english: Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”

paite: Amah mah in, "Sarah in naungekte apom ding, chih kua'n ahia Abraham kiang a gen thei ding? Atek nung in tapa ka neihsakta,” achi hi.
english: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”

paite: Naungek ahong khanglian a, nawinek atawpsakta uh. Isak nawinek atawpsak ni un, Abraham in ankuang thupitak alui hi.
english: The child grew and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.

paite: Aigupta mi Hagar tapa, Abraham a ding a aneihsak pen in Isak asimmohbawl lai Sarah in amu hi.
english: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.

paite: Huaiziak in Abraham kiang ah, "Hiai sikhanu leh atapa delhkhia in. Hiai sikhanu tapa in ka tapa Isak gou aluahpih thei kei ding,” achi hi.
english: Therefore she said to Abraham, “Cast out this servant and her son! For the son of this servant will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”

paite: Hiai thu atapa mah toh kisai ahih ziak in Abraham ngaih in thil hoih loutak ahi.
english: The thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.

paite: Himahleh Pathian in Abraham kiang ah, "Naupang tungtang thu leh na sikhanu tungtang thu na ngaih in thil hoih lou hi kei hen. Sarah in na kiang a thu agen tengteng zui in, Isak ah na suante kisim ding chih ahi ngal a,
english: God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your servant. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For your offspring will be named through Isaac.

paite: Sikhanu tapa ah leng, na suan ahih ziak in, nam chih tham ngial ka bawl ding," achi hi.
english: I will also make a nation of the son of the servant, because he is your child.”

paite: Beltak in Abraham athou a, tanghou leh tuithawl, tui a dim ala a, Hagar kiang a pia in, aliangkou ah asuan a, naupang toh asawlkhia hi. Apai a, Beer-sheba gamdai ah avakvakta hi.
english: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a container of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.

paite: Tuithawl a tui ahong beitak in, sawlbawk lim nuai khat ah naupang akoihta mai hi.
english: The water in the container was spent, and she put the child under one of the shrubs.

paite: "Naupang si ding ka en ngam kei," achih ziak in gamla kuam, thal kap phakna ding ah, ava pai a, amazawn a tu in ngaihtak in akapta hi.
english: She went and sat down opposite him, a good way off, about a bow shot away. For she said, “Don’t let me see the death of the child.” She sat opposite him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.

paite: Pathian in naupang aw aza a; Pathian angel in van a kipan Hagar asam a, akiang ah, "Bangchi na hia, Hagar? Lau ke'n, a-omna a naupang aw Pathian in aza hi.
english: God heard the voice of the boy. The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky, and said to her, “What troubles you, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.

paite: Thou inla, naupang phong in, na khut in len in, amah nam thupitak a bawl ding ka hi," achi hi.
english: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him with your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”

paite: Pathian in amit ahihvaksak a, huan tuileh amuta hi. Huai ah ava pai a, tuithawl dim in tui adim a, naupang adawnsak hi.
english: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the container with water, and gave the boy a drink.

paite: Naupang kiang ah Pathian a-om a, ahong khanglian a; gamdai ah ateng zel a, thalkapmi ahong hita hi.
english: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and as he grew up, he became an archer.

paite: Paran gamdai dai ah ateng a; Aigupta gam a kipan zi aguan hi.
english: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother got a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai lai in Abimelek leh asepaih pawl a heutu Phikol in Abraham kiang ah, "Na thilhih peuh ah na kiang ah Pathian a-om.
english: At that time, Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in all that you do.

paite: Tu in hiai ah Pathian min lou inla, kei leh ka tapa leh ka tapa' tapa leng khem lou in, ka hon hehpih khit tak sa bang in kei leh na tenna gam hehpih thuk sam ding in ka kiang ah kichiam in," achi hi.
english: Now, therefore, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”

paite: Abraham in, “Ka kichiam ding," achi hi.
english: Abraham said, “I will swear.”

paite: Abimelek sikhate'n tuileh asuhsak ziak un Abraham in Abimelek asal hi.
english: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.

paite: Abimelek in, “Hiai thilhih pen kua ahia, ka thei himhim kei. Nang lah na hon hilh ngal kei a, tuni ngal lou in ka za kha himhim kei," achi hi.
english: Abimelech said, “I don’t know who has done this thing. You didn’t tell me, and I didn’t hear of it until today.”

paite: Abraham in belamte leh bawngtalte api a, Abimelek kiang ah apia a; anih un thu akhungta uhi.
english: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.

paite: Abraham in abelamhon lak a belamnou anu sagih akoihtuam hi.
english: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

paite: Abimelek in Abraham kiang ah, "Belamnou anu sagih atuam a na koih bang na chihna ahia?” achi hi.
english: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What do these seven ewe lambs, which you have set by themselves, mean?”

paite: Ama'n, "Hiai tuileh keimah leh ahi, chih na hon theihpihna ding in hiai belamnou anu sagih ka khut a kipan na lak ding ahi," achi hi.
english: He said, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”

paite: Huaiziak in huai mun Beer-sheba asa hi; huai a anih ua akichiam ziak un.
english: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there.

paite: Beer-sheba ah thu akhungta uh. Abimelek athou a, asepaih pawl heutu Philok toh Philistiate gam ah apai nawnta uhi.
english: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

paite: Abraham in Beer-sheba ah meilah sing asuan a, huai ah TOUPA, Tangtawn Pathian min alou hi.
english: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of Yahweh, the Everlasting God.

paite: Philistiate gam ah Abraham sawtpi ataam hi.
english: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.

paite: Huai thilte nung in Pathian in Abraham a-enchian hi. Akiang ah, "Abraham," achi a; ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om," achi hi.
english: After these things, God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

paite: Ama'n, "Na tapa, na tapa neihsun, na ittak, Isak tonpih inla, Moriah gam ah pai in, huai ah ka hon hilh ding tang khat ah halmang thillat in amah lan in," achi hi.
english: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”

paite: Beltak in Abraham athou a, sabiltung abawl a, akiang ah atapa Isak toh sikha tangval nih atonpih hi. Haltum thillat a ding in sing a-ek a, athou a, Pathian in ahilhna mun lam ah apaita hi.
english: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.

paite: Ani thum ni in Abraham adak a, amun gamlapi a om amu hi.
english: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.

paite: Abraham in asikha tangvalte kiang ah, "Hiai ah sabiltung toh ana om un. Kei leh naupang huai pam ah ka va hoh ding ua; huai ah Pathian ka va be ding ua; na kiang uah ka hong kik nawn ding uh," achi hi.
english: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go over there. We will worship, and come back to you.”

paite: Abraham in halmang thillatna ding sing ala a, atapa Isak aposak hi. Ama'n mei leh temta atawi a; anih un apaikhawm uhi.
english: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.

paite: Isak in apa Abraham ahoupih a, "Pa," achi a, ama'n, "Bawi, hiai ah ka om,” achi hi. Ama'n, "En dih, mei leh sing a-om a; hileh leng halmang thillat ding belamnou lah koi ah?" achi hi.
english: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am, my son.” He said, “Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?”

paite: Abraham in, "Bawi, Pathian in amah a dia halmang thillat ding belamnou angaihtuah tawm ding hi," achi a; anih un apaikhawm zel uhi.
english: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.

paite: Pathian in ahilhna mun ava tungta ua, Abraham in huai ah maitam adoh a, sing chiangkhawm in, atapa Isak ahen a, maitam a sing tung ah alumsak hi.
english: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.

paite: Abraham in akhut alik a, atapa thahna ding temta ala hi.
english: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.

paite: TOUPA angel in van a kipan amah asam a, "Abraham, Abraham," achi a, ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om," achi hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

paite: Ama'n, "Naupang tung ah na khut kha ke'n. Amah bangmah loh ke'n. Na tapa, na neihsun mahmah leng kei a dia na it louh ziak in Pathian na lau chih tu in ka theita," achi hi.
english: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”

paite: Abraham adak a, a-en a, ngai in, anunglam ah belampa, singbawk a akii awk ana om hi. Abraham in huai belampa ava man a, atapa sik in halmang thillat in alan zawta hi.
english: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.

paite: Abraham in huai mun min, "Jehovah Jireh," asa hi; tuni tan a, "TOUPA tang ah ngaihtuah hi na ve," achih zel bang un.
english: Abraham called the name of that place “Yahweh Will Provide”. As it is said to this day, “On Yahweh’s mountain, it will be provided.”

paite: TOUPA angel in anihveina ding in van a kipan Abraham asam nawn hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,

paite: "Hiai thil na hih ziak leh na tapa neihsun na it louh ziak in kei mahmah in ka kichiam hi.
english: and said, “‘I have sworn by myself,’ says Yahweh, ‘because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,

paite: K'on vualzawl ngeingei ding a, van a aksite zah leh tuipi piau a piaunel zah in na suante ka pungsak ngeingei ding. Na suante'n adoute uh kulh kongkhak atang ding uhi.
english: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your offspring greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your offspring will possess the gate of his enemies.

paite: Ka thu na man ziak in na suan ah leitung a nam chih vualzawl in a-om ding uh," achi hi.
english: All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your offspring, because you have obeyed my voice.’”

paite: Asikha tangvalte kiang ah Abraham akik nawn a, athou ua, Beer-sheba lam manoh in apai uhi. Beer-sheba ah Abraham ateng hi.
english: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.

paite: Hichi in huai thilte nung in Abraham kiang ah, "Ngai in, Milkah in leng na sanggampa Nahor tate aneihsakta ve," chi in Abraham ahilh uhi.
english: After these things, Abraham was told, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:

paite: Ata masa Huz ahi a; asanggampa Buz ahi, Aram pa Kemuel;
english: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,

paite: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph leh Bethuelte leng ahi uh,
english: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”

paite: Bethuel in tanu Rebekah anei a; huai giatte Milkah in Abraham nau Nahor aneihsakte ahi uh.
english: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

paite: Amei, amin Reumah in leng Tebah, Gaham, Thahash leh Maakah anei hi.
english: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.

paite: Sarah damsung kum zakhat wmnil Sarah damsung kumte ahi uh.
english: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah’s life.

paite: Kanaan gam a Kiriath-arba, Hebron kichi ah Sarah asi a, Sarah suun ding leh kah ding in Abraham ahong hi.
english: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

paite: Amisi luang ma a kipan Abraham adingtou a, Heth suante kiang ah,
english: Abraham rose up from before his dead and spoke to the children of Heth, saying,

paite: "Na lak uah mikhual leh khualtam lel ka hi a; ka misi luang muh louh dia ka vuitheihna ding in vuina mun hon pia un,” chi in angen hi.
english: “I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”

paite: Heth suante'n Abraham adawng ua, akiang ah,
english: The children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,

paite: "Ka toupa, hon ngaikhia in, nang ka lak ua vaihawm thupitak na hi a; ka hante uh lak a na deihna penpen ah na misi vui in. Na misi na vuina ding in ka lak uah kuamah in ka han uh hon piak ka it kei ding uh," achi uhi.
english: “Hear us, my lord. You are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in the best of our tombs. None of us will withhold from you his tomb. Bury your dead.”

paite: Huai gam mite leh Heth suante ma ah Abraham dingtou in akun hi.
english: Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, to the children of Heth.

paite: "Ka misi ka muh louh dia ka vui pha na sak uleh, hon ngaikhia unla, Zohar tapa Ephron kiang ah hon ngetsak un.
english: He talked with them, saying, “If you agree that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

paite: Alou taw a om, aneih, Makpelah kokhuk hon pe ding in, na lak ua vuina mun ding ama'n hun asak zahzah la henla, hon pia hen," achi hi.
english: that he may sell me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field. For the full price let him sell it to me among you as a possession for a burial place.”

paite: Heth suante lak ah Ephron atu a; Heth mi Ephron in Heth suante theih in akhokulh kong a lut peuhmah nangawn theih in Abraham adawng a,
english: Now Ephron was sitting in the middle of the children of Heth. Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the children of Heth, even of all who went in at the gate of his city, saying,

paite: "Hilou e, ka toupa, hon ngaikhia in. Lou leh asung a om kokhuk leng ka hon pia hi. Ka chipihte tapate mitmuh in ka hon pia hi. Na misi vui in," chi in.
english: “No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. In the presence of the children of my people I give it to you. Bury your dead.”

paite: Huchi in huai gam mite ma ah Abraham akun hi.
english: Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.

paite: Huai gam mite theih in Ephron kiang ah, "Pha na sakleh hehpih in hon ngaikhia in; lou man ka hon pe ding, kei a kipan la in, huai mun kia ah ka misi ka vui ding," achi hi.
english: He spoke to Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, “But if you will, please hear me. I will give the price of the field. Take it from me, and I will bury my dead there.”

paite: Ephron in Abraham adawng a, akiang ah,
english: Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,

paite: "Ka toupa, hon ngaikhia in. Lei mun dangka shekel zali ahi a, huai zaw, nang leh kei a ding in gen tham ahi a hia? Na misi vui mai in," achi hi.
english: “My lord, listen to me. What is a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver between me and you? Therefore bury your dead.”

paite: Abraham in Ephron thu azuita a; Heth suante theih in Ephron in agen zah, dangka shekel zali, sumsinte zat zel abuk a, Ephron kiang ah apeta hi.
english: Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the hearing of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, according to the current merchants’ standard.

paite: Ephron lou, Mamre toh kizawn Makpelah gam a om, alou toh, asung a kokhuk om toh, lou a sing om tengteng toh, alou kim a sing om tengteng toh,
english: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all of its borders, were deeded

paite: Heth suante mitmuh in, akhokulh kong a om peuhmahte muh in, gou ding in Abraham kiang ah piakkip in a-omta hi.
english: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.

paite: Huai nung in Kanaan gam a Mamre toh kizawn, Hebron kichihna, Makpelah lou a kokhuk ah Abraham in azi Sarah avuita hi.
english: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.

paite: Lou leh asung a kokhuk om vuina mun ding in Abraham kiang ah Heth suante'n apekipta uhi.
english: The field, and the cave that is in it, were deeded to Abraham by the children of Heth as a possession for a burial place.

paite: Abraham upa in ahong tek mahmahta a, TOUPA'N thil bangkim ah Abraham avualzawl hi.
english: Abraham was old, and well advanced in age. Yahweh had blessed Abraham in all things.

paite: Abraham in asikha, a-inn a upapen, aneih tengteng tung a thuneipa kiang ah, "Hehpih in ka pheipi nuai ah na khut golh in,
english: Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, who ruled over all that he had, “Please put your hand under my thigh.

paite: TOUPA, van Pathian leh lei Pathian min lou in, ka tenna Kanaan mite nungak lak a mi ka tapa zi ding a neihsak lou ding in, ka hon kichiamsak ding.
english: I will make you swear by Yahweh, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live.

paite: Ka gam lam a ka tanaute kiang ah hoh inla, ka tapa Isak zi na pisak ding ahi," achi hi.
english: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”

paite: Sikha in akiang ah, "Numei in hiai gam lam ah hon zui nuam kei taleh, na tapa na hong pawtna gam a pikik nawn ding ka hi diam?" achi hi.
english: The servant said to him, “What if the woman isn’t willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring your son again to the land you came from?”

paite: Abraham in akiang ah, "Huai a ka tapa pikik nawn lou ding in pilvang in.
english: Abraham said to him, “Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.

paite: TOUPA, van Pathian, ka pa inn a kipan leh ka pianna gam a kipan hon pikhepa leh hon houpihpa leh hiai gam na suante kiang ah ka pe ding, chi a ka kiang a kichiampa'n, amah ngei in na ma ah a-angel apaisak ding a, huai a kipan ka tapa zi na pisak ding ahi.
english: Yahweh, the God of heaven—who took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my birth, who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, ‘I will give this land to your offspring—he will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.

paite: Numei in hon zuih nop keileh, ka kiang a na kichiamna thu ah na siang ding. Akoi abang hitaleh, huai ah zaw ka tapa na pikik nawn ding ahi kei," achi hi.
english: If the woman isn’t willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this oath to me. Only you shall not bring my son there again.”

paite: Sikha in apu Abraham pheipi nuai ah akhut agolh a, akiang ah huai thu ah akichiamta hi.
english: The servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.

paite: Sikha in apu sangawngsaute lak ah sangawngsau sawm akai a, apu thil hoih chiteng tawi in, apawtkheta hi. Athou a, Mesopotamia gam a Nahor khopi lam ah akipankheta hi.
english: The servant took ten of his master’s camels, and departed, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.

paite: Nitaklam a tui tawi dia numeite akuan hun laitak un, dainawl a tuileh kiang ah asangawngsaute akhukdinsak hi.
english: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.

paite: "Aw TOUPA, ka pu Abraham' Pathian, hehpih in tuni in hon lohchingsak in, ka pu Abraham tung ah hehpihna langsak in.
english: He said, “Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

paite: En in, tuikhuk kiang ah ka dingh a, khua a mite tanute tui tawi ding in ahong kuan uhi.
english: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water. The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.

paite: Huan hichi hi henla, nungak kuapeuh kiang a, 'Hehpih in ka dawn ding in na tuibel niamsak dih ve,' ka chih a, ama'n, 'Dawn in, na sangawngsaute leng dawn ding ka pe ding,' chi peuhmah, huai mi ngei na sikha Isak zi ding a na miseh hi hen. Hiai ah ka pu tung ah hehpihna na langsak, chih ka thei ding," achi hi.
english: Let it happen, that the young lady to whom I will say, ‘Please let down your pitcher, that I may drink,’ then she says, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink,’—let her be the one you have appointed for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, agen khit ma in, ngai in, Abraham nau Nahor zi Milkah tapa Bethuel tanu Rebekah, aliangzang a tuibel pua in ahong kuan hi.
english: Before he had finished speaking, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher on her shoulder.

paite: Huai nungak amel hoih mahmah, nungak siangthou ahi a, pasal himhim akithuahpih ngei kei hi. Tuikhuk ah apaisuk a, atuibel adimsak a, apaitou nawn hi.
english: The young lady was very beautiful to look at, a virgin. No man had known her. She went down to the spring, filled her pitcher, and came up.

paite: Amah tuak ding in sikhapa atai a, "Hehpih in na tuibel a tui tawmchik hon dawnsak dih ve,” achi hi.
english: The servant ran to meet her, and said, “Please give me a drink, a little water from your pitcher.”

paite: Ama'n, “Dawn in, ka toupa," achi a; kintak in akhut in atuibel adomkhesuk a, adawnsak hi.
english: She said, “Drink, my lord.” She hurried, and let down her pitcher on her hand, and gave him a drink.

paite: Adawn nung in, "Na sangawngsaute a ding leng, adawnkham masiah uh ka tawi ding," achi hi.
english: When she had finished giving him a drink, she said, “I will also draw for your camels, until they have finished drinking.”

paite: Kintak in gankuang ah atuibel atei a, tui tawi ding in tuileh lam ah atai nawn a, asangawngsau tengteng a ding leng atawisak hi.
english: She hurried, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.

paite: Sikha in alohchingsak leh sak louh theihna ding in adai dide hi.
english: The man looked steadfastly at her, remaining silent, to know whether Yahweh had made his journey prosperous or not.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hina, sangawngsaute'n adawnkhamtak un, sikha in dangka-eng bilbah shekel kimkhat a gik leh akhut a ding dangka-eng tau nih shekel sawm a gik asuahkhia hi.
english: As the camels had finished drinking, the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold,

paite: Akiang ah, "Kua tanu na hia? Hehpih in hon hilh in. Na pa inn ah ka giahna ding uh mun a-om diam?" achi hi.
english: and said, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me. Is there room in your father’s house for us to stay?”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Bethuel, Milkah tapa, Nahor a ding a aneih- saknu tanu ka hi," achi hi.
english: She said to him, “I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.”

paite: Amah mah in akiang ah, "Buhpawl leh gan an ka hau tuak ua, giahna mun leng ka nei uh," achi hi.
english: She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.”

paite: Sikha in alu akunsak a, TOUPA abia hi.
english: The man bowed his head, and worshiped Yahweh.

paite: "Ka pu tung ngei a azahngaihna leh athutakna tawp ngei lou, TOUPA, ka pu Abraham' Pathian phat in om hen. Kei leng, TOUPA'N ka pu unaute inn lam a hon na pi ahi ve,” achi hi.
english: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master. As for me, Yahweh has led me on the way to the house of my master’s relatives.”

paite: Nungak atai a, huai thute anu inkuanpihte ava hilh hi.
english: The young lady ran, and told her mother’s house about these words.

paite: Rebekah in sanggam pasal anei a, amin Laban ahi. Laban apawtkhia a, tuikhuk lam ah huai mi kiang ah ava tai hi.
english: Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, bilbah leh asanggamnu khut a taute amu a, huai mi'n, "Huchi khachi in ahon chi," chi a, asanggamnu Rebekah thugente azaktak in, huai mi kiang ah ahohta hi. Ngai in, amah tuikhuk ah sangawngsaute kiang ah ana dingh gige hi.
english: When he saw the ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, “This is what the man said to me,” he came to the man. Behold, he was standing by the camels at the spring.

paite: Laban in, "Nang, TOUPA vualzawlpa, hong inla, ka inn uah hong lut in. Bangziak a inpua a dingh nilouh? Inn leh mun sangawngsaute a ding in ka bawl khinta," achi hi.
english: He said, “Come in, you blessed of Yahweh. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.”

paite: Huchi in inn ah alut a, Laban sangawngsau van aphel a; sangawngsaute a ding in buhpawl leh gan an apia a, akhe leh alawmte khe silna ding tui apia hi.
english: The man came into the house, and he unloaded the camels. He gave straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.

paite: Abraham sikha ma ah nek ding alui a; himahleh ama'n, "Ka hong hohna san thu ka gen mateng ka ne kei ding," achi hi. Ama'n, "Gen ve le," achi hi.
english: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.” Laban said, “Speak on.”

paite: Ama'n, "Kei Abraham sikha ka hi.
english: He said, “I am Abraham’s servant.

paite: TOUPA'N ka pu nakpitak in avualzawl a, miliantak ahong hita. TOUPA'N akiang ah belamhon, bawnghon, dangka, dangka-eng, sikhapate, sikhanute, sangawngsaute leh sabiltungte leng apia hi.
english: Yahweh has blessed my master greatly. He has become great. Yahweh has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male servants and female servants, and camels and donkeys.

paite: Ka pu zi Sarah in tek nungpi in ka pu a ding in tapa aneihsak a; akiang ah aneih tengteng ape vek hi.
english: Sarah, my master’s wife, bore a son to my master when she was old. He has given all that he has to him.

paite: Ka pu in, ka tenna gam a Kanaante nungak lak a ka tapa zi ding a na neihsak ding ahi kei.
english: My master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,

paite: Ka pa inn lam ah, ka tanaute kiang ah hoh inla, ka tapa zi na pisak zaw ding ahi, chi in ahon kichiamsak hi."
english: but you shall go to my father’s house, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son.’

paite: Ke'n ka pu kiang ah, "Numei in hon zui nuam kei kha ding," ka chi hi.
english: I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not follow me?’

paite: Ama'n, ka kiang ah, "TOUPA ama a ka om zelnapa'n na kiang ah a-angel ahon sawl ding a; na hohna ding ah hon lohchingsak ding. Ka tapa a ding in ka tanaute leh ka pa inkote lak a zi na neisak ding ahi.
english: He said to me, ‘Yahweh, before whom I walk, will send his angel with you, and prosper your way. You shall take a wife for my son from my relatives, and of my father’s house.

paite: Ka tanaute kiang ngei na tun chiang in, ka kiang a na kichiamna a kipan na siang ding. Nungak ahon piak kei uleh ka kiang a na kichiamna a kipan na siang ding," achi hi.
english: Then you will be clear from my oath, when you come to my relatives. If they don’t give her to you, you shall be clear from my oath.’

paite: "Tuni in tuikhuk ka hong tung a, 'Aw, TOUPA, ka pu Abraham' Pathian, ka paina a na hon lohchinsak dingleh, en in, tuikhuk kiang ah ka dingh hi.'
english: I came today to the spring, and said, ‘Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, if now you do prosper my way which I go—

paite: Hichi hi henla, tui tawi ding a nungak hong kuan kuapeuh kiang a, 'Hehpih in dawn ding na tuibel a tui tawmchik hon pia in,' ka chih a,
english: behold, I am standing by this spring of water. Let it happen, that the maiden who comes out to draw, to whom I will say, “Please give me a little water from your pitcher to drink,”

paite: ama'n ka kiang a, 'Dawn in, na sangawngsaute a ding leng ka tawi ding, chi peuhmah, huai mi ngeingei ka pu tapa a ding a TOUPA numei seh hi hen,' ka chi hi.
english: then she tells me, “Drink, and I will also draw for your camels,”—let her be the woman whom Yahweh has appointed for my master’s son.’

paite: Ka lungsim a ka gen khit ma in, ngai in, Rebekah, atuibel pua in ahong kuan a; tuikhuk ah apaisuk a; tui atawi a; akiang ah, 'Hehpih in tui hon dawnsak dih ve,' ka na chi hi.
english: Before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her pitcher on her shoulder. She went down to the spring, and drew. I said to her, ‘Please let me drink.’

paite: Ama'n kintak in aliangzang a kipan tuibel adomkhia a, 'Dawn in, na sangawngsaute leng dawn ding ka pe ding,' achi hi. Ka dawn a, sangawngsaute leng adawnsak hi.
english: She hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink.’ So I drank, and she also gave the camels a drink.

paite: Ke'n, 'Kua tanu na hia?' chi in ka dong a; ama'n, 'Nahor tapa, Milkah in aneihsakpa Bethuel tanu ka hi,' achi hi. Abil ah bilbah ka batsak a, taute leng akhut ah ka bunsak hi.
english: I asked her, and said, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ She said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bore to him.’ I put the ring on her nose, and the bracelets on her hands.

paite: "Ka lu ka kunsak a, TOUPA ka bia a, TOUPA, ka pu Abraham' Pathian, ka pu sanggampa tanu ngei, atapa a dia azi ding a pisak ding a lampi diktak a hon pipa ka phat hi.
english: I bowed my head, and worshiped Yahweh, and blessed Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter for his son.

paite: Tu in ka pu na hehpih ua, atung a chihtak pet a na hih ding uleh hon hilh un. Na hih kei ding uleh leng hon hilh un. Taklam hiam, veilam hiam, ka nga thei ding," achi hi.
english: Now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. If not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.”

paite: Laban leh Bethuel in adawng ua, "Hiai thil TOUPA a kipan a pawt ahi. Kou na kiang ah asia-apha bangmah ka gen thei kei uh.
english: Then Laban and Bethuel answered, “The thing proceeds from Yahweh. We can’t speak to you bad or good.

paite: En in, na ma ah Rebekah a-om, pi inla, paipih in, TOUPA'N agensa bang in na pu tapa zi ding in om hen," achi uh.
english: Behold, Rebekah is before you. Take her, and go, and let her be your master’s son’s wife, as Yahweh has spoken.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Abraham sikha in athu uh azaktak in lei si in TOUPA abia hi.
english: When Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth to Yahweh.

paite: Abraham sikha in dangka suang kizepnate, dangka- eng kizepnate leh silh-le-ten alakhia a, Rebekah apia a; asanggampa leh anu kiang ah leng thil manpha pipi apia hi.
english: The servant brought out jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing, and gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and her mother.

paite: Amah leh alawmte'n ne in adawn ua, huai ah agiakta uh. Zingsang in athou ua, "Ka pu kiang ah hon paisakta un," achi hi.
english: They ate and drank, he and the men who were with him, and stayed all night. They rose up in the morning, and he said, “Send me away to my master.”

paite: Asanggampa leh anu'n, "Nungak ni sawt lou chik, ni sawm lel bek, ka kiang uah om tadih hen. Huai khit in ahong pai na ding," achi uhi.
english: Her brother and her mother said, “Let the young lady stay with us a few days, at least ten. After that she will go.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hon zekaisak kei dih ua, TOUPA'N lah ka hohna ah ahon lohchingsakta ngal a. Ka pu kiang a ka paitheihna ding in, hon sawl zaw mai ve ua,” achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Don’t hinder me, since Yahweh has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.”

paite: Amau, "Nungak ka sam ding ua, ama kam mahmah kidongleh," achi uhi.
english: They said, “We will call the young lady, and ask her.”

paite: Rebekah asam ua akiang ah, "Hiai mipa kiang ah na pai nuam maw?" achi ua. Ama'n, "Pai nuam ve ning e,” achi hi.
english: They called Rebekah, and said to her, “Will you go with this man?” She said, “I will go.”

paite: Asanggamnu uh Rebekah leh adonnu leh Abraham sikha leh amite akhakheta uhi.
english: They sent away Rebekah, their sister, with her nurse, Abraham’s servant, and his men.

paite: Huan Rebekah avualzawl ua, akiang ah, "Ka sanggamnu uh aw, nang, sing ngenta sang tampite nu hong hi in! Na suante'n amau hote kulh kongkhak neihsak uhen!" achi uhi.
english: They blessed Rebekah, and said to her, “Our sister, may you be the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let your offspring possess the gate of those who hate them.”

paite: Rebekah athou a, asikhanute toh sangawngsaute tung ah atuang ua, huai mi azuita uhi. Abraham sikha in Rebekah api a, apaita uhi.
english: Rebekah arose with her ladies. They rode on the camels, and followed the man. The servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

paite: Huan Beer-lahai-roi tuikhuk lam a kipan Isak ahong a, amah sim gam a teng ahi.
english: Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South.

paite: Nitaklam in loubuk ah kingaihtuah ding in Isak apawtkhia hi. Adak a, a-en a, ngai in, sangawngsau hong paite amu hi.
english: Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the evening. He lifted up his eyes and looked. Behold, there were camels coming.

paite: Rebekah adak a, Isak amuhtak in sangawngsau tung a kipan akumkhia hi.
english: Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she got off the camel.

paite: Sikhapa kiang ah, "Gamlak anhon dawn ding a hong pai kua ahia?" achi a; sikha in, "Ka pu ahi,” achi hi. Kikhuhna puan ala a, akikhuhta hi.
english: She said to the servant, “Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us?” The servant said, “It is my master.” She took her veil, and covered herself.

paite: Sikha in athilhih tengteng Isak ahilh hi.
english: The servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.

paite: Isak in anu Sarah puanin ah apilut a, Rebekah ala a, azi ahong hita hi. Amah a-it a, anu sih nung Isak khamuang in a-omta hi.
english: Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife. He loved her. So Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.

paite: Huan Abraham in zi dang anei nawn a, amin Keturah ahi.
english: Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.

paite: Ama'n Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak leh Shuah aneihsak hi.
english: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.

paite: Jokshan in tapa Sheba leh Dedan anei a, Dedan tapate Asshurim leh Letushim leh Leummim ahi uh.
english: Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.

paite: Midian tapate Ephah, Epher, Hanok, Abidah leh Eldaah ahi uh. Huai tengteng Keturah tate ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

paite: Abraham in aneih tengteng Isak apia hi.
english: Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac,

paite: Amei tapate kiang ah Abraham in thilpiakte apia a; amah dam lai ngei in atapa Isak a kipan amaute suahlam gam ah asawlkhia hi.
english: but Abraham gave gifts to the sons of Abraham’s concubines. While he still lived, he sent them away from Isaac his son, eastward, to the east country.

paite: Abraham damsung kum zakhat sawmsagih-le-nga ahi.
english: These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.

paite: Abraham in akha akhahta a, lu a kelsam pou vek in tekkun a dam in asi a, achipihte kiang a pi in a-omta hi.
english: Abraham gave up his spirit, and died at a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.

paite: Atapa Isak leh Ishmael in Hit mi Zohar tapa Ephron lou a, Mamre phak ma a Makpelah kokhuk ah avui uhi.
english: Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is near Mamre,

paite: Huai lou, Abraham in Heth suante a pan aleisa ahi a, huai mun ah azi Sarah kiang ah Abraham vui in a-om hi.
english: the field which Abraham purchased from the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Abraham sih nung in, Pathian in atapa Isak avualzawl a; Beer-lahai-roi ah Isak ateng hi.
english: After the death of Abraham, God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.

paite: Hiaite Abraham tapa Ishmael, Sarah sikhanu, Aigupta mi Hagar in Abraham aneihsak suante ahi uh.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant, bore to Abraham.

paite: Hiaite amin chiat uleh asuante uh dungzui zel in Ishmael tapate min ahi. Ishmael tapa upapen Nebajoth ahi a, huai ban ah Kedar, Adbeel leh Mibsam,
english: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to the order of their birth: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

paite: Mishma, Dumah leh Massa,
english: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,

paite: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish leh Kedemah ahi uh.
english: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.

paite: Huaite Ishmael tapate ahi ua, huaite akhua uh bang leh agiahphual uh dungzui zel a amin uh gelh ahi a, anam uh bang zel in vaihawmmi sawm-le-nih ahi uhi.
english: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments: twelve princes, according to their nations.

paite: Ishmael damsung kum zakhat sawmthum-le-sagih ahi a; akha khah in asi a, achipihte kiang ah pi in a-omta hi.
english: These are the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred thirty-seven years. He gave up his spirit and died, and was gathered to his people.

paite: Atapate Havilah gam a kipan Assuria gam lam a Aigupta gam phak ma a Shur tan in ateng ua, a-unau dang teng a kipan atuamten uhi.
english: They lived from Havilah to Shur that is before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria. He lived opposite all his relatives.

paite: Hiaite Abraham tapa Isak suante ahi ua: Abraham in tapa Isak anei hi.
english: This is the history of the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son. Abraham became the father of Isaac.

paite: Isak in Padan-aram gam a Siria mi Bethuel tanu, Aram mi Laban sanggamnu Rebekah zi a aneih lai in kum sawmli a upa ahi.
english: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.

paite: Azi achiin ziak in Isak in TOUPA kiang ah azi a ding in nget petmah in angetsak hi. TOUPA'N angetna angaihkhiaksak a, azi Rebekah ahong gaita hi.
english: Isaac entreated Yahweh for his wife, because she was barren. Yahweh was entreated by him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

paite: Asung a anaupaite akisual ua; ama'n, "Hichibang ahih ngalleh, bangziak in ahia, ka hi chih?" achi a; TOUPA dong ding in akuanta hi.
english: The children struggled together within her. She said, “If it is like this, why do I live?” She went to inquire of Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'n akiang ah, "Na sul ah nam nih a-om ua, na gilsung a kipan nam nih akikhen ding uh, nam khat sang in nam khat ahatzaw ding a, a-upazaw in anaupangzaw nna asem ding,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to her, “Two nations are in your womb. Two peoples will be separated from your body. The one people will be stronger than the other people. The elder will serve the younger.”

paite: Anau neih ahun in, ngai in, asul ah phik a-om hi.
english: When her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

paite: Amasazaw asan a san seksawk, puanmul bang a mul thiapthuap in ahong suakkhia a, amin Esau asa uhi.
english: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.

paite: Huai nung in anau hong suakkhe nawn a, akhut in Esau khetul alenkip a; ama min Jakob asa uhi. Rebekah in amaute aneih lai in Isak kum sawmguk a upa ahi.
english: After that, his brother came out, and his hand had hold on Esau’s heel. He was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.

paite: Naupangte hong khanglian ua; Esau sabetsiam, gamvakmi ahi a; Jakob mimelmawl, puaninte a tengmi ahi.
english: The boys grew. Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field. Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.

paite: Isak in asamatte anek zel ziak in Esau a-it a; Rebekah in bel Jakob a-it hi.
english: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he ate his venison. Rebekah loved Jacob.

paite: Jakob in betang ahuan laitak in Esau gamkuan ahong tung a, atawl mahmah hi.
english: Jacob boiled stew. Esau came in from the field, and he was famished.

paite: Esau in Jakob kiang ah, "Hehpih in na betang huan hon nesak in; ka bah mahmah hi,” achi hi. Huaiziak in ahi amin Edom achih uh.
english: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with some of that red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom.

paite: Jakob in, "Na ta masa hihna hon leisak phot lechin,” achi hi.
english: Jacob said, “First, sell me your birthright.”

paite: Esau in, "Ngai in, si dek ka hi ngal a; kei a ding in hiai ta masa hihna bang aphatuam dia?" achi hi.
english: Esau said, “Behold, I am about to die. What good is the birthright to me?”

paite: Jakob in, "Tuni in ka kiang ah kichiam phot in,” achi hi. Akiang ah akichiam a, Jakob kiang ah ata masa hihna akhawng maimah hi.
english: Jacob said, “Swear to me first.” He swore to him. He sold his birthright to Jacob.

paite: Jakob in Esau tanghou leh abetang huan apia a; ama'n ne in adawn a, athou a, apaikheta hi. Huchibang in Esau in ata masa hihna angaineu hi.
english: Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew. He ate and drank, rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.

paite: Huan Abraham dam lai a kial ke masapen chih louh, huai gam ah kial ahong ke nawn a, Philistiate kumpipa Abimelek kiang ah Gerar ah Isak ava hohsuk hi.
english: There was a famine in the land, in addition to the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines, to Gerar.

paite: Akiang ah TOUPA ahong kilak a, "Aigupta gam ah hohsuk ke'n. K'on hilh ding gam ah teng in.
english: Yahweh appeared to him, and said, “Don’t go down into Egypt. Live in the land I will tell you about.

paite: Hiai gam ah om tadih inla, na kiang ah ka om ding a, ka hon vualzawl ding hi. Hiai gam tengteng nang kiang leh na suante kiang a pia in, na pa Abraham kiang a ka kichiamna ka hihkip ding hi.
english: Live in this land, and I will be with you, and will bless you. For I will give to you, and to your offspring, all these lands, and I will establish the oath which I swore to Abraham your father.

paite: Van a aksi zah in na suante ka pungsak ding hiai gam tengteng na suante kiang ah ka pe lai ding hi. Na suan ah leitung a nam tengteng vualzawl in a-om ding uh.
english: I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and will give all these lands to your offspring. In your offspring all the nations of the earth will be blessed,

paite: "Abraham in ka thu amang a, ka thuhilhte, ka thupiakte, ka dan thusehte leh ka dante azuih ziak in," achi hi.
english: because Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my requirements, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.”

paite: Huchi in Gerar ah Isak ateng hi.
english: Isaac lived in Gerar.

paite: Huai khua a mite'n azi tungtang adong ua; ama'n, "Ka sanggamnu ahi,” achi hi. Amel ahoih ziak in hiai khua a mite'n Rebekah ziak in hon that kha ding uh, chi in "Ka zi ahi," achi ngamta kei hi.
english: The men of the place asked him about his wife. He said, “She is my sister,” for he was afraid to say, “My wife”, lest, he thought, “the men of the place might kill me for Rebekah, because she is beautiful to look at.”

paite: Hichi a, huai a sawtpi a-om nung in, Philistiate kumpipa Abimelek in tohlet a kipan a-en a, ngai in, Isak in azi Rebekah athoh lai amuta hi.
english: When he had been there a long time, Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was caressing Rebekah, his wife.

paite: Abimelek in Isak asam a, "Ngai in, amah na zi ahi mah vele. Bangziak a ka sanggamnu ahi, chi maimah na hia?" achi hi. Isak in akiang ah, "Amah ziak in ka si kha ding ka chih ziak ahi," achi hi.
english: Abimelech called Isaac, and said, “Behold, surely she is your wife. Why did you say, ‘She is my sister’?” Isaac said to him, “Because I said, ‘Lest I die because of her.’”

paite: Abimelek in, "Ka tung ua na thilhih bangchidan ahia? Mite lak a mi kuapeuh in na zi kithuahpih kha thei uh akei maw, ka tung uah siamlouhna na hon tungsak dek vele," achi hi.
english: Abimelech said, “What is this you have done to us? One of the people might easily have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt on us!”

paite: Abimelek mah in, "Kuapeuh hiai mi hiam, azi hiam, khoih, hihlup ngeingei ding ahi," chi in mi tengteng thu apia hi.
english: Abimelech commanded all the people, saying, “He who touches this man or his wife will surely be put to death.”

paite: Isak in huai gam ah buh aching a, huai kum in aleh za anei a, TOUPA'N avualzawl hi.
english: Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. Yahweh blessed him.

paite: Ahong thupi mahmah a, nakpitak a mithupi hong suak hial in ahong lian huaihuai hi.
english: The man grew great, and grew more and more until he became very great.

paite: Belamhon leh bawnghon anei a, inkuan leng tampi anei a, huaiziak in Philistiate'n amah ahaza uhi.
english: He had possessions of flocks, possessions of herds, and a great household. The Philistines envied him.

paite: Apa Abraham dam lai a, apa sikhate'n tuileh atoh tengteng uh Philistiate'n ahudim ua, lei in ahihdim vek uhi.
english: Now all the wells which his father’s servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped, and filled with earth.

paite: Abimelek in Isak kiang ah, "Ka kiang ua kipan paimang in, kou sang in lah na hatzaw ngal a,” achi hi.
english: Abimelech said to Isaac, “Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we.”

paite: Huai a kipan Isak apawtkhia a, Gerar Phaizang ah puanin akai a, huai ah atengta hi.
english: Isaac departed from there, encamped in the valley of Gerar, and lived there.

paite: Isak in apa Abraham dam lai a tuileh atohte uh atou nawn a; Abraham sih nung in Philistiate'n lah ana hudim vek ngal ua. Apa'n amin ana sak bangbang in amin asa chiat hi.
english: Isaac dug again the wells of water, which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father, for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham. He called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

paite: Isak sikhate'n phaizang ah atou ua, huai ah tuileh nak nei amu uhi.
english: Isaac’s servants dug in the valley, and found there a well of flowing water.

paite: Gerar a ganpute'n, “Kou tui ahi," chi in Isak ganpute toh akisel ua, amah toh akisel ziak un tuileh min Eshek asata hi.
english: The herdsmen of Gerar argued with Isaac’s herdsmen, saying, “The water is ours.” So he called the name of the well Esek, because they contended with him.

paite: Tuileh dang atou nawn ua; huai leng tuhkhiak tum in akiselpih nawn zel ua; amin Sitnah asa hi.
english: They dug another well, and they argued over that, also. So he called its name Sitnah.

paite: Huai a kipan akisuan a, tuileh dang atou nawn hi. Huai ahihleh tuhkhiak tum in asubuai nawn ngal kei uhi. Tu in, “TOUPA'N mun lianpi ahon bawlsakta a, hiai gam ah chi tampi i suang ding uh," chi in amin Rehoboth asa hi.
english: He left that place, and dug another well. They didn’t argue over that one. So he called it Rehoboth. He said, “For now Yahweh has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land.”

paite: Huai a kipan Beer-sheba ah ahohtou hi.
english: He went up from there to Beersheba.

paite: Huai zan mah in akiang ah TOUPA akilak a, “Kei, na pa Abraham' Pathian ka hi. Lau ke'n, na kiang ah ka om hi. Ka hon vualzawl ding a, ka sikha Abraham ziak a na suante pungsak ding ka hi," achi hi.
english: Yahweh appeared to him the same night, and said, “I am the God of Abraham your father. Don’t be afraid, for I am with you, and will bless you, and multiply your offspring for my servant Abraham’s sake.”

paite: Huai mun ah maitam adoh a, TOUPA min alou a, huai ah apuanin leng akai hi. Isak sikhate'n huai ah tuileh atou nawn uhi.
english: He built an altar there, and called on Yahweh’s name, and pitched his tent there. There Isaac’s servants dug a well.

paite: Gerar a kipan Abimelek, alawm Ahuzzath leh sepaih pawl heutu Phikol toh akiang ah ahoh uhi.
english: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar with Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his army.

paite: Isak in akiang ah, "N'on ngai kei ua, na kiang ua pan na hon paimangsak ngal ua, bangchidan in ahia ka kiang a na hong pai uh?" achi hi.
english: Isaac said to them, “Why have you come to me, since you hate me, and have sent me away from you?”

paite: Amau, "Na kiang ah TOUPA a-om chih chiantak in ka thei ua, i kikal uah, kou leh nangmah kikal ah kichiam in thu i khung ding uh.
english: They said, “We saw plainly that Yahweh was with you. We said, ‘Let there now be an oath between us, even between us and you, and let’s make a covenant with you,

paite: Na zakdah ka hih ngei louh bang ua, thil hoih kia lou ngal na tung a ka hih louh ua, hoihtak a ka hon paimangsak bang un; nang leng ka siatna ding himhim uh na hihlouhna ding in. Tu in nang TOUPA vualzawl na hita," achi uhi.
english: that you will do us no harm, as we have not touched you, and as we have done to you nothing but good, and have sent you away in peace.’ You are now the blessed of Yahweh.”

paite: Huan amaute a ding in ankuang aluisak a, ne in adawn uhi.
english: He made them a feast, and they ate and drank.

paite: Zingsang in beltak in athou ua, akichiamtuah uhi. Isak in amau apaisak a, akiang a kipan khamuangtak in apawtta uhi.
english: They rose up some time in the morning, and swore an oath to one another. Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai ni mah in Isak sikhate ahong pai ua, tuileh toh thu ahong hilh ua, akiang ah, “Tui ka muta uh," achi uhi.
english: The same day, Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had dug, and said to him, “We have found water.”

paite: Ama'n huai tuileh Shebah asa hi. Huaiziak in tutan in huai kho min Beer-sheba akichi lai hi.
english: He called it “Shibah”. Therefore the name of the city is “Beersheba” to this day.

paite: Esau kum sawmli a upa ahih in, Hit mi Beeri tanu Judith leh Hit mi Elon tanu Basemath zi in anei hi.
english: When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite.

paite: Huaite Isak leh Rebekah lunggimnate ahi uhi.
english: They grieved Isaac’s and Rebekah’s spirits.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Isak hong tek a, kho mu thei lou khop in amit ahong mialta hi. Atapa upazaw Esau asam a, akiang ah, "Ka tapa," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Hiai ah ka om,” achi hi.
english: When Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said to him, “My son?” He said to him, “Here I am.”

paite: Ama'n, "Ngai in, ka tek mahmahta a, ka sih ni ding lah ka thei kei hi.
english: He said, “See now, I am old. I don’t know the day of my death.

paite: Tu in hehpih in na vanzat, na thaltang leh na thalpeu tawi in, va gamvak inla, sa hon va matsak in.
english: Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field, and get me venison.

paite: Ka sih ma a ka hon vualzawl theihna ding in, ka duh lamtak in meh ding in limtak hon bawlsak inla, ka nek ding in ka kiang ah hon tawi in,” achi hi.
english: Make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat, and that my soul may bless you before I die.”

paite: Isak in atapa Esau ahoupih lai Rebekah in ana za hi. Sa beng a hon po ding in Esau agamvakta hi.
english: Rebekah heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.

paite: Rebekah in atapa Jakob kiang ah, "Ngai in, na pa'n na u Esau kiang a athugen ka za.
english: Rebekah spoke to Jacob her son, saying, “Behold, I heard your father speak to Esau your brother, saying,

paite: Sa hon puak inla, ka nek a ka sih ma a TOUPA ma a ka hon vualzawlna ding in, meh limtak hon bawlsak in, chi ahi.
english: ‘Bring me venison, and make me savory food, that I may eat, and bless you before Yahweh before my death.’

paite: Ka tapa, tu in ka hon thupiak bang in ka thu zui in.
english: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command you.

paite: Ganhon lak ah va hoh inla, kelnou nih hoihtak, huai a kipan hon la in. Aduh lamtak in na pa a ding in meh limtak in huai ka na bawl ding.
english: Go now to the flock and get me two good young goats from there. I will make them savory food for your father, such as he loves.

paite: Asih ma a hon vualzawlsak ding in, anek ding in na pa kiang ah na va paipih ding ahi,” achi hi.
english: You shall bring it to your father, that he may eat, so that he may bless you before his death.”

paite: Jakob in anu Rebekah kiang ah, "Ngai in, ka u Esau mimulhau ahi a, kei lah minel ka hi.
english: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, “Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.

paite: Ka pa'n hon na zawt vialvial kha ding a, amah a ding in khempa ka hong hi dia, vualzawl gen tak louh hamsiat kizon lel ka hi kei ding maw," achi hi.
english: What if my father touches me? I will seem to him as a deceiver, and I would bring a curse on myself, and not a blessing.”

paite: Anu'n akiang ah, "Ka tapa, ka tung ah na hamsiat muh ding tung hen. Ka thu zui inla, hon va lak in," achi hi.
english: His mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my son. Only obey my voice, and go get them for me.”

paite: Huchi in akuan a, ava la a, anu kiang ah apaipihta hi. Anu'n apa duh lamtak in meh limtak abawl hi.
english: He went, and got them, and brought them to his mother. His mother made savory food, such as his father loved.

paite: Rebekah in atapa upapen Esau puansilh hoihtak, akiang a inn a om ala a, atapa naupangzaw Jakob asilhsak hi.
english: Rebekah took the good clothes of Esau, her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob, her younger son.

paite: Huai ban ah kelnou vun leng akhut leh angawng nelna munte ah aphah hi.
english: She put the skins of the young goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck.

paite: Meh limtak leh tanghou abawlte atapa Jakob khut ah apia hi.
english: She gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

paite: Amah apa kiang ah ava pai a, "Pa aw," achi a; ama'n, “Hiai ah ka om, ka tapa, akua zaw pen na hia?" achi hi.
english: He came to his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am. Who are you, my son?”

paite: Jakob in apa kiang ah, "Na tapa upazaw Esau ka hi; na hon sawl bang in ka hih khinta. Hehpih in thou inla, hon vualzawl ding in tu inla, ka samatsa ne in," achi hi.
english: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau your firstborn. I have done what you asked me to do. Please arise, sit and eat of my venison, that your soul may bless me.”

paite: Isak in atapa kiang ah, "Ka tapa, bangchidan ahia, hong man baih na tel chia?" achi a. Ama'n, “TOUPA na Pathian in ahon lohchinsak ziak ahi," achi hi.
english: Isaac said to his son, “How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?” He said, “Because Yahweh your God gave me success.”

paite: Isak in Jakob kiang ah, “Ka tapa, hehpih in hong pai nai dih, ka hon zawt vialvial ding, ka tapa Esau na hi na hiam," achi hi.
english: Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not.”

paite: Jakob in apa Isak ava naih a; ama'n ana zawt vialvial a, "A-aw Jakob aw hiven, akhutte lah Esau khutte hiven," achi hi.
english: Jacob went near to Isaac his father. He felt him, and said, “The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”

paite: A-u Esau khut abang a, akhut amul ziak in amah atheitel kei hi. Huchi in amah avualzawlta hi.
english: He didn’t recognize him, because his hands were hairy, like his brother Esau’s hands. So he blessed him.

paite: "Ka tapa Esau ngei na hi maw?" achi a; ama'n, "Hi e," achi hi.
english: He said, “Are you really my son Esau?” He said, “I am.”

paite: Ama'n, "Hon tawi nai in, ka hon vualzawlna ding in ka tapa samatsa ka ne ding," achi hi. Ahon tawi nai a, aneta a, uain leng ahon la a, huai leng adawn hi.
english: He said, “Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless you.” He brought it near to him, and he ate. He brought him wine, and he drank.

paite: Apa Isak in akiang ah, "Ka tapa hong pai nai in, hon tawp in," achi hi.
english: His father Isaac said to him, “Come near now, and kiss me, my son.”

paite: Ava naih a, atawp a, ama'n apuansilh gim aza a, avuałzawl hi. "En in, ka tapa gim TOUPA vualzawl gam gim bang ahi.
english: He came near, and kissed him. He smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him, and said, “Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which Yahweh has blessed.

paite: Pathian in van daitui, lei hoihna, buh tampi leh uain tampi hon pia hen.
english: God give you of the dew of the sky, of the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and new wine.

paite: Namte'n na nna sem uhenla, na ma ah namte kun uhen. Na unaute tung ah toupa in om inla; na nu tapate na ma ah kun uhen. Hon hamsiatte hamsiat in om uhenla, hon vualzawl peuhmah vualzawl in om hen," achi hi.
english: Let peoples serve you, and nations bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers. Let your mother’s sons bow down to you. Cursed be everyone who curses you. Blessed be everyone who blesses you.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Isak in Jakob avualzawl zohtak in, apa Isak kiang a kipan Jakob a pawtkhe man lel chih in a-unaupa, Esau sabeng ahong tung hi.
english: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and Jacob had just gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

paite: Ama'n leng meh limtak abawl a, apa kiang ah, "Ka pa aw, hong thoukhia inla, na hon vualzawl theihna ding in na tapa samatsa neta in le," achi hi.
english: He also made savory food, and brought it to his father. He said to his father, “Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that your soul may bless me.”

paite: Apa Isak in akiang ah, "Kua na hia?" achi a; ama'n, "Na tapa, na tapa upazaw, Esau ka hi," achi hi.
english: Isaac his father said to him, “Who are you?” He said, “I am your son, your firstborn, Esau.”

paite: Isak nakpi in aling zungzung a, "Sa va man a, ka kiang a, asa hon tawi, na hong tun ma a, ka na nek khit a, ka vualzawlpa kua ahia? Ahi, amah vualzawl in a-om ding,” achi hi.
english: Isaac trembled violently, and said, “Who, then, is he who has taken venison, and brought it to me, and I have eaten of all before you came, and have blessed him? Yes, he will be blessed.”

paite: Esau in apa thugen azak in nakpitak leh khase mahmah in akapta a, apa kiang ah, “Pa aw, hon vualzawl in, kei leng hon vualzawl mahmah ve aw," achi hi.
english: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceedingly great and bitter cry, and said to his father, “Bless me, even me also, my father.”

paite: Ama'n, “Na nau in ahong khem a, na vualzawlnate ahong laksakta," achi hi.
english: He said, “Your brother came with deceit, and has taken away your blessing.”

paite: Ama'n, “Amin Jakob achih uh dik mahmah hilou hia? Nihvei ahon suanta; ka ta masa hihna ahon laksak a; ngai in, tu in ka vualzawlna ahon laksak nawnta,” achi hi. Amah mah in, "Kei a dia vualzawlna hon sitsak lou maw?" achi hi.
english: He said, “Isn’t he rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times. He took away my birthright. See, now he has taken away my blessing.” He said, “Haven’t you reserved a blessing for me?”

paite: Isak in adawng a, Esau kiang ah, "Ngai in, amah na toupa in ka bawlta, a-unau tengteng leng asikha ding in akiang ah ka pe vekta, buh leh uain in leng ka vakta hi. Nang a ding in, ka tapa, bang hon hihsak ding ka hia?" achi hi.
english: Isaac answered Esau, “Behold, I have made him your lord, and all his brothers I have given to him for servants. I have sustained him with grain and new wine. What then will I do for you, my son?”

paite: Esau in apa kiang ah, "Pa aw, vualzawlna khat kia ahi maw na neih? Pa aw, kei leng hon vualzawl mahmah ve," chi in ngaihtak in akapta hi.
english: Esau said to his father, “Do you have just one blessing, my father? Bless me, even me also, my father.” Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

paite: Huan apa Isak in adawng a, akiang ah, "Ngai in, na tenna ding lei hoihna tak, tunglam a kipan van daitui kiakna mun ahi ding.
english: Isaac his father answered him, “Behold, your dwelling will be of the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of the sky from above.

paite: Na namsau in ahi na hin ding, himahleh na nau nna na sem ding hi. Hichi ahong hi ding a, na kitutkhiak hun chiang in na ngawng a kipan ahakkol na singkheta ding," achi hi.
english: You will live by your sword, and you will serve your brother. It will happen, when you will break loose, that you will shake his yoke from off your neck.”

paite: Apa'n Jakob avualzawl ziak in Esau in amudah hi. Esau in alungsim in, "Ka pa suun ni ding anaita a, huai khit chiang in ka nau Jakob ka that mai ding,” achi hi.
english: Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him. Esau said in his heart, “The days of mourning for my father are at hand. Then I will kill my brother Jacob.”

paite: Atapa upazaw Esau thugen Rebekah ahilh ua; ama'n mi asawl a, atapa naupangzaw Jakob asam a, akiang ah, "Ngai in, na u Esau in na tungthu ah, nang hon thah tum in akikhamuan hi.
english: The words of Esau, her elder son, were told to Rebekah. She sent and called Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, “Behold, your brother Esau comforts himself about you by planning to kill you.

paite: Huaiziak in ka tapa, tu in ka thu mang in. Thou inla, Haran a ka sanggampa Laban kiang ah va tai in.
english: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Laban, my brother, in Haran.

paite: Na u hehna adaih mateng akiang ah ni bangzah hiam va om tadih in;
english: Stay with him a few days, until your brother’s fury turns away—

paite: na u hehna na tung a adaih a, atung a na thilhih amangngilh mateng. Huai chiang mi ka hon sawl ding a, huai a kipan ka hong pikhesak ding. Bangziak a ni khat thu a na nih ua hon chan tel gaode ding ka hia?" achi hi.
english: until your brother’s anger turns away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send, and get you from there. Why should I be bereaved of you both in one day?”

paite: Rebekah in Isak kiang ah, "Heth tanute ziak in hin ka chimtak mahmah. Jakob in hiai gam nungak, hiai Heth tanute lak a mi zi ding a aneih nawn ngial in zaw, kei a ding in hin bang phatuam ding ahia?" achi hi.
english: Rebekah said to Isaac, “I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good will my life do me?”

paite: Huan Isak in Jakob asam a, avualzawl a, thu leng apia a akiang ah, "Kanaan gam nungakte lak a mi zi in na nei ding ahi kei.
english: Isaac called Jacob, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

paite: Thou inla, Padan-aram gam a na nu pa Bethuel inn ah hoh inla, huai a kipan na nu sanggampa Laban tanute lak a mi zi in va nei in.
english: Arise, go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father. Take a wife from there from the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.

paite: Pathian Bangkim hihthei in hon vualzawl in, mipi tampite na hong hihtheihna ding in chi tampi hon suangsak in, hon pungsak hen.
english: May God Almighty bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, that you may be a company of peoples,

paite: Mikhual na hihna gam, Pathian in Abraham kiang a apiak na luahna ding in Abraham vualzawlna leng hon tangsak hen, nang leh na suante leng," achi hi.
english: and give you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to your offspring with you, that you may inherit the land where you travel, which God gave to Abraham.”

paite: Huchi in Isak in Jakob asawlkhia hi. Huan ama'n Padan-aram gam a, Jakob leh Esau nu Rebekah sanggampa Siria mi Bethuel tapa, Laban kiang azuanta hi.
english: Isaac sent Jacob away. He went to Paddan Aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.

paite: Esau in, Isak in Jakob avualzawl a zi nei ding in Padan-aram gam ah asawlkhia, chih leh avualzawl lai a, Kanaan gam nungakte lak a mi zi in na nei ding ahi kei,
english: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan Aram, to take him a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he gave him a command, saying, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;”

paite: chi in thu apia chih leh Jakob in anu leh apa thu mang in Padan-aram gam ah apaita chih athei hi.
english: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan Aram.

paite: Esau in Kanaan gam nungakte'n apa Isak lung ahihkim kei uh chih athei hi.
english: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn’t please Isaac, his father.

paite: Ishmael kiang ah Esau ava hoh a, Abraham tapa Ishmael tanu, Nebajoth sanggamnu Mahalath, zi in anei a, zi aneihsate ban ah amah aneih behlap ahi.
english: So Esau went to Ishmael, and took, in addition to the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.

paite: Beer-sheba a kipan Jakob apawt a, Haran kholam azuanta hi.
english: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.

paite: Koi lai mun hiam atung a, ni atum tak ziak in huai ah agiakta hi. Huai ah suang khat ala a; lukham in anei a, huai ah ihmu ding in alumta hi.
english: He came to a certain place, and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. He took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.

paite: Mang anei a, ngai in, leitung ah lei ahong kidoh a, adawn in van asun hi. Ngai in, atung ah Pathian angelte kahtou in akumsuk uhi.
english: He dreamed and saw a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.

paite: Ngai in, adawn ah TOUPA adingh a, "Kei TOUPA, na pu Abraham' Pathian leh Isak' Pathian ka hi. Na lupna gam nang leh na suante kiang ah ka hon pe ding.
english: Behold, Yahweh stood above it, and said, “I am Yahweh, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac. I will give the land you lie on to you and to your offspring.

paite: Na suante lei a leivui zah a tam ahi ding ua, tumlam, suahlam, mallam leh simlam ah na dalhzak ding uh. Nang ah leh na suan ah leitung a inkuan chih vualzawl in a-om ding uh.
english: Your offspring will be as the dust of the earth, and you will spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. In you and in your offspring, all the families of the earth will be blessed.

paite: Ngai in, na kiang ah ka om, na paina peuh ah ka hon veng ding a, hiai gam ah ka hon pikik nawn ding. Na kiang a ka gen ka hih masak keileh ka hon nuse kei ding,” achi hi.
english: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”

paite: Jakob ihmu ahong khanglou a, "Hiai mun ah TOUPA a-om ngeingei hi. Ke'n lah ka na thei kei a,” achi hi.
english: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely Yahweh is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”

paite: Huchi in alau a, "Hiai mun lauhuai hi na mai e! Hiai mun dang hilou in, Pathian inn na hi ei ve, hiai van kongpi na hi ei ve,” achi hi.
english: He was afraid, and said, “How awesome this place is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.”

paite: Zingkhang in Jakob athou a, asuang lukham ala a, suangphuh in aphut a, adawn ah sathau abuak hi.
english: Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil on its top.

paite: Huai mun min Bethel asa a; akho min bel atung in Luz ahi.
english: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.

paite: Jakob in, "Pathian ka kiang a om a, ka paina lampi a ahon ven a, nek ding tanghou leh silh ding puansilh TOUPA'N ahon piak a,
english: Jacob vowed a vow, saying, “If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and clothing to put on,

paite: ka pa inn a lungmuangtak a ka hong pai nawnleh TOUPA, ka Pathian ahi ding a,
english: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, and Yahweh will be my God,

paite: hiai suang ka phuh leng Pathian' inn ahi ding a; ka kiang a na hon piak ding tengteng a kipan sawm-a-khat ka hon pe ngeingei ding," chi in akichiamta hi.
english: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God’s house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you.”

paite: Huai nung in Jakob apai zel a, suahlam mite gam atungta hi.
english: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.

paite: Huan a-etleh ngai in, gamlak ah tuileh ana om a, akiang ah belamhon thum akual uhi. Huai tuileh a kipan belamhonte, tui adawnsak uhi. Tuileh kong a suang om alian mahmah hi.
english: He looked, and saw a well in the field, and saw three flocks of sheep lying there by it. For out of that well they watered the flocks. The stone on the well’s mouth was large.

paite: Huai ah belamhon tengteng apaikhawm ua; tuileh kong a kipan suang akhuksuan ua, tuileh kong a, a-omna ngei ah suang akoih nawn uhi.
english: There all the flocks were gathered. They rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone back on the well’s mouth in its place.

paite: Jakob in akiang uah, "Ka unaute aw, koilam mi na hi ua?” achi hi. Amau, "Haran khomi ka hi uh," achi uh.
english: Jacob said to them, “My relatives, where are you from?” They said, “We are from Haran.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Nahor tapa Laban na thei kha uhia?" achi a; amau, "Thei e,” achi uhi.
english: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?” They said, “We know him.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Dam lai ahi na maw?" achi a; amau, "Dam lai mah e, en in, atanu, Rakil leng belamte pi ding in ahong kuan," achi uhi.
english: He said to them, “Is it well with him?” They said, “It is well. See, Rachel, his daughter, is coming with the sheep.”

paite: Ama'n, "Ngai un, ni asang lai mahmah ngal a, ganhonte pikhawm leng ahun nai kei. Belamte tui dawnsak unla, va khah lai un," achi hi.
english: He said, “Behold, it is still the middle of the day, not time to gather the livestock together. Water the sheep, and go and feed them.”

paite: Amau, "Ka hihthei kei ding uh, belamhon tengteng apikhawm ua, tuileh kong a kipan suang a khuksuan mateng uh. Huai khit chiang in belamte tui ka dawnsak zel uh," achi uhi.
english: They said, “We can’t, until all the flocks are gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well’s mouth. Then we will water the sheep.”

paite: Amau ahoupih lai in Rakil, apa belamte toh ahong tung a; ama'n huai belamte achin zel ahi.
english: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she kept them.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jakob in anu sanggampa Laban tanu Rakil leh anu sanggampa Laban belamhon amuh in ava naih a, tuileh kong a kipan suang akhuksuan a, anu sanggampa belamte tui adawnsak hi.
english: When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother, Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.

paite: Jakob in Rakil atawp a, ngaihtak in akapta hi.
english: Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

paite: Jakob in apa tanau nai leh Rebekah tapa ahihdan Rakil ahilh hi. Rakil atai a, apa ava hilhta hi.
english: Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s relative, and that he was Rebekah’s son. She ran and told her father.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Laban in asanggamnu tapa Jakob tanchin azaktak in, amah dawn ding in atai a, apom a, atawp a, a-inn ah apita hi. Jakob in hiai thu tengteng Laban ahilh hi.
english: When Laban heard the news of Jacob, his sister’s son, he ran to meet Jacob, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. Jacob told Laban all these things.

paite: Laban in akiang ah, "Ka guh mah leh ka sa mah na hi,” achi hi. Huchi in akiang ah kha khat ataam hi.
english: Laban said to him, “Surely you are my bone and my flesh.” Jacob stayed with him for a month.

paite: Huan Laban in Jakob kiang ah, "Ka tupa na hih ziak in amawk in ka nna na sem dia hia? Bang na loh dia? Hon hilh in," achi hi.
english: Laban said to Jacob, “Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?”

paite: Laban in tanu nih anei a; a-upazaw min Leah ahi a, anaupangzaw min Rakil ahi.
english: Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

paite: Leah mit anou a, Rakil bel chinou hoihtak ahi a, amel leng ahoih mahmah hi.
english: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.

paite: Jakob in Rakil a-it a, "Na tanu naupangzaw Rakil toh kiteng ding in kum sagih nang nna ka hon sepsak ding," achi hi.
english: Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”

paite: Laban in, “Amah ahihleh midang kiang a ka piak sang in nang kiang a ka piak mah ahoihzaw ve. Ka kiang ah om nilouh in," achi hi.
english: Laban said, “It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.”

paite: Jakob in Rakil kitenpih ding in kum sagih a-nna asepsakta hi. Himahleh Rakil a-it mahmah ziak in ni tam lou chik bang in athei hi.
english: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.

paite: Jakob in Laban kiang ah, "Ka kithuahpih theihna ding in ka zi hon peta in, ka hun lah akimta ngal a," achi hi.
english: Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.”

paite: Laban in huai khua a mi tengteng akaikhawm vek a, ankuang alui hi.
english: Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, khomial tung in atanu Leah api a, Jakob kiang ah apilut a; ama'n ana kithuahpih hi.
english: In the evening, he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to Jacob. He went in to her.

paite: Laban in atanu Leah kiang ah asikhanu ding in ama sikhanu Zilpah apia hi.
english: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, zingsang ahong hih in, ngai in, Leah ana hi maimah hi. Jakob in Laban kiang ah, "Ka tung a na thilhih bangchidan ahia? Rakil toh kiteng ding a na nna sem ka ahi kei maw? Bangziak a hon khem maimah na hia?" achi hi.
english: In the morning, behold, it was Leah! He said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? Didn’t I serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me?”

paite: Laban in, "Ka gam uah huchibang a ta upazaw ma a anauzaw piak ngeina ahi kei.
english: Laban said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.

paite: Hiai minu' nipikal zou phot inla, huchi in kum sagih dang ka nna na sep zoh chiang in anauzaw leng ka hon pe ding," achi hi.
english: Fulfill the week of this one, and we will give you the other also for the service which you will serve with me for seven more years.”

paite: Jakob in huchibang in ahih a, anipikal azouta a; atanu Rakil azi ding in apeta hi.
english: Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife.

paite: Laban in atanu Rakil kiang ah asikhanu ding in ama sikhanu Bilhah apia hi.
english: Laban gave Bilhah, his servant, to his daughter Rachel to be her servant.
