paite: Huan huai ah lamlian a-om ding a, kongpi toh, huai Sianthouna Lampi achi ding uh; mithanghuai in lampi atawn kei ding, himahleh huai mite a ding in ahi zaw ding; mi vialzinte, ahi, mihaite leng, huai ah amang kei ding uhi.
english: A highway will be there, a road, and it will be called “The Holy Way”. The unclean shall not pass over it, but it will be for those who walk in the Way. Wicked fools shall not go there.

paite: Humpinelkai himhim huai ah a-om kei ding a, sa hing ne himhim huai ah apaitou sam kei ding uh, muh phak in leng a-om kei ding ua, himahleh tatsate bel huai ah apaitou ding uh.
english: No lion will be there, nor will any ravenous animal go up on it. They will not be found there; but the redeemed will walk there.

paite: TOUPA tatsate akik nawn ding ua, lasa kawm in Zion atung ding uh, tangtawn a kipahna alutung uah a-omta ding a; nopsakna leh kipahna angah ding ua, lungkhamna leh thumna amang ding hi.
english: Then Yahweh’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.”

paite: Kumpipa Hezekiah akum sawm-le-li kum in hichi ahong hi a, Assuria gam kumpipa Sennakerib tuh Judah gam a kulh nei khua tengteng sim ding in ava hohtou a alata hi.
english: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all of the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.

paite: Assuria kumpipa'n Lakish a kipan Jerusalem a kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah sepaihhon tampipi toh Rabshakeh asawl hi. Huan dil saknung tuilakna kiang a Puansawpmi Loubuk lamlian ah adingh hi.
english: The king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem to King Hezekiah with a large army. He stood by the aqueduct from the upper pool in the fuller’s field highway.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa inkuanpihte tung a heutu a om Hilkiah tapa Eliakim, laigelhmi Shebna, tanchin gelhmi Asaph tapa Joah akiang ah ahong suk uhi.
english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph the recorder came out to him.

paite: Huan Rabshakeh in akiang uah, "Hezekiah kiang ah huchi in gen un, 'Kumpipa thupitak Assuria kumpipa in hichi in achi: Na muanna kingakna bang ahi mai a?'
english: Rabshakeh said to them, “Now tell Hezekiah, ‘The great king, the king of Assyria, says, “What confidence is this in which you trust?

paite: Kidouna ding a na lemtheihna leh na hatna zaw thu lel ahi, ka chi. Kua muang a, ka tung a hel na himai a?
english: I say that your counsel and strength for the war are only vain words. Now in whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me?

paite: Ngai in, hiai sialluang chiangkhun kitan Aiguptate muang na hi ve; huai mi na muanleh, na khut ah asun ding hi. Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh ah zaw amah muangte tung ah huchibang ahi.”
english: Behold, you trust in the staff of this bruised reed, even in Egypt, which if a man leans on it, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.

paite: Ahihkeileh, ka kiang ah, "TOUPA i Pathian uh ahi ka muan uh," na chihleh, amah pen Hezekiah in Judahte kiang ah leh Jerusalem kiang ah, "Hiai maitam ma ah kia na biak ding uh ahi," chi a, amun sangte leh amaitamte lakmangsakpa hilou hia?
english: But if you tell me, ‘We trust in Yahweh our God,’ isn’t that he whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar’?”

paite: Huchi in hehpih in, ka pu Assuria kumpipa kiang ah thu chiam in, huchi in ke'n sakol sangnih ka hon pe ding, nang atung ua tuang dingte na muh theih peuh dingleh.
english: Now therefore, please make a pledge to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to set riders on them.

paite: Bangchi in kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite thu ah Aiguptate tung a na muanna nga a, ka pu sikha neupente lak a heutu khat leng na nan zoh ding?
english: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust in Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

paite: Huan hiai hihse ding a sim ding in TOUPA pang lou a hong paitou ka hi a hia? TOUPA'N, ka kiang ah, "Huai gam sim ding in hohtou inla, hihsia in, ahon chi, chi un," achi hi.
english: Have I come up now without Yahweh against this land to destroy it? Yahweh said to me, “Go up against this land, and destroy it.”’”

paite: Eliakim leh Shebna leh Joahte'n, Rabshakeh kiang ah, "Hehpih in na sikhate Siria pau in hon houpih in; huai ka theithei ngal ua; kulhbaang tung a mite zak in Judah pau in hon houpih nawn ke'n," achi uhi.
english: Then Eliakim, Shebna and Joah said to Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it. Don’t speak to us in the Jews’ language in the hearing of the people who are on the wall.”

paite: Himahleh Rabshakeh in, "Ka pu in na pu kiang kia ah leh nang kiang ah hiai thu gen ding in ahon sawl a hia? Kulhbaang tung a tute, noute toh amau ek ne ding leh amau zun dawn dingte kiang ah, ahon sawl ahi zaw kei maw?" achi hi.
english: But Rabshakeh said, “Has my master sent me only to your master and to you, to speak these words, and not to the men who sit on the wall, who will eat their own dung and drink their own urine with you?”

paite: Huchi in Rabshakeh adingh a, Judah pau in ngaihtak in akikou a, "Kumpipa thupi Assuria kumpipa thute ngaikhia un.
english: Then Rabshakeh stood, and called out with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and said, “Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!

paite: Kumpipa'n hichi in achi, 'Hezekiah khem in om nuam dah un; ama'n lah ahon humbit thei kei ding hi.
english: The king says, ‘Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you; for he will not be able to deliver you.

paite: Hezekiah in, TOUPA'N pel lou in hon humbit ding; hiai khopi zaw Assuria kumpipa khut a piak in a-om kei ding, chi in thu gen mahleh, Hezekiah gen ziak in TOUPA muang nuam tuan dah un.' "
english: Don’t let Hezekiah make you trust in Yahweh, saying, “Yahweh will surely deliver us. This city won’t be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”’

paite: Hezekiah thu ngaikhe kei un; Assuria kumpipa'n lah hichi in achi ngal a, "Thilpiak in hon kituahpih unla, ka kiang ah hong paikhia un; michih in agrepgui a pan leh michih in atheipi kung a pan ne chiat unla, michih in atuikhuk a pan tui dawn chiat un.
english: Don’t listen to Hezekiah, for the king of Assyria says, ‘Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and each of you eat from his vine, and each one from his fig tree, and each one of you drink the waters of his own cistern;

paite: Ka hong pai a, noumau gam bang a buh leh uain omna gam, tanghou leh grephuante omna gam a ka hon paipih matan.
english: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

paite: TOUPA'N hon humbit ding, chi a, Hezekiah in ahon khem khakleh pilvang un. Namte pathiante'n Assuria kumpipa khut a pan agam uh ahumbit ngei ua hia?
english: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, “Yahweh will deliver us.” Have any of the gods of the nations delivered their lands from the hand of the king of Assyria?

paite: Hamath leh Arpahte pathiante koi a om ahita ua? Sepharvaimte pathiante koi a om ahita ua? Huai Samaria khua kei a kipan in ahumbitta ua ahia?
english: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand?

paite: Huai gam pathian tengteng lak a kuate'n ahia kei a kipan agam uh ahumbit uh? TOUPA'N Jerusalem khua kei a kipan in ahumbit mahmah ding maw? chi in," achi hi.
english: Who are they among all the gods of these countries that have delivered their country out of my hand, that Yahweh should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?’”

paite: Amau bel adai dide ua, "Thu khat lel in leng adawng kei uh; kumpipa thupiak, amau dawng kei un," chih ahi ngal a.
english: But they remained silent, and said nothing in reply, for the king’s commandment was, “Don’t answer him.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa inkuanpihte tung a heutu a om Hilkiah tapa Eliakim, laigelhmi Shebna, tanchin gelhmi Asaph tapa Joahte'n a uansilh uh botkek in Hezekiah kiang ah ahong pai ua, Rabshakeh thugente ahilh uhi.
english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa Hezekiah in huai azaktak in apuansilhte abotkek a, sai-ip puan asilh a, TOUPA' inn ah alutta hi.
english: When King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into Yahweh’s house.

paite: A-inkuanpihte tung a heutu a om Eliakim leh laigelhmi Shebna leh siampute upate sai-ip puan silh in Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai kiang ah asawl hi.
english: He sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.

paite: Amau akiang ah, Hezekiah in hichi in achi, "Tuni mangbatna leh muhsitna ni ahi; naupangte lah apian hun uh ahita a, amau piangsak ding in hatna lah a-om nawn kei.
english: They said to him, “Hezekiah says, ‘Today is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of rejection; for the children have come to the birth, and there is no strength to give birth.

paite: Rabshakeh apu Assuria kumpipa'n Pathian hing gense ding a asawl thugente, TOUPA na Pathian in abil in aza lai ahi kha ding buchi in athugen, TOUPA na Pathian in abil a azakte ah, ahon sal ding hi; huaiziak in akhosuaksunte a ding in na thumna lan in achi,” achi uhi.
english: It may be Yahweh your God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to defy the living God, and will rebuke the words which Yahweh your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.’”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Hezekiah sikhate Isai kiang ah ahong pai uhi.
english: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

paite: Isai in akiang uah, "Na pu kiang uah hichi in na chi ding uh, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, 'Na thuzak, Assuria kumpipa sikhate'n ahon gensiatnate uh, kihta ke'n.
english: Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master, ‘Yahweh says, “Don’t be afraid of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

paite: Ngai in, asung ah kha banghiam ka omsak ding a, huchi in thuthang aza ding a, amah gam ah akik nawn mai ding; huchi in amah gam ngei ah namsau a puksak in ka omsak ding, achi,' chi in," achi hi.
english: Behold, I will put a spirit in him and he will hear news, and will return to his own land. I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.”’”

paite: Huchi in Rabshakeh akik nawn a, Assuria kumpipa in Libnah adouna a kipan apaikheta chih athei khinta hi.
english: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah, for he heard that he had departed from Lachish.

paite: Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib in Tirhak Ethiopia kumpipa tungthu, "Nang hon sim ding in apawtta," chi in mi gen aza hi. Huchi in huai azaktak in Hezekiah kiang ah palaite asawl a.
english: He heard news concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, “He has come out to fight against you.” When he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,

paite: Hichi in Judahte kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah na chi ding uh ahi, “Na muan Pathian in, Jerusalem khua Assuria kumpipa khut ah piak ahi kei ding, chi in hon khem kei hen.
english: “Thus you shall speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, ‘Don’t let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, “Jerusalem won’t be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”

paite: Ngai in, Assuria Kumpipate'n gam tengteng hihse vek in atung ua athilhihte uh na bil in na za hi, huchi in nang penpen humbit in na om tuam ding hiam?
english: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Shall you be delivered?

paite: Namte pathiante'n, Gozan, Haran, Reseph, Eden ta Telassar a omte, ka pipute sukmante, ahumbit ngei ua hia?
english: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed, Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the children of Eden who were in Telassar?

paite: Hamath kumpipate, Ivvah kumpipate koi a om ahita ua? chi in," achi a.
english: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?’”

paite: Hezekiah in palaite khut a kipan in lai amu a, asim a, huchi in TOUPA' inn ah Hezekiah ava lut a, TOUPA ma ah aphahta hi.
english: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it. Then Hezekiah went up to Yahweh’s house, and spread it before Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah Hezekiah athum hi.
english: Hezekiah prayed to Yahweh, saying,

paite: "Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian aw, cherubte tung a tupa, nang, nang kia, leitung luah gam tengteng Pathian na hi; nangma'n leitung leh van na bawl hi.
english: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, who is enthroned among the cherubim, you are the God, even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.

paite: TOUPA aw na bildoh inla, ngai dih ve; TOUPA aw na mit hak inla, en dih ve; Pathian hing gense ding a mite sawlpa Sennakerib thu tengteng ngai in.
english: Turn your ear, Yahweh, and hear. Open your eyes, Yahweh, and behold. Hear all of the words of Sennacherib, who has sent to defy the living God.

paite: TOUPA, Assuria kumpipate'n nam tengteng leh agam uh ahihse ngei ua, apathiante uh leng mei ah apai uhi.
english: Truly, Yahweh, the kings of Assyria have destroyed all the countries and their land,

paite: Huaite zaw Pathian ahi kei him ua, mihing khut a bawl sing leh suang, ahi zaw uh. Huaiziak in ahihmang uhi.
english: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone; therefore they have destroyed them.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA ka Pathian uh aw, nang, nang kia, TOUPA na hi chih leitung luah gam tengteng in atheihna ding un amah a kipan in hon humbit in," chi in.
english: Now therefore, Yahweh our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you are Yahweh, even you only.”

paite: Huai lai in Amoz tapa Isai in Hezekiah kiang ah mi asawl a, hichi in achi, "TOUPA Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi, Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib siatna ding nangawn a ka kiang a na thum ziak in,
english: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, “Yahweh, the God of Israel says, ‘Because you have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria,

paite: hiai atungtang thu TOUPA'N agen ahi, 'Nungak siangthou, Zion tanu in ahon musit a, hon nuihsan hi; Jerusalem tanu in alu hon sinkhum hi.
english: this is the word which Yahweh has spoken concerning him: The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and ridiculed you. The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.

paite: Kua ahi mai a na minsiatsak a na gensiat? Kua tung ah ahia na aw na puamsak a, na mit na sansak? Israelte Mi Siangthou tung ah ahi kei maw.
english: Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Na sikhate zang in TOUPA min na sesak a, ka kangtalai tampi toh tang sang sanna, Lebanon gam kil ah ka hong tungtouta hi; asidar sing sangtakte leh ameilah sing hoihte ka phuk ding; amun sangpen, alei hoihna gammang ah ka lut ding.
english: By your servants, you have defied the Lord, and have said, “With the multitude of my chariots I have come up to the height of the mountains, to the innermost parts of Lebanon. I will cut down its tall cedars and its choice cypress trees. I will enter into its farthest height, the forest of its fruitful field.

paite: Tuileh ka let a, tui ka dawn zel a, ka khepek nuai in Aigupta lui tengteng ka kangsak vek ding, " na chi hi.
english: I have dug and drunk water, and with the sole of my feet I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt.”

paite: Ke'n nidanglai a pan in huai ka hih ahi a, tuma lam a kipan a ka suktuah ahi chih na za kei a hia? Khua kulh neite inn chimkhawm bang lel a hihsepa na hihtheihna ding in tu in ka tungsak hi.
english: “‘Have you not heard how I have done it long ago, and formed it in ancient times? Now I have brought it to pass, that it should be yours to destroy fortified cities, turning them into ruinous heaps.

paite: Huaiziak in asung a omte ahat lo kei ua, alau ua, azahlak uhi; loubuk loupa bang lel leh loupa hing bang lel, intung loupa hing bang lel, intung loupa bang leh lou buh hoih mah bang lel ahi uhi.
english: Therefore their inhabitants had little power. They were dismayed and confounded. They were like the grass of the field, and like the green herb, like the grass on the housetops, and like a field before its crop has grown.

paite: "Ke'n bel na tut, na pawt, na lut leh ka tung a na hehdan ka thei hi.
english: But I know your sitting down, your going out, your coming in, and your raging against me.

paite: Ka tung a na heh ziak leh na uangpau ka bil a ahong luttouh tak ziak in ka nakbulh nang nak ah ka bulh ding a, ka sikkaihna leng na muk ah ka bulh ding, na hong paina lampi mah ah ka hon kiksak nawn ding, chih," chi in.
english: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.

paite: "Huan hiai pen nang a ding a chiamtehna ding ahi ding; tukum in buhsang na sen ding ua; kum nawn in leng huai buhsang mah na sen ding uh; akum thumna ah buh tuh unla, at unla, grephuante bawl unla, agah ne un.
english: “‘This shall be the sign to you: You will eat this year that which grows of itself, and in the second year that which springs from it; and in the third year sow and reap and plant vineyards, and eat their fruit.

paite: "Huan Judah inkuanpihte lak a akhosuaksunte bel asuklam a zungkai a, atoulam a gah in a-om nawn ding.
english: The remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah will again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

paite: Akhosuaksunte Jerusalem a kipan in apawt ding ua, dam lai dingte Zion tang a kipan in apawt ding uh; sepaihte' TOUPA phatuamngaihna in huaite ahih ding hi.
english: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and survivors will escape from Mount Zion. The zeal of Yahweh of Armies will perform this.’

paite: "Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Assuria kumpipa tungtang thu ah hichi in achi: Amah hiai khopi ahong tung kei ding a, hiai lai ah athal leng akap sam kei ding a, lum toh akiang ah leng ahong pai sam kei ding, asimna ding in lah leikulh abawl sam kei ding.
english: “Therefore Yahweh says concerning the king of Assyria, ‘He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there, neither will he come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.

paite: Ahong paina lampi ah huai mah ah akik nawn ding ziak in, hiai khopi ah ahong tung kei ding," TOUPA'N achi.
english: He will return the way that he came, and he won’t come to this city,’ says Yahweh.

paite: Kei ziak leh ka sikha David ziak in hiai khopi ka humbit ding hi,” chỉ in achi a.
english: ‘For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.’”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA angel ava pawt a, Assuriate giahmun ah mi nuaikhat singgiat-le-sangnga asisak a; huan, zingkhang a mi athoh uleh, ngai in, misi luang ngen ana hi uhi.
english: Then Yahweh’s angel went out and struck one hundred and eighty-five thousand men in the camp of the Assyrians. When men arose early in the morning, behold, these were all dead bodies.

paite: Huchi in Assuria kumpipa Sennakerib apawt a, apaikik a, Nineveh ah a-om nilouh hi.
english: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, went away, returned to Nineveh, and stayed there.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, apathian Nisrok inn a pathian abiak lai in atapa Adrammelek leh Sarezerte'n namsau in asatlum ua; huchi in ataimang ua, Ararat gam ah alut uhi. Huchi in atapa Esarhaddon in asik in vai ahawm hi.
english: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.

paite: Huai lai in Hezekiah si thei ding khop in achi ana hi. Huchi in akiang ah Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai ahong a, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Na inkuanpihte omdan ding gelsak in; damkhe lou a si ding na hi ngal a, chi in," achi hi.
english: In those days Hezekiah was sick and near death. Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him, and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Set your house in order, for you will die, and not live.’”

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah baang lam nga in akihei a, TOUPA kiang ah athum a,
english: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to Yahweh,

paite: "TOUPA aw, na ma a thutak leh lungtang hoihkim pu a ka om zeldan leh na mitmuh a thil hoih ka hih zeldan, hehpih in theigige in," achi hi. Huchi in Hezekiah akap huphup hi.
english: and said, “Remember now, Yahweh, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight.” Then Hezekiah wept bitterly.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA thu Isai kiang ah ahong tung a,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Isaiah, saying,

paite: "Kuan inla, Hezekiah kiang ah gen in, TOUPA, na pu David Pathian in hichi in achi: Na thumna ka za a, na khituite leng ka mu a; ngai in, na damsung nite ah kum sawm-le-nga ka behlap ding hi.
english: “Go, and tell Hezekiah, ‘Yahweh, the God of David your father, says, “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will add fifteen years to your life.

paite: Huan nang leh hiai khopi Assuria kumpipa a kipan ka humbit ding a; hiai khopi ka hum ding hi.
english: I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria, and I will defend this city.

paite: "TOUPA'N athil gen ahih ngei ding chih, hiai nang a ding in TOUPA a kipan chiamtehna ding ahi.
english: This shall be the sign to you from Yahweh, that Yahweh will do this thing that he has spoken.

paite: En in, inlim chial a lim, Ahaz dakbi theihna a niamkiaksa, inliim chial sawm tan in ka kiksak nawn ding," achi hi. Huchi in ni niamna dakbi theihna ah inliim chial sawm tan in akik nawnta hi.
english: Behold, I will cause the shadow on the sundial, which has gone down on the sundial of Ahaz with the sun, to return backward ten steps.”’” So the sun returned ten steps on the sundial on which it had gone down.

paite: Judah kumpipa Hezekiah china, adam nawn nung a alaigelh a:
english: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and had recovered of his sickness:

paite: "Ka damsung nite sun laitak in han kongpi ah lut ding in ka kisa a; ka damsung kum om lai dingte suh in ka omta, ka chi hi.
english: I said, “In the middle of my life I go into the gates of Sheol. I am deprived of the residue of my years.”

paite: TOUPA, TOUPA ngei, mihing gam ah ka mu nawnta kei ding a; khovel a omte lak ah mihing ka mu nawn kei ding hi.
english: I said, “I won’t see Yah, Yah in the land of the living. I will see man no more with the inhabitants of the world.

paite: Ka omna suan in a-om a, belamchingmi puanin bang in ka kiang a kipan a lakmang in a-omta hi. Puan ganmi'n apuan azial bang in ka hinna ka zial a; ama'n siambu a kipan ahon teptan ding a; ni khat leh zan khat thil thu a hon hihtawp maimah ding na hi ve, ka chi hi.
english: My dwelling is removed, and is carried away from me like a shepherd’s tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver. He will cut me off from the loom. From day even to night you will make an end of me.

paite: Zingsang tan ka dai teitei a; humpinelkai bang in ka guh tengteng ahihtan vek a; nang ni khat leh zan khat thil thu a hon hihtawp mai ding na hi ve.
english: I waited patiently until morning. He breaks all my bones like a lion. From day even to night you will make an end of me.

paite: Lensiam hiam, vakang hiam bang in ka hamham a, vakhu bang in ka thum hi, tunglam etna in ka mit avaita hi; TOUPA aw, nuaisiah a om ka hi, nang ka tang in ding in.
english: I chattered like a swallow or a crane. I moaned like a dove. My eyes weaken looking upward. Lord, I am oppressed. Be my security.”

paite: Bang ka gen dia? Ama'n ahon houpih a, amah mah in ahih pah hi; ka hinna ning kitelna ziak in ka damsung kum teng awl khakha in ka pai khiankhianta ding.
english: What will I say? He has both spoken to me, and himself has done it. I will walk carefully all my years because of the anguish of my soul.

paite: "TOUPA aw, hichibang thil ziak in mihingte ahing zel uh, huaite kia ah ka kha hinna a-om zel hi; huaiziak in hon damsak nawn in hon hingsak nawn in.
english: Lord, men live by these things; and my spirit finds life in all of them. You restore me, and cause me to live.

paite: Ngai in, ka lungmuanna ding in ahi, ning kitelna thupitak ka na neih; himahleh nang, ka hinna na it ziak in, siatna kokhuk a kipan in na humbitta; ka khelhnate tengteng lah na nunglam ah na pai vekta hi.
english: Behold, for peace I had great anguish, but you have in love for my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; for you have cast all my sins behind your back.

paite: Han in lah hon phat thei ngal kei a, sihna in leng ahon pahtawi thei sam kei hi; kokhuk a kumte'n na thutak alamen thei kei uhi.
english: For Sheol can’t praise you. Death can’t celebrate you. Those who go down into the pit can’t hope for your truth.

paite: Mihing in, mihing in, amau ngei in tuni a ka hih bang in ahon phat ding uh; pa'n atate kiang ah na thutak atheisak ding.
english: The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do today. The father shall make known your truth to the children.

paite: "TOUPA bel hon hondam ding in amansa gige hi; huaiziak in i damsung tengteng in, TOUPA' inn ah, ka late tumging guineite toh i sa ding."
english: Yahweh will save me. Therefore we will sing my songs with stringed instruments all the days of our life in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Isai in, "Theipi gah lom khat la henla, damdawi atat a tatte ding in ameimatum ah tuamkhum hen, huchi in adam ding," ana chi khinta hi.
english: Now Isaiah had said, “Let them take a cake of figs, and lay it for a poultice on the boil, and he shall recover.”

paite: Hezekiah mah in leng, "TOUPA' inn ah ka hohtou nawn ding chih theihna bang chiamtehna hong om ding ahia?" ana chi khinta hi.
english: Hezekiah also had said, “What is the sign that I will go up to Yahweh’s house?”

paite: Huai lai in Baladan tapa Babulon kumpipa Merodak-baladan in Hezekiah kiang ah achi ana chih leh adam nawnta chih azak ziak in laite leh kipahman akhak hi.
english: At that time, Merodach-baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah, for he heard that he had been sick, and had recovered.

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah atung uah akipak a, akiang uah athil manphate koihna inn dangkate, dangka-engte, gimlim bangbang hiamte, sathau manphate, agalvan koihna insung tengtengte, agou hoih lak a om tengtengte a-ensak hi. A-inn leh agamsung a om himhim Hezekiah in akiang ua a-etsak louh a-om kei hi.
english: Hezekiah was pleased with them, and showed them the house of his precious things, the silver, the gold, the spices, and the precious oil, and all the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures. There was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah didn’t show them.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah zawlnei Isai ahoh a, akiang ah, "Den a mite'n bang ahia agen uh? Koi a kipan in ahia na kiang a ahong uh?" achi hi. Hezekiah in, "Gam gamlapi a kipan, Babulon a kipan in, ka kiang a hong pai ahi uh,” achi hi.
english: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah, and asked him, “What did these men say? From where did they come to you?” Hezekiah said, “They have come from a country far from me, even from Babylon.”

paite: Huchi in ama'n, "Na inn ah bangbang en ahi ua?" achi hi. Hezekiah in, "Ka insung a om tengteng a-en vek uh; ka gou hoihte ka etsak louh bangmah a-om kei," chi in adawng hi.
english: Then he asked, “What have they seen in your house?” Hezekiah answered, “They have seen all that is in my house. There is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them.”

paite: Huchi in Isai in Hezekiah kiang ah, "Sepaihte' TOUPA thu thei in.
english: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of Yahweh of Armies:

paite: Ngai in na insung a om tengteng leh tuni tan a na pipute'n akholkhawmte uh Babulon a paipih in a-om vek ding; bangmah nutsiat in a-om kei ding; huchibang nite ahong tung ding, TOUPA'N achi.
english: ‘Behold, the days are coming when all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have stored up until today, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says Yahweh.

paite: Huan na tapa, na gil a hong gah ding, na suan dingte ngei lak a mi, apaimangpih ding uh; amau Babulon kumpipa' inn ah michilgeh ding in a-om ding uh," achi hi.
english: ‘They will take away your sons who will issue from you, whom you shall father, and they will be eunuchs in the king of Babylon’s palace.’”

paite: Huchi in Hezekiah in, Isai kiang ah, "TOUPA thu na gen ahoih hi," achi hi. Amah mah in, "Ka damsung in lemna leh muanna a-om ding hi," achi lai hi.
english: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “Yahweh’s word which you have spoken is good.” He said moreover, “For there will be peace and truth in my days.”

paite: Huai ni in numei sagih in pasal khat alen ding ua, "Koumau an ka ne ding ua, koumau silh-le-ten ka silh un ka teng ding uh; na min lel hon pusak in; ka minsia uh hon lakmangsak in," chi in agen ding uhi.
english: Seven women shall take hold of one man in that day, saying, “We will eat our own bread, and wear our own clothing. Just let us be called by your name. Take away our reproach.”

paite: Huai ni in TOUPA hiang kilawmtak in leh thupitak in a-om ding a, Israelte damlaite a ding in lei a gahte hoihtak leh kilawmtak in a-om ding.
english: In that day, Yahweh’s branch will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the beauty and glory of the survivors of Israel.

paite: Huchi in Zion nutsiat a omleh, Jerusalem a omden tuh siangthou chih in a-om ding, michih Jerusalem a dam lai a min gelhte.
english: It will happen that he who is left in Zion and he who remains in Jerusalem shall be called holy, even everyone who is written among the living in Jerusalem,

paite: Vaihawmna kha leh katna kha a Toupa'n Zion tanu buahte asawpsiangsak a, asung a kipan Jerusalem sisan asuksiang khit chiang in.
english: when the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from within it, by the spirit of justice and by the spirit of burning.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Zion tang a omna tengteng tung ah leh akikhawmpite tung ah sun in meipi leh meikhu, zan in meikuang vak asiamsak ding; thupina tengteng tung ah banghiam zak a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: Yahweh will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night, for over all the glory will be a canopy.

paite: Sun in nisa liah ding leh huihpi vuahpi lak a kihumbitna leh bukna mun ding in biakbuk ahi ding hi.
english: There will be a pavilion for a shade in the daytime from the heat, and for a refuge and for a shelter from storm and from rain.

paite: Lungmuan un, ka mite lungmuan un, na Pathian un achi hi.
english: “Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God.

paite: Jerusalem kiang ah lungmuan lam sang in thu gen unla, agaldouna uh hihzoh ahita a, akhelhna uh ngaihdam ahi a, athilhihkhelh teng gun ding in TOUPA khut a kipan amun nih in amuta uh chih hilh un.
english: “Speak comfortably to Jerusalem, and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received of Yahweh’s hand double for all her sins.”

paite: Tua! Kikou aw in, "Gamdai ah TOUPA lampi bawl unla, gamkeu ah i Pathian a ding in lamlian kilualsak un.
english: The voice of one who calls out, “Prepare the way of Yahweh in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for our God.

paite: Guam chih sansak ahi vek ding a, tang chih mual chih niamsak ahi ding; lampi kawite tansak ahi ding a, aphokna lailai hihlual ahi ding hi;
english: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low. The uneven shall be made level, and the rough places a plain.

paite: TOUPA thupina hihlat ahi ding a, mi tengteng in huai amu chiat ding uh chih TOUPA kam in lah agenta ngal a," achi hi.
english: Yahweh’s glory shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken it.”

paite: Tua aw in, "Kikou in," achi hi. Mi'n, "Bang gen in ka kikou dia?” achi hi. Mi tengteng loupa bang ahi ua, athupina tengteng uh leng lou a pak bang ahi.
english: The voice of one saying, “Cry out!” One said, “What shall I cry?” “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory is like the flower of the field.

paite: "TOUPA hu in amut ziak in loupa avuai a, apak atul nak; mite zaw loupa bang ahi mahmah uhi.
english: The grass withers, the flower fades, because Yahweh’s breath blows on it. Surely the people are like grass.

paite: Loupa avuai a, apak atul zel; i Pathian thu bel tangtawn in a-om gige ding," chi in achi a.
english: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.”

paite: Zion kiang a atanchinhoih hilh mi aw, tang sang mahmahte ah va hohtou in; Jerusalem kiang a tanchinhoih hilh mi aw, ngaihtak in na aw suah in; suah in, lau ke'n; Judah khuate kiang ah, "En un, na Pathian uh!”
english: You who tell good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who tell good news to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with strength! Lift it up! Don’t be afraid! Say to the cities of Judah, “Behold, your God!”

paite: "En un, Toupa PATHIAN mihattak bang in ahong pai ding hi; aban in vai ahawm ding; En un, akipahman akiang ah a-om a, ditna leng ama ah a-om.
english: Behold, the Lord Yahweh will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him. Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.

paite: Ama'n belamchingpa bang in abelamhonte avak ding a, belamnoute aban in apomkhawm ding a, a-angsung a koih in apaipih ding a, nou kailaite bel awlawl in api hiathiat ding," chi in.
english: He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young.

paite: Kua'n ahia tuite akhutpek sung lel ateh a, tung a van khap lel ateh a, lei a leivui tehna khat lel a thun vek a, tangte lah khaina a khai a, mual pawngte bukna lel a buk?
english: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and marked off the sky with his span, and calculated the dust of the earth in a measuring basket, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?

paite: Kua'n ahia TOUPA kha thilhih dan ding kawkmuh? Ahihkeileh kua ahia amah lemsehsak hi a amah chil?
english: Who has directed Yahweh’s Spirit, or has taught him as his counselor?

paite: Ama'n kua adong a, kua'n ahia amah theisak a, vaihawm lampi ensak a, theihna hilh a, theihsiamna lampi ensak ngei?
english: Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge, and showed him the way of understanding?

paite: Ngai in, namte lah baltin a tui tak khat bang lel ahi ua, bukna a banghiam nen bang lel a seh ahi ua, ngai in, ama'n tuikulh gamte thil neu neuchikte bang in adom zel hi.
english: Behold, the nations are like a drop in a bucket, and are regarded as a speck of dust on a balance. Behold, he lifts up the islands like a very little thing.

paite: Lebanon nangawn khul tham ahi kei a, agam a gante leng halmang a kithoihna tham ahi sam kei hi.
english: Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor its animals sufficient for a burnt offering.

paite: Nam chihte lah ama ah bangmah lou bang ahi ua, amah ngaihtuah in bangmah lou sang a tawm zaw, huihkhua lel ahi uhi.
english: All the nations are like nothing before him. They are regarded by him as less than nothing, and vanity.

paite: Pathian kua toh teh na hi ua? Ahihkeileh, bang lim ahia amah toh na teh ding uh?
english: To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him?

paite: Milim bawltawm zaw, nasem mi in asung a, dangka-eng sekmi'n dangka- eng in aluan khum a, huai a ding in dangka khainiangte asunsak zel hi.
english: A workman has cast an image, and the goldsmith overlays it with gold, and casts silver chains for it.

paite: Huchibang thilpiak pe zou lou a, genthei lo mahmah in sing muat lou ding atel zel, milim bawltawm, ling lou ding, amah a dia bawlkhiaksak ding khutsiam mi azong zel hi.
english: He who is too impoverished for such an offering chooses a tree that will not rot. He seeks a skillful workman to set up a carved image for him that will not be moved.

paite: Na lungsim un na thei kei ua hia? Na bil un na za kei ua hia? Atung a kipan in hon hilh kei ua hia? Lei pianchil a pan na theisiam kei ua hia?
english: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? Haven’t you been told from the beginning? Haven’t you understood from the foundations of the earth?

paite: Amah zaw lei kualkhumna tung a tupa ahi, ama mitmuh in leitung a omte khaupe bang lel ahi uh, amah zaw tung a van puanin tung bang a kaipalh a, omna ding a puanin zak a, miliante bangmah lou suaksakpa ahi.
english: It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in,

paite: Amah leitung a vaihawm mite bangmah lou a bawl nakpa ahi.
english: who brings princes to nothing, who makes the judges of the earth meaningless.

paite: Ahi, suan ahi kei ua; ahi, tuh ahi sam kei uh; ahi, akung un lei ah zung akai kei; huai lou in ama'n amau amut a, avuai ua, pingpei in buhsi alakmang bang in alamang hi.
english: They are planted scarcely. They are sown scarcely. Their stock has scarcely taken root in the ground. He merely blows on them, and they wither, and the whirlwind takes them away as stubble.

paite: Kua toh hon teh a, kua kimpih a hon sep na hi ua? Mi Siangthou in achi hi.
english: “To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.

paite: Tunglam ah na mit uh hak unla, huai thilte kua siam ahia en un; ama'n sepaihte kizomzom in apikhia a, amin chiat un asam a; ahatna thupina ziak leh thilhihtheihna a ahat ziak in khat mah leng kim lou a-om ngei kei uhi.
english: Lift up your eyes on high, and see who has created these, who brings out their army by number. He calls them all by name. By the greatness of his might, and because he is strong in power, not one is lacking.

paite: Jakobte aw, bang achia hiai chi na hi ua, Israelte aw, bang achia hichibang a thu gen na hi ua, "Ka lampi zaw TOUPA lak a sel ahi a, avai hawmsakna ka Pathian lak a lakmang ahi," chih?
english: Why do you say, Jacob, and speak, Israel, “My way is hidden from Yahweh, and the justice due me is disregarded by my God”?

paite: Na lungsim un na thei kei ua hia? Na bil un na za ngei kei ua hia? Tangtawn Pathian, TOUPA kawlmong Siampa, abah louh a, agim ngeilouhdan; atheihsiamdan zonkhiak vual ahi kei hi.
english: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, Yahweh, the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable.

paite: Bahte kiang ah thilhihtheihna apia a, hatna himhim neiloute ahatsak naknak hi.
english: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.

paite: Tuailaite nangawn leng bah in agim ding ua, tangvalte leng apukzou ding uh.
english: Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall;

paite: TOUPA ngakte'n zaw ahatna uh athaksak nawn ding ua; muvanlai bang in kha in alengtou ding ua; gim lou in atai ding ua; bah lou in khe in apai ding uhi.
english: but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.

paite: Tuikulh gamte aw, ka ma ah dai sipsip unla; michih in ahatna uh thaksak nawn uhenla; hong pai nai chiat le uh; huai khit chiang in gen uhen; vaihawm ding in paikhawm ni.
english: “Keep silent before me, islands, and let the peoples renew their strength. Let them come near, then let them speak. Let’s meet together for judgment.

paite: Suahlam a kipan mi khat, diktatna ziak a akhebul a asap, kua'n ahia kaihalh? Ama'n ama ah namte apia a, kumpipate tung ah vai ahawmsak a; leivui bang in anamsau kiang ah apia a, buhsi huih mutleng bang in athalpeu kiang ah leng apia hi.
english: Who has raised up one from the east? Who called him to his feet in righteousness? He hands over nations to him and makes him rule over kings. He gives them like the dust to his sword, like the driven stubble to his bow.

paite: Ama'n amaute adelh a, bittak in араі а; akhe a apai nailouhna lampi ah.
english: He pursues them and passes by safely, even by a way that he had not gone with his feet.

paite: Atung a kipan suan tengteng sam in, kua'n ahia sem a, hih khin? Kei TOUPA, amasapen leh ananungpen, ahihpa kei kia ka hi.
english: Who has worked and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, Yahweh, the first, and with the last, I am he.”

paite: Tuikulh gamte'n amu ua; alau ua; kawlmongte aling ua; ahon naih a, ahong pai uhi.
english: The islands have seen, and fear. The ends of the earth tremble. They approach, and come.

paite: Michih in amau lawmte apanpih ua; michih in a-unaute uh kiang ah, Khamuangtak in om un, achi chiat uhi.
english: Everyone helps his neighbor. They say to their brothers, “Be strong!”

paite: Huchi in abulhkipna lam thu ah, "Ahoih hi,” chi in khutsiam mi in dangka-eng sekmi ahanthawn a, sek a sekmum mi in sekdou sekmi a ahanthawn; alinlouhna ding in kilhnate in akilh kipta hi.
english: So the carpenter encourages the goldsmith. He who smooths with the hammer encourages him who strikes the anvil, saying of the soldering, “It is good;” and he fastens it with nails, that it might not totter.

paite: Himahleh nou Israelte ka sikha, Jakobte ka mitel, ka lawm, Abraham suante aw,
english: “But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the offspring of Abraham my friend,

paite: Nou, lei tawpna a kipan a ka mipi, anawl a kipan a ka misap, "Ка sikhate na hi ua, hon paikhe lou in ka hon tel zaw," ka hon chihte aw,
english: you whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth, and called from its corners, and said to you, ‘You are my servant. I have chosen you and have not cast you away.’

paite: Lau kei un, kei lah na kiang uah ka om ngal a; mangbang kei un, kei lah na Pathian uh ka hi ngal a; ka hon hatsak ding a; ahi, ka hon panpih ding; ahi, ka diktatna khut taklam in ka hon len gige ding hi.
english: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

paite: Ngai in, na tung ua lungkim lou tengteng zahlaktak leh zumtak in a-om ding uh; nou hon selte lah bangmah lou bang ahi ding ua, amang ding uh.
english: Behold, all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded. Those who strive with you will be like nothing, and shall perish.

paite: Nou hon selte na zong ding ua, na mu tuan kei ding uh; nou hon doute lah bangmah lou bang ahi ding ua, thil om lou bang lel ahi ding uh.
english: You will seek them, and won’t find them, even those who contend with you. Those who war against you will be as nothing, as a nonexistent thing.

paite: Kei TOUPA na Pathian un, Lau kei un, ka hon panpih ding, chi in na khut taklam uh ka len ding hi.
english: For I, Yahweh your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’

paite: Nou Jakob tangtel leh Israel mite aw, lau kei un, ka hon panpih ding, TOUPA'N achi, nou hon tanpa Israelte Mi Siangthou ahi.
english: Don’t be afraid, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel. I will help you,” says Yahweh. “Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Ngai in, buhsukna khawl thak mahmah, hiam mahmah, ha nei in ka hon bawl ding; tangte chil in na khenzan ding ua, mualte buhsi bang in na bawl ding uh.
english: Behold, I have made you into a new sharp threshing instrument with teeth. You will thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and will make the hills like chaff.

paite: Na zap ding ua, huih in amut leng ding, pingpei in ahihdalh ding a, huan, noute TOUPA ah na kipak ding ua, Israelte Mi Siangthou na hon suang ding uh.
english: You will winnow them, and the wind will carry them away, and the whirlwind will scatter them. You will rejoice in Yahweh. You will glory in the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Migenthei leh tagahte'n tui azong ua, a-om kei a, alei uh dangtak in ahul khin hi; kei TOUPA'N amau ka dawng ding a, kei Israel' Pathian in amau ka paisan kei ding.
english: The poor and needy seek water, and there is none. Their tongue fails for thirst. I, Yahweh, will answer them. I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.

paite: Tang sang giau ah luite ka luangsak ding a, phaizang laizangte ah tui nak ka suaksak ding; gamdai dil in ka bawl ding a, gamkeu leng tui nak in ka bawl ding hi.
english: I will open rivers on the bare heights, and springs in the middle of the valleys. I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.

paite: Gamdai ah sidar singte, singgite, muite, thausingte ka suan ding a, gamkeu ah meilah singte, phante, sing gelh chite ka suankhawm vek ding;
english: I will put cedar, acacia, myrtle, and oil trees in the wilderness. I will set cypress trees, pine, and box trees together in the desert;

paite: TOUPA khut in huaite ahih ahi chih leh Israelte Mi Siangthou in asiam ahi chih amuh ua, atheih ua, angaihtuah ua, atheihsiam theihna ding un.
english: that they may see, know, consider, and understand together, that Yahweh’s hand has done this, and the Holy One of Israel has created it.

paite: Na thu uh hong gen un, TOUPA'N achi; na paulam pen uh langsak un, Jakobte' Kumpipa'n achi hi.
english: Produce your cause,” says Yahweh. “Bring out your strong reasons!” says the King of Jacob.

paite: Huaite langsak uhenla, thil hong tung dingte i kiang uah gen uhen; i ngaihtuah theihna ding leh atawpna ding i theihtheihna ding in, tuma thilte bang ahia gen un; ahihkeileh, thil hong tung dingte hon theisak un.
english: “Let them announce and declare to us what will happen! Declare the former things, what they are, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or show us things to come.

paite: pathiante na hi uh chih ka theihna ding un tunung chiang a thil tung dingte gen un; ahi, i mangbat chiatna ding un leh i et chiat ding un thil hoih thiam thil hoih lou hiam hih dih ua le.
english: Declare the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and see it together.

paite: Ngai un, bangmah na hi kei ua, na thilhih uh leng bangmah ahi kei; nou hon telpa mikihhuai ahi.
english: Behold, you are nothing, and your work is nothing. He who chooses you is an abomination.

paite: Mallam a kipan mi khat ka dingsak a, amah ahong tung a; nisuahna a kipan ka min loupa; ama'n suang bulhkipna abawl bang in vaihawmte abawl ding a, belvelmi'n bellei achil bang in achil ding hi.
english: “I have raised up one from the north, and he has come, from the rising of the sun, one who calls on my name, and he shall come on rulers as on mortar, and as the potter treads clay.

paite: I theihtheihna ding un kua'n ahia atung a kipan gen ngei? Amah zaw adik i chih theihna ding un kua'n ahia genkhol ngei? Ahi gen himhim a-om kei uh, ahi, theisak himhim a-om kei uh, ahi, na thugente uh za a-om kei uh.
english: Who has declared it from the beginning, that we may know? and before, that we may say, ‘He is right’? Surely, there is no one who declares. Surely, there is no one who shows. Surely, there is no one who hears your words.

paite: Ke'n Zion kiang ah, "En in, hiai ah amaute a-om uh," chi masa ding ka hi a, Jerusalem kiang ah tanchinhoih hon tun mi khat ka pe ding.
english: I am the first to say to Zion, ‘Behold, look at them;’ and I will give one who brings good news to Jerusalem.

paite: Ka et in leng mi himhim a-om kei ua; amau ka dot in leng, alak ua lemthei mi, thu khat leng dawng thei, kuamah himhim leng a-om kei uh.
english: When I look, there is no man, even among them there is no counselor who, when I ask, can answer a word.

paite: En un, anasepte uh bangmah lou ahi a, thil om lou ahi; amilim sunte uh lah huih leh huihkhua lel ahi.
english: Behold, all of their deeds are vanity and nothing. Their molten images are wind and confusion.

paite: Ka sikha, ka let gige, ka tel, ka lung in apahtak mahmah en dih ua; atung ah ka kha ka koihta; Zentelte kiang a piak ding in vaihawmna thu ahong pawt ding.
english: “Behold, my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights: I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring justice to the nations.

paite: Akikou kei ding a, a-aw asuaksak sam kei ding, kongzing ah a-aw akizasak sam kei ding.
english: He will not shout, nor raise his voice, nor cause it to be heard in the street.

paite: Sialluang gawpsa akuaitan kei ding a, meikuang liakliak amitsak kei ding; thudik in vai ahawm zaw ding hi.
english: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a dimly burning wick. He will faithfully bring justice.

paite: Leitung a vaihawmna a-omsak masiah, amah abah kei ding a, alungdong sam kei ding; tuikulh gamte'n adan thu angak nilouh ding uhi.
english: He will not fail nor be discouraged, until he has set justice on the earth, and the islands wait for his law.”

paite: Pathian, TOUPA, van siampa leh phalhpa, lei leh asung a kipan a pawt tengteng hihlianpa, atung a mite kiang a hatna pepa leh atung a paite kiang a kha pepa'n hichi in achi:
english: God Yahweh, he who created the heavens and stretched them out, he who spread out the earth and that which comes out of it, he who gives breath to its people and spirit to those who walk in it, says:

paite: "Kei TOUPA in diktatna in ka hon sam a, na khut ka len ding a, ka hon humbit ding, mite thukhun hi ding leh Zentelte hihvakpa hi ding in ka hon sep ding a;
english: “I, Yahweh, have called you in righteousness. I will hold your hand. I will keep you, and make you a covenant for the people, as a light for the nations,

paite: mitdelte mit hihvak ding leh mitangte suangkul a kipan pikhe ding leh, mial lak a tute suangkul a pan pikhe ding in.
english: to open the blind eyes, to bring the prisoners out of the dungeon, and those who sit in darkness out of the prison.

paite: "TOUPA ka hi; huai ka min ahi; ka thupina midang kiang ah ka pe kei ding a, phat ka lohna leng milim bawltawmte kiang ah ka pe sam kei ding.
english: “I am Yahweh. That is my name. I will not give my glory to another, nor my praise to engraved images.

paite: Ngai un, tuma thilte ahong tungta, thil thakte gen ka hi; apou ma in nang ka hon hilh hi.
english: Behold, the former things have happened and I declare new things. I tell you about them before they come up.”

paite: Tuipi a hoh sukte leh asung a om tengteng leh tuikulh gamte leh, atung a om tengtengte aw, TOUPA pahtawi in la thak sa unla, kawlmong a kipan in leng amah phatna la sa un.
english: Sing to Yahweh a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is therein, the islands and their inhabitants.

paite: Gamdai leh akhote'n a-aw uh suaksak uhen, Kedarte omna khuate'n; suangpi khua a omte'n nuamsa in la sa uhenla, mual dawn a kipan kikou uhen.
english: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voices, with the villages that Kedar inhabits. Let the inhabitants of Sela sing. Let them shout from the top of the mountains!

paite: TOUPA hih thupi uhenla, tuikulh gamte'n aphatna thu gen uhen.
english: Let them give glory to Yahweh, and declare his praise in the islands.

paite: TOUPA lah mihat mahmah bang in apawt ding a, galdoumi bang in mullitna atokthou ding; akikou ding a, ahi, ngaihtak in akikou ding; amah doute tung ah hattak in agamtang ding.
english: Yahweh will go out like a mighty man. He will stir up zeal like a man of war. He will raise a war cry. Yes, he will shout aloud. He will triumph over his enemies.

paite: Sawtpi ka daita a; ka om kinken in ka kidek teitei; tu'n zaw numei nauvei bang in ka kikou tuaituai ding a; ka nak honhon in ka nak huhu ding.
english: “I have been silent a long time. I have been quiet and restrained myself. Now I will cry out like a travailing woman. I will both gasp and pant.

paite: Tang leh mual pawngte ka hihse ding a, aniam tengteng ka keusak vek ding; luite tuikulh gam in ka bawl ding a, dilte ka kangsak ding.
english: I will destroy mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs. I will make the rivers islands, and will dry up the pools.

paite: Mittawte atheih ngei louh lam uah ka pi ding a, atheih ngei louh uh lampi ah ka pi ding; ama uah mial vak in ka bawl ding a, lam kawinate leng ka tangsak ding. Huai thilte ka hih ding a, amau leng ka nuse kei ding.
english: I will bring the blind by a way that they don’t know. I will lead them in paths that they don’t know. I will make darkness light before them, and crooked places straight. I will do these things, and I will not forsake them.

paite: Milim bawltawmte muang a, milim sunte kiang a, ka pathian uh na hi uh, chite kiheisak in a-om ding ua, nakpitak in azahlak ding uhi."
english: “Those who trust in engraved images, who tell molten images, ‘You are our gods,’ will be turned back. They will be utterly disappointed.

paite: Bilngongte aw, za un; mittawte aw, na muhtheihna ding un en un.
english: “Hear, you deaf, and look, you blind, that you may see.

paite: Ka sikha lou ngal kua mit ataw a? Ahihkeileh, ka sawltak sawl bang in kua bil angong a? Hon kithuahpih mi bang in kua mit ataw a? TOUPA sikha bang in kua mit ataw a?
english: Who is blind, but my servant? Or who is as deaf as my messenger whom I send? Who is as blind as he who is at peace, and as blind as Yahweh’s servant?

paite: Thil tampi na mu a, himahleh na lungsim in na vom gige kei; abilte akihong a, himahleh aza kei hi.
english: You see many things, but don’t observe. His ears are open, but he doesn’t listen.

paite: Dan lah adiktatna ziak a letsak a pahtawisak a om TOUPA'N hoih asa hi.
english: It pleased Yahweh, for his righteousness’ sake, to magnify the law and make it honorable.

paite: Himahleh hiaite zaw guta guksak leh loh tuak mite ahi ua; phaizang a ahi vek ua, suangkul a khummangte ahi ua; sal kaih ding ahi ua, kuamah in lah ahumbit ngal kei ua, gallak a lak ding ahi ua, kuamah in, "Pe nawn in!" achi kei uhi.
english: But this is a robbed and plundered people. All of them are snared in holes, and they are hidden in prisons. They have become captives, and no one delivers, and a plunder, and no one says, ‘Restore them!’

paite: Na lak uah huaite bildoh ding kua na om ua? Hun hong tung ding a dia ngaikhia a za ding kua na om ua?
english: Who is there among you who will give ear to this? Who will listen and hear for the time to come?

paite: Kua'n ahia Jakobte gallak a lak ding a pia a, Israelte gutate kiang a pia? TOUPA, atung a i khelhnapa un, apiak hilou hia? Ama lampi ah apai nuam ngal kei ua. Adan thu amang sam kei uhi.
english: Who gave Jacob as plunder, and Israel to the robbers? Didn’t Yahweh, he against whom we have sinned? For they would not walk in his ways, and they disobeyed his law.

paite: Huaiziak in aheh mahmahna leh kibawlna tha amau tung ah asungbua a, huai in amaute akang a himahleh athei sam kei uh; huai in amaute ahul a, himahleh alungsim un angaihtuah tuan kei uhi.
english: Therefore he poured the fierceness of his anger on him, and the strength of battle. It set him on fire all around, but he didn’t know. It burned him, but he didn’t take it to heart.”

paite: Tu in zaw, Jakob aw, TOUPA nou hon siampa leh, Israel aw, nang hon bawlpa'n, hichi in achi: Lau ke'n, ka hon tanta hi; na min in ka hon sam a, kei a na hi hi.
english: But now Yahweh who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.

paite: Tuite na ngah tan lai in na kiang ah ka om ding a; luite na ngah tan lai in leng ahon tum kei ding hi; mei a na pai tan lai in leng ahon hul kei ding a; meikuang in ahon liau kei ding hi.
english: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.

paite: Kei, TOUPA na Pathian, Israelte Mi Siangthou, nang hon humbitpa ka hi ngal a; na tatna ding in Aigupta gam ka pia a, Ethiopia leh Seba gam na sik in ka pia hi.
english: For I am Yahweh your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I have given Egypt as your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in your place.

paite: Ka ngaih in manpha mahmah na hi a, mizahtakhuai mahmah leng na hi hi, it leng ka hon it ziak in, na sik in mite ka pe ding a, na hinna sik ding in michih ka pe ding hi.
english: Since you have been precious and honored in my sight, and I have loved you, therefore I will give people in your place, and nations instead of your life.

paite: Lau kei in, na kiang ah ka om ngal a; na suante suahlam a kipan ka hon pi ding a, tumlam a kipan ka hon pikhawm ding hi.
english: Don’t be afraid, for I am with you. I will bring your offspring from the east, and gather you from the west.

paite: Mallam kiang ah, khah in, ka chi ding a; simlam kiang ah, len kei in, ka chi ding; ka tapate gamlapi a kipan hon pi inla, ka tanute kawlmong a kipan hon pi in;
english: I will tell the north, ‘Give them up!’ and tell the south, ‘Don’t hold them back! Bring my sons from far away, and my daughters from the ends of the earth—

paite: Ka min po peuhmahte leh ka thupina ding a ka siam peuhmahte; amau ka bawl a, ahi, amau ka suktuahte ahi uhi.
english: everyone who is called by my name, and whom I have created for my glory, whom I have formed, yes, whom I have made.’”

paite: Mit nei ngal a mittawte leh, bil nei ngal a nangongte, pikhia un.
english: Bring out the blind people who have eyes, and the deaf who have ears.

paite: Nam chih kikhawm uhenla, michih omkhawm uhen; alak ua kua ahia hiai gen thei a, tuma lam in thilte hon theisak thei? Siamtansak a a-omtheihna ding un apalaite uh hon pi uhen; ahihkeileh bil in za uhenla, thutak ahi, chi uhen.
english: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the peoples be assembled. Who among them can declare this, and show us former things? Let them bring their witnesses, that they may be justified, or let them hear, and say, “That is true.”

paite: "Noute ka theihpihtute na hi uh" TOUPA'N achi; "Ka sikha ka mitelsate, kei amah ka hi chih thei a, na gintak ua, na theihsiamna ding un. Ka om ma in Pathian bawlkhiak in a-om kei a, ka om nung in leng a-om sam kei ding.
english: “You are my witnesses,” says Yahweh, “With my servant whom I have chosen; that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he. Before me there was no God formed, neither will there be after me.

paite: "Kei, kei mahmah, TOUPA ka hi; keimah lou ngal hondampa a-om kei hi.
english: I myself am Yahweh. Besides me, there is no savior.

paite: Ke'n ka gen a, ka hondam a, ka theisak a, na lak uah gamdang pathian a-om kei hi; huaiziak in noute ka palaite na hi uh, TOUPA'N achi, kei Pathian ka hi.
english: I have declared, I have saved, and I have shown, and there was no strange god among you. Therefore you are my witnesses”, says Yahweh, “and I am God.

paite: Ahi, ni om nungsang kei bamah ka hi; huchi in ka khut a kipan hunkhe thei kuamah a-om kei uh; nna ka sem a, kua'n ahia huai hei ding?
english: Yes, since the day was, I am he. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand. I will work, and who can hinder it?”

paite: TOUPA, nou hon tanpa, Israelte Mi Siangthou in hichi in achi: Nou ziak in Babulon ah sepaihte ka sawl a, huchi in avek un, Kaldaite, akipahna longpi uah taimang mi pi in ka pisuk ding.
english: Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel says: “For your sake, I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring all of them down as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their rejoicing.

paite: Kei TOUPA, na Mi Siangthou uh, Israelte Siampa, na Kumpipa uh ka hi,” chi in.
english: I am Yahweh, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.”

paite: Tuipi a lampi bawlpa leh, tui thupi mahmahte a paina ding bawlpa, TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: Yahweh, who makes a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters,

paite: "Kangtalai leh sakol, sepaihte leh thilhihtheihna a pikhepa'n, huaite alumkhawm zengzung ua, athounawnta kei ding uh; achimit khin ua, khawnvak puan mihsak bang in mihsak in a-omta uh," chi in.
english: who brings out the chariot and horse, the army and the mighty man (they lie down together, they shall not rise; they are extinct, they are quenched like a wick) says:

paite: Tuma lam thilte zaw theigige kei unla, nidanglai thilte ngaihtuah sam kei un.
english: “Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old.

paite: Ngai un, thil thak ka hih ding; tua kipan in adawnkhe ding; huai na thei kei ding ua hia? Gamdai nangawn ah lampi ka bawl ding a, gamkeu ah leng luite ka bawl ding.
english: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

paite: Gamsate'n leng hon pahtawi ding ua, sehalte, vasa ngawngsaute tan in; gamdai a tuite ka omsak ziak leh gamkeu a luite ka omsak ziak in, ka mi, ka telte kiang a dawn ding a piak ding.
english: The animals of the field, the jackals and the ostriches, shall honor me, because I give water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen,

paite: Hiai mite kei a ding in ka bawl a; kei phatna ahihlang ding uhi.
english: the people which I formed for myself, that they might declare my praise.

paite: Himahleh Jakobte aw, nou zaw na hon sam kei ua, Israelte aw, nou zaw nawn chimtak zawta uhi.
english: Yet you have not called on me, Jacob; but you have been weary of me, Israel.

paite: Haltum thillat gannoute na hon lak ngei kei ua; na kithoihnate un na hon pahtawi sam kei uh. Thillat in na ka hon semsak ngei kei a, begaw in ka hon hihgim ngei kei hi.
english: You have not brought me any of your sheep for burnt offerings, neither have you honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense.

paite: Kawltu dangka in na hon leisak ngei kei ua, na kithoihna thaute un na hon taisak ngei kei uh; na khelhnate uh puak nasepte na hon semsak ua, na tatleknate un na hon hihgim zawta uhi.
english: You have bought me no sweet cane with money, nor have you filled me with the fat of your sacrifices, but you have burdened me with your sins. You have wearied me with your iniquities.

paite: Kei, kei mahmah, keimah leh keimah ziak lel a, na tatlekna uh nulmangpa ka hi; na khelhnate uh leng ka theigige nawnta kei ding.
english: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.

paite: Hon theihpih un; ngaihtuah chiat ni; siamtansak a na omtheihna ding un na thu uh gen un.
english: Put me in remembrance. Let us plead together. Declare your case, that you may be justified.

paite: Na pu masapen uh akhial a, na thugen mite uh leng ka tung ah atalek uhi.
english: Your first father sinned, and your teachers have transgressed against me.

paite: Huaiziak in Mun Siangthou a miliante ka hihbuah ding a, huchi in Jakobte hamsethuak ding in ka bawl ding a; Israelte muhdah ding in ka bawl ding hi.
english: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; and I will make Jacob a curse, and Israel an insult.”

paite: Tu in zaw, Jakobte, ka sikhate aw, ka tel Israelte aw, ngaikhia unla;
english: Yet listen now, Jacob my servant, and Israel, whom I have chosen.

paite: TOUPA nou hon siampa, sul a pan nou hon bawlpa, nou hon panpih ding pa'n hichi in achi: "Ka sikha Jakob aw, ka tel nou Jeshurunte aw, lau kei un.
english: This is what Yahweh who made you, and formed you from the womb, who will help you says: “Don’t be afraid, Jacob my servant; and you, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.

paite: "Dangtakmi tung ah tui ka sung ding a, lei keu ah tui luangte ka sung ding; na suante uh tung ah ka kha ka sung ding a, na tate uh tung ah ka vualzawlna ka sung ding hi.
english: For I will pour water on him who is thirsty, and streams on the dry ground. I will pour my Spirit on your descendants, and my blessing on your offspring;

paite: Huchi in amau, tui luanna kiang a singhiang kaite apou bang in, loupa lak ah apou ding uh.
english: and they will spring up among the grass, as willows by the watercourses.

paite: "Mi khat in, TOUPA a ka hi, achi ding a; midang Jakob min in akilou ding a; midang in akhut a, TOUPA, chi a gelh in, Israel min abeh min in azang ding chi in," achi hi.
english: One will say, ‘I am Yahweh’s.’ Another will be called by the name of Jacob; and another will write with his hand ‘to Yahweh,’ and honor the name of Israel.”

paite: TOUPA, Israelte Kumpipa, amau tanpa sepaihte TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Kei amasapen pa ka hi a, ananungpen pa ka hi; keimah lou ngal Pathian a-om kei hi.
english: This is what Yahweh, the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, Yahweh of Armies, says: “I am the first, and I am the last; and besides me there is no God.

paite: Nidanglai a mite ka seh nungsang kei hih bang in kua'n asam dia, huaite kua'n agen dia, kua'n ahia kei sik a akizom zel a hihlang ding? Thil hong tung dingte leh hong om dingte gen hen.
english: Who is like me? Who will call, and will declare it, and set it in order for me, since I established the ancient people? Let them declare the things that are coming, and that will happen.

paite: Lau kei unla, kihta sam kei un; tuma lam in na kiang uah ka gen khin in ka hon theisak khin hilou hia? Noute ka palaite na hi uhi. Keimah lou Pathian a-om hiam? Ahi, Suangpi himhim a-om kei; khat lel leng a-om lam ka thei kei."
english: Don’t fear, neither be afraid. Haven’t I declared it to you long ago, and shown it? You are my witnesses. Is there a God besides me? Indeed, there is not. I don’t know any other Rock.”

paite: Milim bawltawm bawl mite avek un huihkhua lel ahi ua; athil deihlam uh aphatuam kei ding; azahlakna ding un amau palaite un leng amu thei kei ua, atheithei kei uhi.
english: Everyone who makes a carved image is vain. The things that they delight in will not profit. Their own witnesses don’t see, nor know, that they may be disappointed.

paite: Kua'n ahia Pathian bawl? Ahihkeileh, kua'n ahia bangmah ding a phatuamloupi milim bawltawm sung?
english: Who has fashioned a god, or molds an image that is profitable for nothing?

paite: Ngai in, apawlpi tengteng azahlak ding ua; nasem mite leng mihingte lak a mi ahi uh. Avek un kikhawm vek uhenla, dingh uhen; alau ding ua, azahlakkhawm ding uh.
english: Behold, all his fellows will be disappointed; and the workmen are mere men. Let them all be gathered together. Let them stand up. They will fear. They will be put to shame together.

paite: Siksek in heipi asek zel a, meihol ah atholh a sek ding bang in asek a, aban hattak in asek zel; ahi, agil ahong kial a, atha ahong zoi zel; tui adawn kei a, abah nak hi.
english: The blacksmith takes an ax, works in the coals, fashions it with hammers, and works it with his strong arm. He is hungry, and his strength fails; he drinks no water, and is faint.

paite: Singlem bawlmi in khau akaigak a, pensil in ahi ding achiamteh a, nawt mamna in ahihdan ding abawl a, bem bawlna in ahi ding abawl a, mihing lim bang in abawl a, inn a om ding in mihing kilawmna bang in abawl zel hi.
english: The carpenter stretches out a line. He marks it out with a pencil. He shapes it with planes. He marks it out with compasses, and shapes it like the figure of a man, with the beauty of a man, to reside in a house.

paite: Sidar singte akiphuk a, sesing leh tosaw ala a, gammang sing lak a khat amah tuam a om ding in ahihkip a; meilah sing asuan a, vuahtui in avak hi.
english: He cuts down cedars for himself, and takes the cypress and the oak, and strengthens for himself one among the trees of the forest. He plants a cypress tree, and the rain nourishes it.

paite: Huai nung in mi a ding a mei a khul ding ahita ding; huai a kipan in ala a, akihihlum zel; ahi, akuangsak a, tanghou ahai zel hi; ahi, pathian abawl a, abe zel hi; huai sing pen milim bawltawm ding in abawl a, huai bokkhup in abia hi.
english: Then it will be for a man to burn; and he takes some of it and warms himself. Yes, he burns it and bakes bread. Yes, he makes a god and worships it; he makes it a carved image, and falls down to it.

paite: Huai sing khenkhat mei ah akhul a; akhen sa nekna ding in azang a; sa a-em a, atai hi; ahi, meilum a-awi a, "Nuam e, ka lumta, mei mel ka muta e," achi hi.
english: He burns part of it in the fire. With part of it, he eats meat. He roasts a roast and is satisfied. Yes, he warms himself and says, “Aha! I am warm. I have seen the fire.”

paite: Aval pathian ding in abawl a, abawltawm milim mah; huai bokkhup a bia a, akiang ah athum a, "Hon hondam in, ka pathian lah na hi ngal a," achi zel hi.
english: The rest of it he makes into a god, even his engraved image. He bows down to it and worships, and prays to it, and says, “Deliver me, for you are my god!”

paite: Athei kei ua, angaihtuah sam kei uh; ama'n lah amit uh amitsisakta ngal a; atheihsiamlouhna ding un alungtang uh leng akhaksakta hi.
english: They don’t know, neither do they consider, for he has shut their eyes, that they can’t see, and their hearts, that they can’t understand.

paite: Huchi in kuamah in atheikhe nawn kei ua, "Mei ah khenkhat ka khul a; ahi, a-am ah tanghou bang in ka hai a; sa leng ka em a, ka ne a; aval thilkihhuai ding in ka bawl ding hia? Sing a suak bokkhup in ka be ding hia? Hih ding in amau ah theihna leh theihsiamna a-om tuan kei hi."
english: No one thinks, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, “I have burned part of it in the fire. Yes, I have also baked bread on its coals. I have roasted meat and eaten it. Shall I make the rest of it into an abomination? Shall I bow down to a tree trunk?”

paite: Vut kia ane zel a; alungtang khem a om in, ahinna akihumbit theihlouhna ding leh, "Ka khut taklam ah zuau a-om kei a hia?" achih theihlouhna ding in, amah akalsuansakta hi.
english: He feeds on ashes. A deceived heart has turned him aside; and he can’t deliver his soul, nor say, “Isn’t there a lie in my right hand?”

paite: "Jakobte aw, huai thilte theigige un, Israelte aw, nou leng theigige un ka sikhate lah na hi ngal ua; kei bawl na hi ua; ka sikhate na hi uh; Israelte aw, ka mangngilh in na om kei ding uhi. TOUPA, bangkim siamtu leh hondampa.
english: Remember these things, Jacob and Israel, for you are my servant. I have formed you. You are my servant. Israel, you will not be forgotten by me.

paite: "Na tatleknate uh meipi hihmang bang in ka hihmangta a, na khelhnate uh mei hihmang bang in ka hihmang nalai hi; ka kiang ah hong kik nawn un, nou lah ka hon tanta ngal a," chi in.
english: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your sins. Return to me, for I have redeemed you.

paite: "Vante aw, nuamsatak in la sa un, TOUPA'N lah huaite ahihta ngal a; lei nuailamte aw, kikou un, tangte aw, gamnuai leh asung a sing om chiteng aw, la sakhe guih un; TOUPA'N Jakobte atanta a, Israelte ah akipahtawi ding hi."
english: Sing, you heavens, for Yahweh has done it! Shout, you lower parts of the earth! Break out into singing, you mountains, O forest, all of your trees, for Yahweh has redeemed Jacob, and will glorify himself in Israel.

paite: TOUPA, noumau hon tanpa, sul a kipan noute hon bawlpa'n hichi in achi: "Kei zaw TOUPA, thil tengteng siampa, keimah kia a van kaipalhpa, liansakpa ka hi; kua ahia ka kiang a om?
english: Yahweh, your Redeemer, and he who formed you from the womb says: “I am Yahweh, who makes all things; who alone stretches out the heavens; who spreads out the earth by myself;

paite: "Kei lah zuautheite chiamtehnate bangmah lou a bawl a, aisan siamte mihai a bawlpa, mipilte nunglam ngasak a, atheihna uh haihuai a bawlpa.
english: who frustrates the signs of the liars, and makes diviners mad; who turns wise men backward, and makes their knowledge foolish;

paite: "Asikha thu hihkip a, apalaite lemtheih tangtungsakpa, Jerusalem tungthu a, 'Huai ah mi a-om nawn ding uh, chipa leh Judah gam kho tungthu a, Bawl in a-om nawn chiat ding uh, asiatna lailai ka bawl nawn ding,' chipa.
english: who confirms the word of his servant, and performs the counsel of his messengers; who says of Jerusalem, ‘She will be inhabited;’ and of the cities of Judah, ‘They will be built,’ and ‘I will raise up its waste places;’

paite: Tui thuk mahmah kiang a, 'Kangtat in, na luite leng ka kangtatsak ding,' chipa.
english: who says to the deep, ‘Be dry,’ and ‘I will dry up your rivers,’

paite: "Kura tungthu a, 'Amah zaw ka belamchingpa ahi a, Jerusalem tungthu ah, Bawl in a-om nawn ding,' chih leh tempul kiang ah, 'Na suangphum lep in a-om nawn ding, chi khop hial in ka deihlam tengteng a hih ding,' chipa ka hi," chi in.
english: who says of Cyrus, ‘He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure,’ even saying of Jerusalem, ‘She will be built;’ and of the temple, ‘Your foundation will be laid.’”

paite: TOUPA'N athaunilh, Kura, namte ama a phukpai ding leh, kumpipate kawnggakte phelsak ding a, ama a kongkhakte honsak ding leh, kulh kongkhakte khak louh a omsak dingpa, akhut taklam ka letpa kiang ah, hichi in achi:
english: Yahweh says to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have held to subdue nations before him and strip kings of their armor, to open the doors before him, and the gates shall not be shut:

paite: "Kei na ma ah ka pai ding a, aphok lailai ka kibangsak ding; dal kongkhak ka hihse vek ding a, akalhna siktawnte ka tansak ding;
english: “I will go before you and make the rough places smooth. I will break the doors of bronze in pieces and cut apart the bars of iron.

paite: TOUPA, na min a hon sampa, Israel' Pathian ka hi chih na theihtheihna ding in mial lak a goute ka hon pe ding a, mundai a sum selte leng ka hon pe ding.
english: I will give you the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places, that you may know that it is I, Yahweh, who calls you by your name, even the God of Israel.

paite: Jakob ka sikhate leh Israel ka telte ziak in na min in ka hon sam a; hon thei ngei kei mah lechin na min ka hon phuahsak hi.
english: For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel my chosen, I have called you by your name. I have given you a title, though you have not known me.

paite: Keimah TOUPA ka hi, adang himhim a-om kei; keimah lou ngal Pathian a-om kei; hon thei ngei kei mah lechin na tai ka hon gaksak ding hi.
english: I am Yahweh, and there is no one else. Besides me, there is no God. I will strengthen you, though you have not known me,

paite: Keimah lou ngal adang a-om kei chih nisuahna lam a kipan leh tumlam a kipan atheihtheihna ding un. kei TOUPA ka hi, adang himhim a-om kei.
english: that they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is no one besides me. I am Yahweh, and there is no one else.

paite: Vak ka bawl a, mial leng ka bawl hi; kituahna ka bawl a, siatna leng ka bawl hi; kei zaw TOUPA, huchibang thilte hih zelpa ka hi," chi in.
english: I form the light and create darkness. I make peace and create calamity. I am Yahweh, who does all these things.

paite: Vante aw, tunglam a kipan takkhesak un, van dumte'n diktatna sungsuk uhen; hotdamna adotkhiak theihna ding un lei kihong henla, diktatna toh poukhawm hen; kei, TOUPA'N huaite ka siam ahi.
english: Rain, you heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness. Let the earth open, that it may produce salvation, and let it cause righteousness to spring up with it. I, Yahweh, have created it.

paite: Amah bawlpa kinakpihmi tung agik hi! Bellei in avel mi kiang ah, "Bang a hon bawl na hia?" achi dia hia? Ahihkeileh, nna na sep in, "Akhut in siam anei kei?" achi dia hia?
english: Woe to him who strives with his Maker— a clay pot among the clay pots of the earth! Shall the clay ask him who fashions it, ‘What are you making?’ or your work, ‘He has no hands’?

paite: Apa kiang a, "Bang chi suang na hia?" chimi tung hiam, anu kiang a, "Bang toh ahia na hinkhiak ding?" chimi tung agik hi!
english: Woe to him who says to a father, ‘What have you become the father of?’ or to a mother, ‘What have you given birth to?’”

paite: TOUPA, Israelte Mi Siangthou, amau Bawlpa'n hichi in achi: "Thil hong tung ding thu hon dong unla; ka tapate leh ka khut nasepte ah thu hon pia un.
english: Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel and his Maker says: “You ask me about the things that are to come, concerning my sons, and you command me concerning the work of my hands!

paite: Leitung ka bawl a, atung a mihing omte leng ka siam hi; keimah in ka khut ngei in, van ka kaipalh a, asepaihte thu ka pia hi.
english: I have made the earth, and created man on it. I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens. I have commanded all their army.

paite: Kura diktatna nei in ka dingsak a, alampite teng ka tangsak ding; ama'n ka khopi abawl nawn ding a, atatna man uh deih ziak in hilou in, kipahman deih ziak leng hilou in, ka salte apawtsak ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi," chi in.
english: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will make all his ways straight. He shall build my city, and he shall let my exiles go free, not for price nor reward,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, Aigupta semgimte leh Ethiopia sumsinmi leh Saviate misang pipite na kiang uah ahong pai ding ua, nou a ding in a-om ding ua; nou ahon zui ding ua; khainiang bun in ahi ahong pai ding uh; huchi in bokkhup in, Pathian noumau ah a-om hi; adang himhim a-om kei, pathian dang himhim a-om kei, chi in ahong thum ding uhi.
english: Yahweh says: “The labor of Egypt, and the merchandise of Ethiopia, and the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to you, and they will be yours. They will go after you. They shall come over in chains. They will bow down to you. They will make supplication to you: ‘Surely God is in you; and there is no one else. There is no other god.

paite: Israel' Pathian aw, Hondampa, Pathian kisel nakpa na hi ngut hi.
english: Most certainly you are a God who has hidden yourself, God of Israel, the Savior.’”

paite: Zahlaktak in a-om ding ua, ahi, avek un zumtak in a-om ding uh; milim bawl mite zumna ah alut ding uh.
english: They will be disappointed, yes, confounded, all of them. Those who are makers of idols will go into confusion together.

paite: Israelte bel tangtawn hotdamna a TOUPA hotdam in a-om ding uh; tangtawn in na zahlak kei ding ua, na zumsak kei ding uhi.
english: Israel will be saved by Yahweh with an everlasting salvation. You will not be disappointed nor confounded to ages everlasting.

paite: TOUPA van siampa'n, amah Pathian, lei bawl a siampa ahi; ama'n lei akipsak a, bangmah lou ding in abawl kei a, mihing omna ding in abawl a, hichi in achi ngal a; Kei TOUPA ka hi; adang a-om kei.
