english: For Yahweh who created the heavens, the God who formed the earth and made it, who established it and didn’t create it a waste, who formed it to be inhabited says: “I am Yahweh. There is no other.

paite: Aguk in, mun mial ah, thu ka gen ngei kei a; Jakob suante kiang ah bangmah lou ding in hon zong un, ka chi ngei kei; kei TOUPA'N diktatna thu ka gen zel a, thudik mahmahte ka gen zel hi.
english: I have not spoken in secret, in a place of the land of darkness. I didn’t say to the offspring of Jacob, ‘Seek me in vain.’ I, Yahweh, speak righteousness. I declare things that are right.

paite: Kikhawm unla hong pai un; namte lak a gawtna pelte aw, hong pai nai chiat un; asing milim bawltawm tawi a, mi hondam theiloupi pathian kiang a thum zelte'n theihna himhim anei kei uh.
english: “Assemble yourselves and come. Draw near together, you who have escaped from the nations. Those have no knowledge who carry the wood of their engraved image, and pray to a god that can’t save.

paite: Gen unla, hon pawtkhesak un; ahi, kidong uhenla; nidanglai a kipan kua'n ahia theisak? Huai hun lai a kipan kua'n ahia gen? Kei TOUPA'N ka hih ahi kei maw? Keimah lou ngal Pathian dang a-om kei; Pathian diktat leh hondampa ka hi; keimah lou ngal adang a-om kei.
english: Declare and present it. Yes, let them take counsel together. Who has shown this from ancient time? Who has declared it of old? Haven’t I, Yahweh? There is no other God besides me, a just God and a Savior. There is no one besides me.

paite: "Kawlmong a mi tengteng aw, kei lam hong nga unla, hotdam in om un; kei lah Pathian ka hi ngal a, adang himhim a-om kei.
english: “Look to me, and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.

paite: Khuk chih ka ma ah akhukdin ding ua, lei chih in leng ka kiang ah kichiam in thu achiam ding chi in kei-le- kei kilou in ka kichiamta, thu lah diktatna in ka kam a kipan in apawtta a, ahong kik nawnta kei ding.
english: I have sworn by myself. The word has gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and will not be revoked, that to me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall take an oath.

paite: "Mi'n, TOUPA kia ah diktatna leh hatna a-om, chi in ka tanchin agen ding ua; amah kiang ah mi ahong pai ding ua, atung a lungkim lou tengteng zahlaktak in a-omta ding uh.
english: They will say of me, ‘There is righteousness and strength only in Yahweh.’” Even to him will men come. All those who raged against him will be disappointed.

paite: Israel suan tengteng TOUPA ah ahi, siamtansak a a-om ua, TOUPA asuan ding uh," chi in.
english: All the offspring of Israel will be justified in Yahweh, and will rejoice!

paite: Bel akun a, Nebo akihihniam a; amilimte gamsa leh gan tung ah ana omta ua; na thil vakpihte uh vanpuak abawl ua, gamsa bah a ding in van puakgik dia bawl ahi lel hi.
english: Bel bows down. Nebo stoops. Their idols are carried by animals, and on the livestock. The things that you carried around are heavy loads, a burden for the weary.

paite: Ana kihihniam un, ana kun chiat ua, van puakgik lah ahumbit thei ngal kei ua, amau mah sal a pi in a-om zawta uhi.
english: They stoop and they bow down together. They could not deliver the burden, but they have gone into captivity.

paite: Jakob inkuanpihte leh, Israel inkuanpihte lak a khosuaksun tengteng aw, gil a kipan ka hon puak a, sul a pan a ka kithuahpihte aw, ka thu ngaikhia un.
english: “Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been carried from their birth, that have been carried from the womb.

paite: Tekkun a na om tanpha un leng amah ka hi ding a, na lu ua kelsam apou vek hun chiang in leng ka hon pom ding hi; ke'n ka bawl a, kei mahmah in ka po ding; ahi, ke'n ka pom ding a, ka humbit ding.
english: Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.

paite: Kibang a seh ka hihna ding un kua toh na hon teh a, kua kimpih in na hon bawl a, kua toh ahia na hon teh ding?
english: “To whom will you compare me, and consider my equal, and compare me, as if we were the same?

paite: Zaip a kipan dangka-eng bungkhe zel dangka bukna a buk zelten, dangka-eng sekmi achial ua, ama'n huai pathian in abawl a, huchi in abokkhup ua, ahi, abe zel uhi.
english: Some pour out gold from the bag, and weigh silver in the balance. They hire a goldsmith, and he makes it a god. They fall down— yes, they worship.

paite: Aliangzang uah apua ua, apaipih ua, a-omna a kipan asuan nawn kei ding; ahi, min amah asam ding ua, himahleh adawng thei kei ding, amangbatna ua kipan ahunkhe thei kei ding hi.
english: They bear it on their shoulder. They carry it, and set it in its place, and it stands there. It cannot move from its place. Yes, one may cry to it, yet it can not answer. It cannot save him out of his trouble.

paite: Talek mite aw, huai theigige unla, kipasalsak unla, theikhe nawn un,
english: “Remember this, and show yourselves men. Bring it to mind again, you transgressors.

paite: Nidang a thil masate theigige un; kei Pathian ka hi a, adang a-om kei; kei Pathian ka hi, kei bang a-om kei;
english: Remember the former things of old; for I am God, and there is no other. I am God, and there is none like me.

paite: Ke'n atawpna ding uh atung a kipan in ka gen a; pha ka sak adingsuak ding a, ka deihlam tengteng ka hih vek ding, ka chi hi;
english: I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not yet done. I say: My counsel will stand, and I will do all that I please.

paite: Suahlam a kipan vasa duhgawl, khopi gamlapi a pan in ka miseh ka sam ding a; ahi, ka genta, ka tangtungsak ding; ka na tumta, ka hih ding.
english: I call a ravenous bird from the east, the man of my counsel from a far country. Yes, I have spoken. I will also bring it to pass. I have planned. I will also do it.

paite: Lungsim ki-uangsak, diktatna toh kigamlate aw, ka thu ngaikhia un;
english: Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted, who are far from righteousness!

paite: Ka diktatna ka hon tawi nai a, gamla ah a-om kei ding, ka hotdamna in leng sawt ahal kei ding; huchi in ka thupina Israelte a ding in hotdamna Zion ah ka koih ding.
english: I bring my righteousness near. It is not far off, and my salvation will not wait. I will grant salvation to Zion, my glory to Israel.

paite: Babulon tanu nungak siangthou aw, hong suk inla, leivui ah tu in; Kaldai tanu aw, laltutphah tel lou in lei lak ah tu in; awm nou leh nuamsa hon chi nawn lou ding uhi.
english: “Come down and sit in the dust, virgin daughter of Babylon. Sit on the ground without a throne, daughter of the Chaldeans. For you will no longer be called tender and delicate.

paite: Buh gawizanna suangte la inla, tangbuang bawl in; na kikhuhna puan koih inla, na tentual lem inla, na khe hong inla, luite ngap galkah in.
english: Take the millstones and grind flour. Remove your veil, lift up your skirt, uncover your legs, and wade through the rivers.

paite: Na vuaktanna khuh louh in a-om ding a, ahi, na zahmoh adawk ding; phu ka la ding a, mi kuamah ka kithuahpih kei ding.
english: Your nakedness will be uncovered. Yes, your shame will be seen. I will take vengeance, and will spare no one.”

paite: Ahon tanpa, amin Sepaihte' TOUPA ahi, Israelte Mi Siangthou.
english: Our Redeemer, Yahweh of Armies is his name, is the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Kaldai tanu aw, dai dide in tu inla, mial nuai ah lut in, Gam chih lalnu hon chita kei ding uh TOUPA'N achi.
english: “Sit in silence, and go into darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans. For you shall no longer be called the mistress of kingdoms.

paite: Ka mite tung ah ka heh a, ka goutan ka hihthanghuai a, na khut ah ka hon pia hi; nang atung uah zahngaihna na langsak kei a; tek lamte tung ah nangawn ah na hakkol giktak na nga ahi.
english: I was angry with my people. I profaned my inheritance and gave them into your hand. You showed them no mercy. You laid a very heavy yoke on the aged.

paite: Kei tangtawn in lalnu ding in ka om ding, na chi a; huchi in huai thilte na lungsim in na ngaihtuah kei a, atawpna ding na theigige sam kei hi.
english: You said, ‘I will be a princess forever,’ so that you didn’t lay these things to your heart, nor did you remember the results.

paite: Huchi in nang nuamtat a om, awlmoh nei lou a om, lungsim a, "Keimah ka hi, keimah lou midang a-om kei, meithai in ka tu kei ding a, tate tan thu ka thei sam kei ding," chinu, hiai thei in;
english: “Now therefore hear this, you who are given to pleasures, who sit securely, who say in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no one else besides me. I won’t sit as a widow, neither will I know the loss of children.’

paite: Hiai thil nih, tate tanna leh meithaina in, ni khat thu in mitphiat kal lou in ahon pha ding a; na bumna zatna tamngial in, na kivenna tamkuam mahleh, huaite nakpitak in na tung ah ahong tung ding hi.
english: But these two things will come to you in a moment in one day: the loss of children and widowhood. They will come on you in their full measure, in the multitude of your sorceries, and the great abundance of your enchantments.

paite: Na gitlouhna muang a; "Kuamah in hon mu kei uh," na chi vial ngal a; na pilna leh na theihna in hon hihsia hi; na lungsim in, "Keimah ka hi, kei lou midang a-om kei," na chi behlap hi.
english: For you have trusted in your wickedness. You have said, ‘No one sees me.’ Your wisdom and your knowledge has perverted you. You have said in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no one else besides me.’

paite: Huaiziak in thil hoih lou na tung ah ahong tung ding a; na vengsiam kei ding; vangtahna in ahon buak ding a; huai na hihmang thei kei ding; siatna leng thakhat in na tung ah hong tung guih ding a; huai na theikhol kei ding.
english: Therefore disaster will come on you. You won’t know when it dawns. Mischief will fall on you. You won’t be able to put it away. Desolation will come on you suddenly, which you don’t understand.

paite: Na kikauna leh bumna na zatna, valnou na hih a kipan a na kisukgimnate, dinpih inla; na phattuampih theih ding phot a, na zohpih theih ding photleh.
english: “Stand now with your enchantments and with the multitude of your sorceries, in which you have labored from your youth, as if you might profit, as if you might prevail.

paite: Na lemtheihna atam mahmah ziak in na gimta hi; tu in van thu theite, aksi en mite, kha teng a thugenkhol mite ding uhenla, na tung a thil hong tung dingte lak a kipan in hon hong uhen.
english: You are wearied in the multitude of your counsels. Now let the astrologers, the stargazers, and the monthly prognosticators stand up and save you from the things that will happen to you.

paite: Ngai in, buhpawl bang lel ahi ding ua; mei in akang ding; meikuang thilhihtheihna lak a kipan akihumbit kei ding uh; hihlumna ding meihol bang ahi kei ding a, awi ding mei bang ahi sam kei ding.
english: Behold, they are like stubble. The fire will burn them. They won’t deliver themselves from the power of the flame. It won’t be a coal to warm at or a fire to sit by.

paite: Huchibang in na kihihgim nakna thilte nang a ding in a-om ding uhi; na naupan nou a kipan a na lak a sumsin mite amau lampi chiat ah avakmang ding ua; hon humbit ding kuamah himhim a-om kei ding uh.
english: The things that you labored in will be like this: those who have trafficked with you from your youth will each wander in his own way. There will be no one to save you.

paite: Aw Jakob inkuan, Aw Israel min kikoppih, Judah tuite a pan a pawt, thutak hilou, diktatna ah hi sam lou, TOUPA min lou a kichiam a, Israel' Pathian min lou zelte aw, hiai ngaikhia un.
english: “Hear this, house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel, and have come out of the waters of Judah. You swear by Yahweh’s name, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness—

paite: Khopi siangthou a mi akichi ngal ua, Israel' Pathian tung ah ginna anga ua; amin sepaihte' TOUPA ahi.
english: for they call themselves citizens of the holy city, and rely on the God of Israel; Yahweh of Armies is his name.

paite: Atung a kipan in thil masate ka gen a; ahi, ka kam a kipan in apawt a, ka theisak a; thakhat in ka tangtungsak guih a, ahong tung hi.
english: I have declared the former things from of old. Yes, they went out of my mouth, and I revealed them. I did them suddenly, and they happened.

paite: Migenhak na hi uh, na ngawng uh sik tha ahi, na tal uh dal ahi chih ka theih ziak in,
english: Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow bronze;

paite: Nidanglai a kipan na kiang uah ka genta; ahong tun ma in na kiang uah ka hon theisakta hi; huchi lou in zaw, "Ka milim in ahih ahi, ka milim bawltawm leh ka milim sun in thu apiak ahi,” na chi kha ding uh.
english: therefore I have declared it to you from of old; before it came to pass I showed it to you; lest you should say, ‘My idol has done them. My engraved image and my molten image has commanded them.’

paite: "Na zata uh, hiaite tengteng en un, noumau na genta kei ding ua hia? Tua kipan in thil thak ka hon theisak ding a, thil kisel na theih ngeilouhte uh.
english: You have heard it. Now see all this. And you, won’t you declare it? “I have shown you new things from this time, even hidden things, which you have not known.

paite: Huaite nidanglai a siam hilou in, tu a siam ahi; tuni ma in na bil un na za ngei kei uh; huchi lou in zaw, 'Ngai in, huaite i theihsa ahi, na chi kha ding uh.’
english: They are created now, and not from of old. Before today, you didn’t hear them, lest you should say, ‘Behold, I knew them.’

paite: Ahi, na bil un na za ngei kei ua; ahi, na lungsim un na thei ngei kei uh, ahi, nidanglai a kipan in na bil uh hon in a-om ngei kei him hi; lepchiahtak in na hih zel uh chih leh, sul a kipan in talek mi ahon chi him uh chih lah ka thei ngal a.
english: Yes, you didn’t hear. Yes, you didn’t know. Yes, from of old your ear was not opened, for I knew that you dealt very treacherously, and were called a transgressor from the womb.

paite: "K'on hihmanlouhna ding in ka min ziak in ka hehna ka hawi lai ding a, phat ka lohna ding in na tung uah ka kidek ding.
english: For my name’s sake, I will defer my anger, and for my praise, I hold it back for you so that I don’t cut you off.

paite: Ngai un, ka hon hihsiang ahi, himahleh dangka hihsiang bang in ahi kei; haksatna haltuina mei ah ka hon chian hi.
english: Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver. I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction.

paite: Kei leh kei ziak in, ahi, kei leh kei ziak lel in ahi ka hih ding; bang ding in ka min suksiat in a-om dia? Ka thupina midang kiang ah ka pe kei ding.
english: For my own sake, for my own sake, I will do it; for how would my name be profaned? I will not give my glory to another.

paite: Jakob leh ka sap Israel aw, ka thu ngaikhia un; kei amah ka hi; amasapen ka hi, ananungpen leng ka hi.
english: “Listen to me, O Jacob, and Israel my called: I am he. I am the first. I am also the last.

paite: Ahi, ka khut in lei kingakna aphum a, ka khut taklam in avante akaipalh a; ka saptak in adingkhawm zel uh.
english: Yes, my hand has laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand has spread out the heavens. when I call to them, they stand up together.

paite: "Noute aw, kikhawm unla, ngaikhia un; alak uah kua'n hiai thil agen dia? TOUPA'N amah a-it a; ama'n Babulon tung ah adeihlam ahih ding a, Kaldaite tung ah aban lik in a-om ding.
english: “Assemble yourselves, all of you, and hear! Who among them has declared these things? He whom Yahweh loves will do what he likes to Babylon, and his arm will be against the Chaldeans.

paite: Kei, keimah ngei in, thu ka genta; ahi, amah ka sam a, ka pi a, alampi alamzangsak ding.
english: I, even I, have spoken. Yes, I have called him. I have brought him and he shall make his way prosperous.

paite: Noute'n hon naih unla, hiai ngaikhia un; atung a kipan in asim in thu ka gen ngei kei; a-om tung lai a kipan in huai ah ka om; tu in Toupa PATHIAN in keimah leh ama Kha hon sawlta hi."
english: “Come near to me and hear this: “From the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time that it happened, I was there.” Now the Lord Yahweh has sent me with his Spirit.

paite: TOUPA, nou hon tanpa, Israelte Mi Siangthou in hichi in achi: "Kei, TOUPA na Pathian uh, na hoihna ding ua hon chilpa, na paina ding lampi ua hon pipa ka hi."
english: Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says: “I am Yahweh your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by the way that you should go.

paite: "Aw noute'n ka thupiakte na ngaikheta hi le uchin, na tung ua lemna lui bang mai a om ding a, na diktatna uh tuipi kihawtte bang mai a om ding hiven maw;
english: Oh that you had listened to my commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river and your righteousness like the waves of the sea.

paite: Na suante uh piaunel zah pha ding ua, na gil ua gahte leng piaunel mal neu chikchik zah a pha ding ua; amin uh ka ma a kipan thaimang in a-om kei ding, hihman in leng a om sam kei ding," chi in.
english: Your offspring also would have been as the sand and the descendants of your body like its grains. His name would not be cut off nor destroyed from before me.”

paite: "Babilon a kipan pawt unla, Kaldaite taimangsan un; hiai lasak husa in genzak in, hilh unla, kawlmong pha in gingsak un, TOUPA'N asikha Jakobte atanta!" chi un.
english: Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! With the sound of joyful shouting announce this, tell it even to the end of the earth; say, “Yahweh has redeemed his servant Jacob!”

paite: Gamdai a api lai in adangtak kei ua; suangpi a pan in amaute a ding in tuite aluangkhesak a; suangpi aphelkhap a, huchi in tui ahong pawtkhia hi.
english: They didn’t thirst when he led them through the deserts. He caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them. He also split the rock and the waters gushed out.

paite: "TOUPA'N, mithulimloute a ding in muanna himhim a-om kei," achi hi.
english: “There is no peace”, says Yahweh, “for the wicked.”

paite: Tuikulh a gamte aw, ka thu ngaikhala, gamlapi a michih aw, ngaikhia un; TOUPA'N sul a kipan ahon sap ka hi; ka nu gilsung a pan in ka min agenta hi.
english: Listen, islands, to me. Listen, you peoples, from afar: Yahweh has called me from the womb; from the inside of my mother, he has mentioned my name.

paite: Ka kam namsau hiam bang in abawl a, akhut ah ahon sel a; thal nawttet vilvel in hon bawl a, athalbawm ah ahon khum a;
english: He has made my mouth like a sharp sword. He has hidden me in the shadow of his hand. He has made me a polished shaft. He has kept me close in his quiver.

paite: Ka kiang ah, "Nang zaw ka sikha na hi; Israel pahtawi a ka omna ding na hi,” achi a.
english: He said to me, “You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will be glorified.”

paite: Ke'n bel, "Athawn in ka semgim a, bangmah lou ding leh huihkhua lel ding in ka thapai; himahleh pel lou in ka tung a vaihawmna ding TOUPA kiang ah ahi a-om, hon ditna ding leng ka Pathian kiang ah ahi a-om," ka chi a.
english: But I said, “I have labored in vain. I have spent my strength in vain for nothing; yet surely the justice due to me is with Yahweh, and my reward with my God.”

paite: Huan tu in TOUPA, Jakobte akiang a pi nawnna ding leh Israelte akiang pikhawm a a-omna ding un, asikha a om ding a sul a kipan a hon bawlpa'n agen, TOUPA mitmuh in mizahtakhuai ka hi ngal a, ka Pathian ka hatna ahi behlap hi.
english: Now Yahweh, he who formed me from the womb to be his servant, says to bring Jacob again to him, and to gather Israel to him, for I am honorable in Yahweh’s eyes, and my God has become my strength.

paite: Ahi, ama'n, "Jakob namte tundinna ding leh Israelte lak a humbitte a-omsak nawnna ding in, ka sikha a na om zaw, thil neuchik mahmah ahi lai; Zentelte vaksakpa ding in ka hon sep ding, kawlmong pha a hondampa dia na omtheihna ding in," achi a.
english: Indeed, he says, “It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel. I will also give you as a light to the nations, that you may be my salvation to the end of the earth.”

paite: TOUPA, Israelte tanpa leh a Mi Siangthou un, mite muhsitpa, namte kih tuntun, vaihawmte sikha kiang ah hichi in achi: "Muanhuai TOUPA, Israelte Mi Siangthou, nang hon telpa ziak in Kumpipate'n amu ding ua, athou ding uh; miliante'n amah abe ding uh," chi in.
english: Yahweh, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, says to him whom man despises, to him whom the nation abhors, to a servant of rulers: “Kings shall see and rise up, princes, and they shall worship, because of Yahweh who is faithful, even the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hun kipahhuai ah ka hon dawng a, hotdamna ni ah ka hon panpih hi; ka hon hawi ding a, mipite thukhunna ding in ka hon pe ding, lei dingkipsak a, gouluah nutsiatsa luahsak ding in;
english: Yahweh says, “I have answered you in an acceptable time. I have helped you in a day of salvation. I will preserve you and give you for a covenant of the people, to raise up the land, to make them inherit the desolate heritage,

paite: Suangkul tangte kiang a, Pawt un, mial a omte kiang a, Hong kilang un, na chih theihna ding in. Lampite ah ane zel ding ua, tang sang mai pengpongte ah atatna mun uh a-om ding hi.
english: saying to those who are bound, ‘Come out!’; to those who are in darkness, ‘Show yourselves!’ “They shall feed along the paths, and their pasture shall be on all treeless heights.

paite: Agilkial un adangtak kei ding ua; kholum a bawlgim in ni in leng ahai sam kei ding hi; amaute itpa in api ding a, tui nak nei kiang ah api ding hi.
english: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun strike them, for he who has mercy on them will lead them. He will guide them by springs of water.

paite: "Huchi in ka tang tengteng lampi ding in ka bawl ding a, ka lamliante leng sansak in a-om ding uh.
english: I will make all my mountains a road, and my highways shall be exalted.

paite: En in, hiaite gamlapi a kipan in ahong pai ding ua; en in hiaite mallam a kipante, tumlam a kipante in ahong pai ding uh; Sinim gam a kipan in ahong non pai ding uhi.
english: Behold, these shall come from afar, and behold, these from the north and from the west, and these from the land of Sinim.”

paite: Vante aw, nuamtak in la sa un; lei aw, nuamsa in om in; tangte aw, la sakhe guih un; TOUPA'N lah amite alungmuan ngal a, a mi haksa thuakte leng ahehpih ding hi.
english: Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth! Break out into singing, mountains! For Yahweh has comforted his people, and will have compassion on his afflicted.

paite: Himahleh Zion in, "Jehovah in ahon paisan a, TOUPA'N ahon mangngilhta," achi hi.
english: But Zion said, “Yahweh has forsaken me, and the Lord has forgotten me.”

paite: "Numei in atapa, agilgah ngei, hehpihlouhna ding in anau nawi ne lai amangngilh thei a hia! Thei e, huaite'n zaw amangngilh uh ahi thei, himahleh ke'n zaw ka hon mangngilh kei ding hi.
english: “Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you!

paite: En in, ka khutpek ah ka hon gelh a; na kulhbaangte ka ma ah a-om gige hi.
english: Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands. Your walls are continually before me.

paite: Na tate akin ua, hon hihmang mite leh hon hihse mite'n ahon pawtsan ding uh.
english: Your children hurry. Your destroyers and those who devastated you will leave you.

paite: Dak inla, en vialvial inla, en in; hiai tengteng akikhawm ua, na kiang ah ahong pai uhi. Kei ka hin bang in, nang pahtawina kisilh bang in hiaite na kisilh a, mou akigak bang in hiaite in na kigak ngei ding," TOUPA'N achi.
english: Lift up your eyes all around, and see: all these gather themselves together, and come to you. As I live,” says Yahweh, “you shall surely clothe yourself with them all as with an ornament, and dress yourself with them, like a bride.

paite: "Na mun sia leh nutsiatsate leh na gam hihmansa thu zaw tu in a-omte a ding in na neu lota ngeingei ding a, nang hon valhte gamlapi ah a-omta ding uh.
english: “For, as for your waste and your desolate places, and your land that has been destroyed, surely now that land will be too small for the inhabitants, and those who swallowed you up will be far away.

paite: Na ta mansak nung a na ta neih nawnte'n, 'Kei a ding in mun aneu lua a; ka omna ding in mun hon pia in,' chi in na bil ah ahon gen ding uh.
english: The children of your bereavement will say in your ears, ‘This place is too small for me. Give me a place to live in.’

paite: Huchi in nang na lungsim in: 'Hiaite kua'n hon suaksak ua eita? Ka tate ka mangsak a, keimah kia sal a vialvak ka hi a; huchi in hiaite kua'n akem ua eita? Ngai in, keimah kia a nutsiat in ka om ngal a, hiaite koi a na om uh ahia? na chi ding, " chi in.
english: Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who has conceived these for me, since I have been bereaved of my children and am alone, an exile, and wandering back and forth? Who has brought these up? Behold, I was left alone. Where were these?’”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, "Ngai in, namte a ding a khut zak in, michih a ding in ka chiamtehna ka takkhe ding; huchi in na tapate angpom in na kiang ah ahon pi ding ua, na tanute leng liangkolou a suan a pi in a-om ding uh.
english: The Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I will lift up my hand to the nations, and lift up my banner to the peoples. They shall bring your sons in their bosom, and your daughters shall be carried on their shoulders.

paite: Kumpipate na tate donpate ahi ding ua, kumpinute na tate donnute ahi ding uh; amau amai ua lei si in ahon be ding ua, na khe a leivui aliak ding uh; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih na thei mai ding, hon ngak mite zahlak in a-om kei ding uh.
english: Kings shall be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down to you with their faces to the earth, and lick the dust of your feet. Then you will know that I am Yahweh; and those who wait for me won’t be disappointed.”

paite: "Gallakte mihattak a kipan suh a om in, sal lauhuaite hotkhiak in a-om ding uam?"
english: Shall the plunder be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captives be delivered?

paite: Om na ke, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Mihattak salte suh in a-om ding ua, milauhuai gallakte hotkhiak in a-om ding; nang hon doute dou ding ka hi ngal a, na tate leng ka hondam ding hi.
english: But Yahweh says, “Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the plunder retrieved from the fierce, for I will contend with him who contends with you and I will save your children.

paite: Nang hon simmohte amau sa ka nesak ding; uain khum kham bang in amau sisan akham ding uh; huchi in mi tengteng in, kei TOUPA nangmah Hondampa leh nangmah Tanpa, Jakob Mihat ka hi chih, athei ding uh," chi in.
english: I will feed those who oppress you with their own flesh; and they will be drunk on their own blood, as with sweet wine. Then all flesh shall know that I, Yahweh, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.”

paite: Ka it luat thu, agrephuan tungtang thu, ka it luat a ding in la in ka sata mai ding. Ka it luat in lei hoihna mahmah mual ah grephuan anei hi.
english: Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful hill.

paite: Akimvel in lei atoukuak a, asuangte atomsiang a, grepgui hoihpen asuan a, alai ah insang alam a, huai ah grep sukna khuk leng atou hi. Huchi in grep gah a gah ding in alamen a, himahleh grep tak lou ahong gah maimah hi.
english: He dug it up, gathered out its stones, planted it with the choicest vine, built a tower in the middle of it, and also cut out a wine press in it. He looked for it to yield grapes, but it yielded wild grapes.

paite: Tu in, Jerusalem a omte leh Judah mite aw, "Hehpih in kei leh ka grephuan kal thu hon ngaihtuah dih ve ua.
english: “Now, inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, please judge between me and my vineyard.

paite: Tua grephuan ah ka hihsa akan-aval atung ah hih nawn lailai ding bangbang om ahita mai a? Bangziak in ahia, grep gah a gah ding a ka lamet et toh, grep tak lou ahong gah maimah?
english: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? Why, when I looked for it to yield grapes, did it yield wild grapes?

paite: "Tu in ngai un, ka grephuan tung ah ka hih ding ka hon hilh ding; aling dai ka lamang ding a, nekgaih in a-om ding; asuangdai ka chimsak ding a, sikden in a-om ding.
english: Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled down.

paite: Huan ka hihse vek ding a; satnou in om ke'n chin, tohvui in leng om sam ke'n teh; loulingnei leh khaulingneite apou zaw ding; meite leng atung a vuah zusak lou ding in thu ka pe ding," achi hi.
english: I will lay it a wasteland. It won’t be pruned or hoed, but it will grow briers and thorns. I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain on it.”

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA grephuan Israel inkuanpihte ahi a, Judah mite akung deihhuai ahi uhi. Vaihawmna diktat alamen a; himahleh, ngai in, nuaisiahna ahong om zawta ahi; diktatna alamen a, himahleh, ngai in, kikou husa ahong om zawta hi.
english: For the vineyard of Yahweh of Armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant. He looked for justice, but behold, oppression, for righteousness, but behold, a cry of distress.

paite: Gam laizang a amau kia a-omtheihna ding ua mi om samna ding mun himhim om lou khop hial a inn leh inn kizomsak zel leh lou leh lou kizom sakte tung agik hi.
english: Woe to those who join house to house, who lay field to field, until there is no room, and you are made to dwell alone in the middle of the land!

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N ka bil ah hichibang in achi, “Innte tampi, lian pipite kilawm pipi, ateng ding om lou in ahawm vek ngeingei ding.
english: In my ears, Yahweh of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate, even great and beautiful, unoccupied.

paite: Grephuan tin sawm mun ah bath khat kia suak ding in akisa a, buhchi homer khat tuh in ephah khat kia suak ding in lah akisa ngal a," chi in.
english: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield an ephah.”

paite: Zu delh ding a zingkhang pipi a thou a, uain in akhamgawpsak mateng zan sawt pipi tan a-omsakte atung uh agik hi.
english: Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink, who stay late into the night, until wine inflames them!

paite: Tumging leh kaihgingte, khuangta leh tamngaite, uain toh ankuangluinate uah a-om sek a, himahleh TOUPA nasep angaisang kei ua, akhut thilhihte leng, angaihtuah ngei kei uhi.
english: The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don’t respect the work of Yahweh, neither have they considered the operation of his hands.

paite: Huaiziak in ka mite zaw, theihna aneih louh ziak un, sal a pi in a-om ua; amizahtakhuaite uh gil akial a, amipite uh dangtak in adang uh akeugawpta hi.
english: Therefore my people go into captivity for lack of knowledge. Their honorable men are famished, and their multitudes are parched with thirst.

paite: Huaiziak in Sheol in agilkialna ana liansak a, akam teh vual louh khop in akata a; huchi in athupinate uh, amipite uh, athupina mahmahte un, alak ua kipaktak a omte toh alutsuk ngoingoi uhi.
english: Therefore Sheol has enlarged its desire, and opened its mouth without measure; and their glory, their multitude, their pomp, and he who rejoices among them, descend into it.

paite: Mineute kunsak in a-om ua, miliante niamsak in a-om ua, kisatheite sukniam in a-omta uhi.
english: So man is brought low, mankind is humbled, and the eyes of the arrogant ones are humbled;

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA bel vaihawmna a tawisang in a-om zawta, Pathian, Mi Siangthou, diktatna a hihsiangthou in a-omta hi.
english: but Yahweh of Armies is exalted in justice, and God the Holy One is sanctified in righteousness.

paite: Huan belamnoute atatna mun ua ata bang un ata diamdiam ding ua, mithau pipite mun sesa a thilte vakvaite'n ane ding uhi.
english: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture, and strangers will eat the ruins of the rich.

paite: Zuautheihna khaute a thulimlouhna kai a, khauzen a kangtalai kaih bang a khelhna kai sekte tung agik hi!
english: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and wickedness as with cart rope,

paite: I muhna ding in hih meng henla, athilhih ding hihkin heh; i theihna ding in Israelte Mi Siangthou lemtheih hong nai in hong tung hen, chi gigete ngei.
english: who say, “Let him make haste, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, that we may know it!”

paite: Thil hoih lou thil hoih chi a, thil hoih lah thil hoih lou chi zel a, vak mial a ngai a, mial vak a ngaisek a, thil khum thil kha a ngai a, thil kha thil khum a ngaisekte atung uh agik hi.
english: Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!

paite: Amau pil a kingaihtuahte leh amau mitmuh a teite atung uh agik hi!
english: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!

paite: Uain dawn lam a mihattak, zu hel lam a thagui nei mite atung uh agik!
english: Woe to those who are mighty to drink wine, and champions at mixing strong drink;

paite: Golh nek ziak a migilou siamtangsak sek a, midiktat diktatna laksak sekte ngei.
english: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice for the innocent!

paite: Huaiziak in meikuang in buhpawl aliah bei dundun sek bang in leh loupa keu meikuang a apuk zungzung sek bang in azung ua muatna bang in a-om ding a, apak uh leivui bang in atungkah lunglung ding; Sepaihte' TOUPA dan adeih louh ua, Israelte Mi Siangthou thu angaihneu ziak un.
english: Therefore as the tongue of fire devours the stubble, and as the dry grass sinks down in the flame, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust, because they have rejected the law of Yahweh of Armies, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA amite tung ah aheh mahmah a, atung uah akhut alik a, avua a, huchi in mualte ah aling vonvon ua, aluangte uh kongzing lak ah nin bulom bang in a-om venvon hi. Huchi tel a ahih in leng ahehna lah adai kei a, akhut alik lailai hi.
english: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burns against his people, and he has stretched out his hand against them and has struck them. The mountains tremble, and their dead bodies are as refuse in the middle of the streets. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is still stretched out.

paite: Gamlatak a om namte a ding in chiamtehna atakkhe ding a, kawlmong a kipan sam ding in asingsit ding; huchi in ngai in, amaute kintak in ahong pai pah ding uh.
english: He will lift up a banner to the nations from far away, and he will whistle for them from the end of the earth. Behold, they will come speedily and swiftly.

paite: Amau lak ah kuamah agim kei ding ua, akisui sam kei ding uh; kuamah alusu kei ding ua, a-ihmu sam kei ding uh; akawnggak uh lah phelkol in a-om kei ding a, akhedap gakna leng atan sam kei ding hi.
english: No one shall be weary nor stumble among them; no one shall slumber nor sleep, neither shall the belt of their waist be untied, nor the strap of their sandals be broken,

paite: Athalte uh azum mahmah a, athalpeu tengteng uh lai sa in a-om keukou a; asakol chinte uh meisah suang abang a, akangtalai khete uh leng pingpei abang hi.
english: whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent. Their horses’ hoofs will be like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind.

paite: Ahusa ging honhon uh humpinelkai humham bang mai ahi. Humpinelkai lun lai humham bang mai in aging honhon hi; ahi, aging honhon a, asamat ding uh aman ua, bittak in apaimangpih ua, kuamah in ahunkhe thei kei hi.
english: Their roaring will be like a lioness. They will roar like young lions. Yes, they shall roar, and seize their prey and carry it off, and there will be no one to deliver.

paite: Huai ni in tuipi ging hawhaw bang in atung uah aging hawhaw ding uh. Huchi in mi'n gam ahon et uleh, ngai in, mial leh mangbatna ngen ahi a, vak lah huai ameite a hihmial in a-om hi.
english: They will roar against them in that day like the roaring of the sea. If one looks to the land, behold, darkness and distress. The light is darkened in its clouds.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Na nu uh makna lai, ka makna, koi a om ahia? Ahihkeileh, ka leibatnate akua pen kiang ah ahia ka hon zuaktak? Ngai un, na thulimlouhnate uh ziak a na nu uh mak a om ahi.
english: Yahweh says, “Where is the bill of your mother’s divorce, with which I have put her away? Or to which of my creditors have I sold you? Behold, you were sold for your iniquities, and your mother was put away for your transgressions.

paite: "Bangziak in ahia ka hong pai a mi himhim a-om louh uh? Bangziak in ahia ka sap a hon dawng ding a-om louh uh? Ka khut hotdam theih louh ding in tomsak in a-om himhim a hia? Ahihkeileh, humbit ding in thilhihtheihna ka nei kei a hia? Ngai un, ka salhna in tuipi ka kangsak a, luipite gamkeu in ka bawl hi; tui himhim a-om louh ziak in angasate a-uih ua, dangtak in asi uh.
english: Why, when I came, was there no one? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it can’t redeem? Or have I no power to deliver? Behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea. I make the rivers a wilderness. Their fish stink because there is no water, and die of thirst.

paite: "Van mial in ka thuam a, akhuhna ding in sai-ip puan ka bawl zel," chi in.
english: I clothe the heavens with blackness. I make sackcloth their covering.”

paite: Mi gimtak thu a ka tawldamsak siamna ding in sinsakte lei Toupa PATHIAN in ahon pia; ama'n zingsang teng a phawng in, sinsakte atheih bang ua thei ding in ka bil aphawng zel.
english: The Lord Yahweh has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him who is weary. He awakens morning by morning, he awakens my ear to hear as those who are taught.

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in ka bil ahon vangsak a, kei zaw ka hel kei, ka lehngat sam kei hi.
english: The Lord Yahweh has opened my ear. I was not rebellious. I have not turned back.

paite: Ka nungzang sat mite ka doh a, ka biang mul bot mite ka doh hi; zahlakna ah leh chilsiatna ah ka mai ka sel kei.
english: I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn’t hide my face from shame and spitting.

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in ahon panpih ding a; huaiziak in ka zum kei a; huaiziak in meisah suang bang in ka nga zel a, ka zahlak kei ding chih ka thei.
english: For the Lord Yahweh will help me. Therefore I have not been confounded. Therefore I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I won’t be disappointed.

paite: Siam hon tangsakpa anai hi; kua'n ahia hon dou ding? Dingkhawm ni ung; hon dou kua ahia? Hon naih mah hen aw.
english: He who justifies me is near. Who will bring charges against me? Let us stand up together. Who is my adversary? Let him come near to me.

paite: Ngai in, Toupa PATHIAN in hon panpih ding; kua'n ahia siam louh hon tangsak ding? Ngai in, huaite puansilh bang in alui ding ua, kausi in anese ding.
english: Behold, the Lord Yahweh will help me! Who is he who will condemn me? Behold, they will all grow old like a garment. The moths will eat them up.

paite: Na lak ua, TOUPA kihta a, asikha thu mang, kua ahia? Mial nuai a khosa, vakna himhim nei lou in TOUPA min muang henla, a Pathian ah kinga hen.
english: Who among you fears Yahweh and obeys the voice of his servant? He who walks in darkness and has no light, let him trust in Yahweh’s name, and rely on his God.

paite: Mei toh a, mei-ekte a ki-umte aw, ngai un; na meikuang uah leh na mei-ek halte uh lak ah vak un. Hiai ka khut a kipan a na muh ding uh ahi hi; lungkhamtak a na lupna ding uh.
english: Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who adorn yourselves with torches around yourselves, walk in the flame of your fire, and among the torches that you have kindled. You will have this from my hand: you will lie down in sorrow.

paite: Diktatna delh mite, "Nou, TOUPA zong mite aw, ka thu ngaikhia un: noute sekna suangpi lam leh noute tohkhiakna kokhuk lam en un.
english: “Listen to me, you who follow after righteousness, you who seek Yahweh. Look to the rock you were cut from, and to the quarry you were dug from.

paite: Na pu uh Abraham lam leh noute hon suangnu Sarah lam en un; khat kia ahih lai in ka sam a, ka vualzawl a, mi tampi ding in ka bawlta hi.
english: Look to Abraham your father, and to Sarah who bore you; for when he was but one I called him, I blessed him, and made him many.

paite: "Na TOUPA'N Zion alungmuanta ngal a; amun sesate tengteng alungmuan a, Eden bang in agamdai abawl a, agamkeu leng TOUPA huan bang in abawl hi; huai ah kipahna leh nopsaknate, kipahthu genna leh lasak husate a-om ding hi.
english: For Yahweh has comforted Zion. He has comforted all her waste places, and has made her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of Yahweh. Joy and gladness will be found in them, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.

paite: "Ka mite aw, ka thu ngaikhia unla; ka namte aw, ka thu bil na doh un; kei a pan in dan thu ahong pawt ding a, michih vakna ding in ka vaihawmna ka kipsak ding.
english: “Listen to me, my people; and hear me, my nation, for a law will go out from me, and I will establish my justice for a light to the peoples.

paite: Ka diktatna anai a, ka hotdamna apawtta, ka bante'n michih vai ahawmsak ding, tuikulh gamte'n ahon ngak ding ua, ka ban amuang ding uh.
english: My righteousness is near. My salvation has gone out, and my arms will judge the peoples. The islands will wait for me, and they will trust my arm.

paite: Van lam ah daktou unla, nuailam ah lei en un; van meikhu bang in azammang ding a, puansilh bang in leitung alui ding, asung a omte huchibang in asi ding uh; ka hotdamna bel tangtawn in a-om ding, ka diktatna leng hihman in a-om kei ding.
english: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look at the earth beneath; for the heavens will vanish away like smoke, and the earth will wear out like a garment. Its inhabitants will die in the same way, but my salvation will be forever, and my righteousness will not be abolished.

paite: "Diktatna theimi, ka dan thu lungtang a pai mite aw, ka thu ngaikhia un; mihing gensiatna lau kei unla, ahon tainate uh ziak in lunghimoh kei un.
english: “Listen to me, you who know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law. Don’t fear the reproach of men, and don’t be dismayed at their insults.

paite: Sim in puansilh anekgawp vek bang in, amaute anegawp vek ding, nget in samul anek bang in, amaute ane ding; ka diktatna tangtawn in a-om ding a, ka hotdamna suan tengteng tan in a-om ding.
english: For the moth will eat them up like a garment, and the worm will eat them like wool; but my righteousness will be forever, and my salvation to all generations.”

paite: "AW TOUPA ban aw, halh inla, hatna kisilh in; nidanglai a, tang a suante om lai a na halh bang in halh in. Nang Rahab satzanpa, dragon sunpa na hi kei a hia?
english: Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of Yahweh! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Isn’t it you who cut Rahab in pieces, who pierced the monster?

paite: Nang tuipi, tui thuk zapi tui kangsakpa, tatsate paisuakna lampi ding a tuipi taw bawlsakpa na hi kei a hia?
english: Isn’t it you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep; who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed to pass over?

paite: TOUPA tatsate akik nawn ding ua, la sa kawm in Zion atung ding ua; tangtawn a kipahna alutung uah a-omta ding; kipahna leh nopsakna amu ding ua, lungkhamna leh mauna amangta ding.
english: Those ransomed by Yahweh will return, and come with singing to Zion. Everlasting joy shall be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy. Sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

paite: "Kei, kei mahmah, nou lungmuanpa ka hi; si ding mihing kihta ding, loupa bang a bawl ding mihing tapa kihta ding nang kua hi na hia;
english: “I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who will be made as grass?

paite: Na TOUPA nang hon Bawlpa, van kaipalh a lei kingaknate phumpa, mangngilh a, nuaisiahmi hihse ding a angim lai hehna ziak lel a nitum a lau? Nuaisiah mi hehna koi a om ahita a?
english: Have you forgotten Yahweh your Maker, who stretched out the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth? Do you live in fear continually all day because of the fury of the oppressor, when he prepares to destroy? Where is the fury of the oppressor?

paite: Sal pimang kintak a khah in a-om ding a, suangkul ah asi kei dia, an nek ding atasam kei ding hi.
english: The captive exile will speedily be freed. He will not die and go down into the pit. His bread won’t fail.

paite: "Kei na TOUPA na Pathian, tuipi kihot ging honhonte khen a tuipi tokletpa ka hi ngal a; ka min sepaihte' TOUPA ahi.
english: For I am Yahweh your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar. Yahweh of Armies is his name.

paite: Van ka kaihpalh a, lei kingaknate ka phum theih a, Zionte kiang a, ka mite na hi uh, ka chih theihna ding in ka thute na kam ah ka koih a, ka khut in ka hon hum hi.
english: I have put my words in your mouth and have covered you in the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and tell Zion, ‘You are my people.’”

paite: Jerusalem aw, Na TOUPA khut a kipan ahehna nou dawnnu, halh inla, thou in; nang hoihoina nou a anengte na dawn a, na dawn siang sipsip hi.
english: Awake, awake! Stand up, Jerusalem, you who have drunk from Yahweh’s hand the cup of his wrath. You have drunken the bowl of the cup of staggering, and drained it.

paite: Atapa suan tengteng lak a pi ding kuamah a-om kei ua; atapa vaklet teng lak ah akhut a len kuamah a-om kei uh.
english: There is no one to guide her among all the sons to whom she has given birth; and there is no one who takes her by the hand among all the sons whom she has brought up.

paite: "Hiai thil nihte'n ahon phat ahi; kua'n ahon kahpih ding ua? Gamna leh siatna leh kial, leh namsau; bangchi in ka hon lungmuan diam aw?
english: These two things have happened to you— who will grieve with you?— desolation and destruction, and famine and the sword. How can I comfort you?

paite: Na tapate abah ua, sathak len a awk bang in, kongzing lu lam ah alum uhi; TOUPA hehna leh na Pathian salhna in adim uhi.
english: Your sons have fainted. They lie at the head of all the streets, like an antelope in a net. They are full of Yahweh’s wrath, the rebuke of your God.

paite: "Huaiziak in nang hihgentheih leh uain kham hilou a mi kham, hiai za in.
english: Therefore now hear this, you afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:

paite: Na TOUPA Jehovah, na Pathian, amite thu genpihpa'n, hichi in achi, 'Ngai in, hoihoina nou, ka hehna nou belhbu ngei, na khut a kipan ka lakheta; na dawn nawnta kei ding,'
english: Your Lord Yahweh, your God who pleads the cause of his people, says, “Behold, I have taken out of your hand the cup of staggering, even the bowl of the cup of my wrath. You will not drink it any more.

paite: Huchi in nang hon hihgentheite khut ah ka koih ding; mamau na hinna kiang ah, 'K'on tot ding un bokkhup un,' achi uh; huchi in atawn mite kiang ah na nungzang lei leh kongzing bang in na doh," chi in.
english: I will put it into the hand of those who afflict you, who have said to your soul, ‘Bow down, that we may walk over you;’ and you have laid your back as the ground, like a street to those who walk over.”

paite: Zion aw, halh in, halh in, na hatna silh in; Jerusalem aw, khopi siangthou, na puansilh kilawmtakte silh in; tuban zeksum louh leh minin na sung ah alutta kei ding uh.
english: Awake, awake! Put on your strength, Zion. Put on your beautiful garments, Jerusalem, the holy city, for from now on the uncircumcised and the unclean will no more come into you.

paite: Jerusalem aw, na tung a bang leivui sing in; thou inla, tu in; Zion tanu aw, sal a om, na ngawng gaknate phel in.
english: Shake yourself from the dust! Arise, sit up, Jerusalem! Release yourself from the bonds of your neck, captive daughter of Zion!

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi ngal a: "Bangmah lou a zuak na hi ua; huchi in dangka lou a tat na hita ding uh," chi in.
english: For Yahweh says, “You were sold for nothing; and you will be redeemed without money.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, "Ka mite atung in Aigupta gam a om ding in apaisuk ua; Assuria mite'n athu-ala bei in anuaisiah uhi.
english: For the Lord Yahweh says: “My people went down at the first into Egypt to live there; and the Assyrian has oppressed them without cause.

paite: Tu a, ke'n hiai a bang ahia ka neih?" "Ka mite bangmah lou in pimang in a-om ua," TOUPA'N achi. Atung ua vaihawmte nuam in a-awng ua, TOUPA'N achi, "Ni tumtum in ka min gensiat in a-om hi.
english: “Now therefore, what do I do here,” says Yahweh, “seeing that my people are taken away for nothing? Those who rule over them mock,” says Yahweh, “and my name is blasphemed continually all day long.

paite: Huaiziak in ka mite'n ka min athei ding uh; huai ni in agenpa ka hi chih athei ding ua; ngai in, keimah ka hi," chi in.
english: Therefore my people shall know my name. Therefore they shall know in that day that I am he who speaks. Behold, it is I.”

paite: Tangte a tanchinhoih tun a, lemna thu tangkoupih a, thil hoih tanchinhoih tun a, hotdamna thu tangkoupih a, Zion kiang a, "Na Pathian kumpi in atu, chimi khe akilawm hi!
english: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news, who proclaims salvation, who says to Zion, “Your God reigns!”

paite: Ngai in! na galvil mite'n aw suah in, nuamsatak in la asa chiat uh; TOUPA Zion a ahong kik nawn chiang a kimaituah a mu ding ahi ngal ua.
english: Your watchmen lift up their voice. Together they sing; for they shall see eye to eye when Yahweh returns to Zion.

paite: Jerusalem mun sesate aw, nuam sakhe guih unla, nuamsatak in la sa un; TOUPA'N amite alungmuanta a, Jerusalem atanta hi.
english: Break out into joy! Sing together, you waste places of Jerusalem; for Yahweh has comforted his people. He has redeemed Jerusalem.

paite: TOUPA'N nam chih mitmuh in aban siangthou alemta; huchi in kawlmong a mi tengteng in i Pathian hotdamna amu ding uh.
english: Yahweh has made his holy arm bare in the eyes of all the nations. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

paite: Pawt un, pawt un, huai a kipan in pawt un, thilnin himhim lawng kei un; asung a kipan paikhia un; TOUPA belsuan tawite aw, siangthoutak in om un.
english: Depart! Depart! Go out from there! Touch no unclean thing! Go out from among her! Cleanse yourselves, you who carry Yahweh’s vessels.

paite: Kintak in na paikhe kei ding ua, taikek in na pai sam kei ding uh; TOUPA'N na ma uh pi ding ahi ngal a; Israel' Pathian na nungdal uh ahi ding hi.
english: For you shall not go out in haste, neither shall you go by flight; for Yahweh will go before you, and the God of Israel will be your rear guard.

paite: Ngai in, ka sikha in piltak in ahih ding, pahtawi leh tawisang in a-om ding a, sangpi in a-om ding.
english: Behold, my servant will deal wisely. He will be exalted and lifted up, and will be very high.

paite: Mi tampi'n lamdang honsak bang un, amel mihing mel sang in asesak zaw a, apiandan lah mihing tate piandan sang mah ahihsiat in a-om.
english: Just as many were astonished at you— his appearance was marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men—

paite: Huchi in ama'n nam tampi tung ah sisan atheh ding; Kumpipate'n amah lak ah akam uh achih ding uh; akiang ua gen ngei louh amu ding ua; bil a azak ngei louh uh angaisiam ding uhi.
english: so he will cleanse many nations. Kings will shut their mouths at him; for they will see that which had not been told them, and they will understand that which they had not heard.

paite: I thugen uh kua'n agingta a? TOUPA khut kua kiang ah ahia akihil?
english: Who has believed our message? To whom has Yahweh’s arm been revealed?

paite: Ama ah thilpou noutak bang in amah lah adawnkhia a, lei keu a pan zung bang in akhangkhia hi; piandan hoihna leh mel kilawmna himhim anei kei a; amah i muh un amah i deihna ding un kilawmna himhim a-om kei hi.
english: For he grew up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of dry ground. He has no good looks or majesty. When we see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.

paite: Amah mihingte muhsit leh deih louh in a-om a; dahnate neimi leh natna thei mi ahi a; amah lak a i mai uh sel bang i hi ua, muhsit in a-om a, e'n lah amah i ngaisang tuan kei uhi.
english: He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom men hide their face; and we didn’t respect him.

paite: Ama'n i natnate pua in, i dahnate leng apo ngei a; himahleh e'n bel dahna khu, Pathian vuak, hihgentheih in i bawl ngal ua.
english: Surely he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering; yet we considered him plagued, struck by God, and afflicted.

paite: Ahih hang in i tatleknate ziak in amah liam in a-om a, i thulimlouhnate ziak in vuak sidup in a-om a; i lungmuanna ding in atung ah sawina akia a; avuakna golhte a hihdam in i omta hi.
english: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.

paite: I vek un belam bang in i vakmang ua; eimah lampi tuam chiat uah i pialta uh; TOUPA'N amah tung ah i vek ua thulimlouhna angata hi!
english: All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and Yahweh has laid on him the iniquity of us all.

paite: Amah nuaisiah in a-om a, himahleh akingainiam a, akam aka kei; belamnou goh ding api uh bang leh, belam amulmet mite ma a adai dide bang mai in; ahi, akam aka kei hi.
english: He was oppressed, yet when he was afflicted he didn’t open his mouth. As a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and as a sheep that before its shearers is silent, so he didn’t open his mouth.

paite: Nuaisiahna leh vaihawmna a lakmang in a-om a; adam tonpihte'n houh kua'n ahia mihing gam a kipan hihman a a-om ngaihtuah mahmah? Ka mite tatlekna ziak a dahna khu ahih.
english: He was taken away by oppression and judgment. As for his generation, who considered that he was cut off out of the land of the living and stricken for the disobedience of my people?

paite: Huan hiamgam ahih ngei kei a, akam ah zekhemna om ngei kei mahleh, ahan migiloute kiang ah asehsak ua, asih nung in mihausa kiang ah a-om hi.
english: They made his grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in his death, although he had done no violence, nor was any deceit in his mouth.

paite: TOUPA'N, amah vuak sidup a-ut him ahi; adahsakta ngei a; ahinna khelhna a dia thillat ding a na zat peuhpeuh chiang in, achisuan amuta ding a, adamsung nite asausak ding, TOUPA deihlam akhut ah lohching in a-om ding hi.
english: Yet it pleased Yahweh to bruise him. He has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he will see his offspring. He will prolong his days and Yahweh’s pleasure will prosper in his hand.

paite: Akha nauvei gim gah amu ding a, alungkimta ding; ka sikha diktattak in atheihna in mi tampi'n siam atang ding ua, athulimlouhnate uh apuaksak ding.
english: After the suffering of his soul, he will see the light and be satisfied. My righteous servant will justify many by the knowledge of himself; and he will bear their iniquities.

paite: Huaiziak in miliante tantuan amah ka hawm ding a, gallak sumte ama'n mihatte ahawm sam ding hi; ahinna pen si khop hial a asunbuak a, talekte lak a simtel a a-om ziak in; himahleh mi tampi khelhna apua a, talekte athumsak hi.
english: Therefore I will give him a portion with the great. He will divide the plunder with the strong, because he poured out his soul to death and was counted with the transgressors; yet he bore the sins of many and made intercession for the transgressors.

paite: "Aw chiing, nang ta nei ngei lou, nuamsatak in la sa in; nang, nauvei ngei lou, la sakhe guih in, kikoukhia in; pasal neimi tate sang in lunglengnu tate lah atamzaw ngal ua," TOUPA'N achi.
english: “Sing, barren, you who didn’t give birth! Break out into singing, and cry aloud, you who didn’t travail with child! For more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife,” says Yahweh.

paite: Na puanin mun kek in, na omnate puanin tung kaipalh in; chil ke'n; na khaute sausak inla, na kaihgakna khette kipsak in.
english: “Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch out the curtains of your habitations; don’t spare; lengthen your cords, and strengthen your stakes.

paite: Taklam leh veilam ah na dalhzak sin ngal a; huchi in na chisuante'n namte' gou aluah ding ua, khopi loih sa nungte ah mi a- omsak nawn ding uh.
english: For you will spread out on the right hand and on the left; and your offspring will possess the nations and settle in desolate cities.

paite: "Lau ke'n, na zahlak kei ding; zum sam ke'n, zahlak in na om sin kei hi; na tuailai zahlakna na mangngilh in, na meithaina minsiatna na theigigeta kei ding hi.
english: “Don’t be afraid, for you will not be ashamed. Don’t be confounded, for you will not be disappointed. For you will forget the shame of your youth. You will remember the reproach of your widowhood no more.

paite: Nang hon bawlpa na pasal ahi a; amin sepaihte' TOUPA, Israelte Mi Siangthou nang hon tanpa ahi; amah leitung pumpi Pathian achi ding uh.
english: For your Maker is your husband; Yahweh of Armies is his name. The Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer. He will be called the God of the whole earth.

paite: "Zi mak lungsim a lungkhamtak, tuailai zi khensa, paihsa nung sap nawn bang in TOUPA'N nang ahon sam ahi, na Pathian in achi hi.
english: For Yahweh has called you as a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit, even a wife of youth, when she is cast off,” says your God.

paite: Mitphiat kal lel ka hon ma a; himahleh hehpihna thupitak in ka hon pi nawn ding.
english: “For a small moment I have forsaken you, but I will gather you with great mercies.

paite: Ka heh dimlet in mitphiat kal na lak ah ka mai ka sel a; himahleh tangtawn zahngaihna in ka hon hehpih ding," TOUPA nang hon Tanpa'n achi hi.
english: In overflowing wrath I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting loving kindness I will have mercy on you,” says Yahweh your Redeemer.

paite: "Huai lah kei a ding in Noah dam lai nite bang ahi a; Noah tuite'n leitung atummang nawn kei ding, chi a, ka kichiam bang in, Na tung ah ka heh nawn kei ding a, ka hon sal nawn kei ding, chi in ka kichiamta ahi.
english: “For this is like the waters of Noah to me; for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah will no more go over the earth, so I have sworn that I will not be angry with you, nor rebuke you.

paite: Tangte apaimang ding ua, mual neute leng suan in a-om ding uh; ka zahngaihna ahihleh nang a kipan in apaimang kei ding a, ka lemna thukhun leng suan in a-om sam kei ding," TOUPA hon hehpihpa'n achi hi.
english: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed,” says Yahweh who has mercy on you.

paite: "Aw nang hihgentheih, tuikihot sepsep, lungmuanna nei lou, ngai in na suangte zehoih in ka lem ding, na suangphumte sapphir suang in ka lem ding hi.
english: “You afflicted, tossed with storms, and not comforted, behold, I will set your stones in beautiful colors, and lay your foundations with sapphires.

paite: Na tungzumte rubi suang in, na kongkhakte karbankul suang in, na kulh tengteng suang hoihte in ka bawl ding.
english: I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.

paite: "Na ta tengteng TOUPA chil in a-om ding ua; na tate lungmuanna thupitak ahi ding.
english: All your children will be taught by Yahweh, and your children’s peace will be great.

paite: Diktatna a kipsak in na om ding a, nuaisiahna a pan gamlapi ah na om ding, na lau kei ding hi; thil mulkimhuai a pan gamlapi ah na om ding a, ahon naih kei ding hi.
english: You will be established in righteousness. You will be far from oppression, for you will not be afraid, and far from terror, for it shall not come near you.

paite: Ngai in, ahong kikhawm uh ahi thei, himahleh ka thu ahi kei ding; nang sual ding a kikhawm peuhmahte nang ziak in apuk ding uh.
english: Behold, they may gather together, but not by me. Whoever gathers together against you will fall because of you.

paite: "Ngai in, ke'n siksekmi pumzap anasepna ding vanzat sek zel mi ka siam a; kei mahmah in hihse ding in hihsemi ka siam ding hi.
english: “Behold, I have created the blacksmith who fans the coals into flame, and forges a weapon for his work; and I have created the destroyer to destroy.

paite: Nang sualna ding avanzat sek himhim aphatuam kei ding; lei chih thubuai a nang hon lang siam louh na tangsak ding a, Huai TOUPA sikhate goutan ahi a, adiktatna uh ka kiang a kipan ahi," TOUPA'N achi.
english: No weapon that is formed against you will prevail; and you will condemn every tongue that rises against you in judgment. This is the heritage of Yahweh’s servants, and their righteousness is of me,” says Yahweh.

paite: Ngai un, dangtak peuhmahte aw, tuite ah hong pai un, dangka neiloute; hong pai unla, lei unla ne un! Ahi, hong pai unla, uain leh nawitui dangka pe lou in, aman leng pe lou in lei un.
english: “Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

paite: An hiloupi a bang ding a dangka pai? Niang leh taina hilou a bang ding a na tha uh pai? Ka thuhoihtak in ngaikhia unla, thil hoih ne un, na hinna uh thil thau in nuamsa hen.
english: Why do you spend money for that which is not bread, and your labor for that which doesn’t satisfy? Listen diligently to me, and eat that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in richness.

paite: Na bil uh doh unla, ka kiang ah hong pai un; za unla, huchi in na hinna uh ahing ding; na kiang uah tangtawn thu ka khung ding, David kiang a huai hehpihna chiamte.
english: Turn your ear, and come to me. Hear, and your soul will live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.

paite: Ngai in, michih a ding in amah palai in ka sep a, michih a ding in makai leh heutu in ka sep ahi.
english: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander to the peoples.

paite: Ngai in, na theih ngei louh na sam ding a, nang hon thei ngei lou namte na kiang ah ahong tai ding uh, TOUPA na Pathian ziak leh Israelte Mi Siangthou ziak in; ama'n ahon pahtawi ngal a.
english: Behold, you shall call a nation that you don’t know; and a nation that didn’t know you shall run to you, because of Yahweh your God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he has glorified you.”

paite: Muh theih a a-om lai in TOUPA zong unla, anai lai in amah sam un;
english: Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.

paite: Migilou in a-omdan tawpsan henla, midiktat lou in angaihtuahnate tawpsan sam hen; TOUPA kiang ah kik nawn hen, huchi in ama'n atung ah zahngaihna asuah ding; i Pathian kiang uah kik nawn hen, ama'n angaidam mahmah ding hi.
english: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy on him, to our God, for he will freely pardon.

paite: Ka ngaihtuahte na ngaihtuahte ahi kei a, na omdante leng ka omdan ahi sam kei, TOUPA'N achi.
english: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says Yahweh.

paite: Leitung sang a vante asa zawk bang in, ka omdante na omdan sang in asangzaw hi, ka ngaihtuahte leng na ngaihtuahte uh sang in asang lai hi.
english: “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

paite: Vuah leh vuk van a kipan azu a, huai lam ah akiktou ngei kei, lei avak zaw hi, thil apousak in adawnsak a, buhchi thehmi kiang ah buhchi apia a, nemi kiang ah nek ding ape zel hi.
english: For as the rain comes down and the snow from the sky, and doesn’t return there, but waters the earth, and makes it grow and bud, and gives seed to the sower and bread to the eater;

paite: Huchi mah bang in ka kam a kipan ka thupawt a-om ding; bangmah hih nei lou in ka kiang ah akik nawn kei ding a, ka deih bang ahihzou zaw ding a, thilhih ding a ka sawlna ah leng alohching ding.
english: so is my word that goes out of my mouth: it will not return to me void, but it will accomplish that which I please, and it will prosper in the thing I sent it to do.

paite: Nuam satak a pawt in, lungmuangtak a pikhiak a om ding na hi ngal ua; tangte leh mual neute'n na ma uah la asakhe guih ding uh, gamlak sing tengteng in leng akhut uh abeng ding uh.
english: For you shall go out with joy, and be led out with peace. The mountains and the hills will break out before you into singing; and all the trees of the fields will clap their hands.

paite: Loulingnei tang in meilah apou zaw ding a, khaulingnei tang in muising apou zaw ding; huai TOUPA minhoihna ding leh tangtawn chiamtehna hihman a om lou ding ahi ngal a.
english: Instead of the thorn the cypress tree will come up; and instead of the brier the myrtle tree will come up. It will make a name for Yahweh, for an everlasting sign that will not be cut off.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Vaihawm zui unla, diktak in hih un; ka hotdamna ahong tung dek in, ka diktatna ahong tung dekta hi.
english: Yahweh says: “Maintain justice and do what is right, for my salvation is near and my righteousness will soon be revealed.

paite: Huchibang hihmi leh huaitak pom geih mihing tapa in nuam asa hi; Sabbath buahsak a, tang zel leh hoih lou hih lou ding a akhut venghoihmi ngei."
english: Blessed is the man who does this, and the son of man who holds it fast; who keeps the Sabbath without profaning it and keeps his hand from doing any evil.”

paite: Huan gamdangmi, TOUPA toh kizommi in, TOUPA'N amite lak ah hon hihtuam ding, chi keileh; michilgeh in, “En in, singkeu ka hi, chi sam keileh.
english: Let no foreigner who has joined himself to Yahweh speak, saying, “Yahweh will surely separate me from his people.” Do not let the eunuch say, “Behold, I am a dry tree.”

paite: Ka Sabbathte tang a, ka kipahpih lam thilte tel a, ka thukhun pomkip michilgehte tungtang thu ah TOUPA'N hichi in achi ngal a;
english: For Yahweh says, “To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, choose the things that please me, and hold fast to my covenant,

paite: akiang uah ka insung leh ka kulh sungte a tanu leh tapa neite sang mah in theihgigena hoihzaw leh minhoihzaw ka pe ding; akiang uah tangtawn min, hihman nawn louh ding, ka pe ding," chi in.
english: I will give them in my house and within my walls a memorial and a name better than of sons and of daughters. I will give them an everlasting name that will not be cut off.

paite: "Gamdang mite leng, Sabbath tang lou lou a, tang zel leh ka thukhun pomkip peuhmah, TOUPA nasem ding leh TOUPA min it ding leh asikhate a om ding a TOUPA toh kizom peuhmahte;
english: Also the foreigners who join themselves to Yahweh to serve him, and to love Yahweh’s name, to be his servants, everyone who keeps the Sabbath from profaning it, and holds fast my covenant,

paite: amaute mah ka tang siangthou ah ka pi ding a, ka thumna inn ah nuam ka sasak ding; halmang a athillatte uleh akithoihnate uh ka maitam a kipahpih in a-om ding; ka inn michih a ding a thumna inn chi ding uh ahi ngal a," chi in.
english: I will bring these to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all peoples.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN, delhkhiak Israelte pikhawmpa'n, "Amah a pikhawm a omte lou leng namdangte akiang ah ka pikhawm lai ding," achi hi.
english: The Lord Yahweh, who gathers the outcasts of Israel, says, “I will yet gather others to him, in addition to his own who are gathered.”

paite: Gamsa tengteng aw, ahi, gamnuai a sa om tengteng aw, ne ding in hong pai un.
english: All you animals of the field, come to devour, all you animals in the forest.

paite: Agalvil mite amit uh ataw a, theihna nei lou ngen ahi ua; ui aw nei lou ngen ahi ua, ana thei kei uh; mang nei a, lum gige a, lup hai mi ahi uh.
english: His watchmen are blind. They are all without knowledge. They are all mute dogs. They can’t bark— dreaming, lying down, loving to slumber.

paite: Ahi, amaute ui duhgawlte ahi ua; hunsak chih anei ngei kei uh; theihsiamna nei lou belampu ahi ua, avekpi un amau lampi, amau punna lam chiat anga uhi.
english: Yes, the dogs are greedy. They can never have enough. They are shepherds who can’t understand. They have all turned to their own way, each one to his gain, from every quarter.

paite: "Hong pai un," chi in "Uain ka la ding a huchi in zu in i kithundim ding; zingchiang tuni bang ahi nawn ding a, ni thupi mahmah ahi ding," achi chiat uhi.
english: “Come,” they say, “I will get wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and tomorrow will be as today, great beyond measure.”

paite: Midiktat amang zel a, kuamah in alungsim un angaihtuah kei uh, Pathian limsak mite lakmang in a-om ua, midiktat thil hoih lou hong tung ding a kipan lakmang ahi uh chih kuamah in angaihtuah kei uhi.
english: The righteous perish, and no one lays it to heart. Merciful men are taken away, and no one considers that the righteous is taken away from the evil.

paite: Lungmuanna ah alut ua; alupnate uah alum tawldam zel ding uh, diktak a pai peuhmahte.
english: He enters into peace. They rest in their beds, each one who walks in his uprightness.

paite: Himahleh nou bumsiamnu tapa, angkawm leh kizuak suante aw, hiai ah hon naih un.
english: “But draw near here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes.

paite: Nuihza bawlna dia na zat zel uh kua eita? Kua na maiphen khum ua, na lei khatkhum ua? Tatlekna ta, zuautheihna suante na hi kei uh maw?
english: Whom do you mock? Against whom do you make a wide mouth and stick out your tongue? Aren’t you children of disobedience and offspring of falsehood,

paite: Nou tosaw lak a, singbuk nuai teng a milimte toh kithoh a suangpi kawl lak nuai a phaizang sung a naupang that zelte.
english: you who inflame yourselves among the oaks, under every green tree; who kill the children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?

paite: Lui Phaizang suang mam lak ah na tantuan a-om a; huaite, huaite ngeingei na tantuan ahi; huaite a ding in dawn thillat na sung a, thilpiak na lan hi. Huai thil ah hihlungkim in ka om ding hia?
english: Among the smooth stones of the valley is your portion. They, they are your lot. You have even poured a drink offering to them. You have offered an offering. Shall I be appeased for these things?

paite: Tang sang zou mahmah tung ah na lupna na koih a; huai lai mah ah kithoihna lan ding in na hohtou zel hi.
english: On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed. You also went up there to offer sacrifice.

paite: Huan kongkhakte leh kongbiang liahte ah na theihgigena na tung a; kei a ding hilou in midang a ding in na kisuah a, na hohtou ngal a; na lupna na kek a, akiang uah thu na khung a; alupna uh lah na muhna ah na it hi.
english: You have set up your memorial behind the doors and the posts, for you have exposed yourself to someone besides me, and have gone up. You have enlarged your bed and made a covenant for yourself with them. You loved what you saw on their bed.

paite: Huan sathau toh kumpipa kiang ah na hoh a, na gimlimte lah na bawl thupi diakdiak a, gamlapi ah na palaite na sawl a, sheol pha hial in na niamsak hi.
english: You went to the king with oil, increased your perfumes, sent your ambassadors far off, and degraded yourself even to Sheol.

paite: Na paina lampi sau ziak in na gim a; himahleh, “Lametna himhim a-om kei, na chi ngal kei a; na hatna halhsakna na mu a; huaiziak in na bahta kei hi.
english: You were wearied with the length of your ways; yet you didn’t say, ‘It is in vain.’ You found a reviving of your strength; therefore you weren’t faint.

paite: "Kua na kihta in na lau, zuau na gen nak a, kei na hon theih tak louh a, na lungsim a na ngaihtuah tak louh mai? Sawtpi ka dai dide kei maw? Kihtak leng na hon kihtak louh, TOUPA'N achi.
english: “Whom have you dreaded and feared, so that you lie, and have not remembered me, nor laid it to your heart? Haven’t I held my peace for a long time, and you don’t fear me?

paite: Na diktatna leh na thilhihte ka gen ding; bangmah lah na loh tak kei dia.
english: I will declare your righteousness; and as for your works, they will not benefit you.

paite: Na kikou chiang in na lak khawmte'n hon humbit uheh; himahleh huih in amaute ala ding a, hu in amut vek ding; kei hon muang in bel gam anei ding a, ka tang siangthou aluah ding.
english: When you cry, let those whom you have gathered deliver you, but the wind will take them. A breath will carry them all away, but he who takes refuge in me will possess the land, and will inherit my holy mountain.”

paite: Ama'n, "Sungvum un, sungvum un, lampi bawl un, ka mite lampi bawl un, ka mite lampi a kipan pukna ding pai un," TOUPA'N achi.
english: He will say, “Build up, build up, prepare the way! Remove the stumbling-block out of the way of my people.”

paite: Mitungnung, tawisang, tang-tawn a om, amin Siangthou in hichi in achi ngal a, “Kei mun tungnung leh siangthou ah ka om a, mithunuailutte lungsim hihhalh ding leh kisik tuntunte lungtang hihhalh ding in mi lungsim a kisik tuntun a thunuailuttak kiang ah leng ka om hi.
english: For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also who is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite.

paite: Tangtawn a dou lou ding ka hi, ka heh gige sam kei ding hi; huchi keileh mi lungsim ka ma ah abah ding a, hinna ka bawlte leng abah ding uh.
english: For I will not contend forever, neither will I always be angry; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls whom I have made.

paite: Ahuaiham a athulimlouhna ziak in ka heh a, ka sat a, ka mai ka hum a, ka heh ahi; amah lah alungtang omdan ngeingei in paupengtak in a-om hi.
english: I was angry because of the iniquity of his covetousness and struck him. I hid myself and was angry; and he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.

paite: "A-omdante ka mu a, amah ka damsak ding; ka pi ding a, amah leh asuunpih mite kiang ah lungmuanna ka pe nawn ding.
english: I have seen his ways, and will heal him. I will lead him also, and restore comforts to him and to his mourners.

paite: Ke'n muk gah ka siam hi. Lemna, lemna, gamlapi a om kiang ah leh naichik a om kiang ah om hen," TOUPA'N achi, “Amah ka damsak ding.
english: I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is far off and to him who is near,” says Yahweh; “and I will heal them.”

paite: Mithulimloute bel tuipi kihot gige bang ahi uh; a-om kinken thei ngei kei a, atuite'n lah nin leh buannawi avikkhe zel uh," chi in.
english: But the wicked are like the troubled sea; for it can’t rest and its waters cast up mire and mud.

paite: Ka Pathian in, “Mithulimloute a ding in muanna himhim a-om kei," achi hi.
english: “There is no peace”, says my God, “for the wicked.”

paite: Ngaihtak in kikou inla, kidam ke'n, pengkul bang in na aw suaksak loloih inla, ka mite kiang ah atatlekna uh hilh inla, Jakob inkuanpihte kiang ah akhelhnate uh hilh in.
english: “Cry aloud! Don’t spare! Lift up your voice like a trumpet! Declare to my people their disobedience, and to the house of Jacob their sins.

paite: Zon zaw niteng in ahon zong zel ua, ka lampi thute theih akilawp ua; diktattak a hih leh a Pathian uh vaihawmna tawpsan ngei lou nam bang in ka kiang ah vaihawmna diktat ahon ngen ua, Pathian naih leng akilawp uhi.
english: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways. As a nation that did righteousness, and didn’t forsake the ordinance of their God, they ask of me righteous judgments. They delight to draw near to God.

paite: Bangziak in ahia an ka ngawl ua, na muh louh? Bangziak in ahia ka kihihgentheih ua, na theih louh? achi nak uhi. Ngai un, na an ngawl ni un noumau nopsakna na bawl ua, na nasem mite tengteng na nuaisiah uh.
english: ‘Why have we fasted,’ they say, ‘and you don’t see? Why have we afflicted our soul, and you don’t notice?’ “Behold, in the day of your fast you find pleasure, and oppress all your laborers.

paite: Ngai un, kihoutheih louh leh kiselna ding leh thulimlouhna khuttum a kitum ding in ahi, an na ngawl nak uh; na aw uh tunglam a zak ding in hiai ni in an na ngawl ngei kei uhi.
english: Behold, you fast for strife and contention, and to strike with the fist of wickedness. You don’t fast today so as to make your voice to be heard on high.

paite: Huchibang an ngawlna ka deihlam ahi hia? Mi akihih gentheihna ni ding uh ahi maw? Sialluang bang a alu kun ding leh anuai a sai-ip puan phah a vut buah ding hia? Huaite an ngawlna TOUPA a ding a ni kipahhuai na chi ding ua hia?
english: Is this the fast that I have chosen? A day for a man to humble his soul? Is it to bow down his head like a reed, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under himself? Will you call this a fast, and an acceptable day to Yahweh?

paite: Hiai an ngawlna ka deihlam ahi kei maw? Thulimlouhna a gakna phelsak leh hakkol khaute sutsak leh nuaisiahte pawtsak leh hakkol chiteng hihtansak.
english: “Isn’t this the fast that I have chosen: to release the bonds of wickedness, to undo the straps of the yoke, to let the oppressed go free, and that you break every yoke?

paite: Na an mi gilkialte kiang a hawm leh genthei delhkhiakte na inn a pi ahi kei maw? Mi vuaktang mu a puan piakleh nangmah tanaute a kipan a kisel louh ahi kei maw?
english: Isn’t it to distribute your bread to the hungry, and that you bring the poor who are cast out to your house? When you see the naked, that you cover him; and that you not hide yourself from your own flesh?

paite: Huai hun chiang in na vak zing nisuak bang in ahong suak ding a, na damna ding ahong poukhe zok ding; na diktatna in na ma akai ding a; TOUPA thupina na nungdal ahi ding.
english: Then your light will break out as the morning, and your healing will appear quickly; then your righteousness shall go before you, and Yahweh’s glory will be your rear guard.

paite: Huai hun chiang in na sam ding a, huchi in TOUPA'N ahon dawng ding; na kikou ding a, huchi in ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om," achi ding. Na lak ua kipan ahakkolte khutzung a mikawkte, mawkpaute na hihman a,
english: Then you will call, and Yahweh will answer. You will cry for help, and he will say, ‘Here I am.’ “If you take away from among you the yoke, finger pointing, and speaking wickedly;

paite: gilkialte kiang a na deihlam pia a, hihgentheihmi na taisakleh, na vak mial lak ah avakkhe ding a, na mial bikbek sun lai bang ahita ding.
