english: and if you pour out your soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will rise in darkness, and your obscurity will be as the noonday;

paite: Huan TOUPA'N ahon pi gige ding a, mun keu ah leng ahon taisak ding a, na guhte leng ahatsak ding; tui a vak huan bang leh tui nak nei kang ngei lou bang na hita ding hi.
english: and Yahweh will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters don’t fail.

paite: Huchi in nang a kipan a hong pawt dingte'n mun lui sesate alem nawn ding ua; suan tampi suangphum ding in na lemtou nawn ding; huchi in nang bel, ase lai bawlhoihpa, mi omna ding a lampite bawlhoihpa, ahon chi ding uh.
english: Those who will be of you will build the old waste places. You will raise up the foundations of many generations. You will be called Repairer of the Breach, Restorer of Paths with Dwellings.

paite: "Sabbath tang lou lou ding a, ka ni siangthou a na deihlam hih lou ding a na khepek na ngat kiksak a, Sabbath ni kipahhuai leh TOUPA ni siangthou zahhuai na chih a, nangmah lampi tawn lou a, nangmah nopsakna bawl lou a, nangmah thu gen lou a, na pahtawileh,
english: “If you turn away your foot from the Sabbath, from doing your pleasure on my holy day, and call the Sabbath a delight, and the holy of Yahweh honorable, and honor it, not doing your own ways, nor finding your own pleasure, nor speaking your own words,

paite: TOUPA tung ah na kipak ding a, lei mun sangte ah ka hon tuangsak ding; na pu Jakob gouluah thil in ka hon vak ding," TOUPA kam in huai achita hi.
english: then you will delight yourself in Yahweh, and I will make you to ride on the high places of the earth, and I will feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father;” for Yahweh’s mouth has spoken it.

paite: Ngai un, TOUPA khut hondam thei lou ding in tomsak in a-om kei a; abil leng za thei lou ding in angong sam kei.
english: Behold, Yahweh’s hand is not shortened, that it can’t save; nor his ear dull, that it can’t hear.

paite: Na thulimlouhnate uh noumau leh na Pathian kal ua kia in ahon khen ahi, bil a azak noplouhna ding in na khelhnate un amai ahon liahsak ahi.
english: But your iniquities have separated you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.

paite: Na khutte uh lah sisan a hihnit in a-om a, na khutzungte uh lah thulimlouhna a hihnit in a-om hi; na mukte un zuau agen a, na lei uh ginatlouhna thu gen in aphun nuanua hi.
english: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity. Your lips have spoken lies. Your tongue mutters wickedness.

paite: Kuama'n diktak in thukhawk agen kei ua, kuama'n thutak in thu agenpih ngei kei uh; huihkhua lelte amuang ua, zuau agen nak uhi; thilhihkhelhna apai ua, thulimlouhna asuang zel uhi.
english: No one sues in righteousness, and no one pleads in truth. They trust in vanity and speak lies. They conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity.

paite: Thangtom tuite a-opkhum ua, maimom gil puan agan uh; atui ne mite asi uhi, hihtap a om ah gul ahong pawt hi.
english: They hatch adders’ eggs and weave the spider’s web. He who eats of their eggs dies; and that which is crushed breaks out into a viper.

paite: Amaimon gil puante uh puansilh ding in ahong om kei ding a, athilhihte uh leng asilh sam kei ding uh; athilhihte uh lah thulimlouhna thilhihte ahi a, hiamgamtak a hihna akhut uah a-om hi.
english: Their webs won’t become garments. They won’t cover themselves with their works. Their works are works of iniquity, and acts of violence are in their hands.

paite: Akhete uh thil hoih lou lam ah atai a, gensiatbei sisan suah ding in akintat nilouh ua; angaihtuahte uh lah thulimlouhna ngaihtuahnate ahi a; gamna leh siatna alampite uah a-om zel hi.
english: Their feet run to evil, and they hurry to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity. Desolation and destruction are in their paths.

paite: Lungmuanna lampi athei kei ua; apaina uah dikna himhim a-om ngei kei; amau a ding in lam kawi bang abawl ua; huai lai a pai peuhmah in lungmuanna athei ngei kei uh.
english: They don’t know the way of peace; and there is no justice in their ways. They have made crooked paths for themselves; whoever goes in them doesn’t know peace.

paite: Huaiziak in vaihawmna ei a kipan gamlapi ah a-om naknak a, diktatna in ahon phazou ngei kei; vak i ngak ua, himahleh, ngai in, mial ahong hi a; vakna i ngak ua, himahleh mial bikbek mah ah i pai uhi.
english: Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness doesn’t overtake us. We look for light, but see darkness; for brightness, but we walk in obscurity.

paite: Mittaw bang in baang i mai puampuam ua, ahi, mit neiloute bang in i mai puampuam uhi; khomial tung bang in sun lai in i kisui ua; mihatte lak ah misi bang phet i hi uhi.
english: We grope for the wall like the blind. Yes, we grope as those who have no eyes. We stumble at noon as if it were twilight. Among those who are strong, we are like dead men.

paite: Vompite bang in i vek un i ham dupdup ua, vakhute bang in nakpitak in i thum ngutngut uh; vaihawmna i ngak ua, himahleh, a-om het kei hi; hotdamna i ngak ua, himahleh gamlapi ah ahon omsan hi.
english: We all roar like bears and moan sadly like doves. We look for justice, but there is none, for salvation, but it is far off from us.

paite: I tatleknate uh na ma ah akhangta a, i khelhnate'n ahon hek gige hi; i kiang ua i tatleknate uh a-om gige ziak in, i thulimlouhnate uh i thei uhi.
english: For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and as for our iniquities, we know them:

paite: I takleknate, TOUPA i theihmohbawlte, i Pathian i zuih louh a i kiheisante, nuaisiah thu leh hel thu i gente, zuau thu i pai ua, lungtang a kipan i genkhiak zelte.
english: transgressing and denying Yahweh, and turning away from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.

paite: Huchi in vaihawmna in nunglam ahon ngatsan a, diktatna in gamlapi ah ahon dinsanta; thutak lah kongzing ah apuk a, dikna alut thei kei hi.
english: Justice is turned away backward, and righteousness stands far away; for truth has fallen in the street, and uprightness can’t enter.

paite: Ahi, thutak a-omta kei a; thil hoih lou tawpsanmi gallak in akibawl zel. Huchi in TOUPA'N huai amu a, thudik a vaihawmna himhim a-om louh ziak in alungkimsakta kei hi.
english: Yes, truth is lacking; and he who departs from evil makes himself a prey. Yahweh saw it, and it displeased him that there was no justice.

paite: Huan mi kuamah a-om kei chih athei a, ngetsakmi mawngmawng a-om louh uh lamdang asa a; huaiziak in amah ban mahmah in hotdamna akibawl a; amah diktatna mah in akilenkip hi.
english: He saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor. Therefore his own arm brought salvation to him; and his righteousness sustained him.

paite: Diktatna lum in anei a, hotdamna lukhu akhu a; puansilh in phulakna puansilhte asilh a, puanaktual ding in phatuamngaihna asilh hi.
english: He put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation on his head. He put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a mantle.

paite: Athilhihte uh bang in, athilhihte uh bang in ama'n athuk ding, amah dou mite hehna in, amelmate thukna in athuk ding; tuikulh gamte thukna in athuk ding.
english: According to their deeds, he will repay as appropriate: wrath to his adversaries, recompense to his enemies. He will repay the islands their due.

paite: Huchi in tumlam a kipan TOUPA min alau ding ua, athupina leng nisuahna a kipan in alau ding uh; tui khang bang a melma ahong pai chiang in, TOUPA Kha in amah dou in alamang ding hi.
english: So they will fear Yahweh’s name from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come as a rushing stream, which Yahweh’s breath drives.

paite: "Zion ah Tanpa in ahong pai ding a, Jakobte lak a tatlekna tawpsan mite lak ah leng ahong pai ding, TOUPA'N achi.
english: “A Redeemer will come to Zion, and to those who turn from disobedience in Jacob,” says Yahweh.

paite: Ke'n zaw, hiai ahi akiang ua ka thukhun,” TOUPA'N achi. “Ka kha na tung a omleh, na kam a thu ka koihte'n, tuban tangtawn pha in na kam apawtsan kei ding ua, na suante kam leng apawtsan sam kei ding ua, na tusuan sawnte kam leng apawtsan sam kei ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: “As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says Yahweh. “My Spirit who is on you, and my words which I have put in your mouth shall not depart out of your mouth, nor out of the mouth of your offspring, nor out of the mouth of your offspring’s offspring,” says Yahweh, “from now on and forever.”

paite: Kumpipa Uzziah asih kum in TOUPA laltutphah sangtak a tawisan a tu ka mu a, apuansilh mong tual in tempul adimsak vek hi.
english: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.

paite: Akiang ah serafte adingh ua; kha guk chiat anei ua, akha nihte un amai uh akhuh ua, nih in akhepekte uh akhuh ua, nih in aleng uhi.
english: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.

paite: Huchi in, "Sepaihte' TOUPA asiangthou hi, asiangthou hi, asiangthou hi: Leitung pumpi athupina in adim," chi in akidawngtuah uhi.
english: One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”

paite: Huchi in akikou husa in kongpi bul suangphum nangawn alingsak dupdup a, meikhu in insung adim hi.
english: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.

paite: Huaitak in, ke'n, "Muk nin pumi ka hi a, muk ninpu mite lak a teng ka hih ziak in ka tung gik hi na tel e! Mangthang ka hita ve; ka mit in kumpipa, sepaihte’ TOUPA, amuta ngal a," ka chi hi.
english: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips, for my eyes have seen the King, Yahweh of Armies!”

paite: Huchi in serafte lak a khat, maitam a kipan taiteh a teh, mei-am tawi in ka kiang ah ahong leng a, ka kam ahong bi hi.
english: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.

paite: "Ngai in, hiai in na muk asukhata, huchi in na thulimlouhna lakmang ahita, na khelhna leng sawpsiang ahita," achi hi.
english: He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”

paite: Huan "Kua ka sawl dia, kou a dia kua kuan ding ahia?" chi in TOUPA aw ka za hi.
english: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”

paite: Huchi in ke'n, "Kei hiai ah ka om, hon sawl ve," ka chi hi. Ama'n, "Kuan inla, hiai mite va hilh in, bil in zaw za unla, theihsiam bel theisiam kei un; muh zaw mu unla, theih bel thei kei un, chi in.
english: He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’

paite: Hiai chite lungtang khengsak inla, abil uh ngongsak inla, amitte uh mit sisak in; huchi lou in zaw amit un amu ding ua, abil un aza ding ua, alungtang un athei ding ua, ahong kihei nawn ding ua, damsak in a-om kha ding uh," achi hi.
english: Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and turn again, and be healed.”

paite: Huan ke'n, "Toupa bang tan ahi dia?" ka chi a. Ama'n ahon dawng a, "Khopite a teng ding bei a suksiat a a-om a, innte a mi bei a a-om a, gam loih sipsip a a-om a,
english: Then I said, “Lord, how long?” He answered, “Until cities are waste without inhabitant, houses without man, the land becomes utterly waste,

paite: TOUPA'N mite gamlapi ah asuan a, gamsung a mun paisansa tampi a-om masiah.
english: and Yahweh has removed men far away, and the forsaken places are many within the land.

paite: Huan asung ah sawm lak ah khat leng om lai a-omleh nek khit in a-om behlap ding uhi; himahleh nahhi leh tosaw phuk khit nung a abul a om nilouh bang in chi siangthou abulsum a om nilouh ahi," ka chi hi.
english: If there is a tenth left in it, that also will in turn be consumed, as a terebinth, and as an oak whose stump remains when they are cut down, so the holy seed is its stump.”

paite: Thou inla, vak in, na vak ahong tung a, Toupa thupina na tung ah ahong suakta hi.
english: “Arise, shine; for your light has come, and Yahweh’s glory has risen on you!

paite: Ngai in, mial in leitung akhuh ding a, mial bikbek in mite akhuh ding ahi; himahleh na tung ah TOUPA ahong suak ding a, thupina na tung ah ahong kilang ding hi.
english: For behold, darkness will cover the earth, and thick darkness the peoples; but Yahweh will arise on you, and his glory shall be seen on you.

paite: Huchi in nam chih na vak lam ah ahong pai ding ua, kumpipate leng na hong suah vakna lam ah ahong pai ding uh.
english: Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising.

paite: Dak inla, na mit in en vialvial in, en in, avek un akikhawm ua, na kiang ah ahong pai uhi; na tapate gamlapi a kipan in ahong pai ding ua, na tanute ahong don ding uhi.
english: “Lift up your eyes all around, and see: they all gather themselves together. They come to you. Your sons will come from far away, and your daughters will be carried in arms.

paite: Huai hun chiang in na mu ding a, na vakta ding a, na lungtang kipak in aling ding, zatsak in a-om ding; tuipi a hauhsakna in na kiang lam ahon naih ding a, namte thahatna na kiang ahong tun ding ziak in.
english: Then you shall see and be radiant, and your heart will thrill and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea will be turned to you. The wealth of the nations will come to you.

paite: Sangawngsau tampi'n ahon tuam ding ua, Midian leh Ephah gam a sangawngsau tuaite'n; huaite tengteng Sheba gam a kipan in ahong pai ding uh; dangka-eng leh begaw ahon po ding ua, TOUPA phatna thu atheisak ding uhi.
english: A multitude of camels will cover you, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah. All from Sheba will come. They will bring gold and frankincense, and will proclaim the praises of Yahweh.

paite: Kedarte ganhon tengteng na kiang ah a-omkhawm ding ua, Nebajoth a belamtalte'n na nna asem ding uh; ka maitam ah kipak in apaitou ding ua, ka thupina in ka pahtawi ding.
english: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered together to you. The rams of Nebaioth will serve you. They will be accepted as offerings on my altar; and I will beautify my glorious house.

paite: Mei bang a leng leh vakhu amau tohlet zuan a leng duamduam bang kuate ahi ua?
english: “Who are these who fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?

paite: Ama'n ahon pahtawi ziak in TOUPA na Pathian min ding leh Israelte Mi Siangthou a ding in na tapate adangka uh leh dangka-eng toh gamlapi a kipan a pi ding in pel lou in tuikulh gamte'n ahon ngak ding ua, Tarshish long liante'n masakpen atuh ding uh.
english: Surely the islands will wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring your sons from far away, their silver and their gold with them, for the name of Yahweh your God, and for the Holy One of Israel, because he has glorified you.

paite: Huan gamdang mite'n kulhbaangte alemtou nawn ding ua, akumpipate un na nna asem ding uh; ka heh in ka hon sat a, himahleh ka hon deihsakna in na tung ah ka zahngai leuleu hi.
english: “Foreigners will build up your walls, and their kings will serve you; for in my wrath I struck you, but in my favor I have had mercy on you.

paite: Na kongkhakte leng hon in a-om gige ding ua; sun le zan in akhak kei ding uh; mite'n nam chih sum na kiang a ahon tawi ua, akumpipate uh ahon pi theih samna ding un.
english: Your gates also shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night, that men may bring to you the wealth of the nations, and their kings led captive.

paite: Na nna sem nuam lou nam leh gam amangthang ding uhi; ahi, huai namte zaw suksiat in a-om ding uh.
english: For that nation and kingdom that will not serve you shall perish; yes, those nations shall be utterly wasted.

paite: Ka Mun Siangthou zem ding in Lebanon thupina na kiang ah ahong pai ding, meilahte, phante, sing gelh chi ahong paikhawm ding ua ka khe sikna mun ka thupibawl ding hi.
english: “The glory of Lebanon shall come to you, the cypress tree, the pine, and the box tree together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.

paite: Nang hon hihgentheite tapate kun in na kiang ah ahong pai ding ua; nangmah musit mite na khepek nuai ah akun ding ua, nang bel TOUPA khopi, Israelte Mi Siangthou Zion, ahon chi ding uh.
english: The sons of those who afflicted you will come bowing to you; and all those who despised you will bow themselves down at the soles of your feet. They will call you Yahweh’s City, the Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Kuamah veh ngei louh khopi, paisan leh huat a na om sang in tangtawn suanpen, suan tampi kipahna ding in ka hon bawl ding.
english: “Whereas you have been forsaken and hated, so that no one passed through you, I will make you an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.

paite: Namte nawitui na tep ding a, kumpipate nawi leng na tep ding; kei TOUPA zaw nang hon hondampa leh nang Tanpa, Jakob Mi Hat ka hi chih na hon thei ding hi.
english: You will also drink the milk of the nations, and will nurse from royal breasts. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

paite: Dal tang in dangka-eng ka hon la ding a, sik tang in dangka ka hon la ding, sing tang in leng sumbelsik, suang tang in sik; lungmuanna na heutu ding in ka sep lai ding a, diktatna nang hon phutmi ding in ka sep ding hi.
english: For bronze I will bring gold; for iron I will bring silver; for wood, bronze, and for stones, iron. I will also make peace your governor, and righteousness your ruler.

paite: Hiamgam a thilhih husa na gam ah zak ahita kei ding a, hiamgamna leh siatna husa leng na gamgi sung ah zak ahita kei ding; na kulhbaang Hotdamna, na chi zaw ding a, na kongkhakte leng, Phatna, na chi ding hi.
english: Violence shall no more be heard in your land, nor desolation or destruction within your borders; but you will call your walls Salvation, and your gates Praise.

paite: Sun a nang hon tan ding nisa ahi kei ding a; kha leng vakna ding in ahon vaksak sam kei ding; TOUPA bel nang a ding in tangtawn vaksakpa ding in a-om ding a, na Pathian leng na thupina ding ahi ding.
english: The sun will be no more your light by day, nor will the brightness of the moon give light to you, but Yahweh will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory.

paite: Na ni atumta kei ding a, na kha leng amangta kei ding hi; TOUPA tangtawn vaksakpa ahita ding a, na lusuun nite atawp ding hi.
english: Your sun will not go down any more, nor will your moon withdraw itself; for Yahweh will be your everlasting light, and the days of your mourning will end.

paite: Na mite avek un midiktat ahi ding ua, na gam aluah tawntung ding uh; pahtawi a ka omtheihna ding a amau a zung selkhia ka suan, ka khutsuak ahi ding uh.
english: Then your people will all be righteous. They will inherit the land forever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.

paite: Mi tawmpen sangkhat ahi ding ua, mineupen leng nam hatte ahi ding uhi, kei TOUPA'N ahunhun in ka tungsak pahpah ding.
english: The little one will become a thousand, and the small one a strong nation. I, Yahweh, will do this quickly in its time.”

paite: Liangvaite kiang a tanchinhoih gen ding a TOUPA'N thau ahon nilh ziak in ka tung ah Toupa PATHIAN kha a-om; ama'n lungtang khasiate tuam ding, salte kiang a pawtna thu leh saltangte kiang a tanin honna thu gen ding.
english: The Lord Yahweh’s Spirit is on me, because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to those who are bound,

paite: TOUPA lungkim kum thu leh i Pathian phulak ni thugen ding bang, lungkhamte lungmuan ding bang,
english: to proclaim the year of Yahweh’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn,

paite: Vut tang a pakkhigui bang, lungkham tang a nopna thau bang, nguina kha tang a phatna puansilh bang akiang ua piak ding, Zion a lungkham a omte a ding a seh ding bang in ahon sawl ahi. Amah pahtawi a a-omna ding in, diktatna sing TOUPA suante chih, ahihtheihna ding un.
english: to provide for those who mourn in Zion, to give to them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness, that they may be called trees of righteousness, the planting of Yahweh, that he may be glorified.

paite: Mun lui sesate alem nawn ding ua, tuma a khua sesate adingh hoihsak nawn ding ua, khopi sesa, suan tampi gamnate, abawlhoih nawn ding uh.
english: They will rebuild the old ruins. They will raise up the former devastated places. They will repair the ruined cities that have been devastated for many generations.

paite: Gamdang mite'n dinsa in na ganhonte uh avak ding ua, theih ngei louh mite na leiletmi ding un leh na grepgui uh kemmi ding in a-om ding uh.
english: Strangers will stand and feed your flocks. Foreigners will work your fields and your vineyards.

paite: Nou bel, TOUPA siampute, chih a loh in na om ding uh; mite'n i Pathian nasem mite ahon chi ding uh. Namte sum na ne ding ua, athupina uh na suang ding uh.
english: But you will be called Yahweh’s priests. Men will call you the servants of our God. You will eat the wealth of the nations. You will boast in their glory.

paite: Na zahlakna gun uh aleh nih na mu ding ua; na zum gun un na tantuan uah nuamsa in la na sa ding uh; huaiziak in na gam uah azahnih na luah ding ua; tangtawn nopsakna nou a ahi ding.
english: Instead of your shame you will have double. Instead of dishonor, they will rejoice in their portion. Therefore in their land they will possess double. Everlasting joy will be to them.

paite: Kei TOUPA'N vaihawmna dik ka deih a, thulim loutak a hiamgam zaw ka hua hi; huchi in amau ka thukna chihtak ngial in akiang uah ka pe ding a, akiang uah tangtawn thu leng ka khung ding.
english: “For I, Yahweh, love justice. I hate robbery and iniquity. I will give them their reward in truth and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

paite: Huchi in asuante uh nam chih lak a theih ahi ding ua, atate uh michih lak a theih ahi ding uh; amau mute'n TOUPA vualzawl chi ahi uh chih athei ding uhi.
english: Their offspring will be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge them, that they are the offspring which Yahweh has blessed.”

paite: TOUPA ah nakpitak in nuam ka sa ding a, ka hinna Pathian ah kipaktak in a-om ding. Mouneipa ding pakkhigui a akizep bang leh mou ding a kivatnate a akivat zel bang in, ama'n hotdamna puansilhte ahon silhsak a, diktatna puanaktual in ahon tuamta hi.
english: I will greatly rejoice in Yahweh! My soul will be joyful in my God, for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation. He has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.

paite: Leitung in athil dawn apawtsak bang leh, huan in asung a thil chinte adawnsak bang in, Toupa PATHIAN in diktatna leh phatna nam chih ma ah adawnkhesak ding ahi.
english: For as the earth produces its bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring up, so the Lord Yahweh will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.

paite: Adiktatna uh vakna bang a suah a, amah hotdamna khawnvak kuang bang a asuah masiah, Zion ziak in ka dai nilouh kei ding a, Jerusalem ziak in ka om kinken kei ding hi.
english: For Zion’s sake I will not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until her righteousness shines out like the dawn, and her salvation like a burning lamp.

paite: Huchi in na diktatna amu ding ua, kumpipa tengteng in na thupina amu ding uh; huan, min thak, TOUPA kam in asak ding in, ahon sam ding uh.
english: The nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory. You will be called by a new name, which Yahweh’s mouth will name.

paite: TOUPA khut a kilawmna lallukhu leh i Pathian khut a thupina lukhu na hi ding.
english: You will also be a crown of beauty in Yahweh’s hand, and a royal diadem in your God’s hand.

paite: Taihsansa, ahon chi nawn kei ding uh; na gam leng, Loihsansa achi nawn sam kei ding uh; Hephzibah, ahon chita ding ua, na gam leng Beulah, achi ding uhi; TOUPA na tung ah akipak ngal a, na gam in pasal anei ding hi.
english: You will not be called Forsaken any more, nor will your land be called Desolate any more; but you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for Yahweh delights in you, and your land will be married.

paite: Tangval in nungak zi a aneih bang in na tapate'n zi in ahon nei ding uh; mou neimi mou tung a akipah bang in, na tung ah na Pathian akipak ding hi.
english: For as a young man marries a virgin, so your sons will marry you. As a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so your God will rejoice over you.

paite: Jerusalem aw, na kulh tung ah galvilmi ka vilsak a; sun leh zan in chik lai mah in adai kei ding; nou TOUPA theihpih ding a omte aw, om kinken het kei un.
english: I have set watchmen on your walls, Jerusalem. They will never be silent day nor night. You who call on Yahweh, take no rest,

paite: Amah leng om kinkensak kei un, Jerusalem ahihkip a, lei a phathuai a abawl masiah.
english: and give him no rest until he establishes, and until he makes Jerusalem a praise on the earth.

paite: TOUPA'N akhut taklam leh abanhat lou a akichiam in, na buh nang hon dou mite an ding in ka pe nawn kei ding a; gamdang mite'n nna sepkhiak uain adawn nawn kei ding uh.
english: Yahweh has sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, “Surely I will no more give your grain to be food for your enemies, and foreigners will not drink your new wine, for which you have labored,

paite: Abuh late'n ane zaw ding ua, TOUPA aphat ding ua alou mite'n ka Mun Siangthou huangsung intual ah adawnta ding, chi in.
english: but those who have harvested it will eat it, and praise Yahweh. Those who have gathered it will drink it in the courts of my sanctuary.”

paite: Pawt unla, kulh kongpite ah pawt un; mite a ding in lampi bawl unla; sungvum un, lamlian sungvum un; suangte tomsiang unla; mite a ding in chiamtehna takkhia un.
english: Go through, go through the gates! Prepare the way of the people! Build up, build up the highway! Gather out the stones! Lift up a banner for the peoples.

paite: Ngai un, kawlmong pha in huchi in atheisak ahi, Zion tanu kiang ah hichi in gen un, "En in, nangmah hotdamna ahong tung ding; en in, akipahman akiang ah a-om hi, aditna leng ama ah a-om hi.
english: Behold, Yahweh has proclaimed to the end of the earth: “Say to the daughter of Zion, ‘Behold, your salvation comes! Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him!’”

paite: Huchi in amau, 'Mipi Siangthou, TOUPA tatte,' achi ding uh; nang bel Zonkhiak, Paisan louh khopi ahon chi ding uh, chi in,” achi hi.
english: They will call them “The Holy People, Yahweh’s Redeemed”. You will be called “Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken”.

paite: Edom gam a kipan hong pai, Bozrah a kipan puansilh diahsan silh kua ahia? Apuansilh a thupitak, ahatna thupidan bang a hong pai? Kei TOUPA diktattak a thu gen a, hotdam lam a mihat mahmah ka hi.
english: Who is this who comes from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? Who is this who is glorious in his clothing, marching in the greatness of his strength? “It is I who speak in righteousness, mighty to save.”

paite: Bangziak a na puansilh san a, na silh-le-tente leng grep sukna khuk a chiltaimi' silh-le-ten bang a om ahia?
english: Why is your clothing red, and your garments like him who treads in the wine vat?

paite: Keimah kia in grep sukna khuk ah ka chiltai a; michih lak a mi khat lel leng ka kiang ah a-om kei uh; ahi, amau ka heh a ka chil a, ka heh a ka pal a; huchi in ahinna sisan uh ka puansilhte ah theh in a-om a, ka puan tengteng ka hihninta hi.
english: “I have trodden the wine press alone. Of the peoples, no one was with me. Yes, I trod them in my anger and trampled them in my wrath. Their lifeblood is sprinkled on my garments, and I have stained all my clothing.

paite: Phulak ni ka lungtang ah a-om a, ka tatkhiakna kum ahong tungta ahi.
english: For the day of vengeance was in my heart, and the year of my redeemed has come.

paite: Huchi in ka en a, panpih ding mi a-om kei ua; len ding mi a-om louh uh lamdang ka sa a; huaiziak in keimah ban mahmah in hotdamna ahon puak a; ka hehna in ahon lenkip hi.
english: I looked, and there was no one to help; and I wondered that there was no one to uphold. Therefore my own arm brought salvation to me. My own wrath upheld me.

paite: Huchi in michih ka heh in ka sikden a, ka heh in ka khamsak a, ahinna sisan uh lei ah ka bota hi.
english: I trod down the peoples in my anger and made them drunk in my wrath. I poured their lifeblood out on the earth.”

paite: TOUPA'N thil bangkim ahon vuh bang zel in TOUPA chitdan thute leh TOUPA phatna thute ka gen ding a; ahehpihnate leh azahngaihna thupidante bang zel a Israel inkuanpihte lak a ahoihna thupi mahmah a atung ua avuh thu leng ka gen ding hi.
english: I will tell of the loving kindnesses of Yahweh and the praises of Yahweh, according to all that Yahweh has given to us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he has given to them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

paite: Ama'n, "Ka mite, hi taktak hi ua, zuautat lou ding tate ahi uh," achi hi. Huchi in amaute hondampa ding in ahong omta hi.
english: For he said, “Surely, they are my people, children who will not deal falsely;” so he became their Savior.

paite: Amangbatna tengteng uah amah amangbang a, angel, ama a om in, amaute ahumbit a; a-itna leh ahehpihna in atanta a; nidanglai ni tengteng ah amaute pua in apom hi.
english: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and in his pity he redeemed them. He bore them, and carried them all the days of old.

paite: Himahleh ahel un, a Kha Siangthou alungkhamsak ua; huaiziak in amau dou ding in kilehheisak in a-om a, amau asualta hi.
english: But they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. Therefore he turned and became their enemy, and he himself fought against them.

paite: Huai lai in amite'n Mosi nidanglai nite atheigige ua, hichi in achi uh, "Tuipi a kipan a abelamching mite toh amaute pi TOUPA koi a om ahia? A Kha Siangthou alak ua koihpa koi a om ahia?
english: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses and his people, saying, “Where is he who brought them up out of the sea with the shepherds of his flock? Where is he who put his Holy Spirit among them?”

paite: Aban thupitak Mosi taklam a paisakpa koi a om ahia? Tangtawn min kibawlna dia ama ua tui kikhensakpa koi a om ahia?
english: Who caused his glorious arm to be at Moses’ right hand? Who divided the waters before them, to make himself an everlasting name?

paite: Akisuihlouhna ding ua tui thuktak a, gamdai a sakol pi bang a, amaute pikaipa koi a om ahia?
english: Who led them through the depths, like a horse in the wilderness, so that they didn’t stumble?

paite: Guam a ganta paisukte bang in TOUPA Kha in amaute akhawlsak a; huchibang in, min thupitak na kibawlna ding in, na mite na pi hi," chi in.
english: As the livestock that go down into the valley, Yahweh’s Spirit caused them to rest. So you led your people to make yourself a glorious name.

paite: TOUPA, Van a kipan in hon ensuk inla, na sianthouna leh na thupina omna a kipan in hon en in; na phatuamngaihna leh na thilhih thupitakte koi ah? Na lungtang a na hon ngaihna leh na hon hehpihna, kham a omta hia?
english: Look down from heaven, and see from the habitation of your holiness and of your glory. Where are your zeal and your mighty acts? The yearning of your heart and your compassion is restrained toward me.

paite: Abraham in hon thei lou in, Israel in leng hon limsak kei mahleh, nang zaw ka Pa uh na hi a; nang zaw, aw TOUPA, ka Pa uh na hi; na min tangtawn a kipan in koute hon Tanpa ahi.
english: For you are our Father, though Abraham doesn’t know us, and Israel does not acknowledge us. You, Yahweh, are our Father. Our Redeemer from everlasting is your name.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang bangziak a na lampi a kipan hon vakmangsak na hia? Na sikha, na gouluah namte ziak in hong kik nawn in.
english: O Yahweh, why do you make us wander from your ways, and harden our heart from your fear? Return for your servants’ sake, the tribes of your inheritance.

paite: Na misiangthoute'n sawt louchik kia anei ua; hon doute'n lah na min siangthou asikgawpta uh.
english: Your holy people possessed it but a little while. Our adversaries have trodden down your sanctuary.

paite: Atung ua vai na hawm ngeilouhte, na min pu ngeilou namte ka bangta uhi.
english: We have become like those over whom you never ruled, like those who were not called by your name.

paite: Aw tangte na ma a aluankhiak zoizoina ding un, van botkek in hong kumsuk teitei lechin aw.
english: Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence—

paite: Namte na ma a alinna ding un nang hon doute kiang a na min theihsakna ding in, mei in sing nen akuansak a, mei in tui asousak bang in!
english: as when fire kindles the brushwood, and the fire causes the water to boil. Make your name known to your adversaries, that the nations may tremble at your presence!

paite: Ka lamet louh uh thil mulkimhuai na hih lai in na hong suk a, na ma ah tangte aluangkhe zoizoi uhi.
english: When you did awesome things which we didn’t look for, you came down, and the mountains quaked at your presence.

paite: Nidanglai a kipan in mite'n, nang kia lou ngal, amaute ngak ding a, sepsak zelpa Pathian athei ngei kei ua, bil in lah aza ngei kei ua, mit in leng amu ngei sam kei uhi.
english: For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, nor has the eye seen a God besides you, who works for him who waits for him.

paite: Nang zaw, nuamtak a om a diktattak a hihmi, na lampite a nang hon theigigete, na don a; ngai in, nang na heh a, kou thil ka hihkhial ua; huaite ah sawtpi ka omta ua, huchi in hotdam in ka om thei lai ding uam?
english: You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we sinned. We have been in sin for a long time. Shall we be saved?

paite: Minin bang in ka na om vekta ngal ua, ka diktatna teng uh leng puansilh nin bang ahi; ka vek un nah bang in ka vuai ua; ka thulimlouhnate un huih bang in ahon mutmang zel hi.
english: For we have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteousness is like a polluted garment. We all fade like a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away.

paite: Huchi in na min lou a, nang hon len ding a kihihhalh kuamah a-om kei uh; kou a kipan in na mai na selta ngal a, ka thulimlouhnate uh zang in na hon mangsakta hi.
english: There is no one who calls on your name, who stirs himself up to take hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us, and have consumed us by means of our iniquities.

paite: Tu in zaw, aw TOUPA, nang ka pa uh na hi; kou bellei ka hi ua; nang kou hon velpa na hi; huchi in ka vek un na khutsuak ka hi uh.
english: But now, Yahweh, you are our Father. We are the clay and you our potter. We all are the work of your hand.

paite: TOUPA aw, heh ke'nla, thulimlouhnate leng tangtawn in theigige ke'n; ngai in hehpih in hon en inla, ka vek un nangmah mite ka hi uhi.
english: Don’t be furious, Yahweh. Don’t remember iniquity forever. Look and see, we beg you, we are all your people.

paite: Na khopi siangthoute gamdai ahong suak ua, Zion gamdai ahong suak a, Jerusalem mun nutsiat ahong hita hi.
english: Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

paite: Ka inn siangthou uleh ka inn kilawmtak uh, ka pipute un nang a hon phat zelna uh, mei ahal ahi; ka thil deihhuaite tengteng uh lah hihsiat in a-omvekta ngal a.
english: Our holy and our beautiful house where our fathers praised you is burned with fire. All our pleasant places are laid waste.

paite: TOUPA aw, huai thilte ah na kidek thei ding a hia? Na dai nilouh in na hon hihgenthei nilouh ding a hia?
english: Will you hold yourself back for these things, Yahweh? Will you keep silent and punish us very severely?

paite: Kei hon deih ngeiloute zon in ka om; hon zong ngeiloute muhkhiak in ka om; ka min pu lou nam kiang ah, "Hon en un, hon en un," ka chi hi.
english: “I am inquired of by those who didn’t ask. I am found by those who didn’t seek me. I said, ‘See me, see me,’ to a nation that was not called by my name.

paite: Mihelhatte a ding in nitum in ka bante ka zak, huaite bel amau ngaihtuahnate bang zel a lampi hoih lou a paite ahi.
english: I have spread out my hands all day to a rebellious people, who walk in a way that is not good, after their own thoughts;

paite: Huante a kithoih a, teklei tungte a banghiam gimlim hal a, ka maitang mahmah a hon hihheh nakte.
english: a people who provoke me to my face continually, sacrificing in gardens, and burning incense on bricks;

paite: Han lakte khawng a tu a, mundaite a giak a, voksa ne a, abelte ua thilkihhuai tuihuante.
english: who sit among the graves, and spend nights in secret places; who eat pig’s meat, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;

paite: Nang kia dingh in, hon naih ke'n, nang sang in ka siangthouzaw hi, chite ahi uh; huaite bel ka nak a meikhu om, nitum a mei mit lou om gige nakte ahi uhi.
english: who say, ‘Stay by yourself, don’t come near to me, for I am holier than you.’ These are smoke in my nose, a fire that burns all day.

paite: Ngai in, ka ma ah gelh in a-om; ka dai nilouh kei ding a, ka thuk ding, a-angsung uah ka thuk ding.
english: “Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will repay, yes, I will repay into their bosom

paite: Noumau thulimlouhna leh na pute uh thulimlouhnate, TOUPA'N achi, huaite'n lah tangte tung ah gimlim ahal ua, mual tungte ah ka min agensia uhi; huaiziak in anasep uh amasapen in a-angsung uah ka tehsak ding hi.
english: your own iniquities and the iniquities of your fathers together”, says Yahweh, “who have burned incense on the mountains, and blasphemed me on the hills. Therefore I will first measure their work into their bosom.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Grep bawm ah uain thak amu ua, mi'n, 'Hihse ke'n, huai ah lah vualzawlna a-om ngal a,' achih bang un, ka sikhate ziak in ka hih sam ding, avek ua ka suksiatlouhna ding in.
english: Yahweh says, “As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one says, ‘Don’t destroy it, for a blessing is in it:’ so I will do for my servants’ sake, that I may not destroy them all.

paite: Huan Jakob a kipan in chi khat ka pawtsak ding a, Judah a kipan in ka tangte luah ding ka pawtsak ding; huchi in ka mitelte'n huai aluah ding ua, ka sikhate huai ah a-om ding uh.
english: I will bring offspring out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains. My chosen will inherit it, and my servants will dwell there.

paite: Huan ka mi, kei hon zongte a ding in, Sharon belamhonte huang ahi ding a, Akor Phaizang bel bawnghon kualna mun ahi ding hi.
english: Sharon will be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down in, for my people who have sought me.

paite: "Himahleh nou TOUPA paisan a, ka tang siangthou mangngilh a, Gad pathian a ding a dohkan bawl a, Meni a ding a dawn thillat lante aw;
english: “But you who forsake Yahweh, who forget my holy mountain, who prepare a table for Fortune, and who fill up mixed wine to Destiny;

paite: k'on sap lai in na hon dawng nuam kei ua, thu ka gen lai in na za ut kei ua, ka mitmuh in thil gilou na hih zaw ua, ka kipahpih louh thil na tel zawk ziak un namsau in na tan hun uh ka hon ngaihtuahsak ding a, na vek un thahna ah na kun vek ding uh.
english: I will destine you to the sword, and you will all bow down to the slaughter; because when I called, you didn’t answer. When I spoke, you didn’t listen; but you did that which was evil in my eyes, and chose that in which I didn’t delight.”

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, 'Ngai un, ka sikhate'n ane ding ua, nou bel gilkial in na om ding ua; ngai un, ka sikhate'n adawn ding ua, nou bel dangtak in na om ding uh; ngai un, ka sikhate'n nuam asa ding ua, nou bel na zum ding uh;
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, my servants will eat, but you will be hungry; behold, my servants will drink, but you will be thirsty. Behold, my servants will rejoice, but you will be disappointed.

paite: ngai un, ka sikhate lungtang akipah ziak un la asa ding ua, nou bel lungtang a na lungkham ziak un na kap ding uh, kha a na vui ziak un na mau vungvung ding uh.
english: Behold, my servants will sing for joy of heart, but you will cry for sorrow of heart, and will wail for anguish of spirit.

paite: Huan hamsia hi ding in ka mitelte kiang ah na min uh na nuse ding ua, Toupa PATHIAN in ahon that ding hi; huan, asikhate min dang in asamta ding hi.
english: You will leave your name for a curse to my chosen, and the Lord Yahweh will kill you. He will call his servants by another name,

paite: Huchi in lei a amah kivualzawl tawmmi bel thutak Pathian ah akivualzawl ding a; lei a kichiammi in thutak Pathian lou in akichiam ding; nidang alungkhamnate mangngilh a a-om tak ziak in leh ka mit a kipan a sel a a-om tak ziakin.'
english: so that he who blesses himself on the earth will bless himself in the God of truth; and he who swears on the earth will swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hidden from my eyes.

paite: "Ngai un, van thakte leh lei thak ka siam ahi; nidanglai thilte zaw theihgige in a-om nawn kei ding a, lungsim ah leng alut nawn kei ding hi.
english: “For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former things will not be remembered, nor come into mind.

paite: Himahleh ka thilsiam ah tangtawn in kipak in nuamsa un; ngai un, Jerusalem nopsakna ding in ka siam a, amite kipahna ding in ka bawl hi.
english: But be glad and rejoice forever in that which I create; for, behold, I create Jerusalem to be a delight, and her people a joy.

paite: Jerusalem tung ah nuam ka sa ding a, ka mite tung ah leng ka kipak ding; asung ah kap husa zak ahi nawn kei ding a, mau husa leng zak ahi nawn kei ding hi.
english: I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and delight in my people; and the voice of weeping and the voice of crying will be heard in her no more.

paite: Huai a kipan a pawt zaw naungek ni sawt louchik dam a-om kei ding ua, putek adamsung nite tangtun lou leng a-om kei ding uh; naupang lah kum za a upa in asi ding ua, mikhial kum za lel dam zaw hamsethuak ahi ding uhi.
english: “No more will there be an infant who only lives a few days, nor an old man who has not filled his days; for the child will die one hundred years old, and the sinner being one hundred years old will be accursed.

paite: Huan innte alam ding ua, huaite ah a-om gige ding uh; grephuan abawl ding ua, agah leng ane ding uh.
english: They will build houses and inhabit them. They will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

paite: Midang omna ding in inn alam nawn kei ding ua, midang nek ding in grephuan abawl nawn kei ding uh; sing damsung nite bang in ka mite damsung nite lah om ding ahi ngal a, ka mitelte zaw sawtpi asepkhiak tung uah akipak ding uhi.
english: They will not build and another inhabit. They will not plant and another eat; for the days of my people will be like the days of a tree, and my chosen will long enjoy the work of their hands.

paite: Bangmah lou in asemgim kei ding ua, vangtah lel ding in ta anei sam kei ding uh; TOUPA vualzawlmi suante ahi ngal ua, atate uh akiang uah a-om nilouh ding uh.
english: They will not labor in vain nor give birth for calamity; for they are the offspring of Yahweh’s blessed and their descendants with them.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, amau hon sap ma un ka dawng ding a; thu agen san lai un leng ka bil in ka za ding hi.
english: It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.

paite: Ngia leh belamnou agamtakhawm ding ua, humpinelkai in bawngtal bang in buhpawl ane ding a; gulpi an leivui ahi ding hi. Ka tang siangthou ah akihih na nawn kei ding ua, akihihse nawn sam kei ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: The wolf and the lamb will feed together. The lion will eat straw like the ox. Dust will be the serpent’s food. They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain,” says Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Van ka tutphah ahi a, lei ka khe ngakna ahi; inn bangchibang ahia na hon lamsak ding uh? Koi lai ahia ka khawlna ding?
english: Yahweh says: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build to me? Where will I rest?

paite: Hiai thil bangkim lah ka khut a ka bawl ahi ngal ua, huchi in hiai thil bangkim ahong omta ahi, TOUPA'N achi; himahleh hiai mi gentheitak a om, lungsim a kisik tuntun, ka thu a ling zel zaw ka en zaw ding.
english: For my hand has made all these things, and so all these things came to be,” says Yahweh: “but I will look to this man, even to he who is poor and of a contrite spirit, and who trembles at my word.

paite: "Bawngtal goumi zaw mi that bang ahi a; belam a kithoihmi zaw ui ngawng hektan bang ahi; thilpiak lanmi peuhmah vok sisan lanmi bang ahi a; begaw halmi peuhmah milim vualzawlmi bang ahi; ahi, amau lampi atelta ua, athilkihhuaite uah alungsim uh akipak zel hi.
english: He who kills an ox is as he who kills a man; he who sacrifices a lamb, as he who breaks a dog’s neck; he who offers an offering, as he who offers pig’s blood; he who burns frankincense, as he who blesses an idol. Yes, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delights in their abominations.

paite: Ka sap lai a kuama'n ahon dawn louh ua, thu ka gen lai a bil a azak louh ua, ka mitmuh a thil gilou ahih zawk ua, ka thil kipahpih louh lam atel ziak un ke'n leng amau khemna dingte ka telsak ding a, akihtak lam uh atung uah ka tungsak ding," chi in.
english: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears on them, because when I called, no one answered; when I spoke, they didn’t listen, but they did that which was evil in my eyes, and chose that in which I didn’t delight.”

paite: Athu a lingte aw, TOUPA thu za un; na unau uh, nou hon hopa leh ka min ziak a nou hon delhkhete'n, "Na kipahman uh ka muhtheihna ding un, TOUPA hih thupi in om hen," achi ua, himahleh azum zawta ding uh.
english: Hear Yahweh’s word, you who tremble at his word: “Your brothers who hate you, who cast you out for my name’s sake, have said, ‘Let Yahweh be glorified, that we may see your joy;’ but it is those who shall be disappointed.

paite: Tua! Khopi a lum vengvung husa! Tempul a kipan husa! Amelmate thukpa TOUPA husa ei ve!
english: A voice of tumult from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of Yahweh that repays his enemies what they deserve.

paite: "Ama'n vei man lou in nau anei a; na sa man lou in pasal naupang anei hi.
english: “Before she travailed, she gave birth. Before her pain came, she delivered a son.

paite: Huchibang kua'n za ngei ahia? Huchibang kua ahia mu ngei? Ni khat in gam apiang guih ding a hia? Thakhat in nam suan in a-om guih ding a hia? Zion in nau aveitak in tate anei pah hi.
english: Who has heard of such a thing? Who has seen such things? Shall a land be born in one day? Shall a nation be born at once? For as soon as Zion travailed, she gave birth to her children.

paite: Pian hun tungsak ngal in ka nei kei ding a hia?" TOUPA'N achi, "Kei neisak zelpa'n ta ka neisak phal kei ding a hia?" Na Pathian in achi hi.
english: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to be delivered?” says Yahweh. “Shall I who cause to give birth shut the womb?” says your God.

paite: "Jerusalem itte tengteng aw, Jerusalem nopsakpih unla, kipahpih un; amah suunte tengteng aw, kipah ziak in nuamsakpih un.
english: “Rejoice with Jerusalem, and be glad for her, all you who love her. Rejoice for joy with her, all you who mourn over her;

paite: Na tep ua, alungmuanna nawite a na taitheihna ding un leh, na tep peng ua, athupina tampi a na kipahtheihna ding un," chih.
english: that you may nurse and be satisfied at the comforting breasts; that you may drink deeply, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi ngal a, "Ngai un, luipi bang mai in akiang pha in lemna ka luangsak ding a, nam chih thupina luita akuang a let zoizoi bang mai in akiang pha in ka luangsak ding, huchi in huai na tep ding uh; ahon angpom ding a, apheipi tung ah ahon tawmsak ding hi.
english: For Yahweh says, “Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the nations like an overflowing stream, and you will nurse. You will be carried on her side, and will be dandled on her knees.

paite: "Mi, anu'n alungmuan bang in ka hon lungmuan ding; huchi in Jerusalem ah lungmuan in na om ding uhi.
english: As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.”

paite: Huai na mu ding ua, na lungtang un nuam asa ding a, na guhte uh leng loupa hing dipdip bang in apha lihliah ding; huchi in TOUPA khut asikhate lam ah a-om chih athei ding ua, amelmate tung ah alungkim kei ding.
english: You will see it, and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones will flourish like the tender grass. Yahweh’s hand will be known among his servants; and he will have indignation against his enemies.

paite: "Ngai un, ahehna thangpaihna a thuk ding leh asalhna meikuang a thuk ding in TOUPA mei toh ahong pai ding hi, akangtalaite pingpei bang mai ahi ding hi.
english: For, behold, Yahweh will come with fire, and his chariots will be like the whirlwind; to give his anger with fierceness, and his rebuke with flames of fire.

paite: Mei in ahi, TOUPA'N angaihtuah ding, anamsau in ahi mi tengteng angaihtuah ding; huchi in TOUPA hihlupte zaw tampi ahi ding uh.
english: For Yahweh will execute judgment by fire and by his sword on all flesh; and those slain by Yahweh will be many.

paite: "Huante ah ahoh ua, alai a mi nung a om khepkhup ding a kihihsiangthou leh kisiangsak zelte, voksa leh thilkihhuai leh chikpi nete, amangthangkhawm ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: “Those who sanctify themselves and purify themselves to go to the gardens, following one in the middle, eating pig’s meat, abominable things, and the mouse, they shall come to an end together,” says Yahweh.

paite: “Athilhihte uleh angaihtuahte uh lah ka thei ngal a; nam chih leh pau chih ka pikhawm hun ahong tung sin; huchi in ahong pai ding ua, ka thupina amu ding uh.
english: “For I know their works and their thoughts. The time comes that I will gather all nations and languages, and they will come, and will see my glory.

paite: Huan alak uah chiamtehna ka omsak ding a, huchi in alak ua gawtna pelte peuhmah namte kiang ah Tarshishte, Pulte, thangpeulaite Lud kiang ah, tuikulh gam gamlapi, ka minthanna za ngei nai lou Tubalte leh Javante kiang ah, ka thupina mu ngei nailoute kiangte ah ka sawl ding; huchi in nam chih lak ah ka thupina thu agen ding uh.
english: “I will set a sign among them, and I will send those who escape of them to the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, who draw the bow, to Tubal and Javan, to far-away islands, who have not heard my fame, nor have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the nations.

paite: Huchi in Israel telte'n athillat uh belsuan siangthoutak a TOUPA' inn a ahong lut zel bang un, TOUPA kiang a thillat ding in nam chih teng lak a kipan na unaute tengteng uh sakol tung, kangtalaite, zawnnate, sabiltung tungte, sangawngsau tungte ah, Jerusalem ka tang siangthou ah ahon pi ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: They shall bring all your brothers out of all the nations for an offering to Yahweh, on horses, in chariots, in litters, on mules, and on camels, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, says Yahweh, as the children of Israel bring their offering in a clean vessel into Yahweh’s house.

paite: "Huan huaite lak a kipan in siampu dingte leh Levi mi dingte ka la ding," TOUPA'N achi.
english: Of them I will also select priests and Levites,” says Yahweh.

paite: "Ka bawl ding van thakte leh lei thak ka ma ah om gige ding bang in, na suante uh leh na min uh leng a-om gige ding ahi," TOUPA'N achi.
english: “For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me,” says Yahweh, “so your offspring and your name shall remain.

paite: "Huan hichi ahi ding a, kha thak a kipan kha thak dang tan in, Sabbath ni a kipan Sabbath dang tan in mi tengteng ka ma a hon be ding in ahong pai zungzung ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: It shall happen that from one new moon to another, and from one Sabbath to another, all flesh will come to worship before me,” says Yahweh.

paite: Apaikhe ding ua, ka tung a talekte luang a-en ding uh; athante uh asi kei ding a, ameikuangte uh leng thah in a-om sam kei ding hi; mi tengteng a ding in thilkihhuai mahmah ahi ding uh.”
english: “They will go out, and look at the dead bodies of the men who have transgressed against me; for their worm will not die, nor will their fire be quenched, and they will be loathsome to all mankind.”

paite: Huan Uzziah tapa Jotham tapa Ahaz vaihawm lai in hichi ahi a, Siria kumpipa Rezin leh Israel kumpipa Remaliah tapa Pekah Jerusalem sim ding in akuantou ua; himahleh azou kei uhi.
english: In the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.

paite: Siria leh Ephraim apangkhawmta uh chi in David inkuanpihte ahilh ua, huchi in alungtang leh akhua-le-tuite lungtang, gamnuai singte huih in amutling suausuau bang in, hihlin in ahong omta hi.
english: David’s house was told, “Syria is allied with Ephraim.” His heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Isai kiang ah, "Nang leh na tapa Shear-jashub, dil saknungzaw pen tuilakna tawp ah, Puansawpmi gam lamlian ah, Ahaz dawn ding in kuankhia unla;
english: Then Yahweh said to Isaiah, “Go out now to meet Ahaz, you, and Shearjashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway of the fuller’s field.

paite: akiang ah, pilvang inla om kinken in; meisel sum khu lel nih, Siria toh Rezin leh Remaliah tapa hehna thupitak kihta ke'nla, na lungtang taikek kei hen.
english: Tell him, ‘Be careful, and keep calm. Don’t be afraid, neither let your heart be faint because of these two tails of smoking torches, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.

paite: Siria in, Ephraim leh Remaliah tapa toh nangmah tung a gitlouh asawm tak ziak in, chi in achi hi.
english: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,

paite: Judah dou ding in kuantou ni in, va hihlau ni, eimah a ding ngei in i va zou dia, alaitak ah kumpipa in Tabeel tapa i tusak ding," chi in.
english: “Let’s go up against Judah, and tear it apart, and let’s divide it among ourselves, and set up a king within it, even the son of Tabeel.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichibang in achi, "Athusawm uh apiching kei dia, avuaksuak ding.
english: This is what the Lord Yahweh says: “It shall not stand, neither shall it happen.”

paite: Siria lutang Damaskas ahi a, Damaskas lutang Rezin lah ahi ngal a; kum sawmguk leh kum nga man ma in Ephraim chi chihtak louh a om ding in suksiat vek in a-om ding.
english: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken in pieces, so that it shall not be a people.

paite: Huan Ephraim lutang Samaria ahi a, Samaria lutang Remaliah tapa lel ahih ziak in. Na up nop kei uleh hihkip in na om kei hial ding uh, chi in," achi hi.
english: The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If you will not believe, surely you shall not be established.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Ahaz ahoupih nawn a,
english: Yahweh spoke again to Ahaz, saying,

paite: "TOUPA na Pathian kiang ah chiamtehna ngen in; thukpi ah hiam, tunglam sangpi ah hiam ngen in," achi hi.
english: “Ask a sign of Yahweh your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.”

paite: Ahaz in bel, "Ka ngen kei ding, TOUPA ka ze-et kei ding," achi hi.
english: But Ahaz said, “I won’t ask. I won’t tempt Yahweh.”

paite: Huan ama'n, "David inkuanpihte aw, tu in ngaikhe dih ua; mihing hihgim thil neuchik ding in na sep uh maw, ka Pathian nangawn hihgim na ut zel uh?
english: He said, “Listen now, house of David. Is it not enough for you to try the patience of men, that you will try the patience of my God also?

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA mahmah in chiamtehna nou ahon pe ding; ngai un, nungak siangthou khat agai ding a, tapa anei ding a, amin 'Immanuel' asa ding uh.
english: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

paite: Ama'n thil hoih lou lam deihlouhna dan atheih chiang in leh thil hoih lam deihna dan atheih chiang in bawngnawi dat leh khuaizu ane ding.
english: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.

paite: Naupang thil hoih lou lam deihlouhna dan leh thil hoih lam deihna dan atheih ma in leng na lauh kumpipa nihte gam nutsiat in a-om ding," achi hi.
english: For before the child knows to refuse the evil and choose the good, the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken.

paite: "Ephraim in Judah anutsiat ni a kipan tung ngei nai lou nite TOUPA'N na tung ah leh na khua-le-tuite tung ah leh na pa inkuanpihte tung leh Assuria kumpipa mahmah tung ah atungsak ding hi.
english: Yahweh will bring on you, on your people, and on your father’s house days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah, even the king of Assyria.

paite: "Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N Aigupta luinak a thoute leh Assuria gam a khuai omte singsit in asam ding hi.
english: It will happen in that day that Yahweh will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.

paite: Huchi in ahong pai ding ua, avek un phaizang leh kense lak ah, suangpi hawm ah, loulingnei tengteng leh gantatna mun tengteng ah adim ding uhi.
english: They shall come, and shall all rest in the desolate valleys, in the clefts of the rocks, on all thorn hedges, and on all pastures.

paite: "Huai ni chiang in Toupa'n mulmet tem kikhel in, Luipi khen gam a Assuria kumpipa omte zang in, lutang leh khemul ametsiang ding a; khamul leng ametsiang vek ding hi.
english: In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.

paite: "Huchi in huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, mi khat in bawngla khat leh belam nih kia avul ding.
english: It shall happen in that day that a man shall keep alive a young cow, and two sheep.

paite: Himahleh hichi ahi ding a, nawitui tampi aneih ding ziak un nawituidat anesak ding; gamsung a om lai mi'n nawituidat leh khuaizu ne chiat ding ahi ngal ua.
english: It shall happen, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter, for everyone will eat butter and honey that is left within the land.

paite: "Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, mun chih, grepgui sang, dangka sang man omna peuhmahte loulingnei leh khaulingnei omna lel ahita ding.
english: It will happen in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand silver shekels, will be for briers and thorns.

paite: Gam pumpi loulingnei leh khaulingnei ngen ahong hih tak ziak in huai ah thaltang leh thalpeu tawi in apai ding uhi.
english: People will go there with arrows and with bow, because all the land will be briers and thorns.

paite: Huchi in mual, tupi a tohsa teng ah, loulingnei leh khaulingnei kihtak ziak in na hong pai kei ding a, bawngtalte tatsakna leh belam gamtatna mun ding lel ahita ding hi,” achi hi.
english: All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending out of oxen, and for sheep to tread on.”

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, “Laigelhna pek lianpi la inla, mihing laigelhna in atung ah Mahershalalhashbaz a ding, chi in gelh in.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Take a large tablet, and write on it with a man’s pen, ‘For Maher Shalal Hash Baz’;

paite: Huchi in theipih muanhuai, siampu Uriah leh Jaberekiah tapa Zekariah theihpihpa ding in ka bawl ding," achi hi.
english: and I will take for myself faithful witnesses to testify: Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.”

paite: Huan zawlneinu kiang ah ka hoh a, huchi in ama'n nau apai a, tapa aneita hi. Huchi in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Amin in Mahershalalhashbaz sa in.
english: I went to the prophetess, and she conceived, and bore a son. Then Yahweh said to me, “Call his name ‘Maher Shalal Hash Baz.’

paite: Naupang in, Nu, Pa, chihna dan atheih ma in leng Damaskas hauhsakna leh Samaria a gallak tengteng Assuria kumpipa ma ah apaimangpih ding uh," achi hi.
english: For before the child knows how to say, ‘My father’ and ‘My mother,’ the riches of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried away by the king of Assyria.”

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah agen nawn a,
english: Yahweh spoke to me yet again, saying,

paite: "Hiai chite'n Shiloah tui awl a luang diahdiah adeih louh ziak un leh Rezin leh Remaliah tapa tung a akipah un,
english: “Because this people has refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;

paite: huaiziak in tu in, ngai in, Toupa'n luipi tui, khauh mahmah leh tam mahmah, Assuria kumpipa leh athupina tengteng, atung uah aluangsak ding; huchi in apiau tengteng a hong let zoizoi in, agei tengteng ah leng alet zoizoi ding;
english: now therefore, behold, the Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Assyria and all his glory. It will come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks.

paite: huchi in Judah gam tuam in aluang ding a; ngawng tan atum pha hial ding a; akha zak in, Immanuel aw, na gam vailam tengteng akhak vek ding hi.
english: It will sweep onward into Judah. It will overflow and pass through. It will reach even to the neck. The stretching out of its wings will fill the width of your land, O Immanuel.

paite: Chichihte aw, buai vengvungta unla, kitamzak a om ding na hi uhi; gam gamlapi a mi tengteng aw, bildoh un; kigalthuam un, kitamzak a om ding na hi uhi; kigalthuam un, kitamzak a om ding na hi uhi.
english: Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be shattered! Dress for battle, and be shattered!

paite: Thu kikum unla, bangmah hi peuh ke'n teh; thu gen unla, piching peuh ke'n teh; Pathian i kiang ah a-om ngal a," chi in.
english: Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”

paite: TOUPA'N khut hattak in huchi in ka kiang ah agen, hiai chite lampi a ka pailouhna ding in hon thuzoh ei ve;
english: For Yahweh spoke this to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,

paite: Hiai chite'n, "Sawm anei uh, achih teng uh, Sawm anei uh, chihpih kei un, akihtak teng uh zong nou zaw kihta kei unla, lau leng laupih sam kei un.
english: “Don’t call a conspiracy all that this people call a conspiracy. Don’t fear their threats or be terrorized.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, amah mah na hihsiangthou ding uhi; amah na kihtak uh hi henla, amah na lauh uh hi hen.
english: Yahweh of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.

paite: Huan amah mun siangthou a ding ahi ding a; Israel inkuanpih nihte a ding in bel pukna suang leh dalna suangpi ahi zaw ding a, Jerusalem a omte a ding in thang leh pial ahi lai ding hi.
english: He will be a sanctuary, but for both houses of Israel, he will be a stumbling stone and a rock that makes them fall. For the people of Jerusalem, he will be a trap and a snare.

paite: Huchi in mi tampi in huai asui ding ua apuk ding uh, kitapsak in a-om ding ua, a-awk ding ua, mat in a-om ding uh," chi in.
english: Many will stumble over it, fall, be broken, be snared, and be captured.”

paite: Theihsakna thu zial gak inla, dan thu ka sinsakte lak ah bilh in.
english: Wrap up the covenant. Seal the law among my disciples.

paite: Huan ke'n Jakob inkuanpihte lak a amai selpa TOUPA ka ngak ding a, amah ka en nilouh ding.
english: I will wait for Yahweh, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.

paite: Ngai in, kei leh TOUPA hon piak naupangte, Israelte lak ah sepaihte' TOUPA Zion tang a om lak a chiamtehna a dingte leh thillamdang a dingte i hi uhi.
english: Behold, I and the children whom Yahweh has given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from Yahweh of Armies, who dwells in Mount Zion.

paite: Huan mi'n, "Dawi aisan siam zawl leh bumsiam ham tualtual leh phun nomnomte dong in, ahon chih chiang un huchi in dawng un; Mi'n a Pathian uh adot zawk ding uh hilou hia? Mihingte a ding in misi adong ding ua hia?"
english: When they tell you, “Consult with those who have familiar spirits and with the wizards, who chirp and who mutter,” shouldn’t a people consult with their God? Should they consult the dead on behalf of the living?

paite: "Dan thu leh theihsakna thu dot ding ahi," chi in. Huai thu bangbang a agen kei uleh amaute a ding in khua himhim avak zok kei ding hi.
english: Turn to the law and to the covenant! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.

paite: Lungkhamtak leh gilkial kawm in gam atuansuak ding ua; hichi ahi ding a, agil uh akial chiang in aheh mahmah ding ua, akumpipa uleh a Pathian uh ahamsiat ding ua, van lam anga ding uhi.
english: They will pass through it, very distressed and hungry. It will happen that when they are hungry, they will worry, and curse their king and their God. They will turn their faces upward,

paite: Huchi in lei lam a-en ding ua, ngai in, lungkhamna leh mialna, lunglauna nguina ahi ding; huchi in mial bikbek ah delhmang in a-om ding uh.
english: then look to the earth and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.

paite: Himahleh lunglau a om khinnu a ding in nguina himhim a-omta kei ding. Tunung Kumpipa Ding Nidanglai in Zebulun gam leh Naphtali gam simmohhuai in a-omsak a, himahleh hun nanung ah zaw thupitak in a-omsakta, tuipi gei, Jordan gal ah, namte' Galili mah.
english: But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.

paite: Mi mial nuai a vakte'n vak thupitak amuta ua; sihna lim gam a omte tung mahmah ah vak ahong vakta hi.
english: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. The light has shined on those who lived in the land of the shadow of death.

paite: Nam na pungsakta a, anopsakna uh na khangsakta hi; buhlak lai a nuamsa bang in na ma ah nuam asata ua, min gallak sum ahawm ua nuam asak bang mai un.
english: You have multiplied the nation. You have increased their joy. They rejoice before you according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the plunder.

paite: Apuakgik puakna hakkol leh aliangzang a zawnna zawl, amah nuaisiahte khetbuk mah, Midiante zoh ni bang in na suktansakta ngala.
english: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of Midian.

paite: Chiak vengvung a mi galthuam a akithuamna tengteng uleh puansilh sisan toh kidiah niaunuau tengteng, hal a, mei a khul ding phet ahi ngal a.
english: For all the armor of the armed man in the noisy battle, and the garments rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.

paite: Ei ding in naupang ahong piang a, tapa piak in i omta; vaihawmna aliangzang ah atuang ding a; amin Lamdang, Lemthei, Pathian Hat, Tangtawn Pa, Lemna Lal lah achi sin ngal ua.
english: For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

paite: David tutphah tung ah leh agam tung ah avaihawmna khandan leh lemna in tawp ni anei kei ding, hihkip ding leh tua kipan a tangtawn tan a leng vaihawmna leh diktatna tungding ding in, Sepaihte' TOUPA phatuamngaihna in huaite ahih ding.
english: Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of Yahweh of Armies will perform this.

paite: Toupa'n Jakobte gam ah thu akhak a, Israelte tung ah aketa.
english: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it falls on Israel.

paite: Huchi in mi tengteng, Ephraimte leh Samaria a om, kisatheitak leh lungsim a ki-uangsak;
english: All the people will know, including Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, who say in pride and in arrogance of heart,

paite: tekleite chim mahleh, suang tak sek in i lemna ding; theipi singte sattan in om mahleh, sidar singte in i kheng ding, chite'n athei ding uh.
english: “The bricks have fallen, but we will build with cut stone. The sycamore fig trees have been cut down, but we will put cedars in their place.”

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Rezin dou mite amah dou ding in atawisang ding a;
english: Therefore Yahweh will set up on high against him the adversaries of Rezin, and will stir up his enemies,

paite: amelma, suahlam a Siriate, tumlam a Philistiate, atokthou ding; huchi in kam ka in Israelte ane khin ding uh. Huchi hial ahih in leng ahehna adai kei a, akhut alik lailai hi.
english: The Syrians in front, and the Philistines behind; and they will devour Israel with open mouth. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

paite: Himahleh mite'n amaute vopa lam anga tuan kei ua, Sepaihte' TOUPA lah azong tuan kei uhi.
english: Yet the people have not turned to him who struck them, neither have they sought Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Israelte a kipan in alutang leh amei, tum hiang leh pumpeng ni khat thu in abantan ding.
english: Therefore Yahweh will cut off from Israel head and tail, palm branch and reed, in one day.

paite: Upa leh mizahtakhuaite, alutang ahi ua; zuauthu sinsak zawlneite, amei ahi uh.
english: The elder and the honorable man is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail.

paite: Hiai mipite'n apikhial nak uhi, apite uh hihmanthat in a-om nak uhi.
english: For those who lead this people lead them astray; and those who are led by them are destroyed.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N atangvalte uh tung ah akipak kei ding a, atagahte uleh ameithaite uh leng azahngai sam kei ding ua; avek un Pathian zahloumi leh thil hoih lou hih mite ahi chiat ua, akam un thugina lou agen uhi. Hichi ahih nung in leng, ahehna adai kei a, akhut alik lailai hi.
english: Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows; for everyone is profane and an evildoer, and every mouth speaks folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

paite: Gitlouhna lah mei bang in akuang luahluah a, loulingnei leh khaulingneite akangmang ahi, gammang nong lak akang luahluah a, akhutou ngoingoi hi.
english: For wickedness burns like a fire. It devours the briers and thorns; yes, it kindles in the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA heh ziak in gam akangsia a, mite leng mei a khul ding sing bang ahi ua; kuamah in amau unau leng ahawi kei uhi.
english: Through Yahweh of Armies’ wrath, the land is burned up; and the people are the fuel for the fire. No one spares his brother.

paite: Huchi in mi'n ataklam ua mi asuh ding ua, himahleh atai tuan kei ding uh; michih in amau bansa ane chiat ding uh.
english: One will devour on the right hand, and be hungry; and he will eat on the left hand, and they will not be satisfied. Everyone will eat the flesh of his own arm:

paite: Manassehte'n Ephraimte ane ding ua, Ephraimte'n Manassehte ane ding ua; anih un Judahte adoukhawm ding uhi. Huchi lawmlawm a ahih in leng, ahehna lah adai kei a, akhut alik lailai hi.
english: Manasseh eating Ephraim and Ephraim eating Manasseh, and they together will be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

paite: Jakob, Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Khrist sikha in, nam sawm-le-nih dalhzakte kiang ah chibai abuk hi.
english: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.

paite: Ka unaute aw, na ginna uh ze-etna in kuhkalna asiam chih thei in, khemna chiteng na tuah chiang un kipahna ngen in sim un.
english: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,

paite: Na ginna ze-etna un kuhkalna asiam chih thei in.
english: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

paite: Bangmah tasam lou a na kim ua, na vek ua na bit theihna ding un, kuhkalna in semkim hen.
english: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

paite: Na lak ua kuapeuh in pilna ataksapleh mi tengteng kiang a itlou leh tai lou a pepa Pathian kiang ah ngen hen, huchi in akiang ah piak ahi ding hi.
english: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

paite: Himahleh ginglel het lou in ginna nei in ngen hen, ginglelmi zaw tuipi kihot huih mutleng leh sep bang ahi.
english: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

paite: Huchibang mi'n Toupa a kipan bangmah muh kiging kei hen.
english: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.

paite: Lungsim det neiloumi athilhih tengteng ah akip kei hi.
english: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

paite: Unau daikil kal a om dopsang a a-om ziak in kipak hen;
english: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

paite: mihau hihneu a a-om ziak in kipak zaw hen; loupa pak bang a aman ding ziak in.
english: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

paite: Ni hong suak a huihlum ahong nun in loupa avuai a; apak apulh a; akilawmna amangthang hi; huchi mah bang in mihau apaina ah avuai ding hi.
english: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.

paite: Khemna thuak teitei mi ahampha hi; ze-et a a-om nung in Hinna Lallukhu, Toupa'n amah itte kiang a achiam amuh ding ziak in.
english: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.

paite: Kuamah in khemna atuah lai in Pathian khem ka hi, chi kei hen. Pathian gitlouhna toh khemvual ahi kei, ama'n leng kuamah akhem ngal kei a.
english: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

paite: Michih amau utna a hip leh pimang a a-om chiang un khemna atuak uh ahi zaw hi.
english: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.

paite: Huan utna pai ahih chiang in huai in khelhna apiangsak a, huan, huai khelhna ahong pichin in, sihna atun hi.
english: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

paite: Ka nau deihtakte aw, khem in om kei un.
english: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.

paite: Thilpiak hoih leh thilpiak buching tunglam a kipan a vakte Pa kiang a kipan a hong suk ahi a, amah ah lamdanna leh kikhekna lim a-om kei hi.
english: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.

paite: Athilsiamte lak a gah masa i hong hihtheihna ding in, amah deihlam in thutak lak a pan in ahon suangkhia hi.
english: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

paite: Unau deihtakte aw, huaite na thei uhi, himahleh michih ngaihkhiak kilawp henla, thugen kituhpih kei henla, heh hak hen.
english: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

paite: Mihing thangpaihna in Pathian diktatna abawl kei hi.
english: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.

paite: Huaiziak in nin tengteng leh gilou dim val koihmang unla, thu kipawi, na kha uh hondam thei, thunuailuttak in pom un.
english: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.

paite: Himahleh noumau kikhem in ngaikhete leltak hilou in thuzuite hi zaw un.
english: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

paite: Kuapeuh thu ngaikhia a zui tuan lou zaw limlang a apianpih maitang hoihtak a ki-en bang ahi.
english: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

paite: Hoihtak in aki-en a, apaimang zoh in mi bangchi ahia ahih akimangngilh nawn pah hi.
english: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

paite: Himahleh kuapeuh dan bukim, noplenna dan vel a, huchibang a om gige a, ngaikhia a, mangngilh nawn maimah nak bang hiloute zui a nasem gige, huai mi athilhih ah vualzawl in a-om ding hi.
english: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

paite: Kuapeuh sabiak limsak hi a kigingta a, alei venghoih lou a, amah lungtang kikhem zaw mi sabiakdan bangmah ahi kei hi.
english: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.

paite: I Pathian leh Pa mitmuh a sabiak siangthou leh gilou pang lou zaw, tagah leh meithaite agimthuak lai ua veh leh khovel buahna bang lou a kibawl zel ahi.
english: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.
