english: He was very thirsty, and called on Yahweh and said, “You have given this great deliverance by the hand of your servant; and now shall I die of thirst, and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?”

paite: Himahleh Pathian in Lehi mun a leikuak akhisak a, tui ahong kikhohkheta hi. Huai adawntak in alungsim ahong halh a, ahong hat nawnta hi. Huai mun min En-hakkore asa a; tuni tan in Lehi mun ah a-om lai hi.
english: But God split the hollow place that is in Lehi, and water came out of it. When he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived. Therefore its name was called En Hakkore, which is in Lehi, to this day.

paite: Huchi in Philistiate hun in Israelte tung ah kum sawmnih vai ahawm hi.
english: He judged Israel twenty years in the days of the Philistines.

paite: Huan Gaza ah Samson ahoh a, huai ah numei kizuak khat ava mu a, ava kithuahpih hi.
english: Samson went to Gaza, and saw there a prostitute, and went in to her.

paite: "Samson hiai ah ahong hoh," chi in Gaza mite ahilh uhi. Huchi in ava umta ua, khopi kulh kongpi chin ah zankhua in atang uhi. Zankhua in adai sipsip ua, "Khua hong vak peuhmahleh, huchi in that na ni," akichi uhi.
english: The Gazites were told, “Samson is here!” They surrounded him and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, “Wait until morning light; then we will kill him.”

paite: Samson bel zankim tan in alum a, zankim in athou a, khopi kulh kongkhakte leh akhuam nih alen a, akalhnate toh aphawikhe vek a, aliangzang ah apua a, Hebron ma a mualvum ah apotou hi.
english: Samson lay until midnight, then arose at midnight and took hold of the doors of the gate of the city, with the two posts, and plucked them up, bar and all, and put them on his shoulders and carried them up to the top of the mountain that is before Hebron.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, anung in Sorek Phaizang a numei khat a-it a, amin Delailah ahi.
english: It came to pass afterward that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.

paite: Philistia' miliante akiang ah ahohtou ua, akiang ah, "Amah ka zohtheihna ding un, ahatna san theih tum in kankhia in. Huchi in ka vek un dangka sangkhat-le-zakhat ka hon pe chiat ding uh," achi uhi.
english: The lords of the Philistines came up to her and said to her, “Entice him, and see in which his great strength lies, and by what means we may prevail against him, that we may bind him to afflict him; and we will each give you eleven hundred pieces of silver.”

paite: Huchi in Delailah in Samson kiang ah, "Na hat mahmahna san hon hilh dih ve. Bangchi in ahia hihnat dia khau khihtheih na hih ding?" achi hi.
english: Delilah said to Samson, “Please tell me where your great strength lies, and what you might be bound to afflict you.”

paite: Samson in akiang ah, "Khauhual thak, keu nai lou sagih in hon hen le uchin, ka hat kei dia, midang bang lel mah ka hi ding,” achi hi.
english: Samson said to her, “If they bind me with seven green cords that were never dried, then shall I become weak, and be as another man.”

paite: Huchi in Philistiate' miliante'n khauhual thak sagih, keu nai lou apia ua, ama'n huaite in ahenta hi.
english: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green cords which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.

paite: Dantan sunggil ah guktan mite akoih a, akiang ah, "Samson, Philistiate'n hon sual dek uh e," achi hi. Mei in ziza khaulom akattat bang phet in ama'n khauhual ahihtanta hi. Huchi in ahatna san atheikhe zou kei hi.
english: Now she had an ambush waiting in the inner room. She said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” He broke the cords as a flax thread is broken when it touches the fire. So his strength was not known.

paite: Delailah in Samson kiang ah, "Ngai in, na hon khem a, zuau hon hilh na hi. Bangchi a hen theih ding na hia? Hon hilhta in," achi hi.
english: Delilah said to Samson, “Behold, you have mocked me, and told me lies. Now please tell me how you might be bound.”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Khauzen thak, zat nai louh in hon hen le uh, huchi in ka hat kei mai ding, midang bang lel mah ka hi ding," achi hi.
english: He said to her, “If they only bind me with new ropes with which no work has been done, then I will become weak, and be as another man.”

paite: Delailah in khauzen thak ala a, ahen a, akiang ah, "Samson, Philistiate'n ahon sual dek uh," achi hi. Dantan sunggil ah guktan mite a-om uhi. Akhut a henna patzang suktat bang mai in ahihtanta hi.
english: So Delilah took new ropes and bound him with them, then said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” The ambush was waiting in the inner room. He broke them off his arms like a thread.

paite: Delailah in Samson kiang ah, "N'on khem lai a, zuau na hon hilh lai hi. Bangchi a hen theih ding na hia? hon hilh dih ve," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Ka samphek sagih puan in gatkhum leteh ahi mai," achi hi.
english: Delilah said to Samson, “Until now, you have mocked me and told me lies. Tell me with what you might be bound.” He said to her, “If you weave the seven locks of my head with the fabric on the loom.”

paite: Ama'n kilhna in akilhkip giugeu a, akiang ah, "Samson, Philistiate'n hon sual dek uh e,” achi hi. Huchi in ihmu lai ahong halh a, puanbu kilhdenna leh puanbu nangawn toh kikhongsak in apaikhia hi.
english: She fastened it with the pin, and said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” He awakened out of his sleep, and plucked away the pin of the beam and the fabric.

paite: Akiang ah, "Na lungtang hon pe hetloupi in, bangchidan a ka hon it, chi thei na hia oi? Tu'n thumvei hilhial na hon khemta hi, na hat mahmahna san na hon hilh nai kei lailai," achi hi.
english: She said to him, “How can you say, ‘I love you,’ when your heart is not with me? You have mocked me these three times, and have not told me where your great strength lies.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, niteng a ngen ngutngut a, adotdot ziak in, si ding khop hial in alunggimta hi.
english: When she pressed him daily with her words and urged him, his soul was troubled to death.

paite: Huchi in alungsim tengteng ahilh vekta hi. Akiang ah, "Ka lu ah mulmet tem himhim zat ahi ngei nai kei hi. Ka nu sul a ka om lai a pan Pathian a dia Nazarit mi dia na om ka hi. Tu in met taleng, ka hatna amang vek ding, huchi in ka hat kei dia, midang bang lel ka hi ding," achi hi.
english: He told her all his heart and said to her, “No razor has ever come on my head; for I have been a Nazirite to God from my mother’s womb. If I am shaved, then my strength will go from me and I will become weak, and be like any other man.”

paite: Alungsim tengteng ahilh vekta chih Delailah in atheih phet in, "Tu kia hong hoh un, alungsim tengteng ahon hilh vekta," chi in Philistia' miliante thukhak in asamsak hi. Huchi in akiang ah Philistia' miliante ava hohtou ua, dangka atawi uhi.
english: When Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, “Come up this once, for he has told me all his heart.” Then the lords of the Philistines came up to her and brought the money in their hand.

paite: Apheipi tung ah a-ihmusak hi. Mi asam a, asamphek sagihte ametkhesak vek hi. Huchi in amah ahihgim panta a, ahatna in anuseta hi.
english: She made him sleep on her knees; and she called for a man and shaved off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.

paite: "Samson, Philistiate'n ahong sual dek uh e,” achi hi. Ihmu lai ahong halh a, "Nidang mah bang in ka pawtkhe nawn ding a, ka kitungkhe nawn ding," achi hi. Himahleh TOUPA'N apaisan khinta chih himhim athei kei hi.
english: She said, “The Philistines are upon you, Samson!” He awoke out of his sleep, and said, “I will go out as at other times, and shake myself free.” But he didn’t know that Yahweh had departed from him.

paite: Philistiate'n aman ua, amitte akhelkhiaksak uhi. Gaza ah apaipihsuk ua, sikkol abunsak ua; suangkul ah buh gawizantu in apang hi.
english: The Philistines laid hold on him and put out his eyes; and they brought him down to Gaza and bound him with fetters of bronze; and he ground at the mill in the prison.

paite: Himahleh asam met ahih nung in hong pou in ahong khang nawn hi.
english: However, the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaved.

paite: Philistia' miliante Dagon pathian kiang a kithoihna thupitak lan ding leh kihih nuamsa ding in akikhawm uhi. "I pathian un i melmapa uh Samson ahon peta," achi uhi.
english: The lords of the Philistines gathered together to offer a great sacrifice to Dagon their god, and to rejoice; for they said, “Our god has delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.”

paite: Mipite'n amuh un apathian uh aphat ua, "I pathian un i melmapa, i gam hihsia a mi tampite thatpa i khut uah ahon peta," achi uhi.
english: When the people saw him, they praised their god; for they said, “Our god has delivered our enemy and the destroyer of our country, who has slain many of us, into our hand.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, alungtang un nuam asak laitak in, Samson pen muhnop ding in va sam dih ua, achi uhi. Huchi in suangkul a pan Samson ava samkhia uhi. Ama uah muhnop ding in a-omta a; khuam leh khuam kikal ah adingsak uhi.
english: When their hearts were merry, they said, “Call for Samson, that he may entertain us.” They called for Samson out of the prison; and he performed before them. They set him between the pillars;

paite: Samson in amah kaitu naupang kiang ah, "Hiai inn dou pen khuam hon khoihsak dih ve, ka hon ngai deh," achi hi.
english: and Samson said to the boy who held him by the hand, “Allow me to feel the pillars on which the house rests, that I may lean on them.”

paite: Huai inn, pasal leh numei in adim miuhmeuh uhi. Philistiate milian tengteng huai ah a-om vek ua, Samson muhnop dia en mite intung ah pasal leh numei sangthum a-om uhi.
english: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines were there; and there were on the roof about three thousand men and women, who saw while Samson performed.

paite: Samson in TOUPA asam a, "Aw Toupa PATHIAN, hehpih in hon theigige inla, hehpih in tutung in hon hihhat in, aw Pathian, ka mit langnih phu Philistiate tung ah tu kia hon lasak in," achi hi.
english: Samson called to Yahweh, and said, “Lord Yahweh, remember me, please, and strengthen me, please, only this once, God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.”

paite: Samson in, huai inn dou pen sut nihte alen a, akhut taklam in khat, akhut veilam in khat mah apansan hi.
english: Samson took hold of the two middle pillars on which the house rested and leaned on them, the one with his right hand and the other with his left.

paite: Samson in, "Philistiate toh sikhawm ning e," achi hi. Huchi in theihtawp in akunsuk a; miliante leh mipi asung a om tengtengte huai inn chim in adelhkhumta hi. Huchi in adam lai a athahte sang in asihkhumte atamzaw uhi.
english: Samson said, “Let me die with the Philistines!” He bowed himself with all his might; and the house fell on the lords, and on all the people who were in it. So the dead that he killed at his death were more than those who he killed in his life.

paite: Huchi in a-unaute leh apa inkote tengteng ahong paisuk ua, ala ua azawngtou ua, Zorah leh Eshtaol kikal a; apa Manoah kivuina mun ah avuita uhi. Huchi in ama'n kum sawmnih sung Israelte tung ah vai ahawm hi.
english: Then his brothers and all the house of his father came down and took him, and brought him up and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the burial site of Manoah his father. He judged Israel twenty years.

paite: Huan Ephraim tanggam ah mi khat a-om a, amin Mikah ahi.
english: There was a man of the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Micah.

paite: Ama'n anu kiang ah, "Dangka sangkhat-le-zakhat nang a pan lakmang a omte, nang leng na hamsiat leh ka zak mahmah a na gen pen, ngai in, huai dangka ka kiang ah a-om, kei lak ahi,” achi hi. Anu'n, "Ka tapa TOUPA vualzawl in om hen," achi hi.
english: He said to his mother, “The eleven hundred pieces of silver that were taken from you, about which you uttered a curse, and also spoke it in my ears—behold, the silver is with me. I took it.” His mother said, “May Yahweh bless my son!”

paite: Dangka sangkhat-le-zakhat anu apekik a, anu'n, "Hiai dangka kei khut mahmah in ka tapa in milim abawlna ding leh milim asunna ding in TOUPA kiang ah ka lan hi. Huaiziak in tu in ka hon pekik ding," achi hi.
english: He restored the eleven hundred pieces of silver to his mother, then his mother said, “I most certainly dedicate the silver to Yahweh from my hand for my son, to make a carved image and a molten image. Now therefore I will restore it to you.”

paite: Huchi in huai dangka anu apekik a, anu'n dangka zanih ala a, dangka sekmi apia a, ama'n milim khuakthoh leh sunthohte ana bawl a, huaite Mikah inn ah a-om uhi.
english: When he restored the money to his mother, his mother took two hundred pieces of silver, and gave them to a silversmith, who made a carved image and a molten image out of it. It was in the house of Micah.

paite: Mikah in pathiante inn anei a, ephod leh milimte abawl a, atapa khat asiampu in aseptuamta hi.
english: The man Micah had a house of gods, and he made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.

paite: Huai lai in Israel gam ah kumpipa a-om kei a; michih in ama mit a dik asakte ahih chiat mai uhi.
english: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.

paite: Judah gam Bethlehem mi Judah nam, Levi chi tangval khat, huai ah ava om hi.
english: There was a young man out of Bethlehem Judah, of the family of Judah, who was a Levite; and he lived there.

paite: Huai mi Bethlehem Judah khopi a pan apawt a, omna zong a vak ahi. Avakna lam ah Ephraim tanggam a Mikah inn ava tung hi.
english: The man departed out of the city, out of Bethlehem Judah, to live where he could find a place, and he came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, as he traveled.

paite: Mikah in akiang ah, "Koi a pan hong pai na hia?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Bethlehem Judah mi Levi chi ka hi a, omna mun zong a vak ka hi,” achi hi.
english: Micah said to him, “Where did you come from?” He said to him, “I am a Levite of Bethlehem Judah, and I am looking for a place to live.”

paite: Mikah in akiang ah, "Ka pa leh siampu ding in ka kiang ah teng in, kum teng in, dangkasik tang sawm ka hon pe dia, puansilh khat leh nek dingte leng," achi hi. Huchi in Levi chi alutta hi.
english: Micah said to him, “Dwell with me, and be to me a father and a priest, and I will give you ten pieces of silver per year, a suit of clothing, and your food.” So the Levite went in.

paite: Levi chi, huai mi kiang a ten alungkim hi. Huchi in atapa khat bang in huai tangvalpa a-omta hi.
english: The Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man was to him as one of his sons.

paite: Mikah in Levi chi aseptuamta a, huchi in tangvalpa asiampu in apangta a, Mikah inn ah atengta hi.
english: Micah consecrated the Levite, and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.

paite: Huchi in Mikah in, "Tu in zaw Levi chi ka siampu ding in ka neita hi. TOUPA'N ahon lamzangsak ngei ding, chih ka thei," achi hi.
english: Then Micah said, “Now I know that Yahweh will do good to me, since I have a Levite as my priest.”

paite: Huai lai in Israel gam ah kumpipa a-om kei. Dan chite’n gam luah ding azong uhi. Israel chite lak ah gam luah ding atang nai kei uhi.
english: In those days there was no king in Israel. In those days the tribe of the Danites sought an inheritance to dwell in; for to that day, their inheritance had not fallen to them among the tribes of Israel.

paite: Dan suante'n anam pumpi lak ua mi, pasalpha nga, Zorah leh Eshtaol a pan gam enkhe ding leh va entel ding in mi asawl uhi. Akiang uah, "Va kuan unla, gam va entel dih ua," achi uhi. Huchi in Ephraim tanggam a Mikah inn ava tung ua, huai ah agiak uhi.
english: The children of Dan sent five men of their family from their whole number, men of valor, from Zorah and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land and to search it. They said to them, “Go, explore the land!” They came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, and lodged there.

paite: Mikah inn kiang a a-om lai un, Levi chi tangval aw athei ua, huai lam ava zuan ua, akiang ah, "Hiai a hon pi kua ahia? Hiai mun ah bang ahia na hih? Bangchi in ahia hiai a na ten?" achi uhi.
english: When they were by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite; so they went over there and said to him, “Who brought you here? What do you do in this place? What do you have here?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Mikah in huchi in ahon na bawlta a, ahon guai a, asiampu in ka om hi," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Thus and thus has Micah dealt with me, and he has hired me, and I have become his priest.”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Ka hohna ding uah ka lamzang ding uh hia ding lou, chih theihtheihna ding in Pathian hon dotsak dih ve," achi uhi.
english: They said to him, “Please ask counsel of God, that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.”

paite: Siampu in akiang uah, "Lungmuangtak in pai un. Na hohna ding ma uah TOUPA a-om hi,” achi hi.
english: The priest said to them, “Go in peace. Your way in which you go is before Yahweh.”

paite: Huchi in mi ngate apawtkhia ua, Laish ah alut ua, huai mite Zidon mite mah bang a galmuangtak leh lungmuangtak a om hithiat a om ava mu ua; amaute zahlaksak ding thuneimi kuamah a-om kei a, Zidonte toh akigamla ua, kuamah toh leng akisai kha kei uhi.
english: Then the five men departed and came to Laish and saw the people who were there, how they lived in safety, in the way of the Sidonians, quiet and secure; for there was no one in the land possessing authority, that might put them to shame in anything, and they were far from the Sidonians, and had no dealings with anyone else.

paite: Zorah leh Eshtaol ah a-unaute uh kiang ah ahong pai ua; a-unaute un akiang uah, "Bangchi ahia oi?" achi uhi.
english: They came to their brothers at Zorah and Eshtaol; and their brothers asked them, “What do you say?”

paite: Amau, "Thou dih ua, i sual ding uh. Gam ahihleh ka va mu ngei ua, ngai un, ahoih mahmah hi. Dai maimah ding na hi uhia? Huai gam va lut a, va luah ding in zekai kei dih uh.
english: They said, “Arise, and let’s go up against them; for we have seen the land, and behold, it is very good. Do you stand still? Don’t be slothful to go and to enter in to possess the land.

paite: Va hoh le uchin galmuang a om mite ahi chih na va mu ding uh; agam lah aza mahmah ngal a. Pathian in nou ahon pe khinta hi. Lei a thil om ah zaw bangmah taksap ding a-om hetlouhna mun ahi," achi uhi.
english: When you go, you will come to an unsuspecting people, and the land is large; for God has given it into your hand, a place where there is no lack of anything that is on the earth.”

paite: Huchi in Zorah leh Eshtaol a pan Dan namte kidouna galthuam silh in mi zaguk apawt uhi.
english: The family of the Danites set out from Zorah and Eshtaol with six hundred men armed with weapons of war.

paite: Ava hohtou ua, Judah gam Kiriath-jearim ah om mun abawl uh. Huaiziak in huai mun tuni tan in Mananeh Dan achi lai ua, Kiriath-jearim tang lam a om ahi.
english: They went up and encamped in Kiriath Jearim in Judah. Therefore they call that place Mahaneh Dan to this day. Behold, it is behind Kiriath Jearim.

paite: Huai a pan Ephraim tanggam lam azuan ua, Mikah inn ava tung uhi.
english: They passed from there to the hill country of Ephraim, and came to the house of Micah.

paite: Huchi in Laish gam enkhe dia mi nga pawtte'n adawng ua, a-unaute uh kiang ah, "Hiai innte ah ephod, milimte, milim bawltawmte, milim suntawmte a-om chih na thei uhia? Huchi bangchi in ahia na hih ding uh ngaihtuah un," achi uhi,
english: Then the five men who went to spy out the country of Laish answered and said to their brothers, “Do you know that there is in these houses an ephod, and teraphim, and a carved image, and a molten image? Now therefore consider what you have to do.”

paite: Huai a pan apai ua, Levi chi tangval omna Mikah inn ngei ava tung ua, atungtang thu adong uhi.
english: They went over there and came to the house of the young Levite man, even to the house of Micah, and asked him how he was doing.

paite: Dan suan mi zaguk kidouna galthuam silhte kulh kongpi bul ah adingh uhi.
english: The six hundred men armed with their weapons of war, who were of the children of Dan, stood by the entrance of the gate.

paite: Mi nga gam enkhete ava hohtou ua, alut ua, milim bawltawm, ephod, milimte leh suntawm milimte ala ua, mi zaguk kidouna galthuam silhte lak ah kulh kongpi bul ah siampu adingh hi.
english: The five men who went to spy out the land went up, and came in there, and took the engraved image, the ephod, the teraphim, and the molten image; and the priest stood by the entrance of the gate with the six hundred men armed with weapons of war.

paite: Huaite Mikah inn ah ava lut ua, bawltawm milimte, ephod, milimte leh suntawm milimte ava lak uleh, siampu in akiang uah, "Hiai a bang hih na mai ua?" achi hi.
english: When these went into Micah’s house, and took the engraved image, the ephod, the teraphim, and the molten image, the priest said to them, “What are you doing?”

paite: Amau, "Dai in, na khut in na muk hum inla, ka kiang uah hong pai inla, ka pa uh leh siampu ding un hong om in. Nang a ding in inn khat kia siampu a om hia hoihzaw, Israel lak a chi khat leh nam khat siampu dia om?" achi uhi.
english: They said to him, “Hold your peace, put your hand on your mouth, and go with us. Be a father and a priest to us. Is it better for you to be priest to the house of one man, or to be priest to a tribe and a family in Israel?”

paite: Siampu lungtang akipak mahmah a, huchi in ephod, milim leh bawltawm milimte ala a, mipite lak ah a-omta hi.
english: The priest’s heart was glad, and he took the ephod, the teraphim, and the engraved image, and went with the people.

paite: Huchi in apaikhia ua, anau neute uh, gante uh leh avante uh amasuan tou zel uh.
english: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones, the livestock, and the goods before them.

paite: Mikah inn a pan gamla kuam apaikhiak nung un Mikah invengte akikaikhawm ua, Dan suante adelhphata uhi.
english: When they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men who were in the houses near Micah’s house gathered together and overtook the children of Dan.

paite: Dan suante asam uhi. Amau anunglam anga ua, Mikah kiang ah, "Bang achia ahia, mi huai zahzah na hon tonpih?" achi uhi.
english: As they called to the children of Dan, they turned their faces, and said to Micah, “What ails you, that you come with such a company?”

paite: Ama'n, "Ka bawl pathiante leh siampu na paipih ua, na pai vengveng ua, bang ka nei lai a? Bangziak a bangchi na hia, na hon chih uh?" achi hi.
english: He said, “You have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and have gone away! What more do I have? How can you ask me, ‘What ails you?’”

paite: Dan suante'n akiang ah, "Ka lak uah pau mawkmawk kei dih aw, huchi lou in zaw mithangpai khut na thuak kha dia, na inkote toh na hinna na tan ding uh," achi uhi.
english: The children of Dan said to him, “Don’t let your voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows fall on you, and you lose your life, with the lives of your household.”

paite: Huchi in Dan suante apai ua, Mikah in lah sual ngam vual hi un athei kei a, a-inn lam ah apai nawnta hi.
english: The children of Dan went their way; and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back to his house.

paite: Mikah thilbawlte leh asiampu neih apaipih ua, Laish khua, galmuang a om hithiatte kiang atungtou ua, namsau in athat ua; mei in khua ahalta uh.
english: They took that which Micah had made, and the priest whom he had, and came to Laish, to a people quiet and unsuspecting, and struck them with the edge of the sword; then they burned the city with fire.

paite: Zidon a pan agamlat mahmah ziak in va hunkhe ding mi kuamah a-om kei, akuakua toh kizatna mahmah anei kei uh. Beth-rehob kiang a om phaizang ahi a, khopi khat alam ua, huai ah atengta uhi.
english: There was no deliverer, because it was far from Sidon, and they had no dealings with anyone else; and it was in the valley that lies by Beth Rehob. They built the city and lived in it.

paite: Akho min Israel tapa, apu uh Dan tam in, Dan asa uhi. Himahleh atung in huai kho min Laish ahi.
english: They called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born to Israel; however the name of the city used to be Laish.

paite: Dan suante'n huai milim bawltawm adingkhesakta ua, Mosi tapa Gershon tapa Jonathan leh atapate, gam sal a pi ahih masiah uh Dan chite siampu ahita uhi.
english: The children of Dan set up for themselves the engraved image; and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons were priests to the tribe of the Danites until the day of the captivity of the land.

paite: Huchi in Mikah bawltawm milim ahihleh Shiloh a Pathian inn a a-om lai teng adingsak uhi.
english: So they set up for themselves Micah’s engraved image which he made, and it remained all the time that God’s house was in Shiloh.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai lai a Israel gam a kumpipa a-om louh lai in, Levi chi a mi khat Ephraim tanggam tawp lam ah a-om a, Judah gam a Bethlehem mi mei in anei hi.
english: In those days, when there was no king in Israel, there was a certain Levite living on the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim, who took for himself a concubine out of Bethlehem Judah.

paite: Amei in ang a kawm san a, huchi in Judah gam a Bethlehem a apa inn ah ataisan hi. Huai ah kha li tak a-om hi.
english: His concubine played the prostitute against him, and went away from him to her father’s house to Bethlehem Judah, and was there for four months.

paite: Apasal athou a, asikha leh asabiltung nih pi in kamdam in ava khem a, lungkim a pikik nawn tum in ava delhzui hi. Ama'n apa inn ah ana pilut a, apa'n ana muh in ana kipahpih hi.
english: Her husband arose and went after her to speak kindly to her, to bring her again, having his servant with him and a couple of donkeys. She brought him into her father’s house; and when the father of the young lady saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.

paite: Asungpa, numei pa'n akiang a om ding in ana khou a; akiang ah ni thum a-om a, ane un adawnkhawm ua, huai ah atung hi.
english: His father-in-law, the young lady’s father, kept him there; and he stayed with him three days. So they ate and drank, and stayed there.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani li ni in zingkhang in athou a, amah bel pawt tum in athou hi. Numei pa'n amakpa kiang ah, "Tanghou tawmchik ne in. Na lungtang hihhalh tadih inla, huai khit chiang in na pai na ding," achi hi.
english: On the fourth day, they got up early in the morning, and he rose up to depart. The young lady’s father said to his son-in-law, “Strengthen your heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward you shall go your way.”

paite: Huchi in atu ua, anih un ane un adawnkhawm uh. Numei pa'n huai mi kiang ah, "Lungkimtak in tuzan giak in, na lungtang nuamsak in," achi hi.
english: So they sat down, ate, and drank, both of them together. Then the young lady’s father said to the man, “Please be pleased to stay all night, and let your heart be merry.”

paite: Huai mi bel pawt tum in athou a, himahleh asungpa'n azolzol a, agiak nawnta hi.
english: The man rose up to depart; but his father-in-law urged him, and he stayed there again.

paite: Ani nga zingkhangpi in pawt tum in athou hi. Numei pa'n, "Na lungtang hihhalh tadih lechin akei dia, nitak ninem hun tan bek om tadih in," achi hi. Huchi in anih un an anekhawm nawn uhi.
english: He arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart; and the young lady’s father said, “Please strengthen your heart and stay until the day declines;” and they both ate.

paite: Huai mi bel amei leh asikha toh pawt tum a akisakleh asungpa, numei pa'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, ni leng akaita, tuzan giak nawn mai inla, ni leng tum ding ahita. Hiai ah giak in; na lungtang akipahna ding in. Huchi in zingchiang in zingkhang in na thou dia, inn lam ah na pai mai ding," achi hi.
english: When the man rose up to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father-in-law, the young lady’s father, said to him, “Behold, now the day draws toward evening, please stay all night. Behold, the day is ending. Stay here, that your heart may be merry; and tomorrow go on your way early, that you may go home.”

paite: Himahleh huai mi huai zan giah a-ut kei a, athou a, apawtta hi. Jebus kho zawn atung a, huai tuh Jerusalem khua ahi, sabiltung nih bawlsa api a; amei leng atel hi.
english: But the man wouldn’t stay that night, but he rose up and went near Jebus (also called Jerusalem). With him were a couple of saddled donkeys. His concubine also was with him.

paite: Jebus kho kiang atun un ni akai mahmahta hi. Sikha in apu kiang ah, "Hong pai dih, hiai Jebuste khopi ah i lut mai dia, i giak mai ding," achi hi.
english: When they were by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the servant said to his master, “Please come and let’s enter into this city of the Jebusites, and stay in it.”

paite: Apu'n akiang ah, "Israel suan hilou namdang khua ah lut lou e. Gibeah kholam i zuan zaw ding," achi hi.
english: His master said to him, “We won’t enter into the city of a foreigner that is not of the children of Israel; but we will pass over to Gibeah.”

paite: Asikha kiang ah, "Kisa aw, hiai munte akoi zaw hiam i zuan ding. Gibeah ah hiam, Ramah ah hiam i giak ding," achi hi.
english: He said to his servant, “Come and let’s draw near to one of these places; and we will lodge in Gibeah, or in Ramah.”

paite: Huchi in apai nawn zel ua; Benjaminte Gibeah kho kiang atun un ni atumta hi.
english: So they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down on them near Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin.

paite: Gibeah a giak ding in alut ua, alut un huai khopi kholak ah atu uh; kuamah zintun ding a-om ngal kei ua.
english: They went over there, to go in to stay in Gibeah. He went in, and sat down in the street of the city; for there was no one who took them into his house to stay.

paite: Ngai in, nitaklam in putek khat lou kuan ahong pai hi. Huai mi bel Ephraim tanggam a mi ahi a, Gibeah a om zual ahi. Amah Benjamin chite lak a ahi.
english: Behold, an old man came from his work out of the field at evening. Now the man was from the hill country of Ephraim, and he lived in Gibeah; but the men of the place were Benjamites.

paite: Akiheileh kholak a mikhualpa amu hi. Putek in, "Koi a hoh ding? Koi a pan a hong pai na hia?" achi hi.
english: He lifted up his eyes, and saw the wayfaring man in the street of the city; and the old man said, “Where are you going? Where did you come from?”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Judah gam a Bethlehem a pan Ephraim tang tawp gam lam a hoh tum ka hi uh. Huai a om ka hi, Bethlehem, Judah gam ah ka va hoh a; tu in TOUPA' inn a hoh tum ka hi. Kuamah hon zintun a-om kei hi.
english: He said to him, “We are passing from Bethlehem Judah to the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim. I am from there, and I went to Bethlehem Judah. I am going to Yahweh’s house; and there is no one who has taken me into his house.

paite: Ka sabiltung ua ding buhpawl leh gan an ka nei uh. Kei leh na sikhanu leh na sikhate kiang a om tangval a ding leng tanghou leh uain a-om lai a, bangmah taksap ka nei kei uh," achi hi.
english: Yet there is both straw and feed for our donkeys; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for your servant, and for the young man who is with your servants. There is no lack of anything.”

paite: Putek in, "Lungmuangtak in om in. Na kulna tengteng ke'n ka tum vek ding. Kholak ah zaw giak mahmah ke'n," achi hi.
english: The old man said, “Peace be to you! Just let me supply all your needs, but don’t sleep in the street.”

paite: Huchi in a-inn ah apilut a, sabiltungte an apia a; akhete uh asil ua, ne in adawn uhi.
english: So he brought him into his house, and gave the donkeys fodder. Then they washed their feet, and ate and drank.

paite: Huchi a nuamsa leh kipaktak a a-om lai un, ngai in, huai khua a mi, Belial tapate khenkhat in huai inn ahon umta uh. Kongkhak ahong khen ua; inn neipa putek kiang ah, "Na inn a hong tungpa hon pikhia in, ka kithuahpih ding uh," achi uhi.
english: As they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, certain wicked fellows, surrounded the house, beating at the door; and they spoke to the master of the house, the old man, saying, “Bring out the man who came into your house, that we can have sex with him!”

paite: Inn neipa akiang uah ava pawt a, akiang uah, "Hilou e, ka unaute aw, hichi tel a gilou zaw hih mahmah kei un. Hiai mi ka mikhual ahi. Hiai thil haihuai hih kei un," achi hi.
english: The man, the master of the house, went out to them, and said to them, “No, my brothers, please don’t act so wickedly; since this man has come into my house, don’t do this folly.

paite: "Ngai un, hiai ah ka tanu nungak leh amei a-om uh. Amau ka hon pikhe dia, amaute zahlaksak in na ut-ut uh atung uah hih un. Himahleh hiai mi tung ah zaw hiai thil gilou hih kei un," achi hi.
english: Behold, here is my virgin daughter and his concubine. I will bring them out now. Humble them, and do with them what seems good to you; but to this man don’t do any such folly.”

paite: Himahleh huai mite'n athu azui nuam kei ua, huchi in hiai mi'n amei aman a, akiang uah ava pikhia hi. Amau ana kithuahpih ua, khovak masiah zankhua in apawngsual uhi. Huchi a khua ahong vaktak in, akhah uhi.
english: But the men wouldn’t listen to him; so the man grabbed his concubine, and brought her out to them; and they had sex with her, and abused her all night until the morning. When the day began to dawn, they let her go.

paite: Khua ahong vaktak in numei apai a, apu tunnapa inn kongpi bul ah apuk a, khovak nung tan in a-om nilouh hi.
english: Then the woman came in the dawning of the day, and fell down at the door of the man’s house where her lord was, until it was light.

paite: Apu zingsang in ahong thou a, inn kongpite ahong a, pai tum in ava pawt hi. Ngai in, ameinu kongpi bul ah akhutte insung lam nga in ana lum hi.
english: Her lord rose up in the morning and opened the doors of the house, and went out to go his way; and behold, the woman his concubine had fallen down at the door of the house, with her hands on the threshold.

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Thou in, i pai ding,” achi hi. Himahleh adawng kei. Huchi in asabiltung tung ah akoihtou a; athou a, amun lam ah apaita hi.
english: He said to her, “Get up, and let’s get going!” but no one answered. Then he took her up on the donkey; and the man rose up, and went to his place.

paite: A-inn atun in temta ala a, amei asem a, aguhte toh seh sawm-le-nih in asemnen a, Israel gam teng ah akhak vek hi.
english: When he had come into his house, he took a knife and cut up his concubine, and divided her, limb by limb, into twelve pieces, and sent her throughout all the borders of Israel.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, amu peuhmahte'n, "Israel suante Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawt nung uh hichibang thilhih leh muh tutan in a-om ngei nai kei. 'Ngaihtuah unla, kihou unla, na lungsim uh gen un, " achi uhi.
english: It was so, that all who saw it said, “Such a deed has not been done or seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt to this day! Consider it, take counsel, and speak.”

paite: TOUPA Angel khat Gilgal a pan Bokim ah ahohtou hi. Ama'n, "Aigupta gam a pan ka hon pawtsak a, 'na pipute uh kiang a kichiam a ka na chiamsa gam ah ka hon pilut a, noute toh ka thukhun ka bohse kei hial ding.
english: Yahweh’s angel came up from Gilgal to Bochim. He said, “I brought you out of Egypt, and have brought you to the land which I swore to give your fathers. I said, ‘I will never break my covenant with you.

paite: Hiai gam a tengte toh thu khung kei unla; amaitamte uh hihchipsak un' ka chi hi. Himahleh ka thupiak na zui kei ua, bangziak in ahia hiai na hih uh?
english: You shall make no covenant with the inhabitants of this land. You shall break down their altars.’ But you have not listened to my voice. Why have you done this?

paite: Huaiziak in amaute ka hon delhkhiaksak nawn kei dia, na pang uah lingte ahi zawta ding ua, apathiante uh nou a ding in thang ahi ding uh," ka chi ahi.
english: Therefore I also said, ‘I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be in your sides, and their gods will be a snare to you.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA angel in Israel suan tengteng kiang a hiai thu agenleh mipite aw suah hial in akap uhi.
english: When Yahweh’s angel spoke these words to all the children of Israel, the people lifted up their voice and wept.

paite: Huai mun min Bokim asa ua; huai ah TOUPA kiang ah kithoihnate alan uhi.
english: They called the name of that place Bochim, and they sacrificed there to Yahweh.

paite: Joshua in mipite akikhenzaksak nung in Israel suante michih amau tantuam gam chiat luah ding in apaita uhi.
english: Now when Joshua had sent the people away, the children of Israel each went to his inheritance to possess the land.

paite: Joshua damsung leh upate Joshua kheng a dam teng, TOUPA'N Israelte a dia thil thupi ahih tengteng mu mite damsung in mipite'n TOUPA nna asem uhi.
english: The people served Yahweh all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great work of Yahweh that he had worked for Israel.

paite: Nun tapa Joshua, TOUPA sikha kum za-le-sawmkhat a upa ahih in asita hi.
english: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Yahweh, died, being one hundred ten years old.

paite: Gaash tang mallam pang Ephraim tanggam a amah tantuam gamgi sung Timnath Heres ah avui uhi.
english: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath Heres, in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.

paite: Huai khang a mi teng leng apipute uh kiang ah apaikhawmta uhi. Amaute nung in TOUPA leh Israelte a dia athilhihte thei lou suan dang ahong omta hi.
english: After all that generation were gathered to their fathers, another generation arose after them who didn’t know Yahweh, nor the work which he had done for Israel.

paite: Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih ua, Baal nna asem uhi.
english: The children of Israel did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and served the Baals.

paite: TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian, Aigupta gam a pan pikhepa alehngatsan ua, pathian dangte, akim ua tengte pathiante azui ua, abia ua, TOUPA ahehsakta uhi.
english: They abandoned Yahweh, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the peoples who were around them, and bowed themselves down to them; and they provoked Yahweh to anger.

paite: TOUPA alehngatsan ua, Baal leh Astoreth nna asem uhi.
english: They abandoned Yahweh, and served Baal and the Ashtaroth.

paite: Israelte tung ah TOUPA ahehta a, amau dou mite khut ah apia a, amelma uh, akim ua tengte kiang ah akhawng a, amelmate uh azouta kei uhi.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, so that they could no longer stand before their enemies.

paite: Koipeuh ah hoh mah le uh TOUPA khut atung uah aselam in ake zel a, TOUPA'N akiang ua kichiam a agensa bang in. Huchi in buai namai in abuaita kei uhi.
english: Wherever they went out, Yahweh’s hand was against them for evil, as Yahweh had spoken, and as Yahweh had sworn to them; and they were very distressed.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N vaihawmte abawlsak a, huaite'n amau dou mite khut a pan ahunkheta hi.
english: Yahweh raised up judges, who saved them out of the hand of those who plundered them.

paite: Huchipi in leng avaihawmte uh thu angaikhe kei ua, pathian dangte kiang a angkawm in amaute abe zawta ua, apipute un TOUPA thupiakte pom a azuih uh lampi pen apialsan pah maimah uhi.
english: Yet they didn’t listen to their judges; for they prostituted themselves to other gods, and bowed themselves down to them. They quickly turned away from the way in which their fathers walked, obeying Yahweh’s commandments. They didn’t do so.

paite: TOUPA'N vaihawmte abawlsak chiang in, vaihawmmi kiang ah TOUPA a-om a, vaihawmte damsung in amelmate uh khut a pan ahunkhe zel hi. Amau nuaisiah mite leh hihlungkham mite ziak a amauna un, TOUPA akisiksak hi.
english: When Yahweh raised up judges for them, then Yahweh was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge; for it grieved Yahweh because of their groaning by reason of those who oppressed them and troubled them.

paite: Himahleh hichi ahong hi a, vaihawmmi asih khit chiang in, anungtolh ua, pathian dangte zui a, a-nna uh asep uah apipute uh sang mah in agamta sezaw sem ua; athilhihte uh leh apaupenna uh leng atawpsan tuan kei uhi.
english: But when the judge was dead, they turned back, and dealt more corruptly than their fathers in following other gods to serve them and to bow down to them. They didn’t cease what they were doing, or give up their stubborn ways.

paite: Israelte tung ah TOUPA ahehta a, "Hiai namte'n apipute uh thu ka piak, ka thukhun abohsia ua, ka thu lah angaikhe kei ua;
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel; and he said, “Because this nation transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and has not listened to my voice,

paite: huaiziak in tuban Joshua sih ma a delhkhiak louh namte ka delhkhiaksak nawn kei ding.
english: I also will no longer drive out any of the nations that Joshua left when he died from before them;

paite: Apipute uh zuih bang a TOUPA dan zuih ding leh ding louh uh Israelte ze-etna ding in amau ka zang ding," achi hi.
english: that by them I may test Israel, to see if they will keep Yahweh’s way to walk therein, as their fathers kept it, or not.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N huai namte delhkhe pah lou in a-omsakta a; Joshua khut ah leng apekhe kei hi.
english: So Yahweh left those nations, without driving them out hastily. He didn’t deliver them into Joshua’s hand.

paite: Huchi in Israel suan om khawmte tengteng akisata ua, pheikhai lual in Dan a pan Beer-sheba kho pha in Gilead gam a mite toh Mizpah ah TOUPA kiang ah akikhawm uhi.
english: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was assembled as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba, with the land of Gilead, to Yahweh at Mizpah.

paite: Mi tengteng heutu, Israel chite tengteng Pathian mite kikhopkhawmna ah atel ua, sepaih namsau tawimi nuaili ahi uhi.
english: The chiefs of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen who drew sword.

paite: Benjamin suante'n Israel suante Mizpah ah ahohtou uh chih aza ua, Israel suante'n, "Bangchidan a hichibang a gitlouhna hong om ahia, hon hilh un?" achi uhi.
english: (Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel had gone up to Mizpah.) The children of Israel said, “Tell us, how did this wickedness happen?”

paite: Levi chi, athah uh numei pasal in, "Benjamin chite omna Gibeah ah ka mei toh giak ding in ka va lut uhi.
english: The Levite, the husband of the woman who was murdered, answered, “I came into Gibeah that belongs to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to spend the night.

paite: Gibeah mite'n ahong sualta ua, zan in inn ahong um ua; hon thah atum ua, ka mei apawngsual ua asita hi.
english: The men of Gibeah rose against me, and surrounded the house by night. They intended to kill me and they raped my concubine, and she is dead.

paite: Huchi in ka mei luang ka sem a, Israelte gam luah tengteng ah ka khak a, Israel gam ah thilkihhuai leh haihuaitak ana hihta ngal ua.
english: I took my concubine and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel; for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel.

paite: Nou Israel suante aw, na vek un ngai un, na ngaihdan uleh pha na sakdan uh gen dih ua," achi hi.
english: Behold, you children of Israel, all of you, give here your advice and counsel.”

paite: Huchi in mi tengteng pheikhai lual in athou ua, “Kuamah i puanin lam ah i pai het kei ding, kuamah i inn ah i lut kei ding uh.
english: All the people arose as one man, saying, “None of us will go to his tent, neither will any of us turn to his house.

paite: Gibeahte i bawldan ding hichibang ahi. Ai i san ding ua, amaute i dou ding uh.
english: But now this is the thing which we will do to Gibeah: we will go up against it by lot;

paite: Gibeah mun a Benjaminte i va sualna ua mipite nek ding pe ding in Israel nam tengteng lak a mi zakhat ah sawmkhat zel, sangkhat ah zakhat zel, singkhat ah sangkhat zel i telkhe ding uh," achi uhi.
english: and we will take ten men of one hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and one hundred of one thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand to get food for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that the men of Gibeah have done in Israel.”

paite: Huchi in Israel mi tengteng pheikhai lual in huai khopi sual ding in akikhawm uhi.
english: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.

paite: Israel namte'n Benjamin nam tengteng kiang ah mi asawl ua, "Na lak ua na hih uh bang gitlouhna ahia?
english: The tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, “What wickedness is this that has happened among you?

paite: Gibeah a mi Belial tate hon pi unla, Israel gam a gitlouhna adaihtheihna ding in ka na that ding uh," chi in mi asawl uhi. Himahleh Benjamin chite'n a-unau Israel suante thugen azui nuam kei uh.
english: Now therefore deliver up the men, the wicked fellows who are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death and put away evil from Israel.” But Benjamin would not listen to the voice of their brothers, the children of Israel.

paite: Benjamin suante bel Israel suante dou ding in khopite a pan ahong pawtkhawm ua, Gibeah ah alutta uhi.
english: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities to Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.

paite: Huai ni a Benjamin suante khopi a pan namsau tawi a pawtte, Gibeah a mi zasagih telkhiakte sim louh in singnih-le-sangguk ahi uh.
english: The children of Benjamin were counted on that day out of the cities twenty-six thousand men who drew the sword, in addition to the inhabitants of Gibeah, who were counted seven hundred chosen men.

paite: Huai tengteng lak ah veilong zasagih, telkhiak a-om ua; amaute'n vaisuangseh in samzang chia leng akhial kei uhi.
english: Among all these soldiers there were seven hundred chosen men who were left-handed. Every one of them could sling a stone at a hair and not miss.

paite: Israel mite, Benjamin mite sim louh in namsau tawimi nuaili ahi uh. Amau tengteng galdou thei vek ahi uh.
english: The men of Israel, besides Benjamin, were counted four hundred thousand men who drew sword. All these were men of war.

paite: Israel suante athou ua, Bethel ah ahohtou ua, Pathian ava dong ua, Benjamin suante kua'n ahia va sual adto masa ding? achi uh.
english: The children of Israel arose, went up to Bethel, and asked counsel of God. They asked, “Who shall go up for us first to battle against the children of Benjamin?” Yahweh said, “Judah first.”

paite: TOUPA'N, "Judah nam va hoh masa uhen," achi hi. Huchi in Israel suante lak ah athou ua, Gibeah khua ava umta uhi.
english: The children of Israel rose up in the morning and encamped against Gibeah.

paite: Israel mite Benjamin pawl sual ding in akisa ua, Israel mite'n Gibeah ah amaute sual ding in panmun akhoh uhi.
english: The men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel set the battle in array against them at Gibeah.

paite: Benjamin suante Gibeah a pan apawtkhia ua, huai ni in Israel suante lak a mi singnih-le-sangnih ava that uhi.
english: The children of Benjamin came out of Gibeah, and on that day destroyed twenty-two thousand of the Israelite men down to the ground.

paite: Mipite, Israel mite akihasuan nawn ua, asual tung ni ua asualna mun mah uah sual ding in panmun akhoh nawn uhi.
english: The people, the men of Israel, encouraged themselves, and set the battle again in array in the place where they set themselves in array the first day.

paite: Israel suante ahohtou ua, Pathian ma ah nitak tan in ava kap ua, "Ka unau uh Benjamin suante ka va sual nawn ding uam?" chi in TOUPA adong uhi. TOUPA'N, "Va sual nawn un," achi hi.
english: The children of Israel went up and wept before Yahweh until evening; and they asked of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I again draw near to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother?” Yahweh said, “Go up against him.”

paite: Ani nih ni in Israel suante'n Benjamin suante ava naih uhi.
english: The children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.

paite: Benjamin suante leng huai ani nih ni in sual ding in Gibeah a pan apawt sam ua, Israel suante lak a mi singkhat-le-sanggiat ahong that nawn uh. Huaite tengteng namsau tawimi ngen ahi uh.
english: Benjamin went out against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men. All these drew the sword.

paite: Huchi in Israel suan tengteng leh mi tengteng ava paitou ua, Bethel ah ahohtou ua, akap ua, TOUPA ma ah atu uhi. Huai ni in nitak tan in an angawl uh. TOUPA kiang ah halmang thillat leh lemna thillatte alan uhi.
english: Then all the children of Israel and all the people went up, and came to Bethel, and wept, and sat there before Yahweh, and fasted that day until evening; then they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before Yahweh.

paite: Israel suante'n TOUPA adong uh (huai hun lai in huai ah Pathian thukhun bawm a-om hi).
english: The children of Israel asked Yahweh (for the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days,

paite: Huai lai in Aaron tapa Eleazar tapa Phinehas in a-nna asem zel ahi. "Ka unau uh Benjamin suante ka va sual nawn ding uam, ka tawpsanta mai ding uam?" chi in TOUPA adong uhi. TOUPA'N, "Va hoh un; zingchiang in zaw na khut uah ka hon peta ding," achi hi.
english: and Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days), saying, “Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease?” Yahweh said, “Go up; for tomorrow I will deliver him into your hand.”

paite: Israel suante'n Gibeah kho kim ah tangpang mi agukkoih uhi.
english: Israel set ambushes all around Gibeah.

paite: Israel suante Benjamin suante sual ding in ani thum ni in akisa nawn uh. Nidang mah bang in Gibeah khua sual ding in panmun akhoh nawn uhi.
english: The children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and set themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.

paite: Benjamin suante bel huai mite sual ding in apawt ua, khua apawtsan uhi. Huchi in nidang mah bang in mite sual in athat pan nawnta ua, loubuk ngial ah Bethel kholam lamliante ah Israel suante sawmthum athat uhi.
english: The children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city; and they began to strike and kill of the people as at other times, in the highways, of which one goes up to Bethel and the other to Gibeah, in the field, about thirty men of Israel.

paite: Benjamin suante'n, "Ama mah bang in i ma uah azahlak nawnta uh e," achi uhi. Israel suante'n bel, "I tai ding uh, khopi a pan lamlian lam ah i tolhkhesak ding," achi uhi.
english: The children of Benjamin said, “They are struck down before us, as at the first.” But the children of Israel said, “Let’s flee, and draw them away from the city to the highways.”

paite: Huchi in Israel suan tengteng in apanmun uh apawtsan ua, Baal Tamar mun ah panmun akhoh uhi. Israel suan aguk a na tangpangte amun ua pan, Gibeah Phaizang a panmun tan in ahong pawtkhia uhi.
english: All the men of Israel rose up out of their place and set themselves in array at Baal Tamar. Then the ambushers of Israel broke out of their place, even out of Maareh Geba.

paite: Israel suante tengteng lak a telkhiak mi singkhat in ava sual ua, kidouna athupi mahmah hi. Himahleh amau thil hoih lou akiang naichik uah a-om chih athei kei uh.
english: Ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel came over against Gibeah, and the battle was severe; but they didn’t know that disaster was close to them.

paite: TOUPA'N Israelte ma ah Benjamin suante athat hi. Israel suante'n huai ni in Benjamin suante mi singnih sangnga-le-zakhat athat uhi. Huaite tengteng namsau tawimi ngen ahi uh.
english: Yahweh struck Benjamin before Israel; and the children of Israel destroyed of Benjamin that day twenty-five thousand one hundred men. All these drew the sword.

paite: Huchi in Benjamin suante'n avuallelta uh chih ahong kitheita uhi. Israel suante'n Gibeah khua sual dia aguk a tangpang mite akoih uh amuan ziak un Benjamin suante anungtolh san uhi.
english: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were struck, for the men of Israel yielded to Benjamin because they trusted the ambushers whom they had set against Gibeah.

paite: Aguk a tangpang mite'n Gibeah khua asual guih uhi. Huchi in aguk a tangpangte akiphalh ua, khua a mi tengteng namsau in asualta uhi.
english: The ambushers hurried, and rushed on Gibeah; then the ambushers spread out, and struck all the city with the edge of the sword.

paite: Israel suante leh aguk a tangpang mite'n akichiam uh bel khopi sung a mei khuttouhsak ding, chih ahi.
english: Now the appointed sign between the men of Israel and the ambushers was that they should make a great cloud of smoke rise up out of the city.

paite: Huai amuh chiang ua, Israel taikekte kilehhei a, dou ding achih uh ahi.
english: The men of Israel turned in the battle, and Benjamin began to strike and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons; for they said, “Surely they are struck down before us, as in the first battle.”

paite: Huchi in khopi sung a meikhu ahong kitun nguingui tak in, Benjamin suante akihei uleh, ngai in, khopi apum in van lam tan ah akhutou ngoingoi hi.
english: But when the cloud began to arise up out of the city in a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them; and behold, the whole city went up in smoke to the sky.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante ahong kilehhei ua, Benjamin suante'n lamdang asa mahmah uh. Atan uh ahoih kei ding chih lah atheita ngal ua.
english: The men of Israel turned, and the men of Benjamin were dismayed; for they saw that disaster had come on them.

paite: Huaiziak in Israel suante ma ah gamdai ah ataikekta uh. Himahleh adelhzui pek ua, khopi a pan hong pawtte'n huai ah ana that uhi.
english: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel to the way of the wilderness, but the battle followed hard after them; and those who came out of the cities destroyed them in the middle of it.

paite: Benjamin suante bel a-umsip ua, adelh ua, nisuahna lam Gibeah kiang a akhawlna uah aphata uhi.
english: They surrounded the Benjamites, chased them, and trod them down at their resting place, as far as near Gibeah toward the sunrise.

paite: Benjamin suante mi singkhat-le- sanggiat asi ua; avek un mihat hangsan chiat ahi uh.
english: Eighteen thousand men of Benjamin fell; all these were men of valor.

paite: Akihei ua, gamdai lam Rimmon suangpi ah atai uh. Mi sangnga lamliante ah atom ua; Gidom tan in adelhzui ua, mi sangnih athat uhi.
english: They turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon. They gleaned five thousand men of them in the highways, and followed hard after them to Gidom, and struck two thousand men of them.

paite: Huchi in huai ni a Benjamin suan site, namsau tawimi ngen singnih-le-sangnga ahi ua, avek un mihat hangsan ahi uhi.
english: So that all who fell that day of Benjamin were twenty-five thousand men who drew the sword. All these were men of valor.

paite: Mi zagukte gamdai lam Rimmon suangpi ah ataikek ua, huai Rimmon suangpi ah kha li sung a-om uhi.
english: But six hundred men turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, and stayed in the rock of Rimmon four months.

paite: Israel suante Benjamin suante tung ah akisa nawn ua, khopi sung a om peuhmah gante, amuhmuh uh namsau in asatlum zel ua, huai lou leng khua amuh peuhmah uh ahal zel uhi.
english: The men of Israel turned again on the children of Benjamin, and struck them with the edge of the sword—including the entire city, the livestock, and all that they found. Moreover they set all the cities which they found on fire.

paite: Huan Israel suante'n Mizpah khua ah, i lak ua mi kuamah in i tanute uh Benjamin suante zi ding in i pe kei ding uh, chi in akichiam uhi.
english: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpah, saying, “None of us will give his daughter to Benjamin as a wife.”

paite: Bethel ah mipite ahoh ua, Pathian ma ah nitak tan in atu ua, a-awte uh suah in akap vongvong uhi.
english: The people came to Bethel and sat there until evening before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept severely.

paite: Amau bel, "Aw TOUPA Israelte' Pathian, bangchidan ahia Israelte lak a hichibang thil ahong om?" achi uhi.
english: They said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, why has this happened in Israel, that there should be one tribe lacking in Israel today?”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, azing in zingkhang in athou ua, huai ah maitam abawl ua, halmang thillatte leh lemna thillatte alan uhi.
english: On the next day, the people rose early and built an altar there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.

paite: Israel suante'n, Israel nam tengteng lak a TOUPA kiang a paikhawm pawl lak a va tel tei lou kuate ahi ua? achi uh. Mizpah a TOUPA kiang ava hoh lou peuhmahte bel, thah ngeingei ding ahi, chi in ana kichiamta uhi.
english: The children of Israel said, “Who is there among all the tribes of Israel who didn’t come up in the assembly to Yahweh?” For they had made a great oath concerning him who didn’t come up to Yahweh to Mizpah, saying, “He shall surely be put to death.”

paite: Israel suante a-unaupa uh Benjamin suante tungthu ah akisik ua, "Tuni in Israel suante lak ah nam khat satkhiak ahita, achi uhi.
english: The children of Israel grieved for Benjamin their brother, and said, “There is one tribe cut off from Israel today.

paite: A-omsunte a ding in azi ding uh bangchi in i hihta ding ua? I tanute uh lah azi ding ua neisak lou ding in TOUPA min lou in i na kichiamta ngal ua,” achi uhi.
english: How shall we provide wives for those who remain, since we have sworn by Yahweh that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?”

paite: Amau achi ua, Mizpah a TOUPA kiang a hong paitou lou Israel namte lak ah a-om hia? Ngai in, kikhawm pawl omna mun ah Jabesh-gilead mite lak ah khat lel leng ahong hoh kei uhi.
english: They said, “What one is there of the tribes of Israel who didn’t come up to Yahweh to Mizpah?” Behold, no one came from Jabesh Gilead to the camp to the assembly.

paite: Mite akisim uleh, ngai in, Jabesh-gilead gam a omte khat lel leng ana omta kei uhi.
english: For when the people were counted, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead there.

paite: Omkhawmte'n mihangsan hoih ngen singkhat-le-sangnih asawl uhi. "Kuan unla, Jabesh-gilead gam a omte numei leh atanu neute uh toh namsau in va satlum vek un.
english: The congregation sent twelve thousand of the most valiant men there, and commanded them, saying, “Go and strike the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the little ones.

paite: Na hihdan ding uh hichibang ahi. Mi tengteng leh numei, pasal kithuahpih khinsa peuhmah hihmangthang vek un,” chi in thu apia uhi.
english: This is the thing that you shall do: you shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman who has lain with a man.”

paite: Jabesh-gilead gam a omte lak ah nungak zali, pasal kithuahpih ngei het louh amu uhi. Huchi in a-omna uh Shiloh ah api ua, huai tuh Kanaan gam a om ahi.
english: They found among the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead four hundred young virgins who had not known man by lying with him; and they brought them to the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.

paite: Omkhawm tengteng in mi asawl ua, Rimmon suangpi a om Benjamin suante ava houpih ua, kilemna bawl ding in asam uhi.
english: The whole congregation sent and spoke to the children of Benjamin who were in the rock of Rimmon, and proclaimed peace to them.

paite: Huaitak in Benjamin pawl ahong nawn ua; Jabesh-gilead gam a numei ahawite uh azi ding un apia uhi. Huchi in leng akiching kei lai uhi.
english: Benjamin returned at that time; and they gave them the women whom they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh Gilead. There still weren’t enough for them.

paite: Israel nam lak a TOUPA'N kihih- tuamna ana bawl ziak in mite, Benjamin suante tungthu ah akisik uhi.
english: The people grieved for Benjamin, because Yahweh had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.

paite: Huchi in omkhawmte upate'n, "Adamlaite zi ding bang i chih ding ua? Benjamin suante lak a numeite lah hihmang ahita ngal ua?" achi uhi.
english: Then the elders of the congregation said, “How shall we provide wives for those who remain, since the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?”

paite: "Amau Israel nam hihmanlouhna ding in Benjamin suan omsunte bangchi in suan i neisak ding ua?
english: They said, “There must be an inheritance for those who are escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe not be blotted out from Israel.

paite: I tanute uh lah azi un i neisak thei ngal kei ua," achi uhi. Israel suante'n, "Kuapeuh Benjamin suante zi dia neisak peuhmah hamsiat in om uhen," chi in akichiam uhi.
english: However, we may not give them wives of our daughters, for the children of Israel had sworn, saying, ‘Cursed is he who gives a wife to Benjamin.’”

paite: Amau, "Ngai un, Bethel mallam, Bethel a pan Shekem zotna lamlian suahlam pang a Lebonah simlam a om Shiloh ah kum sim in TOUPA a ding in ankuangluina a-om,” achi uhi.
english: They said, “Behold, there is a feast of Yahweh from year to year in Shiloh, which is on the north of Bethel, on the east side of the highway that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.”

paite: Amau Benjamin suante kiang ah, "Va hoh unla, grep mun ah va guktan un;
english: They commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, “Go and lie in wait in the vineyards,

paite: Na en unla, ngai un, Shiloh a nungakte lamna a lam dia ahong pawt uleh, grep mun a pan hong pawt unla, Shiloh nungakte na zi ding un man chiat unla, Benjaminte gam ah paipih un.
english: and see, and behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in the dances, then come out of the vineyards, and each man catch his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, apate uh hiam, asanggampate uh hiam kalh dia i kiang ua ahong uleh, akiang uah, hon hehpih un. Kidouna sung in lah zi ka guan thei kei uh. Nou lah na tanute uh na piak thoh un hilou a, kichiamna a moh tang lou ding na hi uh," ka chi ding uh, achi uhi.
english: It shall be, when their fathers or their brothers come to complain to us, that we will say to them, ‘Grant them graciously to us, because we didn’t take for each man his wife in battle, neither did you give them to them; otherwise you would now be guilty.’”

paite: Benjamin suante'n huchibang in ahih uhi. Lampawlte lak a mi amau zah chiat zi ding in aman ua, apaimangpihta uhi. Huchi in agam uah apai ua, khopite apuah nawn ua, huai ah atengta uhi.
english: The children of Benjamin did so, and took wives for themselves according to their number, of those who danced, whom they carried off. They went and returned to their inheritance, built the cities, and lived in them.

paite: Huaitak in huai a pan Israel suante bel amau chichi leh amau namnam in akihuituam nawn ua, huai nungsiah amau gam chiat ah apai nawn uhi.
english: The children of Israel departed from there at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they each went out from there to his own inheritance.

paite: Huai lai in Israelte lak ah kumpipa a-om kei a; michih in ama mitmuh a dik asak bang in ahih chiat uhi.
english: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.

paite: Kanaan gam a galdou kha nai het lou Israelte etchetna ding in TOUPA'N hiai namte anusia hi.
english: Now these are the nations which Yahweh left, to test Israel by them, even as many as had not known all the wars of Canaan;

paite: Atup bel Israel suante, tuma a galdoudan thei nai hetloute galdoudan sinsak ahihna ding lel ahi.
english: only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at least those who knew nothing of it before:

paite: Huaite bel: Philistiate kumpipa ngate, Kanaan mi tengte, Sidonte leh Lebanon tang a teng Hivte ahi ua, Baal-hermon tang a pan Hamath lutna pha in ahi uh.
english: the five lords of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived on Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal Hermon to the entrance of Hamath.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi zang a apipute uh thu ana piakte azuih ding uh leh zuih louh ding uh theihna ding in, huaite Israelte chetna ding ahi uh.
english: They were left to test Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to Yahweh’s commandments, which he commanded their fathers by Moses.

paite: Israel suante Kanaante, Hitte, Amorte, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste lak ah ateng uhi.
english: The children of Israel lived among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

paite: Atanute uh zi in anei ua, atanute uh atapate uh zi in apia ua, apathiante uh nna asem uhi.
english: They took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their own daughters to their sons and served their gods.

paite: Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih ua, TOUPA a Pathian uh amangngilh ua, Baal leh Astoreth nna asem uhi.
english: The children of Israel did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and forgot Yahweh their God, and served the Baals and the Asheroth.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA Israelte tung ah ahehta a, Mesopo Mesopotamia gam kumpipa Kushan-risathaim kiang ah azuakta hi. Huchi in Israel suante'n Kushan-risathaim nna kum giat asem uhi.
english: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia; and the children of Israel served Cushan Rishathaim eight years.

paite: Israel suante'n TOUPA asaptak un, TOUPA'N Israel suante hunkhepa abawlsak a, huai mi in amau ahunkheta hi. Huai mi bel Kaleb naupa Kenaz tapa Othniel ahi.
english: When the children of Israel cried to Yahweh, Yahweh raised up a savior to the children of Israel, who saved them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.

paite: TOUPA kha atung ah ahong tung a, Israel tung ah vai ahawm hi. Ama'n Mesopotamia gam kumpipa Kushan-risathaim ava dou a, TOUPA'N Kushan-risathaim a khut ah apia a, azouta hi.
english: Yahweh’s Spirit came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and Yahweh delivered Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand. His hand prevailed against Cushan Rishathaim.

paite: Huchi in kum sawmli gam galmuang in a-omta a, huchi in Kenaz tapa Othniel asita hi.
english: The land had rest forty years, then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.

paite: Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih nawn uh. TOUPA mitmuh a thil ahihkhelh ziak un TOUPA'N Israelte tung ah Moab kumpipa Eglon ahatsak hi.
english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and Yahweh strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight.

paite: Ama'n Ammon leh Amalek suante akaikhawm a; Israelte ava dou a, tum sing khopi aluahta hi.
english: He gathered the children of Ammon and Amalek to himself; and he went and struck Israel, and they possessed the city of palm trees.

paite: Huchi in Moab kumpipa Eglon thunuai ah Israelte kum sawm-le-giat a-om uhi.
english: The children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

paite: Himahleh Israel suante'n TOUPA asaptak un, TOUPA'N Gera tapa Ehud, Benjamin mi, miveilong, hunkhepa abawlsak hi. Israel suante'n Moab kumpipa piak ding kipahman Ehud atawisak uhi.
english: But when the children of Israel cried to Yahweh, Yahweh raised up a savior for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man. The children of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab.

paite: Ehud in namsau hiamtuah tongtan a sau in asek a; puan nuai ah ataklam pheipi ah ahenbelh hi.
english: Ehud made himself a sword which had two edges, a cubit in length; and he wore it under his clothing on his right thigh.

paite: Moab kumpipa Eglon kipahman ava pia a; Eglon bel mithautak ahi.
english: He offered the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. Now Eglon was a very fat man.

paite: Kipahman ava piak khit in, kipahman tawite apaisak nawn hi.
english: When Ehud had finished offering the tribute, he sent away the people who carried the tribute.

paite: Amah bel Gilgal kho kiang a suangsekna mun a pan anungkik nawn a, "I aw, kumpipa, hon hilh ding thuguk ka nei hi," achi hi. Ama'n, "Dai un," achi hi. Huchi in akiang a dingh teng in apawtkhiaksan vek uhi.
english: But he himself turned back from the stone idols that were by Gilgal, and said, “I have a secret message for you, O king.” The king said, “Keep silence!” All who stood by him left him.

paite: Ehud in akiang ava naih a; amah bel anipi dantan ah amah kia in ana tu hi. Ehud in, "Pathian in na kiang a gen ding thu ahon thukhak hi," achi hi. Atutphah a kipan amah hong dingh hi.
english: Ehud came to him; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room. Ehud said, “I have a message from God to you.” He arose out of his seat.

paite: Ehud in akhut veilam in apheipi taklam a namsau adokkhia a, agil ah adawt hi.
english: Ehud put out his left hand, and took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his body.

paite: Anamsau bul tan in atum a, athau in namsau ahubit a, agilpi a pan namsau adokkhe kei a, a-ek atolhkhia hi.
english: The handle also went in after the blade; and the fat closed on the blade, for he didn’t draw the sword out of his body; and it came out behind.

paite: Huchi in Ehud inlim ah apawt a, dantan kongkhakte akhakkhum a, akalh bikbek hi.
english: Then Ehud went out onto the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room on him, and locked them.

paite: Apawt khit nung in, asikhate ahong pai ua, ava ettak un ngai in, dantan kongkhakte ana kikalh hi. "Anipi dantan ah atuam om tadih a hi in teh," achi uhi.
english: After he had gone, his servants came and saw that the doors of the upper room were locked. They said, “Surely he is covering his feet in the upper room.”

paite: Zumhuai tan khop in angak nilouh ua, ngai in, dantan kongkhakte ahong himhim kei a; huchi in chabi ala ua, ahong ua; ngai in, akumpipa uh pialkhang ah sisa in ana puk hi.
english: They waited until they were ashamed; and behold, he didn’t open the doors of the upper room. Therefore they took the key and opened them, and behold, their lord had fallen down dead on the floor.

paite: Ehud lah huchi a angak nilouh sung un ana taimang khin a, huai suangsekna mun akheng a, Seirah ah atailut hi.
english: Ehud escaped while they waited, passed beyond the stone idols, and escaped to Seirah.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai mun atun in Ephraim tanggam ah pengkul amut a, Israel suante tanggam a pan akiang ah apaisuk ua, ama'n ama uh akaita hi.
english: When he had come, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel went down with him from the hill country, and he led them.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hon zui dih ua. TOUPA'N na melma uh Moabte hon pe khinta ahi,” achi hi. Huchi in azuisuk ua, Moab gam chin Jordan lui kannate ala ua; kuamah agalkah uh aphal kei hi.
english: He said to them, “Follow me; for Yahweh has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.” They followed him, and took the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites, and didn’t allow any man to pass over.

paite: Huai hun in Moabte mihat ngen taleh mihat hangsan hoih ngenta singkhat athat ua; khat lel leng taikhia a-om kei uh.
english: They struck at that time about ten thousand men of Moab, every strong man and every man of valor. No man escaped.

paite: Huchi in huai ni in Israelte lak ah Moabte azahlak uhi. Huchi in gam kum sawmgiat sung galmuang in a-om hi.
english: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. Then the land had rest eighty years.

paite: Anung in Anath tapa Shamgar ahong kilang a, huai mi'n bawng sutna chiang in Philistiate zaguk asunlum a; Israelte ahunkhia hi.
english: After him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who struck six hundred men of the Philistines with an ox goad. He also saved Israel.

paite: Ehud sih nung in Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih nawn uh.
english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, when Ehud was dead.

paite: Huchi in Hazor a vaihawmpa, huai Kanaan gam kumpipa Jabin kiang ah TOUPA'N akhawngta hi. Huai mi sepaih heutupen bel Sisera ahi a, Zentelte gam Haroseth ah ateng hi.
english: Yahweh sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth of the Gentiles.

paite: Israel suante'n TOUPA asam uh. Huai mi in kangtalai zakua tak anei a, kum sawmnih sung Israel suante nakpitak in anuaisiah hi.
english: The children of Israel cried to Yahweh, for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and he mightily oppressed the children of Israel for twenty years.

paite: Huai lai in Lapidoth zi, zawlnei Deborah in Israelte tung ah vai ahawm hi.
english: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, judged Israel at that time.

paite: Ephraim tanggam a Ramah leh Bethel kho kikal a tum sing nuai ah Deborah ateng hi. Israel suante akiang ah avai uh hawmsak ding in ahong hoh zel uhi.
english: She lived under Deborah’s palm tree between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.

paite: Kedesh Naphtali gam a pan Abinoam tapa Barak athukhak a, akiang ah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in, Tabor Tang kiang ah hohtou inla, Naphtali suante leh Zebulun suante mi singkhat pi in.
english: She sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh Naphtali, and said to him, “Hasn’t Yahweh, the God of Israel, commanded, ‘Go and lead the way to Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?

paite: Huchi in Kishon lui ah Jabin sepaih heutu Sisera, akangtalaite leh amipite toh ka hon sawl ding; amah nang ka hon pe ding, chi in thu ahon pia ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: I will draw to you, to the river Kishon, Sisera, the captain of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into your hand.’”

paite: Barak in akiang ah, "Hon tonpih lechin ka hoh ding. N'on tonpih kei dingleh ka hoh kei ding," achi hi.
english: Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, then I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go.”

paite: Ama'n, "K'on tonpih tham ding. Himahleh na hohna a minhoih loh lou ding na hi. TOUPA'N Sisera numei kiang ah akhawng ding hi," achi hi. Huchi in Deborah athou a, Barak toh Kedesh ah ahohta uhi.
english: She said, “I will surely go with you. Nevertheless, the journey that you take won’t be for your honor; for Yahweh will sell Sisera into a woman’s hand.” Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.

paite: Barak in Zebulunte leh Naphtalite Kedesh ah athukhakkhawm a; mi singkhat amah toh ahohtou ua; Deborah leng akiang uah ahohtou sam hi.
english: Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali together to Kedesh. Ten thousand men followed him; and Deborah went up with him.

paite: Ken mi Heber bel Mosi puzon Hobab suante lak a pan ana om tuam a, Kadesh kiang a Zaanaim gam a tosaw sing mun ah apuanin ava kai hi.
english: Now Heber the Kenite had separated himself from the Kenites, even from the children of Hobab, Moses’ brother-in-law, and had pitched his tent as far as the oak in Zaanannim, which is by Kedesh.

paite: Abinoam tapa Barak bel Tabor tang ah ahohtou chih Sisera ahilh uhi.
english: They told Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor.

paite: Huchi in Sisera in akangtalai tengteng, sik kangtalai zakua leh aheute Zentelte gam Haroseth a pan, Kishon lui ah akaikhawm hi.
english: Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people who were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles, to the river Kishon.

paite: Huchi in Deborah in Barak kiang ah, "Khai le, tuni TOUPA'N Sisera hon piak ni ahi. Na makaipa TOUPA ahi kei a hia?" achi hi. Huchi in Barak Tabor tang a pan apaisuk a, mi singkhat in azuisuk uhi.
english: Deborah said to Barak, “Go; for this is the day in which Yahweh has delivered Sisera into your hand. Hasn’t Yahweh gone out before you?” So Barak went down from Mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

paite: TOUPA'N Sisera leh akangtalai tengteng leh asepaih tengteng namsau in Barak ma ah ahihbuai gawpta a; akangtalai a pan Sisera akumkhia a, akhe in ataimang hi.
english: Yahweh confused Sisera, all his chariots, and all his army, with the edge of the sword before Barak. Sisera abandoned his chariot and fled away on his feet.

paite: Barak in bel kangtalaite leh sepaihte Zentel gam Haroseth pha in adelh hi. Huchi in Sisera sepaih tengteng namsau in athat vek a; khat lel leng ahinghawi kei uhi.
english: But Barak pursued the chariots and the army to Harosheth of the Gentiles; and all the army of Sisera fell by the edge of the sword. There was not a man left.

paite: Sisera bel Ken mi Heber zi Jael puanin ah khe in atailut hi. Hozor Kumpipa Jabin leh Ken mi Heber inkuante kikal ah lemna a-om hi.
english: However Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite; for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.

paite: Jael bel Sisera dawn ding in ahong pawt a, akiang ah, "Pu, hong lut in, ka kiang ah hong lut in; lau ke'n," achi hi. Huchi in puanin sung ah akiang ah alutta a, ama'n puan in akhuh hi.
english: Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said to him, “Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; don’t be afraid.” He came in to her into the tent, and she covered him with a rug.

paite: Akiang ah, "Hehpih in tui tawmchik hon pe dih ve, ka dang atak mahmah hi," achi hi. Ama'n bawngnawi thawl ahong a, adawnsak a, akhuhkhum nawn hi.
english: He said to her, “Please give me a little water to drink; for I am thirsty.” She opened a container of milk, and gave him a drink, and covered him.

paite: Akiang ah, "Puanin kongpi ah ding inla, huchi in 'Hiai ah mi a-om hia?' chi a hon dot uleh, 'om lou' na chi zel in," achi hi.
english: He said to her, “Stand in the door of the tent, and if any man comes and inquires of you, and says, ‘Is there any man here?’ you shall say, ‘No.’”

paite: Heber zi Jael in puanin khetkilhna ala a, sek atawi a, awlchik in akhe asuanphei a, khetkilhna in ahaizek ah akhen paisuak a, lei toh akilhbelh hi. Bah in a-ihmut alim mahmah ngal a; huchi in asita hi.
