english: Then Jael, Heber’s wife, took a tent peg, and took a hammer in her hand, and went softly to him, and struck the pin into his temples, and it pierced through into the ground, for he was in a deep sleep; so he fainted and died.

paite: Ngai in, Barak in Sisera ahon delh a, amah tuak ding in Jael ava pawt a, akiang ah, "Hong pai in, na mi zon ka hon ensak ding," achi hi. Huchi in akiang ah ava hoh a; ngai in, Sisera ana sita mai a, ahaizek ah puanin khetkilhna ana tal hi.
english: Behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said to him, “Come, and I will show you the man whom you seek.” He came to her; and behold, Sisera lay dead, and the tent peg was in his temples.

paite: Huchi in Pathian in huai ni in Israel suante ma ah Kanaan gam kumpipa Jabin anuaisiah hi.
english: So God subdued Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel on that day.

paite: Kanaan kumpipa Jabin anuaisiah masiah uh, Kanaan kumpipa Jabin tung ah Israel suante ahat semsem uhi.
english: The hand of the children of Israel prevailed more and more against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.

paite: Huai ni in Deborah leh Abinoam tapa Barak in hiai la asa uhi:
english: Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying,

paite: "Israel a makaite'n ma akaih lai un, amau ut thu a mite'n azuih lai un, TOUPA phat un!
english: “Because the leaders took the lead in Israel, because the people offered themselves willingly, be blessed, Yahweh!

paite: Aw, nou kumpipate aw, ngaikhia un. Aw, nou heutute aw, bil na doh un. Kei mahmah in TOUPA pahtawi in la ka sa dia, TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian phat in la ka sa ding hi.
english: “Hear, you kings! Give ear, you princes! I, even I, will sing to Yahweh. I will sing praise to Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: TOUPA, Seir gam a pan na hong paikhiak a, Edom loubuk a na hong pawt in, lei aling a, van ahong kia a, meipi'n vuah azusak uhi.
english: “Yahweh, when you went out of Seir, when you marched out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, the sky also dropped. Yes, the clouds dropped water.

paite: TOUPA ma ah tangte achim ua, TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian ma ah Sinai Tang mah leng.
english: The mountains quaked at Yahweh’s presence, even Sinai at the presence of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: Anath tapa Samgar dam lai nite leh Jael dam lai nite in lamliante tot louh in a-om ua, zin-le-lengte lah lam neute ah apai uhi.
english: “In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied. The travelers walked through byways.

paite: Israel gamte atul khin a, akhuate luah louh in atul khin hi, kei Deborah ka gamtang a, Israel gam nu ka gamtat masiah.
english: The rulers ceased in Israel. They ceased until I, Deborah, arose; Until I arose a mother in Israel.

paite: Amau pathian thakte atel ua; huchi in kulh kongkhak bul ah kidouna a-om a; Israel gam a mi singli lak ah lum leh tei muh in a-om hia?
english: They chose new gods. Then war was in the gates. Was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?

paite: Ka lungsim Israelte vaihawmpa, mipite lak a lungluttak a kipiate lam ah a-om hi. TOUPA phat un.
english: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, who offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless Yahweh!

paite: Pau un, nou sabiltung kang tung a tuangte, nou vaihawmna a tute leh lampi a paite.
english: “Speak, you who ride on white donkeys, you who sit on rich carpets, and you who walk by the way.

paite: Thalkap mite husa zak phak louh, tui tawina mun ah TOUPA thil dik hihte agengen ua, Israel gam tung a thil dik ahihte ngei. Huchi in TOUPA mipite kulh kongkhakte lam ah apaisuk ding uhi.
english: Far from the noise of archers, in the places of drawing water, there they will rehearse Yahweh’s righteous acts, the righteous acts of his rule in Israel. “Then Yahweh’s people went down to the gates.

paite: Thou in, thou in, Deborah; thou in, thou in, la sa in. Thou in, Barak, thou inla, Abinoam tapa, na salmatte pi in.
english: ‘Awake, awake, Deborah! Awake, awake, utter a song! Arise, Barak, and lead away your captives, you son of Abinoam.’

paite: Huchi in mi omlaite mipite lak a miliante tung ah thu aneisak a, TOUPA'N mihat tung ah thu hon neisak hi.
english: “Then a remnant of the nobles and the people came down. Yahweh came down for me against the mighty.

paite: Ephraim a pan zungzam khat Amalek dou a-om a, Benjamin, na mite lak a mite'n nang hon zui uh, Makir a pan gam vaihawmte ahong paisuk ua, Zebulun a pan laigelhmi chiangkhun tawi mite ahong paisuk uhi.
english: Those whose root is in Amalek came out of Ephraim, after you, Benjamin, among your peoples. Governors come down out of Machir. Those who handle the marshal’s staff came out of Zebulun.

paite: Deborah kiang ah Issakar miliante a-om ua; Issakar leh Barak mah leng. Amah phaizang lam a sawlsuk ahi a, Reuben pawlte ahihleh nakpitak in akingaihtuah lai uhi.
english: The princes of Issachar were with Deborah. As was Issachar, so was Barak. They rushed into the valley at his feet. By the watercourses of Reuben, there were great resolves of heart.

paite: Bangziak a belam huang lak a tu nilouh, belamhon ham ngai ding lel in maw? Reuben pawlte a ding in lungtang a kingaihtuahna thupitak a-om hi.
english: Why did you sit among the sheepfolds? To hear the whistling for the flocks? At the watercourses of Reuben, there were great searchings of heart.

paite: Gileadte Jordan gal ah a-om nilouh ua; bangziak a Dante longte a om nilouh uh ahia? Asherte tuipi piau ah atu kinken ua, atuipiaute ah a-om nilouh uhi.
english: Gilead lived beyond the Jordan. Why did Dan remain in ships? Asher sat still at the haven of the sea, and lived by his creeks.

paite: Zebulun leh Naphtali leng mun sang pawn a sih ngap gigete ahi uh.
english: Zebulun was a people that jeopardized their lives to the death; Naphtali also, on the high places of the field.

paite: Kumpipate'n ahong dou ua, Kanaan kumpipate'n Meggiddo tui kiang, Taanak ah adou ua; sum himhim ala kei uhi.
english: “The kings came and fought, then the kings of Canaan fought at Taanach by the waters of Megiddo. They took no plunder of silver.

paite: Van a pan ahon dou ua; aksite'n amun ua kipan Sisera ahon dou uh.
english: From the sky the stars fought. From their courses, they fought against Sisera.

paite: Kishon lui in amaute ataimang a, nidanglai lui, Kishon lui in, Aw ka kha, hattak in pai zel in.
english: The river Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. My soul, march on with strength.

paite: Huchi in sakolte akipek thotthot ua, sakol hatte atawmtawm ziak un.
english: Then the horse hoofs stamped because of the prancing, the prancing of their strong ones.

paite: Meroz hamsiat un," TOUPA angel in achi, huai a tengte nakpitak in hamsiat un. TOUPA panpih ding, TOUPA'N mihattak adouna panpih dia ahong louh ziak un.
english: ‘Curse Meroz,’ said Yahweh’s angel. ‘Curse bitterly its inhabitants, because they didn’t come to help Yahweh, to help Yahweh against the mighty.’

paite: Numei lak ah Jael, Ken mi Heber zi nuamsapen ahi, numei puanin a tengte lak ah amah minuamsapen ahi.
english: “Jael shall be blessed above women, the wife of Heber the Kenite; blessed shall she be above women in the tent.

paite: Tui ahong ngen a, ama'n nawitui apia hi: miliante' nou in nawituidat ana pia hi.
english: He asked for water. She gave him milk. She brought him butter in a lordly dish.

paite: Kilhna atawi a, ataklam in nasemmi sek; sek in Sisera akhen a, alu ah akhen pailet a, ahi, ahaizek ah akhen a, akhental vengvong hi.
english: She put her hand to the tent peg, and her right hand to the workmen’s hammer. With the hammer she struck Sisera. She struck through his head. Yes, she pierced and struck through his temples.

paite: Akhebul ah akun a, apuk a, alum a; akhebul ah akun a, apukta a; apukna mun ah asita hi.
english: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay. At her feet he bowed, he fell. Where he bowed, there he fell down dead.

paite: Sisera nu bel tawlet ah adak a, vathangkalh awng ah asam a, "Bang achia kangtalai hong tunghak ahia? Bang achia akangtalai khe zekai ahia?" achi hi.
english: “Through the window she looked out, and cried: Sisera’s mother looked through the lattice. ‘Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why do the wheels of his chariots wait?’

paite: Anumei pilte'n ana dawng ua, ahi, amah dawng ding in ahong nawn ua:
english: Her wise ladies answered her, Yes, she returned answer to herself,

paite: Amuzouta kei ua hia? Gallak kihawmta lou uhia? Michih in nungak khat hiam nih chiat; Sisera tan ding gallak puan ze tuamtuam, gallak puan ze kilawm, ze tuamtuam, gallak ngawng a velh ding puan, alangnih a ze kilawm, ze tuamtuam, chi in.
english: ‘Have they not found, have they not divided the plunder? A lady, two ladies to every man; to Sisera a plunder of dyed garments, a plunder of dyed garments embroidered, of dyed garments embroidered on both sides, on the necks of the plunder?’

paite: "Huchibang in aw, TOUPA, na melmate tengteng mangthang vek uhen. Amah itte bel hattak a pai, nisa bang hi uhen,” achi uhi. Huchi in kum sawmli sung gam galmuang in a-om hi.
english: “So let all your enemies perish, Yahweh, but let those who love him be as the sun when it rises in its strength.” Then the land had rest forty years.

paite: Huan Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih uh. Huchi in TOUPA'N Midiante khut ah kum sagih sung apekhia hi.
english: The children of Israel did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, so Yahweh delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.

paite: Midiante'n Israelte azouta ua; huchi in Midiante ziak in tang ah kokhukte, kohawm leh kulhte abawl uhi.
english: The hand of Midian prevailed against Israel; and because of Midian the children of Israel made themselves the dens which are in the mountains, the caves, and the strongholds.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israelte'n haichi achin khit un Midiante, Amalekte leh suahlam mite ahong kuan ua; ava dou ua,
english: So it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the children of the east came up against them.

paite: panmun ava khoh ua, Gaza tan in lei a thilpoute ahihsiatsak ua, Israel gam ah nek ding himhim ahawi kei ua, belam, bawng leh sabiltung tan in ahihse vek uhi.
english: They encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, until you come to Gaza. They left no sustenance in Israel, and no sheep, ox, or donkey.

paite: Aganhonte uh leh apuaninte uh toh ahong kuan ua, khaupe bang in tampi ahong kuan ua; amaute leh asangawngsaute uh sim seng ahi kei, gam hihse dia hong kuan ahi uhi.
english: For they came up with their livestock and their tents. They came in as locusts for multitude. Both they and their camels were without number; and they came into the land to destroy it.

paite: Huchi in Midiante ziak in Israelte akeniam mahmahta ua; huchi in Israel suante'n TOUPA asamta uhi.
english: Israel was brought very low because of Midian; and the children of Israel cried to Yahweh.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Midiante ziak a Israel suante'n TOUPA asaptak un, TOUPA'N Israel suante kiang ah zawlnei khat asawl a; ama'n akiang uah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in, hichi in achi:
english: When the children of Israel cried to Yahweh because of Midian,

paite: 'Aigupta gam a pan ka hon pitou a, saltanna inn a pan ka hon pikhia hi.
english: Yahweh sent a prophet to the children of Israel; and he said to them, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you out of the house of bondage.

paite: Aiguptate khut a pan leh nou hon nuaisiah mi teng khut a pan ka hon hunkhia a, na ma uah amaute ka delhkhia a, agam uh nou ka hon pia hi.
english: I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians and out of the hand of all who oppressed you, and drove them out from before you, and gave you their land.

paite: Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, agam ua na tenna uh Amorte pathiante na lau ding uh ahi kei, ka chi hỉ'. Himahleh ka thugen na zui kei uh," achi hi.
english: I said to you, “I am Yahweh your God. You shall not fear the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell.” But you have not listened to my voice.’”

paite: Huan TOUPA angel ahong pai a, Ophrah a Abiezer mi Joash tosaw sing nuai ah atu hi. Atapa Gideon in Midiante muh louh ding in grep sukna khuk ah buh ana vua hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel came and sat under the oak which was in Ophrah, that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite. His son Gideon was beating out wheat in the wine press, to hide it from the Midianites.

paite: TOUPA angel akiang ah ahong kilak a, akiang ah, "Nang mihat hangsan, na kiang ah TOUPA a-om hi,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel appeared to him, and said to him, “Yahweh is with you, you mighty man of valor!”

paite: Gideon in akiang ah, "Aw ka toupa, ka kiang ua TOUPA om ahihleh bangchidan a hichibang a ka tung ua hiai thilte hong tung ahia? Ka pipute un, TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan hon pitou hilou hia? chi a, athilhih lamdang ahon hilhte uh koilam a bangchi khinta ahia? Tu'n zaw, TOUPA'N hon pampaih ahita a, Midiante khut a hon peta ei ve," achi hi.
english: Gideon said to him, “Oh, my lord, if Yahweh is with us, why then has all this happened to us? Where are all his wondrous works which our fathers told us of, saying, ‘Didn’t Yahweh bring us up from Egypt?’ But now Yahweh has cast us off, and delivered us into the hand of Midian.”

paite: TOUPA'N, amah a-en a, akiang ah, "Hiai na hatna in kuan in, Midiante a pan Israelte hunkhia in. K'on sawl ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: Yahweh looked at him, and said, “Go in this your might, and save Israel from the hand of Midian. Haven’t I sent you?”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, “Aw TOUPA, bangchi in ahia Israelte ka va hutkhiak mahmah ding? Ngai in, Manasseh suan lak a inkuan hatloupen ka hi ua, kei lah ka pa inkote lak a neupen ka hi ngal a," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “O Lord, how shall I save Israel? Behold, my family is the poorest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father’s house.”

paite: TOUPA'N, akiang ah, "Na kiang ah ka om ngeingei ding hi, huchi in Midiante mi khat lel bang in na zou vek ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to him, “Surely I will be with you, and you shall strike the Midianites as one man.”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tanleh, nang mahmah in na hon pi chih chiamtehna banghiam hon musak in.
english: He said to him, “If now I have found favor in your sight, then show me a sign that it is you who talk with me.

paite: Na ma a lat ding thilpiak ka va lak a, na kiang a ka hong nawn masiah hiai a pan hehpih in ana paimang ke'n," achi hi. Ama'n, "Na hong nawn masiah ka na om gige ding," achi hi.
english: Please don’t go away until I come to you, and bring out my present, and lay it before you.” He said, “I will wait until you come back.”

paite: Insung ah Gideon alut a, kelnou leh tangbuang ephah khat silngou soh louh abawl a; seng ah asa akoih a, huai gel tuibel ah akoih a, tosaw sing nuai ah akiang a hon tawi in ahong lan hi.
english: Gideon went in and prepared a young goat and unleavened cakes of an ephah of meal. He put the meat in a basket and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out to him under the oak, and presented it.

paite: Pathian angel in akiang ah, "Sa leh tanghou silngou soh louh la inla, hiai suang tung ah koih inla, atui pen sungkhia in,” achi hi. Huchibang in ama'n ahihta hi.
english: The angel of God said to him, “Take the meat and the unleavened cakes, and lay them on this rock, and pour out the broth.” He did so.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA angel in achiangkhun tawi muk in sa leh tanghou silngou soh louh akhoih a; suang a pan mei ahong pawt a, sa leh tanghou silngou soh louh akangtum vek hi. Huan amuhlouhna ah TOUPA angel in apaimangsanta hi.
english: Then Yahweh’s angel stretched out the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the meat and the unleavened cakes; and fire went up out of the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened cakes. Then Yahweh’s angel departed out of his sight.

paite: Huchi in Gideon in, TOUPA angel ahi chih atheita hi. Gideon in, "Maizen, Aw Toupa PATHIAN, TOUPA angel kimaituah a mu ka kei maw," achi hi. "
english: Gideon saw that he was Yahweh’s angel; and Gideon said, “Alas, Lord Yahweh! Because I have seen Yahweh’s angel face to face!”

paite: TOUPA'N akiang ah, Lungmuangtak in om inla, lau ke'n. Na si kei ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to him, “Peace be to you! Don’t be afraid. You shall not die.”

paite: Huchi in Gideon in huai ah TOUPA a ding in maitam adoh a, Jehovah Shalom asa hi. Tuni tan in Abiezerte gam Ophrah ah a-om lai hi.
english: Then Gideon built an altar there to Yahweh, and called it “Yahweh is Peace.” To this day it is still in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai zan mah in TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Na pa bawngtaltuai, bawngtal nihna kum sagih a upa la inla, na pa neih Baal maitam hihchim inla, abul a sing a bawl Asherah phuk in.
english: That same night, Yahweh said to him, “Take your father’s bull, even the second bull seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that your father has, and cut down the Asherah that is by it.

paite: Hiai suangpi tung ah zeneitak in TOUPA na Pathian a ding in maitam bawl inla, bawngtal nihna la inla, na phuk ding Asherah sing zang in halmang thillat lan in," achi hi.
english: Then build an altar to Yahweh your God on the top of this stronghold, in an orderly way, and take the second bull, and offer a burnt offering with the wood of the Asherah which you shall cut down.”

paite: Huchi in Gideon in asikhate lak a mi sawm api a, TOUPA'N akiang a agen bang in ahihta hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, apa inkote leh khopi a mite alauh ziak in, sun lai in ahih ngam kei a, zan lai in ahihta hi.
english: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as Yahweh had spoken to him. Because he feared his father’s household and the men of the city, he could not do it by day, but he did it by night.

paite: Khopi a mite zingkhang a athoh uleh, ngai in, Baal maitam hihchip in ana om a, abul a Ashera phukpaih in ana om a, maitam tung ah bawngtal nihna lat in ana om hi.
english: When the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was broken down, and the Asherah was cut down that was by it, and the second bull was offered on the altar that was built.

paite: "Hiai kua hih ahia?" chi in akihou ua, akidongtuah ua, azon khit un, "Joash tapa Gideon in hiai thil ahih ana hi,” achi uhi.
english: They said to one another, “Who has done this thing?” When they inquired and asked, they said, “Gideon the son of Joash has done this thing.”

paite: Huchi in khopi a mite'n Joash kiang ah, "Na tapa va pikhia in, asih ngeingei ding ahi. Baal maitam ahihchip ziak leh abul a Asherah aphuk ziak in,” achi uhi.
english: Then the men of the city said to Joash, “Bring out your son, that he may die, because he has broken down the altar of Baal, and because he has cut down the Asherah that was by it.”

paite: "Joash in amah hong kalh teng kiang ah, Baal gum ding na hi uh maw? Ama'n hon hondam ding hia? Kuapeuh amah gum zingsang mahmah a thah ding ahi. Pathian khat ahihleh amaitam ahihchip ziak in kigum leh akei dia," achi hi.
english: Joash said to all who stood against him, “Will you contend for Baal? Or will you save him? He who will contend for him, let him be put to death by morning! If he is a god, let him contend for himself, because someone has broken down his altar!”

paite: Huaiziak in huai ni in amah Jerubbaal asa uhi, amaitam hihchip ahih ziak in, "Baal in amah kalh heh," achi uhi.
english: Therefore on that day he named him Jerub-Baal, saying, “Let Baal contend against him, because he has broken down his altar.”

paite: Huchi in Midiante tengteng leh Amalekte leh suahlam mite akikhawm ua; lui akan ua, Jezreel Phaizang ah akikulh uhi.
english: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east assembled themselves together; and they passed over, and encamped in the valley of Jezreel.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA Kha Gideon tung ah ahong tung a; pengkul amut a; huchi in Abiezerte'n amah agum uhi.
english: But Yahweh’s Spirit came on Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered together to follow him.

paite: Manasseh tengteng kiang ah mi ataisak a; huaite'n leng anaihkhawm uhi. Asherte, Zebulunte leh Naphtali teng kiang ah leng mite ataisak a; amau leng abehlaptouta uhi.
english: He sent messengers throughout all Manasseh, and they also were gathered together to follow him. He sent messengers to Asher, to Zebulun, and to Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.

paite: Gideon in Pathian kiang ah, "Na gen bang a ka khut a Israelte na hutkhiak dingleh,
english: Gideon said to God, “If you will save Israel by my hand, as you have spoken,

paite: ngai in, buhphual ah belam mul ka koih dia, belam mul tung kia a daitui ana om a, leitual ana hul vekleh, na gen bang in ka khut in Israelte na hunkhe ding, chih ka thei ding," achi hi.
english: behold, I will put a fleece of wool on the threshing floor. If there is dew on the fleece only, and it is dry on all the ground, then I’ll know that you will save Israel by my hand, as you have spoken.”

paite: Huchibang ahong hi a, azing zingsangpi a thou a, belam mul asukleh belkuang dim tui atakkhia hi.
english: It was so; for he rose up early on the next day, and pressed the fleece together, and wrung the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.

paite: Gideon in Pathian kiang ah, "Ka tung ah heh ke'n, khatvei kia ka hon gen nawn ding. Hehpih in, khatvei kia belam mul in hon ze-etsak nawn in. Tutung in ahihleh belam mul kia hul henla, leitual ah daitui om nawn leuleu hen," achi hi.
english: Gideon said to God, “Don’t let your anger be kindled against me, and I will speak but this once. Please let me make a trial just this once with the fleece. Let it now be dry only on the fleece, and on all the ground let there be dew.”

paite: Huchibang in Pathian in huai zan in ahih a; belam mul kia ana hul a, leitual ah daitui ana om leuleu hi.
english: God did so that night; for it was dry on the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.

paite: Huchi in Jerubbaal, huai tuh Gideon ahi a, huan akiang a om mi tengteng zingkhang in athou ua, Harod tuikhuk chin ah akikulh uh. Midiante bel mallam pang Moreh mual bul phaizang ah akikulh uhi.
english: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people who were with him, rose up early and encamped beside the spring of Harod. Midian’s camp was on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.

paite: TOUPA'N Gideon kiang ah, "Na kiang a om mite, Midiante akhut ua ka piakna ding in atam lua uh. Huchi lou in zaw Israelte'n, 'Ei khut ngei a kihunkhia i hi uh,' chi in ahon otkhum kha ding uhi.
english: Yahweh said to Gideon, “The people who are with you are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hand, lest Israel brag against me, saying, ‘My own hand has saved me.’

paite: Huaiziak in ngai in, mite zak in, 'Kuapeuh lau leh ling a-omleh kik nawn henla,' Gilead tang a pan paikik nawn hen, chi in genkhia in," achi hi. Huchi in mite singnih-le-sangnih akik nawn ua; singkhat a-om lai uhi.
english: Now therefore proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, ‘Whoever is fearful and trembling, let him return and depart from Mount Gilead.’” So twenty-two thousand of the people returned, and ten thousand remained.

paite: TOUPA'N Gideon kiang ah, "Mite atam lo lai uh. Lui ah pisuk inla, huai ah ke'n ka hon khensak ding. Huan hichi ahi ding a, hiai mi zaw na kiang ah pai heh, ka chih peuhmah na kiang ah pai hen. Hiai mi zaw na kiang ah pai kei heh, ka chih peuhmah pai kei hen," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Gideon, “There are still too many people. Bring them down to the water, and I will test them for you there. It shall be, that those whom I tell you, ‘This shall go with you,’ shall go with you; and whoever I tell you, ‘This shall not go with you,’ shall not go.”

paite: Huchi in lui ah mite apisuk a, TOUPA'N Gideon kiang ah, "Ui bang a, alei a tui liahthoh peuhmah atuam in koih inla, huchi mah bang in kun a khukdin a tui hipthoh peuhmah leng," achi hi.
english: So he brought down the people to the water; and Yahweh said to Gideon, “Everyone who laps of the water with his tongue, like a dog laps, you shall set him by himself; likewise everyone who bows down on his knees to drink.”

paite: Akhutpek a liahthohte mi zathum ahi ua, midang tengteng kun a khukdin a tui hip vek ahi uh.
english: The number of those who lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, was three hundred men; but all the rest of the people bowed down on their knees to drink water.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Gideon kiang ah, "Mi zathum, aliah a liahthohte zang in ka hon hunkhe ding. Midiante na khut ah ka hon pe ding hi. Mipi teng amau mun chiat ah pai nawn uhen," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Gideon, “I will save you by the three hundred men who lapped, and deliver the Midianites into your hand. Let all the other people go, each to his own place.”

paite: Huchi in mite'n nek ding leh apengkulte uh atawi ua; Israel mi tengteng apuanin lam uah apaisak vek a, mi zathumte ahihleh a-omsak a, Midiante kulh bel anuai phaizang a om ahi.
english: So the people took food in their hand, and their trumpets; and he sent all the rest of the men of Israel to their own tents, but retained the three hundred men; and the camp of Midian was beneath him in the valley.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai zan in TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Thou inla, kulh ah va hohsuk dih ve; na khut ah ka hon peta.
english: That same night, Yahweh said to him, “Arise, go down into the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand.

paite: Himahleh hohsuk na lauhleh na sikha Purah toh kulh ah va hohsuk phot un.
english: But if you are afraid to go down, go with Purah your servant down to the camp.

paite: Huchi in athugen uh na za dia; huai khit chiang in na khut hihhat in a-om dia, kulh ah na hoh ngamta ding,” achi hi. Huchi in asikha Purah toh kulh a galvengte tuah masakna pen omna ah ahohsuk uhi.
english: You will hear what they say; and afterward your hands will be strengthened to go down into the camp.” Then went he down with Purah his servant to the outermost part of the armed men who were in the camp.

paite: Midiante, Amalekte leh suahlam tapate tengteng huai phaizang ah khaupehon bang in tampi ana om ua; asangawngsaute uh sim seng vual louh, atamlam uh lah tuipi piau a piaunel zah mahmah ahi uhi.
english: The Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like locusts for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand which is on the seashore for multitude.

paite: Gideon atunsuk in, ngai in, mi khat in alawmpa amang ana hilh a, akiang ah, "Ngai in, mang ka nei a, Midiante kulh ah barli buh tanghou phel ana om a, puanin ah ana tuklut a, ahon hihchim a, ahih lumlet a, puanin akiphah maimah," achi hi.
english: When Gideon had come, behold, there was a man telling a dream to his fellow. He said, “Behold, I dreamed a dream; and behold, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the camp of Midian, came to the tent, and struck it so that it fell, and turned it upside down, so that the tent lay flat.”

paite: Alawmpa'n adawng a, "Huai ahihleh Israel mi, Joash tapa Gideon namsau lou bangdang hi kei e. Pathian in Midiante leh sepaih tengteng akhut a pia ahita ve," achi hi.
english: His fellow answered, “This is nothing other than the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel. God has delivered Midian into his hand, with all the army.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Gideon in huai mang leh alehkhiakna akihilhchian uh azak in Pathian abeta hi. Huchi in Israelte kulh lam ah akik nawn a, "Thou dih uh; TOUPA'N Midian sepaihte na khut uah ahon peta hi," achi hi.
english: It was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream and its interpretation, that he worshiped. Then he returned into the camp of Israel and said, “Arise, for Yahweh has delivered the army of Midian into your hand!”

paite: Huchi in mi zathumte pawl thum in akhen a, avek un pengkul leh leibel vuak, asung a meisel koihsa ape chiat hi.
english: He divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put into the hands of all of them trumpets and empty pitchers, with torches within the pitchers.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hon en unla, ka hih bang in hih sam un. Ngai un, kulh tuah masakpen ka tun chiang a ka hih bang a na hih sam ding uh ahi.
english: He said to them, “Watch me, and do likewise. Behold, when I come to the outermost part of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so you shall do.

paite: Kei leh ka kiang a om tengteng in pengkul ka hon mut chiang un, kulh kimvel a om tengteng in pengkul na mut sam ding uhi, "TOUPA a ding leh Gideon a ding in' na chi chiat ding uh," achi hi.
english: When I blow the trumpet, I and all who are with me, then blow the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and shout, ‘For Yahweh and for Gideon!’”

paite: Huchi in Gideon leh akiang a om mi zakhatte zanven laizang, galven akikhen kuan laitak in kulh tuah masak atungsuk ua, pengkul amut ua, aleibel tawi uh atatkham uhi.
english: So Gideon and the hundred men who were with him came to the outermost part of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch, when they had but newly set the watch. Then they blew the trumpets and broke in pieces the pitchers that were in their hands.

paite: Pawl thumte'n pengkul amut ua, leibelte atatkham ua, akhut veilam un meisel atawi ua, ataklam un pengkul mut ding atawi uhi. "TOUPA leh Gideon namsau," chi in akikou uhi.
english: The three companies blew the trumpets, broke the pitchers, and held the torches in their left hands and the trumpets in their right hands with which to blow; and they shouted, “The sword of Yahweh and of Gideon!”

paite: Kulh kim ah michih amau panmun chiat ah adingh vek ua; huchi in sepaih tengteng atai ua; akikou ua, ataizak uhi.
english: They each stood in his place around the camp, and all the army ran; and they shouted, and put them to flight.

paite: Mi zathumte'n pengkulte amut ua, TOUPA'N sepaih tengteng amau leh amau namsau in akisualsak a, huchi in sepaihte Zererah a Beth-shittah, Tabbath kiang a Abel-meholah gamgi pha in ataizak uhi.
english: They blew the three hundred trumpets, and Yahweh set every man’s sword against his fellow and against all the army; and the army fled as far as Beth Shittah toward Zererah, as far as the border of Abel Meholah, by Tabbath.

paite: Israelte Naphtali, Asher leh Manasseh tengteng a pan kigawmkhawm in Midiante anung-delhta uhi.
english: The men of Israel were gathered together out of Naphtali, out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued Midian.

paite: Gideon in Ephraim tanggam tengteng ah, Midiante hong sual un, Beth-barah tan in luite na lakkhalh un, Jordan lui toh, chi in mite avialtaisak a, huchi in Ephraim tengteng akikhawm ua, Beth-barah tan in luite Jordan lui toh ana lakkhalh vek uhi.
english: Gideon sent messengers throughout all the hill country of Ephraim, saying, “Come down against Midian and take the waters before them as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan!” So all the men of Ephraim were gathered together and took the waters as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan.

paite: Midian kumpipa Oreb leh Zeeb aman ua; Oreb suangpi ah athat ua, Zeeb pen Zeeb grep sukna khuk ah athat uhi. Midiante adelhta ua, huchi in Oreb leh Zeeb lutang Jordan lui gal a Gideon kiang ah ahon tun uhi.
english: They took the two princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb at Oreb’s rock, and Zeeb they killed at Zeeb’s wine press, as they pursued Midian. Then they brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon beyond the Jordan.

paite: Huan Ephraimte'n akiang ah, a hon "Bangziak a hichibang bawl e, Midiante na douna ua na hon chial sam louh?" achi uhi. Huchi in nakpitak in amah atai uhi.
english: The men of Ephraim said to him, “Why have you treated us this way, that you didn’t call us when you went to fight with Midian?” They rebuked him sharply.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou toh genkak ding ke'n bang ka hihzou a eita? Abiezerte grep loh sang a Ephraimte grep loh hoihzaw hilou maw?
english: He said to them, “What have I now done in comparison with you? Isn’t the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?

paite: Pathian in Midiante kumpipa Oreb leh Zeeb na khut uah ahon peta hi. Huchi in nou toh genkak ding in ke'n bang ka hihzou a eita?" achi hi. Huchi in huai thu agentak in atung a ahehna uh adaita hi.
english: God has delivered into your hand the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb! What was I able to do in comparison with you?” Then their anger was abated toward him when he had said that.

paite: Gideon leh akiang a om mi zathumte'n Jordan lui aphasuk ua, akan ua, bah mah le uh adelh teitei uhi.
english: Gideon came to the Jordan and passed over, he and the three hundred men who were with him, faint, yet pursuing.

paite: Sukoth a mite kiang ah, "Hehpih in kei hon zuite sangpek pe dih ua; abah mahmahta uh. Midiante kumpipa Zebah leh Zalmunna delh ka hi,” achi hi.
english: He said to the men of Succoth, “Please give loaves of bread to the people who follow me; for they are faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.”

paite: Sukoth a miliante'n, “Zebah leh Zalmunna na khut a om khinta uhia, huchi a na sepaihte tanghou ka piak pah mai ding uh?" achi uh.
english: The princes of Succoth said, “Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your army?”

paite: Gideon in hiai ziak in, "TOUPA'N Zebah leh Zalmunna ka khut a ahon piak chiang in gamdai a ling leh louling neite in na sa uh ka kuikek ding," achi hi.
english: Gideon said, “Therefore when Yahweh has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.”

paite: Huai a pan Penuel ah ahohtou ua, akiang uah huchi mah bang in agen nawn hi. Penuel a mite'n Sukoth a mite dawn mah bang in adawng uhi.
english: He went up there to Penuel, and spoke to them in the same way; and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered.

paite: Penuel khomite kiang ah, "Vualzou a ka hong kik nawn chiang in, hiai kulh ka hihchim ding," achi hi.
english: He spoke also to the men of Penuel, saying, “When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.”

paite: Zebah leh Zalmunna bel Karkor ah a-om ua, asepaihte leh suahlam mite sepaih asibang teng, singkhat-le-sangnga toh; namsau dok mi nuaikhat-le-singnih lah asi khinta ngal ua.
english: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their armies with them, about fifteen thousand men, all who were left of all the army of the children of the east; for there fell one hundred twenty thousand men who drew sword.

paite: Gideon bel Nob leh Jogbeh suahlam a puanin a tengte lampi ah ahohtou a, sepaihte ava dou a; sepaihte galmuangtak in ana om ngal uhi.
english: Gideon went up by the way of those who lived in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and struck the army; for the army felt secure.

paite: Zebah leh Zalmunna ataikekta ua; amau adelh ua; huchi in Midiante kumpipa nih Zebah leh Zalmunna aman ua, sepaihte tengteng apatausakgawp uhi.
english: Zebah and Zalmunna fled and he pursued them. He took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and confused all the army.

paite: Joash tapa Gideon bel kidouna a pan nisuah ma in ahong kik nawnta hi.
english: Gideon the son of Joash returned from the battle from the ascent of Heres.

paite: Sukoth ah tangval khat aman ua, thu adong ua; huchi in Sukoth a miliante leh upate min agelhsak vek a, sawmsagih-le-sagih ahi uh.
english: He caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and inquired of him; and he described for him the princes of Succoth, and its elders, seventy-seven men.

paite: Sukoth a mite kiang ah ahohtou a, "Zebah leh Zalmunna en dih ve ua, hiaite akei ua, Zebah leh Zalmunna na khut ua omsa bang a, mibahte tanghou ka piak ding uh, chi a na hon enghou uh?" achi hi.
english: He came to the men of Succoth, and said, “See Zebah and Zalmunna, concerning whom you taunted me, saying, ‘Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in your hand, that we should give bread to your men who are weary?’”

paite: Huchi in huai khua upate aman a, gamdai ling leh louling neite in Sukoth mite athuhilh hi.
english: He took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.

paite: Penuel khokulh ahihchim a, khua a mite leng athat hi.
english: He broke down the tower of Penuel, and killed the men of the city.

paite: Huchi in Zebah leh Zalmunna kiang ah, "Tabor tang a na mithahte uh mi bangchibang ahi ua? achi hi. Amau, Nangmah bang ahi uh; Kumpipa tapate abang chiat uh,” achi uhi.
english: Then he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, “What kind of men were they whom you killed at Tabor?” They answered, “They were like you. They all resembled the children of a king.”

paite: Ama'n, "Ka unaute ahi uh, ka nu tapate mahmah ahi ve ua. TOUPA ahin bang in, amaute na hinghawi le uchin zaw, nou hon that lou mah ding hi veng in," achi hi.
english: He said, “They were my brothers, the sons of my mother. As Yahweh lives, if you had saved them alive, I would not kill you.”

paite: Atapa upapen Jether kiang ah, "Khai le, nang amaute that in," achi hi. Himahleh tangval in anamsau aphawi kei; tangval lel ahih lai ziak in alau hi.
english: He said to Jether his firstborn, “Get up and kill them!” But the youth didn’t draw his sword; for he was afraid, because he was yet a youth.

paite: Huchi in Zebah leh Zalmunna in, "Nangmah hong kisa in, hong satlum tanla. Piching leh piching kisual ding ahi," achi uhi. Huchi in Gideon athou a, Zebah leh Zalmunna that in, sangawngsaute ngawng zepnate ala hi.
english: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, “You rise and fall on us; for as the man is, so is his strength.” Gideon arose, and killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and took the crescents that were on their camels’ necks.

paite: Huchi in Israel mite'n Gideon kiang ah, "Nang ka tung uah vaihawm in, nang leh na tapa leh na tapa tapate tan in leng; nang Midiante a pan lah na hon hunkheta ngal a," achi uhi.
english: Then the men of Israel said to Gideon, “Rule over us, both you, your son, and your son’s son also; for you have saved us out of the hand of Midian.”

paite: Gideon in akiang uah, "Ke'n zaw na tung uah vai ka hawm kei ding. Ka tapa in leng na tung uah vai ahawm sam kei ding. TOUPA'N na tung uah vai ahawm zaw ding," achi hi.
english: Gideon said to them, “I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you. Yahweh shall rule over you.”

paite: Gideon in akiang uah, "Thil khat ahihleh hon nget ka ut, michih in na gallak bilbah uh hon pe chiat un," achi hi. (Ishmaelte ahih ziak un dangka-eng bilbah anei uhi).
english: Gideon said to them, “I do have a request: that you would each give me the earrings of his plunder.” (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)

paite: Amau, "Phaltak in ka hon pe ding uh," achi uhi. Huchi in puan aphah ua, michih in agallak bilbah uh apaikhe chiat uhi.
english: They answered, “We will willingly give them.” They spread a garment, and every man threw the earrings of his plunder into it.

paite: Huai dangka-eng bilbah angette gikdan dangka-eng shekel sangkhat-le-zasagih ahi; hakkolte, bilbahte, Midian kumpipate puan sandup sim louh in, asangawngsaute uh khainiang omte leng tel lou in.
english: The weight of the golden earrings that he requested was one thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold, in addition to the crescents, and the pendants, and the purple clothing that was on the kings of Midian, and in addition to the chains that were about their camels’ necks.

paite: Gideon in huaite in Ephod abawl a, a-omna Ophrah ah akoih hi. Israel tengteng in hiai thil ah ang a kawm uh. Huchi in Gideon leh a-inkote a ding in thang ahong hita hi.
english: Gideon made an ephod out of it, and put it in Ophrah, his city. Then all Israel played the prostitute with it there; and it became a snare to Gideon and to his house.

paite: Huchi in Midiante bel Israel suante nuaisiah in a-om ua; atangkhe zou nawn kei uhi. Huchi in Gideon damsung kum sawmli sung in gam galmuang in a-omta hi.
english: So Midian was subdued before the children of Israel, and they lifted up their heads no more. The land had rest forty years in the days of Gideon.

paite: Joash tapa Jerubbaal apai a, a-inn ah atengta hi.
english: Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and lived in his own house.

paite: Gideon in zi tampi aneih ziak in ama suan mahmah tapa sawmsagih anei hi.
english: Gideon had seventy sons conceived from his body, for he had many wives.

paite: Shekem a amei in tapa asuansak lai a, amin Abimelek asa hi.
english: His concubine who was in Shechem also bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech.

paite: Joash tapa Gideon kha leh khuk tuah a dam in asita a, Abiezer mi Ophrah a apa Joash han ah avui uhi.
english: Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the tomb of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Gideon asih phet in Israel suante akinunghei ua, Baalte toh ang a kawm ua, pathian in Baal-berith aneita uhi.
english: As soon as Gideon was dead, the children of Israel turned again and played the prostitute following the Baals, and made Baal Berith their god.

paite: Israel suante'n akim ua melmate tengteng lak a pan amau hunkhepa TOUPA a Pathian uh atheigige kei uhi.
english: The children of Israel didn’t remember Yahweh their God, who had delivered them out of the hand of all their enemies on every side;

paite: Jerubbaal, Gideon kichi mah, Israelte tung a theihtawp a hoih suahpa inkote leng ahehpih kei uhi.
english: neither did they show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, that is, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shown to Israel.

paite: Huan Jerubbaal tapa Abimelek Shekem ah anu sanggampate kiang ah ahoh a, anu' pa inkote tengteng ahoupih hi.
english: Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem to his mother’s brothers, and spoke with them and with all the family of the house of his mother’s father, saying,

paite: "Shekem a mi tengteng zak in thu gen unla, 'Jerubbaal tapa tengteng mi sawm-sagihte'n na tung ua vai ahawm uhia hoih na sak uh, mi khat in na tung ua vai ahawm?' Gen dih ua, kei leng na guh uh leh na sa uh hi sam ka hi, chih theigige un," chi in agen hi.
english: “Please speak in the ears of all the men of Shechem, ‘Is it better for you that all the sons of Jerubbaal, who are seventy persons, rule over you, or that one rule over you?’ Remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.”

paite: Anu sanggampate'n Shekem a mi tengteng zak in huai thu tengteng agen uh. Huchi in Abimelek zuih utna lungsim ahon puta ua, "Amah i unau ahi,” achi ngal ua.
english: His mother’s brothers spoke of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words. Their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, “He is our brother.”

paite: Baal-berith inn a pan dangka sawmsagih apia ua, huai zang in Abimelek in amah zui, mingongtat leh migina lou pipite aguai hi.
english: They gave him seventy pieces of silver out of the house of Baal Berith, with which Abimelech hired vain and reckless fellows who followed him.

paite: Ophrah a apa inn ah ava hoh a, Jerubbaal tapate, a-unau sawmsagihte suang khat tung ah athat hi. Jerubbaal tapa naupangpen Jotham bel ana kibuk ziak in athat kha kei hi.
english: He went to his father’s house at Ophrah, and killed his brothers the sons of Jerubbaal, being seventy persons, on one stone; but Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left, for he hid himself.

paite: Shekem a mi tengteng leh Beth-millo a mi tengteng akikaikhawm ua, Shekem a suangphuh bul tosaw kiang ah kumpipa in Abimelek abawlta uhi.
english: All the men of Shechem assembled themselves together with all the house of Millo, and went and made Abimelech king by the oak of the pillar that was in Shechem.

paite: Hiai Jotham ahilh uleh Gerizim tang ah ahohtou a, avum ah ava dingh a, aw ngaihtak in akikou a, akiang uah, "Nou Shekem a mite aw, ka thugen ngaikhe dih ua, huchi in Pathian mah in leng nou thu ahon ngaikhe sam ding hi:
english: When they told it to Jotham, he went and stood on the top of Mount Gerizim and lifted up his voice, cried out, and said to them, “Listen to me, you men of Shechem, that God may listen to you.

paite: Khatvei atung ua kumpipa ding thaunilh ding in singte akuankhia ua; olive sing kiang ah, 'Nang ka kumpipa hi in,' achi uhi.
english: The trees set out to anoint a king over themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us.’

paite: Himahleh olive sing in akiang uah, 'Pathian leh mihing pahtawina dia azat pen uh ka thau nusia in singte tung ah dopsang in ka om ding maw?' achi hi.
english: “But the olive tree said to them, ‘Should I stop producing my oil, with which they honor God and man by me, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’

paite: Singte'n theipi kung kiang ah, 'Kisa dih, nang ka kumpipa ding un hong om in,' ava chi uhi.
english: “The trees said to the fig tree, ‘Come and reign over us.’

paite: Himahleh theipi kung in akiang uah, 'Ka khumna leh ka gah hoihtak nusia in singte tung ah dopsang in ka om ding maw?' achi hi.
english: “But the fig tree said to them, ‘Should I leave my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’

paite: Singte'n grepgui kiang ah, 'Kisa dih, nang ka kumpipa ding un om in aw?' achi uh.
english: “The trees said to the vine, ‘Come and reign over us.’

paite: Grepgui in akiang uah, 'Pathian leh mihing kipaksak ka uain nusia in singte tung ah dopsang in ka om ding maw?' achi hi.
english: “The vine said to them, ‘Should I leave my new wine, which cheers God and man, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’

paite: Huchi in sing tengteng in lingvom kiang ah, ‘Kisa in, nang ka kumpipa ding un om in,' achi uhi.
english: “Then all the trees said to the bramble, ‘Come and reign over us.’

paite: Lingvom in singte kiang ah, 'Na kumpipa ding ua thau hon nilh taktak na hih uleh ka liim ah hong bu in hon muang un; huchi ahihkeileh ling a pan mei hong pawt henla Lebanon tang a sidar singte kang khin hen,' achi hi.
english: “The bramble said to the trees, ‘If in truth you anoint me king over you, then come and take refuge in my shade; and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.’

paite: "Huaiziak in tu in chihtaktak a Abimelek na kumpipa ua bawl na hih ua, Jerubbaal leh a-inkote hoihtak a bawl a akituahpih bang a, atung a na hih ua;
english: “Now therefore, if you have dealt truly and righteously, in that you have made Abimelech king, and if you have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done to him according to the deserving of his hands

paite: Ka pa'n gal ahon dousak a ana sihloh hialta a, Midiante khut a pan in noute ahon hunkheta hi.
english: (for my father fought for you, risked his life, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian;

paite: Tuni in ka pa inkote tung ah na hel ua, atapate sawmsagih tak suang khat tung ah na that ua, na unaupa uh ahih ziak in asikhanu tapa Abimelek, Shekem khomite kumpipa ding in lah na bawlta ngal ua.
english: and you have risen up against my father’s house today and have slain his sons, seventy persons, on one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his female servant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother);

paite: Tuni a Jerubbaal leh a-inkote tung a chihtaktak a gamta na hih uleh, Abimelek tung ah kipak unla, amah leng na tung uah kipak hen.
english: if you then have dealt truly and righteously with Jerubbaal and with his house today, then rejoice in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you;

paite: Himahleh huchibang ahihkeileh Abimelek a pan mei hong kuangkhia henla, Shekem a mite leh Beth-millo mite kangtum hen. Shekem a mite leh Beth-millo a pan meikuang hong pawt henla, Abimelek kangtum vek hen," achi hi.
english: but if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and devour the men of Shechem and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem and from the house of Millo and devour Abimelech.”

paite: Huchi in Jotham atai a, ataimang a, Beer ah atai a, a-unaupa Abimelek alauh ziak in huai ah atengta hi.
english: Jotham ran away and fled, and went to Beer and lived there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.

paite: Abimelek in Israelte tung ah kum thum vai ahawm hi.
english: Abimelech was prince over Israel three years.

paite: Pathian in Abimelek leh Shekem a mite kikal ah kha gilou asawl hi. Huchi in Shekem khomite Abimelek tung ah lepchiahtak in agamta uhi.
english: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech,

paite: Huai ahihleh Jerubbaal tapa sawmsagihte tung a mulkimhuaitak a, agamtat ziak a atung a phulakna ahong tuntheihna ding leh amaute thatpa a-unaupa uh Abimelek tung a leh a-unaute that ding a amah ana panpih Shekemte tung a, asisan uh a-omtheihna ding ahi.
english: that the violence done to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come, and that their blood might be laid on Abimelech their brother who killed them, and on the men of Shechem who strengthened his hands to kill his brothers.

paite: Shekem a mite'n mualvumte ah amah guktan mite akoih ua, huai mun a va pai peuhmah ana suam ua; huai thu Abimelek ahilh uhi.
english: The men of Shechem set an ambush for him on the tops of the mountains, and they robbed all who came along that way by them; and Abimelech was told about it.

paite: Ebed tapa Gaal, a-unaute toh ahong kuan ua, Shekem ah alut ua; Shekemte'n ana muangmoh kei uh.
english: Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brothers and went over to Shechem; and the men of Shechem put their trust in him.

paite: Lou lam ah ahoh ua, agrephuan ua grepte alou ua, achil ua, vualnop abawl ua, apathian inn uah alut ua, ne a dawn in Abimelek ahamsiat uhi.
english: They went out into the field, harvested their vineyards, trod the grapes, celebrated, and went into the house of their god and ate and drank, and cursed Abimelech.

paite: Ebed tapa Gaal in, "Eite'n a-nna uh i sepsak ding, Abimelek kua ahia? Shekem mah leng kua ahia? Jerubbaal tapa ahi kei maw? Zebul, asepaih makai hilou amaw? Shekem pa Hamor mite nna sem ding maw? Bangziak in ahita amah nna i sep ding uh?
english: Gaal the son of Ebed said, “Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? Isn’t he the son of Jerubbaal? Isn’t Zebul his officer? Serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem, but why should we serve him?

paite: Hiai mite ka khut nuai ah om le uh aw! Abimelek ka lakhe ding." Abimelek kiang ah, "Na sepaihte pungsak inla, hong paikhia in," achi hi.
english: I wish that this people were under my hand! Then I would remove Abimelech.” He said to Abimelech, “Increase your army and come out!”

paite: Huai kho vaihawmpa Zebul in Ebed tapa Gaal thugen azak in, aheh tohthoh in a-om hi.
english: When Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger burned.

paite: Huchi in gitlouhpil in, Abimelek kiang ah, "Ngai in, Ebed tapa Gaal leh a-unaute Shekem ah ahong uh. Ngai in, na tung a hel tum in na khua a mite ahanthawn uhi.
english: He sent messengers to Abimelech craftily, saying, “Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem; and behold, they incite the city against you.

paite: Huchi in na mite toh kisa unla, zan in loubuk ah na tang un.
english: Now therefore, go up by night, you and the people who are with you, and lie in wait in the field.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahi ding a, zingsang a ni asuah chiang in, beltak in thou inla, khua hong dou mai in. Ngai in, amah leh alawite'n nang hon dou dek chiang un, hoih na sak dandan in atung uah na hih mai ding hi," chi a hilh ding in mite ataisak hi.
english: It shall be that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, you shall rise early and rush on the city. Behold, when he and the people who are with him come out against you, then may you do to them as you shall find occasion.”

paite: Huchi in Abimelek leh ami tengteng zan in athou ua, pawl li a kikhen in Shekem khua ava umta uhi.
english: Abimelech rose up, and all the people who were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.

paite: Ebed tapa Gaal ava pawt a, khopi lutna kongpi ah ava dingh a, Abimelek leh amite aguktanna ua kipan ahong kuanta uhi.
english: Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city. Abimelech rose up, and the people who were with him, from the ambush.

paite: Gaal in mipite amuh in Zebul kiang ah, "Ngai in, mualvum a pan mipite ahong paisuk uh," achi hi. Zebul in akiang ah, "Mihing bang a mual lim mu hilel teh," achi hi.
english: When Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, “Behold, people are coming down from the tops of the mountains.” Zebul said to him, “You see the shadows of the mountains as if they were men.”

paite: Gaal in, "En tanla, gam laitak ah mipi ahong paisuk uh. Pawl khatte houh aisan siampa tosaw sing lampi ah ahong pai uh,” achi nawn hi.
english: Gaal spoke again and said, “Behold, people are coming down by the middle of the land, and one company comes by the way of the oak of Meonenim.”

paite: Huchi in Zebul in akiang ah, "Abimelek kua ahia, a-nna i sep ding pen uh? chi a na genna kam koi a omta ahia? Hiaite na mimuhsitte mah hilou uhia? Va pawtkhia inla, va dou in," achi hi.
english: Then Zebul said to him, “Now where is your mouth, that you said, ‘Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him?’ Isn’t this the people that you have despised? Please go out now and fight with them.”

paite: Huchi in Gaal in Shekemte makai in Abimelek ava douta hi.
english: Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.

paite: Abimelek in ana delh a, ataisia a, khopi tan in mi tampi liam in apuk uhi.
english: Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many fell wounded, even to the entrance of the gate.

paite: Abimelek bel Arumah ah ateng hi. Zebul in Gaal leh a-unaute Shekem a teng thei lou ding in adelhkhe vek hi.
english: Abimelech lived at Arumah; and Zebul drove out Gaal and his brothers, that they should not dwell in Shechem.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, azing in mipite loubuk ah apawtkhia uh chih Abimelek ahilh uhi.
english: On the next day, the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.

paite: Mipite api a, pawl thum in akhen a, loubuk ah aguktan ua; adak a, ngai in, mipite khopi a pan ahong pawtkhia ua, huchi in amau ana sual ua, athatta uhi.
english: He took the people and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field; and he looked, and behold, the people came out of the city. So, he rose up against them and struck them.

paite: Abimelek leh apawlte malam ah atai ua, khopi lutna kongpi ah adingh ua, pawl nihte'n loubuk a omte tengteng apumboh ua, athatta uhi.
english: Abimelech and the companies that were with him rushed forward and stood in the entrance of the gate of the city; and the two companies rushed on all who were in the field and struck them.

paite: Abimelek in khopi huai ni in nitum in asual a; huchi in khopi ala a, asung a mite athat a, khopi ahihse vek a; chitui in atheh hi.
english: Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city and killed the people in it. He beat down the city and sowed it with salt.

paite: Shekem kulh a omte tengteng in huai thu ana za ua, Berith pathian insung bitna mun ah atailut uhi.
english: When all the men of the tower of Shechem heard of it, they entered into the stronghold of the house of Elberith.

paite: Shekem kulh a mi tengteng a-omkhawm vek uh chih Abimelek ahilh uhi.
english: Abimelech was told that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.

paite: Abimelek leh akiang a om tengteng Zalmon tang ah ahohtou uhi. Abimelek in heipi atawi a, singhiang asatkhia a, apua a, akiang a om amite kiang ah, "Ka hihdan na mu uh, ka hih bang in nou leng hih mengmeng un," achi hi.
english: Abimelech went up to Mount Zalmon, he and all the people who were with him; and Abimelech took an ax in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it up, and laid it on his shoulder. Then he said to the people who were with him, “What you have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done!”

paite: Mi tengteng in singhiang asatkhe chiat ua, Abimelek hih bang in apua ua, inn kulhpi kim ah asekhawm ua, kulhpi sung a omte ahalkhum uhi. Huchi in Shekem Kulhpi sung a om tengteng asi vek ua, pasal leh numei teng sangkhat vel ahi uh.
english: All the people likewise each cut down his bough, followed Abimelech, and put them at the base of the stronghold, and set the stronghold on fire over them, so that all the people of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.

paite: Huchi in Thebez ah Abimelek ahoh a, Thebez khua a-um a, alata hi.
english: Then Abimelech went to Thebez and encamped against Thebez, and took it.

paite: Himahleh huai khopi sung ah kulhpi kiptak a-om a, huai ah pasal leh numei tengteng leh khopi sung a mi tengteng atailut ua, akikhakkhum bikbek ua, kulh tung ah a-omkhawm uhi.
english: But there was a strong tower within the city, and all the men and women of the city fled there, and shut themselves in, and went up to the roof of the tower.

paite: Abimelek bel kulh lam ah ahoh a, ava dou a, hal ding in kulh kongpi ah ahoh hi.
english: Abimelech came to the tower and fought against it, and came near to the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

paite: Numei kuahiam in Abimelek lutung khat gawizanna suang akhesuk a, aluguh akitam hi.
english: A certain woman cast an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head, and broke his skull.

paite: Huchi in agalvan tawipa tangval asam pah a, akiang ah, "Na namsau phawi inla, hon that mai in. Huchi a mite'n, 'Numei thah ahi,' ahon chihlouhna ding un," achi hi.
english: Then he called hastily to the young man, his armor bearer, and said to him, “Draw your sword and kill me, that men not say of me, ‘A woman killed him.’ His young man thrust him through, and he died.”

paite: Israelte'n Abimelek asi chih atheihtak un, a-inn lam chiat uah apaita uhi.
english: When the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they each departed to his place.

paite: Abimelek in a-unau sawmsagihte athah leh apa tung a giloutak a atatsiatna Pathian in hiai bang in athukta hi.
english: Thus God repaid the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did to his father in killing his seventy brothers;

paite: Shekem khomite gitlouhna tengteng Pathian in athuk samta hi. Jerubbaal tapa Jotham hamsiat amau tung ah ahong tungta hi.
english: and God repaid all the wickedness of the men of Shechem on their heads; and the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal came on them.

paite: Benjamin gam a Anathoth a siampute lak a mi Hilkiah tapa Jeremiah thute:
english: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.

paite: Judah Kumpipa, Ammon tapa Josiah hun lai, avaihawm akum sawm-le-thumna ah akiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: Yahweh’s word came to him in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

paite: Judah kumpipa, Josiah tapa Jehoiakim vaihawm lai in leng ahong tung a; Judah kumpipa Josiah tapa Zedekiah akum sawm-le-khatna tawp, Jerusalem sal a pi akha ngana tan in.
english: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a:
english: Now Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Gilsung a ka hon bawl ma in ka hon thei a, sul a kipan a na pawtkhiak ma in leng ka hon koihtuam a, namte kiang a zawlnei hi ding in ka hon sep khin," chi in.
english: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”

paite: Huan ke'n, "Eh, Toupa PATHIAN, ngai dih, thu ka gensiam kei, ka naupang ngal a," ka chi hi.
english: Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi: "Ka naupang, chi ke'n, ka hon sawlna peuhmah kiang ah na hoh ding a, ka hon thupiak peuhmah na gen ding ahi.
english: But Yahweh said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I command you.

paite: Amaute lau ke'nla, nang hon hunkhe ding in na kiang ah ka om hi," chi in.
english: Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N ahon sawk a, ka kam akhoih a, TOUPA'N ka kiang ah,
english: Then Yahweh stretched out his hand and touched my mouth. Then Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.

paite: "Ngai in, na kam ah ka thute ka koihta, en dih, namte leh kumpipa gamte tung ah, botkhe ding, phel ding, hihse ding, paikhe ding, bawlhoih ding leh dingkhesak ding in tuni in ka hon koih na hi," achi hi.
english: Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”

paite: Huai lou leng ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a, "Jeremiah, bang na mu?" achi hi. Ke'n, “Vaisuaklu singhiang ka mu," ka chi hi.
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Na mu kha mahmah ve; ka thu tangtun ding in ka kigalging gige ahi," achi hi.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “You have seen well; for I watch over my word to perform it.”

paite: Huan anihveina ding in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn a, "Bang na mu a?" chi in. Ke'n bel, "Bel sou bolhbolh, agong mallam nga ka mu," ka chi hi.
english: Yahweh’s word came to me the second time, saying, “What do you see?” I said, “I see a boiling cauldron; and it is tipping away from the north.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi: "Gam a tengte tung ah mallam a kipan thil hoih lou ahong tung ding.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “Out of the north, evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land.

paite: Ngai dih, mallam kumpipa gam nam tengteng ka sam ding; chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; ahong pai ding ua, Jerusalem kongpi lutna ah, akimvel kulhbaang tengteng chin ah leh Judah khopi teng ah alaltutphah uh atung chiat ding uh.
english: For behold, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north,” says Yahweh. “They will come, and they will each set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls all around, and against all the cities of Judah.

paite: Hon paisan in, pathian dangte kiang ah gimlim ahal ua, amau khutsuak mah abia ua; hiai athulimlouhna teng tungtang ua ka thugelte ka puang ding hi.
english: I will utter my judgments against them concerning all their wickedness, in that they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, and worshiped the works of their own hands.

paite: Huaiziak in puan teng inla, thou inla, ka hon thupiak teng akiang uah va gen in; ama uah lunglel ke'n, huchi lou in zaw ama uah ka hon lunglelsak kha ding hi.
english: “You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them, lest I dismay you before them.

paite: Ngai in, tuni in nang, agam pumpite, Judah kumpipate, aheutute, asiampute leh agam mipite dou in khopi kulh a um leh sik khuam leh dalsik khuam in ka hon bawl ahi.
english: For behold, I have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.

paite: Hon sual ding ua, himahleh ahon zou kei ding uh; hon hunkhe ding in na kiang ah ka om hi," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you”, says Yahweh, “to rescue you.”

paite: Aw, Israel inkote aw, na kiang ua TOUPA thugen ngaikhia un,
english: Hear the word which Yahweh speaks to you, house of Israel!

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Namte omdan ching kei unla, van a chiamtehnate ziak in leng lunglau sam kei un; huaite ah namte lunglau in a-om nak uhi.
english: Yahweh says, “Don’t learn the way of the nations, and don’t be dismayed at the signs of the sky; for the nations are dismayed at them.

paite: Mite dante bangmah lou ahi ngal a, Gamnuai ah sing aphuk ua, heipi a mikhutsiam khut in asep ahi.
english: For the customs of the peoples are vanity; for one cuts a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman with the ax.

paite: Dangkasik leh dangka-eng in azem ua, atatlouhna ding in sikkilhna leh sek in akilh uh.
english: They deck it with silver and with gold. They fasten it with nails and with hammers, so that it can’t move.

paite: Tangmai huan a vasa lauh ding milim bang ahi ua, apau thei kei uh. Amau apai theih louh ziak un, puak suan akiphamoh sek uh; amaute lau kei un, thil sia ahihthei kei ua, thil hoih leng ahihthei sam kei uh.
english: They are like a palm tree, of turned work, and don’t speak. They must be carried, because they can’t move. Don’t be afraid of them; for they can’t do evil, neither is it in them to do good.”

paite: Aw TOUPA, nang bang kuamah a-om kei ua, na thupi a, na min hatna in athanglian hi.
english: There is no one like you, Yahweh. You are great, and your name is great in might.

paite: Aw namte Kumpipa, kua'n ahia hon kihta lou ding? Huai lah na tuakzou him ngal a. Namte mipil tengteng lakte ah, alalgam lak uah leng, nang bang mahmah a-om kei uh.
english: Who shouldn’t fear you, King of the nations? For it belongs to you. Because among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their royal estate, there is no one like you.

paite: Amau khawksak nei lou mihai ahi ua, manna bei sing milimte sinsak ahi uhi.
english: But they are together brutish and foolish, instructed by idols! It is just wood.

paite: Tarshish a kipan dangkasik sek ahon la ua, Uphaz a kipan dangka-eng, mikhutsiam bawl, dangka-eng sekmi khutsuak, puansilh dumpuang leh sandup, mikhutsiam khutsuak vek ahi uhi.
english: There is silver beaten into plates, which is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the engraver and of the hands of the goldsmith. Their clothing is blue and purple. They are all the work of skillful men.

paite: TOUPA bel Pathian tak ahi, Pathian hing tangtawn Kumpipa ahi, aheh in lei aling a, namte'n ahehna anangzou kei uh.
english: But Yahweh is the true God. He is the living God, and an everlasting King. At his wrath, the earth trembles. The nations aren’t able to withstand his indignation.

paite: Akiang ua hichibang a na chih ding uh ahi: Pathian, lei leh van bawl hiloupi lei a kipan amangthang ding ua, van nuai a kipan amang vek ding uh.
english: “You shall say this to them: ‘The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth, and from under the heavens.’”

paite: Athilhihtheihna in lei abawl a, apilna in khovel atungding a, alemtheihna in van akaipalh hi.
english: God has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding has he stretched out the heavens.

paite: A-aw asuah chiang in, van ah tui aging honhon a, kawlmong a kipan meipi akahtousak a, vuah zukna ding in khua aphesak a, agoubawm a kipan huih anungsak hi.
english: When he utters his voice, the waters in the heavens roar, and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings for the rain, and brings the wind out of his treasuries.

paite: Michih amawl ua, theihna anei kei uh, dangka-eng sekmi in alimsek azumpih a, amilim sun lah zuau lel ahi a, amau ah hinna leng a-om kei hi.
english: Every man has become brutish and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his engraved image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

paite: Bangmah lou ahi ua, khemna nasep lel, agawt hun chiang un amang ding uh.
english: They are vanity, a work of delusion. In the time of their visitation they will perish.

paite: Jakob tantuan bel hichibang ahi kei, thil tengteng bul ahi ngal a; Israel agouluah nam ahi a, amin sepaihte' TOUPA ahi.
english: The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the maker of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance. Yahweh of Armies is his name.

paite: Aw nang, um a om lellel in, lei a kipan na puanthuah lakhawm in,
english: Gather up your wares out of the land, you who live under siege.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai un, tu in gam a tengte ka singkhe ding, aphawk tham un ka hihgenthei ding."
english: For Yahweh says, “Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this time, and will distress them, that they may feel it.”

paite: Ka natna ziak in ka tung agik hi, ka liamna ana a, himahleh, "Hiai hial haksatna ahi, ka thuak mai ding ahi," ka chi.
english: Woe is me because of my injury! My wound is serious; but I said, “Truly this is my grief, and I must bear it.”

paite: Ka puanin aseta, ka khau tengteng akitat vek a, ka kiang a kipan ka tate apawt ua, a-om nawn kei uh; ka puanin kaipalh ding a- omta kei uh, ka puanzak hon lepsak ding.
english: My tent has been destroyed, and all my cords are broken. My children have gone away from me, and they are no more. There is no one to spread my tent any more, to set up my curtains.

paite: Belamching mite amawl ua, TOUPA thudotdan athei kei uh; huaiziak in alamzang kei ua, abelamhonte uh adalhzak khinta.
english: For the shepherds have become brutish, and have not inquired of Yahweh. Therefore they have not prospered, and all their flocks have scattered.

paite: Ngai un, mallam a pan husa ahong tung, buaina thupi mahmah, Judah khopite hihgawp in, sehal tenna ding a suaksak ding in.
english: The voice of news, behold, it comes, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a dwelling place of jackals.

paite: Aw TOUPA, mihing omdan bel, amah thu lel ahi kei chih ka theita hi; mihing akalsuante ama kipi hilou hi.
english: Yahweh, I know that the way of man is not in himself. It is not in man who walks to direct his steps.

paite: Aw TOUPA, hon thunun inla, ahun lel in, heh lou in, huchi lou in zaw na hon hihmang kha ding hi.
english: Yahweh, correct me, but gently; not in your anger, lest you reduce me to nothing.

paite: Nang hon thei ngeiloute tung leh na min lou ngei lou namte tung ah na hehna bungkhia in; Jakob ane khin ua, ahi, ane khin ua, anemang ua, atenna gam ahihsia uhi.
english: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, and on the families that don’t call on your name; for they have devoured Jacob. Yes, they have devoured him, consumed him, and have laid waste his habitation.

paite: Jeremiah kiang a Jeremiah TOUPA thu hong tung:
english: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

paite: Hiai thukhunte ngaikhia unla, Judah mite leh Jerusalem a tengte kiang ah gen un.
english: “Hear the words of this covenant, and speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;

paite: Nang akiang uah, TOUPA Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: Hiai thukhun thute ngaikhe loumi hamsethuak in om hen.
english: and say to them, Yahweh, the God of Israel says: ‘Cursed is the man who doesn’t hear the words of this covenant,

paite: Huai bel na pipute uh, Aigupta gam, sik haltuina kipan a ka pikhiak ni a, ka paukam suak mang unla, thu ka hon piak tengteng hih un, chi a ka thupiak tak ahi; huchi in ka mite na hi ding ua, kei na Pathian uh ka hi ding;
english: which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace,’ saying, ‘Obey my voice and do them, according to all which I command you; so you shall be my people, and I will be your God;

paite: Na pipute uh kiang a khuaizu leh nawitui a luang gam kichiam a piak ka chiamtak ka tangtun theihna ding in tuni a a-om bang in, hichi in achi: Huan ke'n, “Amen, Aw TOUPA," chi in ka dawng hi.
english: that I may establish the oath which I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey,’ as it is today.” Then I answered, and said, “Amen, Yahweh.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Judah khopite ah leh Jerusalem kholakte ah hiai thu tengteng puang inla: Hiai thukhunte ngaikhia unla, zui un.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Hear the words of this covenant, and do them.

paite: Na pipute un Aigupta gam a kipan ka pikhiak ni a kipan tutan in ka paukam suak mang un, chi in ka theisak sek hi.
english: For I earnestly protested to your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even to this day, rising early and protesting, saying, “Obey my voice.”

paite: Himahleh amang kei ua, bil adoh kei ua, michih, amau lungtang gilou bang zel in a-om zaw uhi. Huaiziak in hiai thukhun thu, hih ding a thu ka piak, ahih louh tengteng uh atung uah ka hon tungsakta ahi,” achi a.
english: Yet they didn’t obey, nor turn their ear, but everyone walked in the stubbornness of their evil heart. Therefore I brought on them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do, but they didn’t do them.’”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Judah mite leh Jerusalem a tengte lak ah phialgukna a-om.
english: Yahweh said to me, “A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

paite: Apipute uh, ka thu ngaikhe nuamloute thulimlouhna lam ah akilehhei nawn ua; pathian dangte nna sem ding in akuan ua; Israel inkote leh Judah inkote'n apipute uh kiang a ka thukhun bawl pen ahihseta uh."
english: They have turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, who refused to hear my words. They have gone after other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai dih ua, atung uah thil hoih lou, apelh het louh ding uh ka hon tungsak ding; ahon sam ding ua, himahleh ka ngaikhe kei ding."
english: Therefore Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will bring evil on them which they will not be able to escape; and they will cry to me, but I will not listen to them.

paite: Huan Judah khopite leh Jerusalem a tengte'n pathian, akiang ua gimlim ahal seknate uh asam ding ua, himahleh abuai hun chiang un huaite'n amau ahumbit het kei ding hi.
english: Then the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry to the gods to which they offer incense, but they will not save them at all in the time of their trouble.

paite: Aw Judah, na pathiante na khopi zah ahi ngal ua; thil zumhuaitak, Baal kiang a gimlim halna ding maitam hial leng Jerusalem kongzing zah in na dingsakta hi.
english: For according to the number of your cities are your gods, Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem you have set up altars to the shameful thing, even altars to burn incense to Baal.’

paite: Huaiziak in hiaite thumsak ke'nla, amau a ding in ngetna hiam aw hiam suah sam ke'n; abuai hun chiang ua ahon sap uleh ka ngaikhe kei ding hi.
english: “Therefore don’t pray for this people. Don’t lift up cry or prayer for them; for I will not hear them in the time that they cry to me because of their trouble.

paite: Thilkihhuai hih kawm in, ka deih mahmah in ka inn ah tantuam bang ahia aneih? Thu kichiamte leh Setan in na siatna ding uh ahon pelsak thei ding ahia? Na suang thei ua hia?
english: What has my beloved to do in my house, since she has behaved lewdly with many, and the holy flesh has passed from you? When you do evil, then you rejoice.”

paite: TOUPA'N na min ding in olive sing hing, gah hoih kilawmpi, ahon chi a, lum honhon in atung ah mei atoh a, ahiangte leng akitan khinta.
english: Yahweh called your name, “A green olive tree, beautiful with goodly fruit.” With the noise of a great roar he has kindled fire on it, and its branches are broken.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, nang hon phutpa'n, Israel inkote leh Judah inkote khelhna, Baal kiang a gimlim lan a, hon hehsak thil uh, amau a dia asepkhiak tung ua thil hoih lou ding thu na tung ah apuangkheta hi.
english: For Yahweh of Armies, who planted you, has pronounced evil against you, because of the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done to themselves in provoking me to anger by offering incense to Baal.

paite: TOUPA'N hon theisak a, ka theita; huchi in nang mahmah in athilhihte uh na hon kawkmuhta.
english: Yahweh gave me knowledge of it, and I knew it. Then you showed me their doings.

paite: "Kei bel belamnou nunnemtak, goh ding a pi bang ka hi, sing pen agah toh, hihse ni e, mihing gam a kipan amah zaw i hihmang vengveng ding uh, amin mawngmawng theih ahihlouhna ding in, chi a ka tung a athil sawm uh ka na thei het kei.”
english: But I was like a gentle lamb that is led to the slaughter. I didn’t know that they had devised plans against me, saying, “Let’s destroy the tree with its fruit, and let’s cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.”

paite: Himahleh, aw sepaihte' TOUPA, diktak a vaihawmpa, sunggil lam leh lungtang entelpa, atung ua na phulak hon musak in, ka tungthu lah na kiang ah ka hon kemsak hi, chi in.
english: But, Yahweh of Armies, who judges righteously, who tests the heart and the mind, I will see your vengeance on them; for to you I have revealed my cause.

paite: Huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA'N Anathoth mi, na hinna zongpa, "Ka khut ua na sihlouhna ding in TOUPA min in thu gen ke'n," chi mite tungtang ah hichi in achi:
english: “Therefore Yahweh says concerning the men of Anathoth, who seek your life, saying, ‘You shall not prophesy in Yahweh’s name, that you not die by our hand’—

paite: "Ngai un, amau ka gawt ding a, tangvalte namsau in asi ding ua, atanute uh, atapate uh kial in asi ding uh;
english: therefore Yahweh of Armies says, ‘Behold, I will punish them. The young men will die by the sword. Their sons and their daughters will die by famine.

paite: khosuak kuamah a-om kei ding uh; Anathoth mite tung ah thil hoih lou ka tun dek ngal a; agawtna kum ding uh atun hun chiang in."
english: There will be no remnant to them, for I will bring evil on the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.’”

paite: Aw TOUPA, na kiang a ka phun in leng, nang zaw na dik nilouh a; himahleh ka vuina thu pen ka gen ding hi. Bangchi in ahia mithulimloute lam alamzan zel uh? Bangchi in ahia khemhat peuhmah nuamsa a a-om nak uh?
english: You are righteous, Yahweh, when I contend with you; yet I would like to plead a case with you. Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why are they all at ease who deal very treacherously?

paite: Amau na phut a, ahi, zung akaita ua, akhang ua, ahi, gah asuahta uhi; amuk un hon naih ua, asunggil un hon gamlat uhi.
english: You have planted them. Yes, they have taken root. They grow. Yes, they produce fruit. You are near in their mouth, and far from their heart.

paite: Aw TOUPA kei bel na hon thei a, na hon mu a, nang lam ah ka lungtang na entel sek a, amaute goh ding belam bang mai in kaikhia inla, agohna ni ding uh sep in.
english: But you, Yahweh, know me. You see me, and test my heart toward you. Pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.

paite: Gam in bang tan ahia asuun ding a, anteh louhingte avuai ding uh? Ateng mite thulim louh ziak in gamsate amang khin ua, vasate leng, "I hun nanung uh amu kei ding uh," achih ziak un.
