english: How long will the land mourn, and the herbs of the whole country wither? Because of the wickedness of those who dwell therein, the animals and birds are consumed; because they said, “He won’t see our latter end.”

paite: "Khe a pai mite toh na kitaiteh a, nang ahon bahsak khit uleh bangchi in sakolte na kitaitehpih thei dia? Muanna gam ah bittak in om lechin leng, Jordan gammang ah bangchi in na hih dia?
english: “If you have run with the footmen, and they have wearied you, then how can you contend with horses? Though in a land of peace you are secure, yet how will you do in the pride of the Jordan?

paite: Na unaute, na pa inkuante ngei in, amau nang ahon khemta ngal ua; amau nang hon delh in ngaihtak in ahon sam ua, thuhoihtak gen mah le uh taksang himhim ke'n."
english: For even your brothers, and the house of your father, even they have dealt treacherously with you! Even they have cried aloud after you! Don’t believe them, though they speak beautiful words to you.

paite: "Ka inn-le-lou paisan in ka gouluah ding ka paimangta; ka hinna in a-it mahmah nu, amelma kiang ah ka peta hi.
english: “I have forsaken my house. I have cast off my heritage. I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.

paite: Ka gouluah ding gamnuai humpinelkai bang ahong hita, ka siatna ding in a-aw asuah a, huaiziak in ka mudah ahi.
english: My heritage has become to me as a lion in the forest. She has uttered her voice against me. Therefore I have hated her.

paite: Ka gouluah ding kei a ding in sasial ne vasa gial ahi hia? Sasial ne vasate'n akimvel in asual ua hia? Gamsa teng va kaikhawm unla, nek bei ding in hon pi un.
english: Is my heritage to me as a speckled bird of prey? Are the birds of prey against her all around? Go, assemble all the animals of the field. Bring them to devour.

paite: "Belamchingmi tampi in ka grephuan ahihsia ua, ka tan asikden ua, ka tantuan nuam mahmah mai gamdai gam segawp asuaksakta uh.
english: Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard. They have trodden my portion under foot. They have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

paite: Gamsia in abawlta ua, asegawp a, ka kiang ah avui hi, agam pumpi asegawp a, himahleh kuamah in adonsak kei uh.
english: They have made it a desolation. It mourns to me, being desolate. The whole land is made desolate, because no one cares.

paite: Gamdai a tang giau tengteng ah, hihse mite ahong tungta ua, gam tawp khat lam a kipan leh khat lam pha in TOUPA namsau in lah anebeita a, muanna nei himhim a-omta kei uh.
english: Destroyers have come on all the bare heights in the wilderness; for the sword of Yahweh devours from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land. No flesh has peace.

paite: Buhchi atuh ua, ling ala ua, akihihgimgawp ua, punna lah a-om tuan kei, TOUPA heh mahmah ziak in gah na suahte uh na zumpih ding uh."
english: They have sown wheat, and have reaped thorns. They have exhausted themselves, and profit nothing. You will be ashamed of your fruits, because of Yahweh’s fierce anger.”

paite: Ka mi Israel kiang a gouluah ding a ka piak khoihsemi, ka inveng giloute tengteng tungtang ah TOUPA'N hichibang in achi: "Ngai un, agam ua kipan ka botkhe ding a, alak ua kipan Judah inkote ka phawikhe ding.
english: Yahweh says, “Concerning all my evil neighbors, who touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit: Behold, I will pluck them up from off their land, and will pluck up the house of Judah from among them.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, ka bohkhiak nung in amau ka hehpih nawn ding a, michih gouluah ding leh michih ama gam mah ah ka hon pi ding.
english: It will happen that after I have plucked them up, I will return and have compassion on them. I will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, Baal kiang a ka mite kichiam a asinsak mah bang un, ka min a, 'TOUPA ahin a ahin sung', chi a kichiam a akisin ua, ka mite omdan ngenteltak a asin uleh ka mite lak ah ka dingkhesak ding.
english: It will happen, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, ‘As Yahweh lives;’ even as they taught my people to swear by Baal, then they will be built up in the middle of my people.

paite: Himahleh angaihkhiak kei ualeh huai nam aboh in ka botkhe ding a, ka hihse ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: But if they will not hear, then I will pluck up that nation, plucking up and destroying it,” says Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi: "Puanmalngat kawnggak lei inla, kawtsak lou in gak in."
english: Yahweh said to me, “Go, and buy yourself a linen belt, and put it on your waist, and don’t put it in water.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA thu bangbang in kawnggak ka lei a, ka gakta hi.
english: So I bought a belt according to Yahweh’s word, and put it on my waist.

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn a,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me the second time, saying,

paite: "Na kawnggak lei, huai na kawng a om pen la in, thou inla, Euphrates Luipi zuan inla, huai a suangheng kal ah sel in," chi in.
english: “Take the belt that you have bought, which is on your waist, and arise, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a cleft of the rock.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N thu hon piak bang in ka kuan a, Euphrates Luipi chin ah ka selta hi.
english: So I went and hid it by the Euphrates, as Yahweh commanded me.

paite: Ni tampi nung in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Thou inla, Euphrates Luipi zuan inla, kawnggak ka hon selsak lakhia in," achi hi.
english: After many days, Yahweh said to me, “Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take the belt from there, which I commanded you to hide there.”

paite: Huchi in Euphrates Luipi ah ka hohta a, ka thai a, ka selna a kipan kawnggak ka pholhkhia hi. Huan ngai dih, kawnggak ana ngot khin vek a; bangmah ding in leng aphatuamta kei hi.
english: Then I went to the Euphrates, and dug, and took the belt from the place where I had hidden it; and behold, the belt was ruined. It was profitable for nothing.

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: hichi mah bang in Judah kisathei pipi leh Jerusalem ki-otsakna mahmahte ka hihse dek hi.
english: “Yahweh says, ‘In this way I will ruin the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.

paite: Hiai nam giloute, ka thute ngaikhe nuam lou a, amau lungsim genhak zui a pathian dangte' nna sem leh be ding a delh mite kawnggak bangmah ding a phatuam lou bang ahi ding uh.
english: This evil people, who refuse to hear my words, who walk in the stubbornness of their heart, and have gone after other gods to serve them and to worship them, will even be as this belt, which is profitable for nothing.

paite: Kawnggakmi kawng a abelh gige bang in Israel inkote pumpi leh Judah inko pumpi ka mite, ka minthanna, ka kilawmna leh ka thupina ahong hihtheihna ding ua ka kiang a belh gige ding a ka bawl ahi uhi; himahleh alimsak kei uh.
english: For as the belt clings to the waist of a man, so I have caused the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah to cling to me,’ says Yahweh; ‘that they may be to me for a people, for a name, for praise, and for glory; but they would not hear.’

paite: Hiai thu akiang ua na gen ding ahi: TOUPA Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi, "Thawl chiteng uain in adim ding," chi in. Huan amaute'n na kiang ah, "Thawl chiteng uain in adim ding chih ka theih louh uh ahi maw?" achi ding uh.
english: “Therefore you shall speak to them this word: ‘Yahweh, the God of Israel says, “Every container should be filled with wine.”’ They will tell you, ‘Do we not certainly know that every container should be filled with wine?’

paite: Huchi in akiang uah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai un, hiai gam a teng tengteng, David tutphah a tu kumpipate, siampute, zawlneite leh Jerusalem a teng tengtengte zukhamna in ka dimsak ding.
english: Then tell them, ‘Yahweh says, “Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.

paite: Amau ka kiphusak ding a, pate atate uh toh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; amau ka hihmanlouhna ding khop in ka hehpih in hiam ka hawi in hiam ka zahngai kei hial ding."
english: I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together,” says Yahweh: “I will not pity, spare, or have compassion, that I should not destroy them.”’”

paite: Ngaikhia unla, bildoh un; kisathei kei un, TOUPA'N thu akhahta hi.
english: Hear, and give ear. Don’t be proud, for Yahweh has spoken.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh pahtawi unla, mialna atunsak ma a khomui tung ate na khe uh akipal ma in, vak na lamet laitak un mial asuaksak a, mial bikbek ding in abawl ding hi.
english: Give glory to Yahweh your God, before he causes darkness, and before your feet stumble on the dark mountains, and while you look for light, he turns it into the shadow of death, and makes it deep darkness.

paite: Himahleh na ngaihkhiak kei uleh na kisaktheihna uh ziak in mundai ah ka kap nilouh ding a, ka khitui leng nakpitak in aluang gige ding; TOUPA belamhon sal a kaih ahih ziak un.
english: But if you will not hear it, my soul will weep in secret for your pride. My eye will weep bitterly, and run down with tears, because Yahweh’s flock has been taken captive.

paite: Kumpipa leh anu kiang ah, "Niam tut un, na lukhute uh aketa hi, na lallukhu thupi uh," chi in.
english: Say to the king and to the queen mother, “Humble yourselves. Sit down, for your crowns have come down, even the crown of your glory.

paite: Sim khopite abing khin a, kuamah hon vual louh in; Judah tengteng sal in atang ua, avek un atang khin uhi.
english: The cities of the South are shut up, and there is no one to open them. Judah is carried away captive: all of them. They are wholly carried away captive.

paite: Na mit uh daktou unla, mallam a kipan ahong kuan en un. Na belamhon neih koi ah, huai na belamhon deihhuaitak?
english: Lift up your eyes, and see those who come from the north. Where is the flock that was given to you, your beautiful flock?

paite: Nangmah in lawm ding a na bawlte na tung a akoih hun chiang un bangchi in na chi dia? Numei nauvei bang mai in na na sa ngial kei ding maw?
english: What will you say when he sets over you as head those whom you have yourself taught to be friends to you? Won’t sorrows take hold of you, as of a woman in travail?

paite: Bangziak in ahia hiaite ka tung a ahong tun? Chi sim na hihleh, na thulimlouhna ziak in ahi na nik lem ahih a na vuaktanna akimuh.
english: If you say in your heart, “Why have these things come on me?” Your skirts are uncovered because of the greatness of your iniquity, and your heels suffer violence.

paite: Ethiopia mivom in avun ahihlamdang in gialbem in azia asel thei a hia? Huchi ahihleh nou thil gilou hihhatsekte'n leng thil hoih hihthei na ve uteh!
english: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? Then may you also do good, who are accustomed to do evil.

paite: Gamdai huih in buhsi amutleng bang mai in amau ka dalhsak ding.
english: “Therefore I will scatter them as the stubble that passes away by the wind of the wilderness.

paite: Hiai na tantuan, na tuam dia ka hon sehsak ahi, na hon mangngilh a, zuau a na kingak ziak in, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: This is your lot, the portion measured to you from me,” says Yahweh, “because you have forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.”

paite: Huchi in kei mahmah in na mai khuh hial in na nik ka hon lemsak ding a, na zumhuaina adawk ding hi.
english: Therefore I will also uncover your skirts on your face, and your shame will appear.

paite: Gamlak a mualte a na angkawmnate, na huk kikou husate, na kiphalgaih thupidante, huai na thilhih kihhuaite ka muta. Aw Jerusalem, na tung agik hi; hihsiang na hih ma bang tan hi ding ahia?
english: I have seen your abominations, even your adulteries and your neighing, the lewdness of your prostitution, on the hills in the field. Woe to you, Jerusalem! You will not be made clean. How long will it yet be?”

paite: Khokheng tungtang a Jeremiah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung;
english: This is Yahweh’s word that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought:

paite: Judah in asuun a, akulh kongpite angui; lei ah puan vom khu in akun ua, Jerusalem kah ging atungkah.
english: “Judah mourns, and its gates languish. They sit in black on the ground. The cry of Jerusalem goes up.

paite: Amilalte'n asikhate uh tui atawisak ua, tuichin azuan ua, tui amu kei uh, tuibel hawm in akik ua; abeidong ua, gen ding athei kei ua, alu uh akhuh uhi.
english: Their nobles send their little ones to the waters. They come to the cisterns, and find no water. They return with their vessels empty. They are disappointed and confounded, and cover their heads.

paite: Gam pum a vuahtui a-om louh ziak in lei akhang a, lei let mite alungdong ua, alu uh akhuh uh.
english: Because of the ground which is cracked, because no rain has been in the land, the plowmen are disappointed. They cover their heads.

paite: Ahi, zukpi in leng loubuk ah nou anei a, louhing a-om louh ziak in ataisan hi.
english: Yes, the doe in the field also calves and forsakes her young, because there is no grass.

paite: Gam sabiltungte mualvum ah adingh ua, sehal bang in huihkhua ngai in anak huhu ua; nek ding loupa om louh ziak in amit uh amial dundun hi.
english: The wild donkeys stand on the bare heights. They pant for air like jackals. Their eyes fail, because there is no vegetation.

paite: Ka thulimlouhna un hon hek mahleh na min ziak in aw TOUPA hong kuan in; ka puknate uh lah atamta ngal a, na tung mahmah ah thil ka na hihkhial uhi.
english: Though our iniquities testify against us, work for your name’s sake, Yahweh; for our rebellions are many. We have sinned against you.

paite: Aw nang Israelte lamet, mangbat lai a hondampa, bangziak a hiai gam a mikhual bang zen a zan khat giak a zin bang lel a om na hia?
english: You hope of Israel, its Savior in the time of trouble, why should you be as a foreigner in the land, and as a wayfaring man who turns aside to stay for a night?

paite: Bangziak a mi lungkegawp bang phet leh pasalpha hondam thei lou bang lel a om na hia? Himahleh nang zaw, aw TOUPA, ka lak uah na om lai a, na min ka pu ua, hon paisan ke'n.
english: Why should you be like a scared man, as a mighty man who can’t save? Yet you, Yahweh, are in the middle of us, and we are called by your name. Don’t leave us.

paite: TOUPA'N hiai mite tungtang ah hichi in achi: Vakmang a-ut nak ua, akalsuan uh akidek kei uh; huchi in TOUPA'N amau apom kei a, athulimlouhna uh atheigigeta ding a, akhelhna uh agawt ding hi.
english: Yahweh says to this people: “Even so they have loved to wander. They have not restrained their feet. Therefore Yahweh does not accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity, and punish them for their sins.”

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Hiai mite hoihna ding ngetsak ke'n.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Don’t pray for this people for their good.

paite: An ngawl mah le uh akikou uh ka ngaikhe kei ding a, halmang leh buh-le-bal thillat lan mah le uh ka dawng kei ding; namsau, kial, hipi in amau ka hihmang zaw ding," achi hi.
english: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and meal offering, I will not accept them; but I will consume them by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence.”

paite: Ke'n, "Eh, Toupa PATHIAN, ngai dih, akiang uah zawlneite'n, 'Namsau na tuak kei ding ua, kial leng na thuak kei ding uh, hiai mun ah muan mahmahna ka hon pe zaw ding hi, achi sek ngal ua,' " ka chi hi.
english: Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Behold, the prophets tell them, ‘You will not see the sword, neither will you have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.’”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Zawlneite'n ka min a zuau gen zel ahi ve ua le; amau ka sawl kei a, thu ka khak kei a, ka houpih sam kei hi. Thil amuh kholhlouhte uh, aisan bangmah a pangloute leh alungsim dohate uh hon hilh ahi ve ua," achi hi.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “The prophets prophesy lies in my name. I didn’t send them. I didn’t command them. I didn’t speak to them. They prophesy to you a lying vision, divination, and a thing of nothing, and the deceit of their own heart.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ka sawl louh a ka min lou a, 'Hiai gam ah kial leh namsau atung kei ding,' chi a zawlnei thugen genmi, huai zawlneite namsau leh kial in amangthang ding uh.
english: Therefore Yahweh says concerning the prophets who prophesy in my name, but I didn’t send them, yet they say, ‘Sword and famine will not be in this land.’ Those prophets will be consumed by sword and famine.

paite: Huan athugenna uh nam leng kial leh namsau ziak in Jerusalem kongzing ah paihkhiak ahi ding ua, atanute uh atapate uh toh, vuimi himhim anei kei ding uh. Athulimlouhna uh amau tung ah ka sung dek ngal a."
english: The people to whom they prophesy will be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword. They will have no one to bury them—them, their wives, their sons, or their daughters, for I will pour their wickedness on them.

paite: Huan akiang ua hiai thu na gen ding ahi: "Sun leh zan in ka khitui luang hen, hul himhim kei hen, ka mi, ka tanu nungak siangthou in nakpi a liamna atuak hi, khutkhak na mahmah toh.
english: “You shall say this word to them: “‘Let my eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease; for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous wound.

paite: Gam a ka pawtleh, maizen, namsau a thahte! Khopi a ka lutleh, maizen, kialpi a misi! Gam chih ah zawlneite, siampute avakvai chiat ua, adan mahmah athei kei uh," chi in.
english: If I go out into the field, then behold, the slain with the sword! If I enter into the city, then behold, those who are sick with famine! For both the prophet and the priest go about in the land, and have no knowledge.’”

paite: Judah paikhe siang na hi hiam? Zion kih na hi maw? Kou a dia hihdamna om lou bikbek a bangziak a hon thuaksak na hia? Muanna ka zong ua, hoihna bangmah ahong tung kei; hihdamna hun ding leng, ngai dih buaina lel.
english: Have you utterly rejected Judah? Has your soul loathed Zion? Why have you struck us, and there is no healing for us? We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!

paite: Aw TOUPA, ka thulimlouhdan uh ka kitheihmohbawl kei uhi, ka pipute uh ginatlouhna toh, na tung ah ka hihkhialta uhi.
english: We acknowledge, Yahweh, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers; for we have sinned against you.

paite: Na min ziak in hon musit ke'n, na laltutphah thupi minsesak ke'nla, ka kiang ua na thukhun theigige in hihse ke'n.
english: Do not abhor us, for your name’s sake. Do not disgrace the throne of your glory. Remember, and don’t break your covenant with us.

paite: Namdangte pathiante lak ah vuah zusak thei a-om uhia? Ahihleh, van in vuahpi atungsak thei hia? Aw TOUPA ka Pathian uh, huai pen nang na hi kei maw? Hiai thil tengteng na hih ahi a, ka lamet uh nang na hi.
english: Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain? Or can the sky give showers? Aren’t you he, Yahweh our God? Therefore we will wait for you; for you have made all these things.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi: "Mosi leh Samuel ka ma ah hong dingh mah le uh, ka lungsim hiai mite lam anga tuan kei ding. Ka muh phak louh ah delhkhia inla, paimang uhen!
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind would not turn toward this people. Cast them out of my sight, and let them go out!

paite: Huan koi ah ka pai ding ua chi a nang a hon dot uleh hichi in akiang uah na chi ding hi. TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Sihna a si dingte, sihna ah; namsau thuak dingte, namsau ah; kial thuak dingte, kial ah; saltang dingte, saltanna ah.
english: It will happen when they ask you, ‘Where shall we go out?’ then you shall tell them, ‘Yahweh says: “Such as are for death, to death; such as are for the sword, to the sword; such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for captivity, to captivity.”’

paite: Thil li ka sehsak ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; that ding in namsau, keizan ding in ui, ne khin leh hihmang ding in tung leng vasate leh gam sahangte.
english: “I will appoint over them four kinds,” says Yahweh: “the sword to kill, the dogs to tear, the birds of the sky, and the animals of the earth, to devour and to destroy.

paite: Judah kumpipa Hezekiah tapa Manasseh in Jerusalem a athilhih ziak in lei kumpipa gam tengteng lak a vial sepsep ding in ka bawl ding.
english: I will cause them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh, the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.

paite: "Kua'n ahon hehpih dia aw Jerusalem? Kua'n hon lungkhampih dia? Na omdan dong ding in kua alampial dia oi?
english: For who will have pity on you, Jerusalem? Who will mourn you? Who will come to ask of your welfare?

paite: Nang na hon paikhia a, na nungtawn tawn a," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. "Huchi in kisik ka chimtak a, na tung ah ka khut ka lika, ka hon hihmang hi.
english: You have rejected me,” says Yahweh. “You have gone backward. Therefore I have stretched out my hand against you and destroyed you. I am weary of showing compassion.

paite: Gam pumpi a kulh kongpite ah kizapna in amau ka zap a, ta bei in ka bawl a, ka mite ka hihmang a; a-omdan uh akiheisan louh ziak un.
english: I have winnowed them with a fan in the gates of the land. I have bereaved them of children. I have destroyed my people. They didn’t return from their ways.

paite: Tuipi piaunel sang a tam in ameithaite uh ka pungsak ding a, suntang lai in tangvalte siatna ding in atung uah lokmi ka tungsak a, mangbatna leh thil mulkimhuai ka tungsak guih hi.
english: Their widows are increased more than the sand of the seas. I have brought on them against the mother of the young men a destroyer at noonday. I have caused anguish and terrors to fall on her suddenly.

paite: Sagih suangnu abahgawp a; akha akhahta; sun ahih lai in ani aketa, zahlak in alungbuai a; huan akhosuaksunte, amelmate uh khut ah namsau a thah ding in ka pe ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: She who has borne seven languishes. She has given up the spirit. Her sun has gone down while it was yet day. She has been disappointed and confounded. I will deliver their residue to the sword before their enemies,” says Yahweh.

paite: "Nu ei, gam pumpi a kituahlouhna mi leh kikalhna mi a na hon na suan ka tung gik hi na tel e! Ka leitawisak kei a, mite'n leng ahon leitawisak kei uh; himahleh avek un hamsia ahon loh uhi.
english: Woe is me, my mother, that you have borne me, a man of strife, and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have not lent, neither have men lent to me; yet every one of them curses me.

paite: TOUPA'N, chihtak ngial in thil hoih a ding in ka hon hihkip ding; chihtak ngial in siatna ni leh haksatna ni in melma na kiang ah khut ka dohsak ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said, “Most certainly I will strengthen you for good. Most certainly I will cause the enemy to make supplication to you in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.

paite: Sik in mallam sik leh ngen akitansak thei dia hia?
english: Can one break iron, even iron from the north, and bronze?

paite: "Gam pumpi a na khelhna tengteng ziak in na hauhsakna leh na goute, aman bei in gallak ding in ka pe ding.
english: I will give your substance and your treasures for a plunder without price, and that for all your sins, even in all your borders.

paite: Na theih ngei louh gam ah na melmate nna ka hon semsak ding. Ka heh ziak a na tung a mei ampha ding akuangkheta hi," achi hi.
english: I will make them to pass with your enemies into a land which you don’t know; for a fire is kindled in my anger, which will burn on you.”

paite: Nang na thei hi, aw TOUPA, hon theigige inla, hong veh in, hon simmohte tung ah phuba hon laksak in. Na dohzohna ke'n manthat loh kei leng; nang ziak a minsiat thuak ka hi chih thei in.
english: Yahweh, you know. Remember me, visit me, and avenge me of my persecutors. You are patient, so don’t take me away. Know that for your sake I have suffered reproach.

paite: Na thute hihlat ahia, ka ne a, na thute kei a ding in kipahna leh ka lungtang nopna ahi; aw TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian, na min lah ka puta ngal ua.
english: Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart, for I am called by your name, Yahweh, God of Armies.

paite: Nopbawl mite lak ah ka tel kei a, ka kipahpih sam kei; nang khut ziak in ka tu tuam a, lungkimlouhna in na hon dimsak hi.
english: I didn’t sit in the assembly of those who make merry and rejoice. I sat alone because of your hand, for you have filled me with indignation.

paite: Bangziak a ka natna dai thei lou a, ka liamna damthei lou ahia, hihdam ut lou bang mai a? Ka tung ah phaizang khemhat tui kang sekte bang na hi ding a hia?
english: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuses to be healed? Will you indeed be to me as a deceitful brook, like waters that fail?

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Na kiheileh angei ka hon bangsak ding, ka ma ah na dingh nawn ding. Thil gina lou a kipan thil manpha ngen na genkhiakleh keimah kam bang na hi ding. Amau nang lam hong nga uhenla, nang bel amau lam na nga ding ahi kei.
english: Therefore Yahweh says, “If you return, then I will bring you again, that you may stand before me; and if you take out the precious from the vile, you will be as my mouth. They will return to you, but you will not return to them.

paite: Hiai mite lak ah ngen kulhbaang in ka hon bawl ding a, ahon sual ding ua, himahleh ahon zou kei ding uh, nang hon hondam ding leh hunkhe ding in na kiang ah ka om ngal a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: I will make you to this people a fortified bronze wall. They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you to save you and to deliver you,” says Yahweh.

paite: Migiloute khut a kipan ka hon hunkhe ding a, mi lauhuaite khut a kipan ka hon pawtkhesak ding.
english: “I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem you out of the hand of the terrible.”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a:
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Zi na nei ding ahi kei a, hiai mun ah tanu tapate leng na nei ding ahi sam kei," chi in.
english: “You shall not take a wife, neither shall you have sons or daughters, in this place.”

paite: Tanu tapa hiai mun a piangte leh hiai gam a nu leh pa amaute suangte tungtang TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: For Yahweh says concerning the sons and concerning the daughters who are born in this place, and concerning their mothers who bore them, and concerning their fathers who became their father in this land:

paite: "Hipi in asi ding ua, kuamah vui louh leh kuamah suun louh in a-om ding uh; leitung ekvut bang lel ahi ding uh. Namsaute, kialte in amangthang ding ua, aluangte uh tungleng vasate leh gamsate an ahi ding hi.
english: “They will die grievous deaths. They will not be lamented, neither will they be buried. They will be as dung on the surface of the ground. They will be consumed by the sword and by famine. Their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Lusuunna inn ah lut ke'nla, suun ding in hoh ke'nla, amaute kah ke'n; hiai mite lak a kipan ka lungmuanna ka hawkta ngal a, zahngaihna leh lainatnate toh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: For Yahweh says, “Don’t enter into the house of mourning. Don’t go to lament. Don’t bemoan them, for I have taken away my peace from this people,” says Yahweh, “even loving kindness and tender mercies.

paite: Hiai gam ah milian leh mineu a si ding ua; vui ahi kei ding ua; kuama'n asuun kei ding ua, aki-at un akimetgiau loh kei ding uh.
english: Both great and small will die in this land. They will not be buried. Men won’t lament for them, cut themselves, or make themselves bald for them.

paite: Lusuun mite amisi ngaih uh lungmuan ding in kuamah in nek ding alui kei ding ua, anu uh hiam apa uh hiam ziak in leng nepna nou dawn ding kuamah in atun kei ding uhi.
english: Men won’t break bread for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead. Men won’t give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.

paite: Huan ne leh dawn ding in alak ua tu ding in ankuangluina inn ah na lut ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not go into the house of feasting to sit with them, to eat and to drink.”

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi ngal a: "Ngai dih ua, na mitmuh un, na damsung un mou awte, mouneipa awte, nopsakna husate, kipahna gingte hiai mun ah ka daisak ding."
english: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place, before your eyes and in your days, the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.

paite: Hiai thu tengteng hiai mite kiang a na hilh hun chiang in amau, "Bangziak in ahia TOUPA'N ka tung ua hichitak a thil hoih lou ahon genkhiak? Bang ahia ka thulimlouhna uh? TOUPA ka Pathian uh tung a ka thilhihkhelh bang ahia?" ahon chih uleh,
english: It will happen, when you tell this people all these words, and they ask you, ‘Why has Yahweh pronounced all this great evil against us?’ or ‘What is our iniquity?’ or ‘What is our sin that we have committed against Yahweh our God?’

paite: hichi in na chi ding hi: "Na pipute un ahon paisan ziak uh ahi, pathian dangte adelh ua, a-nna uh asem ua, abia ua, ahon paisan ua, ka dan azui kei ua;
english: then you shall tell them, ‘Because your fathers have forsaken me,’ says Yahweh, ‘and have walked after other gods, have served them, have worshiped them, have forsaken me, and have not kept my law.

paite: huan noute'n na pipute uh sang a lek lua in na hih ua, ngai un, michih in noumau lungtang gilou paupeng na zui ua, kei na hon ngaikhe kei uh.
english: You have done evil more than your fathers, for behold, you each walk after the stubbornness of his evil heart, so that you don’t listen to me.

paite: Huaiziak in ka gam a kipan noute leh na pipute un leng na theih ngei louh uh gam ah ka hon delhkhe ding, huai ah sun leh zan in pathian dangte nna na sem ding ua, deihsakna ka hon lak dek ngal kei a," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Therefore I will cast you out of this land into the land that you have not known, neither you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.’

paite: Huchi in ngai dih ua, nite ahong tung dek hi, TOUPA thupawt in achi, "Israel suante Aigupta gam a kipan a pikhepa ahin a ahin sung, chita lou in,
english: “Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that it will no more be said, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;’

paite: mallam gam leh adelhzakna gam tengteng a kipan a Israel suante pikhepa TOUPA ahin a ahin sung, achi zawta ding uh," apipute uh kiang a ka piak, amau gam mahmah ah lah ka pikik nawn ding hi.
english: but, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the countries where he had driven them.’ I will bring them again into their land that I gave to their fathers.

paite: "Ngai dih ua, ngamanmi tampi ka thukhak ding a, amau aman ding ua; huai khit in gamvakmi tampi ka thukhak ding a, tang chiteng leh mual chiteng a kipan amaute abengkhe ding ua, suangpi heng kal a kipan in leng.
english: “Behold, I will send for many fishermen,” says Yahweh, “and they will fish them up. Afterward I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them from every mountain, from every hill, and out of the clefts of the rocks.

paite: A-omdan tengteng uah lah ka mit atu nilouh ngal a; kei a kipan sel in a-om kei ua, athulimlouhna uh leng ka mit a kipan sel in a-om sam kei hi.
english: For my eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from my face. Their iniquity isn’t concealed from my eyes.

paite: Huchi in athilkihhuai luangte ua ka gam ahihnit ualeh akihhuaina ua ka goutan gam adimsak ziak un athulimlouhna uh leh akhelhna uh azahnih in ka thuk ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: First I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double, because they have polluted my land with the carcasses of their detestable things, and have filled my inheritance with their abominations.”

paite: Aw TOUPA, ka hatna leh ka kulhpi, mangbat ni a ka kihumbitna, kawlmong a kipan in namte ahong pai ding ua: "Ka pipute un zuau, thil gina lou, punna nei hilou kia lou ngal bangmah gouluah in anei kei uh.
english: Yahweh, my strength, my stronghold, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the nations will come to you from the ends of the earth, and will say, “Our fathers have inherited nothing but lies, vanity and things in which there is no profit.

paite: Mi'n pathiante akibawlsak thei ua hia? Huaite pathian ahi sam ua,” achi ding uh.
english: Should a man make to himself gods which yet are no gods?”

paite: "Huaiziak in ngai dih ua, tutung in amau ka theisak peuhmah ding; ka khut leh ka thilhihtheihna ka theisak ding, ka min TOUPA ahi chih athei ding uh."
english: “Therefore behold, I will cause them to know, this once I will cause them to know my hand and my might. Then they will know that my name is Yahweh.”

paite: Judah khelhna sik laigelhna leh suangmantam hiam mukzum a gelh ahi; alungtang pek ua khuak in a-om a, amaitam uahte leng;
english: “The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond. It is engraved on the tablet of their heart, and on the horns of your altars.

paite: sing hing bul leh mual pawngte ah atate un amaitamte uleh a Asherahte uh atheigige ngal ua.
english: Even their children remember their altars and their Asherah poles by the green trees on the high hills.

paite: Aw nang gam a ka tang, gam dung tawn a na khelhna ziak in na sum leh na gou tengteng, na mun sangte toh gallak ding in ka pe ding hi.
english: My mountain in the field, I will give your substance and all your treasures for a plunder, and your high places, because of sin, throughout all your borders.

paite: Huai na tantuam ka hon piak na tan ding a, na gam theih ngeih louh ah na melmate nna ka hon semsak ding, ka hehna mei, tangtawn a kang ding lah na mut kuangta ngal ua.
english: You, even of yourself, will discontinue from your heritage that I gave you. I will cause you to serve your enemies in the land which you don’t know, for you have kindled a fire in my anger which will burn forever.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Mihing muang a, mihing bantha hatna muang a, TOUPA lehngatsan lungtang neimi hamsethuak in om hen.
english: Yahweh says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in man, relies on strength of flesh, and whose heart departs from Yahweh.

paite: Gamdai a loupa keu gaw bang ahi a, thil hoih pawt ding amu kei ding. Gamdai gamkeu, chi gam, kuamah luah louh ah ateng zaw ding hi.
english: For he will be like a bush in the desert, and will not see when good comes, but will inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, an uninhabited salt land.

paite: TOUPA muangmi, alametpen TOUPA hi in nuam asa hi.
english: “Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose confidence is in Yahweh.

paite: Tui kiang a sing suan, lui gei a zungkai, kholum hong tung ding patau lou, anahte hing gige, khokhen kum khawk sa lou, gah suan kikhelsak tuan lou bang ahi ding hi.
english: For he will be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and will not fear when heat comes, but its leaf will be green, and will not be concerned in the year of drought. It won’t cease from yielding fruit.

paite: Lungtang bel thil tengteng sang in khemhat pen, hoih lou pumlum ahi a; kua'n ahia theithei ding?
english: The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it?

paite: Kei TOUPA bel michih a-omdan bang zel uleh athilhih gah bang zel a pe ding a lungsim enkhepa, lungtang enchianpa ka hi.
english: “I, Yahweh, search the mind. I try the heart, even to give every man according to his ways, according to the fruit of his doings.”

paite: Mi, kilawm lou a hong hau bel vengkeng, ama tuiloupi keuhsak dia op bang ahi, adam lai ngei in amah atuansan ding ua, atawp in mihai ahong himai ding.
english: As the partridge that sits on eggs which she has not laid, so is he who gets riches, and not by right. In the middle of his days, they will leave him. At his end, he will be a fool.

paite: Ka mun siangthou omna bel laltutphah thupi mahmah, atung a kipan a tawisang a om ahi.
english: A glorious throne, set on high from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary.

paite: Aw TOUPA Israel lamet, nang hon paisan mi tengteng azahlak ding uh; kei hon lehngatsan mite lei a leivui a gelh bang lel ahi ding uh, TOUPA hinna tuikhuk pen lah apaisanta ngal ua.
english: Yahweh, the hope of Israel, all who forsake you will be disappointed. Those who depart from me will be written in the earth, because they have forsaken Yahweh, the spring of living waters.

paite: Aw TOUPA hon hihdam inla, huchi in ka dam ding a, hon humbit lechin, huchi in ka bit ding, ka phat gige nang na hi.
english: Heal me, O Yahweh, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved; for you are my praise.

paite: "Ngai in, ka kiang ah, TOUPA thu koi ah? Hong tung leh ake," achi sek uh.
english: Behold, they ask me, “Where is Yahweh’s word? Let it be fulfilled now.”

paite: Thil hoih lou tungsak ding ka hon phut kei a, siatna ni lah ka deih het kei chih na thei hi; ka kam a thupawt lah na maima a om ahi ngal a.
english: As for me, I have not hurried from being a shepherd after you. I haven’t desired the woeful day. You know. That which came out of my lips was before your face.

paite: Kei a ding in kihtakhuai hi ke'nla, mangbat ni a ka kihumbitna na hi.
english: Don’t be a terror to me. You are my refuge in the day of evil.

paite: Hon simmohte zahlak uhenla, kei bel zahlak kei leng; amau bel lungzing uhenla, kei bel lungzing kei leng; mangbat ni atung uah tun inla, nakpi in amaute hihmang in.
english: Let them be disappointed who persecute me, but don’t let me be disappointed. Let them be dismayed, but don’t let me be dismayed. Bring on them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi: Kuan inla, Judah kumpipate lutna zel leh pawtna zel, mipite tate kongpi ah leh Jerusalem kongpite tengteng ah va dingh inla;
english: Yahweh said this to me: “Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, through which the kings of Judah come in and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem.

paite: akiang uah, "Nou Judah kumpipate, Judah tengtengte, Jerusalem a teng tengteng hiai kongpi a lut sekte aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia un."
english: Tell them, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, you kings of Judah, all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Na hinna uh pilvang mahmah dih ua, Sabbath ni in puak nei kei unla, Jerusalem kulh kongpi ah lutpih sam kei un.
english: Yahweh says, “Be careful, and bear no burden on the Sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem.

paite: Huan Sabbath ni in na inn ua kipan puak na pokhe ding uh ahi kei a, nna na sem ding uh ahi sam kei; na pipute uh kiang a ka thupiak bang in Sabbath na tang siangthou zaw ding uh ahi.
english: Don’t carry a burden out of your houses on the Sabbath day. Don’t do any work, but make the Sabbath day holy, as I commanded your fathers.

paite: Amau zaw angaikhe kei ua, bil adoh kei ua; thununna azak ua atanlouhna ding un akigenhaksak zaw uhi."
english: But they didn’t listen. They didn’t turn their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, and might not receive instruction.

paite: TOUPA thupawt in hichi in achi: "Khawksatak a na hon ngaihkhiak ua, Sabbath ni a hiai khopi a kongpi a thil na puaklut louh ua,
english: It will happen, if you diligently listen to me,” says Yahweh, “to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, but to make the Sabbath day holy, to do no work therein;

paite: nna na sep louh ua Sabbath na tan siangthou uleh, hiai khopi kongpi ah leh heutute, David tutphah a tu dingte kangtalaite leh sakolte ah tuang in ahong lut ding ua, amau leh amiliante uh Judah leh Jerusalem a tengte toh; huchi in hiai khopi ah mi atengdenta ding uh.
english: then there will enter in by the gates of this city kings and princes sitting on David’s throne, riding in chariots and on horses, they and their princes, the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and this city will remain forever.

paite: Judah khopi leh Jerusalem kim a kipan, Benjamin gam a kipan, gam niam gam a kipan, tanggam a kipan leh Sim gam a kipan in ahong pai ding ua, halmang thillat leh kithoihnate buh-le-bal thillat leh gimlimte, kipahna kithoihnate TOUPA inn ah ahon tawi ding uh.
english: They will come from the cities of Judah, and from the places around Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin, from the lowland, from the hill country, and from the South, bringing burnt offerings, sacrifices, meal offerings, and frankincense, and bringing sacrifices of thanksgiving to Yahweh’s house.

paite: Himahleh Sabbath tang siangthou ding leh Sabbath ni a puak neih louh leh Jerusalem kulh kongpi a lutpih louh ding thu ah na hon ngaihkhiak kei uleh akulh kongpite ah mei ka pawtsak ding a, Jerusalem kumpipa' inn te akangbei ding a, amit kei ding hi."
english: But if you will not listen to me to make the Sabbath day holy, and not to bear a burden and enter in at the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle a fire in its gates, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem. It will not be quenched.”’”

paite: TOUPA a kipan a Jeremiah kiang a thu hong tung in hichi in achi:
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

paite: "Thou inla, belvelmi inn ah hohsuk inla, huai ah ka thute ka hon theisak ding," achi hi.
english: “Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause you to hear my words.”

paite: Huchi in belvelmi inn ah ka hohsukta a, abel bawlna khawl ah nna asem hi.
english: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and behold, he was making something on the wheels.

paite: Tung a bel abawl lai ahong hoih keileh belvelmi'n hoih asak bang in bel dang ding in abawl nawn zel hi.
english: When the vessel that he made of the clay was marred in the hand of the potter, he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.

paite: Huchi in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn a,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Aw Israel inkote aw, hiai belvelmi hih bang in nou ka hon hihthei kei a hia? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Ngai dih ua, belvelmi khut a tungman bang lel in ka khut ah na om uhi, aw Israel inkote aw,"
english: “House of Israel, can’t I do with you as this potter?” says Yahweh. “Behold, as the clay in the potter’s hand, so are you in my hand, house of Israel.

paite: Chik lai in leng nam hiamgam hiam tungtang thu ah, ka hon dokkhe ding, ka hon phel ding a, ka hon hihse ding, chi in na gen mah leng,
english: At the instant I speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up and to break down and to destroy it,

paite: Huai nam in atungthu ka gen ziak a athil hoih lou hih alehngatsan leh atung a thil hoih lou hih ka tup ka kikhelsak ding.
english: if that nation, concerning which I have spoken, turns from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do to them.

paite: Huan chik lai in leng nam hiamgam tungtang thu ah, ka hon bawl ding a, ka hon dingsak ding, chi a na gen hi leng zong,
english: At the instant I speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it,

paite: ka paukam suak ngaikhe lou a ka mitmuh a thil hoih lou ahihleh ama a ding in thil hoih hih ka tup ka kikhelsak sam ding.
english: if they do that which is evil in my sight, that they don’t obey my voice, then I will repent of the good with which I said I would benefit them.

paite: Huaiziak in Judah mite leh Jerusalem a tengte kiang ah TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai dih ua, na tung uah thil hoih lou ka ngaihtuah a, nou ka hon sawm lai na hi uh, michih in a-omdan hoih lou uh lehngatsan uhenla, na omdan uleh na thilhihte uh bawlpha un," va chi peuhmah in.
english: “Now therefore, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Yahweh says: “Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a plan against you. Everyone return from his evil way now, and amend your ways and your doings.”’

paite: Himahleh amau zaw, "Kilawm kei e! Koumau phasak bangbang in ka om ding ua, michih koumau lungtang gilou genhak bang zel in ka om ding uh," achi sek uhi.
english: But they say, ‘It is in vain; for we will walk after our own plans, and we will each follow the stubbornness of his evil heart.’”

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Namdangte dong him dih ua, hichibang mahmah kua'n athei a? Nungak siangthou Israel in thil lauhuai mahmah ahihta.
english: Therefore Yahweh says: “Ask now among the nations, ‘Who has heard such things?’ The virgin of Israel has done a very horrible thing.

paite: Lebanon vuk in amualvum anuse ngei a hia? Gamla a kipan a tui vot hong luangsukte akangtat ngei a hia?
english: Will the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field? Will the cold waters that flow down from afar be dried up?

paite: Ka mite'n ahon mangngilh ua, bangmah lou phet kiang ah gimlim ahal ua, huaite'n atuma lam lampi ua kipan akisuisak a, lampi pen hilou lamkhem lam azui uh;
english: For my people have forgotten me. They have burned incense to false gods. They have been made to stumble in their ways in the ancient paths, to walk in byways, in a way not built up,

paite: agam uh hihsiatgawp ahi dia, tangtawn a enghou ding; kivialleh min lamdang sa in alu uh asing ding ua.
english: to make their land an astonishment, and a perpetual hissing. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished, and shake his head.

paite: Suahlam huihpi bang in melma ma ah ka thehzak ding, avangtah ni un ka mel hilou, ka dek ka musak ding hi.
english: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy. I will show them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.

paite: Huan amau, "Kisa un, Jeremiah i sawm ding uh, siampu a kipan dan adai kei ding a, mipil a kipan thudot adai sam kei ding, zawlnei a kipan thu adai kei ding hi. Kisa un, i gensegawp ding ua, athu i limsak kei ding," achi uhi.
english: Then they said, “Come! Let’s devise plans against Jeremiah; for the law won’t perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let’s strike him with the tongue, and let’s not give heed to any of his words.”

paite: Hon limsak inla, aw TOUPA ka hon ngetna thu limsak in.
english: Give heed to me, Yahweh, and listen to the voice of those who contend with me.

paite: Thil hoih a gilou dit ahi dia hia? Amau lah ka kha a ding in kokhuk atou ngal ua. Amau a kipan a na hehna heimang ding leh amau a dia thil hoih gen ding a na ma a ka din sek theigige in.
english: Should evil be recompensed for good? For they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember how I stood before you to speak good for them, to turn away your wrath from them.

paite: Huchi in atate uh kialpi kiang ah pekhia inla, namsau hatna kiang ah pia in; huan azite uh ta nei lou in, meithai uhen; apasalte uh hipi in si uhenla, atangvalte uh leng kidouna ah namsau in si uhen.
english: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and give them over to the power of the sword. Let their wives become childless and widows. Let their men be killed and their young men struck by the sword in battle.

paite: Sim mite akiang uh na tunsak guih lai in a-inn ua kipan kap husa thangkhia hen; kei a ding in kokhuk atou ngal ua, ka khe awkna ding in thang akam uhi.
english: Let a cry be heard from their houses when you bring a troop suddenly on them; for they have dug a pit to take me and hidden snares for my feet.

paite: Himahleh nang, aw TOUPA kei hon that ding a ahon sawmna tengteng uh na thei hi; athulimlouhna uh ngaidam ke'nla, na mitmuh in akhelhna uh thaimang sam ke'n. Na ma ah kipuk uhenla, na heh ni in amaute soisa in.
english: Yet, Yahweh, you know all their counsel against me to kill me. Don’t forgive their iniquity. Don’t blot out their sin from your sight, Let them be overthrown before you. Deal with them in the time of your anger.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Kuan unla, belvelmi leibel va lei un; mipite upate leh siampu lak alupate pi inla;
english: Thus said Yahweh, “Go, and buy a potter’s earthen container, and take some of the elders of the people and of the elders of the priests;

paite: belvelmi kongpi lutna chin a Ben Hinnom Phaizang ah hoh inla, huai ah na kiang a thu ka hon hilh ding na puang ding hi.
english: and go out to the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the gate Harsith, and proclaim there the words that I will tell you.

paite: Hichi in na chi ding hi, "Judah kumpipate leh Jerusalem a tengte aw, TOUPA thu za un." Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai dih ua, hiai mun ah aza peuhmah bil am khop hial a thil hoih lou ka hon tun ding hi.
english: Say, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Behold, I will bring evil on this place, which whoever hears, his ears will tingle.

paite: Mite'n ahon paisan ua, hiai mun ahihnin un, amau leh apate uh leh Judah Kumpipate'n leng atheih ngei nai het louh uh, pathian dangte kiang ah gimlim ahal ziak uleh hiai mun mihoih sisan a adimsak ziak un leh Baal kiang a halmang thillat ding a atate uh ahalna ding ua Baal mun sangte alamkhiak ziak un;
english: Because they have forsaken me, and have defiled this place, and have burned incense in it to other gods that they didn’t know—they, their fathers, and the kings of Judah—and have filled this place with the blood of innocents,

paite: Huai zaw ka thupiak ahi kei a, gen leng ka gen sam kei a, ka lungsim ah leng a-om ngei kei hi.
english: and have built the high places of Baal to burn their children in the fire for burnt offerings to Baal, which I didn’t command, nor speak, which didn’t even enter into my mind.

paite: Huaiziak in ngai dih, nite ahong tung ding," TOUPA thupawt in achi; huai nite chiang in hiai mun Tophet chih ahita kei ding a, Ben Hinnom Phaizang chih ahi sam kei ding; kithahna Phaizang chih ahi zawta ding.
english: Therefore, behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that this place will no more be called ‘Topheth’, nor ‘The Valley of the son of Hinnom’, but ‘The valley of Slaughter’.

paite: Huan hiai mun ah Judah leh Jerusalem thiltupte ka vuaksuaksak ding a; amau pen namsau in amelmate uh ma ah leh ahinna uh lak tum mite khut ah ka puksak ding; aluangte uh tung a leng vasate leh lei a gamsate an ding in ka pe ding.
english: “‘“I will make the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem void in this place. I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hand of those who seek their life. I will give their dead bodies to be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.

paite: Huchi in hiai khopi lamdangsak ding leh enghou ding in ka bawl ding a, avialpai peuh in siatna atuahte ziak in lamdang asa ding ua, a-enghou lai ding uhi.
english: I will make this city an astonishment and a hissing. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss because of all its plagues.

paite: Atanute uleh atapate uh sa ka nesak ding a; amelmate uh leh ahinna uh lak tum mite'n a-um ua amangbatsak hun chiang un kuapeuh in a-invengte uh sa ane ding uh.
english: I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters. They will each eat the flesh of his friend in the siege and in the distress with which their enemies, and those who seek their life, will distress them.”’

paite: Huan na paipihte mitmuh in bel na hihtam ding a, akiang uah huchi in na chi ding.
english: “Then you shall break the container in the sight of the men who go with you,

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Hichi mah bang in hiai mite leh hiai khua ka hihtam ding; mi'n belvelmi bel akitapsak a, bawlhoih nawn vual ahih louh bang in Tophet ah avui ding uh; vuina ding mun dang a-om louh ziak in.
english: and shall tell them, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “Even so I will break this people and this city as one breaks a potter’s vessel, that can’t be made whole again. They will bury in Topheth until there is no place to bury.

paite: Huchi hial in hiai mun ka bawl ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; hichi mah bang in hiai khua Tophet bang a bawl hial in, asung a tengte tung ah leng ka hih ding;
english: This is what I will do to this place,” says Yahweh, “and to its inhabitants, even making this city as Topheth.

paite: Jerusalem innte leh Judah kumpipate innte, inn chiteng mahmah atung a van lam thilte kiang a gimlim halkhitna tengteng leh pathian dangte kiang a dawn ding thillat butkhiaknasa tengtengte Tophet mun bang hial a hihnit ahi ding hi.
english: The houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah, which are defiled, will be as the place of Topheth, even all the houses on whose roofs they have burned incense to all the army of the sky and have poured out drink offerings to other gods.”’”

paite: Huan Jeremiah bel, TOUPA'N thugen ding a asawlna mun Tophet a kipan in ahong pai a; TOUPA' inn um sung ah adingh a, mipi tengteng kiang ah hichi in achi:
english: Then Jeremiah came from Topheth, where Yahweh had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the court of Yahweh’s house, and said to all the people:

paite: Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai dih ua, thil hoih lou ka gen tengteng hiai khopi leh akho dang tengteng ah ka hon tungsak ding; ka thu ngaikhe lou ding a alungtang uh akhauhsak ziak un."
english: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, ‘Behold, I will bring on this city and on all its towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have made their neck stiff, that they may not hear my words.’”

paite: Ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a, hichi in achi:
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Kuan inla, Jerusalem zak in kikou in, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, 'Na tuailai a na migitdante, kikham lai a na hon itdante ka theigige hi; gamdai a khoh louh gam a na hon zuihdan bang.
english: “Go and proclaim in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “I remember for you the kindness of your youth, your love as a bride, how you went after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.

paite: Israel bel TOUPA a dia hihsiangthou, agahpung masa ahi, amah negaimi peuhmah amoh ding a, atung uah siatna ahong tung ding,’ " chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Israel was holiness to Yahweh, the first fruits of his increase. All who devour him will be held guilty. Evil will come on them,”’ says Yahweh.”

paite: Aw Jakob inkote leh Israel inkote tengteng aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia un;
english: Hear Yahweh’s word, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel!

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Na pipute un kei ah diktatlouhna bang ahia amuh uh, kei a kipan gamlapi ah avakmang ua, bangmah loul delh a, ana ki-otsak uh?
english: Yahweh says, “What unrighteousness have your fathers found in me, that they have gone far from me, and have walked after worthless vanity, and have become worthless?

paite: 'TOUPA, Aigupta gam a kipan hon pikhia a, gamdai, gamkeu, kokhuk mun, sihna limliap leh gamkeu mun, kuamah paisuak ngeilouhna, kuamah omlouhna mun a hon pi paisuakpa koi a om ahia? achi kei uh.
english: They didn’t say, ‘Where is Yahweh who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, who led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought and of the shadow of death, through a land that no one passed through, and where no man lived?’

paite: Gam hoihtak ah, agah leh hoihna ne ding in, ka hon pilut a, himahleh na lut uleh ka gam na hihnin ua, ka goutan thilkihhuai in na bawl uh.
english: I brought you into a plentiful land to eat its fruit and its goodness; but when you entered, you defiled my land, and made my heritage an abomination.

paite: Siampute'n, 'TOUPA koi a om ahia?' achi kei ua, Dan zang mite'n ahon thei sam kei uh, vaihawmte ka tung ah ahel ua, zawlneite'n Baal min in thu agen ua, thil phatuam lou dingte adelh uh."
english: The priests didn’t say, ‘Where is Yahweh?’ and those who handle the law didn’t know me. The rulers also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal and followed things that do not profit.

paite: "Huchi in ka hon langbawl ding a, na tate uh ta nawnte leng ka langbawl lailai ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Therefore I will yet contend with you,” says Yahweh, “and I will contend with your children’s children.

paite: Kittim tuikulh ah va hoh unla, en un, Kedar ah mi sawl unla, chiktak in ngaihtuah un, hichibang thil a-om ngeina hiam chih theihna ding in.
english: For pass over to the islands of Kittim, and see. Send to Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there has been such a thing.

paite: Namte'n apathian uh akheng uhia, pathiantak hiloupi leng? Ka mite'n bel athupina uh, thil phatuam loutak in akhek uh.
english: Has a nation changed its gods, which really are no gods? But my people have changed their glory for that which doesn’t profit.

paite: "Aw vante, lamdang sa unla, hon mulkimsak henla, mau tuaituai un, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Be astonished, you heavens, at this and be horribly afraid. Be very desolate,” says Yahweh.

paite: Ka mite'n thil nih ahihkhial uhi: kei, hinna tuikhuk ahon paisan ua, tui ching thei lou ding tuivungte atoukhia uhi.
english: “For my people have committed two evils: they have forsaken me, the spring of living waters, and cut out cisterns for themselves: broken cisterns that can’t hold water.

paite: Israel sikha ahi hia? Sikha mawng a piang hia? Bangziak a nuaisiah a om ahia?
english: Is Israel a slave? Is he born into slavery? Why has he become a captive?

paite: Humpinelkai tuailaite'n hamkhum in, atung ah aw asuah ua, agam ahihgawp khinta uh, akhopite leng luahmi nei lou in akangsiang khin hi.
english: The young lions have roared at him and raised their voices. They have made his land waste. His cities are burned up, without inhabitant.

paite: Memphis mi leh Tahpanhes mite'n, na luzang agiausak khinta uh.
english: The children also of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of your head.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian in lampi a ahon pi lai a, na taimangsan ziak in, huai na tung a na tunsak ahi kei maw?
english: “Haven’t you brought this on yourself, in that you have forsaken Yahweh your God, when he led you by the way?

paite: Nile tui dawn ding a Aigupta lampi na zuih, nang ding a bang aphatuam a? Luipi tui dawn ding a Assuria lampi na zuih, nang ding in bang aphatuam a?
english: Now what do you gain by going to Egypt, to drink the waters of the Shihor? Or why do you go on the way to Assyria, to drink the waters of the River?

paite: Na thulimlouhna in hon thuaksak ding a, na nungkinna in nang ahon sal ding hi; hon launa nei lou TOUPA na Pathian na paisan a, thil giloutak leh kha mahmah ahi na hih, na theikhia inla, mu telta in, chih, Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Your own wickedness will correct you, and your backsliding will rebuke you. Know therefore and see that it is an evil and bitter thing, that you have forsaken Yahweh your God, and that my fear is not in you,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Nidanglai a pan na hakkol hihtan in, na khaute leng na hihtatta hi, 'Na nna ka sem nawn kei ding,' na chi a, mual sangte, singbawk nuai ah na kizuak hi.
english: “For long ago I broke off your yoke, and burst your bonds. You said, ‘I will not serve;’ for on every high hill and under every green tree you bowed yourself, playing the prostitute.

paite: Chi dik zang in grepgui hoih mahmah ka hon phut a, bangchidan a kikheng a, kei a dia grep tak lou hong suakta na hia?
english: Yet I had planted you a noble vine, a pure and faithful seed. How then have you turned into the degenerate branches of a foreign vine to me?

paite: Tangal in kisil in sahbon tampi zang mah lechin, na thulimlouhna ka mitmuh in adawk teitei, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: For though you wash yourself with lye, and use much soap, yet your iniquity is marked before me,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: 'Ka kihihnin sam a, Baalte ka delh sam a, bang achia chi thei na hia, phaizang kuak a na omdante en inla, na thilhihsate thei in; sangawngsaula huk diang ngongngong na hi vele.
english: “How can you say, ‘I am not defiled. I have not gone after the Baals’? See your way in the valley. Know what you have done. You are a swift dromedary traversing her ways,

paite: Gam sabiltung gamdai a om, ahuk lai a dak uau-uau a dik vutvut bang; a-utna kua'n ahia dalzou ding? Azongmi kihihgim nuam dah hen, ahun in amu na ding uh.
english: a wild donkey used to the wilderness, that sniffs the wind in her craving. When she is in heat, who can turn her away? All those who seek her will not weary themselves. In her month, they will find her.

paite: Na khe ah khedap bun lou in om ke'nla, na dang leng hul kei heh; nang bel, lamet abeita, pau tuam mite ka ngai a, amau ka delh ding,' na chi hi.
english: “Keep your feet from being bare, and your throat from thirst. But you said, ‘It is in vain. No, for I have loved strangers, and I will go after them.’

paite: "Guta aphawk ua azum bang in, Israel inkote azumta uh, amau, akumpipate uh, aheutute uh, asiampute uh, azawlneite uh leng.
english: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so the house of Israel is ashamed— they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets,

paite: Singbul kiang a, 'Ka pa na hi,' chi a, suangbul kiang a, 'Kei hon suangtu na hi,' chi mite; masuan lou in adekkhuk sah uh ahon suan zaw ua, amangbat hun un bel, 'Thou in, hon hondam tanla,' achi ding uh, na pathian, huai na bawlte koi a om ahita ua?
english: who tell wood, ‘You are my father,’ and a stone, ‘You have given birth to me,’ for they have turned their back to me, and not their face, but in the time of their trouble they will say, ‘Arise, and save us!’

paite: "Amau thou zaw uhenla, na mangbat lai in ahon hondam thei khamoh ding uhia; aw Judah, na pathiante bel na khopite zah mah ahi ve ua oi!
english: “But where are your gods that you have made for yourselves? Let them arise, if they can save you in the time of your trouble, for you have as many gods as you have towns, O Judah.

paite: Bangziak a ka tung a vui nak? Na vek un ka tung ah thil na hihkhial ngal ua, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Why will you contend with me? You all have transgressed against me,” says Yahweh.

paite: Na tate uh ka khen a, aphatuam kei, ahoih loh tuan kei uh; humpinelkai duhgawl bang mai in, noumau namsau in na zawlneite uh ane khin uhi.
english: “I have struck your children in vain. They received no correction. Your own sword has devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.

paite: Aw khangthakte aw, TOUPA thu thei un, Israel a ding in gamdai gam bang ka hi maw? Mial sah meuhmouh gam ka hi maw? Ka mite'n bangdia, ka pawt kichianta ua, ka hong kik nawn kei ding uh, chi uh ahia?
english: Generation, consider Yahweh’s word. Have I been a wilderness to Israel? Or a land of thick darkness? Why do my people say, ‘We have broken loose. We will come to you no more’?

paite: Nungak siangthou in akizephoihnate amangngilh thei in, mouthak in akivatna amangngilh thei ding maw? Ka mite'n ni sim seng louh sung in ahon na mangngilhta uhi.
english: “Can a virgin forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? Yet my people have forgotten me for days without number.

paite: Deihtakmi muhtheihna ding in na omdan ngentel na chia! Numei gilou kiang ah leng na omdan na sinsakta ve.
english: How well you prepare your way to seek love! Therefore you have even taught the wicked women your ways.

paite: Na nikte ah leng migenthei poi khoihloute hinna sisan alang a; na inn abuluh lai khutmat ahi kei uhi.
english: Also the blood of the souls of the innocent poor is found in your skirts. You didn’t find them breaking in, but it is because of all these things.

paite: "Ka moh kei a, kei a kipan ahehna lakmang ahi, na chi nawn ngal a, ngai in, 'Ka gilou kei hi,' na chih ziak in, na tungthu ka ngaihtuah ding.
english: “Yet you said, ‘I am innocent. Surely his anger has turned away from me.’ “Behold, I will judge you, because you say, ‘I have not sinned.’

paite: Na omdan kheng mengmeng a, bangziak a vialvak vak na hia? Assuria na zumpih mah bang in, Aigupta leng na zumpih lai ding hi.
english: Why do you go about so much to change your ways? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria.

paite: Na khutte lukhuk in akiang ua pan na pawtkhe nawn dia, TOUPA'N lah na muannate apaikheta ngal a, amau ah na lamzang kei ding hi."
english: You will also leave that place with your hands on your head; for Yahweh has rejected those in whom you trust, and you won’t prosper with them.

paite: Huan Immer tapa, TOUPA' inn a heutupa pen, siampu Pashur in Jeremiah in huai zawlnei thugente agen chih ana za hi.
english: Now Pashhur, the son of Immer the priest, who was chief officer in Yahweh’s house, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.

paite: Huchi in Pashur in zawlnei Jeremiah akhen a, TOUPA' inn a Benjamin Kongpi saknung a koltanna ah atangsak a.
english: Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Azing in Pashur in Jeremiah akhahkhia a, huan Jeremiah in akiang ah TOUPA'N na min ding in Pashur achi kei a, Magermissabib ahon chi zaw hi.
english: On the next day, Pashhur released Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then Jeremiah said to him, “Yahweh has not called your name Pashhur, but Magormissabib.

paite: TOUPA'N lah hichi in achi ngal a: "Ngai in, nang a ding leh na lawmte tengteng a ding in kihtak in ka hon bawl ding; amau amelmate uh namsau in apuk ding ua, nang zaw na mit in na en lel ding. Judahte tengteng Babulon kumpipa khut ah ka pe vek ding; ama'n Babulon ah sal in api ding a, namsau in athat ding hi.
english: For Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends. They will fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes will see it. I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will carry them captive to Babylon, and will kill them with the sword.

paite: Huai ban ah, khopi hauhna tengteng, asepkhiak tengteng, athil manpha tengteng leh Judah kumpipate gou tengteng amelmate uh khut ah ka pe ding a, amau alok ding ua, aman ding ua, Babulon ah api ding uh.
english: Moreover I will give all the riches of this city, and all its gains, and all its precious things, yes, I will give all the treasures of the kings of Judah into the hand of their enemies. They will make them captives, take them, and carry them to Babylon.

paite: Huan nang Pashur, na insung a om tengtengte toh sal ah na tang ding ua; Babulon ah na pai tei ding; huai ah na si ding a, huai ah vui in na om ding a, nang leh na lawm zuauthu na hilhsekte tengteng toh," achi hi.
english: You, Pashhur, and all who dwell in your house will go into captivity. You will come to Babylon, and there you will die, and there you will be buried, you, and all your friends, to whom you have prophesied falsely.’”

paite: Aw TOUPA, nang na hon khem a, khem a om ka hita ve, nang zaw kei sang in na hat a, na hon zou a; nitum in nuihsan ka hita, mi kuapeuh in ahon nuihsan uhi.
english: Yahweh, you have persuaded me, and I was persuaded. You are stronger than I, and have prevailed. I have become a laughingstock all day. Everyone mocks me.

paite: Thu ka gen peuhmah chiang in, ka kikoukhia a, hiamgamna leh siatna, chi in ka kikou; TOUPA thu bel kei a ding in, nitum a dem leh muhsit lohna kia ahi.
english: For as often as I speak, I cry out; I cry, “Violence and destruction!” because Yahweh’s word has been made a reproach to me, and a derision, all day.

paite: Amah ka kan kei ding a, amin in leng thu ka gen nawn sam kei ding, chi mah leng, ka guh sung a meikuang kikhum khin bang mai in ka lungtang sung ah a-om a, ka pai kinken zou kei a, ka phazou mahmah kei hi.
english: If I say that I will not make mention of him, or speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning fire shut up in my bones. I am weary with holding it in. I can’t.

paite: Mi tampi aguk phun uh ka za; kil chih ah lauhuai a-om, hek unla, i hekkhawm ding uh, chi in. Ka lawmte ka puk ding tang gigete'n, "Khem in a-om kha dia, i zou ding, atung ah phu i la kha ding," achi uhi.
english: For I have heard the defaming of many: “Terror on every side! Denounce, and we will denounce him!” say all my familiar friends, those who watch for my fall. “Perhaps he will be persuaded, and we will prevail against him, and we will take our revenge on him.”

paite: Himahleh TOUPA mihangsan kihtakhuai mahmah bang in ka kiang ah a-om a, hon simmohte apuk ding ua, ahon zou kei ding uh. Zahlaktak in a-om ding ua, alohchin sin louh ziak un. Tangtawn a aminsiatna uh mangngilh in a-om kei ding.
english: But Yahweh is with me as an awesome mighty one. Therefore my persecutors will stumble, and they won’t prevail. They will be utterly disappointed because they have not dealt wisely, even with an everlasting dishonor which will never be forgotten.

paite: Aw sepaihte' TOUPA, midiktatte enchianpa, lungtang leh lungsim mu paisuakpa, atung ua na phulak hon musak dih ve, ka tungtang thu ka hon kemsakta hi.
english: But Yahweh of Armies, who tests the righteous, who sees the heart and the mind, let me see your vengeance on them, for I have revealed my cause to you.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah la sa unla, TOUPA phat un; thil gilou hih mite khut a kipan panpih deihte hinna ahumbitta hi.
english: Sing to Yahweh! Praise Yahweh, for he has delivered the soul of the needy from the hand of evildoers.

paite: Ka piankhiak ni hamsethuak in om hen, ka nu'n ahon piansak ni vualzawl in om dah hen.
english: Cursed is the day in which I was born. Don’t let the day in which my mother bore me be blessed.

paite: Ka pa kiang a, "Tapa na neita," chih thu hon tun a, hong kipaksakmi pen hamsethuak in om hen.
english: Cursed is the man who brought news to my father, saying, “A boy is born to you,” making him very glad.

paite: Huai mi, TOUPA'N hehpih het lou a asukgawp khuate bang in om hen, zingsang lam in kikou husa za henla, sun ahih chiang in galdou husa;
english: Let that man be as the cities which Yahweh overthrew, and didn’t repent. Let him hear a cry in the morning, and shouting at noontime,

paite: sul sung a ahon hihlup louh ziak in; huchi hihleh ka nu ka han himai ding hi a, asul in tangtawn a hon pai ding hiven.
english: because he didn’t kill me from the womb. So my mother would have been my grave, and her womb always great.

paite: Bangziak a sul a kipan hong pawt chitchiat ka hia, semgim leh lungkham a om ding a zahlak mawngmawng a ka damsung nite zang ding in?
english: Why did I come out of the womb to see labor and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?

paite: Kumpipa Zedekiah in Jeremiah kiang a Malkijah tapa Pashur leh siampu Maaseiah tapa Zephaniah asawl lai a Jeremiah kiang a TOUPA a kipan a thu hong tung ahi,
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur the son of Malchijah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, saying,

paite: "Babilon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in ahon dou a, TOUPA'N athilhih thupitak ahih sek bang in ahon huh nuam in, akiksak nawn mai kha diam chih TOUPA hon dotsak dih ve," chi in.
english: “Please inquire of Yahweh for us; for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon makes war against us. Perhaps Yahweh will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may withdraw from us.”

paite: Huan Jeremiah in akiang uah, Zedekiah kiang ah hichibang in va gen un; Israel' Pathian, TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: Then Jeremiah said to them, “Tell Zedekiah:

paite: "Ngai in, Babulon kumpipa leh Kaldai mi, kulh pua a nang hon umbichilhpa na douna galvan zat ka kiksak ding ahi; hiai khopi sung ah amaute ka pikhawm ding.
english: ‘Yahweh, the God of Israel says, “Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, with which you fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans who besiege you outside the walls; and I will gather them into the middle of this city.

paite: Kei mahmah in leng heh leh lungkim lou mahmah leh thangpaitak in ban zak a ban thahat zang in nang ka hon dou ding.
english: I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation.

paite: Hiai khua a teng mihingte leh gante ka that ding a, hipi in asi ding uh."
english: I will strike the inhabitants of this city, both man and animal. They will die of a great pestilence.

paite: Huai nung in, TOUPA thupawt in achi, "Kumpipa Zedekiah leh anungzuite leh midang hiai khua a hipi leh namsau leh kial a siloute, Babulon kumpipa leh amelmate uh khut leh amau thah tum mite khut ah ka pe ding. Namsau hiam in athat ding a, ahehpih het kei ding, ahawi het kei ding a, azahngai sam kei ding."
english: Afterward,” says Yahweh, “I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, his servants, and the people, even those who are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life. He will strike them with the edge of the sword. He will not spare them, have pity, or have mercy.”’

paite: Huan hiai mipite kiang ah huchi in va gen in; TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai un, sihna lampi leh hinna lampi ka hon koihsak hi.
english: “You shall say to this people, ‘Yahweh says: “Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.

paite: Hiai khopi sung a om namsau in hiam kial in hiam hipi in hiam asi ding uh; Kaldai mite nou hon umbichilhpa kiang a pawt a kipete bel ahing ding uh, ahinna uh kidouna kipahman ahi ding hi.
english: He who remains in this city will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, but he who goes out and passes over to the Chaldeans who besiege you, he will live, and he will escape with his life.

paite: Hiai khopi hoihna ding hilou, asiatna ding ka tum bilbel ahi; Babulon kumpipa khut a piak ahi ding a, ama'n mei in ahal ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: For I have set my face on this city for evil, and not for good,” says Yahweh. “It will be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it with fire.”’

paite: Judah kumpipa inkote tungtang thu ah; TOUPA thu ngaikhia un,
english: “Concerning the house of the king of Judah, hear Yahweh’s word:

paite: Aw David inkote aw! TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Zingsang in vai diktak in hawm unla, simmohmi khut a kipan loh thuakmi hunkhia un, huchi lou in zaw ka hehna mei bang in apawt ding a, kuamah phelh vual louh ding in akang dia, na thilhih giloute uh ziak in."
english: House of David, Yahweh says, ‘Execute justice in the morning, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my wrath go out like fire, and burn so that no one can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

paite: "Ngai dih ua, phaizang zang a tengte aw, nou phaizang zang suangpi a teng a, 'Kuate ahia i omna ua hong lut ding?' chite aw, nou ka hon lang ding hi. TOUPA thupawt in achi hi.
english: Behold, I am against you, O inhabitant of the valley, and of the rock of the plain,’ says Yahweh. ‘You that say, “Who would come down against us?” or, “Who would enter into our homes?”

paite: Na thilhih uh gah bang zel in ka hon gawt ding a, agam gammang ah mei ka khah ding a, akim tengteng akangmang ding," TOUPA thupawt in achi hi.
english: I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings,’ says Yahweh; ‘and I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it will devour all that is around her.’”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Judah kumpipa' inn ah hohsuk inla, hiai thu va gen in.
english: Yahweh said, “Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak this word there:

paite: 'Aw Judah kumpipa, David tutphah tung a tu, nang leh na nungzuite leh na mi hiai kongkhak a lutte toh, TOUPA thu ngaikhia un,' " chi in;
english: ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, king of Judah, who sits on David’s throne—you, your servants, and your people who enter in by these gates.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Diktak leh hoihtak in vai hawm unla; simmohmi khut a kipan loh thuakmi hunkhia unla; mikhualte, pa neiloute leh meithai tung ah diklouhna hiam hiamgamna hiam ching kei un; hiai mun ah mihoih sisan leng suah sam kei un.
english: Yahweh says: “Execute justice and righteousness, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor. Do no wrong. Do no violence to the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow. Don’t shed innocent blood in this place.

paite: Hiai thu zui ngei hi le uchin zaw, David tutphah tung a kumpipate kangtalaite leh sakolte tung a tuang in, amaute, anungzuite uh leh amite uh hiai na inn kongkhakte ua lut ngeingei ding uh hiven.
english: For if you do this thing indeed, then kings sitting on David’s throne will enter in by the gates of this house, riding in chariots and on horses—they, their servants, and their people.

paite: Himahleh hiai thute na ngaihkhiak kei uleh, hiai inn asegawp ding a, chi in kei-le-kei kilou in ka kichiam ahi," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: But if you will not hear these words, I swear by myself,” says Yahweh, “that this house will become a desolation.”’”

paite: TOUPA'N Judah kumpipa inkuan tungtang thu hichibang in agen hi: " 'Nang zaw kei a ding in Gilead bang, Lebanon mualvum bang na hi, hinapi in gamdai ka hon suaksak ding; luahmi om lou khopi bang mai in.
english: For Yahweh says concerning the house of the king of Judah: “You are Gilead to me, the head of Lebanon. Yet surely I will make you a wilderness, cities which are not inhabited.

paite: Nang hihmang dingte, galvan nei chiat in, ka bawlkhol ding a; na sidar sing telte aphuk ding ua, mei ah akhul ding uh."
english: I will prepare destroyers against you, everyone with his weapons, and they will cut down your choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.

paite: " ‘Huan nam tampite'n hiai khopi apal paisuak ding ua, michih in amau invengte kiang ah "TOUPA'N hiai khopi thupi mahmah bangziak a hichitak a hih hi ding ahia eita?" achi ding uh.
english: “Many nations will pass by this city, and they will each ask his neighbor, ‘Why has Yahweh done this to this great city?’

paite: A Pathian uh TOUPA thukhun alehngatsan ua pathian dangte abiak ua, a-nna asep ziak uh ahi, chi in adawng ding uh.’ "
english: Then they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned the covenant of Yahweh their God, worshiped other gods, and served them.’”

paite: Misi kah kei unla, suun sam kei un; paimangmi bel nakpi mahmah in kah un, ahong kik nawn kei ding a, apianna gam amuh nawn louh ding ziak in.
english: Don’t weep for the dead. Don’t bemoan him; but weep bitterly for him who goes away, for he will return no more, and not see his native country.

paite: Judah kumpipa Shallum, Josiah sik a vaihawmpa, hiai mun a kipan paikheta tungtang thu bel TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Hiai ah ahong kik nawnta kei ding.
english: For Yahweh says touching Shallum the son of Josiah, king of Judah, who reigned instead of Josiah his father, and who went out of this place: “He won’t return there any more.
