paite: Sal a apina mun uah, huai mah ah asi ding a, hiai gam amu nawnta kei ding."
english: But he will die in the place where they have led him captive. He will see this land no more.”

paite: "Diktatlouhna a inn lam a, diklouhna a dantan tungnungte bawlmi, athawn a amah invengte tha zang, loh pe nuam lou mite tung agik hi;
english: “Woe to him who builds his house by unrighteousness, and his rooms by injustice; who uses his neighbor’s service without wages, and doesn’t give him his hire;

paite: 'Inn thupi mahmah ka kilam ding a, dantan tungnung zapite nei inn, tohlette ka hong ding a, sidar sing in ka thuapsuak ding a, zesan ka nuh ding,' chimi tung mah.
english: who says, ‘I will build myself a wide house and spacious rooms,’ and cuts out windows for himself, with a cedar ceiling, and painted with red.

paite: Sidar sing a na ten ziak in, kumpipa kisa na hi maw! Na pa'n ne in adawn a, diktak in vai ahawm kei maw? Huai amah a ding in ahoih ahi.
english: “Should you reign because you strive to excel in cedar? Didn’t your father eat and drink, and do justice and righteousness? Then it was well with him.

paite: Migenthei leh tasamte vai ahawmsak a, huai ahoih ahi. Hiaitak na hon theihdan ding ahi maw? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; so then it was well. Wasn’t this to know me?” says Yahweh.

paite: 'Himahleh na huaihamte a ding in, mihoih sisan suahna ding, nuaisiahna ding leh hiamgamna ding lel in na mit leh na lungsim na pu ahi.' "
english: But your eyes and your heart are only for your covetousness, for shedding innocent blood, for oppression, and for doing violence.”

paite: Huaiziak in Judahte kumpipa Jehoiakim, Josiah tapa tungthu bel TOUPA'N hichi in agen a; " 'Aw ka unaupa,' chi in hiam, 'Aw ka sanggampa,' chi in hiam amah asuun kei ding ua, 'Aw toupa,' chi in hiam, 'Aw thupipen,' chi in hiam amah asuun sam kei ding uh.
english: Therefore Yahweh says concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah: “They won’t lament for him, saying, ‘Ah my brother!’ or, ‘Ah sister!’ They won’t lament for him, saying ‘Ah lord!’ or, ‘Ah his glory!’

paite: Jerusalem kulh polam a lotkhiak a, paih in, sabiltung vui in avui ding uh.
english: He will be buried with the burial of a donkey, drawn and cast out beyond the gates of Jerusalem.”

paite: Lebanon ah paitou inla, kikou in, Bashan ah na aw suah inla, Abarim a pan in kikou in, na itte tengteng amangthangta ua.
english: “Go up to Lebanon, and cry out. Lift up your voice in Bashan, and cry from Abarim; for all your lovers have been destroyed.

paite: Na lohchin in na kiang ah thu ka gen a, nang lah ka ngaikhe kei ding, na chi a, ka kamsuak ngaihkhiak louh na tuailai kipan in hiai na omdan ahi.
english: I spoke to you in your prosperity, but you said, ‘I will not listen.’ This has been your way from your youth, that you didn’t obey my voice.

paite: Na belampute tengteng uh huih in akivak ding ua, na mi itte sal in atang ding ua, nang leng gitlouhna tengteng ziak in zahlaktak leh mangbangtak in na om ngei ding hi.
english: The wind will feed all your shepherds, and your lovers will go into captivity. Surely then you will be ashamed and confounded for all your wickedness.

paite: Aw Lebanon tang a teng, sidar sing lak a buseptu na tung a natna atun a na hong hehpihhuai ding dan mai zaw! numei nauvei na bang mai in."
english: Inhabitant of Lebanon, who makes your nest in the cedars, how greatly to be pitied you will be when pangs come on you, the pain as of a woman in travail!

paite: Ahin a ka hin sung, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; Judah kumpipa Koniah, Jehoiakim tapa bel ka khut taklam a sawnna zungbuh himah lechin, huai a kipan ka hon botkhe ngeingei ding.
english: “As I live,” says Yahweh, “though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet on my right hand, I would still pluck you from there.

paite: Thah ding a nang hon zongmi khut ah, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar khut ah leh Kaldaite khut ah ngeingei nang ka hon pe ding hi.
english: I would give you into the hand of those who seek your life, and into the hand of them of whom you are afraid, even into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.

paite: Na pianna hilou gamdang ah nang leh na nu nang hon suangtu ka hon paikhe ding a, huai ah na si ding uh.
english: I will cast you out with your mother who bore you into another country, where you were not born; and there you will die.

paite: Alungsim ua kik nawn a-utna mahmah gam uah akik nawn kei ding uh.
english: But to the land to which their soul longs to return, there they will not return.”

paite: Hiai Koniah pen bel kitamgawp, simmohhuai ahi kei a hia? Bel asung a lungkimna omlouhna ahi kei maw? Bangziak a amah leh asuante paihkhiak a gam atheih ngei louh ua paihkhiak a a-om uh?
english: Is this man Coniah a despised broken vessel? Is he a vessel in which no one delights? Why are they cast out, he and his offspring, and cast into a land which they don’t know?

paite: Aw, gam, gam, gam, TOUPA thu ngai in,
english: O earth, earth, earth, hear Yahweh’s word!

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hiai mi ta nei lou, adamsung a lohching lou ding mi ahi, asuante kuamah lohching a, David tutphah tung a tu ding leh Judah gam a vaihawm nawn ding a-om kei ding uh, chi in gelh in.
english: Yahweh says, “Record this man as childless, a man who will not prosper in his days; for no more will a man of his offspring prosper, sitting on David’s throne and ruling in Judah.”

paite: “Agantatna mun a belam hihmangthang a dalhzaksak belamching mite atung uh agik hi!" chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture!” says Yahweh.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA Israel' Pathian in ka mite chingpa belamching mite tungtang thu ah hichi in achi: "Ka ganhonte na dalhsak ua, na delhmang ua, na veh kei uh, ngai un, na thilhih uh gilou ziak in nou ka hong veh ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says against the shepherds who feed my people: “You have scattered my flock, driven them away, and have not visited them. Behold, I will visit on you the evil of your doings,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huan ka ganhon khosuaksunte ka delhzakna gam tengteng a kipan ka pikhawm nawn ding a, ahuangsung uah ka hawlkhawm ding a, gah nuam mahmah ahi ding ua, apung ding uh.
english: “I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they will be fruitful and multiply.

paite: Amaute limsak ding, amaute a ding in belamchingmi ka koih ding a, alau nawnta kei ding ua, kuamah amang nawn kei ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: I will set up shepherds over them who will feed them. They will no longer be afraid or dismayed, neither will any be lacking,” says Yahweh.

paite: "Ngai dih ua, David a ding in Hiang diktat ka suahsak hun ding ahong tung dekta hi," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; amah kumpipa in atu ding a, piltak in agamta ding a, gam pumpi ah dikna leh diktatna atangtungsak ding.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will raise to David a righteous Branch; and he will reign as king and deal wisely, and will execute justice and righteousness in the land.

paite: Ahun sung in Judah hotdam ahi ding a, Israel bittak in a-om ding. Huai amin ding a asak ding uh hiai ahi, "TOUPA i diktatna uh ahi," chih.
english: In his days Judah will be saved, and Israel will dwell safely. This is his name by which he will be called: Yahweh our righteousness.

paite: "Huaiziak in ngai dih ua, ahun atung sinta," TOUPA thupawt in achi hi. Israel mite, "Aigupta gam a kipan a hon pikhepa TOUPA ahin a ahin sung, chi nawn lou in.
english: “Therefore, behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that they will no more say, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;’

paite: Mallam gam leh adelhzakna gam tengteng a kipan Israel inkote suante pikhia a, pikik nawnpa TOUPA ahin a ahin sung, achi zawta ding uhi.” Huchi in amau gam ngei ah ateng ding uh.
english: but, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up and who led the offspring of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all the countries where I had driven them.’ Then they will dwell in their own land.”

paite: Zawlneite tungtang thu pen, ka sung ah ka lungtang apuakkham hi, ka guh teng aling a, zukham bang mai ka hi, zu in azelh zoh mi bang mai in, TOUPA ziak leh athu siangthou ziak in.
english: Concerning the prophets: My heart within me is broken. All my bones shake. I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine has overcome, because of Yahweh, and because of his holy words.

paite: Gam angkawm in adim a, hamsia ziak in gam in asuun a, gamdai louhing munte akeu khinta; alampi uh agilou a, ahatna uh adik kei hi.
english: “For the land is full of adulterers; for because of the curse the land mourns. The pastures of the wilderness have dried up. Their course is evil, and their might is not right;

paite: Zawlneite leh siampute'n Pathian khawk asa kei ua, ka insung mahmah ah leng akhelhna uh ka mu.
english: for both prophet and priest are profane. Yes, in my house I have found their wickedness,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huaiziak in amaute a ding in apaina lampi uh, zan khomial lampi nal bang ahi ding a, huai ah delh in a-om ding ua atolhpuk ding ua, atung uah thil hoih lou ka tungsak ding a, amau gawtna hun, TOUPA thupawt in achi hi.
english: Therefore their way will be to them as slippery places in the darkness. They will be driven on, and fall therein; for I will bring evil on them, even the year of their visitation,” says Yahweh.

paite: Samaria zawlneite tung ah kihhuai ka mu, Baal lou in thu agen ua, Israelte apimang uhi.
english: “I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria. They prophesied by Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.

paite: Jerusalem a zawlneite tung ah thil mulkimhuai ka mu, ang a kawm ua, zuau in agamta ua, thil gilou hihte khut ahatsak ua, kuamah in agitlouh uh kisik atup louh loh uhi; kei a ding in Sodom a mite bang ahong hi vek ua, akhosung a mite tengteng leng Gomorrah a mite bang hial in.
english: In the prophets of Jerusalem I have also seen a horrible thing: they commit adultery and walk in lies. They strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that no one returns from his wickedness. They have all become to me as Sodom, and its inhabitants as Gomorrah.”

paite: Huaiziak in zawlnei hon tungtang thu ah sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai dih ua, gamsai in ka vak ding a, thil kha ka dawnsak ding; Jerusalem a zawlneite kiang a kipan in gam pumpi ah Pathian poisaklouhna lah apawtta ngal a.”
english: Therefore Yahweh of Armies says concerning the prophets: “Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink poisoned water; for from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has gone out into all the land.”

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Zawlnei na kiang ua thugente thu ngaikhe kei un; bangmah lou ahon sinsak ua, TOUPA kam a kipan hilou amau lungsim geltawmte agen uhi.
english: Yahweh of Armies says, “Don’t listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you. They teach you vanity. They speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA thu musit mite kiang ah, 'Nang ding in ahoih ding,' achi vial ua; amau deihlam engtat a hih teitei mite kiang ah, 'Thil hoih lou bangmah na tung ah ahong tung kei ding, " achi uh.
english: They say continually to those who despise me, ‘Yahweh has said, “You will have peace;”’ and to everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his own heart they say, ‘No evil will come on you.’

paite: TOUPA thugelna ah kua apang ngei a, athu sang a thei ding kua ahia om? Ahihleh athu pen kua'n ahia limsak a ngaikhia om?
english: For who has stood in the council of Yahweh, that he should perceive and hear his word? Who has listened to my word, and heard it?

paite: Ngai dih ua, TOUPA huihpi, hehna apawtta, ahi, pingpei huihpi; migiloute lutang anuai ding.
english: Behold, Yahweh’s storm, his wrath, has gone out. Yes, a whirling storm! It will burst on the head of the wicked.

paite: TOUPA hehna amawk kik kei ding, alungsim a atup tinten atangtungsak a, ahih khit phot masiah; ni nanung lam ah na hon theichian ding uh.
english: Yahweh’s anger will not return until he has executed and performed the intents of his heart. In the latter days, you will understand it perfectly.

paite: Zawlneite bel ka sawl louhpi in atai ua, akiang ua thu ka gen louh in leng thu agen uh.
english: I didn’t send these prophets, yet they ran. I didn’t speak to them, yet they prophesied.

paite: Ka thugelna a om tei hi le uh zaw, ka mite kiang a ka thu puang ding hi ve un, athilhihdiklou ua kipan lehngatsak ding hi ve un.
english: But if they had stood in my council, then they would have caused my people to hear my words, and would have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.

paite: Gamlapi a om Pathian hilou in, Pathian nai gige ka hi kei a hia? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Am I a God at hand,” says Yahweh, “and not a God afar off?

paite: Mun kisel ah ka muh theih louh dia kibu thei mi a-om ua hia? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Lei leh van ah ka dim ahi kei maw? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Can anyone hide himself in secret places so that I can’t see him?” says Yahweh. “Don’t I fill heaven and earth?” says Yahweh.

paite: "Mang ka nei, mang ka nei, chi a ka min a zuaugen zawlneite thugen ka zata hi."
english: “I have heard what the prophets have said, who prophesy lies in my name, saying, ‘I had a dream! I had a dream!’

paite: Zawlnei zuaugente, amau lungtang kikhem tawm a thu sek mite lungtang ah hiai bang tan ahia a-om ding?
english: How long will this be in the heart of the prophets who prophesy lies, even the prophets of the deceit of their own heart?

paite: Amau bel a-invengte uh kiang ah amang uh ahilh ua ka mite ka min mangngilhsak atum ua, apate un Baal ziak a ka min amangngilh khit bang un,
english: They intend to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they each tell his neighbor, as their fathers forgot my name because of Baal.

paite: zawlnei mang nei in amang gen hen aw, ka thuneimi in ka thutak diktak in gen hen. Buhpawl leh buhtang in kibatna bang anei ua? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the straw to the wheat?” says Yahweh.

paite: Ka thu mei bang ahi kei maw, sek suang seknenna bang? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Isn’t my word like fire?” says Yahweh; “and like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces?

paite: Huaiziak in ngai un, zawlnei hon, ka thu kiguksak tuah sekte ka dou ahi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Therefore behold, I am against the prophets,” says Yahweh, “who each steal my words from his neighbor.

paite: Ngai dih ua, zawlnei amah dangnalsak a, TOUPA'N achi, chisekte ka dou ahi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Behold, I am against the prophets,” says Yahweh, “who use their tongues, and say, ‘He says.’

paite: Ngai dih ua, mang zuau leltak gen a, hilh a, azuauthute uh leh aki-otsakna thuginaloute uh ziak a ka mite pimang zawlneite ka dou ahi, TOUPA thupawt in achi; ka sawl ngal kei a, thu lah ka pe kei a, hiai mipite aloh taksak kei ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Behold, I am against those who prophesy lying dreams,” says Yahweh, “who tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their vain boasting; yet I didn’t send them or command them. They don’t profit this people at all,” says Yahweh.

paite: Hiai mipite lak a mi kuahiam, zawlnei kuahiam in, siampu kuahiam in, "TOUPA puakgik bang ahia?" chỉ a ahon dot leh hichi in na dawng ding hi, "Noumau mah puakgik pen na hi uh, ka hon paimang ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “When this people, or the prophet, or a priest, asks you, saying, ‘What is the message from Yahweh?’ Then you shall tell them, ‘“What message? I will cast you off,” says Yahweh.’

paite: Zawlnei hiam, siampu hiam, mi kuahiam, TOUPA puakgik, chi a-om uleh, huai mi leh a-inkote ka gawt ding.
english: As for the prophet, the priest, and the people, who say, ‘The message from Yahweh,’ I will even punish that man and his household.

paite: Huchi in mi kuapeuh in a-invengpa kiang ah leh kuapeuh in a-unaupa kiang ah TOUPA'N bangchi in adawng a, TOUPA'N bang agen a? chi in na kidong ding uh.
english: You will say everyone to his neighbor, and everyone to his brother, ‘What has Yahweh answered?’ and, ‘What has Yahweh said?’

paite: TOUPA puakgik na lou kha nawn kei ding ua, mi kuapeuh amah mah thugen apuakgik ahi ding hi. Pathian hing, sepaihte' TOUPA, i Pathian thu uh lah na lehbulh khinta ngal ua.
english: You will mention the message from Yahweh no more, for every man’s own word has become his message; for you have perverted the words of the living God, of Yahweh of Armies, our God.

paite: Zawlnei kiang ah, "TOUPA'N bangchi in nang ahon dawng a? TOUPA'N bang ahia agen?" na chi ding.
english: You will say to the prophet, ‘What has Yahweh answered you?’ and, ‘What has Yahweh spoken?’

paite: Huan "TOUPA puakgik, na chih peuhmah uleh, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: TOUPA puakgik na chi ding uh ahi kei," chi a ka hon sawl a, TOUPA puakgik chi a thu na gen ziak in;
english: Although you say, ‘The message from Yahweh,’ therefore Yahweh says: ‘Because you say this word, “The message from Yahweh,” and I have sent to you, telling you not to say, “The message from Yahweh,”

paite: huchi in ngai un, "Ka hon mangngilh keuhkeuh ding a, noute leh hiai khopi na kiang uleh na pate uh kiang a ka na piaksa toh ka hon paimang ding hi.
english: therefore behold, I will utterly forget you, and I will cast you off with the city that I gave to you and to your fathers, away from my presence.

paite: Huan tangtawn demsiatna leh zahlak nilouhna mangngilh vual louh na tung uah ka hon tun ding hi."
english: I will bring an everlasting reproach on you, and a perpetual shame, which will not be forgotten.’”

paite: Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in Judahte kumpipa Jekoniah, Jehoiakim tapa leh Judah heutute, mikhutsiamte leh siksek mite toh Jerusalem a kipan a Babulon sal dia api nung in, TOUPA'N hiai mengmuhna ahon ensak a, ngai dih, theipi bawm nih TOUPA tempul ma ah akitung hi.
english: Yahweh showed me, and behold, two baskets of figs were set before Yahweh’s temple, after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the craftsmen and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.

paite: Bawm khat ah theipi hoihtak, theipi min masa bangtak a-om a; bawm dang ah bel theipi hoih lou, nek tak louh khop a sia a-om hi.
english: One basket had very good figs, like the figs that are first-ripe; and the other basket had very bad figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Bang ahia na muh, Jeremiah?" achi a. Ke'n, "Theipi, theipi hoih, hoih mahmah; leh ahoih lou, nek tak louh khop a sia," ka chi hi.
english: Then Yahweh asked me, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” I said, “Figs. The good figs are very good, and the bad are very bad, so bad that they can’t be eaten.”

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: TOUPA Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Judah saltangte, Kaldaite gam a athahna ding ua ka sawlkhiakte, hiai theipi hoih bang in ka en ding hi.
english: “Yahweh, the God of Israel says: ‘Like these good figs, so I will regard the captives of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans, as good.

paite: Ahoihna ding un atung uah ka mit ka tusak ding a, hiai gam ah ka pikik nawn ding; amau ka dingsak ding a, ka phel kei ding; ka suan ding a, ka botkhe kei ding.
english: For I will set my eyes on them for good, and I will bring them again to this land. I will build them, and not pull them down. I will plant them, and not pluck them up.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na hon theihna ding in lungtang ka hon pe ding a; ka mite ahi ding ua, a Pathian uh ka hi ding; alungtang tengteng uh toh ka kiang ah ahong kik ding uhi."
english: I will give them a heart to know me, that I am Yahweh. They will be my people, and I will be their God; for they will return to me with their whole heart.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Theipi sia, nek tak louh khop a sia bang in Judah kumpipa Zedekiah leh aheutute uh leh Jerusalem a nituang hiai gam a omlaite leh Aigupta gam a tengte, ka lehngatsan ding hi.
english: “‘As the bad figs, which can’t be eaten, they are so bad,’ surely Yahweh says, ‘So I will give up Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the remnant of Jerusalem who remain in this land, and those who dwell in the land of Egypt.

paite: Haksatak a leitung gam teng lak ah sep leng ding in, ka delhmangnate gensiat leh tehpih leh tai leh hamsiatkhum hi ding in ka tawpsan ding.
english: I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places where I will drive them.

paite: Amau leh apate uh kiang a ka piak gam a kipan valh khit ahih tanpha un alak uah namsau, kial leh hii ka sawl ding hi."
english: I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence among them, until they are consumed from off the land that I gave to them and to their fathers.’”

paite: Judahte kumpipa, Jehoiakim, Josiah tapa kum lina a Judah mite tengteng tungtang a Jeremiah kiang a thu hong tung; huai hun bel Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar kum khatna ahi a,
english: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah (this was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon),

paite: huai thu zawlnei Jeremiah in Judah mi tengteng leh Jerusalem a om tengtengte kiang a agen ahi.
english: which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem:

paite: Kum sawmnih-le-thum sung, Judahte kumpipa Josiah, Ammon tapa kum sawm-le-thumna a kipan tutan in, TOUPA thu ahong tung zel a, phalvak a thou in na kiang uah ka gengen a, himahleh na ngaikhe kei uh.
english: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, even to this day, these twenty-three years, Yahweh’s word has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking; but you have not listened.

paite: TOUPA'N na kiang uah anasemmi zawlneite tengteng asawl a, phalvak a thou in asawl a, himahleh na ngaikhe kei ua, thei ding in na bil uh na doh sam kei uh.
english: Yahweh has sent to you all his servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them (but you have not listened or inclined your ear to hear),

paite: Huai, zawlneite'n, "Michih noumau lampi gilou a kipan hong kik unla, TOUPA'N na kiang ua leh na pipute uh kiang a nidanglai a kipan tangtawn a ding a nou ahon piak gam ah teng un.
english: saying, “Return now everyone from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that Yahweh has given to you and to your fathers, from of old and even forever more.

paite: Pathian dangte kiang ah a-nna uh sem ding leh amaute be ding leh na khut nasep ua kei hon lungkim lousak ding in hoh kei un; huchi in ka hon hihna kei ding hi," achi uh.
english: Don’t go after other gods to serve them or worship them, and don’t provoke me to anger with the work of your hands; then I will do you no harm.”

paite: Himahleh nou ding a hoih lou ding a na khut nasep ua hon hehsak ding in na hon ngaikhe kei uh, TOUPA'N achi.
english: “Yet you have not listened to me,” says Yahweh, “that you may provoke me to anger with the work of your hands to your own hurt.”

paite: "Huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ka thu na ngaihkhiak louh ziak un, ngai dih ua,
english: Therefore Yahweh of Armies says: “Because you have not heard my words,

paite: mallam nam tengteng ka thukhak ding a, TOUPA thupawt in achi hi. Ka nasempa Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar leng ka thukhak ding a, amaute hiai gam leh asung a omte leh hiai kim a nam om tengteng sual ding in ka hon pi ding; ka hihmang sipsip ding a, lamdangsak ding leh enghou ding leh segawp nilouh ding in ka bawl ding.
english: behold, I will send and take all the families of the north,” says Yahweh, “and I will send to Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against its inhabitants, and against all these nations around. I will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and a hissing, and perpetual desolations.

paite: Huan akiang ua kipan nopsakna husa leh kipahna husate, mouneipa aw leh mou awte, buhgawi husa ging leh khawnvak vakte ka lamang ding hi.
english: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the lamp.

paite: Hiai avek in ase ding a, lamdangsak ahi ding a; hiai namte'n Babulon kumpipa nna kum sawmsagih asem ding uh.
english: This whole land will be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations will serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

paite: Huan kum sawmsagih aman hun chiang in Babulon kumpipa leh huai nam, Kaldaite gam, agitlouhna uh ziak in ka gawt ding a; tangtawn in ka segawpsak ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “It will happen, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation,” says Yahweh, “for their iniquity. I will make the land of the Chaldeans desolate forever.

paite: Huai gam tung ah ka thu atung ua ka gen tengteng, Jeremiah in namte tung a agen, hiai laibu a gelhsa tengteng ka tungsak ding hi.
english: I will bring on that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.

paite: Nam tuamtuam leh kumpipa thupitakte'n amaute'n nna akisep un, amau mahmah in leng amau nna ahon sepsak ding uhi.
english: For many nations and great kings will make bondservants of them, even of them. I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the work of their hands.”

paite: TOUPA Israel' Pathian in ka kiang ah hichi in achi: "Ka khut a hiai hehna uain nou la inla, ka hon sawlna ding nam chih dawnsak in.
english: For Yahweh, the God of Israel, says to me: “Take this cup of the wine of wrath from my hand, and cause all the nations to whom I send you to drink it.

paite: Adawn ding ua, ahoi dongdong ding ua, ahai ding ua, akiang ua ka sawl ding namsau ziak in," chi in.
english: They will drink, and reel back and forth, and be insane, because of the sword that I will send among them.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA khut a kipan nou ka la a, TOUPA'N hon sawlna nam chih ka dawnsak hi.
english: Then I took the cup at Yahweh’s hand, and made all the nations to drink, to whom Yahweh had sent me:

paite: Jerusalem leh Judah khopite, huai kumpipate leh heutute, siatgawpnate, lamdangsakte, enghou dingte, hamsiatte tang ding in, tua a-omdan bang uh;
english: Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, with its kings and its princes, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, a hissing, and a curse, as it is today;

paite: Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh leh asikhate, aheutute leh ami tengtengte;
english: Pharaoh king of Egypt, with his servants, his princes, and all his people;

paite: Amau lak a mikitokpolh tengteng; Uz gam a kumpipa teng; Philistia gam a kumpipa tengteng, Ashkelon leh Gaza leh Ekron leh Ashdod khosuaksunte;
english: and all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, all the kings of the Philistines, Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;

paite: Edom leh Moab leh Ammon suante;
english: Edom, Moab, and the children of Ammon;

paite: Tura kumpipa tengteng leh Sidon kumpipate leh tuipi gei kumpipate;
english: and all the kings of Tyre, all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the isle which is beyond the sea;

paite: Dedan leh Tema leh Buz leh abaksam uh met a omte tengteng;
english: Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all who have the corners of their beard cut off;

paite: Arabia kumpipa tengteng, Gamdai a teng nam kihelte kumpipate;
english: and all the kings of Arabia, all the kings of the mixed people who dwell in the wilderness;

paite: Zimri kumpipa tengteng; Elam kumpipa tengteng; Media kumpipa tengteng;
english: and all the kings of Zimri, all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes;

paite: Mallam kumpipa tengteng, agamla leh anai a mi akizom zel in; leitung a kumpi om tengteng in adawn khit chiang in Seshak kumpipa'n adawn ding hi.
english: and all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another; and all the kingdoms of the world, which are on the surface of the earth. The king of Sheshach will drink after them.

paite: Huan akiang uah sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Dawn unla, kham un, lau unla, kipuk in thoutou nawn kei un; na lak ua namsau ka sawl ding ziak in," chi in.
english: “You shall tell them, ‘Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Drink, and be drunk, vomit, fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.”’

paite: Huan na khut a nou pen dawn ding a alak nop kei uleh huchi in na chi ding; sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Na dawn ngeingei ding uh ahi!
english: It shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink, then you shall tell them, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “You shall surely drink.

paite: Ka min tam khopi ah thil hoih lou ka hih pan a, noute gawt louh hial in na om ding uh maw? Gawt louh in na om kei ding ua; lei a teng tengteng tung ah namsau ka samkhe ding," chih sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: For, behold, I begin to work evil at the city which is called by my name; and should you be utterly unpunished? You will not be unpunished; for I will call for a sword on all the inhabitants of the earth, says Yahweh of Armies.”’

paite: Huaiziak in atung ah hiaite gen inla, akiang uah huchi in chi in: "TOUPA mun sang a kipan in athum ding, atenna siangthou a kipan a-aw asuah ding, ahuang tung ah nakpi in athum ding; grep suk mite bang in akikou ding, lei luahte teng tung ah.
english: “Therefore prophesy against them all these words, and tell them, “‘Yahweh will roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation. He will mightily roar against his fold. He will give a shout, as those who tread grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.

paite: Lei tawp pha in husa athangkik ding a, TOUPA'N namte alang a, sa tengteng tung ah vai ahawm ding, namsau kiang ah migilou ape ding," TOUPA thupawt in achi hi.
english: A noise will come even to the end of the earth; for Yahweh has a controversy with the nations. He will enter into judgment with all flesh. As for the wicked, he will give them to the sword,”’ says Yahweh.”

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai in, thil hoih lou in nam chih ahon nuai ding hi, huihpi hat mahmah lei mun tawp a kipan in ahong kuan ding hi.
english: Yahweh of Armies says, “Behold, evil will go out from nation to nation, and a great storm will be raised up from the uttermost parts of the earth.”

paite: Huai ni chiang in TOUPA thahte'n lei tawp a kipan in lei tawp pha in akhak ding ua; suun louh leh khop louh leh vui louh in a-om ding ua; leitung a eklei lel ahi maimah ding uh.
english: The slain of Yahweh will be at that day from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth. They won’t be lamented. They won’t be gathered or buried. They will be dung on the surface of the ground.

paite: "Belamching mite aw kikou tuaituai unla, kap un, nou belamhon lak a makaite aw, kitung buatbuat un, thah a na om ni uleh na dalhzak nite uh ahong tung petmahta hi. Bel deihhuai bang in na puk ding uh.
english: Wail, you shepherds, and cry. Wallow in dust, you leader of the flock; for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions have fully come, and you will fall like fine pottery.

paite: Belamching mite'n taimangna lampi anei kei ding ua, belamhon lak a makaite'n leng pelhna lampi anei kei ding uh.
english: The shepherds will have no way to flee. The leader of the flock will have no escape.

paite: Belamching mite kah husa, belamhon lak a makaite mau ging toh, TOUPA'N atatna mun uh asuksiat lel ziak in.
english: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and the wailing of the leader of the flock, for Yahweh destroys their pasture.

paite: Huang muanhuaite daihsak sipsip in a-omta uh, TOUPA heh mahmah ziak in.
english: The peaceful folds are brought to silence because of the fierce anger of Yahweh.

paite: Abukna pawtsanta, humpinelkai bang in, nuaisiahna namsau lauhuai ziak leh aheh mahmah ziak in agam uh ase khinta hi."
english: He has left his covert, as the lion; for their land has become an astonishment because of the fierceness of the oppression, and because of his fierce anger.

paite: Judah kumpipa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim in vaihawm apat tung in hiai thu TOUPA kiang a kipan ahong tung hi:
english: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came from Yahweh:

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "TOUPA' inn huangsung ah dingh inla, Judah khopi tengteng Pathian be ding a TOUPA' inn a hong paite kiang ah akiang ua gen ding a thu ka hon piak tengteng khat lel leng iim lou in gen vek in.
english: “Yahweh says: ‘Stand in the court of Yahweh’s house, and speak to all the cities of Judah which come to worship in Yahweh’s house, all the words that I command you to speak to them. Don’t omit a word.

paite: Michih in a-omdan gilou uh paisan in angaikhe zenzen khamoh ding uhia, athilhih gilou uh ziak a atung ua thil hoih lou hih ka tup ka khektheihna ding in."
english: It may be they will listen, and every man turn from his evil way, that I may relent from the evil which I intend to do to them because of the evil of their doings.’”

paite: Nang akiang uah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Na hon ngaihkhiak louh ua, ka dan na ma ua ka koih na zuih louh ua,
english: You shall tell them, “Yahweh says: ‘If you will not listen to me, to walk in my law which I have set before you,

paite: zingsangpi a thou a amau na kiang ua ka sawl ka nasemmi zawlnei thu na limsak kei uleh;
english: to listen to the words of my servants the prophets whom I send to you, even rising up early and sending them—but you have not listened—

paite: hiai inn Shiloh bang in ka bawl ding a, leitung a nam tengtengte hamsia thuak ding in ka bawl ding," na chi ding hi.
english: then I will make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.’”

paite: Huan siampute, zawlneite leh mipi tengteng in TOUPA' inn a Jeremiah in hiai thu agen angaikhia uhi.
english: The priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, mipi tengteng kiang a gen ding a TOUPA'N apiak teng agen khit in, siampute, zawlneite leh mipi tengteng in amah amanta ua, "Si peuhmah niteh!"
english: When Jeremiah had finished speaking all that Yahweh had commanded him to speak to all the people, the priests and the prophets and all the people seized him, saying, “You shall surely die!

paite: Bangziak a TOUPA min lou a, "Hiai inn Shiloh bang ahi ding, hiai khopi luahmi om lou in asegawp ding, chi a gen na hia?" achi ua, Huchi in TOUPA' inn a mipi tengteng in Jeremiah aboh lutlut uhi.
english: Why have you prophesied in Yahweh’s name, saying, ‘This house will be like Shiloh, and this city will be desolate, without inhabitant’?” All the people were crowded around Jeremiah in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Judah heutute'n hiai thu azak un, kumpipa' inn a kipan in TOUPA' inn lutna TOUPA' inn Kongpi Thak ah atu uhi.
english: When the princes of Judah heard these things, they came up from the king’s house to Yahweh’s house; and they sat in the entry of the new gate of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huchi in siampute leh zawlneite'n heutute leh mipi tengteng kiang ah, "Hiai mi si tak ahi, khopi siat ding thu, na bil ua na zak bang un agenkhol ngal a," achi uhi.
english: Then the priests and the prophets spoke to the princes and to all the people, saying, “This man is worthy of death, for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your ears.”

paite: Huan heutute leh mipi tengteng kiang ah Jeremiah in, "Na thu ngaihkhiak khitsate uh bang in hiai inn leh hiai khopi siat ding thu gen ding in TOUPA'N kei hon sawl ahi.
english: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the princes and to all the people, saying, “Yahweh sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in na omdan uleh na gamtatdan uh bawlhoih unla, TOUPA na Pathian uh thu mang un; huchi in TOUPA'N na tung ua thil hoih lou tung ding aphuankhiaksa akikhelsak thei ding hi.
english: Now therefore amend your ways and your doings, and obey Yahweh your God’s voice; then Yahweh will relent from the evil that he has pronounced against you.

paite: Kei ka hihleh, na khut ua om ka hi. Dik leh hoih na chih bang un hon bawl un.
english: But as for me, behold, I am in your hand. Do with me what is good and right in your eyes.

paite: Na hon thah uleh, noumau leh hiai khopi leh khua-le-tuite tung ah mihoih sisan na tungsak ding uh chih thei mai un; adiktak in na bil ua hiai thute gen dia TOUPA'N na kiang ua hon sawl ka hi," achi hi.
english: Only know for certain that if you put me to death, you will bring innocent blood on yourselves, on this city, and on its inhabitants; for in truth Yahweh has sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears.”

paite: Huchi in heutute leh mipite'n, siampute leh zawlneite kiang ah, "Hiai mi asih ding ahi kei, TOUPA i Pathian min a i kiang ua thu gen ahi,” achi uhi.
english: Then the princes and all the people said to the priests and to the prophets: “This man is not worthy of death; for he has spoken to us in the name of Yahweh our God.”

paite: Huan huai gam Upa kuate hiam ahong dingh ua, mipi omkhawmte kiang ah,
english: Then certain of the elders of the land rose up, and spoke to all the assembly of the people, saying,

paite: "Mikah, Moreseth mi'n Judah kumpipa Hezekiah vaihawm lai in thu agen a, Judah mi tengteng kiang ah, Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Lou bang in Zion leh ahi ding a, Jerusalem thil se omkhawm asuak ding, tang a inn gammang mun sang bang ahi ding," achi hi.
english: “Micah the Morashtite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah; and he spoke to all the people of Judah, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “‘Zion will be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.’

paite: Judah kumpipa Hezekiah leh Judahte tengteng in amah athat uhia? TOUPA lau in TOUPA deihsakna angen ua, TOUPA'N atung ua thil hoih lou tung ding apuan akikhelsak ahi kei maw? E'n zaw i tung ua thil hoih lou tungsak ding i hi ve ua! achi hi.
english: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him to death? Didn’t he fear Yahweh, and entreat the favor of Yahweh, and Yahweh relented of the disaster which he had pronounced against them? We would commit great evil against our own souls that way!”

paite: Huan midang, TOUPA min a thugen Keriath-jearim mi Shemaiah tapa Uriah mah leng a-om a, Jeremiah thugen tengteng mah bang in hiai gam leh khopi siat ding thu agen hi.
english: There was also a man who prophesied in Yahweh’s name, Uriah the son of Shemaiah of Kiriath Jearim; and he prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah.

paite: Kumpipa Jehoiakim leh amithupite leh heutute'n azak un kumpipa'n hihlup atum a; himahleh Uriah in azak in alau a, ataimang a, Aigupta gam ah apaita hi.
english: When Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men and all the princes heard his words, the king sought to put him to death; but when Uriah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt.

paite: Kumpipa Jehoiakim in Akbor tapa Elnathan leh midangte toh Aigupta gam ah mi asawl hi.
english: Then Jehoiakim the king sent Elnathan the son of Achbor and certain men with him into Egypt.

paite: Huchi in Aigupta gam a kipan in Uriah apikhia ua, kumpipa Jehoiakim kiang ah ahon pi ua, huai in namsau in athat a, aluang vantang han ah apailut ua, achi uhi.
english: They fetched Uriah out of Egypt and brought him to Jehoiakim the king, who killed him with the sword and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.

paite: Himahleh Shaphan tapa Ahikam in Jeremiah agum a, huchi in hihlup ding in mipite kiang ah piak ahita kei hi.
english: But the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, so that they didn’t give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.

paite: Judah Kumpipa Josiah tapa Zedekiah, vaihawm apat tung lai in, TOUPA kiang a kipan in hiai thu ahong tung hi.
english: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi: Hakkolte leh akhaute bawl inla, na ngawng ah bat in.
english: Yahweh says to me: “Make bonds and bars, and put them on your neck.

paite: Huan Edom kumpipa, Moab kumpipa, Ammon mite kumpipa, Tura kumpipa, Sidon kumpipa kiang ah kumpipa Zedekiah kiang a amisawl, Jerusalem a hong paite khut ah khak in.
english: Then send them to the king of Edom, to the king of Moab, to the king of the children of Ammon, to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon, by the hand of the messengers who come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.

paite: Hiai thute apute uh kiang ah gensak in; hichi in Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: huchi in na pute uh kiang a na gen ding uh ahi:
english: Give them a command to their masters, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “You shall tell your masters:

paite: "Ka thilhihtheihna thupitak leh ka ban zak in leitung, mihingte leh leitung a sate toh ka bawl vek a, piak tuak ka chihte kiang ah ka pia hi.
english: ‘I have made the earth, the men, and the animals that are on the surface of the earth by my great power and by my outstretched arm. I give it to whom it seems right to me.

paite: Tu in leng ka nasempa Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar khut ah hiai gam tengteng ka pe khinta hi, gamsate leng amah nna sem ding in ka pe lai hi.
english: Now I have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant. I have also given the animals of the field to him to serve him.

paite: Amah gam huntak atun ma in nam tengteng in amah leh atapate leh atapa tate nna asem ding ua, huai nung in bel nam tampite leh kumpipa thupi mahmahte'n amah sikha ding in abawl ding uh."
english: All the nations will serve him, his son, and his son’s son, until the time of his own land comes. Then many nations and great kings will make him their bondservant.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar hakkol po nuam lou leh a-nna sem nuam lou nam leh lalna gam namsau leh kial leh hipi a amah khut a ka hihman vek masiah amau ka gawt zel ding.
english: “‘“‘It will happen that I will punish the nation and the kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon,’ says Yahweh, ‘with the sword, with famine, and with pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.

paite: Noute'n zaw na zawlneite uh, na aisan siamte uh; na mangte uh, na bumsiamte uh, na kiang ua, "Babilon kumpipa nna na sem kei ding uh," chi a gen mite ngaikhe kei un.
english: But as for you, don’t listen to your prophets, to your diviners, to your dreams, to your soothsayers, or to your sorcerers, who speak to you, saying, “You shall not serve the king of Babylon;”

paite: "Na gam ua kipan a gamlapi a pimang a na omtheihna ding un, na kiang uah zuauthu agenkhol uh ahi; ka hon delhkhiak a na manthatna ding un.
english: for they prophesy a lie to you, to remove you far from your land, so that I would drive you out, and you would perish.

paite: Himahleh Babulon kumpipa hakkol pua a, nna sem nuam namte bel agam ngei uah ka omsak ding a, lei alet ding uh, huai ah ateng gige ding uh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: But the nation that brings their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serves him, that nation I will let remain in their own land,’ says Yahweh; ‘and they will till it and dwell in it.’”’”

paite: Huan Judah kumpipa Zedekiah kiang ah hiai thu tengteng bang zel in ka gen a, "Babilon kumpipa hakkol pua unla, amah leh amite nna sem unla, hing un!
english: I spoke to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, “Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.

paite: Babulon kumpipa nna sem nuam lou namte tungtang TOUPA'N agensa bang in bangziak a namsaute, kialte, hipite a nang leh na mite si ding na hi ua?
english: Why will you die, you and your people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as Yahweh has spoken concerning the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

paite: Zawlnei na kiang ua, Babulon kumpipa nna sem kei un, chite thu ngaikhe kei un; na kiang ua zuauthu gen lel ahi ngal ua.
english: Don’t listen to the words of the prophets who speak to you, saying, ‘You shall not serve the king of Babylon;’ for they prophesy a lie to you.

paite: Ka sawl ahi kei ua, ka min sial in zuauthu agen nak ua, nou leh na kiang ua thugen zawlneite ka delhkhia a, na manthat theihna ding un," TOUPA'N achi.
english: For I have not sent them,” says Yahweh, “but they prophesy falsely in my name; that I may drive you out, and that you may perish, you, and the prophets who prophesy to you.”

paite: Siampute leh hiai mipite tengteng kiang ah leng ka gen sam a; TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Na kiang ua zawlnei thugen, "Ngai un, TOUPA' inn a belsuante Babulon a kipan inn hon tut ahi pah ding hi," chi mite thu ngaikhe kei un, na kiang uah zuau agen uhi.
english: Also I spoke to the priests and to all this people, saying, Yahweh says, “Don’t listen to the words of your prophets who prophesy to you, saying, ‘Behold, the vessels of Yahweh’s house will now shortly be brought again from Babylon;’ for they prophesy a lie to you.

paite: Amaute ngaikhe het kei un; Babulon kumpipa nna sem unla, hing un; bang ding in hiai khopi akisegawp dia?
english: Don’t listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon, and live. Why should this city become a desolation?

paite: Himahleh zawlnei ahih ua, TOUPA thu akiang ua om mah ahihleh TOUPA' inn leh Judah kumpipa' inn leh Jerusalem a belsuan nutsiat a omlaite Babulon a tut ahihlouhna ding in sepaihte' TOUPA kiang ah ngen uhen.
english: But if they are prophets, and if Yahweh’s word is with them, let them now make intercession to Yahweh of Armies, that the vessels which are left in Yahweh’s house, in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, don’t go to Babylon.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, khuam sangte, dal tuipangte, kingaknate leh hiai khopi a belsuan nutsiat a omsunte,
english: For Yahweh of Armies says concerning the pillars, concerning the sea, concerning the bases, and concerning the rest of the vessels that are left in this city,

paite: Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim tapa, Jekoniah leh Judah leh Jerusalem a mihoih tengteng Jerusalem a kipan a Babulon sal a dia api lai a alak val tungtang thu huchi in agen hi.
english: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon didn’t take when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem—

paite: Ahi, sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in TOUPA' inn leh Judah kumpipa' inn leh Jerusalem a belsuan nutsiat a om lai tungtang thu agen ahi;
english: yes, Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says concerning the vessels that are left in Yahweh’s house, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem:

paite: Babulon ah lakmang ahi ding ua, amaute ka hong veh masiah huai ah a-om nilouh ding uh; amau ka latou nawn ding a, hiai mun ah ka koih nawn ding a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: ‘They will be carried to Babylon, and there they will be, until the day that I visit them,’ says Yahweh; ‘then I will bring them up, and restore them to this place.’”

paite: Hichi ahong hi a, huai kum mah in, Judah kumpipa Zedekiah, vaihawm pat tunglam, akum lina, akha ngana ah zawlnei Hananiah, Azzur tapa Gibeon min siampute leh mipi tengteng ma ah, TOUPA' inn ah hon houpih hi.
english: That same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, Hananiah the son of Azzur, the prophet, who was of Gibeon, spoke to me in Yahweh’s house, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Babilon kumpipa hakkol ka hihtanta.
english: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

paite: Kum nih sung vengveng in TOUPA' inn a belsuan Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in hiai mun a kipan a alak a, Babulon tan a apaipih tengteng, hiai mun mahmah ah ka hon tun nawn vek ding.
english: Within two full years I will bring again into this place all the vessels of Yahweh’s house that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place and carried to Babylon.

paite: Hiai mun ah Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim tapa, Jekoniah leh Babulon a hoh Judah saltang tengteng ka pikik nawn ding; Babulon kumpipa hakkol lah hihtan ding ka hi ngal a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi," chi in.
english: I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, who went to Babylon,’ says Yahweh; ‘for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.’”

paite: Huan zawlnei Jeremiah in siampute leh TOUPA' inn a ding mipi tengteng ma ah zawlnei Hananiah kiang ah,
english: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people who stood in Yahweh’s house,

paite: Zawlnei Jeremiah ngei in, "Amen, TOUPA'N huchibang in hih ngei hen; TOUPA' inn a belsuante leh saltanna a mi tengteng Babulon a kipan hiai mun a hon tun ding a na gen TOUPA'N hih ngei hen.
english: even the prophet Jeremiah said, “Amen! May Yahweh do so. May Yahweh perform your words which you have prophesied, to bring again the vessels of Yahweh’s house, and all those who are captives, from Babylon to this place.

paite: Himahleh mipi tengteng leh na bil a ka thugen ngaikhia in.
english: Nevertheless listen now to this word that I speak in your ears, and in the ears of all the people:

paite: Kei leh nang ma a nidang a zawlneite'n gam tampi tung ah leh lalna gam thupi pite tung ah kidounate, thil hoihloute leh hipi thute agen sek uh.
english: The prophets who have been before me and before you of old prophesied against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, of evil, and of pestilence.

paite: Zawlnei muanna thugenmi thugen ahong tun hun chiang in, huai zawlnei pen TOUPA'N asawl ngei ahi, chih akithei mai ding," achi hi.
english: As for the prophet who prophesies of peace, when the word of the prophet happens, then the prophet will be known, that Yahweh has truly sent him.”

paite: Huan zawlnei Hananiah in hakkol, zawlnei Jeremiah puak ala a, ahihtan hi.
english: Then Hananiah the prophet took the bar from off the prophet Jeremiah’s neck, and broke it.

paite: Mipi tengteng ma ah Hananiah in, Hichi in TOUPA'N achi: "Hichibang ngei in Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar hakkol kum nih sung vingveng in nam tengteng ngawng a kipan ka hihtan ding, achi hi." Huchi in zawlnei Jeremiah in apaisanta hi.
english: Hananiah spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, “Yahweh says: ‘Even so I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from off the neck of all the nations within two full years.’” Then the prophet Jeremiah went his way.

paite: Huan zawlnei Hananiah in zawlnei Jeremiah ngawng a kipan hakkol ahihtan nung in Jeremiah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, after Hananiah the prophet had broken the bar from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

paite: Kuan inla, Hananiah kiang ah huchi in va chi in. Hichi in TOUPA'N achi: "Sing hakkol na hihtan a, atang in sik hakkol na bawlsak zaw ahi.
english: “Go, and tell Hananiah, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “You have broken the bars of wood, but you have made in their place bars of iron.”

paite: Hichi in Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi ngal a, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar nna aseptheihna ding un hiai nam tengteng sik hakkol ka posak ding ahi; amah nna asem ding uh; gamnuai a gamsate leng amah ka pe lai ahi," chi in.
english: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they will serve him. I have also given him the animals of the field.”’”

paite: Huan zawlnei Jeremiah in zawlnei Hananiah kiang ah, "Ngai in, Hananiah, TOUPA'N nang ahon sawl peuhmah kei hi; hiai mite zuau na muangsak lel ahi zaw."
english: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, “Listen, Hananiah! Yahweh has not sent you, but you make this people trust in a lie.

paite: Huaiziak in huchi in TOUPA'N achi: "Ngai dih, leitung a kipan ka hon hihmang vengveng ding; TOUPA tung a helna thu na gen ziak in tukum mahmah in na si ding," achi hi.
english: Therefore Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will send you away from off the surface of the earth. This year you will die, because you have spoken rebellion against Yahweh.’”

paite: Huchi in huai kum mah, akha sagihna ah zawlnei Hananiah asita hi.
english: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.

paite: Zawlnei Jeremiah in Jerusalem a kipan a saltang upate, siampute, zawlneite, midangte, Nebukadnezzar in Jerusalem a kipan a Babulon a api khit, akhosuaksunte kiang a alaikhak thu hiai ahi:
english: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the residue of the elders of the captivity, and to the priests, to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon,

paite: Kumpipa Jekoniahte, kumpinute, michilgehte, Judah leh Jerusalem heutute, mikhutsiamte, siksek mite Jerusalem apaikhiak nung ua;
english: (after Jeconiah the king, the queen mother, the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, the craftsmen, and the smiths had departed from Jerusalem),

paite: Shaphan tapa, Elasah leh Hilkiah tapa, Gemariahte khut ah akhak hi; amaute bel Judah kumpipa Zedekiah in Babulon gam a Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar kiang a asawlte ahi uh.
english: by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon). It said:

paite: Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N saltang tengteng, Jerusalem a kipan Babulon sal dia ka pisaksate kiang ah hichi in achi:
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says to all the captives whom I have caused to be carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon:

paite: Inn lam unla, huai ah teng un, huan bawl unla, agah ne un, zi nei unla, tanute tapate nei un.
english: “Build houses and dwell in them. Plant gardens and eat their fruit.

paite: Na tapate uh zi neisak unla, na tanute uh pasal neisak unla, tanu tapa aneihtheihna ding un; huai ah va pung unla, kiam lam nawt kei un;
english: Take wives and father sons and daughters. Take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters. Multiply there, and don’t be diminished.

paite: sal dia ka hon tansakna khopi hoihna ding zong unla, TOUPA kiang ah ngetsak un; ama hoihna ah nou leng hoihna na mu ding uhi.
english: Seek the peace of the city where I have caused you to be carried away captive, and pray to Yahweh for it; for in its peace you will have peace.”

paite: Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Na lak ua zawlneite leh aisan siamte'n hon khem kei uhenla, amang mat uh leng ngaikhe sam kei un.
english: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Don’t let your prophets who are among you and your diviners deceive you. Don’t listen to your dreams which you cause to be dreamed.

paite: Ka min sial in zuauthu na kiang ah agen uhi; kei sawl ahi kei uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: For they prophesy falsely to you in my name. I have not sent them,” says Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi ngal a, Babulon a ding in kum sawmsagih achin chiang in ka hong veh ding a, na kiang ua ka thuchiam hoihtak ka tungsak ding, hiai mun ah ka hon kiksak nawn ding.
english: For Yahweh says, “After seventy years are accomplished for Babylon, I will visit you and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.

paite: Nou lam a ka lungsim putdan ka kithei hi, na hun nanung tawp ua lametna leh tunung hon pe ding in thil hoih lou hilou in hoihna ngaihtuah ka hi.
english: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.

paite: Huan na hon kan ding ua, ka kiang ah na hong thum ding ua, ka hon ngaikhe ding hi.
english: You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you.

paite: Na hon zong ding ua, na lungtang tengteng ua na hon zon hun chiang un na hon mu ding uh.
english: You shall seek me and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.

paite: Huchi in na hon muh un ka om ding, TOUPA thupawt in achi, "Na vangphatnate uh ka tungding nawn ding a, nam tengteng lak a ka hon dalhsakna mun a kipan ka hon pikhawm nawn ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; sal dia ka hon matsakna mun ngei ah ka hon tungsak nawn ding," chi in.
english: I will be found by you,” says Yahweh, “and I will turn again your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places where I have driven you,” says Yahweh. “I will bring you again to the place from where I caused you to be carried away captive.”

paite: "TOUPA'N Babulon gam ah leng zawlnei ahon bawlsak," na chi uhi.
english: Because you have said, “Yahweh has raised us up prophets in Babylon,”

paite: TOUPA'N David tutphah ah kumpipa tungtang thu leh hiai khopi a teng mipi tengteng, sal dia pi tel louh, na unaute uh tungtang thu ah hichi in achi:
english: Yahweh says concerning the king who sits on David’s throne, and concerning all the people who dwell in this city, your brothers who haven’t gone with you into captivity,

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai un, atung uah namsau, kial leh hipi in ka delhzui ding a, theipi hut, ahoih louh mahmah ziak a nek tuak het lou bang mai in ka bawl ding.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Behold, I will send on them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like rotten figs that can’t be eaten, they are so bad.

paite: Namsau, kial, hipi in ka delhzui ding a, leitung alalna gam tengteng thil mulkimhuaitak in ka bawl ding a, amau ka dalhsakna nam tengteng lak ah hamsethuak ding in, lamdangsak chiat ding in, hamsiatkhum, selphou leh gensiat hi ding in ka bawl ding hi.
english: I will pursue after them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth, to be an object of horror, an astonishment, a hissing, and a reproach among all the nations where I have driven them,

paite: Phalvak a thou a ka nasem, zawlnei zang a ka thu na kiang ua ka hon tut khawk asak louh ziak un. TOUPA thupawt in achi; na ngaikhe nuam ngal kei ua, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: because they have not listened to my words,” says Yahweh, “with which I sent to them my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but you would not hear,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huaiziak in nou Jerusalem a kipan a Babulon a ka sawl, saltang tengteng aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia un.
english: Hear therefore Yahweh’s word, all you captives whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.

paite: "Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N Kolaiah tapa, Ahab leh Maaseiah tapa, Zedekiah ka min sial a na kiang ua zuauthu gen mite tungtang thu ah hichi in achi: Ngai un, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar khut ah ka mansak ding hi; na mitmuh ngei un athat ding;
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says concerning Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and concerning Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who prophesy a lie to you in my name: “Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and he will kill them before your eyes.

paite: Amau thu ah Babulon gam a Judah saltang tengteng in, Babulon kumpipa'n mei a a-em Zedekiah leh Ahab bang mai in TOUPA'N na tung ah hih hen, chih hamse lohna in aneihloh ding uh.
english: A curse will be taken up about them by all the captives of Judah who are in Babylon, saying, ‘Yahweh make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;’

paite: Israel gam ah thil haihuaitak ahih ua, invengte uh zite ang a kawm ua, ka min sial in ka thupiak louh zuauthu agen ziak un; kei atheipa leh atheihpihpa ka hi," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: because they have done foolish things in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbors’ wives, and have spoken words in my name falsely, which I didn’t command them. I am he who knows, and am witness,” says Yahweh.

paite: Nehelam mi, Shemaiah tungtang thu ah nang hichi a na gen ding ahi.
english: Concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite you shall speak, saying,

paite: Israel' Pathian, Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi, Jerusalem mipi tengtengte kiang ah nangmah min mahmah in lai na khak hi.
english: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘Because you have sent letters in your own name to all the people who are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, and to all the priests, saying,

paite: TOUPA'N siampu Jehoiada sik in siampu ding in nang ahon bawl a, TOUPA inkemmi na hi ua, mihai, zawlnei kichi peuhte kemte, sikkolte na butsak ding ahi.
english: “Yahweh has made you priest in the place of Jehoiada the priest, that there may be officers in Yahweh’s house, for every man who is crazy and makes himself a prophet, that you should put him in the stocks and in shackles.

paite: Huchi in bangziak a Anathoth a mi Jeremiah, na kiang ua zawlnei kichi na taihilh louh uh?
english: Now therefore, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth, who makes himself a prophet to you,

paite: Babulon gam ah i kiang uah, "Saltanna ding asawt ding a, inn lam unla, hiai ah teng un, huan bawl unla, agah ne un, chih thu ahon khak hi," chi in.
english: because he has sent to us in Babylon, saying, The captivity is long. Build houses, and dwell in them. Plant gardens, and eat their fruit?”’”

paite: Huan siampu Zephaniah in huai laikhak zawlnei Jeremiah zak in asim hi.
english: Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the hearing of Jeremiah the prophet.

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tungta.
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

paite: Saltangte tengteng kiang ah, Nehelam mi Shemaiah tungtang thu ah TOUPA'N huchi in achi: Ka sawl het louh in Shemaiah in na kiang uah thu agen a, zuauthu nou ahon gingtasak a,
english: “Send to all of the captives, saying, ‘Yahweh says concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: “Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, and I didn’t send him, and he has caused you to trust in a lie,”

paite: huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngai un, Nehelam mi Shemaiah leh asuante ka gawt ding a, hiai mite lak ah mi khat lel leng anei kei ding, ka mite a ding a thil hoih ka hih ding amu kei ding; TOUPA tung ah helna thu agen ziak in, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, chi in khak in achi hi.
english: therefore Yahweh says, “Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his offspring. He will not have a man to dwell among this people. He won’t see the good that I will do to my people,” says Yahweh, “because he has spoken rebellion against Yahweh.”’”

paite: Mi'n zi ma henla, amah a pan paikhia in pasal dang neileh, ama'n aneikik nawn diam? Agam in nitloh hial lou ding hia? chih a-om. Nang bel tangval tampi kiang ah na hukmang in, huchipi in ka kiang ah na hong kik nawn ding maw? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “They say, ‘If a man puts away his wife, and she goes from him, and becomes another man’s, should he return to her again?’ Wouldn’t that land be greatly polluted? But you have played the prostitute with many lovers; yet return again to me,” says Yahweh.

paite: Tang giau viauvuau lam ah na mitte lengtousak inla, en in, ahon kithuahpihlouhna mun koi ah? Gamdai a Arabia mi bang mai in amau ngak in lampi geite ah na tu nilouh sek, na hukna leh na thulimlouhnate in gam na hihnin khinta hi.
english: “Lift up your eyes to the bare heights, and see! Where have you not been lain with? You have sat waiting for them by the road, as an Arabian in the wilderness. You have polluted the land with your prostitution and with your wickedness.

paite: Huaiziak in vuah zuksak ahi kei a, vuah nanung leng azu sam kei; mihuk talpuak in na pua, na zum het kei hi.
english: Therefore the showers have been withheld and there has been no latter rain; yet you have had a prostitute’s forehead and you refused to be ashamed.

paite: Ka pa, ka tuailai a hon pipa na hi, chi in tua kipan in na sam kei ding maw?
english: Will you not from this time cry to me, ‘My Father, you are the guide of my youth!’?

paite: Na heh tawntung ding a hia? Athangpaihna a omden ding ahia? Ngai in, huchibang in na pau ngei a, himahleh agilou theipen in thil na hih hi
english: “‘Will he retain his anger forever? Will he keep it to the end?’ Behold, you have spoken and have done evil things, and have had your way.”

paite: Huai lou leng Josiah vaihawm lai in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi, "Nungkinhat Israel thilhih na mu hia? Tang sang chih a kuantou a, singbawk chih nuaite a ahukna thil ahihte?
english: Moreover, Yahweh said to me in the days of Josiah the king, “Have you seen that which backsliding Israel has done? She has gone up on every high mountain and under every green tree, and has played the prostitute there.

paite: Huan ke'n bel hiai thil tengteng ahih nung in ka kiang ah ahong kik nawn ding, ka chi a; himahleh ahong kik tuan kei; huchi in asanggamnu, khemhat Judah in amu samta hi.
english: I said after she had done all these things, ‘She will return to me;’ but she didn’t return, and her treacherous sister Judah saw it.

paite: Ama'n nungkinhat Israel a-angkawm ziak a ka mak a, makna lai ka piak amuh in leng asanggamnu, khemhat Judah in alau tuan kei, huchih nak sang in ava hoh a, hukna thil ava hihteita hi.
english: I saw when, for this very cause, that backsliding Israel had committed adultery, I had put her away and given her a certificate of divorce, yet treacherous Judah, her sister, had no fear, but she also went and played the prostitute.

paite: Huan ahuk mawkmawk zenhouh ziak in gam ahihnin khinta a; singbul, suangbul kiang ah ang akawmta hi.
english: Because she took her prostitution lightly, the land was polluted, and she committed adultery with stones and with wood.

paite: Huchipi in leng asanggamnu, khemhat Judah lungtangtak a ka kiang a hong kik lou in azuaulel in ahong kik a," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Yet for all this her treacherous sister, Judah, has not returned to me with her whole heart, but only in pretense,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi, "Nungkinhat Israel in asanggamnu, khemhat Judah sang in diktatzaw in akihihlang a.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Backsliding Israel has shown herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.

paite: Kuan inla, hiai thu mallam ah va puang in; Nungkinhat Israel hong kik in," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Heh melpu in ka hon en kei ding a, zahngaitheitak ka hi ngal a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, ka heh tawntung kei ding hi.
english: Go, and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, ‘Return, you backsliding Israel,’ says Yahweh; ‘I will not look in anger on you, for I am merciful,’ says Yahweh. ‘I will not keep anger forever.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian tung a na helnate, singbawk nuai a pau tuam mite kiang a na kiphal gaihnate, ka paukam suak na manlouhnate a na thulimlouhna ah thupha tawi in, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Only acknowledge your iniquity, that you have transgressed against Yahweh your God, and have scattered your ways to the strangers under every green tree, and you have not obeyed my voice,’” says Yahweh.

paite: Aw nungkinhat tate aw, hong kik un, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Nou hon honpa ka hi ngal a, na lak ua kipan khopi a mi khat, inkuan a mi nih ka hon la ding a, Zion ah ka hon pi ding hi.
english: “Return, backsliding children,” says Yahweh, “for I am a husband to you. I will take one of you from a city, and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion.

paite: Ka lung toh kituak belamchingte ka hon pe ding a, amau theihna leh theihsiamnate in noute ahon vak ding uhi.
english: I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.

paite: Huchi in na hong tam ua, gam a na hong pun chiang un, huai ni chiang in amau, TOUPA thukhun bawm, achi ngei nawn kei ding uh; alungsim uah alut kei ding a, theih leng atheigige sam kei ding uh; akhelah nawn kei ding ua, abawl nawn kei ding uh.
english: It will come to pass, when you are multiplied and increased in the land in those days,” says Yahweh, “they will no longer say, ‘the ark of Yahweh’s covenant!’ It will not come to mind. They won’t remember it. They won’t miss it, nor will another be made.

paite: Huai nung in Jerusalem bel TOUPA laltutphah achi ding ua, huai ah nam tengteng TOUPA min in Jerusalem ah ahong paikhawm ding uh; alungtang gilou khauhna uh bang in apaita kei ding uh.
english: At that time they will call Jerusalem ‘Yahweh’s Throne;’ and all the nations will be gathered to it, to Yahweh’s name, to Jerusalem. They will no longer walk after the stubbornness of their evil heart.

paite: Huai ni chiang in Judah inkote Israel inkote toh a-omkhawm ding ua, mallam gam a kipan in, na pipute uh kiang a gouluah ding a ka piak gam ah, ahong pawtkhe ding uh.
english: In those days the house of Judah will walk with the house of Israel, and they will come together out of the land of the north to the land that I gave for an inheritance to your fathers.

paite: Ke'n bel, "Nam chih lak a gouluah ding hoihpen, gam nuamtak hon pia in, tate lak a hon koih ka utdan! Ka pa, chi a na hon sap a, na hon zuihna a kipan na pialmang kei ding, chih ka na um hi.
english: “But I said, ‘How I desire to put you among the children, and give you a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the armies of the nations!’ and I said, ‘You shall call me “My Father”, and shall not turn away from following me.’

paite: Zi khemhat pasal ang kawmsan bang in, Aw Israel inkote aw, hon khem na hita ve ua, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Surely as a wife treacherously departs from her husband, so you have dealt treacherously with me, house of Israel,” says Yahweh.

paite: Tang giau velvul tung ah husa a-om hi, Israel suante kap leh thil ngen husa, TOUPA Pathian amangngilh ua, a-omdan uh ahihgawp ziak un.
english: A voice is heard on the bare heights, the weeping and the petitions of the children of Israel; because they have perverted their way, they have forgotten Yahweh their God.

paite: Anungkin hat tate aw, hong kik unla, na nungkin seknate uh ka hihdam ding hi; en dih, na kiang ah ka hong pai uhi, nang TOUPA ka Pathian uh na hi.
english: Return, you backsliding children, and I will heal your backsliding. “Behold, we have come to you; for you are Yahweh our God.

paite: "Mualte a hotdamna lamet athawn ahi, tang tung a husa chiak vengvungte; Israel hotdamna zaw TOUPA i Pathian kia ah ahi a-om.
english: Truly help from the hills, the tumult on the mountains, is in vain. Truly the salvation of Israel is in Yahweh our God.

paite: Himahleh huai thilkihhuai mahmah in i tuailai a kipan i pipute'n tha asukbeina uh anebeita hi; abelamhonte uh, aganhonte uh, atanute uh, atapate uh tan in.
english: But the shameful thing has devoured the labor of our fathers from our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

paite: Zum in lum ni e, i zahlakna in hon khuh heh; TOUPA i Pathian tung ah thil i hihkhial ua, ei leh i pipute'n i tuailai a kipan tuni tan in TOUPA i Pathian paukam i mang kei uhi."
english: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our confusion cover us; for we have sinned against Yahweh our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even to this day. We have not obeyed Yahweh our God’s voice.”

paite: Jeremiah kiang ah TOUPA a kipan thu ahong tung a;
english: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

paite: TOUPA Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Na kiang a thu ka gen tengteng laibu ah gelh in," chi in.
english: “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Write all the words that I have spoken to you in a book.

paite: Ngai in, Israel leh Judah, ka mite omdan ka kikhelsakna ding nite ahong tung lellel hi; gam, apipute uh kiang a ka piak ah ka pikik nawn ding a, aluahta ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, chi in TOUPA'N achi.
english: For, behold, the days come,’ says Yahweh, ‘that I will reverse the captivity of my people Israel and Judah,’ says Yahweh. ‘I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they will possess it.’”

paite: Huan Judah leh Israel tungtang thu a TOUPA thugen hiaite ahi:
english: These are the words that Yahweh spoke concerning Israel and concerning Judah.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Lauhthawnna husa ka za uh, muanna hilou, launa kikou husa.
english: For Yahweh says: “We have heard a voice of trembling; a voice of fear, and not of peace.

paite: Dong vialvial unla, en vialvial dih ua, pasal in nau avei thei hia? Bangziak a numei nauvei bang zen a, pasalte'n atai uh adep chiat ua, amelte uh ahong molh khit?
english: Ask now, and see whether a man travails with child. Why do I see every man with his hands on his waist, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned pale?

paite: Maizen aw! Huai ni thupi hina mai e, akibatpih mahmah a-om kei, Jakob mangbat ni ahi mah ngut hi, himahleh hotkhiak in a-om ding.
english: Alas, for that day is great, so that none is like it! It is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he will be saved out of it.

paite: Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, ahakkol puak ka hihtan ding a, akhau leng ka kitatsak ding; pau tuam mite'n amah nasempa ding in azang ngei nawn kei ding uh.
english: It will come to pass in that day, says Yahweh of Armies, that I will break his yoke from off your neck, and will burst your bonds. Strangers will no more make them their bondservants;

paite: TOUPA a Pathian uh leh akumpipa uh hi ding a ka tunding ding David nna asem zaw ding uhi.
english: but they will serve Yahweh their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up to them.

paite: Huaiziak in aw ka nasempa Jakob aw, lau het ke'n aw, Israel aw, lunglel het ke'n, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Ngai in, gamlapi a kipan in ka hong hunkhe ding a, asaltanna ua kipan na suante ngei, huan Jakob akik nawn ding a, kuamah in alausak ngei nawn kei ding uh.
english: Therefore don’t be afraid, O Jacob my servant, says Yahweh. Don’t be dismayed, Israel. For, behold, I will save you from afar, and save your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob will return, and will be quiet and at ease. No one will make him afraid.

paite: Nang hon hun ding in na kiang ah ka om gige ngal a, ka hon dalhsakna nam tengteng, ka beisak ding a, nang bel beisak lou in; ahun lel in ka hon gawt ding a, gawt louh in na pawt het kei ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: For I am with you, says Yahweh, to save you; for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have scattered you, but I will not make a full end of you; but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi ngal a, na liamna hihdam theih ahi kei a, na meima athupi hi.
english: For Yahweh says, “Your hurt is incurable. Your wound is grievous.

paite: Nang hon panpih ding a-om kei ua, na damna ding damdawi a-om sam kei hi.
english: There is no one to plead your cause, that you may be bound up. You have no healing medicines.

paite: Nang hon itte'n ahon mangngilhta ua, hon limsakta kei uh; melma liamna in ka hon liamsak a, dawm lou in ka hon gawt hi, na thulimlouhna athupi a, na thilhih giloute apun ziak in.
english: All your lovers have forgotten you. They don’t seek you. For I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins were increased.

paite: Bangziak a na liam ziak a kap na hia? Na liamna hihdam theih ahi kei, na thulimlouhna athupi a, na thilhihkhelhte apun ziak in, hiai thilte na tung a hih ka hi.
english: Why do you cry over your injury? Your pain is incurable. For the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins have increased, I have done these things to you.

paite: Himahleh nang hon negaite, nekgaih in a-om ding ua, na melmate michih, sal dia pi in a-om ding uh, nang hon lokte loh in a-om ding ua, gallak a hon late gallak in ka la ding hi.
english: Therefore all those who devour you will be devoured. All your adversaries, everyone of them, will go into captivity. Those who plunder you will be plunder. I will make all who prey on you become prey.

paite: Ka hon damsak nawn ding a, na liamnate ka hihdam ding; TOUPA thupawt in achi; delhkhiak, ahon chi ua, kuamah limsak louh Zion ahi, ahon chih ziak un.
english: For I will restore health to you, and I will heal you of your wounds,” says Yahweh, “because they have called you an outcast, saying, ‘It is Zion, whom no man seeks after.’”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Ngai in, Jakob puanin saltangte ka lehhei ding a, atenna munte ka zahngaihsak ding a, a-omna mual ngei ah akhopi lam ahi ding a, akumpipa' inn a-omdan ngei in adingh nawn ding.
english: Yahweh says: “Behold, I will reverse the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have compassion on his dwelling places. The city will be built on its own hill, and the palace will be inhabited in its own place.

paite: Kipahthu Genna leh nopsakna husa, huaite a pan ahong pawtkhe ding a, Mite ka pungsak ding a, atawm kei ding uh, amau ka hih thupi ding a, aneu kei ding uh.
english: Thanksgiving will proceed out of them with the voice of those who make merry. I will multiply them, and they will not be few; I will also glorify them, and they will not be small.

paite: Atate uh leng nidanglai bang in a-om ding ua, ka ma ah a-omkhopna uh akip ding a; amaute nuaisiah mite peuhmah ka gawt ding hi.
english: Their children also will be as before, and their congregation will be established before me. I will punish all who oppress them.

paite: Aheutupa uh amau mi mah ahi ding a, avaihawmpa uh amau lak a hong pawt mah ahi ding; ahon naih ding a, amah ka bawl dia, ama'n ahon naih ding; kua ahia amah thu a hon naih ngam ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Their prince will be one of them, and their ruler will proceed from among them. I will cause him to draw near, and he will approach me; for who is he who has had boldness to approach me?” says Yahweh.

paite: Huan ka mite na hi ding ua, kei na Pathian uh ka hi ding."
english: “You shall be my people, and I will be your God.

paite: Ngai un, TOUPA huihpi, ahehna huihpi hat mahmah apawtkheta a; migiloute lu anuai ek ding hi.
english: Behold, Yahweh’s storm, his wrath, has gone out, a sweeping storm; it will burst on the head of the wicked.

paite: Alungtang tupnate tangtun a ahih khit masiah, TOUPA hehna lauhuai mahmah akikhel kei ding; ni nanungte ah na hon theisiam ding uhi.
