english: The fierce anger of Yahweh will not return until he has accomplished, and until he has performed the intentions of his heart. In the latter days you will understand it.”

paite: "Huai hun chiang in kei Israel inkuante Pathian ka hi ding a, amaute leng ka mite ahi ding uh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “At that time,” says Yahweh, “I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be my people.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Namsau thah valte, gamdai gam a ka khawl tawldamsak lai in hehpihna amu ua, Israel mahmah ka tawldamsak lai in.
english: Yahweh says, “The people who survive the sword found favor in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.”

paite: Nidang a ka kiang a TOUPA hong kilang in, hichi in achi: Ahi, it tawp lou in ka hon it a, huaiziak in lainatna in ka hon kai hi.
english: Yahweh appeared of old to me, saying, “Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love. Therefore I have drawn you with loving kindness.

paite: K'on dingh thaksak ding, nungak siangthou Israel aw, dingh in kipsak na hong hi ding a, na khuangte toh kizem in na om nawn ding a, nopsak lai lamna munte ah na tel ding hi.
english: I will build you again, and you will be built, O virgin of Israel. You will again be adorned with your tambourines, and will go out in the dances of those who make merry.

paite: Samaria tang dung tawn in grephuante na bawl ding a, teng mite'n aching ding ua, agahte ane ding uhi.
english: Again you will plant vineyards on the mountains of Samaria. The planters will plant, and will enjoy its fruit.

paite: Ephraim tanggamte ah, ching mite kikou ni atung ding hi. Thou un, Zion ah i hoh ding uh, TOUPA i Pathian uh kiang ah," chi in.
english: For there will be a day that the watchmen on the hills of Ephraim cry, ‘Arise! Let’s go up to Zion to Yahweh our God.’”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Jakob a ding in nuam in la sa unla, nam thupipen a ding in kikoukhia un, puang unla, pahtawi unla, "TOUPA Israel khosuaksun, na mite hondam in,' chi un.
english: For Yahweh says, “Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout for the chief of the nations. Publish, praise, and say, ‘Yahweh, save your people, the remnant of Israel!’

paite: Ngai un, mal gam a kipan ka hon pi ding, kawlmong tawp a kipan ka kaikhawm ding, mittaw, khebai, numei naupaite, nauvei lelte toh, mipi tampitak ahong tungkhawm ding uh.
english: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the uttermost parts of the earth, along with the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her who travails with child together. They will return as a great company.

paite: Khitui toh ahong pai ding ua, khamuangtak in ka pi ding, tui luang lamte ah ka vaksak ding a, akisuihlouhna ding uh lamtangte ah; Israel a ding in pa ka hi a, Ephraim bel ka tachil ahi.
english: They will come with weeping. I will lead them with petitions. I will cause them to walk by rivers of waters, in a straight way in which they won’t stumble; for I am a father to Israel. Ephraim is my firstborn.

paite: Aw namte aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia unla, tui gei gam gamlapi ah puang unla, Israel dalhsakpa'n apikhawm nawn ding a, Belamchingpa'n abelamte akep bang in akem ding chi in.
english: “Hear Yahweh’s word, you nations, and declare it in the distant islands. Say, ‘He who scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd does his flock.’

paite: Jakob bel TOUPA'N atankhia a, asang a hat a pan ahunkheta hi.
english: For Yahweh has ransomed Jacob, and redeemed him from the hand of him who was stronger than he.

paite: Zion vum ah lasa in ahong pai ding ua, TOUPA hoihna ah akipak ding ua, buhte, uainte, thaute, belam leh ganhon noute tungte ah akipak ding uh; ahinna uh tui avak huan bang ahi ding a, tangtawn in alungkham nawn kei ding uh.
english: They will come and sing in the height of Zion, and will flow to the goodness of Yahweh, to the grain, to the new wine, to the oil, and to the young of the flock and of the herd. Their soul will be as a watered garden. They will not sorrow any more at all.

paite: Huan nungak siangthoute kipak a lam in anuam ding ua, tangvalte leng atek-akhang in anuam ding ua, alusuunna uh kipahna ka suaksak in ka khamuan ding, adahna ua pan ka kipaksak ding.
english: Then the virgin will rejoice in the dance, the young men and the old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.

paite: Siampute hinna thau in ka taisak ding a, ka hoihna in ka mite leng atai ding uh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people will be satisfied with my goodness,” says Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ramah ah husa aza ua, misi ngai a kap huphup, Rakil in atate akah a, atate a-om nawn louh ziak in akhamuan theih kei hi.
english: Yahweh says: “A voice is heard in Ramah, lamentation and bitter weeping, Rachel weeping for her children. She refuses to be comforted for her children, because they are no more.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Kap lou ding in na aw dek inla, na khitui hul hen, na thilhih in kipahman anei ding chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Gal gam a kipan in ahong pai nawn ding uhi.
english: Yahweh says: “Refrain your voice from weeping, and your eyes from tears, for your work will be rewarded,” says Yahweh. “They will come again from the land of the enemy.

paite: Na hun tawp lam a ding in lametna a-om a, amau gam ah na tate ahong kik nawn ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: There is hope for your latter end,” says Yahweh. “Your children will come again to their own territory.

paite: Ephraim kah leh mauna ka za hi, nang na hon gawt a, bawngtaltuai sawi bang mai in sawi ka hi a, na kiang ah hon kiksak inla, ka kik ding hi, TOUPA ka Pathian na hi ngal a.
english: “I have surely heard Ephraim grieving thus, ‘You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as an untrained calf. Turn me, and I will be turned, for you are Yahweh my God.

paite: N'on kiksak khit nung in ka kisika, na hon thuzoh nung in ka pheipi ka beng a, ka zum a, ahi, ka tuailai minsiat thuak in ka am ahai hi,” achi hi.
english: Surely after that I was turned. I repented. After that I was instructed. I struck my thigh. I was ashamed, yes, even confounded, because I bore the reproach of my youth.’

paite: Ephraim, ka tapa deihtak, ka nau deihtak ahih ziak hia amah ka thunun teng a ka lungtang a aten tinten nak? Huchi in ka lungtang in amah alainat sek a, atung ah zah ka ngai ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Is Ephraim my dear son? Is he a darling child? For as often as I speak against him, I still earnestly remember him. Therefore my heart yearns for him. I will surely have mercy on him,” says Yahweh.

paite: Lampi chiamtehna kibawl inla, nang a ding in lampi kawkmuhna phut in, na va pawtna lam lampi, lampi pen lam ngei chiamteh tinten in; aw nungak siangthou Israel, hong kik nawn in, na khopi ngei ah.
english: “Set up road signs. Make guideposts. Set your heart toward the highway, even the way by which you went. Turn again, virgin of Israel. Turn again to these your cities.

paite: Aw, nang tanu nungtawn, bang tan ahia na vialvak vak ding? TOUPA'N lei ah thil thak asiamta a, numei in pasal ahum zawta hi.
english: How long will you go here and there, you backsliding daughter? For Yahweh has created a new thing on the earth: a woman will encompass a man.”

paite: Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Asaltanna ua kipan ka pikik hun chiang in Judah gam leh akhopite ah hichibang paukam azang nawn ding uh; "Aw, diktatna tenna mun, Aw tang siangthou, TOUPA'N hon vualzawl hen," chih.
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Yet again they will use this speech in the land of Judah and in its cities, when I reverse their captivity: ‘Yahweh bless you, habitation of righteousness, mountain of holiness.’

paite: Huai ah Judahte leh akhopi uah mi tengteng atengkhawm ding ua, lounei mite leh ganvul mite toh.
english: Judah and all its cities will dwell therein together, the farmers, and those who go about with flocks.

paite: Mibahte ka taisakta a, milungkham peuhmahte leng ka hihhalhta hi.
english: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.”

paite: Huchi in ka hong halh a, ka nga vialvial a, mang hoihtak ana hi.
english: On this I awakened, and saw; and my sleep was sweet to me.

paite: Ngai dih, nite ahong tung ding hi, Israel inkote leh Judah inkote ah mihing chi leh gan chi ka tuh ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man and with the seed of animal.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, amau botkhia a, hihzan leh paikhia a, hihmang a, hihgim ding a ka tan bang in amau ding hoihsak ding leh tungding ding in ka enkhe nawn ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: It will happen that, like as I have watched over them to pluck up and to break down and to overthrow and to destroy and to afflict, so I will watch over them to build and to plant,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huai nite in, "Pate'n grep thuk ane ua, atate uh ha azau a, achi nawn ngei kei ding uh."
english: “In those days they will say no more, “‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.’

paite: Michih in amau gitlouhna asihpih zaw ding ua, grep thuk ne peuhmah ha azau ding hi.
english: But everyone will die for his own iniquity. Every man who eats the sour grapes, his teeth will be set on edge.

paite: Ngai dih, nite ahong tung ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; huai nite ah Israel inkote leh Judah inkote kiang ah thukhun thak ka bawl ding.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah,

paite: Apipute uh Aigupta gam a kipan a pikhe ding a akhut uh ka let ni a ka thukhun bang hilou in, amaute a dia apasal uh ka hih in leng ka thukhun abohsia ua, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt, which covenant of mine they broke, although I was a husband to them,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huai ni khit chiang a Israel inkote kiang a ka thukhun ding bel hiai ahi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; asunggil uah ka dan ka koih ding a, alungtang uah ka gelh lai ding a, kei a Pathian uh ka hi ding a, amau ka mite ahi ding uh;
english: “But this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says Yahweh: “I will put my law in their inward parts, and I will write it in their heart. I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

paite: Kuamah in, "TOUPA thei in, chi in amau invengte leh amau unau ahilh kei ding ua; aneupen a kipan in alianpen tan in avek un ahon thei chiat ding uh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, "Abohsiatna uh ka ngaidam ding a, akhelhna uh leng ka theigige kei ding," chi in.
english: They will no longer each teach his neighbor, and every man teach his brother, saying, ‘Know Yahweh;’ for they will all know me, from their least to their greatest,” says Yahweh, “for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.”

paite: Hichi in TOUPA, sun vaksak ding a ni pepa, kha leh aksite a dia dante sehsak a, zan vaksak ding a pepa, tuikihotte ging honhon ding a tuipi tokthoupa'n achi hi; amin sepaihte' TOUPA ahi.
english: Yahweh, who gives the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, who stirs up the sea, so that its waves roar— Yahweh of Armies is his name, says:

paite: "Hiai dansehte ka ma a kipan amanleh Israel suante ka ma a kipan in nam hih atawp den sam ding uh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “If these ordinances depart from before me,” says Yahweh, “then the offspring of Israel also will cease from being a nation before me forever.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Tunglam van teh theih ahih a, lei kingaknate zonkhiak theih ahihleh Israel suante athilhihsate uh ziak in ka paimang sam ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Yahweh says: “If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, then I will also cast off all the offspring of Israel for all that they have done,” says Yahweh.

paite: "Ngai in, nite ahong tung lellel hi, Hananel insung a kipan in kulh ning kongpi tan in TOUPA a ding in khopi lamkhiak ahi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that the city will be built to Yahweh from the tower of Hananel to the gate of the corner.

paite: Atehna khau bel Gareb mual tan in tangtak in apai zinzen ding a, Goath lam ah akawi ding hi.
english: The measuring line will go out further straight onward to the hill Gareb, and will turn toward Goah.

paite: Misi luang leh vut paihna phaizang pumpi leh gamlak tengteng, Kidron lui phaizang tan in, suahlam pang Sakol Kongpi ning tan TOUPA ding a tan ding ahi; huai tuh chikchiang mah a hihzak leh phelsiat ahi nawn kei ding hi."
english: The whole valley of the dead bodies and of the ashes, and all the fields to the brook Kidron, to the corner of the horse gate toward the east, will be holy to Yahweh. It will not be plucked up or thrown down any more forever.”

paite: Judah Kumpipa Zedekiah akum sawmna, huai tuh Nebukadnezzar akum sawm-le-giatna ahi, Jeremiah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung.
english: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.

paite: Huai in Babulon kumpipa sepaihhon in Jerusalem a-um ua; huan Judah kumpipa' inn ngakmi huangsung ah zawlnei Jeremiah atang hi.
english: Now at that time the king of Babylon’s army was besieging Jerusalem. Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the guard, which was in the king of Judah’s house.

paite: Judah kumpipa Zedekiah in, "Bangdia, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Ngai in, hiai khopi Babulon kumpipa khut ah ka pe ding a ala ding;
english: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, “Why do you prophesy, and say, ‘Yahweh says, “Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will take it;

paite: Judah kumpipa Zedekiah leng Kaldai mite khut a kipan apawt kei ding, Babulon kumpipa khut a matsak in a-om zaw ding a, kimaituah in akihoupih ding ua, amit ngei in amel amu ding;
english: and Zedekiah king of Judah won’t escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but will surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and will speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes will see his eyes;

paite: Zedekiah bel Babulon gam ah api ding a, amah ka veh mateng huai ah a-om nilouh ding; Kaldaite dou mah le uchin na lohching kei ding uh?" " chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: and he will bring Zedekiah to Babylon, and he will be there until I visit him,” says Yahweh, “though you fight with the Chaldeans, you will not prosper”’?”

paite: Huan Jeremiah in, ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
english: Jeremiah said, “Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: Ngai in, na paneu Shallum tapa Hanamel in Anathoth a ka lou nang a ding in lei in, "Gouluah thei na hih ziak in na hon leisak ding ahi chi in na kiang ah ahong pai ding," chi in.
english: ‘Behold, Hanamel the son of Shallum your uncle will come to you, saying, “Buy my field that is in Anathoth; for the right of redemption is yours to buy it.”’”

paite: Huchi in ka paneu tapa Hanamel in, "Anathoth a ka lou hon leisak tanla, gouluah thei na hih ziak in na tat ding ahi, nang a ding in lei mai in," achi a. Huchi in hiai TOUPA thu ahi chih ka theita hi.
english: “So Hanamel my uncle’s son came to me in the court of the guard according to Yahweh’s word, and said to me, ‘Please buy my field that is in Anathoth, which is in the land of Benjamin; for the right of inheritance is yours, and the redemption is yours. Buy it for yourself.’ “Then I knew that this was Yahweh’s word.

paite: Huan ka paneu tapa Hanamel Anathoth a lou ka leita a, dangka ka buksak a, adangkasik shekel sawmsagih tak ahi.
english: I bought the field that was in Anathoth of Hanamel my uncle’s son, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.

paite: Huchi in lai ka gelh a, ka hilh a, theihpihmi ka sam a, dangka pen bukna ah ka khai a.
english: I signed the deed, sealed it, called witnesses, and weighed the money in the balances to him.

paite: Kileina lai akileidan leh a-omdan gelhna bilh leh bilhlouhte ka la a.
english: So I took the deed of the purchase, both that which was sealed, containing the terms and conditions, and that which was open;

paite: Huan ka paneu tapa Hanamel mitmuh in leh theihpihmi kileina amin tuang teite mitmuh in leh ngakmi huangsung a Juda tute tengteng ma ah Mahseiah tapa Neriah tapa Baruk ka pia hi.
english: and I delivered the deed of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, in the presence of Hanamel my uncle’s son, and in the presence of the witnesses who signed the deed of the purchase, before all the Jews who sat in the court of the guard.

paite: Baruk bel ama uah thu ka pia a, Israel' Pathian sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: “I commanded Baruch before them, saying,

paite: "Hiai lai, kileina lai, bilhlouhte la inla, a-om sawttheihna ding in leibel ah koih in.
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Take these deeds, this deed of the purchase which is sealed, and this deed which is open, and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may last many days.’

paite: Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi ngal a; hiai gam ah innte, loute, grephuante mite'n ahon lei nawn ding uh," chi in.
english: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: ‘Houses and fields and vineyards will yet again be bought in this land.’

paite: Huan Neriah tapa Baruk kiang ah aleina lai ka piak nung in TOUPA kiang ah ka thum hi.
english: Now after I had delivered the deed of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed to Yahweh, saying,

paite: Aw Toupa PATHIAN, ngai in, na thilhihtheihna thupi leh na khut zak in lei leh van na bawl a; nang a ding in thilhih haksa lua a-om het kei hi.
english: “Ah Lord Yahweh! Behold, you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm. There is nothing too hard for you.

paite: Sang tampite kiang ah hehpihna na musak sek a, pate thulimlouhna anung ua atate uh tung ah na thuk a; aw Pathian thupi leh thilhihthei; amin sepaihte' TOUPA ahi;
english: You show loving kindness to thousands, and repay the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them. The great, the mighty God, Yahweh of Armies is your name:

paite: thilgel siamtak, thilhihtheitak, mihing tate omdan tengteng muchianpa;
english: great in counsel, and mighty in work; whose eyes are open to all the ways of the children of men, to give everyone according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings;

paite: michih a-omdan uleh athilhih uh bang a thukpa; Aigupta gam a chiamtehnate leh thillamdang hihpa, tuni tan a Israel leh midang lak a hih zelpa, tuni bang mahmah a min kibawlpa.
english: who performed signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even to this day, both in Israel and among other men; and made yourself a name, as it is today;

paite: Na mi Israelte, Aigupta gam a kipan chiamtehnate, thillamdangte, khut hat leh ban zak leh thil mulkimhuai thupitak in na pikhia hi.
english: and brought your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, with wonders, with a strong hand, with an outstretched arm, and with great terror;

paite: Hiai khuaizu leh nawitui a luang gam apipute uh kiang a kichiam a piak na chiam na peta a;
english: and gave them this land, which you swore to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey.

paite: ahong lut ua, aluah vek ua, himahleh na paukam taksang lou in, na dan azui kei uh; hih ding a na piakte ahih kei ua, huaiziak in hiai thil hoih lou tengteng atung uah na tungsak hi.
english: They came in and possessed it, but they didn’t obey your voice and didn’t walk in your law. They have done nothing of all that you commanded them to do. Therefore you have caused all this evil to come upon them.

paite: En dih, khopi lakna ding a panmun leivupte ahong omta ve; namsaute, kialte, hipite ziak in khopi leng asimmi Kaldaite khut ah piak ahita; na gensa ahong tungta; en dih, na muta hi.
english: “Behold, siege ramps have been built against the city to take it. The city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans who fight against it, because of the sword, of the famine, and of the pestilence. What you have spoken has happened. Behold, you see it.

paite: Ahi a lah, Aw Toupa PATHIAN, nang ka kiang ah, "Na sum in lou lei inla, thu thei mite sam in; khopi bel Kaldaite khut a piak ahita, na chi," achi hi.
english: You have said to me, Lord Yahweh, ‘Buy the field for money, and call witnesses;’ whereas the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.”

paite: Huan TOUPA thu Jeremiah kiang ah ahong tung hi:
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

paite: "Ngai in, kei TOUPA sa nei tengteng Pathian ka hi, kei a ding in haksa lua a-om a hia? chi in.
english: “Behold, I am Yahweh, the God of all flesh. Is there anything too hard for me?

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngai in hiai khopi Kaldaite khut ah leh Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar khut ah ka pe ding a, ala ding hi.
english: Therefore Yahweh says: Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will take it.

paite: Huchi in hiai khopi simmi Kaldaite ahong pai ding ua, hiai khopi ahal ding ua, akang ding, hon hehsak ding a Baal kiang a gimlim latna, pathian dangte kiang a dawn ding lat butkhiakna inn tung nei inn tengteng toh.
english: The Chaldeans, who fight against this city, will come and set this city on fire, and burn it with the houses on whose roofs they have offered incense to Baal, and poured out drink offerings to other gods, to provoke me to anger.

paite: Israel suante leh Judah tate'n atuailai chik ua kipan in ka mitmuh in thil hoih lou ngen ahih uh; Israel suante'n akhut nasepte un ahon hehsak phet uhi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have done only that which was evil in my sight from their youth; for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, says Yahweh.

paite: Hiai a khopi alam tung ua kipan tutan in hon hehsaktu leh hon thangpaisaktu ahi nilouh ngal a; ka ma a kipan ka hihman vengveng theihna ding in; Israel suante leh Judah tate hon hehsak ding a athil hoih lou hihsate tengteng uh ziak in,
english: For this city has been to me a provocation of my anger and of my wrath from the day that they built it even to this day, so that I should remove it from before my face,

paite: amau, akumpipate uh, aheutute uh, asiampute uh, azawlneite uh, Judah mite Jerusalem luah mite tengteng toh.
english: because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger—they, their kings, their princes, their priests, their prophets, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

paite: Kei lam hong nga lou in adeksah uh ahon ngat ua, tawlnga lou hial in sinsakta mah leng, sinsakna lasawn ding in angeingaih kei uhi.
english: They have turned their backs to me, and not their faces. Although I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not listened to receive instruction.

paite: Ka min tuanna inn hihthanghuai ding in akihhuainate uh akoih zaw uhi.
english: But they set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

paite: Ben Hinnom Phaizang a Baal biakna mun sangte alamkhia ua, atanute uh, atapate uh Molek kiang a mei a apaihna ding un, Judahte thil gilou hihsak ding a hiai kihhuai ahih uh ka thupiak ahi het kei hi, ka lungsim ah leng alut ngei kei hi.
english: They built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through fire to Molech, which I didn’t command them. It didn’t even come into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.”

paite: "Huaiziak in tu in zaw TOUPA Israel' Pathian in, 'Hiai khopi, namsau, kial leh hipi in Babulon kumpipa khut ah piak ahita, na chih nak uh thu ah hichi in achi':
english: Now therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says concerning this city, about which you say, “It is given into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:”

paite: Ngai dih, ka hehna, ka lung hihlouhna, ka thangpaihna thupi mahmahte a amau ka delh manna gam teng a kipan ka pikhawm ding a, hiai mun ka hon tun ding a, bittak in ka omsakta ding.
english: “Behold, I will gather them out of all the countries where I have driven them in my anger, and in my wrath, and in great indignation; and I will bring them again to this place. I will cause them to dwell safely.

paite: Huchi in ka mite ahi ding ua, kei amaute Pathian ka hi ding.
english: Then they will be my people, and I will be their God.

paite: Tangtawn a ahon lauhdet theihna ding un lungtang kibang leh omdan kibang ka bawlsak ding; amau leh anung ua atate uh hoihna ding in.
english: I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear me forever, for their good and the good of their children after them.

paite: Akiang uah tangtawn thukhun ka bawl ding a, amau lehngatsan lou in, ahon launa ka hih gige ding; ahon kiheisanlouhna ding un alungtangte uah ahon lauhna uh ka koih ding.
english: I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from following them, to do them good. I will put my fear in their hearts, that they may not depart from me.

paite: Ahi, ahoihna uh hih ka kipah lam ahi ding a, ka lungtang tengteng in hiai gam ah ka phut ngeingei ding.
english: Yes, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.”

paite: "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Hiai mite tung a thil hoih lou thupi mahmah ka tut bangtak in amaute kiang a thil hoih ka chiam tengtengte ka tungsak ngeingei ding.
english: For Yahweh says: “Just as I have brought all this great evil on this people, so I will bring on them all the good that I have promised them.

paite: Gam kisegawp, Kaldaite khut a piaksa, mi leh sa om nawn lou, na chih gam uah loute akilei nawn ding uhi.
english: Fields will be bought in this land, about which you say, ‘It is desolate, without man or animal. It is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.’

paite: Benjamin gamte ah, Jerusalem khopi kim munte ah, Judah gam khopite leh simlam khopite ah mite'n dangka in lou alei ding ua, leina lai agelh ding ua, abilh ding ua, theihpih mite asam ding uhi; a-omdan uh ka hei ding hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi."
english: Men will buy fields for money, sign the deeds, seal them, and call witnesses, in the land of Benjamin, and in the places around Jerusalem, in the cities of Judah, in the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, and in the cities of the South; for I will cause their captivity to be reversed,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huan Jeremiah kiang ah, vengmi huangsung a khum a a-om lai in, anihveina ding in TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn hi.
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah the second time, while he was still locked up in the court of the guard, saying,

paite: Lei bawlpa TOUPA, kip ding a bawlpa TOUPA'N, amin TOUPA ahi, chi in achi:
english: “Yahweh who does it, Yahweh who forms it to establish it—Yahweh is his name, says:

paite: Hon sam lechin, ka hon dawng ding a, thil thupi leh thil kisel na theih ngei louh ka hon ensak ding.
english: ‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’

paite: Israel' Pathian TOUPA'N hiai khopi innte leh Judah kumpipa' inn te, namsau leh leivupte lak a venna bawl ding a aphelsiat uh tungtang thu ah hichi in achi:
english: For Yahweh, the God of Israel, says concerning the houses of this city and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are broken down to make a defense against the mounds and against the sword:

paite: Kaldaite sual ding in amau ahong kuan ua, ka hehna leh thangpaihna a ka thah luangte in adimsak zaw ding uh, agitlouhna tengteng ziak un hiai khopi lak ah ka mel ka na sel hi.
english: ‘While men come to fight with the Chaldeans, and to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have killed in my anger and in my wrath, and for all whose wickedness I have hidden my face from this city,

paite: Ngai in, damna leh hihdamna ka hon tun ding a, ka hon damsak ding; muanna leh bitna kiptak ka hon musak ding.
english: behold, I will bring it health and healing, and I will cure them; and I will reveal to them abundance of peace and truth.

paite: Judah omdan leh Israel omdan ka hei ding a, atung a ka dinsak bang in ka dingsak nawn ding.
english: I will restore the fortunes of Judah and Israel, and will build them as at the first.

paite: Huan athulimlouhna uh, ka tung a athilhihkhelhna lak ua kipan ka sawpsiang ding a, athulimlouhna uh, ka tung a athilhihkhelhna uleh ka tung a atatleknate tengteng uh ka ngaidam ding.
english: I will cleanse them from all their iniquity by which they have sinned against me. I will pardon all their iniquities by which they have sinned against me and by which they have transgressed against me.

paite: Huchi in hiai khopi lei a nam tengteng, amau a dia ka hihhoih tengteng mu mite ma ah kei a ding in nopna, pahtawina leh thupina ahi ding a; hoihna muanna atung ua ka tut tengteng ziak in lau in aling ding uhi.
english: This city will be to me for a name of joy, for praise, and for glory, before all the nations of the earth, which will hear all the good that I do to them, and will fear and tremble for all the good and for all the peace that I provide to it.’”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Hiai mun, Judah khopi a mi leh sa om nawn lou a loihsa, Jerusalem kholak a mi leh sa leh tengmi om lou a loihsa, achih uah:
english: Yahweh says: “Yet again there will be heard in this place, about which you say, ‘It is waste, without man and without animal, even in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man and without inhabitant and without animal,’

paite: "Sepaihte' TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu gen un. TOUPA lah ahoih ngal a; azahngaihna lah tangtawn in a-om ding hi, chi mite aw leh TOUPA' inn a kipahna kithoihna hon tawi lasa mite aw leh mou awte mouneipa awte ahon za nawn ding uh, atung a a-om bang in gam ka omsak ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those who say, ‘Give thanks to Yahweh of Armies, for Yahweh is good, for his loving kindness endures forever;’ who bring thanksgiving into Yahweh’s house. For I will cause the captivity of the land to be reversed as at the first,” says Yahweh.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Hiai mun, mi leh sa om lou khop a loihsa leh akhopi tengteng ah, belamchingmi abelamhon uh kualsak mite tenna mun ahong om nawn ding.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Yet again there will be in this place, which is waste, without man and without animal, and in all its cities, a habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.

paite: Tanggam khopi ah, phaigam khopi ah, simlam khopi ah, Benjamin gam ah, Jerusalem kim munte ah, Judah khopi ah, amau simmi khut nuai ah belamte apai zungzung ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: In the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, in the cities of the South, in the land of Benjamin, in the places around Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, the flocks will again pass under the hands of him who counts them,” says Yahweh.

paite: Ngai in, nite ahong tung lellel hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, Israel inkote tungtang ah leh Judah inkote tungtang a thuhoihtak ka na gen pen ka tangtungsak ding.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will perform that good word which I have spoken concerning the house of Israel and concerning the house of Judah.

paite: Huai nite leh huai hun chiang in diktatna Hiang David kiang ah ka khangkhesak ding, huai gam ah diktak leh diktattak in vai ahawm ding.
english: “In those days and at that time, I will cause a Branch of righteousness to grow up to David. He will execute justice and righteousness in the land.

paite: Huai nite in Judah humbit in a-om ding, Jerusalem bittak in a-om ding; huan, amin put ding hiai ahi ding, "TOUPA i diktatna," chih.
english: In those days Judah will be saved, and Jerusalem will dwell safely. This is the name by which she will be called: Yahweh our righteousness.”

paite: Toupa'n hichi in achi: David in Israel inkote laltutphah a tu ding mi atasam ngei kei ding;
english: For Yahweh says: “David will never lack a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel.

paite: Siampu Levi chite'n leng ka ma a halmang na lan ding leh buh-le-bal thil lan ding leh kithoih zel ding in mi atasam sam kei ding.
english: The Levitical priests won’t lack a man before me to offer burnt offerings, to burn meal offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.”

paite: Huan TOUPA thu Jeremiah kiang ah ahong tung a, TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

paite: Ka sun seh leh ka zan seh thu na phel theih ua, sun leh zan ahuntak ua om lou ding a na hihtheih uleh,
english: “Yahweh says: ‘If you can break my covenant of the day and my covenant of the night, so that there will not be day and night in their time,

paite: ka nasempa David kiang a ka thukhun leng alaltutphah a tu ding tapa aneihlouhna ding a hihsiat ahi phet ding hi; Levi chite, siampute, ka nasem mite kiang ah leng.
english: then my covenant could also be broken with David my servant, that he won’t have a son to reign on his throne; and with the Levitical priests, my ministers.

paite: Van a omte sim seng louh leh tuipi a piaunel sim seng louh bang mai in ka nasempa David suan leh Levi chi kei na hon sepsak mite ka pungsak ding.
english: As the army of the sky can’t be counted, and the sand of the sea can’t be measured, so I will multiply the offspring of David my servant and the Levites who minister to me.’”

paite: TOUPA thu Jeremiah kiang ah ahong tung a:
english: Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

paite: "Inkuan nih TOUPA'N atelte apaimangta," chi a hiai mite'n agen uh na ngaihtuah ngei kei a hia? Amitmuh ua nam chih tham ahihlouhna ding un hichibang in ka mite amusit uhi.
english: “Don’t consider what this people has spoken, saying, ‘Has Yahweh cast off the two families which he chose?’ Thus they despise my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ka sun leh zan thuseh a-omdet louh a, lei leh van omdante ka seh louh ahihleh,
english: Yahweh says: “If my covenant of day and night fails, if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth,

paite: Jakob suante leh ka nasempa David suante ka paimang ding, Abraham, Isak leh Jakob suante tung ah vaihawmmi asuan a kipan ka la kei ding; a-omdante uh ka kiheisak in atung uah zahngaihna nei ding ka hi ngal a.
english: then I will also cast away the offspring of Jacob, and of David my servant, so that I will not take of his offspring to be rulers over the offspring of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; for I will cause their captivity to be reversed and will have mercy on them.”

paite: Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzarte, asepaihhon tengteng, amah thunuai a lei a vaihawmna gam tengteng leh mipi tengteng in Jerusalem leh akhopi tengteng asual lai ua TOUPA kiang a kipan a Jeremiah kiang a thu hong tung:
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, with all his army, all the kingdoms of the earth that were under his dominion, and all the peoples, were fighting against Jerusalem and against all its cities, saying:

paite: Israel' Pathian, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Judah kumpipa Zedekiah va houpih in, hichi in achi: Ngai in, hiai khopi Babulon kumpipa khut ah ka pe ding a, mei in ahal ding;
english: “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Go, and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and tell him, Yahweh says, “Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon and he will burn it with fire.

paite: akhut a kipan na suakta het kei ding; mat na hi ding a, akhut ah ahon pe ding ua, na mit ngei in Babulon kumpipa na mu ding a, paukam ngei in na kihoupih ding ua, Babulon gam ah na hoh ding hi.
english: You won’t escape out of his hand, but will surely be taken and delivered into his hand. Your eyes will see the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he will speak with you mouth to mouth. You will go to Babylon.”’

paite: Himahleh, aw Judah kumpipa, Zedekiah, TOUPA thu ngaikhe zel dih; na tungtang thu ah TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: “Yet hear Yahweh’s word, O Zedekiah king of Judah. Yahweh says concerning you, ‘You won’t die by the sword.

paite: Namsau in na si kei ding a, muangtak in ahi na sih ding; na ma a kumpipa masa, na pipute gimlim ahalsak bang un, nang leng ahon halsak ding uh; ahon suun ding ua, "Ehe heh, ka pu," chi in. Thu ka khahta hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, chi in.
english: You will die in peace; and with the burnings of your fathers, the former kings who were before you, so they will make a burning for you. They will lament you, saying, “Ah Lord!” for I have spoken the word,’ says Yahweh.”

paite: Zawlnei Jeremiah in hiai thu tengteng Jerusalem a Judah kumpipa Zedekiah kiang ah agen a;
english: Then Jeremiah the prophet spoke all these words to Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,

paite: Babulon kumpipa sepaihhonte'n Jerusalem leh Judah khopi om lai tengteng, Lakish leh Azekah asual lai un; Judah khopi lak a kulh neite hiaite kia ahita uhi.
english: when the king of Babylon’s army was fighting against Jerusalem and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish and against Azekah; for these alone remained of the cities of Judah as fortified cities.

paite: Kumpipa Zedekiah in Jerusalem a om mipi tengteng kiang ah, michih in asikhanu toh asikhapate uh, Hebru nu hiam Hebru pa hiam ahih uleh, akhah ding uh ahi;
english: The word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, after King Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people who were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty to them,

paite: Michih in Hebru pasal hiam numei hiam sal a aneih peuhmah asuahtaksak ding ahi, kuamah in ama Juda sanggampih sal a aneihlouhna ding in.
english: that every man should let his male servant, and every man his female servant, who is a Hebrew or a Hebrewess, go free, that no one should make bondservants of them, of a Jew his brother.

paite: Michih in nasemnu hiam nasempa hiam akhah ding ahi, amau nna sepsak in kuamah a-om ding uh ahi kei, chih thukhun pommi heutu tengteng leh mipi tengteng in thukhun amang ua, akhahta uhi.
english: All the princes and all the people obeyed who had entered into the covenant, that everyone should let his male servant and everyone his female servant go free, that no one should make bondservants of them any more. They obeyed and let them go,

paite: Himahleh huai nung in akihei ua, anasemnu uh leh anasempa uh akhahsate uh akaikik ua, athunuai uah nasemmi ding in akoih nawn uh.
english: but afterwards they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids whom they had let go free to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.

paite: Huaiziak in Jeremiah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn a, TOUPA Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi:
english: Therefore Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

paite: Aigupta gam, saltanna inn a kipan ka pikhiak ni in na pipute uh kiang ah thukhun ka bawl a,
english: “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says: ‘I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage, saying:

paite: michih in a-unaupa, Hebru mi, akiang a zuaksa, kum guk a na nasemsa, akum sagihna tawp in akhah ding ahi, chi in; na pipute un bel ahon ngaikhe kei ua, abil uh adoh sam kei uh.
english: At the end of seven years, every man of you shall release his brother who is a Hebrew, who has been sold to you, and has served you six years. You shall let him go free from you. But your fathers didn’t listen to me, and didn’t incline their ear.

paite: Tu in noute'n, na hong kihei ua, michih in a-invengpa kiang a noplenna thu puang in ka mitmuh in thil dik na hon hihta ua; ka min tam inn ah ka ma ah thukhun na hong kibawlta ua;
english: You had now turned, and had done that which is right in my eyes, in every man proclaiming liberty to his neighbor. You had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name;

paite: himahleh na kihei nawn ua, ka min na hihbuah un a-ut bangtak ua na khahsa nung uh, na sikhanu leh na sikhapa uh na pikik nawn ua, na thunuai uah nasemmi ding bang sikhanute ding bang in na koih nawn uh.
english: but you turned and profaned my name, and every man caused his servant and every man his handmaid, whom you had let go free at their pleasure, to return. You brought them into subjection, to be to you for servants and for handmaids.’”

paite: "Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Michih ama unau leh ama invengte kiang a noplenna thu puang ding in ka thu na ngaikhe kei ua; ngai un, ke'n na kiang uah noplenna thu ka puang hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; namsaute, hipite, kialte in ahi ding; lei a kumpigamte tengteng lak a paihkhiak ding in ka hon bawl ding hi.
english: Therefore Yahweh says: “You have not listened to me, to proclaim liberty, every man to his brother, and every man to his neighbor. Behold, I proclaim to you a liberty,” says Yahweh, “to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine. I will make you be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.

paite: Huan ka thukhun bohsete, ka ma a bawngnou atphel kikal a paisuak hial a thuchiam a tangtungsak lou mi.
english: I will give the men who have transgressed my covenant, who have not performed the words of the covenant which they made before me when they cut the calf in two and passed between its parts:

paite: Judah heutute leh Jerusalem heutute, michilgehte, siampute, mipi tengteng, bawngnou atphel kikal a paite;
english: the princes of Judah, the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, the priests, and all the people of the land, who passed between the parts of the calf.

paite: amelmate uleh ahinna zong mite khut ah ka pe ding a; huchi in aluangte uh tung a leng vasate leh lei a gamsate an ding lel ahi ding.
english: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies and into the hand of those who seek their life. Their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.

paite: Huan Judah kumpipa Zedekiah leh alawite amelmate uleh ahinna zong mite leh Babulon kumpipa sepaihhon, nou hon paisansate khut ah ka pe ding hi.
english: “I will give Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes into the hands of their enemies, into the hands of those who seek their life and into the hands of the king of Babylon’s army, who has gone away from you.

paite: Ngai un, hiai khopi a hong kik nawn ding in thu ka pe ding a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, huchi in asual ding ua, ala ding ua, mei in ahal ding uh; luahmi om lou in Judah khopite ka hihgam vek ding," chi in.
english: Behold, I will command,” says Yahweh, “and cause them to return to this city. They will fight against it, take it, and burn it with fire. I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.”

paite: Judah kumpipa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim vaihawm lai a TOUPA kiang a kipan a Jeremiah kiang a thu hong tung in:
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying,

paite: "Rekab inkote kiang ah hoh in va houpih inla, TOUPA inn a dantan khat ah pilut inla, uain dawn ding pia in," achi a.
english: “Go to the house of the Rechabites, and speak to them, and bring them into Yahweh’s house, into one of the rooms, and give them wine to drink.”

paite: Huan Habazziniah tapa, Jeremiah tapa, Jaazaniah leh a-unaute, atapa tengteng Rekab inkote tengteng toh ka pi a;
english: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, with his brothers, all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;

paite: Pathian mipa Igdali tapa Hanan tate dantan, TOUPA inn ah ka pilut a; huai dantan bel heutute dantan chin kongpi ngakmi Shallum tapa Maaseiah dantan tung a om ahi.
english: and I brought them into Yahweh’s house, into the room of the sons of Hanan the son of Igdaliah, the man of God, which was by the room of the princes, which was above the room of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the threshold.

paite: Huchi in Rekab inkuante tapate ma ah belhbute, noute uain dim ka tung a, akiang uah, "Uain dawn un," ka chi hi.
english: I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites bowls full of wine, and cups; and I said to them, “Drink wine!”

paite: Amau bel, "Uain ka dawn kei hial ding uh; kou hon suangpa Rekab tapa Jonadab in, 'Noumau leh na suante un leng tangtawn a uain na dawn ding uh ahi kei;
english: But they said, “We will drink no wine; for Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, commanded us, saying, ‘You shall drink no wine, neither you nor your children, forever.

paite: inn na lam un haichi na tuh un, grephuan leng na bawl un na nei ding uh ahi sam kei hi; na damsung nite un puanin a na ten zawk ding uh ahi, na omna gam ua na damsawt theihna ding un, chi in thu ahon pia hi.'
english: You shall not build a house, sow seed, plant a vineyard, or have any; but all your days you shall dwell in tents, that you may live many days in the land in which you live as nomads.’

paite: Huchi in kou hon suangpa Rekab tapa Jonadab in paukam a thu hon thukhah tengteng, ka damsung ua kou leh ka zite uh, ka tapate uleh ka tanute un uain dawn louh ding un,
english: We have obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, in all that he commanded us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, or our daughters;

paite: ka tenna inn uh lam louh ding, grephuan hiam lou hiam haichi hiam neih louh ding tan in ka zui uhi.
english: and not to build houses for ourselves to dwell in. We have no vineyard, field, or seed;

paite: Puaninte ah ka teng zaw ua, kou hon suangpa Jonadab thupiak tengteng mang in ka zui vek uhi.
english: but we have lived in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in gam ahong sual lai in kou, 'Kisa un, Kaldai sepaihhonte leh Siria sepaihhonte lau ziak in Jerusalem ah i hoh ding uh,' ka chi ua, huchi in Jerusalem ah ka tengta uhi," achi uhi.
english: But when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, we said, ‘Come! Let’s go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians; so we will dwell at Jerusalem.’”

paite: Huan TOUPA thu Jeremiah kiang ahong tung nawn a
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

paite: Israel' Pathian Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Judah gam a mite leh Jerusalem a mi tengte kiang ah va gen inla, "Ka thute ngaikhe ding in sinsakna na sang kei ding uh maw? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, “Will you not receive instruction to listen to my words?” says Yahweh.

paite: Rekab tapa Jonadab thu, atapate kiang a apiak, uain dawn louh ding pen azui ua, tuni tan in bangmah adawn kei ua, amau suangpa thupiak azui mahmah uh hi; ke'n bel phalvak a thou in na kiang uah thu ka gen a, himahleh na hon ngaikhe kei uh.
english: “The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab that he commanded his sons, not to drink wine, are performed; and to this day they drink none, for they obey their father’s commandment; but I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking, and you have not listened to me.

paite: Ka nasem zawlneite phalvak a thou in na kiang uah ka sawl a, michih na omdan gilou ua kipan hong kik vek unla, na thilhihte uh bawlhoih unla, pathian dangte zaw a-nna uh sem ding in zui kei unla; nou leh na pipute uh kiang a gam ka piak ah na teng ding uh chỉ in; himahleh na bil uh na doh kei ua, na hon ngaikhe sam kei uh.
english: I have sent also to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, ‘Every one of you must return now from his evil way, amend your doings, and don’t go after other gods to serve them. Then you will dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers;’ but you have not inclined your ear, nor listened to me.

paite: Rekab tapa Jonadab suante'n amau suangpa thupiak azui ua, hiai mite'n zaw ahon ngaikhe kei uh.
english: The sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father which he commanded them, but this people has not listened to me.”’

paite: Huaiziak TOUPA Israel' Pathian sepaihte' Pathian in hichi in achi: Ngai un, Judah leh Jerusalem a tengte tung ah thil hoih lou atung ua hong tung ding ka gen khiaksate ka hon tun ding; akiang uah thu ka gen a, angaikhe kei ua, amau ka sam a, ahon dawng sam kei uh," chi in.
english: “Therefore Yahweh, the God of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will bring on Judah and on all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them, because I have spoken to them, but they have not heard; and I have called to them, but they have not answered.’”

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah in Rekab suante kiang ah, Sepaihte' TOUPA Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Na pa Jonadab thupiak na zui ua, athupawt tengteng bang a na hih ziak un;
english: Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites, “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Because you have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according to all that he commanded you,’

paite: Rekab tapa Jonadab in tangtawn in ka ma a dingh ding mi atasam ngei kei ding," chi in Sepaihte' TOUPA Israel' Pathian in achi hi.
english: therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Jonadab the son of Rechab will not lack a man to stand before me forever.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Judah kumpipa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim vaihawm akum lina ah hiai thu TOUPA kiang a kipan Jeremiah kiang ah ahong tung hi:
english: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

paite: "Laibuzial la inla, hiai ah na kiang a thu ka gen tengteng, Israel tungthu, Judah tungthu, nam tengteng tungthu, na kiang a thu ka gen ni a kipan, Josiah hun lai a kipan, tuni tanpha a thu gelh in.
english: “Take a scroll of a book, and write in it all the words that I have spoken to you against Israel, against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah even to this day.

paite: Judah inkote'n atung ua thil hoih lou hih ka tup tengteng, angaikhia un michih in a-omdan gilou uh ahei thei khamoh kei ding uh, athulimlouhna uh leh akhelhna uh ka ngaihdam theihna ding in," achi hi.
english: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I intend to do to them, that they may each return from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.”

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah in Neriah tapa Baruk asam a, huchi in Baruk in TOUPA thu tengteng, akiang a agensa Jeremiah paukam a kipan laibuzial ah agelh hi.
english: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah; and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all Yahweh’s words, which he had spoken to him, on a scroll of a book.

paite: Huan Jeremiah in Baruk kiang ah, "Khakkhum ka hi a, TOUPA' inn ah ka hoh thei kei,
english: Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, “I am restricted. I can’t go into Yahweh’s house.

paite: huaiziak in nang hoh inla, TOUPA thu ka paukam a kipan laibuzial a na gelh an ngawl ni in, TOUPA' inn a mipite bil a zak in va simkhia in; akhopi ua kipan a hong pawt Judahte tengteng bil a zak in leng na simkhiak ding ahi.
english: Therefore you go, and read from the scroll which you have written from my mouth, Yahweh’s words, in the ears of the people in Yahweh’s house on the fast day. Also you shall read them in the ears of all Judah who come out of their cities.

paite: Michih in a-omdan gilou uh hei in, TOUPA ma a hehpihna angetna uh, atun thei kha zenzen ding uam, hiai mite tung a hehna leh thangpaihna TOUPA'N agenkhiak lah athupi mahmah ngal a," chi in thu apia hi.
english: It may be they will present their supplication before Yahweh, and will each return from his evil way; for Yahweh has pronounced great anger and wrath against this people.”

paite: Huchi in Neriah tapa Baruk in zawlnei Jeremiah thupiak tengteng bang in TOUPA' inn a TOUPA thu laibu a om asimta hi.
english: Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book Yahweh’s words in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Judah kumpipa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim vaihawm akum ngana, akha kuana ah Jerusalem mi tengteng leh Judah khopi a kipan a Jerusalem a hong pai tengteng in an ngawl thu apuangta uhi.
english: Now in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, in the ninth month, all the people in Jerusalem and all the people who came from the cities of Judah to Jerusalem, proclaimed a fast before Yahweh.

paite: Huan Baruk in TOUPA kongpi thak lutna ah, um sung tungnungzaw a laigelhmi Shaphan tapa Gemariah dantan, TOUPA' inn a om ah Jeremiah thu laibu a om, mi tengteng bil azak in asim hi.
english: Then Baruch read the words of Jeremiah from the book in Yahweh’s house, in the room of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the upper court, at the entry of the new gate of Yahweh’s house, in the ears of all the people.

paite: Huan Shaphan tapa Gemariah tapa Mikaiah in laibu a om TOUPA thu tengteng ana zak in,
english: When Micaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all Yahweh’s words,

paite: Kumpipa' inn ah ahohsuk a, laigelhmi dantan ah alut a, huan, ngai dih, huai ah heutu tengteng ana tu ua, laigelhmi Elishamate, Shemaiah tapa Delaiah, Akbor tapa Elnathan, Shaphan tapa Gemariah, Hananiah tapa Zedekiah leh heutu tengteng.
english: he went down into the king’s house, into the scribe’s room; and behold, all the princes were sitting there, Elishama the scribe, Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, Elnathan the son of Achbor, Gemariah the son of Shaphan, Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.

paite: Huan Mikaiah in mite bil a zak in Baruk in laibu asim thu ana zak tengteng ahilh hi.
english: Then Micaiah declared to them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.

paite: Huan heutu tengteng in Kushi tapa, Shelemiah tapa Nethaniah tapa Jehudi Baruk kiang ah asawl ua, akiang ah, "Mite bil a zak a na sim laibu tawi in hong pai in," chi ding in. Huchi in Neriah tapa Baruk bel laibuzial tawi in akiang uah ahong hi.
english: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, to Baruch, saying, “Take in your hand the scroll in which you have read in the ears of the people, and come.” So Baruch the son of Neriah took the scroll in his hand, and came to them.

paite: Akiang ah, "Tu inla, ka bil ua ka zak ngei un sim dih ve leh," achi ua, huchi in Baruk in abil ua azak un asimta hi.
english: They said to him, “Sit down now, and read it in our hearing.” So Baruch read it in their hearing.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai thute azak uleh lau in aki-entuah chiat ua, Baruk kiang ah, "Hiai thu tengteng kumpipa ka hilh ngeingei ding uh," achi uhi.
english: Now when they had heard all the words, they turned in fear one toward another, and said to Baruch, “We will surely tell the king of all these words.”

paite: Baruk kiang ah, "Hiai thu tengteng na kam a kipan bangchidan a gelh na hia, hon hilh in?" chi in adong uhi.
english: They asked Baruch, saying, “Tell us now, how did you write all these words at his mouth?”

paite: Baruk in, "Hiai thu tengteng apaukam in ahon hilh a, laitui in laibu ah ka gelh mai ahi," chi in adawng hi.
english: Then Baruch answered them, “He dictated all these words to me with his mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book.”

paite: Heutute'n Baruk kiang ah, "Kuan unla, Jeremiah toh kibu un; kuamah in na omna uh thei kei hen," achi uhi.
english: Then the princes said to Baruch, “You and Jeremiah go hide. Don’t let anyone know where you are.”

paite: Huchi in huangsung ah kumpipa kiang ah alut ua; laibuzial bel laigelhmi Elishama dantan ah akoih ua; athu tengteng paukam in kumpipa ahilh uh.
english: They went in to the king into the court, but they had laid up the scroll in the room of Elishama the scribe. Then they told all the words in the hearing of the king.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n laibuzial la ding in Jehudi asawl a, laigelhmi Elishama dantan a kipan ala uhi. Huan Jehudi in kumpipa leh kumpipa kiang a dingh heutu tengteng bil a zak in asim hi.
english: So the king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and he took it out of the room of Elishama the scribe. Jehudi read it in the hearing of the king, and in the hearing of all the princes who stood beside the king.

paite: Akha kuana ahi a, kumpipa bel aphalbi inn ah atu a, ama a meihol thuk ah kuang a-om hi.
english: Now the king was sitting in the winter house in the ninth month, and there was a fire in the brazier burning before him.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jehudi in khep thum hiam khep li hiam a sim in kumpipa in atemta in alaibuzial a-attan a, meikhuk ah pum katmang vek ding in alawnlut zel hi.
english: When Jehudi had read three or four columns, the king cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was in the brazier, until all the scroll was consumed in the fire that was in the brazier.

paite: Kumpipa leh anasem mite'n hiai thu tengteng ngaikhe mite kuamah alau kei ua, apuansilh uh leng abotkek sam kei uh.
english: The king and his servants who heard all these words were not afraid, and didn’t tear their garments.

paite: Huai phet hilou in Elnathan leh Delaiah leh Gemariahte'n laibuzial hal lou ding in kumpipa kiang ah angen ua, himahleh angaikhe nuam kei.
english: Moreover Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the scroll; but he would not listen to them.

paite: Huan kumpipa'n kumpipa tapa Jerahmeel leh Azriel tapa Seraiah leh Abdeel tapa Shelemiah Baruk laigelhmi leh zawlnei Jeremiah man ding in thu apia a; himahleh TOUPA'N amau asel hi.
english: The king commanded Jerahmeel the king’s son, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to arrest Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet; but Yahweh hid them.

paite: Huan laibuzial leh Jeremiah kam a kipan Baruk in agelh tengteng thute kumpipa'n ahalmang khit in TOUPA thu Jeremiah kiang ah ahong tung hi.
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, after the king had burned the scroll, and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah, saying,

paite: Laibuzial dang la inla, laibuzial masa a thu tengteng, Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim in ahal mangsate gelh nawn vek in.
english: “Take again another scroll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first scroll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah has burned.

paite: Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim tungtang thu ah huchi in na gen ding hi. TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Babilon kumpipa hong pai a, hiai gam hihsia in, hiai mi leh sa ahihmang vek ding chih, bangziak a huchibang thu gelh na hia? chi in laibuzial na halta hi.
english: Concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah you shall say, ‘Yahweh says: “You have burned this scroll, saying, ‘Why have you written therein, saying, “The king of Babylon will certainly come and destroy this land, and will cause to cease from there man and animal”?’”

paite: Huaiziak in Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim tungthu ah TOUPA'N hichi in achi: David tutphah a tu ding mi anei kei ding; aluang leng sun nisa ah leh zan vuk nuai ah paihkhiak ahi ding.
english: Therefore Yahweh says concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: “He will have no one to sit on David’s throne. His dead body will be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.

paite: Athulimlouhna uh ziak in amah leh asuante leh anasem mite ka gawt ding; amau leh Jerusalem a tengte leh Judah mite tung ah atung ua ka phuansa, angaihkhiak kei uleh thil hoih lou tengteng ka hon tun ding," chi in.
english: I will punish him, his offspring, and his servants for their iniquity. I will bring on them, on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and on the men of Judah, all the evil that I have pronounced against them, but they didn’t listen.”’”

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah in laibuzial dang ala a, Neriah tapa Baruk laigelhmi apia a, ama'n huai ah Jeremiah kam a kipan laibu gelhsa tengteng, Jehoiakim in mei a akhulmangsa thute agelh a; huai ban ah akibatpih thu tampi abehlap lai hi.
english: Then Jeremiah took another scroll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah, who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire; and many similar words were added to them.

paite: Huan Josiah tapa Zedekiah, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in, Judah gam kumpipa ding a abawl Jehoiakim tapa Koniah sik in vai ahawmta hi.
english: Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned as king instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.

paite: Himahleh amah leh anasem mite leh agam a mite'n TOUPA thu zawlnei Jeremiah kam a gen angaikhe kei uh.
english: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, listened to Yahweh’s words, which he spoke by the prophet Jeremiah.

paite: Huan kumpipa Zedekiah in Shelemiah tapa Jehukal leh Maaseiah tapa siampu Zephaniah bel zawlnei Jeremiah kiang ah, "TOUPA ka Pathian kiang ah hon thumsak in," chi ding in asawl hi.
english: Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, “Pray now to Yahweh our God for us.”

paite: Jeremiah bel mipite lak ah a-utut in avak thei lai a; tanin ah lah akoih ngal kei ua.
english: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people, for they had not put him into prison.

paite: Pharaoh sepaihhonte Aigupta a kipan ahong pawtkheta ua; huchi in Kaldaite Jerusalem um mite'n atanchin azak un Jerusalem atawpsanta uhi.
english: Pharaoh’s army had come out of Egypt; and when the Chaldeans who were besieging Jerusalem heard news of them, they withdrew from Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA thu zawlnei Jeremiah kiang ah ahong tung a,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

paite: TOUPA Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Judah kumpipa hon dong ding a nou hon sawl kiang ah, 'Ngai in, Pharaoh sepaihhon, nou hon panpih ding a hong paite amau gam Aigupta ah akik nawn ding uh.
english: “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘You shall tell the king of Judah, who sent you to me to inquire of me: “Behold, Pharaoh’s army, which has come out to help you, will return to Egypt into their own land.

paite: Kaldaite hong pai in, hiai khopi asual ding ua, ala ding ua, mei in ahal ding uh.
english: The Chaldeans will come again, and fight against this city. They will take it and burn it with fire.”’

paite: "Kaldaite'n ahon paisan ngei ding uh," chi in nou kikhem kei un, ahon paisan kei ding uh.
english: “Yahweh says, ‘Don’t deceive yourselves, saying, “The Chaldeans will surely depart from us;” for they will not depart.

paite: Noute hon sual Kaldai sepaihte bawl ek mah le uchin, alak ua miliam omsunte kia in leng amau puanin a kipan hong thou in hiai khopi mei in ahal thouthou ding uh, chi in na gen ding ahi,' " chi in.
english: For though you had struck the whole army of the Chaldeans who fight against you, and only wounded men remained among them, they would each rise up in his tent and burn this city with fire.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pharaoh sepaihhonte lau ziak a Kaldai sepaihhonte'n Jerusalem apaisan lai un,
english: When the army of the Chaldeans had withdrawn from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh’s army,

paite: Jeremiah in mite lak a atantuan la ding in Benjamin gam a lut ding in Jerusalem apawtsan hi.
english: then Jeremiah went out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to receive his portion there, in the middle of the people.

paite: Benjamin kongpi atun in ngakmi heutu Hananiah tapa Shelemiah tapa amin Irijah ana om a; huai in, "Kaldaite kiang a kipia na hi," chi in zawlnei Jeremiah ana man hi.
english: When he was in Benjamin’s gate, a captain of the guard was there, whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he seized Jeremiah the prophet, saying, “You are defecting to the Chaldeans!”

paite: Jeremiah in, "Zuau ahi; Kaldaite kiang ah ka kipe kei," achi a; himahleh angaikhe kei a, huchi in Irijah in Jeremiah ana man a, heutute kiang ah apia hi.
english: Then Jeremiah said, “That is false! I am not defecting to the Chaldeans.” But he didn’t listen to him; so Irijah seized Jeremiah, and brought him to the princes.

paite: Huan heutute Jeremiah tung ah aheh mahmah ua, asat ua, laigelhmi Jonathan inn ah akhum uh; huai tan inn ding a azat him uh ahi.
english: The princes were angry with Jeremiah, and struck him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe; for they had made that the prison.

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah lei nuai kokhuk ah alut a, ni tampitak a-om nung in kumpipa Zedekiah in asamkhia hi.
english: When Jeremiah had come into the dungeon house and into the cells, and Jeremiah had remained there many days,

paite: Huan kumpipa'n a-inn ah aguk in akiang ah, "TOUPA kiang a kipan thu banghiam bek a-om hia?" chi in adong hi. Jeremiah in, "Om e,” achi hi. Akiang ah, "Babilon kumpipa khut ah matsak in na om ding," achi lai hi.
english: then Zedekiah the king sent and had him brought out. The king asked him secretly in his house, “Is there any word from Yahweh?” Jeremiah said, “There is.” He also said, “You will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.”

paite: Jeremiah in kumpipa Zedekiah kiang ah, "Nang hiam na nasemmi hiam hiai mite tung ah bang thil ahia ka hihkhelh a na hon matsak?
english: Moreover Jeremiah said to King Zedekiah, “How have I sinned against you, against your servants, or against this people, that you have put me in prison?

paite: Nang kiang a 'Babilon kumpipa nang leh hiai gam dou ding in ahong pai kei ding, chi a thugenmi na zawlneite koi a om ahita ua?'
english: Now where are your prophets who prophesied to you, saying, ‘The king of Babylon will not come against you, nor against this land’?

paite: Aw, ka pu, kumpipa ngaikhia in, ka hon ngen ahi, ka ngetna na sang in, ka hon ngen hi; laigelhmi Jonathan inn ah hon kiksak nawn ke'n, huai ah ka va si kha ding," achi hi.
english: Now please hear, my lord the king: please let my supplication be presented before you, that you not cause me to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Zedekiah in thu apia a, Jeremiah bel ngakmi huangsung ah atangsak a, tanghou bawl mite kongzing a kipan niteng in tanghou beu khat, khopi a tanghou a-om lai siah apia ua, huchibang in Jeremiah bel ngakmi huangsung ah a-om nilouh hi.
english: Then Zedekiah the king commanded, and they committed Jeremiah into the court of the guard. They gave him daily a loaf of bread out of the bakers’ street, until all the bread in the city was gone. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.

paite: Huan Mattan tapa Shephatiah leh Pashur tapa Gedaliah leh Shelemiah tapa Jukal leh Malkijah tapa Pashurte'n, mipi tengteng kiang ah Jeremiah in,
english: Shephatiah the son of Mattan, Gedaliah the son of Pashhur, Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur the son of Malchijah heard the words that Jeremiah spoke to all the people, saying,

paite: "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Hiai khopi a om nilouhte zaw namsau, kial leh hipi in asi ding ua, Kaldaite kiang a kipia bel ahing ding uh, ahinna akihumbit ding a ahing ding," chi in.
english: “Yahweh says, ‘He who remains in this city will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, but he who goes out to the Chaldeans will live. He will escape with his life and he will live.’

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Hiai khopi Babulon kumpipa sepaihhonte khut ah piak ahi ngei ding a, ala ding, chi a agen angaikhia uhi.
english: Yahweh says, ‘This city will surely be given into the hand of the army of the king of Babylon, and he will take it.’”

paite: Huchi in heutute'n kumpipa kiang ah, "Hiai mi hihlup hi hen, ka hon ngen uh; ama'n akiang ua hiai thute gen in hiai khopi a galkapmi omlaite leh mipi tengteng tha hat lousak in; hiai mi'n hiai mipite hoihna azong kei a, asiatna azong zaw,” achi uhi.
english: Then the princes said to the king, “Please let this man be put to death, because he weakens the hands of the men of war who remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words to them; for this man doesn’t seek the welfare of this people, but harm.”

paite: Huan kumpipa Zedekiah in, "Ngai un, amah na khut ua om ahi; kumpipa'n na deih louh lam uh hihthei ahi sam a," achi hi.
english: Zedekiah the king said, “Behold, he is in your hand; for the king can’t do anything to oppose you.”

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah api ua, ngakmi huangsung a om kumpipa tapa Malkijah tuibem ah apailut ua; Jeremiah bel khau in akhesuk ua, huai tuibem ah buannawi kia lou ngal tui a-om kei a; buannawi ah Jeremiah akia hi.
english: Then they took Jeremiah and threw him into the dungeon of Malchijah the king’s son, that was in the court of the guard. They let down Jeremiah with cords. In the dungeon there was no water, but mire; and Jeremiah sank in the mire.

paite: Huan Ethiopia mi, michilgeh kumpipa' inn a om sek Ebed-melek in Jeremiah tuibem ah akoih uh chih ana za a; huchih lai in kumpipa bel Benjamin kongpi ah atu a;
english: Now when Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, a eunuch, who was in the king’s house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon (the king was then sitting in Benjamin’s gate),

paite: Ebed-melek bel kumpipa' inn a kipan apawt a, kumpipa kiang ah,
english: Ebedmelech went out of the king’s house, and spoke to the king, saying,

paite: "Ka pu, kumpipa, hiai mite'n zawlnei Jeremiah tuibem a ana paihkhiak uh thil gilou thupi mahmah hih ahi uh, gilkial ziak in a-omna mun ah si mai ding akei maw; khopi ah tanghou a-om nawn kei a," achi a.
english: “My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon. He is likely to die in the place where he is, because of the famine; for there is no more bread in the city.”

paite: Huan kumpipa'n Ethiopia mi Ebed-melek thu apia a, "Hiai a kipan in mi sawmthum pi inla, tuibem a kipan in asih ma in zawlnei Jeremiah va lakhia un," chi in.
english: Then the king commanded Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, “Take from here thirty men with you, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he dies.”

paite: Huchi in Ebed-melek in mite api a, kumpipa dangka inn nuai ah alut ua, puanak lui paihte leh puansilh siate alakhia ua, tuibem ah Jeremiah kiang ah khau in akhaikhesuk uhi.
english: So Ebedmelech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took from there rags and worn-out garments, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.

paite: Huan Ethiopia mi Ebed-melek in Jeremiah kiang ah, "Hiai puanak luite leh puansilh siate na lenuai ah khau in gakkhum in," achi hi. Huan Jeremiah in huchibang in ahih hi.
english: Ebedmelech the Ethiopian said to Jeremiah, “Now put these rags and worn-out garments under your armpits under the cords.” Jeremiah did so.

paite: Huan Jeremiah bel tuibem a kipan khau in akaikhia ua; huchi in ngakmi huangsung ah Jeremiah a-om nilouh hi.
english: So they lifted Jeremiah up with the cords, and took him up out of the dungeon; and Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.

paite: Huan kumpipa Zedekiah in Jeremiah asam a, TOUPA' inn a lutna thumna ah akiang ah apilut a; huan, kumpipa'n Jeremiah kiang ah, "Thil ka hon dong ding; ka lak ah bangmah iim nei ke'n," achi hi.
english: Then Zedekiah the king sent and took Jeremiah the prophet to himself into the third entry that is in Yahweh’s house. Then the king said to Jeremiah, “I will ask you something. Hide nothing from me.”

paite: Jeremiah in Zedekiah kiang ah, "Hon hilh leng na hon that mahmah kei dia hia? Thu hon hanthawn leng lah hon ngaikhe lou ding chin a,” achi hi.
english: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “If I declare it to you, will you not surely put me to death? If I give you counsel, you will not listen to me.”

paite: Huan kumpipa Zedekiah in Jeremiah kiang ah, "TOUPA hiai ka hinna bawlpa ahin a ahin sung teng ka hon hihlum kei hial ding, na hinna zong mite khut ah leng nang ka hon pe sam kei ding," chi in asim in akichiam hi.
english: So Zedekiah the king swore secretly to Jeremiah, saying, “As Yahweh lives, who made our souls, I will not put you to death, neither will I give you into the hand of these men who seek your life.”

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah in Zedekiah kiang ah, "TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi, 'Babilon kumpipa heutute kiang ah na kipiak leh na hinna na bitsak ding a, hiai khopi leng mei in akang kei ding, nang leh na inkote leng na hing ding uh.'
english: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “Yahweh, the God of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you will go out to the king of Babylon’s princes, then your soul will live, and this city will not be burned with fire. You will live, along with your house.

paite: Babulon kumpipa heutute kiang a na kipiak keileh bel hiai khopi Kaldaite khut a piak ahi ding a, ahal ding ua, akhut ua kipan na suakta het kei ding achi," achi hi.
english: But if you will not go out to the king of Babylon’s princes, then this city will be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they will burn it with fire, and you won’t escape out of their hand.’”

paite: Huan kumpipa Zedekiah in Jeremiah kiang ah, "Kaldai mite kiang a kipia Judate khut ah ahon mansak in nuihzat in ahon bawl kha ding uh ka lau hi,” achi hi.
english: Zedekiah the king said to Jeremiah, “I am afraid of the Jews who have defected to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me.”

paite: Jeremiah in bel, “Ahon mansak kei ding uh; na kiang a ka gen TOUPA aw mang mai in. Huchi in nang a ding in ahoih ding a, hin leng na hing ding. 21 Kipiak na ut keileh bel TOUPA'N hon thu kawkmuh hiai ahi:
english: But Jeremiah said, “They won’t deliver you. Obey, I beg you, Yahweh’s voice, in that which I speak to you; so it will be well with you, and your soul will live.

paite: Kipiak na ut keileh bel TOUPA'N hon thu kawkmuh hiai ahi:
english: But if you refuse to go out, this is the word that Yahweh has shown me:

paite: "Ngai in, Judah kumpipa' inn a numei omlaite tengteng Babulon kumpipa heutute kiang ah pi in a-om ding ua, huai numeite'n, na lawm hoihhoihte'n ahon khem ua, ahon zouta ua, na khe buannawi a atumtak in ahon lehngatsan ua," achi ding uhi.
english: ‘Behold, all the women who are left in the king of Judah’s house will be brought out to the king of Babylon’s princes, and those women will say, “Your familiar friends have turned on you, and have prevailed over you. Your feet are sunk in the mire, they have turned away from you.”

paite: "Na zite, na tanute Kaldai mite kiang ah api vek ding ua, akhut ua kipan na suakta kei ding a, Babulon kumpipa khut ah mat in na om zaw ding a, nang ziak in hiai khopi akang ding," achi hi.
english: They will bring out all your wives and your children to the Chaldeans. You won’t escape out of their hand, but will be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon. You will cause this city to be burned with fire.’”

paite: Huan Zedekiah in Jeremiah kiang ah, "Hiai thute kuamah in thei kei uhen, huchi in na si kei ding.
english: Then Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, “Let no man know of these words, and you won’t die.

paite: Himahleh heutute'n ka hon houpih azak ua, na kiang a ahong ua, na kiang a, 'Kumpipa kiang a na gen hon hilh in; ka lak uah bangmah iim nei ke'nla, ka hon that kei ding uh; na kiang a kumpipa thugente leng, achih uleh,
english: But if the princes hear that I have talked with you, and they come to you, and tell you, ‘Declare to us now what you have said to the king; don’t hide it from us, and we will not put you to death; also tell us what the king said to you;’

paite: nang akiang uah, 'Jonathan inn a hon kiksak lou a, huai a va si lou ding in kumpipa kiang ah ngetna ka pelut lel ahi, na chi ding hi,' "achi hi.
english: then you shall tell them, ‘I presented my supplication before the king, that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan’s house, to die there.’”

paite: Jeremiah kiang ah heutu tengteng hong pai in, adongta ngei ua, kumpipa'n thu apiak tengteng bang in amau ahilh hi. Huchi in akihoupih uh atawp ua; athu theih phak ahita kei hi.
english: Then all the princes came to Jeremiah, and asked him; and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded. So they stopped speaking with him, for the matter was not perceived.

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah bel Jerusalem lak ni tan in ngakmi huangsung ah a-om nilouh hi.
english: So Jeremiah stayed in the court of the guard until the day that Jerusalem was taken.

paite: Huan Judah vaihawm akum kuana akha sawmna ah Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar leh asepaihte'n Jerusalem asual ua, a-um uh.
english: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army came against Jerusalem, and besieged it.

paite: Zedekiah vaihawm kum sawm-le-khatna akha lina, ani kuana ah khopi kulh aphu pailet uh.
english: In the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth day of the month, a breach was made in the city.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jerusalem alak un Babulon kumpipa heutute a hong lut ua, kongpi laita ah atu ua, Nergal-shar-ezar, Samgar-nebo, Sarsekim, Rab-saris mi Nergal-shar-ezar, Rab-mag mi leh Babulon kumpipa heutu dangte toh.
english: All the princes of the king of Babylon came in, and sat in the middle gate: Nergal Sharezer, Samgarnebo, Sarsechim the Rabsaris, Nergal Sharezer the Rabmag, with all the rest of the princes of the king of Babylon.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Judah kumpipa Zedekiah leh galkapmi tengteng in amau amuh un ataikek ua, khopi a kipan zan in kumpipa huai lampi lam ah kulhbaang nih kikal kongpi ah ataikhia ua, amah pen Arabah lampi lam ah apawt hi.
english: When Zedekiah the king of Judah and all the men of war saw them, then they fled and went out of the city by night, by the way of the king’s garden, through the gate between the two walls; and he went out toward the Arabah.

paite: Himahleh Kaldaite sepaihhon in amah adelh ua, Jeriko Phaizang ah Zedekiah apha ua; huchi in amat nung un Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar kiang ah, Hamath gam a Riblah ah api ua, ama'n atungthu angaihtuah hi.
english: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. When they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he pronounced judgment on him.

paite: Huchi in Babulon kumpipa'n Riblah ah amah mitmuh ngei in Zedekiah tapate athat a, Babulon kumpipa'n Judah mihoih teng leng athat lai hi.
english: Then the king of Babylon killed Zedekiah’s sons in Riblah before his eyes. The king of Babylon also killed all the nobles of Judah.

paite: Huai lou leng Zedekiah mit akhelkhia a, kol abunsak a, Babulon ah apita hi.
