english: Moreover he put out Zedekiah’s eyes and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.

paite: Kaldaite'n kumpipa' inn leh midang inn tengteng ahal ua, Jerusalem kulhbaangte leng ahihsia uh.
english: The Chaldeans burned the king’s house and the people’s houses with fire and broke down the walls of Jerusalem.

paite: Huan ngakmi heutu Nebuzaradan in khopi a mipi khosuaksun akiang a amau a kipiate leh mipi omlaite Babulon ah sal in api hi.
english: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the rest of the people who remained in the city, the deserters also who fell away to him, and the rest of the people who remained.

paite: Himahleh ngakmi heutu Nebuzaradan in Judah gam migenthei bangmah neiloute anusia a, grephuan leh loute ape pah ngal hi.
english: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, who had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.

paite: Huan Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in Jeremiah tungtang thu a ngakmi Nebuzaradan kiang ah,
english: Now Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon commanded Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard concerning Jeremiah, saying,

paite: "Amah pi inla, hoihtak in bawl inla, hihna himhim ke'n, na kiang a agen bangbang in hih zel zaw in," chi in thu apia hi.
english: “Take him and take care of him. Do him no harm; but do to him even as he tells you.”

paite: Huan ngakmi heutu Nebuzaradan in Rab-saris mi Nebushazban, Rab-mag mi Nergal-shar-ezar leh Babulon kumpipa sepaih heutu deuhdeuhte athukhak vek a, amau Jeremiah ngakmi huangsung a kipan asamkhia ua,
english: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, Nebushazban, Rabsaris, and Nergal Sharezer, Rabmag, and all the chief officers of the king of Babylon

paite: Shaphan tapa Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kiang ah a-inn a puak ding in akemsak ua, huchi in mite lak ah a-omta hi.
english: sent and took Jeremiah out of the court of the guard, and committed him to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, that he should bring him home. So he lived among the people.

paite: Huan ngakmi huangsung a khakkhum a a-om lai in, Jeremiah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: Now Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah while he was shut up in the court of the guard, saying,

paite: Ethiopia mi Ebed-melek kiang ah, "Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: Ngai in, ahoihna ding hilou in, hiai khopi siatna ding in ka thute ka hon tun ding a, huai ni mahmah in na ma ah tangtunsak ahi ding.
english: “Go, and speak to Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will bring my words on this city for evil, and not for good; and they will be accomplished before you in that day.

paite: Huai ni in nang bel ka hon hunkhe ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, na mi kihtakte khut ah piak na hi kei ding.
english: But I will deliver you in that day,” says Yahweh; “and you will not be given into the hand of the men of whom you are afraid.

paite: Nang ka hon humbit ding a, namsau in na puk kei ding a, kei na hon muan ziak in, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, chi in va gen in," achi hi.
english: For I will surely save you. You won’t fall by the sword, but you will escape with your life, because you have put your trust in me,” says Yahweh.’”

paite: "Aw Israel, na hong kikleh, ka kiang ngel ahang kik ding ahi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Na kihhuainate ka mitmuh louh a na koihmang a, chihtaktak a, thugel diktak zang a diktattak a;
english: “If you will return, Israel,” says Yahweh, “if you will return to me, and if you will put away your abominations out of my sight; then you will not be removed;

paite: TOUPA ahin lai teng, chi a na kichiamleh namte amah ah nuamsa akichi ding ua, amah asuangta ding uh.
english: and you will swear, ‘As Yahweh lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness. The nations will bless themselves in him, and they will glory in him.”

paite: "Judah mite leh Jerusalem kiang ah TOUPA Pathian in hichi in achi: Na lei sit uh let unla, lingte lak ah chỉ theh kei un.
english: For Yahweh says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, “Break up your fallow ground, and don’t sow among thorns.

paite: Nou Judah gam a mi leh Jerusalem a tengte aw, TOUPA a ding in na zek uh sum unla, na lungtang zek uh sum un, huchi lou in zaw na thil gilou hihte uh ziak in, ka hehna mei bang in apawtkhe ding a, kuamah phelh theih louh in akang kha ding.
english: Circumcise yourselves to Yahweh, and take away the foreskins of your heart, you men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem; lest my wrath go out like fire, and burn so that no one can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

paite: Judah gam ah hilh unla, Jerusalem ah puang un, Gam pumpi ah pengkul mut unla, ngaihtak in kikou un. Hong kikhawm unla, kulh nei khopite ah i lut ding uh, chi un;
english: Declare in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, ‘Blow the trumpet in the land!’ Cry aloud and say, ‘Assemble yourselves! Let’s go into the fortified cities!’

paite: Zion lam ah puanzak khai unla, bitna zong in tai unla, zekai kei un, mallam a pan thil hoih lou ka hon tungsak ding, nakpi a siatna.
english: Set up a standard toward Zion. Flee for safety! Don’t wait; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.”

paite: Gammang nuai ning kitel a kipan in humpinelkai apawt hi, namte hihse ding; amun a kipan apawtta, ahong pai lellel hi, na gam hihse ding leh na khopite teng mi nei lou khop a sugawp ding in.
english: A lion has gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations. He is on his way. He has gone out from his place, to make your land desolate, that your cities be laid waste, without inhabitant.

paite: Huaiziak in sai-ip puan teng unla, kap un, mau vongvong un; i lak ua kipan in TOUPA hehna thupi lah akikaikhe ngal kei a."
english: For this, clothe yourself with sackcloth, lament and wail; for the fierce anger of Yahweh hasn’t turned back from us.

paite: "Huai ni chiang in hichi ahong hi ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; kumpipa lungtang a lungke khin ding a, heutute lungtang leng; siampute'n gen ding athei kei ding ua, zawlneite'n lamdang asa ding uh."
english: “It will happen at that day,” says Yahweh, “that the heart of the king will perish, along with the heart of the princes. The priests will be astonished, and the prophets will wonder.”

paite: Huan ke'n, "Ah, Toupa PATHIAN, hiai mite leh Jerusalem nakpitak a khem na hi ve, 'Muanna na nei ding uh,' na chi a, namsau in hinna asun zawta," ka chi hi.
english: Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Surely you have greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You will have peace;’ whereas the sword reaches to the heart.”

paite: Huai hun chiang in hiai mite leh Jerusalem kiang ah, "Gamdai tang giau velvul a kipan huih sa, ka tanu, ka mite zapsiang ding hilou; siangsak ding hi sam lou;
english: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, “A hot wind blows from the bare heights in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to winnow, nor to cleanse.

paite: Huih hat lua, ka thu in ahong tung ding ahi; tu in leng atungthu uh ngaihtuahpa kei ka hi,” chih ahi ding.
english: A full wind from these will come for me. Now I will also utter judgments against them.”

paite: Ngai dih, ahong paitou ding, meipi bang in, akangtalai pingpei bang maite; asakolte muvanlai sang in ahatzaw uh, i tung gik na e! Buluh a om i hi ve ua.
english: Behold, he will come up as clouds, and his chariots will be as the whirlwind. His horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us! For we are ruined.

paite: Aw Jerusalem, thulimlouhna a kipan na lungtang silsiang inla, hotdam a na omtheihna ding in; bang tan ahia na ngaihtuahna gilou na pai ding?
english: Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long will your evil thoughts lodge within you?

paite: Dan gam a kipan aw ahong pawtkhia a, Ephraim tang a kipan in thil hoih lou apuang hi.
english: For a voice declares from Dan, and publishes evil from the hills of Ephraim:

paite: Namte hilh unla, Jerusalem ah puang un, "Ngai dih, gam gamlapi a kipan sual mite ahong tung uh, Judah khopite tung ah a-aw uh asuah uhi.
english: “Tell the nations, behold, publish against Jerusalem, ‘Watchers come from a far country, and raise their voice against the cities of Judah.

paite: Louma veng mite bang mai in akimvel in a-um ua, ka tung a ahel ziak un chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: As keepers of a field, they are against her all around, because she has been rebellious against me,’” says Yahweh.

paite: "Na omdan leh na thilhihte'n, hiaite na tung ah atun ahi, hiai na siatna ding ahi, ana mahmah a na lungtang sun ei ve."
english: “Your way and your doings have brought these things to you. This is your wickedness, for it is bitter, for it reaches to your heart.”

paite: Ka lung ana, ka lung ana, ka lungtang mahmah ana, ka sung ah ka lungtang abuaita a, ka om maimai thei kei, aw ka hinna, pengkul ging, kidouna husa ka zak ziak in.
english: My anguish, my anguish! I am pained at my very heart! My heart trembles within me. I can’t hold my peace, because you have heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.

paite: Siatna tung ah siatna atungta, gam pumpi loh in a-omta, ka puaninte ahihse guih ua, ka puanzakte leng mitphiat kal lou in.
english: Destruction on destruction is decreed, for the whole land is laid waste. Suddenly my tents are destroyed, and my curtains gone in a moment.

paite: "Bang tan ahia kidouna puanzak ka muh ding a, pengkul ging ka zak ding?
english: How long will I see the standard and hear the sound of the trumpet?

paite: Ka mite ahai mahmah ua lah athei ngal kei ua, naupang haitak, theihna nei lou bang mai ahi ua, thil gilou hih asiam ua, thil hoih hihdan asiam kei uh."
english: “For my people are foolish. They don’t know me. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are skillful in doing evil, but they don’t know how to do good.”

paite: Leitung ka etleh, ngai dih, segawp leh vuak in a-om a; vante'n vakna anei kei uh.
english: I saw the earth and, behold, it was waste and void, and the heavens, and they had no light.

paite: Tangte ka etleh, ngai in, aling uh, mual tengteng leng atang zualzual uh.
english: I saw the mountains, and behold, they trembled, and all the hills moved back and forth.

paite: Ka etleh, ngai in, mihing a-om kei ua, tungleng vasate alengmang khinta uh.
english: I saw, and behold, there was no man, and all the birds of the sky had fled.

paite: Ka etleh, ngai in, louma hoihte gamdai asuak khin a, khopite leng achim khin, TOUPA leh ahehna mahmah ah.
english: I saw, and behold, the fruitful field was a wilderness, and all its cities were broken down at the presence of Yahweh, before his fierce anger.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Gam pumpi asegawp ding, himahleh ka hihtawp tawntung kei ding."
english: For Yahweh says, “The whole land will be a desolation; yet I will not make a full end.

paite: "Huaiziak in lei in asuun ding a, tunglam vante leng amial ding; thu ka genta a, ka tumta hi, ka kisik kei a, ka lunghei kei hi.
english: For this the earth will mourn, and the heavens above be black, because I have spoken it. I have planned it, and I have not repented, neither will I turn back from it.”

paite: Sakol tung a tuang leh thalpeu zang mite husa ah, khopi pumpi ataikek ua, gammang ah alut ua, kho chih anusia ua, luahmi khat lel leng om lou in.
english: Every city flees for the noise of the horsemen and archers. They go into the thickets and climb up on the rocks. Every city is forsaken, and not a man dwells therein.

paite: "Huan nang, loh a na om hun chiang in bangchi in na hih dia? Puan san-au a kizem in, kivatna dangka-eng a kivan in, na mitte nuh mah lechin, na kihih lawm thawn ahi, na tangvalte'n ahon simmoh ding ua, na hinna lak atum uhi.
english: You, when you are made desolate, what will you do? Though you clothe yourself with scarlet, though you deck yourself with ornaments of gold, though you enlarge your eyes with makeup, you make yourself beautiful in vain. Your lovers despise you. They seek your life.

paite: Numei nauvei kikou husa ka za, tachil neinu thuak lai, Zion tanu nak ging, akhutte zak a, ka tung gik hi na mai e! Tualthat mite ma ah ka hinna abah khinta," chi in.
english: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, the anguish as of her who gives birth to her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, who gasps for breath, who spreads her hands, saying, “Woe is me now! For my soul faints before the murderers.”

paite: Judah leh Jerusalem sal tengteng, Babulon sal a apite uh lak a Jeremiah khainiang len kawm a api lai a ngakmi apawtsak nung a TOUPA a kipan Jeremiah kiang a thu hong tung hi.
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, after Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all the captives of Jerusalem and Judah who were carried away captive to Babylon.

paite: Ngakmi heutu in Jeremiah api a, akiang ah, "TOUPA i Pathian in hiai mun a thil hoih lou tung ding ana puang khin hi.
english: The captain of the guard took Jeremiah and said to him, “Yahweh your God pronounced this evil on this place;

paite: TOUPA'N ahon tungsakta ngei a, agen bangbang in ahihta hi; TOUPA tung ah thil na hihkhial ua, apaukam na man louh ziak un hiai thil na tung ua ahong tung ahi.
english: and Yahweh has brought it, and done according as he spoke. Because you have sinned against Yahweh, and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing has come on you.

paite: Tu in, ngai in, tuni in na khut a khainiang but ka hon phelsak hi. Babulon a ka kiang a hong na utleh hong inla, na ut keileh hong dah mai in; en dih, gam tengteng na ma ah a-om hi, hong hoh pha na sakleh hoih na sak bang in pai in.
english: Now, behold, I release you today from the chains which are on your hand. If it seems good to you to come with me into Babylon, come, and I will take care of you; but if it seems bad to you to come with me into Babylon, don’t. Behold, all the land is before you. Where it seems good and right to you to go, go there.”

paite: Akik ma in ama'n, Judah khopite tung a ukpi dia Babulon kumpipa'n abawl Shaphan tapa, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kiang ah kik inla, mite lak ah akiang ah om in, ahihkeileh hoh pha na sakna ah va hoh mai in," achi hi. Huchi in ngakmi heutu in nek ding leh thilpiak apia a, apaisakta hi.
english: Now while he had not yet gone back, “Go back then,” he said, “to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has made governor over the cities of Judah, and dwell with him among the people; or go wherever it seems right to you to go.” So the captain of the guard gave him food and a present, and let him go.

paite: Jeremiah bel Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kiang ah Mizpah ah ahoh a, akiang a gam a omsun mite lak ah a-om teita hi.
english: Then Jeremiah went to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah, and lived with him among the people who were left in the land.

paite: Huan sepaih pawl heutu tengteng gamlak a omte'n, amaute leh aheute uh Babulon kumpipa'n, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah huai gam a migenthei penpen, Babulon sal a pilouhte akemsak chih azak un Mizpah khua ah;
english: Now when all the captains of the forces who were in the fields, even they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land, and had committed to him men, women, children, and of the poorest of the land, of those who were not carried away captive to Babylon,

paite: Gedaliah kiang ah ahong pai ua, Nethaniah tapa Ishmael, Kareah tapate Johanan leh Jonathan, Tanhumet tapa Seraiah, Netophah a Ephai tate leh Maakath mi tapa Jezaniah, amau leh amite uh toh.
english: then Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men came to Gedaliah to Mizpah.

paite: Huchi in Shaphan tapa, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah in amau leh aheute uh kiang ah, "Kaldaite nasep kihta kei un; gam ah om dinden unla, Babulon kumpipa na sem unla, noute a ding in ahoih mai ding hi.
english: Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan swore to them and to their men, saying, “Don’t be afraid to serve the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.

paite: Kei zaw Mizpah ah ka om ding a, Kaldai mi ka kiang a hong dingte ma ah noute sik in ka dingh ding; noute'n ahihleh uainte, nipitheite, thaute lakhawm in na bel uah koih unla, na khopi laksate uah teng un," chi in akichiam hi.
english: As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah, to stand before the Chaldeans who will come to us; but you, gather wine and summer fruits and oil, and put them in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that you have taken.”

paite: Huchi mah bang in Juda mi tengteng, Moab gam a tengte, Ammon mite lak a tengte leh Edom gam a tengte leh gamdang a omte'n Babulon kumpipa'n Judah khosuaksunte nusia a, atung uah Shaphan tapa, Ahikam tapa, Gedaliah akoih chih azak un;
english: Likewise when all the Jews who were in Moab, and among the children of Ammon, and in Edom, and who were in all the countries, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah, and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan,

paite: Juda mi tengteng ahawlzakna gam tengteng ua kipan in ahong paikik ua, Judah gam a Mizpah ah Gedaliah kiang ah ahong tung ua, uain leh nipithei alakhawm uhi.
english: then all the Jews returned out of all places where they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, to Mizpah, and gathered very much wine and summer fruits.

paite: Huai lou leng Kareah tapa Johanan leh sepaih pawlte heutu, gamlak a om tengteng Mizpah ah Gedaliah kiang ah,
english: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah,

paite: "Ammon mite kumpipa Baalis in na hinna la ding in Nethaniah tapa Ishmael asawl chih na za hia?" achi uhi.
english: and said to him, “Do you know that Baalis the king of the children of Ammon has sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to take your life?” But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam didn’t believe them.

paite: Huan Kareah tapa Johanan in Mizpah a Gedaliah kiang ah, "Hon paisak dih ve, Nethaniah tapa Ishmael ka va that mai ding, kuamah in athei kei ding uh; Juda mi na kiang omkhawm tengteng adalh vek ua, Judah mi khosuaksunte manthatna hih ding in bangziak a na hinna la ding ahia?" chi in asimtham in agen hi.
english: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spoke to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, “Please let me go, and I will kill Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man will know it. Why should he take your life, that all the Jews who are gathered to you should be scattered, and the remnant of Judah perish?”

paite: Ahikam tapa Gedaliah in bel Kareah tapa Johanan kiang ah, "Hiai thil na hih ding ahi kei; Ishmael na gendan adik kei hi," achi hi.
english: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said to Johanan the son of Kareah, “You shall not do this thing, for you speak falsely of Ishmael.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akha sagihna ah Elishama tapa Nethaniah tapa Ishmael, kumpi chi a mi, kumpipa upate lak a khat, mi sawmkhat pi in Mizpah ah Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kiang ah ahong ua; Mizpah ah an anekhawm uhi.
english: Now in the seventh month, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal offspring and one of the chief officers of the king, and ten men with him, came to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they ate bread together in Mizpah.

paite: Huan Nethaniah tapa Ishmael bel amipi sawmkhatte toh adingh ua, namsau in Shaphan tapa Ahikam tapa, Babulon kumpipa'n gam ukpipa dia abawl Gedaliah athat uhi.
english: Then Ishmael the son of Nethaniah arose, and the ten men who were with him, and struck Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword and killed him, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.

paite: Akiang a Juda mi om tengteng, Mizpah a Gedaliah kiang a omte leh Kaldai galkapmi om teite Ishmael in athat lai hi.
english: Ishmael also killed all the Jews who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah, and the Chaldean men of war who were found there.

paite: Gedaliah athah nung ni nih in hichi ahong hi a, kuamah in atheih ma un,
english: The second day after he had killed Gedaliah, and no man knew it,

paite: Shekem a kipan, Shiloh a kipan, Samaria a kipan in mi sawmgiat, akhamul uh met a, apuansilhte uh kek a, amau ki-atkeh in, tanghou latte leh gimlimte tawi in TOUPA inn ah lan ding in ahong uhi.
english: men came from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, even eighty men, having their beards shaved and their clothes torn, and having cut themselves, with meal offerings and frankincense in their hand, to bring them to Yahweh’s house.

paite: Amau dawn ding in Mizpah a kipan in Nethaniah tapa Ishmael apawtkhia a, lamtawn in akapkap a; huan, hichi ahong hi a, amaute amuh in akiang uah, "Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kiang ah hong pai un," achi hi.
english: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went out from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went, and as he met them, he said to them, “Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.”

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, khopi sung atun uleh Nethaniah tapa Ishmael leh amipite'n amau ana that ua, kokhuk ah apai uhi.
english: It was so, when they came into the middle of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah killed them, and cast them into the middle of the pit, he, and the men who were with him.

paite: Alak ua mi sawmkhatte'n bel, "Hon that kei un, gam ah buh, buhman, sathau leh khuaizu tampi ka sel ngal ua," achi uhi. Huchi in amau ahawi ua, a-unaute uh lak ah athat telta kei hi.
english: But ten men were found among those who said to Ishmael, “Don’t kill us; for we have stores hidden in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey.” So he stopped, and didn’t kill them among their brothers.

paite: Huan Ishmael in Gedaliah toh amithahte luang apaihna kokhuk bel kumpipa Asa in Israel kumpipa Baasha akihtak ziak a abawl ahi. Nethaniah tapa Ishmael in huai luangte in adimsak hi.
english: Now the pit in which Ishmael cast all the dead bodies of the men whom he had killed, by the side of Gedaliah (this was that which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel), Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with those who were killed.

paite: Huchi in Ishmael in Mizpah a mihing a-omsun, kumpipa tanute, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kiang a ngakmi heutu Nebuzaradan in akepsak, Mizpah a om lai tengteng toh sal in api vek a; Nethaniah tapa Ishmael in huaite sal dia pi in Ammon mite zuan in apawt hi.
english: Then Ishmael carried away captive all of the people who were left in Mizpah, even the king’s daughters, and all the people who remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam. Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the children of Ammon.

paite: Himahleh, Kareah tapa Johanan leh akiang a om sepaih pawl heutu tengteng in Nethaniah tapa Ishmael thil hoih lou hih tengteng ana zak un mi tengteng apikhia ua,
english: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,

paite: Nethaniah tapa Ishmael sual ding in akuan ua, tui tampi omna mun Gibeon ah ava mu uh.
english: then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Ishmael kiang a mi tengteng in, Kareah tapa Johanan leh akiang a sepaih heutu tengteng ava muh un ana kipak lo mahmah uhi.
english: Now when all the people who were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, then they were glad.

paite: Huchi in Ishmael in Mizpah a kipan a sal a api tengteng akihei ua, akik nawn ua, Kareah tapa Johanan kiang ah apai diam uhi.
english: So all the people who Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah turned about and came back, and went to Johanan the son of Kareah.

paite: Nethaniah tapa Ishmael bel mi giat toh Johanan a kipan ataikhe geigei ua, Ammon mite kiang ah apaita uhi.
english: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the children of Ammon.

paite: Huan Kareah tapa Johanan leh akiang a sepaih pawl heutu tengteng in, Nethaniah tapa Ishmael in Ahikam tapa Gedaliah athah nung a Mizpah a kipan Nethaniah tapa Ishmael lak a Johanan in ahutkhiaksa mi akhosuaksunte tengteng, kidou mite, numeite, naupangte, michilgehte, Gibeon a kipan a api nawnte api vek hi.
english: Then Johanan the son of Kareah and all the captains of the forces who were with him took all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after he had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam—the men of war, with the women, the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought back from Gibeon.

paite: Huchi in apawt ua, Kaldaite ziak a Aigupta gam a tailut tum in Bethlehem kho kiang ah Geruth Chimham ah akhawl uhi.
english: They departed and lived in Geruth Chimham, which is by Bethlehem, to go to enter into Egypt

paite: Nethaniah tapa Ishmael in, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah, Babulon kumpipa'n huai gam ukpipa dia abawl athah ziak in amau akihta mahmah uhi.
english: because of the Chaldeans; for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor over the land.

paite: Huan sepaih pawl heutute leh Kareah tapa Johanan leh Hoshaiah tapa Jezaniah leh mipi tengteng, aneupen a kipan a alianpen tan in ahong nai ua, zawlnei Jeremiah kiang ah:
english: Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even to the greatest, came near,

paite: "Na ma ah ka ngetna uh pom hi henla, hiai akhosuaksun mi tengteng a ding ngei in na Pathian kiang a hon thumsak ding in ka hon ngen uhi; na hon muh bang ngei in mi tampite lak a kipan tawmchik kia nutsiat in ka omta uh.
english: and said to Jeremiah the prophet, “Please let our supplication be presented before you, and pray for us to Yahweh your God, even for all this remnant, for we are left but a few of many, as your eyes see us,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian in ka paina ding thil uh hon kawkmuh theihna ding in," achi uhi.
english: that Yahweh your God may show us the way in which we should walk, and the things that we should do.”

paite: Huchi in zawlnei Jeremiah in akiang uah, "Na thu uh ka za hi, ngai un, na thu uh bangbang in TOUPA na Pathian kiang uah ka ngen ding hi; huan, hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N nou ahon dawn peuhmah ka hon hilh zel ding; na lak uah bangmah ka iim kei ding," achi hi.
english: Then Jeremiah the prophet said to them, “I have heard you. Behold, I will pray to Yahweh your God according to your words; and it will happen that whatever thing Yahweh answers you, I will declare it to you. I will keep nothing back from you.”

paite: Amau Jeremiah kiang ah, "TOUPA na Pathian in ka kiang ua nang ahon sawlna thu tengteng bang zel a ka hih kei uleh ka lak uah TOUPA thu theipa dik leh muanhuai hi hen.
english: Then they said to Jeremiah, “May Yahweh be a true and faithful witness among us, if we don’t do according to all the word with which Yahweh your God sends you to tell us.

paite: Asia hiam apha hiam ka hon sawlna uh TOUPA ka Pathian uh paukam suak ka mang ngeingei ding uh; TOUPA ka Pathian uh paukam suak ka man uleh kou hoihtheihna ding ahi,” achi uhi.
english: Whether it is good, or whether it is bad, we will obey the voice of Yahweh our God, to whom we send you; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of Yahweh our God.”

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, ani sawm nung in TOUPA thu Jeremiah kiang ah ahong tung a.
english: After ten days, Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah.

paite: Huchi in Kareah tapa Johanan leh akiang asepaih heutu om tengteng leh sepaih tengteng, aneupen a kipan alianpen tan in asam a, akiang uah,
english: Then he called Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh, ama a na ngetna uh tun dia na hon sawlna pa un hichi in achi:
english: and said to them, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your supplication before him, says:

paite: Hiai gam a na omdet uleh ka hon tungding ding a, ka hon phelzak kei ding, ka hon phutkip ding a, ka hon botkhe kei ding, na tung ua thil hoih lou ka tutte lah ka lungheita ngal a.
english: ‘If you will still live in this land, then I will build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up; for I grieve over the distress that I have brought on you.

paite: Babulon kumpipa na lau sek uh lau nawn kei un, amah lau kei un chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; akhut a kipan noute hondam ding leh hunkhe ding in na kiang uah ka om hi.
english: Don’t be afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom you are afraid. Don’t be afraid of him,’ says Yahweh, ‘for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.

paite: Na tung ua zah angaihtheihna ding in zahngaihna nou ka hon phal ding a, na gam mah uah ka hon kiksak ding hi.
english: I will grant you mercy, that he may have mercy on you, and cause you to return to your own land.

paite: Himahleh, hiai gam ah i om kei ding uh, chi a TOUPA na Pathian uh aw na man louh ua,
english: “‘But if you say, “We will not dwell in this land,” so that you don’t obey Yahweh your God’s voice,

paite: "Ahi het lou Aigupta gam ah i pai zaw ding ua, huai ah kidouna himhim i tuak kei ding a, pengkul ging leng i za kei ding a, an taksapna a-om sam kei ding, huai ah i teng zaw ding uh," na chih uleh,
english: saying, “No, but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we will see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread; and there we will dwell;”’

paite: Aw Judah khosuaksunte aw, TOUPA thu ngai dih ua; sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi:
english: now therefore hear Yahweh’s word, O remnant of Judah! Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘If you indeed set your faces to enter into Egypt, and go to live there,

paite: Aigupta gam a lut ding leh huai a teng ding a kihei teitei na hih uleh hichi ahong hi ding a, namsau na kihtak ngei un Aigupta gam ah hon pha ding a, kial na kihtak sek un leng Aigupta gam ah nou ahon delhzui ding a, huai ah na si ding uh.
english: then it will happen that the sword, which you fear, will overtake you there in the land of Egypt; and the famine, about which you are afraid, will follow close behind you there in Egypt; and you will die there.

paite: Aigupta gam a teng ding a kihei teiteite tengteng huchibang in a-om ding ua, namsau, kial leh hipi in na si ding uh, thil hoih lou atung ua ka tut ding a kipan kuamah asuakta un abit kei ding uh.
english: So will it be with all the men who set their faces to go into Egypt to live there. They will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence. None of them will remain or escape from the evil that I will bring on them.’

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in huchi in achi hi, "Jerusalem a tengte tung a ka hehna ka sun mah bang in Aigupta gam na lut hun chiang un na tung uah ka hehna ka sung sam ding; hamsethuak leh lamdangsak chiat, mi kamse banna, gensiat na hi ding ua, hiai mun na mu nawn kei ding uh.
english: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘As my anger and my wrath has been poured out on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so my wrath will be poured out on you, when you enter into Egypt; and you will be an object of horror, an astonishment, a curse, and a reproach; and you will see this place no more.’

paite: "Aw Judah khosuaksunte aw, TOUPA'N na tungtang uh agenta hi, Aigupta gam ah lut kei un, hiai ni in nou ka hon theichiansak ahi chih thei mahmah un. Na hinna uh,
english: “Yahweh has spoken concerning you, remnant of Judah, ‘Don’t go into Egypt!’ Know certainly that I have testified to you today.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang ah na hon sawl ua, TOUPA ka Pathian uh kiang ah hon thumsak inla, TOUPA ka Pathian un achihchih hon hilh inla, ka hih zel ding uhi na chi ngal ua.
english: For you have dealt deceitfully against your own souls; for you sent me to Yahweh your God, saying, ‘Pray for us to Yahweh our God; and according to all that Yahweh our God says, so declare to us, and we will do it.’

paite: Tuni in na kiang uah ka puangta ahi; himahleh na kiang ua ahon sawlna bangmah in TOUPA na Pathian uh paukam lah na mang ngal kei ua.
english: I have declared it to you today; but you have not obeyed Yahweh your God’s voice in anything for which he has sent me to you.

paite: Huaiziak in tu'n zaw theita un, tenna na lunggulhna mun ngei uah namsau, kial leh hipi in na si ngeingei ding uh," chi in achi hi.
english: Now therefore know certainly that you will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence in the place where you desire to go to live.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jerusalem mipi tengteng kiang a TOUPA a Pathian uh thu tengteng TOUPA Pathian in gen ding a asawlna thu, huai thu tengteng agen khit in;
english: When Jeremiah had finished speaking to all the people all the words of Yahweh their God, with which Yahweh their God had sent him to them, even all these words,

paite: Hoshaiah tapa Azariah leh Kareah tapa Johanan leh mikiphasak tengteng in, Jeremiah ahoupih ua, akiang ah, "Zuaugen na hi, TOUPA ka Pathian un, 'Aigupta gam a teng ding in na pai ding uh ahi kei, chi a gen ding in nang ahon sawl sam a;'
english: then Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men spoke, saying to Jeremiah, “You speak falsely. Yahweh our God has not sent you to say, ‘You shall not go into Egypt to live there;’

paite: Kaldaite khut a matsak a ka om ua hon thahtheihna ding un leh Babulon sal dia hon pitheihna ding in Neriah tapa Baruk in kou hon sual ding a hon sawl ahi zaw ve," achi uhi.
english: but Baruch the son of Neriah has turned you against us, to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they may put us to death or carry us away captive to Babylon.”

paite: Huchi in Kareah tapa Johanan leh sepaih pawl heutu teng leh mipi tengteng in Judah gam a teng ding in TOUPA aw amang kei uh.
english: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, didn’t obey Yahweh’s voice, to dwell in the land of Judah.

paite: Huchi in Kareah tapa Johanan leh sepaih pawl heutu tengteng in Judah khosuaksun tengteng, Judah gam a teng ding a hawlzak a a-omna namte uh lak a kipan a hong kik;
english: But Johanan the son of Kareah and all the captains of the forces took all the remnant of Judah, who had returned from all the nations where they had been driven, to live in the land of Judah—

paite: pasalte, numeite, naupangte, kumpipa tanute leh michih ngakmi heutu Nebuzaradan in Shaphan tapa, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah leh akiang a anutsiatte uh zawlnei Jeremiah leh Neriah tapa Baruk leng, apikhawm vek zawta uhi.
english: the men, the women, the children, the king’s daughters, and every person who Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan; and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah.

paite: Huchi in Aigupta gam atungta ua, TOUPA aw amang kei ua, huchi in Tahpanhes khua ngei atung uhi.
english: They came into the land of Egypt, for they didn’t obey Yahweh’s voice; and they came to Tahpanhes.

paite: Tahpanhes ah Jeremiah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,

paite: Suang lianpi la inla, Tahpanhes a Pharaoh inn lutna chin a teklei lep zutna ah Judah mite mitmuh ngei in phut in.
english: “Take great stones in your hand and hide them in mortar in the brick work which is at the entry of Pharaoh’s house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Judah.

paite: Akiang uah, Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Ngai un, ka nasempa Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar ka thukhak ding a, ama'n hiai ka suang phumguk tung ah alaltutphah atung ding; ama'n atung uah akumpi puanin akai ding hi.
english: Tell them, Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will set his throne on these stones that I have hidden; and he will spread his royal pavilion over them.

paite: "Huan ahong ding a, Aigupta gam ahong gawt ding a, sihna a si dingte, sihna ah; saltang dingte, saltanna ah, namsau thuak dingte namsau ah.
english: He will come, and will strike the land of Egypt; such as are for death will be put to death, and such as are for captivity to captivity, and such as are for the sword to the sword.

paite: Aigupta mite pathian innte ah meikuangte akhah ding a, akang ding, sal in api ding a; belamchingmi in puan asilh bang in Aigupta gam asilh ding, huai a kipan in galmuang in apawt ding.
english: I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt. He will burn them, and carry them away captive. He will array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd puts on his garment; and he will go out from there in peace.

paite: Aigupta gam a Beth-shemesh khuam zeknei sang pipite achimsak ding a, Aigupta pathian innte mei in ahal ding, achi, chi in,” achi hi.
english: He will also break the pillars of Beth Shemesh that is in the land of Egypt; and he will burn the houses of the gods of Egypt with fire.’”

paite: Aigupta gam a Juda om tengteng, Migdol khua, Tahpanhes khua, Memphis khua leh Pathros gam a tengte tungtang a Jeremiah kiang a thu hong tung,
english: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews who lived in the land of Egypt, who lived at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Memphis, and in the country of Pathros, saying,

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: Jerusalem leh Judah khopite tung a thil hoih lou ka hon tutte na muta uh; ngai dih ua, tu in ahong segawpta a, kuamah ateng kei uh,
english: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘You have seen all the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, and on all the cities of Judah. Behold, today they are a desolation, and no man dwells in them,

paite: amau nou leh na pipute un pathian dangte atheih ngei nai louh uh na sem ding leh akiang ua gimlim hal in, kei hon hehsak ding uh; aginatlouhnate uh ahih khit tak ziak un.
english: because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger, in that they went to burn incense, to serve other gods that they didn’t know, neither they, nor you, nor your fathers.

paite: Huchi pipi in na kiang uah nasem zawlnei tengteng phalvak a thou in ka sawl a, akiang uah, "Aw, hiai thu kihhuai, ka huat lamtak hih kei un,” chi in.
english: However I sent to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, “Oh, don’t do this abominable thing that I hate.”

paite: Himahleh angaikhe tuan kei ua, aginatlouhna uh pathian dangte kiang a gimlim hal louh ding pen angeingaih kei uh.
english: But they didn’t listen and didn’t incline their ear. They didn’t turn from their wickedness, to stop burning incense to other gods.

paite: Huaiziak in ka hehna leh ka thangpaihna Judah khopite leh Jerusalem kongzingte ah ka sung a akuangta a, tuni a a-om bang in asia a, asegawpta hi.
english: Therefore my wrath and my anger was poured out, and was kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are wasted and desolate, as it is today.’

paite: Huaiziak in tu in zaw TOUPA sepaihte' Pathian, Israel' Pathian in na lak ua kipan numei pasal, naungekte leh nawi ne laite Judah lak a kipan kuamah hawi lou a gawimang vek ding in bangziak a hiai thil hoih loutak na hinna uh tung a hih na hi ua?
english: “Therefore now Yahweh, the God of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Why do you commit great evil against your own souls, to cut off from yourselves man and woman, infant and nursing child out of the middle of Judah, to leave yourselves no one remaining,

paite: Na va tenna uh Aigupta gam pathiante kiang a gimlim hal in leitung gam teng a nam chih lak a hamsethuak leh gensiat na hihtheihna ding uh leh gawimang na hihtheihna ding ua na khut thilhih ngei ua hon hehsak na hi uh.
english: in that you provoke me to anger with the works of your hands, burning incense to other gods in the land of Egypt where you have gone to live, that you may be cut off, and that you may be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?

paite: Na pipute uh gitlouhnate, Judah kumpipate gitlouhnate leh na zite uh gitlouhna, Judah gam leh Jerusalem kongzing a ahih khitsate uh na mangngilhta ua hia?
english: Have you forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, the wickedness of the kings of Judah, the wickedness of their wives, your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives which they committed in the land of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

paite: Tuni tan in leng akisik tuan kei ua, na pipute uh leh noumau ma a ka taklat ka dan leh ka dan thusehte na zui kei ua, na lau sam kei uh.
english: They are not humbled even to this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.’

paite: Huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Ngai un, na siatna ding un Judah tengteng gawimang vek ding in nou ka hon maituah ding hi.
english: “Therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, even to cut off all Judah.

paite: Huan Judah khosuaksun, Aigupta gam a ten tum a kihei teiteite ka man ding a, achimit vek ding uh; Aigupta gam ah apuk ding ua, namsau leh kialte a hihman in a-om ding uh; aneupen a kipan alianpen tan in namsau leh kial in asi ding uh.
english: I will take the remnant of Judah that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to live there, and they will all be consumed. They will fall in the land of Egypt. They will be consumed by the sword and by the famine. They will die, from the least even to the greatest, by the sword and by the famine. They will be an object of horror, an astonishment, a curse, and a reproach.

paite: Jerusalem ka gawt bangmah in Aigupta gam a tengte namsaute, kialte leh hipite a gawt ding ka hi ngal a.
english: For I will punish those who dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence;

paite: Huchi in Aigupta gam a teng ding a kuan Judah khosuaksunte Judah gam, a-omna ding ua kik nawn a-utna mahmah gam uah kik ding in khat lel leng hingdam in asuakta kei ding uh, asim a taikhete kia lou ngal kuamah akik kei ding uh."
english: so that none of the remnant of Judah, who have gone into the land of Egypt to live there, will escape or be left to return into the land of Judah, to which they have a desire to return to dwell there; for no one will return except those who will escape.’”

paite: Huchi in mi tengteng, azite un pathian dang kiang a gimlim ahal chih theite leh numei huai a dinghte mipi tampi, Aigupta gam a teng mipi tengteng in, Pathros ah Jeremiah adawng ua, hichi in achi uh;
english: Then all the men who knew that their wives burned incense to other gods, and all the women who stood by, a great assembly, even all the people who lived in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,

paite: "TOUPA min a ka kiang ua na thugente zaw ka hon ngaihkhiaksak kei ding uh.
english: “As for the word that you have spoken to us in Yahweh’s name, we will not listen to you.

paite: Kou leh ka pipute uh, ka kumpipate uh leh ka heutute un Judah khopite ah leh Jerusalem kongzingte ah ana hih zel bang un van kumpinu kiang a gimlim halte leh akiang a dawn ding thillat butkhiakte, ka paukam suak peuhmah bang un ka hih ngeingei ding uh; huchih lai in ka lamzang ua, nek-le-dawn ding atam a, siatna himhim ka mu sam ua.
english: But we will certainly perform every word that has gone out of our mouth, to burn incense to the queen of the sky and to pour out drink offerings to her, as we have done, we and our fathers, our kings and our princes, in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; for then we had plenty of food, and were well, and saw no evil.

paite: Van kumpinu kiang a thil hal leh akiang a dawn ding thillat butkhiakte ka tawp nungsiah uh bangpeuh ka tasam zawta ua, namsau leh kialte a hihman in ka omta uhi."
english: But since we stopped burning incense to the queen of the sky, and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have lacked all things, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.”

paite: Huan numeite'n, "Van kumpinu kiang a gimlim ka hal lai uh leh akiang a dawn ding thillatte ka butkhiak uh?" achi uhi.
english: The women said, “When we burned incense to the queen of the sky and poured out drink offerings to her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings to her, without our husbands?”

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah in mipi tengteng, numei pasal amah dawng mite tengteng kiang ah,
english: Then Jeremiah said to all the people—to the men and to the women, even to all the people who had given him an answer, saying,

paite: "Judah khopite leh Jerusalem kongzingte ah, nou leh na pipute uh, na kumpipate uh leh na heutute uh leh gam a mipite'n gimlim ahalte uh TOUPA'N atheigige in alungsim ah akhum kei maw?
english: “The incense that you burned in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, you and your fathers, your kings and your princes, and the people of the land, didn’t Yahweh remember them, and didn’t it come into his mind?

paite: Na thil gilou hih ziak uleh na thilkihhuai hihte uh ziak in TOUPA'N athuak ngap nawnta kei hi; huaiziak in, na gam uh tua a-om bang in asia a, lamdangsak chiat, hamsethuak, tengmi om lou, ahong hita hi.
english: Thus Yahweh could no longer bear it, because of the evil of your doings and because of the abominations which you have committed. Therefore your land has become a desolation, an astonishment, and a curse, without inhabitant, as it is today.

paite: Gimlim na hal ua, TOUPA tung ah na gilou ua, TOUPA paukam suakte na mang kei ua, adan hiam adan thusehte hiam athu theihsakte hiam na zuih sam louh ziak un hiai thil hoih lou tua a-om bang in na tung uah ahong tungta hi," achi a.
english: Because you have burned incense and because you have sinned against Yahweh, and have not obeyed Yahweh’s voice, nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil has happened to you, as it is today.”

paite: Huai lou leng Jeremiah in mipi tengteng leh numeite kiang ah, "Aigupta gam a Judah tengteng aw, TOUPA thu za un, sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi:
english: Moreover Jeremiah said to all the people, including all the women, “Hear Yahweh’s word, all Judah who are in the land of Egypt!

paite: Nou leh na zite un, van kumpinu kiang a gimlim hal leh dawn ding thillat butkhiakte ka na chiamsa bang zel in ka hih ngeingei ding, chi in na kam un na genta ua, na khut un na pichingsak lai uhi. 'Na thuchiamte uh hihkip unla, na thu tupte uh tangtungsak vanglak un.'
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘You and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and with your hands have fulfilled it, saying, “We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to her.” “‘Establish then your vows, and perform your vows.’

paite: Huaiziak in nou Judah, Aigupta gam a tengte aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia un: Ngai un, Toupa PATHIAN ahin bang in chi in Aigupta gam pumpi a teng, Judah mi kua kam mah ah ka min aging nawn ngei kei ding, chi in ka min thupi lou in ka kichiam ahi chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Therefore hear Yahweh’s word, all Judah who dwell in the land of Egypt: ‘Behold, I have sworn by my great name,’ says Yahweh, ‘that my name will no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, “As the Lord Yahweh lives.”

paite: Ngai in, ahoihna ding uh hilou in asiatna ding un amau ka tang thek ahi; huchi in Judah mi, Aigupta gam a omte tengteng, namsau leh kialte ahihman in a-om ding uh, amanthat vek matan un.
english: Behold, I watch over them for evil, and not for good; and all the men of Judah who are in the land of Egypt will be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until they are all gone.

paite: Namsau hihman val tawmchik Aigupta gam a kipan a pawt in Judah gam ah alut ding uh; huan, Judah mi khosuaksunte tengteng, Aigupta gam a teng ding a kuan mite'n kua thu ahia pai zaw ding, ka thu hia amau thu, athei ding uh.
english: Those who escape the sword will return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah few in number. All the remnant of Judah, who have gone into the land of Egypt to live there, will know whose word will stand, mine or theirs.

paite: "Huan hiai nou a ding in chiamtehna ahi ding; na tung uah thil hoih lou lam in ka thu apai ngei ding chih na theihna ding un hiai mun ah nou ka hon gawt ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “‘This will be the sign to you,’ says Yahweh, ‘that I will punish you in this place, that you may know that my words will surely stand against you for evil.’

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai un, Pharaoh Hophra, Aigupta kumpipa bel amelma, ahinna zong mite khut ah ka mangsak ding, Judah kumpipa Zedekiah, amelma, ahinna zongmi Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar khut a ka piak bangmah in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will give Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies and into the hand of those who seek his life, just as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who was his enemy and sought his life.’”

paite: Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim, Josiah tapa akum lina ah Jeremiah kam a kipan, hiai thute laibu a agelh lai a, Neriah tapa Baruk kiang a zawlnei Jeremiah thugen:
english: The message that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch the son of Neriah, when he wrote these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying,

paite: Baruk aw, TOUPA Israel' Pathian in, na kiang ah hichi in achi:
english: “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says to you, Baruch:

paite: Nang, "Ka tung gik hi na mai e, TOUPA'N ka thuakna ah lungkhamna ahon behlapta ngal a; ka mauna ka bahpih a, tawldamna ka muzou kei," na chi a.
english: ‘You said, “Woe is me now! For Yahweh has added sorrow to my pain! I am weary with my groaning, and I find no rest.”’

paite: Akiang ah hichi in na gen ding ahi, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngai in, ka lamsa ka phel nawn ding a, gam pumpi mahmah ah ka phuhsa ka botkhe nawn ding.
english: “You shall tell him, Yahweh says: ‘Behold, that which I have built, I will break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up; and this in the whole land.

paite: Huan nang a ding in thil thupi na zong hia? Zong dah mai in; sa tengteng tung ah thil hoih lou ka hon tungsak ding a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; himahleh na hinna bel mun chih a na paina ah gallak ding in ka hon pe ding,” chi in.
english: Do you seek great things for yourself? Don’t seek them; for, behold, I will bring evil on all flesh,’ says Yahweh, ‘but I will let you escape with your life wherever you go.’”

paite: Namte tungtang a zawlnei Jeremiah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung;
english: Yahweh’s word which came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.

paite: Aigupta thu, Euphrates Luipi gei a Karkhemish a om, Judah kumpipa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim, akum lina a Nebukadnezzar in anuaisiah leh Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh Neko sepaihhonte tungtang thu:
english: Of Egypt: concerning the army of Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah.

paite: "Lum bemte, lum zawlte mansa in om unla, gal nawt un,
english: “Prepare the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle!

paite: Sakol van unla, sakol tuang mite aw, tuang un, dal lukhu khu in dingkip unla, tei tat-hiam in sik puanak silh un.
english: Harness the horses, and get up, you horsemen, and stand up with your helmets. Polish the spears, put on the coats of mail.

paite: Bangchidan a amaute lau-le- ling a taikek a mu ka hia! Agalkap mite uh avuallel uh, baksam leng zen in atai ua, nunglam nga het lou in, ning chih ah gal alang chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Why have I seen it? They are dismayed and are turned backward. Their mighty ones are beaten down, have fled in haste, and don’t look back. Terror is on every side,” says Yahweh.

paite: Mizuanzaang ataimang thei kei, galkapmi apawt tuan kei uh, huai a mi Euphrates Luipi gei ah ahawi ua, apuk khinta uh.
english: “Don’t let the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape. In the north by the river Euphrates they have stumbled and fallen.

paite: Nile lui bang a khang kua ahia? Luipi tuikihot kimvel bang in?
english: “Who is this who rises up like the Nile, like rivers whose waters surge?

paite: Aigupta Nile lui bang in akhang a luipi tuikihot kimvel bang mai in, ka khang ding a, leitung ka luahsuak ding, khopi leh aluahte ka hihse ding," achi hi.
english: Egypt rises up like the Nile, like rivers whose waters surge. He says, ‘I will rise up. I will cover the earth. I will destroy cities and its inhabitants.’

paite: "Aw sakolte aw, nawk zel unla, aw kangtalai aw, nakpi in pang un; galdou mite'n ma phu uhenla, Ethiopia mi leh Put mi, lum tawi mite, Lud mi thalpeu zang siamte toh.
english: Go up, you horses! Rage, you chariots! Let the mighty men go out: Cush and Put, who handle the shield; and the Ludim, who handle and bend the bow.

paite: Huai ni ahi, Toupa sepaihte' TOUPA ni, phulak ni, amelmate tung a phu alaktheihna, namsau in agai ding a, atai ding, asisan uh taitak in adawn ding; Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N mal gam ah Euphrates Luipi gei ah mi tampi agou phengphung mai ve.
english: For that day is of the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge himself of his adversaries. The sword will devour and be satiated, and will drink its fill of their blood; for the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, has a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.

paite: Aw, Aigupta tanu siangthou, Gilead ah hohtou inla, singnai nuhchi va la in, damdawi tampi athawn in na zangta, nang a ding in damna himhim a-om kei hi.
english: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, virgin daughter of Egypt. You use many medicines in vain. There is no healing for you.

paite: Namte'n na zahlakna aza ua, na kah in leitung pumpi adim hi, galhatmi leh galhatmi akiphu ua, lei ah apukkhawm uh," chi in.
english: The nations have heard of your shame, and the earth is full of your cry; for the mighty man has stumbled against the mighty, they both fall together.”

paite: Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar hong pai a, Aigupta gam ahong bawl ekdan ding thu TOUPA'N zawlnei Jeremiah kiang a agen:
english: The word that Yahweh spoke to Jeremiah the prophet, how that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon should come and strike the land of Egypt:

paite: "Aigupta gam ah gen unla, Migdol ah puang un; Memphis leh Tahpanhes ah puang unla; dingkip in kigalging un; na kim a mi namsau in agaita ngal a.
english: “Declare in Egypt, publish in Migdol, and publish in Memphis and in Tahpanhes; say, ‘Stand up, and prepare, for the sword has devoured around you.’

paite: Bangziak a na mihatte phiatmang a om ahi ua? Adingh zou kei ua, TOUPA'N apaihkhiak ziak in.
english: Why are your strong ones swept away? They didn’t stand, because Yahweh pushed them.

paite: Mi tampi akisuisak a, ahi, akiphupuk lemlum ua, Nuaisiahna namsau taisan in kisa un, i kik ding uh, i pianna gam ah i mite kiang ah, achi uhi.
english: He made many to stumble. Yes, they fell on one another. They said, ‘Arise! Let’s go again to our own people, and to the land of our birth, from the oppressing sword.’

paite: Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh pen husa lian lel, ahun sehsa a paimangsak a om, chi in huai ah akikou uhi.
english: They cried there, ‘Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he has let the appointed time pass by.’

paite: Ahin a ka hin sung in chih Kumpipa, amin Sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi hi, tangte lak a Tabor tang bang in tuipi chin a Karmel tang bang in ahong pai ngei ding.
english: “As I live,” says the King, whose name is Yahweh of Armies, “surely like Tabor among the mountains, and like Carmel by the sea, so he will come.

paite: Aw nang, tanu, Aigupta gam a teng, saltang ding in kibawl mai in; Memphis akisegawp dek a, teng ding om lou in akangmang ding hi.
english: You daughter who dwells in Egypt, furnish yourself to go into captivity; for Memphis will become a desolation, and will be burned up, without inhabitant.

paite: Aigupta bel bawngla hoihtak ahi, himahleh mal a kipan nasemmi ding hong kuan in ahong pai hi.
english: “Egypt is a very beautiful heifer; but destruction out of the north has come. It has come.

paite: Alak ua sepaih goihlaite bel bawngtuai vak thau bang mai ahi ua, adek uh angat ua, ataikek ua, khawl lou in, atung uah asiatna ni uh atungta, agawtna hun ding uh;
english: Also her hired men in the middle of her are like calves of the stall, for they also are turned back. They have fled away together. They didn’t stand, for the day of their calamity has come on them, the time of their visitation.

paite: Gulpi kitholh bang mai in husa anei a, amelmate kiton in ahong pai ua, singphuk mite bang in hei toh ahong sual uh.
english: Its sound will go like the serpent, for they will march with an army, and come against her with axes, as wood cutters.

paite: Agam gammang vaksuak zoh louh ahong hihse ding uh, khaukhup sang in atamzaw ua, sim seng louh ahi uh.
english: They will cut down her forest,” says Yahweh, “though it can’t be searched; because they are more than the locusts, and are innumerable.

paite: Aigupta tanu azahlak ding, mallam a mi khut a matsak in a-om ding."
english: The daughter of Egypt will be disappointed; she will be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.”

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Ngai un, Thebes khua a Ammon, leh Pharaoh leh Aigupta leh apathiante, akumpipate, Pharaoh ngei leh amah muang mite ka gawt ding.
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will punish Amon of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with her gods and her kings, even Pharaoh, and those who trust in him.

paite: Ahinna uh, zong mite khut ah leh Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar leh anasem mite khut ah ka mansak ding; huai hun chiang in luah in a-om ding, nidanglai nite mah bang in," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: I will deliver them into the hand of those who seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants. Afterwards it will be inhabited, as in the days of old,” says Yahweh.

paite: "Jakob aw, ka nasempa, lau ke'nla, aw Israel, lunglel sam ke'n, ngai in, gamlapi a kipan nang ka hon hunkhe ding a, na suante leng asaltanna gam ua kipan, Jakob ahong kik ding a, muangtak in a-om hiathiat ding a, kuamah in alausak nawn kei ding uh.
english: “But don’t you be afraid, Jacob my servant. Don’t be dismayed, Israel; for, behold, I will save you from afar, and your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob will return, and will be quiet and at ease. No one will make him afraid.

paite: Jakob aw, ka nasempa, lau ke'n, ka hon ompih ahi," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; ka hon delhzakna nam tengteng ka beisak ding a, nang zaw ka hon beisak het kei ding; diktak in ka hon gawt ding a, gawt louh in ka hon khak kei ding hi.
english: Don’t be afraid, O Jacob my servant,” says Yahweh, “for I am with you; for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have driven you, but I will not make a full end of you, but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.”

paite: Pharaoh in Gaza agawt ma a Philistia mite tungtang a zawlnei Jeremiah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung.
english: Yahweh’s word that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh struck Gaza.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngai un, mal a kipan in tui ahong khang hi, akuang dim in aluanglet ding; gam atum ding a asung a om tengteng toh, khopi leh asung a tengte leng; mite akap ding ua, gam a mi tengteng amau tuaituai ding uh.
english: Yahweh says: “Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and will become an overflowing stream, and will overflow the land and all that is therein, the city and those who dwell therein. The men will cry, and all the inhabitants of the land will wail.

paite: Asakol hat chinte leitot ging in kidou kangtalai ging dopdop in, akangtalai ging in, pate alunglel ua, atate uh en lou zen in.
english: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong ones, at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers don’t look back for their children because their hands are so feeble,

paite: Philistia mi tengteng lohna ni, Tura leh Sidon a kipan apanpih mi khosuaksunte sattanna ni ziak in, TOUPA'N tuipi gei Kaphtor omlaite ahihse ding hi.
english: because of the day that comes to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper who remains; for Yahweh will destroy the Philistines, the remnant of the isle of Caphtor.

paite: Gaza mite lu ahong giauta, Ashkelon achimitta a, agam phaizang a teng khosuaksunte; bang tan kiat ding na hia?
english: Baldness has come on Gaza; Ashkelon is brought to nothing. You remnant of their valley, how long will you cut yourself?

paite: Aw TOUPA namsau, na om kinken ma bang tan a sawt ahia? Na pai ah kikhum in; khawl inla om kinken ve.
english: “‘You sword of Yahweh, how long will it be before you are quiet? Put yourself back into your scabbard; rest, and be still.’

paite: TOUPA'N Ashkelon leh tuipi gei tung a gamtang ding a, ahon seh a, hih ding ahon piak ngalleh bangchi in na om kinken thei dia?
english: “How can you be quiet, since Yahweh has given you a command? Against Ashkelon, and against the seashore, there he has appointed it.”

paite: Moab tungtang thu; sepaihte’ TOUPA Pathian in hichi in achi: "Nebo tung agik hi; hihgawp in a-omta; Kiriathaim zahlaksak in a- omta, laksuan ahi. Misgab bel zahlak leh hihsiat in a-omta.
english: Of Moab. Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Woe to Nebo! For it is laid waste. Kiriathaim is disappointed. It is taken. Misgab is put to shame and broken down.

paite: Moab minthanna amangta; Heshbon ah asiatna ding gen in, 'Kisa un, nam ahihna kipan i hihmang ding uh,' " achi ua. Aw Madmen khua, nang leng daihsak sipsip na hi ding a, namsau in ahon delh ding.
english: The praise of Moab is no more. In Heshbon they have devised evil against her: ‘Come! Let’s cut her off from being a nation.’ You also, Madmen, will be brought to silence. The sword will pursue you.

paite: Horonaim a kipan akikou husa, lohna leh siatna thupi mahmah.
english: The sound of a cry from Horonaim, desolation and great destruction!

paite: Moab suksiat ahi a, atate kap ging zak in a-om hi,
english: Moab is destroyed. Her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

paite: Luhith ah kap in apaitou ua, Horonaim sul ah manthatna kikou ging lunglelhhuai aza uh.
english: For they will go up by the ascent of Luhith with continual weeping. For at the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distress of the cry of destruction.

paite: Taimang unla, na hinna uh humbit un, gamdai gam sabiltung bang in om un.
english: Flee! Save your lives! Be like the juniper bush in the wilderness.

paite: Na nasep leh na sum-le-pai na muan ziak in nang leng mat in na om ding hi, Khemosh sal a pi ahi ding; asiampute leh aheutute toh.
english: For, because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you also will be taken. Chemosh will go out into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

paite: Kho chih ah hihsemi ahong tung ding, kho khat lel in leng apel kei ding; phaizang gam leng amang ding; phaizang hihsiat ahi ding. TOUPA'N achihsa bang in.
english: The destroyer will come on every city, and no city will escape; the valley also will perish, and the plain will be destroyed, as Yahweh has spoken.

paite: Alenmang theihna ding in Moab kha pia un, tengmi om lou in, akhuate akisegawp ding.
english: Give wings to Moab, that she may fly and get herself away: and her cities will become a desolation, without anyone to dwell in them.

paite: Limsak loutak a Pathian nna semmi hamsethuak in om henla, sisan suah ding a anamsau zang nuamloumi hamsethuak in om hen.
english: “Cursed is he who does the work of Yahweh negligently; and cursed is he who keeps back his sword from blood.

paite: Atuailai a kipan Moab in nuam asa a, a-uain abohkhum a, bel dang a teituah leng atuak kei a, sal a pi in a-om ngei sam kei hi, alim ngeingei a lim gige in, agim leng alamdang tuan kei.
english: “Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his dregs, and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither has he gone into captivity; therefore his taste remains in him, and his scent is not changed.

paite: "Huaiziak in ngai un, nite ahong tung hi, abungkhe ding mi ka hon sawl ding a, huan amau abungkhe ding uh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; abelte avuaksak ding ua, a-umte ahihkek ding uh.
english: Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will send to him those who pour off, and they will pour him off; and they will empty his vessels, and break their containers in pieces.

paite: Israel inkote'n amuanpi pen uh Bethel azahpih bang un Moab in Khemosh azahpihta ding hi.
english: Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their confidence.

paite: Pasal hoih leh galdou mihangsan i hi ua, bangchidan a chi na hi ua?
english: “How do you say, ‘We are mighty men, and valiant men for the war’?

paite: Moab bel hihgawp in a-om a, akhopi meikhu in azam khinta, atangval hoih teng apuk khinta chih Kumpipa, amin Sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Moab is laid waste, and they have gone up into his cities, and his chosen young men have gone down to the slaughter,” says the King, whose name is Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Moab siatna ahong tung lellel, athuakna ding akinoh hi.
english: “The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hurries fast.

paite: Nou akim a mi teng in amah suun in amin thei teng in chiangkhun khauh leh chiang thupi akitanta hi, chi un.
english: All you who are around him, bemoan him; and all you who know his name, say, ‘How the strong staff is broken, the beautiful rod!’

paite: Aw nang tanu, Dibon a teng, na thupina paisan inla, dangtak in tu in; Moab lokmi'n nang ahon sual a, na kulhte ahihseta hi.
english: “You daughter who dwells in Dibon, come down from your glory, and sit in thirst; for the destroyer of Moab has come up against you. He has destroyed your strongholds.

paite: Aw Aroer a teng nu, kongbul ah dingh in, enkhia in, taikekpa, suaktanu dong inla, Bang amaizen a? chi in.
english: Inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way and watch. Ask him who flees, and her who escapes; say, ‘What has been done?’

paite: Moab zahlaksak in a-omta, achimgawpta ngal a, mau tuaituai in kap un, Moab hihsiat ahita! chih Arnon ah puang un.
english: Moab is disappointed; for it is broken down. Wail and cry! Tell it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.

paite: Gam tampi tung ah; Holon, Zahjah, Mephaath,
english: Judgment has come on the plain country— on Holon, on Jahzah, on Mephaath,

paite: leh Dibon, Nebo, Beth-diblathaim,
english: on Dibon, on Nebo, on Beth Diblathaim,

paite: leh Keriathaim, Beth-gamul, Beth-menon,
english: on Kiriathaim, on Beth Gamul, on Beth Meon,

paite: leh Kerioth, Bozrah leh Moab gam a khua tengteng, agamla leh anai ah vaihawmna ahong tungta hi.
english: on Kerioth, on Bozrah, and on all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.

paite: Moab ki-attan in a-om a, aban hihtan in a-omta, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken,” says Yahweh.

paite: Amah dawnkhamsak un; TOUPA tung ah akiliansak ngal a; huan, Moab bel amah luak ah akitholh ding a, nuihsan in a-om lai ding hi.
english: “Make him drunk, for he magnified himself against Yahweh. Moab will wallow in his vomit, and he also will be in derision.

paite: Israel nang ding nuihza bawlna ahita kei maw? Gutate lak ah atel a hia? Amah tungtang na gen teng in na lu na sinkhum hilou hiam?
english: For wasn’t Israel a derision to you? Was he found among thieves? For as often as you speak of him, you shake your head.

paite: Moab a tengte aw, khopite taisan unla, kawl kikal ah teng un, vakhu, kohawm gei a bu bawlsek bang in om un.
english: You inhabitants of Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock. Be like the dove that makes her nest over the mouth of the abyss.

paite: Moab kisaktheihna ka zata ua, akisathei ngut ve, akikoih sandan, akisaktheihdan, aki-otsakdan leh alungtang kideihkhopdante.
english: “We have heard of the pride of Moab. He is very proud in his loftiness, his pride, his arrogance, and the arrogance of his heart.

paite: Ahehna bangmah ahi kei chih ka thei; aki-otsaknate'n bangmah ahih ko kei, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: I know his wrath,” says Yahweh, “that it is nothing; his boastings have done nothing.

paite: Huchi in Moab tung ah ka mau tuaituai ding a, ahi, Moab pumpi a ding in ka kap ding, Kir-hareseth mite suun ahi ding uh.
english: Therefore I will wail for Moab. Yes, I will cry out for all Moab. They will mourn for the men of Kir Heres.

paite: Jazer kap sang a thupi in ka hon kah ding a, aw Sibmah grep kung, na hiangte tuipi tung ah akiphalh a, Jazer tuipi leng atung hialta a, na nipithei leh grep gahte hihsemi in abawm hi.
english: With more than the weeping of Jazer I will weep for you, vine of Sibmah. Your branches passed over the sea. They reached even to the sea of Jazer. The destroyer has fallen on your summer fruits and on your vintage.

paite: Nopna leh kipahna amang khin hi, theibil leh Moab gam a kipan; uain sukna khuk a ka uain ka beisakta a, kuamah in nuamsa a kikou in achil nawn kei ding uh.
english: Gladness and joy is taken away from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab. I have caused wine to cease from the wine presses. No one will tread with shouting. The shouting will be no shouting.

paite: Heshbon leh Elealeh ah akikou ua, Jahaz tan in aw asuah ua, Zoar a kipan Horonaim tan, Eglath-shelishijah tan in leng, Nimrim tui kim adai ding hi.
english: From the cry of Heshbon even to Elealeh, even to Jahaz they have uttered their voice, from Zoar even to Horonaim, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for the waters of Nimrim will also become desolate.

paite: Huai lou in Moab mun sangte thil lanmi leh apathiante a dia gimlim halmi ka hihmang ding, TOUPA thupawt in achi hi.
english: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab,” says Yahweh, “him who offers in the high place, and him who burns incense to his gods.

paite: Huchi in tamngai bang in ka lungtang Moab a ding in aging a, Kir-hareseth mite a ding in tumging bang in ka lungtang aging hi; huaiziak in niang-le-tai a thil amuhsate amangthang khinta hi.
english: Therefore my heart sounds for Moab like flutes, and my heart sounds like flutes for the men of Kir Heres. Therefore the abundance that he has gotten has perished.

paite: Lu chiteng metgiau ahi a, khamul chiteng met ahi; khut tengteng at ahi a; kongte ah sai-ip puan a-om chiat hi.
english: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped. There are cuttings on all the hands, and sackcloth on the waist.

paite: Moab inn tung tengteng, kongzing leh mun chih ah kahna a-om a; Moab bel phatuam nawn lou bang in ka hihkham khinta hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: On all the housetops of Moab, and in its streets, there is lamentation everywhere; for I have broken Moab like a vessel in which no one delights,” says Yahweh.

paite: Seta namai e! Segawp zou hi na tel e; Moab zahlak in alehngatta ve; huchi in Moab bel akimvel a mite tengteng a ding in nuihza bawlna leh mulkimhuai ahong hita hi.
english: “How it is broken down! How they wail! How Moab has turned the back with shame! So will Moab become a derision and a terror to all who are around him.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngai in, mu bang in aleng ding a, Moab tung ah akha azak ding.
english: For Yahweh says: “Behold, he will fly as an eagle, and will spread out his wings against Moab.

paite: Kerioth lak ahi a, akulhte aphawng guih a, huai ni in Moab pasalphate lungtang numei nauvei lungtang bang mai ahi ding.
english: Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized. The heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day will be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

paite: Moab amangthang ding, nam aching nawn kei ding; TOUPA anuaisiah zawk ziak in.
english: Moab will be destroyed from being a people, because he has magnified himself against Yahweh.

paite: Launa, kokhuk leh tangte, aw Moab luahmi, na tung ah atung hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Terror, the pit, and the snare are on you, inhabitant of Moab,” says Yahweh.

paite: Launa taisanmi kokhuk ah ake ding a, kokhuk a pawt thang ah a-awk ding, agawtna kum ka hon tun sin ngal a, atung ah, Moab tung ah ngei, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “He who flees from the terror will fall into the pit; and he who gets up out of the pit will be taken in the snare, for I will bring on him, even on Moab, the year of their visitation,” says Yahweh.

paite: Heshbon lim ah taikekpawl bahgawp in akhawl ding ua, Heshbon a kipan in mei apawt a, Sihon lak a kipan in meikuang, chiak vengvung mite sip a sam toh Moab baksam akang khin hi.
english: “Those who fled stand without strength under the shadow of Heshbon; for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, and a flame from the middle of Sihon, and has devoured the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.

paite: Na tung agik hi, aw Moab! Khemosh mite amangta ua; na tapate sal a pi in, na tanute sal in atangta uhi.
english: Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh are undone; for your sons are taken away captive, and your daughters into captivity.

paite: Himahleh ni nanung chiang in Moab omdan ka hei ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Hichi tan Moab tungthu ahi.
english: “Yet I will reverse the captivity of Moab in the latter days,” says Yahweh. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.

paite: Ammon mite thu, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Israel in tate anei kei a hia? Gouluahmi nei lou hia? Bang achia ahia akumpipa'n Gad atantak a, khopite a amite aten uh?
english: Of the children of Ammon. Yahweh says: “Has Israel no sons? Has he no heir? Why then does Malcam possess Gad, and his people dwell in its cities?

paite: Huaiziak in ngai un, nite ahong tùng hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Ammon tate Rabbah ah kidou husa ging ka kizasak ding, thil sia omkhawm lel ahong hi ding hi, atanute mei in akang ding a, huchi in Israel in amah neimi anei thuk ding, TOUPA'N achi.
english: Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and it will become a desolate heap, and her daughters will be burned with fire; then Israel will possess those who possessed him,” says Yahweh.

paite: Aw Heshbon, mau tuaituai inla, Ai alok khinta ua; Rabbah tate aw, kap un, kap unla, umna sungte ah vialtai un. Kumpipa, siampu leh amiliante toh sal a pi in a-om ding uhi.
english: “Wail, Heshbon, for Ai is laid waste! Cry, you daughters of Rabbah! Clothe yourself in sackcloth. Lament, and run back and forth among the fences; for Malcam will go into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

paite: Bangziak a na phaizang hoihte suang na hia, aw muanhuailounu aneih hoihhoihte muang a, 'Kua ahia hon sual ding?' chichi nak mi.
english: Why do you boast in the valleys, your flowing valley, backsliding daughter? You trusted in her treasures, saying, ‘Who will come to me?’

paite: Ngai in, na tung ah launa ka hon tun ding a, na kim a mi tengteng a kipan, chih Toupa sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi; michih delhkhiak na hi vek ding uh, kuamah in taikekpawl akaikhawm kei ding uh.
english: Behold, I will bring a terror on you,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, “from all who are around you. All of you will be driven completely out, and there will be no one to gather together the fugitives.

paite: "Huai khit chiang in bel Ammon tate omdan ka kiheisak ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “But afterward I will reverse the captivity of the children of Ammon,” says Yahweh.

paite: Edom thu, Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Teman a pilna om nawn lou ahi maw? Lemthei lemtheihna amang khinta a hia? Apilna uh mang khin hia?
english: Of Edom, Yahweh of Armies says: “Is wisdom no more in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom vanished?

paite: Aw Dedan a tengte aw, taikek unla, lehngat unla, tummang vengveng un; amah ka gawt hun chiang in, Esau siatna atung ah ka hon tun ding hi.
english: Flee! Turn back! Dwell in the depths, inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau on him when I visit him.

paite: Grep lou mite na kiang a ahong pai un, maih anei kei ding ua hia? Zan a guta mite'n adeihzah uh angah masiah un alok zel kei ding ua hia?
english: If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? If thieves came by night, wouldn’t they steal until they had enough?

paite: Esau ka vuaktang sakta a, agukkhuhte ka hongta, abu thei nawn kei ding. Asuante hihsiat ahi ua, a-unaute, a-invengte toh a-omta kei.
english: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he will not be able to hide himself. His offspring is destroyed, with his brothers and his neighbors; and he is no more.

paite: Na tagahte limsak ke'n, ke'n ka hum ding, na meithaite'n kei hon muang uhen."
english: Leave your fatherless children. I will preserve them alive. Let your widows trust in me.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Nou dawn lou dingte'n leng adawn mawk uleh, nang gawt louh hial in na suakta ding a hia? Gawt louh in na pawt kei ding, na dawn mahmah ding hi.
english: For Yahweh says: “Behold, they to whom it didn’t pertain to drink of the cup will certainly drink; and are you he who will altogether go unpunished? You won’t go unpunished, but you will surely drink.

paite: TOUPA'N keimah kilou in ka kichiamta ngal a, Bozrah lamdangsak chiat, gensiat, hihgawp, hamsethuak ahi ding, akhua tengteng leng asegawp tawntung ding," achi hi.
english: For I have sworn by myself,” says Yahweh, “that Bozrah will become an astonishment, a reproach, a waste, and a curse. All its cities will be perpetual wastes.”

paite: TOUPA kiang a kipan thupuan ka zata, namte kiang ah sawltak sawl ahita, "Kikaikhawm unla, amah sual unla, kidou ding in kuan un!
english: I have heard news from Yahweh, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Gather yourselves together! Come against her! Rise up to the battle!”

paite: Ngai in, mihingte muhsit in namte lak ah nang ka hon neusakta hi.
english: “For, behold, I have made you small among the nations, and despised among men.

paite: Na kihih mulkimhuaina tak na lungtang kisathei in ahon khemna ahi, aw nang kawl suangkal a, mualvum a teng zel, mu bang in, sangpi ah bu sep mah lechin, huai a kipan in ka hon lakhesuk ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: As for your terror, the pride of your heart has deceived you, O you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, who hold the height of the hill, though you should make your nest as high as the eagle, I will bring you down from there,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in Edom bel lamdang asak uh ahong hi ding a, mi vialvak peuh in lamdang asa ding ua, asiat luat ziak in atekkhum ding uh.
