english: “Edom will become an astonishment. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished, and will hiss at all its plagues.

paite: Sodom leh Gomorrah leh akim a khopite hihsiat a om mah bang in, kuamah ateng nawn kei ding ua, mihing ta kuamah huai ah a-om ngei nawn kei ding uh.
english: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor cities,” says Yahweh, “no man will dwell there, neither will any son of man live therein.

paite: Ngai un, Jordan gam gammang a kipan a humpinelkai, gan khahna mun ah ahong tou ding a; amah a kipan amau ka taimangsak pah ding a, atung a thunei ding in ka ut-ut ka sep ding. Keimah bang kua ahia om? Kua'n ahia hunbi hon bikhiahsak ding? Belamchingmi kua ahia ka ma a dingh ding pen?
english: “Behold, he will come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation; for I will suddenly make them run away from it, and whoever is chosen, I will appoint him over it. For who is like me? Who will appoint me a time? Who is the shepherd who will stand before me?”

paite: Huaiziak in Edom tung a TOUPA thuhilh leh Teman mite tung a athilseh, hih atuppente ngaikhia un; ganhon nou neute ngei kaihmang in a-om ding ua; atenna uh ahihgawp ding hi.
english: Therefore hear the counsel of Yahweh, that he has taken against Edom, and his purposes that he has purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely they will drag them away, the little ones of the flock. Surely he will make their habitation desolate over them.

paite: Apuksiatna husa uah lei akising a; akah husa uh Tuipi san ah leng zak ahi ding.
english: The earth trembles at the noise of their fall; there is a cry, the noise which is heard in the Red Sea.

paite: Ngai un, muvanlai bang in ahong lengtou ding a; Bozrah tung ah kha azak ding; huai ni in Edom mihangsante lungtang numei nauvei lungtang bang lel ahi ding hi.
english: Behold, he will come up and fly as the eagle, and spread out his wings against Bozrah. The heart of the mighty men of Edom at that day will be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

paite: Damaskas thu: Hamath zumta, Arpad toh, thuhoih lou azata ngal ua, azulta uh; tuipi kihot om kinken thei lou bang in abuai uh.
english: Of Damascus: “Hamath and Arpad are confounded, for they have heard evil news. They have melted away. There is sorrow on the sea. It can’t be quiet.

paite: Damaskas athazaw, taikek atum a, linna in alap a, lungkhamna leh natna in numei nauvei bang mai in alenta hi.
english: Damascus has grown feeble, she turns herself to flee, and trembling has seized her. Anguish and sorrows have taken hold of her, as of a woman in travail.

paite: Ka nopsakna khopi, khopi minthang bangziak a nutsiat a om lou ahia?
english: How is the city of praise not forsaken, the city of my joy?

paite: Huchi in huai ni in atangval honte kongtual ah apuk ding ua, galdoumi tengteng amangthang ding uh, chih sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Therefore her young men will fall in her streets, and all the men of war will be brought to silence in that day,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Damaskas kulhbaang ah mei ka khah ding a, Ben-hadad kumpipa' inn te akang khin ding hi.
english: “I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad.”

paite: Kedar leh Hazor gamte Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in agawtna thu; TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Thou unla, Kedar sual unla, suahlam tate bawl ek un.
english: Of Kedar, and of the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck, Yahweh says: “Arise, go up to Kedar, and destroy the children of the east.

paite: Apuaninte uh, aganhonte uh alaksak ding ua, apuanzakte uh, atui-um belsuan tengteng uh, asangawngsaute uh apaimangpih ding uh, ning chih ah launa a-om a, chi in mite'n akikoukhum ding uh.
english: They will take their tents and their flocks. they will carry away for themselves their curtains, all their vessels, and their camels; and they will cry to them, ‘Terror on every side!’

paite: Taikek unla, vakmang vengveng un, tummang vengveng unla, Hazor a tengte aw, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in nang ahon sawm a, na tung ah hihtup aneita hi.
english: Flee! Wander far off! Dwell in the depths, you inhabitants of Hazor,” says Yahweh; “for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has taken counsel against you, and has conceived a purpose against you.

paite: Thou unla, lungmuangtak a om, amah a khosa, kulh kongkhak leng nei lou, kalhna siktawn leng nei lou nam sual un, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Arise! Go up to a nation that is at ease, that dwells without care,” says Yahweh; “that has neither gates nor bars, that dwells alone.

paite: Asangawngsaute uh gal in ala ding ua, abawnghonte uh alok ding uh. Baksam metgiau honte ning chih ah ka dalhsak ding, asiatna ding uh ning chih a kipan in ka hon tun ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Their camels will be a booty, and the multitude of their livestock a plunder. I will scatter to all winds those who have the corners of their beards cut off; and I will bring their calamity from every side of them,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huan Hazor bel sihna tenna mun ahi ding a, asegawp tawntung ding, huai ah kuamah ateng nawn kei ding uh, mihing tate a-omta kei ding uh.
english: Hazor will be a dwelling place of jackals, a desolation forever. No man will dwell there, neither will any son of man live therein.”

paite: Judah kumpipa Zedekiah vaihawm pat tungna Elam tungtang a TOUPA thu, zawlnei Jeremiah kiang a hong tung;
english: Yahweh’s word that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai un, Elam thalpeu, ahatna bulpi pen uh, ka kitansak ding;
english: “Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.

paite: Kawlmong li a kipan in huih lite ka hon tun ding, Elam tung ah ka dalhsak ding, kawlmong chih ah, Elam delhkhiak mite phak louh nam a-om kei ding uh.
english: I will bring on Elam the four winds from the four quarters of the sky, and will scatter them toward all those winds. There will be no nation where the outcasts of Elam will not come.

paite: Amelma uh, ahinna uh zong mite ma ah, Elamte ka lunglelsak ding, atung uah siatna ka hon tun ding, ka hehna thupitak, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Amau ka hihman vek masiah namsau ka delhsak ding hi.
english: I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before those who seek their life. I will bring evil on them, even my fierce anger,’ says Yahweh; ‘and I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them.

paite: Akumpipate uleh aheutute uh hihmang in Elam ah ka laltutphah ka tung ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from there king and princes,’ says Yahweh.

paite: Himahleh ni nanungte ah hichi ahi ding, Elam omdan ka kiheisak ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: ‘But it will happen in the latter days that I will reverse the captivity of Elam,’ says Yahweh.”

paite: Jerusalem kholakte ah vialtai unla, chiamteh un! Amual tamte zong unla, mi khat bek diktattak a hih a, thutak zong mahmah na muh theih uleh, Jerusalem ka ngaidam ding.
english: “Run back and forth through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in its wide places, if you can find a man, if there is anyone who does justly, who seeks truth, then I will pardon her.

paite: "TOUPA ahin a ahin sung, chi mah le uh, zuau in akichiam lel uh ahi.
english: Though they say, ‘As Yahweh lives,’ surely they swear falsely.”

paite: Aw TOUPA, thutak na muhnop ahi kei a hia? Amau na sat a, himahleh alungkham tuan kei uh, amau na hihmang a, na thuzohna apom nuam tuan kei uh, suangpi sang a tak in atal uh ataksak ua, akilehhei nuam kei bikbek uhi.
english: O Yahweh, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction. They have made their faces harder than a rock. They have refused to return.

paite: "Ke'n, hiaite miphalou, ahai lai ua, TOUPA dan, a Pathian uh thugel athei kei uhi.
english: Then I said, “Surely these are poor. They are foolish; for they don’t know Yahweh’s way, nor the law of their God.

paite: Miliante kiang ah ka hohta ding a, ka houpih ding a, amau zaw TOUPA dan leh Pathian thugelte athei uh," achi a. Himahleh hiai mite'n thukhat sat in, hakkol ahihtan ua, henna khau ahihtat uhi.
english: I will go to the great men and will speak to them, for they know the way of Yahweh, and the law of their God.” But these with one accord have broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.

paite: Huaiziak in gammang nuai a humpinelkai in amaute akei ding a, gamdai ngia in amaute ane bei ding a, gialbem in akhopite a tang in, huai a hong pawt peuhmah abotzan ding; atatleknate uh atam a, anungkinnate uh athupi mahmah ziak in.
english: Therefore a lion out of the forest will kill them. A wolf of the evenings will destroy them. A leopard will watch against their cities. Everyone who goes out there will be torn in pieces, because their transgressions are many and their backsliding has increased.

paite: "Bangchi in ka hon ngaidam thei dia? Na tate'n ahon paisan ua, Pathian hiloupite sam in akichiam ua, taitak a ka vak nung in ang a kawm ua, kizuak innte ah akivel hehu uh.
english: “How can I pardon you? Your children have forsaken me, and sworn by what are no gods. When I had fed them to the full, they committed adultery, and assembled themselves in troops at the prostitutes’ houses.

paite: Amaute zingsang a sakol vakvah bang mai ahi ua, michih ama invengpa zi enlah in aham hi.
english: They were as fed horses roaming at large. Everyone neighed after his neighbor’s wife.

paite: Hiai thilte ziak in ka gawt kei ding maw? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Hichibang nam tung ah phu ka kilaksak kei ding a hia?
english: Shouldn’t I punish them for these things?” says Yahweh. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

paite: Abaangte ah kaltou unla, hihsia un, himahleh hihse khin vek kei un, ahiangte lamang un, TOUPA a lah ahi ngal kei hi.
english: “Go up on her walls, and destroy, but don’t make a full end. Take away her branches, for they are not Yahweh’s.

paite: Israel inkote leh Judah inkote'n ka tung ah lepchiahtak in ahih uh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me,” says Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA bel zuauthei dia sep in, "Bangmah ahihthei sam kei ding, siatna i tung uah atung kei ding, kial hiam namsau hiam i thuak kei ding.
english: They have denied Yahweh, and said, “It is not he. Evil won’t come on us. We won’t see sword or famine.

paite: Zawlneite leng huihzam lel ahi ding ua, amau ah thu a-om kei a; atung uah hichibang a hih ahi ding,” achi uhi.
english: The prophets will become wind, and the word is not in them. Thus it will be done to them.”

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA, Sepaihte Pathian in achi: "Huchibang thu na gen ziak un, ngai in, na kam a ka thute mei ka suaksak ding a, hiai mipi singte akang khin ding.”
english: Therefore Yahweh, the God of Armies says, “Because you speak this word, behold, I will make my words in your mouth fire, and this people wood, and it will devour them.

paite: Ngai un, aw Israel inkote aw, gamlapi a kipan, nam khat na kiang ah ka hon pi ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Nam hattak, nidanglai a kipan a, apau uh na theih louh, athugen uh na theih louh namte.
english: Behold, I will bring a nation on you from far away, house of Israel,” says Yahweh. “It is a mighty nation. It is an ancient nation, a nation whose language you don’t know and don’t understand what they say.

paite: Athalbawm uh han kihong ahi a, avek un mihattak ahi khin uh.
english: Their quiver is an open tomb. They are all mighty men.

paite: Na buhlaksa leh na nek ding ane khin vek ding uh; na tanute na tapate nek ding mahmah; na ganhonte, na belamhonte ane ding ua, na grep guite, na theipi kungte ane ding ua, na khopi kulh nei, na muanpi pente mahmah namsau in ahihse ding uhi.
english: They will eat up your harvest and your bread, which your sons and your daughters should eat. They will eat up your flocks and your herds. They will eat up your vines and your fig trees. They will beat down your fortified cities in which you trust with the sword.

paite: "Himahleh huai nite ah leng ka hon hihchimit kei ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “But even in those days,” says Yahweh, “I will not make a full end of you.

paite: Hichi ahong hi ding a, "Bangziak a ToUPA i Pathian un hiai thil tengteng i tung ua hih ahia?" Na mite un achih hun chiang un, "N'on paisan ua, na gam ua pathian dangte nna na sep bang un, na gam lou uah, paudang mite nna na sem ding uh, akiang uah na chi ding ahi."
english: It will happen when you say, ‘Why has Yahweh our God done all these things to us?’ Then you shall say to them, ‘Just as you have forsaken me and served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve strangers in a land that is not yours.’

paite: "Jakob inkote lak ah hiai genkhia unla, Judah gam ah puang un.
english: “Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,

paite: Aw theihtheihna nei lou, mihaite aw, mit nei a lah mu lou, bil nei a lah zaloute aw, hiai ngaikhia un.
english: ‘Hear this now, foolish people without understanding, who have eyes, and don’t see, who have ears, and don’t hear:

paite: N'on kihta kei uh maw? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Ka ma ah na ling kei ding uh maw? Kei, tuipi huap chiang a dia piautak, tangtawn a aletlouhna ding a daikaihna, tuipi kihot zou mahleh alet tuan theih louh a, ging honhon mahleh akhen theih louh ding bawlpa ka hi.
english: Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh; ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it can’t pass it? Though its waves toss themselves, yet they can’t prevail. Though they roar, they still can’t pass over it.’

paite: Himahleh hiai mite'n genhakna leh helhat lungtang apu ua, ahel ua, ataimangta uh.
english: “But this people has a revolting and a rebellious heart. They have revolted and gone.

paite: Alungtang un leng, TOUPA i Pathian, ahuntak a vuah masa leh vuah nanung zusakpa, buh leh hunbi hon sehsakpa laudan i siam ding uh, achi sam kei uh.
english: They don’t say in their heart, ‘Let’s now fear Yahweh our God, who gives rain, both the former and the latter, in its season, who preserves to us the appointed weeks of the harvest.’

paite: Hiai thilte na thulimlouhnate un ahihmang a, na khelhnate un thil hoih nou ahon tansak ahi.
english: “Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withheld good from you.

paite: "Ka mite lak ah migilou a-om ngal ua, vasa gemmi in atan bang in atang gige ua, thang akam ua, mite aman uh.
english: For wicked men are found among my people. They watch, as fowlers lie in wait. They set a trap. They catch men.

paite: Bawm vasa a dim bang mai in, a-innte uh khemna in adim a, huaiziak in ahong lian ua, ahong hauhsak lohta uhi.
english: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit. Therefore they have become great, and grew rich.

paite: Ahong thau ua, ahong zol ua, ahi, agitlouhna thilhihte un hun chiang anei kei, pa neiloute lamzanna ding in amau lam ah apang kei uhi.
english: They have grown fat. They shine; yes, they excel in deeds of wickedness. They don’t plead the cause, the cause of the fatherless, that they may prosper; and they don’t defend the rights of the needy.

paite: "Hiai thilte ziak in ka gawt kei dia hia?" chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. "Hichibang nam tung ah ka hinna in phu ala kei ding a hia?
english: “Shouldn’t I punish for these things?” says Yahweh. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

paite: Huai gam ah thillamdangtak leh mulkimhuaitak ahong tung hi.
english: “An astonishing and horrible thing has happened in the land.

paite: Zawlneite'n zuauthu agen ua, siampute'n lah amau thuthu in vai ahawm ua, ka mite'n lah huchibang hih a-ut uhi, atawp ah bangchi in na hih ding ua le?”
english: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority; and my people love to have it so. What will you do in the end of it?

paite: Babulon tungtang, Kaldai mite gam tungtang a zawlnei Jeremiah kam a TOUPA thugen:
english: The word that Yahweh spoke concerning Babylon, concerning the land of the Chaldeans, by Jeremiah the prophet.

paite: Namte lak ah gen unla, puang un, puanzak khai in, puang un, sel kei un, Babulon lak ahita. Bel azahlak a, Merodak mulkimna in adim a, milimte ase khinta.
english: “Declare among the nations and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and don’t conceal; say, ‘Babylon has been taken, Bel is disappointed, Merodach is dismayed! Her images are disappointed. Her idols are dismayed.’

paite: Mallam a kipan amah nam khat in ahon sual a, huai in agam ahihgawp ding a, huai ah kuamah ateng nawn kei ding ua; ataikek ua, mi leh sate leng amang khinta uhi.
english: For a nation comes up out of the north against her, which will make her land desolate, and no one will dwell in it. They have fled. They are gone, both man and animal.

paite: Huai nite in leh huai hun chiang in Israel suante ahong pai ding ua, amau leh Judah tate toh; kap kawm in ahong pai ding ua, TOUPA a Pathian uh azong ding uh; chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “In those days, and in that time,” says Yahweh, “the children of Israel will come, they and the children of Judah together; they will go on their way weeping, and will seek Yahweh their God.

paite: Zion lam nga in akalsuanna ding uh adong ding ua, "Kisa un, tangtawn thukhun mangngilh nawn lou ding in TOUPA hong len un," achi ding uh.
english: They will inquire concerning Zion with their faces turned toward it, saying, ‘Come, and join yourselves to Yahweh in an everlasting covenant that will not be forgotten.’

paite: Ka mite zaw belam mang ahi ua; amau ching mite'n apimang ua, mualte ah apaimangsak ua, tang a pan mual dungte ah apai ua, ahuang uh amangngilh khinta uhi.
english: My people have been lost sheep. Their shepherds have caused them to go astray. They have turned them away on the mountains. They have gone from mountain to hill. They have forgotten their resting place.

paite: Amu peuh in ane zel ua, amelmate un, i gilou kei, TOUPA dikna omna apipute uh lamet TOUPA hilhial tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak ahi, achi uhi.
english: All who found them have devoured them. Their adversaries said, ‘We are not guilty, because they have sinned against Yahweh, the habitation of righteousness, even Yahweh, the hope of their fathers.’

paite: Babulon sung a kipan in taikhia unla, Kaldaite gam a kipan paikhia un, kelhon lak a keltalte bang in om un.
english: “Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Go out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the male goats before the flocks.

paite: Ngai dih ua, Babulon hong sual ding in mal gam a kipan nam honpi thupitak kikaikhawm ka tokthou ding a, amah dou ding in akisa ding ua; huai a kipan in lak ahi ding uh; athalte uh lah galbawl siamtak vuaksuak ngei lou bang ahi ding uh.
english: For, behold, I will stir up and cause to come up against Babylon a company of great nations from the north country; and they will set themselves in array against her. She will be taken from there. Their arrows will be as of an expert mighty man. None of them will return in vain.

paite: Huan Kaldai loh in a-om ding, alok mite atai ngial ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Chaldea will be a prey. All who prey on her will be satisfied,” says Yahweh.

paite: Kipak mah le uchin, nuamsa mah le uchin, aw ka goutan lok mite aw, lou lak a bawngla takhialkhial bang leh sakoltal ham ngekngek bang himah le uchin;
english: “Because you are glad, because you rejoice, O you who plunder my heritage, because you are wanton as a heifer that treads out the grain, and neigh as strong horses,

paite: Na nu uh ahong zum mahmah ding a, nou hon suangnu ahong zahlak ding hi. Ngai un, namte lak a nuainungpen, gamdai, gamkeu, gamvuak ahi ding.
english: your mother will be utterly disappointed. She who bore you will be confounded. Behold, she will be the least of the nations, a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.

paite: TOUPA hehna ziak in luahmi a-om kei ding a, ase vek zaw ding hi, Babulon hoh peuhmah amulkimsak ding a, asiatna tengteng ziak in atek ding uhi.
english: Because of Yahweh’s wrath she won’t be inhabited, but she will be wholly desolate. Everyone who goes by Babylon will be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.

paite: Thalpeu tawimi tengteng aw, Babulon umsuak in kivual unla, kap unla, thalte chil kei un, TOUPA tung ah akhialta uhi.
english: Set yourselves in array against Babylon all around, all you who bend the bow; shoot at her. Spare no arrows, for she has sinned against Yahweh.

paite: Akimvel in awng unla, amah-le-amah akipeta, akulhte apukta a, abaangte achimta, TOUPA phulakna ahi ngal a, atung ah phu la unla, ahih bangbang in atung ah hih un.
english: Shout against her all around. She has submitted herself. Her bulwarks have fallen. Her walls have been thrown down, for it is the vengeance of Yahweh. Take vengeance on her. As she has done, do to her.

paite: Babulon a kipan chi thehmi attan unla, buhlak lai a kawite tawimi toh, nuaisiahna namsau lau in amau mite lam azuan chiat ding ua, amau gam chiat ah atai ding uh.
english: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him who handles the sickle in the time of harvest. For fear of the oppressing sword, they will each return to their own people, and they will each flee to their own land.

paite: Israel bel belam dalhzak ahi a; humpinelkaite'n adelhmang ua; Assuria kumpipa'n amah ane phot a, atawp in Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in aguhte ahaizanta hi.
english: “Israel is a hunted sheep. The lions have driven him away. First, the king of Assyria devoured him, and now at last Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has broken his bones.”

paite: Huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: Ngai un, Assuria kumpipa ka gawt bang in Babulon kumpipa leh agam ka gawt ding.
english: Therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.

paite: Huan Israel agantatna ah ka pi nawn ding a, Karmel leh Bashan ah ata ding a, Ephraim tang ah leh Gilead ah amah ata ding hi.
english: I will bring Israel again to his pasture, and he will feed on Carmel and Bashan. His soul will be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and in Gilead.

paite: Huai nite leh huai hun chiang in Israel thulimlouhnate azong ding ua, muh ding a-om kei ding; Judah thilhihkhelhte leng muh ding a-om sam kei ding; omsun ding a ka koihte ngaidam ding ka hi ngal a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: In those days, and in that time,” says Yahweh, “the iniquity of Israel will be sought for, and there will be none, also the sins of Judah, and they won’t be found; for I will pardon them whom I leave as a remnant.

paite: Merathim gam sual un, agam leh Pekod luah mite mahmah that unla, hihgam sipsip un, thu ka hon piak bangbang in hih un, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod. Kill and utterly destroy after them,” says Yahweh, “and do according to all that I have commanded you.

paite: Huai gam ah gal husa a-om, siatna thupi mahmah husa toh.
english: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.

paite: Khovel pumpi sek kitam in, nak keknen hi na tel e; namte lak ah Babulon kinaksiat hi na mai e!
english: How the hammer of the whole earth is cut apart and broken! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations!

paite: Aw Babilon, nang ding in thang na kam a, thei lou a awk na hita ve; muhkhiak leh mat in na omta, TOUPA na sual ziak in.
english: I have laid a snare for you, and you are also taken, Babylon, and you weren’t aware. You are found, and also caught, because you have fought against Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N agalvan bawm ahongta, ahehna vanzatte alakhia a, Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N Kaldaite gam ah hih ding anei hi.
english: Yahweh has opened his armory, and has brought out the weapons of his indignation; for the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, has a work to do in the land of the Chaldeans.

paite: Gamgi tawp pek a kipan in hon sual unla, athil koihkhawmna innte hong vek unla, paikhawm un, hihse vek unla, abangmah hawi kei un.
english: Come against her from the farthest border. Open her storehouses. Cast her up as heaps. Destroy her utterly. Let nothing of her be left.

paite: Abawngtal tuaite that vek unla, goh in om uhen. Atung uh gik hi na tel e! Ani uh, amaute gawtna ni mahmah ahong tungta hi.
english: Kill all her bulls. Let them go down to the slaughter. Woe to them! For their day has come, the time of their visitation.

paite: TOUPA i Pathian phulak, atempul phulakna ngei Zion a gen ding a Babulon a kipan a taikhete leh taimangte husa ngei.
english: Listen to those who flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of Yahweh our God, the vengeance of his temple.

paite: Babulon sual ding in thalkap siam, thalpeu zangmi tengteng samkhawm un; akimvel in buk bawl unla, kuamah suakta kei uhen. Athilhih bangbang in thuk un, ahihsa bang tengteng amah tung ah hih un; TOUPA, Israel Mi Siangthou lah achou ngam hi.
english: “Call together the archers against Babylon, all those who bend the bow. Encamp against her all around. Let none of it escape. Pay her back according to her work. According to all that she has done, do to her; for she has been proud against Yahweh, against the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Huaiziak in akholakte ah tangvalte apuk ding ua, galkapmi tengteng huai ni in amangthang ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Therefore her young men will fall in her streets. All her men of war will be brought to silence in that day,” says Yahweh.

paite: Ngai in, nang mikisathei, ka hon dou ahi, Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi hi. Na ni ahong tungta, na gawtna ding ni mah,
english: “Behold, I am against you, you proud one,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies; “for your day has come, the time that I will visit you.

paite: Huan mikisathei akisui in apuk ding a, kuamah in aphong kei ding ua, akhopite ah mei ka khah ding a, akimvel a om tengteng ka kangsiangsak vek ding.
english: The proud one will stumble and fall, and no one will raise him up. I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it will devour all who are around him.”

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Israel suante leh Judah tate nuaisiah in a-om khawmta ua; sal a amaute pi mite tengteng in amau alen tinten ua, akhah nuam kei uhi. Amaute tanpa bel ahat a; amin sepaihte' TOUPA ahi.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “The children of Israel and the children of Judah are oppressed together. All who took them captive hold them fast. They refuse to let them go.

paite: Amah amau lam ah apang a, Babulon a tengte hihbuai in, leitung a khawlna atuttheihna ding in.
english: Their Redeemer is strong. Yahweh of Armies is his name. He will thoroughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the earth, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.

paite: Kaldai mite tung ah namsau aleng hi, Babulon a tengte, aheutute uh leh amipilte uh tung ah leng, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “A sword is on the Chaldeans,” says Yahweh, “and on the inhabitants of Babylon, on her princes, and on her wise men.

paite: Mizuautheite tung ah namsau, mihai ahong suak ding uh; agalkapmi tung ah namsau, alunglel khin ding uh.
english: A sword is on the boasters, and they will become fools. A sword is on her mighty men, and they will be dismayed.

paite: Asakolte uh leh kangtalaite uh tung ah namsau, asung a mi kilak hel tengtengte tung ah leng, numei bang phet ahong hi ding uh; agou thil tung ah namsau lok in a-om maimai ding uhi.
english: A sword is on their horses, on their chariots, and on all the mixed people who are in the middle of her; and they will become as women. A sword is on her treasures, and they will be robbed.

paite: Atuite kang in akeu khin a, milimte gam lah ahi ngal a, milimte lah ahailoh uhi.
english: A drought is on her waters, and they will be dried up; for it is a land of engraved images, and they are mad over idols.

paite: Huaiziak in gamdai gam sahangte, ngiate toh huai ah ateng ding ua, ostrikte leng huai ah ateng ding uh; luah in a-om ngei nawn kei ding; suan tengteng pha in leng luah in a-om kei ding hi.
english: Therefore the wild animals of the desert with the wolves will dwell there. The ostriches will dwell therein. It will be inhabited no more forever, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation.

paite: Pathian in Sodom leh Gomorrah leh akho invengte ahihsiat bangbang in; huai ah kuamah atengta kei ding ua, mihing tapa kuamah in aveh nawnta kei ding uh, TOUPA thupawt in achi hi.
english: As when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor cities,” says Yahweh, “so no man will dwell there, neither will any son of man live therein.

paite: Ngai un, mallam gam a pan mite ahong ua, mun tawp a kipan nam thupitak leh kumpipa tampi ahong kuan uhi.
english: “Behold, a people comes from the north. A great nation and many kings will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

paite: Thalpeu leh tei atawi ua, hiamgamtak, zahngaihna nei lou ahi uh. Ahusa uh tuipi ging huhu bang ahi a, sakol tung ah atuang ua, michih galkapmi bang a kivan in, Babulon tanu aw, nang ahong sual ding uhi.
english: They take up bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea. They ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Babylon.

paite: Ahusa uh za in Babulon kumpipa khut azawgawpta a, numei nauvei lai natna bang in, natna thupitak in amanta hi.
english: The king of Babylon has heard the news of them, and his hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of him, pains as of a woman in labor.

paite: Ngai un, Jordan gammang a kipan humpinelkai, kahna mun a ahong tou bang in ahong paitou ding a; amah a kipan in amaute ka taimangsak pah ding; atung a thunei ding ka ut-ut ka sep ding. Kei bang kua a-om a! Kua'n sep ding. Kei bang kuakua a-om a? Kua'n ahia hunbi hon sehsak ding? Belamchingmi kua ahia ka ma a dingh ding?
english: Behold, the enemy will come up like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan against the strong habitation; for I will suddenly make them run away from it. Whoever is chosen, I will appoint him over it, for who is like me? Who will appoint me a time? Who is the shepherd who can stand before me?”

paite: Huaiziak in Babulon tung ah TOUPA thuhilh, Kaldai mite tung a athilseh ngaikhia un. Ganhon noute ngei kaihmang in a-om ding ua, gan khahna mun a mite amulkimsak ding.
english: Therefore hear the counsel of Yahweh that he has taken against Babylon; and his purposes that he has purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely they will drag them away, even the little ones of the flock. Surely he will make their habitation desolate over them.

paite: Babulon lakna husa ah lei aling ding a, akahna husa namte lak a zak ahi ding hi.
english: The earth trembles at the noise of the taking of Babylon. The cry is heard among the nations.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai dih, Babulon leh Kaldai mite tung ah, hihse ding huihpi ka sawl ding hi.
english: Yahweh says: “Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against those who dwell in Lebkamai, a destroying wind.

paite: Zapsiangmi ka sawl ding, Babulon tung ah, amah zap in agam azapsiang ding ua, siatna ni a um a sual ding ahi ngal ua.
english: I will send to Babylon strangers, who will winnow her. They will empty her land; for in the day of trouble they will be against her all around.

paite: Thalpeu zangmi in thalpeu lai a, sik puanak silh in, dingh heh, tangvalhon khat leng hawi lou in, asepaih tengteng nuaimang un.
english: Against him who bends, let the archer bend his bow, also against him who lifts himself up in his coat of mail. Don’t spare her young men! Utterly destroy all her army!

paite: Kaldai gam ah thah in apuk ding ua, akholakte uah sut pailet in a-om ding uhi.
english: They will fall down slain in the land of the Chaldeans, and thrust through in her streets.

paite: Israel leh Judah, agam uah Israel Mi Siangthou tung ah khelhna in adim na ua, a Pathian uh sepaihte' TOUPA'N amangngilh kei hi.
english: For Israel is not forsaken, nor Judah, by his God, by Yahweh of Armies; though their land is full of guilt against the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Taimang unla, Babulon khosung a kipan, michih in amah hinna humbit hen; athulimlouhna manloh kei un, TOUPA phulak hun ahi ngal a, ama'n athuk ngeigngei ding hi.
english: “Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Everyone save his own life! Don’t be cut off in her iniquity, for it is the time of Yahweh’s vengeance. He will give to her a recompense.

paite: Babulon bel TOUPA khut a dangka-eng nou, leitung pumpi hihkhamna ahi a, namte'n kham in alung uh amawl khinta hi.
english: Babylon has been a golden cup in Yahweh’s hand, who made all the earth drunk. The nations have drunk of her wine; therefore the nations have gone mad.

paite: Babulon apuk guih a, amangta, amah kah ekek un, hihdam theihdan ding ahihleh singnai damdawi nuhchi laksak un.
english: Babylon has suddenly fallen and been destroyed! Wail for her! Take balm for her pain. Perhaps she may be healed.

paite: Babulon hihdam ka tum a, adam tuan kei, amah nusia in eimah gam chiat uah pai ni, amohna in van asun a, van dum pha a dopkang ahi.
english: “We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed. Forsake her, and let’s each go into his own country; for her judgment reaches to heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.

paite: "TOUPA'N ka dikna apuangta; kisa un, TOUPA i Pathian thilhih, Zion ah i puang ding uh.
english: ‘Yahweh has produced our righteousness. Come, and let’s declare in Zion the work of Yahweh our God.’

paite: "Thalte tat-hiam unla, lumte len un, Media kumpipate lungsim TOUPA'N atokthouta a, athiltup Babulon hihsiat ahi. Huai TOUPA'N atempul ziak a phulakna ahi.
english: “Make the arrows sharp! Hold the shields firmly! Yahweh has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes, because his purpose is against Babylon, to destroy it; for it is the vengeance of Yahweh, the vengeance of his temple.

paite: Babulon kulh bul ah kidouna puangzak thak un, venna hihhat in, galvilmi koih un, galbuknate bawl unla, Babulon mite tungtang thu ah TOUPA'N agen tak, angaihtuah in ahih khinta hi.
english: Set up a standard against the walls of Babylon! Make the watch strong! Set the watchmen, and prepare the ambushes; for Yahweh has both purposed and done that which he spoke concerning the inhabitants of Babylon.

paite: Aw nang, tui tamna mun a tengmi, sum-le-pai hau mahmah, na tawpna atungta, na hinna khau akitanta hi.
english: You who dwell on many waters, abundant in treasures, your end has come, the measure of your covetousness.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA amah kilou in achiamta hi, khaupete bang mai in mihing in ka hon dimsak ngeingei ding, nakpi in ahon otkhum ding uh."
english: Yahweh of Armies has sworn by himself, saying, ‘Surely I will fill you with men, as with locusts, and they will lift up a shout against you.’

paite: Athilhihtheihna in lei abawl a, apilna in khovel adingkhesak a, alemtheihna in van aphalhsak.
english: “He has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom. By his understanding he has stretched out the heavens.

paite: A-aw asuah a, van a tui aging hawhaw a, kawlmong a kipan meipi apaitousak a, vuah zukna ding in khua aphesak a, agoubawm a kipan huih anungsak hi.
english: When he utters his voice, there is a roar of waters in the heavens, and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth. He makes lightning for the rain, and brings the wind out of his treasuries.

paite: Michih amual ua, theihna lou in, dangka-eng sekmichih in alimsek pen azumpih ua, amilim sun lah zuau ngen ahi a, amau ah nakna a-om kei lai hi.
english: “Every man has become stupid and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his image, for his molten images are falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

paite: Bangmah lou, khemna nasep lel ahi ua, agawt hun chiang in amang ding uh.
english: They are vanity, a work of delusion. In the time of their visitation, they will perish.

paite: Jakob tantuan bel hichibang ahi kei, thil tengteng bul ahi ngal a; Israel agouluah nam ahi a, amin sepaihte' TOUPA ahi.
english: The portion of Jacob is not like these, for he formed all things, including the tribe of his inheritance. Yahweh of Armies is his name.

paite: Nang bel ka galdouna heipi leh vanzat na hi a, nang hon zang in namte ka hihzan a, nang zang in lalna gamte ka hihmang hi.
english: “You are my battle ax and weapons of war. With you I will break the nations into pieces. With you I will destroy kingdoms.

paite: Nang hon zang in sakol leh atung a ka hihzan a, nangmah zang in kangtalai leh atung a tuang ka hihzan a;
english: With you I will break in pieces the horse and his rider.

paite: Nangmah zang in numei leh pasal ka hihzan a, nangmah zang in putek leh tuailai ka hihzan a, nangmah zang in nungak leh tangval ka hihzan hi.
english: With you I will break in pieces the chariot and him who rides therein. With you I will break in pieces man and woman. With you I will break in pieces the old man and the youth. With you I will break in pieces the young man and the virgin.

paite: Nangmah zang in belamching leh belamhon ka hihzan a, nangmah zang in louneimi leh bawngtal kop ka hihzan a, nangmah zang in gam ukpipate leh upate ka hihzan sek ahi.
english: With you I will break in pieces the shepherd and his flock. With you I will break in pieces the farmer and his yoke. With you I will break in pieces governors and deputies.

paite: Nang mitmuh ngei in Zion tung a athil hoih lou hih tengteng uh Babulon leh Kaldai mite tung ah ka thuk ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “I will give to Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight,” says Yahweh.

paite: Ngai in, leitung pumpi hihsia, aw hihsetu tang lian, nang ka hon dou ahi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Na tung ah ka khut ka lik ding a, kawl sang a kipan ka hon khukkhe ding, tang kang mit khinsa in ka hon bawl ding.
english: “Behold, I am against you, destroying mountain,” says Yahweh, “which destroys all the earth. I will stretch out my hand on you, roll you down from the rocks, and will make you a burned mountain.

paite: Nang a kipan suang ning ding leh suangphum ding lakkhiak ahi nawn kei ding; tangtawn in na segawp zaw ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: They won’t take a cornerstone from you, nor a stone for foundations; but you will be desolate forever,” says Yahweh.

paite: "Huai gam ah kidou puanzak tak unla, namte lak ah pengkul mut un, amah dou ding namte kisasak unla, Araratte, Minnite, Ashkenaz gamte, amah sual ding sepaih sep unla, khaupe zuanzaang bang mai in sakolte kaikhawm un.
english: “Set up a standard in the land! Blow the trumpet among the nations! Prepare the nations against her! Call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz! Appoint a marshal against her! Cause the horses to come up as the swarming locusts!

paite: Amah dou ding namte kisasak un; Media kumpipate, ukpipate leh upate, athuneihna gam tengteng toh.
english: Prepare against her the nations, the kings of the Medes, its governors, and all its deputies, and all the land of their dominion!

paite: Huai gam nat thuak in aling a, Babulon gam, tengmi om lou a hihsiat ding in, Babulon tung a TOUPA thiltup adingh gige hi.
english: The land trembles and is in pain; for the purposes of Yahweh against Babylon stand, to make the land of Babylon a desolation, without inhabitant.

paite: Babulon galdou mite'n galkap ding ngapta lou in, akulhpi uah aton maimah uh, apasalphatna uh akhing a, numei bang mai ahong hita ua, atenna munte akang khin a, adeidanna siktawn akitan hi.
english: The mighty men of Babylon have stopped fighting, they remain in their strongholds. Their might has failed. They have become as women. Her dwelling places are set on fire. Her bars are broken.

paite: Thangkou tai in midang leng akituahpih a, misawl in leng midang atuak a, Babulon kumpipa kiang a akhopi ning chih ah amanta uh chih hilh ding in.
english: One runner will run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to show the king of Babylon that his city is taken on every quarter.

paite: Lui kannate aman ua, phailuangte ahal siang ua, kidou mite leng alunglelta uh.
english: So the passages are seized. They have burned the reeds with fire. The men of war are frightened.”

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: Babulon tanu phual sikngil lai bang ahi a, sawt lou nung in buhchil hun atung ah ahong tung ding hi."
english: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “The daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time when it is trodden. Yet a little while, and the time of harvest comes for her.”

paite: "Hon negaita, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in, hon haizan a, bel vuak lel in ahon bawlta, gulpi bang in ahon nawmvalhta, ka thil limte'n agilpi adimsak a, ahon paikhe nawnta hi.
english: “Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon has devoured me. He has crushed me. He has made me an empty vessel. He has, like a monster, swallowed me up. He has filled his mouth with my delicacies. He has cast me out.

paite: Kei leh ka satung a hiamgam thilhih, Babulon tung ah om hen; ka sisan Kaldai mite tung ah om hen, Jerusalem in achi ding."
english: May the violence done to me and to my flesh be on Babylon!” the inhabitant of Zion will say; and, “May my blood be on the inhabitants of Chaldea!” will Jerusalem say.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai in, nang lam ah ka pang ding a, na phu ka hon laksak ding, atuipi ka kangsak ding a, atuikhuk leng ka keugawsak ding.
english: Therefore Yahweh says: “Behold, I will plead your cause, and take vengeance for you. I will dry up her sea, and make her fountain dry.

paite: Huan Babulon bel hoih lou paihkhawm lel, sehal tenna mun, lamdangsak chiat leh enghou, tengmi om lou mun ahong hi ding.
english: Babylon will become heaps, a dwelling place for jackals, an astonishment, and a hissing, without inhabitant.

paite: Akikou ton ding ua, humpinelkai lun lai bang in, angik tuaktuak ding uh; humpinelkai nou bang in.
english: They will roar together like young lions. They will growl as lions’ cubs.

paite: Akham mahmah lai un ankuang ka luisak dia, khothei het lou in ka khamsak dia, khanglou het lou ding a a-ihmut dettheihna ding un, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: When they are inflamed, I will make their feast, and I will make them drunk, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake up,” says Yahweh.

paite: Ka pikhe ding a, belam goh ding bang in, belamtalte leh keltalte bang mai in."
english: “I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with male goats.

paite: Shesak lak ahita ve; leitung pumpi pahtawi zel mat in a-omta ve, namte lak ah Babulon asegawpta ve.
english: “How Sheshach is taken! How the praise of the whole earth is seized! How Babylon has become a desolation among the nations!

paite: Babulon tuipi in atumta, akihot thupi mahmah in akhuh khinta.
english: The sea has come up on Babylon. She is covered with the multitude of its waves.

paite: Akhopi asegawpta a, gamkeu, gamdai, mihing tenlouhna mihing ta kuamah phak louh gam ahong suakta hi.
english: Her cities have become a desolation, a dry land, and a desert, a land in which no man dwells. No son of man passes by it.

paite: Babulon bel ka gawt ding, avalhkhitsa akam a kipan asuahkhe ding, namte bel akiang ah aluangkhawm nawn kei ding uh, ahi Babulon kulhpi achim ding.
english: I will execute judgment on Bel in Babylon, and I will bring out of his mouth that which he has swallowed up. The nations will not flow any more to him. Yes, the wall of Babylon will fall.

paite: Ka mite aw, asung a kipan hong pawt unla, TOUPA hehna lauhuai mahmah a kipan, michih amau kihumbit chiat un.
english: “My people, go away from the middle of her, and each of you save yourselves from Yahweh’s fierce anger.

paite: Na lungtang uh bah kei hen, huai gam a thuthang leng lau kei un; kum khat in thuthang ahong tung ding a, kum dang in thuthang ahong tung nawn ding ahi, kumpipa leh kumpipa kisual in gam ah hiamgamna a-om ding.
english: Don’t let your heart faint. Don’t fear for the news that will be heard in the land. For news will come one year, and after that in another year news will come, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.

paite: Huaiziak in ngai un, nite ahong tung hi. Babulon milim sektawmte tung a vai ka hawm a, agam pumpi zumna ni ding; huan, asung ah amithahte apuk ding uh.
english: Therefore behold, the days come that I will execute judgment on the engraved images of Babylon; and her whole land will be confounded. All her slain will fall in the middle of her.

paite: Huchi in lei leh van leh asung a om tengteng in, Babulon tung a kipak in la asa ding uh; mallam a kipan sim mite akiang a tung ding uh ahi ngal a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Then the heavens and the earth, and all that is therein, will sing for joy over Babylon; for the destroyers will come to her from the north,” says Yahweh.

paite: Babulon in Israel mithahte apuksak bang in Babulon ah gam chih a thah a omte apuk ding uh.
english: “As Babylon has caused the slain of Israel to fall, so the slain of all the land will fall at Babylon.

paite: Nou namsau pel mite aw, kuan unla, dingh maimai kei un, gamlapi a kipan in TOUPA theigige unla, na lungsim uah Jerusalem lut hen.
english: You who have escaped the sword, go! Don’t stand still! Remember Yahweh from afar, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.”

paite: Gensiatna thu ka zak ziak un ka zum ua, lungdonna in ka mai uh atuam a, TOUPA' inn a mun siangthoute ah pau theih louh mite ahong lutta uhi.
english: “We are confounded because we have heard reproach. Confusion has covered our faces, for strangers have come into the sanctuaries of Yahweh’s house.”

paite: Huaiziak in ngai un, nite ahong tung hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, amilim sektawmte uh tung a ka vaihawmna ding leh agam pumpi tung a miliamte thumna ni ding ngei.
english: “Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will execute judgment on her engraved images; and through all her land the wounded will groan.

paite: Babulon bel van sun in sang mahleh, akulh sangte hihkip mahleh, atung ah ka kiang a kipan hihsemi ahong tung ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Though Babylon should mount up to the sky, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet destroyers will come to her from me,” says Yahweh.

paite: Babulon a kipan kah husa leh Kaldai gam a kipan siatna thupitak husa;
english: “The sound of a cry comes from Babylon, and of great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans!

paite: TOUPA'N Babulon asim a, ahusa uh thupitak ahih daihsak hi. Agamtat husa uh tui tampi ging hawhaw bang ahi, a- awng zuazualua.
english: For Yahweh lays Babylon waste, and destroys out of her the great voice! Their waves roar like many waters. The noise of their voice is uttered.

paite: Atung ah simmi ahong tung, Babulon tung ngei ah pang ni, amihatte mat in a-om ua, athalpeute uh akitangawpta, TOUPA bel thukna Pathian ahi a, athuk ngeingei ding.
english: For the destroyer has come on her, even on Babylon. Her mighty men are taken. Their bows are broken in pieces, for Yahweh is a God of retribution. He will surely repay.

paite: Huan aheutute leh amipilte, a-ukpipate leh upate leh mihatte ka khamsak dia; alumden ding ua, akhanglou kei ding uh, chih, kumpipa, Sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: I will make her princes, her wise men, her governors, her deputies, and her mighty men drunk. They will sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake up,” says the King, whose name is Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Babulon kumpipa kulhbaang sahtakte achim vek ding a, akongpi sangte akang vek ding; amite'n athawn in asem ua, namte'n meihal a ding lel a kihihgim uh ana hi.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “The wide walls of Babylon will be utterly overthrown. Her high gates will be burned with fire. The peoples will labor for vanity, and the nations for the fire; and they will be weary.”

paite: Judah kumpipa Zedekiah vaihawm akum lina a Babulon ahoh lai a akiang a hoh sam, Seraiah Neriah tapa, Maaseiah tapa kiang a zawlnei Jeremiah thupiak.
english: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. Now Seraiah was chief quartermaster.

paite: Seraiah bel kumpipa insung heutupen ahi a, Jeremiah in Babulon tung a siatna hong tung ding tengteng, Babulon tungtang a hiai thu gelh tengteng laibu ah agelh hi.
english: Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come on Babylon, even all these words that are written concerning Babylon.

paite: Huan Jeremiah in Seraiah kiang ah, Babulon na tun hun chiang in hiai thu tengteng sim ngeingei inla,
english: Jeremiah said to Seraiah, “When you come to Babylon, then see that you read all these words,

paite: Aw TOUPA hiai nam tungtang ah kuamah, mi leh sa leh tenlouhna ding suksiat a om in, tangtawn a kisegawp zaw ding in thu na genta a, na chi ding.
english: and say, ‘Yahweh, you have spoken concerning this place, to cut it off, that no one will dwell in it, neither man nor animal, but that it will be desolate forever.’

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, hiai laibu na sim khit chiang in suang toh gakkhawm in Euphrates Luipi ah pailut inla,
english: It will be, when you have finished reading this book, that you shall bind a stone to it, and cast it into the middle of the Euphrates.

paite: Babulon hichibang mai in atum ding a, atung a siatna ka hon tut ding ziak in athounawn kei ding; abah mahmah ding uh, chi in na gen ding ahi, achi a. Hichi teng Jeremiah thu ahi.
english: Then you shall say, ‘Thus will Babylon sink, and will not rise again because of the evil that I will bring on her; and they will be weary.’” Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.

paite: Zedekiah in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih leh kum khat a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-khat vai ahawm a; anu min Hamutal ahi a, Libnah a Jeremiah tanu ahi.
english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign. He reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

paite: Jehoiakim hih bangbang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

paite: TOUPA aheh mahmah ziak in Jerusalem leh Judah gam ah ama a kipan a paihkhiakna khop in thil ahong tungta a; huchi in Babulon kumpipa tung ah Zedekiah ahelta hi.
english: For through Yahweh’s anger this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

paite: Huan avaihawm akum kuana ah hichi ahong hi a, kha sawmna, huai kha ani sawm ni in Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar leh asepaihhonte Jerusalem dou ding in ahong kuan ua, buk abawlkhumta ua; akim ah kulh abawl uhi.
english: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it round about.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Zedekiah kum sawm-le-khatna tan in khopi um in a-omta hi.
english: So the city was besieged to the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

paite: Akha lina, huai kha ani kuana ah khopi ah kial ahong uang mahmah a, gam mipite a ding in nek ding a-omta kei hi.
english: In the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

paite: Huchi in khopi kulhbaang asunvang ua, kidoumi tengteng ataimang ua, kumpipa huan a baang nih kikal a kongpi a pawt in, zan in khopi a kipan ataikhia ua; Kaldai mite' khopi a om ahi uhi.
english: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled, and went out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden. Now the Chaldeans were against the city all around. The men of war went toward the Arabah,

paite: Himahleh Kaldai sepaihte'n kumpipa adelh ua, Jeriko Phaizang ah Zedekiah apha ua, sepaihhonte akiang a kipan adalhzak uhi.
english: but the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

paite: Huchi in Zedekiah aman ua, Babulon kumpipa kiang ah Hamath gam a Riblah ah apaipih ua; ama'n atung ah vai ahawmkhum hi.
english: Then they took the king, and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he pronounced judgment on him.

paite: Babulon kumpipa'n Zedekiah tapate amitmuh ngei in athat a; Riblah ah Judah heutu tengteng leng athat lai hi.
english: The king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes. He also killed all the princes of Judah in Riblah.

paite: Zedekiah mit akhelkhia a, Babulon ah apaipih hi; asih ni tanpha in suangkul ah akoih hi.
english: He put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison until the day of his death.

paite: Huan kumpipa vengpa pawl heutu Nebuzaradan, amah Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar ma a dingh sek, akum sawm-le-kuana, akha ngana, huai kha ani sawmna in Jerusalem ah ahong lut hi.
english: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, who stood before the king of Babylon, came into Jerusalem.

paite: TOUPA’ inn leh kumpipa' inn ahal a, Jerusalem inn tengteng toh, inn thupi chitengte mei in ahal hi.
english: He burned Yahweh’s house, and the king’s house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, he burned with fire.

paite: Huan Kaldai sepaihhon tengteng, kumpipa vengpa pawl heutu kiang a omte'n Jerusalem kulhte akimvel in ahihchim vek uhi.
english: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down all the walls of Jerusalem all around.

paite: Huchi in vengpa pawl heutu Nebuzaradan in mipi lak a genthei pawl khenkhat khopi a nutsiat a omte, Babulon kumpipa kiang a kipesate leh mikhutsiam omsun tengtengte toh sal in apivekta hi.
english: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the poorest of the people, and the rest of the people who were left in the city, and those who fell away, who defected to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.

paite: Himahleh vengpa pawl heutu Nebuzaradan in gam a migenthei pen khenkhatte grephuan kemmi leh vengmi ding in anusia hi.
english: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poorest of the land to be vineyard keepers and farmers.

paite: TOUPA' inn a dalkhuamte leh akingaknate, dal maiphiat kuang lian TOUPA' inn a omte Kaldai mite'n ahihtamgawp ua, dal tengteng Babulon ah ala uhi.
english: The Chaldeans broke the pillars of bronze that were in Yahweh’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in Yahweh’s house in pieces, and carried all of their bronze to Babylon.

paite: Belte leng, vutluahte, khawnvak mihsaknate, maiphiat kuangte, sikkeute, dal tui-um belsuan tengteng a zat sekte uh ala vek uh.
english: They also took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.

paite: Noute leng, meivu koihnate, maiphiat kuangte, belte, khawnvak koihnate, sikkeute leh belhbute; dangka-eng a bawl huai dangkasik in vengmi pawl heutu in ala vek hi.
english: The captain of the guard took away the cups, the fire pans, the basins, the pots, the lamp stands, the spoons, and the bowls; that which was of gold, as gold, and that which was of silver, as silver.

paite: Khuam nih, dal a bawl bawngtal sawm-le-nih, maiphiatna kuang kingakna, kumpipa Solomon in TOUPA' inn a dia abawl, hiai tui-um belsuan tengteng dalte tamdan teh vual ahi kei hi.
english: They took the two pillars, the one sea, and the twelve bronze bulls that were under the bases, which King Solomon had made for Yahweh’s house. The bronze of all these vessels was without weight.

paite: Huan khuamte khuam khat sandan, tong sawm-le-giat ahi a, tong sawm-le-nih in akimvel zou phet ahi; asahdan zung za delh ahi a, asung ahawm hi.
english: As for the pillars, the height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a line of twelve cubits encircled it; and its thickness was four fingers. It was hollow.

paite: Atung ah dal lubawk a-om a, alubawk sandan tong nga ahi a, alubawk kimvel leh theibuhfai, dal ngen a zep ahi a; khuam nih in leng hichi mah bang in theibuhfai a-om hi.
english: A capital of bronze was on it; and the height of the one capital was five cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital all around, all of bronze. The second pillar also had the same, with pomegranates.

paite: Asik ah theibuhfai sawmkua-le-guk a-om a, akim a azepna theibuhfai tengteng zakhat ahi.
english: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides; all the pomegranates were one hundred on the network all around.

paite: Huan vengpa pawl heutu in siampu lianpen Seraiah leh siampu nihna, Zephaniah leh kongkhak ngakmi thumte aman hi.
english: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold,

paite: Kidou mite tung a heutu dia seh michilgeh leh mi sagih, kumpipa mel mu sekmi, khopi a omte leh sepaih heutu gelhmi, gam mite min kempa leh gam mipi lak a mi sawmguk, khopi a na omte khopi a kipan in apikhia hi.
english: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and seven men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe of the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land; and sixty men of the people of the land, who were found in the middle of the city.

paite: Nebuzaradan, vengpa pawl heutu in amaute api a, Babulon kumpipa kiang ah Riblah ah atun hi.
english: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

paite: Babulon kumpipa'n Hamath gam a Riblah ah atung ua khut kha in, athat vek hi. Huchi in Judah nam agam ua kipan in sal a pimang in a-omta.
english: The king of Babylon struck them, and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.

paite: Hiaite Nebukadnezzar in mipi sal a apite ahi uh; akum sagihna ah Juda mite sangthum sawmnih-le-thum;
english: This is the number of the people whom Nebuchadnezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year, three thousand twenty-three Jews;

paite: Nebukadnezzar kum sawm-le-giatna ah Jerusalem a kipan in mi zagiat sawmthum-le-nih sal in api hi.
english: in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar, he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty-two persons;

paite: Nebukadnezzar akum sawmnih-le-thumna ah Nebuzaradan vengtu pawl heutu in Juda saltang mi zasagih sawmli-le-nga api a, saltang tengteng avek un sangli-le-zaguk ahi uh.
english: in the twenty-third year of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty-five people. All the people numbered four thousand six hundred.

paite: Kumpipa saltan kum sawmthum-le-sagihna, akha sawm-le-nihna, huai kha ani sawmnih-le-nga ni geih in hichi ahong hi a, Babulon kumpipa Evil-merodak in avaihawm akum khatna ah, Judah kumpipa Jehoiakin lutang adopkangsak a, suangkul a kipan apikhia hi.
english: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the twenty-fifth day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the first year of his reign, lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and released him from prison.

paite: Akiang ah hoihtak in apau a, Babulon a akiang a om Kumpipate tutphah sang a sang in laltutphah atunsak hi.
english: He spoke kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,

paite: Asuangkul puansilhte akikhengsak a, adamsung teng ama ah an ane den hi.
english: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life.

paite: Huan amah vakna ding adamsung ni tengteng, asih ni tan in aniteng tantuan Babulon kumpipa'n ape gige hi.
english: For his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him by the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.

paite: Benjamin tate aw, Jerusalem sung a kipan na bitna ding un taimang unla; Tekoa ah pengkul mut unla Beth-hakkerem ah theihsakna suaksak un. Mallam a kipan in siatna ahong kuan hi, hihsiatna thupi mahmah.
english: “Flee for safety, you children of Benjamin, out of the middle of Jerusalem! Blow the trumpet in Tekoa and raise up a signal on Beth Haccherem, for evil looks out from the north with a great destruction.

paite: Zion tanu melhoihtak leh noutak ka hihmang ding.
english: I will cut off the beautiful and delicate one, the daughter of Zion.

paite: Belampute, abelamhonte uh toh akiang ahong tung ding ua, akim ah apuaninte uh akaihkhum ding ua, amau mun chiat ah ake ding uh.
english: Shepherds with their flocks will come to her. They will pitch their tents against her all around. They will feed everyone in his place.”

paite: Amah dou ding in kisa un, thou unla, sun lai in i sual ding uh, ei a ding in khawk hi na e! Ni akihekta a, nitaklam limliap ana sauta hi.
english: “Prepare war against her! Arise! Let’s go up at noon. Woe to us! For the day declines, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.

paite: Thou unla, zan in i sual mai ding uh! A-inn hoihhoih uh hihsia ni.
english: Arise! Let’s go up by night, and let’s destroy her palaces.”

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Asingte phuk unla, Jerusalem sualna ding in mualvum bawl un, khopi gawt ding pen hiai ahi, asung ah nuaisiahna ngen ahi.
english: For Yahweh of Armies said, “Cut down trees, and cast up a mound against Jerusalem. This is the city to be visited. She is filled with oppression within herself.

paite: Tuileh in tui apawtsak bang mai in agitlouhna apawtsak sek, asung ah hiamgamna leh kilohna a-om chih zak ahi, ka ma ah natna leh kiliamsaknate a-om nilouh hi.
english: As a well produces its waters, so she produces her wickedness. Violence and destruction is heard in her. Sickness and wounds are continually before me.

paite: Ka lungsim in ahon nutsiat vengveng ma in aw, Jerusalem, pilvang in, huchi lou in zaw luahmi nei lou gam dia hon bawl in, ka hon hihgawp kha ding hi."
english: Be instructed, Jerusalem, lest my soul be alienated from you, lest I make you a desolation, an uninhabited land.”

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Israel khosuaksunte grep bang in lou siang vek unla, grep lou mi bang in ahiangte ban tuantuan un.
english: Yahweh of Armies says, “They will thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel like a vine. Turn again your hand as a grape gatherer into the baskets.”

paite: "Angaihkhiak theihna ding un kua ka houpih in, kua ka theisak dia? Ngai in, bil lam zeksum louh ahi ua, angaikhe thei kei uh; ngai in, TOUPA thu amau a ding in thil simmohhuai ahi a, kipahna mahmah anei nawn kei uh.
english: To whom should I speak and testify, that they may hear? Behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they can’t listen. Behold, Yahweh’s word has become a reproach to them. They have no delight in it.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA hehna in ka dim a, ka kidek zou nawn kei; kholak a naupang tung ah ka bungkhe dia; tangval omkhawmte tung ah leng, azi toh kiton in pasal leng lak ahi ding a, upate leh teksiate leng.
english: Therefore I am full of Yahweh’s wrath. I am weary with holding it in. “Pour it out on the children in the street, and on the assembly of young men together; for even the husband with the wife will be taken, the aged with him who is full of days.

paite: A-innte uh midang kiang a piak ahi ding a, aloumate uleh azite uh toh; huai gam a tengte tung ah ka khut lik ding ka hi ngal a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Their houses will be turned to others, their fields and their wives together; for I will stretch out my hand on the inhabitants of the land, says Yahweh.”

paite: Aneupen a kipan alianpen tan in leng michih huaihamna in adim ua; zawlneite leh siampute nangawn leng, michih azuautat mahmah uhi.
english: “For from their least even to their greatest, everyone is given to covetousness. From the prophet even to the priest, everyone deals falsely.

paite: Ka mite liamna, awlmoh loutak buaipih in, muanna a-om louh laitak in Muanna, muanna, achi ua.
english: They have healed also the hurt of my people superficially, saying, ‘Peace, peace!’ when there is no peace.

paite: Thilkihhuai ahih un leng azum ua hia? Zum lou hial, azum het kei uh, amai uh leng asan sam kei; huaiziak in pukte lak ah apuk tei ding ua; amaute ka gawt hun chiang in paihkhiak in a-om ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush. Therefore they will fall among those who fall. When I visit them, they will be cast down,” says Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Lamka thuam ah dingh unla, en un, lampi hoih omna lampi luite tawn un, huai ah pai unla, na kha uh a ding in khawlna na mu ding uh," amau bel, "Huai ah ka pai kei ding uh," achi uhi.
english: Yahweh says, “Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, ‘Where is the good way?’ and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it.’

paite: Huan nou a ding in galvil mite ka sep ding a, "Pengkul ging ngaikhia un," chi in; amau bel, “Ka ngaikhe kei ding uh," achi uhi.
english: I set watchmen over you, saying, ‘Listen to the sound of the trumpet!’ But they said, ‘We will not listen!’

paite: Huaiziak in "Aw, namte aw, ngaikhia unla, aw, kikhawmte aw, atung ua hong tung ding thei un.
english: Therefore hear, you nations, and know, congregation, what is among them.

paite: Aw, leitung, ngaikhia in, ngai in, hiai mite tung ah siatna ka hon tun ding; angaihtuahna gahte uh; ka thute angaihkhiak louh ziak un; ka dante lah apaikhe hithet ua.
english: Hear, earth! Behold, I will bring evil on this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not listened to my words; and as for my law, they have rejected it.

paite: Bangziak a Sheba a kipan begaw, gamlapi a kipan kawltute ka kiang hong tung nak ahia? Na halmang kithoihnate uh kipahpihtak ahi kei a, na kithoihnate un ahon kipaksak sam kei hi.
english: To what purpose does frankincense from Sheba come to me, and the sweet cane from a far country? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices are not pleasing to me.”

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Hiai mite kiang ah puknate ka koih ding a, huai ah pate atapate uh toh apukkhawm ding ua, inveng leh alawm leng amangthang ding uh," chi in.
english: Therefore Yahweh says, “Behold, I will lay stumbling blocks before this people. The fathers and the sons together will stumble against them. The neighbor and his friend will perish.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai in, mallam gam a kipan mite ahong pai uh, lei mun tawp a kipan nam thupi mahmah ahong kuankhia hi.
english: Yahweh says, “Behold, a people comes from the north country. A great nation will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

paite: Thalpeu leh teipi atawi ua, hiamgam mahmah, zahngaihna himhim nei lou ahi uhi, ahusa uh tuipi ging honhon bang ahia; sakol tungte ah atuang ua, michih galkapmi bang a kivan in, aw, Zion tanu, nang ahong sual dek uhi," chi in.
english: They take hold of bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Zion.”

paite: "Aminthanna uh i za ua, i khutte azaw khinta, numei nauvei lunggimna bangbang lunggimna'n ahon manta hi.
english: We have heard its report. Our hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of us, and pains as of a woman in labor.

paite: Gam ah paikhe kei un, lampi ah leng pai sam kei un, huai ah lah melma namsau a-om ngal a, kil chih ah launa a-om hi."
english: Don’t go out into the field or walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and terror are on every side.

paite: "Aw, ka mi, ka tanu, sai-ip puan teng inla, vut lak ah tubial in; tapa tang khat suun bang in suun inla, kap vongvong dih, i tung uah hihsemi ahong tung guih dek ngal ua.
english: Daughter of my people, clothe yourself with sackcloth, and wallow in ashes! Mourn, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation, for the destroyer will suddenly come on us.

paite: Ka mite lak a chiamtehmi ding leh ze-etmi ding in ka hon bawl a, a-omdan uh na theih a, na ze-et theihna ding in.
english: “I have made you a tester of metals and a fortress among my people, that you may know and try their way.

paite: Avek un genhaktak a helhat, gensiat ching a vialvak, dal leh sik bang ahi uh, hoihloupi in agamtang uhi.
english: They are all grievous rebels, going around to slander. They are bronze and iron. All of them deal corruptly.

paite: Pum in azap huhu a, mei ah asuan zulbei a, hihsiangthou tupna athawn lel ahi; migiloute lah paihmang ahi ngal kei ua.
english: The bellows blow fiercely. The lead is consumed in the fire. In vain they go on refining, for the wicked are not plucked away.

paite: Mite'n dangkasik ek hoih lou achi ding uh, TOUPA'N amaute apampaih ziak in," achi hi.
english: Men will call them rejected silver, because Yahweh has rejected them.”

paite: TOUPA a pan a Jeremiah kiang a thu hong tung:
english: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

paite: "TOUPA' inn kongpi ah dingh inla, huai ah hiai thu puang inla, hichi in chi in; Nou Judah mi tengteng, TOUPA be ding a hiai kongpi a lutte'n TOUPA thu ngaikhia un."
english: “Stand in the gate of Yahweh’s house, and proclaim this word there, and say, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, all you of Judah, who enter in at these gates to worship Yahweh.’”

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Na omdan uleh na thilhihte uh bawlhoih unla, hiai mun ah ka hon tengsak ding hi.
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.

paite: Hiai, "TOUPA tempul, TOUPA tempul, TOUPA tempul ahi," chih zuauthute gingta kei un.
english: Don’t trust in lying words, saying, ‘Yahweh’s temple, Yahweh’s temple, Yahweh’s temple, are these.’

paite: "Na omdan uleh na thilhihte uh na bawlhoih petmah ua, mi leh invengte kikal a thu diktak a na vai hawmsak ua,
english: For if you thoroughly amend your ways and your doings, if you thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbor;

paite: namdang mite, pa neiloute, meithaite na nuaisiah louh ua, hiai mun a midiktat sisan na suah louh ua, na hoihlouhna ding ua pathian dangte na delh sam kei ualeh,
english: if you don’t oppress the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, and don’t shed innocent blood in this place, and don’t walk after other gods to your own hurt,

paite: hiai gam, tuma lam a na pipute uh kiang a ka piak ah tangtawn in ka hon tengsak ding hi.
english: then I will cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, from of old even forever more.

paite: Ngai un, zuauthu, phattuamna om het lou na gingtazaw ua.
english: Behold, you trust in lying words that can’t profit.

paite: Gukgu in, tualthat in, angkawm in, zuau a kichiam in Baal kiang a gimlim hal in, pathian dang, na theih ngeilouhte uh na delh uhi.
english: Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods that you have not known,

paite: Hiai inn, ka min mahmah a loh ah ka ma ah hong ding in, hiai thilkihhuai tengtengte hih zel kawm in, hotkhiak ka hita, na chi ding ua hia?
english: then come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, ‘We are delivered,’ that you may do all these abominations?

paite: Hiai inn ka min mahmah a loh, na mitmuh un suamhatte kokhuk bang lel ahi hia? Ngai un, kei, kei mahmah in ka mu hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I myself have seen it,” says Yahweh.

paite: Atung a ka min ka tensakna, ka mun Shiloh ah hoh dih ua, ka mi Israel gitlouhna ziak a ka thilhih va en un.
english: “But go now to my place which was in Shiloh, where I caused my name to dwell at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.

paite: Tu in hiai thil tengteng na hih ua, phalvak a thou a na kiang ua thu ka gengente na ngaihkhiak louh ua, nou ka hon sap a, na dawn louh ziak un;
english: Now, because you have done all these works,” says Yahweh, “and I spoke to you, rising up early and speaking, but you didn’t hear; and I called you, but you didn’t answer;

paite: Shiloh tung a ka hih bang in hiai ka min lohna inn, noumau leh na pipute uh kiang a ka mun piak, na muan uh tung ah ka hih dek ahi.
english: therefore I will do to the house which is called by my name, in which you trust, and to the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I did to Shiloh.

paite: Na unau tengteng uh, Ephraim nam pumpi nangawn ka paihkhiak bang in ka mitmuh a kipan nou ka hon paikhe ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brothers, even the whole offspring of Ephraim.

paite: "Huaiziak in hiai mite a ding in thum ke'nla, kikoukhia in thum ke'nla, ka kiang ah leng ngetsak sam ke'n; ka hon ngaikhe kei ding hi.
english: “Therefore don’t pray for this people. Don’t lift up a cry or prayer for them or make intercession to me; for I will not hear you.

paite: Judah khopite a leh Jerusalem kholakte a athilhih uh na mu kei a hia?
english: Don’t you see what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

paite: Naupangte'n sing atom ua, apate un mei atoh ua, numeite'n van kumpinu kiang a lat ding tanghou amek ua, pathian dangte ding in dawn ding thillat atungkhia ua, ahon hehsakna lel ding un.
english: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead the dough, to make cakes to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.

paite: Kei ahi maw hon hehsak uh?" chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; amau zumna ding in amau ahi zaw kei uh maw?
english: Do they provoke me to anger?” says Yahweh. “Don’t they provoke themselves, to the confusion of their own faces?”

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai dih uh, hiai mun tung ah ka hehna leh thangpaihna ka sungkhe ding a; akang dia, amit kei ding.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, my anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place, on man, on animal, on the trees of the field, and on the fruit of the ground; and it will burn and will not be quenched.”

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Na kithoihnate uah halmang kithoihnate behlap unla, sa ne un.
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices and eat meat.

paite: Halmang thillat hiam, kithoihnate hiam tungthu ah zaw na pipute uh kiang ah thu ka gen kei a, Aigupta gam a kipan ka pikhiak lai in leng thu ka pe sam kei.
english: For I didn’t speak to your fathers or command them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices;

paite: Ka aw ngaikhia unla, na Pathian uh ka hi ding a, nou leng ka mite na hi ding uh; na hoihtheihna ding un na omdan ding uh ka hon hilh tengteng zui un, chi in thu ka pe zaw hi.
english: but this thing I commanded them, saying, ‘Listen to my voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be my people. Walk in all the way that I command you, that it may be well with you.’

paite: Himahleh angaikhe kei ua, bil adoh sam kei uh; alungtang gilou ua angaihtuah uh zui in a-om zaw uh, malam zot sang in anungtawn zawta uhi.
english: But they didn’t listen or turn their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.

paite: Na pipute uh Aigupta gam a kipan apawt ni ua kipan a tuni tan in ka nasemmi, zawlnei tengtengte phalvak a thou in na kiang uah niteng in ka sawl zel a,
english: Since the day that your fathers came out of the land of Egypt to this day, I have sent to you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them.

paite: himahleh ahon ngaikhe tuan kei ua, bil adoh sam kei uh; alungsim uh akhauhsak ua, apipute uh sang in agilou zawta uhi.
english: Yet they didn’t listen to me or incline their ear, but made their neck stiff. They did worse than their fathers.

paite: "Hiai thu tengteng akiang ua na gen ding ahi; himahleh ahon ngaikhe kei ding ua; amau na sam ding a, ahon dawng kei ding uh.
english: “You shall speak all these words to them, but they will not listen to you. You shall also call to them, but they will not answer you.

paite: Akiang uah, 'Hiai nam TOUPA a Pathian uh aw ngaikhe lou a, thununna tang lou nam ei ve ua, na chi ding a; thudik amangthangta, akam ua kipan paihmang ahita.
english: You shall tell them, ‘This is the nation that has not listened to Yahweh their God’s voice, nor received instruction. Truth has perished, and is cut off from their mouth.’

paite: Na sam tan inla, paimang in, mun sang giaute ah kapkhia in; TOUPA'N ahehna khang paikhia in anawlkhinta hi.'
english: Cut off your hair, and throw it away, and take up a lamentation on the bare heights; for Yahweh has rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.

paite: "Judah tate'n lah ka mitmuh in thil gilou ahih ngal uh chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; ka min lohna inn ninsak ding in athilkihhuaite uh akoih khin uhi.
english: “For the children of Judah have done that which is evil in my sight,” says Yahweh. “They have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

paite: Atanute uh, atapate uh hal ding in Ben Hinnom Phaizang ah Taphet mun sangte abawl ua; huaite ka thupiak ahi kei a, ka lungsim ah leng alut ngei sam kei.
english: They have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, which I didn’t command, nor did it come into my mind.

paite: Huaiziak in ngai dih uh, nite ahong tung dek," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Huai phaizang pen Tophet, chih ahi nawn kei ding a, Ben Hinnom Phaizang, chih leng ahi sam kei ding a Kithahna Phaizang chih ahita ding; Tophet ah avui ding ua, vuina ding mun a-omta kei ding.
english: Therefore behold, the days come”, says Yahweh, “that it will no more be called ‘Topheth’ or ‘The valley of the son of Hinnom’, but ‘The valley of Slaughter’; for they will bury in Topheth until there is no place to bury.

paite: Mite luang tung a leng vasate leh gamsate an ahi ding; kuamah in adelhmang kei ding uh.
english: The dead bodies of this people will be food for the birds of the sky, and for the animals of the earth. No one will frighten them away.

paite: Judah khopite ah leh Jerusalem kholakte ah nuamsa husate leh kipahna gingte, mouneipa awte, mou awte leng ka daisak ding; agam segawp ding ahi ngal a.
english: Then I will cause to cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride; for the land will become a waste.”
