paite: Huai hun chiang in, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; Judah kumpipate guhte, aheutute guhte, siampute guhte, zawlneite guhte, Jerusalem a tengte guhte ahan ua kipan alakhe ding ua;
english: “At that time,” says Yahweh, “they will bring the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of his princes, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves.

paite: nite, khate, van a om tengteng, a-it ua, nna asep ua, adelh ua, azon ua, chibai abukte uh ma ah aphoukhe ding uh; lakkhawm ahi nawnta kei ding ua, vui ahi sam kei ding uh; leitung a ekvut lel ding ahi ding.
english: They will spread them before the sun, the moon, and all the army of the sky, which they have loved, which they have served, after which they have walked, which they have sought, and which they have worshiped. They will not be gathered or be buried. They will be like dung on the surface of the earth.

paite: Hiai inkuan gilou mahmah om lai sung tengteng, ka hawlzakna mun a omlaite'n hin sang in sih atel zaw ding uh, chih sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Death will be chosen rather than life by all the residue that remain of this evil family, that remain in all the places where I have driven them,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huai lou leng akiang uah huchi in na gen ding hi, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Mi apuk un athounawn kei ding ua hia? Mi avakmang in ahong kik nawn kei dia hia?
english: “Moreover you shall tell them, ‘Yahweh says: “‘Do men fall, and not rise up again? Does one turn away, and not return?

paite: Bang achia hiai Jerusalem mite, tangtawn a nungtawn ding a atolhpuk uh? Khemna alenkip ua, kik nawn a-ut kei uh.
english: Why then have the people of Jerusalem fallen back by a perpetual backsliding? They cling to deceit. They refuse to return.

paite: Ka bildoh in ka ngaikhia a, kuamah in thudik agen kei uh, kuamah in, "Bang ahia ka hih?" chi in athulimlouhna uh akisik sam kei uh; michih in amau lampi anga chiat uh; kidouna mun a sakol dianglut bang mai in.
english: I listened and heard, but they didn’t say what is right. No one repents of his wickedness, saying, “What have I done?” Everyone turns to his course, as a horse that rushes headlong in the battle.

paite: Ahi, van a tuivapi in ahunbite athei a, vakhute, lensiamte, tuivanelkaite, ahun geihgeih in ahong tung zel uh. Ka mite'n bel TOUPA thukhendante athei kei uh.
english: Yes, the stork in the sky knows her appointed times. The turtledove, the swallow, and the crane observe the time of their coming; but my people don’t know Yahweh’s law.

paite: Bangchi in ahia, mipil i hi ua, TOUPA dan i kiang uah a-om, na chih uh? Ngai un, laigelhmi laigelhna zuauthei in, zuau in asuaksak zaw uhi.
english: “‘How do you say, “We are wise, and Yahweh’s law is with us”? But, behold, the false pen of the scribes has made that a lie.

paite: Mipilte azum un alungdong ding ua, mat in a-om ding uh; ngai un, TOUPA thu apaikhia ua, amau ah bang pilna a-om a hia?
english: The wise men are disappointed. They are dismayed and trapped. Behold, they have rejected Yahweh’s word. What kind of wisdom is in them?

paite: Huaiziak in azite uh midangte kiang ah ka pe ding a, aloute uh leng ahon neimi a dingte kiang ah; michih, aneupen a kipan athupipen tan in en hat ahi uhi. Zawlnei a kipan a siampu tan in leng michih khemhat ahi uhi.
english: Therefore I will give their wives to others and their fields to those who will possess them. For everyone from the least even to the greatest is given to covetousness; from the prophet even to the priest everyone deals falsely.

paite: Ka tanu, ka mite liam awlmoh loutak in, muanna om lou napi, "Muanna, muanna," chi in athoih uhi.
english: They have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, “Peace, peace,” when there is no peace.

paite: Thilkihhuai ahih un azum uhia? Ii, azum het kei ua, amel uh leng asan kei. Huaiziak in pukte lak ah apuk tei ding ua, amaute gawt hun chiang in paihkhiak in a-om ding uh chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed. They couldn’t blush. Therefore they will fall among those who fall. In the time of their visitation they will be cast down, says Yahweh.

paite: Amau ka hihmang vek ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; grep guite agah kei ding a, theipi kungte agah sam kei ding; anah leng avuai ding a, amaute tummang dingte ka sep khinta hi.
english: “‘I will utterly consume them, says Yahweh. No grapes will be on the vine, no figs on the fig tree, and the leaf will fade. The things that I have given them will pass away from them.’”

paite: Bangziak a tulai lai i hi ua? Kikaikhawm unla, khopi kulh neite ah lut unla, huai ah i mangthang diam ding uh; TOUPA tung a i gitlouh tak ziak in; TOUPA i Pathian un gutui dawn ding hon pia in manthatna ah ahon koih hi.
english: “Why do we sit still? Assemble yourselves! Let’s enter into the fortified cities, and let’s be silent there; for Yahweh our God has put us to silence, and given us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against Yahweh.

paite: Muanna i zong ua, hoihna bangmah ahong tung kei, hihdamna hun ding leng, ngai in, lungdonna lel!
english: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!

paite: Asakol nak ging uh Dan a kipan a zak ahi a, asakol uh ham ging in gam pumpi aling a, ahong tung ua, asung a om teng, agai vek ua, khopi leh asung a tengte toh.
english: The snorting of his horses is heard from Dan. The whole land trembles at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they have come, and have devoured the land and all that is in it, the city and those who dwell therein.”

paite: Ngai un, na lak uah gulpi ka sawl ding a, gulgu nei, khoizual vuallouhte; huaite'n nou ahon tu ding ua, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “For, behold, I will send serpents, adders among you, which will not be charmed; and they will bite you,” says Yahweh.

paite: Aw lungkhamna ah kilungmuan thei leng aw! Sunggil ah ka lungtang abah khinta hi.
english: Oh that I could comfort myself against sorrow! My heart is faint within me.

paite: Ngai un, gam gamlapi a kipan, ka mite tanu kah husa, Zion ah TOUPA a-om kei a hia? Asung a akumpipa om lou ahi maw? milim bawltawmte leh namdang milimte'n bang achia hon hehsak ahi ua?
english: Behold, the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people from a land that is very far off: “Isn’t Yahweh in Zion? Isn’t her King in her?” “Why have they provoked me to anger with their engraved images, and with foreign idols?”

paite: Buh lak hun akikhelta, nipi abeita, hotdam in i om kei lailai.
english: “The harvest is past. The summer has ended, and we are not saved.”

paite: Ka mite, ka tanu natna ah ka na a, ka suun a, lungdonna in ahon len hi.
english: For the hurt of the daughter of my people, I am hurt. I mourn. Dismay has taken hold of me.

paite: Gilead a singnai damdawi om lou hia? huai ah hihdam mi a-om kei a hia? bangziak a ka mite, ka tanu damthei lou ahia?
english: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then isn’t the health of the daughter of my people recovered?

paite: Ka lu tui hi in, ka mit khitui nak hileh aw, ka mi, ka tanu thahte a ding in asun-azan in ka kap ding,
english: Oh that my head were waters, and my eyes a spring of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!

paite: Gamdai ah khualbuk nei thei leng aw! Ka mite paisan in om mangsan leng aw; angkawm hatmi ahi vek ngal ua, khemhat omkhawm lel ahi uh.
english: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men, that I might leave my people and go from them! For they are all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.

paite: Alei uh thalpeu bang in zuau in azang ua, gam ah akhanglian ua, thutak a khang lou in gilou lam ah akhang ua, kei hon thei lou in, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they don’t know me,” says Yahweh.

paite: Noumau inveng lak ah pilvang chiat unla, na unaute himhim uh muang kei un; unaute lah khemhat ahi ngal ua; invengte leng gensiat hat ahi uh.
english: “Everyone beware of his neighbor, and don’t trust in any brother; for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbor will go around like a slanderer.

paite: Amau inveng chiat akhem ding ua, thudik agen kei ding uh; alei uh zuaugen akisinsak ua, thulimlouhna sem in agim uhi.
english: Friends deceive each other, and will not speak the truth. They have taught their tongue to speak lies. They weary themselves committing iniquity.

paite: Khem hat lak ah na teng a, akhemna uh ziak in kei ahon thei nuam kei uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Your habitation is in the middle of deceit. Through deceit, they refuse to know me,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngai un, amau ka tuisuaksak ding a, ka ze-et ding; ka mi, ka tanu ziak in bang dang ahia ka hihtak ding aw?
english: Therefore Yahweh of Armies says, “Behold, I will melt them and test them; for how should I deal with the daughter of my people?

paite: Alei uh sihna thal ahi a, khemna thu agen zel, mi'n kam in invengte kiang ah kituahna thu gen mahleh, alungtang ah amah atang giugiau hi.
english: Their tongue is a deadly arrow. It speaks deceit. One speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in his heart, he waits to ambush him.

paite: Hiai thilhihte ziak in ka gawt kei dia hia? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; nam hichibang tung ah phu ka la kei dia hia?
english: Shouldn’t I punish them for these things?” says Yahweh. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on a nation such as this?

paite: Tangte a ding in ka kap dia, ka mau vungvung ding, gamdai loupa munte ka suun ding a, kuamah pai nawnlouhna ding a akat khit tak ziak in, mite'n ganta husa aza nawnta kei ding ua, tung a leng vasate leh gamsate leng ataikek ua, apaimangta uh.
english: I will weep and wail for the mountains, and lament for the pastures of the wilderness, because they are burned up, so that no one passes through; Men can’t hear the voice of the livestock. Both the birds of the sky and the animals have fled. They are gone.

paite: Huan Jerusalem bel thil sia omkhawm lel in ka bawl dek a, sehalte tenna mun ahi ding; Judah khopite tengmi om lou in ka hingawn ding.
english: “I will make Jerusalem heaps, a dwelling place of jackals. I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.”

paite: Hiai theisiam ding in mipil kua ahia? Puangkhe ding a TOUPA thugen na sang mi pen kua ahia? Bangziak in ahia gam asiat khit a, kuamah pailouhna ding a gamdai bang a akat khit?
english: Who is wise enough to understand this? Who is he to whom the mouth of Yahweh has spoken, that he may declare it? Why has the land perished and burned up like a wilderness, so that no one passes through?

paite: Huan TOUPA'N, "Ka dan, ama ua ka koih apaisan ua, ka paukam suak amang kei ua, azui kei uh,
english: Yahweh says, “Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice or walked in my ways,

paite: alungtang khauh uh zui a, apipute un asinsak uh Baalte adelh zawk tak ziak un;
english: but have walked after the stubbornness of their own heart and after the Baals, which their fathers taught them.”

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: Ngai un, amau, hiai mite mahmah gamsai in ka vak ding a, tui kha leng ka dawnsak ding.
english: Therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, “Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.

paite: Nam, amau leh apipute un leng atheih ngeilouhte lak ah ka dalhsak ding a; ka hihmanthat vek mateng namsau ka delhsak ding."
english: I will scatter them also among the nations, whom neither they nor their fathers have known. I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them.”

paite: Sepaihte' ToUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngaihtuah unla, numei kap mite hong pai ding in sam un, numei kahsiamte hong pai ding in sam lai un.
english: Yahweh of Armies says, “Consider, and call for the mourning women, that they may come. Send for the skillful women, that they may come.

paite: Hong kin uhenla, hong kahkhum peuhmah le uh, i khitui aluan a, i mitte ua tui apawttheihna ding in.
english: Let them make haste and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears and our eyelids gush out with waters.

paite: Zion a kipan kah husa zak ahi ngal a, i naksiat khit takdan uh; gen ding i thei mahmah kei ua, i gam i paisan ziak uleh, i tennate apaihkhiak tak ziak un.
english: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, ‘How we are ruined! We are greatly confounded because we have forsaken the land, because they have cast down our dwellings.’”

paite: Aw nou numeite aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia unla, akamsuak thu na bil uah lut henla, na tanute uh kah sinsak un; michih in a-invengnu kiang ah suunna la.
english: Yet hear Yahweh’s word, you women. Let your ear receive the word of his mouth. Teach your daughters wailing. Everyone teach her neighbor a lamentation.

paite: I tawlet uahte sihna kal lut in i kumpipa' inn uahte alutta hi; inn polam a kipan naupang hihmang ding leh, kholak a kipan tangval hihmang ding.
english: For death has come up into our windows. It has entered into our palaces to cut off the children from outside, and the young men from the streets.

paite: TOUPA thupawt in hichi in achi: Mi luangte gamlak ah ekvut bang in apuk ding ua, buh lami buhmaih bang in; kuamah in alakhawm kei ding, chi in.
english: Speak, “Yahweh says, “‘The dead bodies of men will fall as dung on the open field, and as the handful after the harvester. No one will gather them.’”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Mipil in apilna suang kei henla mihat in ahatna suang sam kei hen, mihau in asum-le-pai suang kei hen.
english: Yahweh says, “Don’t let the wise man glory in his wisdom. Don’t let the mighty man glory in his might. Don’t let the rich man glory in his riches.

paite: Asuang peuhmah in hiai suang hen, Kei TOUPA, zahngaihna, vaihawmdikna, diktatna lei a zangpa ka hi chih atheih a, atheihsiamnatak; hiai thilte ka kipah lam ahi ngal a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: But let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am Yahweh who exercises loving kindness, justice, and righteousness on the earth, for I delight in these things,” says Yahweh.

paite: Ngai un, nite ahong tung hi, chih Toupa thupawt ahi, zeksum hi ngal, sum louh bang zaw ka gawt ding.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will punish all those who are circumcised only in their flesh:

paite: Aigupta, Judah, Edom, Ammon leh Moab, gamdai a teng, baksam metgiaute; hiai nam tengteng zeksumlouhte ahi ngal ua, Israel inkote tengteng leng lungtang a zeksumlouhte ahi uh.
english: Egypt, Judah, Edom, the children of Ammon, Moab, and all who have the corners of their hair cut off, who dwell in the wilderness, for all the nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in heart.”

paite: Uz gam ah mi khat a-om a, amin Job ahi; amah mihoihkim leh tang ahi a, Pathian kihta a, hoih lou mudah ahi.
english: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God, and turned away from evil.

paite: Ama'n tapa sagih leh tanu thum anei hi.
english: There were born to him seven sons and three daughters.

paite: Aneih-le-lam leng belam sangsagih, sangawngsau sangthum, bawngtal zanga leh sabiltungnu zanga leh inkuan thupi mahmah ahi, huchi in hiai mipa suahlam tate tengteng lak a thupipen ahi.
english: His possessions also were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female donkeys, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the children of the east.

paite: Huan atapate akuan ua khat chiat inn ah, ani ni in ankuangluina anei ua; huchi in mi asawl ua asanggam numei thumte uh amau kiang a ne ding leh dawn ding in asamsak uhi.
english: His sons went and held a feast in the house of each one on his birthday; and they sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, a-ankuanglui san laitak un, Job in mi asawl a amaute ahihsiangthou a, zingsang beltak in athou a, avek ua zah dungzui in halmang thillatte alan a: Job in, "Ka tapate'n thil ahihkhial un, alungtang un Pathian ahamsiat kha ding uh," achi hi. Hichibang in Job in ahih gige hi.
english: It was so, when the days of their feasting had run their course, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all. For Job said, “It may be that my sons have sinned, and renounced God in their hearts.” Job did so continually.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA ma a Pathian tapate ahong kilak ni uh a-om a, alak uah Setan leng ahong pai hi.
english: Now on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before Yahweh, Satan also came among them.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Koi a hong kipan na hia?" achi hi. Setan in TOUPA adawng a, "Leitung langkhat langkhat tawn a, asung a sukvak-touvak ka hi," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Then Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “From going back and forth on the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

paite: TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Ka sikha Job na ngaihtuah ngei hia? Amah bang a hoihkim leh mitang, Pathian kihta a hoih lou mudah lei ah lah kuamah a-om ngal kei a," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant, Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil.”

paite: Setan in TOUPA adawng a, "Bangmah lou dia Job in Pathian kihta ahi maw?
english: Then Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “Does Job fear God for nothing?

paite: Amah kimvel in, a-inn kimvel in leh aneih tengteng kimvel in, ning chiteng ah umna na bawl kei maw? Akhut nasep na vualzawl a, gamsung ah aneih-le-lam apung hi.
english: Haven’t you made a hedge around him, and around his house, and around all that he has, on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.

paite: Himahleh tu in na khut zankhia inla, aneih tengteng khoih in, huchi in na maitang ah nang ahon gense mai ding hi,” achi hi.
english: But stretch out your hand now, and touch all that he has, and he will renounce you to your face.”

paite: TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Ngai in, aneih tengteng nang thu ahi; amah mah tung ah kia na khut kha ke'n," achi hi. Huchi in TOUPA ma a kipan in Setan akuankhia hi.
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Behold, all that he has is in your power. Only on himself don’t stretch out your hand.” So Satan went out from the presence of Yahweh.

paite: Huan atapate leh atanute'n a-unaupa uh upapen inn a ne a uain adawn ni uh a-om a,
english: It fell on a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,

paite: Job kiang ah sawltak khat hong pai in, "Bawngtalte'n lei alet ua, sabiltungte akiang ah agamta ua,
english: that a messenger came to Job, and said, “The oxen were plowing, and the donkeys feeding beside them,

paite: Sheba mite'n amau adelh ua, apimang uh; ahi, namsau hiam in sikhate athat ua; huan nang hilh ding in kei keleu ka suakta hi," achi hi.
english: and the Sabeans attacked, and took them away. Yes, they have killed the servants with the edge of the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

paite: Huchi a thu agen lai in midang khat leng ahong a, "Van a kipan in Pathian mei akia a, belamte leh sikhate akangmang a, amau akangtum hi; huan nang hilh ding in kei keleu ka suakta hi," achi hi.
english: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The fire of God has fallen from the sky, and has burned up the sheep and the servants, and consumed them, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

paite: Huchi a thu agen lai in, midang khat ahong lai a, "Kaldai mite'n pawl thum abawl ua, sangawngsaute adelh ua, apimang uh, huan namsau hiam in sikhate athat ua; huan nang hilh ding in kei keleu ka suakta hi," achi hi.
english: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The Chaldeans made three bands, and swept down on the camels, and have taken them away, yes, and killed the servants with the edge of the sword; and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

paite: Huchi a thu agen lai in, midang khat mah ahong a, "Na tapate leh na tanute'n a-unaupa upapen inn a anek ua uain adawn lai un,
english: While he was still speaking, there came also another, and said, “Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,

paite: ngai in gamdai a kipan in huih thupi ahong nung a, huai inn ning lite ahon nuai a, tangvalte tung ah achim a, asi uh: huan nang hilh ding in kei keleu ka suakta hi," achi hi.
english: and behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and struck the four corners of the house, and it fell on the young men, and they are dead. I alone have escaped to tell you.”

paite: Huchi in Job athou a, apuanak- tual abotkek a, asam ametsiang a, leitual kidenna in anei a, Pathian abeta hi.
english: Then Job arose, and tore his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down on the ground, and worshiped.

paite: Ama'n, "Ka nu sul a kipan vuaktang in ka hong a, huan vuaktang in ka kik ding, TOUPA'N apia a, huan TOUPA'N alamangta; TOUPA min phat in om hen," achi hi.
english: He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. Yahweh gave, and Yahweh has taken away. Blessed be Yahweh’s name.”

paite: Hiai tengteng ah Job in ahihkhial kei a, haihuaitak in Pathian leng amohsa kei hi.
english: In all this, Job didn’t sin, nor charge God with wrongdoing.

paite: "Ka kha in ka hinna achimtak a, ka utdan dan in ka phun ding; ka kha thangpaihna in thu ka gen ding.
english: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

paite: Pathian kiang ah, Hon mohpaih ke'n; bangziak a hon kinakpih na hia hon theisak in, ka chi ding hi.
english: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.

paite: Na nuaisiah nang a dia hoih ahi maw, na khutte thilhih na muhsit a, giloute thugen tung a na maitai?
english: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?

paite: Sa mitte nei na hi hia, ahihkeileh mihing muh bang amu na hi hia?
english: Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?

paite: Na nite mihing nite bang hi a, ahihkeileh na kumte mihing kumte bang,
english: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,

paite: Ka thulimlouhna na kan a, ka khelhna na nungdelh hi.
english: that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?

paite: Ka gilou kei chih thei napi a, na khut a kipan hon suaktasak ding a-om louh?
english: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.

paite: "Na khutte'n ahon sek un ahon bawl kimvel sipsip ua; tu'n kihei in na hon hihse dia hia?
english: “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.

paite: Theigige in, ka hon ngen ahi, tungman bang a na hon mekdan; leivui hon tun nawn ding na hi hia?
english: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?

paite: Nawitui bang in na hon sungkhia in, nawituidat bang in na hon tok kei maw?
english: Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?

paite: Vun leh sa in na hon tuam a, guhte leh thagui in na hon phankhawm hi.
english: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.

paite: Hinna leh deihsakna na hon phal a, huan na hon vehna in ka kha ahawi hi.
english: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.

paite: "Himahleh hiai thilte na lungtang sung ah na sel a; hiai bel na tup ahi chih ka thei hi.
english: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:

paite: Thil ka hihkhelhleh na hon chiamteh a, ka thulimlouhna a kipan na hon khah kei ding hi.
english: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.

paite: Ka gitlouhleh, ka tung agik hi; midiktat himah leng, ka lutang ka sangsak kei ding hi. Lungbuaina in ka dim a, huaiziak in ka gimthuakna en in.
english: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.

paite: Ka lutang akiletsakleh, humpinelkai bang in nang na hon beng a, ka tung a na lamdandan na hon ensak nawn hi.
english: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.

paite: Kei kalh in na palainate na thaksak a, ka tung a na hehna na khangsak a; hon dou ding sepaihhon thak na hon sawl hi.
english: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.

paite: "Bangziak a sul a pan hon lakhia na hia? Na si in kuamah muh louh na hi leng.
english: “‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.

paite: Om lou mah bangta ding hi ing a; sul a pan a han a puak a om ding hi ing.
english: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

paite: Ka nite atom kei maw? Huchi ahihleh, tawp in, hon omsak maimai in, huchi a neukha a ka lungmuan theihna ding in.
english: Aren’t my days few? Stop! Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,

paite: Ka kik nawnlouhna a ka pai ma in khomialna gam leh sihna limliap gam mahmah ah.
english: before I go where I will not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;

paite: Mialna mah bang a, mialna sahna gam a: sihna limliap gam, dan himhim omlouhna, khovak khomial bang a a- omna mun ah.”
english: the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’”

paite: Huan Naamath mi Zophar in adawng a, hichi in achi:
english: Then Zophar, the Naamathite, answered,

paite: "Thu tampite dawn louh ding ahi a hia? Mi houlimna a dim siamtansak ding hia?
english: “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?

paite: Na khemnate'n mite daisak ding hia? na simmoh chiang in, kuamah in nang hon zahlaksak lou ding uhia?
english: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?

paite: Ka thuhilh asiangthou a, na mit uah ka siang hi, na chi ngal a.
english: For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’

paite: Himahleh Pathian in thugen maizenleh zaw, nang dem in amukte hongleh;
english: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you,

paite: Huchi in pilna thugukte nang ahon ensak ding a, atheihna ah thuah tampi ahi chih, huaiziak in na thulimlouhna sang a tawmzaw na lak ah Pathian in nang ahon phut chih thei in.
english: that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves.

paite: "Zon in Pathian na mu thei diam; hoihkimna ah Bangkim hihthei na mu thei diam?
english: “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?

paite: Van bang in asang a; bang na hihthei dia? Sheol sang in athuk a; bang na theithei dia?
english: They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol. What can you know?

paite: Huai a tehna lei sang in asauzaw a, tuipi sang in azazaw hi.
english: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

paite: Paisuak henla, man henla, vaihawmna ah samleh, huchi in kua'n amah adal thei dia?
english: If he passes by, or confines, or convenes a court, then who can oppose him?

paite: Ama'n lah mi bangmah loute athei ngal a; ngaihtuah kei mahleh, thulimlouhna leng amu hi.
english: For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn’t consider it.

paite: Mihing theihsiamna bei in theihsiamna anei ding, mihing a sabiltungnou apian chiang in.
english: An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.

paite: "Na lungtang na koih dik a, amah lam a na khutte na zakleh;
english: “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.

paite: Na khut a thulimlouhna a-om a, gamlapi a na koihkhiak a, gitlouhna na puanin a na tensak keileh;
english: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.

paite: Gensiatna ding om lou in na mai na daksak ding a; ahi, na kip ding a, na lau kei ding.
english: Surely then you will lift up your face without spot. Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear,

paite: Na haksatna na mangngilh ding ziak in; tui luangmang bang in na theigige ding hi.
english: for you will forget your misery. You will remember it like waters that have passed away.

paite: Sun lai sang in na hinna achiangzaw ding a; khomial om mahleh, zingsang bang in na tangkhe ding hi.
english: Life will be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it will be as the morning.

paite: "Lametna a-om ziak in, na kipta ding hi; ahi, ama tanchin na zong ding a, muang in na khawlta ding hi.
english: You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety.

paite: Lup leng na lum ding a, kuamah in nang hon lausak kei ding uhi; ahi, mi tampi'n nang hon zong ding uhi.
english: Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.

paite: Himahleh gilou mitte azuausuak ding a, asuakta kei ding ua, alametna uh kha khah ahi ding hi."
english: But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”

paite: Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
english: Then Job answered,

paite: "Ginlelh vual louh in mite zaw na hi peuhmah ua, nou toh pilna asi ding hi.
english: “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.

paite: Himahleh noute bang in theihsiamna ka nei; nou sang in ka niamzaw kei, ahi, hiaite bang thilte kuan athei kei a?
english: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?

paite: Kei zaw mi invengte a dia nuihzabuk ka hi a, kei, huai Pathian sam a, huai ama'n amah adawnpa, midik, mihoihkim, nuihzabuk ka na hi.
english: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.

paite: Om nuam a om ngaihtuahna ah vangsiatna muhsitna a-om a; himahleh akhe uh teute a ding in mansa in a-om hi.
english: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.

paite: Suamhatte puaninte alohching a, Pathian hehsakte abit ua; akhut a pathian tawite Pathian in tampi apia hi.
english: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.

paite: "Himahleh gamsate dong in, huchi in amau nang ahon sinsak ding uh; huan huihkhua a vasate'n, nang ahon hilh ding uhi.
english: “But ask the animals now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.

paite: Ahihkeileh lei kiang ah thu gen in nang ahon sinsak ding ua; tuipi a ngasate'n na kiang ah apuang ding uhi.
english: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.

paite: Hiai tengteng ah, TOUPA khut in ahih khin chih kua ahia thei lou?
english: Who doesn’t know that in all these, Yahweh’s hand has done this,

paite: Amah khut ah thil hing chiteng kha leh, mihing tengteng hatna a-om hi.
english: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?

paite: Bil in thute enchian in, Kam in ana chiam kei maw?
english: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?

paite: "Mi upate kiang ah pilna a-om a nite sauna ah theihsiamna a-om hi.
english: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.

paite: Amah kiang ah pilna leh hatna a-om; ama'n thupha leh theihsiamna anei.
english: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.

paite: Ngai in, akaipuk a, akilam nawn thei kei ding; mihing akhakbing a, kuama'n ahong thei kei ding.
english: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.

paite: Ngai in, tui aching a a akang hi; akhahkhia a, lei atum vek hi.
english: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.

paite: "Akiang ah hatna leh pilna a-om a; khem a omte leh khempa amah a ahi.
english: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.

paite: Thuhilh mite loh sam in apimang a, huan vaihawmte mihai in abawl hi.
english: He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.

paite: Kumpipate kolte asut a, kawnggak in akawng uh agak hi.
english: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.

paite: Siampute loh sam in apimang a, mihatte azou hi.
english: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.

paite: Muan mite thugen asuan a, upate theihsiamna alamang hi.
english: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.

paite: Lalte tung ah muhsitna abuak a mihatte kawnggak aphel hi.
english: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.

paite: "Mial a kipan in thil thukte amukhia a, sihna limliap khovak ah ahon lakhia hi.
english: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.

paite: Namte apungsak a, amau hihsia in, namte athehzak a, alakhawm nawn hi.
english: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.

paite: Lei a mite hausate lungtang alamang a, gamdai a lampi omlouhna ah amau avakvaisak hi.
english: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

paite: Vakna bei in khomial ah amai ua, huchi in zukhammi bang in amaute ahoisak hi.”
english: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.

paite: Ngai in, ka mit in hiai tengteng amu a, ka bil in huai za in atheisiamta hi.
english: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.

paite: Na thei uh, huai mah ke'n leng ka thei a, nou sang in ka niamzaw kei hi.
english: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.

paite: Bangkim hihthei kiang ah thu ka gen mahmah ding, Pathian toh houlim ka ut hi.
english: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.

paite: Himahleh nou zuau phuakte na hi ua, phattuamna bei damdawisiam na hi vek uhi.
english: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.

paite: Aw na vek un dai sipsip le uchin maw; na pilna uh hi ding hiven.
english: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.

paite: "Tu in ka thusut za un, ka mukte ngetna ngaikhia un.
english: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.

paite: Pathian a ding in dikloutak in thu na gen ding uam, amah a ding in khemhattak in na houlim ding uam?
english: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?

paite: Ami na zahtak ding uam? Pathian a ding in na sual ding uam?
english: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?

paite: Nou ahon zonkhiak ahoih hia? Ahihkeileh mi'n mi akhem bang in, amah na khem ding uam?
english: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?

paite: Nou ahon sal mahmah ding, aguk a mite na zahtak uleh.
english: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.

paite: Ahoih tungtuanna in nou ahon lausak kei dia hia, nou tung ah akihtakhuaina ake kei diam?
english: Won’t his majesty make you afraid and his dread fall on you?

paite: Na thupilte uh vut bang lel ahi, manna bei paunak ahi a, na kidalnate uh tungman kidalnate ahi.
english: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.

paite: Dai unla, thu ka gentheihna ding in, hon omsak maimai un, ka tung ah ahong tung ding hong tung hen.
english: “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.

paite: "Bangziak a ka ha in ka sa kei a, ka khut a ka hinna koih ding ahia?
english: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?

paite: Ama'n hon that mahleh, amah ka ngak lai ding; ama ah ka lampite ka kemhoih lailai ding hi.
english: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.

paite: Hiai leng ka hotdamna ahi ding; Pathian limsakloumi ama a hong pai lou ding ahih ziak in.
english: This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.

paite: Ka thugen thanuamtak in za un, ka thupuanna na bil sung uah om hen.
english: Listen carefully to my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.

paite: Ngai un, tu in ka thu ka bawlhoihta a; ka diktat ahi chih ka thei hi.
english: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.

paite: "Kei hon kiselpih ding amah kua ahia? Kei tu in ka dai dia kha ka khah ding hi.
english: Who is he who will contend with me? For then I would hold my peace and give up the spirit.

paite: Ka tung ah thil nih hih kei phot le uchin, huchi in na mai a kipan ka bu kei ding hi.
english: “Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:

paite: Kei a pan gamlapi ah na khut kaikik in; na lauhuaina in hon lausak ke'n.
english: withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.

paite: "Huai chiang in hon sam lechin, ka hon dawng ding; ahihkeileh hon pausak inla, hon dawng in.
english: Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.

paite: Ka thulimlouhnate leh khelhnate bang ahia? Ka tatlekna leh ka khelhna hon theisak in.
english: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.

paite: Bangziak a na mai sel a na melma dia hon bawl na hia?
english: Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?

paite: Singnah mutleng na hihbuai dia hia? Buhpawl keu na delh dia hia?
english: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?

paite: "Nang lah kei dem in khatak in na gelh a, ka tuailai thulimlouhnate na hon luahsak hi.
english: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.

paite: Ka khete leng kol na bunsak a, ka lampite tengteng na chiamteh hi; ka khenuai kim ah gi na khung hi.
english: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,

paite: Mihing zaw thilmuat leh nget nekgawp puansilh bang in amangthang hi."
english: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.

paite: "Mihing, numei a pan pian nite tomchik ahi a, buaina ngen in adim hi.
english: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.

paite: Pak bang in ahong dawnkhia a, avuai nawn pah a, limliap bang in atai a, a-om gige kei.
english: He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.

paite: Mi huchibang tung ah na mit hak in, vaihawmna ah kei na hon pi dia hia?
english: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?

paite: Thilnin a kipan kua'n ahia thilsiang lakhe thei? Kuamah in.
english: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.

paite: Anite sehsa ahi chih thei in, na kiang ah akhate simna a-om a, akan thei louh ding in agamgite na septa hi.
english: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass.

paite: Amah en ke'n, akhawltheihna ding in, kiloh bang a, ani ahihkim matan.
english: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day.

paite: "Phukpaih in om mahleh, ahong sel nawn ding a, ahiang nou atawp kei ding, chih sing a ding in lametna lah a-om ngal a.
english: “For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.

paite: Lei ah azung upa mahleh, akungpi lei ah sita mahleh;
english: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,

paite: Tuigim ziak in ahong nou thak dia, sing suan bang in bawkte ahon neikhe nawn ding hi.
english: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant.

paite: Mihing asi a, amang zel hi; ahi, mihing in akha akhah a, huan koi ah a-om a?
english: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?

paite: "Tuipi a kipan tuihute alenmang bang in, luipi bel atul a, akang hi.
english: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,

paite: Huai mah bang in mihing alum a athou kei hi, vante a-om nawn louh matan, akhanglou kei ding uh, a-ihmu uh leng ahalh khe sam kei ding uhi.
english: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.

paite: "Aw Sheol ah hon sel lechin aw, na thangpaihna aman masiah hon na gukkep lechin, hun sehsa hon na pia in, kei hon theigige lechin aw;
english: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!

paite: Mi sileh ahing nawn diam? Ka galdouna leh nasepna ni tengteng ka ngak ding a, ka suahtakna ahong tun matan in.
english: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.

paite: N'on na sam dia, k'on dawng ding hi, na khut nasep na hon lunggulh ding hi.
english: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.

paite: Tu in ka kalsuante na sim a: ka khelhnate na chiamteh hi.
english: But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?

paite: Ip sung ah ka tatlekna bilh in ni a-om a, ka thulimlouhna na gonggak hi.
english: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.

paite: "Tang kipuk bangmah lou ahong hi taktak a, amun a kipan in suangpi suan in a-om hi;
english: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place.

paite: tuite'n suang akiamsak ua; leivui a kibawl mun sangte na taimang a; huan mihing lametna na hihsia hi.
english: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.

paite: Tangtawn in amah na zou a, apai a; amel na lamdangsak a, na sawlmang hi.
english: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.

paite: Atapate zah in a-om ua, ama'n athei kei; hihniam in a-om ua, himahleh ama'n amau ahi chih athei kei hi.
english: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.

paite: Himahleh atung a sa in natna anei a, asung ah akha in asuun hi."
english: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”

paite: Huchi in Teman mi Eliphaz in adawng a, hichi in achi:
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

paite: "Mipil in theihna bangmah lou toh dawnna abawl in, suahlam huih in agilpi adimsak diam?
english: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?

paite: Houlimna phatuam lou thu angaihtuah in, ahihkeileh hoih ahihtheihlouhna ding a thugente angaihtuah diam?
english: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?

paite: Ahi, launa na hihmang a, Pathian ma a kipiakzohna na dal lai hi.
english: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.

paite: Na kam in na thulimlouhna asinsak a, khemhatmi lei na tel ngal a.
english: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.

paite: Nang mahmah kam in siam louh ahon tangsak a, kei hilou in; ahi, nang dem in nangmah mukte mah in hon theihpih hi.
english: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.

paite: "Mihing piang masapen hi hia? Ahihkeileh mualte om ma a lakkhiak na hi maw?
english: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?

paite: Pathian thuguk na zata hia? Huan pilna na kikoih hoih hia?
english: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?

paite: Ka theih louh uh bang na thei a? kou a om lou bang na theisiam a?
english: What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?

paite: Ka lak uah samkang leh upa mahmah a-om tuaktuak, na pa sang a nakpi a upazaw.
english: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much older than your father.

paite: "Pathian nepnate leh siamtak a hon hilhte nang a dia neu lua uhia?
english: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?

paite: Bangziak a na lungtang in nang hon pimang ahia? Bangziak a na mitte phia ahia?
english: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,

paite: Huchi a Pathian dem a na lungsim na hei a, na kam a pan a huai thute na pawtkhiaksak.
english: that you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?

paite: "Mihing bang ahia, asian ding? Numei a pan piang amah kua ahia diktat ding?
english: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

paite: Ngai in, amisiangthoute ah muanna anga kei a; amitmuh in vante asiang kei uhi.
english: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;

paite: Mikihhuai leh sia, tui bang a thulimlouhna dawnmi, siang kei sem na in chia.
english: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!

paite: "K'on ensak ding, hon za in; huan ka muhsa ka puang ding.
english: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare

paite: Mipil kuate in ahia apipute ua kipan na thu gen a, a-iim louh uh.
english: (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;

paite: Amau kiang kia ah gam piak in a-om a, mikhual kuamah alak uah apai kei uh.
english: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):

paite: "Migilou in adamsung niteng in natna athuak a, nuaisiah hatmi a dia kholkhawm kumte zah mah.
english: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.

paite: Abil ah launa ging a-om a; hauh lai in lokmi atung ah ahong pai ding hi.
english: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.

paite: Khomial a kipan ahong kik ding chih a-um kei a, namsau a ngak in a-om hi.
english: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.

paite: Tanghou zong in avakvai a, Koi a om ahia? chi in. Khomial ni akiangchin ah mansa in a-om chih athei hi.
english: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

paite: Dahna leh haksatna in amah alausak a; kumpipa galdou dia mansa bang in, amah azou uhi.
english: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

paite: "Pathian dou ding a khut alikkhiak ziak in, Bangkim hihthei dou a kisatheitak in,
english: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,

paite: alum, atuamna sahtak nei toh amah dou a atai teitei ziak in;
english: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,

paite: athau in amaitang akhuh a, agil ah thau akholkhawm hi.
english: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.

paite: "Khopi tulsa ah ateng a, kuamah ten tuaklouhna innte ah, segawp ngiingei dingte aluah ziak in.
english: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.

paite: Ahau kei ding a, aneih-le-lam a-om gige kei ding a; amah lei ah zung akai kei ding.
english: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.

paite: Khomial a kipan asuakta kei ding a, meikuang in aselnoute akangkeu ding a, apaklun laite amutmang ding.
english: He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.

paite: Amah kikhem in, bangmah lou ah muang kei hen: bangmah lou lah athukna hi ding ahi ngal a.
english: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his reward.

paite: "Ahun ma in hihzoh in a-om dia, huan ahiang nou kei ding hi.
english: It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.

paite: Grepgui bang in agah min lou asingpulh dia, olive bang in apak apaikhe ding.
english: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.

paite: Pathian limsak lou kithuahkhawmna hut ding ahi a, golhna puaninte lah mei in akangmang ding hi.
english: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.

paite: Siatna apai ua, thulimlouhna asuakkhesak uh, alungtang un khemna a- nopkeuh uhi.
english: They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”

paite: Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
english: Then Job answered,

paite: "Huchibang thil tampi ka zata hi: lungmuanmi chimtakhuai ngen na hi uh.
english: “I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!

paite: Thu bangmah loute'n tawp hun anei ding uam? Ahihkeileh dawng ding a nang hon hihheh bang ahia?
english: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?

paite: Nou bang in kei leng ka pau thei sam hi; na kha uh ka kha mun a om hileh, noute dem a thute kaikhawm a, ka lu hon sinkhum thei ding hi veng in.
english: I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul’s place, I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you,

paite: Himahleh ka kam in nou ka hon hatsak ding a, ka muk a muanna in na lungkhamna uh ka hon nem ding.
english: but I would strengthen you with my mouth. The solace of my lips would relieve you.

paite: "Thu gen mah leng, ka dahna nep in a-om kei a: doh mah leng, hihnop in ka om a hia?
english: “Though I speak, my grief is not subsided. Though I forbear, what am I eased?

paite: Himahleh ahon chimtaksakta a; ka lawmte tengteng na hihgamta hi.
english: But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made all my company desolate.

paite: Huan kiptak in na hon len a, huai kei demna theihpihna ahi: huchi in ka gawnna kei dem in athou a, ka maitang ah atheisak hi.
english: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.

paite: "Ahehna in kei ahon botkek a, ahon sawi hi; aha ahon gawikhum a: ka tung ah ka gal in amit atat- hiam hi.
english: He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.

paite: Akam uh lianpi in ahon katkhum ua; simmohtak in ka biang ah ahon beng ua; kei dou ding in akikaikhawm uh.
english: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together against me.

paite: Pathian in Pathian limsakloute kiang ah ahon pekhia a, migiloute khut ah ahon paikhia hi.
english: God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.

paite: Om nuam in ka om a, himahleh ahon kitamsak a; ahi, ka ngawng in ahon man a, hon pai nen hi; amuitum ding in ahon tungtou hi.
english: I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up for his target.

paite: Athalkap mite'n ka kimvel ah ahon um ua, ka sisan guite abottan a, ahawi kei; lei ah ka sinkha asungkhia hi.
english: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.

paite: Siatna tung ah siatna in ahon sesak a; galhat bang in ka tung ah atai hi.
english: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs at me like a giant.

paite: Ka vun tung ah sai-ip ka khui a, leivui ah ka kingata hi.
english: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust.

paite: Kahna in ka mai ahoihta kei a, ka mitvunte ah sihna limliap a-om hi.
english: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids,

paite: Ka khut ah hiamgamna om kei mahleh, ka thumna siangthou mahleh.
english: although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.

paite: "Aw leitung, ka sisan khuh ke'n, huan ka kahna in mun nei kei hen.
english: “Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.

paite: Tu mahmah in, ngai in, van ah kei hon theihpihpa a-om a, tungsang ah kei hon genpihpa a-om hi.
english: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.

paite: Ka lawmte'n hon nuihsan ua, himahleh ka mit in Pathian ah khituite asungkhia hi.
english: My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,

paite: "Huchi a Pathian lak a mihing dikna aletkip theih a, invengte lak a mihing tapa dikna aletkip theihna ding in.
english: that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!

paite: Kum tawmchik ahong tun chiang in, ka kik nawnlouhna ding lampi ah ka paita ding hi."
english: For when a few years have come, I will go the way of no return.

paite: "Ka lungsim hihgawp in a-om a, ka nite abei a, kei a ding in han mansa in a-om hi.
english: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct and the grave is ready for me.

paite: Ka kiang ah musit mite a-om taktak ua, ahehna uah ka mit a-om gige hi.
english: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.

paite: Tu in thuchiam hon pia in, nangmah toh kei a ding in moh khu hong hi in; kei toh khutte beng ding kua a-om a?
english: “Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?

paite: Theihsiamna a kipan alungtang uh na sel ngal a; huaiziak in amau na hihlian kei ding hi.
english: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, therefore you will not exalt them.

paite: "Kuapeuh mat ding a alawmte hek a, aneih-le-lam tan tummi, atate nangawn mit azuausuak ding hi.
english: He who denounces his friends for plunder, even the eyes of his children will fail.

paite: Mite houlimna ding in ahon bawl lai a; huchi in tangpi kih ka hong hita hi.
english: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.

paite: Lungkhamna ziak in ka mit leng amial a, ka hiangte tengteng limliap bang ahi.
english: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.

paite: Midikte'n hiai ah lamdang asa ding ua, mihoih Pathian limsakloute dou ding in akitokthou ding.
english: Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.

paite: Himahleh midiktat alampi ah apang zouzou dia, kuapeuh khut siangneite ahat semsem ding uhi.
english: Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.

paite: Himahleh hong kik un, na vek un, tu in hong un; huchi in na lak uah mipil ka mu kei ding.
english: But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.

paite: "Ka nite abeita, ka thiltupte asegawpta hi, ka lungtang ngaihtuahte tan in.
english: My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.

paite: Zan, sun in akheng ua; khovak in khomial anaih, achi uh.
english: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.

paite: Ka inn bang in Sheol en leng: khomial ah ka lupna phah taleng:
english: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,

paite: siatna kiang ah, 'Ka pa na hi,' chi leng; tangtel kiang ah, 'Ka nu leh ka sanggamnu na hi,' chi leng;
english: if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’

paite: huchi hileh ka lametna koi a om ahia? Lamet nei hi leng kua'n ahon musak dia?
english: where then is my hope? As for my hope, who will see it?

paite: Sheol mundaite ah paisuk in leivui ah ka kikkhawm ding ua adiam?"
english: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”

paite: Shuah mi Bildad in adawng a, hichi in achi:
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

paite: "Thute zong a bang tan thang kam ding na hi ua? Ngaihtuah in, huai zoh chiang in ka pau ding uh.
english: “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.

paite: Bangziak a gamsa bang a sim a om a, na mitmuh ua siang lou ka hi ua?
english: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?

paite: Nang na hehna kipumpei ziak in lei mangngilh in a-om diam? Ahihkeileh amun a kipan in suangpi suankhiak in a-om diam?
english: You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?

paite: "Ahi, migilou vakna mihsak in a-om ding a, amei-ek atang kei ding.
english: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.

paite: Apuanin ah vakna amial dia, atung a khawnvak mihsak ahi ding.
english: The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.

paite: Ahatna kalsuante hihtuailuai ahi dia, amah thupha gen in apaikhe ding hi.
english: The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.

paite: Amah khe mahmah in len sung ah amah apailut ua, len ah a-awksak hi.
english: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.

paite: Thang in akhetul ah aman dia, thang in amah alen ding hi.
english: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.

paite: Lei ah amah a ding in thangkual sel in a-om a, lampi ah amah a ding in thang.
english: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.

paite: "Kihtakhuaite'n ning chiteng ah amah alausak dia, A akhetul ah adelhzui ding hi.
english: Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels.

paite: Ahatna gilkial nek in a-om dia, akhawlna ding in mansa in tuahsiatna a-om ding.
english: His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.

paite: Apumpi hiangte anegai ding a, ahi, ahiangte sihna ta masapen in anegai ding hi.
english: The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.

paite: Asuan apuanin a kipan zungkalhkhiak in a-om dia lauhuainate kumpipa kiang a pi in a-om ding hi.
english: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.

paite: Amah a hilou puanin ah teng a-om ding, atenna ah kat thehzak in a-om ding hi.
english: There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.

paite: "Nuailam ah azungte akeu dia, tunglam ah ahiang satkhiak ahi ding.
english: His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.

paite: Lei a kipan in atheihgige amangthang ding; kongzing ah min anei kei ding.
english: His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.

paite: Khovak a kipan in khomial ah hawllut ahi ding a, khovel a kipan a delhkhiak.
english: He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

paite: Amite lak ah tapa anei kei dia, tute leng atenna ah kuamah om lai a-om kei ding hi.
english: He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.

paite: "Amalam a omte'n ani lamdang asa ding uh; nunglam a omte hihlau a a-om bang un.
english: Those who come after will be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.

paite: Huchibang midiktatloute tennate ahi petmah a, Pathian theiloumi mun ahi hi."
english: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”

paite: Huchi in Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
english: Then Job answered,

paite: "Bang tan ka kha hihbuai a, thute a hon hihzan gawp ding na hi ua?
english: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?

paite: Hiai sawmvei na hon kouta ua; ka tung a giloutak a na hih uh na zum kei uh.
english: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.

paite: Ana paikhial taleng maw, keimah kiang a ka diklouhna a-om gige hi.
english: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.

paite: Kei dem in nou kiliansak petmah ve ni uchin, ka minsiatna ka tung ah na gen ding ua,
english: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach,

paite: Pathian in ka thu ah hon zouta chih tu in thei un, huchi in alen in ahon umsuak hi.
english: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.

paite: "Ngai un, 'Hiamgamna,' chi in ka kikoukhia a, himahleh zak in ka om kei, panpih deih in ka kikou a, himahleh vaihawmna a-om kei hi.
english: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.

paite: Ka pai theihlouhna ding in ka lampi a-um a, ka paina dingte ah khomial akoih hi.
english: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.

paite: Ka thupina hon suahsak a, ka lu a kipan lallukhu alakhia hi.
english: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

paite: Ning chiteng ah ahon hihniam a, ka mangta hi; huchi in sing bang in ka lametna abotkhia hi.
english: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.

paite: Ka tung ah ahehna leng asou a, amah a ding in agalte lak a khat bang in ahon sim hi.
english: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.

paite: Asepaih pawlte ahong kuankhawm ua, ka siatna ding in alampi uh abawl ua ka puanin kimvel in puanin akai uhi.
english: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.

paite: "Kei a pan in ka unaute gamlapi ah akoih a, ka meltheihte kei a pan in atuam vekta uh.
english: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.

paite: Ka tanaute'n ahon zuausan ua, ka lawm theihngeite'n ahon mangngilhta uhi.
english: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.

paite: Ka inn tengte leh, ka sikhanute'n, mikhual ahon sa ua: amitmuh un namdangmi ka hi.
english: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.

paite: Ka sikha ka sam a, hon dawng kei, ka kam in amah khem mah leng.
english: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.

paite: Ka zi a ding in ka hu kihhuai ahi a, sanggamte ziak in pumpi hahsiang mah leng ka namsia hi.
english: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.

paite: Naupang neute nangawn in hon simmoh ua; ka thohleh, ka siatna ding in thu agen uhi.
english: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.

paite: Ka lawm thudotte'n kei ahon hua ua, amau ka itte ka tung ah ahel uhi.
english: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.

paite: Ka vun ah leh ka sa ah ka guh abelh bikbek a, ka ha vun toh ka suakta hi.
english: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

paite: Hon hehpih un, hon hehpih un, Aw nou ka lawmte; Pathian khut in kei ahon khoihta ngal a.
english: “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me.

paite: Bangziak a Pathian bang a nou hon sawi na hi ua, ka sa a bangziak a lungkim lou na hi ua?
english: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

paite: "Aw ka thute tu in gelh in om le uh aw; Aw laibu ah kigelh lutleh aw.
english: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!

paite: Sik leh ngen gelhna zum in tangtawn a ding in suangpi a gelh hi le uh aw;
english: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!

paite: Ka Tanpa ahing chih leh, atawp chiang in leitung ah adingh nawn ding chih ka theih ziak in.
english: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.

paite: Ka vun huchibang a hihsiat a a-om khit nung in, himahleh ka sa a kipan Pathian ka mu ding hi.
english: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,

paite: Keimah a ding in amah kei mahmah in ka mu dia, ka mitte'n a-en ding, midang hilou in; ka sung ah ka lungtang asidang hial hi!
english: whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.

paite: "Amah bangchibang in i sawita phet ding uam, na chih uleh, kei ah thubul muh in a-om chih thei in.
english: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,

paite: Namsau kihta un; hehna in lah namsau gawtnate ahon tun ngal a, huchi a vaihawmna a-om chih na theihtheihna ding un."
english: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”

paite: TOUPA Pathian tapate ahong kilak ni uh a-om nawn a, huan TOUPA ma a kilak ding in alak uah Setan leng ahong pai hi.
english: Again, on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before Yahweh, Satan came also among them to present himself before Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Koi a hong kipan na hia?" achi hi. Setan in TOUPA adawng a, "Leitung langkhat langkhat tawn a, asung a sukvak-touvak ka hi," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “From going back and forth on the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Ka sikha Job na ngaihtuah ngei hia? Amah bang a hoihkim leh mitang, Pathian kihta a hoih lou mudah lei ah lah kuamah a-om ngal kei a; ama siatna ding in hon tangsak mah lechin, aginomna alen tinten hi," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil. He still maintains his integrity, although you incited me against him, to ruin him without cause.”

paite: Setan in TOUPA adawng a, "Vun sik in vun, ahi, mihing in aneih tengteng hinna sik in ape ding hi.
english: Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.

paite: Himahleh tu in na khut kha inla, aguh leh asa khoih lechin, na maitang ah nang hon gense ding hi," achi hi.
english: But stretch out your hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will renounce you to your face.”

paite: TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Ngai in, amah na khut ah a-om hi; ahinna lel hawi in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Behold, he is in your hand. Only spare his life.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA ma a kipan in Setan apawtkhia a, meimatum in akhepek nuai a kipan aluzang tan in Job agawt hi.
english: So Satan went out from the presence of Yahweh, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.

paite: Huchi in ama'n kikhuatna ding in belpei ala a; meivu lak ah atu hi.
english: He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes.

paite: Huai lai in azi in akiang ah, "Na ginomna len tinten lailai na hi hia? Pathian gensia inla, si in," achi hi.
english: Then his wife said to him, “Do you still maintain your integrity? Renounce God, and die.”

paite: Himahleh akiang ah, "Numei hai thugente lak a khat bang in thu na gen a. Bang ahia? Pathian khut ah hoih i mu dia, hoih lou leng i mu kei dia hia?" achi hi. Hiai tengteng ah Job in amuk in thil ahihkhial kei hi.
english: But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” In all this Job didn’t sin with his lips.

paite: Huchi a Job lawm thumte'n atung a hiai hoih lou hong tung tengteng azak un, michih ama mun a kipan in ahong ua: Teman mi Eliphaz, Shuah mi Bildad leh Naaman mi Zophar, amah kah ding leh amah lungmuan ding in hohkhawm ding in hun seh abawl uhi.
english: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite; and they made an appointment together to come to sympathize with him and to comfort him.

paite: Huchi a gamlapi a pan adaktouh uleh, amah athei kei ua, nakpi in akikoukhia ua, akapta uhi. Apuanaktual uh michih in abotkek ua, alutang uah van lam ah leivui akibuak uhi.
english: When they lifted up their eyes from a distance, and didn’t recognize him, they raised their voices, and wept; and they each tore his robe, and sprinkled dust on their heads toward the sky.

paite: Huchi in akiang ah leitual ah ni sagih leh zan sagih atu ua, akiang ah kuamah in thu khat leng agen kei uh; alungkhamna anasa mahmah chih amu uhi.
english: So they sat down with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that his grief was very great.

paite: Huan Naamath mi Zophar in adawng a, hichi in achi:
english: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,

paite: "Huaiziak in ka ngaihtuahnate'n kei dawnna ahon pia a, ka sung a om ka kinohna thu ziak mahmah in.
english: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.

paite: Kei hon zahlaksak salhna ka zata a, ka theihsiamna kha in ahon dawng hi.
english: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.

paite: "Leitung a mihing a-om nungsiah, hun lui thu hiai na thei kei maw;
english: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,

paite: Giloute vualzohna atom a, Pathian limsakloute nopsakna mitphiat kal sung lel ahi chih?
english: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?

paite: Ahoihkimna in vante suntou in, alu in meipite phatou mahleh;
english: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,

paite: Himahleh amah ek bang in tangtawn in amangthang ding a, 'Koi a om ahia?' Amah mute'n achi ding uh.
english: yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’

paite: Mang bang in alengmang dia, muh in a-om kei ding hi; ahi, zan mengmuh bang in hawlmang in a-om ding hi.
english: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.

paite: Amah mu mit in amah amuta kei ding hi; amun in leng amah amuta kei ding hi.
english: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.

paite: Atate'n gentheite deihsakna azong ding ua, akhutte'n athil hoih ape nawn ding hi.
english: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.

paite: "Atuailai hatna in aguhte dim mahleh, leivui ah amah toh alum ding uhi.
english: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.

paite: Akam ah gitlouhna khum in alei nuai ah sel mahleh;
english: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,

paite: Sit in, paisak kei in, akam ah kem gige zou mahleh;
english: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth,

paite: Agil a an akitok a, asung ah gulgu bang in akha hi.
english: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.

paite: Hauhsaknate anawmvalh a, alokhe nawn ding hi. Pathian in agilpi a kipan in apaikhe ding hi.
english: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.

paite: Sokval gu atawp dia, gulngan in amah athat ding.
english: He will suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue will kill him.

paite: Luipite, khuaizu leh nawituidat lui luangte a-en kei ding hi.
english: He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.

paite: Sepgim gah ape nawn dia anawmvalhsuk kei ding a; amuhsa ah kipahna anei kei ding.
english: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.

paite: Ama'n lah gentheite anuaisiah a, amangngilh hi; alam louhpi inn hiamgamtak in alata uhi.
english: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.

paite: Adeihgawlna in huntawk anei kei a akipahpih thil himhim akhol kei ding.
english: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he will not save anything of that in which he delights.

paite: Anekgaih louh bangmah om lai a-om kei hi; huaiziak in ahauhna in adaih sawt kei ding.
english: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity will not endure.

paite: Ahauh san lai in haksa sakna anei dia, thulimloumi khut ahong tung ding hi.
english: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him.

paite: Agilpi hihdim ding a akisak lai in, Pathian in atung ah athangpaihna kihtakhuaina akhe ding a, anek lai in atung ah azusak ding hi.
english: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.

paite: Sik galvan a kipan atai dia, dal thal in amah akap pailet ding.
english: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.

paite: Adokkhia a, apumpi a kipan in ahong paikhia; ahi, asinkha a pan amukzumte velvel hong paikhia a launate atung ah ahong tung hi.
english: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.

paite: Agou ding in mialna tengteng kholkhawm in a-om; mei mut louh in amah anegai ding; apuanin a nutsiat a om anegai ding hi.
english: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent.

paite: Vante'n abohsiatna ataklang ding ua, lei amah dou ding in athou ding.
english: The heavens will reveal his iniquity. The earth will rise up against him.

paite: A-inn a punna apaimang dia, aheh ni in avante aluangmang ding hi.
english: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.

paite: "Hiai Pathian a pan a migilou tantuan ahi, agouluah dia Pathian in asehsak."
english: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”

paite: Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
english: Then Job answered,

paite: "Ka thugen hoihtak in ngaikhia unla, hiai na khamuanna thu uh hi hen.
english: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.

paite: Hon thuak teitei unla, ka hon gen ding a, ka gen khit chiang in nuihsan na ni uteh.
english: Allow me, and I also will speak. After I have spoken, mock on.

paite: "Kei phunna mihing tung ah hia? Bangziak a kuhkal lou a om lou ding ka hia?
english: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?

paite: Hon en unla, lamdang sa unla, khut in na kam uh hum un.
english: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.

paite: Ka ngaihtuah in ka lung adong a, linna in ka sa aman nak.
english: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.

paite: "Bangziak in ahia migilou ahin a, tekkun a adam a, ahong thupikhiak?
english: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?

paite: Asuante uh akiang uah amitmuh uah ahihkip a, agil ua gahte amai ma uah.
english: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.

paite: A-inkuante uh lauhuai lak ah abit a, atung uah Pathian chiang ake kei hi.
english: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

paite: Abawngtal un chi akhah a, ahut ngei kei, abawngpi un nou anei a, anou ase ngei kei.
english: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.

paite: Ganhon bang in ataneute uh apawtsak ua, atate uh alam uh.
english: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.

paite: Apekging uleh kaihging toh kituak in la asa ua, atamngai ging uah akipak uh.
english: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

paite: Anite uh lamzangtak in azang ua, lungmuang in Sheol ah apaisuk uh.
english: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.

paite: "Pathian kiang ah, 'Hon paisan in, na lampite theih ka kilawp kei uh.
english: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.

paite: Bangkim hihthei bang a ahih, a-nna ka sep ding uh, akiang a ka thum un punna bang a ka muh ding uh?' achi uhi.
english: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’

paite: Ngai in, alamzanna uh akhut ua om ahi kei a hia? Migilou lemtheihna kei a kipan a gamlapi a om ahi.
english: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

paite: "Migilou meisel bangzah vei amit a, vangtahna atung ua atun a, Pathian in athangpaihna in lungkhamna apiak chiat?
english: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?

paite: Bangzah vei ahia buhpawl huih mut bang ahih ua, buhsi huihpi mutmang bang ahih uh?
english: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?

paite: "Pathian in gitlouhnate atate uh a ding in akholkhawm, na chi ua, amau tung ah tungsak le ake; atheihsiamna ding un.
english: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.

paite: Amau mit ngei in asiatna uh mu uhenla, Bangkim hihthei thangpaihna dawn uhen.
english: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

paite: Aman nung in a-inn uh amau a ding in bang a ahih, akha zah uh hihtawp ahih nung in?
english: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?

paite: Kua'n ahia Pathian theihna sinsak ding? ama'n sangpi a omte vai ahawmsak ngal a.
english: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?

paite: "Alut lai in mi asi a, nuam leh bit lai in.
english: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

paite: Anawite nawizu in adim a, aguhngekte thau in adim hi.
english: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.

paite: Midang lungkhamtak in asi a, Nuamsa a a-an chiam ngei lou in.
english: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.

paite: Vut lak ah kibang in alum ua, than in apumtuam hi.
english: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.

paite: Ngai in, na ngaihtuah uh ka thei, dikloupi a ka tung a na sawmte uh.
english: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.

paite: 'Koi ah ahia kumpi inn a-om, migilou tenna puanin koi ah a-om a?' na chi uh.
english: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’

paite: "Zinzin mite na dong ngei kei ua hia? Agente uh na pom kei ua hia?
english: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,

paite: Migilou vangtah ni in hawi in a-om a, thangpaih ni in hotkhiak in a- om, chih.
english: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, that they are led out to the day of wrath?
