paite: Kua ahia amaitang a alampi pulak ding, kua ahia athilhih bang a amah din ding?
english: Who will declare his way to his face? Who will repay him what he has done?

paite: Han lam a puak ahih in, ahan ven ahi.
english: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.

paite: Lui phaizang a leitang amah a ding in anuam a; mi tengteng in amah nung azui ua, amah ma a na paite sim seng louh ahi uh.
english: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.

paite: Bangchi in thu mumal omloupi a hon khamuan ding na hia? Na dawnnate uah zuauthu lou ngal bangmah a-om kei hi."
english: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”

paite: Huchi in Teman mi Eliphaz in hichi in achi:
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

paite: "Pathian a ding in mihing aphatuam thei diam? Kuapeuh apil amah mah a ding in aphatuam ngei a.
english: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.

paite: Na diktat, Bangkim hihthei a ding a kipahna ahi a hia? Ahihkeileh na lampite na hoihkimsak, amah a dia punna hia?
english: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?

paite: Nang ahon salha, vaihawmna a nang toh alut, amah na kihtak ziak hia?
english: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?

paite: Na gitlouhna alian kei maw? Na thulimlouhna ah leng tawpna a-om sam kei hi.
english: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.

paite: "Bangmah lou ding in na unau thuchiamte na la a, vuaktangte puansilh na suahsak hi.
english: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

paite: Bahte a ding in dawn ding tui na pe kei a, gilkial a ding in tanghou na it hi.
english: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.

paite: Himahleh mihat in gam anei a; asung ah ami deihthoh ateng hi.
english: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.

paite: Khutvuak in meithaite na sawlmang a, pabeite khutte hihtan in a-om hi.
english: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

paite: Huaiziak in na kim ah thangte a-om ua, lauguihna in nang ahon hihbuai hi.
english: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,

paite: Ahihkeileh khomial, na muh theih louh, leh tui tampi in nang ahon khuh hi.
english: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.

paite: "Van sang ah Pathian a-om kei a hia? Aksite sandan en in, sang hi na tel uh e;
english: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!

paite: Nang, 'Pathian in bang athei a? Khomial bikbek ah vai ahawm thei dia hia?
english: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?

paite: Ama'n hon muhlouhna ding a, meipi sah in liah a, van dum khen a vak ahi,' na chi hi.
english: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’

paite: Migiloute totsa lampi lui na kem ding hia?
english: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,

paite: Ahun ma ua lakmang a-om a, akingakna ua tui luang bang a butkhiak a omte.
english: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

paite: Pathian kiang a, 'Hon paimangsan in; huan ei a ding in Bangkim hihthei in bang ahihthei a?' chite.
english: who said to God, ‘Depart from us!’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’

paite: Himahleh a-innte uh thil hoih in adimsak ua, himahleh migiloute thugen kei a kipan agamla hi.
english: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

paite: Midiktatte'n amu ua, akipak uh; mihoihte'n amau anuihsan ua,
english: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,

paite: Chihtaktak in ei dou ding a thoute satkhiak in a-om ua, amaute lak a khosuaksunte mei in ahulta," chi in.
english: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’

paite: "Tu in amah kimeltheihpih inla, muangtak in om in. Huai ah hoih na kiang ah ahong pai ding hi.
english: “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.

paite: Akam a kipan in dan sang in, ka hon ngen hi, na lungtang ah athute kholkhawm in.
english: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.

paite: Bangkim hihthei kiang a na kik nawnleh, lamkip na hi ding; na puaninte a kipan gamlapi ah diktatlouhna na koihmang ding ahi.
english: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.

paite: Huan na gou leivui ah koih inla, luite suangte lak ah Ophir dangka-eng;
english: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.

paite: Bangkim hihthei na gou ahi dia, dangka manpha nang a ding in
english: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.

paite: Bangkim hihthei ah kipak in, Pathian kiang ah daktou ding na hih ziak in.
english: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.

paite: Amah kiang ah na thum ding a, ama'n hon na za ding a, na thuchiam na tangtun ding hi.
english: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.

paite: Thil khat tung ah thupukna bawl in thu na pe dia, nang a ding in hihkip in a-om ding; huchi in na lampite ah khovak atang ding hi.
english: You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.

paite: Ahon sawnpuk chiang un, 'Thohtouhna a-om,' na chi ding. Hihniam a omte ama'n ahondam ding hi.
english: When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.

paite: Ama'n ahoih lou nangawn asuaktasak ding a; ahi, na khutte sianna ziak in amah suahtaksak in a-om ding."
english: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”

paite: Huchi in Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
english: Then Job answered,

paite: Tuni mahmah in ka phunna helhuai ahi, ka mauna sang in ka thuakna agikzaw hi.
english: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.

paite: Aw amah ka muhna mun thei leng la, atutna mahmah ah hoh thei leng aw!
english: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

paite: Ama ah ka thu ka bawlhoih dia, thugente in ka kam dimsak ding hi veng.
english: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

paite: Ahon na dawnna ding thute ka thei dia, huchi in bang ahia ka kiang a agen ding ka theisiam ding.
english: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.

paite: Athilhihtheihna thupina in kei ahon sel diam? Ii, himahleh kei hon hatsak ding hi.
english: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.

paite: Huai ah midik in amah thu asutpih thei dia; huchi in ka vaihawmmi a pan suahtaksak in ka om tawntungta ding hi.
english: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.

paite: "Ngai in, mailam zuan in ka pai a, himahleh huai ah a-om kei; nunglam zuan in, himahleh amah ka mu kei hi.
english: “If I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I can’t find him.

paite: Veilam pang ah, na sep lai in, himahleh amah ka mu thei kei a; taklam pang ah abu, amah ka muh theihlouhna ding in.
english: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.

paite: Himahleh ka zuih lampi athei a; ahon ze-et lai in, dangka-eng bang in ka hon suakkhe ding hi.
english: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.

paite: Ka khe in akalsuante alenkip a; alampite ka zuita a, ka pial kei hi.
english: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.

paite: Amukte thupiak a kipan ka paikik kei a, akam a thute akiphamoh ka an sang in ka kholkhawm zaw hi.
english: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

paite: "Himahleh amah lungsim khek lou ahi a, amah kua'n ahei thei dia? Akha in adeih, huai mah ahih zel hi.
english: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.

paite: Kei a dia sehsa ahih ngal a; thil huchibang tampi akiang ah a-om hi.
english: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.

paite: Huaiziak in a-omna ah ka buai a; ka ngaihtuah chiang in amah ka lau hi.
english: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.

paite: Pathian in ka lungtang abahsakta a, Bangkim hihthei in ahon hihbuaita hi.
english: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.

paite: Khomial ma in satkhiak in ka om ngal kei a, ka mai a kipan khomial sah leng akhuh sam kei hi.”
english: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.

paite: "Bangziak a Bangkim hihthei in vaihawmna hunte bawl lou ahia? Amah theite'n bangziak a anite mu lou uh ahia?
english: “Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?

paite: "Gamgi suan a-om ua; hiamgamtak in ganhon alamang ua, avak uhi.
english: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.

paite: Pabeite sabiltung ahawlmang ua, thuchiamna ding in meithai bawngtal ala uh.
english: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.

paite: Lampi a kipan tasamte aheikhia ua; lei a gentheite akiselkhawm uhi.
english: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.

paite: "Ngai in gamkeu a sabiltungte bang in athilhihna lam uah, an thanuamtak a zong in apaikhia ua, atate uh a ding in gamdai in amau an asuaksak hi.
english: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields them bread for their children.

paite: Gam lam ah agan an a-at ua; migiloute grep gah ala uh.
english: They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.

paite: Zankhua in puan bei in vuaktang in alum ua, khovot ah khuhna nei lou in.
english: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.

paite: Tangte vuahpi in amaute akawt ua, belh ding deih man in suangpi akawi uhi.
english: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for lack of a shelter.

paite: "Pa neiloute nawi a kipan kaikhia a-om ua, huan, gentheite thuchiam la in.
english: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor,

paite: Huchi in tasamte puan bei in vuaktang in avialvak ua, buhphalte gilkial in apua uhi.
english: so that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves.

paite: Olive a pan sathau abawl ua; a-uain sukna uh achil ua, himahleh adangtak uhi.
english: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.

paite: Khopi a kipan mite amau ua, liamte kha akikoukhia ua; Pathian in alimsak kei hi.
english: From out of the populous city, men groan. The soul of the wounded cries out, yet God doesn’t regard the folly.

paite: "Hiaite khovak tung a helte lak a ahi ua; huai lampite athei kei ua, alampite ah a-om gige sam kei uhi.
english: “These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.

paite: Khovak tung in tualthatmi athou a, gentheite leh tasamte athat a; ahi, zan in guta bang in a-om hi.
english: The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief.

paite: Ang kawm mi mit in leng khomui angak a, kuamah in hon mu kei ding, chi in amai abawl lamdang hi.
english: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No eye will see me.’ He disguises his face.

paite: Khomial in innte avut pailet ua, sun chiang in akikhumbilh ua; khovak athei kei uh.
english: In the dark they dig through houses. They shut themselves up in the daytime. They don’t know the light.

paite: Amaute tengteng a ding in zingsang sihna limliap bang ahi a; zan mial lauhuaite lawm in anei uhi."
english: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.

paite: "Tuite tung ah kintak a taihmang in a-om ua, atantuan uh lei ah hamsiat in a-om; agrephuante sukmi in anaih kei.
english: “They are foam on the surface of the waters. Their portion is cursed on the earth. They don’t turn into the way of the vineyards.

paite: Khokhal leh nisa in vuk tuite atawpkang a, huai mah bang in thil hihkhialte Sheol in ahih hi.
english: Drought and heat consume the snow waters, so does Sheol those who have sinned.

paite: Sul in amah amangngilh dia; than in limsatak in amah kivakna in anei ding uh; theihgige in a-omta kei dia, diktatlouhna sing bang a hihtan in a-om ding.
english: The womb will forget him. The worm will feed sweetly on him. He will be no more remembered. Unrighteousness will be broken as a tree.

paite: “Ta nei lou numei ching anegai a; meithai a ding in hoih ahih kei hi.
english: He devours the barren who don’t bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.

paite: Ahi a lah Pathian in athilhihtheihna in mihatte adomkang a, hinna alamet phak louh lai un adingtou uh.
english: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.

paite: Bitna Pathian in amaute apia a, huchi in huai ah akhawl uh; alampite uah amitte a-om hi.
english: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways.

paite: "Hihlet in a-om. ua; himahleh sawt lou kal in, abei uhi; ahi, sukniam in a-om ua, midang tengteng bang in lampi a kipan lakkhiak in a-om-ua, buhvui bang in atkhiak in a-om uhi.
english: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.

paite: Huchibang na hi kei taleh kua ahia zuauthei a hon chian a, ka thugen bangmah lou suah ding?"
english: If it isn’t so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?”

paite: Shuah mi Bildad in adawng a, hichi in achi:
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

paite: "Pathian kiang ah lalna leh launa a-om; ama'n amun sangte ah muanna abawl hi.
english: “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.

paite: "Asepaihhonte kua'n asim seng dia? Kua tung ah ahia avakna tanlouhna a om?
english: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?

paite: Huchi ahih chiang in Pathian ma ah bangchi in mihing adik thei dia? Ahihkeileh amah numei suan bangchi in asiang thei dia?
english: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?

paite: Ngai in, khapi nangawn in vakna anei kei a, amitmuh in aksite asiangthou kei hi.
english: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;

paite: "Mihing, tangtel sang a bangzah a neuzaw? Pathian mitmuh ah mihing bangchi phet ahi diam, mihing tapa, lungnou leltak!"
english: How much less man, who is a worm, and the son of man, who is a worm!”

paite: Huan Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
english: Then Job answered,

paite: "Thilhihtheihna nei lou amah bangchi a panpih in; hatna nei lou ban bangchidan a hondam thei na hia?
english: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!

paite: Pilna nei lou amah bangchi in na thuhilh a, nakpitak a theihna hoih na puangkheta a;
english: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!

paite: Kua kiang ah ahia thute na genkhiak? Kua kha ahia nang a kipan hong paikhia?"
english: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?

paite: "Sisate leh huai a tengte tuite nuai a kipan ahi uh.
english: “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

paite: Ama ah Sheol vuaktang in a-om a, Abaddon in kikhuhna anei kei hi.
english: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.

paite: Ama'n mal mun awng ah aphalhkhia a, bangmah lou tung ah lei akhai hi.
english: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.

paite: Ameipi sah in tuite atun a; anuai ah meipi akikek kei hi.
english: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.

paite: Ama'n laltutphah mai akhuh a, atung ah ameipi aphalh hi.
english: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.

paite: Tuite tung ah, khovak leh khomial kigitna ah, kawlmong akaikual hi.
english: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.

paite: Asalhna ah van khuamte aling ua, lamdang asa uh.
english: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.

paite: "Athilhihtheihna in tuipi akhawlsak a, huan atheihsiamna in Rahab asat hi.
english: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.

paite: Ahu in vante bawlhoih in a-om a; akhut in gulpi kinoh tai lai abawl hi.
english: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.

paite: Ngai in, hiaite a thilhih among lel ahi uh. Ngatchik a ahuau siausiau lel! Athilhihtheihna van-ging kua ahia theisiam ding?"
english: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”

paite: Huchi in Job in agentehna thu apan nawn a, hichi in achi:
english: Job again took up his parable, and said,

paite: "Pathian ahin bang in, ama'n ka dikna alamang a; Bangkim hihthei in, ama'n ka kha ahihbuaia;
english: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter

paite: Ka sung a ka hinna a-om lai teng, Pathian hu ka nakvang a a-om lai teng?
english: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);

paite: Ka mukte'n thutak lou agen kei ding, ka lei in leng khemna thu agen kei ding.
english: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.

paite: Siam ka hon tangsak kei ding a, ka sih ma kei a pan ka dikna ka koihmang kei ding.
english: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.

paite: Ka diktatna ka len tinten a, ka khah kei ding hi, ka dam lai teng ka lungtang in kei hon kou kei ding.
english: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.

paite: "Ka melma gilou bang hi henla, kei dou ding a thou midiktat lou bang hi hen.
english: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.

paite: Punna muta mahleh, Pathian limsakloumi lametna, Pathian in akha alakmang ngal in, bang ahia?
english: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

paite: Atung a buaina atun in, Pathian in akikou aza diam?
english: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?

paite: Bangkim hihthei ah nuam asa in, chik lai peuh in Pathian sap nuam asa diam?
english: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?

paite: "Pathian khut tungtang ah nang ka hon sinsak ding; Bangkim hihthei kiang a om ke'n ka iim kei ding hi.
english: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.

paite: Ngai un, noute tengteng in huai na muta ua; ahih ngalleh, bangziak a bangmah lou hong hi na hi ua?"
english: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?

paite: "Hiai Pathian lak a migilou tantuan leh, nuaisiah hat mite goutan, Bangkim hihthei a pan amuh uh ahi.
english: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

paite: Atate apun uleh, namsau a ding ahi; huan asuan tanghou in atai kei ding hi.
english: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.

paite: Anung a omlaite hi leng in avui dia, ameithaite un kahna abawl kei ding uh.
english: Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.

paite: Leivui bang a dangka vum in, tungman bang in puansilh bawl mahleh;
english: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;

paite: Abawl thei, himahleh midikte'n asilh ding ua, mihoihte'n dangka pen ahawm ding uh.
english: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.

paite: Maimomlen bang in inn alam a, vengmi in abawl aidakbuk bang lel ahi.
english: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.

paite: Hausa in alum a, himahleh khop in a-om kei ding; amit ahak a, huan amah a-om kei.
english: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.

paite: Tuite bang in launate'n amah apha a; zan in huihpi in amah agumang hi.
english: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.

paite: Suahlam huih in amah apomang a, apaimang hi; huchi in amun a kipan in amah amutmang hi.
english: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.

paite: "Pathian in amah nakpi in alawn dia, adawm kei ding; akhut a pan ataimang ding hi.
english: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.

paite: Mite'n amah akhut uh abetkhum ding ua, amun a kipan in amah anuihsan ding uhi."
english: Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.

paite: "Chihtaktak in dangka a ding in khuk a-om a ahihsiang uh dangka-eng a ding in mun.
english: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.

paite: Lei a pan in sik akilakhia a, suang a kipan in dal akisungkhia hi.
english: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.

paite: Mihing in khomial phak tawp aneisak a, bukimna azongkhia hi; khomial leh sihna lim phak tawp tan in.
english: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.

paite: Mite omlouhna ah kokhuk lutna hawm atouvang ua, mite a pan gamla ah akikhai ua, lehlam lehlam ah akivei uh.
english: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.

paite: Lei ahihleh, huai a kipan in tanghou ahong suak a; anuai ah mei ahih bang in akilumlet hi.
english: As for the earth, out of it comes bread. Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

paite: Huai suangte sapphir suang mun ahi a dangka-eng nen anei hi.
english: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.

paite: Huai lampi sasial ne vasa in athei kei a, mu-akla mit in leng amu ngei sam kei hi.
english: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.

paite: Gamsa kisatheite'n asik kha ngei kei ua, humpinelkai lun lai leng huai ah apai kha nai kei hi.
english: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.

paite: "Meisah suangpi tung ah akhut akoih a; azung in mualte alumlet hi.
english: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.

paite: Suangpite lak ah tuilam ahong a; amit in thil manpha chiteng amu hi.
english: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.

paite: Atakkhiaklouhna ding un lui luangte atuam a; thil kisel khovak ah ahon lakhia hi.
english: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.

paite: Himahleh koi lai ah apilna akimu dia? Theihsiamna koi lai a om ahia?
english: “But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?

paite: "Mihing in alampi athei kei; mihing gam ah leng muh in a-om kei.
english: Man doesn’t know its price, and it isn’t found in the land of the living.

paite: Thukna in, 'Kei ah a-om kei,' achi a, tuipi in, 'Ka kiang ah a-om kei,' achi hi.
english: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’

paite: Dangka-eng a lei theih ahi kei a, huai man ding in dangka buk theih ahi kei hi.
english: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.

paite: Ophir dangka-eng toh amanphatna teh theih ahi kei ding, Onik mantam hiam Sapphir toh hiam.
english: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

paite: Dangka-eng leh limlang in akimpih thei kei ua, huai khenna ding in dangka-eng hoih leh suangmantam leng ahi thei kei ding hi.
english: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.

paite: Suang dum hiam suang muh paisuak theih akigen kei ding, Ahi, pilna man rubi suang sang in asangzaw hi.
english: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

paite: Ethiopia topaz suang in apha kei dia, dangka-engtak toh leng amanphatna teh ding ahi kei.
english: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it. It won’t be valued with pure gold.

paite: "Ahihleh pilna koi a kipan a hong pai ahia? Theihsiamna koi a om ahia?
english: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?

paite: Mihing tengteng mit a kipan a sel ahi chih leh, huihkhua a vasate a kipan sitsa a om ahi chih thei in.
english: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.

paite: Abaddon leh Sihna in, 'Huai a thuthang ka bil un ka za uh,' achi uhi.
english: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’

paite: Pathian in huai alampi atheisiam a, amun athei hi.
english: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.

paite: Lei mong tan in a-en ngal a, van nuai thil tengteng amu hi.
english: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.

paite: Huih a ding a gikna apiak lai in leh tuite tehna a ateh lai in;
english: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.

paite: Vuah a ding a thupiak abawl a, vanpiging khophia a dia lampi abawl lai in;
english: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder,

paite: Huai lai in ama'n amu a, apuang a; ahihkip a, ahi, azongkhia hi.
english: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.

paite: "Mihing kiang ah, 'Ngai in, TOUPA kihtak, huai pilna ahi; hoih lou a kipan paimang theihsiamna ahi,' achi hi.”
english: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”

paite: Job in agentehna thu agen nawn a, hichi in achi.
english: Job again took up his parable, and said,

paite: "Aw nidanglai khate bang a om hi leng, Pathian in ahon veh lai nite bang in;
english: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;

paite: Ka lutung a akhawnvak atan a, amah vakna a khomial a ka vak lai;
english: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,

paite: Ka tuailai nite a ka om bang a, ka puanin tung a Pathian thuguk a-om lai in;
english: as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,

paite: Ka kiang a Bangkim hihthei a-om a, ka tate ka kim a-om lai un;
english: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,

paite: Ka kalsuante bawngnawi a sawp ahih a, suangpi in sathau luite abutkhiak lai in.
english: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,

paite: Khopi a kongpi zuan a ka pai lai in, kongzing a ka tutna ka bawl lai in,
english: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.

paite: Tangvalte'n ahon mu ua, abu ua; upate athou ua adingh uh.
english: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.

paite: Lalte houlim akidek ua, akam uah akhut uh akoih uh.
english: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

paite: Miliante aw adai a, akam dangtawng uah alei uh abelh hi.
english: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.

paite: "Bil in ahon zak lai in, hampha ahon chi a; mit in ahon muh lai in, pom ahon chi a;
english: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, and when the eye saw me, it commended me,

paite: Migenthei, panpih ngai a kap, Pa nei lou, panpihtu bei ka hutkhiak ziak in.
english: because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,

paite: Mangthang ding a mansa a kipan vualzawlna ka tung ah ahong tung a; meithai lungtang kipah ziak a lasa ding in ka omsak hi.
english: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

paite: Diktatna ka silh a, ahon tuam hi; ka dikna puanak thupi leh lukhum bang leh suangmantam bang ahi.
english: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

paite: Mittaw a ding in mitte ka hi a, khebai a ding in khete ka hi.
english: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.

paite: Tasam a ding in pa ka hi a; ka theih louh thubul ka zongkhia hi.
english: I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him whom I didn’t know.

paite: Diktatloumi haizek ka hihtan a, aha a kipan asamat ka khahsak.
english: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

paite: "Huchi in ke'n, ka bu ah ka si ding a, piaunel bang in ka nite ka pungsak ding, ka chi a.
english: Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.

paite: Ka zungte tuite pha in adalhzak a, ka hiangte ah zankhua in daitui akai.
english: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.

paite: Kei ah ka thupina athak gige a, ka khut ah ka thalpeu athak gige.
english: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’

paite: Mite'n ahon ngai ua, angak ua, ka thuhilh a ding in adai dide uhi.
english: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.

paite: Ka thute zoh in apau nawn kei uh; ka thugen atung uah atakkhia.
english: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.

paite: Vuah ngak bang in ahon ngak ua; vuah nanungte a ding bang in lianpi in akamka uh.
english: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.

paite: Kimuanna aneih louh chiang un atung uah ka nuihmai a; huchi in ka mel tang apaikhe kei uh.
english: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.

paite: "Alampi ding uh ka telsak a, hausa bang in ka tu a; sepaih pawl lak a kumpipa bang in ka leng a, suun mite lungmuanmi bang in."
english: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.

paite: Hiai khit in Job in akam aka a, ani ahamsiat hi.
english: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.

paite: Job in adawng a, hichi in achi.
english: Job answered:

paite: "Ka pian ni leh zan, pasal naupang pai in a-om, akichihna mangthang hen.
english: “Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’

paite: Huai ni mialna hi hen; tunglam a kipan Pathian in ngaihsak kei hen, atung ah leng khovak tang kei hen.
english: Let that day be darkness. Don’t let God from above seek for it, neither let the light shine on it.

paite: Khomial leh sihna lim in amau a ding in huai ngen uhen; atung ah meipi kai hen; khua nimsak tengteng in huai tuh lausak uhen.
english: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes the day black terrify it.

paite: "Zan ahihleh, mial sah bikbek atung ah tu hen; kum nite lak ah telsak kei hen; khate simna ah tel kei heh.
english: As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.

paite: Ngai in, huai zan hut henla; huai ah kipah aw ging kei hen.
english: Behold, let that night be barren. Let no joyful voice come therein.

paite: Huai ni hamsiatte amau hamsiat uhen, Leviathan tokthou ding a mansa a omte.
english: Let them curse it who curse the day, who are ready to rouse up leviathan.

paite: Huai a khomui aksite mial uhen; khovak zong henla, himahleh bangmah nei kei hen; zingsang mitvunte leng mu sam kei hen.
english: Let the stars of its twilight be dark. Let it look for light, but have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the morning,

paite: Ka nu sul kongkhakte akhak louh ziak in, ka mit a kipan abuaina asel louh ziak in.
english: because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.

paite: "Sul a kipan bangziak a si lou ka hia? Gil a kipan ka hong paikhiak lai a bangziak a kha khah lou ka hia?
english: “Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?

paite: Bangziak a khukte'n kei hon dom ahia? Ahihkeileh bangziak a ka tep ding nawi na om ahia?
english: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?

paite: Tu a na lum khin a, na dai mai ding lah ka hi ngal a; ka na ihmuta dia; huchi in ka na khawlta ding hi.
english: For now I should have lain down and been quiet. I should have slept, then I would have been at rest,

paite: Lei kumpipate leh thudot mite, amau a ding a mun sia bawlte toh.
english: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;

paite: Ahihkeileh dangka-eng nei kumpite, a-innte uh dangka a dimsakte toh.
english: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver;

paite: Ahihkeileh muh louh a ahun lou a piang bang na hilou ka hia, naungek khovak mu ngeiloute bang?
english: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.

paite: Huai ah migiloute'n sukbuai atawpsan ua; huai ah mitawlte akhawl uhi.
english: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.

paite: Huai ah salmatte nuam in a-omkhawm uh; nasem heutute aw aza kei uhi.
english: There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.

paite: Huai ah aneu leh alian a-om ua; apu a kipan in sikha anuamlen.
english: The small and the great are there. The servant is free from his master.

paite: "Bangziak a dah a omte kiang a khovak piak ahia, kha a haksa sa kiang ah hinna;
english: “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,

paite: Sihna deih a, atunlouhnate kiang ah; gou selguk zon sang a thupi a zong mite kiang ah.
english: who long for death, but it doesn’t come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,

paite: Han atun lai ua, nakpitak a kipakte kiang ah?
english: who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?

paite: Bangziak a mi alampi sel a om kiang leh Pathian in a-umsuak kiang a khovak piak a om ahia?
english: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?

paite: An ka nek ma in ka thumna ahong tung a, ka maunate tui bang a leihbuak in a-om hi.
english: For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.

paite: Ka kihtak thil lah ka tung ah ahong tung ngal a, ka laulau ka tung ah ahong tung hi.
english: For the thing which I fear comes on me, that which I am afraid of comes to me.

paite: Nuam ka sa kei a, ka lung amuang kei, khawlna leng ka nei kei hi; himahleh buaina ahong pai hi.”
english: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither do I have rest; but trouble comes.”

paite: "Huan kei sang a naupang, apate uh, ka ganching uite toh koih dia ka sitte'n, kei nuihza bawlna in ahon zang uh.
english: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.

paite: Ahi, akhutte uh hat a, kei bang ahon loh tak dia, huai ahatna uh beisate'n?
english: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?

paite: Taksapna leh kialna in atuikang ua; lei keu leh sia akheuh uh,
english: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.

paite: Pawn a anteh alou ua; huan lou kha zungte a-an uh ahi.
english: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.

paite: Mite lak a kipan hawlkhiak in a-om ua; guta bang in amau nung ah akikou ua.
english: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief,

paite: Guam a hengte ah ateng ding ua, lei leh suangpi hawmte ah.
english: so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.

paite: Pawn lak ah aham ua; lahou nuaite ah akisekhawm uh.
english: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles.

paite: Mihaite tate ahi ua, ahi, mithulim lou tate; gam a pan in delhkhiak ahi uhi.
english: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.

paite: "Huan tu in kei ala uh ka hong hi ahi, amau a ding in houlimna ka hi.
english: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.

paite: Ahon kih ua, kei a kipan atuam ding in uh, ka mai a chilsiat akidek kei uh.
english: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.

paite: Pathian in ka khau akhah a, ahon hihgim a, huan ka ma ah kamkaihna akhahkhia uh.
english: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.

paite: Ka khut taklam ah tuailaite athou ua; ka khe anawlkhin ua, siatna lampi ka ma ah akoih uhi.
english: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet. They cast their ways of destruction up against me.

paite: Ka lampi hihsiarin, ka tuahsiatna azong ua, kuama'n akham kei uh.
english: They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.

paite: Awng zapi apaisuak bang in ahong ua, siatna lak ah ka tung ah akikhuk uh.
english: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.

paite: Ka tung ah launate ahei ua, huih bang in ka minphatna adelhmang uh; meipi bang in ka hauhna apaimang hi.
english: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.

paite: "Huchi in tu in ka sung ah ka kha buakkhiak in a-om; gimthuakna nite'n kei ahon man uhi.
english: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.

paite: Zan in ka guhte asawi a, kei hon sun natnate'n khawl chih anei kei uh.
english: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.

paite: Ka natna hi hat mahmah ziak in ka puansilh anin a: ka puanak ngawng bang in kei ahon gak hi.
english: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.

paite: Buannawi ah ahon pailut a, leivui leh meivu bang ka hi hi.
english: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.

paite: "Na kiang ah ka kikou a, na hon dawng kei hi. Ka ding a, kei na hon en maimah a.
english: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.

paite: Ka tung a gilou ding in na kilumlet a, na bantha hatna in kei na hon sawi hi.
english: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.

paite: Huih ah na hon domkangtou a, huai tung ah na hon tuangsak; huchi in huih ah na hon lumlet den hi.
english: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.

paite: Sihna na hon tun ding chih ka thei hi, mihing tengteng a dia sehsa inn ah.
english: For I know that you will bring me to death, to the house appointed for all living.

paite: Himahleh siatna a pukgawp mi'n aban zak lou ding hia? Atuahsiatna ah panpihna ngen in kikou lou ding hia?
english: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?

paite: Buaina a ding in ka kap kei diam? tasam a ding in ka kha adah kei ding a hiam?
english: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?

paite: Hoih ka ngak chiang in, hoih lou ahong pai a; khovak ka ngak chiang in, khomial ahong pai.
english: When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.

paite: "Ka lungtang abuai, khawl hun amu ngei kei; gimthuakna nite ka tung ah ahong tung.
english: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.

paite: Hihvom a om in ka vialvak, himahleh ni hihvom hilou in; khawmpi ah ka dingh a panpih deih in ka kikou hi.
english: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

paite: Sehalte unaupa ka hi a, simbute lawm ka hi.
english: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.

paite: Ka vun avom a, kei a kipan apilh uh, kholum in ka guhte akang hi.
english: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.

paite: Huaiziak in ka kaihging suunna asuak a, ka mutging mikapte aw."
english: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.

paite: "Ka mit toh thukhun ka na bawl khinta; bangchi in nungak ka en theita dia?
english: “I made a covenant with my eyes; how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?

paite: "Ahihleh tunglam Pathian a kipan in ka tantuan bang ahia, tungsang a Bangkim hihthei a kipan in ka goutan?
english: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?

paite: Midikloute tung ah siatna, gitlouh nasemte tung ah gawtna atung kei maw?
english: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?

paite: Ama'n ka lampite amu kei a hia? ka kalsuante asim vek kei a hia?
english: Doesn’t he see my ways, and count all my steps?

paite: "Thuzuau toh na om a, huai a ka khe khem ding a kinoh ahihleh;
english: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit

paite: bukna diktak ah hon buk dih ua, Pathian in ka thutakna thei hen!
english: (let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);

paite: Ka kalsuan lampi a kipan a na pial hiam, ka lungtang in ka mitte na zui hiam, ka khutte ah nin himhim na belh hiam;
english: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,

paite: Huchi ka hihleh, chi tuh ning, midang in ne hen; ahi, ka lou a piang bulkalh khiak hi hen.
english: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.

paite: "Ka lungtang numei lam a khem a om a, ka inveng kongkhak ka na ngak takleh;
english: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,

paite: huchi ahih takleh ka zi in midang a ding in an su henla, midangte amah tung ah kun uhen.
english: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her.

paite: Huchibang gitlouhna hoih het lou ahi; ahi, vaihawm mite gawt ding khelhna ngei,
english: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges,

paite: siatna ding a Abaddon tan a kangbei leh, ka punna tengteng zungkalh ding mei hi ding lah ahi ngal a.
english: for it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.

paite: "Ka tung a phunna aneih lai ua, ka sikhapa hiam ka sikhanu hiam makhua na musit a, na khualsak lou ka hihleh;
english: “If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me,

paite: Pathian athohkhiak chiang in bang ka hihta dia? Thu akan hun chiang in bang in ka dawngta dia?
english: what then will I do when God rises up? When he visits, what will I answer him?

paite: Kei sul a pan hon bawlpa'n amah abawl kei maw? Khat in ahon bawl tuak ahi kei maw?
english: Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?

paite: "Migentheite alunggulh uh ka piak louh a, ahihkeileh vuaksuak ding a meithai mitte ka na omsakleh;
english: “If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,

paite: Ahihkeileh kei kia in ka an ka nek a, huai a pabei in an anek keileh;
english: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it

paite: Ii, ka tuailai a kipan in pa bang ka hi, ka kiang ah ana khanglianta; ka nu sul a kipan amah pipa ka hita hi.
english: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, I have guided her from my mother’s womb);

paite: "Kuapeuh taksap ziak a mangthang hiam, ahihkeileh tasam khuhna nei lou hiam ka na muhleh;
english: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;

paite: Akawngte'n kei hon vualzawl lou a, ka belam mul a lumsak a ana om keileh.
english: if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;

paite: "Kongpi a panpihna ka muh ziak a pabeite siatna ding a ka khut ka na likleh;
english: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate;

paite: Huchi ka hihleh, ka liang ka liangzang a kipan kia henla, aguh a kipan ka ban kitan hen.
english: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.

paite: Pathian a kipan tuahsia kei a ding in launa ahi ngal a, athupina ka tuak ngam kei hi.
english: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.

paite: "Dangka-eng lametpen a ka na bawl a, dangka-eng hoih kiang ah, ka muanna na hi, ka na chihtak a;
english: “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’

paite: Ka hauhna thupi ziak a hiam, ka khut in tam alam ziak a ka kipah a;
english: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;

paite: Avak lai a ni ka na et a, kha thupitak paikhia ka na et a,
english: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,

paite: Ka lungtang guk a khem a a-om a, ka kam in ka khut ana tawp takleh;
english: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth;

paite: Hiai leng thulimlouhna vaihawmte gawt ding ahi, tung a Pathian kiang a na zuauta hi ding ka hih ziak in.
english: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges, for I would have denied the God who is above.

paite: "Kei hon mudah siatna a ka na kipah a, ahihkeileh hoih lou atung a atun chiang a ka na kipah luatleh;
english: “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him

paite: Ka melma hamsiat ding leh ahenna thum ding in ka kam ka na khialsak kei.
english: (I have certainly not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);

paite: Ka puaninte a, 'A-an a kihihvah lou kua a-om a?' hon na chih kei ualeh;
english: if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’

paite: Kongzing ah mikhual agiak ngei kei a; khualzin a ding in ka kongte ka na hongta.
english: (the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);

paite: "Adam bang a ka angsung a thulimlouhna na sel a, ka tatlekna na khuh ka hih a,
english: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,

paite: aziak, mi tampi launa thupitak ka neih ziak ahih a, sungte hon muh daina launa ziak a huchi a dai dide a, popawt lou ka hihleh,
english: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn’t go out of the door—

paite: Aw, kei hon za ding mi nei leng maw. Ngai in, ka deihlam hiai ahi. Bangkim hihthei in hon dawng henla; ka melma in laibu ah gelhkhiak hen.
english: oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my indictment!

paite: "Chihtaktak in ka liangzang ah ka po dia; lallukhu bang in kei ah ka kan den ding hi.
english: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder, and I would bind it to me as a crown.

paite: Akiang ah ka kalsuan zah ka puang ding a; lal bang in akiangnai ah ka hoh ding hi.
english: I would declare to him the number of my steps. I would go near to him like a prince.

paite: "Ka gam kei dem a akikou a, lei lehsate akahkhawm uleh;
english: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;

paite: Sum lou a huai gahte ka na nek tak a, ahihkeileh huai a aneite ahinna uh ka na tansakleh,
english: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,

paite: Buh hilou in louling neite, barli buh hilou in loubualte pou zaw hen," Job thute abeita hi.
english: let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.

paite: Huchibang in hiai mi thumte Job dawn atawpta ua, amah mit a diktat ahih ziak in.
english: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

paite: Huai lai in Job tung ah Ram inkuan a Buz mi Barakel tapa Elihu hehna akuangkhia a, Pathian hi zaw lou a amah siam akitansak ziak in.
english: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.

paite: Alawm thumte tung ah leng ahehna akuangkhia a, dawnna ding nei lou a, hinapi a lah Job amohpaih ziak un.
english: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

paite: Amah sang a a-upat zawk ziak un, Job kiang a thu gen ding in Elihu in angak hi.
english: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were older than he.

paite: Hiai mi thumte kam a dawnna a-om kei chih atheih in, ahehna akuangkhia hi.
english: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.

paite: "Huchi in Buz mi Barakel tapa. Elihu in adawng hi: Ka naupang a, noute na upa mahmah uh; huaiziak in ka dai a, ka lungsim ka hon ensak ngam kei hi.
english: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old. Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.

paite: Huchi in ka chi, 'Nite'n thu agen ding uh, kum tampi in pilna a sinsak ding hi.'
english: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’

paite: Himahleh mihing lungsim a om a, Bangkim hihthei in theihsiamna apia hi.
english: But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.

paite: Apilte mithupite ahi kei ua, vaihawmna theisiamte upate ahi sam kei uh.
english: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.

paite: Huaiziak in hong ngaikhia un; ke'n leng ka lungsim ka ensak ding, ka chi.
english: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’

paite: "Ngai un, na thute uh ka ngak a, gen ding na zonkhiak lai un, na thusutte uh ka ngaikhia.
english: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.

paite: Ahi, ka hon limsak a, ngai un, kuamah Job thuzoh zou na om kei uh, ahihkeileh na lak uah, athute dawng.
english: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.

paite: Pilna i muta, chi lou ding in pilvang un; mihing hilou in Pathian in amah azou thei hi.
english: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom. God may refute him, not man;’

paite: Ama'n kei siatna ding in athute ahih kei a; ke'n leng nou thugente in amah ka dawng sam kei ding.
english: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.

paite: "Lamdang sa in, adawng nawn akei ua, gen ding thu khat leng anei kei uh.
english: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.

paite: Thu ging neih louh ziak in adingh kinken ua, adawn nawn louh ziak un ke'n ka ngak diam?
english: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?

paite: Ke'n leng ka dawnna ding ka nei hi, ka lungsim ka ensak sam ding, ka chi hi.
english: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.

paite: Thu in ka dim a; ka sung a ka kha in hon sawl teitei hi.
english: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.

paite: Ngai un, ka gilpi pawtkhiakna nei lou uain thawl bang ahi; uain thawl thakte bang in puakzak ding in mansa in ma-om hi.
english: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.

paite: Ka halhtheihna ding in, ka pau ding; ka mukte ka hong dia, ka dawng ding hi.
english: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.

paite: Mihing mihinna zahtaksak kei un, ka hon ngen hi; kuamah kiang ah leng maitang phatna min ka pe kei ding hi.
english: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.

paite: Maitang phatna minte piak ding ka thei ngal kei a; huchi lou in zaw kei hon bawlpa'n ahon lazok ding hi."
english: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.

paite: "Akoi abang hitaleh, Job, ka hon ngen hi, thugen za inla ka thugen tengteng ngaikhia in.
english: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.

paite: Ngai in, tu in, ka kam ka ka a, ka kam in ka pau hi.
english: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.

paite: Ka thute'n ka lungtang dikna agenkhe ding uh; Ka mukte'n atheih ngei uh chihtaktak in agen ding uhi.
english: My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.

paite: Pathian Kha in ahon bawl a, Bangkim hihthei hu in hinna ahon pia hi.
english: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

paite: "Na theihleh hon dawng in; ka ma ah na thute akizom in koih inla na panna ah dingh in.
english: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.

paite: Ngai in, nang bang in Pathian lam ah ka om hi; kei leng tungman a bawl ka hi.
english: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.

paite: Ngai in, ka lauhuaina in nang ahon lausak kei ding, ka hahkatna leng na tung ah agik kei ding hi.
english: Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.

paite: "Chihtaktak in ka zak in na pauta a, huchi in na thute ging ka zata hi.
english: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,

paite: Ka siang hi, tatlekna bei; ka hoih a, kei ah thulimlouhna leng a-om kei, chi in.
english: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.

paite: Ngai in, kei demna ding ziak amu a melma in ahon simta hi;
english: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.

paite: Ka khete kol abunsak a, ka lampite tengteng achiamteh hi.
english: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’

paite: "Ngai in, ka hon dawng ding, hiai na diklouhna ah; mihing sang in Pathian alianzaw hi.
english: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.

paite: Bangziak a amah dou na hia, Ka thute a bangmah mah lah adawng kei ding, chi in?
english: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?

paite: Pathian in lah khatvei agen a, ahi, nihvei, mihing in limsak kei mahleh.
english: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.

paite: Zan a mang ah, mengmuhna ah, mite tung a ihmut kip akiak lai un, lupna tung a ihmut laite un;
english: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed,

paite: huai lai in mite bilte ahong a, vaunate in amau ahihlau a,
english: then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,

paite: Huchi a athiltup a kipan a mihing alakkika, mihing a kipan akisaktheihna asatkhiak theihna ding in;
english: that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

paite: Ama'n kokhuk a kipan akha akepkiksak a, namsau a kipan ahinna.
english: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

paite: "Alupna tung ah natna asawi in leng a-om aguhte akinakna om gige toh in.
english: “He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,

paite: Huchi in ahinna in tanghou, akha in an lim akih hi.
english: so that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.

paite: Asa atummang a, huchi in muh theih in a-om kei; Akimu lou a guhte hong dawkkhia uhi.
english: His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.

paite: Ahi, han kiang ah akha ahong nai a, ahinna hihse mite kiang ah.
english: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.

paite: "Akiang a angel, kamlet, sangkhat lak a khat, mihing kiang a amah a dia dik bang ahia chih etsak ding a-omleh;
english: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him,

paite: Huchi a amah a ding a zahngai thei, Kokhuk a paisukna a kipan amah suaktasak un, tatna ka muta.
english: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’

paite: Asa naupang a sang in nou zaw hen; atuailai nite lam ah kik nawnta hen.
english: His flesh will be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.

paite: Pathian kiang ah athum a, amah ding in deihsak theih in a-om hi; huchi in nopna toh amai amu a; adiktatna akiang ah ape nawn hi.
english: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.

paite: Mite ma ah la asa a, ka khialta a, adik ka na hekkawi a, thuk in ka om kei!
english: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.

paite: Kokhuk sung a paisukna a kipan akha atanta hi, ahinna in vakna amuta ding hi, achi a.
english: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’

paite: "Ngai in, hiai thilte tengteng Pathian in, mihing lak ah ahih a, nihvei, ahi thumvei.
english: “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,

paite: Kokhuk a kipan akha pikik ding in, huchi a mihing vakna ahihvak a a-omtheihna ding in.
english: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

paite: "Chiamteh in, Aw Job, ngaikhia in, dai inla, thu ka gen ding.
english: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.

paite: Gen ding na neihleh, hon dawng in, pau in, siam hon tansak ka ut ngal a.
english: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.

paite: Na neih keileh, kei hon ngaikhia in, dai inla pilna ka hon sinsak ding hi."
english: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”

paite: Huai lou in Elihu in adawng a, hichi in achi:
english: Moreover Elihu answered,

paite: "Ka thute za un, nou mipilte; nou theihna neite, bil hon doh un.
english: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.

paite: Dangtawng in an achep bang in, bil in thute a-enchian hi.
english: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.

paite: Adik ei a ding in i tel ding uh; i lak ua hoih bang ahia i thei ding uh.
english: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.

paite: Job in, 'Ka dik a, Pathian in ka dikna a lamang,' achi ngal a.
english: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right.

paite: Ka dikna huchi hita mahleh zuauthei a sim ka hi a; tatlekna bei himah leng, ka liamna hihdam theih louh ahi.
english: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’

paite: "Muhsitna tui bang a dawn bei, Job bang mihing kua ahia?
english: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,

paite: Thulim lou nasem mite toh ahon a pai, migiloute toh omkhawm mi.
english: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?

paite: Ama'n lah, 'Pathian lak a ka kipahna ding bangmah ka loh tak kei,' achi ngal a.
english: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’

paite: Huaiziak in nou theisiam mite, hon ngaikhia un. Pathian in, gilou bangchi in ahih ngei dia; Bangkim hihthei in thulim lou bangchi in ahih mahmah dia.
english: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

paite: Ama'n lah mihing thilhih amah kiang apekik ding a, mi chiteng alampite kiang a pekik ding ahi.
english: For the work of a man he will give to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

paite: "Ahi, moh khuksakna thu ah, Pathian in giloutak in ahih kei dia, Bangkim hihthei in leng vaihawmna ahihse sam kei ding hi.
english: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

paite: Kua'n ahia amah leitung heutu hihna pia? Ahihkeileh khovel pumpi kua'n ahia athu a koih?
english: Who put him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed him over the whole world?

paite: Mihing tung a alungtang nga a, ama lam a akha leh ahu lakhawm;
english: If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,

paite: Sa tengteng amangthang vek ding ua, mihing leivui asuak nawn ding hi.
english: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.

paite: "Theihsiamna na neihleh, hiai za in; ka thu aw ngaikhia in.
english: “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.

paite: Mi thudik hua in vai ahawm ding hia? Dik leh hat amah na mohpaih ding hia?
english: Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty,

paite: Kumpipa kiang a, 'Na hoih kei' chih akilawm hia? Ahihkeileh miliante kiang a, 'Na gilou uh?' chih.
english: who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?

paite: Milalte mihinna zahtak lou a, Genthei sang a mihausate limsak zawte kiang a chih akilawm sem lou ding hia? Amaute lah akhut nasep ahi ngal ua.
english: He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor, for they all are the work of his hands.

paite: Mitphiat kal lou in asi ua zankim lai mahmah in; mite aling ua apaimang ua, mihing khut hilou in mihatte lakmang in a-om uhi.
english: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.

paite: "Amitte mihing lampite tung ah a-om a, apainate amu hi.
english: “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.

paite: Thulim lou nasem mite bukna ding khomial hiam limliap hiam a-om kei hi.
english: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

paite: Vaihawmna a Pathian ma a pai ding in, mihing angaihtuah lailai akiphamoh kei hi.
english: For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.

paite: Lamte theih phak vual louh in ama'n mihatte ahihzan vek a, amun uah midang atungkhia hi.
english: He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.

paite: Huaiziak in anasepte uh athei hi; zan in amau alumlet a, hihsiat in a-om uhi.
english: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

paite: Midang mitmuh mahmah in migiloute bang in amau agawt hi.
english: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

paite: Amah zuihna a kipan apialkhiak ua, alampite a koimah alimsak louh ziak un.
english: because they turned away from following him, and wouldn’t pay attention to any of his ways,

paite: Huchi in mizawng kahna akiang tung ding in abawl ua, gimthuak kahna aza hi.
english: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.

paite: "Amah na pau keileh, kua'n siam louh atangsak dia? Ama'n amai aselleh, kua'n amah amu thei dia? Namte kiang a hih hiam, ahihkeileh mihing kiang a hih hiam akibang hi.
english: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a man alike,

paite: Huchi a Pathian theiloumi in vai ahawm louh a, amite thang a awksak ding a- omlouhna ding in.
english: that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.

paite: "Kuapeuh in Pathian kiang ah, Gawtna ka thuakta, ka gilou nawn kei ding,
english: “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.

paite: Ka muh louh nang hon sinsak in, gilou ka hihleh ka hih nawn kei ding, achi uhia?
english: Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?

paite: Athukna huchi a na nial na deih bang in a-om diam? Kei hilou in, nang na tel ngeingei ding ahi.
english: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.

paite: "Theisiam mite'n ka kiang ah, 'Ahi,' achi ding uh, aza mipil teng in.
english: Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:

paite: Job in theihna bei in thu agen a, athute pilna bei ahi uh.
english: ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’

paite: Mihaite bang a adawnna ah, atawp chiang in Job tungtang ngaihtuah le uh.
english: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.

paite: Ama'n akhelhna ah helna abehlap a, i lak uah akhut abeng a, Pathian kalh in athu apungsakta hi.”
english: For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”

paite: Elihu in adawng a, hichi in achi:
english: Moreover Elihu answered,

paite: "Hiai na dikna hi in na ngaihtuah hia, ahihkeileh, kei a mawng ahi, Pathian mai ah na chi hia?
english: “Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’

paite: Kei a ding in bang phattuamna a-om dia? Khial lou a ka om in bang phattuamna ka nei a? na chih.
english: that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’

paite: Nang leh na kiang a na lawmte ka hon dawng ding.
english: I will answer you, and your companions with you.

paite: "Vante lam en inla, mu in; vante, nang sang a sangzaw, en in.
english: Look to the skies, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.

paite: Na hihkhelhleh, amah dem a bang hih na hia? Na tatleknate punsak hileh, amah tung a bang hih na hia?
english: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?

paite: Diktat na hihleh, amah bang na pia a? Ahihkeileh na khut a kipan bang amu a?
english: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?

paite: Na gitlouhna in nang bang in mi ahihna thei a; na diktatna in mihing tapa ahih hampha thei hi.
english: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.

paite: Nuaisiahna atam mahmah ziak in akikoukhia ua; mihat ban ziak in panpih deih in akikou uh.
english: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.

paite: Kuamah in, 'Zan chia late hon pia, Pathian kei hon Bawlpa koi a om ahia;
english: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,

paite: Lei a gamsate sang a hon sinsak tamzaw leh, van a vasate sang a hon pilsakzaw?' achi kei uh.
english: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’

paite: Huai ah akikou ua, himahleh, migilou kisaktheihna ziak in, kuamah in dawnna ape kei.
english: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men.

paite: Chihtaktak in Pathian in bangmah lou aza kei dia, Bangkim hihthei in leng alimsaksak kei ding hi.
english: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it.

paite: "Nang ngial in houh, ‘Amah ka mu kei, athu ma ah a-om, Amah ka ngak hi,' na chih vial.
english: How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!

paite: Himahleh tu in, heh a aveh louh a, ki-otsakna leng alimsak louh ziak in;
english: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance,

paite: Huaiziak in Job in bangmah lou in akam aka ahi; theihna bei in thu atamsak ahi.”
english: therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”

paite: Elihu mah in agenzom zel a, hichi in achi:
english: Elihu also continued, and said,

paite: "Hon na thuakzou zek inla, huan ka hon ensak ding; Pathian sik in lah banghiam khat gen ding ka nei ngal a.
english: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.

paite: Gamla a kipan ka theihna ka hon la ding a, kei hon Bawlpa tung ah diktatna ka nga ding hi.
english: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

paite: Diktak in ka thute zuau ahi kei a; hoihkim khat ka kiang ah a-om hi.
english: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.

paite: "Ngai in, Pathian in thil ahihthei a, kuamah amusit kei; theihsiamna hatna ah thil ahihthei hi.
english: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.

paite: Gilou hinna ahawi kei a; himahleh gimthuakte kiang ah adikna uh apia hi.
english: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.

paite: Midiktat a kipan amit alakik kei; himahleh laltutphah tung a kumpipa toh amau tangtawn in akoih a, huchi in hihlet in a-om uhi.
english: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.

paite: Huan sikkhaute a gak a a-om ua, gimthuakna guite alak a a-om uleh;
english: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,

paite: Huchi in athilhih uh amau a- ensak a, atatlekna uh, huchi a kisatheitak a ana omna uh.
english: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

paite: Thuhilhna lam ah abil uh ahonsak a, thulimlouhna a kipan kik ding in thu apia hi.
english: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.

paite: Amah thu angaihkhiak ua, a-nna asep uh leh, anite uh hauhsakna in ahihbei ding ua, akumte uh kipahna in.
english: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

paite: Himahleh angaihkhiak kei ualeh, namsau in amangthang ding ua, huchi in theihna bei in asi ding uh.
english: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.

paite: "Himahleh amau lungtang a Pathian limsaklouhnate'n hehna akholkhawm hi; amau ahen lai in panpih deih in akikou kei uh.
english: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.

paite: Tuailai in asi ua, siangloute lak ah ahinna uh amangthang hi.
english: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.

paite: Agimthuakna in gimthuakte asuaktasak a, nuaisiahna ah abil uh ahonsak hi.
english: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.

paite: Ahi, gakchihna omlouhna, mun lian lam ah dahna a kipan nang ahon pimang ding a; na dohkan tung a kilui thauna in adimta ding hi.
english: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.

paite: Himahleh giloute vaihawmna in na dim a; vaihawmna leh diktatna in nang hon len hi.
english: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.

paite: Thangpaihna a-om ziak in, pilvang in huchi lou in zaw na hauhna in nang ahon pimang kha ding hi; golhgukna tampi in leng nang hon pialsak kei hen.
english: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.

paite: Dahna ana omlouhna ding in, na hauhsaknate ahun diam, ahihkeileh na hatna thilhihtheihna tengteng?
english: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?

paite: Mite tengteng amun ua satkhiak a a-om zan uah lunggulh ke'n.
english: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.

paite: Pilvang in, gilou limsak ke'n; gimthuakna sang in hiai lah na telzawta ngal a.
english: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.

paite: "Ngai in, Pathian in athilhihtheihna in sangtak in ahih; amah bang sinsakmi kua ahia?
english: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?

paite: Kua'n amah alampi thu apia a? Ahihkeileh, 'Diklouhna na bawlta,' kua'n achi thei dia?
english: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness’?

paite: Mite'n la asak uh, athilhih hihlian ding in theigige in.
english: “Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.

paite: Huai ah mite tengteng a-en ua; huai mihing in gamlapi ah amu hi.
english: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.

paite: Ngai in, Pathian alian a, amah i thei kei; akumte zah zontheih ahi kei.
english: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.

paite: "Tui takte ama'n atawi khin a, huai a tuihu a kipan vuah azu.
english: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,

paite: Huai vante'n asungkhia ua, mihing tung ah tampi in atak.
english: which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.

paite: Meipi kiphahte leh a-inn vanpi gingte kua'n atheisiam dia?
english: Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunderings of his pavilion?

paite: Ngai in, akim ah akhovak azak a; tuipi nuai atuam hi.
english: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.

paite: Hiaite in mite avai hawmsak a; an tampi apia hi.
english: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.

paite: Akhutte in khophia atawi a; chiamtehna khoh ding in thu apia hi.
english: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.

paite: Huai husa in atungtang thu agen a, ganhonte'n leng hong kuantou huihpi tungtang thu athei uh."
english: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also, concerning the storm that comes up.

paite: "Hiai ah leng ka lungtang aling a, amun a kipan suan in a-om hi.
english: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.

paite: A-aw ging leh akam a kipan avan-ging paikhia noute'n ngaikhia un.
english: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.

paite: Van pumpi nuai ah asawlkhia a, akhophia lei tawpnate tan in.
english: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.

paite: Huai zoh in aw akikou a; alalna aw in vanpi agingsak a: a-aw zak a a-om chiang in amau alen kei hi.
english: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.

paite: Pathian in a-aw in lamdangtak in vanpi agingsak a; i theihtheih louh, thil thupite ahih zel hi.
english: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.

paite: Ama'n lah vuk kiang ah, 'Lei ah kia in,' achi ngal a; huchi mah bang in vuahmal phin kiang ah leng.
english: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.

paite: Mi chiteng khut atuambit a; abawlsa mite tengteng in huai atheihtheihna ding un.
english: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.

paite: Huai lai in gamsate amun uah alut ua, akuate uah a-om uhi.
english: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.

paite: Simlam dantan a kipan huihpi ahong a; mallam a kipan khovot.
english: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.

paite: Pathian hu in tui khal piak ahi; tuite nakna hihhaksat in a-om.
english: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.

paite: Ahi, meipi nawnna aposak a; akhophia meipi aphalhsak hi.
english: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.

paite: Amah pi in akivial heihei ua, tentheihna khovel maikaih a amaute thu apiak peuhmah ahihna ding un.
english: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,

paite: Bawlhoihna ding hiam, agam a ding hiam, ahihkeileh zahngaihna ding thiam a, ahon paisakna ah.
english: whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.

paite: "Hiai ngaikhia in, Aw Job; dingh kinken inla, Pathian thilhih lamdangte ngaihtuah in.
english: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

paite: Amaute tung a Pathian thupiak akoih a, ameipi khophia atansakdan na thei hia?
english: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?

paite: Meipite kibuk diknate, amah theihna hoihkim thilhih lamdangte na thei hia?
english: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?

paite: Sim huih ziak a lei adaih sipsip lai a, na puansilhte alumdan?
english: You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?

paite: Amah toh van, suntawm limlang bang a khauh na phalh thei hia?
english: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?

paite: Akiang a ka gen ding uh hon sinsak in; mialna ziak in ka thugen ding uh ka gelkhol thei kei ua.
english: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.

paite: Thu ka gen ding chih amah hilh ding ahi diam? Ahihkeileh mihing in valh khit a om ut ding ahi diam?
english: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

paite: "Huchi in mite'n meipi a om khovak amu kei ua: himahleh huih anung a, amaute ahihsiang hi.
english: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.

paite: Mal a kipan in dangka-eng bang a thupi ahong pai a; Pathian alalna ah athupi hi.
english: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.

paite: Bangkim hihthei thu ahihleh, mu thei kei hang; thilhihtheihna ah athupi petmah hi. Huan vaihawmna leh dikna hauhna ah gim athuaksak kei ding hi.
english: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.

paite: Huaiziak in mite'n amah alau ua; lungtang a pil kuamah alimsak kei hi."
english: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N pingpei a kipan in Job adawng a, hichi in achi:
english: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind,

paite: "Theihna bei thute a thuhilh hihmial hiai kua ahia?
english: “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?

paite: Kipasalsak in tu in na kawng gak inla; hon dong ding ka hi, ka kiang a na gen ding ahi.
english: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!

paite: Lei kingaknate ka koih lai in nang koi ah na om a? Gen in, theihsiamna nei na hihleh.
