english: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.

paite: Atehnate kua bawl ahia? Thei na hihleh! Atung a tehna khau kua zan ahia?
english: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?

paite: Anuai suangphumte kua phum ahia? Huai aning a suang kua koih ahia?
english: What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,

paite: Zingsang aksite'n la asakkhawm ua, Pathian tapate tengteng kipak a akikou lai un?
english: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

paite: "Ahihkeileh kua'n kongkhakte in tuipite akhakbing a? Gil a kipan hong pawtkhia bang a, ahong puahkhiak lai in.
english: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,

paite: Huai a puansilh meipi leh, khomial bikbek, huai a ding a tuamna puan ka bawl a,
english: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,

paite: huai a ding a ka thupiak bawl a, kalhnate leh kongkhakte koih a,
english: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,

paite: hiai tan na hong pai ding, himahleh aban hilou in, ka chih a; hiai lai ah aki-uangsak na tuikihotte kholsak in a-om ding uh, ka chih lai in?
english: and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here’?

paite: Na nite akipat nungsiah zingsang thu na pia in, phalvak amun thei ding in na bawlta hia?
english: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,

paite: Lei tawpnate amat theih a, huai a kipan a gilou sinkhiak ahihtheihna ding in?
english: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?

paite: Chiamtehna nuai a tungman lei bang in mel akikheng a; puansilh bang in thil tengteng zenei in adingkhia hi.
english: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.

paite: Gilou a kipan a akhovak uh lettangsak ahi a, aban liksang uh akitan hi.
english: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.

paite: "Tuipi nak sung ah na lutta hia? Ahihkeileh tui thuk tawp ah na paita hia?
english: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?

paite: Sihna kongpite na kiang ah taklat in a-omta hia? Ahihkeileh sihna limliap kongpite na muta hia?
english: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?

paite: Leitung zatdan na theisiamta hia? Puangkhia in, huai na theihleh.
english: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.

paite: Khovak tenna zotna lampi koi ah a-om a, huan khomial omna mun koisan ahia?
english: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,

paite: Huchi a gamgi tan a na tonpih theih a, huai a inn tan a lampite na theihna ding in?
english: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?

paite: Thei mah niteh maw, huai lai a piangta hi ding hi chin a? Na nite atam mahmah ngal a!
english: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!

paite: "Vuk koihkhawmna ah na lut ngei hia, ahihkeileh gial koihkhawmna na muta hia?
english: Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,

paite: Huai buaina hun a ding leh kidou leh kisat ni a dia ka koihkholhte?
english: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

paite: Bang lampi ah ahia khovak akikhen hiam leitung a suahlam huih adalhzak?
english: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?

paite: Kua'n ahia tui tampi luanna ding a tuilam khuak a, kekkia a dia lampi sial?
english: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm,

paite: Mihing omlouhna mun gam tung a vuah zusak ding in; mihing omlouhna, gamdai tung ah.
english: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,

paite: Lei kisia leh segawpsa lungkimsak ding; loupa hing nou khangkhesak ding?
english: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?

paite: Vuah in pa anei hia? Ahihkeileh daitui takte kua suan ahia?
english: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?

paite: Kua gil a kipan a tui khal hong pai ahia? Van daitui khal ngou, kua suahsak ahia?
english: Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?

paite: Suang bang in tuite atak a, tui thuk maite akhal hi.
english: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.

paite: "Siguk khaute na khihkhawm thei hia? zuheisuktun khaute na phel thei hia?
english: “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?

paite: Ama hunbi ah Aksi lamvak a chiamtehnate na pikhe thei hia? Ahihleh Zaangkhua leh tate na pi thei hia?
english: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?

paite: Van thupiakte na thei hia? Huai lalna lei ah na dingkhesak thei diam?
english: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?

paite: Nang tui tampi in akhuhtheihna ding in meipi kiang ah aw na suah thei diam?
english: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?

paite: Amau kiang ah, 'Hiai ah om ung,' chi a apaikhiak theihna ding un khophiate na sawlkhe thei a hia?
english: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?

paite: Sunggil lam ah pilna kua'n akoih a? Ahihkeileh lungsim kiang ah kua'n theihsiamna apia a?
english: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?

paite: Pilna in kua'n meipite asim thei dia? Van tuithawlte kua'n abokhe thei dia?
english: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky,

paite: Alompi a leivui aluan a, asakte akimatkhawm ngiungeu lai un?
english: when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?

paite: "Humpinelkai a ding in samat na betsak ding hia? Ahihkeileh humpinelkai noute gilkial na hihdam ding hia?
english: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,

paite: Akua ua aboh ua, buk ding a abukna mun ua a-om nilouh lai un?
english: when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?

paite: Va-ak a ding a an kua'n pia ahia? Anoute Pathian kiang akikou a an duh man a avakvak lai un?"
english: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?

paite: "Suangpi a gam sathakte'n nou asuaksak hun uh na thei hia? Ahihkeileh nou aneih lai uh na chiamteh thei hia?
english: “Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns?

paite: Akha chinsak zah uh na thei hia? Ahihkeileh apian hun na thei hia?
english: Can you count the months that they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they give birth?

paite: Akun ua, atate uh asuang uh, alungkhamnate uh apaikhia uhi.
english: They bow themselves. They bear their young. They end their labor pains.

paite: Atate uh deihhuaitak in a-om ua, gamlak ah akhanglian ua; akuankhia ua, ahong kik nawn kei uh.
english: Their young ones become strong. They grow up in the open field. They go out, and don’t return again.

paite: "Kua'n gam sabiltung akhahkhia a? Ahihkeileh kua'n gam sabiltunghonte aphel a?
english: “Who has set the wild donkey free? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey,

paite: Kua ahia a-inn ding a gamdai ka piak a, atenna ding a gamkeu ka bawlsak?
english: whose home I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwelling place?

paite: Khopi buai nuanua amusit a, hawltute kikounate aza kei hi.
english: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver.

paite: Mual dungte agantatna mun ahi a, huan thil hing chiteng azong hi.
english: The range of the mountains is his pasture. He searches after every green thing.

paite: "Na nna sem ding in gam bawngtal alungkim hia? Ahihkeileh na anpiakna kiang ah a-om gige diam?
english: “Will the wild ox be content to serve you? Or will he stay by your feeding trough?

paite: Leilehna ah khau in gam bawngtal na khihthei diam? Ahihkeileh na nung ah phaizangte atoktam diam?
english: Can you hold the wild ox in the furrow with his harness? Or will he till the valleys after you?

paite: Ahatna athupi ziak in, amah na muang diam? Ahihkeileh akiang ah na sepgimna na khiak diam?
english: Will you trust him, because his strength is great? Or will you leave to him your labor?

paite: Na buhchi inn ahon tut a, na buhphual a buh akaihkhawm theihna ding in amah na muang diam?
english: Will you confide in him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather the grain of your threshing floor?

paite: "Ostrik kha kisatheitak in akizap a; akhavengte leh amulte amigi hia?
english: “The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, but are they the feathers and plumage of love?

paite: Atuite lah leitung ah anusia a, leivui ah alumsak a,
english: For she leaves her eggs on the earth, warms them in the dust,

paite: Khe in asikkham thei chih a mangngilh a, ahihkeileh gamsa in asikgawp thei, chih.
english: and forgets that the foot may crush them, or that the wild animal may trample them.

paite: Amah a hilou bang in, anoute siatna ding in akhauh a; asepgimna bangmah lou himahleh, alau kei hi.
english: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear,

paite: Pathian in pilna angolhsak ziak in, theihsiamna leng ape sam kei hi.
english: because God has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.

paite: Tungsang lam a akitawisang chiang in, sakol leh atungtuangmi anuihsan.
english: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.

paite: "Sakol hatna nang piak hia? Mul nem in angawng na tuam hia?
english: “Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane?

paite: Khaukhup bang in na tawmsak hia? Ahamna thupi alauhuai ve.
english: Have you made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is awesome.

paite: Guam ah lei akhuat a, ahatna ah akipak a, mi kigalthuamte tuak ding in apaikhia.
english: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength. He goes out to meet the armed men.

paite: Lauhuai anuihsan a, alungdong kei a, namsau leng anungngat sam kei hi.
english: He mocks at fear, and is not dismayed, neither does he turn back from the sword.

paite: Amah ah thalbawm aging lengleng a, teipite zelzel leh chiangzum.
english: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin.

paite: Kihtakhuaina leh hehna in lei anawmvalh a; Pengkul aw ahi chih leng agingta sam kei hi.
english: He eats up the ground with fierceness and rage, neither does he stand still at the sound of the trumpet.

paite: Pengkul agin teng in, 'Hah' achi a, kidouna, heutute vanpiging leh kikou, gamlapi a pan athei.
english: As often as the trumpet sounds he snorts, ‘Aha!’ He smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

paite: "Na pilna in mu sangpi a lengsak in, akhate simlam ah aphalh hia?
english: “Is it by your wisdom that the hawk soars, and stretches her wings toward the south?

paite: Nang thupiak in hia muvanlai in tungsang a leng a abu aseh?
english: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up, and makes his nest on high?

paite: Suangpi tung ah ateng a, huai ah giahna anei a, suanghengte leh kulh muanhuaite ah.
english: On the cliff he dwells and makes his home, on the point of the cliff and the stronghold.

paite: Huai a kipan in mat ding amu a; amitte'n gamla amu hi.
english: From there he spies out the prey. His eyes see it afar off.

paite: Anoute'n leng sisan atawpbei ua; thah a a-omna mun, huai ah a-om hi.”
english: His young ones also suck up blood. Where the slain are, there he is.”

paite: Huai lai in Eliphaz, Teman mi in adawng a hichi in achi:
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

paite: "Mi'n nang hon houlimpih tumleh na zadah diam? Himahleh pau lou in kua a-om thei dia?
english: “If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?

paite: Ngai in, mi tampi na hilhta a, khut hatloute na hihhatta hi.
english: Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.

paite: Apuk lai in na thute'n adingsak a, khuk hatloute na kipsak hi.
english: Your words have supported him who was falling, you have made the feeble knees firm.

paite: Himahleh tu in na tung ah ahong tung a, na bah a; nang ahon khoih a, na buaita hi.
english: But now it has come to you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled.

paite: Pathian na kihtakna, na muanna hilou hia, na lametna na lampite muanhuaina?
english: Isn’t your piety your confidence? Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?

paite: Theigige in, ka hon ngen ahi, hoih hinapi a, mangthang ngei kua ahia? Ahihkeileh koi lai ah ahia midik satkhiak a a-om?
english: “Remember, now, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?

paite: Kei muh in, thulimlouhna lei lette ahi ua, buaina tuh a huai mah atte.
english: According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity and sow trouble, reap the same.

paite: Pathian hu in amangthang ua, hehna a mut a hihmang in a-om uhi.
english: By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.

paite: Humpinelkai humham leh, humpinelkai hangsan aw leh, humpinelkai tuailai hate, akitanta hi.
english: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

paite: Samat taksap ziak in humpinelkai tek amangthang a, huan humpinelkaipi noute adalhzak uhi.
english: The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.

paite: "Tu in aguk in thil ka kiang a hong tung ka bil in huai a huauna asangta hi.
english: “Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.

paite: Zan mengmuhna a kipan angaihtuahnate ah, mite nakpitak a a-ihmut san lai un,
english: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,

paite: ka tung ah launa ahong tung a, linna in ka guhte tengteng asing hi.
english: fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.

paite: Huai lai in ka mai ah kha apai a; ka chimul adinghta hi.
english: Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up.

paite: Ka dingh kinken a, himahleh huai a kilatdan ka theikak theita kei a; alim tuh ka mit ma ah a-om a; daihna a-om a, aw ka za hi,
english: It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes. Silence, then I heard a voice, saying,

paite: Pathian sang in sithei mihing dikzaw ding hia? Abawlpa sang in mihing siangthouzaw ding hia? chi in.
english: ‘Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?

paite: Ngai in, asikhate ah muanna akoih kei a; angelte hai in angoh hi:
english: Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.

paite: Tungman inn a teng amaute hi sem na un chia, asuangphum leivui a om a, leikha ma a chimsia.
english: How much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!

paite: Zingsang leh nitak kikal in hihsiat in a-om ua; theih louh hial in tangtawn in amangthang uhi.
english: Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.

paite: Amau sung a apuanin khau uh bohkhiak touh hilou hia? Pilna tel lou in asi uhi."
english: Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’

paite: Huai lou in TOUPA'N Job adawng a, hichi in achi:
english: Moreover Yahweh answered Job,

paite: "Kuapeuh awlmoh nei lou in thil Bangkim hihthei akiselpih diam? Kuapeuh Pathian kiselpih, huai tuh amah dawngsak un."
english: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”

paite: Job in TOUPA adawng a, hichi in achi:
english: Then Job answered Yahweh,

paite: "Ngai in, bangmah ka hita kei a; bangchi in ka hon dawng dia? Ka kam ah ka khut ka koih.
english: “Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.

paite: Khatvei ka pauta a, ka dawng kei ding; ahi, nihvei himahleh ka pau nawn kei ding.”
english: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”

paite: Toupa'n pingpei a kipan in Job adawng a, hichi in achi.
english: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind:

paite: "Kipasalsak inla, tu in na kawng gak in. Nang a kipan ka hon phut dia, kei kiang ah na hon puang ding hi.
english: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.

paite: Ka vaihawmna bangmah lou a koih ding na hiam? Siam na tantheihna dia, kei hon mohpaih ding na hi hia?
english: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?

paite: Ahihkeileh Pathian bang in ban na nei hia? Amah bang in aw in vanpi na gingsak thei hia?
english: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?

paite: Tu in nang hoihkim leh zahna in kizem in; zahna leh lalna in kivan in.
english: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.

paite: Na hehna dimlette sungkhia in; michih kisatheite en inla, hihniam in.
english: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.

paite: Michih kisathei en inla, kainiam in; adinna uah migiloute tuanchil in.
english: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.

paite: Leivui ah amaute selkhawm in; mundai ah amai uh kan in.
english: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.

paite: Huchi in na khut taklam in nang ahondam thei chih ka hon thei ding.
english: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.

paite: "Ngai dih, nang ka hon siam bang a ka siam, tu in behemoth en in; bawngtal bang in loupa ane hi.
english: “See now behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.

paite: En in tu in, akawng ah ahatna a-om a, agilpi thate ah ahatna a-om hi
english: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.

paite: Sidar sing bang in amei atangsak a, apheite thaguite phankhawm in a-om hi.
english: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.

paite: Aguhte dal lawng ahi a, aguh leh tangte siktawn bang ahi.
english: His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.

paite: "Pathian lampite amakai lianpen ahi, amah bawlpa kia in anamsau amah kiang lam naih ding in abawl thei ding.
english: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.

paite: Chihtaktak in mualte'n amah an apuak ua; gamsate tengteng mawlna mun ah.
english: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.

paite: Singbawk limte nuai ah alum a, pumpeng kawm leh chiknawng lak ah.
english: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.

paite: Tui lili singte'n alim un akhuh ua; lui gei singnah kaite'n atuam kimvel uhi.
english: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.

paite: Ngai in, lui adimletleh, aling kei a; akam chiang pha hial in Jordan khang mahleh, amuang hi.
english: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.

paite: Akiven lai in kuapeuh in amah sikkawi in aman diam, thang in anak avut pailet diam?”
english: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?

paite: “Ngakuai in Leviathan na kaikhe thei diam? Ahihkeileh akhau in alei na sawntum thei diam?
english: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?

paite: Anak sung ah khauhual na thun thei diam? Ahihkeileh sikkawi in ahaizek na vut pailet thei diam?
english: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?

paite: Na kiang ah thilnget tampi abawl diam? Ahihkeileh na kiang ah thu nemte agen diam?
english: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?

paite: Tangtawn a ding in amah sikha dia na laktheihna ding in, nang toh thukhun abawl diam?
english: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?

paite: Vasa toh bang in amah toh na mawl diam? Ahihkeileh na sikhanute a ding in amah na hen diam?
english: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?

paite: Ngaman mite'n amah sumsinna ding in abawl ding uam? Sumsin mite lak ah amah azuak ding uam?
english: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?

paite: Siklen in avun na dimsak thei diam, ahihkeileh alu ngalingte in?
english: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?

paite: Atung ah na khut koih in; kidouna theigige in, huchi in na hih nawn kei ding hi.
english: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.

paite: "Ngai in, amah lametna bangmah lou ahi; amah muh mahmah in mi paihkhiak in a-om kei dia hia?
english: Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?

paite: Amah hihhalh ngam khop ding in kuamah ahang kei; ka ma a dingh kua ahia le?
english: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?

paite: Amah ka dit ding, ka kiang ah kua'n ape masa a le? Van nuai a om peuhmah kei' a ahi.
english: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.

paite: "Aguh-le-tang thu ah ka dai kei ding, ahatna mahmah leh, apum kilawmna ah leng.
english: “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.

paite: Apuansilh tungnung kua'n asuahsak thei dia? Akamkaih thuah nih sung ah kua ahong pai dia?
english: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who will come within his jaws?

paite: Amai kongkhakte kua'n ahong thei dia? Aha kimvel ah lauhuaina a-om.
english: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.

paite: Alip hattakte akisaktheihna ahi, namkipsa bang a khakkhum ahi.
english: Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.

paite: Akal ua huihzam alut theihlouhna ding in, khat in adang anaih mahmah.
english: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

paite: Khat leh adang akizom ua, akisoumat ua, khen theih louh in a-om uh.
english: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.

paite: Ahahchhiaite'n avaksak a, amitte zingsang mitvunte bang ahi.
english: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

paite: Akam a pan meikuangte apawtkhia, mei-ekte atawmkhia hi.
english: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.

paite: Anakvangte a kipan in meikhu apawt a, halsianna bel leh chiklak loupa kang a kipan bang in.
english: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.

paite: "Ahu in suang akuangsak a, akam a pan meikuang apawtkhia hi.
english: His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.

paite: Angawng ah hatna a-om gige a, ama ah lauhuaina alam hi.
english: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.

paite: Asa thate akizomkhawm ua, atung ah akip ua; hihtat theih in a-om kei uh.
english: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.

paite: Alungtang suang bang in akip a; ahi, buhgawina suang nuainung bang ahi.
english: His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.

paite: Amah athoh chiang in, mihatte alau uh; lauh luatna ziak in omdan ding athei kei uh.
english: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.

paite: Mi'n amah namsau in satleh, aphatuam kei hi; teipi hiam, thal hiam, sikmuk zum hiam in leng.
english: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.

paite: Buhpawl bang in sik asim a, sing muatsa bang in dalsik.
english: He counts iron as straw, and bronze as rotten wood.

paite: Thal in amah ataisak thei kei ding; amah lak ah vaisuanglot suangte buhpawl asuak hi.
english: The arrow can’t make him flee. Sling stones are like chaff to him.

paite: "Khetbukte buhpawl bang a sim ahi. Teipi ging anuihsan hi.
english: Clubs are counted as stubble. He laughs at the rushing of the javelin.

paite: Anuailam pangte belpei ahi, buannawi tung ah buhkhetna chiang bang in akiphah hi.
english: His undersides are like sharp potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.

paite: Tui thukte belpi sou bolhbolh ding in abawl a, tuipi nuh theih bawm in abawl hi.
english: He makes the deep to boil like a pot. He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.

paite: Anung ah lampi avaksak a; tui thuk samkang nei asa uhi.
english: He makes a path shine after him. One would think the deep had white hair.

paite: Leitung ah amah bang a lauh nei lou a-om kei a,
english: On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.

paite: Thil sang chiteng a-en a, kisathei tapate tengteng tung ah kumpipa ahi."
english: He sees everything that is high. He is king over all the sons of pride.”

paite: Huchi in Job in TOUPA dawng hichi in achi.
english: Then Job answered Yahweh:

paite: "Thil bangkim na hihthei chih leh nang thiltup kham theih ahi kei chih ka thei hi.
english: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.

paite: Hiai thuhilhna theihna tel lou a sel kua ahia? Huaiziak in ka theihsiam louh, ka theih louh, kei a dia thillamdang luate ka genkhia hi.
english: You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand, things too wonderful for me, which I didn’t know.

paite: "Za in, ka hon ngen ahi, ka pau ding; nang ka hon phut ding, kei lam ah nang puang in, na hon chi hi.
english: You said, ‘Listen, now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you will answer me.’

paite: Zakna bil in nang ka hon za a; himahleh tu in ka mit in ka hon mu a,
english: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you.

paite: Huaiziak in ka kikih a, leivui leh meivu ah ka kisik hi."
english: Therefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huchi a TOUPA'N Job kiang a hiai thute agen khit in, TOUPA'N Teman mi Eliphaz kiang ah, "Ka hehna nang tung leh na lawm nihte tung ah akuang, ka sikha Job bang a noute'n ka tanchin thil dik na gen louh ziak un," achi hi.
english: It was so, that after Yahweh had spoken these words to Job, Yahweh said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled against you, and against your two friends; for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.

paite: "Huaiziak in tu in, bawngtal sagih leh belamtal sagih la unla, ka sikha Job kiang ah hoh unla, nou a ding in halmang thillat lan un; huchi in noute a ding in ka sikha Job athum ding a; amah vang in ka sang dia, huchi in na haina uh dungzui in na tung uah ka hih kei ding; ka sikha Job bang in lah ka tanchin thil dik na gen kei uh," chi in.
english: Now therefore, take to yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will accept him, that I not deal with you according to your folly. For you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.”

paite: Huchi in Teman mi Eliphaz leh Shuah mi Bildad leh Naamath mi Zophar akuan ua, TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in ahihta uhi. TOUPA'N Job asangta hi.
english: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did what Yahweh commanded them, and Yahweh accepted Job.

paite: Alawmte a dia Job athum zoh in TOUPA'N Job saltanna akiheisak a, TOUPA'N Job ama a aneih zahnih apeta hi.
english: Yahweh restored Job’s prosperity when he prayed for his friends. Yahweh gave Job twice as much as he had before.

paite: Huai lai in akiang ah, a-unaute tengteng leh asanggamnute tengteng leh tuma lam a amel theihsa tengteng leh a-insung a tanghou amah toh nete ahong pai ua, amah anem ua, TOUPA'N atung a hoih lou atunsak tengteng tungtang thu ah amah alungmuan uhi. Michih in leng ama sum leh michih in dangka-eng bilbah apia uhi.
english: Then all his brothers, all his sisters, and all those who had been of his acquaintance before, came to him and ate bread with him in his house. They comforted him, and consoled him concerning all the evil that Yahweh had brought on him. Everyone also gave him a piece of money, and everyone a ring of gold.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Job tawpna lam a kipatna lam sang in anak vualzawl zaw hi. Belam singkhat-le-sangli leh sangawngsau sangguk leh bawngtal sangkhat leh sabengtungnu sangkhat anei hi.
english: So Yahweh blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.

paite: Tapa sagih leh tanu thum leng anei hi.
english: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

paite: Amasapen, Jemima achi a; anihna min, Kezia; athumna min, Keren-happuk.
english: He called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren Happuch.

paite: Huchi in gamsung pumpi ah Job tanute bang a melhoih a-om kei uh; apa un a-unaute lak ah goutan amaute apia hi.
english: In all the land were no women found so beautiful as the daughters of Job. Their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.

paite: Huai nung in Job, kum za-le-sawmli adam a, atapate leh atapate' tapate, khang lina tan amu hi.
english: After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.

paite: Huchi in Job atek mahmah a, a-upat tak ziak in asita hi.
english: So Job died, being old and full of days.

paite: "Tu in sam in; nang hon dawng kua a-om a? Misiangthoute lak ah akua lam na nga dia?
english: “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?

paite: Lungzinna in lah mihai athat a, huan thikna in mimawl athat sek hi.
english: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.

paite: Mihai zungkai ka muta a; himahleh thakhat in atenna aka hamsiat hi.
english: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

paite: Bitna a kipan gamlapi ah atate a-om ua, kongpi ah hihgawp in a-om uh, kuamah amaute hunkhe ding a-om kei uhi.
english: His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,

paite: Agilkial in ling lak a kipan nangawn a-an kaihkhawm agaihsak a, suamhat in aneih-le-lam anawmvalhsak hi.
english: whose harvest the hungry eat up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.

paite: Gimthuakna leivui a kipan in ahong pawt kei a, lei a kipan in buaina leng ahong dawnkhe sam kei hi.
english: For affliction doesn’t come out of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;

paite: Himahleh mihing buai ding mah apiang ahi, mei-ekte atoulen bang in.
english: but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

paite: "Himahleh ke'n ahihleh, Pathian lam ah ka zong ding a, Pathian kiang ah ka thu ka koih ding hi.
english: “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,

paite: Thil thupite hihpa leh zonkhiak theih louh; sim zoh louh thillamdangte,
english: who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;

paite: leitung a vuah pepa leh, loute tung a tui sawlpa.
english: who gives rain on the earth, and sends waters on the fields;

paite: Huchi in ama'n aniamsate tungsang ah akoihtou a; misi suunte muanna ah atawisang hi.
english: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.

paite: Zekhem hatte lunggelte bangmah lou asuaksak a, huchi in akhutte un athiltup uh ahihthei kei uhi.
english: He frustrates the plans of the crafty, so that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.

paite: Mipilte akhemhatna un aman a, mihoihloute thilgel athalpaihsak hi.
english: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.

paite: Sun lai in khomialna athuak ua, zan lai bang in suntang lai in amai maimah uhi.
english: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.

paite: Himahleh ama'n gentheite mihatte kam leh khut a kipan leh tasamte mahmah namsau a kipan ahondam hi.
english: But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.

paite: Huchi in mizawng in lametna anei а, thulimlouhna in akam ahumsak hi.
english: So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.

paite: "Ngai in, Pathian in abawlhoih mi in nuam asa hi; huaiziak in Bangkim hihthei sawina musit ke'n.
english: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.

paite: Ama'n lah meima abawl a, atuam a, aliamsak a, akhut in adamsak hi.
english: For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.

paite: Buaina guk ah ahon suaktasak ding a; ahi, sagih ah gilou in nang ahon khoih kei ding hi.
english: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.

paite: Kial chiang in nang sihna a kipan ahon tan ding; namsau thilhihtheihna a kipan, kidou chiang in.
english: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.

paite: Kam sung a leizepna a kipan ahon sel ding a; siatna ahong tun chiang in na lau sam kei ding hi.
english: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes.

paite: Siatna leh kialna ah na nui ding a, lei gamsate na kihta kei ding hi.
english: You will laugh at destruction and famine, neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth.

paite: Gam a suangte toh na kithuahtheih ding ziak un; huan gam a gamsate nang toh na kituak ding uhi.
english: For you will be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field will be at peace with you.

paite: "Na puanin muang in a-om chih na thei ding a; na ganhuang na veh ding a, bangmah kim lou a-om kei ding hi.
english: You will know that your tent is in peace. You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing.

paite: Na chite leng athupi ding a, na suante lei a loupa bang in a-om ding uh chih na thei ding hi.
english: You will know also that your offspring will be great, your offspring as the grass of the earth.

paite: Kum ching in na hankhuk na zuan ding a, ahun a buhlak a-om bang in.
english: You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.

paite: Ngai in, hiai thu i zongta ua, adik mah ahi, za in na hoihna ding in thei in."
english: Behold, we have researched it. It is so. Hear it, and know it for your good.”

paite: Huchi in Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
english: Then Job answered,

paite: "Aw ka lungzinna kibuk thei hi henla, ka tuahsiatna selbukna ah kikoihkhawm thei hileh!
english: “Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!

paite: Tu in tuipite a piaunel sang in agikzaw ding: huaiziak in ka thugente leng akhauh hi.
english: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas, therefore my words have been rash.

paite: Bangkim hihthei thalte lah ka sung ah a-om ngal a, agu uh huai a kipan a ka kha in adawnvek; kei dou ding in Pathian mulkimhuainate akivual uhi.
english: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in array against me.

paite: "Anek ding loupa mu, gam sabiltung aham a hia? Ahihkeileh gan an mu bawngtal aham a hia?
english: Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass? Or does the ox low over his fodder?

paite: Chi tel lou in gim nei lou akine thei dia hia? Ahihkeileh aktuida ah limna mawngmawng a-om a hia?
english: Can that which has no flavor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

paite: Ka kha in amaute akhoih nuam kei; kei a ding in an kihhuai bang ahi uhi.
english: My soul refuses to touch them. They are as loathsome food to me.

paite: "Aw ka nget tang thei leng zaw; ka thil deih Pathian in hon phalleh zaw.
english: “Oh that I might have my request, that God would grant the thing that I long for,

paite: Kei hon hihgawp ding in Pathian deihlam hi lai henla; akhut zan in, kei hon satkhe maileh.
english: even that it would please God to crush me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

paite: Huchi in lungmuanna ka nei lai dia; ahi, damlou natna ah ka kipak ding hi; Mi Siangthou thute ka kitheihmohbawl ngal kei a.
english: Let it still be my consolation, yes, let me exult in pain that doesn’t spare, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.

paite: Ka hatna bang ahia, ka ngak ding? Huan ka beina bang ahia, ka kuhkal ding?
english: What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should be patient?

paite: Ka hatna suangte hatna hi hia? Ahihkeileh ka sa dalsik hia?
english: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of bronze?

paite: Kei ah panpihna a-om het kei a, kei a kipan theihsiamna hawlmang in.
english: Isn’t it that I have no help in me, that wisdom is driven away from me?

paite: "Bah dia mansa a om kiang ah alawm in siamna a-etsak ding ahi kei maw; huchi lou in Bangkim hihthei kihtakna tawpsan ahi kei ding maw.
english: “To him who is ready to faint, kindness should be shown from his friend; even to him who forsakes the fear of the Almighty.

paite: Luita bang in ka unaute alepchiah uh; luita mangthang luanna bang in.
english: My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that pass away;

paite: Huai tui khal ziak a vom a; huai a vukkhal akisel.
english: which are black by reason of the ice, in which the snow hides itself.

paite: Alum hun chiang in atuimang ua, asat chiang in amun ua kipan amangthang uhi.
english: In the dry season, they vanish. When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

paite: Huai lampi a khualzinte a pial ua, bangmah omlouhna mun ah apaitou ua, amangthang uh.
english: The caravans that travel beside them turn away. They go up into the waste, and perish.

paite: Tema khualzinte'n azong ua, Sheba pawlte'n alamen uh.
english: The caravans of Tema looked. The companies of Sheba waited for them.

paite: Akilamet hang un azahlak uh; huai lam ah ava pai ua azahlak uh.
english: They were distressed because they were confident. They came there, and were confounded.

paite: Tu in bangmah na hi ngal kei ua; mulkimhuaina na mu ua, na lau uhi.
english: For now you are nothing. You see a terror, and are afraid.

paite: Kei hon pia un? Ahihkeileh na neih-le-lam ua kipan in kei a ding in thilpiak lan un, ka chi hia?
english: Did I ever say, ‘Give to me’? or, ‘Offer a present for me from your substance’?

paite: Ahihkeileh, melma khut a pan hon tan un, mihat khut a pan hon hukhia un ka chi hia?
english: or, ‘Deliver me from the adversary’s hand’? or, ‘Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors’?

paite: "Hon sinsak in, huan ka dai ding: ka diklouhna hon theisiamsak un.
english: “Teach me, and I will hold my peace. Cause me to understand my error.

paite: Thudikna thute hat hi nah e: himahleh miselna in bang aselphou a?
english: How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove?

paite: Thute selphou ding a um na hi uhia? Chimoh mi thugente huih bang ahi chih thei in.
english: Do you intend to reprove words, since the speeches of one who is desperate are as wind?

paite: Ahi, pa neiloute tung ah ai na san ua, na lawm uh sumsinna van in na bawl uh.
english: Yes, you would even cast lots for the fatherless, and make merchandise of your friend.

paite: Tu in hehpih in hon en un; na ma uah thuzuau ka gen kei a.
english: Now therefore be pleased to look at me, for surely I will not lie to your face.

paite: Kik nawn un ka hon ngen ahi, diklouhna om kei hen; ahi, kik nawn un, ka thu adik ahi.
english: Please return. Let there be no injustice. Yes, return again. My cause is righteous.

paite: Ka lei ah diklouhna a-om hia? Ka lei in thil hoih lou atheikak thei kei dia hia?"
english: Is there injustice on my tongue? Can’t my taste discern mischievous things?

paite: "Leitung ah mihing a ding in kidouna a-om kei maw? Anite kilohmi nite bang ahi kei a hia?
english: “Isn’t a man forced to labor on earth? Aren’t his days like the days of a hired hand?

paite: Limliap deih mahmah sikha bang in, aloh lamen kilohmi bang in.
english: As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow, as a hireling who looks for his wages,

paite: Huai bang in bangmah lou khate nei ding a bawl ka hi, huan kei a ding in zan chimhuaite seh ahi.
english: so I am made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.

paite: Ka lup chiang in, chikchiang in ka thou dia? ka chi a; himahleh zan asawt hi; lehlam lehlam ah nisuah matan kilumlet in ka om hi.
english: When I lie down, I say, ‘When will I arise, and the night be gone?’ I toss and turn until the dawning of the day.

paite: Ka sa than leh leivui khal in atuam a; ka vun kimat in apuakkham hi.
english: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.

paite: Ka nite siamganmi khohthei sang in akinzaw a, lametna bei a zatbei ahi.
english: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.

paite: "Aw ka hinna huih ahi chih theigige in; ka mit in hoih amu nawn kei ding hi.
english: Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.

paite: Kei hon mu mit in ahon en thei nawnta kei ding a; ka tung ah na mitte a-om ding ua himahleh ka omta kei ding hi.
english: The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.

paite: Meipi mangthang a-om nawn louh bang in, huchi in kuapeuh Sheol a paisuk ahong paitou nawnta kei uhi.
english: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away, so he who goes down to Sheol will come up no more.

paite: A-inn ah akik nawn kei ding a, amun in amah athei nawn kei ding hi.
english: He will return no more to his house, neither will his place know him any more.

paite: Huaiziak in ka kam ka khou kei ding a; ka lungsim gimna ah thu ka gen ding; haksatna ah ka kha ka phun ding hi.
english: “Therefore I will not keep silent. I will speak in the anguish of my spirit. I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

paite: "Tuipi ka hi hia, ahihkeileh tua tuipi ngapi lian ka hi a hia, huchi a kei na hon chin nak?
english: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?

paite: Ka lupna in hon lungmuan ding a, ka tutna nem in ka phunna azangkhaisak ding, ka chih chiang in.
english: When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me. My couch will ease my complaint,’

paite: Huai chiang in mang in na hon lausak a, mengmuhna in na hon mulkimsak hi.
english: then you scare me with dreams and terrify me through visions,

paite: Huchi in ka kha in heklup leh sihna atel a, hiai ka guhte sang in.
english: so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.

paite: Ka hinna ka chimtak a; ka hing gige kei ding, hon omsak maimai un; ka nite lah bangmah lou ahi ngal a.
english: I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.

paite: "Mihing bang ahia, hichi tel a na pahtawi ding a, amah tung a na lungtang na koih ding?
english: What is man, that you should magnify him, that you should set your mind on him,

paite: Zingsang teng a amah na veh a, mitphiat kal chih a amah na ettel ding?
english: that you should visit him every morning, and test him every moment?

paite: Bang tan vei kei hon lehngatsan lou ding na hia, bang tan vei ka chil ka nawmvalh matan hon omsak maimai lou ding na hia?
english: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?

paite: Na khial hi taleng, na tung ah bang ka hih a, Aw mite chingpa nangmah? Bangziak a nang a dia chiamtehna bang a hon koih na hia, huchi a keimah a dia puakgik ka hih maimah?
english: If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men? Why have you set me as a mark for you, so that I am a burden to myself?

paite: Bangziak a ka tatlekna ngaidam lou a, ka thulimlouhna lamang lou oi? Kei tu in leivui a lum ding ka hi a; kuhkaltak in na hon zong dia, himahleh ka omta kei ding hi."
english: Why do you not pardon my disobedience, and take away my iniquity? For now will I lie down in the dust. You will seek me diligently, but I will not be.”

paite: Huchi in Shuah mi Bildad in adawng a, hichi in achi:
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

paite: "Bang tan hiai thilte gen ding na hia? Bang tan na kam a thute huih hat bang ding ahi ua?
english: “How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?

paite: Pathian in vaihawmna ahekkawi a hia? Ahihkeileh Bangkim hihthei in dikna ahekkawi ahia?
english: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?

paite: Atung ah na tate akhial ua, huai tatlekna ziak a akhut a amaute apikhiakleh,
english: If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.

paite: Pathian lam kuhkaltak a na zon a, huai Bangkim hihthei kiang a na thilnget na bawlleh;
english: If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.

paite: Na sianthou a na dikleh; nang ziak in tu in ka khanglou dia, na diktatna omna alohchingsak ding hi.
english: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.

paite: Na kipatna neu mahleh, na tawpna nanung lam nakpi in athupi ding hi.
english: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.

paite: "Huaiziak in ka hon ngen hi, hun masa thu kan inla, apipute un ana zonkhiak uh lam ah kisuk in.
english: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.

paite: Ei lah zan a lel i hi ua, bangmah i thei kei uh, leitung ah i nite uh lah limliap ahi a.
english: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)

paite: Amaute'n nang ahon sinsak un, ahon hilh un, alungtang ua kipan in thute agen kei ding ua hia?
english: Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?

paite: Buannawi lou in phaiphek akhangkhe thei a hia? Tui lou in loupa akhangthei a hia?
english: “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?

paite: Hing a om a, satpuk louh ahih lai in, loupa dangte ma in avuai nak hi.
english: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.

paite: Huai bang mah in Pathian mangngilhte tengteng lampi ahi; Pathian limsakloumi lametna amangthang ding:
english: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,

paite: Amuanna akitan ding a, akingakna maimomlen ahi hi.
english: whose confidence will break apart, whose trust is a spider’s web.

paite: A-inn tung ah akingai dia, himahleh adingh kei ding; huai ah alen tinten ding a, himahleh apang sawt kei ding hi.
english: He will lean on his house, but it will not stand. He will cling to it, but it will not endure.

paite: "Nisuah ma in ahing a, ahuan ah aselte amengkhia uhi.
english: He is green before the sun. His shoots go out along his garden.

paite: Azungte leivum kim ah azam ua, suangte omna mun ah ahing hi.
english: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.

paite: Amun a kipan lakmang hileh, huchi in amah akitheihmohbawl ding a, Ka hon mu ngei kei, chi in.
english: If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’

paite: Ngai in, hiai alampi kipahna ahi a, lei a kipan adangte ahong suak ding uh.
english: Behold, this is the joy of his way. Out of the earth, others will spring.

paite: Ngai in, Pathian in mihoihkim apaikhe kei ding, gilou hih mite leng atungding sam kei ding hi.
english: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.

paite: Na kam nuih in ahon dimsak lai dia, na mukte kikouna in.
english: He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.

paite: Hon mudahte zumna in akhuh ding a; gilou puanin a-omta kei ding hi.”
english: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked will be no more.”

paite: Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
english: Then Job answered,

paite: "Chihtaktak in huchi ahi chih ka thei hi, himahleh Pathian lak ah mihing bangchi in adik thei dia?
english: “Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?

paite: Amah kiselpih a-utlam ahihleh, sangkhat lak a khatvei zong amah adawng thei kei ding hi.
english: If he is pleased to contend with him, he can’t answer him one time in a thousand.

paite: Amah lungtang in apil a, hatna in thil ahihthei ahi, amah dou in kua akikhauhsak in, alohchingta a oi?
english: God is wise in heart, and mighty in strength. Who has hardened himself against him and prospered?

paite: "Mualte asuan a, athei kei ua, heh a amaute alumleh lai in.
english: He removes the mountains, and they don’t know it, when he overturns them in his anger.

paite: Amun a kipan in lei asing a, huan huai a khuamte aling uhi.
english: He shakes the earth out of its place. Its pillars tremble.

paite: Nisa thu apia a, asuak kei; aksite abilhkhum ngiungiau hi.
english: He commands the sun and it doesn’t rise, and seals up the stars.

paite: Amah kia'n vante aphalhkhia a, tuipi kihot tung ah apai hi.
english: He alone stretches out the heavens, and treads on the waves of the sea.

paite: Ama'n Zangkhua, Zuheisuktun, Siguk leh simlam aksi munte abawl hi.
english: He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the rooms of the south.

paite: Ama'n sui theih vual louh thil thupite sim zoh louh thillamdangte ahih hi.
english: He does great things past finding out; yes, marvelous things without number.

paite: "Ngai in, ka kiang ah apai a, amah ka mu kei, apai lailai a, himahleh amah ka mu kei hi.
english: Behold, he goes by me, and I don’t see him. He passes on also, but I don’t perceive him.

paite: Ngai in, alamang a, amah kua'n akham thei dia? Bang hih na hia? Kua'n akiang ah achi dia?
english: Behold, he snatches away. Who can hinder him? Who will ask him, ‘What are you doing?’

paite: Pathian in ahehna alakik kei ding; Rahab panpih mite amah nuai ah akun petmah uhi.
english: “God will not withdraw his anger. The helpers of Rahab stoop under him.

paite: Bangchi phet a tawmzaw in amah ka dawng in, amah toh ngaihtuah ding in ka thute ka telkhe dia hia?
english: How much less will I answer him, and choose my words to argue with him?

paite: Diktat himah leng amah ka dawng kei ding hi; ka thukhentu kiang ah thilngetna ka bawl thei lel ding hi.
english: Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn’t answer him. I would make supplication to my judge.

paite: "Amah sam in hon dawng mahleh; ka aw angaikhia chih ka um kei ding hi.
english: If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.

paite: Huihpi in ahon kitamsak a, asan om lou in ka liamnate apungsak hi.
english: For he breaks me with a storm, and multiplies my wounds without cause.

paite: Ka nak ahon phal kei a, himahleh thangpaihna in hon dimsak hi.
english: He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness.

paite: Hatna thu gen leng, ngai in, Amah ahat hi, vaihawmna thu, kua'n hun ahon pe dia?
english: If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, ‘Who,’ says he, ‘will summon me?’

paite: Kidiktatsak leng, ka kam mah in ahon mohpaih hi, hoihkim ka hi, kichi taleng, hoih lou in ahon telsak ding hi.
english: Though I am righteous, my own mouth will condemn me. Though I am blameless, it will prove me perverse.

paite: Hoihkim mah leng, ka kilimsak kei; ka hinna ka musit hi.
english: I am blameless. I don’t respect myself. I despise my life.

paite: "Akibang ahi vek a; huaiziak in ke'n hoihkim leh gilou ahihse tuak, ka chi hi.
english: “It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.

paite: Jepna in thakhat in thatleh, mihoih thuakna anuihsan ding hi.
english: If the scourge kills suddenly, he will mock at the trial of the innocent.

paite: Lei migilou khut a piak a a-om chiang in huai a vaihawmte amaituam a; amah ahihkeileh, kua ahita dia?
english: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If not he, then who is it?

paite: Tu in ka nite laihawmmi sang in akinzaw a ataimang ua, hoih amu kei uh.
english: “Now my days are swifter than a runner. They flee away. They see no good.

paite: Long kinte bang in apaimang ua, muvanlai samat tung a ngumkiak bang in.
english: They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.

paite: Ka phunna ka mangngilh dia, ka mel lungkham ka pai dia, ka kipak ding, chi leng.
english: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face, and cheer up,’

paite: "Ka lungkhamna tengteng ka lau a, hoih na hon sa kei ding chih ka thei hi.
english: I am afraid of all my sorrows. I know that you will not hold me innocent.

paite: Mohpaih in ka om dia; bangziak a athawn a semgim ka hia?
english: I will be condemned. Why then do I labor in vain?

paite: Vuk tui in kisil in, ka khutte siangsak kei leng;
english: If I wash myself with snow, and cleanse my hands with lye,

paite: Hinapi in phaizang ah na hon pailut dia, keimah puante'n ahon kih ding uhi.
english: yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes will abhor me.

paite: "Kei bang in amah lah mihing ahi kei a, amah ka dawn theih a, vaihawmna a ka hohkhawm theihna ding un.
english: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.

paite: Ka kikal uah kou gel hon mattheihna ding in, thulai genmi a-om kei hi.
english: There is no umpire between us, that might lay his hand on us both.

paite: Kei a pan in achiang lamang henla akihtakhuaina in kei hon lausak kei hen.
english: Let him take his rod away from me. Let his terror not make me afraid;

paite: Huai chiang in thu ka gen dia, amah ka lau kei ding: keimah ah huchibang ka hi ngal kei hi."
english: then I would speak, and not fear him, for I am not so in myself.

paite: Pethuel tapa Joel kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi:
english: Yahweh’s word that came to Joel, the son of Pethuel.

paite: Putekte aw, hiai za un; hiai, nou hun lai leh na pute uh hun lai in a-om kha ngeita a hia?
english: Hear this, you elders, and listen, all you inhabitants of the land! Has this ever happened in your days, or in the days of your fathers?

paite: Huai pen na tate uh hilh unla, na tate un amau tate hilh uhenla, ata nawnte un suan dang hilhsawn zel uhen.
english: Tell your children about it, and have your children tell their children, and their children, another generation.

paite: Singnget khaupe in anek bang teng khaukhuphon in ane a, khaukhuphon in anek bang teng khaupehon in ane a; khaupehon in anek bang teng khaupenouhon in ane khinta hi.
english: What the swarming locust has left, the great locust has eaten. What the great locust has left, the grasshopper has eaten. What the grasshopper has left, the caterpillar has eaten.

paite: Nou zukhamte aw, halh unla kap un; uain dawn tengteng aw, a- uain khum ziak in kap vongvong un; na kam ua kipan lah uain lakmang ahita ngal a.
english: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine, for it is cut off from your mouth.

paite: Nam hat mahmah, sim seng louh in ka gam ahong douta uh, ahate humpinelkai liante ha ahi a, humpinelkai pite hapak anei hi.
english: For a nation has come up on my land, strong, and without number. His teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he has the fangs of a lioness.

paite: Ka grepgui ahihsia a, ka theipi sing hawng akheuh a, akheuhsiang vek a, apaimang a; ahiangte akiatngou vek hi.
english: He has laid my vine waste, and stripped my fig tree. He has stripped its bark, and thrown it away. Its branches are made white.

paite: Nungak in, sai-ip puan teng a, atuailai pasal asuun bang in kap vongvong un.
english: Mourn like a virgin dressed in sackcloth for the husband of her youth!

paite: Tangbuang latte, dawn ding latte TOUPA' inn a kipan hihman ahi a; siampu TOUPA nasemte alungkham uhi.
english: The meal offering and the drink offering are cut off from Yahweh’s house. The priests, Yahweh’s ministers, mourn.

paite: Lou hihsiat ahi a, gam alungkham a; buh hihsiat ahi a, uain thak akang a, sathau aginata kei hi.
english: The field is laid waste. The land mourns, for the grain is destroyed, The new wine has dried up, and the oil languishes.

paite: Aw, nou lounei mite aw, suun unla; aw, nou grepgui kem mite aw, huit buh leh barli buh ziak in dah in mau tuaituai un; lou a buhlak ding amangthang vekta hi.
english: Be confounded, you farmers! Wail, you vineyard keepers, for the wheat and for the barley; for the harvest of the field has perished.

paite: Grepgui avuai a, theipi kung avuai a; theibuhfai zung, tum leh epul theikung, lou a sing tengteng leng avulta hi; mihing tate lak a kipahna lah avuaimangta ngal a.
english: The vine has dried up, and the fig tree withered— the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all of the trees of the field are withered; for joy has withered away from the sons of men.

paite: Nou siampute aw, sai-ip puan teng unla kap un; nou maitam nasem mite aw, chiau vengvung un; nou ka Pathian nasem mite aw, hong pai unla, sai-ip puan silh in zankhua in hong lum un; na Pathian inn ua pan tangbuang lat leh dawn ding lat lah kham ahita ngal a.
english: Put on sackcloth and mourn, you priests! Wail, you ministers of the altar. Come, lie all night in sackcloth, you ministers of my God, for the meal offering and the drink offering are withheld from your God’s house.

paite: An ngawl hun tang siangthou in, khawmpi taksuak bawl unla, TOUPA na Pathian inn ah putekte leh hiai gam a teng mi tengteng pikhawm unla, TOUPA sam un.
english: Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly. Gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land to the house of Yahweh, your God, and cry to Yahweh.

paite: Huai ni atung agik hi; TOUPA ni lah anai ngal a, Bangkim hihtheipa a kipan manthatna ahong tung ding hi.
english: Alas for the day! For the day of Yahweh is at hand, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty.

paite: Ka mitmuh in nek ding hihman ahi kei a hia, ahi, i nopna leh i kipahna i Pathian inn a kipan hihman ahi kei a hia?
english: Isn’t the food cut off before our eyes, joy and gladness from the house of our God?

paite: Leikhal nuai ah haichitang amuat a; pangte lah akigawp a, buh innte phel in a-om a, abuhte avuaita uhi.
english: The seeds rot under their clods. The granaries are laid desolate. The barns are broken down, for the grain has withered.

paite: Gante nak thum hi na tel uh e! Bawnghonte abuaizak ua, loupa hing mun aneih louh ziak un; ahi, belamhonte asegawp uhi.
english: How the animals groan! The herds of livestock are perplexed, because they have no pasture. Yes, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.

paite: Aw, TOUPA ka hon sam hi, mei in gamdai gam loupa mun akangsiangta a, meikuang in gam a sing tengteng akangsiangta hi.
english: Yahweh, I cry to you, for the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame has burned all the trees of the field.

paite: Ahi, gamsate nang hon ngai in anak huhu ua; luitate akangtat a, mei in gamdai gam loupa mun akangsiangta hi.
english: Yes, the animals of the field pant to you, for the water brooks have dried up, and the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness.

paite: Zion ah pengkul mut unla, ka tang siangthou ah kigalginna puang un; hiai gamsung a mi tengteng ling uhen; TOUPA ni hong tung ding, anaita hi.
english: Blow the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain! Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble, for the day of Yahweh comes, for it is close at hand:

paite: Mialna leh khonimna ni, mei kai ni leh mial sah ni, tangte tung a phalvak tangkhia bang a mipi tampitak leh hattak, huchibang om ngei nai lou, tunung a suan tampi tan a leng om nawn ngei sam lou ding ahong tung ding hi.
english: A day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness. As the dawn spreading on the mountains, a great and strong people; there has never been the like, neither will there be any more after them, even to the years of many generations.

paite: Amaban uh mei in akangsiang a; anunglam uh meikuang in ahul a; ama ua gam lah Eden huan bang ahi, anunglam ua gamdai gamkeu ahi a; ahi, bangmah in huai apel kei uh.
english: A fire devours before them, and behind them, a flame burns. The land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them, a desolate wilderness. Yes, and no one has escaped them.

paite: Alatdan uh sakol latdan bang ahi; sakol tungtuangmi bang in atai uhi.
english: Their appearance is as the appearance of horses, and they run as horsemen.

paite: Kidouna kangtalai ging bang in tang tung ah akilek suausuau ua, buhpawl kang kuang luahluah leh kidouna a mipi hattak mansa abang uhi.
english: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of the mountains, they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devours the stubble, like a strong people set in battle array.

paite: Amaute mu mipite alau ua; amelte uh ahong mual khin uhi.
english: At their presence the peoples are in anguish. All faces have grown pale.

paite: Mihattak bang in atai ua; kidoumi bang in baang ah akah ua, amau zawn chiat ah apai ua, akivolhdan uh ahihbuai kei uhi.
english: They run like mighty men. They climb the wall like warriors. They each march in his line, and they don’t swerve off course.

paite: Akiphu kha tuan kei ua; amau lampi ah apai chiat ua; galvante anawk paisuak ua, apialzak kei uh.
english: One doesn’t jostle another. They each march in their own path. They burst through the defenses and don’t break ranks.

paite: Khopi tung ah atawm ua; kulh tung ah atai ua; insungte ah akaltou ua; guta bang in tohlette ah alut uhi.
english: They rush on the city. They run on the wall. They climb up into the houses. They enter in at the windows like thieves.

paite: Ama uah lei aling a; vante aling hi; ni leh kha amial a, aksite'n avak uh asel uhi;
english: The earth quakes before them. The heavens tremble. The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N asepaihhonte ma ah a-aw asuah a; agiahbukte lah athupi ngal a; athu tangtungsakpa ahat a, TOUPA ni athupi in amulkimhuai ngal a, kua'n athuak thei mahmah dia?
english: Yahweh thunders his voice before his army, for his forces are very great; for he is strong who obeys his command; for the day of Yahweh is great and very awesome, and who can endure it?

paite: TOUPA'N, huchipi in leng tu in na lungtang tengteng ua an ngawl a, kap a, lungkham in kei lam hong nga le uchin.
english: “Yet even now,” says Yahweh, “turn to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning.”

paite: Na puante uh hilou in na lungtang uh botkek unla, TOUPA na Pathian lam nga un; amah hehpih theitak leh lainatna a dim, lungnel leh zahngaihna hau, thil hoih lou a kipan kik nawn sek ahi, achi hi.
english: Tear your heart and not your garments, and turn to Yahweh, your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and relents from sending calamity.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un lungsim kihei in tangbuang leh dawn ding thillat ah vualzawlna nutsiat in a-om kei ding chih kua'n athei a?
english: Who knows? He may turn and relent, and leave a blessing behind him, even a meal offering and a drink offering to Yahweh, your God.

paite: Zion ah pengkul mut unla, an ngawl hun tang siangthou un, khawmpi taksuaktak bawl un.
english: Blow the trumpet in Zion! Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly.

paite: Mipi kaikhawm unla, omkhawmte hihsiangthou unla, putekte, naupangte, nawitui ne laite kaikhawm unla; mouneite adantan a kipan in hong pawt uhenla, mou leng adantan sunggil a kipan in hong pawt hen.
english: Gather the people. Sanctify the assembly. Assemble the elders. Gather the children, and those who nurse from breasts. Let the bridegroom go out of his room, and the bride out of her chamber.

paite: Siampu, TOUPA nasem mite inlim leh maitam kikal ah kap uhenla; TOUPA aw, "Na mite hawi inla, na goutante gensiat a om namte'n atung ua vai ahawmsak ding un pe ke'n; 'A Pathian uh koi a om ahia,' chi in amipite lak ah bangziak a chi ding ahi ua?" chi uhen.
english: Let the priests, the ministers of Yahweh, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, “Spare your people, Yahweh, and don’t give your heritage to reproach, that the nations should rule over them. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’”

paite: TOUPA'N agam thikthuse khop in adeihthoh a, amite ahehpih hi.
english: Then Yahweh was jealous for his land, and had pity on his people.

paite: TOUPA'N amite kiang ah, Ngai unla, na kiang uah buhte, uainte, sathaute ka hon tungsak ding a, huaite in na tai ding ua; namte lak ah gensiat in ka hon omsak nawn kei ding.
english: Yahweh answered his people, “Behold, I will send you grain, new wine, and oil, and you will be satisfied with them; and I will no more make you a reproach among the nations.

paite: Himahleh na kiang ua kipan in mallam sepaihhon ka suanmang ding a, gamkeu leh sia ah ka paisak ding, amasa pawl suahlam tuipi ah, ananung pawl tumlam tuipi ah; ahong uihkhe ding a, namsetak in ahong nam ding, thil thupitak ahih ziak in, chi in adawng hi.
english: But I will remove the northern army far away from you, and will drive it into a barren and desolate land, its front into the eastern sea, and its back into the western sea; and its stench will come up, and its bad smell will rise.” Surely he has done great things.

paite: Aw gam, lau ke'n, nuam in kipak in; TOUPA'N thil thupite ahihta hi.
english: Land, don’t be afraid. Be glad and rejoice, for Yahweh has done great things.

paite: Gante aw, lau kei un, gamdai loupa mun ahong sel a, sing ahong gah a, theipi kung leh grepgui ahong selpha ding hi.
english: Don’t be afraid, you animals of the field; for the pastures of the wilderness spring up, for the tree bears its fruit. The fig tree and the vine yield their strength.

paite: Nou, Zion tate aw, kipak un, TOUPA na Pathian uah nuam un; noute a ding in vuah azusak a, akha khatna a vuah masa leh vuah nanung ahun lel ahon pe ding hi.
english: “Be glad then, you children of Zion, and rejoice in Yahweh, your God; for he gives you the early rain in just measure, and he causes the rain to come down for you, the early rain and the latter rain, as before.

paite: Pialkhangte buh in adim ding a, uain leh sathau belte adimlet ding uhi.
english: The threshing floors will be full of wheat, and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.

paite: Na lak ua ka sepaihhon tampi ka sawl, khaukhupte, singnget khaute, khauhonte, leh khaupete'n anek khit kumte nou ka hon din nawn ding hi.
english: I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, the great locust, the grasshopper, and the caterpillar, my great army, which I sent among you.

paite: Tampi na ne ding ua, na tai ding ua, nou lamdangtak a hon ngaihtuah sekpa TOUPA na Pathian min na phat ding uh; ka mite azahlak ngei kei uhi.
english: You will have plenty to eat and be satisfied, and will praise the name of Yahweh, your God, who has dealt wondrously with you; and my people will never again be disappointed.

paite: Huan Israelte lak ah ka om chih leh TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, kuamah dang a-om kei uh chih na thei ding uh; ka mite azahlak ngei nawn kei ding uhi.
english: You will know that I am among Israel, and that I am Yahweh, your God, and there is no one else; and my people will never again be disappointed.

paite: Huai nung chiang in hichi ahong hi ding a, mi tengteng tung ah ka kha ka sung ding; huchi in na tapate, na tanute un ka thu agen ding ua, na putekte un mang aman ding ua, na tangvalte un kilaknate amu ding uh;
english: “It will happen afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh; and your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your old men will dream dreams. Your young men will see visions.

paite: Huai ni chiang in sikhapate, sikhanute tung ah leng ka kha ka sungbo ding hi.
english: And also on the servants and on the handmaids in those days, I will pour out my Spirit.

paite: Vante leh leitung ah thillamdangte, sisan, mei leh meikhu ding ka musak ding hi.
english: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth: blood, fire, and pillars of smoke.

paite: Nisa mial asuak ding a, kha sisan asuak ding hi, TOUPA ni thupitak leh mulkimhuai ahong tun ma in.
english: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and terrible day of Yahweh comes.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, kuapeuh TOUPA min lou peuhmah humbit in a-om ding; TOUPA'N agen bang in, Zion tang ah leh Jerusalem khua ah akhosuaksunte a-om ding uhi.
english: It will happen that whoever will call on Yahweh’s name shall be saved; for in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be those who escape, as Yahweh has said, and among the remnant, those whom Yahweh calls.

paite: Ngai dih ua, huai nite leh huai hun a, Judah leh Jerusalem saltangte ka kaihkhop hun chiang in,
english: “For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,

paite: nam chih ka kaikhawm ding a, amaute Jehoshaphat Phaizang ah ka pisuk ding hi. Huai ah, nam chih lak a athehdalh uh, ka mi, ka goutan Israelte tung a agamtatna uh leh, ka gam akihawmna ziak un, atung uah amaute toh thukhenna ka bawlpih ding;
english: I will gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat; and I will execute judgment on them there for my people, and for my heritage, Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations. They have divided my land,

paite: ka mite a ding in ai asan ua, kizuakna man ding in pasal naupang apia ua, uain adawntheihna ding un, aman ding in numei naupang azuak uhi.
english: and have cast lots for my people, and have given a boy for a prostitute, and sold a girl for wine, that they may drink.

paite: "Ahi, aw Tura leh Sidon leh Philistia gam tengteng aw, kei a ding in bang na hi ua le? Na thuk ding ua hia? N'on thuk uleh, hattak in, kintak in na thukna uh na lutung mahmah uah ka hon thuk sam ding hi.
english: “Yes, and what are you to me, Tyre and Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Will you repay me? And if you repay me, I will swiftly and speedily return your repayment on your own head.

paite: Ka dangkasik leh adangka-eng na la ua, ka thil hoihtak deihhuaite na tempul sung uah na tawilut uhi;
english: Because you have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried my finest treasures into your temples,

paite: Judah tate leh Jerusalem tate leng agamgi ua kipan gamlapi a na suanmang theihna ding un, Grik tapate kiang ah na zuakta uhi.
english: and have sold the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem to the sons of the Greeks, that you may remove them far from their border.

paite: Ngai dih ua, na zuakna mun ua kipan in tokthou in ka pawtsak ding a, na thukna uh na lutung mahmah uah ka thuk sam ding hi.
english: Behold, I will stir them up out of the place where you have sold them, and will return your repayment on your own head;

paite: Judah tate khut ah na tapate uh leh na tanute uh ka zuak ding, amau gamlapi ah Sheba mite kiang ah azuak ding uhi," TOUPA'N achita hi.
english: and I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hands of the children of Judah, and they will sell them to the men of Sheba, to a faraway nation, for Yahweh has spoken it.”

paite: Namte lak ah hiai puang unla; kidou ding in kisa unla; mihat mahmahte tokthou un; kidoumi tengtengte hong nai uhenla, hong paitou uhen.
english: Proclaim this among the nations: “Prepare for war! Stir up the mighty men. Let all the warriors draw near. Let them come up.

paite: Na leilehna mukzumte uh namsau ding in sek unla, teipi ding in na theikung kuaika temtate uh sek un; mihat lou in leng ka hat chi hen.
english: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weak say, ‘I am strong.’

paite: Akim a nam tengteng aw, kin unla, hong pai unla kikaikhawm un; Aw TOUPA, huai ah na mihat mahmahte paisuksak in.
english: Hurry and come, all you surrounding nations, and gather yourselves together.” Cause your mighty ones to come down there, Yahweh.

paite: Namte kitokthou uhenla Jehoshaphat Phaizang ah hong paitou uhen; huai ah akim a nam tengteng tung a vaihawm ding in ka tu ding hi.
english: “Let the nations arouse themselves, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat; for there I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations.

paite: Na kawite uh suah un, buhlak ahun hi; hong pai unla, childen un; grep sukna khuk adim a, bel adimlet a; akhelhna uh athupi hi.
english: Put in the sickle; for the harvest is ripe. Come, tread, for the wine press is full, the vats overflow, for their wickedness is great.”

paite: Mipi tampite, thukhenna phaizang a mipi tampite! Thupukna Phaizang ah, TOUPA ni anaita hi!
english: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of Yahweh is near in the valley of decision.

paite: Ni leh kha hihmial in om ding ua, aksite'n avakna uh asel ding uh.
english: The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.

paite: TOUPA Zion tang a kipan in ahumham ding a, Jerusalem a kipan in a-aw asuah ding; leitung leh vante aling ding ua; himahleh TOUPA zaw amite a ding in kihumbitna leh Israel suante a ding in insang ahi ding hi.
english: Yahweh will roar from Zion, and thunder from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth will shake; but Yahweh will be a refuge to his people, and a stronghold to the children of Israel.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA na Pathian uh ka tang siangthou Zion a teng ka hi chih na thei ding uh; huchi in Jerusalem asiangthou ding a, mikhual kuamah apaisuak nawn kei ding.
english: “So you will know that I am Yahweh, your God, dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain. Then Jerusalem will be holy, and no strangers will pass through her any more.

paite: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, tang sangte'n uain khum akaisak ding ua, nawitui in mualte aluang ding a; TOUPA' inn a kipan in tuikhuk ahong kikhohkhe ding a, Shittim lui phaizang anomsak ding hi.
english: It will happen in that day, that the mountains will drop down sweet wine, the hills will flow with milk, all the brooks of Judah will flow with waters; and a fountain will flow out from Yahweh’s house, and will water the valley of Shittim.

paite: Judah tate tung ah engbawltak a agam ua sisan asuah ziak un, Aigupta asegawp ding a, Edom gam gamdai gamkeu asuak ding hi.
english: Egypt will be a desolation and Edom will be a desolate wilderness, for the violence done to the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.

paite: Judah gam tangtawn in luah in a-om gige ding a, Jerusalem khua suan a kipan suan zel tan in luah in a-om ding.
english: But Judah will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.

paite: Huan asisan suahna uh ka sawpsiang louh ka sawpsiang ding a, Zion ah TOUPA ateng gige hi.
english: I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed, for Yahweh dwells in Zion.”

paite: Atung in Thu a-om a, Thu tuh Pathian kiang ah a-om, huai Thu Pathian ahi.
english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

paite: Huai Thu mah atung in Pathian kiang ah a-om hi.
english: The same was in the beginning with God.

paite: Bangkim avek in ama siam ahi; thilsiam tengteng amah siam louh bangmah a-om kei.
english: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.

paite: Amah ah hinna a-om, huai hinna mihingte vakna ahi.
english: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.

paite: Mial lak ah vak ahong vak a; mial in huai azou kei hi.
english: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.

paite: Pathian sawl mi khat a-om a, amin Johan ahi.
english: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.

paite: Huai mi theihpihtu hi ding in ahong, huai vak toh kisai theihpih ding in, amah tawn a mi tengteng in agintak theihna ding un.
english: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.

paite: Amah bel vak ahi kei a, vak thu theihpih ding a hong ahi zaw hi.
english: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.

paite: Vak diktak, michih kiang a vakna pia, khovel ah ahong pailel ahi.
english: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.

paite: Amah khovel ah a-om, khovel ama siam ahi, hinapi in khovel in amah athei kei hi.
english: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.

paite: Ama mite kiang ah ahong a, amite mahmah in ana pom kei uhi.
english: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.

paite: Himahleh amah kipahpih a pom, amin gingtate tengteng kiang ah Pathian tate suahtheihna apia a:
english: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:

paite: amaute sisan hiam, sa deihna hiam, mihing deihna hiam hilou in, Pathian suan a piang ahi zaw uhi.
english: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

paite: Huai Thu tuh sa ahong suak a, i lak uah ahong teng a, hehpihna leh thutak a dim in; athupina Pa Tapa tang neihsun thupina bangbang i muta uhi.
english: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

paite: Johan in amah theihpihna apia a, "Ka nung a hong paipa'n hon paikheng, amah ka ma a omsa him ahih ziak in, chi a athu ka genpa hiai ahi," achi hi.
english: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”

paite: Huan eite'n ataangchinna a kipan hehpihna tung a hehpih nawnsawnna i tang chiat uhi.
english: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

paite: Mosi zang a Dan piak ahi a, himahleh Jesu Khrist ziak in hehpihna leh thutak ahong om hi.
english: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.

paite: Kuamah in chik lai mah in Pathian amu ngei kei; Tapa tang neihsun, Pa angsung a om in theihtheih in amah abawlta hi.
english: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.

paite: Huan Judate'n, "Kua na hia?" chi a dong ding a, Jerusalem a kipan akiang a siampute leh Levi chi a mite asawl lai un hiaite Johan thu na theihsak ahi uhi.
english: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”

paite: Ama'n chiangtak in agen a, "Khrist ka hi kei hi," chi in apulak hi.
english: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Kua na hia le? Elijah na hi hia?" achi ua, adong uhi. Huan ama'n, "Ka hi kei," achi hi. "Huai zawlnei na hi hia?" achi ua. Ama'n, "Hilou e,” chi in adawng hi.
