english: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”

paite: Amau akiang ah ahihleh, "Kua na hia? Hon sawlte ka dawntheihna ding un hon hilh in; na tanchin himhim bang ahia na gen ding?" achi uhi.
english: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”

paite: Ama'n, zawlnei Isai gen bang in, "Toupa lampi hihtang un, chi a, gamdai a kikoupa aw ka hi," achi hi.
english: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”

paite: Amisawlte uh Pharisaite kiang a kipan kuate hiam ahi uhi.
english: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Khrist bek, Elijah bek, zawlnei bek na hih kei ngalleh bang achia baptis nak na hia le?" achi ua, adong nawn uhi.
english: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”

paite: Johan in akiang uah, "Ke'n tui in ka hon baptis a, na lak uah mi khat na theih louh uh adingh ahi,
english: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.

paite: mah ahi ka nung a hong pai dingpa, ka ma a omsa pen, akhedap khau phel tak leng ka hi kei," chi in adawng hi.
english: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”

paite: Hiaite Jordan gal a Bethani a Johan in abaptisna mun a thil tung ahi.
english: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

paite: Huan azing in Johan in akiang a hong pai Jesu amu a, agen a, "En un, Pathian Belamnou khovel khelhna lamangpa!
english: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

paite: Hiai ahi amah, mi khat ka nung a hong paipa, ka ma a omsa him ahi, ka chihpa.
english: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’

paite: Amah lah ka na thei ngal kei a; himahleh Israelte kiang a amah latsak ahihna ding in tui a baptis in ka hong pai ahi,” achi hi.
english: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”

paite: Huan Johan in athu atheisak a, "Vakhu bang in van a kipan Kha hong suk ka mu a, atung ah a-om nilouh," chi in agen hi.
english: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.

paite: Amah lah ka thei ngal kei a; himahleh tui a baptis ding a hon sawlpa'n ka kiang ah, "Kua tung ah leng Kha hong suk a atung a om na muh peuh, hiai tuh Kha Siangthou a baptispa ahi, ahon chi hi.
english: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’

paite: Huai ka muta a, hiai mipa Pathian Tapa ahi chih ka theisakta hi,” achi hi.
english: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”

paite: Huan azing nawn in anungzui nihte toh Johan adingh a,
english: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,

paite: Jesu vialvak vak lai a-en a, "En un, Pathian Belamnou!" achi hi.
english: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”

paite: Anungzui nihte'n athugen aza ua, Jesu azuita uhi.
english: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

paite: Jesu akihei a, ahon zui uh amu a, akiang uah, "Bang ahia na zon uh?" achi hi. Amau, "Rabbi (huai tuh Sinsakpa chihna ahi), koi a teng na hia?" achi uhi.
english: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hong le uchin na mu ding uh," achi hi. Huchi in ahong pai ua, a-omna amu ua; huai hun dak sawmna vel ahih tak ziak in akiang ah huai ni ataam uhi.
english: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

paite: Johan thugen za a Jesu zui nihte lak a khat zaw pen Andru, Simon Peter sanggampa ahi.
english: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

paite: Ama'n amasapen in amah sanggampa Simon amu a, akiang ah, "Messia ka muta uh," achi a, huai tuh Khrist chihna ahi.
english: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n amah ana en a, "Johan tapa Simon na hi, Kifas ahon chi ding uh," achi a (huai tuh Peter chihna hi).
english: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).

paite: Huan azing in Jesu'n Galili gam a hoh atum a, Philip amu a, akiang ah, "Hon zui in," achi hi.
english: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”

paite: Philip bel Bethsaida khomi ahi a, Andru leh Peter omna khopi mah ahi.
english: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

paite: Philip in Nathanael amu a, akiang ah, atanchin Mosi in dan laibu a agelh leh zawlneite'n agelh uh, "Amah ka muta uhi, Nazaret Jesu, Joseph tapa," achi hi.
english: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”

paite: Nathanael in akiang ah, "Nazaret ah thil hoih apawt thei a hia?" achi hi. Philip in akiang ah, "Hong pai inla, en in," achi hi.
english: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang a Nathanael hong dek in amu a, atanchin ana gen a, "En un, Israel mitak, khemna himhim nei lou," achi hi.
english: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”

paite: Nathanael in akiang ah, "Nang bangchidan a hon thei na hia?" achi hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Philip in nang ahon sap ma a, theipi bul a na om lai in, ka hon mu hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”

paite: Nathanael in akiang ah, "Rabbi, Pathian Tapa na hi, Israelte kumpipa na hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Theipi bul ah nang ka hon mu, na kiang a ka chih ziak in na gingta ahi maw? Hiaite sang a thil thupizaw na mu lai ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”

paite: Huan Jesu mah in akiang ah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, van kihong a, Mihing Tapa tung a Pathian angelte kahtou leh kumsuk na mu ding uh," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”

paite: "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh belam huang kongkhak a lut lou a, lampi dang a kahlutmi guta leh suamhat ahi.
english: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.

paite: Kuapeuh kongkhak a lut belamchingpa ahi.
english: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

paite: Kongkhak ngakpa'n amah ana honsak a; belamte'n a-aw aza uh; ama'n belamte amin un asam chiat a, apikhe zel hi.
english: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

paite: Amah a tengteng apawtsaktak in, ama uh akai a, belamte'n amah azui zel ua, a-aw athei uhi.
english: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.

paite: Midang azui kei ding ua, ataimangsan zaw ding uh; midangte aw atheih louh ziak un,” achi hi.
english: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”

paite: Hiai gentehna Jesu'n akiang uah agen hi; himahleh bang thu ahia akiang ua agen chih athei kei uhi.
english: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n akiang uah agen nawn a, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kei belam kongkhak ka hi.
english: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.

paite: Ka ma a hong pai tengteng gutate leh suamhatte ahi vek uh; himahleh belamte'n athu uh angaihsak kei uh.
english: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.

paite: Kei kongkhak ka hi; keimah a mi alutleh, humbit in a-om ding a, alut in apawt dia, nek ding leng amu ding hi.
english: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.

paite: Guta zaw, gu ding leh that ding leh hihse ding lou in ahong pai kei; kei ka hihleh hinna aneihna ding ua, tampitak aneihna ding ua hong pai ka hi.
english: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

paite: "Kei belamchingpa hoih ka hi; belamchingpa hoih in abelamte a ding in ahinna apia hi.
english: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

paite: Kilohmi, belamchingpa tak hilou, belamte amah a hilou in, ngia hong pai amuh in belamte ataisan a; huan ngia in amau akei a, huchi in belamte ahihdalh hi.
english: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.

paite: Kilohmi ahi a, belamte a ding a deihsakna himhim aneih louh ziak in ataimang hi.
english: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn’t care for the sheep.

paite: Kei zaw belamchingpa hoih ka hi.
english: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;

paite: Pa in ahon theih bang in ke'n leng Pa ka thei hi, huan belamte a ding in ka hinna ka pia hi.
english: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

paite: Hiai belam huang a lou belam dangte ka nei hi; amau leng ka hon pi ding a, ka aw aza ding ua, hon khat in chingpa khat toh a-omkhawm ding uhi.
english: I have other sheep which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.

paite: "Hiai ziak in Pa'n kei ahon it ahi; lak nawn ding a ka hinna ka piak ding ziak in.
english: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.

paite: Kuamah in hon laksak kei ding, keimah thuthu in ka pe zaw ding hi. Pe thei ka hi a, la nawn thei leng ka hi. Hiai thupiak ka Pa a pan ka muh ahi,” achi hi.
english: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”

paite: Hiai thu ziak in Judate akikhen ua, akilang nawnta uhi.
english: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.

paite: Akhen tampi in, "Dawi zawl ahi, ahai ei ve; bangziak a athu ngaikhia na hi ua?" achi uhi.
english: Many of them said, “He has a demon and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”

paite: Akhen in, "Hiai dawi zawl thute hi kei e. Dawi in mittaw mit ahihvak thei a hia?" achi uhi.
english: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”

paite: Huan Jerusalem a Latna Ankuanglui lai ahi a, huai hun phalbi lai ahi.
english: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.

paite: Tempul, Solomon inlim ah Jesu akivialleh hi.
english: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.

paite: Judate'n hong umkual ua, akiang ah, "Bang tan lakloh tak a hon koih ding na hia? Khrist na hihleh chiantak in hon hilh in," achi uhi.
english: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ka hon hilhta a, na gingta tuan kei uh; ka Pa min a thil ka hih hiaite'n ka tanchin atheisak uhi.
english: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.

paite: Himahleh na gingta kei uhi, ka belam lak a mi na hih louh ziak un.
english: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.

paite: Ka belamte'n ka aw aza uh, ke'n leng amaute ka thei a, amau ahon zui uhi.
english: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

paite: Akiang uah tangtawn hinna ka pia; tangtawn in amangthang himhim kei ding ua, kuamah in ka khut a kipan hon sut sam kei ding hi.
english: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

paite: Amau hon pepa ka Pa, mi tengteng sang a thupizaw ahi; kuamah in Pa khut a kipan asut thei kei ding hi.
english: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.

paite: Kei leh Pa lah pum khat ka hi uh," chi in adawng hi.
english: I and the Father are one.”

paite: Huan Judate'n adenna ding in suang atawm nawn uhi.
english: Therefore the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

paite: Jesu'n amau ahoupih a, "Pa a kipan nasep hoih tampi ka hon ensak a, huai nasepte lak ah bang nasep ziak in ahia suang a na hon den dek uh?" achi hi.
english: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”

paite: Judate'n akiang ah, "Nasep hoih ziak in suang in ka hon dengdek kei uh; Pathian na gensiat ziak leh nang mihing hi ngal a, Pathian a na kibawl ziak ahi zaw," chi in adawng uhi.
english: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Na dan uah, 'noute pathiante na hi uh ka hon chi,' chih gelh ahi kei a hia?
english: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?

paite: Pathian thu tunnate bawn pathiante achihleh Laisiangthou bohsiat theih ahi kei hi.
english: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),

paite: Pathian Tapa ka hi, ka chih ziak in Pa'n aseh a, khovel a asawlpa Pathian na gensia hon chi na hi uh maw?
english: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?

paite: Ka Pa nasem ka hih keileh hon gingta kei un.
english: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.

paite: Himahleh sem ka hihleh kei hon gingta kei mah le uchin ka nasepte bek gingta un; huchi a keimah ah Pa a-om chih leh kei Pa ah ka om chih na theihna ua, na theihsiamna ding un," chi in adawng hi.
english: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”

paite: Huaitak in mat atum nawn ua, himahleh akhut ua kipan asuakta hi.
english: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.

paite: Jordan lui gal ah Johan in atung a mi abaptisna lam ah apaimang nawn a, huai ah a-om nilouh hi.
english: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.

paite: Huan akiang ah mi tampi ahong pai ua, "Johan in thillamdang bangmah ahih kei a; himahleh Johan in hiai mi tungtang thu agen peuhmah ana dik mahmah hi," achi uhi.
english: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”

paite: Huan huai ah mi tampi in amah agingta uhi.
english: Many believed in him there.

paite: Huan mi khat, Mari leh asanggam Martha omna Bethani khua ah, mi khat amin Lazaras kichi damlou in a-om hi.
english: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.

paite: Asanggampa Lazaras damlou neinu hiai Mari ahihleh sathau gimnamtui Toupa nuh a, asam a akhete nulnu ahi.
english: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.

paite: Asanggamnute'n Jesu kiang ah, "Ngai dih Toupa, na it achi ana," chi in mi asawl uhi.
english: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”

paite: Jesu'n huai azak in, "Hiai natna sihna ding zen ahi kei, Pathian thupina ding ahi zaw hi. Hiai ziak a Pathian Tapa hih thupi ahihtheihna ding in ahi," achi hi.
english: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”

paite: Martha, asanggamnu, Mari leh Lazaraste Jesu'n a-it hi.
english: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

paite: Ama'n china ahi chih azak in, a-omna ngei ah ni nih ataam lai hi.
english: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.

paite: Huai khit in anungzuite kiang ah, "Judia gam ah i hoh nawn ding uh," achi hi.
english: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”

paite: Huan nungzuite'n akiang ah, "Rabbi, tuma zek in Judate'n suang a hon den atum ua; huchipi in huai ah na hoh nawn dia hia?" achi ua.
english: The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”

paite: Jesu'n, "Sun in dakkal sawm-le-nih a-om kei a hia? Mi sun a avakleh akisui ngei kei, hiai khovel vak amuh ziak in.
english: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.

paite: Himahleh mi zan a avakleh akisui hi; amah a vak a-om louh ziak in," chi in adawng hi.
english: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”

paite: Huai thute agen khit in akiang uah, "I lawmpa Lazaras a-ihmuta; amah phawnghalh ding in ka hoh ding," achi hi.
english: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”

paite: Huchi in anungzuite'n akiang ah, "Toupa, a-ihmut takleh akhanglou nawn mai na ke," achi uhi.
english: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”

paite: Jesu'n asih thu gen ahi a; himahleh amau ihmu a atawldam thu gen hiam asa uhi.
english: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n chiangtak in akiang uah, "Lazaras si ahi, achi a,
english: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.

paite: huai a ka om louh nou ziak in ka kipak ahi, na gintak theihna ding un; himahleh akiang ah i hoh ding uh," achi hi.
english: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”

paite: Thomas, Didum achih un, anungzuihpihte kiang ah, "Amah toh i sih samna ding un eite leng i hoh ding uh," achi hi.
english: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s also go, that we may die with him.”

paite: Huchi in Jesu atun in ni li han ah a-omta chih athei hi.
english: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.

paite: Bethani khua ahihleh Jerusalem kiang a om ahi a, ching sawm-le-nga phial a gamla ahi.
english: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.

paite: Huchi in asanggampa uh sihna tung a khamuan ding in Judate tampi Martha leh Mari kiang ah ahoh uhi.
english: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.

paite: Jesu ahong dek chih Martha in azak phet in ava dawn a; Mari bel insung ah atu lailai hi.
english: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.

paite: Martha in Jesu kiang ah, "Toupa, hiai a om hi lechin zaw, ka sanggampa si lou ding hi a.
english: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.

paite: Tu'n ah leng Pathian kiang a na nget peuhmah Pathian in nang hon pe ding chih ka thei," achi hi.
english: Even now I know that whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Na sanggampa athounawn ding," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”

paite: Martha in akiang ah, "Nitawp ni chiah, thohnawnna ah, athounawn ding chih ka thei,” achi hi.
english: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Kei thohnawnna leh hinna ka hi; kuapeuh hon gingta si mahleh ahing gige ding.
english: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.

paite: Ahing peuhmah a, ahon gingta peuhmah tangtawn in asi kei ding; huai thu na gingta hia?" achi hi.
english: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Gingta e, Toupa, Khrist, Pathian Tapa, khovel a hong pai dingpa na hi chih ka gingta hi," achi hi.
english: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”

paite: Huan huai thu agen khit in akuan a, asanggamnu Mari asim sap a, "Sinsakpa hiai ah a-om a, nang ahon samsak,” achi hi.
english: When she had said this, she went away and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”

paite: Ama'n huai azaktak in, adingkhe pah a, akiang ah ava hoh hi.
english: When she heard this, she arose quickly and went to him.

paite: Khua ah Jesu alut nai kei a, Martha in ava dawn lai a a-omna ngei ah a-om lai hi.
english: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.

paite: Huan insung a amah khamuan a ompih Judate'n Mari dingkhe pah a pawt amuhtak un, han a kap ding a hoh dek hi in teh, chi in azui uhi.
english: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”

paite: Huan Jesu omna ah Mari ava tung a, amah amuhtak in, akhebul a bokkhup in akiang ah, "Toupa, hiai a om hi lechin zaw, ka sanggampa si lou ding hi a," achi hi.
english: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n Mari kap leh ahon zui Judate kap amu a, alung akhoih mahmah a, kha in amau hi.
english: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,

paite: Huan ama'n, "Amah koi a sial na hi ua?" achi hi. Amau akiang ah, "Toupa hong pai inla, hong en in," achi uhi.
english: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”

paite: Jesu akapta.
english: Jesus wept.

paite: Judate'n, "En dih uh, Lazaras it hi na tel e," achi uhi.
english: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”

paite: Himahleh khenkhat in, "Hiai mi, mittaw mit hihvakpa'n, hiai mi leng asi lousak thei kei a eita?" achi uhi.
english: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”

paite: Huan Jesu nakpi in amau nawn a, han atung hi. Huai han kokhuk, suang a sit ahi.
english: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.

paite: Jesu'n, "Suang hemkhia un,” achi hi. Asipa sanggamnu Martha in akiang ah, "Toupa, tu'n zaw anamta ding, asihna ni li ahita," achi hi.
english: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, na gintakleh Pathian thupina na mu ding, ka hon chi kei a hia? achi hi. Huchi in suang ahemkhia uhi.
english: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”

paite: Huchi in Jesu avandak a, "Pa ka thu na ngaihkhiak ziak in na tung ah ka kipak hi.
english: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.

paite: Ka thu na ngaikhe zel chih ka thei; himahleh, mipi dinghte ziak in hiai ka chi ahi nang na hon sawl chih agintak theihna ding un," achi hi.
english: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”

paite: Huan huchi a apau khit in aw ngaihtak in, "Lazaras, hong pawt in," chi in akikou hi.
english: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”

paite: Huan misi akhut akhe, han puan a tuamsa in ahong pawtta a, amai leng kinulna puan a tuam ahi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Phel unla, paisak un," achi hi.
english: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Free him, and let him go.”

paite: Huchi in Mari kiang a hong pai Jesu thilhih mu, Judate akhen tampi in Jesu agingta uhi.
english: Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.

paite: Himahleh, akhen Pharisaite kiang ah ava hoh ua, akiang uah Jesu thilhihte ava hilh uhi.
english: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done.

paite: Huchi in siampu liante leh Pharisaite'n vaihawmte asamkhawm ua, "Bangchi in i hih ding ua? Hiai mi'n thillamdang tampi ahih ngal a, achi uhi.
english: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many signs.

paite: Hichibang a i khahzan un zaw mi tengteng in amah agingta ding ua; Rome mite hong pai in, i mun leh i namte ahong laksak tuak ding uh," achi uhi.
english: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”

paite: Huan alak ua mi khat Kaiapha, huai kum a siampu lianpen in akiang uah, "Nou bangmah thei kei uteh,
english: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,

paite: i nam pumpi manthatlouhna ding in mi tengteng sik a mi khat sih, nou a ding in ahoih chih leng na ngaihtuah kei uh," achi hi.
english: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.”

paite: Huai thu amah phuahtawm in agen kei, huai kum in siampu lianpen ahi a, anamte sik a Jesu asih ding genkhol ahi zaw hi.
english: Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,

paite: Huai namte sik kia ahi kei a, khovel a Pathian' ta dalhte tengteng apikhawmna ding in leng ahi sam hi.
english: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.

paite: Huchi in huai ni a kipan amah thahna ding in akihou zel uhi.
english: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.

paite: Huaiziak in Judate lak ah alangtang in Jesu avak nawnta kei a, huai a kipan gamdai zullam a khua khat Ephraim achih uah ava hohta hi; huai ah nungzuite toh a-om nilouh uhi.
english: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.

paite: Huan Judate Paikan Ankuangluina anaita a, mi tampi kisiangsak ding in, gam a pat, Paikan Ankuanglui ma in, Jerusalem ah ahohtou uhi.
english: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.

paite: Huchi in Jesu azong ua tempul ah dingh kawm in akihou ua, "Bang ahia na ngaihtuah uh? Ankuangluina ah ahong kei ding maw?" akichi uhi.
english: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke with one another as they stood in the temple, “What do you think—that he isn’t coming to the feast at all?”

paite: Siampu liante leh Pharisaite'n amah amattheihna ding un kuapeuh in a-omna atheih uleh amaute theihsak ding thu apeta uhi.
english: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.

paite: Huan Paikan Ankuangluina ding ni guk a-om lai a, Jesu'n misi lak a kipan a akaihthoh Lazaras omna khua, Bethani ahong tung hi.
english: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

paite: Huai ah amah a ding in nitak an abawl ua, Martha in nek abawl hi, Lazaras bel a-ankuang umpih khat ahi.
english: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.

paite: Mari in spiknardi buk kimkhat thaunamtui manphatak ahon tawi a, Jesu khete anuh a, asam in anul a, huai thaugim in insung adimta hi.
english: Therefore Mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.

paite: Himahleh Judas Iskariot, anungzuite lak a khat, amansak ding pa'n,
english: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,

paite: "Hiai thaunamtui bangziak a makhai zathum a zuak a migentheite kiang a pe zaw lou uh ahia?" achi hi.
english: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”

paite: Migentheite a-awlmoh ziak a hiai thu gen ahi kei; amah guta ahi a, dangka ip akem a, asung a koih a alak zel ziak ahi zaw hi.
english: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.

paite: Jesu'n, "Subuai kei un, ka kivui ni a dia asit ahi.
english: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.

paite: Na kiang ua migentheite om gige ahi ua, kei bel na kiang ua om gige ding ka hi kei,” achi hi.
english: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”

paite: Huan huai mun ah Jesu a-om chih Juda mipite'n atheih un; ahong ua, Jesu ziak kia hilou in, misi lak a kipan a akaihthoh, Lazaras mah leng amuh nop ziak uh ahi.
english: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

paite: Huan siampu liante Lazaras leng thah ding in akihou uhi.
english: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,

paite: Amah ziak a Judate tampi in langkaisan a, Jesu agintak ziak un.
english: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.

paite: Azing in, Ankuangluina a hong mipi tampi'n Jerusalem ah Jesu ahong pai ding chih azak un,
english: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

paite: tumnahte atawi ua, dawn ding in apawtkhia ua, "Hosanna! Toupa min a Israelte Kumpipa hong pai ahampha e!" chi in akikou uhi.
english: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”

paite: Huan Jesu'n sabiltungnou amu a, atung ah atuang hi.
english: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,

paite: "Lau ke'n, Zion tanu; en in, na Kumpipa, sabiltungnou tung a tuang in, ahong pai ding," chih gelh ahih bang in.
english: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”

paite: Huai thute atung in anungzuite'n atheisiam kei ua; himahleh, Jesu pahtawi ahih nung in, atanchin ah huai thu gelh ahi chih leh amah tung ah huai thilte akihih ngei chih atheita uhi.
english: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.

paite: Huan han a kipan asapkhiakpa Lazaras, misi lak a kipan akaihthoh lai a akiang a mipi omte'n, athu atheihpih uhi.
english: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was testifying about it.

paite: Huaiziak in ahi, mipite'n leng amah ava dawn uh; huai thillamdang ahih chih atheih ziak un.
english: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.

paite: Huchi in Pharisaite'n, "Thei un, bangmah na hihtheih louh uh, en un, khovel in amah azuita,” akichi uhi.
english: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”

paite: Huan ankuangluina a Pathian be ding a hohtoute lak ah Grik kuate hiam a-om uhi.
english: Now there were certain Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.

paite: Huaite Galili gam a Bethsaida a mi Philip kiang ah ahong ua, akiang ah, "Pu, Jesu ka mu nuam uh," achi ua, angen uhi.
english: Therefore, these came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”

paite: Philip in Andru ahong hilh a, Andru leh Philip in Jesu ahong hilh uhi.
english: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.

paite: Jesu'n adawng a, akiang uah, "Mihing Tapa pahtawi a a-omna ding hun atungta hi.
english: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

paite: Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, lei a buhtang akiak a, asih phot keileh amah kia in a-om tawntung; asih in bel, tampi in agah hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.

paite: Kuapeuh ahinna it in amangsak ding a; kuapeuh hiai khovel a ahinna ngaineu in tangtawn hinna ah akem ding hi.
english: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.

paite: Kuapeuh in ka nna asepleh hon zui hen; ka omna ah ka sikha leng a-om ding hi; kuapeuh in kanna asepleh Pa'n amah apahtawi ding hi.
english: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.

paite: "Tu in ka kha amangbang mahmah; bang ka genta dia? 'Pa, hiai hun a pan hon hondam in, ka chi dia hia?' Himahleh hiai ding ziak mah a hiai hun a hong pai lah ka ngal a.
english: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time’? But I came to this time for this cause.

paite: Pa na min pahtawi in," achi hi. Huchi in van a kipan in aw ahong suak a, "Ka pahtawita, ka pahtawi nawn lai ding,” achi hi.
english: Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it and will glorify it again.”

paite: Mipi akiang a dinghte'n huai aza ua, "Vanpiging ahi," achi ua; midangte'n, "Angel in amah houpih ahi," achi uhi.
english: Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”

paite: Jesu'n adawng a, "Huai aw kei a dia hong suak ahi kei, noumau a ding ahi zaw," achi hi.
english: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.

paite: "Tu hiai khovel thukhensakna hun ahi; tu hiai khovel lal paihkhiak hun ahi.
english: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.

paite: Huan lei a kipan a khaikang a ka omleh, mi tengteng keimah kiang ah ka hip ding," achi hi.
english: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”

paite: Huai thu asihdan ding theihsakna dia agen ahi.
english: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

paite: Huan mipi'n akiang ah, "Khrist tangtawn in a-om chih Dan Bu ah ka thei uh, nang Mihing Tapa khaikang a om ding ka hi, bangchi chih a chi na hia? Huai Mihing Tapa kua ahia?" achi ua, adong uhi.
english: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Man?”

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Na lak uah sawt lou sung vak a-om tadih hi. Huai vak na neih sung un vak ah khosa un, huchi lou in zaw mial in ahon lap ding hi. Kuapeuh mial a khosa in apaina athei kei hi.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.

paite: Vak na neih sung un vak gingta un, vak tate na hong hihtheihna ding un," achi hi. Huai thute Jesu'n agen a; huan apai a, amuh louh ding un akiselta hi.
english: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.

paite: Ama uah huchi tel a tam thillamdang hih mahleh, amah agingta tuan kei uh.
english: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,

paite: "Toupa, ka thugen uh kua'n ahia gingta? Toupa khut leng kua kiang ah ahia latsak a a-om?" chi a zawlnei Isai thugen atangtunna ding in.
english: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: “Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”

paite: Hiai ziak in ahi a gintak theih louh uh, Isai in,
english: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again:

paite: "Ama'n amit uh ahihtaw a, alungtang uh ahihkhauh; huchi lou in zaw amit un amu kha ding ua, alungtang un athei kha ding uh, huan hong kihei nawn ding ua, ke'n amau ka hihdam kha ding," chih agen nawn ziak in.
english: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.”

paite: Hiai thilte Isai in athupina amuh a atanchin agen ahi.
english: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.

paite: Himahleh, heutute lak nangawn ah tampi in Jesu agingta uhi; himahleh Pharisaite ziak in akipulak nuam kei uh, huchi lou in zaw sinagog a kipan ahawlkhe kha ding uhi;
english: Nevertheless, even many of the rulers believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,

paite: Pathian pahtakna sang a mihing pahtakna adeih zawk ziak un.
english: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.

paite: Huan Jesu akikou a, "Kuapeuh hon gingta, kei hon gingta ahi kei a, hon sawlpa gingta ahi zaw hi.
english: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.

paite: Kuapeuh kei hon mu hon sawlpa mu ahi.
english: He who sees me sees him who sent me.

paite: Khovel a vak hong pai pen ka hi, kuapeuh kei hon gingta mial a a-omlouhna ding in.
english: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.

paite: Kuapeuh ka thugen za in, gingta kei mahleh, ke'n siam louh ka tangsak kei; khovel siam louh tangsak ding a hong pai ka hi kei a, khovel humbit ding a hong pai ka hi zaw hi.
english: If anyone listens to my sayings and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

paite: Kuapeuh kei hon deih lou a, ka thugente pom lou in, siam louh tangsak khat anei hi, ka thugen huai thu mahmah in, nitawp ni chiang in amah siam louh atangsak ding hi.
english: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke will judge him in the last day.

paite: Keimah phuahtawm in thu ka gen kei a; Pa hon sawlpa'n ka thugen ding leh ka hih ding thu ahon pe zaw hi.
english: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me gave me a commandment, what I should say and what I should speak.

paite: Amah thupiak tangtawn hinna ahi chih ka thei; huaiziak in ka thugen, Pa hon hilh bang zel in ka gen ahi," achi hi.
english: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”

paite: Paikan Ankuanglui kipat ma in, Jesu'n hiai khovel nusia a Pa kiang a apai hun hong tungta chih athei a; khovel a a-itte, atawp pha in a-it hi.
english: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.

paite: Huan nitak an nek lai a, diabol in Simon tapa, Judas Iskariot, lungtang a Jesu zuausan a matsak lungsim akoihsak khit nung in,
english: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,

paite: Pa'n akhut ah thil bangkim apeta chih leh Pathian a kipan hong pai ahi a, Pathian kiang a pai ding ahi chih, Jesu'n theigige in,
english: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,

paite: nitak an um lai adingh a, apuante asuahkhia a, kinulna puan ala a, ateng hi.
english: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist.

paite: Huan kisilna kuang ah tui asung a, nungzuite khe asilsak a, akinulna puanten in anul zel hi.
english: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

paite: Huchi in Simon Peter kiang ah ahong a, "Toupa, nang tel in ka khe na sil dia hia?" achi hi.
english: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Ka thilhih tu'n ah na thei kei; himahleh tunung chiang in na thei ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”

paite: Peter in akiang ah, "Ka khe na sil kei hial ding," achi hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Na khe ka sil keileh ka kiang ah tan na nei kei ding," achi hi.
english: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”

paite: Simon Peter in akiang ah, "Toupa, ka khe kia hilou in, ka khutte leh ka lutang leng aw," achi hi.
english: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Kisil khinsa akhe lou ngal sil akiphamoh kei, apumpi in asiang; nou na siang uh, na vek un zaw ahi kei," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”

paite: Amansak dingpa athei ngal a; huaiziak in, "Na vek un zaw na siang kei uh," achi hi.
english: For he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”

paite: Huchi in akhete uh asil khit a, apuante alak a, atut nawn in akiang uah, "Na tung ua ka thilhih na thei uhia?" achi hi.
english: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?

paite: "Nou, Toupa leh heutupa na hon chi ua; na chi dik uh, ka hihna mah ahi.
english: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.

paite: Kei Toupa leh na heutupa un na khe uh ka silleh noute'n leng na khe uh na kisilsak chiat ding uh ahi.
english: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.

paite: Na tung ua ka hih bang in, nou leng na hih sam ding un, hihdan ding hon hilh ka hi.
english: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.

paite: Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, sikha apu sang in athupizaw kei a; sawl a om leng asawlpa sang in athupizaw sam kei hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither is one who is sent greater than he who sent him.

paite: Huai thilte na theih ua, na hih uleh minuamsa na hi uhi.
english: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.

paite: "Na vek ua thu ka gen kei a; ka telte ka thei; himahleh ka tanghou nepa'n ka tung ah akhetul alikta chih, Laisiangthou ahong tuntheihna ding ahi.
english: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’

paite: Tu in ahong tun ma in ka hon hilh ahi, ahong tun hun chiang a kei amah ka hi chih na gintakna ding un.
english: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.

paite: Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh ka sawl kipahpih, kei hon kipahpih ahi; kuapeuh kei hon kipahpih, hon sawlpa kipahpih ahi," achi hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”

paite: Jesu'n huai thu agen khit in, alungsim amangbang a, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, na lak ua mi khat in kei hon mansak ding," chi in atheisakta hi.
english: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

paite: Huan nungzuite'n achih pen athei kei ua, aki-entuah chiat uhi.
english: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.

paite: Anungzuite lak a khat, Jesu'n a-itpa, dohkan sik ah Jesu angsung ah kingai in a-om hi.
english: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ chest.

paite: Simon Peter in huai mi kiang ah, kua pen thu ahia agen dong ding in akhutvan hi.
english: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”

paite: Jesu awm ngai mah in a-awnphei a, akiang ah, "Toupa, kua pen ahia?" achi hi.
english: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ chest, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”

paite: Jesu'n, "Tanghou them ka diah a, ka piakpa ahi ding," chi in adawng hi. Huchi in tanghou them adiah zoh in Simon tapa, Judas Iskariot in kiang ah apia hi.
english: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

paite: Tanghou them apiak nung in asung ah Setan alutta hi. Huchi in Jesu'n akiang ah, "Na hih ding hih meng in," achi hi.
english: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”

paite: Dohkan a omte'n bang tum a hiai thu gen hiam chih athei kei uh.
english: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.

paite: Akhen in Judas in dangka ip akep ziak in, Jesu'n ankuangluina a ding thil kiphamoh peuh lei in, chi hiam, migentheite kiang ah banghiam piak ding, chi hiam asa uhi.
english: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.

paite: Huan tanghou them la in, apawtkhe pah a; huai tuh zan lai ahi.
english: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.

paite: Huaiziak in apawt nung in, Jesu'n agen a, "Tu in Mihing Tapa pahtawi in a-omta a, Pathian leng amah ziak in pahtawi in a-om hi.
english: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.

paite: Amah a Pathian pahtawi a a-omleh amah leng Pathian mahmah in apahtawi ding a, apahtawi pahta ding hi.
english: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.

paite: Naute aw, hun tomchik na kiang uah ka om lai tadih hi. Nou na hon zong ding uh; Judate kiang a, ka paina ding ah nou na hong pai thei kei ding uh chih ka gen bang in, tu in huchi mah bang in na kiang uah ka gen ahi.
english: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.

paite: Thupiak thak ka hon pia ahi, ki-ittuah chiat un; ke'n nou ka hon it bang in, nou leng ki-ittuah un.
english: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.

paite: Na ki-ittuah uleh mi tengteng in ka nungzuite na hi uh chih hiai ah athei ding uh," achi hi.
english: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”

paite: Simon Peter in akiang ah, "Toupa, koi a hoh ding na hia? achi hi. Jesu'n, ka hohna ding ah nang tu in na hon zui thei kei ding; tunung chiang in zaw na hon zui ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”

paite: Peter in akiang ah, "Toupa, bang ding in ahia tua leng ka hon zuih theih louh ding? Nangmah ziak in ka hinna ka koihkhe ding," achi hi.
english: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”

paite: Jesu'n, "Keimah ziak in na hinna na koihkhe ding maw? Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, nang thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl ma in ak akhuang kei ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.

paite: "Na lungtang uh hihmangbat in om kei hen; Pathian na gingta ua, kei leng hon gingta sam un.
english: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.

paite: Ka Pa inn ah tenna mun tampi a-om; a-om lou hileh, ka hon hilhta ding hi; noute a dia mun bawl ding a kuan dek ka hi.
english: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.

paite: Huan nou a dia mun bawl ding a ka kuanleh ka hong kik nawn ding a, ka kiang ah nou ka hon la ding, ka omna a nou leng na om theih samna ding un.
english: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.

paite: Ka hohna ding alampi na thei uh," achi hi.
english: You know where I go, and you know the way.”

paite: Thomas in akiang ah, "Toupa, koi a hoh ding na hia ka thei kei uh, alampi bang ka chi theih ding ua?" achi hi.
english: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Keimah tuh huai lampi, huai thutak leh huai hinna ka hi; keimah a pai lou kuamah Pa kiang atung kei," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

paite: "Kei na hon theih khit uleh ka Pa leng na thei khinta ding uh; tu a kipan amah na thei ua muh leng na muta uhi," achi hi.
english: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him and have seen him.”

paite: Philip in akiang ah, "Toupa, huai Pa kou hon ensak in, huchi in kou a ding in ahun ding,” achi hi.
english: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Philip, hiai tanpi na kiang ah ka om a, huchi a leng hon thei lou maw? Kuapeuh kei hon mu tuh Pa mu ahi. Huai Pa kou hon musak in bangchi chih a na chih ahia?
english: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?

paite: Kei Pa ah ka om a, keimah ah Pa a-om chih na gingta kei a hia? Na kiang ua thu ka gen, keimah phuahtawm in ka gen kei; keimah ah Pa a-om gige a, thil ahih zaw nak hi.
english: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.

paite: Kei Pa a ka omleh Pa keimah a a-om gingta un; ahihkeileh thilhih ziak bek in hon gingta un.
english: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

paite: Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh hon gingta in ka thilhihte ahih sam ding; hiai sang a thupizaw leng ahih ding, Pa kiang a ka pai ding ziak in.
english: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.

paite: Huan ka min a na nget peuhmah uh ka hih zel ding, Tapa a Pa pahtawi a a-omtheihna ding in.
english: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

paite: Nou ka min a bangpeuh na hon nget uleh, ka hih zel ding hi," achi hi.
english: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.

paite: "Nou na hon it uleh, ka thupiakte na zui ding uhi.
english: If you love me, keep my commandments.

paite: Huan Pa ka ngen dia, ama'n Khamuanpa dang ahon pe ding, tangtawn a na kiang ua om ding in;
english: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:

paite: huai thutak Kha; khovel in aneih theih louh ahi, amah amuh louh a, atheih louh behlap ziak in; nou amah na thei ua, na kiang uah a-om gige ngal a, noumau sung ah a-om ding hi.
english: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.

paite: "Tagah ding in ka hon paisan kei ding; na kiang uah ka hong pai nawn ding hi.
english: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

paite: Sawt louchik sung khovel in ahon mu nawn kei ding; himahleh nou zaw na hon mu ding uh; keimah ka hin ziak in nou leng na hing sam ding uhi.
english: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.

paite: Huai ni chiang in kei ka Pa a ka om leh nou keimah a na om bang un, kei noumau a ka omdan na thei ding uhi.
english: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

paite: "Kuapeuh ka thupiakte nei a, zui tuh kei hon it ahi; kuapeuh kei hon it ka Pa'n a-it ding, ke'n leng amah ka it ding a, akiang ah ka hihna ka kilak ding," achi hi.
english: One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”

paite: Huan Judas, Iskariot lou pen in akiang ah, "Toupa, koute kiang a na kilak a, khovel kiang a na kilak louh se ding bangziak ahia?" achi hi.
english: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”

paite: Jesu'n adawng a, akiang ah, "Mi'n ahon itleh ka thute azui ding a; ka Pa'n amah a-it dia, akiang ah ka hong pai ding ua, amah toh ka tengkhawm gige ding uhi.
english: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.

paite: Kuapeuh hon itlou in ka thu azui kei; na thuzakte uh kei a ahi kei a, Pa hon sawlpa a ahi zaw.
english: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.

paite: "Na kiang ua ka om takdih sung in, hiai thute ka hon hilh ahi.
english: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.

paite: Khamuanpa, Kha Siangthou, Pa in ka min a hon sawl ding in bangkim nou ahon sinsak ding a, na kiang ua ka gen tengteng nou ahon theikhesak nawn lai ding.
english: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.

paite: "Khamuanna ka hon nutsiat hi; keimah khamuanna ka hon pia; khovel in apiak bang in ka hon pe kei. Na lungtang uh hihmangbat in om kei hen, lauh leng lau kei hen.
english: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

paite: Ka paimang ding a, na kiang uah ka hong pai nawn ding, ka hon chih omdan na theita uh. Nou na hon it uh leh Pa kiang a ka pai ding ziak in na kipak ding uh ahi; keimah sang in Pa athupizaw ngal a.
english: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.

paite: Tu in hiai thil ahong tun chiang a na gintak theihna ding un ahong tun ma in ka hon hilh ahi.
english: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.

paite: Na kiang uah thu ka gen tam nawn kei ding, khovel vaihawmpa ahong pai dek ziak in; ama'n keimah ah bangmah anei kei hi.
english: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.

paite: Himahleh ke'n Pa ka it chih leh Pa in hon thupiak bang zel in thil ka hih chih, khovel in atheihna ding uh ahi ve. Dingh dih ua, hiai a kipan i paikhe ding uh.
english: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.

paite: "Kei grepgui dik ka hi, ka Pa akempa ahi.
english: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.

paite: Kei a hiang gah lou peuhmah alamang a; agah peuhmah tamsem agahna ding in ahahsiang hi.
english: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.

paite: Na kiang ua ka thugen ziak in tu'n ah na siangthou pah uhi.
english: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.

paite: Keimah ah om gige un, kei leng noumau ah ka om gige ding. Hiang, grepgui a a-om gige keileh amah in agah thei kei bang in, nou leng keimah a na om gige kei uleh, na gah thei kei ding uhi.
english: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.

paite: "Kei agrepgui ka hi a, nou ahiangte na hi uh. Kuapeuh keimah a om gige a, kei leng amah a ka om gigena, huai mah tampi in agah hi; keimah lou in bangmah na hihthei kei uhi.
english: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

paite: Mi kei a a-om gige keileh hiang bang a paihkhiak in a-om a, avuai hi; huan atawm ua mei ah apai ua, akang hi.
english: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.

paite: Nou keimah a na om gige ua, ka thu leng noumau a a-om gigeleh na ut peuh uh ngen un, nou a ding in hih in a-om ding hi.
english: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.

paite: Hiai ziak in tampi a na gah chiang un ka Pa pahtawi in a-om hi, huchi in ka nungzuite na hi ding uhi.
english: “In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.

paite: Pa'n kei ahon it mah bang in ka hon it hi; ka itna ah om gige un.
english: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

paite: Nou ka thupiakte na zuih uleh ka itna ah na om gige ding uhi, ke'n ka Pa thupiakte ka zui a, a-itna a ka om gige mah bang in.
english: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.

paite: "Ka kipah noumau a a-om gige theihna ding in leh na kipah uh akimna ding in hiai thu na kiang uah ka gen ahi.
english: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.

paite: Hiai ka thupiak ahi, ke'n nou ka hon it bang in, noumau leng ki-ittuah un.
english: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.

paite: Mihing in alawm a dia ahinna apiak sang a itna thupizaw kuama'n anei kei.
english: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

paite: Thu ka hon piak peuhmah na hih uleh ka lawmte na hi ding uh.
english: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.

paite: Sikha ka hon chi nawn kei ding; apu thilhih sikha in atheih louh ziak in; lawmte ka hon chi zawta ding; Pa kiang a ka thil zak tengteng na kiang uah ka hon theisakta hi.
english: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.

paite: Nou na hon tel kei ua, ke'n ka hon tel zaw hi, va gah ding leh na gah uh om gige ding in ka hon sep ahi; ka min a Pa kiang a na nget peuhmah uh ahon piakna ding in.
english: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.

paite: Hiaite ka hon thupiak ahi, ki-ittuah chiat un.
english: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.

paite: "Khovel in nou ahon huatleh ahon huat ma in keimah ahon ho khinta chih thei un.
english: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.

paite: Nou khovel a hi le uchin, khovel in amah a a-it ding; khovel a kipan ka hon telkhiak zawk ziak in, khovel in nou ahon hua hi.
english: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

paite: Apu sang in sikha athupizaw kei, chih thu ka hon hilhta hi, hiai theigige un. Amau kei ahon sawi uleh, nou leng ahon sawi ding uh; ka thu zui hita le uh, noumau thu leng azui ding uhi.
english: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.

paite: Himahleh hiai thil tengteng ka min ziak in na tung uah ahih ding uh, hon sawlpa atheih louh ziak un.
english: But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.

paite: Kei hong pai lou in akiang uah thu gen kei leng khelhna nei lou ding hi ua, himahleh tu in akhelhna uah paulap ding aneita kei uhi.
english: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

paite: Kuapeuh kei hon hua in, ka Pa leng ahua ahi.
english: He who hates me, hates my Father also.

paite: Midang kuamah hih ngeilouhte alak ua hih lou hi taleng, khelhna nei lou ding hi ua, himahleh tu in amau kei leh ka Pa, ka nih un ahon muta uh, huat leng hon hota uhi.
english: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and also hated both me and my Father.

paite: Adan uah, amau aziak om lou in hon hua uh chih, thu kigelh pen, ahong tangtunna ding ua hih uh ei ve.
english: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’

paite: "Huan Pa a kipan Khamuanpa na kiang ua ka hon sawl ding, Pa a kipan thutak Kha ahong tun chiang in, keimah hon theihpih ding hi.
english: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.

paite: Atung a kipan a kei toh omkhawm na hih ziak un nou leng na theihpih ding uhi.
english: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.

paite: "Lungkia a na paimanglouhna ding un na kiang uah hiai thute ka genta hi.
english: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.

paite: Sinagogte ah ahon nongsak ding ua; kuapeuh nou hon that Pathian tung a thil hoih hih in akithei ding ua huai bang hun hong tung ding ahi.
english: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.

paite: Huai thilte ahih ding ua, Pa leh kei hon theih louh ziak un.
english: They will do these things because they have not known the Father nor me.

paite: Hiai thute na kiang uah ka genta hi, ahun ahong tun chiang a, ka hon hilh khinta chih na theih nawnna ding un. Hiai thilte na kiang ua ka om takdih ziak in atung a ka hon hilh louh him na hi uhi.
english: But I have told you these things so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.

paite: "Tu in hon sawlpa kiang ah ka pai ding a noute kuamah in, koi a hoh ding? chi in na hon dong kei uh.
english: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’

paite: Hiai thute na kiang ua ka gen ziak in na lungtang uh lungkhamna in adimzou hialta hi.
english: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.

paite: Himahleh thutak ka hon hilh ahi; ka pai nou a ding in ahoihzaw hi; ka pai keileh na kiang uah Khamuanpa ahong tung kei ding a; ka paileh bel na kiang ua hon sawl ding ka hi.
english: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.

paite: Amah ahong tun chiang in khelhna thute ah, diktatna thute ah, leh vaihawmna thute toh kisai a khovel asiamlouhdan atheisak ding hi.
english: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;

paite: Khelhna thu ah siam louh atang ding uh, kei hon gintak louh ziak un.
english: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;

paite: Diktatna thu ah siam louh atang ding uh; Pa kiang ah ka pai ding; nou kei na hon muh nawn tak louh ding ziak un.
english: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;

paite: Vaihawmna thu ah siam louh atang ding uh; hiai khovel lal siam louh a apuk tak ziak in.
english: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.

paite: "Na kiang uah gen ding tampi ka nei lai a, himahleh tu in zaw na chin tadih kei uhi.
english: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.

paite: Himahleh amah Thutak Kha ahong tun chiang in, thutak tengteng ah nou ahon pi ding; ama phuahtawm in thu agen kei dia; azak peuhmah agen zaw ding, thil hong tung dingte leng nou ahon theisak ding hi.
english: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.

paite: Ama'n kei ahon pahtawi ding a; kei a ala ding a, nou kiang ah ahon theisak ding hi.
english: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.

paite: Pa'n thil aneih tengteng kei a ahi; huaiziak in kei a ala ding a, na kiang uah ahon theisak ding, ka chi hi.
english: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.

paite: "Sawt louchik in nou kei na hon mu kei ding ua; sawt louchik mah in na hon mu nawn ding uh," achi hi.
english: “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”

paite: Anungzuite khenkhat in, i kiang ua athugen bang ahi, sawt louchik in nou kei na hon mu kei ding uh, sawt louchik mah in na hon mu nawn ding uh achih leh Pa kiang a ka hoh dek ziak in, achih? akichi uhi.
english: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”

paite: Amau mah in, sawt louchik, achih bang chihna ahia? Athugen i theisiam kei uh, achi uhi.
english: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”

paite: Huan amah dot ut anei uh chih Jesu'n athei a, akiang uah, "Sawt louchik in nou kei na hon mu kei ding uh, sawt louchik mah in nou kei na hon mu nawn ding uh chi a ka thugen na kidong uh maw?
english: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?

paite: Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, na khitui uh ake ding a, na kap huphup ding uh, khovel bel akipak ding; na lungkham ding ua, himahleh na lungkham uh kipahna asuak ding hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

paite: Numei nau nei ding in avei lai in alungkham nak hi, ahun atun tak ziak in; himahleh nau asuahtak in alunggimna athei nawnta kei hi, khovel a naungek hong pian a akipah ziak in.
english: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.

paite: Tu in nou na lungkham uh; himahleh ka hon mu nawn ding a, na lungtang uh akipak ding, na kipahna uh kuamah in hon laksak kei ding hi.
english: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.

paite: Huai ni chiang in nou kei bangmah na hon ngen kei ding uh. Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, Pa kiang a bangpeuh ka min a na nget uleh ahon pe ding hi.
english: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.

paite: Tutan in ka min in bangmah na ngen nai kei uh. Ngen un, huchi in na mu ding uh, na kipah uh akimna ding in.
english: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.

paite: "Huai thute ahem in na kiang uah ka genta hi; ahun atung dekta, huai hun chiang in na kiang uah ahem in thu ka gen nawnta kei ding a, chiantak in Pa tanchin ka hon hilh ding hi.
english: “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

paite: Huai ni chiang in keimah min in thil na ngen ding uh; Pa kiang ah ke'n ka hon ngetsak ding ka chi kei hi.
english: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,

paite: Pa in amah ngei in noute ahon it ngal a, nou kei na hon it ua, Pa a kipan ka hi chih na hon gintak ziak un.
english: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.

paite: Kei Pa kiang a kipan hong pawt a, khovel a hong pai ka hi a; khovel paisan a, Pa kiang a pai nawn ding ka hi,” achi hi.
english: I came from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world and go to the Father.”

paite: Huan anungzuite'n akiang ah, "Ngai dih, tu in teltak in na genta, ahem in na genta kei hi! achi uhi.
english: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.

paite: Nang bangkim na thei a, kuamah hon dot na kiphamoh kei chih tu in ka theita uh; hiai ziak in Pathian kiang a kipan hong pai na hi chih ka gingta uhi," achi uhi.
english: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”

paite: Jesu'n adawng a akiang uah, "Tu in na gingta uh maw?
english: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?

paite: Ngai un, ahun hong tung ding ahita, tu in leng atung lellel hi, huai hun chiang in noumau inn chiat ah na dalh vek ding ua, keimah kia na hon nuse ding uh. Himahleh ka kiang a Pa a-om ziak in keimah kia in ka om kei hi.
english: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

paite: Hiai thute na kiang uah ka genta hi, keimah a na khamuanna ding un. Khovel ah gimthuakna na nei ding uh, himahleh khamuangtak in om un, ke'n khovel ka zouta,” achi hi.
english: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”

paite: Huai thute Jesu'n agen khit in van lam nga in, "Pa ahun atungta, Tapa in nang ahon pahtawi theihna ding in na Tapa pahtawi in;
english: Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;

paite: huchi a mi tengteng tung a thunei a na bawl in, akiang a na piak peuhmahte tangtawn hinna apiaktheihna ding in.
english: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.

paite: Hiai tangtawn hinna ahi, nang Pathian tak kia leh na sawl Jesu Khrist theih.
english: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.

paite: Nang thilhih ding na hon piakte ka hih khinta a, khovel ah ka hon pahtawita hi.
english: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.

paite: Pa aw, khovel om ma a na kiang a thupina ka neih in, tu in nangmah kiang ngei ah hon pahtawi in.
english: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.

paite: "Nang khovel a kipan a mi, kei na hon piakte kiang ah na min ka hihlangta; amau nang a ahi ua, nang amaute kei na hon piak ahi uh; amau lah na thu azuita uhi.
english: “I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.

paite: Nang kei na hon piak tengteng nang a kipan ahi chih atheita uhi.
english: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,

paite: Nang thu na hon piakte akiang uah ka peta a; huaite akem ua, nang a kipan ka hi chih diktak in atheita uh, nang na hon sawl chih leng agingta uhi.
english: for the words which you have given me I have given to them; and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you. They have believed that you sent me.

paite: "Amaute a ding a ngetsak ka hi. Khovel a dia ngetsak ka hi kei, nang na hon piakte a ding ahi zaw, nang a ahi uhi.
english: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.

paite: Thil tengteng kei a peuhmah nang a ahi a, nang a lah kei a ahi a; amau ziak in pahtawi in ka om hi.
english: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.

paite: Huan kei zaw khovel ah ka omta kei ding, hiaite bel khovel ah a-om ding uh; kei na kiang ah ka hong paidekta hi. Pa Siangthou aw, nang kei na hon piakte na min in hum in pum khat ahihtheihna ding un, eimah pum khat i hih bang in.
english: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.

paite: Akiang ua ka om sung in, nang kei na hon piakte na min in ka hum a; amau ka don a, alak ua khat leng amangthang kei hi, mangthang tapa lou ngal, Laisiangthou atangtun theihna ding in.
english: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

paite: Himahleh tu in na kiang ah ka hong paidekta; khovel ah hiai thute ka gen ahi, ka kipahna amau ua aneih kimna ding un.
english: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.

paite: Na thu akiang uah ka peta hi; khovel in amau ahua a, khovel a ahih louh ziak un, kei khovel a ka hih louh mah bang in.
english: I have given them your word. The world hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

paite: Nang amaute khovel a kipan na lakkhiak ding ngen ka hi kei a, migilou lak ah na hum ding ka chi ahi zaw hi.
english: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.

paite: Amau khovel a ahi kei uh, kei khovel a ka hih louh mah bang in.
english: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

paite: Amau thutak in hihsiangthou in, na thu thutak ahi.
english: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.

paite: Nang khovel a kei na hon sawl bang in, khovel ah amaute ka sawl hi.
english: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.

paite: Amau ziak in ka kihihsiangthou a, amaute leng thutak a asianthouna ding un.
english: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.

paite: "Hiaite a ding kia a ngetsak ka hi kei, athugen ziak ua kei hon gingta lai dingte a ding in leng ka ngetsak hi; avek ua pum khat ahihna ding un;
english: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,

paite: Pa, nang keimah a na om leh kei nangmah a ka om bang in, amau leng eimah a a-omna ding un; nang kei na hon sawl chih khovel in ataksan theihna ding in.
english: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.

paite: Huan nang thupina na hon piak ke'n amau ka peta; amau pum khat ahihtheihna ding un, ei pum khat i hih mah bang in.
english: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them, that they may be one, even as we are one,

paite: Kei amau ah, nang kei ah, amau pum khat a a-om ua abukim theihna ding un; nang kei na hon sawl chih leh na hon it bang in amaute na it chih khovel in atheihtheihna ding in.
english: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one, that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.

paite: "Pa, nang kei na hon piakte, ka omna a ka kiang a om ding in ka deih; leilung pian ma a itna a nang na hon piak ka thupina amuhtheihna ding un.
english: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.

paite: Pa diktat aw, khovel in nang hon thei kei mahleh, ke'n zaw ka hon thei hi; hiaite'n leng nang kei na hon sawl chih athei uhi.
english: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.

paite: Huan akiang uah na min ka theisakta a, ka theisak lai ding, nang kei na hon itna bangbang na itna amau a a-om a, kei leng amau a ka omtheihna ding in,” achi hi.
english: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”

paite: Jesu'n huai thute agen khit in anungzuite toh apawt ua, Kidron luita akan ua, huai ah huan khat a-om hi. Huai ah amah leh anungzuite alut uhi.
english: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.

paite: Huan amansak dingpa Judas in leng huai mun athei a; huai ah anungzuite toh Jesu ava tawlnga zelzel uhi.
