english: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.

paite: Huchi in Judas in sepaih pawl, siampu liante leh Pharisaite kiang a om heutute api a, khawnvakte, meiselte, galvante tawi in huai ah ahong pai uhi.
english: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.

paite: Jesu'n atung a thil tung ding tengteng atheigige a, ava pawt a, akiang uah, "Kua ahia na zon uh?" achi hi.
english: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Nazaret Jesu," chi in adawng uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Keimah ka hi," achi hi.
english: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.

paite: Amansakpa Judas leng alak uah adingh a, "Keimah ka hi," achihtak in, anungtolh ua, lei ah apuk duam uhi.
english: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward and fell to the ground.

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Kua ahia na zon uh?" chi in adong nawn hi. Amau, "Nazaret Jesu," achi uhi.
english: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n, "Keimah ka hi chih ka hon hilhta a; nou kei hon zong na hih uleh hiaite hoihtak in khah un," achi a adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”

paite: "Nang kei na hon piakte khat leng ka mangsak kei," chi a athugen atangtunna ding ahi.
english: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”

paite: Huan Simon Peter in anamsau vom adokkhia a siampu lianpen sikha asat a, abil taklam asatkhiaksak hi. Huai sikha min Malkas ahi.
english: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.

paite: Huchi in Peter kiang ah Jesu'n, "Na namsau apai ah siat in; Pa in nou ahon piak ka dawn kei dia hia?" achi hi.
english: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”

paite: Huchi in sepaih pawl leh Judate heutute'n Jesu aman ua, ahenta uhi.
english: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him,

paite: Annas kiang ah api masa uh, amah Kaiapha sunghpa ahih ziak in. Kaiapha, huai kum a siampu lianpen ahi.
english: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

paite: Kaiapha bel, mi tengteng sang a mi khat sih ahoihzaw chi a, Judate hanthawnpa ahi.
english: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.

paite: Huan Simon Peter in nungzui dang khat toh Jesu azui hi. Huai nungzuipa siampu lianpen meltheih ahi a, siampu lianpen huangsung intual ah, Jesu kiang ah alut sam hi.
english: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;

paite: Himahleh polam a kongkhak bul ah Peter adingh hi. Huchi in nungzui dang siampu lianpen meltheih khat ava pawt a, kongkhak ngaknu ahoupih a, Peter apilut hi.
english: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.

paite: Kongkhak ngak, nungak in Peter kiang ah, "Nang leng hiai mi nungzuite lak a pang sam na hi hia?" achi hi.
english: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”

paite: Ama'n, "Ka hi kei," achi hi. Sikhate leh heutute huai ah adingh uhi. Avot ziak in meihol in mei atoh ua, meilum a-awi uhi. Peter leng akiang uah a-om a, dingh kawm in meilum a-awi sam hi.
english: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.

paite: Siampu lianpen in Jesu anungzuite tanchin leh athusinsak adong hi.
english: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.

paite: Jesu'n adawng a, akiang ah, "Khovel kiang ah vantang theih in, thu ka gen gige hi; sinagog, tempul leh Judate omkhawmnate ah thu ka hilh zel a, asim in bangmah ka gen kei.
english: Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.

paite: Bang achia kei hon dong? Akiang ua ka thugen ka thuzate dong in, ngai in, amaute'n ka thugen athei uh akei hiam," achi hi.
english: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, they know the things which I said.”

paite: Huan agentak in akiang a dingh heutu khat in Jesu abeng a, "Siampu lianpen hichibang in na dawng maw?" achi hi.
english: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Thudiklou gen ka hihleh, adiklouhna hon theisak in; himahleh, ka thugen dik ahihleh bang achia hon beng?" achi hi.
english: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”

paite: Huan Annas in hensa in siampu lianpen Kaiapha kiang ah asawl hi.
english: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.

paite: Simon Peter in dingh kawm in meilum a-awi hi. "Nang leng anungzuite lak a pang sam na hi hia?" achi uhi. Ama'n, "Ka hi kei," chi in akitheihmohbawl hi.
english: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”

paite: Huan siampu lianpen sikha khat Peter in abil satkhiaksakpa sanggampa'n, akiang ah, "Huan ah ka hon mu kei maw?" achi hi.
english: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”

paite: Huchi in Peter in akitheih-mohbawl nawn a; huan ak akhuang pah hi.
english: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.

paite: Kaiapha inn a pan in Vaihawmna inn ah Jesu api nawn ua; huai zingsang ahi a; amau ahihleh Vaihawmna inn ah alut kei uh, alut un zaw buah in, Paikan Ankuanglui ane thei kei ding uhi.
english: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.

paite: Amaute kiang ah Pilat ava pawt a, "Hiai mi tung ah hekna bang ahia na neih uh?" achi hi.
english: Pilate therefore went out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Hiai migilou hi keileh na kiang ah ka hon pi kei ding uh," chi in adawng uhi.
english: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”

paite: Huan Pilat in akiang uah, "Nou pi unla, na dan bang un vai hawmsak un," achi hi. Judate'n akiang ah, "Kou thu in kuamah hihlup dan bang ahi kei," achi uhi.
english: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is illegal for us to put anyone to death,”

paite: Hiai thu asihdan ding, Jesu'n agen bang a atangtunna ding ahi.
english: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

paite: Huchi in insung ah Pilat alut nawn a, Jesu asam a, akiang ah, "Judate' Kumpipa na hi hia?" achi hi.
english: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”

paite: Jesu'n, "Hiai ka tungtang thu nangmah lungsim puakkhiak a na gen hia, midang in hon hilh?" chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”

paite: Pilat in, "Kei Juda mi ka hi a hia? Nangmah chipihte leh siampu liante'n ka kiang ah ahon pekhia ua ahi; thil bang ahia na hih?" chi in adawng hi.
english: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”

paite: Jesu'n, "Ka kumpi hihna hiai khovel ahi kei; ka kumpi hihna hiai khovel a hileh Judate kiang a piak a ka omlouhna ding in, ka sikhate'n adou ding uh. Himahleh ka kumpi hihna zaw hiai khovel a kipan ahi kei," chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”

paite: Pilat in akiang ah, "Huchi, nang kumpipa na hi mawleh?" achi hi. Jesu'n, "Kumpipa ka hi na hon chi mah ve. Thutak theihsak ka piansan leh khovel a ka hong paisan ahi. Kuapeuh thutak a om peuhmah in ka thu asang uh," achi hi.
english: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”

paite: Pilat in akiang ah, "Thutak bang ahia?" achi hi. Huan huai thu agen khit in, Judate kiang ah ava pawt nawn a, akiang uah, "Bangmah agitlouhna ka mu kei," achi hi.
english: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, “I find no basis for a charge against him.

paite: Himahleh Paikan Ankuangluina ah mi khat ka hon pawtsakna ding dan na nei uh; huchi in "Judate' Kumpipa hon pawtsak leng na ut uhia?" achi hi.
english: But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

paite: Amau akikou nawn ua, "Hiai mi hi kei henla, Barabbas pen hi zaw hen," achi uhi. Barabbas tuh suamhat ahi.
english: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.

paite: Huchi in Pilat in Jesu api a, azep hi.
english: So Pilate then took Jesus and flogged him.

paite: Huan sepaihte'n linglukhu aphan ua, akhusak ua, puan sandup leng asilhsak uh.
english: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.

paite: Akiang ah ahong pai ua, "Chibai, Judate' Kumpipa," achi ua, abeng uhi.
english: They kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and they kept slapping him.

paite: Huan Pilat apawt nawn a, akiang uah, "En un, bangmah agitlouhna ka mu kei chih na theihna ding un, na kiang uah ka hon pikhia hi,” achi hi.
english: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”

paite: Jesu, linglukhu khu in leh puan sandup silh in ahong pawt hi. Pilat in akiang uah, "En un, Mihing!" achi hi.
english: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”

paite: Huan siampu liante leh heutute'n amah amuhtak un akikou ua, "Kros ah kilhden in, kros ah kilhden in," achi uhi. Pilat in akiang uah, "Noumau paipih unla, kros ah kilhden un; ke'n zaw bangmah agitlouhna ka mu ngal kei hi,” achi hi.
english: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”

paite: Judate'n akiang ah, "Ka dan uh khat a-om, huai dan bang zel in Pathian Tapa a akibawl ziak in asi ding ahi," achi ua, adawng uhi.
english: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”

paite: Pilat in huai thu azak in alau nawn semsem hi.
english: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.

paite: Ama inpi sung ah va lut nawn in Jesu kiang ah, "Koi a hong kipan na hia?" achi hi. Himahleh Jesu'n adawng kei.
english: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.

paite: Pilat in akiang ah, "Nang kei hon houpih lou ding maw? Hon khah thei leh kros a hon kilhden thei ka hi chih na thei kei a hia?" achi hi.
english: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”

paite: Jesu'n, "Tunglam a kipan piak hi kei lechin, ka tung ah hihtheih na nei kei ding. Huaiziak in na kiang a hon pekhepa'n khelhna lianzaw apua hi," achi hi.
english: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”

paite: Huai nungsiah Pilat in khah atum a; himahleh Judate akikou ua, "Hiai mi na khahleh Kaisar lawm na hi kei; kuapeuh kumpipa a kibawl Kaisar dou ahi,” achi uhi.
english: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”

paite: Pilat in huai thu azak in Jesu apikhia a, amin Suanglep, Hebru pau a Gabbatha achih uh, huai mun ah thukhenna tutphah ah atu hi.
english: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”

paite: Huan huai ni Paikan Ankuangluina kiginni ahi a, dak gukna vel ahi. Huan ama'n Judate kiang ah, "En un, na Kumpipa uh," achi hi.
english: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”

paite: Huan amau akikou ua, "Hihmangthang in, hihmangthang in, kros ah kilhden in," achi uhi. Pilat in akiang uah, "Na kumpipa uh kros ah ka kilhden ding maw?" achi hi. Siampu liante'n, "Kaisar lou ngal kumpipa dang ka nei kei uh," achi ua, adawng uhi.
english: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”

paite: Huchi in Pilat in kilhden ding in akiang uah amah apeta hi. Huchi in Jesu api ua, apaikhiakpih uhi.
english: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.

paite: Ama'n kros kipuak in Luguh Mun, achih uh, Hebru pau a Golgotha achih mun tan apai hi.
english: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,

paite: Huai ah kros ah alai ah Jesu midang nih asik ah khat tuaktuak toh akilhden uhi.
english: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.

paite: Pilat in lai agelh a, kros ah atak a, “NAZARET JESU, JUDATE' KUMPIPA,” chi in.
english: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

paite: Huai laigelh Judate tampi in asim ua; Jesu kros akilhdenna mun uh khopi kiang ahi a; huai Hebru pau, Grik pau leh Latin pau a gelh ahi.
english: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.

paite: Huchi in Juda siampu liante'n Pilat kiang ah, "Judate' Kumpipa, chi in gelh ke'n; Judate' Kumpipa ka hi achi," chi in gelh zaw in, achi uhi.
english: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, “I am King of the Jews.”’”

paite: Pilat in, "Ka gelh khit, gelh khit ahita," chi in adawng hi.
english: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”

paite: Huan sepaihte'n Jesu akilhden khit un apuansilh phel li asuah ua, phel khat chiat in atang ua; apuanak leng ala uh. Puanak khui louh puanak ahi a, angawng a kipan ataw tan a gatthoh ahi.
english: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the tunic. Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

paite: Huaiziak in amau, "I botkek kei dia, kua tan ding ahi hiam, ai i san ding uh," akichi uhi. Laisiangthou a, "Ka puansilhte akihawm ua, ka puanak ding in ai asan uh," chih atangtunna ding in hiai thil sepaihte'n ahih uhi.
english: Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, “They parted my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.” Therefore the soldiers did these things.

paite: Huan Jesu kros kiang ah anu leh anu sanggam, Kleopas zi Mari leh Mari Magdalin adingh uhi.
english: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

paite: Huan Jesu'n anu leh nungzui a-itpa akiang a dingh amu a, anu kiang ah, "Numei, en in, na tapa,” achi hi.
english: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”

paite: Nungzuipa kiang ah, "En in, na nu,” achi hi. Huai dak a pan huai nungzui in a-inn ah amah pita hi.
english: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.

paite: Huai nung in, Jesu'n thil bangkim hihzoh ahita chih athei a, Laisiangthou atangtunna ding in, "Ka dang atak," achi hi.
english: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty!”

paite: Huai ah bel khat uain thuk a dim atung ua, huchi in spanji khat uain thuk a diahdim in, hissop chiangdawn a tak in, amuk ah atulhtou uhi.
english: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.

paite: Huan Jesu'n uain thuk adawn khit in, "Zoh ahita," achi a, huan alu akun a, akha akhahta hi.
english: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished!” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

paite: Huan kiginni ahih ziak in, Sabbath ni a kros a siluangte a-omlouhna ding in, (huai Sabbath ni lah ni thupi ahi ngal a), Judate'n Pilat kiang ah akhete uh hihtan a aluang uh paipih ding in angen uhi.
english: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.

paite: Sepaihte ahong pai ua, akiang a kilhden a om, tuah masakpen leh akhat pen khe ahihtansak uhi.
english: Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;

paite: Himahleh Jesu kiang ahong tun un, ana sita chih athei ua, akhete ahihtan tuan kei uhi.
english: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.

paite: Himahleh sepaihte lak a mi khat in anak ah tei in adawt a, huchi in sisan leh tui ahong luangkhia hi.
english: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.

paite: Huaite mupa'n atheisakta, athu theihsak adik ahi; agen dik chih akithei a, nou leng na gintakna ding un.
english: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.

paite: Laisiangthou in, "Aguh khat lel leng hihtan ahi kei ding," achih tangtunna ding in huai thil ahong omta hi.
english: For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”

paite: Huan Laisiangthou dang in, "Asutpa uh lam a-en ding uh,” achi hi.
english: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.”

paite: Huan huai thilte khit in, Joseph, Arimathai mi, Jesu nungzui, Judate kihtak ziak a sim-om in Jesu luang paipih ding in Pilat kiang ah angen hi. Pilat in aphal a, huchi in ahong pai a, aluang apaipihta hi.
english: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus’ body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.

paite: Huan Nikodem, atung a zan a akiang a hong in, murrah leh aloe kihelsa buk sawmnga vel tawi in ahong pai sam hi.
english: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.

paite: Jesu luang ala ua, Judate kivuidan bang in gimlimte toh puanmalngat hoih in atuam uhi.
english: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.

paite: Huan kros a akilhlupna mun uah huan khat a-om a; huan ah kuamah sial ngei nailouhna han thak khat a-om hi.
english: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.

paite: Judate kiginni ahih ziak in, han omna akiangchin uh ahih toh, huai ah Jesu asialta uhi.
english: Then, because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand), they laid Jesus there.

paite: Huan ani thum ni in, Galili gam a Kana ah kitenna a-om a, huai ah Jesu nu a-om hi.
english: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.

paite: Jesu leh anungzuite leng kitenna ah chial in a-om uhi.
english: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.

paite: Uain abeitak in Jesu nu'n akiang ah, "Uain atasamta uh e,” achi hi.
english: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Numei, nang na hon theihsak ding bang ahia om? Ka hun atung nai kei hi,” achi hi.
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”

paite: Anu'n sikhate kiang ah, "Na kiang ua agen peuhmah hih zel un,” achi hi.
english: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”

paite: Huan Judate silsiang dan bang in suang tuibel guk, buk sawmli mun nih hiam, mun thum hiam ta chiat, huai ah atung uhi.
english: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Tuibelte tui in dimsak un," achi hi. Agong toh kikim in adimsak chiat uhi.
english: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.

paite: Akiang uah, "Tu in dim unla, nekbawl thusa kiang ah paipih un," achi hi. Huchi in apaipihta uhi.
english: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.

paite: Nekbawl thusa in, tui uain hong suak achiam a, ahong kipatna athei kei a, tuidim sikhate'n ahihleh athei uh, mouneipa asam a, akiang ah,
english: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom

paite: "Michih in atung in uain hoih ahawm ua, atam deuh adawn nung un, ahoih lou ahawm uh; nang bel tutan in uain hoih na kem lailai a,” achi hi.
english: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”

paite: Jesu'n hiai a thillamdang hihpatna Galili gam Kana khua a ahih ahi; athupina alangsakta a; anungzuite'n amah agingta uhi.
english: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

paite: Huan huai khit in Kapernaum ah ahohsuk a, amah leh anu toh, a-unaute leh anungzuite toh; huai ah ni tam lou a-om uhi.
english: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.

paite: Huan Judate Paikan Ankuang-luina anaita a, Jerusalem ah Jesu ahohtou hi.
english: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

paite: Tempul a bawng, belam leh vakhu zuak leh dangka kheng a tute amu hi.
english: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.

paite: Huan khauhual in zepna ding abawl a, belam leh bawng avek un tempul a kipan adelhkhia a, dangka khengte dangka asungbua a, adohkante uh leng asawnpuksak hi.
english: He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money and overthrew their tables.

paite: Vakhu zuakte kiang ah, "Hiai thilte hiai a kipan paipih un, ka Pa inn sumsinna mun in bawl kei un," achi hi.
english: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”

paite: Huan “Na inn a ka phatuamngaihna in ahon gai ding," chih gelh ahi chih anungzuite'n athei nawnta uhi.
english: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”

paite: Huchi in Judate'n akiang ah, "Hiai na thilhih chiamtehna bang ahia na hon lah theih?" chi in adong uhi.
english: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Hiai inn hihse le uchin, ni thum sung in ka tungding nawn ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”

paite: Huan Judate'n, "Hiai inn kum sawmli-le-guk sung lam ahi, nang ni thum sung in na tungding ding maw?" achi uhi.
english: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”

paite: Himahleh amah pumpi inn thu gen ahi zaw hi.
english: But he spoke of the temple of his body.

paite: Huaiziak in misi lak a kipan athohnawn in, anungzuite'n huai thugen athei nawnta uhi. Laisiangthou thu leh Jesu thugen agingta uhi.
english: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.

paite: Huan Jerusalem a Paikan Ankuangluina a-om lai in, athil-lamdang hihte amu ua, mi tampi in amin agingta uhi.
english: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.

paite: Himahleh Jesu bel alak uah akikangkoih a, mi tengteng athei hi.
english: But Jesus didn’t entrust himself to them, because he knew everyone,

paite: Mihing thu kuamah hilhchet akiphatmoh louh ziak in; amah mah in mihing sung a om peuhmah athei ngal hi.
english: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.

paite: Nipikal a ani masapen ahong tun in, zingsangpi khomial lai in, han ah Mari Magdalin ava hoh a, hansuang lakkhiaksa in amu hi.
english: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.

paite: Huchi in atai a, Simon Peter leh nungzui dang, Jesu'n a-itpa kiang ah ahong pai a, "Han a kipan Toupa apaimangpih ua, akoihna uh ka thei kei uh," chi in agen hi.
english: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”

paite: Huchi in Peter apawt a, nungzui dang toh han lam azuan uhi.
english: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.

paite: Atai tuak ua; nungzui dang in Peter amakhelh a, han atung masa hi.
english: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.

paite: Huan kunsuk in a-en a, puanmalngat hoih amu a; himahleh asung ah alut kei hi.
english: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.

paite: Simon Peter amah nung in ahong tung sam a, han sung ah alutsuak a; puanmalngat hoih omte amu hi.
english: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,

paite: Jesu lukhung a kinulna puan pen, puanmalngat hoih lak a om lou a, atuam a khepsa a om amu hi.
english: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

paite: Huchi in nungzui dang, han tung masazaw pen leng alut sam a, amu a, agingta hi.
english: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.

paite: Misi lak a kipan a thounawn ding ahi, chih Laisiangthou gen atheigige nawn kei uhi.
english: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.

paite: Huchi in nungzuite amau inn ah apai nawnta uhi.
english: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.

paite: Himahleh han pua ah kap kawm in Mari adingh a; kap kawm in akun a, han sung a-en hi.
english: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,

paite: Huan angel nih puanngou silh, Jesu luang sialna mun ah khat alulam leh khat akhe lam a tu amu hi.
english: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

paite: Huan amau, "Numei, bangziak a kap na hia?" achi uhi. Ama'n, "Ka Toupa apaimangpih ua, akoihna uh ka theih louh ziak in," chi in adawng hi.
english: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”

paite: Huan huchi a agentak in anunglam anga a, Jesu dingh amu a, himahleh Jesu ahi chih athei kei hi.
english: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Numei, bangziak a kap na hia? Kua ahia na zon?" achi hi. Ama'n huanpu hiam asa a, akiang ah, "Pu, amah hiai a kipan a paimangpih na hihleh, na koihna hon hilh tanla, huchi in ka la ding,” achi hi.
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Mari" achi hi. Amah akihei a, akiang ah Hebru pau in, "Rabboni" achi a, (huai tuh Sinsakpa chihna ahi).
english: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang ah, "Hon lawng ke'n, tutan in leng Pa kiang ah ka kahtou nai kei hi. Himahleh ka unaute kiang ah va hoh inla, akiang uah, ka pa, na Pa uh, ka Pathian, na Pathian uh kiang ah ka kahtou dek, achi, va chi in," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”

paite: Mari Magdalin ava hoh a, nungzuite kiang ah, "Toupa ka muta," achi a, akiang ah hiai thute agen chih ahilhta hi.
english: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.

paite: Huan huai ni, nipikal a ni masapen, nitaklam ahong hih in, Judate kihtak ziak a nungzuite omna inn kongkhakte akhak nung un, Jesu ahong pai a, alak uah ahong dingh a, akiang uah, "Na tung uah khamuanna om hen," achi hi.
english: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

paite: Huai agen khit in akiang uah akhut leh anak alak a, Toupa amuhtak un nungzuite akipak uhi.
english: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Na tung uah khamuanna om hen, Pa'n kei hon sawl bang mah in nou ka hon sawl hi," achi nawn hi.
english: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”

paite: Huai thu agen khit in amau ahatkhum a, akiang uah, "Kha Siangthou tang un.
english: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!

paite: Kua khelhna leng na ngaihdam uh ngaihdam ahi ding a; kua khelhna leng na ngaihdam louh uh, ngaihdam louh ahi ding,” achi hi.
english: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”

paite: Huan Jesu ahong lai in sawm-le-nihte lak a pang sam Thomas, Didum achih uh, akiang uah a-om kei hi.
english: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.

paite: Huchi in nungzui dangte'n akiang ah, "Toupa ka muta uh," achi uhi. Himahleh ama'n akiang uah, "Akhut sikkhetna pawn ka muh a, ka khutzung a ka khoih a, anak a ka khut ka golhlut hial keileh ka gingta kei ding," achi hi.
english: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”

paite: Huan ani giat nung in, insung ah anungzuite a-om nawn ua, Thomas leng akiang uah a-om sam hi. Huan kongkhakte khak hinapi in Jesu ahong pai a, alak uah ahong dinghta a, akiang uah, "Na tung uah khamuanna om hen," achi hi.
english: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”

paite: Huan Thomas kiang ah, "Na khutzung in sawk in, ka khutte en in; na khut in khoih inla, ka nak ah sawk in; ging lou ke'nla, gingta mai in," achi hi.
english: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”

paite: Thomas in, "Ka Toupa leh ka Pathian na hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Nang zaw na hon muh ziak in na gingta ahi; mu lou a gingta peuhmahte ahampha uh," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n nungzuite ma ah chiamtehna dang tamtak ahih a, huaite hiai laibu ah gelh vek ahi kei hi.
english: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

paite: Himahleh Jesu tuh huai Khrist, Pathian Tapa ahi chih na gintakna ding uleh, na gintak ua amin a hinna na neihna ding ua gelh ahi.
english: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.

paite: Huai thilte nung in, Tiberias tuipi ah anungzuite kiang ah Jesu akilak nawn a; hichibang in amah mah akilak hi.
english: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.

paite: Simon Peter leh Thomas, Didum achih uh, Galili gam a Kana a Nathanael, Zebedai tapa nihte, anungzui dang nihte toh a-omkhawm uhi.
english: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.

paite: Simon Peter in akiang uah, "Ngasa man ding in ka kuan dek," achi a, amau akiang ah, "Kou leng na kiang ah ka hong sam ding uh," achi uhi. Apawtkhia ua, long ah atuang ua, huai zan in bangmah aman kei uhi.
english: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.

paite: Phalvak in piautak ah Jesu ava dingh a; himahleh anungzuite'n Jesu ahi chih athei kei uhi.
english: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Naute aw, nek ding banghiam na nei uhia?" achi hi. Amau akiang ah, "Nei lou," chi in adawng uhi.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Long sik taklam ah len pai le uchin na man ding uh," achi hi. Apai ua, ngasa atam ziak in akaikhe zou kei uhi.
english: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.

paite: Huchi in nungzui Jesu itpa'n Peter kiang ah, "Toupa ei ve," achi hi. Huchi in Toupa ahi chih Simon Peter in atheih in, apuanak tungsilh ateng a, amah vuaktang a om ahi a, tuipi ah atawmkheta hi.
english: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.

paite: Himahleh nungzuite'n long neuchik in, len ngasa a dim toh kai kawm in ahon zuan ua, gam a kipan in agamla ngal kei ua, tong zanih hiam phet ahi.
english: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.

paite: Huan gam a ahong suahtak un, meihol a mei tohsa atung a ngasa leh tanghou emsa amu uhi.
english: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Tu in na ngasa mat uh akhen hon latou un," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”

paite: Huchi in Simon Peter ava tuang a, ngasa lian pipi a dim tui gei ah ahon kaikhia a, zakhat sawmnga-le-thum apha hi; huchi lawmlawm in tam mahleh len akek kei hi.
english: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Zing an hong ne un," achi hi. Nungzuite lak ah kuamah in akiang ah, "Kua na hia?" chi in adong ngam kei uh. Toupa ahi chih athei uhi.
english: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.

paite: Huan Jesu ahong pai a, tanghou ala a, akiang uah apia a, ngasate leng huchibang mah in ape sam hi.
english: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

paite: Huai tuh Jesu misi lak a kipan athohnawn nung a, anungzuite kiang a akilak thumveina ahi.
english: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.

paite: Huan zing an anek khit un, Simon Peter kiang ah Jesu'n, "Simon, Johan tapa, nang hiaite sang in kei na hon itzaw hia?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Hi, Toupa, ka hon it chih na thei hi,” achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Ka belamnoute vak in," achi hi.
english: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”

paite: Huan anihveina ding in akiang ah, "Simon, Johan tapa, nang kei na hon it hia?" achi nawn hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Hi, Toupa, ka hon it chih na thei hi,” achi nawn hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Ka belamte ching in," achi hi.
english: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”

paite: Huan athumveina ding in akiang ah, "Simon, Johan tapa, nang kei na hon it hia?" achi hi. Huan thumveina a nang kei na hon it hia? chi a akiang a agen ziak in Peter alungkham a, akiang ah, "Toupa, bangkim na thei a, ka hon it chih na thei hi,” achi hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Ka belamte vak in."
english: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.

paite: "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, na naupan lai in na tai ah na kigak a, na utna peuh ah na hoh a; himahleh na upat hun chiang in na khut na zak ding a, midang in ahon gaksak ding ua, na utlouhna lam ah ahon kai ding uh," achi hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”

paite: Huai thu bangchidan a si in ahia Pathian apahtawi ding, chih theihsakna ding a agen ahi. Huai agen khit in akiang ah, "Hon zui in," achi hi.
english: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”

paite: Huai khit in Peter akihei a, Jesu nungzui itpa, nitak an nek lai a a-awm ngai a hong awnphei a, "Amansak dingpa kua pen ahia?" chipa'n, amau hon zui amu hi.
english: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”

paite: Peter in amah amuhtak in, Jesu kiang ah, "Toupa, hiai mi'n bang ahih dia?" achi hi.
english: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Ka hong pai nawn tan a om nilouh ding in deih leng, huai nang bang lunghimoh zenzen? Nang hon zui in," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”

paite: Huchi in huai nungzuipa si lou ding in athu unaute lak ah athangta a; himahleh Jesu'n asi kei ding chih akiang ah agen kei a, "K'ong pai nawn tan a om nilouh ding in deih leng, huai nang bang lunghimoh zenzen?" chi lel ahi zaw hi.
english: This saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”

paite: Huai nungzuipa, "Hiai thu theisakpa leh gelhpa ahi; huan athu theihsak adik chih i thei uhi."
english: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.

paite: Huan hiaite lou leng Jesu thilhih dang tampi a-om lai a; huaite gelh vek ding hileh, laibu gelh ding tengteng khovel ah leng tazou in ka gingta kei hi. Amen.
english: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.

paite: Pharisaite lak a mi, Judate vaihawmpa, amin Nikodem a-om hi.
english: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

paite: Huai mi zan in Jesu kiang ah ahong a, akiang ah, "Rabbi, Pathian a kipan hong pai sinsakpa na hi chih ka thei uhi. Pathian na kiang a om lou hileh hiai thillamdang na hihte kuamah in ahihthei kei ding," achi hi.
english: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher who has come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”

paite: Jesu'n adawng a, akiang ah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, mi kuapeuh apianthak keileh Pathian lalgam amu thei kei," achi hi.
english: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”

paite: Nikodem in akiang ah, "Mi atek nung in bangchi in apiangthak thei dia? Anu sung a nihvei lut in apiang thei dia hia?" achi hi.
english: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”

paite: Jesu'n adawng a, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh tui a leh Kha a apianthak keileh Pathian lalgam alut thei kei hi.
english: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.

paite: Sa suan peuhmah sa ahi a, Kha suan peuhmah kha ahi.
english: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

paite: Na pianthak ngeingei ding ahi ka hon chih lamdang sa ke'n.
english: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must all be born anew.’

paite: Huih a-utna peuh ah anung a, aging na za hi, himahleh koi a kipan hong pai ahia, koi ah ahia ahoh ding chih na thei ngal kei a; kuapeuh Kha a piang huchibang mah in a-om hi," achi hi.
english: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”

paite: Nikodem in adawng a, "Hiai bangchi in a-om thei dia?" achi hi.
english: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”

paite: Jesu'n adawng a, akiang ah, "Israelte sinsakpa na hi ngal a, huaite na thei kei maw?
english: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?

paite: Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kou ka theih uh ka gen ua, ka muh uh ka theisak uh; himahleh ka thu theihsak uh na sang kei uhi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.

paite: Lei lam thil ka hon hilh bawn gingtaloute'n, van lam thil hon hilh leng bangchi in na gingta ding ua?
english: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

paite: Mihing Tapa, van a ompa leh van a kipan hong sukpa kia lou ngal kuamah van ah akahtou ngei kei.
english: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

paite: "Huan Mosi in gamdai a gul akhaikang bang in, Mihing Tapa khaikang in a-om ding hi.
english: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

paite: Kuapeuh agingta in amah ziak a tangtawn hinna aneihna ding in.
english: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

paite: Pathian in khovel a-it mahmah ziak in, a Tapa tang neihsun apia hi. Kuapeuh amah gingtate amanthat louh ua, tangtawn hinna aneih zawkna ding un.
english: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

paite: Khovel siam louh tangsak ding in Pathian in khovel ah a Tapa asawl kei, khovel amah vang a ahintheihna ding in asawl ahi zaw hi.
english: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

paite: "Kuapeuh amah gingta siam louh in a-om kei ding a, kuapeuh agingta lou, tu a kipan siam louh in a-om pah ngal hi; Pathian Tapa tang neihsun min agintak louh ziak in.
english: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.

paite: Hiai siamlouhna ahi, khovel ah vak ahong a, himahleh mi'n vak sang in mial a-itzaw uh; athilhihte uh agitlouh ziak in.
english: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.

paite: Kuapeuh thil gilou hih in vak aho nak, vak ah leng ahong pai kei hi; huchi lou in zaw athilhihte alang kha ding hi.
english: For everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.

paite: Himahleh kuapeuh adik hihte athilhih uh Pathian ziak a hih ahi, chih alatna ding in vak ah ahong pai uhi," achi hi.
english: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”

paite: Huai khit in Jesu anungzuite toh Judia gam ah ahoh ua, huai ah Jesu akiang uah a-om nilouh a, abaptis zel uhi.
english: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.

paite: Johan in leng Ainon ah, Salim kho kiang ah abaptis sam a, huai a tui atam ziak in mi ahong ua, baptisma atang uhi.
english: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came and were baptized;

paite: Hiai hun in Johan suangkul a khum ahi nai kei hi.
english: for John was not yet thrown into prison.

paite: Huan Johan nungzuite leh Juda khenkhat silsiang thu ah akisel uhi.
english: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.

paite: Johan kiang ah ahong pai ua, akiang ah, "Rabbi, Jordan gal a na kiang a om, athu mi na theihsakpa'n, ngai dih, mi abaptis a, akiang ah mi tengteng ahong pai uh," achi uhi.
english: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”

paite: Johan in adawng a, "Van a pan a piak ahihkeileh mihing in bangmah anei thei kei uhi.
english: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.

paite: Kei Khrist ka hi kei, ama a misawl ka hi, ka chih, noumau mahmah hon theihpihte na hi uhi.
english: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’

paite: Mouneipa zaw mounu pasal ahi; himahleh mouneipa lawm ding a athu za mouneipa aw ziak in akipak mahmah a, ka kipahna atangtungta hi.
english: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.

paite: Amah alian semsem ding a, kei bel ka neu hiaihiai ding," achi hi.
english: He must increase, but I must decrease.

paite: "Tunglam a kipan hong pai zaw mi tengteng sang a tungnungpen ahi; lei a kipan bel lei a ahi a, lei lam thu agen a, van a kipan a hong paipa zaw mi tengteng sang a tungnungpen ahi.
english: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.

paite: Amuh leh azak peuh atheisak hi; kuamah in athu theihsak ataksang kei uhi.
english: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.

paite: Athu theihsak taksangmi in, Pathian midiktat ahi, chih akipsak hi.
english: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.

paite: Pathian sawl in Pathian thu agen hi; ama'n zaw teh chitchiat in Kha ape ngal kei a.
english: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.

paite: Pa in Tapa a-it a, akhut ah bangkim avek in apeta hi.
english: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.

paite: Kuapeuh Tapa gingta in tangtawn hinna anei; himahleh Tapa gingta lou in hinna anei kei ding a, Pathian thangpaihna atung ah a-om zaw," achi hi.
english: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”

paite: Johan sang in Jesu'n nungzui tamzaw abawl a, tam abaptis zaw chih Pharisaite'n aza uh chih Toupa'n atheih in.
english: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John

paite: (Jesu hial in zaw abaptis kei a, anungzuite'n abaptis zaw zel uh),
english: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),

paite: Judia gam paisan in, Galili gam ah akik nawnta hi.
english: he left Judea and departed into Galilee.

paite: Huchi in Samaria gam tawn a pai akul hi.
english: He needed to pass through Samaria.

paite: Huchi in Samaria gam khua khat, Saikar achih uh, Jakob in atapa Joseph kiang a mun apiakna kiang ahong tung hi.
english: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

paite: Huai ah Jakob tuileh a-om hi. Huchi in Jesu apaigim ziak in tuileh gei ah atu a; huai hun dak gukna khawng ahi.
english: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.

paite: Huchi in Samari numei khat tui tawi in ahong kuan a, Jesu'n akiang ah, "Dawn ding hon pia in," achi hi.
english: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”

paite: (Anungzuite lah nek ding lei in khua ah ahoh ngal ua).
english: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.

paite: Huchi in Samari numei in akiang ah, "Nang Juda mi hi chin a, kei Samari numei hi ing a, bangchidan a ka kiang a dawn ding hon ngen na hia? achi hi. Judate'n lah Samari mite bangmah in angai ngal kei ua," achi hi.
english: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)

paite: Jesu'n adawng a, akiang ah, "Pathian thilthawnpiak leh dawn ding hon pia in, na kiang a chipa thei leteh zaw nang akiang a ngen zaw ding hi chin a, ama'n tuihing hon pe ding hiven," achi hi.
english: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”

paite: Huan numei in akiang ah, "Pu, akhaikhiakna ding bangmah lah na nei kei a, tuileh athukthuk toh, koi a kipan in ahia huai tuihing na muh ding?
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?

paite: Ka pu uh Jakob sang in na thupizaw a hia? Ama'n hiai tuileh hon pia a, amah leh atate leh agante'n leng adawn uhi,” achi hi.
english: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang ah, "Kuapeuh hiai tui dawn adangtak nawn ding uh," chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,

paite: "Kuapeuh akiang a ka piak ding tui dawn bel, dangtak nawn ngei lou ding a; akiang a tui ka piak ding pen amah ah tui nak ahong phulkhe ding a, tangtawn hinpha a kikhohtou ding ahi," achi hi.
english: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”

paite: Huan numei in akiang ah, "Pu, huai tui hon pe ve, ka dangtak nawnlouhna ding leh hiai tantan a tui tawi ding a ka hong kuanlouhna ding in," achi hi.
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Pai inla, na pasal va sam inla, hiai ah hong kik nawn in,” achi hi.
english: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”

paite: Numei in akiang ah, “Pasal ka nei sam a," chi in adawng hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Pasal ka nei sam a, na chih zaw, na chi dik ve;
english: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’

paite: pasal nga na neita a, tua na neihpa pen na pasal ahi kei him ahi, hiai thu na chi dik ve,” achi hi.
english: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”

paite: Numei in akiang ah, "Pu, zawlnei na hi chih ka thei hi.
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.

paite: Kou pipute'n hiai tang ah Pathian abe zel ua; nou bel mihing in Pathian abiakna mun ding Jerusalem khua ahi, na chi sese ua," achi hi.
english: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang ah, "Numei, kei hon gingta in, hiai tang chitchiat lou leh Jerusalem khua chitchiat lou ah leng Pa na biak hun uh atungta hi.
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.

paite: Nou na theih louhpi uh na be nak ua, kou zaw ka theih uh ka bia uh; hotdamna lah Judate a kipan ahi ngal a.
english: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

paite: Himahleh Pathian be taktakte'n kha leh thutak a Pa abiak hun uh tung ding ahita, tu in leng atung lel hi, Pa'n huchibang mi abemi ding in azong hi.
english: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.

paite: Pathian zaw Kha ahi a, abemite'n kha leh thutak a abiak ngeingei ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”

paite: Numei in akiang ah, "Messia, Khrist akichi, ahong pai ding chih ka thei, amah ahong pai chiang in bangkim ahon hilh ding," achi hi.
english: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”

paite: Jesu'n, "Keimah nang hon houpihpa, huai amah ka hi," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”

paite: Huan huai lai in anungzuite ahong pai ua, numei ahoupih lamdang asa mahmah uhi; himahleh kuamah in, "Bang zong na hia? Bangziak a numei houpih?" achi kei uh.
english: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”

paite: Numei in atuibel apaisan a, khua ah ava pai a, mite kiang ah,
english: So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,

paite: "Ка thilhih peuh hon hilh zel mi khat a-om, hong unla, en dih uh; Khrist ahihtheih tuak na hiam?" achi hi.
english: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”

paite: Amaute khua a kipan ahong pawt ua, akiang lam azuanta uhi.
english: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.

paite: Huai kal in nungzuite'n akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, ne in," achi uhi.
english: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”

paite: Himahleh ama'n akiang uah, "Na theih louh uh nek ding an ka nei," achi hi.
english: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”

paite: Huan nungzuite akihou ua, "Anek ding mi'n ahon tawi ua eita maw?" akichi uhi.
english: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah agen a, "Hon sawlpa deihlam hihleh, ama nna sep zoh ding ka an ahi.
english: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.

paite: Nou, buhlakna ding kha li a-om lai, na chi uh hilou hia? Ngai un ka hon hilh ahi, dak unla loute en un, tu mahmah in lak ding in amin ahi.
english: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.

paite: Alapa'n loh amu a, tangtawn hinna ding in gah ala hi, huchi a atuhpa leh alapa akipah tuaktheihna ding un.
english: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.

paite: Khat in atuh a, midang in ala chih thu hiai ah adik hi.
english: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’

paite: Na sepgim louh uh at dia hon sawl ka hi; midang in asem ua, nou asepsa uh na sunzom uh ahi," achi hi.
english: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”

paite: Huan numei in, "Ka thilhih peuh hon hilh zel," chi a atheihsak thu ziak in huai khua a om Samari mi tampi in Jesu agingta uhi.
english: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”

paite: Huchi in Jesu kiang ah Samari mite ahong pai ua, akiang ua om ding in akhou ngutngut ua; huchi in huai ah ni nih ataam hi.
english: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.

paite: Huan midang tampi in amah thu ziak in agingta samta uhi.
english: Many more believed because of his word.

paite: Amau numei kiang ah, "Tu in zaw na thugen ziak a gingta ka hi kei uh; koumau ngei in athu ka za ua, hiai mipa Khrist, khovel Hondampa ngei ahi chih ka theita uh," achi uhi.
english: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”

paite: Huan ni nih nung in huai a pan pawt in, Galili gam ah apaita hi.
english: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.

paite: Jesu ngei in, zawlnei zaw ama kholam ah pahtawi in a-om ngei kei chih atheihpih hi.
english: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.

paite: Huchi in Galili gam ahong tun in Galili gam mite'n ana kipahpih ua, Jerusalem a ankuanglui lai a athilhih tengteng amuh tak ziak un; amau mah leng ankuangluina ah ahoh sam uhi.
english: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.

paite: Galili gam a Kana khua, tui uain asuahsakna mun ahong tung nawnta hi. Kumpi milian kuahiam a-om a, Kapernaum ah atapa achina hi.
english: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.

paite: Judia gam a kipan Galili gam ah Jesu ahong chih azak in akiang ah ahohtou a, va hohsuk a atapa si dekdek hihdam ding in achial hi.
english: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte na muh kei uleh na gingta kei hial ding uh," achi hi.
english: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”

paite: Huan Kumpi milian in akiang ah, "Pu, ka ta asih ma in hong suk mai in," achi hi.
english: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Pai nawnta in, na tapa adamta," achi hi. Huai mipa'n, Jesu'n akiang a thu agen agingta a, apaita hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.

paite: Apaisuk lai in asikhate'n ana dawn ua, "Na tapa adamta," ana chi uhi.
english: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah adam tung lai adong hi. Amau akiang ah, "Zan in dak sagihna ah akhosik ahong daita hi," achi uhi.
english: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”

paite: Naupang pa'n Jesu'n akiang a, "Na tapa adamta hi,” achih lai ahi chih atheita a; amah leh a-inkuanpihte'n avek un, agingtata uhi.
english: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.

paite: Hiai Judia gam a kipan Galili gam a ahong a Jesu thillamdang hih anihveina ahi.
english: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.

paite: Huai thil nung in Judate ankuangluina a-om a; Jerusalem ah Jesu ahohtou hi.
english: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

paite: Jerusalem ah belam kongkhak kiang ah dil khat a-om a, huai mun Hebru pau in Bethesda achi ua, inlim nga anei hi.
english: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.

paite: Huai ah tui hong tat ngak in damloute, mittawte, khebaite, zawte tampi alum phengphung uhi.
english: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;

paite: Bang hun hiam in huai dil ah angel ahohsuk a, tui ava tok zel a; kuapeuh huai tui kitoh khit a va lut masa penpen in, bangchibang natna nei hileh leng hihdam in a-om zel hi.
english: for an angel went down at certain times into the pool and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of whatever disease he had.

paite: Huai ah kum sawmthum-le-giat damlou mi kuahiam a-om hi.
english: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.

paite: Jesu'n huai a lum amu a, huchibang in sawtpi ana omta chih athei a, akiang ah, "Hihdam na ut hia?" achi hi.
english: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”

paite: Damloupa'n, “Pu, tui kitoh in dil a hon koih ding mi ka nei kei a, ka kuan sung in midang in hon makhelh nak uh," chi in adawng hi.
english: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Thou inla, na awngphah la inla, khe in paita in," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”

paite: Thakhat in huai mipa adam pah a, a-awngphah la in, apaita hi.
english: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now that day was a Sabbath.

paite: Huai ni Sabbath ni ahi a, Judate'n adampa kiang ah, "Sabbath ni ei ve, na awngphah na lak asiang kei," achi uhi.
english: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hon hihdampa ngeingei in ka kiang ah, 'Na awngphah la inla, khe in paita in,' hon chi ahi," chi in adawng hi.
english: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’ ”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Na awngphah la inla, khe in paita in, na kiang a chipa kua ahia?" chi in adong uhi.
english: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat and walk’?”

paite: Himahleh adampa'n kua ahia ahih athei kei, huai a mipi a-om ziak un Jesu apaimangta hi.
english: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.

paite: Aden chiang in Jesu'n amah tempul ah amu a, akiang ah, "Ngai in, na damta hi, khial nawn ke'n, huchi lou in zaw thil hoih lou sem na tung ah ahong tung kha ding," achi hi.
english: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”

paite: Huan huai mi ava paikhia a, Judate kiang ah, "Ahihdampa Jesu ahi," chih ahilh hi.
english: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

paite: Huchi in Sabbath ni a athilhih ziak in Judate'n Jesu a-engbawl ua, thah ding in azong uhi.
english: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n amau ahoupih a, akiang uah, "Ka Pa'n tu tanpha in nna asem zel a, ke'n leng ka sem zel," achi hi.
english: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”

paite: Huchi in Judate'n hihlup atum semsem ua, Sabbath ni atan louh ziak kia ahi kei, Pathian amah Pa a abawl leh Pathian toh kikim a akibawl ziak in leng ahi.
english: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, “Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, Tapa in amah in bangmah ahihthei kei, Pa thilhih amuh kia lou ngal; thil ahih peuhmah, Tapa in leng ahih sam zel hi.
english: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.

paite: Pa in Tapa a-it a, athilhih peuhmah akiang ah amusak a; hiaite sang a thilhih thupizaw akiang ah amusak lai ding, lamdang na sak ding un.
english: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.

paite: Pa in misite kaithou a, hinna apiak bang in, Tapa in leng a-utna peuh kiang ah hinna apia hi.
english: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.

paite: Pa in kuamah vai ahawmsak ngei kei, himahleh vai tengteng Tapa in ahawmsak zaw hi;
english: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,

paite: mi tengteng in Pa zahna apiak bang un, Tapa leng zahna apiakna ding un. Kuapeuh Tapa zahloute'n, Pa asawlpa leng azah kei uhi.
english: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.

paite: "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh ka thu za a, hon sawlpa gingta in, tangtawn hinna anei; siam louh in a-om kei a, sihna a kipan apawt a, hinna ah alut zawta hi.
english: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

paite: Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, ahun atung dekta, tu in leng atung lellel, huai hun chiang in misite'n Pathian Tapa aw aza ding ua, aza peuhmah ahing ding uh.
english: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.

paite: Pa in amah a hinna aneih bang in, Tapa in leng amah a hinna nei ding in apeta hi.
english: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.

paite: Mihing Tapa ahih ziak in, akiang ah thukhenna leh thuneihna apia hi.
english: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.

paite: Hiai lamdang sa kei un, ahun atungta, huai hun chiang in han a om tengteng in a-aw aza ding ua,
english: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice

paite: ahong pawt vek ding uh; thil hoih hihte hinna tang in athounawn ding ua, thil gilou hihte siam louh tang in athounawn ding uhi.
english: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.

paite: "Keimah in bangmah ka hihthei kei; bil a ka zak bangbang in vai ka hawm zel; ka vaihawm adik ahi, keimah deihlam a om ka tum kei; hon sawlpa deihlam a om ka tup zel ziak in.
english: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and my judgment is righteous, because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.

paite: "Keimah tanchin theihpihtu a pang hi leng, ka thu theihpihna adik kei ding hi.
english: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.

paite: Ka tanchin toh kisai theihpihtu midang khat a-om, ama'n ka tanchin atheihpihna apiak pen dik ahi, chih ka thei hi.
english: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.

paite: Nou Johan kiang ah mi na sawl ua, ama'n thutak thu ahon theihpih hi.
english: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

paite: Thu theihpihna ka san mihing a kipan ahi kei a; himahleh na hinna ding un hiai thu ka gen ahi.
english: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.

paite: Huai Johan khawnvak kuangtak leh vaktak ahi, avak ah nopsak takdih na ut uhi.
english: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.

paite: "Himahleh theihpihna ka neih zaw Johan theihpihna sang in athupizaw hi; Pa'n thilhih zoh ding a ahon piak, ka thilhih ngei in Pa'n hon sawl chih ka tanchin atheisak hi.
english: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.

paite: "Pa hon sawlpa ngei leng ka tanchin atheihpihtu in apang hi. Nou chik lai mah in a-aw na za ngei kei ua, amel leng na mu ngei kei uh.
english: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.

paite: Athu leng noumau ah na tengsak kei uh, asawl mipa na gintak louh ziak uh ahi.
english: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.

paite: "Laisiangthou sung a tangtawn hinna om ding a na ngaihtuah ziak un na nak zon ngial ua; huaite mah ka tanchin theihpihtute ahi uhi.
english: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.

paite: Himahleh hinna nei ding in ka kiang ah na hong nuam kei uhi.
english: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.

paite: "Mihing pahtawina ka sang kei.
english: I don’t receive glory from men.

paite: Himahleh nou ka hon thei hi, Pathian itna noumau ah na nei kei uhi.
english: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.

paite: Ka Pa min in ka hong a, noute'n na hon kipahpih kei uh; midang ama min in hong taleh amah na na kipahpih ding uhi.
english: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.

paite: Nou kipahtawi tuahna paktate'n Pathian tak kia a pawt pahtawina zong lou in bangchi in kei na hon gingta thei ding ua?
english: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?

paite: Ke'n Pa kiang a nou ka hon hek ding gingta kei un; nou hon hek khat a-om, na muan uh Mosi ngei.
english: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.

paite: Mosi gingta hi le uchin, kei leng na hon gingtata ding uh; ka tanchin gelh lah amah ahi ngal a.
english: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.

paite: Himahleh ama thugelh gingta lou in, bangchi in ka thute na gingta ding ua?" achi hi.
english: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”

paite: Huai thilte khit in, Galili dil, Tiberias tuipi kichi gallam ah Jesu apai hi.
english: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.

paite: Damloute tung a thillamdang ahihte amuh ziak un mipi tampi in amah azui uhi.
english: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.

paite: Jesu tang ah ahohtou a, huai ah anungzuite kiang ah atu hi.
english: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.

paite: Huan Paikan Ankuangluina, Judate ankuangluina anaita hi.
english: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.

paite: Jesu adak a, mipi tampi in akiang lam hon zuan in amu a, Philip kiang ah, "Hiaite nek ding tanghou koi a lei ding i hi ua?" achi hi.
english: Jesus therefore, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”

paite: Huai thu amah ze-etna ding a agen ahi, ahih ding lah ama'n athei ngal a.
english: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.

paite: Philip in akiang ah, "Michih in tawmchik a atan chiat ding uh leng, makhai zanih man tanghou in adaih kei ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive a little.”

paite: Huan anungzuite lak a khat, Simon Peter unau Andru in akiang ah,
english: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,

paite: "Barli buh tanghou phel nga leh ngasa nih nei pasal naupang khat hiai ah a-om, himahleh mi hiai zah lawmlawm lak ah bang tham hizou ding ahia?" achi hi.
english: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”

paite: Jesu'n, "Mite tusak un," achi hi. Huai ah loupa tampi a-om hi. Huchi in pichingte atusuk ua, atamlam uh sangnga vel ahi.
english: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

paite: Jesu'n tanghou phelte ala a, kipahthu agen khit in atute kiang ah ahawm a, huchi mah bang in ngasate leng adeih hun un ahawm sam hi.
english: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.

paite: Huan akham nung un, anungzuite kiang ah, "Bangmah mang lou ding in anente luak un," achi hi.
english: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”

paite: Huchi in aluak ua, barli buh tanghou phel nga nete nek bang nente bawm sawm-le-nih ahihdim uhi.
english: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.

paite: Mite'n athillamdang hih amuhtak un, "Hiai mi, zawlnei, khovel a hong dingpa ana hi ngei e,” achi uhi.
english: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”

paite: Huchi in amah kumpipa dia bawl ding a mat teitei tum in ahong kuan ding uh, chih Jesu'n athei a, tang ah amah kia in apaituam nawnta hi.
english: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.

paite: Huan nitaklam in anungzuite tuipi ah apaisuk uhi.
english: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea.

paite: Long ah atuang ua, tuipi ah Kapernaum azuan uhi. Khua amialta a, Jesu lah akiang uah ahong tung nai kei hi.
english: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.

paite: Huihpi hattak anun ziak in tuikihot asang hulhul hi.
english: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.

paite: Ching sawmnih leh ching nga hiam, ching sawmthum hiam akalh nung un, tuipi tung a khe a Jesu pai a, long lam hon naih in amu ua, alauta uhi.
english: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.

paite: Himahleh ama'n akiang uah, "Keimah ka hi, lau kei un," achi hi.
english: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”

paite: Huchi in kilawptak in long ah Jesu atuangsakta ua, huchi in along uh azotna gam uah atung pah hi.
english: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.

paite: Azing in dil gal lehlam a mipi dinghte'n, long khat lou ngal long dang a-om kei a, anungzuite toh long ah Jesu atuang ton kei a, anungzuite amau kia in apai uh chih athei uhi.
english: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.

paite: Himahleh Toupa'n kipahthu agen nung a, tanghou anekna kiang uh, Tiberias a kipan long neu chikchik ahong tung uhi.
english: However, boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

paite: Huchi in mipi'n Jesu leh anungzuite a-omta kei uh chih atheih un, amau leng long neute a tuang in, Jesu zong in Kapernaum khua ahong tung uhi.
english: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.
