paite: Huan tuipi gal a ahong muh un akiang ah, "Rabbi, chik in ahia hiai lam na hong tun?" achi uhi.
english: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, thillamdangte na muh ziak ua hon zong na hi kei ua, tanghou phel na nekvah ziak uh ahi zaw.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.

paite: An mang thei phet zong in phiaphia kei un, himahleh an, tangtawn hinpha a om gige ding, Mihing Tapa hon piak ding pen zong in phe zaw un; Pa Pathian in amah achiamtehta hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Pathian nna ka septheihna ding un bang ahia ka hih ding uh?" achi uhi.
english: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Pathian nasep hiai ahi, amisawl gingta le uchin," chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Chiamtehna bang ahia na hih ding, ka muh ua nang ka hon gintak theihna ding un? Thil bang ahia na hih ding?
english: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?

paite: Van a kipan akiang uah amau tanghou nek ding apia chih gelh bang in, ka pipute un gamdai ah manna ane uh," achi uhi.
english: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, van a kipan a tanghou na muh pen uh Mosi hon piak ahi kei, ka Pa'n van a kipan tanghoutak noute ahon piak ahi zaw.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.

paite: Pathian tanghou van a kipan in ahong paisuk a, khovel kiang a hinna pepa ahi," achi hi.
english: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.”

paite: Amau, "Toupa, huai tanghou hon pe gige in," achi uhi.
english: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Keimah hinna tanghou ka hi; kuapeuh ka kiang a hong pai agilkial kei ding, kuapeuh kei hon gingta chik mah chiang in adangtak kei ding.
english: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

paite: Himahleh nou na hon muh un leng na hon gingta kei uh chih ka hon hilhta ve.
english: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.

paite: Pa'n hon piak peuhmah ka kiang ah ahong pai vek ding uh; kuapeuh ka kiang a hong pai ka delhkhe ngei kei ding hi.
english: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.

paite: Kei deihlam hih ding a van a kipan a hong paisuk ka hi kei, hon sawlpa deihlam hih ding a hong paisuk ka hi zaw hi.
english: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.

paite: Hiai ahon sawlpa deihlam ahi, ama'n hon piak tengteng bangmah mangsak lou in, nitawp ni chiang in kaithou zaw leng.
english: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.

paite: Kuapeuh Tapa mu a gingta in tangtawn hinna aneih a, nitawp ni chiang a amah ka kaihthoh ding ka Pa deihlam ahih ziak in," achi hi.
english: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”

paite: Van a kipan a tanghou hong paisuk ka hi, achih ziak in, atung ah Judate aphun uhi.
english: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”

paite: "Hiai mi Joseph tapa Jesu ahi kei a hia, anu leh apa leng i theih? Van a kipan a hong paisuk ka hi, bangchi chih a chi ahia?" achi uhi.
english: They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come down out of heaven’?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Phunphun dah un.
english: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.

paite: Pa hon sawlpa'n ahip keileh kuamah ka kiang ah ahong pai thei kei. Ke'n ahong pai mi nitawp ni chiah ka kaithou ding.
english: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.

paite: Zawlneite laibu ah 'Pathian hilh in a-om ding uh,' chih gelh ahi. Michih Pa thu za a thei peuhmah ka kiang ah ahong pai uhi.
english: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.

paite: Pathian a kipan pen lou ngal in kuamah in Pa amu ngei kei, ama'n zaw Pa amu hi.
english: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.

paite: Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh agingta in tangtawn hinna anei.
english: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.

paite: Keimah hinna tanghou ka hi.
english: I am the bread of life.

paite: Na pipute un gamdai ah manna ane ua, huchi in asi uhi.
english: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died.

paite: Hiai tanghou i chih pen van a kipan a hong paisuk ahi, mi'n anek ua asihlouhna ding un.
english: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.

paite: Keimah van a kipan a tanghou hing hong paisuk ka hi, kuapeuh in hiai tanghou anekleh tangtawn in ahing gige ding; ahi, khovel hinna dia ka piak ding tanghou ka sa ahi,” achi hi.
english: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”

paite: Huchi in Judate akisel ua, "Hiai mi'n bangchi in asa nek ding in hon pe thei ding ahia?" achi uhi.
english: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, Mihing Tapa sa na nek ua, asisan na dawn kei uleh noumau in hinna nei lou hi ve uchin.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.

paite: Kuapeuh ka sa ne a, ka sisan dawn in tangtawn hinna anei; huan, nitawp ni chiang in amah ka kaithou ding.
english: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

paite: Ka sa zaw an taktak ahi a, ka sisan leng dawn tak taktak ahi.
english: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

paite: Kuapeuh ka sa ne a, ka sisan dawnmi, keimah ah a-om gige a, kei leng amah ah ka om gige hi.
english: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.

paite: Pa hing in hon sawl a, Pa ziak a hing ka hih mah bang in, kuapeuh kei hon nete keimah ziak in amah leng ahing ding hi.
english: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on me will also live because of me.

paite: Hiai van a kipan a tanghou hong paisuk ahi; na pipute un tanghou anek ua, asih bang uh zaw ahi kei; kuapeuh hiai tanghou ne tangtawn in ahing gige ding,” achi hi.
english: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”

paite: Huai thute Kapernaum a sinagog a thu ahilh lai a agen ahi.
english: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

paite: Huchi in anungzuite akhen tampi in huai azak un, “Hiai thuhaksa ahi, kua'n angaikhe thei dia?" achi uhi.
english: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”

paite: Huai thu ah anungzuite aphun uh chih Jesu'n alungsim a atheih in, akiang uah, "Hiai thu in hon hih lunghi lou hia?
english: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?

paite: Mihing Tapa tuma lam a a-omna ngei a kahtou mu le uchin, bang na chi ding ua?
english: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?

paite: Hinna pia zaw kha ahi a, sa zaw bangmah ding in aphatuam kei; na kiang ua thu ka gente kha ahi a, hinna leng ahi.
english: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.

paite: Himahleh na lak uah akhen gingta lou om na hi uh," achi hi. Jesu'n atung a kipan in agingtaloute leh amansak dingpa atheigige ngal a.
english: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.

paite: Huan ama'n, huaiziak in ahi na kiang ua, "Pa in apiak keileh kuamah ka kiang ah ahong pai thei kei, ka chih," achi hi.
english: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”

paite: Hiai nung in anungzuite akhen tampi akinunghei ua, amah akithuahpih nawnta kei uhi.
english: At this, many of his disciples went back and walked no more with him.

paite: Jesu'n sawm-le-nihte kiang ah, "Nou leng paimang sam na ut uhia?" achi a.
english: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”

paite: Simon Peter in, “Toupa, kua kiang ah ahia ka pai tuan ding uh? Nangma'n tangtawn hinna thu na nei hi.
english: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.

paite: Nangmah Pathian Mi Siangthou na hi chih ka taksangta ua, theih leng ka thei uh," chi in adawng hi.
english: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Nou sawm-le-nihte keimah hon tel hilou na hi uh maw? Na lak ua mi khat diabol ahih laitei toh," achi hi.
english: Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”

paite: Iskariot, Simon tapa Judas, sawm-le-nihte lak a tel sam, huai thu agen ahi, amah zuausan a mansakpa ding ahi.
english: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.

paite: Huai khit in Galili gam ah Jesu avak a; Judate'n amah hihlup atup ziak un Judia gam apha nuam kei hi.
english: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

paite: Judate Biakbuk Ankuangluina anaita hi.
english: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.

paite: Huchi in a-unaute'n akiang ah, "Hiai a kipan in Judia gam ah va hoh in, na nungzuite'n na thilhih amuhtheihna ding un," achi uhi.
english: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.

paite: "Kuamah in aguk in thil bangmah ahih kei ua, amah mah in alangtang in mite theih ding in ahih hi. Hiai thilte na hih ngalleh khovel kiang ah kimusak in," achi uhi.
english: For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”

paite: A-unaute nangawn in leng amah agingta kei uhi.
english: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ka hun atung nai kei; nou hun zaw chik lai peuh in atung gige hi.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

paite: Khovel in nou ahon ho thei kei, kei zaw hon ho nak uh, athilhihte uh gilou ahi chih ka theihsak ziak in.
english: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.

paite: Nou ankuangluina ah va hohtou unla, kei zaw tu ankuangluina ah ka hohtou tadih kei ding, ka hun atun nai louh ziak in," achi hi.
english: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”

paite: Huai thu akiang uah gen in Galili gam ah a-om nilouh hi.
english: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.

paite: Himahleh a-unaute ankuangluina a ahohtouh nung un, amah leng vantang theih louh in, aguk bang in ahohtou sam hi.
english: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.

paite: Judate'n ankuangluina ah amah azong ua, "Koi a om ahia?" achi uhi.
english: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”

paite: Atung ah mipite lak a mi aphun sim supsup ua, khenkhat in, "Mihoih ahi," achi ua; khenkhat in, "Hi dek kei e, mipi khem ahi," achi uhi.
english: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”

paite: Himahleh Judate akihtak ziak un kuamah in alangtang in atungtang thu agenlang ngam kei uhi.
english: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.

paite: Ankuanglui san laitak in, tempul ah Jesu ahohtou a, thu ahilh hi.
english: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

paite: Huan Judate'n, "Hiai mi'n zil ngeiloupi a bang achia hichi theih ahia?" achi ua, lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
english: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”

paite: Huan Jesu'n amau adawng a, "Ka thuhilh kei a hilou in, hon sawlpa thu ahi zaw.
english: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.

paite: Kuapeuh ama deihlam hih ut in ka thuhilh Pathian a kipan hia, keimah phuahtawm a ka gen chih athei ding hi.
english: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.

paite: Kuapeuh ama phuahtawm thu gen zaw, ama hoihna zong ahi; asawlpa hoihna zongmi mitak ahi, amah ah diklouhna himhim a-om kei hi.
english: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

paite: Mosi in na kiang uah dan ahon pe kei a hia? Himahleh na lak uah kuamah in dan na zui kei uh. Nou bang achia hon hihlup tum na hi ua?" achi hi.
english: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”

paite: Mipi'n, "Dawi zawl na hi ve; kua'n ahia hon hihlup tum?" chi in adawng uhi.
english: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”

paite: Jesu'n adawng a akiang uah, "Thil khat ka hih nou tengteng in lamdang na sa uh.
english: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.

paite: Ahi a, Mosi in zeksum thu nou ahon piak ziak in Sabbath ni in leng mi zek na sum zel uhi. Huai pen Mosi a kipan hilou in pipute a kipan ahi zaw hi.
english: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.

paite: Mosi Dan a tatleklouhna ding a Sabbath ni a pasal in azek asum ngalleh, ke'n Sabbath ni a mi ka hihdam ziak in ka tung ah na heh tuam uh maw?
english: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?

paite: Akilatdan in ngaihtuah kei unla, diktattak in ngaihtuah zaw un," achi hi.
english: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”

paite: Huan Jerusalem a mi khenkhat in, "Hiai mi thah atuppa uh hilou hia?
english: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?

paite: En dih uh, alangtang in hiai ah thu agen a, akiang ah bangmah agen kei uhi. Amah Khrist ahi chih vaihawmte'n thei taktak uh ahita diam?
english: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?

paite: Hiai mi ahong kipatna lam nangawn i thei ngal a. Khrist ahong kilat chiang in ahong kipatna lam kuamah in athei kei ding uh," achi uhi.
english: However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”

paite: Huaiziak in tempul a Jesu'n thu ahilh kawm in akikou a, "Nou na hon thei ua, ka hong kipatna lam leng na thei uh. Himahleh keimah thu a hong pai ka hi kei, amah kei hon sawlpa midik ahi, amah lah na thei ngal kei ua.
english: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.

paite: Ke'n amah ka thei; amah a kipan a hong pawt ka hi a, ama'n lah ahon sawl ngal a," achi hi.
english: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”

paite: Huchi in amah mat atumta ua, himahleh ahun atun nai louh ziak in kuamah in akhoih thei kei uhi.
english: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

paite: Mipi akhen tampite'n bel amah agingta ua, "Khrist ahong kilak chiang in, hiai mi hih sang in chiamtehna tamzaw ahih tuan dia hia?" achi uhi.
english: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”

paite: Huan Pharisaite'n atung a mipi phunna thute aza ua; huchi in siampu liante leh Pharisaite'n amah man ding in heutute asawlta uhi.
english: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.

paite: Jesu'n, "Sawt lou kal na kiang uah ka om phot ding a, hon sawlpa kiang ah ka pai ding hi.
english: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.

paite: Nou na hon zong ding ua, na hon mu kei ding uh; ka omna ah leng na hong thei kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: You will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”

paite: Huan Judate akihou ua, "I muh louh ding in hiai mi koi a hoh dek ahi ding? Grik pemdalhte kiang a hoh in Grikte thu va hilh ding adiam aw?
english: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?

paite: Nou na hon zong ding ua, na hon mu kei ding uh, ka omna ah leng na hong thei kei ding uh achih, bang achihna adiam maw?" achi uhi.
english: What is this word that he said, ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me;’ and ‘Where I am, you can’t come’?”

paite: Huan ankuanglui ni nanungpen, ni thupi ni in, Jesu adingh a, akikou a, "Kuapeuh adangtakleh ka kiang ah hong henla, dawn hen.
english: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!

paite: Kuapeuh kei hon gingta Laisiangthou gen bang in tuihing luite asung a pan ahong luangkhe ding," achi hi.
english: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”

paite: Hiai thu agingtate'n Kha atan ding thu uh agenna ahi; Jesu pahtawi a a-om nai louh ziak in Kha lah piak ahi nai tadih ngal kei ua.
english: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.

paite: Huchi in mipi lak a khenkhat in huai thu azak un, "Hiai zaw zawlnei hi petmah e," achi uhi.
english: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”

paite: Khenkhat in, hiai zaw, "Khrist ahi," achi ua, khenkhat in bel, "Bang ding in Galili gam ah Khrist ahong pawt tel dia?
english: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?

paite: Khrist zaw David suante lak ah, David omna khua Bethlehem a apawt ding ahi, chih Laisiangthou in agen kei a hia?" achi uhi.
english: Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”

paite: Huchi in amah ziak in mipi akikhen ua, akilangta uhi.
english: So a division arose in the multitude because of him.

paite: Khenkhat in mat a-ut ua, himahleh kuamah in akhoih tuan kei uh.
english: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.

paite: Huan heutute, siampu liante leh Pharisaite kiang ah ahong pai nawn ua akiang uah, "Bang achia hon tonpih lou?" achi uhi.
english: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”

paite: Heutute'n, "Hiai mi bang in kuamah in thu agen ngei kei," achi ua, adawng uhi.
english: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”

paite: Pharisaite'n akiang uah, "Nou leng pimang a om sam na hita uh maw?
english: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?

paite: Vaihawmte leh Pharisaite lak a mi amah gingta a-omta a hia?
english: Have any of the rulers or any of the Pharisees believed in him?

paite: Huai dan thei lou mipite sop lai, hamsethuak ei ve ua,” achi ua, adawng uhi.
english: But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is cursed.”

paite: Nikodem, tuma a Jesu kiang a hong, alak ua pang sam ahi a, ama'n akiang uah,
english: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,

paite: "Amah kam ngei a thu zak leh athilhih theih ahih ma, i dan un mi siam louh atangsak ngei a hia?" achi hi.
english: “Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Nang leng huai Galili mi na hi sam maw? Zong lechin, Galili gam ah zawlnei kuamah pawt ding a-om kei uh chih thei tanla," achi ua, adawng uhi.
english: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”

paite: Huan michih ama inn chiat ah apaita uhi.
english: Everyone went to his own house,

paite: Himahleh Olive tang ah Jesu ahohtou hi.
english: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

paite: Zingsang phalvak in tempul ah alut nawn a, mi tengteng akiang ah ahong pai ua, amah atu a, amaute thu ahilh hi.
english: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down and taught them.

paite: Laigelhmite leh Pharisaite'n numei khat angkawm lai amat uh ahon pi ua; alai ah adingsak uhi.
english: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the middle,

paite: Jesu kiang ah, "Sinsakpa, hiai numei angkawm, a-angkawm laitak a amat uh ahi.
english: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.

paite: Mosi Dan laibu in hichibang mi suang a denlup thu ahon pia hi; nang bangchi na sa a?" achi uhi.
english: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”

paite: Huai thu amah hekna ding amuhtheihna ding ua, ze-etna dia agen uh ahi. Huchi in Jesu akun a, athugen uh za lou bang in akhutzung in leitual agelh hi.
english: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

paite: Huan adot lailai ziak un amah adaktou a akiang uah, "Na lak ua khelhna nei lou in amah suang in deng masa heh," achi hi.
english: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”

paite: Akun nawn a, akhutzung in leitual agelh nawn hi.
english: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

paite: Amau athugen azak un, upapen a pan atawp pha in, khatkhat in akigelkhia ua; huchi in numei alai a a-omna ngei a om toh Jesu kia a-om uhi.
english: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.

paite: Jesu adaktou a, "Numei, koi a om ahi ua? Kuamah in siam louh hon tangsak lou uhia?" achi hi.
english: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”

paite: Huan ama'n, "Toupa, kuamah in hon tangsak kei," achi hi. Jesu'n, "Ke'n leng siam louh ka hon tangsak kei; pai inla, tuban khial nawn ke'n," achi hi.
english: She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah thu agen nawn a, "Kei khovel vak ka hi; kei hon zui kuapeuh mial ah akhosa kei ding a, hinna vak anei zaw ding," achi hi.
english: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

paite: Huchi in Pharisaite'n akiang ah, "Nangmah thu theisak na hi; na thu theihsak adik kei," achi uhi.
english: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Keimah thu theisak na hi taleng zong ka thu theihsak adik ahi. Ke'n ka hong kipatna leh ka manohna ding ka thei hi; noute'n bel ka hong kipatna leh ka manohna ding na thei kei uh.
english: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.

paite: Nou sadan in vai na hawmsak uh; ke'n kuamah vai ka hawmsak kei.
english: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.

paite: Ahi, vai hawmsak na hi taleng zong, ka vai hawmsak adik ding; keimah kia ka hi kei a, kei leh Pa hon sawlpa ka hi zaw uhi.
english: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.

paite: Ahi, na dan laibu uah leng mi nih theihpihna adik, chih gelh ahi.
english: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.

paite: Kei ka hihleh keimah thu theisakpa ka hi a, Pa hon sawlpa'n ka thu atheisak hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Koi a na Pa om ahia?" achi uhi. Jesu'n, "Nou kei na hon thei kei uh, ka Pa leng na thei kei uh; kei hon thei hi le uchin, ka Pa leng na thei ding uh," chi in adawng hi.
english: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”

paite: Huai thu tempul a thu ahilh kawm a, sumkoihna mun a agen ahi; ahun a tun nai louh ziak in kuamah in amah aman nai kei uhi.
english: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Ka paimang ding a, nou na hon zong ding ua, na khelhna uah na si ding uh; ka hohna ding ah na hong thei kei ding uh," achi nawn hi.
english: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”

paite: Judate'n, "Ka hohna ding ah na hong thei kei ding uh, achih, akihihlum dia adiam?" achi uhi.
english: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou nuailam a kipan na hi ua; kei tunglam a kipan ka hi; nou khovel a na hi ua, kei zaw hiai khovel a ka hi kei hi.
english: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.

paite: Huaiziak in na kiang uah, na khelhna uah na si ding uh ka chih, huai amah ka hi, chih na gintak kei ualeh na khelhna uah na si ngeingei ding uh," achi hi.
english: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”

paite: Huan amau akiang ah, "Kua na hia?" achi uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Atung a kipan in na kiang uah ka genta hi.
english: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.

paite: Nou tungtang thu ah thil tampi gen ding leh ngaihtuah ding ka nei; himahleh, hon sawlpa zaw midik ahi; amah kiang a ka thuzakte khovel kiang ah ka hilh ahi," achi hi.
english: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However, he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”

paite: Pa thu akiang uah agen chih atheisiam kei uhi.
english: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.

paite: Huchi in Jesu mah in, "Nou mihing Tapa na khaikang nung un, amah ka hi chih leh ke'n keimah thu in thil bangmah ka hih kei a, Pa hon hilh bang zel in hiai thu ka gen zaw ahi chih na thei ding uhi.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.

paite: Hon sawlpa ka kiang ah a-om a, Pa'n kei kia in hon nuse ngei kei; athil kipah lam peuhmah ka hih zel ziak in," achi hi.
english: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”

paite: Huan huai thute agen lai in mi tampi'n amah agingta uhi.
english: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n amah gingta Judate kiang ah, "Ka thu a na om gige uleh, ka nungzuite na hi taktak ding uhi.
english: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.

paite: Huan thutak na thei ding ua, thutak in ahon suaktasak ding,” achi hi.
english: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”

paite: Huan amau akiang ah, “Abraham suante ka hi ua, tutan in kuamah sal ah ka om ngei kei uh, suahtaksak in na om ding uh bangchi chih a chi na hia?" achi ua, adawng uhi.
english: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You will be made free’?”

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh thil hihkhial khelhna sal ahi.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.

paite: Sal kichi peuhmah inn ah a-om gige kei a; Tapa bel a-om gige hi.
english: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.

paite: Tapa in sal a pan ahon suahtaksakleh na suakta taktak ding uhi.
english: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

paite: Abraham suante na hi uh chih ka thei hi, himahleh hon thah na tum ngal ua, ka thu in noute a mun aneih louh ziak in.
english: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.

paite: Ke'n ka Pa kiang a thil ka muh ka gen a; nou leng na pa uh kiang a thil na muh uh na hih uh," achi hi.
english: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”

paite: Huan amau akiang ah, "Ka pa uh Abraham ahi," achi ua, adawng uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Abraham tate hi le uchin, Abraham thilhih na hihta ding uhi," achi hi.
english: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.

paite: "Himahleh Pathian kiang a thutak ka zak, kei ahon hilhpa ngei, tu'n ah hon thah na tum ngal ua; Abraham in zaw hichibang in ahih kei. Nou zaw na pa uh thil na hih nak uhi," achi hi.
english: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Ang kikawm a piang ka hi kei uh, Pa khat kia ka nei uh, Pathian," achi uhi.
english: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Pathian na Pa uh hitaleh nou kei na hon it ding uh; Pathian a pan hong pawt leh akiang a kipan hong pai ka hi; keimah thu a hong leng ka hi sam kei, ama'n ahon sawl zaw hi.
english: Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.

paite: Bangziak a ka thugen theisiam lou? Ka thu na zak theih louh ziak uh ahi.
english: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.

paite: Nou zaw na pa uh diabol a pawt na hi ua, na pa uh utna na hih ding uh. Amah zaw atung a kipan tualthat ahi, thutak ah a-om kei; asung a thutak himhim a-om louh ziak in. Zuauthu agen in amah a ngei agen ahi; zuauthei ahi ngal a, zuaupa leng ahi.
english: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.

paite: Thutak ka gen ziak in nou hon gingta lou na hi uhi.
english: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.

paite: Na lak uah kua'n ahia khelhna a siam louh hon tan thei om? Thutak ka gen in leng nou bang achia hon gingta lou?
english: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?

paite: Pathian a pan pawt in Pathian thu apakta a; Pathian a pan pawt na hih louh ziak un na pakta kei uhi," achi hi.
english: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”

paite: Huan Judate'n akiang ah, "Samari mi dawi zawl na hi ka chih uh, ka chi dik ngel uh ahi kei maw?" achi ua, adawng uhi.
english: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”

paite: Jesu'n, "Dawi zawl ka hi kei. Ka Pa ka zahtak ahi zaw, nou kei na hon zahtak kei uhi.
english: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.

paite: Himahleh keimah kilawmna zong ka hi kei; azongmi leh angaihtuahmi khat a-om hi.
english: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.

paite: Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, mi'n ka thu azuihleh tangtawn in sihna amu kei ding," achi hi.
english: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”

paite: Huan Judate'n akiang ah, "Dawi zawl na hi chih tu in ka theita uhi. Abraham asita, zawlneite toh, nang mi'n ka thu azuihleh tangtawn in sihna achiam kei ding, na chi maw.
english: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’

paite: Ka pu uh Abraham sang in na thupizaw a hia? Amah leng asita a, zawlneite leng asita uh; kua a kibawl na hia?" achi uhi.
english: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”

paite: Jesu'n, "Keimah kipahtawi hi taleng ka kipahtawina bangmah ahi kei; na Pathian uh, na chih uh ka Pa, hon pahtawipa ahi; nou amah na thei kei uhi.
english: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.

paite: Ke'n zaw amah ka thei; amah ka thei kei chi leng noumau bang a zuauthei ka hi ding; huchi in amah ka thei a, athu leng ka zui zel.
english: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him and keep his word.

paite: Na pu uh Abraham in ka ni mu ding ahih ziak in akithalawp a, huan amu petmah a, akipak hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it and was glad.”

paite: Huan Judate'n akiang ah, "Nang kum sawmnga leng hi nailoupi in, Abraham na mu a hia?" achi uhi.
english: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, Abraham om ma a Ompa ka hi,” achi hi.
english: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”

paite: Huchi in adenna ding un suangte atawm ua; himahleh Jesu akibu a, tempul a kipan apawtta hi.
english: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.

paite: Huan Jesu'n apai kawm in pian tung a kipan mittaw khat amu hi.
english: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.

paite: Anungzuite'n akiang ah, "Rabbi, mittawsa a apian kua'n ahia thil hihkhial, hiai mi hia, anu leh apa?" chi in adong uhi.
english: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”

paite: Jesu'n, "Hiai mi'n ahihkhial kei, anu leh apa'n leng ahihkhial kei uh; Pathian nasepte atung a alatna ding ahi zaw," chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.

paite: "Sun ahih lai in hon sawlpa nna i sep ngeingei ding uh ahi; zan hi dekdekta ahi, huai hun chiang in kuamah in nna asem thei kei ding uh.
english: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.

paite: Khovel a ka om sung in khovel vak ka hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

paite: Huchibang a agen khit in, lei ah chil asia a, tungman abawl a, huan amit ah tungman anuh hi.
english: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,

paite: Akiang ah, "Siloam dil ah va sil in,” achi a, (huai tuh Sawl chihna ahi). Va pai in asil a, mitvak in ahong kik nawn hi.
english: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.

paite: Huchi in avengte leh tuma a khutdoh a mute'n, "Hiai mi tu kawm a khutdohpa ahi kei a hia?" achi uhi.
english: Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”

paite: Midang in, "Ahi mah vo oi,” achi ua, midang in, "Hi kei e, akibatpih ahi zaw," achi uhi. Ama'n bel "Huai mi mah ka hi," achi hi.
english: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”

paite: Huan amau akiang ah, "Na mit bangchi in ahia ahong vak?" achi uhi.
english: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”

paite: Ama'n, "Mi khat, Jesu achih un tungman abawl a, ka mit anuh a, 'Siloam dil ah va hoh inla va sil in' ahon chi a, huchi in ka va hoh a, ka sil a, mitvakna ka muta," achi hi.
english: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”

paite: Huan amau akiang ah, "Amah koi a om ahia?" achi uhi. Ama'n, "Ka thei kei," achi hi.
english: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”

paite: Amaute'n Pharisaite kiang ah huai mittawpa ahon pi uhi.
english: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.

paite: Jesu'n tungman bawl a, amit ahihvak ni Sabbath ni ahi.
english: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

paite: Huchi in Pharisaite'n amit ahong vak takdan adong nawn uhi. Ama'n akiang uah, "Ka mit ah tungman akoih a, ka sil a, ka mutheita hi," achi hi.
english: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”

paite: Huan Pharisai khenkhat in, "Huai mi'n Sabbath ni atan louh ziak in, Pathian a kipan ahi kei," achi uhi. Khenkhat in bel, "Mikhial in bangchi in hichibang thillamdang ahihthei dia?" achi uhi. Huchi in akikhen ua, akilangta uhi.
english: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” So there was division among them.

paite: Mittawpa kiang ah, "Na mit ahihvaksak, nang bangchibang in amah na ngaihtuah a?" achi nawn ua. Ama'n, "Zawlnei ahi,” achi hi.
english: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”

paite: Himahleh Judate'n amit hong vakta nu leh pa asap masiah uh, mittaw ana hi him a, amit ahong vakta chih atungtang thu ataksang kei uhi.
english: The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,

paite: Anu leh apa kiang ah, "Hiai mi na tapa uh mittawsa a piang ahi na chih uh ahi hia? Bangchi in ahia tua amuh theih tak?" chi in adong uhi.
english: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”

paite: Anu leh apa'n, "Hiai ka tapa uh ahi chih ka thei uh, mittawsa in apiang chih leng ka thei uh.
english: His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;

paite: Himahleh bangchi in ahia tua hon muh theih chih ka thei kei uh, amit hihvakpa leng ka thei sam kei uh; amah dong un; piching ahi a; amah thu kigen thei ahita," achi ua, adawng uhi.
english: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”

paite: Judate akihtak ziak ua anu leh apa'n huai thute agen uh ahi; Judate'n, huai ma him in leng, amah Khrist ahi chi a gum a-omleh sinagog a pan nohsuah ding chih lem ana sa chiat ngal ua.
english: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.

paite: Huaiziak in anu leh pa'n, "Piching ahi, amah dong un," achi uhi.
english: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”

paite: Huchi in mittawpa asam nawn ua akiang ah, "Pathian phat in hiai mi zaw mikhial ahi chih ka thei uh," achi uhi.
english: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”

paite: Ama'n bel, "Mikhial ahi hia hilou ka thei kei, thil khat ka thei, tuma in ka mit ataw a, tu in ka mutheita," chi in adawng hi.
english: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Na tung ah bangchi in ahia ahih? Na mit bangchi in ahia ahihvak?" achi uhi.
english: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Den in ka hon hilhta vele, na thei nuam ngal kei ua; bang achia thei nuam nawn na hi ua? Nou leng anungzui hih sam ut na hi uh maw?" chi in adawng hi.
english: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”

paite: Huan amau amah atai ua, "Nang amah nungzui na hi, kou zaw Mosi nungzuite ka hi uh, chi in.
english: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

paite: Pathian in Mosi ahoupih chih ka thei uh, hiai mi koi a hong kipan ahia ka theihsak kei uh," achi uhi.
english: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”

paite: Huai mi'n akiang uah, "Huai pentak ahi alamdanna, koi a hong kipan ahia na theih louh uh, ka mit lah ahihvak ngei ngal a," achi hi.
english: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

paite: "Pathian in mikhial thu angaikhe kei chih i thei uhi. Himahleh kuapeuh in Pathian alimsak a, adeihlam ahihleh, Pathian in amah angaikhia hi.
english: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will, he listens to him.

paite: Khovel om tung a kipan kuamah mittawsa a piang mit ahihvak nawn chih akithei ngei kei hi.
english: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.

paite: Hiai mi Pathian a kipan a pawt ahihkeileh bangmah ahihthei kei ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Nang khial lumlet a piang in hiai bang na hon hilh vial maw?" chi in adawng uhi. Huchi in amah ahawlkhia uhi.
english: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” Then they threw him out.

paite: Huan anohkhia uh chih Jesu'n aza a; amah amuh in, "Pathian Tapa na gingta hia?" achi hi.
english: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”

paite: Ama'n, "Pu aw, ka gintak theihna ding in amah kua ahia?" chi in adawng hi.
english: He answered, “Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”

paite: Jesu'n, "Amah na mu khinta, tua nang hon houpihpa ahi," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”

paite: Ama'n, "Toupa, ka gingta hi," chi in amah abia hi.
english: He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.

paite: Jesu'n, "Thukhen ding in hiai khovel a hong ka hi, mittawte' mit ahong vakna ding uleh mitvakte' mit ahong tawtna ding un,” achi hi.
english: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”

paite: Akiang a Pharisai omte'n huai thu azak un, akiang ah, "Kou leng mittaw ka hi sam uh maw?" achi uhi.
english: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Mittaw hi le uchin khelhna nei lou ding hi uchin a, himahleh ka mu thei uh na chih ziak un khelhna ah na om gige uhi," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.

paite: Amittai tapa Jonah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: Now Yahweh’s word came to Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,

paite: "Thou inla, Nineveh khua, khopi thupitak ah hoh inla, atungthu kikoupih in; ka ma ah agitlouhna uh ahong tungtouta," achi hi.
english: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach against it, for their wickedness has come up before me.”

paite: Himahleh Jonah bel TOUPA ma a kipan Tarshish ah taimang ding in athou a; Joppa ah ahohsuk hi. Tarshish zuan ding long amu a; huchi in atuanman pia in, TOUPA ma a kipan Tarshish zuan dingte toh ton ding in long ah alutsuk hi.
english: But Jonah rose up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of Yahweh. He went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid its fare, and went down into it, to go with them to Tarshish from the presence of Yahweh.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N huih hat mahmah tuipi ah anungsak a, tuipi ah huihpi hat mahmah anung hi, huchi in long tamzak ding bang in a-omta hi.
english: But Yahweh sent out a great wind on the sea, and there was a mighty storm on the sea, so that the ship was likely to break up.

paite: Long mite'n lau in, amau pathian chiat asam ua; long zanna ding in long sung a vante tuipi ah apaikhia uhi. Jonah bel long sunggilpen ah na lutsuk pah a, huai ah lum in, ana ihmu hithit hi.
english: Then the mariners were afraid, and every man cried to his god. They threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea to lighten the ship. But Jonah had gone down into the innermost parts of the ship and he was laying down, and was fast asleep.

paite: Huchi in longheutu akiang ah ahong pai a, “Aw nang ihmu, bangchidan ahia? Thou inla, na Pathian sam in, Pathian in, i manlouhna ding in ahon ngaihtuah khamoh ding hiam,” achi hi.
english: So the ship master came to him, and said to him, “What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, call on your God! Maybe your God will notice us, so that we won’t perish.”

paite: “Khai, hiai thil hoih lou i tung ua hong om kua ziak ahia chih i theihna ding in, ai i san ding uh," chi in akihou uhi. Huchi in ai asan ua, aisan Jonah tung ah atuta hi.
english: They all said to each other, “Come! Let’s cast lots, that we may know who is responsible for this evil that is on us.” So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.

paite: Huchi in akiang ah, "Hiai thil hoih lou i tung ua om kua ziak ahia, hon hilh in, ka hon ngen uh; na nasep bang ahia? Koi a kipan a hong na hia? Koi gammi na hia? Bang mi na hia?" achi uhi.
english: Then they asked him, “Tell us, please, for whose cause this evil is on us. What is your occupation? Where do you come from? What is your country? Of what people are you?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hebru mi ka hi; tuipi leh gam bawlpa TOUPA, van Pathian ka lau ahi," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “I am a Hebrew, and I fear Yahweh, the God of heaven, who has made the sea and the dry land.”

paite: Huchi in mite'n akihta mahmah ua, akiang ah, "Bangziak a hiai bang hih na hia?" achi ua ahilhkhitsa ahih ziak in mite'n TOUPA ma a kipan taimang ahi chih lah athei ngal ua.
english: Then the men were exceedingly afraid, and said to him, “What have you done?” For the men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of Yahweh, because he had told them.

paite: Huchi in akiang ah, "Kou a dia tuipi kihot adaihna ding in na tung ah bang ka hih ding ua?" achi ua; tuipi lah akihot sang hulhul ngal a.
english: Then they said to him, “What shall we do to you, that the sea may be calm to us?” For the sea grew more and more stormy.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, “Hon domkang unla, tuipi ah hon lawnkhia un; huchi in nou a ding in tuipi akihot nawn kei ding; kei ziak in na tung uah hiai huihpi thupitak anung ahi chih ka thei hi,” achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Take me up, and throw me into the sea. Then the sea will be calm for you; for I know that because of me this great storm is on you.”

paite: Himahleh mite'n gam a kik ding in nakpi in long akal ua; himahleh ahi thei kei; tuipi lah atung uah anak kihoh semsem ngal a.
english: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to get them back to the land; but they could not, for the sea grew more and more stormy against them.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA asam ua, “Aw TOUPA, hiai | mipa hinna ziak in hon hihmang ke'nla, mihoih sisan moh ka tung uah nga mahmah lou ding in nakpitak in ka hon ngen uhi; TOUPA, hiai lah nang na deih bang a na hih ahi ngal a," achi uhi.
english: Therefore they cried to Yahweh, and said, “We beg you, Yahweh, we beg you, don’t let us die for this man’s life, and don’t lay on us innocent blood; for you, Yahweh, have done as it pleased you.”

paite: Huchi in Jonah adomkang ua, tuipi ah alawnkheta ua; huchi in tuipi kihot phul vonvon adaita hi.
english: So they took up Jonah and threw him into the sea; and the sea ceased its raging.

paite: Huchi in mite'n nakpitak in TOUPA alau ua; TOUPA kiang ah kithoihna alan ua, thu achiam uhi.
english: Then the men feared Yahweh exceedingly; and they offered a sacrifice to Yahweh and made vows.

paite: TOUPA'N Jonah valh ding in nga liantak anasep khin a; huai ngapi gilsung ah Jonah, ni thum leh zan thum a-om hi.
english: Yahweh prepared a huge fish to swallow up Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

paite: Huan ngapi gilsung a kipan in TOUPA a Pathian kiang ah Jonah athum a, hichi in achi a;
english: Then Jonah prayed to Yahweh, his God, out of the fish’s belly.

paite: "Ka haksatna ziak in TOUPA ka sam a, ama'n ahon dawng a; Sheol gilsung a kipan in ka kikou a, nang ka aw na zata hi.
english: He said, “I called because of my affliction to Yahweh. He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my voice.

paite: Thukpi ah, tuipi sunggil ah na hon pailut a, tui tampi ka kimvel ah a-oma; na tuikihot leh na tuikisep tengteng in ahon tum zel hi.
english: For you threw me into the depths, in the heart of the seas. The flood was all around me. All your waves and your billows passed over me.

paite: 'Huan na mitmuh a kipan paihkhiak ka hi a; himahleh na tempul siangthou lam ka nga nawn ding,’ ka chi hi.
english: I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’

paite: Tuite'n ka hinna tan in ahon umkimvel ua; tui thuk ka kim ka vel ah a-om hi; louhingte'n ka lu atuamsuak hi.
english: The waters surrounded me, even to the soul. The deep was around me. The weeds were wrapped around my head.

paite: Tangte taw ah ka paisuk a; lei in tangtawn a ding in akalhnate'n ahon khakkhum a; himahleh nang Aw TOUPA ka Pathian, kohawm a kipan ka hinna na lakhia hi.
english: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains. The earth barred me in forever; yet you have brought my life up from the pit, Yahweh my God.

paite: Ka sung a ka hinna abah lai in, TOUPA ka theigige ding a; na tempul siangthou ah ka thumna na kiang ahong tung hi.
english: “When my soul fainted within me, I remembered Yahweh. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.

paite: Thil gina lou leh zuau leltak limsak mite'n amau zahngaihna alehngatsan uh ahi.
english: Those who regard vain idols forsake their own mercy.

paite: Ke'n zaw kipahthu genna aw toh na kiang ah kithoihna ka lan ding; ka chiamsa thu ka tangtun ding. Hotdamna TOUPA a ahi."
english: But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation belongs to Yahweh.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N ngapi ahoupih a, gam ah Jonah alokheta hi.
english: Then Yahweh spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land.

paite: Huan TOUPA thu Jonah kiang ah ahong tung nawn leuleu a,
english: Yahweh’s word came to Jonah the second time, saying,

paite: "Thou inla, Nineveh khua, khopi thupitak ah hoh inla, thu gen ding ka hon chih pen va tangkoupih in," chi in.
english: “Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach to it the message that I give you.”

paite: Huchi in Jonah athou a, TOUPA thu bang in Nineveh ah ahohta hi. Nineveh bel khopi thupi petmah, ni thum pai aching hi.
english: So Jonah arose, and went to Nineveh, according to Yahweh’s word. Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, three days’ journey across.

paite: Jonah ni khat pai zoh chiang khopi sung ah ava pai phot a, "Ni sawmli in, Nineveh hihman ahi ding hi," chi in akikou hi.
english: Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried out, and said, “In forty days, Nineveh will be overthrown!”

paite: Nineveh mite'n Pathian agingta ua; an ngawl apuang ua, alak ua alianpen a kipan aneupen tan in sai-ip puan asilh uhi.
english: The people of Nineveh believed God; and they proclaimed a fast and put on sackcloth, from their greatest even to their least.

paite: Huai thu Nineveh kumpipa bil ahong tungta a, alaltutphah a kipan athou a, akumpi puan asuah a, sai-ip puan silh in, vut ah atuta hi.
english: The news reached the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, took off his royal robe, covered himself with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.

paite: Kumpipa leh amiliante thupiak in kumpipa'n Nineveh khosung ah thu apuang in apulakta hi. "Mihing hiam, ganta hiam, ganhon hiam, belamhon hiamte in bangmah chiam kei uhen; banghiam ne in tui leng dawn kei uhen;
english: He made a proclamation and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, “Let neither man nor animal, herd nor flock, taste anything; let them not feed, nor drink water;

paite: mihing leh ganhingte'n sai-ip puan silh uhenla, nakpitak in Pathian sam uhen; ahi, michih in amau lampi hoih lou leh akhut ua hiamgamna lehngatsan uhen.
english: but let them be covered with sackcloth, both man and animal, and let them cry mightily to God. Yes, let them turn everyone from his evil way and from the violence that is in his hands.

paite: I manlouhna ding in, Pathian lunghei in lungsim kilehhei in, ahehna mahmah a kipan akilehhei kei ding chih kua'n ahia theithei?" achi hi.
english: Who knows whether God will not turn and relent, and turn away from his fierce anger, so that we might not perish?”

paite: Huchi in Pathian in athilhihte uh en in, alampi hoih lou uh alehngatsan uh chih amu a; akiang ua achihsa, hih atup thil hoih lou Pathian in alehngatsan a; ahihta kei hi.
english: God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way. God relented of the disaster which he said he would do to them, and he didn’t do it.

paite: Himahleh huai in Jonah alungkim het kei a, ahehta hi.
english: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was angry.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah athum a, “Aw TOUPA, ka hon ngen ahi, hiai ka gam ua ka om lai a ka gen hilou hia? Hiai ziak in Tarshish lam ah ka taimang pah a; hehpih thei Pathian, lainatna a dim, heh mengmeng lou, zahngaihna hau, thil hoih lou lehngatsan sek na hi chih ka thei hi.
english: He prayed to Yahweh, and said, “Please, Yahweh, wasn’t this what I said when I was still in my own country? Therefore I hurried to flee to Tarshish, for I knew that you are a gracious God and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and you relent of doing harm.

paite: Huaiziak in AW TOUPA, tu in ka hinna hon laksak ding in ka hon ngen hi; kei a ding in hin sang in sih ahoihzaw hi,” achi hi.
english: Therefore now, Yahweh, take, I beg you, my life from me, for it is better for me to die than to live.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N, na heh mawk, na hihdik hia? achi hi.
english: Yahweh said, “Is it right for you to be angry?”

paite: Huchi in khopi a kipan Jonah apaikhia a, khopi suahlam pang ah atu a, huai ah sawlbuk alam a, khopi tung a thil hong tung ding muh tum in anuailim ah atu nilouh hi.
english: Then Jonah went out of the city and sat on the east side of the city, and there made himself a booth and sat under it in the shade, until he might see what would become of the city.

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in umgui Jonah tung ah azamsak a, ahaksatna a kipan hunkhe ding a alu liah ding in ana sepkhol hi. Huchi in Jonah umgui ziak in akipak mahmah hi.
english: Yahweh God prepared a vine and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shade over his head to deliver him from his discomfort. So Jonah was exceedingly glad because of the vine.

paite: Himahleh Pathian in, azingsang phalvak in, leikha ana sepkhol a, huai in umgui akeitan a, ahong vuaita hi.
english: But God prepared a worm at dawn the next day, and it chewed on the vine so that it withered.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ni ahong suah in Pathian in suahlam huih ana sepkhol a; ni in Jonah lu ahai a, asibup a, amah a ding in sih angen hi, “Kei a ding in hin sang in sih ahoihzaw," achi hi.
english: When the sun arose, God prepared a sultry east wind; and the sun beat on Jonah’s head, so that he was faint and requested for himself that he might die. He said, “It is better for me to die than to live.”

paite: Pathian in Jonah kiang ah, “Umgui tungtang thu a na heh mawk, na hihdik hia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Sih ut hial a ka heh, ka hihdik hi,” achi hi.
english: God said to Jonah, “Is it right for you to be angry about the vine?” He said, “I am right to be angry, even to death.”

paite: TOUPA'N, “Na gim pih louh, na khansak leng hi sam lou, zan khat thu a hong om a, zan khat thu a mang nawn umgui na hehpihleh;
english: Yahweh said, “You have been concerned for the vine, for which you have not labored, neither made it grow; which came up in a night and perished in a night.

paite: Nineveh khua, khopi thupitak, asung a mi nuaikhat-le-singnih sang a tam, ataklam uleh aveilam uh leng khen theiloute leh ganhon tampi omna, ka hehpih kei dia hia?" achi hi.
english: Shouldn’t I be concerned for Nineveh, that great city, in which are more than one hundred twenty thousand persons who can’t discern between their right hand and their left hand, and also many animals?”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA sikha Mosi sih nung in Mosi nasempa Nun tapa Joshua kiang ah TOUPA'N
english: Now after the death of Moses the servant of Yahweh, Yahweh spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ servant, saying,

paite: "Ka sikha Mosi asita a; thou inla, nang leh hiai mipi tengteng in Jordan lui kan unla, Israel suante ka piak gam ah pai un.
english: “Moses my servant is dead. Now therefore arise, go across this Jordan, you and all these people, to the land which I am giving to them, even to the children of Israel.

paite: Mosi kiang a ka gensa bang in na khepek ua na sikna peuhmah uh ka hon pe vek ding.
english: I have given you every place that the sole of your foot will tread on, as I told Moses.

paite: Gamdai a pan leh hiai Lebanon tang a pan lui lianpi Euphrates Luipi pha a, Hitte gam tengteng, nitumna lam a tuipi zatak pha in na gam uh ahi ding.
english: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.

paite: Na damsung teng kuamah himhim in hon nangzou kei ding. Mosi kiang a ka om bang in, nang kiang ah leng ka om ding hi. K'on zuausan kei dia, pai leng k'on paisan sam kei ding hi.
english: No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not fail you nor forsake you.

paite: Hattak leh hangsantak in om in; asuante uh kichiam a piak ka na chiamsa gam, hiaite luahsak ding na hi ngal a.
english: “Be strong and courageous; for you shall cause this people to inherit the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.

paite: Ka sikha Mosi in dan tengteng zui dia thu hon piak zui tinten ding in hattak leh hangsantak in om peuhmah phot in. Na paina teng a na lamzan zel theihna ding in na taklam ah hiam, na veilam ah hiam pialsan het ke'n.
english: Only be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant commanded you. Don’t turn from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may have good success wherever you go.

paite: Hiai Dan Bu in na kam pawtsan het kei hen. Hiai a thu kigelh tengteng na zuih tinten theihna ding in sun leh zan in na ngaihtuah zaw ding ahi. Huchi in na lampite na tuahphasak dia, na hong lamzang ding hi.
english: This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.

paite: Thu ka hon pia hilou hiam? Hattak leh hangsantak in om in. Lau ke'nla, lunglel sam ke'n, TOUPA na Pathian na paina teng ah na kiang a om ding ahi," achi hi.
english: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.”

paite: Joshua in mipi heutute thu apia a,
english: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

paite: "Giahphual va sik unla, mipite kiang ah, 'Nek ding sutuah dih ua, ni thum sung a TOUPA na Pathian un gam luah dia ahon piak luah ding a Jordan lui kan ding na hih ziak un,' " chi in thu ahon pia hi.
english: “Pass through the middle of the camp, and command the people, saying, ‘Prepare food; for within three days you are to pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land which Yahweh your God gives you to possess.’”

paite: Reubente, Gadte leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte kiang ah Joshua in,
english: Joshua spoke to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, saying,

paite: "TOUPA na Pathian un khawlna ahon pia a, hiai hon pe ding chi a TOUPA sikha Mosi in thu hon piak theigige un.
english: “Remember the word which Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, saying, ‘Yahweh your God gives you rest, and will give you this land.

paite: Na zite uh, na taneu chikchikte leh na ganhonte uh zaw Jordan lui gal a Mosi in gam hon na piak ah a-om ding uh. Nou mihat leh hangsan teng kigalthuamsa in na pai masa ding ua, na unaute uh na panpih ding ua,
english: Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock shall live in the land which Moses gave you beyond the Jordan; but you shall pass over before your brothers armed, all the mighty men of valor, and shall help them

paite: TOUPA'N na unaute uh noute bangmah a khawlna apiak a, TOUPA na Pathian un hon gam piak amaute'n leng aluah mateng uh. Huchi in TOUPA sikha Mosi in Jordan lui gal, nisuahna lam gam nou a tuam ding a hon na piakna lam ah na kik nawn ding ua, na luah ding uh," achi hi.
english: until Yahweh has given your brothers rest, as he has given you, and they have also possessed the land which Yahweh your God gives them. Then you shall return to the land of your possession and possess it, which Moses the servant of Yahweh gave you beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise.’”

paite: Amau, "Hih dia na hon thupiak tengteng ka hih ding uh, n'on sawlna teng ah leng ka pai ding uh.
english: They answered Joshua, saying, “All that you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.

paite: Bang lam peuh a Mosi thu ka zuih bang un, nang thu leng ka zui ding uh. Mosi kiang a TOUPA na Pathian a-om bang in nang kiang ah leng om peuhmah phot hen.
english: Just as we listened to Moses in all things, so will we listen to you. Only may Yahweh your God be with you, as he was with Moses.

paite: Kuapeuh na thupiak kalh a, hel a, thu na piak peuhmah zui nuam lou zaw hihlup ding ahi. Hattak leh hangsantak in om peuhmah phot in," chi in Joshua adawng uhi.
english: Whoever rebels against your commandment, and doesn’t listen to your words in all that you command him shall himself be put to death. Only be strong and courageous.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jerusalem kumpipa Adoni-zedek in Joshua in Ai khua ala a, ahihsegawp dimdem a, Jeriko khua leh akumpipa ahihsiat bang in Ai khua leh akumpipa leng ahihsegawp a, Gibeon a mite'n Israelte toh lemna bawl in, alak uah ateng sam uh, chih azak in, alauta mahmah hi.
english: Now when Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them,

paite: Gibeon khua bel lianpi, kumpipa khopite lak a khat bang a lian ahi. Ai khua sang a lianzaw leh amite leng hattak ahih ziak un alau mahmah uhi.
english: they were very afraid, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all its men were mighty.

paite: Huaiziak in Jerusalem kumpipa Adoni-zedek in Hebron kumpipa Hoham, Jermuth kumpina Piram. Lakish kumpipa Japhia leh Eglon kumpipa Debir kiang ah,
english: Therefore Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem sent to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish, and Debir king of Eglon, saying,

paite: "Hong pai unla, hong panpih un, Gibeon i va dou ding uh. Joshua leh Israel suante toh lemna abawl ngal ua," chi in athukhak hi.
english: “Come up to me and help me. Let’s strike Gibeon; for they have made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.”

paite: Amorte kumpipa ngate: Jerusalem kumpipa, Hebron kumpipa, Jermuth kumpipa, Lakish kumpipa leh Eglon kumpipa akikhawm ua, asepaih tengteng uh toh ahohtou ua, Gibeon kho zawn ah giahphual sat in adouta uhi.
english: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together and went up, they and all their armies, and encamped against Gibeon, and made war against it.

paite: Gibeonte'n Gilgal giahphual a om Joshua kiang ah mi asawl ua, "Na sikhate hon nuse ke'n. Kintak in ka kiang uah hong tou in, hong panpih inla, hong hondam in. Singtang gam a teng Amor kumpipate kou hong dou ding in akikhawm uh," chi in ava hilh uhi.
english: The men of Gibeon sent to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, saying, “Don’t abandon your servants! Come up to us quickly and save us! Help us; for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the hill country have gathered together against us.”

paite: Joshua leh akiang a gal dou thei mi tengteng leh mihat hangsan tengteng Gilgal a pan ahohtou uhi.
english: So Joshua went up from Gilgal, he and the whole army with him, including all the mighty men of valor.

paite: TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Amaute lau het ke'n. Na khut ah ka hon pe khinta hi. Alak ua mi kuamah na ma ah adingh zou kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t fear them, for I have delivered them into your hands. Not a man of them will stand before you.”

paite: Huaiziak in Joshua in amaute adou guih a; zankhua a Gilgal a pan ana hohtousa ahi.
english: Joshua therefore came to them suddenly. He marched from Gilgal all night.

paite: TOUPA'N Israelte ma ah amaute ahihbuai gawpta a, Gibeon ah tampi athat a, Beth-horon zottouhna lampi ah adelh a, Azekah leh Makkedah kho pha in athat hi.
english: Yahweh confused them before Israel. He killed them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them by the way of the ascent of Beth Horon, and struck them to Azekah and to Makkedah.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israelte ma ah ataikek ua, Beth-horon a pan apaisukna mun a a-om lai un, TOUPA'N van a pan gial lian pipi atung uah Azekah kho pha in akesak a, asi uhi. Israel suante'n namsau a asatlup sang un gial denlup atamzaw hi.
english: As they fled from before Israel, while they were at the descent of Beth Horon, Yahweh hurled down great stones from the sky on them to Azekah, and they died. There were more who died from the hailstones than those whom the children of Israel killed with the sword.

paite: TOUPA'N Amorte Israel suante apiak ni in Joshua in TOUPA kiang h thu agen a; Israelte mitmuh in, "Ni, Gibeon kho tung ah dingh nilouh in; kha, nang leng, Aijalon Phaizang ah om nilouh in," achi hi.
english: Then Joshua spoke to Yahweh in the day when Yahweh delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel. He said in the sight of Israel, “Sun, stand still on Gibeon! You, moon, stop in the valley of Aijalon!”

paite: Mite'n amelmate uh tung a phu alak masiah uh ni adingh daikinken a, kha leng a-om nilouh hi. Hiai thu Jasar laibu a gelh hilou hia? Huchi in van lai ah ni a-om nilouh a, ni khat sung vengveng tum thu angaihtuah kei hi.
english: The sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the nation had avenged themselves of their enemies. Isn’t this written in the book of Jashar? The sun stayed in the middle of the sky, and didn’t hurry to go down about a whole day.

paite: TOUPA'N huchibang a mihing aw angaihkhiak ni, ama in a-om ngei kei a anung in leng a-om ngei kei; TOUPA'N lah Israelte adoupih ngal a.
english: There was no day like that before it or after it, that Yahweh listened to the voice of a man; for Yahweh fought for Israel.

paite: Joshua leh Israelte agiahphual uh Gilgal ah akik nawn vek uhi.
english: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.

paite: Huai kumpipa ngate ataimang ua, Makkedah kokhuk ah akibu uhi.
english: These five kings fled, and hid themselves in the cave at Makkedah.

paite: "Makkedah kokhuk a kibu, kumpipa ngate muh ahi uh," chi in Joshua hilh in a-om hi.
english: Joshua was told, saying, “The five kings have been found, hidden in the cave at Makkedah.”

paite: Joshua in, "Kokhuk kam suang lianpi khuk in sin unla, veng mite leng omsak un.
english: Joshua said, “Roll large stones to cover the cave’s entrance, and set men by it to guard them;

paite: Noute bel om kei unla; na melmate uh delh unla, anungdalte that unla; akhua himhim uah lutsak kei un. TOUPA na Pathian un na khut uah amau ahon peta ngal a," achi hi.
english: but don’t stay there. Pursue your enemies, and attack them from the rear. Don’t allow them to enter into their cities; for Yahweh your God has delivered them into your hand.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Joshua leh Israel suante'n athah bei khit ua, kulhbaangpi nei khuate a, a-omlaite atailut khit un,
english: When Joshua and the children of Israel had finished killing them with a very great slaughter until they were consumed, and the remnant which remained of them had entered into the fortified cities,

paite: mi tengteng Joshua kiang Makkedah ah galmuangtak in ahong kik nawn ua. Israel suante dem in kuamah in lei alok ngam kei uh.
english: all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace. None moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.

paite: Joshua in, "Kokhuk kam hong unla, kokhuk a pan ka kiang ah kumpipa ngate hon kaikhia un," achi hi.
english: Then Joshua said, “Open the cave entrance, and bring those five kings out of the cave to me.”

paite: Hichibang in ahih ua, kumpipa ngate: Jerusalem kumpipa, Hebron kumpipa, Jermuth kumpipa, Lakish kumpipa leh Eglon kumpipa kokhuk a pan akiang ah ahon pikhia uhi.
english: They did so, and brought those five kings out of the cave to him: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipate Joshua kiang a ahon pitak un, Joshua in Israel tengteng asamkhawm a, amah toh kuan galdou thei mite lak a heutute kiang ah, "Hong pai nai unla, hiai kumpipate ngawng sik un," achi hi. Huchi in ahong pai nai ua, angawng uh ahong siksak uhi.
english: When they brought those kings out to Joshua, Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said to the chiefs of the men of war who went with him, “Come near. Put your feet on the necks of these kings.” They came near, and put their feet on their necks.

paite: Joshua in akiang uah, "Lau kei unla, lunglel sam kei un. Hattak leh hangsantak in om un. Na dou uh na melma tengteng tung ah TOUPA'N hichibang in ahih ding," achi hi.
english: Joshua said to them, “Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed. Be strong and courageous, for Yahweh will do this to all your enemies against whom you fight.”

paite: Huai khit in Joshua in amau asatzan a, athat a, sing dawn ah akhai a; nitaklam tan in sing dawn ah akikhai lai uhi.
english: Afterward Joshua struck them, put them to death, and hanged them on five trees. They were hanging on the trees until the evening.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, nitum kuan in Joshua in thu apia a, sing dawn a pan alakhia ua, akibukna kokhuk uah apailut ua, akokhuk kam suang lianpi in asin ua, tuni tan in leng a-om lai hi.
english: At the time of the going down of the sun, Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and threw them into the cave in which they had hidden themselves, and laid great stones on the mouth of the cave, which remain to this very day.

paite: Joshua in huai ni in Makkedah khua ala a, akumpipa uh tan in namsau in alok a; huai khua a om tengteng asatlum vek a, khat lel leng hawi anei kei. Jeriko kumpipa tung a ahih mah bang in, Makkedah kumpipa tung ah leng ahihta hi.
english: Joshua took Makkedah on that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with its king. He utterly destroyed it and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining. He did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.

paite: Joshua Israel tengteng toh Makkedah a pan Libnah ah apai ua, Libnah khua adou uhi.
english: Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, to Libnah, and fought against Libnah.

paite: TOUPA'N huai khua kumpipa tan in Israelte khut ah apia hi. Huai khua dou in asung a om tengteng athat vek hi. Asung a om mi khat mah leng hinghawi anei kei hi. Jeriko kumpipa tung a ahih mah bang in akumpipa tung ah ahih hi.
english: Yahweh delivered it also, with its king, into the hand of Israel. He struck it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining in it. He did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.

paite: Joshua Israel tengteng toh Libnah a pan Lakish ah apai ua, panmun khoh in asual uhi.
english: Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, to Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it.

paite: TOUPA'N Lakish khua Israelte khut ah apia a, ani nih ni in ala ua huai khua dou in asung a om tengteng namsau in athat vek ua, Libnah khote tung a ahih bang in ahihta uhi.
english: Yahweh delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel. He took it on the second day, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with all the souls who were in it, according to all that he had done to Libnah.

paite: Bezer kumpipa Horam, Lakish khua panpih ding in akuantou a; Joshua in amah leh aheute nangawn khat mah leng hawi lou in athatgam vek hi.
english: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua struck him and his people, until he had left him no one remaining.

paite: Joshua Israel tengteng toh Lakish a pan Eglon ah apai ua, panmun akhoh ua; adou uhi.
english: Joshua passed from Lachish, and all Israel with him, to Eglon; and they encamped against it and fought against it.

paite: Huai ni in ala ua, huai ni mah in huai khua dou in asung a om tengteng namsau in athat bei sipsip hi. Lakish kho tung a ahih bang in ahihta hi.
english: They took it on that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword. He utterly destroyed all the souls who were in it that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.

paite: Joshua, Israelte tengteng toh Eglon a pan Hebron ah apai ua adou uhi.
english: Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, to Hebron; and they fought against it.

paite: Ala ua, huai khua, akumpipa, akhopel tengteng leh asung a om tengteng namsau a dou in athat vek ua, Eglon kho tung a hih bang in khat mah leng hinghawi anei kei hi. Akhua nangawn hihse vek in asung a om tengteng athat bei sipsip hi.
english: They took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, with its king and all its cities, and all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but he utterly destroyed it, and all the souls who were in it.

paite: Joshua leh Israel tengteng Debir ah akihei nawn ua adou ua;
english: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir, and fought against it.

paite: huai khua, akumpipa leh akhopel tengteng ala ua; namsau in adou ua, asung a om tengteng athat bei sipsip ua; khat mah leng hawi anei kei uh. Hebron kho tung leh Debir khua leh akumpipa uh tung a ahih bang in ahihta hi.
english: He took it, with its king and all its cities. They struck them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls who were in it. He left no one remaining. As he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to its king; as he had done also to Libnah, and to its king.

paite: Huchi in Joshua in agam pumpi, tanggamte, simlam a phaizang leh mual gamte hihse vek in akumpipa tengteng uh athat vek a; khat mah hinghawi anei kei hi. TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian thupiak bang in anak thei peuhmah ahihchimit vek hi.
english: So Joshua struck all the land, the hill country, the South, the lowland, the slopes, and all their kings. He left no one remaining, but he utterly destroyed all that breathed, as Yahweh, the God of Israel, commanded.

paite: Joshua in Kadesh-barnea a pan Gaza pha in, Goshen gam tengteng toh Gibeon pha in ahihse vek hi.
english: Joshua struck them from Kadesh Barnea even to Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even to Gibeon.

paite: Huai kumpipate tengteng leh agam uh TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in Israelte adoupih ziak in, Joshua in hun khat a alak vek ahi uhi.
english: Joshua took all these kings and their land at one time because Yahweh, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.

paite: Joshua leh Israel tengteng a giahphual Gilgal ah akik nawn vek uhi.
english: Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Hazor kumppaangaazak in, Madon kumpipa Jobab, Shimron kumpipa leh Akshaph kumpipa,
english: When Jabin king of Hazor heard of it, he sent to Jobab king of Madon, to the king of Shimron, to the king of Achshaph,

paite: Mallam tanggam kumpipate, Kineroth simlam a Arabah kumpipate, Phaigam kumpipate leh tumlam pang a Dor kumpipate,
