english: and to the kings who were on the north, in the hill country, in the Arabah south of Chinneroth, in the lowland, and in the heights of Dor on the west,

paite: suahlam leh tumlam a om Kanaan mite, tanggam a om, Amorte, Hitte, Perizte, Jebuste, Mizpah gam Hermon tang nuai a om Hivte kiang ah mi asawl hi.
english: to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite in the hill country, and the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpah.

paite: Huan asepaih tengteng uh toh mi tampi, atamdan uh tuipi a piaunel zah mahmah sakol leh kangtalai tampi toh akisa uhi.
english: They went out, they and all their armies with them, many people, even as the sand that is on the seashore in multitude, with very many horses and chariots.

paite: Huai kumpipa tengteng akimukhawm ua Israelte dou ding in Merom tuite ah agiakkhawm uhi.
english: All these kings met together; and they came and encamped together at the waters of Merom, to fight with Israel.

paite: TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Amaute lau ke'n. Zingchiang in hichih hun in amaute hihlupsa vek in Israelte ka hon pe mai ding hi. Asakolte khukguh na kilawisak dia, akangtalaite uh na halsak ding uh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t be afraid because of them; for tomorrow at this time, I will deliver them up all slain before Israel. You shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire.”

paite: Joshua leh gal dou thei mi tengteng Merom tuite ah ava kuan guih ua adou uhi.
english: So Joshua came suddenly, with all the warriors, against them by the waters of Merom, and attacked them.

paite: TOUPA'N Israelte khut ah apia a adou ua, Zidon lianzaw pha in, Misrephoth-maim munte pha in, suahlam pang a Mizpeh Phaizangte pha in adelh ua, khat leng hawi nei lou in athat vek uhi.
english: Yahweh delivered them into the hand of Israel, and they struck them, and chased them to great Sidon, and to Misrephoth Maim, and to the valley of Mizpah eastward. They struck them until they left them no one remaining.

paite: TOUPA'N asawl bang in Joshua in atung uah ahih a; asakolte khukguh akilawisak ua, akangtalaite uh ahalsak uhi.
english: Joshua did to them as Yahweh told him. He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.

paite: Huai hun in Joshua akilehhei a, Hazor khua ala a, akumpipa uh namsau in athat hi. Tuma in Hazor khua huai lai a hiai gamte tengteng lak a khopi pen ahi.
english: Joshua turned back at that time, and took Hazor, and struck its king with the sword; for Hazor used to be the head of all those kingdoms.

paite: Huai khua a om tengteng namsau in athat vek a, ahihchimit vek a, ahing peuhmah khat mah leng ahinghawi kei uhi.
english: They struck all the souls who were in it with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them. There was no one left who breathed. He burned Hazor with fire.

paite: Huchi in Kumpipate khopi tengteng leh akumpipa tengteng uh Joshua in aman vek a, namsau a dou in athat a, ahihchimit vek a; TOUPA sikha Mosi in thu apiak bang in.
english: Joshua captured all the cities of those kings, with their kings, and he struck them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded.

paite: Mual pawng a khopi a na om khinsate, Hazor khua chih louh, Israelte'n khat mah leng ahal kei uh. Huai khua bel Joshua in ahal hi.
english: But as for the cities that stood on their mounds, Israel burned none of them, except Hazor only. Joshua burned that.

paite: Hiai khopite a gallak tengteng leh gante Israel suante'n amau a tuam ding in anei ua; mihing bel ahihman vek masiah uh namsau in athat zel ua, ahing peuhmah hawi anei kei uhi.
english: The children of Israel took all the plunder of these cities, with the livestock, as plunder for themselves; but every man they struck with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them. They didn’t leave any who breathed.

paite: TOUPA'N a sikha Mosi thu apiak bang in, Mosi in huai thu Joshua apesawn a; Joshua in huai bang in ahih zel hi. TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak tengteng hih louh himhim anei kei hi.
english: As Yahweh commanded Moses his servant, so Moses commanded Joshua. Joshua did so. He left nothing undone of all that Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Huai bang in Joshua in huai gam tengteng, tanggamte, sim gam tengteng, Goshen gam tengteng, phaizang leh phaizang teng leh Israelte tangte leh phaizang teng toh ala vek hi.
english: So Joshua captured all that land, the hill country, all the South, all the land of Goshen, the lowland, the Arabah, the hill country of Israel, and the lowland of the same,

paite: Seir va suntou Halak tang a pan Hermon tang nuai a Lebanon Phaizang a Baal-gad pha in akumpipate tengteng uh aman a that in ahihlum hi.
english: from Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir, even to Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon under Mount Hermon. He took all their kings, struck them, and put them to death.

paite: Joshua in huai kumpipa tengteng sawtpitak adou hi.
english: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.

paite: Gibeon a om Hivte kia chih louh Israelte toh lemna bawl khua a-om kei uh. Dou a lak vek ahi uhi.
english: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon. They took all in battle.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang a, ahihchimit vek a, deihsakna nei het lou a, ahihman theihna dia alungtang uh hihkhauhsak a Israelte dou sakpa TOUPA ahi.
english: For it was of Yahweh to harden their hearts, to come against Israel in battle, that he might utterly destroy them, that they might have no favor, but that he might destroy them, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Huai lai in Joshua akuan a, tanggamte a pan, Hebron a pan, Debir a pan, Anab khua leh Judia tanggam tengteng leh Israel tanggam tengteng a pan Anakte ahihmang vek hi.
english: Joshua came at that time, and cut off the Anakim from the hill country, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah, and from all the hill country of Israel. Joshua utterly destroyed them with their cities.

paite: Israel suante gam ah Anakte khat lel leng atengta kei ua; Gaza, Gath leh Ashdod khuate kia ah bel a-om lai uhi.
english: There were none of the Anakim left in the land of the children of Israel. Only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, did some remain.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a, agen tengteng bang in Joshua in gam pumpi alata hi. Joshua in Israelte anam uh kikhendan bang zel in agouluah ding un gam ape chiat hi. Huchi in gam galmuang in a-omta hi.
english: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that Yahweh spoke to Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. Then the land had rest from war.

paite: Hiaite ahi uh huai gam kunipipate, Israel santen ahihman ua, agam uh Jordan lui gal, nisuahna lam gamte, Arnon Phaizang a pan Hermon tang tan, suahlam pang a Arabah tengteng toh aneihsak uh kumpipate:
english: Now these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel struck, and possessed their land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah eastward:

paite: Amorte kumpipa Sihon, Heshbon a teng in Arnon Phaizang pang a om Aroer a pan vai ahawm a, phaizang laitak a khopite, Ammon suante gamgi Jabok lui pha in Gilead gam kimkhat tung ah vai ahawm hi.
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, even to the river Jabbok, the border of the children of Ammon;

paite: Suahlam ah Arabah ah Kineroth Tuipi tan in ahi a; suahlam ah Beth-jeshimoth hohna lampı lam ah Arabah Tuipi, Chi Tuipi tan in ahi a; simlam ah Pisgah tang nuai pha in ahi.
english: and the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, eastward, and to the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, eastward, the way to Beth Jeshimoth; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah:

paite: Astaroth leh Edrei a om Rephaim nam khosuaksunte lak ah Bashan kumpipa Og in vai ahawm hi.
english: and the border of Og king of Bashan, of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

paite: Amah Hermon tang, Salkah khua leh Bashan tengteng, Geshurte leh Maakathte gamgi pha leh Heshbon kumpipa Sihon gamgi chiang Gilead gam kimkhat pha in vai ahawm hi.
english: and ruled in Mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

paite: TOUPA sikha Mosi leh Israel suante'n huaite athat ua; TOUPA sikha Mosi in Reuben chite, Gad chite, Manasseh nam kimkhatte agouluah ding un ahawm hi.
english: Moses the servant of Yahweh and the children of Israel struck them. Moses the servant of Yahweh gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

paite: Hiai gam kumpipate ahi, Joshua leh Israel suante'n Jordan lui gal tumlam pang a, athahte uh, Lebanon Phaizang Baal-gad a pan Seir tang suntou Halak tang pha in. Joshua in Israel suante akikhendan bang zel un, huai gam agouluah ding un ape chiatta hi.
english: These are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel struck beyond the Jordan westward, from Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon even to Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir. Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;

paite: Tanggam a, phaizang gamte, Arabahte, tanggamte, gamdai gamte, sim gamte; huaite bel Hit mite, Amor mite, Kanaan mite, Periz mite, Hiv mite, Jebus mite gam ahi.
english: in the hill country, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and in the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the South; the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:

paite: Jeriko kumpipa khat; Bethel kho kiang a Ai kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;

paite: Jerusalem kumpipa, khat; Hebron kumpina khat;
english: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

paite: Jarmuth kumpipa, khat; Lakish kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

paite: Eglon kumpipa, khat; Gezer kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

paite: Debir kumpipa, khat; Geder kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

paite: Hormah kumpipa, khat; Arad kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

paite: Libnah kumpipa, khat; Adullam kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

paite: Makkedah kumpipa, khat; Bethel kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;

paite: Tappuah kumpipa, khat; Hepher kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

paite: Aphek kumpipa, khat; Lasaron kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lassharon, one;

paite: Madon kumpipa, khat; Hazor kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

paite: Shimron-meron kumpipa, khat; Akshaph kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Shimron Meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

paite: Taanak kumpipa, khat; Magiddo kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

paite: Kedesh kumpipa, khat; Karmel tang a Jokneam kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;

paite: Dor tuipang a Dor kumpipa, khat; Gilgal a Goiim namte kumpipa, khat;
english: the king of Dor in the height of Dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one;

paite: Tirzah kumpipa, khat; kumpipa tengteng sawmthum-le-khat ahi uh.
english: the king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty-one.

paite: Joshua ahong upata a, ahong tek mahmahta hi. TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Na hong upa in na hong tek mahmahta a, gam lak ding lah atam lai mahmah ngal a.
english: Now Joshua was old and well advanced in years. Yahweh said to him, “You are old and advanced in years, and there remains yet very much land to be possessed.

paite: Hiai gamte ahi lak louh: Philistia gam tengteng leh Geshur gam tengteng.
english: “This is the land that still remains: all the regions of the Philistines, and all the Geshurites;

paite: Aigupta gam chin a om Shihor a pan mallam pang a Ekron gamgi tan in, huai tuh Kanaan mite gam a sim ahi; Philistiate vaihawmtu ngate, Gaza mite, Ashdod mite, Ashkelon mite Git mite leh Ekron mite: simlam a Avi mite.
english: from the Shihor, which is before Egypt, even to the border of Ekron northward, which is counted as Canaanite; the five lords of the Philistines; the Gazites, and the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avvim,

paite: Kanaan mite gam tengteng leh Zidon mite gam a Mearah, Amorte gamgi Aphek kho pha in.
english: on the south; all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that belongs to the Sidonians, to Aphek, to the border of the Amorites;

paite: Gebal mite gam leh nisuahna lam Lebanon gam tengteng Hermon tang nuai Baal-gad a pan Hamath kholutna pha in.
english: and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal Gad under Mount Hermon to the entrance of Hamath;

paite: Lebanon a pan Misrephoth-maim mun pha in, tanggam a teng tengteng, Zidon mi tengteng. Amaute Israel suante ma ah ka delhkhe dia; ka hon thupiak bang in Israel gouluah ding in bawlsak in.
english: all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, even all the Sidonians. I will drive them out from before the children of Israel. Just allocate it to Israel for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.

paite: Huchi in hiai gam nam kuate leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte gouluah ding in hawmsak in," achi hi.
english: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”

paite: TOUPA sikha Mosi in amau a dia asehsak bang in Reuben suante leh Gad suante'n Manasseh nam kimkhat dangte toh Mosi piaksa Jordan suahlam gam ah goutan aneita uhi.
english: With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of Yahweh gave them:

paite: Huai gam ahihleh Arnon Phaizang gei a om Aroer a pan leh phaizang laitak a khopi leh Medeba phaigam tengteng, Dibon tan ahi.
english: from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain of Medeba to Dibon;

paite: Amorte kumpipa Sihon, Heshbon a vaihawm a tu khopi tengteng Ammon suante gamgi tan ahi.
english: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, to the border of the children of Ammon;

paite: Gilead gam leh Geshurte leh Maakathte gamgi chiang leh Hermon tang tengteng leh Bashan gam tengteng Salkah kho tan ahi.
english: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah;

paite: Astaroth leh Edrei a kumpipa a tu Bashan gam kumpipa Og gam tengteng toh, huaite Rephaim nam milian khosuaksunte ahi uh; huaite Mosi in ana dou a, ana delhkheta hi.
english: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (who was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for Moses attacked these, and drove them out.

paite: Himahleh Geshurte leh Maakathte Israel suante'n adelhkhe kei ua; Geshurte leh Maakathte tuni tan in Israelte lak ah atengden lai uhi.
english: Nevertheless the children of Israel didn’t drive out the Geshurites, nor the Maacathites: but Geshur and Maacath live within Israel to this day.

paite: Levi namte kia ahi gouluah ding a piak louh. Akiang ua ana gensa bang in TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian a dia mei a thillatte amau gouluah ahi.
english: Only he gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The offerings of Yahweh, the God of Israel, made by fire are his inheritance, as he spoke to him.

paite: Reuben suante nam a-inkuan dungzui in Mosi in gam ana peta hi.
english: Moses gave to the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their families.

paite: Agamgi uh Arnon Phaizang a om Aroer a pan phaizang laitak a khopi leh Medeba phaigam tengteng a pan,
english: Their border was from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain by Medeba;

paite: Heshbon leh huai phaigam a khopi tengteng; Debon, Bamoth-baal leh Beth-baal-meon;
english: Heshbon, and all its cities that are in the plain; Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,

paite: Jahaz, Kedemoth leh Mephaath;
english: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,

paite: Kiriathaim, Sibmah leh phaizang a tang a om Zereth-sahar;
english: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar in the mount of the valley,

paite: Beth-peor leh Ashdot-pisgah leh Beth-jeshimoth;
english: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, Beth Jeshimoth,

paite: Phaigam khopi tengteng, Heshbon a vaihawm Amorte Kumpipa Sihon lalgam teng, Mosi in ana thah khitsa Midiante kumpipate Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur leh Reba omna gam toh ahi.
english: all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses struck with the chiefs of Midian, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the princes of Sihon, who lived in the land.

paite: Beor tapa Balaam, aisan siam leng a-inkuante toh Israel suante'n athat uhi.
english: The children of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the soothsayer, with the sword, among the rest of their slain.

paite: Reuben suante gam chiang bel Jordan leh apang teng ahi. Hiai gam leh akhopite leh khuate ahi Reuben suante a dia a-inkuan omdan bang zel a gouluah dia asehsak uh.
english: The border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and its villages.

paite: Mosi in Gad suante a-inkuan dungzui un gam apia hi.
english: Moses gave to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad, according to their families.

paite: Agamgi uh Jazer khua leh Gilead gam khopi tengteng leh Ammon suante gam kimkhat, Rabbah kho kiang a om Aroer pha in;
english: Their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer that is near Rabbah;

paite: Heshbon a pan Ramath-mizpeh leh Betonim pha in; Mahanaim a pan Debir gamgi pha in;
english: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;

paite: Guam ah Beth-aram, Beth-nimrah, Sukoth, Zaphon, Heshbon kumpipa Sihon gam teng, Jordan leh agei a gamte, Jordan gal suahlam pang a Kinereth Tuipi tawp chiang tan in ahi.
english: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan’s bank, to the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward.

paite: Hiai Gad suante a dia a-inkuan omdan bang zel a agouluah ding ua seh, akhopite uh leh akhuate uh ahi.
english: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and its villages.

paite: Mosi in Manasseh nam kimkhatte gam apia hi. Manasseh nam kimkhatte a dia a-inkuan omdan bang zel a piak ahi uh.
english: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh. It was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families.

paite: Agamgi uh Mahanaim a pan Bashan gam tengteng. Bashan gam kumpipa Og gam tengteng leh Bashan gam a Jair khopi tengteng toh, kho sawmguk ahi.
english: Their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities.

paite: Gilead gam kimkhat leh Bashan gam kumpipa Og gam a Astaroth, Edrei; huai Manasseh tapa Makir suan Makir suan kimkhatte a dia a-inkuan uh omdan bang zel a seh ahi.
english: Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.

paite: Hiaite Moab phai, Jeriko zawn, Jordan gal lehlam a, Mosi in gouluah dia a piak gamte ahi uh.
english: These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho, eastward.

paite: Levi chite Mosi in gouluah ding ape kei hi. Akiang ua ana gensa bang in TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian agouluah uh ahi.
english: But Moses gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. Yahweh, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he spoke to them.

paite: Hiaite ahi Israel suante'n Kanaan gam alak ua, siampu Eleazar, Nun tapa Joshua leh Israel suante nam inkuan lupente'n agouluah ding ua ana hawm uh.
english: These are the inheritances which the children of Israel took in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed to them,

paite: Nam kuate leh nam kimkhatte a tuam dia TOUPA'N Mosi zang a thu ana piak bang in aisan in agouluah uh piak ahi.
english: by the lot of their inheritance, as Yahweh commanded by Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half-tribe.

paite: Mosi in nam nih leh nam kimkhatte Jordan gal ah agouluah ding uh ana peta hi. Levi chite bel alak uah gouluah ding ape kei hi.
english: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan; but to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.

paite: Joseph suante nam nih ahi ua, Manasseh leh Ephraim. Levi chite huai gam ah tantuam ape kei uh, a-omna ding uh khopite leh adaikim ua gantatna ding mun leh a-inn leh alou uh bawlna ding lou ngal piak ahi kei uhi.
english: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. They gave no portion to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for their livestock and for their property.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in Israel suante'n ahih ua, gam ahawm uhi.
english: The children of Israel did as Yahweh commanded Moses, and they divided the land.

paite: Judah suante Gilgal ah Joshua kiang ah ava hoh ua; Keniz mi Jephunneh tapa Kaleb in akiang ah, "Kadesh-barnea mun a Pathian mipa Mosi kiang a TOUPA'N ka tungtang leh na tungtang thu ana gen na thei hi.
english: Then the children of Judah came near to Joshua in Gilgal. Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know the thing that Yahweh spoke to Moses the man of God concerning me and concerning you in Kadesh Barnea.

paite: TOUPA sikha Mosi in Kadesh-barnea mun a pan gam va enkhe dia ahon sawl lai in kum sawmli a upa ka na hita a; ka lungsim a om bangtak akiang ah ka tun nawn hi.
english: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of Yahweh sent me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land. I brought him word again as it was in my heart.

paite: Himahleh ka unau ka kiang a pai samte'n mipite lungtang azulsuaksak ua; ke'n bel TOUPA ka Pathian ka zui hi.
english: Nevertheless, my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt; but I wholly followed Yahweh my God.

paite: Mosi in huai ni in, TOUPA ka Pathian na zuih ziak in na khe in ana siksa gam tangtawn in nang leh na suante gouluah ahi ngeingei ding, chi in akichiam hi.
english: Moses swore on that day, saying, ‘Surely the land where you walked shall be an inheritance to you and to your children forever, because you have wholly followed Yahweh my God.’

paite: Huchi in ngai in, TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a huai thute agen nung Israelte gamdai a, avakvaih sung un TOUPA'N agensa bang in kum sawmli-le-nga tak ahon damsak lai hi. Ngai in, tu in kum sawmgiat-le-nga ka hita.
english: “Now, behold, Yahweh has kept me alive, as he spoke, these forty-five years, from the time that Yahweh spoke this word to Moses, while Israel walked in the wilderness. Now, behold, I am eighty-five years old, today.

paite: Hichi pipi in leng Mosi in ahon sawl lai mah bang in ka hat lai a, nidanglai a kidouna ding leh nasep silbawlna dia thagui ka neih mah bang in tu in leng ka nei lai hi.
english: As yet I am as strong today as I was in the day that Moses sent me. As my strength was then, even so is my strength now for war, to go out and to come in.

paite: Huaiziak in hiai tang, TOUPA'N huai ni a agensa pen hon pia in, Anakte a-om ua, akhopite uh athupi a, kulhbaang a umsuak ahi uh, chih huai ni in na za a; TOUPA'N ahon ompih dia, amaute ka delhkhe thei ding, TOUPA'N ana gensa bang in," achi hi.
english: Now therefore give me this hill country, of which Yahweh spoke in that day; for you heard in that day how the Anakim were there, and great and fortified cities. It may be that Yahweh will be with me, and I shall drive them out, as Yahweh said.”

paite: Joshua in avualzawl a; Jephunneh tapa Kaleb gouluah ding in Hebron khua apeta hi.
english: Joshua blessed him; and he gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.

paite: Huaiziak in Hebron khua tuni tan in Keniz mi, Jephunneh tapa Kaleb gouluah ahong hita hi; TOUPA Israelte' Pathian azuih ziak in.
english: Therefore Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he followed Yahweh, the God of Israel wholeheartedly.

paite: Hebron kho min ama in Kiriath-arba ahi. Arba ahihleh Anakte lak a mithupipen ahi. Huai khit in agam ahong galmuangta hi.
english: Now the name of Hebron before was Kiriath Arba, after the greatest man among the Anakim. Then the land had rest from war.

paite: Hiai Judah suante a-inkuan dungzui a amau a tuam dia seh a om ahi: Edom gamgi chiang, simlam pang Zin gamdai tan hial in, simtawp tanpha in akizalhsuk hi.
english: The lot for the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families was to the border of Edom, even to the wilderness of Zin southward, at the uttermost part of the south.

paite: Simlam gamgi bel, chi Tuipi simtawp a tuipi gam geng a pan simlam doh ahi.
english: Their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looks southward;

paite: Simlam zuan in Akrabbim tan in apai zel a, Zin ava tung hi. Kadesh-barnea simlam ah atungkah a, Hebron ava tung a, Adar ah atoupai a, Karka akualkhum hi.
english: and it went out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and went up by the south of Kadesh Barnea, and passed along by Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned toward Karka;

paite: Azmon ah apai zel a, Aigupta luita ah atuakkhia a; tuipi ah gamgi atawp hi. Hiai bel simlam pang gamgi ahi.
english: and it passed along to Azmon, went out at the brook of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your south border.

paite: Suahlam pang gamgi bel Chi Tuipi ahi a, Jordan ah atawp hi. Mallam pang gamgi bel tuipi tuimeng a pan Jordan tun tawp chiang ahi.
english: The east border was the Salt Sea, even to the end of the Jordan. The border of the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the end of the Jordan.

paite: Beth-hoglah ah atoupai a, Beth-arabah mal ah apai zel a; Reuben tapa Bohan suang ah apaitou zel hi.
english: The border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

paite: Akor Phaizang a pan Debir ah apaitou a, lui simlam a om Adummim atungkahna chin ah Gilgal lam zuan in mallam ah apai zel a; En-shemesh tuite ah apaipai a, En-rogel ah asuakkhia hi.
english: The border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that faces the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the river. The border passed along to the waters of En Shemesh, and ended at En Rogel.

paite: Hinam tapa phaizang ah Jebuste gam pang simlam, huai tuh Jerusalem ahi, pha in apaitou a; Hinnom tang lam pang phaizang chin a om tang vum ah apaitou a, huai tuh Rephaim mallam pang phaizang tawp mahmah ahi.
english: The border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem) southward; and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the farthest part of the valley of Rephaim northward.

paite: Mualvum a pan Nephtoah a luituite pha in apaisuak a, Ephron tang a khopite ah apai zel a; gamgi Baalah, huai tuh Kiriath-jearim ahi, lam ah apaisuk hi.
english: The border extended from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of Mount Ephron; and the border extended to Baalah (also called Kiriath Jearim);

paite: Baalah a pan tumlam pang ah Seir tang pha in akihekkual nawn a, mallam pang ah Jearim, huai tuh Kesalon ahi, Beth-shemesh ah apaisuk a, Timnah tawn in apai zel hi.
english: and the border turned about from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and passed along to the side of Mount Jearim (also called Chesalon) on the north, and went down to Beth Shemesh, and passed along by Timnah;

paite: Mallam pang Ekron zul ah apaikhia a, Shikron ah apaisuak a, Baalah tang ah apai zel a, Jabneel ah apawt a; tuipi ah atawp hi.
english: and the border went out to the side of Ekron northward; and the border extended to Shikkeron, and passed along to Mount Baalah, and went out at Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.

paite: Tumlam pang gamgi bel tuipi azat a za leh apiau chiang teng ahi. Huai gam chiang ahi Judah suante a dia a-inkuan uh dungzui a sehsak a om.
english: The west border was to the shore of the great sea. This is the border of the children of Judah according to their families.

paite: Jephunneh tapa Kaleb TOUPA'N Joshua thu apiak bang in Judah suante lak ah tantuam abawlsak a, huai tuh Kiriath-arba ahi, Arba bel Anan pa ahi a, akhopi ahihleh Hebron ahi.
english: He gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of Yahweh to Joshua, even Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron).

paite: Kaleb in huai khua a pan Anak tapate thum Sheshai, Ahiman leh Talmai adelhkhia hi.
english: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

paite: Huai a pan Debir khomite ava dou a; ama in Debir kho min Kiriath-sepher ahi.
english: He went up against the inhabitants of Debir: now the name of Debir before was Kiriath Sepher.

paite: Kaleb in, "Kuapeuh Kiriath-sepher va dou a, va la zou peuhmah, azi ding in ka tanu Aksah ka pe ding," achi hi.
english: Caleb said, “He who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it, to him I will give Achsah my daughter as wife.”

paite: Kaleb unaupa Kenaz tapa Othniel in ava la zou a; huchi in azi ding in atanu Aksah aneisakta hi.
english: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akiang ava tun in, apa gam ngen ding in akuan a; asabiltung a pan akumkhia hi. Kaleb in akiang ah, "Bang na deih a?" ana chi hi.
english: When she came, she had him ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey, and Caleb said, “What do you want?”

paite: Ama'n, "Hon vualzawl in. Simlam gam lah na hon peta ngal a. Tui nak neite leng hon pe tel lai in," achi hi. Huchi in tui nak nei saknungte leh khangnungte apeta hi.
english: She said, “Give me a blessing. Because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” So he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

paite: Hiai ahi Judah suante nam, a-inkuan uh dungzui a agouluah uh.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.

paite: Simlam a Edom gamgi zul a Judah suante aneih khopi hiaite ahi uh: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
english: The farthest cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom in the South were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,

paite: Kinah, Dimonah leh Adadah;
english: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,

paite: Kadesh, Hazor leh Ithnan;
english: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,

paite: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,
english: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,

paite: Hazor, Hadattah, Kerioth, Hezron (huai Hazor ahi),
english: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (also called Hazor),

paite: Amam, Shema, Moladah,
english: Amam, Shema, Moladah,

paite: Hazar-gaddah, Hesmon, Beth-palet,
english: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,

paite: Hazar-shual, Beer-sheba, Bizjothjah,
english: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,

paite: Baalah, Ijim, Ezem,
english: Baalah, Iim, Ezem,

paite: Eltolad, Kesil, Hormah.
english: Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah,

paite: Ziklag, Madmannah leh Sansannah.
english: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,

paite: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain leh Rimmon ahi ua; khopi tengteng, akhotate uh toh sawmnih-le-kua ahi.
english: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon. All the cities are twenty-nine, with their villages.

paite: Phaigam lam ah Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,
english: In the lowland, Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,

paite: Zanoah, En-gannim, Tappuah, Enam,
english: Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,

paite: Jarmuth, Adullam, Sokoh, Azekah,
english: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,

paite: Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah leh Gederothaim ahi ua, akhotate uh toh khopi teng sawm-le-li ahi uh.
english: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim); fourteen cities with their villages.

paite: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal-gad;
english: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,

paite: Dilean, Mizpah leh Joktheel;
english: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,

paite: Lakish, Bozkath, Eglon;
english: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,

paite: Kabbon, Lahmas, Kitlish;
english: Cabbon, Lahmam, Chitlish,

paite: Gederoth, Beth-dagon, Naamah, Makkedah. Akhopel teng uh toh khopi tengteng sawm-le-guk ahi uh.
english: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages.

paite: Libnah, Ether, Ahsan,
english: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,

paite: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,
english: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,

paite: Keilah, Akzib leh Mareshah. Akhopel teng uh toh khopi tengteng kua ahi uh.
english: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages.

paite: Ekron leh akhopite leh akhotate toh,
english: Ekron, with its towns and its villages;

paite: Ekron a pan tuipi tanpha in Ashdod zul a om tengteng, akhotate uh toh.
english: from Ekron even to the sea, all that were by the side of Ashdod, with their villages.

paite: Ashdod leh akhopite leh akhotate: Gaza leh akhopite leh akhotate; Aigupta lui leh tuipi za leh agei chiang pha in.
english: Ashdod, its towns and its villages; Gaza, its towns and its villages; to the brook of Egypt, and the great sea with its coastline.

paite: Singtang gam lam ah Shamir, Jattir, Sokoh,
english: In the hill country, Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,

paite: Dannah leh Kirjath-sannah, huai tuh Debir ahi,
english: Dannah, Kiriath Sannah (which is Debir),

paite: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim leh Gosen,
english: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,

paite: Gosen, Holon leh Giloh; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng sawm-le-khat ahi.
english: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages.

paite: Arab, Dumah, Eshean,
english: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,

paite: Janum, Beth-tappuah, Aphekah,
english: Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,

paite: Humtah leh Kiriath-arba, huai tuh Hebron ahi, huan Zior; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng kua ahi.
english: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), and Zior; nine cities with their villages.

paite: Maon, Karmel, Ziph, Juttah,
english: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Jutah,

paite: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,
english: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,

paite: Kain, Gibeah leh Timnah; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng sawm ahi.
english: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages.

paite: Halhul, Beth-zur, Gedor,
english: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,

paite: Maarath, Beth-anoth leh Eltekon; akhotate uh toh khopite tengteng guk ahi.
english: Maarath, Beth Anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages.

paite: Kiriath-baal, huai tuh Kiriath-jearim ahi, leh Rabbah; akhotate uh toh khopi nih ahi.
english: Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.

paite: Gamdai a Beth-arabah, Middin, Sekakah,
english: In the wilderness, Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,

paite: Chi khopi Nibshan leh En-gedi; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng guk ahi.
english: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En Gedi; six cities with their villages.

paite: Jerusalem a teng Jebuste ahihleh Judah suante'n adelhkhe zou kei ua, tuni tan in Jerusalem ah Judah suante leh Jebuste atengkhawm uhi.
english: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah couldn’t drive them out; but the Jebusites live with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.

paite: Joseph suante tantuam, Jeriko zawn a pan gamdai kiang, suahlam pang Jeriko tuite ah asuak a, Jeriko a pan singtang gam ah Bethel pha in apaitou zel hi.
english: The lot came out for the children of Joseph from the Jordan at Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east, even the wilderness, going up from Jericho through the hill country to Bethel.

paite: Bethel a pan Luz ah alut a, Arki mite gamgi a Ataroth pha in apai zel hi.
english: It went out from Bethel to Luz, and passed along to the border of the Archites to Ataroth;

paite: Tumlam pang ah Japhlet suante gamgi, Beth-horon gamgi khangnungzaw, Gezer pha in apaisuk zel a; tupi ah asuak hi.
english: and it went down westward to the border of the Japhletites, to the border of Beth Horon the lower, and on to Gezer; and ended at the sea.

paite: Huchi in Joseph suante Manasseh leh Ephraim suante'n tantuam in alata uhi.
english: The children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.

paite: A-inkuan uh dungzui zel a Ephraim suante gamgi hiai ahi: Suahlam pang atantuam uh gamgi Ataroth-addar ahi a, Beth-horon saknungzaw apha hi.
english: This was the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families. The border of their inheritance eastward was Ataroth Addar, to Beth Horon the upper.

paite: Mikmethath maltum lam pang ah asuak a, suahlam pang ah Taanath-shiloh pha in akihei nawn a, Janohah suahlam ah apai zel hi.
english: The border went out westward at Michmethath on the north. The border turned about eastward to Taanath Shiloh, and passed along it on the east of Janoah.

paite: Janohah a pan Ataroth ah, Naarah ah apaisuk a, Jeriko atung a, Jordan ah asuak hi.
english: It went down from Janoah to Ataroth, to Naarah, reached to Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.

paite: Tappuah a pan tumlam pang ah Kanah luita pha in apai a; tuipi ah asuak hi. Huaite ahi Ephraim suante a-inkuan uh dungzui a atantuam uh.
english: From Tappuah the border went along westward to the brook of Kanah; and ended at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families;

paite: Manasseh suante tantuam lak a Ephraim suante a dia khopi asehtuamsakte toh; akhopi tengteng leh akhotate leng.
english: together with the cities which were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

paite: Gezer a teng Kanaante adelhkhe kei ua; Ephraimte lak ah Kanaante tuni tan in a-om lai ua, asikha un a-om uhi.
english: They didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwell in the territory of Ephraim to this day, and have become servants to do forced labor.

paite: Manasseh suante tantuam hiaite ahi. Manasseh Joseph tapa masa ahi a, Gilead pa, Manasseh tapa masa Makir galhat ahih ziak in Gilead leh Bashan gam atang hi.
english: This was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. As for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

paite: Manasseh suan dang tengteng a ding in a-inkuan uh dungzui in tantuam leng a-om hi. Abiezer suante a ding, Helek suante a ding, Shekem suante a ding, Hepher suante a ding leh Shemida suante a ding. Huaite a-inkuan uh dungzui zel a Joseph tapa Manasseh suan pasalte ahi uhi.
english: So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of Asriel, for the children of Shechem, for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida. These were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.

paite: Manasseh tapa Makir, huai tapa Gilead, huai tapa Hepher, huai tapa Zelophehad in tapa nei lou in tanu ngen anei hi. Atanute min Mahlah, Noah, Hoglai, Milkah leh Tirzah ahi.
english: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

paite: Siampu Eleazar ma ah leh Nun tapa Joshua ma ah leh miliante ma ah ahoh ua, "Ka unaute uh lak a tantuam hon pe sam ding in TOUPA'N Mosi thu apia hi," chi in agen uhi. TOUPA thupiak bang in apa uh unaute lak ah tantuam ape samta hi.
english: They came to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the princes, saying, “Yahweh commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” Therefore according to the commandment of Yahweh he gave them an inheritance among the brothers of their father.

paite: Jordan gal ah Gilead leh Bashan gam sim louh in, Manasseh tantuam ding in mun sawm apuk a;
english: Ten parts fell to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan;

paite: Manasseh tanute'n atapate uh lak ah tantuam aneih sam ziak uh ahi. Gilead gam bel Manasseh tapa dangte'n atang uhi.
english: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.

paite: Manasseh gamgi Shekem suahlam a om Asher a pan Mikmethath pha in ahi a; taklam pang ah En-tappuah mite tenna pha in apai hi.
english: The border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem. The border went along to the right hand, to the inhabitants of En Tappuah.

paite: Tappuah gam Manasseh a ahi a; himahleh Manasseh gamgi chin a Tappuah ahihleh Ephraim suante a ahi.
english: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.

paite: Gamgi kan in luita simlam pang ah apaisuk a, Ephraim suante gamgi asun hi. Ephraim suante khopite khenkhat Manasseh suante khopite lak ah a-om hi. Himahleh Manasseh suante gamgi bel Kanah kuam mallam pang ah apai a, tuipi ah atawp hi.
english: The border went down to the brook of Kanah, southward of the brook. These cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh. The border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook, and ended at the sea.

paite: Simlam pang Ephraim a ahi a, mallam pang pen Manasseh a ahi. Tuipi a gamgi ahi. Mallam ah Asher pha in ahi a, suahlam ah Issakar pha in ahitou hi.
english: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea was his border. They reached to Asher on the north, and to Issachar on the east.

paite: Issakar leh Asher gam ah Manasseh in Beth-shean leh akim a khuate, Ibleam leh akim a khuate, Dor a tengte leh akim a khuate, Endor a tengte leh akim a khuate, Taanak a tengte leh akim a khuate, leh Meggiddo a tengte leh akim a khuate zou in, kho seh thum anei uhi.
english: Manasseh had three heights in Issachar, in Asher Beth Shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns.

paite: Kanaan mite'n huai gam luah asawm teitei ziak un, Manasseh suante'n huai khopi a tengte adelhkhe zou kei uhi.
english: Yet the children of Manasseh couldn’t drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israel suante ahong hat hiaihiai un, Kanaante nasem a goih ding in a-omsak ua, adelhkhe siang vek kei uhi.
english: When the children of Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them out.

paite: Joseph suante'n Joshua kiang ah, "Bangchidan ahia gouluah ding tantuam seh khat, tan khat kia na hon piak tuam, TOUPA'N lah tutan in hon nak vualzawl mahmah ngal a?" achi uhi.
english: The children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, “Why have you given me just one lot and one part for an inheritance, since we are a numerous people, because Yahweh has blessed us so far?”

paite: Joshua in akiang uah, "Tam na hih uleh, Perizte leh miliante gammang na tenna ding un va vat un. Ephraim tanggam pen nou a dia aneu luatleh," achi hi.
english: Joshua said to them, “If you are a numerous people, go up to the forest, and clear land for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the Rephaim, since the hill country of Ephraim is too narrow for you.”

paite: Joseph suante'n, "Tanggam kou a ding in ahun kei. Phaigam a teng Kanaan tengteng, Beth-shean leh akhopi a tengte leh Jezreel phaizang a tengte'n sik kangtalai anei chiat tuamse uh," achi uhi.
english: The children of Joseph said, “The hill country is not enough for us. All the Canaanites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both those who are in Beth Shean and its towns, and those who are in the valley of Jezreel.”

paite: Joshua in Joseph inkuante, Ephraim leh Manasseh suante kiang ah, "Na tam mahmah ua, hat leng na hat ua; tan khat kia na nei kei ding uh.
english: Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, that is, to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, “You are a numerous people, and have great power. You shall not have one lot only;

paite: 'Tanggam teng nou a ding ahi lai ding hi. Gammang hitaleh, na vat ding ua, agam chiang tengteng nou a ahi ding.' Kanaante'n sik kangtalaite nei in, hat tawk le uh leng, na hawlkhe zou ding uh," achi hi.
english: but the hill country shall be yours. Although it is a forest, you shall cut it down, and it’s farthest extent shall be yours; for you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong.”

paite: Huai nung in Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng Shiloh ah akikhawm ua, huai ah kihoupihna biakbuk akai uhi. Huai gam teng azou khinta uhi.
english: The whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The land was subdued before them.

paite: Israel suante lak ah atantuam uh tang nai lou nam sagih a-om lai uhi.
english: Seven tribes remained among the children of Israel, which had not yet divided their inheritance.

paite: Joshua in Israel suante kiang ah, "TOUPA na pipute uh Pathian in nou hon piaksa gam, bang tan ahia luah lou a na awltat lai ding uh?
english: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “How long will you neglect to go in to possess the land, which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has given you?

paite: Nam chih a kipan mi thum zel telkhia unla; amau akuan ding ua, gam ava en vialvial ding ua, atantuam hun ding uh bang chiat zel in ava gelh ding ua; ka kiang ah ahong nawn ding uh.
english: Appoint for yourselves three men from each tribe. I will send them, and they shall arise, walk through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; then they shall come to me.

paite: Mun sagih in akhen phot ding ua; Judah pawl simlam ah atantuam uah a-om ding ua, Joseph inkuante mallam ah atantuam uah a-om ding uh.
english: They shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall live in his borders on the south, and the house of Joseph shall live in their borders on the north.

paite: Gam mun sagih in va khen unla, huai gelhna hon pia un. Huchi in hiai ah TOUPA i Pathian ma ah ai ka hon sansak ding hi.
english: You shall survey the land into seven parts, and bring the description here to me; and I will cast lots for you here before Yahweh our God.

paite: Levi teng in na lak uah tantuam anei kei ding uh. TOUPA mai a siampu nasep amau goutan ahi. Gad pawl, Reuben pawl leh Manasseh nam kimkhat bel Jordan gal suahlam ah amau tantuam TOUPA sikha Mosi in apiak ana tangta uh," achi hi.
english: However, the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of Yahweh is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of Yahweh gave them.”

paite: Huchi in huai mite apawtkheta ua, Joshua in, "Gam va en vialvial unla, hon gelhkhia unla, ka kiang ah hon tun nawn unla, hiai ah Shiloh ah TOUPA ma ah ai ka hon sansak ding," chi in thu apia hi.
english: The men arose and went. Joshua commanded those who went to survey the land, saying, “Go walk through the land, survey it, and come again to me. I will cast lots for you here before Yahweh in Shiloh.”

paite: Mite akuan ua, gam ava en vialvial ua, mun sagih in akhen ua, laibu ah akhuakhua in agelhkhia ua, giahphual Shiloh ah Joshua kiang ah akik nawn uhi.
english: The men went and passed through the land, and surveyed it by cities into seven portions in a book. They came to Joshua to the camp at Shiloh.

paite: Joshua in Shiloh ah TOUPA ma ah ai ana sansak a; huai ah Joshua in Israel suante akikhendan bang zel un gam ahawmta hi.
english: Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before Yahweh. There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.

paite: Aisan a-inkuan uh dungzui in Benjamin suante tung ah aketa a; agamgi chiang uh Judah suante leh Joseph suante kikal ahi.
english: The lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families. The border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

paite: Mallam pang a agamgi chiang uh Jordan a pan ahi a; Jeriko sik ah mallam pang ah apaitou a, tumlam pang ah tanggam ah apaitou zel a; Beth-Aven gamdai ah atawp hi.
english: Their border on the north quarter was from the Jordan. The border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the hill country westward. It ended at the wilderness of Beth Aven.

paite: Hiai a pan Luz lam ah, Luz, huai tuh Bethel ahi, sik ah, simlam pang ah apai zel a; Beth-horon khang simlam pang a mual zul ah Ataroth-addar ah apaisuk hi.
english: The border passed along from there to Luz, to the side of Luz (also called Bethel), southward. The border went down to Ataroth Addar, by the mountain that lies on the south of Beth Horon the lower.

paite: Apai zel a, Beth-horon simlam pang a tangchin a pan tumlam ah simlam pang ah akualphei a; Kiriath-baal, huai Kiriath-jearim ahi, Judah suante khopi ah atawp a; huai tumlam pang gamgi ahi.
english: The border extended, and turned around on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon southward; and ended at Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), a city of the children of Judah. This was the west quarter.

paite: Simlam pang a gam Kiriath- jearim tawp a pan ahi a; tumlam ah apawt a, Nephtoah luituite ah apai zel hi.
english: The south quarter was from the farthest part of Kiriath Jearim. The border went out westward, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.

paite: Rephaim mallam pang phaizang a Hinnom Tapa phaizang chin a tangmong ah apaisuk a; Jebuste sik ah, simlam pang a Hinnom Phaizang ah apaisuk a, En-rogel ah apaisuk hi.
english: The border went down to the farthest part of the mountain that lies before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of Rephaim northward. It went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En Rogel.

paite: Mallam zuan in apai a, En-shemesh ah apai a, Adummim kahtouhna chin Geliloth ah apai a; Reuben tapa Bohan suang ah apaisuk a;
english: It extended northward, went out at En Shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. It went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

paite: Arabah sik mallam pang ah apai zel a, Arabah ah apaisuk a;
english: It passed along to the side opposite the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.

paite: Beth-hoglah sik, mallam pang ah apai zel a; atawpna bel Jordan simtawp, Chi Tuipi mallam tuipi meng ah ahi. Huai simlam gamgi ahi.
english: The border passed along to the side of Beth Hoglah northward; and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the south border.

paite: Jordan suahlam pang, agamgi chiang ahi. Huai ahi Benjamin suante a-inkuan uh dungzui a atantuam gam in akolhkhum sung.
english: The Jordan was its border on the east quarter. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the borders around it, according to their families.

paite: Benjamin suante a-inkuan dungzui un akhopite uh, Jeriko, Beth- hoglah, Emek-keziz,
english: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,

paite: Beth-arabah, Zemariam, Bethel,
english: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,

paite: Avim, Parah, Ophrah,
english: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,

paite: Kephar-haammonai, Ophni leh Geba; akhopel tengteng toh akhopi tengteng sawm-le-nih ahi.
english: Chephar Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages.

paite: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,
english: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,

paite: Mizpeh, Kephirah, Mozah,
english: Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah,

paite: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah;
english: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,

paite: Zelah, Eleph, Jebus, huai Jerusalem ahi, Gibeah leh Kiriath, akhotate toh khopi sawm-le-li ahi. Hiaite ahi Benjamin suante a-inkuan uh dungzui ua atantuam ding ua kisepte.
english: Zelah, Eleph, the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

paite: Aisan nihveina Simeon suante tung ah a-inkuan uh dungzui in apuk hi. Atantuam uh Judah suante tantuam lak ah atel hi.
english: The second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. Their inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah.

paite: Atantuam ding ua pukte Beer-sheba, Sheba, Moladah,
english: They had for their inheritance Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,

paite: Hazar-shual, Balah, Ezem,
english: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,

paite: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
english: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,

paite: Ziklag, Beth-markaboth. Hazar-susah,
english: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,

paite: Beth-lebaoth leh Sharuhen; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng sawm-le-thum ahi.
english: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages;

paite: Ain, Rimmon, Ether leh Ashan: akhotate toh khopi li.
english: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan; four cities with their villages;

paite: Huai khopi kim akhopel tengteng Baalath-beer simlam a Ramah apha hi. Huaite Simeon suante a-inkuan uh dungzui a amau tantuam dia seh ahi.
english: and all the villages that were around these cities to Baalath Beer, Ramah of the South. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

paite: Simeon suante tantuam Judah suante tantuam lak a ahi. Judah suante tantuam amau a ding in aza lo ngal a; huaiziak in Simeon suante tantuam lak ah atel hi.
english: Out of the part of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon; for the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them. Therefore the children of Simeon had inheritance in the middle of their inheritance.

paite: Aisan thumveina Zebulun suante tung ah a-inkuan uh dungzui in apuk hi. Atantuam gamgi uh Sarid tan ahi.
english: The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families. The border of their inheritance was to Sarid.

paite: Agamgi uh tumlam pang ah Maralah pha in apai a, Dabeseth ava tung a; Jokneam kiang a luita tan ava tung hi.
english: Their border went up westward, even to Maralah, and reached to Dabbesheth. It reached to the brook that is before Jokneam.

paite: Sarid a pan suahlam pang nisuahna lam ah Kisloth-tabor gamgi pha in akawitou a; Daberath ah apawt hi.
english: It turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth Tabor. It went out to Daberath, and went up to Japhia.

paite: Huai a pan suahlam pang ah Gittah-hepher leh Eth-kazin ah apai zel a, Neah lam zuan in Rimmon ah apawt hi.
english: From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.

paite: Mallam ah Hannathon ah akualphei nawn a, apawtna Iphtah-el Phaizang ah ahi.
english: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;

paite: Katath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah leh Bethlehem; akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng sawm- le-nih ahi.
english: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.

paite: Hiaite ahi Zebulun suante a-inkuan uh dungzui a, atantuam ding ua seh; huai khopite leh khopelte toh.
english: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

paite: Aisan liveina Issakar suante tung ah a-inkuan uh omdan dungzui in apuk hi.
english: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, even for the children of Issachar according to their families.

paite: Agamgi chiang uh Jezreel, Kesuloth, Shunem,
english: Their border was to Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,

paite: Haphraim, Shion, Anaharath,
english: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,

paite: Rabbith, Kishion, Abez,
english: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,

paite: Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah leh Beth-pazzez tan ahi.
english: Remeth, Engannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez.

paite: Tabor, Shahazimah leh Beth-shemesh ava pha a; apawtna Jordan ah ahi a, akhopel teng toh khopi tengteng sawm-le-guk ahi,
english: The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh. Their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.

paite: Hiaite ahi Issakar suante nam a-inkuan uh dungzui a, atantuam ding ua seh; khopite leh akhotate toh.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities with their villages.

paite: Aisan ngana Asher suante tung ah a-inkuan uh dungzui in apuk hi.
english: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

paite: Gamgi chiang Helkath, Hali, Beten, Akshaph,
english: Their border was Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,

paite: Allammelek, Amad leh Mishal ahi a; tumlam pang ah Karmel tang leh Shihor-libnath aphasuk hi.
english: Allammelech, Amad, Mishal. It reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath.

paite: Nisuahna lam pang ah Beth-dagon akualtou a, Zebulun leh mallam pang ah Jiphthah-el Phaizang ah Beth-emek leh Neiel ava pha a; veilam ah Kabul pha in apai a,
english: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,

paite: Ebron leh Rehob, Hammon leh Kanah, Zidon thupi pha in apai zel hi.
english: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.

paite: Gamgi Ramah leh Tura khopi kulhbaang nei ah akualphei a, Hosah ah akualphei nawn a, Akzib gam tuipi ah apawt hi.
english: The border turned to Ramah, to the fortified city of Tyre; and the border turned to Hosah. It ended at the sea by the region of Achzib;

paite: Ummah, Aphek leh Rehob; akhopel teng toh khopi tengteng sawmnih-le-nih ahi.
english: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities with their villages.

paite: Huaite ahi Asher suante nam a-inkuan uh dungzui a, khopite leh akhotate atantuam uh.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

paite: Aisan gukna Naphtali suante tung ah a-inkuan uh dungzui in apuk hi.
english: The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

paite: Agamgi chiang uh Heleph leh Zaananim a singkung lianpi a pan Adami-nekeb, Jabneel leh Lakkum pha in apai a, Jordan ah atawp hi.
english: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan.

paite: Tumlam pang ah Aznoth-tabor ah apaisuk a; huai a pan Hukok ah apai a, simlam ah Zebulun ava tung a, tumlam ah Asher atung a, nisuahna lam ah Judia gam a Jordan aphatou hi.
english: The border turned westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there to Hukkok. It reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise.

paite: Khopi kulhbaang neite: Ziddim, Zer, Hamath, Rakkath, Kinneret,
english: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,

paite: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,
english: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,

paite: Kedesh, Edrei, En-hazor,
english: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,

paite: Iron, Migdal-el, Horem, Beth-anath leh Beth-shemesh ahi a, akhotate uh toh khopi tengteng sawm ahi.
english: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath, and Beth Shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

paite: Hiaite ahi Naphtali suante nam a-inkuan dungzui ua khopite leh akhotate atantuam uh.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities with their villages.

paite: Aisan sagihna Dan suante tung ah a-inkuan uh dungzui in apuk hi.
english: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.

paite: Atantuam gamgi uh Zorah, Estaol leh Ir-shemesh,
english: The border of their inheritance was Zorah, Eshtaol, Irshemesh,

paite: Shaalabbin, Aijalon leh Jethlah,
english: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,

paite: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,
english: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,

paite: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,
english: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,

paite: Jehud, Bene-berak, Gath-rimmon,
english: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,

paite: Me-jarkon, Rakkon leh Joppa kiang a gamgi toh.
english: Me Jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border opposite Joppa.

paite: Dan suante gamgi in huaite ava kheng a; Dan suante'n Lesem adou ua, ala ua, namsau in ahihmang ua, atangta uh. Huai ah ateng pah ua, apu uh Dan min tam in Lesem, Dan ana chi uhi.
english: The border of the children of Dan went out beyond them; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their forefather.

paite: Hiaite ahi Dan suante nam a-inkuan uh dungzui a, huai khopi leh akhotate toh atantuam uh.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.

paite: Huchi in atantuam ding ua gamgi bawl bang zel a gam ahawm khit un, Israel suante'n Nun tapa Joshua alak uah tantuam abawlsak uhi.
english: So they finished distributing the land for inheritance by its borders. The children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them.

paite: TOUPA thupiak bang in Ephraim singtang gam a, akhopi ding in anget mah Timnath-serah apia ua; ama'n khopi asat a, huai ah ateng hi.
english: According to Yahweh’s commandment, they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in the hill country of Ephraim; and he built the city, and lived there.

paite: Hiaite ahi siampu Eleazar, Nun tapa Joshua leh Israel suante nam inkuan a lupente'n Shiloh a TOUPA ma a kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a ai san a, agoutan ding ua ana hawmte uh. Huchi in gam kihawm azouta uhi.
english: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before Yahweh, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing the land.

paite: Huan Nun tapa Joshua in, "Agam leh Jeriko khua va en mah dih ua," chi in mi nih Sittim a pan asim a enkhe ding asawl hi. Ava hoh ua, kizuak khat, amin Rahab inn ah ava lut ua, huai ah ava zintung uhi.
english: Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent two men out of Shittim as spies, saying, “Go, view the land, including Jericho.” They went and came into the house of a prostitute whose name was Rahab, and slept there.

paite: "Ngai in, tuzan in gam enkhe ding in Israel suante ahong uh," chi in Jeriko kumpipa hilh in a-om hi.
english: The king of Jericho was told, “Behold, men of the children of Israel came in here tonight to spy out the land.”

paite: Jeriko kumpipa'n, "Na inn a hong tung mikhualte hon pekhia in. Gam pumpi enkhe ding a hong ahi uh," chỉ ding in Rahab kiang ah mi asawl hi.
english: Jericho’s king sent to Rahab, saying, “Bring out the men who have come to you, who have entered into your house; for they have come to spy out all the land.”

paite: Numei in huai mi nihte api a, asel a, akiang uah, "Hi, ka kiang ah mite ahong ngei ngut ua, himahleh koi a pan hong pai ahi ua, chih zaw ka thei kei.
english: The woman took the two men and hid them. Then she said, “Yes, the men came to me, but I didn’t know where they came from.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, khomial, kulh kongpi khak hun lai in huai mite apawtkhe nawnta uh. Koilam ah ahia apai uh ka theita kei hi. Delh meng le uchin, na pha lai ding uh,” achi hi.
english: About the time of the shutting of the gate, when it was dark, the men went out. Where the men went, I don’t know. Pursue them quickly. You may catch up with them.”

paite: Himahleh inn tung ah apitou a, inn tung a ziza kung siatkhawm lak a sel khin lah ahi ngal a.
english: But she had brought them up to the roof, and hidden them under the stalks of flax which she had laid in order on the roof.

paite: Mite'n Jordan lui lam ah, agalkaina tan in ava delh ua; adelh mite apawtkhiaktak un kulh kongpi akhak uhi.
english: The men pursued them along the way to the fords of the Jordan River. As soon as those who pursued them had gone out, they shut the gate.

paite: Alup ma un inn tung ah akiang uah ava hohtou hi.
english: Before they had lain down, she came up to them on the roof.

paite: Akiang uah, "Hiai gam TOUPA'N nou ahon peta, na lauhhuaina un hon delhkhum a, hiai gam a teng tengteng na ma uah azul khin uh, chih ka thei hi.
english: She said to the men, “I know that Yahweh has given you the land, and that the fear of you has fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt away before you.

paite: Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawtkhiak un TOUPA'N Tuipi San ahon hihkangsak a, Jordan lui gal a Amorte kumpi nih: Sihon leh Og tung a na hihdante uh, huchibang a na hihmangdante uh lah ka na zata ngal ua.
english: For we have heard how Yahweh dried up the water of the Red Sea before you, when you came out of Egypt; and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon and to Og, whom you utterly destroyed.

paite: Huai ka na zaktak un, ka lungtangte uh azul khin a, noute ziak a lau lou himhim a-om kei hi. TOUPA na Pathian u lah tunglam van ah leh nuailam lei ah Pathian ahi.
english: As soon as we had heard it, our hearts melted, and there wasn’t any more spirit in any man, because of you: for Yahweh your God, he is God in heaven above, and on earth beneath.

paite: "Tu in na tung uah ka hehpihna ka langsakta hi, nou leng ka pa inkote tung ah na hehpihna uh langsak sam un.
english: Now therefore, please swear to me by Yahweh, since I have dealt kindly with you, that you also will deal kindly with my father’s house, and give me a true sign;

paite: Ka nu leh ka pa, ka sanggam pasalte, ka sanggam numeite leh aneih teng uh hawi unla, sihna lak a pan ka hinna uh hon humbitsak ding in TOUPA min in hehpih in ka kiang ah kichiam unla, chiamtehna dik hon pia un," achi hi.
english: and that you will save alive my father, my mother, my brothers, and my sisters, and all that they have, and will deliver our lives from death.”

paite: Mite'n akiang ah, "Ka thilhih uh na genkhiak kei dingleh na sih tang in ka si ding uh. Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N gam ahon piak hun chiang in, ka hon hehpih ding ua, na tung ah muanhuaitak in ka hih ding uh," achi uhi.
english: The men said to her, “Our life for yours, if you don’t talk about this business of ours; and it shall be, when Yahweh gives us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with you.”

paite: Tohlet ah khauhual azankhesuk a; khopi kulhbaang khou a a-inn om ahi a, huan amah kulhbaang tung a teng ahi.
english: Then she let them down by a cord through the window; for her house was on the side of the wall, and she lived on the wall.

paite: Akiang uah, "Tang lam zuan in pai un, huchi lou in zaw nou hon delhte'n ahon mu kha ding uh. Huai ah ni thum sung va kibu un; nou hon delhte ahong kik nawn masiah uh. Huai zoh chiang in na pai nawn na ding uh," achi hi.
english: She said to them, “Go to the mountain, lest the pursuers find you. Hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers have returned. Afterward, you may go your way.”

paite: Mite'n akiang ah, "Kichiamna a na hon kichiamsakna ah zaw dembei ka hi ding uh.
english: The men said to her, “We will be guiltless of this your oath which you’ve made us to swear.

paite: Ngai in, hiai gam ka hong lut chiang un na hon khiakna tohlet ah hiai khau san na gak belh în. Insung ah na kiang ah na pa, na nu, na sanggam teng leh na pa inkote tengteng pilut vek in.
english: Behold, when we come into the land, tie this line of scarlet thread in the window which you used to let us down. Gather to yourself into the house your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your father’s household.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, na inn kongpi a pan kholak a pawtkhe peuhmah alutung ah asisan a-om dia, kou ahihleh moh in ka om kei ding uh. Kuapeuh insung a na kiang a om peuhmah atung ua khutkhak ahihleh, ka lutung uah asisan uh a-om ding hi.
english: It shall be that whoever goes out of the doors of your house into the street, his blood will be on his head, and we will be guiltless. Whoever is with you in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand is on him.

paite: Himahleh ka thilhih uh na genkhiakleh na hon kichiamsakna ah moh in ka om kei ding uh," achi uhi.
english: But if you talk about this business of ours, then we shall be guiltless of your oath which you’ve made us to swear.”

paite: Ama'n, "Na thu bang zel uh hi hen," achi a; huchi in amau akhakhia a, apaita uhi. Tohlet ah khau san agakden hi.
english: She said, “Let it be as you have said.” She sent them away, and they departed. Then she tied the scarlet line in the window.

paite: Apai ua, huai tang ava tung ua, huai ah ni thum, amau delhte akik nawn masiah uh ava om uhi. Adelh mite'n lamtawn in azong ua, himahleh amuzou kei uh.
english: They went and came to the mountain, and stayed there three days, until the pursuers had returned. The pursuers sought them all along the way, but didn’t find them.

paite: Huai mi nihte akik nawn ua, huai tang a pan apaisuk ua, agalkah ua, Nun tapa Joshua kiang atung ua; atung ua thil tung tengteng ahilh uhi.
english: Then the two men returned, descended from the mountain, crossed the river, and came to Joshua the son of Nun. They told him all that had happened to them.

paite: Joshua kiang ah, "TOUPA'N agam pumpi i khut uah ahon na pe petmah ve, huai kia leng hilou, huai gam a tengte i ma uah azul khin uh," achi uhi.
english: They said to Joshua, “Truly Yahweh has delivered all the land into our hands. Moreover, all the inhabitants of the land melt away before us.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Joshua ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,

paite: "Israel suante kiang ah, 'Kihumbitna khuate bawl in, Mosi zang a na kiang ua ka gen khitsa ahi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Assign the cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you by Moses,

paite: Kuapeuh thei lou leh tumloupi a mi that kha, huai ah atailut thei ding hi. Huchi in sisan phulami a pan nou a ding in kihumbitna ahi ding.
english: that the man slayer who kills any person accidentally or unintentionally may flee there. They shall be to you for a refuge from the avenger of blood.

paite: Huai khopite lak a akoi hiam pen a, atailut chiang in, khopi kulhbaang kongpi lutna ah ava dingh ding a, huai kho upate bil a zak in atanchin ava tun ding. Amau khopi sung ah akiang uah apilut ding ua, alak ua aten sam theihna ding in a-omna ding asehsak ding uhi.
english: He shall flee to one of those cities, and shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city, and declare his case in the ears of the elders of that city. They shall take him into the city with them, and give him a place, that he may live among them.

paite: Sisan phulami in ahon delhleh athatmi pen akhut ah na pe ding uh ahi kei. A-invengte thei lou a, athah ahi; ama in aho ngal kei hi.
english: If the avenger of blood pursues him, then they shall not deliver up the man slayer into his hand; because he struck his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him before.

paite: Omkhawmte ma a vai hawmsak dia adin ma leh siampu lianpen a pangpa asih mateng, huai khopi ah ateng ding hi. Huai nung in mithat mi pen amah khosung mahmah, ataikhiaksan khua, amah mah insung ah alut nawn ding ahi,' chi in gen in," achi hi.
english: He shall dwell in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days. Then the man slayer shall return, and come to his own city, and to his own house, to the city he fled from.’”

paite: Huchi in Naphtali tanggam a Galili a Kadesh, Ephraim tanggam a Shekem leh Judia singtang gam a Kirath Arba, (huai tuh Hebron ahi) asep uhi.
english: They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.

paite: Suahlam ah Jordan gal a Jeriko ah Reuben nam gam a gamdai phaizang a Bezer, Gad nam gam a Gilead gam a Ramoth, Manasseh nam gam a Bashan a Golan asepta uhi.
english: Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

paite: Hiai khuate ahi Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng leh alak ua namdang tengte a dia seh a om. Kuapeuh mi that kha, hiai khuate a tailut in mipi mai a adin mateng sisan phulami khut ah si lou in a-om thei ding hi.
english: These were the appointed cities for all the children of Israel, and for the alien who lives among them, that whoever kills any person unintentionally might flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stands trial before the congregation.

paite: Huchi in Levi chi inkuan a pente siampu Eleaza kiang ah leh Nun tapa Joshua kiang ah leh Israel suante nam inkuan a lupente kiang ah ahoh uhi.
english: Then the heads of fathers’ houses of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel.

paite: "Kanaan gam a Shiloh khua ah, TOUPA'N Mosi zang in ka tenna ding uh khopite, ka gante uh tatna ding akimvel toh na hon piak ding uh thu ana peta," achi uhi.
english: They spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, “Yahweh commanded through Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with their pasture lands for our livestock.”

paite: Huchi in Israel suante'n TOUPA thupiak bang in atantuam ua kipan hiai khopite akimvel toh Levi chite apia uhi.
english: The children of Israel gave to the Levites out of their inheritance, according to the commandment of Yahweh, these cities with their pasture lands.

paite: Aisan Kohath suan tung ah apukta hi. Huchi in siampu Aaron suan Levi chi a mite'n Judah nam tantuam a pan, Simeon nam tantuam a pan leh Benjamin nam tantuam a pan khopi sawm-le-thum aisan in atangta uhi.
english: The lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. The children of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, had thirteen cities by lot out of the tribe of Judah, out of the tribe of the Simeonites, and out of the tribe of Benjamin.

paite: Kohath suan dangte'n Ephraim nam suante tantuam a pan, Dan nam tantuam a pan leh Manasseh nam kimkhat tantuam a pan khopi sawm aisan in atangta uhi.
english: The rest of the children of Kohath had ten cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh.

paite: Gershon suante'n Issakar nam suante tantuam a pan, Asher nam tantuam a pan, Naphtali nam tantuam a pan leh Bashan gam a Manasseh nam kimkhatte tantuam a pan, khopi sawm-le-thum aisan in atangta uhi.
english: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, out of the tribe of Asher, out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

paite: Merari suante'n a-inkuan uh dungzui in Reuben nam tantuam a pan, Gad nam tantuam a pan leh Zebulun nam tantuam a pan khopi sawm-le-nih atangta uhi.
english: The children of Merari according to their families had twelve cities out of the tribe of Reuben, out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun.

paite: Israel suante'n TOUPA'N Mosi zang a thu apiak bang in Levi mite khopite leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte aisan in apia uhi.
english: The children of Israel gave these cities with their pasture lands by lot to the Levites, as Yahweh commanded by Moses.

paite: Huchi in Judah suante nam tantuam a pan leh Simeon suante nam tantuam a pan hiai khopi minlohte apia uhi.
english: They gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are mentioned by name:

paite: Huaite Levi suan Kohath pawl a namte, Aaron suan pawl a ding ahi; amau tung ah aisan apuk masapen hi.
english: and they were for the children of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi; for theirs was the first lot.

paite: Amau a ding in Judah tanggam a Kiriath-arba leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh apia uhi. Kiriath-arba Hebron kichi ahi a, Arba ahihleh Anak pa ahi.
english: They gave them Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron), in the hill country of Judah, with its pasture lands around it.

paite: Khopi kimvelte leh akhotate Jephunneh tapa Kaleb tantuam ding in apia uhi.
english: But they gave the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.

paite: Siampu Aaron suante Hebron, mithat mite kihumbitna khopi, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Libnah khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
english: To the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Libnah with its pasture lands,

paite: Jattir khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Eshtemoa khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
english: Jattir with its pasture lands, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,

paite: Holon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Debir khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
english: Holon with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,

paite: Ain khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Juttah khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; Beth-shemesh khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; huai nam nihte tantuam a pan khopi kua apia uhi.
english: Ain with its pasture lands, Juttah with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands: nine cities out of those two tribes.

paite: Benjamin nam tantuam a pan Gibeon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Geba khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
english: Out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its pasture lands, Geba with its pasture lands,

paite: Anathoth khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Almon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; khopi li ape lai uhi.
english: Anathoth with its pasture lands, and Almon with its pasture lands: four cities.

paite: Aaron suan siampute khopi tengteng khopi sawm-le-thum ahi, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh.
