english: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.

paite: Kohath suante inkuan, Levi pawl leh Kohath suan dangte'n leng atantuam khopite uh Ephraim nam tantuam a pan in ahi atan uh.
english: The families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, even the rest of the children of Kohath, had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.

paite: Mi that mite kihumbitna khopi Ephraim singtang gam a Shekem khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Gezer khua akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
english: They gave them Shechem with its pasture lands in the hill country of Ephraim, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Gezer with its pasture lands,

paite: Kibzaim khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Beth-horon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; khopi li apia uhi.
english: Kibzaim with its pasture lands, and Beth Horon with its pasture lands: four cities.

paite: Dan nam tantuam a pan Eltekeh khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Gibbethon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
english: Out of the tribe of Dan, Elteke with its pasture lands, Gibbethon with its pasture lands,

paite: Aijalon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Gath-rimmon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, khopi li.
english: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: four cities.

paite: Manasseh nam kimkhatte tantuam a pan Taanak khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; Gath-rimmon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; khopi nih.
english: Out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with its pasture lands, and Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: two cities.

paite: Kohath suan dangte nam khopi tengteng kho sawm ahi, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh.
english: All the cities of the families of the rest of the children of Kohath were ten with their pasture lands.

paite: Gershon suante pawl, Levi namte Manasseh nam kimkhatte tantuam a pan, mithat mite kihumbitna khopi, Bashan gam a Golan khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; Beeshterah khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; khopi nih apia uhi.
english: They gave to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Be Eshterah with its pasture lands: two cities.

paite: Issakar nam tantuam a pan Kishion khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Daberath khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
english: Out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishion with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,

paite: Jarmuth khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, En-gannim khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; khopi li.
english: Jarmuth with its pasture lands, En Gannim with its pasture lands: four cities.

paite: Asher nam tantuam a pan Mishal khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
english: Out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,

paite: Helkath khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Rehob khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, khopi li.
english: Helkath with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands: four cities.

paite: Naphtali nam tantuam a pan, mithat mite kihumbitna khopi, Galili gam a Kadesh khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Hammoth-dor khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Kartan khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, khopi thum.
english: Out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, Hammothdor with its pasture lands, and Kartan with its pasture lands: three cities.

paite: Gershon pawl a-inkuan uh dungzui zel a, atantuam uh khopi tengteng sawm-le-thum ahi, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh.
english: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.

paite: Merari suante pawl inkuan, Levi pawl dangte bel Zebulun nam tantuam a pan Jokneam khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Kartah khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
english: To the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its pasture lands, Kartah with its pasture lands,

paite: Dimnah khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Nahalal khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, khopi li.
english: Dimnah with its pasture lands, and Nahalal with its pasture lands: four cities.

paite: Reuben nam tantuam a pan Bezer khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Jahaz khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
english: Out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its pasture lands, Jahaz with its pasture lands,

paite: Kedemoth khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; khopi li.
english: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands: four cities.

paite: Gad nam tantuam a pan, mithat mite kihumbitna khopi, Gilead gam a Ramoth khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Mahanaim khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
english: Out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Mahanaim with its pasture lands,

paite: Heshbon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Jazer khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; avek in khopi li,
english: Heshbon with its pasture lands, Jazer with its pasture lands: four cities in all.

paite: Hiai tengteng Levi pawl inkuan dangte Merari suante pawl a-inkuan uh dungzui zel a, akhopite uh ahi. Huchi in atantuam uh khopi sawm-le-nih ahi.
english: All these were the cities of the children of Merari according to their families, even the rest of the families of the Levites. Their lot was twelve cities.

paite: Israel suante pawl tantuam a pan Levi pawl khopi tengteng sawmli-le-giat ahi, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh.
english: All the cities of the Levites among the possessions of the children of Israel were forty-eight cities with their pasture lands.

paite: Hiai khopite'n akimvel anei chiat ua; khopi tengteng huchibang vek ahi uh.
english: Each of these cities included their pasture lands around them. It was this way with all these cities.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N apipute uh kichiam a piak ana chiamsa gam tengteng Israelte apia hi. Amau huai gam aluah ua, asung ah atengta uhi.
english: So Yahweh gave to Israel all the land which he swore to give to their fathers. They possessed it, and lived in it.

paite: TOUPA'N apipute uh kiang a kichiam a, ana chiamsa bang ngei in mun chih ah muanna apia a, amelma tengteng uh kuamah ama ua pangzou himhim a-om kei uhi. TOUPA'N amelma tengteng akhut uah ape vek hi.
english: Yahweh gave them rest all around, according to all that he swore to their fathers. Not a man of all their enemies stood before them. Yahweh delivered all their enemies into their hand.

paite: TOUPA'N Israel inkuante kiang a, ahoih lam thu a na gen tengteng vuaksuak khat leng a-om kei a, ahong tung vek hi.
english: Nothing failed of any good thing which Yahweh had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.

paite: Huai khit in Joshua in Reuben pawlte, Gad pawlte leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte asam hi.
english: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh,

paite: Akiang uah, "TOUPA sikha Mosi in hon thupiak peuhmah na zuita ua, ke'n thu ka hon piak peuhmah leng na zuita uhi.
english: and said to them, “You have kept all that Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, and have listened to my voice in all that I commanded you.

paite: Tuni tanpha in na unaute uh na taisan kei ua, TOUPA na Pathian un hih dia thu ahon piak na zuita uhi.
english: You have not left your brothers these many days to this day, but have performed the duty of the commandment of Yahweh your God.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un akiang ua ana gensa bang in, na unaute uh muanna apeta hi. Huaiziak in TOUPA sikha Mosi in Jordan gal a na tantuam ding ua hon piaksa gam ah, na puanin kaihte uah pai nawnta un.
english: Now Yahweh your God has given rest to your brothers, as he spoke to them. Therefore now return and go to your tents, to the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of Yahweh gave you beyond the Jordan.

paite: TOUPA sikha Mosi in TOUPA na Pathian uh it a, alampi tengteng tawn a, athupiakte zui a, amah len tinten a, na lungtang tengteng uleh na kha tengteng ua amah nna sem chiatchiat dia hon thupiakte, huai thupiak leh dante pilvangtak in limsak un," achi hi.
english: Only take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law which Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, to love Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to keep his commandments, to hold fast to him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.”

paite: Joshua in amau avualzawl a, apaisakta hi. Huchi in apuanin lam uah apaita uhi.
english: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away; and they went to their tents.

paite: Manasseh nam kimkhatte Mosi in Bashan gam ah tantuam apia a; akimkhat dangte Joshua in tumlam pang ah Jordan gal ah a-unaute lak ah tantuam ape zawta hi. Joshua in a-inn lam ua apaisak dek lai in avualzawl hi.
english: Now to the one half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given inheritance in Bashan; but Joshua gave to the other half among their brothers beyond the Jordan westward. Moreover when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he blessed them,

paite: Akiang uah, "Na puanin lam uah hauhsakna tamtak toh paita unla, ganta tampi toh, dangka toh, dangka-eng toh, dal toh, sik toh, silh-le-ten tampi toh. Na melmate ua pan na gallakte uh unaute toh kihawm dialdial un," achi hi.
english: and spoke to them, saying, “Return with much wealth to your tents, with very much livestock, with silver, with gold, with bronze, with iron, and with very much clothing. Divide the plunder of your enemies with your brothers.”

paite: Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte akik nawn ua, Kanaan gam Shiloh a pan Israel suante kiang a pan Gilead gam, TOUPA'N Mosi zang a thu a na piak bang in amau tantuam ding mawng a sehsa gam a pai ding in apawtkheta uhi.
english: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession, which they owned, according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

paite: Kanaan gam a Jordan gamgi ava tun un Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte'n Jordan lui gei ah maitam lianpi kholang mahmah khat adoh uhi.
english: When they came to the region near the Jordan, that is in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an altar there by the Jordan, a great altar to look at.

paite: Ngai in, Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte'n Kanaan gam chin tak, Jordan gamgi, Israel suante gam lam pang ah maitam adoh uh, chih Israelte kiang ah kuahiam khat in ava hilh hi.
english: The children of Israel heard this, “Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have built an altar along the border of the land of Canaan, in the region around the Jordan, on the side that belongs to the children of Israel.”

paite: Israel suante'n hiai thu azak un, Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng amaute dou tum in Shiloh ah akikhawm uhi.
english: When the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up against them to war.

paite: Israel suante'n Gilead gam a Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte kiang ah siampu Eleazar tapa Phinehas asawl uhi.
english: The children of Israel sent to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest.

paite: Milian sawmkhat, Israel nam a inkuan a lupente'n Phinehas azui uhi.
english: With him were ten princes, one prince of a fathers’ house for each of the tribes of Israel; and they were each head of their fathers’ houses among the thousands of Israel.

paite: Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte kiang Gilead gam ah ahoh ua, akiang uah,
english: They came to the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, and they spoke with them, saying,

paite: huchi in TOUPA mi omkhawm tengteng in, "Bangziak a tuni a TOUPA tung a hel tum a maitam doh a, TOUPA lehngatsan na hi ua?" achi uhi.
english: “The whole congregation of Yahweh says, ‘What trespass is this that you have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away today from following Yahweh, in that you have built yourselves an altar, to rebel today against Yahweh?

paite: "Peor mun a tatsiatnate, ei a dia neu lua a sim theih ahi maw? Tuni tan in leng huai a i khelhna ua pan silsiang i hi nai kei ua, TOUPA mi omkhawmte lak ah hipi alen tanpha in leng.
english: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day, although there came a plague on the congregation of Yahweh,

paite: Tuni a TOUPA lehngatsan na tup maizen uh? Huchi in tuni in TOUPA tung ah na na helta maimah ua, zingchiang a zaw Israel mipi omkhawm tengteng tung a amah heh ding ahita ve.
english: that you must turn away today from following Yahweh? It will be, since you rebel today against Yahweh, that tomorrow he will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.

paite: Na gam luah uh siang lou ahihleh, TOUPA gam, TOUPA biakbuk omna mun ah hong pai unla, ka lak uah hong teng un. Himahleh TOUPA i Pathian un achih louh maitam dang bawl in TOUPA tung ah hel kei unla, kou tung ah leng hel kei un.
english: However, if the land of your possession is unclean, then pass over to the land of the possession of Yahweh, in which Yahweh’s tabernacle dwells, and take possession among us; but don’t rebel against Yahweh, nor rebel against us, in building an altar other than Yahweh our God’s altar.

paite: Zer tapa Akan in hamsiat thil ah ana hihkhial a, Israel mipi tengteng tung ah hehna ahong om ahi kei maw? Huai mi tatsiatna ah amah kia amangthang tuam kei hi," achi uhi.
english: Didn’t Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the devoted thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? That man didn’t perish alone in his iniquity.’”

paite: Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte'n Israel nam a intekpente adawng ua, akiang uah,
english: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh answered, and spoke to the heads of the thousands of Israel,

paite: "TOUPA, pathiante' Pathian, pathiante TOUPA Pathian in athei. Israel pawl in leng thei hen! Ka maitam doh uh TOUPA lehngatsan a, hel tupna hiam thilhihkhelh tupna hiam a ka hih uleh, tuni in leng hon hawi kei un,
english: “The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, the Mighty One, God, Yahweh, he knows; and Israel shall know: if it was in rebellion, or if in trespass against Yahweh (don’t save us today),

paite: halmang thillatna ding hiam, nek ding thillatna ding hiam, lemna thillatna ding hiam ahihleh, TOUPA mahmah in thukhen hen.
english: that we have built us an altar to turn away from following Yahweh; or if to offer burnt offering or meal offering, or if to offer sacrifices of peace offerings, let Yahweh himself require it.

paite: Tunung chiang in na suante un ka suante uh kiang ah, Nou TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian na zat phakna uh bang om ahia?
english: “If we have not out of concern done this, and for a reason, saying, ‘In time to come your children might speak to our children, saying, “What have you to do with Yahweh, the God of Israel?

paite: Nou Reuben suante leh Gad suante aw, TOUPA'N kou leh nou a ding in Jordan gamgi ding in abawl hi. TOUPA ah tantuam na nei sam kei uh, ahon chi kha ding uh, chi a, pilvan ziak a aziak neitak a ka hih uh ahi. Na suante un kou suante TOUPA laudan thei lou in abawl kha thei uhi.
english: For Yahweh has made the Jordan a border between us and you, you children of Reuben and children of Gad. You have no portion in Yahweh.”’ So your children might make our children cease from fearing Yahweh.

paite: Huaiziak in kisa un, maitam i bawl ding uh, halmang thillatna ding leh kithoihna ding bel hilou in.
english: “Therefore we said, ‘Let’s now prepare to build ourselves an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice;

paite: Kou leh nou leh i nung ua i suante kikal ah theihpihna ahi dia, huchi in ka halmang thillatte uh leh ka kithoihnate uh leh ka lemna thillatte ua TOUPA nna ka septheihna ding uh leh na suante un leng tunung chiang a ka suante uh kiang a TOUPA ah tantuam na nei sam kei uh ahon chihlouhna ding un, ka chi ua ahi.
english: but it will be a witness between us and you, and between our generations after us, that we may perform the service of Yahweh before him with our burnt offerings, with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings;’ that your children may not tell our children in time to come, ‘You have no portion in Yahweh.’

paite: Huaiziak in hichi ahi ding a, tunung chiang a ka kiang uh hiam, ka suante uh kiang uh hiam a huchibang a ahon chih chiang ua kou, 'En ve ua, ka pipute un TOUPA maitam abawl uh omdan, halmang thillatna ding leh kithoihna ding ahi kei a, kou leh nou kikal a theihpihna ahi zaw hi,' ka chihna ding ua, ka hih uh ahi.
english: “Therefore we said, ‘It shall be, when they tell us or our generations this in time to come, that we shall say, “Behold the pattern of Yahweh’s altar, which our fathers made, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice; but it is a witness between us and you.”’

paite: TOUPA tung a hel a TOUPA lehngatsan a, TOUPA ka Pathian uh maitam, abiakbuk chin a maitam kia lou halmang thillatna ding hiam, nek ding thillatna ding hiam, theihpihna ding hiam a maitam bawl ka hihlouhdan uh," achi uhi.
english: “Far be it from us that we should rebel against Yahweh, and turn away today from following Yahweh, to build an altar for burnt offering, for meal offering, or for sacrifice, besides Yahweh our God’s altar that is before his tabernacle!”

paite: Siampu Phinehas leh akiang a omkhawmte' miliante, Israel pawl nam intekpente'n Reuben suante leh Gad suante leh Manasseh suan kimkhatte thugen azak un akipaksak mahmah hi.
english: When Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation, even the heads of the thousands of Israel that were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spoke, it pleased them well.

paite: Siampu Eleazar tapa Phinehas in Reuben suante leh Gad suante leh Manasseh suan kimkhatte kiang ah, "TOUPA tung a thil na hihkhelh louh ziak un, tu'n zaw TOUPA i lak ua om ngeina ahi, chih ka theita ve ua. Huchi in Israel suante TOUPA khut a pan na hunkheta uh," achi uhi.
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said to the children of Reuben, to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, “Today we know that Yahweh is among us, because you have not committed this trespass against Yahweh. Now you have delivered the children of Israel out of Yahweh’s hand.”

paite: Huchi in siampu Eleazar tapa Phinehas leh milian pawl, Reuben suante leh Gad suante a pan leh Gilead gam a pan Kanaan gam ah Israel suante kiang ah akik nawnta ua, thu ava tun nawn uhi.
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, to the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.

paite: Huai thute'n Israel suante akipaksak mahmah a; Israel suante'n Pathian aphatta uh. Huchi in Reuben suante leh Gad suante dou a, atenna gam uh suksiatsak ding in kuankhiak atum nawn kei uhi.
english: The thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and spoke no more of going up against them to war, to destroy the land in which the children of Reuben and the children of Gad lived.

paite: Reuben suante leh Gad suante'n huai maitam pen, "theihpihtu,” achi uhi. "TOUPA, Pathian a na hi ngei chih i kikal ua theihpihtu ahi ngal a," achi uhi.
english: The children of Reuben and the children of Gad named the altar “A Witness Between Us that Yahweh is God.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA'N Israelte amelma tengteng a pan galmuanna apiak nung hun sautak a pai nung in Joshua ahong upa in, ahong tekta hi.
english: After many days, when Yahweh had given rest to Israel from their enemies all around, and Joshua was old and well advanced in years,

paite: Joshua in Israel tengteng, a-upate leh a-intekpente, avaihawmte leh aheutu teng uh asamsak a, akiang uah, "Ka upa in, ka tekta hi.
english: Joshua called for all Israel, for their elders and for their heads, and for their judges and for their officers, and said to them, “I am old and well advanced in years.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un noute ziak a hiai nam tengteng tung a athilhihte na muta ua; TOUPA na Pathian un, amah mah in noute a ding in gal ahon dousak hi.
english: You have seen all that Yahweh your God has done to all these nations because of you; for it is Yahweh your God who has fought for you.

paite: Ngai un, Jordan lui leh tumlam Tuipi Lian kikal a nam omlaite zou in, aisan in na tantuam ding un ka hon pia hi.
english: Behold, I have allotted to you these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even to the great sea toward the going down of the sun.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un na ma uah amau adelhkhe dia, na muhbatlouhna uah ahawlmang vek ding. TOUPA na Pathian un na kiang ua agensa bang in agam uh na luah ding uhi.
english: Yahweh your God will thrust them out from before you, and drive them from out of your sight. You shall possess their land, as Yahweh your God spoke to you.

paite: Huaiziak in Mosi Dan laibu a gelh tengteng taklam ah hiam veilam ah hiam a na pialsan hetlouhna ding un hangsantak in zui un.
english: “Therefore be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that you not turn away from it to the right hand or to the left;

paite: Hiai nam na lak ua omlaite toh tengkhawm kei un. Apathiante uh min gen kei unla, aminte un kichiam kei unla, a-nna uh leng sem kei unla, ama uah leng kun in a-nna uh sem kei un.
english: that you not come among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow down yourselves to them;

paite: Himahleh tuni tan a na hih gige bang un, TOUPA na Pathian uh lenkip un.
english: but hold fast to Yahweh your God, as you have done to this day.

paite: TOUPA'N na ma uah nam thupitak leh hattakte adelhkhe khinta hi. Na ma uah tuni tan in kuamah pangzou himhim a-om kei uhi.
english: “For Yahweh has driven great and strong nations out from before you. But as for you, no man has stood before you to this day.

paite: Na lak ua mi khat in mi sangkhat adelh ding, na kiang ua agensa bang in, TOUPA na Pathian un nou a ding in gal ahon dousak ngal a.
english: One man of you shall chase a thousand; for it is Yahweh your God who fights for you, as he spoke to you.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh it ding in pilvang mahmah un.
english: Take good heed therefore to yourselves, that you love Yahweh your God.

paite: Pilvang lou a, na lehngatsan himhim ua, hiai namte lak a khosuaksun, na lak ua omlaite ngei, na pawlmat ua, amaute toh pasal leh zi a na kineih ua, amaute na kithuahpih ua, amau leng nou ahon kithuahpih uleh zaw,
english: “But if you do at all go back, and hold fast to the remnant of these nations, even these who remain among you, and make marriages with them, and go in to them, and they to you;

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un hiai namte na mitmuh un ahon delhkhiaksak nawn kei ding hi. TOUPA na Pathian un hiai gam hoihtak a hon piak a pan na manthat vek masiah uh amaute nou a ding in pial leh thang leh na pang ua ding in khetna chiang leh na mit ua ding in ling ahong hi zaw ding uh, chih teltak in thei un.
english: know for a certainty that Yahweh your God will no longer drive these nations from out of your sight; but they shall be a snare and a trap to you, a scourge in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from off this good land which Yahweh your God has given you.

paite: "Ngai un, tuni in leitung pumpi dan bang in ka paita ding hi. TOUPA na Pathian un na tungtang uh, ahoih lam, ana gensa tengteng vuaksuak khat lel leng a-om kei, chih na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng un na thei uhi. Na tung uah ahong tungvekta a, khat lel leng vuaksuak a-om kei hi.
english: “Behold, today I am going the way of all the earth. You know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one thing has failed of all the good things which Yahweh your God spoke concerning you. All have happened to you. Not one thing has failed of it.

paite: Huaiziak in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian un na kiang ua thil hoih agen tengteng na tung ua ahong tun vek tak mah bang in, TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak hiai gam hoihtak a pan ahon manthatsak vek masiah TOUPA'N thil hoihloute na tung uah atungsak ding hi.
english: It shall happen that as all the good things have come on you of which Yahweh your God spoke to you, so Yahweh will bring on you all the evil things, until he has destroyed you from off this good land which Yahweh your God has given you,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon thupiak thukhun na tatlek san ua, pathian dangte nna sem a, kun a na biak uleh, TOUPA hehna na tung uah a-om dia, ahon piak gam hoihtak a pan na mangthang pah ding uhi," achi hi.
english: when you disobey the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods, and bow down yourselves to them. Then Yahweh’s anger will be kindled against you, and you will perish quickly from off the good land which he has given to you.”

paite: Huan Joshua in Israel nam tengteng Shekem ah asam-khawm a, Israel upate, a-intekpente, avaihawmte leh aheutute uh asamsak a; Pathian ma ah ahong kimusak chiat uhi.
english: Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, for their heads, for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

paite: Joshua in mi tengteng kiang ah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi: Na pipute uh nidanglai in lui khen lam ah ateng ua, Abraham pa leh Nahor pa Terah hialte leng, amaute'n pathian dangte nna asem uhi.
english: Joshua said to all the people, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Your fathers lived of old time beyond the River, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor. They served other gods.

paite: Na pu uh Abraham huai lui gal a pan ka pikhia a, Kanaan gam teng tawnsuak in ka pi a, asuante ka pungsak a, Isak ka pia hi.
english: I took your father Abraham from beyond the River, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his offspring, and gave him Isaac.

paite: Isak kiang ah Jakob leh Esau ka pia a; Esau tantuam ding in Seir tang ka pia a; Jakob leh atate Aigupta ah apaisuk uhi.
english: I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau Mount Seir, to possess it. Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.

paite: Mosi leh Aaron ka sawl a, alak ua thillamdang hih in Aigupta ka gawt a: huai khit in amaute ka hon pikhia hi.
english: “‘I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.

paite: Na pipute uh Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhia a, tuipi na hong tung ua; Aigupta mite'n na pipute uh kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite toh Tuipi San tan in anungdelh uhi.
english: I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and you came to the sea. The Egyptians pursued your fathers with chariots and with horsemen to the Red Sea.

paite: Amau TOUPA asam ua, Aigupta mite toh na kikal uh amialsak bikbek a, amaute tuipi tuamsak in akhuhkhumsak a; Aigupta gam a ka thilhih na mit un amu a; gamdai ah sawtpi na teng uhi.
english: When they cried out to Yahweh, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea on them, and covered them; and your eyes saw what I did in Egypt. You lived in the wilderness many days.

paite: Jordan lui gal a om Amorte gam ah ka hon pi a; amau ahon dou uh. Na khut uah amaute ka hon pia a, agam uh na luahta uhi. Amau ka hon hihmangsakta hi.
english: “‘I brought you into the land of the Amorites, that lived beyond the Jordan. They fought with you, and I gave them into your hand. You possessed their land, and I destroyed them from before you.

paite: Moab kumpipa Zippor tapa Balak ahong kisa a, Israel adou a; Beor tapa Balaam nou hon hamsiat ding in asamsak hi.
english: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and fought against Israel. He sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you,

paite: Himahleh Balaam thu ka ngaikhe kei hi. Huaiziak in nou ahon vualzawl zosopta hi. Huchi in akhut a pan ka hon hunkheta hi,
english: but I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he blessed you still. So I delivered you out of his hand.

paite: Jordan lui na kan ua, Jeriko khua na tungtou ua; Jeriko khomite'n hon na dou ua, Amorte, Perizte, Kanaante, Hitte, Girgaste, Hivte leh Jebuste toh; amau na khut uah ka hon peta hi.
english: “‘You went over the Jordan, and came to Jericho. The men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Girgashite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I delivered them into your hand.

paite: Na ma uah tunpi ka sawl a, huai in na ma uah amau adelh a, Amorte' kumpipa nihte tan in leng. Himahleh na namsau un hiam, na thal un hiam in ahi kei hi.
english: I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; not with your sword, nor with your bow.

paite: "Na sepkhiak het louh uh gam leh na bawl het louh uh khopite ka hon pia a, huaite ah na teng ua; na suan louh uh grephuan leh olive huan a pan na ne uhi.
english: I gave you a land on which you had not labored, and cities which you didn’t build, and you live in them. You eat of vineyards and olive groves which you didn’t plant.’

paite: "Huaiziak in TOUPA laudan siam unla, chitak leh thutak in ama nna sem un. Na pipute un Lui gal leh Aigupta gam a, a-nna asep uh pathiante koihkhia unla; TOUPA nna sem un.
english: “Now therefore fear Yahweh, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, in Egypt; and serve Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA nna sep hoih lou a na theih uleh tuni in kua nna ahia na sep ding uh, tel un. Na pipute un Lui gal a, a-nna asep uh pathiante hia, na luah uh gam a Amorte pathiante? Kei leh inkuante'n zaw TOUPA nna ahi ka sep ding uh," achi hi.
english: If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahweh.”

paite: Mipite'n, "TOUPA Pathian paisan a, pathian dangte nna ka sep louh ding dan uh.
english: The people answered, “Far be it from us that we should forsake Yahweh, to serve other gods;

paite: TOUPA i Pathian ngei ahi, i pipute toh Aigupta gam saltanna inn a pan hon pikhia a, i mitmuh a chiamtehna thupi taktak hih a, i paina teng leh mipi tengteng i nawk paisuakna ah leng hon vengbit hi.
english: for it is Yahweh our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way in which we went, and among all the peoples through the middle of whom we passed.

paite: TOUPA'N i ma ngei uah mi chih, huai gam a om Amorte ngei adelhkhe vek hi. Huaiziak in kou leng TOUPA nna ahi ka sep ding uh; amah lah ka Pathian uh ahi ngal a," chi in adawng uhi.
english: Yahweh drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land. Therefore we also will serve Yahweh; for he is our God.”

paite: Joshua in mipite kiang ah, "TOUPA nna ná sem thei kei ding uh. Amah lah Pathian siangthou ahi ngal a. Mullit hat Pathian ahi a; na tatleknate uh leh na khelhnate uh angaidam kei ding hi.
english: Joshua said to the people, “You can’t serve Yahweh, for he is a holy God. He is a jealous God. He will not forgive your disobedience nor your sins.

paite: TOUPA na paisan ua, namdang pathiante nna na sep uleh, na tung ua thil hoih ahih khit nung in ahong kihei dia, hon hih na in ahon hihmangthang ding," achi hi.
english: If you forsake Yahweh, and serve foreign gods, then he will turn and do you evil, and consume you, after he has done you good.”

paite: Mipite'n, Joshua kiang ah, "Hilou e, TOUPA nna ka sem kinken zaw ding uh," achi uhi.
english: The people said to Joshua, “No, but we will serve Yahweh.”

paite: Joshua in mipite kiang ah, "A- nna sep tum in TOUPA na telta uh, chih atheihpihtute noumau mah na hi uh," achi hi. Amau, "Theihpihtute ka hí uh,” achi uhi.
english: Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen Yahweh yourselves, to serve him.” They said, “We are witnesses.”

paite: Amah mah in, "Huchi ahihleh na lak ua namdang pathian omte koihmang unla, na lungtangte uh TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian lam ah awnsak un," achi hi.
english: “Now therefore put away the foreign gods which are among you, and incline your heart to Yahweh, the God of Israel.”

paite: Mipite'n Joshua kiang ah, "TOUPA i Pathian nna ka sem ding ua, athu ka zui ding uh," achi uhi.
english: The people said to Joshua, “We will serve Yahweh our God, and we will listen to his voice.”

paite: Huai ni in Joshua in mipite toh kikal ah thu akhung a, Shekem ah dan thuseh leh thuseh asehsak hi.
english: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made for them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

paite: Joshua in hiai thu Pathian Dan Laibu ah agelh a; suang lianpi ala a, TOUPA Mun Siangthou chin a tosaw nuai ah aphut hi.
english: Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God; and he took a great stone, and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of Yahweh.

paite: Joshua in mipi tengteng kiang ah, "Ngai un, hiai suang i thu hon theihpihtu hi hen. TOUPA'N i kiang ua thu agen tengteng aza vekta hi. Huaiziak in na thu uh hon theihpihtu ahi ding hi, huchi lou in zaw Pathian na kitheihmohbawl kha ding uh," achi hi.
english: Joshua said to all the people, “Behold, this stone shall be a witness against us, for it has heard all Yahweh’s words which he spoke to us. It shall be therefore a witness against you, lest you deny your God.”

paite: Huchi in Joshua in mipite atantuam gam chiat uah apaisakta hi.
english: So Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai thilte khit in Nun tapa Joshua, TOUPA sikha kum za-le-sawmkhat a upa ahih in asita hi.
english: After these things, Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Yahweh, died, being one hundred ten years old.

paite: Gaash tang mallam pang, Ephraim tanggam a amah tantuam gamgi sung Timnath-serah ah avuita uhi.
english: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.

paite: Joshua damsung leh amah khup a dam, TOUPA'N Israelte a dia thil ahih tengteng theihpih mite damsung in Israelte'n TOUPA nna asem uhi.
english: Israel served Yahweh all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, and had known all the work of Yahweh, that he had worked for Israel.

paite: Israel suante'n Aigupta gam a pan Joseph guhte apuaktouh uh Shekem a Shekem pa Hamor tapate a pan Jakob in dangka zakhat a aleina mun ah avui ua; huai mun Joseph suante tantuam ahita hi.
english: They buried the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, in Shechem, in the parcel of ground which Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of silver. They became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

paite: Huan Aaron tapa Eleazar asi a; atapa Phinehas tantuam dia apiak Ephraim tang ah avui uhi.
english: Eleazar the son of Aaron died. They buried him in the hill of Phinehas his son, which was given him in the hill country of Ephraim.

paite: Huan Joshua zingkhang in athou a, Israel suan tengteng toh Shittim a pan akisuan ua, Jordan lui atung uhi. Agalkah ma un huai ah agiak uhi.
english: Joshua got up early in the morning; and they moved from Shittim and came to the Jordan, he and all the children of Israel. They camped there before they crossed over.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ni thum nung in heutute'n giahphual ava tawn vialvial uhi.
english: After three days, the officers went through the middle of the camp;

paite: "TOUPA na Pathian uh thukhun bawm leh siampute, Levi chite'n azawn uh na muh chiang un na omna ua kipan kisuan unla, na zui ding uh ahi.
english: and they commanded the people, saying, “When you see the ark of Yahweh your God’s covenant, and the Levitical priests bearing it, then leave your place and follow it.

paite: Himahleh nou toh akal tehna tong sangnih vel ahi ding ahi. Naih kei unla, huchi in na paina ding lampi na theithei ding uhi. Hiai lampi lah tuma lam in na tawn ngei ngal kei ua," chi in mipite thu apia uhi.
english: Yet there shall be a space between you and it of about two thousand cubits by measure—don’t come closer to it—that you may know the way by which you must go; for you have not passed this way before.”

paite: Joshua in mipite kiang ah, "Kihihsiangthou un, zingchiang a TOUPA'N na lak ua thillamdang mahmah hih ding ahi," achi hi.
english: Joshua said to the people, “Sanctify yourselves; for tomorrow Yahweh will do wonders among you.”

paite: Joshua in siampute kiang ah, "Thukhun bawm zawng unla, mipite ma ah galkah un," achi hi. Huchi in thukhun bawm azawng ua, mipite ma ah apaita uhi.
english: Joshua spoke to the priests, saying, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and cross over before the people.” They took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.

paite: TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, “Mosi kiang a ka om bang in na kiang ah ka om ding, chih atheihtheihna ding un, tuni in Israel tengteng mitmuh in ka hon pahtawi pan ding hi.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to magnify you in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that as I was with Moses, so I will be with you.

paite: Thukhun bawm zawng siampute, Jordan lui gei na tun chiang un, Jordan lui ah dingden un, chi in thu pia in,” achi hi.
english: You shall command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, saying, ‘When you come to the brink of the waters of the Jordan, you shall stand still in the Jordan.’”

paite: Joshua in Israel suante kiang ah, "Hong pai unla, TOUPA na Pathian uh thu hong ngaikhia un," achi hi.
english: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “Come here, and hear the words of Yahweh your God.”

paite: Joshua in, "Hiai ah Pathian hing na lak uah a-om a, na ma uah Kanaante, Hitte, Hivte, Perizte, Girgaste, Amorte leh Jebuste adelhkhe ngeingei ding hi.
english: Joshua said, “By this you shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Hivite, the Perizzite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, and the Jebusite out from before you.

paite: Ngai un, leitung pumpi TOUPA thukhun bawm in na ma uah Jordan lui akan hi.
english: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passes over before you into the Jordan.

paite: Israel namte lak a mi sawm-le-nih, nam chih sik in mi khat zel telkhia un.
english: Now therefore take twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, for every tribe a man.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA leitung pumpi TOUPA bawm zawng siampute khepek Jordan tui a akingaktak in, saklam a pan Jordan tui hong luangte akitat dia; ahong kiching venvon ding," achi hi.
english: It shall be that when the soles of the feet of the priests who bear the ark of Yahweh, the Lord of all the earth, rest in the waters of the Jordan, that the waters of the Jordan will be cut off. The waters that come down from above shall stand in one heap.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, mipite Jordan lui kan dia apuanin ua kipan apawt lai un, mipite ma ah thukhun bawm zawng siampute apai uhi.
english: When the people moved from their tents to pass over the Jordan, the priests who bore the ark of the covenant being before the people,

paite: Bawm zawngte Jordan lui ava tung ua, bawm zawng siampute khe in tui gei asiktak in, buhlak sung teng Jordan lui a kuang tengteng ah tui alet gige hi.
english: and when those who bore the ark had come to the Jordan, and the feet of the priests who bore the ark had dipped in the edge of the water (for the Jordan overflows all its banks all the time of harvest),

paite: Saklam a pan tuipi luang lai akhawlta a, gamla kuamtak a Zarethan gam chin a Adam ah ahong kiching hi. Arabah tuipi, Chi Tuipi lam a luangsuk lai akitat geih a; huchi in Jeriko khozawntak ah mipite agalkahta uhi.
english: the waters which came down from above stood, and rose up in one heap a great way off, at Adam, the city that is beside Zarethan; and those that went down toward the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, were wholly cut off. Then the people passed over near Jericho.

paite: Jordan lui lai ah TOUPA thukhun bawm zawng siampute leihul ah adingh ua, mipi tengteng Jordan lui agalkah vek uhi.
english: The priests who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan; and all Israel crossed over on dry ground, until all the nation had passed completely over the Jordan.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, anam pumpi ua Jordan lui agalkah siang nung un, TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah,
english: When all the nation had completely crossed over the Jordan, Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,

paite: "Mipite lak a mi sawm-le-nih, nam chih a mi khat zel telkhia inla,
english: “Take twelve men out of the people, a man out of every tribe,

paite: akiang uah, Jordan lui lai, siampute dinna laitak a suangte sawm-le-nih la unla, pophei unla, giahphual, tuzan a na giahna ding uah koih un, chi in thu pia in," achi hi.
english: and command them, saying, ‘Take from out of the middle of the Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, carry them over with you, and lay them down in the place where you’ll camp tonight.’”

paite: Huchi in Joshua in Israel suante lak a mi sawm-le-nih, nam chih a mi khat zel atelkhiakte asam a;
english: Then Joshua called the twelve men whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, a man out of every tribe.

paite: Joshua in akiang uah, "TOUPA na Pathian uh bawm ma ah Jordan lui lai ah galkah unla, Israel suante anam zah zel in, michih in suang khat chiat pua hen.
english: Joshua said to them, “Cross before the ark of Yahweh your God into the middle of the Jordan, and each of you pick up a stone and put it on your shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel;

paite: Hiaite na lak uah chiamtehna ahong hi ding a, tunung chiang in na tate un, hiai suangte bang na chihna uh ahia? chỉ a ahon dot chiang un,
english: that this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask in the future, saying, ‘What do you mean by these stones?’

paite: Nou akiang uah, TOUPA thukhun bawm ma a Jordan tuite ahong kan tak ziak in ahi. Jordan akan lai un, Jordan tuite ahong kitat a ahi. Hiai suangte Israel suante'n tangtawn a atheihgigena ding uh ahi, na chi ding uh," achi hi.
english: then you shall tell them, ‘Because the waters of the Jordan were cut off before the ark of Yahweh’s covenant. When it crossed over the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off. These stones shall be for a memorial to the children of Israel forever.’”

paite: Israel suante'n Joshua thupiak bang in ahih ua, Israel suante'n anam zah zel in, Jordan lui lai a suang sawm-le-nih ala ua; agiahphual uah, apophei ua, huai ah akoih uhi.
english: The children of Israel did as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the middle of the Jordan, as Yahweh spoke to Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel. They carried them over with them to the place where they camped, and laid them down there.

paite: Thukhun bawm zawng siampute dinna laitak, Jordan lui lai ah Joshua in huai suang sawm-le-nihte aphut a; huaite tuni tan in a-om lai uhi.
english: Joshua set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests who bore the ark of the covenant stood; and they are there to this day.

paite: Mosi in Joshua thu ana piak tengteng bang a TOUPA'N mipite kiang a hih dia Joshua thu apiak ahihzoh vek mateng uh siampu bawm zawngte Jordan lui lai ah adingh nilouh uhi. Mipite akinoh ua, agalkahta uhi.
english: For the priests who bore the ark stood in the middle of the Jordan until everything was finished that Yahweh commanded Joshua to speak to the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua; and the people hurried and passed over.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, mipi tengteng agalkah siang vek nung un, TOUPA bawm leh siampute leng mipi mitmuh in agalkahta uhi.
english: When all the people had completely crossed over, Yahweh’s ark crossed over with the priests in the presence of the people.

paite: Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte Mosi in akiang ua ana gen khitsa bang in, Israel suante ma ah kigalthuam in agalkah uhi.
english: The children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spoke to them.

paite: Galvan a kivan dimdiam mi singli vel galdou ding in Jeriko phaizang ah TOUPA ma ah agalkah uhi.
english: About forty thousand men, ready and armed for war, passed over before Yahweh to battle, to the plains of Jericho.

paite: Huai ni in TOUPA'N Israel tengteng mitmuh in Joshua atawisang a; Mosi alauh mah bang un adamsung teng in amah alau uhi.
english: On that day, Yahweh magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.

paite: TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah thu agen a:
english: Yahweh spoke to Joshua, saying,

paite: "Siampute, thu theihpihna bawm zawngte Jordan lui a pan hong pawt ding in thu pia in," achi hi.
english: “Command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, that they come up out of the Jordan.”

paite: Joshua in siampute, "Jordan lui a pan hong pawtta un," chi in thu apia hi.
english: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, “Come up out of the Jordan!”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, siampute, TOUPA thukhun bawm zawngte Jordan lui lai a pan ahong pawt ua, siampute khete'n leihul asiktak in, Jordan tuite aluan ngeina bang un ahong luang nawn ua, ama a mah bang in akuang ah aluanglet nawn hi.
english: When the priests who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant had come up out of the middle of the Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet had been lifted up to the dry ground, the waters of the Jordan returned to their place, and went over all its banks, as before.

paite: Mipite akha khatna, ani sawm ni in Jordan lui a pan apawt ua, Jeriko suahlam pang Gilgal ah giahphual asatta uhi.
english: The people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, on the east border of Jericho.

paite: Jordan lui a pan suang sawm-le-nih apuakkhiak uh, Joshua in Gilgal ah aphut hi.
english: Joshua set up those twelve stones, which they took out of the Jordan, in Gilgal.

paite: Israel suante kiang ah, "Tunung chiang a na suante un apate uh kiang a, hiai suangte bang chihna ahia? chi a hon dot chiang un,
english: He spoke to the children of Israel, saying, “When your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, ‘What do these stones mean?’

paite: Israelte'n Jordan lui leihul ah agalkah ua ahi, chi in na suante uh na theisak ding uhi.'
english: Then you shall let your children know, saying, ‘Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un nidanglai a Tuipi San i galkah masiah ua, i ma ua ana kangtatsak mah bang in, TOUPA na Pathian un Jordan tuite na galkah masiah uh na ma uah akangtatsak a ahi.
english: For Yahweh your God dried up the waters of the Jordan from before you until you had crossed over, as Yahweh your God did to the Red Sea, which he dried up from before us, until we had crossed over,

paite: Lei a nam chiteng in TOUPA khut ana hat ngei, chih atheih ua, TOUPA na Pathian uh tangtawn a alauhtheihna ding un," chi in agen hi.
english: that all the peoples of the earth may know that Yahweh’s hand is mighty, and that you may fear Yahweh your God forever.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jordan lui khen suahlam a om Amorte kumpipa tengteng leh tuipi gei a om Kanaan gam kumpipa tengtengte'n, agalkah masiah uh TOUPA'N Jordan tuite Israel suante ma ah akangtatsak, chih ana zak un, Israel suante ziak in alungtang uh ana zul khin a, lauthawng lou himhim a-om kei uhi.
english: When all the kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, who were by the sea, heard how Yahweh had dried up the waters of the Jordan from before the children of Israel until we had crossed over, their heart melted, and there was no more spirit in them, because of the children of Israel.

paite: Huai lai in TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Temta hiam kibawl inla, Israel suante zek anihveina ding in sumsak in," achi hi.
english: At that time, Yahweh said to Joshua, “Make flint knives, and circumcise again the sons of Israel the second time.”

paite: Joshua in temta hiamte akibawl a, Israel suante Gibeth Haraloth ah azek uh asumsak hi.
english: Joshua made himself flint knives, and circumcised the sons of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.

paite: Joshua in azeksumna ziak hiai ahi: Aigupta gam a pan pawt tengteng, pasal galdoumi tengteng Aigupta gam a pan apawtkhiak nung un lamkal a gamdai a asih khit tak ziak uh ahi.
english: This is the reason Joshua circumcised them: all the people who came out of Egypt, who were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness along the way, after they came out of Egypt.

paite: Aigupta gam a pan pawt tengteng zeksumsa vek ahi ua; himahleh Aigupta gam a pan apawt ua gamdai a lamkal a piang tengteng bel zeksum ahi kei uhi.
english: For all the people who came out were circumcised; but all the people who were born in the wilderness along the way as they came out of Egypt had not been circumcised.

paite: TOUPA aw angaihkhiak nop louh ziak ua mipi tengteng, Aigupta gam a pan hong pawt galdou mite tan hihman a a-om vek tan un Israel suante gamdai ah kum sawmli avialvak uhi. TOUPA'N amau pi-le-pute kiang a nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam kichiam a piak ana chiam, huai gam mu lou ding in akiang uah TOUPA ana kichiamta hi.
english: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness until all the nation, even the men of war who came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they didn’t listen to Yahweh’s voice. Yahweh swore to them that he wouldn’t let them see the land which Yahweh swore to their fathers that he would give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.

paite: Asuante uh amau sik a akhanletsakte Joshua in azek uh asumsak hi. Lamkal a azek uh sum ahih louh ziak in zeksum louh ana hi him uhi.
english: Their children, whom he raised up in their place, were circumcised by Joshua, for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them on the way.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, mipi tengteng zek asum khit un, adam mateng uh amau giahphual chiat uah a-om uhi.
english: When they were done circumcising the whole nation, they stayed in their places in the camp until they were healed.

paite: TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Tuni in Aiguptate'n nou hon muhsitna uh noumau a pan ka khukmangta," achi hi. Huchi in tuni tan in huai mun Gilgal achi uhi.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you.” Therefore the name of that place was called Gilgal to this day.

paite: Israel suante'n Gilgal ah giahphual asat ua; Jeriko Phaizang ah huai kha, ani sawm-le-li ni in Paikan Ankuang alui uhi.
english: The children of Israel encamped in Gilgal. They kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month at evening in the plains of Jericho.

paite: Paikan khit azing mah in huai gam a tanghou silngou soh louh leh vaimim kan ane uhi.
english: They ate unleavened cakes and parched grain of the produce of the land on the next day after the Passover, in the same day.

paite: Huai gam a buh anek ni zing ua pan manna aketa kei a; Israel suante'n manna leng amu nawn kei uhi. Huai kum in Kanaan gam a buh-le-bal ane zawta uhi.
english: The manna ceased on the next day, after they had eaten of the produce of the land. The children of Israel didn’t have manna any more, but they ate of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.

paite: Huan Jeriko kho kiangchin a Joshua a-om lai in adak a, a-entou a, ngai in, hichi ahong hi a, amazawn chin ah mi khat anamsau phawisa tawi in ana ding hi. Joshua in ava naih a, akiang ah, "Kou lam a pang na hi hia, ka melmate uh lam a pang?" achi hi.
english: When Joshua was by Jericho, he lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, a man stood in front of him with his sword drawn in his hand. Joshua went to him and said to him, “Are you for us, or for our enemies?”

paite: Ama'n, “Hilou e, TOUPA sepaihte heutu dia hong pai ka hi zaw," achi hi. Huchi in lei ah Joshua abokkhup a, amah abia a, akiang ah, "Ka toupa'n asikha kiang ah bang gen ding nei ahia?" achi hi.
english: He said, “No; but I have come now as commander of Yahweh’s army.” Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and worshiped, and asked him, “What does my lord say to his servant?”

paite: TOUPA sepaihte heutu in Joshua kiang ah, "Na khepek a pan na khedap phel in. Na dinna mun siangthou ahi,” achi a; huchi in Joshua in aphelta hi.
english: The prince of Yahweh’s army said to Joshua, “Take off your sandals, for the place on which you stand is holy.” Joshua did so.

paite: Jeriko khua Israel suante ziak in akikhak bikbek a; kuamah apawt kei ua, kuamah leng alut kei uh.
english: Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the children of Israel. No one went out, and no one came in.

paite: TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "En in, Jeriko leh akumpipa uh leh amihat hangsante uh na khut ah ka hon pe khinta hi.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Behold, I have given Jericho into your hand, with its king and the mighty men of valor.

paite: Galdoumi tengteng in khopi kimvel in khatvei na va velsuak phot ding uh. Huchibang in ni guk sung na hih ding uh ahi.
english: All of your men of war shall march around the city, going around the city once. You shall do this six days.

paite: Siampu sagih in bawm malam ah belampa kii pengkul sagih atawi ding ua, ani sagih ni in khopi sagihvei na velsuak ding ua, siampute'n pengkul amut ding uh.
english: Seven priests shall bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark. On the seventh day, you shall march around the city seven times, and the priests shall blow the trumpets.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, belampa kii amutging uh na zak chiang un, mipi tengteng ngaihtak in kikou uhen. Huchi in khopi kulhbaang achim dia, mipi amau mazawn chiat ah apaitou ding uh," achi hi.
english: It shall be that when they make a long blast with the ram’s horn, and when you hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; then the city wall will fall down flat, and the people shall go up, every man straight in front of him.”

paite: Nun tapa Joshua in siampute asam a, akiang uah, "Thukhun bawm zawng unla, siampu sagih in TOUPA bawm malam ah belampa kii pengkul sagih tawi uhen," achi hi.
english: Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said to them, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before Yahweh’s ark.”

paite: Ama'n mipite kiang ah, "Pai zel unla, khopi velsuak un, mi kigalthuamte TOUPA bawm malam ah pai zel uhen,” achi hi.
english: They said to the people, “Advance! March around the city, and let the armed men pass on before Yahweh’s ark.”

paite: Hichi ahong hita a, Joshua in mipite kiang a thu agen khit in TOUPA ma a belampa kii pengkul sagih tawi siampu sagihte apai zel ua, pengkul amut ua; TOUPA thukhun bawm in azui hi.
english: It was so, that when Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns before Yahweh advanced and blew the trumpets, and the ark of Yahweh’s covenant followed them.

paite: Mi kigalthuamte pengkul amut ua; TOUPA thukhun bawm in azui hi. 9 Mi kigalthuamte pengkul mut siampute ma ah apai ua, nungdal mite'n bawm amasuan ua, siampute'n pai kawm in pengkul amut uhi.
english: The armed men went before the priests who blew the trumpets, and the ark went after them. The trumpets sounded as they went.

paite: Joshua in mipite kiang ah, "Kikou kei unla, na aw uh leng zak hi kei hen. Kikou dia thu ka hon piak ni atun mateng na kam ua pan thu pawt kei hen. Huai hun chiang in na kikou ding uh," chi in thu apia hi.
english: Joshua commanded the people, saying, “You shall not shout nor let your voice be heard, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth until the day I tell you to shout. Then you shall shout.”

paite: TOUPA bawm khopi khatvei velh in avelsuaksak a; giahphual ah apai ua, giahphual ah agiak nawn uhi.
english: So he caused Yahweh’s ark to go around the city, circling it once. Then they came into the camp, and stayed in the camp.

paite: Joshua zingkhang in athou a, siampute'n TOUPA bawm azawng uhi.
english: Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up Yahweh’s ark.

paite: TOUPA bawm ma ah belampa kii pengkul sagih tawi siampu sagihte apai ua, pengkul amut uhi. Ama uah mi kigalthuamte apai ua; nungdalte'n TOUPA bawm ahon masuan ua, siampute'n apai kawm un pengkul amut uhi.
english: The seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns in front of Yahweh’s ark went on continually, and blew the trumpets. The armed men went in front of them. The rear guard came after Yahweh’s ark. The trumpets sounded as they went.

paite: Ani nih ni in khopi khatvei avelsuak nawn ua, agiahphual uah akik nawn uh. Huchibang in ni guk ahih uhi.
english: The second day they marched around the city once, and returned into the camp. They did this six days.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani sagih ni in zingkhang, phalvak in athou ua, ahihdan ngei mah un sagihvei avelsuak ua; huai ni kia in khopi sagihvei avelsuak uhi.
english: On the seventh day, they rose early at the dawning of the day, and marched around the city in the same way seven times. On this day only they marched around the city seven times.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, asagihveina a siampute'n pengkul amuttak un Joshua in mipite kiang ah, "Kikou un: TOUPA'N khopi ahon pe khinta hi.
english: At the seventh time, when the priests blew the trumpets, Joshua said to the people, “Shout, for Yahweh has given you the city!

paite: Khopi leh asung a thil om tengteng TOUPA hamsiat ahi. Rahab kizuaknu kia, amah leh a-insung a akiang a om tengteng bel i misawlte uh ana sel ziak in hinghawi ding ahi.
english: The city shall be devoted, even it and all that is in it, to Yahweh. Only Rahab the prostitute shall live, she and all who are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.

paite: Nou zaw hamsiat thilte a pan kihuikhe hiau un, huchi lou in zaw, hamsiat thilte la in noumau mah hamsiat in na omloh kha ding uhi. Israelte giahphual hamsiat a omsak in na buaisak kha ding uhi.
english: But as for you, only keep yourselves from what is devoted to destruction, lest when you have devoted it, you take of the devoted thing; so you would make the camp of Israel accursed and trouble it.

paite: Dangkasik, dangka-eng, dal leh sik tui-um belsuan teng ahihleh TOUPA a tuam ahi vek hi. TOUPA sum in akoih ding ahi," achi hi.
english: But all the silver, gold, and vessels of bronze and iron are holy to Yahweh. They shall come into Yahweh’s treasury.”

paite: Mipite akikou ua, siampute'n pengkul amut uhi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, mipite'n pengkul ging azaktak un, ngaihtak in akikou ua, kulhbaang achimta hi. Huchi in mipite amazawn chiat uah apaitou ua, khopi ah alut ua, khopi alata uhi.
english: So the people shouted and the priests blew the trumpets. When the people heard the sound of the trumpet, the people shouted with a great shout, and the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight in front of him, and they took the city.

paite: Khopi sung a mi tengteng, numei leh pasal, atek- akhang, bawngtal, belam leh sabiltung teng namsau in asatlum vek uhi.
english: They utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, both young and old, and ox, sheep, and donkey, with the edge of the sword.

paite: Joshua in mi nih, gam va enkhete kiang ah, "Huai kizuaknu inn ah va lut unla, akiang a na kichiamsa bang un huai numei leh aneih teng hon pikhia un," achi hi.
english: Joshua said to the two men who had spied out the land, “Go into the prostitute’s house, and bring the woman and all that she has out from there, as you swore to her.”

paite: Enkhe mi tangvalte ava lut ua, Rahab, anu leh pa, asangamte leh aneih teng ahon pikhia ua, atanau teng leng ahon pikhia ua; Israelte giahphual polam ah a-omsak uhi.
english: The young men who were spies went in, and brought out Rahab with her father, her mother, her brothers, and all that she had. They also brought out all of her relatives, and they set them outside of the camp of Israel.

paite: Khopi leh asung a thil om teng mei in ahal vek ua; dangkasik, dangka-eng, sum-eng leh sik tui-um belsuan teng kia TOUPA' inn a sumkoihna ah akoih uhi.
english: They burned the city with fire, and all that was in it. Only they put the silver, the gold, and the vessels of bronze and of iron into the treasury of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Himahleh Joshua in Jeriko khua enkhe dia amisawlte ana humbit ziak in, Rahab kizuaknu leh aneih teng leh apa inkuante Joshua in ahinghawi vek a; Israelte lak ah tuni tan in ateng lai uhi.
english: But Rahab the prostitute, her father’s household, and all that she had, Joshua saved alive. She lives in the middle of Israel to this day, because she hid the messengers whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

paite: Huai lai in Joshua in, Hiai Jeriko khopi hon lam nawn peuhmah TOUPA ma ah hamsiat in om hen. Asuangphum phummi ta masa leh akulhbaang kongpite tungkhemi ta tumpen leng hamsiat in om hen, chi in amaute ahilh chiatchiat hi.
english: Joshua commanded them with an oath at that time, saying, “Cursed is the man before Yahweh who rises up and builds this city Jericho. With the loss of his firstborn he will lay its foundation, and with the loss of his youngest son he will set up its gates.”

paite: Joshua kiang ah TOUPA a-om a; gam pumpi ah amin hong thangta hi.
english: So Yahweh was with Joshua; and his fame was in all the land.

paite: Himahleh Israel suante hamsiat thilte ah ahong talekta ua, Judah nam a Zerah tapa Zabdi, huai tapa Karmi, huai tapa Akan in hamsiat thilte ana la a, Israel suante tung ah TOUPA ahehta hi.
english: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the devoted things; for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of the devoted things. Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against the children of Israel.

paite: Joshua in Jeriko a pan Bethel suahlam Beth-Aven chin a om Ai ah mi asawl a, akiang uah, "Va hohtou unla, gam va enkhia un," chi in agen hi. Mite ava hohtou ua, Ai khua ava enkhia uhi.
english: Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth Aven, on the east side of Bethel, and spoke to them, saying, “Go up and spy out the land.” The men went up and spied out Ai.

paite: Joshua kiang ah akik nawn ua, akiang ah, "Mi tengteng hohtou chitchiat kei uhen. Mi sangnih hiam sangthum hiam va hohtou uhenla, Ai khua dou le uh. Mi tengteng va hihgim chitchiat ding ahi kei; tawmchik kia lah ahi ngal ua," achi uhi.
english: They returned to Joshua, and said to him, “Don’t let all the people go up, but let about two or three thousand men go up and strike Ai. Don’t make all the people to toil there, for there are only a few of them.”

paite: Huchi in mipi lak a mi sangthum huai ah ahohtou ua, Aite ma ah ahong taikek uhi.
english: So about three thousand men of the people went up there, and they fled before the men of Ai.

paite: Aite'n mi sawmthum-le-guk ana that ua; kulhbaang kongpi chin a pan Sebarim pha hial in adelh ua, akumsukna ah athat uhi. Huaiziak in mite lungtang azul khin a, tui bang ahong hita hi.
english: The men of Ai struck about thirty-six men of them. They chased them from before the gate even to Shebarim, and struck them at the descent. The hearts of the people melted, and became like water.

paite: Joshua in apuante abotkek a, TOUPA bawm ma ah amah leh Israel upate amai ua lei si in nitaklam tan in abokkhup uhi. Alu uah leivui abuak uhi.
english: Joshua tore his clothes, and fell to the earth on his face before Yahweh’s ark until the evening, he and the elders of Israel; and they put dust on their heads.

paite: Joshua in, “Maizen! Toupa PATHIAN aw, bang ding in ahia, hiai mipite hihmanthat dia, Amorte khut a piak dia, Jordan lui na pi galkai mahmah? Jordan lui gal ah lungkimtak in om hiathiat zaw mai le ung!
english: Joshua said, “Alas, Lord Yahweh, why have you brought this people over the Jordan at all, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to cause us to perish? I wish that we had been content and lived beyond the Jordan!

paite: TOUPA aw, hichi a melmate delh a Israelte ataikek mawk uh bang ka lohta dia oi?
english: Oh, Lord, what shall I say, after Israel has turned their backs before their enemies?

paite: Kanaante leh hiai gam a tengte'n aza ding ua, ahon um ding ua, lei a pan ka min uh hihmangthang ding ahita ve ua. Na min thupi bang na chihta dia le?" achi hi.
english: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear of it, and will surround us, and cut off our name from the earth. What will you do for your great name?”

paite: TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Thou in, Bang achia bokkhup nilouh na hia?
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Get up! Why have you fallen on your face like that?

paite: Israelte'n thil ahihkhial ua; zuih dia ka piak ka thukhun ah atalek ua, hamsiat thilte ala ua, agu nalai ua, asim iim behlap ua, amau van lak mahmah ah asimsel uhi.
english: Israel has sinned. Yes, they have even transgressed my covenant which I commanded them. Yes, they have even taken some of the devoted things, and have also stolen, and also deceived. They have even put it among their own stuff.

paite: Huaiziak in ahi, Israel suante'n amelmate uh zou lou a, amelmate a pan ataikek uh. Hamsiat in a-omta ua ahi. Hamsiat a om pen na lak ua pan na hihmang keileh ka hon ompih nawn kei ding.
english: Therefore the children of Israel can’t stand before their enemies. They turn their backs before their enemies, because they have become devoted for destruction. I will not be with you any more, unless you destroy the devoted things from among you.

paite: 'Thou inla, mipite hihsiangthou photmai in'. Akiang uah, zingchiang a ding in kihihsiangthou un. TOUPA Israelte' Pathian in, Israelte aw, na lak uah hamsiat thil a-om a ahi. Na lak ua pan hamsiat thil na lakmang masiah uh na melmate uh na zou thei kei ding uh.
english: Get up! Sanctify the people, and say, ‘Sanctify yourselves for tomorrow, for Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, “There is a devoted thing among you, Israel. You cannot stand before your enemies until you take away the devoted thing from among you.”

paite: Zingchiang in achichi a, na hong kilat ding uh ahi. Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N huai chi a na mat pen anam anam a ahong kilat ding uh ahi. TOUPA'N huai nam a na mat pen a- inkuankuan ua ahong kilat nawn ding uh ahi. TOUPA'N huai inkuan a na mat pen amalmal a ahong kilat nawn ding ahi.
english: In the morning therefore you shall be brought near by your tribes. It shall be that the tribe which Yahweh selects shall come near by families. The family which Yahweh selects shall come near by households. The household which Yahweh selects shall come near man by man.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, kuapeuh hamsiat thil na la peuhmah, amah leh aneih tengteng mei a hal vek ding ahi. TOUPA thukhun atatleksan ziak leh Israelte lak a thil gilou haihuaitak ahih ziak in, achi," na chi ding hi.
english: It shall be, that he who is taken with the devoted thing shall be burned with fire, he and all that he has, because he has transgressed Yahweh’s covenant, and because he has done a disgraceful thing in Israel.’”

paite: Joshua zingkhang in athou a, Israelte achichi in ahong kilangsak a; Judah namte mat ahong hita uh.
english: So Joshua rose up early in the morning and brought Israel near by their tribes. The tribe of Judah was selected.

paite: Judah namte ahong kilangsak nawn a; Zerah namte ana man a; Zerahte inkuante amalmal in ahong kilang nawn ua; Zabdi mat ana hita.
english: He brought near the family of Judah, and he selected the family of the Zerahites. He brought near the family of the Zerahites man by man, and Zabdi was selected.

paite: A-inkuante amalmal in hong kilangsak nawn a; huchi in Judah chi a Zerah tapa Zabdi, huai tapa Karmi, huai tapa Akan mat ahong hita hi.
english: He brought near his household man by man, and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was selected.

paite: Joshua in Akan kiang ah, "Ka tapa, TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian thupina pia inla; akiang ah kipuang in. Na thilhih hon hilh in. Kei kiang ah iim ke'n," achi hi.
english: Joshua said to Achan, “My son, please give glory to Yahweh, the God of Israel, and make confession to him. Tell me now what you have done! Don’t hide it from me!”

paite: Akan in Joshua adawng a, akiang ah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian tung ah thil ka na hihkhialta, hichibang in ahi ka na hih:
english: Achan answered Joshua, and said, “I have truly sinned against Yahweh, the God of Israel, and this is what I have done.

paite: 'Gallak lak a Babulon puan hoihtak leh dangka shekel zanih leh dangka-eng tang shekel sawmnga buk ka mu a, ka enlah lua a, ka lata mai hi. Ngai in, ka puanin sung a lei a selguk ahi a, dangka pen huai nuai ah a-om,'" achi hi.
english: When I saw among the plunder a beautiful Babylonian robe, two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold weighing fifty shekels, then I coveted them and took them. Behold, they are hidden in the ground in the middle of my tent, with the silver under it.”

paite: Joshua in mite asawl a, puanin sung ah ava tai ua; ngai in, apuanin ah selguk ahi ngei a, anuai ah dangka ana om hi.
english: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent. Behold, it was hidden in his tent, with the silver under it.

paite: Puanin sung a kipan alakhia ua, Joshua leh Israel suan tengteng kiang ah ahon tawi ua; amau TOUPA ma ah akoih uhi.
english: They took them from the middle of the tent, and brought them to Joshua and to all the children of Israel. They laid them down before Yahweh.

paite: Joshua leh Israel tengteng in Zerah tapa Akan dangka, puan, dangka-eng tang, atapate, atanute, abawngtal, asabiltungte, abelamte, apuanin leh aneih tengteng toh api ua; Akor Phaizang ah apaitouhpih uhi.
english: Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, the silver, the robe, the wedge of gold, his sons, his daughters, his cattle, his donkeys, his sheep, his tent, and all that he had; and they brought them up to the valley of Achor.

paite: Joshua in, "Bangziak a hon hihmangbang na hia? TOUPA'N tuni in nang leng ahon hihmangbang ding hi,” achi hi. Huchi in Israel tengteng in suang in adeng ua; suang a aden khit un mei in ahal uhi.
english: Joshua said, “Why have you troubled us? Yahweh will trouble you today.” All Israel stoned him with stones, and they burned them with fire and stoned them with stones.

paite: Atung ah suang achiangvum ua, tuni tan in a-om lai hi. Huchi in TOUPA'N aheh petmahna akiheisan hi. Huaiziak in huai mun min tuni tan in Akor Phaizang achi lai uhi.
english: They raised over him a great heap of stones that remains to this day. Yahweh turned from the fierceness of his anger. Therefore the name of that place was called “The valley of Achor” to this day.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Lau ke'nla, lunglel sam ke'n. Galdou thei tengteng tonpih inla, thou inla, Ai ah hohtou in. Ngai in, na khut ah Ai kumpipa, amite, akhua leh agam ka hon peta hi.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t be afraid, and don’t be dismayed. Take all the warriors with you, and arise, go up to Ai. Behold, I have given into your hand the king of Ai, with his people, his city, and his land.

paite: Jeriko leh akumpipa uh tung a na hih bang in, Ai khua leh akumpipa tung ah leng na hih ding hi. Gallak leh gante kia nou a tuam ding in nei un. Khopi nung ah guktan un," achi hi.
english: You shall do to Ai and her king as you did to Jericho and her king, except you shall take its goods and its livestock for yourselves. Set an ambush for the city behind it.”

paite: Joshua leh galdou thei tengteng Ai a hohtou ding in akisata ua, huchi in Joshua in mihat hangsan singthum atelkhia a, zan in asawlkheta hi.
english: So Joshua arose, with all the warriors, to go up to Ai. Joshua chose thirty thousand men, the mighty men of valor, and sent them out by night.

paite: Akiang uah, "Ngai un, khopi nunglam ah khopi dou ding in guktan un. Khopi a pan gamla lua ah pai kei unla, mansa in om gige un.
english: He commanded them, saying, “Behold, you shall lie in ambush against the city, behind the city. Don’t go very far from the city, but all of you be ready.

paite: Kei leh ka kiang a om tengteng in khopi ka hon zuan ding uh. Huan hichi ahi ding a, tuma a mah bang in hong dou dia ahong pawt chiang un, ama uah i taikek ding uh.
english: I and all the people who are with me will approach the city. It shall happen, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them.

paite: Hon delh ding in ahong pawt ding ua, khua a pan gamla sim i kihepkhiak tan in. Amau, Tuma a mah bang in i ma uah taikek uh e,' achi ding ua; ama uah i taikek ding uh.
english: They will come out after us until we have drawn them away from the city; for they will say, ‘They flee before us, like the first time.’ So we will flee before them,

paite: Guktanna a pan na hong pawtkhe ding ua, khopi na la ding uhi. TOUPA na Pathian un na khut uah ahon pe ding hi.
english: and you shall rise up from the ambush, and take possession of the city; for Yahweh your God will deliver it into your hand.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, khopi na lak chiang un, khopi na hal ding uh ahi. TOUPA thu bang zel in na hih ding uh ahi. Ngai un, thu ka hon peta," chi in thu apia hi.
english: It shall be, when you have seized the city, that you shall set the city on fire. You shall do this according to Yahweh’s word. Behold, I have commanded you.”

paite: Joshua in asawlkheta a, guktanna mun ah ahoh ua, Ai kho tumlam ah Bethel leh Ai kho kikal ah a-om uh. Joshua bel huai zan in mipite lak ah agiak hi.
english: Joshua sent them out; and they went to set up the ambush, and stayed between Bethel and Ai on the west side of Ai; but Joshua stayed among the people that night.

paite: Zingkhang in Joshua athou a, mipite akaikhawm a, amah leh Israel upate mipite ma ah Ai kholam ah ahohtou uhi.
english: Joshua rose up early in the morning, mustered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.

paite: Mi tengteng, akiang a galdou thei omte tan in ahohtou ua, ava zuan ua, khopi chin ah ahohtou ua, Ai kho mallam pang ah agiaktou uhi. Ai khua toh akikal uah phaizang a-om hi.
english: All the people, even the men of war who were with him, went up and came near, and came before the city and encamped on the north side of Ai. Now there was a valley between him and Ai.

paite: Mi sangnga atonpih a, khopi tumlam a Bethel leh Ai kho kikal ah aguktansak hi.
english: He took about five thousand men, and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.

paite: Mite, khopi mallam a sepaihte panmun leh khopi tumlam a guktan mite panmun hoihtak in asep a; Joshua huai zan in phaizang lak ah apai hi,
english: So they set the people, even all the army who was on the north of the city, and their ambush on the west of the city; and Joshua went that night into the middle of the valley.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Ai kumpipa'n huai amuhtak in, kintak in zingkhang in athou a, huai khua a mite leh amah leh alawite tengteng toh, amun seh Arabah zawn ah Israelte dou ding in apawtta hi. Himahleh kho nunglam ah amah dou ding in guktanmi a-om uh chih athei kei hi.
english: When the king of Ai saw it, they hurried and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at the time appointed, before the Arabah; but he didn’t know that there was an ambush against him behind the city.

paite: Joshua leh Israel tengteng zohsa bangtak in a-om ua, gamdai lampi ah atai uhi.
english: Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.

paite: Khopi a om tengteng amau delh ding in asamkhawm ua; huchi in Joshua adelh ua, khopi a pan gamla sim ah khemkhiak in a-omta uhi.
english: All the people who were in the city were called together to pursue after them. They pursued Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.

paite: Ai ah leh Bethel ah Israelte delh lou khat leng a-om kei ua; khopi bangmah lou kal a pawtsan in Israelte adelhta uhi.
english: There was not a man left in Ai or Bethel who didn’t go out after Israel. They left the city open, and pursued Israel.

paite: TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Na teipi tawi Ai kholam nga in lik in. Na khut a hon pe ding ka hi," achi hi. Joshua in khopi lam nga in ateipi alikta hi.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Stretch out the javelin that is in your hand toward Ai, for I will give it into your hand.” Joshua stretched out the javelin that was in his hand toward the city.

paite: Guktan mite a-omna ua kipan ahong paikhe guih ua, akhut azaktak in atai ua, khopi ah alut ua, alata ua; khua ahal pah uhi.
english: The ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand and entered into the city and took it. They hurried and set the city on fire.

paite: Aite'n anunglam uh a-et uleh, ngai in, khopi kang meikhu van lam a khutou amu ua, akoilam lam ah leng taitheihna himhim anei kei ua; gamdai a tai delhte'n ana lehdelh uhi.
english: When the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way. The people who fled to the wilderness turned back on the pursuers.

paite: Joshua leh Israel tengteng in guktan mite'n khopi alak ua, khopi meikhu paitou amuhtak un akik nawn ua, Ai mite athat uhi.
english: When Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned back and killed the men of Ai.

paite: Midangte amau dou ding in khopi sung a pan ahong pawtkhia ua Israelte'n akaltehta uhi. Akhen alangkhat ah, akhen alangkhat ah a-om uhi. Huchi in athat ua, khat lel leng hawi leh khah anei kei uhi.
english: The others came out of the city against them, so they were in the middle of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side. They struck them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.

paite: Ai kumpipa ahingmat ua, Joshua kiang ah ahon pi uhi.
english: They captured the king of Ai alive, and brought him to Joshua.
