paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israelte'n Ai khomi gamlak a om tengteng, gamdai gam a amau ava delhna mun uah namsau in athat vek uhi. Huai khit in Israelte tengteng Ai ah akik nawn ua, asung a om tengteng namsau in ava that uhi.
english: When Israel had finished killing all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness in which they pursued them, and they had all fallen by the edge of the sword until they were consumed, all Israel returned to Ai and struck it with the edge of the sword.

paite: Huai ni a si tengteng numei leh pasal singkhat-le-sangnih ahi ua, Ai a pasal teng asi khin vek uhi.
english: All that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the people of Ai.

paite: Joshua in lah ateipi likna khut Ai khomite tengteng ahihman keuhkeuh masiah akaikik kei hi.
english: For Joshua didn’t draw back his hand, with which he stretched out the javelin, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.

paite: TOUPA'N Joshua thu apiak a, hih dia achih bangbang in huai khopi a gante leh gallakte kia Israelte a tuam ding in atangta uhi.
english: Israel took for themselves only the livestock and the goods of that city, according to Yahweh’s word which he commanded Joshua.

paite: Joshua in Ai khua ahal a, tangtawn a ding in leivum in abawl a, tuni tan in loihsan ahita.
english: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a heap forever, even a desolation, to this day.

paite: Ai kumpipa nitak tan in sing dawn ah akhai a; nitum kuan in Joshua in thu apia a, huchi in aluang sing dawn a pan alakhia ua, khopi kulhbaang kongpi lutna ah apai ua, atung ah suang avum ua, tuni tan in a-om lai hi.
english: He hanged the king of Ai on a tree until the evening. At sundown, Joshua commanded, and they took his body down from the tree and threw it at the entrance of the gate of the city, and raised a great heap of stones on it that remains to this day.

paite: Joshua in Ebal tang ah TOUPA, Israel Pathian a ding in maitam adoh hi.
english: Then Joshua built an altar to Yahweh, the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal,

paite: Mosi Dan laibu a gelhsa bang in, TOUPA sikha Mosi in Israel suante ana piaksa bang in, sek louh suangte, kuamah in sik a asek ngei nai hetlouhte in maitam abawl hi. Huai ah TOUPA a ding in halmang thillatte alan a, lemna thillatte leng alan uhi.
english: as Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses: an altar of uncut stones, on which no one had lifted up any iron. They offered burnt offerings on it to Yahweh and sacrificed peace offerings.

paite: Huai ah Israel mite muh mah in Mosi Dan gelhsa huai suangte tung ah ateisawn hi.
english: He wrote there on the stones a copy of Moses’ law, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.

paite: Israel tengteng, gamdangmi hi in, tualsungmi hitaleh avekpi un, a upate uh, amakaite uh leh vaihawmte toh TOUPA thukhun bawm sik tuak ah adingh uhi. Amau huai bawm zawng Levi siampute mai ah huai bang in adingh uhi. Amau kikimkhen in, akimkhat Gerizim tang mazawn ah adingh ua, akimkhat dang Ebal tang mazawn ah adingh uhi. TOUPA sikha Mosi in Israelte vualzawl dia thu ahilh lai in, hiai bang a hih ding in thu ana pe khinta hi.
english: All Israel, with their elders, officers, and judges, stood on both sides of the ark before the Levitical priests, who carried the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, the foreigner as well as the native; half of them in front of Mount Gerizim, and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of Yahweh had commanded at the first, that they should bless the people of Israel.

paite: Huai khit in Joshua in dan thu teng, vualzawlna thu leh hamse thu tengteng asim a, dan laibu a kigelh tengteng bang in asimkhia hi.
english: Afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessing and the curse, according to all that is written in the book of the law.

paite: Mosi thupiak tengteng Israel omkhawm tengteng leh numeite leh naupang neuchikte leh alak ua namdang omte ma ah Joshua in sim louh himhim anei kei hi.
english: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded which Joshua didn’t read before all the assembly of Israel, with the women, the little ones, and the foreigners who were among them.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jordan gal a kumpipa tengteng, mual a omte, phaizang a omte, tuipi zatak dung teng a Lebanon pha a om tengteng, Hitte, Amorte, Kanaante, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste'n ana zak un,
english: When all the kings who were beyond the Jordan, in the hill country, and in the lowland, and on all the shore of the great sea in front of Lebanon, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard of it

paite: Joshua leh Israelte pheikhai khat a dou tum in akikhawm uhi.
english: they gathered themselves together to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.

paite: Himahleh Gibeon khomite'n Joshua in Jeriko khua leh Ai khua abawldan ana zak un, lepchiahpil in agamtang uhi.
english: But when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and to Ai,

paite: Palai a kibawl in ip lui pipi, uain thawl lui pipi, asesa kithuap nemnum sabiltungte a pua in mi akisawl uhi.
english: they also resorted to a ruse, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks on their donkeys, and old, torn-up and bound up wineskins,

paite: Khedap lui thuap nennon abun ua, puan lui pipi asilh ua, anek ding tanghoute uh gaw gemgom, ap khetkhut ngen ahi.
english: and old and patched sandals on their feet, and wore old garments. All the bread of their food supply was dry and moldy.

paite: Gilgal giahphual ah Joshua kiang ah ava hoh ua, akiang leh Israelte kiang ah, "Gamlapi a pan hong pai ka hi ua, huaiziak in tu in kou leh nou lemna thu khung ni,” achi uhi.
english: They went to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, and said to him and to the men of Israel, “We have come from a far country. Now therefore make a covenant with us.”

paite: Israelte'n huai Hivte kiang ah, "Ka lak ua teng hi kha ni uchia; bangchi in nou toh lemna thu i khung thei dia?" achi uh.
english: The men of Israel said to the Hivites, “What if you live among us? How could we make a covenant with you?”

paite: Amau Joshua kiang ah, "Na sikhate ka hi uh," achi uhi. Joshua in akiang uah, "Kuate na hi ua? Koilam a pan hong pai na hi ua?" achi hi.
english: They said to Joshua, “We are your servants.” Joshua said to them, “Who are you? Where do you come from?”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "TOUPA a Pathian min uh ka zak ziak un na sikhate gamlapi a pan hong pai ka hi uh. Aminthandan, Aigupta gam a athilhih tengteng,
english: They said to him, “Your servants have come from a very far country because of the name of Yahweh your God; for we have heard of his fame, all that he did in Egypt,

paite: Jordan lui gal a Amorte kumpipa nihte, Heshbon gam kumpipa Sihon, Bashan gam kumpipa Astaroth a om Og tung a athilhih tengteng ka na za uhi.
english: and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon and to Og king of Bashan, who was at Ashtaroth.

paite: Ka upate uh leh ka gam ua tengte'n ka kiang uah, 'Lampi a nek ding tawi unla, amau va houpih un,' akiang uah, 'Na sikha ka hi uh. Nou toh kilem ni, na va chi ding uh," " chi in ahon sawl uhi.
english: Our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spoke to us, saying, ‘Take supplies in your hand for the journey, and go to meet them. Tell them, “We are your servants. Now make a covenant with us.”’

paite: “Hiai ka nek ding uh tanghoute na kiang a hong dia ka hong pawt ni ua ka inn ua kipan asa a ka hon puak uh ahi. Himahleh tu in en dih, agaw gemgom a a-ap khetkhutta hi.
english: This our bread we took hot for our supplies out of our houses on the day we went out to go to you; but now, behold, it is dry, and has become moldy.

paite: Hiai thawl uain ka thunnate uh leng athak ahi. En dih, avang khin vekta hi. Hiai ka puante uh leh ka khedapte uh leng ka hong paina uh agamla mahmah a, aluigawpta hi," achi uhi.
english: These wineskins, which we filled, were new; and behold, they are torn. These our garments and our sandals have become old because of the very long journey.”

paite: Mite'n atawi uh nek-le-dawn dingte achiam ua, TOUPA dong in thu akan masa kei uhi.
english: The men sampled their provisions, and didn’t ask counsel from Yahweh’s mouth.

paite: Huchi in Joshua in amau toh kilemna abawl a, amaute hawi ding in amau toh thu akhungta hi. Omkhawm miliante leng akiang uah akichiam uhi.
english: Joshua made peace with them, and made a covenant with them, to let them live. The princes of the congregation swore to them.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akiang ua thu akhun ua kipan ni thum nung in, akhopite uh amau kiangnai a teng sam ahi uh, chih atheikheta uh.
english: At the end of three days after they had made a covenant with them, they heard that they were their neighbors, and that they lived among them.

paite: Israel suante akipankhia ua, ani thum ni in akhopite uh ava tung uhi. Akhopite uh Gibeon, Kephirah, Beeroth leh Kiriath-jearim ahi.
english: The children of Israel traveled and came to their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath Jearim.

paite: Omkhawm heutute'n TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian min lou a akiang ua ana kichiam tak ziak un, Israel suante'n akhoih kei uh. Huchi in mipi omkhawm tengteng heutute tung ah aphun uhi.
english: The children of Israel didn’t strike them, because the princes of the congregation had sworn to them by Yahweh, the God of Israel. All the congregation murmured against the princes.

paite: Himahleh heutu tengteng in mipi omkhawm tengtengte kiang ah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian min lou in akiang uah i na kichiamta ngal ua. Huaiziak in amaute i khoih uh siang lou ahi.
english: But all the princes said to all the congregation, “We have sworn to them by Yahweh, the God of Israel. Now therefore we may not touch them.

paite: Hichibang in atung uah hih ni. I hinghawi mai ding uh. Huchi lou in zaw i tung uah thangpaihna ahong tung kha ding, akiang uah lah i na kichiam khinta ngal ua," achi uhi.
english: We will do this to them, and let them live; lest wrath be on us, because of the oath which we swore to them.”

paite: Heutute mah in akiang uah, "Hinghawi in om uhen. Himahleh omkhawm tengteng a dia sing po mite leh tui tawi mite hi uhen," achi uhi; heutute'n ana chiam khit tak sa bang un.
english: The princes said to them, “Let them live.” So they became wood cutters and drawers of water for all the congregation, as the princes had spoken to them.

paite: Joshua in amaute asamsak a, akiang uah, "Bangdia, gamlapi a pan hong pai ka hi uh, chi a hon khem na hi ua? Ka kiangnai a teng sam lah na hi ngal ua.
english: Joshua called for them, and he spoke to them, saying, “Why have you deceived us, saying, ‘We are very far from you,’ when you live among us?

paite: Huaiziak in tu in hamsiat na hi uh, na lak ua mi kuamah ka Pathian inn a dia sing pomi leh tui tawimi na hihna ua pan asuakta ngei kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: Now therefore you are cursed, and some of you will never fail to be slaves, both wood cutters and drawers of water for the house of my God.”

paite: Amau Joshua adawng ua, "TOUPA na Pathian un asikha Mosi gam pumpi nou hon pe dia, agam luahmi tengteng na ma ua kipan ahihmang zel ding ahi, chih thu ana piak, na sikhate hon na hilhchian mahmah ua; huaiziak a noute ziak a ka hinna uh mansuah lau mahmah a, hichibang a na gamta ka hi uh.
english: They answered Joshua, and said, “Because your servants were certainly told how Yahweh your God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you. Therefore we were very afraid for our lives because of you, and have done this thing.

paite: Tu in ngai in, na khut a om ka hi ua; na ngaihtuahna a hoih leh dik a na theih bang in ka tung uah hih mai in," achi uhi.
english: Now, behold, we are in your hand. Do to us as it seems good and right to you to do.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Israel suante a pan Joshua in hunkhia in, athatta kei uhi.
english: He did so to them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, so that they didn’t kill them.

paite: Huai ni in Joshua in aseh bang in omkhawmte leh TOUPA maitam a dia sing po mite leh tui tawi mite in asep a, tuni tan in hiaite in apang uhi.
english: That day Joshua made them wood cutters and drawers of water for the congregation and for Yahweh’s altar to this day, in the place which he should choose.

paite: Mite a khopi dim sek, bangchidan a lungzuang a tu maimah ahia! Bangchidan a meithai bang a hong om maimah ahia! Namte lak a thupi sek a, bialte lak a lalnu sek, bangchidan a sikha suak maimah ahia!
english: How the city sits solitary, that was full of people! She has become as a widow, who was great among the nations! She who was a princess among the provinces has become a slave!

paite: Zan in nakpitak in akap a, abiang a khituite toh; a-itte tengteng lak ah amah nem ding kuamah anei kei a; alawmte tengteng atung ah lepchiahtak in agamta ua, amelmate ahong hi uhi.
english: She weeps bitterly in the night. Her tears are on her cheeks. Among all her lovers she has no one to comfort her. All her friends have dealt treacherously with her. They have become her enemies.

paite: Gimthuakna ziak leh, saltanna thupi ziak in saltanna ah Judah apaita hi; khovel mite lak ah ateng a, tawldamna amu kei; mun kochikte ah amah sawi tengteng in apha uhi.
english: Judah has gone into captivity because of affliction and because of great servitude. She dwells among the nations. She finds no rest. All her persecutors overtook her in her distress.

paite: Kikhopna thupi a kuamah ahong pai louh ziak un. Zion lampite'n asuun ua; akongpite tengteng loih in a-om a, asiampute athum huthut uh; anungak siangthoute gimthuak in a-om ua, amah mah haksa thuak in a-om hi.
english: The roads to Zion mourn, because no one comes to the solemn assembly. All her gates are desolate. Her priests sigh. Her virgins are afflicted, and she herself is in bitterness.

paite: Agalte vaihawm makai ahong hi a, melmate alohching uh; atatlekna tam luat ziak in TOUPA'N lah amah gim athuaksak ngal a; melma ma ah ata tuailaite saltanna ah apai uh.
english: Her adversaries have become the head. Her enemies prosper; for Yahweh has afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions. Her young children have gone into captivity before the adversary.

paite: Zion tate a pan in kilawmna tengteng apaimangta; alalte loupa hing mu lou zuktalte bang ahi ua, delhmi ma ah hatna nei lou in apai uh.
english: All majesty has departed from the daughter of Zion. Her princes have become like deer that find no pasture. They have gone without strength before the pursuer.

paite: Agimthuak ni leh ahaksat ni in Jerusalem in nidanglai a kipan a om khinsa athil nuamte tengteng atheigige a; melma khut a mite apuk lai un, amah kuamah in apanpih kei, galte'n amah amu ua, asiatna ah anuihsan uhi.
english: Jerusalem remembers in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that were from the days of old; when her people fell into the hand of the adversary, and no one helped her. The adversaries saw her. They mocked at her desolations.

paite: Nakpitak in Jerusalem in thil ahihkhial a; huaiziak in thilnin bang in ahong om hi; avuaktanna amuh ziak un, amah zahte'n amusit ua, ahi, anak huthut a, nunglam ah akiheita hi.
english: Jerusalem has grievously sinned. Therefore she has become unclean. All who honored her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness. Yes, she sighs and turns backward.

paite: Anik ah anitna a-om a; abeina nanung atheigige kei; huaiziak in lamdangtak in ahong kun a; lungmuanmi anei kei hi; ngai in, Aw TOUPA, ka gimthuakna; melmapa akiliansak hi.
english: Her filthiness was in her skirts. She didn’t remember her latter end. Therefore she has come down astoundingly. She has no comforter. “See, Yahweh, my affliction; for the enemy has magnified himself.”

paite: Gal in amah nu gou manphate tengteng tung ah akhut azak a; amun siangthou sung ah khovel mi ahong lut chih amu ngal a, na kikhopna uah amau ahong lut louh ding uh ahi chi a thu na piak.
english: The adversary has spread out his hand on all her pleasant things; for she has seen that the nations have entered into her sanctuary, concerning whom you commanded that they should not enter into your assembly.

paite: Amite tengteng anak huhu ua, tanghou azong ua; kha hihhalh ding in athil nuamte uh sa khenna ding in apia ua: "Thei inla, Aw TOUPA, en in ka hong buah ziak in."
english: All her people sigh. They seek bread. They have given their pleasant things for food to refresh their soul. “Look, Yahweh, and see, for I have become despised.”

paite: Nou a ding a bangmah lou ahi maw, nou hon paisuaksante tengteng? Ngai unla, en un, ka tung a hih a om ka lungkhamna bang lungkhamna himhim a-om hiam? Aheh mahmah lai a TOUPA'N ahon hihgimna bang.
english: “Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look, and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow, which is brought on me, with which Yahweh has afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.

paite: Tungsang a kipan in ka guhte ah mei ahon sawl a, amaute azou a; ka khe a ding in len azak a, ahon nungheisan; segawp leh nitum a bah in ahon bawlta hi.
english: “From on high has he sent fire into my bones, and it prevails against them. He has spread a net for my feet. He has turned me back. He has made me desolate and I faint all day long.

paite: Akhut a ka tatleknate hakkol khih in a-om a; phialkhawm in a-om ua, ka ngawngzang ah ahong tung ua; ka hatna avuaksuaksak; amau ka dou zohlouhte, akhut uah Toupa'n kei ahon pia hi.
english: “The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand. They are knit together. They have come up on my neck. He made my strength fail. The Lord has delivered me into their hands, against whom I am not able to stand.

paite: Ka lak a ka mihatte Toupa'n bangmah lou in a-omsak a; ka tangvalte mekgawpna ding in ka siatna ding in ama'n kikhawmpi poimoh asam a; uain sukna bang in Toupa'n Judah tanu siangthou asikdenta hi.
english: “The Lord has set at nothing all my mighty men within me. He has called a solemn assembly against me to crush my young men. The Lord has trodden the virgin daughter of Judah as in a wine press.

paite: Hiai thilte ziak in ka kap a; ka mit tui in atum a; lungmuan ding ka kha hihhalh ding kei a pan agamla ngal a; melma avualzoh ziak in, ka tate amau kia a nutsiat in a-om uhi.
english: “For these things I weep. My eye, my eye runs down with water, because the comforter who should refresh my soul is far from me. My children are desolate, because the enemy has prevailed.”

paite: Zion in akhutte azakkhia a; amah lungmuan ding kuamah a-om kei uh; TOUPA'N Jakob tungthu ah thu apia a, huchi a akimvel a omte agalte ahong hihna ding un; Jerusalem alak uah thilnin bang in a-om hi.
english: Zion spreads out her hands. There is no one to comfort her. Yahweh has commanded concerning Jacob, that those who are around him should be his adversaries. Jerusalem is among them as an unclean thing.

paite: TOUPA adiktat a; athupiak ka helsan ua; himahleh za un, ka hon ngen hi, nou mi tengtengte aw, ka lungkhamna en un; ka nungak siangthoute leh ka tangvalte saltanna ah apai uhi.
english: “Yahweh is righteous, for I have rebelled against his commandment. Please hear all you peoples, and see my sorrow. My virgins and my young men have gone into captivity.

paite: Ka itte ka sam a, himahleh ahon khem uh; ka siampute leh ka upate'n amau khate hihhalh ding a an akizon lai un khopi sung ah asihloh uhi.
english: “I called for my lovers, but they deceived me. My priests and my elders gave up the spirit in the city, while they sought food for themselves to refresh their souls.

paite: Aw TOUPA, ngai in; ka dah ua; ka lungsim amangbang a; ka sung ah ka lungtang akilumlet a; nakpitak in ka helta ua; polam ah namsau thah in insung ah sihna a-om hi.
english: “Look, Yahweh; for I am in distress. My heart is troubled. My heart turns over within me, for I have grievously rebelled. Abroad, the sword bereaves. At home, it is like death.

paite: Ka thum aza ua; kuamah hon khamuan ding a-om kei; ka melmate tengteng in ka mangbatna aza ua, huchibang a na hih ziak in akipak uh; na phuankhiaksa ni na tun ding a, kei bang ahi ding uh.
english: “They have heard that I sigh. There is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my trouble. They are glad that you have done it. You will bring the day that you have proclaimed, and they will be like me.

paite: Agitlouhna tengteng uh na ma ah hong tung hen; ka tatlekna tengteng ziak a ka tung a na hih bang in amaute tung ah leng hih in; ka khoisatna atam lua a, ka lungtang leng abahgawpta hi.
english: “Let all their wickedness come before you. Do to them as you have done to me for all my transgressions. For my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.

paite: Bangchidan a Toupa'n ahehna a Zion tanu meipi a tuam ahia! Israel kilawmna van a kipan lei ah apaikheta a, aheh ni in akhe ngakna atheigige kei hi.
english: How has the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger! He has cast the beauty of Israel down from heaven to the earth, and hasn’t remembered his footstool in the day of his anger.

paite: Jakob tenna tengteng Toupa'n anawmvalh a, ahehpih kei; ahehna ah Judah tanu kulh hatte alaichim a, lei toh kilual in akoih hi; gam leh huai a vaihawmte ahihninta hi.
english: The Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob without pity. He has thrown down in his wrath the strongholds of the daughter of Judah. He has brought them down to the ground. He has profaned the kingdom and its princes.

paite: Aheh mahmahna ah Israel kii tengteng asattan a; melma ma a kipan akhut taklam alakikta; meikuang, kimvel hulbei bang in Jakob akangmangta hi.
english: He has cut off all the horn of Israel in fierce anger. He has drawn back his right hand from before the enemy. He has burned up Jacob like a flaming fire, which devours all around.

paite: Melma bang in athalpeu alai a, gal bang in akhut taklam toh adingh a, mit a ding a etnophuaite tengteng athat a; Zion tanu puanin ah meikuang bang in athangpaihna asungbua hi.
english: He has bent his bow like an enemy. He has stood with his right hand as an adversary. He has killed all that were pleasant to the eye. In the tent of the daughter of Zion, he has poured out his wrath like fire.

paite: Toupa'n melma bang ahong hi, Israel anawmvalhta; a-inpi tengteng anawmvalh vek a, akulh muanhuaite ahihseta; Judah tanu ah suunna leh kahna apungsak hi.
english: The Lord has become as an enemy. He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces. He has destroyed his strongholds. He has multiplied mourning and lamentation in the daughter of Judah.

paite: Huan hileh kilawm bang in, hiamgamtak in abiakbuk alamang a; akikhopna mun ahihseta; TOUPA'N kikhawm thupi leh Sabbath Zion ah mangngilh in a-omsak a, ahehna thangpaihna in kumpipa leh siampu amusit hi.
english: He has violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were a garden. He has destroyed his place of assembly. Yahweh has caused solemn assembly and Sabbath to be forgotten in Zion. In the indignation of his anger, he has despised the king and the priest.

paite: Toupa'n amaitam apaimang a, amun siangthou akih a, a-inpi kulhbaangte melmate khut ah apeta hi; kikhop thupi ni bang in TOUPA insung ah thawm anei uhi.
english: The Lord has cast off his altar. He has abhorred his sanctuary. He has given the walls of her palaces into the hand of the enemy. They have made a noise in Yahweh’s house, as in the day of a solemn assembly.

paite: Zion tanu kulhbaang TOUPA'N suksiat atumta; akhauzan a, hihse lou ding in akhut ala kei hi; himahleh leichian leh kulhbaang akapsak a; akigawp tuak uhi.
english: Yahweh has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion. He has stretched out the line. He has not withdrawn his hand from destroying; He has made the rampart and wall lament. They languish together.

paite: Akongpite lei ah atum ua; akalhna chiangte hihsia in akuaitan hi; dan omlouhna namte lak ah akumpipa leh alalte a-om uh; ahi, TOUPA a kipan azawlneite'n meng amu kei uhi.
english: Her gates have sunk into the ground. He has destroyed and broken her bars. Her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not. Yes, her prophets find no vision from Yahweh.

paite: Leitung ah Zion tanu upate atu ua, apau kei uh; aluzang ua leivui akhi ua; sai-ip puan asilh uhi; Jerusalem nungak siangthoute'n lei lam ah alu uh akun uhi.
english: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground. They keep silence. They have cast up dust on their heads. They have clothed themselves with sackcloth. The virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.

paite: Khitui in ka mitte azuau a, ka lungsim amangbang hi, leitung ah ka sin buakkhiak in a-om a, ka mite tanu siatna ziak in khopi kongzingte a naupang tuailaite leh nawi ne laite asihbup ziak un.
english: My eyes fail with tears. My heart is troubled. My bile is poured on the earth, because of the destruction of the daughter of my people, because the young children and the infants swoon in the streets of the city.

paite: Anute uh kiang ah, buh-le-bal leh uain koi a om ahia? achi ua. Khopi kongzingte miliamte bang a asihbup lai un, anute uh angsung a akha uh sunbuak a a-om lai in.
english: They ask their mothers, “Where is grain and wine?” when they swoon as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul is poured out into their mothers’ bosom.

paite: Na kiang ah bang ka theisak dia? Nang toh bang ka teh dia, Aw Jerusalem tanu? Aw Zion tanu siangthou, ka hon lungmuan theihna ding in, bang toh ka hon kikimsak dia? Na siatna lah tuipi bang in athupi ngal a; kua'n nang ahon hihdam thei dia?
english: What shall I testify to you? What shall I liken to you, daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I compare to you, that I may comfort you, virgin daughter of Zion? For your breach is as big as the sea. Who can heal you?

paite: Na zawlneite'n bangmah lou leh haina nang a ding in mengmuh in amu ua; na koltanna pi nawn ding in, na gitlouhna amukhe kei uh; himahleh bangmah lou puakgik leh pimang a omna ziakte nang hon muhsak uh.
english: Your prophets have seen false and foolish visions for you. They have not uncovered your iniquity, to reverse your captivity, but have seen for you false revelations and causes of banishment.

paite: Hon paikheng tengteng in nang akhut uh ahon betkhum ua; Jerusalem tanu akikoukhum ua; alu uh asinkhum uh, hiai khopi kilawmna bukim, leitung pumpi a nopsakna, achih uh ahi maw? achi uhi.
english: All that pass by clap their hands at you. They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, “Is this the city that men called ‘The perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth’?”

paite: Nang siatna ding in na melmate tengteng in lianpi in akam uh aka ua; hiai ni i ngakngak uh ahi mahmah ve; i mukheta a, i muta uh.
english: All your enemies have opened their mouth wide against you. They hiss and gnash their teeth. They say, “We have swallowed her up. Certainly this is the day that we looked for. We have found it. We have seen it.”

paite: TOUPA'N alunggeli ahihtangtungta, nidanglai a athupiak ahihtangtung a; apaita, ahehpih kei; na tung a melma akipaksak a, na galte kii atawisangta hi.
english: Yahweh has done that which he planned. He has fulfilled his word that he commanded in the days of old. He has thrown down, and has not pitied. He has caused the enemy to rejoice over you. He has exalted the horn of your adversaries.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah alungtang akikou a; Aw Zion tanu kulhbaang, sun leh zan in khitui luipi bang in luangsak in; khawl kipe ke'nla; na mit khawlsak ke'n.
english: Their heart cried to the Lord. O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night. Give yourself no relief. Don’t let your eyes rest.

paite: Thou in, zan in kikou in, anvente kipatna ah; TOUPA mai ah tui bang in na lungtang sungkhia in; na ta tuailaite hinna a ding in amah lam ah na khutte liktou in, kongzingte ah an ngawl in abahgawp uhi.
english: Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches! Pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord. Lift up your hands toward him for the life of your young children, who faint for hunger at the head of every street.

paite: Aw TOUPA, en inla, ngai in, hichibang a na hihna; numeite'n agah uh ane ding uam, khut a oih a om naupangte? TOUPA mun siangthou sung ah siampu leh zawlnei thah a-om ding uh hia?
english: “Look, Yahweh, and see to whom you have done thus! Should the women eat their offspring, the children that they held and bounced on their knees? Should the priest and the prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?

paite: Kongzingte a leitual ah tuailaite leh putekte alum ua; namsau in ka nungak siangthoute leh ka tangvalte apuk uh; na heh ni in amaute na that a; na that a, na hehpih kei hi.
english: “The youth and the old man lie on the ground in the streets. My virgins and my young men have fallen by the sword. You have killed them in the day of your anger. You have slaughtered, and not pitied.

paite: Kikhawmpi thupi lai bang in, mun chih ah a-unaute na sam a, TOUPA heh ni in kuamah suakta hiam, om hiam a-om kei; huai ka dontei a ka khoilette ka melma in anegaita hi.
english: “You have called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, my terrors on every side. There was no one that escaped or remained in the day of Yahweh’s anger. My enemy has consumed those whom I have cared for and brought up.

paite: Ahehna chiang a gimthuakna mu keimah ka hi.
english: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

paite: Khovak ah hilou in khomial ah ama'n hon pi in, ahon vaksak hi.
english: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.

paite: Nitum in ka siatna ding in akhut ahei ahei petmah hi.
english: Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long.

paite: Ka sa leh ka vun a-upasak a; ka guhte akitansak hi.
english: He has made my flesh and my skin old. He has broken my bones.

paite: Ka siatna ding in alam a, khatna leh nauveina in ahon umsuak hi.
english: He has built against me, and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.

paite: Sawtpi a sisate bang in, mun mialte ah ahon tengsak hi.
english: He has made me dwell in dark places, as those who have been long dead.

paite: Ka pawtkhiak theihlouhna ding in, ka kimvel in dai akai a, ka khainiang agik hi.
english: He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. He has made my chain heavy.

paite: Ahi, ka kah a, panpihna ka nget lai in, ka thumna adaltan hi.
english: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.

paite: Suangsek in ka lampite dai akaitou a, ka lam zuihte akawisak hi.
english: He has walled up my ways with cut stone. He has made my paths crooked.

paite: Kei a ding in amah vompi mibuk leh mun-guk a humpinelkai bang ahi.
english: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in hiding.

paite: Ka lampite akaihei a, ahon botnen a; ahon bawlgawp hi.
english: He has turned away my path, and pulled me in pieces. He has made me desolate.

paite: Athalpeu alai a, athal a dia ngim ding in kei ahon bawl hi.
english: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

paite: Athalbawm a thalte ka lungtang ah alutsak a,
english: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.

paite: Ka mite tengteng nuihsan ka hong hi; ni tumtum a ala uh.
english: I have become a derision to all my people, and their song all day long.

paite: Hehna in ahon dimsak ua, gamsai in ahon vak uhi.
english: He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.

paite: Suangtat in ka hate leng akitamsak a, vut in ahon tuam hi.
english: He has also broken my teeth with gravel. He has covered me with ashes.

paite: Muanna a kipan gamlapi ah ka kha na suan a; hauhsakna ka mangngilhta.
english: You have removed my soul far away from peace. I forgot prosperity.

paite: Ka hatna amang a, TOUPA a kipan ka lametna, ka chi a.
english: I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from Yahweh.”

paite: Ka gimthuakna leh ka haksatna, gamsai leh khatna theigige in.
english: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.

paite: Ka kha in amaute atheigige a, ka sung ah akun ngiungiau hi.
english: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.

paite: Hiai ka thei thaka, huaiziak in lametna ka nei hi.
english: This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.

paite: TOUPA zahngaihnate ziak ahi hihmang a i om louh uh; alainatnate azuau ngei louh ziak in.
english: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.

paite: Zingsang teng in athak zel ua; na ginomna athupi hi.
english: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.

paite: TOUPA ka tantuan ahi, ka kha in achi; huaiziak in amah ah lametna ka nei ding.
english: “Yahweh is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”

paite: Amah ngakte kiang ah TOUPA ahoih, amah zongmi tung ah.
english: Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.

paite: Mi'n TOUPA hotdamna a lamet angak vengveng ahoih hi.
english: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.

paite: Mi'n atuailai a hakkol apuak amah a ding in ahoih ahi.
english: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

paite: Amah tung a angak tak ziak in, tangtut henla, dai sipsip hen.
english: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.

paite: Leivui ah akam koih hen; huchi a lametna a-omtheihna ding in.
english: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if it is so that there may be hope.

paite: Amah bengpa kiang ah abiang doh hen; kouna in amah dimvum hen.
english: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.

paite: Toupa'n lah tangtawn in adelh kei ding a.
english: For the Lord will not cast off forever.

paite: Dahna suaksak mahleh, azahngaihna tamdan dungzui in lainatna anei ding hi.
english: For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

paite: Kilawptak in mite tate hihgim hiam lungkhamsak hiam ahi kei hi.
english: For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.

paite: Lei a suangkul tangte tengteng khenuai sikkham ding,
english: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,

paite: Tungnungpen maima a mihing thuneihna kaihei ding in.
english: to turn away the right of a man before the face of the Most High,

paite: Athu a mihing bawlsiat, Toupa'n pha asa kei.
english: to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.

paite: Toupa'n thu apiak louh in, hichi ahong hi, chi kua ahia?
english: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?

paite: Tungnungpen kam a kipan in hoih lou leh hoih ahong pai kei maw?
english: Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?

paite: Bangziak a mihing, akhelhna gawtna a ding a mi phun ahia?
english: Why should a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

paite: I lampite zong in enchian ni, huan TOUPA lam ah kik nawn ni.
english: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Yahweh.

paite: Vante a Pathian kiang ah i lungtang leh i khutte liktou ni;
english: Let’s lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.

paite: Ka tatlek ua ka hel uh; na ngaidam kei hi.
english: “We have transgressed and have rebelled. You have not pardoned.

paite: Hehna in na khuh a, kou na hon delh a, that in, na hehpih kei hi.
english: “You have covered us with anger and pursued us. You have killed. You have not pitied.

paite: Meipi in na kituam a, huchi a ka thumna in apailetlouhna ding in.
english: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.

paite: Mite lak ah deih louh leh ninneng bang in na hon bawl hi.
english: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the middle of the peoples.

paite: Ka siatna ding in ka melma tengteng un akam uh lianpi in aka uh.
english: “All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.

paite: Launa leh kokhuk ka tung uah ahong tung a, siatgawpna leh siatna.
english: Terror and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.”

paite: Ka mite tanu suksiatna ziak in, ka mit tui in atum hi.
english: My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

paite: Khawl lou in, ka mit in abuak a, akhawl kei hi.
english: My eye pours down and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,

paite: Van a kipan TOUPA'N a-etsuk a, amuh matan
english: until Yahweh looks down, and sees from heaven.

paite: ka khopi tanute tengteng ziak in ka mit in ka kha adahsak.
english: My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.

paite: Vasa bang in ahon delhbah ua, aziak bei a ka melma hite'n.
english: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.

paite: Leikohawm sung ah ka hinna asattat ua, ka tung ah suang akhia uhi.
english: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.

paite: Ka lutung ah tuite aluang a; satkhiak in ka om, ka chi hi.
english: Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”

paite: Aw TOUPA, leikohawm niampen a pan in, na min ka sam hi.
english: I called on your name, Yahweh, out of the lowest dungeon.

paite: Ka aw na za a; ka kahna ah, ka nakna ah na bil sel ke'n.
english: You heard my voice: “Don’t hide your ear from my sighing, and my cry.”

paite: Nang ka hon sap ni in na hong pai nai a, "Lau ke'n!" na chỉ hi.
english: You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, “Don’t be afraid.”

paite: Aw TOUPA, ka kha thu na hon gensak a; ka hinna na tanta hi.
english: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul. You have redeemed my life.

paite: Aw TOUPA, ka diklouhna na mu a, ka thu ngaihtuah in.
english: Yahweh, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.

paite: Ka tung a aphulakna tengteng uleh athusawm tengteng uh na muta hi.
english: You have seen all their vengeance and all their plans against me.

paite: Akouna uh na za a, Aw TOUPA, ka siatna ding a athusawm tengteng uh.
english: You have heard their reproach, Yahweh, and all their plans against me,

paite: Ka siatna ding a dinghte mukte leh nitum a ka siatna ding a angaihtuahna uh.
english: the lips of those that rose up against me, and their plots against me all day long.

paite: Atut uleh adintouh uh nang en in; ala uh ka hi.
english: You see their sitting down and their rising up. I am their song.

paite: Aw TOUPA, akhut nasep dungzui in, atung uah thuk in.
english: You will pay them back, Yahweh, according to the work of their hands.

paite: Lungtang lungkhamna leh na hamsia atung uah pia inla,
english: You will give them hardness of heart, your curse to them.

paite: heh in amau na delh ding a TOUPA vante nuai a kipan amaute na hihgawp ding hi.
english: You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of Yahweh.

paite: Bangchidan a dangka-eng mial ahia! Bangchidan a dangka-eng siangthoupen lamdangta ahia! Mun siangthou a suangte kongzingte ah sunkhiak ahi.
english: How the gold has become dim! The most pure gold has changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.

paite: Zion tapa manphate, dangka-eng hoih toh teh theih, bangchidan a leibel, belvelmi khutsuak bang a ngaih hi ahia!
english: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how they are esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!

paite: Sehalte nangawn in anawi uh asuah ua, ata tuailaite uh atepsak uh; gamdai ostrikte bang in ka mite tanu ahong gilou uhi.
english: Even the jackals offer their breast. They nurse their young ones. But the daughter of my people has become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

paite: Nawitep lai naupang lei dangtak ziak in adangtawng ah abelh a; naupangte'n tanghou angen ua, kuamah in amaute a ding in abalkham kei uhi.
english: The tongue of the nursing child clings to the roof of his mouth for thirst. The young children ask for bread, and no one breaks it for them.

paite: Nuamtak a nete kongzing ah amangthang ua; puan sandup a khangliante'n ekvum akawi uhi.
english: Those who ate delicacies are desolate in the streets. Those who were brought up in purple embrace dunghills.

paite: Ka mite tanu gitlouhna gawtna Sodom khelhna gawtna sang in athupizaw a, huai tuh mitphiat kal lou in akizou a, amah tung ah khut akinga kei hi.
english: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom, which was overthrown as in a moment. No hands were laid on her.

paite: Amiliante vuk sang in asiangthou zaw ua, nawitui sang in angouzaw uh, rubi sandup sang in apum uh asandupzaw ua, atetna uh sapphir suangmantam bang ahi.
english: Her nobles were purer than snow. They were whiter than milk. They were more ruddy in body than rubies. Their polishing was like sapphire.

paite: Amel uh suangkuangthei sang in avomzaw a; kongzing atheih in a-om kei uh; avun uh aguh uah abelh bikbek a; akeu a, chiangkang abang hi.
english: Their appearance is blacker than a coal. They are not known in the streets. Their skin clings to their bones. It is withered. It has become like wood.

paite: Namsau a thah a om dingte, kial a thah a om dingte sang in ahoihzaw uh; gam a theigahte duh ziak in hiaite lah agawnggawp un, nakpi in asia uhi.
english: Those who are killed with the sword are better than those who are killed with hunger; for these pine away, stricken through, for lack of the fruits of the field.

paite: Hehpihthei numeite khut in atate uh huan in, ka tanute hihsia in ane uhi.
english: The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children. They were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

paite: TOUPA'N athangpaihna ahihpichingta, ahehna asungkhia a; Zion ah mei atoh a, huai in asuangphumte asuse vek hi.
english: Yahweh has accomplished his wrath. He has poured out his fierce anger. He has kindled a fire in Zion, which has devoured its foundations.

paite: Lei a kumpipate leh khovel a mi tengteng in leng, Jerusalem kongpi ah gal leh melma alut ding uh, chih.
english: The kings of the earth didn’t believe, neither did all the inhabitants of the world, that the adversary and the enemy would enter into the gates of Jerusalem.

paite: Azawlneite khelhna ziak leh asiampute ginatlouhna ziak ahi, huchibang a alaktak a midikte sisan suah a a-om.
english: It is because of the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the middle of her.

paite: Mittawte bang in kongzing ah avakvai ua, sisan a suknit in a-om ua, mite'n apuante uh alawng kei uh.
english: They wander as blind men in the streets. They are polluted with blood, So that men can’t touch their garments.

paite: "Paimang un, Siangloute! Paimang un, paimang un! Hon lawng kei un," chi in amau akikoukhum ua; ataimang ua, avialvak lai un, mite'n namte lak ah, hiai ah a-om nawn kei ding uh, achi uh.
english: “Go away!” they cried to them. “Unclean! Go away! Go away! Don’t touch! When they fled away and wandered, men said among the nations, “They can’t live here any more.”

paite: TOUPA hehna in amaute ahawmzak a; amaute alimsak nawnta kei ding; siampute min azahtak kei ua, upate adeihsak kei uh.
english: Yahweh’s anger has scattered them. He will not pay attention to them any more. They didn’t respect the persons of the priests. They didn’t favor the elders.

paite: Koute mitte avaigawp a, huhna mu lou in; lametna i ngak uah nam hon hondam thei lou ding i ngak uhi.
english: Our eyes still fail, looking in vain for our help. In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.

paite: I kongzingte ua i pai theihlouhna ding in, i kalsuante azong ua; i tawp uh anai a, i nite akimta; i tawp uh lah ahong tungta.
english: They hunt our steps, so that we can’t go in our streets. Our end is near. Our days are fulfilled, for our end has come.

paite: Van a muvanlaite sang in ei hon delhte akinzaw uh; mual tung ah hon delh ua, gamdai ah ahon na buk uhi.
english: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the sky. They chased us on the mountains. They set an ambush for us in the wilderness.

paite: I nakvangte a hu, TOUPA thaunilh, akokhuk ua lak in a-om ua; amah thu gen in. Alimnuai a namte lak ah i hing ding, i chi uhi.
english: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of Yahweh, was taken in their pits; of whom we said, under his shadow we will live among the nations.

paite: Nuamsa inla kipak in aw Edom tanu, Uz gam a teng; nou lah nang pha in leng ahong paisuak ding; na kham ding a vuaktang in na kibawl ding.
english: Rejoice and be glad, daughter of Edom, who dwells in the land of Uz. The cup will pass through to you also. You will be drunken, and will make yourself naked.

paite: Aw Zion tanu, na thulimlouhna gawtna zoh ahita; saltanna ah nang ahon pimang nawn kei ding; na thulimlouhna in ahong veh ding, Aw Edom tanu; na khelhnate amukhe ding hi.
english: The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished, daughter of Zion. He will no more carry you away into captivity. He will visit your iniquity, daughter of Edom. He will uncover your sins.

paite: Theigige in, Aw TOUPA, ka tung ua hong tung; ahon kouna uh en inla, mu in.
english: Remember, Yahweh, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.

paite: Ka gouluah uh mikhual kiang a hei ahi a, ka innte uh gamdang mite lam ah.
english: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to aliens.

paite: Tagah leh pabei ka hi ua, ka nute uh meithai bang ahi uh.
english: We are orphans and fatherless. Our mothers are as widows.

paite: Ka tui dawn ding uh sum in ka lei ua; ka singte uh kou lak a zuak in a-om hi.
english: We must pay for water to drink. Our wood is sold to us.

paite: Ka ngawngzang uah kou hon delhte a-om ua, ka bah ua, khawlna ka nei kei uh.
english: Our pursuers are on our necks. We are weary, and have no rest.

paite: Aiguptate leh Assuriate kiang ah, tanghou a lungkim ding in ka kipia uh.
english: We have given our hands to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

paite: Ka pipute uh akhial ua, a-om kei uh; agitlouhna uh kou ka pua uh.
english: Our fathers sinned, and are no more. We have borne their iniquities.

paite: Sikhate'n ka tung uah vai ahawm ua; akhut ua kipan kou hon tankhe ding kuamah a-om kei uh.
english: Servants rule over us. There is no one to deliver us out of their hand.

paite: Ka hinna uh lauthawnna toh ka tanghou uh ka mu ua gamdai namsau ziak in.
english: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, because of the sword in the wilderness.

paite: Thuk bang in ka vun uh avom a nakpitak a kialna ziak in.
english: Our skin is black like an oven, because of the burning heat of famine.

paite: Zion a numeite asual ua, Judah khopite a nungakte.
english: They ravished the women in Zion, the virgins in the cities of Judah.

paite: Akhut un lalte khailup in a-om ua, upa melte zahtak in a-om kei hi.
english: Princes were hanged up by their hands. The faces of elders were not honored.

paite: Tangvalte'n khawl apua ua, naupangte sing nuai ah akisui uh.
english: The young men carry millstones. The children stumbled under loads of wood.

paite: Kongpi a kipan upate akhawl ua, alasakna ua kipan in tangvalte akhawl uh.
english: The elders have ceased from the gate, and the young men from their music.

paite: Ka lungtang kipahna uh atawp a, ka lamna uh dahna asuak hi.
english: The joy of our heart has ceased. Our dance is turned into mourning.

paite: Ka lu ua kipan ka lallukhu uh akia a, ka khelh ziak un, ka tung uh agik hi!
english: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!

paite: Hiai ziak in ka lungtang uh abah a; hiai thilte ziak in ka mitte uh amial hi.
english: For this our heart is faint. For these things our eyes are dim:

paite: Hihsiat a om, Zion Tang ziak in; sehalte atung ah avak uh.
english: for the mountain of Zion, which is desolate. The foxes walk on it.

paite: Aw TOUPA, nang tangtawn in na om gige; na laltutphah khang khat a kipan in khang khat tan in a-om hi.
english: You, Yahweh, remain forever. Your throne is from generation to generation.

paite: Bangziak a tangtawn a hon mangngilh a, hichi tantan hon nungngatsan na hia?
english: Why do you forget us forever, and forsake us for so long a time?

paite: Nang lam hon ngasak in, Aw TOUPA huchi in bawlhoih nawn in ka om ding uh; nidanglai bang in ka nite uh thaksak in,
english: Turn us to yourself, Yahweh, and we will be turned. Renew our days as of old.

paite: ka tung ua heh lua a, hon pum nawlkhin na hih kei ngalleh.
english: But you have utterly rejected us. You are very angry against us.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi asam a, kihoupihna biakbuk a pan ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,

paite: "Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, 'Na lak ua kuapeuh in TOUPA kiang a thillat na lat un, ganhon, bawnghon leh belamhon lak ate, na lat ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When anyone of you offers an offering to Yahweh, you shall offer your offering of the livestock, from the herd and from the flock.

paite: "Athillat pen ganhon lak ate halmang thillat ahihleh apa, gensiatbei alat ding ahi. Amah TOUPA ma a pom ahihtheihna ding in kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah alan ding ahi".
english: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect. He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before Yahweh.

paite: Haltum thillat lutung ah akhut akoih dia; huchi in amah a ding in lemna bawlna dia pomsak ahi ding.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

paite: TOUPA ma ah bawngtal agou dia; Aaron tapa, siampute'n asisan alan ding ua, sisan in kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul a maitam atheh ding uhi.
english: He shall kill the bull before Yahweh. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Haltum thillat vun alip dia, asemnen ding ahi.
english: He shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

paite: Siampu Aaron tapate'n maitam ah mei akoih ding ua, mei tung ah sing achiangkhawm ding uhi.
english: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay wood in order on the fire;

paite: Aaron tapa siampute'n sabakte, alute leh athaute maitam a mei tung ah sing ah kilawmtak in akoih ding uhi.
english: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar;

paite: Asungkuate leh akhete tui in asil ding ua; siampu in TOUPA a dia gimlimtak, mei a lat halmang thillat ding in apum in maitam ah ahal ding ahi.
english: but he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. The priest shall burn all of it on the altar, for a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: “Athillat, halmang thillat ding aganhon lak ate, belam hiam, kel hiam ahihleh apa, gensiatbei alan ding ahi".
english: “‘If his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without defect.

paite: Maitam sik, mallam pang ah TOUPA ma ah agou dia; Aaron tapa, siampute'n maitam kimvel in sisan atheh ding uhi.
english: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before Yahweh. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

paite: Asem ding a, alu toh, athau toh; siampu in maitam tung a mei tung a sing tung ah akoih hoih ding hi.
english: He shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat. The priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar,

paite: Asungkuate leh akhete tui in asil dia; apum in siampu in alan dia, maitam ah ahal ding hi. TOUPA a dia gimlimtak, mei a lat halmang thillat ahi.
english: but the innards and the legs he shall wash with water. The priest shall offer the whole, and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: “TOUPA a dia thillat vasa lam halmang thillat ahihleh athillat ah vakhute hiam, vapalnoute hiam alan ding ahi".
english: “‘If his offering to Yahweh is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall offer his offering from turtledoves or of young pigeons.

paite: Siampu in maitam ah ahon tawi dia, alu ahektan dia, maitam ah ahal ding. Asisan maitam pang ah atakkangsak ding ahi.
english: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar;

paite: Agongkholh amul toh alakhe dia, maitam kiang, suahlam pang a meivu koihna mun ah apai ding hi.
english: and he shall take away its crop and its feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.

paite: Akhate abottol dia, atak botzak lou in siampu in maitam a mei tung ah ahal ding; huai TOUPA a dia gimlimtak, mei a lat halmang thillat ahi.
english: He shall tear it by its wings, but shall not divide it apart. The priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Huan Aaron tapa Nadab leh Abihute'n amei lakna uh ala tuak ua, huai ah mei-am akoih ua, gimlim abuak ua, TOUPA thupiak louhpi in Ama ah mei zat louh chi alan uhi.
english: Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and offered strange fire before Yahweh, which he had not commanded them.

paite: TOUPA ma a pan mei ahong pawtkhia a, amau akanglum a, TOUPA ma ah asita uhi.
english: Fire came out from before Yahweh, and devoured them, and they died before Yahweh.

paite: Mosi in Aaron kiang ah, “Kei hon naih mite ah ka siangthou ding a, mipi tengteng ma ah thupisak in ka om ding, chi a TOUPA'N agentak hiai ahi,” achi a, Aaron adai dide hi.
english: Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what Yahweh spoke of, saying, ‘I will show myself holy to those who come near me, and before all the people I will be glorified.’” Aaron held his peace.

paite: Mosi in Aaron paneu Uzziel tapate, Mishael leh Elzaphan asam a, akiang uah, "Mun siangthou mai a pan giahphual polam ah na unaute uh pokhia un," achi hi.
english: Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, “Draw near, carry your brothers from before the sanctuary out of the camp.”

paite: Amau ahong pai nai ua, Mosi gen bang in a-unaute uh puanaktual in giahphual polam ah apokhia uh.
english: So they came near, and carried them in their tunics out of the camp, as Moses had said.

paite: Mosi in Aaron kiang ah leh atapa Eleazar leh Ithamar kiang ah, "Na sam uh khah kei unla, na puante uh leng botkek kei un, huchi lou in zaw na si kha ding ua; mi tengteng tung ah TOUPA athangpai kha ding. Himahleh na unaute uh leh Israel inkote teng in ahihleh TOUPA'N mei a ahihmanthatte asuun thei ding uhi.
english: Moses said to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons, “Don’t let the hair of your heads go loose, and don’t tear your clothes, so that you don’t die, and so that he will not be angry with all the congregation; but let your brothers, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which Yahweh has kindled.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin kongpi a pan na pawt ding uh ahi kei. Huchi lou in zaw na si ding uh. TOUPA sathau nilhchi na tung uah a-om ngal a," achi hi. Huchi in Mosi thu bang in ahihta uhi.
english: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting, lest you die; for the anointing oil of Yahweh is on you.” They did according to the word of Moses.

paite: TOUPA'N Aaron ahoupih a,
english: Then Yahweh said to Aaron,

paite: "Nang hiam, na tapate hiam in leng, kihoupihna biakbuk sung a na lut chiang un, zu leh dawn theih hat himhim dawn kei un, huchi lou in zaw na si ding uh. Hiai na suan zelte uh tan a tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi.
english: “You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die. This shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

paite: Huai bel asiangthou leh siangthou lou, asiang leh siang lou na khentheihna ding uleh;
english: You are to make a distinction between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi zang a akiang ua agen, thupiak tengteng Israel suante na sinsak theihna ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: You are to teach the children of Israel all the statutes which Yahweh has spoken to them by Moses.”

paite: Mosi in Aaron kiang ah leh atapa dam lai Eleazar leh Ithamar kiang ah, "TOUPA a dia mei a thillat a tangbuang thillat lat bangte la unla, maitam bul ah silngou tel lou in ne un; hiai thil siangthoupen ahi ngal a.
english: Moses spoke to Aaron, and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons who were left, “Take the meal offering that remains of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire, and eat it without yeast beside the altar; for it is most holy;

paite: TOUPA a dia mei a thillat a nang a tuam leh na tapate a tuam ahih ziak in mun siangthou ah na ne ding uhi. Huchibang a thupiak a om ka hi.
english: and you shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your portion, and your sons’ portion, of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire; for so I am commanded.

paite: A-awm vei leh aliang taklam vei pen mun siang ah na ne ding uh; nang leh na tapate leh na tanute toh; Israel suante lemna thillat kithoihna nang a tuam leh na tapate a dia seh ahi ngal a.
english: The waved breast and the heaved thigh you shall eat in a clean place, you, and your sons, and your daughters with you: for they are given as your portion, and your sons’ portion, out of the sacrifices of the peace offerings of the children of Israel.

paite: Aliang vei leh a-awm vei pen TOUPA ma a vei thillat dia vei ding in mei a thillat thau toh ahon tawi ding uh ahi. Huai nang leh na tapate toh, tangtawn a nou a tuam ding ahi; TOUPA thupiak bang in," achi hi.
english: They shall bring the heaved thigh and the waved breast with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It shall be yours, and your sons’ with you, as a portion forever, as Yahweh has commanded.”

paite: Mosi in khelh thoihna kel pen ngenteltak in azong a, ngai dih, ana hal khin tham uh ahi a; huchi in Aaron tapa dam lai, Eleazar leh Ithamar tung ah ahehta hi.
english: Moses diligently inquired about the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burned. He was angry with Eleazar and with Ithamar, the sons of Aaron who were left, saying,

paite: "Bangziak a khelh thoihna mun siangthou a ne lou na hi ua? Thil siangthou, mipi omkhawmte thulimlouhna po dia TOUPA ma a lemna bawlsakna dia nou ahon piak ahi ngal a.
english: “Why haven’t you eaten the sin offering in the place of the sanctuary, since it is most holy, and he has given it to you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before Yahweh?

paite: Ngai dih ua, asisan pen mun siangthou ah laklut ahi kei a, thu ka hon piak bang a mun siangthou a na nek ngeingei ding uh ahi,” achi hi.
english: Behold, its blood was not brought into the inner part of the sanctuary. You certainly should have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded.”

paite: Aaron in Mosi kiang ah, "Ngai dih, tuni in TOUPA ma ah akhelh thoihna uh leh ahalmang thillat uh alan uhi. Hichibang thilte lah ka tung ah ahong omta ngal a; tuni in khelh thoihna ana ne taleng, TOUPA mitmuh in pom in a-om dia hia?" achi hi.
english: Aaron spoke to Moses, “Behold, today they have offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before Yahweh; and such things as these have happened to me. If I had eaten the sin offering today, would it have been pleasing in Yahweh’s sight?”

paite: Mosi in huai azak in alungkimta hi.
english: When Moses heard that, it was pleasing in his sight.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,

paite: "Israel suante houpih unla, leitung a gamsa tengteng lak a na nek ding uh gamsa hiaite ahi uh.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘These are the living things which you may eat among all the animals that are on the earth.

paite: Gamsa khechin nih a ka paisuak, eknel hai peuhmah na ne thei ding uh.
english: Whatever parts the hoof, and is cloven-footed, and chews the cud among the animals, that you may eat.

paite: Himahleh eknel hai hiam, khechin nih a ka paisuak hiam lak ah hiaite zaw na ne ding uh ahi kei. Sangawngsau in eknel haileh leng, achin akat louh ziak in; nou a ding in siang lou ahi.
english: “‘Nevertheless these you shall not eat of those that chew the cud, or of those who part the hoof: the camel, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.

paite: Zupi, eknel ahai na a, himahleh achin akat louh ziak in nou a ding in siang lou ahi.
english: The hyrax, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.

paite: Zusapi, eknel ahai na a, himahleh achin akat louh ziak in, nou a ding in siang lou ahi.
english: The hare, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.

paite: Vok, achin aka paisuak na a, himahleh eknel ahai louh ziak in; nou a ding in siang lou ahi.
english: The pig, because it has a split hoof, and is cloven-footed, but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you.

paite: Asa uh na ne ding uh ahi kei, aluang uh leng na khoih ding uh ahi kei, nou a ding in siang lou ahi.
english: You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses. They are unclean to you.

paite: "Tui sung a tengte lak ah hiaite na ne thei ding uh: Tuipite leh luite a om kha leh lip nei photphot na ne thei ding uhi.
english: “‘You may eat of all these that are in the waters: whatever has fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, that you may eat.

paite: Tui sung a tengte leh tui a thil hing om tengteng lak ah tuipi ate, lui ate, kha leh lip nei lou photphot nou a ding in thilkihhuai ahi.
english: All that don’t have fins and scales in the seas and rivers, all that move in the waters, and all the living creatures that are in the waters, they are an abomination to you,

paite: Nou a ding in thilkihhuai ahi ding ua; asa uh na ne ding uh ahi kei. Aluangte uh thilkihhuai a na neih ding uh ahi.
english: and you shall detest them. You shall not eat of their meat, and you shall detest their carcasses.

paite: Tui a kha leh lip nei lou photphot zaw nou a ding in thilkihhuai ahi.
english: Whatever has no fins nor scales in the waters is an abomination to you.

paite: "Vasa lak ah hiaite thilkihhuai a na neih ding uh ahi a; nek ding ahi kei. Thilkihhuai ahi uh: muvanlai, musane leh tuivapi.
english: “‘You shall detest these among the birds; they shall not be eaten because they are an abomination: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,

paite: Muvompi leh musi chi himhimte.
english: the red kite, any kind of black kite,

paite: Va-ak leh achi himhimte.
english: any kind of raven,

paite: Simbu, vabak, tuipi vasate leh mu chi himhimte.
english: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,

paite: Simbutanglip, ngagal leh simbupi.
english: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl,

paite: Tuivapi, vabukngak leh musanepi,
english: the white owl, the desert owl, the osprey,

paite: Intung vasa, dil vasa leh achi himhim, huihtun leh bakte.
english: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe, and the bat.

paite: "Kha nei khe li a pai chi peuhmah nou a ding in thilkihhuai ahi.
english: “‘All flying insects that walk on all fours are an abomination to you.

paite: Himahleh aleng thei ganhing neu pawl khat na nek theih ding uh a-om. Huaite ahihleh lei lak a tawm thei kheguh tang neite ahi uhi.
english: Yet you may eat these: of all winged creeping things that go on all fours, which have long, jointed legs for hopping on the earth.

paite: Hiaite lak a na nek theih dingte uh, khaupe chí himhim, kelkum, khuangbai ahihkeileh khaukhup.
english: Even of these you may eat: any kind of locust, any kind of katydid, any kind of cricket, and any kind of grasshopper.

paite: Himahleh kha nei, khe li nei dangte peuhmah nou a ding in kihhuai ahi vek uhi.
english: But all winged creeping things which have four feet are an abomination to you.

paite: "Hiaite ziak in siang lou na suak thei uhi. Kuapeuh hiai ganhing siang lou sisa toh kisukha peuhmah nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: “‘By these you will become unclean: whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

paite: Kuapeuh huai luang lami peuhmah in apuante uh asawp ding uh ahi, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uh.
english: Whoever carries any part of their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Gamsa chin ka paisuak lou, eknel leng hai lou chi tengteng nou a ding in siang lou ahi ua; kuapeuh huaite khoih siang lou ahi ding.
english: “‘Every animal which has a split hoof that isn’t completely divided, or doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. Everyone who touches them shall be unclean.

paite: Bokvak a pai tengteng lak a khebom a pai peuhmahte nou a ding in siang lou ahi a; aluang uh khoih peuhmah nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: Whatever goes on its paws, among all animals that go on all fours, they are unclean to you. Whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

paite: Aluang lami peuhmah in apuante asawp ding ahi, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding a; nou a ding in siang lou ahi.
english: He who carries their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. They are unclean to you.

paite: "Lei a vakthoh chi lak a nou a dia siang lou hiaite ahi: Bui, chikpi, thankikpi leh achi himhim.
english: “‘These are they which are unclean to you among the creeping things that creep on the earth: the weasel, the rat, any kind of great lizard,

paite: Inhik, tangteuh, thankik, dokdawn leh zusa.
english: the gecko, and the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the skink, and the chameleon.

paite: Avakthoh chi tengteng lak a nou a dia siang lou hiaite ahi uh. Kuapeuh hiaite sisa akhoih uleh nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uhi.
english: These are they which are unclean to you among all that creep. Whoever touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until the evening.

paite: Asih ua bangpeuh adelhkhum uh, siang lou ahi dia; vanzat photphot sing a bawl tui-um belsuan hiam, puan hiam, savun hiam, sai-ip hiam leng tui a diah ding ahi a; nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding. Huai khit in ahong siang ding hi.
english: Anything they fall on when they are dead shall be unclean; whether it is any vessel of wood, or clothing, or skin, or sack, whatever vessel it is, with which any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the evening. Then it will be clean.

paite: Akiakna peuh leibel chih na hihtam ding uh ahi, asung a om tengteng siang lou ahi ding uh.
english: Every earthen vessel into which any of them falls and all that is in it shall be unclean. You shall break it.

paite: Huai bel a nek chi om tengteng leh huai a om tui a diahsa himhim siang lou ahi dia; dawn chi, dawn theih chi tengteng leng huai bel sung a om himhim siang lou ahi ding.
english: All food which may be eaten which is soaked in water shall be unclean. All drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.

paite: Thil bangpeuh asiluang a kahiang khatpeuh in adelhkhum phot siang lou ahi zel dia; tanghou kanna hiam, kan lumna bel hiam leng hihtap vek ding ahi, siang lou ahi khin a, nou a ding in siang lou ahi ding.
english: Everything whereupon part of their carcass falls shall be unclean; whether oven, or range for pots, it shall be broken in pieces. They are unclean, and shall be unclean to you.

paite: Himahleh tuikhuk hiam, tuibem, tui tamtak omna siang lou chih a-om kei, himahleh asiluang in asuk khak peuhmah siang lou ahi ding.
english: Nevertheless a spring or a cistern in which water is gathered shall be clean, but that which touches their carcass shall be unclean.

paite: Chin ding haichi himhim zaw siluang in bang lai peuh in delhkhum taleh asiang lou kei hi.
english: If part of their carcass falls on any sowing seed which is to be sown, it is clean.

paite: Himahleh haichi, tui a diahsa siluang in koi lai peuh adelh khakleh nou a ding in siang lou ahi.
english: But if water is put on the seed, and part of their carcass falls on it, it is unclean to you.

paite: "Gamsa na nek theih chi himhim uh leng asihleh aluang khoihmi peuhmah nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: “‘If any animal of which you may eat dies, he who touches its carcass shall be unclean until the evening.

paite: Asa ne peuhmah in apuante uh asawp ding uh ahi, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding. Aluang lami in leng apuante asawp ding ahi, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: He who eats of its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. He also who carries its carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: "Ganhing leitung a bokvak chi tengteng thilkihhuai ahi ua, nek ding ahi kei.
english: “‘Every creeping thing that creeps on the earth is an abomination. It shall not be eaten.

paite: Akitholh chi leh khe li a pai chi hiam, khe tampi nei chi hiam, leitung a bokvak chi himhim na ne ding uh ahi kei, thilkihhuai ahi ngal ua.
english: Whatever goes on its belly, and whatever goes on all fours, or whatever has many feet, even all creeping things that creep on the earth, them you shall not eat; for they are an abomination.

paite: Bokvak chi himhim in na kihihthanghuai ding uh ahi kei, hiaite in na kihihbuah ding uh ahi kei, huaite in siang lou in na kibawl ding uh ahi kei hi.
english: You shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps. You shall not make yourselves unclean with them, that you should be defiled by them.

paite: Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi ngal a; huaiziak in, kisiangsak unla, siangthou in om un; kei lah ka siangthou ngal a. Leitung a teng, abok a vak, abangchi mah in kihihbuah kei un.
english: For I am Yahweh your God. Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am holy. You shall not defile yourselves with any kind of creeping thing that moves on the earth.

paite: Na Pathian uh hi ding a Aigupta gam a kipan noute hon pikhia TOUPA lah ka hi ngal a. Kei ka siangthou a, huaiziak in, nou leng na siangthou ding uh ahi.
english: For I am Yahweh who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

paite: "Hiai pen gamsa leh vasate leh tui a teng chi thil hing chiteng leh lei a bokvak chitengte tungthu a dan ding ahi.
english: “‘This is the law of the animal, and of the bird, and of every living creature that moves in the waters, and of every creature that creeps on the earth,

paite: Asiang leh siang lou khenna ding leh gamsa nek theih chi leh gamsa nek theih louh chi khenna ding in, chi in,” achi hi.
english: to make a distinction between the unclean and the clean, and between the living thing that may be eaten and the living thing that may not be eaten.’”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante kiang ah, numei in nau apai a, tapa aneihleh ni sagih sung siang lou ahi dia; numei dan ngeina hun lai a asian louh bang in siang lou ahi ding hi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a woman conceives, and bears a male child, then she shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of her monthly period she shall be unclean.

paite: Ani giat ni in atapa zekmong vun asum ding ahi.
english: In the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

paite: Sisan ziak a kisiangsak in ni sawmthum-le-thum a-om lai ding ahi. Akisiansak ni akim mateng thilsiang himhim akhoih ding ahi kei a; mun siangthou ah leng alut ding ahi sam kei hi.
english: She shall continue in the blood of purification thirty-three days. She shall not touch any holy thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying are completed.

paite: "Nau numei aneihleh bel numei dan ngeina hun lai a asian louh bang in nipikal nih sung siang lou ahi dia, sisan ziak a kisiangsak in ni sawmguk- le-guk a-om lai ding ahi.
english: But if she bears a female child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her period; and she shall continue in the blood of purification sixty-six days.

paite: "Tapa hiam, tanu hiam ziak a kisiansak ni akim chiang in halmang thillat ding in belamnou kum khat a upa leh khelh thoihna ding in vapalnou hiam, vakhu hiam kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah siampu kiang ah ahon tawi ding ahi:
english: “‘When the days of her purification are completed for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring to the priest at the door of the Tent of Meeting, a year old lamb for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon or a turtledove, for a sin offering.

paite: Ama'n TOUPA ma ah alan ding a, kilemna abawlsak dia, huchi in asisan pawtna a pan asiang ding. Hiai pen pasal hiam, numei hiam neinu a dia dan ahi.
english: He shall offer it before Yahweh, and make atonement for her; then she shall be cleansed from the fountain of her blood. “‘This is the law for her who bears, whether a male or a female.

paite: "Aneih in belamnou achin keileh vakhu kop khat hiam, vapalnou kop khat hiam atawi ding ahi: Khat halmang thillat ding in, akhat pen khelh thoihna ding in. Siampu in kilemna abawlsak dia, huchi in ahong siangta ding, chi in gen in," achi hi.
english: If she cannot afford a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons: the one for a burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering. The priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean.’”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: "Mi vun a, akhem hiam, abol hiam, phak hileh kilawm akimuhleh siampu Aaron kiang ah hiam, atapa siampute lak a kua pen hiam kiang api ding ahi.
english: “When a man shall have a swelling in his body’s skin, or a scab, or a bright spot, and it becomes in the skin of his body the plague of leprosy, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons, the priests.

paite: Siampu in avun a hii pen ana en dia, ahii omna amul akan a, ahii pen avun sang a thukzaw a akimuhleh phak ahi a, siampu in amah ana en dia, misiang lou in apuang ding ahi.
english: The priest shall examine the plague in the skin of the body. If the hair in the plague has turned white, and the appearance of the plague is deeper than the body’s skin, it is the plague of leprosy; so the priest shall examine him and pronounce him unclean.

paite: Avun a bolte akan a, avun sang a thukzaw a akimuh keileh, amul akan keileh hii nei mi pen siampu in ni sagih sung akhumtuam ding hi.
english: If the bright spot is white in the skin of his body, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and its hair hasn’t turned white, then the priest shall isolate the infected person for seven days.

paite: Siampu in ani sagih ni in amah a-en dia; ngai dih, ahii pen angeingei a amuh a, ahii pen avun a azamzak keileh siampu in ni sagih mah akhumtuam nawn ding hi.
english: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. Behold, if in his eyes the plague is arrested and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall isolate him for seven more days.

paite: Siampu in ni sagih ni in a-en nawn dia; ngai dih, hii pen amial a, hii pen avun a azamzak keileh siampu in asiang chih apuang ding ahi. Akhem lel ahi a, apuante asawp dia, ahong siang ding hi.
english: The priest shall examine him again on the seventh day. Behold, if the plague has faded and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. It is a scab. He shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

paite: Himahleh asiansakna ding a siampu aki-etsak nung a akhem pen avun a azamzak luatleh siampu aki-ensak nawn ding ahi:
english: But if the scab spreads on the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest again.

paite: Siampu in a-en dia, ngai in, akhem pen avun a azamzakleh siampu in siang lou chih apuang dia, hiai phak ahi.
english: The priest shall examine him; and behold, if the scab has spread on the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is leprosy.

paite: "Mi'n phak hii avomleh siampu kiang a pi ding ahi;
english: “When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought to the priest;

paite: Siampu in ana en dia, ngai dih, avun a akang a-om khiak a, amul akansak a, abawk dulh hethutleh,
english: and the priest shall examine him. Behold, if there is a white swelling in the skin, and it has turned the hair white, and there is raw flesh in the swelling,

paite: asa a phak kumlui om ahi a, siampu in siang lou ahi chih apuang dia, himahleh amah siang lou ahih ziak a khumtuam ding ahi kei hi.
english: it is a chronic leprosy in the skin of his body, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. He shall not isolate him, for he is already unclean.

paite: Aphak pen avun a azamzak mahmah a, ahii veimi vun, alu a pan akhe tan a siampu theih chiang phak in abopleh, siampu'n a-en ding hi.
english: “If the leprosy breaks out all over the skin, and the leprosy covers all the skin of the infected person from his head even to his feet, as far as it appears to the priest,

paite: Ngai dih, phak in asa tengteng abop suaksa ahihleh, hii veimi asiang chih apuang dia, akang khinta a, asiangta hi.
english: then the priest shall examine him. Behold, if the leprosy has covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean of the plague. It has all turned white: he is clean.

paite: Himahleh asa adulh hethutleh, siang lou ahi dia,
english: But whenever raw flesh appears in him, he shall be unclean.

paite: Siampu in asa dulh hethut a-en dia, siang lou in apuang ding hi. Sa dulh hethut pen siang lou ahi a, phak ahi.
english: The priest shall examine the raw flesh, and pronounce him unclean: the raw flesh is unclean. It is leprosy.

paite: Himahleh sa dulh hethut pen ana lamdan nawn a, ana kan nawnleh siampu kiang ah ahoh ding hi.
english: Or if the raw flesh turns again, and is changed to white, then he shall come to the priest.

paite: Siampu in ana en dia; ngai dih, ahii akanleh siampu in hii veimi asiang lou kei chih apuang ding hi. Amah asiangta hi.
english: The priest shall examine him. Behold, if the plague has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him clean of the plague. He is clean.

paite: "Asa leh avun a om meimatum ahi a, adamta hi.
english: “When the body has a boil on its skin, and it has healed,

paite: Ameimatum omna mun ana kan a na san hiam, kang san deuh a na bol hiam ahihleh, siampu in a-et ding ahi.
english: and in the place of the boil there is a white swelling, or a bright spot, reddish-white, then it shall be shown to the priest.

paite: Siampu in ana en dia, ngai dih, avun sang a thukzaw a akimuh a, amul akanleh siampu in siang lou in apuang ding ahi: phak hii ahi a, meimatum hong suakkhia ahi.
english: The priest shall examine it. Behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and its hair has turned white, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy. It has broken out in the boil.

paite: Himahleh siampu in ana et a, ngai dih, mul kang a-om louh a, amial sim phet ahihleh, siampu in ni sagih akhumtuam ding a:
