english: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there are no white hairs in it, and it isn’t deeper than the skin, but is dim, then the priest shall isolate him seven days.

paite: Avun a azamzakleh siampu in siang lou in apuang ding hi.
english: If it spreads in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is a plague.

paite: Himahleh abol ngou pen a-omna ngei a om a, azamzak keileh meimatum pawn lel ahi a; siampu in asiangthou chih apuang ding ahi.
english: But if the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread, it is the scar from the boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

paite: "Ahihkeileh avun polna mun asa a-om a, akang hiam, asan sim hiam ahihkeileh angouleh,
english: “Or when the body has a burn from fire on its skin, and the raw flesh of the burn becomes a bright spot, reddish-white, or white,

paite: siampu in ana en dia, ngai dih, apolna laitak a mul pen akan a, huchi avun sang a thukzaw a akimuhleh phak ahi a, meikat ahong omkhia phak ahi a, siampu in siang lou in apuang ding ahi, hiai phak hii ahi.
english: then the priest shall examine it; and behold, if the hair in the bright spot has turned white, and its appearance is deeper than the skin, it is leprosy. It has broken out in the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.

paite: Himahleh siampu in ana et a, ngai dih, apol a mul kang om lou a, avun sang a thuk lou zaw a, mial deuh lel ahihleh siampu in ni sagih akhumtuam ding ahi.
english: But if the priest examines it, and behold, there is no white hair in the bright spot, and it isn’t deeper than the skin, but has faded, then the priest shall isolate him seven days.

paite: Siampu in ni sagih ni in amah a-en dia, avun a azamzak luatleh siampu in asiang lou in apuang ding hi, hiai phak hii ahi.
english: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. If it has spread in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is the plague of leprosy.

paite: Apol pen a-omna ngei a ana omdet a, vun a azamzak keileh, mial deuh lel ahihleh meikat bawk lel ahi a, siampu in asiang chih apuang ding ahi; meikang pawn lel ahi.
english: If the bright spot stays in its place, and hasn’t spread in the skin, but is faded, it is the swelling from the burn, and the priest shall pronounce him clean, for it is the scar from the burn.

paite: "Numei hiam, pasal hiam in alu ah hiam, akhamul lak ah hiam hii aveileh
english: “When a man or woman has a plague on the head or on the beard,

paite: Siampu in hii pen ana en dia; ngai dih, avun sang a thukzaw a akimuh a, amul eng ngattak a-omleh siampu in siang lou in apuang ding ahi; meima sungtum ahi a, alu hiam akhamul hiam phak ahi.
english: then the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and the hair in it is yellow and thin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean. It is an itch. It is leprosy of the head or of the beard.

paite: Siampu in meima sungtum hii pen a-et a, ngai dih, avun sang a thuk lou zaw a akimuh a, amul vom a-om keileh siampu in meima sungtum hii veimi pen ni sagih akhumtuam ding hi.
english: If the priest examines the plague of itching, and behold, its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, and there is no black hair in it, then the priest shall isolate the person infected with itching seven days.

paite: Ni sagih ni in siampu in hii a-en dia, ngai dih, meima sungtum azamzak louh a, mul eng a-om keileh, meima sungtum a vun sang a thukzaw a akimuh keileh,
english: On the seventh day the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if the itch hasn’t spread, and there is no yellow hair in it, and the appearance of the itch isn’t deeper than the skin,

paite: met ding ahi a, meima sungtum laitak bel amet ding ahi kei; siampu in meima sungtum neimi ni sagih dang akhumtuam nawn ding ahi.
english: then he shall be shaved, but he shall not shave the itch. Then the priest shall isolate the one who has the itch seven more days.

paite: Ni sagih ni in siampu in meima sungtum a-en nawn dia; ngai dih, meima sungtum pen avun a azak louh a, avun sang a thukzaw a akimuh keileh, siampu in siang in apuang ding ahi. Huchi in apuante asawp dia, ahong siangta ding hi.
english: On the seventh day, the priest shall examine the itch; and behold, if the itch hasn’t spread in the skin, and its appearance isn’t deeper than the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him clean. He shall wash his clothes and be clean.

paite: Himahleh meima sungtum pen akisiansak nung a, avun a azamzak luatleh,
english: But if the itch spreads in the skin after his cleansing,

paite: siampu in amah ana en dia, ngai dih, meima sungtum pen avun a, azamzakleh, siampu a ding in mul eng zon akiphamoh chitchiat kei ding; amah siang lou ahi.
english: then the priest shall examine him; and behold, if the itch has spread in the skin, the priest shall not look for the yellow hair; he is unclean.

paite: Himahleh meima sungtum pen angeingei a amuh a, mul vom apouleh, meima sungtum adamta ahi a, amah a siang a, siampu in asiang, chih apuang ding hi.
english: But if in his eyes the itch is arrested and black hair has grown in it, then the itch is healed. He is clean. The priest shall pronounce him clean.

paite: "Numei hiam, pasal hiam, avun ah pol, pol ngou kilhkelh ana omleh,
english: “When a man or a woman has bright spots in the skin of the body, even white bright spots,

paite: siampu in a-en dia, ngai dih, avun a pol pen mialngou sim lel ahihleh pol lel ahi a, vun a hong suak ahi a, amah asiang hi.
english: then the priest shall examine them. Behold, if the bright spots on the skin of their body are a dull white, it is a harmless rash. It has broken out in the skin. He is clean.

paite: Asam pulhsiang mi lugiau ahi; himahleh amah asiang hi.
english: “If a man’s hair has fallen from his head, he is bald. He is clean.

paite: Asip sam apulh siangleh talkolh ahi a, himahleh amah asiang hi.
english: If his hair has fallen off from the front part of his head, his forehead is bald. He is clean.

paite: Himahleh lugiau hiam, talkolh hiam ah, hii san sim a ngou a-omleh, alugiau hiam, atalkolh hiam phak ahi.
english: But if a reddish-white plague is in the bald head or the bald forehead, it is leprosy breaking out in his bald head or his bald forehead.

paite: Huchi in siampu in ana en dia, ngai dih, alugiau hiam, atalkolh hiam a hii hong bawkkhia pen asan simleh ngou sim hethut a, avun a phak bang akimuhleh,
english: Then the priest shall examine him. Behold, if the swelling of the plague is reddish-white in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, like the appearance of leprosy in the skin of the body,

paite: amah phak ahi a, siang lou ahi. Siampu in siang lou a apuan ngeingei ding ahi, alu ah phakna a-om hi.
english: he is a leprous man. He is unclean. The priest shall surely pronounce him unclean. His plague is on his head.

paite: "Phak hii veimi puante bohkek ahi dia, asamte khah ahi dia, amuk tunglam atuam dia, siang lou, siang lou, chi in akikou ding ahi.
english: “The leper in whom the plague is shall wear torn clothes, and the hair of his head shall hang loose. He shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’

paite: Phak in abop sung teng siang lou ahi dia; siang lou ahi a, atengtuam dia; giahphual pua ah ateng ding hi.
english: All the days in which the plague is in him he shall be unclean. He is unclean. He shall dwell alone. His dwelling shall be outside of the camp.

paite: "Phak hii omna puansilh, samul puan hiam, khauzang ngat puan hiam;
english: “The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it is a woolen garment, or a linen garment;

paite: agatthoh hiam, aphanthoh hiam; khauzang ngat hiam, samul hiam, savun hiam, bangpeuh savun a bawl ah hiam; savun hiam, bangpeuh savun a bawl ah hiam, savun hiam,
english: whether it is in warp or woof; of linen or of wool; whether in leather, or in anything made of leather;

paite: gat ah hiam, phan ah hiam, bangpeuh savun a bawl ah hiam ahing sim hiam a adawkkhiakleh, phak hii ahi a, siampu in a-en ding hi.
english: if the plague is greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the leather, or in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything made of leather; it is the plague of leprosy, and shall be shown to the priest.

paite: Siampu in hii a-en dia, hii omna ni sagih akhumtuam ding hi.
english: The priest shall examine the plague, and isolate the plague seven days.

paite: Ni sagih ni in hii a-en dia, hii pen puansilh, gat ah hiam, phan ah hiam, savun ah hiam, bang ding peuh a leng azat uh savunte ah hiam, azamleh hii pen phakkip mahmah chi ahihleh siang lou ahi.
english: He shall examine the plague on the seventh day. If the plague has spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in the skin, whatever use the skin is used for, the plague is a destructive mildew. It is unclean.

paite: Puansilh, gatthoh hiam, phanthoh hiam, samul hiam, khauzang ngat hiam, savun a bawl chi himhim hiam, phak omna peuhmah hal ding ahi; phakkip mahmah chi ahi ngal a, hal ngeingei ding ahi.
english: He shall burn the garment, whether the warp or the woof, in wool or in linen, or anything of leather, in which the plague is, for it is a destructive mildew. It shall be burned in the fire.

paite: "Siampu in ana et a, huchi a, ngai dih, puansilh, gat hiam, phan hiam, savun a bawl chi himhim ah leng hii pen azam keileh
english: “If the priest examines it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin;

paite: hii omna siampu in sawp ding thu ape dia, ni sagih dang akhumtuam nawn ding hi.
english: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing that the plague is in, and he shall isolate it seven more days.

paite: Hii omna sawp ahih khit nung in siampu in ana en nawn dia, ngai dih, huai hii latdan akikhek keileh hii pen zam kei mahleh, asiang tuan kei, mei a na hal ding ahi; akipchi ahi, asunglam hiam, apolam hiam agiauleh leng.
english: Then the priest shall examine it, after the plague is washed; and behold, if the plague hasn’t changed its color, and the plague hasn’t spread, it is unclean; you shall burn it in the fire. It is a mildewed spot, whether the bareness is inside or outside.

paite: Siampu in ana et a, huchi a, ngai dih, sawp khit nung a mial sim lel ahihleh puansilh a pan hiam, savun a pan hiam, gat a pan hiam, phan a pan hiam abotkhe ding ahi.
english: If the priest looks, and behold, the plague has faded after it is washed, then he shall tear it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof;

paite: Puansilh pen, gat ah hiam, phan ah hiam, savun bawl ah hiam alat lailai leh ahong pawt nawn ahi a; hii omna pen na hal ding ahi.
english: and if it appears again in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is spreading. You shall burn what the plague is in with fire.

paite: Puansilh, gat hiam, phan hiam, bangpeuh savun a bawl chi himhim hiam na sawp a, hii in anutsiatleh sawp nawn ding ahi a, huchi in ahong siangta ding hi.
english: The garment, either the warp, or the woof, or whatever thing of skin it is, which you shall wash, if the plague has departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and it will be clean.”

paite: "Hiai bel, puansilh samul hiam, khauzang ngat hiam, gat hiam, phan hiam, savun a bawl chi himhim hiam a phak hii om asian leh sian louh puanna dan ding ahi," chi in.
english: This is the law of the plague of mildew in a garment of wool or linen, either in the warp, or the woof, or in anything of skin, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Hiai phak siansak ni a hihdan ding ahi. Siampu kiang a pi ding ahi.
english: “This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought to the priest,

paite: Huchi in siampu giahphual pua ah apaikhe dia; siampu in a-en dia, ngai dih, phakmi pen aphakna hii adamleh
english: and the priest shall go out of the camp. The priest shall examine him. Behold, if the plague of leprosy is healed in the leper,

paite: siampu in akisiangsak ding mi vasa hing siang nih, sidar sing, khauzang san leh hissop tawisak ding in thu ape ding hi.
english: then the priest shall command them to take for him who is to be cleansed two living clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.

paite: Siampu in vasa khat pen leibel ah luitui tung ah goh ding in thu ape ding hi.
english: The priest shall command them to kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.

paite: Vasa hing pen ala dia, sidar sing, khauzang san, hissop toh luitui luang tung a gohsa vasa sisan ah adiah vek ding hi.
english: As for the living bird, he shall take it, the cedar wood, the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water.

paite: Phakna a pan a kisiangsak ding mi sagihvei atheh dia, asiang chih apuang ding, huchi in vasa hing pen gamlak ah akhah ding hi.
english: He shall sprinkle on him who is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird go into the open field.

paite: Akisiangsak ding mi'n apuante asawp dia, akimetmai vek dia, akisil ding ahi. Huchi in ahong siang dia, huai khit chiang in giahphual ah ahoh dia, himahleh apuanin pua ah ni sagih a-om lai ding hi.
english: “He who is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and bathe himself in water; and he shall be clean. After that he shall come into the camp, but shall dwell outside his tent seven days.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, ani sagih ni in alu a sam tengteng leh akhamul leh amitkhu multe ametmai dia, amul tengteng ametmai ding hi. Apuante asawp in akisil dia, huchi in ahong siangta ding hi.
english: It shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows. He shall shave off all his hair. He shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his body in water. Then he shall be clean.

paite: "Ani giat ni in belamnoupa nih gensiatbei leh belamnounu khat gensiatbei, kum khat a upa leh tangbuang thillat ding in tangbuang nel mahmah ephah mun sawm a khen mun thum sathau a mek leh sathau thawl khat atawi ding ahi.
english: “On the eighth day he shall take two male lambs without defect, one ewe lamb a year old without defect, three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, and one log of oil.

paite: Asiangsakpa siampu in kisiangsak ding mi leh huai thilte kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah TOUPA ma ah akoih ding hi.
english: The priest who cleanses him shall set the man who is to be cleansed, and those things, before Yahweh, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Siampu in belamnoupa khat pen sathau log khat toh ala dia, tatlek thoihna ding in alan dia, TOUPA ma a vei thillat ding in avei ding hi.
english: “The priest shall take one of the male lambs, and offer him for a trespass offering, with the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

paite: Khelh thoihna leh halmang thillat agoh zelna mun uh, mun siangthou ah belamnoupa pen agou dia, khelh thoihna siampu a tuam ahih bang in tatlek thoihna leng siampu a tuam ahi; hiai thil siangthoupen ahi.
english: He shall kill the male lamb in the place where they kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the place of the sanctuary; for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering. It is most holy.

paite: Siampu in tatlek thoihna sisan ala dia, kisiangsak ding mi bil taklam mongte, akhut taklam khutpite, ataklam khepite siampu in anuh ding hi.
english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

paite: Sathau log khat pen siampu in ala dia, amah khutpek veilam ah asung ding hi.
english: The priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand.

paite: Siampu in akhut veilam a sathau ah akhut taklam zung adiah ding a, TOUPA ma ah akhutzung in sathau sagihvei atheh ding.
english: The priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before Yahweh.

paite: Akhut a sathau om lai teng in kisiangsak ding mi bil taklam dawn, akhut taklam khutpi leh akhe taklam khepi ah tatlekna kithoihna sisan tung ah anuh ding hi.
english: The priest shall put some of the rest of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering.

paite: Siampu in akhut a om lai teng in kisiangsak ding mi lu anuh dia; huchi in siampu in TOUPA ma ah kilemna abawlsak ding ahi.
english: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, and the priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh.

paite: "Siampu in khelh thoihna alan dia, asianlouhna a pan kisiangsak ding mi pen kilemna abawlsak dia; huai khit in halmang thillat agou ding hi.
english: “The priest shall offer the sin offering, and make atonement for him who is to be cleansed because of his uncleanness. Afterward he shall kill the burnt offering;

paite: Siampu in halmang thillat leh tangbuang thillat maitam ah alat ding asiam a, siampu in kilemna abawlsak ding a, huchi in ahong siang ding hi.
english: then the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meal offering on the altar. The priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

paite: "Mizawng ahih a, hiaite aneih zoh keileh, belamnoupa khat tatlek thoihna, kilemna bawlsakna dia vei ding leh tangbuang thillat dia tangbuang nel mahmah ephah mun sawm a khen mun khat, sathau a zut, sathau log khat toh atawi ding ahi.
english: “If he is poor, and can’t afford so much, then he shall take one male lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make atonement for him, and one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering, and a log of oil;

paite: Vakhu kop khat hiam, vapalnou kop khat hiam, aneih zoh lamlam; khat khelh thoihna ding, khat pen halmang thillat ding ahi ding hi.
english: and two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to afford; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.

paite: Ani giat ni in akisiansakna ding in siampu kiang ah kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah TOUPA ma ah ahon tawi ding ahi.
english: “On the eighth day he shall bring them for his cleansing to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, before Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in siampu in tatlek thoihna belamnou leh sathau log khat ala dia, vei thillat ding in TOUPA ma ah siampu in avei ding ahi.
english: The priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

paite: Tatlek thoihna belamnou pen agou dia; siampu in tatlek thoihna sisan ala dia, kisiangsak ding mi bil taklam dawn, akhut taklam khutpi leh akhe taklam khepi anuh ding hi.
english: He shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering. The priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering and put it on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

paite: Siampu in sathau amah khutpek veilam ah asung ding ahi.
english: The priest shall pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand;

paite: Siampu in akhut veilam a sathau khenkhat akhut taklam in TOUPA ma ah sagihvei atheh ding ahi.
english: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before Yahweh.

paite: Siampu in akhut a sathau in kisiangsak ding mi bil taklam dawn, akhut taklam khutpi, akhe taklam khepi leh tatlek kithoihna sisan tungtak ah anuh ding hi.
english: Then the priest shall put some of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the trespass offering.

paite: Siampu in akhut a sathau om lai teng in TOUPA ma a kilemna bawlsak ding in kisiangsak ding mi lu anuh ding hi.
english: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before Yahweh.

paite: Vakhu hiam, vapalnou hiam, aneih zoh lamlam khat alan dia;
english: He shall offer one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, which ever he is able to afford,

paite: aneih zoh lamlam, khelh thoihna ding in khat, halmang thillat ding in khat, tangbuang thillat toh. Huchi in siampu in kisiangsak ding mi a ding in TOUPA ma ah kilemna abawlsak ding hi.
english: of the kind he is able to afford, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meal offering. The priest shall make atonement for him who is to be cleansed before Yahweh.”

paite: Hiai bel phak hii vei, kisiansakna dan bang a chinloute a dia dan ahi,” achi hi.
english: This is the law for him in whom is the plague of leprosy, who is not able to afford the sacrifice for his cleansing.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: "Luah dia ka hon piak Kanaan gam na lut chiang ua, na luah ding uh gam a inn khat a phak hii ka koihleh,
english: “When you have come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put a spreading mildew in a house in the land of your possession,

paite: Huai inn neitu in, hiai inn ah hii hileh kilawmtak omleh kilawm ka sa, chi in siampu ahong hilh ding ahi.
english: then he who owns the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, ‘There seems to me to be some sort of plague in the house.’

paite: Siampu in hii a-en dia, alut ma in insung hihvuak ding in siampu in thu ape dia, hiai insung a thil om tengteng siang lou ahi ding hi; huai nung in siampu insung en ding in alut ding ahi.
english: The priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest goes in to examine the plague, that all that is in the house not be made unclean. Afterward the priest shall go in to inspect the house.

paite: Ama'n hii a-en dia, ngai dih, hii in ahinglam sim hiam asanlam sim hiam a baang anekkuak a, baang sang a niamzaw a akimuhleh,
english: He shall examine the plague; and behold, if the plague is in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, and it appears to be deeper than the wall,

paite: siampu inn a pan kongpi ah apawt dia, ni sagih sung huai inn akhak ding ahi.
english: then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days.

paite: Ani sagih ni in siampu'n inn ava en nawn dia, ngai dih, hii pen huai inn baang a ana zamzakleh;
english: The priest shall come again on the seventh day, and look. If the plague has spread in the walls of the house,

paite: siampu in huai hii omna suang pen lakhia a, khopi polam a ninpaihna mun a paih ding in thu ape ding hi,
english: then the priest shall command that they take out the stones in which is the plague, and cast them into an unclean place outside of the city.

paite: Insung lam akiatsiangsak kimvel dia, suang zutbitna a kiatkhiak leivui pen dainawl mun nin ah asung ding uhi.
english: He shall cause the inside of the house to be scraped all over. They shall pour out the mortar that they scraped off outside of the city into an unclean place.

paite: Suang dang ala ding ua, huai suangte mun ah akoih ding ua; suang zutbitna dang ala ding ua, inn ahu ding uhi.
english: They shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.

paite: "Suang alakkhiak a, inn akiat-siang a, ahuk khit nung a hii ahong dawk nawnleh, siampu ava lut dia, ava en nawn ding hi.
english: “If the plague comes again, and breaks out in the house after he has taken out the stones, and after he has scraped the house, and after it was plastered,

paite: Ngai dih, hii ana zamzakleh huai inn a phak akipchi ahi a, siang lou ahi.
english: then the priest shall come in and look; and behold, if the plague has spread in the house, it is a destructive mildew in the house. It is unclean.

paite: Huai inn aphel dia, asuang, asing leh asuang zutbitna teng leng dainawl mun nin ah anawnkhe vek ding ahi.
english: He shall break down the house, its stones, and its timber, and all the house’s mortar. He shall carry them out of the city into an unclean place.

paite: Kuapeuh huai inn khak ahih sung himhim alut taphot nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding hi.
english: “Moreover he who goes into the house while it is shut up shall be unclean until the evening.

paite: Kuapeuh huai inn a lum taphot in apuante uh asawp ding ua; kuapeuh huai inn a an ne taphot in apuante uh asawp ding uh ahi.
english: He who lies down in the house shall wash his clothes; and he who eats in the house shall wash his clothes.

paite: "Siampu alut a, a-et kimvel a, ngai dih, huai inn hukbit ahih nung a, hii azamzak keileh, inn asiang chih siampu in apuang ding; hii pen akikhinmang tak ziak in.
english: “If the priest shall come in, and examine it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the house, after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.

paite: Inn siansakna ding in vasa nih leh sidar sing leh khauzang san leh hissop atawi ding hi.
english: To cleanse the house he shall take two birds, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop.

paite: Vasa khat pen leibel ah luitui luang tung ah agou ding hi.
english: He shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.

paite: Sidar sing, hissop, khau san leh vasa hing pen ala dia, vasa gohsa sisan ah leh luitui ah adiah ding hi.
english: He shall take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times.

paite: Vasa sisan, luitui luang, vasa hing pen, sidar sing, hissop leh khau san in huai inn asiangsak ding ahi.
english: He shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, with the living bird, with the cedar wood, with the hyssop, and with the scarlet;

paite: Vasa hing pen khua a pan gamlak ah kilemna bawlna ding in alengkhesak dia; huchi in huai inn asiangsak ding a, ahong siang ding hi.
english: but he shall let the living bird go out of the city into the open field. So shall he make atonement for the house; and it shall be clean.”

paite: "Hiai pen phak hii chi chih leh meima sunglut tungthu a dan ahi;
english: This is the law for any plague of leprosy, and for an itch,

paite: puan a-omleh innte a om phak a ding;
english: and for the destructive mildew of a garment, and for a house,

paite: chibawk, khem, pol leh chikang chihte toh kisai a,
english: and for a swelling, and for a scab, and for a bright spot;

paite: sianlouhna hun leh sianna hun a sinsak ding, phak dan ahi," achi hi.
english: to teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean. This is the law of leprosy.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupihua,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: Israel suante houpih unla, akiang uah, 'Mi kuapeuh sa a thil apawtleh athilpawt ziak in siang lou ahi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, because of his discharge he is unclean.

paite: Athilpawt sung teng siang lou ahi a, asa ah apawt gige hiam, apawt atawpta hiam leng hitaleh, amah siang lou himhim ahi.
english: This shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body has stopped from his discharge, it is his uncleanness.

paite: Thilpawtmi lupna peuhmah siang lou ahi dia; atutna peuhmah leng siang lou ahi lai ding hi.
english: “‘Every bed on which he who has the discharge lies shall be unclean; and everything he sits on shall be unclean.

paite: Kuapeuh alupna khoih peuhmahte'n apuante uh asawp ding ua, akisil ding uh ahi, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uhi.
english: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Thilpawtmi tutna a tu peuhmahte'n apuante uh asawp ding ua, akisil ding uh ahi, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uh.
english: He who sits on anything on which the man who has the discharge sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Kuapeuh thilpawtmi sa khoih peuhmah in apuante uh asawp ding ua, akisil ding uh ahi, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uhi.
english: “‘He who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Thilpawtmi in misiang chil asiatkhumleh apuante asawp dia, akisil ding ahi, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: “‘If he who has the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Tuanna bangpeuh a leng thilpawtmi atuanleh siang lou ahi ding.
english: “‘Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean.

paite: Kuapeuh akingaihnasa nung thil khoih peuhmahte nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding ua; huai thil lasuan mi peuhmah in apuante uh asawp ding ua; akisil ding uh ahi. Nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uhi.
english: Whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening. He who carries those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Kuapeuh thilpawtmi in akhut sil lou a akhoih peuhmah in apuante asawp dia, akisil ding ahi. Nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: “‘Whomever he who has the discharge touches, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Thilpawtmi leibel khoihsa suktap ding ahi; asing vanzat tengteng silsiang vek ding ahi,' achi hi.
english: “‘The earthen vessel, which he who has the discharge touches, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

paite: "Huan thilpawtmi bel, athilpawt hihsiang ahihleh, akisiansakna ding in ni sagih akipe dia, apuante asawp dia; luitui ah akisil dia; huchi in ahong siangta ding hi.
english: “‘When he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

paite: Ani giat ni in vakhu kop khat hiam, vapalnou kop khat hiam tawi in TOUPA ma ah kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah ahoh dia, siampu ape ding ahi.
english: “‘On the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before Yahweh to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest.

paite: Siampu in khelh thoihna ding in khat, halmang thillat ding in akhat pen alan ding hi. Siampu in athilpawt thu ah TOUPA ma ah kilemna abawlsak ding.
english: The priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh for his discharge.

paite: "Pasal kuapeuh kipolhna chi amah a pan apawtleh apumpi in akisil vek dia, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: “‘If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Puansilh leh vun, kipolhna chitukna peuhmah sawpsiang vek ding ahi a, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: Every garment and every skin which the semen is on shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Numei akithuahpih leng anih ua akisil tuak ding uh ahi. Nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uhi.
english: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: "Numei in thilpawt aneih a, asa a thilpawt si ahihleh ni sagih sung siang lou ahi dia; kuapeuh amah khoih kha taphot nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: “‘If a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days. Whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening.

paite: Asian louh sung a, alupna peuhmah siang lou ahi dia, atutna peuhmah leng siang lou ahi lai ding hi.
english: “‘Everything that she lies on in her impurity shall be unclean. Everything also that she sits on shall be unclean.

paite: Alupna khoih peuhmahte'n apuante uh asawp ding ua, akisil ding uh ahi. Nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uh.
english: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Kuapeuh atutna khoih peuhmahte'n apuante uh asawp ding ua, akisil ding uh ahi. Nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uhi.
english: Whoever touches anything that she sits on shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Alupna a thil om hiam, atutna a thil om hiam khoih peuhmah leng nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uh.
english: If it is on the bed, or on anything she sits on, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the evening.

paite: Kuapeuh in akithuahpih a, asi neih luang in amah asuk khakleh ni sagih sung siang lou ahi dia; alupna peuhmah siang lou ahi vek ding hi.
english: “‘If any man lies with her, and her monthly flow is on him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed he lies on shall be unclean.

paite: "Numei asi neih ngeina hilou, ni sawtkuamtak a sipawt hiam, anitdan ngeina sang a sawtzaw sipawt hiam ahihleh, asianlouhdan ngeina sung a, a-om zel bang in sipawtmi anit sung teng siang lou in a-om ding hi.
english: “‘If a woman has a discharge of her blood many days not in the time of her period, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her period, all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be as in the days of her period. She is unclean.

paite: Asipawt sung teng alupna taphot asiang louh ngeina hun lai a, alupna bang ahi dia; atutna peuhmah asian louh ngeina hun lai a, asiang louh bang in siang lou ahi ding.
english: Every bed she lies on all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her period. Everything she sits on shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her period.

paite: Kuapeuh huai thil khoih peuhmah siang lou ahi dia, apuante asawp dia, akisil ding ahi. Nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: Whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

paite: Himahleh asipawt pen siansak ahihleh ni sagih ama'n akisim dia, huchi in ahong siangta ding hi.
english: “‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

paite: Ani giat ni in vakhu kop khat hiam, vapalnou kop khat hiam atawi dia, kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah siampu ahong pe ding ahi.
english: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Siampu in khelh thoihna ding in khat, halmang thillat ding in khat alan ding ahi. Huchi in siampu in sipawtmi asianlouhna thu ah TOUPA ma ah kilemna abawlsak ding ahi.
english: The priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before Yahweh for the uncleanness of her discharge.

paite: "Hiai bang in Israel suante asianlouhna ua pan na hihtuam ding uh ahi; alak ua ka biakbuk ahihbuah khak chiang ua leng asianlouhna ua asihlouhna ding un.
english: “‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.’”

paite: "Hiai dan pasal thilpawt neimi leh kipolhna a pan chi pawtkhia a ninte leh
english: This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of him who has an emission of semen, so that he is unclean by it;

paite: numei kha teng si neih sung a ding, pasal hi in numei hitaleh sa a pan thilpawt neimi a ding leh siang lou a ngaih numei kithuahpih pasal a ding ahi," achi hi.
english: and of her who has her period, and of a man or woman who has a discharge, and of him who lies with her who is unclean.

paite: Huan Aaron tapa nihte'n TOUPA ava naih ua asihloh nung un TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they came near before Yahweh, and died;

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Na unau Aaron houpih inla, puanzak sung Mun Siangthou ah, bawm tung a zahngaihna tutphah ma ah chik lai peuh in leng hong lut het kei heh, asi kha ding hi. Zahngaihna tutphah tung a, meipi a hong kilang ding ka hih ziak in.
english: and Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron your brother not to come at just any time into the Most Holy Place within the veil, before the mercy seat which is on the ark; lest he die; for I will appear in the cloud on the mercy seat.

paite: Hichibang in Mun Siangthou ah khelh thoihna ding in bawngtuai, halmang thillat ding in belampa toh Aaron ahoh ding ahi.
english: “Aaron shall come into the sanctuary with a young bull for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

paite: "Puanmalngat puanak siangthou asilh dia, asa khuhna ding in puanmalngat pheituam abun ding, puanmalngat dial akhim ding ahi. Hiaite puansilh siangthou ahi a; akisil masa dia, huchi in asilh phet ding ahi.
english: He shall put on the holy linen tunic. He shall have the linen trousers on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.

paite: "Israel suan mipi omkhawmte a pan khelh thoihna ding in kelpa nih leh halmang thillat ding in belampa khat atawi ding ahi.
english: He shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two male goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

paite: Aaron in amah a tuam, khelh thoihna bawngtal pen alan dia, amah leh a-inkote a ding in kilemna abawl ding ahi.
english: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.

paite: Kel nih akai dia, kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah TOUPA ma ah akoih ding hi.
english: He shall take the two goats, and set them before Yahweh at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Aaron in kel nih tungthu ah ai asan dia, khat TOUPA a tuam ahi dia, akhat pen thuak sik thuak kel ahi ding.
english: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats: one lot for Yahweh, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

paite: Aaron in TOUPA a tuam dia puk kel pen ala dia, khelh thoihna ding in alan ding hi.
english: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for Yahweh, and offer him for a sin offering.

paite: Thuak sik thuak kel dia puk pen kilemna bawlna dia khah ding in TOUPA ma ah ahing in akoih ding hi.
english: But the goat on which the lot fell for the scapegoat shall be presented alive before Yahweh, to make atonement for him, to send him away as the scapegoat into the wilderness.

paite: "Aaron in ama a tuam khelhna bawngtal pen ala dia, amah leh a-inkote a ding in kilemna abawl dia, amah a tuam khelh thoihna bawngtal pen agou ding hi.
english: “Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and shall kill the bull of the sin offering which is for himself.

paite: TOUPA ma a maitam a pan mei lakna dim in mei-am ala dia, gimlim gawizan ngiingei pham khat toh puanzak sung ah alutpih ding hi.
english: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before Yahweh, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil.

paite: Gimlim khu in thu theihpihna tung a zahngaihna tutphah abopna ding in TOUPA ma a mei ah gimlim abuak dia, sihna atuahlouhna ding in.
english: He shall put the incense on the fire before Yahweh, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is on the covenant, so that he will not die.

paite: Bawngtal sisan bangzah hiam ala dia, akhutzung in zahngaihna tutphah suahlam pang a theh dia, akhut in zahngaihna tutphah bul sisan in sagihvei atheh ding ahi.
english: He shall take some of the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it with his finger on the mercy seat on the east; and before the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.

paite: "Mipi a tuam khelh thoihna kel pen agou dia, asisan, bawngtal sisan abawl bang in abawl dia, zahngaihna tutphah tung leh zahngaihna tutphah ma ah atheh ding hi.
english: “Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the mercy seat and before the mercy seat.

paite: Israel suante sianlouhnate leh akhelhnate ua atatleknate uh ziak in Mun Siangthou a ding in kilemna abawl ding hi. Huai mah bang in, asianlouhnate uh lak a om, kihoupihna biakbuk a ding in leng abawl sam ding hi.
english: He shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins; and so he shall do for the Tent of Meeting that dwells with them in the middle of their uncleanness.

paite: Mun Siangthou a kilemna bawl dia alut lai in, amah leh a-inkote leh Israel mipite a dia kilemna bawl khin a ahong pawtkhiak masiah kuamah puanin sung ah a-om ding ahi kei.
english: No one shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he enters to make atonement in the Holy Place, until he comes out, and has made atonement for himself and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.

paite: TOUPA ma a maitam lam ah apawt dia, huai a ding in kilemna abawl dia, bawngtal sisan leh kel sisan bangzah hiam ala dia, maitam kiite ah akimvel in atat ding ahi.
english: “He shall go out to the altar that is before Yahweh and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the bull’s blood, and some of the goat’s blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar.

paite: Akhut in huai sisan sagihvei atheh dia, asiangsak dia, Israel suante sianlouhna a pan ahihsiangthou ding hi.
english: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and make it holy from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

paite: "Mun Siangthou leh kihoupihna biakbuk leh maitam a dia kilemna abawl khit chiang in, kel hing pen ahon kai ding hi.
english: “When he has finished atoning for the Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.

paite: Aaron in kel hing lutung ah akhut langnih akoih dia, atung ah Israel suante gitlouhna teng leh khial a atatlekna teng uh apulak dia; huaite kel lutung ah anga dia, mi khat asehkholhsa un gamdai ah apimang ding hi.
english: Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them on the head of the goat, and shall send him away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is ready.

paite: Huai kel in agitlouhna tengteng uh luah louh gam ah apomang dia, kel bel gamdai ah akhah ding hi.
english: The goat shall carry all their iniquities on himself to a solitary land, and he shall release the goat in the wilderness.

paite: "Kihoupihna puanin ah Aaron alut dia, Mun Siangthou a, alut lai a puanmalngat puansilh asuah dia, huai ah anuse ding hi.
english: “Aaron shall come into the Tent of Meeting, and shall take off the linen garments which he put on when he went into the Holy Place, and shall leave them there.

paite: Mun siangthou ah akisil dia, apuansilh asilh dia, ahong pawtkhe dia, amah a tuam halmang thillat leh mipi a tuam halmang thillat alan dia, amah leh mipi a ding in kilemna abawl ding hi.
english: Then he shall bathe himself in water in a holy place, put on his garments, and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.

paite: Khelh thoihna thau maitam ah ahal ding hi.
english: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.

paite: Thuak sik thuak kel khah mi kuapeuh in apuante asawp dia, akisil dia, huai khit in a-omna mun ah apai nawn ding ahi.
english: “He who lets the goat go as the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

paite: Khelh thoihna bawngtal leh khelh thoihna kel sisan kilemna abawlna dia Mun Siangthou a, alutpih uh giahphual pua ah apaipih ding hi; avun, asa leh a-ek ahal ding ahi.
english: The bull for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried outside the camp; and they shall burn their skins, their flesh, and their dung with fire.

paite: Ahalmi'n apuan asawp dia, akisil dia, huai khit in a-omna mun ah apai nawn ding ahi.
english: He who burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

paite: "Hiai na tangtawn dan thuseh ding uh ahi: Akha sagihna, huai kha ani sawm ni in na lungsimte uh na gimsak ding ua, na gam ua mi himhim hiam, gamdangmi na lak ua teng hiam in bangmah asep louh ding ahi.
english: “It shall be a statute to you forever: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict your souls, and shall do no kind of work, whether native-born or a stranger who lives as a foreigner among you;

paite: Hiai ni in noute hihsiangthou ding in noute a ding in kilemna bawl ahi dia; huchi in TOUPA ma ah na khelhna tengteng lak ua pan na siang ding uhi.
english: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you. You shall be clean from all your sins before Yahweh.

paite: Nou a dia Sabbath ni ahi a, na lungsimte uh na gimsak ding uh ahi. Hiai tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi.
english: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls. It is a statute forever.

paite: Siampu, apa sik a siampu hi dia sathau nilh ding leh hihtuam mi hi ding in kilemna abawl dia, puanmalngat puansilh siangthou asilh dia; mun siangthou a ding in kilemna abawl dia; kihoupihna biakbuk leh maitam a ding in leng kilemna abawl sam ding hi.
english: The priest, who is anointed and who is consecrated to be priest in his father’s place, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments.

paite: Siampute leh mipihon a ding in kilemna abawl nawn lai ding hi.
english: Then he shall make atonement for the Holy Sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.

paite: Akhelhna tengteng uh ziak a kum chih a khatvei Israel suante a dia kilemna bawl na tangtawn dan thuseh ding uh ahi," achi hi. Huchi in TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in Mosi in ahihta hi.
english: “This shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins.” It was done as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Aaron leh atapate leh Israel suan tengteng houpih inla, akiang uah: Hiai TOUPA thupiak ahi:
english: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded:

paite: Israel inkote lak a mi bawngtal hiam, belamnou hiam, kel hiam giahphual hiam, giahphual polam hiam a gou a,
english: Whatever man there is of the house of Israel who kills a bull, or lamb, or goat in the camp, or who kills it outside the camp,

paite: TOUPA biakbuk ma a TOUPA a dia athillat dia kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul a hon tawi lou peuhmah, huai mi sisan suah a ngaih ahi ding; sisan suah ngei ahi, huai mi achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
english: and hasn’t brought it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to offer it as an offering to Yahweh before Yahweh’s tabernacle: blood shall be imputed to that man. He has shed blood. That man shall be cut off from among his people.

paite: Hiai pen Israel suante'n akithoihnate uh, gamlak a kithoihnate uh ahon lak ua, TOUPA a ding ngei a kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul a, siampu kiang a, ahon tawi ua, TOUPA a dia lemna thillat kithoihna ahihtheihna ding ahi.
english: This is to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, that they may bring them to Yahweh, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, to the priest, and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace offerings to Yahweh.

paite: Siampu in kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul a maitam, sisan in atheh dia, TOUPA a ding in gimlimtak in athau ahal ding ahi.
english: The priest shall sprinkle the blood on Yahweh’s altar at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and burn the fat for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: A-angkawmna uh dawite kiang ah akithoih nawn ding uh ahi kei. Hiai asuante uh tan a tangtawn a dia dan thuseh ahi.
english: They shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices to the goat idols, after which they play the prostitute. This shall be a statute forever to them throughout their generations.’

paite: "Akiang uah, Israel inkomi himhim hiam, gamdangmi alak ua tengte hiam in halmang thillat hiam, kithoihna hiam,
english: “You shall say to them, ‘Any man there is of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,

paite: TOUPA kiang a kithoihna dia kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul a hon tawi lou a-omleh huai mi achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
english: and doesn’t bring it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to Yahweh, that man shall be cut off from his people.

paite: "Kuapeuh Israel inkote lak a mi hiam, gamdangmi alak ua teng hiam, bang sisan leng ne peuhmah, huai sisan nemi tung ah ka mai ka gumsak dia, achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ahi ding hi.
english: “‘Any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who eats any kind of blood, I will set my face against that soul who eats blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

paite: Sa hinna pen sisan a a-om ziak in, na hinna ua dia kilemna bawlna ding a maitam tung a nou ka hon piak ahi. Hinna ding a kilemna bawlna pen sisan mah lah ahi ngal a.
english: For the life of the flesh is in the blood. I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your souls; for it is the blood that makes atonement by reason of the life.

paite: Huaiziak in Israel suante kiang ah, kuamah in sisan na ne ding uh ahi kei. Gamdangmi na lak ua teng in leng sisan a ne ding ahi kei, ka chi ahi.
english: Therefore I have said to the children of Israel, “No person among you may eat blood, nor may any stranger who lives as a foreigner among you eat blood.”

paite: "Israel suante lak a mi hiam, gamdangmi alak ua teng hiam, gam va vak a, sa hiam, vasa hiam, nek theih chi ahon tutleh asisan apawtsak dia, leivui in asisan avuk ding ahi.
english: “‘Whatever man there is of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who takes in hunting any animal or bird that may be eaten, he shall pour out its blood, and cover it with dust.

paite: Sa tengteng hinna thu ah asisan leh ahinna kibang geih ahi. Huaiziak in Israel suante kiang ah, sa sisan mawngmawng na ne ding uh ahi kei, sa tengteng hinna asisan ahi ngal a. Hiai ne peuhmah satkhiak ahi ding.
english: For as to the life of all flesh, its blood is with its life. Therefore I said to the children of Israel, “You shall not eat the blood of any kind of flesh; for the life of all flesh is its blood. Whoever eats it shall be cut off.”

paite: "Amah sih a si hiam, sa keihlup hiam nemi, huai gam a mi hiam leng hi hen aw, apuan uh asawp ding ua, akisil ding uh ahi. Nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding uh. Huchi in nitaklam in ahong siangta ding uh.
english: “‘Every person that eats what dies of itself, or that which is torn by animals, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening. Then he shall be clean.

paite: Asawp louh ua, akisil kei uleh athulimlouhna moh akipuak ding uh," achi hi.
english: But if he doesn’t wash them, or bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.’”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh said to Moses,

paite: "Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, 'Kei TOUPA, na Pathian uh ka hi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am Yahweh your God.

paite: Na omna masa uh Aigupta gam mite hih bang in hih kei unla, ka hon pilutna ding Kanaan gam mite dan thusehte bang in leng hih kei un.
english: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived. You shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. You shall not follow their statutes.

paite: Ka vaihawmte na zui ding ua, ka dan thusehte zui in na mang ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
english: You shall do my ordinances. You shall keep my statutes and walk in them. I am Yahweh your God.

paite: Huaiziak in ka dan leh ka vaihawmte na mang ding uh ahi, huai mi'n ahihleh ahing ding hi. Kei TOUPA ka hi,' achi hi.
english: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am Yahweh.

paite: "Kuamah in na tanau nai numei, avuaktanna lem ding in na zuan ding ahi kei. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘None of you shall approach any close relatives, to uncover their nakedness: I am Yahweh.

paite: Na pa vuaktanna ahihkeileh na nu vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei. Na nu ahi a, avuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei hi.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, nor the nakedness of your mother: she is your mother. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

paite: Na pa zi vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei, na pa vuaktanna ahi.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife. It is your father’s nakedness.

paite: Na sanggamnu, na pa tanu hiam na nu tanu hiam, na pianpih hiam, na pianpih louh hiam vuaktanna leng na lem ding ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, whether born at home or born abroad.

paite: Na tapa tanu hiam, na tanu, tanu hiam vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei. Avuaktanna uh nang vuaktanna ahi ngal a.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness; for theirs is your own nakedness.

paite: Na pa zi tanu, na pa suan vuaktanna, na sanggamnu ahi, avuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, conceived by your father, since she is your sister.

paite: Na pa sanggamnu vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei. Na pa tanaunu nai ahi.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister. She is your father’s near kinswoman.

paite: Na nu sanggamnu vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei, na nu tanaunu nai ahi ngal a.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.

paite: Na pa sanggam vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei, azi na zuan ding ahi kei, amah na nu ahi.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother. You shall not approach his wife. She is your aunt.

paite: Na mounu vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei. Na tapa zi ahi a, avuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

paite: Na sanggampa zi vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei. Na sanggampa vuaktanna ahi.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife. It is your brother’s nakedness.

paite: Nutate vuaktanna na lem ding uh ahi kei. Avuaktanna lem ding in atapa tanu hiam, atanu tanu hiam na la ding ahi kei. Na tanau naite ahi ua; gitlouhna lianpi ahi.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness. They are near kinswomen. It is wickedness.

paite: Na zi adam lai teng, asanggamnu vuaktanna lem ding in na zi in na nei ding ahi kei hi.
english: “‘You shall not take a wife in addition to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is still alive.

paite: "Numei anitdan ngeina a, anit sung in avuaktanna lem ding in na zuan ding ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.

paite: Alak a kihihnin ding in na invengpa zi na kithuahpih ding ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.

paite: Molek a dia mei a lutsuaksak ding in na gil a gah himhim na pe ding ahi kei, na Pathian min na hihse ding ahi sam kei. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘You shall not give any of your children as a sacrifice to Molech. You shall not profane the name of your God. I am Yahweh.

paite: Numei bang in pasal na kithuahpih ding ahi kei. Thilkihhuai ahi.
english: “‘You shall not lie with a man as with a woman. That is detestable.

paite: Kihihnin ding in ganta himhim na kithuahpih ding ahi kei. Luppih ding in ganta ma ah numei adin ding ahi kei. Gitlouhna tungtuan ahi.
english: “‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. No woman may give herself to an animal, to lie down with it: it is a perversion.

paite: "Hiaite ah, abangmah ah kihihnin kei un. Hiai thil tengteng ah na ma ua ka delhkhiak khitsa namte ana nin khinta uhi.
english: “‘Don’t defile yourselves in any of these things; for in all these the nations which I am casting out before you were defiled.

paite: Agam leng anin khinta hi. Huaiziak in athulimlouhnate uh ziak in amau ka gawt a, gam in asung a teng mite alokhe khin vek hi.
english: The land was defiled. Therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.

paite: Huaiziak in nou zaw ka dante, ka vaihawmte na zui ding uh ahi. Hiai thilkihhuaite na hih ding uh ahi kei; na gam ua mi himhim hiam, gamdangmi na lak ua tengte hiam in leng.
english: You therefore shall keep my statutes and my ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the native-born, nor the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you

paite: Hiai thilkihhuai tengteng na ma ua hiai gam a omte'n ana hih khin ua, gam mah leng anin khinta hi;
english: (for the men of the land that were before you had done all these abominations, and the land became defiled),

paite: na ma ua om nam aluakkhiak mah bang a na hihnit ua, gam in ahon luakkhiaklouhna ding in.
english: that the land not vomit you out also, when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.

paite: Kuapeuh hiai thilkihhuaite lak a khatpeuh hihmi achipihte a pan satkhiak ahi ding.
english: “‘For whoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.

paite: "Huaiziak in hiai thilkihhuai na ma ua omte'n achin bang uh na chin samlouhna ding un leh huai a na kihihnitlouhna ding un ka thuseh na zui ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi," achi hi.
english: Therefore you shall keep my requirements, that you do not practice any of these abominable customs which were practiced before you, and that you do not defile yourselves with them. I am Yahweh your God.’”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suan mipi omkhawmte tengteng houpih inla, akiang uah, 'Na siangthou ding uh ahi, Kei, TOUPA na Pathian uh ka siangthou ngal a.
english: “Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I, Yahweh your God, am holy.

paite: "Israel suan mipi omkhawmte tengteng houpih inla, akiang uah, 'Na siangthou ding uh ahi, Kei, TOUPA na Pathian uh ka siangthou ngal a.
english: “‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am Yahweh your God.

paite: "Milim lam ah kihei kei unla, sunthoh milimte leng kibawltawm kei un. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
english: “‘Don’t turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I am Yahweh your God.

paite: "TOUPA a dia kilemna thillat na lat chiang un noumau deihtelna a na lat ding uh ahi.
english: “‘When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.

paite: Na lat ni mah uh ahihkeileh azing a na nek ding uh ahi. Ani thum ni tan a, aval a-om laileh mei a na hal ding uh ahi.
english: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day. If anything remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.

paite: Ani thum ni tan a nek ahihleh thilkihhuai ahi a; pomsak ahi kei ding hi.
english: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination. It will not be accepted;

paite: Ane kuapeuh in TOUPA sianthouna ahihnit ziak in athulimlouhna moh akipuak dia, huai mi achipihte a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
english: but everyone who eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the holy thing of Yahweh, and that soul shall be cut off from his people.

paite: "Na lou ua buh na lak chiang un, lounawl zulte tan in na la vek ding uh ahi kei. Asang leng na zong ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.

paite: Na grephuan uah asang na zong ding uh ahi kei. Na grephuan ua agah kia leng na tomkhawm ding uh ahi kei. Mizawng leh gamdangmi a ding in na hawisak ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
english: You shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard. You shall leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am Yahweh your God.

paite: "Na gu ding uh ahi kei. Atak lou in thil na hih ding ahi kei. Zuau na kihilhtuah ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall not steal. “‘You shall not lie. “‘You shall not deceive one another.

paite: Na Pathian min hemsak ding in ka min in dikloutak in na kichiam ding uh ahi kei. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘You shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of your God. I am Yahweh.

paite: "Na invengte na khem ding ahi kei. Na guksak ding leng ahi kei. Kilohmi loh zankhua in azingsang tan in na kem ding ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him. “‘The wages of a hired servant shall not remain with you all night until the morning.

paite: Nangong na hamsiat ding ahi kei. Mittaw ma ah apukna ding na koih ding ahi kei. Na Pathian na lauh ding ahi. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind; but you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.

paite: "Vaihawmna ah diktat loutak in thu na khen ding ahi kei. Mizawng na simmoh tuam ding ahi kei hi. Mi thilhihthei na zahtak tuam ding ahi kei. Himahleh diktattak in na invengte vai na hawmsak ding ahi.
english: “‘You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not be partial to the poor, nor show favoritism to the great; but you shall judge your neighbor in righteousness.

paite: Na chipihte lak ah migensia in na vialvak ding ahi kei. Na invengte sisan thu ah ahilou lam in na pang ding ahi kei. TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people. “‘You shall not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am Yahweh.

paite: "Na lungtang in na unau na ho ding ahi kei. Na invengte na taihilh ngeingei ding ahi. Na huchihleh agitlouhna ah na siang ding hi.
english: “‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.

paite: Phu na la ding ahi kei. Na chipihte suante huatna na pai ding ahi kei. Nang na ki-it bang in na invengte na it ding ahi. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am Yahweh.

paite: "Ka thupiakte na zui ding uh ahi. Na ganta chi tuamtuam suangsak ke'n. Na lou ah haichi chi nih chingkhawm ke'n. Thil chituam nih gatpolh puan na silh ding ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall keep my statutes. “‘You shall not cross-breed different kinds of animals. “‘You shall not sow your field with two kinds of seed; “‘Don’t wear a garment made of two kinds of material.

paite: "Kuapeuh sikhanu, apasal ding khamsa nei, tat nai louh, khahkhiak nai louh pasal dang toh lumkhawm peuhmah gawt ding ahi. Himahleh hihlup ding bel ahi kei, amah zalen ahih louh ziak in.
english: “‘If a man lies carnally with a woman who is a slave girl, pledged to be married to another man, and not ransomed or given her freedom; they shall be punished. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin kongpi bul ah TOUPA kiang ah atatlekna thoihna ding in belampa ahon kaih ding ahi.
english: He shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, even a ram for a trespass offering.

paite: Athilhihkhelhsa, akhelhna ah TOUPA ma ah tatlek thoihna belampa in siampu in kilemna abawlsak dia; huchi in athilhihkhelhsa ngaihdam ahi ding.
english: The priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before Yahweh for his sin which he has committed; and the sin which he has committed shall be forgiven him.

paite: "Gam na va luah ua, nek dia theikung chi chih na suan hun un agah siang lou in na ngai ding uh. Nou a ding in kum thum siang lou a ngaih ding ahi a, nek het louh ding ahi.
english: “‘When you come into the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as forbidden. For three years it shall be forbidden to you. It shall not be eaten.

paite: Himahleh, akum lina ah agah teng TOUPA phatna ding in amah a dia sehtuam ahi ding hi.
english: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, for giving praise to Yahweh.

paite: Akum ngana ah nou a dia apun zel theihna ding in agah na ne ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
english: In the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, that it may yield its increase to you. I am Yahweh your God.

paite: "Asisan toh khatpeuh na ne ding uh ahi kei. Bum ching in ai na san ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it. You shall not use enchantments, nor practice sorcery.

paite: Na baknel a pan akimvel in na lu na met ding ahi kei. Na khamul lang tuak leng na tan ding ahi sam kei.
english: “‘You shall not cut the hair on the sides of your head or clip off the edge of your beard.

paite: Misi ziak in na sa uh na atkeh ding uh ahi kei. Na satung ua gelh in chiamtehna na gelh ding uh ahi kei. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you. I am Yahweh.

paite: "Na tanu kizuaksak ke'n. Gam angkawmna gam ahong suak kha dia, gitlouhna in ahong dim kha ding hi.
english: “‘Don’t profane your daughter, to make her a prostitute; lest the land fall to prostitution, and the land become full of wickedness.

paite: Ka Sabbathte na tan ding uh ahi. Ka mun siangthou na zahtak ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am Yahweh.

paite: "Dawi aisan siamte zuan kei unla, bumsiamte leng ahon nitsak-louhna ding un zongkhe kei un. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘Don’t turn to those who are mediums, nor to the wizards. Don’t seek them out, to be defiled by them. I am Yahweh your God.

paite: "Lu a kelsam poute ma ah dingh in. Tek omna na zahtak in. Na Pathian lau in. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.

paite: "Gamdangmi, na gam ua ana teng a-omleh na hihsiat louh ding uh ahi.
english: “‘If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.

paite: Gamdangmi na lak ua tengte bel nou a ding in na gam ua mi bang ahi ding ua, nangmah na ki-it bang in amah na it ding ahi. Nou leng Aigupta gam ah gamdangmi na hi ngeita uhi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
english: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.

paite: "Vaihawm thu ah, tehna chiang ah, gikdan ah leh saudan tehna ah diktatloupi in na hih ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.

paite: Bukna dik, gikdan dik, ephah dik, hin dik na nei ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh Aigupta gam a pan nou hon pikhepa ka hi.
english: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

paite: Ka thupiak tengteng leh ka vaihawm tengteng na pom ding ua, na zuih ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA ka hi,” achi hi.
english: “‘You shall observe all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them. I am Yahweh.’”

paite: “Huan kuapeuh in TOUPA kiang a thillat, tangbuang thillat alat chiang in, athillat tangbuang nel dimdem ahi ding ahi. Sathau abuak dia, atung ah begaw akoih lai ding ahi”.
english: “‘When anyone offers an offering of a meal offering to Yahweh, his offering shall be of fine flour. He shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it.

paite: Aaron tapa siampute kiang ah apaipih dia; ama'n apham khat in huai a tangbuang nel dimdem, asathau toh, abegaw tengteng toh alakhe ding a, siampu in maitam tung ah theihgigena, TOUPA a dia gimlimtak, mei a thillat ding in ahal ding hi.
english: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests. He shall take his handful of its fine flour, and of its oil, with all its frankincense, and the priest shall burn its memorial on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Tangbuang thillat bangte Aaron leh atapate a ding ahi ding. Huai TOUPA a dia mei a thillatte a thil siangthoupen ahi.
english: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire.

paite: “Tangbuang thillat, akanna a kan thillat na latleh, tangbuang nel dimdem, sathau a mek silngou soh louh tanghou hiam, sathau a zut, silngou soh louh tanghou pei hiam ahi ding ahi”.
english: “‘When you offer an offering of a meal offering baked in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

paite: “Na thillat, kuang a kan tangbuang thillat ahihleh, silngou soh louh, sathau a mek, tangbuang nel dimdem ahi ding hi”.
english: If your offering is a meal offering made on a griddle, it shall be of unleavened fine flour, mixed with oil.

paite: Na phelkhap ding a, sathau a na buah ding ahi. Huai tangbuang thillat ahi.
english: You shall cut it in pieces, and pour oil on it. It is a meal offering.

paite: “Na thillat kan bel a kan, tang- buang thillat ahihleh tangbuang nel dimdem leh sathau a bawl ahi ding hi”.
english: If your offering is a meal offering of the pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

paite: Hiai thil a bawl tangbuang thillat TOUPA kiang ah na hon tawi dia; siampu kiang a lat ahi dia, ama'n maitam ah hon paipih ding hi.
english: You shall bring the meal offering that is made of these things to Yahweh. It shall be presented to the priest, and he shall bring it to the altar.

paite: Siampu in tangbuang thillat a pan theihgigena pen alakhe dia, maitam ah ahal ding. Hiai TOUPA a dia gimlimtak, mei a thillat ahi.
english: The priest shall take from the meal offering its memorial, and shall burn it on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Tangbuang thillat lat bangte Aaron leh atapate atuam ding ahi dia; hiai TOUPA a dia mei a thillatte lak a siangthoupen ahi.
english: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire.

paite: "Tangbuang thillat himhim, TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh silngou soh a bawl ding ahi kei. TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ah silngou hiam, khuaizu himhim na hel ding uh ahi kei”.
english: “‘No meal offering which you shall offer to Yahweh shall be made with yeast; for you shall burn no yeast, nor any honey, as an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Gah masapen thillat bang in TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding ua; gimlim dia maitam akoih ding ahi kei hi.
english: As an offering of first fruits you shall offer them to Yahweh, but they shall not rise up as a pleasant aroma on the altar.

paite: Na tangbuang thillat ah na Pathian thukhun chi na maih ding ahi kei. Na thillat tengteng ah chi na lat tel ding ahi.
english: Every offering of your meal offering you shall season with salt. You shall not allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be lacking from your meal offering. With all your offerings you shall offer salt.

paite: Gah masapen tangbuang thillat TOUPA kiang a na latleh na buh thak masapente, tangbuang thillat ding in tanghou pek na lan ding ahi.
english: “‘If you offer a meal offering of first fruits to Yahweh, you shall offer for the meal offering of your first fruits fresh heads of grain parched with fire and crushed.

paite: Sathau na buak dia, atung ah begaw na koih ding ahi,
english: You shall put oil on it and lay frankincense on it. It is a meal offering.

paite: siampu in huai theihgigena, buh sukzan bangzah hiam toh begaw tengteng toh ahal ding ahi. Hiai TOUPA a dia amei a thillat ahi.
english: The priest shall burn as its memorial part of its crushed grain and part of its oil, along with all its frankincense. It is an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante kiang ah, kuapeuh, Israel suante lak a mi hiam, Israel gam a teng gamdangmi hiam, agil a gah Molek pe peuhmah hihlup ngeingei ding ahi. Hiai gam a mi teng in suang in adenglum ding uhi.
english: “Moreover, you shall tell the children of Israel, ‘Anyone of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners in Israel, who gives any of his offspring to Molech shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone that person with stones.

paite: Ka mun siangthou leh ka min siangthou hihnin ding a, agilgah khenkhat Molek kiang a apiak ziak in huai mi tung ah ka mai ka gumsak dia, achipihte lak a pan ka satkhe ding hi.
english: I also will set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people, because he has given of his offspring to Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

paite: Hiai gam a mite'n agil a gah Molek kiang a piak akitheihmohbawl ua, ahihlup kei uleh,
english: If the people of the land all hide their eyes from that person when he gives of his offspring to Molech, and don’t put him to death,

paite: amah leh a-inkote tung ah ka mai ka gumsak dia, Molek kiang a kei hon ang kawmsan peuhmahte toh achipihte uh lak a pan ka satkhe ding hi.
english: then I will set my face against that man and against his family, and will cut him off, and all who play the prostitute after him to play the prostitute with Molech, from among their people.

paite: "Alak ua angkawm dia dawi aisan siamte leh bumsiamte zuan mi tung ah ka mai ka gumsak dia; achipihte lak a pan ka satkhe ding hi.
english: “‘The person that turns to those who are mediums and wizards, to play the prostitute after them, I will even set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people.

paite: Huaiziak in kihihsiangthou unla, siangthou in om un. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi ngal a.
english: “‘Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am Yahweh your God.

paite: Ka thupiakte pom in na zui ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA noute hon hihsiangthoupa ka hi.
english: You shall keep my statutes, and do them. I am Yahweh who sanctifies you.

paite: "Anu hiam, apa hiam hamsiat-khum peuhmah hihlup ngeingei ding ahi. Anu hiam, apa hiam hamsiatkhum ahi a, atung ah asisan moh a-om ding ahi.
english: “‘For everyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother. His blood shall be upon himself.

paite: "Mi zi angkawm, a-invengte zi angkawm zaw, a-angkawmpa leh a-angkawmnu, anih ua hihlup ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “‘The man who commits adultery with another man’s wife, even he who commits adultery with his neighbor’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

paite: Apa zi kithuahpih in apa vuaktanna lem ahi a; hihlup tuaktuak ding ahi. Asisan moh atung uah a-om ding hi.
english: “‘The man who lies with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both of them shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

paite: Mi'n amounu akithuahpihleh hihlup tuaktuak ding ahi. Tatsiatna tungtuan hih ahi ua, asisan moh atung uah a-om ding hi.
english: “‘If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death. They have committed a perversion. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

paite: Mi'n numei akithuahpih bang a pasal akithuahpihleh thilkihhuai mahmah hihtuak ahi ua, hihlup ngeingei ding ahi. Asisan moh atung uah a-om ding hi.
english: “‘If a man lies with a male, as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

paite: Mi'n nuta zi in nei leh gitlouhna ahi. Na lak ua thulimlouhna a-omlouhna ding in amah leh nutate mei a hallup ding ahi.
english: “‘If a man takes a wife and her mother, it is wickedness. They shall be burned with fire, both he and they, that there may be no wickedness among you.

paite: Mi'n ganta akithuahpihleh hihlup ngeingei ding ahi. Ganta leng hihlup ding ahi.
english: “‘If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal.

paite: Numei in ganta ava naih a, akithuahpihsakleh huai numei na hihlup ngeingei ding uh ahi. Ganta leng hihlup ngeingei ding ahi a; asisan moh atung uah a-om ding hi.
english: “‘If a woman approaches any animal and lies with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon them.

paite: "Mi'n asanggamnu, apa tanu hiam, anu tanu hiam akitenpih a, avuaktanna amuh a, ama'n leng avuaktanna amuhleh thil gilou hih ahi ua, amite mitmuh a satkhiak ding ahi uh. Asanggamnu vuaktanna lem ahi a, atatlekna moh apo ding hi.
english: “‘If a man takes his sister—his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter—and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness, it is a shameful thing. They shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people. He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness. He shall bear his iniquity.

paite: Mi'n numei akha teng si neih aneih lai a, akithuahpih a, avuaktanna alemleh asi pawtna lem ahi a, ama'n leng asi pawtna lem ahi a, achipihte ua pan anih ua satkhiak ding ahi.
english: “‘If a man lies with a woman having her monthly period, and uncovers her nakedness, he has made her fountain naked, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood. Both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

paite: "Na nu sanggamnu hiam, na pa sanggamnu hiam vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei. Asanggam nai vuaktanna lem ahi a, agitlouhna moh apo ding.
