english: The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of sweet incense before Yahweh, which is in the Tent of Meeting; and he shall pour out the rest of the blood of the bull at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Khelh thoihna bawng thau tengteng, asungkua thau leh agilbom teng leng ala vek dia;
english: He shall take all the fat of the bull of the sin offering from it: the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

paite: akal nihte leh aphuk chin a om, atuamthau leh asin tuam alam, akal nihte nangawn toh asuah ding ahi.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall remove,

paite: Lemna thillat kithoihna bawngtal a kipan alak bang in, siampu in halmang thillat maitam ah ahal ding ahi.
english: as it is removed from the bull of the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.

paite: Bawngvunte, asa tengtengte, alu toh, akhete toh, asungkuate, a-ekte,
english: He shall carry the bull’s skin, all its meat, with its head, and with its legs, its innards, and its dung

paite: abawng pumpi toh giahphual polam mun siang ah, vut paihna ah apaipih dia, sing tung ah ahal ding, vut paihna ahal ding ahi,' achi hi.
english: —all the rest of the bull—outside of the camp to a clean place where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire. It shall be burned where the ashes are poured out.

paite: "Israel omkhawm tengteng in ahihkhelh khak ua, mipi mitmuh a sel ahih a, TOUPA'N hih louh ding a thu apiakte, abang mahmah ahih ua,
english: “‘If the whole congregation of Israel sins, and the thing is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, and are guilty;

paite: siam louh atan ua, athil gilou hih uh theihkhiak ahihleh, mipi in khelh thoihna ding in bawngtuai alan ding ua, kihoupihna biakbuk kong ah ahon kai ding uhi.
english: when the sin in which they have sinned is known, then the assembly shall offer a young bull for a sin offering, and bring it before the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Upa omkhawmte'n TOUPA ma ah bawng lutung ah akhut uh akoih ding ua; TOUPA ma a huai bawng goh ding ahi.
english: The elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before Yahweh; and the bull shall be killed before Yahweh.

paite: Thaunilh siampu in kihoupihna biakbuk ah bawng sisan bangzah hiam ahon tawi ding hi.
english: The anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the bull to the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Siampu in huai sisan ah akhutzung adiah dia, puanzak bul ah TOUPA ma ah sagihvei atheh ding hi.
english: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before Yahweh, before the veil.

paite: Sisan pen kihoupihna biakbuk a TOUPA ma ah maitam kii ah tam lou atat dia, sisan tengteng kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi kiang a halmang thillat maitam bul ah asungkhe ding ahi.
english: He shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before Yahweh, that is in the Tent of Meeting; and the rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Athau tengteng ala vek dia, maitam ah ahal ding.
english: All its fat he shall take from it, and burn it on the altar.

paite: Huchibang in bawng pen ahih dia; khelh thoihna bawng ahih bang geih in hiai leng ahih ding ahi. Huchi in siampu in kilemna abawl ding a, ngaihdam ahi ding uhi.
english: He shall do this with the bull; as he did with the bull of the sin offering, so he shall do with this; and the priest shall make atonement for them, and they shall be forgiven.

paite: Huai bawng giahphual pua ah apaipih dia, bawng masa ahal bang in ahal ding hi. Hiai mipi a dia khelh thoihna ahi.
english: He shall carry the bull outside the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bull. It is the sin offering for the assembly.

paite: "Vaihawmtu in thil ahihkhelh a, TOUPA a Pathian in hih louh ding a thu apiakte abang pen hiam ahihkhak a, siam louh atan a,
english: “‘When a ruler sins, and unwittingly does any one of all the things which Yahweh his God has commanded not to be done, and is guilty,

paite: athil gilou hih atheihleh athillat ding in kelpa gensiatbei ahon kai ding ahi.
english: if his sin in which he has sinned is made known to him, he shall bring as his offering a goat, a male without defect.

paite: Kel lutung ah akhut akoih dia, TOUPA ma ah halmang thillat agoh zelna uah agou ding hi”. Hiai khelh thoihna ahi.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before Yahweh. It is a sin offering.

paite: Siampu in khelh thoihna sisan akhutzung in tam lou ala dia, maitam kiite ah halmang thillat atat dia, halmang thillat maitam bul ah asisan asungkhe ding hi.
english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering. He shall pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.

paite: Athau tengteng, lemna thillat kithoihna thau ahal bang in maitam ah ahal ding ahi. Huchi in akhelhna tungthu ah siampu in kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
english: All its fat he shall burn on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin, and he will be forgiven.

paite: "Vantang lak a mi, akuamah mah in TOUPA'N hih louh ding a thu apiakte abangmah hihkhial in, siam louh na tangleh,
english: “‘If anyone of the common people sins unwittingly, in doing any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, and is guilty,

paite: athil gilou hih atheihleh athillat ding in kelnu gensiatbei, athilhihkhelhsa khelh thoihna ding in ahon kai ding hi”.
english: if his sin which he has sinned is made known to him, then he shall bring for his offering a goat, a female without defect, for his sin which he has sinned.

paite: "Khelh thoihna lutung ah akhut akoih dia, halmang thillatna mun ah khelh thoihna agou ding hi”.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering.

paite: Siampu in asisan, akhutzung in tam lou ala dia, halmang thillat maitam kiite ah atat dia, asisan tengteng maitam bul ah asungkhe ding hi.
english: The priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

paite: Athau tengteng lemna thillat kithoihna thau alak bang in ala vek ding hi. Siampu in TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in maitam ah ahal ding ahi. Huchi in siampu in kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
english: All its fat he shall take away, like the fat is taken away from the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.

paite: "Khelh thoihna dia athillat ding belamnou ahon tawileh, anu, gensiatbei ahon tawi ding ahi”.
english: “‘If he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring a female without defect.

paite: Khelh thoihna lutung ah akhut akoih dia, halmang thillat agohna uah khelhna thoihna ding in agou ding hi.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.

paite: Siampu in khelh thoihna sisan akhutzung in tam lou ala dia, halmang thillat maitam kiite ah atat dia, sisan tengteng maitam bul ah asungkhe ding hi.
english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and all the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

paite: Athau tengteng, belamnou thau, lemna thillat kithoihna alak bang in ala vek ding a, siampu in TOUPA a dia mei a thillat bang in maitam ah ahal ding ahi. Huchi in siampu in athilhihkhelhsa tungthu ah kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
english: He shall remove all its fat, like the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar, on the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned, and he will be forgiven.

paite: "Huan kuapeuh athil muh hiam, athil zak hiam a dia theihpih ahih a, kichiamsakmi aw azak a leng gen nuam lou a, thil ahihkhelhleh athulimlouhna moh apo ding”.
english: “‘If anyone sins, in that he hears a public adjuration to testify, he being a witness, whether he has seen or known, if he doesn’t report it, then he shall bear his iniquity.

paite: "Kuapeuh in thilsiang lou himhim, gamsa siang lou luang hiam, gan siang lou luang hiam, avakthoh ganhing siang lou luang hiam thei lou a, akhoihkhakleh, siang lou leh mohtang ahi ding hi”.
english: “‘Or if anyone touches any unclean thing, whether it is the carcass of an unclean animal, or the carcass of unclean livestock, or the carcass of unclean creeping things, and it is hidden from him, and he is unclean, then he shall be guilty.

paite: "Mihing leng asianlouhna bangpeuh hi hen aw, asianlouhna thei lou a, akhoihleh atheihkhiak hun in siam louh atang ding hi”.
english: “‘Or if he touches the uncleanness of man, whatever his uncleanness is with which he is unclean, and it is hidden from him; when he knows of it, then he shall be guilty.

paite: "Kuapeuh in thil hoih lou hiam, thil hoih hiam hih dia, akam a thei lou a, akichiam zialzialleh, akoi abang hitaleh, akichiam zialzialna atheihkhiak hun in siam louh atang ding hi”.
english: “‘Or if anyone swears rashly with his lips to do evil or to do good—whatever it is that a man might utter rashly with an oath, and it is hidden from him—when he knows of it, then he will be guilty of one of these.

paite: "Huan hichi ahi ding a, hiai thilte khat a leng siam louh atan chiang in akhelhna apuang ding ahi.
english: It shall be, when he is guilty of one of these, he shall confess that in which he has sinned;

paite: Khelh thoihna ding in belamhon lak ah anu, belamnou hiam kel hiam, athilhihkhelhsa man ding in TOUPA kiang a lat ding in khelhna thoihna ahon tawi dia; siampu in akhelh tungthu ah kilemna abawlsak ding ahi”.
english: and he shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh for his sin which he has sinned: a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin.

paite: "Aneih in belamnou achin zoh keileh TOUPA kiang a lat ding in akhelh man ding in akhelh thoihna ding in vakhu nih hiam, vapalnou hiam ahon tawi ding ahi. Khat, khelh thoihna ding in, akhat pen halmang thillat ding in.
english: “‘If he can’t afford a lamb, then he shall bring his trespass offering for that in which he has sinned, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, to Yahweh; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

paite: Siampu kiang ah ahon tawi dia, ama'n khelh thoihna ding in alan masa dia, phelkhap lou in angawng ah alu ahektan ding hi.
english: He shall bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one which is for the sin offering. He shall wring off its head from its neck, but shall not sever it completely.

paite: Khelh thoihna sisan maitam pang ah tam lou atheh dia, asisan om lai teng maitam bul ah atakkangsak ding hi. Hiai khelh thoihna ahi.
english: He shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

paite: Akhat pen dan dungzui in halmang thillat ding in alan dia; siampu in athilhihkhelhsa tungthu ah lemna abawlsak dia”, ngaihdam ahi ding.
english: He shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has sinned, and he shall be forgiven.

paite: "Himahleh vakhu nih hiam, vapalnou nih hiam aneih zoh keileh akhelh man thillat ding leh khelh thoihna ding in tangbuang nel dimdem, ephah mun sawm a khen mun khat ahon tawi ding hi. Sathau a buak ding ahi kei a, atung ah begaw akoih ding ahi kei; khelh thoihna ahih ziak in.
english: “‘But if he can’t afford two turtledoves or two young pigeons, then he shall bring as his offering for that in which he has sinned, one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering. He shall put no oil on it, and he shall not put any frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering.

paite: Siampu kiang ah ahon tawi dia, siampu in theihgigena ding in apham khat ala dia, maitam tung ah TOUPA a ding in mei a thillat bang in ahal ding ahi. Hiai tatlek thoihna ahi.
english: He shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as the memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, on the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. It is a sin offering.

paite: Huai thillak a abangmah leng ahihkhelhsa tungtang thu ah siampu in kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding. A-om lai teng tangbuang thillat bangmah in siampu tantuam ahi ding," achi hi.
english: The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned in any of these things, and he will be forgiven; and the rest shall be the priest’s, as the meal offering.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Kuapeuh in thil ahihkhelh a, TOUPA thil siangthoute tung a akhelh khakleh, akhelh thoihna, belamhon lak a belampa gensiatbei, Mun siangthou shekel bang in, dangka shekel bangzah hiam gun a ngaih, tatlek kithoihna ding in TOUPA a ding in ahon kai ding ahi.
english: “If anyone commits a trespass, and sins unwittingly regarding Yahweh’s holy things, then he shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation in silver by shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering.

paite: Thil siangthou tung a ana hihdiklouh khitsa pen adin dia, amun nga a khen mun khat abehlap dia, siampu ape ding ahi. Huchi in siampu in tatlek thoihna belampa in kilemna abawlsak dia”, ngaihdam ahi ding.
english: He shall make restitution for that which he has done wrong regarding the holy thing, and shall add a fifth part to it, and give it to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and he will be forgiven.

paite: "Kuapeuh in thil ahihkhelh a, hih louh dia TOUPA'N thu apiakte khatpeuh ahihleh, thei kei mahleh siam louh atang himhim dia, athulimlouhna moh apo ding ahi.
english: “If anyone sins, doing any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, though he didn’t know it, he is still guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

paite: Belamhon lak a belampa gensiatbei, aman kilawm hun, tatlek thoihna ding in siampu kiang ah ahon kai ding ahi. Siampu in theiloupi a hihkhelh khak tungthu ah kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding.
english: He shall bring a ram without defect from of the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the thing in which he sinned and didn’t know it, and he will be forgiven.

paite: Hiai tatlek thoihna ahi a; TOUPA ma ah talek mah ahi," achi hi.
english: It is a trespass offering. He is certainly guilty before Yahweh.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Kuapeuh in thil hihkhial in, TOUPA thu kalh in talek taleh, sum kepsak thu ah hiam, lep thu ah hiam, guktak thu ah hiam a-invengte khem in, a-invengte zuaubawl taleh,
english: “If anyone sins, and commits a trespass against Yahweh, and deals falsely with his neighbor in a matter of deposit, or of bargain, or of robbery, or has oppressed his neighbor,

paite: ahihkeileh, vanmangte mu in, khem in, zuau in kichiam taleh, hiai thil tengteng akhatpeuh leng hihkhial taleh,
english: or has found that which was lost, and lied about it, and swearing to a lie—in any of these things that a man sins in his actions—

paite: hichi ahi ding a, akhial ngei ahih a, siam louh atanleh avan gukte, khem a athillakte, akiang a kepsak sumte, vanmang atopte,
english: then it shall be, if he has sinned, and is guilty, he shall restore that which he took by robbery, or the thing which he has gotten by oppression, or the deposit which was committed to him, or the lost thing which he found,

paite: zuau a kichiamna thil bangpeuh leng adit nawn ding ahi. Akim sipsip in adin nawn vek ding a, amun nga a khen mun khat val in abehlap ding. Siam louh atan ni in aneitu ape ding ahi.
english: or any thing about which he has sworn falsely: he shall restore it in full, and shall add a fifth part more to it. He shall return it to him to whom it belongs in the day of his being found guilty.

paite: Atatlek thoihna, belamhon lak a, aman kilawm hun, belampa gensiatbei tatlek thoihna ding in TOUPA a ding in siampu kiang ah ahon kai ding ahi.
english: He shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh: a ram without defect from the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest.

paite: Siampu in TOUPA ma ah kilemna abawlsak ding a, siam louh tanna ding a thil ahih peuhmah tungthu ah, ngaihdam ahi ding,” achi hi.
english: The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh, and he will be forgiven concerning whatever he does to become guilty.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Aaron leh atapate kiang ah, hiai halmang thillat dan ding ahi. Haltum thillat pen maitam tung a, ahalna ah zankhua in azingchiang tan in a-om dia; maitam a mei akuang nilouh ding ahi.
english: “Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the burnt offering: the burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.

paite: Siampu in apuanmalngat puansilh asilh dia, asa khuhna ding in apuanmalngat khekol ateng dia; maitam a halmang thillat kangvute ala dia, maitam pang ah akoih ding ahi.
english: The priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put on his linen trousers upon his body; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

paite: Apuansilh siangthou asuah dia, puansilh dang asilh dia, avute giahphual pua mun siangthou ah apaipih ding ahi.
english: He shall take off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

paite: Maitam tung ah mei kuansak nilouh ahi dia, amit ding ahi kei. Siampu in zingsang teng in sing akhul dia, halmang thillat akoih hoih dia, huai ah kilemna thillatte thau ahal ding ahi.
english: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it, it shall not go out; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning. He shall lay the burnt offering in order upon it, and shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.

paite: Maitam ah mei akuang gige dia, amit ding ahi kei hi.
english: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.

paite: "Hiai tangbuang thillatdan ding ahi. Aaron tapate'n maitam bul ah, TOUPA ma ah alan ding uh ahi.
english: “‘This is the law of the meal offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before Yahweh, before the altar.

paite: Ama'n apham khat in tangbuang thillat tung a begaw tengteng alakhe dia, TOUPA a dia gimlimtak, theihgigena ding in maitam ah ahal ding hi.
english: He shall take from there his handful of the fine flour of the meal offering, and of its oil, and all the frankincense which is on the meal offering, and shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma, as its memorial portion, to Yahweh.

paite: Alak bangte Aaron leh atapate'n ane ding uhi. Huai mun siangthou ah silngou soh louh in ane ding ua; kihoupihna biakbuk kongtual ah ane ding uh ahi.
english: That which is left of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten without yeast in a holy place. They shall eat it in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Silngou toh akan ding uh ahi kei. Mei a ka thillat atantuan ding ua ka piak ahi. Huai khelh thoihna leh tatlek thoihna bang a siangthoupen ahi.
english: It shall not be baked with yeast. I have given it as their portion of my offerings made by fire. It is most holy, as are the sin offering and the trespass offering.

paite: Aaron suan pasal tengteng in anek ding uh ahi. Hiai TOUPA a dia halmang thillat tungthu a na suante zel uh tan a tangtawn dan ahi ding. Kuapeuh hiaite khoih peuhmah asiangthou ding uh, chi in thu pia in," achi hi.
english: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as their portion forever throughout your generations, from the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Whoever touches them shall be holy.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Thaunilh a, a-om ni ua, Aaron leh atapate'n TOUPA kiang a alat ding uh thillat hiai ahi. Tangbuang thillat dia lat zel ding, tangbuang nel dimdem ephah sawm a khen mun khat, zingsang in akim, nitak in akim.
english: “This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to Yahweh in the day when he is anointed: one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening.

paite: Sathau in kuangdai sung ah na kang dia, sathau a akidiah suak khit chiang in na hon lalut dia; na balnen dia, tangbuang thillat TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in na lan ding ahi.
english: It shall be made with oil in a griddle. When it is soaked, you shall bring it in. You shall offer the meal offering in baked pieces for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Atapate lak a, asik a pangmi, thaunilh siampu in alan dia; tangtawn dan thuseh ding in TOUPA a dia halmang vek ding ahi.
english: The anointed priest that will be in his place from among his sons shall offer it. By a statute forever, it shall be wholly burned to Yahweh.

paite: Siampu in tangbuang thillat a lat peuhmah halmang vek ding ahi a, nek het louh ding ahi," achi hi.
english: Every meal offering of a priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Hiai khelh thoihna dan ding ahi. Haltum thillat goh zelna ah khelh thoihna leng TOUPA ma a goh ding ahi. Hiai thil siangthoupen ahi.
english: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the sin offering: in the place where the burnt offering is killed, the sin offering shall be killed before Yahweh. It is most holy.

paite: Khelh thoihna lantu siampu in ane dia; kihoupihna biakbuk kongtual ah, mun siangthou ah ane ding ahi.
english: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Kuapeuh huai sa khoih peuhmah asiangthou ding ahi. Asisan pen bang puan peuh a theh ahihleh, abanna peuhmah mun siangthou ah na sawp ding ahi.
english: Whatever shall touch its flesh shall be holy. When there is any of its blood sprinkled on a garment, you shall wash that on which it was sprinkled in a holy place.

paite: Ahuanna leibel pen sukkhap ding ahi. Sumbel a huan ahihleh bel nawtsiang a khuahsiang ding ahi.
english: But the earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken; and if it is boiled in a bronze vessel, it shall be scoured, and rinsed in water.

paite: Pasal siampu tengteng in huai ane ding uh ahi. Hiai thil siangthoupen ahi.
english: Every male among the priests shall eat of it. It is most holy.

paite: Khelh thoihna sisan, Mun Siangthou a kilemna bawlna dia kihoupihna puanin a hong kitawi pen nek ding ahi kei, mei a halmang ding ahi.
english: No sin offering, of which any of the blood is brought into the Tent of Meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be eaten. It shall be burned with fire.

paite: "Huchi mah bang in hiai tatlek thoihdan ding ahi. Thil siangthoupen ahi.
english: “‘This is the law of the trespass offering: It is most holy.

paite: Haltum thillat agoh zelna ua tatlek kithoihna leng goh ding ahi a; asisan a maitam theh kimvel ding ahi.
english: In the place where they kill the burnt offering, he shall kill the trespass offering; and its blood he shall sprinkle around on the altar.

paite: Athau tengteng alat ding ahi. Amei thautakte, asungkua thaute,
english: He shall offer all of its fat: the fat tail, and the fat that covers the innards,

paite: akal nihte leh aboh thau, aphuk kiang a thau leh asin tuam lap, akalte nangawn in asuahkhe ding ahi.
english: and he shall take away the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys;

paite: Siampu in TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ding in maitam tung ah ahal ding ahi. Hiai tatlek thoihna ahi.
english: and the priest shall burn them on the altar for an offering made by fire to Yahweh: it is a trespass offering.

paite: Pasal siampu tengteng in ane ding ua; mun siangthou a nek ding ahi. Hiai thil siangthoupen ahi.
english: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy.

paite: "Tatlek thoihna pen khelh thoihna mah bang ahi a, dan khat ahi. Kilepna bawltu siampu in huai atang ding hi.
english: “‘As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with them shall have it.

paite: Siampu, kuapeuh halmang thillat latsaktu siampu ngei in halmang thillat dia alat vun apum tan ding ahi.
english: The priest who offers any man’s burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.

paite: Akanna a kan tangbuang thillat peuhmah, sikbel a kan leh kuang a kan tengteng alantu siampu atuam ding ahi.
english: Every meal offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is prepared in the pan and on the griddle, shall be the priest’s who offers it.

paite: Tangbuang thillat tengteng sathau a mek leng, agaw leng adang mah bang in Aaron tapa tengteng akihawm dialdial ding uh ahi.
english: Every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, belongs to all the sons of Aaron, one as well as another.

paite: "Hiai pen mi'n TOUPA kiang a alat ding, lemna thillat a kithoihdan ding ahi.
english: “‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to Yahweh:

paite: Kipahthu genna dia alatleh kipahthu genna kithoihna ding in sathau a zut, silngou soh louh tanghou leh sathau a zut silngou soh louh tanghou pa didekte leh sathau a mek tangbuang nel mahmah kidiah suak a lat tel ding ahi.
english: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mixed with oil.

paite: "Kipahthu genna dia lemna thillat kithoihna ah tanghou silngou soh alat tel ding ahi.
english: He shall offer his offering with the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving with cakes of leavened bread.

paite: Huai athillat teng a TOUPA a dia vei thillat a ding in khat chiat alan dia; lemna thillat sisan a thehtu siampu a tuam ding ahi.
english: Of it he shall offer one out of each offering for a heave offering to Yahweh. It shall be the priest’s who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.

paite: Kipahthu genna dia alemna thillat kithoihna sa pen thillat alat ni mah a nekgaih ding ahi. Azingchiang tan a bangmah asit ding ahi kei.
english: The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any of it until the morning.

paite: "Himahleh athillat kithoihna pen thuchiam hiam, amah ut thu a thillat hiam ahihleh kithoihna alat ni mah a nek ding ahi a; nek bang azingchiang a nek ding ahi.
english: “‘But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow, or a free will offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice. On the next day what remains of it shall be eaten,

paite: Himahleh kithoihna sa, ani thum ni tan a-om lailaileh hal ding ahi.
english: but what remains of the meat of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.

paite: Alemna thillat kithoihna sa ani thum ni tan a anek uleh, pomsak ahi kei dia, alantu leng alan a sim ahi kei ding. Thilkihhuai ahi dia, kuapeuh ane in athulimlouhna moh uh apo ding hi.
english: If any of the meat of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted, and it shall not be credited to him who offers it. It will be an abomination, and the soul who eats any of it will bear his iniquity.

paite: Thilsiang lou himhim toh kisukha sa nek ding ahi kei, hal ding ahi. Sa siang peuhmah nek ding ahi.
english: “‘The meat that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire. As for the meat, everyone who is clean may eat it;

paite: Himahleh lemna thillat kithoihna sa, TOUPA a tuam, siang lou nemi achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
english: but the soul who eats of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings that belongs to Yahweh, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.

paite: Kuapeuh in thilsiang lou himhim, misiang lou hiam, gan siang lou hiam, thilkihhuai siang lou himhim akhoih a, lemna thillat kithoihna sa, TOUPA a tuam anekleh huai mi achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi, chi in Aaron leh atapate houpih in," achi hi.
english: When anyone touches any unclean thing, the uncleanness of man, or an unclean animal, or any unclean abomination, and eats some of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings which belong to Yahweh, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Bawng hiam, belam hiam, kel hiam thau na ne ding uh ahi kei.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘You shall eat no fat, of bull, or sheep, or goat.

paite: Amah sih a si thau leh gamsa balzan thau thil dang a dia zat ding ahi. Na ne himhim ding uh ahi kei.
english: The fat of that which dies of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of animals, may be used for any other service, but you shall in no way eat of it.

paite: Kuapeuh, TOUPA a dia mi'n mei thillat alat uh sathau nemi, achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
english: For whoever eats the fat of the animal which men offer as an offering made by fire to Yahweh, even the soul who eats it shall be cut off from his people.

paite: Na tenna peuh uah sisan himhim, vasa hiam, gamsa hiam sisan hiam na ne ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.

paite: Kuapeuh hitaleh, sisan ne himhim achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi, chi in Israel suante houpih in," achi hi.
english: Whoever it is who eats any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "TOUPA kiang a lemna thillat kithoihna lan peuhmah in, TOUPA a dia athillat, alemna thillat kithoihna a pan ahong lat ding ahi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to Yahweh shall bring his offering to Yahweh out of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

paite: TOUPA a dia mei a thillat amah khut mahmah in ahon tawi ding a; athau leh a-awm ahon la ding ahi; a-awm pen TOUPA ma a vei thillat ding a vei ahihtheihna ding in.
english: With his own hands he shall bring the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before Yahweh.

paite: Siampu in maitam ah athau ahal dia, a-awm bel Aaron leh atapate a tuam ding ahi.
english: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

paite: Aliang taklam pen kilemna thillat kithoihna a pan vei thillat dia siampu na piak ding uh ahi.
english: The right thigh you shall give to the priest for a heave offering out of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

paite: Aaron tapate lak a lemna thillat sisan leh thau lantu kuapeuh in atantuan ding in aliang taklam atang ding ahi.
english: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.

paite: A-awm leh aliang avei lel pen uh Israel suante a lemna thillat kithoihna a pan ka la tuam a, Israel suante tangtawn dan thuseh ding in siampu Aaron leh atapate ka pia ahi, chi in Israel suante kiang ah gen in," achi hi.
english: For the waved breast and the heaved thigh I have taken from the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel.’”

paite: Hiai ahi, siampu nasem dia TOUPA kiang a lat ahih nungsiah TOUPA a dia mei a thillat a pan Aaron tantuan leh atapate tantuan ding,
english: This is the consecrated portion of Aaron, and the consecrated portion of his sons, out of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister to Yahweh in the priest’s office;

paite: amau thau anilh ni a Israel suante'n dan thuseh a apiak gige ding ua TOUPA'N thu apiak. Hiai tangtawn a asuan hong om zel dingte tan a ahihdan ding uh ahi.
english: which Yahweh commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them. It is their portion forever throughout their generations.

paite: Hiai ahi halmang thillat, tang- buang thillat, khelh thoihna leh tatlek kithoihna dan.
english: This is the law of the burnt offering, the meal offering, the sin offering, the trespass offering, the consecration, and the sacrifice of peace offerings

paite: Sinai gamdai a Israel suante'n thillat TOUPA kiang a alat ding ua thu apiak ni a Sinai Tang a TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak ahi.
english: which Yahweh commanded Moses in Mount Sinai in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to Yahweh, in the wilderness of Sinai.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Aaron atapate toh pi inla, puansilhte, nilhchi sathau, khelh thoihna bawngtalte, belampa nihte, tanghou silngou soh louh bawm khat toh tawi inla,
english: “Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bull of the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;

paite: Omkhawmte tengteng kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi kim ah paikhawmsak in," achi hi.
english: and assemble all the congregation at the door of the Tent of Meeting.”

paite: TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in Mosi in ahih a; omkhawmte tengteng kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi kim ah a-omkhawm uhi.
english: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Mosi in omkhawmte kiang ah, "Hiai ahi, TOUPA'N hih dia ahon thupiak pen," achi hi.
english: Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded to be done.”

paite: Mosi in Aaron leh atapate ahon pi a, tui in amaute asil hi.
english: Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

paite: Puanak asilhsak a, kawnggakna in agak a, puanaktual asilhsak a, siampu puanak in atuam a, siampu puanak gakna siamtak a gat in agak a, huai in agakbelh hi.
english: He put the tunic on him, tied the sash on him, clothed him with the robe, put the ephod on him, and he tied the skillfully woven band of the ephod on him and fastened it to him with it.

paite: Awmtuamna athuah a, awmtuamna ah Urim leh Thummim akoih hi.
english: He placed the breastplate on him. He put the Urim and Thummim in the breastplate.

paite: Dial akhimsak a, dial tung ah dangka-eng sikpek abulh a, huai mailam ah TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in siampu lukhu siangthou akilhbelh hi.
english: He set the turban on his head. He set the golden plate, the holy crown, on the front of the turban, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Mosi in nilhchi sathau ala a, biakbuk leh asung a thil om teng-teng anilh a, asiangthousak chiat hi.
english: Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and sanctified them.

paite: Huai mah in sagihvei maitam atheh a, maitam leh atui-um belsuan tengteng, maiphiatna kuang leh atunna siangthousak ding in anilh hi.
english: He sprinkled it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, and the basin and its base, to sanctify them.

paite: Huai sathau Aaron lu ah abuak a asianthouna ding in anilh hi.
english: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

paite: Mosi in Aaron tapate ahon pi a, puanak sungsilh tualte asilhsak a, kawnggakna in agak a, TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in dial akhimsak hi.
english: Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and clothed them with tunics, and tied sashes on them, and put headbands on them, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Khelh thoihna bawngtal ahon kai a, Aaron leh atapate'n khelh thoihna ding bawngtal lutung ah akhut uh akoih uhi.
english: He brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.

paite: Agou a; Mosi in asisan ala a, huai maitam a dia kilemna bawlna ding in akhutzung in maitam kii ah akimvel in atat a, maitam asiangsak a, maitam bul ah sisan sung in asiangthousak hi.
english: He killed it; and Moses took the blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement for it.

paite: Agilbom tengteng, asin, alap, akal nihte leh athau ala a, maitam tung ah Mosi in ahal hi.
english: He took all the fat that was on the innards, and the cover of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat; and Moses burned it on the altar.

paite: Bawngtal pen avun toh, asa toh, a-ek toh giahphual pua ah ahal hi; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in.
english: But the bull, and its skin, and its meat, and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Haltum thillat belampa pen alan a, Aaron leh atapate'n belampa lutung ah akhut uh akoih uhi.
english: He presented the ram of the burnt offering. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

paite: Agou a, Mosi in maitam sisan in akimvel in atheh hi.
english: He killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

paite: Belampa asem a, alu, asemnente leh athau ahal hi.
english: He cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burned the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

paite: Asungkua leh akhete asil a; belampa pen maitam ah avek in ahal hi. Huai gimlim dia halmang thillat ahi a; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ahi.
english: He washed the innards and the legs with water; and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Belampa dang, hihtuamna belampa pen ahon la nawn a, Aaron leh atapate'n belampa lutung ah akhut uh akoih uhi.
english: He presented the other ram, the ram of consecration. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

paite: Mosi in agou a, asisan ala a, Aaron bil taklam dawn, akhut taklam khutpi leh akhe taklam khepi anuh hi.
english: He killed it; and Moses took some of its blood, and put it on the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.

paite: Mosi in Aaron tapate api a, abil taklam dawn, akhut taklam khutpi, akhe taklam khepi anuh a, maitam sisan in akimvel ah atheh hi.
english: He brought Aaron’s sons; and Moses put some of the blood on the tip of their right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

paite: Athaute, amei thau, agilbom tengteng asin tuam pen alapte, akal nih leh athau leh aliang taklam ala hi:
english: He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat that was on the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh;

paite: TOUPA ma a tanghou silngou soh louh bawm a pan tanghou silngou soh louh khat leh sathau a mek tanghou pei khat leh tanghou peipa'n khat ala a, thau tung leh aliang taklam tung ah akoih hi.
english: and out of the basket of unleavened bread that was before Yahweh, he took one unleavened cake, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat and on the right thigh.

paite: Avek in Aaron khutpek tung ah leh atapate khutpek tung ah akoih a, TOUPA ma ah vei thillat ding in avei hi.
english: He put all these in Aaron’s hands and in his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

paite: Mosi in akhut a pan ala a, halmang thillat tung ah maitam ah ahal hi. Huai gimlim dia ahihtuamna ahi. TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ahi.
english: Moses took them from their hands, and burned them on the altar on the burnt offering. They were a consecration offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Mosi in a-awm ala a, TOUPA ma ah vei thillat in avei a; hihtuamna belampa Mosi tantuam ahi, TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in.
english: Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It was Moses’ portion of the ram of consecration, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Mosi in nilhchi sathau a pan tam lou leh maitam asisan tam lou ala a, huai in Aaron leh apuansilhte atheh a; atapate leh atapate puansilhte leng atheh hi. Aaron leh apuansilh ahihsiangthou a, atapate leh atapate puansilhte leng ahihsiangthou hi.
english: Moses took some of the anointing oil, and some of the blood which was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons, and on his sons’ garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

paite: Mosi in Aaron leh atapate kiang ah, "Kihoupihna puanin kongpi bul ah sa huan unla, Aaron leh atapate'n anek ding uh ahi, chi a thu ka piak bang in, huai ah hihtuamna bawm a tanghou toh ne uhen.
english: Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Boil the meat at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’

paite: Sa leh tanghou nekbangte na hal ding uh ahi.
english: What remains of the meat and of the bread you shall burn with fire.

paite: Na kihihtuamna ni uh achin masiah kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi pawtsan lou in ni sagih na om ding uh ahi. Ni sagih sung nou hon hihtuam ding ahi ngal a.
english: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your consecration are fulfilled: for he shall consecrate you seven days.

paite: Tuni a ahihsa bang in, nou a dia kilemna hon bawlsak ding in TOUPA'N thu apeta hi.
english: What has been done today, so Yahweh has commanded to do, to make atonement for you.

paite: Huaiziak in kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah ni sagih, sun leh zan in na om nilouh ding ua, na sihlouhna ding ua TOUPA thupiak na zuih ding uh ahi; huchibang ding a thu piak ahi,” achi hi.
english: You shall stay at the door of the Tent of Meeting day and night seven days, and keep Yahweh’s command, that you don’t die: for so I am commanded.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi zang a ahih ding ua thu apiak tengteng Aaron leh atapate'n ahih uhi.
english: Aaron and his sons did all the things which Yahweh commanded by Moses.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani giat ni in Mosi in Aaron leh atapate leh Israel upate asam hi.
english: On the eighth day, Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

paite: Aaron kiang ah, "Khelh thoihna ding in bawngnoupa leh halmang thillat ding in belampa gensiatbei tuaktuak kai inla, TOUPA ma ah lan in," achi hi.
english: and he said to Aaron, “Take a calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without defect, and offer them before Yahweh.

paite: "Israel suante kiang ah, 'Khelh thoihna ding in kelpa, halmang thillat ding in bawngnou leh belamnou kum khat a upa tuaktuak gensiatbei tuak
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without defect, for a burnt offering;

paite: leh bawngtal leh belampa, sathau a mek tangbuang thillat toh TOUPA ma a lemna thillat a lat ding in hon kai un.' Tuni in na kiang uah TOUPA ahong kilang ding hi, chi in hilh in,” achi hi.
english: and a bull and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before Yahweh; and a meal offering mixed with oil: for today Yahweh appears to you.’”

paite: Mosi in thu apiak bang in kihoupihna biakbuk kong ah ahon kai ua; TOUPA ma ah omkhawmte tengteng in ava naih ua, ava dingh uhi.
english: They brought what Moses commanded before the Tent of Meeting. All the congregation came near and stood before Yahweh.

paite: Mosi in, “Hiai ahi na hih ding ua Toupa'n thu ahon piak, na lak uah TOUPA thupina ahong kilang ding," achi hi.
english: Moses said, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded that you should do; and Yahweh’s glory shall appear to you.”

paite: Mosi in Aaron kiang ah, "Maitam hon naih inla, na khelh thoihna leh na halmang thillat lan inla, nang a ding leh mipite a ding in kilemna bawl in. Mipite thillat pen lan inla, amau a ding in kilemna bawl in, TOUPA thupiak bang in,” achi hi.
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Draw near to the altar, and offer your sin offering, and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself, and for the people; and offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them, as Yahweh commanded.”

paite: Aaron in maitam ava naih a, amah a tuam khelh thoihna bawngnou agou hi.
english: So Aaron came near to the altar, and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.

paite: Aaron tapate'n akiang ah sisan ahon tawi ua, huai sisan ah akhutzung adiah a, maitam kiite ah atat a, sisan pen maitam bul ah asung hi.
english: The sons of Aaron presented the blood to him; and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar;

paite: Himahleh, khelh thoihna thau, akalte leh asin tuam pen lapte, TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in maitam tung ah ahal hi.
english: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the cover from the liver of the sin offering, he burned upon the altar, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Asa leh avun giahphual pua ah ahal hi.
english: The meat and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.

paite: Haltum thillat pen agou a; Aaron tapate'n asisan apia ua, ama'n maitam kimvel in atheh hi.
english: He killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.

paite: Haltum thillat sabakte leh alu apia ua, ama'n maitam ah ana hal hi.
english: They delivered the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head. He burned them upon the altar.

paite: Asungkuate leh akhete asil a, maitam ah halmang thillat tung ah ahal hi.
english: He washed the innards and the legs, and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar.

paite: Mipite thillat pen alan a, mipite khelh thoihna kel akai a, agou a, ama a mah bang in khelh thoihna ding in alan hi.
english: He presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and killed it, and offered it for sin, like the first.

paite: Haltum thillat alan a, adan bang in alan hi.
english: He presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.

paite: Tangbuang thillat alan a, huai a pan pham khat ala a, zingsang a halmang thillat chih louh leng maitam ah ahal lai hi.
english: He presented the meal offering, and filled his hand from there, and burned it upon the altar, in addition to the burnt offering of the morning.

paite: Mipite atuam dia lemna thillat kithoihna bawngtal leh belampa leng agou a, Aaron tapate'n asisan apia ua, maitam kimvel ah atheh hi.
english: He also killed the bull and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people. Aaron’s sons delivered to him the blood, which he sprinkled around on the altar;

paite: Bawngtal thau leh belampa thau, amei thau, agilbomte, akalte, asin tuam pen alapte leng apia uhi.
english: and the fat of the bull and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covers the innards, and the kidneys, and the cover of the liver;

paite: Athau pen a-awmte tung ah akoih a, ama'n athau pen maitam ah ahal hi.
english: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar.

paite: A-awm leh aliang taklam pen, Mosi thupiak bang in Aaron in TOUPA ma ah vei thillat ding in avei hi.
english: Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh for a wave offering before Yahweh, as Moses commanded.

paite: Aaron in mipi lam ah aban azak a, avek un avualzawl hi. Khelh thoihna, halmang thillat leh lemna thillat alat zoh in ahong paisuk hi.
english: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them; and he came down from offering the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin ah Mosi leh Aaron ava lut ua, ahong pawtkhe nawn ua, mipite avualzawl uhi. TOUPA thupina mi tengteng kiang ah ahong kilang hi.
english: Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting, and came out, and blessed the people; and Yahweh’s glory appeared to all the people.

paite: TOUPA ma a pan mei ahong pawtkhia a, halmang thillat leh thaute maitam ah akangtumta hi. Mipi tengteng in huai amuh un akikou zuazua ua, lei si in abokkhup uhi.
english: Fire came out from before Yahweh, and consumed the burnt offering and the fat upon the altar. When all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.

paite: Huai thilte i lak ua tak petpet a gintak a om, mi tampi in athu gelh ana tup uh,
english: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,

paite: atung a pan a mute leh thu nasemte'n ahon hilh bang un,
english: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,

paite: Theophilus aw, abul a pan bangkim chiantak in ka sui a, kizom zel in nang a ding in kigelhleh ahoih ding, ka chi hi;
english: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;

paite: huai tuma a nang ahon hilh uh thudik ahi chih na theihsemna ding in.
english: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.

paite: Judia gam kumpipa Herod adam lai in, Abijah pawl a mi amin Zakariah a-om a; huai mi in Aaron tanute lak a khat zi in anei a, amin Elizabeth ahi.
english: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.

paite: Anih un Pathian mitmuh in diktat in a-om ua, gensiatbei in Toupa thupiak leh adan thuseh tengteng zui in a-om zel uhi.
english: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.

paite: Himahleh Elizabeth achiin ziak in ta anei kei ua, anih un upa pitak ahi tuak uhi.
english: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.

paite: Huan hichibang ahi a, apawlte hihdan ngeina bang a Pathian ma a siampu nna sem a a-om lai in,
english: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division

paite: siampu dan bang in Toupa tempul a lut leh gimlim hal atan ahi.
english: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

paite: Gimlim hal hun lai in mipite avek un inpua ah ana thum uhi.
english: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.

paite: Toupa angel khat gimlim halna maitam taklam a dingh in akiang ah akilak hi.
english: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

paite: Zakariah in amuhtak in alungzing a, lauh leng alau hi.
english: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.

paite: Himahleh angel in akiang ah, "Zakariah, lau ke'n, na ngetna zak a a-om ziak in, na zi Elizabeth in tapa hon neihsak dia, amin Johan na sak ding ahi.
english: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard. Your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.

paite: Huan nang nuam in na kipak ding a; amah apian in mi tampi akipak ding uhi.
english: You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.

paite: Toupa ngaih in milian ahi dia, uain leh zu himhim adawn kei ding; anu sung a pan in Kha Siangthou in adim ding hi.
english: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.

paite: Israel suante tampi Toupa a Pathian lam uh angasak nawn ding hi.
english: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.

paite: Pate lungtang tate lam angasak ding, michihmohte midiktat pilna lam ngasak ding, Toupa a dia mipite mansa a omsak ding a bawlkhol ding in Elijah lungsim leh thilhihtheihna pu in Toupa ma ah apai ding," achi hi.
english: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.”

paite: Huan Zakariah in angel kiang ah, "Huai bangchi in ka thei dia? Kei putekpi hi ing a, ka zi leng pitek ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”

paite: Angel in adawng a, akiang ah, "Kei Gabriel, Pathian ma a dingh zel ka hi; nang hon houpih ding leh hiai thuhoih hon hilh ding a sawl ka hi.
english: The angel answered him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.

paite: Ngai in ka thugente ahuntak a hong tung ding, na gintak louh ziak in huai thilte ahong tun masiah na dai dide ding a, pau leng na pau thei kei ding," achi hi.
english: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak until the day that these things will happen, because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.”

paite: Huan mipite'n Zakariah ana ngak ua, tempul sung a a-om sawt ziak in lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
english: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.

paite: Huan ahong pawt in akiang uah thu agen theita kei hi; huchi in tempul ah kha kilak amu ahi chih atheita ua; akiang uah chiamtehnate abawl a, pau thei lou in a-om hi.
english: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, anasepna ni akimtak in a-inn ah apaita hi.
english: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.

paite: Huai nite nung in, azi Elizabeth agaita a, kha nga akisel zoh in,
english: After these days Elizabeth his wife conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,

paite: "Mi lak a ka minse khuhna ding in, Toupa'n ahon muh in, hichibang in ka tung ah ahihta," achi hi.
english: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”

paite: Huan akha gukna ah Pathian in Galili gam a khua khat Nazaret achih uah, angel Gabriel,
english: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,

paite: nungak siangthou khat kiang ah asawl a, huai nungak tuh David suan a mi khat amin Joseph toh kikham ahi ua; nungak min Mari ahi.
english: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.

paite: Huan akiang ah angel alut a, "Chibai, nang nakpitak a deihtuam; na kiang ah Toupa a-om," achi hi.
english: Having come in, the angel said to her, “Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”

paite: Huai thugen ziak in alunghimoh mahmah a, bangchidan a chibai hon buk adiam aw? chi in akingaihtuah hi.
english: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.

paite: Angel in akiang ah, "Mari, lau ke'n; Pathian a pan deihsakna na tang hi.
english: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.

paite: Ngai in, na gai ding a, tapa na nei dia, amin Jesu na sa ding hi.
english: Behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and shall name him ‘Jesus.’

paite: Amah milian ahong hi ding a, Tungnungpen Tapa achi ding uh. Toupa Pathian in apu David laltutphah ape dia,
english: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,

paite: Jakob suante tung ah tangtawn in vai ahawm dia, agam in bei ni anei kei ding,” achi hi.
english: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”

paite: Huan Mari in angel kiang ah, "Hiai bangchi in ahi thei dia? Pasal lah nei lou ing a," achi hi.
english: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”

paite: Huan angel in adawng a, akiang ah, "Na tung ah Kha Siangthou ahong tung ding a, Tungnungpen thilhihtheihna in ahon liahkhum ding, huaiziak in misiangthou hong piang ding leng, siangthou Pathian Tapa chih in a-om ding, achi hi.
english: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.

paite: Ngai in, na sanggamnu Elizabeth in leng atek nung in tapa apaita; achiing achih uh, tu kha akha gukna ahita hi.
english: Behold, Elizabeth your relative also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.

paite: Pathian thupawt himhim thil hi thei lou a-om kei," achi hi.
english: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”

paite: Mari in, "Ngai in, Toupa sikhanu ka hi, na thu bang zel in ka tung ah tung hen," achi hi. Huan angel in apaisanta hi.
english: Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” Then the angel departed from her.

paite: Huai lai in Mari athou a, singtang ah, Judia gam a khua khat ah ahoh pah hi.
english: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,

paite: Zakariah inn ah alut a, Elizabeth chibai abuk hi.
english: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Mari in Elizabeth chibai abuktak in, asung a naungek ahong kitawm a; Kha Siangthou in Elizabeth ahong dimta hi; aw ngaihtak in akikou a,
english: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

paite: "Nang numei sapsap ding in na hampha hi, na gilgah leng ahampha hi.
english: She called out with a loud voice and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!

paite: Ka Toupa nu ka kiang a na hong bangchidan ahia oi?
english: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

paite: Ngai in, na hon chibai buk husa ka bil a aluttak in, akipah ziak in ka sung a naungek akitawm hi.
english: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!

paite: Agingtanu leng ahampha hi, akiang a Toupa thugen tangtung ding ahih ziak in," achi hi.
english: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”

paite: Huan Mari in: "Ka nuntakna in Toupa apahtawi e,
english: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.

paite: ka kha leng ka Hondampa Pathian tung ah akipak mahmah a.
english: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,

paite: Asikhanu namtomdan amu a, ahehpih a; ngai in, tunung siah khang tengteng in hampha ahon chi ding uh.
english: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.

paite: Amah mihat in ka tung ah thil thupitak ahon hihsak a, amin leng asiangthou hi.
english: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.

paite: Amah laute tung ah akhang- akhang in azahngaihna a-om hi.
english: His mercy is for generations and generations on those who fear him.

paite: Aban in athahatdan a-ensak a, mikisatheite alunggelna uh ahihdalhta hi.
english: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

paite: Alaltutphah ua tu kumpipate akaikhia a, namtomte apahtawita hi.
english: He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.

paite: Gilkialte thil hoih in ahihvah a, mihaute khutvuak in apaimangsakta hi.
english: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.

paite: Asikha Israel taksap awng ahuta a, azahngaihna theihgigena ding in.
english: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,

paite: I pipute Abraham leh asuante kiang a tangtawn thuchiam agen bang ahi."
english: as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”

paite: Akiang uah kha thum vel Mari a-om a, a-inn ah akik nawnta hi.
english: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.

paite: Huan Elizabeth nau neih ahong hunta a; huchi in tapa ahon neita hi.
english: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.

paite: Toupa'n atung ah azahngaihna thupi asuah chih avengte leh asanggamte'n ana za ua, akipahpih uhi.
english: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani giat ni in naungek zeksum ding in ahong pai ua; amin ding in apa min mah Zakariah sak atum uhi.
english: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

paite: Anu'n, "Hilou e, Johan chih ding ahi," chi in adawng hi.
english: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”

paite: Anu kiang ah, "Na sanggamte lak ah hiai min pu kuamah a-om kei uh, achi uhi.
english: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”

paite: Huan apa kiang ah chiamtehna bawl in, amin ding in bang sa lehang na deih a? achi uhi.
english: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.

paite: Huan laigelhna pek angen a, amin Johan ahi," chi in agelh hi.
english: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They all marveled.

paite: Avek un lamdang asa mahmah uhi. Thakhat in akam hong kihong in, alei ahong kiphel a, Pathian phat in ahong paukheta hi.
english: His mouth was opened immediately and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.

paite: Akim ua omte tengteng in alauta ua; huchi in huai thute Judia gam singtang gam tengteng ah athangta hi.
english: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.

paite: Aza peuhmah in, alungtang un avei chiat ua, "Huai naungek bangchi phet ahong hi diam aw?" achi uhi. Huan Toupa khut in amah apanpih hi.
english: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.

paite: Huan apa Zakariah, Kha Siangthou in adim a, agenkhol a,
english: His father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,

paite: "Toupa Israel' Pathian phat in om hen, amite ahong veh a, tatna abawlsak hi.
english: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;

paite: Asikha David inkuante lak ah hotdamna kii ahon bawlsak tak ziak in;
english: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David

paite: Tang lai a pan a zawlnei siangthoute kam a agen bang in.
english: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),

paite: I doute lak leh hon ho tengteng lak a hotdam a i om ding thu,
english: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us;

paite: I pipute kiang a achiam zahngaihna tangtungsak ding leh athukhun siangthou theigige ding in.
english: to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,

paite: I pu Abraham kiang a kichiam a,
english: the oath which he swore to Abraham our father,

paite: I doute lak a ahon humbit a, lau lou a ama nna i sepna ding in.
english: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,

paite: I damsung teng a amitmuh a siangthou leh diktattak a omna ding in.
english: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.

paite: Ahi, Bawi, nang zaw Tungnungpen Zawlnei ahon chi ding ua; alampite bawlkhol ding in Toupa ma ah na pai ding hi.
english: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,

paite: Akhelhnate uh ngaihdamna dia amite kiang a hotdamna theihna pe ding in.
english: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,

paite: I Pathian lungtang a zahngaihna nou ngiingei ziak in, huchi in tunglam a kipan i tung a ninou suak in ahong veh ding a,
english: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the dawn from on high will visit us,

paite: mial lak leh sihna lim a tute tanvak ding leh khamuanna lampi a i khete kalsuansak ding in," achi hi.
english: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”

paite: Huan naungek ahong khanglian deuhdeuh a, akhalam ahong hat hiaihiai a, Israelte kiang a ahong kilak masiah gamdai ah a-om gige hi.
english: The child was growing and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.

paite: Huai khit in Toupa'n midang sawmsagih asep a, apaina ding kho teng leh mun teng ah, ama ah nihnih in asawl hi.
english: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place where he was about to come.

paite: Akiang uah, "Buh lak ding atam mahmah a, himahleh asemte atawm uh, huchi in abuh la ding a sem dingte sawl ding in buh neipa kiang ah ngen un.
english: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.

paite: Pai un; ngai un, ngehon lak a belamnou bang in ka hon sawl ahi.
english: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.

paite: Dangka ip, kawlzal leh khedap tawi kei unla, lampi ah kuamah chibai buk kei un.
english: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.

paite: Huan inn na lutna peuh uah amasapen in, 'Hiai inn ah khamuanna tung hen!' chi un.
english: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’

paite: Huai inn a khamuanna ta a-omleh na khamuanna thu uh atung ah a-om ding a; a-om keileh na kiang uah ahong kik nawn ding hi.
english: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.

paite: Huai inn ah tung in om nilouh unla, ahon piak peuh uh ne in dawn un; nasemmi loh mu tak ahi. Inn teng ah ban hoh kei un.
english: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.

paite: Huan khua na lutna peuh uah hon kipahpih uleh, hon lui peuh uh na ne ding ua; huai a damlou omte leng na hihdam ding ua;
english: Into whatever city you enter and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.

paite: akiang uah, 'Pathian lalgam na kiang uah hong tungta,' na chi ding uh.
english: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

paite: Khua na lutna peuh uah hon kipahpih kei uleh akongzing uah paikhia unla,
english: But into whatever city you enter and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,

paite: na kho leivui uh ka khepek ua bang teng na tung uah tatsiang ung e; himahleh Pathian lalgam ahong naita chih thei un, na chi ding uhi.
english: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

paite: K'on hilh ahi, huai ni chiang in huai khuate thuak sang in Sodom khua thuak ding adan a-om zaw ding hi.
english: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.

paite: "Korazin, na tung agik e! Bethsaida, na tung agik e! Noumau a thillamdang kihihte Tura leh Sidon a hih hileh, sai-ip puan silh a vut lak a tu in akisik khin thamta ding uh.
english: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

paite: Himahleh thukhen ni chiang in nou thuak sang in Tura leh Sidon khua thuak ding adan a-om zaw ding.
english: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.

paite: Huan nang Kapernaum, van tan ah tawisang in na om a, misikhua a sawnkhiak a om ding na hi.
english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.

paite: "Kuapeuh na thu uh ngaikhia keimah thu ngaikhia ahi a; kuapeuh nou hon deih lou kei hon deih lou ahi; kuapeuh nou hon ngai lou kei hon ngai lou ahi a, kuapeuh kei hon ngai lou tuh hon sawlpa ngai lou ahi," achi hi.
english: Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”

paite: Huan sawmsagihte kipaktak in ahong kik nawn ua, "Toupa, dawite nangawn na min ziak in ka thuthu un a-om uh," achi uhi.
english: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Khophia bang in van a kipan Setan hong kia ka mu hi.
english: He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.

paite: Ngai un, gulte, aikamte sikdenna thu leh melma thilhihtheihna tengteng tung a thuneihna ka hon pia ahi; bangmah in ahon hih na kei hial ding.
english: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.

paite: Himahleh dawite na thuthu ua a-om ziak un kipak kei un; van a na min uh gelh ahih ziak in kipak zaw un,” achi hi.
english: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”

paite: Huai laitak in Jesu, Kha Siangthou in akipak mahmah a, "Pa aw, lei leh van Toupa, nang mipil leh mibengvakte kiang ah hiai thu na iim a, naungekte kiang a na than ziak in ka hon phat hi; ahi, Pa, huchibang hih nang ngaih in ahoih ahi.
english: In that same hour, Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”

paite: Ka Pa'n bangkim ahon kemsak a, Tapa kua ahia, Pa lou ngal kuamah in athei kei, Pa leng kua ahia, Tapa leh akiang ua Tapa in atheihsak nopnate kia lou ngal kuamah in athei kei," achi hi.
english: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”

paite: Huan nungzuite lam anga a, asim in, "Na thil muhte uh amu mitte ahampha e!
english: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,

paite: K'on chi ahi, zawlnei tampi leh kumpipa tampite'n leng na thil muhte uh muh akilawp gige ua, himahleh amu kei uh, bil a na zakte uh leng zak akilawp thei mahmah ua, himahleh aza kei uh," achi hi.
english: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”

paite: Huan ngai un dan thei mi kuahiam adingh a, amah ze-etna ding in, "Sinsakpa, tangtawn hinna neihna ding in bang ka hih dia?" achi hi.
english: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Dan laibu ah bang gelh ahia? Bangchi in na sim a?" achi hi.
english: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”

paite: Huan ama'n, "Toupa, na Pathian na lungtang tengteng, na kha tengteng, na hatna tengteng, na lungsim tengteng in na it ding ahi; nangmah na ki-it bang in na vengte na it ding ahi, chih," chi in adawng hi.
english: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang ah, "Na dawng dik hi; huchi in hih lechin na hing ding,” achi hi.
english: He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”

paite: Ama'n bel kisiamtansak ut in, Jesu kiang ah, "Ahihleh, ka inveng kua ahia?" achi hi.
english: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”

paite: Jesu'n adawng a, "Kuahiam Jerusalem a kipan Jeriko ah ahohsuk a, suamhatte atuak hi. Amau apuansilh asuahsak vek ua, avua ua, si dektak in apaisanta uhi.
english: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

paite: Huan huai lampi ah siampu kuahiam ava paisuk a, amuhtak in lampi sik lehlam ah apel maimah hi.
english: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

paite: Huan huchibang mah in Levi chimi khat leng huai mun ahong tung a, amuhtak in lampi sik lehlam ah apel maimah hi.
english: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.

paite: Himahleh, Samaria gam a mi kuahiam zin pai lai a-omna ahong tung a, amuhtak in alainat mahmah hi.
english: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,

paite: Akiang ah ava hoh a, aliamnate thau leh uain abuak a, atuam a, amah gan tung ah atuangsak a, khualbuk ah apaipih a, akemta hi.
english: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

paite: Huan azing in makhai nih asuahkhia a, khualbuk kempa kiang ah apia a, amah na kem inla, hiai ban ana zat teng, ka hong kik nawn chiang in ka hon din ding," achi hi.
english: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’

paite: Huai mi thumte lak ah, suamhatte tuakpa a ding in, invengte hi pen kua hi in na gingta a? achi hi.
english: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”

paite: Ama'n, "Huai atung a zahngaihna suahpa," achi hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Nang leng huai mah bang in va hih in," achi hi.
english: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”

paite: Huan azin kawm un khua khat ah alut a; numei khat amin Martha in ana zintun hi.
english: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

paite: Huai minu'n sanggam numei khat anei a, amin Mari ahi, huai minu Toupa khebul ah atu a, athu angaikhia hi.
english: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard his word.

paite: Martha in bel nna sem in abuai mahmah a; huchi in akiang a hong pai in, "Toupa, ka sanggamnu'n kei kia nasem ding a hon khiat khawk sa lou na hi maw? Hon huh ding in sawl in,” achi hi.
english: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.”

paite: Toupa'n, "Martha, Martha, thil tampi na ngaihtuah a, buai nei ve; thil khat kia akul ahi;
english: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,

paite: Mari in tan hoih atel a, huai laksak ding ahi kei," chi in adawng hi.
english: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu koi lai mun hiam ah athum a, athum khit in anungzui mi khat in akiang ah, "Toupa, Johan in anungzuite thumdan ahilh bang in hon hilh sam in," achi hi.
english: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Na thum chiang un hichibang in na chi ding uh, achi hi: Ka Pa uh, van a om, na min kizahtak hen, na gam hong tung hen.
english: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.

paite: Niteng in ka nek khop uh an hon pia in.
english: Give us day by day our daily bread.

paite: Ka khelhnate uh hon ngaidam in, kou leng kuapeuh bat hon neite ka ngaidam uhi; Khemna ah hon pilut ke'n. Gilou lak ah hon hu zaw in."
english: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Na lak ua kuahiam in lawm nei henla, zan lai in akiang a hoh in, 'Lawm, tanghou phel thum hon leitawisak ve.
english: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

paite: Ka lawm zin in ahon tawn a, ama a lui ding bangmah ka nei kei,' chi henla;
english: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’

paite: ama'n insung a pan in, 'Hon hihbuai ke'n; tu'n zaw kong khak ahi, ka tate leng ka kiang ah lupna ah a-ihmuta uh; thou in ka hong pe thei kei chi in dawng taleh, ka hon hilh ahi,'
english: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?

paite: alawm ahih ziak in thou in ava pe kei na a, anget ngutngut ziak in thou in adeih zahzah ava pe ding hi.
english: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.

paite: "Huchi in ka hon hilh ahi, 'Ngen un, piak in na om ding uh; zong un, na mu ding uh; kiu un, honsak in na om ding uh.
english: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.

paite: Kuapeuh angen in angah a, kuapeuh azong in amu a, akiu peuhmah honsak in a-om ding hi.'
english: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

paite: Nou lak a papen, ata in tanghou ngen taleh kua ahia suang pe ding? Ahihleh ngasa ngen taleh kua ahia gul pe ding?
