english: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?

paite: Ahihkeileh, aktui ngen taleh aikam ape dia hia?
english: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?

paite: Huchi in nou migilou in bawn na tate thil hoih piakdan na theih uleh, na Pa uh van a om in angente Kha Siangthou pe na tel in chia!" achi hi.
english: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”

paite: Huan Jesu'n dawi pau thei lou khat adelhkhia hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, dawi apawttak in pau thei lou ahong pauta; huchi in mipi'n lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
english: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.

paite: Himahleh akhen in, "Dawimang Beelzibul ziak in ei ve dawite adelhkhiak zel," achi uhi.
english: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

paite: Akhen in, amah ze-etna ding in, van a kipan chiamtehna angen uhi.
english: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.

paite: Ama'n angaihtuah uh athei a, akiang uah, "Koi gam leng amah kidou peuh amangthang a; inkuan khat leng amah kidou amangthang hi.
english: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.

paite: Setan leng amah akidouleh agam bangchi in adingkhe dia? Beelzibul ziak in dawite adelhkhia, na hon chi uh maw;
english: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.

paite: ke'n Beelzibul ziak a dawite delhkhia ka hihleh, na tate un kua ziak in ahia adelhkhiak uh? Huaiziak in amau noute hon vai hawmsak dingte ahi ding uh.
english: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

paite: Himahleh ke'n Pathian khutzung ziak a dawite delhkhia ka hihleh Pathian lalgam na kiang uah ahong tung khinta hi.
english: But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.

paite: "Mihat in hiamzat kim tawi a a-inn aven sung teng, asum bittak in a-om gige hi.
english: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.

paite: Himahleh amah sang a hatzaw in ahong sual a, azoh chiang in, amuan agalvan kim asut a, sum alaksak a ahawmzak zel hi.
english: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.

paite: "Kuapeuh ka lam a pang lou tuh hon dou ahi a, kuapeuh hon lakkhawmpih lou in ahihzak hi.
english: “He who is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.

paite: "Dawi nin paimi sung a kipan apawt in, khawlna zong in tui omlouhna mun peuh ah avakvak hi. Huan khawlna himhim amu kei a, ka pawtna inn ah ka kik nawn mai ding," achi hi.
english: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’

paite: Ava tun in phiatsiang leh zephoih in amu hi.
english: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.

paite: Huaitak in ava pai a, amah sang a gilouzaw dawi dang sagih ahon pi a, huai mi sung ah alut ua, ateng uhi. "Huai mihing omdan nanung, amasa sang in ahoih kei zaw tham hi," achi hi.
english: Then he goes and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai thute agen lai in, mipi lak ah numei khat akikoukhia a, akiang ah, "Nang hon painu gil leh, nang hon vaktu nawi ahampha e,” achi hi.
english: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”

paite: Ama'n bel, "Pathian thu za a zuite mihampha ahi zaw uh," achi hi.
english: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”

paite: Huan mipite akiang a ahong kikhop lai un, Jesu'n, "Hiai khang giloute ahi uh; chiamtehna azong ua; himahleh Jonah chiamtehna chih louh akiang uah chiamtehna piak ahi kei ding.
english: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

paite: Nineveh a mite a dia chiamtehna Jonah ahih bang in, Mihing Tapa leng hiai khangte chiamtehna ahong hi ding hi.
english: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.

paite: Thukhen ni chiang in, Simlam kumpinu hiai khangte kiang ah adingh dia, siam louh atangsak ding; Solomon pilna ngaikhe ding in kawlmong a kipan ahong ngal a; ngai un, Solomon sang a thupizaw hiai ah a-om hi.
english: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.

paite: Thukhen ni chiang in, Nineveh khua a mite hiai khangte kiang ah adingh ding ua, siam louh atangsak ding uh, Jonah thuhilh ziak in akisik ngal ua; ngai un, Jonah sang a thupizaw hiai ah a-om hi.
english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.

paite: "Kuamah in khawnvak akimu lou ding in asel kei a, loh nuai ah leng akoih ngei sam kei uh, alut mite'n vak amuhtheihna ding un akoihna ah akoih zel uhi.
english: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.

paite: Na pumpi khawnvak na mit ahi; na mit achiimleh na pumpi leng avek in avaksuak nak hi; achiim keileh bel na pumpi amial vek nak hi.
english: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.

paite: Huchi in na sung a vak om mial ana hi kha ding e, pilvang in.
english: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.

paite: Huchi in na pumpi koi lai peuh mial lou a, avek a avakkhiakleh khawnvak vak petpet in atatvak bang in avakkhe vek ding," achi hi.
english: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”

paite: Huan agen lai in Pharisai khat in amah kiang a an ne ding in achial a; huchi in alut a an ane hi.
english: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in and sat at the table.

paite: Pharisai in an um amuh in, an nek ma a khut asil louh lamdang asa mahmah hi.
english: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.

paite: Toupa'n akiang ah, "Nou Pharisaite'n nou leh kuang polam na silsiang ngeitak ua; na sunglam uh lah lepgukna leh gilou in adim hi.
english: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.

paite: Mihaite aw, polam bawlpa'n sunglam leng abawl kei a hia?
english: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?

paite: Himahleh na neihte uh migenthei kiang a thilthawnpiak ding in zang un; huchi in ngai un, nou a ding in bangkim asiang vek hi.
english: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.

paite: "Nou Pharisaite aw, na tung uh agik e; pudina, pardi leh anteh-louhing teng sawm-a-khat na pia ua, diktatna leh Pathian itna na limsak kei uhi; himahleh huaite ei ve na hih ding uh, adangte hih lou tuan lou in.
english: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

paite: Nou Pharisaite aw, na tung uh agik e! Sinagog ah tutphah hoihpente leh dawr mun a chibai bukte na ngaisang uh.
english: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.

paite: Laigelhmite leh Pharisai lepchiahte, na tung uh agik hi! Han chiamteh louh, atung a thei lou a mi apaina zel bang na hi uh," achi hi.
english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”

paite: Huan dan thei mi khat in akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, hiai thu na gen kou leng hon tai na hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”

paite: Huan ama'n, "Dan thei mite aw, nou leng na tung uh agik! Puakgik, puak haksa pipi mite na suan ua, nou lah huai puakgikte na khutzung khat un leng na khoih ngei kei uh.
english: He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.

paite: Na tung uh agik! Na pipute uh thahsa zawlneite han inn na lam ngal ua.
english: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

paite: Huchi in na pipute uh thilhihte na theihpih un na hoihsakpih uh ahi; amau athat ua, nou ahan innte na lam uhi.
english: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.

paite: Huaiziak in 'Pathian pilna in leng, akiang uah zawlneite leh sawltakte ka sawl dia, akhen athat ding ua, akhen asawi ding uh,' achi hi.
english: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,

paite: Zawlnei tengteng sisan, leitung pian tung a kipan a kisuah, hiai khangte tung ah phu alak theih ding in achi hi.
english: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation,

paite: Abel sisan suah a kipan, Zakariah, maitam leh tempul kikal a sisan suah tan in; ahi, ka hon hilh ahi, hiai khangte tung ah phu akila ding.
english: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.

paite: Nou dan theite aw, na tung uh agik e! Theihna chabi na paimangpih ua; nou lah na lut ngal kei ua, mi alut dingte na dal uhi,” achi hi.
english: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”

paite: Huai a kipan apawt in, lai-gelhmite leh Pharisaite'n amah atawng ua, thu chiteng gensak teitei tum in leh,
english: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him,

paite: apaukhelh zenzenleh mat tum in atang gige uhi.
english: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.

paite: Huchih lai a mipi sang tampi kiphu mawimawi zou hial a ahong kikhop un, Jesu'n amasapen in anungzuite kiang ah, "Pharisaite silngou, lepchiahna lak ah pilvang un,
english: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, “Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

paite: kilang lou ding a selguk bangmah a-om kei a; theih louh ding a iim leng bangmah a-om sam kei hi.
english: But there is nothing covered up that will not be revealed, nor hidden that will not be known.

paite: Huaiziak in mial a na gen peuh uh vak a zak in a-om ding; dantan sunggil a bilbul a na thugen uh intung vum ah tangkoupih in a-om ding hi.
english: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.

paite: "Huan ka lawmte aw, ka hon hilh ahi, pumpi that a, huai nung a bangmah dang hih nawn theiloute zaw, kihta kei un,
english: “I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

paite: Himahleh kua ahia na lauh ding uh ka hon hilhkhol ahi; ahihlup nung a leng Gehenna a paihtheihna thuneipa lau un.
english: But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear him.

paite: "Dal dangka nih in kawlgit nga azuak sek kei ua hia? Himahleh alak ua khat leng Pathian in amangngilh ngei kei hi.
english: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.

paite: Na luzang ua samzangte nangawn leng sim vek ahi uh. Lau kei un; kawlgit tampi sang in na manphazaw uhi.
english: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

paite: "Huan ka hon hilh ahi, mite ma a hon gum peuhmah Pathian angelte ma ah Mihing Tapa in agum sam ding hi.
english: “I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, the Son of Man will also confess before the angels of God;

paite: Himahleh mite ma a hon kitheihmohbawl peuhmah Pathian angelte ma ah ka kitheihmohbawl sam ding hi.
english: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of God’s angels.

paite: Mihing Tapa kalh a thu gen peuhmah agenkalhna ngaihdamsak ahi ding a; himahleh Kha Siangthou hilhial gensia zaw agensiatna ngaihdamsak ahi kei ding.
english: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

paite: "Sinagog a mite, vaihawmte, heutute ma a ahon pi hun chiang un, bangchi in bang thu in ka dawng dia, bang thu ka gen dia chi in lungkham kei un.
english: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will answer or what you will say;

paite: Huai huntak in, bang ahia na gen ding uh, Kha Siangthou in ahon hilh ding hi,” achi hi.
english: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”

paite: Mipi lak a khat in Jesu kiang ah, "Sinsakpa, ka u kiang ah gou hon hawm sam ding in hilh in," achi hi.
english: One of the multitude said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”

paite: Himahleh ama'n akiang ah, "Mihing, noumau tung ah kua'n ahia kei thukhenpa hiam tan seppa hiam a hon bawl?" achi hi.
english: But he said to him, “Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?”

paite: Akiang uah, "Pilvang unla, enna lak ah kiveng un; hauhna mihing damsan ahi kei," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man’s life doesn’t consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.”

paite: Huan akiang uah gentehna thu agen a, "Mihau kuahiam ahong pung mahmah hi.
english: He spoke a parable to them, saying, “The ground of a certain rich man produced abundantly.

paite: Huchi in akingaihtuah a, bangchibang in ka hih diam aw? Ka buh-le-bal koihkhawmna ding ka nei kei hi.
english: He reasoned within himself, saying, ‘What will I do, because I don’t have room to store my crops?’

paite: Hichibang in ka hih ding e, 'ka buh innte ka phel ding a, asang a lianzaw in ka lam dia, huai ah buh leh ka van tengteng ka koihkhawm ding.'
english: He said, ‘This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns, build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.

paite: Huan ka kha kiang ah, 'Kha aw, kum tampi sung daih ding tampi na kholta; khawl inla, ne in dawn inla, nuamtak in om in, ka chi ding,' achi hi.
english: I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.”’

paite: Himahleh, Pathian in akiang ah, 'Nang mihai, tuzan chiah na kha ahon laksak ding uh, huai na lamkhiakte, kua a ahita dia?'
english: “But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose will they be?’

paite: Amau a dia gou khol a, Pathian lam a hauloute huchi ahi uh," achi hi.
english: So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.”

paite: Huan anungzuite kiang ah, "Huaiziak in ka hon hilh ahi, bang ka ne diam aw? chi in na hinna thu uh leh bang silh in ka teng diam aw? chi in na pumpi thu uah lunghimoh kei un.
english: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.

paite: Nek ding sang in hinna athupizawa, puansilh sang in leng pumpi athupizaw hi.
english: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.

paite: Va-akte ngaihtuah dih uh, buh atuh kei ua, a-at sam kei uh; buhpang leh buh inn leng anei kei uh; himahleh Pathian in amaute avak hi; noute vasate sang a manphazaw na hi uh.
english: Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!

paite: Huan nou lak ah lunghimoh ziak a kua'n ahia ama dunglam tong khat a hihsang thei tuan?
english: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?

paite: Hiai lel leng hihtheiloute'n bangziak a thil dang lunghimoh nak na hi ua?
english: If then you aren’t able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?

paite: Lilite khandan ngaihtuah dih uh; nna asem kei ua, khau leng akhek kei uh; himahleh ka hon hilh ahi, Solomon hilhial leng athupina tengteng a akizep in, hiai lilite lak a khat tuk in zep in a-om kei hi.
english: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

paite: Huchi in gamlak loupa tuni a hing a, azing a thukkhuk a khul nawn mai ding bawn Pathian in hichi tel a azepleh, aw nou mi gintawmte, huaite sang in puansilh hon pe zaw na tel in chia!
english: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?

paite: Huan na nek ding uh, na dawn ding uh, zong kei un; ginglel in leng om sam kei un.
english: “Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.

paite: Khovel a namte'n huai thil tengteng azong uh; huai bang na kiphamoh uh chih na Pa un atheigige hi.
english: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.

paite: Himahleh Pathian kumpigam zong zaw un, huchi in huai thilte leng ahon piak behlap ding hi.
english: But seek God’s Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.

paite: "Pawltawmte aw, lau kei un; nou kiang a gam piak ding na Pa uh kipah lamtak ahi.
english: “Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.

paite: Na neih peuh uh zuak unla, migentheite kiang ah pia un; van ah guta naih phaklouhna ah, leikha in aneksiatlouhna ah, dangka ip lui theiloute, gou bei theiloute kibawl un.
english: Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.

paite: Na gou omna peuh ua na lungtang uh leng a-om ding ziak in.
english: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

paite: "Na kawng uh gak unla, na khawnvak uh leng desa diam in om un.
english: “Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.

paite: Mi'n apu uh kitenna ankuangluina a kipan ahong pai chiang a, kongkhak ahon kiuhtak a, hon thei pah ding a angak nilouh bang in, om un.
english: Be like men watching for their lord when he returns from the wedding feast, that when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.

paite: Apu uh ahong pai chiang in sikha na ngak nilouh a, amuhte ahampha uh; chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, ama'n akawng agak dia, amau an um ding in atusak ding a, a-nna uh asepsak ding hi.
english: Blessed are those servants whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you that he will dress himself, make them recline, and will come and serve them.

paite: Zan lai in hiam, thoh hun in hiam a hong a, huchibang a ahon muh, huai sikhate ahampha uhi.
english: They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch and finds them so.

paite: "Himahleh, hiai thei un, guta ahong pai ding inn neipa'n theileh aveng dia, a-inn aphenvangsak kei ding hi.
english: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into.

paite: Nou leng mansa in om un, na gintak louh dak un Mihing Tapa ahong pai ding hi,” achi hi.
english: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don’t expect him.”

paite: Huan Peter in, "Toupa, hiai gentehna koumau kia hia na hon hilh, mi tengteng?" achi hi.
english: Peter said to him, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?”

paite: Toupa'n, "Sumkempa ginom, piltak, apu in ahun teng a atan ding uh hawmsak ding a a-inkuanpihte tung a heutu a abawl ding kua pen ahi dia le?"
english: The Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?

paite: Apu hong pai chiang in sikha huchibang a hih a hon muh dingpa ahampha hi.
english: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.

paite: Diktak in ka hon hilh ahi, aneih tengteng tung a heutu ding in abawl ding hi.
english: Truly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

paite: Himahleh huai sikha in alungtang in, "Ka pu ahong zok kei ding e," chi in asikhanu, asikhapa, na vo taleh ne in dawn in na kham taleh;
english: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My lord delays his coming,’ and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink and to be drunken,

paite: huai sikha pu, agin louh ni, atheih louh lai in ahong ding a, tum nih ahon suah ding a, miginomloute tan bang atangsak ding hi.
english: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn’t expecting him and in an hour that he doesn’t know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.

paite: Sikha apu deihlam theigige napi a na kiging tuan lou a, apu deihlam a gamta loupa'n nakpitak a vuak atuak ding hi.
english: That servant who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,

paite: Himahleh theiloupi a vuakna tham a gamtapa'n awlchik a vuak atuak ding. Tampi piak a ommi kiang ah tampi phut in a-om ding a; tampi kepsakpa kiang ah atamsem aphut ding uhi.
english: but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.

paite: "Khovel a mei khesuk ding a hong pai ka hi; tu in leng kang pahleh chi na tel ing e!
english: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.

paite: Himahleh baptisma tan ding ka nei, huai ka hihtangtun mateng ka om nuam lou hi na mahmah e;
english: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!

paite: khovel a lem lengsak ding a hong pai hiam hon sa na hi uh maw? Hi dek lou hial, ka hon hilh ahi, kikhenna lengsak ding a hong pai ka hi zaw.
english: Do you think that I have come to give peace on the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.

paite: Tunung chiang in inkuan khat ah mi nga akidou ding uh, thum in nih, nih in thum.
english: For from now on, there will be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

paite: Akidou ding ua, pa in atapa, atapa in apa; anu in atanu, atanu in anu; atekpi in amou, amou in atekpi," achi hi.
english: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”

paite: Huan mipi kiang ah leng, "Tumlam a mei kai na muh uleh, 'vuah azu ding na chi pah ua; huan ahong zu ngei zel hi.'
english: He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.

paite: Sim huih nung na muh chiang un, 'khua alum ding, na chi ua, ahong lum hi.'
english: When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.

paite: Nou lepchiahte aw, khovel leh van omdan leng na genchian thei ngal ua, bang achia tu hun theichian siam lou na hi ua?
english: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t interpret this time?

paite: "Bang achia noumau in thudik kikhen lou na hi ua?
english: “Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?

paite: Hon hekpa toh thukhenpa kiang na zot lai un, lampi ah kileptheihna khat zong teitei in; huchi lou in zaw thukhenpa mai ah hon kailut ding a, thukhenpa'n miman heutu ahon mansak ding a, miman heutupa'n suangkul ah ahon khum kha ding hi.
english: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

paite: K'on hilh ahi, paihsa san khat nangawn na piak kim masiah, huai a kipan na pawt kei hial ding," achi hi.
english: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there until you have paid the very last penny.”

paite: Huai lai in, kuate hiam a-om ua, huaite'n Pilat in Galili mite asisan uh Pathian biakna sagohte lak a ahelsakte tungtang Jesu ahilh uhi.
english: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Huai Galili mite huchibang thil athuak ziak un Galili mi tengteng sang in migilou tuan hi un na gingta ua hia?
english: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?

paite: Hilou e, ka hon hilh ahi, nou leng na kisik kei uleh huchi mah bang in na mangthang vek ding uhi.
english: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.

paite: Huan Siloam insang in mi sawm-le-giat adelhlupte leng Jerusalem a om tengteng sang in migilouzaw hi un na gingta ua hia?
english: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them—do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?

paite: Hilou e, ka hon hilh ahi, nou leng na kisik kei uleh huchibang mah in na mangthang vek ding uh," chi in adawng hi.
english: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”

paite: Huan hiai gentehna agen a, "Kuahiam in agrephuan ah theipi kung khat asuan hi. Huan akung ah gah ahong zong a khat leng amu kei hi.
english: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it and found none.

paite: Huchi in grephuan kemmi kiang ah, 'Ngai in, kum thum sung hiai theipi kung ah agah ka va zong zel a, khat leng ka mu kei; phuk in; bangziak a mun dal a om nilouh ahia?' achi hi.
english: He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down! Why does it waste the soil?’

paite: Ama'n akiang ah 'Pu, tukum bek om henla, akimvel in ka tou ding a, ek in ka phungvuh lai dia;
english: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it and fertilize it.

paite: huchi a agahleh ahoih ding, agah kei laileh phuk mai in,' " achi hi.
english: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”

paite: Huan Sabbath ni in ama'n sinagog khat ah thu ahilh hi.
english: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.

paite: Ngai in, kum sawm-le-giat hatlouhna nei dawimat numei khat a-om a; huai mi akun kheukheu a, a-ut thu in adingtang thei kei hi.
english: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over and could in no way straighten herself up.

paite: Jesu'n amah amuhtak in asam a, akiang ah, "Numei, na hatlouhna in ahon khahta," achi hi.
english: When Jesus saw her, he called her and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”

paite: Huan atung ah akhut akoih a; thakhat in atang pah a, Pathian aphatta hi.
english: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God.

paite: Jesu'n Sabbath ni a mi ahihdam ziak in sinagog heutu aheh a, mipi ahoupih a, akiang uah, "Mihing nasepna ding ni guk a-om vo oi; huai sung in kihihdam un, Sabbath ni in hilou in," achi hi.
english: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”

paite: Toupa'n akiang ah, "Nou lepchiahte aw, Sabbath ni in na bawng uh hiam na sabiltung uh hiam a-an nekna a kipan phel in, tui dawn ding in na pikhe chiat zel uh hilou hia?
english: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead him away to water?

paite: Hiai numei, Abraham tanu ahi ngal a, ngai un, Setan in kum sawm-le-giat aman a, Sabbath ni in leng hiai gak phelsak louh dan ahi a hia?" chi in adawng hi.
english: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”

paite: Huai thute agen lai in amelma tengteng azum ua; mipi bel athil thupi hih tengteng ziak in akipak uhi.
english: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed; and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

paite: Huchi in ama'n, "Pathian lalgam bang ahia? Bang toh ka teh dia?
english: He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?

paite: Ankam chi tang khat mi'n alak a, huan a atheh bang ahi, huai ahong pou a, sing ahong hi a, ahiangte ah tungleng vasate agiak uh," achi hi.
english: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his own garden. It grew and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky live in its branches.”

paite: Huan "Pathian lalgam bang toh ka teh dia? achi nawn a.
english: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?

paite: Silngou numei in alak a, anbuang tehna thum lak a avek a athoh mateng aphum bang ahi," achi hi.
english: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”

paite: Huan ama'n thu hilh kawm zel in, Jerusalem kholam naih in kholian leh khoneute a tawn zel hi.
english: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.

paite: Kuahiam in akiang ah, "Hotdamte tawmchik ahi ding uh maw? achi hi.
english: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, kong kochik ah lut tum teitei un; ka hon hilh ahi, mi tampi in lut atum ding ua, alut thei kei ding uh.
english: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.

paite: Inn neipa athoh a, kong akhak nung in, nou apua a dingh in, 'Toupa, kong hon hon in, chi a kongkhak na hon kiuh chiang un, ama'n koilam mi na hi ua, hon thei lou ka hi' chi in nou ahon dawng ding hi.
english: When once the master of the house has risen up and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’

paite: Huai hun chiang in, nou, 'Na muh in ka ne ua, ka dawn ve ua oi, ka kongzing uah leng thu na hilh zel vo oi,' chi in na gen pan ding uh.
english: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’

paite: Ama'n, 'Ka hon hilh ahi, koilam mi na hi ua, ka hon thei ngei kei; nou thil gilou hihte aw, ka kiang a pan paimang vek un,' ahon chi ding hi.
english: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’

paite: Pathian lalgam sung a Abraham, Isak, Jakob leh zawlnei tengteng om na muh ua, nou polam a delhkhiak a om na hih lam uh na kitheih chiang un, na kap ding ua, ha na gawi ding uhi.
english: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.

paite: Huan suahlam, tumlam, simlam leh mallam a kipan mite ahong pai ding ua, Pathian lalgam ah ne in adawn ding uhi.
english: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.

paite: Huan ngai un, ananungpente leng amasapen a om a-om ding ua, amasapente leng ananungpen a om ding a-om uh," achi hi.
english: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”

paite: Huaitak in Pharisai kuate hiam ahong pai ua, akiang ah, "Pawt inla, hiai a kipan paimang in; Herod in thah hon sawm ahi,” achi uhi.
english: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Huai sehal kiang ah hiai thu va gen un, 'Ngai in, tuni toh, zingchiang toh dawite ka delhkhe dia, natnate leng ka hihdam lai dia, ani thum ni in ka zou ding.
english: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.

paite: Akoi abang hitaleh tuni toh, zingchiang toh, ani thum ni toh ka pai zel lai ding; Jerusalem kho polam ah zawlnei amanthat thil hi thei hilou ahi.'
english: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’

paite: Aw Jerusalem, Jerusalem; zawlneite that, na kiang a hon sawlte suang a na denglum; akpi in anoute akha nuai a a-opkhum bang in na tate bangzah vei opkhum ka tum a? Himahleh na ut kei uhi.
english: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!

paite: En in, na inn avuak a taihsan in a-omta. Ka hon hilh ahi, 'Toupa min a hong pai ahampha, na chih masiah na hon mu kei ding, " achi hi.
english: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Sabbath ni in Pharisai vaihawmmi khat inn a an ne ding a ahoh in ana enkhia uhi.
english: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.

paite: Huan ngai in ama ah damlou chibawk kuahiam a-om hi.
english: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n dan thei mi leh Pharisaite ahoupih a, akiang uah, "Sabbath ni in hihdam asiang hia, siang lou?" achi hi.
english: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”

paite: Amau adai dide uhi. Ama'n damlou alawng a, hihdam in apaisakta hi.
english: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Na lak uah kuahiam in sabiltung hiam bawngtal hiam nei unla, Sabbath ni in tuikul sung ah ke taleh kua ahia kaikhe pah lou ding?" achi hi.
english: He answered them, “Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”

paite: Huai thu adawng thei kei uhi.
english: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.

paite: Huan amichialte un tutna mun hoihpen atel zel uh amu a, akiang uah gentehna agen hi,
english: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,

paite: "Kitenna an ne ding a kuapeuh in ahon sap chiang in tutna mun hoihpen ah tu kei un; huchi lou in zaw noute sang a mizahtakhuai zaw ana sam kha dia, huchi in ahon sampa'n,
english: “When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,

paite: 'Hiai mi tutna ding awn in,' ahon chi dia; huan nang zumpi in tutna mun niampen ah na tu nawn phing ding hi.
english: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.

paite: Ahon sap chiang in tutna mun niampen ah na va tu zaw ding a; huchi in ahon sampa ahong chiang in, na kiang ah, 'Lawm, tutna mun hoih deuh ah tu in, ahon chi thei ding hi.' Huchi in na an umpihte mitmuh in pahtawi in na om ding hi.
english: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.

paite: Kingaisang peuhmah aneu ding a; kingaineu pahtawi a om ding ahih ziak in," achi hi.
english: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”

paite: Huan asampa kiang ah leng, “Sun an hiam nitak an hiam a ankuang na lui chiang in, na lawmte, na unaute, na sanggamte, na inveng mihaute na sam kei ding hi; huchi lou in zaw ahon sam thuk ding ua, ahon thuk chitchiat kha ding uh.
english: He also said to the one who had invited him, “When you make a dinner or a supper, don’t call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.

paite: Ankuang na lui chiang in, tagahte, piangsualte, khebaite, mittawte, na sam zaw ding hi.
english: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;

paite: Huchi in huaite'n thukna ding aneih louh ziak un, na hampha ding; midikte thohnawn chiang a thukkik na hih ding ziak in," achi hi.
english: and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”

paite: Huan a-an umpih kuahiam in huai thu aza a, akiang ah, "Pathian lalgam a an ne ding mi ahampha," achi hi.
english: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in God’s Kingdom!”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang ah, “Mi kuahiam in nitak in ankuang thupi alui a, mi tampi asam hi.
english: But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.

paite: An nek hun in, amisapte kiang ah, 'Hong paita un, bangkim amanta,' chi ding in asikha khat asawl hi.
english: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, ‘Come, for everything is ready now.’

paite: Huan avek un thukhat sat in paulam anei chiat uhi. Amasapen in akiang ah, 'Lou ka na lei a, a-en dia ka hoh kiphamoh ahi; hon hehpih inla, hon ngaisiam hen,' achi hi.
english: They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.’

paite: Midang in 'Bawngtal tuak nga ka na lei a, asiat aphat chian ding in ka kuan ding a, hon hehpih inla, hon ngaisiam hen,' achi hi.
english: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’

paite: Huan midang in, 'Zi ka na nei a, huaiziak in ka hoh thei kei,' achi hi.
english: “Another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I can’t come.’

paite: "Huan sikha in apu kiang ah, huai thute ava hilh hi. Huan inn neipa aheh a, asikha kiang ah, 'Kintak in pawt inla, kongzing leh kongkawm kal ah pai inla, mizawngte leh poihlongte leh mittawte leh khebaite hiai lai ah hon pilut in,' achi hi.
english: “That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.’

paite: Huan asikha in, 'Pu, na hon thupiak bang in ka hih khin a, himahleh mun awng lailai veh aw,' achi hi.
english: “The servant said, ‘Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.’

paite: Apu in, sikha kiang ah, 'Pawt inla, lamlian leh daikil kal ah pai inla, ka inn dimna ding in mi hon sawllut teitei in achi hi.'
english: “The lord said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

paite: K'on hilh ahi, ka misapte khat in leng ka ankuang lui achiam kei hial ding," achi hi.
english: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper. For many are called, but few are chosen.’”

paite: Huan mipi tampitakte akiang ah ahoh ua; huchi in amah akihei a, akiang uah,
english: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,

paite: "Kuapeuh ka kiang a hong pai in anu leh apa leh azi leh atate leh a-unaute leh asanggamnu leh ama hinna nangawn ahuat keileh ka nungzui ahi thei kei ding.
english: “If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can’t be my disciple.

paite: Kuapeuh ama kros pua a hon zui lou ka nungzui tak ahi thei kei ding.
english: Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross and come after me, can’t be my disciple.

paite: "Nou lak a kuahiam in insang lam tum unla, kua ahia tu masa a, lam zohna khop sum na neih uleh neih louh thei ding a, abei ding zah sut masa lou ding?
english: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?

paite: Huchi lou in zaw, suangphum khin phot a, alam zoh theih keileh a-en peuh in,
english: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation and isn’t able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,

paite: 'Hiai mi'n gel napi in azou thei ngal kei chi in anuihsan ding uh.'
english: saying, ‘This man began to build and wasn’t able to finish.’

paite: "Huan kumpipa kua'n ahia kumpipa dang dou ding a akuan ding in, tu masa a, mi singnih toh amah dou ding a hong, mi singkhat toh atuah ngam ding leh ding louh, mi dong lou ding?
english: Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?

paite: Huchi ahih kei vanglakleh kumpipa dang gamlapi a a-om lai in, kituahna lam thuchiam ngen ding in palai asawl ding hi.
english: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy and asks for conditions of peace.

paite: Huchibang in, nou lak ah kuapeuh aneih tengteng paisan lou ka nungzui ahi thei kei ding hi.
english: So therefore, whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.

paite: "Chi ahoih a, himahleh chi apen khit in, bang in ahih al nawn dia?
english: “Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?

paite: Lei a ding in ahoih kei; ekvum ding in leng ahoih sam kei; mi'n apaikhia uhi. Kuapeuh zakna ding a bil nei in za hen," achi hi.
english: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

paite: Huan siahkhon mite leh mikhialte tengteng in athu za ding in akiang ahon zuan uhi.
english: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.

paite: Pharisaite leh laigelhmite'n, "Hiai mi'n mikhialte akithuahpih a, akiang uah an ane chi in aphun tuak uhi."
english: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”

paite: Huchi in ama'n akiang uah hiai gentehna agen hi.
english: He told them this parable:

paite: "Nou lak ah kuahiam in belam zakhat nei henla, alak ua khat mangsak taleh gamdai ah sawmkua-le-kuate nusia in, amang pen amuh nawn masiah kua ahia zong lou ding?
english: “Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?

paite: Huan amuh nawn in kipaktak in aliangzang ah apua hi.
english: When he has found it, he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

paite: Inn atuntak in, alawmte leh avengte asamkhawm a, akiang uah, 'Hon kipahpih un, ka belam mang ka mu nawnta,' achi hi.
english: When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’

paite: K'on hilh ahi, huchi mah bang in, midik sawmkua-le-kua kisik tuan ding neiloute sang in mikhial khat kisik, tung a van a mi akipahna athupizaw ding hi.
english: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.

paite: "Huan numei kuapeuh in makhai sawm nei in khat mangsak taleh khawnvak de in, inn phiat in amuh nawn masiah kua ahia hoihtak a zong lou ding?
english: “Or what woman, if she had ten drachma coins, if she lost one drachma coin, wouldn’t light a lamp, sweep the house, and seek diligently until she found it?

paite: Huan amuh nawn in, alawmte leh avengte asamkhawm a, 'Hon kipahpih un, ka makhai mansak ka mu nawnta,' achi hi.
english: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost!’

paite: K'on hilh ahi, huchi mah bang in, Pathian angelte ma ah, mikhial khat kisik tung ah kipahna a-om nak hi," achi hi.
english: Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”

paite: "Mi kuahiam in tapa nih anei hi:
english: He said, “A certain man had two sons.

paite: Anaupangzaw pen in, apa kiang ah, 'Pa, gou ka tan ding a tuak teng hon pia in,' achi hi. Huchi in akiang uah agoute ahawmta hi.
english: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of your property.’ So he divided his livelihood between them.

paite: Huan ni sawt lou nung in atapa naupangzaw pen in atan ding tuak tengteng alakhawm vek a, gam gamlapi ah azinta a, huai ah nuamtat lua in agoute amawk zatmangta hi.
english: Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his property with riotous living.

paite: Huan azatbei zoh vektak in, huai gam ah kial thupitak ahong tung a; nek ding ahong tasamta hi.
english: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.

paite: Huchi in huai gammi khat ava bel a; ama'n vok an pe ding in alou ah asawl hi.
english: He went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.

paite: Huan thil hawng vok in anekte ua kihihvah a-ut mahmah a; kuamah in lah bangmah ape ngal kei ua.
english: He wanted to fill his belly with the pods that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.

paite: Huan amah-le-amah ahong kiphawkkhiaktak in, 'Ka pa kiang a kilohte an nek seng louh atamtam maizen toh, kei lah hiai ah gilkial a si ding himai veng in!'
english: But when he came to himself, he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying with hunger!

paite: Ka thou ding a, ka pa kiang ah ka pai ding a, akiang ah, 'Pa, van a tung ah leh nangmah mitmuh in thil ka hihkhial; na tapa a seh tak ka hita kei;
english: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight.

paite: na kiang a kiloh khat bang in hon bawl in, ka chi ding,' achi hi.
english: I am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me as one of your hired servants.”’

paite: Huchi in athou a, apa kiang ah apaita hi. Huan gamlapi a a-om lai in, apa'n ana mu a, alainat mahmah a, atai a, ava pom a, atawp tonton hi.
english: “He arose and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him and was moved with compassion, and ran, fell on his neck, and kissed him.

paite: Huan atapa in akiang ah, 'Pa, van a tung ah leh nangmah mitmuh in thil ka hihkhial; na tapa a seh tak ka hita kei,' achi hi.
english: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’

paite: Himahleh apa'n asikhate kiang ah, 'Puan hoihpen hon lakhe pah unla, silhsak un; akhut ah zungbuh, akhepek ah khedap bunsak un;
english: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet.

paite: bawngnou thautak hon la unla; gou un, i ne ding ua, nopbawl in i om ding uh.
english: Bring the fattened calf, kill it, and let’s eat and celebrate;

paite: Hiai ka tapa asi a, ahong hing nawnta hi; amang a, i mu nawnta uhi,' achi a. Huchi in kipaktak in a-om panta ua.
english: for this, my son, was dead and is alive again. He was lost and is found.’ Then they began to celebrate.

paite: "Huan atapa upazaw pen lou ah a-om hi; inn ahong tun kuan in bangpeuh tumging leh lam husa azata hi.
english: “Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near to the house, he heard music and dancing.

paite: Huchi in asikha khat asam a, tua bang ahia? chi in adong hi.
english: He called one of the servants to him and asked what was going on.

paite: Huan ama'n akiang ah, 'Na nau ahong tung a, damtak a amuh nawn ziak in na pa'n bawngnou thautak agou hi,' achi a.
english: He said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has received him back safe and healthy.’

paite: "Amah aheh a, alut nuamta kei hi. Huchi in apa ahong pawtkhia a, amah ahong sam hi.
english: But he was angry and would not go in. Therefore his father came out and begged him.

paite: Himahleh ama'n apa kiang ah, 'Ngai in, kum hiai zah na nna semta ing a, na thu a lah talek ngei lou ing a; ka lawmte toh kipahna ka bawlna ding in kelnou khat leng na hon pe ngei kei hi.
english: But he answered his father, ‘Behold, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours, but you never gave me a goat, that I might celebrate with my friends.

paite: Himahleh hiai na tapa kizuakte kiang a na sum nemang vekpa ahong tuntak a maw, amah a ding a bawngnou thautak na goh!' chi in adawng hi.
english: But when this your son came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.’

paite: Huan ama'n akiang ah, 'Ka tapa, ka kiang a om gige hi chin a, ka neih tengteng nang a ahi.'
english: “He said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.

paite: Kipak leh nuamtak a om ding ahi; hiai na nau asi a; ahong hing nawn a; amang a, i mu nawnta ahi,” achi hi.
english: But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad, for this, your brother, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’”

paite: Huan Jesu'n anungzuite kiang ah hiai thu leng agen a, "Mi sumhau kuahiam in sumkemmi anei a; huai mi'n asum azatbeisak thu ah akiang ah ahek uhi.
english: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.

paite: Huchi in ama'n amah asam a, akiang ah, 'Na tungtang thu ka zak bangchidan ahia? Na sumkep thu hon pelut in; tuban siah sumkem in na pang thei nawn kei ding,' achi hi.
english: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’

paite: Sumkempa'n, alungsim in, 'Ka pu in ka sumkep hon tawpsak ding hi a, bangchi in ka hihta dia le? Lei toh ka ngap kei a, khutdoh lah ka zum ngal hi.
english: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.

paite: Sumkep ahon tawpsak hun chiang in a-innte ua hon omsak theihna ding un ka hihdan ding ka theita,' achi hi.
english: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’

paite: "Huchi in atoupa sumbate asam chiat a, amasapen kiang ah, 'Ka pu lak ah bangzah na ba a?' achi hi.
english: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’

paite: Ama'n, 'Thau tehna dan zakhat, achi a, ama'n akiang ah, na lai la inla tu meng inla, sawmnga gelh in,' achi hi.
english: He said, ‘A hundred batos of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’

paite: Midang kiang ah, 'Nang bangzah na ba a?' achi hi. Ama'n buh tehna dan zakhat, achi a, ama'n akiang ah, 'Na lai la inla, sawmgiat gelh in,' achi hi.
english: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred cors of wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’

paite: "Huan apu in sumkempa diklou alemtheih ziak in aphat hi; vak tate sang in hiai khovel tate atulai thu ua apil zawk ziak un.
english: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.

paite: "K'on hilh ahi, diktatlouhna sum in nou a ding in lawm bawl un, sum abei hun chiang a tangtawn a omna a ahon omsakna ding un.
english: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.

paite: 'Kuapeuh tawmchik tung a ginom lou tampi tung ah leng aginom kei uhi.'
english: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.

paite: Sumlem tung a bawn na ginom kei uleh kua'n ahia hauhna dik noute hon kemsak ding?
english: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

paite: Midang atung a bawn na ginom kei un, noumau akua in hon peta dia?
english: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?

paite: "Sikha kuamah in heutu nih nna asemkop thei kei, khat hua in khat adeih ding, ahihkeileh khat gum in khat amusit ding, Pathian leh sum nna na semkop thei kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will hold to one and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.”

paite: Huan Pharisai sum deihtate'n huai thu tengteng aza ua, anuihsan uhi.
english: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.

paite: Huchi in ama'n akiang uah, "Mi mitmuh a kisiamtangsak na hi uh, himahleh Pathian in na lungtang uh athei a; mihing lak a apahtawi uh Pathian mitmuh in kihhuaipi ahi."
english: He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.

paite: "Dan leh Zawlneite, Johan hong om tan in a-om a; huai nungsiah Pathian lalgam tanchinhoih agen ua, michih in pawnglut asawm uhi.
english: “The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of God’s Kingdom is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.

paite: Himahleh dan thu sutvom neuchik aman sang in lei leh van amanthat abaihlamzaw hi."
english: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.

paite: "Kuapeuh azi ma a, adang nei, angkawm ahi; kuapeuh mi zi maksa nei angkawm ahi.”
english: “Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.

paite: "Huan mihausa kuahiam a-om a, puan sandup leh puanmalngat asilh a, niteng in nuamsatak in a-om hi.
english: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.

paite: Amin Lazaras khutdoh, meima a pumdim, akongkhak bul ah alum hi.
english: A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was taken to his gate, full of sores,

paite: Mihausa dohkan a khatehnen kiate nek alunggulh a; uite'n ameimate aliahsak uhi."
english: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.

paite: "Huan hichi ahong hi a, khutdohpa asi a, angelte'n apaipih ua, Abraham angsung ah akoih uhi. Mihausa leng asi a, vui in a-omta hi.
english: The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died and was buried.

paite: Huan misikhua ah gimthuak in a-om a, adaktouhleh gamlapi a Abraham leh a-angsung a Lazaras om amuta hi.
english: In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.

paite: Akikou a, 'Pa Abraham, ka tung ah zahngai in, Lazaras hon sawl inla, tui ah akhutzung muk diah henla, ka lei hihvotna ding in; hiai meikuang ah ka gim mahmah hi, " achi hi.
english: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’

paite: "Himahleh Abraham in, 'Ka tapa, nang na dam lai in, thil hoih na mu a, huchi mah bang in Lazaras in thil hoih lou amuh thei tanla; himahleh tu'n ah amah zaw hiai ah khamuangtak in a-om a, nang zaw gim na hita ve.
english: “But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But here he is now comforted and you are in anguish.

paite: Huai lou leng hiai a kipan a nou kiang a paitumte apai theihlouhna ding un leh kuamah huai a kipan kou kiang a ahong kai theihlouhna ding in, kou leh nou kikal ah guam thupitak koihdet in a-om hi,' " achi hi.
english: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over from there to us.’

paite: Huan ama'n, "Ahihleh, pa, amah ka pa inn ah paisak ding bek in, ka hon ngen hi.
english: “He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house—

paite: Sanggam pasal nga ka nei a; hiai gimthuakna mun ah ahong pai kha ding uh chih akiang uah va hilhleh," achi hi.
english: for I have five brothers—that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’

paite: "Abraham in, 'Mosi leh zawlneite anei ve ua oi; huai mite thu ngai le uh ake,' achi hi.
english: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’

paite: Huan ama'n pa Abraham, 'Hilou e; misi lak a mi hilhial akiang uah hohleh akisik ding uh,' achi hi.
english: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, 'Mosi leh zawlneite thu angaih kei un zaw, misi lak a mi thounawn hoh mahleh leng ataksang tuan kei ding uh, " achi hi.
english: “He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead.’”

paite: Huan Jesu'n anungzuite kiang ah, "Puknate om lou thei ahi kei; himahleh puknate omsakpa tung agik hi!
english: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!

paite: Hiai mineute lak a khat leng hihpuk sang in, angawng ah buhgawina suang oksak in, tuipi ah kipaileh amah a ding in ahoihzaw ding hi.
english: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.

paite: Pilvang un, na unau in thil ahihkhelhleh taihilh in; akisikleh ngaidam in.
english: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.

paite: Ni khat in na tung ah sagihvei thil hihkhial in sagihvei, ka kisik, chi a nang lam a ahong kihei nawnleh na ngaihdam ding ahi," achi hi.
english: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”

paite: Huan sawltakte'n Toupa kiang ah, "Ka ginna uh khangsak in," achi uhi.
english: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”

paite: Toupa'n, "Ankam tang khat bang ginna na neih uleh, hiai singtheimi kung kiang ah, na kibotkhia inla, tuipi ah na kisuan in, na chi ding ua, na thu uh amang mai ding hi.
english: The Lord said, “If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, ‘Be uprooted and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.

paite: "Himahleh nou lak ah kuapeuh in lei let hiam, belamching hiam sikha nei unla, ahong vaipaitak in, an hong um pah aw, kua ahia nou lak ana chi ding?
english: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say when he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and sit down at the table’?

paite: 'Ka nek ding hon bawlsak inla, puan teng inla, ka nek a ka dawn zoh masiah ka nek bawl in; huai khit chiang in nang ne in dawn in, na lak ua kua ahia na chi zaw lou ding?'
english: Wouldn’t he rather tell him, ‘Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink’?

paite: Na thu bang ua ahih ziak in na sikha kiang ah kipahthu na gen ngei ua hia?
english: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.

paite: Huchibang in 'Nou leng na kiang ua thupiak tengteng bang a na hih nung un, sikha phatuam lou ka hi uh, ka hih ding him uh ahi ka hih uh,' chi un,” achi hi.
english: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jerusalem kholam a apai lai in, Samaria leh Galili gam atawn hi.
english: As he was on his way to Jerusalem, he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.

paite: Huan koi khua hiam a alut ding in, miphak ngenta, sawm in ana dawn uh a, huaite'n gamlatak a dingh in, aw ngaihtak in,
english: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.

paite: "Jesu, Heutupa, ka tung uah zahngai in," achi uhi.
english: They lifted up their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”

paite: Ama'n amau amuh in, akiang uah, "Siampute kiang ah va kilak un," achi hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, apai lai un ahong siang chiat uhi.
english: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.

paite: Huan alak ua khat in dam chih akitheih in, aw ngaihtak a Pathian phat kawm in akik nawnta hi.
english: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.

paite: Huan akhebul ah abokkhup a, akipahna thu agen hi; huai mi Samari mi ahi.
english: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n, "Mi sawm hong siangta hilou na hi uh maw? Kuate koi ah?" chi in adong hi.
english: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?

paite: "Pathian phat ding a kik nawn, hiai theih louh mi kia lou ngal kuamah muh a om lou uhia?" achi hi.
english: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?”

paite: Akiang ah, "Thou inla, paita in; na ginna na dampih hi," achi hi.
english: Then he said to him, “Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.”

paite: Pharisaite'n Pathian lalgam hong tun hun ding adot ziak un, akiang uah, "Pathian lalgam muh theih in ahong tung kei,
english: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation;

paite: 'En un, hiai ah hiam, huai ah hiam, achi kei ding uh,' ngai un, Pathian lalgam na lak uah a-om," chi in adawng hi.
english: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”

paite: Huan nungzuite kiang ah, "Mihing Tapa dam lai ni, ni khat bek na muhnop ni uh ahong om ding a himahleh na mu kei ding uh.
english: He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.

paite: Na kiang uah, 'Hiai ah en un, hiam pam ah en un, ahon chi ding ua; paikhe kei unla, amau leng zui kei un,
english: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away or follow after them,

paite: van nuai lehlam a khua aphiat a, van nuai lehlam tanpha a avak zel bang in Mihing Tapa ahong pai ni in a-om ding ahi ngal a.'
english: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of one part under the sky, shines to another part under the sky, so will the Son of Man be in his day.

paite: Himahleh huai ma in thil tamtak athuak ding a, hiai khangte deih louh in a-om ding hi.
english: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

paite: Noah dam lai a thil omdan bang in, Mihing Tapa ahong pai nawn hun chiang in a-om sam ding hi.
english: As it was in the days of Noah, even so it will also be in the days of the Son of Man.

paite: Noah long a alut a, tui ahong let a, avek ua ahihlup khit ni atun masiah, ane un adawn ua, zi leh pasal in akinei uhi.
english: They ate, they drank, they married, and they were given in marriage until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came and destroyed them all.

paite: Huchibang in Lot dam lai in ahong om a; ane un adawn ua, alei un azuak ua, asuan un alam uhi.
english: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

paite: Himahleh Sodom a kipan Lot apawt ni in van a kipan mei leh kaat azu a, avek un ahihlumta hi.
english: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.

paite: Huchibang in Mihing Tapa ahong kilak ni in a-om ding hi.
english: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.

paite: "Huai ni in kuamah insung a avan om, ama inn tung a om, va la ding in kum kei heh; lou a om leng pai kei hen.
english: In that day, he who will be on the housetop and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.

paite: Lot zi theigige un.
english: Remember Lot’s wife!

paite: Kuapeuh ahinna humbit sawm in amansuah ding a kuapeuh ahinna tan in ahumbit ding hi.
english: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.

paite: K'on hilh ahi, huai zan in lupna khat ah mi nih alum ding ua, khat lak in a-om ding a, khat nutsiat in a-om ding hi.
english: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.

paite: Buh gawizan in numei nih a-om ding ua, khat lak in a-om dia, khat nutsiat in a-om ding hi.
english: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken and the other will be left.”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Toupa, koi ah eita?" chi in adong uhi. Ama'n akiang uah, "Saluang omna peuh ah musane leng akikhawm ding uh," achi hi.
english: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there the vultures will also be gathered together.”

paite: Huan lunglel lou a thum gige ding ahi chih atheihna ding un akiang uah gentehna agen hi.
english: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray and not give up,

paite: "Koi lai khua hiam ah thukhenmi khat a-om a, huai mi'n Pathian alau kei a, mihing leng khawk asa kei hi.
english: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect man.

paite: Huai khua ah meithai khat a-om a; ama'n, ka melma tung ah phu hon laksak in, chi in akiang ah ahoh zihzeh hi.
english: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’

paite: Huan amah sawt khop a-ut kei a; himahleh anung in alungsim in 'Pathian lau lou in mihing khawk sa kei mah leng;
english: He wouldn’t for a while; but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect man,

paite: hiai meithainu'n hon hihbuai ziak in aphu ka laksak mai ding, huchi lou in zaw, hong zihzeh taleh ahon hihbuai den kha ding, achi hi.
english: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”

paite: "Huan Toupa mah in, thukhen midiktat lou thugen za un.
english: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.

paite: 'Atung uah dohzou tadih mahleh leng amitel, asun-azan a amah samte phu Pathian in alaksak kei dia hia?'
english: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?

paite: K'on hilh ahi, aphu uh alaksak pah ding. Himahleh Mihing Tapa ahong pai chiang in leitung ah huai bang ginna ahon mu diam?" achi hi.
english: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”

paite: Huan midiktat hih kigingta a, midang tengteng musit kuate hiam kiang ah hiai gentehna leng agen hi.
english: He also spoke this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others:

paite: "Tempul ah thum ding in mi nih ahohtou ua; khat Pharisai ahi a, khat siahkhonmi ahi.
english: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.

paite: "Pharisai adingh a, amah kia in hichibang in athum hi: 'Pathian, midang negute, dikloute, angkawmte bang ka hih louh ziak leh hiai siahkhonmi bang leng ka hih louh ziak in na tung ah ka kipak hi.'
english: The Pharisee stood and prayed by himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men: extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.

paite: Nipikal teng in nihvei an ka ngawl zel; ka neih teng sawm-a-khat ka pe zel," achi hi.
english: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’

paite: "Siahkhonmi'n bel gamlatak a dingh in, van lam leng adak ngam kei a, 'Pathian, kei mikhial, ka tung ah zahngai in,' chi in a-awm akitum hi.
english: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his chest, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’

paite: K'on hilh ahi, amasa sang in huai mi pen siamtang in a-inn ah apaikikta hi. Kingai thupi peuh aniam ding ua, kingainiam pahtawi in a-om ding," achi hi.
english: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”

paite: Huan akhoih ding in akiang ah anaupang neute uh ahon pi ua; nungzuite'n huai amuhtak un ana tai uhi.
english: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n akiang ah amaute asam a, "Naupang neute ka kiang ah hon paisak unla, kham kei un, Pathian lalgam huchibang mite a ahi ngal a.
english: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh Pathian lalgam naupang neu in akipahpih bang a kipahpih lou asung ah alut kei hial ding," achi hi.
english: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

paite: Vaihawmmi kuahiam in akiang ah, "Sinsakpa hoih, tangtawn hinna tanna ding in bang ka hih dia?" chi in adong hi.
english: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Bangziak a hoih hon chi? Mi khat kia ngal lou kuamah hoih a-om kei, huai tuh Pathian ahi.
english: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one: God.

paite: Thupiakte: Ang kawm ke'n, Tual that ke'n, Gu ke'n, Hek ke'n, Na nu leh pa zahtak in, chihte, na thei vele," achi hi.
english: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”

paite: Ama'n, "Huai tengteng ka tuailai chil a kipan ka zui zel," achi hi.
english: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n huai azaktak in akiang ah, "Tu in thil khat na sam lai; na neih tengteng zuak inla, gentheite kiang ah hawm in, huchi in van ah gou na nei ding; huan hong pai inla, hon zui in," achi hi.
english: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me.”

paite: Amah bel, huai thute azak in, ahauh mahmah ziak in alungkham mahmah hi.
english: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n amah a-en a, "Mihaute Pathian lalgam lut haksa hi na e!
english: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

paite: Pathian lalgam a mihausa alut sang in phimbil a sangawngsau lutsuak abaihlamzaw,” achi hi.
english: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

paite: Huai thu zate'n, "Huchi ahih in kua hotdam in a-om thei dia?" achi uhi.
english: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”

paite: Ama'n, "Mihing hih vual louh Pathian hihtheih ahi,” achi hi.
english: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”

paite: Peter in, "Ngai in, kou bangkim nusia in ka hon zui uh," achi hi.
english: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, 'Kuapeuh Pathian lalgam ziak a, inn hiam, zi hiam, unaute hiam, nu le pa hiam, tate hiam paisan photphot,
english: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake,

paite: tu damsung mahmah in asang a tamzaw mu lou ding kuamah a-om kei, hun hong tung lai ding a tangtawn hinna toh,' " achi hi.
english: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”

paite: Huan sawm-le-nihte akiang ah apituam a, akiang uah, "Ngai un, Jerusalem a hohtou ding i hi ua; zawlneite thugelh tengteng Mihing Tapa tung ah atung ding hi.
english: He took the twelve aside and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.

paite: Zentelte kiang ah piak in a-om ding a, nuihza bawlna in azang ding uh, zumhuaitak in abawl ding ua, achilphih ding uhi.
english: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.

paite: Huan avo ding ua, athat ding uh; ni thum ni in athounawn ding," achi hi.
english: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”

paite: Huai thute atheisiam kei ua, athugen alak uah sel in a-om, bang gen ahia chih leng athei kei uh.
english: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jeriko atun ding kuan in, mittaw kuahiam lam gei ah khutdoh in ana tu hi.
english: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.

paite: Huai mi'n mipi paiging aza a, bangchi thu ahia chih adong hi.
english: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.

paite: Amau, "Nazaret Jesu apai ahi," chih ahilh uhi. 38 Huchi in "Jesu, David Tapa, ka tung ah zahngai in," chi in akikou hi.
english: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.

paite: Amasate'n dai ding in atai ua, himahleh, "David Tapa, ka tung ah zahngai in," chi in akikou nak semsem hi.
english: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

paite: Huchi in Jesu adingh a, akiang a hon pi ding in thu apia hi.
english: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

paite: Huchi in Jesu adingh a, akiang a hon pi ding in thu apia hi.
english: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,

paite: Akiang ahong tun in, "Na tung ah bangchi a ka hih ahia na deih?" achi a, ana dong hi. Ama'n, "Toupa, muh theih ka ut," achi hi.
english: “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Mutheita in, na ginna dampih na hi," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”

paite: Huan thakhat in amu thei pah a, Pathian phat kawm zel in amah azuita hi; huan mi tengteng in huai amuh un, Pathian aphat uhi.
english: Immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.

paite: Jeriko ah Jesu alut a, paisuak ding in akisa hi.
english: He entered and was passing through Jericho.

paite: Ngai in, mi khat amin Zakai a-om a; huai mi tuh siahkhon heutu ahi; amah ahausa ngial hi.
english: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.

paite: Jesu mi bangchibang hiam chi in muh atum a; amah lah aniam ngal a, mipi ziak in amu thei kei hi.
english: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.

paite: Huchi in amatai a, a-en ding in theipi kung ah akal a; huai lampi ahon tot ding ahi ngal a.
english: He ran on ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was going to pass that way.

paite: Jesu, huai mun atun in adak a, akiang ah, "Zakai, hong kum meng in; tuni in na inn a hong tung ding ka hi," achi hi.
english: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”

paite: Huan kintak in akum a, kipaktak in amah azintunta hi.
english: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.

paite: Huai amuhtak un avek un, "Mikhialte kiang a tung ding in alutta ve," chi in aphun uhi.
english: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”

paite: Zakai adingh a, Toupa kiang ah, "Ngai in, Toupa, ka sum kimkhat tagahte kiang ah ka pe ding a; kua lak ah leng thil bangpeuh na negu taleng, aleh li in ka din ding," achi hi.
english: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Tuni in hiai inn ah hotdamna ahong tungta; amah leng Abraham tapa ahi ngal a.
english: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.

paite: Mangthangte zong a hondam ding in Mihing Tapa hong pai ahi him hi," achi hi.
english: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”

paite: Huan huai thute angaihkhiak lai un, Jerusalem anaih tak ziak leh Pathian lalgam hong lang pah ding hi a angaihtuah ziak un gentehna agen hi.
english: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that God’s Kingdom would be revealed immediately.
