paite: Huchi in hiai thu agen hi. "Milian kuahiam gamukna thu la a hong kik nawn ding in kho gamlatak ah ahoh hi.
english: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.

paite: Ahoh ding in asikhate sawm asam a, akiang uah dangka sawm apia a, ka hong tun nawn masiah hiai in sum na sin un, chi in.
english: He called ten servants of his and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, ‘Conduct business until I come.’

paite: Himahleh akhua-le-tuite'n ahua ua, hiai mi ka tung ua vaihawm ding in ka deih kei uh, chi in anung ah thu akhak uhi.
english: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’

paite: "Huan hichi ahong hi a, lalgam la zou, ahong kik nawn in asikha sum apiakte, apeipundan uh theihna ding in asamsak hi.
english: “When he had come back again, having received the kingdom, he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.

paite: Amasapen ahong pai a, 'Toupa, na dangka sawm in apung,' achi hi.
english: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, 'Sikha hoih, na hihhoih e; tawmchik tung a na ginom ziak in kho sawm tung ah heutu in om in' achi hi.
english: “He said to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.’

paite: Anihna ahong pai a, 'Toupa, na dangka nga in apung e,' achi hi.
english: “The second came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’

paite: Amah kiang ah leng, 'Nang leng kho nga tung ah heutu in om in,' achi hi.
english: “So he said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’

paite: "Huan midang ahong pai a, 'Toupa en in, hiai na dangka, kho-ul nulna puan in ka kem kinken hi.
english: Another came, saying, ‘Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,

paite: Mimawktat na hih ziak in ka hon lau hi; na koih louh leng na la a, na tuh louh leng na at ngal a,' achi hi.
english: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’

paite: Huan ama'n akiang ah, 'Sikha gilou, na paukam suak ngei in ka hon siam louh ding. Mimawktat ka hih a, ka koih louh leng ka lak a, ka tuh louh leng ka at na thei maw?
english: “He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn’t lay down and reaping that which I didn’t sow.

paite: Huchi ahihleh bangziak a sumbuk a ka dangka na koih mai louh; huchi a ka hong pai chiang a apung toh ka lak ding hi a?' achi hi.
english: Then why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’

paite: "Huan akiang a dinghte kiang ah, 'Asum laksak unla, dangka sawm neipa kiang ah pia un,' achi hi.
english: He said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina away from him and give it to him who has the ten minas.’

paite: Amau akiang ah, 'Toupa, ama'n sum sawm anei aka,' achi uhi.
english: “They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’

paite: K'on chi ahi, 'Anei peuh piak behlap ahi ding a, anei lou aneihsun leng laksak ahi ding hi.
english: ‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.

paite: Himahleh hiai ka galte atung ua vaihawm dia hon deih lou, hon pi unla, ka ma ah that un, " achi hi.
english: But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’”

paite: Hiai thu agen khit in Jerusalem kholam naihtou in ma akai hi.
english: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Bethphage leh Bethani kho kiang, Olive tang kichi atun in, nungzuite lak a mi nih asawl hi.
english: When he came near to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the mountain that is called Olivet, he sent two of his disciples,

paite: "Na mazawn khua uah va hoh unla; huai ah na lut tung un sabiltungnou kikhih, kuamah tuan ngei nailouhna, na va mu ding ua, huai hon phel unla, hon kai un.
english: saying, “Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, which no man has ever sat upon. Untie it and bring it.

paite: Huan kuapeuh in 'Bangziak a phel?' chi a ahon dot uleh 'Toupa'n adeih a ahi,' chi un," achi hi.
english: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say to him: ‘The Lord needs it.’”

paite: Huan amisawlte apaita ua, akiang ua agen bang in ava mu uhi.
english: Those who were sent went away and found things just as he had told them.

paite: Sabiltungnou aphel lai un, aneite'n akiang uah, "Sabiltungnou bangziak a phel?" achi uhi.
english: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”

paite: Amau, "Toupa'n adeih a ahi," achi uhi.
english: They said, “The Lord needs it.”

paite: Huchi in Jesu kiang ah ahon kai ua; huan sabiltungnou tung ah apuante uh aphah ua, atung ah Jesu atuangsak uhi.
english: Then they brought it to Jesus. They threw their cloaks on the colt and sat Jesus on them.

paite: Huan apaina ding lampi ah apuante uh aphah uhi.
english: As he went, they spread their cloaks on the road.

paite: Huan atun kuan in, Olive tang kumsukna dingtak ah, anungzui mihonpi tengteng in athil thupi hih tengteng amuh ziak un akipak ua, aw ngaihtak in Pathian aphat ua,
english: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,

paite: "Toupa min a kumpipa hong pai ahampha e; van ah lemthu leng henla, tungnungpen ah thupina om hen," chi in.
english: saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”

paite: Huan mipi lak a Pharisai khenkhat in akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, na nungzuite tai in," achi uhi.
english: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”

paite: Ama'n bel ka hon hilh ahi, "Hiaite adaih uleh suangte bek akikou ding uh," chi in adawng hi.
english: He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”

paite: Huan atun kuan in, khua amu a, akahkhum a,
english: When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it,

paite: "Aw, nang tel in tu sung in khamuanna thei leteh aw; himahleh tu'n zaw na muhlouhna ding in akiselta ngal a.
english: saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.

paite: Na galte'n na kimvel ah leikulh akhoh ding ua, ahon um ding ua, na kimvel ah pawt theih louh in ahon opkhum ding ua, huchibang nite na tung ah ahong tung ding hi.
english: For the days will come on you when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,

paite: Na sung a na ta, na naute, nangmah toh lei ah ahon pai ek ding ua; na sung ah suang kichiang himhim ahawi kei ding uh; veh a na om ni na theih louh ziak in," chi in.
english: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’t know the time of your visitation.”

paite: Huan tempul ah ava lut a, bangpeuh zuakte adelhkhia a, akiang uah,
english: He entered into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,

paite: "Ka inn thumna inn ahi ding, chih gelh ahi; nou bel suamhatte khuk in na bawl zaw uh," achi hi.
english: saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”

paite: Huan niteng in tempul ah thu ahilh zel hi. Siampu liante, laigelhmite leh vantang lak a heutu deuhte'n amah hihman atum uhi.
english: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.

paite: Himahleh mipi'n phatuamngaitak a athugen angaihkhiak ziak un, ahihdan ding athei tuan kei uhi.
english: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.

paite: Huai lai in hichi ahong hi a, Kaisar Augustas in khovel tengteng min khum ding thu apia hi.
english: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.

paite: Huai tuh Siria gam a gam-ukpa Kurini ahih lai a minkhumna masapen ahi.
english: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.

paite: Huchi in mi tengteng amin uh khum ding in akhua chiat uah ahoh uhi.
english: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.

paite: Huan Joseph leng, David inkuante leh asuan ahihman in Galili gam a Nazaret a kipan in, Judia gam a David khua Bethlehem ah ahoh hi.
english: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to David’s city, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David,

paite: Azikham Mari gaisan lai toh, min khum ding in.
english: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai a a-om lai un, anau neih ahong hun hi.
english: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.

paite: Huan ata masa in pasal aneikhia a; puan in atuam a, khualbuk a atak louh ziak un gan anpiakna ah asial hi.
english: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.

paite: Huan huai gam mah ah belamchingte a-om ua, gamlak ah zan in abelamhonte uh aching uhi.
english: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.

paite: Toupa angel khat akiang uah ahong dingh a, Toupa thupina in akim uh atanvak a; huchi in alauta mahmah uhi.
english: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

paite: Huan angel in akiang uah, "Lau kei unla, ngai un, michih a ding in tanchinhoih kipahhuai mahmah ka hon tut ahi.
english: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.

paite: Tuni in nou a ding in David khua ah Hondampa apiangta, amah Khrist Toupa ahi.
english: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

paite: Hiai nou a ding in chiamtehna ding ahi; naungek puan a tuam, gan anpiakna kuang a lum na mu ding uh," achi hi.
english: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”

paite: Huan angel kiang ah van mipihon ahong omkhawm guih ua, Pathian aphat ua;
english: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God and saying,

paite: "Tungnungpen ah Pathian thupi henla, leitung a akipahpih mahmah mihingte lak ah lemthu leng hen,” achi uhi.
english: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, angelte'n van a apaisantak un, belamchingte'n, "Tu'n ah Bethlehem kho pha in pai lehang, Toupa'n thu ahon hilh hong tung i en ding uh," akichi uhi.
english: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”

paite: Huchi in apai mengmeng ua, Mari toh, Joseph toh, gan anpiakna kuang a naungek lum ava mu uhi.
english: They came with haste and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.

paite: Ava muh un hiai naungek tanchin angel in ahilh agenthangta uhi.
english: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.

paite: Aza peuhmah in belamchingte thugen lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
english: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.

paite: Mari in thugen tengteng alungtang in angaihtuah a, avom gige hi.
english: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.

paite: Belamchingte'n angel hilh bang ngei a bangkim amuh ua azak ziak un, Pathian pahtawi leh phat kawm zel in akik nawnta uhi.
english: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.

paite: Huan azeksum ni ding ni giat ahong chin in, amin ding in, sul a a-om ma a angel in agensa, Jesu asa uhi.
english: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

paite: Mosi Dan bang a akisiansakna ni uh ahong tun in, Jerusalem ah amah ava tonpihtou uh; Toupa kiang a amah lan ding in.
english: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord

paite: Toupa thu a, "Ta pasal sul hong peuhmah Toupa a ding a sehtuam achi ding uh," chi a gelh ahih bang in.
english: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),

paite: Toupa Dan gen bang a vakhu kop khat hiam vapalnou nih hiam kithoihna lan ding in.
english: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”

paite: Huan ngai in, Jerusalem ah mi khat amin Simeon a-om a; huai mi midiktat leh Pathian limsak ahi a, Israelte khamuanpa ding angak gige a, atung ah Kha Siangthou a-om hi.
english: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.

paite: Toupa Khrist amuh masiah zaw asi kei ding chih Kha Siangthou in ana theisak him ahi.
english: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.

paite: Kha theihsak in tempul ah ava lut a; naungek Jesu, anu leh apa'n dan ngeina bang a atung a hihsak ding a ahon pilut lai un,
english: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,

paite: ama'n ana angpom a, Pathian aphat hi,
english: then he received him into his arms and blessed God, and said,

paite: "Toupa, tu'n ah zaw na thu bang zel in, na sikha khamuangtak in na paisak ding a;
english: “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;

paite: na hotdamna ka mit in amuh tak ziak in,
english: for my eyes have seen your salvation,

paite: huai michih muh dia na bawl tak;
english: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;

paite: Zentelte kiang a kilakna vak leh na mi Israelte thupina ding," achi hi.
english: a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”

paite: Huan naungek thu agen anu leh apa'n lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
english: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him.

paite: Simeon in amau avualzawl a, anu Mari kiang ah, “Ngai in, hiai naupang Israel lak a mi tampi pukna ding leh dinkhiakna ding a seh ahi, gensiat a om chiamtehna hi ding in leng.
english: Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is appointed for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.

paite: Ahi, nang lungtang leng namsau in adawt pailet ding a; huchi a mi tampi in alungtang ua angaihtuahte uh alatna ding in,” achi hi.
english: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”

paite: Huan mi khat, amin, Anna, zawlnei, Phanuel Tanu, Asher nam a mi a-om a; amah tektak ahi a, anungak tawp nungsiah apasal kiang ah kum sagih a-om hi.
english: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,

paite: Kum sawmgiat-le-li ahih tanpha meithai in a-om a, ama'n tempul paisan lou in asun-azan in an ngawl a thum in Pathian abe zel hi.
english: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years), who didn’t depart from the temple, worshiping with fastings and petitions night and day.

paite: Huchih laitak in amah ahong pai a, Pathian kiang ah kipahthu agen a, Jerusalem tatna lamen peuhmahte kiang ah Jesu tanchin agen hi.
english: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.

paite: Huan Toupa dan bang zel a thil tengteng ahihzoh un, Galili gam a, amau khua Nazaret ah akik nawnta uhi.
english: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.

paite: Naungek ahong khanglian deuhdeuh a, ahong hat hiaihiai a, pilna in adimta a, atung ah Pathian deihsakna a-om hi.
english: The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.

paite: Huan kum teng in, Paikan Ankuanglui hun in, anu leh apa Jerusalem ah ahoh zel uhi.
english: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.

paite: Amah kum sawm-le-nih ahih in dan ngeina in ahohtou uhi.
english: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast;

paite: Ankuanglui zoh a akik nawn lai un, Jerusalem ah naupang Jesu a-om lai a, anu leh pa'n athei kei uhi.
english: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn’t know it,

paite: Huchi in apawlte lak ua om hi na'nteh achi ua, ni khat lam apai khin ua, asanggamte uh leh ameltheihte uh lak ah azong uhi.
english: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey; and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.

paite: Amuh louh ziak un zong kawmkawm in Jerusalem ah akik nawnta uhi.
english: When they didn’t find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani thum nung in, tempul ah, sinsak mite lak a tu a, athu uh na ngaikhia a, amaute thudong in, ava mu uhi.
english: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, both listening to them and asking them questions.

paite: Athu zate'n atheihdan leh adawndan lamdang asa mahmah uh.
english: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.

paite: Anu leh apa'n amah amuh un, lamdang asa mahmah ua; anu'n, akiang ah, "Tapa aw, bangziak a hichibang a hon hih na hia? Ngai in, na pa leh ke'n lungkhamtak in ka hon zong ua," achi hi.
english: When they saw him, they were astonished; and his mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Bangziak a hon zong na hi ua? Ka Pa inn a ka om ding na thei kei ua hia?" achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?”

paite: Huan akiang ua athugen atheisiam kei uhi.
english: They didn’t understand the saying which he spoke to them.

paite: Huan amau azuisuk a, Nazaret khua ahong tung ua, athu uh mang in a-om hi. Anu'n huai thil tengteng alungtang ah avom gige hi.
english: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

paite: Jesu apil deuhdeuh a, ahong lian hiaihiai a, Pathian leh mihing deihsak in a-om deuhdeuhta hi.
english: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.

paite: Huan ni khat tempul a mite thu hilh a, tanchinhoih agen lai in, siampu liante, laigelhmite, upate toh akiang ah ahong pai guih uhi.
english: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.

paite: Akiang ah, "Kua thu in ahia hiai thilte na hih? Kua'n ahia thu hon pia? hon hilh in," achi uhi.
english: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Ke'n leng thu kam khat ka hon dong sam ding; hon dawng un," achi hi.
english: He answered them, “I also will ask you one question. Tell me:

paite: "Johan baptisma van a kipan hia, mihing a kipan?" chi in adong hi.
english: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?”

paite: Akingaihtuah ua, "Van a kipan chi lehang, bangziak a amah gingta lou? hon chi thepthup ding hi.
english: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’

paite: Huan mihing a kipan chi lehang lah, mi tengteng in suang in ahon deng ding ua; Johan zawlnei ahih lam athei ngal ua," achi uhi.
english: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”

paite: Huchi in adawng ua, "Koi a kipan ahia ka thei kei uh," achi uhi.
english: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ke'n leng kua thu in ahia hiai thil ka hih chih ka hon hilh sam kei ding,” achi hi.
english: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

paite: Huan mipite kiang ah hiai gentehna agen a, "Mi kuahiam in grephuan abawl a, aloukemte kiang ah khohloh ding in apia a, sawtpi taam ding in gamdang ah ahohta hi.
english: He began to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.

paite: Huan agah loh hun in atan ding gah apiak ding un loukemte kiang ah sikha khat asawl hi Himahleh loukemte'n a na vua uhi.
english: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him and sent him away empty.

paite: Sikha dang asawl nawn a; huai leng na vo nawn in, zumhuaipi in ana bawl ua, khutvuak in apaisak nawnta uhi.
english: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

paite: Huan athumna asawl nawn a; huai leng hihliam in apaikhia uhi.
english: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him and threw him out.

paite: Huai zoh in grephuan neipa'n, 'Bangchi in ka hihta dia? Ka tapa deihtak ka sawlmai ding; amah ana zah khamoh kei ding uh,' achi hi.
english: The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.’

paite: Himahleh loukemte'n amah ana muhtak un, 'Hiai gouluah dingpa ahi, that ni, huchi in agou ei a ahi ding,' chi in akihou uhi.
english: “But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’

paite: Huchi in grephuan a pan apaikhia ua, ahihlumta uhi. Huan grephuan neipa'n amaute bang alohta dia le?
english: Then they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?

paite: Loukemte ahong hihmang dia, huan grephuan midangte ape ding," achi hi. Huan huai azak un, "Huai tel zaw tung keileh," achi uhi.
english: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When they heard that, they said, “May that never be!”

paite: Himahleh amaute a-en a, ahihleh hiai thu agelh uh bang ahia? "Inn lam mite suang deih louhpen, huai mahmah aning a suang phatuampen ahong hita, chih.
english: But he looked at them and said, “Then what is this that is written, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the chief cornerstone’?

paite: Kuapeuh huai suang tung a puk akitatgawp ding; adelhkhakte houh adelhzan lai ding," achi hi.
english: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”

paite: Huai laitak in laigelhmite leh siampu liante'n mat atum ua; himahleh huai gentehna amau dem a agen ahi chih atheih ziak un, mipi alau uhi.
english: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.

paite: Gam-ukpa vaihawmna leh thuneihna nuai a apiaktheihna ding un, athu genkhelh tang in a-enkhia ua, mihoih a kibawl enkhetu aguk sawl uhi.
english: They watched him and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, diktak in thu gen in na sinsak zel a, kuamah khentuam nei lou in chihtaktak in Pathian thu na hilh zel chih ka thei uh.
english: They asked him, “Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.

paite: Kaisar kiang a siah ka piak uh asiang hia, siang lou?" chi in adong uhi.
english: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

paite: Himahleh ama'n adoha lungput uh athei a, akiang uah, "Bang achia hon ze-et na hi ua?" achi hi.
english: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, “Why do you test me?

paite: "Na sumtang uh hon lak un, kua lim leh kua min ahia tuang?" achi a, amau, "Kaisar lim,” achi uhi.
english: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Huchi ahih nung, Kaisar thilte Kaisar kiang ah pia unla, Pathian thilte Pathian kiang ah pia un," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

paite: Huchi in mipi ma a paukhelh lak ding amu kei ua; adawnna lamdang asa mahmah ua, adai dide uhi.
english: They weren’t able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer and were silent.

paite: Huan Saddukai, thohnawnna a-om kei chite lak a mi kuate hiam akiang ah ahong ua; thu adong uhi.
english: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.

paite: "Sinsakpa, Mosi in, mi'n zi nei in, ta nei lou in sihsan taleh a-unaupa'n azi luah in, a-unaupa a ding in chi asuahsak ding chih, agelh hi.
english: They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife and raise up children for his brother.

paite: Ahi a, unau pasal sagih a-om ua; upapen in zi anei a, ta nei lou in asi hi.
english: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.

paite: Anihna in aluah a; ta nei lou in asi nawn hi.
english: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.

paite: Athumna in aluah nawn a, huchibang in unau sagihte'n anei chiat ua, ta nei lou in asi uhi.
english: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.

paite: Atawpna ah numei leng asita hi.
english: Afterward the woman also died.

paite: Huchi ahihleh thohnawn hun ah akua pen zi ahi dia? Amau sagihte'n zi in anei chiat ngal ua," achi uhi.
english: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Tulai mite zi leh ta in akinei zel ua,
english: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.

paite: himahleh huai hun chiang a tel tak ding leh misi lak a pan thohnawnna tang tak a seh peuhmahte, zi leh ta in akinei nawn kei ding uh.
english: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.

paite: Sih leng asi thei nawn kei ding uh, angelte bang a om ding ahi ngal ua; thohnawnna tate ahih ziak un, Pathian tate ahi ding uh," achi hi.
english: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.

paite: "Misi kaihthoh in a-om ding uh chih Mosi in leng loubuk ah, Toupa, Abraham' Pathian, Isak' Pathian, Jakob' Pathian, achih lai in, atheisak hi.
english: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’

paite: Amah misi Pathian ahi kei a, mihing Pathian ahi zaw; amah ngaih in mi tengteng ahing vek ngal ua,” achi hi.
english: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”

paite: Laigelhmite lak a kuate hiam in, "Sinsakpa, na gen dik e,” chi in adawng uhi.
english: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you speak well.”

paite: Huchi in thudang adong ngam nawn kei uhi.
english: They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah Khrist, David tapa ahi chih bangchidan a chi thei uh ahia?
english: He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?

paite: Sam laibu ah David mahmah in, "Toupa'n, ka Toupa kiang ah, ka taklam a tu in,
english: David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,

paite: Na khepek ngakna ding a na melmate ka bawl masiah," ana chi hi.
english: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

paite: Huchi in David in amah, "Toupa achi ngal a, bangchi in ahia atapa ahihtheih?" achi hi.
english: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”

paite: Huan mi tengteng theih in anungzuite kiang ah, laigelhmite lak ah pilvang un.
english: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,

paite: "Amau puanaktual silh a vak a-ut ua, dawr mun ah chibai buk leh sinagog a tutphah hoihpen a tut, ankuangluina ah mun hoihpen adeihtuam nak uhi.
english: “Beware of those scribes who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;

paite: Meithaite innte anegai ua, mi khemna ding in sawt pipi athum uhi. Huaite'n siam louh anak tan sem ding uhi," achi hi.
english: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

paite: Huan adakkhia a, mihaute'n sumkholna a sum akhiak lai uh amu hi.
english: He looked up and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.

paite: Meithai zawngtak kuahiam in dal dangka muza nih hong khia leng amu hi.
english: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.

paite: Huchi in "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, hiai tengteng sang in tua meithai zawngtak in akhe tamzaw.
english: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,

paite: Hiai tengteng in aneihlet uh akhia ua; ama'n bel akitunhingna ding a aneih sunsun akhe vek hi," achi hi.
english: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.”

paite: Huan kuate hiam in tempul thu, suang hoihtak leh thil piakkhawm a azep kilawmdan uh, agen lai un, ama'n,
english: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,

paite: "Hiai na thil muh uh, hihchip louh a suang kichiang himhim hiai a a-om louh ding nite ahong tung ding hi," achi hi.
english: “As for these things which you see, the days will come in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”

paite: 7 Huan amau akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, huaite chikchiang in ahong om ding ua? Huaite ahong tun ding chiamtehna bang a-om dia?" chi in adong uhi.
english: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”

paite: Huan ama'n, "Pimang a na omlouhna ding un pilvang un. Mi tampi'n, 'Khrist ka hi!' huan, 'Ahun tung ding ahita, chi in keimah min sial in ahong pai ding uh, huaite zui kei un.'
english: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is at hand.’ Therefore don’t follow them.

paite: Kidou thu leh buai thu na zak hun chiang un lau kei un; huaite atung masa ding a, tawpna bel hi pah lou ding ahi,” achi hi.
english: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”

paite: Akiang uah, "Nam tuam leh nam tuam akidou ding ua, gam tuam leh gam tuam akidou ding uh.
english: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

paite: 'Nakpitak in ziin aling dia, mun tuamtuam ah kial ake ding a, hipi aleng lai ding; van a kipan thil lauhuai leh chiamtehna thupitak ahong om ding hi.'
english: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.

paite: Himahleh huai thil tengteng atun ma in, nou ahon man ding ua, sinagog leh suangkul ah pi in ahon hihgim ding uh, keimah min ziak in kumpipate leh gamukte ma ah ahon pi ding uhi.
english: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.

paite: Hiai noute a ding a theihpihna hun lemtang ahi ding hi.
english: It will turn out as a testimony for you.

paite: Huchi in dawnna ding ngaihtuah khawl lou ding in na lungtang uah kihihkip un.
english: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,

paite: Na melma tengteng un hon dou ua hon sel theihlouhna ding un kam leh pilna ka hon pe ding hi.
english: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.

paite: Huan na nu leh na pate, na unaute, na tanaute, na lawmte un leng hon mansak ding ua; akhen ahon that ding uhi.
english: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.

paite: Keimah min ziak in mi tengteng huat na hi ding uh.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.

paite: Himahleh, na samzang uh khat leng amangthang kei ding.
english: And not a hair of your head will perish.

paite: Na kuhkalna uah na hinna uh na humbit ding uhi.
english: “By your endurance you will win your lives.

paite: "Himahleh sepaihte'n Jerusalem khua a-um uh na muh chiang un, amangthang dek chih thei un.
english: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.

paite: Huai hun chiang in Judia gam a omte'n tang ah taimangsan uhen; asung a omte'n pawtsan uhen, gam a omte asung ah lut kei uhen.
english: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.

paite: Huai nite phulakna ahi; thu agelh tengteng uh ahong tuntheihna ding in.
english: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

paite: Huai nite in gaite leh naunou pomte tung agik ding, khovel ah haksatna thupitak atun ding ziak in leh hiai chite tung a thangpaihna atun ding ziak in.
english: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath to this people.

paite: Huan namsau in asi ding ua, nam chih kiang ah sal a pi in a-om ding uh; huan Jerusalem tuh Zentelte ni atawp mateng Zentelte sikden in a-om ding hi.
english: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

paite: "Huan ni leh kha leh aksite ah, chiamtehna a-om ding a; tuipi mau leh akihoh ziak in leitung ah leng namte haksatna leh mangbatna atung ding;
english: “There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;

paite: mite launa ziak leh khovel a thil hong tung ding ngaihtuah ziak in, asibup ding ua; van thilhihtheihnate aling ding hi.
english: men fainting for fear and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

paite: Huai hun chiang in Mihing Tapa thilhihtheihna leh thupina thupi toh meipi lak a hong pai amu ding uhi.
english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

paite: Huan huai thilte ahong tun pat hun chiang in entou unla, dakkhia un; na tatna uh ahong nai tak ziak in," achi hi.
english: But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”

paite: Huan akiang uah gentehna thu agen a, "Theipi kung leh sing tengteng en un;
english: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree and all the trees.

paite: ahong selnoutak in huai na mu ua, nipi hong tung ding ahita, chih noumau in na thei uhi.
english: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.

paite: Huchi mah bang in nou leng huaite hong tung na muh chiang un, Pathian lalgam ahong naita chih thei un.
english: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, thil tengteng atunkim masiah hiai khangte amang kei ding hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.

paite: Lei leh van amang dia, ka thu bel amang kei ding hi.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

paite: "Himahleh pilvang un, huchi lou in zaw nekvah luat toh, zukham toh damsung khosak ngaihtuah in, na lungtang uh adim lo kha ding a, huai ni in thang-awk bang in thakhat in na tung uah ahong tung guih kha ding hi.
english: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.

paite: Huchi bangtak a leitung maikaih a omte tengteng tung a tung chiat ding ahi ngal a.
english: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.

paite: Huai thil hong tung ding tengteng pel ding leh Mihing Tapa ma a dingh tak ding a seh na hihtheihna ding uleh thahatna na neihna ding un chik lai peuh in thum kawm in limsak gige un," achi hi.
english: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”

paite: Huan niteng in tempul ah thu ahilh zel a; zan teng in apawt a, Olive tang achih uah agiak zel hi.
english: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.

paite: Huan zing in athu ngaikhe ding in mi tengteng tempul ah akiang ah ahong zel uhi.
english: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.

paite: Huan Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuanglui Ni, Paikan Ankuangluina kichi anaita hi.
english: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.

paite: Siampu liante leh laigelhmite'n hihlup theihna ding dan azong ua, vantang lah akihta ngal ua.
english: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.

paite: Sawm-le-nihte lak a pang, Judas, Iskariot kichi sung ah Setan alut hi.
english: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.

paite: Huchi in amah ava pai a siampu liante leh heutute kiang ah zuausan a matsak theihna ding dan ava kihoupih hi.
english: He went away and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.

paite: Amau akipak mahmah ua, akiang ah dangka piak achiamta uhi.
english: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.

paite: Ama'n lem asa a, mipi om louh kal a zuausan a matsakna lemtang azongta hi.
english: He consented and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.

paite: Huan Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ni, Paikan Ankuangluina belamnou gohna ding ni ahong tungta hi.
english: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n, "Peter leh Johan asawl a, Paikan Ankuang i nek ding hon va bawlsak un," chi in.
english: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”

paite: Huan amau akiang ah, "Koi ah va bawl le ung na ut a?” achi uhi.
english: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Ngai un, khopi a na lut un, pasal, bel a tui tawi in ahon tuak ding a, alutna inn ah zui lut un," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.

paite: Inn neipa kiang ah, "Sinsakpa'n, ka nungzuite toh Paikan Ankuang ka nekna ding uh, mikhual inn pindan koi lai ahia ahon chi, na chi ding uh.
english: Tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

paite: Huchi in ama'n indan tungnung zapi, van omsa, ahon ensak ding; huai ah hih un," achi hi.
english: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”

paite: Huan ahohta ua, akiang ua agen bangtak in amuta ua; huan Paikan Ankuang ava bawl uhi.
english: They went, found things as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

paite: Huan anek hun in, dohkan um in atu a, asawltakte toh a-um uhi.
english: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Ka thuak ding ka thuak ma in hiai Paikan Ankuang hon nekpih ka ut mahmah hi.
english: He said to them, “I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,

paite: K'on hilh ahi, hiai Pathian lalgam a atak a hihtangtun ahih masiah, ka ne nawn kei ding," achi hi.
english: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in God’s Kingdom.”

paite: Huan nou ala a, kipahthu agen khit in, "Hiai la unla, kihawm un;
english: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, “Take this and share it among yourselves,

paite: k'on hilh ahi, tuban Pathian lalgam ahong tun masiah grepgui gahtui ka dawn nawn kei ding," achi hi.
english: for I tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until God’s Kingdom comes.”

paite: Huan tanghou ala a, kipahthu agen khit in abalkham a, akiang uah apia a, "Hiai ka pumpi ahi, na sik ua piak ding pen; keimah theihgigena in hih zel un,” achi hi.
english: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.”

paite: Huchibang in nitak an nek zoh in nou ala a, "Hiai nou ka sisan a thukhun thak, na sik ua pawt ding pen."
english: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

paite: "Himahleh ngai un, zuausan a hon mansak dingpa khut ka kiang ah dohkan tung ah a-omta hi.
english: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.

paite: Mihing Tapa seh a a-om bangtak in apai ding hi, himahleh zuausan a mansak dingpa mihing tung agik hi!" achi hi.
english: The Son of Man indeed goes as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!”

paite: Huan amau lak ah, "Huchibang thilhih ding kua ahi dia le?" chi in akidongtuah uhi.
english: They began to question among themselves which of them it was who would do this thing.

paite: Huan alak uah kua pen ahia thupipen a seh chih thu ah, kiselna ahong pawt hi.
english: A dispute also arose among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Zentel kumpipate atung uah thu anei gige ua, atung ua thuneite thil hoih hihsakte in angai uhi.
english: He said to them, “The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’

paite: Himahleh nou zaw huchibang na hi kei ding uh; na lak ua thupipen nauzaw bang in om henla, makaipen leng nasempen bang in om zaw hen.
english: But not so with you. Rather, the one who is greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.

paite: Kua ahia thupizaw, dohkan a an um hia, an pepa? Dohkan a an um pen ahi zaw kei maw? Himahleh kei zaw na lak uah nasempa bang in ka om hi.
english: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn’t it he who sits at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.

paite: "Ze-etna ka tuah sung noute kei hon ompihte na hi uh.
english: “But you are those who have continued with me in my trials.

paite: Huchi in kei, ka Pa'n gam ahon sehsak bang in gam ka hon sehsak ahi.
english: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,

paite: Ka gam a ka dohkan a na nek ua na dawntheihna ding un; huchi in Israel nam sawm-le-nih vai hawmsak in laltutphah ah na hong tu ding uhi.
english: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”

paite: "Simon, Simon, ngai in, Setan in buhsep bang a ahon septheihna ding in, noute ahon ngen hi.
english: The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,

paite: Himahleh na ginna amanlouhna ding in ka hon thumsak hi; na kihei nawn chiang in nang na unaute hihkip in," achi hi.
english: but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang ah, "Toupa, na kiang ah suangkul ah leh sihna ah leng pai sam ngap ka hi,” achi hi.
english: He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”

paite: "Ama'n Peter, ka hon hilh ahi, na hon theihna ah thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl masiah tuni in ak akhuang kei ding,” achi hi.
english: He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Dangka ip lou, kawlzal lou leh khedap lou a ka hon sawlkhiak in bang na tasam ua?" achi hi. Amau, "Bangmah,” achi uhi.
english: He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, bag, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Tu'n zaw dangka ip nei in keng henla, kawlzal toh, kuapeuh namsau nei lou in apuan zuak henla, lei hen.
english: Then he said to them, “But now, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a bag. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.

paite: K'on hilh ahi, amah talekte lak ah simtel ahi, chi a kigelh ka tung ah ahong tung ahi; ka tungtang thu tungkim ngei ding ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: ‘He was counted with transgressors.’ For that which concerns me is being fulfilled.”

paite: Huan amau, "Toupa, en dih, hiai ah namsau nih a-om," achi ua. Ama'n akiang uah, "Ahun,” achi hi.
english: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “That is enough.”

paite: Huan amah apawt a, angeina dan in Olive tang ah ahohta a; nungzuite'n leng azui uhi.
english: He came out and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.

paite: Amun ava tun un, akiang uah, "Khemna a na lutlouhna ding un thum un,” achi hi.
english: When he was at the place, he said to them, “Pray that you don’t enter into temptation.”

paite: Huan suang a denphak tan vel ah ava paituam hi.
english: He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and he knelt down and prayed,

paite: Huan akhukdin a, athum a, "Pa, hoih na sakleh ka kiang a pan hiai nou lasuan in; himahleh kei thu hilou in, nangmah thu hi zaw hen," achi hi.
english: saying, “Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.”

paite: Huan van a kipan angel khat amah hihhat ding in akiang ah ahong kilak hi.
english: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.

paite: Huan agim mahmah a, phatuamngai nawn sem in athum a; sisan bang in akho-ul mal liantak in lei ah atakkheta hi.
english: Being in agony, he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.

paite: Huan athum khit a athoh in, nungzuite kiang ah ahong pai a, alungkham ziak un ana ihmu uh amu hi.
english: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples and found them sleeping because of grief,

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Bangziak a ihmu na hi ua? Khemna a na lutlouhna ding un thou unla, thum un," achi hi.
english: and said to them, “Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.”

paite: Huan huai agen laitak in, ngai dih, mipi ahong pai ua, sawm-le-nihte lak a tel Judas in ama uh akai a; tawp tum in Jesu ahon zuan hi.
english: While he was still speaking, a crowd appeared. He who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n, akiang ah, "Judas, Mihing Tapa tawp a mansak ding na hi maw?" achi hi.
english: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”

paite: Huan akim a mite'n thil hong tung ding atheih un, "Toupa, namsau in ka sat ding uam?" achi uhi.
english: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”

paite: Huan alak ua kuahiam in siampu lianpen sikha asat a, abil taklam asatkhiaksak hi.
english: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

paite: Huan Jesu'n, "Hih nawn ke'n," achi a, abil akhoih a, ahihdamta hi.
english: But Jesus answered, “Let me at least do this”—and he touched his ear and healed him.

paite: Jesu'n akiang a hong siampu liante tempul heutute leh upate kiang ah, "Namsau leh khetbuk tawi in, suamhat man ding bang hial in na hong kuan uh maw?
english: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, “Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?

paite: Tempul a na kiang ua niteng a ka om lai in hon mat tum in na hon sawk kei ua; himahleh tu mial thuneihna toh na tat hun uh ahi,” achi hi.
english: When I was with you in the temple daily, you didn’t stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness.”

paite: Huan aman ua, api ua, siampu lianpen inn ah apilut uhi. Peter in gamlapi ah azui hi.
english: They seized him and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.

paite: Huan inn huangsung intual ah mei achih ua, atukhawm ua, alak uah Peter ava tu sam hi.
english: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.

paite: Huan meivak nuai a atut lai in nungak kuahiam in amu a, a-en nilouh a, "Hiai mi leng akiang a om ahi,” achi hi.
english: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, “This man also was with him.”

paite: Ama'n bel, "Numei, amah ka thei kei," chi in akitheihmohbawl hi.
english: He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”

paite: Aden chiang deuh in midang in ahong mu nawn a, "Nang leng alak ua mi na hi ve," achi hi. Peter in bel, "Mihing aw, ka hi kei,” achi hi.
english: After a little while someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”

paite: Huan dakkal khat phial nung in, midang in, "Hiai mi leng akiang a om ahi tham hi; Galili gammi ahi," achi tinten hi.
english: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, “Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!”

paite: Huan Peter in, "Mihing aw, na thugen ka thei kei," achi hi. Huan thakhat in, apau laitak in ak ahong khuangta hi.
english: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

paite: Huan Toupa akihei a, Peter a-en hi. Peter in, "Ak khuan ma in thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl ding, chi a Toupa'n akiang a athugen ahon phawkkhe thak hi."
english: The Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord’s word, how he said to him, “Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times.”

paite: Huan apawt a, akap huphup hi.
english: He went out, and wept bitterly.

paite: Jesu lente'n nuihza bawlna in azang ua, asat uhi.
english: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.

paite: Amit atuamsak ua, "Kua ahia hon sat, gen in?" chi in adong uhi.
english: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”

paite: Thudang tampi in leng agensia un akou uhi.
english: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.

paite: Huan khua avaktak in upa hon, siampu liante leh laigelhmite ahong kikhawm ua, avaihawmna uah api uhi.
english: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,

paite: "Khrist na hihleh hon hilh in," achi uhi. Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Hon hilh mah leng na gingta kei ding uh.
english: “If you are the Christ, tell us.” But he said to them, “If I tell you, you won’t believe,

paite: Ke'n noute thu hon dong hita leng leng, na hon dawng kei ding ua, na hon khah sam kei ding uh.
english: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.

paite: Himahleh tuban siah Mihing Tapa, Pathian thilhihtheihna taklam ah atuta ding," achi hi.
english: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”

paite: Huan avek un, "Nang Pathian Tapa na hi maw le?" achi ua. Ama'n akiang uah, "Hi e, na hon chih bang un," achi hi.
english: They all said, “Are you then the Son of God?” He said to them, “You say it, because I am.”

paite: Huan amau, "Bang theihpihna dang i deih lai dia? Eimah mah in amah kamsuak a pan i zata ve ua le,” achi uhi.
english: They said, “Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!”

paite: Huan mipi tengteng adingh ua, Pilat kiang ah Jesu apita uhi.
english: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.

paite: "Hiai mi'n ka chite uh apimang a, Kaisar kiang ah siah liau akham a, Khrist, kumpipa, akichih ka za uh," chi in ahek uhi.
english: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.”

paite: Pilat in akiang ah, "Judate' Kumpipa na hi hia?" chi in adong a. Ama'n, "Hi e," chi in adawng hi.
english: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered him, “So you say.”

paite: Pilat in siampu liante leh mipite kiang ah, "Hiai mi tung ah bangmah khelhna ka mu kei,” achi hi.
english: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”

paite: Himahleh amau, "Galili gam a kipan Judia gam khua teng leh hiai mun tan ah thu hilh in, mi tengteng afuihse gige," chi in akhauh semsem uhi.
english: But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.”

paite: Pilat in huai azak in, hiai mi Galili gam a mi ahi hiam chih adong hi.
english: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.

paite: Huchi in Herod ukna sung a mi ahi chih atheihtak in Herod kiang ah asawlta a; huai lai in amah leng Jerusalem ah a-om hi.
english: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.

paite: Herod in Jesu amuh in akipak mahmah a; atanchin azak ziak in, tuma lam a pan muh ana ut him ahi a, athillamdang hih banghiam bek muh alamen hi.
english: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.

paite: Huan thu tampi adong a; himahleh bangmah in adawng tuan kei.
english: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.

paite: Siampu Liante leh laigelhmite'n dingh in nakpitak in ahek uhi.
english: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.

paite: Herod leh asepaihte'n Jesu simmohbawl in nuihza bawlna'n azang uh, puan thupitak silhsak in Pilat kiang ah asawl nawnta hi.
english: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.

paite: Huai ni in Herod leh Pilat akihoutheita uh; huai masiah a zaw kimelma et ahi uhi.
english: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.

paite: Pilat in siampu liante, heutute, mi tengteng asamkhawm a, akiang uah,
english: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,

paite: "Mite apimang chi in hiai mi ka kiang ah na hon pi uhi, ngai un, na ma ua ka etchet nung in na hekna thu uah hiai mi tung ah bangmah khelhna ka mu kei;
english: and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and behold, having examined him before you, I found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.

paite: Herod in leng mu tuan lou in, i kiang uah ahon sawlkik nawn hi. Ngai un, sihna khop hial bangmah ahih kei hi.
english: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.

paite: Huchi in ka vo ding a, ka pawtsak mai ding," achi hi.
english: I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

paite: (Ankuanglui ni a alak ua mi khat apawtsak teitei ding ahi ngal a).
english: Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast.

paite: Himahleh kituaktak in akikou ua, "Hiai mi hihmangthang inla, Barabbas pen hon pawtsak zaw in," achi uhi.
english: But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—

paite: Huai mi khopi a helna leh tualthah ziak a suangkul tang ahi.
english: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.

paite: Pilat in bel Jesu khah a-ut a, akiang uah thu agen nawn hi.
english: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,

paite: Himahleh, "Kros ah kilhden in, kros ah kilhden in,” chi in akikou uhi.
english: but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”

paite: Huan ama'n, athumveina ah akiang uah, "Bang ding in maw? Hiai mi in bang ahia ahihkhelh? Sihna khop hial atung ah bangmah ka mu kei; ka sawi ding a, ka khah mai ding," achi hi.
english: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

paite: Amau bel aw ngaihtak suah in kilhden ding in angen teitei uhi. Huan a-aw un avau daita uhi.
english: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.

paite: Pilat in anget bang ua hih ding in thu ahihpukta hi.
english: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.

paite: Helna leh tualthah ziak a suangkul tang anget uh akhah a; Jesu bel a-utut aloh ding un apeta hi.
english: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.

paite: Apikhiak lai un, Kurini khomi Simon kichi, gamsung a kipan hong pai amantawm ua, Jesu nunglam a po ding in atung ah kros angata uhi.
english: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid the cross on him to carry it after Jesus.

paite: Huan mi nazong leh numei amah kah a mau zelzul, mipi tampitak in amah azui uhi.
english: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.

paite: Jesu bel amaute lam nga in, "Jerusalem tanute aw, hon kah kei un, noumau leh na tate uh a ding in kap zaw un," achi hi.
english: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

paite: "Ngai un, ani ahong tung ding a, 'Huai ni in, numei chingte, naupai ngeilouhna gilte, naungek tep ngei louh nawite ahampha uh,' achi ding uhi.
english: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.’

paite: Huai hun chiang in mite'n, tangte kiang ah, 'Hon delh un,' achi ding uh, mualte kiang ah, 'Hon khuh un,' achi ding uhi.
english: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and tell the hills, ‘Cover us.’

paite: Sing ahin lai a bawn hichibang a ahih uleh; akeu chiang in bang alohta phet ding ua?" achi hi.
english: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”

paite: Huan akiang ah midang nih, migiloute leng hihlup ding in api uhi.
english: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.

paite: Kalvari, achih mun uh atun un, migiloute, ataklam ah khat, aveilam ah khat toh akilhden uhi.
english: When they came to the place that is called “The Skull”, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.

paite: Jesu'n, "Pa, amaute ngaidam in; athilhih uh athei kei ua ahi," achi hi. Huchi in apuansilhte kihawm in, ai asan uhi.
english: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.

paite: Huan mihonpi'n dingh kawm in a-en uhi. Huchi in vaihawm mite'n, "Midang bawn ahondam aka; Pathian tel Khrist ahih taktakleh amah leng kihondam hen aw," chi in a-enghou uhi.
english: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”

paite: Sepaihte'n leng amah nuihza bawlna in anei ua, akiang ah ahong ua, zu thuk apia uhi.
english: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,

paite: "Judate' Kumpipa na hih taktakleh kihondam in," achi uhi.
english: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”

paite: Huan alutung zawn kros ah, Grik, Latin leh Hebru laimal in, "HIAI JUDATE' KUMPIPA AHI," chi in laigelh atak uhi.
english: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: “THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

paite: Huan amigilou kilh khat un Jesu atai a, "Khrist na hi kei a hia? Kihondam inla, kou leng hon hondam tanla," achi hi.
english: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, “If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!”

paite: Himahleh khatpa'n dawng kawm in, ataihilh a, "Pathian nangawn na kihta kei a hia kibang sap a hon gawt uh?
english: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, “Don’t you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?

paite: Ei zaw gawt tuak him i hi; i thilhih man lel mu i hi a; hiai mi'n bangmah ahihkhial ngal kei a,” achi hi.
english: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”

paite: Ama'n Jesu kiang ah, "Toupa na lalgam a na hong pai chiang in hon theigige in," achi hi.
english: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, tuni in ka kiang ah Paradis ah na om sam ding,” achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”

paite: Huan dak gukna vel ahi a, huai nungsiah dak kuana hun tan in gam pumpi ahong mialvekta a, nisa vak abeita hi.
english: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.

paite: Tempul puanzak alai ah ahong keksuak hi.
english: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.

paite: Aw ngaihtak in Jesu akikou a, "Pa, na khut ah ka kha ka hon kemsak hi," achi hi. Huai achih zoh in akha akhahta hi.
english: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!” Having said this, he breathed his last.

paite: Sepaih zaheutupa'n thil omdan amuh in, "Hiai mi, pel lou in midik ahi ngeingei," chi in Pathian aphat hi.
english: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”

paite: Huai etnop en ding a mipi hong kikhawm tengtengte'n thil omdante amuh un a-awm uh kitum in akik nawnta uhi.
english: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their chests.

paite: Huan ameltheihte tengteng leh numei Galili gam a kipan a hon zuite, huai thilte en in gamlatak ah adingh uhi.
english: All his acquaintances and the women who followed with him from Galilee stood at a distance, watching these things.

paite: Huan ngai un, mi khat amin Joseph, vaihawmmi, mihoihtak, diktak, Judate khua khat Arimathai a kipan a-om hi.
english: Behold, there was a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man

paite: Avaihawm uah leh athilhih uah leng aki-awi kei him a, ama'n Pathian lalgam ana lamen gige hi.
english: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for God’s Kingdom.

paite: Huai mi Pilat kiang ah ahoh a, Jesu luang angen hi.
english: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

paite: Huan alakhia a, puanmalngat in atuam a, han, suang khuakkuak, kuamah sial nailouhna ah, asial hi.
english: He took it down and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.

paite: Huan huai ni tuh Kisakkholhna ni, Sabbath ni tun dek kuan ahi.
english: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.

paite: Galili gam a kipan akiang a numei hong zuite'n azui zel ua, han leh aluang sialdan amu uhi.
english: The women who had come with him out of Galilee followed after, and saw the tomb and how his body was laid.

paite: Huan apai nawn ua, gimnamtui leh thaunamtui abawl ua; huan Sabbath ni in thupiak bang in akhawlta uhi.
english: They returned and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.

paite: Huan nipikal a ani masapen, phalvak in, gimnamtui abawlte uh tawi in, han ah ava hoh uhi.
english: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.

paite: Han a kipan suangtum khuksuan a om amu uhi.
english: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

paite: Huan alut ua, Toupa Jesu luang amu kei uhi.
english: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huaiziak a amangbat lai un, ngai in, mi nih puan milengthei silh akiang uah ahong dingh uhi.
english: While they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.

paite: Alau ziak ua, lei si a bokkhup a a-om lai un, akiang uah, "Bangziak a misi lak a mihing zong?
english: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. The men said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead?

paite: Hiai ah a-om nawnta kei, athounawnta; Galili gam a a-om lai a na kiang ua athugen theigige un,
english: He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,

paite: Mihing Tapa mikhialte khut ah matsak in a-om ding a, akilhden ding ua, ani thum ni in athounawn ding ahi, achih," achi uhi.
english: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”

paite: Huan athugente ahon thei thak nawn uhi.
english: They remembered his words,

paite: Hanmun a kipan apai nawn un, sawm-le-khatte leh midang tengtengte kiang ah huai thil tengteng ahilh uhi.
english: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.

paite: Sawltakte kiang a huai thuhilhte bel Mari Magdalin, Mari, Joanna, Jakob nu Mari leh akiang ua numei dangte ahi uhi.
english: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.

paite: Himahleh huaite thugen thu maimai in angai ua, amau ataksang kei uhi.
english: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.

paite: Himahleh Peter athou a, han ah ataita a; huan akun a, a-en a, puanmalngat omte kia amu a, huchi in thil omdan lamdang satak in inn lam ah apaita hi.
english: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.

paite: Huan ngai in, huai ni mah in alak ua mi nih khua khat Emmaus achih uah ahoh dek ua, huai khua Jerusalem a pan ching sawmguk ahi.
english: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.

paite: Huan thil hong tung tengteng agenkhawm zel uhi.
english: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.

paite: Gen a akisel lai un, Jesu ngei in ahon zuan a, akiang uah apai samta hi.
english: While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.

paite: Himahleh amah a theihlouhna ding un, amit uh hihvaih in a-om hi.
english: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Pai kawm a na genkhawm uh bang thu ahia?” achi hi. Huan dahmeltak in adingh dinden uhi.
english: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”

paite: Huan amin Kleopas pen in akiang ah, "Tulai a thil omdan na theih louh, Jerusalem ah nangmah kia in hia na ten?" chi in adong hi.
english: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Bang thil eita?" achi hi. Amau akiang ah, "Nazaret Jesu, Pathian leh mi tengteng mitmuh a athu leh athilhih a zawlnei minthangtak tanchin thu;
english: He said to them, “What things?” They said to him, “The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;

paite: siampu liante leh ka heutute un thah ding a thu apiak ua, akilhden thute uh.
english: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.

paite: Kou amah zaw Israelte tanpa hi ding a lamen lua hi ung a, himahleh, huai thiltun nungsiah tuni ani thum ni ahita hi.
english: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.

paite: Huai lou leng ka pawlte uh numei kuate hiam zingsang in, han ah ava hoh ua, hon hihmangbang uhi.
english: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;

paite: Aluang muloupi in, Pathian angelte kilak ka mu uh, huai mite'n athounawnta chih agen uh, ahong chi uhi.
english: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.

paite: Ka ompihte lak ua kuate hiam han ah ahoh ua, numeite gen bang ngei in amu ua; himahleh amah amu kei uh," achi uhi.
english: Some of us went to the tomb and found it just like the women had said, but they didn’t see him.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Mihaite aw, zawlneite thugen tengteng gintak thu a ze-olte aw;
english: He said to them, “Foolish people, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!

paite: Khrist in huai thilte thuak a thupina a lut ding him ahi kei a hia?" achi hi.
english: Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”

paite: Mosi leh zawlneite tengteng a pan in, Laisiangthou tengteng a ama tanchin toh kisai peuhmah amau ahilhchian zel hi.
english: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.

paite: Huan ahohna ding khua uh atung dekta ua; amah gamla deuh a hoh tum bang in a-om hi.
english: They came near to the village where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.

paite: Kam in akhou ua, "Ka kiang uah taam in; nitaklam hi ding ahita a, ni leng tum dekta ahi," chi in. Huchi in akiang ua taam ding in alutta hi.
english: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akiang ua an um a atut in tanghou ala a, avualzawl a, abalkham a, akiang uah apia hi.
english: When he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave it to them.

paite: Huan amit uh ahong vakta a, amel atheichianta uhi. Himahleh amah amangta mai hi.
english: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him; then he vanished out of their sight.

paite: Amau, “Lampi a hon houpih lai a Laisiangthou thute hon hilhchet lai in i lungtang avakhuai him hilou hia?" akichi uhi.
english: They said to one another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”

paite: Huai laitak in, athou ua, Jerusalem ah akik nawn ua, sawm-le-khatte leh alawm omkhawmte amu ua, amau,
english: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,

paite: "Toupa ana thounawn taktak ahi, Simon kiang ah leng akilakta," ana chi uhi.
english: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”

paite: Amau lampi a bang thil om hiam chih leh tanghou abalkhap a, amel atheihdante uh ahilh sam uhi.
english: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.

paite: Huai thu agen lai un, Jesu mahmah alak uah ahong dingh a, akiang uah, "Na tung uah khamuanna om hen," achi hi.
english: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

paite: Himahleh kiguih hial in, lauhuai asa mahmah ua, sikha mu hi in akingaihtuah uhi.
english: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Bang achia mangbang na hi ua? Bangziak a na lungsim ua ginlahna hong om ahia?
english: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?

paite: Ka khutte ka khepekte en un, kei mahmah ka hi. Hon khoih unla, thei un; sa leh guh nei a na hon muh bang un, kha in zaw sa leh guh anei ngal kei hi," achi hi.
english: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”

paite: Huai agen khit in akhutte akhepekte amau alak hi.
english: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.

paite: Kipah luat ziak a agin ngam louh ua lamdang asak lai un, akiang uah, "Hiai ah banghiam nek ding na nei uhia?" achi hi.
english: While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”

paite: Ngahou, bak khat leh khuaizu khak apia uhi.
english: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.

paite: Ala a, ama uah aneta hi.
english: He took them, and ate in front of them.

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Na kiang ua ka om lai a ka tanchin gelh peuhmah thute ahong tung ding chi a ka hon hilhhilhte Mosi Dan, zawlneite leh phatna late a thu kigen, hiaite mah ka thu ahi,” achi hi.
english: He said to them, “This is what I told you while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms concerning me must be fulfilled.”

paite: Huchi in Laisiangthou thu theihna ding in alungtang uh avaksakta hi.
english: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Hichibang a gelh ahi, Khrist in gim athuak ding a, ani thum ni in misi lak a kipan athounawn ding,” achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,

paite: "Ama min in kisikna leh khelh ngaihdamna thu Jerusalem khua a pan in nam chih kiang ah hilh ahi ding," chi in.
english: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

paite: "Huai thil tengteng atheihpihte na hi uhi.
english: You are witnesses of these things.

paite: Huan ngai un, na tung uah ka Pa thuchiam ka hon sawl ding hi. Himahleh, tunglam a kipan thilhihtheihna silhsak a na om masiah uh khopi ah om kinken un," achi hi.
english: Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.”

paite: Huan Bethani pha in amau apikhia a; huan aban azak a, avualzawl hi.
english: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands and blessed them.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, avualzawl laitak in amau apaisan a, van ah pitouh in a-omta hi.
english: While he blessed them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.

paite: Huan amah abia ua, kipak kawm in Jerusalem ah akik nawn ua;
english: They worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,

paite: tempul ah Pathian phat in a-om nilouh uhi. Amen.
english: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

paite: Tiberias Kaisar vaihawm akum sawm-le-nga kum in, Judia gam ukpa Pontias Pilat ahi a, Galili gam kumpipa Herod ahi a, a-unau Philip, Ituria leh Trakoniti gam kumpipa ahi a, Abilin gam kumpipa Lusania ahi.
english: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,

paite: Annas leh Kaiapha siampu lianpen ahi ua, huai lai in gamdai ah Zakariah tapa Johan kiang ah Pathian thu ahong tung hi.
english: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.

paite: Amah bel Jordan lui gei kim gam tengteng ah ahoh a, thil hihkhial ngaihdamna ding in kisikna baptisma thu agen zel hi.
english: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.

paite: Zawlnei Isai laibu a: "Gamdai a kikou aw in, Toupa lampi sial unla, alampite tangsak un.
english: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.

paite: Guam chih sundim ahi ding a, tang leh mual chih, hihniam ahi ding; lampi kawite tansak ahi ding a, lampi phokte mamsak ahi ding.
english: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.

paite: Huan mi tengteng in Pathian hotdamna amu ding uh," achi, chih gelh bang in.
english: All flesh will see God’s salvation.’”

paite: Ama'n baptisma tang ding akiang a mipi hong sukte kiang ah, "Nou gul suante aw, thangpaihna hong tung ding taisan ding a kua'n hon vauhilh ahia?
english: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

paite: Huchi in kisik minputak in gah un, ei hon suangpa Abraham ahi na lungsim un chi kei un; Pathian in hiai suangte Abraham suante in adingsak thei chih ka hon hilh ahi.
english: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance, and don’t begin to say among yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father;’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!

paite: Tu mahmah in singbul teng ah heipi koih ahita; huchi in sing chih gah hoih a gah lou peuhmah phuk in a-om a, mei ah paih in a-om," achi hi.
