english: Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.”

paite: Huan mipite'n akiang ah, "Bang ka hihta ding ua?" chi in adong uhi.
english: The multitudes asked him, “What then must we do?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Kuapeuh puanak nih nei in anei lou kiang ah hawm hen; kuapeuh an nei in huchibang mah in hih hen," chi in adawng hi.
english: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”

paite: Huan siahkhon mite leng baptisma tang ding in ahong ua, akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, bang ka hih ding ua?" achi uhi.
english: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what must we do?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hon sehsak val uh khon kei un," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”

paite: Sepaihte'n leng akiang ah, "Kou leng bang ka hih ding ua?" chi in adong uhi. Ama'n akiang uah, "Kuamah hiamgam in hih kei unla, dikloupi in kuamah hek kei unla, na loh uah lungkim un," achi hi.
english: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.”

paite: Huan mite'n alamet ua, mi tengteng in Johan tungthu alungtang ua, Khrist ahi kha zenzen diam aw? chi a angaihtuah lai un,
english: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,

paite: Johan in adawng a, avek ua kiang ah, "Ke'n tui in ka hon baptis a, himahleh kei sang a mithupizaw ahong pai ding, akhedap khau phel tak leng ka hi kei; ama'n Kha Siangthou leh mei in nou ahon baptis ding.
english: John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire.

paite: Akhut in aphazah atawi a, aphual zapsianna ding leh buhpang a buhte sunlutna ding in; asite mei mit ngei lou ah ahalmang ding," achi hi.
english: His winnowing fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”

paite: Huan hanthawnna tampi in mite kiang ah tanchinhoih ahilh zel hi.
english: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,

paite: Himahleh kumpipa Herod in anaupa zi, Herodias tungthu ah leh athilhihkhelh tung a Johan in ataihilh ziak in,
english: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,

paite: athilhihkhelh tengteng behlap in amah suangkul ah akhum hi.
english: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.

paite: Huan mi tengteng abaptis zoh in, hichi ahong hi a, Jesu leng baptis zoh a a-om in, athum a, van ahong kihong a,
english: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized and was praying. The sky was opened,

paite: Kha Siangthou sa pu in vakhu bang in ahong suk a, atung ah atuta a; van a kipan in aw ahong pawt a, "Nang ka Tapa deihtak na hi; na tung ah ka kipak mahmah," achi hi.
english: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n thu ahilh pat tung lai in amah kum sawmthum vel ahita, mi ngaih in zaw Joseph tapa ahi a, huai Heli tapa ahi a,
english: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,

paite: huai Matthat tapa ahi a, huai Levi tapa ahi a, huai Melki tapa ahi a, huai Janna tapa ahi a, huai Joseph tapa ahi a,
english: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

paite: huai Matthathias tapa ahi a, huai Amos tapa ahi a, huai Nahum tapa ahi a, huai Esli tapa ahi a, huai Naggai tapa ahi a,
english: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

paite: huai Maathi tapa ahi a, huai Matthathias tapa ahi a, huai Semmei tapa ahi a, huai Josek tapa ahi a, huai Joda tapa ahi a,
english: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,

paite: huai Joanan tapa ahi a, huai Rhesa tapa ahi a, huai Zerubbabel tapa ahi a, huai Salathiel tapa ahi a, huai Neri tapa ahi,
english: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

paite: huai Melki tapa ahi, huai Addi tapa ahi, huai Kosam tapa ahi, huai Elmadam tapa ahi, huai Er tapa ahi,
english: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,

paite: huai Joses tapa ahi a, huai Eliezer tapa ahi a, huai Jorim tapa ahi a, huai Matthat tapa ahi,
english: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

paite: huai Levi tapa ahi a; huai Simeon tapa ahi, huai Judah tapa ahi, huai Joseph tapa ahi, huai Jonam tapa ahi, huai Eliakim tapa ahi a,
english: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,

paite: huai Melia tapa ahi, huai Menna tapa ahi, huai Mattatha tapa ahi a, huai Nathan tapa ahi, huai David tapa ahi,
english: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

paite: huai Jesse tapa ahi, huai Obed tapa ahi a, huai Boaz tapa ahi a, huai Salmon tapa ahi a, huai Nahshon tapa ahi,
english: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

paite: huai Amminadab tapa ahi a, huai Admin tapa ahi, huai Arni tapa ahi a, huai Hezron tapa ahi, huai Perez tapa ahi a, huai Judah tapa ahi,
english: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

paite: huai Jakob tapa ahi a, huai Isak tapa ahi, huai Abraham tapa ahi a, huai Tera tapa ahi a, huai Nahor tapa ahi.
english: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

paite: Huai Serug tapa ahi, huai Reu tapa ahi, huai Peleg tapa ahi, huai Eber tapa ahi, huai Selah tapa ahi,
english: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

paite: huai Kainan tapa ahi, huai Arpakshad tapa ahi, huai Sem tapa ahi, huai Noah tapa ahi, huai Lamekh tapa ahi,
english: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

paite: huai Methuselah tapa ahi, huai Enok tapa ahi, huai Jared tapa ahi, huai Mahalalel tapa ahi, huai Kainan tapa ahi,
english: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,

paite: huai Enos tapa ahi, huai Seth tapa ahi, huai Adam tapa ahi, huai Pathian tapa ahi.
english: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

paite: Jesu, Kha Siangthou in adim a, Jordan lui a kipan akik nawn a, diabol khem kawm in gamdai ah ni sawmli Kha pi in a-om hi.
english: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness

paite: Huai nite in bangmah ane kei hi.
english: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.

paite: Atawp in agil ahong kialta a, diabol in akiang ah, "Pathian Tapa na hihleh hiai suang tanghou suak ding in thu pia in," achi hi.
english: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Tanghou kia in mihing ahing kei ding, Pathian kam a thupawt in ahing zaw ding," chih gelh ahi, chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered him, saying, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’”

paite: Huan tang sangtak ah apitou a, mitphiat kal lou in khovel gam tengteng a-ensak hi.
english: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

paite: Akiang ah, "Hiai tengteng tung a thuneihna leh athupina ka hon pe ding; ka kiang a piak ahita hi, ka ut peuh kiang ah leng ka pe zel hi.
english: The devil said to him, “I will give you all this authority and their glory, for it has been delivered to me, and I give it to whomever I want.

paite: Huchi in hon bia inla, avek in nang a ahi ding," achi hi.
english: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Toupa na Pathian na biak ding a, amah nna kia na sep ding ahi," chih gelh ahi, chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”

paite: Huan Jerusalem ah api a, tempul tungzum ah akoih a, akiang ah, "Pathian Tapa na hihleh hiai a kipan kikesak in;
english: He led him to Jerusalem and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,

paite: nangmah humbit ding in na tungthu ah zaw a-angelte thu ape ding a,
english: for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;’

paite: amau akhut un ahon dom ding uh, huchi lou in zaw na khe in suang na sui kha ding, chih gelh ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.’”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Toupa na Pathian ze-et ke'n," chih gelh ahi, chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”

paite: Huan diabol in akhemna ding teng a akhem khit in alemtan hun chiang a ding in apaisanta hi.
english: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.

paite: Kha thilhihtheihna in Galili gam ah Jesu apai nawnta a; atanchin huai kim gam teng ah athangta hi.
english: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.

paite: Huan sinagogte ah thu ahilh zel a, mi tengteng phat in a-om hi.
english: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.

paite: Huan akhanletna khua Nazaret ahong tung a; Sabbath ni a ahihdan ngeina bang in sinagog ah alut a, sim ding in adingh hi.
english: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.

paite: Akiang ah zawlnei Isai laibu apia ua, ama'n laibuzial aphel a, hiai thu kigelhna laitak asim hi:
english: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,

paite: "Liangvaite kiang a Tanchinhoih gen ding a na hon seh ziak in ka tung ah Toupa Kha a-om; ama'n ahon sawl, salte kiang ah pawtna thu leh, mittawte kiang a mitvak neih nawnna thu gen ding, simmoh thuakte pawtsakna ding.
english: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,

paite: Toupa lungkim kum thu gen ding in," chih.
english: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”

paite: Huan laibu azial a, nasepsakpa ape nawn a, atuta hi. Huan sinagog a mi tengteng mit atung ah atuta hi.
english: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.

paite: Akiang uah, "Hiai Laisiangthou thu tuni in na zak un atangtungta," chi in agen pan hi.
english: He began to tell them, “Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”

paite: Avek un amah aphat ua, akamsuak hehpihna thute lamdang asa mahmah uh, "Hiai mi Joseph tapa ahi kei a hia?" achi uhi.
english: All testified about him and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth; and they said, “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou hiai thupil thu, Daktor, nang leh nang kihihdam in, Kapernaum a na thilhih ka na zak peuh uh, hiai ah nangmah kholam ah leng hih in chi in hon chi khong ding zaw na hi ve ua,” achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Doubtless you will tell me this proverb, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.’”

paite: Amah mah in, “Chihtaktak in, ka hon hilh ahi, zawlnei kuamah ama kholam ah pahtawi in a-om ngei kei hi.
english: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.

paite: Huchi in diktak in ka hon chi ahi, Elijah dam lai a, kum thum leh kha guk van abin a, khovel a kial nakpitak a ahong tun in, Israel gam ah meithai tampi a-om uhi.
english: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.

paite: Himahleh alak ua kuamah kiang ah Elijah sawl ahi kei, Sidon gam lam a Zarephath a numei, meithai kiang kia a sawl ahi zaw hi.
english: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.

paite: Huan zawlnei Elishah dam lai in leng Israel gam ah phak tampi a-om ua; himahleh alak uah kuamah hihsiangthou in a-om kei, Siria mi Naaman kia hihsiangthou in a-om zaw hi," achi hi.
english: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”

paite: Huan sinagog a mi tengteng in huai thute azaktak un, aheh mahmah uhi.
english: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue as they heard these things.

paite: Adingh suausuau ua, khua a kipan in asawnkhia ua, paihkhiak ding in akho omna mual pang ah api uhi.
english: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.

paite: Himahleh amah alak uah apaisuak a, apaimangta hi.
english: But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.

paite: Huan Galili gam a khua khat, Kapernaum ah ava hohsuk hi. Sabbath ni in mite thu ahilh hi.
english: He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,

paite: Thuneitak a agen ziak in athuhilh lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
english: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.

paite: Huan sinagog ah dawi nin paimi khat ana om hi.
english: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon; and he cried out with a loud voice,

paite: Amah aw ngaihtak in akikou a, “Eh! Nazaret Jesu, kou leh nang bang ahia i kizolhna om? Hon hihmangthang ding in na hong maw? Nang ka hon thei, Pathian Mi Siangthou na hi," achi hi.
english: saying, “Ah! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”

paite: Jesu'n atai a, “Dai inla, asung a kipan pawt in," achi hi. Huan dawi in alai ah ahihpuk a, hihna lou in asung a kipan apawtta hi.
english: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent and come out of him!” When the demon had thrown him down in the middle of them, he came out of him, having done him no harm.

paite: Huan avek un lamdang asa mahmah ua, "Bang thu ahia le? Thuneitak leh thilhihtheitak in dawi ninte thu apia a, apawt uh," chi in akihou uhi.
english: Amazement came on all and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”

paite: Huan huai kim gam khua teng ah atanchin athangta hi.
english: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.

paite: Huan athou a, sinagog a kipan apawt a, Simon inn ah alut hi. Simon zi nu nakpitak in akhosik a, huchi in amah a ding in ana ngetsak uhi.
english: He rose up from the synagogue and entered into Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him to help her.

paite: Akiang ah adingh a, khosik atai a, adaita hi; athou pah a, a-nna uh asepsakta hi.
english: He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.

paite: Huan nitum kuan in natna tuamtuam a na, damlou nei peuhmah in akiang ah ahon pi ua; avek un atung uah akhut akoih chiat a, ana hihdam zel hi.
english: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

paite: Huan dawite'n leng, "Pathian Tapa na hi," chi a kikou in, mi tampi sung a kipan in hong pawt uhi. Huan amau atai a, Khrist ahi chih atheih ziak un apau uh aphal kei hi.
english: Demons also came out of many, crying out and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.

paite: Huan khovak tak in apawt a, kuamah omlouhna mun ah ahoh a; mipite'n azong ua, akiang ah ahong ua, amau apaisanlouhna ding in let atum uhi.
english: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn’t go away from them.

paite: Himahleh akiang uah, "Kho dang ah leng Pathian lalgam tanchinhoih ka hilh ding ahi, huai ding a sawl ka hi ngal a,” achi hi.
english: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of God’s Kingdom to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”

paite: Huchi in Galili gam a sinagogte ah thu ahilhta hi.
english: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, mipi'n Pathian thu angaihkhiak ua, amah aboh huthut lai un, amah Gennesaret tuipi gei ah adingh hi.
english: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.

paite: Huan tuipi gei a long nih om amu a, himahleh ngaman mite apawtkhia ua, alente uh asawp uhi.
english: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets.

paite: Huchi in long khat Simon a pen ah atuang a, akiang ah lui gei a kipan neukha tolhlutsak deuh angen hi. Huan atu a, long a kipan mipite thu ahilh hi.
english: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.

paite: Huan thugen azoh in, Simon kiang ah, "Lithuk lam naih unla, ngaman ding in, na lente uh pai un," achi hi.
english: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch.”

paite: Huan Simon in akiang ah, "Heutupa, gimtak in zankhua in ka pang ua, bangmah ka man kei ua, himahleh na thu in lente ka pai nawn ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night and caught nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”

paite: Huan apaih ualeh nga tampitak akhuh ua, alente uh akek iak-iak hi.
english: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.

paite: Huan long dang a om alawmte uh amau huh ding in akhutvan hial uhi. Ahong pai ua, long nih tum phialphial in asungdim tuaktuak uhi.
english: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.

paite: Simon Peter in huai amuh in, Jesu khebul a bokkhup in, “Toupa, hon paisan in, mikhial ka hi,” achi hi.
english: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”

paite: Anga mat uh amah leh alawmte'n lamdang asa mahmah uhi;
english: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;

paite: Simon pawlte mah Zebedai tapa Jakob leh Johan in leng lamdang asa mahmah sam uhi. Simon kiang ah Jesu'n, "Lau ke'n, tuban siah mihing na manta ding," achi hi.
english: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.”

paite: Huan lui gei ah alongte uh atolh galkai ua, bangkim paisan in amah azuita uhi.
english: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, khua khat a a-om lai in ngai dih, mi khat phak a pumdim a-om a, ama'n Jesu amuh in, ama a bokkhup in, "Toupa, na utleh na hon hihsiang thei," chi in angen ngutngut hi.
english: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

paite: Ama'n sawk in akhoih a, "Ka ut hi, na siangta in,” achi hi. Huan thakhat in aphak ahong bei pah hi.
english: He stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.

paite: Akiang ah, "Kuamah hilh ke'n, himahleh siampu kiang ah va ki-ensak inla, na sianthouna ding Mosi seh bang lan in, mite theihchetna ding in," achi hi.
english: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

paite: Himahleh atanchin thu athang semsem a; mipi tampitak athu za nuam leh anatnate uh hihdam ut in ahong kikhawm kheukhou uhi.
english: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

paite: Himahleh amah gamdai ah apaituam a, athum hi.
english: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai lai in ni khat thu ahilh hi. Akiang ah Pharisaite leh dansiamte atu uhi, huaite Galili leh Judia gam kho teng a kipan a hong pai ahi uhi. Mite hihdamna ding in akiang ah Toupa thilhihtheihna a-om hi.
english: On one of those days, he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.

paite: Huan ngai dih, lupna toh mizaw khat ahon zawng ua; ama a koih ding in zawnlut atum uhi.
english: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.

paite: Himahleh mipi ziak in zawnlutdan ding amu thei kei ua, intung a kipan alaitak, Jesu ma ah alupna toh akhaikhesuk uhi.
english: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle before Jesus.

paite: Huan aginna uh amuh in akiang ah, "Mihing, na khelhnate ngaihdam ahita," achi hi.
english: Seeing their faith, he said to him, “Man, your sins are forgiven you.”

paite: Laigelhmite leh Pharisaite'n, "Pathian gensia hiai mi kua ahia? Pathian kia lou in kua'n ahia khelhnate ngaidam thei?" chi in angaihtuah uhi.
english: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, “Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?”

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n angaihtuah uh athei a, akiang uah, "Na lungtang uah bang na ngaihtuah ua?
english: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, “Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?

paite: Na khelhnate ngaihdam ahita, chih leh thou inla, khe in paita in, chih, akoi pen gen anuam zaw?
english: Which is easier to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Arise and walk’?

paite: Himahleh, khovel ah Mihing Tapa in khelhnate ngaihdam theihna anei chih na theihna ding un," damlou mizaw kiang ah, “Thou inla, na lupna la inla, na inn ah pai in, ka hon chi,” achi hi.
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins,” he said to the paralyzed man, “I tell you, arise, take up your cot, and go to your house.”

paite: Huchi in amitmuh un athou pah a, alupna ala a, Pathian phat kawmkawm in a-inn ah apaita hi.
english: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.

paite: Huan avek un lamdang asa mahmah ua, Pathian aphat uhi. "Tuni in thillamdang pitak i mu hi,” achi ua, alau mahmah uhi.
english: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things today.”

paite: Huaite khit in apawt a, siah piakna mun a tu, siahkhonmi khat amin Levi amu a; akiang ah, "Hon zui in," achi hi.
english: After these things he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!”

paite: Huchi in adingh a bangkim paisan in azuita hi.
english: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.

paite: Huan Levi in a-inn ah Jesu a ding in ankuang thupitak alui a; siahkhonmi leh midangte toh mi tampi in amau a-umpih chiat uhi.
english: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.

paite: Pharisaite leh laigelhmite anungzuite tung ah aphun uhi, "Bangziak a siahkhon mite leh mikhialte kiang a ne a dawn na hi ua?" achi uhi.
english: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Midam-theite'n daktor akiphamoh kei ua, midamtheiloute'n akiphamoh uhi.
english: Jesus answered them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

paite: Midiktatte sam ding a hong pai ka hi kei a, mikhialte kisiksak ding a hong pai ka hi zaw," chi in adawng hi.
english: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”

paite: Huan amau akiang ah, "Johan nungzuite'n an angawl zel ua, athum zel uh; Pharisaite nungzuite'n leng huchibang mah in ahih zel uh; himahleh na nungzuite'n ane un adawn gige uh," achi uhi.
english: They said to him, “Why do John’s disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Moupi mite kiang a apasal ding a om lai siah moupi mite an angawlsak thei ua hia?
english: He said to them, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?

paite: Himahleh apasal ding amau a kipan pimang nite ahong tung ding a, huai ni chiang in zaw angawl ding uh," achi hi.
english: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.”

paite: Huan akiang uah gentehna thu leng agen a, "Kuamah in puan thak them in puan lui athuap ngei kei, thuap mah le uh, athak in akaikek dia, athak them leh alui akituak kei ding uhi.
english: He also told a parable to them. “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.

paite: Huan kuamah in uain thak savun uain thawl lui ah athun ngei kei, thun le uh uain thak savun thawlte apuakzak dia, abo dia, savun thawlte leng asegawp ding uhi.
english: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled and the skins will be destroyed.

paite: Uain thak savun uain thawl thak ah athun zaw ding uhi.
english: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.

paite: Huan kuapeuh uain lui na dawn khin in leng, athak aduh pah kei hi; alui pen hoihzaw achi ngal a,” achi hi.
english: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Sabbath ni khat in buhlei ah apaisuak a, anungzuite'n buhvuite akhiak ua, akhutpek ua nuaisiang in ane uhi.
english: Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate, rubbing them in their hands.

paite: Pharisai kuate hiam in, "Bangziak a Sabbath ni a hihsiang lou hih na hi ua?" achi uhi.
english: But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”

paite: Jesu'n adawng a, "David agilkial lai a alawmte toh athilhih uh huai bangte leng na sim kei ua hia?
english: Jesus, answering them, said, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him,

paite: Huchi a Pathian inn a lut a, siampute lou ngal in anek siang louh tanghou koihtuam alak a, alawmte kiang a apiak sam thu," achi hi.
english: how he entered into God’s house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Mihing Tapa zaw Sabbath' Toupa ahi,” achi hi.
english: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Sabbath ni dang khat in sinagog ah alut a, thu ahilh a; huai ah mi khat khut taklam zaw ana om hi.
english: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.

paite: Laigelhmite leh Pharisaite'n ahekna ding amuhtheihna ding un, Sabbath ni in hihdam ding in akisa hia kisa lou asim et uhi.
english: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.

paite: Himahleh ama'n alungsim uh thei a, khutzaw kiang ah, "Thou inla, alai ah dingkhia in," achi hi. Huan athou a, adingkheta hi.
english: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Sabbath ni in hihhoih asiang hia, hihsiat? Hotdam asiang hia, hihlup? K'on dong ahi," achi hi.
english: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”

paite: Huan avek un a-en velvel a, akiang ah, "Na khut zankhia in,” achi hi. Huan azankhia a, akhut adamta hi.
english: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.

paite: Huchi in aheh lo mahmah ua, Jesu tung a hihdan ding akihouta uhi.
english: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai a kipan in apawt a, thum ding in tang ah akuan a, Pathian kiang ah zankhua in athum hi.
english: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.

paite: Khua avaktak in anungzuite asam a; alak uah sawm-le-nih atel a, amin ding un leng Sawltakte asa hi.
english: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:

paite: Huaite Simon Peter achih leh a-unaupa Andru, Jakob leh Johan, Philip leh Bartholomai,
english: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;

paite: Matthai leh Thomas, Alphai tapa Jakob, Zealot kichi Simon,
english: Matthew; Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus; Simon who was called the Zealot;

paite: leh Jakob tapa Judas leh amansakpa Judas Iskariot ahi uh.
english: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.

paite: Huan amau toh apaikhia a, mun zang ah adingh a, anungzui mipite toh, Judia gam tengteng a kipan leh Jerusalem a kipan leh Tura leh Sidon kholam a tuipi gei a kipan mipi tampitak athu ngainuam leh adamlouhnate uh hihdam ut in ahong pai uhi.
english: He came down with them and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases,

paite: Huchi in dawi nin sukbuaite leng damsak in a-omta uhi.
english: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits; and they were being healed.

paite: Huan akiang a kipan thilhihtheihna apawtkhia a, michih ahihdam zel ziak in mipi tengteng in amah khoih atum uhi.
english: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.

paite: Huan adakkhia a, anungzuite mitsuan kawm in agen a: "Nou gentheite aw, na hampha uh; Pathian lalgam nou a ahi ngal a.
english: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for God’s Kingdom is yours.

paite: Nou tua gilkialte aw, na hampha uh, tai ding na hi ngal ua. Nou tua kapte aw, na hampha uh, nui ding na hi ngal ua."
english: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.

paite: "Mihing Tapa ziak a mite'n ahon huat ua, hon pampaih ua, hon tai ua, na min uh ahoih kei chi a ahon paihmang chiang un, na hampha ding uh.
english: Blessed are you when men hate you, and when they exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man’s sake.

paite: Huai ni in kipak unla, nuam in tawm un, ngai un, van ah na kipahman uh a-om kihkeih hi; huchibang mah in apipute un zawlneite tung ah ahih uhi.”
english: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.

paite: "Himahleh, nou mihaute aw, na tung uh agik e; na khamuanna uh na mu khinta ngal ua;
english: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.

paite: nou tua vahte aw, na tung uh agik e; na gil uh ahong kial ding. Nou tua nuite aw; na tung uh agik e; lungkham a kap ding na hi ngal ua."
english: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.

paite: "Mi tengteng in ahon phat chiang un na tung uh agik ding hi; huchi mah bang in apipute un zawlnei takloute tung ah ahih uhi.
english: Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.

paite: "Ka thu ngaikhete aw, ka hon hilh ahi, na melmate uh it unla, hon hote hoihna ding hih un,
english: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

paite: Hon hamsiatte vualzawl unla, hon simmohte thumsak un.
english: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.

paite: Biang langkhat a hon bengpa alehlam leng doh in; na puan hon laksakpa kiang ah na puanak leng it ke'n.
english: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.

paite: Ahon ngen peuh kiang ah pia in; huan na van hon laksakpa kiang ah ngen nawn ke'n.
english: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.

paite: Huan mi'n na tung ua ahih ding uh na deih bang zel un mi tung ah leng hih sam un.
english: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.

paite: "Huan ahon itte kia na it un, pahtak bang na loh ding ua? Mikhialte'n leng amau itte a-it sam ve ua oi!
english: “If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.

paite: Na tung ua hoihte tung kia a na hoih un, pahtak bang na loh ding ua? Mikhialte'n leng huchibang mah in ahih zel ve ua oi.
english: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.

paite: Muh nawn lametnate kiang kia a thil na leitawisak un, pahtak bang na loh ding ua? Mikhialte'n leng angeingei mu nawn ding in mikhialte kiang ah aleitawisak sam uhi.
english: If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.

paite: Himahleh na melmate uh it unla, ahoihna ding un hih unla, lunglel het lou in leitawisak un; huchi in na kipahman uh atam dia, Tungnungpen tate na hi ding uh; ama'n mi kipahna dan theiloute leh migiloute ahehpih hi.
english: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.

paite: Na Pa azahngaih theih bang in zahngai thei in om un.
english: “Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.

paite: "Hawmsak kei un, huchi in hawmsak in na om kei ding uh; kuamah siam lou in sep kei un, huchi in siam louh in na om kei ding uh; ngaidam un, huchi in ngaihdam in na om ding uh;
english: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.

paite: pia un, huchi in piak in na om ding uh, hoihtak a teh a, hen gak a, sin gak in, let nawinawi in na angsung uah piak in na om ding uh. Noumau tehna ngei mah a tehsak a piak in na om ding uh ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”

paite: Huan akiang uah, gentehna agen a: "Mittaw in mittaw mah api thei diam? Anih un kokhuk ah akekhawm kei ding ua hia?
english: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?

paite: Asinsakpa tung ah nungzui a-om kei; himahleh mi kuapeuh kisinsiamtate asinsakpa bang in a-om ding uh.
english: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.

paite: "Huan bangziak a na mit a singtum om limsak lou a, na unau mit a ninneng neuchik om mu na hia?
english: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

paite: Nangmah mit a singtum om mu lou in, na unau kiang a, 'Unau, na mit a ninneng neuchik om hon lakhesak ve,' bangchi a chi thei na hia? Milepchiah na mit a pan singtum lakhe masa in, huchi in na unau mit a ninneng neuchik lakkhiak ding chiantak in na mu thei ding hi.
english: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.

paite: "Sing hoih gahsia a gah a-om ngei kei; sing sia lah gah hoih a gah a-om ngei sam kei hi.
english: “For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit, nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.

paite: Sing chih amau gah chiat ah akithei hi. Mi'n khaulingnei kung ah theipi alou ngei kei uh, loubukh lingnok lak ah grep gah alou ngei sam kei uh.
english: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.

paite: Mihoih in alungtang goubawm hoih a kipan thil hoihte alakhia a; migilou in alungtang goubawm sia a kipan thil hoihloute alakhe zel hi; alungtang a dim val kam in agen zel ngal a.
english: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.

paite: "Huan nou bang ding a, ka gente hihloupi a, Toupa, Toupa, hon chi na hi ua?
english: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?

paite: Michih ka kiang a hong a, ka thu za a zui peuhmah kua bang ahi ua, ka hon ensak ding:
english: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words and does them, I will show you who he is like.

paite: Amah zaw inn lammi in lei thukpi a tou a, suangpi tung a suangphum lem mi bang ahi; huan tui ahong khan in, tui khauh in huai inn akhoh a, ahihling thei kei; hoihtak a lam ahih ziak in.
english: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.

paite: Himahleh thu za a mang lou suangphum louh a leitung maimah a inn lammi ahi; tui khauh in huai inn akhoh a, achim pah a; huai inn siatna thupitak ahi,” achi hi.
english: But he who hears and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.”

paite: Huan mipite zak a athugen teng azohtak in Kapernaum ah alut a,
english: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

paite: sepaih zaheutu kuahiam sikha deihtak a china in, asi dekdek hi.
english: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.

paite: Huchi in Jesu tanchin azaktak in asikha hong hihdam ding a ngen ding in akiang ah Juda upate asawl hi.
english: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.

paite: Amau Jesu kiang ava tung ua, limtak in angen uhi,
english: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,

paite: "Amah zaw na hihsak tak ahi; ka nam uh a-it a, ka sinagog uh leng ama hon lamsak ahi,” achi uhi.
english: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”

paite: Huchi in Jesu amau toh ahong pai hi. A-inn atun dek kuan in sepaih zaheutu'n alawmte asawl a, "Ka insung na lutna tak ahi kei,
english: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.

paite: huaiziak in na kiang a hong tak in leng ka kisim kei, thu leltak gen lechin, ka naupang adam mai ding.
english: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.

paite: Kei leng mi thunuai a om ka hi a, ka nuai ah sepaihte a-om ua; huai mipa, hiai mipa, 'Pai in,' ka chihleh apai a, midang kiang ah leng, 'Hong pai in,' ka chihleh ahong pai a; ka sikha kiang ah leng, hiai hih in, ka chih leh ahih zel," achi hi.
english: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

paite: Jesu'n huai thu azak in lamdang asa mahmah a, akihei a, mipi amah zuite kiang ah, "K'on hilh ahi, Israelte lak ah leng hichi tel a ginna thupi ka mu kha kei," achi hi.
english: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”

paite: Huan inn ah amisawlte apai nawn ua, damtak in sikha amuta uhi.
english: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.

paite: Huan sawt louchik in khua khat Nain kichi ah ahoh a; akiang ah anungzuite leh mipi tampitak ahoh sam uhi.
english: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.

paite: Khopi kongkhak kiang atun in, ngai in, misi ahon zawngkhia ua, anu tapa neihsun ahi a, amah lah meithai ahi ngal a; akhua mite tampi akiang ah a-om uhi.
english: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only born son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.

paite: Toupa'n meithainu amuh in, alainat mahmah a, "Kap ke'n," achi hi.
english: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her and said to her, “Don’t cry.”

paite: Huan ava naih a, lang ava len hi; huchi in lang zawngte akhawl uhi. "Tangval thou in, ka hon chi," achi hi.
english: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”

paite: Huan misi atukhia a, ahong pauta hi. Huchi in Jesu'n anu kiang ah apeta hi.
english: He who was dead sat up and began to speak. Then he gave him to his mother.

paite: Huan mi tengteng in alau ua, Pathian aphat ua, "I lak ah zawlnei thupi ahong suakta, achi ua, Pathian in amite hong vehta," achi uhi.
english: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!” and, “God has visited his people!”

paite: Huan huai mi tungtang thu Judia gam tengteng leh akiang vel gam teng ah athangkheta hi.
english: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea and in all the surrounding region.

paite: Huan Johan nungzuite'n huai thu tengteng Johan ahilh uhi.
english: The disciples of John told him about all these things.

paite: Huchi in Johan in anungzuite nih asam a, Toupa kiang ah asawl a, "Hong pai dingpa na hi hia, midang hungaih lailai ding ka hi uhia?” chi in.
english: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”

paite: Huan amisawlte akiang ahong tun un, "Baptispa Johan in, 'Hong pai dingpa na hi hia, midang hungaih lai ding ka hi uhia?' chi in na kiang ah kou a hon sawl," achi uhi.
english: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, ‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”

paite: Huaitak in Jesu'n, damloute, hipi veite, dawimatte tampi ahihdam a, mittaw tampite leng amit uh ahihvak hi.
english: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.

paite: Akiang uah, "Pai nawnta unla, thil na muh uleh na zak uh Johan va hilh un; mittawte mit ahong vakta, khebaite khe in apaita ua, phakte hihsiang in om ua, nangongte bil ahong vakta, misite kaihthoh in a-omta uh, azawngte'n tanchinhoih hilh atangta uh.
english: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

paite: Huan kuapeuh ka tung a lung hihlouhna mu lou ahampha hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

paite: Johan sawltakte apai nung un Jesu'n mipite kiang ah Johan thu agen a, "Bang en ding a gamdai a paikhia na hi ua? Sialluang huih mut ling maw?
english: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

paite: Ahihkeileh, bang en ding pen a paikhia na hi ua? Puannem silh mi maw? Ngai un, puan thupi silh leh minuamsate kumpipate inn ah ei ve a-om uh.
english: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed and live delicately are in kings’ courts.

paite: Ahihkeileh, bang en ding pen in ahia na paikhiak uh? Zawlnei maw? Ahi tawk vo oi, ka hon chi ahi, amah zaw zawlnei sang a leng thupizaw ahi.
english: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

paite: 'En dih, ka thangkou na ma ah ka sawl ahi, ama'n na ma ah na lampi abawlkhol ding, chi a, atanchin kigelh, hiai mipa ahi.’
english: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

paite: Numei suan lak ah Johan sang a thupizaw a-om kei; himahleh Pathian lalgam a mineupen leng amah sang in athupizaw, ka hon chi ahi," achi hi.
english: “For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in God’s Kingdom is greater than he.”

paite: Huan mi tengteng leh siahkhonte'n huai azak un, Johan khut a baptisma tangsa ahih ziak un, Pathian siam atangsak uhi.
english: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.

paite: Pharisaite leh dan thei mite'n bel akiang a baptisma ana tang kei ua, amau a ding a Pathian in hoih dia asehsak adeih kei uhi.
english: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.

paite: Huchi in Jesu mah in, "Hiai khang bang toh ka teh diam aw? Bang toh kibang ahi ua?
english: “To what then should I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?

paite: Naupang dawr mun a tu a, 'Tamngai hon tumsak ung a, lam lou uchin a;' 'Suun ung a, nou lah kap tuan lou uchin a,' chi a kichituahte bang ahi uh.
english: They are like children who sit in the marketplace and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’

paite: Baptispa Johan ahong pai a, tanghou ane kei, uain leng adawn kei a nou, 'Dawi zawl ei ve,' na chi uhi.
english: For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’

paite: Mihing Tapa ahong pai a, ane in adawn a, 'En dih uh, an haipa, uain haipa, siahkhon mite leh mikhialte lawm,' na chi zel uhi.
english: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’

paite: Himahleh pilna tuh atate tengteng in siam atan uhi," achi hi.
english: Wisdom is justified by all her children.”

paite: Pharisaite lak a mi khat in akiang a an ne ding in adeih hi. Huai Pharisai inn ah alut a, an a-um hi.
english: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house and sat at the table.

paite: Ngai dih, huai khua a numei khat om in Pharisai inn ah an um in atu chih a theihtak in alabaster bawm in thaunamtui ahon tawi hi.
english: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.

paite: Anung ah akhepek bul ah kap kawm in adingh a, akhitui in akhepek asukawt a, asam in anul a, akhepek atawp a, thaunamtui anuh hi.
english: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

paite: Huan asampa Pharisai in huai amuh in, alungsim in, “Hiai mi zawlnei ahihleh akhoihnu numei kua ahia, mi bangchi ahia, theihtuaktak hi a, mikhial ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Simon, na kiang ah thu kam khat gen ding ka nei," chi in adawng hi. Ama'n, "Bang ahia, Sinsakpa?" achi hi.
english: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”

paite: Jesu'n, "Dangka leitawisak kuahiam in leibami nih anei a; khat in makhai zanga, khat in sawmnga aba uhi.
english: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.

paite: Huan aditna ding anei kei ua, angaidam tuaktuak hi. Huai mite akua in amah a-itzaw dia?" achi hi.
english: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”

paite: Simon in, "Angaihdam tampen in hi in ka gingta," chi in adawng hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Na chi dik," achi hi.
english: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.” He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”

paite: Huan numei lam anga a, Simon kiang ah, "Hiai numei na mu hia? Na inn ah ka hong lut a, nang ka khepek silna ding tui na hon pe kei a, ama'n akhitui in ka khepek asukawt a, asam in anul hi.
english: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.

paite: Nang tawp himhim na hon tawp kei; ama'n ka hong lut nungsiah ka khepek tawp atawlnga kei hi.
english: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.

paite: Nang ka lutang ah thau na hon nilh kei a; ama'n ka khepek thaunamtui anilh hi.
english: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.

paite: Huaiziak in ka hon chi ahi, akhelhna tampi ngaihdam in a-omta; ama'n nakpi in a-it hi. Himahleh, ngaidam tawm in, neuchik in a-it," achi hi.
english: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But one to whom little is forgiven, loves little.”

paite: Huai zoh in numei kiang ah, "Na khelhnate ngaihdam ahita," achi hi.
english: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”

paite: Huchi in an umpihte'n, "Mikhialte nangawn ngaidam kua ahia eita?" akichi uhi.
english: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”

paite: Numei kiang ah, "Na ginna in ahon hondam hi, khamuangtak in paita in," achi hi.
english: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”

paite: Anung in Jesu thuhih leh Pathian lalgam tanchinhoih gen kawm in kholian leh khoneute tawn vialvial in apai a; akiang ah sawm-le-nihte a-om uhi.
english: Soon afterwards, he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of God’s Kingdom. With him were the twelve,

paite: Numei kuate hiam dawimat leh china dam nawnte Magdalin kichi Mari sung a dawi sagih pawtna achih uh,
english: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;

paite: Joanna, Herod sumkempa Chuza zi, Sussana leh midang tampite toh ahi uh; huaite'n amau neihsa in amah nna asepsak zel uhi.
english: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod’s steward; Susanna; and many others who served them from their possessions.

paite: Huan mipi tampitak ahong kikhawm ua, kho chih a pan akiang a hong paikhawm mite kiang ah gentehna in thu agen a.
english: When a great multitude came together and people from every city were coming to him, he spoke by a parable:

paite: "Buhchithehpa buhchi theh in akuan a; atheh lai in akhen lamsik ah akia a, mi'n asikden ua, tungleng vasate'n anegai uhi.
english: “The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.

paite: Huan akhen suang tung ah akia a, apoutak in akawt louh ziak in avuai pah hi.
english: Some seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.

paite: Huan akhen loulingnei lak ah akia a, lou in apou tonpih a, adepmang hi.
english: Some fell amid the thorns, and the thorns grew with it and choked it.

paite: Huan akhen lei hoih ah akia a, ahong pou a, aleh za in agahta," achi hi. Huai thu agen lai in akikou a, "Kuapeuh zakna ding bil nei in, za uhen!" achi hi.
english: Some fell into the good ground and grew and produced one hundred times as much fruit.” As he said these things, he called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear!”

paite: Huan anungzuite'n akiang ah, "Hiai gentehna bang chihna ahia?" chi in adong uhi.
english: Then his disciples asked him, “What does this parable mean?”

paite: Ama'n, "Pathian lalgam thugukte na theih ding ua piak ahi a, midang kiang ah bel gentehna kia a gen ahi; mu napi a amuh theihlouhna ding uleh za napi a atheihsiamlouhna ding un," chi in adawng hi.
english: He said, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of God’s Kingdom, but to the rest it is given in parables, that ‘seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.’

paite: Huai gentehna thu omdan hiai ahi: Buhchi Pathian thu ahi.
english: “Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

paite: Lampi sik a kiate thu zasate ahi uh; himahleh diabol ahong pai a, agin louh ua, hotdam ahihtheihlouhna ding un alungtang ua kipan thu alakmangsak zel hi.
english: Those along the road are those who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.

paite: Huan suang tung a kiate azaktak ua thu kipaktak a pom pahte ahi ua; himahleh zung himhim anei kei ua, sawt louchik kia agingta ua, khemna hun in atawpsan nak uhi.
english: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root. They believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.

paite: Huan loulingnei lak a kiate thuzate ahi ua; himahleh akhosak zelna uah damsung khosak ngaihtuahnate, hauhsaknate, nopsaknate'n adep a, agah piching kei nak uhi.
english: What fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life; and they bring no fruit to maturity.

paite: Lei hoih a kiate bel thu za a lungtang kizen leh hoihtak a kem kinken a, thuakzoutak a gahsuahte ahi uhi.
english: Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and produce fruit with perseverance.

paite: "Kuamah khawnvak de in bel in akhuh kei uh, lupna nuai ah leng akoih kei uh; alut peuhmah in avak amuhtheihna ding un akoihna ah akoih zaw hi.
english: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.

paite: Thang lou ding a iim bangmah a-om kei, theih louh ding leh lang lou ding a selguk bangmah a-om sam kei hi.
english: For nothing is hidden that will not be revealed, nor anything secret that will not be known and come to light.

paite: Huchi in bangchibang in ahia na zak uh pilvang un; kuapeuh anei piak behlap ahi ding a, kuapeuh anei lou nei akichih sun leng laksak ahi ding,” achi hi.
english: Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has.”

paite: Huan anu leh a-unaute'n Jesu kiang ahong naih ua, himahleh mipi ziak in akiang atung thei kei uhi.
english: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.

paite: "Na nu leh na unaute nangmah muh tum in inpua ah adingh nilouh uh," chi in ahilh uhi.
english: Some people told him, “Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Pathian thu za a gingtate ka nu leh ka unaute ahi uh," chi in adawng hi.
english: But he answered them, “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai lai in ni khat anungzuite toh long ah atuang a, akiang uah, "Dil gal khat lam ah i kai ding uh,” achi a, huchi in long aphel ua, apaita uhi.
english: Now on one of those days, he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples, and he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side of the lake.” So they launched out.

paite: Long a atuan lai un Jesu a-ihmuta a; tuipi ah huihpi ahong nungsuk a, along uh tui in adim dekdek a, lauhuaipi in a-omta hi.
english: But as they sailed, he fell asleep. A wind storm came down on the lake, and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.

paite: Huan akiang ah ava hoh ua, aphawng ua, "Heutupa, heutupa, mangthang ding ka kei uh maw,” achi uhi. Amah akhanglou a huih leh tuikihot ataita a; atawp ua adaita mai uhi.
english: They came to him and awoke him, saying, “Master, Master, we are dying!” He awoke and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water; then they ceased, and it was calm.

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Na ginna uh koi a om ahia?" achi hi. Huan alau ua, lamdang asa mahmah uh. "Hiai mi kua ahia le, huih leh tui nangawn thu apiak a, athu aman uh?" akichi uhi.
english: He said to them, “Where is your faith?” Being afraid, they marveled, saying to one another, “Who is this then, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him?”

paite: Galili gam zawn Gerasinte gam atung uhi.
english: Then they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.

paite: Huan gam a apaikhiak lai in, khua a mi dawimat kuahiam in ana mu a; huai mi sawtpi puan silh lou in a-om hi, inn ah leng a-om kei a, han ngen ah a-om zaw hi.
english: When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes, and didn’t live in a house, but in the tombs.

paite: Jesu amuhtak in akikou a, ama ah abokkhup a, aw ngaihtak in, "Jesu, Pathian Tungnungpen Tapa, kei leh nang bang i kizolhna om ahia? Hon hihgim lou ding in ka hon ngen ahi," achi hi.
english: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, “What do I have to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don’t torment me!”

paite: Jesu'n huai mi sung a kipan a dawi nin pawt ding in thu ape khinta hi. Huai mi dawi in tamveipi amat ahi a; khainiang leh kol abunsak ua, aveng zel ua; himahleh agakna uh ahihtat a, dawi in gamkeu ah adelhkhia hi.
english: For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He was kept under guard and bound with chains and fetters. Breaking the bonds apart, he was driven by the demon into the desert.

paite: Jesu'n, "Na min bang ahia?" chi in adong a, ama'n, "Nuai ka hi," achi, asung a dawi tampi alut ziak in.
english: Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He said, “Legion,” for many demons had entered into him.

paite: Huan kokhuk taw nei lou a paih ding thu pe lou ding in Jesu kiang ah angen uhi.
english: They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss.

paite: Huai tang ah vokhon tampi agamta ua; vok sung a luttheihna thu akiang ah angen uhi. Ama'n phalna apia hi.
english: Now there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain, and they begged him that he would allow them to enter into those. Then he allowed them.

paite: Dawite huai mi sung a kipan apawt ua, vok sung ah alut uhi; huan tuipi gei, ken ah vokhonte ataisuk ua, tuipi ah atailut ua, tui hak in asita uhi.
english: The demons came out of the man and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.

paite: Huan vok vulte'n huai thil omdan amu ua, atai ua, khua ah leh gam ah agen uhi.
english: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.

paite: Huan bang ahita a? chi a en ding in apawt chiat uhi. Jesu kiang ahong tun un, dawi pawtsan nung puansilh a, lungsim ngeina pu in, Jesu khebul a tu ahong mu ua, huchi in alauta uhi.
english: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus’ feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

paite: Huan atheite'n dawimat ahihdamdan thu amaute ana hilh uhi.
english: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.

paite: Huan akim Gerasinte gam a mi tengteng in, alau mahmah ziak un, amah akiang ua kipan paimang ding in angen ua; huan, long ah atuang a, apaikik nawnta hi.
english: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them, for they were very much afraid. Then he entered into the boat and returned.

paite: Dawi pawtsan mi in Jesu kiang a omdet angen hi.
english: But the man from whom the demons had gone out begged him that he might go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n, "Na inn ah pai inla, Pathian in nang a dia thil ahon hihsak thupidan va hilh in," chi in asawlkhia hi. Huchi in apai a, khopi sung tengteng ah Jesu'n amah a dia thil ahihsak thupidan atangkoupihta hi.
english: “Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you.” He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.

paite: Huan Jesu ahong kik nawn in mipi in amah akipahpih ua; amah ana ngak nilouh uhi.
english: When Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.

paite: Huan ngai dih, sinagog vaihawmpa mi khat amin Jaira ahong pai a, Jesu khebul ah abokkhup a, a-inn a hoh ding in angen ngutngut hi.
english: Behold, a man named Jairus came. He was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus’ feet and begged him to come into his house,

paite: Tanu tang khat, kum sawm-le-nih hiam ding anei a, amah laitat ding in alum hi. Huan Jesu apai lai in mipihon in aboh lutlut uhi.
english: for he had an only born daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went, the multitudes pressed against him.

paite: Numei khat kum sawm-le-nih sipawt a china asum neih tengteng daktorte lak a zang khinta, kuamah in ahihdam theih tuan louh uh;
english: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians and could not be healed by any,

paite: anung ah ahong pai a, apuan mong akhoih a; thakhat in asipawt akam guih hi.
english: came behind him and touched the fringe of his cloak. Immediately the flow of her blood stopped.

paite: Jesu'n, "Kua ahia hon khoih?" achi hi. "Kei zaw ka hi kei," ana chi chiat uhi. Peter leh alawmte'n, "Heutupa, mipi'n hon boh lutlut in, ahon vel vengvung ve ua," achi uhi.
english: Jesus said, “Who touched me?” When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, “Master, the multitudes press and jostle you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n, "Kuahiam in hon khoih ahi, ka sung a kipan thilhihtheihna apawt chih ka theih ziak in," achi hi.
english: But Jesus said, “Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me.”

paite: Huan numei in akisel theih louh atheih in, ling kawm in ahong pai a, ama ah bokkhup in akhoihsan leh thakhat a adam takdan mi tengteng ma ah agenkheta hi.
english: When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling; and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

paite: Huan akiang ah, "Tanu, na ginna na dampih hi, khamuangtak in paita in," achi hi.
english: He said to her, “Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.”

paite: Apau laitak in sinagog vaihawmpa inn a kipan mi khat ahong pai a, "Na tanu asita, heutupa hihgim nuam dah in," achi hi.
english: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house came, saying to him, “Your daughter is dead. Don’t trouble the Teacher.”

paite: Jesu'n huai thu azak in, "Lau ke'n, gingta mai in, huchi in adam nawn ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, “Don’t be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.”

paite: Huan inn ava tun in, Peter, Johan, Jakob leh naupang nu leh pate kia chih louh ngal kuamah lut ding aphal kei hi.
english: When he came to the house, he didn’t allow anyone to enter in, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.

paite: Avek un ana kap kheukhou ua, akap vengvung ua, himahleh, ama'n, "Kap kei un, asi kei, ihmu ahi zaw," achi hi.
english: All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, “Don’t weep. She isn’t dead, but sleeping.”

paite: Huan si khin a atheih ziak un anuihsan maimah uhi.
english: They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.

paite: Jesu'n akhut alen a, "Nungaknou, thou in," achi a, asam hi.
english: But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, “Child, arise!”

paite: Huan akha ahong kik nawn a, athou pah hi.
english: Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately. He commanded that something be given to her to eat.

paite: Banghiam nek ding piak ding thu apia hi. Anu leh apa'n lamdang asa mahmah uhi. Himahleh ama'n athilhih kuamah hilh lou ding in achi bikbek hi.
english: Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.

paite: Huan Jesu'n sawm-le-nihte asamkhawm a, dawi nin tengteng tung a thilhihtheihna leh natnate hihdamtheihna thuneihna apia hi.
english: He called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

paite: Huchi in Pathian lalgam thu gen ding leh damloute hihdam ding in asawlkheta hi.
english: He sent them out to preach God’s Kingdom and to heal the sick.

paite: Akiang uah, "Zinna a ding in chiangkhun hiam, kawlzal hiam, tanghou hiam, dangka hiam, bangmah keng kei un; puanak nih leng keng kei un.
english: He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—no staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money. Don’t have two tunics each.

paite: Na tunna inn uah tung kinken unla, huai inn a kipan paikhia un.
english: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.

paite: Huan ahon kipahpih lou peuhmah huai khua a kipan na paikhiak chiang un amau mohpaihna ding in na khepek ua leivui tatkhia un,” achi hi.
english: As many as don’t receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.”

paite: Huchi in akuanta ua, khua atawn vialvial uhi. Gam chih ah tanchinhoih ahilh ua, mi ahihdam zel uhi.
english: They departed and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News and healing everywhere.

paite: Huan kumpipa Herod in athilhih tengteng uh ana za a; khenkhat in, "Johan hing nawnta ahi, achi ua, khenkhat in,
english: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,

paite: Elijah hong kilak ahi, achi ua, khenkhat in, nidanglai zawlnei kuahiam thounawnta ahi," achih ziak un, alungzingta hi.
english: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.

paite: Herod in, "Johan alu ka tanta a; himahleh hichi lawmlawm a athu ka zakzak kua ahia?" chi in amah muh atumta hi.
english: Herod said, “I beheaded John, but who is this about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.

paite: Huan sawltakte ahong kik nawn un, akiang ah athilhihte uh ahilh ua, ama'n amaute pi in khopi Bethsaida kichi ah apaituamta hi.
english: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them and withdrew apart to a desert region of a city called Bethsaida.

paite: Himahleh mipi'n athei ua, azui zel uh; ama'n amaute ana kipahpih a, Pathian lalgam thu ahilh a, hihdam kiphamoh peuhmahte ahihdam hi.
english: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, spoke to them of God’s Kingdom, and he cured those who needed healing.

paite: Huan nitaklam ahong hi dekta a; sawm-le-nihte ahong pai ua, akiang ah, "Khuate leh akim gam ah giahna leh annek-tuidawn zong ding in mipite paisak tanla; gamkeu mun a om hi ngal hang a," achi uhi.
english: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came and said to him, “Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms and lodge and get food, for we are here in a deserted place.”

paite: Ama'n bel akiang uah, "Nou nek ding pia un," achi hi. Amau, “Mi hiai zahzah nek ding i va leisak keileh, tanghou phel nga leh nga nih kia lou ngal bangmah i nei kei uh," achi uhi.
english: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.”

paite: Piching ngen leng sangnga phial ahi uhi. Huan anungzuite kiang ah, "Mite apawlpawl in tusak un, sawmnga zel in,” achi hi.
english: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”

paite: Huchi in ahih ua, atusak vekta uhi.
english: They did so, and made them all sit down.

paite: Huan tanghou phel nga leh ngasa nih ala a, van lam en in avualzawl a, abalkham a, mipi ma a lui ding in anungzuite kiang ah apia hi.
english: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.

paite: Huan ane ua, avah chiatta ua, akhamval nengte uh bawm sawm-le-nih aluakdim uhi.
english: They ate and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu amah kia a athum lai in akiang ah anungzuite a-om ua; akiang uah, "Mipite'n kua ka hi ahon chi ua?" chi in adong hi.
english: As he was praying alone, the disciples were near him, and he asked them, “Who do the multitudes say that I am?”

paite: Amau, "Baptispa Johan ahon chi ua; himahleh khenkhat in, Elijah hiam nidanglai zawlnei kuahiam thounawn ahon chi uh," chi in adawng uhi.
english: They answered, “‘John the Baptizer,’ but others say, ‘Elijah,’ and others, that one of the old prophets has risen again.”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Ahihleh nou kua ka hi na hon chi ua?" achi hi. Peter in, "Pathian Khrist mah," chi in adawng hi.
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “The Christ of God.”

paite: Huan huai thu kuamah hilh louh ding chi bikbek in, thu apia hi:
english: But he warned them and commanded them to tell this to no one,

paite: "Mihing Tapa in thil tampi athuak dia, upate, siampu liante leh laigelhmite deih louh in a-om ding, thah in a-om dia, ani thum ni in kaihthoh in a-om ding," achi hi.
english: saying, “The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.”

paite: Huan mi tengteng kiang ah, "Kuapeuh in hon zuih a-utleh amah kingaihsak lou in, niteng a ama kros pua in hon zui hen.
english: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

paite: Kuapeuh ahinna humbit ut in atan ding; kuapeuh keimah ziak a ahinna tan in ahumbit ding.
english: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake will save it.

paite: Mi'n khovel apum in nei henla, amah kimangsak hiam, ahihkeileh kimanlohleh amah a ding in bang aphatuam dia?
english: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?

paite: Kuapeuh keimah leh ka thu zahpihmi zaw Mihing Tapa in ama thupina toh, a Pa thupina leh a-angel siangthoute thupina toh ahong pai hun chiang in azahpih ding hi.
english: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.

paite: Diktak in ka hon hilh ahi, hiai a dinghte akhen, Pathian lalgam amuh masiah uh sihna chiam lou hial ding a-om uh," achi hi.
english: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here who will in no way taste of death until they see God’s Kingdom.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n athugen nung ni giat hiam in, Peter, Johan leh Jakob api a, thum ding in tang ah ahohtou uhi.
english: About eight days after these sayings, he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray.

paite: Athum lai in amel omdan ahong lamdang a, apuansilhte mi lengthei in ahong ngouta hi.
english: As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.

paite: Huan ngai in, mi nih amah toh akihou ua, huai mite Mosi leh Elijah ahi uh.
english: Behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,

paite: Thupina a kithuam in akilak ua, Jerusalem a sihna ahih bukim ding thu agen uhi.
english: who appeared in glory and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.

paite: Peter leh alawmte bel a-ihmut uh asuak a, himahleh ahak teitei ua athupina leh akiang a mi nih dinghte amu uhi.
english: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men who stood with him.

paite: Huan huai mite'n Jesu apaisan dek lai un, Peter in Jesu kiang ah, "Heutupa, ei a ding in hiai a om ahoih, aidakbuk thum i khoh dia, nang a ding in khat, Mosi a ding in khat, Elijah a ding in khat, achi a, athugen leng theiloupi in."
english: As they were parting from him, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah,” not knowing what he said.

paite: Huan huai thute agen lai in mei ahong kai a, amau aliahta; mei lak a alut lai un alau uhi.
english: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.

paite: Meipi a kipan aw ahong suak a, "Hiai ka Tapa, ka tel ahi, amah thu ngai un," achi hi.
english: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!”

paite: Huan aw adaihtak in Jesu kia amuta uhi. Huan adai dide ua, huai lai in athil muh uh kuamah bangmah ahilh kei uhi.
english: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, azing in tang a kipan apaisuk nung un, mipi tampitak in amah ana dawn uhi.
english: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.

paite: Ngai in, mipi lak ah mi khat akikou a, "Sinsakpa, ka tapa en ding in ka hon ngen ahi, amah ka tapa neihsun ahi.
english: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only born child.

paite: Ngai in, dawi in aman a, akikoukhe guih zel a; huchi in achilphuan ke hial in agimbawl a, nakpitak a hih sidup in apaisan zel hi.
english: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams; and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.

paite: Na nungzuite kiang ah delhkhe ding in ka ngen na a, ahihthei kei uh," achi hi.
english: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n, "Ginna nei lou khang leh lampialte aw, bang tan ahia ka hon thuak theih ding? Hiai ah na tapa hon pi in," chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”

paite: Huan ahong pai lai in dawi in ahihpuk ek a, nakpitak in agimbawlta hi; himahleh Jesu'n dawi nin atai a, naupang ahihdam a, apa kiang ah apaisak nawnta hi.
english: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.

paite: Huan mi tengteng in Pathian thupidan lamdang asa mahmah uhi. Huchi in mi tengteng in athilhih tengteng lamdang asak lai un, Jesu'n anungzuite kiang ah,
english: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

paite: "Hiai thute na bil uah lut hen. Mihingte khut a Mihing Tapa matsak a om ding ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: “Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.”

paite: Himahleh athugen atheisiam kei uh, atheihtheihlouhna ding ua kisel ahi, huai thugen tanchin amah adong ngam kei uhi.
english: But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.

paite: Huan alak uah kua athupipen dia? chih thu in ana kisel uhi.
english: An argument arose among them about which of them was the greatest.

paite: Jesu'n alungtang ua angaihtuah uh athei a, naupang neu khat akai a, asik ah a-omsak a, akiang uah,
english: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,

paite: "Kuapeuh ka min ziak a hiai naupang neu kipahpih keimah hon kipahpih ahi ding uh; keimah hon kipahpih hon sawlpa kipahpih ahi; na vek ua lak a neupen athupipen ahi ding," achi hi.
english: and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great.”

paite: Johan in, “Heutupa, kuahiam na min a dawite delkhia ka mu ua, ka hon zuihna ua apan louh ziak in ka khamta uhi,” chi in adawng hi.
english: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Kham nawn kei un, kuapeuh nou hon dal lou nou lam a pang ahi," achi hi.
