english: Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, amah pitouh hun ding anaitak in, Jerusalem a hoh atum tinten a, ama ah mi ama taisak hi.
english: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem

paite: Huan apai ua, amah a dia na kimansak ding in Samari mite khua khat ah alut uhi.
english: and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.

paite: Amai Jerusalem kholam naih a alat ziak in amah ana kipahpih kei uhi.
english: They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set toward Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in anungzui Jakob leh Johan in huai atheih un, "Toupa, amaute kangmang ding in, Elijah hih bang in van a kipan mei hong ke ding a thu ka piak uh hoih na sa hia?" achi uhi.
english: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”

paite: Amah akihei a, amau tai in, "Bang kha a pan na hi ua chih thei lou na hi uhiam?
english: But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.

paite: Mihing Tapa mite hihmangthang ding hilou in, hondam ding a hong pai ahi zaw hi,” achi hi. Huan kho dang ah apaita uhi.
english: For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.” They went to another village.

paite: Huan lampi a apai lai un, kuahiam in akiang ah, "Na paina peuh ah ka hon zui ding," achi hi.
english: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Sehalte'n kua anei ua, tungleng vasate'n leng bu anei uh, himahleh Mihing Tapa in zaw alu ngakna ding mun anei kei," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”

paite: Jesu'n midang kiang ah, "Hon zui in," achi hi. Himahleh ama'n, "Toupa, ka pa hon vuisak phot in," achi hi.
english: He said to another, “Follow me!” But he said, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Misite'n amisi uh kivui uhen; nang Pathian lalgam thu va gen zaw in," achi hi.
english: But Jesus said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce God’s Kingdom.”

paite: Huan midang in leng, "Toupa, ka hon zui ding, himahleh ka inn a mite kampha in hon khasak phot in," achi hi.
english: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang ah, "Kuapeuh leilehna len a, nunglam nga Pathian kumpigam mi hi tak ahi kei," achi hi.
english: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”

paite: Israel kiang a TOUPA kilakna Malaki in amuh.
english: A revelation, Yahweh’s word to Israel by Malachi.

paite: "Ka hon itta," TOUPA'N achi. Nou bel, "Koi lai ah ahia nang kou na hon it tak?" na chi uhi, "Esau, Jakob unaupa ahi kei maw? Hinapi in, Jakob ka it hi."
english: “I have loved you,” says Yahweh. Yet you say, “How have you loved us?” “Wasn’t Esau Jacob’s brother?” says Yahweh, “Yet I loved Jacob;

paite: Himahleh Esau ka hua a, atang sangte ka hihgawp a, gamdai sehalte kiang ah agoutan ka peta hi, TOUPA'N achi.
english: but Esau I hated, and made his mountains a desolation, and gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness.”

paite: Edom in, "Suk zawngkhal in i om ua, himahleh i kik nawn ding ua mun kisegawpsate i lam ding uh," chi mahleh, hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N, "Alam nawn ding ua, himahleh ka chimsak ding; mite'n amaute gitlouhna gam leh mipi atung ua tangtawn a TOUPA hehna nam," achi ding uhi.
english: Whereas Edom says, “We are beaten down, but we will return and build the waste places,” Yahweh of Armies says, “They shall build, but I will throw down; and men will call them ‘The Wicked Land,’ even the people against whom Yahweh shows wrath forever.”

paite: Huchi in na mitte un amu dia, "Israel gamgi khen ah TOUPA letsak in om hen," na chi ding uhi.
english: Your eyes will see, and you will say, “Yahweh is great—even beyond the border of Israel!”

paite: "Tapa in apa azahtak a, sikha in apu; huchi apa ka hihleh, kei zahtakna koi a om ahia? Huchi a pu ka hihleh, kei kihtakna koi a om ahia? Sepaihte' TOUPA'N na kiang uah achi, siampu ka min musitte aw. Nou koi lai ah ahia na min ka muhsit uh? na chi uhi.
english: “A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master, where is the respect due me?” says Yahweh of Armies to you priests who despise my name. “You say, ‘How have we despised your name?’

paite: Ka maitam tung ah tanghou sesa na lan ua, nou koi lai ah ahia ka hon hihnit uh? na chi uh. TOUPA dohkan asimmohhuai, na chihna uah.
english: You offer polluted bread on my altar. You say, ‘How have we polluted you?’ In that you say, ‘Yahweh’s table is contemptible.’

paite: Kithoihna ding a mittaw na lat un, gilou ahi kei maw? Khebai leh damlou na lat un, gilou ahi kei maw? Tu in na ukpipa kiang ah pe mah dih ua, ama'n apom in na tung ah alungdam diam? Ahihkeileh nou ahon deihsak diam?" sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: When you offer the blind for sacrifice, isn’t that evil? And when you offer the lame and sick, isn’t that evil? Present it now to your governor! Will he be pleased with you? Or will he accept your person?” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huchi in tu in ka hon ngen hi, i tung a azahngaihna na theihna ding un Pathian deihsakna ngen un. Hiai na khut ua kipan thilpiak toh nou hon deihsak diam? sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: “Now, please entreat the favor of God, that he may be gracious to us. With this, will he accept any of you?” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Athawn a ka maitam tung a mei na tohlouhna ding un, na lak ua mi khat kongkhakte khak ding omleh aw; Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, "Nou ah kipahna ka nei kei a, na khut ua kipan in thillat leng ka sang sam kei ding.
english: “Oh that there were one among you who would shut the doors, that you might not kindle fire on my altar in vain! I have no pleasure in you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “neither will I accept an offering at your hand.

paite: Nisuahna a kipan nitumna lam pha hial in leng namte lak ah ka min athupi hi, mun chih ah ka min a ding in gimlim akilan a, thillat siangthou; namte lak a ka min alet ziak in, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: For from the rising of the sun even to its going down, my name is great among the nations, and in every place incense will be offered to my name, and a pure offering; for my name is great among the nations,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Himahleh nou na hihnin ua, TOUPA dohkan anin a, huai a agah toh an nangawn azahpihhuai na chihna uah.
english: “But you profane it when you say, ‘Yahweh’s table is polluted, and its fruit, even its food, is contemptible.’

paite: 'Ngai un, nak chimtakhuai hina e; na chi lai ua, huan na hahchhiai khum uh, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, hiamgamtak a lak hiam ahihkeileh khebaite leh damloute huchibang thillat na hon tawi uh; na khut ua kipan in hiaite sang peuhmah ding ka diam?' TOUPA'N achi.
english: You say also, ‘Behold, what a weariness it is!’ And you have sniffed at it”, says Yahweh of Armies; “and you have brought that which was taken by violence, the lame, and the sick; thus you bring the offering. Should I accept this at your hand?” says Yahweh.

paite: Himahleh aganhon lak a apa nei a, thuchiam a TOUPA lak a thil demkai a kithoih, mikhempa hamsiat in om heh; Kumpipa thupi ka hi a, namte lak ah ka min alauhuai ngal a," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: “But the deceiver is cursed who has in his flock a male, and vows and sacrifices to the Lord a defective thing; for I am a great King,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and my name is awesome among the nations.”

paite: Tu in, nou siampute aw, “Hiai thupiak noute a ding ahi.
english: “Now, you priests, this commandment is for you.

paite: Ka min pahtawi ding a, na ngaihkhiak louh ua, na lungtang ua na koih kei uleh, huchi in na tung uah hamsia ka tungsak ding a, na vualzawlnate uh ka hamsiatkhum ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, ahi, lungtang a na koih louh ziak un, ka hamsiat khinta hi.
english: If you will not listen, and if you will not take it to heart, to give glory to my name,” says Yahweh of Armies, “then I will send the curse on you, and I will curse your blessings. Indeed, I have cursed them already, because you do not take it to heart.

paite: Ngai un, noute ziak in na chi tuh ka sal ding a, na mai uah ek ka thehthang ding a, na kithoihna ek ngei uh; huchi in huai toh lakmang in na om ding uhi.
english: Behold, I will rebuke your offspring, and will spread dung on your faces, even the dung of your feasts; and you will be taken away with it.

paite: Hiai thupiak, Levi toh ka thukhun a-omtheihna ding in, na kiang uah ka hon sawlta chih na thei ding uh, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: You will know that I have sent this commandment to you, that my covenant may be with Levi,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: "Hinna leh lungmuanna ka thukhun amah toh a-om hi, akihtak theihna ding in akiang ah amaute ka peta a, kei ahon kihta a, ka min azahtak mahmah hi.
english: “My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him that he might be reverent toward me; and he was reverent toward me, and stood in awe of my name.

paite: Akamsung ah thutak dan a-om a, diktatlouhna amuk ah akimu kei; lungmuanna leh tanna ah ka thu azui a, gitlouhna a kipan in mi tampi aheimangsak hi.
english: The law of truth was in his mouth, and unrighteousness was not found in his lips. He walked with me in peace and uprightness, and turned many away from iniquity.

paite: Siampu mukte'n theihna akem un, akam uah dan azong ding uh ahi him hi; amah lah sepaihte' TOUPA sawltak ahi ngal a.
english: For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth; for he is the messenger of Yahweh of Armies.

paite: "Himahleh lampi a kipan pialsak in na om ua; tampi dan ah na kisuipuksak uhi; Levi thukhun na suseta uhi.
english: But you have turned away from the path. You have caused many to stumble in the law. You have corrupted the covenant of Levi,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huaiziak in ka lampite na zuih louh dungzui un, dan a mite deihsak tuam na neih zawk ziak un, ke'n leng mipite tengteng ma ah zahpihhuai leh dai in ka hon bawlta hi," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: “Therefore I have also made you contemptible and wicked before all the people, according to the way you have not kept my ways, but have had respect for persons in the law.

paite: I vek un pa khat i nei kei ua hia? Pathian khat in hon siam kei a hia? Bangziak a lepchiahtak a michih in i pipute uh thukhun hihnin a-unau siatna ding a hih i hi ua?
english: Don’t we all have one father? Hasn’t one God created us? Why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, profaning the covenant of our fathers?

paite: Judah in lepchiahtak in ahihta a, Israel ah leh Jerusalem ah kihhuai hih in a-om hi, Judah in Pathian' mun siangthou it ahihninta a, theih louh pathian tanu akitenpihta hi.
english: Judah has dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah has profaned the holiness of Yahweh which he loves, and has married the daughter of a foreign god.

paite: TOUPA'N hiai thilhihpa, sinsakpa leh sinsak a ompa, Jakob puanin a kipan leh sepaihte' TOUPA kiang a thillat lanpa asatkhe ding hi.
english: Yahweh will cut off the man who does this, him who wakes and him who answers, out of the tents of Jacob and him who offers an offering to Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huan hiai na hih nawn uh; TOUPA maitam khitui, kah leh thumna in na khuh ua, thillat alimsak nawn louh a, na khut ua kipan deihsakna toh san leng asan nawn louh tanpha in.
english: “This again you do: you cover Yahweh’s altar with tears, with weeping, and with sighing, because he doesn’t regard the offering any more, neither receives it with good will at your hand.

paite: Hinapi in lah, "Bangziak in maw?" achi uhi. Na tuailai zi, lepchiahtak a na bawl, na kithuahpihnu, na thukhun zi hinapi in, amah leh nang kikal ah TOUPA theihpihpa ahih khit tak ziak in.
english: Yet you say, ‘Why?’ Because Yahweh has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt treacherously, though she is your companion and the wife of your covenant.

paite: Pathian in nihte sa khat in hon bawl kei maw? Khat in na kha hon bawlsak in, ahingsak kei maw? Bang achia khat? Pathian limsak chi azong ahi. Huaiziak in michih in atuailai zi lepchiahtak a hih lou ding in na kha thu uah pilvang un.
english: Did he not make you one, although he had the residue of the Spirit? Why one? He sought godly offspring. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let no one deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.

paite: TOUPA Israel' Pathian in achi, koihmangna ka hua a, hiamgamna a puansilh khuh mipa ka mudah hi, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Huaiziak in michih in atuailai zi lepchiahtak a hih lou ding in, na kha thu uah pilvang un.
english: One who hates and divorces”, says Yahweh, the God of Israel, “covers his garment with violence!” says Yahweh of Armies. “Therefore pay attention to your spirit, that you don’t be unfaithful.

paite: Na thu un TOUPA na hihgimta uh, koi ah ka hon hihgim ua ahia, na chi lai uhi; michih gilou hih TOUPA mitmuh in ahoih a, huaite ah amah akipak hi na chihna uah leh vaihawmna Pathian koi a om hiam na chih nakna uah.
english: You have wearied Yahweh with your words. Yet you say, ‘How have we wearied him?’ In that you say, ‘Everyone who does evil is good in Yahweh’s sight, and he delights in them;’ or ‘Where is the God of justice?’

paite: "Ngai in, ka sawltak ka sawl a, ama'n ka ma ah lampi abawlkhol ding a TOUPA, na zon uh, atempul ah thakhat in ahong pai ding; na kipahna uh, thukhun sawltak, ngai un, ahong hi," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: “Behold, I send my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me! The Lord, whom you seek, will suddenly come to his temple. Behold, the messenger of the covenant, whom you desire, is coming!” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Himahleh ahong paina ni kua'n athuakzou thei dia? Ahong lat chiang in kua adingzou dia? Amah hihsiangthou meikuang leh puansawptu sahbon bang ahi ngal a.
english: “But who can endure the day of his coming? And who will stand when he appears? For he is like a refiner’s fire, and like launderers’ soap;

paite: Huchi in dangka hihsiangthoumi leh siangsakmi bang in atu ding a Levi tapate ahihsiang ding hi, dangka-eng leh dangka bang in amau akhuahsiang ding a, huchi in diktatna in TOUPA kiang ah thillatte alan ding uhi.
english: and he will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver, and he will purify the sons of Levi, and refine them as gold and silver; and they shall offer to Yahweh offerings in righteousness.

paite: Huai chiang in Judah leh Jerusalem thillatte nidanglai bang leh tang a kumte bang in TOUPA a ding in namtui ahi ding hi.
english: Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasant to Yahweh as in the days of old and as in ancient years.

paite: "Huan vaihawmna ah aisan mite kalh in, angkawmte kalh in, zuau a kichiamte kalh in theihpihpa kin ka hi ding a, loh thu a migoih, meithai, pabei, nuaisiah, athuneihna a kipan mikhual kaiheipa, kei hon kihtaloute kalh in, na kiang uah ka hong ding sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: I will come near to you to judgment. I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, against the adulterers, against the perjurers, and against those who oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and who deprive the foreigner of justice, and don’t fear me,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: "Kei TOUPA ka zulhzau kei a; huaiziak in Jakob tapate aw, haltum in na om kei uhi.
english: “For I, Yahweh, don’t change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.

paite: Na pipute uh dam lai a kipan ka dan thupiakte na kilehheisan ua, na zui kei uhi. Ka kiang ah hong kik unla, na kiang uah ka hong kik ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Himahleh nou, koi ah i kik ding ua? na chi uhi.
english: From the days of your fathers you have turned away from my ordinances and have not kept them. Return to me, and I will return to you,” says Yahweh of Armies. “But you say, ‘How shall we return?’

paite: Mi'n Pathian alok diam? Hinapi in noute'n na hon lok uh. Himahleh bangchidan in ka hon lok ua eita? na chi uhi. Sawm-a-khatte ah leh thillatte ah.
english: Will a man rob God? Yet you rob me! But you say, ‘How have we robbed you?’ In tithes and offerings.

paite: Hiai nam pumpi in, kei na hon loh ziak un hamsiatna a hamsiat na hi uhi.
english: You are cursed with the curse; for you rob me, even this whole nation.

paite: Ka insung a an ahong omtheihna ding in koihkhawmna inn ah sawm-a-khat avek in hon lalut unla, huai in kei hon entel un, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Akoihna ding dantan kiching om lou khop in van tohlette hong in, vualzawlna ka hon buakkhe kei na hiam!
english: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house, and test me now in this,” says Yahweh of Armies, “if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there will not be enough room for.

paite: Huan negaimi pen nou ziak in ka sal ding a, na leigahte uh ahihse kei ding hi; na grepgui uh leng lou ah ahun tun ma in agah akesak kei ding hi, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast its fruit before its time in the field,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huchi in nam tengteng in nang nuamsa ahon chi ding ua; gam deihhuai na hih ding ziak un, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: “All nations shall call you blessed, for you will be a delightful land,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: "Kei dem a na thute uh akhauh hi," TOUPA'N achi, "Nou koi ah nang dem in thu ka gen ua eita," na chi uh.
english: “Your words have been harsh against me,” says Yahweh. “Yet you say, ‘What have we spoken against you?’

paite: "Pathian nasep athawn ahi, athupiak i zuih ua, suunna puan silh a sepaihte' TOUPA ma a i om uh bang ahia aphattuamna, na chi uh.
english: You have said, ‘It is vain to serve God,’ and ‘What profit is it that we have followed his instructions and that we have walked mournfully before Yahweh of Armies?

paite: Tu in kisatheite nuamsa chi in agitlouhna nasemte tunding in a-om uh; ahi; Pathian khemte hotkhiak in a-om uh," i chi uhi.
english: Now we call the proud happy; yes, those who work wickedness are built up; yes, they tempt God, and escape.’

paite: TOUPA kihtate akihoupih ua; huchi in TOUPA'N angaikhia a, aza a, TOUPA kihta a, amin ngaihtuahte ama ah, theihgigena laibuzial ah gelh ahi.
english: Then those who feared Yahweh spoke one with another; and Yahweh listened and heard, and a book of memory was written before him for those who feared Yahweh and who honored his name.

paite: "Huan amau kei a ahi ding ua, gou lamdangtak ka bawl ni chiang in," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Mi'n ama nasem atapa ahawi bang in huchi in amau ka hawi ding hi.
english: They shall be mine,” says Yahweh of Armies, “my own possession in the day that I make. I will spare them, as a man spares his own son who serves him.

paite: Huai hun chiang in na hong kihei ding ua, diktatte leh giloute, Pathian nasem leh ama nna semloute kal na khenchian thei ding uhi.
english: Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn’t serve him.

paite: "Ngai in, ani ahong tun ziak in, meiphualpi bang in akuang a; huchi in kisatheite tengteng, gilou nasemte tengteng, buhpawl ahi ding uh; huan ahong tung huai ni in amaute zung leh hiang nuse lou hial in akangmang ding uh," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: “For behold, the day comes, burning like a furnace, when all the proud and all who work wickedness will be stubble. The day that comes will burn them up,” says Yahweh of Armies, “so that it will leave them neither root nor branch.

paite: Himahleh nou ka min kihtate kiang ah diktatna ni, akhate ahihdamna toh ahong suak ding; huchi in na pawtkhe ding ua, huangsung bawngnoute bang in na diang velhvelh ding uhi.
english: But to you who fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings. You will go out and leap like calves of the stall.

paite: Huan giloute na sikden ding ua; ka gamtat ni chiang in na khepek nuai uah meivu hi ding ahih ziak un, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: You shall tread down the wicked; for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I make,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: "Horeb a Israel tengteng a ding a ka sikha Mosi Dan, amah thupiak, dan thusehte leh vaihawmte ngei, theigige un.
english: “Remember the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded to him in Horeb for all Israel, even statutes and ordinances.

paite: Ngai un, TOUPA ni thupi leh mulkimhuai ahong tun ma in na kiang uah zawlnei Elijah ka hon sawl ding hi.
english: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and terrible day of Yahweh comes.

paite: Pate lungtang tate lam ah, tate lungtang apate uh lam ah angasak ding; huchi lou in zaw hamsia in lei ka gawt kha ding hi.”
english: He will turn the hearts of the fathers to the children and the hearts of the children to their fathers, lest I come and strike the earth with a curse.”

paite: Pathian Tapa, Jesu Khrist tanchinhoih kipat tungna,
english: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

paite: zawlneite Isai laibu in, "Ngai dih, na ma ah ka sawltak ka sawl a, ama'n na lampi abawlkhol ding;
english: As it is written in the prophets, “Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you:

paite: gamdai a kikoupa aw in, Toupa lamlian sial unla, alampite hihtang un," chi a gelh ahih bang in.
english: the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!’”

paite: Johan in gamdai ah abaptis a, khelhnate ngaihdamna ding a kisikna baptisma thu gen in, ahong pawt hi.
english: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.

paite: Judia gam a mi tengteng leh Jerusalem a mi tengteng apawt ua, akiang ah apai ua, akhelhnate uh thupha tawi in Jordan lui ah, amaute abaptis zel hi.
english: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.

paite: Johan sangawngsau mul puan in akivan a, akawng savun kawnggak in agak a, a-an khaukhup leh khuaizu ahi.
english: John was clothed with camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.

paite: "Ka nung ah kei sang a thupizaw ahong pailel ahi; kun a akhedap khau phel tak leng ka hi kei," achi hi.
english: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.

paite: "Ke'n tui in noute ka hon baptis a; ama'n ahihleh Kha Siangthou in ahi ahon baptis ding," chi in agen hi.
english: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”

paite: Huai nite in hichi ahong hi a, Galili gam a Nazaret a kipan Jesu ahong pai a, Jordan lui ah Johan in ana baptis hi.
english: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

paite: Tui a pan ahong pawttak in, van kihong a vakhu bang a atung a Kha hong kum amu hi.
english: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

paite: Huan van a kipan aw hong pawt in, "Nang ka Tapa deihtak na hi a, na tung ah ka kipak mahmah," achi hi.
english: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

paite: Kha in amah gamdai ah asawl pah hi.
english: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.

paite: Huchi in Setan khem in gamdai ah ni sawmli a-om a, gamsate lak ah a-om a; angelte'n a-nna asepsak uhi.
english: He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.

paite: Johan mat a a-om nung in, Pathian lalgam tanchinhoih gen in, Galili gam ah Jesu ahong pai hi.
english: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,

paite: "Ahun ahong tungta a, Pathian lalgam ahong naita; kisik unla tanchinhoih gingta un," chi in.
english: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”

paite: Galili tuipi gei anawk lai in tuipi a Simon leh Simon unaupa Andru len pai a om amu a; amaute ngamanmi ahi him uhi.
english: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Hon zui un, huchi in mihing man ding in ka hon bawl ding," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”

paite: Alen uh paisan in amah azui pah uhi.
english: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.

paite: Sau lou apaileh Zebedai tapa Jakob leh a-unaupa Johan amu a, huaite len bawlpha in long ah a-om uhi.
english: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.

paite: Huan ama'n amau asam pah a; apa uh Zebedai leh kilohmi agoihte uh toh long nusia in azuita uhi.
english: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

paite: Huan Kapernaum ah ava lut ua; Sabbath ni in sinagog ah alut a, thu ahilh hi.
english: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.

paite: Laigelhmite bang lou a, thuneitak a amau thu ahilh ziak in athuhilh lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
english: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

paite: Asinagog uah dawi nin paimi khat ana om a; ama'n;
english: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,

paite: "Nazaret Jesu, kou leh nang bang ahia i kizolhna om? Kou hon hihmang dia hong pai na hi maw? Nang ka hon thei a, Pathian Mi Siangthou na hi," chi in akikoukhia hi.
english: saying, “Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”

paite: Jesu'n atai a, "Dai inla, asung a kipan hong pawt in," achi hi.
english: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”

paite: Dawi nin in amah a-engbawl a ngaihtak a kikou in asung a kipan ahong pawtta hi.
english: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

paite: Huan avek un lamdang asa mahmah ua, huchi in "Hiai bang ahia le! Sinsakna thak ahi ve! Dawi ninte nangawn thuneitak in thu apia a, athu amang zel uh," chi in akihou uhi.
english: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? What can this new doctrine be? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”

paite: Huan Galili leh akim gam tengteng ah atanchin athangta hi.
english: The report of him went out immediately into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.

paite: Huan sinagog a kipan apawt un, Jakob leh Johan toh Simon leh Andru inn ah alut uhi.
english: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

paite: Huan Simon sungnu khosik in achi ana a, ana lum a; huchi in a-omdan Jesu ahilh pah uhi.
english: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.

paite: Huan Jesu'n akhut a len in, aphong a; huchi in khosik in anuseta a, a-nna uh asepsak hi.
english: He came and took her by the hand and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.

paite: Huan nitaklam a nitum nung in, akiang ah damlou tengteng leh dawimatte ahon pi uhi.
english: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick and those who were possessed by demons.

paite: Akhomi tengteng kongkhak bul ah ahong omkhawm khiukheu uhi.
english: All the city was gathered together at the door.

paite: Huan mi tampi natna chiteng a nate ahihdam a, dawi tampi adelhkhia a; dawite'n amah atheih ziak un apau uh aphal kei hi.
english: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

paite: Huan zingsang khovak ma tham a thou in apawt a, gamdai mun ah ahoh a, huai ah athum hi.
english: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.

paite: Simon leh alawmte'n anung ah azui uhi.
english: Simon and those who were with him searched for him.

paite: Amah ava muh un akiang ah, "Mi tengteng in ahon zong uh,” achi uhi.
english: They found him and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Maban khuate ah pai ni, huai a leng thu ka gentheihna ding in; huai mah ka hong pawtsan ahi," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”

paite: Huchi in thu hilh a dawite delhkhe kawm in Galili gam tengteng a asinagogte uah alut hi.
english: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.

paite: Huan akiang ah phak ahong pai a, "Na utleh na hon hihsiangthou thei," chi in ama ah khukdin in angen ngutngut hi.
english: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”

paite: Ama'n ahehpih mahmah a, sawk in akhoih a, "Ka ut hi, na siangthouta in," achi hi.
english: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”

paite: Huchi in phakna in amah anuse pah a, ahong siangthouta hi.
english: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him and he was made clean.

paite: Jesu'n amah akham bikbek kawm in asawlkhe pah hi.
english: He strictly warned him and immediately sent him out,

paite: "Kuamah kiang a bangmah gen lou ding in pilvang in; himahleh siampu kiang ah va kilak inla, na kisiansakna ding in Mosi thilsehte lan in, mite'n ahon theihchetna ding un," achi hi.
english: and said to him, “See that you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

paite: Himahleh amah apawt a, huai thu nakpitak a kikoupih in athang-zakta hi; huchi in Jesu alangtang in khua ah alut thei nawnta kei a, gamdai mun ah a-om zawta a; huan mun teng a kipan mite akiang ah ahong pai uhi.
english: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places. People came to him from everywhere.

paite: Huan adingh a, huai a kipan Judia gam ah leh Jordan gal ah apaita hi. Akiang ah mipite ahong kikhawm ua; huchi in ahih ngeidan in amaute thu ahilh nawn hi.
english: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.

paite: Pharisai khenkhat akiang ah ahong pai ua, amah ze-etna ding in, "Mi'n zi amak asiang hia?" chi in ahong dong uhi.
english: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Mosi in bangchi in thu ahon pia a?" chi in adawng a.
english: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”

paite: Amau, "Mosi in kimakna laigelh a mak aphal," achi uhi.
english: They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n akiang uah, "Na lungtang khauh ziak un ahi huai thupiak nou a dia ahon gelhsak.
english: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.

paite: Himahleh leitung pian tung a kipan, Pathian in amaute numei leh pasal asiam hi.
english: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.

paite: Huai thu ziak in pasal in anu leh apa apaisan ding a, azi alen tinten ding;
english: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,

paite: huchi in anih un sa khat ahong hita ding ua; nih ahi nawnta kei ua, sa khat ahong hi zawta ding uh.
english: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.

paite: Huaiziak in Pathian in agawmsa mihing in khen kei hen," achi hi.
english: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.”

paite: Huan inn ah anungzuite'n huai thu amah adong nawn uhi.
english: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Kuapeuh azi ma a, midang nei in azi ang akawmsan hi;
english: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.

paite: ama'n leng apasal khen a, midang aneihleh angkawm ahi," achi hi.
english: If a woman herself divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.”

paite: Mite'n akhoih ding in naupang neute ahon pi ua; huan nungzuite'n huai mite ana tai uhi.
english: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n huai amuh in alung hi kei mahmah a, nungzuite kiang ah, "Naupang neute ka kiang ah hon paisak unla, kham kei un; Pathian lalgam hichibang mite a ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, "Kuapeuh naupang neute'n akipahpih bang a Pathian lalgam kipahpih lou asung ah alut kei hial ding,” achi hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

paite: Huan amau pom in, atung uah akhut akoih a, avualzawlta hi.
english: He took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.

paite: Huan pai ding a apawt lai in mi khat amah lam ah ahong tai a, ama ah akhukdin a, akiang ah, "Sinsakpa hoih, tangtawn hinna ka neihtheihna ding in bang ka hih dia?" chi in adong hi.
english: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Bangziak a hoih hon chi na hia? Mi khat kia lou ngal kuamah hoih a-om kei uh, huai Pathian ahi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.

paite: Thupiakte na thei vo oi; tual that ke'n, angkawm ke'n, gu ke'n, hek ke'n, khem ke'n, na nu leh na pa zahtak in, chihte," achi hi.
english: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not give false testimony,’ ‘Do not defraud,’ ‘Honor your father and mother.’”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, huai tengteng ka naupan lai a kipan ka zuita," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”

paite: Jesu'n amah a-en a, a-it a, akiang ah, "Hih ding khat nei lai chia; pai inla, na neih peuhmah zuak inla, tagahte kiang ah pia in, huchi in van ah gou na nei ding; huan hong pai inla, hon zui in,” achi hi.
english: Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me, taking up the cross.”

paite: Himahleh, huai thu ah amel ahong mual a, lungkhamtak in apaimangta; mihausa ahih ziak in.
english: But his face fell at that saying, and he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had great possessions.

paite: Jesu'n a-en vialvial a, anungzuite kiang ah, "Mihausate ding in Pathian lalgam lut haksat tuak hi na mai e," achi hi.
english: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!”

paite: Nungzuite'n athugen lamdang asa mahmah uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Naute aw, hauhna muangte a ding in Pathian lalgam a lut ahaksa ngei e.
english: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answered again, “Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

paite: Pathian lalgam a mihausa alut sang in sangawngsau phim bilvang a lut paisuak abaihlamzaw," achi hi.
english: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

paite: Amau lamdang asa mahmah ua, akiang ah, "Ahihleh, kua hotdam ahi thei dia?" achi uhi.
english: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”

paite: Jesu'n amau a-en a, "Huai zaw mihing a ding in hih vual ahi kei, Pathian a ding in bel hih vual louh a-om kei; Pathian a ding in bangkim hihtheih ahi ngal iris a," achi hi.
english: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”

paite: Peter in akiang ah, "Ngai dih, kou bangkim paisan in ka hon zui ua,” chi in agen pan a.
english: Peter began to tell him, “Behold, we have left all and have followed you.”

paite: Jesu'n, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh keimah ziak leh tanchinhoih ziak a inn, unaupate, unaunute, nu, pa, tate leh gamte paisan,
english: Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or land, for my sake, and for the sake of the Good News,

paite: tu damsung mahmah in, innte, unaupate, sanggamnute, nute, tate, gamte aleh za in, sawinate toh, hun hong tung ding a tangtawn hinna toh mu lou ding mahmah a-om kei hi.
english: but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time: houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land, with persecutions; and in the age to come eternal life.

paite: Himahleh mi tampi masapen a omte nanungpen ahong hi ding ua, nanungpente leng masapen ahong hi ding uh," achi hi.
english: But many who are first will be last, and the last first.”

paite: Huan Jerusalem a hohtou ding in lampi ah a-om ua; Jesu'n ama uh akai hi. Amau lamdang asa mahmah ua; ahon zuite'n alau uhi. Ama'n sawm-le-nihte apituam nawn a, atung a tung dingte ahilh hi.
english: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.

paite: "Ngai dih ua, Jerusalem a hohtou ding i hi ua; Mihing Tapa siampu liante leh laigelhmite khut ah matsak in a-om ding; amau si ding in atung ah thu ahihpuk ding ua, Zentelte kiang ah ape ding uh.
english: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death, and will deliver him to the Gentiles.

paite: Amau nuihza bawlna in anei ding ua, chil asiatkhum ding ua, avo ding ua, athat ding uh; himahleh ni thum nung in athounawn ding," chi in atung a thil tung dingte amaute ahilh hi.
english: They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”

paite: Huan Zebedai tapa Jakob leh Johan in amah ahong naih ua, akiang ah, "Sinsakpa na kiang a ka hon nget peuh uh na hon hihsak ka ut uh," achi uhi.
english: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou a ding in bang hon hihsak leng na ut ua?" achi hi.
english: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Na thupina ah na taklam ah khat, na veilam ah khat hon tusak in," achi uhi.
english: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand and one at your left hand, in your glory.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Na nget uh na thei kei ua ahi. Ka nou dawn ding na dawn thei ding ua hia? Ka baptisma tan ding leng na tang thei ding ua hia?" achi hi.
english: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Hihthei e,” achi uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ka nou dawn ding na dawn ding ua, ka baptisma tan ding leng na tang ding uh;
english: They said to him, “We are able.” Jesus said to them, “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;

paite: himahleh ka taklam leh ka veilam a tut ding thu zaw kei piak ding ahi kei a, abawlsakte uh a ding ahi zaw,” achi hi.
english: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”

paite: Huan sawmte'n huai azak un, Jakob leh Johan tung ah alungkim kei uhi.
english: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.

paite: Jesu'n amau asam a, akiang uah, "Zentelte tung a vaihawm dia asehte uh atung uah alian mahmah ua, amiliante un atung uah thu anei mahmah uh chih na thei uhi.
english: Jesus summoned them and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

paite: Himahleh noute lak ah zaw huchibang ahi kei ding; kuapeuh na lak ua milian hih ut nasemtu in apang zaw ding ahi.
english: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.

paite: Kuapeuh na lak ua masapen hih utmi tengteng sikha a apan ding ahi.
english: Whoever of you wants to become first among you shall be bondservant of all.

paite: Mihing Tapa hial leng nna sepsak a om ding in ahong pai kei a, nasem ding leh mi tampi tatna dia ahinna pe ding a hong pai ahi zaw hi," achi hi.
english: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

paite: Huan Jeriko khua ahong tung uhi; huchi in Jesu, Jeriko a kipan anungzuite leh mipi tampitak toh apawt lai un khutdoh mittaw, Timai tapa Bartimai lam gei ah ana tu hi.
english: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.

paite: Huan Nazaret Jesu ahi chih azaktak in, "Jesu, David Tapa, ka tung ah zahngai in," chi in akikou hi.
english: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

paite: Mi tampi in dai ding in akhou ua; himahleh ama'n, "David Tapa, ka tung ah zahngai in," chi in akinak kou semsem hi.
english: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

paite: Jesu adingh a, "Amah hon sam dih ua," achi hi. Huan mittaw asam ua akiang ah, "Khamuangtak in om in. Thou in; ahon sam," achi uhi.
english: Jesus stood still and said, “Call him.” They called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!”

paite: Huan apuan paikhia in adingh a, Jesu kiang ah ahohta hi.
english: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.

paite: Jesu'n amah ahoupih a, "Na tung ah bang hon hihsak leng na ut a?" achi hi. Mittaw in akiang ah, "Heutupa, muh theih ka ut," achi hi.
english: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”

paite: Jesu'n, akiang ah, "Paita in, na ginna dampih hi teh,” achi a, huchi in amu thei pahta a, lampi ah Jesu azuita hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the way.

paite: Huchi in Jerusalem khua tung ding a akisak ua, Olive tang a Bethphage leh Bethani kho kiang atun un, anungzuite lak a mi nih asawl a, akiang uah,
english: When they came near to Jerusalem, to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples

paite: "Na mazawn ua khua ah va hoh unla; na lut tung un sabiltungnou kikhih, kuamah tuan ngeilouhna, na mu ding ua; phel unla, hon kai un.
english: and said to them, “Go your way into the village that is opposite you. Immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. Untie him and bring him.

paite: Huan kuapeuh in, huai bangziak a hih ahon chih uleh, Toupa'n adeih a ahi; hiai ah ahon koihsak nawn pah na ding, na chi ding uh," achi hi.
english: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs him;’ and immediately he will send him back here.”

paite: Huan ahohta ua, kongzing ah kongkhak polam a sabiltungnou kikhih ava mu ua; huai aphelta uhi.
english: They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.

paite: Huai a dingh kuate hiam in, akiang uah, "Sabiltungnou bangziak a phel?" achi uhi.
english: Some of those who stood there asked them, “What are you doing, untying the young donkey?”

paite: Amau Jesu gen bangtak in akiang uah agen ua; huchi in aphalta uhi.
english: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.

paite: Huan Jesu kiang ah sabiltungnou ahon kai ua, atung ah apuante uh aphah ua; atung ah atuangta hi.
english: They brought the young donkey to Jesus and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.

paite: Mi tampi in lampi ah apuan uh aphah ua; midang in leng gam a sawlnah sat in aphah uhi.
english: Many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees and spreading them on the road.

paite: Amalam a paite leh anunglam a hon zuite'n: "Hosanna! Toupa min a hong pai ahampha!
english: Those who went in front and those who followed cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!

paite: Gam hong tung ding, i Pa David lalgam ahampha! Tungnungpen ah Hosanna!" chi in akikou uhi.
english: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”

paite: Huan Jerusalem a tempul ah ava lut a; bangkim a-et velvel khit in nitaklam leng ahong hita a, apawt a, sawm-le-nihte toh Bethani ah apaita uhi.
english: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

paite: Azing in Bethani a kipan apawt nung in agil ahong kialta hi.
english: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.

paite: Theipi kung nah nei gamlapi ah amu a, agah ka muh khakleh chi in ava zuan hi; ava tun in anah kia lou ngal bangmah amuta kei a; theipi gah hun ahi kei him hi.
english: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n sing ahoupih a, "Tuban tangtawn in nang a pan kuamah in gah ne nawnta kei hen," achi hi. Anungzuite'n huai aza uhi.
english: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.

paite: Huan Jerusalem khua atung ua, tempul ah ava lut a, tempul a zuak mite leh lei mite adelhkhia a, dangka kheng mite dohkante leh vakhu zuak mite tutphah asawnpuksak hi.
english: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

paite: Tempul a mite'n van alut paisuakpih uh aphalta kei hi.
english: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.

paite: Huan amaute sinsak in akiang uah, "Ka inn nam chih a ding in thumna inn achi ding uh, chih gelh ahi kei a hia? Nou suamhatte khuk in na bawl ua," achi hi.
english: He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers!”

paite: Siampu liante leh laigelhmite'n huai aza ua, amah hihmanthat theihna ding azongta uhi; mipi tengteng in athuhilh lamdang asak ziak un amah alau uhi.
english: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.

paite: Huan nitaklam ahong hih in khopi a kipan apawtkhia uhi.
english: When evening came, he went out of the city.

paite: Huan zingsang a apai kawm un huai theipi kung azung tanpha vuai khin in amuta uhi.
english: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.

paite: Huchi in Peter in theikhia in akiang ah, "Heutupa, en dih; theipi kung hamsiat na loh ana vuai khin vekta," achi hi.
english: Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Pathian gingta un.
english: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh in hiai tang kiang ah, na kisuan inla, tuipi ah na kipailut in chi a, alungtang a ginglel lou a agen atung ngeingei ding chih gingta peuhmah in agen bangbang amu ding uhi.
english: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.

paite: Huaiziak in ka hon hilh ahi, bangkim thum a na nget peuhmah uh musa in kiging unla huchi in na mu ding uh.
english: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

paite: Thum a na din peuhmah chiang un kua tung ah leng thubuai banghiam na neih uleh ngaidam un; na Pa uh van a om in leng na tatlekna uh ahon ngaihdam theihna ding in.
english: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.

paite: Himahleh na ngaihdam kei uleh, na Pa uh van a om in na tatleknate uh ahon ngaidam sam kei ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions.”

paite: Huan Jerusalem khua atung nawn ua; tempul a avak lai in siampu liante, laigelhmite leh upate akiang ah ahong pai ua,
english: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to him,

paite: akiang ah, "Kua thu in ahia hiai thilte na hih? Hiai thilte hih ding in kua'n ahia nang thu hon piak?" achi uhi.
english: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ke'n leng thu kam khat ka hon dong sam ding, hon dawng le uchin, huchi in kua thu in ahia hiai thil ka hih chih ka hon hilh ding," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

paite: "Johan Baptisma van a kipan hia; mihing a kipan? Hon dawng un," achi hi.
english: The baptism of John—was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”

paite: Huan akingaihtuah ua, "Van a kipan chi lehang, Bang achia athu gingta lou na hi ua, ahon chi dia;
english: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we should say, ‘From heaven;’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

paite: himahleh mihing a kipan chi leng mipi akihta ua; mi tengteng in Johan zawlnei taktak in abawl chiat uhi."
english: If we should say, ‘From men’”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.

paite: Huchi in Jesu adawng ua, "Thei kei ung," achi uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ke'n leng kua thu in ahia hiai thilte ka hih, ka hon hilh sam kei ding," achi hi.
english: They answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

paite: Huan gentehna thu in akiang uah agen a, "Mi kuahiam in grephuan abawl a, akim huang in a-um a, grep sukna ding khuk atou a, insang alam a, loukhou mite kiang ah khohloh ding in apia a, gamdang ah apaisanta hi.
english: He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.

paite: Agah loh hun in atansik amau kiang a kipan la ding in lou khohloh mite kiang ah sikha khat asawl hi.
english: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.

paite: Huai mi ana man ua, avua ua, khutvuak in apaisak uhi.
english: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.

paite: Huan sikha dang akiang uah asawl nawn a; huai mi leng alu ana hihliam ua, zumhuaipi in ana bawl uhi.
english: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.

paite: Huan sikha dang asawl nawn zel a; huai mi ana that ua, sikha dang tampi leng, khenkhat ana vua ua, khenkhat ana that uhi.
english: Again he sent another, and they killed him, and many others, beating some, and killing some.

paite: Huan sawl ding khat, atapa deihtak kia anei lai hi; 'Ka tapa zaw ana zahtak ding uh' chi in amah ananungpen in akiang uah asawl hi.
english: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

paite: Himahleh huai lou khohloh mite'n, 'hiai mi gouluah dingpa ahi; i that ding uh aw; huchi in agouluah ding ei a ahi mai ding,' akichi uhi.
english: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

paite: Huchi in amah aman ua, that in, grephuan a pan alawnkhia uhi.
english: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

paite: Huaiziak in grephuan neipa'n bangchi in ahon hih dia? Lou khohloh mite ahon hihmangthang dia; grephuan midangte ape ding hi.
english: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.

paite: Hiai Laisiangthou na sim kei ua hia? 'Inn lam mite' suang deih louhpen, huai mahmah aning a suang phatuampen ahong hita hi.
english: Haven’t you even read this Scripture: ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner.

paite: Huai Toupa hih ahi, i mitmuh un alamdang hi, chih,' " achi hi.
english: This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?”

paite: Huan amah mat atum ua; himahleh huai gentehna thu amau dem a agen ahi chih atheih ziak un, mipite alau uhi. Huchi in amah anusia ua, apaimangta uhi.
english: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him and went away.

paite: Huan athugen a mat ahihtheihna ding in Pharisaite leh Herod pawl a mi kuate hiam akiang ah asawl uhi.
english: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.

paite: Huchi in amau ahong tun un akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, midiktat na hi a, deihsak tuam kuamah na nei kei chih ka thei uh, kuamah khentuam nei lou in, chihtak ngial in Pathian lam thu na hilh zel hi; Kaisar kiang a leiman liau asiang hia siang lou?
english: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?

paite: Pe ding ka hi uhia, pe lou ding?" achi uhi. Ama'n alepchiahdan uh thei in, akiang uah, "Bangziak a hon ze-et na hi ua? Makhai hon tawi un, ka en ding," achi hi.
english: Shall we give, or shall we not give?” But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.”

paite: Ahon tawi ua, ama'n akiang uah, "Hiai kua lim leh kua min ahia?" achi hi.
english: They brought it. He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”

paite: Amau, "Kaisar a," achi uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Kaisar thilte Kaisar kiang ah pia unla, Pathian thilte Pathian kiang ah peta unla," achi hi. Huchi in lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
english: Jesus answered them, “Give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” They marveled greatly at him.

paite: Huan Saddukai, thohnawnna a-om kei chite, akiang ah ahong ua,
english: Some Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him. They asked him, saying,

paite: akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, Mosi in, kuapeuh a-unaupa'n ta nei lou in azi sihsan taleh a-unaupa'n azi luah in a-unaupa a ding in chi asuahsak ding chi in ahon gelhsak hi.
english: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

paite: Ahi, sal sagih a-om ua; a-upapen in zi anei a, chi suah lou in asi hi.
english: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.

paite: Huan anihna in aluah a, chi suah lou in asi nawn zel a; athumna in huchi mah bang in.
english: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;

paite: Huchi in sal sagihte chi suah lou in asita ua, atawpna ah numei leng asita hi.
english: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.

paite: Thohnawn hun in akua pen zi ahi dia le? Sagihte'n zi in anei chiat ngal ua," chi in adong uhi.
english: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Hiai ziak hilou hia, na theihkhelh nak uh, Laisiangthou leh Pathian thilhihtheihna na theih louh ziak un?
english: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God?

paite: Misi lak a pan athohnawn hun un zi leh pasal a kinei lou in, van angelte bang ahi zawta ding uh ahi.
english: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

paite: Huan misite kaihthoh a a-om ding thu lah Mosi laibu a loubukh kuang thu a Pathian in, 'Kei Abraham' Pathian, Isak' Pathian leh Jakob' Pathian ka hi, chi a, amah ahoupihdan na sim kei ua hia?'
english: But about the dead, that they are raised, haven’t you read in the book of Moses about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?

paite: Amah misi Pathian ahi kei a, mihing Pathian ahi zaw; na theikhial tel uh," achi hi.
english: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.”

paite: Huan laigelhmite lak a mi khat ahong a, akisel uh ana ngaikhia a, Jesu'n amaute thutak in adawng chih athei a, akiang ah, "Thupiak tengteng ah koi ahia thupipen?" chi in adong hi.
english: One of the scribes came and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”

paite: Jesu'n, "Athupipen hiai ahi; Israel aw, ngai dih uh, Toupa i Pathian uh Toupa khat kia ahi;
english: Jesus answered, “The greatest is: ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.

paite: 'Toupa na Pathian na lungtang tengteng in, na kha tengteng in, na lungsim tengteng in leh na hatna tengteng in na it ding ahi,' chih.
english: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.

paite: Azom hiai ahi, 'Nangmah na ki-it bang in na vengte na it ding,' chih. Hiaite sang a thupiak thupizaw a-om kei," chi in adawng hi.
english: The second is like this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”

paite: Laigelhmi'n akiang ah, "Hina ngei e, Sinsakpa amah zaw khat kia ahi a, amah lou zaw kuamah dang a-om kei,
english: The scribe said to him, “Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he;

paite: amah lungtang tengteng, theihsiamna tengteng, hatna tengteng a it a, eimah i ki-it bang a vengte it halmang thilpiak leh kithoihna tengteng sang in ahoihzaw petmah chih, na gen dik ngei," achi hi.
english: and to love him with all the heart, with all the understanding, all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”

paite: Piltak in adawng chih Jesu'n atheih in akiang ah, "Pathian lalgam na gamlat kei hi," achi a, huai nungsiah kuamah in thu adong ngamta kei uhi.
english: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from God’s Kingdom.” No one dared ask him any question after that.

paite: Huan tempul a Jesu'n thu ahilh lai in, amau ahoupih a, "Khrist David tapa ahi chih laigelhmite'n bangchidan a gen uh ahia?
english: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?

paite: David ngei in, Kha Siangthou in, Toupa'n, ka Toupa kiang ah, 'Na melmate na khepek ngakna a ka bawl masiah ka taklam ah tu in, achi,' achi hi.
english: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

paite: "David ngei in amah Toupa, achi ngal a, koi a kipan in ahia amah atapa ahih?" achi hi. Huan mivantang in kipaktak in athu angaikhia uhi.
english: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.

paite: Huan athuhilhna ah, "Lai-gelhmite lak ah pilvang un; amau puanaktual silh a vak a-ut ua, dawr munte ah mite chibai abuk ua,
english: In his teaching he said to them, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,

paite: sinagog ah tutphah hoihpen leh ankuangluina a mun hoihpen adeihtuam nak uh;
english: and to get the best seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts,

paite: meithai inn anegai ua, kilimbawl in sawt pipi athum uh; huaite'n siam louh tanna lianzaw atang ding uh," achi hi.
english: those who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

paite: Huan sumkholna zawn ah atu a; sumkholna a mipi sumkhiakdan a-en a; mihau tampitak in tampipi akhia uhi.
english: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.

paite: Meithai zawngtak ahong pai a, dal dangka muza nih akhia a, huai tuh paihsa khat hu ahi.
english: A poor widow came and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.

paite: Jesu'n anungzuite asam a, akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, sumkholna a khe tengteng lak ah hiai meithai zawngtak in akhe tampen hi.
english: He called his disciples to himself and said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,

paite: Hiaite tengteng in aneihlet uh akhia ua; ama'n zaw adeihthoh laitak, aneihsun, ahinna ding tengteng akhe vek ahi," achi hi.
english: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”

paite: Huan tempul a kipan apaikhiak lai in, anungzuite lak a mi khat in akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, en dih, suang leh innte athupi mahmah hi," achi hi.
english: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!”

paite: Jesu'n, akiang ah, "Hiai inn thupitakte na mu maw? Hihchip louh a, suang kichiang hiai ah a-om kei ding," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down.”

paite: Huan Olive tang a tempul zawn a atut lai in, Peter, Jakob, Johan leh Andrute'n akiang ah,
english: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,

paite: "Huaite chikchiang in ahong om dia? Huai tengteng atun ding chiang in chiamtehna bang a-om dia, hon hilh in," chi in asimdot uhi.
english: “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Kuamah in hon khemlouhna ding in pilvang un.
english: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

paite: Mi tampi, Khrist ka hi, chi in keimah min lou in ahong pai ding ua, mi tampi akhempuk ding uh.
english: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ and will lead many astray.

paite: Huan kidou thu leh kidou thuthang na zak hun chiang un mangbang kei un; huaite hong tung ding him ahi uh. Himahleh atawpna zaw ahi nai tadih kei ding.
english: “When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.

paite: Nam tuam leh nam tuam akidou ding ua, gam tuam leh gam tuam akidou ding ua; mun tuamtuam ah zin aling dia; kial ake ding hi. Hiaite nauvei kipatna ahi.
english: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places. There will be famines and troubles. These things are the beginning of birth pains.

paite: "Himahleh pilvang un; vaihawmte ahon mansak ding ua; sinagog ah ahon vo ding ua; keimah ziak in gamukte leh kumpipate ma ah theihpihna pe ding in na dingh ding uhi.
english: “But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them.

paite: Huan nam tengteng kiang a tanchinhoih hilh masak ding ahi.
english: The Good News must first be preached to all the nations.

paite: Huan hon pi a, ahon matsak hun chiang un, bang ka gen dia chi in ngaihtuah khawl kei un; ahuntak a theihsak a na om peuh uh, huai ngeingei gen zaw un; agen pen zaw noumau hilou in Kha Siangthou ahi zaw ding hi.
english: When they lead you away and deliver you up, don’t be anxious beforehand or premeditate what you will say, but say whatever will be given you in that hour. For it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.

paite: Huan hihlup ding in unaupa leh unaupa akimansak ding ua, pa in atapa amansak ding a; tate'n leng anu leh pate uh adou ding ua, athatsak ding uhi.
english: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

paite: Keimah min ziak in mi tengteng huat na hi ding uh; himahleh atawp pha a thuak mualsuahmi, huai mi hotdam in a-om ding hi.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

paite: "Himahleh zawlnei Daniel in agen bang a hihmangbangpa kihhuai adinlouhna ding a dingh na muh chiang un, asim peuh in a-omdan thei hen, huai hun chiang in Judia gam a omte tang sang ah taimang uhen;
english: “But when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not” (let the reader understand), “then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,

paite: inn tung a om kum kei hen; a-insung a thil lakhe ding in lut sam kei hen.
english: and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.

paite: Huan lou a om apuansilh la ding in kik nawn kei hen.
english: Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.

paite: Huai ni in naupaite leh naunou pomte tung agik ding hi.
english: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!

paite: Huaite phalbi a ahong tunlouhna ding in thum un.
english: Pray that your flight won’t be in the winter.

paite: Huai nite bang a gimthuakna thupi Pathian siam leilung pian tung a kipan tutan in a-om ngei nai kei a, chik mah chiang in a-om ngei nawn kei ding hi.
english: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.

paite: Huan Toupa'n huai nite hihtom keileh mihing dam in asuakta kei ding; himahleh, telte ziak in nite ahihtom hi.
english: Unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he picked out, he shortened the days.

paite: "Huai hun chiang in, kuapeuh in na kiang ua, 'En dih uh; hiai ah Khrist a-om!' ahihkeileh 'En dih uh; huai ah a-om!' hiam achih chiang un gingta kei un.
english: Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t believe it.

paite: Khrist takloute leh zawlnei takloute hong pawt ding ahi ngal ua, huaite'n chiamtehna leh thillamdang ahih ding uh; hi thei ngialleh telte nangawn akhemtheihna ding un.
english: For false christs and false prophets will arise and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

paite: Nou zaw pilvang un, ngai dih uh, bangkim ka hon hilhkhol khinta ahi.
english: But you watch. “Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.

paite: "Himahleh huai nite zoh in, huai gimthuakna khit in, ni hihmial in a-om ding a, kha avak nawn kei ding hi.
english: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,

paite: Van a kipan aksite ahong ke ding ua, van a thilhihtheihna omte hihlin in a-om ding uhi.
english: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.

paite: Huai hun chiang in Mihing Tapa, thilhihtheihna leh thupina lianpi toh meipi lak a hong pai amu ding uhi.
english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

paite: Huai hun chiang in a-angelte asawlkhe dia, atelte lei ning li a pan lei tawp a kipan van tawp pha in apikhawm ding uhi.
english: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.

paite: "Huchi in theipi kung ah gentehna zil un; ahiang ahong nou a, anah ahong sel in nipi anaita chih na thei uhi.
english: “Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near;

paite: Huchi mah bang in, nou leng huaite hong tung na muh chiang un, amah ahong naita a, kongkhak bul mahmah ah a-om chih, thei un.
english: even so you also, when you see these things coming to pass, know that it is near, at the doors.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, huai tengteng atunkim masiah hiai khang amang kei ding hi.
english: Most certainly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.

paite: Lei leh van amang dia, ka thu ahihleh amang kei ding hi.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

paite: "Himahleh huai ni leh dak Pa kia lou ngal kuamah in, van a angelte'n leng Tapa in leng athei kei uhi.
english: “But of that day or that hour no one knows—not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

paite: Pilvang unla, kiging gige in thum un; ahun lah na thei ngal kei ua.
english: Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.

paite: Mi a-inn paisan a, asikhate thu neisak a, anasep ding uh pe chiat a, kongkhak veng leng kigin ding thu pe phot a, gamdang a va taam bang ahi.
english: “It is like a man traveling to another country, having left his house and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.

paite: Huaiziak in kiging gige in om un, inn neipa hong pai ding hun, nitaklam in hia, zan in hia, ak khuan in hia, zing in hia chih lah na thei ngal kei ua.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming—whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;

paite: Huchi lou in zaw, hong pai guih kha taleh ihmu in ahon mu kha ding.
english: lest, coming suddenly, he might find you sleeping.

paite: Huan na kiang ua ka genmi tengteng kiang a ka gen ahi: Kiging gige in om un," achi hi.
english: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch!”

paite: Huan ni nih nung a Paikan Ankuangluina leh Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina om ding ahi a; siampu liante leh laigelhmite'n, amah khem a, man a, ahihlup theihna ding dan azongzong uhi.
english: It was now two days before the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception and kill him.

paite: Himahleh, "Ankuanglui sung in hi kei hen, huchi lou in zaw vantang lak ah buaina ahong om kha ding," achi uhi.
english: For they said, “Not during the feast, because there might be a riot among the people.”

paite: Huan Bethani a phak Simon inn a a-om lai a, ankuang a-um lai in numei khat, alabaster bawm a spiknardi thau gimlim man tampi tawi in ahong a, abawm ahihkham a, alu ah asungta hi.
english: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar and poured it over his head.

paite: Himahleh khenkhatte alunghita kei ua, "Bangziak a thau gimlim hihmang mawkmawk ahia?
english: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, “Why has this ointment been wasted?

paite: Hiai thau makhai zathum sang a tamzaw a zuak a, migentheite kiang a piak theih ahi ngal a," achi uhi. Huchi in atung ah aphun uhi.
english: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor.” So they grumbled against her.

paite: Jesu'n, "Hih hen aw; bangziak a va hihbuai na hi ua? Ka tung ah thil hoihtak a hih ahi.
english: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.

paite: Migentheite na kiang ua om gige ahi ua, na ut hun peuh un na hehpih thei uhi; kei bel na kiang ua om gige lou ding ka hi.
english: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.

paite: Ahihtheih khamkham a hih ahi; ka pumpi vui ding a sathau nuhkhol ahi.
english: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.

paite: Huchi in chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, khovel tengteng a tanchinhoih akigenna koipeuh ah hiai numei thilhih, amah theihgigena ding in akigen zel ding,” achi hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.”

paite: Huan Judas Iskariot, sawm-le-nihte lak a khat in, Jesu akiang ua zuausan a amatsak theihna ding in siampu liante kiang ah ava hoh hi.
english: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.

paite: Amau huai thu azaktak un akipak mahmah ua, akiang ah dangka piak achiamta uhi. Huchi in zuausan a matsakdan ding lemtang azongta uhi.
english: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.

paite: Huan Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh ani masapen a, Paikan Ankuangluina belamnou agoh zelna ni uah, anungzuite'n akiang ah, "Paikan Ankuanglui na nektheihna ding in koi ah va bawl le ung na ut a?" achi uhi.
english: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”

paite: Huchi in anungzuite lak a mi nih asawl a, akiang uah, "Khopi ah va lut unla, huai ah bel a tui pua pasal in ahon tuak dia; amah zui un.
english: He sent two of his disciples and said to them, “Go into the city, and there a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him,

paite: Huan alutna peuh ah huai inn kempa kiang ah, 'Sinsakpa'n ka nungzuite toh Paikan Ankuang ka nekna ding uh, mikhual inn pindan koi lai ahia? achi,' na chi ding uhi.
english: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

paite: Huchi in ama'n inn pindan tungnung zatak, van omsa, mansa dimdiam ahon ensak dia; huai ah ei a ding in bawl un," achi hi.
english: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”

paite: Huan nungzuite apawt ua, khopi ah ava lut ua, akiang ua agen bangtak in ava mu ua; Paikan Ankuang abawlta uhi.
english: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.

paite: Huan nitaklam ahong hih in, amah sawm-le-nihte toh ava hohta uhi.
english: When it was evening he came with the twelve.

paite: Huan an a-um ua anek lai un Jesu'n, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, na lak ua mi khat, ka kiang a ne sam in, hon zuausan in hon mansak ding," achi hi.
english: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me—he who eats with me.”

paite: Huan alungkham panta ua, khatkhat in akiang ah, "Keimah ka hi hia?" achi chiat uhi.
english: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Sawm-le-nihte lak a mi khat, ka kuang a tanghou hon diahpihpa ahi.
english: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.

paite: Mihing Tapa atanchin agelh bangtak un apai ding; himahleh Mihing Tapa mansak ding mipa tung agik hi! Huai mihing zaw piang keileh amah a ding in ahoihzaw ding," achi hi.
english: For the Son of Man goes as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

paite: Huan an anek lai un Jesu'n tanghou ala a, avualzawl zoh in abalkham a, akiang uah apia a, "La unla ne un, hiai ka pumpi ahi," achi hi.
english: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed it, he broke it and gave to them, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body.”

paite: Huan nou ala a, kipahthu agen zoh in akiang uah apia a; huchi in avek un adawn chiat uhi.
english: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Hiai ka sisan a thukhun thak ahi, mi tampi a dia pawt ding ahi.
english: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, Pathian lalgam a athak ka dawn ni atun masiah grep guigah tui ka dawn nawnta kei ding,” achi hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in God’s Kingdom.”

paite: Huan la asak zoh un, apawt ua, Olive tang ah apaita uhi.
english: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Na vek un lungkia in na hon taisan ding uh. 'Belamchingpa ka khen dia, belamte adalh ding uh' chih gelh ahi ngal a.
english: Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’

paite: Himahleh ka thohnawn nung in Galili gam ah na ma uah ka pai ding," achi hi.
english: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

paite: Peter in akiang ah, "Avek un lungkia in hon taisan mah le uh, ke'n zaw ka hon taisan kei ding," achi hi.
english: But Peter said to him, “Although all will be offended, yet I will not.”
