paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang ah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, tuzan ngeingei in, ak nihvei akhuan ma in, nang thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl ding," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”

paite: Ama'n bel khauhtak in, "Na sihna ah si sam ding himah leng ka hon kitheihmohbawl kei hial ding," achi hi. Huchibang in achi chiat uhi.
english: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.

paite: Huan Gethsemani achih mun uh atung ua; ama'n anungzuite kiang ah, "Ka thum sung teng hiai ah na tu un," achi hi.
english: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”

paite: Peter, Jakob leh Johan api a, nakpitak a lungkham in amangbang mahmah hi.
english: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.

paite: Huchi in akiang uah, "Ka kha alungkham mahmah a, sihna khop hial ahi; hiai ah om unla, kiging gige un," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch.”

paite: Huan neukha in malam ah ava pai zek a, lei ah abokkhup a, ahihtheihleh huai hun in amah pel ding in athum hi.
english: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.

paite: "Abba, Pa, bangkim na hihthei a; kei a kipan in hiai nou lamang in; himahleh kei thu hilou in nangmah thuthu hi zaw hen," achi hi.
english: He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

paite: Huan ahong pai a, amau ihmu in ahong mu a, huchi in Peter kiang ah, "Simon, ihmu na hi maw? Dakkal khat lel leng kiging gige in na om thei kei maw?
english: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?

paite: Khemna a na lutlouhna ding un kiging gige in thum un. Kha in tuh angap a, sa zaw ahat kei,” achi hi.
english: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

paite: Huan ava hoh nawn a, athugen ngei gen in athum nawn hi.
english: Again he went away and prayed, saying the same words.

paite: Huan ahong pai nawn a amau ihmu in ahong mu nawn hi, a-ihmut uh asuak mahmah ngal a; athugen dawndan ding leng athei kei uhi.
english: Again he returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they didn’t know what to answer him.

paite: Huan ahong pai thumveina ah akiang uah, "Na ihmu lailai uh maw, na tawlnga lailai uh maw? Ahunta ve; ahun hong tungta; Mihing Tapa mikhialte khut a zuausan a piak ahita hi.
english: He came the third time and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

paite: Thou un, i pai ding uh; en un, zuausanpa ahong naita," achi hi.
english: Arise! Let’s get going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

paite: Huan agen laitak in, Judas, sawm-le-nihte lak a mi khat, ahong tung pah a, siampu liante leh laigelhmite leh upate a kipan mipi, namsau leh khetbuk tawite toh.
english: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came—and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.

paite: Huan zuausanpa'n, "ka tawp peuhmah amah ahi ding; man unla, kizentak in na pimang ding uh," chi in chiamtehna ana hilhkhol dimdiam hi.
english: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.”

paite: Huchi in atuntak in ava naih a, "Rabbi!" chi in atawp tonton hi.
english: When he had come, immediately he came to him and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.

paite: Huan amah alen ua, amanta uhi.
english: They laid their hands on him and seized him.

paite: Huan akiang a dinghte lak a mi kuahiam in anamsau adok a, siampu lianpen sikha asat a, abil asatkhiaksak hi.
english: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

paite: Huan Jesu'n amau ahoupih a, akiang uah, "Temsaute, khetbukte tawi in suamhat man ding bang in, kei hon man ding in na hong kuan uh maw?
english: Jesus answered them, “Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?

paite: Tempul ah niteng a thu hilh in na kiang uah ka om a; na hon man ngal kei ua, himahleh Laisiangthou thugelh atuntheihna ding ei ve," achi hi.
english: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”

paite: Huan avek un amah anusia ua, ataimang vekta uhi.
english: They all left him, and fled.

paite: Tangval kuahiam, puanmalngat kia bat in, amah azui a; amah ana man uhi.
english: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,

paite: Himahleh apuanmalngat ataisan a, vuaktang in ataimangta hi.
english: but he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.

paite: Siampu lian kiang ah Jesu api ua; siampu liante, upate leh laigelhmite tengteng toh ahong ton uhi.
english: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.

paite: Peter in gamlapi a pai in amah azui a, siampu lianpen inn huangsung kong lai pha in; sikhate lak ah meilum awi in atu sam hi.
english: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.

paite: Jesu ahihlup theihna ding un siampu liante leh vaihawmte tengteng in amah hekna azong ua, amu kei uh.
english: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.

paite: Mi tampi in zuau in ahek ua, himahleh, ahekna thu uh akituak kei hi.
english: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.

paite: Huan kuate hiam adingh ua, zuau in ahek uhi.
english: Some stood up and gave false testimony against him, saying,

paite: Hiai mi'n, "Khut a lam tempul ka hihse dia, ni thum sung in tempul dang, khut a lam louh, ka lam ding, achih, ka za uh," achi uhi.
english: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”

paite: Huchi in leng ahekna thu uh akituak thei sam kei uhi.
english: Even so, their testimony didn’t agree.

paite: Siampu lianpen alai ah adingkhia a, Jesu kiang ah, "Bangmah a dawng lou maw? Hiaite hon hekna bangchidan ahia?" chi in adong hi.
english: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”

paite: Amah lah adai dide a, bangmah in adawng kei. Siampu lianpen in akiang ah, "Khrist, Hampha Tapa, na hi hia?" chi in adong nawn hi.
english: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?”

paite: Jesu'n, "Hi e, Mihing Tapa thilhihtheihna taklam a tu a, van meipi lak a hong pai na mu ding uh," achi hi.
english: Jesus said, “I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.”

paite: Siampu lianpen in apuansilh abotkek a, "Theihpih dang bang ding in i deih lai dia?
english: The high priest tore his clothes and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?

paite: Pathian agensiatdan na zata uh; bangchi na sa ua?" achi hi. Avek un amah si tak in asep chiat uhi.
english: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.

paite: Huan akhen in amah achilsiat pah ua, amai tuam in khuttum in atum ua, akiang ah, "Zawlnei bang in gen in," achi uhi; sikhate'n apaipih kawm un akhutpek un abeng ekek uhi.
english: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.

paite: Huan Peter nuailam a inn huangsung kong lai a a-om lai in siampu lianpen sikha nungakte lak a khat ahong pai a,
english: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,

paite: Peter, meilum awi amu a, a-en a, "Nang leng Nazaret mi Jesu kiang a om na hi ve," achi hi.
english: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”

paite: Ama'n, "Na thugen ka thei kei, angaihna leng ka thei kei," chi in akitheihmohbawl hi. Inn lim ah apawtkhia a; huchi in ak akhuangta hi.
english: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.

paite: Huan nungak in amu a, akiang a dinghte kiang ah, "Hiai mi alak ua mi ahi," achi nawn hi.
english: The maid saw him and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”

paite: Himahleh akitheihmohbawl nawn hi. Sawt lou nung in akiang a dinghte'n, Peter kiang ah, "Alak ua mi hi tawk teh, Galili gam a mi na hi ngal a,” achi uhi.
english: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”

paite: Ama'n, "Huai na mihing gen uh ka thei kei," chi in hamsia kiloh in akichiamta hi.
english: But he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”

paite: Huan ak khuan nihveina akhuang pah hi. Peter in, Jesu'n akiang a, "Ak nihvei akhuan ma in nang thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl ding," achih atheikhe thak nawn a, huai angaihtuah a akapta hi.
english: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the words that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” When he thought about that, he wept.

paite: Huan zingsang ahong hih in, siampu liante, upate leh laigelhmite leh vaihawmte tengteng toh akihou ua, Jesu ahen ua, api ua, Pilat kiang ah apeta uhi.
english: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders, scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, bound Jesus, carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.

paite: Pilat in akiang ah, "Judate' Kumpipa na hi hia," chi in adong a, ama'n akiang ah, "Na gen bang in himah ing," chi in adawng hi.
english: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”

paite: Siampu liante'n thu tampi in ahek uhi.
english: The chief priests accused him of many things.

paite: Huchi in Pilat in adong nawn a, akiang ah, "Bangmah a dawng lou maw? Ngai in, ahon hekna uh tamdan!" achi hi.
english: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”

paite: Jesu'n bangmah in adawng kei; huchi in Pilat in lamdang asa mahmah hi.
english: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.

paite: Huan Pilat in ankuanglui ni in mi henta khat anget peuhmah uh apawtsak zel hi.
english: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whomever they asked of him.

paite: Mi khat, Barabbas achih uh, ahelte lak ah hensa in a-om a, amah bel helna a pang leh tualthat ahi.
english: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.

paite: Mipite ahohtou ua, amau a dia ahihsak zel bang a hihsak ding in angen uhi.
english: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.

paite: Pilat in adawng a akiang uah, "Judate' Kumpipa hon khahsak leng na ut uhia?" achi hi.
english: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

paite: Siampu liante'n hazat ziak a paipih uh ahi, chih athei hi.
english: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.

paite: Himahleh siampu liante'n Barabbas pawtsak zawk ngen ding in mipite ahasuan uhi.
english: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.

paite: Huan Pilat in akiang uah, "Judate' Kumpipa achih uh bang ka lohta dia le?" chi in adong nawn hi.
english: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”

paite: Huan amau, “Kros ah kilhden in," chi in akikou nawn uhi.
english: They cried out again, “Crucify him!”

paite: Pilat in akiang uah, "Bang ding in maw? Bang ahihkhial a ahia?" achi hi. Himahleh amau, "Kilhden in," chi in akikou semsem uhi.
english: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”

paite: Huchi in Pilat in mipite hihlungkim ut in, Barabbas apawtsakta a; Jesu avuak zoh in kilhden ding in apeta hi.
english: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.

paite: Huan sepaihte'n inn huangsung kong lai, Praitoriam achih uah, amah apilut ua, apawl ua mi tengteng asamkhawm uhi.
english: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.

paite: Huchi in puan sandup asilhsak ua, linglukhu phan in akhusak uhi.
english: They clothed him with purple; and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.

paite: "Chibai, Judate' Kumpipa!" chi in chibai abuk uhi.
english: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

paite: Alu sialluang in akhen ua, chil aphih ua, khukdin in chibai abuk uhi.
english: They struck his head with a reed and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.

paite: Huan nuihza bawlna a azatzoh un, puan sandup ahawk ua, ama puan asilhsak nawn ua, kilhden ding in apikhia uhi.
english: When they had mocked him, they took the purple cloak off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.

paite: Huan mi vialvak khat, Kurini khomi, Alexander leh Rufas pa, Simon, agam lam a kipan hong pai, akros po ding in aman uhi.
english: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them that he might bear his cross.

paite: Golgotha mun ah Jesu api ua, huai tuh Luguh Mun, chihna ahi.
english: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, “The place of a skull.”

paite: Huan uain murrah toh hel apia ua, himahleh adawn nuam kei.
english: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.

paite: Akilhden ua, atan ding chiat uh theihna ding in aisan in apuansilhte akihawm uhi.
english: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.

paite: Akilhden hun uh dak thumna vel ahi.
english: It was the third hour when they crucified him.

paite: Ahekna lai atunglam ah agelh ua, "JUDATE' KUMPIPA,” chi in.
english: The superscription of his accusation was written over him: “THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

paite: Huan suamhat nih, ataklam ah khat, aveilam ah khat amah toh akilhden uhi.
english: With him they crucified two robbers, one on his right hand, and one on his left.

paite: Laisiangthou in, "Amah talekte toh simkhawm ahita," chih genna hihtangtun in a-omta hi.
english: The Scripture was fulfilled which says, “He was counted with transgressors.”

paite: Huan mi kivialleh peuh in alu uh sing in, "Ehe! Nang tempul susia a ni thum a lam nawnpa,
english: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads and saying, “Ha! You who destroy the temple and build it in three days,

paite: Kihondam inla, kros a kipan hong kum in," chi in a-enghou uhi.
english: save yourself, and come down from the cross!”

paite: Huchi mah bang in siampu liante'n, laigelhmite toh, amau lak a enghou in, "Midang bawn hondam a, amah kihondam theiloupi in," achi uh.
english: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.

paite: I muh a, i gintak theihna ding in, "Khrist, Israel Kumpipa, tu in kros a kipan hong kumleh akei dia," achi uhi. Huan amah toh akilhden samte'n leng a-enghou uhi.
english: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him.” Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.

paite: Huan dak gukna ahong hih in, dak kuana dong in gam pumpi ahong mialta hi.
english: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

paite: Dak kuana ding in aw ngaihtak in Jesu, "Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakthani?" chi in akikoukhia a, huai tuh, "Ka Pathian, Ka Pathian, bang achia hon paisan?" chihna ahi.
english: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” which is, being interpreted, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

paite: Huan akiang a dingh khenkhatte'n huai azak un, "Ngai un, Elijah sam ahi," achi uh.
english: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”

paite: Mi khat atai a, uain thuk spanji diahdim in, chiangdawn ah atak a, adawnsak hi. "Khawl dih ua, amah lakhe ding in Elijah ahong hiam i en ding uh," achi uhi.
english: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to take him down.”

paite: Aw ngaihtak in Jesu akikou a, akha akhahta hi.
english: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.

paite: Tempul puanzak atunglam a kipan anuailam pha in ahong keksuakta hi.
english: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.

paite: Amazawn a sepaih zaheutupa dingh in huchibang a akha akhah amuh in, “Hiai mi zaw Pathian Tapa ahi ngeingei," achi hi.
english: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”

paite: Numeite'n leng gamlatak a dingh in a-en ua; huaite lak ah Mari Magdalin, Jakob naupangzaw leh Joses nu Mari, Salomi leng apang uhi.
english: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

paite: Huaite Galili gam a a-om lai a, amah zui a, a-nna sepsak zelte ahi uhi; numei dang tampi Jerusalem a amah toh hohtoute leng a-om uhi.
english: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.

paite: Huan nitaklam ahih in Kisakkholhna ahih ziak in, huai Sabbath ma ni ahi,
english: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

paite: Arimathai a om, Joseph, vaihawmpa zahtakhuai, Pathian lalgam lamenmi, ahong pai a, hangsantak in Pilat kiang ah alut a, Jesu luang angenta hi.
english: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for God’s Kingdom, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

paite: Huchi in Pilat in huchibang a asih pah lamdang asa mahmah a, huchi in sepaih zaheutupa sam in, asihna asawtta hiam chih adong hi.
english: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.

paite: Sepaih zaheutupa kam a pan sita ahi chih atheih in, Joseph kiang ah aluang apia hi.
english: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.

paite: Huan ama'n puanmalngat alei a, amah alakhia a, puanmalngat in atuam a, han khuakkuak ah asial a, suang in han kong adelhta hi.
english: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.

paite: Huan Mari Magdalin leh Joses nu Mari in asialna amu uhi.
english: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.

paite: Huan Sabbath ni abei in han ah Mari Magdalin, Jakob nu Mari leh Salomite ava hoh ua, amah nuh ding in gimlim alei uhi.
english: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.

paite: Ni sagih ani masapen in, zingsangpi in, nisuah lai in han ava tung uhi.
english: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.

paite: "Han kong a suang kua'n hon khukkhiaksak ding adiam aw?" akichih laitak un,
english: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”

paite: adak uleh suang khukkhiaksa in amuta uh, alian mahmah ngal a.
english: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.

paite: Han sung ah alut ua, pasal khat puanngou silh, ataklam pang a tu amu ua; lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
english: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were amazed.

paite: Huchi in ama'n akiang uah, "Lamdang sa kei un; Jesu Nazaret mi, akilhden uh, na zong ua; athounawnta; hiai ah a-omta kei; en un, asialna uh!
english: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him!

paite: Himahleh pai unla, anungzuite leh Peter kiang ah, Galili gam ah na ma uah apai ding hi; na kiang ua achih bang ngei in huai ah na mu ding uh," achi hi.
english: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”

paite: Huchi in linna leh lamdang sak luatna in amau atuam ziak in apawt ua, han a kipan atai vengveng ua; alauh ziak un kuamah kiang ah bangmah agen kei uhi.
english: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.

paite: Huan ni sagih ni masapen zingsang a athohnawn in, Mari Magdalin, asung a pan dawi sagih adelhkhiakna nu kiang ah akilak masapen hi.
english: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

paite: Amah Jesu ompih zelte kiang ah ava hoh a, misi suun a akah lai un ava hilhta hi.
english: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

paite: Himahleh amah ahing a, muh leng amu chih aza na ua, agingta tuan kei uhi.
english: When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.

paite: Huai nung in alak ua mi nih gam lam zuan a apai lai un mel dang pu in akiang uah akilak nawn hi.
english: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.

paite: Amau nungzui dangte kiang ah ava hilh ua, amau thu leng agingta tuan kei uhi.
english: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.

paite: Huai nung in, an a-um lai un sawm-le-khatte kiang ah akilak a, athohnawn nung a amute thu agintak louh uh leh alungtang khauh thu uah ataihilh hi.
english: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table; and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

paite: Akiang uah, "Khovel tengteng ah pai unla, thilsiam tengteng kiang ah tanchinhoih hilh un.
english: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

paite: Agingta a baptisma tang hotdam in a-om ding a; agingta lou tuh siam louh tang in a-om ding.
english: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.

paite: Hiai chiamtehnate'n agingtate azui zel ding: Ka min in dawite adelhkhe ding ua, pau thak in apau ding uh;
english: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;

paite: khut in gulte ala ding ua; sihna gu bangchibang dawn mah le uh bangmah achi kei ding uh; damloute tung ah akhut uh akoih ding ua, adam zel ding uh," achi hi.
english: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”

paite: Huchi in Toupa Jesu'n akiang ua thu agen khit in van ah pitouh in a-om a, Pathian taklam ah atu hi.
english: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.

paite: Huchi in amau apaikhia ua, gam teng ah thu agenta uhi. Toupa'n amau aseppih a, chiamtehnate'n zui in thu ahihkip zel hi. Amen.
english: They went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.

paite: Huan ni bangzah hiam nung in Kapernaum a ahong lut nawnleh inn ah a-om chih thu ahong thang hi.
english: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home.

paite: Huchi in kongkhak kim a omna ding om lou khop in mi tampi ahong kikhawm ua, akiang uah thu agen hi.
english: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.

paite: Mizaw khat, mi li zawn, akiang ah ahon pi uhi.
english: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.

paite: Mipi ziak a akiangnai a ahong pai theih louh ziak un a-omna intung aphenvang ua; huai khit in alupna leh atung a mizaw lum kawm in akhaikhesuk uhi.
english: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n aginna uh amuh in, mizaw kiang ah, "Ka tapa, na khelhnate ngaihdam ahita," achi hi.
english: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”

paite: Laigelhmi khenkhat huai mun ah atu uhi.
english: But there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,

paite: "Hiai mi'n bangziak a hichibang thu gen ahia? Pathian agensia hi; mi khat, Pathian kia lou ngal, kua'n ahia khelhnate ngaidam thei?" chi in alungtang un angaihtuah uhi.
english: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”

paite: Huan Jesu'n, alungtang un huchibang angaihtuah uh chih alungsim in athei pah a, akiang uah, "Huai thu bangziak a na lungtang ua ngaihtuah na hi ua?
english: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?

paite: Mizaw kiang a, 'Na khelhnate ngaihdam ahita,' chih leh 'na lupna la inla, khe in paita in,' chih akoi ahia agen nuamzaw?
english: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk’?

paite: Himahleh leitung ah Mihing Tapa in khelhnate ngaihdam theihna anei chih na theihna ding un," ahi, mizaw kiang ah;
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he said to the paralytic—

paite: "Thou inla, na lupna la inla, na inn ah pai in, ka hon chi," achi hi.
english: “I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”

paite: Huchi in amah athou a, alupna la pah in, avek ua mitmuh in apaita hi; huchi in avek un lamdang asa mahmah uh, hichibang himhim i mu ngei kei, chi in Pathian aphat uhi.
english: He arose, and immediately took up the mat and went out in front of them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”

paite: Huan apawt nawn a tuipi gei ah apaita hi, mipi tengteng akiang ah ava pai ua, ama'n thu ana hilh hi.
english: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.

paite: Apai kawm in, Alphai tapa, Levi siah piakna mun a tu amu a, akiang ah, "Hon zui in," achi hi. Athou a azuita hi.
english: As he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. He said to him, “Follow me.” And he arose and followed him.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n Levi inn ah an a-um a, siahkhonte leh mikhialte tampi in Jesu leh anungzuite a-umpih uhi, amah zuite tampi ahi uh.
english: He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.

paite: Pharisaite leh laigelhmite'n Jesu'n mikhialte leh siahkhonte kiang a anek amuh un, anungzuite kiang ah, "Bangchidan ahia siahkhonte leh mikhialte kiang a anek a adawn?" achi uhi.
english: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, “Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?”

paite: Jesu'n huai aza a, akiang uah, "Michidamte'n daktor akiphamoh kei ua, midamloute'n akiphamohzaw uh; midiktatte sam ding a hong pai ka hi kei a, mikhialte sam ding a hong pai ka hi zaw," achi hi.
english: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

paite: Huan Johan nungzuite leh Pharisaite'n an angawl zel uhi. Amau ahong pai ua, Jesu kiang ah, "Bangziak a Johan nungzuite leh Pharisaite nungzuite'n an ngawl ua, nang nungzuite'n angolh sam louh uh?" achi uhi.
english: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Moupite kiang a apasal a-om lai teng moupite'n an angawl thei ua hia? Apasal ding akiang ua a-om lai teng angawl thei kei ding uh.
english: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.

paite: Himahleh akiang ua kipan apasal pimang nite ahong tung ding a, huai ni chiang in zaw angawl ding uhi.
english: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.

paite: "Kuamah in puan tui khai nai louh them in puan lui athuap ngei kei uh; thuap le uh, thuap bit asawmna lam uah akaikek ding a, athak in alui akaikek ding a, ahong kek semsem ding hi.
english: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.

paite: Huan kuamah in savun uain thawl lui ah uain thak athun ngei kei, uain in savun thawl aphukham ding a, uain abo bei ding hi, savun thawl mah leng; uain thak savun uain thawl thak ah athun zaw uh," achi hi.
english: No one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu Sabbath ni in buhlei ah apaisuak hi, anungzuite'n apai kawm un buhvuite akhiak uhi.
english: He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.

paite: Pharisaite'n akiang ah, "En dih, bangziak a Sabbath ni a hihsiang lou hih ahi ua?" achi uhi.
english: The Pharisees said to him, “Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "David leh alawmte ataksap ua, agilkial lai ua athilhih uh na sim kei ua hia?
english: He said to them, “Did you never read what David did when he had need and was hungry—he, and those who were with him?

paite: Abiathar siampu lianpen ahih lai a, Pathian inn a alut a, siampute kia lou ngal in anek siang louh tanghou koihtuam anek a, alawmte kiang a apiak sam thu,” achi hi.
english: How he entered into God’s house at the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?”

paite: Huan amah mah in, akiang uah, "Sabbath zaw mihing a dia bawl ahi, mihing bel Sabbath ni a dia bawl ahi kei hi.
english: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

paite: Huchi in Mihing Tapa zaw Sabbath tung nangawn a Toupa ahi," achi hi.
english: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.”

paite: Huan sinagog ah alut nawn a; huai ah khutzaw khat ana om hi.
english: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there whose hand was withered.

paite: Amah ahektheihna ding un Sabbath ni a ahihdam nop leh nop louh a-enkhia uhi.
english: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.

paite: Ama'n khutzaw kiang ah, "Dingkhia in," achi hi.
english: He said to the man whose hand was withered, “Stand up.”

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Sabbath ni in hihhoih hia siang, hihsiat? Hotdam hia siang, hihlup?" chi in adong hi. Himahleh adai dide uhi.
english: He said to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good or to do harm? To save a life or to kill?” But they were silent.

paite: Huan alungtang uh tak ziak a lungkham mahmah leh heh kawm a amaute a-et velvel nung in, huai mi kiang ah, "Na khut zan in," achi a, huchi in azankhia a, akhut adamta hi.
english: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.

paite: Pharisaite apawtkhia ua, amah hihlup theihna ding lampi ngaihtuah in Herod pawl a mite toh akihoukhawm pah uhi.
english: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

paite: Jesu anungzuite toh tuipi lam ah apaimang ua; Galili gam a kipan mipi tampitak in azui uhi.
english: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,

paite: Athilhih thupidan azak un Judia gam a kipan, Jerusalem a kipan, Idumai gam a kipan, Jordan gal a kipan, Tura leh Sidon kho kim a kipan in mipi tampitak akiang ah ahong pai uhi.
english: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.

paite: Mipi ziak in amah a dia long neu mansa a om ding in anungzuite ahilh hi, huchi lou in zaw hon um lutlut kha ding uhi.
english: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.

paite: Mipi tampi ahihdam tak ziak in natna nei peuhmah in amah akhoihtheihna ding un aboh huthut uhi.
english: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.

paite: Dawi ninte'n leng amah amuh un ama ah bokkhup in, "Nang Pathian Tapa na hi," chi in akikou uhi.
english: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him and cried, “You are the Son of God!”

paite: Huan atanchin genthang lou ding in akiang uah achi bikbek hi.
english: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.

paite: Huan tang ah ahohtou a, ama'n angaihngaih akiang ah asam a; amau akiang ah ahohtou uhi.
english: He went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.

paite: Akiang a om ding leh thugen dia asawlkhiak ding in sawm-le-nihte asep hi.
english: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach

paite: Natnate hihdam ding leh dawite delhkhe ding in thuneihna apia hi.
english: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:

paite: Huai mite, Simon, Peter, achih pa;
english: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);

paite: Zebedai tapa, Jakob leh Jakob unau Johan, huai mite Boanerges achihte; huai omdan tuh vanpiging tapate chihna ahi.
english: James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);

paite: Andru, Philip, Bartholomai, Matthai, Thomas, Alphai tapa Jakob, Thaddai, Kanaan mi Simon leh,
english: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;

paite: amansakpa, Judas Iskariot ahi uhi.
english: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.

paite: Huai zoh in, inn khat ah alut uhi. Huai ah mipi tampi ahong kikhawm nawn ua, huchi in an nangawn leng ane thei kei uhi.
english: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

paite: Huan alawmte'n azak un, "Lungsim buai ahita," chi in amah mat atum uhi.
english: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”

paite: Huan laigelhmi, Jerusalem a kipan a hong sukte'n, "Beelzibul zawl ahi, dawite kumpipa ziak in ahi, dawite adelhkhiak," achi uhi.
english: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”

paite: Jesu'n laigelhmite asam a, gentehna in akiang uah, "Setan in Setan mah bangchi in adelhkhe thei dia?
english: He summoned them and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?

paite: Gam leng amah akidouleh huai gam adingkhe thei kei ding hi.
english: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

paite: Inkuan khat leng amah akidou uleh, huaite inkuan adingkhe thei kei ding uhi.
english: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

paite: Setan leng amah kidou a, akilanleh adingkhe thei kei ding a, amangthang zaw ding hi.
english: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.

paite: Kuamah in mihatpa ahen masak phot keileh inn a lut in asum alaksak thei kei uh, huai nung in bel a-inn alok mai ding uhi.
english: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.

paite: "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, mihing tate, akhelhna tengteng uah leh Pathian agensiatna bangpeuh uah leng agensiatnate uh ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
english: “Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;

paite: Kuapeuh Kha Siangthou hilhial gensia zaw chik mah chiang in ngaihdam ahi kei ding a, tangtawn khelhna ah siam louh in a-om zaw ding," achi hi.
english: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.”

paite: Dawi nin pai ahi, achih ziak un huai agen ahi.
english: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”

paite: Huan anu leh a-unaute ahong ua, inpua ah adingh ua; amah sam ding in mi asawl uhi.
english: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.

paite: Akim a mipi tu diamduamte'n akiang ah, "Ngai dih, inpua ah na nu leh na sanggampate'n ahon ngak uh," achi uhi.
english: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Ka nu leh ka sanggampate kuate ahi ua?" chi in adong hi.
english: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”

paite: Akiang a tute a-en vialvial a, "En un, ka nu leh ka sanggampate;
english: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

paite: kuapeuh Pathian deihlam hih photphot ka sanggampa, ka sanggamnu leh ka nu ahi uh," achi hi.
english: For whoever does the will of God is my brother, my sister, and mother.”

paite: Huan tuipiau ah thu ahilh nawn hi. Mipi tampitak akiang ah ahong kikhawm ua, huchi in tuipi ah long ah tuang in atu a, mipi tengteng tuipiau a leitung ah a-om uhi.
english: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.

paite: Huan gentehna zang in thil tampi asinsak a, amah sinsakna dan in akiang uah,
english: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,

paite: "Ngaikhia unla, en dih ua; buhchithehpa buhchi theh ding in akuan hi.
english: “Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, atheh lai in akhen lampi sik ah akia a, vasate'n anegai uhi.
english: As he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.

paite: Akhen suangsilei ah akia a; lei asah louh ziak in apou pah hi.
english: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.

paite: Himahleh ni ahong suah in haivuai in ahong om a, zung aneih louh ziak in avuaimang uhi.
english: When the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

paite: Akhen loulingnei lak ah akia a, loupa ahong khang a, buhkungte adepmang a, agahta kei hi.
english: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

paite: Akhen lei hoih a kia in apou a, akhanglian a, agah a; aleh sawmthum aleh sawmguk leh aleh za in apung chiat uhi,” achi hi.
english: Others fell into the good ground and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.”

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Kuapeuh zakna ding bil nei in, za hen!" achi hi.
english: He said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.”

paite: Huan amah kia a-om lai in akim a omte leh sawm-le-nihte'n gentehna thu adongchian thak uhi.
english: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Pathian lalgam thuguk zaw noute kiang a piak ahi a, polam mite a ding in bel bangkim gentehna a gen ahi.
english: He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,

paite: Muh zaw amu na ua, atheisiam kei ding uh, huchi lou in zaw akihei nawn ding ua, ngaihdam ahong hi kha ding uh," achi hi.
english: that ‘seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Hiai gentehna thu na theisiam kei uh maw? Huchi ahih in bangchi in gentehna tengteng na theisiam tuan ding ua?
english: He said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?

paite: Buhchithehpa'n thu atheh ahi.
english: The farmer sows the word.

paite: Lamsik a thu theh hiai bang ahi uh; thu azaktak un kintak a Setan hong pai in alungtang ua thu theh alakmangsak hi.
english: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.

paite: Huchibang mah in suangsilei a theh hiaite ahi uh; thu azak phet ua kipaktak a pom pahte.
english: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.

paite: Himahleh amau ah zung anei kei ua, sawt louchik kia a-om uh; huai nung in thu ziak a gimthuakna hiam sawina hiam ahong om phet in akipuk pah uhi.
english: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.

paite: Huan midangte loulingnei lak a theh bang ahi uh; huaite'n thu azata ua,
english: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,

paite: himahleh khovel lunggulhnate, thil dang duhgawlnate ahong lut chiang in, thu adep a, gah lou in a-om hi.
english: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

paite: Huchi in lei hoih a kia hiaite ahi uh; thu za a, pom, aleh sawmthum, aleh sawmguk leh aleh za a gahte ahi uh," achi hi.
english: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Mi'n khawnvak de in akoihna a koih lou in, loh nuai hiam, lupna nuai hiam ah akoih ngei ua hia?
english: He said to them, “Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?

paite: Thang lou ding a iim bangmah a-om ngei kei a, lang lou ding a sel bangmah a-om sam kei hi.
english: For there is nothing hidden except that it should be made known, neither was anything made secret but that it should come to light.

paite: Kuapeuh zakna ding a bil nei peuh in za hen," achi hi.
english: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.”

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Na zak uh bang ahia, pilvang un; na tehna ngei mah ua tehsak in na om ding ua, atamzaw bawn piak in na om ding uhi.
english: He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you; and more will be given to you who hear.

paite: Kuapeuh anei piak behlap in a-om ding ua, kuapeuh anei lou aneihsun nangawn laksak in om ding," achi hi.
english: For whoever has, to him more will be given; and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”

paite: "Pathian lalgam tuh mi'n lei a chi atuh bang ahi," achi hi.
english: He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,

paite: "Zan chiang in a-ihmu a, sun chiang in athou zel a; chi pou in ana khang a, himahleh bangchi a pou a, khang ahia chih athei kei.
english: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.

paite: Lei in amah in gah ahon suah a; amasapen in akung, huan avui leh avui ah atang hong om hi.
english: For the earth bears fruit by itself: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.

paite: Himahleh agah amin chiang in, kawite in a-at pah uhi; buhlak ahun tak ziak in," achi hi.
english: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”

paite: Huan "Pathian lalgam bang toh i tehpih dia? Ahihkeileh, bang gentehna in ahia i genteh ding? achi hi.
english: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?

paite: Ankam chi tang khat lei a atuh un, lei a chi tengteng sang in neupen mahleh,
english: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,

paite: atuh nung un ahong pou a, loupa tengteng sang in ahong lianzawta a, hiang liantak ahon nei a, huchi in tungleng vasate alim ah agiak uh, huchi mah bang ahi," achi hi.
english: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”

paite: Huan huchibang gentehna thu tampi in, atheihsiam theih khomkhom uh, akiang uah agen zel hi.
english: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.

paite: Himahleh gentehna lou in zaw akiang uah thu agen ngei kei; amah nungzuite kiang ah asim in bangkim ahilhchian zel hi.
english: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.

paite: Huai ni mah nitaklam ahong hih in, akiang uah, "Gal khat lam i kai ding uh," achi hi.
english: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”

paite: Huchi in mipite paisan in, a-om ngeingei bang in, long ah apaipih pah ua, long dangte leng akiang ah a-om uhi.
english: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.

paite: Huchi in huihpi thupitak ahong nung a, tuikihotte long ah ahong kihotlut zuazua hi, huchi in long ahong dimta hi.
english: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.

paite: Amah lukham kham a ihmu in, longmei lam ah a-om hi. Huan aphawng ua akiang ah, "Heutupa, ka manthat uh khawk sa lou na hi maw?" achi uhi.
english: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”

paite: Amah ahong thou a, huih atai a, tuipi kiang ah leng, "Dai inla om kinken in," achi hi. Huan huih atawp a, hong dai dide hi.
english: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased and there was a great calm.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Bangchi a hichi tel a lau na hi ua oi? Ginna nei lou na hi uh maw?" achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”

paite: Huchi in lau petmah in alau ua, "Hiai mi kua ahia le, huih leh tuipi nangawn in athu aman uh?" akichi uhi.
english: They were greatly afraid and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

paite: Huan dil gal, Gerasin mite gam ahong tung uhi.
english: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

paite: Long a kipan apawt nung in dawi nin pai khat, han a kipan a hong pawt in amah ana tuak pah hi.
english: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.

paite: Hanmunte ah akhosa zel a, kuamah in sik khainiang nangawn a ahen theih louh uh ahi.
english: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,

paite: Sikkol leh sik khainiang in ahen ua; himahleh sik khainiang abottat a, sikkol leng ahihtan zel a; kuamah in athuzoh zou kei uhi.
english: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.

paite: Sun leh zan in han leh tang ah akikoukou a, suang in aki-at hi.
english: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.

paite: Huan gamlatak a kipan Jesu amuhtak in atai a, amah abia hi.
english: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,

paite: Huan aw ngaihtak a kikou in, "Jesu, Pathian Tungnungpen Tapa, kei leh nang bang ahia i kizolhna om? Hon gimsak lou ding in Pathian min in nget chihtak in ka hon ngen hi,” achi hi.
english: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don’t torment me.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Nang, dawi nin pai, hiai mi sung a kipan pawt in," ana chi hi.
english: For he said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”

paite: Huan ama'n, "Na min bang ahia?" chi in adong hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Ka min nuai ahi, tampi ka hih ziak un," achi hi.
english: He asked him, “What is your name?” He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”

paite: Huai gam a pan amau sawlkhe lou ding in Jesu kiang ah nakpi in angen hi.
english: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

paite: Huan huai lai a tang pang ah vokhon tampi ata uhi.
english: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.

paite: Dawi ninte'n, "Vok sung ah hon sawl in, asung ua ka luttheihna ding un," chi in akiang ah angen uhi.
english: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”

paite: Ama'n thu apia a, huchi in dawi ninte apawt ua, vok sung ah alut ua; vokhonte sangnih phial ahi ua, ken ah ataisuk ua, tuipi ah atailut ua; tuipi ah tui hak in asita uhi.
english: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.

paite: Huan vok an pete atai ua, khua leh lou ah agen ua, huai thil hong om bang ahia chih en ding in mite ahong taikhawm uhi.
english: Those who fed the pigs fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.

paite: Jesu kiang ahong tung ua, dawimatpa, alungsim ngei pu leh puansilh a huai a tu amu ua, huchi in alauta uhi.
english: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.

paite: Ama ua mute'n, dawimat tung a thiltundan leh vok tanchin amaute ana hilh uhi.
english: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.

paite: Huan amau agam ua kipan a pawt ding in angenta uhi.
english: They began to beg him to depart from their region.

paite: Huan long a alut in dawi nin paipa'n amah kiang a omsak ding in angen hi.
english: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n aphal kei a, akiang ah, "Na inn a na lawmte kiang ah pai inla, Toupa'n nang a dia thil hon hihsak athupidan leh nang ahon lainatdan va hilh in," achi zaw hi.
english: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.”

paite: Huan apai a, Dekapolis ah Jesu'n amah a dia thil ahihsak thupidan atangkoupihta hi. Huan mi tengteng in lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
english: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.

paite: Jesu long a gal khat lam a ahong kai nawn in mipi tampitak akiang ah ahong paikhawm ua, amah tuipi gei ah a-om hi.
english: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.

paite: Huchi in sinagog a vaihawmte lak a mi khat, amin Jaira, ahong a, Jesu amuhtak in akhebul ah abokkhup hi.
english: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet

paite: "Ka tanu naupang chik asi dekdek a; hong dam a, ahintheihna ding in hong pai a atung a na khut koih ding in ka hon ngen hi," chi in nakpi in athum hi.
english: and begged him much, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.”

paite: Huchi in Jesu akiang ah ava hoh a, mipi tampitak in zui in, amah aboh lutlut uhi.
english: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.

paite: Huan numei khat kum sawm-le-nih sipawt a damlou a-om hi.
english: A certain woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years,

paite: Daktor tampi lak ah nakpitak a thuak in, aneih tengteng azangbei khinta a, phattuam nak sang in ase zosop hi.
english: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,

paite: Huai mi'n Jesu tanchin ana za a, anung ah mipi lak ah ahong pai a, apuan mong akhoih hi.
english: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes.

paite: "Apuan mong kia khoih leng hihdam in ka om mai ding," alungsim in achi hi.
english: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”

paite: Huan thakhat in asipawt akam ngal a, anatna hihdam ahi chih asa ah akitheita hi.
english: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.

paite: Jesu'n, asung a kipan thilhihtheihna apawt chih athei a, mi lak ah akihei vialvial a, "Kua ahia ka puan mong khoih?" achi hi.
english: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”

paite: Anungzuite'n akiang ah, "Mipi'n ahon boh lutlut uh mu chin a, kua ahia hon khoih? Bangchidan a chi na hia?" achi uhi.
english: His disciples said to him, “You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

paite: Ama'n huai thilhihnu muh tum in a-en vialvial hi.
english: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.

paite: Huchi in numei in atung a thil ahihsak thei in, lau leh ling kawm in ahong pai a, ama ah bokkhup in, akiang ah thudik ahilh vek hi.
english: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Tanu na ginna dampih na hi, khamuangtak in pai inla, na natna a kipan na damta in," achi hi.
english: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”

paite: Apau laitak in sinagog a vaihawmpa inn a kipan mi ahong pai ua, "Na tanu asita, sinsakpa hihbuai lailai ding na hiam?" achi uhi.
english: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house, saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?”

paite: Jesu'n athugen uh ngeingaih lou in, sinagog a vaihawmpa kiang ah, "Lau ke'n, gingta mai in," achi hi.
english: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”

paite: Peter, Jakob leh Jakob unau Johan chih louh ngal midang kuamah in amah azuih uh aphal kei hi.
english: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.

paite: Huan sinagog vaihawmpa inn atung a, Jesu'n ana buai vengvung, kap vengvung leh mau vengvungte thawm aza hi.
english: He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.

paite: Ava lut a, akiang uah, "Bangziak a bil am zen a kap na hi ua? Naupang si lou ahi, ihmu ahi zaw," achi hi.
english: When he had entered in, he said to them, “Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”

paite: Huan amah anuihsan maimah uhi. Himahleh ama'n avek un apawtsak a, naupang omna ah ava lut hi.
english: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.

paite: Huan naupang khut alen a, akiang ah, "Talitha kumi," achi a, huai tuh "Nungaknou, thou in, ka hon chi," chihna ahi.
english: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha cumi!” which means, being interpreted, “Girl, I tell you, get up!”

paite: Huan numei naupang athou a, apai pah ngal a; amah kum sawm-le-nih mi ahi. Huan amau lamdang asa mahmah uh.
english: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hiai kuamah in thei kei hen," achi bilbel a, nek ding piak ding thu apia hi.
english: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.

paite: Huan huai a kipan apawt a, a-omna kholam atungta a; anungzuite'n azui uhi.
english: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.

paite: Sabbath ni ahong hi a, sinagog ah thu ahilh a; mi tampi athu zate'n, "Hiai mi'n hiai thu koi a kipan amuh ahia? Hiai mi kiang a pilna piak bang pilna ahia? Akhut in hichi tel a thillamdang ahih bangchidan ahia?" ana chi uhi.
english: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?

paite: "Hiai mi Mari tapa, Jakob, Joses, Judas leh Simon sanggampa, singlem bawlpa ahi kei a hia? Asanggamnute leng hiai a i kiang ua om ahi kei ua hia?" achi ua, lamdang asa mahmah uhi. Huchi in atung ah alungkim kei uhi.
english: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” So they were offended at him.

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Zawlnei zaw ama kholam ah, ama inkote lak ah, ama inn kia lou ngal ah pahtawi louh in a-om ngei kei," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”

paite: Huan mi damlou tawmchikte tung a khut koih a ahihdam kia lou ngal huai ah thil thupi lua ahih kei hi.
english: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them.

paite: Agintak louh uh lamdang asa mahmah hi. Huan thuhilh kawm in khuate atawn vialvial hi.
english: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.

paite: Huan sawm-le-nihte asam a, nihnih in asawlkhia a; dawi ninte tung a thuneihna leng apia hi.
english: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.

paite: Azinna ua ding in chiangkhun kia lou ngal bangmah, tanghou leh kawlzal leng, akawnggak ua dangka tawi louh ding achi bikbek hi.
english: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,

paite: Khedap bel but ding achi a; puanak nih silhthuah kei un, achi lai hi.
english: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Koipeuh ah leng na tunna inn uah, huai a kipan na pawt mateng uh tung kinken un.
english: He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.

paite: Huan koi khua peuh in ahon kipahpih louh ua, na thu uh angaihkhiak kei ualeh huai a kipan na pawt chiang un, amau mohpaih ding in, na khepek nuai ua leivui kai na tatkhe ding uh," achi hi.
english: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”

paite: Huchi in apaikhia ua, mite akisik ding uh ahi chih agen uhi.
english: They went out and preached that people should repent.

paite: Dawi tampi leng adelhkhia ua, damlou tampi leng thau anilh ua, ahihdam uhi.
english: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick and healed them.

paite: Huan kumpipa Herod in ana za a, amin athan ziak in, "Baptispa Johan, misi lak a pan thounawn a, huaiziak a huai thilhihtheihnate'n amah a sem ahi," achi hi.
english: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.”

paite: Midangte'n bel, "Elijah ahi, achi ua; midangte'n, ma lai zawlneite bang zawlnei khat ahi," achi uhi.
english: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”

paite: Himahleh Herod in ana zak in, "Alutang ka tanpa ngei, hong thounawnta ahi," achi hi.
english: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”

paite: Herod in a-unau Philip zi Herodias ziak in mi asawlkhia a, Johan amansak a, suangkul ah hen in ana khum khinta a; Herodias zi in ana neita ngal a.
english: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.

paite: Johan in lah Herod kiang a, "Na unaupa zi na neihsak siang lou ahi," ana chih khit tak ziak in.
english: For John had said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”

paite: Huaiziak in Herodias in amah amudah a, hihlup a-ut a, himahleh ahihthei kei hi.
english: Herodias set herself against him and desired to kill him, but she couldn’t,

paite: Herod in, Johan midiktat leh misiangthou ahi chih atheih ziak in amah akihta a, amah a-enkhia a, athu azak in, thil tampi ahih a, kipaktak in angaikhia hi.
english: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.

paite: Huan Herod in apian ni in amithupite, sepaih heutu liante, Galili gam a miliante a ding a zan ankuang alui lai in hun lemtang ahong omta hi.
english: Then a convenient day came when Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.

paite: Herodias tanu ahong lut a, alam a, Herod leh a-ankuang umpihte akipaksakta hi. Kumpipa'n numei naupang kiang ah, "Na deihdeih hon ngen in, ka hon pe ding,” achi hi.
english: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”

paite: "Bangpeuh na hon nget phot, hon pe ding ka hi, ka gam kimkhat nangawn leng," chi in akiang ah akichiam hial hi.
english: He swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”

paite: Amah apawt a, anu kiang ah, "Bang ka ngen dia?" ava chi hi. Anu'n, "Baptispa Johan lutang," ana chi hi.
english: She went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”

paite: Huan amah kintak in kumpipa kiang ah ava lut pah a, "Kuangpi a Baptispa Johan lutang na hon piak pah ka ut," chi in angen hi.
english: She came in immediately with haste to the king and requested, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”

paite: Huan kumpipa alungkham mahmah a; himahleh akichiamna leh a-ankuang umpihte ziak in asel nuam kei hi.
english: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.

paite: Huan kumpipa'n amah vengte lak a sepaih khat alutang va la ding a thu pia in asawl pah hi. Amah suangkul a pai in alutang ava tankheta hi.
english: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard and commanded to bring John’s head; and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

paite: Huai lutang kuang in ahon tawi a, numei naupang kiang ah apia a, huan numei naupang in anu kiang ah apeta hi.
english: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.

paite: Huan anungzuite'n azak un, aluang la in, han ah avuita uhi.
english: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse and laid it in a tomb.

paite: Huan sawltakte Jesu kiang ah ahong kikhawm ua, thil bangkim, athilhih peuh uleh athuhilh peuh uh, ahong hilh uhi.
english: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Noumau kia in gamdai mun ah atuam in hong unla, khawl tadih un," achi hi. Mipi atam a, akuan leh apai akiphamat ua, an nangawn leng ane man kei uhi.
english: He said to them, “Come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

paite: Huchi in gamdai mun ah long in apaituamta uhi.
english: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.

paite: Mite'n apai lai uh amu ua, mi tampi in amau athei ua, kho chih a pan huai ah khe in ataikhawm ua, ana makhelhta uhi.
english: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.

paite: Huchi in amah hong paikhiak in mipi tampitak amuta a, chingtu ding nei lou belamte bang ahih ziak un alainat mahmah a, thu tampi ahilhta hi.
english: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.

paite: Huan ni akai mahmahta a, anungzuite akiang ah ahong ua, "Hiai gamdai mun ahi a, ni akaita mahmah hi.
english: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.

paite: I kim a loute leh khuate a hoh a, anek ding uh banghiam bek aleitheihna ding un amaute paisakta in," achi uhi.
english: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”

paite: Ama'n bel akiang uah, "Noumau nek ding pia un," chi in adawng hi. Amau akiang ah, "Makhai zanih man tanghou va lei in nek ding pe ding ka ding uam?" achi uhi.
english: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Tanghou phel bangzah na nei ua? Hon en dih ua," achi a. Huan aneih zah uh atheihtak un, "Nga leh ngasa nih," achi uhi.
english: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”

paite: Huan ama'n, avek un loupa hing tung ah apawlpawl a tusak ding in akiang uah thu apia hi.
english: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.

paite: Huchi in apawlpawl in, zakhat khawng, sawmnga khawng in atu uhi.
english: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.

paite: Huan ama'n tanghou phel nga leh ngasa nih ala a, van lam en in avualzawl a, tanghou phelte abalkham a, ama ua lui ding in anungzuite kiang ah apia a; ngasa nih leng huaite tengteng lak ah ahawmzak hi.
english: He took the five loaves and the two fish; and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.

paite: Avek un ane ua, akham chiat uh.
english: They all ate and were filled.

paite: Huan tanghou leh ngasa nente bawm sawm-le-nih adim hi.
english: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.

paite: Tanghou phel nete pasal piching ngen sangnga ahi uh.
english: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.

paite: Huan mipi akikhensak nung in gal khat lam a Bethsaida a na pai masa ding in long ah anungzuite atuangsak pah hi.
english: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.

paite: Amau akikhensak nung in thum ding in tang ah ahohtou hi.
english: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.

paite: Nitaklam ahong hih in, tuipi laitak ah long a-om a, amah kia in gam ah a-om hi.
english: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.

paite: Long kalh a mangbang in amaute amu a, huih in ahilou lam ah asep hi. Huchi in zanven lina ding kuan in tuipi tung a khe a pai in amau lam ahon zuan a, amau paisuak san atum hi.
english: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea; and he would have passed by them,

paite: Himahleh amah tuipi tung a khe a pai amuh un sikha sa in, akikoukhia uhi.
english: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;

paite: Avek un amah amu ua, alau mahmah uhi. Himahleh ama'n amau ahoupih pah a, akiang uah, "Khamuangtak in om un, keimah ka hi, lau kei un," achi hi.
english: for they all saw him and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

paite: Huan long ah akiang uah atuangtou sam a, huih adai maimah hi. Huan lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
english: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;

paite: Alungtang uh akhauh ziak in tanghou beu thillamdang thu angaihtuah ban kei uhi.
english: for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.

paite: Huan gal khat lam akai un Gennesaret gam atung ua, luipiau ah long akhih uhi.
english: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret and moored to the shore.

paite: Long a kipan apawt nung un mite'n amah ana thei pah uhi.
english: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,

paite: Huai gam kim tengteng ah atai ua, a-om chih azakna peuh uah alupna un damloute ahon zawng hial uhi.
english: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick on their mats to where they heard he was.

paite: Huan khoneu leh kholian ah khopi leh khota leh koipeuh ah leng alutna ah damloute, dawr mun ah alumsak ua, apuan mong bek khoihsak ding in angen ngutngut uhi. Huan amah khoih peuhmah adam uhi.
english: Wherever he entered—into villages, or into cities, or into the country—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.

paite: Huan Pharisaite leh laigelhmite lak a mi kuate hiam, Jerusalem a kipan akiang ah ahong kikhawm uhi.
english: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.

paite: Huaite'n nungzui khenkhatte'n khut ninpi a tanghou anek uh amu ua, nin, chih tuh, sil lou, chihna ahi.
english: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.

paite: Pharisaite leh Judate tengteng in upate thugousiah apom tinten ziak un akhut uh hoihtak a asil kei uleh ane ngei kei uhi.
english: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.

paite: Dawr mun a kipan a apai un leng akisil phot kei uleh ane ngei kei uhi. Huan thugousiah dang tampi achin uh a-om, nou, bel, taubelte sil thute ah.
english: They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)

paite: Huchi in Pharisaite leh laigelhmite'n, "Bang achia upate thugousiah bang a na nungzuite om lou a, khut ninpi a tanghou ne ahi ua," chi in adong uhi.
english: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Isai in nou milepchiahte thu a na genkhol dik hilhial ve, 'Hiai mite'n amuk un ahon zahtak ua, alungtang un hon gamlat uh' achi hi.
english: He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

paite: 'Mihing thupiakte asinsak lel ziak un ahon biak uh athawn ahi,' chih gelh bang in.
english: They worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’

paite: "Pathian thupiakte nelhsiah in mihing thugousiah na len tinten ua ei ve," achi hi.
english: “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”

paite: Akiang uah, "Na thugousiah uh na zuihtheihna ding ua Pathian thupiakte na deih louh uh zaw, lem na thei hial ve ua.
english: He said to them, “Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.

paite: Mosi in, 'Na nu leh na pa zahtak in,' 'Kuapeuh anu hiam apa hiam gensia si mahmah hen,' achi a;
english: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’

paite: nou hichibang in na chi ua, mi'n, anu hiam, apa hiam kiang a, 'Na hon phatuampihna ding Korban ahita,' achih, (huai tuh Pathian kiang a piak, chihna ahi),
english: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban,”’” that is to say, given to God,

paite: Anu a ding hiam, apa a ding hiam in bangmah hihsak na phal nawn kei nak uh.
english: “then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,

paite: Na thugousiah uh na piak sawnsawnna un Pathian thu bangmah lou na suah uhi; huai bang thil tampi na hih uh," achi hi.
english: making void the word of God by your tradition which you have handed down. You do many things like this.”

paite: Huan mipite asam nawn a, akiang uah, "Na vek un ka thu ngaikhia unla, theisiam un;
english: He called all the multitude to himself and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand.

paite: mihing polam a kipan asung a lut amah hihnin thei bangmah a-om kei; mihing sung a kipan a hong pawt, huaite mihing hihnin ahi zaw hi.
english: There is nothing from outside of the man that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.

paite: Kuapeuh zakna ding bil nei in, za hen!" achi hi.
english: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear!”

paite: Mipite inn a alutsan nung in anungzuite'n gentehna thu amah adongchian uhi.
english: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou leng huchi tel a theihsiamna nei lou na hi uh maw? Bangpeuh polam a kipan a mihing sung a lut in amah ahihnin thei kei chih na thei kei ua hia?
english: He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can’t defile him,

paite: Alungtang sung a lut lou a, agilpi sung a alut zawk ziak in leh dailenna a pawtkhe mai ahih ziak in," achi a. (Huai tuh an chiteng asiang, achihna ahi).
english: because it doesn’t go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, making all foods clean?”

paite: "Mihing sung a pan hong pawt, huai ngeingei in mihing ahihnin nak ahi.
english: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.

paite: Mihingte sunglam lungtang a kipan in, ngaihtuahna giloute ahong pawt nak hi;
english: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,

paite: kingaihna, guktakna, tualthahna, angkawmna leh enna, gitlouhna, khemhatna, bevenna, hazatna gensiatna, kisaktheihna leh haihuainate ahi.
english: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.

paite: Hiai thil giloute tengteng sunglam a kipan ahong pawt a, mihing ahihnin nak hi,” achi hi.
english: All these evil things come from within and defile the man.”

paite: Huan athou a, huai a kipan in Tura leh Sidon uk ah apaita hi. Inn ah alut a, kuamah theih adeih kei a; himahleh akisel thei tuan kei.
english: From there he arose and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.

paite: Huchi in numei khat, atanu naupang chik dawi nin pai in, atanchin ana za a, akhebul ah abokkhup hi.
english: For a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.

paite: Huai numei tuh Grik mi ahi a, Sirophoinisia gam a piang ahi. Ama'n atanu sung a kipan a dawi delhkhe ding in angen hi.
english: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Tate hong vah masa uhen aw; tate tanghou laksak a uite kiang a paih kilawm lou ahi,” achi hi.
english: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

paite: Numei in akiang ah, "Toupa, hih zaw ahi na a, himahleh dohkan nuai a uite'n leng tate tanghou nen ane zel sam ve uah oi," chi in adawng hi.
english: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”

paite: Ama'n, akiang ah, "Na thugen ziak in paita in; na tanu sung a kipan dawi apawtta hi,” achi hi.
english: He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”

paite: Huan a-inn ah apaita, atanu, dawi in apawtkhiaksan, lupna a lum ava muta hi.
english: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.

paite: Huan Tura gam a kipan apawt nawn a, Sidon khua tawn in Dekapolis gam paikan in Galili tuipi atungta hi.
english: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee through the middle of the region of Decapolis.

paite: Mi khat nangong, pau leng pau kichian thei lou akiang ah hon tonpih ua, atung a khut koih ding in angen uhi.
english: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.
