paite: Ama'n mipi lak a kipan in amah kia in apituam a, akhutzungte in abilsung akhoih a, chil sia in alei akhoihsak hi.
english: He took him aside from the multitude privately and put his fingers into his ears; and he spat and touched his tongue.

paite: Van lam en in akhoisa huthut hi. Huan akiang ah, "Ephatha," achi a; huai bel, "Kihongta in," chihna ahi.
english: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”

paite: Huchi in abilte hong kihong a, aleigakna leng ahong kiphel a, chiantak in apau theita hi.
english: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.

paite: Akiang uah, kuamah hilh lou ding achi bikbek a; himahleh anak kham peuhleh, anak tangkoupihzaw sem uhi.
english: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.

paite: "Ama'n bangkim hoihtak in ahih a; nangongte nangawn apausak zel," achi ua, lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
english: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”

paite: Huai nite in, mipi tampitak ahong om nawn ua, nek ding bangmah anei kei ua, ama'n anungzuite asam a, akiang uah,
english: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,

paite: "Mipite tu in ka kiang ah ni thum a-omta ua, nek ding bangmah aneih louh ziak un ka lainat mahmah hi.
english: “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat.

paite: An ngawl in a-inn uah paisak leng lamkal ah abah kha ding uh; khenkhatte houh ahong paina uh agamla mahmah ngal a," achi hi.
english: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”

paite: Anungzuite'n, "Mi'n hiai gamdai ah koi a tanghou in ahia hiai mite ahihvah theih ding uh?" chi in amah adawng uhi.
english: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”

paite: Huan ama'n, "Tanghou phel bangzah na nei ua?" chi in amau adong a. Amau, "Phel sagih," achi uhi.
english: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”

paite: Huan mipite lei a tu ding in thu apia a; tanghou phel sagih ala a, kipahthu agen khit in abalkham a, ama ua lui ding in anungzuite kiang ah apia a; huchi in mipite ma ah aluita uhi.
english: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.

paite: Ngasa tawmchik leng anei ua; ama'n avualzawl a, huaite leng ama ua lui ding in thu apia hi.
english: They also had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.

paite: Huchi in ane ua, akham chiat ua; bawm sagih dim in akhamval nen uh aluak uhi.
english: They ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

paite: Amau sangli vel ahi ua; ama'n amaute apaisakta hi.
english: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.

paite: Amah bel anungzuite kiang ah long ah atuang pah a, huchi in Dalmanutha gam atung uhi.
english: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha.

paite: Pharisaite ahong pai ua, amah ze-etna ding in, amah a pan van a kipan a chiamtehna zong in amah ahong sel uhi.
english: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven and testing him.

paite: Huan amah alungsim in nakpi in anak kuaikuai a, "Bang achia hiai khangte'n chiamtehna zong uh ahia? Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, hiai khangte kiang ah chiamtehna himhim piak ahi kei ding," achi hi.
english: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”

paite: Huchi in amaute paisan in long ah atuang nawn a, gal khat lam ah apaisanta hi.
english: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.

paite: Huan anungzuite'n tanghou atawi mangngilh ua, tanghou phel khat kia lou ngal long ah tanghou dang himhim lah anei kei uhi.
english: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Pharisaite silngou leh Herod silngou lak ah kiveng unla, pilvang un," achi hi.
english: He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”

paite: Amau, "Tanghou i neih louh ziak ei ve," chi in akingaihtuah uhi.
english: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”

paite: Jesu'n huai atheih in, akiang uah, "Bangziak a tanghou na neih louh ziak ua kingaihtuah na hi ua? Tu nangawn in na theisiam kei lai uh maw? Theisiam lou lai maw? Na lungtang uh na khauhsak ua hia?
english: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet or understand? Is your heart still hardened?

paite: Mit nei napi in na mu kei ua hia? Bil nei napi in na za kei ua hia? Theigige lou uh maw?
english: Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?

paite: Sangnga lak a tanghou phel nga ka balkhap lai in anen bawm bangzah ahia na luahdim uh?" achi hi. Amau, "Sawm-le-nih,” achi uhi.
english: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”

paite: Huan sangli a dia sagih ka balkhap lai in, anen bawm bangzah ahia na luahdim uh? achi a. Amau akiang ah, "Sagih," achi uhi.
english: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Bangchidan a tu nangawn a theisiam lou lailai na hi ua?" achi hi.
english: He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”

paite: Huai nung in Bethsaida ahong tung uhi. Huan akiang ah mittaw ahon pi ua, amah khoih ding in angen uhi.
english: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him.

paite: Ama'n mittaw khut alen a, khua a kipan apikhia hi; amit ah chil sia in atung a akhut akoih khit in, "Khua na mu thei hia?" chi in adong hi.
english: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.

paite: Amah hong dakkhia a, "Mite ka mu; singkung pai bang in ka mu,” achi hi.
english: He looked up, and said, “I see men, but I see them like walking trees.”

paite: Amit ah akhut akoih nawn a, ahong hakkhia a, ahong dam maimah a, bangkim chiantak in amutheita hi.
english: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.

paite: Huan Jesu'n, khua ah leng lut ke'n chi in a-inn ah apaisakta hi.
english: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’t enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”

paite: Huan Jesu leh anungzuite ahong pai zel ua, Kaisaria Philippi khuate ahong tung ua; huan pai kawm in anungzuite kiang ah, "Mite'n kei kua ka hi ahon chi ua?" chi in adong hi.
english: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Who do men say that I am?”

paite: Amau, "Baptispa Johan ahi, ahon chi ua; midang in Elijah ahi, ahon chi ua; khenkhat in bel, zawlnei kuahiam ahi, ahon chi uh," achi uhi.
english: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others, one of the prophets.”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Ahihleh nou kei kua ka hi na hon chi ua?" chi in adong hi. Peter in akiang ah, "Khrist na hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”

paite: Huan ama'n atanchin kuamah hilh louh ding in achi bikbek hi.
english: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.

paite: Huan Mihing Tapa in thil tampi athuak dingte, upate, siampu liante, laigelhmite deih louh a a-om ding, hihlup a a-om ding leh ni thum nung a athohnawn ding thute amau ahilh hi.
english: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

paite: Huai thute chiantak in agen hi. Huan Peter in amah apituam a, atai hi.
english: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him and began to rebuke him.

paite: Himahleh amah ahong kihei a, anungzuite muh in, Peter atai a, "Setan, ka nung ah pai in, Pathian thilte ngaihtuah lou in, mihing thilte na ngaihtuah zaw,” achi hi.
english: But he, turning around and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”

paite: Huan mipite, anungzuite toh asam a, akiang uah, "Kuapeuh in hon zuih a-utleh amah kingaihsak lou in, ama kros pua in hon zui hen.
english: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

paite: Kuapeuh ahinna humbit ut in atan ding a; kuapeuh keimah ziak leh tanchinhoih ziak a ahinna tan in ahumbit ding hi.
english: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.

paite: Mi'n khovel apum in nei henla, ahinna tan taleh amah a ding in bang aphatuam dia?
english: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?

paite: Mi'n ahinna tang in bang ape thei dia?
english: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?

paite: Kuapeuh hiai khang a angkawm leh gilou chingte lak ah keimah leh ka thu zumpih, Mihing Tapa in, angel siangthoute toh a Pa thupina a kivan a ahong hun chiang in, huai mi ahon zumpih thuk sam ding," achi hi.
english: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, hiai a dingh akhente, Pathian lalgam thilhihtheihna toh hong tung amuh ma ua, sihna chiam lou ding a-om uh," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see God’s Kingdom come with power.”

paite: Huan ni guk nung in Jesu'n Peter, Jakob leh Johan apituam a, tang sangtak ah apaitouhpih a; ama uah amel omdan ahong lamdangta hi.
english: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.

paite: Huchi in apuansilhte lei a puansawpmi in asawp ngou theih louh khop hial a ngou velvol in ahong lamdangta hi.
english: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.

paite: Akiang uah Elijah leh Mosi ahong kilak ua, Jesu toh akihou uhi.
english: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.

paite: Peter in Jesu ahoupih a, "Heutupa, ei a ding in hiai a om ahoih; aidakbuk thum i lam ding ua, nang a ding in khat, Mosi a ding in khat, Elijah a ding in khat," achi hi.
english: Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

paite: Alau mahmah ziak un agen pen leng athei kei hi.
english: For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.

paite: Huan amau liah in meipi ahong kai a; meipi a pan aw ahong suak a, "Hiai ka Tapa deihtak ahi, amah thu ngai un," achi hi.
english: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”

paite: Kintak in akimvel a-en ua, akiang ua Jesu kia lou ngal kuamah amuta kei uhi.
english: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.

paite: Huan tang a kipan apaisuk lai un, "Misi lak a kipan Mihing Tapa athohnawn khit mateng athil muhte uh kuamah hilh louh ding," achi bikbek hi.
english: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

paite: Huchi in huai thu avom kinken uhi, misi lak a pan thohnawn pen bang chihna hi ding ahia chih akidong uhi.
english: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.

paite: Huan amau akiang ah, "Bangchidan a laigelhmite'n, Elijah ahong pai masa ding ahi," chi ahi ua? chi in adong uhi.
english: They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Bangkim bawlhoih thak ding in Elijah ahong pai masa him ahi; ahihleh thil tampi athuak ding a, muhdah a mawkbawl in a-om ding chi a Mihing Tapa tungthu bangchidan a gelh a na om ahia le? achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?

paite: Himahleh ka hon hilh ahi, Elijah zaw ahong pai khinta hi, atanchin agelh bang ngei un atung ah a-utut un ahih khinta uhi,” achi hi.
english: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”

paite: Huan nungzuite kiang atunsuk un, akim ua mipi tampite leh laigelhmite ana kisel lai uh amu uhi.
english: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.

paite: Mipi tengteng in amah amuhtak un lamdang asa mahmah ua, akiang ah atai pah ua, chibai ava buk kheukhou uhi.
english: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, greeted him.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Amaute toh bang thu ahia na na kisel uh?" chi in adong hi.
english: He asked the scribes, “What are you asking them?”

paite: Mipi lak a mi khat in akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, ka tapa, dawi mat pau thei lou dia abawl, na kiang ah ka hon pi a;
english: One of the multitude answered, “Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;

paite: amatna peuh ah apuksak ekek a; huchi in achilphuan pawt in, aha agawi a, ahong kongkaw a; na nungzuite'n delhkhe le uh ka chihleh adelhkhe thei kei uh," achi hi.
english: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down; and he foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren’t able.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Ginna nei lou khangte aw, bang tan na kiang ua om ding a bang tan hon thuak thei ding ka hia? Amah ka kiang ah hon pi un," chi in adawng hi.
english: He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to me.”

paite: Huan amah Jesu kiang ah ahon pi ua; dawi in amah amuhtak in nakpi in naupang asawisa pah a; huchi in lei ah apuk a, achilphuan kai zezu in akikhuk volvol hi.
english: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.

paite: Huan ama'n apa kiang ah, "Hichibang a ahong kipatna bang tan ahita a?" chi in adong hi. Ama'n, "Anaupan lai a kipan ahita,"
english: He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has been happening to him?” He said, “From childhood.

paite: "Huchi in amah hihmangthang ding in tamveipi mei ah leh tui ah asawnpuk a; himahleh nang bangchi chi hiam bek a na hihtheihleh hon hehpih inla, hon huh in," achi hi.
english: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Na gintakleh e! Agingtami a ding in bangkim hihtheih ahi," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”

paite: Huchi in naupang' pa'n khitui toh, "Toupa, ka gingta hi, ka ginlahna hon huh in," chi in akikoukhia hi.
english: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”

paite: Jesu'n mipi hong taikhawm amuh in, dawi nin atai a, akiang ah, "Nang dawi pau thei lou leh nangong, thu ka hon pia hi, asung a kipan pawt inla, lut nawn ke'n," achi hi.
english: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”

paite: Huchi in akikoukheta a, nakpitak a asawi khit in apawtta a, naupang misi bang in a-om a; huchi in mi tamzawte'n, "Asi ahi," achi uhi.
english: After crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead, so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”

paite: Jesu'n akhut alen a, akaithou a; huan ahong thou maimahta hi.
english: But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him up; and he arose.

paite: Huan Jesu inn a ava lutleh anungzuite'n, "Bangchi a kou delhkhe thei lou ka hi ua?" chi in asim in adong uhi.
english: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hichibang zaw thumna leh an ngawlna kia lou ngal in bangchi mah in apawt thei kei,” achi hi.
english: He said to them, “This kind can come out by nothing but by prayer and fasting.”

paite: Huan huai a kipan apaikhia ua; Galili gam paikan in, kuamah theih adeih kei,
english: They went out from there and passed through Galilee. He didn’t want anyone to know it,

paite: anungzuite asinsak lai ahih ziak in akiang uah, "Mihing Tapa mihingte khut ah matsak in a-om dia, athat ding ua; ahihlup nung uh ni thum nung in athounawn ding," achi ngal a.
english: for he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, “The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.”

paite: Himahleh athugen atheisiam kei ua, amah lah adong ngam kei uhi.
english: But they didn’t understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.

paite: Huan Kapernaum khua ahong tung ua; insung a a-om lai in, akiang uah, "Lampi a bang thu ahia na kisel uh?" chi in adong hi.
english: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”

paite: Lampi ah, i lak uah kua i thupipen dia? chi a ana kisel khit ziak un adai dide uhi.
english: But they were silent, for they had disputed with one another on the way about who was the greatest.

paite: Huan amah atu a, sawm-le-nihte asam a, akiang uah, "Kuapeuh in masapen hih a-utleh mi tengteng sang in ananungpen in a-om ding ahi, mi tengteng nna sem in a-om ding ahi," achi hi.
english: He sat down and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”

paite: Huan naupang chik khat akai a, alak uah adingsak a; apom a akiang uah,
english: He took a little child and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,

paite: "Kuapeuh ka min ziak a hiai bang naupang chik khat kipahpih keimah hon kipahpih ahi a, kuapeuh kei hon kipahpih zaw, kei hon kipahpih ahi kei ding, hon sawlpa kipahpih ahi zaw uh," achi hi.
english: “Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me; and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him who sent me.”

paite: Johan in akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, kuahiam na min a dawite delhkhia ka mu ua; ahon zuih louh ziak in ka kham uhi," achi hi.
english: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow us.”

paite: Jesu'n, "Kham nawn kei un; kuamah ka min a thil thupi hih kei hon gense pah thei a-om kei hi.
english: But Jesus said, “Don’t forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name and be able quickly to speak evil of me.

paite: Kuapeuh ei hon dou lou i lam a pang ahi.
english: For whoever is not against us is on our side.

paite: Kuapeuh Khrist mi na hih ziak ua tui nou khat dawn ding hon pia, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, akipahman atan kei hial ding hi.
english: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name because you are Christ’s, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.

paite: "Huan kuapeuh hon gingta neuchikte lak a khat leng hihpuk, angawng ah buh gawizanna suang lianpi oksak in tuipi ah khe le uh, amah a ding in ahoihzaw ding hi.
english: “Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.

paite: Huan na khut in ahon hihpukleh tankhia in; melhem a hinna a lut nang ding in ahoihzaw, khut nih nei a gawtmun mei mit thei lou a pai sang in,
english: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,

paite: athan uh asih louh a, meikuang mihlouhna ah.
english: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

paite: Na khe in ahon hihpukleh tankhia in, khe nih nei a gawtmun a paih a om sang in, khebai a hinna a lut nang a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
english: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched—

paite: Athan uh asih louh a, meikuang amihlouhna ah.
english: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

paite: Huan na mit in ahon hihpukleh khelkhia in; mit langnih nei a gawtmun a paih a om sang in mit langkhat nei a Pathian lalgam a lut nang a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
english: If your eye causes you to stumble, throw it out. It is better for you to enter into God’s Kingdom with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,

paite: Athan uh sih ngeilouhna leh mei mih ngeilouhna ah.
english: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

paite: Michih mei a soh a om ding uh ahi ngal a.
english: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.

paite: Chi ahoih hi; himahleh, chi apen khitleh bang in na hih al nawn ding ua? Noumau ngei ah chi nei unla, khat-le-khat kilem in om un," achi hi.
english: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”

paite: Abraham tapa, David tapa, Jesu Khrist khangthubu.
english: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

paite: Abraham in Isak asuang a, Isak in Jakob asuang a, Jakob in Judas leh a-unaute asuang hi.
english: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.

paite: Judas in Tamar a pan Perez leh Zerah asuang a, Perez in Erom asuang a, Erom in Aram asuang hi.
english: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.

paite: Aram in Amminadab asuang a, Amminadab in Nashon asuang a, Nashon in Salmon asuang hi.
english: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.

paite: Salmon in Rahab a pan Boaz asuang a, Boaz in Ruth a pan Obed asuang a, Obed in Jesse asuang hi.
english: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.

paite: Jesse in kumpipa David asuang a, kumpipa David in Uria zi a pan Solomon asuang hi.
english: Jesse became the father of King David. David the king became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife.

paite: Solomon in Rehoboam asuang a, Rehoboam in Abijah asuang a, Abijah in Asa asuang hi.
english: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.

paite: Asa in Jehoshaphat asuang a, Jehoshaphat in Jeram asuang a, Jeram in Uzzia asuang hi.
english: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.

paite: Uzzia in Jotham asuang a, Jotham in Ahaz asuang a, Ahaz in Hezekiah asuang hi.
english: Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.

paite: Hezekiah in Manasseh asuang a, Manasseh in Amon asuang a, Amon in Josiah asuang hi.
english: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.

paite: Babulon sal a api lai un Josiah in Jekoniah leh a-unaute asuang hi.
english: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.

paite: Huan Babulon sal a api nung un Jekoniah in Salathiel asuang a, Salathiel in Zerubbabel asuang hi.
english: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.

paite: Zerubbabel in Abiud asuang a, Abiud in Eliakim asuang a, Eliakim in Azor asuang a,
english: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.

paite: Azor in Zadok asuang a, Zadok in Akim asuang a, Akim in Eliud asuang hi.
english: Azor became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.

paite: Eliud in Eleazar asuang a, Eleazar in Mathan asuang a, Mathan in Jakob asuang hi.
english: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.

paite: Jakob in Joseph, Mari pasal asuang a, huai Mari lak ah Jesu Khrist ahong piangta hi.
english: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

paite: Huchi in suan tengteng Abraham a pan David tan suan sawm-le-li ahi a, David a pan Babulon a sal a pi ahih tan un, suan sawm-le-li ahi a, Babulon a sal a pi ahih ua pan Khrist tan suan sawm-le-li ahi.
english: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.

paite: Jesu Khrist hong piandan hichibang ahi. Anu Mari leh Joseph akikham lai ua a-omkhawm ma un, Kha Siangthou in agaisak chih atheita uhi.
english: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.

paite: Huchi in apasal Joseph, midiktak ahi a, amah daisak a-ut kei a, aguk in tawpsan atum hi.
english: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.

paite: Himahleh, huai thute angaihtuah lai in, ngai in, amang in akiang ah Toupa angel ahong kilak a, "Joseph, nang David tapa, na zi Mari neih lau ke'n, anaupai Kha Siangthou a kipan ahi.
english: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Mary as your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

paite: Tapa anei dia, amin ding in Jesu na sa ding; ama'n amite akhelhna ua kipan ahotdam ding ziak in," achi hi.
english: She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”

paite: Toupa'n zawlnei kam a:
english: Now all this has happened that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,

paite: "Ngai in, nungak siangthou agai dia, tapa anei dia, amin Immanuel asa ding uh," chi a agen ahong tuntheihna ding in huai tengteng ahong om hi. Huai tuh, "I kiang uah Pathian a-om," chihna ahi.
english: “Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel,” which is, being interpreted, “God with us.”

paite: Huchi in Joseph ihmu athoukhia a, Toupa Angel in akiang a thu apiak bang in ahih a, azi aneita hi.
english: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;

paite: Himahleh, tapa aneih masiah akithuahpih kei; huan amin Jesu asata hi.
english: and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.

paite: Huai zoh in anungzui sawm-le-nihte akiang ah asamkhawm a, akiang uah khaninte tung leh amau hawlkhe ding, damlouhna chiteng leh natna chiteng hihdam ding in athuneihna apia hi.
english: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.

paite: Huai sawltak sawm-le-nihte min hiaite ahi: Amasapen in Simon Peter leh a-unau Andru; Zebedai tapa Jakob leh a-unau Johan,
english: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;

paite: Philip leh Bartholomai; Thomas leh siahkhon Matthai; Alphai tapa Jakob leh Thaddai;
english: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, who was also called Thaddaeus;

paite: Kanaan mi Simon leh zuausan a mansakpa Judas Iskariot.
english: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

paite: Hiai sawm-le-nihte Jesu'n asawlkhia a, akiang uah huchi in thu apia hi. "Zentelte lam ah pai kei unla, Samari mite khua ah leng lut kei un.
english: Jesus sent these twelve out and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of the Samaritans.

paite: Himahleh Israel inkuan belam mangte kiang ah pai zaw un.
english: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

paite: Huan na pai un, van-gam anaita, chi in thu gen zel un.
english: As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’

paite: Damloute hihdam unla, misite kaithou unla, phakte hihsiangthou unla; dawite hawlkhia un, athawn in na mu ua, athawn in pia un.
english: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.

paite: Na kawnggak uah dangka-eng hiam, dangka hiam, dal dangka hiam vom kei un.
english: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.

paite: Zinna a ding in kawlzal hiam, puanak nih hiam, khedap hiam, chiangkhun hiam tawi sam kei un; nasemmi nek ding mu tak ahi.
english: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.

paite: "Huan kholian hi in khoneu hitaleh na lutna peuh uah nou hon tungsaktak mi zongkhia unla, na pawt nawn mateng uh huai inn ah tung den un.
english: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you go on.

paite: A-inn ua na lut peuh chiang un, chibai buk un.
english: As you enter into the household, greet it.

paite: Huai inn a mite chibai buktak ahih ualeh atung uah na khamuanna uh atung dia; atak kei ualeh nou tung ah akhamuanna uh hong kik nawn ding hi.
english: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.

paite: Kuapeuh nou hon kipahpih lou a, na thu uh leng angaihkhiak keileh, huai inn a kipan leh huai khua a kipan na pawt chiang un, na khepek ua leivui tatkhia un.
english: Whoever doesn’t receive you or hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, thukhen ni chiang in huai khua sang in Sodom leh Gomorrah gam thuak ding adan a-omzaw ding hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.

paite: "Ngai dih ua, ngia lak a belam om bang in ka hon sawlkhia hi; gul bang a pil in, vakhu bang a poi khoih lou in om un.
english: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents and harmless as doves.

paite: Himahleh mihing lak ah pilvang un; vaihawmte ahon mansak ding uh; sinagogte a hon vuak ding ziak un.
english: But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.

paite: Keimah ziak in gamukte leh kumpipate ma ah amaute leh Zentelte theihsakna ding in hon pi ding uhi.
english: Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.

paite: Himahleh ahon matsak chiang un, bang chih ding ahia, bang thu ka gen dia? chi in lungkham kei un; ahuntak in na gen ding uh ahon theisak ding hi.
english: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.

paite: Agenpa noumau na hi kei ding ua, na Pa uh Kha in noumau ah agen zaw ding hi.
english: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.

paite: "Huan hihlup ding in unaupa leh unaupa akimansak ding ua, pa'n leng ata amansak ding; tate'n leng anu leh apate uh adou ding uh, ahihlumsak ding uh.
english: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

paite: Ka min ziak in mi tengteng huat na hi ding ua; himahleh atawp pha a thuak ngap peuhmah hotdam in a-om ding hi.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

paite: Huchi in hiai khua ahon gawt chiang un, kho dang ah taisan un; chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, Mihing Tapa hong pai ma in Israel gam a khopite na siksuak kei ding uhi.
english: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel until the Son of Man has come.

paite: "Nungzui aheutu tung ah a-om kei; sikha leng apu tung ah a-om kei hi.
english: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.

paite: Nungzui aheutu bang a a-om leh sikha apu bang a a-om ahun lel hi. Inn neipa bawn Beelzibul achih uleh, a-inkuanpihte nak chih na tel un chia!
english: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of his household!

paite: "Huaiziak in amaute kihta kei un; lang lou ding a sel bangmah a-om kei, theih louh ding a iim bangmah a-om kei hi.
english: Therefore don’t be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, or hidden that will not be known.

paite: Mial a nou ka hon hilh vak ah na gen ding ua; bilbul ana zak uh intung a tuang in tangkoupih un.
english: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.

paite: Huan pumpi that a kha that theiloute kihta kei unla; Gehenna a kha leh pumpi hihmang theipa kihta zaw un.
english: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.

paite: Kawlgit nih dal dangka khat in azuak zel uh hilou hiam? Himahleh alak ua khat leng na Pa uh theih louh in lei ah ake kei ding hi.
english: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will.

paite: Na samzangte uh nangawn leng sim vek ahi.
english: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

paite: Huaiziak in lau kei un; kawlgit tampi sang in na manphazaw uhi.
english: Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

paite: "Huchi in mite ma a hon gum peuhmah, ka Pa van a om ma ah ka gum sam ding hi.
english: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, I will also confess him before my Father who is in heaven.

paite: Himahleh kuapeuh mite ma a hon kitheihmohbawl, ka Pa van a om ma ah ka kitheihmohbawl sam ding.
english: But whoever denies me before men, I will also deny him before my Father who is in heaven.

paite: "Leitung a lemna lengsak ding a hong pai hon sa kei un; lemna lengsak ding hilou in namsau lengsak ding a hong pai ka hi zaw.
english: “Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.

paite: Mi apa dousak ding in, tanu anu dousak ding in, mou anu dousak ding a hong pai ka hi.
english: For I came to set a man at odds against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

paite: Mi amelma amah inkuanpihte lak a mi mah ahi ding hi.
english: A man’s foes will be those of his own household.

paite: "Kuapeuh anu hiam, apa hiam, kei sang a itzaw tuh ka mi hi tak ahi kei; kuapeuh atanu hiam atapa hiam kei sang a itzaw leng, ka mi hi tak ahi kei.
english: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t worthy of me.

paite: Kuapeuh ama kros pua a hon zui lou ka mi hi tak ahi kei.
english: He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me isn’t worthy of me.

paite: Kuapeuh ahinna mu in amansuah ding a, keimah ziak a ahinna mansuah in amu ding.
english: He who seeks his life will lose it; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.

paite: "Kuapeuh nou hon kipahpih in kei hon kipahpih ahi a, kuapeuh kei hon kipahpih ahon sawlpa kipahpih ahi.
english: “He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.

paite: Zawlnei kuahiam, zawlnei ahih ziak a kipahpih in zawlnei pahtakman angah ding a; kuapeuh midiktat kuahiam midiktat ahih ziak a kipahpih in midiktat pahtakman angah ding hi.
english: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.

paite: Huan kuapeuh hiai mineuchikte lak a khat kiang a, nungzui ahih ziak a tuisik nou khat kia pia leng, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, ama pahtakman amansuah kei hial ding," achi hi.
english: Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n anungzui sawm-le-nihte thu apiak zoh in huai a pan in akhopite uah sinsak ding leh thugen ding in apaita uhi.
english: When Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities.

paite: Johan in suangkul sung a Khrist thilhihte ana zak in anungzuite sawl in akiang ah,
english: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples

paite: "Hong pai dingpa na hi hia, ahihkeileh midang hungaih lai ding ka hi uhiam?" achisak hi.
english: and said to him, “Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?”

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Pai nawnta unla, thil na muh uh leh na zak uh Johan kiang ah va hilh un;
english: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:

paite: mittawte amit uh ahong vakta, khebaite khe in ahong pai ua, phakte ahong siangthouta ua, nangongte leng abil uh ahong vakta, misite leng kaihthoh in a-omta ua; mizawngte'n leng tanchinhoih hilh adongta uhi.
english: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

paite: Kuapeuh ka tung a lung hihlouhna mu lou ahampha hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

paite: Huai mite apaitak un, Jesu'n mipite kiang ah Johan thu agenta hi, "Bang en ding a gamdai a paikhia na hi ua? Sialluang huih mut ling maw?
english: As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

paite: Ahihkeileh bang en ding pen a paikhia na hita ua? Puannem silh maw? Ngai un, puannem silhte zaw kumpipate inn ah ei ve a-om uh.
english: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.

paite: Ahihkeileh bangziak pentak in ahia na paikhiak uh? Zawlnei en ding in maw? Ahi tawk vo oi, ka hon chi ahi; zawlnei sang a leng thupizaw.
english: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

paite: "En dih, na ma ah ka thangkou ka sawl ahi, ama'n na ma ah na lampite abawl ding chih atanchin agelh uh hiai mipa ahi.
english: For this is he, of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

paite: "Chihtaktak in, ka hon hilh ahi, numei suan lak ah baptispa Johan sang a thupizaw apiang kei; himahleh van-gam a mineupen amah sang in athupizaw hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.

paite: Baptispa Johan om a kipan tutan in van-gam in hiamgamna atuak nak, hiamgamte'n thagum in ala uhi.
english: From the days of John the Baptizer until now, the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.

paite: Zawlneite tengteng leh Dan thu in Johan ahong om tanpha in ana genkhol zel uhi.
english: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

paite: Na pom nop uleh, huai zaw Elijah hong pai dingpa mah ahi.
english: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.

paite: Kuapeuh zakna ding a bil nei in za hen!
english: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

paite: "Himahleh hiai khangte bang toh ka tehpih dia? Naupang dawr mun a tu a, alawmte sam a,
english: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions

paite: tamngai hon tumsak ung a, lam lou uchin a, kap huphup ung a, suun lou uchin a, chite bang ahi uh.
english: and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’

paite: Johan ahong pai a, ne in adawn kei a, dawi zawl achi uhi.
english: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’

paite: Mihing Tapa ahong pai a, ne in adawn a, 'En dih ua, an haipa, uain haipa, siahkhonte leh mikhialte lawm,' achi uh. Hinapi in athilhih in pilna siam atan uh," achi hi.
english: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is justified by her children.”

paite: Huan akisik louh ziak un, athil thupi hihtamna khopite atai hi.
english: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent.

paite: "Korazin, na tung agik e; Bethsaida, na tung agik e; noumau a thil thupi kihihte Tura leh Sidon a hih hileh, sai-ip puan silh a vut lak a tu in akisikta ding uhi.
english: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

paite: Himahleh ka hon hilh ahi, thukhen ni chiang in nou thuak ding sang in Tura leh Sidon khua thuak ding adan a-om zaw ding hi.
english: But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.

paite: Huan nang Kapernaum, van tan a tawisang na hi dia hia? Misikhua tan a paisuk ding na hita ve, nangmah a thil thupitak kihihte Sodom a hih hileh, tutan in a-om lai ding hi.
english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, you will go down to Hades. For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in you, it would have remained until today.

paite: Himahleh ka hon hilh ahi, thukhen ni chiang in na thuak ding sang in Sodom gam thuak ding adan a-om zaw ding," achi hi.
english: But I tell you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom on the day of judgment, than for you.”

paite: Huchih lai in Jesu'n ahoupih a, "Pa aw, leitung leh van Toupa, nang mipil leh mibengvakte kiang ah hiai thu na iim a, naungekte kiang a na theihsak ziak in ka hon phat hi.
english: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.

paite: Ahi, Pa, tua bang hih, nang ngaih in ahoih ahi.
english: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.

paite: Ka Pa'n thil bangkim hon kemsakta; Pa lou in kuamah in Tapa athei kei; Tapa leh akiang ua Tapa in akitheihsak utnate kia lou ngal in kuamah in Pa athei kei hi.
english: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.

paite: "Nou semgim leh puakgik po tengteng aw, ka kiang ah hong pai un, keima'n khawlna ka hon pe ding hi.
english: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

paite: Ka hakkol pua unla, kei a kipan zil un; thunuailut leh lungtang kingainiamtak ka hi; huchi in na kha ua ding in khawlna na mu ding uh.
english: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.

paite: Ka hakkol puak anuam a, ka puakgik leng azang hi," achi hi.
english: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”

paite: Huchih lai in, Sabbath ni in buhlei kantan in Jesu apai hi. Nungzuite agilkial ua, nek ding in buhvuite akhiak uhi.
english: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.

paite: Pharisaite'n huai amuh un, akiang ah, "En dih, na nungzuite'n Sabbath ni in hihsiang lou ahih uh," achi uhi.
english: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "David in agilkial lai a alawmte toh athilhih uh na sim kei ua hia?
english: But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him:

paite: Huchi a Pathian inn a alut a, amah leh alawmte'n nek siang louh, siampute kia nek siang tanghou koihtuam anek thu uh?
english: how he entered into God’s house and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those who were with him, but only for the priests?

paite: Ahihkeileh Sabbath ni in tempul a siampu omte'n Sabbath ni abohsiat un leng siamtang in a-om uh chih Dan thu na sim kei ua hia?
english: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?

paite: Huchi ahih ngalleh, tempul sang a thupizaw hiai ah a-om chih ka hon hilh ahi.
english: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.

paite: Himahleh 'kithoihna deih lou in, zahngaihna ka deih' chih a-omdan na thei hi le uchin, mi siamtangte siam louh tangsak lou ding hi ve uchin.
english: But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ you wouldn’t have condemned the guiltless.

paite: Mihing Tapa zaw Sabbath' Toupa ahi," achi hi.
english: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

paite: Huan huai a kipan apai a, asinagogte uah ava lut hi.
english: He departed from there and went into their synagogue.

paite: Ngai dih, mi khat khutzaw ana om a, amah ahektheihna ding un, "Sabbath ni a hihdam asiang hia?" chi in Jesu adong uhi.
english: And behold, there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” so that they might accuse him.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Noute lak ah kuapeuh in belam khat nei unla, Sabbath ni in kokhuk ah ke taleh kua ahia len a kaikhe lou ding?
english: He said to them, “What man is there among you who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won’t he grab on to it and lift it out?

paite: Belam khat sang in mihing khat bangchi lel a manphazaw ahia? Huaiziak in Sabbath ni in hihhoih asiang hi,” achi hi.
english: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”

paite: Huai zoh in, huai mi kiang ah, "Na khut zan in," achi a, huchi in azan a, alangkhat bang in adamsiangta hi.
english: Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.

paite: Pharisaite bel apawt ua, amah ahihlup theihdan ding uh ngaihtuah in akihou uhi.
english: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.

paite: Jesu'n huai thu atheih in huai mun a kipan in akihemmang hi. Himahleh mi tampi in amah azui ua, adamloute uh ana hihdam vek hi.
english: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,

paite: Atanchin genthang het lou ding in akiang uah achi hi.
english: and commanded them that they should not make him known,

paite: Huai zawlnei Isai thugenkholh tangtunna ding ahi zaw hi;
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

paite: "En dih, ka sikha ka tel, ka deihtak, ka lungsim in apahtak mahmah, atung ah ka Kha ka koih dia, huchi in Zentelte kiang ah dik a vaihawmna apuangkhe ding hi;
english: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.

paite: Asel kei ding a, akikou sam kei ding, kongzing ah kuamah in a-aw aza kei ding uh.
english: He will not strive, nor shout, neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.

paite: Dik a vaihawmna avualzohsak mateng sialluang kigawpsa ahihtankhe kei ding a, meivak kuang liakliak ahihmit sam kei ding hi.
english: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.

paite: Amah min ah Zentelte'n lametna angah ding uh," achi hi.
english: In his name, the nations will hope.”

paite: Huchih lai in dawimat mittaw pau thei lou khat akiang ah hon pi ua; ama'n ahihdam a, pau thei lou hong pau in, ahon mutheita hi.
english: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him; and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.

paite: Huchi in mipi tengteng in lamdang asa mahmah ua, "Hiai mipa, David Tapa hilou ahi maw?" achi uhi.
english: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”

paite: Himahleh Pharisaite'n huai azak phet un, "Hiai mi'n dawite kumpipa, Beelzibul ziak lou in dawite adelhkhe kei ding," achi uhi.
english: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

paite: Jesu'n amaute ngaihtuahte athei a, akiang uah, "Koi gam leng amah kidou amangthang nak; koi khua hiam, inkuan khat leng amah kidou, akhosuak kei ding hi.
english: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.

paite: Setan in Setan mah adelhkhiak in amah-le-amah kidou hi ding ahi a; agam bangchi in adingh dia le?
english: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?

paite: Huan kei Beelzibul ziak a dawite delhkhia ka hihleh, na tate un kua ziak in ahia adelhkhiak uh? Huaiziak in amaute noute tung a thukhen mite ahi ding uhi.
english: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

paite: Himahleh, ke'n Pathian Kha ziak a dawite delhkhia ka na hihleh, Pathian lalgam na kiang uah hong tungta ahi ding hi.
english: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.

paite: "Huchi ahih kei ngal in, mi'n mihat agak masak phot keileh bangchi in ahia mihat inn alut a, asum alaksak theih ding? Huai nung in a-inn alok mai ding hi.
english: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.

paite: "Kuapeuh kei lam a pang lou, hon dou ahi; kuapeuh hon lakkhawmpih lou in athehzak ahi.
english: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.

paite: Huaiziak in ka hon hilh ahi, mi akhelhna chiteng uah leh Pathian agensiatna chiteng uh ngaihdam ahi ding ua; Kha hilhial agensiatna ngaihdamsak ahi kei ding hi.
english: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.

paite: Kuapeuh Mihing Tapa kalh, akalhna uh ngaihdamsak ahi ding; kuapeuh Kha Siangthou hilhial kalh zaw huai akalhna uh, tu damsung leh hun hong tung ding ah leng, ngaihdam ahi kei ding," achi hi.
english: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, either in this age, or in that which is to come.

paite: "Sing hoih agah leng ahoih na chih kei ngal uleh, sing sia agah leng asia, chi vanglak un; sing agah a akitheih ziak in.
english: “Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.

paite: Nou gul suante aw, nou gilou napi in bangchi in ahia thuhoih na gen theih ding uh? Lungtang a dim val kam in agen zel hi.
english: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.

paite: Mihoih in agoubawm hoih a kipan thil hoihte alakhia a, migilou in agoubawm hoih lou a kipan thil hoih lou alakhe zel hi.
english: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.

paite: "Huan ka hon hilh ahi. Mite'n thugina lou agen peuhmah uh huai thu tanchin mah vaihawm ni chiang in agen ding uhi.
english: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.

paite: Na thu in siam ahon tangsak ding a, na thu mah in siam louh ahon tangsak ding hi," achi hi.
english: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”

paite: Huai lai in laigelhmite leh Pharisaite lak a mi kuate hiam in amah ahoupih ua akiang ah, "Heutupa, nang a kipan chiamtehna muh ka ut uh," achi uhi.
english: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Khang gilou leh angkawmte'n chiamtehna azong ua, himahleh zawlnei Jonah chiamtehna lou ngal akiang uah chiamtehna piak ahi kei ding hi.
english: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

paite: Ngapi gilsung a Jonah ni thum leh zan thum a-om bang in, Mihing Tapa ni thum leh zan thum lei gilsung ah a-om sam ding hi.
english: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

paite: Nineveh khomite thukhen ni chiang in hiai khangte kiang ah adingh sam ding ua, siam louh atangsak ding uh. Jonah thugen ziak in akisik ua; ngai dih ua, Jonah sang a thupizaw hiai ah a-om hi.
english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.

paite: Thukhen ni chiang in hiai khangte kiang ah simlam kumpinu athou ding a, siam louh atangsak ding hi, Solomon pilna ngaikhe ding in kawlmong a kipan ahong pai ngal a; ngai dih ua, hiai ah Solomon sang a thupizawa-om hi!
english: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.

paite: "Huan mihing sung a kipan a dawi nin pawt in, khawlna zong in tui omlouhna mun ah avakvak a, amu kei hi.
english: “When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.

paite: Huan 'ka pawtna inn mah ah ka kik nawn mai ding,' achi a; ava tunleh ahawm a zephoihsa in ava mu hi.
english: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came;’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.

paite: Huaitak in ava pai a, amah sang a gilouzaw dawi dang sagih ahon pi a, huai mi sung ah alut ua, atengta uhi; huai mihing omdan nanung amasa sang in ahong hoih kei zaw hi. Tua bang mah in, hiai khang giloutakte tung ah ahong om ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: Then he goes and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”

paite: Mipite kiang a thu agen lai in ngai dih, amah houpih tum in inpua ah anu leh a-unaute adingh uhi.
english: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.

paite: Mi khat in akiang ah, "Ngai dih, na nu leh na unaute nang hon houpih tum in inpua ah adingh nilouh uh," achi hi.
english: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”

paite: Ama'n ahilhpa kiang ah, "Ka nu kua ahia? Ka unaute leng kuate ahi ua?" chi in adawng hi.
english: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”

paite: Huan nungzuite lam a akhut zan in, "En un, ka nu leh ka unaute;
english: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

paite: kuapeuh ka Pa van a om deihlam hih phot ka unaupa leh ka unaunu leh ka nu ahi uh," achi hi.
english: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”

paite: Huai ni'n inn a kipan Jesu pakhia a, tuipi gei ah atu hi.
english: On that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside.

paite: Huan akiang ah mipi tampitak ahong kikhawm ua, huchi in long ah atuang a, atu a, mipi tengteng piautak ah adingh uhi.
english: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.

paite: Gentehna in thu tampi akiang uah agen hi, "Ngai dih ua, buhchithehpa buhchi theh in akuan hi.
english: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.

paite: Buhchi atheh lai in akhen lamsik ah akia a, vasate'n ane zou uhi.
english: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.

paite: Akhen suangsilei lak ah akia a, lei asah louh ziak in hong pou pah hi.
english: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.

paite: Himahleh ni asuah in haivuai in a-om a; zung aneih louh ziak in avuai maimah hi.
english: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.

paite: Huan akhen loulingnei lak ah akia a, loupa hong pousang a; adepmangta hi.
english: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.

paite: Akhen lei hoih ah akia a, khenkhat aleh za, khenkhat aleh sawmguk, khenkhatte aleh sawmthum in hong gah uhi.
english: Others fell on good soil and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.

paite: Kuapeuh bil nei in, za hen!" achi hi.
english: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

paite: Huan nungzuite ahong pai ua, akiang ah, "Bangziak a gentehna a thu gen na hia?" achi uhi.
english: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”

paite: Ama'n adawng a akiang uah, "Van lalgam thuguk noute theih phal ahi a, amau theih zaw phal ahi kei hi.
english: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.

paite: Kuapeuh anei piak behlap ahi ding a, ahau ding; kuapeuh anei lou aneihsun nangawn laksak ahi ding hi.
english: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance; but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.

paite: Huchi ahih ziak in akiang uah gentehna in thu ka gen ahi; 'mu napi in amu kei nak ua, za napi in atheisiam kei nak uh.'
english: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they understand.

paite: Isai thugenkholh atung uah atung hi; 'Bil in zaw na za ding ua, theih bel na theisiam kei ding uh; muh zaw na mu ding ua, theih bel na thei kei ding uh.
english: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive;

paite: Hiai chite lungtang ananggawpta, abilte uh angong a, amitsi ua, huchi lou in zaw amit un amu ding ua, abil un aza kha ding ua, alungtang un atheisiam ding ua, ahong kik nawn kha ding ua, amau ka na hihdam kha ding,' ana chi hi.
english: for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, and they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, and I would heal them.’

paite: "Nou mitte zaw ahampha hi, amuh ziak in; na bil uh leng ahampha hi, azak ziak in.
english: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, zawlnei tampi leh midiktat tampi'n leng na thil muhte uh muh a-ut ua, himahleh amu kei uh; na thilzakte uh zak a-ut ua, himahleh aza kei uhi.
english: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.

paite: "Huaiziak in buhchithehpa gentehna thu za un.
english: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.

paite: Kuapeuh in lalgam thu bil a azak a, atheihsiam keileh migilou hong pai in, alungtang a thehsa alaksak nak hi. Huai tuh lamsik a theh ahi.
english: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.

paite: Suangsilei a theh bel, thu za a kipaktak a pom bang ahi.
english: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word and immediately with joy receives it;

paite: Himahleh amah ah zung a-om kei a, sawt louchik kia a-om a, thu ziak a gimthuakna leh sawina ahong omtak in apuk pah hi.
english: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.

paite: Huan loulingnei lak a thehte tuh thu za a, himahleh khovel awlmohna leh hauhsakna khemna in thu adep a, gah lou in ahong om hi.
english: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

paite: Huan lei hoih tung a theh tuh thu bil a za a, theisiam ahi; huai tuh agah ngei a, khenkhat aleh za, khenkhat aleh sawmguk, khenkhat aleh sawmthum in apung," achi hi.
english: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”

paite: Akiang uah gentehna dang agen nawn a, "Van lalgam tuh mi alou a chi hoih thehpa toh teh ahi.
english: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,

paite: Himahleh mi a-ihmut kal in melma ahong pai a, buhlak ah buhlem atheh a, apaimang nawnta hi.
english: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.

paite: Huan buh hong pou a, ahong vuih in, buhlem leng ahong kilang sam hi.
english: But when the blade sprang up and produced grain, then the darnel weeds appeared also.

paite: Huchi in inn neipa sikhate ahong pai ua, akiang ah, Pu, na lou a chi hoih theh lou na hi maw? Buhlemte koi a kipan a hong om ahia? achi uhi.
english: The servants of the householder came and said to him, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where did these darnel weeds come from?’

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, melma in na theh ahi ve," achi hi. Sikhate'n akiang ah ahihleh huaite va lakhawm le ung hoih na sa hia? achi uhi.
english: “He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’

paite: Ama'n bel, "sa lou e, buhlem na lakkhawmna lam uah buhtak na botkhawm kha ding uh.
english: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.

paite: Buh lak dong in poukhawm uheh; buhlak hun chiang in buh atte kiang ah, buhlem lakhawm masa phot unla, hal ding in lomgak un; buhtak pen bel ka buh inn ah seklut un, ka chi ding," achi hi.
english: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.”’”

paite: Akiang uah gentehna dang agen nawn a, "Van lalgam tuh mi'n ankam chi tang khat alak a, alou a atheh bang ahi.
english: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took, and sowed in his field,

paite: Huai chi laklak ah aneupen a; himahleh ahong pousang chiang in loupa lak ah alianpen a, sing hong hi a, huchi in tungleng vasate ahong pai ua, ahiang ah agiak uh," achi hi.
english: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.”

paite: Akiang uah gentehna dang agen nawn a, "Van lalgam tuh numei in silngou anbuang tehna thum lak a abilh a, avek a athoh mateng aphum bang ahi," achi hi.
english: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened.”

paite: Jesu'n mipite kiang ah gentehna in huai tengteng agen a, gentehna lou in akiang uah bangmah agen kei hi.
english: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,

paite: Zawlnei in, "Gentehna in ka kam ka ka ding a, leilung pian tung a kipat thil kisel ka genkhe ding," chi a agen ahong tuntheihna ding in.
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.”

paite: Huai lai in mipite apaisan a, inn ah alut a, nungzuite akiang ah ahong pai ua, "Lou a buhlem gentehna thu hon hilhchian in," achi uhi.
english: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”

paite: Ama'n adawng a, "Chi hoih thehpa Mihing Tapa ahi a; lou bel khovel ahi.
english: He answered them, “He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,

paite: Chi hoihte gam tate ahi ua; buhlemte migilou tate ahi.
english: the field is the world, the good seeds are the children of the Kingdom, and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.

paite: Melma buhlem thehpa diabol ahi a, buhlak hun khovel tawpna ding ahi; a-atte angelte ahi uhi.
english: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.

paite: Huchi in buhlemte alakhawm ua mei a ahal bang un khovel tawpna ah a-om ding hi.
english: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.

paite: Mihing Tapa in angelte asawlkhe ding a, gam a kipan hihkhialsakte leh thil hihkhialte tengteng akhawmkhe ding uh.
english: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling and those who do iniquity,

paite: Amaute haltuina mei ah apai ding ua, huai lai ah kah leh hagawi a-om ding hi.
english: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

paite: Huai hun chiang in midiktatte a Pa uh gam ah ni bang in atang ding uhi. Zakna ding a bil nei peuh in za hen!
english: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

paite: "Van lalgam tuh lou a gou phumguk bang ahi; mi'n huai mu in, asel nawn a, akipah ziak in aneih tengteng azuak a, huai lou aleita hi.
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.

paite: "Huan van-gam tuh sumsinmi tuikepsuang hoihtak zongmi bang ahi nawn hi.
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,

paite: Huan ama'n tuikepsuang manphatak khat amu a, aneih tengteng zuak in aleita hi.
english: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.

paite: "Van lalgam tuh lenpi, tuipi a paih, chi chih tunkhawmna bang ahi nawn hi.
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some fish of every kind,

paite: Adimtak in agei ah akaikhia ua, atu ua, bawm ah ahoih teng alakhawm ua, ahoihloute apaih uh bang ahi.
english: which, when it was filled, fishermen drew up on the beach. They sat down and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.

paite: Khovel tawp hun chiang in huchibang mah in a-om ding, angelte ahong pawt ding ua, midiktatte lak ah migiloute akhenkhe ding uh.
english: So it will be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,

paite: Huchi in haltuina mei ah apai ding ua, huai ah kah leh hagawi a-om ding," achi hi.
english: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

paite: Jesu mah in akiang uah, "Huai tengteng na theisiam uhia?" achi a, amau akiang ah, "Thei e,” achi uhi.
english: Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Huaiziak in laigelhmi van-gam thuhilh a om peuhmah, inn neipa, agoubawm a kipan a thil thakte leh thil luite pholhkhepa bang ahi," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n huai gentehnate agen khit in huai a kipan apaita hi.
english: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.

paite: A-omna kholam atung a, asinagogte uah amaute thu ahilh a, huchi in lamdang asa mahmah ua, "Hiai mi'n koi a kipan a hiai bang pilna leh hiai nasep thupi hihtheihnate amuh ahia?
english: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works?

paite: Hiai mi singlem bawlpa tapa hilou hia? Anu Mari kichi hilou hia? A-unaute Jakob, Joseph, Simon, Judas kichite hilou uhia?
english: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?

paite: Hiai mi in koi a kipan a hiaite tengteng mu ahia? Asanggamnute leng i kiang ua om vek hilou uhia?" achi uhi.
english: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”

paite: Huchi in atung ah alungkim kei uhi. Himahleh Jesu'n akiang uah, "Zawlnei ama kholam leh ama inn lam lou ngal ah pahtawi louh in a-om ngei kei," achi hi.
english: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country and in his own house.”

paite: Agin louh ziak un huai ah nasep thupi dang tam ahih kei hi.
english: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

paite: Huai laitak in kumpipa Herod in Jesu tanchin ana za hi.
english: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,

paite: Asikhate kiang ah thu agen a, "Hiai Baptispa Johan ahi; misi lak a kipan thounawn ahi; huaiziak in huai thilhihtheihnate'n amah a sem ahi," achi hi.
english: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”

paite: Herod in a-unau Philip zi, Herodias ziak in Johan aman a, ahen a, suangkul ah ana khum hi.
english: For Herod had arrested John, bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.

paite: Johan in akiang ah amah na neih asiang kei, achih ziak in.
english: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”

paite: Johan hihlup ut mahleh mipi akihta a, zawlnei hi a apom ziak un.
english: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

paite: Himahleh Herod pian ni ahong tun in alai ah Herodias tanu alam a, Herod akipaksak hi.
english: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.

paite: Huai phet in anget peuhmah pe ding in thu akichiam hi.
english: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.

paite: Ama'n anu' thuhilh bang in, "Hiai kuang ah Baptispa Johan lutang hon pia in," achi hi.
english: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”

paite: Kumpipa alungkhamta a, himahleh athuchiamte leh a-ankuang umpihte ziak in piak ding thu apia hi.
english: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,

paite: Huchi in mi asawl a, Johan lutang atansak hi.
english: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.

paite: Huan kuang in alutang ahon la ua, numei naupang kiang ah apia ua, ama'n anu kiang ah apaipihta hi.
english: His head was brought on a platter and given to the young lady; and she brought it to her mother.

paite: Johan nungzuite'n aluang hong la ua, avui ua, huchi in Jesu ava hilh uhi.
english: His disciples came, took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.

paite: Jesu'n huai thu azak in, hiai a kipan long in gamkeu lam ah apaituamta hi. Himahleh mipi'n azaktak un khua a kipan khe a pai in azuita uhi.
english: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.

paite: Huchi in amah ahong paikhiakleh mipi tampitak amu a, ahehpih mahmah a, adamloute uh ahihdamsak hi.
english: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them and healed their sick.

paite: Nitaklam ahong hih in, nungzuite akiang ah ahong pai ua, "Hiai mun gamkeu ahi a, ni akaita a, mipite khuate apai a, amau a ding nek ding aleitheihna ding un paisakta in," achi uhi.
english: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Apaimang uh akiphamoh kei, noumau nek ding pia un," achi hi.
english: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Hiai ah tanghou phel nga leh ngasa nih kia i nei uh," achi uhi.
english: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”

paite: Ama'n, "Huaite ka kiang ah hon la un," achi hi.
english: He said, “Bring them here to me.”

paite: Huchi in loupa tung a tu ding in mipite thu apia a, tanghou phel nga leh ngasa nihte ala a, van lam en in avualzawl a, abalkham a, nungzuite kiang ah tanghoute apia a, mipite kiang ah nungzuite'n apesawn uhi.
english: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.

paite: Huan avek un ane ua, avah chiatta ua; akhamval uh bawmpi sawm-le-nih dim angah uhi.
english: They all ate and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.

paite: Anete numei leh naupang sim louh in, piching ngen sangnga vel ahi uh.
english: Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.

paite: Huan mipite asawlmang khit in apai ma a gal khat na pai masa ding in nungzuite long ah atuangsak teitei hi.
english: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

paite: Mipite apaimang nung un thum ding in tang ah atuam in apaitou a, nitaklam ahong hih in huai ah amah kia in a-omta hi.
english: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.

paite: Tuipi laitak ah long a-omta a; huih in ahilou lam a asawn ziak in tuikihot in asepta hi.
english: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

paite: Zanven lina ah tuipi tung a khe a Jesu pai a, akiang lam uh hon zuan in amu uhi.
english: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.

paite: Nungzuite'n amah tuipi tung a khe apai amuh un, "Sikha ahi," chi in abuai ua, lau in akikouta uhi.
english: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n amaute ahoupih pah a, "Khamuangtak in om un, keimah ka hi, lau kei un," achi hi.
english: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

paite: Peter in adawng a, "Toupa, nang na hihleh tui tung ah nang kiang a hong pai thu hon pia in," achi hi.
english: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”

paite: Huan ama'n, "Hong pai ve,” achi a, long a kipan Peter akum a, Jesu kiang zuan in tui tung ah khe in apaita hi.
english: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.

paite: Himahleh huih nung amuh in alau a, tum ding in akisa a, "Toupa, hon hondam in," chi in akikou hi.
english: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”

paite: Jesu'n asawk pah a, amah alen a, akiang ah, "Nang gintawm, bangziak a ginglah na hia?" achi hi.
english: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”

paite: Huan long a atuan uleh huih adaita hi.
english: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.

paite: Long a omte'n, "Pathian Tapa na hi taktak hi," chi in amah abia uhi.
english: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”

paite: Huan gal khat lam akai uleh, Gennesaret gam ahong tung uhi.
english: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

paite: Huai mun a mite'n amah atheihtak un, huai kim gam tengteng ah mi asawl ua, damlou tengteng akiang ah ahon pi ua;
english: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region and brought to him all who were sick;

paite: Apuan mong bek khoih theih angen ngutngut ua; huan akhoih peuhmah adam zel uhi.
english: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.
