paite: Huai khit in Jesu kiang ah Jerusalem a kipan Pharisaite leh laigelhmite ahong pai ua,
english: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,

paite: "Bangziak a upate thugousiah a na nungzuite talek nak uh ahia? Tanghou anek chiang un akhut uh asil ngei kei uh," achi uhi.
english: “Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Nou leng bangziak a na thugousiah ziak ua Pathian thupiak a talek na hi ua?
english: He answered them, “Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?

paite: Pathian in, 'Na nu leh na pa zahtak in, kuapeuh anu hiam apa hiam gensia si ngeingei heh' achi hi.
english: For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’

paite: Nou bel, 'kuapeuh anu hiam apa hiam kiang a, na hon zatna ding Pathian kiang a piak ahih peuhmah chiang in,
english: But you say, ‘Whoever may tell his father or his mother, “Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God,”

paite: anu leh apa azah ding ahi nawn kei,' na chi uhi. Huchi in na thugousiah ziak un Pathian thu bangmah lou na suah uhi.
english: he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.

paite: Nou lepchiahte, Isai in na tungtang thu uh ana genkhol dik mahmah hi;
english: You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,

paite: "Hiai mite'n akam un ahon zah ua, amuk un ahon phat ua, himahleh alungtang un ahon gamlat uh.
english: ‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

paite: Himahleh, athuhilhna ua mihing thupiak ahilh ziak un ahon biak uh athawn mai ahi," chi in adawng hi.
english: And they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’”

paite: Huan mipi asam a akiang uah, "Ngaikhia unla, theisiam un;
english: He summoned the multitude, and said to them, “Hear, and understand.

paite: kam a lut in mihing ahihnin kei a; himahleh kam a pawt, huai ngei in mihing ahihnin zaw hi,” achi hi.
english: That which enters into the mouth doesn’t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.”

paite: Huai lai in anungzuite ahong pai ua, akiang ah, "Pharisaite'n huai thu azak ua alungkimlouhdan uh na thei hia?" achi uhi.
english: Then the disciples came and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying?”

paite: Ama'n, "Kung tengteng ka Pa van a om suan louh bohkhiak in a-om ding.
english: But he answered, “Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.

paite: Amaute awlmoh kei un; mittaw makai ahi uh; huchi in mittaw in mittaw mah apileh kokhuk ah akekhawm ding uh," chi in adawng hi.
english: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”

paite: Huan Peter in akiang ah, "Huai gentehna thu hon hilhchian in," chi in adong hi.
english: Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”

paite: Ama'n, "Tutan a nou leng thei nai lou lai na hi uh maw?
english: So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?

paite: Kam a lut peuhmah gil ah alutsuk a, dailenna ah paihkhiak in a-om chih na thei kei ua hia?
english: Don’t you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly and then out of the body?

paite: Kam a pawtte bel lungtang a kipan a hong pawt ahi ua; huaite ngeingei in mihing ahihnin nak hi.
english: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.

paite: Lungtang a kipan ngaihtuahna giloute, tualthahna, angkawmna, kingaihna, guktakna, hekna, gensiatna ahong pawt nak hi.
english: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.

paite: Huaite ahi mihing hihnin; khut sil lou a an nek in mi ahihnin kei,” achi hi.
english: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’t defile the man.”

paite: Jesu hiai a kipan pawt in Tura leh Sidon uk ah apaita hi.
english: Jesus went out from there and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.

paite: Huan ngai dih, huai gam a kipan Kanaan numei khat ahong pai a, "Toupa, David Tapa, ka tung ah zahngai in, ka tanu dawi in lungkhamhuaipi in ama'n," chi in akikou hi.
english: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”

paite: Ama'n bel kam khat in leng adawng kei hi. Anungzuite'n, "I nung ah akikoukou a, paisak mai in," chi in hong gen uhi.
english: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”

paite: Ama'n bel, "Israel inkote nam lak a belam mangte kiang lou ngal ah sawl ka hi kei," chi in adawng hi.
english: But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

paite: Himahleh numei ahong pai a, "Toupa hon huh in," chi in abia hi.
english: But she came and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, help me.”

paite: Huan ama'n, "Tate tanghou laksak a, uite kiang a paih akilawm kei," chi in adawng hi.
english: But he answered, “It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

paite: Numei in, "Toupa, hih zaw ahi tham hi; himahleh, uite'n leng apu uh dohkan a kipan a tanghou nen kia ane zel sam ve ua oi," achi hi.
english: But she said, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.”

paite: Huaitak in Jesu'n akiang ah, "Numei, na ginna thupi na tel e; na deih bangtak in na tung ah om hen," chi in adawng a, huchi in atanu huai hun ngei in adamta hi.
english: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.

paite: Huai a kipan Jesu apai a, Galili tuipi kiang ahong tung a; tang ah apaitou a, huai ah atu hi.
english: Jesus departed from there and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up on the mountain and sat there.

paite: Huchi in akiang ah mipi tampi ahong ua, khebaite, mittawte, pau theiloute, piangsualte leh midang tampi ahon pi ua, ama'n amaute ana hihdam chiat hi.
english: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,

paite: Mipite'n pau theiloute hong pau a, piangsualte hong hoih a, khebaite khe a pai a, mittawte'n hon mutheita uh chih amuh un lamdang asa mahmah ua; huchi in Israel' Pathian aphatta uhi.
english: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, the injured healed, the lame walking, and the blind seeing—and they glorified the God of Israel.

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n anungzuite asam a, "Ka kiang ah mipite ni thum a-omta ua, nek ding bangmah aneih louh ziak un, ka lainat mahmah; an ngawl in ka paikiksak ut kei hi, huchi lou in zaw lamkal ah abahsegawp kha ding uh," achi hi.
english: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”

paite: Nungzuite'n akiang ah, "Mipi hiai zahzah vahna khop tanghou huai zahzah gamdai ah koi a kipan i mu dia?" achi uhi.
english: The disciples said to him, “Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Tanghou phel bangzah na nei ua? achi hi. Amau akiang ah, phel sagih leh nga neu tawmchik toh," achi uhi.
english: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”

paite: Huan ama'n lei a tu ding in mipite thu apia a,
english: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;

paite: huan tanghou phel sagih leh ngate ala a, kipahthu gen in, abalkham a, nungzuite kiang ah apia a, huchi in nungzuite'n mipite kiang ah apesawn uhi.
english: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

paite: Huan avek un ane ua, avah chiatta ua; akhamval nen uh bawmpi sagih adim hi.
english: They all ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.

paite: Anete tuh numei leh naupang sim louh in, piching ngen sangli ahi uh.
english: Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.

paite: Huan mipite asawlmang nung in long ah Jesu atuang a, Magadan gam atung hi.
english: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.

paite: Huai zoh in Pharisaite leh Saddukaite ahong pai ua, amah ze-etna ding in van a kipan chiamtehna amaute ensak ding in angen uhi.
english: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Nitaklam ahong hih in, khua apha dia ahi ding e, meisan asuak a, na chi nak uh.
english: But he answered them, “When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’

paite: Huan zingsang in, tuni'n khua se dia ahi ding e, meisan asuak a, aniamkai, na chi nak uh. 'Van omdan na theisiam ngal ua, himahleh, hun chiamtehnate na theisiam thei kei uhi.'
english: In the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but you can’t discern the signs of the times!

paite: Khang gilou leh angkawmte'n chiamtehna azong ua, himahleh, Jonah chiamtehna lou ngal akiang uah chiamtehna piak ahi kei ding," chi in adawng hi. Huan amaute paisan in apawtkheta hi.
english: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah.” He left them and departed.

paite: Huan nungzuite gal khat lam atun un tanghou apo mangngilh ua,
english: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Pharisaite leh Saddukaite silngou lak ah kiveng unla, pilvang un," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

paite: Amau, "Tanghou i puak louh ziak uh ei ve," chi in akingaihtuah uhi.
english: They reasoned among themselves, saying, “We brought no bread.”

paite: Jesu'n huai athei a, "Nou ginglahte aw, bang achia tanghou na neih louh ziak ua kingaihtuah maimah na hi ua?
english: Jesus, perceiving it, said, “Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, because you have brought no bread?

paite: Tu nangawn in na lungsim un na thei nai kei lailai uh maw? Mi sangnga nek tanghou phel nga leh akhamval uh bawmpi bangzah na dimsak zah uh na theigige kei ua hia?
english: Don’t you yet perceive or remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up,

paite: Mi sangli nek tanghou phel sagih leh akhamval uh bawmpi bangzah hiam na luahdim uh chih thei lou uh maw?
english: or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

paite: Tanghou thu na kiang ua gen lou in, Pharisaite leh Saddukaite silngou a pan pilvang un, chih gen ka hi zaw chih bang achia thei lou na hi ua?" achi hi.
english: How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

paite: Huaitak in tanghou silngou lak a pilvang ding in asawl kei a, Pharisaite leh Saddukaite thuhilhna a pan pilvang ding in amau asawl zaw chih atheita uhi.
english: Then they understood that he didn’t tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

paite: Kaisaria uk a Philippi mun ahong tun in Jesu'n anungzuite kiang ah, "Mite'n Mihing Tapa kua ahi achi ua?" chi in adong hi.
english: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”

paite: Amau, "Khenkhat in Baptispa Johan ahi, achi ua; khenkhat in Elijah; khenkhat in Jeremiah hiam zawlnei kuahiam ahi," achi uh, achi uhi.
english: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Ahihleh nou kua ka hi na hon chi ua?" achi hi.
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”

paite: Simon Peter in, "Khrist Pathian Hing Tapa na hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Simon, Bar Jonah, hampha chia; sa leh sisan in hon theihsak na hi kei a, ka Pa van a om hon theihsak na hi zaw hi.
english: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.

paite: K'on hilh ahi, nang Peter na hi, hiai suangpi tung ah ka saptuam ka lamtou ding a, misi khokulh kongkhakte'n hiai azou kei ding uh.
english: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

paite: Van lalgam chabite ka hon pe ding a, leitung ah bangpeuh na hen van ah leng hen ahi ding a, leitung ah bangpeuh na phel van ah leng phel ahi ding,” achi hi.
english: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”

paite: Huai zoh in Khrist ahi chih kuamah hilh lou ding in nungzuite achi bikbek hi.
english: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.

paite: Huai nung in Jerusalem a apai ding dan, upate, siampu liante, laigelhmite a pan thil tampi athuakdan ding leh hihlup a a-omdan ding, ni thum ni a kaihthoh a a-omdan ding Jesu'n anungzuite atheisak panta hi.
english: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.

paite: Huai phet in Peter in amah apituam a, "Toupa, hi kei hen! Huaite na tung ah tung ngei kei hen!" chi in ataihilh hi.
english: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”

paite: Jesu akihei a, Peter kiang ah, "Setan, ka nung ah pai in, kei a di'n pukna na hi; Pathian thilte ngaihtuah lou in mihing thilte na ngaihtuah zaw hi," achi hi.
english: But he turned and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.”

paite: Jesu'n anungzuite kiang ah, "Kuapeuh in hon zuihnopleh amah kimangngilh in, ama kros pua in hon zui hen.
english: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

paite: Kuapeuh ahinna humbit ut in atan ding a; kuapeuh keimah ziak a ahinna tan in ahumbit ding hi.
english: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.

paite: Mi'n khovel apumpi in nei henla, ahinna tanleh amah a ding in bang aphatuam dia? Ahihkeileh mi'n ahinna sik in bang ape thei dia?
english: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?

paite: "Mihing Tapa a-angelte toh, a Pa thupina a kizem a ahong pai ding ziak in. Huai hun chiang in michih anasep bang un adin chiat ding hi.
english: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will give to everyone according to his deeds.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon chi ahi, hiai adingh akhente, agam a Mihing Tapa hong pai amuh masiah uh, sihna chiam lou hial ding a-om uh," achi hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.”

paite: Huan ni guk nung in Jesu'n atuam in tang sangtak ah Peter, Jakob leh a-unau Johan apaitouhpih hi.
english: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.

paite: Huan ama uah amel omdan ahong lamdangta a; amai ni bang in ahong tang a, apuansilhte vuk bang in ahong ngouta hi.
english: He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

paite: Huan ngai dih, Mosi leh Elijah, amah kihoupih in akiang uah akilak uhi.
english: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.

paite: Huan Peter in Jesu ahoupih a, "Toupa, ei a di'n hiai a om ahoih, na utleh hiai ah aidakbuk thum ka bawl ding a; nang a ding in khat, Mosi a ding in khat, Elijah a ding in khat,” achi hi.
english: Peter answered and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

paite: Agen laitak in, mei ngoutak in amaute aliahta a; ngai dih, mei a kipan aw in, "Hiai ka Tapa deihtak, ka kipahna mahmah ahi; amah thu ngai un," achi hi.
english: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”

paite: Huan nungzuite'n huai azak un bokkhup in apuk ua, alau mahmah uhi.
english: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.

paite: Jesu'n amaute ahong khoih a, "Thou unla, lau kei un,” achi hi.
english: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”

paite: Huan adakkhia ua, Jesu kia lou ngal kuamah amuta kei uhi.
english: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.

paite: Huan tang a kipan akum lai un, Jesu'n akiang uah, "Misi lak a kipan Mihing Tapa athohnawn masiah na thil muh uh kuamah hilh kei un," chi in thu apia hi.
english: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”

paite: Huan anungzuite'n akiang ah, "Laigelhmite'n Elijah hong pai masa ding ahi, bangchidan a chi ahi ua?" chi in adong uhi.
english: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

paite: Ama'n, "Elijah ahong pai ding him ahi a, bangkim asiam hoih ding hi.
english: Jesus answered them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things;

paite: Himahleh ka hon hilh ahi, Elijah zaw ahong pai khinta, amah athei kei ua, atung ah a-utut un ahihzawta uhi. Huchi mah bang in Mihing Tapa in leng alak uah athuak sam ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”

paite: Huaitak in, nungzuite'n akiang ua Baptispa Johan thu gen ahi chih atheita uhi.
english: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.

paite: Huan mipi kiang ahong tun un mi khat akiang ah ahong pai a, ama a khukdin in,
english: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,

paite: "Toupa ka tapa tung ah zahngai in, amah phungzawl vei ahi a, anak thuak tel mai; tamveipi mei ah apuklut a, tamveipi tui ah leng apuk nak hi.
english: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.

paite: Na nungzuite kiang ah ka hon pi a, ahihdam thei kei uh," achi hi.
english: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”

paite: Jesu'n, "Ginna nei lou leh khang genhakte aw, bang tan ahia ka hon thuakzoh ding, amah ka kiang ah hon pi un," chi in adawng hi.
english: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n dawi atai a, asung a kipan apawt a; huai dak in naupang adamta hi.
english: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.

paite: Huai zoh in, atuam in Jesu kiang ah nungzuite ahong pai ua, "Bang achia kou delhkhe thei lou ka hi ua?" achi uhi.
english: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Na gintak louh ziak un ahi. Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, ankam tang khat bang ginna na neih uleh, hiai tang kiang ah, 'Hiai a kipan huai a pam ah va kisuan in,' na chi ding ua, akisuan mai ding; nou a ding in hihtheih louh bangmah a-om kei ding," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.

paite: Akoi abang hitaleh, hichibang zaw thumna leh an ngawlna lou ngal in apaikhe kei ding hi.
english: But this kind doesn’t go out except by prayer and fasting.”

paite: Galili gam a a-om lai un Jesu'n akiang uah, "Mihing Tapa zaw mihingte khut ah matsak in a-om ding a, athat ding ua;
english: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,

paite: ani thum ni in kaihthoh in a-om ding hi," achi a, huchi in alungkham mahmah uhi.
english: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.

paite: Kapernaum khua ahong tun un, Peter kiang ah sumkhonte ahong pai ua, "Na pu un siah pe zel lou hia?" achi uhi.
english: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”

paite: Ama'n, "Pe zel e,” achi hi. Huan insung a ava lut in, Jesu'n akiang ah, "Simon, bangchi in na ngai a? Lei a kumpipate'n siah leh leiman sumte kua a pan ahia alak zel uh? Atate ua pan hia, mituam a pan?" chi in ana gentuh hi.
english: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”

paite: Peter in, "Mituam a pan," achihtak in, Jesu'n akiang ah, "Huchi ahihleh tate awl uh ahi mai vo oi.
english: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.

paite: Himahleh nang tuipi ah va hoh inla, ngakuai diah inla, nga hong suak masapen man in, akam kek lechin dangka nih na mu ding; huaite la inla kei leh nang a ding in akiang uah pia in, huchi lou in zaw amaute i hihlungkim kei kha ding," achi hi.
english: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”

paite: Huai laitak in Jesu kiang ah hungzuite ahong pai ua, “Van lalgam ah kua athupipen dia?" achi uhi.
english: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”

paite: Huan ama'n naupang neuchik asam a; alak uah adingsak hi.
english: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them

paite: "Chihtaktak in ka hon chi ahi, na lamdan ua, naupang neuchik bang na hong hih kei uleh, van-gam ah na lut kei hial ding uh.
english: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

paite: Huchi in kuapeuh hiai naupang neuchik bang a kingainiam, huai mi van-gam ah athupipen ding," achi hi.
english: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

paite: Huan kuapeuh ka min ziak a hichibang naupang neuchik khat kipahpih keimah hon kipahpih ahi.
english: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,

paite: "Himahleh hiai hon gingta neuchikte lak a khat leng hihpuk, angawng ah buh gawizanna suang lianpi oksak in tuipi thuk lai ah khemang le uh, amah a ding in ahoihzaw ding hi.
english: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if a huge millstone were hung around his neck and that he were sunk in the depths of the sea.

paite: Puknate ziak in khovel tung agik hi, puknate bel om ding him ahi a; himahleh pukna omsakpa tung agik hi!
english: “Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!

paite: "Huan na khut hiam na khe hiam in hon hihpukleh, tankhia inla, paimang in; khut nih leh khe nih nei a tangtawn mei a paih a na om sang in, piangsual hiam khebai hiam a hinna a lut nang ding in ahoihzaw hi.
english: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.

paite: Huan na mit in hon hihpukleh khelkhia inla, paimang in; mit langnih nei a Gehenna mei a paih a om sang in, mit langkhat nei a hinna a lut nang a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
english: If your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire.

paite: "Hiai mineute lak a khat leng simmoh lou ding in pilvang un, a-angelte un van ah ka Pa van a om mel a-en gige uh chih ka hon hilh ahi.
english: See that you don’t despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.

paite: Mihing Tapa mangthangte zong ding a hong pai ahi him hi.
english: For the Son of Man came to save that which was lost.

paite: "Bangchi na sa ua? Mi kuapeuh in belam za nei henla, alak ua khat vakmang taleh sawmkua-le-kuate nusia in, tang a pai in, amang pen azong kei dia hia?
english: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, amuh nawn zenzenleh sawmkua-le-kua vakmangloute tung ah sang in, tua belam tung ah akipak zaw ding hi.
english: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.

paite: Huchi mah bang in hiai mineute lak a khat manthat na Pa uh van a om deihlam ahi kei hi.
english: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.

paite: "Huan na unau in na tung a thil ahihkhelhleh pai inla, amah leh nang kia theih in akhelhna hilh in; ahon ngaihkhiakleh na unau zou na hi ding.
english: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.

paite: Ahon ngaihkhiak keileh midang khat hiam nih hiam na kiang ah na pi dia, huchi in thu chiteng theihpihmi nih hiam thum hiam kam a hihkip a a-omtheihna ding in.
english: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

paite: Huan amau leng angaihkhiak nop kei laileh, saptuamte kiang ah tun in. Huan saptuamte leng angaihkhiak nop keileh amah tuh nang ding in Zentel leh siahkhonmi bang hi hen.
english: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.

paite: "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, leitung ah bangpeuh na hen uh, van ah hen ahi ding. Huan leitung a na phel uh, van ah leng phel ahi ding hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.

paite: "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh nawn hi. Leitung ah na lak ua mi nih athilnget ua akithutuah uleh, ka Pa van a om hihsak in a-om ding uh.
english: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.

paite: Mi nih hiam thum hiam ka min a akikhopna peuh uah alak uah ka om zel hi," achi hi.
english: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”

paite: Huai lai in Peter ahong pai a, "Toupa, ka unau in bangzah vei ahia ka tung ah hihkhialleh ka ngaihdam ding? Sagihvei tan in ahi diam?" achi hi.
english: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Sagihvei tan ka hon chi kei a, sagihvei mun sawmsagih tan," ka hon chi zaw ahi.
english: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.

paite: "Huaiziak in van-gam tuh kuahiam asikhate kiang a asum thu saifel tum toh tehpih ahi.
english: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

paite: Huchi a sum thu hon sai pattak in, mi khat talent singkhat ba akiang ah ahon pi uhi.
english: When he had begun to settle, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.

paite: Huan piak ding aneih louh ziak in, apu in amah toh, azi toh, atate toh, aneih tengteng toh zuak a dit ding thu apia hi.
english: But because he couldn’t pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

paite: Huchi in sikha in Toupa, 'ka tung ah zahngai tadih inla, avek in ka hon pe ding, chi in bokkhup in abia hi.'
english: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’

paite: Huai sikhapa pu'n ahehpih mahmah a, akhah a, abat angaidamta hi.
english: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the debt.

paite: "Himahleh huai sikha apaikhia a, asikha hihpihte lak a khat amakhai zakhat ba ava mu a; amah aman a, na bat hon pia in, chi in agawlmek hi.
english: “But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’

paite: Huchi in asikha hihpihpa'n bokkhup in, ka tung ah zahngai tadih inla, ka hon pe ding, chi in angen ngutngut hi.
english: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’

paite: Himahleh a-ut kei a; abat apiak zoh masiah suangkul ah akhumta hi.
english: He would not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay back that which was due.

paite: Huchi in asikha hihpihte'n athilhih amuh un, poi asa mahmah ua, athilhih tengteng atoupa uh ahilhta uhi.
english: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.

paite: Huaitak in atoupa'n amah asam a, akiang ah, sikha gilou, na hon nget ngutngut ziak a, na bat tengteng hon ngaidam ing a;
english: Then his lord called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.

paite: k'on hehpih bang in nang leng na sikha hihpih na hehpih sam ding hilou hia? achi hi.
english: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’

paite: Huchi in atoupa athangpaita a, abat tengteng apiak zoh masiah migawtte kiang ah apeta hi.
english: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him.

paite: Michih in na lungtangtak ua na unaute uh na ngaihdam kei uleh ka Pa van a om in leng huchi mah bang in na tung uah ahih sam ding," achi hi.
english: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n huai thute agen zoh in, Galili gam a kipan apawt a, Jordan lui gal Judia gam ah ahoh hi.
english: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.

paite: Mipi thupitak in azui ua; amaute ahihdam zel hi.
english: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.

paite: Huan Pharisaite akiang ah ahong ua, amah ze-etna ding in, "Bangziak peuh in mi'n azi mak asiang hia?" achi uhi.
english: Pharisees came to him, testing him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”

paite: Ama'n, "Atung a kipan amau bawlpa'n numei leh pasal abawlleh,
english: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,

paite: hiai ziak in pasal in anu leh apa apaisan ding a, azi alen ding.
english: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh’?

paite: Huchi in anih un sapum khat ahong hita ding uh, achi chih na sim kei ua hia? Huchi in nih ahita kei ua, sapum khat ahi zawta uhi. Huaiziak in Pathian in agawmsa mihing in khen kei hen," chi in adawng hi.
english: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”

paite: Amau bel akiang ah, "Ahihleh, bangziak a Mosi in kimakna laipiak a mak ding chi a thu pia ahia?" achi uhi.
english: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce and divorce her?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Mosi in na lungtang uh khauh ziak in ei ve na zite uh mak aphal; himahleh atung a kipan huchibang ahi ngei kei hi.
english: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.

paite: Ke'n zaw ka hon chi ahi, kuapeuh kingaihna ziak hilou a, zi ma a midang nei angkawm ahi; maksa nei peuhmah leng angkawm ahi," achi hi.
english: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”

paite: Nungzuite'n akiang ah, "Azi lam thu a pasal huchibang ahihleh kiten louh ahoihzaw," achi uhi.
english: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Huai thu ahihleh, apiaknate kia lou ngal, mi napeuh in apom thei kei ding uh.
english: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.

paite: Michilgeh, anu gilsung ua kipan huchibang a piang himte a-om ua; michilgeh, mihing khut a gehte leng a-om sam ua; michilgeh van-gam ziak a chilgeh a kibawltawmte leng a-om sam uhi. Kuapeuh apom thei in pom hen," achi hi.
english: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”

paite: Huai lai in atung ua akhut koih a, athumsak ding in, akiang ah naupang neute ahon pi ua; nungzuite'n ana tai uhi.
english: Then little children were brought to him that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n, "Naupang neute ka kiang ah hon paisak unla, kham kei un; van-gam hichibang mite a ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”

paite: Huan atung uah akhut akoih a, huai a pan in apaita hi.
english: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.

paite: Huan mi khat akiang ah ahong a, "Pu, tangtawn hinna ka neihtheihna ding in thil hoih bang ka hih ding?" achi hi.
english: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Thil hoih thu bangziak a hon dong? Hoih khat kia a-om; himahleh, hinna a na lut utleh thupiakte zui in," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Akoi pen maw?" achi hi. Jesu'n, "Tual na that ding ahi kei; Ang na kawm ding ahi kei; Na gu ding ahi kei; Na hek ding ahi kei;
english: He said to him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’

paite: Na nu leh na pa zahtak in, chihte leh nangmah na ki-it bang in na vengte na it ding ahi chih," achi hi.
english: ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’”

paite: Tangval in akiang ah, "Huaite teng ka zui zel; bang ka sam lai a?" achi hi.
english: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Hoihkim a om na utleh, pai inla, na neih tengteng zuak inla, mizawngte kiang ah pia in, huchi in van ah gou na nei ding; huan, hong pai inla, hon zui in," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”

paite: Tangval bel mihausa ahih ziak in, huai thu azak in lungkhamtak in apaimangta hi.
english: But when the young man heard this, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.

paite: Jesu'n anungzuite kiang ah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, mihausa a dia van-gam lut haksapi ahi.
english: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.

paite: Huan ka hon hilh ahi, Pathian lalgam a mihausa alut sang in phimbil a sangawngsau lutsuak abaihlamzaw," achi hi.
english: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

paite: Huan nungzuite'n huai azak un, lamdang asa mahmah ua, "Kua hotdam in a-om zou dia?" achi uhi.
english: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”

paite: Jesu'n amau a-en a, akiang uah, "Huai mihing hih vual ahi kei, Pathian a di'n bangkim hihtheih ahi," achi hi.
english: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

paite: Peter in akiang ah, "Ngai dih, kou bangkim paisan in ka hon zuita ua; bang ka mu ding ua?" chi in adong hi.
english: Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything and followed you. What then will we have?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, "Khovel thak ah, athupina tutphah a Mihing Tapa atut chiang in, nou kei hon zuite, Israel nam sawm-le-nihte tung a vaihawm in, laltutphah sawm-le-nih ah na tu sam ding uhi.
english: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

paite: Huan michih a-innte, a-unaute, asanggamnute, apa, anu, atate, agamte ka min ziak a paisan peuhmah in aleh za amu ding ua, tangtawn hinna atang ding uh.
english: Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.

paite: Himahleh mi tampi, amasapen a omte, ananungpen ah a-om ding ua; ananungpen a omte leng amasapen ah a-om ding uh," achi hi.
english: But many will be last who are first, and first who are last.

paite: Huan kumpipa Herod vaihawm lai a Judia gam a, Bethlehem a Jesu ahong pian lai in, ngai in, suahlam a kipan Jerusalem ah mipilte ahong pai uhi.
english: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,

paite: "Koi ah ahia Judate' Kumpipa ahong pian? Suahlam ah ama aksi ka mu ua, amah be dia hong pai ka hi uh," achi uhi.
english: “Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.”

paite: Kumpipa Herod in huai azak phet in alungzing a, Jerusalem tengteng leng alung uh azing sam hi.
english: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

paite: Huchi in siampu liante leh mite laigelhmi tengteng asamkhawm a, Khrist pianna ding thu adongta hi.
english: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.

paite: Huan amau akiang ah, "Judia gam a Bethlehem khua ah zawlnei in hichi in agelh akei hiam:
english: They said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,

paite: "Nang, Judia gam a Bethlehem aw, Judia khopite lak ah na neupen kei hial, na sung a kipan ukpa hong suak ding ahi ngal a, ka mi Israelte vengpa ding," chih, achi uhi.
english: ‘You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are in no way least among the princes of Judah; for out of you shall come a governor who shall shepherd my people, Israel.’”

paite: Huai nung in Herod in aguk in mipilte asam a, ngenteltak in aksi kilat lai adongkheta hi.
english: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.

paite: Huan amau Bethlehem ah apaisak a, "Paita unla, naungek thu ngenteltak in dongkhia un, ke'n leng amah ka hong biak theih samna ding in, na muh chiang un hong hilh un," achi hi.
english: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, “Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.”

paite: Huan kumpipa thu azak un apaita ua, ngai in suahlam a aksi amuh uh naungek omna tung zawn atun a akhawl masiah ama uah apai zel hi.
english: They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them until it came and stood over where the young child was.

paite: Aksi amuh un, akipak lo mahmah uhi.
english: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.

paite: Inn sung ah ava lut ua, anu Mari kiang a naungek om amuh un, abokkhup ua, abia uhi. Agoubawm uh ahong ua, akiang ah kipahna dangka-eng, begaw leh murrah alan uhi.
english: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

paite: Herod kiang a kik nawn lou ding in amang ua vauhilh a a-om ziak un, amau kholam, lam tuam ah apaita uhi.
english: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.

paite: Huan apai nung un, ngai in, Joseph kiang ah amang in Toupa angel akilak a, "Thou inla, naungek leh anu pi inla, Aigupta gam ah taipih in, ka hon hilh nawn masiah huai ah om gige in; Herod in naungek hihsiat dia zong ding ahih ziak in," achi hi.
english: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.”

paite: Huchi in athou a, azanzan in naungek leh anu api a, Aigupta gam ah apaita hi.
english: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night and departed into Egypt,

paite: Herod sih mateng huai ah a-om gige hi. Toupa'n zawlnei kam a, "Ka tapa Aigupta gam a pan ka samkhia," chi a agen ahong tuntheihna ding ahi.
english: and was there until the death of Herod, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, “Out of Egypt I called my son.”

paite: Huchih lai in Herod in mipilte' khem a om ahih lam akitheihtak in aheh mahmah a, mi asawl a, ahun laitak thu ngenteltak a mipilte adotkhiak bang in, Bethlehem khua leh akim tengteng a pasal naupang kum nih chiang nuailam avek un athatta hi.
english: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.

paite: Huchih lai in zawlnei Jeremiah in:
english: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,

paite: "Ramah ah husa aza uh, suunna, kah thawm, misi ngai a mau vengvungte, Rakil in atate akah a, a-om nawn louh ziak un akhamuan theih kei," chi a ana gen ahong tungta hi.
english: “A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn’t be comforted, because they are no more.”

paite: Himahleh Herod asih nung in, ngai in, Aigupta gam a Joseph kiang ah Toupa Angel amang in akilak hi.
english: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,

paite: "Thou inla, naungek leh anu pi inla, Israel gam ah pai in; naungek thah tumte asih tak ziak un," achi hi.
english: “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child’s life are dead.”

paite: Huchi in athou a, naungek leh anu api a, Israel gam ah apaita uhi.
english: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

paite: Himahleh Arkelaus in apa Herod sik in Judia gam ah vai ahawm chih azak in, huai lam a pai alau a; amang a vauhilh a a-om ziak in Galili gam ah apai a,
english: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,

paite: Nazaret kichi khua khat ah atengta hi. "Amah zaw Nazaret mi achi ding uh," chi a zawlneite na gen ahong tuntheihna ding in.
english: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets that he will be called a Nazarene.

paite: "Van lalgam tuh inn neipa grephuan a sem dingte chial ding a zing a pawtkhia bang ahi.
english: “For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.

paite: Ama'n nasemte toh ni khat a makhai loh dia akituahtak un agrephuan ah asawl chiat hi.
english: When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

paite: Huan dak thumna ding vel in ava pawt a, midang dawr mun a dingh maimaite amu hi.
english: He went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.

paite: Akiang uah, 'nou leng grephuan ah va pai sam ve ua, akilawm hun ka hon pe na ding,' achi hi.
english: He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you.’ So they went their way.

paite: Huchi in apaita uhi. Huan dak gukna ding leh dak kuana ding vel in ava pawt nawn a, huchi mah bang in ahih nawn hi.
english: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.

paite: Huan dak sawm-le-khatna ding in ava pawt a, midang dinghte amu a; akiang uah, 'Bangziak a nitum a hiai lai a dingh maimai na hi ua?' achi hi.
english: About the eleventh hour he went out and found others standing idle. He said to them, ‘Why do you stand here all day idle?’

paite: Amau akiang ah, 'kuamah in ahon chial louh ziak un,' achi uhi. Ama'n akiang uah, 'Nou leng grephuan ah va hoh sam un,' achi hi.
english: “They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’ “He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and you will receive whatever is right.’

paite: "Huan nitaklam ahong hih in, grephuan neipa'n asumkempa kiang ah, 'Nasemte samkhawm inla, ananungpen a kipan amasapen tan in aloh uh pia in,' achi hi.
english: “When evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.’

paite: Huan dak sawm-le-khatna ding khawng a achialte ahong uleh makhai amu chiat uhi.
english: “When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.

paite: Amasapente ahong ua, muh tam deuh akigingta ua; himahleh amau leng makhai mah amu chiat uhi.
english: When the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.

paite: Aloh uh asantak un, inn neipa tung ah aphun uhi.
english: When they received it, they murmured against the master of the household,

paite: Hiai nanungpente'n dakkal khat kia asem ua, kou sun haksa leh kho-ul thuakte toh kibang in na bawl a," chi in.
english: saying, ‘These last have spent one hour, and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat!’

paite: Ama'n bel alak ua mi khat kiang ah, "Lawm, na tung ah bangmah ka hihkhial sam a; makhai loh ding a kithukim i hi kei maw?
english: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Didn’t you agree with me for a denarius?

paite: Nang a la inla pai mai in; nang ka hon piak bangmah hiai nanungpen kiang ah ka pe nuam ahi.
english: Take that which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.

paite: Kei a hiven, ka ut-ut a ka hih asiang kei a hia? Ahihkeileh kei ka hoih ziak in nang na haza a hia?" chi in adawng hi.
english: Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’

paite: "Huchi in ananungpente, amasapente ahong hi ding ua, amasapente leng ananungpente ahong hi ding uh," achi hi.
english: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”

paite: Jerusalem a ahohtouh lai in Jesu'n anungzui sawm-le-nihte apituam a, lampi ah akiang uah,
english: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,

paite: "Ngai dih uh, Jerusalem ah i paitou dia, siampu liante leh laigelhmite khut a Mihing Tapa matsak in a-om ding a; amau si ding in atung ah thu ahihpuk ding uhi.
english: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,

paite: Nuihza bawlna dia zat ding leh kilhden ding in Zentelte kiang ah ape ding uh; huan, ani thum ni in kaihthoh in a-om ding," achi hi.
english: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.”

paite: Huai laitak in, Zebedai tapate nu, atate pi in akiang ah ahong a, amah bia in thil banghiam angen hi.
english: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.

paite: Huan ama'n akiang ah, "Bang ahia na deih?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Hiai ka tapa nihte na gam ah na taklam ah khat, na veilam ah khat atuttheihna ding un thu pia in," achi hi.
english: He said to her, “What do you want?” She said to him, “Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom.”

paite: Jesu'n, "Na nget uh thei lou hi uteh. Ka nou dawn ding na dawn thei ua hia? Ka baptisma tan ding na tang thei ding ua hia?" chi in adawng hi. Amau akiang ah, "Thei e,” achi uhi.
english: But Jesus answered, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?” They said to him, “We are able.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Ka nou na dawn ngei ding ua; ka baptisma tan ding na tang thei ding uh. Himahleh ka taklam leh ka veilam a tut ding thu zaw kei piak ding ahi kei, ka Pa bawlsakte a ding ahi zaw ding," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “You will indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with; but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give, but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father.”

paite: Huchi in sawmkhatte'n huai azak un unau nihte tung ah ahehta uhi.
english: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.

paite: Jesu'n amaute asam a, "Zentelte vaihawmte atung uah thu anei mahmah ua, amiliante un atung uah thu anei mahmah lai uh chih leng na thei uh.
english: But Jesus summoned them, and said, “You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

paite: Himahleh nou lak ah zaw huchi ahi kei ding; kuapeuh na lak ua milian hih ut na nasem un a-om zaw ding hi.
english: It shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant.

paite: Kuapeuh na lak ua masapen hih ut na nasem un a-om lai ding ahi.
english: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,

paite: Mihing Tapa nasepsak a om ding in ahong pai kei a, nasem ding leh mi tampi tatna dia ahinna pe ding a hong pai ahi zaw hi," achi hi.
english: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

paite: Jeriko a kipan apawt lai un mipi tampitak in amah azui uhi.
english: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

paite: Ngai dih, mittaw nih lam gei a tute'n Jesu ahong pai chih azak un, "Toupa, Nang David Tapa, ka tung uah zahngai in," chi in akikou uhi.
english: Behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

paite: Mipite'n dai ding in atai ua, himahleh amau, "Toupa, Nang David Tapa, ka tung uah zahngai in,” chi in akinak kou semsem uhi.
english: The multitude rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

paite: Jesu adingh a, amau asam a, "Na tung uah bang ka hih na ut ua?" achi hi.
english: Jesus stood still and called them, and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”

paite: Amaute'n akiang ah, "Mitvak ka ut uh," achi uhi.
english: They told him, “Lord, that our eyes may be opened.”

paite: Jesu'n amau ahehpih mahmah a, amit uh akhoihsak a; huchi in amu thei pah ngal ua, amah azuita uhi.
english: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.

paite: Huchi in Jerusalem khua atun ding kuan ua, Bethphage khua, Olive tang atun un Jesu'n nungzuite nih asawl a, akiang uah,
english: When they came near to Jerusalem and came to Bethsphage, to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,

paite: "Na mazawn ua khua ah va hoh unla, sabiltung khih, akiang a anou toh na mu ding ua; phel unla, ka kiang ah hon kai un.
english: saying to them, “Go into the village that is opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Untie them and bring them to me.

paite: Huan kuapeuh in na kiang ua banghiam agen uleh, 'Toupa'n adeih a ahi,' na chi ding uh; ama'n ahon sawl pah mai ding," achi hi.
english: If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and immediately he will send them.”

paite: Hiai tengteng zawlnei kam a gen ahong tuntheihna ding in ahong omta hi.
english: All this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,

paite: "En dih, na Kumpipa, thunuailuttak in, sabiltung tung ah, sabiltungnou tung ngei a tuang in na kiang ah ahong pai, chi in Zion tanu hilh in," achih.
english: “Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your King comes to you, humble, and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.”

paite: Huchi in nungzuite ava pai ua, Jesu'n akiang ua thu apiak bang ngei in ahihta uhi.
english: The disciples went and did just as Jesus commanded them,

paite: Sabiltung leh anou ahon kai ua, atung uah apuante uh aphah ua, huai ah atuangta hi.
english: and brought the donkey and the colt and laid their clothes on them; and he sat on them.

paite: Huan mipi lak a tamzaw in lampi ah apuante uh ana phah ua, midang in singsawl sat in, lampi ah aphah uhi.
english: A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.

paite: Mipi amalam a paite leh amah zuite'n, "David Tapa kiang ah Hosanna! Toupa min a hong pai ahampha hi; tungnungpen ah Hosanna!" chi in akikou uhi.
english: The multitudes who went in front of him, and those who followed, kept shouting, “Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”

paite: Jerusalem khua ahong lut in akhua in, "Hiai mi kua ahia?" chi in aling souhsouh uhi.
english: When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up, saying, “Who is this?”

paite: Mipite'n hiai mi zawlnei Jesu, Galili gam a Nazaret a ahi, achi uhi.
english: The multitudes said, “This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.”

paite: Pathian tempul ah Jesu ava lut a, tempul a zuak mite leh lei mite tengteng adelhkhia a, dangka khengte' dohkante leh vakhu zuakte tutphahte leng asawnpaihsak hi.
english: Jesus entered into the temple of God and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

paite: Akiang uah, "Ka inn thumna inn achi ding uh, chi a gelh ahi. Himahleh nou bel suamhatte khuk in na bawl zaw uh," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a den of robbers!”

paite: Huan tempul ah mittawte leh khebaite akiang ah ahong ua; amau ana hihdam hi.
english: The lame and the blind came to him in the temple, and he healed them.

paite: Himahleh siampu liante leh laigelhmite'n athillamdang hihte leh tempul a, David Tapa Hosanna; chi a naupang kikoute amuh un, alungkim kei mahmah uhi.
english: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children who were crying in the temple and saying, “Hosanna to the son of David!” they were indignant,

paite: Akiang ah, hiaite thugen na za hia? achi uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Za e, 'naungekte leh nawi ne laite kam a pawt in pahtawina na hihkimta,' chih na sim ngei kei ua hia?" achi hi.
english: and said to him, “Do you hear what these are saying?” Jesus said to them, “Yes. Did you never read, ‘Out of the mouth of children and nursing babies, you have perfected praise’?”

paite: Huan amaute apaisan a, khopi a pan pawt in, Bethani ah apai a; huai ah agiakta hi.
english: He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and camped there.

paite: Azing a khopi lam a akik nawn lai in agil hong kialta hi.
english: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.

paite: Lampi sik ah theipi kung amu a, ava naihleh anah kia lou ngal muh ding a-om kei hi. Huan akiang ah, "Tangtawn in na gah nawn ke'n," achi hi.
english: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit from you forever!” Immediately the fig tree withered away.

paite: Huchi in theipi avuai pah hi. Nungzuite'n huai amuh un, "Bangchidan ahia theipi avuai pah tel?" chi in lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
english: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree immediately wither away?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, ginna na neih ua, na ginlah kei uleh, theipi tung a hih bang phet leng na hih kei ding ua, hiai tang kiang ah na kisuan inla tuipi ah na kipailut in, chi le uchin, na chih bang un a-om mai ding hi.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it would be done.

paite: Bangpeuh gingta a thum a na nget uh na mu ding uh," chi in adawng hi.
english: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”

paite: Huan tempul alut nung a thu ahilh lai in, akiang ah siampu liante leh vantang upate ahong ua, akiang ah, "Kua thu in ahia hiai thil na hih? Kua'n thu hon pia ahia?" achi uhi.
english: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ke'n leng thu kam khat ka hon dong sam ding a, huai na hon hilh uleh, kua thu in hiam hiai thilte ka hih chih ka hon hilh sam ding hi.
english: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

paite: Johan baptisma koi a kipan ahia? Van a kipan hia, ahihkeileh mihing a kipan?" chi in adong hi. Amau akingaihtuah ua, "Van a kipan chi lehang, bangziak a amah ginglou na hi ua le?" ahon chi dia;
english: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

paite: "Mihing a kipan chi lehang, mipi i kihta ngal ua; mi tengteng in lah Johan zawlnei in apom ngal ua," achi uhi.
english: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.”

paite: Huchi in Jesu adawng ua, "Thei kei ung," achi uhi. Ama'n leng akiang uah, "Ke'n leng kua thu in ahia hiai thilte ka hih ka hon hilh sam kei ding," achi hi.
english: They answered Jesus, and said, “We don’t know.” He also said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.

paite: "Himahleh nou bangchi na sa ua? Mi kuahiam in tapa nih anei a, akhatna pen kiang ah ava hoh a, 'Tapa aw, kuan inla ka grephuan ah va sem ve,' achi hi.
english: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’

paite: Ama'n, 'Ka ut kei,' chi in adawng hi. Himahleh aden chiang in alungsim kheng in, akuanta hi.
english: He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went.

paite: Huan anihna pa kiang ah leng ava hoh a, tua bangmah in ava chi hi. Ama'n 'Pu, ka kuan ding, " chi in adawng a, himahleh akuanta kei hi.
english: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I’m going, sir,’ but he didn’t go.

paite: "Huai mi nihte akua zaw in apa uh deihlam ahih a le?" achi hi. Amaute'n, "Amasapen in," achi uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, siahkhonte leh kizuakte'n Pathian lalgam ah nou hon lutsan ding uh.
english: Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said to him, “The first.” Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into God’s Kingdom before you.

paite: Diktatna tawn in na kiang uah Johan ahong a, amah na gingta kei uh; siahkhonte leh kizuakte'n amah agingta ua; noute'n huai na muh nung un leng amah na gintakna ding un na kisik nuam tuan kei uh.
english: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him; but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn’t even repent afterward, that you might believe him.

paite: "Gentehna thudang ngaikhia un; mi kuahiam inn neitu a-om a, huai mi'n grephuan abawl a, dai in a-umsuak a, grep sukna khuk atou a, inn sang alam a; loukemte kiang ah khohloh ding a pia in gamdang ah apaita hi.
english: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a wine press in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.

paite: Huan agah loh hun in agah lakhawm ding in loukemte kiang ah asikhate asawl hi.
english: When the season for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the farmers to receive his fruit.

paite: Loukemte'n tua sikhate ana man ua, khat avua ua, khat pen that in, adang khat suang in adeng uhi.
english: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.

paite: Huai zoh in sikha dang amasa pawl sang a tamzaw asawl nawn hi. Amau tung ah leng ama ua mite ahih bangmah un ana hih nawn uhi.
english: Again, he sent other servants more than the first; and they treated them the same way.

paite: Huai nung in, 'Ka tapa azahtak kha ding uh,' chi in atapa akiang uah asawl hi.
english: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

paite: Himahleh loukemte'n atapa ana muhtak un, hiai mipa gouluah dingpa ahi; that ni in agouluah ding tansak ni, akichi uhi.
english: But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and seize his inheritance.’

paite: Huchi in amah aman ua, grephuan a kipan paikhia in athat uhi.
english: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard, then killed him.

paite: Huchi in grephuan neipa ahong pai chiang in huai loukemte tung ah bangchi in ahihta dia le?" achi hi.
english: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”

paite: Amaute'n akiang ah, “Huai migiloute haksatak in ahihmangthang ding a, grephuan loukem midang aloh hun teng a agahte akiang a pe zel dingte kiang ah khohloh ding in ape ding," achi uhi.
english: They told him, “He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers who will give him the fruit in its season.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Inn lam mite suang deih louhpen huai ngeingei aning a suang phatuampen ahong hita. Huai Toupa hih ahi, i mitmuh in alamdang ahi, chih Laisiangthoute na sim ngei kei ua hia?”
english: Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?

paite: "Huaiziak in Pathian lalgam na kiang ua kipan laksak ahi dia, namdang kiang ah agahsuah ding piak ahi ding, chih ka hon hilh ahi.
english: “Therefore I tell you, God’s Kingdom will be taken away from you and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.

paite: Huai suang tung a puk tuh akitamgawp dia; adelhkhak mi agawizan ding," achi hi.
english: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but on whomever it will fall, it will scatter him as dust.”

paite: Huan siampu liante leh Pharisaite'n agentehna thute azak un amau tungthu gen ahi chih atheita uhi.
english: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.

paite: Huchi in amah mat atum ua; himahleh mipi'n zawlnei a apom ziak un akihta uhi.
english: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.

paite: Jesu'n amaute houpih in akiang uah gentehna thu agen nawn hi,
english: Jesus answered and spoke to them again in parables, saying,

paite: "Van lalgam tuh kumpipa kuahiam atapa a dia kitenna ankuanglui toh teh ahi.
english: “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a wedding feast for his son,

paite: Huan kitenna ankuang um dia achialte sam ding in asikhate asawl a, himahleh ahong nuam kei uh.
english: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.

paite: Ama'n, ka chialte kiang ah, 'ngai dih ua, ka ankuang amanta; ka bawngtalte leh ka gan vak thaute ka gouta a, bang teng amanta hi; kitenna ankuang um ding in hong paita un,' chi un, chi in sikha dang asawl nawn hi.
english: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the wedding feast!”’

paite: Himahleh ana limsak kei ua, khat a lou ah akuan a, khat asumsinna ah apaimang hi.
english: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise;

paite: Midangte'n asikhate aman ua, zumhuaitak in abawl ua, ahihlumta uhi.
english: and the rest grabbed his servants, treated them shamefully, and killed them.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa athangpaita a; asepaihhon asawl a, tualthatte ahihmang a, akhua uh leng ahalsakta hi.
english: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.

paite: Asikhate kiang ah, 'kitenna ankuang man ahita, ka chialte ne tak ahi kei uh.
english: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.

paite: Huaiziak in lamlian ah pai unla, mi na muh peuhpeuh uh kitenna ankuang um ding in chial un,' achi hi.
english: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the wedding feast.’

paite: Huchi in huai sikhate apawt ua, lamlian a va pai in, amuh peuhmah uh migilou leh mihoihte leng apikhawm vek uhi. Huchi in michialte in kitenna dantan ahong dimta hi.
english: Those servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.

paite: "Himahleh kumpipa michialte enkhe ding a ahong lutleh kitenna puan silhloumi khat huai ah amu hi.
english: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,

paite: Huchi in akiang ah, 'Lawm, bangchidan a kitenna puan silh lou a hiai a hong lut na hia?' achi hi. Amah adai dide hi.
english: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?’ He was speechless.

paite: Kumpipa'n asikhate kiang ah, 'Akhut leh akhe gak unla, polam mial ah paikhia un; huai ah kah leh hagawi a-om ding,' achi hi.
english: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’

paite: Chialte tampi ahi ua, telte zaw tawmchik ahi uh," achi hi.
english: For many are called, but few chosen.”

paite: Huai lai in Pharisaite athugen a amattheihna ding dan akikum uhi.
english: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.

paite: Huan amau anungzuite uleh Herod pawlte akiang ah asawl ua, huai mite'n, "Sinsakpa, midiktak na hi a, diktak in Pathian thu na hilh a, kuamah deihsak tuam leh maivil tuam na nei kei chih ka thei uh.
english: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach; for you aren’t partial to anyone.

paite: Huaiziak in bangchi na sa a, hon hilh in, Kaisar kiang a siah piak asiang hia siang lou?" achi uhi.
english: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

paite: Jesu'n agitlouhdan uh ana thei a, "Lepchiahte aw, bangziak a hon ze-et na hi ua?
english: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?

paite: Na siahsum uh hon ensak un," achi hi. Huan akiang ah makhai ahon la uhi.
english: Show me the tax money.” They brought to him a denarius.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hiai kua lim leh kua min ahia?" achi hi.
english: He asked them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Kaisar a," achi uh. Ama'n akiang uah, "Huchi ahih nung Kaisar thilte Kaisar kiang ah pia unla, Pathian thilte Pathian kiang ah pia un," achi hi.
english: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

paite: Hiai thute azaktak un lamdang asa mahmah ua, amah nusia in, apaimangta uhi.
english: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him and went away.

paite: Huai ni mah in, akiang ah Saddukaite, thohnawnna a-om kei chite ahong pai ua;
english: On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,

paite: akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, Mosi in, mi ta nei lou in sileh, a-unaupa'n azi luah in a-unaupa a ding in chi akhahsak ding ahi,” achi hi.
english: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

paite: "Ahi a, koute lak ah sal sagih a-om ua; a-upapen in zi anei a, asi a, chi akhah louh ziak in a-unaupa luah ding in azi anutsiat hi.
english: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.

paite: Huchi mah bang in anihna in aluah a, athumna in aluah lai a, asagihna tan in aluah chiat uhi.
english: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.

paite: Atawp in avek ua asih nung un numei mah leng hong sita hi.
english: After them all, the woman died.

paite: Huchi in thohnawnna ah amau sagihte lak ah akua pen zi ahi dia? Avek un lah anei kha chiat ngal ua? chi in," adong uhi.
english: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Laisiangthou leh Pathian thilhihtheihna na theih louh ziak un na ngaikhial nak uhi.
english: But Jesus answered them, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.

paite: Thohnawn hun ah zi leh pasal a kitenna a-om nawn kei a, van a angelte bang ahi zawta ding uh," achi hi.
english: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.

paite: Himahleh, misi thohnawnna thu Pathian in na kiang ua agen na sim kei ua hia?
english: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,

paite: "Kei Abraham' Pathian, Isak Pathian, Jakob' Pathian ka hi, Pathian zaw misite Pathian ahi kei a, ahingte Pathian ahi zaw," chi in adawng hi.
english: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”

paite: Mipite'n huai azak un athuhilh lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
english: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.

paite: Jesu'n Saddukaite selkhia ahi chih Pharisaite'n azak un akikhawm uhi.
english: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.

paite: Huchi in alak ua dansiammi khat in, amah ze-et in thu adong hi.
english: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.

paite: "Sinsakpa, dan ah bang thupiak pen ahia thupipen?" achi hi.
english: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Toupa na Pathian tuh na lungtang tengteng, na kha tengteng, na lungsim tengteng in na it ding ahi, chih.
english: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’

paite: Huai thupiak thupipen leh poimohpen ahi.
english: This is the first and great commandment.

paite: Huan a zom in, akibatpih hiai ahi, 'Nangmah na ki-it bang in na inveng leng na it ding ahi, chih.'
english: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’

paite: Huai thupiak nihte ah dan leh zawlneite thu tengteng akikhaikhawm vek," achi hi.
english: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”

paite: Huan Pharisaite akikhop lai un Jesu'n amaute thu adong hi.
english: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,

paite: "Khrist bangchi na sa ua? Kua tapa ahia?" achi hi. Amau akiang ah, "David tapa," achi uh.
english: saying, “What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “Of David.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Bangchidan in ahia David in Kha a amah Toupa, achih?
english: He said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,

paite: "Toupa'n, ka Toupa kiang ah, 'Na melmate na khepek nuai a ka koih masiah ka taklam ah tu in,' achih?
english: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet’?

paite: David in amah Toupa, achih ngalleh, bangchi in atapa ahi dia?" achi hi.
english: “If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”

paite: Kuamah in kam khat in leng adawng thei kei ua, huai ni a kipan kuamah in thudang adong ngam nawnta kei uhi.
english: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.

paite: Jesu'n mipite leh anungzuite kiang ah thu agen hi.
english: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,

paite: “Mosi tutphah ah laigelhmite leh Pharisaite atu uhi.
english: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses’ seat.

paite: Huaiziak in ahon hilh peuhmah uh hih unla zui zel un; amau thilhih bang zaw hih tuan kei un, gen zaw agen ua, ahih tuan kei uh.
english: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.

paite: Puakgik haksatak abawl ua, mite asuan ua, amau lah akhutzung un leng akhoih nuam kei uh.
english: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.

paite: Athilhih tengteng uh mihing muh ding in ahi, ahih zawk uh, athil buh uleh akhipte uh aliansak ua, apuan mongkai uh asausak ua,
english: But they do all their works to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the fringes of their garments,

paite: ankuangluina ah mun hoihpen leh sinagogte ah tutphah hoihpen leh,
english: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,

paite: dawr mun a chibai buk leh mi'n, 'Rabbi, Rabbi,' achih bang uh adeihtuamse uhi.
english: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ by men.

paite: Nou zaw, Rabbi chih in om kei un; sinsakpa khat na nei ua, nou tengteng unaute na hi uhi.
english: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi’, for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.

paite: Huan leitung ah kuamah Pa, chi kei un; na Pa uh khat kia van a om ahi.
english: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.

paite: Heutute chih in om sam kei un, heutu khat na nei ua amah Khrist ahi.
english: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.

paite: Na lak ua thupipen na sikha ua a-om zawk ding ahi.
english: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.

paite: Kuapeuh kiliansak adai ding, kuapeuh kingaineu pahtawi in a-om ding hi.
english: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

paite: "Himahleh nou laigelhmi leh Pharisai lepchiahte aw, na tung uh agik hi; van-gam lampi mite na khaksak ngal ua; nou lah na lut ngal kei uh, mi alut dingte lut ding leng na phal kei zel uh.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.

paite: Laigelhmi leh Pharisai lepchiahte aw, na tung uh agik hi; meithai innte na negai ngal ua, thumna saupi mi khemna ding in na nei ua, huaiziak in mohna liansem na mu ding uhi.
english: “But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don’t enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.

paite: "Nou laigelhmi leh Pharisai lepchiahte aw, na tung uh agik hi; phungkai khat lel bawl ding in tuipi leh gam na pai kimvel ngal ua, huchibang a ahong omtak in, amah noumau lehnih in gawtmun ta in na bawl uhi.
english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.

paite: "Nou makai mittaw, kuapeuh tempul lou a kichiam bangmah ahi kei; kuapeuh tempul a dangka-eng lou a kichiam zaw tangtunsak ding ahi chite aw, na tung uh agik hi.
english: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’
