paite: Nou mihai leh mittawte aw; abang pen athupizaw a, dangka-eng hia, ahihkeileh dangka-eng siangthousak tempul?
english: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?

paite: Kuapeuh maitam lou a kichiam bangmah ahi kei; atung a thilpiak om lou a kichiam in atangtunsak ding ahi, na chi uh.
english: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated.’

paite: Nou mittawte aw, abang athupizaw a, thilpiak hia thilpiak siangthousak maitam?
english: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?

paite: Huchi in 'maitam lou a kichiam peuhmah zaw maitam leh atung a om tengteng lou a kichiam ahi.
english: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it and by everything on it.

paite: Huan tempul lou a kichiam peuhmah zaw tempul leh asung a tengpa lou a kichiam ahi.
english: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by him who has been living in it.

paite: Huan van lou a kichiam peuhmah leng Pathian laltutphah leh atung a tupa lou a kichiam ahi.'
english: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by him who sits on it.

paite: "Nou laigelhmi leh Pharisai lepchiahte aw, na tung uh agik hi; pudina, mohuri, zira sawm-a-khat na pia ua, dan khawkzaw, diktatna, zahngaihna, ginomna na limsak ngal kei uh; himahleh hiaite ei ve na hih ding uh, adangte hih lou tuan lou in.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

paite: Nou makai mittawte, thousi khisiang a sangawngsau nawmvalhte aw!
english: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!

paite: "Laigelhmi leh Pharisai lepchiahte aw, na tung uh agik hi; nou leh kuang polam na hihsiang ua, asung lah lepgukna leh kideklouhna in adim uhi.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.

paite: Nou Pharisai mittaw, nou leh kuang sunglam hihsiang masa un, apolam leng ahong siantheihna ding in.
english: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.

paite: "Laigelhmi leh Pharisai lepchiahte aw, na tung uh agik hi; hansuang nuhngou, polam a kilawmtak a kilang, asunglam misi guhte leh nin chiteng a dim bang na hi uh.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones and of all uncleanness.

paite: Nou leng huai bang in polam ah mihing mitmuh in diktattak in na kilang ua, na sunglam uh bel lepchiahna leh gitlouhna in na dim uhi.
english: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

paite: "Nou laigelhmi leh Pharisai lepchiahte aw, na tung uh agik hi; zawlneite han na lam ua, midiktat hante leng na zem uhi.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the tombs of the righteous,

paite: I pipute dam lai a na om hi taleng, zawlneite sisan suahna ua pang lou ding hi hang a,' na chi uhi.
english: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’

paite: Huchi in zawlneite thatte suante na hi uh chih na kitheisak uhi.
english: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.

paite: Na pipute uh hih bang in sem zom tou ngal un.
english: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.

paite: Gulte leh gul suante aw, Gehenna vaihawmna bangchi in na pel thei ding ua?
english: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?

paite: Ngai dih ua, huaiziak mah in na kiang uah, zawlneite, mipilte, laigelhmite ka hon sawl ding; khenkhat na that ding ua, kros ah na kilhden ding uh, khenkhat na sinagogte uah savun khau in na zep ding ua, kho teng ah na sawi zel ding uhi.
english: Therefore, behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,

paite: Huchi in Abel midiktattak sisan a kipan, tempul leh maitam kikal a Barak tapa Zekariah na thah uh sisan tan in, leitung a midiktat sisan na suah tengteng uh noumau tung ah ahong tung ding hi.
english: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, huai tengteng tu khang tung ah ahong tung ding hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.

paite: "Aw Jerusalem, Jerusalem, zawlneite that, na kiang ua ahon sawlte uh suang a na denglum a, akpi in anoute akha nuai a a-opkhum bang in na tate bangzah vei opkhum ka tum a, himahleh na ut kei uhi.
english: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!

paite: En un, na inn uh avuak a taisan in a-omta hi.
english: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.

paite: K'on hilh ahi, 'Toupa min a hong pai ahampha hi, na chih masiah uh tuban na hon mu nawnta kei ding uh,’ " achi hi.
english: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

paite: Tempul a kipan Jesu pawtkhia a, apai lai in, anungzuite tempul ensak ding in akiang ah hong pai uhi.
english: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.

paite: Himahleh ama'n akiang uah, "Hiai tengteng na mu uh maw? Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, hihchip louh a suang kichiang hiai ah a-om kei ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: But he answered them, “You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.”

paite: Olive tang a atut lai in nungzuite amau kia in akiang ah ahong ua, "Huaite chikchiang in ahong om dia? Na hong pai nawnna leh khovel tawpna ding chiamtehna bang ahi dia? hon hilh in," achi uhi.
english: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?”

paite: Jesu'n amau adawng a, "Kuamah hon khemzohlouhna ding in pilvang un.
english: Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

paite: Mi tampi'n, 'Khrist ka hi, chi in keimah min lou in ahong pai ding uh; mi tampi akhemzoh ding ziak un.'
english: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.

paite: Huan kidou thu leh kidou thuthang na za ding ua; na mangbatlouhna ding un pilvang un; huaite ahong om ding him ahi; himahleh tawpna zaw ahi nai tadih kei ding hi.
english: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.

paite: Nam tuam leh nam tuam akidou ding ua, gam tuam leh gam tuam akidou ding ua, mun tuamtuam ah kial ake dia, zin aling ding hi.
english: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.

paite: Huai tengteng nauvei kipatna ahi.
english: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.

paite: "Huai hun chiang in gimthuak ding in hon mansak ding ua, hon that ding uh. Ka min ziak in nam tengteng huat na hi ding uh.
english: “Then they will deliver you up to oppression and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.

paite: Huai hun chiang in mi tampi apuk ding ua, akimansaktuah ding ua, akihotuah ding uhi.
english: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.

paite: Zawlnei taklou tampi ahong pawt ding ua, mi tampi akhempuk ding uh.
english: Many false prophets will arise and will lead many astray.

paite: Huan hihkhelhna apun ding ziak in mi tamzaw itna ahong dai ding hi.
english: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.

paite: Himahleh, atawp tan a thuak ngap peuhmah, huai mi ngei hotdam in a-om ding hi.
english: But he who endures to the end will be saved.

paite: Huan hiai lalgam tanchinhoih nam tengteng theihsakna ding in khovel tengteng ah hilh in a-om ding; huai khit chiang in tawpna ahong tung ding hi.
english: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.

paite: "Huchi in hihmangbangpa kihhuai, zawlnei Daniel gen, mun siangthou a dingh na muh chiang un, asim peuhmah in a-omdan thei hen.
english: “When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),

paite: Judia gam a omte tang sang ah taimang uhen.
english: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

paite: Inn tung a om in a-inn a banghiam la ding in kum kei hen.
english: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house.

paite: Huan lou a om inn a puan la ding in kik nawn kei hen.
english: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.

paite: Huai ni'n numei gaite leh naunou pomte tung agik ding hi!
english: But woe to those who are with child and to nursing mothers in those days!

paite: Na taimang hun ding uh phalbi lai hiam, Sabbath ni hiam a ahong tunlouhna ding in thum un.
english: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter nor on a Sabbath,

paite: Huai hun chiang in gimthuakna thupi a-om ding ziak in, hichibang a thupi leilung pian tung a kipan tutan in a-om ngei nai kei a, chik mah chiang in ahong om nawn sam kei ding.
english: for then there will be great suffering, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.

paite: Huai nite hihtom hi keileh mihing dam in apawt kei ding uh; himahleh, telte ziak in huai nite hihtom ahi ding hi.
english: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be shortened.

paite: "Huai hun chiang in kuapeuh in na kiang ua, 'En dih, Khrist hiai ah hiam, huai ah hiam,' achih uleh, gingta kei un.
english: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘There!’ don’t believe it.

paite: Khrist taklou leh zawlnei takloute ahong pawt ding ziak un, huaite'n hi thei liaileh telte nangawn leng akhempuk theihna ding un chiamtehna leh thillamdang thupitakte ahih ding uhi.
english: For false christs and false prophets will arise, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

paite: Ngai un, ka hon hilhkhol khinta hi.
english: “Behold, I have told you beforehand.

paite: "Huchi in na kiang uah, 'ngai un, gamdai ah a-om' hon chih uleh, 'paikhe kei un; dantan sunggil ah a-om, hon chih uleh, taksang sam kei un'.
english: “If therefore they tell you, ‘Behold, he is in the wilderness,’ don’t go out; or ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe it.

paite: Khua, suahlam a ahong phiat a, tumlam tan a akilat zel bang in, Mihing Tapa ahong pai nawnna huchibang ahi ding hi.
english: For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

paite: "Siluang omna mun peuh ah musanete leng a-omkhawm ding uh.
english: For wherever the carcass is, that is where the vultures gather together.

paite: "Himahleh huai gimthuakna nite nung zek in, ni hihmial in a-om ding a, kha avak nawnta kei dia, van a kipan aksite ahong ke ding ua, van thilhihtheihnate hihlin in a-om ding uh.
english: “But immediately after the suffering of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;

paite: Huai hun chiang in van ah Mihing Tapa chiamtehna ahong lang ding a, huai hun chiang in leitung a nam tengteng in asuun ding ua, 'Mihing Tapa thilhihtheihna leh thupina lian toh van meipi tung a hong pai amu ding uh.'
english: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.

paite: Huan a-angelte pengkul ging thupi toh asawlkhe ding a, amau atelte lei ning lite a kipan, van tawp a kipan alehlam tawp pha in akaikhawm ding uh.
english: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.

paite: "Huchi in theipi kung ah gentehna thu zil un; ahiang ahong nou a, anah ahong sel in nipi anai chih na thei uh.
english: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable: When its branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.

paite: Huchi mah bang in nou leng huai tengteng na muh chiang un, amah ahong naita a, kongkhak bul ah a-om chih thei un.
english: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that he is near, even at the doors.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, huai tengteng atunkim masiah hiai khang amang kei ding.
english: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things are accomplished.

paite: Lei leh van amang dia, ka thu ahihleh amang kei ding hi.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

paite: "Himahleh, huai ni leh hun thu Pa kia lou ngal kuamah in, van a angelte'n leng, Tapa in leng athei kei uh.
english: “But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

paite: Noah dam lai bang in Mihing Tapa hong pai nawnna ah ahi ding.
english: As the days of Noah were, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

paite: Huai ni, tuichim tun ma in, long a Noah alut ni tan in, ane un adawn ua, zi leh pasal in akinei ua;
english: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship,

paite: tuichim ahong tung a, avek ua alakmang masiah bangmah athei kei uh; Mihing Tapa hong pai nawnna huchi mah bang ahi ding.
english: and they didn’t know until the flood came and took them all away, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

paite: Huai hun chiang in lou ah mi nih a-om ding ua; khat paimangpih in a-om dia, khat nutsiat in a-om ding.
english: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left.

paite: Numei nih buh gawinelna ah buh gawinel in a-om ding ua, khat paimangpih in a-om dia, khat nutsiat in a-om ding hi.
english: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.

paite: "Huaiziak in kiging un, bang ni'n ahia na Toupa uh ahong pai ding na theih louh ziak un.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.

paite: Himahleh, hiai thei un, guta hong pai hun ding inn neitu in theileh, aveng ding a, a-inn aphenvangsak kei ding hi.
english: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

paite: Huaiziak in nou leng kiging gige in om un, na gin louh dak ua Mihing Tapa ahong pai ding ziak in.
english: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.

paite: "Sikha muanhuai, piltak, apu'n ahun teng a atan ding uh hawmsak ding a a-inkuanpihte tung a heutu dia akoih, kua pen ahi dia le?
english: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?

paite: Apu hong pai chiang in sikha huchibang hih a amuh pen ahampha ding hi.
english: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, aneih tengteng tung ah heutu ding in akoih ding hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

paite: Himahleh sikha gilou in alungtang in, ka pu ahong zok kei ding, chi in
english: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’

paite: asikha hihpihte na vua henla, nekham-takhamte kiang ah ne in dawn taleh;
english: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,

paite: huai sikha pu agintak louh ni'n, atheih louh lai in, ahong pai ding a,
english: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,

paite: tum nih asuah ding a, milepchiahte tan bangbang atangsak ding; huai ah kah leh hagawi a-om ding hi."
english: and will cut him in pieces and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.

paite: "Huai hun chiang in van-gam tuh nungak siangthou sawm, akhawnvak uh tawi a mouneipa dawn ding a pawtte toh teh ahi ding hi.
english: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

paite: Huchi in alak ua nga ahai ua, nga apil uhi.
english: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

paite: Ahaite'n akhawnvak uh atawi ua, atui atawi kei uhi.
english: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,

paite: Apilte'n bel akhawnvakte uh tawi in, a-um ah atui leng atawi uhi.
english: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

paite: Huan mouneipa hong zekai ziak in avek un alusu ua, ana ihmuta uhi.
english: Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.

paite: "Ngai dih uh! Zan lai in, 'Mouneipa ahong e; adawn ding in hong pawt un,' chi in kikou ging ahong omta hi.
english: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’

paite: Huaitak in nungak siangthoute athou vek ua, akhawnvakte uh ahahsiang uhi.
english: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

paite: Huan ahaite'n apilte kiang ah, 'Na khawnvaktui uh hon pe sam un; ka khawnvak uh mit ding in akisa,' achi uhi.
english: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’

paite: Himahleh, apilte'n, 'Kou leh nou a ding in akiching kei ding; azuakte kiang ah pai unla, va lei zaw un,' chi in adawng uhi.
english: But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’

paite: Huan lei ding a apaimang kal un mouneipa ahong tungta a; huchi in amansate amah toh kitenna ankuang um ding in alut ua; huan, kongkhak akhakta uh.
english: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.

paite: "Huai nung in nungak siangthou dangte leng ahong tung ua, 'Toupa, toupa, hon hon in,' achi uhi.
english: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’

paite: Himahleh ama'n, 'Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, ka hon thei ngei kei,’ chi in adawng hi.
english: But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’

paite: "Huaiziak in kiging un, ani leh ahun na theih louh ziak un.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.

paite: "Van lalgam tuh mi gamdang a pai dia kisa, asikhate sam a, akiang ua asumte kemsak bang ahi.
english: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them.

paite: Sikha khat kiang ah talent nga apia a, sikha dang kiang ah talent nih apia a, sikha dang kiang ah talent khat apia a; ahihtheih hundan ding chiat ua pia in apaita hi.
english: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.

paite: Talent nga mupa huai in ava sumsin pah a, talent nga dang amukheta hi.
english: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.

paite: Huchi mah bang in talent nih mupa'n leng talent nih dang amukhia hi.
english: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.

paite: Talent khat mupa bel ava kuan a, lei atou a, apu dangka aphumgu zawta hi.
english: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord’s money.

paite: "Hun sawtpi nung in huai sikhate pu amau toh asum tungtang hihfel ding in ahong pai hi.
english: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and settled accounts with them.

paite: Talent nga mupa ahong pai a, talent nga dang ahon tawi a, 'Pu, nang talent nga na hon kemsak a; en dih, talent nga dang ka mukhia,' achi hi.
english: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.’

paite: Apu'n akiang ah, 'Sikha hoih leh muanhuai, na hihhoih hi, tawmchik tung ah na muanhuai a, tampi tung ah ka hon omsak ding; na pu kipahna ah lut in,' achi hi.
english: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

paite: "Talent nih mupa leng ahong pai a, 'Pu, nang talent nih na hon kemsak a; en dih, talent nih dang ka mukhia,' achi hi.
english: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’

paite: Apu'n akiang ah, 'Sikha hoih leh muanhuai, na hihhoih e, tawmchik tung ah na muanhuai a, tampi tung ah ka hon omsak ding; na pu kipahna ah lut in,' achi hi.
english: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

paite: "Huan talent khat mupa leng ahong pai a, 'Pu, mi chihhakpi na hi chih ka hon thei a; na tuhlouhna ah leng na at a, na thehlouhna ah leng na khawm hi.
english: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn’t sow, and gathering where you didn’t scatter.

paite: Huaiziak in ka lau a, ka va pai a, lei ah na talent ka selgu a; en in, nang a ngei na mu nawn,' achi hi.
english: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’

paite: "Apu'n akiang ah, 'Sikha gilou leh zongzaw, ka tuhlouhna ah ka at a, ka thehlouhna ah leng ka khawm chih na thei maw?
english: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.

paite: Huchi ahih ngalleh sumsinte kiang a ka dangka na koih ding hi a, huchi a ka hong pai a kei a apung toh ka muh nawn ding ahi.
english: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.

paite: Huaiziak in atalent khat laksak unla, talent sawm neipa kiang ah pia un.
english: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.

paite: Kuapeuh anei piak behlap ahi ding a, ahong hau ding; kuapeuh anei lou aneihsun nangawn laksak ahi ding.
english: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.

paite: Huan sikha phatuam lou polam mial ah paikhia un, huai ah kah leh hagawi a-om ding,' chi in adawng hi.
english: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

paite: "Himahleh, Mihing Tapa, a-angelte tengteng toh athupina a kivan a ahong pai hun chiang in, athupina laltutphah ah atu ding hi.
english: “But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.

paite: Ama ah nam chih akikhawm ding ua; belamchingpa'n kel lak a pan belamte akhenkhia bang in amaute akhenkhe ding hi.
english: Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.

paite: Belamte ataklam ah akoih ding a, aveilam ah kelte akoih ding hi.
english: He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

paite: Huai hun chiang in Kumpipa'n ataklam a mite kiang ah, 'Ka Pa deihsakte aw, hong pai un, khovel siamchil a pan nou a dia gam bawlsa luah un.
english: Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world;

paite: Ka gil akial in, nek ding na hon pia ua; ka dang atak in, dawn ding na hon pia uh; mikhual ka hih in na hon zintun ua;
english: for I was hungry and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty and you gave me drink. I was a stranger and you took me in.

paite: vuaktang ka hih in, puan na hon silhsak uh; ka chi anat a, ka kiang a na hong ziak un,' achi ding hi.
english: I was naked and you clothed me. I was sick and you visited me. I was in prison and you came to me.’

paite: "Huai hun chiang in, midiktatte'n, 'Toupa, chik in ahia gilkial a ka hon muh ua nek ding ka hon piak uh? Dangtak a ka hon muh ua, dawn ding ka hon piak uh?
english: “Then the righteous will answer him, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you a drink?

paite: Chik in ahia mikhual a ka hon muh ua, ka hon zintun ua, vuaktang a ka hon muh ua, puan ka hon silhsak uh?
english: When did we see you as a stranger and take you in, or naked and clothe you?

paite: Chik in ahia china in hiam suangkul ah hiam ka hon muh ua, na kiang a ka hong uh?' chi in adong ding uh.
english: When did we see you sick or in prison and come to you?’

paite: Kumpipa'n amaute kiang ah, 'Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, hiai ka unau neupente lak a mi khat tung a na hih uh ka tung a hih na hi uh,' chi in adawng ding hi.
english: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’

paite: "Huai khit in, aveilam a mite kiang ah leng, 'Nou hamse thuakte aw, tangtawn mei diabol leh asawltakte dia mun bawl ah hon paimangsan un;
english: Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels;

paite: Ka gil akial in, nek ding na hon pe kei ua; ka dang atak in, dawn ding na hon pe kei ua;
english: for I was hungry, and you didn’t give me food to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink;

paite: mikhual ka hih in, na hon zintun kei uh; vuaktang ka hih in, puan na hon silhsak kei ua; china leh suangkul a ka om a, na hon veh louh ziak un,' achi ding hi.
english: I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’

paite: "Huai hun chiang in amau leng, 'Toupa, chik in ahia gilkial hiam, vuaktang hiam, china hiam, suangkul ah hiam ka hon muh ua, na nna ka hon sepsak louh uh?' chi in adong ding uh.
english: “Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn’t help you?’

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, 'Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, hiai mineupente lak a mi khat tung a na hih louh uh ka tung a hih lou na hi uh' chi in adawng ding hi.
english: “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these, you didn’t do it to me.’

paite: Huan huaite tangtawn gawtna ah apai ding ua; midiktatte bel tangtawn hinna ah apai ding uhi,” achi hi.
english: These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n huai thu tengteng agen khit in, anungzuite kiang ah,
english: When Jesus had finished all these words, he said to his disciples,

paite: "Ni nih nung chiang in Paikan Ankuangluina ahong om ding chih na thei ua, Mihing Tapa kilhden ding in amansak ding uh," achi hi.
english: “You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified.”

paite: Huai lai in siampu lianpen Kaiapha achih uh huangsung ah siampu liante leh vantang upate akikhawm uhi.
english: Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas.

paite: Jesu khem a mat a, ahihlup theihna ding un akikum uhi.
english: They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit and kill him.

paite: Himahleh, "Ankuanglui ni in hi keileh, huchi lou in zaw vantang lak ah buaina ahong piang kha ding," achi uhi.
english: But they said, “Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.”

paite: Bethani khua a, miphak Simon inn a Jesu a-om lai in,
english: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

paite: numei khat alabaster bawm a thau gimlim mantam tawi in, akiang ah ahong pai a, an a-um lai in alu ah asung hi.
english: a woman came to him having an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment, and she poured it on his head as he sat at the table.

paite: Himahleh nungzuite'n huai amuh un aheh ua, "Bangziak a hichibang a hihmangthang mawkmawk ahia?
english: But when his disciples saw this, they were indignant, saying, “Why this waste?

paite: Hiai thau mantam tampi a zuak a, mizawngte kiang a piak theih ahi ngal a," achi uhi.
english: For this ointment might have been sold for much and given to the poor.”

paite: Jesu'n huai atheih in, akiang uah, "Bangziak a numei hihbuai na hi ua? Ka tung ah thil hoihtak ahih ahi.
english: However, knowing this, Jesus said to them, “Why do you trouble the woman? She has done a good work for me.

paite: Mizawngte tangtawn a na kiang ua om ahi kei hiam, kei bel tangtawn a na kiang ua om ka hi kei hi.
english: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.

paite: Hiai thau gimlim ka sa a asun, vui ding a hon bawl ding in ahih ahi.
english: For in pouring this ointment on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, khovel tengteng ah koi ah leng hiai tanchinhoih agenna peuh uah hiai numei thilhih leng amah theihgigena ding in agen zel ding uh," achi hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News is preached in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of as a memorial of her.”

paite: Huai nung in sawm-le-nihte lak a mi khat, Judas Iskariot achih uh, siampu liante kiang ah ahoh a;
english: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests

paite: "Amah hon mansak leng, bang na hon pe ding ua?" achi hi. Huchi in dangka sawmthum abuksakta uhi.
english: and said, “What are you willing to give me if I deliver him to you?” So they weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.

paite: Huai nung siah zuausan a matsakna ding hunlem azongta hi.
english: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

paite: Huan Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh ani masapen in Jesu kiang ah nungzuite ahong ua, "Paikan Ankuanglui nekna ding koi lai ah hon bawlsak le ung na ut a?" achi uhi.
english: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?”

paite: Ama'n, "Khopi ah kuahiam kiang ah hoh unla, akiang ah, 'Sinsakpa'n, ka hun anaita a; na inn ah nungzuite toh Paikan Ankuang ka um ding uh e' achi, va chi un,” achi hi.
english: He said, “Go into the city to a certain person, and tell him, ‘The Teacher says, “My time is at hand. I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.”’”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ua achih bang in nungzuite'n ahih ua; Paikan Ankuang abawlta uhi.
english: The disciples did as Jesus commanded them, and they prepared the Passover.

paite: Huai ni nitaklam in, nungzui sawm-le-nihte toh an a-um uhi.
english: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.

paite: An anek lai un, ama'n, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, na lak ua mi khat in kei ahon mansak ding,” achi hi.
english: As they were eating, he said, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

paite: Huchi in alungkham mahmah ua, akiang ah, "Toupa, kei ka hi maw?" achi chiat uhi.
english: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, “It isn’t me, is it, Lord?”

paite: Ama'n, "Ankuang hon sawkpihpa ngei in kei hon zuausan in hon mansak ding achi hi.
english: He answered, “He who dipped his hand with me in the dish will betray me.

paite: Mihing Tapa tanchin agelh bang un apai ding hi. Himahleh, Mihing Tapa mansak dingpa tung agik hi; huai mipa zaw piang keileh amah a ding in ahoihzaw ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: The Son of Man goes even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

paite: Huan amansak dingpa Judas in adong a, "Heutupa, keimah ka hi maw?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Hi e,” achi hi.
english: Judas, who betrayed him, answered, “It isn’t me, is it, Rabbi?” He said to him, “You said it.”

paite: Huan an anek lai un Jesu'n tanghou ala a, avualzawl khit in, abalkham a; nungzuite kiang ah apia a, "La unla, ne un; hiai ka pumpi ahi," achi hi.
english: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples and said, “Take, eat; this is my body.”

paite: Huai zoh in nou leng la a, kipahthu agen khit in, akiang uah apia a, "Na vek un dawn un;
english: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, “All of you drink it,

paite: hiai ka sisan a thukhun thak, khelhnate ngaihdamna dia mi tampi a dia pawt ding ahi.
english: for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.

paite: Himahleh ka hon hilh ahi, ka Pa gam a noute toh athak ka dawn ni atun masiah tuban grepgui gahtui ka dawn nawnta kei ding," achi hi.
english: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father’s Kingdom.”

paite: Huan la asak zoh un apawt ua, Olive tang ah apaita uhi.
english: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

paite: Jesu'n amau kiang ah, "Tuzan chiang in na vek un ka tungthu a lungkia in na hon taisan vek ding uh; 'Belamchingpa ka zep ding a, belamhonte adalh ding uh' chih gelh bang in.
english: Then Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’

paite: "Himahleh ka thohnawn nung in Galili gam ah na ma uah ka pai ding," achi hi.
english: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

paite: Peter in akiang ah, "Avek un na tungthu ah lungkia in om mah le uh kei zaw lungkia in ka om kei hial ding," chi in adawng hi.
english: But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, tuzan in ak khuan ma in, nang thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl ding," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”

paite: Peter in akiang ah, "Na sihna a leng si sam ding himah leng ka hon kitheihmohbawl kei hial ding," achi a. Huchibang mah in nungzuite'n leng achi chiat uhi.
english: Peter said to him, “Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you.” All of the disciples also said likewise.

paite: Huai zoh in amau toh mun khat Gethsemani achih uh atung ua; anungzuite kiang ah, "Pam a ka va thum kal in hiai ah na tu un," achi hi.
english: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and pray.”

paite: Peter leh Zebedai tapate nih api a, alungkham in ahong mangbang mahmahta hi.
english: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Ka kha alungkham mahmah a, sihna khop hial ahi; hiai ah om unla, hon venpih un," achi hi.
english: Then Jesus said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch with me.”

paite: Neukha in malam ah ava pai zek a, bokkhup in, "Ka Pa aw, ahihtheihleh hiai nou in hon pel mahmah hen; himahleh kei thu hilou in, nang thuthu hi zaw hen," chi in athum hi.
english: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

paite: Huan nungzuite kiang ah ahong pai a, amaute ihmu in ahong mu a, Peter kiang ah, "Nou dakkal khat lel leng hon hahpih zou lou na hi uh maw?
english: He came to the disciples and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?

paite: Khemna a na lutlouhna ding un kiging gige in thum un; kha in zaw angap a, sa bel ahat kei," achi hi.
english: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

paite: Nihveina ah ava pai a, athum nawn a, "Ka Pa aw, ka dawn louh a hiai nou in ahon pelh theih keileh nangmah thuthu hi hen," achi hi.
english: Again, a second time he went away and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.”

paite: Ahong pai nawn a, amaute ihmu in ahong mu nawn hi; a-ihmut uh asuah mahmah ziak in.
english: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

paite: Huan apaisan nawn a, athumveina ah agen ngei gen in athum nawn hi.
english: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.

paite: Huai khit in nungzuite kiang ah ahong pai nawn a, akiang uah, "Na ihmu lailai uh maw, na tawlnga lailai uh maw? Ngai dih uh, ahun ahong tungta, mikhialte khut ah Mihing Tapa khot khit ahita.
english: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

paite: Thou unla, pai ni, en dih uh, hon mansak dingpa ahong naita," achi hi.
english: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

paite: Huan agen lai mah in Judas, sawm-le-nihte lak a mi khat, siampu liante leh laigelhmite leh upate kiang a kipan mipi tampitak leh namsau leh khetbukte toh ahong tung hi.
english: While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

paite: Amansak ding pa'n chiamtehna ding ahilhkhol sipsip a, "Ka tawp penpen amah na man ding uh," chi in.
english: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”

paite: Huchi in Jesu ava naih a, "Chibai, Heutupa," chi in atawp hi.
english: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Lawm, na hong nangawn hih in," achi hi. Huaitak in, Jesu alen ua, amanta uh.
english: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

paite: Huan ngai dih, Jesu ompihte lak a khat in akhut zankhia in anamsau adokkhia a, siampu lianpen sikha aban a, abil abankhiaksak hi.
english: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n akiang ah, "Na namsau akoihna ah koih nawn in; namsau pan peuhmah namsau mah a asih ding ziak in.
english: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.

paite: Ka Pa ngen leng angel sangguk mun sawm-le-nih hon sawl pah ding ahi; ngen thei lou in na hon ngaihtuah ua hia?
english: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?

paite: Himahleh, ngen leng bangchi in ahia Laisiangthou in hichibang a hong om ding achihte atangtun theih ding?" achi hi.
english: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?”

paite: Huai laitak in Jesu'n mipite kiang ah, "Namsaute, khetbukte tawi in suamhat man ding bang in keimah man ding a hong pawt na hi uh maw? Tempul ah niteng in thuhilh in ka tu a, na hon man ngal kei uhi.
english: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, “Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me.

paite: Himahleh zawlnei Laisiangthou thute atunkimna dia hiai tengteng hong tungta ei ve," achi hi. Huchi in nungzui tengteng in amah anusia ua, ataimangta uhi.
english: But all this has happened that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples left him and fled.

paite: Jesu mante'n siampu lianpen Kaiapha inn a, laigelhmite leh upate omkhawmna ah amah apita uhi.
english: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.

paite: Himahleh Peter in gamlatak ah siampu lianpen huangsung tan in amah zui in ava lut a, atawpna tan thei ding in sikhate lak ah ava tu hi.
english: But Peter followed him from a distance to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.

paite: Amah ahihlup theihna ding un siampu liante leh vaihawmte tengteng in Jesu hekna ding azong uhi.
english: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him to death,

paite: Theihpih taklou tampi toh hong pai mah le uh ngohna ding bangmah amu thei kei uhi. Aden chiang in mi nih ahong pai ua,
english: and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward

paite: hiai mipa'n, "Tempul hihsia a, ni thum sung a lam nawn thei ka hi, achi,” achi uhi.
english: and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.’”

paite: Huchi in siampu lianpen adingtou a, akiang ah, "Bangmah adawng lou ding maw? Hiaite hon hekna bangchidan ahia?” achi hi.
english: The high priest stood up and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”

paite: Jesu bel adai dide hi. Huan siampu lianpen in akiang ah, "Pathian hing min in ka hon ngen ahi, Khrist, Pathian Tapa na hi hia? Hon hilh in," achi hi.
english: But Jesus stayed silent. The high priest answered him, “I adjure you by the living God that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Hi e, himahleh, ka hon hilh ahi, tunung chiang in Mihing Tapa thilhihtheihna taklam a tu a, van meipi tung a hong pai na mu ding uh," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.”

paite: Huan siampu lianpen in apuansilh abotkek a, "Pathian agenseta e! Theihpih dang bang i kiphamoh nawn dia? Ngai dih uh, Pathian agensiatdan tu in na zata uh. Bangchi na sa ua?" achi hi.
english: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.

paite: Amaute'n, "Si tak ahi," chi in adawng uhi. 67 Huan amai ah chil aphih ua, atum ua; khenkhat in akhutpek ua beng in,
english: What do you think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”

paite: "Nang Khrist, kua ahia hon tum hon hilh in?" achi uhi.
english: Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,

paite: Vaihawmna huangsung polam ah Peter atu a; nungaknou khat akiang ah ahong pai a, "Nang leng Galili gam a mi, Jesu kiang a om na hi ve," achi hi.
english: saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”

paite: Ama'n bel, "Na thugen ka thei kei," chi in avek ua ma ah akitheihmohbawl hi.
english: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, “You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!”

paite: Huan inlim a apawttak in nungak dang in amah amu a, huai a omte kiang ah, "Hiai mi Nazaret Jesu kiang a ompa ahi," achi hi.
english: But he denied it before them all, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”

paite: Peter kichiam in, "Huai mipa ka thei kha kei," chi in kitheihmohbawl nawn hi.
english: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him and said to those who were there, “This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.”

paite: Peter kichiam in, "Huai mipa ka thei kha kei," chi in kitheihmohbawl nawn hi.
english: Again he denied it with an oath, “I don’t know the man.”

paite: Huan sawt lou nung in, akiang a dinghte'n Peter kiang ah, "Nang leng alak ua mi na hi vo oi, na pau ah akithei," achi uhi.
english: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, “Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known.”

paite: Ama'n bel huai mipa ka thei kha kei, chi in hamsia kiloh in akichiamta hi. Huchi in ak akhuang pah ngal hi.
english: Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.

paite: Huan Peter in, "Jesu'n ak akhuan ma in nang thumvei na hon kitheihmohbawl ding," chi a akiang a athugen aphawkkhia a, apawtkhia a, akap huphup hi.
english: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.

paite: Huan zingsang ahong hih in siampu liante leh vantang upate tengteng Jesu that ding in atungthu ah akihou uhi.
english: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.

paite: Amah hen in api ua, gam-ukpa Pilat kiang ah api uhi.
english: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

paite: Huan amansakpa Judas in Jesu siam louh tangsak uh ahi chih atheihtak in akisik a, siampu liante leh upate kiang ah dangka sawmthum ahon tawikik hi.
english: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

paite: "Midik sisan ka khot thil ka hihkhial,” achi hi. Amau, "Huai kou a ding in bang akhawk dia? Nang na lohloh kiloh in,” achihsan uhi.
english: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”

paite: Ama'n huai dangka tempul ah apailut a, paimang in a-awklumta hi.
english: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary and departed. Then he went away and hanged himself.

paite: Huan siampu liante'n huai dangka ala ua, "Hiai sumbawm a koih asiang kei, sisan man ahi," achi uhi.
english: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”

paite: Huchi in akihou ua, mikhualte vuina ding in belvelmi mun aleita uhi.
english: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them to bury strangers in.

paite: Huaiziak in tutan in huai mun, "Sisan mun" achi uhi.
english: Therefore that field has been called “The Field of Blood” to this day.

paite: Huan zawlnei Jeremiah in ana gen, "Amah man ding a Israel suante lak a kuate hiam in asak uh dangka sawmthum alata uh;
english: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him upon whom a price had been set, whom some of the children of Israel priced,

paite: Toupa'n hon hilh bang in belvelmi mun man ding in apia uh," chih ahong tangtungta hi.
english: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”

paite: Huan gam-ukpa ma ah Jesu adingh hi. Gam-ukpa'n, "Judate' Kumpipa na hi hia?" chi in adong hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Hi e,” achi hi.
english: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said to him, “So you say.”

paite: Siampu liante leh upate'n ahek lai un bangmah in adawng kei hi.
english: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

paite: Huchi in Pilat in akiang ah, "Ahon hekna zouzai uh na za kei a hia?" achi hi.
english: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”

paite: Ama'n kam khat lel in leng adawng kei hi; huchi in gam-ukpa'n lamdang asa mahmah hi.
english: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.

paite: Huan gam-ukpa'n ankuanglui ni in henta khat, adeihdeih uh, mipite a ding in apawtsak zel hi.
english: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner whom they desired.

paite: Huai lai in henta minthang, Barabbas achih uh a-om hi.
english: They had then a notable prisoner called Barabbas.

paite: Huchi in ahong kikhop un, Pilat in akiang uah, "Kua zaw hon pawtsak leng na ut ua? Barabbas hia, Jesu Khrist kichi?" achi hi.
english: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”

paite: Hazat ziak in amah amansak uh chih athei hi.
english: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.

paite: Vaihawmna tutphah a atut lai in, azi in, "Hiai midik tung ah bangmah hih ke'n, tuni'n amah ziak in ka mang in thil tampi ka thuak hi," chi in athukhak hi.
english: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”

paite: Huan siampu liante leh upate'n, Barabbas nget a Jesu hihmanthat ding in mipite athuzoh uhi.
english: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.

paite: Gam-ukpa'n amau ahoupih a, "Amau nihte akua zaw hon pawtsak leng chi na hi ua?" achi nawn hi.
english: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”

paite: Amaute'n, "Barabbas," achi uhi. Pilat in akiang uah, "Jesu Khrist kichi, bang ka chihta dia le?" achi hi. Avek un, "Amah kilhden in om hen," achi uhi.
english: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”

paite: Ama'n, "Bang ding in maw? Bang ahihkhial a ahia?" achi hi. Himahleh amau, "Kilhden in," chi in akikou vengvung uhi.
english: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”

paite: Huchi in Pilat in bangmah ahihtheita kei a, hong buai deuhdeuh zaw ding chih akitheih in, tui ala a, mipite ma ah akhut asil a, "Hiai midik sisan ah ka siang e; noumau na lohloh uh kiloh un," achi hi.
english: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”

paite: Huan mipi tengteng in, "Asisan zaw koumau tung ah leh ka tate uh tung ah om hen," chi in adawng uhi.
english: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us and on our children!”

paite: Huai khit in Barabbas apawtsak a; Jesu azep a, kilhden ding in apeta hi.
english: Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.

paite: Huai khit in, sepaihte'n gam-ukpa inpi ah Jesu apilut ua, apawl ua mi tengteng akiang ah hong kikhawm uhi.
english: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.

paite: Apuante suahsak in, puan sandup asilhsak uhi.
english: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him.

paite: Linglukhu aphan ua, khusak in, akhut taklam in sialluang atawisak ua; ama ah akhukdin ua, "Chibai, Judate' Kumpipa," chi in nuihza bawlna in anei uhi.
english: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

paite: Huan amah achilsiat ua, sialluang laksak in alu akhen uhi.
english: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.

paite: Nuihza bawlna dia aneih khit un, puan asuahsak ua, ama puante asilhsak nawn ua, kilhden ding in apikheta uhi.
english: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.

paite: Huan apaikhiak lai un, Kurini a mi, amin Simon amu ua; huai mi ama kros po ding in aman uhi.
english: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.

paite: Golgotha mun ahong tun un, huai tuh Luguh mun chihna ahi,
english: When they came to a place called “Golgotha”, that is to say, “The place of a skull,”

paite: uain thuk, thil kha toh hel, dawn ding in apia ua, himahleh acheptak in adawn nuam kei hi.
english: they gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.

paite: Akilhden khit un, ai san in apuansilh akihawm uhi.
english: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,

paite: Huan huai ah tu in avengta uhi.
english: and they sat and watched him there.

paite: Ahekna uh, "HIAI JUDATE' KUMPIPA JESU AHI," chi a gelh, alutung ah asuang uhi.
english: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, “THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

paite: Amah toh, suamhat nih, ataklam ah khat leh aveilam ah khat akilhden uhi.
english: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.

paite: Huan mi vialvak peuh in alu uh sinkhum in,
english: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads

paite: "Nang tempul hihsia a ni thum a lam nawnpa, kihihdam in; Pathian Tapa na hihleh kros a kipan hong kumsuk tanla," chi in a-enghou uhi.
english: and saying, “You who destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”

paite: Huchi mah bang in siampu liante'n, laigelhmite toh, enghou in,
english: Likewise the chief priests also mocking with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,

paite: "Midangte hondampa, amah-le-amah kihondam theiloupi in, Israelte kumpipa ahih ngalleh tu in kros a kipan hong kumleh a kei dia, huchi in amah i gingta mai ding.
english: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.

paite: Pathian amuang na aka, amah zaw a-utleh tu in kihondamleh ake; Pathian Tapa ka hi, achi ngal a," achi uhi.
english: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”

paite: Suamhat akilhden un leng, huchi mah bang in a-enghou hi.
english: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.

paite: Huan dak gukna a kipan dak kuana tan in khua ahong mialvekta hi.
english: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.

paite: Dak kuana ding in, aw ngaihtak in, "Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakthani?" chi in Jesu akikoukhia a, huai tuh, "Ka Pathian, ka Pathian bang achia hon paisan?" chihna ahi.
english: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

paite: Akiang a dingh khenkhatte'n huai azak un, “Hiai mi'n Elijah sam ahi," achi uhi.
english: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”

paite: Alak ua mi khat kintak in atai pah a, spanji ala a, uain thuk diahdim in chiang ah asuang a, adawnsak hi.
english: Immediately one of them ran and took a sponge, filled it with vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.

paite: Midangte'n, "Ngaihsak kei un, amah lakhe ding in Elijah ahong pai hiam i en ding uh,” achi uhi.
english: The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”

paite: Jesu ngaihtak in akikou nawn a, akha akhahta hi.
english: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

paite: Huan ngai dih, tempul puanzak atunglam a kipan anuailam tan in hong keksuakta a; ziin ahong ling a, suangpite khangkham in; hante ahong kihong hi.
english: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

paite: Mi Siangthou ihmusate pumpi tampi leng kaihthoh in a-omta uhi.
english: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;

paite: Huaite athohnawn nung in, han a kipan hong pawt in kho siangthou ah alut ua, mi tampi lak ah akilakta uhi.
english: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.

paite: Huan sepaih zaheutu leh akiang a Jesu veng a omte'n, zinling leh thil omdante amuh un alau mahmah ua, "Hiai mi zaw Pathian Tapa ahi ngeingei," achi uhi.
english: Now the centurion and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the things that were done, were terrified, saying, “Truly this was the Son of God!”

paite: Huai ah, numei tampi, a-nna sepsak kawm zel a Galili gam a kipan a hon zuite a-om ua, gamlapi ah a-en uhi.
english: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.

paite: Huaite lak ah Mari Magdalin, Jakob leh Joseph nu Mari leh Zebedai tapate' nute a-om uhi.
english: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

paite: Huan nitaklam ahong hih in, Arimathai khua a mihausa, amin Joseph ahong pai a, amah leng Jesu nungzui ahi sam hi.
english: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple, came.

paite: Huai mi Pilat kiang ah ava hoh a, Jesu luang angen hi. Pilat in piak ding in thu apia hi.
english: This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.

paite: Huchi in Joseph in aluang ala a, puanmalngat siangtak in atuam hi.
english: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth

paite: Ama hankhuk thak, suang khuakkuak ah asial a; suang lianpi in hankhuk kongkhak adelh a, apaita hi.
english: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock. Then he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.

paite: Huan huai ah Mari Magdalin leh Mari dang a-om ua, hankhuk mazawn ah atu uhi.
english: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

paite: Huan azing in, huai tuh, kisakkholhna zoh ni zing ahi a, Pilat kiang ah siampu liante leh Pharisaite a-omkhawm kheukhou uhi.
english: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,

paite: "Pu, huai mikhemhat in adam lai in, ni thum nung in ka thounawn ding, achih ka theigige uhi.
english: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’

paite: Huchi in ani thum ni tanpha hankhuk venghoih ding in thu pia in; huchi lou in zaw anungzuite'n amah ava gukhe ding ua, vantang kiang ah, misi lak a kipan athounawnta achi kha ding uh; huchi in khemna nanung zaw amasa sang in ahoih kei zaw sem ding," achi uhi.
english: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”

paite: Pilat in akiang uah, "Vengmi sepaihte na nei ve ua oi; pai unla, na hihtheih bang un venghoihsakta unla," achi hi.
english: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”

paite: Huchi in vengmi sepaihte toh ava hoh ua, hankhuk avenghoihsak ua, hansuang achiamteh uhi.
english: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.

paite: Huan Sabbath ni abei in, ani sagih ni masapen ding a phalvak in, han en ding in Mari Magdalin leh Mari dang akuan uhi.
english: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

paite: Ngai dih, nakpitak in ziin ahong ling a; van a kipan Toupa angel ahong suk a, suang ahong khukkhia a, atung ah atuta hi.
english: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.

paite: Amel omdan khophia bang ahi a, apuansilhte tuh vuk bang in angou hi;
english: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

paite: Amah akihtak ziak un veng mite aling ua, misi bang in a-om hial uhi.
english: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.

paite: Angel in numeite ahoupih a, akiang uah, "Nou zaw lau kei un; akilhden uh Jesu zong na hi uh chih ka thei;
english: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

paite: hiai ah a-omta kei; agen bang ngei in athounawnta, alupna mun en un, achi hi.
english: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

paite: Pai meng unla, nungzuite kiang ah, 'Misi lak a kipan athounawnta hi. Ngai dih uh, Galili gam ah na ma uah apai; huai ah amah na mu ding uh' chi in hilh un. Ngai dih uh, ka hon hilhta ahi," achi hi.
english: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”

paite: Huan lau leh kipak mahmah kawm in, han a kipan apai mengmeng ua, anungzuite hilh ding in ataita uhi.
english: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.

paite: Huan ngai dih, Jesu'n amaute atuak a, "Chibai aw,” achi hi. Huchi in amaute'n akhepek alen ua, abia uhi.
english: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Lau kei unla, paita un, Galili gam a pai ding in ka unaute va hilh un; huai ah na hon mu ding uh, achi," chi in.
english: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”

paite: Huan apai lai un vengmi sepaih khenkhat khopi ah ava lut ua, thil omdan tengteng siampu liante kiang ah ava hilh uhi.
english: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.

paite: Upate toh akikhawm ua, akihou zoh un, sepaihte kiang ah dangka tampi apia ua,
english: When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,

paite: "Zan a ka ihmut kal un, anungzuite hong pai in, amah aguta uh, chi unla,
english: saying, “Say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept.

paite: gam-ukpa'n huai ana zakleh amah leng i khem ding ua lunghimoh lou ding in i bawl na ke,” achi uhi.
english: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”

paite: Huchi in dangka ala ua, ahilh bang un ahihta ua; huchi in tutan in huai thu Judate lak ah agenthang lai uhi.
english: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until today.

paite: Himahleh Galili gam a Jesu'n tang a sehsak ah nungzui sawm-le-khatte ahoh uhi.
english: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.

paite: Amah amuh un abia ua; khenkhat in aginglah uhi.
english: When they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.

paite: Huchi in akiang uah Jesu ahong pai a, amau ahoupih a, "Lei leh van a thuneihna tengteng ka kiang a piak ahita.
english: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

paite: Huaiziak in kuan unla, nam chih a pan nungzuite bawl unla, Pa toh, Tapa toh, Kha Siangthou toh min in baptis unla,
english: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

paite: thu ka hon piak tengteng zui ding in thuhilh un. Ngai un, kei tangtawn in, khovel tawp pha in leng, na kiang uah ka om gige hi," achi hi.
english: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.

paite: Huchih lai in Baptispa Johan in,
english: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,

paite: "Kisik un! Van-gam anaita," chi in Judia gamdai ah thu gen in ahong pai hi.
english: “Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”

paite: Amah ahi, zawlnei Isai in: "Gamdai a mi kikou aw in, Toupa lamlian sial unla, alampite tangsak un, achi," chi a ana gen pen.
english: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make the way of the Lord ready! Make his paths straight!”

paite: Johan in sangawngsau mul puan asilh a, savun kawnggak agak a, a-an khaukhup leh khuaizu ahi.
english: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel’s hair with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

paite: Huchih lai in Jerusalem khua, Judia gam tengteng, Jordan luidung kim tengteng akiang ah ahong paikhawm ua,
english: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.

paite: akhelhna uh thupha tawi in, Jordan lui ah baptisma atang uhi.
english: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.

paite: Himahleh Pharisaite leh Saddukaite tampi ama a baptisma tang ding a hong paite amuh in, akiang uah, "Nou gul suante! Thangpaihna hong tung ding taisan ding a kua'n hon thuhilh ahia?
english: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

paite: Huchi in kisikna toh kilawm gah hon suangkhia un.
english: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!

paite: Abraham ka pu uh ahi, chi in kingaihtuah kei un, Pathian in hiai suangte Abraham suante in adingsak thei ka hon chi ahi.
english: Don’t think to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father,’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.

paite: Tu a kipan in singbul teng ah heipi akoihta uh; huchi in sing chih gah hoih a gah lou peuhpeuh aphuk ua, mei ah apailut zel uhi.
english: Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.

paite: Ke'n zaw kisikna ding in tui in ka hon baptis a, himahleh, amah ka nung a hong pai kei sang in athupizaw a, akhedap tawitak leng ka hi kei, ama'n zaw Kha Siangthou leh mei in noute ahon baptis ding hi.
english: “I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.

paite: Akhut in phazah atawi a, aphual azapsiang sipsip ding a, buhpang ah abuh asung ding, asi bel mei mit thei lou in ahalmang ding,” achi hi.
english: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.”

paite: Huchih lai in akiang a baptisma tang ding in Galili gam a kipan Jordan lui ah Johan kiang ah Jesu ahong pai hi.
english: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.

paite: Johan in, "Nang kei na hon baptis kiphamohzaw hinapi, ka kiang ah na hong zosop ahi maw?" chi in akham hi.
english: But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n akiang ah, "Tu in lemsa teitei in, hichibang a diktatna tengteng hihtangtun ei a ding in akilawm ngal a," chi in adawng a, huchi in lem asata hi.
english: But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he allowed him.

paite: Huan Jesu baptisma atantak in tui a kipan apawt pah a, ngai in, amah a ding in van ahong kihong a, Pathian Kha, vakhu bang a hong suk in, atung a hong tu amu hi.
english: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.

paite: Huan ngai in, van a kipan aw in, "Hiai ka Tapa deihtak, ka kipahna mahmah ahi," achi hi.
english: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”

paite: Huai khit in diabol khem a om ding in gamdai ah Kha pilut in Jesu a-omta hi.
english: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

paite: Huan ni sawmli leh zan sawmli an angolh nung in agil hong kialta hi.
english: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.

paite: Khempa ahong pai a, akiang ah, "Pathian Tapa na hihleh hiai suangte tanghou suak ding in thu pia in," achi hi.
english: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”

paite: Himahleh ama'n, "Tanghou kia in mihing ahing kei ding, Pathian kam a thupawtte in ahing zaw ding, chih gelh ahi ngal a," chi in adawng hi.
english: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’”

paite: Huai zoh in, diabol in kho siangthou ah apilut a, Pathian tempul tungzum ah akoih a,
english: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,

paite: akiang ah, "Pathian Tapa na hihleh kikesak in; 'Na tungthu ah a-angelte thu ape ding a, akhut un ahon dom ding uh, huchi lou in zaw na khe in suang na sui kha ding,' chih gelh ahi ngal a,” achi hi.
english: and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, ‘He will command his angels concerning you,’ and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don’t dash your foot against a stone.’”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Toupa na Pathian ze-et ke'n chih gelh ahi zaw," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’”

paite: Huan diabol in tang sangtak ah api nawn a, khovel gam tengteng leh athupina a-ensak hi.
english: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.

paite: Huan akiang ah, "Bokkhup in hon bia in, hiai tengteng ka hon pe ding," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.”

paite: Huaitak in Jesu'n akiang ah, "Setan, hiai a kipan paimang in, Toupa na Pathian na biak ding, ama nna kia na sep ding ahi chih gelh ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: Then Jesus said to him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”

paite: Huai zoh in diabol in apaisanta a, ngai in, angelte'n amah nna ahong sepsak uhi.
english: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.

paite: Huan Johan aman uh chih Jesu'n azak phet in, Galili ah akihemkhia hi.
english: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.

paite: Nazaret khua apaisan a, Kapernaum ah a-om nilouh a, huai tuh Zebulun leh Naphtali uk, tuipi gei a om ahi a,
english: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,

paite: zawlnei Isai kam a thugenkholh tangtunna ding ahi:
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

paite: "Dil lam a, Jordan gal a, Zebulun gam leh Naphtali gam, Zentelte Galili gam a,
english: “The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,

paite: mial nuai a tute'n vak thupi amu ua, sihna lim nuai a tute tung ah vak ahong suakta,” chi a agen hong tuntheihna ding in.
english: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light; to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”

paite: Huai hun a kipan in Jesu'n, "Kisik un! Van lalgam anaita," chi in thu agenta hi.
english: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”

paite: Huan Galili Tuipi gei a avak kawm in, unau nih Simon Peter kichi a-unau Andru toh, tuipi ah len pai lai amu a; amaute ngamanmi ahi him uhi.
english: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hon zui un, mihing man ding in ka hon bawl ding," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”

paite: Huchi in alente uh nuse pah in amah azuita uhi.
english: They immediately left their nets and followed him.

paite: Huan huai a kipan apai zel a unau dang nih, Zebedai tapa Jakob leh a-unau Johan, apa uh Zebedai kiang a long a alente uh bawlpha in amu a; amaute asam hi.
english: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.

paite: Huchi in long leh apa uh nuse pah in amah azuita uhi.
english: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.

paite: Jesu'n asinagogte ua thu hilh in, lalgam tanchinhoih gen in, mite natna chiteng leh hatlouhna chiteng hihdam in Galili gam tengteng ah apai vialvial hi.
english: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

paite: Siria gam tengteng ah atanchin athangta a, akiang ah mi damlou tengteng damlouhna leh natna chih thuakte, dawimatte, kaih veite leh zawte ahon pi ua, ana hihdam hi.
english: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.

paite: Galili gam a kipan, Dekapolis a kipan, Jerusalem leh Judia a kipan leh Jordan gal a kipan in mipi tampitak in amah azui uhi.
english: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from beyond the Jordan followed him.

paite: Huchi in mipite amuh in tang a paitou in atu a, akiang ah anungzuite hong pai uhi.
english: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.

paite: Huan thu agen a, amaute thu ahilh hi.
english: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,

paite: "Lungsim a gentheite ahampha uh, van-gam amaute a ahi ngal a.
english: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

paite: Lungkhamte ahampha uh, khamuan a om ding ahi ngal ua.
english: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.

paite: Thunuailutte ahampha uh, leigou luah ding ahi ngal ua.
english: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.

paite: Diktatna lunggulh a gilkial leh dangtakte ahampha uh, tai ding ahi ngal ua.
english: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.

paite: Zahngaitheite ahampha uh, zahngaihna mu ding ahi ngal ua.
english: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.

paite: Lungsim a siangthoute ahampha uh, Pathian mu ding ahi ngal ua.
english: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.

paite: Lemna bawlte ahampha uh, Pathian tate chih ding ahi ngal ua.
english: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.

paite: Diktatna ziak a sawina thuakte ahampha uh, van-gam amau a ahi ngal a.
english: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

paite: "Mi'n keimah ziak a ahon tai ua, ahon sawi ua, zuau a gilou chiteng a hon hek hun chiang un, na hampha uhi.
english: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

paite: Kipak unla, nakpitak in nuam un, van ah na kipahman uh athupi ngal a; huchi mah bang in na ma ua zawlnei omte leng ana sawi zel uhi.
english: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

paite: "Lei chi na hi uh, himahleh chi peng taleh, bang in ahia ahih al nawn ding? Paihkhiak a mihingte chilgawp ding louh ngal, bangmah ding in aphatuam kei hi.
english: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.

paite: "Khovel vak na hi uh. Mual tung a khopi om selguk theih ahi kei.
english: “You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.

paite: Mi'n khawnvak de in loh nuai ah akoih ngei kei ua, akoihna ah akoih zaw uhi. Huchi in insung a om tengteng atanvak hi.
english: Neither do you light a lamp and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.

paite: Huchi mah bang in, na vak uh mite mitmuh ding in vak hen, huchi in na thil hoih hihte uh amu ding ua, na Pa uh van a om apahtawi thei ding uhi.
english: Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.

paite: "Dan hiam zawlneite thu hihmang ding a hong pai in hon ngaihtuah kei un; hihmang ding a hong pai ka hi kei a, hihtangtung ding a hong pai ka hi zaw hi.
english: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, lei leh van aman ma, avek a atunkim masiah uh dan thu a sutvom neuchik hiam, thaivom neuchik hiam, khat leng amang kei hial ding.
english: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.

paite: Huchi in kuapeuh hiai thupiak neupente lak a khat bohsia a, huai zui dia mite thuhilh peuhmah, van-gam ah mineupen akichi ding; himahleh kuapeuh zui a thuhilh behlapte, van-gam ah milian akichi ding hi.
english: Therefore, whoever shall break one of these least commandments and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.

paite: Na diktatna un laigelhmite leh Pharisaite diktatna akhup kei in zaw van-gam ah na lut kei hial ding uh chih ka hon hilh ahi.
english: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

paite: "Nidanglai a mite kiang ah, 'Tual na that ding ahi kei,' kichi leh, 'Kuapeuh tualthat vaihawmna a ding in lauhuai in a-om ding, kichi na zata uh.
