english: “You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not murder;’ and ‘Whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment.’

paite: Ke'n zaw, kuapeuh a-unau tung a heh vaihawmna a ding in lauhthawnhuaitak in a-om ding. Kuapeuh a-unau selphou vaihawmte hawmsak a om lauhthawnhuaitak in a-om ding; 'Nang mihai' chi kuapeuh Gehenna mei a paih lauhthawnhuaitak in a-om ding uh, chih ka hon hilh ahi.
english: But I tell you that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of the judgment. Whoever says to his brother, ‘Raca!’ will be in danger of the council. Whoever says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of Gehenna.

paite: Huaiziak in maitam a na thilpiak na lat lai a na unau in na tung ah lung hihlouhna anei chih na theihkhiakleh,
english: “If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,

paite: huai maitam ma a na thilpiak nusia in pai inla, na unau kilempih in, huai zoh in na thilpiak lan in.
english: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.

paite: Na langpa toh vaihawmna inn zuan a lampi a na paikhawm lai un kilempih in, huchi lou in zaw na langpa'n thukhenmi khut ah hon pe dia, thukhenmi'n mimanpa kiang ah hon pe dia; suangkul ah hon khum kha ding hi.
english: Agree with your adversary quickly while you are with him on the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, paihsa san khat nangawn na piak kim masiah huai a kipan in na pawtkhe kei hial ding hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there until you have paid the last penny.

paite: "Nidanglai mite'n 'Ang na kawm ding ahi kei' achih uh na zata uhi.
english: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery;’

paite: Himahleh ke'n zaw kuapeuh etlahna lungsim toh numei en in, alungsim in angkawm ahi chih ka hon hilh ahi.
english: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.

paite: Na mit taklam in hon hihpukleh, khelkhia inla paihmang in; na pumpi Gehenna a pai sang in na pumpi a hiang khat manthat nang a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
english: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

paite: Na khut taklam in hon hihpukleh, tankhia inla paihmang in; na pumpi a Gehenna a pai sang in, na pumpi a hiang khat manthat nang a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
english: If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

paite: "Kuapeuh zi ma in kimakna lai akiang ah pia heh, leng akichi.
english: “It was also said, ‘Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,’

paite: Ke'n zaw kuapeuh kingaihna ziak hilou a zi ma in amah angkawmsak ahi, kuapeuh maksa nei nawn angkawm ahi chih ka hon hilh ahi.
english: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.

paite: "Nidanglai in mite kiang ah, 'Zuau in kichiam ke'nla, Toupa kiang ah na kichiamnate tangtun zaw in,' akichi chih leng na zata uhi.
english: “Again you have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,’

paite: Ke'n zaw ka hon hilh ahi, chiam himhim kichiam kei un; van lou in kichiam kei un, huai Pathian laltutphah ahi ngal a; lei lou in kichiam sam kei un, huai akhe ngakna ahi.
english: but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;

paite: Jerusalem lou in kichiam sam kei un, huai Kumpipa thupitak khopi ahi.
english: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.

paite: Na lutang lou in na kichiam ding ahi sam kei, samzang khat lel leng na hihngou in, na hihvom thei ngal kei uhi.
english: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.

paite: Na thugen uh, 'Ahi, hi henla,' 'Hilou, hilou,' hi vanglak hen, akan-aval zaw gitlouhna asuak ahi.
english: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.

paite: "Mit sik in mit, ha sik in ha, akichi chih na zata uhi.
english: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’

paite: Ke'n zaw ka hon hilh ahi. Migilou nang kei un; na taklam biang bengte, alehlam leng doh zaw un.
english: But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.

paite: Kuapeuh in na lak ah thusia bawl ut in, na puanak lak atupleh, na puanza leng lasak ngal in.
english: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.

paite: Huan mel khat pai dia hon phut kiang ah mel nih pai in.
english: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.

paite: Ahon ngen kiang ah pia inla, nang lak a leitawi nuam kiheisan ke'n.
english: Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.

paite: "Na vengte it inla, na melmate hua in, akichi chih na zata uhi.
english: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’

paite: Ke'n zaw ka hon hilh ahi, na melmate uh it unla, hon sawite thumsak un.
english: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,

paite: Na Pa uh van a om tate na hihtheihna ding un. Ama'n migiloute leh mihoihte tung ah anisa asuaksak a, midiktatte leh diktatloute tung ah leng vuah azusak hi.
english: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.

paite: Nou hon itte kia na it un, kipahman bang ahia na muh ding uh? Siahkhon mite'n leng huchibang in ahih sam kei ua hia?
english: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?

paite: Huan na unaute kia uh chibai na buk un bang na hihtam tuan ua ahia? Zentelte'n leng hichibang in ahih sam kei ua hia?
english: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?

paite: Huchi in na Pa uh van a om ahoihkim sipsip bang in na hoihkim sipsip ding uh ahi."
english: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.

paite: "Na diktatna nasepte uh mite ma a, mihing mitmuh ding a hih lou ding in pilvang un; huchi lou in zaw na Pa uh van a om kiang ah kipahman na nei kei ding uh.
english: “Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.

paite: "Huchi in mi kiang a thilpiak na piak in, milepchiahte'n mite phat alohtheihna ding ua sinagogte leh kongzing a ahih nak bang un na ma uah pengkul mut kei un. Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, amaute'n apahtakman uh angahta uh.
english: Therefore, when you do merciful deeds, don’t sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

paite: Nang zaw mi kiang a thilpiak na piak in, na khut taklam in ahih na khut veilam in thei kei hen;
english: But when you do merciful deeds, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand does,

paite: na thilpiak aguk ahihtheihna ding in. Huchi in na Pa aguk a mupa'n pahtakman ahon pe ding hi.
english: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

paite: "Huan na thum chiang un milepchiahte bang in na hih ding uh ahi kei; mi'n amuhtheihna ding un, sinagogte leh kongzing kathuam laitak khawng ah dingh kawm a thum a-ut se uhi. Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, amaute'n apahtakman uh angahta uh.
english: “When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.

paite: Nang zaw na thum chiang in, na dantan sunggil a lut in, na kongkhak khak inla, na Pa aguk a om kiang ah thum in. Huchi in na Pa aguk a mupa'n pahtakman ahon pe ding hi.
english: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

paite: "Huan na thum un, Zentelte bang in gentuan mawkmawk kei un; apau tam ziak ua zak a om ding akisa uhi.
english: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.

paite: Huaiziak in amaute bang in om kei un, amah na nget ma ua na Pa un bangbang ahia na poimoh uh theigige ahi.”
english: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.

paite: Huchi in nou zaw hichibang in thum un: "Ka Pa uh van a om, na min kizahtak hen.
english: Pray like this: “‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.

paite: Na gam hong tung hen. Na deihlam van a akihih bang in, lei ah leng kihih hen.
english: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.

paite: Niteng ka nek khop uh an hon pia in.
english: Give us today our daily bread.

paite: Ka tung ua khialte ka ngaihdam bang un, nang leng ka khelhna uh hon ngaidam in.
english: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.

paite: Khemna ah hon pilut ke'nla, gilou lak ah hon hu zaw in, lalgam leh thilbawltheihna leh thupina Tangtawn a nang a ahih ziak in, Amen," chi in.
english: Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’

paite: "Mi atatleknate uh na ngaihdam uleh, na Pa uh van a om in leng hon ngaidam sam ding hi.
english: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

paite: Himahleh mite tatleknate na ngaihdam kei ngal un, na Pa un na tatleknate uh angaidam sam kei ding hi.
english: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

paite: "An na ngolh un leng, milepchiahte bang in nguimel pu kei un; amau zaw mite mitmuh a an ngawl a akilat theihna ding un, amel uh anguisak nak uhi. Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, apahtakman uh angahta uhi.
english: “Moreover when you fast, don’t be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

paite: Nou zaw, an na ngolh chiang un na lu uh sathau nilh unla, na mai uh phiat un.
english: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,

paite: Huchi in na Pa uh aguk a om mitmuh lou ngal ah mihing mitmuh in an ngawl na bang kei ding ua; huchi in na Pa uh aguk a mupa'n pahtakman ahon pe ding hi.
english: so that you are not seen by men to be fasting, but by your Father who is in secret; and your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.

paite: "Lei a, leikha leh tui-ek in aneksiatna ah, gutate'n phenvang a agukna uah gou kikhol kei un.
english: “Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal;

paite: Van ah, leikha leh tui-ek in aneksiatlouhna ah, gutate'n aphen ua aguklouhna uah, gou kikhol zaw un.
english: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal;

paite: Na gou omna peuh uah na lungtang uh leng a-om ding hi.
english: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

paite: "Pumpi khawnvak mit ahi; huchi a na mit achimleh avek in na pumpi atansuak ding hi.
english: “The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.

paite: Na mit asiatleh na pumpi avek in amial khin vek ding. Huchi in na sung a vak om pen mial hileh nak mial na tel in chia!
english: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!

paite: "Kuamah in heutu nih nna asemkop thei kei; khat hua in khat a-it ding; ahihkeileh, khat gum in khat asimmoh ding. Pathian leh sum nna na semkop thei kei ding uh.
english: “No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can’t serve both God and Mammon.

paite: "Huaiziak in ka hon hilh ahi. Bang ahia ka nek ding, bang ahia ka dawn ding, chi in na hinna thu uh leh; bang ahia ka silh ding, bang ahia ka ten ding, chi in na pumpi thu uh lunghimoh kei un. Nek ding sang in hinna athupizaw kei a hia? Silh-leten sang in pumpi leng athupizaw kei a hia?
english: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?

paite: Tungleng vasate en un; buh atuh kei ua, a-at kei uh, buh inn ah leng aseklut sam kei uh. Himahleh na Pa uh van a om in amaute avak hi. Noute amau sang a nakpitak a manphazaw hilou na hi uh maw?
english: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?

paite: Huan noute lak ah lunghihmoh ziak a kua'n ahia ama dunglam tong khat a hihsang thei tuan?
english: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?

paite: "Huan silh-le-ten thu bang ding a lunghimoh na hi ua? Gamlak lili pak khandan hoihtak in ngaihtuah un; nna asem kei ua, khau leng akhek kei uh.
english: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,

paite: Himahleh, ka hon hilh ahi, Solomon hial leng athupina tengteng a akizep in hiai lili pak khat bang in zep in a-om kei hi.
english: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.

paite: Huchi in gamlak loupa, tuni a hing a, azing a thuk a khul mai ding bawn Pathian in huchi lawmlawm a azepleh, aw nou gintawmte, silh-le-ten ding hon pe tawk na lou ding hiam?
english: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?

paite: "Huchi in bang ahia i nek ding, ahihkeileh bang ahia i dawn ding? Ahihkeileh bang silh in ahia i om ding chi in lunghimoh kei un.
english: “Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’

paite: Zentelte'n huai tengteng azong uhi. Hiaite tengteng na poimoh uh chih na Pa uh van a om in theigige ahi.
english: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.

paite: Agam leh ama diktatna zong masa un, huchi in hiaite tengteng ahon piak behlap ding hi.
english: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

paite: "Huchi in azing a ding lunghimoh kei un; azing in amah a ding akilunghimoh tawm ding ziak in. Ni khat a ding in ni khat buaina ahun lel hi.”
english: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.

paite: "Vai hawmsak kei un, vai hawmsak na hihlouhna ding un.
english: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.

paite: Na vai hawmsak mah bang un hawmsak in na om ding uh, na tehna ngei mah un hon tehsak nawn ding uh.
english: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.

paite: Huan bangziak a, nangmah mit a singtum om ngaihtuah lou a, na unau mit a ninneng neuchik mu na hia?
english: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

paite: Bangchi in na unau kiang ah, na mit a kipan huai ninneng neuchik hon lakhesak ve, na chih theih ding? Ngai in, nangmah mit mahmah ah singtum a-om nilouh ngal a.
english: Or how will you tell your brother, ‘Let me remove the speck from your eye,’ and behold, the beam is in your own eye?

paite: Milepchiah, na mit a kipan singtum lakhe masa in; huchi in na unau mit a kipan ninneng neuchik lakkhiak ding kichiantak in na mu thei ding hi.
english: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother’s eye.

paite: "Ui kiang ah thil siangthou pe kei un; vok ma ah na tuikepsuang uh pai kei un, achilse kha ding ua, huan kihei in nang ahon balzak kha ding uh.
english: “Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.

paite: "Ngen un, piak in na om ding uh; zong un, na mu ding uh; kiu un, hon honsak ding uh.
english: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.

paite: Kuapeuh angen in angah a; kuapeuh azong in amu a; akiu peuhmah honsak in a-om ding hi.
english: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

paite: Ahihleh noute kuapeuh na tapa un tanghou ngen taleh, kua'n suang pe ding na hi ua?
english: Or who is there among you who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?

paite: Ahihkeileh ngasa ngen taleh, kua'n gul pe ding na hi ua?
english: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?

paite: Huchi hileh nou migilou in bawn, na tate uh thil hoih piakdan na theih un, na Pa uh van a om in angente thil hoih pe zaw sem lou ding hia?
english: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!

paite: "Huaiziak in mi'n na tung ua thil bangpeuh hih ding a na deih bang uh, mi tung ah leng hih sam un; huai Dan leh zawlneite thu ahi him hi.
english: Therefore, whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.

paite: "Kong kochik ah lut un; manthatna a paina kong aza a, alampi leng alian a, huai a lut tam leng atam mahmah uhi.
english: “Enter in by the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter in by it.

paite: Hinna a paina kong akochik a, alampi aneu a, atawnte tawmchik ahi uh.
english: How narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life! There are few who find it.

paite: "Zawlnei takloute lak ah pilvang un, amaute belam vun silh in na kiang uah ahong pai nak ua, asunglam uh nge duhgawl pipi ahi uh.
english: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.

paite: Amaute agah uah na thei mai ding uh. Khaulingnei gui ah grep gah alou ngei ua hia? Lenling ah theipi a lou ngei ua hia?
english: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?

paite: Huchi mah bang in sing hoih peuhmah agah ahoih a; sing sia agah ase nak.
english: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit, but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.

paite: Sing hoih agah ase thei kei, sing sia agah ahoih thei sam kei hi.
english: A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.

paite: Sing chih gah hoih lou aphuk ua, mei ah apai uhi.
english: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

paite: Huaiziak in amaute agah uah na thei mai ding uhi.
english: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.

paite: "Toupa, Toupa, hon chi na peuh van-gam ah alut kei ding uh; ka Pa van a om deihlam hihte alut ding uhi.
english: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven, but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.

paite: Huai ni chiang in mi tampi'n, Toupa, na min in thute ka gen ua, na min in dawite ka delhkhia ua, na min in thillamdang tampi ka hih zel uh hilou hiam? achi ding uh.
english: Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?’

paite: Huai hun chiang in, 'Nou thil gilou hihte aw, ka hon thei ngei kei, ka kiang a kipan paimang un, chi in amaute ka hilh ding hi.'
english: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’

paite: "Huchi in michih hiai ka thu za a, zui peuhmah, mipil suangpi tung a inn lammi toh ka tehpih ding hi.
english: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock.

paite: Vuahpi hong zu in tui ahong khang a, huih ahong nung a, huai inn hon mut zialzial a; himahleh achim kei; suangpi tung a lepkip ahih ziak in.
english: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.

paite: Huan michih, hiai ka thu za a zom lou peuhmah, mihai piaunel tung a inn lammi toh ka teh ding hi.
english: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.

paite: Vuah hong zu in tui ahong khang a, huih ahong nung a, huai inn hon mut zialzial a; achimta a, huai inn anakchip ngel hi," achi hi.
english: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell—and its fall was great.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu'n huai thu agen zoh in, mipi'n athuhilh lamdang asa mahmah uh;
english: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,

paite: laigelhmite bang lou a, thuneihna neitak a amaute thu ahilh ziak in.
english: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.

paite: Huan tang a kipan a ahong paisuk nung in mipi tampitak in amah azuita uhi.
english: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

paite: Ngai in, akiang ah phak khat ahong pai a, "Toupa, na utleh na hon hihsiangthou thei hi,” chi in abia hi.
english: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

paite: Jesu'n sawk in akhoih a, "Ka ut hi, na siangthouta in," achi hi. Thakhat in phak hong siangthou pah hi.
english: Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Kuamah hilh lou ding in pilvang in, himahleh siampu kiang ah va kilak inla, Mosi in thilpiak ding achihte lan in; amau hon theihchetna ding un," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “See that you tell nobody; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”

paite: Kapernaum a lut in, akiang ah sepaih zaheutu ahong pai hi.
english: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him for help,

paite: "Toupa, inn ah ka sikha alum maimah a, nakpitak a hihnat in a-om," chi in ana ngen hi.
english: saying, “Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang ah, "Ka hong pai dia, ka hihdam ding," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”

paite: Sepaih zaheutu'n, "Toupa, ka insung na lutna tak ahi kei, thu kia gen lechin ka sikha adam mai ding.
english: The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

paite: Kei leng mi thunuai a om ka hi a, ka nuai ah sepaihte a-om ua, 'nang pai in,' ka chihleh apai zel a; midang kiang ah, 'nang hong pai in,' ka chihleh ahong pai zel; ka sikha kiang ah leng, 'hiai hih in' ka chihleh ahih zel," chi in adawng hi.
english: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and tell another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and tell my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n hiai thu azak in lamdang asa a, amah zuite kiang ah, "Chihtaktak in, ka hon hilh ahi, Israelte lak ah hichi tel a ginna thupi ka mu kei hi.
english: When Jesus heard it, he marveled and said to those who followed, “Most certainly I tell you, I haven’t found so great a faith, not even in Israel.

paite: K'on hilh ahi, suahlam leh tumlam a pan mi tampi ahong pai ding ua, van-gam ah Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang ah atu ding uh.
english: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,

paite: Gam tate zaw polam mial ah paihkhiak in a-om ding uh; huai ah kah leh hagawi a-om ding," achi hi.
english: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n sepaih zaheutu kiang ah, "Paita in, na gin bang in na tung ah tung hen," achi a, huchi in sikha adamta hi.
english: Jesus said to the centurion, “Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.” His servant was healed in that hour.

paite: Peter inn ah Jesu alut a, azi nu khosik a lum amu hi.
english: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother lying sick with a fever.

paite: Akhut akhoihsak a, akhosik adaita; athou a, a-nna asepsakta hi.
english: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. So she got up and served him.

paite: Huan nitaklam ahong hih in akiang ah dawimatte tampi ahon pi ua; thu in dawite adelhkhia a, damlou tengteng ahihdam hi.
english: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick,

paite: Zawlnei Isai in, "Amah ngei in i hatlouhnate ala a, i natnate apua," chi a agen hong tangtun theihna ding in.
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.”

paite: Jesu'n akimvel a mipi tampitak amuh in, gal khat lam a pai ding in thu apia hi.
english: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.

paite: Laigelhmi khat ahong pai a, akiang ah, "Heutupa, na paina peuh ah ka hon zui ding," achi hi.
english: A scribe came and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Sehalte'n kua anei ua, tungleng vasate'n leng bu anei uh, himahleh Mihing Tapa in zaw lungakna ding mun anei kei," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.”

paite: Huan anungzuite lak a midang khat in, "Toupa, ka pa hon vuisak phot in," achi hi.
english: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

paite: Himahleh ama'n akiang ah, "Hon zui in; misi in amau misi kivui uhen," achi hi.
english: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”

paite: Huan long sung ah alut a, anungzuite'n azui uhi.
english: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.

paite: Ngai in, tuipi ah huihpi hattak ahong nung a, huchi in tuikihot in long atumtou a; himahleh amah a-ihmu hi.
english: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves; but he was asleep.

paite: Huan akiang a hong pai in aphawng ua, "Toupa, hon hondam in, mangthang ding ka kei uhiam,” achi uhi.
english: The disciples came to him and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou ginglahte aw, bangziak a lau na hi ua?" achi hi. Huchi in athou a, huih leh tuipi atai a; huan ahong dai sipsipta hi.
english: He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.

paite: Huan mite'n lamdang asa mahmah uhi. "Hiai mi bangchidan ahia, huih leh tuipi nangawn in athu aman uh?" achi uhi.
english: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

paite: Huan gal khat lam Gadaren mite gam atun in dawimat nih, han a kipan hong pawt in, ahon tuak ua; ahang mahmah ua, huchi in huai lampi ah kuamah apai thei kei uhi.
english: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.

paite: Ngai in, amau, "Pathian Tapa kou leh nang bang ahia i kizolhna om? Hunchiam tun ma a koute hon gawt ding a hong pai na hi maw?" chi in akikou uhi.
english: Behold, they cried out, saying, “What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”

paite: Huan a-omna ua kipan gamla khop ah vokhon tampi agamta uhi.
english: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.

paite: Huan dawite'n, "N'on delhkhiak aleh huai a vokhonte sung ah hon lutsak in," chi in akiang ah nakpi in angen uhi.
english: The demons begged him, saying, “If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Pai un," achi a, huchi in ahong pawtkhia ua, vok sung ah alut ua; ngai in, vokhon tengteng tui gei ken lak ah ataisuk ua, tuipi a tailut in, tui ah amangthangta uhi.
english: He said to them, “Go!” They came out and went into the herd of pigs; and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea and died in the water.

paite: Huan ganvulte atai ua, khua ah apai ua, dawimatte tung a thil hong tungte bangkim ahilhta uhi.
english: Those who fed them fled and went away into the city and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.

paite: Ngai in, akhua in Jesu mu ding in ahong pawt ua; amah amuhtak un agam ua kipan a pawtkhe ding in nakpi in angen uhi.
english: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.

paite: Huan long ah lut in agalkah a, ama khua ahong tung hi.
english: He entered into a boat and crossed over, and came into his own city.

paite: Ngai in, mizeng khat damlou, lupna a lum ahon zawng ua; huchi in Jesu'n aginna uh mu in, zeng damloupa kiang ah, "Tapa, khamuangtak in om in, na khelhnate ngaihdam ahita," achi hi.
english: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”

paite: Ngai in, laigelhmi kuate hiam akingaihtuah ua, "Hiai mi'n Pathian agensia," achi uh.
english: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n angaihtuahte uh athei a, "Bangziak a na lungtang ua gilou ngaihtuah na hi ua? achi hi.
english: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?

paite: 'Na khelhnate ngaihdam hi hen' chih leh 'thou inla, khe in pai in, chih koi abaihlamzaw?'
english: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk’?

paite: Himahleh Mihing Tapa in leitung ah khelhnate ngaihdam theihna anei chih na theihna ding un," zeng damloupa kiang ah, "Thou in, na lupna la inla, na inn ah pai in,” achi hi.
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”

paite: Huchi in athou a, a-inn ah apaita hi.
english: He arose and departed to his house.

paite: Himahleh, mipi'n amuh un lamdang asa ua, huchibang hihtheihna mihingte kiang a pepa, Pathian apahtawita uhi.
english: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.

paite: Huai a kipan Jesu apai zel a, siah piakna mun a tu, mi khat, amin Matthai amu a; akiang ah, "Hon zui in," achi a, huchi in athou a, azuita hi.
english: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, a-inn a ankuang a-um lai in, ngai in, siahkhonte leh mikhial tampi ahong pai ua, Jesu leh anungzuite a-umpih uhi.
english: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.

paite: Pharisaite'n huai amuh un, anungzuite kiang ah, "Bangziak a na heutupa un siahkhonte leh mikhialte kiang a ne ahia?" achi uhi.
english: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n huai azaktak in, "Midamtheite'n daktor akiphamoh kei ua, midamtheiloute'n akiphamohzaw uhi.
english: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

paite: Huchi in 'kithoihna deih lou in zahngaihna ka deih hi,' chih, a-omdan va zil un, midiktatte sam dia hong pai ka hi kei a, mikhialte sam ding a hong pai ka hi zaw," achi hi.
english: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

paite: Huchih lai in akiang ah Johan nungzuite ahong pai ua, "Bangziak a kou leh Pharisaite'n an ngawl zelzel ua, na nungzuite'n ngawl lou uh ahia?" achi uhi.
english: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Moupite kiang a apasal a-om lai teng moupite'n asuun thei ua hia? Himahleh, akiang ua kipan apasal pimang nite ahong tung ding a, huai hun chiang in an angawl ding uhi.
english: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

paite: Huan kuamah in puan lui puan tui khai louh them in athuap ngei kei; athuapna in puan akaihkek ding ziak in, ahong nakkek zaw sem ding hi.
english: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.

paite: Kuamah in uain thak savun uain thawl lui ah athun ngei kei uh; huchi lou in zaw savun thawlte apuakkek dia, uain abo dia, savun thawl leng hong kise ding; huaiziak in savun uain thawl thak ah uain thak athun zaw ua, huchi in hoihtak in a-om tuaktuak hi,” achi hi.
english: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.”

paite: Huan akiang ua agen laitak in, ngai in, vaihawmpa khat ahong pai a, amah bia in, "Tu mah in ka tanu asi a; himahleh hong pai inla, atung ah na khut koih lechin ahong hing nawn ding," achi hi.
english: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”

paite: Huchi in Jesu athou a, azuita a, nungzuite'n leng azui uhi.
english: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.

paite: Ngai in, numei khat kum sawm leh kum nih sipawt damlou, anung ah hong pai a, apuan mong akhoihsak hi.
english: Behold, a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;

paite: "Apuan mongkai khoih lel leng, hihdam in ka om mai ding," alungsim in achi hi.
english: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”

paite: Huan Jesu akihei a, amah amu a, "Ka tanu, khamuangtak in om in; na ginna na dampih hi," achi hi. Huchi in numeinu huai dakkal a kipan adamta hi.
english: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.

paite: Vaihawmpa inn ah Jesu alut a, tamngai tumte leh mipi thawm ngaih vengvungte ava muh in,
english: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house and saw the flute players and the crowd in noisy disorder,

paite: "Pawt un; naupang asi kei, ihmu ahi zaw," achi hi. Amau bel amah anuihsan maimah uh.
english: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.

paite: Himahleh mipite polam a apawtsak zoh in amah alut a, naupang khut ah alen a, hong thou maimah hi.
english: But when the crowd was sent out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.

paite: Hiai tanchin huai gam tengteng ah athangkheta hi.
english: The report of this went out into all that land.

paite: Huai a kipan Jesu apai zel a, mittaw nih in, "David Tapa, ka tung uah zahngai in," chi a kikou in azui uhi.
english: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”

paite: Huan inn a alutleh akiang ah mittawte ahong pai ua; Jesu'n akiang uah, "Hiai hihthei ding in na hon gingta ua hia?" achi hi. Amaute'n akiang ah, "Gingta e, Toupa," achi uhi.
english: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They told him, “Yes, Lord.”

paite: Ama'n amit uh akhoihsak a, "Na gintak bang un na tung uah tung hen," achi hi.
english: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”

paite: Huchi in amitte uh hong vakta hi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Kuamah theih louh ding in pilvang un," achi bilbel hi.
english: Then their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”

paite: Himahleh amau apawt ua, huai gam tengteng ah atanchin agenthangta uhi.
english: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.

paite: Huai a pan apawt laitak un, ngai in, dawimat pau thei lou khat akiang ah ahon pi uhi.
english: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.

paite: Huai dawi adelhkhiaktak in pau thei lou tuh ahong pauta a; mipite'n lamdang asa mahmah ua, "Israelte lak ah hichibang akimu ngei kei hi,” achi uhi.
english: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”

paite: Pharisaite'n bel, "Dawi kumpipa ziak in ahi, dawite adelhkhiak nak," achi uh.
english: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n asinagogte ua hilh a, lalgam tanchinhoih gen in, damlouhna chiteng leh natna chiteng ahihdam a, kholian leh khoneu tengteng atawn vialvial hi.
english: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

paite: Huchi in mipite amuh in, chingtu nei lou belamte bang a gimthuak leh dalh a a-om ziak un alainat mahmah hi.
english: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.

paite: Anungzuite kiang ah, "Buh lak ding atam mahmah a, himahleh sem mite atawm uhi.
english: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.

paite: Huaiziak in abuh la dia sem dingte sawl ding in buh neipa kiang ah ngen un," achi hi.
english: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”

paite: Judah kumpipa Jotham, Ahaz leh Hezekiah vaihawm lai a Moreseth mi Mikah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung, Samaria khua leh Jerusalem kho tungtang amuh thu.
english: Yahweh’s word that came to Micah of Morasheth in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

paite: Nou, mite aw, na vek un za unla; Aw lei leh asung a om tengteng aw, ngaikhia un; Toupa PATHIAN, Toupa atempul siangthou a kipan, nou dem in na tungthu uh theihpihpa hi hen.
english: Hear, you peoples, all of you! Listen, O earth, and all that is therein. Let the Lord Yahweh be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.

paite: Ngai dih ua, TOUPA amun a kipan in ahong pawt a, ahong paisuk ding a, lei mun sangte achil ngal ding hi.
english: For behold, Yahweh comes out of his place, and will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.

paite: Mei kiangchin a khuainun bang leh munken a tui kikhohkhia bang mai in, tangte anuai ah azul ding a, munzangte akhangkham ding.
english: The mountains melt under him, and the valleys split apart like wax before the fire, like waters that are poured down a steep place.

paite: Hiai tengteng Jakobte tatlekna ziak leh Israel inkote khelhna ziak ahi. Jakobte tatlekna bang ahia oi? Samaria ahi kei maw? Judah mun sangte bang ahia? Jerusalem ahi kei maw?
english: “All this is for the disobedience of Jacob, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the disobedience of Jacob? Isn’t it Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? Aren’t they Jerusalem?

paite: Huaiziak in Samaria gam a thil sia omkhawm bang in ka bawl ding a, grephuan mun bang mai in; huai mun a suangte lui phaizang ah ka khukkhe ding a, asuangphumte ka dawksak ding hi.
english: Therefore I will make Samaria like a rubble heap of the field, like places for planting vineyards; and I will pour down its stones into the valley, and I will uncover its foundations.

paite: Amilim bawltawm tengteng sukkhap vek ahi ding a, akizuakna mante mei a halmang ahi ding a, amilim tengteng ka hihgawp ding; kizuakna man ding in ala vek ngal a, kizuakna man mah in apang nawn ding uhi.
english: All her idols will be beaten to pieces, all her temple gifts will be burned with fire, and I will destroy all her images; for of the hire of a prostitute has she gathered them, and to the hire of a prostitute shall they return.”

paite: Hiai ziak in ka kap ding a, ka mau tuaituai ding a, kisuah leh vuaktang in ka om ding; sehalte bang in ka kikou ding a, vangawngsaute bang in ka thum ding hi.
english: For this I will lament and wail. I will go stripped and naked. I will howl like the jackals and mourn like the ostriches.

paite: Aliamna hihdam theih ahi kei; Judah gam atungta ngal a; ka mite kongpi, Jerusalem hial atungta hi.
english: For her wounds are incurable; for it has come even to Judah. It reaches to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.

paite: Gath ah gen kei unla kap het kei un; Beth-le-aphrah ah leivui lak ah kikhuk un.
english: Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t weep at all. At Beth Ophrah I have rolled myself in the dust.

paite: Aw Saphir mi, vuaktang leh zumtak in paimang in; Zaanan mite Beth-ezel kahna ziak in ahong pawtkhe kei ding ua; huai a bitna mun a-om louh ziak in.
english: Pass on, inhabitant of Shaphir, in nakedness and shame. The inhabitant of Zaanan won’t come out. The wailing of Beth Ezel will take from you his protection.

paite: Maroth mi in tanhoih tan angaklah tuntun hi; TOUPA kiang a kipan thil hoih lou Jerusalem kongpi tan a ahong tunsuk ziak in.
english: For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good, because evil has come down from Yahweh to the gate of Jerusalem.

paite: Aw Lakish mi, kangtalai sakol hattak henden in; amah pen Zion tanu khelhna kipatna ahi. Israelte tatlekna nang a muh ahi.
english: Harness the chariot to the swift steed, inhabitant of Lachish. She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; for the transgressions of Israel were found in you.

paite: Huaiziak in Moreseth-gath kiang ah kikhakna thilpiak na piak ding ahi; Akzib innte Israel gam kumpipate a ding in khemna ahi ding hi.
english: Therefore you will give a parting gift to Moresheth Gath. The houses of Achzib will be a deceitful thing to the kings of Israel.

paite: Aw Maresa mi, nang hon zoutu na kiang ah ka hon pi ding; Israelte thupina Adullam pha in ahong pai ding hi.
english: I will yet bring a conqueror to you, inhabitants of Mareshah. The glory of Israel will come to Adullam.

paite: Kimetgiau inla, na ta deihtakte ziak in kimetgiau in; musane bang in kihihgiau semsem in; na kiang a kipan sal a pi in a-omta uhi.
english: Shave your heads, and cut off your hair for the children of your delight. Enlarge your baldness like the vulture, for they have gone into captivity from you!

paite: Alupna tung ua thulimlouhna gelmi leh thil hoih lou ngaihtuahkhemi tung agik hi; zingsang a khua avak in huai ahih zel uhi.
english: Woe to those who devise iniquity and work evil on their beds! When the morning is light, they practice it, because it is in the power of their hand.

paite: Miloute eng in alaksak ua; innte a-eng ua, alaksak zel uhi; mi leh a-inkote uh mi leh agoutan un anuaisiah uhi.
english: They covet fields and seize them, and houses, then take them away. They oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'n hichi in achi: “Ngai dih, hiai inko tung ah thil hoih lou ka gel ahi, huai a kipan in na ngawng uh na suan kei ding ua, kisatheitak in apai nawn kei ding uh; hun hoih lou ahih ding ziak in.
english: Therefore Yahweh says: “Behold, I am planning against these people a disaster, from which you will not remove your necks, neither will you walk haughtily, for it is an evil time.

paite: Huai ni chiang in noute dem in gentehna abawl ding ua, kahla khasiathuai a sam in; "Suksiat in i om vekta ua, ka mite thil tan akilamdangta; kei kipan gam lakmang ahi a; helhatmi kiang ah i lou uh hawmzak ahita," achi ding uhi.
english: In that day they will take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, saying, ‘We are utterly ruined! My people’s possession is divided up. Indeed he takes it from me and assigns our fields to traitors!’”

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA mite kikhawmte lak ah aisan a khau a tehsak mi kuamah na nei kei ding uhi.
english: Therefore you will have no one who divides the land by lot in Yahweh’s assembly.

paite: Thu gen kei un, chi in agen zel ua, hiai mite kiang ah thu agen kei ding uh; gensiatna adai kei ding hi.
english: “Don’t prophesy!”—they prophesy— “Don’t prophesy about these things. Disgrace won’t overtake us.”

paite: Aw Jakob inkote aw, TOUPA kha nehden in a-om a hia? Hiaite athilhih chih ding ahi maw? Diktak a om zel mi tung ah ka thute'n thil hoih ahih kei maw?
english: Shall it be said, O house of Jacob, “Is Yahweh’s Spirit angry? Are these his doings? Don’t my words do good to him who walks blamelessly?”

paite: Himahleh ka mite tunai chin in melma bang in ahong dingkhia uhi; kidou ding lungsim a nei lou, muangtak a vialvakte lak a kipan in apuansilh puanaktualte uh na suahsak uhi.
english: But lately my people have risen up as an enemy. You strip the robe and clothing from those who pass by without a care, returning from battle.

paite: Ka mi numeite a-inn nuamtak ua kipan na delhkhia ua; anaupang neute a kipan ka thupina alamang den uhi.
english: You drive the women of my people out from their pleasant houses; from their young children you take away my blessing forever.

paite: Thou unla, paimang un; hiai khawlna mun ding ahi kei a; siatna thupitak tan ahi, buahna a-om ziak in.
english: Arise, and depart! For this is not your resting place, because of uncleanness that destroys, even with a grievous destruction.

paite: Mi kuahiam in kha a om chi a zuauthu gen in, "Uain leh zu na taina ding uh ahi," chi in hong gen taleh huai mi, mipite zaknop lel thugen zawlnei ahi ding hi.
english: If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood lies, saying, “I will prophesy to you of wine and of strong drink,” he would be the prophet of this people.

paite: Aw Jakobte, na vek un ka hon samkhawm ding a; Israel khosuak-sunte ka pikhawm ding a; Bozrah khua belam bang a koihkhawm ding; ganhonte aloupa mun ua om bang in, mipi ahih ziak un achiak zuazua ding uh.
english: I will surely assemble all of you, Jacob. I will surely gather the remnant of Israel. I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as a flock in the middle of their pasture. They will swarm with people.

paite: Ama uah lampi phuvangpa apai a; aphu pailet ua, kongkhak pha in apai zel ua, huai ah apaikhia uhi; akumpipa uh ama uah apai a, TOUPA'N ama uh akai hi.
english: He who breaks open the way goes up before them. They break through the gate, and go out. Their king passes on before them, with Yahweh at their head.

paite: Aw nou Jakob heutute leh Israel inkote vaihawmte aw: Ngaikhia unla, ka hon ngen hi ka chi ahi; vaihawmdan na theih ding uh hilou hia?
english: I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?

paite: Thil hoih na hua ua, thil hoih lou na it ua, avun uh na hawksak ua, aguh ua kipan in sa na leukhia uh.
english: You who hate the good, and love the evil; who tear off their skin, and their flesh from off their bones;

paite: Ka mite sa ne in; avun uh na lip ua, aguh uh na hihtansak ua; ahi, sa uina bel sung a sa atnen bang in huan ding in na atnen uhi.
english: who also eat the flesh of my people, and peel their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as meat within the cauldron.

paite: Huai hun chiang in TOUPA asam ding ua, himahleh amau adawng kei ding; ahi, huai hun chiang in athilhih ua ahihhoih louhdan bang un, amau a kipan amai asel ding hi.
english: Then they will cry to Yahweh, but he will not answer them. Yes, he will hide his face from them at that time, because they made their deeds evil.”

paite: Ka mite thil hihkhialsak mi, nek ding banghiam piak a a-om chiang ua, "Muanna" chi a kikou a, huai bang peloute peuhmah kidouna thu a vaulau zawlneite tungtang thu TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: Yahweh says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray—for those who feed their teeth, they proclaim, “Peace!” and whoever doesn’t provide for their mouths, they prepare war against him:

paite: "Huaiziak in kilakna na neihlouhna ding un noute kiang zan hong tung hi; aisan na bawl theihlouhna ding un na kiang uah mialna ahong om ding a; zawlneite a ding in ni atum ding a, amau tung ah sun amial ding hi.
english: “Therefore night is over you, with no vision, and it is dark to you, that you may not divine; and the sun will go down on the prophets, and the day will be black over them.

paite: Mutheite azum ding ua, aisan siamte azahlak ding uh, avek un amuk uh ahum ding uh; Pathian in adawn louh ziak in."
english: The seers shall be disappointed, and the diviners confounded. Yes, they shall all cover their lips, for there is no answer from God.”

paite: Himahleh Jakob kiang ah atatlekna uh theisak ding leh Israelte kiang ah akhelhna uh theisak ding in TOUPA kha ziak athilhihtheihnate, vaihawmnate, hatnate in ka dim hi.
english: But as for me, I am full of power by Yahweh’s Spirit, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Jacob his disobedience, and to Israel his sin.

paite: Nou Jakob inkote heutute leh Israel inkote vaihawmmi, vaihawmna kih a, dikna chiteng lumlet mite aw, hiai ngaikhia un, ka hon ngen ahi.
english: Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and pervert all equity,

paite: Sisan in Zion leh ginatlouhna in Jerusalem alam uh.
english: who build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

paite: Huai ah heutute'n kipahman lamen in vai ahawm ua, siampute'n loh lamen in asinsak ua, azawlneite'n dangka lamen in ai asan uhi; huchi in leng, TOUPA alak uah a-om kei a hia? I tung uah thil hoih lou ahong tung kei ding, chi in TOUPA tung ah akinga uhi.
english: Her leaders judge for bribes, and her priests teach for a price, and her prophets tell fortunes for money; yet they lean on Yahweh, and say, “Isn’t Yahweh among us? No disaster will come on us.”

paite: Huaiziak in Zion, noute ziak in, lou bang a leileh ahi ding a, Jerusalem thilsia omkhawm ahi ding a, tang a inn omna gammang bang ahi ding.
english: Therefore Zion for your sake will be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps of rubble, and the mountain of the temple like the high places of a forest.

paite: Himahleh ni nanung chiang in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA' inn omna tang, tang lian tungte hihkip in a-om ding a, mualte tung ah tawisang in a-om ding; huai ah tawisang in a-om ding; huai ah chichihte apai zungzung ding uh.
english: But in the latter days, it will happen that the mountain of Yahweh’s temple will be established on the top of the mountains, and it will be exalted above the hills; and peoples will stream to it.

paite: Nam tampite apai ding ua, hong unla, TOUPA tang ah, Jakob' Pathian inn ah i hohtou ding uh; huchi in ama'n alampi tanchinte hon sinsak ding a, alampite ah i pai ding ua, achi ding uh; Zion a kipan dan thu ahong pawt ding a. TOUPA thu bel Jerusalem a kipan in ahong pawt ding hi.
english: Many nations will go and say, “Come! Let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law will go out of Zion, and Yahweh’s word from Jerusalem;

paite: Ama'n chi tampi lak ah vai ahawm ding a, gamlapi a nam hattak leng asal ding; anamsaute uh leilehna mukzum ding in asek ding ua, ateipite uh theikung attanna temkawi ding in asek ding uh; namdang in namdang tung ah namsau alikta kei ding a, kidoudan leng asinsakta kei ding uh.
english: and he will judge between many peoples, and will decide concerning strong nations afar off. They will beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not lift up sword against nation, neither will they learn war any more.

paite: Michihte agrepgui nuai uah leh atheipi kung nuai uah atu ding ua; kuamah in alausak kei ding uh; Sepaihte' TOUPA kam in agenta ngal a.
english: But every man will sit under his vine and under his fig tree. No one will make them afraid, for the mouth of Yahweh of Armies has spoken.

paite: Mi chih amau pathian min chiat in a-om ding ua, ei leng TOUPA i Pathian min in tangtawn tangtawn in i om ding hi.
english: Indeed all the nations may walk in the name of their gods, but we will walk in the name of Yahweh our God forever and ever.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Huai ni chiang in khebaite ka kaikhawm ding a, delhmang a om leh sukgim a omte ka kaikhawm ding," chi in.
english: “In that day,” says Yahweh, “I will assemble that which is lame, and I will gather that which is driven away, and that which I have afflicted;

paite: Akhosuaksunte ka khosuaksak ding a, gamlapi a delhmang a omte bel nam hattak in ka bawl ding; tuban siah Zion tang ah tangtawn in TOUPA'N atung uah vai ahawmta ding hi.
english: and I will make that which was lame a remnant, and that which was cast far off a strong nation: and Yahweh will reign over them on Mount Zion from then on, even forever.”

paite: Aw nang, ganchinna insang, Zion tanu tenna bitna tang, na kiang ah lalgam masa ahong tung ding; ahi, Jerusalem tanu kiang ngei ah lalgam ahong tung ding hi.
english: You, tower of the flock, the hill of the daughter of Zion, to you it will come. Yes, the former dominion will come, the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.

paite: Bang achia hichi nak kah na hia? Na sung ah kumpipa a-om kei a hia, nang hon gensakpa amangthangta a hia, numei nauvei bang a lunggimna in nang ahon mat?
english: Now why do you cry out aloud? Is there no king in you? Has your counselor perished, that pains have taken hold of you as of a woman in travail?

paite: Aw Zion tanu, numei nauvei suak ding bang in natna thuak in vei in; khopi a kipan in na pawtkhe ding a, gam ah na teng ding a, Babulon tanpha a pai ding na hi ngal a, huai ah hotkhiak in na om ding a, huai ah na melmate khut a kipan TOUPA'N nang ahon hunkhe ding hi.
english: Be in pain, and labor to give birth, daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now you will go out of the city, and will dwell in the field, and will come even to Babylon. There you will be rescued. There Yahweh will redeem you from the hand of your enemies.

paite: Tu in tampi nang hon dou in akikhawm ua, hihbuai in om henla, i mit in Zion tung a alunggulhpen mu hen, achi uhi.
english: Now many nations have assembled against you, that say, “Let her be defiled, and let our eye gloat over Zion.”

paite: Himahleh TOUPA ngaihtuahnate athei kei ua, aphatsakna leng atheisiam sam kei uh; phual a buhphal koihkhawm bang in amau akaikhawmta ngal a.
english: But they don’t know the thoughts of Yahweh, neither do they understand his counsel; for he has gathered them like the sheaves to the threshing floor.

paite: Aw Zion tanu, thou inla chil in; sik bang in na kii ka bawl ding a, dal bang in na khepek ka bawl ding; huan mi tampite na satnen ding a; athil neihte uh TOUPA a dia na koihtuam ding ahi, asum uh lei kumpi TOUPA a ding in akoihtuam ding uhi.
english: Arise and thresh, daughter of Zion, for I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hoofs bronze. You will beat in pieces many peoples. I will devote their gain to Yahweh, and their substance to the Lord of the whole earth.

paite: Aw sepaihhonte' tanu, tu in sepaih hon kaikhawm inla; amau ahon umsuakta ua; Israelte vaihawmpa abiang ah sikchiang in asun ding uhi.
english: Now you shall gather yourself in troops, daughter of troops. He has laid siege against us. They will strike the judge of Israel with a rod on the cheek.

paite: Himahleh nang, Bethlehem Ephratha aw, Judah gam a sang tampi lak a tel ding in neu tawk lechin leng, nang a kipan in Israelte vaihawmpa ding kei a ding in ahong pawt ding; ahong pawtna sawtpi, tang lai nite a kipan ahi.
english: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me who is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings out are from of old, from ancient times.

paite: Huaiziak in nauveimi'n asuahsak mateng amau alehngatsan ding; huchi in a-unau khosuaksunte Israel suante kiang ah akik nawn ding uhi.
english: Therefore he will abandon them until the time that she who is in labor gives birth. Then the rest of his brothers will return to the children of Israel.

paite: Amah adingh dia, TOUPA a Pathian min thupina ngei in; amaute a-omta ding ua; amah lah lei tawp pha in athupi ding hi.
english: He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of Yahweh, in the majesty of the name of Yahweh his God. They will live, for then he will be great to the ends of the earth.

paite: Huan hiai mi kilemna ahi ding; Assuria mi agam ua ahong a, i kumpipa uh innte ahon sik chiang in, amah dou ding in belampu sagih leh mithupi giat i kitelkhe ding uhi.
english: He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land and when he marches through our fortresses, then we will raise against him seven shepherds, and eight leaders of men.

paite: Assuria gam namsau in ahihse ding ua, Nimrod gam a lutna ahihse lai ding uh; huan ama'n, i gam ua Assuria mi hong pai a, i gam chiang uh ahong sik hun chiang in, amah a kipan in ahon hunkhe ding hi.
english: They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in its gates. He will deliver us from the Assyrian, when he invades our land, and when he marches within our border.

paite: Jakob mi khosuaksunte chi tampi lak ah TOUPA a kipan a daitui kia bang leh loupa tung a vuahzu bang in a-om ding uh; huai in mihing angak kei a, mihing tapate angak sam kei hi.
english: The remnant of Jacob will be among many peoples like dew from Yahweh, like showers on the grass, that don’t wait for man nor wait for the sons of men.

paite: Jakob khosuaksunte namte lak ah leh chi tampite lak ah gamnuai sate lak a humpinelkai bang leh belamhon lak a humpinelkai lun lai bang in a-om ding; ama'n apaisuak peuhmahte asikden a, abotnen a, humbit ding leng kuamah a-om kei uh.
english: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, among many peoples, like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep; who, if he goes through, treads down and tears in pieces, and there is no one to deliver.

paite: Na khut nang hon doute tung ah lik in om henla, na melma tengteng hihman in om hen.
english: Let your hand be lifted up above your adversaries, and let all of your enemies be cut off.

paite: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N achi, nang a kipan in na sakolte ka hihmang ding a, na kangtalaite ka hihse ding;
english: “It will happen in that day”, says Yahweh, “that I will cut off your horses from among you and will destroy your chariots.

paite: na khopite ka hihmang ding a, na kulhhat tengteng ka hihchim ding;
english: I will cut off the cities of your land and will tear down all your strongholds.

paite: na khut a kipan bumsiamte ka hihmang ding a; aisan siamte ka hihmang ding; aisan siamte na nei nawnta kei ding hi;
english: I will destroy witchcraft from your hand. You shall have no soothsayers.

paite: nang a kipan na milim bawltawmte leh na suangphuhte ka hihmang ding a; na khutsuakte na be nawn kei ding hi.
english: I will cut off your engraved images and your pillars from among you; and you shall no more worship the work of your hands.

paite: Nang a kipan Asherahte ka botkhe ding a; na khopite ka hihse ding hi.
english: I will uproot your Asherah poles from among you; and I will destroy your cities.

paite: Huan thu ngaikhe lou namte tung ah hehna leh thangpaihna in phulakna ka pichingsak ding hi.
english: I will execute vengeance in anger and wrath on the nations that didn’t listen.”

paite: Tu in TOUPA thugen ngaikhia un: Thou inla, tangte ma ah lang in, mualte'n na aw ngaikhia uhen,
english: Listen now to what Yahweh says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.

paite: Aw tangte aw, TOUPA hon hekna ngaikhia unla, nou leitung kingaknate aw, ngaikhia un; TOUPA amite toh akilang a, Israelte ahekna agen ding hi.
english: Hear, you mountains, Yahweh’s indictment, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for Yahweh has a case against his people, and he will contend with Israel.

paite: Aw ka mite aw, na tung uah bang ka hihta a ahia? Bang lam in ahia ka hon hihgim? Hon gen dih ua.
english: My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me!

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan in nou ka hon pikhia a, saltanna inn a pan nou ka hon tankhia a; na ma uah Mosi, Aaron leh Miriam ka sawl hi.
english: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

paite: Aw ka mite aw, TOUPA thilhih diktat na theihna ding un, Moab kumpipa Balak thusawm leh Boer tapa Balaam in adawndan, Sittim a kipan a Gilgal pha a thil omdante khawng tu in theigige un.
english: My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of Yahweh.”

paite: Bang toh ahia TOUPA ma a ka hong pai ding a, Pathian tungnung ma a ka kun ding? Haltum thillatte, bawngnou kum khat a upate toh ama ah ka hong pai dia hia?
english: How shall I come before Yahweh, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?

paite: TOUPA belamtal sang tampi hiam sathau lui singkhatte hiam ah alungkim dia hia? Ka tatlekna ziak in ka tachil pia in, ka khelhna ziak in pumpi gah ka pe dia hia?
english: Will Yahweh be pleased with thousands of rams? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

paite: Aw mihing, ahoih nang ahon ensakta hi; TOUPA'N nang ahon phut bang ahia? Diktak a hih leh zahngaihna it leh na Pathian toh kiniamkhiaktak a tonkhawm ahi kei maw?
english: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

paite: TOUPA'N khopi asam hi, pilna nei mi'n na min laudan asiam ding; khetbuk leh aseppa limsak un.
english: Yahweh’s voice calls to the city— and wisdom fears your name— “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.

paite: Migilou insung ah gitlouhna a kaihkhawm goubawmte leh tehna diklou kihhuaitak a-om lai hia?
english: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah that is accursed?

paite: Bukna diklou zangte leh khemna dia gikdan tehna diklou zangte siangthou ka chi ding a hia?
english: Shall I tolerate dishonest scales, and a bag of deceitful weights?

paite: Huai a mihausate lah hiamgamna in adim ua, huai a tengte'n zuau agen ua, akamsung ua alei uh khemhat ahi.
english: Her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their speech.

paite: Huaiziak in ke'n leng nakpi a hon limsak in ka hon khen a; na khelhna ziak in ka hon hihgam hi.
english: Therefore I also have struck you with a grievous wound. I have made you desolate because of your sins.

paite: Na ne ding a, himahleh na tai kei ding; na kiang ah na daina a-om ding a; na khol ding a, himahleh abit kei ding; na kholsate namsau kiang ah paimangpih ding in ka pe ding hi.
english: You shall eat, but not be satisfied. Your hunger will be within you. You will store up, but not save, and that which you save I will give up to the sword.

paite: Na tuh ding a, himahleh na la kei ding; olive gahte na chil ding a, himahleh athau na nilh kei ding; grep chil mah lechin, a-uain na dawn kei ding.
english: You will sow, but won’t reap. You will tread the olives, but won’t anoint yourself with oil; and crush grapes, but won’t drink the wine.

paite: Omri dan thusehte lah na vom gige ngal a, Ahab inkuan thuhilhna tengteng zui in amau lemtheihna ah na pai uhi; huchi in mun gamgawp in ka hon bawl sinta, na sung a tengte simmoh thuak in soisak in a-om ding uhi.
english: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of Ahab’s house. You walk in their counsels, that I may make you a ruin, and your inhabitants a hissing. You will bear the reproach of my people.”

paite: Ka tung gik hina mai e! Nipithei sekkhawm hun lai a om bang leh grep loh hun lai a grep maih loh ding bang ka hi ngal a; gahbom nek ding a-om kei; ka hinna in theipi min masa alunggulh hi.
english: Misery is mine! Indeed, I am like one who gathers the summer fruits, as gleanings of the vineyard. There is no cluster of grapes to eat. My soul desires to eat the early fig.

paite: Pathian limsakmi lei a kipan amang ua, mihing lak ah midiktak a-om kei uh; sisan suah ding in atang vek ua; michih in amau unau len in agem uhi.
english: The godly man has perished out of the earth, and there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; every man hunts his brother with a net.

paite: Akhutte uh thil hoih lou tung a thanuamtak a hih ding in anga ua; kumpipa'n thilpiak angiat a, vaihawmpa'n anegu a; milian in alungsim thilhihkhelhna agenkhia a; huai in akithutuak uhi.
english: Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe. The powerful man dictates the evil desire of his soul. Thus they conspire together.

paite: Alak ua mihoihpen loulingnei bang ahi a; midikpen leng dailing nei sang in ahoih kei zaw; nang veng mite ni, veh a na om ni ngei ahong tung hi; huai tuh amangbat ni uh ahi ding hi.
english: The best of them is like a brier. The most upright is worse than a thorn hedge. The day of your watchmen, even your visitation, has come; now is the time of their confusion.

paite: Lawm ah muang kei unla, makaimi ah ginna koih kei un; na angsung a omnu a kipan in na kam kongkhakte veng in.
english: Don’t trust in a neighbor. Don’t put confidence in a friend. With the woman lying in your embrace, be careful of the words of your mouth!

paite: Tapa in pa min ahihsia a, tanu in anu adou a, mou in api adou ngal a; mihing melmate zaw amah inkote mah ahi uh.
english: For the son dishonors the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.

paite: Huaiziak in ke'n zaw TOUPA lam ka en ding a; ka hotdamna Pathian ka ngak ding; ka Pathian in ahon ngaikhe ding hi.
english: But as for me, I will look to Yahweh. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.

paite: Aw ka melma, ka puk hun chiang in hon awi ke'n; ka thounawn ding; mial a ka tut in leng TOUPA kei a ding in vak ahi ding hi.
english: Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, Yahweh will be a light to me.

paite: TOUPA tung a thil ka hihkhelh ziak in, alung hihlouhna mahmah ka po ding, ka tungthu ahon genpih a, kei a dia vaihawmna atangtun masiah; vak ah ahon pikhe ding a, huan diktatna ka mu ding hi.
english: I will bear the indignation of Yahweh, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case and executes judgment for me. He will bring me out to the light. I will see his righteousness.

paite: Huchi in ka melma ka kiang a, TOUPA na Pathian koi ah, chipa'n huai amu ding a, zahlakna'n amah atuam ding hi. Ka mite'n amah a-en ding ua; tu'n zaw kongzing buannawi bang a sikden ahita ding hi.
english: Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, “Where is Yahweh your God?” My eyes will see her. Now she will be trodden down like the mire of the streets.

paite: Na kulhbaangte bawlna ni ding leh na gamgi kekletna ni ahong tung ding hi.
english: A day to build your walls! In that day, he will extend your boundary.

paite: Huai ni chiang in Assuria gam leh Aigupta khopi a kipan, Aigupta leh Lui pha hial a kipan, tuipi leh tuipi kikal a kipan leh tang leh tang kikal a kipan na kiang ah ahong pai ding uhi.
english: In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and mountain to mountain.

paite: Huchipi in gam, asung a tengte ziak leh athilhih uh gah ziak in hihgam ahi ding hi.
english: Yet the land will be desolate because of those who dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.

paite: Karmel tangkal a gamnuai a lungzuangtak a om na goutan belamhon, na mite na khetbuk zang in vak inla; nidanglai bang in Bashan leh Gilead ah vak in om chiat uhen.
english: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your heritage, who dwell by themselves in a forest. Let them feed in the middle of fertile pasture land, in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan a na paikhiak lai bang in akiang ah thillamdang mahmahte ka ensak ding hi.
english: “As in the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt, I will show them marvelous things.”

paite: Namte'n huai amu ding ua, athilhihtheihna tengteng uh azumpih ding uh; amuk uh ahum ding ua, abil uh angong ding hi.
english: The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might. They will lay their hand on their mouth. Their ears will be deaf.

paite: Gul bang in leivui aliak ding ua; bokkhup a vakte bang in a-omna kua ua kipan in ling kawm in ahong pai ding uh; TOUPA i Pathian kiang ah laudan siam kawm in ahong pai ding ua, nang ziak in alau ding uhi.
english: They will lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth, they will come trembling out of their dens. They will come with fear to Yahweh our God, and will be afraid because of you.

paite: Nang bang a thulimlouhna ngaidampa leh agoutan khosuaksun tatlekna nelhsiah Pathian kua a-om a? Ahehna tangtawn in avom gige kei; zahngaihna a akipah mahmah ziak in.
english: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.

paite: Akiheikik nawn ding a, i tung ah hehpihna anei ding; akhenuai ah i thulimlouhnate asikden ding a; nang amaute khelhna tengteng tuipi taw thukpi ah na pailut ding hi.
english: He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot. You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

paite: Nidanglai a ka pu leh pate kiang a na kichiamsa, Jakob kiang ah thutak leh Abraham kiang ah zahngaihna na tangtun ding hi.
english: You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.

paite: Nineveh kho puakgik. Elkosh mi Nahum kilakna bu,
english: A revelation about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

paite: TOUPA zaw mullit hat Pathian leh phulak ching ahi; TOUPA'N phu ala a, hehna in adim hi; TOUPA'N amah dou mite tung ah phu ala a, amelmate a ding in hehna akholkhawm hi.
english: Yahweh is a jealous God and avenges. Yahweh avenges and is full of wrath. Yahweh takes vengeance on his adversaries, and he maintains wrath against his enemies.

paite: TOUPA alungnel a, nakpi a thilhihthei ahi, mimohte siam atangsak mahmah kei ding; TOUPA'N pingpei leh huihpi ah alampi anei a, meipite akhe a leivui ahi.
english: Yahweh is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. Yahweh has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.

paite: Tuipi asal a, akangtatsak a, lui tengteng leng akangsak khin a; Bashan gam abah a, Karmel tang leh Lebanon tang paklunte avuai uhi.
english: He rebukes the sea and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel languish. The flower of Lebanon languishes.

paite: Amah ziak in tangte aling ua, mualte azulmang ua; ama ah lei avuak a, ahi leitung leh asung a om tengteng toh in.
english: The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all who dwell in it.

paite: Alung hihlouhna mai ah kua ahia dingh thei a, ahehna thupitak ah kua ahia om thei ding? Ahehna mei bang a sunbuak ahi a, suangpite akekzaksak vek hi.
english: Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken apart by him.

paite: TOUPA zaw ahoih a, mangbat ni a kulhkip ahi; amah a aginna uh koih mite athei hi.
english: Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.

paite: Himahleh tui khang luanglet zang in huai mun manthat vekna atungsak ding a, khomial a amelmate delhlut ding in.
english: But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.

paite: TOUPA kalh in bang na gel ua? Bei sipsipna atungsak ahi, haksa nihveina atung kei ding hi.
english: What do you plot against Yahweh? He will make a full end. Affliction won’t rise up the second time.

paite: Lingnok bang a om in a-uain dawn un diahkawt dimdem bang in om mahleh, buhpawl keu bang mai a hihman vek in a-om ding uhi.
english: For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with their drink, they are consumed utterly like dry stubble.

paite: Nang a pawt mi khat TOUPA kalh a thil gilou ngaihtuahmi, gitlouhna thuhilhmi a-om hi.
english: One has gone out of you who devises evil against Yahweh, who counsels wickedness.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ahat theihtawp un hat mah le uh, tam leng tampi himah le uh, huchipi in leng vatpuk in a-om ding ua, amangthang ding uhi. Hon na hihgim khin mah leng ka hon hihgim nawnta kei ding hi.
english: Yahweh says: “Though they are in full strength and likewise many, even so they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.

paite: Tu'n zaw na kiang a kipan ahakkol ka kitansak ding a, nang gakna khaute ka kitatsak vek ding.
english: Now I will break his yoke from off you, and will burst your bonds apart.”

paite: "TOUPA'N na tungtang thu ah thu apia hi, na min chi bang a tuh ahi nawnta kei ding a; na pathiante inn a kipan milim bawltawm leh milim sunte ka hihmangthang ding a; na han ka bawl ding; na gilou ngal a," chi in.
english: Yahweh has commanded concerning you: “No more descendants will bear your name. Out of the house of your gods, I will cut off the engraved image and the molten image. I will make your grave, for you are vile.”

paite: Tangte a tanchinhoih tun a, lemna thu tangkoupihte khe en dih; Aw Judah, na ankuang lui inla, na thuchiamte tangtun in; mi thugina lou in ahon pal paisuak nawn kei ding a; hihmanthat vek ahita hi.
english: Behold, on the mountains the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace! Keep your feasts, Judah! Perform your vows, for the wicked one will no more pass through you. He is utterly cut off.

paite: Kitamgawpsakpa doutu na mai ah ahong pawt hi; kigalthuam inla, na lampi veng in, na kawng khauhsak inla na thilhihtheihna hattak in bawlhoih in.
english: He who dashes in pieces has come up against you. Keep the fortress! Watch the way! Strengthen your waist! Fortify your power mightily!

paite: Hihse mite'n Israel thupina hihsia in agrep guite hihtan mah le uh, TOUPA Jakobte thupina ama a bang in atungding nawn ngal ding ahi.
english: For Yahweh restores the excellency of Jacob as the excellency of Israel, for the destroyers have destroyed them and ruined their vine branches.

paite: Amihatte lum sansak ahi a, mihangsante asan-au in akivan ua; akisakna ni in kangtalaite kahpasik tet in ate kelkel ua, teipite mulkimhuaitak in aphe zolzol hi.
english: The shield of his mighty men is made red. The valiant men are in scarlet. The chariots flash with steel in the day of his preparation, and the pine spears are brandished.

paite: Kangtalaite kongzing ah atai gomgom a; lamlian zate ah akiphu noknok ua; meisel bang in alang ua, khophia bang in atai zualzual uhi.
english: The chariots rage in the streets. They rush back and forth in the wide ways. Their appearance is like torches. They run like the lightnings.

paite: Amiliante atheigige a; apai lai un akisuipai ua; baang lam zuan in akinoh ua, kihumbitna ding abawl uhi.
english: He summons his picked troops. They stumble on their way. They dash to its wall, and the protective shield is put in place.

paite: Lui kongkhakte hon ahi a, kumpipa' inn hihsiat in a-om hi.
english: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved.

paite: Huan Huzzab salmat in apaimangpih ua, asikhanute'n a-awm uh tum in vakhu bang a ham in akah uhi.
english: It is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her servants moan as with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.

paite: Nidanglai a kipan Nineveh khua zaw dil a tui luangkhia bang ahi; himahleh ami tampi ataikhe ding ua, khawl in, khawl in, chi in kikou mah le uh kuamah akihei kei ding uh.
english: But Nineveh has been from of old like a pool of water, yet they flee away. “Stop! Stop!” they cry, but no one looks back.

paite: Dangkasik gallak in laksak unla unla, dangka-eng leng gallak in laksak un; gou manpha a dim ahih ziak in thil kisekkhawm leh vanhoihte tawi bei ni anei kei ding hi.
english: Take the plunder of silver. Take the plunder of gold, for there is no end of treasure, an abundance of every precious thing.

paite: Sukvuak in a-om a, avuak keuhkeuh a, asiang sipsip; lungtang azulmang a, khukte akihot ua, kawng tengteng ana tuntun a, amelte amual khin vek hi.
english: She is empty, void, and waste. The heart melts, the knees knock together, their bodies and faces have grown pale.

paite: Humpinelkai khosakna mun, humpinelkai pite leh anoute nek ding abalnenna leh alausak ding om lou a humpinelkai leh humpinelkai tekte pai vialvialna koi mun hita ahia?
english: Where is the den of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion and the lioness walked with the lion’s cubs, and no one made them afraid?

paite: Humpinelkai tal in anoute kham khop abotnen a, humpinelkai pite a ding in akeilum a, akokhukte uh sa keih in adimsak a, a-omna kokhuk samatte in adimsak hi.
