paite: Huan hichibang ngen in livei ka kiang ah mi ahon sawl ua; angeingei in amaute ka dawng zel hi.
english: They sent to me four times like this; and I answered them the same way.

paite: Huchi in Sanballat in ka kiang ah hichibang in angaveina ding in asikha akhut a laikhak honsa toh ahon sawl a;
english: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me the same way the fifth time with an open letter in his hand,

paite: huai ah, "Namte lak ah akigen a, Gasmu in achi a, nang leh Judate'n hel na tum uh; huai a ding in kulhbaang na lam hi: huchi in nang akumpipa uh hi ding in, hiai thute dungzui in,
english: in which was written, “It is reported among the nations, and Gashmu says it, that you and the Jews intend to rebel. Because of that, you are building the wall. You would be their king, according to these words.

paite: Jerusalem a nang tanchin gen ding in zawlneite leng na sep a, Judah ah kumpipa a-om chi in. Huchi in tu in hiai thute dungzui in kumpipa kiang a tut ding ahi; huaiziak in hong kuan inla, kihouna i nei ding," chi in.
english: You have also appointed prophets to proclaim of you at Jerusalem, saying, ‘There is a king in Judah!’ Now it will be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let’s take counsel together.”

paite: Akiang ah mi ka sawl a, "Na gen bang a huchibang thilhih a-om kei a, himahleh na lungtang a kipan na phuahtawm ahi," chi in.
english: Then I sent to him, saying, “There are no such things done as you say, but you imagine them out of your own heart.”

paite: Amau lah, hih louh ahihna ding in, "Nasepna a kipan akhutte uh hatsak louh in a-om ding," chi a hon lauhsak a-ut ngal ua. Himahleh tu in, Aw Pathian, nang ka khutte hatsak in.
english: For they all would have made us afraid, saying, “Their hands will be weakened from the work, that it not be done.” But now, strengthen my hands.

paite: Khum a om, Mehetabel tapa Delaiah tapa Shemaiah inn ah ka hoh a, ama'n, "Tempul sung ah, Pathian inn ah i kikhawm dia, huchi in tempul kongkhakte i khak ding, nang that dia hong ding uh lah ahi ngal ua; ahi, zan in nang that ding a hong ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: I went to the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabel, who was shut in at his home; and he said, “Let us meet together in God’s house, within the temple, and let’s shut the doors of the temple; for they will come to kill you. Yes, in the night they will come to kill you.”

paite: Ke'n bel, "Kei bang mi, taise ding hon sa maw? Huan kua ahia, huchi a kei bang a om a, ahinna humbitna ding a tempul sung a hoh nuam ding? Ka lut kei ding," ka chi hi.
english: I said, “Should a man like me flee? Who is there that, being such as I, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.”

paite: Ka ngaihtuah a, huchi in ngai in, Pathian in amah asawl kei a; himahleh ka siatna ding in hiai genkholhna agenkheta hi: Tobiah leh Sanballat in amah aguai uhi.
english: I discerned, and behold, God had not sent him, but he pronounced this prophecy against me. Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

paite: Hiai a ding a goih ahi, ka launa ding leh huchibang a hih a, khial a, thutut gilou ding a thubuai aneihtheihna ding ua, kei ahon simmoh theihna ding un.
english: He was hired so that I would be afraid, do so, and sin, and that they might have material for an evil report, that they might reproach me.

paite: Aw ka Pathian, Tobiah leh Sanballat anasepte uh bang zel leh zawlneinu Noadiah leh zawlnei dangte, lausak hon tumte, theigige in.
english: “Remember, my God, Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and also the prophetess Noadiah and the rest of the prophets that would have put me in fear.”

paite: Huchi in Elul kha ani sawmnih-le-nga ni, ani sawmnga-le-nih sung in, kulhbaang zoh in a-omta hi.
english: So the wall was finished in the twenty-fifth day of Elul, in fifty-two days.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, i melmate tengteng in huai azak un, i kim i vel ua om namte teng in alauta ua, amitmuh ngei uah nakpitak in alunglelta uhi; hiai nasep i Pathian hih ahi chih athei ngal ua.
english: When all our enemies heard of it, all the nations that were around us were afraid, and they lost their confidence; for they perceived that this work was done by our God.

paite: Huai lou in huai lai in Judah miliante'n laikhak tampi Tobiah kiang ah akhak ua, amau kiang ah Tobiah laikhakte ahong tung hi.
english: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah’s letters came to them.

paite: Amah Arah tapa Shekaniah tanu pasal ahih ziak in, Judah ah mi tampi amah lam a kichiam lah a-om ngal ua; atapa Jehohanan in Berekiah tapa Meshullam tanu zi in anei hi.
english: For there were many in Judah sworn to him because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah as wife.

paite: Huai lou leng ka ma ah athil hoih hihte agen ua, amah kiang ah ka thute atun zel uhi. Huchi in Tobiah in kei hon hihlau ding in laikhakte akhak hi.
english: Also they spoke of his good deeds before me, and reported my words to him. Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.

paite: Hichi ahong hi a, kulhbaang lam khit ahih a, kongkhakte ka tun khit a, kongkhak ngak mite leh lasa mite leh Levi mite seh ahih khit nung un,
english: Now when the wall was built and I had set up the doors, and the gatekeepers and the singers and the Levites were appointed,

paite: ka unau Hanani leh Hananiah kulh ukpa kiang ah Jerusalem kepna ka pia a: amah miginom ahi a, tampi sang a Pathian laudan siam ahih ziak in.
english: I put my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the governor of the fortress, in charge of Jerusalem; for he was a faithful man and feared God above many.

paite: Akiang ah, "Ni asat mateng Jerusalem kongpite hon hi kei hen; galvilmi adin lai un, kongkhakte khak uhenla, amaute kalhkhum un; Jerusalem a tengte vengmi sep inla, michih ama dinmun ah, michih ama inn zawn chiat ah," chi in.
english: I said to them, “Don’t let the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot; and while they stand guard, let them shut the doors, and you bar them; and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, everyone in his watch, with everyone near his house.”

paite: Khopi aza in alian a: himahleh huai ah mite atawm ua, innte lah lam ahi kei uhi.
english: Now the city was wide and large; but the people were few therein, and the houses were not built.

paite: Huchi in ka Pathian in ka lungtang miliante, vaihawm mite, mipite, khangsutna a sim ahihtheihna ding ua kaikhawm ding in akoih hi. Huan amasapen a hong lang amaute khangsutna laibu ka muta a, huai ah gelh a om ka mu hi.
english: My God put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be listed by genealogy. I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up at the first, and I found this written in it:

paite: Hiaite bial naupangte ahi ua, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in apimangte, huai pimang a omte lak a saltanna kipan a paitoute, Jerusalem leh Judah akik nawn, michih amah khopi a kik;
english: These are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and who returned to Jerusalem and to Judah, everyone to his city,

paite: Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordekai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah toh hong paite.
english: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, and Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

paite: Israel mite lak a pasal zah: Parosh suante, sangnih zakhat sawmsagih-le-nih.
english: The children of Parosh: two thousand one hundred seventy-two.

paite: Shephatiah suante, zathum sawmsagih-le-nih.
english: The children of Shephatiah: three hundred seventy-two.

paite: Arah suante, zaguk sawmnga-le-nih.
english: The children of Arah: six hundred fifty-two.

paite: Pahath-moab suante, Jeshua leh Joab tate, sangnih zagiat sawmkhat-le-giat.
english: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab: two thousand eight hundred eighteen.

paite: Elam suan sangkhat zanih sawmnga-le-li.
english: The children of Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

paite: Zattu suan zagiat sawmli-le-nga.
english: The children of Zattu: eight hundred forty-five.

paite: Zakkai suan zasagih-le-sawmguk.
english: The children of Zaccai: seven hundred sixty.

paite: Binnui suan zaguk sawmli-le-giat.
english: The children of Binnui: six hundred forty-eight.

paite: Bebai suan zaguk sawmnih-le-giat.
english: The children of Bebai: six hundred twenty-eight.

paite: Azgad suan sangnih zathum sawmnih-le-nih.
english: The children of Azgad: two thousand three hundred twenty-two.

paite: Adonikam suan zaguk sawmguk-le-sagih.
english: The children of Adonikam: six hundred sixty-seven.

paite: Bigvai suan sangnih sawmguk-le-sagih.
english: The children of Bigvai: two thousand sixty-seven.

paite: Adin suan zaguk sawmnga-le-nga.
english: The children of Adin: six hundred fifty-five.

paite: Ater, Hezekiah suan sawmkua-le-giat.
english: The children of Ater: of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.

paite: Hashum suan zathum sawmnih-le-giat.
english: The children of Hashum: three hundred twenty-eight.

paite: Bezai suan zathum sawmnih-le-li.
english: The children of Bezai: three hundred twenty-four.

paite: Hariph suan zakhat sawmkhat-le-nih.
english: The children of Hariph: one hundred twelve.

paite: Gibeon suan sawmkua-le-nga.
english: The children of Gibeon: ninety-five.

paite: Bethlehem leh Netophah suan zakhat sawmgiat-le-giat.
english: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah: one hundred eighty-eight.

paite: Anathoth mite, zakhat sawmnih-le-giat.
english: The men of Anathoth: one hundred twenty-eight.

paite: Beth-azmaveth, mite sawmli-le-nih.
english: The men of Beth Azmaveth: forty-two.

paite: Kiriath-jearim, Kephirah, Beeroth suante, zasagih sawmli-le-thum.
english: The men of Kiriath Jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth: seven hundred forty-three.

paite: Ramah leh Geba mite, zaguk sawmnih-le-khat.
english: The men of Ramah and Geba: six hundred twenty-one.

paite: Mikmas suante, zakhat sawmnih-le-nih.
english: The men of Michmas: one hundred twenty-two.

paite: Bethel leh Ai mite, zakhat sawmnih-le-thum.
english: The men of Bethel and Ai: one hundred twenty-three.

paite: Nebo dang mite, sawmnga-le-nih.
english: The men of the other Nebo: fifty-two.

paite: Elam dang suan sangkhat zanih sawmnga-le-li.
english: The children of the other Elam: one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

paite: Harim suan zathum-le-sawmnih.
english: The children of Harim: three hundred twenty.

paite: Jeriko suan zathum sawmli-le-nga.
english: The children of Jericho: three hundred forty-five.

paite: Lod, Hadid leh Ono suante, zasagih sawmnih-le-khat.
english: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono: seven hundred twenty-one.

paite: Senaah suan sangthum zakua-le-sawmthum.
english: The children of Senaah: three thousand nine hundred thirty.

paite: Siampute: Jedaiah suante, Jeshua inkuan a kipan, zakua sawmsagih-le-thum.
english: The priests: The children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua: nine hundred seventy-three.

paite: Imer suante, sangkhat sawmnga-le-nih.
english: The children of Immer: one thousand fifty-two.

paite: Pashur suante, sangkhat zanih sawmli-le-sagih.
english: The children of Pashhur: one thousand two hundred forty-seven.

paite: Harim suante, sangkhat sawm-le-sagih.
english: The children of Harim: one thousand seventeen.

paite: Levi mite: Jeshua, Kadmiel suante, Hodevah suante, sawmsagih-le-li.
english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, of the children of Hodevah: seventy-four.

paite: Lasa mite: Asaph suante, zakhat sawmli-le-giat.
english: The singers: the children of Asaph: one hundred forty-eight.

paite: Kongkhak ngakte: Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita leh Shobai suante, zakhat sawmthum-le-giat.
english: The gatekeepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai: one hundred thirty-eight.

paite: Tempul nasem, Nethinim mite: Ziha, Hasupha, Tabbaoth;
english: The temple servants: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

paite: Keros, Sia, Padon;
english: the children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,

paite: Lebana, Hagabah, Shalmai;
english: the children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Salmai,

paite: Hanan, Giddel, Gahar;
english: the children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,

paite: Reaiah, Rezin, Nekoda;
english: the children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,

paite: Gazzam, Uzza, Paseah;
english: the children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah,

paite: Besai, Meunim, Nephishesim;
english: the children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephushesim,

paite: Bakbuk, Hakupha, Harhur;
english: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

paite: Bazlith, Mehida, Harsha;
english: the children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

paite: Barkos, Sisera, Tamah;
english: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,

paite: Neziah leh Hatipha suante.
english: the children of Neziah, and the children of Hatipha.

paite: Solomon sikhate tate: Sotai, Sophereth, Perida;
english: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,

paite: Jaala, Darkon, Giddel;
english: the children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

paite: Shephatiah, Hattil, Zebaim mi Pokereth leh Ammon suante.
english: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, and the children of Amon.

paite: Nethinim mite tengteng leh Solomon sikhate' suante, zathum sawmkua-le-nih.
english: All the temple servants and the children of Solomon’s servants were three hundred ninety-two.

paite: uan hiaite Telmelah, Tel-harsha, Kerub, Addon leh Immer a kipan paitoute ahi uh, himahleh apipute uh inkote, Israel a kipan ahi hiam chih bel a-ensak thei kei uhi:
english: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses, nor their offspring, whether they were of Israel:

paite: Delaiah, Tobiah leh Nekoda suante, zaguk sawmli-le-nih.
english: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda: six hundred forty-two.

paite: Siampute a kipan: Habaiah, Koz leh Barzillai suan Gilead mi Barzillai tanute lak a zi neipa min atamsak uhi.
english: Of the priests: the children of Hobaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.

paite: Hiaite'n khangthu suina a sim a omte lak ah amin gelhna uh azong ua, himahleh muh in a-om kei; huaiziak in nin a sim ahi ua siamputna a kipan koihkhiak ahi uhi.
english: These searched for their genealogical records, but couldn’t find them. Therefore they were deemed disqualified and removed from the priesthood.

paite: Ukpipa in akiang uah, siampu khat Urim leh Thummim toh ahong suah mateng thil siangthoupente lak a nek louh ding chih agen hi.
english: The governor told them not to eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to minister with Urim and Thummim.

paite: Omkhawm tengteng avek un singli sangnih zathum-le-sawmguk,
english: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,

paite: Apasal sikhate uh leh anungak sikhate uh, sangsagih zathum sawmthum-le-sagihte sim louh in: pasal lasa leh numei lasa zanih sawmli-le-nga anei uhi.
english: in addition to their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven. They had two hundred forty-five singing men and singing women.

paite: Asakolte uh zasagih sawmthum-le-guk; asakolneute uh, zanih sawmli-le-nga;
english: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five;

paite: Asangawngsaute, zali sawmthum-le-nga; asabiltungte uh sangguk zasagih-le-sawmnih.
english: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.

paite: Pipute inkote lak a lupente lak a kipan khenkhatte nasem ding in akipia uhi. Ukpipa'n sumbawm ah dangka- eng darik sangkhat, maiphiat kuang sawmnga, siampute puan zanga-le- sawmthum apia hi.
english: Some from among the heads of fathers’ households gave to the work. The governor gave to the treasury one thousand darics of gold, fifty basins, and five hundred thirty priests’ garments.

paite: Huan pipute inkote lak a lupente lak a khenkhatte'n dangka-eng darik singnih leh, dangka paun sangnih-le-zanih apia uhi.
english: Some of the heads of fathers’ households gave into the treasury of the work twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand two hundred minas of silver.

paite: Mipite lak a adangdangte piak dangka-eng darik singnih leh dangka paun sangnih leh, siampute puan sawmguk-le- sagih ahi.
english: That which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, plus two thousand minas of silver, and sixty-seven priests’ garments.

paite: Huchi in siampute, Levi mite, kongkhak ngakte leh lasa mite, mite lak a akhente leh Nethinim mite leh Israel tengteng a khopite uah atengta uhi. Akha sagihna ahong tun in, Israel suante akhopite uah a-om uhi.
english: So the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, some of the people, the temple servants, and all Israel lived in their cities. When the seventh month had come, the children of Israel were in their cities.

paite: Huchi in mite tengteng Tui Kongpi mai a om mun lian ah mi khat bang in akikhawmkhawmta ua; TOUPA'N Israel kiang a apiak, Mosi Dan laibu hon tawi ding in laigelhmi Ezra kiang ah thu ahilh uhi.
english: All the people gathered themselves together as one man into the wide place that was in front of the water gate; and they spoke to Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which Yahweh had commanded to Israel.

paite: Siampu Ezra in omkhawmte, pasal leh numei, theihsiamna toh za thei ding tengteng ma ah akha sagihna ani khat ni in dan thu ahon lata hi.
english: Ezra the priest brought the law before the assembly, both men and women, and all who could hear with understanding, on the first day of the seventh month.

paite: Pasal leh numeite leh theisiam thei dingte ma ah, zingkhang a kipan sun lai tanpha in Tui Kongpi mai a om mun lian ma ah asimta hi; huchi in mite tengteng in Dan Laibu abildoh chiat uhi.
english: He read from it before the wide place that was in front of the water gate from early morning until midday, in the presence of the men and the women, and of those who could understand. The ears of all the people were attentive to the book of the law.

paite: Huai ding mah a abawl uh, sing dohkang tung ah laigelhmi Ezra adingh a; asik ah Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah leh Maaseiah, ataklam pang ah adingh ua; aveilam pang ah, Pedaiah, Mishael, Malkijah, Hashum, Hashbaddana, Zekariah leh Meshullam.
english: Ezra the scribe stood on a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

paite: Huchi in Ezra in mite mitmuh in laibu ahong a; mite tunglam ah a-om ngal a; huan ahongta a, mite tengteng adingh uhi:
english: Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people (for he was above all the people), and when he opened it, all the people stood up.

paite: Ezra in TOUPA, Pathian thupi avualzawl hi. Huchi in mipi tengteng in adawng ua, "Amen, Amen," chi a akhutte uh lik kawm in alute uh akunsak ua amai ua lei si in TOUPA abia uhi.
english: Then Ezra blessed Yahweh, the great God. All the people answered, “Amen, Amen,” with the lifting up of their hands. They bowed their heads, and worshiped Yahweh with their faces to the ground.

paite: Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah leh Levi mite'n mipite dan theisiam ding in abawl ua: huchi in mite amau mun ah adingh uhi.
english: Also Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law; and the people stayed in their place.

paite: Huchi in teltak in laibu ah, Pathian dan sung ah asim ua; a-omdan ataklang ua, huchi a lai simkhiak atheihsiamna ding un.
english: They read in the book, in the law of God, distinctly; and they gave the sense, so that they understood the reading.

paite: Huan Nehemiah, amah Tirshatha ahi a, huan siampu leh laigelhmi Ezra, leh Levite mite sinsakte'n, mite tengteng kiang ah, "Tuni TOUPA na Pathian uh a dia ni siangthou ahi; dah kei unla kap kei un," achi ua. Dan thute azak un lah mite tengteng akap ngal ua.
english: Nehemiah, who was the governor, Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who taught the people said to all the people, “Today is holy to Yahweh your God. Don’t mourn, nor weep.” For all the people wept when they heard the words of the law.

paite: Akiang uah, "Pai unla, thaute ne unla, akhumkhum dawn un, amah a dia bangmah bawlkhol a om lou kiang ah tantuante khak un: tuni lah i TOUPA uh a dia ni siangthou ahi ngal a. Dah kei unla; TOUPA a kipahna na hatna uh ahi,” achi hi.
english: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for today is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved, for the joy of Yahweh is your strength.”

paite: Huchi in Levite'n mite tengteng adaisak ua, "Tuni siangthou ahih ziak in, dai sipsip unla; dah kei un," chi in.
english: So the Levites calmed all the people, saying, “Hold your peace, for the day is holy. Don’t be grieved.”

paite: Huan mite tengteng ne ding leh dawn ding leh vualnopna thupi bawl ding in apaita ua, akiang ua phuankhiak a om thute atheisiamta uhi.
english: All the people went their way to eat, to drink, to send portions, and to celebrate, because they had understood the words that were declared to them.

paite: Ani nih ni in mite tengteng pipute inko lupente, siampute leh Levi mite, laigelhmi Ezra kiang ah, Dan thute ngaikhe ding in akikhawmkhawm uhi.
english: On the second day, the heads of fathers’ households of all the people, the priests, and the Levites were gathered together to Ezra the scribe, to study the words of the law.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi zang a Israel suante akha sagihna ankuangluina a aidakbuk a atendan ding ua thu apiakdan dan a kigelh amu uhi:
english: They found written in the law how Yahweh had commanded by Moses that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month;

paite: "Tang ah kuankhia unla, olive hiang, gam olive leh muising hiang, tum hiang, sing vunsah hiang, akigelh bang a, aidakbuk bawlna ding in va la un, akhopi tengteng uh leh Jerusalem a apuankhiak theihna ding un," achi hi.
english: and that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities and in Jerusalem, saying, “Go out to the mountain, and get olive branches, branches of wild olive, myrtle branches, palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make temporary shelters, as it is written.”

paite: Huchi in mite akuankhia ua, ava la ua, michih in a-inn tung ah, ahuangsungte uah, Pathian huangsungte ah, Tui Kongpi a mun lian ah leh Ephraim Kongpi a mun lian ah aidakbukte akibawlta uhi.
english: So the people went out and brought them, and made themselves temporary shelters, everyone on the roof of his house, in their courts, in the courts of God’s house, in the wide place of the water gate, and in the wide place of Ephraim’s gate.

paite: Huan saltanna a kipan hong pai nawn omkhawmte tengteng in aidakbukte abawl ua, aidakbuk ah ateng uhi. Nun tapa Joshua dam lai a kipan huai ni tanpha in Israel suante'n lah huchibang in ahih nai kei uhi. Huchi in nakpi a kipahna mahmah a-omta hi.
english: All the assembly of those who had come back out of the captivity made temporary shelters and lived in the temporary shelters, for since the days of Joshua the son of Nun to that day the children of Israel had not done so. There was very great gladness.

paite: Huai lou in niteng in ani masapen a kipan ani tawp ni tan in Pathian Dan laibu sung ah asim hi. Huan ankuangluina ni sagih anei ua; ani giat ni in paidan dungzui in kikhopna thupi a-omta hi.
english: Also day by day, from the first day to the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. They kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according to the ordinance.

paite: Hiai kha ani sawmnih-le-li ni in Israel suante an ngawl kawm leh sai-ip puansilh kawm leh atung ua lei kibuak kawm in akikhawm ua.
english: Now in the twenty-fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, with sackcloth, and dirt on them.

paite: Huchi in Israel chite mikhual tengteng a kipan in akikoihtuam ua, adingh ua akhelhnate uleh, apipute uh thulimlouhnate thupha atawi uhi.
english: The offspring of Israel separated themselves from all foreigners and stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their fathers.

paite: Amun uah adingh ua, TOUPA a Pathian uh Dan laibu sung ah ni khat a aseh lina teng asim ua; aseh lina teng thupha atawi ua, TOUPA a Pathian uh abeta uhi.
english: They stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of Yahweh their God a fourth part of the day; and a fourth part they confessed and worshiped Yahweh their God.

paite: Huchih lai in Levi mite, Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani leh Kenanite dohkan tung ah adingh ua, TOUPA a Pathian kiang uah aw ngaihtak in akikou uhi.
english: Then Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani of the Levites stood up on the stairs, and cried with a loud voice to Yahweh their God.

paite: Huai lai in Levi mite, Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah leh Pethahiahte'n, "Dingh unla tangtawn a kipan tangtawn pha in TOUPA na Pathian uh vualzawl un: huchi in vualzawlna leh phatna tengteng tunglam a tawisang a om, na min thupi vualzawl in om hen.”
english: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, “Stand up and bless Yahweh your God from everlasting to everlasting! Blessed be your glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise!

paite: "Nang, nang kia mahmah TOUPA na hi; van, vante' van a, sepaihte tengteng, lei leh asung a thil om tengteng, tuipite leh asung ua om tengteng na bawl a, avek un na hawi a; van sepaihte'n nang ahon bia uhi.
english: You are Yahweh, even you alone. You have made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their army, the earth and all things that are on it, the seas and all that is in them, and you preserve them all. The army of heaven worships you.

paite: Abram tel a, Kaldaite Ur a kipan a amah pikhia a, akiang a Abraham min pepa, TOUPA Pathian na hi;
english: You are Yahweh, the God who chose Abram, brought him out of Ur of the Chaldees, gave him the name of Abraham,

paite: Na ma a lungtang ginom na mu a, Kanaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Jebus mite leh Girgas mite gam pe ding a amah toh thukhun bawlpa, achite kiang a pe ding in, na thute bawl piching a; nang lah na diktat ngal a.
english: found his heart faithful before you, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite, and the Girgashite, to give it to his offspring, and have performed your words, for you are righteous.

paite: Aigupta a ka pipute uh gimthuakna na mu a, Tuipi San a akah uh na za a;
english: “You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red Sea,

paite: Pharaoh tung leh, asikhate tengteng tung leh, agam a mite tengteng tung ah chiamtehna leh thillamdangte na ensak a; amaute siatna ding in kisatheitak in agamtang uh chih lah na thei ngal hi; tuni a bang in, min na kimuh hi.
english: and showed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, against all his servants, and against all the people of his land, for you knew that they dealt proudly against them, and made a name for yourself, as it is today.

paite: Ama uah tuipi na khen a, huchi in gam hul tung ah tuipi lak ah apaisuak ua; amau delhte nang tui thuk sung ah, tui hattak sung a suang bang in na pailut hi.
english: You divided the sea before them, so that they went through the middle of the sea on the dry land; and you cast their pursuers into the depths, as a stone into the mighty waters.

paite: Huai lou in sun in meipi kitung in amaute na pi a; zan in meikuang dingh in, apaina ding lampi ua vakna amaute kiang a pe ding in.
english: Moreover, in a pillar of cloud you led them by day; and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light in the way in which they should go.

paite: Sinai Tang ah leng na hohsuk a, van a kipan in amau na houpih a, vaihawmna dikte leh dan dikte, dan thuseh leh thupiak hoihte na pia hi.
english: “You also came down on Mount Sinai, and spoke with them from heaven, and gave them right ordinances and true laws, good statutes and commandments,

paite: Amau kiang ah na Sabbath siangthou na theisak a, na sikha Mosi khut in, thupiakte leh dan thusehte leh dan amaute na thupiak in na pia hi.
english: and made known to them your holy Sabbath, and commanded them commandments, statutes, and a law, by Moses your servant,

paite: Agilkial un van a kipan tanghou na pia a, adangtak un suangpi a kipan amaute a ding in tui na pawtkhesak a, amaute pe ding a na khut na lik a, gam luah ding a kuan ding in amaute thu na pia hi.
english: and gave them bread from the sky for their hunger, and brought water out of the rock for them for their thirst, and commanded them that they should go in to possess the land which you had sworn to give them.

paite: Himahleh amaute leh apipute un kisatheitak in ahih ua, apaupeng ua, na thupiakte angaikhe kei uhi,
english: “But they and our fathers behaved proudly, hardened their neck, didn’t listen to your commandments,

paite: Thu amang nuam kei ua, alak ua na hih na thillamdangte leng alimsak sam kei uh; himahleh aki-uangsak ua, ahelna uah atanna ua kik nawn ding in heutu khat asep uhi; himahleh nang ngaidam dia mansa, lainatna a dim leh hehpihsiam, heh mengmeng lou, zahngaihna hau, amaute lehngatsan lou Pathian na hi.
english: and refused to obey. They weren’t mindful of your wonders that you did among them, but hardened their neck, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage. But you are a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and didn’t forsake them.

paite: Ahi, bawngnou sun abawl lai un, Aigupta a kipan a nang hon pikhepa hiai na Pathian ahi, achi ua, nakpitak a thangpaihnate abawl lai un.
english: Yes, when they had made themselves a molded calf, and said, ‘This is your God who brought you up out of Egypt,’ and had committed awful blasphemies,

paite: Huchi napi in na zahngaihna tampite ziak in amaute gamdai ah na lehngatsan kei hi: sun in atung ua kipan meipi dingh apaimang kei a, vakna amau pe ding, zan a meikuang dingh leng, apaina lampi uah amaute pi ding in.
english: yet you in your manifold mercies didn’t forsake them in the wilderness. The pillar of cloud didn’t depart from over them by day, to lead them in the way; neither did the pillar of fire by night, to show them light, and the way in which they should go.

paite: Amaute chil ding in na kha hoih na pia a, akam uah na Manna na phal lou kei a, amaute adangtak un tui na pia hi.
english: You gave also your good Spirit to instruct them, and didn’t withhold your manna from their mouth, and gave them water for their thirst.

paite: Ahi, gamdai ah kum sawmli amaute na vak a, bangmah atasam kei ua; apuansilhte uh atul kei a, akhepekte uh abawk kei hi.
english: “Yes, forty years you sustained them in the wilderness. They lacked nothing. Their clothes didn’t grow old, and their feet didn’t swell.

paite: Huai ban ah lalgamte leh mite amau na pia a, atantuante uh dungzui a na piakkhiakte: Sihon gam, Heshbon kumpipa gam leh Bashan kumpipa Og gam alata uhi.
english: Moreover you gave them kingdoms and peoples, which you allotted according to their portions. So they possessed the land of Sihon, even the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.

paite: Van aksite bang in atate uh na pungsak a, nei ding in alut ding uh chi a, api-le-pute kiang a na gen bang in, gamsung ah na pilut hi.
english: You also multiplied their children as the stars of the sky, and brought them into the land concerning which you said to their fathers that they should go in to possess it.

paite: Huchi in tate alut ua gam aneita ua, ama uah gam a tengte na satpuka, Kanaante, akumpite leh, gam a mite, amau khut ah na pia a, huchi a a-utdan ua atung ua ahihtheihna ding un.
english: “So the children went in and possessed the land; and you subdued before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gave them into their hands, with their kings and the peoples of the land, that they might do with them as they pleased.

paite: Khopi hatte, gam hoihte ala ua, thil hoih tengteng a dim innte anei ua, tuibel sekte, grephuante, olive huante, atam a tam theikungte: huchi in ane ua, avah ua, ahong thau ua, na hoihna thupi ziak in akipak mahmah uhi.
english: They took fortified cities and a rich land, and possessed houses full of all good things, cisterns dug out, vineyards, olive groves, and fruit trees in abundance. So they ate, were filled, became fat, and delighted themselves in your great goodness.

paite: Hinapi'n lah thu amang kei ua, na tung ah ahel ua, na dan anunglam uah apai ua, na kiang lam amaute ngasak nawn ding a, amaute dem a thugen na zawlneite athat ua, thangpaihna thupi mahmah abawl uhi.
english: “Nevertheless they were disobedient and rebelled against you, cast your law behind their back, killed your prophets that testified against them to turn them again to you, and they committed awful blasphemies.

paite: Huaiziak in amelmate uh khut ah amau na pia a, amau ahihgenthei uh: abuai ni ua na kiang a ahong kah lai un, van a kipan in na za a; na zahngaihna tampi dungzui in amelmate uh khut a kipan a amaute hondam ding in akiang uah hondam mite na pia hi.
english: Therefore you delivered them into the hand of their adversaries, who distressed them. In the time of their trouble, when they cried to you, you heard from heaven; and according to your manifold mercies you gave them saviors who saved them out of the hands of their adversaries.

paite: Himahleh atawldam nung un na ma ah gilou ahih nawn zel ua; huaiziak in amelmate uh khut ah amau na nusia a, huchi in amau atung uah thu anei ua: hinapi in ahong kihei ua, na kiang a akah un, van a kipan na za a; na zahngaihnate dungzui in amaute tamveipi na hunkhia hi.
english: But after they had rest, they did evil again before you; therefore you left them in the hands of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them; yet when they returned and cried to you, you heard from heaven; and many times you delivered them according to your mercies,

paite: Na dan a na pilut theih nawnna ding in, amau na dem a: himahleh kisatheitak in ahih ua, na thupiakte alimsak kei ua, na vaihawmte tung ah akhial zosop uhi, huai mi'n ahihleh, huai ah ahing ding, liang asawisak ua, aki-uangsak ua, aza nuam kei uhi.
english: and testified against them, that you might bring them again to your law. Yet they were arrogant, and didn’t listen to your commandments, but sinned against your ordinances (which if a man does, he shall live in them), turned their backs, stiffened their neck, and would not hear.

paite: Himahleh kum tampi amau na thuakzou a, na zawlneite in na kha zang in amaute na dem a, himahleh angaikhe nuam kei ua; huaiziak in gam mite khut ah amaute na peta hi.
english: Yet many years you put up with them, and testified against them by your Spirit through your prophets. Yet they would not listen. Therefore you gave them into the hand of the peoples of the lands.

paite: Huchi napi in na zahngaihna tampite ziak in amaute na hihbei keuhkeuh kei a, na lehngatsan kei; nang lah hehpih thei leh chingthei Pathian na hi ngal a.
english: “Nevertheless in your manifold mercies you didn’t make a full end of them, nor forsake them; for you are a gracious and merciful God.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in, ka Pathian uh, thupi Pathian hat leh kihtakhuai, thukhun leh zahngaihna vompa, na ma ah, ka tung uh, ka kumpipate uh tung, ka vaihawmte uh tung, ka siampute uh tung, ka zawlneite uh tung, ka pipute uh tung, na mite, Assuria kumpipate dam lai a kipan a tuni tan, na mite tung a, nauveina bangmah tham lou bang in kilang kei hen.
english: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness, don’t let all the travail seem little before you that has come on us, on our kings, on our princes, on our priests, on our prophets, on our fathers, and on all your people, since the time of the kings of Assyria to this day.

paite: Akoi abang hitaleh ka tung ua hong tung tengteng ah nang na diktat a; nang lah diktak in na hih ngal a, kou bel giloutak in ka hih uhi.
english: However you are just in all that has come on us; for you have dealt truly, but we have done wickedly.

paite: Kumpipate leh ka vaihawmte uh hiam, siampute uh hiam, ka pipute uh hiam in na dan azui kei ua, na thupiakte leh na thu theihpihnate, amaute dem a na theihpihnate lah angaikhe nuam sam kei uhi.
english: Also our kings, our princes, our priests, and our fathers have not kept your law, nor listened to your commandments and your testimonies with which you testified against them.

paite: Agam uah nang nna asem kei ua, na hoih mahmahna ziak a amau na piak, ama ua na piak gam lian leh hoih, anasep gilou ua kipan akilehhei sam kei uhi.
english: For they have not served you in their kingdom, and in your great goodness that you gave them, and in the large and rich land which you gave before them. They didn’t turn from their wicked works.

paite: Ngai in, tuni in sikhate ka hi ua, agah nekna ding leh huai ahoihte neihna dia ka pipute uh kiang a na piak gam ahihleh, ngai in, asung ah sikhate ka hi uhi.
english: “Behold, we are servants today, and as for the land that you gave to our fathers to eat its fruit and its good, behold, we are servants in it.

paite: Ka khelhna ziak ua ka tung ua na koih kumpipate a ding in anak pun mahmah a, athuthu un, ka pumpite uleh, ka gantate uh tung athilhihtheihna anei ua, kou ka nak gim mahmah uhi."
english: It yields much increase to the kings whom you have set over us because of our sins. Also they have power over our bodies and over our livestock, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.

paite: Huan hiaite tengteng huchibang hita mahleh thukhun muanhuai ka bawl ua, ka gelh ua; ka vaihawmte uh, ka Levi mite uleh ka siampute un, huai ah suai akai uhi.
english: Yet for all this, we make a sure covenant, and write it; and our princes, our Levites, and our priests, seal it.”

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan ahong pawt uh akum nihna, akha nihna, ani khat ni in Sinai gamdai ah kihoupihna biakbuk ah TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

paite: "Israel suan omkhawm tengteng, a-inkuankuan un amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in pasal tengteng sim vek in," achi hi.
english: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every male, one by one,

paite: "Kum sawmnih a pan atunglam Israel lak a galdou thei chiang peuhmah nang leh Aaron in apawlpawl in na sim vek ding uh ahi.
english: from twenty years old and upward, all who are able to go out to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall count them by their divisions.

paite: Na kiang ah nam chih lak a khat, inkuan a vaihawm makai a-om ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: With you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers’ house.

paite: Hiaite na kiang a om dingte min ahi: Reuben nam a kipan Shedeur tapa Elizur,
english: These are the names of the men who shall stand with you: Of Reuben: Elizur the son of Shedeur.

paite: Simeon nam a kipan Zurishaddai tapa Shelumiel.
english: Of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

paite: Judah nam a kipan Amminadab tapa Nahson.
english: Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

paite: Issakar nam a kipan Zuar tapa Nethaneel.
english: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.

paite: Zebulun nam a kipan Helon tapa Eliab.
english: Of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon.

paite: Joseph tapate a kipan: Ephraim nam a kipan Ammihud tapa Elishama; Manasseh nam a kipan Pedazur tapa Gamaliel.
english: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud; of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

paite: Benjamin nam a kipan Gideoni tapa Abidan.
english: Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.

paite: Dan nam a kipan Ammishaddai tapa Ahiezer.
english: Of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

paite: Asher nam a kipan Okran tapa Pagiel.
english: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.

paite: Gad nam a kipan Deuel tapa Eliasaph.
english: Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

paite: Naphtali nam a kipan Enan tapa Ahira.
english: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.”

paite: Hiaite omkhawm mipite' tel, api-le-pute uh nam a vaihawm makai Israel inkuan a lupente ahi uh, chi in.
english: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.

paite: Mosi leh Aaron in huai mi amin ua lohte api uhi.
english: Moses and Aaron took these men who are mentioned by name.

paite: Mipi omkhawm tengteng akha nihna, ani khat ni in asamkhawm vek ua; a-inkuankuan in amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam teng apipute uh min ataklang uhi.
english: They assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they declared their ancestry by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, one by one.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in Sinai gamdai ah asimta uhi.
english: As Yahweh commanded Moses, so he counted them in the wilderness of Sinai.

paite: Israel tapa upapen Reuben tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in pasal kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: The children of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

paite: Reuben nam, asimte uh singli sangguk-le-zanga ahi.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

paite: Simeon tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in pasal kum sawmnih a pan atunglam galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Simeon, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, those who were counted of it, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

paite: Simeon nam, asimte uh singnga sangkua-le-zathum ahi uh.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

paite: Gad tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in pasal kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Gad, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

paite: Gad nam a asimte uh singli sangnga zaguk-le-sawmnga ahi uh.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

paite: Judah tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Judah, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

paite: Judah nam a asimte uh singsagih sangli-le-zaguk ahi uh.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Judah, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

paite: Issakar tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

paite: Issakar nam a asimte uh singnga sangli-le-zali ahi uh.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

paite: Zebulun tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Zebulun, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

paite: Zebulun nam a asimte uh singnga sangsagih-le-zali ahi uh.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

paite: Joseph tate lak a Ephraim tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh tamdan bang zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Joseph: of the children of Ephraim, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

paite: Ephraim nam a asimte uh singli-le-zanga ahi uh.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred.

paite: Manasseh tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh tamdan bang zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Manasseh, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

paite: Manasseh nam a asimte uh singthum sangnih-le-zanih ahi uh.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

paite: Benjamin tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh tamdan bang zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

paite: Benjamin nam a asimte uh, singthum sangnga-le-zali ahi uh.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

paite: Dan tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh tamdan bang zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Dan, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

paite: Dan nam a asimte uh, singguk sangnih- le-zasagih ahi uh.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

paite: Asher tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh tamdan bang zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

paite: Asher nam a asimte uh, singli sangkhat-le-zanga ahi uh.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

paite: Naphtali tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh tamdan bang zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

paite: Naphtali nam a asimte uh, singnga sangthum-le-zali ahi uh.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

paite: Hiaite Mosi leh Aaron in Israel vaihawm makai sawm-le-nih, inkuan a lupente toh asimte uh ahi.
english: These are those who were counted, whom Moses and Aaron counted, and the twelve men who were princes of Israel, each one for his fathers’ house.

paite: Huchi in Israel suan a-inkuankuan ua kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng, Israel gam ate sim ahi uhi.
english: So all those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war in Israel—

paite: Asim teng uh nuaiguk sangthum zanga-le-sawmnga ahi uh.
english: all those who were counted were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

paite: Levite pipute asimtel kei uh.
english: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not counted among them.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: For Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Levi chi na simtel ding ahi kei, Israel mite lak ah na simtel ding ahi sam kei.
english: “Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count, neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel;

paite: "Levite theihpihna biakbuk kem mite leh van tengteng kem mite dia seh zawk ding ahi. Biakbuk a van tengteng azawng ding ua, akem ding ua, biakbuk akimvel in a-omkhum ding uhi.
english: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; and they shall take care of it, and shall encamp around it.

paite: Biakbuk malam a apai chiang in Levite'n aphel ding ua; biakbuk kaih ding chiang in Levite mah in akai nawn ding uh. Namdang hong kigolh peuhmah hihlup ding ahi.
english: When the tabernacle is to move, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.

paite: "Israel suante'n amau mun chiat ah, apawlpawl in atamdan uh dungzui zel in apuaninte uh akai ding uh.
english: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their divisions.

paite: Himahleh Levite'n Israel suan omkhawmte tung a hehna a-omlouhna ding in theihpihna biakbuk kimvel ah akai ding uhi. Levite'n theihpihna biakbuk akep ding uh," achi hi.
english: But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel. The Levites shall be responsible for the Tabernacle of the Testimony.”

paite: Huchibang in Israel suante'n TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a thu apiak tengteng bang in ahihta uhi.
english: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they did.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Dangka pengkul nih bawl inla; sekthoh in bawl in. Mipi omkhawmte sapkhawmna ding leh pawtsakna dia na zat ding ahi.
english: “Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the congregation and for the journeying of the camps.

paite: Huai akimut chiang in mipi omkhawmte tengteng na kiang ah kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak bul a ahong kikhop vek ding uh ahi.
english: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Khat lel amut uleh Israel mipite heutu intekpente kia na kiang a ahong paikhawm ding uh ahi.
english: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.

paite: Gallau mut a na mut uleh suahlam pang a omte apawt ding uhi.
english: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.

paite: Gallau mut a na mut nawn uleh simlam pang a omte apawt ding uhi. Apawtna ding un gallau mut bang a amut ding uh ahi.
english: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

paite: Himahleh mipite hong paikhawmna ding in na mut peuhmah ding ua, gallau mut a bel mut lou in.
english: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.

paite: Aaron tapa siampute'n pengkul amut ding uh ahi. Huai nou a ding in na suante uh tan a tangtawn dan ahi ding hi.
english: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations.

paite: Na gam ua melma, nou hon nuaisiahte dou dia na kuan chiang un gallau mut in pengkulte na mut ding uhi. Huchi in TOUPA na Pathian ma uah theihgigena ahi ding ua, na melmate ua pan humbit na hi ding uh.
english: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets. Then you will be remembered before Yahweh your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.

paite: Nuam na sak nite un, ahunbi a na ankuangluinate uah, na kha thakte uah, na halmang thillat uahte leh na kilemna thillat kithoihnate uah pengkul na mut ding uh ahi. Huchi in na Pathian ma uah nou a ding in theihgigena ahi ding. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi," chi in.
english: “Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God. I am Yahweh your God.”

paite: Akum nihna, akha nihna, huai kha ani sawmnih ni in, hichi ahong hi a, meipi in theihsakna biakbuk tung atungkah santa hi.
english: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the covenant.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante apaidan dungzui in Sinai gamdai a pan apawt ua; Paran gamdai ah meipi akhawlta hi.
english: The children of Israel went forward on their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.

paite: Mosi zang a TOUPA thupiak bang in apawt uhi.
english: They first went forward according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

paite: Amasapen in Judah pawlte, apawl uh tamdan dungzui zel in apawt ua; aheutu uh Amminadab tapa Nashon ahi.
english: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.

paite: Issakarte heutu Zuar tapa Nethaneel;
english: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.

paite: Zebulunte heutu Helon tapa Eliab ahi.
english: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.

paite: Biakbuk aphel ua, Gershon tapa leh Merari tapa biakbuk zawng mite apawt uhi.
english: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.

paite: Reubente apawl uh tamdan dungzui in apawt ua; aheutu uh Shedeur tapa Elizur ahi.
english: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.

paite: Simeonte heutu Zurishaddai tapa Selumiel ahi.
english: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.

paite: Gadte heutu Deuel tapa Eliasaph ahi.
english: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.

paite: Kohathte'n mun siangthou azawng ua, apawt ua; adangte'n atun ma un biakbuk ana lam uh.
english: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.

paite: Ephraimte apawl uh tamdan dungzui in apawt ua; aheutu uh Emihud tapa Elishama ahi.
english: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army.

paite: Manassehte heutu Pedazur tapa Gamaliel ahi.
english: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.

paite: Benjaminte heutu Gideoni tapa Abidan ahi.
english: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.

paite: Ananungpen in Dante apawl uh tamdan dungzui in apawt ua; aheutu uh Ammishaddai tapa Ahiezer ahi.
english: The standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rear guard of all the camps, set forward according to their armies. Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai was over his army.

paite: Asherte heutu Okran tapa Pagiel ahi.
english: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher.

paite: Naphtalite heutu Enan tapa Ahira ahi.
english: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.

paite: Hiai bang ahi Israel suante pawl atamdan dungzui ua apaidan uh, hiai bang in apai zom zel uhi.
english: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward.

paite: Mosi sunghpa Midian mi Reuel tapa Hobab kiang ah, Mosi in, "K'on pe ding, TOUPA'N achihna mun ah ka pai ding ua, ka kiang uah hong sam inla, hoihtak in na tung ah ka hih ding uh. TOUPA'N Israel suante tungtang thu lah hoih in agenta ngal a," achi hi.
english: Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which Yahweh said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for Yahweh has spoken good concerning Israel.”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Ka hong dah mai ding, ka gam uah ka tanaute kiang ah ka pai zaw mai ding," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my relatives.”

paite: Ama'n, "Hon paisan mahmah ke'n, gamdai ah lah giahphual satna ding na thei zaw ngal a, kou a ding in mit na hong hi ding hi.
english: Moses said, “Don’t leave us, please; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.

paite: Hichi ahi dia, ka kiang ua na hong samleh, ahi, hichi ahi ding. TOUPA'N thil hoih hon hihsak bang in ka hon hihsak sam zel ding uhi," achi hi.
english: It shall be, if you go with us—yes, it shall be—that whatever good Yahweh does to us, we will do the same to you.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA tang a pan ni thum lam ah apai ua; TOUPA thukhun bawm amau a dia kingakna mun zong in ama uah ni thum lam ah ana pai masa hi.
english: They set forward from the Mount of Yahweh three days’ journey. The ark of Yahweh’s covenant went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.

paite: Abuk ua pan apawt un TOUPA meipi sun in atung uah a-om hi.
english: The cloud of Yahweh was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai bawm apawt ding peuhmah chiang in Mosi in, "TOUPA aw, hong kisa inla, na melmate hawlzak in, nang hon hote na ma ah taikek uhen," achi zel hi.
english: When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, Yahweh, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”

paite: Akingakna peuh ah, TOUPA aw, Israel mipi sang tampite kiang ah hong kik nawn in, achi zel hi.
english: When it rested, he said, “Return, Yahweh, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”

paite: Huan mipite'n TOUPA zak a phun in thil hoih lou pipi agen ua; TOUPA'N huai azak in ahehta hi. Huchi in TOUPA mei alak uah ahong kuang a, giahphual ponungpen a omte akangta hi.
english: The people were complaining in the ears of Yahweh. When Yahweh heard it, his anger burned; and Yahweh’s fire burned among them, and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.

paite: Huchi in mipite'n Mosi asam ua; TOUPA kiang ah Mosi athum a, huai mei amitta hi.
english: The people cried to Moses; and Moses prayed to Yahweh, and the fire abated.

paite: TOUPA mei alak ua ahong kat ziak in, huai mun min Taberah asa hi.
english: The name of that place was called Taberah, because Yahweh’s fire burned among them.

paite: Alak ua mikihel pawl khat in sa lunggulhna ahon neita ua; Israel suante leng akap nawn ua, "Kua'n ahia nek ding sa hon pe ding?
english: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly; and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who will give us meat to eat?

paite: Ut leh dah a Aigupta gam a ngasa i nek zelte i theigige ua, tangmaite, mazelte, phulun sialnek chite, vaiphulunte, phulun ngou leng.
english: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;

paite: Himahleh tu in i guhngek uh akeu khinta, bangmah lamet ding a-om kei, manna lel lou ngal," achi uhi.
english: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”

paite: Manna bel koriandar tang bang, alatdan in bedeli suang bang ahi.
english: The manna was like coriander seed, and it looked like bdellium.

paite: Mite'n atomkhawm ua, gawinelna in agawinel ua, sum in asu ua, belte ah ahuan ua, tanghou in abawl uhi. Nek in sathau a kan tanghou abang hi.
english: The people went around, gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it. Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.

paite: Giahphual a zan a dai akiak in manna leng ahong kia hi.
english: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.

paite: Mipite a-inkuankuan un apuanin kongkhak chiat uah akap uh, chih Mosi in ana za hi. TOUPA aheh mahmah a; Mosi leng alungkim kei hi.
english: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and Yahweh’s anger burned greatly; and Moses was displeased.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA kiang ah, "Bangziak in ahia na sikha na hon sukgim a, bang ahia na mit ka tunlouhna, hiai mite tengteng puakgik ka tung a na ngak?
english: Moses said to Yahweh, “Why have you treated your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?

paite: Hiai mipite tengteng ka suan ahi ua hia? Api-le-pute uh kiang a kichiam a piak na chiam gam a pilut ding in. Naupommi in nawitui ne lai a pom bang in na angsung ah pom in, na hon chih dia ka pikhiak?
english: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them out, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers’?

paite: Hiai mipi tengteng piak ding sa koi a pan ka nei dia? 'Ka nek ding un sa hon pia in,' chi in akap ngal ua.
english: Where could I get meat to give all these people? For they weep before me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’

paite: Hiai mipi tengteng keimah kia in ka po zou kei. Kei a ding in agik lua hi.
english: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

paite: Hichibang a hon hih ding na hihleh, hon sisak vanglak in, na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tanleh, ka gentheihna hon musak nawn mahmah ke'n," achi hi.
english: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my wretchedness.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Israelte Upa, mipite Upa leh aheutute uh hi a na theih mi sawmsagih ka kiang ah hon pikhawm inla, kihoupihna biakbuk ah nangmah toh dingkhawm ding in hon pi in.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.

paite: Huchi in ka hong pawt dia, huai ah ka hong houpih ding. Na tung a om kha om pen atung uah ka koih ding. Nang kia'n po lou in mipite puakgik ahon puakpih ding uhi.
english: I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you don’t bear it yourself alone.

paite: Nang mipite kiang ah, zingchiang a ding in kihihsiangthou vek unla; huchi in sa na ne ding uh. Sa nek ding kuan ahia hon pe ding? Aigupta gam a nuam i saksak uh toh, chi in TOUPA zak in na kap ua; huaiziak in, TOUPA'N noute sa ahon pe dia, huchi in na ne ding uhi.
english: “Say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, and you will eat meat; for you have wept in the ears of Yahweh, saying, “Who will give us meat to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt.” Therefore Yahweh will give you meat, and you will eat.

paite: Ni khat kia, ni nih kia, ni sawm kia, ni sawmnih kia leng na ne kei ding ua;
english: You will not eat just one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days,

paite: himahleh kha khat pumlum, na nakvang ua ahong pawtkhiak a nou a dia kihhuai ahong hih masiah na ne ding uh. Na lak ua om TOUPA na deih louh ua, Aigupta gam a pan bangziak a paikhia i hi ua? chi a, ama a na kah ziak un," achi hi.
english: but a whole month, until it comes out at your nostrils, and it is loathsome to you; because you have rejected Yahweh who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, “Why did we come out of Egypt?”’”

paite: Mosi in, "Ka ompih mipite khe a pai thei kia leng nuaiguk ahi ua; kha khat pumlum nek ding in sa ka pe ding, na chi hi.
english: Moses said, “The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, ‘I will give them meat, that they may eat a whole month.’

paite: Belamhon leh ganhon leng gohsak lehang leng, akham ding ua hia? Tuipi a ngasa tengteng leng matsak vek lehang leng, akhamzou ding ua hia?" achi hi.
english: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?”

paite: TOUPA'N, Mosi kiang ah, "TOUPA khut tomsak ahi a hia? Na tung ah ka thu bang a, atun leh tun louh na thei mai ding,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Has Yahweh’s hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”

paite: Mosi apawt a, TOUPA thu mipite ahilh hi. Mipite Upa sawmsagihte asamkhawm a, puanin kim ah adingsak hi.
english: Moses went out, and told the people Yahweh’s words; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the Tent.

paite: Meipi ah TOUPA ahong suk a, ahong houpih a, ama tung a om Kha pen Upa sawmsagihte tung ah akoih hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, atung ua kha akoihtak in thu agen ua; agen zom sawt kei uhi.
english: Yahweh came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.

paite: Himahleh giahphual ah mi nih a-om lai ua, khat min Eldad ahi, akhat pen min Medad ahi. Atung uah kha a-om a, upate lak a min khum ahi ua, himahleh kihoupihna biakbuk ah bel ahoh kei uhi. Giahphual ah thu agen uhi.
english: But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad; and the Spirit rested on them. They were of those who were written, but had not gone out to the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.

paite: Huchi in tangval khat ava tai a, Mosi ava hilh a, "Eldad leh Medad in giahphual ah thu agen uh," achi hi.
english: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”

paite: Nun tapa Joshua, atuailai a pan Mosi nasempa'n adawng a, "Ka toupa Mosi, kham ve,” achi hi.
english: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”

paite: Mosi in akiang ah, "Kei gum a na thikthu sia hia? Pathian mi tengteng zawlnei hi vek le uh, TOUPA'N atung uah tua Kha koihchiatleh chi zomah lai ka hi!" achi hi.
english: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all Yahweh’s people were prophets, that Yahweh would put his Spirit on them!”

paite: Huchi in Mosi leh Israel Upa tengteng giahphual ah alut nawn uhi.
english: Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

paite: TOUPA a pan huih ahong nung a, tuipi a pan vengkeng ahon mutleng a, giahphual lehlam sang ni khat lam, alehlam ni khat lamtuak dimsuak in giahphual kim ah tong nih ding a sang in akesak hi.
english: A wind from Yahweh went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the earth.

paite: Mipite'n huai ni nitum leh zankhua leh azing nitum tan in vengkeng ava tomkhawm ua; atom tawmpen in leng homer sawm atom hi. Giahphual kim ah amau a chiat aphou uhi.
english: The people rose up all that day, and all of that night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers; and they spread them all out for themselves around the camp.

paite: Huai sa anek lai un, anek khit ma un, mipite tung ah TOUPA aheh mahmah a, TOUPA'N hipi nasatak in mipite agawtta hi.
english: While the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, Yahweh’s anger burned against the people, and Yahweh struck the people with a very great plague.

paite: Hiai mun min Kibroth-hattaavah asa a; huai a saduhte avui ziak un.
english: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who lusted.

paite: Kibroth-hattaavah a pan mipite Hazeroth ah apai ua; Hazeroth ah agiahphual uh asat uhi.
english: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.

paite: Huan Miriam leh Aaron in Mosi in Kus numei zi a, aneih ziak in agensia ua; Kus numei bel anei ngei hi.
english: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.

paite: Amau, "Mosi kiang kia ah hia TOUPA'N thu agen tuam? Ei kiang ah leng agen sam kei a hia?" achi uh. TOUPA'N huai ana za hi.
english: They said, “Has Yahweh indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And Yahweh heard it.

paite: Mosi bel leitung a mihing tengteng sang in amigi mahmah hi.
english: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.

paite: Thakhat in TOUPA'N Mosi, Aaron leh Miriam kiang ah, "Na thum un hong paisuk unla, kihoupihna biakbuk ah hong pai un," achi hi. Huchi in athum un ava hoh uhi.
english: Yahweh spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.

paite: TOUPA meipi dingh ah ahong paisuk a, puanin kongkhak ah ahong dingh a, Aaron leh Miriam asam a; anih un ahong paisuk uhi.
english: Yahweh came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.

paite: Ama'n, "Ka thu ngaikhia un. Na lak ua zawlnei na om uleh amah kiang ah kei TOUPA kilakna in ka kihil dia, manglam in ka houpih ding.
english: He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, Yahweh, will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.

paite: Ka sikha Mosi bel huchibang ahi kei. Ka inko tengteng ah amuanhuai hi.
english: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.

paite: Amah toh paukam in thuguk om lou in teltak in ka kihou ding ua; TOUPA mel leng amu ding. Huaiziak in ka sikha Mosi bangchidan a gense ngam na hi ua?" achi hi.
english: With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see Yahweh’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA atung uah aheh mahmah a, apai nawnta hi.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against them; and he departed.

paite: Puanin tung ah meipi akikhinta hi. Ngai in, Miriam vuk bang a ngou in ahong phakta a; Aaron in Miriam a-en a, ngai in, phak ana hita maimah hi,
english: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.

paite: Huchi in Aaron in Mosi kiang ah, "Ka toupa aw, ka tung uah khelhna nga mahmah ke'n. Haihuaitak in ka na hihta ua, ka na khialta uhi.
english: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.

paite: Anu sul a pan sisa phial mahmah a ahong pawt bang in amah omsak ke'n," achi hi.
english: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in, "Pathian aw, damsak nawn dih ve," chi in TOUPA angen hi.
english: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Apa'n amai chilsiat hilhial taleh ni sagih azakta kei ding maw? Giahphual pua ah ni sagih kibu henla; huai khit chiang in pilut nawn hi hen," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”

paite: Huchi in giahphual pua ah ni sagih sung Miriam khumtuam in a-om hi. Miriam apilut nawn ma un mipite akisuan kei uhi.
english: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.

paite: Huai khit in mipite Hazeroth a pan apawt ua, Paran gamdai ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante ka piak, Kanaan gam va enkhe ding in mi sawl in. Anam inko chih ua mi, a-intekpa pen lak a mi khat chiat na sawl ding,” achi hi.
english: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”

paite: Mosi in Paran gamdai a pan TOUPA thupiak bang in akuansakta a; avek un Israel suante lak a intekpa pen chiat ahi uhi.
english: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of Yahweh. All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.

paite: Hiaite amin uh ahi: Reuben nam lak a mi Zakkur tapa Shammua.
english: These were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

paite: Simeon nam lak a mi Hori tapa Shaphat.
english: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

paite: Judah nam lak a mi Jephunneh tapa Kaleb.
english: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

paite: Issakar nam lak a mi Joseph tapa Igal.
english: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

paite: Ephraim nam lak a mi Nun tapa Hoshea.
english: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.

paite: Benjamin nam lak a mi Raphu tapa Palti.
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

paite: Zebulun nam lak a mi Sodi tapa Gaddiel.
english: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

paite: Joseph nam, Manasseh nam achih uh, lak a mi Susi tapa Gaddi.
english: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

paite: Dan nam lak a mi Gemalli tapa Ammiel.
english: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

paite: Asher nam lak a mi Mikael tapa Sethur.
english: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

paite: Naphtali nam lak a mi Vophsi tapa Nahbi.
english: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

paite: Gad nam lak a mi Maki tapa Geuel.
english: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

paite: Hiaite gam enkhe dia Mosi in asawlte min ahi. Mosi in Nun tapa Hoshea, Joshua achi hi.
english: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.

paite: Huchi in Mosi in Kanaan gam enkhe ding in amaute asawl a, akiang uah, "Simlam lampi ah pai phot unla, tangte ah kahtou un.
english: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country.

paite: Huai gam bangchibang ahia, huai a teng mipite ahat uh hia, hat lou, atawm uh leh atam uh;
english: See the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;

paite: atenna gam uh ahoih hia hoih lou, a-omna khuate uh bangchibang ahia, puanin maimah hia, kulh nei;
english: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;

paite: huai gam lei thau ahi hia, lei gawng, gammang om hia om lou chih va enkhia un. Hangsantak in om unla, huai gam theigahte hon pua un," achi hi. Tu grep gah masa gah hun laitak ahi.
english: and what the land is, whether it is fertile or poor, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.

paite: Huchi in akuantouta ua, huai gam Zin gamdai a pan Hamath lutna Rehob tan in a-enkhe vek uhi.
english: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.

paite: Simlam ah ahohtou phot ua, Hebron ava tung ua, huai ah Anak suan Ahiman, Sheshai leh Talmai a-om uhi. Hebron bel Aigupta gam a Zoan kilam ma kum sagih a kilam khinta ahi.
english: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

paite: Eshkol Phaizang ava tung ua, huai ah grep gahbom khat ahiang toh asattan ua, chiang in mi nih in azawng uhi. Theibuhfai leh theipite leng apua uhi.
english: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.

paite: Israel suante'n huai a grep bom asatkhiak ziak un, huai mun Eshkol Phaizang asa uhi.
english: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.

paite: Ni sawmli zoh in gam etkhiakna a pan ahong kik nawn uhi.
english: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.

paite: Huchi in Paran gamdai a Kadesh ah Mosi leh Aaron leh Israel suan mipi omkhawmte tengteng kiang ahong tung ua, akiang uah leh mipi omkhawmte tengteng kiang ah thu ahon tun ua, huai gam theite a-ensak uhi.
english: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation. They showed them the fruit of the land.

paite: Akiang ah, "N'on sawlna gam ah ka va hoh ua, bawngnawi leh khuaizu luanna ana hi ngei ngut a; hiai agam thei ahi.
english: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
