paite: Himahleh agam a mi tengte mihat pipi ahi ua, khuate leng kulh nei, thupi taktak ahi. Anak suante leng ka va mu uh.
english: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.

paite: Simlam gam ah Amalekte ateng ua; tanggam ah Hitte, Jebuste, Amorte ateng uh. Tuipi gei leh Jordan luidung ah Kanaante ateng uh," chi in ahilh uhi.
english: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi ma ah Kaleb in mipite adaisak khipkhep a, "Kisa tou zok ni in, va latou zok ni, i zou ngeingei ding uh," achi hi.
english: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let’s go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!”

paite: Himahleh ahohpihte'n, "I va zou vek thei kei ding e, ei sang in lah ahatzaw ngal ua," achi uhi.
english: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”

paite: Huchi in Israel suante kiang ah, "Ka va gam etkhiak uh gam, enkhe dia ka va vakna uh, asung a mi tengte nek khit hatmi ahi ua; ami om ka muhte uh mi awmkhauh pipi ahi uh.
english: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.

paite: Huai ah Anak suante, miliante, awmkhauh pipi ka va mu ua; koute lah khaupe bang lel in ka va kimu ua, amau leng khaupe ek bang lel in ahon mu uh," chi in ahoih lou lam in agen uhi.
english: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”

paite: Huan omkhawm tengteng aw suah in akap ua; huai zan in mite akap uhi.
english: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

paite: Israel suan tengteng Mosi tung leh Aaron tung ah aphun ua; omkhawm tengteng in akiang uah, "Aigupta gam ah Pathian in hon that geih hileh aw! Ahihkeileh gamdai ah hon na that geih hileh aw!
english: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, “We wish that we had died in the land of Egypt, or that we had died in this wilderness!

paite: Bang achia namsau a si maimah dia Pathian in hiai gam a hon pi ahi diam aw? I zi leh i tate lah mat maimah ding ahi ngal ua. Aigupta gam a kik nawn ei a dia hoihzaw lou ding hia? achi uhi.
english: Why does Yahweh bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed! Wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”

paite: Huchi in akihoukhawm ua, heutu bawl ni e, Aigupta gam ah kik nawn ni," achi uhi.
english: They said to one another, “Let’s choose a leader, and let’s return into Egypt.”

paite: Huchi in Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng ma ah Mosi leh Aaron abokkhup uhi.
english: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

paite: Nun tapa Joshua leh Jephunneh tapa Kaleb, gam va enkhete lak a telte'n apuan uh abotkek uh.
english: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.

paite: Israel suan omkhawm tengteng kiang ah, "Enkhe dia ka va vakna gam uh gam hoihtak ahi.
english: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceedingly good land.

paite: I tung ua TOUPA akipahleh huai gam ah ahon pilut ngei ding. Huai nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam ahon pe ding hi.
english: If Yahweh delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us: a land which flows with milk and honey.

paite: TOUPA tung ah hel kei phot le uchin. Huai gam a mite leng lau sam kei un. I an ding uh ahi ua, akihumbitna uh bangmah ahi kei. TOUPA i kiang uah a-om hi, amau lau kei un," chi in agen uhi.
english: Only don’t rebel against Yahweh, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is removed from over them, and Yahweh is with us. Don’t fear them.”

paite: Himahleh omkhawm tengteng in suang a den asawm ua; huchi in kihoupihna biakbuk, Israel suan tengteng ma ah TOUPA thupina ahong kilangta hi.
english: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. Yahweh’s glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all the children of Israel.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Hiai mipite'n bang tan hon thusim lou ding ahi ua; alak ua chiamtehna ka hih zel nangawn a leng bang tan ahia hon taksan louh lai ding uh?
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? How long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?

paite: Hipi in ka gawt dia, ka in-gamsak dia, nangmah ah amau sang a thupi leh thilhihtheizaw nam ka bawlkhe zaw mai ding,” achi hi.
english: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”

paite: Mosi in TOUPA kiang ah, "Aigupta mite'n aza kha ding uh. Hiai mite lah alak ua pan na thilhihtheihna a na pikhiakte ahi ngal ua.
english: Moses said to Yahweh, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.

paite: Hiai gam a teng mite ahilh ding uh. Hiai mite lak ah nang TOUPA na om chih azata uh. Kimaituah hial a muh in na om a, atung uah na meipi a-om a; sun in meipi dingh, zan in meikuang in ama uh lah na pi zel hi.
english: They will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you Yahweh are among this people; for you Yahweh are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them, and you go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.

paite: Hiai mite na thahgamleh na minthanna za namte'n,
english: Now if you killed this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,

paite: TOUPA'N hiai mite kichiam a, achiam gam a api theih louh ziak in gamdai ah athatta, achi ding uh.
english: ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.’

paite: Tu in ka hon ngen ahi, ka TOUPA thilhihtheihna hih thupi in om hen, thu a na gen tak dungzui in;
english: Now please let the power of the Lord be great, according as you have spoken, saying,

paite: TOUPA lungneltak, migitna hau, thulimlouhnate, tatleknate ngaidam zel; moh a asehte khah ngei loupa, pate thulimlouhna tate, tate tasawnte, suan thumna leh suan lina tan a gawt zel ahi, na chi hi.
english: ‘Yahweh is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and he will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.’

paite: Na migitna athupi bang ngei leh Aigupta gam a pan tutan a na ngaihdam bang in mipite thulimlouhna ngaidam in," achi hi.
english: Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness, and just as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.”

paite: TOUPA'N, "Na thu bang in ka ngaidam hi.
english: Yahweh said, “I have pardoned according to your word;

paite: Himahleh kei ka hin bang in TOUPA thupina in leitung pumpi adimsak ding.
english: but in very deed—as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with Yahweh’s glory—

paite: Aigupta gam leh gamdai a ka thupina leh ka thillamdang hihte mu a, huchi pipi a leng sawmveitak hon ze-et lailai a, ka thu zui lou lai mi tengteng in;
english: because all those men who have seen my glory and my signs, which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not listened to my voice;

paite: apipute uh kiang a kichiam a ka chiam huai gam amu kei hial ding uh. Alak ua kei hon ngaineute mawngmawng in leng amu sam kei ding uh.
english: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any of those who despised me see it.

paite: Ka sikha Kaleb in bel lungsim dang aput a, ahon zuih taktak ziak in, amah zaw ava hohna gam ah ka pilut dia, asuante'n huai aluah ding uh.
english: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him I will bring into the land into which he went. His offspring shall possess it.

paite: Phaizang a Amalekte leh Kanaante teng ahih ziak un, zingchiang in kihei unla, Tuipi San lampi lam gamdai ah lut un," achi hi.
english: Since the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley, tomorrow turn and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: "Hiai mithulim lou omkhawmte, ka tung a phunphunte bang tan ahia ka dohzoh ding? Israel suante phunna, ka tung a aphunnate uh ka za hi.
english: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation that complain against me? I have heard the complaints of the children of Israel, which they complain against me.

paite: Akiang uah, ka hin bang in ka gen ahi, ka bilbuk ngei a na gen bang un na tung uah ka hih ding hi.
english: Tell them, ‘As I live, says Yahweh, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so I will do to you.

paite: Na luang uh gamdai ah apuk dia; na lak ua simsa mi tengteng, kum sawmnih a pan atunglam ka tung a phun teng,
english: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were counted of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have complained against me,

paite: ban zak hial a, ka hon omsak ding, ka chih gam ah Jephunneh tapa Kaleb leh Nun tapa Joshua kia lou ngal na lut kei ding uh,
english: surely you shall not come into the land concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

paite: Himahleh mat ding lel ahi ding uh, na chih uh na tate uh ka pilut dia, na ngaihneu uh gam athei ding uhi.
english: But I will bring in your little ones that you said should be captured or killed, and they shall know the land which you have rejected.

paite: "Nou bel na luang uh hiai gamdai ah apuk ding hi.
english: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.

paite: Na tate uh gamdai ah kum sawmli sung avakvai ding ua, gamdai a na luangte uh amawk man masiah na kizuakna uh amau athuakloh ding uhi.
english: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead bodies are consumed in the wilderness.

paite: Gam na va etkhiak ni zah uh, ni sawmli, ni khat tang in kum khat zel, kum sawmli sung na tatlekna uh na thuakloh ding ua, huchi in ka thuchiam ka hihlamdan dan na thei ding uhi.
english: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’

paite: Kei TOUPA'N migilou omkhawm, kei hon kalh a omkhawmte tung ah hiai ka hih ngei ding ka na chi khinta hi. Hiai gamdai ah amangthang ding ua. Huai ah asi ding uh," achi hi.
english: I, Yahweh, have spoken. I will surely do this to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.”

paite: Gam enkhe dia Mosi misawl hong kik nawnte'n, gam omdan ahoih lou lam agen un amah tung ah omkhawmte aphunsak hi.
english: The men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation to murmur against him by bringing up an evil report against the land,

paite: Huai gam omdan ahoih lou lam agente ngei TOUPA ma ah hipi in asita uhi.
english: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before Yahweh.

paite: Gam enkhe dia hohte lak a Nun tapa Joshua leh Jephunneh tapa Kaleb bel asi kei uhi.
english: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.

paite: Mosi in huai thute Israel suan tengteng ahilh a; huchi in mipite'n nakpitak in asuun uhi.
english: Moses told these words to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.

paite: Huchi in zingsangpi in athou ua, tang vum ah ahohtou ua, "Ngai in, hiai ah ka hong pai uh. TOUPA'N ahon chiamna mun ah ka hoh ding uh, ka na khialta uhi," achi uhi.
english: They rose up early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, “Behold, we are here, and will go up to the place which Yahweh has promised; for we have sinned.”

paite: Mosi in, "Tu a bangziak a TOUPA thupiak palsat na hi ua? Hiai alohching kei ding.
english: Moses said, “Why now do you disobey the commandment of Yahweh, since it shall not prosper?

paite: Na kiang ua TOUPA a-om louh ziak in hohtou kei un; melmate thah a na omlouhna ding un," achi hi.
english: Don’t go up, for Yahweh isn’t among you; that way you won’t be struck down before your enemies.

paite: "Na ma uah Amalekte leh Kanaante a-om uhi. Namsau a thah na hi phet ding uh. TOUPA na lehngatsan tak ziak un na kiang uah TOUPA a-om kei ding," achi hi.
english: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you will fall by the sword because you turned back from following Yahweh; therefore Yahweh will not be with you.”

paite: Himahleh mualvum a hoh atum ua; himahleh TOUPA thukhun bawm leh Mosi giahphual a pan apawtkhe kei uhi.
english: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of Yahweh’s covenant and Moses didn’t depart out of the camp.

paite: Huchi in huai mual a om Amalekte leh Kanaante hong kuansuk in, ahong dou ua, Hormah tanpha in asatpuk phengphung uhi.
english: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down even to Hormah.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, tenna ding a gam ka hon piakna na tun chiang un,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,

paite: TOUPA kiang a mei a thillat ahihkeileh halmang thillat, ahihkeileh thuchiam tangtun dia kithoihna, ahihkeileh noumau ut thu a thillat, ahihkeileh ankuanglui hunbi, ahihkeileh ganhon lak, ahihkeileh belamhon lak, ahihkeileh TOUPA a dia gimlim bawl ding a na lat chiang un,
english: and will make an offering by fire to Yahweh—a burnt offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a free will offering, or in your set feasts, to make a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, of the herd, or of the flock—

paite: TOUPA kiang a thillat lanmi peuhmah in tangbuang thillat, tangbuang nelte ephah mun sawm a khen mun khat, sathau hin mun li a khen mun khat a mek alat ding ahi.
english: then he who offers his offering shall offer to Yahweh a meal offering of one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with one fourth of a hin of oil.

paite: Dawn thillat dia uain hin mun li a khen mun khat halmang thillat, ahihkeileh kithoihna belamnou khat a dia na bawl ding uh ahi.
english: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering, one fourth of a hin, with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.

paite: Belamtal a tangbuang thillat, tangbuang nelte, ephah mun sawm a khen mun nih, sathau hin mun thum a khen mun khat mek na bawl ding uh ahi.
english: “‘For a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil;

paite: Dawn thillat dia TOUPA a ding a gimlim ding uain hin mun thum a khen mun khat na lat ding uh ahi.
english: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Haltum thillat ding, ahihkeileh thuchiam tangtun dia kithoihna, ahihkeileh TOUPA kiang a lemna thillat a bawngtal na lat chiang un;
english: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to Yahweh,

paite: Bawngtal lat toh kiton in tangbuang thillat tangbuang nelte ephah mun sawm a khen mun thum sathau hin kimkhat a mek na lat ding uh ahi.
english: then he shall offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil;

paite: Dawn thillat dia uain hin kimkhat, TOUPA a dia gimlim mei a thillat na lat ding uh ahi.
english: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: "Huchibang in bawngtal, ahihkeileh belampa, ahihkeileh belamnou, ahihkeileh kelnou ahi ding ahi.
english: Thus it shall be done for each bull, for each ram, for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats.

paite: Atamdan uh dungzui zel in na bawl ding ua, atamdan uh dungzui zel in na lan ding uhi.
english: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.

paite: Huai gam a piang tengteng in hichibang zel in TOUPA a dia gimlim mei a thillat alat chiang un ahih ding uhi.
english: “‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Namdangmi na kiang ua tengsa him ahihkeileh kuapeuh na kiang ua teng zelzel ding hiamte'n leng TOUPA a dia gimlim mei a thillat lan nuam peuhmah in na hih bang ua ahih sam ding uh ahi.
english: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, as you do, so he shall do.

paite: Na suante uh leh mipite leh namdang na kiang ua omte a dia leng dan khat kia a-om ding ahi. TOUPA ma ah namdangte noumau bang ahi ding uh.
english: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner, a statute forever throughout your generations. As you are, so the foreigner shall be before Yahweh.

paite: Nou a ding leh na kiang ua namdang omte a ding in dan khat leh hihdan kibang khat kia a-om ding," achi hi.
english: One law and one ordinance shall be for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, hichi ahi ding a, ka hon pina ding gam na va tun ua,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land where I bring you,

paite: huai gam tanghou na nek chiang un, TOUPA kiang ah vei thillat na lan ding uh ahi.
english: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a wave offering to Yahweh.

paite: Na tanghou mek masakpen lak ua beu khatvei thillat dia na lat ding uh ahi. Buhphual a vei thillat dia na vei bang un na vei ding uhi.
english: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering. As the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.

paite: Na suante uh tan in na tanghou mek masakpen uh TOUPA kiang a vei thillat dia na lat zel ding uh ahi.
english: Of the first of your dough, you shall give to Yahweh a wave offering throughout your generations.

paite: "Hiai thupiak tengteng, TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a agen, tup mawng hilou a zuih khak louh na neih uleh,
english: “‘When you err, and don’t observe all these commandments which Yahweh has spoken to Moses—

paite: TOUPA'N thu apiak tung a pan na suante uh tan a dia Mosi zang a thu apiak tengteng chihna ahi.
english: even all that Yahweh has commanded you by Moses, from the day that Yahweh gave commandment and onward throughout your generations—

paite: Hichi ahi dia, omkhawmte'n thei lou a, ahih khak uh ahihleh, omkhawm tengteng in halmang thillat TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in bawngtuai khat alan ding ua, adan ngeina bang in tangbuang thillat leh dawn thillat toh, khelhna kithoihna ding in keltal khat leng alan tel ding uh ahi.
english: then it shall be, if it was done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, with its meal offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one male goat for a sin offering.

paite: Siampu in Israel suan omkhawm tengteng a ding in kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding uh. Thei lou a hihkhak ahih ziak leh athillat uh TOUPA a dia mei a thillat leh ahihkhelh uh sik a khelhna kithoihna alat tak ziak un.
english: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh, and their sin offering before Yahweh, for their error.

paite: Israel suante omkhawm tengteng ngaihdam ahi ding ua, alak ua namdang omte leng; mipi tengteng in ahih khak uh ahih ziak in.
english: All the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, as well as the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them; for with regard to all the people, it was done unwittingly.

paite: "Mi'n thei lou a thil ahihkhelhleh khelhna kithoihna ding in kelnu khat kum khat a upa alat ding ahi.
english: “‘If a person sins unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.

paite: Thei lou a TOUPA ma a hihkhialmi a ding in siampu in kilemna abawl ding hi; huchi in ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
english: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs when he sins unwittingly before Yahweh. He shall make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.

paite: Thei lou a hihkhialmi a ding in, Israel suante, huai gam a piangte a ding leh namdangmi na lak ua omte a ding in leng dan khat na neih ding uh ahi.
english: You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them.

paite: "Himahleh tup mawng a hihkhial ahihleh, huai gam a piang hiam, namdang hiam leng hitaleh TOUPA gensia ahi a; huai mi achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
english: “‘But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, blasphemes Yahweh. That soul shall be cut off from among his people.

paite: TOUPA thu musit a, athupiak abohsiat ziak in, huai mi satkhiak ding ahi, athulimlouhna moh ama'n apo ding, chi in," achi hi.
english: Because he has despised Yahweh’s word, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall be utterly cut off. His iniquity shall be on him.’”

paite: Israel suante gamdai a a-om lai un mi khat Sabbath ni a sing tom amu uhi.
english: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.

paite: Asing tom mu mite'n amah Mosi leh Aaron leh mipi omkhawmte kiang ah ahon pi uhi.
english: Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.

paite: Bangchi a hih ding ahia chih genkhiak nai louh ahih ziak in tanna inn ah akhum uhi.
english: They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Hiai mi hihlup ngeingei ding ahi, giahphual pua ah mipi omkhawm tengteng in suang in adeng ding uh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “The man shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in mipi omkhawm tengteng in giahphual pua ah api ua, suang in adenglumta uhi.
english: All the congregation brought him outside of the camp, and stoned him to death with stones, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante kiang ah, asuante uh tanpha a, apuan mong ua agei bawl ding leh among teng gei a adum khak ding in gen in.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes on the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put on the fringe of each border a cord of blue.

paite: Huai among na et ua, TOUPA thupiak tengteng na theihgige ua na zuihna ding un leh; kizuak a na om zel bang ua na lungtang uh deih leh na mit uh la lam peuh deih a na omlouhna ding un.
english: It shall be to you for a fringe, that you may see it, and remember all Yahweh’s commandments, and do them; and that you don’t follow your own heart and your own eyes, after which you used to play the prostitute;

paite: Ka thupiak tengteng na theihgige ua na zuih ua, na Pathian uh a dia na sianthou theihna ding uh ahi.
english: so that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.

paite: Na Pathian uh hi ding a Aigupta gam a pan nou hon pikhepa TOUPA, na Pathian uh ka hi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi,” achi hi.
english: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Yahweh your God.”

paite: Levi tapa Kohath, huai tapa Izhar, huai tapa Korah pen Eliab tapate, Dathan leh Abiram leh Peleth tapa On leh Reuben tapate'n mite api ua;
english: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took some men.

paite: Israel suante, mi tallang deuhdeuh mipi omkhawmte lak a heutu vaihawmmi dia telte lak a mi zanih-le-sawmnga toh Mosi ma ah ava kisa uhi.
english: They rose up before Moses, with some of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown.

paite: Mosi leh Aaron kalh in akikhawm ua, akiang uah, "Na uang lua uh, na uang lua uh, omkhawm mipite lah asiangthou chiat ngal ua, TOUPA alak uah a-om chih mu zenpi a, bangziak a TOUPA mipi omkhawmte tung a kikoih na hi ua?" achi uh.
english: They assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, “You take too much on yourself, since all the congregation are holy, everyone of them, and Yahweh is among them! Why do you lift yourselves up above Yahweh’s assembly?”

paite: Mosi in huai azak in amai a lei si in abokkhup hi.
english: When Moses heard it, he fell on his face.

paite: Korah leh apawlte tengteng kiang ah, "Zingchiang in TOUPA'N amah ate kuate ahi ua, kuate ahia siangthou, chih ataklang ding a, akiang ah ahon pai naisak ding. Ama'n amitel ngei tan in akiangnai ah apaisak ding hi.
english: He said to Korah and to all his company, “In the morning, Yahweh will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to him. Even him whom he shall choose, he will cause to come near to him.

paite: Hichi in hih un, Korah leh apawlte tengteng aw, zingchiang in mei laknate tawi unla;
english: Do this: have Korah and all his company take censers,

paite: huai ah mei koih unla, TOUPA ma ah gimlim buak un. TOUPA'N atel peuhmah asiangthou ding. Levi tapate, na uang lua uh," chi in agen hi.
english: put fire in them, and put incense on them before Yahweh tomorrow. It shall be that the man whom Yahweh chooses, he shall be holy. You have gone too far, you sons of Levi!”

paite: Mosi in Korah kiang ah, "Nou Levi tapate aw, ngaikhia unla,
english: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!

paite: TOUPA biakbuk nasep sem ding leh khawmpi nna sem dia khawmpite ma a dingh a, amah kiang a hon om naisak ding a, Israel Pathian in Israel omkhawmte a pan noute ahon omsak, nou a dia thil neuchik phet a kilang hia?
english: Is it a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of Yahweh’s tabernacle, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them;

paite: Amah kiang ah ahon om naisakta a, na kiang a na unau Levi tapa tengteng, siamputna leng na zong ua hia?
english: and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? Do you seek the priesthood also?

paite: Huaiziak in nang leh na pawl tengteng TOUPA kalh in na kikhawm uh ahi. Aaron in bang ahih a ahia, atung a na phun uh?" achi hi.
english: Therefore you and all your company have gathered together against Yahweh! What is Aaron that you complain against him?”

paite: Mosi in Eliab tapa Dathan leh Abiram asamsak a, "Amau ka hong paitou kei ding uh.
english: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, “We won’t come up!

paite: Gamdai a hon that dia nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam a pan na hon pikhiak thil neuchik ahi hia? Ka tung uah na kilalsak nawn ngal a.
english: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but you must also make yourself a prince over us?

paite: Nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam ah na hon pilut kei a, lou ding leh grephuan gou ding lah na hon pe kei a; hiai mite mitte na mialsak ding maw? Ka hong paitou kei hial ding uh," achi uh.
english: Moreover you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We won’t come up.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi aheh mahmah a, "TOUPA kiang ah, athillat uh sang ke'n. Asabiltung uh khat lel leng ka la kei, kuamah ka hih na kei," achi hi.
english: Moses was very angry, and said to Yahweh, “Don’t respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, neither have I hurt one of them.”

paite: Mosi in Korah kiang ah, "Zingchiang in nang, na mi kikhawmte leh Aaron TOUPA ma ah ana om un.
english: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before Yahweh, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.

paite: Amei lakna uh tawi chiat uhenla, gimlim buak uhen. TOUPA ma ah amei lakna uh hon tawi uhenla, mei lakna zanih-le-sawmnga hon tawi uhen. Nang leh Aaron in leng na mei lakna uh tawi tuaktuak un," achi hi.
english: Each man take his censer and put incense on it, and each man bring before Yahweh his censer, two hundred fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each with his censer.”

paite: Huchi in michih in amei lakna uh atawi chiat ua, mei akoih ua, gimlim abuak ua, Mosi leh Aaron toh kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah ava dingh uhi.
english: They each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and stood at the door of the Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron.

paite: Korah in mipi tengteng ama ah kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah a-omkhawmsak a; mipi tengteng kiang ah TOUPA thupina ahong langta hi.
english: Korah assembled all the congregation opposite them to the door of the Tent of Meeting. Yahweh’s glory appeared to all the congregation.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: "Hiai mipi omkhawmte a pan kihuikhia un, amau ka hihmang guihtheihna ding in," achi hi.
english: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”

paite: Amau abokkhup ua, "Pathian aw, sa tengteng kha Pathian, mi khat khelh ziak in mipi omkhawm tengteng tung ah na heh dia hia?" achi uhi.
english: They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry with all the congregation?”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Mipite kiang ah, Korah, Dathan leh Abiram puanin a pan kihemkhia un, chi in gen in," achi hi.
english: “Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from around the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram!’”

paite: Mosi athoutou a, Dathan leh Abiram kiang ah ava hoh a; Israelte upate'n azui uhi.
english: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

paite: Omkhawmte kiang ah, "Hiai migiloute puanin a pan pawtkhia un. Abangmah uh khoih kei un, huchi lou in zaw akhelhna tengteng uah na pangkha ding uh," chi in agen hi.
english: He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins!”

paite: Huchi in Korah, Dathan leh Abiram puanin a pan apawtkhe duamduam ua; Dathan leh Abiram ahong pawtkhia ua, apuanin kongkhak uah azite, atapate leh atanu neu chikchikte uh toh adingh uhi.
english: So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.

paite: Mosi in, "Keimah lungsim a pawtkhia ahi kei a, hiai thilhih ding in TOUPA'N ahon sawl ahi, chih hiai ah na thei ding uh.
english: Moses said, “Hereby you shall know that Yahweh has sent me to do all these works; for they are not from my own mind.

paite: Hiai mi tengteng dan bang lel a asih ua, mi tengteng gawt bang lel a gawt ahih uleh Pathian in kei hon sawl lou ahi ding.
english: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they experience what all men experience, then Yahweh hasn’t sent me.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N thil thak abawl a, lei in akam akat a, amau leh amau a tengteng avalh a, ahing a Sheol alut uleh bel hiai mite'n TOUPA ana hehsak uh, chih na thei ding uh," achi hi.
english: But if Yahweh makes a new thing, and the ground opens its mouth, and swallows them up with all that belong to them, and they go down alive into Sheol, then you shall understand that these men have despised Yahweh.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai thu tengteng agen khit in anuai ua lei ahong khangkham phok hi.
english: As he finished speaking all these words, the ground that was under them split apart.

paite: Lei in akam aka a, a-inkuan un Korah mi tengteng, aneih tengteng uh toh avalh khin vekta hi.
english: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up with their households, all of Korah’s men, and all their goods.

paite: Huchi in amau leh amau a tengteng Sheol ah ahing in atum vek ua, lei in akam achihkhum a, omkhawmte lak a pan amangthangta uhi.
english: So they, and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol. The earth closed on them, and they perished from among the assembly.

paite: Huchi in akim ua Israel tengteng akikou husa uah ataizak ua, lei in ei leng ahon valh kha ding, achi uhi.
english: All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”

paite: TOUPA a pan meikuang ahong pawtkhia a, gimlim lanmi zanih-le-sawmnga ahong kanglumta hi.
english: Fire came out from Yahweh, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Aaron tapa siampu Eleazar kiang ah thu gen inla, ama'n meikuang a pan mei laknate lakhe ding in hilh in, siangthou lah ahita ngal ua.
english: “Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter the fire away from the camp; for they are holy,

paite: Ahinna tung mah a hiai mikhialte mei laknate maitam khuhna kuang ding in sek hi uhen, TOUPA ma a lat ahi ngal a. Huaiziak in asiangthou hi, huai Israel suante a ding in chiamtehna ahi ding," achi hi.
english: even the censers of those who sinned against their own lives. Let them be beaten into plates for a covering of the altar, for they offered them before Yahweh. Therefore they are holy. They shall be a sign to the children of Israel.”

paite: Siampu Eleazar in mi kangte dal mei laknate ala a; maitam khuhna ding in asekta hi.
english: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers which those who were burned had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,

paite: Israel suante a dia theihgigena hi ding in huchi a Aaron tate hilou namdang himhim, TOUPA ma a gimlim hal dia ahong pai nailouhna ding un. Mosi zang a akiang a TOUPA'Nagen bang a, Korah leh apawlte bang ahong hihlouhna ding in.
english: to be a memorial to the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger who isn’t of the offspring of Aaron, would come near to burn incense before Yahweh, that he not be as Korah and as his company; as Yahweh spoke to him by Moses.

paite: Himahleh azingsang in, TOUPA mite na that uh, chi in Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng Mosi leh Aaron tung ah aphun uhi.
english: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel complained against Moses and against Aaron, saying, “You have killed Yahweh’s people!”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Mosi leh Aaron tung mipi apunkhawm lai un, kihoupihna biakbuk lam a-en ua; ngai in, meipi in ahon khuh a, TOUPA thupina ahong kilang hi.
english: When the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, they looked toward the Tent of Meeting. Behold, the cloud covered it, and Yahweh’s glory appeared.

paite: Mosi leh Aaron kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah ahoh uhi.
english: Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Hiai mipi omkhawmte lak a pan kihemkhia un, amau ka hihmang guihtheihna ding in," achi hi. Amau amai ua lei si in abokkhup uhi.
english: “Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!” They fell on their faces.

paite: Mosi in Aaron kiang ah, "Na mei lakna tawi inla, maitam a pan mei koih inla; gimlim buak inla, mipi omkhawmte kiang ah paipih meng inla, amaute a ding in kilemna bawl in. TOUPA hehna ahong suak hi; hipi aleng panta," achi hi.
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, put fire from the altar in it, lay incense on it, carry it quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from Yahweh! The plague has begun.”

paite: Aaron in Mosi gen bang in atawi a, omkhawmte lak ah atailut a, ngai in, mipi lak ah huai hipi ahong leng pan a; gimlim abuak a, mipi a ding in kilemna abawl hi.
english: Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the middle of the assembly. The plague had already begun among the people. He put on the incense, and made atonement for the people.

paite: Misi leh mihing kikal ah adingh a, hipi akhawlta hi.
english: He stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

paite: Huchi in Korah tungtang thu a site sim louh, hipi a si tengteng singkhat sangli-le-zasagih ahi uh.
english: Now those who died by the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, in addition to those who died about the matter of Korah.

paite: Aaron kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a Mosi kiang ah akik nawn a, huchi in hipi akhawlta hi.
english: Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and the plague was stopped.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante houpih inla, a-inkuan chih a tuam ding in chiang khat chiat, a-inkuan uh dungzui zel a a-intekpen tengteng zah, chiang sawm-le-nih la inla; achiang uah amin uh gelh in.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and take rods from them, one for each fathers’ house, of all their princes according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods. Write each man’s name on his rod.

paite: Levi chiang ah Aaron min gelh inla; a-inkuan chih uh a ding in chiang khat zel ahi ding ahi.
english: You shall write Aaron’s name on Levi’s rod. There shall be one rod for each head of their fathers’ houses.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin thu theihsakna ma ah na koih dia, huai ah i kimu ding.
english: You shall lay them up in the Tent of Meeting before the covenant, where I meet with you.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, ka tel ding mi chiang asel ding; huchi in Israel suante na tung a aphunna uh ka daisak ding,” achi hi.
english: It shall happen that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud. I will make the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you, cease from me.”

paite: Mosi in Israel suante ahoupih a, a-intekpen tengteng in amau inkuan chih a tuam a ding, intekpen chih in chiang khat zel, chiang sawm-le-nih apia uhi. Huaite lak ah Aaron chiang leng atel sam hi.
english: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and all their princes gave him rods, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, a total of twelve rods. Aaron’s rod was among their rods.

paite: Mosi in theihpihna biakbuk ah TOUPA ma ah huai chiangte akoih hi.
english: Moses laid up the rods before Yahweh in the Tent of the Testimony.

paite: Azing in hichi ahong hi a, theihpihna puanin ah Mosi ava hoh a; ngai in, Levi inkuante a dia Aaron chiang ana sel a, pakmum asuah a, apakpalh a, vaisuaklu min asuang hi.
english: On the next day, Moses went into the Tent of the Testimony; and behold, Aaron’s rod for the house of Levi had sprouted, budded, produced blossoms, and bore ripe almonds.

paite: Mosi in TOUPA ma a pan chiang tengteng Israel tengteng kiang ah alakhia a; ana en ua, amau chiang chiat ala uhi.
english: Moses brought out all the rods from before Yahweh to all the children of Israel. They looked, and each man took his rod.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Helhat tate ahi uh chih theihsak zelna ding in Aaron chiang theihpihna bul ah koih nawn in. Huchi in ka tung a ahelna uh na daisak thei ding, asihlouhna ding un," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Put back the rod of Aaron before the covenant, to be kept for a token against the children of rebellion; that you may make an end of their complaining against me, that they not die.”

paite: Huchibang in Mosi in TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in ahih hi.
english: Moses did so. As Yahweh commanded him, so he did.

paite: Israel suante'n Mosi kiang ah, "Ngai in, ka si ua, ka mangthang uh, ka vek un ka mangthang uh.
english: The children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, “Behold, we perish! We are undone! We are all undone!

paite: TOUPA biakbuk kiangnai a hong pai peuhmah asi ding uh. Kou leng si in ka mangthang ding uh maw?" achi uhi.
english: Everyone who keeps approaching Yahweh’s tabernacle, dies! Will we all perish?”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Aaron kiang ah, "Nang leh na tapate leh na inkuan un mun siangthou tung a khelhna toh kisai mohpuakna na la ding uh ahi. Nang leh na tapate kia in siampu hihna toh kisai thilhihkhelhte a mohpuakna na puak ding uh ahi.
english: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your fathers’ house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

paite: Na unaute, Levi suante leh na pa inkote hon tawnpih in, huchi a amau mun siangthou tung a khelhna toh kisai a mohpuakna alaktheihna ding un. Nang leh na tapate'n bel siampu hihna toh kisai thilhihkhelhte ah mohpuakna na lak ding uh ahi.
english: Bring your brothers also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, near with you, that they may be joined to you, and minister to you; but you and your sons with you shall be before the Tent of the Testimony.

paite: Nna nasep ahon huh ding ua, puanin nasep tengteng atang ding ua, himahleh mun siangthou tui-um belsuan leh maitam pen hon naih kei uhen, asihlouhna ding un, amau hiam, nang hiam in leng.
english: They shall keep your commands and the duty of the whole Tent; only they shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar, that they not die, neither they nor you.

paite: Puanin nasepna tengteng ah kihoupihna biakbuk nna pen atang ding uh. Namdangte'n nou ahon naih ding uh ahi kei hi.
english: They shall be joined to you and keep the responsibility of the Tent of Meeting, for all the service of the Tent. A stranger shall not come near to you.

paite: Nang mun siangthou nasep leh maitam nasep pen na tang ding, Israel suante tung a hehna a-om nawnlouhna ding in.
english: “You shall perform the duty of the sanctuary and the duty of the altar, that there be no more wrath on the children of Israel.

paite: Ngai in, ke'n na unau Levite, Israel suante lak a pan ka telkhia a, kihoupihna biakbuk ah asem ding uh. TOUPA'N nang a hon thilthawnpiak ahi uh.
english: Behold, I myself have taken your brothers the Levites from among the children of Israel. They are a gift to you, dedicated to Yahweh, to do the service of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Nang leh na tapate'n maitam leh puanzak sunglam thu ah na siampu nasep uh na sem ding uh. Nang na sem dia; siampu nasep na sep ding in ka hon pia hi. Namdang hong kigolh peuhmah thah ahi ding uh," achi hi.
english: You and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil. You shall serve. I give you the service of the priesthood as a gift. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

paite: TOUPA'N Aaron ahoupih a, "Ngai in, Israelte thil siangthou teng lak a kei a dia vei thillat teng leng ka hon pia hi. Thaunilh na hih ziak leh na tapate tangtawn dan ding ahih ziak in huaite ka hon pia hi.
english: Yahweh spoke to Aaron, “Behold, I myself have given you the command of my wave offerings, even all the holy things of the children of Israel. I have given them to you by reason of the anointing, and to your sons, as a portion forever.

paite: Mei a dia keptuam, thillat siangthoupente nang a ahi ding uh. Athillat teng uh, tangbuang thillat hiam khelhna thillat hiam mohna thillat hiam tantuan thillat tengteng nang leh na tapate tantuan ahi uh.
english: This shall be yours of the most holy things from the fire: every offering of theirs, even every meal offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall give to me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.

paite: Mun siangthoupen ah na ne ding ua; pasal teng in ane ding ua, nou a ding in hiai thil siangthou ahi.
english: You shall eat of it like the most holy things. Every male shall eat of it. It shall be holy to you.

paite: "Hiaite kei a tuam ahi; athilpiak uh tangbuang thillat, Israel suante vei thillat tengteng tan in. Nang, na tapate leh tanute a dia tangtawn a na tantuam ding ua ka hon piak ahi. Na inn a misiang tengteng in ane thei ding uh.
english: “This is yours, too: the wave offering of their gift, even all the wave offerings of the children of Israel. I have given them to you, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as a portion forever. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

paite: Sathau hoihpen, grep hoihpen, buh hoihpen leh gah masapen TOUPA a dia apiak teng uh ka hon pia hi.
english: “I have given to you all the best of the oil, all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first fruits of them which they give to Yahweh.

paite: Alou ua gah min masapen TOUPA a dia ahon tawi uh nang a ahi dia; na inn a misiang teng in ane thei ding uh.
english: The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to Yahweh, shall be yours. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

paite: Israelte thillat tengteng nang a ahi ding.
english: “Everything devoted in Israel shall be yours.

paite: "TOUPA a dia apiak uh sul hong masapen peuhmah mihing leng gan leng nang a ahi ding. Himahleh tapa masapen zaw na tan ngeingei dia, gan siang lou nou suakkhe masapen leng na tat ding ahi.
english: Everything that opens the womb, of all flesh which they offer to Yahweh, both of man and animal, shall be yours. Nevertheless, you shall surely redeem the firstborn of man, and you shall redeem the firstborn of unclean animals.

paite: "Kha khat ahih in tat dingte tatna man na sehdan bang in, mun siangthou a shekel hihdan bang a shekel nga a na tat ding ahi, shekel tuh gerah sawmnih ahi.
english: You shall redeem those who are to be redeemed of them from a month old, according to your estimation, for five shekels of money, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, which weighs twenty gerahs.

paite: Himahleh bawng suakkhe masapen hiam, belam suakkhe masapen hiam, kel suakkhe masapen hiam, na tat ding ahi kei; asiangthou uhi. Asisan uh maitam ah na theh dia, TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in athaute mei a thillat in na hal ding ahi.
english: “But you shall not redeem the firstborn of a cow, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat. They are holy. You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar, and shall burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Asa uh nang a ahi dia, vei thillat leh aliang taklam pang nang a ahih bang in.
english: Their meat shall be yours, as the wave offering breast and as the right thigh, it shall be yours.

paite: "Thil siangthou vei thillat, Israel suante'n TOUPA a dia alatte uh tangtawn a na tantuam ding un ka hon pia hi. TOUPA ma a nang, na tapate leh na tanute a dia tangtawn thukhun ahi," achi hi.
english: All the wave offerings of the holy things which the children of Israel offer to Yahweh, I have given you and your sons and your daughters with you, as a portion forever. It is a covenant of salt forever before Yahweh to you and to your offspring with you.”

paite: TOUPA'N Aaron kiang ah, "Agam uah goutan na nei kei dia, alak uah leng tantuan na nei sam kei ding. Israel suante lak a na tantuan leh na goutan, Keimah ka hi.
english: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel.

paite: "Ngai in, anasep, puanin a asep man ding un, Israel gam a sawm-a-khat tengteng Levi suante kiang ah ka pia ahi.
english: “To the children of Levi, behold, I have given all the tithe in Israel for an inheritance, in return for their service which they serve, even the service of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Tu a pan Israel suante'n kihoupihna biakbuk ahon naih het louh ding uh ahi; khelhna pua in asi kha ding uh.
english: Henceforth the children of Israel shall not come near the Tent of Meeting, lest they bear sin, and die.

paite: Himahleh Levite'n bel kihoupihna biakbuk nasep asem ding ua; Israelte khelhna toh kisai mohpuakna ala ding uh. Hiai asuante tan a ding in dan thusehsa hi dia; Israel suante lak ah goutan anei kei ding uh.
english: But the Levites shall do the service of the Tent of Meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations. Among the children of Israel, they shall have no inheritance.

paite: Israel suante'n sawm-a-khat TOUPA a dia vei thillat alat uh Levite goutan ding in ka pia hi. Huaiziak in akiang uah, Israel suante lak ah goutan anei kei ding uh, ka na chita him ahi," achi hi.
english: For the tithe of the children of Israel, which they offer as a wave offering to Yahweh, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance. Therefore I have said to them, ‘Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Levite houpih inla, akiang uah, na goutan ding ua Israel suante sawm- a-khat ka hon piak na lak chiang un, huai sawm-a-khat a pan sawm-a-khat TOUPA kiang ah vei thillat ding in na lan ding uh ahi.
english: “Moreover you shall speak to the Levites, and tell them, ‘When you take of the children of Israel the tithe which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall offer up a wave offering of it for Yahweh, a tithe of the tithe.

paite: Na vei thillat uh buhphual a buh leh uain tung masapen dia sim ahi ding.
english: Your wave offering shall be credited to you, as though it were the grain of the threshing floor, and as the fullness of the wine press.

paite: Huchibang in Israel suante lak a sawm-a-khat na lak tengteng uah leng TOUPA vei thillat ding in na lan zui zel ding uhi; huai TOUPA vei thillat pen siampu Aaron na piak ding uh ahi.
english: Thus you also shall offer a wave offering to Yahweh of all your tithes, which you receive of the children of Israel; and of it you shall give Yahweh’s wave offering to Aaron the priest.

paite: Na thillat tengteng lak ua ahoihpen, asiangthoupen TOUPA vei thillat ding in na lan ding uhi.
english: Out of all your gifts, you shall offer every wave offering to Yahweh, of all its best parts, even the holy part of it.’

paite: Huaiziak in akiang uah, ahoihpen na vei chiang un Levite buhphual a tung leh grep sukna a pan tung bang a sim ahi ding.
english: “Therefore you shall tell them, ‘When you heave its best from it, then it shall be credited to the Levites as the increase of the threshing floor, and as the increase of the wine press.

paite: Koi lai peuh ah leng na ne thei ding uh, nou leh na inkuanpihte un leng; kihoupihna biakbuk a na sep man uh ahi ngal a.
english: You may eat it anywhere, you and your households, for it is your reward in return for your service in the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Ahoihpen na vei uleh akhelh moh na po kei ding uh. Israel suante thil siangthou na hihthanghuai kei ding ua, na si kei ding uhi, chi in," achi hi.
english: You shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have heaved from it its best. You shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that you not die.’”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: "Hiai TOUPA thupiak dan ahi. Israel suante bawngla san, dembei, gensiatbei, hakkol bulhsak ngei het louh na kiang a hon kai ding in hilh un.
english: “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded. Tell the children of Israel to bring you a red heifer without spot, in which is no defect, and which was never yoked.

paite: Siampu Eleazar na pe ding a, ama'n giahphual pua ah apikhe dia, ama ah mi khat in agou ding hi.
english: You shall give her to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her outside of the camp, and one shall kill her before his face.

paite: Siampu Eleazar in akhut in asisan ala dia, kihoupihna biakbuk ma ah asisan sagihvei atheh ding.
english: Eleazar the priest shall take some of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the Tent of Meeting seven times.

paite: Mi khat in huai bawngla amitmuh in ahal dia; avun, asa, asisan leh a-ek ahalmang ding hi.
english: One shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her meat, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn.

paite: Siampu in sidar sing, hissop leh khau san ala dia, abawngla hal uah apailut ding ahi.
english: The priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer.

paite: Siampu in apuansilhte sawp in, akisil dia, huai khit in giahphual ah ahoh dia, nitaklam tan in siampu siang lou ahi ding.
english: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening.

paite: Ahal mi in apuansilhte sawp in, akisil dia, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: He who burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.

paite: Mi asiang khat in bawngla vu alakhawm dia, giahphual pua a mun siang a ngaih ah akoih dia, Israel suan mipi omkhawmte kisiansakna tui dia zat ding ahi. Hiai khelh siansakna ahi.
english: “A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up outside of the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for use in water for cleansing impurity. It is a sin offering.

paite: Bawngla vu lakhawm mi in apuansilhte asawp dia, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding. Hiai Israel suante leh namdang akiang ua omte a ding in tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi.
english: He who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. It shall be to the children of Israel, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them, for a statute forever.

paite: "Kuapeuh siluang khoih peuhmah ni sagih sung siang lou ahi ding.
english: “He who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.

paite: Amah ani thum ni in akisiangsak dia, ani sagih ni in asiang ding. Himahleh, ani thum ni a akisiansak keileh ani sagih ni in leng asiang kei ding hi.
english: He shall purify himself with water on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean; but if he doesn’t purify himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

paite: Kuapeuh siluang khoihmi, akisiansak keileh TOUPA biakbuk ahihnin ahi. Huai mi Israel mite a pan satkhiak ding ahi. Kisiansakna tui atung a atheh louh ziak in asiang kei dia, atung ah asianlouhna a-om lai hi.
english: Whoever touches a dead person, the body of a man who has died, and doesn’t purify himself, defiles Yahweh’s tabernacle; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel; because the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him, he shall be unclean. His uncleanness is yet on him.

paite: "Puanin a mi asihleh hiai adan ding ahi. Puanin a lut peuhmah leh puanin sung a om peuhmahte ni sagih sung siang lou ahi ding uh.
english: “This is the law when a man dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

paite: Tui-um belsuan kihong, sit louh peuhmah siang lou ahi uh.
english: Every open vessel, which has no covering bound on it, is unclean.

paite: Gamlak a namsau a thah hiam, misi luang hiam, mihing guh hiam, han hiam mi'n akhoihleh ni sagih sung siang lou ahi ding.
english: “Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

paite: "Asiangloute a tuam ding in khelh thoihna vu ala ding ua, bel ah tuikhuk tui toh asung ding uhi.
english: “For the unclean, they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering; and running water shall be poured on them in a vessel.

paite: Misiang in, hissop ala dia, tui ah adiah dia, puanin tung, tui-um belsuan tengteng, huai a om mi tengteng, guh hiam, thah siluang hiam, misi luang hiam, han hiam khoih mite tung ah atheh ding.
english: A clean person shall take hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, on all the vessels, on the persons who were there, and on him who touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave.

paite: Misiang in ani thum ni leh ani sagih ni in misiang lou atheh dia, ani sagih ni in ahihsiang dia; apuansilhte asawp dia, akisil dia, nitaklam in ahong siangta ding hi.
english: The clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day. On the seventh day, he shall purify him. He shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.

paite: "Misiang lou kisiangsak lou in TOUPA mun siangthou ahihnit ziak in huai mi omkhawmte a pan satkhiak ding ahi. Kisiansakna tui a theh louh ahi a, siang lou ahi.
english: But the man who shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of Yahweh. The water for impurity has not been sprinkled on him. He is unclean.

paite: Hiai amau a ding in tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi. Kisiansakna tui a theh peuhmah in apuansilhte asawp dia; akisiansakna tui khoih peuhmah nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: It shall be a perpetual statute to them. He who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and he who touches the water for impurity shall be unclean until evening.

paite: Misiang lou in akhoih peuhmah siang lou ahi zel dia; huai khoihmi kuapeuh nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding," achi hi.
english: “Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupiha,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: “Israel suante’n a inkuan chiamtehna uh bang chiat in apawl uh hihdan bang in apuanin uh akai ding uhi. Kihoupihna puanin a pan bangtan hiam kihal in akai ding uhi.
english: “The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers’ houses. They shall encamp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it.

paite: "Nisuahna lam suahlam pang ah apawl uh tamdan dungzui zel a puanin kai dingte Judah pawlte ahi ding ua; Judah tate lak a vaihawmbmakai ding Amminadab tapa Nashon ahi.
english: “Those who encamp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

paite: Sim a om pawlte tamdan, singsagih sangli-le-zaguk ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

paite: Amah zom a puanin kai dingte Issakar chi ahi ding a; Issakar tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Zuar tapa Nethaneel ahi.
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.

paite: Sim a om pawlte tamdan singnga sangli-le-zali ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

paite: Zebulun chite, Zebulun tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Helon tapa Eliab ahi.
english: “The tribe of Zebulun: the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singnga sangsagih-le-zali ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

paite: Apawl uh tamdan bang zel in sim a om Judah inkuante nuaikhat singgiat sangguk-le-zali ahi uh. Amaute'n ma akai zel ding uhi.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out first.

paite: "Apawl uh tamdan bang zel in asimlam pang ah Reubente pawl a-om ding ua; Reuben tate lak a vaihawm makai Shedeur tapa Elizur ahi.
english: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singli sangguk-le-zanga ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were counted of it, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

paite: Azom a dingte Simeon chi ahi ding ua; Simeon tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Zurishaddai tapa Selumiel ahi.
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singnga sangkua-le-zathum ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

paite: Huai khit in Gad chite ahi ding ua, Gad tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Reuel tapa Eliasaph ahi.
english: “The tribe of Gad: the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singli sangnga zaguk-le-sawmnga ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

paite: Reubente tamdan nuaikhat singnga sangkhat zali-le-sawmnga ahi uh; apawl uh dungzui in. Azom in amaute apawtkhe ding uhi.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, according to their armies. They shall set out second.

paite: "Kihoupihna puanin ah akipankhe ding ua, Levite alai ah a-om ding ua, a-omna thu zil bang zel in apawlpawl in apai chiat ding uhi.
english: “Then the Tent of Meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the middle of the camps. As they encamp, so shall they set out, every man in his place, by their standards.

paite: "Apawl tamdan thu in atumlam pang ah Ephraimte a-om ding ua, Ephraim tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Ammihud tapa Elishama ahi.
english: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singli-le-zanga ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty thousand five hundred.

paite: Azom in Manasseh chi ahi ding a; Manasseh tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Pedazur tapa Gamaliel ahi.
english: “Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh. The prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singthum sangnih-le-zanih ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

paite: Azom nawn in Benjamin chite, Benjamin tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Gideoni tapa Abidan ahi.
english: “The tribe of Benjamin: the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singthum sangnga-le-zali ahi uh.
english: His army, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

paite: Ephraimte tamdan nuaikhat sanggiat-le-zakhat ahi. Azom nawn in apaikhe ding uhi.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out third.

paite: "Apawl uh tamdan bang zel in Dante amallam pang ah a-om ding ua; Dan tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Ammishaddai tapa Ahiezer ahi.
english: “On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singguk leh sangnih leh zasagih ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

paite: Azom a puanin kai dingte Asher chi ahi ding a; Asher tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Okran tapa Pagiel ahi.
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher. The prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singli leh sangkhat leh zanga ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

paite: Azom nawn in Naphtali chite; Naphtali tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Enan tapa Ahira ahi,
english: “The tribe of Naphtali: the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singnga sangthum-le-zali ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

paite: Dante tamdan nuaikhat singnga sangsagih-le-zaguk ahi ua; amau apawlpawl a pawtkhia in ananungpen ahi ding uhi."
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last by their standards.”

paite: Hiai Israel suante inkuan teng a mi asimte uh, tamdan ahi a, nuaiguk sangthum zanga-le-sawmnga apha uhi.
english: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were counted of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

paite: Levite Israel suante lak a simtel ahi kei uh; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in.
english: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Huchibang in Israel suante'n ahih ua; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang zel in apawlpawl in puanin akai uhi. Huchi mah bang in achichi in a-inkuankuan zel un akipankhe zel uhi.
english: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.

paite: Huan Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng huai kha khatna in Zin gamdai alut ua; mipite'n Kadesh ah giahphual asat ua; huai ah Miriam asi a, huai ah avui uhi.
english: The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month. The people stayed in Kadesh. Miriam died there, and was buried there.

paite: Omkhawmte a ding in tui a-om kei a; Mosi leh Aaron kalh in akikhawm uh.
english: There was no water for the congregation; and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

paite: Mite'n, "TOUPA ma a i unaute asih lai un Pathian in hon that geih maileh aw!
english: The people quarreled with Moses, and spoke, saying, “We wish that we had died when our brothers died before Yahweh!

paite: Kou leh ka gante uh toh bangziak a TOUPA mipite si ding a gamdai a pilut na hia?
english: Why have you brought Yahweh’s assembly into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our animals?

paite: Bangziak in ahia hiai gam hoihloupi a hon pilut dia Aigupta gam a pan na hon pawtkhiaksak mahmah? Buh-le-balte, theipite, grepkungte, theibuhfaite omlouhna mun ahi, tui dawn ding mahmah leng a-om sam kei hi,” achi uhi.
english: Why have you made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in to this evil place? It is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi leh Aaron mipi a pan kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah ahoh ua, abokkhup ua; TOUPA thupina akiang uah ahong kilang hi.
english: Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and fell on their faces. Yahweh’s glory appeared to them.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Chiang la inla, mipite omkhawmsak inla, nang leh na sanggampa Aaron toh, huai suangpi in amitmuh ua tui pawtsak ding in thu pia in. Suangpi a pan tui na lakkhiaksak dia, mipi omkhawmte leh agante uh na dawnsak ding ahi," achi hi.
english: “Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before their eyes, that it pour out its water. You shall bring water to them out of the rock; so you shall give the congregation and their livestock drink.”

paite: Mosi in TOUPA ma a pan chiang, athupiak bang in ala hi.
english: Moses took the rod from before Yahweh, as he commanded him.

paite: Mosi leh Aaron in mipite suangpi bul ah a-omkhawmsak ua, Mosi in akiang uah, "Nou mihelte aw, ngai un, hiai suangpi a pan tui ka hon lakkhiaksak ding ua hia?" achi uhi.
english: Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, “Hear now, you rebels! Shall we bring water out of this rock for you?”

paite: Mosi in aban azak a, achiang in suangpi nihvei asat a; huchi in tui tamtak ahong pawt a, mipi omkhawmte leh agante un adawn uhi.
english: Moses lifted up his hand, and struck the rock with his rod twice, and water came out abundantly. The congregation and their livestock drank.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron kiang ah, "N'on gintak louh ua, Israel suante mitmuh a na hon pahtawi louh ziak un hiai omkhawmte ka piak gam ah na pilut kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”

paite: Hiai Meribah tui ahi. Israel suante'n TOUPA akinakpih ua, amaute lak a amah pahtawi a a-om ziak in.
english: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with Yahweh, and he was sanctified in them.

paite: Mosi in Kadesh a pan Edom kumpipa kiang ah mi asawl a, "Na unaupa Israel in hichi in achi, ka tung ua thuakna hong tung tengteng na thei hi.
english: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “Your brother Israel says: You know all the travail that has happened to us;

paite: Ka pipute uh Aigupta gam ah ahohsuk ua, sawtpi Aigupta gam a ka om uh, Aigupta mite'n kou leh ka pipute hoih loutak in ahon bawl uh.
english: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we lived in Egypt a long time. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA ka sam ua, ka aw uh ana za a, angel ahon sawl a, Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhia a, ngai in, na gam naihpen khua Kadesh ah ka om uhi.
english: When we cried to Yahweh, he heard our voice, sent an angel, and brought us out of Egypt. Behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the edge of your border.

paite: Hehpih in na gam ka tawn paisuak ding uh aw. Lou hiam, grephuan hiam ka tawn kei ding ua, tuileh tuite leng ka dawn kei ding uh. Kumpipa lamlian ah ka pai ding ua, na gam ka khen masiah uh taklam hiam, veilam hiam ah ka pial kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: “Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through field or through vineyard, neither will we drink from the water of the wells. We will go along the king’s highway. We will not turn away to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed your border.”

paite: Edom in akiang ah, "N'on palsuak ding ahi kei. N'on palleh hon dou ding in namsau toh ka hong kuan ding," achi hi.
english: Edom said to him, “You shall not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against you.”

paite: Israel suante'n akiang ah, "Lamlian ah ka paitou ding ua; kou leh ka ganta un na tui ka dawn uleh aman ka hon pe ding uh. Thil dang bangmah hih lou in apai in ka paisuak mai ding uh," achi uhi.
english: The children of Israel said to him, “We will go up by the highway; and if we drink your water, I and my livestock, then I will give its price. Only let me, without doing anything else, pass through on my feet.”

paite: Ama'n, "Paisuak lou ding," achi hi. Huchi in Edom mipi tampi leh mihat taktakte toh amau dou ding in ahong kuanta uhi.
english: He said, “You shall not pass through.” Edom came out against him with many people, and with a strong hand.

paite: Hiai bang in Edom in Israel mite agam a apaisuak uh aphal kei a, Israel mite'n akiksan nawnta uhi.
english: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border, so Israel turned away from him.

paite: Huchi in Kadesh a pan apawt ua; Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng Hor tang ahong tung uh.
english: They traveled from Kadesh, and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron, Edom gam naih Hor tang ah ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,

paite: "Achipihte kiang ah Aaron pi ahita ding. Meribah tui a ka thu kalh a, ahel ziak in Israel suante ka piak gam ah alut kei ding.
english: “Aaron shall be gathered to his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against my word at the waters of Meribah.

paite: Aaron leh atapa Eleazar Hor tang ah hon pitou in.
english: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;

paite: Aaron puansilhte suahsak inla, atapa Eleazar silhsak in. Aaron achipihte kiang a pi ahi ding, huai ah asi ding," achi hi.
english: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron shall be gathered, and shall die there.”

paite: Mosi in TOUPA thupiak bang in ahih a; mipi omkhawm tengteng mitmuh in Hor tang ah apaitou uhi.
english: Moses did as Yahweh commanded. They went up onto Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

paite: Huchi in Mosi in Aaron puansilh asuahsak a, Eleazar asilhsak hi. Aaron tang vum ah asita a, tang a pan Mosi leh Eleazar ahong paikhesuk uhi.
english: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron died there on the top of the mountain, and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.

paite: Mipi omkhawm tengteng in Aaron si ahi chih atheih un, Israel inkote'n ni sawmthum sung Aaron asuun uhi.
english: When all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

paite: Huan Kanaan mi, kumpipa Arad simlam a om in, Atharim lampi ah Israel mite ahong pai uh chi a kigen ana za a; huchi in Israel mite ana dou a, galmat khenkhat anei hi.
english: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South, heard that Israel came by the way of Atharim. He fought against Israel, and took some of them captive.

paite: Israel mite'n TOUPA kiang ah thu achiam ua, "Ka khut ua hiai mite na hon piakleh akhuate uh ka hihmang ding uh," achi uh.
english: Israel vowed a vow to Yahweh, and said, “If you will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.”

paite: TOUPA'N Israel mite thu apom a, akiang uah Kanaan mite apia a, amau leh akhuate ahihmang uhi. Huai mun min Hormah asa uhi.
english: Yahweh listened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. The name of the place was called Hormah.

paite: Hor tang a pan Tuipi San lam ah Edom gam kualkhum in apai ua; alampi ziak in mipi alunglel mahmah uhi.
english: They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom. The soul of the people was very discouraged because of the journey.

paite: Mipite'n Pathian leh Mosi kalh in, "Gamdai a si dia bang ding a Aigupta a pan hon pikhia na hia? Tanghou lah om lou, tui lah om lou. Hiai tanghou kihhuai lah ka hinna un akih hi,” achi uh.
english: The people spoke against God and against Moses: “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no bread, there is no water, and our soul loathes this disgusting food!”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N mipi lak ah gul gukhahte asawl a, mite atu ua, Israel mite tampi asi uhi.
english: Yahweh sent venomous snakes among the people, and they bit the people. Many people of Israel died.

paite: Huaiziak in mite Mosi kiang ah ahong pai ua, "TOUPA leh nang kalh a ka na pau uh ka khialta uh, i lak ua gulte lamang ding in TOUPA kiang ah thum dih ve," achi uhi. Huchi in mite a ding in Mosi athum hi.
english: The people came to Moses, and said, “We have sinned, because we have spoken against Yahweh and against you. Pray to Yahweh, that he take away the serpents from us.” Moses prayed for the people.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Gul gukhah lim bawl inla, khuam lek ah khai in. Huan hichi ahi ding a, gultukmi peuhmah in huai a-et uleh adam ding uh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Make a venomous snake, and set it on a pole. It shall happen that everyone who is bitten, when he sees it, shall live.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in dal gul abawl a, khuam lek ah akhai a; huan hichi ahong hi a, gultukmi peuhmah in huai dal gul a-et uleh adam uhi.
english: Moses made a serpent of bronze, and set it on the pole. If a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked at the serpent of bronze, he lived.

paite: Israel suante apai zel ua, Oboth ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in Oboth.

paite: Oboth a pan apai nawn ua, nisuahna lam Moab gamdai bul Ije-abarim ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrise.

paite: Huai a pan apai nawn ua, Zered Phaizang ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: From there they traveled, and encamped in the valley of Zered.

paite: Huai a pan apai nawn ua, Amorte gamgi a pan hong dawktuam gamdai a Arnon lehlam ah giahphual asat uhi. Arnon bel Moab gamgi, Moab leh Amorte kikal a om ahi.
english: From there they traveled, and encamped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness that comes out of the border of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA kidounate laibu ah, Tuipi San leh Arnon luitate a;
english: Therefore it is said in The Book of the Wars of Yahweh, “Vaheb in Suphah, the valleys of the Arnon,

paite: Ar tenna a luangkhia luite leh Moab gamgi a omte ah athilhihte, achih.
english: the slope of the valleys that incline toward the dwelling of Ar, leans on the border of Moab.”

paite: Huai a pan Beer ah apai nawn ua; huai bel TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a mipite samkhawm inla, tui ka pe ding, achihna tuileh ahi.
english: From there they traveled to Beer; that is the well of which Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather the people together, and I will give them water.”

paite: Huchi in Israelte'n hiai la asa uh. "Aw tuikhuk, hong kikhohkhia inla, athu la in sa un.
english: Then Israel sang this song: “Spring up, well! Sing to it,
