paite: Dan petu in akawkmuh bang a miliante uleh mipite heutute'n akhetbuk uh toh alaih uh tuikhuk," chi in. Huchi in gamdai a pan Mattanah tan;
english: the well, which the princes dug, which the nobles of the people dug, with the scepter, and with their poles.” From the wilderness they traveled to Mattanah;

paite: Mattanah a pan Nahaliel ah; Nahaliel a pan Bamoth ah;
english: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth;

paite: Bamoth a pan Moab lou a phaizang leh gamdai sunsuk Jeshimon lam nga Pisgah vum ah apai uhi.
english: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks down on the desert.

paite: Israel mite'n Amorte kumpipa Sihon kiang ah mi asawl ua,
english: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

paite: "Na gam ah hon paisuaksak ve; lou ah hiam, grephuan ah hiam ka pial kei ding ua; tuileh tuite ka dawn kei ding uh. Na gam ka khen masiah uh Kumpipa Lamlian ah ka pai zel ding uh," chi in.
english: “Let me pass through your land. We will not turn away into field or vineyard. We will not drink of the water of the wells. We will go by the king’s highway, until we have passed your border.”

paite: Himahleh Sihon in Israel mite agam a apaisuak uh aphal kei hi. Sihon in amite tengteng akaikhawm vek a, Israel mite dou ding in gamdai ah akisazawta hi. Jahaz ava tung ua; huai ah Israel mite adou uh.
english: Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border, but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and came to Jahaz. He fought against Israel.

paite: Israel mite'n namsau in amah athat ua, agam Arnon a pan Jabok tan in, Ammon suante tan in alazou uhi. Ammon suante gamgi kulh nei ahih ziak in agam chiang lel alazou uhi.
english: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was fortified.

paite: Israel mite'n huai khua tengteng ala ua; Israel mite'n Amorte khua tengteng aluah uhi. Heshbon leh akhopel tengteng ah leng ateng uhi.
english: Israel took all these cities. Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.

paite: Heshbon khua bel Amorte kumpipa Sihon khua ahi. Amah huai ma a Moab kumpipa asual a akhut a pan gam tengteng, Arnon tan alaksakpa ahi.
english: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even to the Arnon.

paite: Huaiziak in paunak gente'n, "Heshbon ah hong pai in, kilam thak hen, Sihon khopi kilam thak hen, achi uhi.
english: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say, “Come to Heshbon. Let the city of Sihon be built and established;

paite: Heshbon a pan mei ahong pawt a, Sihon khopi a pan meikuang. Moab a Ar akang khin a, Arnon a mun sang a toupate toh.
english: for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon. It has devoured Ar of Moab, The lords of the high places of the Arnon.

paite: Aw, Moab, na tung agik hi. Na mangthangta, Aw Kemosh mi! Ama'n Amorte kumpipa Sihon kiang ah tapate galtaite bang in leh atanute saltangte bang in apia hi.
english: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, and his daughters into captivity, to Sihon king of the Amorites.

paite: Himahleh amau ka kap ua, Dibon tan in Heshbon amangthangta. Huchi in Nophah tan in ka hihmang uh, huai in Medeba tan apha hi."
english: We have shot at them. Heshbon has perished even to Dibon. We have laid waste even to Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba.”

paite: Huchibang in, Amorte gam ah Israel mite ateng uhi,
english: Thus Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.

paite: Mosi in Jazer enkhe ding in mi asawl a, akhuate ala ua, huai a teng Amorte ahawlkhia uhi.
english: Moses sent to spy out Jazer. They took its villages, and drove out the Amorites who were there.

paite: Akik nawn ua, Bashan lampi ah apaitou uh. Bashan kumpipa Og, amau dou ding in, amah leh amite tengteng, Edrei ah akisakhia uhi.
english: They turned and went up by the way of Bashan. Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Amah lau ke'n. Amah, amite tengteng leh agam na khut ah ka hon pe khinta hi. Heshbon a om Amorte kumpipa Sihon tung a na hih bang in na hih ding ahi,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Don’t fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, with all his people, and his land. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”

paite: Huchi in amah leh tapate hawi himhim nei lou in amite tengteng toh athat ua; agam aluahsakta uhi.
english: So they struck him, with his sons and all his people, until there were no survivors; and they possessed his land.

paite: Huan Israel suante apai zel ua, Jeriko zawn Jordan gal a Moab Phaizang ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.

paite: Zippor tapa Balak in Israel mite'n Amorte abawldan tengteng uh ana thei hi.
english: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

paite: Moabte'n mite alau mahmah ua, atam ngal ua. Israel suante ziak in Moabte alungkham uhi.
english: Moab was very afraid of the people, because they were many. Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

paite: Moabte'n Midian upate kiang ah, "Hiai mipite'n bawng in loupa anekgaih bang in i kim ua mi tengteng anegai ding uh," achi uhi. Huai lai in Zippor tapa Balak Moab kumpipa ahi.
english: Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now this multitude will lick up all that is around us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field.” Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.

paite: Huaiziak in Beor tapa Balaam, Pethor a om kiang ah mi asawl hi. Huai bel amite suante gam a lui kiang a om ahi. Amah ava sam ua, "Ngai in, Aigupta gam a pan hong paikhia mipi a-om ua; ngai in, leitung maikaih atuamdim ua, ka kiangchin ah a-om uhi.
english: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, “Behold, there is a people who came out of Egypt. Behold, they cover the surface of the earth, and they are staying opposite me.

paite: Hehpih in hong pai inla, hiai mite hong hamsiat dih ve. Kei a ding in ahat lua ua, ka zoh theih ua ka gam a pan ka delhkhiak theih zenzen khak uleh. Na vualzawl peuhmah vualzawl in a-om a, na hamsiat peuhmah lah hamsiat in a-om, chih ka thei," ava chisak hi.
english: Please come now therefore, and curse this people for me; for they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I shall prevail, that we may strike them, and that I may drive them out of the land; for I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed.”

paite: Huchi in Moab upate leh Midian upate aisanna ding tawi in apawtkhia ua; Balaam kiang ava tung ua, Balak thukhah ahilh uhi.
english: The elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand. They came to Balaam, and spoke to him the words of Balak.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Tuzan hiai ah giak unla, TOUPA'N hon hilh bangbang thu na kiang ua ka hon tun ding," achi hi. Huchi in Moab miliante Balaam kiang ah agiakta uhi.
english: He said to them, “Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as Yahweh shall speak to me.” The princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.

paite: Balaam kiang ah Pathian ahong a, na kiang a mite kuate ahi ua? achi hi.
english: God came to Balaam, and said, “Who are these men with you?”

paite: Balaam in Pathian kiang ah, "Zippor tapa Moab kumpipa Balak in ka kiang ah,
english: Balaam said to God, “Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has said to me,

paite: 'Ngai in, Aigupta gam a pan a hong pai mipite'n leitung maikaih aluahdim uh. Hong pai inla, hong hamsiat in, ka zoh theih a, ka delhkhiak theih khakleh,' " chi in mi ahon sawl hi, achi hi.
english: ‘Behold, the people that has come out of Egypt covers the surface of the earth. Now, come curse them for me. Perhaps I shall be able to fight against them, and shall drive them out.’”

paite: Pathian in Balaam kiang ah, "Akiang ua na hoh ding ahi kei. Huai mite na hamsiat ding ahi kei; mihampha ahi uh," achi hi.
english: God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed.”

paite: Zingsang in Balaam athou a, Balak miliante kiang ah, "Na gam uah pai nawnta un. TOUPA'N na kiang ua hoh dia ka pawt aphal kei,” achi hi.
english: Balaam rose up in the morning, and said to the princes of Balak, “Go to your land; for Yahweh refuses to permit me to go with you.”

paite: Huchi in Moab miliante athou ua, Balak kiang ah apai ua, "Balaam in ahon zui ut kei," achi uhi.
english: The princes of Moab rose up, and they went to Balak, and said, “Balaam refuses to come with us.”

paite: Balak in milian tamsem, asang ua zahtakhuaizaw asawl nawn hi.
english: Balak again sent princes, more, and more honorable than they.

paite: Balaam kiang ava tung ua, akiang ah, "Zippor tapa Balak in hichi in achi, 'Ka kiang a na hong hoh ding bangmah in dal kei hen.
english: They came to Balaam, and said to him, “Balak the son of Zippor says, ‘Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me,

paite: Mithupitak in ka hon bawl dia, ka kiang a na gen peuhmah ka hih zel ding. Huaiziak in hong pai teitei inla, hiai mite hong hamsiatsak mahmah mai in,' " achi uhi.
english: for I will promote you to very great honor, and whatever you say to me I will do. Please come therefore, and curse this people for me.’”

paite: Balaam in Balak mite adawng a, akiang uah, "Balak in a-inn dim dangka leh dangka-eng hon pe ding himahleh, abangmah TOUPA ka Pathian thu pel in ka hihthei kei.
english: Balaam answered the servants of Balak, “If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the word of Yahweh my God, to do less or more.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah bangchi in ahia agen nawn ding, tuzan hiai lai ah giak peuhmah phot un," achi hi.
english: Now therefore please stay here tonight as well, that I may know what else Yahweh will speak to me.”

paite: Zan in Balaam kiang ah Pathian ahong a, akiang ah, "Hiai mite nang hong sam a hong ahih uleh, thou inla, akiang uah hoh in. Himahleh na kiang a ka gen kia na hih ding ahi," achi hi.
english: God came to Balaam at night, and said to him, “If the men have come to call you, rise up, go with them; but only the word which I speak to you, that you shall do.”

paite: Huchi in zingsang in Balaam athou a, asabiltung tung ah tutphah aphah a, Moab miliante azuita hi.
english: Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.

paite: Huchi in ahoh ziak in Pathian aheh mahmah a, amah na lamdal ding in lampi ah TOUPA angel ana dingh hi. Asabiltung tung a tuang ahi a, asikhate nih leng akiang ah a-om uhi.
english: God’s anger burned because he went; and Yahweh’s angel placed himself in the way as an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.

paite: Sabiltung in TOUPA angel, namsau tawi a lampi a dingh amu hi. Huchi in lampi a pan sabiltung apialkhia a, gamlak ah apai a, Balaam in lampi a kiksak tum in sabiltung asat hi.
english: The donkey saw Yahweh’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and the donkey turned out of the path, and went into the field. Balaam struck the donkey, to turn her into the path.

paite: Grephuan umna kikal kuak ah TOUPA angel adingh hi.
english: Then Yahweh’s angel stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

paite: Sabiltung in TOUPA angel amu a, grephuan umna ava ngai a, dai umna toh Balaam khe anehden hi. Balaam in asabiltung asat nawn hi.
english: The donkey saw Yahweh’s angel, and she thrust herself to the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall. He struck her again.

paite: Apam deuh ah TOUPA angel apai a, mun kochik laitak, taklam hiam, veilam hiam a leng pialna omlouhna laitak ah adingh hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel went further, and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

paite: Sabiltung in TOUPA angel amu a, Balaam akualpihta hi. Balaam aheh mahmah a, achiangkhun in sabiltung asat hi.
english: The donkey saw Yahweh’s angel, and she lay down under Balaam. Balaam’s anger burned, and he struck the donkey with his staff.

paite: TOUPA'N sabiltung apausak a, Balaam kiang ah, "Bang ka hon chih a ahia? Thumveitak na hon huchi sat?" achi hi.
english: Yahweh opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?”

paite: Balaam in sabiltung kiang ah, "N'on simmoh ziak in ahi. Namsau tawi hi leng, ka hon that khin hialta ding," achi hi.
english: Balaam said to the donkey, “Because you have mocked me, I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would have killed you.”

paite: Sabiltung in Balaam kiang ah, "Tutan a na tuanna gige na sabiltung ka hi kei a hia? Hichibang in ka hon hih ngei a hia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Hih ngei lou e,” achi hi.
english: The donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not your donkey, on which you have ridden all your life long until today? Was I ever in the habit of doing so to you?” He said, “No.”

paite: TOUPA'N Balaam mit avaksak a, TOUPA angel namsau tawi alampi a dingh amuta a; akun a, amai a lei si in abokkhup hi.
english: Then Yahweh opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw Yahweh’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed his head, and fell on his face.

paite: TOUPA angel in akiang ah, "Bang achia hichibang a na sabiltung thumvei sat na hia? Ngai in, na gamtatdan ka mitmuh a asiat ziak in hon na lamdal dia hong pawtkhia ka hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel said to him, “Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out as an adversary, because your way is perverse before me.

paite: Sabiltung in ahon mu a, ka ma a thumvei pial ahi. Pial keileh amah that lou a, nang hon that khin ding ka hi,” achi hi.
english: The donkey saw me, and turned away before me these three times. Unless she had turned away from me, surely now I would have killed you, and saved her alive.”

paite: Balaam in TOUPA angel kiang ah, "Ka na khialta hi. Hon na lamdal ding in lampi ah na dingh chih ka thei kei hi," achi hi.
english: Balaam said to Yahweh’s angel, “I have sinned; for I didn’t know that you stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it displeases you, I will go back again.”

paite: TOUPA angel in Balaam kiang ah, "Hiai mite kiang ah hoh inla; himahleh na kiang a ka thugen ding kia na gen ding ahi," achi hi. Huchi in Balaam in Balak miliante azuita hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel said to Balaam, “Go with the men; but you shall only speak the word that I shall speak to you.” So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

paite: Balak in Balaam ahong chih azak in Arnon lam a gamgi chiang ah Moab khopi pha in ava dawn a, huai tuh gamgi tawpna ahi.
english: When Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him to the City of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is in the utmost part of the border.

paite: Balak in Balaam kiang ah, "Phatuamngaitak a nang hong sam dia mi ka hon sawl ahi kei maw? Bangziak a ka kiang a hong nuam lou na hia? Mithupitak in ka hon bawl thei ka hia?" achi hi.
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I earnestly send for you to summon you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I not able indeed to promote you to honor?”

paite: Balaam in Balak kiang ah, "Ngai in, ka hong hi. Bangmah gentheihna mawngmawng ka nei a hia? Pathian in ka kam a thu akoih kia ka gen ding," achi hi.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Behold, I have come to you. Have I now any power at all to speak anything? I will speak the word that God puts in my mouth.”

paite: Huchi in Balak kiang ah Balaam ahohta a, Kiriath-huzot ava tung uhi.
english: Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath Huzoth.

paite: Balak in bawng leh belam alan a, khenkhat Balaam leh akiang a om miliante kiang ah akhak hi.
english: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes who were with him.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, azingsang in Balak in Balaam api a, Baal mun sangte ah ahohtouhpih a, huai a pan mite omna chiang amupha hi.
english: In the morning, Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal; and he saw from there part of the people.

paite: Balaam in Balak kiang ah, "Hiai ah maitam sagih hon bawlsak inla, bawngtal sagih leh belampa sagih hon suktuahsak in," achi hi.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Build here seven altars for me, and prepare here seven bulls and seven rams for me.”

paite: Balak in Balaam gen bang in ahih a; Balak leh Balaam in maitam chin ah bawngtal khat leh belam khat alan uhi.
english: Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram.

paite: Balaam in Balak kiang ah, "Na halmang thillat bul ah ana dingh gige inla, kei ka va paituam ding. Kei hon houpih ding in TOUPA ahong pai kha thei hi. Ama'n hon hilh peuhmah ka hon hilh ding," achi hi.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go. Perhaps Yahweh will come to meet me. Whatever he shows me I will tell you.” He went to a bare height.

paite: Huchi in mual giau velvul ah ahohtou hi. Pathian in Balaam ana kituahpih hi. Balaam in akiang ah, "Maitam sagih ka bawl khin a; maitam chih ah bawngtal khat leh belampa khat ka lan chiat," achi hi.
english: God met Balaam, and he said to him, “I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.”

paite: TOUPA'N Balaam kam ah thu akoih a, "Balak kiang ah kik nawn inla, va gensawn in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”

paite: Huchi in akiang ah akik nawnta a; ngai in, ahalmang thillat bul ah amah leh Moab milian tengteng leng ana dingh lai uhi.
english: He returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.

paite: Ama'n thu agenta a, "Aram a pan Balak in ahon pi a, suahlam tang a Moab kumpipa'n, 'Hong inla, Jakobte hon hamsiatsak in, hong inla, Israelte hong dalsak in!' achi a.
english: He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East. Come, curse Jacob for me. Come, defy Israel.

paite: Bangchi in Pathian hamsiat louh ka hamsiat dia? Bangchi in Pathian dal louh ka dal dia?
english: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom Yahweh has not defied?

paite: Amau lah suangpi tung a pan ka mu ngal a, mualte a pan amau ka mu a, ngai in, mite atuam in ateng ding ua, namte lak a simtel louh ding ahi uh.
english: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall not be listed among the nations.

paite: Jakobte leivui kua'n asim thei dia, Israelte mun li a khen, mun khat kua'n ahia sim thei ding? Midiktat sih in si sam ning, ka tawpna amah a bang hi hen!" achi hi.
english: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or count the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous! Let my last end be like his!”

paite: Balaam kiang ah Balak in, "N'on bawldan bangchidan ahia? Ka melmate hamsiat ding in ka hon pi a, na vualzawl zaw mawk ngal a!" achi hi.
english: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them altogether.”

paite: Ama'n adawng a, "TOUPA'N ka kam a akoih ka gen ding mah hilou ding maw?" achi hi.
english: He answered and said, “Must I not take heed to speak that which Yahweh puts in my mouth?”

paite: Balak in akiang ah, "Mun dang ah hoh nawn dih ni e, huai a pan na thei vek ding. A-omna chiang uh na mu ding, avek un zaw na mu vek khol kei ding. Huai a pan hon hamsiatsak in," achi hi.
english: Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place, where you may see them. You shall see just part of them, and shall not see them all. Curse them from there for me.”

paite: Huchi in Zophimte tenna Pisgah vum ah apitou a, maitam sagih adoh a, maitam chih ah bawngtal khat leh belampa khat alan hi.
english: He took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

paite: Balak kiang ah, "Pam a TOUPA ka va houpih sung in na halmang thillat bul ah ana dingh lai in," achi hi.
english: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet God over there.”

paite: TOUPA'N Balaam ana kituahpih a, akam ah thu akoih a, "Balak kiang ah kik nawnta inla, akiang ah va gensawn in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”

paite: Akiang ah ava hoh a, ngai in, ahalmang thillat bul ah ana dingh nilouh hi. Moab miliante leng akiang ah a-om uh. Balak in akiang ah, "TOUPA'N bang ana gen a?" achi hi.
english: He came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. Balak said to him, “What has Yahweh spoken?”

paite: Ama'n thu agenta hi: "Thou inla, Balak, ngaikhia in. Zippor tapa, ka thu ngai in.
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.

paite: Pathian zaw Zuauhat mihing ahi kei. Kisik hat mihing tapa leng ahi sam kei. Agensa ahih kei dia hia? Ana gensa ahih piching kei dia hia?
english: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and he won’t do it? Or has he spoken, and he won’t make it good?

paite: Ngai in, vualzawl ding in thupiak ka mu a, ama'n avualzawl khin a, ke'n ka hihlamdang thei kei.
english: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.

paite: Jakobte ah thulimlouhna amu kei a, Israelte ah phengphitna amu sam kei. TOUPA a Pathian uh akiang uah a-om a, alak uah kumpipa kikou husa a-om hi.
english: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. Yahweh his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.

paite: Aigupta a pan Pathian in apikhia a, gam bawngtal tha bang anei uhi.
english: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.

paite: Jakobte tung ah bumhaina a-om kei a; Israelte tung ah leng khimhaina a-om sam kei hi. Jakobte leh Israelte kiang ah Pathian thilhih hihlat ahi!
english: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘What has God done!’

paite: Ngai in, humpinelkai lian bang in mipite athou ua, humpinelkai dawng bang in adingtou ua; asamat uh anek ma un akual kei ding uh, amat uh sisan adawn ma un," achi hi.
english: Behold, a people rises up as a lioness. As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eats of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain.”

paite: Balak in Balaam kiang ah, "Hamsiat ke'nla, vualzawl leng vualzawl het ke'n," achi hi.
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.”

paite: Himahleh Balaam in adawng a, Balak kiang ah, "TOUPA'N agen tengteng ka hih ngeingei ding ahi chi in ka hon hilh khin ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that Yahweh speaks, that I must do’?”

paite: Balak in Balaam kiang ah, "Hong dih, mun dang ah ka hon pi nawn dia, huai a pan na hon hamsiatsak Pathian in phal kha zenzen hiam," achi hi.
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there.”

paite: Huchi in Jeshimon lam nga Peor vum ah Balak in Balaam apitouta hi.
english: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.

paite: Balaam in Balak kiang ah, "Hiai ah maitam sagih hon bawlsak inla, bawngtal sagih leh belampa sagih hon suktuahsak in," achi hi.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”

paite: Balak in Balaam gen bang in ahih a, maitam chih ah bawngtal khat leh belampa khat alan hi.
english: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

paite: Israelte vualzawl ding TOUPA deihlam ahi chih Balaam in atheih in nidang a ahih bang in bumna zat tum lou in gamdai lam anga zawta hi.
english: When Balaam saw that it pleased Yahweh to bless Israel, he didn’t go, as at the other times, to use divination, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

paite: Balaam avandak a, Israel mite anam dungzui zel a om amu a; atung ah Pathian Kha ahong tung hi.
english: Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.

paite: Huchi in hiai thu agen a, "Beor tapa Balaam in agen a, amit a kichiantak a mupa'n agen hi.
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;

paite: Pathian thute za a, Bangkim hihtheipa kilakna mu, akhup a puk a, amitte hong vakpa'n agen hi.
english: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

paite: Jakob aw, na puaninte hoih hi na e, Israel aw, na biakbukte uh!
english: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!

paite: Phaizang bang in akiphah a, luidung a huante bang in, TOUPA suan tosaw bang in, luidung a sidar singte bang ahi uh.
english: As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which Yahweh has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.

paite: Abaltinte a pan tui asungkhe dia, tui tampite ah ahaichi a-om dia, akumpipa Agag sang in asangzaw dia, alalgam tawisang in a-om ding hi.
english: Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.

paite: "Aigupta a pan Pathian in apikhia a, gam bawngtal hatna bang anei a, Amelma uh namdangte anegai dia, aguhte uh atansak dia, athaltangte in akap pailet ding hi.
english: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall consume the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.

paite: Akun a, humpinelkai bang in akual a, humpinelkai bang mai in; kua'n atokthou dia? Hon vualzawl peuhmah vualzawl in om uhenla, hon hamsiat peuhmah hamsiat in om hen," achi hi.
english: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”

paite: Balaam tung ah Balak aheh mahmah a; akhutte nuaituah in Balak in Balaam kiang ah, "Ka melmate hamsiat ding in ka hon sam a, tu in, thumveitak amau na vualzawlta.
english: Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.

paite: Huaiziak in na mun ah taimang in. Thupitak a hon tawisang ding ka hon chih na hi a; himahleh, ngai in, TOUPA'N nang ka hon tawisang ding adal," achi hi.
english: Therefore, flee to your place, now! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, Yahweh has kept you back from honor.”

paite: Balaam in Balak kiang ah, "Na misawlte kiang ah ka gen kei maw?
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I also tell your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,

paite: 'Balak in a-inn dangka leh dangka- eng a dim hon pe ding himahleh, ahoih lam hiam, aselam hiam TOUPA thu khen lam ah keimah lungsim a suak in bangmah ka hihthei kei. TOUPA'N agen peuhmah ka gen ding,' chi in.
english: ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond Yahweh’s word, to do either good or bad from my own mind. I will say what Yahweh says’?

paite: "Ngai in, ka mite kiang ah ka paita ding. Huaiziak in hong hoh in, tunung a na mite tung a hiai mite'n ahih ding uh ka hon hilh ding," achi hi.
english: Now, behold, I go to my people. Come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”

paite: Hiai thu agen a, Beor tapa Balaam mitvaktak amu in agen hi.
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;

paite: "Pathian thute za a, Tungnungpen theihna thei, Bangkim hihthei kilakna mu, akhup a puk a mit hong vakta in;
english: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

paite: Amah ka mu, himahleh tu in hilou in; Amah ka en a, naichik ah hilou in. Jakob a pan aksi khat ahong suakkhe dia, Israel a pan lalchiang ahong dingkhe dia, Moab gam nawlte adou dia, Seth tapate ahihse ding hi.
english: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and crush all the sons of Sheth.

paite: Amelma Edom leh Seirte lak zoh in a-om ding ua; Israel in hattak in ahih ding hi.
english: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemy, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.

paite: Jakob a pan ukmi khat ahong paikhe dia, khopi a omsunte ahihmang ding," achi hi.
english: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”

paite: Amalek lam anga a, thu agen a, "Amalek bel namte bulpen ahi na a, adawn lam tangtawn a amanthatna ahi," achi hi.
english: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, but his latter end shall come to destruction.”

paite: Kente lam anga a, thu agen a, "Na tenna mun akip a, suangpi ah na bu na sep hi.
english: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.

paite: "Asshurte'n sal a hon pimang masiah, Kente hihmanthat in na om ding uh," achi hi.
english: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive.”

paite: Thu agen nawn a, "Pathian in hiai ahih, kua ahing zou dia?
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Alas, who shall live when God does this?

paite: Himahleh Kittim gam a pan longte ahong tung ding ua, Asshur ahihgim dia, Eber ahihgim ding ua, Amah leng amangthang ding," achi hi.
english: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber. He also shall come to destruction.”

paite: Huchi in Balaam adingkhia a, akhua ah apaita. Huchi in Balak leng apai samta hi.
english: Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.

paite: Huan Shittim a Israelte ataam sung un, pasalte'n Moab numeite akithuahpih uhi.
english: Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab;

paite: Apathiante uh ma a kithoihnate ah achial ua; huchi in ane ua, apathiante ma ah akun uhi.
english: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods. The people ate and bowed down to their gods.

paite: Israelte'n Peor Baal abe samta uhi. Huchi in Israelte tung ah TOUPA hehna akuangta hi.
english: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Mipite heutu tengteng pi inla, TOUPA hehna lauhuaitak mai Israelte tung a pan akikhinmang theihna ding in sun khovak ah amaute that in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up to Yahweh before the sun, that the fierce anger of Yahweh may turn away from Israel.”

paite: Mosi in Israelte vaihawmte kiang ah, "Peor Baal biakna a tel peuhmahte that vek un," achi hi.
english: Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor.”

paite: Ngai in, puanin kongkhak a mite kap a a-om laitak un, Mosi leh Israel omkhawmte mitmuh in Israel mi khat in Midian numei khat a-unaute kiang ah ahon pi hi.
english: Behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brothers a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Siampu Aaron tapa Eleazar tapa Phinehas in amuhtak in omkhawmte a pan athou a, teipi khat alata hi.
english: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the middle of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand.

paite: Israel mi apuanin sung ah adelhlut a, Israel mi toh anih un asun pailet a, numei pen agil ah asun pailet hi. Huchi in Israel suante tung a hipi adaita hi.
english: He went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stopped among the children of Israel.

paite: Himahleh huai hipi a site singnih-le-sangli ahi uh.
english: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Siampu Aaron tapa Eleazar tapa Phinehas in alak ua kei a dia phatuam angaih ziak in Israel suante a pan ka hehna aheimang a, huchi in ka thikthusiat ziak in Israel suante ka hihmangthang kei hi.
english: “Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I didn’t consume the children of Israel in my jealousy.

paite: Huaiziak in ngai in, ka lemna thukhun amah ka pe ding hi.
english: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace.

paite: Amah leh anung a asuante a ding in tangtawn siamputna thukhun ahi dia; a Pathian a dia phatuam ngai a Israel suante a dia kilemna abawlsak ziak in, chi in gen in," achi hi.
english: It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”

paite: Midian numei toh athah uh Israel mi min Jimri ahi a, amah Simeonte lak a inkuan a vaihawm makai Salu tapa ahi.
english: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.

paite: Athah uh Midian numei min Kozbi ahi. Amah Zur tanu ahi a, Midiante inkuan lak a heutu ahi.
english: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Midiante hihlungzing unla, that un.
english: “Harass the Midianites, and strike them;

paite: Amau Peor tungtang thu leh a-unaunu uh Midiante heutu tanu Kozbi toh kisai a noute ahon khem lai un, melma bang a hon sai uh ahi. Peor ziak a hipi ahong tun in Kozbi thah a om ahi,” achi hi.
english: for they harassed you with their wiles, wherein they have deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the incident regarding Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.”

paite: Huan hipi adaih nung in hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA'N Mosi leh siampu Aaron tapa Eleazar ahoupih a,
english: After the plague, Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

paite: "Israel suan omkhawm tengteng, kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, a-inkuan dungzui un Israel gam a galdou thei chiang teng sim vek un," achi hi.
english: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go out to war in Israel.”

paite: Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in Jeriko zawn, Jordan gei, Moab Phaizang ah amaute ahoupih a,
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

paite: "Mipite kum sawmnih a pan atunglamte sim un," TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante kiang a thu apiak bang in, achi uhi.
english: “Take a census, from twenty years old and upward, as Yahweh commanded Moses and the children of Israel.” These are those who came out of the land of Egypt.

paite: Israel ta upapen Reuben: Reuben tapate: Hanok suan Hanok inkote, Pallu suan Pallu inkote.
english: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;

paite: Hezron suan Hezron inkote, Karmi suan Karmi inkote.
english: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

paite: Hiaite Reubente inkuante ahi uh. Sim a om tengteng singli sangthum zasagih-le-sawmthum ahi uh.
english: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.

paite: Pallu suan Eliab.
english: The son of Pallu: Eliab.

paite: Eliab suante: Neumuel, Dathan leh Ahiram ahi uh. Hiai Dathan leh Abiram ahi ua, TOUPA ahehsak lai ua Mosi leh Aaron kalh a Korah pawl a tel omkhawmte.
english: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram who were called by the congregation, who rebelled against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah when they rebelled against Yahweh;

paite: Huai pawl asih lai un lei in akam aka a, Korahte toh avalhkhawm a; mei in mi zanih-le-sawmnga akattum lai in, huchi in chiamtehna ana hita uhi.
english: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah when that company died; at the time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.

paite: Himahleh Korah tapate asi kei uh.
english: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.

paite: Simeon tapate inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a asuante uh: Nemuel suan Nemuel inkote, Jamin suan Jamin inkote, Jakin suan Jakin inkote,
english: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;

paite: Zerah suan Zerah inkote, Shaul suan Shaul inkote ahi uh.
english: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

paite: Hiaite Simeon suante ahi ua, singnih sangnih-le-zanih ahi uh.
english: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.

paite: A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Gad tapate: Zephon suan Zephon inkote, Haggi suan Haggi inkote leh Shuni suan Shuni inkote,
english: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;

paite: Ozni suan Ozni inkote, Eri suan Eri inkote;
english: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;

paite: Arod suan Arod inkote leh Areli suan Areli inkote.
english: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

paite: Hiaite asimdan bang zel ua Gad tapate suante ahi ua, singli-le-zanga ahi uh.
english: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

paite: Judah tapate: Er leh Onan ahi a, huan Kanaan gam ah Er leh Onan asi uhi.
english: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

paite: Judah suante inkuan paidan hichibang ahi: Shelah suan Shelah inkote,
english: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.

paite: leh Perez suan Perez inkote: Zer suan Zer inkote, Hezron suan Hezron inkote; Hamul suan Hamul inkote ahi uh.
english: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

paite: Hiaite asimdan bang zel un Judah tapate suante ahi ua, singsagih sangguk-le-zanga ahi uh.
english: These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.

paite: A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Issakar suante: Tola suan Tola inkote, Puah suan Puah inkote,
english: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;

paite: Jashub suan Jashub inkote, Shimron suan Shimron inkote ahi uh.
english: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

paite: Hiaite asimdan bang zel ua Issakar tapate suante ahi ua, singguk sangli-le-zathum ahi.
english: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.

paite: A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Zebulun suante: Sered suan Sered inkote, Elon suan Elon inkote, Jahleel suan Jahleel inkote ahi uh.
english: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

paite: Hiaite asimdan bang zel ua Zebulunte suante ahi ua, singguk-le-zanga ahi uh.
english: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were counted of them, sixty thousand five hundred.

paite: A-inkuan uh kizomdan dungzui zel a Joseph suante: Manasseh leh Ephraim.
english: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.

paite: Manasseh suante: Makir suan Makir inkote; Makir in Gilead asuang a, Gilead suan Gilead inkote ahi uh.
english: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

paite: Hiaite Gilead suante ahi ua: Iezer suan Iezer inkote, Helek suan Helek inkote,
english: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;

paite: Asriel suan Asriel inkote, Shekem suan Shekem inkote,
english: and Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;

paite: Shemida suan Shemida inkote; Hepher suan Hepher inkote ahi uh.
english: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

paite: Hepher tapa Zelophehad in tapa nei lou in tanute anei a: Zelophehad tanute min Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah leh Tirzah ahi uh.
english: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

paite: Hiaite Manasseh suante ahi uh. Asim teng uh singnga sangnih-le-zasagih ahi.
english: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.

paite: Hiai a-inkuan uh kizomdan dungzui zel a Ephraim suante ahi ua: Shuthelah suan Suthelah inkote, Beker suan Beker inkote, Tahan suan Tahan inkote ahi uh.
english: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

paite: Hiaite Shuthelah suante ahi ua: Eran suan Eran inkote ahi uh.
english: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

paite: Hiaite asimdan bang zel un Ephraim suante inkuan ahi ua, singthum sangnih-le-zanga ahi. Hiai a-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Joseph suante ahi uh.
english: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were counted of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

paite: A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Benjamin suante: Bela suan Bela inkote, Ashbel suan Ashbel inkote, Ahiram suan Ahiram inkote,
english: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;

paite: Shupham suan Shupham inkote, Hupham suan Hupham inkote ahi uh.
english: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

paite: Bela suante Ard leh Naaman ahi uh: Ard suan Ard inkote, Naaman suan Naaman inkote ahi uh.
english: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

paite: Hiaite a-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel in Benjamin suante ahi uh. Asim teng uh singli sangnga-le-zaguk ahi.
english: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.

paite: Hiaite a-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Dan suante ahi ua: Shuham suan Shuham inkote ahi uh. Hiaite a-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Dan suante ahi uh.
english: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

paite: Saham suante tengteng asimdan bang zel un singguk sangli-le-zali ahi.
english: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.

paite: A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Asher suante ahi ua: Jimna suan a pan Jimna inkote, Ishvi suan a pan Ishvi inkote; Beriah suan a pan Beriah inkote.
english: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.

paite: Beriah suan Beriah inkote: Heber suan a pan Heber inkote; Malkiel suan a pan Malkiel inkote ahi uh.
english: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

paite: Asher tanu min Serah ahi.
english: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

paite: Hiaite Asher tapate suan asim teng uh ahi ua, singnga sangthum-le-zali ahi.
english: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred.

paite: A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Naphtali suante: Jahzeel suan a pan Jahzeel inkote; Guni suan a pan Guni inkote;
english: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;

paite: Jezer suan a pan Jezer inkote; Silem suan a pan Silem inkote ahi uh.
english: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

paite: Hiaite a-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Naphtali suante ahi ua; asim teng uh singli sangnga-le-zali ahi.
english: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.

paite: Hiaite Israel suante asim teng uh ahi ua, nuaiguk sangkhat zasagih-le-sawmthum ahi.
english: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Hiaite amin zah zel ua gam hawmsak ding ahi.
english: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

paite: Atam deuhte gam na pe tam dia, atawm deuhte gam na pe tawm deuh ding ahi. Asimdan bang in gam piak chiat ding ahi.
english: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.

paite: Himahleh aisan a gam hawm ding ahi: Apute nam min kizomdan bang zel in gam atang ding uhi.
english: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

paite: Aisan bang zel in atam leh atawmte kiang ah gam hawm ahi ding hi,” achi hi.
english: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”

paite: Hiai Levite, a-inkuan kizomdan bang zel ua simte ahi uh: Gershon suan a pan Gershon inkote; Kohath suan a pan Kohath inkote; Merari suan a pan Merari inkote ahi uh.
english: These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

paite: Hiaite Levi suante ahi uh: Libni inkote, Hebron inkote, Mahli inkote, Mushi inkote, Korah inkote ahi uhi.
english: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.

paite: Kohath in Amram asuang a, Amram zi min Jokebed, Levi tanu, Aigupta gam a Levi a pan a piang ahi a, ama'n Amram lak ah Aaron leh Mosi leh asanggamnu Miriam asuang hi.
english: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

paite: Aaron in Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar asuang hi.
english: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

paite: Nadab leh Abihu in TOUPA zat louh chi meikuang azat lai un asi uhi.
english: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before Yahweh.

paite: Sim tengteng pasal kha khat chiang tunglam teng singnih-le-sangthum ahi. Israel mite lak ah gam hawm tang ding ahih louh ziak un Israel mite lak ah sim ahi kei uh.
english: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not counted among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

paite: Jeriko zawn, Jordan gei, Moab Phaizang a Israel suante Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in asim uh hiaite ahi uh.
english: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

paite: Himahleh hiaite lak ah Sinai gamdai a Israel mite Mosi leh siampu Aaron in asimte, khat lel leng a-omta kei hi.
english: But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

paite: TOUPA'N gamdai ah asi ngeingei ding uh, ana chi khinta ngal a. Jephunneh tapa Kaleb leh Nun tapa Joshua lou ngal kuamah dam a-om kei uhi.
english: For Yahweh had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

paite: oseph tapa Manasseh suan a Manasseh tapa Makir, huai mi tapa Gilead, huai mi tapa Hepher tapa Jelophehad tanute ahong pai ua, atanute min, Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah leh Tirzah ahi uh.
english: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin kongkhak ah Mosi, siampu Eleazar leh miliante leh omkhawmte tengteng ma a kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah ava dingh uhi.
english: They stood before Moses, before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,

paite: "Gamdai ah ka pu uh asi a, TOUPA kalh a kikhawm, Korah pawl ah atel kei. Himahleh amah khelh ziak in asi a, tapa anei kei hi.
english: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against Yahweh in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin. He had no sons.

paite: Tapa aneih louh ziak lel in bangziak a ka pa uh min, asuante a pan mang ding ahia? Ka pa unaute lak ah tantuan hon pia un," achi uhi.
english: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”

paite: Mosi in athu uh TOUPA ma ah atun hi.
english: Moses brought their cause before Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Jelophehad tanute'n ahihdik uhi. Apa uh unaute lak ah tantuan na bawlsak ding ahi. Apa uh tantuan na piak ding ahi.
english: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers. You shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.

paite: Israel suante kiang ah mi tapa nei lou a asihleh agou atanute na piak ding uh ahi.
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.

paite: Tanu aneih keileh agou a-unaute na piak ding uh ahi.
english: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.

paite: "Sanggam pasalte aneih keileh agou apa sanggam pasalte na piak ding uh ahi.
english: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

paite: Apa'n sanggam pasalte aneih keileh agou atanau na pe ding ua, ama'n aluah ding hi. TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang a Israel suante a ding in vaihawmna dan thuseh kip ahi ding, chi in gen in," achi hi.
english: If his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman who is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it. This shall be a statute and ordinance for the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, “Abarim tang ah hohtou inla, Israel suante ka piak ding gam va en in.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.

paite: Na muh khit chiang in na sanggampa Aaron achipihte kiang a pi ahih mah bang in nang leng pi na hita ding hi!
english: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;

paite: Zin gamdai a omkhawmte aphun lai ua amitmuh ua tui a kei hon pahtawi dia ka hon thupiak kalh a na hel ziak in," achi hi. Huaite Zin gamdai a Kadesh a Meribah tuite ahi.
english: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)

paite: Mosi in TOUPA ahoupih a,
english: Moses spoke to Yahweh, saying,

paite: "Omkhawm mipite tung a om ding mi khat, sa tengteng khate Pathian, TOUPA'N sep hen.
english: “Let Yahweh, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,

paite: TOUPA mi omkhawmte chingtu nei lou belam bang a a-omlouhna ding un, ama uh kai ding, amaute pikhia a, pilut ding in," achi hi.
english: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that the congregation of Yahweh may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Huai Kha omnapa Nun tapa Joshua pi inla, atung ah na khut nga in.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.

paite: Siampu Eleazar leh omkhawm mipite ma ah dingsak inla, amitmuh un amah nna guan in.
english: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.

paite: Israel suante mipi omkhawm tengteng in athu aman theihna ding un atung ah na zahtakhuaina nga in.
english: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.

paite: Huchi in amah siampu Eleazar ma ah adingh dia, ama'n TOUPA ma ah Urim thu alaksak dia; athu in apawt ding ua, athu in alut ding uh; amah leh Israel suan tengteng, omkhawmte toh," achi hi.
english: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before Yahweh. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”

paite: Mosi in TOUPA thupiak bang in ahih a, Joshua api a, Eleazar leh omkhawmte ma ah adingsak hi.
english: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him. He took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.

paite: Huchi in atung ah akhut anga a, Mosi zang a TOUPA'N agen bang in nna aguanta hi.
english: He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as Yahweh spoke by Moses.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante thu pia inla, akiang uah, kei a dia gimlim mei a thillat, ka kiang a thillat pen ahun geih in na lan ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, as a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’

paite: Akiang uah, hiai mei a thillat TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh ahi. Belamnoupa, kum khat a upa, gensiatbei, niteng in nih, halmang thillat alat gige ding ahi.
english: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to Yahweh: male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

paite: Belamnou khat zingsang in na lan ding ua, nitaklam in khat na lan ding uh.
english: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening,

paite: Tangbuang thillat ding in tangbuang nelte ephah mun sawm a khen mun khat sathau suk, hin mun li a khen mun khat a hel toh.
english: with one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.

paite: TOUPA a dia mei a thillat, gimlim dia Sinai Tang a sehsa halmang thillat lat gige ding ahi.
english: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Belamnou khat latna a dawn thillat, hin mun li a khen mun khat ahi ding ahi. TOUPA a dia uain, dawn thillat mun siangthou ah na sungkhe ding ahi.
english: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for each lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to Yahweh in the holy place.

paite: Belamnou khat nitaklam in na lan dia: zingsang lam a tangbuang thillat bang in leh dawn thillat bang in TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in mei a thillat na lan ding ahi.
english: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Sabbath ni in belamnoupa kum khat a upa, gensiatbei nih leh tangbuang thillat a ding in tangbuang nelte ephah mun sawm a khen mun nih sathau a helkhawm leh dawn thillat toh na lat ding ahi.
english: “‘On the Sabbath day, you shall offer two male lambs a year old without defect, and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering:

paite: Hiai Sabbath niteng a halmang thillat lat gige leh dawn thillat sim louh a halmang thillat lat ding ahi.
english: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

paite: Na kha thak teng un TOUPA a dia halmang thil na lat ding uh ahi. Ganhon a pan bawngtal nih, belampa khat leh belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sagih.
english: “‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect,

paite: Bawngtal chih ah tangbuang thillat ding in tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm ephah mun sawm a khen mun thum; belam khat a tangbuang thillat ah tangbuang nelte, sathau a helkhawm mun sawm a khen mun nih.
english: and three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for the one ram;

paite: Belamnou chih ah tangbuang thillat ah tangbuang nelte, sathau a helkhawm mun sawm a khen mun khat. Hiai halmang thillat gimlim TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ahi.
english: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb, as a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Adawn thillat uh bawngtal khat ah uain hin kimkhat ahi dia, belampa khat ah hin mun thum a khen mun khat, belamnou khat ah hin mun li a khen mun khat. Hiai kumtawn a kha teng a halmang thillat ahi.
english: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

paite: TOUPA kiang a khelh thoihna dia kelpa khat na lat ding uh ahi; halmang thillat lat gige leh huai dawn thillat sim louh in.
english: Also, one male goat for a sin offering to Yahweh shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

paite: Akha khatna, ani sawm-le-li ni TOUPA Paikan ahi.
english: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Yahweh’s Passover.

paite: Huai kha ani sawm-le-nga ni ankuanglui ni ahi dia; ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh nek ding ahi.
english: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.

paite: Ani khat ni in khawmpi siangthou a-om dia; nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
english: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work,

paite: Mei a thillat bel TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh ahi. Ganhon a pan bawngtal nih, belampa khat leh belamnoupa kum khat a upa sagih; na ngaihtuah ua gensiatbei ahi ding ahi.
english: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old. They shall be without defect,

paite: Tangbuang nelte, sathau helkhawm, atangbuang thillat uh toh, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen mun thum, belampa khat ah mun sawm a khen mun nih.
english: with their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer three tenths for a bull, and two tenths for the ram.

paite: Belamnou sagih bel belamnou khat ah mun sawm a khen mun khat ahi ding ahi.
english: You shall offer one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

paite: Nou a dia kilemna bawlna ding khelh thoihna ding in kelpa khat.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.

paite: Hiaite zingsang a halmang thillat dawn thillat sim louh a lat gige ding ahi.
english: You shall offer these in addition to the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

paite: Hichibang in TOUPA a dia gimlim, mei a thillat nek ding niteng in, ni sagih sung na lan ding uh ahi; halmang thillat lat gige leh dawn thillat sim louh in.
english: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh. It shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

paite: Ani sagih ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua, nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
english: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

paite: Na Nipikal Ankuangluina, na buh thak tung ankuangluina TOUPA a dia thil thak tangbuang thillat na lat ni un leng khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua; nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to Yahweh in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;

paite: TOUPA a dia gimlim halmang thillat bel na lat ding uh ahi; ganhopn a pan bawngtal nih, belampa khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa sagih.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh, tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen mun thum.
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the one ram,

paite: Belampa khat ah mun sawm a khen mun nih, belamnou sagih, belamnou khat chiat ah mun sawm a khen mun khat.
english: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

paite: Nou a dia kilemna bawlna ding kelpa khat toh.
english: and one male goat, to make atonement for you.

paite: Haltum thillat gige leh huai a tangbuang thillat, huaite dawn thillat toh na lat ding uh ahi, na ngaihtuah ua gensiatbei ahi ding ahi.
english: Besides the continual burnt offering and its meal offering, you shall offer them and their drink offerings. See that they are without defect.

paite: "Huan akha sagihna, ani khat ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua; nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei; nou a ding in pengkul mut ni ahi ding ahi.
english: “‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no regular work. It is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.

paite: TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in halmang thillat na lan ding uh ahi: Ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai khat, belampa khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sagih.
english: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh, tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen mun thum, belampa khat ah mun sawm a khen mun nih,
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram,

paite: belamnou sagih, khat chiat ah mun sawm a khen mun khat.
english: and one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

paite: Nou a dia kilemna bawlna ding in khelh thoihna kelpa khat toh.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;

paite: Kha thak halmang thillat leh huai tangbuang thillatte, halmang thillat lat gige leh huai a tangbuang thillat, dawn thillat, ahihdan ngeina uh TOUPA a dia gimlim ding a mei a thillatte sim louh in.
english: in addition to the burnt offering of the new moon with its meal offering, and the continual burnt offering with its meal offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: "Hiai akha sagihna, ani sawm ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding uh. Na hinna uh zangsak in nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall afflict your souls. You shall do no kind of work;

paite: TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in halmang thillat na lan ding uh ahi. Ganhon a pan bawngtal khat, belampa khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa sagih; na ngaihtuah ua gensiatbei ahih ding ahi.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old, all without defect;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh, tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen mun thum, belampa khat ah mun sawm a khen mun nih.
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the one ram,

paite: Belamnou sagih, belamnou khat chiat ah mun sawm a khen mun khat.
english: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

paite: Khelh thoihna ding in kelpa khat toh; kilemna dia khelh thoihna, halmang thillat lat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn thillat uh sim louh in.
english: one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.

paite: "Akha sagihna, ani sawm-le-nga ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua; bang nna mahmah na sem ding uh ahi kei, TOUPA a ding in ni sagih sung ankuang na lui ding uh ahi.
english: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. You shall keep a feast to Yahweh seven days.

paite: TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in mei a thillat, halmang thillat na lat ding uh ahi. Ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai sawm-le-thum, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa sawm-le-li, huaite gensiatbei chiat ahih ding uh ahi:
english: You shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh sathau toh helkhawm bawngtal sawm-le-thum, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen mun thum, belampa nih, belampa khat ah mun sawm a khen mun nih.
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenths for each ram of the two rams,

paite: Belamnou sawm-le-li, belamnou khat ah mun sawm a khen mun khat.
english: and one tenth for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;

paite: Khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

paite: "Ani nih ni in bawngtaltuai sawm-le-nih, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li na lat ding uh ahi.
english: “‘On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh leh dawn thillat a dan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding,
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

paite: khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat gige, huai atangbuang thillat, dawn thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering and their drink offerings.

paite: "Ani thum ni in bawngtal sawm-le-khat, belampa nih, belamnou kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li.
english: “‘On the third day: eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

paite: Khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige leh huai atangbuang thillat leh huai adawn thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

paite: "Ani li ni in bawngtal sawm, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li.
english: “‘On the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh leh dawn thillat, adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding,
english: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

paite: khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

paite: "Ani nga ni in bawngtal kua, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li.
english: “‘On the fifth day: nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh leh dawn thillat uh, adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat uh, adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un, bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

paite: Khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn ding thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

paite: "Ani guk ni in bawngtal giat, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li.
english: “‘On the sixth day: eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un bawngtal a ding;
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

paite: khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and the drink offerings of it.

paite: "Ani sagih ni in bawngtal sagih, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li.
english: “‘On the seventh day: seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat, adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un, bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding,
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

paite: khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

paite: "Ani giat ni in khawmpi siangthoutak na nei ding ua; nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly. You shall do no regular work;

paite: TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in halmang thillat bel na lat ding uh ahi. Bawngtal khat, belampa khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sagih.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

paite: "Atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat uh, bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding, adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un,
english: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance,

paite: khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige leh huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn ding thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering, and its drink offering.

paite: "Na thuchiamte uh, ut thu a thillatte, na halmang thillatte uh, na tangbuang thillatte uh, na dawn thillatte uh, na kilemna thillatte uh sim louh in hiaite ankuangluina hunbi nei a na neihte uh ni in TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding uhi, chi in,” achi hi.
english: “‘You shall offer these to Yahweh in your set feasts—in addition to your vows and your free will offerings—for your burnt offerings, your meal offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak tengteng Mosi in Israel suante ahilh hi.
english: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: TOUPA'N Sinai Tang a Mosi ahouph la a Aaron leh Mosi suan hiaite ahi uh.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that Yahweh spoke with Moses in Mount Sinai.

paite: Aaron tapate min, a-upapen Nadab, huan Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar ahi.
english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

paite: Hiaite siampu dia thaunilh, siampu nasem ding a sehtuam, Aaron tapate min ahi.
english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.

paite: Nadab leh Abihu ahihleh Sinai gamdai a mei zat louh ding achih, TOUPA ma a alat lai un TOUPA ma ah asita ua, ta anei kei uhi. Eleazar leh Ithamar in apa uh Aaron dam lai in siampu nna asem uhi.
english: Nadab and Abihu died before Yahweh when they offered strange fire before Yahweh in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children. Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the presence of Aaron their father.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Levi chite, siampu Aaron kiang ah pi inla, nna aseptheihna ding un akiang ah omsak in.
english: “Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him.

paite: Amau biakbuk a nasem in kihoupihna biakbuk chin ah amah leh omkhawm mipi tengteng a ding in nna asem ding uhi.
english: They shall keep his requirements, and the requirements of the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin van tengteng akem ding ua, Israel suante a ding in biakbuk ah asem ding uh.
english: They shall keep all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting, and the obligations of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

paite: Levite Aaron leh atapate kiang ah na pe ding a; Israel suante lak a kipan amah kiang a piak ahi uhi.
english: You shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons. They are wholly given to him on the behalf of the children of Israel.

paite: Aaron leh atapate na sep ding a, asiampu hihna nna asem nilouh ding uh. Midang hong kigolh a-omleh hihlup ding ahi," achi hi.
english: You shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood, but the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Ngai in, Levite Israel suante lak a pan Israel suante tachil sul hong masapen sik-le-tang a keimah ngei in ka lak ahi uh. Huaiziak in Levite kei a ahi ding uhi.
english: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn who open the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine,

paite: Piang masa ta tengteng kei a ahi. Aigupta gam a piang masa tengteng ka thah ni in Israelte lak a piang masa tengteng, amihing leh ganta tan in kei a tuam ding a ka kham ahi. Kei a ahi ding uh. Kei, TOUPA ka hi,” achi hi.
english: for all the firstborn are mine. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I made holy to me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and animal. They shall be mine. I am Yahweh.”

paite: Sinai gamdai ah TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

paite: "Levi tate a-inkuankuan un, akhang-akhang un sim inla; pasal peuhmah kha khat a pan atunglam teng na sim ding ahi," achi hi.
english: “Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families. You shall count every male from a month old and upward.”

paite: Mosi in ahih ding a thupiak bang in TOUPA thu bang in asim chiatta hi.
english: Moses counted them according to Yahweh’s word, as he was commanded.

paite: Levi tapate min: Gershon, Kohath leh Merari ahi.
english: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

paite: Amaute suangpa Gershon tapate min Libni leh Shimei ahi.
english: These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.

paite: Amaute suangpa Kohath tapate min Amram, Izhar, Hebron leh Uzziel ahi.
english: The sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

paite: Amaute suangpa Merari tapate min Mahli leh Mushi ahi. Hiaite a-inkuan uh dungzui zel a Levi suante ahi uh.
english: The sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.

paite: Gershon, Libnite leh Simeite suangpa ahi a, hiaite Gershonte suante ahi uhi,
english: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites. These are the families of the Gershonites.

paite: Pasal tengteng kha khat a pan atunglam asimte uh sangsagih-le-zanga ahi uhi.
