english: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, even those who were counted of them were seven thousand five hundred.

paite: Gershonte suante'n apuanin uh biakbuk tumlam pang ah akai ding uhi.
english: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.

paite: Gershonte inkuan a vaihawm makai Lael tapa Eliasaph ahi.
english: Eliasaph the son of Lael shall be the prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites.

paite: Gershon tapate'n kihoupihna biakbuk a asep ding uh ahihleh biakbuk leh puanin, atung, kihoupihna biakbuk leh akongkhak puanzak kep ahi ding a;
english: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, the tent, its covering, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

paite: a-intual puanzakte, biakbuk chin a, a-intual kongkhak puanzak leh maitam kim a zat ding khau tengteng toh leng ahi lai ding hi.
english: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and its cords for all of its service.

paite: Kohath bel Amramte, Izharte, Hebronte leh Uzzielte suangpa ahi a; hiai teng Kohath suante ahi uhi.
english: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites. These are the families of the Kohathites.

paite: Pasal tengteng kha khat a pan atunglam asimdan bang zel un sanggiat-le-zaguk ahi ua, mun siangthou akem ding uhi.
english: According to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred keeping the requirements of the sanctuary.

paite: Kohath tapate suante'n biakbuk simlam pang ah apuanin akai ding uhi.
english: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.

paite: Kohathte suante inkuan a vaihawm makai ding Uzziel tapa Eliazaphan ahi.
english: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

paite: Akep dingte: bawm, dohkan, sathau, khawnvak koihna, maitam, mun siangthou a nasepna tui-um belsuan tengteng, puanzak leh huai a nasepna thil tengteng ahi.
english: Their duty shall be the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, the screen, and all its service.

paite: Siampu Aaron tapa Eleazar, Levi makaite vaihawm makai ahi ding a, mun siangthou kem mite amakaih ding hi.
english: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, with the oversight of those who keep the requirements of the sanctuary.

paite: Merari, Mahlite leh Mushite suangpa ahi. Hiai Merari suante ahi uh.
english: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.

paite: Pasal tengteng kha khat a pan atunglam asimdan bang zel un sangguk-le-zanih ahi uh.
english: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.

paite: Merari suante inkuan a vaihawm makai Abihail tapa Zuriel ahi a; biakbuk mallam pang ah apuanin akai ding uhi.
english: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.

paite: Merari tapate kep ding a sehte biakbuk khuam lepkhawm, baangkal, akhuamte, akingakna khuakkuak, avanzat tengteng leh nasepna vanzat tengteng ahi uh.
english: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service,

paite: Akongpi umna khuamte, akingakna khuakkuakte, akilhbelhna leh akhaute toh leng ahi lai ding hi.
english: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords.

paite: Biakbuk suahlam pang kihoupihna biakbuk chin a, nisuahna lam a puanin kai ding ahihleh Mosi leh Aaron leh atapa ahi ding ua, mun siangthou ah Israel suante a tuam ding in akul peuhpeuh asem ding uh. Namdang hong kigolh peuhmah thah ding ahi.
english: Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward, in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Moses, with Aaron and his sons, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary for the duty of the children of Israel. The outsider who comes near shall be put to death.

paite: TOUPA thupiak a Levite a-inkuankuan ua pasal tengteng kha khat a pan atunglam Mosi leh Aaron in asim teng uh singnih-le-sangnih ahi uh.
english: All who were counted of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the commandment of Yahweh, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Israel suante lak a piang masa, pasal kha khat a pan atunglam teng sim inla, azah uh thei in.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Count all the firstborn males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

paite: Israel suante lak a piang masa teng sik in kei a ding in Levite na hon laksak dia, Israel suante gan tengteng apiang masapen sik in Levite gante, na hon laksak ding ahi, kei TOUPA ka hi," achi hi.
english: You shall take the Levites for me—I am Yahweh—instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel.”

paite: Mosi in TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in Israel suante lak a piang masa teng asim hi.
english: Moses counted, as Yahweh commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

paite: Amin uh kizom bang zel in kha khat a pan atunglam piang masa pasal teng asim a, singnih sangnih zanih sawmsagih-le-thum ahi uh.
english: All the firstborn males according to the number of names from a month old and upward, of those who were counted of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante lak a piang masa teng sik in Levite la inla, agan uh sik in Levite gan; Levite kei a ahi ding ua; kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of their livestock; and the Levites shall be mine. I am Yahweh.

paite: Levite sang a tamzawte lak ah tat ding in Israel suante piang masa zanih sawmsagih-le-thum la in.
english: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel who exceed the number of the Levites,

paite: Shekel nga chiat na la ding ahi; mun siangthou a shekel bang in na la ding, shekel bel gerah sawmnih ahi:
english: you shall take five shekels apiece for each one; according to the shekel of the sanctuary you shall take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs);

paite: Atatna sum val Aaron leh atapate na piak ding ahi," achi hi.
english: and you shall give the money, with which their remainder is redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons.”

paite: Levite tatte ban ah atatna sum uh Mosi in ala hi.
english: Moses took the redemption money from those who exceeded the number of those who were redeemed by the Levites;

paite: Israel suante piang masate lak a pan sum ala a; sum siangthou shekel bang in sangkhat zathum sawmguk-le-nga ala hi.
english: from the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak, TOUPA thu bang in Mosi in tatna sum Aaron leh atapate apia hi.
english: and Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and to his sons, according to Yahweh’s word, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Huan Mosi in Israel suan Intekpente ahoupih a, "TOUPA'N thu apiak pentak hiai ahi.
english: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded.

paite: Mi'n TOUPA kiang a thu achiam a ahihkeileh athuchiam a kihenleh athuchiam abohse ding ahi kei. Akam a pawt bangbang ahih ding ahi.
english: When a man vows a vow to Yahweh, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.

paite: "Numei in leng anungak lai a, apa inn a a-om lai a, TOUPA kiang a thu achiam a, athuchiam a akihen a;
english: “Also, when a woman vows a vow to Yahweh and binds herself by a pledge, being in her father’s house, in her youth,

paite: athuchiam leh athuchiam a akihenna apa'n azak a, apa'n adaihsan maimahleh athuchiam tengteng apaisuak ding ahi. Athuchiam a akihenna a-om gige ding ahi.
english: and her father hears her vow and her pledge with which she has bound her soul, and her father says nothing to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

paite: Himahleh apa'n azak ni a aphal keileh athuchiam a akihenna thuchiamte akoi mahmah apaisuak kei ding. Apa'n aphal louh ziak in TOUPA'N amah angaidam ding hi.
english: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows or of her pledges with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. Yahweh will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.

paite: "Thuchiam min thu khual lou a, ahenna a-om lai a pasal aneih a;
english: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,

paite: apasal in azak a, azak ni a, adaih dideleh athuchiam a-om gige dia, thuchiam a ahenna leng a-om gige ding.
english: and her husband hears it, and says nothing to her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her pledges with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

paite: Himahleh apasal in azak ni a aphal keileh atung a thuchiam leh khual lou a akihenna amang dia, TOUPA'N amah angaidam ding.
english: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he makes void her vow which is on her and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul. Yahweh will forgive her.

paite: "Himahleh meithai hiam, mak a omnu hiam thuchiam zaw, ahenna tengteng in adelh gige ding.
english: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul shall stand against her.

paite: "Inn a thu achiam a, kichiam a akihenleh,
english: “If she vowed in her husband’s house or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,

paite: apasal in azak a leng adaih dide a, aphal louh keileh athuchiam a-om gige dia, kichiam a akihenna leng a-om gige ding hi.
english: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her and didn’t disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she bound her soul shall stand.

paite: Himahleh apasal in azak ni a bangmah lou a bawl a, ahihmangleh athuchiam hiam, kichiam a akihenna a kam a thupawt peuhmah a-om nawn kei ding. Apasal in ahihmang khinta ahi. TOUPA'N amah angaidam ding.
english: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. Yahweh will forgive her.

paite: Thuchiam tengteng leh hinna hihgim dia hen akichiamna tengteng apasal in akipsak thei in ahihmang thei hi.
english: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

paite: Himahleh apasal in azak ni a pan adeihdan leh athuchiam tengteng leh atung ahenna om tengteng kipsak ahi a; azak ni a pan adaihsan ziak in akipsak ahi.
english: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows or all her pledges which are on her. He has established them, because he said nothing to her in the day that he heard them.

paite: Himahleh azak khit nung a bangmah lou a bawl a, ahihmanleh athulimlouhna moh apuak ding ahi," achi hi.
english: But if he makes them null and void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”

paite: Hiaite pasal leh azi kal leh apa inn a a-om gige lai a, akikal ua dan ding a TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiakte ahi uh.
english: These are the statutes which Yahweh commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Midiante tung ah Israel suante phu la in. Huai khit chiang in na chipihte kiang a pi na hita ding," achi hi.
english: “Avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”

paite: Mosi in mipite ahoupih a, "Midiante tung a TOUPA phulakna tangtun dia Midiante dou ding in na lak ua mi kigalthuam uhen.
english: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for war, that they may go against Midian, to execute Yahweh’s vengeance on Midian.

paite: Israel nam tengteng lak a nam chih a mi sangkhat zel kidouna a na kuan ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: You shall send one thousand out of every tribe, throughout all the tribes of Israel, to the war.”

paite: Huchi in Israelte sang tamtak lak a pan, nam chih a pan sangkhat chiat, kidouna a kuan ding in sepaih singkhat-le-sangnih apekhia uhi.
english: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand from every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

paite: Huchi in Mosi in chi chih lak a mi sangkhat chiat leh siampu Eleazar tapa Phinehas mun siangthou a tui-um belsuante, thupiakna dia pengkulte tawi in kidouna ah akuansak hi.
english: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in Midiante adou ua; pasal teng athat uhi.
english: They fought against Midian, as Yahweh commanded Moses. They killed every male.

paite: Amithahte lak ah Midiante kumpipate leng atel uh. Huai Midiante kumpipa ngate Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur leh Reba ahi a, Beor tapa Balaam leng namsau in athat uhi.
english: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.

paite: Israel suante'n Midiante numei teng leh atate uh sal in api ua; aganta tengteng uh, abelamhon tengteng uh leh avan tengteng uh gallak in ala uhi.
english: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.

paite: A-omna khuate leh agiahna tengteng uh ahal vek uhi.
english: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.

paite: Gallak tengteng, mihing leh gan tan in apaipih vek uhi.
english: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.

paite: Salte, matte leh gallakte, Mosi, siampu Eleazar leh Israel suan omkhawmte kiang, Jeriko zawn Jordan gei Moab Phaizang a agiahphual uh ahon tun uhi.
english: They brought the captives with the prey and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.

paite: Mosi, siampu Eleazar leh omkhawmte intek penpente'n giahphual pua ah ana dawn uhi.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest, with all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.

paite: Sepaih heutu, sangkhatte tung a heutute leh zakhatte tung a heutute, kidouna a pan hong tungte tung ah Mosi aheh hi.
english: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.

paite: Mosi in akiang uah, "Numei tengteng na hinghawi vek uh maw?
english: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?

paite: Ngai un, Balaam lemtheih a Peor tungtang thu ah Israelte TOUPA tung a taleksak mite hiaite ahi uh. TOUPA mi omkhawmte lak ah hipi ahong leng hi.
english: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Yahweh in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of Yahweh.

paite: Huaiziak in naupangte lak a pasal tengteng that unla, pasal kithuahpihsa numei teng leng that un.
english: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.

paite: Numei naupang pasal kithuahpih nai louh tengteng nou a ding in hinghawi un.
english: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

paite: Giahphual pua ah ni sagih sung giak unla; kuapeuh mi that leh thah a om misi khoih peuhmah ani thum ni leh ani sagih ni in kisiangsak un; noumau leh na salte uh leng.
english: “Encamp outside of the camp for seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.

paite: Van himhim leh savun a thilbawl tengteng, kel mul a thilbawl tengteng, sing a thilbawl tengteng thu ah na kisiangsak ding uh," achi hi.
english: You shall purify every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.”

paite: Siampu Eleazar in kidouna a hoh kidou mite kiang ah, "Hiai TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak, dan thuseh ahi.
english: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded Moses.

paite: Bangpeuh dangka-eng, dangkasik, dal, sik, langva leh ngen,
english: However the gold, and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

paite: mei a hal a se thei lou teng mei ah na tholh paisuak ding ua, huchi in ahong siangthou ding uh. Bangpeuh, silsianna tui a hihsiangthou ding ahi. Mei a hal thuak thei lou peuhmah tui a na tholh paisuak ding uh ahi.
english: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.

paite: Ani sagih ni in na puan uh na sawp ding ua, na hong siang ding uh. Huai khit in giahphual ah na hong lut ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Nang, siampu Eleazar leh omkhawmte inkuan lupente'n gallak a, alak uh mihing leh gante sim vek un.
english: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;

paite: Gallak mun nih ah khen un; kidouna a kuan kidou mite a ding leh omkhawmte a ding in.
english: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.

paite: Kidouna a kuan galdoumi a pan TOUPA a dia siah piak ding in mihing zanga zel ah khat, mihing a pan, bawng a pan, sabiltung a pan leh belamhon a pan sepkhia un.
english: Levy a tribute to Yahweh of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.

paite: Huaite a tan kimkhat ua pan la unla, TOUPA a dia vei thillat ding in siampu Eleazar pia un.
english: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for Yahweh’s wave offering.

paite: Israel suante tan sawmnga a pan khat, mihing a pan, bawng a pan, sabiltung a pan, belamhon a pan leh ganhon a pan sepkhia inla, huaite TOUPA biakbuk kemmi Levite pia in," achi hi.
english: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in ahih uhi.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Sepaihte'n amat uh gallak sim louh alak uh belam nuaiguk singsagih-le-sangnga,
english: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,

paite: Bawng singsagih-le-sangnga,
english: seventy-two thousand head of cattle,

paite: sabiltung singguk-le-sangkhat,
english: sixty-one thousand donkeys,

paite: pasal kithuahpih nai louh numei singthum-le-sangnih ahi uh.
english: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.

paite: Akimkhat, kidouna a kuante tantuan, belam nuaithum singthum sangsagih-le-zanga ahi,
english: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep;

paite: TOUPA siah belam zaguk sawmsagih-le-nga ahi.
english: and Yahweh’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.

paite: Bawng singthum-le-sangguk ahi a; huai a TOURA siah sawmguk-le-khat ahi.
english: The cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which Yahweh’s tribute was seventy-two.

paite: Sabiltung singthum-le-zanga ahi; huai a TOUPA siah sawmguk-le-khat ahi.
english: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which Yahweh’s tribute was sixty-one.

paite: Mihing singkhat-le-sangguk ahi ua; huai a TOUPA siah mi sawmthum-le-nih ahi.
english: The persons were sixteen thousand, of whom Yahweh’s tribute was thirty-two persons.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in siah, TOUPA vei thillat Mosi in siampu Eleazar apia hi.
english: Moses gave the tribute, which was Yahweh’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Mosi in galdou mite a pan ahawm Israel mite tantuan kimkhat galdou a kuante lak ah ahawm hi.
english: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought

paite: Omkhawmte' tantuan kimkhat belam nuaithum singthum sangsagih-le-zanga,
english: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,

paite: Bawng singthum-le-sangguk,
english: thirty-six thousand head of cattle,

paite: Sabiltung singthum-le-zanga,
english: thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,

paite: Mihing singkhat-le-sangguk ahi.
english: and sixteen thousand persons),

paite: Israel tantuan kimkhat a pan Mosi in mihing leh gan sawmnga zel ah khat ala a, TOUPA thupiak bang in TOUPA biakbuk kemmi Levite apia hi.
english: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of Yahweh’s tabernacle, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Sepaihte tung a heutu, sang-khatte tung a heutute, zakhatte tung a heutute'n Mosi ava naih uhi.
english: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.

paite: Mosi kiang ah, "Na sikhate'n ka khut ua om kidou mite ka sim ua, kuamah kim lou ka om kei uhi.
english: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.

paite: Ka hinna ua dia TOUPA ma a kilemna bawlna dia TOUPA a dia thillat mi'n aneih lam uh, dangka-eng a bawl zephoih van, khengawng a bulhte, khutngawng a bulhte, minsawnna zungbuhte, bilbahte, khite ka hon tawi uh," achi uhi.
english: We have brought Yahweh’s offering, what every man found: gold ornaments, armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before Yahweh.”

paite: Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in dangka-eng a bawl van tengteng ana sang uhi.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.

paite: Sangte tung a heutute leh zate tung a heutute'n dangka-eng TOUPA kiang a vei thillat dia alat tengteng uh shekel singkhat sangguk zasagih-le-sawmnga ahi.
english: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to Yahweh, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.

paite: Galdou mite'n agallak uh amau a chiat ding in ala ngal ua.
english: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.

paite: Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in sangkhatte tung a heutu leh zakhatte tung a heutute dangka-eng ala ua, Israel suante theihgigena ding in kihoupihna biakbuk ah TOUPA ma ah ahon tawi uhi.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting for a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh.

paite: Reuben leh Gad tate'n ganta ahau mahmah ua; Jazer gam leh Gilead gam amuh un, amun ganta a dia hoihtak hi in athei uhi.
english: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. They saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead. Behold, the place was a place for livestock.

paite: Huchi in Gad tate leh Reuben tate'n Mosi, siampu Eleazar leh omkhawm mipite ava houpih ua,
english: Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,

paite: "Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Shebam, Nebo leh Beon,
english: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,

paite: Israel omkhawmte ma a TOUPA'N azoh gam, gante a ding in ahoih a, na sikhate'n ganhonte ka nei uhi.
english: the land which Yahweh struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”

paite: Na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tan uleh, na sikhate kiang ah ka luah ding un hiai gam hon pia inla, Jordan lui hon pi galkai dah mai ve," achi uhi.
english: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”

paite: Mosi in Gad tate leh Reuben tate kiang ah, "Na unaute uh kidouna ah akuan ding ua, nou bel hiai ah na om maimah ding uh maw?
english: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?

paite: Bangziak a TOUPA'N apiak gam a lut lou dia Israel suante lungtang lunglelsak na hi ua?
english: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which Yahweh has given them?

paite: Kadesh-barnea a pan gam va enkhe dia ka sawl in na pate un hichi mah bang in ahih uhi.
english: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.

paite: Eshkol Phaizang atuntouh un gam ava mu ua, TOUPA'N gam apiak a alut noplouhna ding un Israel suante lungtang alunglelsak uhi.
english: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which Yahweh had given them.

paite: Huai ni in TOUPA aheh mahmah a, akichiam a,
english: Yahweh’s anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying,

paite: Aigupta gam a pan hong pawt, kum sawmnih chiang tunglam mi himhim in Abraham, Isak leh Jakob, kiang a kichiam a, ka piak gam kuamah in amu kei ding uh; ahon zuih taktak louh ziak un.
english: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me,

paite: 'Keniz mi Jephunneh tapa Kaleb leh Nun tapa Joshua kia lou ngal, amau bel TOUPA azuih taktak ziak un,' achi hi.
english: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have followed Yahweh completely.’

paite: Israelte tung ah TOUPA aheh mahmah a, TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou hihmi suan tengteng amanthat vek masiah uh gamdai ah kum sawmli avakvaisak hi.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation who had done evil in Yahweh’s sight was consumed.

paite: Ngai un, Israelte tung a TOUPA hehna lauhuaitak behlap in nou gilou in na pute uh sik in na dinghta uhi,
english: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of Yahweh toward Israel.

paite: TOUPA zui lou a, na om himhim uleh ama'n amaute gamdai ah a-omsak nawn ding hi. Hiai mi tengteng na hihmang mai kei ding uh maw?" achi hi.
english: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.”

paite: Ava naih ua, akiang ah, "Hiai ah ka gante uh a ding in belam huangte leh ka tate uh a ding in khua ka sat ding uh.
english: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;

paite: Kou bel amun ding uh ka tut masiah uh Israel suante ma a pai ding in ka kigalthuam ding uhi. Hiai gam a mite ziak in ka tate uh kulh nei khuate ah ateng ding uh.
english: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

paite: Israel suante michih in amun luah ding aluah chiat ma un ka inn uah ka paikik kei ding uh.
english: We will not return to our houses until the children of Israel have all received their inheritance.

paite: Ka luah ding uh bel hiai lam gal Jordan suahlam ahih ziak in Jordan gal khat lam leh akhen lam zaw ka luahpih kei ding uh," achi uhi.
english: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”

paite: Mosi in akiang uah, "Huchibang na chih ua, galdou dia TOUPA ma a kuan dia na kigalvat ua,
english: Moses said to them: “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before Yahweh to the war,

paite: TOUPA ma a gam zoh ahih masiah na lak ua kigalthuam tengteng TOUPA ma a Jordan na galkah vek ua, ama a melmate adelhkhiak mateng leh
english: and every one of your armed men will pass over the Jordan before Yahweh until he has driven out his enemies from before him,

paite: TOUPA ma a gam lak a om a, huai khit chiang a na kik nawn ding uleh TOUPA leh Israelte ma ah na mohpuakna ua pan na siangta ding ua, TOUPA ma ah hiai gam na luah ding uhi.
english: and the land is subdued before Yahweh; then afterward you shall return, and be clear of obligation to Yahweh and to Israel. Then this land shall be your possession before Yahweh.

paite: Himahleh huchibang a na hih kei uleh, ngai un, TOUPA tung ah na khial uh ahi dia, na khelhna un hon mukhe ngeingei ding chih thei un.
english: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against Yahweh; and be sure your sin will find you out.

paite: Na tate uh a ding in khuate sat unla, na belamte uh a ding in leng huangte bawl unla, na gen bangbang un hih un,” achi hi.
english: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”

paite: Gad tate leh Reuben tate'n Mosi kiang ah, "Na sikhate'n ka toupa uh thupiak bang in ka hih ding uh.
english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.

paite: Ka zi, ka tate uh, ka belamhonte uh leh ka ganhon tengteng uh Gilead gam khuate ah ana om ding uh.
english: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead;

paite: Himahleh na sikha, kidou dia kigalthuam tengteng in ka toupa uh gen bang in TOUPA ma ah ka va galkah ding uh," chi in agen uhi.
english: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before Yahweh to battle, as my lord says.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in, atungtang thu uah siampu Eleazar, Nun tapa Joshua leh Israel nam inkuan lupente thu apia hi.
english: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.

paite: Mosi in akiang uah, "Gad tate, Reuben tate leh galdou dia kigalthuam tengteng in TOUPA ma a Jordan lui ahong galkahpih ua, huai gam na zoh uleh Gilead gam pen aluah ding ua na piak ding uh ahi.
english: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle before Yahweh, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;

paite: Himahleh kigalthuam a ahong galkahpih kei uleh Kanaan gam ah na lak uah atel mai ding uh," achi hi.
english: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”

paite: Gad tate leh Reuben tate'n, "Asikha kiang a TOUPA'N agen bang in ka hih ding uh.
english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As Yahweh has said to your servants, so will we do.

paite: Kigalvan a TOUPA ma a galkah in Kanaan gam ah ka lut ding ua, ka gam luah ding uh Jordan lui khen lam ah ahi lai ding," chỉ in adawng uhi.
english: We will pass over armed before Yahweh into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”

paite: Mosi in Gad tate, Reuben tate leh Joseph tapa Manasseh suan nam kimkhatte Amor kumpipa Sihon gam, Bashan Kumpipa Og gam, huai gamte a khua tengteng toh, akim gam a khuate nangawn toh apia hi.
english: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.

paite: Gad tate'n Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer;
english: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,

paite: Atroth leh Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah;
english: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,

paite: Beth-nimrah leh Beth- haran alam ua, khopi kulh neite, belam huangte toh.
english: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities and folds for sheep.

paite: Reuben tate'n Heshbon, Elealeh, Kirjathaim,
english: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,

paite: Nebo leh Baal-meon, aminte khek khit ahi, huan Sibmah alam ua; akhosatte uh min dang aphuak zel uhi.
english: Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah. They gave other names to the cities which they built.

paite: Manasseh tapa Makir tapate Gilead gam ah ahoh ua, ala ua, huai a teng Amorte ahawlkhia uhi.
english: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.

paite: Mosi in Gilead gam Manasseh tapa Makir apia a; huai ah ateng hi.
english: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.

paite: Manasseh tapa Jair in akhotate ava la a, Havothjair asa hi.
english: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.

paite: Nobah in Kenath ava la a, akhotate toh, ama min tam in Nobah asa hi.
english: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

paite: Mosi leh Aaron makaih a Aigupta gam a pan apawlpawl a pawt a, apai zeldan uh hiải bang ahi.
english: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

paite: TOUPA thupiak in apaikhia ua, apai zelnate uh Mosi in agelh a; apaikhiak ua apainate uh hiaite ahi.
english: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of Yahweh. These are their journeys according to their starting points.

paite: Akha khatna, ani sawm-le-nga ni in Rameses a pan apawt ua; Paikan Ankuanglui ni zing in Aigupta mi teng muh in hangsantak in Israel suante apawtkhia uhi.
english: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,

paite: Aigupta mite'n ata masapen teng uh TOUPA'N athahsakte avui ua, apathiante uh leng TOUPA'N athukhen khumta hi.
english: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom Yahweh had struck among them. Yahweh also executed judgments on their gods.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante Rameses a pan apawt ua, Sukot ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.

paite: Sukot a pan apawt ua, gamdai phak tung Etham ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

paite: Etham a pan apawt ua, Baal-zephon bul a Pi-hahiroth lam ah akinung khin ua, Migdol chin ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon, and they encamped before Migdol.

paite: Pi-hahiroth chin a pan apawt ua, tuipi apaltan ua, gamdai ah alut uhi. Etham gamdai ah ni thum lam apai ua, Marah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.

paite: Marah a pan apawt ua, Elim atung uh. Elim ah tui nak nei sawm-le-nih leh tum sing sawmsagih a-om a; huai ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there.

paite: Elim a pan apawt ua, Tupi San ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.

paite: Tuipi San a pan apawt ua, Sin gamdai ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

paite: Sin gamdai a pan apawt ua, Dophkah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

paite: Dophkah a pan apawt ua, Alush ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

paite: Alush a pan apawt ua, Rephidim ah giahphual asat ua, huai ah mipite dawn ding tui a-om kei hi.
english: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

paite: Rephidim a pan apawt ua, Sinai gamdai ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.

paite: Sinai gamdai a pan apawt ua, Kibroth- hattaavah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.

paite: Kibroth-hattaavah a pan apawt ua, Hazeroth ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.

paite: Hazeroth a pan apawt ua, Rithmah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.

paite: Rithmah a pan apawt ua, Rimmon-parez ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.

paite: Rimmon-parez a pan apawt ua, Libnah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.

paite: Libnah a pan apawt ua, Rissah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.

paite: Rissah a pan apawt ua, Kehelathah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.

paite: Kehelathah a pan apawt ua, Shepher tang ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.

paite: Shepher tang a pan apawt ua, Haradah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.

paite: Haradah a pan apawt ua, Makheloth ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.

paite: Makheloth a pan apawt ua, Tahath ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.

paite: Tahath a pan apawt ua, Terah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.

paite: Terah a pan apawt ua, Mithkah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.

paite: Mithkah a pan apawt ua, Hashmonah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.

paite: Hashmonah a pan apawt ua, Moseroth ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.

paite: Moseroth a pan in apawt ua, Bene-jaakan ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.

paite: Bene-jaakan a pan apawt ua, Hor-hagidgad ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.

paite: Hor-hagidgad a pan apawt ua, Jotbathah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.

paite: Jotbathah a pan apawt ua, Abronah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.

paite: Abronah a pan apawt ua, Ezion-geber ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.

paite: Ezion-geber a pan apawt ua, Zin gamdai ah giahphual asat uh huai tuh Kadesh leng achi uhi.
english: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

paite: Kadesh a pan apawt ua, Edom gam chin a Hor tang ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

paite: TOUPA thupiak in Hor tang ah Siampu Aaron ahohtou a, Israel suante Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawt uh akum sawmlina, akha ngana, ani khat ni in huai ah asita hi.
english: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of Yahweh and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.

paite: Aaron Hor tang a asih in kum zakhat sawmnih-le-thum ahi.
english: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.

paite: Kanaan mi, Kanaan gam simlam a om Arad kumpipa'n Israel suante ahong pai uh ana za hi.
english: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

paite: Hor tang a pan apawt ua, Zalmonah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.

paite: Zalmonah a pan apawt ua, Punon ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.

paite: Punon a pan apawt ua, Oboth ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.

paite: Oboth a pan apawt ua, Moab gam naih Ije-abarim ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.

paite: Ije-abarim a pan apawt ua, Dibon-gad ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.

paite: Dibon-gad a pan apawt ua, Almon-diblathaim ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.

paite: Almon-diblathaim a pan apawt ua, Nebo chin a Abarim tang ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

paite: Abarim tang a pan apawt ua, Jeriko zawn, Jordan gei Moab Phaizang ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

paite: Jordan gei Beth-jeshimoth a pan Abel-shittim pha in Moab Phaizang ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.

paite: Jeriko zawn Jordan gei Moab Phaizang ah TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

paite: "Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah Jordan lui na kan ua, Kanaan gam na lut chiang un,
english: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

paite: huai gam a om tengteng na delhkhe vek ding ua, asuang milim tengteng uh na hihse vek ding ua, amilim sunte uh na hihse vek ding ua, amun sangte uh na hihchim vek ding uh ahi.
english: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.

paite: Gam na luah ding ua, huai ah na teng ding uh. Na luah ding ua gam ka hon piaksa na hi uh.
english: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.

paite: Achi dungzui bang zel in aisan in gam na luah ding ua, a-inbul deuhte gam za deuh na pe ding ua, a-inbul lou deuhte gam neu deuh na pe ding uh. Aisan apukna peuh michih a tuam ahi dia; na pi-le-pute uh chi paidan bang zel in na luah ding uhi.
english: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the larger groups you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.

paite: Himahleh huai gam a omte na delhkhiak kei uleh na omsakte uh na mit ua ding in sutna zum leh na sa ua ding in ling bang ahi ding ua, na omna gam uah buaina ahon tun ding uhi.
english: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be like pricks in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will harass you in the land in which you dwell.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, atung ua hih ka tup bang na tung uah ka hih ding, chi in," achi hi.
english: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so I will do to you.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante thu pia inla, akiang uah, Kanaan gam na tun chiang un, Kanaan gam, agamgi dan dungzui zel a na luah ding gam uh,
english: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),

paite: simlam na luah ding chiang uh Zin gamdai a pan Edom gam zulzul ahi dia, simlam gamgi Chi Tuipi tawp a pan suahlam pang ahi ding.
english: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.

paite: Na gamgi uh Akrabbim tungkahna simlam pang ah akawi dia, ahong pawtna Kadesh-barnea simlam ah ahi dia, Hazaraddar ah apai dia, Azmon ah apai zel ding.
english: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.

paite: Gamgi Azmon a pan Aigupta lui tan in akawi dia, atawpna Tuipi ah ahi ding.
english: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.

paite: "Tumlam pang ah Tuipi Lian agamgi ding in na tang ding ua, hiai tumlam a na gamgi uh ahi ding.
english: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.

paite: "Hiai mallam a na gamgi uh ahi ding. Tuipi Lian a pan Hor tang huap in na bawl ding uh.
english: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.

paite: Hor tang a pan Hamath lutna tan in na bawl dia, gamgi tunna bel Zedad ah ahi ding hi.
english: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.

paite: Gamgi Jiphron ah apai zel dia, atunna Hazar-enan ah ahi ding. Hiai mallam a na gamgi uh ahi ding hi.
english: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.

paite: "Suahlam a na gamgi uh Hazar-enan a pan Shepham tan in na bawl ding uhi.
english: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.

paite: Gamgi Shepham a pan Riblah tan in Ain suahlam pang ah asukpai dia; huchi in gamgi apai suksuk dia, Kinereth tuipi suahlam pang asun ding hi.
english: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.

paite: Gamgi Jordan ah apaisuk dia, atunna Chi Tuipi ah ahi dia hiai akimvel a gamgi paidan bang in na gam uh ahi ding, chi in," achi hi.
english: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”

paite: Mosi in Israel suante thu apia a, "Hiai TOUPA'N nam kua-le-akimte piak dia thu apiak aisan a na luah ding gam uh ahi.
english: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which Yahweh has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;

paite: Reuben tate nam in a-inkuan uh dungzui zel leh Gad tate nam in a-inkuan uh dungzui zel leh Manasseh nam kimkhat in leng agam luah ding uh atangta ngal ua.
english: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.

paite: Nam nih leh nam kimkhatte'n agam luah ding uh nisuahna lam Jeriko zawn Jordan gal suahlam ah atangta uh," achi hi.
english: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Luah dia gam hon khennenpihte min hiaite ahi. Siampu Eleazar leh Nun tapa Joshua.
english: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

paite: Gam luah dia khennen ding in nam chih a pan a-intekpen khat chiat na tel ding ahi," achi hi.
english: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.

paite: Huai mite min bel hiaite ahi. Judah nam a mi Jephunneh tapa Kaleb.
english: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

paite: Simeon tate nam a mi Ammihud tapa Semuel.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

paite: Benjamin nam a mi Kislon tapa Elidad.
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

paite: Dan tate nam lak a intekpen Jogli tapa Bukki.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.

paite: Joseph tate lak a mi, Manasseh tate nam intekpen Ephod tapa Hanniel.
english: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

paite: Ephraim tate nam lak a intekpen Sitan tapa Kemuel.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

paite: Zebulun tate nam lak a intekpen Parnak tapa Elizaphan.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

paite: Issakar tate nam lak a intekpen Azan tapa Paltiel.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

paite: Asher tate nam lak a intekpen Selo mi tapa Ahihud.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

paite: Naphtali tate nam lak a intekpen Ammihud tapa Padahel.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”

paite: Hiaite Kanaan gam a Israel suante gam luah ding hawm dia TOUPA'N thu apiakte ahi uhi.
english: These are they whom Yahweh commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

paite: Huan Jeriko zawn Jordan gei, Moab Phaizang ah TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

paite: "Israel suante thu pia inla, agam uah Levite tenna ding khuate bawlsak uhen. Agante uh tatna ding in kho dainawl kim Levite na piak ding uh ahi.
english: “Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites cities to dwell in out of their inheritance. You shall give pasture lands for the cities around them to the Levites.

paite: Khuate atenna ding uh ahi dia, akimte bel bawng leh agante leh aganvulh tengteng a ding ahi.
english: They shall have the cities to dwell in. Their pasture lands shall be for their livestock, and for their possessions, and for all their animals.

paite: Levite na piak ding dainawl khokulh a pan tong sangkhat a sau ahih ding ahi.
english: “The pasture lands of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it.

paite: Kulh polam a pan na teh dia, suahlam pang ah tong sangnih, mallam pang ah tong sangnih, khopi bel alaitak ah a-om ding ahi. Hiai amau dainawl tuam ahi ding.
english: You shall measure outside of the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the middle. This shall be the pasture lands of their cities.

paite: Levite na piak ding khuate lak ah tualthatte taina ding kihumbitna khopi guk ahi dia; huaite lou khua sawmli-le-nih na piak lai ding uh ahi.
english: “The cities which you shall give to the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall give for the man slayer to flee to. Besides them you shall give forty-two cities.

paite: Levite na piak ding khua tengteng khua sawmli-le-giat ahi ding. Dainawl toh na piak ding uh ahi.
english: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their pasture lands.

paite: Israel suante luah khua na piakdan ding, mi tamte na pe tam dia, atawmte na pe tawm ding ahi. Michih in aluah uh gam tamdan dungzui a khua Levite na piak ding uh ahi,” achi hi.
english: Concerning the cities which you shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many you shall take many, and from the few you shall take few. Everyone according to his inheritance which he inherits shall give some of his cities to the Levites.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

paite: Jordan lui na galkah ua Kanaan gam na lut chiang un kihumbitna khua na sep ding uh ahi, tup mawng hilou a tual thatkhami taina ding in.
english: then you shall appoint for yourselves cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the man slayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

paite: Huai khuate, phulami a pan na kihumbitna khua uh, omkhawmte ma a vai hawmsak dia adin ma a tualthatmi asihlouhna ding ahi.
english: The cities shall be for your refuge from the avenger, that the man slayer not die until he stands before the congregation for judgment.

paite: Nou a dia kihumbitna ding na sehte uh khopi guk ahi ding.
english: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.

paite: Jordan gal ah khopi thum na sep dingua, Kanaan gam ah khopi thum na sep ding ua, kihumbitna khopite ahi ding uh.
english: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan. They shall be cities of refuge.

paite: Israel suante leh namdang leh akiang ua tengte a ding in hiai khopi gukte kihumbitna ahi dia, huai ah kuapeuh mi that kha atailut ding ahi.
english: These six cities shall be refuge for the children of Israel, for the stranger, and for the foreigner living among them, that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

paite: "Himahleh mi kuahiam in sik a mi asat a, asihleh tualthat ahi a, tualthat bel hihlup ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “‘But if he struck him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

paite: Si khop a suang a mi aden a, asihleh tualthat ahi a, tualthat bel hihlup ngeingei ding ahi.
english: If he struck him with a stone in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

paite: Ahihkeileh mi khat in mi khat sing zang in sat henla, si taleh tualthat ahi a, tualthat bel hihlup ngeingei ding ahi.
english: Or if he struck him with a weapon of wood in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

paite: Sisan phulami'n tualthatmi athat dia, amuh peuh chiang in athat ding ahi.
english: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death. When he meets him, he shall put him to death.

paite: "Mi khatpeuh in huatna toh tupkholhna nei in midang khat sawn henla, ahihkeileh tup mawng in banghiam in deng henla, huai mi si taleh;
english: If he shoved him out of hatred, or hurled something at him while lying in wait, so that he died,

paite: ahihkeileh kimelmakna nei in akhuttum in tum henla, huai mi si taleh ahihlumpa hihlup ngeingei ding ahi. Amah tualthat ahi a, sisan phulami in athah ding ahi.
english: or in hostility struck him with his hand, so that he died, he who struck him shall surely be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when he meets him.

paite: "Himahleh kimelmakna nei hilou a, kuahiam khat in midang asawn khak ahihkeileh tup mawng hilou a amah aden khak a,
english: “‘But if he shoved him suddenly without hostility, or hurled on him anything without lying in wait,

paite: ahihkeileh amah mu lou a, amah that thei suang atung a akhiak a, amah asihleh amelma leng hilou a, hihnat tum leng hilou ahih ziak in.
english: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him so that he died, and he was not his enemy and not seeking his harm,

paite: Omkhawmte'n hiai vaihawmna dan bang in ahihlum mi leh sisan phulami vai ahawmsak ding uh ahi:
english: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.

paite: Omkhawmte'n tualthatmi sisan phulami a pan ahumbit ding ua, omkhawmte'n ataina, akihumbitna khua ah atengsak ding ua, sathau siangthou nilh a om siampu lianpen asih mateng huai lai khua ah ateng ding hi.
english: The congregation shall deliver the man slayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, where he had fled. He shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

paite: Himahleh chik lai peuh in tualthatmi ataina, a kihumbitna kho gamgi polam apai a;
english: “‘But if the man slayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge where he flees,

paite: sisan phulami in akihumbitna kho polam a amuh a, sisan phulami in athahleh asisan ah moh apo kei ding.
english: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the man slayer, he shall not be guilty of blood,

paite: Siampu lian asih mateng akihumbitna khua ah ateng gige ding a, himahleh siampu asih in bel tualthatmi atenna gam ah apaikik ding ahi.
english: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest, the man slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

paite: Hiai thilte na suante uh tan a na tenna peuh ua na vaihawmna dan thuseh ding uh ahi.
english: “‘These things shall be for a statute and ordinance to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

paite: "Kuapeuh in mi athahleh tualthatmi pen theihpihte kam a pan thupawt a hihlup ding ahi. Himahleh theihpih khat kia mi hihlupna ding in ahun kei.
english: “‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain based on the testimony of witnesses; but one witness shall not testify alone against any person so that he dies.

paite: Tualthatmi na tan ding uh ahi kei. Sihna khop a moh ahi a, hihlup ngeingei ding ahi zaw.
english: “‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death. He shall surely be put to death.

paite: Siampu sih ma in, kihumbitna khua a tailut kuapeuh agam a sawlkik nawn dia tatna sum na lak ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall take no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land before the death of the priest.

paite: Huchi in na tenna gam uh na hihthanghuai kei ding ua, sisan in gam ahihthanghuaileh sisan suahna gam hihthanghuai silna ding in asuahmi sisan kia lou lah zattheih ahi ngal kei a.
english: “‘So you shall not pollute the land where you live; for blood pollutes the land. No atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed in it, but by the blood of him who shed it.

paite: Na tenna gam uh, ka omna na hihthanghuai ding uh ahi kei. Kei TOUPA lah Israel suante lak ah ka om ngal a, chi in," achi hi.
english: You shall not defile the land which you inhabit, where I dwell; for I, Yahweh, dwell among the children of Israel.’”

paite: Huan Joseph inkuanpihte lak a mi, Manasseh tapa Makir tapa Gilead tate inkuan lupente lak a mite'n ahon naih ua, Mosi leh heutu, Israel suante intekpente ma ah thu agen uhi.
english: The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.

paite: "TOUPA'N ka toupa Israel suante aisan a, aluah ding uh gam pe ding in thu apia hi. TOUPA'N ka toupa, ka unaupa uh Jelophehad gam a tanute pe ding in nang thu ahon pia hi.
english: They said, “Yahweh commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel. My lord was commanded by Yahweh to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

paite: Amau Israel suante lak a mi, namdang kuapeuh tate ava kitenpih uleh, ka pi-le-pute uh gam aluah uh laksak a, akitenpih uh namte gam toh gawm ding ahi dia; huchibang in ka gam tantuan ua kipan lakkhiak ahi ding hi.
english: If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So it will be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.

paite: Israel suante Jubili ahong tun chiang in agam uh ava kitenpih uh namte gam toh gawm ding ahi dia; huchi in ka pi-le-pute uh gam a pan amau gam lak hek ahong hi ding hi," achi uh.
english: When the jubilee of the children of Israel comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”

paite: Mosi in, TOUPA thu bang in Israel suante thu apia a, "Joseph tate nam in agen dik uhi.
english: Moses commanded the children of Israel according to Yahweh’s word, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speak what is right.

paite: Jelophehad tanute tungtang thu a TOUPA'N thu apiak pen hiai ahi. 'Hoih asaksak uh kitenpih uhenla, himahleh apate uh nampih lak a mi ngei akitenpih ding uh ahi.
english: This is the thing which Yahweh commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them be married to whom they think best, only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante gam pen namdang kiang a suan ahi kei ding. Israel suante'n api-le-pute uh nam gam aneih gige ding uh ahi.
english: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

paite: Israel suante lak a gouluah ding tanu peuhmah Israel suante'n api-le-pute uh gam aluah chiat zel theihna ding un apa nampih lak a mi zi ahih ngeingei ding ahi.
english: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may each possess the inheritance of his fathers.

paite: Huchi in gam bel namdang kiang a suan ahi kei ding hi. Israel suante'n amau gam chiat atang gige ding uh ahi ngal a, " achi hi.
english: So shall no inheritance move from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall each keep his own inheritance.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in Jelophehad tanute'n ahih uhi.
english: The daughters of Zelophehad did as Yahweh commanded Moses:

paite: Jelophehad tanu Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milkah leh Noahte'n apa uh unau tapate akitenpih uhi.
english: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father’s brothers’ sons.

paite: Joseph tapa Manasseh tapate akitenpih ua, agam uh apa uh nam ah a-om gige hi.
english: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

paite: Hiaite TOUPA'N Mosi zang a Jeriko zawn Jordan gal a Moab Phaizang a Israel suante apiak, thupiakte leh vaihawmdante ahi uhi.
english: These are the commandments and the ordinances which Yahweh commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: "Levi tapate lak a Kohath tapate, akhang-akhang un, a-inkuankuan un, sim vek in.
english: “Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

paite: kum sawmthum a pan atunglam, kum sawmnga tan in nasepna, kihoupihna biakbuk a sem ding teng.
english: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin mun siangthoupen a Kohath tapate nasep ding hiaite ahi.
english: “This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, regarding the most holy things.

paite: "Giahphual a suan ding teng un Aaron, atapate toh alut ding ua, dantan puanzak ahawkkhe ding ua, huai in thukhun bawm akhuh ding uh.
english: When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in with his sons; and they shall take down the veil of the screen, cover the ark of the Testimony with it,

paite: Huai pen ngalvang vun in akhuh ding ua, puandum buang in leng akhuh ding ua, azawnna chiang athuah ding uhi.
english: put a covering of sealskin on it, spread a blue cloth over it, and put in its poles.

paite: "Etsakna tanghou dohkan tung ah puandum buang aphah ding ua, huai ah kuangte, keute, belhbute leh noute butkhiakna ding akoih ding uhi. Tatlak lou in tanghou koih huai ah a-om ding ahi.
english: “On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the cups with which to pour out; and the continual bread shall be on it.

paite: Huai pen puansan in akhuh ding ua; akhuhna ngalvang vun in akhuh ding uh, azawnna chiang athuah ding uhi.
english: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

paite: "Vaksak khawnvak koihna leh huai a dia azat ding ua khawnvakte, ataitehte, avu koihnate, thau bing tengteng puandum buang in akhuh ding uhi.
english: “They shall take a blue cloth and cover the lamp stand of the light, its lamps, its snuffers, its snuff dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it.

paite: Huai leh avanzat tengteng akhuhna ngalvang vun a khuh in azawnna ah akoih ding uhi.
english: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.

paite: "Dangka-eng maitam puandum buang in akhuh ding ua, akhuhna ngalvang vun in akhuh nawn ding uh, azawnna chiang athuah ding uhi.
english: “On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

paite: Mun siangthou a vanzat leh tui- um belsuan tengteng ala vek ding ua, puandum buang in atun ding ua, akhuhna ngalvang vun in akhuh ding uh, azawnna ah akoih ding uhi.
english: “They shall take all the vessels of ministry with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.

paite: Maitam a meivu alamang ding ua, atung ah puan sandup aphah ding uhi.
english: “They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it.

paite: Atung ah anasep vialvialna uh tui-um belsuan tengteng, mei laknate, sa thukna sikkhutte vutluahnate, tuikuangte leh maitam tui-um belsuan tengteng akoih ding uhi. Akhuhna ngalvang vun in akhuh ding ua, azawnna abulh ding uh.
english: They shall put on it all its vessels with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the meat hooks, the shovels, and the basins—all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.

paite: Aaron leh atapate'n mun siangthou leh mun siangthou van tengteng om mun suan dia akhuh khit chiang un; huai khit chiang in azawng ding in Kohath tapate ahong pai ding uhi. Himahleh thil siangthou himhim akhoih ding uh ahi kei, huchi lou in zaw asi kha ding uh. Hiaite kihoupihna biakbuk a Kohath tapate nasep ding ahi.
english: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it; but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. The sons of Kohath shall carry these things belonging to the Tent of Meeting.

paite: "Siampu Aaron tapa Eleazar sep ding, det ding thau, gimnamtui, niteng a tangbuang thillat, nilhchi thau, biakbuk, huai a thil om tengteng, mun siangthou leh avante ngaihtuah ahi,” achi hi.
english: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: "Kohath suan inkuan zaw Levite lak a pan satkhe kei un.
english: “Don’t cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;

paite: Himahleh thil siangthoute khoih lou a, si lou a a-omtheihna ding uh hichibang ahi. Aaron leh atapate lut uhenla, asep ding uh leh atantuam ding chiat uh sehsak uhen.
english: but do this to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in and appoint everyone to his service and to his burden;

paite: Himahleh akikhuh lai teng thil siangthoute en ding in lut kei uhen, alut uleh asi ding uh," achi hi.
english: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Gershon tapate leng a-inkuankuan un, akhang-akhang un sim vek in.
english: “Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ houses, by their families;

paite: Kum sawmthum a pan atunglam kum sawmnga a upa tan in nasepna kihoupihna biakbuk a sem thei ding teng zah sim vek in.
english: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old: all who enter in to wait on the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Gershon suante tantuam nasep lam leh puak lam hiai ahi.
english: “This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:

paite: Biakbuk puanzakte, kihoupihna biakbuk, akhuhnate, atung khuhna ngalvang vun, kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak puanzak;
english: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the Tent of Meeting, its covering, the covering of sealskin that is on it, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

paite: intual puanzakte, intual kongkhak puanzakte, abiakbuk leh maitam bul a, akhaute leh avanzat tengteng uh toh apo ding ua, sep dia kiphamoh Reuhmah asem ding uhi.
english: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the gate of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatever shall be done with them. They shall serve in there.

paite: Gershon suante nasep, asep lam leh puak lam ah atantuan tengteng uh Aaron leh atapate'n asep ding ua; ahih ding uh banghiam nengneng tan a sehsak in huaite asem ding uhi.
english: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.

paite: Huaite kihoupihna biakbuk a Gershon suante nasep ahi. Ahih ding uh siampu Aaron tapa Ithamar seh ding ahi.
english: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting. Their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

paite: "Merari tapate, akhang-akhang un, a-inkuankuan un na sim ding ahi.
english: “As for the sons of Merari, you shall count them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;

paite: Kum sawmthum a pan atunglam kum sawmnga a upa tan in kihoupihna biakbuk a sem ding zah na sim vek ding ahi.
english: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who enters on the service, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin a anasep uh, atantuam ding uh hiaite ahi. Biakbuk khuam lepkhawmte, abaangkalte, akhuamte, akingakna khuakkuakte;
english: This is the duty of their burden, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

paite: a-intual umna khuamte, akingakna khuakkuakte, akilhbelhnate, akhaute, avanzat tengteng leh avanzat dang tengteng puakte, amin uh lou chiat in atantuam ding uh na sehsak ding ahi.
english: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service. You shall appoint the instruments of the duty of their burden to them by name.

paite: Huaite siampu Aaron tapa Ithamar heu a kihoupihna biakbuk a Merari tapate suante'n ahih ding uh banghiam nengneng tan a anasepdan ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi leh Aaron leh omkhawmte lak a lupente'n Kohathte tapate akhang-akhang un, a-inkuankuan un asimta uhi.
english: Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation counted the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

paite: Kihoupihna puanin a nasepna a ding in michih nasem dia kisate, kum sawmthum a pan atunglam kum sawmnga a upa chiang.
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Huaite akhang-akhang a asim uh sangnih zasagih-le-sawmnga ahi uhi.
english: Those who were counted of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.

paite: Hiaite ahi uh, kihoupihna biakbuk a nasem Kohathte suan Mosi zang a TOUPA thupiak bang a Mosi leh Aaron in asimte.
english: These are those who were counted of the families of the Kohathites, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

paite: Hiaite a-inkuankuan a, akhang-akhang ua kisim, Gershon tapate ahi uh.
english: Those who were counted of the sons of Gershon, by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

paite: Kum sawmthum a pan atunglam kum sawmnga a upa tan kihoupihna biakbuk nasepna a dia michih nasem dia kisate.
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting,

paite: Akhang akhang a, a-inkuankuan ua asimte uh sangnih zaguk-le-sawmthum ahi uh.
english: even those who were counted of them, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, were two thousand six hundred thirty.

paite: Huaite ahi uh, Gershon tapate suante, kihoupihna biakbuk a nasem teng, TOUPA thupiak bang a Mosi leh Aaron in asimte uh.
english: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Gershon, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of Yahweh.

paite: Huaite a-inkuankuan ua, akhang- akhang ua, Merari tapate asimte uh ahi,
english: Those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

paite: kihoupihna biakbuk a sem ding a nasem zah ding, kum sawmthum a pan atunglam kum sawmnga a upa chiang.
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting,

paite: Huai akhang-akhang a, a-inkuankuan ua asimte uh sangthum leh zanih ahi uh.
english: even those who were counted of them by their families, were three thousand two hundred.

paite: Hiaite Merari tapate suante asim uh, Mosi zang a TOUPA thupiak bang a Mosi leh Aaron in asimte ahi uhi.
english: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

paite: Mosi leh Aaron leh Israelte lupente'n akhang-akhang a, a-inkuankuan a, asimte uh avek un huai teng ahi uh.
english: All those who were counted of the Levites whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel counted, by their families and by their fathers’ houses,

paite: Nasem ding leh kihoupihna biakbuk a puakchi pomi ding zah, kum sawmthum a pan atunglam kum sawmnga a upa chiang.
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered in to do the work of service and the work of bearing burdens in the Tent of Meeting,

paite: Asimte uh sanggiat zanga-le-sawmgiat ahi uh.
english: even those who were counted of them, were eight thousand five hundred eighty.

paite: Mosi zang a TOUPA thupiak bang a michih asep ding leh atantuam ding dungzui zel a sim ahi. Hichibang in TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang a sim ahi uhi.
english: According to the commandment of Yahweh they were counted by Moses, everyone according to his service and according to his burden. Thus they were counted by him, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante agiahna mun ua kipan phak tengteng leh sipawt tengteng leh misi ziak a buah peuhmahte pawtkhesak vek ding in thu pia in.
english: “Command the children of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper, everyone who has a discharge, and whoever is unclean by a corpse.

paite: Numei leh pasal pawtkhesak in giahphual pua ah na koih ding ahi. Alaitak a ka omna giahna mun abuahsaklouhna ding un," achi hi.
english: You shall put both male and female outside of the camp so that they don’t defile their camp, in the midst of which I dwell.”

paite: Huchi in Israel suante'n huchibang in ahih uhi, dainawl ah akoihkhia ua; TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a agen bang in Israel suante'n ahih uhi.
english: The children of Israel did so, and put them outside of the camp; as Yahweh spoke to Moses, so the children of Israel did.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante kiang ah gen inla, pasal hiam, numei hiam in TOUPA tung ah thil bangpeuh na hihkhial in moh taleh;
