english: “Speak to the children of Israel: ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against Yahweh, and that soul is guilty,

paite: ahihkhelhna ah thupha atawi ding ahi. Ahihkhelh man pen kimtak in adin dia, amun nga a khen mun khat ahihkhelhnapa apiak behlap ding ahi.
english: then he shall confess his sin which he has done; and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, add to it the fifth part of it, and give it to him in respect of whom he has been guilty.

paite: Himahleh huai mi in khelh man piakna ding tanau nai aneih keileh, khelh man pen TOUPA a tuam ahi dia, akhelh man leh akhialpa a dia kilemna bawlsakna belampa pen siampu kiang a piak ding ahi.
english: But if the man has no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made to Yahweh shall be the priest’s, in addition to the ram of the atonement, by which atonement shall be made for him.

paite: Israel suante thil siangthou vei thillat tengteng, siampu kiang a lat peuhmah siampu a tuam ding ahi.
english: Every heave offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present to the priest, shall be his.

paite: Michih thil siangthou siampu a tuam ahi dia, mite'n siampu apiak peuhmah ama a tuam ahi ding, chi in," achi hi.
english: Every man’s holy things shall be his; whatever any man gives the priest, it shall be his.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante kiang ah gen inla, akiang uah, Mi, azi in alampialsan a, mi'n amah kithuahpih henla, apasal in thei kei henla,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘If any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him,

paite: huchibang a a-om nilouh a, kihihthanghuai pipi a kigenkhe nai lou hi in, athei kuamah om lou, mat louh hitaleh;
english: and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband and this is kept concealed, and she is defiled, there is no witness against her, and she isn’t taken in the act;

paite: apasal thikthu hong sia a, azi muangmoh a, siangthou lou mah ana hihleh, ahihkeileh apasal thikthu hong sia a, azi muangmoh a, azi siangthou ana hihleh:
english: and the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife and she is defiled; or if the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife and she isn’t defiled;

paite: huai mi in azi a dia thillat barli buh tangbuang ephah mun sawm a khen mun khat tawi in siampu kiang ah azi api ding hi. Athillat ding sathau abuak ding ahi kei a, begaw leng anuh ding ahi sam kei. Thikthusiatna tangbuang thillat, theihgigena thillat, thulimlouhna theihgigena ahi.
english: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and shall bring her offering for her: one tenth of an ephah of barley meal. He shall pour no oil on it, nor put frankincense on it, for it is a meal offering of jealousy, a meal offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to memory.

paite: "Siampu in azi api dia, TOUPA ma ah adingsak dia:
english: The priest shall bring her near, and set her before Yahweh.

paite: Siampu in leibel in tui siangthou ala dia, biakbuk pialkhang a leivui ala dia, tui ah akhe ding hi.
english: The priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and the priest shall take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.

paite: Siampu in huai numei TOUPA ma ah adingsak dia, asam akhahkhiaksak dia, theihgigena tangbuang thillat atawisak dia; siampu in hamsia tungsak tui kha akhut in atawi ding,
english: The priest shall set the woman before Yahweh, and let the hair of the woman’s head go loose, and put the meal offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal offering of jealousy. The priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that brings a curse.

paite: Siampu in huai numei akichiamsak dia, numei kiang ah, 'Na pasal hilou midang kuamah in hon kithuahpih louh a, nitna lam a na lampial keileh hamsia tungsak hiai tui kha a pan na hul ding.
english: The priest shall cause her to take an oath and shall tell the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you haven’t gone aside to uncleanness, being under your husband’s authority, be free from this water of bitterness that brings a curse.

paite: Himahleh lampialsan a na kihihnit a, na pasal lou mi kuahiam in ahon kithuahpihleh na hul kei ding,' achi ding.
english: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband’s authority, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband—”

paite: Siampu in numei avau dia, akichiamsak ding. Numei kiang ah siampu in, 'TOUPA'N na pheipi azawtsak a, na gil apuaksakleh, TOUPA'N na chipihte lak ah hamsethuak in nang hon bawl hen.
english: then the priest shall cause the woman to swear with the oath of cursing, and the priest shall tell the woman, “May Yahweh make you a curse and an oath among your people, when Yahweh allows your thigh to fall away, and your body to swell;

paite: Hamsia tungsak hiai tui na gil ah alut dia, na gil apuaksak dia, na pheipi azawsak ding. Numei in, Amen, Amen,' achi ding.
english: and this water that brings a curse will go into your bowels, and make your body swell, and your thigh fall away.” The woman shall say, “Amen, Amen.”

paite: "Siampu in huai hamsia thute laibu ah agelh dia, tui kha ah adiah ding hi.
english: “‘The priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall wipe them into the water of bitterness.

paite: Hamsia tungsak tui kha numei adawnsak ding ahi. Huchi in hamsia tungsak tui kha agilsung ah alut dia, ahong kha ding hi.
english: He shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causes the curse; and the water that causes the curse shall enter into her and become bitter.

paite: Siampu in thikthusiatna thillat tangbuang numei khut a pan ala dia; TOUPA ma ah tangbuang thillat avei dia, maitam ah apaipih ding hi.
english: The priest shall take the meal offering of jealousy out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the meal offering before Yahweh, and bring it to the altar.

paite: Siampu in tangbuang thillat theihgigena pham khat ala dia, maitam ah ahal dia, huai khit in tui numei adawnsak ding ahi.
english: The priest shall take a handful of the meal offering, as its memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.

paite: Tui adawnsakleh hichi ahi dia; ahong nit a, apasal tung a thil hihkhial ana hihleh hamsia tungsak huai tui agilsung ah alut dia, ahong kha dia, agil ahong puak dia, apheipi ahong zaw dia; huchi in numei achipihte lak a hamsia thuaknu ahong hi ding hi.
english: When he has made her drink the water, then it shall happen, if she is defiled and has committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causes the curse will enter into her and become bitter, and her body will swell, and her thigh will fall away; and the woman will be a curse among her people.

paite: Himahleh numei anit louh a, asianthouleh ahul dia, nau apai thei ding.
english: If the woman isn’t defiled, but is clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive offspring.

paite: "Hiai zi lampial a, apasal hilou midang toh kihihnin hiam,
english: “‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goes astray, and is defiled,

paite: ahihkeileh apasal thikthu hong siat a azi ahazat chiang a vaihawmdan ding ahi. Huchi in TOUPA ma ah api dia, siampu in hiai dan tengteng bang in atung ah ahih ding.
english: or when the spirit of jealousy comes on a man, and he is jealous of his wife; then he shall set the woman before Yahweh, and the priest shall execute on her all this law.

paite: Huchi in pasal pen thulimlouhna ah ahul dia, numei in akhelhna moh apo ding hi, chi in," achi hi.
english: The man shall be free from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.’”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante kiang ah gen inla, akiang uah, pasal hiam, numei hiam in leng banghiam thuchiam tuam, TOUPA a dia akipiakna Nazarit thuchiam achiam lai in uain leh zu angawl ding ahi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘When either man or woman shall make a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to Yahweh,

paite: Uain thuk, zu thuk leh grep tui adawn ding ahi kei a, grep mindup hiam, minvuai hiam leng ane ding ahi sam kei hi.
english: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink. He shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of fermented drink, neither shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.

paite: Akihihtuam sung teng grepgui a pan atang leng, ahawng leng ane ding ahi kei.
english: All the days of his separation he shall eat nothing that is made of the grapevine, from the seeds even to the skins.

paite: "Kihihtuamna thu achiam sung teng alu leng amet louh hial ding ahi. TOUPA a dia akihihtuam sung ni akim mateng hihtuam ahi dia, asam ahawi ding ahi.
english: “‘All the days of his vow of separation no razor shall come on his head, until the days are fulfilled in which he separates himself to Yahweh. He shall be holy. He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.

paite: TOUPA a dia akihihtuam sung teng misi luang anaih ding ahi kei.
english: “‘All the days that he separates himself to Yahweh he shall not go near a dead body.

paite: Apa, anu, a-unaupa, a-unaunu hiam sih thu ah leng akihihnin ding ahi kei hi; Pathian a dia akihihtuamna in amah agak ziak in.
english: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die, because his separation to God is on his head.

paite: Akihihtuam sung teng TOUPA a tuam ahi.
english: All the days of his separation he is holy to Yahweh.

paite: "Akiang ah mi hong siguih in, akihihtuamna lutang hon hihnin kha taleh, akisiansak ni, ani sagih ni in alu amet ding ahi.
english: “‘If any man dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles the head of his separation, then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing. On the seventh day he shall shave it.

paite: Ani giat ni in kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a siampu kiang ah vakhu kop khat hiam, vapalnou kop khat hiam ahon tawi ding ahi.
english: On the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Siampu in khat khelh thoihna ding in alan dia, akhat pen halmang thillat ding in, misi ziak a ahihkhelhna ah kilemna abawlsak ding. Huai ni mah in alu ahihsiangthou ding ahi.
english: The priest shall offer one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because he sinned by reason of the dead, and shall make his head holy that same day.

paite: Akihihtuamna nite TOUPA kiang a pia in khelh thoihna ding in belamnoupa kum khat a upa ahon tawi ding hi. Himahleh akihihtuamna hihnit ahih tak ziak in amangta ding uhi.
english: He shall separate to Yahweh the days of his separation, and shall bring a male lamb a year old for a trespass offering; but the former days shall be void, because his separation was defiled.

paite: "Hiai Nazarit mi dan ahi: Akihihtuamna ni abukim chiang in kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a pi ahi ding.
english: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite: when the days of his separation are fulfilled, he shall be brought to the door of the Tent of Meeting,

paite: TOUPA a dia thillat ding in belampa kum khat a upa gensiatbei halmang thillat ding in khat, khelh thoihna ding in belamnounu kum khat a upa gensiatbei khat, lemna thillat ding in belampa gensiatbei khat,
english: and he shall offer his offering to Yahweh: one male lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering, one ewe lamb a year old without defect for a sin offering, one ram without defect for peace offerings,

paite: silngou soh louh tanghou loh khat, tangbuang nel mahmah thau a mek tanghou leh tangbuang nel mahmah thau a mek tanghou beu, thau a zut tanghou pek silngou soh louh leh nek thillat ding uleh dawn ding thillatte toh alan ding ahi.
english: a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil with their meal offering and their drink offerings.

paite: "Siampu in huaite TOUPA ma ah alan dia, akhelh kithoihna leh ahalmang thillat alan ding ahi.
english: The priest shall present them before Yahweh, and shall offer his sin offering and his burnt offering.

paite: Belampa pen palbawm a tanghou silngou soh louh toh lemna kithoih thillat TOUPA kiang ah alan dia; siampu in tangbuang thillat leh dawn thillat mah leng alan tel ding ahi.
english: He shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh, with the basket of unleavened bread. The priest shall offer also its meal offering and its drink offering.

paite: Nazarit mi in kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah akihihtuamna lu amet dia, akihihtuamna sam ala dia, lemna kithoihna thillat nuai a mei ah ahalmang ding hi.
english: The Nazirite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the Tent of Meeting, take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace offerings.

paite: Siampu in belampa liang huanmin leh bawm a silngou soh louh tanghou khat leh silngou soh louh tanghou pek khat ala dia, Nazarit mi in akihihtuamna lu amet khit in atawisak ding hi.
english: The priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them on the hands of the Nazirite after he has shaved the head of his separation;

paite: Siampu in vei thillat ding in TOUPA ma ah avei ding ahi. Hiai siampu a tuam ahi ding, awm vei leh liang vei toh. Huai khit in Nazarit mi in uain adawn theita ding hi.
english: and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh. They are holy for the priest, together with the breast that is waved and the thigh that is offered. After that the Nazirite may drink wine.

paite: "Hiai ahi Nazarit mi thuchiam dan leh TOUPA ma a thillatdan. Ama ut thu a lat sim louh in akihihtuamna thuchiam dungzui zel in ahih ding ahi," achi hi.
english: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite who vows and of his offering to Yahweh for his separation, in addition to that which he is able to afford. According to his vow which he vows, so he must do after the law of his separation.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Aaron leh atapate kiang ah, hichi- bang in Israel suante na vualzawl ding ahi. Akiang uah,
english: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is how you shall bless the children of Israel.’ You shall tell them,

paite: "TOUPA'N nou hon vualzawl in hon veng hen.
english: ‘Yahweh bless you, and keep you.

paite: TOUPA'N na tung uah amel vaksak henla, hon hehpih hen.
english: Yahweh make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you.

paite: TOUPA'N nou lam hong nga henla, lungmuanna noute hon pia hen, chi in gen un, chi in agen hi.
english: Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’

paite: "Huchibang a hih in Israel suante tung ah ka min tuansak ahi dia, amau ka vualzawl ding," achi hi.
english: “So they shall put my name on the children of Israel; and I will bless them.”

paite: Mosi in biakbuk alam khit a, thau anilh khit a, ahihsiangthou khit a, van tengteng leh maitam leh tui-um belsuan tengteng thaunilh a, ahihsiangthou ni in hichi ahi a,
english: On the day that Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed it and sanctified it with all its furniture, and the altar with all its vessels, and had anointed and sanctified them;

paite: Israel intekpen, a-inkuan ua intekpente'n thillat alan ua, huaite anam ua intekpente, asimte uh tung a omte ahi uh.
english: the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ houses, gave offerings. These were the princes of the tribes. These are they who were over those who were counted;

paite: Athillatte uh kangtalai tung nei guk leh bawngtal sawm-le-nih, intekpen nih in kangtalai khat zel, khat in bawngtal khat zel TOUPA ma ah ahon paipih ua, biakbuk ah ahong lan uhi.
english: and they brought their offering before Yahweh, six covered wagons and twelve oxen; a wagon for every two of the princes, and for each one an ox. They presented them before the tabernacle.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Biakbuk nasepna ding in aphatuam kha ding, na la chiat un; Levite, anasep uh dungzui zel in na pe chiat ding hi," achi hi.
english: “Accept these from them, that they may be used in doing the service of the Tent of Meeting; and you shall give them to the Levites, to every man according to his service.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in kangtalaite leh bawngtalte ala a, Levite khut ah apia hi.
english: Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.

paite: Kangtalai nih leh bawngtal li Gershon tapate anasep uh dungzui zel in apia hi.
english: He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon, according to their service.

paite: Kangtalai li leh bawngtal giat, siampu Aaron tapa Ithamar, Merari tapate anasep uh dungzui in apia hi.
english: He gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

paite: Kohath tapate bel mun siangthou a nasep amau a tuam hi a, anasep uh azawnthoh ahih ziak in ape kei hi.
english: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged to them; they carried it on their shoulders.

paite: Intekpente'n thaunilh ni in maitam latna dia athillatte uh maitam bul ah alan uhi.
english: The princes gave offerings for the dedication of the altar in the day that it was anointed. The princes gave their offerings before the altar.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Intekpen chih in maitam latna dia athillat, athillat uh amau tan hi zel ding in alan ding uhi," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedication of the altar.”

paite: Ni khat ni a thillat lan ding mi Judah chi Amminadab tapa Nashon ahi.
english: He who offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah,

paite: Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik, dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding in thau helsa tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
english: and his offering was: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: Shekel sawm toh kikim a gik gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu khat;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

paite: halmang thillat ding in bawngtaltuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa khat;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: khelh thoihna ding in keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

paite: Ni nih ni in Issakar intekpente'n Zuar tapa Nethaneel in alan hi.
english: On the second day Nethanel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, gave his offering.

english: He offered for his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: khelh thoihna ding in keltal khat;

english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nethanel the son of Zuar.

english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.

paite: Ani li ni in Reuben tate intekpen Shedeur tapa Elizur in alan hi.

english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Elizur the son of Shedeur.

english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old: this was the offering of Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

english: On the sixth day, Eliasaph the son of Deuel, prince of the children of Gad,

english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Elishama the son of Ammihud.

english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

english: one male goat for a sin offering;

english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

paite: Ani kua ni in Benjamin tate intekpen Gideoni tapa Abidan in alan hi.
english: On the ninth day Abidan the son of Gideoni, prince of the children of Benjamin,

english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: lemna kithoihna thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnoupa kum khat a upa nga ahi. Hiaite Gideoni tapa Abidan thillatte ahi uh.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Abidan the son of Gideoni.

paite: Ani sawm ni in Dan tate intekpen Ammishaddai tapa Ahiezer in alan hi.
english: On the tenth day Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai, prince of the children of Dan,

english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

english: one male goat for a sin offering;

english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

paite: Ani sawm-le-khat ni in Asher tate intekpen Okran tapa Pagiel in alan hi.
english: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ochran, prince of the children of Asher,

paite: Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel sawm-thum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: lemna kithoih thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnoupa kum khat upa ngate Okran tapa Pagiel thillatte ahi uh.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ochran.

paite: Ani sawm-le-nih ni in Naphtali tate intekpen Enan tapa Ahira in alan hi.
english: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali,

paite: Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: shekel sawm toh kikim a gik gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu khat;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

paite: halmang thillat ding bawngtaltuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa khat;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: lemna kithoih thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnoupa kum khat a upa ngate Enan tapa Ahira thillatte ahi uh.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.

paite: Maitam thau nilh ni a Israel intekpente thillatte dangkasik kuang sawm-le-nih, dangkasik belhbu sawm-le-nih leh dangka-eng keu sawm-le-nih ahi.
english: This was the dedication offering of the altar, on the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden ladles;

paite: Dangkasik kuang shekel za-le-sawmthum toh kikim a gik chiat ahi a, belhbu sawmsagih chiat ahi. Dangkasik tui-um belsuan tengteng mun siangthou a shekel sangnih-le-zali toh kikim a gik ahi.
english: each silver platter weighing one hundred thirty shekels, and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;

paite: Gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu sawm-le-nih mun siangthou a shekel sawm toh kikim a gik chiat ahi. Dangka-eng keu tengteng shekel za-le-sawmnih toh kikim a gik ahi.
english: the twelve golden ladles, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the ladles weighed one hundred twenty shekels;

paite: Haltum thillat ding bawngtal tengteng sawm-le-nih ahi a, belamtal sawm-le-nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa sawm-le-nih; atangbuang thillatte uh toh, Khelh thoihna ding keltal sawm-le-nih.
english: all the cattle for the burnt offering twelve bulls, the rams twelve, the male lambs a year old twelve, and their meal offering; and twelve male goats for a sin offering;

paite: Lemna kithoihna thillat ding bawngtal sawmnih-le-li ahi a, belamtal bel sawmguk, keltal sawmguk, belamnoupa kum khat a upa sawmguk ahi. Hiai thau nilh khit a maitam latna dia thilpiakte ahi uh.
english: and all the cattle for the sacrifice of peace offerings: twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty male lambs a year old. This was the dedication offering of the altar, after it was anointed.

paite: Huchi in biakbuk a amah be dia Mosi alut in thukhun bawm tung a zahngaihna tutphah tunglam a cherub nihte kikal a pan amah ahoupihna aw aza hi.
english: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with Yahweh, he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim; and he spoke to him.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Aaron houpih inla, akiang ah, khawnvak na det chiang in khawnvak sagihte'n sathau khawnvak koihna malam atatvak ding uh ahi," chi in.
english: “Speak to Aaron, and tell him, ‘When you light the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lamp stand.’”

paite: Aaron in huchibang in ahih a; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in khawnvak koihna malam ah khawnvakte ade hi.
english: Aaron did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lamp stand, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Hiai khawnvak koihna ahihleh dangka-eng a sekthoh chi ahi a; amung bul a kipan apak tan a sekthoh ahi. Alim TOUPA'N Mosi a-etsak bang geih a khawnvak koihna bawl ahi.
english: This was the workmanship of the lamp stand, beaten work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was beaten work. He made the lamp stand according to the pattern which Yahweh had shown Moses.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Levite, Israel suante lak a pan hihtuam inla, hihsiangthou in.
english: “Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

paite: Amaute hihsiangthou ding in hichibang in na hih ding ahi. Atung uah sawpsianna tui sung inla, apumpi tengteng uh metsak inla, apuante uh sawpsak inla, kihihsiangthousak in.
english: You shall do this to them to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.

paite: Bawngtaltuai khat tangbuang thillat thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah toh lasak inla, khelh thoihna ding in bawngtaltuai khat dang leng na kaisak ding ahi.
english: Then let them take a young bull and its meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering.

paite: Levite kihoupihna biakbuk bul ah pi inla, Israel suan omkhawm tengteng kigawmkhawmsak vek in.
english: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting. You shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel.

paite: Levite TOUPA kiang ah na lan dia; Israel suante'n Levite tung ah akhut uh anga ding uhi.
english: You shall present the Levites before Yahweh. The children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites,

paite: Huchi in Aaron in Levite, TOUPA nna aseptheihna ding un Israel suante min in vei thillat TOUPA kiang ah alan ding.
english: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before Yahweh for a wave offering on the behalf of the children of Israel, that it may be theirs to do the service of Yahweh.

paite: Levite'n bawngtalte lutung ah akhut uh anga ding ua; Levite a dia kilemna bawlna ding in, khat, khelh thoihna ding in, akhat pen halmang thillat ding in TOUPA kiang ah alan ding ahi.
english: “The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering to Yahweh, to make atonement for the Levites.

paite: "Levite Aaron leh atapate ma ah na omsak dia, TOUPA a ding in vei thillat ding in na lan ding ahi.
english: You shall set the Levites before Aaron and before his sons, and offer them as a wave offering to Yahweh.

paite: Huchibang in Israel suante lak a pan Levite na hihtuam dia, huchi in Levite kei a ahi ding uh.
english: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.

paite: Huai khit in Levite kihoupihna biakbuk nasem ding in alut ding ua, nang amaute na hihsiangthou ding, vei thillat ding in na lan ding ahi.
english: “After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting. You shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering.

paite: Israel suante lak a pan kei a tuam dia seh ahi ngal ua. Sul hong tengteng, Israel suante ta masapen teng tang in kei a ding in ka neita hi.
english: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of all who open the womb, even the firstborn of all the children of Israel, I have taken them to me.

paite: Israel suante lak a ta masapente, mihing toh ganta toh kei a ahi him uhi. Aigupta gam a ta masapente ka sihsak lai in kei a tuam dia ka sehsa ahi.
english: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both man and animal. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for myself.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante lak a ta masapente tang in Levite ka nei khinta ahi.
english: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante tang a kihoupihna biakbuk a nasem ding leh Israel suante'n mun siangthou ahon naih ua leng Israel suante lak a hii alenlouhna dia lemna bawl ding in Israel suante lak a pan Levite Aaron leh atapate ka pia ahi," achi hi.
english: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel, so that there will be no plague among the children of Israel when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary.”

paite: Huchibang in Mosi, Aaron leh Israel suan omkhawm tengteng in Levite tung ah ahihta uhi. Levite tungtang thu a TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak tengteng bang in atung uah Israel suante'n ahih uhi.
english: Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel did so to the Levites. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.

paite: Huchi in Levite siansak ahi ua, apuante uh asawp ua; Aaron in TOUPA ma ah vei thillat ding in alan hi. Amau hihsianthouna ding in Aaron in kilemna abawlsak hi.
english: The Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them for a wave offering before Yahweh and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.

paite: Huai zoh in Levite Aaron leh atapate nuai a, anasep uh sem ding in kihoupihna biakbuk sung ah alut uhi. Levite tungtang thu a TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in atung uah ahihta hi.
english: After that, the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron and before his sons: as Yahweh had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Levite tantuam hiaite ahi. Kum sawmnih-le-nga chiang tunglam in kihoupihna biakbuk a nasep asem ding uh.
english: “This is what is assigned to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to wait on the service in the work of the Tent of Meeting;

paite: Kum sawmnga a upate'n anasep uh akhawlsan ding ua, nna asem nawn kei ding uh.
english: and from the age of fifty years they shall retire from doing the work, and shall serve no more,

paite: Himahleh khawmpite biakbuk kep thu ah a-unaute uh ahuh zel ding ua, nasep zaw asem nawn kei ding uh. Hichibang in Levite nasep na gelsak ding ahi," achi hi.
english: but shall assist their brothers in the Tent of Meeting, to perform the duty, and shall perform no service. This is how you shall have the Levites do their duties.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawt nung uh akum nihna, akha khatna in Sinai gamdai ah Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

paite: "Israel suante'n Paikan Ankuangluina ahunbi zel in nei uhen.
english: “Let the children of Israel keep the Passover in its appointed season.

paite: Ahunbi in, hiai kha, ani sawm-le-li nitaklam in na nei ding uhi. Huai a hih dia seh tengteng leh dan bang in na nei ding uhi," achi hi.
english: On the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you shall keep it in its appointed season. You shall keep it according to all its statutes and according to all its ordinances.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in Israel suante Paikan Ankuangluina nei ding in ahilh hi.
english: Moses told the children of Israel that they should keep the Passover.

paite: Huchi in Sinai gamdai ah akha khatna, ani sawm-le-li ni nitaklam in Paikan Ankuangluina anei uhi. TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang zel in Israel suante'n ahih uhi.
english: They kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, in the wilderness of Sinai. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did.

paite: Kuate hiam misi luang ziak a siang lou ana om ua, huai ni in Paikan Ankuangluina ah atel thei kei ua, huchi in huai ni in Mosi leh Aaron ma ah ahoh uhi.
english: There were certain men who were unclean because of the dead body of a man, so that they could not keep the Passover on that day, and they came before Moses and Aaron on that day.

paite: Huaite'n akiang ah, "Misi luang ziak in siang lou ka hi ua; huaiziak in hia, Israel suante lak a ahunbi a TOUPA kiang a thillat ka lat sam uh kham ka hih uh?" achi uhi.
english: Those men said to him, “We are unclean because of the dead body of a man. Why are we kept back, that we may not offer the offering of Yahweh in its appointed season among the children of Israel?”

paite: Mosi in akiang uah, "Na pau kei phot dih uh. Na tungtang thu uah TOUPA'N bangchi in ahia thu ahon piak ka hon za masa phot ding," achi hi.
english: Moses answered them, “Wait, that I may hear what Yahweh will command concerning you.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante kiang ah, na lak ua kuapeuh, na suante uh lak a kuapeuh, misi luang ziak a siang lou hiam, ana zinmang hiam a-om zenzen uleh TOUPA a ding in Paikan Ankuangluina neih himhim ding ahi.
english: “Say to the children of Israel, ‘If any man of you or of your generations is unclean by reason of a dead body, or is on a journey far away, he shall still keep the Passover to Yahweh.

paite: Akha nihna, ani sawm-le-li ni nitaklam in anei ding ua; tanghou silngou soh louh lou kha toh anek ding uh ahi.
english: In the second month, on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

paite: Azing a ding in bangmah akoih ding uh ahi kei. Aguh leng ahihtan ding uh ahi kei. Paikan Ankuangluina a hih dia seh bang zel a ahih ding uh ahi.
english: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break a bone of it. According to all the statute of the Passover they shall keep it.

paite: Himahleh, siang ngal a, zinmangna nei lou, Paikan Ankuangluina a tel lou mawkmawk ahihleh achipihte lak a pan huai mi satkhiak ding ahi. Ahunbi a TOUPA kiang a thillat alat louh ziak in huai mi in akhelh moh akipuak ding hi.
english: But the man who is clean, and is not on a journey, and fails to keep the Passover, that soul shall be cut off from his people. Because he didn’t offer the offering of Yahweh in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

paite: "Namdangmi na kiang ua om in TOUPA a dia ankuangluina a tel sam a-utleh Paikan Ankuangluina a hih dia seh leh adan bang in ahih ding ahi. Hiai gam a mi mawng leh namdang mite a dia dan kikhat na neih ding uh ahi, chi in gen in,” achi hi.
english: “‘If a foreigner lives among you and desires to keep the Passover to Yahweh, then he shall do so according to the statute of the Passover, and according to its ordinance. You shall have one statute, both for the foreigner and for him who is born in the land.’”

paite: Huchi in biakbuk lam khit ni in biakbuk, theihpihna puanin pen meipi in atuam liiliai hi. Nitaklam in biakbuk tung ah meikuang bangbang azingsang tan in a-om hi.
english: On the day that the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the Tent of the Testimony. At evening it was over the tabernacle, as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.

paite: Huchibang in a-om nilouh a; meipi in atuam nilouh a, zan chiang in mei bang in akilang hi.
english: So it was continually. The cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.

paite: Meipi in puanin akikhinsan teng in Israel suante'n pai ding vai ahawm zel ua; meipi khawlna mun peuh ah Israel suante'n giahphual asat zel uhi.
english: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel traveled; and in the place where the cloud remained, there the children of Israel encamped.

paite: TOUPA thupiak in Israel suante apai zel ua, TOUPA thupiak mah in giahphual asat uhi. Biakbuk tung a meipi a-om sung teng giahphual ah a-om nilouh uh.
english: At the commandment of Yahweh, the children of Israel traveled, and at the commandment of Yahweh they encamped. As long as the cloud remained on the tabernacle they remained encamped.

paite: Biakbuk tung a meipi sawtpi a-omleh Israel suante'n TOUPA thu azui ua, apai kei uhi.
english: When the cloud stayed on the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept Yahweh’s command, and didn’t travel.

paite: Biakbuk tung a ni tam lou sung meipi a-om chiang in giahphual asat ua, TOUPA thupiak bang in, huchi in apai zel uhi.
english: Sometimes the cloud was a few days on the tabernacle; then according to the commandment of Yahweh they remained encamped, and according to the commandment of Yahweh they traveled.

paite: Akalkal in meipi nitaklam a pan azingsang pha in a-om a; zingsang a meipi in atungkahsanleh apai zel uhi. Ni khat lel hiam, zan khat lel hiam om a meipi in atungkahsanleh apai zel uhi.
english: Sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they traveled; or by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they traveled.

paite: Biakbuk tung a meipi ni nih hiam, kha khat hiam, kum khat hiam a-om a, huai a a-om nilouh leh Israel suante giahphual ah a-om nilouh ua, apai kei uh. Atungkahsanleh bel apai zel uhi.
english: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a year that the cloud stayed on the tabernacle, remaining on it, the children of Israel remained encamped, and didn’t travel; but when it was taken up, they traveled.

paite: TOUPA thupiak in giahphual asat zel ua, TOUPA thupiak in apai zel uh. Mosi zang a TOUPA thupiak in TOUPA thu azui uhi.
english: At the commandment of Yahweh they encamped, and at the commandment of Yahweh they traveled. They kept Yahweh’s command, at the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

paite: Obadiah mengmuhna Toupa PATHIAN in Edom tungtang ah hichi in achi: TOUPA a kipan thu ka thei a, namte lak ah palai sawl ahi, "Thou unla, kidouna ah amah dou ding in i kuan ding uh," chi in.
english: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Lord Yahweh says about Edom. We have heard news from Yahweh, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Arise, and let’s rise up against her in battle.

paite: "Ngai dih, namte lak ah ka hon hihneuta hi; nakpi a muhsit in na omta.
english: Behold, I have made you small among the nations. You are greatly despised.

paite: Aw nang, suangpi kitam kal a teng, mun sang luah, kua'n ahia lei a hon kesak ding lungsim a chipa? Na lungtang kisaktheihna in nang ahon khemta hi.
english: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says in his heart, ‘Who will bring me down to the ground?’

paite: Muvanlai bang in sangpi ah lengtou mah lechin, na bu leng aksi lak ah seh in om mahleh, huai a kipan ka hon kaikhesuk ding," TOUPA'N achi.
english: Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there,” says Yahweh.

paite: "Na kiang ah gutate, suamhatte zan in hong pai le uh, hihman nak hih na ni chia, adeihzah un agu kei ding ua hia? Na kiang ah grep lakhawm mite hong pai le uh, grep lak ding khenkhatte anuse kei ding ua hia?
english: “If thieves came to you, if robbers by night—oh, what disaster awaits you—wouldn’t they only steal until they had enough? If grape pickers came to you, wouldn’t they leave some gleaning grapes?

paite: Esau thilte zonkhiak ahita a; agoubawm selgukte maikhiak ahita!
english: How Esau will be ransacked! How his hidden treasures are sought out!

paite: Nang lawmte khem in na om a, gamgi pha in hon delhkhe ding ua; na kituahpihte'n nang ahon zouta ua; na tanghou nete'n na nuai ah thang akam ua; amah ah theihsiamna a-om kei hi.
english: All the men of your alliance have brought you on your way, even to the border. The men who were at peace with you have deceived you, and prevailed against you. Friends who eat your bread lay a snare under you. There is no understanding in him.”

paite: Huai ni chiang in Edom a kipan mipilte ka hihmang in, Esau tang a kipan theihsiamna ka hihmang kei dia hia?" TOUPA'N achi hi.
english: “Won’t I in that day”, says Yahweh, “destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mountain of Esau?

paite: Aw Teman, Esau tang ah michih thahgam a a-om vekna ding ua, na mihatte nakpitak in alunglel ding uh.
english: Your mighty men, Teman, will be dismayed, to the end that everyone may be cut off from the mountain of Esau by slaughter.

paite: "Na unaupa Jakob tung a na hiamgamna ziak in zumna in nang ahon khuh ding, tangtawn in hihmanthat in na om ding hi.
english: For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.

paite: Langkhat a na din ni a, mikhualte'n asum alakmang ni ua, namdang mite akulh kongkhak a ahong lut ua, Jerusalem tung a ai asan lai un, nang leng amau lak a tel bang in na om hi.
english: In the day that you stood on the other side, in the day that strangers carried away his substance and foreigners entered into his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, even you were like one of them.

paite: Himahleh na unaupa asiat lai in awibawl ke'nla, Judah tate amanthat ni un kipak ke'n; ahaksat ni in kisatheitak in pau ke'n.
english: But don’t look down on your brother in the day of his disaster, and don’t rejoice over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction. Don’t speak proudly in the day of distress.

paite: Ka mite avangsiat ni un akulh kongpi uah lut ke'nla; avangsiat ni un athuakna uh en ke'n, avangsiat ni un asum-le-paite uh tung ah na khutte uh nga sam kei un.
english: Don’t enter into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity. Don’t look down on their affliction in the day of their calamity, neither seize their wealth on the day of their calamity.

paite: Ami khenkhat taikhete that ding in lamka thuam a dingh in, haksat ni in ami omsunte mansak ke'n.
english: Don’t stand in the crossroads to cut off those of his who escape. Don’t deliver up those of his who remain in the day of distress.

paite: Nam tengteng tung ah TOUPA ni lah anai ngal a; na hihsiat mah bang in na tung ah hih ahi ding; na hihdan nangmah luzang ah hong kik ding hi.
english: For the day of Yahweh is near all the nations! As you have done, it will be done to you. Your deeds will return upon your own head.

paite: Ka tang siangthou a na dawn bang un, nam tengteng in adawn gige ding uh, ahi, adawn ding ua, avalh ding ua, piang lou bang in a-om ding uh.
english: For as you have drunk on my holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. Yes, they will drink, swallow down, and will be as though they had not been.

paite: Zion tang ah bel suaktate a-om ding ua, asiangthou ding uh; Jakob inkote'n agoutante uh atang ding uhi.
english: But in Mount Zion, there will be those who escape, and it will be holy. The house of Jacob will possess their possessions.

paite: Jakob inkote mei ahi ding ua, Joseph inkote meikuang ahi ding, Esau inkote buhpawl ahi ding ua, amau lak ah akuang ding ua, akangmang ding uh; Esau inkote khosuak a-om kei ding uh; TOUPA'N lah achita ngal hi.
english: The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble. They will burn among them and devour them. There will not be any remaining to the house of Esau.” Indeed, Yahweh has spoken.

paite: Simlam mite'n Esau mual atang ding a; phaizang mite'n Philistia atang ding uh; amaute'n Ephraim leh Samaria lou atang ding uh; Benjamin in Gilead gam atang ding hi.
english: Those of the South will possess the mountain of Esau, and those of the lowland, the Philistines. They will possess the field of Ephraim, and the field of Samaria. Benjamin will possess Gilead.

paite: Kanaan mite lak a hiai Israel suan saltang mipite'n Zarephath gam tan atang ding ua; Sepharad gam a Jerusalem khomite saltang in simlam khopite atang ding uhi.
english: The captives of this army of the children of Israel, who are among the Canaanites, will possess even to Zarephath; and the captives of Jerusalem, who are in Sepharad, will possess the cities of the Negev.

paite: Zion tang a pan Esau dou ding in akuantou ding ua, atung ah vai ahawm ding uhi; huan gam TOUPA a ah i ding hi.”
english: Saviors will go up on Mount Zion to judge the mountains of Esau, and the kingdom will be Yahweh’s.

paite: Paul leh Timothi, Khrist Jesu sikhate'n, Philippi a om misiangthou tengteng leh heutute leh upate kiang ah:
english: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:

paite: Hehpihna leh khamuanna i Pa Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Khrist a kipan na tung uah om hen.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Noute ka hon theihgigena ah ka Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen hi,
english: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

paite: na vek ua ding a kipaktak a thum a ka hon ngetsakna teng ah;
english: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,

paite: ani masapen a pan tuni tanpha a tanchinhoih a na kithuahkhawmna ziak ua kipak in.
english: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

paite: Hiai thil mahmah gingta ing; amah nou a nasep hoih panpa'n Jesu ni tanpha in azoukim vek ding hi.
english: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

paite: Na vek ua tungtang thu a, ke'n hichibang lungsim ka neih adik ahi, ka lungtang a ka hon neih ziak in; ka kolbutna leh tanchinhoih gupna leh hihkipna thu a hehpihna ka tanpihte na hi vek uhi.
english: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

paite: Khrist Jesu hehpihna nou ngiingei ah nou ka hon ngai mahmah chih Pathian in ahon theihpih hi.
english: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

paite: Noute theihna leh theihkakna toh kithuah itna a na khan semsemna ding un ka thum hi.
english: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

paite: Huchi a thil hoihpen na deih ua, Khrist ni a siangthou leh dembei a na omtheihna ding uh leh,
english: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,

paite: Pathian thupina leh pahtawina ding a, Jesu Khrist ziak a hong om dikna gahte na dimtheihna ding un.
english: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

paite: Unaute aw, tu in ka tung a thil hong tungte, tanchinhoih akhanna dia hong tung ahi uh chih na theih uh ka deih;
english: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,

paite: huchi in inpi vengpawl tengteng leh adang tengteng kiang ah Khrist ziak a kolbun ka hi chih achiangta hi.
english: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,

paite: Ka kolbuhna a kipan a Toupa muanna nei in unaute lak a tampite lau lou a Pathian thu gen ding in nakpitak in ahong hangsan deuhdeuhta uhi.
english: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

paite: Khenkhatte'n hazatna ziak leh thangpaihna ziak in Khrist atangkoupih ua; khenkhatte'n hoih asak ziak un agen uh.
english: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

paite: Pawl khatte'n itna ziak in, tanchinhoih dikdan gen dia om ka hihdan thei in agen uhi.
english: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;

paite: Himahleh pawl dang in kikhenna ding in Khrist atangkoupih ua, ataktak hilou in ka kolbuhna a ka thuakna behlap tum in.
english: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.

paite: Bang apoi a? Kong bangkim a Khrist akigenkhiak photleh akhem hi in atak hitaleh, huai ah ka kipak hi. Ahi, ka kipak zel lai ding hi.
english: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.

paite: Na thumnate uh leh Jesu Khrist Kha panpihna ziak in hiai ka suahtakna hong suak ding chih ka thei hi.
english: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

paite: Ka gintak taktakna leh ka lametna bang in bangmah ah hihzum in ka om kei hial dia, himahleh ahi gige sa mah bang in tu in leng ka hinna hiam ka sihna hiam in ka pumpi ah hangsanna kim toh Khrist hihlet in a-om ngeingei ding hi.
english: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.

paite: Kei a ding in zaw hin Khrist ahi a, huan sih leng punna ahi.
english: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

paite: Himahleh sa a hin ka tan ding hitaleh kei a ding in sepgim gah tampi suahna ding ahi. Hinapi in ka tel ding pen ka thei kei.
english: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.

paite: Nih kalteh in hamhaihtak in ka om hi. Paimang a Khrist kiang a om utna ka nei a; huai lah nakpitak in ahoihzaw ngal a.
english: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

paite: Himahleh noute ziak in sa a om phot akiphamohzaw hi.
english: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

paite: Huchi in hiai ginna ka neih ziak in, ka om phot ding chih ka thei; ginna a na khanletna ding uh leh na kipahna ding un, na vek ua lak ah ka om phot ding hi;
english: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,

paite: huchi a na kiang ua ka hong pai nawn ding ziak a Khrist Jesu na suanna ding uh tam semsem kei a na neihna ding un.
english: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

paite: Na omdan uh Khrist tanchinhoih toh kituaksak photphot un; hong hoh a, nou hong muh hiam, ahihkeileh ka om louh a leng kha khat a na dinkipdan uh leh lungsim khat nei a tanchinhoih thugin a na pandan uh, na tanchin uh ka zaktheihna ding in.
english: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;

paite: Huan bangmah ah na melmate uh hihlau in om kei un. Huai amau a ding in manna ding kichetna teltak ahi a, himahleh nou a ding in hotdamna ding kichetna ahi, huai Pathian a kipan ahi.
english: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.

paite: Hiai tuh noute a ding in phal ahita; Khrist gingtate kia hilou in, ama ziak in na thuak sam ding uh.
english: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,

paite: Keimah a na muh uleh na zak uh huai kidouna mah na dou ding uh ahi.
english: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.

paite: Huaiziak in Khrist a thu kihilh ding a-om a, itna a kinep theihna ding a-om a, kha toh kithuahna, kilainatna leh kihehpihna a-omleh,
english: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,

paite: huai lungsim mah pu in, hichibang itna mah nei unla, tup kibang leh lungsim khat nei in ka kipahna hon hihkimsak un.
english: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

paite: Kikhenna ding leh kithupisakna ziak in bangmah hih kei un; lungsim niamlak in michih in ama sang in midang hoih sa zaw hen.
english: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;

paite: Na lak ua kuapeuh in amah a ding kia en lou in, midang a leng en sam hen.
english: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

paite: Khrist Jesu a om hiai lungsim nei le uchin:
english: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

paite: Amah Pathian bang a om hinapi in, Pathian toh kikim a om thil khiaklah ding in asep kei hi,
english: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

paite: himahleh amah ahong ki- awngsak a, sikha bang in ahong om a, mihing bang geih in ahong piang hi.
english: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

paite: Huchi in mihing mel ahon pu a, ahong kingainiam a, si ding in thu ahon mang a, ahi, kros a sihna nangawn.
english: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.

paite: Huaiziak in Pathian in amah nakpitak in ahihlianta a, min laklak a min tungnungpen apeta hi;
english: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,

paite: Jesu min a mi tengteng akhukdin a, van tung, leitung leh lei nuai a thil om tengteng leh,
english: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

paite: lei tengteng in Jesu Khrist Pa Pathian thupina ding a Toupa ahi chih apuankhiak theihna ding un.
english: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

paite: Huchi ahih ziak in, ka itte aw, ka om lai kia hilou a, ka om louh lai a leng thu na man theih tak mah bang un, lau leh ling kawm in na hotdamna chiat uh semkhia un;
english: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

paite: ama lungtaina ding a noumau a hon utsak leh hon semsakpa Pathian ahi.
english: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.

paite: Dawngdawng lou leh phunphun lou in thil bangkim hih un;
english: Do all things without complaining and arguing,

paite: Khangthak gilou leh khial, alak ua khovel vak bang a na tennate lak uah Pathian ta gensiatbei leh siangthou,
english: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

paite: hinna thu taklang na hihtheihna ding un; huai a kipan ke'n, Khrist ni ahong tun chiang a, athawn in ka semgim kei a, athawn in ka taigim kei ka chih ngamna ding in.
english: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.

paite: Ahi, na ginna thillat tung ua Pathian a dia buakkhiak a om ding na hi leng ka kipak a, na vek un ka hon kipahpih hi.
english: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.

paite: Huaiziak mah in, nou leng kipak unla; kei leng hon kipahpih un.
english: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.

paite: Akoi abang hitaleh na omdan uh ka theih a lungmuang a ka omtheihna ding in na kiang ua Timothi hon sawl pah Toupa Jesu ah ka lamen hi.
english: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.

paite: Hichibang lungsim pu a, na hoihna ding uh awlmoh midang kuamah ka nei kei hi.
english: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.

paite: Jesu Khrist thilte zong lou in, avek un amau tuam chiat azong uhi.
english: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

paite: Himahleh ama'n tuh ta in apa nna asep bang in tanchinhoih genzakna ah kei ahon seppih chih theihchetna amah ah na nei uhi.
english: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.

paite: Huaiziak in bangchi in ka om dia chih ka hon theihchet peuhpeuh chiang in amah hon sawlkhiak pah ka kilamen hi.
english: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

paite: Himahleh keimah mah leng ka hong pah ding chih Toupa ah ka kilamen hi.
english: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.

paite: Himahleh ka sanggam leh seppih leh sepaihpih leh na taksapna ua gamtang leh sawltak Epaphroditas na kiang ua hon sawl kiphamoh ka sa hi;
english: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,

paite: na vek un ahon ngai mahmah a, adam louh thu na zak un, alungkham mahmah hi.
english: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.

paite: Si dektak in achina ngei a; himahleh Pathian in atung ah zahngaihna anei a; amah tung kia leng hilou in kei tung ah leng ahi sam a, huchi a lungkhamna ka neih sawnsawnlouhna ding in.
english: For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.

paite: Huaiziak in amah ka hon sawl teitei hi, amah na muh chiang un ana kipahpih un, huchi a kei leng ka dah luatlouhna ding in.
english: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

paite: Huaiziak in kipaktak in Toupa ah amah na kipahpih unla, hichibang mite ana ngaisang un;
english: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,

paite: Khrist nasepna ah amah tuh ahong si dek a, kei a ding a na hihkimlouhte uh hon hihsak atupna lam ah ahinna akhuai dektak hi.
english: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.

paite: Atawp pen in unaute aw, Toupa ah kipak un. Angei mah gelh kei a ding in achimtakhuai kei a, nou a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
english: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.

paite: Uite lak ah kiveng un, nna gilou semte a pan kiveng un, sa atgawp mite a pan kiveng un.
english: Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.

paite: Eite lah Kha a Pathian bia, Khrist Jesu suang, zeksum diktakte i hi ngal ua, huan pumpi ah suan ding i nei kei uhi.
english: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;

paite: Sa ah suang ding chi lehang kei mahmah in suan ding ka nei sem ding hi. Mi himhim in asa a suan ding nei a akitheihleh ke'n ka nei sem hi.
english: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:

paite: Ani giat ni a zeksum, Israel chi, Benjamin nam, Hebru mi kholdiak, dan lam a Pharisai;
english: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;

paite: phatuamngaihna lam chi lehang saptuamte sawi; dan a diktatna lam chi lehang gensiatbei ka hi.
english: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

paite: Ahihi hitaleh, kei a dia punna ka ngah thilte peuhmah Khrist ziak in manna in ka simta hi.
english: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.

paite: Ahitak in, ka Toupa theihna manpha ziak in thil tengteng ka tanta hi. Khrist ka tantheihna ding in thil tengteng ninneng bang phet in ka sim hi.
english: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

paite: Amah a ka omtheihna ding in leh dan a kinga keimah diktatna hilou a, Khrist ginna ziak a om pen, ginna a kinga Pathian a pan suak diktatna nei zaw in.
english: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,

paite: Huchi a amah leh athohnawnna thilhihtheihna ka theih a, athuaknate tanpih a, asihna a amah batna ka neihtheihna ding in.
english: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,

paite: Bangchi hiam a misi lak a kipan thohnawnna ka ngah theih khakleh chi in.
english: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

paite: Hiai tang khin ka hi kei a, bukim khinta ka hi kei; himahleh huai mah kei a hihsak tum in ka delh teitei hi, Khrist Jesu'n kei, amah a ahon hihsak tak ziak in.
english: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

paite: Unaute aw, tang khinta in ka kingai kei a; himahleh thil khat ka hih hi: nunglam a omte mangngilh in malam a om pen ka delh hi;
english: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,

paite: Khrist Jesu a Pathian sapna sang kipahman mu ding in phakchiamna ka delh hi.
english: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

paite: Huaiziak in i lak ua apiching deuhdeuh bek in huchibang lungsim i nei ding uh; huchi a thil peuhpeuh a lungsim dang na neih uleh Pathian in nou ahon theisak ngei ding hi.
english: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.

paite: I hong tunna i ngahna chiang uah muanhuai in kip peuhmah ni uh.
english: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.

paite: Unaute aw, kei hon enton vek unla huchibang a omte zuih ding a na hon neihte uh chiamteh un.
english: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

paite: Mi tampi a-om ua, atanchin uh ka hon hilhta hi, amau Khrist kros melmate ahihdan uh tu in leng kap kawm in ka hon hilh hi.
english: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,

paite: Lei lam thil ngaihtuahte zaw atawpna uh siatna ahi a, apathian uh agilpi uh ahi a, athupina uh leng adaina uh ahi.
english: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

paite: I khua-le-tui hihna uh zaw van ah ahi zaw a; huai a kipan mah in Toupa Jesu Khrist hondampa i ngak uhi.
english: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,

paite: I pumpi thulim lou amah thupina pumpi toh kibang ding in, ahon bawlthaksak ding a, thil bangkim ama thuthu a a-omsak theihna thilhihtheihna in.
english: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.

paite: Huaiziak in ka unau it leh ngaih, ka kipahna leh ka lallukhute aw, Toupa ah kiptak in dingh un, ka itte aw.
english: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.

paite: Toupa a lungsim kibang pu ding in Euodia ka thuhilh a, Sintikhe ka thuhilh hi.
english: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.

paite: Ahi, nou leng ka hon ngen ahi, hakkol puakpih muanhuaite, tanchinhoih a ka na seppih hiai numeite, Klemen leh ka naseppih dangte hinna bu a min tuangte leng na panpih un.
english: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.

paite: Toupa ah kipak gige un; ka chi nawn ding hi kipak un.
english: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

paite: Na migitna uh mi tengteng kiang ah kithei hen, Toupa anai hi.
english: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

paite: Bangmah lou ah mangbang kei un; himahleh thil bangkim ah, thumna leh ngetna, kipahthu genna toh na ngetnate uh Pathian kiang ah theihsak in om hen.
english: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

paite: Huchi in Pathian muanna, lungsim himhim a theih zoh vual louh in Khrist Jesu ah na lungtang leh na ngaihtuahnate uh ahon kepsak ngeingei ding hi.
english: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

paite: Atawp pen in unaute aw, thil dik peuhmah, thil phathuai peuhmah, thil kilawm peuhmah, thil siangthou peuhmah, thil hoih peuhmah, thil minhoih peuhmah, hoihna himhim a-om a, phatna ding a-omleh huai thilte ngaihtuah un.
english: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.

paite: Kei a pan na zilkhiakte, tante, zakte leh na muhte uh, huai thilte hih un. Huchi in muanna Pathian na kiang uah a-om ding hi.
english: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.

paite: Himahleh nakpitak in Toupa ah ka kipak hi, huchi a tua kei na hon awlmohna uh athak nawn ziak in; na hon limsak mahmah ua, himahleh hun kizen na nei kei ua ahi.
english: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

paite: Taksap ziak a hiai thu gen ka hi kei; bangchibang in om mah leng huai a lungkim a omdan ka theikheta hi.
english: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

paite: Zawndan ka siam a, hauhdan leng ka siam, mun chih leh thil tengteng a gilvah leh gilkial a omtheihna leh niang leh tasam a omtheihna thuguk ka theikheta hi.
english: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

paite: Ahon hihhatpa Khrist ah thil tengteng ka hihthei hi.
english: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

paite: Huchi a ka mangbatna a na hon panpih ziak un na hihhoih mahmah uhi.
english: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

paite: Nou mahmah, nou Philippite ngei in leng tanchinhoih om tung a kipat, Masidonia gam a kipan a ka pai nung, nou chih louh saptuam dang kuamah in piak leh muh lam ah ahon pe kei uh chih na thei uhi.
english: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.

paite: Thessalonika ah ka taksap awng na hon huksakta uhi.
english: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.

paite: Thilpiak ka zon ziak ahi kei a, nou a ding a gahpung zong ka hi zaw hi.
english: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

paite: Ahimhim in thil bangkim ka nei a, ka hau a; hihdim in ka om a, noumau a pan bangbang hiam, gimnamtui, kithoihna hoih, Pathian kipaksak, Epaphroditas a kipan in ka na mu hi.
english: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.

paite: Huai chiang in ka Pathian in Khrist Jesu thupina ahauhna bang in na taksap tengteng uh ahon pe ngeingei ding hi. hi.
english: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

paite: Tu in Pathian leh i Pa uh kiang ah tangtawn, tangtawn in thupina om hen, Amen.
english: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

paite: Khrist Jesu a misiangthou tengteng chibai hon buksak un. Ka kiang a unau omte'n leng chibai ahon buk uhi.
english: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

paite: Misiangthou tengteng in chibai ahon buk uhi, Kaisar inkuanpihte ahi deuh tuam uhi.
english: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.

paite: Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna in hon ompih hen, Amen.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

paite: Paul, Khrist Jesu hentapa leh i unaupa Timothi in, ka deihtak leh ka sepgimpih uh Philemon kiang leh,
english: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,

paite: ka sanggamnu uh Apphia kiang ah, ka sepaihpih uh Arkippas kiang leh na inn a saptuam kikhawmte kiang ah leng:
english: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:

paite: Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Ka thumnate ah na min lou gige in, ka Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen hi.
english: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,

paite: Toupa Jesu lam leh misiangthou tengteng lam a itna leh ginna na neih za in.
english: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,

paite: Na ginna kikoppihna, noumau a om thil hoih chiteng theihkimna lam ah Khrist lam a ahong phattuam theihna ding in.
english: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.

paite: Unaupa aw, nangmah ziak a misiangthoute lungtang ahong halh tak ziak in na itna ah ka kipak in ka kha amuang mahmah hi.
english: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.

paite: Huaiziak in akilawm hun hih ding in nang thu hon piak Khrist ah kingap mah leng,
english: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,

paite: itna ziak in, Paul putek hial hita leh, tu a Khrist Jesu hentapa hita in, anget in ka hon ngen zaw hi.
english: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

paite: Ka ta Onesimas, kolbun kawm a ka neihkhiak, amah a ding in na kiang ah ka ngetsak hi.
english: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,

paite: Tuma lam in nang a ding in aphatuam kei a, tu'n zaw kei leh nang a ding in aphatuamta hi.
english: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.

paite: Amah, ka lungtang mahmah na kiang ah ka hon sawlkik nawn hi.
english: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,

paite: Amah tanchinhoih a ka kolbutna a nangmah sik a nna ahon sepsak theihna ding in ka kiang a omsak nilouh ka ut mahmah hi.
english: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.

paite: Himahleh na hehpihna hehpihsak teitei bang hilou in, na thu bang ahihtheih zawkna ding in, na thu lou in bangmah hih ka ut kei hi.
english: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.

paite: Sawt lou kal nang ahon khen tangtawn a amah na neih tawntungna ding ziak ahi kha mai ding hi,
english: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,

paite: himahleh sikha bang hi nawn lou a, sikha sang a hoih unau deihtak bang zaw in; kei a ding in deihtak ahi diak a, nang a ding ngial in sa leh Toupa ah nak hihna in chia!
english: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

paite: Huchi in lawm a na hon simleh keimah bang in amah na kipahpih in.
english: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.

paite: Huan na tung a banghiam ahihkhelh a, na thil banghiam abatleh keimah bat in bawl in.
english: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.

paite: Kei Paul in, keimah khut ngei a ka gelh ahi. Keimah in ka ditsak ding hi; ka kiang a nangma'n leng bat na neih sam dan hon hilh bel ka hi kei hi.
english: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).

paite: Ahi, unaupa aw, nangmah ziak in Toupa ah kipahna hon neisak inla, Khrist ah leng ka lungtang hihhalh in.
english: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.

paite: Ka gen sang a thupizaw tham in na hih ding chih ka theih ziak in, na hon thuman ding chih muang in na kiang ah ka gelh ahi.
english: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.

paite: Akoi abang hitaleh, huai kia hih lou in, tunna ding hon na suktuahsak in; na thumnate uh ziak in na kiang ua piak ka hi ding chih ka kigingta hi.
english: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

paite: Epaphras, Khrist Jesu a ka hentakpihpa'n chibai ahon buk hi;
english: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

paite: huchi mah bang in ka seppih Marka, Aristarkhas, Demas leh Lukate'n leng chibai ahon buk uhi.
english: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na kha uah om hen, Amen.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

paite: Israel kumpipa, David tapa Solomon paunakte.
english: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:

paite: Pilna leh hilhna theihna ding; theihsiamna thute theihkakna ding;
english: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;

paite: thilhih pilhuai a hilhna mu ding, diktatna, vaihawm leh hawmsiamna ah;
english: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;

paite: mimawlte kiang a kivensiamna pe ding, tangval kiang a theihna leh ngentelna.
english: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—

paite: Mipil in azak theih a, sinsiamna a apuntheihna ding in; theisiammi in thuphate aphaktheihna ding;
english: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;

paite: Paunak leh lim a thugen theisiam ding; mipilte thute, gentehna thugen theihhakte theisiam ding in.
english: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.

paite: TOUPA kihtak theihna kipatna ahi; himahleh mihai in pilna leh hilhna amusit.
english: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

paite: Ka tapa, na pa hilhna za in, na nu dan mangngilh ke'n;
english: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;
