paite: na lu a ding in deihhuai lutang zem leh na ngawng vial ding khainiangte hi ding ahi ngal a.
english: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.

paite: Ka tapa, mikhialte'n ahon zol ualeh, pha sakpih ke'n.
english: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.

paite: Hon zui in, sisan i buk ding ua, aziak bei in mihoihte aguk in i tang ding uh, achih uleh;
english: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lie in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.

paite: Sheol bang in amaute ahing in i nawmvalh ding ua, huan, kokhuk sung a paisukte bang in,
english: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.

paite: apum in van manpha tengteng i mu ding ua, gallakte in i innte uh i dimsak ding uh;
english: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.

paite: na tan kou lak ah na seplut ding a; sumbawm khat i neikhawm ding ua;
english: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse”—

paite: ka tapa, lampi ah amau toh ton ke'n; alampi ua kipan na khe kaikik in;
english: my son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,

paite: gilou hih ding in akhe uh atai ngal a, huan sisan suah ding in akinoh uhi.
english: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.

paite: Vasa himhim mitmuh in, len akiphah thawn ngal a,
english: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;

paite: huan hiaite'n amau sisan ngei atang ua, amau hinna ngei aguk in abuk uhi.
english: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.

paite: Huchibang tuh michih punna a duhgawlte lampi ahi a; huai in aneitute hinna alakmangsak sek hi.
english: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.

paite: Kongzing ah ngaihtak in pilna akikou a; mun liante ah a-aw asuah a;
english: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.

paite: mipi omkhawmte munpipen ah akikou a; kongpite lutna ah, khopi ah, athute agen.
english: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:

paite: Bang tan ahia, nou mimawlte'n, mawlna na it ding uh? Nuihsan mite'n nuihsan a amaute akipah ding ua, mihaite'n theihna ahuat ding uh?
english: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?

paite: Ka salhna ah kihei unla; ngai in na tung uah ka kha ka sungbo ding, na kiang uah ka thute ka theisak ding hi.
english: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.

paite: Ka sap a, na nial ziak un; ka bante ka zak a, kuamah in alimsak kei uh.
english: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;

paite: Himahleh ka thupha tengteng bangmah lou in na koih ua, ka salhnate bangmah na deih kei uhi.
english: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;

paite: Ke'n leng na tuahsiat ni un ka hon nuihsan dia; na launa uh ahong tun chiang in ka hon chiamnuih ding;
english: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,

paite: huihpi bang a na launa uh ahong tun chiang in; pingpei bang a na tuahsiatna uh ahong tun chiang in; lungkhamna leh dahna na tung ua ahong tun chiang in.
english: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.

paite: Huai hun chiang in kei ahon sam ding ua, himahleh ka dawng kei ding; thanuamtak in ahon zong ding ua, himahleh ahon mu kei ding uh.
english: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me,

paite: Theihna ahuat ua, TOUPA kihtakna azon louh ziak un,
english: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of Yahweh.

paite: ka thupha lak ah bangmah adeih kei ua; ka salhna tengteng amusit uhi.
english: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.

paite: Huaiziak in alampi uh gah ane ding ua, amau thusawmte ngei in avah ding uhi.
english: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.

paite: Mimawlte nungtolhna in amaute athat dia, mihaite hauhsakna in amaute hihmang ding ahih ziak in.
english: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.

paite: Himahleh kuapeuh kei hon ngaikhia bittak in ateng ding ua, gilou launa pang lou in amuang ding uhi.
english: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”

paite: Solomon paunakte. Tapa pil in pa kipak abawl a; himahleh tapa hai anu gikna ahi.
english: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

paite: Gitlouhna sumte'n bangmah aloh tak kei; himahleh diktatna in sihna a kipan atankhia hi.
english: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.

paite: TOUPA'N midiktat kialsih aphal kei ding; himahleh migilou a kipan atankhia hi.
english: Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.

paite: Khut ze-ol mi ahong genthei a; himahleh mithanuam khut in hauhsakna abawl hi.
english: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.

paite: Nipi lai a lakhawmpa tapa pil ahi; himahleh pawltak hun a ihmu zumhuai omsak tapa ahi.
english: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

paite: Midiktat lutung ah vualzawlnate a-om a; himahleh gilou kam hiamgamna in atuam hi.
english: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

paite: Midik theihgigena anuam a; himahleh migilou min amuat mang ding.
english: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.

paite: Lungtang pil in thupiakte asang ding a; himahleh mihai haiham apuk ding.
english: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.

paite: Tangtak a pai hoihtak in apai a; himahleh alampite kilawmlousak theih in a-om ding hi.
english: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.

paite: Amit a chiamtehna bawl in lungkhamna a-omsak a; himahleh mihai haiham apuk ding.
english: One who winks with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.

paite: Midiktat kam hinna tuikhuk ahi; himahleh hiamgamna in gilou kam atuam hi.
english: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

paite: Huatna in kidouna atokthou a, himahleh itna in tatlekna tengteng akhuh hi.
english: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.

paite: Theihkak theihna neimi muk ah pilna muh in a-om; himahleh chiang theihsiamna neiloumi nungzang a ding ahi.
english: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.

paite: Mipilte'n theihna akholkhawm ua; himahleh mihai kam in siatna anaih.
english: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.

paite: Mihausa hauhsakna akhopi muanhuai ahi; migenthei siatna agentheih uh ahi.
english: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

paite: Midiktat sepgimna in hinna azuan a; gilou punna in khelhna lam.
english: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.

paite: Bawlhoihna limsak hinna lampi ah a-om a; himahleh salhna don lou apaikhial hi.
english: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.

paite: Huatna sel zuauthei mukte a kipan ahi a; huan migensiatna gen mihai ahi.
english: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.

paite: Thu tampite ah tatlekna a-om lou kei a; himahleh amukte thuzoh in piltak in ahih hi.
english: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.

paite: Midiktat lei dangka hoihpen bang ahi; migilou lungtang athamatna neuchik ahi.
english: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.

paite: Midiktat mukte'n mi tampi avak a; himahleh mihaite theihsiamna taksap ziak in asi uh.
english: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.

paite: TOUPA vualzawlna in hauhsakna abawl a, huan huai ah lungkhamna abehlap kei hi.
english: Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

paite: Mihai a ding in gitlouhna hih kisukhalhna bang ahi; huchibang in theisiammi a ding in pilna ahi.
english: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.

paite: Migilou launa, amah tung ah ahong tung ding; midiktat deihna phal in a-om ding hi.
english: What the wicked fear will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.

paite: Pingpei alenmang bang in, migilou a-om nawn kei; himahleh midiktat tangtawn suangphum ahi.
english: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.

paite: Zu thuk in ha asuksiat bang in meikhu in mit asusia a, huchibang mah in amah sawlte a ding in mi zongzaw a-om hi.
english: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.

paite: TOUPA kihtak in nite asausak a, himahleh migilou kumte hihtom ahi ding.
english: The fear of Yahweh prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

paite: Midiktat lametna kipahna ahi ding, himahleh migilou lametna amangthang ding.
english: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.

paite: TOUPA lampi a mitangte a ding in kulh muanhuai ahi; himahleh migilou nasem mite a ding in siatna ahi.
english: The way of Yahweh is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

paite: Midiktat suankhiak ahi ngei kei ding; himahleh gamsung ah migilou ateng kei ding hi.
english: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.

paite: Midiktat kam in pilna ahon tun a; himahleh lei gina lou satkhiak in a-om ding.
english: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.

paite: Midiktat mukte'n lak tuak bang ahia athei a, himahleh migilou kam in ginatlouhna agen hi.
english: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.

paite: TOUPA a ding in bukna diklou kihhuai ahi, himahleh gikdan dik akipahpih lam ahi.
english: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.

paite: Kisaktheihna ahong pai chiang in, zumna ahong pai; himahleh mikiniamkhiakte kiang ah pilna a-om hi.
english: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.

paite: Mitangte dikna in amau api ding, himahleh milepchiahte hoihlouhna in amau ahihse ding hi.
english: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.

paite: Thangpaih ni in hauhsak aphatuam kei, himahleh diktatna in sihna a kipan ahunkhia hi.
english: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

paite: Mihoihkim diktatna in alampi aseksak dia; himahleh migilou agitlouhna ah apuk ding hi.
english: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

paite: Mitangte diktatna in amau asuaktasak; himahleh lepchiahtak a hihte amau poikhoihna a lak in a-om ding uhi.
english: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.

paite: Migilou asih chiang in alametna amangthang ding; huan thulimlouhna lametna amangthang hi.
english: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.

paite: Midiktat buaina lak a kipan suahtaksak in a-om a, amun ah migilou ahong pai hi.
english: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.

paite: Akam a Pathian limsak lou mi'n a-inveng ahihsia a; himahleh theihna ziak in midiktat suahtaksak in a-om hi.
english: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.

paite: Midiktat alamzan chiang in, khopi akipak a; gilou amanthat chiang in, kikouna a-om hi.
english: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.

paite: Mitang vualzawlna ziak in khopi tawisang in a-om; himahleh migilou kam a hihsiat in a-om hi.
english: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

paite: Kuapeuh a-inveng musit pilna bei ahi; himahleh theisiammi adai dide hi.
english: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.

paite: Tangthu genmi bang a vialvak in thuguk ataklang; himahleh lungsim muanhuai in thu a-im hi.
english: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.

paite: Kipina pil omlouhna mun ah mite apuk ua; himahleh thupha gen tampi omna ah bitna a-om hi.
english: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

paite: Kuapeuh mikhual a dia amoh khu dia dingh in na asa ding, himahleh moh khu dia dinna hua amuang hi.
english: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.

paite: Numei deihhuai in zahtakhuaina anei gige; huan pasal hatte'n hauhsakna anei gige hi.
english: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.

paite: Michingthei in amah kha a ding in ahihhoih a; himahleh migilou in ama sa ahihbuai hi.
english: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.

paite: Migilou in loh gina sang lou a; himahleh diktatna tuh in kipahman muan anei hi.
english: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

paite: Kuapeuh diktatna a dingkip in hinna atungding; huan kuapeuh gilou delh in ama sihna ding in ahih ahi.
english: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.

paite: Alungtang ua hoihloute TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi ua; himahleh alampi ua hoihkimte akipahna ahi.
english: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to Yahweh, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.

paite: Khut kilen mah le uh, migilou gawt louh in a-om kei ding; himahleh diktat chi suahtaksak in a-om ding hi.
english: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.

paite: Vok nak sung a dangka-eng suang bang in, huchibang in numei melhoih ngentelna nei lou ahi.
english: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.

paite: Midiktat deihlam hoih kia ahi a; himahleh migilou lametna thangpaihna ahi.
english: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.

paite: Athehzak a-om a, apung semsem hi; akilawm kheng a it a-om a, himahleh taksap lam amanoh lel hi.
english: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.

paite: Misiam thausak in a-om ding, huan kuapeuh tuibuak amah leng tui buah in a-om ding hi.
english: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

paite: Kuapeuh buh-le-bal it, mite'n amah ahamsiat ding uh; himahleh kuapeuh azuaktu luzang ah vualzawlna a-om ding hi.
english: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.

paite: Kuapeuh hoih thanuamtak a zong in deihsakna azong; himahleh kuapeuh siatna zong, amah tung ah ahong tung ding hi.
english: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.

paite: Kuapeuh ahauhsakna muang apuk ding; himahleh nah hing bang in midiktat alun ding hi.
english: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.

paite: Kuapeuh ama inn hihbuai in huih aluah ding; huan mihai lungtang pil sikha in a-om ding hi.
english: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.

paite: Midiktat gah hinna sing ahi; kuapeuh apil in khate aman hi.
english: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.

paite: Ngai in, midiktatte lei ah thuk in a-om ding. Migilou leh mikhial kinak thuksem na'n chia!
english: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid on the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!

paite: Kuapeuh bawlhoihna it in theihna a-it hi; himahleh kuapeuh salhna hua ahai ahi.
english: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.

paite: Mihoih in TOUPA deihsakna atang ding; himahleh gitlouhna ngaihtuah mipa moh atangsak ding.
english: A good man shall obtain favor from Yahweh, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.

paite: Gitlouhna in mi aphutkip kei ding; himahleh diktatna zung akisuan ngei kei ding.
english: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

paite: Numei hoih apasal a ding in lallukhu ahi; himahleh zumhuai bawlnu aguhte ah muatna bang ahi.
english: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.

paite: Midiktat ngaihtuahna adik a; himahleh migilou thute khemna ahi.
english: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.

paite: Migilou thute sisan suah dia bukna ahi a; himahleh mitang kam in amau asuaktasak ding hi.
english: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.

paite: Migiloute zoh in a-om ua, a-om nawnta kei uh; himahleh midiktatte inn bel adingh ding hi.
english: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.

paite: Mihing apilna bangbang a phat in a-om ding; himahleh kuapeuh lungtang hoih lou muhsit in a-om ding hi.
english: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.

paite: Kuapeuh amah kingai thupi a, tanghou neiloumi sang in kuapeuh zahtak zek a om a sikha neimi ahoihzaw.
english: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself and lacks bread.

paite: Midiktat in agan hinna alimsak hi, himahleh migilou zahngaihna nemte akhel mahmah hi.
english: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

paite: Kuapeuh agam lei let in tanghou tampi anei ding, himahleh mi bangmah lou nungdelhmi theihsiamna bei ahi.
english: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.

paite: Migilou in migiloute len adeih a, himahleh midiktatte zung in gah asuang hi.
english: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.

paite: Mukte tatlekna ah migilou a ding in thang a-om a, himahleh buaina a kipan midiktat ahong paikhe ding.
english: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.

paite: Amuk gah in mihoih tai in a-om ding a; huan mihing khut a hihte akiang a piak ahi ding.
english: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.

paite: Mihai lampi amah mit ah adik a; himahleh kuapeuh apil in thupha angaikhia hi.
english: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.

paite: Mihai buaina tu mahmah a theih ahi; himahleh mipilvang in zahlakna asel hi.
english: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.

paite: Kuapeuh thutak gen in diktatna a-ensak a, himahleh palai zuau in khemna.
english: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.

paite: Namsau sut bang a pilvang loutak a pau a-om a; himahleh mipil lei damna ahi.
english: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.

paite: Thutak lei tangtawn in hihkip in a-om ding; himahleh lei zuauthei zaw mitphiat kal khat a ding lel ahi.
english: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.

paite: Gilou thilgelte lungtang ah khemna a-om; himahleh lemna thupha gente kiang ah nopna a-om hi.
english: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.

paite: Midiktatte tung ah siatna ahong tung kei dia; himahleh migilou, gilou in adim ding.
english: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.

paite: Muk zuautheite TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi; himahleh diktak a hihte akipahna ahi uh.
english: Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh, but those who do the truth are his delight.

paite: Mipilvang in theihna asel a; himahleh mihai lungtang in haina apuangkhia.
english: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.

paite: Mithanuam khut in vaihawmna apo dia; himahleh mithadah khut phutluih nna sepsak ahi ding hi.
english: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.

paite: Lungtang gikna in mi akunsak a; himahleh thuhoih in akipaksak hi.
english: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.

paite: Midiktat a-inveng a ding in pitu ahi a; himahleh migilou lampi in amaute a paikhialsak hi.
english: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

paite: Mithadah in agamvakna a amatsa nangawn a-em ngap kei a; himahleh mithanuam vanneihte amanpha hi.
english: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.

paite: Diktatna lampi ah hinna a-om; huai alampi ah sihna a-om kei hi.
english: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.

paite: Tapa pil in apa hilhna aza a; himahleh musitmi in asalhna aza kei hi.
english: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.

paite: Mi'n akam gah in hoih ane ding hi; himahleh lepchiahmi kha in hiamgamna ane ding hi.
english: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.

paite: Kuapeuh akam veng in ahinna avom a; himahleh kuapeuh amukte hong za in siatna anei ding hi.
english: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.

paite: Thadah kha in adeih a, bangmah anei kei; himahleh thanuam kha thausak in a-om ding hi.
english: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.

paite: Midiktat in zuau ahua; himahleh migilou huathuai ahi a, zumna atung sek hi.
english: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.

paite: Lampi a mitang amah diktatna in aveng; himahleh gitlouhna in mikhial aman hi.
english: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

paite: Amah leh amah hausa a kibawl a-om, himahleh bangmah anei kei; amah-le-amah genthei a kibawl a-om, himahleh hauhsakna thupi anei hi.
english: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.

paite: Mihing hinna tat man ahauhsakna ahi; himahleh genthei in vaulauna aza kei hi.
english: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.

paite: Midiktat vakna akipak a; himahleh migilou khawnvak akithat ding.
english: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

paite: Kisaktheih ziak in kiselna kia ahong a; himahleh hoihtak a thuhilh pilna ahi.
english: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.

paite: Bangmah lou a hauhsakna muh akiam ding; himahleh sepgimna ziak a lakkhawm apung ding hi.
english: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.

paite: Lametna halsawt in lungtang achinasak a; himahleh deih ahong tun chiang in, hinna sing ahi.
english: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.

paite: Kuapeuh thu musit in atung ah asiatna atun hi; himahleh kuapeuh thupiak kihta kipahman piak in a-om ding.
english: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.

paite: Mipil dan hinna tuikhuk ahi, sihna thangte a kipan a paimangna ding.
english: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.

paite: Theihsiamna hoih in deihsakna apia a; himahleh lepchiahmi lampi aphok hi.
english: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

paite: Mipilvang peuhmah in theihna toh in nna asem a; himahleh mihai in diklouhna athehzak.
english: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.

paite: Sawltak gilou hoih lou ah apuk a; himahleh palai muanhuai damna ahi.
english: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.

paite: Gentheihna leh zumna bawlhoihna nial kiang ah a-om dia; himahleh salhna limsak zahtak in a-om ding.
english: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.

paite: Deih hihpichin kha a ding in anuam a; himahleh gilou a kipan paimang mihaite a ding in kihhuai ahi.
english: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.

paite: Mipilte toh ton in, huchi in na pil ding; himahleh mihaite kithuahpih in huaiziak in athuak ding.
english: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

paite: Hoih lou in mikhialte adelh a; himahleh midiktat hoih a thuk in a-om ding hi.
english: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.

paite: Mihoih in gouluah ata leh tute kiang ah anutsiat; mikhial hauhsakna midiktat a dia kholkhawm in a-om hi.
english: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.

paite: Genthei loukhohna ah an tampi a-om; himahleh diklouhna ziak a suksiat a-om hi.
english: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.

paite: Kuapeuh chiang zang lou in atapa amudah a; himahleh amah it in amah thanuamtak in asawi zel hi.
english: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.

paite: Midiktat in akha lungkimna tan in ane a; himahleh migilou gilpi atasam ding.
english: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.

paite: Numei pil in innte alam a; himahleh mihai in amah khut in aphelsia.
english: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.

paite: Atang a gamtami in TOUPA akihta a; himahleh alampite a hoih lou in amah amusit hi.
english: He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.

paite: Mihai kam ah kisaktheihna chiang a-om; himahleh mipil mukte'n huaite ahawi ding hi.
english: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.

paite: Bawngtalte omlouhna ah, anpiakna kuang asiang a; himahleh bawngtal hatna ziak in nakpi a punna a-om hi.
english: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

paite: Theihpih ginom in zuau agen kei ding; himahleh theihpih zuauthei in zuau agen hi.
english: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.

paite: Musitmi in pilna azong a, amu kei hi; himahleh theihsiamna nei a ding in theihna abaih hi.
english: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.

paite: Mihai a-omna ah lut in, amah ah theihna mukte na mu kei ding hi.
english: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.

paite: Mipilvang pilna a lampi theihsiam ahi a; himahleh mihaite haina khemna ahi.
english: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.

paite: Mihai in khelhna achiamnuihbawl a; himahleh mitangte lak ah deihsakna a-om hi.
english: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.

paite: Lungtang in amah khatna athei a; huan mikhual in anopsakna atokbuai kei hi.
english: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.

paite: Migiloute inn suksiat in a-om ding; himahleh mitang biakbuk apha ding hi.
english: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.

paite: Mihing a dia lampi dik a kilawm a-om a, himahleh huai tawpna sihna lampite ahi.
english: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

paite: Lungtang nuihna nangawn lungkhamna ahi a; huan vualnopna tawpna gikna ahi.
english: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.

paite: Lungtang a nungtolhmi amah lampite a dimsak in a-om ding; huan mihoih amah mah a kipan a hihlungkim in a-om ding hi.
english: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.

paite: Mimawl in thu chih a-um a; himahleh mipilvang in apaina hoihtak in a-en hi.
english: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

paite: Mipil in akihta a, gilou a kipan apaimang; himahleh mihai bel ngottat in, akimuang hi.
english: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.

paite: Kuapeuh hehbaih haitak in agamta ding; huan ngaihtuah giloumi huat in a-om hi.
english: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.

paite: Mimawl in haina aluah ding; himahleh mipilvang theihna khuksak in a-om ding.
english: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

paite: Hoih mai ah hoih lou akun a; huan diktat kongpite ah gilou akun hi.
english: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

paite: Genthei amah inveng mahmah muhdah in a-om; himahleh hausa in lawm tampi anei hi.
english: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.

paite: A-inveng musit in thil ahihkhial a; himahleh migenthei hehpih, ama'n nuam asa hi.
english: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.

paite: Hoih lou ngaihtuahte apaikhial kei uh maw? Himahleh zahngaihna leh thutak hoih ngaihtuah kiang ah a-om ding hi.
english: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.

paite: Sepgimna tengteng ah phattuamna a-om; himahleh mukte houlimna taksapna lam kia ah apai hi.
english: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.

paite: Mipilte ahauhsakna ua theih in a-om uhi; himahleh mihaite ahaina ua theih in a-om uhi.
english: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.

paite: Theihpih dik in khate asuaktasak a; himahleh zuaugen in khemna a-omsak hi.
english: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.

paite: TOUPA kihtakna ah muanna hat a-om a; huan atate'n bukna mun anei ding uh.
english: In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.

paite: TOUPA kihtak hinna tuikhuk ahi, sihna thangte a kipan paimangna ding in.
english: The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.

paite: Mipi tamna ah kumpipa thupina a-om; himahleh mipite omlouhna lal siatna ahi.
english: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.

paite: Kuapeuh ahehhak theihsiamna thupi a kipan ahi; himahleh kuapeuh lungtom in haina atawisang hi.
english: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.

paite: Lungtang hoih taksa a dia hinna ahi; himahleh hazatna guhte muatna ahi.
english: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.

paite: Kuapeuh genthei nuaisiah in abawlpa simmoh ahi; himahleh kuapeuh tasam tung a zahngaihna nei in amah azahtak hi.
english: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.

paite: Migilou agitlouh hihna a paihlut in a-om a; himahleh midiktat in asihna ah lametna anei hi.
english: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.

paite: Theihsiamna nei lungtang ah pilna akhawl a; himahleh mihaite sunglam pang a om kitheihsak in a-om hi.
english: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.

paite: Diktatna in nam atawisang a; himahleh khelhna mi kuapeuh a ding in zahlakna ahi.
english: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.

paite: Sikha piltak a gamta kiang ah kumpipa deihsakna a-om a; himahleh zumna omsak tung ah athangpaihna a-om hi.
english: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.

paite: Dawnna nem in thangpaihna aheimang a; himahleh thusia in hehna atokthou hi.
english: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

paite: Mipil lei in theihna agen dik a; himahleh mihaite kam in haina asungkhia hi.
english: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly.

paite: TOUPA mitte mun chiteng ah a-om a, hoih lou leh hoih veng gige in.
english: Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.

paite: Lei damthei hinna sing ahi; himahleh huai a kilawmlouhna kha sukkhapna ahi.
english: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.

paite: Mihai in apa bawlhoihna amusit a; himahleh kuapeuh salhna limsak in pilvanna amu hi.
english: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.

paite: Midiktat inn ah gou tampi a-om; himahleh migilou summuhna buaina ahi.
english: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.

paite: Mipil mukte'n theihna aphalh a; himahleh mihai lungtang in huchibang in ahih kei hi.
english: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.

paite: Migilou kithoihna TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi; himahleh mitang thumna akipahna ahi.
english: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

paite: Migilou lampi TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi; himahleh kuapeuh diktatna zui a-it hi.
english: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.

paite: Lampi mangngilhmi a ding in bawlhoihna haksatak a-om a; huan kuapeuh taihilhna mudah asi ding hi.
english: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way. Whoever hates reproof shall die.

paite: Sheol leh Abaddon TOUPA ma ah a-om uh; mite tate lungtangte bangzah phet in atamzaw diam aw?
english: Sheol and Abaddon are before Yahweh— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!

paite: Musitmi'n salh a om nuam asa kei; mipil kiang azuan kei ding hi.
english: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.

paite: Lungtang nuam in mel kipak abawl a; himahleh lungtang dahna ziak in lungsim apuakkham hi.
english: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.

paite: Theihsiamna nei lungtang in theihna azong; himahleh mihaite kam haina in akivak hi.
english: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.

paite: Gimthuak nite tengteng hoih lou ahi; himahleh kuapeuh lungtang kipak in ankuangluina anei gige hi.
english: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.

paite: TOUPA launa toh tawmchik ahoihzaw, huai agou thupi leh buaina sang in.
english: Better is little, with the fear of Yahweh, than great treasure with trouble.

paite: Itna omna a anteh-louhing nek ding ahoihzaw, bawngtal thau leh huai a muhdahna sang in.
english: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.

paite: Mithangpai in kinialna atokthou a; himahleh kuapeuh heh hak in kinakna adamsak hi.
english: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.

paite: Thadah lampi ling daikalh bang ahi; himahleh mitang lampi lamlian abawl ahi.
english: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.

paite: Tapa pil in pa kipak abawl a; himahleh mihai in anu amusit hi.
english: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.

paite: Pilna bei a ding in haina nopsakna ahi; himahleh theisiammi in apaina atangsak hi.
english: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.

paite: Thupha omlouhna ah, thiltupte avuaksuak; himahleh thupha gen tamna ah hihkip in a-om uh.
english: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.

paite: Akam a dawnna ah mi'n nopsakna anei; huan ahuntak a thugen hoih hi na mah e.
english: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!

paite: Mipil a ding in hinna lampi apaitou a, nuailam a Sheol a kipan apaimang theihna ding in.
english: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.

paite: TOUPA'N kisathei inn azungkalhkhiak ding; himahleh meithai gamgi ahihkip ding.
english: Yahweh will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.

paite: TOUPA a ding in lunggel giloute akihhuai a; himahleh lungsim siangthoute thugen ama kipah lam ahi.
english: Yahweh detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.

paite: Punna a duhgawl in ama inn ahihbuai a; himahleh kuapeuh thilpiak hua ahing ding.
english: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.

paite: Midiktat lungtang in dawng ding in akisin a; himahleh migilou kam in thil hoih lou asungkhia hi.
english: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.

paite: Migilou a kipan gamla ah TOUPA a-om a; himahleh midiktat thumna aza hi.
english: Yahweh is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

paite: Mitte vakna in lungtang akipaksak a; huan tanchinhoih in guhte athausak hi.
english: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.

paite: Hinna taihilhnate ngaikhia bil mipilte lak ah a-om gige ding.
english: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.

paite: Kuapeuh bawlhoihna nial in amah kha amusit ahi; himahleh kuapeuh taihilhna ngaikhia in theihsiamna amu hi.
english: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.

paite: TOUPA kihtak pilna thuhilhna ahi; huan zahtakna ma ah kiniamkhiakna apai hi.
english: The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.

paite: Lungtang kisakkholna mihing a ahi; himahleh lei dawnna TOUPA a kipan ahi.
english: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.

paite: Mihing lampi tengteng ama mit ah asiang a; himahleh TOUPA'N khate abuk zel hi.
english: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but Yahweh weighs the motives.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah na nasepte kemsak inla, huan na ngaihtuahnate hihkip in a-om ding hi.
english: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.

paite: TOUPA'N thil chiteng aziak nei in abawlta; ahi, gilou nangawn gilou ni a ding in.
english: Yahweh has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.

paite: Michih lungtang kisathei TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi; thei in, gawt louh in a-om kei ding hi.
english: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh; they shall certainly not be unpunished.

paite: Zahngaihna leh thutak in thulimlouhna suksiang ahi; huan TOUPA kihtakna in mite hoih lou a kipan apaimang uhi.
english: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.

paite: Mihing lampite'n TOUPA asuk lungkim chiang in, amelmate nangawn amah toh kilem in abawl hi.
english: When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

paite: Diktatna toh tawmchik ahoihzaw, diklouhna toh summuhna thupi sang in.
english: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.

paite: Mihing lungtang in alampi angaihtuah a; himahleh TOUPA'N akalsuante abawlsak hi.
english: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.

paite: Kumpipa muk ah Pathian thu a-om; akam in vaihawmnate ah atalek kei ding hi.
english: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.

paite: Bukna dik leh tehna dik TOUPA a ahi uh; ip gikna tengteng anasep ahi.
english: Honest balances and scales are Yahweh’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.

paite: Kumpipate a ding in gilou hih kihhuai ahi; laltutphah lah diktatna a hihkip ahi ngal a.
english: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.

paite: Muk diktatte kumpipate kipahna ahi; huan thudik gente a-it uhi.
english: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.

paite: Kumpipa thangpaihna sihna sawltakte bang ahi; himahleh mipil in ahih lungdam ding hi.
english: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.

paite: Kumpipa melvakna ah hinna a-om; huan adeihsakna vuah nanung meipi bang ahi.
english: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.

paite: Pilna muh dangka-eng sang in nak hoih zawk hi na e; ahi, theihsiamna muh dangka sang a tel zawk ding ahi.
english: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.

paite: Mitang lamlian hoih lou a kipan a paimang ahi; kuapeuh alampi kem in akha ahawi hi.
english: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.

paite: Siatna ma ah kisaktheihna apai a, huan lungsim ki-uangsak pukna ma ah.
english: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.

paite: Gentheite toh lungsim niamkhiak a om ahoihzaw, kisathei toh gallak hawm sang in.
english: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.

paite: Kuapeuh thu limsak in hoih amu ding; huan kuapeuh TOUPA muang, ama'n nuam asa hi.
english: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in Yahweh is blessed.

paite: Lungtang pil pilvang akichi ding; huan muk khumna in sinsiamna apungsak hi.
english: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.

paite: Theihsiamna neimi a ding in hinna luikhuk ahi; himahleh mihaite bawlhoihna ahaina uh ahi.
english: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.

paite: Mipil lungtang in akam ahilh a, huan amuk ah sinsiamna abehlap hi.
english: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.

paite: Thu kipahhuai khuaizu bang ahi, kha a dia khum, guhte a dia damna.
english: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

paite: Mihing a dia dik hileh kilawm lampi a-om, himahleh huai tawpna sihna lampite ahi.
english: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

paite: Nasem gimmi ankam limna in amah a ding in asemgim a; agilkialna in huai a kipan alunggulh ngal a.
english: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him, for his mouth urges him on.

paite: Mithulim lou in siatna angaihtuah; huan amuk ah meisa bang a-om hi.
english: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.

paite: Miki-uangsak in kinakna athehzak a; huan huauhatmi in lawm bulte akhenzak hi.
english: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.

paite: Hiamgammi in a-invengte akhem a, ahoih lou lam lampi ah api.
english: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.

paite: Kuapeuh amitsik-at in thil hoih lou agel ahi; kuapeuh amuk chih in hoih lou ahon tun nak hi.
english: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.

paite: Samkang zaw thupina lallukhu ahi, diktatna lampi ah muh ahi.
english: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.

paite: Kuapeuh heh hak mihat sang in ahoihzaw; huan kuapeuh alungsim thuzoh khopi lak sang in.
english: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.

paite: Angsung ah ai akisan a; himahleh huai ahihpaisuakna zaw TOUPA a kipan ahi.
english: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from Yahweh.

paite: Kinakna toh a-inn dim a nopbawl sang in tanghou gaw a muanna toh om ahoihzaw.
english: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.

paite: Sikha piltak a hih in tapa zumhuaina omsak tung ah vai ahawm ding, huan unaute lak a goutanna ah tan anei ding hi.
english: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.

paite: Huansianna bel zaw dangka a ding ahi, huan meipi dangka-eng a ding; himahleh TOUPA'N lungtangte a-endik hi.
english: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but Yahweh tests the hearts.

paite: Hoih lou hihmi'n gilou mukte alimsak a; huan zuauhat in siatna lei abildoh hi.
english: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.

paite: Kuapeuh genthei musit in amah Bawlpa asimmoh a; huan kuapeuh tuahsiat ni a kipak gawt louh in a-om kei ding hi.
english: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.

paite: Tate' tate mi upate lallukhu ahi uh; huan tate thupina apate uh ahi.
english: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children is their parents.

paite: Thugen hoih mihai toh akilawm kei; muk zuauthei lal toh akilawm kei sem hi.
english: Excellent speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.

paite: Anei mit ah thilpiak suangmantam bang ahi; koilam peuh a akiheina ah, alohching hi.
english: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.

paite: Kuapeuh tatlekna khuh in itna azong hi; himahleh kuapeuh thubuai a nuamsa in lawmte akhendalh hi.
english: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.

paite: Mihai sung a vuakna zakhat sang in theihsiamna neimi sung ah taina alut thukzaw.
english: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.

paite: Mihoih lou in helna kia azong a; huaiziak in sawltak khel amah dou ding a sawl in a-om ding hi.
english: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

paite: Vompi anoute laksak a om in mi tuak hen, ahaina a mihai sang in.
english: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

paite: Kuapeuh hoih sik a gilou kipahman pia, a-inn a kipan gilou apaimang kei ding.
english: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

paite: Kinakna kipatna mi'n tui akhahkhiak bang ahi; huaiziak in kinakna a-om ma in, kiselna paisan in.
english: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.

paite: Kuapeuh gilou siamtangsak, kuapeuh midiktat mohpaih, amau gel TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi tuaktuak uhi.
english: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.

paite: Huaiziak in pilna lei ding in mihai khut ah aman a-om a hia, theihsiamna anei kei chih thei in?
english: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?

paite: Lawm in chik lai peuh in a-it gige a, huan vangtah ni a ding in unau khat apiang hi.
english: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.

paite: Mi theihsiamna bei in khut abeng a, invengte ma ah moh khu ding in ahong om hi.
english: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.

paite: Kinakna deih in tatlekna adeih hi; kuapeuh akongpi domsang in siatna azong hi.
english: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.

paite: Kuapeuh lungtang sia nei in hoih amu kei; huan siatna ah lei hoih lou nei apuk hi.
english: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.

paite: Kuapeuh mihai suang in alungkhamna ding in asuang; huan mihaipa'n nopsakna anei kei hi.
english: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.

paite: Lungtang nuamsa damdawi hoih ahi; himahleh lungsim puakkham in guhte akeusak.
english: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

paite: Migilou in angsung a kipan in thilpiak alakhia a, vaihawmna lampi heikawisak ding in.
english: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.

paite: Theihsiamna neimi ma ah pilna a-om; himahleh mihai mitte lei tawp ah a-om hi.
english: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.

paite: Apa a ding in tapa hai lungkhamna ahi a, amah piangsaknu a ding in khatna ahi.
english: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.

paite: Midiktat gawt hiam thutak ziak a milian zep leng ahoih kei hi.
english: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.

paite: Kuapeuh theihna neimi akamsim thei hi; kuapeuh theihsiamna nei lungsim tawldam in a-om hi.
english: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.

paite: Mihai nangawn, adaih dide lai in, pil a ngaih ahi; amukte achih lai in, pilvang bang a theih ahi.
english: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.

paite: Kuapeuh kituamseh in ama deihlam azong a, huan pilna hoih tengteng tung ah athangpai hi.
english: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.

paite: Theihsiamna ah mihai in kipahna anei kei, himahleh alungtang a kitaklat theihna ding ahi.
english: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.

paite: Migilou ahong chiang in, muhsitna leng ahong pai a, zahtaklouhna toh zumna ahong pai hi.
english: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.

paite: Mihing kam thute tui thukte bang ahi; pilna tuikhuk luangte bang ahi.
english: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.

paite: Migilou guptuam ahoih kei, vaihawmna a midiktat nawlkhin leng.
english: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.

paite: Mihai mukte kiselna ah alut a, huan akam in zepna asam hi.
english: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.

paite: Mihai kam asiatna ahi, huan amukte akha a ding a thang ahi uh.
english: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.

paite: Huauhatmi thute tanghou limtak bang ahi a, gil sungnungpen pen ah atumsuk uhi.
english: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.

paite: Anasepna ze-ol leng hihsemi a ding in unau ahi.
english: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.

paite: TOUPA min insang muanhuai ahi; midiktat huai ah atailut a, abit hi.
english: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

paite: Mihau hauhsakna a khopi muan ahi, ama ngaihdan a kulhbaang sangtak bang.
english: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.

paite: Siatna ma ah mihing lungtang aki-uangsak a, zahna ma ah kiniamkhiakna apai hi.
english: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.

paite: Kuapeuh azak ma a dawnna pia, amah a ding in haina leh zumna ahi.
english: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.

paite: Mihing lungsim in athuakgimna apozou a; himahleh lungsim puakkham kua in thuakzou ding?
english: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?

paite: Mipilvang lungtang in theihna amu a; huan mipil bil in theihna azong hi.
english: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

paite: Mihing thilpiak in amah a ding in omna abawl a, huan mithupite ma ah amah api hi.
english: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.

paite: Kuapeuh agen masa dik in akilang phot hi; invengte hong pai a amah ahong zonkhiak masiah.
english: He who pleads his cause first seems right— until another comes and questions him.

paite: Aisan in kiselna atawpsak a, huan mihatte kikal ah akhen hi.
english: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.

paite: Unau hihkhasiat khopi muan sang in lak ahaksa zaw; huan huchibang kiselna kulhpi sikchiangte ahi.
english: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.

paite: Mihing gilpi akam a gah in adim ding; amukte punna a hihlungkim in a-om ding hi.
english: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.

paite: Sihna leh hinna lei thilhihtheihna ah a-om; huan huai itte'n huai gah ane ding uh.
english: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.

paite: Kuapeuh zi mu in thil hoih mu ahi a, TOUPA a kipan deihsakna atang hi.
english: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of Yahweh.

paite: Genthei in kamdam in akhem sek a; himahleh hausa in khauhtak in adawng hi.
english: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.

paite: Kuapeuh lawm tampite bawl in amah siatna ahih a; himahleh unau sang a ginomzaw lawm khat a-om hi.
english: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

paite: Ginom a migenthei, mihau amukte kilawm lou gen leh mihai sang in ahoihzaw hi.
english: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.

paite: Huai lou in, kha theihna bei a a-om ding ahoih kei; huan kuapeuh akhe man-gang akhial nak hi.
english: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty with one’s feet and miss the way.

paite: Mihing haina in alampi ahihsia a; huan alungtang in TOUPA ahek hi.
english: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against Yahweh.

paite: Hausakna in lawmte tampi abehlap a; himahleh alawm a kipan migenthei khen in a-om.
english: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.

paite: Theihpih taklou gawt louh in a-om kei ding; huan kuapeuh zuaugen asuakta kei ding.
english: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.

paite: Mi tampi in misiam deihsakna angen ding ua; huan michih thilpiakte pia a ding in lawm ahi.
english: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.

paite: Migenthei unaute tengteng in amah ahua ua; amah a kipan bangchi a gamla in ahia alawmte apai uh! Thute in amau adelh a, himahleh apai khin uhi.
english: All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.

paite: Kuapeuh pilna mu in akha a-it a; kuapeuh theihsiamna kem in hoih amu ding hi.
english: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.

paite: Theihpih taklou gawt louh in a-om kei ding a; kuapeuh zuaugen amangthang ding.
english: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.

paite: Mihai a ding in nuamtat akilawm kei a; lalte tung a sikha vaihawm akilawm kei sem hi.
english: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

paite: Mihing ngentelna in amah ahehhaksak a; huan atatlekna paikan athupina ahi.
english: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.

paite: Kumpipa thangpaihna humpinelkai humham bang ahi; himahleh adeihsakna loupa tung a daitui bang ahi.
english: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

paite: Tapa hai apa tuahsiatna ahi; huan zi hanhat a-intung keh gige ahi.
english: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.

paite: Inn leh hauhsaknate nu leh pate a kipan gouluah ahi; himahleh zi pil TOUPA a kipan ahi.
english: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from Yahweh.

paite: Thadahna nakpi a ihmutna ah apai a; huan mithadah in gilkial athuak ding.
english: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.

paite: Kuapeuh thupiak zui in akha akem a; himahleh kuapeuh alampite a pilvang lou asi ding.
english: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.

paite: Kuapeuh genthei hehpihna nei in TOUPA a ding in aleitawisak a, huan athil hoih hih amah adin nawn ding.
english: He who has pity on the poor lends to Yahweh; he will reward him.

paite: Lametna a-om lai in na tapa sawi in; huan akah ziak in na kha in khawlsan mawk ke'n.
english: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.

paite: Nakpitak a thangpaimi in gawtna athuak ding; amah na hutkhiakleh, huai tuh na hihkik nawn kul ding ahi ngal a.
english: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.

paite: Thupha za inla, hilhna sang in, na hinkhua nanung a na piltheihna ding in.
english: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.

paite: Mihing lungtang ah thugel tampi a-om a; himahleh TOUPA thuhilhna, huai mah adingh ding hi.
english: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.

paite: Mihing deihthusam amigitna tehna ahi; huan migenthei mizuauthei sang in ahoihzaw hi.
english: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.

paite: TOUPA kihtak hinna lam zotna ahi; huan kuapeuh huai nei lungkim in a-om gige ding; gilou veh in a-om kei ding hi.
english: The fear of Yahweh leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.

paite: Mithadah in kuang sung ah akhut aphum a, huchi in akam ah huai ahon tun nawn ngap kei hi.
english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

paite: Simmohhat sat in, mimawl in pilvandan asin ding; theihsiamna nei sal in, huchi in theihna atheisiam ding hi.
english: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.

paite: Kuapeuh apa tung a hiamgam a, anu delhmang, zumna omsak leh simmohna tun tapa ahi.
english: He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.

paite: Theihna thute a kipan a lampial lel ding in, ka tapa, hilhna zak tawp in.
english: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.

paite: Theihpihmi phattuamna nei lou in vaihawmna asimmoh; huan migilou kam in thulimlouhna anawmvalh hi.
english: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.

paite: Muhsit hatmi a ding in vaihawmnate bawlkholhsa ahi, mihai nungzang a ding in vuaknate.
english: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.

paite: Ka tapa, ka thute na san a, ka thupiakte nang a na kholkhawmleh;
english: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,

paite: huchi a pilna lam a na bil na doh a, theihsiamna lam a na lung na suk leh;
english: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;

paite: ahi, theihkakna na sap a, theihsiamna ding a na aw na suahleh;
english: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;

paite: dangka bang a huai na zon a, gou sel bang a huai na zonleh;
english: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures;

paite: huchi in TOUPA kihtakna na theisiam ding a, Pathian theihna na mu ding hi.
english: then you will understand the fear of Yahweh, and find the knowledge of God.

paite: TOUPA'N lah pilna ape ngal a; akam a kipan in theihna leh theihsiamna ahong pai hi.
english: For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

paite: Midik a ding in pilna hoih akholkhawm a, muanhuaina a omte amaute a ding in lum ahi.
english: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,

paite: Vaihawmna lampite aventheihna ding in, amisiangthoute lampi ahawitheihna ding in.
english: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.

paite: Huchi in diktatna leh vaihawmna na theisiam ding a, huan, hawmsiamna, ahi, lampi hoih chiteng.
english: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.

paite: Na lungtang sung ah pilna ahong lut ding a, huan na kha a ding in theihna anuam ding hi.
english: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

paite: Ngentelna in nang ahon veng ding a, theihsiamna in nang ahon kem ding hi.
english: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,

paite: Gilou lampi a kipan ahon hunkhe ding, mi thil hoih lou gente a kipan;
english: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,

paite: lampi tangte mangngilh, khomial lampite a pai ding;
english: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,

paite: gilou hih ding a kipak a, gilou hoihlouhna a nuamsa;
english: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,

paite: alampite ua kawi a, alampite ua dikloute.
english: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,

paite: Numei lamdang a kipan nang hon hun ding, mikhualnu athute toh amaitangphatnu a kipan mahmah in;
english: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,

paite: ama'n atuailai lawm anusia a, a Pathian thukhun amangngilh hi.
english: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;

paite: A-inn in sihna lampi adoh a, alampite'n misite lampi;
english: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.

paite: amah kiang a hoh kuamah akik nawn kei ua, kuamah in hinna lampite aphazou sam kei uhi.
english: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.

paite: Mihoihte lampi a na pai theih a, midiktatte lampi na zuihtheihna ding in.
english: Therefore walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

paite: Mitangte gamsung a teng ding ahi ua, huan asung ah mihoihkimte a-om tawntung ding uh.
english: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.

paite: Himahleh giloute gam a kipan satkhiak in a-om ding ua, huan lepchiahtak a hihte huai a kipan zungkalhkhiak in a-om ding uh.
english: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.

paite: Uain muhsit hat ahi a, zu khauh kilai hat ahi; kuapeuh huai a paikhial apil kei hi.
english: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

paite: Kumpipa kihtakhuaina humpinelkai humham bang ahi; kuapeuh amah hihheh in ama hinna siatna ding in thil ahihkhial hi.
english: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.

paite: Mihing a ding in kinakna a kipan kidang koih zahtakhuaina ahi; himahleh mihai in kinakna abawl ding hi.
english: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.

paite: Mithadah in phavang in lei alet kei ding; huaiziak in pawltak chiang in azong dia, bangmah anei kei ding hi.
english: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.

paite: Mihing lungtang ah thupha gel tui thuk bang ahi; himahleh theihsiamna neimi in huai asuahkhe ding hi.
english: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.

paite: Mi tampi'n amah tung a siam mi atuak ding; himahleh miginom kua'n amu ding?
english: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?

paite: Midik ama muanhuaina a-om, amah nung in atate ahampha uhi.
english: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.

paite: Kumpipa vaihawmna laltutphah tung a tu in amit in gilou tengteng athehzak hi.
english: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.

paite: Kua'n, ka lungtang ka hihsiang a, ka khelhna a kipan ka siangthou, achi thei dia?
english: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin”?

paite: Bukna kibang lou leh tehna kibang lou, anih tuaktuak un TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi.
english: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.

paite: Naupang nangawn in athilhih in amah-le-amah akitheisak a, anasep asiangthou hia, adik hia chih.
english: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.

paite: Za thei bil leh mu thei mit, TOUPA'N anih tuaktuak un abawl hi.
english: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Yahweh has made even both of them.

paite: Ihmut it ke'n, na genthei kha ding hi; na mit hak in, huchi in tanghou in na tai ding hi.
english: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.

paite: Aleimi in, bangmah ahi kei, bangmah ahi kei, achi; himahleh apai khit nung in, huai chiang in aki-uangsak hi.
english: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.

paite: Dangka-eng a-om, rubi suang tampi; himahleh theihsiamna mukte jewel suangmantam ahi uh.
english: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.

paite: Mikhual a dia moh khu dia kichiammi puansilh la in; mikhual numei a dia kichiam ahihleh mohkhuhna ding in len in.
english: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.

paite: Zuautheihna tanghou mihing a ding in akhum a; himahleh anung in akam suanghum in adim ding hi.
english: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.

paite: Thiltup chiteng thuhoih gel a hihkip ahi; huan pina pil in nang kidouna na bawl.
english: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!

paite: Kuapeuh tangthu gen a pai vialvial in thugukte akitheisak hi; huaiziak in kuapeuh amukte zapi a hong kithuahpih dah in.
english: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.

paite: Kuapeuh apa hiam anu hiam hamsiat, zan khomial penpen ah akhawnvak hekmial ahi ding hi.
english: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.

paite: Atung in kinohtak a gou muh theih ahi, atawpna vualzawl ahi kei ding hi.
english: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won’t be blessed in the end.

paite: Gilou ka thuk ding, chi ke'n; TOUPA ngak in, ama'n ahon hondam ding hi.
english: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for Yahweh, and he will save you.

paite: Bukna kibang lou TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi; huan khaina kibang lou ahoih kei hi.
english: Yahweh detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.

paite: Mihing painate TOUPA a kipan ahi; huchi ahih chiang in bangchi in mihing in alampi atheisiam dia?
english: A man’s steps are from Yahweh; how then can man understand his way?

paite: Mihing a ding in, "Asiangthou," chih mawkmawk thang ahi, huan anung a thu kan ding a thu chiam.
english: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.

paite: Kumpipa pil in migiloute ahaih a, atung uah chilna kangtalai khe apaisak hi.
english: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.

paite: Mihing lungsim TOUPA khawnvak ahi; gilpi sunglam sungnung penpen avek a zong in.
english: The spirit of man is Yahweh’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.

paite: Zahngaihna leh thutak in kumpipa ahawi a; huan alaltutphah zahngaihna aletkip hi.
english: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.

paite: Tangvalte thupina ahatna uh ahi; putekte kilawmna asamkang uh ahi.
english: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.

paite: Keh zou a satna in thil hoih lou asingsiang a; satna in gilpi sunggil lamte azel hi.
english: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.

paite: Kumpipa lungtang TOUPA khut a om ahi, tui lampite bang in; a-utna lamlam ah ahei hi.
english: The king’s heart is in Yahweh’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.

paite: Mihing lampi chiteng amah mit ah adik a; himahleh TOUPA'N lungtangte abuk hi.
english: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but Yahweh weighs the hearts.

paite: Diktatna leh vaihawmna hih kithoihna sang in TOUPA a ding in alaktakzaw hi.
english: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.

paite: Mit hah sang leh lungtang kisathei, migilou khawnvak nangawn, khelhna ahi.
english: A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.

paite: Mipil ngaihtuahnate'n hauhsakna lam kia anawt a; himahleh michih kinohhat taksapna lam kia ah akinoh hi.
english: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.

paite: Lei zuauthei agou muh tuimei lehlam lehlam a mutleng bang ahi; huaite zong mite'n sihna azong uhi.
english: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.

paite: Migilou hiamgamna in amaute ataimang ding; vaihawmna hih anial ziak un.
english: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.

paite: Amah mohna a dimpa lampi akawi mahmah a; himahleh misiangthou ahihleh, athilhih adik ahi.
english: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.

paite: Inn zapi sung a numei selhat toh ten sang in, intung vum ning a ten ahoihzaw.
english: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

paite: Migilou kha in hoih lou adeih; a-invengte in amit ah deihsakna atang kei hi.
english: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.

paite: Muhsit hatmi gawt a a-om chiang in, mimawl bawlpil in a-om hi; huan mipil hilh a a-om chiang in, theihna amu hi.
english: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.

paite: Midiktat in migilou inkuan angaihtuah; migiloute amau siatna ding in vuallel a a-omdan uh.
english: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.

paite: Kuapeuh genthei kahna a bil hum, amah leng akap ding, himahleh zak in a-om kei ding hi.
english: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.

paite: Aguk a thilpiak in hehna anemzou, huan angsung a van tawi in hehna mahmah.
english: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.

paite: Midiktat a ding in vaihawmna hih kipahna ahi, himahleh thulim lou hihte a ding in siatna ahi.
english: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

paite: Theihsiamna lampi a kipan vakmangmi misite kikhopna ah akhawl ding.
english: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.

paite: Kuapeuh nopbawlna it migenthei ahi ding; kuapeuh uain leh sathau hai ahau kei ding uh.
english: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.

paite: Migilou midiktat a ding in tatna sum ahi a, huan mitang mun ah milepchiah ahong pai hi.
english: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.

paite: Numei kisel hat leh kinak hat kiang sang in gamkeu a ten ahoihzaw.
english: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.

paite: Mipil tenna ah gou leh sathau manpha a-om; himahleh mihai in huai anawmvalh vek hi.
english: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man swallows it up.

paite: Kuapeuh diktatna leh zahngaihna delh in hinna, diktatna leh zahtakhuaina amu ding hi.
english: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.

paite: Mipil mihatte khopi ah akah a, huai lai a muanna hatna aphel hi.
english: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.

paite: Kuapeuh kamsim a, pau lou in buainate a kipan akha akemhoih hi.
english: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.

paite: Mikisathei leh uang, amin muhsit hat ahi, kisaktheihna leh ki-otsakna in thil ahih zel hi.
english: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.

paite: Thadahmi deih in amah athat a; akhutte'n sepgim anial ngal uh.
english: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.

paite: Nitum a duhgawltak a huaiham a-om a; himahleh midiktat in apia a, a-it kei hi.
english: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.

paite: Migilou kithoihna kihhuai ahi, lungsim gilou toh huai ahon tawi chiang in, bangchi phet a kihhuai sem ahi diam aw!
english: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!

paite: Theihpih zuauthei amangthang ding; himahleh azami in kalh vual louh in thu agen ding.
english: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.

paite: Migilou in amaitang a taksak a himahleh mitang ahihleh bel, alampite abawlhoih hi.
english: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.

paite: TOUPA kalh in pilna hiam theihsiamna hiam thupha hiam a-om kei hi.
english: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.

paite: Kidou ni a ding in sakol bawlsa ahi; himahleh vualzohna TOUPA a ahi.
english: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.

paite: Hauhsakna thupite sang in minhoih tel zawk ding ahi, dangka leh dangka-eng sang in deihsakna a-ithuai zaw hi.
english: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.

paite: Hausa leh genthei akituakkhawm ua, amaute bawl TOUPA ahi.
english: The rich and the poor have this in common: Yahweh is the maker of them all.

paite: Mipilvang in hoih lou amu a, akibu hi. Himahleh mimawl in aphu zel a, athuakloh hi.
english: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

paite: Kiniamkhiakna leh TOUPA kihtakna loh tak hauhsaknate, zahtakhuaina leh hinna ahi.
english: The result of humility and the fear of Yahweh is wealth, honor, and life.

paite: Lingte leh thangte mihoih lou lampi ah a-om; kuapeuh akha kem in huaite agamlat ding hi.
english: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked; whoever guards his soul stays far from them.

paite: Apaina ding lampi ah naupang chil in, huan a-upat hun nangawn in leng huai a kipan apial kei ding hi.
english: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

paite: Mihau in genthei tung ah vai ahawm a, huan leitawisakmi a ding in leitawimi sikha ahi.
english: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.

paite: Kuapeuh thulimlouhna tuh in tuahsia ala ding; huan ahehna chiang alohching kei ding.
english: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.

paite: Kuapeuh khuttawi lian mit nei vualzawl in a-om ding; migenthei kiang a atanghou a kipan apiak ziak in.
english: He who has a generous eye will be blessed, for he shares his food with the poor.

paite: Muhsit hatmi delhkhia in, huan kinakna apaikhe ding hi; ahi, kisualna leh zumhuaina atawp ding hi.
english: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.

paite: Kuapeuh lungtang sianthouna it, amukte deihhuaina ziak in kumpipa alawm ahi ding hi.
english: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.

paite: Theihna nei amah TOUPA mit in avomhoih ding, himahleh lepchiahmi thute apai ahi.
english: Yahweh’s eyes watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.

paite: Thadah in, polam ah humpinelkai a-om; kongzing ah thah in a-om ding, achi hi.
english: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”

paite: Numei lamdangte kam kokhuk thuk ahi; kuapeuh TOUPA deihloumi huai ah akelut ding hi.
english: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under Yahweh’s wrath will fall into it.

paite: Haina naupang lungtang sung ah henlop in a-om a; himahleh bawldikna chiang in amah a kipan gamlapi ah adelhkhe ding hi.
english: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child; the rod of discipline drives it far from him.

paite: Kuapeuh apunna khansakna ding a migenthei nuaisiah a, kuapeuh mihau kiang a pia, taksapna atung lel hi.
english: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.

paite: Na bildoh inla, mipil thute za in, huan ka theihna lam ah na lungtang suk in.
english: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.

paite: Na sung a na kepleh thil nuam ahi ngal a, na muk a hihkip khawm a a-omleh.
english: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.

paite: Na muanna TOUPA ah ahihtheihna ding in, tuni in na kiang ah, nang mahmah kiang ah ka theisak hi.
english: I teach you today, even you, so that your trust may be in Yahweh.

paite: Thuphate leh theihna tungtang a thil hoih penpente na kiang ah ka gelh khinta kei maw.
english: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,

paite: Na kiang a thu hon dongte thutak a na dawntheihna ding a, thutak leh muanhuaite nang hon theisak hilou ka hi hiam?
english: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?

paite: Agentheih ziak in, genthei lok ke'n, kongpi ah gimthuak leng nuaisiah sam ke'n.
english: Don’t exploit the poor because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;

paite: TOUPA'N lah athu uh agen sin ngal a, amau lokte hinna alok ding hi.
