english: for Yahweh will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.

paite: Mihehbaih toh kizawl ke'nla, huan thangpaihhat mi toh kithuah ke'n.
english: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man. Don’t associate with one who harbors anger,

paite: Alampite na sin kha dia, na kha a ding in thang na mu kha ding hi.
english: lest you learn his ways and ensnare your soul.

paite: Khutbengte lak a khat hi ke'nla, ahihkeileh leibate ziak a mohkhu a pangte lak a leng hi sam ke'n.
english: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.

paite: Piak ding na neih keileh, bang ding a na nuai a kipan na lupna lamang ding ahia?
english: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?

paite: Na pipute koihkipsa, tang a gamgi suan ke'n.
english: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.

paite: Anasep a kizenmi na mu hia? Kumpipate ma ah adingh ding a; mithulimloute ma ah adingh kei ding hi.
english: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.

paite: Vaihawmmi toh ne ding a na tut chiang in, na ma a om amah hoihtak in ngaihtuah in.
english: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;

paite: Huan anhaimi na hihleh, na gawl ah temta koih ding na hi.
english: put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.

paite: A-anlimte duh lo ke'n; an khemna a dim ahi chih thei in.
english: Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.

paite: Hausa ding in kigimsak ke'n; nangmah pilna a kipan tawp in.
english: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.

paite: A-omloupi tung ah na mit na koih ding maw? Hauhsaknate'n lah amau a ding in kha akibawl ngal ua, van lam zuan a leng muvanlai bang in.
english: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.

paite: Misumchit neih tanghou ne ke'n, a-anlimte leng duh sam ke'n.
english: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies,

paite: Amah akisim bang in, huchibang ahi; Ne inla dawn in, na kiang ah achi a; himahleh alungtang nang kiang ah a-om kei hi.
english: for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.

paite: Na an nek na lokhe ding a, na thuhoihte na mansuah ding.
english: You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.

paite: Mihai bil ah thugen ke'n, na thute pilna lah musit ding ahi ngal a.
english: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.

paite: Tang a gamgi suan ke'n; pa neiloute lou ah lut ke'n;
english: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,

paite: amaute tanpa lah ahat ngal a; na siatna ding in amau thu agensak ding hi.
english: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.

paite: Na lungtang hilhna lam ah suk inla, na bilte theihna thute lam ah.
english: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.

paite: Naupang lak ah bawlhoihna it ke'n. Chiang in sat lechin leng asi kei ding hi.
english: Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.

paite: Chiang in amah na sat ding a, huan Sheol a kipan akha na suaktasak ding hi.
english: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.

paite: Ka tapa, na lungtang apilleh, kei mahmah, ka lungtang akipak ding;
english: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.

paite: ahi, ka lungtang in nuam asa ding a, na mukte'n thil dik agen chiang un.
english: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.

paite: Na lungtang in mikhialte eng kei hen; himahleh nitum in TOUPA kihtakna ah om in.
english: Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear Yahweh all day long.

paite: Kipahman lah a-om taktak ngal a; huchi in na lametna satkhiak ahi kei ding.
english: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.

paite: Za in, ka tapa pil in, huchi in lampi ah na lungtang pi in.
english: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!

paite: Uain haite lak ah om ke'n; sa haite lak ah.
english: Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat;

paite: Zukham hat leh anhai genthei ding uh ahi ngal a; huan ihmut haina in puansia in mi atuam ding hi.
english: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.

paite: Nang hon suang na pa thu ngaikhia inla, ahong upat chiang in na nu musit ke'n.
english: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.

paite: Thutak lei inla, zuak ke'n; ahi, pilna, hilhna leh theihsiamna.
english: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.

paite: Midiktatpa nakpitak in akipak ding; huan kuapeuh tapa pil suang in amah a kipan nopsakna anei ding hi.
english: The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.

paite: Na nu leh na pa kipaksak inla, nang hon suangnu nuamsasak in.
english: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!

paite: Ka tapa, na lungtang hon pia in, ka lampite ah na mitte kipak uhen.
english: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.

paite: Kizuak lah phaizang thukpi ahi ngal a; huan numei lamdang zaw kokhuk kochik ahi.
english: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.

paite: Ahi, suamhatmi bang in abuk a, huan mite lak ah lepchiahna apungsak hi.
english: Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.

paite: Tunggikna kua'n anei a? Lungkhamna kua'n anei a? Kinaknate kua'n anei a? Phunna kua'n anei a? Akul lou liamnate kua'n anei a? Mit sanna kua'n anei a?
english: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?

paite: Uain a peng opte'n; uain lehbulh zong dia kuante in.
english: Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.

paite: Asan lai in uain en ke'n, nou sung a azia asuah lai in, nemtak a apaisuk lai in.
english: Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.

paite: Atawp chiang in gulpi bang in akei a, guldekpak bang in gu in azen hi.
english: In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.

paite: Na mitte'n thillamdangte amu ding a, na lungtang in thil hoihloute agenkhe ding hi.
english: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.

paite: Ahi, tuipi lai a lum ahihkeileh longkhuam dawn a lum bang na hi ding hi.
english: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:

paite: Ahon sat ua, na ka sa kei; ahon vua ua, bangmah in ka vei kei. Chikchiang in ka halh dia? Zong thak nawn na veng, na chi ding.
english: “They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I will look for more.”

paite: Migiloute siatna ding in enlah ke'n, akiang ua om ut sam ke'n.
english: Don’t be envious of evil men, neither desire to be with them;

paite: Alungtang un nuaisiahna asin ua, amukte un siatna thu agen uhi.
english: for their hearts plot violence and their lips talk about mischief.

paite: Pilna ziak in inn lam in a-om a; theihsiamna in hihkip in a-om.
english: Through wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established;

paite: Huan theihna in dantante hihdim in a-om, hauhna manpha leh nuamte tengteng in.
english: by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.

paite: Mipil ahat; ahi, theihna nei mi'n hatna apungsak.
english: A wise man has great power. A knowledgeable man increases strength,

paite: Pina pil in na galdouna bawl ding na hi ngal a; huan thuhilhmi tampite ah bitna a-om hi.
english: for by wise guidance you wage your war, and victory is in many advisors.

paite: Mihai a ding in pilna asang lua; kongpi ah akam aka kei hi.
english: Wisdom is too high for a fool. He doesn’t open his mouth in the gate.

paite: Kuapeuh hoih lou hih ngaihtuah, mite'n siatna deihmi achi ding uh.
english: One who plots to do evil will be called a schemer.

paite: Mihai ngaihtuahna khelhna ahi; huan mite a ding in musitmi kihhuai ahi.
english: The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men.

paite: Vangsiat ni a na bahleh, na hatna aneu hi.
english: If you falter in the time of trouble, your strength is small.

paite: Sihna lam a puakmang a omte suaktasak in, huan thah a om dia mansate nangma'n suaktasak in.
english: Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!

paite: Ngai in, hiai ka thei kei uh na chihleh; lungtangte bukpa'n huai angaihtuah kei maw? Na kha kempa'n, huai athei kei maw? Huan michih kiang ah athilhih bang in ape kei ding maw?
english: If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this,” doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul, doesn’t he know it? Shall he not give to every man according to his work?

paite: Ka tapa, khuaizu ne in, ahoih ngal a; huan chep a khum khuaikhak.
english: My son, eat honey, for it is good, the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste;

paite: Huchi in pilna na khalam a ding ahi chih na thei ding; na muhleh, huchi in kipahman a-om ding, huan na lametna satkhiak ahi kei ding hi.
english: so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul. If you have found it, then there will be a reward: Your hope will not be cut off.

paite: Aw giloupa, midiktat omna dou ding in tang ke'n; akhawlna mun hihsiatsak ke'n.
english: Don’t lay in wait, wicked man, against the habitation of the righteous. Don’t destroy his resting place;

paite: Midiktat lah sagihvei apuk a, huan athounawn ngal a; himahleh migilou tuahsia zoh in a-om ding hi.
english: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.

paite: Na melma apuk lai in nuamsa ke'n, zoh a a-om lai in na lungtang kipak kei hen.
english: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,

paite: TOUPA'N huai amu kha in, amah akipahpih kei in, huan amah a kipan athangpaihna aheimang kha ding hi.
english: lest Yahweh see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.

paite: Gilou hihte ziak in kilungkhamsak dah in; giloute leng eng sam ke'n.
english: Don’t fret yourself because of evildoers, neither be envious of the wicked;

paite: Migilou a ding a kipahman om lou ding ahi ngal a; migilou khawnvak heklup in a-om ding hi.
english: for there will be no reward to the evil man. The lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.

paite: Ka tapa, TOUPA leh kumpipa kihta in; huan akoi mahmah leng thuman lou ke'n.
english: My son, fear Yahweh and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious,

paite: Amau a pan a siatna lah thakhat a om guih ding ahi ngal a; huan amaute a pan tuahsiatna kua ahia thei?
english: for their calamity will rise suddenly. Who knows what destruction may come from them both?

paite: Hiaite leng mipil thugente ahi. Vaihawmna a mite deihsak tuam neih ahoih kei.
english: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judgment is not good.

paite: Kuapeuh migilou kiang a, na diktat hi, chi peuhmah; mite'n amah ahamsiat ding ua, namte'n amah akih ding.
english: He who says to the wicked, “You are righteous,” peoples will curse him, and nations will abhor him—

paite: Himahleh amah salte a ding in kipahna ahi ding, huan atung uah vualzawlna hoih ahong tung ding hi.
english: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and a rich blessing will come on them.

paite: Dawnna dik pia mukte mite'n atawp ding uhi.
english: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.

paite: Polam ah na thilhih bawlkhol inla, lou sung ah nang a ding in huai tuh mansa in bawl in; huan huai nung in na inn lam in.
english: Prepare your work outside, and get your fields ready. Afterwards, build your house.

paite: Abul bei in na inveng siatna ding in theihpihmi hi ke'n; huan na mukte in khem ke'n.
english: Don’t be a witness against your neighbor without cause. Don’t deceive with your lips.

paite: Ka tung a ahih bang in amah tung ah leng ka hih ding, chi ke'n; mi anasep bang in ka thuk ding.
english: Don’t say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work.”

paite: Thadahmi lou kiang ah ka pai a, huan theihsiamna bei mi grephuan kiang ah;
english: I went by the field of the sluggard, by the vineyard of the man void of understanding.

paite: ngai in, ling in akhannelh khin vek a, huai a alouma loulingnei in akhuhta; huan huai a asuang bangte achim khinta hi.
english: Behold, it was all grown over with thorns. Its surface was covered with nettles, and its stone wall was broken down.

paite: Huchih lai in ka en a, hoihtak in ka ngaihtuah a; ka mu a, hilhna ka sangta hi.
english: Then I saw, and considered well. I saw, and received instruction:

paite: Tomkha ihmut zek lai, tomchik lusuk zek, khut khep a tomchik ihmut zek,
english: a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep,

paite: huchibang in suamhatmi bang in na gentheihna ahong pai ding a; huan mi kigalthuam bang in na taksapna hong tung ding hi.
english: so your poverty will come as a robber and your want as an armed man.

paite: Judah kumpipa Hezekiah mite'n ateikhiak uh, hiaite leng Solomon paunakte ahi uh.
english: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.

paite: Thil iim Pathian thupina ahi; himahleh thu zonkhiak kumpite thupina ahi.
english: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.

paite: Van sandan, huan lei thukdan, huan kumpipate lungtang zonkhiak theih ahi kei hi.
english: As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.

paite: Dangka a kipan tui-ek lamang in, huan siangsakmi a ding in tui-um belsuan ahong omkhe ding.
english: Take away the dross from the silver, and material comes out for the refiner.

paite: Kumpipa ma a kipan gilou lamang in, huan alaltutphah diktatna a hihkip ahi ding hi.
english: Take away the wicked from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.

paite: Kumpipa ma ah malam sang ah om ke'n, huan mithupite omna mun ah dingh ke'n.
english: Don’t exalt yourself in the presence of the king, or claim a place among great men;

paite: Hiai lam ah hong paitou in, na kiang a ahon chih uh ahoihzaw; na mitte'n amuhsa uh, lal ma a koihniam a na om sang in.
english: for it is better that it be said to you, “Come up here,” than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, whom your eyes have seen.

paite: Sual ding in kinoh in kuankhe pah ke'n, atawp in bang hih ding ahia chih na thei kei kha ding.
english: Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?

paite: Na inveng toh kal thu amau toh genkhawm un, huan midang thugukte pholhsuah ke'n!
english: Debate your case with your neighbor, and don’t betray the confidence of another,

paite: Huai za in nang a hon kou kha dia, na zahlakna akiheimang kei kha ding hi.
english: lest one who hears it put you to shame, and your bad reputation never depart.

paite: Kituaktak a thu khat gen dangka kuang sung a dangka-eng epul theite bang ahi.
english: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.

paite: Thumangmi bil ah taihilh mipil dangka-eng bilbah leh dangka-eng hoih chỉ khi bang ahi.
english: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.

paite: Pawltak huan vukvot bang in, huchi in sawltak ginom amah sawlte a ding in ahi; apute kha ahihhalh zel hi.
english: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul of his masters.

paite: Vuah pai lou meipite leh huih bang in, huchi in kuapeuh dikloutak a athilpiakte a ki-uangsak ahi hi.
english: As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively.

paite: Doh theih mahmahna in vaihawmpa thuzoh ahi, huan lei nem in guh ahihtan ding hi.
english: By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.

paite: Khuaizu na muta hia? Nang a dia hun lel ne in; huchi lou in zaw na vah ding a, na lo kha ding hi.
english: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.

paite: Na inveng inn ah hoh vang in; huchi lou in zaw ahon chimtak in ahon mudah kha ding hi.
english: Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor’s house, lest he be weary of you, and hate you.

paite: A-inveng siatna dia zuaugen khetbuk, namsau leh thal hiam bang ahi.
english: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.

paite: Buai hun a miginom lou muan zaw ha kisia leh khepek guh kilawi bang ahi.
english: Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth or a lame foot.

paite: Milunggim kiang a lasa tuh khovot lai a puansilh suah bang leh zu leh tangal hel bang ahi.
english: As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.

paite: Na melma agil akialleh nek ding tanghou pia inla; huan adang atakleh, dawn ding tui pia in.
english: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink;

paite: Alutung a mei-am sekkhawm hi ding lah na hi ngal a, huan TOUPA'N kipahman nang a hon pe ding hi.
english: for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and Yahweh will reward you.

paite: Mal huih in vuah ahon zusak pah a; huchibang in migensiatna lei in hehmel abawl hi.
english: The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.

paite: Inn tung ning a ten, insung za a kisel hat numei toh tenkhawm sang in ahoihzaw hi.
english: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

paite: Kha dangtak a dia tui votte bang in, gam gamla a pan tanchinhoih ahi.
english: Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.

paite: Migilou in midiktat alam pialsak tuh tuikhuk suknit leh tui nak hihsiat bang ahi.
english: Like a muddied spring and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.

paite: Khuaizu tampi nek ahoih kei; huchi mah bang in mite ding in amau thupina zonkhiak thupina ahi kei.
english: It is not good to eat much honey, nor is it honorable to seek one’s own honor.

paite: Amah a lungsim thuzohna bei khopi chimsa leh bang nei lou bang ahi.
english: Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.

paite: Nipi la a vuk bang leh pawltak lai a vuah bang in, zahtakhuaina mihai a ding in akilawm kei hi.
english: Like snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a fool.

paite: Kawlgit avakvaih bang in, phialphiah alen lai bang in, huchi mah bang in hamsia bulbal nei lou atangtung kei hi.
english: Like a fluttering sparrow, like a darting swallow, so the undeserved curse doesn’t come to rest.

paite: Zepna sakol a ding, kamkaihna sabiltung a ding, huan chiang mihaite nungzang a ding ahi.
english: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools!

paite: Mihai ahaina dungzui in dawng ke'n, huchi lou in zaw nang leng amah na bang kha ding.
english: Don’t answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.

paite: Mihai ahaina bang in dawng in, ama kideihna ah apilsak kha ding hi.
english: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.

paite: Kuapeuh mihai khut a thukhak in amah khete atankhia a, siatna ding adawn hi.
english: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence.

paite: Khebai khete a kikhai nelnel; huai bangmah in mihaite kam sung a gentehna ahi.
english: Like the legs of the lame that hang loose, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

paite: Mihai kiang a zahna piak zaw suanglotna khau a suang gakkhawm bang ahi.
english: As one who binds a stone in a sling, so is he who gives honor to a fool.

paite: Zukham hat khut a loulingnei bang in, huai bangmah in mihaite kam sung a gentehna ahi.
english: Like a thorn bush that goes into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

paite: Mihai leh mivialvak guaimi, thalkap siam midang liamsak zel mi bang ahi.
english: As an archer who wounds all, so is he who hires a fool or he who hires those who pass by.

paite: Ui ama luak lam a kik nawn bang in, huai bangmah in ahaina sunzom mihai ahi.
english: As a dog that returns to his vomit, so is a fool who repeats his folly.

paite: Ama kideihna a pil mi na mu hia? Amah a pan sang in mihai a kipan lametna a-om zaw hi.
english: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

paite: Thadah in, "Lampi ah humpinelkai a-om; kongzing ah humpinelkai a- om," achi hi.
english: The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”

paite: Kongkhak a kopza ah akihei zel bang in, alupna tung ah thadahna a-om hi.
english: As the door turns on its hinges, so does the sluggard on his bed.

paite: Thadah in kuang sung ah akhut athun a; akam atun ngap nawn kei hi.
english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.

paite: Thadah ama kideihna ah asan pe thei ding mi sagih sang in pil akisa zaw hi.
english: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion.

paite: Kuapeuh paisuak a, amah a hilou kinakna a kihihbuai, ui abil a man bang ahi.
english: Like one who grabs a dog’s ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own.

paite: Mihai in mei-ekte, thal leh sihna viallot bang in;
english: Like a madman who shoots torches, arrows, and death,

paite: mi invengte khem a, chiamnui ka hi kei a hia? chi toh akibang hi.
english: is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, “Am I not joking?”

paite: Sing taksap ziak in mei amit a; huan huauhatmi omlouhna ah, kinakna abei hi.
english: For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.

paite: Suangkuangtheite meisumsa a ding bang in leh sing mei a ding bang in; kinak hatmi kilanna uangsak ahi.
english: As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man to kindling strife.

paite: Huauhatmi thute an limtak bang ahi, huan gilpi sungnungpen ah atumsuk hi.
english: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, they go down into the innermost parts.

paite: Leibel limlang tui a luan bang in, lungtang gilou muk azol in anal hi!
english: Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart.

paite: Mihuauhat in amuk in athehdalh a, alungtang in khemna apai.
english: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.

paite: Kilawmna thu agen chiang in, amah um ke'n; alungtang ah lah kihhuai sagih a-om ngal a.
english: When his speech is charming, don’t believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart.

paite: Ahuatna khemna in kituam mahleh, khawmpite ma ah tangpi muh in agitlouhna etsak ahi ding hi.
english: His malice may be concealed by deception, but his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.

paite: Kuapeuh khuk tou huai ah ake ding; huan kuapeuh suang khuk, amah tung ah hong kileh ding hi.
english: Whoever digs a pit shall fall into it. Whoever rolls a stone, it will come back on him.

paite: Lei zuauthei in ahihliamsate amudah a, maitangphat hat kam in siatna abawl hi.
english: A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin.

paite: Zingchiang thu ah ki- uangsak ke'n; ni in bang hon suahpih ding ahia chih lah na thei ngal kei a.
english: Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring.

paite: Midang in nang hon phat uhen, nangmah mah kam hilou in; mikhual in nangmah mah mukte hilou in.
english: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.

paite: Suang agik a, piaunel agik hi; himahleh mihai lungzinna huaite gel sang in agikzaw hi.
english: A stone is heavy, and sand is a burden; but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.

paite: Thangpaihna agilou, hehna akhel; himahleh thikna ma ah kua adingh thei dia?
english: Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?

paite: Aguk a itna sang in alangtang a salhna ahoihzaw.
english: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.

paite: Lawm khat liamnate ginom ahi ua, himahleh melma hon tawpna khemna ahi.
english: The wounds of a friend are faithful, although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.

paite: Kha gilvah in khuaikhak achimtak a; himahleh kha gilkial a ding in thil kha chiteng akhum hi.
english: A full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.

paite: Abuk a kipan a vasa vakvai bang in, huai bang in amun a kipan mi avakvai hi.
english: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his home.

paite: Nuh theih leh gimnamtui in lungtang akipaksak a; huai bangmah in mihing lawm khumna lungsimtak a thupha a hong pai ahi.
english: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.

paite: Na lawm mahmah, na pa lawm mangngilh ke'n; na tuahsiatna ni in na unau inn ah hoh ke'n; gamlapi a-unau sang in inveng nai om ahoihzaw hi.
english: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend. Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster. A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.

paite: Ka tapa, pil in, ka lungtang kipaksak in, kei hon taite ka dawntheihna ding in.
english: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.

paite: Mipilvang in hoih lou amu a, abu hi; himahleh mimawl in a- awlmoh kei a, athuakloh hi.
english: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

paite: Mikhual a ding moh khu dia om puansilh la in; huan numei lamdang a dia moh khu dia om chiamkhamna ding in len in.
english: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!

paite: Kuapeuh aw ngaihtaka, zingsang beltak a thou a, a-inveng vualzawl, ama a ding in hamsia a sim ahi ding hi.
english: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him.

paite: Vuahchiin ni a vuah zu leh numei kinak hat akibang.
english: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:

paite: Kuapeuh amah khou huih khou bang ahi a, khut taklam a sathau ham bang ahi.
english: restraining her is like restraining the wind, or like grasping oil in his right hand.

paite: Sik in sik ahiamsak bang in mihing in alawm mel ahiamsak hi.
english: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.

paite: Kuapeuh theipi kung kem in huai a agah ane ding; huan kuapeuh apu ngak zahtak in a-om ding hi.
english: Whoever tends the fig tree shall eat its fruit. He who looks after his master shall be honored.

paite: Tui a maitang in maitang amuh bang in, huai mah bang in mihing lungsim ah mihinna akimu hi.
english: Like water reflects a face, so a man’s heart reflects the man.

paite: Sheol leh Abaddon alungkim ngei kei ua, huan mihing mitte alungkim ngei kei uh.
english: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; and a man’s eyes are never satisfied.

paite: Huansianna bel dangka a ding ahi, huan meipi dangka-eng a ding, huchibang mah in mihing phatna a ze-et in a-om hi.
english: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but man is refined by his praise.

paite: Mihai sum sung ah buh taisate lak ah suk in su mah lechin, huchipi in leng amah a kipan in ahaina apaimang kei lai ding hi.
english: Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.

paite: Na belamhonte omdan thei ding in thanuam in, na ganhonte hoihtak in en in;
english: Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds,

paite: Hauhsaknate tangtawn a ding ahi kei a; lallukhu in suan tengteng adaih zou hia?
english: for riches are not forever, nor does the crown endure to all generations.

paite: Buhpawl puak in a-om a, huan loupa nou akilang, mualte a loupate akilakhawm hi.
english: The hay is removed, and the new growth appears, the grasses of the hills are gathered in.

paite: Belamnoute'n na puansilh ding ahon pe ding, huan kelte'n na lou man ding.
english: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field.

paite: Huan na an ding in, na inkote an ding in kel nawitui kiching a-om ding hi; huan na nungakte vakna ding in.
english: There will be plenty of goats’ milk for your food, for your family’s food, and for the nourishment of your servant girls.

paite: Migilou kuamah delh louh in atai; himahleh midiktat humpinelkai bang in ahangsan hi.
english: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

paite: Gam tatlekna ziak in thuneimi tampi a-om a; himahleh theisiam leh theihna nei mite ziak in huai gam bel suk vaiveng theih ahi.
english: In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.

paite: Taksap hau migenthei nuaisiahte zaw lou susia vuahpi zu bang ahi.
english: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.

paite: Amau dan mangngilhte'n migilou aphat ua; himahleh huchibang dan zuite amau tung ah athangpai uhi.
english: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.

paite: Mihoih lou in vaihawmna atheisiam kei; himahleh amau TOUPA zongte'n thil tengteng atheisiam uh.
english: Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek Yahweh understand it fully.

paite: Alampite a hoih lou mihau sang in athutakna a om migenthei ahoihzaw hi.
english: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.

paite: Kuapeuh dan zui tapa pil ahi; himahleh kuapeuh anhai mite toh kithuah in apa azumsak hi.
english: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.

paite: Kuapeuh aneih, anou leh apung tamsak in, migenthei hehpihmi amah a ding in alakhawm hi.
english: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.

paite: Kuapeuh dan za lou ding a abil kaihei, athumna nangawn kihhuai ahi.
english: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.

paite: Kuapeuh lampi gilou a midik lamhaihsak, ama kokhuk mahmah ah akelut ding hi; himahleh mihoihkim in gou hoih aluah ding hi.
english: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.

paite: Mihausa ama ngaih in apil a; himahleh migenthei theihsiamna nei in amah azongkhia hi.
english: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.

paite: Midiktat avualzoh chiang in, thupina lian a-om; himahleh migilou athoh chiang in, mite abu uhi.
english: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.

paite: Kuapeuh atatlekna khuh alohching kei ding; himahleh kuapeuh huaite thupha tawi a, mangngilh in zahngaihna amu ding uh.
english: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

paite: Lau thei gige mi ahampha hi; himahleh alungtang saksak gige siatna ah ake ding hi.
english: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.

paite: Humpinelkai humham leh vompi hawk bang in; huai mah bang in migentheite tung a vaihawmmi gilou ahi.
english: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.

paite: Vaihawmmi theihsiamna tasam nuaisiah hat mithupi ahi; himahleh kuapeuh huaihamna hua in anite asausak ding hi.
english: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.

paite: Mi kuapeuh sisan a dimmi himhim, kokhuk sung ah atailut ding; kuamah in panpih kei hen.
english: A man who is tormented by blood guilt will be a fugitive until death. No one will support him.

paite: Kuapeuh tangtak a om suahtaksak in a-om ding; himahleh kuapeuh alampite a hoih lou apuk zaw ding hi.
english: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.

paite: Kuapeuh agam lei let in tanghou tampi anei ding; himahleh kuapeuh mi bangmah lou nungzui in gentheihna kiching anei ding hi.
english: One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.

paite: Miginom in vualzawlna ahau ding; himahleh kuapeuh hau ding a kintat gawt louh in a-om kei ding hi.
english: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.

paite: Mite deihsak tuam neih ahoih kei; tanghou them ziak in mi atalek ding leng ahi sam kei hi.
english: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.

paite: Kuapeuh deihgawl sumchit hauhsakna delh in akinoh a, huan atung ah taksapna ahong tung sin chih athei kei hi.
english: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.

paite: Kuapeuh mi deihsakna a sal in alei a maitangphat hatmi sang in deihsakna tamsem anung in amu ding hi.
english: One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.

paite: Kuapeuh anu hiam apa hiam lok a, "Tatlekna ahi kei," chimi zaw; amah mah hihsemi kithuahpih ahi hi.
english: Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, “It’s not wrong,” is a partner with a destroyer.

paite: Kuapeuh lungsim duhgawl in kinakna atokthou hi; himahleh kuapeuh TOUPA a muanna koih thausak in a-om ding hi.
english: One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in Yahweh will prosper.

paite: Kuapeuh ama lungtang muang mihai ahi; himahleh kuapeuh piltak a om, suahtaksak in a-om ding hi.
english: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.

paite: Kuapeuh genthei kiang a pia atasam kei ding a; himahleh kuapeuh amit sel in hamsia tampi anei ding hi.
english: One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.

paite: Migiloute alal chiang un, mite akibu ua; himahleh amanthat chiang un, midiktat apung hi.
english: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.

paite: Kuapeuh salh a om nak a, genhak teitei hihdamna om lou in thakhat in akise ding hi.
english: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.

paite: Midiktatte apun chiang un, mite akipak uh; himahleh migilou in vaihawmna apuak chiang in, mite amau uh.
english: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.

paite: Kuapeuh pilna it in apa akipaksak a; himahleh kuapeuh kizuakte kithuahpih in asum amawk zatbei hi.
english: Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.

paite: Kumpipa'n vaihawmna in gam ahihkip a; himahleh kuapeuh thilpiak phut teitei in ahihsia hi.
english: The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.

paite: Mi invengte maitangphat in kalsuante a ding in len azaksak hi.
english: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.

paite: Mihoih lou tatlekna ah thang a-om; himahleh midiktat in la asa a, akipak hi.
english: An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.

paite: Midiktat in migenthei thu atheihpih a; migilou in huai thei ding in theihsiamna anei kei hi.
english: The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.

paite: Misimmoh hatte'n khopi ahal ua; himahleh mipilte'n thangpaihna aheimang uh.
english: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.

paite: Mipil in mihai akiselpihleh, aheh hiam anui hiam, khawlna a-om kei ding hi.
english: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.

paite: Sisan duh a dangtak in amah mihoihkim amudah; huan mitang ahihleh, ahinna azong uhi.
english: The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.

paite: Mihai in ahehna tengteng agen a; himahleh mipil in agenkhe kei a, akhemdai hi.
english: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.

paite: Vaihawmmi'n zuauthu angaih-khiakleh, asikha tengteng gilou ahi uh.
english: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.

paite: Migenthei leh nuaisiah hat akituakkhawm ua; TOUPA'N anih tuak uh mitte asukvaksak hi.
english: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: Yahweh gives sight to the eyes of both.

paite: Kumpipa ginomtak gentheite ngaihtuah, tangtawn in alaltutphah akip ding hi.
english: The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.

paite: Chiang leh salhna in pilna apia; himahleh naupang ama thuthu a omsak in anu a ding in zumna ahi.
english: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.

paite: Giloute apun chiang un, tatlekna apung hi; himahleh midiktat in apukna uh a-en ding hi.
english: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.

paite: Na tapa bawlhoih in, awlna ahon pe ding hi; ahi, na kha a ding in nopna ahon pe ding hi.
english: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.

paite: Mengmuhna omlouhna ah, mite azautat uh; himahleh kuapeuh dan zui, ama'n nuam asa hi.
english: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.

paite: Sikha thute a bawlhoih in a-om kei ding; thei mahleh alimsak kei ding.
english: A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.

paite: Athute a kinoh mi na mu hia? Amah sang in mihai a kipan in lametna a-om zaw hi.
english: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

paite: Kuapeuh anaupan a kipan a asikha nuamtattak a kem in atawptawp in ama tapa hong hi in anei ding hi.
english: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.

paite: Miheh in kinakna atokthou a, huan mithangpai in tatlekna ahau hi.
english: An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.

paite: Mihing kisaktheihna in amah alainiam ding; himahleh kuapeuh lungsim kiniamkhiak in pahtawina amu ding.
english: A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.

paite: Kuapeuh guta toh kithuah in amah kha amudah hi; nakpitak a ngetna aza a, huan bangmah agen kei hi.
english: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.

paite: Mihing kihtakna in thang ahon tawi a; himahleh kuapeuh TOUPA a muanna koih abit ding hi.
english: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.

paite: Mi tampi'n vaihawmmi deihsakna azong ua; himahleh mihing vaihawmna TOUPA a kipan hong pai ahi.
english: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from Yahweh.

paite: Midiklou midiktat a ding in kihhuai ahi; huan kuapeuh lampi a tang migilou a ding in kihhuai ahi.
english: A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.

paite: Ka tapa, ka dan mangngilh ke'n; himahleh ka thupiakte na lungtang in kem hen.
english: My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,

paite: Nite sawtna leh damsung kumte leh muanna, nang a hong kibehlap ding ahi ngal a.
english: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.

paite: Zahngaihna leh thutak in nang hon nuse kei hen; na ngawng kimvel in vial inla; na lungtang dohkan tung ah amaute gelh in.
english: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

paite: Huchi in Pathian leh mihing mitmuh in deihsakna leh theihsiamna hoih na mu ding hi.
english: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

paite: Na lungtang tengteng toh TOUPA ah muang inla, nangmah theihsiamna ah kinga ke'n.
english: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.

paite: Na lampi tengteng ah amah thei inla, huchi in ama'n na lampite apitang ding hi.
english: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

paite: Nangmah mit ah pil ke'nla; TOUPA kihta inla, gilou taisan in.
english: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.

paite: Na lai a ding in damna ahi ding a, na guhte a ding in guhngek.
english: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.

paite: Na van in TOUPA zahtak in, na punna tengteng a gah masate toh in.
english: Honor Yahweh with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase;

paite: Huchi in hauhna in na pangte adimlet dia, na belte uain thak in adimlet ding hi.
english: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.

paite: Ka tapa, TOUPA sawina musit ke'nla; abawlhoihna leng chimtak sam ke'n.
english: My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;

paite: Pa'n akipahna tapa asalh bang in; TOUPA'N a-itte asal ngal a.
english: for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.

paite: Pilna mumi leh theihsiamna mumi'n nuam asa hi.
english: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.

paite: Huai a vante lah dangka vante sang in ahoihzaw ngal a, huan huai a punna dangka- eng hoih sang in.
english: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.

paite: Rubi suang sang in amanphazaw; huan amah toh na thil deihte na tehpih thei kei ding.
english: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.

paite: Akhut taklam ah nite sawtna a-om a; akhut veilam ah hauhsaknate leh zahtakhuaina.
english: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.

paite: Alampite nopna lampite ahi a, alampite tengteng muanna ahi.
english: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.

paite: Amah len tintente a ding in hinna sing ahi; amah nei den michih in nuam asa uhi.
english: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.

paite: TOUPA'N pilna in lei amukhia a; theihsiamna in vante ahihkipta hi.
english: By wisdom Yahweh founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.

paite: Atheihna in thuknate akitam a, huan vante'n adaitui ataksak uhi.
english: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.

paite: Ka tapa, na mitte a kipan amaute paimangsak ke'n; pilna hoih leh ngentelna kem gige in.
english: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,

paite: Huchi in na kha a ding in hinna ahi ding ua, na ngawng a ding in kilawmna.
english: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.

paite: Huchi in bittak in na lampi ah na pai ding a, na khe akisui kei ding hi.
english: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.

paite: Na lup chiang in, na lau kei dia; ahi, na lum ding a, na ihmut alim ding.
english: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.

paite: Lauguihna kihta ke'n, ahong pai chiang in, giloute hihgawpna leng lau sam ke'n.
english: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;

paite: TOUPA na kimuanna ahi sin ngal a, na khe thang a awk lou ding in aveng ding hi.
english: for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.

paite: Amu dingte a kipan thil hoih it ke'n, hih ding a na khut thilhihtheihna a-om lai in.
english: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.

paite: Na invengte kiang ah, na kiang a na neih lai in, pai inla, hong nawn in, huchi in zingsang chiang in ka hon pe ding, chi ke'n.
english: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.

paite: Na invengte siatna ding gilou ngaihtuah ke'n, na kiang ah bittak in ateng chih thei in.
english: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.

paite: Aziak bei in mi toh kina ke'n, gilou bangmah na tung a ahihkeileh.
english: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.

paite: Hiamgammi eng ke'n, alampite bangmah tel ke'n.
english: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.

paite: Kilawm lou lah TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi ngal a; himahleh athuguk mitangte kiang ah a-om hi.
english: For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh, but his friendship is with the upright.

paite: TOUPA hamsia migiloute inn ah a-om; himahleh midiktatte tenna avualzawl hi.
english: Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.

paite: Ama'n nuihsan hatte anuihsan a, himahleh kingainiamte kiang ah hehpihna apia hi.
english: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.

paite: Mipil in thupina gou aluah ding; himahleh zumna mihaite kaisanna ahi ding hi.
english: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.

paite: Jakeh tapa Agur thute. Huai mi in Ithiel kiang ah, Ithiel leh Ukal kiang ah.
english: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the revelation: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:

paite: Chihtaktak in kuamah sang in ka haizaw a, mihing theihsiamna ka nei kei.
english: “Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.

paite: Pilna ka sin nai kei a, Mi Siangthou theihna leng aka nei kei, achi hi.
english: I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.

paite: Van ah kua akahtouta in ahong kumsuk a? Akhuttum sung ah kua'n huih alakhawmta a? Apuansilh in kua'n tuite atun a? Lei tawpnate kua'n ahihkipta a? Amin bang ahia? Huan atapa min bang ahia, na theihleh?
english: Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?

paite: Pathian thu chiteng ettel ahi; amah a muangte a ding in lum ahi.
english: “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

paite: Athute ah behlap ke'n, hon sal dia, zuauthei amuh in na om kha ding hi.
english: Don’t you add to his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.

paite: Thil nih ka hon ngen; ka sih ma in huaite hon kitheihmohbawl ke'n.
english: “Two things I have asked of you. Don’t deny me before I die.

paite: Bangmah lou leh zuau kei a kipan gamlapi ah suan in. Gentheihna hiam hauhsaknate hiam hon pe ke'n; kei a dia kiphamoh an in hon vak in.
english: Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me,

paite: Huchi lou in zaw ka kham in, nang ka hon kitheihmohbawl in, TOUPA kua ahia? Ka chi kha ding hi. Ahihkeileh, ka genthei in, ka gu in, ka Pathian min thanghuaitak in ka bawl kha ding hi.
english: lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is Yahweh?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.

paite: Apu kiang ah sikha gense ke'n, huchi lou in zaw nang ahon hamsiat dia, mohtansak in na om ding hi.
english: “Don’t slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.

paite: Apa uh hamsiat suan khat a-om a, anu uh vualzawl lou.
english: There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.

paite: Amau mitte a siangthou suan khat a-om a, ahi a lah anitna ua kipan silsiang louh ahi uhi.
english: There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.

paite: Suan khat a-om a, aw amitte uh sanghah hi na e; huan amitkhu vunte sansak in a-om hi.
english: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.

paite: Ahate uh namsau bang leh ahate uh temta bang suan khat a-om uh, lei a kipan a migenthei leh tasamte mite lak a kipan anekbeina ding in.
english: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.

paite: Vot in tanu nih anei a, hon pia in, hon pia in, chi in akikou ua. Thil thum lungkimsak theih ngei louh a-om uh, ahi, li, "Hun e,” chi lou.
english: “The leech has two daughters: ‘Give, give.’ “There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don’t say, ‘Enough!’:

paite: Han leh sul hut; lei tui a hihlungkim a om lou; huan mei, "Hun e," chi lou.
english: Sheol, the barren womb, the earth that is not satisfied with water, and the fire that doesn’t say, ‘Enough!’

paite: Apa nuihsan mit leh anu thuman musit, phaizang va- akte'n atawm ding ua, muvanlai noute'n ane ding uhi.
english: “The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the young eagles shall eat it.

paite: Thil thum kei a ding a lamdang lua a-om ua, ahi, ka theih louh li.
english: “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand:

paite: Huihkhua a muvanlai lampi; suangpi tung a gulpi lampi; tuipi lak a long lampi leh pasal nungak toh alampi.
english: The way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship in the middle of the sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.

paite: Huai mah bang in angkawm hat numei lampi ahi; ane a, zapi in akam aka a, gitlouhna ka hih kei, achi hi.
english: “So is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’

paite: Thil thum ziak in lei aling a, huan thil li apuak zoh louh ziak in;
english: “For three things the earth trembles, and under four, it can’t bear up:

paite: sikha kumpipa hong hih lai leh mihai ankham lai;
english: For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,

paite: numei huathuaitak in pasal aneih a, sikha nungak in api aluah in.
english: for an unloved woman when she is married, and a servant who is heir to her mistress.

paite: Leitung ah aneu thil li a-om ua himahleh apil mahmah uh.
english: “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:

paite: Miksite hat lou ganhing hon ahi ua, himahleh nipi lai in anek ding uh asutuah ua;
english: The ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.

paite: kawl sazawte hat lou pawltak ahi ua, himahleh suangpi heng ah a-inn abawl uhi.
english: The hyraxes are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.

paite: Khaukhupte'n kumpipa anei kei ua, himahleh ahonhon in avek un kilem in apai uh;
english: The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks.

paite: inhikte na khut a na tawi theih ahi ua; himahleh kumpipate inpite ah ateng uh.
english: You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.

paite: Apai chiang ua thupi thil thum a-om ua, ahi, apai chiang ua thupi, li.
english: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:

paite: Humpinelkai, gamsa laklak a hat penpen, bangmah ma ah akiheimang kei hi;
english: The lion, which is mightiest among animals, and doesn’t turn away for any;

paite: kidouna sakol; keltal leng; huan kumpipa, amite ma a pai.
english: the greyhound; the male goat; and the king against whom there is no rising up.

paite: Na kiletsak a haitak a na gamtatleh, ahihkeileh ngaihtuahna gilou na neihleh, na kam tung ah na khut koih in,
english: “If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.

paite: nawitui pei in nawituidat a- omsak a, nak hek in sisan asuahkhesak; huchi mah bang in thangpaihna paisuak in kilaina a-omsak hi.
english: For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood, so the forcing of wrath produces strife.”

paite: Kumpipa Lemuel thute; anu'n amah athuhilh thu:
english: The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him:

paite: Bang ahia, ka tapa? Bang ahia, Aw ka sul tapa? Huan bang ahia, ka thuchiam tapa?
english: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!

paite: Na hatna numeite kiang ah pe ke'nla, kumpipate hihsete kiang ah leng na lampite pe sam ke'n.
english: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.

paite: Kumpipate a ding ahi kei, Aw Lemuel, uain dawn kumpipate a ding ahi kei; Zu khauh koi a om ahia, chih leng lalte a ding ahi sam kei.
english: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’

paite: Huchi lou in zaw adawn un, dan amangngilh un, gimthuak kuapeuh vaihawmna akaikawi kha ding uh.
english: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.

paite: Mangthang dia mansa kiang ah zu khauh pia un, kha a haksa sa kiang ah uain.
english: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.

paite: Dawnsak unla, agentheihna mangngilhsak un, ahaksatna theigige nawn kei hen.
english: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

paite: Pau thei lou a ding in na kam ka in, sukgawp a ommi huchibangte tengteng thu ah.
english: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.

paite: Na kam ka inla, diktak in vai hawm in, gentheite leh tasamte kiang ah vai hawmsak in.
english: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”

paite: Zi nunhoih kua'n amu dia? Rubi suang tung pek sang in amanphazaw hi.
english: Who can find a worthy woman? For her value is far above rubies.

paite: Apasal lungtang in amah amuang a, punna taksapna anei kei ding hi.
english: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.

paite: Adamsung niteng in amah ahihhoih a, ahihse kei.
english: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.

paite: Samul leh ziza azong a, akhut in kilawptak in nna asem hi.
english: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.

paite: Sumsinmi longte bang ahi a; gamla a kipan in an ahon tawi a.
english: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.

paite: Zan lai in leng athou a, a-inkote ding an leh asikhanute kiang ah asep ding apia hi.
english: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.

paite: Lou angaihtuah a, alei a; akhut a gahte in grephuan abawl hi.
english: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.

paite: Hatna in akawng agak a, akhutte ahatsak hi.
english: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.

paite: Asumsinna vante aphatuam chih amu a; zan in akhawnvak amit kei hi.
english: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.

paite: Akhutte muikhut ah anga a, akhutte mui ah anga hi.
english: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.

paite: Gentheite lam ah akhut azak a; ahi, tasamte lam asawk hi.
english: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.

paite: A-inkote ziak in vuk akihta kei a; a-inkote tengteng puan san-au in akithuam uhi.
english: She is not afraid of the snow for her household, for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

paite: Puanphah zehoih mantam akibawl a; apuansilh puanmalngat leh sandup ahi.
english: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.

paite: Kongpite a gam upate lak a apasal atut chiang in, mite' theihtuam in a-om hi.
english: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.

paite: Puan hoih puansilh abawl a, azuak a; sumsinmi kiang ah kawnggakte apekhia hi.
english: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.

paite: Hatna leh zahtakna apuansilh ahi; huan hun hong tung ding anuihsan hi.
english: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.

paite: Pilna in akam aka a; siamna dan alei ah a-om hi.
english: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue.

paite: A-inkote lampi hoihtak in a-en a, huan thadahna tanghou ane kei hi.
english: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.

paite: Atate athou ua, amah nuamsa achi uhi; apasal in leng, amah aphat hi.
english: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:

paite: Tanu tampite'n hoihtak in ahih ua, himahleh nang zaw amaute tengteng na khup vek hi, chi in.
english: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”

paite: Ngaihbanna khemna in adim a, huan kilawmna bangmah lou ahi; himahleh numei TOUPA laudan siam, phat in a-om ding hi.
english: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.

paite: Akhut a gahte amah pia un; huan kongpite ah athilhihte'n amah phat hen.
english: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!

paite: Tate aw, pa hilhna za un, theihsiamna thei ding in limsak un.
english: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;

paite: Thugin hoihtak ka hon pe ngal a; ka dan taisan kei un.
english: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.

paite: Ka pa a ding in tapa ka hi a, ka nu mitmuh a nunnem leh ithuaipen ka hi.
english: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.

paite: Huan ahon sinsak a, ka kiang ah, na lungtang in ka thute lenden hen; ka thupiakte zui inla, huchi in hing in.
english: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.

paite: Pilna nei in, theihsiamna nei in; mangngilh ke'n, ka kam a thute a kipan lunglel ke'n.
english: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.

paite: Huai mangngilh ke'nla, nang ahon hawi ding a; amah it inla, ama'n ahon kem ding hi.
english: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.

paite: Pilna thil thupipen ahi; huaiziak in pilna la in; ahi, na muhsa tengteng toh theihsiamna la in.
english: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

paite: Amah pahtawi inla, ama'n nang hon kaisangsak ding; pahtawina ahon tun dia, amah na kawi lai in.
english: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.

paite: Na lu a ding in kilawmna kizepna ahon pe dia; kilawmna lallukhu nang ahon pe ding hi.
english: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”

paite: Aw ka tapa, ka gente za inla, sang in; huchi in na damsung kumte atam ding hi.
english: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.

paite: Pilna lampi ah ka hon kisinsakta a; lampi tangte ah ka hon pita hi.
english: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.

paite: Na pai chiang in, na kalsuante haksa in a-om kei ding a; na taileh, na kisui puk kei ding.
english: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.

paite: Hilhna kiptak in len in; paisak ke'n; amah vom in; amah lah na hinna ahi ngal a.
english: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.

paite: Migiloute lampi ah lut ke'n; gilou mite lampi ah pai ke'n.
english: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.

paite: Pel inla, akiang ah pai ke'n; kiheisan inla, pai vengveng in.
english: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.

paite: Poi akhoih kei ngal uleh, a- ihmu ngal kei ua; kuahiam apuksak kei uleh, a-ihmutna uh lakmang in a-om hi.
english: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.

paite: Gitlouhna tanghou lah ane ngal ua, hiamgamna uain adawn uhi.
english: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.

paite: Himahleh midiktatte lampi khovak tung bang ahi, sun laitak a nisa bang a tangpha semsem.
english: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.

paite: Migiloute lampi khomial bang ahi; akisuihna uh athei kei uhi.
english: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.

paite: Ka tapa, ka thute limsak in; ka gente ah na bildoh in.
english: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.

paite: Na mitte a kipan amaute lamang ke'n; na lungtang lak ah vom in.
english: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.

paite: Amau mute a ding in hinna ahi ngal ua, asa uh a ding in damna.
english: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.

paite: Thanopna tengteng toh na lungtang kem in; huai a kipan lah hinna tui nakte aluang ngal a.
english: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.

paite: Nang a kipan kam hoih lou koihmang inla, nang a kipan in muk kilawmloute gamlapi ah koih in.
english: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.

paite: Na mitte'n tangtak in en uhenla, na etna na ma ah tang hen.
english: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.

paite: Na khe lampi pheisak inla, huan na lampi tengteng hihkip in omsak in.
english: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.

paite: Na khut taklam hiam veilam hiam ah pial ke'n; gilou lampi ah pai ke'n.
english: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.

paite: Ka tapa, ka pilna limsak in; ka theihsiamna na bildoh in.
english: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,

paite: Ngentelna na vom theih a, na mukte'n theihna akeptheihna ding un.
english: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.

paite: Numei gina lou mukte'n lah khuaizu atakkhesak ngal a, akam sathau sang in analzaw hi.
english: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,

paite: Himahleh atawpna nanung gamsai bang in akha a, namsau hiamtuah bang in ahiam hi.
english: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.

paite: Akhete sihna lam ah apaisuk a; akalsuante'n Sheol zuan in alen tinten hi.
english: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.

paite: Huchi in hinna lampi phei amu kei hi; alampite akip kei a, ama'n athei kei hi.
english: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in, ka tapate, hon ngaikhia unla, ka kam a thute a kipan paimang kei un.
english: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.

paite: Amah a kipan in na lampi gamlapi ah suanmang in, a-inn kongkhak nai ah hong pai ke'n.
english: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,

paite: Huchi lou in zaw midangte kiang ah na zahtakhuaina na pe kha ding a, na kumte gilou kiang ah.
english: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;

paite: Huchi lou in zaw na hatna in mikhualte avah kha ding ua, gamdangmi inn ah na sepgimnate a-om kha ding;
english: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.

paite: Huan na sa leh na pumpi hihgawp a a-om lai in na tawpna nanung ah na sun kha ding.
english: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,

paite: Huchi in hilhna za nuam lou hi na tel ing e, ka lungtang in salhna na musit na tel e, na chi kha ding.
english: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof.

paite: Hon sinsak mite aw ka mang kei a, kei hon hilhte lam leng ka bil in ka na doh kei.
english: I haven’t obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!

paite: Omkhawmte leh kikhawmpite lak ah gilou tengteng ah siatna ka na hita mahmah hi.
english: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”

paite: Nangmah tuibem a kipan tuite dawn in, nangmah tuileh a kipan tui luang laite.
english: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.

paite: Na tui nak neite suk thanghuaigawp a om ding hia, kongzingte ah na luite?
english: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?

paite: Nangmah a ding kia hi uhen, nang kiang a mikhualte ding hilou in.
english: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.

paite: Na tuikhuk vualzawl in om hen; huan na tuailai zi ah kipak in.
english: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.

paite: Deihhuai sazukpi leh heksiam sakhipi bang. A-itna leh ngaihnatna in chik lai peuh in leng nang hon lungkimsak gige hen; huan a-itna a vak in om gige in.
english: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.

paite: Bangziak in ahia, ka tapa, numei lamdang vak a om a, mikhual ang va kawi ding na hia?
english: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?

paite: Mihing lampite lah TOUPA mit ma ah a-om ngal a, ama'n alampite tengteng apheisak hi.
english: For the ways of man are before Yahweh’s eyes. He examines all his paths.

paite: Giloute amah thulimlouhnate'n aman ding a, akhelhna guite a kan in a-om ding hi.
english: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.

paite: Hilhna taksap ziak in asi ding a; ahaina thupina ah apaimang ding hi.
english: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.

paite: Ka tapa, na inveng a dia moh khu dia nai dinleh mikhual a ding a na khut na kichiamleh,
english: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,

paite: na kam a thute a awk na hih a, na kam a thute a mat na hihleh,
english: you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.

paite: tu in hiai hih in, ka tapa, nang leh nang kihonkhia in, na inveng khut sung ah na om chih thei in; kuan in, nang leh nang kiniamkhiak inla, na inveng va ngen ngutngut in.
english: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.

paite: Na mitte ihmusak ke'nla, na mitvunte leng lususak sam ke'n.
english: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.

paite: Gamvakpa khut a sakhipi bang leh thangkampa khut a vasa bang in kihonkhia in.
english: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

paite: Miksi kiang ah hoh in, nang thadah; alampite ngaihtuah inla, pil in.
english: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;

paite: Hausa, heutu, hiam vaihawmmi, nei lou in,
english: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

paite: nipi chiang in an asutuah ua, pawltak chiang in an akaikhawm hi.
english: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.

paite: Bang tan ihmu ding na hia, aw thadah? Na ihmutna a kipan chikchiang a thou ding na hia?
english: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?

paite: Neukha ihmut lai, neukha lusuk, ihmu ding a neukha khutte khep.
english: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep—

paite: Huchi in na gentheihna guta bang in ahong pai dia, huan na taksapna mi kigalthuam bang in.
english: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.

paite: Miphatuamlou, migilou; kam ki-uangsak toh avak a;
english: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,

paite: amitte in chiamtehna abawl a, akhete in thu agen a, akhutzungte in chiamtehna abawl a;
english: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,

paite: alungtang sung ah hoihlouhna a-om a, gilou agel gige a; kilemlouhna atuh naknak hi.
english: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.

paite: Huaiziak in atuahsiatna thakhat in ahong tung ding a; thakhat a kekgawp in, hihdamna bei in a-om ding hi.
english: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.

paite: Toupa'n amuhdah thil guk a-om a; ahi, amah a dia kihhuai sagih a-om hi.
english: There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:

paite: Mit ki-uangsakte, lei zuauthei, mihoih sisan suah khutte;
english: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,

paite: Ngaihtuahna gilou ngaihtuah lungtang, siatna hih ding a kintaite;
english: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,

paite: Zuauthu gen palai taklou, leh unaute lak a kilemlouhna chi tuh.
english: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.

paite: Ka tapa, na pa thupiak zui in, huan na nu dan mangngilh ke'n.
english: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.

paite: Na lungtang tung ah vial gige inla, na ngawng kim ah gak in.
english: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.

paite: Na vak chiang in, nang ahon pi ding a; na ihmut chiang in, nang ahon veng ding hi; huan na khanloh chiang in, nang ahon houpih ding hi.
english: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.

paite: Thupiak lah khawnvak ahi ngal a; huan dan vakna ahi; huchi in hilhna taihilhna hinna lampi ahi.
english: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,

paite: Numei gilou a kipan leh mikhual lei maitang phatna a kipan in nang hon kem ding hi.
english: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.

paite: Na lungtang in akilawmna lunggulh ke'n; amitvunte'n nang hon man kei hen.
english: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.

paite: Numei kizuaknu ziak in pasal tanghou them a mat in a-om hi; huchi in angkawmnu'n hinna manpha azong sek hi.
english: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.

paite: Mi'n a-angsung ah mei ala thei diam, apuante akang kei diam?
english: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?

paite: Ahihkeileh mi suangkuangthei sa tung ah avak thei diam, akhete akang kei diam?
english: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?

paite: Huchibang in kuapeuh invengte zi zuan; kuapeuh amah khoih gawt louh a-om kei ding.
english: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.

paite: Guta in agilkial ziak a alunggulhna taisak ding kia a agukleh mite'n guta amusit kei uhi.
english: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry,

paite: Himahleh muh a a-omleh, azah sagih in adin ding a; a-inn a van tengteng ape ding hi.
english: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.

paite: Kuapeuh angkawm theihsiamna bei ahi; amah kha hihse ding a ahih ahi.
english: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.

paite: Liamnate leh zumhuaite amu ding; huan azahpihhuaina nulmang ahi kei ding.
english: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.

paite: Mullitna lah mi thangpaihna ahi ngal a; huchi in phulak ni chiang in ahawi kei ding hi.
english: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.

paite: Tatna alimsak kei ding a; thilpiak tampi pe lechin leng, lungdam in a-om kei ding hi.
english: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.

paite: Ka tapa, ka thute kem in, na kiang ah ka thupiakte kholkhawm in.
english: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.

paite: Ka thupiakte kem inla hing in; huan ka dan na mittang bang in,
english: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.

paite: na khutzungte tung ah vial inla; na lungtang suangpek tung ah gelh in.
english: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

paite: Pilna kiang ah, "Ka sanggamnu na hi," chi inla, theihsiamna na tanaunu chi in.
english: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,

paite: Numei lamdang a kipan nang ahon keptheihna ding un, athute a maitangphatnu mikhual a kipan.
english: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.

paite: Ka inn tohlet a pan ka dakkhia a, tohlet vang kal ah ka en paisuak a;
english: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.

paite: huan mimawlte lak ah ka en a, tuailaite lak ah ka theikak a, tangval theihsiamna beipa,
english: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,

paite: a-omna ningchin a kongzing a paisuak a, a-inn lam zuan a pai zelpa;
english: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,

paite: khomui in, nitaklam in, zan mial bikbek leh khomial ah.
english: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.

paite: Ngai in, numei khat, kizuak puansilh silh, lungtang kiva in akituahpih a.
english: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.

paite: Amah ahi lawlaw a, atum tuntun a; akhe a-inn ah a-om ngei kei.
english: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.

paite: Kongzing a om ton a-om a, mun liante a a-om ton a-om a, ning chiteng abuk zel hi.
english: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.

paite: Huchi in amah amanta a, amah atawpta a, zummoh maitang toh in akiang ah.
english: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:

paite: Lemna kithoihnate ka kiang ah a-om; tuni in ka thuchiamte ka peta hi.
english: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.

paite: Huaiziak in nang tuak ding in ka hong paikhia a, na mel thanuamtak a zong ding in, ka hon muta hi.
english: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.

paite: Ka tutna nuam pialkhang phah zehoihte a zep, ka phah khinta, Aigupta khau puan gialte toh.
english: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.

paite: Ka lupna murrah, aloe leh sinamon in ka namtuisakta hi.
english: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

paite: Hong pai in, zingsang matan i itna dimtek i la ding; itna in i kilungmuantuah ding.
english: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.

paite: Ka pasal lah inn ah a-om ngal kei a, khual gamla ah azin hi.
english: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.

paite: Sum ip akitawi a; kha alik chiang in inn ah ahong pai ding, achi hi.
english: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”

paite: Athugen siamna in amah akipesakta a, amuk a maitang phatnate in amah asawlmangta hi.
english: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.

paite: Amah azui pah a, goh ding a bawngtal apai bang in leh mihai bawlhoihna dia sikkhau khihmi bang in;
english: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.

paite: thal in asin akap pailet tan; thang lam a vasa akintat bang in, huai tuh ahinna gun a hih athei kei hi.
english: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.

paite: Tu in, ka tapate, huaiziak in hon ngaikhia un, ka kam a thute limsak un.
english: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.

paite: Na lungtang amah lampi lam ah awn kei henla, lampite lam ah paimang kei hen.
english: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,

paite: Amah lah tampi liamsa in apai lumletta a; ahi, athahsate mihat tampi ahi uh.
english: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.

paite: A-inn Sheol zotna lampi ahi, sihna dantante zuan a sukpai.
english: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.

paite: Pilna akikou in, theihsiamna in a-aw asuah kei maw?
english: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?

paite: Lampi a mun sangte tung ah, lampite kisutna ah adingh a;
english: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.

paite: kongpite biang ah, khopi lutna ah, kongkhakte apailutna ah, nakpi in akikou hi.
english: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:

paite: Noute, aw mite, ka sam; huan ka aw mite tapa kiang ah ahi.
english: “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.

paite: Aw nou mimawlte, kivensiamna theisiam un; nou mihaite, lungtang theisiam nei un.
english: You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!

paite: Za un, thil hoihpente gen ding ka hi ngal a; huan ka mukte honna thil dikte ahi ding hi.
english: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.

paite: Ka kam in thutak gen ding ahi ngal a; gitlouhna ka muk a ding in akihhuai hi.
english: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

paite: Ka kam a thute teng diktatna ah a-om; huaite ah bangmah diklou a-om kei hi.
english: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.

paite: Atheisiam kuapeuh a ding in akichian a, theihna mu amaute a ding in adik hi.
english: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.

paite: Ka hilhna sang unla, dangka hilou in; dangka-eng hoihpen sang in theihna.
english: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.

paite: Rubi suang sang in pilna ahoihzaw hi; huan deihhuai thilte tengteng huai toh tehpih theih ahi kei uh.
english: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.

paite: Kei, pilna, kivensiamna toh ka tengkhawm a, theihna leh theihkakna ka mu hi.
english: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.

paite: TOUPA kihtak a gilou huat ding ahi; kisaktheihna leh, ki-otsakna, gilou lampi leh kam hoih lou, ka hua hi.
english: The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.

paite: Thupha kei a ahi, theihna hoih; theihsiamna leh hatna ka nei hi.
