english: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.

paite: Kei ziak in kumpipate'n vai ahawm ua, lalte'n dikna thu apia uh.
english: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

paite: Kei ziak in lalte'n vai ahawm ua, miliante leh lei a vaihawmte tengteng in.
english: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.

paite: Kei hon itte amau ka it a; kuapeuh hon zong in hon mu hi.
english: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.

paite: Hauhna leh zahna ka kiang ah a-om; ahi, sawt daih hauhna leh diktatna toh.
english: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.

paite: Ka gah dangka-eng sang in ahoihzaw, ahi, dangka-eng hoih sang in; ka sum muhna dangka hoihpen sang in.
english: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.

paite: Diktatna lampi ka zui a, vaihawmna lampite lak ah.
english: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,

paite: Kei hon itte van ka luahsak theih a, agoubawm uh ka dimsak theihna ding in.
english: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.

paite: Toupa'n alampi kipat tung in ahon nei a, nidang a athilhihte ma in.
english: “Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.

paite: Tangtawn a kipan, atung a kipan leh lei om ma a pan koihkip ka hi.
english: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.

paite: Thuknate a-om louh lai in, lakkhiak in ka om a; luikhuk tui a dimte a-om louh lai un.
english: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.

paite: Tangte a-omkip ma a, mualte om ma in lakkhiak in ka om.
english: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;

paite: Lei leh gam bawlkhiak ahih ma in, leivui a khovel abawl nai louh lai in.
english: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.

paite: Vante ahihkip lai in, huai ah ka om; tui thuk maikaih a tehna akoih lai in.
english: When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,

paite: Tung a vante abawlkip lai in; tui thukte tuikhukte ahong hat lai un.
english: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,

paite: Tuipi kiang a agi apiak lai in, huchi a tuite'n athupiak tung a atatleklouhna ding un; lei suangphumte achiamteh lai in.
english: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,

paite: Huai lai in akiang ah ka om, nasemmi heutu bang in; huan niteng in akipahna ka hi a, ama a kipak gige in;
english: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,

paite: atentheihna lei ah; ka kipahna mite tapate kiang ah a-om hi.
english: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in, ka tapate, hon ngaikhia unla; ka lampite zui mite'n nuam asa ngal ua.
english: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.

paite: Hilhna za in pil unla, nial kei un.
english: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.

paite: Mi kei hon za in nuam asa hi, niteng a ka kongpi leh ka kongkhak khuamte a ngak in.
english: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.

paite: Kuapeuh hon mu in hinna amu ua, TOUPA deihsakna tang ding ahi uhi.
english: For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from Yahweh.

paite: Himahleh kuapeuh ka tung a thil hihkhial in amah kha ahihdik kei hi; kei hon hote'n sihna a-it uhi.
english: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”

paite: Pilna in a-inn alam khin a, akhuam sagihte aphut hi.
english: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.

paite: Agante agouta a; a-uain leng ahelta hi; adohkan leng abawl khinta hi.
english: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.

paite: Anungakte asawlkheta a, khopi mun sang penpente tung ah akikou a,
english: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:

paite: mimawl peuhmah, hiai lam ah hong kihei hen; theihsiamna nei lou amah tungtang ahihleh, ama'n akiang ah,
english: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

paite: "Hong in, ka tanghou ne unla, ka helsa ka uain dawn un," achi hi.
english: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!

paite: Paikhia unla, nou mimawlte, hing un; theihsiamna lampi ah pai un.
english: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”

paite: Musitmi bawlhoih in amah a ding in zumhuaina amu; huan kuapeuh migilou-salou in amah a ding in minsiatna amu.
english: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.

paite: Musitmi sal dah in, nang ahon ho kha ding; mipil sal in, huchi in nang ahon it ding.
english: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.

paite: Mipil kiang ah hilhna pe lechin, apilzaw lai ding a; midiktat sinsak in.
english: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.

paite: TOUPA kihtak pilna bul ahi; misiangthou theihna theihsiamna ahi.
english: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

paite: Kei ziak in na nite lah hihtam ahi ding a, na damsung kumte hihpun ahi ding hi.
english: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.

paite: Na pilleh, nangmah a dia pil na hi. Huan mi na muhsitleh, nang kia in na po ding hi.
english: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.

paite: Numei hai a-aphuai; mimawl ahi a, bangmah athei kei.
english: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.

paite: Huan a-inn kongkhak ah atu a, khopi mun sangte atutphah tung ah,
english: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

paite: avialpaite sam ding, alampite ua pai zelte,
english: to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,

paite: mimawl kuapeuh, hiai lai ah hong kihei hen; huan amah theihsiamna nei lou tungtang ahihleh, ama'n akiang ah,
english: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

paite: tuigukte akhum a, aguk a tanghou nek anuam, achi hi.
english: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”

paite: Himahleh ama'n huai ah misite a-om uh chih leh amichialte Sheol thuk ah a-om uh chih athei kei hi.
english: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.

paite: Pathian limsakloute hoihsak bang a om ngei lou a, mikhialte lampi a leng dingh lou a, musitte tutphah a leng tu ngeiloumi ahampha hi.
english: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;

paite: Akipahna tuh TOUPA dan ah ahi zaw a; adan thu sun leh zan in angaihtuah ngitnget hi.
english: but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.

paite: Amah zaw tui luang kiang a sing suan ahun a gah zel, anah leng kau ngei lou bang ahi a; athilhih peuhmah alamzang zel ding hi.
english: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

paite: Pathian limsakloute huchibang ahi kei ua; buhsi huih in amut lengmang bang ahi zaw uhi.
english: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.

paite: Huaiziak in mi Pathian limsakloute zaw vaihawmna ma ah adingh thei kei ding uh, mikhialte leng midiktatte omkhopna ah adingh thei sam kei ding uhi.
english: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

paite: TOUPA'N midiktatte lampi athei naknak ngal a; mikhialte lampi bel amangthang ding hi.
english: For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.

paite: TOUPA aw, bang achia gamlapi a dingh nak na hia? Bang achia mangbat lai bang a kisel nak?
english: Why do you stand far off, Yahweh? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

paite: Migilou-salou kisaktheihna ziak in migentheite delh in a-om uhi, athil gilou ngaihtuahkhiakte uah amau mah awk uhen.
english: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.

paite: Migilou-salou in alungtang ut lam asuang, mihuaiham in TOUPA apaikhia a, amusit hi.
english: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns Yahweh.

paite: Migilou-salou in kisaktheih melpu in, angaihtuahna ah, Pathian a-om kei, achi hi. Angaihtuahna tengteng tuh, Pathian a-om kei, chih ngen ahi.
english: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.

paite: A-omdante tuh chik lai peuh in leng akip a; na vaihawmnate tunglam gamlapi ah, amuh bat louh ah, a-om hi; Amah doute tengteng lah anuihsan maimah ngal a.
english: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.

paite: Alungsim in, "Ka ling kei ding, khang tengteng tan in mangbang in ka om kei ding," achi hi.
english: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”

paite: Akam hamse lohnate, khemnate, mengbawlnate in adim a; alei nuai ah thilhihkhelhna leh siatna a-om hi.
english: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.

paite: Kho teng a guktanna munte ah atu zel a; mundai ah khelhna nei lou mite athat zel hi, amit in tasam mite aguktan nak ahi.
english: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.

paite: Humpinelkai in akua a aguktan bang in ama'n mundai ah aguktan zel hi; mitasam man ding in atang zel a, mitasam aman ngei a, huchi in alen in akaimang nak hi.
english: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net.

paite: Abokkhup a, akun a, bangmah hihthei lou amihatte uh hihpuk in a-om nak uhi.
english: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.

paite: Alungsim ah, Pathian in amangngilh ahi; amai asel a, chik mah chiang in amu kei ding, achi hi.
english: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”

paite: TOUPA aw, thou in; Pathian aw, na khut lik in, migentheite mangngilh ke'n;
english: Arise, Yahweh! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.

paite: Bangziak in ahia migilou-salou in Pathian amuhsit, alungsim a, na phut kei ding, achih nak?
english: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?

paite: Muh zaw na mu khin tham a; na khut a thuk ding thil hihkhial leh hihvuina na en a, migentheite na kiang ah akikemsak ua; pa nei lou panpihpa na hi.
english: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.

paite: Migilou-salou ban sutan inla, migilou, gitlouhna zongkhia in, na muh het louh mateng.
english: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.

paite: TOUPA tangtawn tangtawn a ding in Kumpipa ahi a; namte amah gam a pan in amangthang uhi.
english: Yahweh is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.

paite: TOUPA, kingainiamte deihna na ngaikhia a; alungtang uh na kisasak ding a, abil un leng na zasak ding hi.
english: Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,

paite: Pa neiloute leh nuaisiah a omte, leitung mi'n a-engbawl nawnlouhna ding un, avai uh hawmsak in.
english: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.

paite: Gam tengteng aw, TOUPA pahtawi in nuamsatak in kikou un.
english: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!

paite: Kipak kawm in TOUPA nna sem unla; la sa kawm in ama ah hong pai un.
english: Serve Yahweh with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

paite: TOUPA tuh Pathian ahi chih thei un; hon bawlpa amah ahi a, amah a i hi ua; amite leh agantatna mun a belamte i hi.
english: Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

paite: Kipahthu gen kawm in akongkhak ah lut unla, phat kawm in ahuangsung intual ah lut un; akiang ah kipahthu gen unla, amin phat un.
english: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

paite: TOUPA ahoih ngal a; azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding hi, amuanhuaidan suan tengteng tan in a-om ding hi.
english: For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.

paite: Zahngaihna leh vaihawmna dik thu la in ka sa ding a; TOUPA aw, nangmah phat in la ka sa ding.
english: A Psalm by David. I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, Yahweh, I will sing praises.

paite: Lam hoihkim ah piltak in ka om ding. Aw chikchiang in ahia ka kiang a na hong pai ding? Ka insung ah lungtang hoihkim pu in ka om ding hi.
english: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.

paite: Thil hoihloute ka mitmuh ah ka koih kei ding, lampialte thilhih ka hua ahi; keimah ah abang kei ding hi.
english: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.

paite: Lungtang genhak in hon paisan ding a; thil gilou himhim ka thei kei ding hi.
english: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.

paite: Kuapeuh a-invengte aguk a gen, huai mi ka hihmang ding a; mi mit tunghah leh lungtang kisathei pumi ka thuak thei kei ding hi.
english: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.

paite: Hiai gam a mi muanhuaite tung ah ka mit atu ding a, ka kiang a a-omtheihna ding un; lam hoihkim tawnmi in ka nna asem ding hi.
english: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.

paite: Khem hat ka insung ah a-om kei ding a; ka mitmuh ah mizuauhat hihkip in a-om kei ding hi.
english: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.

paite: Zingsang teng in hiai gam a migilou-salou tengteng ka hihmang ding a; TOUPA khopi a kipan thil hihkhial tengteng hihmang ding in.
english: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from Yahweh’s city.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka thumna ngaikia inla ka kikou husa na kiang hong tung hen.
english: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before Yahweh. Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you.

paite: Ka mangbat ni in ka lak ah na mai sel ke'nla, kei lam ah na bil hon doh in; ka hon sap chiang in hon dawng pah in.
english: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.

paite: Ka damsung nite meikhu bang in azammang a, ka guhte taptung bang in asa hi.
english: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.

paite: Ka lungtang loupa bang in hailum in a-om a, avuaita hi; tanghou nek ding ka mangngilhta ngal a.
english: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.

paite: Ka thum husa ziak in ka guhte kasa ah abelh bikbek ahi.
english: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.

paite: Gamdai tuivapi bang ka hi a; kho tul simbu bang ka hita hi.
english: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.

paite: Ka hak gige a, inn tung a kawlgit amah kia a om bang ka hita hi.
english: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.

paite: Hon doute'n nitum in hon gensia ua; ka tung a hangsante'n keimah bang a om ding in hamsia alou uhi.
english: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.

paite: Vut an bang in ka ne a, ka dawn ding in khitui toh ka helta ngal a.
english: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,

paite: Na lung hih louh mahmah leh na heh ziak in; nang na hon domkang a, na hon paimangta hi.
english: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.

paite: Ka damsung nite limliap kiam bang ahi a; loupa bang in ka vuaita hi.
english: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang bel tangtawn in na om ding a; nangmah theihgigena suan tengteng tan in a-om lai ding hi.
english: But you, Yahweh, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.

paite: Na thou ding a, Zion tang na hehpih ding a; amah lah deihsak ahunta ngal a, ahi, hun seh atungta hi.
english: You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.

paite: Na sikhate'n asuangte a-it un, aleivui leng ahehpih ngal uhi.
english: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.

paite: Huchi in namte'n TOUPA min alau ding ua, leitung a kumpipate tengteng in na thupina leng alau ding uhi.
english: So the nations will fear Yahweh’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.

paite: TOUPA'N Zion adinsak hun in, athupina in ahong kilang ding hi;
english: For Yahweh has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.

paite: Tagahte thumna alimsak a, athumna uh amusit kei hi.
english: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.

paite: Huai khangthak hong om dingte a ding in gelh ahi ding a, nam siam a hong om ding in TOUPA aphat ding hi.
english: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise Yah,

paite: Ama'n amun siangthou sangpi a kipan in a-ensuk a; TOUPA'N van a kipan in lei amu a;
english: for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, Yahweh saw the earth,

paite: Suangkul tangte thumging ngaikhe ding leh, si ding a sehte khahkhe ding in;
english: to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,

paite: Huchi a mite'n Zion ah TOUPA min agenthang ua, Jerusalem a aphatna agenthang theihna ding un.
english: that men may declare Yahweh’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,

paite: Mite akikhawmkhawm ua, kumpigamte toh, TOUPA nasem ding in.
english: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve Yahweh.

paite: Ama'n lam lak ah ka tha abahsak a; ka damsung ahihtom hi.
english: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.

paite: Ka Pathian aw, ka hat lai nite in hon lamang ke'n, ka chi a, nang kum suan om sung tengteng in a-om ding hi.
english: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.

paite: Leitung kingakna nidang a na phumsa ahi a; vante leng na khutsuak ahi.
english: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.

paite: Huaite tuh ahong mang ding a, nang zaw na omden ding hi; ahi, huai tengteng puansilh bang in ahong lui ding ua; puan bang in na khek ding a, ahong lamdangta ding hi.
english: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.

paite: Nang zaw na ngeingei a, na kumte'n bei ni anei kei ding.
english: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.

paite: Na sikhate tate a-om gige ding ua, asuante uh na ma ah hihkip in a-om ding uhi.
english: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”

paite: Ka hinna aw, TOUPA phat inla; ka sung a om tengteng aw, amin siangthou phat in!
english: By David. Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!

paite: Ka hinna aw, TOUPA phat inla, athil hihhoih tengteng mangngilh ke'n.
english: Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,

paite: Ama'n na thulimlouhna tengteng angaidam a; na natna tengteng ahihdam hi.
english: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,

paite: Manthatna lak a kipan na hinna atan a; zahngaihna leh lainatnate ahon khusak hi.
english: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,

paite: Na kam thil hoih in ataisak a; huchi in na valnouna muvanlai bang in siam thak in a-om nawn hi.
english: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

paite: TOUPA'N, nuaisiahna thuak tengteng a ding in thil kizente hihsak in, vai ahawmsak nak hi.
english: Yahweh executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.

paite: Alampite Mosi atheisak a, athilhihte Israel suante leng atheisak hi.
english: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.

paite: TOUPA lainatna a dim, mihehpih theitak, lungneltak, zahngaihna hautak ahi.
english: Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.

paite: Ama'n atai kei ding a; ahehna apai nilouh sam kei ding hi.
english: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.

paite: I khelhnate bang in i tung uah ahih kei a, i thulimlouhnate bang in ahon thuk sam kei hi.
english: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.

paite: Van, leitung sangtak a a-om bang in, amah laute tung ah azahngaihna alian mahmah ahi.
english: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.

paite: Suahlam leh tumlam a kigamlat bang in, i tatleknate tuh eimah a kipan in akoihmangta hi.
english: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

paite: Pa'n atate ahehpih bang in, TOUPA'N amah laute ahehpih hi.
english: Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.

paite: I pumpi kibawlkhiakdan athei a; leivui lel i hi chih atheih ziak in.
english: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.

paite: Mihing damsung nite loupa bang ahi a; loubuk a pak bang in alun hi.
english: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

paite: Huih in amut a, amang hi; a-omna mun in athei nawnta kei ding hi.
english: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.

paite: TOUPA zahngaihna bel amah kihtate tung ah tangtawn a pan tangtawn pha in a-om ding a, adiktatna leng ata suan atu suan tan un a-om ding hi.
english: But Yahweh’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,

paite: Athukhun zui peuhmahte leh, athuhilhte man tum a theigige peuhmahte tung ah.
english: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.

paite: TOUPA'N alaltutphah van ah ahihkip a; agam in bangkim tung ah vai ahawm hi.
english: Yahweh has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.

paite: Athu ngaikhia a, athu mang nou a-angelte aw, hatna a thupite aw, TOUPA phat un.
english: Praise Yahweh, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.

paite: Asepaihte aw, adeihlam hih a nasemte aw, TOUPA phat un.
english: Praise Yahweh, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.

paite: Avaihawmna mun peuhmah a athilhih tengteng aw, TOUPA phat un; ka hinna aw, TOUPA phat in.
english: Praise Yahweh, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise Yahweh, my soul!

paite: Ka hinna aw, TOUPA phat in, TOUPA ka Pathian aw, nang na thupi mahmah a; pahtawina leh thupina in na kithuam hi.
english: Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.

paite: Nang puan bang in vak na silh a; puanin tung bang in vante na kaipalh a;
english: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.

paite: Ama'n adantan sunggil kalvaite tuite ah akhung a; meipi kangtalai in abawl a; huih khate tung ah avak hi.
english: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.

paite: Ama'n angelte huih asuaksak a; anasemte meikuang zuazua asuaksak hi.
english: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.

paite: Leitung kingaknate na phum a, tangtawn a alinlouhna ding in.
english: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.

paite: Nang leilung thukpi puan bang in na silhsak a; tuite tang tungte ah a-om pheuphou hi.
english: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.

paite: Na taihilhna ziak in ataimang a; na vanpiging husa ziak in apaimang pah hi;
english: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.

paite: Tang tung ah apaitou a, phaizangte ah apaisuk a, amah a dia mun na bawlsakna lam ah.
english: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.

paite: Akan louh ding in gi na khung a, lei tupmang ding a akik nawn taklouhna ding in.
english: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.

paite: Ama'n phaizangte ah luinak asawlkhia a; mualte kikal ah aluang hi.
english: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.

paite: Huaite'n gamsate kiang ah dawn ding tui apia ua; Gam sabiltungte'n adangtak uh ahihdai uhi.
english: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.

paite: Akung uah tungleng vasate'n omna anei ua, singbawk lak ah aham uhi.
english: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.

paite: Ama'n adantan tungnung a kipan in tui in mualte avak a; na thilhih gahte in leitung atai hi.
english: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.

paite: Gante a ding in loupa apousak a, mihing a ding in haichi; lei a kipan nek ding apawtna ding in.
english: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:

paite: Mihing lungtang kipahsakna uain toh, amai kilawmsakna ding thau toh, mihing lungtang hihhatna tanghou toh.
english: wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.

paite: TOUPA singte tui in adim ua, Lebanon tang a asuan sidar singte mah,
english: Yahweh’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted,

paite: huai ah vasate'n bu asep sep ua; vakang bel meilah singte a- inn ahi.
english: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.

paite: Mual sangte sathak a ding ahi a; suangpite zusapi a ding in kihumbitna ahi.
english: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.

paite: Ama'n kha hunbi theihna ding in asep a; ni in tum hun atheigige hi.
english: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.

paite: Nang mial na bawl a, zan ahong hi zel hi, huai hun in gamnuai a sa khempeuhte atakhia uhi.
english: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.

paite: Humpinelkai hatlaite'n asamat ding uh humham khum in, Pathian kiang a kipan anek ding uh azong uhi.
english: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.

paite: Ni asuak a, apaimang ua, a-omna khuk chiat uah akual zel uhi.
english: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.

paite: Mihing nasem in apawt a, nitaklam tan in asemgim hi.
english: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.

paite: TOUPA aw, na thilhihte tam hi na tel e! Pilna in na bawl vek ahi; leitung na hauhsakna in adim hi.
english: Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.

paite: Pam ah tuipi a-om a, thupi, lianpitak, huai ah thil bokvak a pai sim zoh louh a-om a, sa neu leh sa liante.
english: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.

paite: Huai ah longte apai uh; huai ah Leviathan a-om a, asung a mawl ding a na bawl ngei.
english: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.

paite: Huaite teng in ahon ngak chiat ua, ahuntak a a-an uh na piak zelna ding in.
english: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.

paite: Akiang ua na piakte atawm ua; na khut na zak a, na hoihna in atai uhi.
english: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.

paite: Na mai na sel a, alungzing ua, ahatna uh na laksak a, asi ua, amau leivui ah akik nawn uhi.
english: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.

paite: Na kha na sawlkhia a, siam in a-om zel uhi; leitung melpuak na thaksak zel hi.
english: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.

paite: TOUPA thupina tangtawn in om henla; TOUPA anasep ah nuam hen.
english: Let Yahweh’s glory endure forever. Let Yahweh rejoice in his works.

paite: Ama'n lei a-en a, aling nak; mualte akhoih a, akhukhe nak hi.
english: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

paite: Ka damsung teng in TOUPA pahtawi in la ka sa ding a; ka hin lai teng in ka Pathian phat in la ka sa ding hi.
english: I will sing to Yahweh as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

paite: Ka ngaihtuahna amah a ding in khumtak hi hen; TOUPA ah ka nuam ding hi.
english: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.

paite: Mikhialte lei a kipan hihman in om uhenla, migilou-saloute om nawn kei uhen! Ka hinna aw, TOUPA phat in! TOUPA phat un!
english: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless Yahweh, my soul. Praise Yah!

paite: Aw, TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu gen unla, amin lou un; michih lak ah athilhihte theisak un.
english: Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.

paite: Amah pahtawi in la sa unla, amah phat in la sa un; athillamdang hih tengteng thu in houlim un.
english: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.

paite: Amin siangthou suang un; TOUPA zongte lungtang nuamsa hen.
english: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.

paite: TOUPA leh ahatna zong unla; amel zong gige un.
english: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

paite: Anasep zohsa lamdangte, athillamdangte leh akam a vaihawmnate theigige un;
english: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

paite: Asikha Abraham suante aw, atelte Jakob tate aw.
english: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

paite: Amah TOUPA i Pathian ahi a; avaihawmte leitung ah a-om hi.
english: He is Yahweh, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

paite: Athukhun tangtawn in atheigige hi, suan sangkhat tan a athu na piak ngei;
english: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

paite: Abraham kiang a athukhun leh, Isak kiang a akichiamna ngei;
english: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,

paite: Huai mah dan thuseh a ding in Jakob kiang ah ahihkip a, Israel kiang a tangtawn thukhun ding in.
english: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

paite: Kanaan gam na kiang ah ka hon pe dia, na goutan tuam ding in chi in.
english: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”

paite: Mi tawmchik phet ahih lai un; ahi, tawmchik phet, huai gam ah mikhual ahi ngal ua;
english: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

paite: Nam tuamtuam kiang ah apai ua, gam tuamtuam a kipan in mi tuamtuamte kiang ah,
english: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

paite: Kuamah nuaisiah aphal kei a, ahi, amau ziak in kumpipate ataihilh a,
english: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

paite: Ka thaunilhte khoih kei unla, ka zawlneite hih na kei un, chi in.
english: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

paite: Huai gam a tung ding in kial asam a; nek ding himhim a-omsakta kei hi.
english: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.

paite: Ama uah mi asawl a; sikha ding in Joseph zuak in a-om a,
english: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.

paite: akhete kol in ahih na ua; sik khainiang bun in a-om hi.
english: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,

paite: Athu atun masiah, TOUPA thu in amah aze-et gige hi.
english: until the time that his word happened, and Yahweh’s word proved him true.

paite: Kumpipa'n mi sawl in, akhahkhia a, mite vaihawmpa ngei in asuaktasak hi.
english: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

paite: A-insung a heutu ding leh, asum tengteng tung a vaihawm ding in abawl a,
english: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,

paite: Amiliante a-utut a hen ding leh; a-upate hihpil ding in.
english: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.

paite: Israel leng Aigupta gam ah ahoh a; Ham gam ah Jakob a-om tadih hi.
english: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.

paite: Amite nakpitak in apungsak a, amau doute sang in ahihhat zawta hi.
english: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.

paite: Amite ho ding in alungtang uh alehngatsak a, asikhate tung a lepchiahtak a hih ding in.
english: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

paite: Asikha Mosi asawl a, amitel Aaron toh.
english: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

paite: Amau achiamtehnate alak uah a-ensak ua, Ham gam ah thillamdangte a- ensak uhi.
english: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

paite: Ama'n mial asawl a, ahihmialta a; huchi in athute anialta kei uhi.
english: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.

paite: Atuite uh sisan asuaksak a, a ngasate uh ahihlumta hi.
english: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.

paite: Agam uh ukeng in adimta a, kumpipa dantan sung nangawn ah.
english: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.

paite: Ama'n thu agen a, thou tampi hong pai ua, hik leng agamsung pumpi uah ahong om uhi.
english: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.

paite: Akiang uah vuah sik in gial apia a, agam uah meikuang zualzual apeta hi.
english: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.

paite: Agrep guite leh atheipi kungte uh asisak a; agam ua singte akitansakta hi.
english: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.

paite: Ama'n thu agen a, khaupete ahong pai ua, lungte toh, sim zoh vual louh in.
english: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.

paite: Huaite'n agam ua haichiteng anegai ua, aleigahte uh leng agai uhi.
english: They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.

paite: Agam ua ta masa om tengteng athat a, ahatna tengteng ua gah masapente uh.
english: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.

paite: Huchi in dangka leh dangka- eng toh apikheta a; amah namte lak ah mihat lou khat leng a-om kei hi.
english: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.

paite: Apawt lai un Aiguptate akipak ua, amau alau tak ziak un.
english: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.

paite: Ama'n aliah ding in meipi akaisak a, zan a tanvak ding in meikuang leng apia hi.
english: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.

paite: Angen ua, huchi in vamim apia a, van an in amau ataisakta hi.
english: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.

paite: Suangpi ahong a, huchi in tui ahong pawt zuazua a, mun keute ah lui bang in aluangta hi.
english: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.

paite: Athu siangthou atheigige a, asikha Abraham toh.
english: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.

paite: Huchi in amite nuamsatak in apikheta a, amitelte lasa kawmkawm in.
english: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.

paite: Namte' gamte akiang uah apia a; amau michih sepkhiaksa aluahta uhi.
english: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,

paite: Adan thusehte azuihtheihna ding un, adante akephoihna ding in, TOUPA phat un.
english: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise Yah!

paite: TOUPA phat un, Aw, TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu hilh un; amah lah ahoih ngal a, azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding hi.
english: Praise Yahweh! Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

paite: Kua ahia TOUPA thilhih thupitakte gen thei a, aphatnate theisak vek thei?
english: Who can utter the mighty acts of Yahweh, or fully declare all his praise?

paite: Vaihawmna kemhoihte'n nuam asa uhi, chik lai peuh a diktattak a hihmi toh.
english: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.

paite: TOUPA aw, na mite na deihsakna in hon theigige inla, Aw, na hotdamna toh hong veh in.
english: Remember me, Yahweh, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,

paite: Na mitelte hamphatna ka muh theih a, na namte kipahna a nop ka sak theih a, na gouluahte toh ka suantheihna ding in.
english: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.

paite: Ka pipute uh bang in thil ka hihkhial ua, tatsetak ka hi ua, giloutak in ka om uhi.
english: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.

paite: Ka pipute un Aigupta gam a na thillamdang hihte atheisiam kei ua; na zahngaihna thupitak atheigige nawn kei ua, tuipi ah ahel zawta uh; Tuipi San ah.
english: Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

paite: Huchi pipi in leng ama min ziak in amaute ahondamta a, athilhihtheihna thupitak atheihsakna ding in.
english: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.

paite: Tuipi San atai a, huchi in akangta a; huan amau gamdai a pi paisuak bang in tui thukte ah api paisuakta hi.
english: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.

paite: Amau homi khut a kipan ahondam a, melma khut a kipan atanta hi.
english: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

paite: Tuite'n amau doute akhuh khin a, khat leng dam a pawt a- omta kei uhi.
english: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.

paite: Huai lai in athute agingta ua; aphatna la asa uhi.
english: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.

paite: Himahleh athilhihte amangngilh zok ua; alunggelna angak ngamta kei uhi;
english: They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,

paite: gamdai ah thil alunggulh mahmah ua, gamkeu ah Pathian aze-etta uhi.
english: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.

paite: Athilnget uh apia a; himahleh ahinna uah gawnna alutsakta hi.
english: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.

paite: Agiahphual uah Mosi ahaza ua, TOUPA misiangthou Aaron toh.
english: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, Yahweh’s saint.

paite: Lei akamka a, Dathan avalhta, Abiram pawlte akhuh khin hi.
english: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

paite: Apawl lak uah mei kuansak in ahong om a, meikuang ah migilou-saloute akangmang uhi.
english: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.

paite: Horeb tang ah bawngnou lim abawl ua, alim sun abeta uhi.
english: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.

paite: Huchibang in athupina uh bawngtal loupa ne bang phet asuaksakta uhi.
english: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.

paite: Pathian ahondampa uh, Aigupta gam a thil thupitak hihpa amangngilhta uhi.
english: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,

paite: Ham gam a thillamdangte, Tuipi San dung a thil mulkimhuaite hihte.
english: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.

paite: Huaiziak in ahihmang kha ding, achi a, ahehna heimang ding in alutna ding ah ama ah amitel Mosi na dingh kei ngialleh, ahihmang ding chih agen hi.
english: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them.

paite: Ahi, gam deihhuaitak angaineu ua, athu agingta nuam kei ua;
english: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,

paite: apuanin uah aphun zaw ua, TOUPA aw angaikhe nuam kei uhi.
english: but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to Yahweh’s voice.

paite: Huaiziak in amau lam ah akhut azak a, amaute gamdai a ahihpukna ding leh,
english: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,

paite: achisuan dingte uh namte lak a ahihpuk a, gam chih a ahihzakna ding in.
english: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.

paite: Baal-peor azom ua, misi kiang a thillatte ane samta uhi.
english: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

paite: Huchibang in athilhihte un amah asuheh ua; atung uah hipi aleng hi.
english: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.

paite: Phinehas adingh a, vai ahawm a; huchi in hipi daihsak in a- omta hi.
english: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.

paite: Huai amah diktatna a seh ahi, tangtawn in suan tengteng tan in.
english: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.

paite: Meribah tuite ah amah ahihheh ua, amau ziak in Mosi tung ah thil hoih lou atung hial hi.
english: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;

paite: Akha tung ah ahel ua, amuk in thu kilawmloupi agen ziak in.
english: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.

paite: TOUPA'N akiang ua hihman thu apiak bang in namte ahihmang kei ua.
english: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as Yahweh commanded them,

paite: Namte akihelpih ua, athilhihte uh aching zaw ua;
english: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.

paite: amilim nnate uh asem ua; huaite amau a ding in thang ahong hita hi.
english: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.

paite: Ahi, dawite kiang ah atapate leh atanute un akithoih ua,
english: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

paite: sisan gensiatbei, atapate uleh atanute uh sisan asuah ua, huaite in Kanaan gam milimte kiang ah akithoih uhi; huai gam sisan in ana ninta hi.
english: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.

paite: Huchi in anasepte un ahihnin ua, athilhihte un ang a kawm uhi.
english: Thus they were defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA amite tung ah athangpaita a, agouluah akih hi.
english: Therefore Yahweh burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.

paite: Huchi in namte khut ah amau apia a; amau hote'n atung uah vai ahawm uhi.
english: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.

paite: Amau doute'n anuaisiah ua, akhut uah hihneu in a-om uhi.
english: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.

paite: Tamveipi amaute ahumbit a; himahleh alunggelna uah ahel nak uhi, agitlouh satlouhna uah hihniam in a-omta uhi.
english: He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.

paite: Huchipi in leng ama'n, akikou husa uh za in, amangbatna uh alimsak ahi.
english: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.

paite: Athukhun amau atheisak gige a, azahngaihna thupidan bang zel in alungsim akisikta hi.
english: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

paite: Sal a pi tengteng amau ahehpihsak hi.
english: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian uh aw, hon hondam inla, namte lak a pan hon pikhawm in, na min siangthou phat ding leh na phatna suang ding in.
english: Save us, Yahweh, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!

paite: TOUPA, Israel' Pathian, phat in om hen, tangtawn a kipan tangtawn pha in leng, mi tengteng in, Amen, chi uhen, TOUPA phat un.
english: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise Yah!

paite: Aw TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu hilh un; amah ahoih ngal a; azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding hi.
english: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

paite: TOUPA tatsate'n huai gen uhen, doumi khut a kipan atatkhiakte'n.
english: Let the redeemed by Yahweh say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

paite: Gam teng a kipan apikhawm a, suahlam leh tumlam, simlam leh mallam a kipan in.
english: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

paite: Gamdai a gamkeu lampi ah avakvak ua; tenna ding khua himhim amu kei uhi.
english: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.

paite: Gilkial leh dangtak in ahinna uh agilsung uah abahta hi.
english: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

paite: Huaitak in abuaina uah TOUPA asam ua, ama'n alungkhamna uah ahumbit hi.
english: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

paite: Mihing tenna khua a apaitheihna ding un, lampi tangtak ah apikheta hi.
english: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.

paite: Aw, mihingte'n TOUPA azahngaihna ziak leh mihing tate tung a athillamdang hihte ziak in phat teitei le u aw!
english: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

paite: Ama'n ahinna un alunggulh mahmah in ataisak a, hinna gilkial avahsak hi.
english: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.

paite: Mial nuai ah leh sihna lim a tu a, gimthuakna leh sikkhau a hente mahmah;
english: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,

paite: Pathian thute tung ah ahel ua, Tungnungpen lunggel angaihneu ziak un.
english: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.

paite: Ama'n alungtang uh sepgimna in aminsakta a; apuk ua, panpihpa ding himhim a-om ngal kei a.
english: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.

paite: Abuaina uah TOUPA asam ua, ama'n abuaina ua kipan apikhia a, amangbatna ua pan ahondam hi.
english: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

paite: Mial nuai a kipan leh sihna lim a kipan apikhia a, ahenna uh asuktatsakta hi.
english: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.

paite: Aw, mihingte'n TOUPA azahngaihna ziak in leh mihing tate tung a athillamdang hihte ziak in phat teitei le u aw!
english: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

paite: Ama'n dal kongkhakte achimsak a, akalhna siktawnte ahihtanta ngal a.
english: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.

paite: Mihaite atatlekna ziak un leh, agitlouh satlouhnate uh ziak in akihihgim uhi.
english: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.

paite: Ahinna un nek theih chiteng akih a; sihna kulh kongkhakte anaih uhi.
english: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.

paite: Huaitak in abuaina uah TOUPA asam ua, ama'n amangbatna ua kipan in ahondam zel hi.
english: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.

paite: Athu asawlkhia a, amau adamsak hi, amanthatna ua kipan in ahumbit hi.
english: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.

paite: Aw, mihingte'n TOUPA achit ziak leh mihing tate tung a athillamdang hihte ziak in phat teitei le uh aw!
english: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

paite: Amau kipahthugen kithoihnate lan uhenla, athilhihte uh la sa in hilh uhen.
english: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.

paite: Tuipi a long lian apaisuk a, tui zatak tung a nasemte'n.
english: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,

paite: Huaite'n TOUPA thilhihte leh tui thupi a athillamdang hihte amu uhi.
english: these see Yahweh’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.

paite: Ama'n thu apia a, huihpi anungsak a, huai in atuikihotte asangsak hi.
english: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.

paite: Van lam ah septouh in a-om ua, tui thukpi ah atumsuk nawn zel uhi; mangbatna ziak in ahinna uh azulbei hi.
english: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.

paite: Zukham bang in asawi hoihoi ua, atuan loklok ua, omdan ding hun lel athei kei nak uhi.
english: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.

paite: Huan abuaina uah TOUPA asam ua, ama'n amangbatna ua kipan in api hi.
english: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.

paite: Huihpi adaisak duam a, huchi in atuikihotte adai uhi.
english: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

paite: Huan adaih tak ziak in akipak ua; huchi in ama'n a-omna ding uh longkhawlna ah apitung hi.
english: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.

paite: Aw, mihingte'n TOUPA achit ziak leh, mihing tate tung a athillamdang hihte ziak in phat mahmah le uh aw!
english: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!

paite: Amau mite kikhopna ah amah phat uhenla, upate tutna ah phat uhen.
english: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.

paite: Ama'n luipite gamdai asuaksak a, tui nakte leng lei keu asuaksak hi.
english: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,

paite: Gam hoih gamsia asuaksak zel, asung a omte genhak ziak in.
english: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

paite: Gamdai dilmun asuaksak zel a, gamkeu leng tui nak asuaksak hi.
english: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.

paite: Huai ah gilkialte a-omsak a, tenna ding khua abawl uhi.
english: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,

paite: Loute anei ua, grephuante abawl ua, agah hong pungte amuhtheihna ding un.
english: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.

paite: Amau avualzawl a, nakpitak a hihpun in a-om ua; agante uh kiam aphal kei hi.
english: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.

paite: Huan nuaisiah, gimthuakna, lungkhamna ziak in akiam hiaihiai ua, akun ngiungiau lel uhi.
english: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

paite: Ama'n miliante tung ah muhsitna asungbua a, gamdai, lampi omlouhna ah avakvaisak hi.
english: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.

paite: Himahleh gentheite gimthuakna a kipan in mun sang ah akhatou hi, ganhon bang in inkuanpihte asiamsak hi.
english: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.

paite: Midiktatte'n huai mu in akipak ding uh; thulimlouhna tengteng in akam ahum ding hi.
english: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.

paite: Kuapeuh apil in huaite akemhoih ding ua, TOUPA zahngaihnate angaihtuah ding uhi.
english: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of Yahweh.

paite: Pathian aw, ka lungtang akip hi; la ka sa ding, ahi, phatna la ka sa ding, ka thupina teng toh.
english: A Song. A Psalm by David. My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.

paite: Pekging leh kaihgingte aw, halh un; kei zaw zingkhang in ka halh ding.
english: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.

paite: TOUPA aw, michih lakte ah kipahthu ka hon hilh ding; mite lak ah nangmah phat in la ka sa ding hi.
english: I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.

paite: Na zahngaihna van khup in athupi a, na thutak in vandumte asun hial hi.
english: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

paite: Pathian aw, nang van khen ah pahtawi in hong om in; na thupinate leitung tengteng tung ah pahtawi in om hen.
english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.

paite: Na deihtakte humbit a a-omtheihna ding un, na khut taklam in hondam inla, hon dawng in.
english: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

paite: Pathian in asianthouna ah hiai bang in agen a, Nuam ka sa ding; Shekem khua ka hawm ding a, Sukkoth Phaizang ka hawmzak ding.
english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

paite: Gilead gam kei a ahi a; Manasseh gam leng ka lu humbitna ahi; Judah gam ka lalchiang ahi.
english: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.

paite: Moab gam ka kisilna bel ahi a; Edom gam ah ka khedap ka pai ding a; Philistia gam ka kikoukhum ding hi.
english: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”

paite: Khopi kulh nei ah kua'n ahon pilut dia? Edom gam ah kua'n ahon pi dia?
english: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

paite: Pathian aw, nang hon khahkhia hilou na hi maw? Pathian aw, ka sepaihhonte uh kiang ah lah na pawt ngal kei a.
english: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.

paite: Galte sual ding in hon panpih in; mihing panpihna zaw bangmah lou phet ahi.
english: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.

paite: Pathian ziak in hangtak in ka hih ding uh; amah lah hon doute sikdenpa ding ahi ngal a.
english: Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.

paite: Ka phat Pathian aw, dai nilouh ke’n;
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. God of my praise, don’t remain silent,

paite: Migilou-salou kam leh kam khemhat ka tung ah ahangsan ngal ua; amau lei zuauthei in ka kiang ah thu agen uhi.
english: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.

paite: Huatna thu in ahon umsuak ua, bangmah lou in hon dou uhi.
english: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.

paite: Ka it ziak in hon doute ahong hita uh; himahleh kei zaw thumthum ding in ka kipe tinten hi.
english: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.

paite: Amau thil hoih thil gilou in ahon thuk ua, ka itna huatna mah in ahon thuk uhi.
english: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

paite: Nang atung ah migilou koih inla; ataklam ah hekmi dingh hen.
english: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.

paite: Vai hawmsak a a-om chiang in siam louh tang in pawt henla; athumna khelhna ah suak hen.
english: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.

paite: Adamsung nite tom henla; aheutu hihna midang in tang hen.
english: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.

paite: Atate pa lou in om uhenla, azi mah leng meithai in om hen.
english: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

paite: Atate mivakvai hong hi in, khut doh uhenla; anek ding uh amun gamsiate ah zong uhen.
english: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.

paite: Apung delh a dangka leitawisak in aneih tengteng laksak vek henla; mikhualte'n asepgim gah lok uhen.
english: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.

paite: Atung a zahngaihna langsak zel ding kuamah om sam kei uhenla; ata pa neiloute hehpihpa ding kuamah om kei hen.
english: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.

paite: Asuante hihman in om uh henla; khangthak hong om nawn ah amin uh nulmang in om hen.
english: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

paite: Apipute uh gitlouh satlouhna TOUPA kiang ah theihgige in om henla; anu khelhna nulmang in om kei hen.
english: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by Yahweh. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.

paite: TOUPA ma ah om gige hen. Ama'n amau theihgigena lei a kipan ahihmang theihna ding in.
english: Let them be before Yahweh continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;

paite: Zahngaihna latsakna dan atheih louh ua, migenthei, tagah leh khasiate thah tum a asawi zawk ziak un.
english: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.

paite: Ahi, mi hamsiat a-utlam ahi a, huchi in amah tung ah ahong tung a; mi vualzawl akipah lam ahi kei a, huchi in amah gamlat in a-om hi.
english: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.

paite: Puanak tual silh bang in hamsiatna in akivan a, huai agilsung ah tui bang in alut a, aguhte ah thau bang in aluanglut hi.
english: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.

paite: Huai amah a ding in silh gige puansilh bang in om henla, akigak zelna kawnggak mah leng hi hen.
english: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.

paite: Huai hon doute leh ka hinna gensete TOUPA'N athukna ahi.
english: This is the reward of my adversaries from Yahweh, of those who speak evil against my soul.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA Pathian aw, nang na min ziak in hon hehpih inla; na zahngaihna ahoih ziak in hon humbit in.
english: But deal with me, Yahweh the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;

paite: Genthei leh tagahtak ka hi a, ka lungtang ka gilsung ah liam in a-om ngal a.
english: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.

paite: Liim kiam lam bang in ka mang a; khaupe bang in mutleng in ka om hi.
english: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.

paite: Ka khukte an ngawl ziak in ahatta kei a; ka sa in thau himhim aputa kei hi.
english: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.

paite: Amau gensiat ka na hita a; hon muh un alu uh asing uhi.
english: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian aw, hon panpih inla; aw na zahngaihna bang zel in hon hondam in;
english: Help me, Yahweh, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;

paite: Huai na khut ahi, achih theih ua, TOUPA, nang na hih ahi, chih atheihna ding un.
english: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, Yahweh, have done it.

paite: Amau hamsiat uhen, nang zaw vualzawl zaw in; athohtak un azahlak ding ua, na sikha in bel nuam asa ding hi.
english: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.

paite: Hon doute zumna puan silhsak in om uhenla, puanak a kivan bang in amau zahlakna in kivan uhen.
english: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

paite: Ka kam in TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu nakpi in ka gen dia; ahi, mipi lak ah amah ka phat ding hi.
english: I will give great thanks to Yahweh with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.

paite: Amah tagahte taklam ah adingh a, hinna vai hawmsakte lak a hondam ding in.
english: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.

paite: TOUPA ah ka ginna ka nga zel a, bangchidan ahia ka hinna kiang a, "Na tang ah vasa bang in lengmang in chi na hi ua?
english: For the Chief Musician. By David. In Yahweh, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?

paite: En dih ua, lungtang diktak pu mial nuai a akaptheihna ding un, migilou-saloute'n thalpeu alai ua, athal uah akhau ah abulh chiat uhi;
english: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.

paite: Suangphumte hihsiat a-omleh, midiktat in bang ahia ahihtheih ding?"
english: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?

paite: TOUPA atempul siangthou ah a-om a, TOUPA laltutphah leng van ah a-om; mihing tate amit in a-en a, amit in a-enchian zel hi.
english: Yahweh is in his holy temple. Yahweh is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.

paite: TOUPA'N midiktat a-enchian zel a; migilou-salou leh hiamgamna deihte bel ahinna in ahua hi.
english: Yahweh examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.

paite: Migilou-saloute tung ah thang akesak ding a; mei leh kaat leh huih mulkimhuaitak a nou tan ding uh ahi ding hi.
english: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.

paite: TOUPA lah adiktat ngal a; diktatna adeih naknak hi; midiktatte'n amel amu ding uhi.
english: For Yahweh is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.

paite: TOUPA'N, ka TOUPA kiang ah, na melmate na khe ngakna a ka bawl masiah ka taklam ah tu in, achi hi.
english: A Psalm by David. Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”

paite: TOUPA'N na hatna chiang Zion tang a kipan in asawlkhe ding; nang nangmah doute lak ah vai hawm in.
english: Yahweh will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.

paite: Na mite na thilhihtheihna ni ah amau ut thu in akipe zel uhi. Siangthou kilawmna ah, zingsang gilsung a kipan in, na valnou daitui na nei hi.
english: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.

paite: TOUPA akichiam a, akisik nawn kei ding, nang zaw Melkizedek omdan bang a tangtawn siampu na hi a, chi in.
english: Yahweh has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

paite: TOUPA na taklam a om in aheh ni in kumpipate anuaizan ding hi.
english: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.

paite: Namte lak ah vai ahawm ding a, munte siluang in ahihdim ding a, gam tampi ah lu asatzan ding hi.
english: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.

paite: Lam lak a luita adawn ding a; huaiziak in alu atawisang ding hi.
english: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.

paite: TOUPA phat un. Mithudikte omkhawmna ah leh kikhopna ah, ka lungtang tengteng in TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu ka hilh ding hi.
english: Praise Yah! I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

paite: TOUPA thilhihte athupi a, atung a kipak peuhmahte zonkhiak ahi nak hi.
english: Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.

paite: Anasep azahtakhuai in athupi a; adiktatna tangtawn a om ding ahi.
english: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.

paite: Ama'n athillamdang hihte atheigige a; TOUPA mihehpih theitak, zahngaihna a dim ahi.
english: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. Yahweh is gracious and merciful.

paite: Amah laute kiang ah nek ding apia a; athukhun tangtawn in atheigige ding.
english: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.

paite: Athilhihtheihdan amite kiang ah alangsak a, namte gouluah ding akiang ua pia in.
english: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.

paite: Akhut thilhihte thutak leh vaihawmna dik ahi a; athuzohna thute amuanhuai hi.
english: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.

paite: Huaite tangtawn tangtawn a ding in hihkip in a-om a, thutak leh diktat a hih ahi chiat hi.
english: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.

paite: Ama'n amite kiang ah tatna asawl a; athukhun tangtawn a ding in asep a; amin asiangthou in azahtakhuai hi.
english: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!

paite: TOUPA kihtak pilna bul ahi a; huchibang a hih mite'n theihsiamna hoih anei uhi; ama phatna tangtawn a om ding ahi.
english: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!

paite: TOUPA phat un, TOUPA kihtami in nuam asa hi, athupiakte a nakpitak a kipakmi in.
english: Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.

paite: Asuante lei ah hattak in a-om ding ua; midiktat khang vualzawl in a-om ding hi.
english: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.

paite: A-inn ah sum leh hauhsakna a-om a; adiktatna tangtawn a om ding ahi.
english: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.

paite: Midik a ding in mial ah vakna hong pawtkhia; amah mihehpih thei, zahngaihna a dim diktat ahi.
english: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.

paite: Mite hehpih a leitawisakmi hoih in avuk nak a; amah kizentak in akhosa ding hi.
english: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.

paite: Bangchik mah chiang a ling lou ding ahi ngal a; midiktat tangtawn a theihgige in a-om ding hi.
english: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.

paite: Tanchin hoih loutakte a lau kei ding, TOUPA muang in alungtang akip ahi.
english: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.

paite: Alungtang akip a, alau kei ding, amah doute tung a alunggulh a hihtangtung amuh masiah.
english: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.

paite: Ahawmzak a, gentheite kiang ah apia, adiktatna tangtawn a om ding ahi; akii zahtaktak a pahtawi in a-om ding hi.
english: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.

paite: Migilou-salou in huai amu ding a, aheh ding a, aha agawi ding a azulmang ding, migilou-saloute deihlam amang ding hi.
english: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.

paite: TOUPA phat un. Aw TOUPA sikhate aw, phat unla, TOUPA min phat un.
english: Praise Yah! Praise, you servants of Yahweh, praise Yahweh’s name.

paite: TOUPA min phat in om hen, tu a kipan tangtawn in.
english: Blessed be Yahweh’s name, from this time forward and forever more.

paite: Nisuahna a kipan atumna pha in, TOUPA min phat ding ahi.
english: From the rising of the sun to its going down, Yahweh’s name is to be praised.

paite: TOUPA nam chihte tung ah tungnungpek ahi a, athupina in vante akhup tham ahi.
english: Yahweh is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.

paite: Tunglam a tutphah nei, TOUPA i Pathian bang kua ahia,
english: Who is like Yahweh, our God, who has his seat on high,

paite: van a thil omte leh lei a thil omte en ding a kua kihihniam ahia?
english: who stoops down to see in heaven and on the earth?

paite: Ama'n genthei leivui a kipan akaithou a, tagah eklei a kipan adomkang hi.
english: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,

paite: Miliante kiang a omsak theihna ding in, amite miliante kiang ngei ah.
english: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

paite: Ama'n numei chiing inn-le-lou akepsak a, tu leh ta neinu bang in nuamsatak in abawl hi. TOUPA phat un.
english: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise Yah!

paite: Aigupta gam a pan Israelte apawt ua, Jakob inkuanpihte melmak mi lak a kipan apawt lai un.
english: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,

paite: Judah a mun siangthou ahi a, Israelte avaihawmna gam ahong hita hi.
english: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

paite: Tuipi in huai amu a, ataimang a; Jordan lui kiksak in a-omta hi.
english: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.

paite: Tangte belamtal bang in adiang ua, mual neute belampa noute bang in.
english: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.

paite: Aw nang tuipi, bang na chi a, na taimang tak? Nang Jordan, bangchi na hia, na kik nawn tak?
english: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?

paite: Nou tangte aw, bang na chi ua ahia, belampa noute bang a na dian uh?
english: You mountains, that you skipped like rams? You little hills, like lambs?

paite: Nang leitung, TOUPA ma ah ling in, Jakobte Pathian ma ah.
english: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

paite: Ama'n suangpi dil asuaksak a, meisuang tui nak asuaksak hi.
english: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.

paite: TOUPA aw, kou hon pe lou in, koumau hon pe lou in, na min thupina pe zaw in, na zahngaihna leh na thutak ziak in.
english: Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.

paite: Bang achia namte'n, "A Pathian uh koi a om ahia?" chi uh ahia?
english: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”

paite: Ka Pathian uh van ah a-om a; a-utut ahih ahi.
english: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.

paite: Amilimte uh dangka leh dangka-eng ahi ua, mihing khutsuak ahi uh.
english: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

paite: Kam anei ua, apau kei uh; mit anei ua, amu kei uh;
english: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.

paite: bil anei ua, aza kei uh; nak anei ua, gim aza kei uh;
english: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.

paite: khut anei ua, bangmah akhoih kei uh; khe anei ua, apai kei uh; agawl tungtawn un apau sam kei uhi.
english: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.

paite: Amau bawlte amaute bang ahi ding ua; ahi, huai muang peuhmahte.
english: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.

paite: Israelte aw, TOUPA muang un; amah amau panpihpa leh aphaw uh ahi.
english: Israel, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.

paite: Aaron inkuanpihte aw, TOUPA muang un, amau panpihpa leh aphaw uh amah ahi.
english: House of Aaron, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.

paite: TOUPA laute aw, TOUPA muang un, amau panpihpa leh aphaw uh ahi.
english: You who fear Yahweh, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.

paite: TOUPA'N hon theigige a; avualzawl ding, Israel inkuante avualzawl ding a, Aaron inkuante avualzawl ding hi.
english: Yahweh remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.

paite: TOUPA laute avualzawl ding, aneu leh alian in.
english: He will bless those who fear Yahweh, both small and great.

paite: TOUPA'N nou hon pungsak hen, nou leh na tate uh toh.
english: May Yahweh increase you more and more, you and your children.

paite: TOUPA vualzawlna mute na hi uh, amah lei leh van siampa ahi.
english: Blessed are you by Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.

paite: Vante TOUPA vante ahi a; leitung mihing tate kiang ah apia hi.
english: The heavens are Yahweh’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.

paite: Misite'n TOUPA aphat kei ua, mundaitak a paisukte peuhmah in aphat sam kei uh;
english: The dead don’t praise Yah, nor any who go down into silence,

paite: kou bel TOUPA ka phat ding uh, tu a kipan tangtawn in, TOUPA phat un.
english: but we will bless Yah, from this time forward and forever more. Praise Yah!

paite: TOUPA ka it ahi, ka aw leh ka ngetnate angaihkhiak ziak in.
english: I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.

paite: Kei lam a abil ahon doh ziak in ka damsung teng in amah ka sam ding hi.
english: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

paite: Sihna khauhualte'n hon vial a, Sheol natnate'n hon man a, mangbatna leh lungkhamna ka na tuak hi.
english: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.

paite: Huaitak in TOUPA min ka sam a; "Aw TOUPA, hehpih in ka hinna humbit in," chi in.
english: Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”

paite: TOUPA mihehpih theitak leh diktattak ahi a; ahi, i Pathian uh milainat theitak ahi.
english: Yahweh is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.

paite: TOUPA'N mimawlte ahumbit nak a; hihniam in ka om a, ama'n hon hondamta hi.
english: Yahweh preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.

paite: Ka hinna aw, na khawlna ah kikta in; TOUPA'N na tung ah hoihtak in ahihta ngal a.
english: Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.

paite: Ka hinna sihna a pan, ka mitte khitui a pan, ka khete pukna a pan na humbitta hi.
english: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

paite: Mihing gam ah TOUPA ma ah ka vak ding hi.
english: I will walk before Yahweh in the land of the living.

paite: Ka gingta a, thu ka gen ding, ahi, nakpitak a hihgim in ka om hi.
english: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”

paite: Ka lungvai in, mi tengteng zuau ahi uh, ka na chita mawk hi.
english: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”

paite: Ka tung a athil hoih hih tengteng ziak in TOUPA kiang ah bang ahia ka piak thuk sam ding?
english: What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?

paite: Hotdamna nou ka la ding a, TOUPA min ka sam ding hi.
english: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on Yahweh’s name.

paite: Ka thuchiamte TOUPA kiang ah ka tangtun ding, ahi amite ma ah.
english: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people.

paite: Amisiangthoute sihna TOUPA muh in manphapi ahi.
english: Precious in Yahweh’s sight is the death of his saints.

paite: TOUPA aw, na sikha ka hi, na sikha, na sikhanu tapa ka hi; na hon henna na sutta hi.
english: Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.

paite: Kipahthu genna kithoihnate ka hon lan ding a, TOUPA min ka sam ding hi.
english: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on Yahweh’s name.

paite: Ka thuchiamte TOUPA kiang ah ka tangtun ding, ahi, amite tengteng ma ah;
english: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people,

paite: TOUPA' inn huangsung intual ah, Jerusalem aw, na laitak ah ka tangtun ding hi. TOUPA phat un.
english: in the courts of Yahweh’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise Yah!

paite: Aw, nam chihte aw, TOUPA phat unla; michihte aw, amah phat un.
english: Praise Yahweh, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!

paite: Azahngaihna i tung uah athupi in; TOUPA thutak tangtawn a om ding ahih ziak in. TOUPA phat un.
english: For his loving kindness is great toward us. Yahweh’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise Yah!

paite: Aw, TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu gen un; Amah lah ahoih ngal a; azahngaihna leng tangtawn a om ding ahih ziak in.
english: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

paite: Azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding chih Israelte'n gen uhen.
english: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

paite: Azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding chih, Aaron inkuante'n gen uhen.
english: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

paite: Azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding chih, TOUPA kihtate'n gen uhen.
english: Now let those who fear Yahweh say that his loving kindness endures forever.

paite: Ka mangbatna a kipan in TOUPA ka sam a, TOUPA'N hon dawng a, mun awngthawl ah hon omsakta hi.
english: Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.

paite: TOUPA kei lam a pang ahi a, ka lau kei ding; mihing in bang ahon chih thei dia.
english: Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

paite: TOUPA kei lam a pang hon panpihte lak a ahi; huaiziak in hon doute tung ah ka thu deihtel ka mu ding hi.
english: Yahweh is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.

paite: Mihing muan sang in TOUPA a muanna koih ahoihzaw hi.
english: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in man.

paite: Miliante gintak sang in TOUPA a ginna koih ahoihzaw hi.
english: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in princes.
