paite: Nam chih in ahon umsuak ua; amau TOUPA min in ka hihmang ding.
english: All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name I cut them off.

paite: Amau hon umsuak ua; ahi, hon umsuak ua; amau TOUPA min in ka hihmang ding hi.
english: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In Yahweh’s name I indeed cut them off.

paite: Khuai bang in hon umsuak ua; ling meikuang bang in mihsak in a-om uh; amau TOUPA min in ka hihmang ding hi.
english: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In Yahweh’s name I cut them off.

paite: Ka pukna ding in hon sut na tum a; himahleh TOUPA'N ahon panpih geih hi.
english: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but Yahweh helped me.

paite: TOUPA ka hatna leh ka la ahi, ka hotdamna leng ahong hita hi.
english: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.

paite: Kipahna leh hotdamna husa midiktatte puanin ah a-om hi, TOUPA khut taklam in hangsantak in ahih nak hi.
english: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly.

paite: TOUPA khut taklam pahtawi in a-om nak a; TOUPA khut taklam in hangsantak in ahih nak hi.
english: The right hand of Yahweh is exalted! The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly!”

paite: Ka si kei ding, ka dam ding hi, TOUPA thilhihte ka theisak zaw ding.
english: I will not die, but live, and declare Yah’s works.

paite: TOUPA'N nakpitak in hon thuzoh a, sihna kiang ah zaw hon pe tel kei hi.
english: Yah has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

paite: Diktatna kulh kongkhakte hon honsak un; huaite ah ka lut ding a, TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu ka hilh ding hi.
english: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.

paite: Hiai TOUPA kongkhak ahi; midiktatte alut ding uh.
english: This is the gate of Yahweh; the righteous will enter into it.

paite: Na kiang ah kipahthu ka gen ding, nang hon dawng in, hon hondampa na hita ngal a.
english: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.

paite: Inn lamte suang deih louh aning a suang phatuampen ana hita hi.
english: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.

paite: Huai TOUPA hih ahi; i mitmuh uah alamdang ahi.
english: This is Yahweh’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.

paite: Hiai TOUPA ni seh ahi, hiai ah i nuam un i kipak ding uh.
english: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

paite: TOUPA aw, hehpih in hon hondam inla, TOUPA aw, hehpih in vangphatna hon sawl in.
english: Save us now, we beg you, Yahweh! Yahweh, we beg you, send prosperity now.

paite: TOUPA min a hong pai in nuam asa hi; TOUPA' inn a pan in ka hon vualzawl uhi.
english: Blessed is he who comes in Yahweh’s name! We have blessed you out of Yahweh’s house.

paite: TOUPA Pathian ahi, ama'n vak ahon pia a, kithoihna ding khauhual in khih uhen, maitam kii mahmah ah.
english: Yahweh is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.

paite: Nang ka Pathian na hi a, kipahthu ka hon hilh ding a; ka Pathian na hi a, ka hon pahtawi ding hi.
english: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.

paite: Aw, TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu hilh un; amah lah ahoih ngala; azahngaihna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

paite: Lampi a mihoihkimte'n nuam asa uhi, TOUPA dan zuite'n.
english: ALEPH Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to Yahweh’s law.

paite: Athu theihsakte zuite'n nuam asa uhi, lungtang tengteng a amah zongte'n.
english: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.

paite: Ahi, amau diktatlouhna ahih kei ua; alampite ah apai zel uhi.
english: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.

paite: Nang na thuzohna thute phatuamngaitak a, zui ding in thu na hon pia hi.
english: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.

paite: Aw, na dan thusehte zui ding in ka omdante hihkip in omleh aw;
english: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!

paite: Huai hun chiang in ka zahlak kei ding a, na thupiakte khawk ka sak hun chiang in.
english: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.

paite: Lungtang diktak pu in kipahthu ka hon hilh ding hi. Na vaihawmna dikte ka zil hun chiang in.
english: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.

paite: Na dan thuseh ka zui ding a, aw, hon paisan den ke'n.
english: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me. BETH

paite: Valnou in, bangchi in ahia a- omdan ahihsiangthou ding? Na thu bang zel a a-omdan venghoih in.
english: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.

paite: Ka lungtang tengteng in ka hon zong a; Aw, na thupiakte ka paisan zaw phal mahmah ke'n.
english: With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.

paite: Na tung a thil ka hihkhelh louhna ding in na thu tuh ka lungtang ah ka kem hi.
english: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang nuam na sa hi; na dan thusehte hon zilsak in.
english: Blessed are you, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.

paite: Na kam a na vaihawm pawt tengteng ka muk in ka theisakta hi.
english: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.

paite: Na thu theihsak lam ah nuam ka sa a, hauhsaknate teng a nuam ka sak bang in.
english: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.

paite: Na thuzohna thute ka ngaihtuah ding a, na lampite ka limsak behlap ding hi.
english: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.

paite: Na dan thuseh tungte ah ka kipak ding a; na thu ka mangngilh kei ding hi.
english: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word. GIMEL

paite: Ka hintheihna ding in na sikha tung ah hoihtak in hih in; huchi in na thu ka zui ding hi.
english: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.

paite: Na dan thu a kipan thillamdang ka muhtheihna ding in, ka mitte vaksak in.
english: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.

paite: Lei ah mikhual ka hi a; na thupiakte ka lak ah iim ke'n.
english: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.

paite: Ka hinna kitamgawp in a-om a, chik lai peuh a na vaihawmna angai hi.
english: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.

paite: Mikisathei, hamsiat a omte na taihilh a, na thupiakte vakmangsante.
english: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.

paite: Gensiatna leh muhsitna ka kiang a kipan lamang in; na thu theihsakte ka zui hi.
english: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.

paite: Miliante leng atu ua, hon kalh ua; himahleh na sikha in na dan thusehte angaihtuah zaw ahi.
english: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.

paite: Na thu theihsakte ka kipahna ahi a, thupha hon hilhte ahi uh.
english: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors. DALETH

paite: Ka hinna leivui ah abelh bikbek a; na thu bang zel in hon hihhalh in.
english: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!

paite: Ka omdante ka hon theisak a, nang na hon dawng a; na dan thusehte hon sinsak in.
english: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.

paite: Na thuzohna lam hon theisiamsak in, huchi in na thillamdang hih thute ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
english: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.

paite: Ka hinna lungkham ziak in atuimang nak a; na thu bang zel in hon hihhat in.
english: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.

paite: Omdan diklou ka kiang a kipan lasuan inla; hehpih in na dan hon pia in.
english: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!

paite: Omdan muanhuai ka tel a; na vaihawmnate ka ma ah ka omsak hi.
english: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.

paite: Na thu theihsakte ah ka bel tinten a; TOUPA aw, hon zahlaksak ke'n.
english: I cling to your statutes, Yahweh. Don’t let me be disappointed.

paite: Na thupiak lam ah ka tai ding a, ka lungtang na hihlet hun chiang in.
english: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free. HE

paite: TOUPA aw, na dan thuseh lampi hon ensak in; huchi in atawp pha in ka tawn ding hi.
english: Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.

paite: Theihsiamna hon pia in, huchi in na dan ka kemhoih ding hi, ahi ka lungtang tengteng in ka zui ding hi.
english: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.

paite: Na thupiak lampi ah hon paisak in, huai ah ka kipak ngal a.
english: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.

paite: Na thu theihsak lam ah ka lungtang kiheisak in, huaihamna lam ah hilou in.
english: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.

paite: Thil bangmah lou phet en lou ding in ka mit kaihei inla, na lampite ah hon hihhalh in.
english: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.

paite: Na thu na sikha kiang ah hihkip in, huai nangmah launa ahi.
english: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.

paite: Kei a dia gensiatna ka kihtak lamang in; na vaihawmte lah ahoih ngal a.
english: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.

paite: Ngai in, na thuzohna thute theih ka ut gige a; na diktatna ziak in hon hihhalh in.
english: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness. VAV

paite: TOUPA aw, na zahngaihnate ka kiang ah hong pai hen, na hotdamna ngei, na thu bang zel in.
english: Let your loving kindness also come to me, Yahweh, your salvation, according to your word.

paite: Huchi in hon gensete dawnna ding ka nei ding a, na thu lah ka muang ngal a.
english: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.

paite: Huan thutak thu ka kam a kipan lakhe vek ke'nla; na vaihawmnate ka lamen gige ngal a.
english: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.

paite: Huchi in na dan ka zui gige ding a, tangtawn tangtawn in.
english: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.

paite: Huan noplenna ah ka vak ding a; na thuzohna thute ka zong hi.
english: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.

paite: Na thu theihsak thute kumpipate ma ah ka gen ding a, ka zum kei ding hi.
english: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.

paite: Huan ka it, na thupiak ah ka kipak ding hi.
english: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.

paite: Na thupiak, ka it lamte ah, ka khutte ka zak ding a, na dan thusehte ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
english: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes. ZAYIN

paite: Na sikha kiang a thuchiam theigige in, Nang na hon lametsak ziak in.
english: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.

paite: Huai ka gimthuakna ah leng ka khamuanna ahi, na thu in lah ahon hihhalhta ngal a.
english: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.

paite: Kisatheite'n nakpitak in hon nuihsan ua, himahleh na dan ka pai hoisan kei hi.
english: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.

paite: TOUPA aw, nidanglai a na vaihawmte ka theigige a, ka kikhamuan zel hi.
english: I remember your ordinances of old, Yahweh, and have comforted myself.

paite: Lung hihlouhna in nakpitak in hon buakkhumta a, migilou-salou na dan paisante ziak in.
english: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.

paite: Ka khualzinna inn ah na dan thusehte ka la ahi gige hi.
english: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.

paite: TOUPA aw, zan chiang in na min ka theigige hi, na dan leng ka zui gige hi.
english: I have remembered your name, Yahweh, in the night, and I obey your law.

paite: Huai ka nei a, na thuzohna thute ka vomhoih ziak in.
english: This is my way, that I keep your precepts. HETH

paite: TOUPA ka tantuan ahi a; na thu ka zui ding chih ka gen khinta hi.
english: Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.

paite: Ka lungtang tengteng in na deihsakna ka ngen a; na thu bang zel in hon hehpih in.
english: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.

paite: Ka omdante ka ngaihtuah a, na thu theihsak lam ah ka kalsuan hi.
english: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.

paite: Ka kintat a, na thupiakte zui ding in ka zekai kei hi;
english: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.

paite: Migilou-salou khauhual in hon gaklom gige a; himahleh na dan ka mangngilh kei hi.
english: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.

paite: Zankim in kipahthu gen ding in ka thou ding a, na vaihawm diktatte ziak in.
english: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.

paite: Nangmah laute leh na thuzohna thu zuite lawm ka hi.
english: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.

paite: TOUPA aw, leitung na zahngaihna in adim ahi; na dan thusehte hon sinsak in.
english: The earth is full of your loving kindness, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes. TETH

paite: TOUPA aw, na thu bang in na sikha na hihhoih zel hi.
english: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, Yahweh.

paite: Ngaihtuah siamna leh theihna hon sinsak in; na thupiakte ka gingta hi.
english: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.

paite: Hihhaksat a ka om ma in ka vakmang a, tu'n zaw na thu ka zuita hi.
english: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.

paite: Nang na hoih a, thil hoih leng na hih a; na dan thusehte hon sinsak in.
english: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.

paite: Kisatheite'n ka tung ah zuau a phuaktawm ua, ka lungtang tengteng in na thuzohna thute ka vomhoih ding hi.
english: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.

paite: Alungtang uh sungthau bang in athau a; Kei bel na dan tung ah ka kipak gige hi.
english: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.

paite: Na dan thusehte ka ziltheihna ding a hihhaksat a ka om ahoih hi.
english: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.

paite: Dangka-eng leh dangka sang tampi sang in na kam a dan pawt kei a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
english: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH

paite: Na khut in hon siam in, ahon sek hi; na thupiakte ka sintheihna ding in theihsiamna hon pia in.
english: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.

paite: Nangmah laute'n ahon mu ding ua, akipak ding uh; na thu ka lamet ziak in.
english: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.

paite: TOUPA aw, na vaihawmte adik chih leh nang ginomtak in ahi, na hon hihgim chih ka thei hi.
english: Yahweh, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

paite: Na sikha kiang a na thuchiam bang zel in hehpih in na zahngaihna ka khamuanna hisak in.
english: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.

paite: Ka hintheihna ding in na zahngaihnate ka kiang ah hong pai hen; na dan ka kipahna ahi.
english: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.

paite: Kisathei zahlak in om uhen; dikloupi in hon hihniamta ua; himahleh na thuzohna thute ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
english: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.

paite: Nang hon laute'n kei lam hong nga uhen, na thu theihsakte athei ding uhi.
english: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.

paite: Ka zahlaklouhna ding in ka lungtang na dan thusehte ah hoihkim in om hen.
english: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed. KAPF

paite: Ka hinna na hotdamna ngai in abah a; himahleh na thu ka lamen gige hi.
english: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.

paite: Na thu etna in ka mit avai khinta a, "Nang chikchiang a hon khamuan ding na hia?" ka chi, ka chi a.
english: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”

paite: Meikhu uk savun thawl bang ka na hita ngal a; himahleh na dan thusehte ka mangngilh kei hi.
english: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.

paite: Na sikha kum chiang ding bang tan hi ding ahia, hon simmohte tung ah chikchiang in ahia vai na hawm ding?
english: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?

paite: Mikisathei, na dan bang a omloute'n ka kiakna ding in kokhukte atou uhi.
english: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.

paite: Na thupiak tengteng a ginom ahi; amau dikloupi in hon simmoh uh; hon panpih in!
english: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!

paite: Amau lei ah hon hihmang dekdek ua; himahleh na thuzohna thute lah ka kiheisan ngal kei hi.
english: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.

paite: Na zahngaihna bang zel in hon hihhalh in; huchi in na kam a thu theihsak ka zui ding hi.
english: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth. LAMEDH

paite: TOUPA aw, tangtawn a ding in na thu van ah kiptak in a-om hi.
english: Yahweh, your word is settled in heaven forever.

paite: Na ginomna suan tengteng pha in a-om ding hi; leitung na hihkip a, a-om gige hi.
english: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.

paite: Huaite tuni in na vaihawmte bang in a-om gige a thil teng na sikhate ahi uhi.
english: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.

paite: Na dan ka kipahna hi keileh zaw, ka gimthuakna a mangthang ding hi ing a.
english: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.

paite: Na thuzohna thute chik lai peuh in leng ka mangngilh kei ding, nang lah huaite in na hon hihhalhta ngal a.
english: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.

paite: Nang a ka hi, hon hondam in; na thuzohna thute ka zong ngal a.
english: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.

paite: Migilou-saloute'n hihmang tum in ahon ngak ua; himahleh na thu theihsakte ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
english: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.

paite: Hoihkimna teng tawpna ka mu a; na thupiak aza ngei e.
english: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless. MEM

paite: Aw, na dan deih hi na tel ing e! Nitum a ka ngaihtuah ahi.
english: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.

paite: Na thupiakte'n hon doute sang a pilzaw in hon bawl a; tangtawn a ka kiang a a-om gige ziak in.
english: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.

paite: Hon hilhte tengteng sang in pilna ka nei zaw ahi; na thu theihsakte ka ngaihtuah ahih nak ziak in.
english: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.

paite: Tekte sang in ka theisiam zaw a, ahi, na thuzohna thute ka vomhoih ziak in.
english: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.

paite: Na thu ka zuihtheihna ding in lampi gilou himhim ah ka khete kalsuan ka phal kei hi.
english: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.

paite: Na vaihawmna a pan ka pial kei; nang na hon hilh ziak in.
english: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.

paite: Na thute ka kam a ding in khum hi na tel e! Ahi, ka kam a ding in khuaizu sang in akhumzaw hi.
english: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!

paite: Na thuzohna thute ziak in theihsiamna ka nei zel; huaiziak in omdan diklou peuhmah ka hua hi.
english: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way. NUN

paite: Na thu ka khe a ding in khawnvak ahi a, ka lampi a ding in vak ahi.
english: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

paite: Na vaihawmna diktatte zui ding in ka kichiam a, ka hihkip lai hi.
english: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.

paite: Nakpitak a hihhaksat in ka om a; TOUPA aw, na thu bang zel in hon hihhalh in.
english: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your word.

paite: TOUPA aw, hehpih in ka kam a ka deih thu phatna ana sang inla, na dante hon sinsak in.
english: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. Yahweh, teach me your ordinances.

paite: Ka hinna ka khut ah a-om a; himahleh, na dan ka mangngilh ngei kei hi.
english: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.

paite: Migilou-saloute'n ka awkna ding in thang akam ua; himahleh na thuzohna thute ka vakmangsan kei hi.
english: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.

paite: Na thu theihsakte tangtawn a gouluah ding in ka la a; ka lungtang hihnuam pen ahi.
english: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

paite: Na dan thusehte, atawp pha a zui ding in, ka lungtang ka koihkipta hi.
english: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end. SAMEKH

paite: Bangmah lou ngaihtuahnate ka hua a, na dan ka deih ahi.
english: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.

paite: Nang ka bukna mun leh ka phaw na hi a; na thu ka lamet ahi.
english: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.

paite: Nou thil hoih lou hihte aw, hon paisan un; ka Pathian thilpiakte ka vomhoih theihna ding in.
english: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.

paite: Ka hintheihna ding in na thu bang zel in hon len nilouh inla, ka lamet tung ah zahlak in hon omsak ke'n.
english: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.

paite: Hon kai in, huchi in ka bit ding a, na dan thusehte ka khawk sa gige ding ahi.
english: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.

paite: Na dan thusehte vakmangsan tengteng na musit a; akhemna uh lah zuau ahi.
english: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.

paite: Lei a migilou-salou tengteng eksia bang in na hihmang a, huaiziak in na thu theihsakte ka deih hi.
english: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.

paite: Ka sa nangmah lau in aling a, na vaihawmnate leng ka lau hi.
english: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments. AYIN

paite: Vai ka hawm a, diktattak in ka hih hi; hon nuaisiahte lak ah hon nuse ke'n.
english: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.

paite: Na sikha tungtang thu ah, ahoihna a bultum in; kisatheite'n hon nuaisiah kei uhen.
english: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.

paite: Na hotdamna etna in ka mit avai khinta a, na thu diktattak etna toh in.
english: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.

paite: Na zahngaihna bang zel in na sikha tung ah hih inla, na dan thusehte hon hilh in.
english: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.

paite: Na sikha ka hi a, theihsiamna hon pia in; na thu theihsakte ka theihna ding in.
english: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.

paite: TOUPA, sep ahunta; na dan bangmah lou in abawlta uhi.
english: It is time to act, Yahweh, for they break your law.

paite: Huaiziak in na thupiakte dangka-eng sang in ka deih a; ahi, dangka-eng siangthou sang in.
english: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.

paite: Huaiziak in thil peuhmah thu a na thuzohna thu tengteng dik in ka thei a; omdan diklou peuhmah ka hua ahi.
english: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way. PE

paite: Na thu theihsakte alamdang a; huaiziak in ka hinna in azui hi.
english: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.

paite: Na thu hilhchet in mite ahihvak a; mimawlte atheisiamsak hi.
english: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.

paite: Kam zapi in ka ka a, ka nak hawphawp hi; na thupiakte ka lunggulh ziak in.
english: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.

paite: Kei lam hong nga inla, hon hehpih in, na min deihte na hehpih bang in.
english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.

paite: Ka khe kalsuante na thu ah hihkip inla; gitlouhnate ka tung ah thu neisak ke'n.
english: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.

paite: Mihing nuaisiahna pan hon humbit in; huchi in na thuzohna thute ka zui ding hi.
english: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.

paite: Na mel in na sikha sunvak inla; na dan thusehte hon sinsak in.
english: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.

paite: Na dan azuih louh ziak in, Lui a tui bang in ka mit ah ka khitui aluangkhia hi.
english: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law. TZADHE

paite: TOUPA aw, nang na dik a, na vaihawmte adik ahi.
english: You are righteous, Yahweh. Your judgments are upright.

paite: Na thu theihsakte diktat leh ginom mahmah in thu na pia hi.
english: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.

paite: Ka phattuamngaihna in hon negaita, hon doute'n na thu amangngilh ziak un.
english: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.

paite: Na thu siangthou mahmah ahi; huaiziak in na sikha in adeih hi.
english: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.

paite: Mineu leh mi muhsit ka hi a, himahleh na thuzohna thute ka mangngilh ngei kei hi.
english: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.

paite: Na diktatna tangtawn diktatna ding ahi a, na dan leng thutak ahi.
english: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.

paite: Mangbatna leh lunglauna in hon buakkhumta a; himahleh na thupiakte ka kipahna ahi.
english: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.

paite: Na thu theihsakte tangtawn a ding in adik ahi; theihsiamna hon pia in, huchi in ka hing gige ding hi.
english: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live. QOPH

paite: Ka lungtang tengteng in ka hon sam a; TOUPA aw, hon dawng in; na dan thusehte ka kemhoih ding hi.
english: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, Yahweh! I will keep your statutes.

paite: Ka hon sam hi; hon dawng in, huchi in na thu theihsakte ka zui ding hi.
english: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.

paite: Phalvak ma in ka thou a, huhna deih in ka kikou a; na thute ka lamen hi.
english: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.

paite: Na thu ka ngaihtuah theihna ding in zanvente ma in, ka mitte ahak uhi.
english: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.

paite: Na zahngaihna bang zel in ka aw ngaikhia inla; TOUPA aw, na vaihawmnate bang zel in hon hihhalh in.
english: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your ordinances.

paite: Ngaihtuah gilou delhte'n ahon naih ua; amau zaw na dan gamlat a om ahi uh.
english: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang zaw na nai a; na thupiak tengteng thutak ahi.
english: You are near, Yahweh. All your commandments are truth.

paite: Nidanglai in, na thu theihsakte a kipan in, huaite tangtawn a ding in na hihkip chih ka na theita hi.
english: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever. RESH

paite: Ka haksatna ngaihtuah inla, hon humbit in; na dan lah ka mangngilh ngei ngal kei a;
english: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.

paite: Ka thu hon genpih inla, hon tan in na thu bang zel in hon hihhalh in.
english: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.

paite: Hotdamna migilou-saloute a pan agamla hi, na dan thusehte azuih louh ziak un.
english: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.

paite: TOUPA aw, na zahngaihnate athupi hi; na vaihawmnate bang zel in hon hihhalh in.
english: Great are your tender mercies, Yahweh. Revive me according to your ordinances.

paite: Hon simmohte leh hon doute tampi ahi ua, himahleh na thu theihsakte ka paikawisan kei hi.
english: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.

paite: Lepchiahtak a hihte ka en a, ka lungkim kei hi; na thu azuih louh ziak un.
english: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.

paite: Na thuzohna thute ka deihdan ngaihtuah inla, TOUPA aw, na zahngaihna bang in hon hihhalh in.
english: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your loving kindness.

paite: Na thu atung a pan in adik a, na vaihawmna diktat chiteng tangtawn in a-om nilouh hi.
english: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever. SIN AND SHIN

paite: Miliante'n aziak om lou in hon simmoh ua; himahleh ka lungtang in na thute ahi, akihtak.
english: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.

paite: Na thu ah nuam ka sa a, thil thupipi gallak amu bang in.
english: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.

paite: Zuauthu ka hua in ka kih a; na dan bel ka deih ahi.
english: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.

paite: Ni khat in sagihvei nang ka hon phat a, na vaihawm diktatte ziak in.
english: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.

paite: Na dan deihte'n khamuanna thupitak anei ua; pukna himhim anei kei uhi.
english: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.

paite: TOUPA aw, na hotdamna ka lamen a, na thupiakte bang in ka hih zel hi.
english: I have hoped for your salvation, Yahweh. I have done your commandments.

paite: Ka hinna in na thu theihsakte azui gige a; ka deih mahmah hi.
english: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.

paite: Na thuzohna thute leh na thu theihsakte ka zui zel a; ka omdan tengteng na ma ah a-om hi.
english: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you. TAV

paite: TOUPA aw, ka hon sap husa na ma ah hong nai hen; na thu bangbang in theihsiamna hon pia in.
english: Let my cry come before you, Yahweh. Give me understanding according to your word.

paite: Hehpih ka ngetna na ma ah tung hen; na thu bang in hon humbit in.
english: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.

paite: Na dan thusehte na hon sinsak chiang in, ka muk in nang phatna thu gen hen.
english: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.

paite: Ka lei in na thu agen ding a, na thupiak tengteng diktatna ahih ziak in.
english: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.

paite: Na khut in hon panpih in, na thuzohna thute ka tel ngal a.
english: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.

paite: TOUPA aw, na hotdamna ka lunggulh nak a; na dan ka kipahna ahi.
english: I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.

paite: Ka hinna hing hen, huchi in ahon phat ding hi; na vaihawmnate'n leng hon panpih hen.
english: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.

paite: Belam mang bang in ka vakmang a, na sikha zong in; na thupiakte lah ka mangngilh ngei ngal kei a.
english: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.

paite: TOUPA, hon panpih in; Pathian limsakmi lah a-om nawnta ngal kei ua; mihing tate lak a kipan miginom lah amangta ngal ua.
english: For the Chief Musician; upon an eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm of David. Help, Yahweh; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

paite: Michih in a-invengte kiang ah thu bangmah lou maimai agengen ua; maitang phatna leh khemna lungtang pu in thu agen nak uhi.
english: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.

paite: TOUPA'N maitang phatna muk tengteng a-atkhe ding a, thu kisathei genna lei toh,
english: May Yahweh cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,

paite: amau, i lei in i zou ding ua; i mukte eimah a ngei aka, kua ahia i tung a lal om? achi uhi.
english: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”

paite: TOUPA'N, "Gentheite asimmoh ziak uleh, tagahte thum ziak in, ka thou pah dia; anuihsan uh bittak in ka omsak ding," achi hi.
english: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says Yahweh; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”

paite: TOUPA thute thu siangthoutak ahi a; dangka leitung a haltuina mei a etkhiak a, sagihvei hihsiangthou zohsa bang ahi.
english: Yahweh’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang amau na kemhoih ding a, hiai khangte lak ah chik lai peuh in leng na humbit ding.
english: You will keep them, Yahweh. You will preserve them from this generation forever.

paite: Mihing tate lak ah khelhna pahtawi a a-om in, migilou-salou avialvak nak uhi.
english: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.

paite: Ka mangbatna ah TOUPA ka sam a, huchi in ama'n ahon dawng hi.
english: A Song of Ascents. In my distress, I cried to Yahweh. He answered me.

paite: TOUPA aw, muk zuautheite lak leh lei mikhemhat lak ah ka hinna humbit in.
english: Deliver my soul, Yahweh, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.

paite: Nang lei khemhat, na kiang ah bang ahon pe ding ua, bang ahon behlap ding ua?
english: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?

paite: Mihat thal zumtakte, Juniper sing lingte toh.
english: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

paite: Mashekte gam a ka omleh Kedarte puanin lak a ka om ka tung agik hi.
english: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

paite: Lemna hote kiang ah ka hinna sawtpi a-omta hi.
english: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.

paite: Ke'n kituah ka ut a; himahleh thu ka gentak in kidou a-ut nak uhi.
english: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.

paite: Tangte lam ah ka mit ka suantou ding a; koi a kipan in ahia panpihna ahong tun ding?
english: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

paite: Hon panpihna tuh TOUPA lei leh van bawlpa a pan ahong tung ding hi.
english: My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.

paite: Ama'n na khe kisuan aphal kei ding a; nangmah chingpa alusu kei ding hi.
english: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.

paite: Ngai in Israelte chingpa alusu in a-ihmu sam kei ding hi.
english: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

paite: TOUPA nangmah chingpa ahi; TOUPA na taklam a nang hon liahpa ahi.
english: Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.

paite: Sun in nisa in ahon hai kei dia, zan in leng kha in ahon sun sam kei ding.
english: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

paite: TOUPA'N hoih lou chiteng a pan ahon ching dia; na hinna aching ding hi.
english: Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.

paite: TOUPA'N na pawt leh na lut aching ding a, tua kipan a, tangtawn in.
english: Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.

paite: TOUPA' inn ah hoh ni, ka kianga achih lai un ka kipak hi.
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to Yahweh’s house!”

paite: Jerusalem aw, na kulh kongkhak sung ah ka khete uh adingh hi.
english: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!

paite: Jerusalem, khopi bang a lam kiptak a gawmkhawm,
english: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,

paite: TOUPA min phat ding in huai ah namte apaitou ua, TOUPA namte ngei, Israelte kiang a thu theihsakna ding in.
english: where the tribes go up, even Yah’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to Yahweh’s name.

paite: Huai ah lah vaihawmna a ding in laltutphahte tun ahi ngal a, David inkuanpihte laltutphahte.
english: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.

paite: Jerusalem khamuanna ding in ngetsak un; nang hon deihte anavak uhi.
english: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.

paite: Na kulh sungte ah khamuanna om henla, na inpite ah navakna om hen.
english: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.

paite: Ka unaute leh ka lawmte ziak in, na sung ah khamuanna om hen, ka chi ding hi.
english: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”

paite: TOUPA i Pathian inn ziak in na hoihna ding ka zong ding.
english: For the sake of the house of Yahweh our God, I will seek your good.

paite: Aw, nang van a tu, nang lam ah ka mit ka suantou zel hi.
english: A Song of Ascents. I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.

paite: Ngai in, sikhate mit in apu khut a-et nak bang in leh, sikhanu mit in api khut a-et bang in, i mit in TOUPA lam a-en nilouh ahi, ahon hehpih masiah.
english: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to Yahweh, our God, until he has mercy on us.

paite: Ka tung uah zahngai in, TOUPA aw, ka tung uah zahngai in, muhsitna in ka dim sinsen uhi.
english: Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.

paite: Minuamsate simmohna leh kisatheite muhsitna in ka hinna uh adim hi.
english: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.

paite: Ei lam a pang TOUPA hilou hileh, Israelte'n chi uhen.
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, let Israel now say,

paite: Mite'n hon sual lai un ei lam a pang TOUPA hilou hileh,
english: if it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, when men rose up against us,

paite: huai lai mah in amau eite ahon hingvalhta ding ua, i tung ua athangpaih lai un.
english: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,

paite: Huai lai mah in tuite'n ahon tummangta ding ua, lui in i hinna avuktumta ding hi.
english: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.

paite: Huai lai mah in tui kisatheite'n i hinna avuktumta ding hi.
english: Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.

paite: Samat bang a mat ding a aha ua hon pe lou TOUPA phat in om hen.
english: Blessed be Yahweh, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.

paite: Thangkamte thang a pan vasa suakta bang in i hinna asuakta hi, thang aseta a, eite i suakta uhi.
english: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.

paite: Hon panpihna ding TOUPA lei leh van bawlpa min ah a-om, chi in.
english: Our help is in Yahweh’s name, who made heaven and earth.

paite: TOUPA muangte tuh Zion tang hihlin vual louh, tangtawn a om gige ding bang ahi.
english: A Song of Ascents. Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.

paite: Tangte, Jerusalem kim a a-om bang in amite kim ah TOUPA a-om hi. Tu a kipan tangtawn in.
english: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so Yahweh surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.

paite: Gilou-salou lalchiang midiktat tan tung ah akinga kei ding a; midiktatte'n akhut ua thulimlouhna akhoih kei uleh.
english: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.

paite: TOUPA aw, hoihtak a omte tung ah hoihtak in hih in, alungtang ua diktak a omte tung ah.
english: Do good, Yahweh, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.

paite: Alampi kawi ua pialte bel TOUPA'N thil hihkhialte toh apikhe ding. Israelte tung ah khamuanna om hen.
english: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.

paite: TOUPA'N Zion salte apikik nan lai in, mang nei bang hial i hi ua.
english: A Song of Ascents. When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.

paite: Huai lai in i kam uh nuihna in adim a, i lei uh lasakna in; huai lai in namte lak ah, TOUPA'N amau a ding in thil thupi ahihsak ahi, achi ua.
english: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “Yahweh has done great things for them.”

paite: TOUPA'N thil thupitak hon hihsak a; i kipak mahmah ahi.
english: Yahweh has done great things for us, and we are glad.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka saltanna ua kipan hon pikik nawn in, simlam luite bang in.
english: Restore our fortunes again, Yahweh, like the streams in the Negev.

paite: Khitui ke kawm a tuhte'n nuamsatak in a-at ding uhi.
english: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

paite: Kap kawm a buhchi kuankhiakpihmi in, abuhphalte uh tawi in nuamsa in ahong pai nawn ding hi.
english: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.

paite: TOUPA'N inn alam keileh, alamte'n asemgim thawn phet uhi, TOUPA'N khopi aven hoih keileh, a vengmi ahakthawn lel ahi.
english: A Song of Ascents. By Solomon. Unless Yahweh builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless Yahweh watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.

paite: Zingsangpi in na thou ua, na khawl hak mahmah ua, sepgimna an na nek uh, nou ding in athawn lel ahi; ami deihtak bel ihmut ape nak ngal a.
english: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.

paite: Ngai in, tate tuh TOUPA a pan i goutan ahi ua, gil a gah akipahman ahon piak ahi.
english: Behold, children are a heritage of Yahweh. The fruit of the womb is his reward.

paite: Hat lai tate mihat khut a thaltangte bang ahi uh.
english: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.

paite: Athalbawm thal a dim neite kipaktak in a-om zel uhi; kulh kong a adoute uh abiak un leng azahlak kei ding uhi.
english: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.

paite: TOUPA lau peuhmahte'n nuam asa uh, alampi tawnte'n.
english: A Song of Ascents. Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.

paite: Na khut sepgim gah ne ding lah na hi ngal a; vualzawl in na om ding a, nang a ding in ahoih ding hi.
english: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.

paite: Na zi na insung a grepgui gahpha bang ahi ding a; na tate na dohkan kim ah, olive selte bang ahi ding uh.
english: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.

paite: Ngai in, TOUPA lau mi huchibang in vualzawl in a-om ding hi.
english: Behold, this is how the man who fears Yahweh is blessed.

paite: TOUPA'N Zion a pan in hon vualzawl ding hi; huchi in na damsung teng in Jerusalem hoihna na mu ding hi.
english: May Yahweh bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

paite: Ahi, na tute na mu ding a, Israelte tung ah khamuanna om hen.
english: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.

paite: "Ka naupan chik a pan in mi'n tamveipi ahon mangbangsak ua." Israelte'n chi uhen.
english: A Song of Ascents. Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say:

paite: "Ka naupan chik a pan in mi'n tamveipi hon mangbangsak ua; himahleh hon zou tuan kei uh.
english: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.

paite: Lei lette'n ka nungzang ah lei alet ua; aleileh kuangte uh asausak uhi."
english: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.

paite: TOUPA adiktat ahi; migilou-saloute khauhualte a- attanta, chi in.
english: Yahweh is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.

paite: Amau zahlak leh taizaksak in om uhen, Zion hote tengteng mah.
english: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.

paite: Inn tung a loupa akhansang ma a vuai bang in om uhen.
english: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,

paite: Huai loupa in buh atmi khut ahihdim nhei kei a, bumphali telkhawmimin leng a-angsung ahihdim ngei sam kei hi.
english: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.

paite: Na tung uah TOUPA vualzawlna om hen; TOUPA min in ka hon vualzawl uhi, apaikhen mite'n achi sam kei uhi.
english: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of Yahweh be on you. We bless you in Yahweh’s name.”

paite: TOUPA aw, bang tan ahia na hon mangngilh nilouh ding? Bang tan ahia kei a kipan a na mai na sel ding?
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

paite: Nitum in ka lungtang a lungkhamna nei in bang tan ahia ka lungsim a ka gelgel ding? Bang tan ka melma ka tung a tawisan hi ding ahia?
english: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian aw, ngaihtuah inla, hon dawng in; ka mit hon hihvak in, huchi lou in zaw sihna ihmut in ka ihmu kha ding hi.
english: Behold, and answer me, Yahweh, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;

paite: Ka melma in, amah ka zouta, achi kha ding hi; ka lin leh kei hon doute akipak kha ding uhi.
english: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.

paite: Himahleh ke'n zaw na zahngaihna ka muang ahi; na hon hotdamna ah ka lungtang akipak ding.
english: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.

paite: Ka tung a hoihtak a ahih tak ziak in, TOUPA pahtawi in la ka sa ding hi.
english: I will sing to Yahweh, because he has been good to me.

paite: TOUPA aw, tui thukpi a kipan ka hon sam a,
english: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA ka aw ngaikhia in; hehpih ka ngetna aw na bil in ngaikhia in.
english: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.

paite: TOUPA nang thulimlouhnate na chiamtehleh TOUPA aw, kua adingzouta dia?
english: If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?

paite: Himahleh na kiang ah ngaihdamna a-om ahi, kihtak a na omtheihna ding in.
english: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.

paite: TOUPA ka ngak gige a, ka hinna in angak gige a, athu leng ka lamen ahi.
english: I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.

paite: Vengmi'n zingsang khovak angaklah sang in ka hinna in TOUPA angaklahzaw hi. Ahi, vengmi'n zingsang khovak angaklah sang in.
english: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.

paite: Israelte aw, TOUPA lamen un, TOUPA kiang ah zahngaihna a-om a, amah ah tatna tampi a-om hi.
english: Israel, hope in Yahweh, for there is loving kindness with Yahweh. Abundant redemption is with him.

paite: Huchi in ama'n Israelte athulimlouhna tengteng ua kipan ahunkhe ding hi.
english: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.

paite: TOUPA, ka lungtang akisathei kei a, ka mitte asanghah kei a; thil thupitakte ah ka kisangsak sam kei hi; kei a ding in thillamdang luate ah leng.
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. Yahweh, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.

paite: Ka hinna khim in ka daisak a; naupang nawinek tawpta anu kiang a om bang in, ka hinna naupang nawinek tawpta bang in ka om hi.
english: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.

paite: Israelte aw, TOUPA lamen un, tu a kipan a tangtawn in.
english: Israel, hope in Yahweh, from this time forward and forever more.

paite: TOUPA, David haksat thuaknate tengteng theihpih in;
english: A Song of Ascents. Yahweh, remember David and all his affliction,

paite: TOUPA kiang a kichiam a, Jakob Mihatpa kiang a thu achiamdan;
english: how he swore to Yahweh, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:

paite: "Ka omna inn a biakbuk ah ka lut kei dia, ka lupna ah ka kah sam kei ding hi.
english: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;

paite: Ka mitte ihmut ka phal kei ding a, ka mitte asin uh leng ka phal sam kei ding,
english: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,

paite: TOUPA mun ding ka zonkhiak masiah, Jakob Mi Hatpa omna ding," chi in.
english: until I find out a place for Yahweh, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”

paite: Ngai in, athu Ephrathah ah ka za ua; sing gam ah ka muta uhi.
english: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar.

paite: Amah biakbuk ah ka lut ding ua; akhe ngakna bul ah ka be ding uhi.
english: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.”

paite: TOUPA aw, thou inla, na khawlmun ding ah lut in; nang leh na hatna bawm.
english: Arise, Yahweh, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.

paite: Na siampute diktatna in kivan uhenla; na misiangthoute nuamsa in kikou uhen.
english: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!

paite: Na sikha David ziak in na thaunilh mel kiheisak nawn ke'n.
english: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.

paite: David kiang ah thutak in TOUPA akichiamta a; alehngatsan kei ding hi; "Na pumpi gah a mi laltutphah ah ka tusak ding.
english: Yahweh has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.

paite: Na tate'n ka thukhun leh ka thu theihsak, amau ka hilh ding azuih uleh, atate uh leng tangtawn in na laltutphah ah atu zel ding uh," chi in.
english: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”

paite: TOUPA'N Zion lah atel ngal a; a-omna ding in adeih hi.
english: For Yahweh has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.

paite: Hiai tangtawn a ding a ka khawlmun ding ahi; hiai ah ka om nilouh ding; ka deihlam ahi ngal a.
english: “This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.

paite: Anek ding tampi in ka vualzawl dia; amigentheite uh tanghou in ka taisak ding hi.
english: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.

paite: Asiampute hotdamna in ka van ding a; amisiangthoute nuamsa in akikou ding uhi.
english: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.

paite: Huai ah David kii ka selkhesak ding; ka thaunilh a ding in khawnvak ka septa hi.
english: I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.

paite: Amah doute zahlakna in ka van ding a, amah tung ah zaw alallukhu ate sengsung ding, chi in.
english: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”

paite: Ngai in, unaute kituak diamdiam a omkhawm anak hoih in, anuam mahmah hi!
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!

paite: Lu a thau manphatak, khamul a luangkhia, Aaron khamul ngei a luangkhia a, apuanaktual mong a luangkhia bang ahi.
english: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,

paite: Hermon daitui chiim Zion tangte a ke zel bang ahi; huai ah ToUPA'N vualzawlna thu apia a, tangtawn a hinna ding ngei.
english: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there Yahweh gives the blessing, even life forever more.

paite: Ngai un, TOUPA' inn a zan a dingh zel TOUPA sikhate tengteng aw, TOUPA phat un.
english: A Song of Ascents. Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh’s house!

paite: Na khutte uh mun siangthou lam ah zak unla, TOUPA phat un.
english: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise Yahweh!

paite: TOUPA'N Zion a kipan in hon vualzawl hen; lei leh van bawlpa ngei in.
english: May Yahweh bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.

paite: TOUPA phat un. TOUPA min phat un; TOUPA Sikhate aw, amah phat un.
english: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh’s name! Praise him, you servants of Yahweh,

paite: Nou TOUPA' inn a dingh a, Pathian inn huangsung intual a dinghte aw,
english: you who stand in Yahweh’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.

paite: TOUPA phat un; TOUPA lah ahoih ngal a; amin phat in la sa un, anuam mahmah ngal a!
english: Praise Yah, for Yahweh is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.

paite: TOUPA'N amah a ding in Jakob atelta a, agou tuam ding in Israel atel hi.
english: For Yah has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.

paite: TOUPA thupitak ahi chih leh, pathian tengteng sang a tungnungpen ahi chih, i thei ngal uhi.
english: For I know that Yahweh is great, that our Lord is above all gods.

paite: TOUPA'N a-ut peuhmah, van ah, lei ah, tuipi ah, tui thukpite ah ahih hi.
english: Whatever Yahweh pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.

paite: Ama'n meipite kawlmong a kipan in apaitousak a; vuah in khophiate asiam hi; akoihkhawmna a kipan huih alakhia hi.
english: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.

paite: Ama'n Aigupta gam ta masate athat a, mihing leh sate leng.
english: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.

paite: Aigupta gam aw, amah chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte na sung ah ahon sawl a, Pharaoh tung ah leh asikhate tung ah.
english: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.

paite: Ama'n nam tampi athat a, kumpipa thupi taktakte athat hi.
english: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings—

paite: Sihon Amorte kumpipa leh Og Bashan gam kumpipa leh, Kanaan gam a mi tengteng.
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—

paite: Agam uh gouluah ding in apia a, ami Israelte goutan ding in.
english: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.

paite: TOUPA aw, na min tangtawn in a-om ding a; TOUPA aw, nangmah theihgigena suan om sung teng in leng a-om ding hi.
english: Your name, Yahweh, endures forever; your renown, Yahweh, throughout all generations.

paite: TOUPA'N amite vai ahawmsak in, asikhate tung ah lainatna anei ding hi.
english: For Yahweh will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.

paite: Namte milimte dangka leh dangka-eng ahi ua, mihing khutsuak ahi uh.
english: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

paite: Kam anei ua, himahleh apau kei uh; mitte anei ua, himahleh amu thei kei uh;
english: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.

paite: Bilte anei ua, himahleh aza thei kei uh; akam uah hatna a-om sam kei hi.
english: They have ears, but they can’t hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.

paite: Amau bawlte amaute bang in a-om ding uh, huaite gingta peuhmahte.
english: Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them.

paite: Israel inkuanpihte aw, TOUPA phat un! Aaron inkuanpihte aw, TOUPA phat un!
english: House of Israel, praise Yahweh! House of Aaron, praise Yahweh!

paite: Levi inkuanpihte aw, TOUPA phat un! TOUPA lau mite aw, TOUPA phat un!
english: House of Levi, praise Yahweh! You who fear Yahweh, praise Yahweh!

paite: TOUPA Zion a kipan phat in om hen, Jerusalem a tengpa ngei, TOUPA phat un!
english: Blessed be Yahweh from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise Yah!

paite: Aw, TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu hilh un, amah lah ahoih ngal a; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

paite: Aw, pathiante' Pathian kiang ah kipahthu hilh un; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loving kindness endures forever.

paite: Aw, kumpipate TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu hilh un; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Amah kia thillamdang thupitak hihpa kiang ah; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: to him who alone does great wonders, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Pilna a van siampa kiang ah; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: to him who by understanding made the heavens, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Lei tui tung akoih ziazua pa kiang ah; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: to him who spread out the earth above the waters, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Vaksakpa thupitak kiang ah; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: to him who made the great lights, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Ni, sun a vaihawm ding in; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: the sun to rule by day, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Kha leh aksite, zan a vaihawm ding in; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: the moon and stars to rule by night, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Aiguptate ta masa hihlumpa kiang ah; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Israelte alak ua kipan a pikhepa kiang ah; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: and brought out Israel from among them, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Khut hat leh ban zak in; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Tuipi San kikhensakpa kiang ah; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: to him who divided the Red Sea apart, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Israelte alaitak a galkahsak a; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: and made Israel to pass through the middle of it, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Pharaoh leh asepaihte Tuipi San a hihmangpa kiang ah; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Amite gamdai a pipa kiang ah; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: to him who led his people through the wilderness, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Kumpipa thupitakte thatpa kiang ah; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: to him who struck great kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Kumpi minthangte thatpa kiang ah; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: and killed mighty kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Sihon Amorte kumpipa; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Og Bashan gam kumpipa; azahngaihna tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a;
english: Og king of Bashan, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Agam goutan dia pia; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: and gave their land as an inheritance, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Asikha Israel goutan pepa kiang ah; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: even a heritage to Israel his servant, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Ama'n i nam niam lai in hon theigige a; azahngaihna tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a;
english: who remembered us in our low estate, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Hon doute lak ah hon humbit a; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: and has delivered us from our adversaries, for his loving kindness endures forever;

paite: Ama'n sa tengteng kiang ah nek ding apia a; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: who gives food to every creature, for his loving kindness endures forever.

paite: Aw, van Pathian kiang ah kipahthu hilh un; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven, for his loving kindness endures forever.

paite: Babulon luite gei ah, huai ah i tu a, ahi, i kap zel a, Zion i ngaihtuah hi.
english: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

paite: Huai a muisumte ah i kaihgingte i khai ua.
english: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.

paite: Zion la khat hon saksak un, chi in sal a hon pite'n la sa ding in ahon sawl ua, hon hih gentheite'n nuamsa ding in leng ahon chi nak uhi.
english: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”

paite: Mi gam peuh ah bangchi in TOUPA la i sa thei dia?
english: How can we sing Yahweh’s song in a foreign land?

paite: Jerusalem aw, ka hon mangngilhleh, ka khut taklam in athilsiam mangngilh hen.
english: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.

paite: K'on theihgige keileh, ka dangtawng ah ka lei belh bikbek hen; ka nopsakna pen sang a Jerusalem ka deih zawk keileh.
english: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.

paite: TOUPA aw, Jerusalem ni in Edom suante theigige in. Asuangphum nangawn chimsak un, chimsak un, chite.
english: Remember, Yahweh, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”

paite: Babulon tanu aw, hihman a om ding; ka tung ua na hih bang a hon thuk ding pa kipak in a-om ding hi.
english: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.

paite: Na tanu noute hon laksak a, suangpi satna dia zang ding pa kipaktak in a-om ding hi.
english: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.

paite: Na kiang ah ka lungtang teng in kipahthu ka gen ding a; pathiante ma ah nang phat in la ka sa ding hi.
english: By David. I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.

paite: Na tempul siangthou lam nga in ka hon be ding a, na zahngaihna leh na thutak ziak in na min ka phat ding; thil tengteng tung ah na min leh na thu na hihlianta ngal a.
english: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.

paite: K'on sap ni in nang na hon dawng a, ka hinna na hatna in na hon hihhat hi.
english: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.

paite: TOUPA aw, lei a kumpipa tengteng in kipahthu ahon hilh ding ua, na kam a thupawtte azata uhi.
english: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, Yahweh, for they have heard the words of your mouth.

paite: Ahi, TOUPA lampite la in asa ding ua; TOUPA thupina lah athupi ngal a.
english: Yes, they will sing of the ways of Yahweh, for Yahweh’s glory is great!

paite: TOUPA tungnungtak ahi na a, mineute alimsak hi; mikisatheite bel gamlapi a kipan in athei hi.
english: For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.

paite: Mangbatna lak ah vak mah leng nang na hon hihhalh ding a; hon doute hehna sual ding in na khut na zak ding a, na khut taklam in na hon hondam ding hi.
english: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.

paite: TOUPA'N ka tungtang a ahih ding atangtun ding; TOUPA aw, na zahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding a; nangmah khut thilhihte tawpsan ke'n.
english: Yahweh will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, Yahweh, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang ngenteltak in n'on ensuak a, n'on theita hi.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.

paite: Nang ka tut leh ka din na thei a, gamlapi a kipan in leng ka ngaihtuahna na thei hi.
english: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.

paite: Ka pai leh ka lup na hon entel zel a, ka omdan tengteng na thei vek hi.
english: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.

paite: Ngai in, TOUPA aw, nang na theih siang vek louh, ka lei ah thu a-om kei hi.
english: For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, Yahweh, you know it altogether.

paite: Nang ka nunglam leh ka malam ah na hon umsuak a, ka tung ah na khut na koih lai hi.
english: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.

paite: Huchi tel a theihna kei a ding in alamdang lua a; asang tel a, ka phazou kei hi.
english: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.

paite: Na kha a pan in koi ah ka pai dia? Nang a pan koi ah ka taimang dia?
english: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?

paite: Van ah kahtou ning chi leng, huai ah na om ngal a; Sheol ah lupna bawl ning chi leng, ngai in, huai ah leng na om zel hi.
english: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!

paite: Zing kha zak in, tuipi tawp pek ah va om ning chi leng;
english: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,

paite: huai ah leng na khut in na hon pi ding a, na khut taklam in hon len ding ahi ngal a.
english: even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.

paite: Pel lou in mial in hon khuh zou vek ding a, ka kim a vak zan ahi ding chi dek mah leng;
english: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”

paite: Mial in nang a pan bangmah aliah kei a, zan lah sun bang in avak hi; nang a ding in mial leh vak akibang sapsap hi.
english: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.

paite: Nangmah ngei in ka lungsim na nei a; ka nu gilsung ah na hon phankhawm hi.
english: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.

paite: Na kiang ah kipahthu ka hon hilh ding a; lauhuaitak leh lamdangpi a bawl ka hih ziak in. Na thilhihte lamdangtak ahi a; huai tuh ka hinna in atheitel mahmah hi.
english: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

paite: Aguk a bawl a ka om a, lei mun nuainungpen a kilawmtak a bawl a ka om lai in, ka guh ka tang nang a pan sel in a-om kei hi.
english: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.

paite: Ka lim kibawl kim nai lou na mit in amu a, na laibu ah ka hiangte teng gelh vek ahi, anisim a bawl in a-om zel a, khat leng a-om nai louh lai in.
english: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.

paite: Pathian aw, na ngaihtuahnate kei a ding in manpha hi na tel e! Agawmkhawmna thupi hi na tel e!
english: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!

paite: Sim dek mah leng, atamdan piaunel sang in atamzaw ding; ka khanloh hun in, na kiang a om nilouh ka na hi.
english: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.

paite: Pathian aw, migilou-saloute na that ngei ding a; huchi in sisan suah hatte'n hon paisan ding uhi.
english: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!

paite: Amau giloutak in nang ahon gensia un, nangmah doute'n na min agen thanghuai nak uhi.
english: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.

paite: TOUPA aw, nangmah hote ka ho kei a hia? Nangmah sualte tung ah ka lungkim a hia?
english: Yahweh, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?

paite: Amau huat petmah in ka hua a; hon doute in ka sep chiat hi.
english: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.

paite: Pathian aw, ngenteltak in hon ensuak inla, ka lungtang thei in; hon chian inla, ka ngaihtuahnate thei in.
english: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.

paite: Kei ah gilou-salou lam mawngmawng a-om hia om lou, en inla, tangtawn lampi ah hon pi in.
english: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.

paite: Mihai in alungsim in, "Pathian a-om kei," achi a. Akigawp khin ua, thilkihhuaitak ahih ua; thil hoih hih a-om kei uhi.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.

paite: Theisiam a Pathian zong a-om uhiam, chi in TOUPA'N van a kipan in mihing tate a-ensuk hi.
english: Yahweh looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.

paite: Ahilou lam ah apial vekta ua, nintak in ana om chiatta ua; kuamah thil hoih hih a-om kei ua, khat lel leng a-om kei hi.
english: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

paite: Thil hihkhialte tengteng in theihna himhim anei kei ua hia? Tanghou anek bang un ka mite a ne zou vek ua, TOUPA asam kei uhi.
english: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on Yahweh?

paite: Huai ah lau tuntun in a-om ua; Pathian, midiktat suante lak a a-om ziak in.
english: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.

paite: Mitasam suangtuahnate na selphou ua, TOUPA akihumbitna ahih ziak in.
english: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because Yahweh is his refuge.

paite: Israelte hotdamna Zion a kipan in hong pawt mahleh aw! TOUPA'N amite sal a a-om uh apikik nawn chiang in, huai hun in Jakobte anuam ding ua, Israelte akipakta ding uhi.
english: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When Yahweh restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

paite: TOUPA aw, migilou a pan hon humbit inla; mingongtat a pan hon hum in;
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Deliver me, Yahweh, from evil men. Preserve me from violent men:

paite: amau alungtang uah thilhihkhelhte angaihtuah ua; dou ding in akikhawm uhi.
english: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.

paite: Alei uh gul bang in ahiamsak ua; akamsung uah thangtom gu a-om hi. Selah
english: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.

paite: TOUPA aw, migilou-salou khut lak ah hon kemhoih inla; mingongtat lak ah hon hum in; amau ka khe kalsuante sawnkawi atum uhi.
english: Yahweh, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.

paite: Mikisatheite'n ka awkna ding in thang aguk kam ua, khauhualte toh; lamsik ah len aphahua; ka awkna ding in thangte akam uhi. Selah
english: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah, nang zaw ka Pathian na hi; TOUPA aw, hehpih ka ngetna awte na bil na doh in.
english: I said to Yahweh, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA Pathian aw, ka hotdamna hatna aw, nang kisual ni chiah ka lu na hon khuhsak a,
english: Yahweh, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.

paite: TOUPA aw, migilou-salou deihlamte zaw phal ke'nla; angaihtuahna gilou pichingsak ke'n; huchi keileh akipahtawi kha ding uhi, ka chi a. Selah
english: Yahweh, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.

paite: Hon umsuakte lu amau muk a thugina lou agen un khuh hen.
english: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

paite: Mei-amte atung uah kia henla; mei ah paih in om uhenla; athoh nawnlouhna ding un kokhuk thupitak ah paih in om uhen.
english: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.

paite: Thuhoih lou genpa lei ah hihkip in a-om kei ding a, mingongtat hihse ding in thil hoih lou in azong ding hi.
english: An evil speaker won’t be established on the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

paite: TOUPA'N gimthuakte agum ding chih ka thei, tagahte a ding in diktak in vai ahawm ding.
english: I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.

paite: Pel lou in midiktatte'n na min aphat ding ua; na ma ah midikte a-om ding uhi.
english: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.

paite: TOUPA, ka hon sam hi, ka kiang ah hong pai meng inla, ka hon sap in ka aw ah bil na doh in.
english: A Psalm by David. Yahweh, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.

paite: Ka thumna gimnamtui bang in na ma ah hihkhiak in om henla; ka khut zak nitaklam kithoihna bang in om hen.
english: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka kam bul ah vengmi tusak inla; ka muk kongkhak veng in.
english: Set a watch, Yahweh, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.

paite: Gilou-salou thil hihkhialmi te hih bang in, thil hoih lou lam ah ka lungtang kiheisak ke'nla; aneklimte uh hon nesak ke'n.
english: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.

paite: Midiktat in hon sat hen, migitna ahi ding; hon taihilh hen; thau manpha ahi ding a, migilou-salou in ka lutang thaunilh ngei kei hen, anasep giloute hua in ka thum gige hi.
english: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.

paite: Amau mohpaih dingte kiang a piakkhiak ahih chiang un, TOUPA thu adik chih athei ding uh.
english: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.

paite: Mi'n lei aleh a, ahihzan bang in aguhte uh han gong ah thehdalh in a-om ding.
english: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”

paite: TOUPA Pathian aw, ka mit in nang lama-en nak a; nangmah ah ka muanna ka nga a; ka hinna vuaktang in nuse ke'n.
english: For my eyes are on you, Yahweh, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul destitute.

paite: Ka awkna ding a athangkam lak uah hon hum in, thil hihkhialte thang lak ah.
english: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.

paite: Kei ka suakta ding a, migilou-salou amau len ah awk uhen.
english: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.

paite: Ka Ka aw in, TOUPA ka sam a; ka aw in TOUPA kiang ah hehpihna ka ngen hi.
english: A contemplation by David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer. I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.

paite: Ama ah ka mangbat thu ka sungbua a; ama ah ka buaina ka theisak hi.
english: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.

paite: Ka sung a ka kha abah lai in, nang ka lampi na thei a! Ka paina lampi ah ka awkna ding in thang aguk kam uhi.
english: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.

paite: Ka taklam ah om inla, en dih, kuamah hon thei a-om kei ua; ka kihumbitna a-omta kei a; kuamah himhim in ka hinna alimsakta kei hi.
english: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka hon sam a, “Nang ka kihumbitna, mihing gam a ka tantuam na hi," ka chi a.
english: I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”

paite: Ka kikou husa ngaikhia in; nakpitak in hihniam in ka om hi. Hon simmohte lak ah hon humbit in, kei sang in ahatzaw ngal ua.
english: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.

paite: Na min ka phattheihna ding in, ka hinna suangkul a kipan in pikhia in, midiktatte'n hon umsuak ding ua; nang hoihtak a na hon hih ding ziak in.
english: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka thumna ngaikia inla; hehpih ka ngetna ah bildoh in; na ginomna ziak leh na diktatna ziak in hon dawng in.
english: A Psalm by David. Hear my prayer, Yahweh. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.

paite: Na sikha tung ah vaihawm ke'n; na mitmuh ah mihing himhim siamtang a om ding lah a-om kei uhi.
english: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.

paite: Melma in ka hinna asimmoh a; ka hinna lei ah asatpuk a; sawtpi a sisa bang in, mun mialte ah hon omsak hi.
english: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.

paite: Huaiziak in ka sung ah ka kha abah a, ka sung ah ka lungtang amangbang hi.
english: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.

paite: Nidanglai nite ka theigige a; na thilhihte teng ka ngaihtuah zel a na khut nasepte ka sut zel hi.
english: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.

paite: Ka khutte nang lam ah ka zak zel a, ka hinna, gam zawngkhaltak bang in, nangmah ah adangtak hi. Selah
