english: I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah.

paite: TOUPA aw, hon dawng meng in, ka kha abah hi; kei a pan na mai sel ke'n; huchi lou in zaw kokhuk a paisukte bang lel in ka na om kha ding hi.
english: Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.

paite: Zingsang in na zahngaihna thu hon theisak in; nang lah ka hon muang ngal a, ka paina ding lampi hon theisak in; ka lungsim lah na kiang ah ka koihkip zel ngal a.
english: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.

paite: TOUPA aw hon doute lak ah hon humbit in; na hon na sel ding in na kiang ah ka hong tai hi.
english: Deliver me, Yahweh, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.

paite: Na deihlam hih hon kisinsak in; ka Pathian lah na hi ngal a; na kha hoih in lamphei ah hon pi zel hen.
english: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.

paite: TOUPA aw, na min ziak in hon hihhalh inla; na diktatna ziak in ka hinna mangbatna a kipan pikhia in.
english: Revive me, Yahweh, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.

paite: Na zahngaihna ziak in hon doute hihmang inla, ka hinna hihmangbangte tengteng hihmang in; na sikha ka hi uhi.
english: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, for I am your servant.

paite: TOUPA ka suangpi phat in om hen, ama'n ka khutte galdou azilsak a, ka khutzungte dou ding in achil hi.
english: By David. Blessed be Yahweh, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle—

paite: Ka zahngaihna leh ka kulhpi, ka insang leh hon humbitpa, ka phaw leh ka muanna kingakna ka nuai a ka mite zou zelpa ahi.
english: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.

paite: TOUPA mihing bang ahia, hichi tel a amah na theih naknak? Mihing tapa leng kua ahia ahih, na ngaihtuah naknak?
english: Yahweh, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?

paite: Mihing zaw bangmah lou lel ahi a; adamsung nite lim mang zel bang ahi.
english: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.

paite: TOUPA aw, na vante kunsak in hong paisuk inla; tangte khoih in, huchi in akhukhe ding uhi.
english: Part your heavens, Yahweh, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.

paite: Khua phesak inla, amau dalhsak in na thalte kapkhia inla, hihbuaigawp in.
english: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.

paite: Tunglam a kipan in na khut in hon sawk inla; tui lian a kipan in hon honkhia in.
english: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,

paite: Akam un bangmah lou agen ua, akhut taklam uh diklouhna khut taklam ahi.
english: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

paite: Pathian aw, nangmah pahtawi in la thak ka sa ding a; pekging gui sawm nei in nangmah phat in la ka sa ding hi.
english: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.

paite: Amah ahi, kumpipate kiang a hotdamna pia a, namsau mi hihse thei lak a asikha David hunkhepa pen.
english: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.

paite: Hon honkhia inla, mikhualte khut a kipan hon humbit in, akam un thu bangmah lou peuh agen nak ua, akhut taklam uh khut taklam diklou ahi.
english: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

paite: Ka tate uh ahong valnou ua singnou dipdip bang a a-om ua; ka tanute uh leng inpi omdan gel bang a aning a suangkhuak bang a a-om hun un;
english: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

paite: Ka buh innte uh adim a, thil chi chih a-om phetphut a; ka belamte un leng nou asang asang a tam, asing asing a tam ka mun ua aneih chiang un;
english: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.

paite: Ka bawngte uh ahong suan phat a; nou neihsiat himhim a-om louh a; insung lok leh pawtkhia a-om louh a, ka kongzingte ua kikou husa a-om louh chiang in.
english: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.

paite: Huchibang a om mite kipaktak in a-om nak uhi; ahi, TOUPA Pathian anei mite kipaktak in a-om nak uhi.
english: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is Yahweh.

paite: Kumpipa aw, ka Pathian, ka hon pahtawi ding a; na min tangtawn tangtawn in ka phat ding hi.
english: A praise psalm by David. I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.

paite: Niteng in ka hon phat ding a; na min tangtawn tangtawn in ka phat ding hi.
english: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.

paite: TOUPA athupi a, nakpitak a phat ding ahi; athupidan suikhiak vual ahi kei hi.
english: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.

paite: Suan khat in suan dang kiang ah na thilhihte aphat sawnsawn ding a, na thilhih thupitakte atheisak ding hi.
english: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.

paite: Nangmah pahtawina kilawmdan thupitak leh na thillamdang hihte ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
english: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.

paite: Mite'n na thilhih mulkimhuaite hatdan agen ding ua; ke'n leng na thupidan ka theisak sam ding hi.
english: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.

paite: Na hoihna thupitak atheih uh agen ding ua, na diktatna nuamsatak in la in asa ding uhi.
english: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.

paite: TOUPA mihehpih thei, chitna a dim, lungnel, zahngaihna thupitak nei ahi.
english: Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.

paite: TOUPA bangkim tung ah leng ahoih hi; athilsiamte tung ah zahngaihnate a-om hi.
english: Yahweh is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.

paite: TOUPA aw, na thilsiam teng in na kiang ah kipahthu ahon hilh ding ua; misiangthoute'n nang ahon phat ding uhi.
english: All your works will give thanks to you, Yahweh. Your saints will extol you.

paite: Na gam thupidan thu gen in, na thilhihtheihna thu houlimna in azang ding ua;
english: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,

paite: Mihing tate kiang a athilhih thupitakte leh agam kilawmna thupidan theisak ding in.
english: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.

paite: Na gam tangtawn gam ding ahi a, na thuneihna suan om sung teng in a-om gige ding hi. TOUPA athute ah amuanhuai a, anasepte ah deihsak asiam hi.
english: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. Yahweh is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.

paite: TOUPA'N apukte alen gige a, kun kheukheu a omte akaitang hi.
english: Yahweh upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.

paite: Amau tengteng mit nang tung ah atu a; ahuntak ah an nek ding uh na pia hi;
english: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.

paite: na khut na zak a, thil hing teng deih na hihtaisak hi.
english: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

paite: TOUPA alampi tengteng ah adik a, anasep peuhmah a mihehpih thei ahi.
english: Yahweh is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.

paite: TOUPA amah min lou tengteng kiang ah anai hi; thudik a amah lou peuhmahte kiang ah.
english: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

paite: Amah laute deihlam ahihtangtung ding a; akahna uh aza ding a, ahondam ding hi.
english: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

paite: Amah it tengteng TOUPA'N ahawi a; himahleh migilou ahihmangthang ding.
english: Yahweh preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.

paite: TOUPA phatna ka kam in agen ding a; sa tengteng in amin siangthou tangtawn tangtawn in phat uhen!
english: My mouth will speak the praise of Yahweh. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.

paite: TOUPA phat un! Ka hinna aw, TOUPA phat in.
english: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh, my soul.

paite: Ka damsung teng in TOUPA ka phat ding a; ka hin lai teng in ka Pathian phat in la ka sa ding hi.
english: While I live, I will praise Yahweh. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.

paite: Miliante gingta kei unla, mihing tapa panpihna himhim omlouhna gingta sam kei un.
english: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.

paite: Anakna in apawtsana, amah lei ah akik nawn a; huai ni mah in angaihtuahnate amang pah ahi.
english: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.

paite: Amah panpihtu dia Jakob' Pathian neimi in nuam asa hi, alametna TOUPA a Pathian ah a-om hi.
english: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God,

paite: Ama'n van leh lei abawl a, tuipi leh asung a om tengteng, ama'n thudik avom gige hi.
english: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;

paite: Nuaisiah a omte a ding in vai ahawmsak a, gilkialte kiang ah an apia a, TOUPA'N hentate asuaktasak hi;
english: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. Yahweh frees the prisoners.

paite: TOUPA'N mittawte mit ahihvaksak a; kun kheukheute TOUPA'N akaitang a; TOUPA'N midiktatte a-it hi;
english: Yahweh opens the eyes of the blind. Yahweh raises up those who are bowed down. Yahweh loves the righteous.

paite: TOUPA'N mikhualte aveng a; pabeite leh meithaite akhotuah a; himahleh gilou lampite alumlehsak hi.
english: Yahweh preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.

paite: TOUPA'N tangtawn in vai ahawm ding; Zion aw, na Pathian in suan tengteng tan in vai ahawm ding hi. TOUPA phat un!
english: Yahweh will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise Yah!

paite: TOUPA phat un! Pathian phat a lasak ahoih a; amah zaw mi deihsak asiam a, phat akilawm him ahi.
english: Praise Yah, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.

paite: TOUPA'N Jerusalem adingsak nawn a; Israel delhkhiakte apikhawm nawn hi.
english: Yahweh builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.

paite: Khasiate ahihdam a, aliamnate uh atuam zel hi.
english: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

paite: Aksi tamdan asim a; amin uh asa chiat hi.
english: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.

paite: TOUPA athupi a, thilhihtheihna ah leng hattak ahi; apilna in tawp ni anei kei ding hi.
english: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.

paite: TOUPA'N thunuailutte alen gige a; migilou-saloute lei ah ahihniam zel hi.
english: Yahweh upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.

paite: Kipahthu gen a TOUPA pahtawi in la sa unla; kaihging toh i Pathian phat in la sa un.
english: Sing to Yahweh with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,

paite: Ama'n van meipi akhuhsak a, lei a ding in vuah asutuah a, tangte ah loupa apousak hi.
english: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.

paite: Ama'n sa kiang ah anek ding apia a, va-aknou hamhamte kiang ah toh.
english: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.

paite: Amah sakol hatna ah akipak kei a; mihing khe tungte ah leng kipahna himhim anei kei naknak hi.
english: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

paite: TOUPA amah laute tung leh azahngaihna lamente tung ah akipak hi.
english: Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.

paite: Jerusalem aw, TOUPA phat un; Zion aw, na Pathian phat in.
english: Praise Yahweh, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!

paite: Ama'n na kulh kongkhakte kalhna singtawnte akhauhsak a; na sung a na tate om lah avualzawl ngala.
english: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.

paite: Na gamgi sung ah lemna abawl a; buh hoihpen in ahon hihdim hi.
english: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.

paite: Athupiak lei ah asawlkhia a, hattak in athu atai hi.
english: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.

paite: Vuk belam mul bang in apia a; vuk kia vut bang in athehzak hi.
english: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.

paite: Atui khal tanghou them bang in apaikhia a, amah votna ma ah kua ahia dingh thei ding?
english: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?

paite: Athu asawlkhia a, huaite azulsak a, huih anungsak a tuite ahong luang hi.
english: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

paite: Athu Jakobte kiang ah alangsak a, Israelte kiang ah adan thusehte leh avaihawmte alangsak hi.
english: He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.

paite: Ama'n kua nam tung ah mah huchibang in ahih ngei kei a; avaihawmte athei sam kei uhi. TOUPA phat un!
english: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise Yah!

paite: TOUPA phat un! Van a kipante TOUPA phat unla; tunglamte ah amah phat un.
english: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!

paite: Angel tengteng aw, amah phat unla; asepaih tengteng aw amah phat un!
english: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!

paite: Ni leh khate aw, amah phat unla; aksi vakte aw, amah phat un!
english: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!

paite: Vante' vante aw, amah phat unla, vante tung a tui omte aw, amah phat un!
english: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.

paite: Amaute'n TOUPA min phat uhen; ama'n thu apia a, siam in a-omta uhi.
english: Let them praise Yahweh’s name, for he commanded, and they were created.

paite: Ama'n huaite tangtawn tangtawn a ding in ahihkip a; khen nawn theih louh ding in agite uh akhungkip hi.
english: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.

paite: Nou dragonte leh thuknate aw! Lei a kipan TOUPA phat un.
english: Praise Yahweh from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths,

paite: mei leh gial, vuk leh tuihute aw, athu zui zel huihpite!
english: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy wind, fulfilling his word,

paite: Tangte leh mualte tengteng, singgah nuam leh sidar singte aw;
english: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,

paite: gamsate leh ganvulhte aw; ganhingte, tungleng vasate aw;
english: wild animals and all livestock, small creatures and flying birds,

paite: lei a kumpipate leh michih kumpi tate leh lei vaihawmte aw;
english: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,

paite: nungak leh tangvalte, putek leh naupangte aw, TOUPA phat un!
english: both young men and maidens, old men and children.

paite: Amaute'n TOUPA min phat uhen; ama min kia tawisang in a-om ngal a; athupina in lei leh van akhup tham hi.
english: Let them praise Yahweh’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.

paite: Amite a ding in kii atungdingta, amisiangthou tengteng a ding a phatna mah; amah kiangnai a om Israel mite a ding. TOUPA phat un!
english: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise Yah!

paite: TOUPA phat un! TOUPA pahtawi in la thak sa unla, misiangthoute kikhopna ah aphatna la sa un.
english: Praise Yahweh! Sing to Yahweh a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.

paite: Israelte amau siampa tung ah kipak uhenla; Zion tate akumpipa uh tung ah nuam uhen.
english: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

paite: Amin lou in phat uhenla; khuangta leh kaihging toh amah phat in la sa uhen.
english: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!

paite: TOUPA amite tung ah akipak a; thunuailutte hotdamna in azem ding hi.
english: For Yahweh takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.

paite: Misiangthoute thupina ah kipaktak in om uhenla; alupna tungte uah nuam in la sa uhen!
english: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.

paite: Pathian pahtawi a phatna akam uah om henla, akhut uah namsau hiamtuah om hen.
english: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,

paite: Namte tung a phu la a, michih tung a gawtna tungsak ding leh,
english: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;

paite: akumpipate uh khainiang a hen a, amihoihte uh sikkolte bunsak ding leh,
english: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

paite: atung ua vaihawm gelhsa tungsak ding in; huai kilawmna a misiangthou tengteng in anei chiat uhi, TOUPA phat un!
english: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise Yah!

paite: TOUPA, na puanin ah kua ahong zintung dia? Na mual siangthou ah kua hong om ding?
english: A Psalm by David. Yahweh, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?

paite: Diktak a om, kizentak a hih a, alungtang a thutak genmi pen.
english: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;

paite: Alei a mi gense ngei lou a, alawm tung a thil hihkhial ngei lou a, a-invengte min leng gense ngeiloumi pen.
english: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;

paite: Migilou muhsit in a-om nak hi; TOUPA laudan siamte apahtawi hi. Amah a ding a poi ding nangawn kichiam khin a hihlamdang ngei lou mi.
english: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear Yahweh; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;

paite: Apung delh ding a asum leitawisak loumi, asiam zaw siam lou tangsak ding a golhna leng la ngeiloumi pen. Huchibang thilhihmi, Bangchik mah in aling kei ding hi.
english: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.

paite: TOUPA phat un! Pathian a mun siangthou ah phat unla; athilhihtheihna huihkhua zapi ah amah phat un!
english: Praise Yah! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!

paite: Athilhih thupitak ziak in amah phat unla; athupi mahmah dan bang in amah phat un!
english: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!

paite: Pengkul ging in amah phat unla; pekging leh kaihging in amah phat un!
english: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!

paite: Khuangta leh lam in amah phat unla; kaihging tuamtuam leh tamngai in amah phat un!
english: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!

paite: Dakkhutbet ngaihtak in amah phat unla; dakkhutbet ngaihtak in amah phat un!
english: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!

paite: Bangkim, hathei peuhmah in TOUPA phat hen! TOUPA phat un!
english: Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!

paite: Pathian aw, hon humbit in, nangmah ah ka ginna ka koih hi.
english: A Poem by David. Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah, nang tuh ka TOUPA na hi a; nang lou ngal thil hoih himhim ka nei kei.
english: My soul, you have said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”

paite: Lei a misiangthou omte zaw, amau zaw mihoih, ka kipahna teng omna ahi uh, ka chi ahi.
english: As for the saints who are on the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.

paite: pathian dangte kiang a taite zaw, alungkhamnate uh apung ding, asisan dawn kithoihna uh ke'n zaw ka lan kei ding a, ka muk in aminte uh ka lou sam kei ding hi.
english: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.

paite: TOUPA ka goutan leh ka nou tan ahi, nang ka tantuam na hon hihkipsak zel hi.
english: Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.

paite: Tehna khaute mun nuamtak ah ka tuam ding in aketa ahi; ahi, gou hoihtak ka luahta ahi.
english: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.

paite: TOUPA, suangtuahsakpa, ka phat ding a, ahi, zan chiang in ka lungsim hon hilhpil zel hi.
english: I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.

paite: TOUPA ka ma ah ka omsak gige a; ka taklam a a-om ziak in ka ling kei ding hi.
english: I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

paite: Huaiziak in ka lungtang akipak a, ka thupina anuam hi; ka sa leng bittak in a-om ding hi.
english: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.

paite: Ka kha Sheol ah na nuse kei ding a, muatna mu ding in na misiangthou na phal sam kei ding hi.
english: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.

paite: Nang hinna lampi na hon theisak ding a; na ma ah nuam dimletna a-om hi; na khut taklam ah tangtawn kipahna ding a-om hi.
english: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka dikna thu za inla, ka kikou husa ngaikhia inla, ka thumna, zuauthu genhat muk a pawt hilou ah, bil na doh in.
english: A Prayer by David. Hear, Yahweh, my righteous plea. Give ear to my prayer that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.

paite: Ka tung a thupukna na ma a kipan a pawt hi henla; na mit in khentuam neihlouhna en hen.
english: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.

paite: Ka lungtang na enchian a; zan in na hong pha a; na hon endikta a bangmah na mu het kei a; ka kam in agenkhial kei ding ka chi tinten ahi.
english: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.

paite: Mihing thilhih ah zaw, na muk a thupawt ziak in mihing ngongtat lampi a pai lou ding in ka kikemhoih ahi.
english: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.

paite: Ka kalsuante'n na lampi atawn ziahziah a, ka khete atal ngei kei hi.
english: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.

paite: Pathian aw, ka hon sam zel a, nang lah na hon dawng ding a; kei lam ah na bil hon doh inla, ka thugen ngaikhia in.
english: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.

paite: Nangmah a ginna koih peuhmahte kiang a, na khut taklam a amau sualte hondam zelpa aw, na zahngaihna lamdang kilangsak in.
english: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.

paite: Mit nauta bang in hon kem inla, na kha nuai ah hon busak in.
english: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,

paite: Migilou-salou hon hihsia a, hon dou a hon umkimvel lak ah.
english: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.

paite: Amaute thau a um in a-om ua, akam un kisatheitak in thu agen uhi.
english: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.

paite: Tu in ka kalsuanna peuhmah ahon umsuak a, hon hihpuk ding in amitte uh ka tung uah atusak uhi.
english: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.

paite: Amah humpinelkai sa keih ut bang leh humpinelkai lun lai mundai peuh a buk nilouh bang ahi.
english: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

paite: TOUPA aw, thou inla, amah maituah pih inla, kunsak in; ka hinna migilou-salou lak ah na namsau in humbit in.
english: Arise, Yahweh, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword,

paite: TOUPA aw, na khut in mihingte lak ah, khovel mihingte lak ah, humbit in; amau tuam zaw tu damsung a aneih uh ahi a, agil uh na gou in na dimsak naknak a; tate lungkim huntak in anei ua, asum zat val uh atangekte uh a ding in asihsan zel uhi.
english: from men by your hand, Yahweh, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.

paite: Ke'n zaw diktatna nei in na mel ka mu ding a; nangmah batna nei a ka hah chiang in ka lungkim hun mahmah ding hi.
english: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.

paite: TOUPA ka hatna aw, ka hon it hi.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David the servant of Yahweh, who spoke to Yahweh the words of this song in the day that Yahweh delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul. He said, I love you, Yahweh, my strength.

paite: TOUPA ka suangpi leh ka kulhpi, hon humbitpa ahi; ka Pathian ka suangpi kiptak ahi a, amah ah ginna ka koih ding; ka phaw, ka hotdamna kii leh ka insang ahi.
english: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

paite: Phat tuak TOUPA ka sam ding a, Hon doute lak ah hotdam in ka om ding hi.
english: I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.

paite: Sihna khauhualte'n ahon gak a, Pathian limsaklouhna tuihual in hon tum a;
english: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

paite: Sheol khauhualte'n ahon gaksuak a, sihna thangte ka kimvel in a-om hi.
english: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.

paite: Ka lungkham a TOUPA ka sam a, ka Pathian ka sam hi. Ama'n atempul a pan ka aw aza a, ama a ka kikou husa abil ah alutta hi.
english: In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.

paite: Huaitak in lei aling a, akisatta aheh ziak in mualte leng akingakna nangawn toh akisat in alingta hi.
english: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.

paite: Anak a kipan in meikhu azamtou a, akam a pawt mei in akang zuazua a, meihol leng akuangsak hi.
english: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.

paite: Ama'n vante kunsak in, ahohsuk a; akhenuai ah mial bikbek a-om hi.
english: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.

paite: Cherub tung ah atuang a, alengta hi, ahi, huihkhuate ah aleng vengveng hi.
english: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.

paite: Mial bukna mun ah, bukta in ama umna abawl a; tui a mialna leh van a meipite mah.
english: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

paite: Ama a vakna ziak in ameipite atheng a, gialte leh mei-amte ake toktok uhi.
english: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.

paite: TOUPA van tung ah aging dodop a, Tungnungpen in a-aw asuaksak a; gialte leh mei- amte ake toktok uhi.
english: Yahweh also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.

paite: Athalte akapkhia a, amaute ahihzak hi; ahi, khua aphe zolzol nilouh a, ahihbuai vengvung hi.
english: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them. He routed them with great lightning bolts.

paite: Huaitak in, TOUPA aw, na tai ding a, na nak a hu pawt in amut ziak in, tui luannate ahong kilang a, leilung kingaknate hihlat in a-omta hi.
english: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, Yahweh, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.

paite: Ama'n tunglam a kipan hon sawk in, ahon len a; tui tampi a kipan hon kaikhia hi.
english: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.

paite: Kei galhattak lak ah hon humbit a, hon hote lak ah leng; kei a ding in ahat lo zen ngal ua.
english: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

paite: Amau ka vangtah ni in hon sual ua, himahleh TOUPA ka ginpi pen ahi.
english: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.

paite: Ama'n mun awngthawl ah hon pikhia a; ka tung a akipah ziak in hon humbitta ahi.
english: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

paite: TOUPA'N ka diktatdan bang in ka tung ah ahih a; ka khutte asianthoudan bang ngei in ahon din ahi.
english: Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.

paite: TOUPA lampite ka tawn a, ka Pathian kiang a kipan giloutak in ka paimang ngei ngal kei a.
english: For I have kept the ways of Yahweh, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

paite: Avaihawmna tengteng ka ma ah a-om a, adan thusehte ka pai ngei ngal kei hi.
english: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.

paite: Amah lak ah gensiatbei ka hi a, ka siatna a kipan ka kihuikhe zel hi.
english: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N ka dikdan bang in ahon na dinta a, ka khutte amitmuh a asianthou bang zel in.
english: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

paite: Mihehpih theitakte lak ah hehpih theitak in na kilang ding a; mihoihkimte lak ah hoihkim in na kilang ding a;
english: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.

paite: misiangthoute lak ah siangthou in na kilang ding a; huan, genhakte lak ah genhak in na kilang ding hi.
english: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.

paite: Gimthuak mite hondam ding na hi ngal a; mikisatheite bel na hihniam ding hi.
english: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.

paite: Nang ka khawnvak na hon detsak ding ahi ngal a. TOUPA ka Pathian in ka mialna ahihvak ding hi.
english: For you will light my lamp, Yahweh. My God will light up my darkness.

paite: Nang hon panpih in gal ka delh ngal a; ka Pathian panpih mah in kulh dai ka tawmkan ahi.
english: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

paite: Pathian lampi ahoihkim a, TOUPA thu etdik ahita hi; amah a ginna koih tengteng a ding in amah tuh phaw ahi.
english: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

paite: TOUPA lou Pathian kua a-om a ahia? I Pathian lou suangpi kua a-om a ahia?
english: For who is God, except Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God,

paite: Hatna hon tengsakpa leh ka lampi hih hoihkimpa Pathian mah;
english: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?

paite: Ama'n ka khe zukpi khe bang in abawl a, ka mun sangte ah hon omsak hi.
english: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.

paite: Ka khutte galdou ding in achil a, ka bante'n dal thalpeu alaizou hial hi.
english: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

paite: Nang na hotdamna phaw na hon pia a, na khut taklam in ahon kai a, na kingaihniamna in na hon bawllian hi.
english: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.

paite: Ka nuai a ka kalsuanna na hihlian a, huchi in ka khete ateu kei hi.
english: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.

paite: Hon doute ka delh ding a, ka delhpha ding; hihmanthat a a-om masiah uh ka kihei kikta kei ding hi.
english: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.

paite: Athohnawn theihlouhna ding un ka sattan ding a, ka khenuai ah apuk ding uh.
english: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.

paite: Nang kidouna a ding in hatna ka tai ah na hon tengsak a, hon sualte ka nuai ah na zouta hi.
english: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

paite: Hon hote ka hihmanthat theihna ding in, nang hon doute hon nunglehngatsan ding in na omsakta hi.
english: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

paite: Amau akikou ua, himahleh hondampa ding kuamah a-om kei uh; TOUPA asam ua, himahleh adawng tuan kei hi.
english: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.

paite: Huaitak in leivui huih mutleng bang in ka satnen a, kholak buannawi bang phet in ka paikheta hi.
english: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.

paite: Nang mite kilaina lak ah na hon humbit a; namte lutang ding in na hon siam a, ka theih ngei louh mite'n ka nek-tak abawlta ding uhi.
english: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.

paite: Ka tanchin azaktak un ka thu amang ding ua; mikhualte ka kiang ah akipe ding uhi.
english: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.

paite: Mikhualte avul ding ua, a-insang ua kipan in ling kawm in ahong suk ding uhi.
english: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.

paite: TOUPA ahing hi; ka suangpi phat in om henla; hon hondampa Pathian pahtawi in om hen.
english: Yahweh lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,

paite: Phu hon laksakpa leh ka nuai a mite koihpa Pathian ahi.
english: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.

paite: Ama'n hon doute lak ah hon honkhia a, ahi, nang kei hon sualte tunglam ah na hon domkang a; mihiamgamte lak a kipan na hon humbit zel hi.
english: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA aw, namte lak ah kipahthu ka hon hilh ding a, nang phat in la ka sa ding hi.
english: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

paite: Ama'n hotdamna thupitak akumpipa kiang ah ape zel a; athaunilhpa tung ah, David leh asuante tung ngei ah, tangtawn in azahngaihna alangsak ding hi.
english: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.

paite: Vante'n Pathian thupidan atheisak ua; huihkhua liantak in akhutsuak alangsak hi.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

paite: Sun in sun kiang ah thu agensawn a, zan in zan kiang ah theihna asulang sawnsawn hi.
english: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.

paite: Thugen himhim leh pau a-om kei a; a-aw uh bil a zak theih ahi kei hi.
english: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.

paite: Atehna khau uh leilung luah tengteng ah zamsuaksak in a-om a; athu uh kawlmong pha in athangkheta hi. Huaite ah ni a ding in puanin azak a,
english: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,

paite: huai ni tuh mouneipa ding adantan a kipan pawt bang ahi a, mihattak bang in, ataina lampi a atai ding nuam asa naknak hi.
english: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.

paite: Apawtna kawlmong tawp a kipan ahi a, ataikawina atawp lehlam tan in ahi a, asatna a kipan bangmah sel in a-om kei hi.
english: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.

paite: TOUPA dan ahoihkim a, hinna ahalhsak hi; TOUPA thu theihsak amuanhuai a, mimawl apilsak hi.
english: Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.

paite: TOUPA thuzohna adik a, lungtang akipaksak nak hi. TOUPA thupiak asiangthou a, mitte ahihvak nak hi.
english: Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.

paite: TOUPA laudan siam asiang a, tangtawn a ding in a-om hi. TOUPA vaihawmnate atak a, akizen kimvel vek ahi.
english: The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.

paite: Huaite dangka-eng sang in adeihhuaizaw a, ahi, dangka-eng siangthou tampi sang in leng; khuaizu leh khuaikhak sang in leng akhumzaw ahi.
english: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.

paite: Huai lou leng huaite in na sikha taihilh in ka om zel hi; huaite zuih ah kipahman thupitak a-om hi.
english: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.

paite: Kua'n ahia amah diklouhnate theithei ding? Diklouhna kiselte lak ah hon huikhia in.
english: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.

paite: Thil hihkhial teitei lou ding in na sikha hon len tinten inla; ka tung ah amaute thu neisak ke'n! Huchi in hoih in ka om dia, tatlekna thupitak lak ah gensiatbei in ka om ding hi.
english: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka suangpi leh hon tanpa, ka kam a thupawtte leh ka lungtang a ka ngaihtuahnate na mitmuh in pomtak mtak hi hen.
english: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.

paite: "Bang achia namte heh a, bang achia michih in thil phatuam lou ngaihtuah uh ahia?
english: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

paite: Leitung a kumpipate akisa duamduam ua, heutute'n leng TOUPA leh athaunilh kalh asawm chiat uh,
english: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed, saying,

paite: agaknate uh hihtat in, akhauhualte uh ei a kipan i paimang ding uh," chi in.
english: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”

paite: "Van a tupa anui dia; TOUPA'N amaute anuihsan ding hi.
english: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.

paite: Huai khit chiang in heh in akiang uah thu agen ding a, thangpaitak in amaute ahihmangbangta ding hi.
english: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:

paite: Kei mahmah in ka mual siangthou Zion ah ka kumpipa ka tusak hi," achi hi.
english: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”

paite: Thusehsa ka gen ding hi; TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Nang zaw ka tapa na hi a; tuni in ka hon neikhia ahi.
english: I will tell of the decree: Yahweh said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.

paite: Hon ngen in, huchi in na gouluah ding in namte ka hon pe dia, kawlmong tawp tan in na gou ding in leng ka hon pe ding hi.
english: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.

paite: Sikchiang in amaute na hihkham dia; belvelmi'n bel apaihkhap bang un na paikham ding,” achi hi.
english: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipate aw, pilta unla; leitung a vaihawmte aw, thuzoh in omta un.
english: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.

paite: Laudan siam in TOUPA nna sem unla, ling kawm in kipak un.
english: Serve Yahweh with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

paite: Tapa tawp unla, huchi keileh aheh ding a, lam lak ah na mangthang kha ding uh, athangpai zok ding hi. Amah a ginna koih tengteng ahampha uhi.
english: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.

paite: Mangbat ni in TOUPA'N hon dawng hen! Jakob' Pathian min in hon liahkhuh hen!
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,

paite: Mun siangthou a kipan in panpihna hon sawlsak henla, Zion a kipan in hon hihhat hen!
english: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,

paite: Na thillat teng theigige henla, na halmang thillat kipahpih hen! Selah
english: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.

paite: Na lungtang deihlam hon pia henla, na lunggel tengteng hon lohchingsak hen.
english: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.

paite: Na hotdamna ah nuam in la ka sa ding ua, ka Pathian min un ka puanzakte uh ka zak lai ding uh! TOUPA'N na ngetnate hon lohchingsak hen!
english: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May Yahweh grant all your requests.

paite: TOUPA'N athaunilh ahondam chih tu in ka theita; akhut taklam hotdamna tha in avan siangthou a kipan in amah ahon dawng ding hi.
english: Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.

paite: Khenkhatte'n kangtalaite amuang ua, khenkhat in sakolte amuang uh, E'n zaw TOUPA i Pathian min i lou zaw ding hi
english: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of Yahweh our God.

paite: Amau zaw akun un, apukta ua; ei zaw i thou ua, i ding zawta hi.
english: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.

paite: TOUPA, hondam in! I sap chiang in kumpipa'n hon dawng hen.
english: Save, Yahweh! Let the King answer us when we call!

paite: TOUPA aw, kumpipa tuh na hatna ah anuam ding a, na hotdamna ah nuamsa na zouzen in chia!
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!

paite: Alungtang deihlam na pia a, amuk a thilnget na phal lou kei hi. Selah
english: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.

paite: Hoihna a vualzohnate in na dawn a; dangka-eng siangthou kumpi lukhu na khusak hi.
english: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.

paite: Ama'n hinna ahon ngen a, na pia a tangtawn tangtawn a damna.
english: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.

paite: Na hotdamna ah athupina alian mahmah ahi; pahtawina leh thupina amah tung ah na nga zel hi.
english: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.

paite: Tangtawn a ding in vualzawlna liantak mu in na bawl a, na ma a nopsakna in na kipaksak hi.
english: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.

paite: Kumpipa'n TOUPA amuang a, tungnungpen zahngaihna ziak in aling kei ding hi.
english: For the king trusts in Yahweh. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.

paite: Na khut in na melmate tengteng azongkhe vek ding a; na khut taklam in nang hon doute azongkhe ding hi.
english: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.

paite: Na heh hun chiang in amau haltuina meikuang lutlut bang in na bawl ding. TOUPA'N amau heh in avalh khin ding a, mei in akangmang mai ding hi.
english: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.

paite: Agahte uh lei a kipan na hihmang ding a, asuante uh mihing tate lak a kipan in na hihmang behlap ding hi.
english: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.

paite: Na tung ah thil gilou hih atum ua; thil gilou angaihtuahkhia ua, ahihtangtung thei ngal kei uhi.
english: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.

paite: Nang amau na kiheisak dek a, na thalpeu khaute amaitang uah laisa in na bawl ding hi.
english: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.

paite: TOUPA aw, na hatna ah pahtawi in hong om in, huchi in na thilhihtheihna phat in la ka sa ding uhi.
english: Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.

paite: Ka Pathian, ka Pathian, bang achia non paisan? Bang achia hon panpih ding a na gamlat mahmah a, ka thumna thute a kipan a na gamlat?
english: For the Chief Musician; set to “The Doe of the Morning.” A Psalm by David. My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?

paite: Ka Pathian aw, sun in ka kikou a, himahleh na dawng tuan kei a; zan in leng ka kikou a, ka dai tuan kei hi.
english: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.

paite: Himahleh, nang Israelte phatna a tengpa aw, nang zaw na siangthou hi.
english: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.

paite: Ka pipute un nang hon na muang ua, amuang ua, huchi in nang na humbit zel hi.
english: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.

paite: Nang ahon sam ua, huchi in humbit in a-om zel ua, ahon muang ua, huchi in zahlak in a-om ngei kei uhi.
english: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.

paite: Kei zaw mihing ka hi kei a, tangtel phet ka hi a; mihingte gensiat leh mite muhsit ka hi.
english: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.

paite: Ahon mu peuh in hon nuihsan ua, amuk uh alawksak ua, alu uh asing uh.
english: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,

paite: TOUPA muang hiven, ama'n amah humbitleh ake; atung a akipah ziak in humbitleh ake, achi uhi.
english: “He trusts in Yahweh. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”

paite: Nang sul a kipan a hon lakhepa na hi a, ka nu ang a nawi ka tep lai nangawn in nang muandan na hon sinsaksakta hi.
english: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.

paite: Sul a kipan him in nangmah tung ah ngak ka na hi a, ka nu gilsung ah ka Pathian na hi hi.
english: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.

paite: Hon gamlat mahmah ke'n; mangbatna ding anai ngal a; panpihtu ding a-om tuan kei hi.
english: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.

paite: Bawngtal tampi in ahon umsuak ua, Bashan gam a bawngtal hattakte’n hon umsuak uhi;
english: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.

paite: Humpinelkai duhgawl humham bang in ahon kamkatkhum uhi.
english: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.

paite: Tui bang in buakkhiak in ka om a, ka guh tengteng leng akilawi hi; ka lungtang khuainun bang ahi a, ka gil lak ah azul khinta hi;
english: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.

paite: Ka tha belpei bang in akeu khin a; ka lei ka dangtawng ah abelh bikbek a; nang sihna leivui ah na hon pilutta hi.
english: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.

paite: Uite'n ahon umsuak uа; thil hoih lou hih omkhawmte'n hon umbit ua; ka khut leh ka khete avut uhi.
english: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.

paite: Ka guh tengteng ka sim thei a; amau lah hon en in hon ensal ua;
english: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.

paite: Ka puansilhte akihawm ua, ka puanak ding in ai asan uhi.
english: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.

paite: Nang bel, TOUPA aw, hon gamlat mahmah ke'n! Hon hihhatpa aw, hon panpih ding in hong kin in!
english: But don’t be far off, Yahweh. You are my help. Hurry to help me!

paite: Ka hinna namsau lak ah humbit inla; ka neihsun pentak ui thilhihtheihna lak ah humbit in!
english: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.

paite: Humpinelkai kam a kipan in hon hondam inla; ahi, gam bawngtal kii a kipan in ka kha hondam in!
english: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.

paite: Ka unaute kiang ah na min ka hilh ding a; kikhawmte lak ah ka hon phat ding hi;
english: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.

paite: TOUPA laudan siamte aw, amah phat un; Jakob suan tengteng aw, amah pahtawi un; Israel suante aw, amah kihta un!
english: You who fear Yahweh, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!

paite: Ama'n gimthuakmi gimdan amusit ngal kei a, akih sam kei; amai lah alak ah asel kei; amah asap in angaikhe zaw hi.
english: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.

paite: Kikhopna thupitak a ka hon phat zel zaw nangmah na hi; alaudan siamte ma ah ka thuchiam ka tangtun ding hi.
english: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.

paite: Thunuailutte'n ane ding ua, atai ding uh, amah zongte'n TOUPA aphat ding uh; na lungtang uh tangtawn in hing in om hen!
english: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise Yahweh who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.

paite: Kawlmong a mi tengteng in leng athei nawn ding ua, TOUPA lam angata ding uh; nam chih a chi chih na ma ah akun ding uhi.
english: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to Yahweh. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.

paite: Gam TOUPA a ahi a, namte tung a vaihawmpa ahi.
english: For the kingdom is Yahweh’s. He is the ruler over the nations.

paite: Lei a mi nei zou tengtengte'n ane un abe ding ua; leivui dia paisuak dingte ama ah ahong kun ding uhi; amau hinna hingsak gige theiloute.
english: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.

paite: Chisuan in amah nek-le-tak abawl ding a; khangthak hong om nawnte kiang ah TOUPA tanchin ahilh ding uhi.
english: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.

paite: Ahong pai ding ua, nam hong pawt ding kiang ah, ahih khinta, chi in adiktatdan ahon theisak ding uhi.
english: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.

paite: TOUPA tuh hon chingpa ahi a; ka tasam kei ding hi.
english: A Psalm by David. Yahweh is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.

paite: Ama'n loupa hing nou mitmet mun ah hon kualsak zel a; tui dai dide kiang ah hon pi zel hi.
english: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

paite: Ka hinna ahon bawlhoihsak zel a, ama min ziak in diktatna lampi ah hon pi zel hi.
english: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

paite: Ahi, sihna lim phaizang tawn mah leng, gilou himhim ka lau kei ding; nang ka kiang ah na om ngal a, na khetbuk leh na chiangkhun in hon khamuan zel hi.
english: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

paite: Hon doute mitmuh in ka ma ah dohkan na bawlkhol a; ka lutang thau na nilh khin a, ka nou adimlet hi.
english: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.

paite: Pel lou in hoihna leh zahngaihna in ka damsung teng in hon zui zel ding ua; huchi in TOUPA' inn ah tangtawn in ka om nilouhta ding hi.
english: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh’s house forever.

paite: Leitung leh asung a thil om tengteng TOUPA a ahi a; khovel leh asung a om tengteng toh;
english: A Psalm by David. The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.

paite: Tuipite tung a lei amah muhkhiak ahi a, tuite tung ah amah hihkip ahi.
english: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.

paite: TOUPA mual ah kua apaitou dia, amun siangthou ah kua ahia dingh ding?
english: Who may ascend to Yahweh’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?

paite: Khut siang leh lungtang siangthou nei a, alungsim thulim lou lam a koih ngei lou a, khem tum a kichiam ngei lou mi.
english: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.

paite: Ama'n TOUPA kiang a kipan vualzawlna amu ding a, ahondampa Pathian kiang a kipan diktanna leng amu ding hi.
english: He shall receive a blessing from Yahweh, righteousness from the God of his salvation.

paite: Huai tuh amah zongmi suan ahi. Jakob' Pathian aw, na mel zongte mah. Selah
english: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.

paite: Kongpite aw, na lutang uh sangsak un; nou tangtawn kongkhakte aw, kikhaisang un! Huchi a thupina Kumpipa ahong luttheihna ding in.
english: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

paite: Thupina Kumpipa kua ahia? TOUPA hattak leh thilhihtheitak, TOUPA kidouna a thilhihtheitak, ahi!
english: Who is the King of glory? Yahweh strong and mighty, Yahweh mighty in battle.

paite: Kongpite aw, na lutang uh sangsak unla, ahi, tangtawn kongkhakte aw, kikhaisang un! Huchi a thupina Kumpipa a hong luttheihna ding in.
english: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

paite: Hiai thupina Kumpipa kua ahia? Sepaihte' TOUPA amah mah thupina Kumpipa ahi. Selah
english: Who is this King of glory? Yahweh of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka lungsim na kiang ah ka koih den zel a.
english: By David. To you, Yahweh, I lift up my soul.

paite: Ka Pathian aw, nang ka hon muang hi, zahlak in hon omsak ke'nla; hon doute hon zoh phal ke'n.
english: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.

paite: Ahi, nang hon ngakte kuamah zahlak in a-om kei ding uh. Aziak om lou a lepchiahtak a gamtate zahlak in a-om ding uh.
english: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.

paite: TOUPA aw, na lampite hon theisak inla; na lamtate tanchin hon hilh in.
english: Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.

paite: Na thutak ah hon pi inla, hon hilh in, nang hon hondampa Pathian na hi ngal a; nitum in ka hon ngak nilouh hi.
english: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.

paite: TOUPA aw, na lainatna leh na zahngaihnate theigige in; tuma a na om gige sa ahi ngal a.
english: Yahweh, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.

paite: Ka valnou lai khelhnate leh ka tatleknate theigige ke'nla; TOUPA aw na hoihna ziak in, na zahngaihna bang zel in hon theigige in.
english: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA zaw a hoih in adik ahi; huaiziak in mikhialte lampi amusak ding.
english: Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.

paite: Thunuailutte vaihawmna dik ah api ding a, thunuailutte amah lampi tanchin leng ahilh ding hi.
english: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.

paite: Athukhun leh athu theihsakte zuite a ding in TOUPA lampi tengteng zahngaihna leh thutak ahi.
english: All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

paite: TOUPA aw, na min ziak in thulimlouhna ngaidam in, thupitak ahi ngal a.
english: For your name’s sake, Yahweh, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.

paite: TOUPA kihtami kua ahia? Atel ding lampi amusak ding hi.
english: What man is he who fears Yahweh? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.

paite: Ahinna nuamsatak in a-om ding a; asuante'n gam aluah ding uhi.
english: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.

paite: TOUPA thuguk amah laudan siamte kiang ah a-om, athukhun amaute atheisak ding hi.
english: The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.

paite: Ka mit in TOUPA lam a-en gige a, ama'n ka khete len a kipan in lakhe ding ahi ngal a.
english: My eyes are ever on Yahweh, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.

paite: Kei lam hong nga inla, ka tung ah zahngai in; chim leh haksatak in ka om ngal a.
english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.

paite: Ka lungtang buainate ahong thupita a; ka mangbatna a kipan hon pikhia in aw.
english: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.

paite: Ka haksatna leh ka thuakdan ngaihtuah inla, ka khelhnate ngaidam in.
english: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.

paite: Hon doute ngaihtuah dih, tampi ahi ua; nakpi petmah in ahon ho behlap uhi.
english: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.

paite: Ka hinna vomhoih inla, hon humbit in aw; zahlak in hon omsak ke'nla, nang ah ka ginna ka koih ngal a.
english: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.

paite: Ka lungsim hoihna leh ka dikna in hon humbit in. K'on ngak nilouh ngal a.
english: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.

paite: Pathian aw, Israelte mangbatna tengteng ua kipan tankhia in.
english: God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.

paite: TOUPA aw, vai hon hawmsak in, lungsim hoihtak pu in ka om a, ginglah lou in ka muang hi.
english: By David. Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.

paite: TOUPA aw, hon pheklek in hon enchian in; ka lungsim leh ka lungtang hihsiangthou in.
english: Examine me, Yahweh, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.

paite: Na zahngaihna ka ma ah a-om ngal a, na thutak ah ka om zel hi.
english: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.

paite: Mi bangmah lou phette kiang ah ka tu ngei kei a; milepchiahte kiang ah leng ka lut sam kei ding hi.
english: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.

paite: Thil hoih lou hihte kikhawmte ka mudah a, migilou-saloute kiang ah ka tu kei ding.
english: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.

paite: Ka khutte gensiatbeina in ka sil ding a, huchibang in, TOUPA aw, na maitam ka vel ding hi.
english: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, Yahweh,

paite: Kipahthu genna ngaihtak a ka gen theih a, na thillamdang hih tengteng thute ka hilhtheihna ding in.
english: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.

paite: TOUPA, na omna inn ka it a, na thupina omna leng.
english: Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.

paite: Ka hinna mikhialte lak ah lakhawm ke'nla, ka hinna leng sisan suah hatte lak ah lakhawm sam ke'n.
english: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men

paite: Akhut uah ngaihtuah gilou a-om a, akhut taklam uh golhna in adim hi.
english: in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes.

paite: Himahleh kei zaw lungsim hoih pu in ka om ding; hon tan inla, hon hehpih in.
english: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.

paite: Ka khe mun tamtak ah adingh a; kikhopkhawmna ah TOUPA aphat ding hi.
english: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA ka vak leh hon hondampa ahi; kua ka lau dia? TOUPA ka hinna insang ahi; kua ka kihta dia?
english: By David. Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

paite: Thil hoih lou hihte, hon doute leh ka melmate'n, ka sa nek tum a hon sual lai un, akisui ua, apuk chiat uhi.
english: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.

paite: Sepaih pawlte'n hon sual tum in hon giahkhum mah le uh ka lungtang in akihta kei ding; ka tung ah kidouna hong suak mahleh, huchipi in leng ka gingta tinten ding hi.
english: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah thil khat ka ngen a, huai mah ka zong ding; TOUPA kilawmdan mu ding leh, atempul a thu dong ding in ka damsung teng a TOUPA' inn a ka om gige theihna ding in.
english: One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life, to see Yahweh’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.

paite: Mangbat ni inn a bukta ah hon koihkhian ding ahi ngal a, ahumbitna puanin ah hon sel ding a; suangpi tung ah hon khakai ding hi.
english: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.

paite: Tu in hon doute, hon umsuakte tunglam ah ka lu dopkang in a-om ding; huchi in apuanin ah nopna kithoihnate ka lan ding a; la ka sa ding.
english: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka aw a ka hon sapleh ngaikhia inla; ka tung ah zahngai inla, dawn leng hon dawng in.
english: Hear, Yahweh, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.

paite: Ka mel zong un, chi a na gen lai in, ka lungtang in na kiang ah, TOUPA mel ka zong ding, ka chi hi.
english: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, Yahweh.”

paite: Ka lak ah na mai sel ke'nla; na sikha heh in hihmang ke'n, nang zaw hon panpihpa na hi gige a; hon hondampa Pathian aw, hon paikhe ke'nla hon paisan ke'n.
english: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.

paite: Ka nu leh ka pa'n hon paisanta uhi, himahleh TOUPA'N ahon pom lai ding.
english: When my father and my mother forsake me, then Yahweh will take me up.

paite: TOUPA aw, na lampi hon ensak inla; ka melmate ziak in lampi phei mahmah ah hon pi in.
english: Teach me your way, Yahweh. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.

paite: Hon doute ut-ut a hih ding in hon pe mahmah ke'n; theihpih dikloute'n hon sual ua, nunsiat thu sekhe nakte'n.
english: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.

paite: Mihing gam ah TOUPA hoihna muh kigingta lou hi leng ka bahta ding hi.
english: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.

paite: TOUPA ngak gige in; hattak in om in, na lungtang kihihhang in; ahi, TOUPA ngak gige in.
english: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA aw, hon sam ding hi ing; ka suangpi, kei lam ah na bil ngongsak ke'n, huchi lou in zaw; nang na hon daihsanleh, kokhuk a lutsukte bang lel in ka hong om kha ding hi.
english: By David. To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.

paite: K'on sap a, ka khutte na biakna mun siangthou lam a ka zakleh, hehpih ka ngetna awte ngaikhia in.
english: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.

paite: Migilou-salou lak leh thil hihkhialte lak ah hon kaimangkhawm ke'n; huaite'n a-invengte uh kiang ah lemna thu agen na ua, himahleh alungtangte uah thilhihkhelhna atheh uhi.
english: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.

paite: Athilhih bang zel un, athilhihte leh agitlouhdan bang zel un thuk inla; akhut nasep bang in thuk inla; agitlouh man uh musak in.
english: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.

paite: TOUPA nasepte leh akhut a athilhih alimsak louh ziak un ama'n amau bawlhoih lou in ahihse ding hi.
english: Because they don’t respect the works of Yahweh, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.

paite: Ama'n ka ngetna awte angaihkhiak ziak in TOUPA phat in om hen.
english: Blessed be Yahweh, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.

paite: TOUPA ka hatna leh ka phaw ahi a; ka lungtang in amah amuang hi; huchi in huh in ka om hi; huaiziak in nakpitak in ka lungtang anuam a; ka la in amah ka phat ding hi.
english: Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

paite: TOUPA ahatna uh ahi a, athaunilh a ding in hotdamna insang ahi.
english: Yahweh is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

paite: Na mite hondam inla, na gouluah ding vualzawl in; amaute vak inla, tangtawn in pom in.
english: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.

paite: Mithilhihtheitak tate aw, TOUPA kiang ah pia unla, TOUPA kiang ah thupina leh hatna pia un.
english: A Psalm by David. Ascribe to Yahweh, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah amin thupina pia unla; siangthou kilawmna silh in TOUPA bia un.
english: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Worship Yahweh in holy array.

paite: TOUPA aw tui tungte ah aging a; thupina Pathian ahong ging doldol a, TOUPA mah tui tampi tung ah aging hi.
english: Yahweh’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even Yahweh on many waters.

paite: TOUPA aw thilhihtheitak ahi a; TOUPA aw thupitak ahi.
english: Yahweh’s voice is powerful. Yahweh’s voice is full of majesty.

paite: TOUPA aw in sidar singte ahihtan a; ahi, TOUPA'N Lebanon tang a sidar singte ahihtan lemlum zel hi.
english: Yahweh’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, Yahweh breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

paite: Bawngnou bang in amaute adiangsak a; Lebanon leh Sirion tangte gam bawngtalnou bang mai in.
english: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.

paite: TOUPA aw in meikuangte aphelh zel.
english: Yahweh’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.

paite: TOUPA aw in gamdai sing aling a; TOUPA'N Kadesh gamdai alingsak zel hi.
english: Yahweh’s voice shakes the wilderness. Yahweh shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

paite: TOUPA aw in zukpite nou aneisak a, gammang singnahte anuaikeu vek hi; atempul ah, "Athupi e!" achi chiat zel uhi.
english: Yahweh’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”

paite: Tuichim lai in kumpipa in TOUPA atu a, ahi, tangtawn a ding in kumpipa ding in TOUPA atu hi.
english: Yahweh sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, Yahweh sits as King forever.

paite: TOUPA'N amite kiang ah hatna ape ding a, TOUPA'N amite khamuanna in avualzawl ding hi.
english: Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.

paite: TOUPA aw kei hon doute pung hi na mahmah uh e! Kei hon sualte tampi ahi uh;
english: A Psalm by David, when he fled from Absalom his son. Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.

paite: amah a ding in Pathian ah panpihna himhim a-om kei, chi a, ka hinna tungtang thugente tampi a-om uhi. Selah
english: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA aw, nang ka thupina leh ka kim ka vel in ka phaw na hi a; ka lu domkangpa na hi.
english: But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.

paite: Ka aw in TOUPA ka sam a, amual siangthou a kipan in ahon dawng zel hi. Selah
english: I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.

paite: Kei ka lum in ka na ihmuta a; ka khanglou nawn a; TOUPA'N ahon na len gige ahi.
english: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for Yahweh sustains me.

paite: Hon dou a, hon umsuakte, mi singkhat nangawn ka kihta kei ding.
english: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.

paite: TOUPA aw, thou inla; ka Pathian aw, hon hondam in; kei hon doute teng abiangguh uah na khen pah a; Pathian limsak lou mite ha na kikhongsak a;
english: Arise, Yahweh! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.

paite: hotdamna tuh TOUPA a ahi; na vualzawlna na mite tung ah om hen. Selah
english: Salvation belongs to Yahweh. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka hon pahtawi ding a; nang na hon domsang a hon doute na hon otkhumsak louh ziak in.
english: A Psalm. A Song for the Dedication of the Temple. By David. I will extol you, Yahweh, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian aw, ka hon sam a, nang na hon hihdamta hi.
english: Yahweh my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang ka hinna Sheol a kipan na pikhia a; kokhuk a ka paisuk louhna ding in nang na hon humhing zel hi.
english: Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

paite: Amisiangthoute aw, TOUPA phat in la sa unla, amin siangthou phat un.
english: Sing praise to Yahweh, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.

paite: Ahehna mitphiat kal lel ahi a; adeihsakna ah hinna a-om hi; kahna zan khat sung lel ahi a, himahleh zingsang in nopna ahong tung nak hi.
english: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

paite: Ke'n zaw nuam ka sak lai in, chik mah chiang in ka ling kei ding, ka chi hi.
english: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”

paite: TOUPA nang na deihsakna ziak in ka tang na dingkipsakta a; himahleh na mai na sel a, ka hong mangbangta hi.
english: You, Yahweh, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang ka hon sam a; TOUPA kiang ah hehpihna ka ngen hi.
english: I cried to you, Yahweh. I made supplication to the Lord:

paite: Kokhuk a ka paisuk leh, ka sisan ah punna bang a om ding! Leivui in hon phat ding hia? Na thutak a gen sin maw?
english: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?

paite: TOUPA aw, ngaikhia inla, ka tung ah zahngai in; TOUPA, nang hon panpihpa hi in.
english: Hear, Yahweh, and have mercy on me. Yahweh, be my helper.”

paite: Kei a ding in ka suunna, lamna na suaksak a; ka sai-ip puan na hon suahsak a, kipahna na hon tengsak hi.
english: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,

paite: Ka thupina dai nilouh lou a, nangmah phat a la asakna ding in TOUPA ka Pathian aw, tangtawn in kipahthu ka hon hilh gige ding hi.
english: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!

paite: TOUPA aw, nangmah ah ka ginna ka koih zel a; chik mah chiang in zahlak in hon omsak ke'nla, na diktatna ziak in hon humbit in.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.

paite: Kei lam ah na bil hon doh inla; hon humbit meng in; kei a ding in suangpi kiptak, hon hotdamna ding in bitna inn hong hi in.
english: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.

paite: Nang ka suangpi leh ka kulhpi na hi a; huaiziak in na min ziak in hon pi hon kai in.
english: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.

paite: Ka awkna dia aguk a alenphah lak uah hon kaikhia in; ka insang na hi ngal a.
english: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.

paite: Na khut ah ka kha ka hon kemsak hi. TOUPA thutak Pathian, nang na hon tanta hi.
english: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, Yahweh, God of truth.

paite: Thil bangpeuh gina lou peuh ngaihtuahte ka hua a; ke'n bel TOUPA ka muang ahi.
english: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in Yahweh.

paite: Na zahngaihna ziak in nuam in ka kipak ding a; ka mangbatna na mu gige hi; ka hinna amangbat lai in na theigige hi.
english: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.

paite: Hon doumi khut ah na hon khum kei a; ka khe mun awngthawl ah na nga zawta hi.
english: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka tung ah zahngai in, mangbang in ka om ngal a; lungkhamna ziak in ka mit, ahi, ka hinna leh ka pumpi nangawn ase huaihuai hi.
english: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.

paite: Ka damsung lungkhamna in amangbangta ngei a, ka kumte thumna in abeita hi; ka thulimlouhna ziak in ka tha azaw a, ka guhte leng asegawp hi.
english: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.

paite: Hon doute ziak in ka min ahong seta a, ahi ka vengte lak ah nakpi in aseta hi, ka meltheihte a ding in leng kihtakhuaipi ka hita hi; kholak a hon mute'n ahon taisanta ngal ua.
english: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.

paite: Misi amangngilh bang ngei un mangngilh in ka om a, bel kitam bang lel ka hita hi.
english: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.

paite: Mi tampi hon hekna ka za ngal a, kil chih ah mulkimna a-om hi. Kei kalh a akisawmkhawm lai un, ka hinna hon laksak atum uhi.
english: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA aw, ka hon muang a; ka Pathian na hi ka chi hi.
english: But I trust in you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my God.”

paite: Ka hunte na khut ah a-om a, hon doute khut a kipan leh hon simmohte lak ah hon humbit in.
english: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

paite: Na mel in na sikha hon sunvak in; na zahngaihna ziak in hon hondam in.
english: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.

paite: TOUPA aw, zahlak in hon omsak ke'n; ka hon sam ngal a; migilou-salou zahlak in om uhen, Sheol ah dai dinden in om uhen.
english: Let me not be disappointed, Yahweh, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.

paite: Muk zuautheite pau thei lou in om uhen; huaite'n kisathei leh musit kawm in pautaltak in midiktatte agense zel uhi.
english: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.

paite: Na hoihna, nangmah laudan siamte a ding a na kholkhawm thupi na tel e! Mihing tate mitmuh a muanna koihte a ding a na hihsak pentak.
english: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!

paite: Amau mihing omna lak ah na humbitna na mitmuh in na selgu dia; lei selhatna lak ah bukta ah na koih gu ding hi.
english: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.

paite: TOUPA phat in om hen; achitdan lamdangtak khopi kiptak ah ahon musak ngal a.
english: Praise be to Yahweh, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.

paite: Kei lah, hamhaih in, na mitmuh a pan paihmang in ka omta, ka na chi maimah hi; himahleh ka hon sap a hehpihna ka hon ngetna awte na na za hi.
english: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.

paite: Amisiangthou tengtengte aw, TOUPA it un; TOUPA'N miginom ahumbit a, kisatheitak a gamta nakpitak in athuk zel hi.
english: Oh love Yahweh, all you his saints! Yahweh preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.

paite: TOUPA lamen tengtengte aw, hattak in om unla, na lungtang uh hangsak un.
english: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in Yahweh.

paite: Atatlekna ngaihdam a om a, akhelhna khuh a om in nuam asa hi.
english: By David. A contemplative psalm. Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

paite: TOUPA'N thulimlouhna nei a aseh louh a, akha a khemna himhim omloumi in nuam asa hi.
english: Blessed is the man to whom Yahweh doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

paite: Ka khelhna ka genkhiak louh lai in, nitum a ka mau nilouhna in ka guhte atak khin vekta hi.
english: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

paite: Sun leh zan in na khut in na hon delh a; ka tui nawnna leng, khal nisa in thil ahihlamdang bang in, alamdang hialta hi. Selah
english: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.

paite: Ka khelhna na kiang ah ka puang a, ka thulimlouhna ka imta kei hi, ka tatlekna TOUPA kiang ah ka pulak ding a, ka chi a; huchi in ka khelh thulimlouhna na ngaidamta hi. Selah
