english: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

paite: Huaiziak in Pathian limsak michih in zon muh baihlam a na om lai in na kiang ah thum chiat uhen; tui liante ahong let hun chiang in amau aphazou kei ding hi.
english: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.

paite: Nang ka bukna mun na hi a, mangbatna lak ah na hon humbit ding a; humbitna late in na hon umsuaksak ding. Selah
english: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.

paite: Na paina lampi ah ka hon hilh pil dia, ka hon chil ding; ka mit in ka hon pi ding a, ka hon suangtuahsak zel ding hi.
english: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

paite: Ngaihtuahna nei lou sakol hiam, sabiltung hiam bang in om ke'nla; tuate letkipna ding asikbah leh kaihkhawlna khau ahi a, huchi lou in na kiangnai ah ahong pai kei ding uhi.
english: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.

paite: Migilou-salou a ding lungkhamna tampi a-om ding; TOUPA muangte bel zahngaihna in a-umsuak zaw ding hi.
english: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.

paite: Midiktatte aw, TOUPA ah nuam in kipak unla; lungtang diktak pu tengteng aw, nuam in kikou un.
english: Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!

paite: Midiktatte aw, TOUPA ah nuam in la sa un; midik a ding in Pathian phat akilawm him ahi.
english: Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.

paite: Kaihging in TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu gen unla; pekging gui sawm nei in amah phat in la sa un.
english: Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.

paite: Amah pahtawi in la thak sa unla; husa thupi toh siamtak in tum un.
english: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!

paite: TOUPA thu adik a; athilhih tengteng muanhuaitak a hih ahi ngal a.
english: For Yahweh’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.

paite: Diktatna leh vaihawmna dik a-it nak a; leitung TOUPA zahngaihna in adim hi.
english: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA thu in vante siam ahi a; huai a omte tengteng leng akam a hu a siam ahi uhi.
english: By Yahweh’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.

paite: Ama'n tuipi tuite koihkhawm bang in abawl lemkhawm a; tui thukpite koihkhawmna innte ah akoih hoih zel hi.
english: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.

paite: Leitung luah tengteng in TOUPA laudan siam henla; khovel a om tengteng amah lau in om uhen.
english: Let all the earth fear Yahweh. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

paite: Ama'n agen a, ahong omta a; thu apia a, ahong omkipta hi.
english: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.

paite: TOUPA'N namte lunggelna bangmah lou in a-omsak a; michih ngaihtuahnate bangmah phattuamna nei lou in asiam hi.
english: Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

paite: TOUPA lunggelna bel tangtawn in a-omkip ding a, alungtang a ngaihtuahte khang tengteng tan in a- omkip ding hi.
english: The counsel of Yahweh stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

paite: TOUPA Pathian anei nam ahampha uhi; amah gouluah ding a atel mite mah.
english: Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

paite: TOUPA'N van a kipan in a-en a; mihing tate tengteng amu nak hi.
english: Yahweh looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.

paite: Lei a om tengteng a-omna mun a kipan in ahon en zel hi.
english: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,

paite: Amaute tengteng lungtang sekpa'n athilhih tengteng uh a-enkhia hi.
english: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.

paite: Kumpipa himhim sepaih tam ziak lel a humbit ahi ngei kei, mihat thahat ziak lel a tatkhiak ahi sam kei.
english: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

paite: Bitna ding in sakol bangmah ahi kei; ahat mahmah ziak lel in kuamah ahumbit tuan kei ding hi.
english: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.

paite: Ngai dih, TOUPA mit tuh amah laudan siamte tung ah atu gige a; azahngaihna lamente tung ah.
english: Behold, Yahweh’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,

paite: Ahinna uh sihna lak a humbit ding leh kial tun a amau tungding ding in.
english: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.

paite: I hinna in TOUPA angak nilouh a; amah hon panpihpa leh i phaw uh ahi.
english: Our soul has waited for Yahweh. He is our help and our shield.

paite: Amah ah i lungtang anuam ding ahi; amin siangthou i muan ziak in.
english: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

paite: TOUPA aw, na zahngaihna ka tung uah om hen, ka hon lamet bang zel un.
english: Let your loving kindness be on us, Yahweh, since we have hoped in you.

paite: Chik lai peuh in leng TOUPA ka phat ding a; amah phatna ka kam ah apawt gige ding hi.
english: By David; when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless Yahweh at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.

paite: Ka hinna in TOUPA asuang ding a, thunuailutte'n huai aza ding ua, akipak ding uhi.
english: My soul shall boast in Yahweh. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.

paite: Aw, TOUPA hon phatpih unla, amin pahtawi chiat ni.
english: Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let’s exalt his name together.

paite: TOUPA ka zong a ama'n ahon dawng a, ka kihtak peuhmah lak ah ahon humbit hi.
english: I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

paite: Amah a-en ua, huchi in ahong vakta uhi; amelte uh chik mah in azum kei ding.
english: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.

paite: Hiai migenthei akikou a, TOUPA'N aza a, amangbatna tengteng ah ahunkheta hi.
english: This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

paite: Amah laudan siamte tuh akimvel uah TOUPA angel in a-opkhum a, ahumbit hi.
english: Yahweh’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.

paite: Aw, TOUPA hoihdan chiam him dih ua; amah a muanna koihmi ahampha hi.
english: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

paite: Amisiangthoute aw, TOUPA laudan siam un; amah laudan siamte a ding in taksapna himhim a-om louh ziak in.
english: Oh fear Yahweh, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.

paite: Humpinelkai lunlaite tuh atasam un agilkial naknak uh; TOUPA zongte zaw thil hoih himhim atasam kei ding uhi.
english: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.

paite: Kisa un, naupangte, ka thu ngaikhia un; TOUPA laudan ka hon hilh ding hi.
english: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.

paite: Hoihna amuhtheihna ding un, hinna deih a damsawt utmi kua ahia?
english: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?

paite: Na lei tuh gilou lak ah venghoih inla, na muk khemna thu gen lou ding in venghoih in.
english: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.

paite: Gilou paisan inla, thil hoih hih in; lemna zong inla, adelh in delh in.
english: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.

paite: TOUPA mit in midiktatte a-en gige a, abil in asap uh za ding in angaikhe gige hi.
english: Yahweh’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.

paite: TOUPA mel in thil hihkhialte adou a, amau theihgigena lei a kipan hihmangthang ding in.
english: Yahweh’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.

paite: Midiktatte akikou ua, TOUPA'N aza a, amangbatna tengteng uah ahunkheta hi.
english: The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

paite: TOUPA'N lungtang khasiate anaih zel a, lungsim a kisik peuhmahte ahondam zel hi.
english: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

paite: Midik haksatnate atam a, himahleh TOUPA'N huaite a pan ahonkhia ahi.
english: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.

paite: Aguh tengteng akemhoih a, khat lel leng hihtan ahi kei hi.
english: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.

paite: Thil hoih lou in migilou-saloute athat ding a; dik hote'n siam louh atang ding uhi.
english: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.

paite: TOUPA'N asikhate hinna atan a; amah a muanna koihte khat lel leng siam louh tang a-om kei ding uhi.
english: Yahweh redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.

paite: "TOUPA aw, hon sualte nang sual in; hon doute nang dou in.
english: By David. Contend, Yahweh, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.

paite: Phaw neu leh phaw lian la inla, hon panpih ding in dingh in.
english: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.

paite: Tei leng phawi inla, hon delhte lam na dal in; ka hinna kiang ah, na hondampa ka hi," chi in.
english: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”

paite: "Ka hinna hihmang tum a zongte zahlaksak a hihzum in om uhen, hon hihsiatna ding a thubawlte taizaksak in gen ding thei lou hial in om uhen.
english: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.

paite: Buhsi huih mutleng bang in om uhenla, TOUPA angel in delhzui zel hen.
english: Let them be as chaff before the wind, Yahweh’s angel driving them on.

paite: Alampi uh mialtak leh naltak hi henla, TOUPA angel in gawt hen.
english: Let their way be dark and slippery, Yahweh’s angel pursuing them.

paite: "Aziak om lou in hon matna ding un alen uh kokhuk ah aphahgu ua, aziak om lou in ka hinna kiakna ding in kokhuk atou uhi.
english: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.

paite: Akigin louh lai in atung uah siatna tung henla; alen phahguk ah amah mah awk henla, huai ah kesia hen.
english: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.

paite: "Huchi in ka hinna TOUPA ah anuam ding hi; ahotdamna ah akipak ding.
english: My soul shall be joyful in Yahweh. It shall rejoice in his salvation.

paite: Ka guh tengteng in, TOUPA, migenthei nan zoh vual louh lak a humbitpa ahi, tagah leh genthei, ahihgampa a pan humbitpa, nang bang kua a om?" achi ding uhi.
english: All my bones shall say, “Yahweh, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”

paite: "Theihpih diktat lou hialte ahong ding ua; ka thil theih het louh thute ahon dong uhi.
english: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.

paite: Ka hinna in mansuah khop in thil hoih thil sia in ahon din hi.
english: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.

paite: Ke'n bel, adam louh lai un, ka puansilh sai-ip ahi a; ka hinna an ngawl in ka hihgenthei ngal a; ka thumna keimah angsung ngei ah ahong kik nawn hi.
english: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.

paite: Ka lawm hiam, ka unau hiam leng hi heh aw atung ua ka omdan ding bang in ahi ka om; mi anu kah bang in suun in ka kun hi.
english: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.

paite: "Himahleh kei ka bai leh amau akipak ua, akikhawm hial ua; mivuak hatte hon sual ding in akikhawm ua, huai ka na thei ngal kei a, tawp nuam lou in ahon hih ek uhi.
english: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.

paite: Ankuangluina a chiamnuih gente bang phet in aha uh ahon gawikhum uhi.
english: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.

paite: "TOUPA, nang bang tan ahia na et ding? Ka hinna hihsiat atupna lak uah hon hunkhia inla, ka neihsun pen humpinelkai lak ah honkhia in.
english: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.

paite: Kikhopna thupitak ah kipahthu ka hon hilh ding a; mi tampi lak ah ka hon phat ding hi.
english: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.

paite: "Ka melmate'n dikloutak ah hon otsan kei uhen; bangmah lou a hon hote leng amit un kihoupih sam kei uhen.
english: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.

paite: "Kituahna thu himhim agen ngal kei ua, hiai gam a om hiathiatte khemna thute angaihtuah zaw uhi.
english: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.

paite: Ahi, akam un hon kam kat khum ua; Ku! Ku! I mit in i muta achi uhi.
english: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”

paite: TOUPA aw, nang na mu hi, daihsan ke'n! TOUPA aw, hon gamlat mahmah ke'n.
english: You have seen it, Yahweh. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.

paite: Ka Pathian leh ka TOUPA aw, ka vaihawm ding in, ahi, ka thu a hong um ding in, kihalhsak inla, hak in.
english: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian aw, na diktatna bang zel in vai hon hawmsak inla; amaute'n hon otsan kei uhen.
english: Vindicate me, Yahweh my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.

paite: Alungsim un, Nuam e! Huchibang akei maw i deih, chi kei uhen. Amah i valh khinta, chi sam kei uhen.
english: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”

paite: "Ka siatna tung a kipakte zahlak leh gen ding bei in om chiat uhenla; ka tung a kiliansakte zahlakna leh zumna silhsak in om uhen.
english: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.

paite: Ka diktatna tung a kipakte nuam a kikou in kipaktak in om uhenla, Ahi, asikha vangphatna a kipakte'n TOUPA pahtawi in om hen, chi gige uhen.
english: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May Yahweh be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”

paite: Huchi in ka lei in na diktatna thu agen ding a, na phatna thu nitum in agen ding hi."
english: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.

paite: "Migilou-salou tatlekna in ka lungtang sung ah thu agen a, 'Amit ah Pathian kihtakna a-om kei,' chi in.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David, the servant of Yahweh. A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

paite: Athulimlouhna amukhe kei ding ua, apai tuan kei ding uh, chi in. Amah mitmuh in akiphat tawm hi.
english: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.

paite: Akam a thupawtte thulimlouhna leh khemna thu gen ahi nak a; pil leh thil hoih hih atawpta ahi.
english: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.

paite: Alupna ah thil thulim lou agel gige a; lampi hoih lou ah apai teitei a; gilou akih kei hi.
english: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.

paite: TOUPA aw, na zahngaihna vante ah a-om a; na ginomna in meipite asu hi.
english: Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

paite: Na diktatna Pathian tangte bang ahi; na vaihawmte tui thuk talkhauh bang ahi; TOUPA aw, mihing leh gamsa na humbit hi.
english: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. Yahweh, you preserve man and animal.

paite: "Pathian aw, na zahngaihna manpha hi na tel e! Mihing tate na kha nuai ah atu zel uhi.
english: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.

paite: Amau na insung thil hoih in atai ding ua; na kipahna lui ana dawnsak ding hi.
english: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.

paite: Hinna tuikhuk nang ah a-om a, na vak ah vak ka mu ding uhi.
english: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.

paite: "Aw, nangmah theite tung ah na zahngaihna kitheisak inla; lungtang diktak pute tung ah leng na diktatna langsak in.
english: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

paite: Kisathei khe hon sual ding in kei lam ah kalsuan dah henla, migilou-salou khut in hon delhmang kei hen.
english: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.

paite: "Huai ah thulimlouhna hihte apuk ua; paihkhiak in a-om ua, athou thei nawn kei ding uhi."
english: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.

paite: Thil hoih lou hihte ziak in kihihlungkham nuam dah inla, dikloutak a hihte leng eng ke'n.
english: By David. Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.

paite: Loupa bang in atpaih in a-om zok ding ua, louhing bang a vuai ding ahi ngal ua.
english: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.

paite: TOUPA muang inla, thil hoih hih in; hiai gam ah om inla, ginomna delh zel in.
english: Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.

paite: TOUPA tung ah leng kipak in; huchi in na lungtang deihlamte ahon pe ding hi.
english: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

paite: Na omdan ding TOUPA tung ah nga inla; amah muang in, ama'n ahih vek ding.
english: Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

paite: Na dikdan vak bang in asuaksak ding a, na siamtandan leng sun lai bang mai in.
english: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.

paite: TOUPA ah khawl inla, amah ngak nilouh in; a-omdan a vangphatna mute ziak in kihihlungkham nuam dah in, ngaihtuahna giloute pichin mi ziak in.
english: Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

paite: Heh tawpsan inla, thangpaih kisik in; kihihlungkham nuam ke'n, thilhihkhelh ah ahong ke maimah nak hi.
english: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.

paite: Thil hoih lou hihte hihmang in a-om dek ngal ua; TOUPA ngakte'n bel gam aluah ding uhi.
english: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.

paite: Sawt louchik in migilou-salou a-om nawnta kei dia; ahi, a-omna mun uh enen mah lechin, a-omta kei ding hi.
english: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.

paite: Thunuailutte'n gam aluah ding ua; kituahna thupitak ah akipak ding uhi.
english: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

paite: Migilou-salou in midiktat a sawm a, aha agawikhum nak hi.
english: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.

paite: Toupa'n amah anuihsan ding. Ani hong tung dek ahi chih atheih ziak in.
english: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.

paite: Genthei leh tagahte hihpuk ding leh omdan dikte that ding in migilou-saloute'n namsau aphawi ua, athalpeute uh alai uhi.
english: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.

paite: Anamsau un amau lungtang asun ding a, thalpeute uh hihtan in a-om ding hi.
english: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.

paite: Midiktat thil tawmchik neih migilou-salou thil neih keihkuih sang in ahoihzaw ahi.
english: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.

paite: Migilou-salou bante hihtan in a-om dek ngal a, TOUPA'N midik alen gige ding ahi.
english: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.

paite: TOUPA'N mihoihkimte nite athei a; agouluah ding uh tangtawn a om gige ding ahi.
english: Yahweh knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.

paite: Hun hoih lou ah azahlak kei ding ua; kial kum in leng avah ding uhi.
english: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

paite: Migilou-saloute amangthang ding ua, TOUPA doute leng gamlak loupa pak kilawm bang in hihmanthat in a-om ding ua, meikhu in azammang ding uhi.
english: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of Yahweh shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.

paite: Migilou-salou in aleitawi a, ape nawn kei nak a; midik in bel zahngaihna suah in, ape zaw nak hi.
english: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.

paite: Avualzawlna mute'n gam aluah ding ua, ahamsiatte hihmanthat in a-om ding uhi.
english: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.

paite: Mi kalsuante TOUPA hihkip ahi a; alampi ah akipak nak hi.
english: A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.

paite: Puk mahleh, lupdetsak in zaw a-om kei ding hi; TOUPA'N akhut in alen gige ngal a.
english: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.

paite: Naupang ka na hita a, tu in tek ka hong hita, himahleh midiktat limsak louh a a-om lam ka mu ngei kei hi, asuante an ngolh lam leng ka mu ngei sam kei hi.
english: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.

paite: Mi ahehpih gige a, aleitawisak a; asuante leng ahampha nak uhi.
english: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.

paite: Gilou paisan inla, thil hoih hih in; huchi in tangtawn in teng gige in.
english: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.

paite: TOUPA'N vaihawm diktat adeih ngal a, amisiangthoute apaisan ngei kei hi, tangtawn a ding in kephoih in a-om ua; migilou-salou suante bel hihmang in a-om ding uhi.
english: For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.

paite: Midikte'n gam aluah ding ua, asung ah tangtawn in a-om ding uh.
english: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.

paite: Midik kam in pilna thu agen a, alei in vaihawm diktatna thu agen hi.
english: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.

paite: A Pathian dan alungtang ah a-om a; akalsuan atolh kei ding hi.
english: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.

paite: Migilou-salou in midiktat a-enkhia a, hihlup atum gige hi.
english: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.

paite: TOUPA'N akhut ah anuse kei ding a, avaihawm hun chiang in siam louh tansak aphal sam kei ding hi.
english: Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

paite: TOUPA ngak inla, alampi tawn in, huchi in gam luah ding in ahon pahtawi ding hi; migilou-saloute hihmanthat a a-om uh na mu ding hi.
english: Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.

paite: Migilou-salou nakpitak a thu nei a, apouna mun a singnou dawng thenthon bang a, ka biambuam ka mu hi.
english: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

paite: Himahleh lampi ah mi ava pai ua, ngai dih, amah ana om kei maimah a; ahi, ka zong a, himahleh muh theih ahita kei hi.
english: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.

paite: Migensiatbei chiamteh inla, midiktak en in, huchibang mite tawpna ding zaw khamuanna hi ding ahi ngal a.
english: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.

paite: Talekte bel akituak a hihsiat in a-om ding ua, migilou-salou tawpna ding tuh hihmanthat ahita ding hi.
english: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.

paite: Himahleh midiktatte hotdamna TOUPA a kipan in ahi; amah mangbat lai a kulhpi muan ahi.
english: But the salvation of the righteous is from Yahweh. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

paite: TOUPA'N amaute panpih in ahumbit a, amah ah akituklut ziak un migilou-saloute lak ah humbit in ahondam hi.
english: Yahweh helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.

paite: TOUPA aw, heh in hon tai ke’nla; thangpai in hon sawi sam ke'n.
english: A Psalm by David, for a memorial. Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.

paite: Na thalte ka sa ah atal a, na khut ka tung ah atu bukbuk ngal a.
english: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.

paite: Na lung hihlouhna ziak in ka sa ah dam lai himhim a-om kei a; ka thulimlouhna ziak in ka guhte ah dam lai a-om kei hi.
english: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

paite: Ka thulimlouhnate'n ka lu atummang a, puakgiktak, ka puak zoh vual louh ahi.
english: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.

paite: Ka haina ziak in ka liamnate uih in anamse zouta hi.
english: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.

paite: Ka chi ana a, ka kun ngiungiau a; nitum in lungkham in ka mau den hi.
english: I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.

paite: Ka kawng a lum huthut vek a; ka sa ah leng dam lai a-om kei hi.
english: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.

paite: Ka bah a, ka sidup keihkuih a; ka lungtang noplouhna ziak in ka thum hithit hi.
english: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka deihlam tengteng na thei a; ka thumnate nang a pan sel ahi kei hi.
english: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.

paite: Ka lungphu kisai in hatna ka nei kei a; ka mit vakna in hon paimangsanta hi.
english: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.

paite: Hon itte leh ka lawmte ka natna lak ah akihuikhia ua; ka sanggamte leng gamlapi ah adingh uhi.
english: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.

paite: Ka hinna hihmang tum a zongte'n hon matna ding un thang akam ua; ka siatna ding zongte'n leng thuhoih loutakte agen nak uhi; nitum in khemna thute angaihtuah uhi.
english: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.

paite: Himahleh kei tuh nangong bang in za lou in ka om a; pau theiloumi kam ka ngei lou bang in ka om hi.
english: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.

paite: Ahi, mi pau za lou, akam a taihilhna pawt ngei lou bang in ka om hi.
english: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.

paite: TOUPA aw, nangmah ka hon lamen ngal a; TOUPA ka Pathian aw, nang na hon dawng hi.
english: For I hope in you, Yahweh. You will answer, Lord my God.

paite: Huchi lou in zaw hon otsan ding a, ka khe ateutak in ka tung ah akihihlian kha ding uh, ka chi ahi.
english: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”

paite: Ka puk dekdek ngal a, ka lungngaihna leng ka ma ah a-om gige hi.
english: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.

paite: Ka thulimlouhna ka pulak ding a; ka khelhna ziak in lungngai in ka om ding hi.
english: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.

paite: Himahleh hon doute ahalh ua, ahat uhi; dikloupi a hon hote kilawmloupi in apung ua.
english: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.

paite: Thil hoih thil gilou a thukte thil hoih ka delh ziak in hon doute ahi uhi.
english: They who give evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.

paite: TOUPA aw, hon paisan ke'nla; ka Pathian aw, hon gamlat mahmah ke'n.
english: Don’t forsake me, Yahweh. My God, don’t be far from me.

paite: TOUPA ka hondampa aw, hon panpih ding in, kin meng in.
english: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.

paite: Ka lei a thil ka hihkhelh louhna ding in ka omdante ka venghoih ding a; migilou-saloute ka ma a a-om sung uh ka kam mukgakna in ka gak ding, ka chi.
english: For the Chief Musician. For Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”

paite: Huchi in dai dide in pau lou in ka om a, ahoih lam ah leng ka dai dide a; himahleh ka lungngaihna tohthoh in a-om zosop hi.
english: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.

paite: Ka sung ah ka lung asa vutvut a; ka ngaihtuah in mei akuangkhia a; ka lei in thu ka genta hi.
english: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:

paite: TOUPA, ka tawpna ding leh, ka dam chiang ding, bangchi ahi, chih, hon theisak inla; ka hinna beikindan hon theisak in.
english: “Yahweh, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.

paite: Ngai in, ka damsung khutpek tan phet in na siam a; ka kum na mitmuh in bangmah tham ahi kei a; michih ahoih lai pen un bangmah lou lel ahi vek uhi. Selah
english: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.

paite: Michih nuamsa bang in avak ngei ua; amawk buai ngei nak uhi. Gou akholkhawm ua, aluah ding lah athei kei uhi.
english: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.

paite: TOUPA aw, tu'n ah bang ka ngak dia? Nang ah ahi ka lametna a-om.
english: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.

paite: Ka tatlekna tengteng lak ah hon honkhia inla; mihai gensiat in hon omsak ke'n.
english: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.

paite: Nangmah hih ahih ziak in ka pau kei a, ka kam leng ka ka kei hi.
english: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.

paite: N'on satna ka kiang a kipan lasuan inla; na khut khak a hihman ka hi.
english: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

paite: Mi atatlekna ziak a thuhilh a na sawi in, adeih lai pen leikha bang in na hihsia a; michih bangmah lou lel ahi uhi. Selah
english: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka thumna ngaikhia inla, ka kikouna ah na bildoh inla; ka khitui kia daihsan ke'n; na mikhual ka hi a, ka pipute bang in Khualzin tam lel bang ka hi ngal a.
english: “Hear my prayer, Yahweh, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.

paite: Aw, hiai a kipan ka pawt a, ka om louh paisuak vengveng ma in, ka halh nawnna ding in hon hawi in.
english: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”

paite: Ka diktanna Pathian aw, ka hon sap chiang in hon dawng in; ka mangbat chiang in, nang na hon hih navak zel a; ka tung ah zahngai inla, ka thumna hon ngaihkhiaksak in.
english: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm by David. Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.

paite: Mihing tate aw, ka thupina bang tan ahia zahlakna a na suahsak ding uh? Bang tan ahia thil bangmah lou na thupisak ua, zuauthu na zon ding uh? Selah
english: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.

paite: TOUPA Pathian limsakmi amah a ding in akoihtuam chih thei zaw un; amah ka sap peuhmah chiang in, TOUPA'N ahon ngaikhe ding hi.
english: But know that Yahweh has set apart for himself him who is godly; Yahweh will hear when I call to him.

paite: Kihta unla, thil hihkhial kei un; na lupna tung uah na lungtang un ngaihtuah unla, dai sipsip un. Selah
english: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.

paite: Diktatna kithoihna lan unla, TOUPA gingta un.
english: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in Yahweh.

paite: Hoihna himhim kua'n ahia hon musak ding chite tampi a-om uhi. TOUPA, nang mahmah in na mel vak in hon sunvak in!
english: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.

paite: Abuh leh a-uain uh ahong khan chiang a akipahna sang ua, kipahna thupizaw ka lungtang ah na omsak hі.
english: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.

paite: Khamuangtak in ka lum ding a, ka ihmu ding hi; TOUPA, nangmah mah na hi, kei kia a leng bittak a hon omsak gige.
english: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, Yahweh, make me live in safety.

paite: TOUPA ka ngakngak a; ama'n ahon ngeingaih a, ka kikou azata hi.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.

paite: Manthatna kokhuk a kipan, buannawi diadua a pan ahon khaikhetou a; huchi in ka khe suangpi tung ah angala, ka kalsuante ahihkip hi.
english: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.

paite: La thak ka kam ah akoih a, i Pathian phatna; mi tampi'n huai amu ding ua, alau ding ua, TOUPA amuang ding uhi.
english: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA a muanna nei a, kisatheite leh thuzuau a kipan a kihemkhemi ahampha hi.
english: Blessed is the man who makes Yahweh his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian aw, nang thillamdang na hihte leh koumau lam na hon ngaihtuahnate atam mahmah a, huaite na ma a hihlat zoh vual ahi kei ding.
english: Many, Yahweh, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.

paite: Kithoihna leh thillat tung ah kipahna na nei kei a; ka bilte na hon honsakta a; halmang a thillat leh khelhna ding a thillat na phut kei hi.
english: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.

paite: Huaitak in, ke'n, "Ngai in, ka hong pai hi; laibuzial ah ka thu gelh ahi.
english: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.

paite: Ka Pathian aw, na deihlam hih ka kipah lamtak ahi; ahi, na dan thu ka lungtang ah a-om gige hi," ka chi a.
english: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”

paite: Kikhopna thupitak ah diktatna thuhoih ka tangkoupih a; TOUPA aw, ngai in, ka kam ka it kei ding chih na thei hi.
english: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, Yahweh, you know.

paite: Na diktatna ka lungsung ah ka iim kei a; na ginomna leh na hotdamna thu ka tangkoupih zaw ding; na zahngaihna leh na takna kikhopna thupitak a mite lak ah ka sel kei ding hi.
english: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.

paite: TOUPA aw, na lainatnate ka lak ah it ke'nla; na zahngaihna leh na takna in hon humbit gige in.
english: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, Yahweh. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.

paite: Thil hoih lou sim zoh louh in hon umsuak a, ka thulimlouhnate'n hon delhpha a, huchi in ka dak theita kei a; huaite ka samzang sang in atamzaw a, ka lungtang atawlta hi.
english: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.

paite: TOUPA aw, hehpih in hon humbit inla; TOUPA aw, hon panpih ding in kin in.
english: Be pleased, Yahweh, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, Yahweh.

paite: Ka hinna hihmang tum a zongte zahlak leh zumtak in om chiat uhen; ka siatna tung a kipakte kik nawn in hihzum in om uhen.
english: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.

paite: Awi hang e! Awi hang! chite azahlak ziak un mangbangtak in om uhen.
english: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”

paite: Nang hon zong tengteng nangmah ah nuamtak leh kipaktak in om uhenla; na hotdamna itte'n, TOUPA phat in om hen, chi gige uhen.
english: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let Yahweh be exalted!”

paite: Kei zaw genthei leh liangvai ka hi a, himahleh Toupa'n ahon ngaihtuah a; nang hon panpihpa leh hon humbitpa na hi a; ka Pathian aw, sawt hal mahmah ke'n.
english: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.

paite: Gentheite ngaihtuahmi ahampha hi, mangbat ni in TOUPA'N amah ahumbit ding.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Blessed is he who considers the poor. Yahweh will deliver him in the day of evil.

paite: TOUPA'N amah humbit in ahihhing ding a, lei ah vualzawl in a-om ding; amah doute'n ut-ut a abawl ding un ape kei ding.
english: Yahweh will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.

paite: TOUPA'N agimna lupna mun ah ahihhat ding a; nang achi anat lai in alupna na bawlsak vek zel hi.
english: Yahweh will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.

paite: "TOUPA aw, hon hehpih inla, ka hinna hihdam in, na tung ah thil ka hihkhial ngal a," ka chi a.
english: I said, “Yahweh, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”

paite: "Hon doute'n, chikchiang in asi in, amin amang diam aw!" chi in hon gensia uhi.
english: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”

paite: Alak ua kuahiam in ahong veh lai in, thu bangmah lou maimai agen zel a; alungtang in thulimlouhna alakhawm a; apawtkhiaktak in mi ahilh zel hi.
english: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.

paite: Hon ho tengteng hon gensia in akihuau ua; hon hihsiatna ding uh angaihtuah uhi.
english: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.

paite: Natna hoih loutak in amankipta, tua lum athounawn kei ding, achi ua.
english: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”

paite: Ahi, ka lawm kithuahpih theih, ka muantak, ka tanghou nekpih ngei in akhetul ka tung ah alikta hi.
english: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA aw, nang hon hehpih inla, amau ka thuktheihna ding in hon kaithou nawn in.
english: But you, Yahweh, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.

paite: Hiai ah ka tung ah na kipak chih ka thei hi, hon dou in ahon zoh louh ziak in.
english: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.

paite: Kei zaw lungsim hoihtak ka putna ah nangma'n na hon len tinten a, Na ma ah tangtawn a ding in na hon koih hi.
english: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.

paite: TOUPA, Israel' Pathian, tangtawn a kipan tangtawn pha in phat in om hen, Amen! Amen!
english: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.

paite: Luita tui duh a nak hawkhawk sakhi bang in, Pathian aw, ka hinna nangmah duh in anak hawkhawk hi.
english: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.

paite: Ka hinna Pathian duh in, Pathian hing duh in, adangtak ahi; chikchiang in ahia Pathian ma ka tun ding a, amai ka muh ding.
english: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?

paite: Ka khitui sun leh zan in ka an ahi a, na Pathian koi a om ahia le! hon chi nilouh ua.
english: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

paite: Hiai thil ka theigige a, ka hinna ka sung ah ka sungbua a, mipi lak a ka pai in, nopna leh phatna ging toh, mi tampi ankuangluina a Pathian inn zuan a ama uh ka kaih zeldante.
english: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.

paite: Ka hinna aw, bang achia kun nilouh? Bang achia ka sung a buai? Pathian lamen in; amel a damna ziak in amah ka hon phat ding ahi ngal a, hon panpihpa leh ka Pathian.
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.

paite: Ka Pathian aw, ka hinna ka sung ah akun nilouh; huaiziak in Jordan leh Hermon gam a kipan, Mizar tang a kipan in ka hon theigige ahi.
english: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.

paite: Na tui luang ging zuazuate ah tui thuk leh tui thuk akisam ua; na tuikihot leh na tui kisep teng in hon vuktumta hi.
english: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA'N azahngaihna sun in thu ape ding a, ala in zan chiang in hon ompih ding hi, ka hinna Pathian kiang a thumna in.
english: Yahweh will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.

paite: Pathian ka suangpi kiang ah, "Bangziak a hon mangngilh a bang ding a melma nuaisiahna ziak a lungkham a ka mau vialvial nak!" ka chi ding hi.
english: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”

paite: Ka guh a namsau om bang mai in hon doute'n hon gense gige ua; Na Pathian koi a om ahia le! Hon chi nilouh ua.
english: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

paite: Ka hinna aw, bang achia kun nilouh? Bang achia ka sung a buai? Pathian lamen in; amah ka phat ding a, hon panpihpa leh ka Pathian ahi.
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

paite: Pathian aw, vai hon hawmsak inla, Pathian limsak lou nam tung ah ka thu hon genpih in; aw, mikhem hat, midiklou lak ah hon humbit in.
english: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.

paite: Nang ka hatna Pathian na hi ngal a; bang ding in ahia na hon pampaih ding? Bang ding in ahia melma nuaisiahna ziak a lungkham a ka mau vialvial nak?
english: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

paite: Aw, na vak leh na thutak sawlkhia inla, amaute'n na mual siangthou ah hon pi in, na omnate hon tun uhen.
english: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.

paite: Pathian maitam kiang ah ka pai ding, Pathian ka nopna mahmah kiang ah; Pathian, ka Pathian aw, kaihging toh in ka hon phat ding hi.
english: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.

paite: Ka hinna aw, bang achia kun nilouh? Bang achia ka sung a buai? Pathian lamen in; amah phat ding ka hi ngal a, hon panpihpa leh ka Pathian.
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.

paite: Pathian aw, nidanglai a adam lai ua na thilhihte ka pipute un hon hilh uh ka bil un ka za ua.
english: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. A contemplative psalm. We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.

paite: Namte na khut in na hawlkhia a, amaute na phut a; mite na hihgim a, na paikhia hi.
english: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.

paite: Gam luah ding a amau namsau a alak uh ahi kei a, amau ban a kihumbit leng ahi kei uh; atung ua na kipah ziak in na khut taklam, na ban leh, na mel vak in ahi zaw.
english: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.

paite: Pathian aw, nang ka Kumpipa na hi; Jakob humbitna ding in thu pia in.
english: God, you are my King. Command victories for Jacob!

paite: Nangmah ziak in ka melmate uh ka si pai ding ua; na min ziak in hon sualte ka chil ekek ding uhi.
english: Through you, we will push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.

paite: Ka thalpeu ka muang kei ding a, ka namsau in hon hondam sam kei ding.
english: For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me.

paite: Hon doute lak ah na hon hondam zawta a, hon hote na zaklaksak behlap hi.
english: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.

paite: Nitum in Pathian ka suang ding ua, na min tangtawn in ka phat ding uhi. Selah
english: In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.

paite: Tu'n zaw nang na hon khahkhia a, na hon hihzum a; ka sepaihhonte uh toh na pawtkhe ngei kei hi.
english: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.

paite: Melmate lak ah na hon taizaksak a; hon hote'n gallak adeihdeih uh ala uhi.
english: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.

paite: Nang nek ding belam bang in na hon pia a; namte lak ah na hon hihdalh behlap hi.
english: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.

paite: Na mite bangmah lou in na khawngta a, aman uh lah atam het kei hi.
english: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.

paite: Nang ka kim ua mite gensiat in na hon omsak a, ka kiangnai ua mite muhsit leh nuihsan in na hon omsak hi.
english: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.

paite: Nang namte lak ah aselam gentehna in na hon omsak a, michih lak a mite lu sinkhum in na hon omsak hi.
english: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

paite: Ka buaina nitum in ka ma ah a-om gige a, ka zahlakna in hon tuam zouta hi.
english: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,

paite: Genthangmi leh gensemi aw ziak leh, melma leh phulami ziak in.
english: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.

paite: Huai tengteng ka tung uah atung a; himahleh ka hon mangngilh ngei kei ua, na thukhun ah zuau in ka hih ngei kei uhi.
english: All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.

paite: Ka lungtang uh akihei nawn kei a, ka kalsuante'n na lampi apaisan ngei kei hi.
english: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,

paite: Nang sehalte omna ah na hon bawl ek a, sihna lim a na hon tuamna ding in.
english: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

paite: I Pathian min i mangngilh a, gamdang pathian lam a i khutte i zakleh
english: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,

paite: Pathian in huai azongkhe kei dia hia! Lungtang thugukte atheigige a.
english: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.

paite: Ahi, nangmah ziak in thah in ka om gige ua; belam goh dingte bang a seh ka hi uhi.
english: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.

paite: TOUPA aw, halh tanla, bang achia ihmu! Hak inla, tangtawn in hon khahkhe ke'n.
english: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.

paite: Bangziak in ahia na mai na sel a, ka haksatdan uleh nuaisiah ka thuakdan uh na mangngilh nak.
english: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?

paite: Ka hinna uh leivui si in akun a; ka gilpi uh lah lei ah abelh bikbek hi.
english: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.

paite: Hon panpih ding in thou inla, na zahngaihna ziak in hon tan in.
english: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.

paite: Ka lungtang thil hoih in adimlet a, kumpipa tungtang thu a ka laphuah ka gen ding hi; ka lei laigelh siamtak laigelhna ahi.
english: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Lilies.” A contemplation by the sons of Korah. A wedding song. My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.

paite: Mihing tate sang in na mel ahoihzaw a; hehpihna in na muk akinuh hi; huaiziak in Pathian in tangtawn a ding in ahon vualzawl ahi.
english: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.

paite: Aw, mihat, na kawng ah namsau vom in, na thupina leh na kilawmna toh.
english: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.

paite: Thutak leh thunuailutna leh diktatna ziak in na kilawmna silh in lamzangtak in sakol tung a tuang in pai zel in; huchi in na khut taklam in thil mulkimhuaite ahon hilh ding ahi.
english: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.

paite: Na thal azum a; michih na nuai ah apuk zel uh, kumpipa melmate lungtang ah atal hi.
english: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.

paite: Pathian aw, na laltutphah tangtawn in a-om ding ahi, khentuam neihlouhna lalchiang na gam lalchiang ahi.
english: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.

paite: Diktatna na deih a, gilou-salou na hua hi, huaiziak in, Pathian, na Pathian in, na lawmte sang in nakpi in nopna thau ahon nilhta hi.
english: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

paite: Na puansilh tengteng murrah gimte, aloe gimte, sing gimte anam vungvung a; saiha a bawl kumpipa' inn a kaihging chi tuamtuam ging hong pawtte'n ahon hihnuam ahi.
english: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.

paite: Na numei hoihte lak ah kumpipate tanute apang ua; na taklam ah Ophir dangka-eng a kizem in kumpinu adingh hi.
english: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.

paite: Ka tanu aw, ngaikhia inla, ngaihtuah inla, bildoh in; na mite leh na pa inn a mite mangngilh in.
english: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n na melhoih adeih ding hi, amah i TOUPA ahi ngal a; amah bia in.
english: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.

paite: Tura tanu thilpiak tawi in huai ah a-om ding a; mi lak a hausate ngei in na deihsakna angen ding uhi.
english: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.

paite: Kumpipa insung a kumpipa tanu athupi zou hial a, apuansilh dangka-eng a zep kilawm ahi.
english: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.

paite: Puankhui kilawm silh in kumpipa kiang ah api ding ua, amah zui alawm nungakte na kiang ah api ding uh.
english: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.

paite: Kipak leh nuam in api ding ua, kumpipa' inn ah alut ding uh.
english: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.

paite: Na pate sik in na tate a-om ding ua; leitung tengteng ah milian in amaute na bawl ding.
english: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.

paite: Na min suan tengteng ah theihgige ding in ka bawl ding; huaiziak in michih in tangtawn tangtawn in kipahthu ahon hilh ding uh.
english: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.

paite: Pathian i kihumbitna leh i hatna, mangbat lai a huh pahpahpa nai gige ahi.
english: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

paite: Huaiziak in leitung hong kidang in, mualte tuipi sung pek ah kisuan mahleh i lau kei ding uh.
english: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;

paite: Atuite ging honhon in phul butbut mahleh, akihot thupi ziak in mualte ling duamduam mahleh, i lautuan sam kei ding. Selah
english: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.

paite: Lui khat a-om a, huai luikate'n Pathian khopi akipaksak hi, tungnungpen omna Mun Siangthoupen.
english: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.

paite: Alaitak ah Pathian a-om a, aling kei ding; Pathian in phalvak chiang in apanpih ding hi.
english: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.

paite: Namte aging huthut ua, gamte aling a; ama'n a-aw asuah a leitung ahong tui khinta hi.
english: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA i kiang uah a-om a, Jakob' Pathian i insang ahi. Selah
english: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

paite: Kisa un, TOUPA thilhihte en un, leitung a thil ahihsiatdan.
english: Come, see Yahweh’s works, what desolations he has made on the earth.

paite: Ama'n kidounate kawlmong pha in ahihtawp a; thalpeu ahihtan a, tei asattan hi; kangtalaite mei ah ahalmang hi.
english: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.

paite: Dai unla, Pathian ka hi chih thei un; namte lak ah pahtawi in ka om ding, leitung ah pahtawi in ka om ding hi.
english: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA i kiang uah a-om a; Jakob' Pathian i insang ahi. Selah
english: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

paite: Mi tengtengte aw, na khut uh beng unla; nopna aw in Pathian kiang ah kikou un.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!

paite: TOUPA Tungnungpen akihtakhuai a; leitung tengteng ah kumpipa thupitak ahi.
english: For Yahweh Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.

paite: Ama'n michih i nuai uah azou ding a, i khenuai ah namte azou ding hi.
english: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.

paite: Ama'n i gouluah ding hon telsak ding a, a-it Jakob leh asuanpen gam mah ahi. Selah
english: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

paite: Kikou aw toh Pathian apaitou a, TOUPA pengkul ging toh apaitou hi.
english: God has gone up with a shout, Yahweh with the sound of a trumpet.

paite: Pathian phat in la sa unla, phat in la sa un; i Kumpipa phat in la sa unla, phat in la sa un.
english: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!

paite: Pathian lah leitung tengteng Kumpipa ahi ngal a, theisiam a phat in la sa un.
english: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.

paite: Pathian in namte tung ah vai ahawm a, Pathian alaltutphah siangthou ah atu hi.
english: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.

paite: Abraham' Pathian mite hi ding in michih lak a miliante a- omkhawm ua, leitung kumpipate Pathian a ahi ngal ua, nakpitak a pahtawi in amah a-om hi.
english: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!

paite: TOUPA athupi a, nakpitak a phat ding ahi, i Pathian khopi ah, atang siangthou ah.
english: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

paite: Asandan a kilawm, leitung tengteng kipahna, Zion tang ahi, mallam pang a, Kumpipa thupitak khopi.
english: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.

paite: A-inpi ah Pathian in insang ahihdan akitheisak hi.
english: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.

paite: Ngai in, kumpipate akikhawm ua, apaikhawmta uhi.
english: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.

paite: Amu ua, huchi in lamdang asa ua; amangbang ua, apaimang pah uhi.
english: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.

paite: Huai ah linna in aman a; numei nauvei natna in amat lai bang in.
english: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.

paite: Suahlam huih in Tarshish long liante ana hihse zel hi.
english: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA khopi ah, i Pathian khopi ah, bil a i zak bangtak in i muta; Pathian in huai khopi tangtawn a ding in ahihkip ding. Selah
english: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of Yahweh of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.

paite: Pathian aw, na tempul sunggil ah na zahngaihna ka ngaihtuahta uhi.
english: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.

paite: Pathian aw, na min bang ngei in na phatna kawlmong pha in a-om a; na khut taklam diktatna in adim hi.
english: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.

paite: Na vaihawmnate ziak in Zion tang kipaktak in om henla, Judah tanute nuam in om uhen.
english: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.

paite: Zion kim ah, akimvel in pai unla; agalven insangte leng sim un.
english: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.

paite: Akulhte chiamteh hoih unla, a-inpite ngaihtuah un; khang hong om nawnte a na hilhtheihna ding un.
english: Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.

paite: Hiai Pathian tangtawn tangtawn a i Pathian hi ding ahi a, sih tanpha a leng hon pipa ahi ding hi.
english: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.

paite: Mi tengteng aw, hiai ngaikhia unla; khovel a om tengteng aw, bildoh un.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,

paite: Mineu leh milian, mihau leh mizawng in leng.
english: both low and high, rich and poor together.

paite: Ka kam in pilna thu agen ding a; ka lungtang ngaihtuah tuh theihsiamna thu ahi ding hi.
english: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.

paite: Genteh thu ah ka bil ka doh ding a; ka thugil gen kaihging in ka gentel ding hi.
english: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.

paite: Ni hoihloute ah, ka khetul bul a thulimlouhna in hon umsuak in leng, bang ding in ka lau dia!
english: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?

paite: Amau neih-le-lam muang a, amau hauhna tampi suangte'n.
english: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—

paite: Kuamah in a-unau atan thei kei ding uh, Pathian kiang ah tatna leng apiaksak thei sam kei ding uhi.
english: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.

paite: Ahinna uh tatna ding in tatna man atam lua a, tangtawn a leng angim louh mai ding ahi.
english: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,

paite: Adam gige a, muatna amuhlouhna ding in.
english: that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.

paite: Mipilte asi ua, huai bang in, mihai leh mimawlte leng amang tuaktuak ua, aneih-le-lam uh midangte anutsiat zel uhi.
english: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.

paite: Alungsim ngaihtuahdan uh, a-innte uh tangtawn a om ding bang leh, a-omnate uh suan tengteng tan a om ding bang in ahi; agamte uh amau min mah atamsak uhi.
english: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.

paite: Himahleh mihing pahtawi in a-om gige kei ua; gamsa mangthangte bang ahi uhi.
english: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.

paite: Hiai kihaimuante tuah ahi a, atan ua kipakte tawpna. Selah
english: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.

paite: Belamhon bang in Sheol a ding a seh ahi, sihna amaute avak ding hi, zingsang lam in midiktatte'n atung uah thu anei ding ua; a-omnate ua a-omlouhna ding in, akilawmna uh Sheol hihsiat ding ahi ding hi.
english: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.

paite: Ka hinna bel Pathian in Sheol thilhihtheihna a kipan atankhe ding a; ama'n ahon kipahpih ding hi. Selah
english: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.

paite: Mi hihhauh a ahong om a, a-insung thupina ahong thupi huthut in leng, lau ke'n.
english: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

paite: Asih hun chiang in bangmah akeng kei ding hi; athupina in zui khe lou ding ahi ngal a.
english: for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.

paite: Adam lai in nuamsa mahleh, adamsung in phat loh mahleh.
english: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—

paite: Amah suangtute lam ah apai dia, vak amu ngei kei ding uh.
english: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.

paite: Mihing, pahtawi a om a, theihsiamna nei tuan lou zaw, gamsa mangthang zelte bang phet ahi uhi.
english: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka thute ah na bil hon doh inla, ka ngaihtuahnate ngaihtuah in.
english: For the Chief Musician, with the flutes. A Psalm by David. Give ear to my words, Yahweh. Consider my meditation.

paite: Ka kumpipa leh ka Pathian, ka kikou aw ngaikhia in, na kiang a thum ka hi ngal a.
english: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.

paite: TOUPA aw, zingsang in ka aw na za zel ding a; zingsang in ka thumna na ma ah ka gel hoih dimdiam ding a, ka hon na hungaih zel ding hi.
english: Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

paite: Gilou-salou kipahpih Pathian na hi ngal kei a; mikhialte na kiang atung kei ding hi.
english: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.

paite: Miki-uangsakte na mitmuh in adingh thei kei ding ua; gitlouhna nna semte tengteng na hua hi.
english: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.

paite: Zuaugen hatte na hihmang ding a; TOUPA'N sisan suah hat leh khemhatmi akih nilouh hi.
english: You will destroy those who speak lies. Yahweh abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.

paite: Himahleh kei bel, na hoihna niphatna in, na inn ah ka hong lut ding a; laudan siam kawm in na tempul siangthou lam nga in ka hon be zel ding hi.
english: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka melmate ziak in na diktatna in hon pi inla; na lampi ka ma ah kichiansak in.
english: Lead me, Yahweh, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.

paite: Akam uah ginomna himhim a-om, keila; asunglam uh gitlouh satlouhna ngen ahi; agawl uh han kihong ahi a; alei un mi aphat khempeuh uhi.
english: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.

paite: Pathian aw, amaute siam louh tangsak in amau hoihsaknate ngei pukna in zang uhen; atatlekna tampi ziak un sawnkhia in; na tung ah ahel ngal ua.
english: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.

paite: Nangmah a ginna koihte nangmah ah kipak uhenla, na humbit zel ziak in nuam in kikou nilouh uhen; na min itte leng nangmah ah kipaktak in om uhen.
english: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.

paite: Midiktat na vualzawl ding a; TOUPA aw, amah phaw bang in, deihsakna in na umsuak ding hi.
english: For you will bless the righteous. Yahweh, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.

paite: "Bangkim hihthei, TOUPA Pathian in thu agen a, leitung nisuahna lam a kipan a atumna lam tan in asamta hi.
english: A Psalm by Asaph. The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.

paite: Kilawm bukim, Zion a kipan in Pathian avakkhia hi.
english: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.

paite: "I Pathian ahong ding a, adai nilouh kei ding; amah ma ah mei akuang zuazua ding a, akim ah huihpi anung ding hi.
english: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.

paite: Amite vai ahawmtheihna ding in tunglam vante leh lei asam ding.
english: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:

paite: Ka misiangthoute ka kiang ah pikhawm unla, kithoih a thukhungte ngei," chi in.
english: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”

paite: Huchi in vante'n adiktatna atangkoupih ding ua, amah Pathian ngei vaihawmpa ahi ngal a. Selah
english: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.

paite: "Ka mite aw, ngaikhia unla, thu ka gen ding hi; Israel aw, ngaikhia in, ka hon hilhchiansak ding hi; kei Pathian, na Pathian ngeingei ka hi.
english: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.

paite: Na kithoihnate ziak in ka hon tai kei ding; ka ma ah na halmang thillatte a-om gige ngal a.
english: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.

paite: Na inn a kipan bawngtal ka lakhe kei ding a, na ganhuang a kipan keltalte ka lakhe sam kei ding hi.
english: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.

paite: Gamnuai a sa chiteng kei a ahi a, mual sangkhat tung a gan omte leng.
english: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.

paite: Tang a vasa tengteng ka thei vek a; gamsate kei' a ahi.
english: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.

paite: "Gilkial mah leng ka hon hilh kei ding, leitung leh asung a thil om tengteng kei' a ahi.
english: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

paite: Bawngtal sa ka ne in kel sisan ka dawn dia hiam?
english: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

paite: Pathian kiang ah kipahthugen kithoihna lan zaw inla; na thuchiam leng Tungnungpen lak ah tangtun in.
english: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.

paite: Huan mangbat ni in hon sam lechin, ka hon humbit ding a, huchi in nang na hon pahtawi ding hi, achi a.
english: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

paite: "Migilou-salou kiang ah bel, Pathian in, Ka dan thuseh bangchidan a na kam a lou na hia?
english: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,

paite: Thuhilhna na hua a, ka thute na nunglam ah na pai zel ngal a.
english: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?

paite: Guta na muh in phaze na sakpih a, angkawmpate na koppih gige behlap hi.
english: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.

paite: "Gilou kiang ah na kam na pia a, Na lei in khemna a bawl gige hi.
english: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.

paite: Tu kawm in na unau na kalh a; nangmah nu tapa ngei na hek hi.
english: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.

paite: Huai thil na hih a, himahleh ka dai nilouh a; nangmah bang geih in na hon gingta hi. Himahleh ka hon tai a, na mitmuh in kizom zel in ka hihlang ding hi.
english: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.

paite: "Nou Pathian mangngilhte aw, hiai ngaihtuah dih ua! Huchi lou in zaw ka hon botnen kha ding hi, noumau hon humbit ding lah a om dek ngal kei hi.
english: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.

paite: Kuapeuh kipahthugen kithoihna lan in ahon pahtawi zel hi, huan a-omdan kemhoihmi kiang ah Pathian hotdamna ka ensak ding hi,” achi a.
english: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”

paite: "Pathian aw, na itna thupitak dungzui in ka tung ah zahngai inla; na lainatna thupi dungzui in ka tatleknate nulmang in.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David, when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

paite: Ka thulimlouhnate hon silsiang vilvel inla, ka khelhna hon silsiangsak in.
english: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.

paite: "Ka tatleknate ka theigige ngal a, ka khelhna ka ma ah a-om nilouh hi.
english: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.

paite: Na tung ah, na tung kia ah thil ka hihkhial a, na mitmuh in thil gilou ka na hihta hi; thu na gen a siamtang a na om theih a, vai na hawm a, gensiatbei a na omtheihna ding in.
english: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.

paite: Ngai in, thulimlouhna a suktuah in ka om a; ka nu'n khelhna in ahon pai hi.
english: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.

paite: "Ngai in, sunggil ah takna na deih naknak a, akimu lou lam ah pilna na hon theisak ding hi."
english: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

paite: Hissop in hon siangsak inla, huchi in ka siang ding; hon silsiang lechin, vuk sang in ka ngouzaw ding hi.
english: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

paite: Nopna leh kipahna bil in hon zasak in; na guh suktante a kipahtheihna ding in.
english: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.

paite: Ka khelhnate lak ah na mai sel inla, ka thulimlouhna tengteng nulmang in.
english: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.

paite: "Pathian aw, keimah ah lungtang siangthoutak siam inla; ka sung ah kha diktak siam thak nawn in.
english: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

paite: Na kiang a kipan in hon paimang ke'nla; na Kha Siangthou hon laksak ke'n.
english: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.

paite: Na hotdamna kipahna hon pe nawn inla; na Kha khut in hon len gige in.
english: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.

paite: Huchi in talekte na lampi tungtang ka hilh ding a; huchi in mikhialte nang lam anga nawn ding uhi.
english: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.

paite: "Pathian, hon hondampa Pathian aw, sisan suahte lak ah hon tankhia in; huchi in ka lei in na diktatna thu kipaktak in la in asa ding hi.
english: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang ka muk hong in; huchi in ka kam in na phatna a theisak ding hi.
english: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.

paite: "Kithoihna tung ah kipahna na nei ngal kei a; huchi hilou hileh ka pe ding a, halmang a thillat tung ah lungkimna himhim na nei kei hi.
english: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.

paite: Pathian deihlam kithoihnate zaw kha khasia ahi. Pathian aw, lungtang khasia leh kisik tuntun na musit kei ding hi.
english: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.

paite: "Na deihlamtak in Zion tung ah thil hoih hih inla; Jerusalem kulh lem in.
english: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in diktatna kithoihnate tung ah kipahna na neita ding a, halmang a thillat leh halmang a pumpiak tung ah, huchi in na maitam tung ah bawngtalte alanta ding uh.”
english: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.

paite: "Mihat aw, bang achia thil hihkhelh suang na hia! Pathian zahngaihna tung a gitlouhna bangziak a suang?
english: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by David, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, “David has come to Ahimelech’s house.” Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.

paite: Na lei in niteng in gilou-salou asuangtuah nak; mulmet tem hiamtak khemhat bang in.
english: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

paite: Hoih sang in gilou na deihzaw a; diktatna thugen sang in zuauthu gen na deihzaw hi. Selah
english: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.

paite: Nang lei khemhat aw, thu mivalhtheite na deih hi.
english: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.

paite: "Pathian in tangtawn a ding in ahon hihse ding a, ahon man ding a, na omna a kipan in ahon kaikhe ding a, mihing gam a kipan ahon botkhe ek ding hi. Selah
english: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.

paite: Midiktatte'n leng amu un alau ding ua, anuihsan ding uh.
english: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,

paite: En dih uh, hiai mi ahi, akulhpi a Pathian nei nuam lou a, ahauhna thupi muang zaw a, gitlouh satlouhna akihihhat," chi in.
english: “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”

paite: "Kei zaw, Pathian inn a olive sel liahliah bang ka hi, Pathian zahngaihna tangtawn tangtawn in ka muang ding hi.
english: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.

paite: Huai na hih ziak in, tangtawn in kipahthu ka hon hilh ding; na misiangthoute mitmuh ah na min ka ngak ding, ahoih ahi."
english: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.

paite: Mihai in alungtang in, Pathian a-om kei, achi nak hi. Ase khin ua, thil thulim lou kihhuaitak ahih uh; kuamah thil hoih hih himhim a-om kei uh.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Mahalath.” A contemplation by David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.

paite: Theisiam a Pathian zong himhim a-om uhiam chih thei ding in Pathian in van a kipan mihing tate a-ensuk a.
english: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.

paite: Alehngat chiat ua; nintak in ana om vekta ua; kuamah thil hoih hih a-om kei ua, khat lel leng a-om kei uh.
english: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

paite: Thil hihkhialte'n theih anei kei ua hia! Tanghou nek bang in ka mite ane khin ua, Pathian lah asam kei uhi.
english: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?
