paite: Launa omlouhna ah alau petpet ua, Pathian in nang hon umpa guhte adalhsak ziak in; Pathian in amau amuhsit ziak in, amau na zahlaksak.
english: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.

paite: Israelte hotdamna Zion a kipan in hong pawtleh aw! Pathian in ami saltangte a pikik nawn chiang in, huai hun chiang in Jakobte anuam ding ua, Israelte akipak ding uhi.
english: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

paite: Pathian aw, na min in hon hondam inla, na hatna in vai hon hawmsak in.
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David, when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, “Isn’t David hiding himself among us?” Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.

paite: Pathian aw, ka thumna ngaikhia inla; ka kam a thu suakkhete bildoh in.
english: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.

paite: Mikhualte'n hon sual ua, mingongtatte'n ka hinna hihmang tum in azong ua, ama uah Pathian akoih kei uhi. Selah
english: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.

paite: Ngai in, Pathian hon panpihpa ahi a, TOUPA ka hinna lentu ahi.
english: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.

paite: Ama'n ka melmate gitlouhna athuk ding a, nang amaute na thutakna ziak in hihmangthang in.
english: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.

paite: Keimah deih thu a thil lan in na kiang ah ka kithoih ding a; TOUPA aw, na min ka phat ding, ahoih ziak in.
english: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, Yahweh, for it is good.

paite: Ka mangbatna tengteng ah na hon tankheta a; hon doute tung a ka deihtel ka mit in amuta hi.
english: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.

paite: Pathian aw, ka thumna ah bildoh inla; hehpih ka ngetna ah kisel ke'n.
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David. Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.

paite: Hon za inla, hon dawng in; ka mangbat thu ziak in ka mau vialvial a, ka thum nilouh hi.
english: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan

paite: Melma husa in hon hihmangbang; migilou-salou nuaisiahna in ahon vuk ua, heh in hon sawi uhi.
english: because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.

paite: Ka sung ah ka lungtang ana mahmah a, sih mulkimnate'n hon delhkhum hi.
english: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.

paite: Lauthawnna leh linna in hon bawm a, launa in ahon khuh khinta hi.
english: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.

paite: Huan ke'n, vakhu bang a kha neih ut hi na tel ing e, aw! Huchi in ka lengmang ding a, khamuangtak in ka om ding.
english: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.

paite: Ngai in, gamlapi ah ka vialvak dia, gamdai ah ka om ding hi. Selah
english: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.

paite: Huih hattak leh huihpi a kipan ka bukna mun ah ka taikin ding, ka chi a.
english: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”

paite: TOUPA aw, alei uh hihsia in hihkek in; khopi ah ngongtatna leh kisuknatna ka mu ngal a.
english: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

paite: Sun leh zan in khopi kulh dawn ah avialvak ua; sung ah thulimlouhna leh haksatna a-om hi.
english: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.

paite: Gitlouh satlouhna asung ah a-om a, nuaisiahna leh khemna in kholak apawtsan ngei kei hi.
english: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.

paite: Hon gensia lah melma ahi ngal kei a; hileh zaw, ka thuak thei zaw ding, ka tung a kihihlian a hon hua ahi sam kei a; hileh zaw, ka buksan ding hi.
english: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.

paite: Himahleh, nang, ka mi batpih, ka lawm, kithuahpih theih na hi ngal a.
english: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.

paite: Kam khumtak in i kihoukhawm zel a, mipi lak a Pathian inn ah i pawt zel hi.
english: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.

paite: Sihna atung uah hong tung henla, kohawm ah ahing in paisuk uhen; gitlouh satlouhnate a omna uah leh agilsungte uah a-om ngal a.
english: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.

paite: Ke'n zaw Pathian ka sam ding a; TOUPA'N hon hondam ding hi.
english: As for me, I will call on God. Yahweh will save me.

paite: Nitaklam, zingsang, sun in ka mangbat thu ka gen in ka thum ding a, huchi in ama'n ka aw angaikhe ding hi.
english: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.

paite: Ka tung a kidouna lak ah ka hinna khamuangtak in ahumbitta a, hon sualte lah atam ngal ua.
english: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.

paite: Pathian, nidanglai a om gige in, angaikhe dia, amau adawng ding. Selah Lamdanna nei ngei lou, Pathian laudan siam ngei lou mite zaw.
english: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They never change and don’t fear God.

paite: Amah toh kituakte tung ah akhut alik a; athukhun abohsia hi.
english: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.

paite: Akam nawituidat bang in anem a, alungtang bel kidouna ahi ngal a; athute sathau sang in analzaw a, himahleh namsau phawisate ahi.
english: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.

paite: TOUPA tung ah na puakgik nga lechin, ama'n nang ahon hihhat ding hi. Midiktat chik mah in leng hihlin aphal kei ding hi.
english: Cast your burden on Yahweh and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

paite: Himahleh, Pathian aw, nang amaute manthatna kohawm ah na paisuksak ding; sisan suah hat leh khemhat mite tuh adamsung kimkhat uh leng adam zou kei ding uhi; ke'n bel nang ka hon muang hi.
english: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.

paite: Pathian aw, hon hehpih in; mihing in hon valh khit atum uhi, nitum in hon sual in hon nuaisiah uh.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Silent Dove in Distant Lands.” A poem by David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.

paite: Ka melmate'n nitum in hon valh zoh atum ua, kisatheitak a hon sualte lah atam ngal ua.
english: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.

paite: Ka lau chiang in, nangmah ka hon muang hi.
english: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

paite: Pathian ah athu ka phat ding a; Pathian ka gingta a, ka lau kei ding; sa in bang ahon chih thei dia!
english: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?

paite: Nitum in ka thute alakawi ua; angaihtuahna tengteng tuh ka siatna ding lam ngen ahi.
english: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.

paite: Akikhawm ua, abu ua, ka khapte achiamteh ua, ka hinna hihmang tum a angak ziak un.
english: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.

paite: Thulimlouhna in asuahtak san ding uam! Pathian aw, heh in michih hihniam in.
english: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.

paite: Nang ka vakvaihnate na chiamteh a, ka khituite na savun thawl ah thun in; na laibu ah atuang chiat kei ua hia!
english: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?

paite: K'on sap hun ngeingei in hon doute ataizak ding ua; hiai ka thei, Pathian in hon panpih hi.
english: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.

paite: Pathian ah athu ka phat ding a, TOUPA ah athu ka phat ding hi.
english: In God, I will praise his word. In Yahweh, I will praise his word.

paite: Pathian ka gingta a, ka lau kei ding; mihing in bang ahon chih thei dia!
english: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

paite: Pathian aw, na kiang ah thuchiam ka nei a, kipahthugen kikhopnate in ka hon thuk ding hi.
english: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.

paite: Ka hinna sihna lak ah na humbit a; ka khete puk lou ding in na humbit kei a hia! Hinna vak a Pathian ma a ka paitheihna ding in.
english: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.

paite: Pathian aw, hon hehpih inla, hon hehpih in; ka hinna nangmah ah ahong puklut ngal a, ahi, na khalim nuai ah ka bu ding, vangtahnate athen masiah.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when he fled from Saul, in the cave. Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.

paite: Pathian Tungnungpen ka sam ding, Pathian kei dia bangkim hon hihsakpa.
english: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.

paite: Hon valh khit tumpa'n ahon gensiat hun chiang in ama'n van a kipan in ahon sawl ding a, ahon hondam ding hi;Selah Pathian in azahngaihna leh athutak ahon sawlkhe ding.
english: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.

paite: Ka hinna humpinelkai lak ah a-om a; mi mei a kang lak ah ka lum a, mihing tate lak ah; huaite ha tei leh thal ahi a, alei uh namsau hiamtak ahi.
english: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

paite: Pathian aw, nang van khen pek ah pahtawi in hong om in! Na thupina leitung tengteng tung ah hong om hen!
english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!

paite: Ka khe awkna ding in len aphah ua; ka hinna akun kheikhei a, ka ma ah kokhuk atou ua; amau mah alaitak ah akia uhi. Selah
english: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves. Selah.

paite: Ka lungtang akip ahi, Pathian aw, ka lungtang akip ahi; la ka sa ding a, ahi, phatna la ka sa ding hi.
english: My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.

paite: Ka thupina, halh in; pekging leh kaihgingte aw, halh un; kei zingkhang in ka halh ding hi.
english: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.

paite: TOUPA aw, michih lak ah nang kipahthu ka hon hilh ding a, namte lak ah nangmah phat in la ka sa ding hi.
english: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.

paite: Na zahngaihna vante sun in athupi a, na thutak meipite sun in athupi ahi.
english: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.

paite: Pathian aw, nang vante khen pek ah pahtawi in omta in; na thupina leitung tengteng ah hong omta hen.
english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.

paite: Diktatna thu dai dide in maw na gen taktak uh! Mihing tate aw, diktak in maw vai na hawm uh!
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David. Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?

paite: Ahi, na lungtang uah thil thulim lou na hih nak ua; leitung ah na khut ua thil ngongtatna na bukkhia uhi.
english: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands on the earth.

paite: Migilou-saloute anu uh gilsung a kipan in Pathian a pan khen in a-om ua; apiantak un zuauthu gen in avakmang zel uhi.
english: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

paite: Agu uh gulgu bang ahi a; thangtom nangong abil hum bang ahi uhi.
english: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,

paite: Huai in gul aitawi aw angaikhe kei a, bangchibang a siam in bum mah le uh.
english: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.

paite: Pathian aw, akam uah hate tansak inla; TOUPA aw, humpinelkai hatsanlaite ha lian pipite tongkhia in.
english: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, Yahweh.

paite: Amau tui hattak a luang bang in tuimang uhenla; athalte a angim in, sattan bang in om zel hen.
english: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.

paite: Dokdawn, tui a mang maimah zel bang hileh; ahun lou a numei nau neih, nisa mel mu lou bang hi hen aw.
english: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.

paite: Na belte un ling satna atheih ma un leng ama'n pingpei in alamang ding; ahing lai leh akuang lai leng.
english: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.

paite: Midiktat in phulakna amuh in akipak ding a, migilou-salou sisan ah akhe asil ding hi.
english: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,

paite: Huchi in mite'n, "Midiktat a ding in kipahman a-om taktak a, lei ah vaihawmpa Pathian a-om taktak hi," achi ding uhi.
english: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”

paite: Ka Pathian aw, hon doute a pan hon humbit inla; hon sualte a pan hon humbit in.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.

paite: Thil hihkhialte a pan hon humbit inla, sisan suah hatte a pan hon hondam in.
english: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka tatlekna ziak hilou in, ka khelh ziak leng hilou in, ngai in, ka hinna atang gige hi, mihatte hon sual ding in akikhawm uhi.
english: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, Yahweh.

paite: Ka khelh louhpi in leng hon sual ding in akisa ua; hon panpih ding in kihihhalh inla, en in.
english: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!

paite: TOUPA aw, sepaihte' Pathian, Israel' Pathian, nangmah ngei nam chih gawt ding in thou inla; milepchiah giloutakte peuhmah hawi ke'n. Selah
english: You, Yahweh God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.

paite: Nitaklam in ahong nawn ua, ui bang in aham vengvung ua, khopi kimvel ah apai uhi.
english: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.

paite: Ngai in akam un asa-ikkhia ua; amuk uah namsaute a-om a, kua athei a-om a! achi maimah uhi.
english: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA aw, nang amau na nuihsan zaw ding a; nam chih na nuihsan ding hi.
english: But you, Yahweh, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.

paite: Ahatna ziak in amah ka ngak nilouh ding a, Pathian ka insang ahi ngal a.
english: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.

paite: Ka tung a zahngai Pathian in ahon dawn ding a, Pathian in ka melmate tung ah ka thudeih ahon musak ding hi.
english: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.

paite: Amau that ke'nla, huchi lou in zaw ka mite'n amangngilh kha ding ua; TOUPA aw, ka phaw pen uh, Na thilhihtheihna in hihdalh inla, hihniam in.
english: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.

paite: Akam khelhna ziak un leh amuk ua thupawt ziak in akisaktheihna ngei uah awk uhen; athugen zel uh hamse lohna leh zuauthu ziak in leng.
english: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.

paite: Amaute thangpai in hihmangthang inla, a-om nawnlouhna ding un hihmangthang inla, Pathian in Jakobte lak ah vai ahawm chih thei chiat uhen; kawlmong pha in.
english: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.

paite: Huan nitaklam in hong uhenla, ui bang in ham vengvung uhenla, khopi kimvel ah pai uhen.
english: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.

paite: Amau nek ding zong in avakvak ding ua, atai kei uleh a-om zanhak ding uhi.
english: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.

paite: Himahleh ke'n na hatna thu la in ka sa ding a; ahi, zingsang in na zahngaihna thu nuamtak in la in ka sa ding hi; nang ka insang, ka mangbat ni a ka kihumbitna na hi ngal a.
english: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.

paite: Ka hatna aw, nang phat in la ka sa ding a; Pathian ka insang, ka tung a siam Pathian ahi ngal a.
english: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.

paite: TOUPA aw, heh in hon sal ke'nla, thangpai in hon sawi sam ke'n.
english: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, upon the eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm by David. Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka tung ah zahngai in, ka gimgawpta a; TOUPA aw, hon damsak in; ka guhte lah ana vekta ngal a;
english: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am faint. Yahweh, heal me, for my bones are troubled.

paite: Ka hinna leng nakpitak in hihmangbat in a-om hi; TOUPA aw, nang bang tan ahia na hon etsim ding?
english: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, Yahweh—how long?

paite: TOUPA aw, hong kik nawn inla, ka hinna hondam in, na hoihna phatna ziak in hon hondam in.
english: Return, Yahweh. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.

paite: Sih nung in nang theihgigena a-om ngal kei a; Sheol ah kua'n ahia na tung a kipahthu gen ding?
english: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?

paite: Ka mauna lam ah ka bahta; zan teng in tui ah ka lupna ka kilamsak a; ka lupna ka khitui in ka kawtsak zel hi;
english: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.

paite: Lungkhamna ziak in ka mit ase hulhul a; hon doute ziak in ahong tek deuhdeuhta hi.
english: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.

paite: Nou, nna gilou sem tengteng aw, hon paisan vek un; TOUPA'N ka kah ging azata ngal a;
english: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for Yahweh has heard the voice of my weeping.

paite: TOUPA'N hehpihna ka nget lah angaikheta a; TOUPA'N ka thumna akipahpih ding hi.
english: Yahweh has heard my supplication. Yahweh accepts my prayer.

paite: Hon doute tengteng azahlak un amangbang mahmah ding ua; akik nawn ding ua, thakhat in ahong zahlak ding uhi.
english: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.

paite: "Pathian aw, nang na hon khahkhia a, na hon hihsia a; na hong hehta a; hon tungding nawn in aw.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lily of the Covenant.” A teaching poem by David, when he fought with Aram Naharaim and with Aram Zobah, and Joab returned, and killed twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt. God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.

paite: Hiai gam na hihling a, na khangsakta hi; akhangkhamte siam hoih nawn inla; aling aling ngal a.
english: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.

paite: Na mite thil haksa pipi na tuaksak a hoina uain na hon dawnsak hi.
english: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.

paite: Nang laudan siamte kiang ah puanzak na peta a, thutak ziak a zak ahihtheihna ding in. Selah
english: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

paite: Na deihtakte humbit a a-om theihna ding un, na khut taklam in hon hondam inla, hon dawng in.
english: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

paite: "Pathian in asianthouna ah hichibang in agen, ka nuam ding a; Shekem khua ka hawm ding a, Sukkoth phaizang ka hawmzak ding hi.
english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

paite: Gilead gam kei a ahi a, Manasseh gam kei a ahi a; Ephraim gam leng ka lu humbitna ahi a; Judah gam ka lalchiang ahi.
english: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.

paite: Moab gam ka kisilna bel ahi; Edom gam ah khedap ka pai ding, Philistia gam, nang zaw keimah ziak in kikou tanla, chi in.
english: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my sandal on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”

paite: "Khopi kiptak ah kua'n ahon pilut dia! Edom gam ah kua'n a hon pi ding!
english: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?

paite: Pathian aw, nangmah mah in na hon deih louh ka hi kei ua hia? Pathian aw, ka sepaihte kiang uah lah na pawt ngal ta kei a.
english: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.

paite: Melmate sual ding in hon panpih in, mihing panpihna bangmah lou maimai ahi ngal a.
english: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.

paite: Pathian ziak in hangsantak in ka hih ding; amah tuh i melmate sikden dingpa ahi ngal a."
english: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.

paite: Pathian aw, ka kikou husa na za inla; ka thumna ngaikhia in.
english: For the Chief Musician. For a stringed instrument. By David. Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.

paite: Ka lungtang abah lai in kawlmong a kipan ka hon sam ahi. Kei sang a sangzaw suangpi ah hon pi in.
english: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

paite: Nang kei a ding in humbitna melmate lak ah galven insang kiptak na hi ngal a.
english: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.

paite: Na puanin ah tangtawn in ka om ding a, na kha nuai bukna mun ah ka muang ding hi. Selah
english: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.

paite: Pathian aw, nang ka thuchiamte na ngaikhia a, na min laudan siamte gam luah tuh na hon pia hi.
english: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

paite: Kumpipa damsung hihsau in, akumte suan tampi bang ahi ding.
english: You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.

paite: Pathian ma ah tangtawn in a-om gige ding, aw, amah ah zahngaihna leh thutak bawl in, amah humbittu ding in.
english: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

paite: Huchi in ka thuchiamte niteng a ka hihtheihna ding in, tangtawn in na min phat in la ka sa ding hi.
english: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.

paite: Ka hinna in Pathian kia angak a, amah a kipan in ka hotdamna ahong pawt ding ahi.
english: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.

paite: Amah kia ka suangpi leh hon hondampa ahi. Ka insang ahi a, nakpitak in ka ling kei ding hi.
english: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.

paite: Nou tengteng in, mi khat that ding a, baang awn leh gawl puk dekdek bang in bang tan ahia na sual ding uh?
english: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

paite: Athupina a kipan a sawnkhe ding lel in akihou ua; zuaugen akipah lamtak uh ahi a, akam un avualzawl ua, himahleh alungsim un hamsia aloh zel ngal uhi. Selah
english: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

paite: Ka hinna aw, Pathian kia ngak in; ka lametna amah kiang a kipan a pawt ahi ngal a.
english: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

paite: Amah kia ka suangpi leh ka hotdamna ahi; ka insang ahi a, ka ling kei ding.
english: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.

paite: Pathian kiang ah ka hotdamna leh ka thupina a-om a; ka hatna suangpi leh ka kihumbitna Pathian ah a-om hi.
english: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

paite: Nou mipite aw, chik lai peuh in leng amah muang unla, na lungtang uh ama ah sungbua un; Pathian ei a ding in kihumbitna ahi. Selah
english: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.

paite: Minamniamte bangmah lou lel ahi ua, minam liante leng zuau lel ahi uhi; bukna ah teh hi le uh, tuihu sang in azangzaw ding uh.
english: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.

paite: Nuaisiahna muang kei unla; aphatuam lou guktakna lamen kei unla, hauhnate ahong khanleh atung ah na lungtang uh nga kei un.
english: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.

paite: Pathian in khatvei agen a; hiai nihveitak ka zata hi; thilhihtheihna Pathian a ahi chih.
english: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.

paite: TOUPA aw, zahngaihna nang a mah ahi a, michih athilhih bangbang un na thuk ngal zel hi.
english: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.

paite: Pathian aw, nang ka Pathian na hi a; phalvak in ka hon zong hi; ka hinna nangmah duh in adangtak a; ka sa in ahon ngai ahi, gamkeu leh phaizang tui omlouhna ah.
english: A Psalm by David, when he was in the desert of Judah. God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

paite: Huchi mah bang in mun siangthou ah ka hon en gige hi, na thilhihtheihna leh na thupina mu ding in.
english: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.

paite: Na zahngaihna ka hinna sang a ahoih zawk ziak in ka muk in ahon phat ding hi.
english: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.

paite: Huchi mah bang in ka damsung teng in ka hon phat ding a; na min in ka khutte ka zak ding hi.
english: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.

paite: Ka hinna guhngek leh thau a atai bang in atai ding a; ka kam in kipahna mukpu in ahon phat ding hi.
english: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,

paite: Ka lupna tung a ka hon theihgige lai in, zan a na tungtang thu ka lunggel lai in.
english: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.

paite: Nang hon panpihpa na hi a, na kha nuai ah nuam in la ka sa ding hi.
english: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.

paite: Ka hinna in hon zui tettet a, na khut taklam in na hon kai zel hi.
english: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.

paite: Ka hinna hihmang tum a zongte lei mun nuainung ah alut ding ua;
english: But those who seek my soul to destroy it shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

paite: Namsau thilhihtheihna in apuk ding ua; sehalte tan ahi ding uhi.
english: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.

paite: Kumpipa bel Pathian ah anuam ding a; amah lou a kichiam peuhmah in asuang ding ua, zuauhat kamte hum a om ding ahih ziak in.
english: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.

paite: Pathian aw, ka mangbat thu ah ka aw na za inla; melmate lauhhuaina lak ah ka hinna humbit in.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

paite: Thil hoih lou hihte kihou gukna lak ah hon sel in; thil hihkhialte buaina lak ah.
english: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;

paite: Amau namsau bang in alei uh atat-hiam ua, athu khate ngei uh thalte bang a kap ding in angim ua.
english: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,

paite: Mi gensiatbeite mundai a akaptheihna ding un; lau lou in khatvei thu in akap guih ngal uhi.
english: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.

paite: Thil gilou hih ding in sakithuhilh ua; thang aguk a kam thu bang ah akihou zel ua; "Kua'n huaite amu dia?" achi uhi.
english: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”

paite: Thulimlouhna azongkhia ua; "Hahkattak in i zongta," achi ua, asunglam ngaihtuahna leh lungtang uh thuktak ahi ngal a.
english: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.

paite: Himahleh Pathian in thal in amaute akap ding a, Thakhat in liam in a-om ding uhi.
english: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.

paite: Huchibang in, amau lei ngei a amau adou ziak in, kisui in a-om ding ua; amau mute'n alu uh asing ding uhi.
english: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.

paite: Huchi in mi tengteng in alau ding ua; Pathian nasep agen ding uhi, athilhih piltak in angaihtuah ding uhi.
english: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.

paite: Midiktatte TOUPA ah akipak ding uh; lungtang diktat pu tengteng in asuang ding uhi.
english: The righteous shall be glad in Yahweh, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!

paite: Pathian aw, Zion ah phatna in hon ngak nilouh hi, thuchiam na kiang ah tangtungsak in.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.

paite: Thumna zapa aw, na kiang ah sa tengteng ahong pai ding hi.
english: You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.

paite: Thulimlouhnate'n hon zoh chiang in, ka tatleknate uh nang na silsiang hi.
english: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.

paite: Mi, na tempul huangsung intual a om thei ding a na tel a, na kiang na naihsak in nuam asa hi; na inn hoihna in ka tai ding uh, na tempul siangthou hoihna in.
english: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.

paite: Pathian hon hondampa aw, diktatna mulkimhuai thilhihte in na hon dawng ding hi; nang kawlmong a mi tengteng leh tuipi tung a gamlapi a omte lametna na hi.
english: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea.

paite: Thilhihtheihna atai a kigak a, nangmah hatna a mualte hihkippa na hi hi.
english: By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.

paite: Tuipi thawm ging, akihot gingte leh michih chiak vengvung hihdaipa na hi.
english: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

paite: Kawlmong tawp a omte'n leng na theihsaknate alau ua; zingsang leh nitak paikhiaknate nuam in na kikousak hi.
english: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.

paite: Lei na veh a, tui in na khai a, nakpi petmah in na hihhoih hi; Pathian luitui in adim a, lei huchibang a na bawl nung in amaute a ding in buh na bawlsak hi.
english: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.

paite: Leilehte tui tampi in na vak a; asaichian na khengsak hi; vuahtui in na nemsak a, athilpoute na vualzawl zel hi.
english: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.

paite: Na hoihna in kum na khusak a; na paina lampite'n kiningchinna aluanglet hi.
english: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.

paite: Gamdai a gantatna munte ah aluanglet a, mual neute leng nopna toh akigaksuak uhi.
english: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.

paite: Gantatna munte ganhon in aluahsuak a; phaizangte leng buh in akhuh suak hi; nuam in akikou ua, la asa uhi.
english: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.

paite: Leitung luah tengteng aw, Pathian pahtawi in nuam in kikou unla.
english: For the Chief Musician. A song. A Psalm. Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!

paite: Amin thupidan la in sa unla, aphatna hih thupi un.
english: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!

paite: Pathian kiang ah, "Na thilhihte mulkimhuai na e! Na thilhihtheihna thupidan thu ah nangmah melmate na kiang ah akipelut ding uhi.
english: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.

paite: Leitung luah tengteng in ahon be ding ua, nangmah phat in la asa ding uh, chi un. Selah
english: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.

paite: Kisa un, Pathian thilhihte en un; mihing tate tung a athilhih ah akihtakhuai ahi.
english: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.

paite: Ama'n tuipi leigaw asuaksak a; luipi khe in apaikai ua, huai ah amah ah i kipak uhi.
english: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.

paite: Athilhihtheihna in tangtawn in vai ahawm hi; amit in namte a-en hi, helhatte kipahtawi kei uhen. Selah
english: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.

paite: Michihte aw, i Pathian uh phat unla, amah phatna husa theisak un.
english: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,

paite: Ama'n i hinna uh ahihhing gige a, I khete kisuan aphal kei hi.
english: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.

paite: Pathian aw, nang na hon enchian a; dangkasik etchet bang in na hon enchian hi.
english: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.

paite: Nang len ah na hon pilut a; ka kawng uah puakgik giktak na hon koih hi.
english: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.

paite: Mihingte, kangtalai tung a tuang in, ka lutung uah na paisak a; meikuang leh tui ah ka paisuak ua; himahleh mun hausatak ah lut ding in na hon pikhia ahi.
english: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.

paite: Halmang thillatte toh na inn ah ka lut ding a, ka thuchiamte na lak ah ka tangtungsak ding hi.
english: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,

paite: Ka muk in agen a, mangbang a ka om lai a kam in agente mah.
english: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.

paite: Sathautak halmang thillatte na kiang ah ka lan ding a, belampate hal namtui toh; bawngtalte, kelte toh ka lan ding hi. Selah
english: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.

paite: Kisa un, Pathian laudan siam tengteng aw, ngaikhia un. Huchi in ka hinna a ding a athilhih ka hon theisak ding hi.
english: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.

paite: Ka kam in amah ka sam a, ka lei a pahtawi in a-om hi.
english: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.

paite: Ka lungtang a thulim lou ka limsakleh Toupa'n hon ngaikhe kei ding hi.
english: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.

paite: Himahleh, Pathian in hon ngaikhia a; ka thumna alimsak hi.
english: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.

paite: Pathian aw, ka thumna vuaksuaksak lou a, ka lak a azahngaihna tawp sam lou phat in om hen.
english: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.

paite: Pathian in hon hehpih henla, hon vualzawl henla, amel i tung uah hon vaksak hen. Selah
english: For the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.

paite: Na lampi leitung a mi theih ahihtheih a, na hotdamna nam chih kiang a theih ahihtheihna ding in.
english: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,

paite: Pathian aw, michih in hon phat hen; mi khempeuhte'n hon phat hen.
english: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

paite: Aw, namte kipaktak a om in, nopla sa uhen; nang michih khentuam nei lou a vai hawmsak in, leitung a namte na uk ngal a. Selah
english: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.

paite: Pathian aw, michih in hon phat uhen; mi chitengte'n hon phat uhen.
english: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

paite: Lei in athilpou apia a; Pathian, koumau Pathian ngei in, ahon vualzawl ding.
english: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.

paite: Pathian in hon vualzawl ding a; kawlmong a mi tengteng in leng amah alau ding uhi.
english: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.

paite: Pathian thou in amelmate delhzak hen; amah hote leng ama ah taikek uhen.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.

paite: Meikhu mutmang a a-om bang in, amaute mutmang in; meilum a khuainun azul bang in migilou-saloute Pathian ma ah mangthang uhen.
english: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

paite: Midiktatte bel kipaktak in om uhenla; Pathian ma ah nuam uhenla; ahi, kipaktak in nuam uhen.
english: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.

paite: Pathian pahtawi in la sa unla, amin phat in la sa un; kangtalai a gamdaite paisuakna ding in lamlian ding sungvum unla, amin TOUPA ahi; ama ah nuam un.
english: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!

paite: Pathian a-omna siangthou a om, pabeite Pa leh meithaite ngaihtuahpa ahi.
english: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

paite: Pathian in mi tangkhatte inkuan ah apangsak a, mihentate apikhia a, vangphatna ah apilut hi; helhatte zaw gamkeu ah a-om uhi.
english: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

paite: Pathian aw, na mite makai a na hong pawt a, gamdai a na paisuak lai in, Selah
english: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.

paite: lei aling dupdup a, vante leng Pathian ma ah atakkhia a; Sinai Tang hilhial leng Pathian ma ah, Israel' Pathian ma ah, aling dupdup hi.
english: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

paite: Pathian aw, nang vuah tampi na zusak a, na gouluah ding, abah lai in, na hihkip hi.
english: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.

paite: Na mi omkhawmte'n huai ah panmun akhoh ua; Pathian aw, nang na hoihna in gentheite a ding inn na bawlsak hi.
english: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.

paite: Toupa'n thu apia, tanchin genmi numeite pawl lianpi ahi uhi.
english: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.

paite: Sepaihte kumpipate ataikek ua, inn ngaknu'n gallak sum ahawm hi.
english: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,

paite: Vakhu kha dangka-eng a luan a, akha mong leng dangka-eng te selsel a luan bang in, belam huang kal bang ah om mah le uh.
english: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.

paite: Bangkim hihthei in huai akumpipate ahihzak lai, Zalmon tang a vukzuk lai bang ahi hi.
english: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.

paite: Pathian tang Bashan tang ahi a; Bashan tang tuh tang sangpi ahi.
english: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.

paite: Tang sangtakte aw, Pathian in a-omna ding a atang deih, bangziak a haza a en. Ahi, TOUPA huai ah tangtawn in a-om nilouh ding ahi.
english: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, Yahweh will dwell there forever.

paite: Pathian kangtalai singnih ahi a, asang a sang tampi ahi; TOUPA tuh Sinai Tang a om bang in, huai lak ah mun siangthou ah a-omta hi.
english: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.

paite: Nang tunglam ah na paitou a, matte sal in na pi a; mihingte a pan thilpiakte na mu a, ahi, helhatte a pan in leng; akiang ua TOUPA Pathian a- omtheihna ding in.
english: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that Yah God might dwell there.

paite: TOUPA ka puak uh niteng a hon puaksakpa, hon hondampa Pathian phat in om hen. Selah
english: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.

paite: Ei Pathian zaw hotdamna Pathian ahi; TOUPA Pathian ah sihna a pan suahtakna a-om hi.
english: God is to us a God of deliverance. To Yahweh, the Lord, belongs escape from death.

paite: Himahleh Pathian in amah melmate lu asat phel ding a, gitlouhna a pai zelte lu sam phatak.
english: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.

paite: TOUPA'N, "Bashan gam a kipan in ka pi nawn ding a tuipi nuai thuktak a pan ka pi nawn ding.
english: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea,

paite: Na khe sisan a na diah theih a, na ui leite'n na doute lak a tan aneihtheihna ding in," achi a.
english: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”

paite: Pathian aw, na pailaite amu ua, i Pathian i kumpipa mun siangthou a apai lai
english: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.

paite: nungak khuang bengte lak ah, lasa pawlte apai masa ua, tumging tum pawl in azui uhi.
english: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,

paite: Kikhopnate ah Pathian phat un, Israel tui nak a pawtte aw, TOUPA phat un.
english: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”

paite: Huai ah nautum Benjamin avaihawmpa un a-om chiuchiau, Judah miliante leh a-upate uh, Zebulun miliante, Naphtali miliante toh.
english: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

paite: Na Pathian in na thilhihtheihna apia a; Pathian aw, kou ding a thil na hon hihsak hihhat in.
english: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.

paite: Jerusalem a na tempul ziak in Kumpipate'n kipahmante ahon puak ding uhi.
english: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings shall bring presents to you.

paite: Dangkate sikden in sialluang lak a gamsahangte taihilh in; bawngtal tampi, michih bawngnoute toh kidou ut mi khempeuh ahihzakta hi.
english: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample under foot the bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan in miliante ahong pawt ding ua; Ethiopiate akhut uh Pathian lam a zak ding in akintat ding uh.
english: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.

paite: Leitung gamte aw, Pathian pahtawi in la sa unla; aw, TOUPA phat in la sa un. Selah
english: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord— Selah—

paite: Vante van nidanglai a omte tung a tuangpa mah. Ngai in, a-aw asuah a, A-aw thupitak mahmah ahi.
english: to him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.

paite: Pathian kiang ah hatna pia un; athupina Israelte tung ah a-om a, ahatna vandumte ah a-om hi.
english: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.

paite: Pathian aw, na mun siangthou a kipan in na kihtakhuai ahi. Amah Israel' Pathian ngei in amite kiang ah hatna leh thilhihtheihna apia hi. Pathian phat in om hen.
english: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!

paite: Pathian aw, hon hondam in; tuite lah ka hinna pha in alutta hi.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Lilies.” By David. Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!

paite: Buannawi thukpi, siksan himhim omlouhna ah, ka tum hulhul hi; tui thukpi tui lian hon tupnate ah, ka na lutta hi.
english: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

paite: Ka kikouna lam in ka bah a; ka dang akeu khinta; ka Pathian ka ngakna ah ka mit avai khinta hi.
english: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.

paite: Bangmah lou a hon hote ka samzang sang in atam ua, dikloupi a hon dou a hon hihmanthat tumte mihattak ahi uhi; ka lak het louh ka pe nawn hi.
english: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.

paite: Pathian aw, nang ka haidan na thei; nang lak ah ka khelhnate sel ahi kei hi.
english: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.

paite: Toupa aw, sepaihte' PATHIAN, nangmah ngakte keimah ziak in zahlak kei uhen; Israel' Pathian aw, nangmah zongte keimah ziak in hihzum in om kei uhen.
english: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord Yahweh of Armies. Don’t let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.

paite: Nangmah ziak a gensiat ka thuak ziak in, zumna in ka mai akhuh khinta hi.
english: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.

paite: Ka unaute lak ah mikhual ka na hita a, ka nu naute lak ah theih ngei louh mi ka na hita hi.
english: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.

paite: Na inn a ka phatuamngaihna in hon negai a; nangmah gensete gensiatnate ka tung ah akibung hi.
english: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.

paite: Ka kah a, an ngawl kawm a ka hinna ka sawileh, huai gensiat a ka omna phet ahi.
english: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.

paite: Ka puansilh a sai-ip ka zatleh, amaute a dia hoih lou lam a gentehna ka na hi zel.
english: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.

paite: Kulh kong a tute'n ka tungthu agen ua; zukhamhatte lasak ka hita hi.
english: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA aw, ke'n zaw, hun kipahhuai ah ahi ka thum; Pathian aw, na zahngaihna thupi ziak in na hotdamna thupitak in hon dawng in.
english: But as for me, my prayer is to you, Yahweh, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.

paite: Buannawi a kipan hon humbit inla, hon tumsak mahmah ke'n; hon hote lak ah leh tui thukpi a kipan humbit in hon omsak in.
english: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.

paite: Tui lian in hon tummang kei henla, tui thukpi in leng hon valh kei hen, kokhuk in leng akam chihkhum kei hen.
english: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.

paite: TOUPA aw, hon dawng in; na zahngaihna ahoih ngal a; na zahngaihna thupidan bang zel in kei lam hong nga in.
english: Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.

paite: Na sikha lak ah na mai sel ke'n; ka mangbang ngal a; hon dawng meng in.
english: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!

paite: Ka hinna hon naih in, tan inla; hon doute ziak in hon humbit in.
english: Draw near to my soul and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.

paite: Nang mi hon gensiatnate, ka zahlaknate, ka zumnate na thei hi; hon doute na ma ah a-om vek uhi.
english: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.

paite: Mi hon gensiatna in ka khasia a; nakpitak in ka lungkham behlap hi; huchi in hon hehpih ding ka zong a, himahleh kuamah a-om kei ua; hon khamuan ding ka zong nawn a, kuamah ka mu sam kei.
english: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.

paite: Ka an ding in banghiam thil kha ahon piak behlap ua; ka dangtak in uain thuk dawn ding in hon pia uhi.
english: They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.

paite: Ama ua adohkan uh thang hi henla; khamuangtak a a-om lai un pial suak hen.
english: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.

paite: Amitte uh, amuh theihlouhna ding un, hihmial in om hen; akawngbomte uh kivuangsak gige in.
english: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.

paite: Na lungkim louh mahmahna atung uah sungbua inla, na heh thangpaihna in amaute man hen.
english: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.

paite: A-omna uh gam henla; apuanin uah kuamah om kei hen.
english: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.

paite: Na satpa asawi ua, na sukliamte lungkhamna leng agen ngal nak uhi.
english: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.

paite: Athulimlouhna uah thulimlouhna behlap inla; amau na diktatna ah lut kei uhen.
english: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.

paite: Amin uh hinna bu a pan nulmang in om uhen, midiktat lak ah gelh hi kei uhen.
english: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.

paite: Himahleh kei gentheitak leh lungkhamtak ka hi a; Pathian aw, na hotdamna in mun sang ah hon koih in.
english: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.

paite: Pathian min la in ka phat ding a, kipahthu gen in amah ka pahtawi ding hi.
english: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

paite: Huchibang in bawngtal hiam, kii leh chinnei bawngtal hiam, sang in TOUPA akipaksak zaw ding hi.
english: It will please Yahweh better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.

paite: Thunuailutte'n huai mu in akipak uhi; nou Pathian zongte aw, na lungtang uh hing in om hen.
english: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.

paite: TOUPA'N tasamte ngaikhia in, ahentate amusit ngal kei a.
english: For Yahweh hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.

paite: Lei leh van in amah phat hen, tuipite leh asung ua thil tang thei peuhmahte toh.
english: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!

paite: Pathian in Zion honkhia in, Judah khuate asiam dek ngal a; huchi in huai ah a-om ding ua, neih toh athuah ding uh.
english: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.

paite: Asikhate suante'n gou aluah ding ua; amin itte asung ah a-om ding uhi.
english: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian aw nangmah ah ka ginna ka nga a; hon delh tengteng lak ah hon hondam in hon humbit in;
english: A meditation by David, which he sang to Yahweh, concerning the words of Cush, the Benjamite. Yahweh, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,

paite: huchi lou in zaw, humbitpa om lou in humpinelkai bang in, ka hinna abotnen kha ding hi.
english: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian aw, huchibang a hih ka na hih a, ka khut a khelhna a-om a,
english: Yahweh, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,

paite: ka lawm khelhna a thuk ka na hihleh, ahi, bangmah lou a hon dou ka humbit ana hi zaw.
english: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary),

paite: Melma in ka hinna delh in, delhpha mai hen aw; ahi, ka hinna lei ah chilpuk in, ka thupina leivui lak ah koih mai hen. Selah
english: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.

paite: TOUPA aw, heh in thou inla, hon doute thangpaihna dou ding in kisa inla; kei a ding in kihihhalh inla; vaihawmna ding thu na peta hi.
english: Arise, Yahweh, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.

paite: Huchi in michih omkhawmte'n hon umsuak uhen, huan, nang atung uah sangpi in kik nawn in.
english: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.

paite: TOUPA'N michih vai ahawmsak hi. TOUPA aw, keimah a ka diktatna leh ka lungsim hoihna om bang zel in vai hon hawmsak in.
english: Yahweh administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.

paite: Giloute gitlouhna hong tawp taleh aw, midiktatte hihkip in. Pathian diktat in lungtangte leh lungsimte a-enchian hi.
english: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.

paite: Pathian kiang ah ka phaw a-om, amah zaw lungtang dikpu hondampa ahi.
english: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

paite: Pathian vaihawmpa diktat ahi, ahi, niteng in migiloute tung a lung hihlouhna nei Pathian ahi.
english: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.

paite: Mi akiheikik keileh ama'n anamsau tat-hiam in; thalpeu alai a, amanta hi.
english: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.

paite: Sihna vanzatte amah thahna ding in leng abawl dimdiam a; athalte kuangthei in abawl hi.
english: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.

paite: En in, gitlouhna in thulimlouhna apiangsak a; ahi, thilhihkhelhna apai a, zuauthu apiangsakta hi.
english: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.

paite: Kokhuk abawl a, thukpi in atou a, amah khuk toh ah aketa hi.
english: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.

paite: Athilhihkhelhna ama lutung mah ah ahong kik nawn ding, hiamgamtak a athilhih ama sip mah ah ake ding hi.
english: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.

paite: TOUPA adiktatna ziak in, akiang ah kipahthu ka gen ding; TOUPA tungnungpen min phat in la ka sa ding hi.
english: I will give thanks to Yahweh according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of Yahweh Most High.

paite: Pathian aw, hon humbit ding in kin inla; TOUPA aw, hon panpih ding in kin meng in.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David. A reminder. Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, Yahweh.

paite: Ka hinna hihmang tum a zongte zahlak in zum uhen, ka siatna zong a kipakte.
english: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

paite: Ku! Ku! chite azahlak ziak un taikeksak in om uhen.
english: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”

paite: Ahon zong tengteng nangmah ah nuamtak leh kipaktak in om uhenla; na hotdamna itte'n, Pathian pahtawi in om hen, chi gige uhen.
english: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”

paite: Himahleh kei zaw genthei leh tagahtak ka hi a; Pathian aw, ka kiang ah hong pai meng in, nang hon panpihpa leh hon humbitpa na hi a; TOUPA aw, sawt hal mahmah ke'n.
english: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. Yahweh, don’t delay.

paite: TOUPA aw, nangmah ah ka ginna ka koih zel hi; chik mah chiang in zahlak in hon omsak ke'n.
english: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.

paite: Na diktatna vang in hon humbit in, hon honkhia in; kei lam ah na bil hon doh inla, hon hondam in.
english: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.

paite: Kei a ding in omna suangpi, ka hoh theihgigena hong hi in, nang hon hondam ding in thu na pia a; ka suangpi leh ka kulhpi na hi ngal a.
english: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.

paite: Ka Pathian aw, migilou-salou khut a kipan hon honkhia in, midiktat lou leh nunsia khut a kipan.
english: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

paite: TOUPA Pathian aw, nang ka lamet na hi; ka naupan chik a kipan ka hon muan na hi.
english: For you are my hope, Lord Yahweh, my confidence from my youth.

paite: Ka nu gil a kipan in nangmah na hon len zel a, ka nu sung a kipan hon lakhepa na hi; ahi nangmah ka hon phat gige ding.
english: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.

paite: Mi tampi theih in thillamdang ka hi a; himahleh ka kihumbitna kiptak na hi.
english: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.

paite: Ka kam nang phatna in adim ding a, nitum in nang pahtawina in adim ding hi.
english: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.

paite: Ka tek chiang in hon nial ke'nla, ka bah chiang in hon paisan ke'n.
english: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.

paite: Ka melmate'n ka tungthu agen ua; ka hinna tangte leng akikum uhi.
english: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,

paite: Pathian in apaisanta, delh unla, man un; humbitpa ding himhim a-om ngal kei a, chi in.
english: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”

paite: Pathian aw, hon gamlat mahmah ke'n; ka Pathian aw, hon panpih ding in kin in.
english: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.

paite: Ka hinna tung a melmate zahlak leh mangthang in om uhenla; ka siatna zongte gensiatna leh zumna a khuh in om uhen.
english: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.

paite: Himahleh ke'n zaw ka lamen gige ding a, ka hon phat semsem ding hi.
english: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.

paite: Ka kam in na diktatna thu agen ding a, nitum in na hotdamna thu agen ding a; atamdan ka thei ngal kei a.
english: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.

paite: Toupa PATHIAN thilhih thupiakte toh ka hong pai ding a, adiktatna, nangmah diktatna thu kia ka gen ding hi.
english: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Yahweh. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.

paite: Pathian aw, ka naupan chik a kipan nang na hon hilh a; tutan in na thillamdang hihte ka theisak gige hi.
english: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.

paite: Ahi, Pathian aw, ka tek a ka sam akan hun in hon paisan mahmah ke'n; na hatna hiai khangte kiang leh, na thilhihtheihna khang hong om lai dingte kiang a ka theihsak mateng.
english: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.

paite: Pathian aw, na diktatna leng asang mahmah ahi; Pathian aw, nang thil thupitakte hihpa, nangmah bang kua a-om a?
english: God, your righteousness also reaches to the heavens. You have done great things. God, who is like you?

paite: Nang, buaina tampi leh thupitak hon musakpa'n na hon hingsak nawn dia, lei thukpi a kipan na hon pikhe nawn ding hi.
english: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.

paite: Nang ka thupina hon hihpungsak inla, hong kihei nawn inla, hon khamuan in.
english: Increase my honor and comfort me again.

paite: Pekging in ka hon phat ding a, ka Pathian aw, na thutak ka phat ding hi, Nang Israelte Mi Siangthou aw, kaihging toh nang phat in la ka sa ding.
english: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.

paite: Nangmah phat a la ka sak chiang in ka muk anuam mahmah ding a; na tatsa ka hinna mah leng nuam asa mahmah ding hi.
english: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!

paite: Ka lei in leng nitum in na diktatna thu agen ding; ka siatna ding zongte azahlak un azumta uhi.
english: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.

paite: Pathian aw, na vaihawmnate kumpipa kiang ah pia inla, na diktatna kumpipa tapa kiang ah pia in.
english: By Solomon. God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.

paite: Na mite dikna in vai ahawmsak ding a, na mi gentheite vaihawmna dik in vai ahawmsak ding hi.
english: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.

paite: Tang lian leh mual neute'n diktatna in mite kiang ah khamuanna ahon tun ding uhi.
english: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.

paite: Ama'n mi lak a gentheite vai ahawmsak ding a, tagah tate ahondam ding a, nuaisiahtu bel ahihzan ding hi.
english: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.

paite: Tung a ni leh kha om sung teng, suan om sung teng in leng akikou ding uhi.
english: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.

paite: Amah loupa gawitan tung a vuah kia bang in ake ding a; lei vak vuahtui bang mai in.
english: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.

paite: Adam lai un midiktat ahampha ding uh, khapi om nawn louh dong in khamuanna thupi toh akhang ding uhi.
english: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.

paite: Ama'n tuipi a pan a tuipi dang pha in, luipi a pan kawlmong pha in thu anei ding.
english: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.

paite: Gamdai a omte ama ah akun ding ua, amelmate'n leng leivui aliak ding uhi.
english: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.

paite: Tarshish gam leh tuikulh gam kumpipate'n kipahman ahon tawi ding ua; Sheba leh Seba gam Kumpipate'n thilpiakte ahon lan ding uhi.
english: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

paite: Ahi, kumpipa tengteng ama ah abokkhup ding ua, nam chih teng in a-nna asem ding uhi.
english: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.

paite: Genthei in asap chiang in ama'n ahumbit ding a, mitagah, panpihpa nei lou leng ahumbit ding hi.
english: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.

paite: Migenthei leh tagahte ahehpih ding a, tagahte hinna ahondam ding hi.
english: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.

paite: Ahinna uh nuaisiahna leh hiamgamna lak a kipan atan ding a, asisan uh amah ngaihdan in manphatak ahi ding hi.
english: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.

paite: Huan ahing ding a; Sheba gam dangka-eng a kipan a piak ahi ding a, mite'n amah athumsak gige ding ua; niteng in phat in a-om ding hi.
english: He will live; and Sheba’s gold will be given to him. Men will pray for him continually. They will bless him all day long.

paite: Lei ah, mualvum peuh ah, buh tampi a-om ding a; avui Lebanon bang in aling suausuau ding a, khua a mite bel loupa bang in apha lihliah ding uhi.
english: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.

paite: Amin tangtawn in a-omden ding a; amin nisa a-om sung in tatlak lou in a-om zel ding a; mite amah ah vualzawl in a-om ding ua; nam chihte'n amah hampha achi ding uh.
english: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.

paite: TOUPA Pathian, Israel' Pathian phat in om hen, amah kia in thillamdang ahih zel a.
english: Praise be to Yahweh God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

paite: Amin thupitak tangtawn in phat in leng om henla; leitung pumpi leng athupina a hihdim in om hen. Amen, Amen.
english: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.

paite: Jesse tapa David thumnate abeita hi.
english: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.

paite: Israelte tung ah Pathian ahoih ngei e, lungtang siangthoute tung ah.
english: A Psalm by Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

paite: Himahleh ke'n zaw ka siktal dekdek a; ka kalsuante ateu dekdek ahi.
english: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.

paite: Migilou-saloute vangphatdan ka muh in mi ki-uangsakte ka eng hi.
english: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

paite: Asih lai un thuakgimna anei kei ua, ahatna uh akip zosop hi.
english: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.

paite: Midang bang a gimthuak in a-om kei uhi. Midang bang a gawt in leng a-om sam kei uh.
english: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.

paite: Huaiziak in kisaktheihna in khainiang bang in angawng uh avial a; hiamgamna in puan bang in atuam hi.
english: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.

paite: Thau ziak in amit uh apawng leuluau a, lungtang thudeih sang a thupi anei uhi.
english: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.

paite: Anuihsan ua, giloutak in nuaisiahna thu agen ua, kisaktheihna in apau uhi.
english: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.

paite: Akam uh van lam ah akoih ua, alei un leitung apha suak zel hi.
english: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.

paite: Huaiziak in amite huai ah akik nawn ua, tui nou dim adawnsiang sipsip uhi.
english: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.

paite: Pathian in bangchi in athei dia? Tungnungpen in theihna anei dia hia? achi uhi.
english: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”

paite: En dih, hiai migilou-saloute ahi uh; nuamsa a om in ahau deuhdeuh uhi.
english: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.

paite: Athawn in ka lungtang ka hihsiang a, ka khutte gensiatbei in ka sil hi.
english: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,

paite: Nitum in gawt in ka om a, zingsang teng in sawi in ka om hi.
english: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.

paite: Huchibang in ka gen ding, na chi taleng; ngai dih, muanhuai loutak a hih ka hi ding.
english: If I had said, “I will speak thus”, behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.

paite: Huai ka theihna ding dan ka ngaihtuah in, kei a ding in ana lua hi.
english: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me—

paite: Pathian' mun siangthou a ka lut a, abeina ding uh ka ngaihtuah masiah.
english: until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.

paite: Amau mun naltak ah na koih a; siatnate ah na paikhe zel hi.
english: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.

paite: Bangchidan ahia mitphiat kal kia a a-ingamtak uh aw! Thil mulkimhuaitakte a hihmanthat vek in a-omta uhi.
english: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.

paite: Mi'n khanloh nung a mang bangmah asak louh bang un, TOUPA aw, na halh hun in amau lim leng bangmah na sa kei ding hi.
english: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.

paite: Ka lungsim lungkham a a-om a, ka lungtang a sut a ka om lai in.
english: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.

paite: Mimawl leh bangmah thei lou ka hi a, na lak ah gamsa bang phet ka hi hial hi.
english: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.

paite: Himahleh na kiang ah ka om gige a, ka khut taklam na len gige hi.
english: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.

paite: Nang na lemtheihna in na hon pi ding a, huai nung chiang in thupina ah na hon tun ding hi.
english: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

paite: Van ah nang lou kua ka nei a? Lei ah leng nang lou ngal ka deih kuamah a-om kei hi.
english: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.

paite: Ka sa leh ka lungtang abahta a, himahleh Pathian tangtawn a ka lungtang utna ding leh ka tantuan ding ahi.
english: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

paite: Ngai in, nangmah gamlat a omte amangthang dek ua; ahon angkawmsan peuhmahte na hihmangta ahi.
english: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.

paite: Himahleh kei a ding in bel Pathian naih ahoih hi; Toupa PATHIAN ka kihumbitna in ka nei a, na nasep tengteng ka puanzak theihna ding in.
english: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.

paite: Pathian aw, bang ding a hon paimang den ding na hia oi? Bangziak a na gantatna mun a belamte tung a na hehna akhut?
english: A contemplation by Asaph. God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

paite: Na mite omkhawmte, nidanglai a na lei, na gou ding a na tat namte theigige in; na omna Zion tang toh.
english: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance: Mount Zion, in which you have lived.

paite: Tangtawn siatna lam ah na khe khai in, melmate'n mun siangthou ah thil gilou chiteng ahihta uhi.
english: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.

paite: Nangmah doute na mite kikhawmte lak ah a-awng zuazua ua; achiamtehnate uh chiamtehna hi ding in atakta uhi.
english: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.

paite: Mi singbawk heipi a ngimte bang in akimu ua.
english: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.

paite: Tun ah athilkhuak kilawm teng uh heita leh sek in ahihse chiat uhi.
english: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.

paite: Na mun siangthou ahal ua; na min omna lei a tumkhop hial in ahihbuahta uhi.
english: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.

paite: Alungsim un, avek in i hihse ding, achi ua, hiai gam a Pathian kikhopna inn tengteng ahalse khinta uhi.
english: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.

paite: I kichiamtehnate uh i muta kei ua, zawlnei a-omta kei ua asawtdan ding thei himhim i lak uah leng a-om kei hi.
english: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.

paite: Pathian aw, melma in bang tan ahia hon gensiat ding? Gal in na min tangtawn in agense dia hia?
english: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?

paite: Bang ding in ahia, na khut, na khut taklam na lakkik? Pholhkhe nawn inla, amaute hihmang in.
english: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!

paite: Himahleh, Pathian nidanglai tan a ka Kumpipa, lei laitak a hotdamna siampa pen ahi.
english: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.

paite: Nang na hatna in tuipi na kikhensak a, nang tui a dragonte na kitamsak hi.
english: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

paite: Nang Leviathan lute na zansak a, amah gamdai mi omte kiang ah an ding in na pia hi.
english: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.

paite: Nang tuikhuk leh tui lian na khen a; nang lui lian taktakte na kangsak hi.
english: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.

paite: Sun nang a ahi a, zan leng nang а ahi. Nang khovak leh nisa na ngaihtuah hi.
english: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.

paite: Nang leitung gamgite na khung vek hi; nang nipi leh phalbi na siam ahi.
english: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.

paite: TOUPA aw, hiai theigige in, melma in ahon gensiat a; nam haipi in na min agensiat.
english: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, Yahweh. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.

paite: Aw na vakhu hinna gam sahang kiang ah pe mahmah ke'nla; na migentheite hinna tangtawn in mangngilh sam ke'n.
english: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.

paite: Thukhun hon poimohngaih in; lei mun mial tata hiamgamna omna in adim hi.
english: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.

paite: Aw, nuaisiahna thuakte zahlak in nungkik kei uhenla; genthei leh tagahte'n na min phat uhen.
english: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.

paite: Pathian aw, thou inla, nangmah thu kigen tawm inla, mihai in nitum in ahon gensiat dan theigige in.
english: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.

paite: Nangmah galte husa mangngilh ke'n; ahon sualte chiak vengvung a paitou gige ahi uhi.
english: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.

paite: "Pathian aw, kipahthu ka hon hilh uhi; kipahthu ka hon hilh uhi, na min anai ziak in; mi'n na thillamdang hih thute agengen uhi.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Psalm by Asaph. A song. We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.

paite: "Hun seh pen ka muh hun chiang in diktak in vai ka hawm ding hi.
english: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.

paite: Lei leh asung a om tengteng azul khinta, ke'n abante ka phut ahi. Selah
english: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.

paite: Mi-uangte kiang ah, 'Uangtak in om kei un,' ka chi a, migilou-saloute kiang ah, 'Na kii uh sangsak kei un,' leng ka chi hi.
english: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.

paite: Na kii uh tunglam ah hihsang kei unla; ngawng golh zen in thu gen kei un.
english: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”

paite: "Sansakna suahlam a kipan ahi kei a, tumlam a kipan leng ahi kei lai a, simlam a kipan ahi sam kei hi.
english: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.

paite: Pathian vaihawmpa ahi zaw; ama'n khat niamsak in khat asangsak hi.
english: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.

paite: TOUPA khut ah nou a om a, a-uain aphul a; thil dang toh hel in adim a, huai a pan abungkhia a; pel lou in aneng nangawn lei a migilou-salou tengteng in adawnsiang sinsin ding uhi.
english: For in Yahweh’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.

paite: "Himahleh ke'n zaw tangtawn in ka theisak ding a, Jakob' Pathian phat in la ka sa ding hi.
