english: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

paite: Migilou-saloute kii tengteng ka hihtan ding a; midiktatte kii zaw sansak in a-om ding hi.
english: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.

paite: Judahte lak ah Pathian theih in a-om a; Israelte lak ah amin athupi hi.
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm by Asaph. A song. In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.

paite: Salem ah biakbuk a-om a. Amah omna Zion ah a-om hi.
english: His tabernacle is also in Salem. His dwelling place in Zion.

paite: Huai ah thalpeu thalte ahihsia a; phawte, namsaute, kidouna vanzatte toh. Selah
english: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.

paite: Nang thupitak leh hoihtak na hi a, sathah tangte sang in.
english: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.

paite: Lungtang phate'n suam atuak ua, a-ihmu uh a-ihmu denta uhi; mihatte leng kuamah in akhut uh alik theita kei uhi.
english: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.

paite: Jakob' Pathian aw, na sawina ziak in kangtalai leh sakol leng gen ding thei lou in a-om tuaktuak uhi.
english: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

paite: Nang, nangmah mah, lau ding na hi; na heh peuhmah leh, kua ahia na mitmuh a dingh thei ding?
english: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?

paite: Na vaihawm thu van a kipan in na theisak a; lei alau a, adaita hi.
english: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,

paite: Lei a mi thunuailut tengteng hondam ding leh vaihawm ding a Pathian athoh lai in. Selah
english: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.

paite: Pel lou in mihing hehna in nang ahon phat ding a, hehna kawnggak in na kigak ding hi.
english: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.

paite: Thu chiam inla, TOUPA na Pathian uh lak ah hihtangtung un; akim a mi tengteng in kihtak dingpa kipahmante hon tawisak uhen.
english: Make vows to Yahweh your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.

paite: Ama'n lalte kha asatkhe ding a; amah lei a kumpipate a ding in akihtakhuai ahi.
english: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.

paite: Ka aw in Pathian ka sam a; ka aw in Pathian ngei tuh ka sam ding a, ama'n kei lam ah bil ahon doh ding hi.
english: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by Asaph. My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.

paite: Ka buai ni in TOUPA ka zong a, zan chiang in leng ka khut khaikhe lou in ka zak gige a; ka hinna in khamuan a om anial hi.
english: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.

paite: Pathian ka theigige a, ka buai naknak; ka ngaihtuah a, ka kha abah naknak. Selah
english: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.

paite: Ka mitvunte na haksak a, pau thei lou khop in ka buai hi.
english: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.

paite: Nidanglaite ka ngaihtuah a, tang lai hun leh kumte.
english: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

paite: Zan a ka lasak ka thei nawn a; ka lungtang ah ka kingaihtuah a, ka kha in phatuamngaitak in azong hi.
english: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:

paite: Toupa'n tangtawn in akhahkhe dia eita aw? Chik mah chiang in akipakta kei dia eita aw?
english: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?

paite: Azahngaihna amang tawntung dia eita aw? Athuchiam suan tengteng pha in amang dia eita aw?
english: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?

paite: Pathian in hehpih a mangngilh a eita aw? Heh in lainatnate akhakta a eita aw? Selah
english: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.

paite: Huai ka hatlouhna ziak ahi; himahleh Tungnungpen khut taklam kumte ka theigige hi.
english: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”

paite: TOUPA thilhih thute ka gen ding a; nidanglai a na thillamdang hihte ka theigige ding hi.
english: I will remember Yah’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.

paite: Nna nasep tengteng ka ngaihtuah ding a, na thilhihte leng ka sut ding hi, ka chi a.
english: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.

paite: Pathian aw, na lampi mun siangthou ah a-om a, Pathian bang Pathian thupi kua a-om a?
english: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?

paite: Nang thillamdang hihpa Pathian na hi a; michih lakte ah na hatdan na theisak zel hi.
english: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.

paite: Na ban in na mite na honkhia, Jakob leh Joseph tate. Selah
english: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

paite: Tuite'n ahon mu ua, Pathian aw, tuite'n nang ahon mu ua, akikou ua; tui thukpite leng aling uhi.
english: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.

paite: Meipite'n tui asungbua ua; vante'n aw asuah ua; na thalte leng aphe zolzol hi.
english: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.

paite: Na van-ging husa pingpei ah a-om a; khophiate'n khovel atanvak zolzol a; lei kising in aling dopdop hi.
english: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.

paite: Tuipi ah na lampi a-om a, na lampite tui zatak ah a-om a, na khapte theih ahi kei hi.
english: Your way was through the sea, your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.

paite: Mosi leh Aaron khut in na mite belamhon bang in na pipi hi.
english: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

paite: Ka mite aw, ka dan thu ah bil na doh unla; ka kam a thute ah na bil uh hon doh un.
english: A contemplation by Asaph. Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.

paite: Gentehna thu in ka kam ka ding a; nidanglai a thugil gente ka genkhe ding.
english: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,

paite: Huaite i bil un i za ua, i lungsim in leng i thei uhi, apipute'n leng ahon hilh uhi.
english: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

paite: Huaite atate uh lak ah i iim kei ding ua, khang hong om ding kiang ah TOUPA phatna thu leh, ahatdan leh athillamdang pipi hihdante i hilh zaw ding uhi.
english: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.

paite: Jakobte lak a thu theihsak ahihkip a, Israelte lak ah dan asep a, huaite i pipute kiang ah thupiak in apia a, amau huai thu atate uh kiang ah atheihsak ding un.
english: For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;

paite: Khang hong om ding naupang hong piang dingte'n, atheihna ding un, huaite athou ua, atate uh kiang a, ahilhsawn zel ding un;
english: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,

paite: Alametna uh Pathian ah akoih ua, Pathian thilhihtet amangngilhlouhna ding leh athupiakte azonna ding un.
english: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,

paite: Apipute bang ua, suan genhak leh helhat suan lungtang bawldiklou, Pathian lak a lungsim ginom lou pu a a-omlouhna ding un.
english: and might not be as their fathers— a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.

paite: Ephraim suante galthuam a kithuam a, thalpeu tawi in, kisual ni in ataikek ua.
english: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

paite: Pathian thukhun azui kei ua, adan a om leng a-ut kei ua.
english: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.

paite: Athilhihte amangngilh ua, athillamdang amuhsakte toh.
english: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.

paite: Apipute uh mitmuh ah thillamdang pipite ahih zel a. Aigupta gam a Zoan mun ah.
english: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

paite: Tuipi akhenhok a, amau agalkaisak a; tuite thil koihkhawm venvon bang in akhawlsak meuhmouh hi.
english: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.

paite: Sun chiang in meipi in api a, zankhua in meikuang in leng apipi hi.
english: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.

paite: Gamdai ah suangpite akitamsak a, tui thukpi a kipan bang mai in dawn ding tampi apia hi.
english: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

paite: Suangpi a kipan in luite apawtsak a, tuite luipi bang in aluangkhesak hi.
english: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

paite: Huchi pipi in leng atung ah thil ahihkhial lailai ua, gamkeu ah Tungnungpen tung ah ahel uhi.
english: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.

paite: Agongthak uh hihdamna ding a anek ding uh ngen in alungtang un Pathian aze-et uhi.
english: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.

paite: Ahi, Pathian kalh in thu agen ua; Gamdai ah Pathian in dohkan abawlkhol thei diam maw?
english: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

paite: Ngai in, suangpi asat a, tuite ahong kikhohkhia a, luite apiau ah adimlet a; an leng ape thei lai diam maw? Amite a ding in sa abawlkhol diam maw? achi ua.
english: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N ana za a, ahehta hi. Jakobte tung ah mei ahong kuangkheta a, Israelte tung ah ahehna ahong suakta hi;
english: Therefore Yahweh heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,

paite: Pathian agingta kei ua, ahotdamna leng amuan louh ziak un.
english: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.

paite: Himahleh tunglam vandumte thu apia a, van kongkhakte ahonsak a;
english: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.

paite: anek ding un atung uah manna azusak a, van buh akiang uah apia hi.
english: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.

paite: Mihingte'n angel an ane ua; vahna khop in an ahon pia hi.
english: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.

paite: Suahlam huih van ah anungsak a, athilhihtheihna in sim huih anungsak hi.
english: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.

paite: Atung uah leivui bang in sa azusak a, vasa kha nei tuipi a piaunel zah;
english: He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.

paite: agiahna muntak uah akesak a, a-omna buk kim uah.
english: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.

paite: Huchi in ane ua, avah ngial ua; alunggulh uh akiang uah apia hi.
english: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.

paite: Agongthakna uh adai nai kei a, a-an uh akam uah a-om lai a,
english: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,

paite: Huchi in Pathian hehna atung uah atung a, amihoihte uh athat a, Israel tangval telte asatpuk helhul hi.
english: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their strongest, and struck down the young men of Israel.

paite: Huchipi in leng thil ahihkhial lailai ua, thillamdang hihte agingta tuan kei uh,
english: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.

paite: Huaiziak in adamsung nite uh bangmah lou phet in ahihmangsak a, adamsung kumte uh launa in ahihmansak lai hi.
english: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.

paite: Amaute athah chiang in amah azong ua; akik nawn ua, phalvak in Pathian azong uhi.
english: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.

paite: Pathian asuangpi uh ahi chih leh Pathian Tungnungpen atanpa uh ahi chih atheikhe zel uhi.
english: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.

paite: Himahleh akam un amaitangphat ua, alei un akiang ah zuauthu agen uhi.
english: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.

paite: Alungtang uh amah lam ah adik kei a, thukhun ah lah aginom sam kei uh.
english: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.

paite: Himahleh, amah bel lainatna a dim ahih ziak in athulimlouhna uh angaidam a, amau ahihmang kei hi. Ahi, tamveipi ahehna alakik a, athangpaihnate atokthou nuam kei hi.
english: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.

paite: Sa leltak ahih uh atheigige a; huih, kik nawn lou ding a nung zel bang in.
english: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.

paite: Gamdai ah atung ah hel mun in, gamkeu ah amah hih lungkham mun hi na tel uh e!
english: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!

paite: Akiheikik nawn un Pathian a ze-et ua, Israelte Mi Siangthou ahihvui uhi.
english: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Akhut atheigige kei ua, melma lak a ahumbit ni atheigige sam kei uhi.
english: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;

paite: Huchi a Aigupta gam ah achiamtehnate akoih a, Zoan loubuk ah athillamdang hihte leng akoih a;
english: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,

paite: aluipi uh sisan asuaksak a, aluite uh leng sisan asuaksak hi, huchi in adawn theita kei uhi.
english: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.

paite: Alak uah thou tampi asawl a, huai in amau ane khin a; ukengte leng asawl a, huai in amau ahihmangta hi.
english: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

paite: Athilpoute uh leng lung kiang ah apia a, asepgim gah uh khaupe kiang ah apia hi.
english: He also gave their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.

paite: Agrep guite uh gial in ahihsia a, atheipi kungte uh leng vuk in ahihsia hi.
english: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.

paite: Agantate uh gialpi kiang ah apia a, aganhonte uh kek sa velvol kiang ah apia hi.
english: He also gave over their livestock to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

paite: Ahehna thupitak atung uah akhia a, thangpaihnate, lung hihlouhna mahmahte, mangbatnate, angel giloute,
english: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.

paite: ahehna a ding in lampi abawlsak a; ahinna uh sihna lak ah ahumbit kei a, ahinna uh hipi kiang ah ape zawta hi.
english: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,

paite: Aigupta gam a ta masa tengteng athat a, Ham puanin ah ahatna gah masapente.
english: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.

paite: Himahleh belam bang in amite apikhia a, ganhon bang in gamdai ah api hi.
english: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

paite: Bittak in api a, huchi in bangmah alau kei ua; himahleh tuipi in amelmate uh akhuh khinta hi.
english: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

paite: Amun siangthou gamgi apitung a, hiai tang, akhut taklam a alei.
english: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.

paite: Ama uah namte adelhkhia ua, amau khuate gouluah ding in ahawm a, apuaninte uah Israel namte a-omsak hi.
english: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

paite: Himahleh, Pathian Tungnungpen aze-et ua, atung ah ahel ua, athu theihsakte azui kei uh.
english: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,

paite: Kihei nawn in, apipute uh bang in lepchiahtak in agamta zawta ua, thalpeu muanhuai lou bang in apaikawi uhi.
english: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.

paite: Amun sangte un amah ahihheh ngal a, amilim siamte un amullitsak hi.
english: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.

paite: Pathian in huai ana zak in aheh a, Israelte akih mahmah hi.
english: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,

paite: Huchi in Shiloh biakbuk mihing lak a apuanin koih, apaisan a;
english: so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,

paite: ahatna sal ah amansak a, athupina melma khut ah amansak hi.
english: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.

paite: Amite namsau kiang ah apia a; agouluah ding tung ah ahehta hi.
english: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.

paite: Mei in atangvalte uh akangmang a, anungakte un kitenna aneita kei uhi.
english: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.

paite: Asiampute uh namsau a hihpuk in a-om ua; ameithaite un suunna abawl kei uhi.
english: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.

paite: Huchih lai in, mi ihmu khanglou bang in TOUPA akhanglouta a, mihat uain ziak a kikou bang in.
english: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.

paite: Amelmate asatkik a, tangtawn minsiatna alohsakta hi.
english: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.

paite: Huai lou leng Joseph puanin adeih kei a, Ephraim nam leng atelta kei hi;
english: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,

paite: Judah nam atel zawta a, a-it Zion tang mah.
english: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.

paite: A-inn siangthou van sangte bang in alam a, tangtawn ding a ahihkip leilung bang in.
english: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.

paite: Asikha David atel a, belam huang a kipante alakhia a;
english: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

paite: Belampu nou kaite zuihna a kipan in apikhia a, ami Jakobte leh agouluah ding Israelte vak ding in.
english: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.

paite: Huchi in ama'n alungtang uh hoihna bang zel in amaute avak a; akhutsiamna in apita hi.
english: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.

paite: Pathian aw, na gouluah ding ah namte alut ua; na tempul siangthou ahihnin uhi; kisesa in Jerusalem akoih uhi.
english: A Psalm by Asaph. God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

paite: Na sikhate luang tungleng vasate an ding in apia ua, na misiangthoute sa gamsate kiang ah apia ua.
english: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.

paite: Asisan uh Jerusalem kim ah tui bang in asungbua ua; amau vui ding lah kuamah a-om ngal kei uhi.
english: They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.

paite: I kim ua mite gensiat in i na om ua, i kiangnai a mite muhsit leh nuihsan in i na omta uhi.
english: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.

paite: TOUPA aw, bang tan ahia na heh nilouh ding? Na mullitna mei bang in akuang ding ahia?
english: How long, Yahweh? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?

paite: Nangmah thei lou namte tung a na hehna sungbua in, na min sam lou gam tung ah.
english: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name,

paite: Jakobte ane khin ua; a-omna uh ahihgamta uhi.
english: for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.

paite: Ka pipute uh thulimlouhnate ka lak uah theigige ke'n; na lainatna in hon don pah hen. Nakpitak a hihniam in ka omta ngal ua.
english: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.

paite: Hon hondampa Pathian aw, na min thupina ding in hon panpih inla; na min ziak in hon humbit in, ka khelhnate uh silsiang in.
english: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.

paite: Bang achia namte'n, a Pathian uh koi a omta ahia le, chi ding uh ahia? Na sikhate sisan pawt phulakna ka mitmuh un namte lak ah theih hi hen.
english: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.

paite: Henta thumna na ma ah tung hen; na thilhihtheihna thupidan bang zel in si ding a sehte humbit in.
english: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang ahon gensiatna uh, ka kiangnai uate tung ah aleh sagih in thuk in.
english: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.

paite: Huchi in kou na mite, na gantatna mun a belamte'n, tangtawn in kipahthu ka hon hilh ding uhi; suan tengteng tan in nangmah phatna ka theisak zel ding uhi.
english: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.

paite: TOUPA koute TOUPA aw, leitung tengteng ah na minhoih hi na tel e! Na thupina thu van tungte ah na koih a.
english: For the Chief Musician; on an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by David. Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!

paite: Melma leh phulami daihsakna ding in, hon doute ziak in naungek leh nawi ne laite kam a pawt in hatna na hihkip hi.
english: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.

paite: Na van, na khutsuakte, kha leh aksi na sehte, ka ngaihtuah chiang in,
english: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,

paite: Mihing bang ahia, huchi tel a na limsak? Mihing tapa leng bang ahia, huchi tel a na veh? ka chi hi.
english: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?

paite: Amah zaw angelte sang a nuaizaw phet in na bawl a, thupina leh pahtawina na khusak hi.
english: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.

paite: Na khutsuak tungte ah thu na neisak a; akhenuai ah bangpeuh na koih a.
english: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:

paite: Belam leh bawng tengteng toh, ahi, gamsate toh leng;
english: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,

paite: Tung a leng vasa leh tuipi ngasate, tuipi a lampi tawn peuhmahte toh.
english: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.

paite: TOUPA kou TOUPA aw, leitung tengteng ah na minhoih hi na tel e!
english: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!

paite: Israelte chingpa, Belamhon bang Joseppipa bil na doh in; nang cherubte kal a tu, hong vakkhia in.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lilies of the Covenant.” A Psalm by Asaph. Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.

paite: Ephraim leh Benjamin, Manasseh mitmuh in na hatna tokthou inla, hon hondam ding in hong pai in.
english: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!

paite: Pathian aw, hon kiheisak nawn inla; na mel hihvak in, huchi in hotdam in ka om ding uhi.
english: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

paite: TOUPA aw, sepaihte' Pathian, bang tan ahia na mite thumna tung a na heh ding?
english: Yahweh God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?

paite: Amaute khitui tanghou in na vak a, khitui dawn ding in tehna liantak in na pe zel hi.
english: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.

paite: Nang ka kim ua mite a ding in kinakna ding in na hon bawl nak a, ka melmate uh anui chiat nak uhi.
english: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.

paite: Sepaihte' Pathian aw, hon kiheisak nawn inla; na mel hihvak in, huchi in hotdam in ka om ding uhi.
english: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan grepgui na hon la a; namte na delhkhia a, na suanta hi.
english: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.

paite: Ama na hihsiang zel a, thutak in zung akai a, gam aluah vek hi.
english: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.

paite: Mualte aliim tuam in a-om chiat a, ahiangte Pathian sidar singte bang ahi.
english: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.

paite: Ahiangte tuipi tan in azamsuaksak a aselte Luipi pha in.
english: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.

paite: Bang achia ahuangte hihsia na hia? Lampi a pai peuhmah in agah alohtheihna ding un.
english: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

paite: Gamnuai a ngal in ahihsia a, gamsate'n leng ane uhi.
english: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.

paite: Sepaihte' Pathian aw, hehpih in kihei nawn in; van a kipan in hon ensuk inla, hiai grepgui en inla, hong veh in.
english: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,

paite: Akung na khut taklam in asuanleh, ahiang nang dia na khauhsak toh.
english: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.

paite: Mei ah akangta, phuk in a-omta; na mel asalhna ziak in amangthang zel hi.
english: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.

paite: Na taklam a mi tung ah na khut om hen, mihing tapa nang dia na hihhat tung ah.
english: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.

paite: Huchi in ka hon kiksan kei ding ua; hon hihhalh inla, na min ka lou ding uhi.
english: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.

paite: TOUPA aw, sepaihte' Pathian, hon kiheisak nawn inla; na mel hihvak in, huchi in hotdam in ka om ding uhi.
english: Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

paite: Pathian hon hihhatpa pahtawi in nuamtak in la sa unla; Jakob' Pathian pahtawi in nuamtak in kikou un.
english: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. By Asaph. Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!

paite: Phatna la sa unla, khuangta, kaihging ngaihnophuai, pekging toh hon tawi un.
english: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.

paite: Kha thak in pengkul mut unla, kha lik a i ankuangluina thupi ni in.
english: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.

paite: Israelte ding a dan thuseh ahi ngal a, Jakob' Pathian dan ahi.
english: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

paite: Huai Joseph lak a thu theihsakna ding a aseh ahi. Aigupta gam tung a apaikhiak lai in, ka theih louh pau ka zak lai in.
english: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.

paite: Aliangzang thil gik a pan in ka lasuan a, loh a kipan akhutte khahkhiak in a-om hi.
english: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.

paite: Mangbat ni in na hon sam a, ka hon humbit a; van-ging bukna mun ah ka hon dawng hi; Meribah tuite ah ka hon ze-et ahi. Selah
english: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.” Selah.

paite: Ka mite aw, ngaikhia unla, ka hon theihsak bang in; Israel aw, ka thu ngaikhe nuam hi le uteh aw!
english: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!

paite: Gamdang pathian himhim na lak uah a-om ding ahi kei; midang pathian himhim na biak ding uh leng ahi kei hi.
english: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.

paite: Kei, TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi a, Aigupta gam a kipan hon pikhepa tak; na kam uh liankat un, ka hihdim ding hi.
english: I am Yahweh, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

paite: Himahleh ka mite'n ka aw angaikhe kei ua; Israelte'n hon deih kei uhi.
english: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.

paite: Huchi in alungtang uh genhakdan bang zel a om ding in ka khahzanta ahi, amau hoihsak bang a a-omna ding un.
english: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.

paite: Aw, ka mite'n ka thu ngaikhia in, Israelte ka lampite ah pai le u aw.
english: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!

paite: Amelmate uh ka hihneu zok in, amau galte tung ah ka khut ka lik ding hi.
english: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.

paite: TOUPA hote akiang ah akipelut ding uhi; amau hun bel a om nilouh ding ahi.
english: The haters of Yahweh would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.

paite: Nou bel buh hoihpen in ka hon vak ding hi; suangpi a khuaizu in ka a hon hon taisak ding ahi.
english: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”

paite: Mihat omkhawmte lak ah Pathian adingh a; pathiante lak ah vai ahawm hi.
english: A Psalm by Asaph. God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.

paite: Bang tan ahia dikloutak a vai na hawm ua, migilou-saloute, na deihsak tuam ding uh?
english: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.

paite: Gentheite leh pa neiloute hawmsak unla; haksa thuakte, tagahte tung ah hihdik un.
english: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

paite: Gentheite leh tagahte gum unla; migilou-salou khut a kipan humbit un.
english: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”

paite: Athei kei ua, theihsiamna leng anei kei uh; mial ah akileh akileh ua; leilung kingakna tengteng alingta hi;
english: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

paite: pathiante na hi ua, na vek un Tungnungpen tate na hi uh, ka chi hi.
english: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.

paite: Himahleh mihingte bang phet in na hong si ding ua, milian khat bang in na hong puk ding uhi.
english: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”

paite: Pathian aw, thou inla, lei vai hawmsak in, nam chih na gouluah ding ahi uhi.
english: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.

paite: Pathian aw, pau lou in om ke'nla; Pathian aw, dai nilouh ke'n, om maimai mahmah ke'n.
english: A song. A Psalm by Asaph. God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.

paite: Ngai in, na melmate alum lutlut ua; nangmah hote adak hekhawk uhi.
english: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.

paite: Na mite lepchiahtak in asawm ua, na mi selgukte tung ah aselam in akihou akihoukhawm uhi.
english: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.

paite: Kisa dih ua, anam uh mangsak khop in i hihmang ding uh; Israel min himhim theihgige a a-om nawnlouhna ding in, achi uhi.
english: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”

paite: Thukhat sat in akihou ua; na tung ah aselam a hih ding in thu achiamkhawm uhi.
english: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.

paite: Edom leh Ishmael puaninte, Moab leh Haggar;
english: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

paite: Gebal leh Ammon leh Amalek; Philistiate Tura a omte toh,
english: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

paite: Assuriate amau lam ah apang ua; Lot suante apanpih uhi. Selah
english: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.

paite: Amau Midiante tung a na hih bang, Kishon lui a Sisera tung a na hih bang, Jabin tung a na hih bang in hih sam in.
english: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;

paite: Huai mite Endor ah amang ua; lei a ding in eklei bang lel ana hita uhi.
english: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.

paite: Amiliante uh Oreb leh Zeeb bang in bawl inla, Ahi, a kumpipa tengteng uh Zebah leh Zalmunna bang in bawl in.
english: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

paite: Huai mite'n, Pathian omnate i luahsak ding uh, achi uhi.
english: who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”

paite: Ka Pathian aw, amaute leivui kipei lunglung bang in bawl in; buhsi huih mutleng bang in.
english: My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.

paite: Gam kang mei bang leh, tang kang meikuang bang in.
english: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,

paite: Amau na huihpi in delh inla, na huih thupitak in hihlau in.
english: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.

paite: TOUPA aw, na min a zontheihna ding un amel uh zumna in hihdim in.
english: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, Yahweh.

paite: Tangtawn in zahlak leh mangbangtak in om uhenla; ahi, hihzum a om in mangthang uhen.
english: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;

paite: Nangmah kia Jehovah min pu, leitung tengteng tung a Tungnungpen na hi chih atheihna ding un.
english: that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh, are the Most High over all the earth.

paite: Sepaihte TOUPA aw, na omnate deihhuai na tel e!
english: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. How lovely are your dwellings, Yahweh of Armies!

paite: Ka hinna in TOUPA huangsung intualte angai mahmah a, ahi, abahpih hial a; ka lungtang leh ka sa Pathian hing kiang ah akikoukhia hi.
english: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of Yahweh. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

paite: Ahi, kawlgit in inn amu a, lensiam in leng amah a ding in bu amu, anou koihna ding in sepaihte' TOUPA aw, ka Kumpipa leh ka Pathian, huai nangmah maitamte ngei ahi.
english: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, Yahweh of Armies, my King, and my God.

paite: Na inn a omte'n nuam asa ua; nang ahon phat gige ding uhi. Selah
english: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.

paite: Nangmah a hatna neimi in nuam asa hi; alungtang a Zion naihna lamliante om in.
english: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.

paite: Baka Phaizang atot un, tuikhuk omnate abawl ua, ahi, vuahtui ke masa in vualzawlna in akhuh hi.
english: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.

paite: Hatna a kipan in hat nawnsemna ah apai ua, Zion ah Pathian ma ah akimusak chiat uhi.
english: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.

paite: TOUPA aw, Sepaihte' Pathian, ka thumna hon ngaikhia inla; Jakobte Pathian aw, bil na doh in. Selah
english: Yahweh, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.

paite: Pathian ka phaw pen uh aw, en in, na thaunilhpa mel en in.
english: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.

paite: Na huangsung intual a ni khat om tuh mun dang a ni sangkhat sang in ahoihzaw hi. Gitlouhna puaninte a om sang in i Pathian inn kongkhak ngaktu hih leng ka utzaw ahi.
english: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

paite: TOUPA Pathian i ni leh phaw ahi, TOUPA'N hehpihna leh thupina ape ding a; diktak a omte lak ah thil hoih a-it kei ding hi.
english: For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA aw, nangmah muangmi in nuam asa hi.
english: Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.

paite: TOUPA, na gam tung ah na kipak a; sal a om Jakob na pikik nawnta hi.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Yahweh, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.

paite: Na mite thulimlouhnate na ngaidam a, agitlouhna tengteng uh na khuh khinta hi. Selah
english: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.

paite: Na thangpaihna tengteng na lamang a; na hehna thupitak na kiheisanta hi.
english: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.

paite: Hon hondampa Pathian aw, hon kiheisak nawn inla, ka tung ua na hehna tawpsak in.
english: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.

paite: Ka tung uah na heh nilouh dia hia? Na hehna suan tengteng tan in na kitheisak zel dia hia?
english: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?

paite: Nangmah a na mite akipahtheihna ding un na hon hihhalh nawn kei dia hia?
english: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

paite: TOUPA aw, na zahngaihna hon musak inla, na hotdamna leng hon pia in.
english: Show us your loving kindness, Yahweh. Grant us your salvation.

paite: TOUPA Pathian thu gen ding ka ngaikhe ding; amite leh amisiangthoute kiang ah khamuanna thu agen dek a, himahleh amau haina lam ah kihei nawnta kei uhen.
english: I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.

paite: Ahotdamna amah kihtate naih in a-om ngeingei nak hi; i gam ua thupina a-omtheihna ding in.
english: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.

paite: Zahngaihna leh thutak akituak a; diktatna leh kituahna akitawptuah a,
english: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

paite: Thutak lei a kipan in adawnkhia a; diktatna in van a pan ahon tansukta hi.
english: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.

paite: Ahi, TOUPA'N thil hoih ape ding a; i gam in leng athilpou ape ding hi.
english: Yes, Yahweh will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.

paite: Diktatna in ama akai ding a; akhapte lampi ah asiam ding hi.
english: Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps.

paite: TOUPA aw, kei lam ah na bil hon doh inla, hon dawng in; genthei leh tagah lua ka hi.
english: A Prayer by David. Hear, Yahweh, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

paite: Ka hinna vomhoih inla; Pathian limsakmi ka hi ngal a, ka Pathian aw, nangmah muang na sikha, hondam in.
english: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.

paite: TOUPA aw, hon hehpih inla; nitum in ka hon sam ngal a.
english: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.

paite: Na sikha hinna hihnuam in; TOUPA aw, ka lungsim na kiang ah ka koihdet ziak in.
english: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

paite: TOUPA, nang, na hoih a, ngaihdam na ngap a, ahon sam peuhmah tung ah zahngaihna na hau ngal hi.
english: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka thumna ah na bil na doh in; hehpih ka hon ngetna aw ngaikhia in.
english: Hear, Yahweh, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.

paite: Ka mangbat ni in ka hon sam ding a, huchi in na hon dawng ding hi.
english: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.

paite: TOUPA aw, pathiante lak ah nang bang himhim a-om kei ua; na thilhih bang thilhih a-om kei hi.
english: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.

paite: TOUPA aw, na siam nam chihte ahong pai ding ua, na ma ah akun ding ua, na min ahon pahtawi ding uhi.
english: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.

paite: Nang na thupi ngala, thillamdangte leng na hih zel a; nangmah kia Pathian na hi.
english: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.

paite: TOUPA aw, na lampi hon ensak inla, na thutak ah ka om ding a, na min lau ding in lungtang khat hon pusak in.
english: Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian aw, ka lungtang tengteng in ka hon phat ding a; na min tangtawn in ka pahtawi ding hi.
english: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.

paite: Ka tung a na zahngaihna athupi ziak in, ka hinna kokhuk nuainungpen a kipan na humbitta hi.
english: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

paite: Pathian aw, mikisatheite'n hon sual ua, mingongtat omkhawmte'n ka hinna hihmang tum in azong ua, nang ama uah ahon koih kei uhi.
english: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA aw, nang Pathian, lainatna a dim, mihehpih thei, lungnel, zahngaihna leh thutak hau na hi.
english: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

paite: Kei lam hong nga inla, aw, ka tung ah zahngai in, na sikha kiang ah na hatna pia inla, na sikhanu tapa hondam in.
english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.

paite: Hoihna ding chiamtehna hon lak in; hon hote'n huai amuh ua, azahlakna ding un, TOUPA, nang na hon panpih a, na hon khamuan ziak in.
english: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, Yahweh, have helped me, and comforted me.

paite: Asuangphum tang siangthou ah a-om hi.
english: A Psalm by the sons of Korah; a Song. His foundation is in the holy mountains.

paite: TOUPA'N Zion kulh kongkhakte Jakob omna tengteng sang in a-itzaw ahi.
english: Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

paite: Pathian khopi aw, na tungthu thupitak in agen uhi. Selah
english: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.

paite: Hon theite lak ah apang sam uh chih Rahab leh Babulon tungtang thu ka gen ding; Philistia leh Tura, Ethiopia toh, "En un, hiai mi huai lai a piang ahi," achi ua.
english: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”

paite: Zion tungtang thu gen ahih chiang in, "Hiai mi leh huai mi amah a piang ahi; Tungnungpen ngei in amah ahihkip ding," chi a gen ahi dia;
english: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.

paite: TOUPA'N, mite' min gelh a akhumlut chiang in, "Hiai mi huai a piang ahi," achi ding a, Selah
english: Yahweh will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.

paite: Lasate leh lamte'n, "Ka tuikhuk teng nangmah ah ahi a-om," achi ding uhi.
english: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”

paite: TOUPA aw, hon humbitpa Pathian, sun leh zan in na ma ah ka kikou gige a;
english: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Suffering of Affliction.” A contemplation by Heman, the Ezrahite. Yahweh, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.

paite: Ka thumna na ma ah lut henla; ka kikou husa ah na bil hon doh in.
english: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.

paite: Ka hinna mangbatnate in adim a, ka hinna in Sheol anaihta ngal a.
english: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.

paite: Kokhuk a paite toh simkhawm ka hi; hatna himhim neiloumi bang ka hi a;
english: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,

paite: Gal thahte han a lumte bang a misi lak a paihkhiak ka hi; huaite na theih tak louh, na khut a kipan hihman ahi uhi.
english: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.

paite: Kokhuk nuainungpen ah na hon lumsak a, mun mial, thupi ah.
english: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

paite: Na hehna in hon delhkhum a, nang na tuikihot tengteng in gim na hon thuaksakta hi. Selah
english: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.

paite: Ka meltheihte hon gamlat in na omsak a; amaute a dia kihhuaipi in na hon bawlta a; khakkhum in ka om a, ka pawt thei kei hi.
english: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.

paite: Gimthuak ziak in ka mit aseta a; TOUPA aw, niteng in ka hon sam ahi, nang lam ah ka khutte ka zak hi.
english: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, Yahweh. I have spread out my hands to you.

paite: Misite a ding in thillamdang na hih dek a hia? Sisate'n thou in ahon phat ding ua hia? Selah
english: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.

paite: Na chitdan hankhuk a puangzak in, hiam ahihkeileh na ginomdan Abaddon mun ah puanzak in a-om dia hia?
english: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?

paite: Na thillamdang hihte mial ah theih in a-om dia hia? Na diktatna gam ah theih in a-om dek nawn a hia?
english: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

paite: TOUPA aw, ke'n zaw ka hon sam a, ka thumna in zingsang in ahon don hi.
english: But to you, Yahweh, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.

paite: TOUPA, bang achia ka hinna khahkhia na hia? Bang achia ka lak a na mai sel?
english: Yahweh, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?

paite: Ka naupan chil a kipan gimthuak leh si dekdek in ka om a; na thil mulkimhuaite ka thuak in hihlungbuai in ka om hi.
english: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.

paite: Na heh mahmahna in hon vukmang a; thil mulkimhuaite'n hon hihmangta hi.
english: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.

paite: Huaite'n nitum in tui bang in hon umsuak ua; ka kim ka vel in hon um chiat uhi.
english: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.

paite: Hon itpa leh ka lawm hon gamlat in a-omsakta a, ka meltheihnate mial ah na omsakta ahi.
english: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.

paite: "TOUPA zahngaihna thute tangtawn in la in ka sa ding a; ka kam in na ginomdan suan tengteng tan in ka theisak ding.
english: A contemplation by Ethan, the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.

paite: Zahngaihna tangtawn a ding in leptouh in a-om ding a; na ginomna vante ah ngei na hihkip ding, ka chita ahi.
english: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”

paite: Ka mitel kiang ah thu ka khung a, ka sikha David kiang ah ka kichiamta a;
english: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,

paite: na suante tangtawn a ding in ka hihkip ding a, na laltutphah leng suan tengteng tan in ka lem ding, chi in. Selah
english: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.

paite: "TOUPA aw, vante'n na thillamdang hihte aphat ding ua; misiangthoute kikhopna ah na ginomna leng aphat ding uhi.
english: The heavens will praise your wonders, Yahweh, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

paite: Tung vandumte ah TOUPA toh kiteh thei ding kua a-om a? Mihattak tate lak ah TOUPA bang.
english: For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,

paite: Misiangthoute omkhawmna ah Pathian kihtakhuaitak, akim a mi tengteng sang a kihtakpen ding kua ahia?
english: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?

paite: "TOUPA sepaihte' Pathian aw, nang bang a mihat kua a-om a? Na ginomna na kim ah a-om ngal a.
english: Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.

paite: Nang tuipi kisaktheihna vai na hawm a, atuikihot kiseplaite uh na hihdai hi.
english: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.

paite: Nang Rahab gal thah bang in na hihkham dimdem a; nangmah galte na ban thahat in na delhzakta hi.
english: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.

paite: Vante nangmah a ahi a, leitung leng nangmah a ahi; khovel leh asung a om teng nangmah muhkhiak ahi.
english: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.

paite: Sim leh mal nangmah siam ahi a; Tabor leh Hermon na min ziak in anuam hi.
english: You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.

paite: Nang ban thilhihtheitak na nei a; na khut ahat a, na khut taklam pahtawi in a-om hi.
english: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.

paite: "Diktatna leh vaihawmna dik na laltutphah kingakna ahi a; na ma ah zahngaihna leh thutak apai hi.
english: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.

paite: "Husa kipahhuai za namte'n nuam asa ua; TOUPA aw, amau na mel vak ah avak uhi.
english: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, Yahweh.

paite: Na min ziak in nitum in anuam ua, diktatna ziak in pahtawi in a-om uhi.
english: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.

paite: Nang ahatna uh thupina na hi ngal a; na deihsakna ziak in ka kii uh pahtawi in a-om ding.
english: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.

paite: Ka phaw uh TOUPA a ahi ngal a; ka kumpipa uh Israelte Mi Siangthou ahi.
english: For our shield belongs to Yahweh, our king to the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Huai lai in na misiangthoute kiang ah kilakna in thu na gen a, mihattak khat tung ah panpihna ka nga a; mi khat mite lak a telkhiak ka pahtawita hi, chi in.
english: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.

paite: Ka sikha David ka mukheta a; ka thau siangthou in amah ka nilhta a.
english: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,

paite: Akiang ah ka khut hihkip in a-om ding a; ka ban in amah ahihhat ding a, ahihhat taktak ding hi.
english: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.

paite: "Melma in alak ah aphut kei ding; thulimlouhna tapa in ahihgim kei ding.
english: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.

paite: Amah galte ama ah ka satpuk ding a, amah hote ka bawl ek ding.
english: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.

paite: Amah kiang ah bel ka ginomna leh ka zahngaihna a-om ding hi; ka min ziak in akii pahtawi in a-om ding hi.
english: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.

paite: Tuipi ah akhut ka ngasak ding a, luipite ah akhut taklam.
english: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.

paite: Ama'n, 'Nang ka Pa, ka Pathian, ka hotdamna suangpi na hi,' chi in ahon sam ding hi.
english: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’

paite: Huan ke'n amah tapa masa in ka siam ding a, lei a kumpipate lak ah tungnungpen in ka bawl ding hi.
english: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

paite: Ka zahngaihna tangtawn in amah a ding in ka kephoihsak ding a, ka thukhun akiang ah a- omkip ding hi.
english: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.

paite: Asuante tangtawn in ka omsak ding a, alaltutphah van om lai siah in ka omsak ding hi.
english: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

paite: "Atate'n ka dan alehngatsan ua, ka vaihawmnate bang a a-om louh ua;
english: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;

paite: ka dan thuseh a tatlekna aneih ua, ka thupiakte akephoih kei uleh;
english: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;

paite: atatlek chiang un ka gawt dia, athulimlouhnate uh zep in ka hong kan ding.
english: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

paite: Himahleh, ka zahngaihna tu in akiang a kipan ka laksak vek kei ding a, ka ginomna zuau a suak ding in leng ka phal sam kei ding.
english: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.

paite: Ka thukhun ka hihse kei ding a, ka muk a thupawt leng ka hihlamdang sam kei ding hi.
english: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.

paite: "Khatvei ka sianthouna lou in ka kichiam a, David kiang ah zuau ka gen kei ding;
english: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.

paite: Asuante tangtawn in a-om ding ua, alaltutphah ka ma ah ni bang in a-om ding hi.
english: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.

paite: Kha bang in tangtawn a ding in hihkip in a-om ding a, van dum a theihpih ginom bang in, achi a. Selah
english: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.

paite: "Himahleh nang na khahkhia in na deih kei a, na thaunilhpa tung ah na hehta ahi.
english: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.

paite: Na sikha thukhun na deih kei a; alallukhu lei a paikhe hial in na hihniamta hi.
english: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.

paite: Ahuang tengteng na hihpuk a; akulhpite na hihseta hi.
english: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.

paite: Lampi a pai peuhmah in athil alaksak zel uh.
english: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.

paite: Amah doute khut taklam na pahtawi a; amelma tengteng na hih nuamsata hi.
english: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.

paite: Ahi, anamsau ma na bengpek a, amah kisualna ah na dingkipsak kei hi.
english: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.

paite: Avakna na hihtawpsak a, alaltutphah lei ah na paikheta hi.
english: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.

paite: Atangval lai nite uh na hihtom a; amah zahlakna in na khuhta hi. Selah
english: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.

paite: "TOUPA aw, bang tan ahia na buk nilouh ding? Bang tan ahia na hehna mei bang a akuan ding?
english: How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?

paite: Aw, ka hun atomdan theigige inla; mihing tate siam gina kei na tel chia!
english: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!

paite: Kua mi ahia sih ni mel mu lou a hing a, Sheol khut a kipan a ahinna humbit ding? Selah
english: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.

paite: "TOUPA, nidanglai a na hehpihna, na ginomna David kiang a kichiam a na chiam, koi a om hita ahia?
english: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?

paite: TOUPA, na sikhate agensiatna uh theigige in; nam hattakte tengteng gensiatna ka angsung a ka thuak zeldan.
english: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,

paite: TOUPA aw, nang hon doute gensiatna, na thaunilhpa khapte gensiatna mah,
english: With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.

paite: TOUPA tangtawn in phat in om hen. Amen, Amen."
english: Blessed be Yahweh forever more. Amen, and Amen.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah ka lungtang tengteng in kipahthu ka gen ding a; na thillamdang hih tengteng ka theisak ding hi.
english: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm by David. I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.

paite: Nangmah ah ka kipak in ka nuam ding a; Tungnungpen aw, na min phat in la ka sa ding hi.
english: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

paite: Hon doute ataizaktak un, na ma ah akipalpuk ua, amangthang uhi.
english: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.

paite: Kei a dia kilawm himahleh ka thu ah nang kei na hon gum ngal a; diktak a vaihawm in laltutphah ah na tu a.
english: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.

paite: Namte na thuhilh a, gilou- saloute na hihmangthang a, amin uh leng tangtawn tangtawn in na thaimangta hi.
english: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.

paite: Dou mite amangbang vek ua, tangtawn a ding in bangmah nei lou in a-omta uhi; na kho sukgamsate amaute theihgigena nangawn toh amangthang hi.
english: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.

paite: TOUPA tangtawn in kumpipa in atu dia; alaltutphah vaihawmna in abawlta hi.
english: But Yahweh reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.

paite: Ama'n khovel kizentak in vai ahawmsak ding a, khentuam nei lou in michih vai ahawm ding hi.
english: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

paite: Nuaisiahte a ding in TOUPA bukna ahi ding, buai hun chiang a bukna.
english: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.

paite: Huchi in na min theite'n ahon muang ding ua; nang zaw TOUPA, nangmah hon zongte na paisan ngei ngal kei hi.
english: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.

paite: TOUPA, Zion a om phat in la sa unla; mite lak ah athilhihte hilh un.
english: Sing praises to Yahweh, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.

paite: Sisan suah thu dongtel zelpa'n amau lah atheigige ngal a; migenthei kikou aw amangngilh ngei kei hi.
english: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.

paite: TOUPA aw, hon hehpih inla; sihna kongkhak a pan hon kaikhepa, hon hote ziak a ka mangbatna en in.
english: Have mercy on me, Yahweh. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,

paite: Nangmah phatna tengteng ka theihsak theihna ding in; Zion tanu kongpi ah, na hon hotdamna ah ka nuam ding hi.
english: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.

paite: Namte akokhuk bawl uah atum ua; aguk a alen zak uah amau khe mah a-awkta hi.
english: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.

paite: TOUPA akihilta a, vai ahawmta a; migilou-salou amah khutsuak mah ah a- awk hi. Higgaion. Selah
english: Yahweh has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.

paite: Migilou-saloute Sheol ah akik nawn ding uh. Nam chih Pathian mangngilh hatte tengteng toh.
english: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.

paite: Tagahte mangngilh in a-om nilouh kei ding ua, gentheite lametna tangtawn in amang sam kei ding hi.
english: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

paite: TOUPA aw, thou dih ve; mihing peuhmah vualzou kei hen; na mitmuh ah vai hawmsak in namte om uhen.
english: Arise, Yahweh! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.

paite: TOUPA aw, amau lausak in; namte'n mihing lel ahi uh chih kithei uhen. Selah
english: Put them in fear, Yahweh. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.

paite: TOUPA, suan tengteng tan a ka tenna uh nangmah na hi a,
english: A Prayer by Moses, the man of God. Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.

paite: Tangte pian ma a, leitung leh khovel na bawlkhiak ma in leng; tangtawn a kipan tangtawn Pathian, nangmah na hi.
english: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

paite: Nang mihingte manthatna ah na kiksak a; mihing tate aw, kikta un, na chi zel hi.
english: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”

paite: Nang seh in kum sangkhat zan mangta bang phet ahi a, zanven khat sung bang phet ahi.
english: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.

paite: Amaute tui lian bang in na taimang a; khang khat ihmu bang phet ahi ua, zingsang a loupa dawnkhia bang ahi uhi.
english: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.

paite: Zingsang in ahong pou in ahong dawnkhia a; nitaklam in phuk in a-om a, avuai hi.
english: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.

paite: Na hehna a hihman in ka om ua, na thangpaihna a hihmangbat a leng ka om ziak un.
english: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.

paite: Ka thulimlouhnate uh na ma ah na koih a, ka khelhna gukte uh na mel vak ah na koihta hi.
english: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

paite: Ka damsung ni tengteng uh na hehna ah amang zel a; ka damsung kumte uh tangthu bang in ka tawpsak uhi.
english: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

paite: Ka damsung kumte uh kum sawmsagih ahi a, hatna ziak in kum sawmgiat leng ahi thei hi; himahleh asawtna zaw sepgimna leh lungngaihna lel ahi a; amang pah a, kou leng ka lengmang zel uhi.
english: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.

paite: Kua'n ahia na hehna thilhihtheihdan thei a, nangmah kihtakdan ding a na hehna thei lou?
english: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?

paite: Ka damsung nite uh simdan hon hilh in, huchi a pilna lungtang ka neihloh hialna ding un.
english: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

paite: TOUPA aw, hong kik nawn in; bang tan ahia na heh ding? Na sikhate tungthu ah na lungsim kiheisak in.
english: Relent, Yahweh! How long? Have compassion on your servants!

paite: Aw, zingsang in na zahngaihna in hon taisak in; ka damsung tengteng ua ka nuam ua ka kipahtheihna ding un.
english: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

paite: Nang na hon hihgim ni leh, thil hoih lou ka tuah kum sung hute bang un hon kipaksak in.
english: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

paite: Nna nasep na sikhate kiang ah kithei henla, na thupina atate kiang uah kithei hen.
english: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian uh kilawmna ka tung uah om hen, ka khut nasep uh ka tung uah leng hihkip in; ahi, ka khut nasep uh hihkip in.
english: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.

paite: Tungnungpen bukna mun a ommi Bangkim hihthei limnuai ah ateng ding hi.
english: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

paite: TOUPA tungthu ah, amah ka kihumbitna leh ka kulhpi; ka Pathian, ka muan ahi, ka chi ding.
english: I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”

paite: Ama'n thangkammi thang leh hipi hoih lou lak ah nang ahon hondam ding hi.
english: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.

paite: Akha in ahon khuh ding a, akha nuai ah na muang ding hi; athutak phaw neu leh phaw lian ahi.
english: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.

paite: Zan a thil mulkimhuai na lau kei ding a, sun a thal leng zong na lau kei ding hi.
english: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,

paite: Mial nuai a hii leng na lau kei ding a, sun a thilhihsia siatna na lau kei ding hi.
english: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.

paite: Na sik ah sang apuk ding ua, na taklam ah sing apuk ding uh; himahleh nang ahon naih kei ding hi.
english: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.

paite: Na mit in na en ding a, migilou-saloute siatna amuh in na mu lel ding hi.
english: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang ka kihumbitna na hi a! Tungnungpen na omna ahi;
english: Because you have made Yahweh your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,

paite: Thil hoih lou in ahon tuak kei ding a, hii himhim in leng na puanin ahon naih sam kei ding hi.
english: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.

paite: Na lampi teng a hon humbit ding in, na tungthu ah zaw a-angelte thu pe ding ahi ngal a.
english: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.

paite: Akhut un hon dom ding ua, huchi lou in zaw na khe in suang na sui khakha ding hi.
english: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.

paite: Humpinelkai leh gulgial na sikden ding a; humpinelkai hat lai leh dragon na sikden ding hi.
english: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.

paite: Ka tung a a-itna angak ziak in amah ka humbit ding a; ka min atheih ziak in mun sang ah ka khatou ding hi.
english: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.

paite: Ama'n hon sam ding a, ka dawng ding hi; mangbat lai in akiang ah ka om ding hi, amah ka humbit in ka pahtawi ding hi.
english: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.

paite: Damsawtna in ka lungkimsak ding a, ka hotdamna leng ka musak ding hi.
english: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”

paite: TOUPA kiang a kipahthu gen leh Tungnungpen aw, na min phat a lasak thil hoih ahi.
english: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High,

paite: Zingsang a na zahngaihna hihlat leh, zan teng a na ginomna hihlat,
english: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,

paite: thil tumtheih gui sawm neite, pekgingte, kaihging tum khasiathuaite toh, ahoih hi.
english: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.

paite: TOUPA, nang nna na sep in na hon kipaksak a, na khut thilhihte ziak in nuam in la ka sa ding hi.
english: For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.

paite: TOUPA aw, na thilhihte thupi hi na tel e! Na ngaihtuahnate thuk hi na lawmlawm e!
english: How great are your works, Yahweh! Your thoughts are very deep.

paite: Mimawl in hiai athei kei hi; mihai in atheisiam sam kei hi.
english: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:

paite: Migilou-saloute loupa bang a ahong nou ua, thil hihkhialte tengteng a hong phat letlot un, tangtawn a ding ahihman a hong om ding uh ahi, chih.
english: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang zaw tangtawn a ding a sangpi a om gige na hi.
english: But you, Yahweh, are on high forever more.

paite: TOUPA aw, ngai dih, nang hon doute, ngai dih, nang hon doute amangthang dek uhi; thil hihkhial tengteng hihzak in a-om vek ding uhi.
english: For behold, your enemies, Yahweh, for behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.

paite: Himahleh gam bawngtal kii bang in ka kii na pahtawi a; sathau thak ka nilhta hi.
english: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.

paite: Ka mit in leng ka galte tung a ka thudeih amu dia, ka bil in kei hon dou gilou- saloute tung a ka thudeih aza ding.
english: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.

paite: Midiktat tum sing bang in akhanpha ding a; Lebanon tang a sidar sing bang in akhang huthut ding hi.
english: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

paite: TOUPA' inn a suan a omte i Pathian huangsung intual ah akhanpha ding uhi.
english: They are planted in Yahweh’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.

paite: Upat nung in leng agah lailai ding ua; tuipai kiihkeih in ahing dipdip ding uhi.
english: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,

paite: TOUPA diktat ahi chih theihsakna ding in; amah ka suangpi ahi a, amah ah diktatlouhna himhim a-om kei hi.
english: to show that Yahweh is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

paite: Kumpipa in TOUPA atu a, athupina in akithuam a; TOUPA ahatna a kithuam in atai ah akigakta hi; khovel leng alin theihlouhna ding in, hihkip in a-om hi.
english: Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.

paite: Na laltutphah nidanglai a na hihkipsa ahi a, nang tangtawn a omsa na hi.
english: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.

paite: TOUPA aw, luipite'n a-aw uh asuah ua, luipite'n aging thupitak uh asuah uhi.
english: The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.

paite: Tui tampi awte sang in, tuipi kihot hattakte sang in leng, tunglam a TOUPA ahatzaw hi.
english: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.

paite: Na thu theihsakte amuanhuai mahmah a; TOUPA aw, tangtawn in na inn sianthouna toh akilawm hi.
english: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, Yahweh, forever more.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang phulakna thunei Pathian, nang phulakna thunei, Pathian, vakkhia in.
english: Yahweh, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.

paite: Nang lei a vaihawmpa, kisa inla; kisatheite agitlouh man uh thuk in.
english: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.

paite: TOUPA, migilou-saloute bang tan ahia, bang tan ahia avualzoh ding uh?
english: Yahweh, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?

paite: Amaute amawk pau ua, kisatheitak in thu agen ua; thil hihkhialte tengteng akiphat tawm uhi.
english: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.

paite: TOUPA aw, na mite akeknensak ua, na gouluah ahihgim uhi.
english: They break your people in pieces, Yahweh, and afflict your heritage.

paite: Meithai leh mikhual athat ua, pa nei lou athat uhi.
english: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.

paite: TOUPA'N amu kei ding, Jakob' Pathian in angaihtuah sam kei ding, achi uhi.
english: They say, “Yah will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”

paite: Mi lak a mimawlte aw, ngaihtuah un; mihaite aw, chikchiang in na pil ding ua?
english: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?

paite: Bil phutpa'n aza kei dia hia? Mitsiampa'n amu kei dia hia?
english: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?

paite: Namte thuzohpa'n na taihilh kei dia hia, mihing pilna hilhpa'n?
english: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.

paite: TOUPA'N mihing ngaihtuahnate bangmah lou phet ahi chih athei hi.
english: Yahweh knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

paite: TOUPA aw, mi na thuzoh a, na dan thu a pan sin mite ahampha uhi.
english: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law,

paite: Migilou a dia kokhuk toh a a-om masiah, mangbat nite a pan khawlna na piakna ding in.
english: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.

paite: TOUPA'N amite apaikhe dek kei a, agoutan apaisan sam kei ding hi.
english: For Yahweh won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

paite: Vaihawmna diktatna ah akik nawn dia, lungtang diktak pu tengteng in huai azui ding uhi.
english: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.

paite: Kua ahia thil hoih lou hihte hon dousak ding a kisa ding? Thil hihkhialte hon dousak ding in kua adingh dia?
english: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?

paite: TOUPA hon panpihpa hi keileh, ka hinna mundai ah a-om pah ding hi.
english: Unless Yahweh had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.

paite: Ka khe ateu a, ka chih in, aw TOUPA, na zahngaihna in ahon kai hi.
english: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.

paite: Ka lungsim angaihtuah tampi ka neih lai in, na khamuannate'n ka hinna аhihnuam zel hi.
english: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

paite: Gitlouh satlouhna laltutphah, dan a thilhihkhelhna omsak in, nang hon kithuahpih dia hia?
english: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?

paite: Midiktat hinna sual tum in apungkhawm ua, sisan gensiatbei siam louh atangsak nak uhi.
english: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA ka insang ahi a; ka Pathian ka kihumbitna suangpi ahi.
english: But Yahweh has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.

paite: Akhelhna uh atung uah akesak a, ahoihlouhna ah ahihmangthang ding a; TOUPA i Pathian in ahihmang ding hi.
english: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. Yahweh, our God, will cut them off.

paite: Aw hong pai TOUPA pahtawi in nuamsatak in la i sa ding uh; i hotdamna suangpi pahtawi in nuamsatak in i kikou ding uhi.
english: Oh come, let’s sing to Yahweh. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!

paite: Kipahthu gen in ama ah pai ni e, phatna la sa a amah pahtawi in nuamsatak in aw i suah ding uhi.
english: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!

paite: TOUPA Pathian athupi mahmah ziak in, pathian tengteng tung ah Kumpipa thupitak ahi.
english: For Yahweh is a great God, a great King above all gods.

paite: Amah khut ah lei mun thuktakte a-om a, mual dawn sangtakte amah a mah ahi.
english: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.

paite: Tuipi amah a ahi a, ama bawl ahi a; gam leng akhutsuak ahi.
english: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.

paite: Aw hong pai unla, bia in kun ni e, TOUPA eite Hon siampa ma ah i khukdin ding uh.
english: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before Yahweh, our Maker,

paite: Amah i Pathian ahi a, eite agantatna mun a mite leh, akhut a belamte i hi ngal ua. Tuni in a-aw na zak uleh,
english: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!

paite: Meribah a ahih bang un na lungtang uh khauhsak kei un, Gamdai a Massah ni bang in.
english: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,

paite: Huai lai in na pipute un ahon khem ua, hon ze-et ua, ka thilhih amu uhi.
english: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.

paite: Kum sawmli sung huai suante tung ah ka lunghi kei hi. Alungtang ua ngaihkhelh hatmi ahi ua, ka lampite leng athei kei uhi, ka chi hi.
english: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “They are a people who err in their heart. They have not known my ways.”

paite: Huaiziak in ka khawlna ah alut kei ding uh, chi in heh in ka kichiam hi.
english: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”
