english: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”

paite: Gitlouh zoh in om ke'nla, hoihna in gilou zou zaw in.
english: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

paite: Michih atung ua vaihawm thuneite thuthu in om hen. Pathian thu lou in kuamah thunei a-om ngal kei ua; vaihawm thunei mite zaw Pathian seh ahi uh.
english: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.

paite: Huaiziak in kuapeuh vaihawmmi sel Pathian sehkalh ahi a, aselte'n amau tung ah vaihawmna akimuh ding uhi.
english: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.

paite: Vaihawmte thil hoih hihte ding in kihtakhuai ahi kei ua; thil hoih lou hihte a ding in bel kihtakhuai ahi uhi. Ahihleh vaihawmmi kihta lou a om na ut uhia? Thil hoih hih le uchin phat na loh ding uh.
english: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the authority,

paite: Amah tuh na hoihna ding ua Pathian nasemmi ahi ngal a. Himahleh kihta un, namsau lah amawk tawi ngal kei a; amah Pathian nasemmi, thil hihkhialmi tung a heh a phulami ahi.
english: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.

paite: Huaiziak in Pathian hehna kihtakna ziak kia hilou in, na sia-le-pha theihna ziak lel ua leng na kituklut ding uh ahi.
english: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.

paite: Hiai ziak in siah leng na liau zel ve ua le; huchibang thil ngei hih teitei ding in Pathian nasem mite ahi uhi.
english: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.

paite: Mi tengteng kiang ah piak ding peuhmah pia un; leiman piakna ding kiang ah leiman pia unla, siah liauna dingpa kiang ah siah liau unla; kihtak dingpa leng kihta unla; zahtak dingpa leng zahtak un.
english: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.

paite: Ki-ittuahna lou ngal kuamah bangmah ba kei un; amau mihinpih itpa'n dan azuikimta hi.
english: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

paite: Hiaite, "Ang kawm ke'n, Tualthat ke'n, Gu ke'n, Eng ke'n," chih leh thupiak dang om lai himhimte, "Nangmah na ki-it bang in na invengte na it ding ahi,” chih in akhaikhawm vek hi.
english: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

paite: Itna in a-invengte ahihse ngei kei a; huaiziak in itna zaw dan zuihkimna ahi.
english: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.

paite: Huai lou in, tu bang hun ahia chih na thei ua, ihmu khanloh a hun mahmahta chih na thei uhi. Tu'n zaw i gintak tung lai sang in i hotdamna anai zawta ngal a.
english: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.

paite: Zan abei dekdekta a, khua avak dekta hi; huaiziak in mial a thilhihte paikhia in vak thuam in i kithuam ding uh.
english: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.

paite: Sun a om bang in kilawmtak in i om ding uh, zu dawn buai leh zu kham a om lou in, huk leh kingaihhat a om lou in, kilai leh kihaza a om lou in.
english: Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.

paite: Toupa Jesu Khrist in kithuam zaw unla, na sa duhgawlna uh pichin ding in bangmah kibawl kei un.
english: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.

paite: Huan ginna hat lou mi, angaihdante gense lou in ngai un.
english: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

paite: Mi khat in thil bangkim ne thei ding in akigingta a, mihat lou in bel anteh-louhing kia ane hi.
english: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

paite: Ane mite'n nelou a kidekte simmoh kei henla; nelou a kidekte'n leng anete soisel tuan kei hen; Pathian in amah akipahpih khinta ngal a.
english: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

paite: Midang sikha tung a soiselpa nang kua na hia? Apu a ding in ahi adin hiam ahihkeileh apuk. Himahleh amah zaw dinsak in a-om ding, Toupa'n adingsak thei hi.
english: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

paite: Mi khat in ni khat nidang sang in athupi ngaih tuam a, midang in ni tengteng kibang chiat in angai. Michih amah lungsim ah kitheichian hen aw.
english: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

paite: Ni tangpa'n Toupa pahtawina ding in atang hi. Huan bangkim nepa'n, Pathian kiang a kipahthu agen ziak in, Toupa pahtawina ding in ane a; aneloupa'n leng Toupa pahtawina ding in ane kei a, Pathian kiang ah kipahthu agen hi.
english: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

paite: Kuamah eimah a dia hing i hi kei ua, kuamah eimah a dia si leng i hi sam kei.
english: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

paite: I hinleh Toupa a ding in i hing a; i sih in leng Toupa a dia si i hi ngal a; huaiziak in i hin in leng, i sih in leng Toupa a i hi uhi.
english: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

paite: Khrist sihna leh ahin nawnna pen, mihing leh misi Toupa ahihtheihna ding ahi.
english: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

paite: Himahleh nang bang achia na unau soisel na hia oi? Ahihkeileh nang bang achia na unau simmoh na hia oi? Pathian' thukhenna tutphah ma a dingh vek ding lah i hi ngal ua.
english: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

paite: "Toupa'n, kei ka hin bang in, mi tengteng ka ma ah akun ding ua, lei tengteng leng Pathian kiang ah akipulak ding uh chi in ka chiam ahi," achi, chih gelh ahi.
english: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”

paite: Huchi in i vek un Pathian kiang ah eimah tanchin i gen chiat ding uhi.
english: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

paite: Huaiziak in kisoisel nawn kei ni, kuapeuh in a-unau lampi ah kisuihna hiam dalna hiam koih louh tum zaw hen.
english: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.

paite: Amah mawngmawng a siang lou bangmah himhim a-om kei chih Toupa Jesu ah ka thei mahmah hi; thil khatpeuh siang lou a seh pen bel aseppa a ding in siang lou ahi mai hi.
english: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

paite: Na banghiam nek ziak a na unau lungsim anatleh itna dan in na gamta kei' a ahi. Asih sik a Khrist in asihsakpa na thil nek in hihmang kei hen.
english: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

paite: Huchi in nou a dia hoihna, gilou lam a gen in om kei hen.
english: Then don’t let your good be slandered,

paite: Pathian lalgam nek-le-dawn thu hilou in Kha Siangthou a diktatna, kituahna leh kipahna ahi zaw hi.
english: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

paite: Kuapeuh huai thu ah Khrist nasem Pathian kipahpih leh mihing phat in a-om hi.
english: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

paite: Huchi in kituahna ding leh kihihhat tuahna ding thilte i delh ding uh.
english: So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

paite: Na thil nek ziak in Pathian nasep hihse ke'n. Thil tengteng asiangthou ngei a, himahleh banghiam anek in mi ahihpukleh anepa a ding in gilou ahi.
english: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

paite: Na unau pukna ding ahihleh, sa neklouhte, uain dawnlouhte, thil bangpeuh hih louh ahoih ahi.
english: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

paite: Ginna na neih Pathian ma ah nangmah kia theih in nei mai in. Ama hoihsak lam a siam louh kitan lou tuh mihampha ahi.
english: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.

paite: Himahleh ginglelpa'n anekleh, ginna a anek louh ziak in, siam louh atang hi; bangpeuh ginna lou a hih zaw khelhna ahi.
english: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.

paite: Huchi in ei ahatte'n, eimah kipahna zong lou in, ahatlouhnate hatlouhna i thuakpih ding uh ahi.
english: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

paite: Eimah invengte chiat tunding leh ahoihna ding ua kipahsak i tum chiat ding uh.
english: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.

paite: Khrist in leng amah kipahna azong ngal kei a, "Nang hon taite taina ka tung ah atuta," chih gelh bang in ahi zaw.
english: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”

paite: Laisiangthou a kuhkalna leh khamuanna mu a lametna i neihtheihna ding un, nidanglai a gelh peuhmahte eite hon hilhna ding a gelh ahi uhi.
english: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

paite: Tu in kuhkalna leh khamuanna Pathian in, Khrist Jesu ah noute lungsim leh ngaihtuahna mun khat pu in hon omsak hen;
english: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus,

paite: Huchi a, lungsim mun khat leh kituaktak a Toupa Jesu Khrist Pa leh Pathian na pahtawi theihna ding uh ahi.
english: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Huaiziak in Khrist in Pathian thupina ding a noute ahon kipahpih mah bang in, khat-le-khat kipahpihtuah chiat un.
english: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.

paite: Tu in, pipute kiang a thuchiamte hihkipna ding in Khrist tuh Pathian thutakdan theihsakna ding in zeksumte nasempa ahong hita chih na kiang uah ka gen hi.
english: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,

paite: Azahngaihna ziak a Zentelte'n Pathian apahtawi theihna ding un, "Huaiziak in Zentelte lak ah ka hon phat ding a, na min pahtawina ding in la ka sa ding," chih gelh bang in.
english: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore I will give praise to you among the Gentiles and sing to your name.”

paite: "Huan nou Zentel tengtengte aw, amite toh kipak un," achi nawn hi.
english: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.”

paite: "Nou Zentel tengtengte aw, Toupa phat un, mi tengteng in amah phat uhen," achi nawn hi.
english: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.”

paite: Isai in: "Jesse zungzam ahong khang ding a, Zentelte tung a vaihawm dingpa ahong dingkhe ding hi; amah ah Zentelte'n alametna uh akoih ding uhi," achi lai hi.
english: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.”

paite: Kha Siangthou thilhihtheihna ziak a lametna na hauhtheihna ding un, lametna Pathian, na gintak ziak un, kipahna leh kituahna chiteng in hon hihdim hen.
english: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.

paite: Huan ka unaute aw, nou tungthu zaw noumau mah hoihna in na dim ua, na kihanthawntuah thei uh chih keimah ngei in leng diktak in ka thei hi.
english: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.

paite: Himahleh Pathian in ahon piak hehpihna ziak in nou hon theihpih ding in koi kalkal hiam ah hangsantak in ka gelh hi.
english: But I write the more boldly to you in part as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,

paite: Zentelte kiang a Khrist Jesu nasempa a ka omtheihna ding in, Zentelte Kha Siangthou a hihsiangthou ahih ua, pomtak ahihtheihna ding un Pathian tanchinhoih lam ah siampu nna ka sem ahi.
english: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

paite: Huchi in Pathian nna ka sep lam thu ah Khrist Jesu ah kisaktheihna ding ka nei ahi.
english: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.

paite: Khrist in Zentelte thumangsak ding a ka thugen leh nasepnate zang a asepkhiakte lou ngal bangmah ka gen ngam ngal kei a,
english: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,

paite: chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte, thilhihtheihna ah, Kha Siangthou thilhihtheihna in Jerusalem khua leh akim gam a kipan in, Illirikum gam pha in, Khrist tanchinhoih gam chih ah ka hilh kimta; keimah hon zang a athilhih tuh huchi tel ahi.
english: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;

paite: Ahi, midang suangphum tung a lem ka hihlouhna ding in, tanchinhoih Khrist min loh khitna mun a gen lou in.
english: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.

paite: "Atanchin gen ngeilouhnate'n amu ding ua, za ngei nailoute'n aza ding uh," chih gelh bang in, gen ka tum zaw ahi.
english: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”

paite: Huaiziak in ahi, na kiang ua hong ka kikhelsak naknak.
english: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,

paite: Tu in bel hiai gam kim ah sepna mun himhim ka neita kei a, kum tampi na kiang ua hong ut in leng ka omta hi.
english: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,

paite: Spain gam a ka hoh chiang in ka pai kawm a nou hon muh ka kilamen ngal a, noumau toh kithuahkhawm phot in, maban ka paina ding ah noute'n na hon va khaksuk uh leng ka lamen ahi.
english: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.

paite: Tu in bel, misiangthoute nasem ding in Jerusalem ah ka hoh tadih ding hi.
english: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.

paite: Masidonia leh Akhaia gam a mite'n kipaktak in Jerusalem a misiangthoute lak a gentheite a ding in thilpiakte ape chiat uhi.
english: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.

paite: Hiai thilpiak in amau nakpi in akipaksak hi; amaute ding in leng bat ahi him hi; Zentelte'n Judate khalam vualzawlna akikoppih ualeh salam thil a amaute taksap awng ahuksak sam uh akilawm him ahi.
english: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in material things.

paite: Huaiziak in huai ka hih a, gah leng amaute diktak a ka muhsak nung in, noute hon tawn in, Spain gam ah ka pai zel ding hi.
english: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.

paite: Huan na kiang ua ka hong chiang in, Khrist tanchinhoih vualzawlna kim pu in ka hong ding chih ka thei hi.
english: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.

paite: Unaute aw, Pathian kiang a na hon thumsak na uah, hon thumpih teitei ding in Toupa Jesu Khrist leh Kha Siangthou itna in nget petmah in ka hon ngen ahi.
english: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

paite: Juda gam a gingloute lak a ka bit theihna ding leh Jerusalem a dia huhna ka tawi misiangthoute kipahna lamtak ahihtheihna ding in.
english: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,

paite: Pathian hoihsak bang a nuamtak a na kiang ua ka hong a, i halhkhawm vek theihna ding un.
english: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.

paite: Lemna Pathian na vek ua tung ah om hen. Amen.
english: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

paite: I sanggamnu, Phoebi, Kenkriai a saptuamte nasem,
english: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,

paite: Toupa min a misiangthoute bang a na na kipahpihna ding uleh, na huh uh akiphatmohna peuh a na na huh ding un hon kimeltheihsak ka ut ahi. Amah mah in leng mi tampi ana huh a, kei ngei leng ahon huh zel hi.
english: that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.

paite: Khrist Jesu a hon huhte Priscilla leh Akuila chibai hon buksak un,
english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

paite: ka hinna humbitna ding a amau ngawngtan ngapte; amau tung kia ah kipahthu ka gen kei a, Zentel saptuam tengteng tung ah leng ka gen sam hi.
english: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.

paite: A-inn ua saptuam kikhawmte leng chibai hon buksak un. Ka deihtak, Epanitas, Asia gam a Khrist gingta masapen, chibai hon buksak un aw.
english: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

paite: Noute a dia semgim Mari, chibai hon buksak un aw.
english: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

paite: Ka chipih leh ka hentakpih, Andronikas leh Junia, chibai hon buksak un; amau sawltakte lak a minthangtak ahi ua, kei sang a Khrist a om masazaw ahi uh.
english: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.

paite: Amplias, Toupa a ka deihtak, chibai hon buksak un aw.
english: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

paite: Khrist a i naseppih uh Urbanes leh ka deihtak Stakis chibai hon buksak un.
english: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

paite: Khrist a mitak, Apelles, chibai hon buksak un. Aristobulas, a-inkuanpihte lak a mite chibai hon buksak un.
english: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.

paite: Ka chipih, Herodion, chibai hon buksak un. Inkuanpihte lak a mi Narkissas, Toupa a om, chibai hon buksak un.
english: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

paite: Triphena leh Triphosa Toupa a semgimte, chibai hon buksak un aw. Deihtak Persis, Toupa a ana semgim mahmah, chibai hon na buksak un.
english: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

paite: Toupa amitel Rufus leh anu, kei nu leng hi sam, chibai hon na buksak un.
english: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

paite: Asinkritas, Phligon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes leh akiang ua unau omte, chibai hon na buksak un aw.
english: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.

paite: Philologas leh Julia, Nerias leh sanggamnu, Olimpas leh akiang ua misiangthou om tengteng, chibai hon na buksak un.
english: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

paite: Tawp siangthou in chibai kibuk un. Khrist saptuam pawl tengteng in chibai ahon buk chiat uhi.
english: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.

paite: Huan unaute aw, thuhilhna thu noumau hilh louh lam a kikhenna leh pukna omsakte a pan kiveng ding leh kiheisan ding in ka hon ngen ahi.
english: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.

paite: Huchibang mite'n i Toupa Khrist nna asem kei ua, amau gilpi nna asem zaw uhi; akamzolna uleh akamsiamna un mipilloute lungtang akhem nak uhi.
english: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.

paite: Na thumandan uh mi tengteng lak ah athangkheta ngal a. Huaiziak in noumau tungthu ah ka kipak hi; himahleh, hoih lam a na pil ua, gilou lam a na pil louh uh ka deih ahi.
english: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.

paite: Huan lemna Pathian in na khepek nuai uah Setan ahon sikdensak pah ding hi. I Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na kiang uah om hen.
english: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

paite: Ka naseppih Timothi leh ka chipih Lusias leh Jason, Sosipaterte'n chibai ahon buk uhi.
english: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.

paite: Kei Tertias, hiai laigelhtu in, Toupa min in chibai ka hon buk hi.
english: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.

paite: Ka tunnapa Gaias leh saptuam tengteng in chibai ahon buk uhi. Huai sumkempa Erastas leh unaupa Kuartas in chibai ahon buk uhi.
english: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na vek ua tung ah om hen. Amen.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.

paite: Huaiziak in mihing aw, miselhat kuapeuh himah lechin paulam himhim na nei kei hi. Midang na selna mah ah nangmah leh nangmah siam louh na kitan hi. Nang selhat in leng huchibang thilte na hih sam ngal hi.
english: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.

paite: Huchibang thilhih nakte tung ah Pathian' vaihawmna diktak in atung, chih i thei uhi.
english: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.

paite: Mihing aw, huchibang thilhih nakte gensia, nang leng huchibang na hih sam ngal nak a, Pathian' vaihawmna pelh na kigingta a hia?
english: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?

paite: Ahihkeileh Pathian hoihna kisikna a nang hon pi ding a om ahi chih thei lou in, ahoihna, athuaktheihna leh adohtheihna hauhnate na ngaineu a hia?
english: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?

paite: Himahleh na lungtang khauh leh kisik utlouhnate ziak in, na tung ah thangpaihna na kholkhawmte Pathian' vaihawmna diktat hong kilatna, thangpaihna ni chiang a ding a kholkhawm ahi zaw hi.
english: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God,

paite: Pathian in michih athilhih bang zel un ahawmsak ding;
english: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”

paite: Thil hoih hih teitei a, thupina leh pahtawina leh manthat theihlouhna zong mite kiang ah tangtawn hinna ape ding hi.
english: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;

paite: Himahleh genhakte, thutak zui lou a, gitlouhna zui zawte tung ah, hehna leh thangpaihna, haksatna leh lungkhamna thupitak a-om dia;
english: but to those who are self-seeking and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,

paite: mihing thil hihkhial tengteng kha tung ah a-om ding, Juda mi kha tung ah a-om masa ding a, huan, Grik mi kha tung ah a-om nawn ding hi.
english: oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

paite: Himahleh, thil hoih hih peuhmahte kiang ah thupina, pahtawina, khamuanna piak ahi ding, Juda mi kiang ah piak ahi masa ding a, huan, Grik mi kiang ah ahi nawn ding hi.
english: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

paite: Pathian in mi deihsak tuam anei ngal kei hi.
english: For there is no partiality with God.

paite: Kuapeuh dan nei lou a thil hihkhial, dan lou in amangthang ding hi; kuapeuh dan nei a thil hihkhial, dan bang in vaihawm in a-om ding.
english: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.

paite: Dan zami phette Pathian mitmuh in midik ahi kei ua; dan zuite midik ahi zaw ding uhi.
english: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified

paite: Dan nei lou Zentelte'n amau pianpih a dan thilte ahih un, amau dan nei kei mah le uh, amau leh amau dan in akinei tawm uhi.
english: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,

paite: Alungtang uah dan thilhih gelh ahi chih langsak ding in asia-le-pha theihna un atheihpih hi; alungsimte un leng theihpih ahih ziak in angaihtuahna un siam louh atangsak hiam siam atangsak zel hi.
english: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)

paite: Ka tanchinhoih gen bang in, Pathian vaihawm ni chiang in mihing thugukte, Jesu Khrist ah angaihtuah ding hi.
english: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.

paite: Himahleh nang Juda na kichi a, dan a kinga in Pathian na suang hi.
english: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,

paite: Adeihlam na thei a, thil hoihzawte hoih na sa a, dan a hilh in na om a,
english: know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,

paite: nangmah mittawte pipa, mial lak a omte vakna hi in na kigingta hi.
english: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,

paite: Dan ah pilna leh thutak omdan na theih ziak in, mipilloute hilhpilpa, naungekte hilhpa in na kigingta hi.
english: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.

paite: Huchibang na hih ngalleh nang midangte hilhpa, nangmah na kihilh kei a hia? Nang guta lou dia mite hilhpa, nang na gu nak maw?
english: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?

paite: Nang angkawm lou dia hilhpa, nang ang na kawm maw? Nang milim hopa, nang milim tempul a thilte na gu nak maw?
english: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?

paite: Nang dan suangpa, nang dan a na tatlek ziak in Pathian na hihminse zel ahi maw?
english: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?

paite: "Pathian min noumau ziak in Zentelte lak ah gensiat in a-omta hi," chi a kigelh bang in.
english: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” just as it is written.

paite: Dan zuipa na hihleh zeksum aphatuam ngíal hi; dan a talekpa na hihleh bel, na zeksum sum louh bang phet ahong hita hi.
english: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

paite: Huaiziak in zek sumloumi in dan thusehte azuihleh azeksum louh, sum bang a sim ahi kei dia hia?
english: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?

paite: Huan amau sa a zeksum louh in dan azuih kim uleh, nang dan thu gelh leh zeksum nei ngal a dan a talekpa ahon mohpaih kei ding ua hia?
english: Won’t those who are physically uncircumcised, but fulfill the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?

paite: Alang lel a Juda mi hih zaw Juda mi tak ahi kei a; alang a sa lel a zeksum zaw zeksum tak ahi tuan sam kei hi.
english: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;

paite: Himahleh alang lel hilou a, Juda mi zaw, Juda mi tak ahi; huan zeksum tak, lungsim a sum ahi, laigelh thu phet ah hilou in, kha ah ahi; huai mi'n mihing phat aloh kei a, Pathian phat aloh zaw ahi.
english: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.

paite: Ahihleh Juda mi'n hamphat tuamna bang ahia aneih tuan? Zeksum leng bang ahia aphattuamna?
english: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?

paite: Bang lam peuh ah aphatuam hi; Pathian thute akiang ua kepsak a a-om ziak ahi pen.
english: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.

paite: Mi khenkhatte'n ginna nei kei mah le uh, bang ahi tuan a eita? Agintaklouhna un Pathian muanhuaina bangmah lou in abawl tuan a hia?
english: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?

paite: Bawl tuan lou hial! Pathian midiktak hita hen, michih zuauthei hi uhen: "Nang na thugen in siam na tang thei a, vaihawm a na om in leng na zohtheihna ding in," chih gelh bang in.
english: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “that you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.”

paite: Himahleh i diktatlouhna in Pathian diktatna a hihlat semleh bang i gen dia? Pathian in mi agawt in, midiktat lou ahi hia? Mihing dan bang in ka gen ahi.
english: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.

paite: Hilou hial! Huchibang hitaleh, Pathian in khovel vai bangchi in ahawm dia?
english: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?

paite: Himahleh ka zuauthu gen ziak a Pathian thu dikdan amah hih thupi khop hial a alat sem ngalleh bang achia kei leng mikhial bang a siam louh tansak a om lai ka hia?
english: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?

paite: Bang achia, ahon hek ua, mi khenkhat in gen louhpi hon gensak bang un, "Thil hoih ahong tuntheihna ding in thil gilou i hih ding uh," chi a i gen zawk louh? Huchibang ching mite'n siam louh atan uh adik him ahi.
english: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let’s do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.

paite: Ahihleh amau sang in i hoihzaw khol ua hia? Hoihzaw lou hial. Judate leh Grikte khelhna sikha a om vek in tuma in leng i ngohta vele;
english: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin.

paite: "Kuamah midiktat himhim a-om kei uh, khat leng a-om kei uh;
english: As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.

paite: kuamah theisiam himhim a-om kei uh, kuamah Pathian zong himhim a-om kei uh.
english: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.

paite: Ahilou lam ah apial khinta ua, bangmah phatuam lou in a-om khinta ua, kuamah thil hoih hih himhim a-om kei uh, khat lel leng a-om kei uh,"
english: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”

paite: Agawl uh han kihong ahi a; alei un khemna thu agen uhi. Akamsung uah gulgu a-om hi.
english: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”

paite: Akam uh hamse lohna leh thukha in adim hi.
english: “Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”

paite: Akhete uh sisan suah ding in akinsuan uhi;
english: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.

paite: Alampite uah manthatna leh gimthuakna a-om a;
english: Destruction and misery are in their ways.

paite: khamuanna lampi athei kei ua,
english: The way of peace, they haven’t known.”

paite: amit uah Pathian launa a-om kei, chih gelh bang in.
english: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”

paite: Dan in bangpeuh agen a, dan thuthu a omte kiang a agen ahi chih i thei uhi; kam chiteng adaihsak theihna ding in leh khovel a mi tengteng Pathian vaihawm a a-omtheihna ding un.
english: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.

paite: Huchi in "Dan thilhihte ziak in mi kuamah amitmuh in siamtang in a-om kei ding uhi," dan tawn in khelhna theihna ahong om hi.
english: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.

paite: Himahleh tu'n bel dan leh zawlneite na theihsak Pathian dikna dan tel lou in hihlat in a-omta hi.
english: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;

paite: Huai tuh Jesu Khrist gintak ziak a, agingtate tengteng a dia Pathian diktatna ahi. Lamdanna himhim a-om kei.
english: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,

paite: Mi tengteng in thil ahihkhelh ziak ua Pathian thupina atan zoh louh nung un,
english: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

paite: Khrist Jesu a om tatna ziak in, hehpihna a athawn a siamtansak in a-om uhi.
english: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,

paite: Amah tuh asisan ziak a thuphatawina hi in, ginna a muh ding in Pathian in aluikheta hi. Hiai tuh Pathian dikna latsakna ding ahi, ama'n adohtheihna ziak a nidanglai khelhnate apaikan tak ziak in.
english: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;

paite: Huan amah ngei adik a, chih leh Jesu a ginna neimi siam atangsak chih chetna ding in.
english: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.

paite: Na ki-otsakna uh koi a om ahia le? Posiah in a-omta. Bang dan in ahia le? Thilhihna dan in hia? Hilou hial, ginna dan in ahi zaw hi.
english: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.

paite: Huchi in dan thilhihte ziak hilou in, ginna in mihingte siamtansak in a-om chi in i sep uhi.
english: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

paite: Pathian, Judate Pathian kia ahi hia? Zentelte Pathian leng ahi sam kei a hia? Hi e, Zentelte Pathian leng ahi.
english: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,

paite: Pathian khat kia ahih ziak in; ama'n zeksumte aginna ziak un, zeksumlouhte aginna ziak un siam atangsak ding hi.
english: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.

paite: Huchi ahihleh hiai ginna ziak in dan bangmah lou a bawl i hi uhia? Bawl lou hial! Dan tuh i hihkip zaw uhi.
english: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.

paite: Ahihleh Abraham, sadan a i pu un, bang ahia amuh i gen ding?
english: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?

paite: Abraham in thilhih ziak a siam atan ngalleh suan ding anei ahi, Pathian ma ah zaw hi het lou in.
english: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.

paite: Laisiangthou in bang agen a? "Abraham in Pathian agingta a, huan huai ginna tuh adikna a seh ahi," chi in agen ahi.
english: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”

paite: Huan nasemmi loh tuh hehpihna a seh ahi kei a, bat a seh ahi zaw hi.
english: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.

paite: Himahleh nna sem lou a, Pathian limsak lou siamtangsakpa gingtazaw mi ginna, ama diktatna a seh ahi.
english: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.

paite: Mi athilhih ngaihtuah lou a, Pathian in diktat a aseh, avualzawlsak thu David in leng,
english: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works:

paite: "Atatleknate ngaihdam a om a, akhelhnate uh khuh a omte, ahampha uhi,
english: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

paite: Toupa'n khelhna nei a asehlouhte ahampha uhi," chi a agen bang in.
english: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”

paite: Ahihleh huai vualzawlna zeksumte kia tung ah hia a-om, zeksumloute tung ah leng? Abraham ginna adiktatna a seh ahi, i chi ngal ua.
english: Is this blessing then pronounced only on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.

paite: Huai bangchi seh ahia? Azeksum nung in hia, azeksum ma in? Azeksum nung in ahi kei a, azeksum ma in ahi zaw hi.
english: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

paite: Huchi in azeksum ma in ginna ziak in diktatna amu chih chiamtehna ding in zeksum thu amu hi. Huchi a amah tuh zeksum lou himahleh agingtate diktatna sehsak a omte tengteng pa ahihtheihna ding in.
english: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.

paite: Huchi mah bang a zeksumte phet hilou, i pa uh Abraham in zek asum ma a aneih ginna bang ginna khekhap zuite pa ahihtheihna ding ahi.
english: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.

paite: Abraham leh asuante kiang a khovel gouluah ding ahi ding uh chih thuchiam zaw dan a kinga ahi kei a, ginna ziak a diktatna a kinga ahi zaw hi.
english: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

paite: Dan nei mite gouluahte hi ding hi le uh bel, ginna bangmah in aphatuam kei a, thuchiam leng thuchiam ahita kei hi.
english: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.

paite: Dan in thangpaihna atun nak ngal a; himahleh dan omlouhna ah tatlekna leng a-om kei hi.
english: For the law produces wrath; for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.

paite: Huaiziak in thuchiam hehpihna a piak ahihtheihna ding in ginna a kinga ahi, asuante tengteng in thuchiam pel lou a aluahtheihna ding un. Dan nei mite kia in aluah kei ding ua, Abraham neih bang ginna neite'n leng aluah sam ding uhi; amah i vek ua pa ahi.
english: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.

paite: "Nam tampite pa in ka hon bawlta," chi a gelh ahih bang in, misite hihhingpa leh thil omloute om bang a genpa, agin Pathian mitmuh ah eite pa a bawl in a-om zaw hi.
english: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.

paite: Lamet tuak a a-om louh in leng ama'n zaw lamentak in agingta a, "Nam tampite pa ahong hihtheihna ding in; huchibang in na suante ahong hi ding uh," chi a hilh a a-om bang in.
english: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”

paite: Huan ginna kip lou tuan lou in, apumpi sisa bang a om tuh angaihtuah a, amah kum za vel mi ahi ngal a, Sarah chiing leng angaihtuah sam hi.
english: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.

paite: Pathian thuchiam ginglel lou in ginna tasam in a-om kei a, Pathian apahtawi hi.
english: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,

paite: Athuchiam alohchingsak thei chih agingta a, aginna ahong kip zawta hi.
english: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.

paite: Huaiziak in aginna tuh adiktatna a seh ahita hi.
english: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”

paite: Huchi in "amah ah sehsak in a-om," chih amah ziak kia a gelh ahi kei a,
english: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,

paite: eite ziak in leng ahi. Jesu i Toupa misi lak a kipan a kaithoupa gingta, eite a ding in sehsak ahi ding,
english: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,

paite: amah i tatlekna ziak a piakkhiak a om a, siam i tanna ding a kaihthoh a ompa ahi.
english: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.

paite: Huaiziak in ginna ziak a siamtansak a om in i Toupa Jesu Khrist pansan in Pathian toh kilem in i om uhi.
english: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

paite: Amah tawn mah in ginna in hiai hehpihna ah luttheihna i nei ua; huai a ding in Pathian thupina i tan ding lametna ah kipak in i om uhi.
english: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

paite: Huai kia leng hilou in, i gimthuakna ah leng kipak in i om uh, gimthuakna in thuakhatna atun hi.
english: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;

paite: Thuakhatna in hindan hoih atun a, hindan hoih in lametna atun chih thei in.
english: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;

paite: Huan lametna in ahon zahlaksak kei a, huai Kha Siangthou i kiang ua hon piak tawn a Pathian itna i lungtang ua sun a a-om tak ziak in.
english: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

paite: I hat louh lai in ahuntak in Pathian limsakloute sih sik in Khrist ahong sita hi.
english: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

paite: Midik sik a sih, mi a-ut ngel kei hial ding ua, mihoih sik in bel mi kuahiam bek in sih angap khamoh kei ding hi.
english: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.

paite: Himahleh Pathian in mikhialte i hih lai a Khrist i sik a asihna ah ahon itna alangsakta hi.
english: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

paite: Huchi in asisan a siamtansak a i om khit nung in, amah ziak in Pathian hehna a kipan hotdam in i om ngei ding uhi.
english: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.

paite: Melma i hih lai a bawn a Tapa sihna ziak a Pathian toh na kilemkik khin i hih ngal uleh, kilem a i om khit nung un ahinna ziak in hotdam in i om sem ding uhi.
english: For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.

paite: Huai kia leng ahi kei, kilepkikna tua hon musakpa i Toupa Jesu Khrist ziak in Pathian ah leng i kipak ahi.
english: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

paite: Huan mi khat ziak in khovel ah khelhna alut a, khelhna ziak in sihna alut a, huchi in mi tengteng akhelh tak ziak un sihna in mi tengteng azelsuakta hi.
english: Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned.

paite: Dan om ma in khovel ah khelhna a-om khin ngal a; dan a-om louh lai in khelhna tuh khelhna a sim ahi kei hi.
english: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.

paite: Himahleh Adam om a kipan Mosi om pha in Adam tatlekna bang a thil hihkhialloute tung ah leng sihna in vai ahawm zel hi. Adam tuh hong pai dingpa tehpihna ahi.
english: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.

paite: Himahleh thilthawnpiak zaw tatlekna toh akibang kei. Mi khat tatlekna ziak a mi tampi asih ualeh Pathian hehpihna leh mi khat, Jesu Khrist hehpihna thawnpiak akichingzaw sem a mi tampi tung ah vuh in a-om hi.
english: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.

paite: Huan thilthawnpiak zaw mi khat tatlekna gah toh leng akibang sam kei hi. Mi khat tatlekna tung a vaihawmna in siam louh tansakna atun a, mi tampi tatlekna tung a thilthawnpiak in bel siamtansakna atun hi.
english: The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification.

paite: Mi khat tatlekna ziak a sihna in huai mi khat mah pansan a vai ahawm leh hehpihna kiningching mahmah leh diktatna thawnpiak tangte'n mi khat, Jesu Khrist pansan in hinna ah vai ahawm zaw sem ding uhi.
english: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

paite: Huan mi khat tatlekna in mi tengteng a ding a siam louh tansakna atut mah bang in, mi khat diktatna thilhih in mi tengteng a ding in suahtakna leh hinna ahon tun hi.
english: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.

paite: Mi khat thumanlouhna ziak a mi tampi mikhial a bawl ahih bang un, mi khat thumanna ziak in mi tampi midiktat a bawl ahi ding uhi.
english: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.

paite: Khelhna latsak semna ding in Dan ahong om behlap a; himahleh khelhna akhanna peuh ah hehpihna akhangsem,
english: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly,

paite: huchi a khelhna in sihna a vai ahawm mah bang a, hehpihna in leng i Toupa Jesu Khrist pansan a diktatna ziak a tangtawn hinna dong a vai ahawmtheihna ding in.
english: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

paite: Bang i genta dia le? Hehpihna akhansem theihna ding in khelhna ah i om nilouh ding ua hia?
english: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

paite: Om nilouh lou hial ding! Eite khelhna lam a sisa, khelhna ah bangchi in i hing thei lailai dia?
english: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?

paite: Eite Khrist Jesu a baptis lut a om tengteng asihna ah baptis lut in i om chih na thei kei ua hia?
english: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

paite: Huaiziak in asihna a baptis lut a om in amah toh vuikhawm in i om uhi, huchi a Pa thupina in misi lak a kipan a Khrist akaihthoh tak bang a eite leng hinna thak a i khosak theihna ding in.
english: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

paite: Asihna kibatpih a amah toh i kizop khit ngalleh athohnawnna kibatpih in leng i kizom ngei ding uhi.
english: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;

paite: I mihing lui akiang ah kilhden in a-om samta chih i thei; huchi a khelhna pumpi hihmanthat a a-omtheihna ding leh tua kipan a khelhna sikha a i omlouhna ding in.
english: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.

paite: Kuapeuh sisa khelhna lak ah asuaktata hi.
english: For he who has died has been freed from sin.

paite: Huan Khrist toh i sih samleh akiang ah i hing sam ding chih i gingta uhi.
english: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,

paite: Misi lak a kipan Khrist kaihthoh in a-omta, asi nawn kei ding chih i thei ngal ua; sihna in amah tung ah thu aneita kei hi.
english: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!

paite: Asihna khelhna lam thu ah tangtawn a ding in khatvei kia asi a, ahinna bel Pathian lam thu ah ahing ahi.
english: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.

paite: Huchi mah bang in, nou leng khelhna lam thu ah sisa in kisep unla, Pathian lam thu ah bel Khrist Jesu ah hing in kisep un.
english: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

paite: Huaiziak in na pumpi uh duhgawlna thumang ding in na pumpi sithei uah khelhna vai hawmsak kei un.
english: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.

paite: Na pumpi hiangte uh leng diktatlouhna vanzat ding in khelhna kiang ah pe phal sam kei un; himahleh misi lak a kipan hing nawn bang in Pathian kiang ah kipia unla, na pumpi hiangte uh leng diktatna vanzat ding in Pathian kiang ah pe phal zaw un.
english: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.

paite: Noute dan thunuai a om hilou a, hehpihna nuai a om na hih ziak un khelhna in na tung uah thu anei nawn kei ding hi.
english: For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.

paite: Bangchi in ahita dia le? Dan thunuai a om i hi kei ua, hehpihna nuai a om i hih zawk ziak in i khial ding uh ahi diam? Hilou hial ding!
english: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it never be!

paite: Kua kiang peuh ah leng athu mang ding a asikha dia na kipiak un sihna khop a khelhna sikha hiam, diktatna khop a thumang sikha hiam, athu na man uh sikha na hi uh chih na thei kei ua hia?
english: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?

paite: Himahleh Pathian kiang ah kipahthu om hen; noute khelhna sikha na hita mah le uchin, thuginpi a na kipiakna uh na lungtang taktak un na zuita uhi.
english: But thanks be to God that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.

paite: Khelhna lak a kipan suahtaksak in na omta ua, diktatna sikhate na hong hita uhi.
english: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.

paite: Na sa uh hat louh ziak in mihing dan in thu ka gen hi; na sahiangte uh nitna leh tatlekna ding a tatlekna kiang a sikha ding a na piak phal bang un, tu in na sahiangte uh sianthouna ding in diktatna kiang ah sikha ding in pe zaw un.
english: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.

paite: Khelhna sikhate na hih lai un diktatna lak ah na siang uhi.
english: For when you were servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.

paite: Huai na thil zahpihsate uah, huai lai in gah bang ahia na muh zel uh? Huai thilte tawpna zaw sihna ahi.
english: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.

paite: Tu'n ah bel khelhna lak a hihsiang a om in, Pathian sikhate na hong hih un, sianthouna mu khop in na gah uh na nei uh akei hiam, huai tawpna tangtawn a hinna toh.
english: But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life.

paite: Khelhna man sihna ahi ngal a, Pathian thilthawnpiak bel i Toupa Khrist Jesu ziak in tangtawn a hinna ahi.
english: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

paite: Ahihleh unaute aw, dan in mi adamsung teng atungah vai ahawm nak chih na thei kei ua hia? Dan thei mite kiang ah ka gen ahi.
english: Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?

paite: Pasal nei lai numei apasal damsung teng apasal ah dan a hen in a-om ngal a; himahleh asih in bel pasal lam ah dan a kipan khahkhiak in a-om hi.
english: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.

paite: Huchi a apasal damsung a midang akitenpihleh angkawm chih ahi ding a; apasal asih in bel huai dan a kipan khahkhiak in a-om a, huchi in midang nei taleh leng angkawm ahi kei hi.
english: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.

paite: Huchi ahih mah bang in ka unaute aw, Pathian lam a i gahtheihna ding in midang, misi lak a kipan kaihthoh ngeingei na kitenpih theihna ding un, Khrist pumpi pansan in dan lam ah sihsak in na omta uhi.
english: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might produce fruit to God.

paite: Sa a i om lai un dan ziak a khelhna utna hong suakte'n, i sahiangte ah sihna khop a gah ding in asem nak hi.
english: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.

paite: Tu in bel hon henpa lak ah si khin in, dan a kipan khah in i omta, laigelh lui bang hilou a, Kha a hinna thak a nna i septheihna ding in.
english: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.

paite: Bang i genta dia le? Dan khelhna ahi a hia le? Hilou hial! Himahleh, dan tawn a theih hi keileh khelhna thei lou ding hi ing a; dan in, "Eng ke'n," chi keileh, en chih thei lou ding ka hi.
english: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.”

paite: Himahleh khelhna in, thupiak ziak in, lemtan lai mu in ka sung ah enna chiteng a-omsak hi. Dan pang lou in khelhna kichi asisa ahi ngal a.
english: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.

paite: Tuma lam in kei dan lou in ka na hing a; himahleh thupiak ahong omtak in khelhna ahong halh a, kei ka sita hi.
english: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived and I died.

paite: Huan hinna thuchiam nei thupiak kei a ding in sihna ahong hi chih ka na theita hi.
english: The commandment which was for life, this I found to be for death;

paite: Khelhna in thupiak ziak in, lemtanna la in ahon khem a, huai tungtawn mah in ahon hihlumta hi.
english: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.

paite: Huchi ahih ziak in dan asiangthou a, thupiak leng asiangthou in, adik a, ahoih ahi.
english: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, righteous, and good.

paite: Ahihleh thil hoih kichi kei a ding in sihna ahong hi a hia? Hilou hial! Khelhna tuh kei a ding in sihna ahong hi zawta hi. Huchi in khelhna, khelhna ahi chih alattheihna ding in thil hoih zang in ahon that a; thupiak ziak a khelhna, khelhna pen thupitak ahong hihtheihna ding in.
english: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was producing death in me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceedingly sinful.

paite: Dan ahihleh khalam thil ahi chih i thei ngal ua, kei bel sami, khelhna a khotsa ka hi.
english: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.

paite: Keimah thilhih mah leng ka theisiam thei kei; ka thilhih zel pen lah ka hih ut lam ahi ngal kei a, ka thil huat lamtak ka hih zaw nak ngal a.
english: For I don’t understand what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.

paite: Ka hih ut louh lam ka hih zel in tuh, dan hoih ahi chih pompih ka suak hi.
english: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.

paite: Tu in, huai thilhih pen keimah ahi nawnta kei a, keimah a om khelhna in ahih ahi zaw hi.
english: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

paite: Keimah ah, huai bel, ka taksa ah, thil hoih hih ding lunggulhna zaw keimah ah a-om, himahleh huai thil hoih bangchi sepsuah ding ahia chih ka thei zou kei.
english: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.

paite: Thil hoih hih ka ut pen hih lou in, khelhna hih ka ut louh pen, ka hih zaw kha nak ngal a.
english: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.

paite: Tu in ka hih ut louh lam pen ka hihleh, ahihpa kei ka hi nawnta kei a, ka sung a teng huai khelhna pen ahi zaw hi.
english: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

paite: Huchi in thil hoih hih ka ut laitak in kei ah gitlouhna ahong om nak chih hiai dan ka mukhia hi.
english: I find then the law that, while I desire to do good, evil is present.

paite: Ka lungsim taktak in Pathian dan tung ah ka kipahpih ngal nak a;
english: For I delight in God’s law after the inward person,

paite: himahleh ka sahiangte ah dan tuam a-om chih ka thei, huai in ka lungsim dan adou a, ka sahiangte a khelhna dan om kiang ah sal in ahon pi hi.
english: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.

paite: Genthei hi na lawmlawm ing e! Hiai sihna pumpi a pan kua'n ahia hon suahtaksak ding?
english: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?

paite: Jesu Khrist i Toupa ziak in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen hi. Huchi in keimah tak in zaw ka lungsim in Pathian dan ka sem a, ka taksa in bel gitlouhna dan asem hi.
english: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, sin’s law.

paite: Huaiziak in tu'n ah zaw Khrist Jesu a omte a ding in siam louh tansakna himhim a-omta kei hi.
english: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

paite: Khrist Jesu a Hinna Khadan in khelhna leh sihna dan a kipan hon suaktasakta ngal a.
english: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.

paite: Sa ziak a dan ahat louh a, ahihtheih vual louh, Pathian in, amah Tapa ngei, khelhna sa gilou bang pu in, khelhna thoihna ding a hon sawl in, sa a khelhna om tuh siam louh atangsakta,
english: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,

paite: sadan zui lou a Khadan zui zawte eimah a dan in angiat diktatna tangtun a a-omtheihna ding in.
english: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

paite: Sadan a omte'n salam thilte alunggulh nak ua; Khadan a omte'n bel Khalam thilte alunggulh nak uhi.
english: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.

paite: Sa thilte deih zaw sihna ahi ngal a, Kha thil deih bel hinna leh khamuanna ahi.
english: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;

paite: Sa deihdan zaw Pathian douna ahih ziak in, huai Pathian dan in a-om ngal kei a, om leng a-om thei kei him ahi.
english: because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.

paite: Huchi in sa a omte'n Pathian akipaksak thei kei uhi.
english: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.

paite: Himahleh Pathian Kha noumau a a-om taktakleh sa a om na hi kei ua, Kha a om na hi zaw uhi. Himahleh, kuapeuh Khrist Kha nei lou zaw amah a ahi kei.
english: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.

paite: Khrist Kha noumau a a-om ngalleh khelhna ziak in pumpi asi ahi; kha bel dikna ziak in ahing ahi.
english: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.

paite: Himahleh misi lak a kipan Jesu kaithounawn pa Kha noumau a a-omleh, misi lak a kipan Khrist Jesu kaithounawn pa'n, noumau a om ama Kha pansan in na pumpi sitheite uh ahihhing sam ding hi.
english: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.

paite: Huaiziak in unaute aw, bat i nei; sadan a om ding in sa lak ah bel ahi kei.
english: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

paite: Sadan a na om uleh, na si mahmah ding uh; himahleh pumpi thilhihte Kha a na hihlup zel uleh bel na hing ding uhi.
english: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.

paite: Pathian Kha pi a om peuhmahte zaw, Pathian tate ahi ngal ua.
english: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.

paite: Lau a om nawn ding in bawi hihna kha tang na hi ngal kei ua; himahleh ta hihna kha na tang ua, "Abba, Pa!" chi in i kikou hi,
english: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”

paite: Kha mahmah in, eimah kha toh, Pathian tate i hi chih hon theisak hi.
english: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;

paite: Huan tate i hihleh gouluahpihte i hi uhi; Pathian gouluahte, Khrist luahpihte i hi ua; akiang a pahtawi a i om sam theihna ding a amah i thuakpih taktak nakleh.
english: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.

paite: Tu lel a thuaknate den chiang a i tung a thupina hihlat a om ding toh tehpih tham in ka sep kei hi.
english: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

paite: Thilsiam tengteng in, lamen mahmah in, Pathian tate hong latna angaklah mahmah uhi.
english: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.

paite: Thilsiam tengtengte thil thulim lou thuthu a omsak in a-omta uh; a-ut ua om ahi kei ua, lametna a a-omsakpa ziak ahi zaw hi.
english: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope

paite: Thilsiam tengteng leng siatna sikha a kipan suahtaksak in a-om ding ua, Pathian tate noplenna thupi ah alut ding uhi.
english: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.

paite: Thilsiam tengteng tutan in thum leh nauvei nat thuak in a-om uh chih i thei ngal ua.
english: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

paite: Thilsiamte kia hilou in, eite ngei, Kha gah masa tengte leng, ta hihna kilatna, i pumpi tatna ngak in i lungsim sung uah i mau uhi.
english: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.

paite: Hiai lametna a hotdam lah i hi ngal ua. Himahleh muh theihgige lametna zaw lametna ahi kei. Kua'n amuh theihgige alamen a?
english: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?

paite: I muh louh pen i lametleh bel i ngak teitei hi.
english: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.

paite: Huai bang in, Kha in i hatlouhna ah hon huh zel a; bangchi a thum ding ahia chih i thei ngal kei ua; himahleh Kha in mauna gen vual louh in hon thumsak zel hi.
english: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.

paite: Pathian deihlam bang zel a misiangthoute athumsak zel ziak in, lungtang enpa'n Kha deihlam athei hi.
english: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.

paite: Pathian a-it mite, Ama'n aseh bang a asapte a ding in, ahoihna ding un thil bangkim asemkhawm chih i thei hi.
english: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

paite: Atheihkholhte ama Tapa batpih a om ding in asepkhol a, a-unau tampite lak a ta masapen ahong hihtheihna ding in.
english: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.

paite: Huan asehkholhte asam a; huan asapte siam atangsak lai a; siam atansakte apahtawi lai hi.
english: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.

paite: Huai thu ah bang i genta dia le? Pathian ei lam a apanleh kua'n ahia hon zou thei ding?
english: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

paite: Ama Tapa ngei leng hawi lou a, i vek ua ding a pepa'n thil tengteng athawn in ahon pe tawk kei dia hia?
english: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?

paite: Pathian mitelte kua'n ahia hek ding? Siamtangsakpa lah Pathian ahi ngal a.
english: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.

paite: Kua'n ahia siam louh tangsak ding? Asi pen Khrist Jesu ahi; ahi, athounawn zawta a, Pathian taklam a om hon gensakpa ahi.
english: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.

paite: Khrist itna a kipan kua'n ahia hon khen ding? Gimthuakna in hia, lungngaihna in hia, sawina in hia, taam in hia, vuaktanna in hia, lauhuaina in hia, namsau in hia?
english: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

paite: "Nangmah ziak in nitum in thah in ka om ua; goh ding belam bang a sim ka hi uh," chih gelh bang in.
english: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”

paite: Khen lou hial ding, huaite tengteng ah, hon itpa ziak in, vual tungtuangte sang a tungtuangzaw i hi uhi.
english: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

paite: Sihna hiam, hinna hiam, angelte hiam, thupinate hiam, thil omlelte leh thil hong om dingte hiam thilhihtheihna leh,
english: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,

paite: sanna, thukna leh thilsiam dangte himhim in leng, i Toupa Khrist Jesu a om Pathian itna a kipan hon khen thei kei ding chih diktak in ka theichian hi.
english: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

paite: Khrist ah thutak tak ka gen ahi, ka zuau kei, Kha Siangthou ah ka sia-le-pha theihna in leng hon theihpih hi.
english: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit

paite: Ka lungtang ah haksatna thupitak leh lungngaihna dai thei lou ka pai hi.
english: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.

paite: Ka unaute salam a ka chipihte sik in, kei pen Khrist a kipan hihtuam khop hial in hamsethuak in om leng ka chi hi.
english: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh

paite: Amau Israel mi ahi ngal ua; ta hihna, thupina leh thukhun tengteng, dan piakna leh Pathian nasepna a thuchiam tengteng amau a ahi.
english: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;

paite: Pipute leng amau a ahi ua, salam thu ah Khrist leng amau a kipan a hong pawt ahi a; amah thil tengteng tung a om, tangtawn a phat tuak Pathian ahi. Amen.
english: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.

paite: Himahleh Pathian thu bangmah lou bang a omta ahi kei hi. Israel suante Israel mi ahi vek kei uh;
english: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.

paite: Abraham suante ahih ziak un avek un atate leng ahi kei uhi, "Isak ah na suante akiminloh ding," chih ahi zaw hi.
english: Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac.”

paite: Huai sa tate Pathian tate chihna ahi kei ua, thuchiam tate Abraham suan a seh ahi uh chihna ahi zaw uhi.
english: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as heirs.

paite: Thuchiam pen hiai ahi, "Tu hun bang in ka hong dia, Sarah in tapa anei ding,"
english: For this is a word of promise: “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.”

paite: Huai phet ahi kei Rebekah in leng i pu Isak lak a nau apai lai in,
english: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.

paite: naupangte apian ma uh, sia-le-pha atheih ma un, thilhih ziak hilou in, asampa deihna ziak zaw in, tel lam thu ah Pathian thiltup akiptheihna ding in akiang ah;
english: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls,

paite: "A-upazaw in anaupangzaw nna asem ding," Pathian in achi hi.
english: it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.”

paite: "Jakob ka it a, Esau zaw ka hua," chih gelh bang in.
english: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”

paite: Bang i genta ding ua le? Pathian ah diktatlouhna a-om a hia?
english: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!

paite: Om lou hial! Ama'n, "Ka hehpih peuhmah ka hehpih dia, zah ka ngaihna tung peuhmah ah zah ka ngai ding," chi in Mosi kiang ah agenta hi.
english: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”

paite: Huaiziak in adeihpa ziak ahi kei a, ataipa ziak leng ahi sam kei a, ahehpihpa Pathian ziak ahi zaw hi.
english: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.

paite: Laisiangthou in Pharaoh kiang ah, "Hiai ziak tak in ahi ka hon tunding, nang a ka thilhihtheihna ka taklat theihna ding leh leitung tengteng a ka min athantheihna ding in," achi hi.
english: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”

paite: Huchi in Pathian in zahngaihna asuah ut peuhmah tung ah azahngai a, a-ut peuhmah alungkhauhsak hi.
english: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.

paite: Nou ka kiang ah, bangziak a ama'n moh a hon dem lai ahia? Kua in adeihlam kalh ahia? hon chi ding na hih tuak uhi.
english: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”

paite: Ahi a, mihing aw, nang Pathian nial vialpa kua na hia le? Thilsiam in asiampa kiang ah, "Bang achia hichibang a hon siam,” achi dia hia?
english: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?”

paite: Tungman tang khat a pan bel khat kilawmtak, manphatak a zat ding leh manpha lou deuh a zat ding bawl ding in belvelpa'n tungman tung ah thu anei kei a hia?
english: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?

paite: Pathian in ahehna leh athilhihtheihna latsak a-ut a, ahehna thuak ding a hihsiat a om ding a abawlkholhte tung a ahehpihna hauhdan alatsak a athuakzoh teiteileh bang apoi a?
english: What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,

paite: Huchi a athupina hauhsaknate, azahngaihna thupina tang ding a abawlkholhte tung a asunbuakleh alatsak theihna ding in,
english: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory—

paite: huaite tuh eite i hi ua, Judate lak a kipan kia hilou in, Zentelte lak a kipan a leng sapte ahi.
english: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?

paite: Hosea laibu ah: "Ka mite hi ngei lou, ka mite, ka chi dia; it ngei louhnu leng itnu, ka chita ding hi.
english: As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not beloved.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, akiang ua, ka mite na hi kei uh achihna mun ngei ah Pathian hing tate chih in a- omta ding uh, chih gelh bang in."
english: “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children of the living God.’”

paite: Isai in leng Israel mite thu kikoupih in, "Israel mite zaw tuipi piaunel zah in tam mah le uh, akhosuaksunte kia hotdam in a-om ding uh.
english: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;

paite: Toupa'n kintak a hihzou vek in leitung ah agawt ding thu atangtun dek ngal a," achi hi.
english: for he will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the Lord will make a short work upon the earth.”

paite: Isai in, "Sepaihte' Toupa'n chisuah ding hon na hawisak lou hileh Sodom khua bang in i na omta ding ua, Gomorrah khua bang a bawl in i na omta ding uh," chi a agenkholh bang in.
english: As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.”

paite: Bang i genta dia le? Zentel, diktatna delhloute'n, ginna ziak adiktatna tuh ana phata uhi.
english: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn’t follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith;

paite: Israel, diktatna dan delhte'n, diktatna pen aphazouta kei uh.
english: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.

paite: Bangziak in ahia? Ginna in adelh kei ua, thilhih a muh theih bang a adelh ziak uh ahi. Pukna suang ah apukta uhi.
english: Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone,
