english: Yahweh said to me, “Throw it to the potter—the handsome price that I was valued at by them!” I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huchi in Judah leh Israel kikal a ki-unauna ka suksiat theihna ding in, ka chiangkhun dang 'Kizopna' kichi pen ka tumtan hi.
english: Then I cut apart my other staff, Union, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

paite: "Huan TOUPA'n ka kiang ah, 'Belamching mihai vanzatte kilak nawn in,' achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Take for yourself yet again the equipment of a foolish shepherd.

paite: Ngai in, gamsung ah belamchingmi ka bawlkhe ding hi. Ama'n satkhiak a om dingte aveh kei dia, delhzak a om dingte leng azong sam kei dia, satkeh a omte leng ahihdam sam kei ding, ahoih leng avak sam kei dia, himahleh athaute sa ane ding a, achinte nangawn uh atolsak ding hi.
english: For, behold, I will raise up a shepherd in the land who will not visit those who are cut off, neither will seek those who are scattered, nor heal that which is broken, nor feed that which is sound; but he will eat the meat of the fat sheep, and will tear their hoofs in pieces.

paite: Belamhonte nusia belamchingmi phattuamna bei tung agik hi; aban tung leh amit taklam tung namsau in adou ding a; aban akeugawp kiuhkeuh ding a, amit taklam amial bikbek ding!" achi hi.
english: Woe to the worthless shepherd who leaves the flock! The sword will strike his arm and his right eye. His arm will be completely withered, and his right eye will be totally blinded!”

paite: Judah tungtang a TOUPA thu kilakna: Van phalhkhia a, lei kingakna koih a, mihing sung a mihing kha koihpa, TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: A revelation of Yahweh’s word concerning Israel: Yahweh, who stretches out the heavens and lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within him says:

paite: "Ngai in, kho kimvel a mite a ding in hoina nou in Jerusalem ka bawl ding a, Judah tung ah leng, Jerusalem lakna ah ahi ding hi.
english: “Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of reeling to all the surrounding peoples, and it will also be on Judah in the siege against Jerusalem.

paite: Huan huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, mi tengteng a ding in Jerusalem suang chimtakhuai in ka bawl ding a, ama ziak a tunggik kisate nakpi in liamsak in a-om ding ua, amah dou ding in leitung a nam tengteng akikhawmkhawm ding uhi.
english: It will happen in that day that I will make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all the peoples. All who burden themselves with it will be severely wounded, and all the nations of the earth will be gathered together against it.

paite: Huai ni chiang in lamdangsakna toh sakol chih ka khen ding a, hehna toh atungtuangmi; huan Judah inkote tung ah ka mit ahak ding a mittawtna in mite sakol chih ka gawt ding hi.
english: In that day,” says Yahweh, “I will strike every horse with terror and his rider with madness. I will open my eyes on the house of Judah, and will strike every horse of the peoples with blindness.

paite: Judah hausate'n alungtang un, Jerusalem a tengte'n sepaihte' TOUPA a Pathian uah hatna anei uh," achi ding uhi.
english: The chieftains of Judah will say in their heart, ‘The inhabitants of Jerusalem are my strength in Yahweh of Armies their God.’

paite: Huai ni chiang in Judah hausate sing lak a mei-am bang in ka bawl dia, buhphal lak a meisel bang in akimvel, khut taklam pang leh veilam pang a mite tengteng anegai ding uh. Jerusalem ahihleh ama mun, Jerusalem mahmah ah ahong teng nawn ding hi.
english: In that day I will make the chieftains of Judah like a pan of fire among wood, and like a flaming torch among sheaves. They will devour all the surrounding peoples on the right hand and on the left; and Jerusalem will yet again dwell in their own place, even in Jerusalem.

paite: TOUPA'N amasa in Judah puaninte leng ahondam ding; David inkote thupina leh Jerusalem a tengte thupina Judah tung akiliksaklouhna ding in.
english: Yahweh also will save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of David’s house and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem not be magnified above Judah.

paite: Huai ni chiang in TOUPA'N Jerusalem a tengte ahum ding a, alak ua hatloupen leng huai ni chiang in David bang ahi ding a; David inkote Pathian bang in a-om ding, ama ua pai TOUPA angel bang in.
english: In that day Yahweh will defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem. He who is feeble among them at that day will be like David, and David’s house will be like God, like Yahweh’s angel before them.

paite: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, Jerusalem dou ding a hong kuan nam tengteng hihse ding in ka kuankhe ding hi.
english: It will happen in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

paite: Huan David inkote tung leh Jerusalem a tengte tung ah hehpihna leh thumna kha ka sungbo ding a; asutpa uh lam a-en ding uh; amah asuun ding ua, mi'n atapa neihsun asuun bang in, mi'n ata masa khasetak a akah bang in, amah akah ding uhi.
english: I will pour on David’s house and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem the spirit of grace and of supplication. They will look to me whom they have pierced; and they shall mourn for him as one mourns for his only son, and will grieve bitterly for him as one grieves for his firstborn.

paite: Huai ni chiang in Jerusalem ah suunna thupi a-om ding, Megiddon Phaizang a Hadad-rimmon suunna bang in.
english: In that day there will be a great mourning in Jerusalem, like the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddo.

paite: Huan gam pumpi in asuun dia; inkuan chih in atuam in, David nam inkote atuam in, azite un atuam in; Nathan nam inkote atuam in, azite un atuam in;
english: The land will mourn, every family apart; the family of David’s house apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;

paite: Levi nam inkote atuam in, azite un atuam in; Shimei inkote atuam in, azite un atuam in;
english: the family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of the Shimeites apart, and their wives apart;

paite: inkuan om lai teng a inkuan chih atuam in, azite un atuam in.
english: all the families who remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.

paite: Huai ni chiang in khelhna leh nitna siangsak ding in, David inkote leh Jerusalem a tengte a ding in tuikhuk kihong ahong om ding hi.
english: “In that day there will be a fountain opened to David’s house and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for uncleanness.

paite: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, gam a kipan in milimte minte ka satkhe ding a, theihgige in a-omta kei ding uh; huan zawlneite leh kha nin gam a kipan in ka paikhesak ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: It will come to pass in that day, says Yahweh of Armies, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they will be remembered no more. I will also cause the prophets and the spirit of impurity to pass out of the land.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, zawlnei kuapeuh ahong kilat laileh amah suangtu anu leh apa'n akiang ah, "Na hing kei ding; TOUPA min in zuau na gen a," achi ding ua; amah suangtu anu leh apa'n thu agenkholh ziak in amah asun pailet ding uhi.
english: It will happen that when anyone still prophesies, then his father and his mother who bore him will tell him, ‘You must die, because you speak lies in Yahweh’s name;’ and his father and his mother who bore him will stab him when he prophesies.

paite: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, zawlneite thu agenkholhna uah, amengmuh uah azahlak chiat ding ua; khem ding in samul phan puanak leng asilh sam kei ding uhi.
english: It will happen in that day that the prophets will each be ashamed of his vision when he prophesies; they won’t wear a hairy mantle to deceive,

paite: "Zawlnei ka hi kei, leiletmi ka hi; ka tuailai a kipan a sikha a bawl ka hih khit tak ziak in,” achi zaw ding uhi.
english: but he will say, ‘I am no prophet, I am a tiller of the ground; for I have been made a bondservant from my youth.’

paite: Mi'n akiang ah, na bante kikal a liamnate bang ahia? achi ding ua, huchi in ama'n, "Huaite ka lawmte insung a ka liamnate ahi uh," chi in adawng ding uhi.
english: One will say to him, ‘What are these wounds between your arms?’ Then he will answer, ‘Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.’

paite: "Aw namsau, ka belamchingmi dou ding leh mi ka lawm dou ding in halh in, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Belamchingmi khen in, huan belamte adalh ding uh; huchi in aneute tung ah ka khut ka lik ding hi.
english: “Awake, sword, against my shepherd, and against the man who is close to me,” says Yahweh of Armies. “Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered; and I will turn my hand against the little ones.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, gam tengteng ah, huai a seh nih satkhiak in a-om dia asi ding uhi; himahleh huai a athumna nutsiat in a-om ding, TOUPA'N achi.
english: It shall happen that in all the land,” says Yahweh, “two parts in it will be cut off and die; but the third will be left in it.

paite: Huan aseh thumna mei a paisuak in ka hon tawi dia, dangka hihsiangthou bang in ka hihsiangthou ding a, dangka ettel bang in ka entel ding hi; ka min alou ding ua, amau ka dawng ding; ka mite ahi, ka chi dia, amau, TOUPA ka Pathian ahi," hon chi ding uhi.
english: I will bring the third part into the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will test them like gold is tested. They will call on my name, and I will hear them. I will say, ‘It is my people;’ and they will say, ‘Yahweh is my God.’”

paite: Ngai in, TOUPA ni, na gallak na lak a hawm a a-om ding hun ahong tung hi.
english: Behold, a day of Yahweh comes, when your plunder will be divided within you.

paite: Jerusalem dou a galdou ding in nam tengteng ka kaikhawm ding a; khopi lak in a-om dia, innte lok in leh numeite sualluih in a-om ding uh; khopi kimkhat sal a kaih in a-om ding a, khopi a kipan mikhosuaksunte kuamah satkhiak in a-om kei ding uhi.
english: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city will be taken, the houses rifled, and the women ravished. Half of the city will go out into captivity, and the rest of the people will not be cut off from the city.

paite: Huai ni chiang in TOUPA apaikhe dia, kidou lai a adou bang in huai namte adou ding hi.
english: Then Yahweh will go out and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.

paite: Huai ni chiang in akhe a Jerusalem suahlam a om, Olive Tang sik in adingh dia, huchi in Olive Tang bel suahlam a pan tumlam ah phel nih kisuah in akiphelkhap ding hi, huchi in phaizang thupi mahmah ahong omta ding a; tang kimkhat mallam ah leh akimkhat simlam ah akikhin ding hi. Huchi in phaizang lam ah ka mualte na taikek ding uhi.
english: His feet will stand in that day on the Mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east; and the Mount of Olives will be split in two from east to west, making a very great valley. Half of the mountain will move toward the north, and half of it toward the south.

paite: Mualte phaizang Azal tung ding ahi ngal a; ahi, Judah kumpipa Uzziah dam lai a zinling ma a kipan na taikek uh bang in; huchi in TOUPA ka Pathian ahong pai ding a, akiang ah misiangthoute ahon tonpih ding hi.
english: You shall flee by the valley of my mountains, for the valley of the mountains shall reach to Azel. Yes, you shall flee, just like you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Yahweh my God will come, and all the holy ones with you.

paite: Huan huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, khovot a-om kei dia, vuk a-om sam kei ding.
english: It will happen in that day that there will not be light, cold, or frost.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA a dia theih a om ni khat ahi ding; sun hilou, zan hilou; himahleh hichi ahi ding a, nitaklam in khovak a-om ding hi.
english: It will be a unique day which is known to Yahweh—not day, and not night; but it will come to pass that at evening time there will be light.

paite: Huan huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, Jerusalem a kipan in tui hingte aluangkhe dia; alak ua kimkhat suahlam tuipi ah, alak ua kimkhat tumlam tuipi ah; nipi leh phalbi in a-omden ding hi.
english: It will happen in that day that living waters will go out from Jerusalem, half of them toward the eastern sea, and half of them toward the western sea. It will be so in summer and in winter.

paite: Huchi in leitung tengteng ah TOUPA kumpipa ahi ding; huai ni chiang in TOUPA khat amin khat ahi ding hi.
english: Yahweh will be King over all the earth. In that day Yahweh will be one, and his name one.

paite: Jerusalem sim Geba a kipan Rimmon tan, gam tengteng phaizang asuak ding a; Jerusalem bel Benjamin kongpi a kipan kongpi khatna chiang, aning a kongpi chiang, Hananel insang a kipan kumpipa uain sukna pha a kipan khentuam in a-om ding hi.
english: All the land will be made like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she will be lifted up and will dwell in her place, from Benjamin’s gate to the place of the first gate, to the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananel to the king’s wine presses.

paite: Huai ah mite ateng ding ua, hamsia a-om nawn kei dia; himahleh Jerusalem ah muangtak in ateng ding uhi.
english: Men will dwell therein, and there will be no more curse; but Jerusalem will dwell safely.

paite: Huan Jerusalem kidoupih mite tengteng TOUPA'N agawtna ding hipi bel hiai ahi ding; akhe ua adin lai un, asa uh amuat ding a, amit hawm sung uah amit uh amuat ding, akamsung uah alei uh amuat ding hi.
english: This will be the plague with which Yahweh will strike all the peoples who have fought against Jerusalem: their flesh will consume away while they stand on their feet, and their eyes will consume away in their sockets, and their tongue will consume away in their mouth.

paite: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA a kipan nakpitak a buaina alak uah ahong om ding a; michih in a-invengte khut ah alen tinten ding a, a-invengte khut dou ding in akhut akisa ding hi.
english: It will happen in that day that a great panic from Yahweh will be among them; and they will each seize the hand of his neighbor, and his hand will rise up against the hand of his neighbor.

paite: Judah in leng Jerusalem ah adou dia; kho kim khovel a nam tengteng hauhsakna dangka-eng, dangka, puansilh atam a tam in alakhawm ding hi.
english: Judah also will fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the surrounding nations will be gathered together: gold, silver, and clothing, in great abundance.

paite: Huchibang in hiai gawtna hipi gamsa tengteng leh sakol, sakolneu, sangawngsau leh sabiltungte puaninte ah hiai gawtna a-om ding hi.
english: A plague like this will fall on the horse, on the mule, on the camel, on the donkey, and on all the animals that will be in those camps.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, Jerusalem dou ding a hong kuan nam tengteng lak a nutsiat a om michih akum sik in Kumpipa, sepaihte' TOUPA, be ding leh Biakbukte Ankuangluina nei ding in Jerusalem ah akuantou ding uhi.
english: It will happen that everyone who is left of all the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up from year to year to worship the King, Yahweh of Armies, and to keep the feast of booths.

paite: Hichi ahi ding a, leitung a inkuan tengteng, Jerusalem a Kumpipa, sepaihte' TOUPA, be ding a hohtou lou peuhmah, atung uah vuah azu kei ding hi.
english: It will be that whoever of all the families of the earth doesn’t go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, Yahweh of Armies, on them there will be no rain.

paite: Aigupta inkuan ahohtouh louh ua, ahong pai kei uleh, amaute tung ah leng vuah azu kei ding; Biakbuk Ankuangluina nei ding a hohtou lou namte gawtna ding hipi a-om zaw ding hi.
english: If the family of Egypt doesn’t go up and doesn’t come, neither will it rain on them. This will be the plague with which Yahweh will strike the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.

paite: Hiai Aigupta gawtna bel Biakbuk Ankuangluina nei ding a hoh lou nam tengteng gawtna ahi ding hi.
english: This will be the punishment of Egypt and the punishment of all the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.

paite: Huai ni chiang in sakol longte ah, TOUPA A DING A SIANGTHOU, chih akigelh ding a; TOUPA' inn a belte maitam ma a noubemte bang ahi ding uhi.
english: In that day there will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, “HOLY TO YAHWEH”; and the pots in Yahweh’s house will be like the bowls before the altar.

paite: Ahi, Jerusalem leh Judah a bel tengteng sepaihte' TOUPA a ding in siangthou ahi ding uh; akithoihte ahong pai ding ua huai belte la in kithoihna sa ahuan ding uhi, huai ni chiang in sepaihte' TOUPA' inn ah Kanaan mi a-om nawn kei ding hi.
english: Yes, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to Yahweh of Armies; and all those who sacrifice will come and take of them, and cook in them. In that day there will no longer be a Canaanite in the house of Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huan ka dak a, ngai in mi khat akhut a tehna khau tawi ka mu hi!
english: I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.

paite: Huai lai in ke'n, “Koilam a hoh ding?" ka chi hi. Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Jerusalem, availam bang tan hi a, adunglam bang tan hiam chih thei ding a teh ding in," ahon chi hi.
english: Then I asked, “Where are you going?” He said to me, “To measure Jerusalem, to see what is its width and what is its length.”

paite: Huan ngai in, kei hon houpih angel apaikhia a, amah kituahpih ding in angel dang khat apaikhe nawn hi.
english: Behold, the angel who talked with me went out, and another angel went out to meet him,

paite: Akiang ah, "Tai inla, huai a tangvalpa kiang ah, Jerusalem zaw asung a mipi tampitak leh ganhonte ziak in, kulhbaang om lou khuate bang in luah in a-om ding a,
english: and said to him, “Run, speak to this young man, saying, ‘Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the multitude of men and livestock in it.

paite: huan akimvel a meikuang kulhbaang a umtu ka hi ding a, huchi in asung a athupina ka hih ding ziak in, TOUPA'N achi," chi in.
english: For I,’ says Yahweh, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the middle of her.

paite: Khai, khai, mallam gam a kipan taikek un, TOUPA'N achi; van huih lite bang in nou lah ka hon dalhzaksakta ngal a, TOUPA'N achi.
english: Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,’ says Yahweh; ‘for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the sky,’ says Yahweh.

paite: Khai! Zion ah tai in, nang Babulon tanu toh tengkhawm un.
english: ‘Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.’

paite: Huchibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, thupina khit in nang hon lok namte kiang ah ama'n kei ahon sawl hi; kuapeuh nang hon khoih in amit nauta khoih ahi.
english: For Yahweh of Armies says: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches the apple of his eye.

paite: "Ngai in, atung ua ka khut sing ding ka hi a, huchi in ana uh sepsakte a ding in gallak ahi ding uh; huan sepaihte TOUPA'N kei ahon sawl chih na thei ding uh.
english: For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they will be a plunder to those who served them; and you will know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me.

paite: "Aw Zion tanu, la sa inla, kipak in; ngai in, kei na lak ua teng ding in ka hong pai hi," TOUPA'N achi.
english: Sing and rejoice, daughter of Zion! For behold, I come and I will dwell within you,’ says Yahweh.

paite: Huai ni chiang in TOUPA lam ah nam tampi akizomkhawm ding ua, ka mite ahi ding uh; na lak ah ka teng ding a, huchi in sepaihte' TOUPA'N na kiang ah kei ahon sawl chih na thei ding hi.
english: Many nations shall join themselves to Yahweh in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell among you, and you shall know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me to you.

paite: Huan gam siangthou a atantuam bang in TOUPA'N Judah aluah ding a, Jerusalem ahon tel ding hi.
english: Yahweh will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and will again choose Jerusalem.

paite: Dai un, mi tengteng, TOUPA ma ah a-omna siangthou a kipan in amah akhanglou in athoukheta hi.
english: Be silent, all flesh, before Yahweh; for he has roused himself from his holy habitation!”

paite: Huchi in siampu lianpen Joshua TOUPA angel ma a dingh leh Setan akhut taklam a ahek ding a dingh ahon musak hi.
english: He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before Yahweh’s angel, and Satan standing at his right hand to be his adversary.

paite: TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Aw Setan, TOUPA'N hon tai hen; ahi, Jerusalem telpa TOUPA'N nang hon tai hen; hiai mi kangmei a kipan sahkhiak ahi kei a hia?" achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Yahweh rebuke you, Satan! Yes, Yahweh who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! Isn’t this a burning stick plucked out of the fire?”

paite: Huchi in Joshua puansilh nin a kizem in angel ma ah adingh hi.
english: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and was standing before the angel.

paite: Angel in ama a dinghte kiang ah thu agenta hi. "Amah a kipan puansilh nin lamang un,” chi in. Huan akiang ah, "Ngai in, na thulimlouhna nang a kipan ka lakheta a, puansilh hoih in ka hon zem ding," chi in.
english: He answered and spoke to those who stood before him, saying, “Take the filthy garments off him.” To him he said, “Behold, I have caused your iniquity to pass from you, and I will clothe you with rich clothing.”

paite: Huan ke'n, "Aluzang ah lukhu siang koih uhen," ka chi a. Huchi in aluzang ah lukhu siang akoih ua, puansilh in atuam ua; huchi in TOUPA angel kiangnai ah adingh hi.
english: I said, “Let them set a clean turban on his head.” So they set a clean turban on his head, and clothed him; and Yahweh’s angel was standing by.

paite: Huan TOUPA angel in Joshua kiang ah hiai thu agen a,
english: Yahweh’s angel solemnly assured Joshua, saying,

paite: "Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Ka lampite a na om a, ka thupiak na zuihleh ka inko vai na hawm ding a, ka vaihawmna innte ah thu na nei dia, hiai a dinghte lak a luttheihna ka hon pe ding," chi in.
english: “Yahweh of Armies says: ‘If you will walk in my ways, and if you will follow my instructions, then you also shall judge my house, and shall also keep my courts, and I will give you a place of access among these who stand by.

paite: Aw siampu lianpen Joshua, tu in za un; nang leh na ma a tu na lawite; amau chiamtehna hoih mite ahi ua; ngai in ka sikha Hiang hon pi ding ka hih ziak in.
english: Hear now, Joshua the high priest, you and your fellows who sit before you, for they are men who are a sign; for, behold, I will bring out my servant, the Branch.

paite: Ngai in, Joshua ma a ka suang koih, suang khat mit sagih nei tung ah laigelh ka gelh ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Ni khat thu in gam pumpi thulimlouhna ka lamang ding hi, chi in.
english: For, behold, the stone that I have set before Joshua: on one stone are seven eyes; behold, I will engrave its inscription,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

paite: "Huai ni chiang in, na grepgui nuai leh theipi sing nuai ah michih in a-invengte na chial ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: In that day,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘you will invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree.’”

paite: Huan kei hon houpih angel ahong pai nawn a, mi ihmu lai phawn bang in ahong phawng hi.
english: The angel who talked with me came again and wakened me, as a man who is wakened out of his sleep.

paite: Huan ka kiang ah, "Bang na mu a?" achi a. Ke'n, "Ngai in, dangka-eng khawnvak koihna, adawn a noubem leh apeng a khawnvak sagih omte, huai a khawnvak sagihte toh ka mu, chi in ka dawng hi.
english: He said to me, “What do you see?” I said, “I have seen, and behold, a lamp stand all of gold, with its bowl on the top of it, and its seven lamps on it; there are seven pipes to each of the lamps which are on the top of it;

paite: Huan Olive sing nih akiang a om, khat noubem taklam pang ah khat veilam pang ah," ka chi hi.
english: and two olive trees by it, one on the right side of the bowl, and the other on the left side of it.”

paite: Huan ka dawng a, kei hon houpih angel kiang ah thu ka gen a, "Hiaite bang ahi ua, ka toupa?" ka chi hi.
english: I answered and spoke to the angel who talked with me, saying, “What are these, my lord?”

paite: Kei hon houpih angel in ahon dawng a, ka kiang ah, "Hiaite bang ahi ua na thei kei maw?" achi a. Ke'n, " 'Ii,' Thei lou, ka toupa," ka chi hi.
english: Then the angel who talked with me answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”

paite: Huaitak in ama'n hon dawng a, ka kiang ah thu agen a, "Hiai Zerubbabel kiang a TOUPA thu ahi: Thahatna in hilou, thilhihtheihna in leng hi sam lou, ka Kha in ahi zaw, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is Yahweh’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Kua na hia, Aw tang thupi? Zerubbabel ma ah mun zang na hong hi ding; ama'n atung ah, 'Hehpihna, hehpihna!' chi a kikou in suang poimohpen ahon lakhe ding hi," achi hi.
english: Who are you, great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you are a plain; and he will bring out the capstone with shouts of ‘Grace, grace, to it!’”

paite: Huai lou in TOUPA thu ka kiang ahong tung lai a, hichi in achi:
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Zerubbabel khut in hiai inn suangphum akoih khinta; akhutte mah in azou ding, huan Sepaihte' TOUPA'N na kiang ah kei ahon sawlta chih na thei ding," chi in.
english: “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house. His hands shall also finish it; and you will know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me to you.

paite: Thil neu kipat ni kua'n asimmoh thei a? Zerubbabel khut ah ulum amu ding ua, akipak ding uh. Hiai TOUPA mit sagihte ahi; leitung pumpi kantan a vialtaite.
english: Indeed, who despises the day of small things? For these seven shall rejoice, and shall see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. These are Yahweh’s eyes, which run back and forth through the whole earth.”

paite: Huan ke'n ka dawng a akiang ah, "Khawnvak koihna taklam pang tung a hiai olive sing nihte leh huai aveilam pang a bang ahi ua?" ka chi hi.
english: Then I asked him, “What are these two olive trees on the right side of the lamp stand and on the left side of it?”

paite: Anihveina ding in ka dong nawn a, akiang ah, "Dangka-eng kahiang nihte sik a om, dangka-eng sathau amau a kipan suah zel olive hiang nihte bang ahi ua?" ka chi hi.
english: I asked him the second time, “What are these two olive branches, which are beside the two golden spouts that pour the golden oil out of themselves?”

paite: Ama'n hon dawng a, hiaite bang hi ding ahi ua chih thei lou maw? achi a. Huan ke'n, " 'Ii,' Thei lou, ka toupa," ka chi hi.
english: He answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”

paite: Huaitak in ama'n, "Hiaite leitung pumpi TOUPA kiang a dingh, thaunilh nihte ahi uh," achi hi.
english: Then he said, “These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth.”

paite: Huan ka dak nawn a, ngai in, laibuzial leng ka mu hi.
english: Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Bang na mu a?" hon chi hi. Ke'n, “Laibuzial leng ka mu; huai dunglam tong sawmnih ahi a, availam tong sawm," ka chi hi.
english: He said to me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a flying scroll; its length is twenty cubits, and its width ten cubits.”

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai gam pumpi tung a paikhia hamsia ahi, huai dungzui in kuapeuh guta tu a kipan satkhiak in a-om ding ua; huai dungzui in kuapeuh dikloupi a kichiamte tu a kipan satkhiak in a-om ding uh.
english: Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land, for everyone who steals shall be cut off according to it on the one side; and everyone who swears falsely shall be cut off according to it on the other side.

paite: Ka paikhesak ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi a, gutami inn ah alut ding, ka min a zuau a hamsia zangmi inn ah; huan a-inn ah a-om gige dia, asing asuang toh anegai ding," achi hi.
english: I will cause it to go out,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him who swears falsely by my name; and it will remain in the middle of his house, and will destroy it with its timber and its stones.”

paite: Huchi in kei hon houpih angel apaikhia a, ka kiang ah, "Tu in dak inla, bang ahia paikhia chih en in," achi hi.
english: Then the angel who talked with me came forward and said to me, “Lift up now your eyes and see what this is that is appearing.”

paite: Ke'n, "Bang ahia?" ka chi hi. Ama'n, "Hiai a paikhia 'Ephah' ahi, achi a, huai lou in, hiai, 'Gamsung tengteng a mite khelhna ahi," " achi hi.
english: I said, “What is it?” He said, “This is the ephah basket that is appearing.” He said moreover, “This is their appearance in all the land—

paite: Ngai in, "Ngensik dopkang in a-om a; huai Ephah sung a tu hiai numei ahi," achi lai hi.
english: and behold, a lead cover weighing one talent was lifted up—and there was a woman sitting in the middle of the ephah basket.”

paite: Huan ama'n, “Hiai gitlouhna ahi," achi a; huai Ephah sung a-ensuak a; huai agong ah ngen gik angasuk hi.
english: He said, “This is Wickedness;” and he threw her down into the middle of the ephah basket; and he threw the lead weight on its mouth.

paite: Huchi in ka dak a, ngai in, numei nih hong paikhia ua, akhate uah huih a-om hi. Tuivapi bang in kha anei ua; huchi in lei leh van kikal ah huai Ephah adomtou uhi.
english: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, there were two women; and the wind was in their wings. Now they had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the ephah basket between earth and the sky.

paite: Kei hon houpih angel kiang ah, "Hiaite'n koilam a Ephah po ding uh ahia?" ka chi hi.
english: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, “Where are these carrying the ephah basket?”

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Shinar gam a inn ding lam ding in. Huan abawl zoh chiang un ama muntak ah koih in a-om ding," achi hi.
english: He said to me, “To build her a house in the land of Shinar. When it is prepared, she will be set there in her own place.”

paite: Huchi in ka dak nawn a, ngai in, tang nih kikal a kipan in kangtalai li a hong paikhia ua, huai tangte dal tang ahi uhi.
english: Again I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, four chariots came out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of bronze.

paite: Kangtalai khat in sakol san anei ua kangtalai nihna in sakol vom;
english: In the first chariot were red horses. In the second chariot were black horses.

paite: kangtalai thumna in sakol ngou; kangtalai lina in sakol puang hat anei uhi.
english: In the third chariot were white horses. In the fourth chariot were dappled horses, all of them powerful.

paite: Huan kei hon houpih angel ka dong a akiang ah, "Hiaite bang ahi ua, ka toupa?" ka chi hi.
english: Then I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these, my lord?”

paite: Angel in ahon dawng a, ka kiang ah, "Hiaite van huih lite, leitung pumpi Toupa ma a va dingh khin a paikhete ahi uh.
english: The angel answered me, “These are the four winds of the sky, which go out from standing before the Lord of all the earth.

paite: Sakol vomte omna kangtalai mallam gam ah apaikhia ua; amau zui in angoute tumlam ah apawtkhia ua; apuangte simlam zuan in apawtkhia uhi."
english: The one with the black horses goes out toward the north country; and the white went out after them; and the dappled went out toward the south country.”

paite: Huan sakolte apaikhia ua, lei kantan a avialvak theihna ding uh angaklah uhi. Ama'n, "Hiai a kipan pai unla, lei kantan in vialvak un,” achi a, huchi in lei kantan in avialvak uhi.
english: The strong went out, and sought to go that they might walk back and forth through the earth. He said, “Go around and through the earth!” So they walked back and forth through the earth.

paite: Huchi in ahon sam a, ka kiang ah thu agen a, "Ngai in, mallam gam zuan a paite'n mallam gam ah ka kha akhawlsakta uh," achi hi.
english: Then he called to me, and spoke to me, saying, “Behold, those who go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.”

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi:
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: Babulon a kipan saltang hong pai Heldai, Tobijah leh Jedaiah a pan thilpiak la in; ani mah in pai inla, Zephaniah tapa Josiah inn ah lut in.
english: “Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah; and come the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, where they have come from Babylon.

paite: Ahi, amau a kipan dangka leh dangka-eng la inla, kumpi lukhute bawl in, Jehozadak tapa Joshua, siampu lianpen luzang ah khusak in.
english: Yes, take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them on the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest;

paite: Huan akiang ah thu gen inla, huchibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Ngai in, mi amin Kahiang: amun a kipan ahong kakhe ding a, ama'n TOUPA tempul alam ding hi.
english: and speak to him, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says, “Behold, the man whose name is the Branch! He will grow up out of his place; and he will build Yahweh’s temple.

paite: Ama'n TOUPA tempul alam ding a, thupina silhsak in a-om ding a, alaltutphah tung ah atu dia, vai ahawm ding; alaltutphah tung ah siampu ahi ding; huchi in amau gel kikal ah lemna thuhilhna a-om ding hi.
english: He will build Yahweh’s temple. He will bear the glory, and will sit and rule on his throne. He will be a priest on his throne. The counsel of peace will be between them both.

paite: Kumpi lukhute Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah leh Zephaniah tapa Hen kiang ah, TOUPA tempul atheihgigena ding in a-om ding uhi.
english: The crowns shall be to Helem, to Tobijah, to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in Yahweh’s temple.

paite: Huan gamlapi a omte ahong pai ding ua TOUPA tempul ahong lampih ding ua, huchi in sepaihte' TOUPA'N na kiang a kei hon sawl ahi chih na thei ding hi. Huchi in hiai ahong tung ding, TOUPA na Pathian aw pilvangtak a na man uleh, achi, chi in.
english: Those who are far off shall come and build in Yahweh’s temple; and you shall know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me to you. This will happen, if you will diligently obey Yahweh your God’s voice.”’”

paite: Kumpipa Darias akum lina in hichi ahong hi a, Kisleu kha, akha kuana, ani li ni in, Zekariah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: In the fourth year of King Darius, Yahweh’s word came to Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.

paite: Huan amau Bethel a omte'n Serezer leh Regem-melek leh amite uh TOUPA deihsakna ngen ding in asawl ua,
english: The people of Bethel sent Sharezer and Regem Melech and their men to entreat Yahweh’s favor,

paite: sepaihte' TOUPA' inn a siampute kiang leh zawlneite kiang a thu va gen ding in, "Kum tampi sung ka na hihsa bang in akha ngana ah kei-le-kei kihihtuam in, kap a suun in an ka ngawl diam?" chi in.
english: and to speak to the priests of the house of Yahweh of Armies and to the prophets, saying, “Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?”

paite: Huai lai in sepaihte ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
english: Then the word of Yahweh of Armies came to me, saying,

paite: "Gam a mite tengteng kiang leh siampute kiang ah thugen in. Hiai kum sawmsagih sung, akha ngana leh akha sagihna a an na ngolh chiang un, kei a ding in, keimah ding in na ngawlta uhia?
english: “Speak to all the people of the land and to the priests, saying, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh month for these seventy years, did you at all fast to me, really to me?

paite: Na nek chiang un, na dawn chiang un, noumau a mah ding in na ne un, na dawn uh ahi kei maw?
english: When you eat and when you drink, don’t you eat for yourselves and drink for yourselves?

paite: "Jerusalem akiluah lai leh ahauhsak lai a, akimvel a khopite leh Sim leh gam niam gam akiluah lai a zawlnei masate zang a TOUPA tangkoupih hiai thute ahi kei ua hia? chi in," chi in.
english: Aren’t these the words which Yahweh proclaimed by the former prophets when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and its cities around her, and the South and the lowland were inhabited?’”

paite: Huan TOUPA thu Zekariah kiang ah hiai bang in ahong tung hi.
english: Yahweh’s word came to Zechariah, saying,

paite: Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N thu agen hi: "Vaihawmna dik hih un, michih in a-unau tung ah zahngaihna leh lainatna ensak hen.
english: “Thus has Yahweh of Armies spoken, saying, ‘Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother.

paite: Meithai nuaisiah kei un, pabeite, mikhual, gentheite leng, na lak ua kuamah in alungtang in a-unau siatna ding gilou ngaihtuah kei hen, chi in,” achi hi.
english: Don’t oppress the widow, the fatherless, the foreigner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart.’

paite: Himahleh ngaihkhiak a-ut kei ua, genhaktak in akiheimang ua, azaklouhna ding un abil uh ahum uhi.
english: But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.

paite: Ahi, suang tak bang in alungtang uh abawl ua, huchi keileh dan aza kha ding ua, zawlnei masate khut a ama Kha a sepaihte' TOUPA'N athukhakte aza kha ding uh; huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA a kipan nakpi a hehna ahong tung hi.
english: Yes, they made their hearts as hard as flint, lest they might hear the law and the words which Yahweh of Armies had sent by his Spirit by the former prophets. Therefore great wrath came from Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, "Ka kikou lai a angaihkhiak louh ziak un akikou chiang un leng ka ngaikhe sam kei ding," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: It has come to pass that, as he called and they refused to listen, so they will call and I will not listen,” said Yahweh of Armies;

paite: "Himahleh atheih louh uh namte lam ah pingpei in amaute ka delhsak ding. Huchi in gam amau nung in akisegawp ding a, kuamah in akantan un alehkik kei ding uh; gam nuam asukgawp ziak un, achi," chi in.
english: “but I will scatter them with a whirlwind among all the nations which they have not known. Thus the land was desolate after them, so that no man passed through nor returned; for they made the pleasant land desolate.”

paite: Huchi in sepaihte ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn a;
english: The word of Yahweh of Armies came to me.

paite: "Hichibang in sepaihte! TOUPA'N achi: Thikthusetak in Zion ka deihthoh a, nakpitak a hehna toh amah a ding in phatuam ka ngai hi," chi in.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I am jealous for her with great wrath.”

paite: Hichibang in TOUPA'N achi: Zion ah kiksak in ka om a, Jerusalem lai ah ka teng ding; Jerusalem bel Thutak khopi, sepaihte' TOUPA tang, tang siangthou akichi ding hi.
english: Yahweh says: “I have returned to Zion, and will dwell in the middle of Jerusalem. Jerusalem shall be called ‘The City of Truth;’ and the mountain of Yahweh of Armies, ‘The Holy Mountain.’”

paite: Hichi in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Jerusalem kongzingte ah putekte leh pitekte ahong khosa ding ua, a-upat ziak un akhut uah chiangkhun akhun chiat ding uh.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Old men and old women will again dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, every man with his staff in his hand because of their old age.

paite: Khopi kongzingte a kimawl in numei leh pasal naupangte adim ding hi.
english: The streets of the city will be full of boys and girls playing in its streets.”

paite: Hichibang in sepaihte' ToUPA'N achi: Huai ni chiang a hiai mite lak a khosuaksunte mit a lamdang ahihleh, kei mit ah leng alamdang sam kei dia hia? sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “If it is marvelous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in those days, should it also be marvelous in my eyes?” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Ngai in, suahlam gam a kipan leh tumlam gam a kipan, ka mite ka hondam ding hi.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Behold, I will save my people from the east country and from the west country.

paite: Amau ka hon pikhawm ding a, Jerusalem lai ah ateng ding ua; ka mite ahi ding uh, thutak leh diktatna ah, a Pathian uh ka hi ding hi.
english: I will bring them, and they will dwell within Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.”

paite: Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "TOUPA' inn suangphum phum ni a kipan a hiai nite a zawlneite kam a kipan a hiai thu zate'n, tempul akilam theihna ding in noute khut hatsak un.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Let your hands be strong, you who hear in these days these words from the mouth of the prophets who were in the day that the foundation of the house of Yahweh of Armies was laid, even the temple, that it might be built.

paite: Huai nite malam a mihing a dia kilohna a-om louh a, aganta dia leng kilohna a-om sam louh ziak in; melma ziak in apawtkhia hiam hong lut hiam a ding in leng muanna himhim a-omsak kei a, mi tengteng michih a-invengte dou in ka koih hi.
english: For before those days there was no wages for man nor any wages for an animal, neither was there any peace to him who went out or came in, because of the adversary. For I set all men everyone against his neighbor.

paite: Himahleh tu in zaw hiai mite lak a khosuaksunte tung ah tuma lam nite bang in ka om kei ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: But now I will not be to the remnant of this people as in the former days,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huan haichi pawi a om ding ahi ngal a; grepgui in agah asuang ding a, leitung in apung a-omsak ding a, vante'n adaitui uh ape ding uh; huchi in hiai mite lak a omlaite hiai thil tengteng ka luahsak ding hi.
english: “For the seed of peace and the vine will yield its fruit, and the ground will give its increase, and the heavens will give their dew. I will cause the remnant of this people to inherit all these things.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, namte lak a hamsia na hih tak bang un, Aw Judah inkote leh Israel inkote, huchibang mah in nou ka hon hondam ding a; vualzawlna na hi ding uh; lau kei un, himahleh na khutte uh hatsak un."
english: It shall come to pass that, as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you, and you shall be a blessing. Don’t be afraid. Let your hands be strong.”

paite: Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "Na pipute un ahon hihheh lai ua, na tung ua gilou hih ding ka tup bang in, huchi in ka nem tuan kei, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi:
english: For Yahweh of Armies says: “As I thought to do evil to you when your fathers provoked me to wrath,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and I didn’t repent,

paite: Huchi in Jerusalem tung leh Judah inkote tung ah hoih hih ding tulai nite in ka tum nawnta hi; lau kei un.
english: so again I have thought in these days to do good to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah. Don’t be afraid.

paite: Na hih ding uh thil hiaite ahi: Michih in a-invengte toh thutak kihilh un; na kongpite uah thutak leh lemna vaihawmna hih un;
english: These are the things that you shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbor. Execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates,

paite: na lak ua kuamah in a-invengte siatna ding na lungtang uah gilou ngaihtuah kei un; thuchiam diklou deih kei un; hiaite tengteng ka thil huat lam ahi uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbor, and love no false oath; for all these are things that I hate,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huan sepaihte ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn hi,
english: The word of Yahweh of Armies came to me.

paite: Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "Kha lina an ngawlna, ngana an ngawlna, sagihna an ngawlna leh sawmna an ngawlna, Judah inkote a ding in nopna leh kipahna, ankuangluina vualnopna ahi ding hi; huaiziak in thutak leh lemna deih in," chi in.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months shall be for the house of Judah joy, gladness, and cheerful feasts. Therefore love truth and peace.”

paite: Huchi in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "Hichibang in ahong om lai ding, mite leh khopi tampite a pan ahong pai ding ua;
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Many peoples and the inhabitants of many cities will yet come.

paite: huan, khopi khat a teng mite khopi dang a tengte kiang ah apai ding ua, TOUPA deihsakna ngen ding leh sepaihte' TOUPA zong ding in kintak in kuan ni; kei leng ka kuan ding, achi ding uhi.
english: The inhabitants of one will go to another, saying, ‘Let’s go speedily to entreat the favor of Yahweh, and to seek Yahweh of Armies. I will go also.’

paite: Ahi, mi tampite leh nam hatte Jerusalem a TOUPA sepaihte zong ding leh TOUPA deihsakna ngen ding in ahong kuan ding uhi.
english: Yes, many peoples and strong nations will come to seek Yahweh of Armies in Jerusalem and to entreat the favor of Yahweh.”

paite: Huchibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahong hi ding a, namte pau tengteng a kipan mi sawm in Juda mipa puanten alen ding ua, na kiang ah ka pai ding uh, na kiang ah Pathian a-om chih ka za ngal ua, achi ding uh," chi in.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “In those days, ten men out of all the languages of the nations will take hold of the skirt of him who is a Jew, saying, ‘We will go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.’”

paite: Hadrak gam dou in TOUPA thu a kilak a, "Damaskas akhawlna mun ahi ding. Aram khopite TOUPA a ahi, Israel nam tengteng ahih bang un,
english: A revelation. Yahweh’s word is against the land of Hadrach, and will rest upon Damascus— for the eye of man and of all the tribes of Israel is toward Yahweh—

paite: huan pil mah le uh agamgitpih Hamath, Tura leh Sidon tung atung ding hi.
english: and Hamath, also, which borders on it, Tyre and Sidon, because they are very wise.

paite: Tura kulh muanhuaitak in akilamkhia in, dangka leivui bang in vum venvon in, kongzingte buannawi bang in dangka-eng hoih in dim mahleh.
english: Tyre built herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver like the dust, and fine gold like the mire of the streets.

paite: Ngai in, TOUPA'N amah neih-le-lam alamang ding a, tuipi a ahauhsakna ahihse ding; huchi in meikuang a nekgaih ahong hi ding hi.
english: Behold, the Lord will dispossess her, and he will strike her power in the sea; and she will be devoured with fire.

paite: "Ashkelon in huai amu dia, alau ding; Gaza in leng amu dia, nakpi a suknat in a-om ding; Ekron, alametna zahlakna ahi dia; Gaza a kipan kumpipa amangthang ding a, Ashkelon luah in a-om kei ding hi.
english: Ashkelon will see it, and fear; Gaza also, and will writhe in agony; as will Ekron, for her expectation will be disappointed; and the king will perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon will not be inhabited.

paite: Huchi in Ashdod ah chi siangloute ateng ding ua, Philistiate kisaktheihna ka satkhe ding hi.
english: Foreigners will dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

paite: Huan akam a kipan asisan ka lamang ding a, ahate kikal a kipan in akihhuainate; huchi in amah leng i Pathian a ding in khosuaksun ahi ding hi; Jebus mi bang in Judah leh Ekron ah hausa ahi ding hi.
english: I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth; and he also will be a remnant for our God; and he will be as a chieftain in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.

paite: Huan sepaih pawlte ziak in akimvel in ka inn ka um ding, huchi a kuamah apaisuak uhiam akik nawnlouhna ding un; huchi in nuaisiahmi in apaltan nawnta kei ding; tu in ka mit mahmah in ka muta hi," achi hi.
english: I will encamp around my house against the army, that no one pass through or return; and no oppressor will pass through them any more: for now I have seen with my eyes.

paite: Aw Zion tanu, nakpi mahmah in kipak in; Aw Jerusalem tanu, kikou in; ngai in, na kumpipa kiniamkhiak in, sabiltung tung, sabiltungnou tuan ngei nailouhna tung a tuang in na kiang ah ahong hi; amah adiktat a, hotdamna anei.
english: Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your King comes to you! He is righteous, and having salvation; lowly, and riding on a donkey, even on a colt, the foal of a donkey.

paite: Ephraim a kipan kangtalai leh Jerusalem a kipan sakol ka satkhe ding a, kidouna thalpeu satkhiak in a-om ding a; namte kiang ah lemna thu agen ding; huchi in agam tuipi a kipan tuipi tan, luipi a kipan lei tawpnate tan ahi ding hi.
english: I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem. The battle bow will be cut off; and he will speak peace to the nations. His dominion will be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.

paite: Nang tungthu ah leng, na thukhun sisan ziak in tui omlouhna kokhuk a kipan in na suangkul tangte ka sawlkheta hi.
english: As for you also, because of the blood of your covenant, I have set free your prisoners from the pit in which is no water.

paite: Lametna suangkul a tangte, kulh muanhuai lam ah kihei un; tuni mahmah in na tung ah azahnih in ka hon dinkik ding chih ka puang hi.
english: Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you.

paite: Judah thalpeu bang in ka laikulta a, Ephraim thal a bawl in thalpeu ah ka bulhta hi. Aw Zion, na tapate dou ding in na tapate ka tokthou ding, Aw Grik, huchi in mihat namsau bang in, nang ka hon bawl ding hi.
english: For indeed I bend Judah as a bow for me. I have loaded the bow with Ephraim. I will stir up your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece, and will make you like the sword of a mighty man.

paite: Huchi in atung ah TOUPA akimu ding a, khophia bang in athal apaikhe ding; Toupa PATHIAN in pengkul amut dia, simlam pingpei toh apaikhe ding hi.
english: Yahweh will be seen over them. His arrow will flash like lightning. The Lord Yahweh will blow the trumpet, and will go with whirlwinds of the south.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N amaute ahunkhe ding a; suang sailim tangte asikden ding ua; anegai ding ua, uain bang in asisan uh adawn ding uh; noubemte bang in adim ding ua, maitam ningte bang in akawt ding uhi.
english: Yahweh of Armies will defend them. They will destroy and overcome with sling stones. They will drink, and roar as through wine. They will be filled like bowls, like the corners of the altar.

paite: Huai ni chiang in TOUPA a Pathian un abelamhonte bang in amau ahondam ding a; lallukhu a suangmantamte bang in agam ah atang ding uhi.
english: Yahweh their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people; for they are like the jewels of a crown, lifted on high over his land.

paite: Ahi, ahoihna alian mahmah a, akilawmna athupi mahmah a; buh-le-bal in tangvalte atai ding a, uain thak in nungakte atai ding uhi.
english: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine the virgins.

paite: Judah kumpipa, Ammon tapa Josiah dam lai a, Kushi tapa, Gedaliah tapa, Amariah tapa, Hezekiah tapa, Zephaniah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung.
english: Yahweh’s word which came to Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah.

paite: "Leitung a thil om tengteng ka hihbei sipsip ding," TOUPA'N achi.
english: I will utterly sweep away everything from the surface of the earth, says Yahweh.

paite: "Mihing leh sa ka hihbei ding; van a tungleng vasate, tuipi a ngasate, giloute toh kipalpuknate ka hihbei ding; leitung a pan mihing ka satkhe ding," TOUPA'N achi.
english: I will sweep away man and animal. I will sweep away the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and the heaps of rubble with the wicked. I will cut off man from the surface of the earth, says Yahweh.

paite: "Judah tung leh Jerusalem a tengte tung ah ka khut ka lik ding a; hiai mun a kipan in Baal omlaite leh milim biak ching siampute min ka satkhe ding;
english: I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place—the name of the idolatrous and pagan priests,

paite: Intung a van aksihon bia; TOUPA kiang a kun a kichiam khin napi a, Milkom mai a kichiamte;
english: those who worship the army of the sky on the housetops, those who worship and swear by Yahweh and also swear by Malcam,

paite: TOUPA zuihna a kipan kilehheite leh TOUPA zong lou a, amah kanloute ka satkhe ding hi.”
english: those who have turned back from following Yahweh, and those who haven’t sought Yahweh nor inquired after him.

paite: Toupa PATHIAN ma ah dai sipsip in, TOUPA ni lah anaita ngal a; TOUPA'N lah kithoihna abawlkhol khin a, amisapte ahihsiangthou khinta hi.
english: Be silent at the presence of the Lord Yahweh, for the day of Yahweh is at hand. For Yahweh has prepared a sacrifice. He has consecrated his guests.

paite: TOUPA kithoih ni in hichi ahi ding, heutute leh kumpipa tapate leh gamdang puan a kizem huchibang tengteng ka gawt ding hi.
english: It will happen in the day of Yahweh’s sacrifice that I will punish the princes, the king’s sons, and all those who are clothed with foreign clothing.

paite: Huai ni chiang in, phual kan a tawmte, hiamgamna leh khemna a apu uh inn hihdimte, ka gawt ding hi.
english: In that day, I will punish all those who leap over the threshold, who fill their master’s house with violence and deceit.

paite: "Huai ni chiang in," TOUPA'N achi, Ngasa Kongpi a pan kah thawmging a-om dia, Kongpi Nihna a pan mauna leh mualte a kipan nakpitak a siatna husa a-om ding.
english: In that day, says Yahweh, there will be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, a wailing from the second quarter, and a great crashing from the hills.

paite: Mau un, nou Maktes a tengte, na sumsin mite tengteng a-omta kei ua; dangka teh mite satkhiak ahita uhi.
english: Wail, you inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the people of Canaan are undone! All those who were loaded with silver are cut off.

paite: Huai hun chiang in hichi ahi ding hi, khawnvak tawi in Jerusalem zong ding ka hi; mi uain dawn a tengden, alungtang ua, TOUPA'N thil hoih hi in thil gilou leng ahih sam kei ding chi mite ka gawt ding hi.
english: It will happen at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and I will punish the men who are settled on their dregs, who say in their heart, “Yahweh will not do good, neither will he do evil.”

paite: Huchi in ahauhna uh gallak ahong hi dia, a-innte uh asegawp ding; innte alam ding ua, himahleh aluah kei ding uh; grephuante abawl ding ua, himahleh huai a uain adawn kei ding uhi.
english: Their wealth will become a plunder, and their houses a desolation. Yes, they will build houses, but won’t inhabit them. They will plant vineyards, but won’t drink their wine.

paite: TOUPA ni thupi anai a, anai a, akinoh mahmah, TOUPA ni in kah aw athupi ding a; mi thilhihtheitakte huai ah akap loloih ding uhi.
english: The great day of Yahweh is near. It is near and hurries greatly, the voice of the day of Yahweh. The mighty man cries there bitterly.

paite: Huai ni thangpaihna ni ahi, lungzinna leh dahna ni, mialna leh lungkiakna ni, meipi leh khomial bikbek ahi;
english: That day is a day of wrath, a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,

paite: pengkul leh gallauna ni, khopi daikaih siatna, aning a insangte siat ni.
english: a day of the trumpet and alarm against the fortified cities and against the high battlements.

paite: Huan mite tung ah dahna ka tun ding a, mittawte bang in avak ding uh, TOUPA tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak un; huchi in asisan uh leivui bang leh asa uh eklei bang in butkhiak in a-om ding hi.
english: I will bring such distress on men that they will walk like blind men because they have sinned against Yahweh. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.

paite: TOUPA thangpaihna ni chiang in adangka uhiam adangka-eng uhiam in amaute atan thei kei ding; himahleh amullitna mei in gam pumpi akangbei ding a; hihbei a om ding ahih ziak in, beina mulkimhuai, gamsung a tengte tengteng tung ah a-om ding hi.
english: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them in the day of Yahweh’s wrath, but the whole land will be devoured by the fire of his jealousy; for he will make an end, yes, a terrible end, of all those who dwell in the land.

paite: Kikaikhawm un, ahi, kikaikhawm un, zumna nei lou namte aw;
english: Gather yourselves together, yes, gather together, you nation that has no shame,

paite: thupiak akuankhiak ma a, buhsi bang a hon mutmang ma in, na tung ua TOUPA hehna kihtakhuai ahong tun ma in, na tung ua TOUPA hehna ni ahong tun ma in kikaikhawm un.
english: before the appointed time when the day passes as the chaff, before the fierce anger of Yahweh comes on you, before the day of Yahweh’s anger comes on you.

paite: Avaihawmna zui, nou lei a minunnem tengtengte aw, TOUPA zong un; diktatna zong un, migitna zong un; TOUPA hehna ni ah sel in na om kha thei uhi.
english: Seek Yahweh, all you humble of the land, who have kept his ordinances. Seek righteousness. Seek humility. It may be that you will be hidden in the day of Yahweh’s anger.

paite: Gaza lah nutsiat in a-om dia, Ashkelon hihgawp in; suntang lai in Ashdod ahawlkhe ding ua, Ekron akizungkalh ding hi.
english: For Gaza will be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation. They will drive out Ashdod at noonday, and Ekron will be rooted up.

paite: Tuipi piau a teng Kereth namte aw na tung uh agik hi! TOUPA thu in noute ahon dem hi, Kanaan aw, Philistiate gam a teng om lou ding in ka hon hihgawp ding.
english: Woe to the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! Yahweh’s word is against you, Canaan, the land of the Philistines. I will destroy you until there is no inhabitant.

paite: Huchi in tuipi, piaute louhing nou mun ahi ding a, belamchingte innte leh belamhonte ahuangte ahi ding hi.
english: The sea coast will be pastures, with cottages for shepherds and folds for flocks.

paite: Huai piau bel Judah inkuan khosuaksunte a ding ahi ding; huai ah abelamhonte uh avak ding uh; nitaklam in Ashkelon innte ah akual ding uh; TOUPA a Pathian un amaute aveh in, sal a atang uh pikhe nawn ding ahih ziak in.
english: The coast will be for the remnant of the house of Judah. They will find pasture. In the houses of Ashkelon, they will lie down in the evening, for Yahweh, their God, will visit them and restore them.

paite: Moab hon kouna leh Ammon tate gensiatna ka zata hi. Akigitpihte uh tung a kiliansak a, ka mite gam dou asawm uhi.
english: I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the children of Ammon, with which they have reproached my people and magnified themselves against their border.

paite: Huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian ka hin bang in, "Chihtaktak in Moab, Sodom bang ahi ding a, Ammon tate Gomorrah bang, lou bineite leh chikhukte mun sia asuakden ding a, ka mi omlaite'n alok ding ua, ka nam omlaite'n amaute aluah ding uhi.”
english: Therefore, as I live, says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, surely Moab will be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, a possession of nettles and salt pits, and a perpetual desolation. The remnant of my people will plunder them, and the survivors of my nation will inherit them.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA mite tung a akiletsak ua, akou ziak un, akisak-theihna ziak un sawi in a-om ding uhi.
english: This they will have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Amaute tung ah TOUPA alauhuai ding a; lei pathiante tengteng kial in ahihbei chiang in michih in amau mun chiat leh namte' tuikulh gam tengteng nangawn in amah abe ding uhi.
english: Yahweh will be awesome to them, for he will famish all the gods of the land. Men will worship him, everyone from his place, even all the shores of the nations.

paite: Nou Ethiopiate leng, ka namsau a thah a om ding na hi uhi.
english: You Cushites also, you will be killed by my sword.

paite: Huan ama'n mallam dou in akhut alikkhe ding a, Assuria ahihse ding; Nineveh akisegawp ding a, huchi in gamdai bang in akeu ding uh.
english: He will stretch out his hand against the north, destroy Assyria, and will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as the wilderness.

paite: Alai ah belamte akual ding ua, namte ganta tengteng; vangawngsau leh sakuh achial tungnung ah agiak ding ua; tohlet ah a-aw in la asa ding uh; sangkilte ah siatgawpna a-om ding; sidar sing a nasepte ahihsiat ziak in.
english: Herds will lie down in the middle of her, all kinds of animals. Both the pelican and the porcupine will lodge in its capitals. Their calls will echo through the windows. Desolation will be in the thresholds, for he has laid bare the cedar beams.

paite: Hiai khopi nuamsa pilvang loutak a teng a, "Alungtang a keimah ka hi, kei lou kuamah dang a-om kei," chi ahi; bangchidan a hong segawp a, gantate a dia kualna ding hi ahia; kuapeuh akiang a pai in anuihsan in, akhut alehkhum ding uhi.
english: This is the joyous city that lived carelessly, that said in her heart, “I am, and there is no one besides me.” How she has become a desolation, a place for animals to lie down in! Everyone who passes by her will hiss and shake their fists.

paite: Khopi helhat leh buah, nuaisiah ching tung agik hi!
english: Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, the oppressing city!

paite: Kuamah thu angaikhe kei a, bawlhoihna leng asang thei kei. amuanna leng TOUPA ah a-om kei a; a Pathian anaih sam kei hi.
english: She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in Yahweh. She didn’t draw near to her God.

paite: Asung a aheutu liante uh humpinelkai humham ahi ua, avaihawmte uh lah nitaklam ngehon, azingchiang a nek ding nuse ut lou bang ahi uh.
english: Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.

paite: Azawlneite uh lah mizuauthei leh lepchiah ahi ua; asiampute un mun siangthou ahihbuah ua, dan tung ah ahiamgam uhi.
english: Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.

paite: Asung ua TOUPA bel adiktat a; thil thulim lou ahih kei ding; zingsang teng in avaihawm khovak ah alak a, avuaksuak ngei kei a; himahleh midiktatloute'n zaw zumna athei kei uhi.
english: Yahweh, within her, is righteous. He will do no wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light. He doesn’t fail, but the unjust know no shame.

paite: Namte ka satkheta a, a-insangte uh akisegawp hi; akongzingte uh ka susia a, kuamah apai kei uhi; akhopite uh hihsiat in a-om a, huchi a mi kuamah om lou in, ateng leng a-om kei uhi.
english: I have cut off nations. Their battlements are desolate. I have made their streets waste, so that no one passes by. Their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, so that there is no inhabitant.

paite: Chihtaktak in kei na hon kihta ding ua, bawlhoihna na kipahpih ding, ka chi a; huchi in atenna satkhiak in a-om kei dia, amah tungtang a sehsa tengteng bang in; himahleh beltak in athou ua, ahih tengteng uh asesak uhi.
english: I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction,” so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her. But they rose early and corrupted all their doings.

paite: "Huaiziak in mat ding zuan a ka thoh ni atun masiah hon na ngak un," TOUPA'N achi. Namte kaihkhawm ka tup ahi ngal a, lalgamte ka suktuah a atung ua ka hehna ka sunbuak theihna ding in, ka thangpaihna lauhuai tengteng; ka mullitna mei a leitung pumpi nekgaih a om ding lah ahi ngal a.
english: “Therefore wait for me”, says Yahweh, “until the day that I rise up to the prey, for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms to pour on them my indignation, even all my fierce anger, for all the earth will be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.

paite: Huai hun chiang a mite'n TOUPA min aloh ua, thukhat sat a amah nna aseptheihna ding un, akiang uah muk siangthou ka pe ding hi.
english: For then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that they may all call on Yahweh’s name, to serve him shoulder to shoulder.

paite: Ethiopia luite khen lam a kipan gimlim hal mite, dalhsa ka mite tanu mahmah in ka thillat ahon tawi ding hi.
english: From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.

paite: Huai ni chiang in ka tung a na tatlekna, na thilhihte tengteng ziak in na zahlak kei ding; huai hun chiang a na lak a na mikisathei leh ki-uangsakte lakhe ding ka hih ziak in, huchi in ka tang siangthou ah na ki-uangsak nawnta kei ding uhi.
english: In that day you will not be disappointed for all your doings in which you have transgressed against me; for then I will take away out from among you your proudly exulting ones, and you will no more be arrogant in my holy mountain.

paite: Himahleh na lak ah mi gimthuak leh genthei ka nuse ding a, TOUPA ah amuang ding uhi.
english: But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in Yahweh’s name.

paite: Israel khosuaksunte'n gilou ahih kei ding ua, zuau agen sam kei ding uh; akam uah leng lei khemhat akimu kei ding hi; ne a, lum a, amaute kuamah in ahihlau louh ding ziak un.
english: The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity nor speak lies, neither will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth, for they will feed and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.”

paite: La sa in, Aw Zion tanu; kikou in, aw Israel! Jerusalem tanu aw, na lungtang tengteng toh kipak inla, nuamsa in!
english: Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.

paite: TOUPA'N na vaihawmnate alamangta a, na melma adelhkhia a, na lak ah Israel kumpipa, TOUPA a-om hi; gilou na lau nawn kei ding hi.
english: Yahweh has taken away your judgments. He has thrown out your enemy. The King of Israel, Yahweh, is among you. You will not be afraid of evil any more.

paite: Huai ni chiang in, Jerusalem kiang ah, "Lau ke'n," chih ahi ding; Aw Zion, na khutte ze-olsak ke'n.
english: In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands be weak.”

paite: Na lak ah TOUPA na Pathian a-om hi, hondam ding mihat; na itna ah akhawl ding, la sa in na tung ah anuam ding hi.
english: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.

paite: Khawmpi kulmut ziak a dahnate, noute a dia puakgik leh gensiatna hiite ka lamang ding hi.
english: I will remove those who grieve about the appointed feasts from you. They are a burden and a reproach to you.

paite: Ngai in, huai hun chiang in, nang hihgimte tengteng ka bawl ding a, panpih kiphamohnu ka hondam ding a, hawlmang a omnu ka lakhawm ding; huchi in leitung pumpi a azahlakna uh ana omkhitnate ah, phatna leh minthanna amaute ka pe ding hi.
english: Behold, at that time I will deal with all those who afflict you; and I will save those who are lame and gather those who were driven away. I will give them praise and honor, whose shame has been in all the earth.

paite: Huai hun chiang in ka hon la nawn ding a, huai hun chiang in nou ka hon kaikhawm ding hi; na mitmuh ua na saltanna ua kipan ka hon pi nawn hun chiang in, lei a mi tengteng lak ah min leh phatna in nou ka hon bawl ding, TOUPA'N achita hi.
english: At that time I will bring you in, and at that time I will gather you; for I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says Yahweh.
